slp1: yo hyAjijIvizedBEkzyaM karmaRA nEva kenacit । samAramBAnbuBUzeta hatasvastirakiYcanaH । sarvalokezu viKyAto na putrapaSusaMhitaH ॥6॥

text: kāpālīṃ nṛpa pāpiṣṭhāṃ vṛttimāsthāya jīvataḥ । santyajya rājyamṛddhaṃ te loko'yaṃ kiṃ vadiṣyati ॥7॥
html:
kāpālīṃ nṛpa pāpiṣṭhāṃ vṛttimāsthāya jīvataḥ ।
santyajya rājyamṛddhaṃ te loko'yaṃ kiṃ vadiṣyati ॥7॥
slp1: kApAlIM nfpa pApizWAM vfttimAsTAya jIvataH । santyajya rAjyamfdDaM te loko'yaM kiM vadizyati ॥7॥

text: sarvārambhānsamutsṛjya hatasvastirakiñcanaḥ । kasmādāśaṃsase bhaikṣyaṃ cartuṃ prākṛtavatprabho ॥8॥
html:
sarvārambhānsamutsṛjya hatasvastirakiñcanaḥ ।
kasmādāśaṃsase bhaikṣyaṃ cartuṃ prākṛtavatprabho ॥8॥
slp1: sarvAramBAnsamutsfjya hatasvastirakiYcanaH । kasmAdASaMsase BEkzyaM cartuM prAkftavatpraBo ॥8॥

text: asminrājakule jāto jitvā kṛtsnāṃ vasundharām । dharmārthāvakhilau hitvā vanaṃ mauḍhyātpratiṣṭhase ॥9॥
html:
asminrājakule jāto jitvā kṛtsnāṃ vasundharām ।
dharmārthāvakhilau hitvā vanaṃ mauḍhyātpratiṣṭhase ॥9॥
slp1: asminrAjakule jAto jitvA kftsnAM vasunDarAm । DarmArTAvaKilO hitvA vanaM mOQyAtpratizWase ॥9॥

text: yadīmāni havīṃṣīha vimathiṣyantyasādhavaḥ । bhavatā viprahīṇāni prāptaṃ tvāmeva kilbiṣam ॥10॥
html:
yadīmāni havīṃṣīha vimathiṣyantyasādhavaḥ ।
bhavatā viprahīṇāni prāptaṃ tvāmeva kilbiṣam ॥10॥
slp1: yadImAni havIMzIha vimaTizyantyasADavaH । BavatA viprahIRAni prAptaM tvAmeva kilbizam ॥10॥

text: ākiñcanyamanāśāsyamiti vai nahuṣo'bravīt । kṛtyā nṛśaṃsā hyadhane dhigastvadhanatāmiha ॥11॥
html:
ākiñcanyamanāśāsyamiti vai nahuṣo'bravīt ।
kṛtyā nṛśaṃsā hyadhane dhigastvadhanatāmiha ॥11॥
slp1: AkiYcanyamanASAsyamiti vE nahuzo'bravIt । kftyA nfSaMsA hyaDane DigastvaDanatAmiha ॥11॥

text: aśvastanamṛṣīṇāṃ hi vidyate veda tadbhavān । yaṃ tvimaṃ dharmamityāhurdhanādeṣa pravartate ॥12॥
html:
aśvastanamṛṣīṇāṃ hi vidyate veda tadbhavān ।
yaṃ tvimaṃ dharmamityāhurdhanādeṣa pravartate ॥12॥
slp1: aSvastanamfzIRAM hi vidyate veda tadBavAn । yaM tvimaM DarmamityAhurDanAdeza pravartate ॥12॥

text: dharmaṃ saṃharate tasya dhanaṃ harati yasya yaḥ । hriyamāṇe dhane rājanvayaṃ kasya kṣamemahi ॥13॥
html:
dharmaṃ saṃharate tasya dhanaṃ harati yasya yaḥ ।
hriyamāṇe dhane rājanvayaṃ kasya kṣamemahi ॥13॥
slp1: DarmaM saMharate tasya DanaM harati yasya yaH । hriyamARe Dane rAjanvayaM kasya kzamemahi ॥13॥

text: abhiśastavatprapaśyanti daridraṃ pārśvataḥ sthitam । dāridryaṃ pātakaṃ loke kastacchaṃsitumarhati ॥14॥
html:
abhiśastavatprapaśyanti daridraṃ pārśvataḥ sthitam ।
dāridryaṃ pātakaṃ loke kastacchaṃsitumarhati ॥14॥
slp1: aBiSastavatprapaSyanti daridraM pArSvataH sTitam । dAridryaM pAtakaM loke kastacCaMsitumarhati ॥14॥

text: patitaḥ śocyate rājannirdhanaścāpi śocyate । viśeṣaṃ nādhigacchāmi patitasyādhanasya ca ॥15॥
html:
patitaḥ śocyate rājannirdhanaścāpi śocyate ।
viśeṣaṃ nādhigacchāmi patitasyādhanasya ca ॥15॥
slp1: patitaH Socyate rAjannirDanaScApi Socyate । viSezaM nADigacCAmi patitasyADanasya ca ॥15॥

text: arthebhyo hi vivṛddhebhyaḥ saṃbhṛtebhyastatastataḥ । kriyāḥ sarvāḥ pravartante parvatebhya ivāpagāḥ ॥16॥
html:
arthebhyo hi vivṛddhebhyaḥ saṃbhṛtebhyastatastataḥ ।
kriyāḥ sarvāḥ pravartante parvatebhya ivāpagāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: arTeByo hi vivfdDeByaH saMBfteByastatastataH । kriyAH sarvAH pravartante parvateBya ivApagAH ॥16॥

text: ardhāddharmaśca kāmaśca svargaścaiva narādhipa । prāṇayātrā hi lokasya vinārthaṃ na prasidhyati ॥17॥
html:
ardhāddharmaśca kāmaśca svargaścaiva narādhipa ।
prāṇayātrā hi lokasya vinārthaṃ na prasidhyati ॥17॥
slp1: arDAdDarmaSca kAmaSca svargaScEva narADipa । prARayAtrA hi lokasya vinArTaM na prasiDyati ॥17॥

text: arthena hi vihīnasya puruṣasyālpamedhasaḥ । vyucchidyante kriyāḥ sarvā grīṣme kusarito yathā ॥18॥
html:
arthena hi vihīnasya puruṣasyālpamedhasaḥ ।
vyucchidyante kriyāḥ sarvā grīṣme kusarito yathā ॥18॥
slp1: arTena hi vihInasya puruzasyAlpameDasaH । vyucCidyante kriyAH sarvA grIzme kusarito yaTA ॥18॥

text: yasyārthāstasya mitrāṇi yasyārthāstasya bāndhavāḥ । yasyārthāḥ sa pumāṁlloke yasyārthāḥ sa ca paṇḍitaḥ ॥19॥
html:
yasyārthāstasya mitrāṇi yasyārthāstasya bāndhavāḥ ।
yasyārthāḥ sa pumāṁlloke yasyārthāḥ sa ca paṇḍitaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: yasyArTAstasya mitrARi yasyArTAstasya bAnDavAH । yasyArTAH sa pumAṁlloke yasyArTAH sa ca paRqitaH ॥19॥

text: adhanenārthakāmena nārthaḥ śakyo vivitsatā । arthairarthā nibadhyante gajairiva mahāgajāḥ ॥20॥
html:
adhanenārthakāmena nārthaḥ śakyo vivitsatā ।
arthairarthā nibadhyante gajairiva mahāgajāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: aDanenArTakAmena nArTaH Sakyo vivitsatA । arTErarTA nibaDyante gajEriva mahAgajAH ॥20॥

text: dharmaḥ kāmaśca svargaśca harṣaḥ krodhaḥ śrutaṃ damaḥ । arthādetāni sarvāṇi pravartante narādhipa ॥21॥
html:
dharmaḥ kāmaśca svargaśca harṣaḥ krodhaḥ śrutaṃ damaḥ ।
arthādetāni sarvāṇi pravartante narādhipa ॥21॥
slp1: DarmaH kAmaSca svargaSca harzaH kroDaH SrutaM damaH । arTAdetAni sarvARi pravartante narADipa ॥21॥

text: dhanātkulaṃ prabhavati dhanāddharmaḥ pravartate । nādhanasyāstyayaṃ loko na paraḥ puruṣottama ॥22॥
html:
dhanātkulaṃ prabhavati dhanāddharmaḥ pravartate ।
nādhanasyāstyayaṃ loko na paraḥ puruṣottama ॥22॥
slp1: DanAtkulaM praBavati DanAdDarmaH pravartate । nADanasyAstyayaM loko na paraH puruzottama ॥22॥

text: nādhano dharmakṛtyāni yathāvadanutiṣṭhati । dhanāddhi dharmaḥ sravati śailādgirinadī yathā ॥23॥
html:
nādhano dharmakṛtyāni yathāvadanutiṣṭhati ।
dhanāddhi dharmaḥ sravati śailādgirinadī yathā ॥23॥
slp1: nADano DarmakftyAni yaTAvadanutizWati । DanAdDi DarmaH sravati SElAdgirinadI yaTA ॥23॥

text: yaḥ kṛśāśvaḥ kṛśagavaḥ kṛśabhṛtyaḥ kṛśātithiḥ । sa vai rājankṛśo nāma na śarīrakṛśaḥ kṛśaḥ ॥24॥
html:
yaḥ kṛśāśvaḥ kṛśagavaḥ kṛśabhṛtyaḥ kṛśātithiḥ ।
sa vai rājankṛśo nāma na śarīrakṛśaḥ kṛśaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: yaH kfSASvaH kfSagavaH kfSaBftyaH kfSAtiTiH । sa vE rAjankfSo nAma na SarIrakfSaH kfSaH ॥24॥

text: avekṣasva yathānyāyaṃ paśya devāsuraṃ yathā । rājankimanyajjñātīnāṃ vadhādṛdhyanti devatāḥ ॥25॥
html:
avekṣasva yathānyāyaṃ paśya devāsuraṃ yathā ।
rājankimanyajjñātīnāṃ vadhādṛdhyanti devatāḥ ॥25॥
slp1: avekzasva yaTAnyAyaM paSya devAsuraM yaTA । rAjankimanyajjYAtInAM vaDAdfDyanti devatAH ॥25॥

text: na ceddhartavyamanyasya kathaṃ taddharmamārabhet । etāvāneva vedeṣu niścayaḥ kavibhiḥ kṛtaḥ ॥26॥
html:
na ceddhartavyamanyasya kathaṃ taddharmamārabhet ।
etāvāneva vedeṣu niścayaḥ kavibhiḥ kṛtaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: na cedDartavyamanyasya kaTaM tadDarmamAraBet । etAvAneva vedezu niScayaH kaviBiH kftaH ॥26॥

text: adhyetavyā trayī vidyā bhavitavyaṃ vipaścitā । sarvathā dhanamāhāryaṃ yaṣṭavyaṃ cāpi yatnataḥ ॥27॥
html:
adhyetavyā trayī vidyā bhavitavyaṃ vipaścitā ।
sarvathā dhanamāhāryaṃ yaṣṭavyaṃ cāpi yatnataḥ ॥27॥
slp1: aDyetavyA trayI vidyA BavitavyaM vipaScitA । sarvaTA DanamAhAryaM yazwavyaM cApi yatnataH ॥27॥

text: drohāddevairavāptāni divi sthānāni sarvaśaḥ । iti devā vyavasitā vedavādāśca śāśvatāḥ ॥28॥
html:
drohāddevairavāptāni divi sthānāni sarvaśaḥ ।
iti devā vyavasitā vedavādāśca śāśvatāḥ ॥28॥
slp1: drohAddevEravAptAni divi sTAnAni sarvaSaH । iti devA vyavasitA vedavAdASca SASvatAH ॥28॥

text: adhīyante tapasyanti yajante yājayanti ca । kṛtsnaṃ tadeva ca śreyo yadapyādadate'nyataḥ ॥29॥
html:
adhīyante tapasyanti yajante yājayanti ca ।
kṛtsnaṃ tadeva ca śreyo yadapyādadate'nyataḥ ॥29॥
slp1: aDIyante tapasyanti yajante yAjayanti ca । kftsnaM tadeva ca Sreyo yadapyAdadate'nyataH ॥29॥

text: na paśyāmo'napahṛtaṃ dhanaṃ kiñcitkvacidvayam । evameva hi rājāno jayanti pṛthivīmimām ॥30॥
html:
na paśyāmo'napahṛtaṃ dhanaṃ kiñcitkvacidvayam ।
evameva hi rājāno jayanti pṛthivīmimām ॥30॥
slp1: na paSyAmo'napahftaM DanaM kiYcitkvacidvayam । evameva hi rAjAno jayanti pfTivImimAm ॥30॥

text: jitvā mamatvaṃ bruvate putrā iva piturdhane । rājarṣayo jitasvargā dharmo hyeṣāṃ nigadyate ॥31॥
html:
jitvā mamatvaṃ bruvate putrā iva piturdhane ।
rājarṣayo jitasvargā dharmo hyeṣāṃ nigadyate ॥31॥
slp1: jitvA mamatvaM bruvate putrA iva piturDane । rAjarzayo jitasvargA Darmo hyezAM nigadyate ॥31॥

text: yathaiva pūrṇādudadheḥ syandantyāpo diśo daśa । evaṃ rājakulādvittaṃ pṛthivīṃ pratitiṣṭhati ॥32॥
html:
yathaiva pūrṇādudadheḥ syandantyāpo diśo daśa ।
evaṃ rājakulādvittaṃ pṛthivīṃ pratitiṣṭhati ॥32॥
slp1: yaTEva pUrRAdudaDeH syandantyApo diSo daSa । evaM rAjakulAdvittaM pfTivIM pratitizWati ॥32॥

text: āsīdiyaṃ dilīpasya nṛgasya nahuṣasya ca । ambarīṣasya māndhātuḥ pṛthivī sā tvayi sthitā ॥33॥
html:
āsīdiyaṃ dilīpasya nṛgasya nahuṣasya ca ।
ambarīṣasya māndhātuḥ pṛthivī sā tvayi sthitā ॥33॥
slp1: AsIdiyaM dilIpasya nfgasya nahuzasya ca । ambarIzasya mAnDAtuH pfTivI sA tvayi sTitA ॥33॥

text: sa tvāṃ dravyamayo yajñaḥ samprāptaḥ sarvadakṣiṇaḥ । taṃ cenna yajase rājanprāptastvaṃ devakilbiṣam ॥34॥
html:
sa tvāṃ dravyamayo yajñaḥ samprāptaḥ sarvadakṣiṇaḥ ।
taṃ cenna yajase rājanprāptastvaṃ devakilbiṣam ॥34॥
slp1: sa tvAM dravyamayo yajYaH samprAptaH sarvadakziRaH । taM cenna yajase rAjanprAptastvaM devakilbizam ॥34॥

text: yeṣāṃ rājāśvamedhena yajate dakṣiṇāvatā । upetya tasyāvabhṛthaṃ pūtāḥ sarve bhavanti te ॥35॥
html:
yeṣāṃ rājāśvamedhena yajate dakṣiṇāvatā ।
upetya tasyāvabhṛthaṃ pūtāḥ sarve bhavanti te ॥35॥
slp1: yezAM rAjASvameDena yajate dakziRAvatA । upetya tasyAvaBfTaM pUtAH sarve Bavanti te ॥35॥

text: viśvarūpo mahādevaḥ sarvamedhe mahāmakhe । juhāva sarvabhūtāni tathaivātmānamātmanā ॥36॥
html:
viśvarūpo mahādevaḥ sarvamedhe mahāmakhe ।
juhāva sarvabhūtāni tathaivātmānamātmanā ॥36॥
slp1: viSvarUpo mahAdevaH sarvameDe mahAmaKe । juhAva sarvaBUtAni taTEvAtmAnamAtmanA ॥36॥

text: śāśvato'yaṃ bhūtipatho nāsyāntamanuśuśruma । mahāndāśarathaḥ panthā mā rājankāpathaṃ gamaḥ] ॥37॥
html:
śāśvato'yaṃ bhūtipatho nāsyāntamanuśuśruma ।
mahāndāśarathaḥ panthā mā rājankāpathaṃ gamaḥ] ॥37॥
slp1: SASvato'yaM BUtipaTo nAsyAntamanuSuSruma । mahAndASaraTaH panTA mA rAjankApaTaM gamaH] ॥37॥

text: muhūrtaṃ tāvadekāgro manaḥśrotre'ntarātmani । dhārayitvāpi te śrutvā rocatāṃ vacanaṃ mama ॥1॥
html:
muhūrtaṃ tāvadekāgro manaḥśrotre'ntarātmani ।
dhārayitvāpi te śrutvā rocatāṃ vacanaṃ mama ॥1॥
slp1: muhUrtaM tAvadekAgro manaHSrotre'ntarAtmani । DArayitvApi te SrutvA rocatAM vacanaM mama ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: sārthagamyamahaṃ mārgaṃ na jātu tvatkṛte punaḥ । gaccheyaṃ tadgamiṣyāmi hitvā grāmyasukhānyuta ॥2॥
html:
sārthagamyamahaṃ mārgaṃ na jātu tvatkṛte punaḥ ।
gaccheyaṃ tadgamiṣyāmi hitvā grāmyasukhānyuta ॥2॥
slp1: sArTagamyamahaM mArgaM na jAtu tvatkfte punaH । gacCeyaM tadgamizyAmi hitvA grAmyasuKAnyuta ॥2॥

text: kṣemyaścaikākinā gamyaḥ panthāḥ ko'stīti pṛccha mām । atha vā necchasi praṣṭumapṛcchannapi me śṛṇu ॥3॥
html:
kṣemyaścaikākinā gamyaḥ panthāḥ ko'stīti pṛccha mām ।
atha vā necchasi praṣṭumapṛcchannapi me śṛṇu ॥3॥
slp1: kzemyaScEkAkinA gamyaH panTAH ko'stIti pfcCa mAm । aTa vA necCasi prazwumapfcCannapi me SfRu ॥3॥

text: hitvā grāmyasukhācāraṃ tapyamāno mahattapaḥ । araṇye phalamūlāśī cariṣyāmi mṛgaiḥ saha ॥4॥
html:
hitvā grāmyasukhācāraṃ tapyamāno mahattapaḥ ।
araṇye phalamūlāśī cariṣyāmi mṛgaiḥ saha ॥4॥
slp1: hitvA grAmyasuKAcAraM tapyamAno mahattapaH । araRye PalamUlASI carizyAmi mfgEH saha ॥4॥

text: juhvāno'gniṃ yathākālamubhau kālāvupaspṛśan । kṛśaḥ parimitāhāraścarmacīrajaṭādharaḥ ॥5॥
html:
juhvāno'gniṃ yathākālamubhau kālāvupaspṛśan ।
kṛśaḥ parimitāhāraścarmacīrajaṭādharaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: juhvAno'gniM yaTAkAlamuBO kAlAvupaspfSan । kfSaH parimitAhAraScarmacIrajawADaraH ॥5॥

text: śītavātātapasahaḥ kṣutpipāsāśramakṣamaḥ । tapasā vidhidṛṣṭena śarīramupaśoṣayan ॥6॥
html:
śītavātātapasahaḥ kṣutpipāsāśramakṣamaḥ ।
tapasā vidhidṛṣṭena śarīramupaśoṣayan ॥6॥
slp1: SItavAtAtapasahaH kzutpipAsASramakzamaH । tapasA viDidfzwena SarIramupaSozayan ॥6॥

text: manaḥkarṇasukhā nityaṃ śṛṇvannuccāvacā giraḥ । muditānāmaraṇyeṣu vasatāṃ mṛgapakṣiṇām ॥7॥
html:
manaḥkarṇasukhā nityaṃ śṛṇvannuccāvacā giraḥ ।
muditānāmaraṇyeṣu vasatāṃ mṛgapakṣiṇām ॥7॥
slp1: manaHkarRasuKA nityaM SfRvannuccAvacA giraH । muditAnAmaraRyezu vasatAM mfgapakziRAm ॥7॥

text: ājighranpeśalāngandhānphullānāṃ vṛkṣavīrudhām । nānārūpānvane paśyanramaṇīyānvanaukasaḥ ॥8॥
html:
ājighranpeśalāngandhānphullānāṃ vṛkṣavīrudhām ।
nānārūpānvane paśyanramaṇīyānvanaukasaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: AjiGranpeSalAnganDAnPullAnAM vfkzavIruDAm । nAnArUpAnvane paSyanramaRIyAnvanOkasaH ॥8॥

text: vānaprasthajanasyāpi darśanaṃ kulavāsinaḥ । nāpriyāṇyācariṣyāmi kiṃ punargrāmavāsinām ॥9॥
html:
vānaprasthajanasyāpi darśanaṃ kulavāsinaḥ ।
nāpriyāṇyācariṣyāmi kiṃ punargrāmavāsinām ॥9॥
slp1: vAnaprasTajanasyApi darSanaM kulavAsinaH । nApriyARyAcarizyAmi kiM punargrAmavAsinAm ॥9॥

text: ekāntaśīlī vimṛśanpakvāpakvena vartayan । pitṝndevāṃśca vanyena vāgbhiradbhiśca tarpayan ॥10॥
html:
ekāntaśīlī vimṛśanpakvāpakvena vartayan ।
pitṝndevāṃśca vanyena vāgbhiradbhiśca tarpayan ॥10॥
slp1: ekAntaSIlI vimfSanpakvApakvena vartayan । pitFndevAMSca vanyena vAgBiradBiSca tarpayan ॥10॥

text: evamāraṇyaśāstrāṇāmugramugrataraṃ vidhim । sevamānaḥ pratīkṣiṣye dehasyāsya samāpanam ॥11॥
html:
evamāraṇyaśāstrāṇāmugramugrataraṃ vidhim ।
sevamānaḥ pratīkṣiṣye dehasyāsya samāpanam ॥11॥
slp1: evamAraRyaSAstrARAmugramugrataraM viDim । sevamAnaH pratIkzizye dehasyAsya samApanam ॥11॥

text: atha vaiko'hamekāhamekaikasminvanaspatau । caranbhaikṣyaṃ munirmuṇḍaḥ kṣapayiṣye kalevaram ॥12॥
html:
atha vaiko'hamekāhamekaikasminvanaspatau ।
caranbhaikṣyaṃ munirmuṇḍaḥ kṣapayiṣye kalevaram ॥12॥
slp1: aTa vEko'hamekAhamekEkasminvanaspatO । caranBEkzyaM munirmuRqaH kzapayizye kalevaram ॥12॥

text: pāṃsubhiḥ samavacchannaḥ śūnyāgārapratiśrayaḥ । vṛkṣamūlaniketo vā tyaktasarvapriyāpriyaḥ ॥13॥
html:
pāṃsubhiḥ samavacchannaḥ śūnyāgārapratiśrayaḥ ।
vṛkṣamūlaniketo vā tyaktasarvapriyāpriyaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: pAMsuBiH samavacCannaH SUnyAgArapratiSrayaH । vfkzamUlaniketo vA tyaktasarvapriyApriyaH ॥13॥

text: na śocanna prahṛṣyaṃśca tulyanindātmasaṃstutiḥ । nirāśīrnirmamo bhūtvā nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ ॥14॥
html:
na śocanna prahṛṣyaṃśca tulyanindātmasaṃstutiḥ ।
nirāśīrnirmamo bhūtvā nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: na Socanna prahfzyaMSca tulyanindAtmasaMstutiH । nirASIrnirmamo BUtvA nirdvandvo nizparigrahaH ॥14॥

text: ātmārāmaḥ prasannātmā jaḍāndhabadhirākṛtiḥ । akurvāṇaḥ paraiḥ kāñcitsaṃvidaṃ jātu kenacit ॥15॥
html:
ātmārāmaḥ prasannātmā jaḍāndhabadhirākṛtiḥ ।
akurvāṇaḥ paraiḥ kāñcitsaṃvidaṃ jātu kenacit ॥15॥
slp1: AtmArAmaH prasannAtmA jaqAnDabaDirAkftiH । akurvARaH parEH kAYcitsaMvidaM jAtu kenacit ॥15॥

text: jaṅgamājaṅgamānsarvānnavihiṃsaṃścaturvidhān । prajāḥ sarvāḥ svadharmasthāḥ samaḥ prāṇabhṛtaḥ prati ॥16॥
html:
jaṅgamājaṅgamānsarvānnavihiṃsaṃścaturvidhān ।
prajāḥ sarvāḥ svadharmasthāḥ samaḥ prāṇabhṛtaḥ prati ॥16॥
slp1: jaNgamAjaNgamAnsarvAnnavihiMsaMScaturviDAn । prajAH sarvAH svaDarmasTAH samaH prARaBftaH prati ॥16॥

text: na cāpyavahasankañcinna kurvanbhrukuṭīṃ kvacit । prasannavadano nityaṃ sarvendriyasusaṃyataḥ ॥17॥
html:
na cāpyavahasankañcinna kurvanbhrukuṭīṃ kvacit ।
prasannavadano nityaṃ sarvendriyasusaṃyataḥ ॥17॥
slp1: na cApyavahasankaYcinna kurvanBrukuwIM kvacit । prasannavadano nityaM sarvendriyasusaMyataH ॥17॥

text: apṛcchankasyacinmārgaṃ vrajanyenaiva kenacit । na deśaṃ na diśaṃ kāñcidgantumicchanviśeṣataḥ ॥18॥
html:
apṛcchankasyacinmārgaṃ vrajanyenaiva kenacit ।
na deśaṃ na diśaṃ kāñcidgantumicchanviśeṣataḥ ॥18॥
slp1: apfcCankasyacinmArgaM vrajanyenEva kenacit । na deSaM na diSaM kAYcidgantumicCanviSezataH ॥18॥

text: gamane nirapekṣaśca paścādanavalokayan । ṛjuḥ praṇihito gacchaṃstrasasthāvaravarjakaḥ ॥19॥
html:
gamane nirapekṣaśca paścādanavalokayan ।
ṛjuḥ praṇihito gacchaṃstrasasthāvaravarjakaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: gamane nirapekzaSca paScAdanavalokayan । fjuH praRihito gacCaMstrasasTAvaravarjakaH ॥19॥

text: svabhāvastu prayātyagre prabhavantyaśanānyapi । dvandvāni ca viruddhāni tāni sarvāṇyacintayan ॥20॥
html:
svabhāvastu prayātyagre prabhavantyaśanānyapi ।
dvandvāni ca viruddhāni tāni sarvāṇyacintayan ॥20॥
slp1: svaBAvastu prayAtyagre praBavantyaSanAnyapi । dvandvAni ca virudDAni tAni sarvARyacintayan ॥20॥

text: alpaṃ vāsvādu vā bhojyaṃ pūrvālābhena jātu cit । anyeṣvapi caraṁllābhamalābhe sapta pūrayan ॥21॥
html:
alpaṃ vāsvādu vā bhojyaṃ pūrvālābhena jātu cit ।
anyeṣvapi caraṁllābhamalābhe sapta pūrayan ॥21॥
slp1: alpaM vAsvAdu vA BojyaM pUrvAlABena jAtu cit । anyezvapi caraṁllABamalABe sapta pUrayan ॥21॥

text: vidhūme nyastamusale vyaṅgāre bhuktavajjane । atītapātrasañcāre kāle vigatabhikṣuke ॥22॥
html:
vidhūme nyastamusale vyaṅgāre bhuktavajjane ।
atītapātrasañcāre kāle vigatabhikṣuke ॥22॥
slp1: viDUme nyastamusale vyaNgAre Buktavajjane । atItapAtrasaYcAre kAle vigataBikzuke ॥22॥

text: ekakālaṃ caranbhaikṣyaṃ gṛhe dve caiva pañca ca । spṛhāpāśānvimucyāhaṃ cariṣyāmi mahīmimām ॥23॥
html:
ekakālaṃ caranbhaikṣyaṃ gṛhe dve caiva pañca ca ।
spṛhāpāśānvimucyāhaṃ cariṣyāmi mahīmimām ॥23॥
slp1: ekakAlaM caranBEkzyaM gfhe dve cEva paYca ca । spfhApASAnvimucyAhaM carizyAmi mahImimAm ॥23॥

text: na jijīviṣuvatkiñcinna mumūrṣuvadācaran । jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ caiva nābhinandanna ca dviṣan ॥24॥
html:
na jijīviṣuvatkiñcinna mumūrṣuvadācaran ।
jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ caiva nābhinandanna ca dviṣan ॥24॥
slp1: na jijIvizuvatkiYcinna mumUrzuvadAcaran । jIvitaM maraRaM cEva nABinandanna ca dvizan ॥24॥

text: vāsyaikaṃ takṣato bāhuṃ candanenaikamukṣataḥ । nākalyāṇaṃ na kalyāṇaṃ cintayannubhayostayoḥ ॥25॥
html:
vāsyaikaṃ takṣato bāhuṃ candanenaikamukṣataḥ ।
nākalyāṇaṃ na kalyāṇaṃ cintayannubhayostayoḥ ॥25॥
slp1: vAsyEkaM takzato bAhuM candanenEkamukzataH । nAkalyARaM na kalyARaM cintayannuBayostayoH ॥25॥

text: yāḥ kāścijjīvatā śakyāḥ kartumabhyudayakriyāḥ । sarvāstāḥ samabhityajya nimeṣādivyavasthitaḥ ॥26॥
html:
yāḥ kāścijjīvatā śakyāḥ kartumabhyudayakriyāḥ ।
sarvāstāḥ samabhityajya nimeṣādivyavasthitaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: yAH kAScijjIvatA SakyAH kartumaByudayakriyAH । sarvAstAH samaBityajya nimezAdivyavasTitaH ॥26॥

text: teṣu nityamasaktaśca tyaktasarvendriyakriyaḥ । suparityaktasaṅkalpaḥ sunirṇiktātmakalmaṣaḥ ॥27॥
html:
teṣu nityamasaktaśca tyaktasarvendriyakriyaḥ ।
suparityaktasaṅkalpaḥ sunirṇiktātmakalmaṣaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: tezu nityamasaktaSca tyaktasarvendriyakriyaH । suparityaktasaNkalpaH sunirRiktAtmakalmazaH ॥27॥

text: vimuktaḥ sarvasaṅgebhyo vyatītaḥ sarvavāgurāḥ । na vaśe kasyacittiṣṭhansadharmā mātariśvanaḥ ॥28॥
html:
vimuktaḥ sarvasaṅgebhyo vyatītaḥ sarvavāgurāḥ ।
na vaśe kasyacittiṣṭhansadharmā mātariśvanaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: vimuktaH sarvasaNgeByo vyatItaH sarvavAgurAH । na vaSe kasyacittizWansaDarmA mAtariSvanaH ॥28॥

text: vītarāgaścarannevaṃ tuṣṭiṃ prāpsyāmi śāśvatīm । tṛṣṇayā hi mahatpāpamajñānādasmi kāritaḥ ॥29॥
html:
vītarāgaścarannevaṃ tuṣṭiṃ prāpsyāmi śāśvatīm ।
tṛṣṇayā hi mahatpāpamajñānādasmi kāritaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: vItarAgaScarannevaM tuzwiM prApsyAmi SASvatIm । tfzRayA hi mahatpApamajYAnAdasmi kAritaH ॥29॥

text: kuśalākuśalānyeke kṛtvā karmāṇi mānavāḥ । kāryakāraṇasaṃśliṣṭaṃ svajanaṃ nāma bibhrati ॥30॥
html:
kuśalākuśalānyeke kṛtvā karmāṇi mānavāḥ ।
kāryakāraṇasaṃśliṣṭaṃ svajanaṃ nāma bibhrati ॥30॥
slp1: kuSalAkuSalAnyeke kftvA karmARi mAnavAH । kAryakAraRasaMSlizwaM svajanaM nAma biBrati ॥30॥

text: āyuṣo'nte prahāyedaṃ kṣīṇaprāyaṃ kalevaram । pratigṛhṇāti tatpāpaṃ kartuḥ karmaphalaṃ hi tat ॥31॥
html:
āyuṣo'nte prahāyedaṃ kṣīṇaprāyaṃ kalevaram ।
pratigṛhṇāti tatpāpaṃ kartuḥ karmaphalaṃ hi tat ॥31॥
slp1: Ayuzo'nte prahAyedaM kzIRaprAyaM kalevaram । pratigfhRAti tatpApaM kartuH karmaPalaM hi tat ॥31॥

text: evaṃ saṃsāracakre'sminvyāviddhe rathacakravat । sameti bhūtagrāmo'yaṃ bhūtagrāmeṇa kāryavān ॥32॥
html:
evaṃ saṃsāracakre'sminvyāviddhe rathacakravat ।
sameti bhūtagrāmo'yaṃ bhūtagrāmeṇa kāryavān ॥32॥
slp1: evaM saMsAracakre'sminvyAvidDe raTacakravat । sameti BUtagrAmo'yaM BUtagrAmeRa kAryavAn ॥32॥

text: janmamṛtyujarāvyādhivedanābhirupadrutam । asāramimamasvantaṃ saṃsāraṃ tyajataḥ sukham ॥33॥
html:
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhivedanābhirupadrutam ।
asāramimamasvantaṃ saṃsāraṃ tyajataḥ sukham ॥33॥
slp1: janmamftyujarAvyADivedanABirupadrutam । asAramimamasvantaM saMsAraM tyajataH suKam ॥33॥

text: divaḥ patatsu deveṣu sthānebhyaśca maharṣiṣu । ko hi nāma bhavenārthī bhavetkāraṇatattvavit ॥34॥
html:
divaḥ patatsu deveṣu sthānebhyaśca maharṣiṣu ।
ko hi nāma bhavenārthī bhavetkāraṇatattvavit ॥34॥
slp1: divaH patatsu devezu sTAneByaSca maharzizu । ko hi nAma BavenArTI BavetkAraRatattvavit ॥34॥

text: kṛtvā hi vividhaṃ karma tattadvividhalakṣaṇam । pārthivairnṛpatiḥ svalpaiḥ kāraṇaireva badhyate ॥35॥
html:
kṛtvā hi vividhaṃ karma tattadvividhalakṣaṇam ।
pārthivairnṛpatiḥ svalpaiḥ kāraṇaireva badhyate ॥35॥
slp1: kftvA hi viviDaM karma tattadviviDalakzaRam । pArTivErnfpatiH svalpEH kAraREreva baDyate ॥35॥

text: tasmātprajñāmṛtamidaṃ cirānmāṃ pratyupasthitam । tatprāpya prārthaye sthānamavyayaṃ śāśvataṃ dhruvam ॥36॥
html:
tasmātprajñāmṛtamidaṃ cirānmāṃ pratyupasthitam ।
tatprāpya prārthaye sthānamavyayaṃ śāśvataṃ dhruvam ॥36॥
slp1: tasmAtprajYAmftamidaM cirAnmAM pratyupasTitam । tatprApya prArTaye sTAnamavyayaM SASvataM Druvam ॥36॥

text: etayā satataṃ vṛttyā carannevaṃprakārayā । dehaṃ saṃsthāpayiṣyāmi nirbhayaṃ mārgamāsthitaḥ] ॥37॥
html:
etayā satataṃ vṛttyā carannevaṃprakārayā ।
dehaṃ saṃsthāpayiṣyāmi nirbhayaṃ mārgamāsthitaḥ] ॥37॥
slp1: etayA satataM vfttyA carannevaMprakArayA । dehaM saMsTApayizyAmi nirBayaM mArgamAsTitaH] ॥37॥

text: śrotriyasyeva te rājanmandakasyāvipaścitaḥ । anuvākahatābuddhirnaiṣā tattvārthadarśinī ॥1॥
html:
śrotriyasyeva te rājanmandakasyāvipaścitaḥ ।
anuvākahatābuddhirnaiṣā tattvārthadarśinī ॥1॥
slp1: Srotriyasyeva te rAjanmandakasyAvipaScitaH । anuvAkahatAbudDirnEzA tattvArTadarSinI ॥1॥
author: bhīma uvāca ।

text: ālasye kṛtacittasya rājadharmānasūyataḥ । vināśe dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ kiṃ phalaṃ bharatarṣabha ॥2॥
html:
ālasye kṛtacittasya rājadharmānasūyataḥ ।
vināśe dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ kiṃ phalaṃ bharatarṣabha ॥2॥
slp1: Alasye kftacittasya rAjaDarmAnasUyataH । vinASe DArtarAzwrARAM kiM PalaM BaratarzaBa ॥2॥

text: kṣamānukampā kāruṇyamānṛśaṃsyaṃ na vidyate । kṣātramācarato mārgamapi bandhostvadantare ॥3॥
html:
kṣamānukampā kāruṇyamānṛśaṃsyaṃ na vidyate ।
kṣātramācarato mārgamapi bandhostvadantare ॥3॥
slp1: kzamAnukampA kAruRyamAnfSaMsyaM na vidyate । kzAtramAcarato mArgamapi banDostvadantare ॥3॥

text: yadīmāṃ bhavato buddhiṃ vidyāma vayamīdṛśīm । śastraṃ naiva grahīṣyāmo na vadhiṣyāma kañcana ॥4॥
html:
yadīmāṃ bhavato buddhiṃ vidyāma vayamīdṛśīm ।
śastraṃ naiva grahīṣyāmo na vadhiṣyāma kañcana ॥4॥
slp1: yadImAM Bavato budDiM vidyAma vayamIdfSIm । SastraM nEva grahIzyAmo na vaDizyAma kaYcana ॥4॥

text: bhaikṣyamevācariṣyāma śarīrasyā vimokṣaṇāt । na cedaṃ dāruṇaṃ yuddhamabhaviṣyanmahīkṣitām ॥5॥
html:
bhaikṣyamevācariṣyāma śarīrasyā vimokṣaṇāt ।
na cedaṃ dāruṇaṃ yuddhamabhaviṣyanmahīkṣitām ॥5॥
slp1: BEkzyamevAcarizyAma SarIrasyA vimokzaRAt । na cedaM dAruRaM yudDamaBavizyanmahIkzitAm ॥5॥

text: prāṇasyānnamidaṃ sarvamiti vai kavayo viduḥ । sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva sarvaṃ prāṇasya bhojanam ॥6॥
html:
prāṇasyānnamidaṃ sarvamiti vai kavayo viduḥ ।
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva sarvaṃ prāṇasya bhojanam ॥6॥
slp1: prARasyAnnamidaM sarvamiti vE kavayo viduH । sTAvaraM jaNgamaM cEva sarvaM prARasya Bojanam ॥6॥

text: ādadānasya cedrājyaṃ ye kecitparipanthinaḥ । hantavyāsta iti prājñāḥ kṣatradharmavido viduḥ ॥7॥
html:
ādadānasya cedrājyaṃ ye kecitparipanthinaḥ ।
hantavyāsta iti prājñāḥ kṣatradharmavido viduḥ ॥7॥
slp1: AdadAnasya cedrAjyaM ye kecitparipanTinaH । hantavyAsta iti prAjYAH kzatraDarmavido viduH ॥7॥

text: te sadoṣā hatāsmābhī rājyasya paripanthinaḥ । tānhatvā bhuṅkṣva dharmeṇa yudhiṣṭhira mahīmimām ॥8॥
html:
te sadoṣā hatāsmābhī rājyasya paripanthinaḥ ।
tānhatvā bhuṅkṣva dharmeṇa yudhiṣṭhira mahīmimām ॥8॥
slp1: te sadozA hatAsmABI rAjyasya paripanTinaH । tAnhatvA BuNkzva DarmeRa yuDizWira mahImimAm ॥8॥

text: yathā hi puruṣaḥ khātvā kūpamaprāpya codakam । paṅkadigdho nivarteta karmedaṃ nastathopamam ॥9॥
html:
yathā hi puruṣaḥ khātvā kūpamaprāpya codakam ।
paṅkadigdho nivarteta karmedaṃ nastathopamam ॥9॥
slp1: yaTA hi puruzaH KAtvA kUpamaprApya codakam । paNkadigDo nivarteta karmedaM nastaTopamam ॥9॥

text: yathāruhya mahāvṛkṣamapahṛtya tato madhu । aprāśya nidhanaṃ gacchetkarmedaṃ nastathopamam ॥10॥
html:
yathāruhya mahāvṛkṣamapahṛtya tato madhu ।
aprāśya nidhanaṃ gacchetkarmedaṃ nastathopamam ॥10॥
slp1: yaTAruhya mahAvfkzamapahftya tato maDu । aprASya niDanaM gacCetkarmedaM nastaTopamam ॥10॥

text: yathā mahāntamadhvānamāśayā puruṣaḥ patan । sa nirāśo nivarteta karmedaṃ nastathopamam ॥11॥
html:
yathā mahāntamadhvānamāśayā puruṣaḥ patan ।
sa nirāśo nivarteta karmedaṃ nastathopamam ॥11॥
slp1: yaTA mahAntamaDvAnamASayA puruzaH patan । sa nirASo nivarteta karmedaM nastaTopamam ॥11॥

text: yathā śatrūnghātayitvā puruṣaḥ kurusattama । ātmānaṃ ghātayetpaścātkarmedaṃ nastathāvidham ॥12॥
html:
yathā śatrūnghātayitvā puruṣaḥ kurusattama ।
ātmānaṃ ghātayetpaścātkarmedaṃ nastathāvidham ॥12॥
slp1: yaTA SatrUnGAtayitvA puruzaH kurusattama । AtmAnaM GAtayetpaScAtkarmedaM nastaTAviDam ॥12॥

text: yathānnaṃ kṣudhito labdhvā na bhuñjīta yadṛcchayā । kāmī ca kāminīṃ labdhvā karmedaṃ nastathāvidham ॥13॥
html:
yathānnaṃ kṣudhito labdhvā na bhuñjīta yadṛcchayā ।
kāmī ca kāminīṃ labdhvā karmedaṃ nastathāvidham ॥13॥
slp1: yaTAnnaM kzuDito labDvA na BuYjIta yadfcCayA । kAmI ca kAminIM labDvA karmedaM nastaTAviDam ॥13॥

text: vayamevātra garhyā hi ye vayaṃ mandacetasaḥ । tvāṃ rājannanugacchāmo jyeṣṭho'yamiti bhārata ॥14॥
html:
vayamevātra garhyā hi ye vayaṃ mandacetasaḥ ।
tvāṃ rājannanugacchāmo jyeṣṭho'yamiti bhārata ॥14॥
slp1: vayamevAtra garhyA hi ye vayaM mandacetasaH । tvAM rAjannanugacCAmo jyezWo'yamiti BArata ॥14॥

text: vayaṃ hi bāhubalinaḥ kṛtavidyā manasvinaḥ । klībasya vākye tiṣṭhāmo yathaivāśaktayastathā ॥15॥
html:
vayaṃ hi bāhubalinaḥ kṛtavidyā manasvinaḥ ।
klībasya vākye tiṣṭhāmo yathaivāśaktayastathā ॥15॥
slp1: vayaM hi bAhubalinaH kftavidyA manasvinaH । klIbasya vAkye tizWAmo yaTEvASaktayastaTA ॥15॥

text: agatīnkāgatīnasmānnaṣṭārthānarthasiddhaye । kathaṃ vai nānupaśyeyurjanāḥ paśyanti yādṛśam ॥16॥
html:
agatīnkāgatīnasmānnaṣṭārthānarthasiddhaye ।
kathaṃ vai nānupaśyeyurjanāḥ paśyanti yādṛśam ॥16॥
slp1: agatInkAgatInasmAnnazwArTAnarTasidDaye । kaTaM vE nAnupaSyeyurjanAH paSyanti yAdfSam ॥16॥

slp1: anuruDya mahAprAjYo BrAtuScittamarindamaH । vyUQorasko mahAbAhustAmrAsyo mitaBAzitA ॥2॥

text: viśākhayūpe devānāṃ sarveṣāmagnayaścitāḥ । tasmādviddhi mahārāja devānkarmapathi sthitān ॥3॥
html:

tasmādviddhi mahārāja devānkarmapathi sthitān ॥3॥
slp1: viSAKayUpe devAnAM sarvezAmagnayaScitAH । tasmAdvidDi mahArAja devAnkarmapaTi sTitAn ॥3॥

text: anāstikānāstikānāṃ prāṇadāḥ pitaraśca ye । te'pi karmaiva kurvanti vidhiṃ paśyasva pārthiva । vedavādāpaviddhāṃstu tānviddhi bhṛśanāstikān ॥4॥
html:
anāstikānāstikānāṃ prāṇadāḥ pitaraśca ye ।
te'pi karmaiva kurvanti vidhiṃ paśyasva pārthiva ।
vedavādāpaviddhāṃstu tānviddhi bhṛśanāstikān ॥4॥
slp1: anAstikAnAstikAnAM prARadAH pitaraSca ye । te'pi karmEva kurvanti viDiM paSyasva pArTiva । vedavAdApavidDAMstu tAnvidDi BfSanAstikAn ॥4॥

text: na hi vedoktamutsṛjya vipraḥ sarveṣu karmasu । devayānena nākasya pṛṣṭhamāpnoti bhārata ॥5॥
html:
na hi vedoktamutsṛjya vipraḥ sarveṣu karmasu ।
devayānena nākasya pṛṣṭhamāpnoti bhārata ॥5॥
slp1: na hi vedoktamutsfjya vipraH sarvezu karmasu । devayAnena nAkasya pfzWamApnoti BArata ॥5॥

text: atyāśramānayaṃ sarvānityāhurvedaniścayāḥ । brāhmaṇāḥ śrutisampannāstānnibodha janādhipa ॥6॥
html:
atyāśramānayaṃ sarvānityāhurvedaniścayāḥ ।
brāhmaṇāḥ śrutisampannāstānnibodha janādhipa ॥6॥
slp1: atyASramAnayaM sarvAnityAhurvedaniScayAH । brAhmaRAH SrutisampannAstAnniboDa janADipa ॥6॥

text: vittāni dharmalabdhāni kratumukhyeṣvavāsṛjan । kṛtātmasu mahārāja sa vai tyāgī smṛto naraḥ ॥7॥
html:
vittāni dharmalabdhāni kratumukhyeṣvavāsṛjan ।
kṛtātmasu mahārāja sa vai tyāgī smṛto naraḥ ॥7॥
slp1: vittAni DarmalabDAni kratumuKyezvavAsfjan । kftAtmasu mahArAja sa vE tyAgI smfto naraH ॥7॥

text: anavekṣya sukhādānaṃ tathaivordhvaṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ । ātmatyāgī mahārāja sa tyāgī tāmasaḥ prabho ॥8॥
html:
anavekṣya sukhādānaṃ tathaivordhvaṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।
ātmatyāgī mahārāja sa tyāgī tāmasaḥ prabho ॥8॥
slp1: anavekzya suKAdAnaM taTEvorDvaM pratizWitaH । AtmatyAgI mahArAja sa tyAgI tAmasaH praBo ॥8॥

text: aniketaḥ paripatanvṛkṣamūlāśrayo muniḥ । apācakaḥ sadā yogī sa tyāgī pārtha bhikṣukaḥ ॥9॥
html:
aniketaḥ paripatanvṛkṣamūlāśrayo muniḥ ।
apācakaḥ sadā yogī sa tyāgī pārtha bhikṣukaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: aniketaH paripatanvfkzamUlASrayo muniH । apAcakaH sadA yogI sa tyAgI pArTa BikzukaH ॥9॥

text: krodhaharṣāvanādṛtya paiśunyaṃ ca viśāmpate । vipro vedānadhīte yaḥ sa tyāgī gurupūjakaḥ ॥10॥
html:
krodhaharṣāvanādṛtya paiśunyaṃ ca viśāmpate ।
vipro vedānadhīte yaḥ sa tyāgī gurupūjakaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: kroDaharzAvanAdftya pESunyaM ca viSAmpate । vipro vedAnaDIte yaH sa tyAgI gurupUjakaH ॥10॥

text: āśramāṃstulayā sarvāndhṛtānāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ । ekataste trayo rājangṛhasthāśrama ekataḥ ॥11॥
html:
āśramāṃstulayā sarvāndhṛtānāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ।
ekataste trayo rājangṛhasthāśrama ekataḥ ॥11॥
slp1: ASramAMstulayA sarvAnDftAnAhurmanIziRaH । ekataste trayo rAjangfhasTASrama ekataH ॥11॥

text: samīkṣate tu yo'rthaṃ vai kāmaṃ svargaṃ ca bhārata । ayaṃ panthā maharṣīṇāmiyaṃ lokavidāṃ gatiḥ ॥12॥
html:
samīkṣate tu yo'rthaṃ vai kāmaṃ svargaṃ ca bhārata ।
ayaṃ panthā maharṣīṇāmiyaṃ lokavidāṃ gatiḥ ॥12॥
slp1: samIkzate tu yo'rTaM vE kAmaM svargaM ca BArata । ayaM panTA maharzIRAmiyaM lokavidAM gatiH ॥12॥

text: iti yaḥ kurute bhāvaṃ sa tyāgī bharatarṣabha । na yaḥ parityajya gṛhānvanameti vimūḍhavat ॥13॥
html:
iti yaḥ kurute bhāvaṃ sa tyāgī bharatarṣabha ।
na yaḥ parityajya gṛhānvanameti vimūḍhavat ॥13॥
slp1: iti yaH kurute BAvaM sa tyAgI BaratarzaBa । na yaH parityajya gfhAnvanameti vimUQavat ॥13॥

text: yadā kāmānsamīkṣeta dharmavaitaṃsiko'nṛjuḥ । athainaṃ mṛtyupāśena kaṇṭhe badhnāti mṛtyurāṭ ॥14॥
html:
yadā kāmānsamīkṣeta dharmavaitaṃsiko'nṛjuḥ ।
athainaṃ mṛtyupāśena kaṇṭhe badhnāti mṛtyurāṭ ॥14॥
slp1: yadA kAmAnsamIkzeta DarmavEtaMsiko'nfjuH । aTEnaM mftyupASena kaRWe baDnAti mftyurAw ॥14॥

text: abhimānakṛtaṃ karma naitatphalavaducyate । tyāgayuktaṃ mahārāja sarvameva mahāphalam ॥15॥
html:
abhimānakṛtaṃ karma naitatphalavaducyate ।
tyāgayuktaṃ mahārāja sarvameva mahāphalam ॥15॥
slp1: aBimAnakftaM karma nEtatPalavaducyate । tyAgayuktaM mahArAja sarvameva mahAPalam ॥15॥

text: śamo damastapo dānaṃ satyaṃ śaucamathārjavam । yajño dhṛtiśca dharmaśca nityamārṣo vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ॥16॥
html:
śamo damastapo dānaṃ satyaṃ śaucamathārjavam ।
yajño dhṛtiśca dharmaśca nityamārṣo vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: Samo damastapo dAnaM satyaM SOcamaTArjavam । yajYo DftiSca DarmaSca nityamArzo viDiH smftaH ॥16॥

text: pitṛdevātithikṛte samārambho'tra śasyate । atraiva hi mahārāja trivargaḥ kevalaṃ phalam ॥17॥
html:
pitṛdevātithikṛte samārambho'tra śasyate ।
atraiva hi mahārāja trivargaḥ kevalaṃ phalam ॥17॥
slp1: pitfdevAtiTikfte samAramBo'tra Sasyate । atrEva hi mahArAja trivargaH kevalaM Palam ॥17॥

text: etasminvartamānasya vidhau vipraniṣevite । tyāginaḥ prasṛtasyeha nocchittirvidyate kvacit ॥18॥
html:
etasminvartamānasya vidhau vipraniṣevite ।
tyāginaḥ prasṛtasyeha nocchittirvidyate kvacit ॥18॥
slp1: etasminvartamAnasya viDO vipranizevite । tyAginaH prasftasyeha nocCittirvidyate kvacit ॥18॥

text: asṛjaddhi prajā rājanprajāpatirakalmaṣaḥ । māṃ yakṣyantīti śāntātmā yajñairvividhadakṣiṇaiḥ ॥19॥
html:
asṛjaddhi prajā rājanprajāpatirakalmaṣaḥ ।
māṃ yakṣyantīti śāntātmā yajñairvividhadakṣiṇaiḥ ॥19॥
slp1: asfjadDi prajA rAjanprajApatirakalmazaH । mAM yakzyantIti SAntAtmA yajYErviviDadakziREH ॥19॥

text: vīrudhaścaiva vṛkṣāṃśca yajñārthaṃ ca tathauṣadhīḥ । paśūṃścaiva tathā medhyānyajñārthāni havīṃṣi ca ॥20॥
html:
vīrudhaścaiva vṛkṣāṃśca yajñārthaṃ ca tathauṣadhīḥ ।
paśūṃścaiva tathā medhyānyajñārthāni havīṃṣi ca ॥20॥
slp1: vIruDaScEva vfkzAMSca yajYArTaM ca taTOzaDIH । paSUMScEva taTA meDyAnyajYArTAni havIMzi ca ॥20॥

text: gṛhasthāśramiṇastacca yajñakarma virodhakam । tasmādgārhasthyameveha duṣkaraṃ durlabhaṃ tathā ॥21॥
html:
gṛhasthāśramiṇastacca yajñakarma virodhakam ।
tasmādgārhasthyameveha duṣkaraṃ durlabhaṃ tathā ॥21॥
slp1: gfhasTASramiRastacca yajYakarma viroDakam । tasmAdgArhasTyameveha duzkaraM durlaBaM taTA ॥21॥

text: tatsamprāpya gṛhasthā ye paśudhānyasamanvitāḥ । na yajante mahārāja śāśvataṃ teṣu kilbiṣam ॥22॥
html:
tatsamprāpya gṛhasthā ye paśudhānyasamanvitāḥ ।
na yajante mahārāja śāśvataṃ teṣu kilbiṣam ॥22॥
slp1: tatsamprApya gfhasTA ye paSuDAnyasamanvitAH । na yajante mahArAja SASvataM tezu kilbizam ॥22॥

text: svādhyāyayajñā ṛṣayo jñānayajñāstathāpare । athāpare mahāyajñānmanasaiva vitanvate ॥23॥
html:
svādhyāyayajñā ṛṣayo jñānayajñāstathāpare ।
athāpare mahāyajñānmanasaiva vitanvate ॥23॥
slp1: svADyAyayajYA fzayo jYAnayajYAstaTApare । aTApare mahAyajYAnmanasEva vitanvate ॥23॥

text: evaṃ dānasamādhānaṃ mārgamātiṣṭhato nṛpa । dvijāterbrahmabhūtasya spṛhayanti divaukasaḥ ॥24॥
html:
evaṃ dānasamādhānaṃ mārgamātiṣṭhato nṛpa ।
dvijāterbrahmabhūtasya spṛhayanti divaukasaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: evaM dAnasamADAnaM mArgamAtizWato nfpa । dvijAterbrahmaBUtasya spfhayanti divOkasaH ॥24॥

text: sa ratnāni vicitrāṇi sambhṛtāni tatastataḥ । makheṣvanabhisantyajya nāstikyamabhijalpasi । kuṭumbamāsthite tyāgaṃ na paśyāmi narādhipa ॥25॥
html:
sa ratnāni vicitrāṇi sambhṛtāni tatastataḥ ।
makheṣvanabhisantyajya nāstikyamabhijalpasi ।
kuṭumbamāsthite tyāgaṃ na paśyāmi narādhipa ॥25॥
slp1: sa ratnAni vicitrARi samBftAni tatastataH । maKezvanaBisantyajya nAstikyamaBijalpasi । kuwumbamAsTite tyAgaM na paSyAmi narADipa ॥25॥

text: rājasūyāśvamedheṣu sarvamedheṣu vā punaḥ । ya cānye kratavastāta brāhmaṇairabhipūjitāḥ । tairyajasva mahārāja śakro devapatiryathā ॥26॥
html:
rājasūyāśvamedheṣu sarvamedheṣu vā punaḥ ।
ya cānye kratavastāta brāhmaṇairabhipūjitāḥ ।
tairyajasva mahārāja śakro devapatiryathā ॥26॥
slp1: rAjasUyASvameDezu sarvameDezu vA punaH । ya cAnye kratavastAta brAhmaREraBipUjitAH । tEryajasva mahArAja Sakro devapatiryaTA ॥26॥

text: rājñaḥ pramādadoṣeṇa dasyubhiḥ parimuṣyatām । aśaraṇyaḥ prajānāṃ yaḥ sa rājā kalirucyate ॥27॥
html:
rājñaḥ pramādadoṣeṇa dasyubhiḥ parimuṣyatām ।
aśaraṇyaḥ prajānāṃ yaḥ sa rājā kalirucyate ॥27॥
slp1: rAjYaH pramAdadozeRa dasyuBiH parimuzyatAm । aSaraRyaH prajAnAM yaH sa rAjA kalirucyate ॥27॥

text: aśvāngāścaiva dāsīśca kareṇūśca svalaṅkṛtāḥ । grāmāñjanapadāṃścaiva kṣetrāṇi ca gṛhāṇi ca ॥28॥
html:
aśvāngāścaiva dāsīśca kareṇūśca svalaṅkṛtāḥ ।
grāmāñjanapadāṃścaiva kṣetrāṇi ca gṛhāṇi ca ॥28॥
slp1: aSvAngAScEva dAsISca kareRUSca svalaNkftAH । grAmAYjanapadAMScEva kzetrARi ca gfhARi ca ॥28॥

text: apradāya dvijātibhyo mātsaryāviṣṭacetasaḥ । vayaṃ te rājakalayo bhaviṣyāmo viśāmpate ॥29॥
html:
apradāya dvijātibhyo mātsaryāviṣṭacetasaḥ ।
vayaṃ te rājakalayo bhaviṣyāmo viśāmpate ॥29॥
slp1: apradAya dvijAtiByo mAtsaryAvizwacetasaH । vayaM te rAjakalayo BavizyAmo viSAmpate ॥29॥

text: adātāro'śaraṇyāśca rājakilbiṣabhāginaḥ । duḥkhānāmeva bhoktāro na sukhānāṃ kadācana ॥30॥
html:
adātāro'śaraṇyāśca rājakilbiṣabhāginaḥ ।
duḥkhānāmeva bhoktāro na sukhānāṃ kadācana ॥30॥
slp1: adAtAro'SaraRyASca rAjakilbizaBAginaH । duHKAnAmeva BoktAro na suKAnAM kadAcana ॥30॥

text: aniṣṭvā ca mahāyajñairakṛtvā ca pitṛsvadhām । tīrtheṣvanabhisantyajya pravrajiṣyasi cedatha ॥31॥
html:
aniṣṭvā ca mahāyajñairakṛtvā ca pitṛsvadhām ।
tīrtheṣvanabhisantyajya pravrajiṣyasi cedatha ॥31॥
slp1: anizwvA ca mahAyajYErakftvA ca pitfsvaDAm । tIrTezvanaBisantyajya pravrajizyasi cedaTa ॥31॥

text: chinnābhramiva gantāsi vilayaṃ māruteritam । lokayorubhayorbhraṣṭo hyantarāle vyavasthitaḥ ॥32॥
html:
chinnābhramiva gantāsi vilayaṃ māruteritam ।
lokayorubhayorbhraṣṭo hyantarāle vyavasthitaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: CinnABramiva gantAsi vilayaM mAruteritam । lokayoruBayorBrazwo hyantarAle vyavasTitaH ॥32॥

text: antarbahiśca yatkiñcinmanovyāsaṅgakārakam । parityajya bhavettyāgī na yo hitvā pratiṣṭhate ॥33॥
html:
antarbahiśca yatkiñcinmanovyāsaṅgakārakam ।
parityajya bhavettyāgī na yo hitvā pratiṣṭhate ॥33॥
slp1: antarbahiSca yatkiYcinmanovyAsaNgakArakam । parityajya BavettyAgI na yo hitvA pratizWate ॥33॥

text: etasminvartamānasya vidhau vipraniṣevite । brāhmaṇasya mahārāja nocchittirvidyate kvacit ॥34॥

brāhmaṇasya mahārāja nocchittirvidyate kvacit ॥34॥
slp1: etasminvartamAnasya viDO vipranizevite । brAhmaRasya mahArAja nocCittirvidyate kvacit ॥34॥

text: nihatya śatrūṃstarasā samṛddhānśakro yathā daityabalāni saṅkhye । kaḥ pārtha śocennirataḥ svadharme pūrvaiḥ smṛte pārthiva śiṣṭajuṣṭe ॥35॥
html:
nihatya śatrūṃstarasā samṛddhānśakro yathā daityabalāni saṅkhye ।
kaḥ pārtha śocennirataḥ svadharme pūrvaiḥ smṛte pārthiva śiṣṭajuṣṭe ॥35॥
slp1: nihatya SatrUMstarasA samfdDAnSakro yaTA dEtyabalAni saNKye । kaH pArTa SocennirataH svaDarme pUrvEH smfte pArTiva Sizwajuzwe ॥35॥

text: kṣātreṇa dharmeṇa parākrameṇa jitvā mahīṃ mantravidbhyaḥ pradāya । nākasya pṛṣṭhe'si narendra gantā na śocitavyaṃ bhavatādya pārtha] ॥36॥
html:
kṣātreṇa dharmeṇa parākrameṇa jitvā mahīṃ mantravidbhyaḥ pradāya ।
nākasya pṛṣṭhe'si narendra gantā na śocitavyaṃ bhavatādya pārtha] ॥36॥
slp1: kzAtreRa DarmeRa parAkrameRa jitvA mahIM mantravidByaH pradAya । nAkasya pfzWe'si narendra gantA na SocitavyaM BavatAdya pArTa] ॥36॥

text: na bāhyaṃ dravyamutsṛjya siddhirbhavati bhārata । śārīraṃ dravyamutsṛjya siddhirbhavati vā na vā ॥1॥
html:
na bāhyaṃ dravyamutsṛjya siddhirbhavati bhārata ।
śārīraṃ dravyamutsṛjya siddhirbhavati vā na vā ॥1॥
slp1: na bAhyaM dravyamutsfjya sidDirBavati BArata । SArIraM dravyamutsfjya sidDirBavati vA na vA ॥1॥
author: sahadeva uvāca ।

text: bāhyadravyavimuktasya śārīreṣu ca gṛdhyataḥ । yo dharmo yatsukhaṃ vā syāddviṣatāṃ tattathāstu naḥ ॥2॥
html:
bāhyadravyavimuktasya śārīreṣu ca gṛdhyataḥ ।
yo dharmo yatsukhaṃ vā syāddviṣatāṃ tattathāstu naḥ ॥2॥
slp1: bAhyadravyavimuktasya SArIrezu ca gfDyataH । yo Darmo yatsuKaM vA syAddvizatAM tattaTAstu naH ॥2॥

text: śārīraṃ dravyamutsṛjya pṛthivīmanuśāsataḥ । yo dharmo yatsukhaṃ vā syātsuhṛdāṃ tattathāstu naḥ ॥3॥
html:
śārīraṃ dravyamutsṛjya pṛthivīmanuśāsataḥ ।
yo dharmo yatsukhaṃ vā syātsuhṛdāṃ tattathāstu naḥ ॥3॥
slp1: SArIraM dravyamutsfjya pfTivImanuSAsataH । yo Darmo yatsuKaM vA syAtsuhfdAM tattaTAstu naH ॥3॥

text: dvyakṣarastu bhavenmṛtyustryakṣaraṃ brahma śāśvatam । mameti ca bhavenmṛtyurna mameti ca śāśvatam ॥4॥
html:
dvyakṣarastu bhavenmṛtyustryakṣaraṃ brahma śāśvatam ।
mameti ca bhavenmṛtyurna mameti ca śāśvatam ॥4॥
slp1: dvyakzarastu BavenmftyustryakzaraM brahma SASvatam । mameti ca Bavenmftyurna mameti ca SASvatam ॥4॥

text: brahmamṛtyū ca tau rājannātmanyeva samāśritau । adṛśyamānau bhūtāni yodhayetāmasaṃśayam ॥5॥
html:
brahmamṛtyū ca tau rājannātmanyeva samāśritau ।
adṛśyamānau bhūtāni yodhayetāmasaṃśayam ॥5॥
slp1: brahmamftyU ca tO rAjannAtmanyeva samASritO । adfSyamAnO BUtAni yoDayetAmasaMSayam ॥5॥

text: avināśo'sya sattvasya niyato yadi bhārata । bhittvā śarīraṃ bhūtānāṃ na hiṃsā pratipatsyate ॥6॥
html:
avināśo'sya sattvasya niyato yadi bhārata ।
bhittvā śarīraṃ bhūtānāṃ na hiṃsā pratipatsyate ॥6॥
slp1: avinASo'sya sattvasya niyato yadi BArata । BittvA SarIraM BUtAnAM na hiMsA pratipatsyate ॥6॥

text: athāpi ca sahotpattiḥ sattvasya pralayastathā । naṣṭe śarīre naṣṭaṃ syādvṛthā ca syātkriyāpathaḥ ॥7॥
html:
athāpi ca sahotpattiḥ sattvasya pralayastathā ।

slp1: etezAM yatamAnAnAmutpadyante tu sampadaH । tvaM tu sarvAM mahIM labDvA kuruze svayamApadam ॥36॥

text: yathāstāṃ sammatau rājñāṃ pṛthivyāṃ rājasattamau । māndhātā cāmbarīṣaśca tathā rājanvirājase ॥37॥
html:
yathāstāṃ sammatau rājñāṃ pṛthivyāṃ rājasattamau ।
māndhātā cāmbarīṣaśca tathā rājanvirājase ॥37॥
slp1: yaTAstAM sammatO rAjYAM pfTivyAM rAjasattamO । mAnDAtA cAmbarIzaSca taTA rAjanvirAjase ॥37॥

text: praśādhi pṛthivīṃ devīṃ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan । saparvatavanadvīpāṃ mā rājanvimanā bhava ॥38॥
html:
praśādhi pṛthivīṃ devīṃ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan ।
saparvatavanadvīpāṃ mā rājanvimanā bhava ॥38॥
slp1: praSADi pfTivIM devIM prajA DarmeRa pAlayan । saparvatavanadvIpAM mA rAjanvimanA Bava ॥38॥

text: yajasva vividhairyajñairjuhvannagnīnprayaccha ca । purāṇi bhogānvāsāṃsi dvijātibhyo nṛpottama] ॥39॥
html:
yajasva vividhairyajñairjuhvannagnīnprayaccha ca ।
purāṇi bhogānvāsāṃsi dvijātibhyo nṛpottama] ॥39॥
slp1: yajasva viviDEryajYErjuhvannagnInprayacCa ca । purARi BogAnvAsAMsi dvijAtiByo nfpottama] ॥39॥

text: yājñasenyā vacaḥ śrutvā punarevārjuno'bravīt । anumānya mahābāhuṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ bhrātaramīśvaram ॥1॥
html:
yājñasenyā vacaḥ śrutvā punarevārjuno'bravīt ।
anumānya mahābāhuṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ bhrātaramīśvaram ॥1॥
slp1: yAjYasenyA vacaH SrutvA punarevArjuno'bravIt । anumAnya mahAbAhuM jyezWaM BrAtaramISvaram ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: daṇḍaḥ śāsti prajāḥ sarvā daṇḍa evābhirakṣati । daṇḍaḥ supteṣu jāgarti daṇḍaṃ dharmaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ॥2॥
html:
daṇḍaḥ śāsti prajāḥ sarvā daṇḍa evābhirakṣati ।
daṇḍaḥ supteṣu jāgarti daṇḍaṃ dharmaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: daRqaH SAsti prajAH sarvA daRqa evABirakzati । daRqaH suptezu jAgarti daRqaM DarmaM vidurbuDAH ॥2॥

text: dharmaṃ saṃrakṣate daṇḍastathaivārthaṃ narādhipa । kāmaṃ saṃrakṣate daṇḍastrivargo daṇḍa ucyate ॥3॥
html:
dharmaṃ saṃrakṣate daṇḍastathaivārthaṃ narādhipa ।
kāmaṃ saṃrakṣate daṇḍastrivargo daṇḍa ucyate ॥3॥
slp1: DarmaM saMrakzate daRqastaTEvArTaM narADipa । kAmaM saMrakzate daRqastrivargo daRqa ucyate ॥3॥

text: daṇḍena rakṣyate dhānyaṃ dhanaṃ daṇḍena rakṣyate । etadvidvannupādatsva svabhāvaṃ paśya laukikam ॥4॥
html:
daṇḍena rakṣyate dhānyaṃ dhanaṃ daṇḍena rakṣyate ।
etadvidvannupādatsva svabhāvaṃ paśya laukikam ॥4॥
slp1: daRqena rakzyate DAnyaM DanaM daRqena rakzyate । etadvidvannupAdatsva svaBAvaM paSya lOkikam ॥4॥

text: rājadaṇḍabhayādeke pāpāḥ pāpaṃ na kurvate । yamadaṇḍabhayādeke paralokabhayādapi ॥5॥
html:
rājadaṇḍabhayādeke pāpāḥ pāpaṃ na kurvate ।
yamadaṇḍabhayādeke paralokabhayādapi ॥5॥
slp1: rAjadaRqaBayAdeke pApAH pApaM na kurvate । yamadaRqaBayAdeke paralokaBayAdapi ॥5॥

text: parasparabhayādeke pāpāḥ pāpaṃ na kurvate । evaṃ sāṃsiddhike loke sarvaṃ daṇḍe pratiṣṭhitam ॥6॥
html:
parasparabhayādeke pāpāḥ pāpaṃ na kurvate ।
evaṃ sāṃsiddhike loke sarvaṃ daṇḍe pratiṣṭhitam ॥6॥
slp1: parasparaBayAdeke pApAH pApaM na kurvate । evaM sAMsidDike loke sarvaM daRqe pratizWitam ॥6॥

text: daṇḍasyaiva bhayādeke na khādanti parasparam । andhe tamasi majjeyuryadi daṇḍo na pālayet ॥7॥
html:
daṇḍasyaiva bhayādeke na khādanti parasparam ।
andhe tamasi majjeyuryadi daṇḍo na pālayet ॥7॥
slp1: daRqasyEva BayAdeke na KAdanti parasparam । anDe tamasi majjeyuryadi daRqo na pAlayet ॥7॥

text: yasmādadāntāndamayatyaśiṣṭāndaṇḍayatyapi । damanāddaṇḍanāccaiva tasmāddaṇḍaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ॥8॥
html:
yasmādadāntāndamayatyaśiṣṭāndaṇḍayatyapi ।
damanāddaṇḍanāccaiva tasmāddaṇḍaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: yasmAdadAntAndamayatyaSizwAndaRqayatyapi । damanAddaRqanAccEva tasmAddaRqaM vidurbuDAH ॥8॥

text: vāci daṇḍo brāhmaṇānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ bhujārpaṇam । dānadaṇḍaḥ smṛto vaiśyo nirdaṇḍaḥ śūdra ucyate ॥9॥
html:
vāci daṇḍo brāhmaṇānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ bhujārpaṇam ।
dānadaṇḍaḥ smṛto vaiśyo nirdaṇḍaḥ śūdra ucyate ॥9॥
slp1: vAci daRqo brAhmaRAnAM kzatriyARAM BujArpaRam । dAnadaRqaH smfto vESyo nirdaRqaH SUdra ucyate ॥9॥

text: asammohāya martyānāmarthasaṃrakṣaṇāya ca । maryādā sthāpitā loke daṇḍasañjñā viśāmpate ॥10॥
html:
asammohāya martyānāmarthasaṃrakṣaṇāya ca ।
maryādā sthāpitā loke daṇḍasañjñā viśāmpate ॥10॥
slp1: asammohAya martyAnAmarTasaMrakzaRAya ca । maryAdA sTApitA loke daRqasaYjYA viSAmpate ॥10॥

text: yatra śyāmo lohitākṣo daṇḍaścarati sūnṛtaḥ । prajāstatra na muhyanti netā cetsādhu paśyati ॥11॥
html:
yatra śyāmo lohitākṣo daṇḍaścarati sūnṛtaḥ ।
prajāstatra na muhyanti netā cetsādhu paśyati ॥11॥
slp1: yatra SyAmo lohitAkzo daRqaScarati sUnftaH । prajAstatra na muhyanti netA cetsADu paSyati ॥11॥

text: brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho'tha bhikṣukaḥ । daṇḍasyaiva bhayādete manuṣyā vartmani sthitāḥ ॥12॥
html:
brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho'tha bhikṣukaḥ ।
daṇḍasyaiva bhayādete manuṣyā vartmani sthitāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: brahmacArI gfhasTaSca vAnaprasTo'Ta BikzukaH । daRqasyEva BayAdete manuzyA vartmani sTitAH ॥12॥

text: nābhīto yajate rājannābhīto dātumicchati । nābhītaḥ puruṣaḥ kaścitsamaye sthātumicchati ॥13॥
html:
nābhīto yajate rājannābhīto dātumicchati ।
nābhītaḥ puruṣaḥ kaścitsamaye sthātumicchati ॥13॥
slp1: nABIto yajate rAjannABIto dAtumicCati । nABItaH puruzaH kaScitsamaye sTAtumicCati ॥13॥

text: nācchittvā paramarmāṇi nākṛtvā karma dāruṇam । nāhatvā matsyaghātīva prāpnoti mahatīṃ śriyam ॥14॥
html:
nācchittvā paramarmāṇi nākṛtvā karma dāruṇam ।
nāhatvā matsyaghātīva prāpnoti mahatīṃ śriyam ॥14॥
slp1: nAcCittvA paramarmARi nAkftvA karma dAruRam । nAhatvA matsyaGAtIva prApnoti mahatIM Sriyam ॥14॥

text: nāghnataḥ kīrtirastīha na vittaṃ na punaḥ prajāḥ । indro vṛtravadhenaiva mahendraḥ samapadyata ॥15॥
html:
nāghnataḥ kīrtirastīha na vittaṃ na punaḥ prajāḥ ।
indro vṛtravadhenaiva mahendraḥ samapadyata ॥15॥
slp1: nAGnataH kIrtirastIha na vittaM na punaH prajAH । indro vftravaDenEva mahendraH samapadyata ॥15॥

text: ya eva devā hantārastāṁlloko'rcayate bhṛśam । hantā rudrastathā skandaḥ śakro'gnirvaruṇo yamaḥ ॥16॥
html:
ya eva devā hantārastāṁlloko'rcayate bhṛśam ।
hantā rudrastathā skandaḥ śakro'gnirvaruṇo yamaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: ya eva devA hantArastAṁlloko'rcayate BfSam । hantA rudrastaTA skandaH Sakro'gnirvaruRo yamaH ॥16॥

text: hantā kālastathā vāyurmṛtyurvaiśravaṇo raviḥ । vasavo marutaḥ sādhyā viśvedevāśca bhārata ॥17॥
html:
hantā kālastathā vāyurmṛtyurvaiśravaṇo raviḥ ।
vasavo marutaḥ sādhyā viśvedevāśca bhārata ॥17॥
slp1: hantA kAlastaTA vAyurmftyurvESravaRo raviH । vasavo marutaH sADyA viSvedevASca BArata ॥17॥

text: etāndevānnamasyanti pratāpapraṇatā janāḥ । na brahmāṇaṃ na dhātāraṃ na pūṣāṇaṃ kathañcana ॥18॥
html:
etāndevānnamasyanti pratāpapraṇatā janāḥ ।
na brahmāṇaṃ na dhātāraṃ na pūṣāṇaṃ kathañcana ॥18॥
slp1: etAndevAnnamasyanti pratApapraRatA janAH । na brahmARaM na DAtAraM na pUzARaM kaTaYcana ॥18॥

text: madhyasthānsarvabhūteṣu dāntāñśamaparāyaṇān । yajante mānavāḥ kecitpraśāntāḥ sarvakarmasu ॥19॥
html:
madhyasthānsarvabhūteṣu dāntāñśamaparāyaṇān ।
yajante mānavāḥ kecitpraśāntāḥ sarvakarmasu ॥19॥
slp1: maDyasTAnsarvaBUtezu dAntAYSamaparAyaRAn । yajante mAnavAH kecitpraSAntAH sarvakarmasu ॥19॥

text: na hi paśyāmi jīvantaṃ loke kañcidahiṃsayā । sattvaiḥ sattvāni jīvanti durbalairbalavattarāḥ ॥20॥
html:
na hi paśyāmi jīvantaṃ loke kañcidahiṃsayā ।
sattvaiḥ sattvāni jīvanti durbalairbalavattarāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: na hi paSyAmi jIvantaM loke kaYcidahiMsayA । sattvEH sattvAni jIvanti durbalErbalavattarAH ॥20॥

text: nakulo mūṣakānatti biḍālo nakulaṃ tathā । biḍālamatti śvā rājañśvānaṃ vyālamṛgastathā ॥21॥
html:
nakulo mūṣakānatti biḍālo nakulaṃ tathā ।
biḍālamatti śvā rājañśvānaṃ vyālamṛgastathā ॥21॥
slp1: nakulo mUzakAnatti biqAlo nakulaM taTA । biqAlamatti SvA rAjaYSvAnaM vyAlamfgastaTA ॥21॥

text: tānatti puruṣaḥ sarvānpaśya dharmo yathāgataḥ । prāṇasyānnamidaṃ sarvaṃ jaṅgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ ca yat ॥22॥
html:
tānatti puruṣaḥ sarvānpaśya dharmo yathāgataḥ ।
prāṇasyānnamidaṃ sarvaṃ jaṅgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ ca yat ॥22॥
slp1: tAnatti puruzaH sarvAnpaSya Darmo yaTAgataH । prARasyAnnamidaM sarvaM jaNgamaM sTAvaraM ca yat ॥22॥

text: vidhānaṃ devavihitaṃ tatra vidvānna muhyati । yathā sṛṣṭo'si rājendra tathā bhavitumarhasi ॥23॥
html:
vidhānaṃ devavihitaṃ tatra vidvānna muhyati ।
yathā sṛṣṭo'si rājendra tathā bhavitumarhasi ॥23॥
slp1: viDAnaM devavihitaM tatra vidvAnna muhyati । yaTA sfzwo'si rAjendra taTA Bavitumarhasi ॥23॥

text: vinītakrodhaharṣā hi mandā vanamupāśritāḥ । vinā vadhaṃ na kurvanti tāpasāḥ prāṇayāpanam ॥24॥
html:
vinītakrodhaharṣā hi mandā vanamupāśritāḥ ।
vinā vadhaṃ na kurvanti tāpasāḥ prāṇayāpanam ॥24॥
slp1: vinItakroDaharzA hi mandA vanamupASritAH । vinA vaDaM na kurvanti tApasAH prARayApanam ॥24॥

text: udake bahavaḥ prāṇāḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca phaleṣu ca । na ca kaścinna tānhanti kimanyatprāṇayāpanāt ॥25॥
html:
udake bahavaḥ prāṇāḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca phaleṣu ca ।
na ca kaścinna tānhanti kimanyatprāṇayāpanāt ॥25॥
slp1: udake bahavaH prARAH pfTivyAM ca Palezu ca । na ca kaScinna tAnhanti kimanyatprARayApanAt ॥25॥

text: sūkṣmayonīni bhūtāni tarkagamyāni kānicit । pakṣmaṇo'pi nipātena yeṣāṃ syātskandhaparyayaḥ ॥26॥
html:
sūkṣmayonīni bhūtāni tarkagamyāni kānicit ।
pakṣmaṇo'pi nipātena yeṣāṃ syātskandhaparyayaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: sUkzmayonIni BUtAni tarkagamyAni kAnicit । pakzmaRo'pi nipAtena yezAM syAtskanDaparyayaH ॥26॥

text: grāmānniṣkramya munayo vigatakrodhamatsarāḥ । vane kuṭumbadharmāṇo dṛśyante parimohitāḥ ॥27॥
html:
grāmānniṣkramya munayo vigatakrodhamatsarāḥ ।
vane kuṭumbadharmāṇo dṛśyante parimohitāḥ ॥27॥
slp1: grAmAnnizkramya munayo vigatakroDamatsarAH । vane kuwumbaDarmARo dfSyante parimohitAH ॥27॥

text: bhūmiṃ bhittvauṣadhīśchittvā vṛkṣādīnaṇḍajānpaśūn । manuṣyāstanvate yajñāṃste svargaṃ prāpnuvanti ca ॥28॥
html:
bhūmiṃ bhittvauṣadhīśchittvā vṛkṣādīnaṇḍajānpaśūn ।
manuṣyāstanvate yajñāṃste svargaṃ prāpnuvanti ca ॥28॥
slp1: BUmiM BittvOzaDISCittvA vfkzAdInaRqajAnpaSUn । manuzyAstanvate yajYAMste svargaM prApnuvanti ca ॥28॥

text: daṇḍanītyāṃ praṇītāyāṃ sarve sidhyantyupakramāḥ । kaunteya sarvabhūtānāṃ tatra me nāsti saṃśayaḥ ॥29॥
html:
daṇḍanītyāṃ praṇītāyāṃ sarve sidhyantyupakramāḥ ।
kaunteya sarvabhūtānāṃ tatra me nāsti saṃśayaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: daRqanItyAM praRItAyAM sarve siDyantyupakramAH । kOnteya sarvaBUtAnAM tatra me nAsti saMSayaH ॥29॥

text: daṇḍaścenna bhavelloke vyanaśiṣyannimāḥ prajāḥ । śūle matsyānivāpakṣyandurbalānbalavattarāḥ ॥30॥
html:
daṇḍaścenna bhavelloke vyanaśiṣyannimāḥ prajāḥ ।
śūle matsyānivāpakṣyandurbalānbalavattarāḥ ॥30॥
slp1: daRqaScenna Bavelloke vyanaSizyannimAH prajAH । SUle matsyAnivApakzyandurbalAnbalavattarAH ॥30॥

text: satyaṃ cedaṃ brahmaṇā pūrvamuktaṃ daṇḍaḥ prajā rakṣati sādhu nītaḥ । paśyāgnayaśca pratiśāmyantyabhītāḥ santarjitā daṇḍabhayājjvalanti ॥31॥
html:
satyaṃ cedaṃ brahmaṇā pūrvamuktaṃ daṇḍaḥ prajā rakṣati sādhu nītaḥ ।
paśyāgnayaśca pratiśāmyantyabhītāḥ santarjitā daṇḍabhayājjvalanti ॥31॥
slp1: satyaM cedaM brahmaRA pUrvamuktaM daRqaH prajA rakzati sADu nItaH । paSyAgnayaSca pratiSAmyantyaBItAH santarjitA daRqaBayAjjvalanti ॥31॥

text: andhaṃ tama ivedaṃ syānna prajñāyeta kiñcana । daṇḍaścenna bhavelloke vibhajansādhvasādhunī ॥32॥
html:
andhaṃ tama ivedaṃ syānna prajñāyeta kiñcana ।
daṇḍaścenna bhavelloke vibhajansādhvasādhunī ॥32॥
slp1: anDaM tama ivedaM syAnna prajYAyeta kiYcana । daRqaScenna Bavelloke viBajansADvasADunI ॥32॥

text: ye'pi sambhinnamaryādā nāstikā vedanindakāḥ । te'pi bhogāya kalpante daṇḍenopanipīḍitāḥ ॥33॥
html:
ye'pi sambhinnamaryādā nāstikā vedanindakāḥ ।
te'pi bhogāya kalpante daṇḍenopanipīḍitāḥ ॥33॥
slp1: ye'pi samBinnamaryAdA nAstikA vedanindakAH । te'pi BogAya kalpante daRqenopanipIqitAH ॥33॥

text: sarvo daṇḍajito loko durlabho hi śucirnaraḥ । daṇḍasya hi bhayādbhīto bhogāyeha prakalpate ॥34॥
html:
sarvo daṇḍajito loko durlabho hi śucirnaraḥ ।
daṇḍasya hi bhayādbhīto bhogāyeha prakalpate ॥34॥
slp1: sarvo daRqajito loko durlaBo hi SucirnaraH । daRqasya hi BayAdBIto BogAyeha prakalpate ॥34॥

text: cāturvarṇyāpramohāya sunītanayanāya ca । daṇḍo vidhātrā vihito dharmārthāvabhirakṣitum ॥35॥
html:
cāturvarṇyāpramohāya sunītanayanāya ca ।
daṇḍo vidhātrā vihito dharmārthāvabhirakṣitum ॥35॥
slp1: cAturvarRyApramohAya sunItanayanAya ca । daRqo viDAtrA vihito DarmArTAvaBirakzitum ॥35॥

text: yadi daṇḍānna bibhyeyurvayāṃsi śvāpadāni ca । adyuḥ paśūnmanuṣyāṃśca yajñārthāni havīṃṣi ca ॥36॥
html:
yadi daṇḍānna bibhyeyurvayāṃsi śvāpadāni ca ।
adyuḥ paśūnmanuṣyāṃśca yajñārthāni havīṃṣi ca ॥36॥
slp1: yadi daRqAnna biByeyurvayAMsi SvApadAni ca । adyuH paSUnmanuzyAMSca yajYArTAni havIMzi ca ॥36॥

text: na brahmacāryadhīyīta kalyāṇī gaurna duhyate । na kanyodvahanaṃ gacchedyadi daṇḍo na pālayet ॥37॥
html:
na brahmacāryadhīyīta kalyāṇī gaurna duhyate ।
na kanyodvahanaṃ gacchedyadi daṇḍo na pālayet ॥37॥
slp1: na brahmacAryaDIyIta kalyARI gOrna duhyate । na kanyodvahanaM gacCedyadi daRqo na pAlayet ॥37॥

text: viśvalopaḥ pravarteta bhidyeransarvasetavaḥ । mamatvaṃ na prajānīyuryadi daṇḍo na pālayet ॥38॥
html:
viśvalopaḥ pravarteta bhidyeransarvasetavaḥ ।
mamatvaṃ na prajānīyuryadi daṇḍo na pālayet ॥38॥
slp1: viSvalopaH pravarteta BidyeransarvasetavaH । mamatvaM na prajAnIyuryadi daRqo na pAlayet ॥38॥

text: na saṃvatsarasatrāṇi tiṣṭheyurakutobhayāḥ । vidhivaddakṣiṇāvanti yadi daṇḍo na pālayet ॥39॥
html:
na saṃvatsarasatrāṇi tiṣṭheyurakutobhayāḥ ।
vidhivaddakṣiṇāvanti yadi daṇḍo na pālayet ॥39॥
slp1: na saMvatsarasatrARi tizWeyurakutoBayAH । viDivaddakziRAvanti yadi daRqo na pAlayet ॥39॥

text: careyurnāśrame dharmaṃ yathoktaṃ vidhimāśritāḥ । na vidyāṃ prāpnuyātkaścidyadi daṇḍo na pālayet ॥40॥
html:
careyurnāśrame dharmaṃ yathoktaṃ vidhimāśritāḥ ।
na vidyāṃ prāpnuyātkaścidyadi daṇḍo na pālayet ॥40॥
slp1: careyurnASrame DarmaM yaToktaM viDimASritAH । na vidyAM prApnuyAtkaScidyadi daRqo na pAlayet ॥40॥

text: na coṣṭrā na balīvardā nāśvāśvataragardabhāḥ । yuktā vaheyuryānāni yadi daṇḍo na pālayet ॥41॥
html:
na coṣṭrā na balīvardā nāśvāśvataragardabhāḥ ।
yuktā vaheyuryānāni yadi daṇḍo na pālayet ॥41॥
slp1: na cozwrA na balIvardA nASvASvataragardaBAH । yuktA vaheyuryAnAni yadi daRqo na pAlayet ॥41॥

text: na preṣyā vacanaṃ kuryurna bālo jātu karhicit । tiṣṭhetpitṛmate dharme yadi daṇḍo na pālayet ॥42॥
html:
na preṣyā vacanaṃ kuryurna bālo jātu karhicit ।
tiṣṭhetpitṛmate dharme yadi daṇḍo na pālayet ॥42॥
slp1: na prezyA vacanaM kuryurna bAlo jAtu karhicit । tizWetpitfmate Darme yadi daRqo na pAlayet ॥42॥

text: daṇḍe sthitāḥ prajāḥ sarvā bhayaṃ daṇḍaṃ vidurbudhāḥ । daṇḍe svargo manuṣyāṇāṃ loko'yaṃ ca pratiṣṭhitaḥ ॥43॥
html:
daṇḍe sthitāḥ prajāḥ sarvā bhayaṃ daṇḍaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ।
daṇḍe svargo manuṣyāṇāṃ loko'yaṃ ca pratiṣṭhitaḥ ॥43॥
slp1: daRqe sTitAH prajAH sarvA BayaM daRqaM vidurbuDAH । daRqe svargo manuzyARAM loko'yaM ca pratizWitaH ॥43॥

text: na tatra kūṭaṃ pāpaṃ vā vañcanā vāpi dṛśyate । yatra daṇḍaḥ suvihitaścaratyarivināśanaḥ ॥44॥
html:
na tatra kūṭaṃ pāpaṃ vā vañcanā vāpi dṛśyate ।
yatra daṇḍaḥ suvihitaścaratyarivināśanaḥ ॥44॥
slp1: na tatra kUwaM pApaM vA vaYcanA vApi dfSyate । yatra daRqaH suvihitaScaratyarivinASanaH ॥44॥

text: haviḥ śvā prapibeddhṛṣṭo daṇḍaścennodyato bhavet । haretkākaḥ puroḍāśaṃ yadi daṇḍo na pālayet ॥45॥
html:
haviḥ śvā prapibeddhṛṣṭo daṇḍaścennodyato bhavet ।
haretkākaḥ puroḍāśaṃ yadi daṇḍo na pālayet ॥45॥
slp1: haviH SvA prapibedDfzwo daRqaScennodyato Bavet । haretkAkaH puroqASaM yadi daRqo na pAlayet ॥45॥

text: yadidaṃ dharmato rājyaṃ vihitaṃ yadyadharmataḥ । kāryastatra na śoko vai bhuṅkṣva bhogānyajasva ca ॥46॥
html:
yadidaṃ dharmato rājyaṃ vihitaṃ yadyadharmataḥ ।
kāryastatra na śoko vai bhuṅkṣva bhogānyajasva ca ॥46॥
slp1: yadidaM Darmato rAjyaM vihitaM yadyaDarmataH । kAryastatra na Soko vE BuNkzva BogAnyajasva ca ॥46॥

text: sukhena dharmaṃ śrīmantaścaranti śucivāsasaḥ । saṃvasantaḥ priyairdārairbhuñjānāścānnamuttamam ॥47॥
html:
sukhena dharmaṃ śrīmantaścaranti śucivāsasaḥ ।
saṃvasantaḥ priyairdārairbhuñjānāścānnamuttamam ॥47॥
slp1: suKena DarmaM SrImantaScaranti SucivAsasaH । saMvasantaH priyErdArErBuYjAnAScAnnamuttamam ॥47॥

text: arthe sarve samārambhāḥ samāyattā na saṃśayaḥ । sa ca daṇḍe samāyattaḥ paśya daṇḍasya gauravam ॥48॥
html:
arthe sarve samārambhāḥ samāyattā na saṃśayaḥ ।
sa ca daṇḍe samāyattaḥ paśya daṇḍasya gauravam ॥48॥
slp1: arTe sarve samAramBAH samAyattA na saMSayaH । sa ca daRqe samAyattaH paSya daRqasya gOravam ॥48॥

text: lokayātrārthameveha dharmapravacanaṃ kṛtam । ahiṃsā sādhuhiṃseti śreyāndharmaparigrahaḥ ॥49॥
html:
lokayātrārthameveha dharmapravacanaṃ kṛtam ।
ahiṃsā sādhuhiṃseti śreyāndharmaparigrahaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: lokayAtrArTameveha DarmapravacanaM kftam । ahiMsA sADuhiMseti SreyAnDarmaparigrahaH ॥49॥

text: nātyantaguṇavānkaścinna cāpyatyantanirguṇaḥ । ubhayaṃ sarvakāryeṣu dṛśyate sādhvasādhu ca ॥50॥
html:
nātyantaguṇavānkaścinna cāpyatyantanirguṇaḥ ।
ubhayaṃ sarvakāryeṣu dṛśyate sādhvasādhu ca ॥50॥
slp1: nAtyantaguRavAnkaScinna cApyatyantanirguRaH । uBayaM sarvakAryezu dfSyate sADvasADu ca ॥50॥

text: paśūnāṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ chittvā tato bhindanti nastakān । kṛṣanti bahavo bhārānbadhnanti damayanti ca ॥51॥
html:
paśūnāṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ chittvā tato bhindanti nastakān ।
kṛṣanti bahavo bhārānbadhnanti damayanti ca ॥51॥
slp1: paSUnAM vfzaRaM CittvA tato Bindanti nastakAn । kfzanti bahavo BArAnbaDnanti damayanti ca ॥51॥

text: evaṃ paryākule loke vipathe jarjarīkṛte । taistairnyāyairmahārāja purāṇaṃ dharmamācara ॥52॥
html:
evaṃ paryākule loke vipathe jarjarīkṛte ।
taistairnyāyairmahārāja purāṇaṃ dharmamācara ॥52॥
slp1: evaM paryAkule loke vipaTe jarjarIkfte । tEstErnyAyErmahArAja purARaM DarmamAcara ॥52॥

text: yaja dehi prajā rakṣa dharmaṃ samanupālaya । amitrāñjahi kaunteya mitrāṇi paripālaya ॥53॥
html:
yaja dehi prajā rakṣa dharmaṃ samanupālaya ।
amitrāñjahi kaunteya mitrāṇi paripālaya ॥53॥
slp1: yaja dehi prajA rakza DarmaM samanupAlaya । amitrAYjahi kOnteya mitrARi paripAlaya ॥53॥

text: mā ca te nighnataḥ śatrūnmanyurbhavatu bhārata । na tatra kilbiṣaṃ kiñcitkarturbhavati bhārata ॥54॥
html:
mā ca te nighnataḥ śatrūnmanyurbhavatu bhārata ।
na tatra kilbiṣaṃ kiñcitkarturbhavati bhārata ॥54॥
slp1: mA ca te niGnataH SatrUnmanyurBavatu BArata । na tatra kilbizaM kiYcitkarturBavati BArata ॥54॥

text: ātatāyī hi yo hanyādātatāyinamāgatam । na tena bhrūṇahā sa syānmanyustaṃ manyumṛcchati ॥55॥
html:
ātatāyī hi yo hanyādātatāyinamāgatam ।
na tena bhrūṇahā sa syānmanyustaṃ manyumṛcchati ॥55॥
slp1: AtatAyI hi yo hanyAdAtatAyinamAgatam । na tena BrURahA sa syAnmanyustaM manyumfcCati ॥55॥

text: avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāmantarātmā na saṃśayaḥ । avadhye cātmani kathaṃ vadhyo bhavati kenacit ॥56॥
html:
avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāmantarātmā na saṃśayaḥ ।
avadhye cātmani kathaṃ vadhyo bhavati kenacit ॥56॥
slp1: avaDyaH sarvaBUtAnAmantarAtmA na saMSayaH । avaDye cAtmani kaTaM vaDyo Bavati kenacit ॥56॥

text: yathā hi puruṣaḥ śālāṃ punaḥ sampraviśennavām । evaṃ jīvaḥ śarīrāṇi tāni tāni prapadyate ॥57॥
html:
yathā hi puruṣaḥ śālāṃ punaḥ sampraviśennavām ।
evaṃ jīvaḥ śarīrāṇi tāni tāni prapadyate ॥57॥
slp1: yaTA hi puruzaH SAlAM punaH sampraviSennavAm । evaM jIvaH SarIrARi tAni tAni prapadyate ॥57॥

text: dehānpurāṇānutsṛjya navānsampratipadyate । evaṃ mṛtyumukhaṃ prāhurye janāstattvadarśinaḥ] ॥58॥
html:
dehānpurāṇānutsṛjya navānsampratipadyate ।
evaṃ mṛtyumukhaṃ prāhurye janāstattvadarśinaḥ] ॥58॥
slp1: dehAnpurARAnutsfjya navAnsampratipadyate । evaM mftyumuKaM prAhurye janAstattvadarSinaH] ॥58॥

text: arjunasya vacaḥ śrutvā bhīmaseno'tyamarṣaṇaḥ । dhairyamāsthāya tejasvī jyeṣṭhaṃ bhrātaramabravīt ॥1॥
html:
arjunasya vacaḥ śrutvā bhīmaseno'tyamarṣaṇaḥ ।
dhairyamāsthāya tejasvī jyeṣṭhaṃ bhrātaramabravīt ॥1॥
slp1: arjunasya vacaH SrutvA BImaseno'tyamarzaRaH । DEryamAsTAya tejasvI jyezWaM BrAtaramabravIt ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: rājanviditadharmo'si na te'styaviditaṃ bhuvi । upaśikṣāma te vṛttaṃ sadaiva na ca śaknumaḥ ॥2॥
html:
rājanviditadharmo'si na te'styaviditaṃ bhuvi ।
upaśikṣāma te vṛttaṃ sadaiva na ca śaknumaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: rAjanviditaDarmo'si na te'styaviditaM Buvi । upaSikzAma te vfttaM sadEva na ca SaknumaH ॥2॥

text: na vakṣyāmi na vakṣyāmītyevaṃ me manasi sthitam । atiduḥkhāttu vakṣyāmi tannibodha janādhipa ॥3॥
html:
na vakṣyāmi na vakṣyāmītyevaṃ me manasi sthitam ।
atiduḥkhāttu vakṣyāmi tannibodha janādhipa ॥3॥
slp1: na vakzyAmi na vakzyAmItyevaM me manasi sTitam । atiduHKAttu vakzyAmi tanniboDa janADipa ॥3॥

text: bhavatastu pramohena sarvaṃ saṃśayitaṃ kṛtam । viklavatvaṃ ca naḥ prāptamabalatvaṃ tathaiva ca ॥4॥
html:
bhavatastu pramohena sarvaṃ saṃśayitaṃ kṛtam ।
viklavatvaṃ ca naḥ prāptamabalatvaṃ tathaiva ca ॥4॥
slp1: Bavatastu pramohena sarvaM saMSayitaM kftam । viklavatvaM ca naH prAptamabalatvaM taTEva ca ॥4॥

text: kathaṃ hi rājā lokasya sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ । mohamāpadyate dainyādyathā kupuruṣastathā ॥5॥
html:
kathaṃ hi rājā lokasya sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ ।
mohamāpadyate dainyādyathā kupuruṣastathā ॥5॥
slp1: kaTaM hi rAjA lokasya sarvaSAstraviSAradaH । mohamApadyate dEnyAdyaTA kupuruzastaTA ॥5॥

text: āgatiśca gatiścaiva lokasya viditā tava । āyatyāṃ ca tadātve ca na te'styaviditaṃ prabho ॥6॥
html:
āgatiśca gatiścaiva lokasya viditā tava ।
āyatyāṃ ca tadātve ca na te'styaviditaṃ prabho ॥6॥
slp1: AgatiSca gatiScEva lokasya viditA tava । AyatyAM ca tadAtve ca na te'styaviditaM praBo ॥6॥

text: evaṃ gate mahārāja rājyaṃ prati janādhipa । hetumatra pravakṣyāmi tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ॥7॥
html:
evaṃ gate mahārāja rājyaṃ prati janādhipa ।
hetumatra pravakṣyāmi tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ॥7॥
slp1: evaM gate mahArAja rAjyaM prati janADipa । hetumatra pravakzyAmi tadihEkamanAH SfRu ॥7॥

text: dvividho jāyate vyādhiḥ śārīro mānasastathā । parasparaṃ tayorjanma nirdvandvaṃ nopalabhyate ॥8॥
html:
dvividho jāyate vyādhiḥ śārīro mānasastathā ।
parasparaṃ tayorjanma nirdvandvaṃ nopalabhyate ॥8॥
slp1: dviviDo jAyate vyADiH SArIro mAnasastaTA । parasparaM tayorjanma nirdvandvaM nopalaByate ॥8॥

text: śārīrājjāyate vyādhirmānaso nātra saṃśayaḥ । mānasājjāyate vyādhiḥ śārīra iti niścayaḥ ॥9॥
html:
śārīrājjāyate vyādhirmānaso nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
mānasājjāyate vyādhiḥ śārīra iti niścayaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: SArIrAjjAyate vyADirmAnaso nAtra saMSayaH । mAnasAjjAyate vyADiH SArIra iti niScayaH ॥9॥

text: śārīramānase duḥkhe yo'tīte anuśocati । duḥkhena labhate duḥkhaṃ dvāvanarthau prapadyate ॥10॥
html:
śārīramānase duḥkhe yo'tīte anuśocati ।
duḥkhena labhate duḥkhaṃ dvāvanarthau prapadyate ॥10॥
slp1: SArIramAnase duHKe yo'tIte anuSocati । duHKena laBate duHKaM dvAvanarTO prapadyate ॥10॥

text: śītoṣṇe caiva vāyuśca trayaḥ śārīrajā guṇāḥ । teṣāṃ guṇānāṃ sāmyaṃ ca tadāhuḥ svasthalakṣaṇam ॥11॥
html:
śītoṣṇe caiva vāyuśca trayaḥ śārīrajā guṇāḥ ।
teṣāṃ guṇānāṃ sāmyaṃ ca tadāhuḥ svasthalakṣaṇam ॥11॥
slp1: SItozRe cEva vAyuSca trayaH SArIrajA guRAH । tezAM guRAnAM sAmyaM ca tadAhuH svasTalakzaRam ॥11॥

text: teṣāmanyatamotseke vidhānamupadiṣyate । uṣṇena bādhyate śītaṃ śītenoṣṇaṃ prabādhyate ॥12॥
html:
teṣāmanyatamotseke vidhānamupadiṣyate ।
uṣṇena bādhyate śītaṃ śītenoṣṇaṃ prabādhyate ॥12॥
slp1: tezAmanyatamotseke viDAnamupadizyate । uzRena bADyate SItaM SItenozRaM prabADyate ॥12॥

text: sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva mānasāḥ syustrayo guṇāḥ । harṣeṇa bādhyate śoko harṣaḥ śokena bādhyate ॥13॥
html:
sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva mānasāḥ syustrayo guṇāḥ ।
harṣeṇa bādhyate śoko harṣaḥ śokena bādhyate ॥13॥
slp1: sattvaM rajastamaScEva mAnasAH syustrayo guRAH । harzeRa bADyate Soko harzaH Sokena bADyate ॥13॥

text: kaścitsukhe vartamāno duḥkhasya smartumicchati । kaścidduḥkhe vartamānaḥ sukhasya smartumicchati ॥14॥
html:
kaścitsukhe vartamāno duḥkhasya smartumicchati ।
kaścidduḥkhe vartamānaḥ sukhasya smartumicchati ॥14॥
slp1: kaScitsuKe vartamAno duHKasya smartumicCati । kaScidduHKe vartamAnaH suKasya smartumicCati ॥14॥

text: sa tvaṃ na duḥkhī duḥkhasya na sukhī ca sukhasya ca । na duḥkhī sukhajātasya na sukhī duḥkhajasya vā ॥15॥
html:
sa tvaṃ na duḥkhī duḥkhasya na sukhī ca sukhasya ca ।
na duḥkhī sukhajātasya na sukhī duḥkhajasya vā ॥15॥
slp1: sa tvaM na duHKI duHKasya na suKI ca suKasya ca । na duHKI suKajAtasya na suKI duHKajasya vA ॥15॥

text: smartumarhasi kauravya diṣṭaṃ tu balavattaram । atha vā te svabhāvo'yaṃ yena pārthiva kṛṣyase ॥16॥
html:
smartumarhasi kauravya diṣṭaṃ tu balavattaram ।
atha vā te svabhāvo'yaṃ yena pārthiva kṛṣyase ॥16॥
slp1: smartumarhasi kOravya dizwaM tu balavattaram । aTa vA te svaBAvo'yaM yena pArTiva kfzyase ॥16॥

text: dṛṣṭvā sabhāgatāṃ kṛṣṇāmekavastrāṃ rajasvalām । miṣatāṃ pāṇḍuputrāṇāṃ na tasya smartumarhasi ॥17॥
html:
dṛṣṭvā sabhāgatāṃ kṛṣṇāmekavastrāṃ rajasvalām ।
miṣatāṃ pāṇḍuputrāṇāṃ na tasya smartumarhasi ॥17॥
slp1: dfzwvA saBAgatAM kfzRAmekavastrAM rajasvalAm । mizatAM pARquputrARAM na tasya smartumarhasi ॥17॥

text: pravrājanaṃ ca nagarādajinaiśca nivāsanam । mahāraṇyanivāsaśca na tasya smartumarhasi ॥18॥
html:
pravrājanaṃ ca nagarādajinaiśca nivāsanam ।
mahāraṇyanivāsaśca na tasya smartumarhasi ॥18॥
slp1: pravrAjanaM ca nagarAdajinESca nivAsanam । mahAraRyanivAsaSca na tasya smartumarhasi ॥18॥

text: jaṭāsurātparikleśaṃ citrasenena cāhavam । saindhavācca parikleśaṃ kathaṃ vismṛtavānasi । punarajñātacaryāyāṃ kīcakena padā vadham ॥19॥
html:
jaṭāsurātparikleśaṃ citrasenena cāhavam ।
saindhavācca parikleśaṃ kathaṃ vismṛtavānasi ।
punarajñātacaryāyāṃ kīcakena padā vadham ॥19॥
slp1: jawAsurAtparikleSaM citrasenena cAhavam । sEnDavAcca parikleSaM kaTaM vismftavAnasi । punarajYAtacaryAyAM kIcakena padA vaDam ॥19॥

text: yacca te droṇabhīṣmābhyāṃ yuddhamāsīdarindama । manasaikena te yuddhamidaṃ ghoramupasthitam ॥20॥
html:
yacca te droṇabhīṣmābhyāṃ yuddhamāsīdarindama ।
manasaikena te yuddhamidaṃ ghoramupasthitam ॥20॥
slp1: yacca te droRaBIzmAByAM yudDamAsIdarindama । manasEkena te yudDamidaM GoramupasTitam ॥20॥

text: yatra nāsti śaraiḥ kāryaṃ na mitrairna ca bandhubhiḥ । ātmanaikena yoddhavyaṃ tatte yuddhamupasthitam ॥21॥
html:
yatra nāsti śaraiḥ kāryaṃ na mitrairna ca bandhubhiḥ ।
ātmanaikena yoddhavyaṃ tatte yuddhamupasthitam ॥21॥
slp1: yatra nAsti SarEH kAryaM na mitrErna ca banDuBiH । AtmanEkena yodDavyaM tatte yudDamupasTitam ॥21॥

text: tasminnanirjite yuddhe prāṇānyadi ha mokṣyase । anyaṃ dehaṃ samāsthāya punastenaiva yotsyase ॥22॥
html:
tasminnanirjite yuddhe prāṇānyadi ha mokṣyase ।
anyaṃ dehaṃ samāsthāya punastenaiva yotsyase ॥22॥
slp1: tasminnanirjite yudDe prARAnyadi ha mokzyase । anyaM dehaM samAsTAya punastenEva yotsyase ॥22॥

text: tasmādadyaiva gantavyaṃ yuddhasya bharatarṣabha । etajjitvā mahārāja kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyasi ॥23॥
html:
tasmādadyaiva gantavyaṃ yuddhasya bharatarṣabha ।
etajjitvā mahārāja kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyasi ॥23॥
slp1: tasmAdadyEva gantavyaM yudDasya BaratarzaBa । etajjitvA mahArAja kftakftyo Bavizyasi ॥23॥

text: etāṃ buddhiṃ viniścitya bhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatim । pitṛpaitāmahe vṛtte śādhi rājyaṃ yathocitam ॥24॥
html:
etāṃ buddhiṃ viniścitya bhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatim ।
pitṛpaitāmahe vṛtte śādhi rājyaṃ yathocitam ॥24॥
slp1: etAM budDiM viniScitya BUtAnAmAgatiM gatim । pitfpEtAmahe vftte SADi rAjyaM yaTocitam ॥24॥

text: diṣṭyā duryodhanaḥ pāpo nihataḥ sānugo yudhi । draupadyāḥ keśapakṣasya diṣṭyā tvaṃ padavīṃ gataḥ ॥25॥
html:
diṣṭyā duryodhanaḥ pāpo nihataḥ sānugo yudhi ।
draupadyāḥ keśapakṣasya diṣṭyā tvaṃ padavīṃ gataḥ ॥25॥
slp1: dizwyA duryoDanaH pApo nihataH sAnugo yuDi । drOpadyAH keSapakzasya dizwyA tvaM padavIM gataH ॥25॥

text: yajasva vājimedhena vidhivaddakṣiṇāvatā । vayaṃ te kiṅkarāḥ pārtha vāsudevaśca vīryavān] ॥26॥
html:
yajasva vājimedhena vidhivaddakṣiṇāvatā ।
vayaṃ te kiṅkarāḥ pārtha vāsudevaśca vīryavān] ॥26॥
slp1: yajasva vAjimeDena viDivaddakziRAvatA । vayaM te kiNkarAH pArTa vAsudevaSca vIryavAn] ॥26॥

text: asantoṣaḥ pramādaśca mado rāgo'praśāntatā । balaṃ moho'bhimānaśca udvegaścāpi sarvaśaḥ ॥1॥
html:
asantoṣaḥ pramādaśca mado rāgo'praśāntatā ।
balaṃ moho'bhimānaśca udvegaścāpi sarvaśaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: asantozaH pramAdaSca mado rAgo'praSAntatA । balaM moho'BimAnaSca udvegaScApi sarvaSaH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: ebhiḥ pāpmabhirāviṣṭo rājyaṃ tvamabhikāṅkṣasi । nirāmiṣo vinirmuktaḥ praśāntaḥ susukhī bhava ॥2॥
html:
ebhiḥ pāpmabhirāviṣṭo rājyaṃ tvamabhikāṅkṣasi ।
nirāmiṣo vinirmuktaḥ praśāntaḥ susukhī bhava ॥2॥
slp1: eBiH pApmaBirAvizwo rAjyaM tvamaBikANkzasi । nirAmizo vinirmuktaH praSAntaH susuKI Bava ॥2॥

text: ya imāmakhilāṃ bhūmiṃ śiṣyādeko mahīpatiḥ । tasyāpyudaramevaikaṃ kimidaṃ tvaṃ praśaṃsasi ॥3॥
html:
ya imāmakhilāṃ bhūmiṃ śiṣyādeko mahīpatiḥ ।
tasyāpyudaramevaikaṃ kimidaṃ tvaṃ praśaṃsasi ॥3॥
slp1: ya imAmaKilAM BUmiM SizyAdeko mahIpatiH । tasyApyudaramevEkaM kimidaM tvaM praSaMsasi ॥3॥

text: nāhnā pūrayituṃ śakyā na māsena nararṣabha । apūryāṃ pūrayannicchāmāyuṣāpi na śaknuyāt ॥4॥
html:
nāhnā pūrayituṃ śakyā na māsena nararṣabha ।
apūryāṃ pūrayannicchāmāyuṣāpi na śaknuyāt ॥4॥
slp1: nAhnA pUrayituM SakyA na mAsena nararzaBa । apUryAM pUrayannicCAmAyuzApi na SaknuyAt ॥4॥

text: yatheddhaḥ prajvalatyagnirasamiddhaḥ praśāmyati । alpāhāratayā tvagniṃ śamayaudaryamutthitam । jayodaraṃ pṛthivyā te śreyo nirjitayā jitam ॥5॥
html:
yatheddhaḥ prajvalatyagnirasamiddhaḥ praśāmyati ।
alpāhāratayā tvagniṃ śamayaudaryamutthitam ।
jayodaraṃ pṛthivyā te śreyo nirjitayā jitam ॥5॥
slp1: yaTedDaH prajvalatyagnirasamidDaH praSAmyati । alpAhAratayA tvagniM SamayOdaryamutTitam । jayodaraM pfTivyA te Sreyo nirjitayA jitam ॥5॥

text: mānuṣānkāmabhogāṃstvamaiśvaryaṃ ca praśaṃsasi । abhogino'balāścaiva yānti sthānamanuttamam ॥6॥
html:
mānuṣānkāmabhogāṃstvamaiśvaryaṃ ca praśaṃsasi ।
abhogino'balāścaiva yānti sthānamanuttamam ॥6॥
slp1: mAnuzAnkAmaBogAMstvamESvaryaM ca praSaMsasi । aBogino'balAScEva yAnti sTAnamanuttamam ॥6॥

text: yogakṣemau ca rāṣṭrasya dharmādharmau tvayi sthitau । mucyasva mahato bhārāttyāgamevābhisaṃśraya ॥7॥
html:
yogakṣemau ca rāṣṭrasya dharmādharmau tvayi sthitau ।
mucyasva mahato bhārāttyāgamevābhisaṃśraya ॥7॥
slp1: yogakzemO ca rAzwrasya DarmADarmO tvayi sTitO । mucyasva mahato BArAttyAgamevABisaMSraya ॥7॥

text: ekodarakṛte vyāghraḥ karoti vighasaṃ bahu । tamanye'pyupajīvanti mandavegañcarā mṛgāḥ ॥8॥
html:
ekodarakṛte vyāghraḥ karoti vighasaṃ bahu ।
tamanye'pyupajīvanti mandavegañcarā mṛgāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: ekodarakfte vyAGraH karoti viGasaM bahu । tamanye'pyupajIvanti mandavegaYcarA mfgAH ॥8॥

text: viṣayānpratisaṃhṛtya saṃnyāsaṃ kurute yatiḥ । na ca tuṣyanti rājānaḥ paśya buddhyantaraṃ yathā ॥9॥
html:
viṣayānpratisaṃhṛtya saṃnyāsaṃ kurute yatiḥ ।
na ca tuṣyanti rājānaḥ paśya buddhyantaraṃ yathā ॥9॥
slp1: vizayAnpratisaMhftya saMnyAsaM kurute yatiH । na ca tuzyanti rAjAnaH paSya budDyantaraM yaTA ॥9॥

text: patrāhārairaśmakuṭṭairdantolūkhalikaistathā । abbhakṣairvāyubhakṣaiśca tairayaṃ narako jitaḥ ॥10॥
html:
patrāhārairaśmakuṭṭairdantolūkhalikaistathā ।
abbhakṣairvāyubhakṣaiśca tairayaṃ narako jitaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: patrAhArEraSmakuwwErdantolUKalikEstaTA । abBakzErvAyuBakzESca tErayaM narako jitaH ॥10॥

text: yaścemāṃ vasudhāṃ kṛtsnāṃ praśāsedakhilāṃ nṛpaḥ । tulyāśmakāñcano yaśca sa kṛtārtho na pārthivaḥ ॥11॥
html:
yaścemāṃ vasudhāṃ kṛtsnāṃ praśāsedakhilāṃ nṛpaḥ ।
tulyāśmakāñcano yaśca sa kṛtārtho na pārthivaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: yaScemAM vasuDAM kftsnAM praSAsedaKilAM nfpaH । tulyASmakAYcano yaSca sa kftArTo na pArTivaH ॥11॥

text: saṅkalpeṣu nirārambho nirāśo nirmamo bhava । viśokaṃ sthānamātiṣṭha iha cāmutra cāvyayam ॥12॥
html:
saṅkalpeṣu nirārambho nirāśo nirmamo bhava ।
viśokaṃ sthānamātiṣṭha iha cāmutra cāvyayam ॥12॥
slp1: saNkalpezu nirAramBo nirASo nirmamo Bava । viSokaM sTAnamAtizWa iha cAmutra cAvyayam ॥12॥

text: nirāmiṣā na śocanti śocasi tvaṃ kimāmiṣam । parityajyāmiṣaṃ sarvaṃ mṛṣāvādātpramokṣyase ॥13॥
html:
nirāmiṣā na śocanti śocasi tvaṃ kimāmiṣam ।
parityajyāmiṣaṃ sarvaṃ mṛṣāvādātpramokṣyase ॥13॥
slp1: nirAmizA na Socanti Socasi tvaM kimAmizam । parityajyAmizaM sarvaM mfzAvAdAtpramokzyase ॥13॥

text: panthānau pitṛyānaśca devayānaśca viśrutau । ījānāḥ pitṛyānena devayānena mokṣiṇaḥ ॥14॥
html:
panthānau pitṛyānaśca devayānaśca viśrutau ।
ījānāḥ pitṛyānena devayānena mokṣiṇaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: panTAnO pitfyAnaSca devayAnaSca viSrutO । IjAnAH pitfyAnena devayAnena mokziRaH ॥14॥

text: tapasā brahmacaryeṇa svādhyāyena ca pāvitāḥ । vimucya dehānvai bhānti mṛtyoraviṣayaṃ gatāḥ ॥15॥
html:
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa svādhyāyena ca pāvitāḥ ।
vimucya dehānvai bhānti mṛtyoraviṣayaṃ gatāḥ ॥15॥
slp1: tapasA brahmacaryeRa svADyAyena ca pAvitAH । vimucya dehAnvE BAnti mftyoravizayaM gatAH ॥15॥

text: āmiṣaṃ bandhanaṃ loke karmehoktaṃ tathāmiṣam । tābhyāṃ vimuktaḥ pāśābhyāṃ padamāpnoti tatparam ॥16॥
html:
āmiṣaṃ bandhanaṃ loke karmehoktaṃ tathāmiṣam ।
tābhyāṃ vimuktaḥ pāśābhyāṃ padamāpnoti tatparam ॥16॥
slp1: AmizaM banDanaM loke karmehoktaM taTAmizam । tAByAM vimuktaH pASAByAM padamApnoti tatparam ॥16॥

text: api gāthāmimāṃ gītāṃ janakena vadantyuta । nirdvandvena vimuktena mokṣaṃ samanupaśyatā ॥17॥
html:
api gāthāmimāṃ gītāṃ janakena vadantyuta ।
nirdvandvena vimuktena mokṣaṃ samanupaśyatā ॥17॥
slp1: api gATAmimAM gItAM janakena vadantyuta । nirdvandvena vimuktena mokzaM samanupaSyatA ॥17॥

text: anantaṃ bata me vittaṃ yasya me nāsti kiñcana । mithilāyāṃ pradīptāyāṃ na me dahyati kiñcana ॥18॥
html:
anantaṃ bata me vittaṃ yasya me nāsti kiñcana ।
mithilāyāṃ pradīptāyāṃ na me dahyati kiñcana ॥18॥
slp1: anantaM bata me vittaM yasya me nAsti kiYcana । miTilAyAM pradIptAyAM na me dahyati kiYcana ॥18॥

text: prajñāprāsādamāruhya naśocyāñśocato janān । jagatīsthānivādristho mandabuddhīnavekṣate ॥19॥
html:
prajñāprāsādamāruhya naśocyāñśocato janān ।

text: dṛśyaṃ paśyati yaḥ paśyansa cakṣuṣmānsa buddhimān । ajñātānāṃ ca vijñānātsambodhādbuddhirucyate ॥20॥
html:
dṛśyaṃ paśyati yaḥ paśyansa cakṣuṣmānsa buddhimān ।
ajñātānāṃ ca vijñānātsambodhādbuddhirucyate ॥20॥
slp1: dfSyaM paSyati yaH paSyansa cakzuzmAnsa budDimAn । ajYAtAnAM ca vijYAnAtsamboDAdbudDirucyate ॥20॥

text: yastu vācaṃ vijānāti bahumānamiyātsa vai । brahmabhāvaprasūtānāṃ vaidyānāṃ bhāvitātmanām ॥21॥
html:
yastu vācaṃ vijānāti bahumānamiyātsa vai ।
brahmabhāvaprasūtānāṃ vaidyānāṃ bhāvitātmanām ॥21॥
slp1: yastu vAcaM vijAnAti bahumAnamiyAtsa vE । brahmaBAvaprasUtAnAM vEdyAnAM BAvitAtmanAm ॥21॥

text: yadā bhūtapṛthagbhāvamekasthamanupaśyati । tata eva ca vistāraṃ brahma sampadyate tadā ॥22॥
html:

slp1: yadA BUtapfTagBAvamekasTamanupaSyati । tata eva ca vistAraM brahma sampadyate tadA ॥22॥

text: te janāstāṃ gatiṃ yānti nāvidvāṃso'lpacetasaḥ । nābuddhayo nātapasaḥ sarvaṃ buddhau pratiṣṭhitam] ॥23॥

nābuddhayo nātapasaḥ sarvaṃ buddhau pratiṣṭhitam] ॥23॥
slp1: te janAstAM gatiM yAnti nAvidvAMso'lpacetasaH । nAbudDayo nAtapasaH sarvaM budDO pratizWitam] ॥23॥

text: tūṣṇīṃbhūtaṃ tu rājānaṃ punarevārjuno'bravīt । santaptaḥ śokaduḥkhābhyāṃ rājño vākśalyapīḍitaḥ ॥1॥
html:
tūṣṇīṃbhūtaṃ tu rājānaṃ punarevārjuno'bravīt ।
santaptaḥ śokaduḥkhābhyāṃ rājño vākśalyapīḍitaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: tUzRIMBUtaM tu rAjAnaM punarevArjuno'bravIt । santaptaH SokaduHKAByAM rAjYo vAkSalyapIqitaH ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: kathayanti purāvṛttamitihāsamimaṃ janāḥ । videharājñaḥ saṃvādaṃ bhāryayā saha bhārata ॥2॥
html:
kathayanti purāvṛttamitihāsamimaṃ janāḥ ।
videharājñaḥ saṃvādaṃ bhāryayā saha bhārata ॥2॥
slp1: kaTayanti purAvfttamitihAsamimaM janAH । videharAjYaH saMvAdaM BAryayA saha BArata ॥2॥

text: utsṛjya rājyaṃ bhaikṣārthaṃ kṛtabuddhiṃ janeśvaram । videharājaṃ mahiṣī duḥkhitā pratyabhāṣata ॥3॥
html:
utsṛjya rājyaṃ bhaikṣārthaṃ kṛtabuddhiṃ janeśvaram ।
videharājaṃ mahiṣī duḥkhitā pratyabhāṣata ॥3॥
slp1: utsfjya rAjyaM BEkzArTaM kftabudDiM janeSvaram । videharAjaM mahizI duHKitA pratyaBAzata ॥3॥

text: dhanānyapatyaṃ mitrāṇi ratnāni vividhāni ca । panthānaṃ pāvanaṃ hitvā janako mauṇḍyamāsthitaḥ ॥4॥
html:
dhanānyapatyaṃ mitrāṇi ratnāni vividhāni ca ।
panthānaṃ pāvanaṃ hitvā janako mauṇḍyamāsthitaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: DanAnyapatyaM mitrARi ratnAni viviDAni ca । panTAnaM pAvanaM hitvA janako mORqyamAsTitaH ॥4॥

text: taṃ dadarśa priyā bhāryā bhaikṣyavṛttimakiñcanam । dhānāmuṣṭimupāsīnaṃ nirīhaṃ gatamatsaram ॥5॥
html:
taṃ dadarśa priyā bhāryā bhaikṣyavṛttimakiñcanam ।
dhānāmuṣṭimupāsīnaṃ nirīhaṃ gatamatsaram ॥5॥
slp1: taM dadarSa priyA BAryA BEkzyavfttimakiYcanam । DAnAmuzwimupAsInaM nirIhaM gatamatsaram ॥5॥

text: tamuvāca samāgamya bhartāramakutobhayam । kruddhā manasvinī bhāryā vivikte hetumadvacaḥ ॥6॥

slp1: tamuvAca samAgamya BartAramakutoBayam । krudDA manasvinI BAryA vivikte hetumadvacaH ॥6॥

text: kathamutsṛjya rājyaṃ svaṃ dhanadhānyasamācitam । kāpālīṃ vṛttimāsthāya dhānāmuṣṭirvane'caraḥ ॥7॥
html:
kathamutsṛjya rājyaṃ svaṃ dhanadhānyasamācitam ।
kāpālīṃ vṛttimāsthāya dhānāmuṣṭirvane'caraḥ ॥7॥
slp1: kaTamutsfjya rAjyaM svaM DanaDAnyasamAcitam । kApAlIM vfttimAsTAya DAnAmuzwirvane'caraH ॥7॥

text: pratijñā te'nyathā rājanviceṣṭā cānyathā tava । yadrājyaṃ mahadutsṛjya svalpe tuṣyasi pārthiva ॥8॥
html:
pratijñā te'nyathā rājanviceṣṭā cānyathā tava ।
yadrājyaṃ mahadutsṛjya svalpe tuṣyasi pārthiva ॥8॥
slp1: pratijYA te'nyaTA rAjanvicezwA cAnyaTA tava । yadrAjyaM mahadutsfjya svalpe tuzyasi pArTiva ॥8॥

text: naitenātithayo rājandevarṣipitarastathā । śakyamadya tvayā bhartuṃ moghaste'yaṃ pariśramaḥ ॥9॥
html:
naitenātithayo rājandevarṣipitarastathā ।
śakyamadya tvayā bhartuṃ moghaste'yaṃ pariśramaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: nEtenAtiTayo rAjandevarzipitarastaTA । Sakyamadya tvayA BartuM moGaste'yaM pariSramaH ॥9॥

text: devatātithibhiścaiva pitṛbhiścaiva pārthiva । sarvairetaiḥ parityaktaḥ parivrajasi niṣkriyaḥ ॥10॥
html:
devatātithibhiścaiva pitṛbhiścaiva pārthiva ।

slp1: devatAtiTiBiScEva pitfBiScEva pArTiva । sarvEretEH parityaktaH parivrajasi nizkriyaH ॥10॥

text: yastvaṃ traividyavṛddhānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasraśaḥ । bhartā bhūtvā ca lokasya so'dyānyairbhṛtimicchasi ॥11॥
html:

slp1: yastvaM trEvidyavfdDAnAM brAhmaRAnAM sahasraSaH । BartA BUtvA ca lokasya so'dyAnyErBftimicCasi ॥11॥

text: śriyaṃ hitvā pradīptāṃ tvaṃ śvavatsamprati vīkṣyase । aputrā jananī te'dya kausalyā cāpatistvayā ॥12॥
html:
śriyaṃ hitvā pradīptāṃ tvaṃ śvavatsamprati vīkṣyase ।

slp1: SriyaM hitvA pradIptAM tvaM Svavatsamprati vIkzyase । aputrA jananI te'dya kOsalyA cApatistvayA ॥12॥

text: aśītirdharmakāmāstvāṃ kṣatriyāḥ paryupāsate । tvadāśāmabhikāṅkṣantyaḥ kṛpaṇāḥ phalahetukāḥ ॥13॥
html:
aśītirdharmakāmāstvāṃ kṣatriyāḥ paryupāsate ।
tvadāśāmabhikāṅkṣantyaḥ kṛpaṇāḥ phalahetukāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: aSItirDarmakAmAstvAM kzatriyAH paryupAsate । tvadASAmaBikANkzantyaH kfpaRAH PalahetukAH ॥13॥

text: tāśca tvaṃ viphalāḥ kurvankāṁllokānnu gamiṣyasi । rājansaṃśayite mokṣe paratantreṣu dehiṣu ॥14॥
html:

rājansaṃśayite mokṣe paratantreṣu dehiṣu ॥14॥
slp1: tASca tvaM viPalAH kurvankAṁllokAnnu gamizyasi । rAjansaMSayite mokze paratantrezu dehizu ॥14॥

html:
