slp1: nEva te'sti paro loko nAparaH pApakarmaRaH । DarmyAndArAnparityajya yastvamicCasi jIvitum ॥15॥

text: srajo gandhānalaṅkārānvāsāṃsi vividhāni ca । kimarthamabhisantyajya parivrajasi niṣkriyaḥ ॥16॥
html:
srajo gandhānalaṅkārānvāsāṃsi vividhāni ca ।
kimarthamabhisantyajya parivrajasi niṣkriyaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: srajo ganDAnalaNkArAnvAsAMsi viviDAni ca । kimarTamaBisantyajya parivrajasi nizkriyaH ॥16॥

text: nipānaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhūtvā tvaṃ pāvanaṃ mahat । āḍhyo vanaspatirbhūtvā so'dyānyānparyupāsase ॥17॥
html:
nipānaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhūtvā tvaṃ pāvanaṃ mahat ।
āḍhyo vanaspatirbhūtvā so'dyānyānparyupāsase ॥17॥
slp1: nipAnaM sarvaBUtAnAM BUtvA tvaM pAvanaM mahat । AQyo vanaspatirBUtvA so'dyAnyAnparyupAsase ॥17॥

text: khādanti hastinaṃ nyāse kravyādā bahavo'pyuta । bahavaḥ kṛmayaścaiva kiṃ punastvāmanarthakam ॥18॥
html:
khādanti hastinaṃ nyāse kravyādā bahavo'pyuta ।
bahavaḥ kṛmayaścaiva kiṃ punastvāmanarthakam ॥18॥
slp1: KAdanti hastinaM nyAse kravyAdA bahavo'pyuta । bahavaH kfmayaScEva kiM punastvAmanarTakam ॥18॥

text: ya imāṃ kuṇḍikāṃ bhindyāttriviṣṭabdhaṃ ca te haret । vāsaścāpaharettasminkathaṃ te mānasaṃ bhavet ॥19॥
html:
ya imāṃ kuṇḍikāṃ bhindyāttriviṣṭabdhaṃ ca te haret ।
vāsaścāpaharettasminkathaṃ te mānasaṃ bhavet ॥19॥
slp1: ya imAM kuRqikAM BindyAttrivizwabDaM ca te haret । vAsaScApaharettasminkaTaM te mAnasaM Bavet ॥19॥

text: yastvayaṃ sarvamutsṛjya dhānāmuṣṭiparigrahaḥ । yadānena samaṃ sarvaṃ kimidaṃ mama dīyate । dhānāmuṣṭirihārthaścetpratijñā te vinaśyati ॥20॥
html:
yastvayaṃ sarvamutsṛjya dhānāmuṣṭiparigrahaḥ ।
yadānena samaṃ sarvaṃ kimidaṃ mama dīyate ।
dhānāmuṣṭirihārthaścetpratijñā te vinaśyati ॥20॥
slp1: yastvayaM sarvamutsfjya DAnAmuzwiparigrahaH । yadAnena samaM sarvaM kimidaM mama dIyate । DAnAmuzwirihArTaScetpratijYA te vinaSyati ॥20॥

text: kā vāhaṃ tava ko me tvaṃ ko'dya te mayyanugrahaḥ । praśādhi pṛthivīṃ rājanyatra te'nugraho bhavet । prāsādaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ vāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca ॥21॥
html:
kā vāhaṃ tava ko me tvaṃ ko'dya te mayyanugrahaḥ ।
praśādhi pṛthivīṃ rājanyatra te'nugraho bhavet ।
prāsādaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ vāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca ॥21॥
slp1: kA vAhaM tava ko me tvaM ko'dya te mayyanugrahaH । praSADi pfTivIM rAjanyatra te'nugraho Bavet । prAsAdaM SayanaM yAnaM vAsAMsyABaraRAni ca ॥21॥

text: śriyā nirāśairadhanaistyaktamitrairakiñcanaiḥ । saukhikaiḥ sambhṛtānarthānyaḥ santyajasi kiṃ nu tat ॥22॥
html:
śriyā nirāśairadhanaistyaktamitrairakiñcanaiḥ ।
saukhikaiḥ sambhṛtānarthānyaḥ santyajasi kiṃ nu tat ॥22॥
slp1: SriyA nirASEraDanEstyaktamitrErakiYcanEH । sOKikEH samBftAnarTAnyaH santyajasi kiM nu tat ॥22॥

text: yo'tyantaṃ pratigṛhṇīyādyaśca dadyātsadaiva hi । tayostvamantaraṃ viddhi śreyāṃstābhyāṃ ka ucyate ॥23॥
html:
yo'tyantaṃ pratigṛhṇīyādyaśca dadyātsadaiva hi ।
tayostvamantaraṃ viddhi śreyāṃstābhyāṃ ka ucyate ॥23॥
slp1: yo'tyantaM pratigfhRIyAdyaSca dadyAtsadEva hi । tayostvamantaraM vidDi SreyAMstAByAM ka ucyate ॥23॥

text: sadaiva yācamāneṣu satsu dambhavivarjiṣu । eteṣu dakṣiṇā dattā dāvāgnāviva durhutam ॥24॥
html:
sadaiva yācamāneṣu satsu dambhavivarjiṣu ।
eteṣu dakṣiṇā dattā dāvāgnāviva durhutam ॥24॥
slp1: sadEva yAcamAnezu satsu damBavivarjizu । etezu dakziRA dattA dAvAgnAviva durhutam ॥24॥

text: jātavedā yathā rājannādagdhvaivopaśāmyati । sadaiva yācamāno vai tathā śāmyati na dvijaḥ ॥25॥
html:
jātavedā yathā rājannādagdhvaivopaśāmyati ।
sadaiva yācamāno vai tathā śāmyati na dvijaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: jAtavedA yaTA rAjannAdagDvEvopaSAmyati । sadEva yAcamAno vE taTA SAmyati na dvijaH ॥25॥

text: satāṃ ca vedā annaṃ ca loke'sminprakṛtirdhruvā । na ceddātā bhaveddātā kutaḥ syurmokṣakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ॥26॥
html:
satāṃ ca vedā annaṃ ca loke'sminprakṛtirdhruvā ।
na ceddātā bhaveddātā kutaḥ syurmokṣakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: satAM ca vedA annaM ca loke'sminprakftirDruvA । na ceddAtA BaveddAtA kutaH syurmokzakANkziRaH ॥26॥

text: annādgṛhasthā loke'sminbhikṣavastata eva ca । annātprāṇaḥ prabhavati annadaḥ prāṇado bhavet ॥27॥
html:
annādgṛhasthā loke'sminbhikṣavastata eva ca ।
annātprāṇaḥ prabhavati annadaḥ prāṇado bhavet ॥27॥
slp1: annAdgfhasTA loke'sminBikzavastata eva ca । annAtprARaH praBavati annadaH prARado Bavet ॥27॥

text: gṛhasthebhyo'bhinirvṛttā gṛhasthāneva saṃśritāḥ । prabhavaṃ ca pratiṣṭhāṃ ca dāntā nindanta āsate ॥28॥
html:
gṛhasthebhyo'bhinirvṛttā gṛhasthāneva saṃśritāḥ ।
prabhavaṃ ca pratiṣṭhāṃ ca dāntā nindanta āsate ॥28॥
slp1: gfhasTeByo'BinirvfttA gfhasTAneva saMSritAH । praBavaM ca pratizWAM ca dAntA nindanta Asate ॥28॥

text: tyāgānna bhikṣukaṃ vidyānna mauṇḍyānna ca yācanāt । ṛjustu yo'rthaṃ tyajati taṃ sukhaṃ viddhi bhikṣukam ॥29॥
html:
tyāgānna bhikṣukaṃ vidyānna mauṇḍyānna ca yācanāt ।
ṛjustu yo'rthaṃ tyajati taṃ sukhaṃ viddhi bhikṣukam ॥29॥
slp1: tyAgAnna BikzukaM vidyAnna mORqyAnna ca yAcanAt । fjustu yo'rTaM tyajati taM suKaM vidDi Bikzukam ॥29॥

text: asaktaḥ saktavadgacchanniḥsaṅgo muktabandhanaḥ । samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca sa vai mukto mahīpate ॥30॥
html:
asaktaḥ saktavadgacchanniḥsaṅgo muktabandhanaḥ ।
samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca sa vai mukto mahīpate ॥30॥
slp1: asaktaH saktavadgacCanniHsaNgo muktabanDanaH । samaH SatrO ca mitre ca sa vE mukto mahIpate ॥30॥

text: parivrajanti dānārthaṃ muṇḍāḥ kāṣāyavāsasaḥ । sitā bahuvidhaiḥ pāśaiḥ sañcinvanto vṛthāmiṣam ॥31॥
html:
parivrajanti dānārthaṃ muṇḍāḥ kāṣāyavāsasaḥ ।
sitā bahuvidhaiḥ pāśaiḥ sañcinvanto vṛthāmiṣam ॥31॥
slp1: parivrajanti dAnArTaM muRqAH kAzAyavAsasaH । sitA bahuviDEH pASEH saYcinvanto vfTAmizam ॥31॥

text: trayīṃ ca nāma vārtāṃ ca tyaktvā putrāṃstyajanti ye । triviṣṭabdhaṃ ca vāsaśca pratigṛhṇantyabuddhayaḥ ॥32॥
html:
trayīṃ ca nāma vārtāṃ ca tyaktvā putrāṃstyajanti ye ।
triviṣṭabdhaṃ ca vāsaśca pratigṛhṇantyabuddhayaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: trayIM ca nAma vArtAM ca tyaktvA putrAMstyajanti ye । trivizwabDaM ca vAsaSca pratigfhRantyabudDayaH ॥32॥

text: aniṣkaṣāye kāṣāyamīhārthamiti viddhi tat । dharmadhvajānāṃ muṇḍānāṃ vṛttyarthamiti me matiḥ ॥33॥
html:
aniṣkaṣāye kāṣāyamīhārthamiti viddhi tat ।
dharmadhvajānāṃ muṇḍānāṃ vṛttyarthamiti me matiḥ ॥33॥
slp1: anizkazAye kAzAyamIhArTamiti vidDi tat । DarmaDvajAnAM muRqAnAM vfttyarTamiti me matiH ॥33॥

text: kāṣāyairajinaiścīrairnagnānmuṇḍāñjaṭādharān । bibhratsādhūnmahārāja jaya lokāñjitendriyaḥ ॥34॥
html:
kāṣāyairajinaiścīrairnagnānmuṇḍāñjaṭādharān ।
bibhratsādhūnmahārāja jaya lokāñjitendriyaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: kAzAyErajinEScIrErnagnAnmuRqAYjawADarAn । biBratsADUnmahArAja jaya lokAYjitendriyaH ॥34॥

text: agnyādheyāni gurvarthānkratūnsapaśudakṣiṇān । dadātyaharahaḥ pūrvaṃ ko nu dharmatarastataḥ ॥35॥
html:
agnyādheyāni gurvarthānkratūnsapaśudakṣiṇān ।
dadātyaharahaḥ pūrvaṃ ko nu dharmatarastataḥ ॥35॥
slp1: agnyADeyAni gurvarTAnkratUnsapaSudakziRAn । dadAtyaharahaH pUrvaM ko nu DarmatarastataH ॥35॥

text: tattvajño janako rājā loke'sminniti gīyate । so'pyāsīnmohasampanno mā mohavaśamanvagāḥ ॥36॥
html:
tattvajño janako rājā loke'sminniti gīyate ।
so'pyāsīnmohasampanno mā mohavaśamanvagāḥ ॥36॥
slp1: tattvajYo janako rAjA loke'sminniti gIyate । so'pyAsInmohasampanno mA mohavaSamanvagAH ॥36॥

text: evaṃ dharmamanukrāntaṃ sadā dānaparairnaraiḥ । ānṛśaṃsyaguṇopetaiḥ kāmakrodhavivarjitāḥ ॥37॥
html:
evaṃ dharmamanukrāntaṃ sadā dānaparairnaraiḥ ।
ānṛśaṃsyaguṇopetaiḥ kāmakrodhavivarjitāḥ ॥37॥
slp1: evaM DarmamanukrAntaM sadA dAnaparErnarEH । AnfSaMsyaguRopetEH kAmakroDavivarjitAH ॥37॥

text: pālayantaḥ prajāścaiva dānamuttamamāsthitāḥ । iṣṭāṁllokānavāpsyāmo brahmaṇyāḥ satyavādinaḥ] ॥38॥
html:
pālayantaḥ prajāścaiva dānamuttamamāsthitāḥ ।
iṣṭāṁllokānavāpsyāmo brahmaṇyāḥ satyavādinaḥ] ॥38॥
slp1: pAlayantaH prajAScEva dAnamuttamamAsTitAH । izwAṁllokAnavApsyAmo brahmaRyAH satyavAdinaH] ॥38॥

text: vedāhaṃ tāta śāstrāṇi aparāṇi parāṇi ca । ubhayaṃ vedavacanaṃ kuru karma tyajeti ca ॥1॥
html:
vedāhaṃ tāta śāstrāṇi aparāṇi parāṇi ca ।
ubhayaṃ vedavacanaṃ kuru karma tyajeti ca ॥1॥
slp1: vedAhaM tAta SAstrARi aparARi parARi ca । uBayaM vedavacanaM kuru karma tyajeti ca ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: ākulāni ca śāstrāṇi hetubhiścitritāni ca । niścayaścaiva yanmātro vedāhaṃ taṃ yathāvidhi ॥2॥
html:
ākulāni ca śāstrāṇi hetubhiścitritāni ca ।
niścayaścaiva yanmātro vedāhaṃ taṃ yathāvidhi ॥2॥
slp1: AkulAni ca SAstrARi hetuBiScitritAni ca । niScayaScEva yanmAtro vedAhaM taM yaTAviDi ॥2॥

text: tvaṃ tu kevalamastrajño vīravratamanuṣṭhitaḥ । śāstrārthaṃ tattvato gantuṃ na samarthaḥ kathañcana ॥3॥
html:
tvaṃ tu kevalamastrajño vīravratamanuṣṭhitaḥ ।
śāstrārthaṃ tattvato gantuṃ na samarthaḥ kathañcana ॥3॥
slp1: tvaM tu kevalamastrajYo vIravratamanuzWitaH । SAstrArTaM tattvato gantuM na samarTaH kaTaYcana ॥3॥

text: śāstrārthasūkṣmadarśī yo dharmaniścayakovidaḥ । tenāpyevaṃ na vācyo'haṃ yadi dharmaṃ prapaśyasi ॥4॥
html:
śāstrārthasūkṣmadarśī yo dharmaniścayakovidaḥ ।
tenāpyevaṃ na vācyo'haṃ yadi dharmaṃ prapaśyasi ॥4॥
slp1: SAstrArTasUkzmadarSI yo DarmaniScayakovidaH । tenApyevaM na vAcyo'haM yadi DarmaM prapaSyasi ॥4॥

text: bhrātṛsauhṛdamāsthāya yaduktaṃ vacanaṃ tvayā । nyāyyaṃ yuktaṃ ca kaunteya prīto'haṃ tena te'rjuna ॥5॥
html:
bhrātṛsauhṛdamāsthāya yaduktaṃ vacanaṃ tvayā ।
nyāyyaṃ yuktaṃ ca kaunteya prīto'haṃ tena te'rjuna ॥5॥
slp1: BrAtfsOhfdamAsTAya yaduktaM vacanaM tvayA । nyAyyaM yuktaM ca kOnteya prIto'haM tena te'rjuna ॥5॥

text: yuddhadharmeṣu sarveṣu kriyāṇāṃ naipuṇeṣu ca । na tvayā sadṛśaḥ kaścittriṣu lokeṣu vidyate ॥6॥
html:
yuddhadharmeṣu sarveṣu kriyāṇāṃ naipuṇeṣu ca ।
na tvayā sadṛśaḥ kaścittriṣu lokeṣu vidyate ॥6॥
slp1: yudDaDarmezu sarvezu kriyARAM nEpuRezu ca । na tvayA sadfSaH kaScittrizu lokezu vidyate ॥6॥

text: dharmasūkṣmaṃ tu yadvākyaṃ tatra duṣprataraṃ tvayā । dhanañjaya na me buddhimabhiśaṅkitumarhasi ॥7॥
html:
dharmasūkṣmaṃ tu yadvākyaṃ tatra duṣprataraṃ tvayā ।
dhanañjaya na me buddhimabhiśaṅkitumarhasi ॥7॥
slp1: DarmasUkzmaM tu yadvAkyaM tatra duzprataraM tvayA । DanaYjaya na me budDimaBiSaNkitumarhasi ॥7॥

text: yuddhaśāstravideva tvaṃ na vṛddhāḥ sevitāstvayā । samāsavistaravidāṃ na teṣāṃ vetsi niścayam ॥8॥
html:
yuddhaśāstravideva tvaṃ na vṛddhāḥ sevitāstvayā ।
samāsavistaravidāṃ na teṣāṃ vetsi niścayam ॥8॥
slp1: yudDaSAstravideva tvaM na vfdDAH sevitAstvayA । samAsavistaravidAM na tezAM vetsi niScayam ॥8॥

text: tapastyāgo vidhiriti niścayastāta dhīmatām । paraṃ paraṃ jyāya eṣāṃ saiṣā naiḥśreyasī gatiḥ ॥9॥
html:
tapastyāgo vidhiriti niścayastāta dhīmatām ।
paraṃ paraṃ jyāya eṣāṃ saiṣā naiḥśreyasī gatiḥ ॥9॥
slp1: tapastyAgo viDiriti niScayastAta DImatAm । paraM paraM jyAya ezAM sEzA nEHSreyasI gatiH ॥9॥

text: na tvetanmanyase pārtha na jyāyo'sti dhanāditi । atra te vartayiṣyāmi yathā naitatpradhānataḥ ॥10॥
html:
na tvetanmanyase pārtha na jyāyo'sti dhanāditi ।
atra te vartayiṣyāmi yathā naitatpradhānataḥ ॥10॥
slp1: na tvetanmanyase pArTa na jyAyo'sti DanAditi । atra te vartayizyAmi yaTA nEtatpraDAnataH ॥10॥

text: tapaḥsvādhyāyaśīlā hi dṛśyante dhārmikā janāḥ । ṛṣayastapasā yuktā yeṣāṃ lokāḥ sanātanāḥ ॥11॥
html:
tapaḥsvādhyāyaśīlā hi dṛśyante dhārmikā janāḥ ।
ṛṣayastapasā yuktā yeṣāṃ lokāḥ sanātanāḥ ॥11॥
slp1: tapaHsvADyAyaSIlA hi dfSyante DArmikA janAH । fzayastapasA yuktA yezAM lokAH sanAtanAH ॥11॥

text: ajātaśmaśravo dhīrāstathānye vanavāsinaḥ । anantā adhanā eva svādhyāyena divaṃ gatāḥ ॥12॥
html:
ajātaśmaśravo dhīrāstathānye vanavāsinaḥ ।
anantā adhanā eva svādhyāyena divaṃ gatāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: ajAtaSmaSravo DIrAstaTAnye vanavAsinaH । anantA aDanA eva svADyAyena divaM gatAH ॥12॥

text: uttareṇa tu panthānamāryā viṣayanigrahāt । abuddhijaṃ tamastyaktvā lokāṃstyāgavatāṃ gatāḥ ॥13॥
html:
uttareṇa tu panthānamāryā viṣayanigrahāt ।
abuddhijaṃ tamastyaktvā lokāṃstyāgavatāṃ gatāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: uttareRa tu panTAnamAryA vizayanigrahAt । abudDijaM tamastyaktvA lokAMstyAgavatAM gatAH ॥13॥

text: dakṣiṇena tu panthānaṃ yaṃ bhāsvantaṃ prapaśyasi । ete kriyāvatāṃ lokā ye śmaśānāni bhejire ॥14॥
html:
dakṣiṇena tu panthānaṃ yaṃ bhāsvantaṃ prapaśyasi ।
ete kriyāvatāṃ lokā ye śmaśānāni bhejire ॥14॥
slp1: dakziRena tu panTAnaM yaM BAsvantaM prapaSyasi । ete kriyAvatAM lokA ye SmaSAnAni Bejire ॥14॥

text: anirdeśyā gatiḥ sā tu yāṃ prapaśyanti mokṣiṇaḥ । tasmāttyāgaḥ pradhāneṣṭaḥ sa tu duḥkhaḥ praveditum ॥15॥
html:
anirdeśyā gatiḥ sā tu yāṃ prapaśyanti mokṣiṇaḥ ।
tasmāttyāgaḥ pradhāneṣṭaḥ sa tu duḥkhaḥ praveditum ॥15॥
slp1: anirdeSyA gatiH sA tu yAM prapaSyanti mokziRaH । tasmAttyAgaH praDAnezwaH sa tu duHKaH praveditum ॥15॥

text: anusṛtya tu śāstrāṇi kavayaḥ samavasthitāḥ । apīha syādapīha syātsārāsāradidṛkṣayā ॥16॥
html:
anusṛtya tu śāstrāṇi kavayaḥ samavasthitāḥ ।
apīha syādapīha syātsārāsāradidṛkṣayā ॥16॥
slp1: anusftya tu SAstrARi kavayaH samavasTitAH । apIha syAdapIha syAtsArAsAradidfkzayA ॥16॥

text: vedavādānatikramya śāstrāṇyāraṇyakāni ca । vipāṭya kadalīskandhaṃ sāraṃ dadṛśire na te ॥17॥
html:
vedavādānatikramya śāstrāṇyāraṇyakāni ca ।
vipāṭya kadalīskandhaṃ sāraṃ dadṛśire na te ॥17॥
slp1: vedavAdAnatikramya SAstrARyAraRyakAni ca । vipAwya kadalIskanDaM sAraM dadfSire na te ॥17॥

text: athaikāntavyudāsena śarīre pañcabhautike । icchādveṣasamāyuktamātmānaṃ prāhuriṅgitaiḥ ॥18॥
html:
athaikāntavyudāsena śarīre pañcabhautike ।
icchādveṣasamāyuktamātmānaṃ prāhuriṅgitaiḥ ॥18॥
slp1: aTEkAntavyudAsena SarIre paYcaBOtike । icCAdvezasamAyuktamAtmAnaM prAhuriNgitEH ॥18॥

text: agrāhyaścakṣuṣā so'pi anirdeśyaṃ ca tadgirā । karmahetupuraskāraṃ bhūteṣu parivartate ॥19॥
html:
agrāhyaścakṣuṣā so'pi anirdeśyaṃ ca tadgirā ।
karmahetupuraskāraṃ bhūteṣu parivartate ॥19॥
slp1: agrAhyaScakzuzA so'pi anirdeSyaM ca tadgirA । karmahetupuraskAraM BUtezu parivartate ॥19॥

html:

text: yadvacaḥ phalgunenoktaṃ na jyāyo'sti dhanāditi । atra te vartayiṣyāmi tadekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu ॥2॥

atra te vartayiṣyāmi tadekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu ॥2॥

text: ajātaśatro dharmeṇa kṛtsnā te vasudhā jitā । tāṃ jitvā na vṛthā rājaṃstvaṃ parityaktumarhasi ॥3॥

text: catuṣpadī hi niḥśreṇī karmaṇyeṣā pratiṣṭhitā । tāṃ krameṇa mahābāho yathāvajjaya pārthiva ॥4॥
html:

slp1: catuzpadI hi niHSreRI karmaRyezA pratizWitA । tAM krameRa mahAbAho yaTAvajjaya pArTiva ॥4॥

text: tasmātpārtha mahāyajñairyajasva bahudakṣiṇaiḥ । svādhyāyayajñā ṛṣayo jñānayajñāstathāpare ॥5॥
html:

svādhyāyayajñā ṛṣayo jñānayajñāstathāpare ॥5॥
slp1: tasmAtpArTa mahAyajYEryajasva bahudakziREH । svADyAyayajYA fzayo jYAnayajYAstaTApare ॥5॥

text: karmaniṣṭhāṃstu budhyethāstaponiṣṭhāṃśca bhārata । vaikhānasānāṃ rājendra vacanaṃ śrūyate yathā ॥6॥
html:
karmaniṣṭhāṃstu budhyethāstaponiṣṭhāṃśca bhārata ।

slp1: karmanizWAMstu buDyeTAstaponizWAMSca BArata । vEKAnasAnAM rAjendra vacanaM SrUyate yaTA ॥6॥

text: kṛcchrācca dravyasaṃhāraṃ kurvanti dhanakāraṇāt । dhanena tṛṣito'buddhyā bhrūṇahatyāṃ na budhyate ॥8॥
html:

text: anarhate yaddadāti na dadāti yadarhate । anarhārhāparijñānāddānadharmo'pi duṣkaraḥ ॥9॥
html:

slp1: anarhate yaddadAti na dadAti yadarhate । anarhArhAparijYAnAddAnaDarmo'pi duzkaraH ॥9॥

text: yajñāya sṛṣṭāni dhanāni dhātrā yaṣṭādiṣṭaḥ puruṣo rakṣitā ca । tasmātsarvaṃ yajña evopayojyaṃ dhanaṃ tato'nantara eva kāmaḥ ॥10॥
html:

text: yajñairindro vividhairannavadbhirdevānsarvānabhyayānmahaujāḥ । tenendratvaṃ prāpya vibhrājate'sau tasmādyajñe sarvamevopayojyam ॥11॥
html:

text: mahādevaḥ sarvamedhe mahātmā hutvātmānaṃ devadevo vibhūtaḥ । viśvāṁllokānvyāpya viṣṭabhya kīrtyā virocate dyutimānkṛttivāsāḥ ॥12॥
html:

viśvāṁllokānvyāpya viṣṭabhya kīrtyā virocate dyutimānkṛttivāsāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: mahAdevaH sarvameDe mahAtmA hutvAtmAnaM devadevo viBUtaH । viSvAṁllokAnvyApya vizwaBya kIrtyA virocate dyutimAnkfttivAsAH ॥12॥

text: āvikṣitaḥ pārthivo vai maruttaḥ svṛddhyā martyo yo'jayaddevarājam । yajñe yasya śrīḥ svayaṃ sanniviṣṭā yasminbhāṇḍaṃ kāñcanaṃ sarvamāsīt ॥13॥

text: hariścandraḥ pārthivendraḥ śrutaste yajñairiṣṭvā puṇyakṛdvītaśokaḥ । ṛddhyā śakraṃ yo'jayanmānuṣaḥ saṃstasmādyajñe sarvamevopayojyam] ॥14॥

text: atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । indreṇa samaye pṛṣṭo yaduvāca bṛhaspatiḥ ॥1॥

text: santoṣo vai svargatamaḥ santoṣaḥ paramaṃ sukham । tuṣṭerna kiñcitparataḥ susamyakparitiṣṭhati ॥2॥

text: yadā saṃharate kāmānkūrmo'ṅgānīva sarvaśaḥ । tadātmajyotirātmaiva svātmanaiva prasīdati ॥3॥

text: na bibheti yadā cāyaṃ yadā cāsmānna bibhyati । kāmadveṣau ca jayati tadātmānaṃ prapaśyati ॥4॥

text: yadāsau sarvabhūtānāṃ na krudhyati na duṣyati । karmaṇā manasā vācā brahma sampadyate tadā ॥5॥

text: evaṃ kaunteya bhūtāni taṃ taṃ dharmaṃ tathā tathā । tadā tadā prapaśyanti tasmādbudhyasva bhārata ॥6॥

evaṃ kaunteya bhūtāni taṃ taṃ dharmaṃ tathā tathā ।

text: anye śamaṃ praśaṃsanti vyāyāmamapare tathā । naikaṃ na cāparaṃ kecidubhayaṃ ca tathāpare ॥7॥

text: yajñameke praśaṃsanti saṃnyāsamapare janāḥ । dānameke praśaṃsanti kecideva pratigraham । kecitsarvaṃ parityajya tūṣṇīṃ dhyāyanta āsate ॥8॥

dānameke praśaṃsanti kecideva pratigraham ।
kecitsarvaṃ parityajya tūṣṇīṃ dhyāyanta āsate ॥8॥
slp1: yajYameke praSaMsanti saMnyAsamapare janAH । dAnameke praSaMsanti kecideva pratigraham । kecitsarvaM parityajya tUzRIM DyAyanta Asate ॥8॥

text: rājyameke praśaṃsanti sarveṣāṃ paripālanam । hatvā bhittvā ca chittvā ca kecidekāntaśīlinaḥ ॥9॥

text: etatsarvaṃ samālokya budhānāmeṣa niścayaḥ । adroheṇaiva bhūtānāṃ yo dharmaḥ sa satāṃ mataḥ ॥10॥
html:
etatsarvaṃ samālokya budhānāmeṣa niścayaḥ ।

text: adrohaḥ satyavacanaṃ saṃvibhāgo dhṛtiḥ kṣamā । prajanaḥ sveṣu dāreṣu mārdavaṃ hrīracāpalam ॥11॥
html:

text: dhanaṃ dharmapradhāneṣṭaṃ manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo'bravīt । tasmādevaṃ prayatnena kaunteya paripālaya ॥12॥
html:
dhanaṃ dharmapradhāneṣṭaṃ manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo'bravīt ।

text: yo hi rājye sthitaḥ śaśvadvaśī tulyapriyāpriyaḥ । kṣatriyo yajñaśiṣṭāśī rājaśāstrārthatattvavit ॥13॥
html:
