sādhyā rājarṣisaṅghāśca dharmametaṃ samāśritāḥ ।
apramattāstataḥ svargaṃ prāptāḥ puṇyaiḥ svakarmabhiḥ] ॥19॥
slp1: evaM rudrAH savasavastaTAdityAH parantapa । sADyA rAjarzisaNGASca DarmametaM samASritAH । apramattAstataH svargaM prAptAH puRyEH svakarmaBiH] ॥19॥

text: tasminvākyāntare vākyaṃ punarevārjuno'bravīt । viṣaṇṇamanasaṃ jyeṣṭhamidaṃ bhrātaramīśvaram ॥1॥
html:
tasminvākyāntare vākyaṃ punarevārjuno'bravīt ।
viṣaṇṇamanasaṃ jyeṣṭhamidaṃ bhrātaramīśvaram ॥1॥
slp1: tasminvAkyAntare vAkyaM punarevArjuno'bravIt । vizaRRamanasaM jyezWamidaM BrAtaramISvaram ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: kṣatradharmeṇa dharmajña prāpya rājyamanuttamam । jitvā cārīnnaraśreṣṭha tapyate kiṃ bhavānbhṛśam ॥2॥
html:
kṣatradharmeṇa dharmajña prāpya rājyamanuttamam ।
jitvā cārīnnaraśreṣṭha tapyate kiṃ bhavānbhṛśam ॥2॥
slp1: kzatraDarmeRa DarmajYa prApya rAjyamanuttamam । jitvA cArInnaraSrezWa tapyate kiM BavAnBfSam ॥2॥

text: kṣatriyāṇāṃ mahārāja saṅgrāme nidhanaṃ smṛtam । viśiṣṭaṃ bahubhiryajñaiḥ kṣatradharmamanusmara ॥3॥
html:
kṣatriyāṇāṃ mahārāja saṅgrāme nidhanaṃ smṛtam ।
viśiṣṭaṃ bahubhiryajñaiḥ kṣatradharmamanusmara ॥3॥
slp1: kzatriyARAM mahArAja saNgrAme niDanaM smftam । viSizwaM bahuBiryajYEH kzatraDarmamanusmara ॥3॥

text: brāhmaṇānāṃ tapastyāgaḥ pretyadharmavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ । kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca vihitaṃ saṅgrāme nidhanaṃ vibho ॥4॥
html:
brāhmaṇānāṃ tapastyāgaḥ pretyadharmavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ।
kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca vihitaṃ saṅgrāme nidhanaṃ vibho ॥4॥
slp1: brAhmaRAnAM tapastyAgaH pretyaDarmaviDiH smftaH । kzatriyARAM ca vihitaM saNgrAme niDanaM viBo ॥4॥

text: kṣatradharmo mahāraudraḥ śastranitya iti smṛtaḥ । vadhaśca bharataśreṣṭha kāle śastreṇa saṃyuge ॥5॥
html:
kṣatradharmo mahāraudraḥ śastranitya iti smṛtaḥ ।
vadhaśca bharataśreṣṭha kāle śastreṇa saṃyuge ॥5॥
slp1: kzatraDarmo mahArOdraH Sastranitya iti smftaH । vaDaSca BarataSrezWa kAle SastreRa saMyuge ॥5॥

text: brāhmaṇasyāpi cedrājankṣatradharmeṇa tiṣṭhataḥ । praśastaṃ jīvitaṃ loke kṣatraṃ hi brahmasaṃsthitam ॥6॥
html:
brāhmaṇasyāpi cedrājankṣatradharmeṇa tiṣṭhataḥ ।
praśastaṃ jīvitaṃ loke kṣatraṃ hi brahmasaṃsthitam ॥6॥
slp1: brAhmaRasyApi cedrAjankzatraDarmeRa tizWataH । praSastaM jIvitaM loke kzatraM hi brahmasaMsTitam ॥6॥

text: na tyāgo na punaryācñā na tapo manujeśvara । kṣatriyasya vidhīyante na parasvopajīvanam ॥7॥
html:
na tyāgo na punaryācñā na tapo manujeśvara ।
kṣatriyasya vidhīyante na parasvopajīvanam ॥7॥
slp1: na tyAgo na punaryAcYA na tapo manujeSvara । kzatriyasya viDIyante na parasvopajIvanam ॥7॥

text: sa bhavānsarvadharmajñaḥ sarvātmā bharatarṣabha । rājā manīṣī nipuṇo loke dṛṣṭaparāvaraḥ ॥8॥
html:
sa bhavānsarvadharmajñaḥ sarvātmā bharatarṣabha ।
rājā manīṣī nipuṇo loke dṛṣṭaparāvaraḥ ॥8॥
slp1: sa BavAnsarvaDarmajYaH sarvAtmA BaratarzaBa । rAjA manIzI nipuRo loke dfzwaparAvaraH ॥8॥

text: tyaktvā santāpajaṃ śokaṃ daṃśito bhava karmaṇi । kṣatriyasya viśeṣeṇa hṛdayaṃ vajrasaṃhatam ॥9॥
html:
tyaktvā santāpajaṃ śokaṃ daṃśito bhava karmaṇi ।
kṣatriyasya viśeṣeṇa hṛdayaṃ vajrasaṃhatam ॥9॥
slp1: tyaktvA santApajaM SokaM daMSito Bava karmaRi । kzatriyasya viSezeRa hfdayaM vajrasaMhatam ॥9॥

text: jitvārīnkṣatradharmeṇa prāpya rājyamakaṇṭakam । vijitātmā manuṣyendra yajñadānaparo bhava ॥10॥
html:
jitvārīnkṣatradharmeṇa prāpya rājyamakaṇṭakam ।
vijitātmā manuṣyendra yajñadānaparo bhava ॥10॥
slp1: jitvArInkzatraDarmeRa prApya rAjyamakaRwakam । vijitAtmA manuzyendra yajYadAnaparo Bava ॥10॥

text: indro vai brahmaṇaḥ putraḥ karmaṇā kṣatriyo'bhavat । jñātīnāṃ pāpavṛttīnāṃ jaghāna navatīrnava ॥11॥
html:
indro vai brahmaṇaḥ putraḥ karmaṇā kṣatriyo'bhavat ।
jñātīnāṃ pāpavṛttīnāṃ jaghāna navatīrnava ॥11॥
slp1: indro vE brahmaRaH putraH karmaRA kzatriyo'Bavat । jYAtInAM pApavfttInAM jaGAna navatIrnava ॥11॥

text: taccāsya karma pūjyaṃ hi praśasyaṃ ca viśāmpate । tena cendratvamāpede devānāmiti naḥ śrutam ॥12॥
html:
taccāsya karma pūjyaṃ hi praśasyaṃ ca viśāmpate ।
tena cendratvamāpede devānāmiti naḥ śrutam ॥12॥
slp1: taccAsya karma pUjyaM hi praSasyaM ca viSAmpate । tena cendratvamApede devAnAmiti naH Srutam ॥12॥

text: sa tvaṃ yajñairmahārāja yajasva bahudakṣiṇaiḥ । yathaivendro manuṣyendra cirāya vigatajvaraḥ ॥13॥
html:
sa tvaṃ yajñairmahārāja yajasva bahudakṣiṇaiḥ ।
yathaivendro manuṣyendra cirāya vigatajvaraḥ ॥13॥
slp1: sa tvaM yajYErmahArAja yajasva bahudakziREH । yaTEvendro manuzyendra cirAya vigatajvaraH ॥13॥

text: mā tvamevaṅgate kiñcitkṣatriyarṣabha śocithāḥ । gatāste kṣatradharmeṇa śastrapūtāḥ parāṃ gatim ॥14॥
html:
mā tvamevaṅgate kiñcitkṣatriyarṣabha śocithāḥ ।
gatāste kṣatradharmeṇa śastrapūtāḥ parāṃ gatim ॥14॥
slp1: mA tvamevaNgate kiYcitkzatriyarzaBa SociTAH । gatAste kzatraDarmeRa SastrapUtAH parAM gatim ॥14॥

text: bhavitavyaṃ tathā tacca yadvṛttaṃ bharatarṣabha । diṣṭaṃ hi rājaśārdūla na śakyamativartitum] ॥15॥
html:
bhavitavyaṃ tathā tacca yadvṛttaṃ bharatarṣabha ।
diṣṭaṃ hi rājaśārdūla na śakyamativartitum] ॥15॥
slp1: BavitavyaM taTA tacca yadvfttaM BaratarzaBa । dizwaM hi rAjaSArdUla na Sakyamativartitum] ॥15॥

text: evamuktastu kaunteyo guḍākeśena bhārata । novāca kiñcitkauravyastato dvaipāyano'bravīt ॥1॥
html:
evamuktastu kaunteyo guḍākeśena bhārata ।
novāca kiñcitkauravyastato dvaipāyano'bravīt ॥1॥
slp1: evamuktastu kOnteyo guqAkeSena BArata । novAca kiYcitkOravyastato dvEpAyano'bravIt ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: bībhatsorvacanaṃ samyaksatyametadyudhiṣṭhira । śāstradṛṣṭaḥ paro dharmaḥ smṛto gārhasthya āśramaḥ ॥2॥
html:
bībhatsorvacanaṃ samyaksatyametadyudhiṣṭhira ।
śāstradṛṣṭaḥ paro dharmaḥ smṛto gārhasthya āśramaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: bIBatsorvacanaM samyaksatyametadyuDizWira । SAstradfzwaH paro DarmaH smfto gArhasTya ASramaH ॥2॥

text: svadharmaṃ cara dharmajña yathāśāstraṃ yathāvidhi । na hi gārhasthyamutsṛjya tavāraṇyaṃ vidhīyate ॥3॥
html:
svadharmaṃ cara dharmajña yathāśāstraṃ yathāvidhi ।
na hi gārhasthyamutsṛjya tavāraṇyaṃ vidhīyate ॥3॥
slp1: svaDarmaM cara DarmajYa yaTASAstraM yaTAviDi । na hi gArhasTyamutsfjya tavAraRyaM viDIyate ॥3॥

text: gṛhasthaṃ hi sadā devāḥ pitara ṛṣayastathā । bhṛtyāścaivopajīvanti tānbhajasva mahīpate ॥4॥
html:
gṛhasthaṃ hi sadā devāḥ pitara ṛṣayastathā ।
bhṛtyāścaivopajīvanti tānbhajasva mahīpate ॥4॥
slp1: gfhasTaM hi sadA devAH pitara fzayastaTA । BftyAScEvopajIvanti tAnBajasva mahIpate ॥4॥

text: vayāṃsi paśavaścaiva bhūtāni ca mahīpate । gṛhasthaireva dhāryante tasmājjyeṣṭhāśramo gṛhī ॥5॥
html:
vayāṃsi paśavaścaiva bhūtāni ca mahīpate ।
gṛhasthaireva dhāryante tasmājjyeṣṭhāśramo gṛhī ॥5॥
slp1: vayAMsi paSavaScEva BUtAni ca mahIpate । gfhasTEreva DAryante tasmAjjyezWASramo gfhI ॥5॥

text: so'yaṃ caturṇāmeteṣāmāśramāṇāṃ durācaraḥ । taṃ carāvimanāḥ pārtha duścaraṃ durbalendriyaiḥ ॥6॥
html:
so'yaṃ caturṇāmeteṣāmāśramāṇāṃ durācaraḥ ।
taṃ carāvimanāḥ pārtha duścaraṃ durbalendriyaiḥ ॥6॥
slp1: so'yaM caturRAmetezAmASramARAM durAcaraH । taM carAvimanAH pArTa duScaraM durbalendriyEH ॥6॥

text: vedajñānaṃ ca te kṛtsnaṃ tapaśca caritaṃ mahat । pitṛpaitāmahe rājye dhuramudvoḍhumarhasi ॥7॥
html:
vedajñānaṃ ca te kṛtsnaṃ tapaśca caritaṃ mahat ।
pitṛpaitāmahe rājye dhuramudvoḍhumarhasi ॥7॥
slp1: vedajYAnaM ca te kftsnaM tapaSca caritaM mahat । pitfpEtAmahe rAjye DuramudvoQumarhasi ॥7॥

text: tapo yajñastathā vidyā bhaikṣamindriyanigrahaḥ । dhyānamekāntaśīlatvaṃ tuṣṭirdānaṃ ca śaktitaḥ ॥8॥
html:
tapo yajñastathā vidyā bhaikṣamindriyanigrahaḥ ।
dhyānamekāntaśīlatvaṃ tuṣṭirdānaṃ ca śaktitaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tapo yajYastaTA vidyA BEkzamindriyanigrahaH । DyAnamekAntaSIlatvaM tuzwirdAnaM ca SaktitaH ॥8॥

text: brāhmaṇānāṃ mahārāja ceṣṭāḥ saṃsiddhikārikāḥ । kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca vakṣyāmi tavāpi viditaṃ punaḥ ॥9॥
html:
brāhmaṇānāṃ mahārāja ceṣṭāḥ saṃsiddhikārikāḥ ।
kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca vakṣyāmi tavāpi viditaṃ punaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: brAhmaRAnAM mahArAja cezwAH saMsidDikArikAH । kzatriyARAM ca vakzyAmi tavApi viditaM punaH ॥9॥

text: yajño vidyā samutthānamasantoṣaḥ śriyaṃ prati । daṇḍadhāraṇamatyugraṃ prajānāṃ paripālanam ॥10॥
html:
yajño vidyā samutthānamasantoṣaḥ śriyaṃ prati ।
daṇḍadhāraṇamatyugraṃ prajānāṃ paripālanam ॥10॥
slp1: yajYo vidyA samutTAnamasantozaH SriyaM prati । daRqaDAraRamatyugraM prajAnAM paripAlanam ॥10॥

text: vedajñānaṃ tathā kṛtsnaṃ tapaḥ sucaritaṃ tathā । draviṇopārjanaṃ bhūri pātreṣu pratipādanam ॥11॥
html:
vedajñānaṃ tathā kṛtsnaṃ tapaḥ sucaritaṃ tathā ।
draviṇopārjanaṃ bhūri pātreṣu pratipādanam ॥11॥
slp1: vedajYAnaM taTA kftsnaM tapaH sucaritaM taTA । draviRopArjanaM BUri pAtrezu pratipAdanam ॥11॥

text: etāni rājñāṃ karmāṇi sukṛtāni viśāmpate । imaṃ lokamamuṃ lokaṃ sādhayantīti naḥ śrutam ॥12॥
html:
etāni rājñāṃ karmāṇi sukṛtāni viśāmpate ।
imaṃ lokamamuṃ lokaṃ sādhayantīti naḥ śrutam ॥12॥
slp1: etAni rAjYAM karmARi sukftAni viSAmpate । imaM lokamamuM lokaM sADayantIti naH Srutam ॥12॥

text: teṣāṃ jyāyastu kaunteya daṇḍadhāraṇamucyate । balaṃ hi kṣatriye nityaṃ bale daṇḍaḥ samāhitaḥ ॥13॥
html:
teṣāṃ jyāyastu kaunteya daṇḍadhāraṇamucyate ।
balaṃ hi kṣatriye nityaṃ bale daṇḍaḥ samāhitaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: tezAM jyAyastu kOnteya daRqaDAraRamucyate । balaM hi kzatriye nityaM bale daRqaH samAhitaH ॥13॥

text: etāśceṣṭāḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ rājansaṃsiddhikārikāḥ । api gāthāmimāṃ cāpi bṛhaspatirabhāṣata ॥14॥
html:
etāśceṣṭāḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ rājansaṃsiddhikārikāḥ ।
api gāthāmimāṃ cāpi bṛhaspatirabhāṣata ॥14॥
slp1: etAScezwAH kzatriyARAM rAjansaMsidDikArikAH । api gATAmimAM cApi bfhaspatiraBAzata ॥14॥

text: bhūmiretau nigirati sarpo bilaśayāniva । rājānaṃ cāviroddhāraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ cāpravāsinam ॥15॥
html:
bhūmiretau nigirati sarpo bilaśayāniva ।
rājānaṃ cāviroddhāraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ cāpravāsinam ॥15॥
slp1: BUmiretO nigirati sarpo bilaSayAniva । rAjAnaM cAvirodDAraM brAhmaRaM cApravAsinam ॥15॥

text: sudyumnaścāpi rājarṣiḥ śrūyate daṇḍadhāraṇāt । prāptavānparamāṃ siddhiṃ dakṣaḥ prācetaso yathā] ॥16॥
html:
sudyumnaścāpi rājarṣiḥ śrūyate daṇḍadhāraṇāt ।
prāptavānparamāṃ siddhiṃ dakṣaḥ prācetaso yathā] ॥16॥
slp1: sudyumnaScApi rAjarziH SrUyate daRqaDAraRAt । prAptavAnparamAM sidDiM dakzaH prAcetaso yaTA] ॥16॥

text: bhagavankarmaṇā kena sudyumno vasudhādhipaḥ । saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ prāptaḥ śrotumicchāmi taṃ nṛpam ॥1॥
html:
bhagavankarmaṇā kena sudyumno vasudhādhipaḥ ।
saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ prāptaḥ śrotumicchāmi taṃ nṛpam ॥1॥
slp1: BagavankarmaRA kena sudyumno vasuDADipaH । saMsidDiM paramAM prAptaH SrotumicCAmi taM nfpam ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । śaṅkhaśca likhitaścāstāṃ bhrātarau saṃyatavratau ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
śaṅkhaśca likhitaścāstāṃ bhrātarau saṃyatavratau ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । SaNKaSca liKitaScAstAM BrAtarO saMyatavratO ॥2॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: tayorāvasathāvāstāṃ ramaṇīyau pṛthakpṛthak । nityapuṣpaphalairvṛkṣairupetau bāhudāmanu ॥3॥
html:
tayorāvasathāvāstāṃ ramaṇīyau pṛthakpṛthak ।
nityapuṣpaphalairvṛkṣairupetau bāhudāmanu ॥3॥
slp1: tayorAvasaTAvAstAM ramaRIyO pfTakpfTak । nityapuzpaPalErvfkzErupetO bAhudAmanu ॥3॥

text: tataḥ kadācillikhitaḥ śaṅkhasyāśramamāgamat । yadṛcchayāpi śaṅkho'tha niṣkrānto'bhavadāśramāt ॥4॥
html:
tataḥ kadācillikhitaḥ śaṅkhasyāśramamāgamat ।
yadṛcchayāpi śaṅkho'tha niṣkrānto'bhavadāśramāt ॥4॥
slp1: tataH kadAcilliKitaH SaNKasyASramamAgamat । yadfcCayApi SaNKo'Ta nizkrAnto'BavadASramAt ॥4॥

text: so'bhigamyāśramaṃ bhrātuḥ śaṅkhasya likhitastadā । phalāni śātayāmāsa samyakpariṇatānyuta ॥5॥
html:
so'bhigamyāśramaṃ bhrātuḥ śaṅkhasya likhitastadā ।
phalāni śātayāmāsa samyakpariṇatānyuta ॥5॥
slp1: so'BigamyASramaM BrAtuH SaNKasya liKitastadA । PalAni SAtayAmAsa samyakpariRatAnyuta ॥5॥

text: tānyupādāya visrabdho bhakṣayāmāsa sa dvijaḥ । tasmiṃśca bhakṣayatyeva śaṅkho'pyāśramamāgamat ॥6॥
html:
tānyupādāya visrabdho bhakṣayāmāsa sa dvijaḥ ।
tasmiṃśca bhakṣayatyeva śaṅkho'pyāśramamāgamat ॥6॥
slp1: tAnyupAdAya visrabDo BakzayAmAsa sa dvijaH । tasmiMSca Bakzayatyeva SaNKo'pyASramamAgamat ॥6॥

text: bhakṣayantaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṅkho bhrātaramabravīt । kutaḥ phalānyavāptāni hetunā kena khādasi ॥7॥
html:
bhakṣayantaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṅkho bhrātaramabravīt ।
kutaḥ phalānyavāptāni hetunā kena khādasi ॥7॥
slp1: BakzayantaM tu taM dfzwvA SaNKo BrAtaramabravIt । kutaH PalAnyavAptAni hetunA kena KAdasi ॥7॥

text: so'bravīdbhrātaraṃ jyeṣṭhamupaspṛśyābhivādya ca । ita eva gṛhītāni mayeti prahasanniva ॥8॥
html:
so'bravīdbhrātaraṃ jyeṣṭhamupaspṛśyābhivādya ca ।
ita eva gṛhītāni mayeti prahasanniva ॥8॥
slp1: so'bravIdBrAtaraM jyezWamupaspfSyABivAdya ca । ita eva gfhItAni mayeti prahasanniva ॥8॥

text: tamabravīttadā śaṅkhastīvrakopasamanvitaḥ । steyaṃ tvayā kṛtamidaṃ phalānyādadatā svayam । gaccha rājānamāsādya svakarma prathayasva vai ॥9॥
html:
tamabravīttadā śaṅkhastīvrakopasamanvitaḥ ।
steyaṃ tvayā kṛtamidaṃ phalānyādadatā svayam ।
gaccha rājānamāsādya svakarma prathayasva vai ॥9॥
slp1: tamabravIttadA SaNKastIvrakopasamanvitaH । steyaM tvayA kftamidaM PalAnyAdadatA svayam । gacCa rAjAnamAsAdya svakarma praTayasva vE ॥9॥

text: adattādānamevedaṃ kṛtaṃ pārthivasattama । stenaṃ māṃ tvaṃ viditvā ca svadharmamanupālaya । śīghraṃ dhāraya caurasya mama daṇḍaṃ narādhipa ॥10॥
html:
adattādānamevedaṃ kṛtaṃ pārthivasattama ।
stenaṃ māṃ tvaṃ viditvā ca svadharmamanupālaya ।
śīghraṃ dhāraya caurasya mama daṇḍaṃ narādhipa ॥10॥
slp1: adattAdAnamevedaM kftaM pArTivasattama । stenaM mAM tvaM viditvA ca svaDarmamanupAlaya । SIGraM DAraya cOrasya mama daRqaM narADipa ॥10॥

text: ityuktastasya vacanātsudyumnaṃ vasudhādhipam । abhyagacchanmahābāho likhitaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ ॥11॥
html:
ityuktastasya vacanātsudyumnaṃ vasudhādhipam ।
abhyagacchanmahābāho likhitaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ ॥11॥
slp1: ityuktastasya vacanAtsudyumnaM vasuDADipam । aByagacCanmahAbAho liKitaH saMSitavrataH ॥11॥

text: sudyumnastvantapālebhyaḥ śrutvā likhitamāgatam । abhyagacchatsahāmātyaḥ padbhyāmeva nareśvaraḥ ॥12॥
html:
sudyumnastvantapālebhyaḥ śrutvā likhitamāgatam ।
abhyagacchatsahāmātyaḥ padbhyāmeva nareśvaraḥ ॥12॥
slp1: sudyumnastvantapAleByaH SrutvA liKitamAgatam । aByagacCatsahAmAtyaH padByAmeva nareSvaraH ॥12॥

text: tamabravītsamāgatya sa rājā brahmavittamam । kimāgamanamācakṣva bhagavankṛtameva tat ॥13॥
html:
tamabravītsamāgatya sa rājā brahmavittamam ।
kimāgamanamācakṣva bhagavankṛtameva tat ॥13॥
slp1: tamabravItsamAgatya sa rAjA brahmavittamam । kimAgamanamAcakzva Bagavankftameva tat ॥13॥

text: evamuktaḥ sa viprarṣiḥ sudyumnamidamabravīt । pratiśrauṣi kariṣyeti śrutvā tatkartumarhasi ॥14॥
html:
evamuktaḥ sa viprarṣiḥ sudyumnamidamabravīt ।
pratiśrauṣi kariṣyeti śrutvā tatkartumarhasi ॥14॥
slp1: evamuktaH sa viprarziH sudyumnamidamabravIt । pratiSrOzi karizyeti SrutvA tatkartumarhasi ॥14॥

text: anisṛṣṭāni guruṇā phalāni puruṣarṣabha । bhakṣitāni mayā rājaṃstatra māṃ śādhi māciram ॥15॥
html:
anisṛṣṭāni guruṇā phalāni puruṣarṣabha ।
bhakṣitāni mayā rājaṃstatra māṃ śādhi māciram ॥15॥
slp1: anisfzwAni guruRA PalAni puruzarzaBa । BakzitAni mayA rAjaMstatra mAM SADi mAciram ॥15॥

text: pramāṇaṃ cenmato rājā bhavato daṇḍadhāraṇe । anujñāyāmapi tathā hetuḥ syādbrāhmaṇarṣabha ॥16॥
html:
pramāṇaṃ cenmato rājā bhavato daṇḍadhāraṇe ।
anujñāyāmapi tathā hetuḥ syādbrāhmaṇarṣabha ॥16॥
slp1: pramARaM cenmato rAjA Bavato daRqaDAraRe । anujYAyAmapi taTA hetuH syAdbrAhmaRarzaBa ॥16॥
author: sudyumna uvāca ।

text: sa bhavānabhyanujñātaḥ śucikarmā mahāvrataḥ । brūhi kāmānato'nyāṃstvaṃ kariṣyāmi hi te vacaḥ ॥17॥
html:
sa bhavānabhyanujñātaḥ śucikarmā mahāvrataḥ ।
brūhi kāmānato'nyāṃstvaṃ kariṣyāmi hi te vacaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: sa BavAnaByanujYAtaH SucikarmA mahAvrataH । brUhi kAmAnato'nyAMstvaM karizyAmi hi te vacaH ॥17॥

text: chandyamāno'pi brahmarṣiḥ pārthivena mahātmanā । nānyaṃ vai varayāmāsa tasmāddaṇḍādṛte varam ॥18॥
html:
chandyamāno'pi brahmarṣiḥ pārthivena mahātmanā ।
nānyaṃ vai varayāmāsa tasmāddaṇḍādṛte varam ॥18॥
slp1: CandyamAno'pi brahmarziH pArTivena mahAtmanA । nAnyaM vE varayAmAsa tasmAddaRqAdfte varam ॥18॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: tataḥ sa pṛthivīpālo likhitasya mahātmanaḥ । karau pracchedayāmāsa dhṛtadaṇḍo jagāma saḥ ॥19॥
html:
tataḥ sa pṛthivīpālo likhitasya mahātmanaḥ ।
karau pracchedayāmāsa dhṛtadaṇḍo jagāma saḥ ॥19॥
slp1: tataH sa pfTivIpAlo liKitasya mahAtmanaH । karO pracCedayAmAsa DftadaRqo jagAma saH ॥19॥

text: sa gatvā bhrātaraṃ śaṅkhamārtarūpo'bravīdidam । dhṛtadaṇḍasya durbhuddherbhagavankṣantumarhasi ॥20॥
html:
sa gatvā bhrātaraṃ śaṅkhamārtarūpo'bravīdidam ।
dhṛtadaṇḍasya durbhuddherbhagavankṣantumarhasi ॥20॥
slp1: sa gatvA BrAtaraM SaNKamArtarUpo'bravIdidam । DftadaRqasya durBudDerBagavankzantumarhasi ॥20॥

text: na kupye tava dharmajña na ca dūṣayase mama । dharmastu te vyatikrāntastataste niṣkṛtiḥ kṛtā ॥21॥
html:
na kupye tava dharmajña na ca dūṣayase mama ।
dharmastu te vyatikrāntastataste niṣkṛtiḥ kṛtā ॥21॥
slp1: na kupye tava DarmajYa na ca dUzayase mama । Darmastu te vyatikrAntastataste nizkftiH kftA ॥21॥
author: śaṅkha uvāca ।

text: sa gatvā bāhudāṃ śīghraṃ tarpayasva yathāvidhi । devānpitṝnṛṣīṃścaiva mā cādharme manaḥ kṛthāḥ ॥22॥
html:
sa gatvā bāhudāṃ śīghraṃ tarpayasva yathāvidhi ।
devānpitṝnṛṣīṃścaiva mā cādharme manaḥ kṛthāḥ ॥22॥
slp1: sa gatvA bAhudAM SIGraM tarpayasva yaTAviDi । devAnpitFnfzIMScEva mA cADarme manaH kfTAH ॥22॥

text: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śaṅkhasya likhitastadā । avagāhyāpagāṃ puṇyāmudakārthaṃ pracakrame ॥23॥
html:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śaṅkhasya likhitastadā ।
avagāhyāpagāṃ puṇyāmudakārthaṃ pracakrame ॥23॥
slp1: tasya tadvacanaM SrutvA SaNKasya liKitastadA । avagAhyApagAM puRyAmudakArTaM pracakrame ॥23॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: prādurāstāṃ tatastasya karau jalajasannibhau । tataḥ sa vismito bhrāturdarśayāmāsa tau karau ॥24॥
html:
prādurāstāṃ tatastasya karau jalajasannibhau ।
tataḥ sa vismito bhrāturdarśayāmāsa tau karau ॥24॥
slp1: prAdurAstAM tatastasya karO jalajasanniBO । tataH sa vismito BrAturdarSayAmAsa tO karO ॥24॥

text: tatastamabravīcchaṅkhastapasedaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā । mā ca te'tra viśaṅkā bhūddaivameva vidhīyate ॥25॥
html:
tatastamabravīcchaṅkhastapasedaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā ।
mā ca te'tra viśaṅkā bhūddaivameva vidhīyate ॥25॥
slp1: tatastamabravIcCaNKastapasedaM kftaM mayA । mA ca te'tra viSaNkA BUddEvameva viDIyate ॥25॥

text: kiṃ nu nāhaṃ tvayā pūtaḥ pūrvameva mahādyute । yasya te tapaso vīryamīdṛśaṃ dvijasattama ॥26॥
html:
kiṃ nu nāhaṃ tvayā pūtaḥ pūrvameva mahādyute ।
yasya te tapaso vīryamīdṛśaṃ dvijasattama ॥26॥
slp1: kiM nu nAhaM tvayA pUtaH pUrvameva mahAdyute । yasya te tapaso vIryamIdfSaM dvijasattama ॥26॥
author: likhita uvāca ।

text: evametanmayā kāryaṃ nāhaṃ daṇḍadharastava । sa ca pūto narapatistvaṃ cāpi pitṛbhiḥ saha ॥27॥
html:
evametanmayā kāryaṃ nāhaṃ daṇḍadharastava ।
sa ca pūto narapatistvaṃ cāpi pitṛbhiḥ saha ॥27॥
slp1: evametanmayA kAryaM nAhaM daRqaDarastava । sa ca pUto narapatistvaM cApi pitfBiH saha ॥27॥
author: śaṅkha uvāca ।

text: sa rājā pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha śreṣṭho vai tena karmaṇā । prāptavānparamāṃ siddhiṃ dakṣaḥ prācetaso yathā ॥28॥
html:
sa rājā pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha śreṣṭho vai tena karmaṇā ।
prāptavānparamāṃ siddhiṃ dakṣaḥ prācetaso yathā ॥28॥
slp1: sa rAjA pARqavaSrezWa SrezWo vE tena karmaRA । prAptavAnparamAM sidDiM dakzaH prAcetaso yaTA ॥28॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: eṣa dharmaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ prajānāṃ paripālanam । utpathe'sminmahārāja mā ca śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ ॥29॥
html:
eṣa dharmaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ prajānāṃ paripālanam ।
utpathe'sminmahārāja mā ca śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ ॥29॥
slp1: eza DarmaH kzatriyARAM prajAnAM paripAlanam । utpaTe'sminmahArAja mA ca Soke manaH kfTAH ॥29॥

text: bhrāturasya hitaṃ vākyaṃ śṛṇu dharmajñasattama । daṇḍa eva hi rājendra kṣatradharmo na muṇḍanam] ॥30॥
html:
bhrāturasya hitaṃ vākyaṃ śṛṇu dharmajñasattama ।
daṇḍa eva hi rājendra kṣatradharmo na muṇḍanam] ॥30॥
slp1: BrAturasya hitaM vAkyaM SfRu DarmajYasattama । daRqa eva hi rAjendra kzatraDarmo na muRqanam] ॥30॥

text: punareva maharṣistaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano'bravīt । ajātaśatruṃ kaunteyamidaṃ vacanamarthavat ॥1॥
html:
punareva maharṣistaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano'bravīt ।
ajātaśatruṃ kaunteyamidaṃ vacanamarthavat ॥1॥
slp1: punareva maharzistaM kfzRadvEpAyano'bravIt । ajAtaSatruM kOnteyamidaM vacanamarTavat ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: araṇye vasatāṃ tāta bhrātṝṇāṃ te tapasvinām । manorathā mahārāja ye tatrāsanyudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
html:
araṇye vasatāṃ tāta bhrātṝṇāṃ te tapasvinām ।
manorathā mahārāja ye tatrāsanyudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
slp1: araRye vasatAM tAta BrAtFRAM te tapasvinAm । manoraTA mahArAja ye tatrAsanyuDizWira ॥2॥

text: tānime bharataśreṣṭha prāpnuvantu mahārathāḥ । praśādhi pṛthivīṃ pārtha yayātiriva nāhuṣaḥ ॥3॥
html:
tānime bharataśreṣṭha prāpnuvantu mahārathāḥ ।
praśādhi pṛthivīṃ pārtha yayātiriva nāhuṣaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: tAnime BarataSrezWa prApnuvantu mahAraTAH । praSADi pfTivIM pArTa yayAtiriva nAhuzaH ॥3॥

text: araṇye duḥkhavasatiranubhūtā tapasvibhiḥ । duḥkhasyānte naravyāghrāḥ sukhaṃ tvanubhavantvime ॥4॥
html:
araṇye duḥkhavasatiranubhūtā tapasvibhiḥ ।
duḥkhasyānte naravyāghrāḥ sukhaṃ tvanubhavantvime ॥4॥
slp1: araRye duHKavasatiranuBUtA tapasviBiH । duHKasyAnte naravyAGrAH suKaM tvanuBavantvime ॥4॥

text: dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca bhrātṛbhiḥ saha bhārata । anubhūya tataḥ paścātprasthātāsi viśāmpate ॥5॥
html:
dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca bhrātṛbhiḥ saha bhārata ।
anubhūya tataḥ paścātprasthātāsi viśāmpate ॥5॥
slp1: DarmamarTaM ca kAmaM ca BrAtfBiH saha BArata । anuBUya tataH paScAtprasTAtAsi viSAmpate ॥5॥

text: atithīnāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca bhārata । ānṛṇyaṃ gaccha kaunteya tataḥ svargaṃ gamiṣyasi ॥6॥
html:
atithīnāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca bhārata ।
ānṛṇyaṃ gaccha kaunteya tataḥ svargaṃ gamiṣyasi ॥6॥
slp1: atiTInAM ca pitFRAM devatAnAM ca BArata । AnfRyaM gacCa kOnteya tataH svargaM gamizyasi ॥6॥

text: sarvamedhāśvamedhābhyāṃ yajasva kurunandana । tataḥ paścānmahārāja gamiṣyasi parāṃ gatim ॥7॥
html:
sarvamedhāśvamedhābhyāṃ yajasva kurunandana ।
tataḥ paścānmahārāja gamiṣyasi parāṃ gatim ॥7॥
slp1: sarvameDASvameDAByAM yajasva kurunandana । tataH paScAnmahArAja gamizyasi parAM gatim ॥7॥

text: bhrātṝṃśca sarvānkratubhiḥ saṃyojya bahudakṣiṇaiḥ । samprāptaḥ kīrtimatulāṃ pāṇḍaveya bhaviṣyasi ॥8॥
html:
bhrātṝṃśca sarvānkratubhiḥ saṃyojya bahudakṣiṇaiḥ ।
samprāptaḥ kīrtimatulāṃ pāṇḍaveya bhaviṣyasi ॥8॥
slp1: BrAtFMSca sarvAnkratuBiH saMyojya bahudakziREH । samprAptaH kIrtimatulAM pARqaveya Bavizyasi ॥8॥

text: vidma te puruṣavyāghra vacanaṃ kurunandana । śṛṇu macca yathā kurvandharmānna cyavate nṛpaḥ ॥9॥
html:
vidma te puruṣavyāghra vacanaṃ kurunandana ।
śṛṇu macca yathā kurvandharmānna cyavate nṛpaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: vidma te puruzavyAGra vacanaM kurunandana । SfRu macca yaTA kurvanDarmAnna cyavate nfpaH ॥9॥

text: ādadānasya ca dhanaṃ nigrahaṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira । samānaṃ dharmakuśalāḥ sthāpayanti nareśvara ॥10॥
html:
ādadānasya ca dhanaṃ nigrahaṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira ।
samānaṃ dharmakuśalāḥ sthāpayanti nareśvara ॥10॥
slp1: AdadAnasya ca DanaM nigrahaM ca yuDizWira । samAnaM DarmakuSalAH sTApayanti nareSvara ॥10॥

text: deśakālapratīkṣe yo dasyordarśayate nṛpaḥ । śāstrajāṃ buddhimāsthāya nainasā sa hi yujyate ॥11॥
html:
deśakālapratīkṣe yo dasyordarśayate nṛpaḥ ।
śāstrajāṃ buddhimāsthāya nainasā sa hi yujyate ॥11॥
slp1: deSakAlapratIkze yo dasyordarSayate nfpaH । SAstrajAM budDimAsTAya nEnasA sa hi yujyate ॥11॥

text: ādāya baliṣaḍbhāgaṃ yo rāṣṭraṃ nābhirakṣati । pratigṛhṇāti tatpāpaṃ caturthāṃśena pārthivaḥ ॥12॥
html:
ādāya baliṣaḍbhāgaṃ yo rāṣṭraṃ nābhirakṣati ।
pratigṛhṇāti tatpāpaṃ caturthāṃśena pārthivaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: AdAya balizaqBAgaM yo rAzwraM nABirakzati । pratigfhRAti tatpApaM caturTAMSena pArTivaH ॥12॥

text: nibodha ca yathātiṣṭhandharmānna cyavate nṛpaḥ । nigrahāddharmaśāstrāṇāmanurudhyannapetabhīḥ । kāmakrodhāvanādṛtya piteva samadarśanaḥ ॥13॥
html:
nibodha ca yathātiṣṭhandharmānna cyavate nṛpaḥ ।
nigrahāddharmaśāstrāṇāmanurudhyannapetabhīḥ ।
kāmakrodhāvanādṛtya piteva samadarśanaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: niboDa ca yaTAtizWanDarmAnna cyavate nfpaH । nigrahAdDarmaSAstrARAmanuruDyannapetaBIH । kAmakroDAvanAdftya piteva samadarSanaH ॥13॥

text: daivenopahate rājā karmakāle mahādyute । pramādayati tatkarma na tatrāhuratikramam ॥14॥
html:
daivenopahate rājā karmakāle mahādyute ।
pramādayati tatkarma na tatrāhuratikramam ॥14॥
slp1: dEvenopahate rAjA karmakAle mahAdyute । pramAdayati tatkarma na tatrAhuratikramam ॥14॥

text: tarasā buddhipūrvaṃ vā nigrāhyā eva śatravaḥ । pāpaiḥ saha na sandadhyādrāṣṭraṃ paṇyaṃ na kārayet ॥15॥
html:
tarasā buddhipūrvaṃ vā nigrāhyā eva śatravaḥ ।
pāpaiḥ saha na sandadhyādrāṣṭraṃ paṇyaṃ na kārayet ॥15॥
slp1: tarasA budDipUrvaM vA nigrAhyA eva SatravaH । pApEH saha na sandaDyAdrAzwraM paRyaM na kArayet ॥15॥

text: śūrāścāryāśca satkāryā vidvāṃsaśca yudhiṣṭhira । gomato dhaninaścaiva paripālyā viśeṣataḥ ॥16॥
html:
śūrāścāryāśca satkāryā vidvāṃsaśca yudhiṣṭhira ।
gomato dhaninaścaiva paripālyā viśeṣataḥ ॥16॥
slp1: SUrAScAryASca satkAryA vidvAMsaSca yuDizWira । gomato DaninaScEva paripAlyA viSezataH ॥16॥

text: vyavahāreṣu dharmyeṣu niyojyāśca bahuśrutāḥ । guṇayukte'pi naikasminviśvasyācca vicakṣaṇaḥ ॥17॥
html:
vyavahāreṣu dharmyeṣu niyojyāśca bahuśrutāḥ ।
guṇayukte'pi naikasminviśvasyācca vicakṣaṇaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: vyavahArezu Darmyezu niyojyASca bahuSrutAH । guRayukte'pi nEkasminviSvasyAcca vicakzaRaH ॥17॥

text: arakṣitā durvinīto mānī stabdho'bhyasūyakaḥ । enasā yujyate rājā durdānta iti cocyate ॥18॥
html:
arakṣitā durvinīto mānī stabdho'bhyasūyakaḥ ।
enasā yujyate rājā durdānta iti cocyate ॥18॥
slp1: arakzitA durvinIto mAnI stabDo'ByasUyakaH । enasA yujyate rAjA durdAnta iti cocyate ॥18॥

text: ye'rakṣyamāṇā hīyante daivenopahate nṛpe । taskaraiścāpi hanyante sarvaṃ tadrājakilbiṣam ॥19॥
html:
ye'rakṣyamāṇā hīyante daivenopahate nṛpe ।
taskaraiścāpi hanyante sarvaṃ tadrājakilbiṣam ॥19॥
slp1: ye'rakzyamARA hIyante dEvenopahate nfpe । taskarEScApi hanyante sarvaM tadrAjakilbizam ॥19॥

text: sumantrite sunīte ca vidhivaccopapādite । pauruṣe karmaṇi kṛte nāstyadharmo yudhiṣṭhira ॥20॥
html:
sumantrite sunīte ca vidhivaccopapādite ।
pauruṣe karmaṇi kṛte nāstyadharmo yudhiṣṭhira ॥20॥
slp1: sumantrite sunIte ca viDivaccopapAdite । pOruze karmaRi kfte nAstyaDarmo yuDizWira ॥20॥

text: vipadyante samārambhāḥ sidhyantyapi ca daivataḥ । kṛte puruṣakāre tu nainaḥ spṛśati pārthivam ॥21॥
html:
vipadyante samārambhāḥ sidhyantyapi ca daivataḥ ।
kṛte puruṣakāre tu nainaḥ spṛśati pārthivam ॥21॥
slp1: vipadyante samAramBAH siDyantyapi ca dEvataH । kfte puruzakAre tu nEnaH spfSati pArTivam ॥21॥

text: atra te rājaśārdūla vartayiṣye kathāmimām । yadvṛttaṃ pūrvarājarṣerhayagrīvasya pārthiva ॥22॥
html:
atra te rājaśārdūla vartayiṣye kathāmimām ।
yadvṛttaṃ pūrvarājarṣerhayagrīvasya pārthiva ॥22॥
slp1: atra te rAjaSArdUla vartayizye kaTAmimAm । yadvfttaM pUrvarAjarzerhayagrIvasya pArTiva ॥22॥

text: śatrūnhatvā hatasyājau śūrasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ । asahāyasya dhīrasya nirjitasya yudhiṣṭhira ॥23॥
html:
śatrūnhatvā hatasyājau śūrasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ ।
asahāyasya dhīrasya nirjitasya yudhiṣṭhira ॥23॥
slp1: SatrUnhatvA hatasyAjO SUrasyAklizwakarmaRaH । asahAyasya DIrasya nirjitasya yuDizWira ॥23॥

text: yatkarma vai nigrahe śātravāṇāṃ yogaścāgryaḥ pālane mānavānām । kṛtvā karma prāpya kīrtiṃ suyuddhe vājigrīvo modate devaloke ॥24॥
html:
yatkarma vai nigrahe śātravāṇāṃ yogaścāgryaḥ pālane mānavānām ।
kṛtvā karma prāpya kīrtiṃ suyuddhe vājigrīvo modate devaloke ॥24॥
slp1: yatkarma vE nigrahe SAtravARAM yogaScAgryaH pAlane mAnavAnAm । kftvA karma prApya kIrtiM suyudDe vAjigrIvo modate devaloke ॥24॥

text: santyaktātmā samareṣvātatāyī śastraiśchinno dasyubhirardyamānaḥ । aśvagrīvaḥ karmaśīlo mahātmā saṃsiddhātmā modate devaloke ॥25॥
html:
santyaktātmā samareṣvātatāyī śastraiśchinno dasyubhirardyamānaḥ ।
aśvagrīvaḥ karmaśīlo mahātmā saṃsiddhātmā modate devaloke ॥25॥
slp1: santyaktAtmA samarezvAtatAyI SastrESCinno dasyuBirardyamAnaH । aSvagrIvaH karmaSIlo mahAtmA saMsidDAtmA modate devaloke ॥25॥

text: dhanuryūpo raśanā jyā śaraḥ sruksruvaḥ khaḍgo rudhiraṃ yatra cājyam । ratho vedī kāmago yuddhamagniścāturhotraṃ caturo vājimukhyāḥ ॥26॥
html:
dhanuryūpo raśanā jyā śaraḥ sruksruvaḥ khaḍgo rudhiraṃ yatra cājyam ।
ratho vedī kāmago yuddhamagniścāturhotraṃ caturo vājimukhyāḥ ॥26॥
slp1: DanuryUpo raSanA jyA SaraH sruksruvaH Kaqgo ruDiraM yatra cAjyam । raTo vedI kAmago yudDamagniScAturhotraM caturo vAjimuKyAH ॥26॥

text: hutvā tasminyajñavahnāvathārīnpāpānmukto rājasiṃhastarasvī । prāṇānhutvā cāvabhṛthe raṇe sa vājigrīvo modate devaloke ॥27॥
html:
hutvā tasminyajñavahnāvathārīnpāpānmukto rājasiṃhastarasvī ।
prāṇānhutvā cāvabhṛthe raṇe sa vājigrīvo modate devaloke ॥27॥
slp1: hutvA tasminyajYavahnAvaTArInpApAnmukto rAjasiMhastarasvI । prARAnhutvA cAvaBfTe raRe sa vAjigrIvo modate devaloke ॥27॥

text: rāṣṭraṃ rakṣanbuddhipūrvaṃ nayena santyaktātmā yajñaśīlo mahātmā । sarvāṁllokānvyāpya kīrtyā manasvī vājigrīvo modate devaloke ॥28॥
html:
rāṣṭraṃ rakṣanbuddhipūrvaṃ nayena santyaktātmā yajñaśīlo mahātmā ।
sarvāṁllokānvyāpya kīrtyā manasvī vājigrīvo modate devaloke ॥28॥
slp1: rAzwraM rakzanbudDipUrvaM nayena santyaktAtmA yajYaSIlo mahAtmA । sarvAṁllokAnvyApya kIrtyA manasvI vAjigrIvo modate devaloke ॥28॥

text: daivīṃ siddhiṃ mānuṣīṃ daṇḍanītiṃ yoganyāyaiḥ pālayitvā mahīṃ ca । tasmādrājā dharmaśīlo mahātmā hayagrīvo modate svargaloke ॥29॥
html:
daivīṃ siddhiṃ mānuṣīṃ daṇḍanītiṃ yoganyāyaiḥ pālayitvā mahīṃ ca ।
tasmādrājā dharmaśīlo mahātmā hayagrīvo modate svargaloke ॥29॥
slp1: dEvIM sidDiM mAnuzIM daRqanItiM yoganyAyEH pAlayitvA mahIM ca । tasmAdrAjA DarmaSIlo mahAtmA hayagrIvo modate svargaloke ॥29॥

text: vidvāṃstyāgī śraddadhānaḥ kṛtajñastyaktvā lokaṃ mānuṣaṃ karma kṛtvā । medhāvināṃ viduṣāṃ sammatānāṃ tanutyajāṃ lokamākramya rājā ॥30॥
html:
vidvāṃstyāgī śraddadhānaḥ kṛtajñastyaktvā lokaṃ mānuṣaṃ karma kṛtvā ।
medhāvināṃ viduṣāṃ sammatānāṃ tanutyajāṃ lokamākramya rājā ॥30॥
slp1: vidvAMstyAgI SraddaDAnaH kftajYastyaktvA lokaM mAnuzaM karma kftvA । meDAvinAM viduzAM sammatAnAM tanutyajAM lokamAkramya rAjA ॥30॥

text: samyagvedānprāpya śāstrāṇyadhītya samyagrāṣṭraṃ pālayitvā mahātmā । cāturvarṇyaṃ sthāpayitvā svadharme vājigrīvo modate devaloke ॥31॥
html:
samyagvedānprāpya śāstrāṇyadhītya samyagrāṣṭraṃ pālayitvā mahātmā ।
cāturvarṇyaṃ sthāpayitvā svadharme vājigrīvo modate devaloke ॥31॥
slp1: samyagvedAnprApya SAstrARyaDItya samyagrAzwraM pAlayitvA mahAtmA । cAturvarRyaM sTApayitvA svaDarme vAjigrIvo modate devaloke ॥31॥

text: jitvā saṅgrāmānpālayitvā prajāśca somaṃ pītvā tarpayitvā dvijāgryān । yuktyā daṇḍaṃ dhārayitvā prajānāṃ yuddhe kṣīṇo modate devaloke ॥32॥
html:
jitvā saṅgrāmānpālayitvā prajāśca somaṃ pītvā tarpayitvā dvijāgryān ।
yuktyā daṇḍaṃ dhārayitvā prajānāṃ yuddhe kṣīṇo modate devaloke ॥32॥
slp1: jitvA saNgrAmAnpAlayitvA prajASca somaM pItvA tarpayitvA dvijAgryAn । yuktyA daRqaM DArayitvA prajAnAM yudDe kzIRo modate devaloke ॥32॥

text: vṛttaṃ yasya ślāghanīyaṃ manuṣyāḥ santo vidvāṃsaścārhayantyarhaṇīyāḥ । svargaṃ jitvā vīralokāṃśca gatvā siddhiṃ prāptaḥ puṇyakīrtirmahātmā] ॥33॥
html:
vṛttaṃ yasya ślāghanīyaṃ manuṣyāḥ santo vidvāṃsaścārhayantyarhaṇīyāḥ ।
svargaṃ jitvā vīralokāṃśca gatvā siddhiṃ prāptaḥ puṇyakīrtirmahātmā] ॥33॥
slp1: vfttaM yasya SlAGanIyaM manuzyAH santo vidvAMsaScArhayantyarhaRIyAH । svargaM jitvA vIralokAMSca gatvA sidDiM prAptaH puRyakIrtirmahAtmA] ॥33॥

text: dvaipāyanavacaḥ śrutvā kupite ca dhanañjaye । vyāsamāmantrya kaunteyaḥ pratyuvāca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥1॥
html:
dvaipāyanavacaḥ śrutvā kupite ca dhanañjaye ।
vyāsamāmantrya kaunteyaḥ pratyuvāca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥1॥
slp1: dvEpAyanavacaH SrutvA kupite ca DanaYjaye । vyAsamAmantrya kOnteyaH pratyuvAca yuDizWiraH ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: na pārthivamidaṃ rājyaṃ na ca bhogāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ । prīṇayanti mano me'dya śoko māṃ nardayatyayam ॥2॥
html:
na pārthivamidaṃ rājyaṃ na ca bhogāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ ।
prīṇayanti mano me'dya śoko māṃ nardayatyayam ॥2॥
slp1: na pArTivamidaM rAjyaM na ca BogAH pfTagviDAH । prIRayanti mano me'dya Soko mAM nardayatyayam ॥2॥

text: śrutvā ca vīrahīnānāmaputrāṇāṃ ca yoṣitām । paridevayamānānāṃ śāntiṃ nopalabhe mune ॥3॥
html:
śrutvā ca vīrahīnānāmaputrāṇāṃ ca yoṣitām ।
paridevayamānānāṃ śāntiṃ nopalabhe mune ॥3॥
slp1: SrutvA ca vIrahInAnAmaputrARAM ca yozitAm । paridevayamAnAnAM SAntiM nopalaBe mune ॥3॥

text: ityuktaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ vyāso yogavidāṃ varaḥ । yudhiṣṭhiraṃ mahāprājñaṃ dharmajño vedapāragaḥ ॥4॥
html:
ityuktaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ vyāso yogavidāṃ varaḥ ।
yudhiṣṭhiraṃ mahāprājñaṃ dharmajño vedapāragaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: ityuktaH pratyuvAcedaM vyAso yogavidAM varaH । yuDizWiraM mahAprAjYaM DarmajYo vedapAragaH ॥4॥

text: na karmaṇā labhyate cintayā vā nāpyasya dātā puruṣasya kaścit । paryāyayogādvihitaṃ vidhātrā kālena sarvaṃ labhate manuṣyaḥ ॥5॥
html:
na karmaṇā labhyate cintayā vā nāpyasya dātā puruṣasya kaścit ।
paryāyayogādvihitaṃ vidhātrā kālena sarvaṃ labhate manuṣyaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: na karmaRA laByate cintayA vA nApyasya dAtA puruzasya kaScit । paryAyayogAdvihitaM viDAtrA kAlena sarvaM laBate manuzyaH ॥5॥

text: na buddhiśāstrādhyayanena śakyaṃ prāptuṃ viśeṣairmanujairakāle । mūrkho'pi prāpnoti kadācidarthānkālo hi kāryaṃ prati nirviśeṣaḥ ॥6॥
html:
na buddhiśāstrādhyayanena śakyaṃ prāptuṃ viśeṣairmanujairakāle ।
mūrkho'pi prāpnoti kadācidarthānkālo hi kāryaṃ prati nirviśeṣaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: na budDiSAstrADyayanena SakyaM prAptuM viSezErmanujErakAle । mUrKo'pi prApnoti kadAcidarTAnkAlo hi kAryaM prati nirviSezaH ॥6॥

text: nābhūtikāle ca phalaṃ dadāti śilpaṃ na mantrāśca tathauṣadhāni । tānyeva kālena samāhitāni sidhyanti cedhyanti ca bhūtikāle ॥7॥
html:
nābhūtikāle ca phalaṃ dadāti śilpaṃ na mantrāśca tathauṣadhāni ।
tānyeva kālena samāhitāni sidhyanti cedhyanti ca bhūtikāle ॥7॥
slp1: nABUtikAle ca PalaM dadAti SilpaM na mantrASca taTOzaDAni । tAnyeva kAlena samAhitAni siDyanti ceDyanti ca BUtikAle ॥7॥

text: kālena śīghrāḥ pravivānti vātāḥ kālena vṛṣṭirjaladānupaiti । kālena padmotpalavajjalaṃ ca kālena puṣyanti nagā vaneṣu ॥8॥
html:
kālena śīghrāḥ pravivānti vātāḥ kālena vṛṣṭirjaladānupaiti ।
kālena padmotpalavajjalaṃ ca kālena puṣyanti nagā vaneṣu ॥8॥
slp1: kAlena SIGrAH pravivAnti vAtAH kAlena vfzwirjaladAnupEti । kAlena padmotpalavajjalaM ca kAlena puzyanti nagA vanezu ॥8॥

text: kālena kṛṣṇāśca sitāśca rātryaḥ kālena candraḥ paripūrṇabimbaḥ । nākālataḥ puṣpaphalaṃ nagānāṃ nākālavegāḥ sarito vahanti ॥9॥
html:
kālena kṛṣṇāśca sitāśca rātryaḥ kālena candraḥ paripūrṇabimbaḥ ।
nākālataḥ puṣpaphalaṃ nagānāṃ nākālavegāḥ sarito vahanti ॥9॥
slp1: kAlena kfzRASca sitASca rAtryaH kAlena candraH paripUrRabimbaH । nAkAlataH puzpaPalaM nagAnAM nAkAlavegAH sarito vahanti ॥9॥

text: nākālamattāḥ khagapannagāśca mṛgadvipāḥ śailamahāgrahāśca । nākālataḥ strīṣu bhavanti garbhā nāyāntyakāle śiśiroṣṇavarṣāḥ ॥10॥
html:
nākālamattāḥ khagapannagāśca mṛgadvipāḥ śailamahāgrahāśca ।
nākālataḥ strīṣu bhavanti garbhā nāyāntyakāle śiśiroṣṇavarṣāḥ ॥10॥
slp1: nAkAlamattAH KagapannagASca mfgadvipAH SElamahAgrahASca । nAkAlataH strIzu Bavanti garBA nAyAntyakAle SiSirozRavarzAH ॥10॥

text: nākālato mriyate jāyate vā nākālato vyāharate ca bālaḥ । nākālato yauvanamabhyupaiti nākālato rohati bījamuptam ॥11॥
html:
nākālato mriyate jāyate vā nākālato vyāharate ca bālaḥ ।
nākālato yauvanamabhyupaiti nākālato rohati bījamuptam ॥11॥
slp1: nAkAlato mriyate jAyate vA nAkAlato vyAharate ca bAlaH । nAkAlato yOvanamaByupEti nAkAlato rohati bIjamuptam ॥11॥

text: nākālato bhānurupaiti yogaṃ nākālato'staṃ girimabhyupaiti । nākālato vardhate hīyate ca candraḥ samudraśca mahormimālī ॥12॥
html:
nākālato bhānurupaiti yogaṃ nākālato'staṃ girimabhyupaiti ।
nākālato vardhate hīyate ca candraḥ samudraśca mahormimālī ॥12॥
slp1: nAkAlato BAnurupEti yogaM nAkAlato'staM girimaByupEti । nAkAlato varDate hIyate ca candraH samudraSca mahormimAlI ॥12॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । gītaṃ rājñā senajitā duḥkhārtena yudhiṣṭhira ॥13॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
gītaṃ rājñā senajitā duḥkhārtena yudhiṣṭhira ॥13॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । gItaM rAjYA senajitA duHKArtena yuDizWira ॥13॥

text: sarvānevaiṣa paryāyo martyānspṛśati dustaraḥ । kālena paripakvā hi mriyante sarvamānavāḥ ॥14॥
html:
sarvānevaiṣa paryāyo martyānspṛśati dustaraḥ ।
kālena paripakvā hi mriyante sarvamānavāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: sarvAnevEza paryAyo martyAnspfSati dustaraH । kAlena paripakvA hi mriyante sarvamAnavAH ॥14॥

text: ghnanti cānyānnarā rājaṃstānapyanye narāstathā । sañjñaiṣā laukikī rājanna hinasti na hanyate ॥15॥
html:
ghnanti cānyānnarā rājaṃstānapyanye narāstathā ।
sañjñaiṣā laukikī rājanna hinasti na hanyate ॥15॥
slp1: Gnanti cAnyAnnarA rAjaMstAnapyanye narAstaTA । saYjYEzA lOkikI rAjanna hinasti na hanyate ॥15॥

text: hantīti manyate kaścinna hantītyapi cāpare । svabhāvatastu niyatau bhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayau ॥16॥
html:
hantīti manyate kaścinna hantītyapi cāpare ।
svabhāvatastu niyatau bhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayau ॥16॥
slp1: hantIti manyate kaScinna hantItyapi cApare । svaBAvatastu niyatO BUtAnAM praBavApyayO ॥16॥

text: naṣṭe dhane vā dāre vā putre pitari vā mṛte । aho kaṣṭamiti dhyāyañśokasyāpacitiṃ caret ॥17॥
html:
naṣṭe dhane vā dāre vā putre pitari vā mṛte ।
aho kaṣṭamiti dhyāyañśokasyāpacitiṃ caret ॥17॥
slp1: nazwe Dane vA dAre vA putre pitari vA mfte । aho kazwamiti DyAyaYSokasyApacitiM caret ॥17॥

text: sa kiṃ śocasi mūḍhaḥ sañśocyaḥ kimanuśocasi । paśya duḥkheṣu duḥkhāni bhayeṣu ca bhayānyapi ॥18॥
html:
sa kiṃ śocasi mūḍhaḥ sañśocyaḥ kimanuśocasi ।
paśya duḥkheṣu duḥkhāni bhayeṣu ca bhayānyapi ॥18॥
slp1: sa kiM Socasi mUQaH saYSocyaH kimanuSocasi । paSya duHKezu duHKAni Bayezu ca BayAnyapi ॥18॥

text: ātmāpi cāyaṃ na mama sarvāpi pṛthivī mama । yathā mama tathānyeṣāmiti paśyanna muhyati ॥19॥
html:
ātmāpi cāyaṃ na mama sarvāpi pṛthivī mama ।
yathā mama tathānyeṣāmiti paśyanna muhyati ॥19॥
slp1: AtmApi cAyaM na mama sarvApi pfTivI mama । yaTA mama taTAnyezAmiti paSyanna muhyati ॥19॥

text: śokasthānasahasrāṇi harṣasthānaśatāni ca । divase divase mūḍhamāviśanti na paṇḍitam ॥20॥
html:
śokasthānasahasrāṇi harṣasthānaśatāni ca ।
divase divase mūḍhamāviśanti na paṇḍitam ॥20॥
slp1: SokasTAnasahasrARi harzasTAnaSatAni ca । divase divase mUQamAviSanti na paRqitam ॥20॥

text: evametāni kālena priyadveṣyāṇi bhāgaśaḥ । jīveṣu parivartante duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca ॥21॥
html:
evametāni kālena priyadveṣyāṇi bhāgaśaḥ ।
jīveṣu parivartante duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca ॥21॥
slp1: evametAni kAlena priyadvezyARi BAgaSaH । jIvezu parivartante duHKAni ca suKAni ca ॥21॥

text: duḥkhamevāsti na sukhaṃ tasmāttadupalabhyate । tṛṣṇārtiprabhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhārtiprabhavaṃ sukham ॥22॥
html:
duḥkhamevāsti na sukhaṃ tasmāttadupalabhyate ।
tṛṣṇārtiprabhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhārtiprabhavaṃ sukham ॥22॥
slp1: duHKamevAsti na suKaM tasmAttadupalaByate । tfzRArtipraBavaM duHKaM duHKArtipraBavaM suKam ॥22॥

text: sukhasyānantaraṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhasyānantaraṃ sukham । na nityaṃ labhate duḥkhaṃ na nityaṃ labhate sukham ॥23॥
html:
sukhasyānantaraṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhasyānantaraṃ sukham ।
na nityaṃ labhate duḥkhaṃ na nityaṃ labhate sukham ॥23॥
slp1: suKasyAnantaraM duHKaM duHKasyAnantaraM suKam । na nityaM laBate duHKaM na nityaM laBate suKam ॥23॥

text: sukhamante hi duḥkhānāṃ duḥkhamante sukhasya ca । tasmādetaddvayaṃ jahyādya icchecchāśvataṃ sukham ॥24॥
html:
sukhamante hi duḥkhānāṃ duḥkhamante sukhasya ca ।
tasmādetaddvayaṃ jahyādya icchecchāśvataṃ sukham ॥24॥
slp1: suKamante hi duHKAnAM duHKamante suKasya ca । tasmAdetaddvayaM jahyAdya icCecCASvataM suKam ॥24॥

text: yannimittaṃ bhavecchokastāpo vā duḥkhamūrchitaḥ । āyāso vāpi yanmūlastadekāṅgamapi tyajet ॥25॥
html:
yannimittaṃ bhavecchokastāpo vā duḥkhamūrchitaḥ ।
āyāso vāpi yanmūlastadekāṅgamapi tyajet ॥25॥
slp1: yannimittaM BavecCokastApo vA duHKamUrCitaH । AyAso vApi yanmUlastadekANgamapi tyajet ॥25॥

text: sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ priyaṃ vā yadi vāpriyam । prāptaṃ prāptamupāsīta hṛdayenāparājitaḥ ॥26॥
html:
sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ priyaṃ vā yadi vāpriyam ।
prāptaṃ prāptamupāsīta hṛdayenāparājitaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: suKaM vA yadi vA duHKaM priyaM vA yadi vApriyam । prAptaM prAptamupAsIta hfdayenAparAjitaH ॥26॥

text: īṣadapyaṅga dārāṇāṃ putrāṇāṃ vā carāpriyam । tato jñāsyasi kaḥ kasya kena vā kathameva vā ॥27॥
html:
īṣadapyaṅga dārāṇāṃ putrāṇāṃ vā carāpriyam ।
tato jñāsyasi kaḥ kasya kena vā kathameva vā ॥27॥
slp1: IzadapyaNga dArARAM putrARAM vA carApriyam । tato jYAsyasi kaH kasya kena vA kaTameva vA ॥27॥

text: ye ca mūḍhatamā loke ye ca buddheḥ paraṃ gatāḥ । ta eva sukhamedhante madhyaḥ kleśena yujyate ॥28॥
html:
ye ca mūḍhatamā loke ye ca buddheḥ paraṃ gatāḥ ।
ta eva sukhamedhante madhyaḥ kleśena yujyate ॥28॥
slp1: ye ca mUQatamA loke ye ca budDeH paraM gatAH । ta eva suKameDante maDyaH kleSena yujyate ॥28॥

text: ityabravīnmahāprājño yudhiṣṭhira sa senajit । parāvarajño lokasya dharmavitsukhaduḥkhavit ॥29॥
html:
ityabravīnmahāprājño yudhiṣṭhira sa senajit ।
parāvarajño lokasya dharmavitsukhaduḥkhavit ॥29॥
slp1: ityabravInmahAprAjYo yuDizWira sa senajit । parAvarajYo lokasya DarmavitsuKaduHKavit ॥29॥

text: sukhī parasya yo duḥkhe na jātu sa sukhī bhavet । duḥkhānāṃ hi kṣayo nāsti jāyate hyaparātparam ॥30॥
html:
sukhī parasya yo duḥkhe na jātu sa sukhī bhavet ।
duḥkhānāṃ hi kṣayo nāsti jāyate hyaparātparam ॥30॥
slp1: suKI parasya yo duHKe na jAtu sa suKI Bavet । duHKAnAM hi kzayo nAsti jAyate hyaparAtparam ॥30॥

text: sukhaṃ ca duḥkhaṃ ca bhavābhavau ca lābhālābhau maraṇaṃ jīvitaṃ ca । paryāyaśaḥ sarvamiha spṛśanti tasmāddhīro naiva hṛṣyenna kupyet ॥31॥
html:
sukhaṃ ca duḥkhaṃ ca bhavābhavau ca lābhālābhau maraṇaṃ jīvitaṃ ca ।
paryāyaśaḥ sarvamiha spṛśanti tasmāddhīro naiva hṛṣyenna kupyet ॥31॥
slp1: suKaM ca duHKaM ca BavABavO ca lABAlABO maraRaM jIvitaM ca । paryAyaSaH sarvamiha spfSanti tasmAdDIro nEva hfzyenna kupyet ॥31॥

text: dīkṣāṃ yajñe pālanaṃ yuddhamāhuryogaṃ rāṣṭre daṇḍanītyā ca samyak । vittatyāgaṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ ca yajñe samyagjñānaṃ pāvanānīti vidyāt ॥32॥
html:
dīkṣāṃ yajñe pālanaṃ yuddhamāhuryogaṃ rāṣṭre daṇḍanītyā ca samyak ।
vittatyāgaṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ ca yajñe samyagjñānaṃ pāvanānīti vidyāt ॥32॥
slp1: dIkzAM yajYe pAlanaM yudDamAhuryogaM rAzwre daRqanItyA ca samyak । vittatyAgaM dakziRAnAM ca yajYe samyagjYAnaM pAvanAnIti vidyAt ॥32॥

text: rakṣanrāṣṭraṃ buddhipūrvaṃ nayena santyaktātmā yajñaśīlo mahātmā । sarvāṁllokāndharmamūrtyā caraṃścāpyūrdhvaṃ dehānmodate devaloke ॥33॥
html:
rakṣanrāṣṭraṃ buddhipūrvaṃ nayena santyaktātmā yajñaśīlo mahātmā ।
sarvāṁllokāndharmamūrtyā caraṃścāpyūrdhvaṃ dehānmodate devaloke ॥33॥
slp1: rakzanrAzwraM budDipUrvaM nayena santyaktAtmA yajYaSIlo mahAtmA । sarvAṁllokAnDarmamUrtyA caraMScApyUrDvaM dehAnmodate devaloke ॥33॥

text: jitvā saṅgrāmānpālayitvā ca rāṣṭraṃ somaṃ pītvā vardhayitvā prajāśca । yuktyā daṇḍaṃ dhārayitvā prajānāṃ yuddhe kṣīṇo modate devaloke ॥34॥
html:
jitvā saṅgrāmānpālayitvā ca rāṣṭraṃ somaṃ pītvā vardhayitvā prajāśca ।
yuktyā daṇḍaṃ dhārayitvā prajānāṃ yuddhe kṣīṇo modate devaloke ॥34॥
slp1: jitvA saNgrAmAnpAlayitvA ca rAzwraM somaM pItvA varDayitvA prajASca । yuktyA daRqaM DArayitvA prajAnAM yudDe kzIRo modate devaloke ॥34॥

text: samyagvedānprāpya śāstrāṇyadhītya samyagrāṣṭraṃ pālayitvā ca rājā । cāturvarṇyaṃ sthāpayitvā svadharme pūtātmā vai modate devaloke ॥35॥
html:
samyagvedānprāpya śāstrāṇyadhītya samyagrāṣṭraṃ pālayitvā ca rājā ।
cāturvarṇyaṃ sthāpayitvā svadharme pūtātmā vai modate devaloke ॥35॥
slp1: samyagvedAnprApya SAstrARyaDItya samyagrAzwraM pAlayitvA ca rAjA । cAturvarRyaM sTApayitvA svaDarme pUtAtmA vE modate devaloke ॥35॥

text: yasya vṛttaṃ namasyanti svargasthasyāpi mānavāḥ । paurajānapadāmātyāḥ sa rājā rājasattamaḥ] ॥36॥
html:
yasya vṛttaṃ namasyanti svargasthasyāpi mānavāḥ ।
paurajānapadāmātyāḥ sa rājā rājasattamaḥ] ॥36॥
slp1: yasya vfttaM namasyanti svargasTasyApi mAnavAH । pOrajAnapadAmAtyAH sa rAjA rAjasattamaH] ॥36॥

text: abhimanyau hate bāle draupadyāstanayeṣu ca । dhṛṣṭadyumne virāṭe ca drupade ca mahīpatau ॥1॥
html:
abhimanyau hate bāle draupadyāstanayeṣu ca ।
dhṛṣṭadyumne virāṭe ca drupade ca mahīpatau ॥1॥
slp1: aBimanyO hate bAle drOpadyAstanayezu ca । Dfzwadyumne virAwe ca drupade ca mahIpatO ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: vasuṣeṇe ca dharmajñe dhṛṣṭaketau ca pārthive । tathānyeṣu narendreṣu nānādeśyeṣu saṃyuge ॥2॥
html:
vasuṣeṇe ca dharmajñe dhṛṣṭaketau ca pārthive ।
tathānyeṣu narendreṣu nānādeśyeṣu saṃyuge ॥2॥
slp1: vasuzeRe ca DarmajYe DfzwaketO ca pArTive । taTAnyezu narendrezu nAnAdeSyezu saMyuge ॥2॥

text: na vimuñcati māṃ śoko jñātighātinamāturam । rājyakāmukamatyugraṃ svavaṃśocchedakārakam ॥3॥
html:
na vimuñcati māṃ śoko jñātighātinamāturam ।
rājyakāmukamatyugraṃ svavaṃśocchedakārakam ॥3॥
slp1: na vimuYcati mAM Soko jYAtiGAtinamAturam । rAjyakAmukamatyugraM svavaMSocCedakArakam ॥3॥

text: yasyāṅke krīḍamānena mayā vai parivartitam । sa mayā rājyalubdhena gāṅgeyo vinipātitaḥ ॥4॥
html:
yasyāṅke krīḍamānena mayā vai parivartitam ।
sa mayā rājyalubdhena gāṅgeyo vinipātitaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: yasyANke krIqamAnena mayA vE parivartitam । sa mayA rAjyalubDena gANgeyo vinipAtitaH ॥4॥

text: yadā hyenaṃ vighūrṇantamapaśyaṃ pārthasāyakaiḥ । kampamānaṃ yathā vajraiḥ prekṣamāṇaṃ śikhaṇḍinam ॥5॥
html:
yadā hyenaṃ vighūrṇantamapaśyaṃ pārthasāyakaiḥ ।
kampamānaṃ yathā vajraiḥ prekṣamāṇaṃ śikhaṇḍinam ॥5॥
slp1: yadA hyenaM viGUrRantamapaSyaM pArTasAyakEH । kampamAnaM yaTA vajrEH prekzamARaM SiKaRqinam ॥5॥

text: jīrṇaṃ siṃhamiva prāṃśuṃ narasiṃhaṃ pitāmaham । kīryamāṇaṃ śaraistīkṣṇairdṛṣṭvā me vyathitaṃ manaḥ ॥6॥
html:
jīrṇaṃ siṃhamiva prāṃśuṃ narasiṃhaṃ pitāmaham ।
kīryamāṇaṃ śaraistīkṣṇairdṛṣṭvā me vyathitaṃ manaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: jIrRaM siMhamiva prAMSuM narasiMhaM pitAmaham । kIryamARaM SarEstIkzRErdfzwvA me vyaTitaM manaH ॥6॥

text: prāṅmukhaṃ sīdamānaṃ ca rathādapacyutaṃ śaraiḥ । ghūrṇamānaṃ yathā śailaṃ tadā me kaśmalo'bhavat ॥7॥
html:
prāṅmukhaṃ sīdamānaṃ ca rathādapacyutaṃ śaraiḥ ।
ghūrṇamānaṃ yathā śailaṃ tadā me kaśmalo'bhavat ॥7॥
slp1: prANmuKaM sIdamAnaM ca raTAdapacyutaM SarEH । GUrRamAnaM yaTA SElaM tadA me kaSmalo'Bavat ॥7॥

text: yaḥ sa bāṇadhanuṣpāṇiryodhayāmāsa bhārgavam । bahūnyahāni kauravyaḥ kurukṣetre mahāmṛdhe ॥8॥
html:
yaḥ sa bāṇadhanuṣpāṇiryodhayāmāsa bhārgavam ।
bahūnyahāni kauravyaḥ kurukṣetre mahāmṛdhe ॥8॥
slp1: yaH sa bARaDanuzpARiryoDayAmAsa BArgavam । bahUnyahAni kOravyaH kurukzetre mahAmfDe ॥8॥

text: sametaṃ pārthivaṃ kṣatraṃ vārāṇasyāṃ nadīsutaḥ । kanyārthamāhvayadvīro rathenaikena saṃyuge ॥9॥
html:
sametaṃ pārthivaṃ kṣatraṃ vārāṇasyāṃ nadīsutaḥ ।
kanyārthamāhvayadvīro rathenaikena saṃyuge ॥9॥
slp1: sametaM pArTivaM kzatraM vArARasyAM nadIsutaH । kanyArTamAhvayadvIro raTenEkena saMyuge ॥9॥

text: yena cogrāyudho rājā cakravartī durāsadaḥ । dagdhaḥ śastrapratāpena sa mayā yudhi ghātitaḥ ॥10॥
html:
yena cogrāyudho rājā cakravartī durāsadaḥ ।
dagdhaḥ śastrapratāpena sa mayā yudhi ghātitaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: yena cogrAyuDo rAjA cakravartI durAsadaH । dagDaH SastrapratApena sa mayA yuDi GAtitaH ॥10॥

text: svayaṃ mṛtyuṃ rakṣamāṇaḥ pāñcālyaṃ yaḥ śikhaṇḍinam । na bāṇaiḥ pātayāmāsa so'rjunena nipātitaḥ ॥11॥
html:
svayaṃ mṛtyuṃ rakṣamāṇaḥ pāñcālyaṃ yaḥ śikhaṇḍinam ।
na bāṇaiḥ pātayāmāsa so'rjunena nipātitaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: svayaM mftyuM rakzamARaH pAYcAlyaM yaH SiKaRqinam । na bAREH pAtayAmAsa so'rjunena nipAtitaH ॥11॥

text: yadainaṃ patitaṃ bhūmāvapaśyaṃ rudhirokṣitam । tadaivāviśadatyugro jvaro me munisattama । yena saṃvardhitā bālā yena sma parirakṣitāḥ ॥12॥
html:
yadainaṃ patitaṃ bhūmāvapaśyaṃ rudhirokṣitam ।
tadaivāviśadatyugro jvaro me munisattama ।
yena saṃvardhitā bālā yena sma parirakṣitāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: yadEnaM patitaM BUmAvapaSyaM ruDirokzitam । tadEvAviSadatyugro jvaro me munisattama । yena saMvarDitA bAlA yena sma parirakzitAH ॥12॥

text: sa mayā rājyalubdhena pāpena gurughātinā । alpakālasya rājyasya kṛte mūḍhena ghātitaḥ ॥13॥
html:
sa mayā rājyalubdhena pāpena gurughātinā ।
alpakālasya rājyasya kṛte mūḍhena ghātitaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: sa mayA rAjyalubDena pApena guruGAtinA । alpakAlasya rAjyasya kfte mUQena GAtitaH ॥13॥

text: ācāryaśca maheṣvāsaḥ sarvapārthivapūjitaḥ । abhigamya raṇe mithyā pāpenoktaḥ sutaṃ prati ॥14॥
html:
ācāryaśca maheṣvāsaḥ sarvapārthivapūjitaḥ ।
abhigamya raṇe mithyā pāpenoktaḥ sutaṃ prati ॥14॥
slp1: AcAryaSca mahezvAsaH sarvapArTivapUjitaH । aBigamya raRe miTyA pApenoktaH sutaM prati ॥14॥

text: tanme dahati gātrāṇi yanmāṃ gururabhāṣata । satyavākyo hi rājaṃstvaṃ yadi jīvati me sutaḥ । satyaṃ mā marśayanvipro mayi tatparipṛṣṭavān ॥15॥
html:
tanme dahati gātrāṇi yanmāṃ gururabhāṣata ।
satyavākyo hi rājaṃstvaṃ yadi jīvati me sutaḥ ।
satyaṃ mā marśayanvipro mayi tatparipṛṣṭavān ॥15॥
slp1: tanme dahati gAtrARi yanmAM gururaBAzata । satyavAkyo hi rAjaMstvaM yadi jIvati me sutaH । satyaM mA marSayanvipro mayi tatparipfzwavAn ॥15॥

text: kuñjaraṃ cāntaraṃ kṛtvā mithyopacaritaṃ mayā । subhṛśaṃ rājyalubdhena pāpena gurughātinā ॥16॥
html:
kuñjaraṃ cāntaraṃ kṛtvā mithyopacaritaṃ mayā ।
subhṛśaṃ rājyalubdhena pāpena gurughātinā ॥16॥
slp1: kuYjaraM cAntaraM kftvA miTyopacaritaM mayA । suBfSaM rAjyalubDena pApena guruGAtinA ॥16॥

text: satyakañcukamāsthāya mayokto gururāhave । aśvatthāmā hata iti kuñjare vinipātite । kānnu lokāngamiṣyāmi kṛtvā tatkarma dāruṇam ॥17॥
html:
satyakañcukamāsthāya mayokto gururāhave ।
aśvatthāmā hata iti kuñjare vinipātite ।
kānnu lokāngamiṣyāmi kṛtvā tatkarma dāruṇam ॥17॥
slp1: satyakaYcukamAsTAya mayokto gururAhave । aSvatTAmA hata iti kuYjare vinipAtite । kAnnu lokAngamizyAmi kftvA tatkarma dAruRam ॥17॥

text: aghātayaṃ ca yatkarṇaṃ samareṣvapalāyinam । jyeṣṭhaṃ bhrātaramatyugraṃ ko mattaḥ pāpakṛttamaḥ ॥18॥
html:
aghātayaṃ ca yatkarṇaṃ samareṣvapalāyinam ।
jyeṣṭhaṃ bhrātaramatyugraṃ ko mattaḥ pāpakṛttamaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: aGAtayaM ca yatkarRaM samarezvapalAyinam । jyezWaM BrAtaramatyugraM ko mattaH pApakfttamaH ॥18॥

text: abhimanyuṃ ca yadbālaṃ jātaṃ siṃhamivādriṣu । prāveśayamahaṃ lubdho vāhinīṃ droṇapālitām ॥19॥
html:
abhimanyuṃ ca yadbālaṃ jātaṃ siṃhamivādriṣu ।
prāveśayamahaṃ lubdho vāhinīṃ droṇapālitām ॥19॥
slp1: aBimanyuM ca yadbAlaM jAtaM siMhamivAdrizu । prAveSayamahaM lubDo vAhinIM droRapAlitAm ॥19॥

text: tadāprabhṛti bībhatsuṃ na śaknomi nirīkṣitum । kṛṣṇaṃ ca puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ kilbiṣī bhrūṇahā yathā ॥20॥
html:
tadāprabhṛti bībhatsuṃ na śaknomi nirīkṣitum ।
kṛṣṇaṃ ca puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ kilbiṣī bhrūṇahā yathā ॥20॥
slp1: tadApraBfti bIBatsuM na Saknomi nirIkzitum । kfzRaM ca puRqarIkAkzaM kilbizI BrURahA yaTA ॥20॥

text: draupadīṃ cāpyaduḥkhārhāṃ pañcaputravinākṛtām । śocāmi pṛthivīṃ hīnāṃ pañcabhiḥ parvatairiva ॥21॥
html:
draupadīṃ cāpyaduḥkhārhāṃ pañcaputravinākṛtām ।
śocāmi pṛthivīṃ hīnāṃ pañcabhiḥ parvatairiva ॥21॥
slp1: drOpadIM cApyaduHKArhAM paYcaputravinAkftAm । SocAmi pfTivIM hInAM paYcaBiH parvatEriva ॥21॥

text: so'hamāgaskaraḥ pāpaḥ pṛthivīnāśakārakaḥ । āsīna evamevedaṃ śoṣayiṣye kalevaram ॥22॥
html:
so'hamāgaskaraḥ pāpaḥ pṛthivīnāśakārakaḥ ।
āsīna evamevedaṃ śoṣayiṣye kalevaram ॥22॥
slp1: so'hamAgaskaraH pApaH pfTivInASakArakaH । AsIna evamevedaM Sozayizye kalevaram ॥22॥

text: prāyopaviṣṭaṃ jānīdhvamadya māṃ gurughātinam । jātiṣvanyāsvapi yathā na bhaveyaṃ kulāntakṛt ॥23॥
html:
prāyopaviṣṭaṃ jānīdhvamadya māṃ gurughātinam ।
jātiṣvanyāsvapi yathā na bhaveyaṃ kulāntakṛt ॥23॥
slp1: prAyopavizwaM jAnIDvamadya mAM guruGAtinam । jAtizvanyAsvapi yaTA na BaveyaM kulAntakft ॥23॥

text: na bhokṣye na ca pānīyamupayokṣye kathañcana । śoṣayiṣye priyānprāṇānihastho'haṃ tapodhana ॥24॥
html:
na bhokṣye na ca pānīyamupayokṣye kathañcana ।
śoṣayiṣye priyānprāṇānihastho'haṃ tapodhana ॥24॥
slp1: na Bokzye na ca pAnIyamupayokzye kaTaYcana । Sozayizye priyAnprARAnihasTo'haM tapoDana ॥24॥

text: yatheṣṭaṃ gamyatāṃ kāmamanujāne prasādya vaḥ । sarve māmanujānīta tyakṣyāmīdaṃ kalevaram ॥25॥
html:
yatheṣṭaṃ gamyatāṃ kāmamanujāne prasādya vaḥ ।
sarve māmanujānīta tyakṣyāmīdaṃ kalevaram ॥25॥
slp1: yaTezwaM gamyatAM kAmamanujAne prasAdya vaH । sarve mAmanujAnIta tyakzyAmIdaM kalevaram ॥25॥

text: tamevaṃvādinaṃ pārthaṃ bandhuśokena vihvalam । maivamityabravīdvyāso nigṛhya munisattamaḥ ॥26॥
html:
tamevaṃvādinaṃ pārthaṃ bandhuśokena vihvalam ।
maivamityabravīdvyāso nigṛhya munisattamaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: tamevaMvAdinaM pArTaM banDuSokena vihvalam । mEvamityabravIdvyAso nigfhya munisattamaH ॥26॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: ativelaṃ mahārāja na śokaṃ kartumarhasi । punaruktaṃ pravakṣyāmi diṣṭametaditi prabho ॥27॥
html:
ativelaṃ mahārāja na śokaṃ kartumarhasi ।
punaruktaṃ pravakṣyāmi diṣṭametaditi prabho ॥27॥
slp1: ativelaM mahArAja na SokaM kartumarhasi । punaruktaM pravakzyAmi dizwametaditi praBo ॥27॥

text: saṃyogā viprayogāśca jātānāṃ prāṇināṃ dhruvam । budbudā iva toyeṣu bhavanti na bhavanti ca ॥28॥
html:
saṃyogā viprayogāśca jātānāṃ prāṇināṃ dhruvam ।
budbudā iva toyeṣu bhavanti na bhavanti ca ॥28॥
slp1: saMyogA viprayogASca jAtAnAM prARinAM Druvam । budbudA iva toyezu Bavanti na Bavanti ca ॥28॥

text: sarve kṣayāntā nicayāḥ patanāntāḥ samucchrayāḥ । saṃyogā viprayogāntā maraṇāntaṃ hi jīvitam ॥29॥
html:
sarve kṣayāntā nicayāḥ patanāntāḥ samucchrayāḥ ।
saṃyogā viprayogāntā maraṇāntaṃ hi jīvitam ॥29॥
slp1: sarve kzayAntA nicayAH patanAntAH samucCrayAH । saMyogA viprayogAntA maraRAntaM hi jIvitam ॥29॥

text: sukhaṃ duḥkhāntamālasyaṃ dākṣyaṃ duḥkhaṃ sukhodayam । bhūtiḥ śrīrhrīrdhṛtiḥ siddhirnādakṣe nivasantyuta ॥30॥
html:
sukhaṃ duḥkhāntamālasyaṃ dākṣyaṃ duḥkhaṃ sukhodayam ।
bhūtiḥ śrīrhrīrdhṛtiḥ siddhirnādakṣe nivasantyuta ॥30॥
slp1: suKaM duHKAntamAlasyaM dAkzyaM duHKaM suKodayam । BUtiH SrIrhrIrDftiH sidDirnAdakze nivasantyuta ॥30॥

text: nālaṃ sukhāya suhṛdo nālaṃ duḥkhāya durhṛdaḥ । na ca prajñālamarthebhyo na sukhebhyo'pyalaṃ dhanam ॥31॥
html:
nālaṃ sukhāya suhṛdo nālaṃ duḥkhāya durhṛdaḥ ।
na ca prajñālamarthebhyo na sukhebhyo'pyalaṃ dhanam ॥31॥
slp1: nAlaM suKAya suhfdo nAlaM duHKAya durhfdaH । na ca prajYAlamarTeByo na suKeByo'pyalaM Danam ॥31॥

text: yathā sṛṣṭo'si kaunteya dhātrā karmasu tatkuru । ata eva hi siddhiste neśastvamātmanā nṛpa] ॥32॥
html:
yathā sṛṣṭo'si kaunteya dhātrā karmasu tatkuru ।
ata eva hi siddhiste neśastvamātmanā nṛpa] ॥32॥
slp1: yaTA sfzwo'si kOnteya DAtrA karmasu tatkuru । ata eva hi sidDiste neSastvamAtmanA nfpa] ॥32॥

text: jñātiśokābhitaptasya prāṇānabhyutsisṛkṣataḥ । jyeṣṭhasya pāṇḍuputrasya vyāsaḥ śokamapānudat ॥1॥
html:
jñātiśokābhitaptasya prāṇānabhyutsisṛkṣataḥ ।
jyeṣṭhasya pāṇḍuputrasya vyāsaḥ śokamapānudat ॥1॥
slp1: jYAtiSokABitaptasya prARAnaByutsisfkzataH । jyezWasya pARquputrasya vyAsaH SokamapAnudat ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । aśmagītaṃ naravyāghra tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
aśmagītaṃ naravyāghra tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । aSmagItaM naravyAGra tanniboDa yuDizWira ॥2॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: aśmānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prājñaṃ vaideho janako nṛpaḥ । saṃśayaṃ paripapraccha duḥkhaśokapariplutaḥ ॥3॥
html:
aśmānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prājñaṃ vaideho janako nṛpaḥ ।
saṃśayaṃ paripapraccha duḥkhaśokapariplutaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: aSmAnaM brAhmaRaM prAjYaM vEdeho janako nfpaH । saMSayaM paripapracCa duHKaSokapariplutaH ॥3॥

text: āgame yadi vāpāye jñātīnāṃ draviṇasya ca । nareṇa pratipattavyaṃ kalyāṇaṃ kathamicchatā ॥4॥
html:
āgame yadi vāpāye jñātīnāṃ draviṇasya ca ।
nareṇa pratipattavyaṃ kalyāṇaṃ kathamicchatā ॥4॥
slp1: Agame yadi vApAye jYAtInAM draviRasya ca । nareRa pratipattavyaM kalyARaM kaTamicCatA ॥4॥
author: janaka uvāca ।

text: utpannamimamātmānaṃ narasyānantaraṃ tataḥ । tāni tānyabhivartante duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca ॥5॥
html:
utpannamimamātmānaṃ narasyānantaraṃ tataḥ ।
tāni tānyabhivartante duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca ॥5॥
slp1: utpannamimamAtmAnaM narasyAnantaraM tataH । tAni tAnyaBivartante duHKAni ca suKAni ca ॥5॥
author: aśmovāca ।

text: teṣāmanyatarāpattau yadyadevopasevate । tattaddhi cetanāmasya haratyabhramivānilaḥ ॥6॥
html:
teṣāmanyatarāpattau yadyadevopasevate ।
tattaddhi cetanāmasya haratyabhramivānilaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: tezAmanyatarApattO yadyadevopasevate । tattadDi cetanAmasya haratyaBramivAnilaH ॥6॥

text: abhijāto'smi siddho'smi nāsmi kevalamānuṣaḥ । ityevaṃ hetubhistasya tribhiścittaṃ prasicyati ॥7॥
html:
abhijāto'smi siddho'smi nāsmi kevalamānuṣaḥ ।
ityevaṃ hetubhistasya tribhiścittaṃ prasicyati ॥7॥
slp1: aBijAto'smi sidDo'smi nAsmi kevalamAnuzaH । ityevaM hetuBistasya triBiScittaM prasicyati ॥7॥

text: sa prasiktamanā bhogānvisṛjya pitṛsañcitān । parikṣīṇaḥ parasvānāmādānaṃ sādhu manyate ॥8॥
html:
sa prasiktamanā bhogānvisṛjya pitṛsañcitān ।
parikṣīṇaḥ parasvānāmādānaṃ sādhu manyate ॥8॥
slp1: sa prasiktamanA BogAnvisfjya pitfsaYcitAn । parikzIRaH parasvAnAmAdAnaM sADu manyate ॥8॥

text: tamatikrāntamaryādamādadānamasāmpratam । pratiṣedhanti rājāno lubdhā mṛgamiveṣubhiḥ ॥9॥
html:
tamatikrāntamaryādamādadānamasāmpratam ।
pratiṣedhanti rājāno lubdhā mṛgamiveṣubhiḥ ॥9॥
slp1: tamatikrAntamaryAdamAdadAnamasAmpratam । pratizeDanti rAjAno lubDA mfgamivezuBiH ॥9॥

text: ye ca viṃśativarṣā vā triṃśadvarṣāśca mānavāḥ । pareṇa te varṣaśatānna bhaviṣyanti pārthiva ॥10॥
html:
ye ca viṃśativarṣā vā triṃśadvarṣāśca mānavāḥ ।
pareṇa te varṣaśatānna bhaviṣyanti pārthiva ॥10॥
slp1: ye ca viMSativarzA vA triMSadvarzASca mAnavAH । pareRa te varzaSatAnna Bavizyanti pArTiva ॥10॥

text: teṣāṃ paramaduḥkhānāṃ buddhyā bheṣajamādiśet । sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ vṛttaṃ prekṣamāṇastatastataḥ ॥11॥
html:
teṣāṃ paramaduḥkhānāṃ buddhyā bheṣajamādiśet ।
sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ vṛttaṃ prekṣamāṇastatastataḥ ॥11॥
slp1: tezAM paramaduHKAnAM budDyA BezajamAdiSet । sarvaprARaBftAM vfttaM prekzamARastatastataH ॥11॥

text: mānasānāṃ punaryonirduḥkhānāṃ cittavibhramaḥ । aniṣṭopanipāto vā tṛtīyaṃ nopapadyate ॥12॥
html:
mānasānāṃ punaryonirduḥkhānāṃ cittavibhramaḥ ।
aniṣṭopanipāto vā tṛtīyaṃ nopapadyate ॥12॥
slp1: mAnasAnAM punaryonirduHKAnAM cittaviBramaH । anizwopanipAto vA tftIyaM nopapadyate ॥12॥

text: evametāni duḥkhāni tāni tānīha mānavam । vividhānyupavartante tathā sāṃsparśakāni ca ॥13॥
html:
evametāni duḥkhāni tāni tānīha mānavam ।
vividhānyupavartante tathā sāṃsparśakāni ca ॥13॥
slp1: evametAni duHKAni tAni tAnIha mAnavam । viviDAnyupavartante taTA sAMsparSakAni ca ॥13॥

text: jarāmṛtyū ha bhūtāni khāditārau vṛkāviva । balināṃ durbalānāṃ ca hrasvānāṃ mahatāmapi ॥14॥
html:
jarāmṛtyū ha bhūtāni khāditārau vṛkāviva ।
balināṃ durbalānāṃ ca hrasvānāṃ mahatāmapi ॥14॥
slp1: jarAmftyU ha BUtAni KAditArO vfkAviva । balinAM durbalAnAM ca hrasvAnAM mahatAmapi ॥14॥

text: na kaścijjātvatikrāmejjarāmṛtyū ha mānavaḥ । api sāgaraparyantāṃ vijityemāṃ vasundharām ॥15॥
html:
na kaścijjātvatikrāmejjarāmṛtyū ha mānavaḥ ।
api sāgaraparyantāṃ vijityemāṃ vasundharām ॥15॥
slp1: na kaScijjAtvatikrAmejjarAmftyU ha mAnavaH । api sAgaraparyantAM vijityemAM vasunDarAm ॥15॥

text: sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ bhūtānāṃ paryupasthitam । prāptavyamavaśaiḥ sarvaṃ parihāro na vidyate ॥16॥
html:
sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ bhūtānāṃ paryupasthitam ।
prāptavyamavaśaiḥ sarvaṃ parihāro na vidyate ॥16॥
slp1: suKaM vA yadi vA duHKaM BUtAnAM paryupasTitam । prAptavyamavaSEH sarvaM parihAro na vidyate ॥16॥

text: pūrve vayasi madhye vāpyuttame vā narādhipa । avarjanīyāste'rthā vai kāṅkṣitāśca tato'nyathā ॥17॥
html:
pūrve vayasi madhye vāpyuttame vā narādhipa ।
avarjanīyāste'rthā vai kāṅkṣitāśca tato'nyathā ॥17॥
slp1: pUrve vayasi maDye vApyuttame vA narADipa । avarjanIyAste'rTA vE kANkzitASca tato'nyaTA ॥17॥

text: supriyairviprayogaśca samprayogastathāpriyaiḥ । arthānarthau sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vidhānamanuvartate ॥18॥
html:
supriyairviprayogaśca samprayogastathāpriyaiḥ ।
arthānarthau sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vidhānamanuvartate ॥18॥
slp1: supriyErviprayogaSca samprayogastaTApriyEH । arTAnarTO suKaM duHKaM viDAnamanuvartate ॥18॥

text: prādurbhāvaśca bhūtānāṃ dehanyāsastathaiva ca । prāptivyāyāmayogaśca sarvametatpratiṣṭhitam ॥19॥
html:
prādurbhāvaśca bhūtānāṃ dehanyāsastathaiva ca ।
prāptivyāyāmayogaśca sarvametatpratiṣṭhitam ॥19॥
slp1: prAdurBAvaSca BUtAnAM dehanyAsastaTEva ca । prAptivyAyAmayogaSca sarvametatpratizWitam ॥19॥

text: gandhavarṇarasasparśā nivartante svabhāvataḥ । tathaiva sukhaduḥkhāni vidhānamanuvartate ॥20॥
html:
gandhavarṇarasasparśā nivartante svabhāvataḥ ।
tathaiva sukhaduḥkhāni vidhānamanuvartate ॥20॥
slp1: ganDavarRarasasparSA nivartante svaBAvataH । taTEva suKaduHKAni viDAnamanuvartate ॥20॥

text: āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānamutthānaṃ pānabhojanam । niyataṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ kālenaiva bhavantyuta ॥21॥
html:
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānamutthānaṃ pānabhojanam ।
niyataṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ kālenaiva bhavantyuta ॥21॥
slp1: AsanaM SayanaM yAnamutTAnaM pAnaBojanam । niyataM sarvaBUtAnAM kAlenEva Bavantyuta ॥21॥

text: vaidyāścāpyāturāḥ santi balavantaḥ sudurbalāḥ । strīmantaśca tathā ṣaṇḍhā vicitraḥ kālaparyayaḥ ॥22॥
html:
vaidyāścāpyāturāḥ santi balavantaḥ sudurbalāḥ ।
strīmantaśca tathā ṣaṇḍhā vicitraḥ kālaparyayaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: vEdyAScApyAturAH santi balavantaH sudurbalAH । strImantaSca taTA zaRQA vicitraH kAlaparyayaH ॥22॥

text: kule janma tathā vīryamārogyaṃ dhairyameva ca । saubhāgyamupabhogaśca bhavitavyena labhyate ॥23॥
html:
kule janma tathā vīryamārogyaṃ dhairyameva ca ।
saubhāgyamupabhogaśca bhavitavyena labhyate ॥23॥
slp1: kule janma taTA vIryamArogyaM DEryameva ca । sOBAgyamupaBogaSca Bavitavyena laByate ॥23॥

text: santi putrāḥ subahavo daridrāṇāmanicchatām । bahūnāmicchatāṃ nāsti samṛddhānāṃ viceṣṭatām ॥24॥
html:
santi putrāḥ subahavo daridrāṇāmanicchatām ।
bahūnāmicchatāṃ nāsti samṛddhānāṃ viceṣṭatām ॥24॥
slp1: santi putrAH subahavo daridrARAmanicCatAm । bahUnAmicCatAM nAsti samfdDAnAM vicezwatAm ॥24॥

text: vyādhiragnirjalaṃ śastraṃ bubhukṣā śvāpadaṃ viṣam । rajjvā ca maraṇaṃ jantoruccācca patanaṃ tathā ॥25॥
html:
vyādhiragnirjalaṃ śastraṃ bubhukṣā śvāpadaṃ viṣam ।
rajjvā ca maraṇaṃ jantoruccācca patanaṃ tathā ॥25॥
slp1: vyADiragnirjalaM SastraM buBukzA SvApadaM vizam । rajjvA ca maraRaM jantoruccAcca patanaM taTA ॥25॥

text: niryāṇaṃ yasya yaddiṣṭaṃ tena gacchati hetunā । dṛśyate nābhyatikrāmannatikrānto na vā punaḥ ॥26॥
html:
niryāṇaṃ yasya yaddiṣṭaṃ tena gacchati hetunā ।
dṛśyate nābhyatikrāmannatikrānto na vā punaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: niryARaM yasya yaddizwaM tena gacCati hetunA । dfSyate nAByatikrAmannatikrAnto na vA punaH ॥26॥

text: dṛśyate hi yuvaiveha vinaśyanvasumānnaraḥ । daridraśca parikliṣṭaḥ śatavarṣo janādhipa ॥27॥
html:
dṛśyate hi yuvaiveha vinaśyanvasumānnaraḥ ।
daridraśca parikliṣṭaḥ śatavarṣo janādhipa ॥27॥
slp1: dfSyate hi yuvEveha vinaSyanvasumAnnaraH । daridraSca pariklizwaH Satavarzo janADipa ॥27॥

text: akiñcanāśca dṛśyante puruṣāścirajīvinaḥ । samṛddhe ca kule jātā vinaśyanti pataṅgavat ॥28॥
html:
akiñcanāśca dṛśyante puruṣāścirajīvinaḥ ।
samṛddhe ca kule jātā vinaśyanti pataṅgavat ॥28॥
slp1: akiYcanASca dfSyante puruzAScirajIvinaH । samfdDe ca kule jAtA vinaSyanti pataNgavat ॥28॥

text: prāyeṇa śrīmatāṃ loke bhoktuṃ śaktirna vidyate । kāṣṭhānyapi hi jīryante daridrāṇāṃ narādhipa ॥29॥
html:
prāyeṇa śrīmatāṃ loke bhoktuṃ śaktirna vidyate ।
kāṣṭhānyapi hi jīryante daridrāṇāṃ narādhipa ॥29॥
slp1: prAyeRa SrImatAM loke BoktuM Saktirna vidyate । kAzWAnyapi hi jIryante daridrARAM narADipa ॥29॥

text: ahametatkaromīti manyate kālacoditaḥ । yadyadiṣṭamasantoṣāddurātmā pāpamācaran ॥30॥
html:
ahametatkaromīti manyate kālacoditaḥ ।
yadyadiṣṭamasantoṣāddurātmā pāpamācaran ॥30॥
slp1: ahametatkaromIti manyate kAlacoditaH । yadyadizwamasantozAddurAtmA pApamAcaran ॥30॥

text: striyo'kṣā mṛgayā pānaṃ prasaṅgānninditā budhaiḥ । dṛśyante cāpi bahavaḥ samprasaktā bahuśrutāḥ ॥31॥
html:
striyo'kṣā mṛgayā pānaṃ prasaṅgānninditā budhaiḥ ।
dṛśyante cāpi bahavaḥ samprasaktā bahuśrutāḥ ॥31॥
slp1: striyo'kzA mfgayA pAnaM prasaNgAnninditA buDEH । dfSyante cApi bahavaH samprasaktA bahuSrutAH ॥31॥

text: iti kālena sarvārthānīpsitānīpsitāni ca । spṛśanti sarvabhūtāni nimittaṃ nopalabhyate ॥32॥
html:
iti kālena sarvārthānīpsitānīpsitāni ca ।
spṛśanti sarvabhūtāni nimittaṃ nopalabhyate ॥32॥
slp1: iti kAlena sarvArTAnIpsitAnIpsitAni ca । spfSanti sarvaBUtAni nimittaM nopalaByate ॥32॥

text: vāyumākāśamagniṃ ca candrādityāvahaḥkṣape । jyotīṃṣi saritaḥ śailānkaḥ karoti bibharti vā ॥33॥
html:
vāyumākāśamagniṃ ca candrādityāvahaḥkṣape ।
jyotīṃṣi saritaḥ śailānkaḥ karoti bibharti vā ॥33॥
slp1: vAyumAkASamagniM ca candrAdityAvahaHkzape । jyotIMzi saritaH SElAnkaH karoti biBarti vA ॥33॥

text: śītamuṣṇaṃ tathā varṣaṃ kālena parivartate । evameva manuṣyāṇāṃ sukhaduḥkhe nararṣabha ॥34॥
html:
śītamuṣṇaṃ tathā varṣaṃ kālena parivartate ।
evameva manuṣyāṇāṃ sukhaduḥkhe nararṣabha ॥34॥
slp1: SItamuzRaM taTA varzaM kAlena parivartate । evameva manuzyARAM suKaduHKe nararzaBa ॥34॥

text: nauṣadhāni na śāstrāṇi na homā na punarjapāḥ । trāyante mṛtyunopetaṃ jarayā vāpi mānavam ॥35॥
html:
nauṣadhāni na śāstrāṇi na homā na punarjapāḥ ।
trāyante mṛtyunopetaṃ jarayā vāpi mānavam ॥35॥
slp1: nOzaDAni na SAstrARi na homA na punarjapAH । trAyante mftyunopetaM jarayA vApi mAnavam ॥35॥

text: yathā kāṣṭhaṃ ca kāṣṭhaṃ ca sameyātāṃ mahodadhau । sametya ca vyatīyātāṃ tadvadbhūtasamāgamaḥ ॥36॥
html:
yathā kāṣṭhaṃ ca kāṣṭhaṃ ca sameyātāṃ mahodadhau ।
sametya ca vyatīyātāṃ tadvadbhūtasamāgamaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: yaTA kAzWaM ca kAzWaM ca sameyAtAM mahodaDO । sametya ca vyatIyAtAM tadvadBUtasamAgamaH ॥36॥

text: ye cāpi puruṣaiḥ strībhirgītavādyairupasthitāḥ । ye cānāthāḥ parānnādāḥ kālasteṣu samakriyaḥ ॥37॥
html:
ye cāpi puruṣaiḥ strībhirgītavādyairupasthitāḥ ।
ye cānāthāḥ parānnādāḥ kālasteṣu samakriyaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: ye cApi puruzEH strIBirgItavAdyErupasTitAH । ye cAnATAH parAnnAdAH kAlastezu samakriyaH ॥37॥

text: mātṛpitṛsahasrāṇi putradāraśatāni ca । saṃsāreṣvanubhūtāni kasya te kasya vā vayam ॥38॥
html:
mātṛpitṛsahasrāṇi putradāraśatāni ca ।

putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ ॥21॥
slp1: sa cenmamAra sfYjaya caturBadratarastvayA । putrAtpuRyataraScEva mA putramanutapyaTAH ॥21॥

text: suhotraṃ cedvaitithinaṃ mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma । yasmai hiraṇyaṃ vavṛṣe maghavānparivatsaram ॥22॥
html:
suhotraṃ cedvaitithinaṃ mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma ।
yasmai hiraṇyaṃ vavṛṣe maghavānparivatsaram ॥22॥
slp1: suhotraM cedvEtiTinaM mftaM sfYjaya SuSruma । yasmE hiraRyaM vavfze maGavAnparivatsaram ॥22॥

text: satyanāmā vasumatī yaṃ prāpyāsījjanādhipa । hiraṇyamavahannadyastasmiñjanapadeśvare ॥23॥
html:
satyanāmā vasumatī yaṃ prāpyāsījjanādhipa ।
hiraṇyamavahannadyastasmiñjanapadeśvare ॥23॥
slp1: satyanAmA vasumatI yaM prApyAsIjjanADipa । hiraRyamavahannadyastasmiYjanapadeSvare ॥23॥

text: kūrmānkarkaṭakānnakrānmakarāñśiṃśukānapi । nadīṣvapātayadrājanmaghavā lokapūjitaḥ ॥24॥
html:
kūrmānkarkaṭakānnakrānmakarāñśiṃśukānapi ।
nadīṣvapātayadrājanmaghavā lokapūjitaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: kUrmAnkarkawakAnnakrAnmakarAYSiMSukAnapi । nadIzvapAtayadrAjanmaGavA lokapUjitaH ॥24॥

text: hairaṇyānpatitāndṛṣṭvā matsyānmakarakacchapān । sahasraśo'tha śataśastato'smayata vaitithiḥ ॥25॥
html:
hairaṇyānpatitāndṛṣṭvā matsyānmakarakacchapān ।
sahasraśo'tha śataśastato'smayata vaitithiḥ ॥25॥
slp1: hEraRyAnpatitAndfzwvA matsyAnmakarakacCapAn । sahasraSo'Ta SataSastato'smayata vEtiTiH ॥25॥

text: taddhiraṇyamaparyantamāvṛttaṃ kurujāṅgale । ījāno vitate yajñe brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samāhitaḥ ॥26॥
html:
taddhiraṇyamaparyantamāvṛttaṃ kurujāṅgale ।
ījāno vitate yajñe brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samāhitaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: tadDiraRyamaparyantamAvfttaM kurujANgale । IjAno vitate yajYe brAhmaReByaH samAhitaH ॥26॥

text: sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā । putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ । adakṣiṇamayajvānaṃ śvaitya saṃśāmya mā śucaḥ ॥27॥
html:
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā ।
putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ ।
adakṣiṇamayajvānaṃ śvaitya saṃśāmya mā śucaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: sa cenmamAra sfYjaya caturBadratarastvayA । putrAtpuRyataraScEva mA putramanutapyaTAH । adakziRamayajvAnaM SvEtya saMSAmya mA SucaH ॥27॥

text: aṅgaṃ bṛhadrathaṃ caiva mṛtaṃ śuśruma sṛñjaya । yaḥ sahasraṃ sahasrāṇāṃ śvetānaśvānavāsṛjat ॥28॥
html:
aṅgaṃ bṛhadrathaṃ caiva mṛtaṃ śuśruma sṛñjaya ।
yaḥ sahasraṃ sahasrāṇāṃ śvetānaśvānavāsṛjat ॥28॥
slp1: aNgaM bfhadraTaM cEva mftaM SuSruma sfYjaya । yaH sahasraM sahasrARAM SvetAnaSvAnavAsfjat ॥28॥

text: sahasraṃ ca sahasrāṇāṃ kanyā hemavibhūṣitāḥ । ījāno vitate yajñe dakṣiṇāmatyakālayat ॥29॥
html:
sahasraṃ ca sahasrāṇāṃ kanyā hemavibhūṣitāḥ ।
ījāno vitate yajñe dakṣiṇāmatyakālayat ॥29॥
slp1: sahasraM ca sahasrARAM kanyA hemaviBUzitAH । IjAno vitate yajYe dakziRAmatyakAlayat ॥29॥

text: śataṃ śatasahasrāṇāṃ vṛṣāṇāṃ hemamālinām । gavāṃ sahasrānucaraṃ dakṣiṇāmatyakālayat ॥30॥
html:
śataṃ śatasahasrāṇāṃ vṛṣāṇāṃ hemamālinām ।
gavāṃ sahasrānucaraṃ dakṣiṇāmatyakālayat ॥30॥
slp1: SataM SatasahasrARAM vfzARAM hemamAlinAm । gavAM sahasrAnucaraM dakziRAmatyakAlayat ॥30॥

text: aṅgasya yajamānasya tadā viṣṇupade girau । amādyadindraḥ somena dakṣiṇābhirdvijātayaḥ ॥31॥
html:
aṅgasya yajamānasya tadā viṣṇupade girau ।
amādyadindraḥ somena dakṣiṇābhirdvijātayaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: aNgasya yajamAnasya tadA vizRupade girO । amAdyadindraH somena dakziRABirdvijAtayaH ॥31॥

text: yasya yajñeṣu rājendra śatasaṅkhyeṣu vai punaḥ । devānmanuṣyāngandharvānatyaricyanta dakṣiṇāḥ ॥32॥
html:
yasya yajñeṣu rājendra śatasaṅkhyeṣu vai punaḥ ।
devānmanuṣyāngandharvānatyaricyanta dakṣiṇāḥ ॥32॥
slp1: yasya yajYezu rAjendra SatasaNKyezu vE punaH । devAnmanuzyAnganDarvAnatyaricyanta dakziRAH ॥32॥

text: na jāto janitā cānyaḥ pumānyastatpradāsyati । yadaṅgaḥ pradadau vittaṃ somasaṃsthāsu saptasu ॥33॥
html:
na jāto janitā cānyaḥ pumānyastatpradāsyati ।
yadaṅgaḥ pradadau vittaṃ somasaṃsthāsu saptasu ॥33॥
slp1: na jAto janitA cAnyaH pumAnyastatpradAsyati । yadaNgaH pradadO vittaM somasaMsTAsu saptasu ॥33॥

text: sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā । putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ ॥34॥
html:
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā ।
putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ ॥34॥
slp1: sa cenmamAra sfYjaya caturBadratarastvayA । putrAtpuRyataraScEva mA putramanutapyaTAH ॥34॥

text: śibimauśīnaraṃ caiva mṛtaṃ śuśruma sṛñjaya । ya imāṃ pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ carmavatsamaveṣṭayat ॥35॥
html:
śibimauśīnaraṃ caiva mṛtaṃ śuśruma sṛñjaya ।
ya imāṃ pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ carmavatsamaveṣṭayat ॥35॥
slp1: SibimOSInaraM cEva mftaM SuSruma sfYjaya । ya imAM pfTivIM kftsnAM carmavatsamavezwayat ॥35॥

text: mahatā rathaghoṣeṇa pṛthivīmanunādayan । ekacchatrāṃ mahīṃ cakre jaitreṇaikarathena yaḥ ॥36॥
html:
mahatā rathaghoṣeṇa pṛthivīmanunādayan ।
ekacchatrāṃ mahīṃ cakre jaitreṇaikarathena yaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: mahatA raTaGozeRa pfTivImanunAdayan । ekacCatrAM mahIM cakre jEtreREkaraTena yaH ॥36॥

text: yāvadadya gavāśvaṃ syādāraṇyaiḥ paśubhiḥ saha । tāvatīḥ pradadau gāḥ sa śibirauśīnaro'dhvare ॥37॥
html:
yāvadadya gavāśvaṃ syādāraṇyaiḥ paśubhiḥ saha ।
tāvatīḥ pradadau gāḥ sa śibirauśīnaro'dhvare ॥37॥
slp1: yAvadadya gavASvaM syAdAraRyEH paSuBiH saha । tAvatIH pradadO gAH sa SibirOSInaro'Dvare ॥37॥

text: nodyantāraṃ dhuraṃ tasya kañcinmene prajāpatiḥ । na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyantaṃ sarvarājasu bhārata । anyatrauśīnarācchaibyādrājarṣerindravikramāt ॥38॥
html:
nodyantāraṃ dhuraṃ tasya kañcinmene prajāpatiḥ ।
na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyantaṃ sarvarājasu bhārata ।
anyatrauśīnarācchaibyādrājarṣerindravikramāt ॥38॥
slp1: nodyantAraM DuraM tasya kaYcinmene prajApatiH । na BUtaM na BavizyantaM sarvarAjasu BArata । anyatrOSInarAcCEbyAdrAjarzerindravikramAt ॥38॥

text: sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā । putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ । adakṣiṇamayajvānaṃ taṃ vai saṃśāmya mā śucaḥ ॥39॥
html:
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā ।
putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ ।
adakṣiṇamayajvānaṃ taṃ vai saṃśāmya mā śucaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: sa cenmamAra sfYjaya caturBadratarastvayA । putrAtpuRyataraScEva mA putramanutapyaTAH । adakziRamayajvAnaM taM vE saMSAmya mA SucaH ॥39॥

text: bharataṃ caiva dauḥṣantiṃ mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma । śākuntaliṃ maheṣvāsaṃ bhūridraviṇatejasam ॥40॥
html:
bharataṃ caiva dauḥṣantiṃ mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma ।
śākuntaliṃ maheṣvāsaṃ bhūridraviṇatejasam ॥40॥
slp1: BarataM cEva dOHzantiM mftaM sfYjaya SuSruma । SAkuntaliM mahezvAsaM BUridraviRatejasam ॥40॥

text: yo baddhvā triṃśato hyaśvāndevebhyo yamunāmanu । sarasvatīṃ viṃśatiṃ ca gaṅgāmanu caturdaśa ॥41॥
html:
yo baddhvā triṃśato hyaśvāndevebhyo yamunāmanu ।
sarasvatīṃ viṃśatiṃ ca gaṅgāmanu caturdaśa ॥41॥
slp1: yo badDvA triMSato hyaSvAndeveByo yamunAmanu । sarasvatIM viMSatiM ca gaNgAmanu caturdaSa ॥41॥

text: aśvamedhasahasreṇa rājasūyaśatena ca । iṣṭavānsa mahātejā dauḥṣantirbharataḥ purā ॥42॥
html:
aśvamedhasahasreṇa rājasūyaśatena ca ।
iṣṭavānsa mahātejā dauḥṣantirbharataḥ purā ॥42॥
slp1: aSvameDasahasreRa rAjasUyaSatena ca । izwavAnsa mahAtejA dOHzantirBarataH purA ॥42॥

text: bharatasya mahatkarma sarvarājasu pārthivāḥ । khaṃ martyā iva bāhubhyāṃ nānugantumaśaknuvan ॥43॥
html:
bharatasya mahatkarma sarvarājasu pārthivāḥ ।
khaṃ martyā iva bāhubhyāṃ nānugantumaśaknuvan ॥43॥
slp1: Baratasya mahatkarma sarvarAjasu pArTivAH । KaM martyA iva bAhuByAM nAnugantumaSaknuvan ॥43॥

text: paraṃ sahasrādyo baddhvā hayānvedīṃ vicitya ca । sahasraṃ yatra padmānāṃ kaṇvāya bharato dadau ॥44॥
html:
paraṃ sahasrādyo baddhvā hayānvedīṃ vicitya ca ।
sahasraṃ yatra padmānāṃ kaṇvāya bharato dadau ॥44॥
slp1: paraM sahasrAdyo badDvA hayAnvedIM vicitya ca । sahasraM yatra padmAnAM kaRvAya Barato dadO ॥44॥

text: sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā । putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ ॥45॥
html:
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā ।
putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ ॥45॥
slp1: sa cenmamAra sfYjaya caturBadratarastvayA । putrAtpuRyataraScEva mA putramanutapyaTAH ॥45॥

text: rāmaṃ dāśarathiṃ caiva mṛtaṃ śuśruma sṛñjaya । yo'nvakampata vai nityaṃ prajāḥ putrānivaurasān ॥46॥
html:
rāmaṃ dāśarathiṃ caiva mṛtaṃ śuśruma sṛñjaya ।
yo'nvakampata vai nityaṃ prajāḥ putrānivaurasān ॥46॥
slp1: rAmaM dASaraTiM cEva mftaM SuSruma sfYjaya । yo'nvakampata vE nityaM prajAH putrAnivOrasAn ॥46॥

text: vidhavā yasya viṣaye nānāthāḥ kāścanābhavan । sarvasyāsītpitṛsamo rāmo rājyaṃ yadānvaśāt ॥47॥
html:
vidhavā yasya viṣaye nānāthāḥ kāścanābhavan ।
sarvasyāsītpitṛsamo rāmo rājyaṃ yadānvaśāt ॥47॥
slp1: viDavA yasya vizaye nAnATAH kAScanABavan । sarvasyAsItpitfsamo rAmo rAjyaM yadAnvaSAt ॥47॥

text: kālavarṣāśca parjanyāḥ sasyāni rasavanti ca । nityaṃ subhikṣamevāsīdrāme rājyaṃ praśāsati ॥48॥
html:
kālavarṣāśca parjanyāḥ sasyāni rasavanti ca ।
nityaṃ subhikṣamevāsīdrāme rājyaṃ praśāsati ॥48॥
slp1: kAlavarzASca parjanyAH sasyAni rasavanti ca । nityaM suBikzamevAsIdrAme rAjyaM praSAsati ॥48॥

text: prāṇino nāpsu majjanti nānarthe pāvako'dahat । na vyālajaṃ bhayaṃ cāsīdrāme rājyaṃ praśāsati ॥49॥
html:
prāṇino nāpsu majjanti nānarthe pāvako'dahat ।
na vyālajaṃ bhayaṃ cāsīdrāme rājyaṃ praśāsati ॥49॥
slp1: prARino nApsu majjanti nAnarTe pAvako'dahat । na vyAlajaM BayaM cAsIdrAme rAjyaM praSAsati ॥49॥

text: āsanvarṣasahasrāṇi tathā putrasahasrikāḥ । arogāḥ sarvasiddhārthāḥ prajā rāme praśāsati ॥50॥
html:
āsanvarṣasahasrāṇi tathā putrasahasrikāḥ ।
arogāḥ sarvasiddhārthāḥ prajā rāme praśāsati ॥50॥
slp1: AsanvarzasahasrARi taTA putrasahasrikAH । arogAH sarvasidDArTAH prajA rAme praSAsati ॥50॥

text: nānyonyena vivādo'bhūtstrīṇāmapi kuto nṛṇām । dharmanityāḥ prajāścāsanrāme rājyaṃ praśāsati ॥51॥
html:
nānyonyena vivādo'bhūtstrīṇāmapi kuto nṛṇām ।
dharmanityāḥ prajāścāsanrāme rājyaṃ praśāsati ॥51॥
slp1: nAnyonyena vivAdo'BUtstrIRAmapi kuto nfRAm । DarmanityAH prajAScAsanrAme rAjyaM praSAsati ॥51॥

text: nityapuṣpaphalāścaiva pādapā nirupadravāḥ । sarvā droṇadughā gāvo rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati ॥52॥
html:
nityapuṣpaphalāścaiva pādapā nirupadravāḥ ।
sarvā droṇadughā gāvo rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati ॥52॥
slp1: nityapuzpaPalAScEva pAdapA nirupadravAH । sarvA droRaduGA gAvo rAme rAjyaM praSAsati ॥52॥

text: sa caturdaśa varṣāṇi vane proṣya mahātapāḥ । daśāśvamedhāñjārūthyānājahāra nirargalān ॥53॥
html:
sa caturdaśa varṣāṇi vane proṣya mahātapāḥ ।
daśāśvamedhāñjārūthyānājahāra nirargalān ॥53॥
slp1: sa caturdaSa varzARi vane prozya mahAtapAH । daSASvameDAYjArUTyAnAjahAra nirargalAn ॥53॥

text: śyāmo yuvā lohitākṣo mattavāraṇavikramaḥ । daśa varṣasahasrāṇi rāmo rājyamakārayat ॥54॥
html:
śyāmo yuvā lohitākṣo mattavāraṇavikramaḥ ।
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi rāmo rājyamakārayat ॥54॥
slp1: SyAmo yuvA lohitAkzo mattavAraRavikramaH । daSa varzasahasrARi rAmo rAjyamakArayat ॥54॥

text: sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā । putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ ॥55॥
html:
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā ।
putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ ॥55॥
slp1: sa cenmamAra sfYjaya caturBadratarastvayA । putrAtpuRyataraScEva mA putramanutapyaTAH ॥55॥

text: bhagīrathaṃ ca rājānaṃ mṛtaṃ śuśruma sṛñjaya । yasyendro vitate yajñe somaṃ pītvā madotkaṭaḥ ॥56॥
html:
bhagīrathaṃ ca rājānaṃ mṛtaṃ śuśruma sṛñjaya ।
yasyendro vitate yajñe somaṃ pītvā madotkaṭaḥ ॥56॥
slp1: BagIraTaM ca rAjAnaM mftaM SuSruma sfYjaya । yasyendro vitate yajYe somaM pItvA madotkawaH ॥56॥

text: asurāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi bahūni surasattamaḥ । ajayadbāhuvīryeṇa bhagavānpākaśāsanaḥ ॥57॥
html:
asurāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi bahūni surasattamaḥ ।
ajayadbāhuvīryeṇa bhagavānpākaśāsanaḥ ॥57॥
slp1: asurARAM sahasrARi bahUni surasattamaH । ajayadbAhuvIryeRa BagavAnpAkaSAsanaH ॥57॥

text: yaḥ sahasraṃ sahasrāṇāṃ kanyā hemavibhūṣitāḥ । ījāno vitate yajñe dakṣiṇāmatyakālayat ॥58॥
html:
yaḥ sahasraṃ sahasrāṇāṃ kanyā hemavibhūṣitāḥ ।
ījāno vitate yajñe dakṣiṇāmatyakālayat ॥58॥
slp1: yaH sahasraM sahasrARAM kanyA hemaviBUzitAH । IjAno vitate yajYe dakziRAmatyakAlayat ॥58॥

text: sarvā rathagatāḥ kanyā rathāḥ sarve caturyujaḥ । rathe rathe śataṃ nāgāḥ padmino hemamālinaḥ ॥59॥
html:
sarvā rathagatāḥ kanyā rathāḥ sarve caturyujaḥ ।
rathe rathe śataṃ nāgāḥ padmino hemamālinaḥ ॥59॥
slp1: sarvA raTagatAH kanyA raTAH sarve caturyujaH । raTe raTe SataM nAgAH padmino hemamAlinaH ॥59॥

text: sahasramaśvā ekaikaṃ hastinaṃ pṛṣṭhato'nvayuḥ । gavāṃ sahasramaśve'śve sahasraṃ gavyajāvikam ॥60॥
html:
sahasramaśvā ekaikaṃ hastinaṃ pṛṣṭhato'nvayuḥ ।
gavāṃ sahasramaśve'śve sahasraṃ gavyajāvikam ॥60॥
slp1: sahasramaSvA ekEkaM hastinaM pfzWato'nvayuH । gavAM sahasramaSve'Sve sahasraM gavyajAvikam ॥60॥

text: upahvare nivasato yasyāṅke niṣasāda ha । gaṅgā bhāgīrathī tasmādurvaśī hyabhavatpurā ॥61॥
html:
upahvare nivasato yasyāṅke niṣasāda ha ।
gaṅgā bhāgīrathī tasmādurvaśī hyabhavatpurā ॥61॥
slp1: upahvare nivasato yasyANke nizasAda ha । gaNgA BAgIraTI tasmAdurvaSI hyaBavatpurA ॥61॥

text: bhūridakṣiṇamikṣvākuṃ yajamānaṃ bhagīratham । trilokapathagā gaṅgā duhitṛtvamupeyuṣī ॥62॥
html:
bhūridakṣiṇamikṣvākuṃ yajamānaṃ bhagīratham ।
