dadato me'kṣayā cāstu dharme śraddhā ca vardhatām ॥105॥
slp1: yasmE vahnirvarAnprAdAttato vavre varAngayaH । dadato me'kzayA cAstu Darme SradDA ca varDatAm ॥105॥

text: mano me ramatāṃ satye tvatprasādāddhutāśana । lebhe ca kāmāṃstānsarvānpāvakāditi naḥ śrutam ॥106॥
html:
mano me ramatāṃ satye tvatprasādāddhutāśana ।
lebhe ca kāmāṃstānsarvānpāvakāditi naḥ śrutam ॥106॥
slp1: mano me ramatAM satye tvatprasAdAdDutASana । leBe ca kAmAMstAnsarvAnpAvakAditi naH Srutam ॥106॥

text: darśena paurṇamāsena cāturmāsyaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ । ayajatsa mahātejāḥ sahasraṃ parivatsarān ॥107॥
html:
darśena paurṇamāsena cāturmāsyaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
ayajatsa mahātejāḥ sahasraṃ parivatsarān ॥107॥
slp1: darSena pOrRamAsena cAturmAsyEH punaH punaH । ayajatsa mahAtejAH sahasraM parivatsarAn ॥107॥

text: śataṃ gavāṃ sahasrāṇi śatamaśvaśatāni ca । utthāyotthāya vai prādātsahasraṃ parivatsarān ॥108॥
html:
śataṃ gavāṃ sahasrāṇi śatamaśvaśatāni ca ।
utthāyotthāya vai prādātsahasraṃ parivatsarān ॥108॥
slp1: SataM gavAM sahasrARi SatamaSvaSatAni ca । utTAyotTAya vE prAdAtsahasraM parivatsarAn ॥108॥

text: tarpayāmāsa somena devānvittairdvijānapi । pitṝnsvadhābhiḥ kāmaiśca striyaḥ svāḥ puruṣarṣabha ॥109॥
html:
tarpayāmāsa somena devānvittairdvijānapi ।
pitṝnsvadhābhiḥ kāmaiśca striyaḥ svāḥ puruṣarṣabha ॥109॥
slp1: tarpayAmAsa somena devAnvittErdvijAnapi । pitFnsvaDABiH kAmESca striyaH svAH puruzarzaBa ॥109॥

text: sauvarṇāṃ pṛthivīṃ kṛtvā daśavyāmāṃ dvirāyatām । dakṣiṇāmadadadrājā vājimedhamahāmakhe ॥110॥
html:
sauvarṇāṃ pṛthivīṃ kṛtvā daśavyāmāṃ dvirāyatām ।
dakṣiṇāmadadadrājā vājimedhamahāmakhe ॥110॥
slp1: sOvarRAM pfTivIM kftvA daSavyAmAM dvirAyatAm । dakziRAmadadadrAjA vAjimeDamahAmaKe ॥110॥

text: yāvatyaḥ sikatā rājangaṅgāyāḥ puruṣarṣabha । tāvatīreva gāḥ prādādāmūrtarayaso gayaḥ ॥111॥
html:
yāvatyaḥ sikatā rājangaṅgāyāḥ puruṣarṣabha ।
tāvatīreva gāḥ prādādāmūrtarayaso gayaḥ ॥111॥
slp1: yAvatyaH sikatA rAjangaNgAyAH puruzarzaBa । tAvatIreva gAH prAdAdAmUrtarayaso gayaH ॥111॥

text: sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā । putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ ॥112॥
html:
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā ।
putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ ॥112॥
slp1: sa cenmamAra sfYjaya caturBadratarastvayA । putrAtpuRyataraScEva mA putramanutapyaTAH ॥112॥

text: rantidevaṃ ca sāṅkṛtyaṃ mṛtaṃ śuśruma sṛñjaya । samyagārādhya yaḥ śakraṃ varaṃ lebhe mahāyaśāḥ ॥113॥
html:
rantidevaṃ ca sāṅkṛtyaṃ mṛtaṃ śuśruma sṛñjaya ।
samyagārādhya yaḥ śakraṃ varaṃ lebhe mahāyaśāḥ ॥113॥
slp1: rantidevaM ca sANkftyaM mftaM SuSruma sfYjaya । samyagArADya yaH SakraM varaM leBe mahAyaSAH ॥113॥

text: annaṃ ca no bahu bhavedatithīṃśca labhemahi । śraddhā ca no mā vyagamanmā ca yāciṣma kañcana ॥114॥
html:
annaṃ ca no bahu bhavedatithīṃśca labhemahi ।
śraddhā ca no mā vyagamanmā ca yāciṣma kañcana ॥114॥
slp1: annaM ca no bahu BavedatiTIMSca laBemahi । SradDA ca no mA vyagamanmA ca yAcizma kaYcana ॥114॥

text: upātiṣṭhanta paśavaḥ svayaṃ taṃ saṃśitavratam । grāmyāraṇyā mahātmānaṃ rantidevaṃ yaśasvinam ॥115॥
html:
upātiṣṭhanta paśavaḥ svayaṃ taṃ saṃśitavratam ।
grāmyāraṇyā mahātmānaṃ rantidevaṃ yaśasvinam ॥115॥
slp1: upAtizWanta paSavaH svayaM taM saMSitavratam । grAmyAraRyA mahAtmAnaM rantidevaM yaSasvinam ॥115॥

text: mahānadī carmarāśerutkledātsusruve yataḥ । tataścarmaṇvatītyevaṃ vikhyātā sā mahānadī ॥116॥
html:
mahānadī carmarāśerutkledātsusruve yataḥ ।
tataścarmaṇvatītyevaṃ vikhyātā sā mahānadī ॥116॥
slp1: mahAnadI carmarASerutkledAtsusruve yataH । tataScarmaRvatItyevaM viKyAtA sA mahAnadI ॥116॥

text: brāhmaṇebhyo dadau niṣkānsadasi pratate nṛpaḥ । tubhyaṃ tubhyaṃ niṣkamiti yatrākrośanti vai dvijāḥ । sahasraṃ tubhyamityuktvā brāhmaṇānsma prapadyate ॥117॥
html:
brāhmaṇebhyo dadau niṣkānsadasi pratate nṛpaḥ ।
tubhyaṃ tubhyaṃ niṣkamiti yatrākrośanti vai dvijāḥ ।
sahasraṃ tubhyamityuktvā brāhmaṇānsma prapadyate ॥117॥
slp1: brAhmaReByo dadO nizkAnsadasi pratate nfpaH । tuByaM tuByaM nizkamiti yatrAkroSanti vE dvijAH । sahasraM tuByamityuktvA brAhmaRAnsma prapadyate ॥117॥

text: anvāhāryopakaraṇaṃ dravyopakaraṇaṃ ca yat । ghaṭāḥ sthālyaḥ kaṭāhāśca pātryaśca piṭharā api । na tatkiñcidasauvarṇaṃ rantidevasya dhīmataḥ ॥118॥
html:
anvāhāryopakaraṇaṃ dravyopakaraṇaṃ ca yat ।
ghaṭāḥ sthālyaḥ kaṭāhāśca pātryaśca piṭharā api ।
na tatkiñcidasauvarṇaṃ rantidevasya dhīmataḥ ॥118॥
slp1: anvAhAryopakaraRaM dravyopakaraRaM ca yat । GawAH sTAlyaH kawAhASca pAtryaSca piWarA api । na tatkiYcidasOvarRaM rantidevasya DImataH ॥118॥

text: sāṅkṛte rantidevasya yāṃ rātrimavasadgṛhe । ālabhyanta śataṃ gāvaḥ sahasrāṇi ca viṃśatiḥ ॥119॥
html:
sāṅkṛte rantidevasya yāṃ rātrimavasadgṛhe ।
ālabhyanta śataṃ gāvaḥ sahasrāṇi ca viṃśatiḥ ॥119॥
slp1: sANkfte rantidevasya yAM rAtrimavasadgfhe । AlaByanta SataM gAvaH sahasrARi ca viMSatiH ॥119॥

text: tatra sma sūdāḥ krośanti sumṛṣṭamaṇikuṇḍalāḥ । sūpabhūyiṣṭhamaśnīdhvaṃ nādya māṃsaṃ yathā purā ॥120॥
html:
tatra sma sūdāḥ krośanti sumṛṣṭamaṇikuṇḍalāḥ ।
sūpabhūyiṣṭhamaśnīdhvaṃ nādya māṃsaṃ yathā purā ॥120॥
slp1: tatra sma sUdAH kroSanti sumfzwamaRikuRqalAH । sUpaBUyizWamaSnIDvaM nAdya mAMsaM yaTA purA ॥120॥

text: sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā । putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ ॥121॥
html:
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā ।
putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ ॥121॥
slp1: sa cenmamAra sfYjaya caturBadratarastvayA । putrAtpuRyataraScEva mA putramanutapyaTAH ॥121॥

text: sagaraṃ ca mahātmānaṃ mṛtaṃ śuśruma sṛñjaya । aikṣvākaṃ puruṣavyāghramatimānuṣavikramam ॥122॥
html:
sagaraṃ ca mahātmānaṃ mṛtaṃ śuśruma sṛñjaya ।
aikṣvākaṃ puruṣavyāghramatimānuṣavikramam ॥122॥
slp1: sagaraM ca mahAtmAnaM mftaM SuSruma sfYjaya । EkzvAkaM puruzavyAGramatimAnuzavikramam ॥122॥

text: ṣaṣṭiḥ putrasahasrāṇi yaṃ yāntaṃ pṛṣṭhato'nvayuḥ । nakṣatrarājaṃ varṣānte vyabhre jyotirgaṇā iva ॥123॥
html:
ṣaṣṭiḥ putrasahasrāṇi yaṃ yāntaṃ pṛṣṭhato'nvayuḥ ।
nakṣatrarājaṃ varṣānte vyabhre jyotirgaṇā iva ॥123॥
slp1: zazwiH putrasahasrARi yaM yAntaM pfzWato'nvayuH । nakzatrarAjaM varzAnte vyaBre jyotirgaRA iva ॥123॥

text: ekacchatrā mahī yasya praṇatā hyabhavatpurā । yo'śvamedhasahasreṇa tarpayāmāsa devatāḥ ॥124॥
html:
ekacchatrā mahī yasya praṇatā hyabhavatpurā ।
yo'śvamedhasahasreṇa tarpayāmāsa devatāḥ ॥124॥
slp1: ekacCatrA mahI yasya praRatA hyaBavatpurA । yo'SvameDasahasreRa tarpayAmAsa devatAH ॥124॥

text: yaḥ prādātkāñcanastambhaṃ prāsādaṃ sarvakāñcanam । pūrṇaṃ padmadalākṣīṇāṃ strīṇāṃ śayanasaṅkulam ॥125॥
html:
yaḥ prādātkāñcanastambhaṃ prāsādaṃ sarvakāñcanam ।
pūrṇaṃ padmadalākṣīṇāṃ strīṇāṃ śayanasaṅkulam ॥125॥
slp1: yaH prAdAtkAYcanastamBaM prAsAdaM sarvakAYcanam । pUrRaM padmadalAkzIRAM strIRAM SayanasaNkulam ॥125॥

text: dvijātibhyo'nurūpebhyaḥ kāmānuccāvacāṃstathā । yasyādeśena tadvittaṃ vyabhajanta dvijātayaḥ ॥126॥
html:
dvijātibhyo'nurūpebhyaḥ kāmānuccāvacāṃstathā ।
yasyādeśena tadvittaṃ vyabhajanta dvijātayaḥ ॥126॥
slp1: dvijAtiByo'nurUpeByaH kAmAnuccAvacAMstaTA । yasyAdeSena tadvittaM vyaBajanta dvijAtayaH ॥126॥

text: khānayāmāsa yaḥ kopātpṛthivīṃ sāgarāṅkitām । yasya nāmnā samudraśca sāgaratvamupāgataḥ ॥127॥
html:
khānayāmāsa yaḥ kopātpṛthivīṃ sāgarāṅkitām ।
yasya nāmnā samudraśca sāgaratvamupāgataḥ ॥127॥
slp1: KAnayAmAsa yaH kopAtpfTivIM sAgarANkitAm । yasya nAmnA samudraSca sAgaratvamupAgataH ॥127॥

text: sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā । putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ ॥128॥
html:
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā ।
putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ ॥128॥
slp1: sa cenmamAra sfYjaya caturBadratarastvayA । putrAtpuRyataraScEva mA putramanutapyaTAH ॥128॥

text: rājānaṃ ca pṛthuṃ vainyaṃ mṛtaṃ śuśruma sṛñjaya । yamabhyaṣiñcansambhūya mahāraṇye maharṣayaḥ ॥129॥
html:
rājānaṃ ca pṛthuṃ vainyaṃ mṛtaṃ śuśruma sṛñjaya ।
yamabhyaṣiñcansambhūya mahāraṇye maharṣayaḥ ॥129॥
slp1: rAjAnaM ca pfTuM vEnyaM mftaM SuSruma sfYjaya । yamaByaziYcansamBUya mahAraRye maharzayaH ॥129॥

text: prathayiṣyati vai lokānpṛthurityeva śabditaḥ । kṣatācca nastrāyatīti sa tasmātkṣatriyaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥130॥
html:
prathayiṣyati vai lokānpṛthurityeva śabditaḥ ।
kṣatācca nastrāyatīti sa tasmātkṣatriyaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥130॥
slp1: praTayizyati vE lokAnpfTurityeva SabditaH । kzatAcca nastrAyatIti sa tasmAtkzatriyaH smftaH ॥130॥

text: pṛthuṃ vainyaṃ prajā dṛṣṭvā raktāḥ smeti yadabruvan । tato rājeti nāmāsya anurāgādajāyata ॥131॥
html:
pṛthuṃ vainyaṃ prajā dṛṣṭvā raktāḥ smeti yadabruvan ।
tato rājeti nāmāsya anurāgādajāyata ॥131॥
slp1: pfTuM vEnyaM prajA dfzwvA raktAH smeti yadabruvan । tato rAjeti nAmAsya anurAgAdajAyata ॥131॥

text: akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī puṭake puṭake madhu । sarvā droṇadughā gāvo vainyasyāsanpraśāsataḥ ॥132॥
html:
akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī puṭake puṭake madhu ।
sarvā droṇadughā gāvo vainyasyāsanpraśāsataḥ ॥132॥
slp1: akfzwapacyA pfTivI puwake puwake maDu । sarvA droRaduGA gAvo vEnyasyAsanpraSAsataH ॥132॥

text: arogāḥ sarvasiddhārthā manuṣyā akutobhayāḥ । yathābhikāmamavasankṣetreṣu ca gṛheṣu ca ॥133॥
html:
arogāḥ sarvasiddhārthā manuṣyā akutobhayāḥ ।
yathābhikāmamavasankṣetreṣu ca gṛheṣu ca ॥133॥
slp1: arogAH sarvasidDArTA manuzyA akutoBayAH । yaTABikAmamavasankzetrezu ca gfhezu ca ॥133॥

text: āpaḥ saṃstambhire yasya samudrasya yiyāsataḥ । saritaścānudīryanta dhvajasaṅgaśca nābhavat ॥134॥
html:
āpaḥ saṃstambhire yasya samudrasya yiyāsataḥ ।
saritaścānudīryanta dhvajasaṅgaśca nābhavat ॥134॥
slp1: ApaH saMstamBire yasya samudrasya yiyAsataH । saritaScAnudIryanta DvajasaNgaSca nABavat ॥134॥

text: hairaṇyāṃstrinalotsedhānparvatānekaviṃśatim । brāhmaṇebhyo dadau rājā yo'śvamedhe mahāmakhe ॥135॥
html:
hairaṇyāṃstrinalotsedhānparvatānekaviṃśatim ।
brāhmaṇebhyo dadau rājā yo'śvamedhe mahāmakhe ॥135॥
slp1: hEraRyAMstrinalotseDAnparvatAnekaviMSatim । brAhmaReByo dadO rAjA yo'SvameDe mahAmaKe ॥135॥

text: sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā । putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ ॥136॥

sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā ।
putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ ॥136॥
slp1: sa cenmamAra sfYjaya caturBadratarastvayA । putrAtpuRyataraScEva mA putramanutapyaTAH ॥136॥

text: kiṃ vai tūṣṇīṃ dhyāyasi sṛñjaya tvaṃ na me rājanvācamimāṃ śṛṇoṣi । na cenmoghaṃ vipralaptaṃ mayedaṃ pathyaṃ mumūrṣoriva samyaguktam ॥137॥
html:
kiṃ vai tūṣṇīṃ dhyāyasi sṛñjaya tvaṃ na me rājanvācamimāṃ śṛṇoṣi ।
na cenmoghaṃ vipralaptaṃ mayedaṃ pathyaṃ mumūrṣoriva samyaguktam ॥137॥
slp1: kiM vE tUzRIM DyAyasi sfYjaya tvaM na me rAjanvAcamimAM SfRozi । na cenmoGaM vipralaptaM mayedaM paTyaM mumUrzoriva samyaguktam ॥137॥

text: śṛṇomi te nārada vācametāṃ vicitrārthāṃ srajamiva puṇyagandhām । rājarṣīṇāṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ mahātmanāṃ kīrtyā yuktāṃ śokanirṇāśanārtham ॥138॥
html:
śṛṇomi te nārada vācametāṃ vicitrārthāṃ srajamiva puṇyagandhām ।
rājarṣīṇāṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ mahātmanāṃ kīrtyā yuktāṃ śokanirṇāśanārtham ॥138॥
slp1: SfRomi te nArada vAcametAM vicitrArTAM srajamiva puRyaganDAm । rAjarzIRAM puRyakftAM mahAtmanAM kIrtyA yuktAM SokanirRASanArTam ॥138॥
author: sṛñjaya uvāca ।

text: na te moghaṃ vipralaptaṃ maharṣe dṛṣṭvaiva tvāṃ nāradāhaṃ viśokaḥ । śuśrūṣe te vacanaṃ brahmavādinna te tṛpyāmyamṛtasyeva pānāt ॥139॥
html:
na te moghaṃ vipralaptaṃ maharṣe dṛṣṭvaiva tvāṃ nāradāhaṃ viśokaḥ ।
śuśrūṣe te vacanaṃ brahmavādinna te tṛpyāmyamṛtasyeva pānāt ॥139॥
slp1: na te moGaM vipralaptaM maharze dfzwvEva tvAM nAradAhaM viSokaH । SuSrUze te vacanaM brahmavAdinna te tfpyAmyamftasyeva pAnAt ॥139॥

text: amoghadarśinmama cetprasādaṃ sutāghadagdhasya vibho prakuryāḥ । mṛtasya sañjīvanamadya me syāttava prasādātsutasaṅgamaśca ॥140॥
html:
amoghadarśinmama cetprasādaṃ sutāghadagdhasya vibho prakuryāḥ ।
mṛtasya sañjīvanamadya me syāttava prasādātsutasaṅgamaśca ॥140॥
slp1: amoGadarSinmama cetprasAdaM sutAGadagDasya viBo prakuryAH । mftasya saYjIvanamadya me syAttava prasAdAtsutasaNgamaSca ॥140॥

text: yaste putro dayito'yaṃ viyātaḥ svarṇaṣṭhīvī yamadātparvataste । punaste taṃ putramahaṃ dadāmi hiraṇyanābhaṃ varṣasahasriṇaṃ ca] ॥141॥

yaste putro dayito'yaṃ viyātaḥ svarṇaṣṭhīvī yamadātparvataste ।
punaste taṃ putramahaṃ dadāmi hiraṇyanābhaṃ varṣasahasriṇaṃ ca] ॥141॥

author: nārada uvāca ।

text: sa kathaṃ kāñcanaṣṭhīvī sṛñjayasya suto'bhavat । parvatena kimarthaṃ ca dattaḥ kena mamāra ca ॥1॥
html:
sa kathaṃ kāñcanaṣṭhīvī sṛñjayasya suto'bhavat ।
parvatena kimarthaṃ ca dattaḥ kena mamāra ca ॥1॥
slp1: sa kaTaM kAYcanazWIvI sfYjayasya suto'Bavat । parvatena kimarTaM ca dattaH kena mamAra ca ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: yadā varṣasahasrāyustadā bhavati mānavaḥ । kathamaprāptakaumāraḥ sṛñjayasya suto mṛtaḥ ॥2॥
html:
yadā varṣasahasrāyustadā bhavati mānavaḥ ।
kathamaprāptakaumāraḥ sṛñjayasya suto mṛtaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: yadA varzasahasrAyustadA Bavati mAnavaH । kaTamaprAptakOmAraH sfYjayasya suto mftaH ॥2॥

text: utāho nāmamātraṃ vai suvarṇaṣṭhīvino'bhavat । tathyaṃ vā kāñcanaṣṭhīvītyetadicchāmi veditum ॥3॥
html:
utāho nāmamātraṃ vai suvarṇaṣṭhīvino'bhavat ।
tathyaṃ vā kāñcanaṣṭhīvītyetadicchāmi veditum ॥3॥
slp1: utAho nAmamAtraM vE suvarRazWIvino'Bavat । taTyaM vA kAYcanazWIvItyetadicCAmi veditum ॥3॥

text: atra te kathayiṣyāmi yathā vṛttaṃ janeśvara । nāradaḥ parvataścaiva prāgṛṣī lokapūjitau ॥4॥
html:
atra te kathayiṣyāmi yathā vṛttaṃ janeśvara ।
nāradaḥ parvataścaiva prāgṛṣī lokapūjitau ॥4॥
slp1: atra te kaTayizyAmi yaTA vfttaM janeSvara । nAradaH parvataScEva prAgfzI lokapUjitO ॥4॥
author: vāsudeva uvāca ।

text: mātulo bhāgineyaśca devalokādihāgatau । vihartukāmau samprītyā mānuṣyeṣu purā prabhū ॥5॥
html:
mātulo bhāgineyaśca devalokādihāgatau ।
vihartukāmau samprītyā mānuṣyeṣu purā prabhū ॥5॥
slp1: mAtulo BAgineyaSca devalokAdihAgatO । vihartukAmO samprItyA mAnuzyezu purA praBU ॥5॥

text: haviḥpavitrabhojyena devabhojyena caiva ha । nārado mātulaścaiva bhāgineyaśca parvataḥ ॥6॥
html:
haviḥpavitrabhojyena devabhojyena caiva ha ।
nārado mātulaścaiva bhāgineyaśca parvataḥ ॥6॥
slp1: haviHpavitraBojyena devaBojyena cEva ha । nArado mAtulaScEva BAgineyaSca parvataH ॥6॥

text: tāvubhau tapasopetāvavanītalacāriṇau । bhuñjānau mānuṣānbhogānyathāvatparyadhāvatām ॥7॥
html:
tāvubhau tapasopetāvavanītalacāriṇau ।
bhuñjānau mānuṣānbhogānyathāvatparyadhāvatām ॥7॥
slp1: tAvuBO tapasopetAvavanItalacAriRO । BuYjAnO mAnuzAnBogAnyaTAvatparyaDAvatAm ॥7॥

text: prītimantau mudā yuktau samayaṃ tatra cakratuḥ । yo bhaveddhṛdi saṅkalpaḥ śubho vā yadi vāśubhaḥ । anyonyasya sa ākhyeyo mṛṣā śāpo'nyathā bhavet ॥8॥
html:
prītimantau mudā yuktau samayaṃ tatra cakratuḥ ।
yo bhaveddhṛdi saṅkalpaḥ śubho vā yadi vāśubhaḥ ।
anyonyasya sa ākhyeyo mṛṣā śāpo'nyathā bhavet ॥8॥
slp1: prItimantO mudA yuktO samayaM tatra cakratuH । yo BavedDfdi saNkalpaH SuBo vA yadi vASuBaH । anyonyasya sa AKyeyo mfzA SApo'nyaTA Bavet ॥8॥

text: tau tatheti pratijñāya maharṣī lokapūjitau । sṛñjayaṃ śvaityamabhyetya rājānamidamūcatuḥ ॥9॥
html:
tau tatheti pratijñāya maharṣī lokapūjitau ।
sṛñjayaṃ śvaityamabhyetya rājānamidamūcatuḥ ॥9॥
slp1: tO taTeti pratijYAya maharzI lokapUjitO । sfYjayaM SvEtyamaByetya rAjAnamidamUcatuH ॥9॥

text: āvāṃ bhavati vatsyāvaḥ kañcitkālaṃ hitāya te । yathāvatpṛthivīpāla āvayoḥ praguṇībhava । tatheti kṛtvā tau rājā satkṛtyopacacāra ha ॥10॥
html:
āvāṃ bhavati vatsyāvaḥ kañcitkālaṃ hitāya te ।
yathāvatpṛthivīpāla āvayoḥ praguṇībhava ।
tatheti kṛtvā tau rājā satkṛtyopacacāra ha ॥10॥
slp1: AvAM Bavati vatsyAvaH kaYcitkAlaM hitAya te । yaTAvatpfTivIpAla AvayoH praguRIBava । taTeti kftvA tO rAjA satkftyopacacAra ha ॥10॥

text: tataḥ kadācittau rājā mahātmānau tathāgatau । abravītparamaprītaḥ suteyaṃ varavarṇinī ॥11॥
html:
tataḥ kadācittau rājā mahātmānau tathāgatau ।
abravītparamaprītaḥ suteyaṃ varavarṇinī ॥11॥
slp1: tataH kadAcittO rAjA mahAtmAnO taTAgatO । abravItparamaprItaH suteyaM varavarRinI ॥11॥

text: ekaiva mama kanyaiṣā yuvāṃ paricariṣyati । darśanīyānavadyāṅgī śīlavṛttasamanvitā । sukumārī kumārī ca padmakiñjalkasannibhā ॥12॥
html:
ekaiva mama kanyaiṣā yuvāṃ paricariṣyati ।
darśanīyānavadyāṅgī śīlavṛttasamanvitā ।
sukumārī kumārī ca padmakiñjalkasannibhā ॥12॥
slp1: ekEva mama kanyEzA yuvAM paricarizyati । darSanIyAnavadyANgI SIlavfttasamanvitA । sukumArI kumArI ca padmakiYjalkasanniBA ॥12॥

text: paramaṃ saumya ityuktastābhyāṃ rājā śaśāsa tām । kanye viprāvupacara devavatpitṛvacca ha ॥13॥
html:
paramaṃ saumya ityuktastābhyāṃ rājā śaśāsa tām ।
kanye viprāvupacara devavatpitṛvacca ha ॥13॥
slp1: paramaM sOmya ityuktastAByAM rAjA SaSAsa tAm । kanye viprAvupacara devavatpitfvacca ha ॥13॥

text: sā tu kanyā tathetyuktvā pitaraṃ dharmacāriṇī । yathānideśaṃ rājñastau satkṛtyopacacāra ha ॥14॥
html:
sā tu kanyā tathetyuktvā pitaraṃ dharmacāriṇī ।
yathānideśaṃ rājñastau satkṛtyopacacāra ha ॥14॥
slp1: sA tu kanyA taTetyuktvA pitaraM DarmacAriRI । yaTAnideSaM rAjYastO satkftyopacacAra ha ॥14॥

text: tasyāstathopacāreṇa rūpeṇāpratimena ca । nāradaṃ hṛcchayastūrṇaṃ sahasaivānvapadyata ॥15॥
html:
tasyāstathopacāreṇa rūpeṇāpratimena ca ।
nāradaṃ hṛcchayastūrṇaṃ sahasaivānvapadyata ॥15॥
slp1: tasyAstaTopacAreRa rUpeRApratimena ca । nAradaM hfcCayastUrRaM sahasEvAnvapadyata ॥15॥

text: vavṛdhe ca tatastasya hṛdi kāmo mahātmanaḥ । yathā śuklasya pakṣasya pravṛttāvuḍurāṭchanaiḥ ॥16॥
html:
vavṛdhe ca tatastasya hṛdi kāmo mahātmanaḥ ।
yathā śuklasya pakṣasya pravṛttāvuḍurāṭchanaiḥ ॥16॥
slp1: vavfDe ca tatastasya hfdi kAmo mahAtmanaH । yaTA Suklasya pakzasya pravfttAvuqurAwCanEH ॥16॥

text: na ca taṃ bhāgineyāya parvatāya mahātmane । śaśaṃsa manmathaṃ tīvraṃ vrīḍamānaḥ sa dharmavit ॥17॥
html:
na ca taṃ bhāgineyāya parvatāya mahātmane ।
śaśaṃsa manmathaṃ tīvraṃ vrīḍamānaḥ sa dharmavit ॥17॥
slp1: na ca taM BAgineyAya parvatAya mahAtmane । SaSaMsa manmaTaM tIvraM vrIqamAnaH sa Darmavit ॥17॥

text: tapasā ceṅgitenātha parvato'tha bubodha tat । kāmārtaṃ nāradaṃ kruddhaḥ śaśāpainaṃ tato bhṛśam ॥18॥
html:
tapasā ceṅgitenātha parvato'tha bubodha tat ।
kāmārtaṃ nāradaṃ kruddhaḥ śaśāpainaṃ tato bhṛśam ॥18॥
slp1: tapasA ceNgitenATa parvato'Ta buboDa tat । kAmArtaM nAradaM krudDaH SaSApEnaM tato BfSam ॥18॥

text: kṛtvā samayamavyagro bhavānvai sahito mayā । yo bhaveddhṛdi saṅkalpaḥ śubho vā yadi vāśubhaḥ ॥19॥
html:
kṛtvā samayamavyagro bhavānvai sahito mayā ।
yo bhaveddhṛdi saṅkalpaḥ śubho vā yadi vāśubhaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: kftvA samayamavyagro BavAnvE sahito mayA । yo BavedDfdi saNkalpaH SuBo vA yadi vASuBaH ॥19॥

text: anyonyasya sa ākhyeya iti tadvai mṛṣā kṛtam । bhavatā vacanaṃ brahmaṃstasmādetadvadāmyaham ॥20॥
html:
anyonyasya sa ākhyeya iti tadvai mṛṣā kṛtam ।
bhavatā vacanaṃ brahmaṃstasmādetadvadāmyaham ॥20॥
slp1: anyonyasya sa AKyeya iti tadvE mfzA kftam । BavatA vacanaM brahmaMstasmAdetadvadAmyaham ॥20॥

text: na hi kāmaṃ pravartantaṃ bhavānācaṣṭa me purā । sukumāryāṃ kumāryāṃ te tasmādeṣa śapāmyaham ॥21॥
html:
na hi kāmaṃ pravartantaṃ bhavānācaṣṭa me purā ।
sukumāryāṃ kumāryāṃ te tasmādeṣa śapāmyaham ॥21॥
slp1: na hi kAmaM pravartantaM BavAnAcazwa me purA । sukumAryAM kumAryAM te tasmAdeza SapAmyaham ॥21॥

text: brahmavādī gururyasmāttapasvī brāhmaṇaśca san । akārṣīḥ samayabhraṃśamāvābhyāṃ yaḥ kṛto mithaḥ ॥22॥
html:
brahmavādī gururyasmāttapasvī brāhmaṇaśca san ।
akārṣīḥ samayabhraṃśamāvābhyāṃ yaḥ kṛto mithaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: brahmavAdI gururyasmAttapasvI brAhmaRaSca san । akArzIH samayaBraMSamAvAByAM yaH kfto miTaH ॥22॥

text: śapsye tasmātsusaṅkruddho bhavantaṃ taṃ nibodha me । sukumārī ca te bhāryā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ॥23॥
html:
śapsye tasmātsusaṅkruddho bhavantaṃ taṃ nibodha me ।
sukumārī ca te bhāryā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: Sapsye tasmAtsusaNkrudDo BavantaM taM niboDa me । sukumArI ca te BAryA Bavizyati na saMSayaH ॥23॥

text: vānaraṃ caiva kanyā tvāṃ vivāhātprabhṛti prabho । sandrakṣyanti narāścānye svarūpeṇa vinākṛtam ॥24॥
html:
vānaraṃ caiva kanyā tvāṃ vivāhātprabhṛti prabho ।
sandrakṣyanti narāścānye svarūpeṇa vinākṛtam ॥24॥
slp1: vAnaraM cEva kanyA tvAM vivAhAtpraBfti praBo । sandrakzyanti narAScAnye svarUpeRa vinAkftam ॥24॥

text: sa tadvākyaṃ tu vijñāya nāradaḥ parvatāttadā । aśapattamapi krodhādbhāgineyaṃ sa mātulaḥ ॥25॥
html:
sa tadvākyaṃ tu vijñāya nāradaḥ parvatāttadā ।
aśapattamapi krodhādbhāgineyaṃ sa mātulaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: sa tadvAkyaM tu vijYAya nAradaH parvatAttadA । aSapattamapi kroDAdBAgineyaM sa mAtulaH ॥25॥

text: tapasā brahmacaryeṇa satyena ca damena ca । yukto'pi dharmanityaśca na svargavāsamāpsyasi ॥26॥
html:
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa satyena ca damena ca ।
yukto'pi dharmanityaśca na svargavāsamāpsyasi ॥26॥
slp1: tapasA brahmacaryeRa satyena ca damena ca । yukto'pi DarmanityaSca na svargavAsamApsyasi ॥26॥

text: tau tu śaptvā bhṛśaṃ kruddhau parasparamamarṣaṇau । pratijagmaturanyonyaṃ kruddhāviva gajottamau ॥27॥
html:
tau tu śaptvā bhṛśaṃ kruddhau parasparamamarṣaṇau ।
pratijagmaturanyonyaṃ kruddhāviva gajottamau ॥27॥
slp1: tO tu SaptvA BfSaM krudDO parasparamamarzaRO । pratijagmaturanyonyaM krudDAviva gajottamO ॥27॥

text: parvataḥ pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ vicacāra mahāmuniḥ । pūjyamāno yathānyāyaṃ tejasā svena bhārata ॥28॥
html:
parvataḥ pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ vicacāra mahāmuniḥ ।
pūjyamāno yathānyāyaṃ tejasā svena bhārata ॥28॥
slp1: parvataH pfTivIM kftsnAM vicacAra mahAmuniH । pUjyamAno yaTAnyAyaM tejasA svena BArata ॥28॥

text: atha tāmalabhatkanyāṃ nāradaḥ sṛñjayātmajām । dharmeṇa dharmapravaraḥ sukumārīmaninditām ॥29॥
html:
atha tāmalabhatkanyāṃ nāradaḥ sṛñjayātmajām ।
dharmeṇa dharmapravaraḥ sukumārīmaninditām ॥29॥
slp1: aTa tAmalaBatkanyAM nAradaH sfYjayAtmajAm । DarmeRa DarmapravaraH sukumArImaninditAm ॥29॥

text: sā tu kanyā yathāśāpaṃ nāradaṃ taṃ dadarśa ha । pāṇigrahaṇamantrāṇāṃ prayogādeva vānaram ॥30॥
html:
sā tu kanyā yathāśāpaṃ nāradaṃ taṃ dadarśa ha ।
pāṇigrahaṇamantrāṇāṃ prayogādeva vānaram ॥30॥
slp1: sA tu kanyA yaTASApaM nAradaM taM dadarSa ha । pARigrahaRamantrARAM prayogAdeva vAnaram ॥30॥

text: sukumārī ca devarṣiṃ vānarapratimānanam । naivāvamanyata tadā prītimatyeva cābhavat ॥31॥
html:
sukumārī ca devarṣiṃ vānarapratimānanam ।
naivāvamanyata tadā prītimatyeva cābhavat ॥31॥
slp1: sukumArI ca devarziM vAnarapratimAnanam । nEvAvamanyata tadA prItimatyeva cABavat ॥31॥

text: upatasthe ca bhartāraṃ na cānyaṃ manasāpyagāt । devaṃ muniṃ vā yakṣaṃ vā patitve pativatsalā ॥32॥
html:
upatasthe ca bhartāraṃ na cānyaṃ manasāpyagāt ।
devaṃ muniṃ vā yakṣaṃ vā patitve pativatsalā ॥32॥
slp1: upatasTe ca BartAraM na cAnyaM manasApyagAt । devaM muniM vA yakzaM vA patitve pativatsalA ॥32॥

text: tataḥ kadācidbhagavānparvato'nusasāra ha । vanaṃ virahitaṃ kiñcittatrāpaśyatsa nāradam ॥33॥
html:
tataḥ kadācidbhagavānparvato'nusasāra ha ।
vanaṃ virahitaṃ kiñcittatrāpaśyatsa nāradam ॥33॥
slp1: tataH kadAcidBagavAnparvato'nusasAra ha । vanaM virahitaM kiYcittatrApaSyatsa nAradam ॥33॥

text: tato'bhivādya provāca nāradaṃ parvatastadā । bhavānprasādaṃ kurutāṃ svargādeśāya me prabho ॥34॥
html:
tato'bhivādya provāca nāradaṃ parvatastadā ।
bhavānprasādaṃ kurutāṃ svargādeśāya me prabho ॥34॥
slp1: tato'BivAdya provAca nAradaM parvatastadA । BavAnprasAdaM kurutAM svargAdeSAya me praBo ॥34॥

text: tamuvāca tato dṛṣṭvā parvataṃ nāradastadā । kṛtāñjalimupāsīnaṃ dīnaṃ dīnataraḥ svayam ॥35॥
html:
tamuvāca tato dṛṣṭvā parvataṃ nāradastadā ।
kṛtāñjalimupāsīnaṃ dīnaṃ dīnataraḥ svayam ॥35॥
slp1: tamuvAca tato dfzwvA parvataM nAradastadA । kftAYjalimupAsInaM dInaM dInataraH svayam ॥35॥

text: tvayāhaṃ prathamaṃ śapto vānarastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi । ityuktena mayā paścācchaptastvamapi matsarāt । adyaprabhṛti vai vāsaṃ svarge nāvāpsyasīti ha ॥36॥
html:
tvayāhaṃ prathamaṃ śapto vānarastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ।
ityuktena mayā paścācchaptastvamapi matsarāt ।
adyaprabhṛti vai vāsaṃ svarge nāvāpsyasīti ha ॥36॥
slp1: tvayAhaM praTamaM Sapto vAnarastvaM Bavizyasi । ityuktena mayA paScAcCaptastvamapi matsarAt । adyapraBfti vE vAsaM svarge nAvApsyasIti ha ॥36॥

text: tava naitaddhi sadṛśaṃ putrasthāne hi me bhavān । nivartayetāṃ tau śāpamanyo'nyena tadā munī ॥37॥
html:
tava naitaddhi sadṛśaṃ putrasthāne hi me bhavān ।
nivartayetāṃ tau śāpamanyo'nyena tadā munī ॥37॥
slp1: tava nEtadDi sadfSaM putrasTAne hi me BavAn । nivartayetAM tO SApamanyo'nyena tadA munI ॥37॥

text: śrīsamṛddhaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā nāradaṃ devarūpiṇam । sukumārī pradudrāva parapatyabhiśaṅkayā ॥38॥
html:
śrīsamṛddhaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā nāradaṃ devarūpiṇam ।
sukumārī pradudrāva parapatyabhiśaṅkayā ॥38॥
slp1: SrIsamfdDaM tadA dfzwvA nAradaM devarUpiRam । sukumArI pradudrAva parapatyaBiSaNkayA ॥38॥

text: tāṃ parvatastato dṛṣṭvā pradravantīmaninditām । abravīttava bhartaiṣa nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ॥39॥
html:
tāṃ parvatastato dṛṣṭvā pradravantīmaninditām ।
abravīttava bhartaiṣa nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ॥39॥
slp1: tAM parvatastato dfzwvA pradravantImaninditAm । abravIttava BartEza nAtra kAryA vicAraRA ॥39॥

text: ṛṣiḥ paramadharmātmā nārado bhagavānprabhuḥ । tavaivābhedyahṛdayo mā te bhūdatra saṃśayaḥ ॥40॥
html:
ṛṣiḥ paramadharmātmā nārado bhagavānprabhuḥ ।
tavaivābhedyahṛdayo mā te bhūdatra saṃśayaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: fziH paramaDarmAtmA nArado BagavAnpraBuH । tavEvABedyahfdayo mA te BUdatra saMSayaH ॥40॥

text: sānunītā bahuvidhaṃ parvatena mahātmanā । śāpadoṣaṃ ca taṃ bhartuḥ śrutvā svāṃ prakṛtiṃ gatā । parvato'tha yayau svargaṃ nārado'tha yayau gṛhān ॥41॥
html:
sānunītā bahuvidhaṃ parvatena mahātmanā ।
śāpadoṣaṃ ca taṃ bhartuḥ śrutvā svāṃ prakṛtiṃ gatā ।
parvato'tha yayau svargaṃ nārado'tha yayau gṛhān ॥41॥
slp1: sAnunItA bahuviDaM parvatena mahAtmanA । SApadozaM ca taM BartuH SrutvA svAM prakftiM gatA । parvato'Ta yayO svargaM nArado'Ta yayO gfhAn ॥41॥

text: pratyakṣakarmā sarvasya nārado'yaṃ mahānṛṣiḥ । eṣa vakṣyati vai pṛṣṭo yathā vṛttaṃ narottama] ॥42॥
html:
pratyakṣakarmā sarvasya nārado'yaṃ mahānṛṣiḥ ।
eṣa vakṣyati vai pṛṣṭo yathā vṛttaṃ narottama] ॥42॥
slp1: pratyakzakarmA sarvasya nArado'yaM mahAnfziH । eza vakzyati vE pfzwo yaTA vfttaM narottama] ॥42॥

text: tato rājā pāṇḍusuto nāradaṃ pratyabhāṣata । bhagavañśrotumicchāmi suvarṇaṣṭhīvisambhavam ॥1॥
html:
tato rājā pāṇḍusuto nāradaṃ pratyabhāṣata ।
bhagavañśrotumicchāmi suvarṇaṣṭhīvisambhavam ॥1॥
slp1: tato rAjA pARqusuto nAradaM pratyaBAzata । BagavaYSrotumicCAmi suvarRazWIvisamBavam ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: evamuktaḥ sa ca munirdharmarājena nāradaḥ । ācacakṣe yathā vṛttaṃ suvarṇaṣṭhīvinaṃ prati ॥2॥
html:
evamuktaḥ sa ca munirdharmarājena nāradaḥ ।
ācacakṣe yathā vṛttaṃ suvarṇaṣṭhīvinaṃ prati ॥2॥
slp1: evamuktaH sa ca munirDarmarAjena nAradaH । Acacakze yaTA vfttaM suvarRazWIvinaM prati ॥2॥

text: evametanmahārāja yathāyaṃ keśavo'bravīt । kāryasyāsya tu yaccheṣaṃ tatte vakṣyāmi pṛcchataḥ ॥3॥
html:
evametanmahārāja yathāyaṃ keśavo'bravīt ।
kāryasyāsya tu yaccheṣaṃ tatte vakṣyāmi pṛcchataḥ ॥3॥
slp1: evametanmahArAja yaTAyaM keSavo'bravIt । kAryasyAsya tu yacCezaM tatte vakzyAmi pfcCataH ॥3॥

text: ahaṃ ca parvataścaiva svasrīyo me mahāmuniḥ । vastukāmāvabhigatau sṛñjayaṃ jayatāṃ varam ॥4॥
html:
ahaṃ ca parvataścaiva svasrīyo me mahāmuniḥ ।
vastukāmāvabhigatau sṛñjayaṃ jayatāṃ varam ॥4॥
slp1: ahaM ca parvataScEva svasrIyo me mahAmuniH । vastukAmAvaBigatO sfYjayaM jayatAM varam ॥4॥

text: tatra sampūjitau tena vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā । sarvakāmaiḥ suvihitau nivasāvo'sya veśmani ॥5॥
html:
tatra sampūjitau tena vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ।
sarvakāmaiḥ suvihitau nivasāvo'sya veśmani ॥5॥
slp1: tatra sampUjitO tena viDidfzwena karmaRA । sarvakAmEH suvihitO nivasAvo'sya veSmani ॥5॥

text: vyatikrāntāsu varṣāsu samaye gamanasya ca । parvato māmuvācedaṃ kāle vacanamarthavat ॥6॥
html:
vyatikrāntāsu varṣāsu samaye gamanasya ca ।
parvato māmuvācedaṃ kāle vacanamarthavat ॥6॥
slp1: vyatikrAntAsu varzAsu samaye gamanasya ca । parvato mAmuvAcedaM kAle vacanamarTavat ॥6॥

text: āvāmasya narendrasya gṛhe paramapūjitau । uṣitau samaye brahmaṃścintyatāmatra sāmpratam ॥7॥
html:
āvāmasya narendrasya gṛhe paramapūjitau ।
uṣitau samaye brahmaṃścintyatāmatra sāmpratam ॥7॥
slp1: AvAmasya narendrasya gfhe paramapUjitO । uzitO samaye brahmaMScintyatAmatra sAmpratam ॥7॥

text: tato'hamabruvaṃ rājanparvataṃ śubhadarśanam । sarvametattvayi vibho bhāgineyopapadyate ॥8॥
html:
tato'hamabruvaṃ rājanparvataṃ śubhadarśanam ।
sarvametattvayi vibho bhāgineyopapadyate ॥8॥
slp1: tato'hamabruvaM rAjanparvataM SuBadarSanam । sarvametattvayi viBo BAgineyopapadyate ॥8॥

text: vareṇa chandyatāṃ rājā labhatāṃ yadyadicchati । āvayostapasā siddhiṃ prāpnotu yadi manyase ॥9॥
html:
vareṇa chandyatāṃ rājā labhatāṃ yadyadicchati ।
āvayostapasā siddhiṃ prāpnotu yadi manyase ॥9॥
slp1: vareRa CandyatAM rAjA laBatAM yadyadicCati । AvayostapasA sidDiM prApnotu yadi manyase ॥9॥

text: tata āhūya rājānaṃ sṛñjayaṃ śubhadarśanam । parvato'numataṃ vākyamuvāca munipuṅgavaḥ ॥10॥
html:
tata āhūya rājānaṃ sṛñjayaṃ śubhadarśanam ।
parvato'numataṃ vākyamuvāca munipuṅgavaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: tata AhUya rAjAnaM sfYjayaM SuBadarSanam । parvato'numataM vAkyamuvAca munipuNgavaH ॥10॥

text: prītau svo nṛpa satkāraistava hyārjavasambhṛtaiḥ । āvābhyāmabhyanujñāto varaṃ nṛvara cintaya ॥11॥
html:
prītau svo nṛpa satkāraistava hyārjavasambhṛtaiḥ ।
āvābhyāmabhyanujñāto varaṃ nṛvara cintaya ॥11॥
slp1: prItO svo nfpa satkArEstava hyArjavasamBftEH । AvAByAmaByanujYAto varaM nfvara cintaya ॥11॥

text: devānāmavihiṃsāyāṃ yadbhavenmānuṣakṣamam । tadgṛhāṇa mahārāja pūjārho nau mato bhavān ॥12॥
html:
devānāmavihiṃsāyāṃ yadbhavenmānuṣakṣamam ।
tadgṛhāṇa mahārāja pūjārho nau mato bhavān ॥12॥
slp1: devAnAmavihiMsAyAM yadBavenmAnuzakzamam । tadgfhARa mahArAja pUjArho nO mato BavAn ॥12॥

text: prītau bhavantau yadi me kṛtametāvatā mama । eṣa eva paro lābho nirvṛtto me mahāphalaḥ ॥13॥
html:
prītau bhavantau yadi me kṛtametāvatā mama ।
eṣa eva paro lābho nirvṛtto me mahāphalaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: prItO BavantO yadi me kftametAvatA mama । eza eva paro lABo nirvftto me mahAPalaH ॥13॥
author: sṛñjaya uvāca ।

text: tamevaṃvādinaṃ bhūyaḥ parvataḥ pratyabhāṣata । vṛṇīṣva rājansaṅkalpo yaste hṛdi ciraṃ sthitaḥ ॥14॥
html:
tamevaṃvādinaṃ bhūyaḥ parvataḥ pratyabhāṣata ।
vṛṇīṣva rājansaṅkalpo yaste hṛdi ciraṃ sthitaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: tamevaMvAdinaM BUyaH parvataH pratyaBAzata । vfRIzva rAjansaNkalpo yaste hfdi ciraM sTitaH ॥14॥
author: nārada uvāca ।

text: abhīpsāmi sutaṃ vīraṃ vīryavantaṃ dṛḍhavratam । āyuṣmantaṃ mahābhāgaṃ devarājasamadyutim ॥15॥
html:
abhīpsāmi sutaṃ vīraṃ vīryavantaṃ dṛḍhavratam ।
āyuṣmantaṃ mahābhāgaṃ devarājasamadyutim ॥15॥
slp1: aBIpsAmi sutaM vIraM vIryavantaM dfQavratam । AyuzmantaM mahABAgaM devarAjasamadyutim ॥15॥
author: sṛñjaya uvāca ।

text: bhaviṣyatyeṣa te kāmo na tvāyuṣmānbhaviṣyati । devarājābhibhūtyarthaṃ saṅkalpo hyeṣa te hṛdi ॥16॥
html:
bhaviṣyatyeṣa te kāmo na tvāyuṣmānbhaviṣyati ।
devarājābhibhūtyarthaṃ saṅkalpo hyeṣa te hṛdi ॥16॥
slp1: Bavizyatyeza te kAmo na tvAyuzmAnBavizyati । devarAjABiBUtyarTaM saNkalpo hyeza te hfdi ॥16॥
author: parvata uvāca ।

text: suvarṇaṣṭhīvanāccaiva svarṇaṣṭhīvī bhaviṣyati । rakṣyaśca devarājātsa devarājasamadyutiḥ ॥17॥
html:
suvarṇaṣṭhīvanāccaiva svarṇaṣṭhīvī bhaviṣyati ।
rakṣyaśca devarājātsa devarājasamadyutiḥ ॥17॥
slp1: suvarRazWIvanAccEva svarRazWIvI Bavizyati । rakzyaSca devarAjAtsa devarAjasamadyutiH ॥17॥

text: tacchrutvā sṛñjayo vākyaṃ parvatasya mahātmanaḥ । prasādayāmāsa tadā naitadevaṃ bhavediti ॥18॥
html:
tacchrutvā sṛñjayo vākyaṃ parvatasya mahātmanaḥ ।
prasādayāmāsa tadā naitadevaṃ bhavediti ॥18॥
slp1: tacCrutvA sfYjayo vAkyaM parvatasya mahAtmanaH । prasAdayAmAsa tadA nEtadevaM Bavediti ॥18॥
author: nārada uvāca ।

text: āyuṣmānme bhavetputro bhavatastapasā mune । na ca taṃ parvataḥ kiñciduvācendravyapekṣayā ॥19॥
html:
āyuṣmānme bhavetputro bhavatastapasā mune ।
na ca taṃ parvataḥ kiñciduvācendravyapekṣayā ॥19॥
slp1: AyuzmAnme Bavetputro BavatastapasA mune । na ca taM parvataH kiYciduvAcendravyapekzayA ॥19॥

text: tamahaṃ nṛpatiṃ dīnamabruvaṃ punareva tu । smartavyo'haṃ mahārāja darśayiṣyāmi te smṛtaḥ ॥20॥
html:
tamahaṃ nṛpatiṃ dīnamabruvaṃ punareva tu ।
smartavyo'haṃ mahārāja darśayiṣyāmi te smṛtaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: tamahaM nfpatiM dInamabruvaM punareva tu । smartavyo'haM mahArAja darSayizyAmi te smftaH ॥20॥

text: ahaṃ te dayitaṃ putraṃ pretarājavaśaṃ gatam । punardāsyāmi tadrūpaṃ mā śucaḥ pṛthivīpate ॥21॥
html:
ahaṃ te dayitaṃ putraṃ pretarājavaśaṃ gatam ।
punardāsyāmi tadrūpaṃ mā śucaḥ pṛthivīpate ॥21॥
slp1: ahaM te dayitaM putraM pretarAjavaSaM gatam । punardAsyAmi tadrUpaM mA SucaH pfTivIpate ॥21॥

text: evamuktvā tu nṛpatiṃ prayātau svo yathepsitam । sṛñjayaśca yathākāmaṃ praviveśa svamandiram ॥22॥
html:
evamuktvā tu nṛpatiṃ prayātau svo yathepsitam ।
sṛñjayaśca yathākāmaṃ praviveśa svamandiram ॥22॥
slp1: evamuktvA tu nfpatiM prayAtO svo yaTepsitam । sfYjayaSca yaTAkAmaM praviveSa svamandiram ॥22॥

text: sṛñjayasyātha rājarṣeḥ kasmiṃścitkālaparyaye । jajñe putro mahāvīryastejasā prajvalanniva ॥23॥
html:
sṛñjayasyātha rājarṣeḥ kasmiṃścitkālaparyaye ।
jajñe putro mahāvīryastejasā prajvalanniva ॥23॥
slp1: sfYjayasyATa rAjarzeH kasmiMScitkAlaparyaye । jajYe putro mahAvIryastejasA prajvalanniva ॥23॥

text: vavṛdhe sa yathākālaṃ sarasīva mahotpalam । babhūva kāñcanaṣṭhīvī yathārthaṃ nāma tasya tat ॥24॥
html:
vavṛdhe sa yathākālaṃ sarasīva mahotpalam ।
babhūva kāñcanaṣṭhīvī yathārthaṃ nāma tasya tat ॥24॥
slp1: vavfDe sa yaTAkAlaM sarasIva mahotpalam । baBUva kAYcanazWIvI yaTArTaM nAma tasya tat ॥24॥

text: tadadbhutatamaṃ loke paprathe kurusattama । bubudhe tacca devendro varadānaṃ mahātmanoḥ ॥25॥
html:
tadadbhutatamaṃ loke paprathe kurusattama ।
bubudhe tacca devendro varadānaṃ mahātmanoḥ ॥25॥
slp1: tadadButatamaM loke papraTe kurusattama । bubuDe tacca devendro varadAnaM mahAtmanoH ॥25॥

text: tatastvabhibhavādbhīto bṛhaspatimate sthitaḥ । kumārasyāntaraprekṣī babhūva balavṛtrahā ॥26॥
html:
tatastvabhibhavādbhīto bṛhaspatimate sthitaḥ ।
kumārasyāntaraprekṣī babhūva balavṛtrahā ॥26॥
slp1: tatastvaBiBavAdBIto bfhaspatimate sTitaH । kumArasyAntaraprekzI baBUva balavftrahA ॥26॥

text: codayāmāsa vajraṃ sa divyāstraṃ mūrtisaṃsthitam । vyāghro bhūtvā jahīmaṃ tvaṃ rājaputramiti prabho ॥27॥
html:
codayāmāsa vajraṃ sa divyāstraṃ mūrtisaṃsthitam ।
vyāghro bhūtvā jahīmaṃ tvaṃ rājaputramiti prabho ॥27॥
slp1: codayAmAsa vajraM sa divyAstraM mUrtisaMsTitam । vyAGro BUtvA jahImaM tvaM rAjaputramiti praBo ॥27॥

text: vivṛddhaḥ kila vīryeṇa māmeṣo'bhibhaviṣyati । sṛñjayasya suto vajra yathainaṃ parvato dadau ॥28॥
html:
vivṛddhaḥ kila vīryeṇa māmeṣo'bhibhaviṣyati ।
sṛñjayasya suto vajra yathainaṃ parvato dadau ॥28॥
slp1: vivfdDaH kila vIryeRa mAmezo'BiBavizyati । sfYjayasya suto vajra yaTEnaM parvato dadO ॥28॥

text: evamuktastu śakreṇa vajraḥ parapurañjayaḥ । kumārasyāntaraprekṣī nityamevānvapadyata ॥29॥
html:
evamuktastu śakreṇa vajraḥ parapurañjayaḥ ।
kumārasyāntaraprekṣī nityamevānvapadyata ॥29॥
slp1: evamuktastu SakreRa vajraH parapuraYjayaH । kumArasyAntaraprekzI nityamevAnvapadyata ॥29॥

text: sṛñjayo'pi sutaṃ prāpya devarājasamadyutim । hṛṣṭaḥ sāntaḥpuro rājā vananityo'bhavattadā ॥30॥
html:
sṛñjayo'pi sutaṃ prāpya devarājasamadyutim ।
hṛṣṭaḥ sāntaḥpuro rājā vananityo'bhavattadā ॥30॥
slp1: sfYjayo'pi sutaM prApya devarAjasamadyutim । hfzwaH sAntaHpuro rAjA vananityo'BavattadA ॥30॥

text: tato bhāgīrathītīre kadācidvananirjhare । dhātrīdvitīyo bālaḥ sa krīḍārthaṃ paryadhāvata ॥31॥
html:
tato bhāgīrathītīre kadācidvananirjhare ।
dhātrīdvitīyo bālaḥ sa krīḍārthaṃ paryadhāvata ॥31॥
slp1: tato BAgIraTItIre kadAcidvananirJare । DAtrIdvitIyo bAlaH sa krIqArTaM paryaDAvata ॥31॥

text: pañcavarṣakadeśīyo bālo nāgendravikramaḥ । sahasotpatitaṃ vyāghramāsasāda mahābalaḥ ॥32॥
html:
pañcavarṣakadeśīyo bālo nāgendravikramaḥ ।
sahasotpatitaṃ vyāghramāsasāda mahābalaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: paYcavarzakadeSIyo bAlo nAgendravikramaH । sahasotpatitaM vyAGramAsasAda mahAbalaH ॥32॥

text: tena caiva viniṣpiṣṭo vepamāno nṛpātmajaḥ । vyasuḥ papāta medinyāṃ tato dhātrī vicukruśe ॥33॥
html:
tena caiva viniṣpiṣṭo vepamāno nṛpātmajaḥ ।
vyasuḥ papāta medinyāṃ tato dhātrī vicukruśe ॥33॥
slp1: tena cEva vinizpizwo vepamAno nfpAtmajaH । vyasuH papAta medinyAM tato DAtrI vicukruSe ॥33॥

text: hatvā tu rājaputraṃ sa tatraivāntaradhīyata । śārdūlo devarājasya māyayāntarhitastadā ॥34॥
html:
hatvā tu rājaputraṃ sa tatraivāntaradhīyata ।
śārdūlo devarājasya māyayāntarhitastadā ॥34॥
slp1: hatvA tu rAjaputraM sa tatrEvAntaraDIyata । SArdUlo devarAjasya mAyayAntarhitastadA ॥34॥

text: dhātryāstu ninadaṃ śrutvā rudatyāḥ paramārtavat । abhyadhāvata taṃ deśaṃ svayameva mahīpatiḥ ॥35॥
html:
dhātryāstu ninadaṃ śrutvā rudatyāḥ paramārtavat ।
abhyadhāvata taṃ deśaṃ svayameva mahīpatiḥ ॥35॥
slp1: DAtryAstu ninadaM SrutvA rudatyAH paramArtavat । aByaDAvata taM deSaM svayameva mahIpatiH ॥35॥

text: sa dadarśa gatāsuṃ taṃ śayānaṃ pītaśoṇitam । kumāraṃ vigatānandaṃ niśākaramiva cyutam ॥36॥
html:
sa dadarśa gatāsuṃ taṃ śayānaṃ pītaśoṇitam ।
kumāraṃ vigatānandaṃ niśākaramiva cyutam ॥36॥
slp1: sa dadarSa gatAsuM taM SayAnaM pItaSoRitam । kumAraM vigatAnandaM niSAkaramiva cyutam ॥36॥

text: sa tamutsaṅgamāropya paripīḍitavakṣasam । putraṃ rudhirasaṃsiktaṃ paryadevayadāturaḥ ॥37॥
html:
sa tamutsaṅgamāropya paripīḍitavakṣasam ।
putraṃ rudhirasaṃsiktaṃ paryadevayadāturaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: sa tamutsaNgamAropya paripIqitavakzasam । putraM ruDirasaMsiktaM paryadevayadAturaH ॥37॥

text: tatastā mātarastasya rudantyaḥ śokakarśitāḥ । abhyadhāvanta taṃ deśaṃ yatra rājā sa sṛñjayaḥ ॥38॥
html:
tatastā mātarastasya rudantyaḥ śokakarśitāḥ ।
abhyadhāvanta taṃ deśaṃ yatra rājā sa sṛñjayaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: tatastA mAtarastasya rudantyaH SokakarSitAH । aByaDAvanta taM deSaM yatra rAjA sa sfYjayaH ॥38॥

text: tataḥ sa rājā sasmāra māmantargatamānasaḥ । taccāhaṃ cintitaṃ jñātvā gatavāṃstasya darśanam ॥39॥
html:
tataḥ sa rājā sasmāra māmantargatamānasaḥ ।
taccāhaṃ cintitaṃ jñātvā gatavāṃstasya darśanam ॥39॥
slp1: tataH sa rAjA sasmAra mAmantargatamAnasaH । taccAhaM cintitaM jYAtvA gatavAMstasya darSanam ॥39॥

text: sa mayaitāni vākyāni śrāvitaḥ śokalālasaḥ । yāni te yaduvīreṇa kathitāni mahīpate ॥40॥
html:
sa mayaitāni vākyāni śrāvitaḥ śokalālasaḥ ।
yāni te yaduvīreṇa kathitāni mahīpate ॥40॥
slp1: sa mayEtAni vAkyAni SrAvitaH SokalAlasaH । yAni te yaduvIreRa kaTitAni mahIpate ॥40॥

text: sañjīvitaścāpi mayā vāsavānumate tadā । bhavitavyaṃ tathā tacca na tacchakyamato'nyathā ॥41॥
html:
sañjīvitaścāpi mayā vāsavānumate tadā ।
bhavitavyaṃ tathā tacca na tacchakyamato'nyathā ॥41॥
slp1: saYjIvitaScApi mayA vAsavAnumate tadA । BavitavyaM taTA tacca na tacCakyamato'nyaTA ॥41॥

text: ata ūrdhvaṃ kumāraḥ sa svarṇaṣṭhīvī mahāyaśāḥ । cittaṃ prasādayāmāsa piturmātuśca vīryavān ॥42॥
html:
ata ūrdhvaṃ kumāraḥ sa svarṇaṣṭhīvī mahāyaśāḥ ।
cittaṃ prasādayāmāsa piturmātuśca vīryavān ॥42॥
slp1: ata UrDvaM kumAraH sa svarRazWIvI mahAyaSAH । cittaM prasAdayAmAsa piturmAtuSca vIryavAn ॥42॥

text: kārayāmāsa rājyaṃ sa pitari svargate vibhuḥ । varṣāṇāmekaśatavatsahasraṃ bhīmavikramaḥ ॥43॥
html:
kārayāmāsa rājyaṃ sa pitari svargate vibhuḥ ।
varṣāṇāmekaśatavatsahasraṃ bhīmavikramaḥ ॥43॥
slp1: kArayAmAsa rAjyaM sa pitari svargate viBuH । varzARAmekaSatavatsahasraM BImavikramaH ॥43॥

text: tata iṣṭvā mahāyajñairbahubhirbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ । tarpayāmāsa devāṃśca pitṝṃścaiva mahādyutiḥ ॥44॥
html:
tata iṣṭvā mahāyajñairbahubhirbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ ।
tarpayāmāsa devāṃśca pitṝṃścaiva mahādyutiḥ ॥44॥
slp1: tata izwvA mahAyajYErbahuBirBUridakziREH । tarpayAmAsa devAMSca pitFMScEva mahAdyutiH ॥44॥

text: utpādya ca bahūnputrānkulasantānakāriṇaḥ । kālena mahatā rājankāladharmamupeyivān ॥45॥
html:
utpādya ca bahūnputrānkulasantānakāriṇaḥ ।
kālena mahatā rājankāladharmamupeyivān ॥45॥
slp1: utpAdya ca bahUnputrAnkulasantAnakAriRaH । kAlena mahatA rAjankAlaDarmamupeyivAn ॥45॥

text: sa tvaṃ rājendra sañjātaṃ śokametannivartaya । yathā tvāṃ keśavaḥ prāha vyāsaśca sumahātapāḥ ॥46॥
html:
sa tvaṃ rājendra sañjātaṃ śokametannivartaya ।
yathā tvāṃ keśavaḥ prāha vyāsaśca sumahātapāḥ ॥46॥
slp1: sa tvaM rAjendra saYjAtaM Sokametannivartaya । yaTA tvAM keSavaH prAha vyAsaSca sumahAtapAH ॥46॥

text: pitṛpaitāmahaṃ rājyamāsthāya duramudvaha । iṣṭvā puṇyairmahāyajñairiṣṭāṁllokānavāpsyasi] ॥47॥
html:
pitṛpaitāmahaṃ rājyamāsthāya duramudvaha ।
iṣṭvā puṇyairmahāyajñairiṣṭāṁllokānavāpsyasi] ॥47॥
slp1: pitfpEtAmahaM rAjyamAsTAya duramudvaha । izwvA puRyErmahAyajYErizwAṁllokAnavApsyasi] ॥47॥

text: tūṣṇīṃbhūtaṃ tu rājānaṃ śocamānaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram । tapasvī dharmatattvajñaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano'bravīt ॥1॥
html:
tūṣṇīṃbhūtaṃ tu rājānaṃ śocamānaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram ।
tapasvī dharmatattvajñaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano'bravīt ॥1॥
slp1: tUzRIMBUtaM tu rAjAnaM SocamAnaM yuDizWiram । tapasvI DarmatattvajYaH kfzRadvEpAyano'bravIt ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: prajānāṃ pālanaṃ dharmo rājñāṃ rājīvalocana । dharmaḥ pramāṇaṃ lokasya nityaṃ dharmānuvartanam ॥2॥
html:
prajānāṃ pālanaṃ dharmo rājñāṃ rājīvalocana ।
dharmaḥ pramāṇaṃ lokasya nityaṃ dharmānuvartanam ॥2॥
slp1: prajAnAM pAlanaM Darmo rAjYAM rAjIvalocana । DarmaH pramARaM lokasya nityaM DarmAnuvartanam ॥2॥

text: anutiṣṭhasva vai rājanpitṛpaitāmahaṃ padam । brāhmaṇeṣu ca yo dharmaḥ sa nityo vedaniścitaḥ ॥3॥
html:
anutiṣṭhasva vai rājanpitṛpaitāmahaṃ padam ।
brāhmaṇeṣu ca yo dharmaḥ sa nityo vedaniścitaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: anutizWasva vE rAjanpitfpEtAmahaM padam । brAhmaRezu ca yo DarmaH sa nityo vedaniScitaH ॥3॥

text: tatpramāṇaṃ pramāṇānāṃ śāśvataṃ bharatarṣabha । tasya dharmasya kṛtsnasya kṣatriyaḥ parirakṣitā ॥4॥
html:
tatpramāṇaṃ pramāṇānāṃ śāśvataṃ bharatarṣabha ।
tasya dharmasya kṛtsnasya kṣatriyaḥ parirakṣitā ॥4॥
slp1: tatpramARaM pramARAnAM SASvataM BaratarzaBa । tasya Darmasya kftsnasya kzatriyaH parirakzitA ॥4॥

text: tathā yaḥ pratihantyasya śāsanaṃ viṣaye naraḥ । sa bāhubhyāṃ vinigrāhyo lokayātrāvighātakaḥ ॥5॥
html:
tathā yaḥ pratihantyasya śāsanaṃ viṣaye naraḥ ।
sa bāhubhyāṃ vinigrāhyo lokayātrāvighātakaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: taTA yaH pratihantyasya SAsanaM vizaye naraH । sa bAhuByAM vinigrAhyo lokayAtrAviGAtakaH ॥5॥

text: pramāṇamapramāṇaṃ yaḥ kuryānmohavaśaṃ gataḥ । bhṛtyo vā yadi vā putrastapasvī vāpi kaścana । pāpānsarvairupāyaistānniyacchedghātayeta vā ॥6॥
html:
pramāṇamapramāṇaṃ yaḥ kuryānmohavaśaṃ gataḥ ।
bhṛtyo vā yadi vā putrastapasvī vāpi kaścana ।
pāpānsarvairupāyaistānniyacchedghātayeta vā ॥6॥
slp1: pramARamapramARaM yaH kuryAnmohavaSaM gataH । Bftyo vA yadi vA putrastapasvI vApi kaScana । pApAnsarvErupAyEstAnniyacCedGAtayeta vA ॥6॥

text: ato'nyathā vartamāno rājā prāpnoti kilbiṣam । dharmaṃ vinaśyamānaṃ hi yo na rakṣetsa dharmahā ॥7॥
html:
ato'nyathā vartamāno rājā prāpnoti kilbiṣam ।
dharmaṃ vinaśyamānaṃ hi yo na rakṣetsa dharmahā ॥7॥
slp1: ato'nyaTA vartamAno rAjA prApnoti kilbizam । DarmaM vinaSyamAnaM hi yo na rakzetsa DarmahA ॥7॥

text: te tvayā dharmahantāro nihatāḥ sapadānugāḥ । svadharme vartamānastvaṃ kiṃ nu śocasi pāṇḍava । rājā hi hanyāddadyācca prajā rakṣecca dharmataḥ ॥8॥
html:
te tvayā dharmahantāro nihatāḥ sapadānugāḥ ।
svadharme vartamānastvaṃ kiṃ nu śocasi pāṇḍava ।
rājā hi hanyāddadyācca prajā rakṣecca dharmataḥ ॥8॥
slp1: te tvayA DarmahantAro nihatAH sapadAnugAH । svaDarme vartamAnastvaM kiM nu Socasi pARqava । rAjA hi hanyAddadyAcca prajA rakzecca DarmataH ॥8॥

text: na te'bhiśaṅke vacanaṃ yadbravīṣi tapodhana । aparokṣo hi te dharmaḥ sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara ॥9॥
html:
na te'bhiśaṅke vacanaṃ yadbravīṣi tapodhana ।
aparokṣo hi te dharmaḥ sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara ॥9॥
slp1: na te'BiSaNke vacanaM yadbravIzi tapoDana । aparokzo hi te DarmaH sarvaDarmaBftAM vara ॥9॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: mayā hyavadhyā bahavo ghātitā rājyakāraṇāt । tānyakāryāṇi me brahmandahanti ca tapanti ca ॥10॥
html:
mayā hyavadhyā bahavo ghātitā rājyakāraṇāt ।
tānyakāryāṇi me brahmandahanti ca tapanti ca ॥10॥
slp1: mayA hyavaDyA bahavo GAtitA rAjyakAraRAt । tAnyakAryARi me brahmandahanti ca tapanti ca ॥10॥

text: īśvaro vā bhavetkartā puruṣo vāpi bhārata । haṭho vā vartate loke karmajaṃ vā phalaṃ smṛtam ॥11॥
html:
īśvaro vā bhavetkartā puruṣo vāpi bhārata ।
haṭho vā vartate loke karmajaṃ vā phalaṃ smṛtam ॥11॥
slp1: ISvaro vA BavetkartA puruzo vApi BArata । haWo vA vartate loke karmajaM vA PalaM smftam ॥11॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: īśvareṇa niyuktā hi sādhvasādhu ca pārthiva । kurvanti puruṣāḥ karma phalamīśvaragāmi tat ॥12॥
html:
īśvareṇa niyuktā hi sādhvasādhu ca pārthiva ।
kurvanti puruṣāḥ karma phalamīśvaragāmi tat ॥12॥
slp1: ISvareRa niyuktA hi sADvasADu ca pArTiva । kurvanti puruzAH karma PalamISvaragAmi tat ॥12॥

text: yathā hi puruṣaśchindyādvṛkṣaṃ paraśunā vane । chettureva bhavetpāpaṃ paraśorna kathañcana ॥13॥
html:
yathā hi puruṣaśchindyādvṛkṣaṃ paraśunā vane ।
chettureva bhavetpāpaṃ paraśorna kathañcana ॥13॥
slp1: yaTA hi puruzaSCindyAdvfkzaM paraSunA vane । Cettureva BavetpApaM paraSorna kaTaYcana ॥13॥

text: atha vā tadupādānātprāpnuyuḥ karmaṇaḥ phalam । daṇḍaśastrakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ puruṣe tanna vidyate ॥14॥
html:
atha vā tadupādānātprāpnuyuḥ karmaṇaḥ phalam ।
daṇḍaśastrakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ puruṣe tanna vidyate ॥14॥
slp1: aTa vA tadupAdAnAtprApnuyuH karmaRaH Palam । daRqaSastrakftaM pApaM puruze tanna vidyate ॥14॥

text: na caitadiṣṭaṃ kaunteya yadanyena phalaṃ kṛtam । prāpnuyāditi tasmācca īśvare tanniveśaya ॥15॥
html:
na caitadiṣṭaṃ kaunteya yadanyena phalaṃ kṛtam ।
prāpnuyāditi tasmācca īśvare tanniveśaya ॥15॥
slp1: na cEtadizwaM kOnteya yadanyena PalaM kftam । prApnuyAditi tasmAcca ISvare tanniveSaya ॥15॥

text: atha vā puruṣaḥ kartā karmaṇoḥ śubhapāpayoḥ । na paraṃ vidyate tasmādevamanyacchubhaṃ kuru ॥16॥
html:
atha vā puruṣaḥ kartā karmaṇoḥ śubhapāpayoḥ ।
na paraṃ vidyate tasmādevamanyacchubhaṃ kuru ॥16॥
slp1: aTa vA puruzaH kartA karmaRoH SuBapApayoH । na paraM vidyate tasmAdevamanyacCuBaM kuru ॥16॥

text: na hi kaścitkvacidrājandiṣṭātpratinivartate । daṇḍaśastrakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ puruṣe tanna vidyate ॥17॥
html:
na hi kaścitkvacidrājandiṣṭātpratinivartate ।
daṇḍaśastrakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ puruṣe tanna vidyate ॥17॥
slp1: na hi kaScitkvacidrAjandizwAtpratinivartate । daRqaSastrakftaM pApaM puruze tanna vidyate ॥17॥

text: yadi vā manyase rājanhaṭhe lokaṃ pratiṣṭhitam । evamapyaśubhaṃ karma na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ॥18॥
html:
yadi vā manyase rājanhaṭhe lokaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ।
evamapyaśubhaṃ karma na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ॥18॥
slp1: yadi vA manyase rAjanhaWe lokaM pratizWitam । evamapyaSuBaM karma na BUtaM na Bavizyati ॥18॥

text: athābhipattirlokasya kartavyā śubhapāpayoḥ । abhipannatamaṃ loke rājñāmudyatadaṇḍanam ॥19॥
html:
athābhipattirlokasya kartavyā śubhapāpayoḥ ।
abhipannatamaṃ loke rājñāmudyatadaṇḍanam ॥19॥
slp1: aTABipattirlokasya kartavyA SuBapApayoH । aBipannatamaM loke rAjYAmudyatadaRqanam ॥19॥

text: athāpi loke karmāṇi samāvartanta bhārata । śubhāśubhaphalaṃ ceme prāpnuvantīti me matiḥ ॥20॥
html:
athāpi loke karmāṇi samāvartanta bhārata ।
śubhāśubhaphalaṃ ceme prāpnuvantīti me matiḥ ॥20॥
slp1: aTApi loke karmARi samAvartanta BArata । SuBASuBaPalaM ceme prApnuvantIti me matiH ॥20॥

text: evaṃ satyaṃ śubhādeśaṃ karmaṇastatphalaṃ dhruvam । tyaja tadrājaśārdūla maivaṃ śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ ॥21॥
html:
evaṃ satyaṃ śubhādeśaṃ karmaṇastatphalaṃ dhruvam ।
tyaja tadrājaśārdūla maivaṃ śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ ॥21॥
slp1: evaM satyaM SuBAdeSaM karmaRastatPalaM Druvam । tyaja tadrAjaSArdUla mEvaM Soke manaH kfTAH ॥21॥

text: svadharme vartamānasya sāpavāde'pi bhārata । evamātmaparityāgastava rājanna śobhanaḥ ॥22॥
html:
svadharme vartamānasya sāpavāde'pi bhārata ।
evamātmaparityāgastava rājanna śobhanaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: svaDarme vartamAnasya sApavAde'pi BArata । evamAtmaparityAgastava rAjanna SoBanaH ॥22॥

text: vihitānīha kaunteya prāyaścittāni karmiṇām । śarīravāṃstāni kuryādaśarīraḥ parābhavet ॥23॥
html:
vihitānīha kaunteya prāyaścittāni karmiṇām ।
śarīravāṃstāni kuryādaśarīraḥ parābhavet ॥23॥
slp1: vihitAnIha kOnteya prAyaScittAni karmiRAm । SarIravAMstAni kuryAdaSarIraH parABavet ॥23॥

text: tadrājañjīvamānastvaṃ prāyaścittaṃ cariṣyasi । prāyaścittamakṛtvā tu pretya taptāsi bhārata] ॥24॥
html:
tadrājañjīvamānastvaṃ prāyaścittaṃ cariṣyasi ।
prāyaścittamakṛtvā tu pretya taptāsi bhārata] ॥24॥
slp1: tadrAjaYjIvamAnastvaM prAyaScittaM carizyasi । prAyaScittamakftvA tu pretya taptAsi BArata] ॥24॥

text: hatāḥ putrāśca pautrāśca bhrātaraḥ pitarastathā । śvaśurā guravaścaiva mātulāḥ sapitāmahāḥ ॥1॥
html:
hatāḥ putrāśca pautrāśca bhrātaraḥ pitarastathā ।
śvaśurā guravaścaiva mātulāḥ sapitāmahāḥ ॥1॥
slp1: hatAH putrASca pOtrASca BrAtaraH pitarastaTA । SvaSurA guravaScEva mAtulAH sapitAmahAH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kṣatriyāśca mahātmānaḥ sambandhisuhṛdastathā । vayasyā jñātayaścaiva bhrātaraśca pitāmaha ॥2॥
html:
kṣatriyāśca mahātmānaḥ sambandhisuhṛdastathā ।
vayasyā jñātayaścaiva bhrātaraśca pitāmaha ॥2॥
slp1: kzatriyASca mahAtmAnaH sambanDisuhfdastaTA । vayasyA jYAtayaScEva BrAtaraSca pitAmaha ॥2॥

text: bahavaśca manuṣyendrā nānādeśasamāgatāḥ । ghātitā rājyalubdhena mayaikena pitāmaha ॥3॥
html:
bahavaśca manuṣyendrā nānādeśasamāgatāḥ ।
ghātitā rājyalubdhena mayaikena pitāmaha ॥3॥
slp1: bahavaSca manuzyendrA nAnAdeSasamAgatAH । GAtitA rAjyalubDena mayEkena pitAmaha ॥3॥

text: tāṃstādṛśānahaṃ hatvā dharmanityānmahīkṣitaḥ । asakṛtsomapānvīrānkiṃ prāpsyāmi tapodhana ॥4॥
html:
tāṃstādṛśānahaṃ hatvā dharmanityānmahīkṣitaḥ ।
asakṛtsomapānvīrānkiṃ prāpsyāmi tapodhana ॥4॥
slp1: tAMstAdfSAnahaM hatvA DarmanityAnmahIkzitaH । asakftsomapAnvIrAnkiM prApsyAmi tapoDana ॥4॥

text: dahyāmyaniśamadyāhaṃ cintayānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ । hīnāṃ pārthivasiṃhaistaiḥ śrīmadbhiḥ pṛthivīmimām ॥5॥
html:
dahyāmyaniśamadyāhaṃ cintayānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
hīnāṃ pārthivasiṃhaistaiḥ śrīmadbhiḥ pṛthivīmimām ॥5॥
slp1: dahyAmyaniSamadyAhaM cintayAnaH punaH punaH । hInAM pArTivasiMhEstEH SrImadBiH pfTivImimAm ॥5॥

text: dṛṣṭvā jñātivadhaṃ ghoraṃ hatāṃśca śataśaḥ parān । koṭiśaśca narānanyānparitapye pitāmaha ॥6॥
html:
dṛṣṭvā jñātivadhaṃ ghoraṃ hatāṃśca śataśaḥ parān ।
koṭiśaśca narānanyānparitapye pitāmaha ॥6॥
slp1: dfzwvA jYAtivaDaM GoraM hatAMSca SataSaH parAn । kowiSaSca narAnanyAnparitapye pitAmaha ॥6॥

text: kā nu tāsāṃ varastrīṇāmavasthādya bhaviṣyati । vihīnānāṃ svatanayaiḥ patibhirbhrātṛbhistathā ॥7॥
html:
kā nu tāsāṃ varastrīṇāmavasthādya bhaviṣyati ।
vihīnānāṃ svatanayaiḥ patibhirbhrātṛbhistathā ॥7॥
slp1: kA nu tAsAM varastrIRAmavasTAdya Bavizyati । vihInAnAM svatanayEH patiBirBrAtfBistaTA ॥7॥

text: asmānantakarānghorānpāṇḍavānvṛṣṇisaṃhitān । ākrośantyaḥ kṛśā dīnā nipatantyaśca bhūtale ॥8॥
html:
asmānantakarānghorānpāṇḍavānvṛṣṇisaṃhitān ।
ākrośantyaḥ kṛśā dīnā nipatantyaśca bhūtale ॥8॥
slp1: asmAnantakarAnGorAnpARqavAnvfzRisaMhitAn । AkroSantyaH kfSA dInA nipatantyaSca BUtale ॥8॥

text: apaśyantyaḥ pitṝnbhrātṝnpatīnputrāṃśca yoṣitaḥ । tyaktvā prāṇānpriyānsarvā gamiṣyanti yamakṣayam ॥9॥
html:
apaśyantyaḥ pitṝnbhrātṝnpatīnputrāṃśca yoṣitaḥ ।
tyaktvā prāṇānpriyānsarvā gamiṣyanti yamakṣayam ॥9॥
slp1: apaSyantyaH pitFnBrAtFnpatInputrAMSca yozitaH । tyaktvA prARAnpriyAnsarvA gamizyanti yamakzayam ॥9॥

text: vatsalatvāddvijaśreṣṭha tatra me nāsti saṃśayaḥ । vyaktaṃ saukṣmyācca dharmasya prāpsyāmaḥ strīvadhaṃ vayam ॥10॥
html:
vatsalatvāddvijaśreṣṭha tatra me nāsti saṃśayaḥ ।
vyaktaṃ saukṣmyācca dharmasya prāpsyāmaḥ strīvadhaṃ vayam ॥10॥
slp1: vatsalatvAddvijaSrezWa tatra me nAsti saMSayaH । vyaktaM sOkzmyAcca Darmasya prApsyAmaH strIvaDaM vayam ॥10॥

text: te vayaṃ suhṛdo hatvā kṛtvā pāpamanantakam । narake nipatiṣyāmo hyadhaḥśirasa eva ca ॥11॥
html:
te vayaṃ suhṛdo hatvā kṛtvā pāpamanantakam ।
narake nipatiṣyāmo hyadhaḥśirasa eva ca ॥11॥
slp1: te vayaM suhfdo hatvA kftvA pApamanantakam । narake nipatizyAmo hyaDaHSirasa eva ca ॥11॥

text: śarīrāṇi vimokṣyāmastapasogreṇa sattama । āśramāṃśca viśeṣāṃstvaṃ mamācakṣva pitāmaha] ॥12॥
html:
śarīrāṇi vimokṣyāmastapasogreṇa sattama ।
āśramāṃśca viśeṣāṃstvaṃ mamācakṣva pitāmaha] ॥12॥
slp1: SarIrARi vimokzyAmastapasogreRa sattama । ASramAMSca viSezAMstvaM mamAcakzva pitAmaha] ॥12॥

text: yudhiṣṭhirasya tadvākyaṃ śrutvā dvaipāyanastadā । samīkṣya nipuṇaṃ buddhyā ṛṣiḥ provāca pāṇḍavam ॥1॥
html:
yudhiṣṭhirasya tadvākyaṃ śrutvā dvaipāyanastadā ।
samīkṣya nipuṇaṃ buddhyā ṛṣiḥ provāca pāṇḍavam ॥1॥
slp1: yuDizWirasya tadvAkyaM SrutvA dvEpAyanastadA । samIkzya nipuRaM budDyA fziH provAca pARqavam ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: mā viṣādaṃ kṛthā rājankṣatradharmamanusmara । svadharmeṇa hatā hyete kṣatriyāḥ kṣatriyarṣabha ॥2॥
html:
mā viṣādaṃ kṛthā rājankṣatradharmamanusmara ।
svadharmeṇa hatā hyete kṣatriyāḥ kṣatriyarṣabha ॥2॥
slp1: mA vizAdaM kfTA rAjankzatraDarmamanusmara । svaDarmeRa hatA hyete kzatriyAH kzatriyarzaBa ॥2॥

text: kāṅkṣamāṇāḥ śriyaṃ kṛtsnāṃ pṛthivyāṃ ca mahadyaśaḥ । kṛtāntavidhisaṃyuktāḥ kālena nidhanaṃ gatāḥ ॥3॥
html:
kāṅkṣamāṇāḥ śriyaṃ kṛtsnāṃ pṛthivyāṃ ca mahadyaśaḥ ।
kṛtāntavidhisaṃyuktāḥ kālena nidhanaṃ gatāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: kANkzamARAH SriyaM kftsnAM pfTivyAM ca mahadyaSaH । kftAntaviDisaMyuktAH kAlena niDanaM gatAH ॥3॥

text: na tvaṃ hantā na bhīmo'pi nārjuno na yamāvapi । kālaḥ paryāyadharmeṇa prāṇānādatta dehinām ॥4॥
html:
na tvaṃ hantā na bhīmo'pi nārjuno na yamāvapi ।
kālaḥ paryāyadharmeṇa prāṇānādatta dehinām ॥4॥
slp1: na tvaM hantA na BImo'pi nArjuno na yamAvapi । kAlaH paryAyaDarmeRa prARAnAdatta dehinAm ॥4॥

text: na yasya mātāpitarau nānugrāhyo'sti kaścana । karmasākṣī prajānāṃ yastena kālena saṃhṛtāḥ ॥5॥
html:
na yasya mātāpitarau nānugrāhyo'sti kaścana ।
karmasākṣī prajānāṃ yastena kālena saṃhṛtāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: na yasya mAtApitarO nAnugrAhyo'sti kaScana । karmasAkzI prajAnAM yastena kAlena saMhftAH ॥5॥

text: hetumātramidaṃ tasya kālasya puruṣarṣabha । yaddhanti bhūtairbhūtāni tadasmai rūpamaiśvaram ॥6॥
html:
hetumātramidaṃ tasya kālasya puruṣarṣabha ।
yaddhanti bhūtairbhūtāni tadasmai rūpamaiśvaram ॥6॥
slp1: hetumAtramidaM tasya kAlasya puruzarzaBa । yadDanti BUtErBUtAni tadasmE rUpamESvaram ॥6॥

text: karmamūrtyātmakaṃ viddhi sākṣiṇaṃ śubhapāpayoḥ । sukhaduḥkhaguṇodarkaṃ kālaṃ kālaphalapradam ॥7॥
html:
karmamūrtyātmakaṃ viddhi sākṣiṇaṃ śubhapāpayoḥ ।
sukhaduḥkhaguṇodarkaṃ kālaṃ kālaphalapradam ॥7॥
slp1: karmamUrtyAtmakaM vidDi sAkziRaM SuBapApayoH । suKaduHKaguRodarkaM kAlaM kAlaPalapradam ॥7॥

text: teṣāmapi mahābāho karmāṇi paricintaya । vināśahetukāritve yaiste kālavaśaṃ gatāḥ ॥8॥
html:
teṣāmapi mahābāho karmāṇi paricintaya ।
vināśahetukāritve yaiste kālavaśaṃ gatāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tezAmapi mahAbAho karmARi paricintaya । vinASahetukAritve yEste kAlavaSaM gatAH ॥8॥

text: ātmanaśca vijānīhi niyamavrataśīlatām । yadā tvamīdṛśaṃ karma vidhinākramya kāritaḥ ॥9॥
html:
ātmanaśca vijānīhi niyamavrataśīlatām ।
yadā tvamīdṛśaṃ karma vidhinākramya kāritaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: AtmanaSca vijAnIhi niyamavrataSIlatAm । yadA tvamIdfSaM karma viDinAkramya kAritaH ॥9॥

text: tvaṣṭreva vihitaṃ yantraṃ yathā sthāpayiturvaśe । karmaṇā kālayuktena tathedaṃ bhrāmyate jagat ॥10॥
html:
tvaṣṭreva vihitaṃ yantraṃ yathā sthāpayiturvaśe ।
karmaṇā kālayuktena tathedaṃ bhrāmyate jagat ॥10॥
slp1: tvazwreva vihitaM yantraM yaTA sTApayiturvaSe । karmaRA kAlayuktena taTedaM BrAmyate jagat ॥10॥

text: puruṣasya hi dṛṣṭvemāmutpattimanimittataḥ । yadṛcchayā vināśaṃ ca śokaharṣāvanarthakau ॥11॥
html:
puruṣasya hi dṛṣṭvemāmutpattimanimittataḥ ।
yadṛcchayā vināśaṃ ca śokaharṣāvanarthakau ॥11॥
slp1: puruzasya hi dfzwvemAmutpattimanimittataH । yadfcCayA vinASaM ca SokaharzAvanarTakO ॥11॥

text: vyalīkaṃ cāpi yattvatra cittavaitaṃsikaṃ tava । tadarthamiṣyate rājanprāyaścittaṃ tadācara ॥12॥
html:
vyalīkaṃ cāpi yattvatra cittavaitaṃsikaṃ tava ।
tadarthamiṣyate rājanprāyaścittaṃ tadācara ॥12॥
slp1: vyalIkaM cApi yattvatra cittavEtaMsikaM tava । tadarTamizyate rAjanprAyaScittaM tadAcara ॥12॥

text: idaṃ ca śrūyate pārtha yuddhe devāsure purā । asurā bhrātaro jyeṣṭhā devāścāpi yavīyasaḥ ॥13॥
html:
idaṃ ca śrūyate pārtha yuddhe devāsure purā ।
asurā bhrātaro jyeṣṭhā devāścāpi yavīyasaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: idaM ca SrUyate pArTa yudDe devAsure purA । asurA BrAtaro jyezWA devAScApi yavIyasaH ॥13॥

text: teṣāmapi śrīnimittaṃ mahānāsītsamucchrayaḥ । yuddhaṃ varṣasahasrāṇi dvātriṃśadabhavatkila ॥14॥
html:
teṣāmapi śrīnimittaṃ mahānāsītsamucchrayaḥ ।
yuddhaṃ varṣasahasrāṇi dvātriṃśadabhavatkila ॥14॥
slp1: tezAmapi SrInimittaM mahAnAsItsamucCrayaH । yudDaM varzasahasrARi dvAtriMSadaBavatkila ॥14॥

text: ekārṇavāṃ mahīṃ kṛtvā rudhireṇa pariplutām । jaghnurdaityāṃstadā devāstridivaṃ caiva lebhire ॥15॥
html:
ekārṇavāṃ mahīṃ kṛtvā rudhireṇa pariplutām ।
jaghnurdaityāṃstadā devāstridivaṃ caiva lebhire ॥15॥
slp1: ekArRavAM mahIM kftvA ruDireRa pariplutAm । jaGnurdEtyAMstadA devAstridivaM cEva leBire ॥15॥

text: tathaiva pṛthivīṃ labdhvā brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ । saṃśritā dānavānāṃ vai sāhyārthe darpamohitāḥ ॥16॥
html:
tathaiva pṛthivīṃ labdhvā brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ ।
saṃśritā dānavānāṃ vai sāhyārthe darpamohitāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: taTEva pfTivIM labDvA brAhmaRA vedapAragAH । saMSritA dAnavAnAM vE sAhyArTe darpamohitAH ॥16॥

text: śālāvṛkā iti khyātāstriṣu lokeṣu bhārata । aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi te cāpi vibudhairhatāḥ ॥17॥
html:
śālāvṛkā iti khyātāstriṣu lokeṣu bhārata ।
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi te cāpi vibudhairhatāḥ ॥17॥
slp1: SAlAvfkA iti KyAtAstrizu lokezu BArata । azwASItisahasrARi te cApi vibuDErhatAH ॥17॥

text: dharmavyucchittimicchanto ye'dharmasya pravartakāḥ । hantavyāste durātmāno devairdaityā ivolbaṇāḥ ॥18॥
html:
dharmavyucchittimicchanto ye'dharmasya pravartakāḥ ।
hantavyāste durātmāno devairdaityā ivolbaṇāḥ ॥18॥
slp1: DarmavyucCittimicCanto ye'Darmasya pravartakAH । hantavyAste durAtmAno devErdEtyA ivolbaRAH ॥18॥

text: ekaṃ hatvā yadi kule śiṣṭānāṃ syādanāmayam । kulaṃ hatvātha rāṣṭraṃ vā na tadvṛttopaghātakam ॥19॥
html:
ekaṃ hatvā yadi kule śiṣṭānāṃ syādanāmayam ।
kulaṃ hatvātha rāṣṭraṃ vā na tadvṛttopaghātakam ॥19॥
slp1: ekaM hatvA yadi kule SizwAnAM syAdanAmayam । kulaM hatvATa rAzwraM vA na tadvfttopaGAtakam ॥19॥

text: adharmarūpo dharmo hi kaścidasti narādhipa । dharmaścādharmarūpo'sti tacca jñeyaṃ vipaścitā ॥20॥
html:
adharmarūpo dharmo hi kaścidasti narādhipa ।
dharmaścādharmarūpo'sti tacca jñeyaṃ vipaścitā ॥20॥
slp1: aDarmarUpo Darmo hi kaScidasti narADipa । DarmaScADarmarUpo'sti tacca jYeyaM vipaScitA ॥20॥

text: tasmātsaṃstambhayātmānaṃ śrutavānasi pāṇḍava । devaiḥ pūrvagataṃ mārgamanuyāto'si bhārata ॥21॥
html:
tasmātsaṃstambhayātmānaṃ śrutavānasi pāṇḍava ।
devaiḥ pūrvagataṃ mārgamanuyāto'si bhārata ॥21॥
slp1: tasmAtsaMstamBayAtmAnaM SrutavAnasi pARqava । devEH pUrvagataM mArgamanuyAto'si BArata ॥21॥

text: na hīdṛśā gamiṣyanti narakaṃ pāṇḍavarṣabha । bhrātṝnāśvāsayaitāṃstvaṃ suhṛdaśca parantapa ॥22॥
html:
na hīdṛśā gamiṣyanti narakaṃ pāṇḍavarṣabha ।
bhrātṝnāśvāsayaitāṃstvaṃ suhṛdaśca parantapa ॥22॥
slp1: na hIdfSA gamizyanti narakaM pARqavarzaBa । BrAtFnASvAsayEtAMstvaM suhfdaSca parantapa ॥22॥

text: yo hi pāpasamārambhe kārye tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ । kurvannapi tathaiva syātkṛtvā ca nirapatrapaḥ ॥23॥
html:
yo hi pāpasamārambhe kārye tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ ।
kurvannapi tathaiva syātkṛtvā ca nirapatrapaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: yo hi pApasamAramBe kArye tadBAvaBAvitaH । kurvannapi taTEva syAtkftvA ca nirapatrapaH ॥23॥

text: tasmiṃstatkaluṣaṃ sarvaṃ samāptamiti śabditam । prāyaścittaṃ na tasyāsti hrāso vā pāpakarmaṇaḥ ॥24॥
html:
tasmiṃstatkaluṣaṃ sarvaṃ samāptamiti śabditam ।
prāyaścittaṃ na tasyāsti hrāso vā pāpakarmaṇaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: tasmiMstatkaluzaM sarvaM samAptamiti Sabditam । prAyaScittaM na tasyAsti hrAso vA pApakarmaRaH ॥24॥

text: tvaṃ tu śuklābhijātīyaḥ paradoṣeṇa kāritaḥ । anicchamānaḥ karmedaṃ kṛtvā ca paritapyase ॥25॥
html:
tvaṃ tu śuklābhijātīyaḥ paradoṣeṇa kāritaḥ ।
anicchamānaḥ karmedaṃ kṛtvā ca paritapyase ॥25॥
slp1: tvaM tu SuklABijAtIyaH paradozeRa kAritaH । anicCamAnaH karmedaM kftvA ca paritapyase ॥25॥

text: aśvamedho mahāyajñaḥ prāyaścittamudāhṛtam । tamāhara mahārāja vipāpmaivaṃ bhaviṣyasi ॥26॥
html:
aśvamedho mahāyajñaḥ prāyaścittamudāhṛtam ।
tamāhara mahārāja vipāpmaivaṃ bhaviṣyasi ॥26॥
slp1: aSvameDo mahAyajYaH prAyaScittamudAhftam । tamAhara mahArAja vipApmEvaM Bavizyasi ॥26॥

text: marudbhiḥ saha jitvārīnmaghavānpākaśāsanaḥ । ekaikaṃ kratumāhṛtya śatakṛtvaḥ śatakratuḥ ॥27॥
html:
marudbhiḥ saha jitvārīnmaghavānpākaśāsanaḥ ।
ekaikaṃ kratumāhṛtya śatakṛtvaḥ śatakratuḥ ॥27॥
slp1: marudBiH saha jitvArInmaGavAnpAkaSAsanaH । ekEkaM kratumAhftya SatakftvaH SatakratuH ॥27॥

text: pūtapāpmā jitasvargo lokānprāpya sukhodayān । marudgaṇavṛtaḥ śakraḥ śuśubhe bhāsayandiśaḥ ॥28॥
html:
pūtapāpmā jitasvargo lokānprāpya sukhodayān ।
marudgaṇavṛtaḥ śakraḥ śuśubhe bhāsayandiśaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: pUtapApmA jitasvargo lokAnprApya suKodayAn । marudgaRavftaH SakraH SuSuBe BAsayandiSaH ॥28॥

text: svargaloke mahīyantamapsarobhiḥ śacīpatim । ṛṣayaḥ paryupāsante devāśca vibudheśvaram ॥29॥
html:
svargaloke mahīyantamapsarobhiḥ śacīpatim ।
ṛṣayaḥ paryupāsante devāśca vibudheśvaram ॥29॥
slp1: svargaloke mahIyantamapsaroBiH SacIpatim । fzayaH paryupAsante devASca vibuDeSvaram ॥29॥

text: so'yaṃ tvamiha saṅkrānto vikrameṇa vasundharām । nirjitāśca mahīpālā vikrameṇa tvayānagha ॥30॥
html:
so'yaṃ tvamiha saṅkrānto vikrameṇa vasundharām ।
nirjitāśca mahīpālā vikrameṇa tvayānagha ॥30॥
slp1: so'yaM tvamiha saNkrAnto vikrameRa vasunDarAm । nirjitASca mahIpAlA vikrameRa tvayAnaGa ॥30॥

text: teṣāṃ purāṇi rāṣṭrāṇi gatvā rājansuhṛdvṛtaḥ । bhrātṝnputrāṃśca pautrāṃśca sve sve rājye'bhiṣecaya ॥31॥
html:
teṣāṃ purāṇi rāṣṭrāṇi gatvā rājansuhṛdvṛtaḥ ।
bhrātṝnputrāṃśca pautrāṃśca sve sve rājye'bhiṣecaya ॥31॥
slp1: tezAM purARi rAzwrARi gatvA rAjansuhfdvftaH । BrAtFnputrAMSca pOtrAMSca sve sve rAjye'Bizecaya ॥31॥

text: bālānapi ca garbhasthānsāntvāni samudācaran । rañjayanprakṛtīḥ sarvāḥ paripāhi vasundharām ॥32॥
html:
bālānapi ca garbhasthānsāntvāni samudācaran ।
rañjayanprakṛtīḥ sarvāḥ paripāhi vasundharām ॥32॥
slp1: bAlAnapi ca garBasTAnsAntvAni samudAcaran । raYjayanprakftIH sarvAH paripAhi vasunDarAm ॥32॥

text: kumāro nāsti yeṣāṃ ca kanyāstatrābhiṣecaya । kāmāśayo hi strīvargaḥ śokamevaṃ prahāsyati ॥33॥
html:
kumāro nāsti yeṣāṃ ca kanyāstatrābhiṣecaya ।
kāmāśayo hi strīvargaḥ śokamevaṃ prahāsyati ॥33॥
slp1: kumAro nAsti yezAM ca kanyAstatrABizecaya । kAmASayo hi strIvargaH SokamevaM prahAsyati ॥33॥

text: evamāśvāsanaṃ kṛtvā sarvarāṣṭreṣu bhārata । yajasva vājimedhena yathendro vijayī purā ॥34॥
html:
evamāśvāsanaṃ kṛtvā sarvarāṣṭreṣu bhārata ।
yajasva vājimedhena yathendro vijayī purā ॥34॥
slp1: evamASvAsanaM kftvA sarvarAzwrezu BArata । yajasva vAjimeDena yaTendro vijayI purA ॥34॥

text: aśocyāste mahātmānaḥ kṣatriyāḥ kṣatriyarṣabha । svakarmabhirgatā nāśaṃ kṛtāntabalamohitāḥ ॥35॥
html:
aśocyāste mahātmānaḥ kṣatriyāḥ kṣatriyarṣabha ।
svakarmabhirgatā nāśaṃ kṛtāntabalamohitāḥ ॥35॥
slp1: aSocyAste mahAtmAnaH kzatriyAH kzatriyarzaBa । svakarmaBirgatA nASaM kftAntabalamohitAH ॥35॥

text: avāptaḥ kṣatradharmaste rājyaṃ prāptamakalmaṣam । carasva dharmaṃ kaunteya śreyānyaḥ pretya bhāvikaḥ] ॥36॥
html:
avāptaḥ kṣatradharmaste rājyaṃ prāptamakalmaṣam ।
carasva dharmaṃ kaunteya śreyānyaḥ pretya bhāvikaḥ] ॥36॥
slp1: avAptaH kzatraDarmaste rAjyaM prAptamakalmazam । carasva DarmaM kOnteya SreyAnyaH pretya BAvikaH] ॥36॥

text: kāni kṛtveha karmāṇi prāyaścittīyate naraḥ । kiṃ kṛtvā caiva mucyeta tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
kāni kṛtveha karmāṇi prāyaścittīyate naraḥ ।
kiṃ kṛtvā caiva mucyeta tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: kAni kftveha karmARi prAyaScittIyate naraH । kiM kftvA cEva mucyeta tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: akurvanvihitaṃ karma pratiṣiddhāni cācaran । prāyaścittīyate hyevaṃ naro mithyā ca vartayan ॥2॥
html:
akurvanvihitaṃ karma pratiṣiddhāni cācaran ।
prāyaścittīyate hyevaṃ naro mithyā ca vartayan ॥2॥
slp1: akurvanvihitaM karma pratizidDAni cAcaran । prAyaScittIyate hyevaM naro miTyA ca vartayan ॥2॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: sūryeṇābhyudito yaśca brahmacārī bhavatyuta । tathā sūryābhinirmuktaḥ kunakhī śyāvadannapi ॥3॥
html:
sūryeṇābhyudito yaśca brahmacārī bhavatyuta ।
tathā sūryābhinirmuktaḥ kunakhī śyāvadannapi ॥3॥
slp1: sUryeRAByudito yaSca brahmacArI Bavatyuta । taTA sUryABinirmuktaH kunaKI SyAvadannapi ॥3॥

text: parivittiḥ parivettā brahmojjho yaśca kutsakaḥ । didhiṣūpatistathā yaḥ syādagredidhiṣureva ca ॥4॥
html:
parivittiḥ parivettā brahmojjho yaśca kutsakaḥ ।
didhiṣūpatistathā yaḥ syādagredidhiṣureva ca ॥4॥
slp1: parivittiH parivettA brahmojJo yaSca kutsakaH । diDizUpatistaTA yaH syAdagrediDizureva ca ॥4॥

text: avakīrṇī bhavedyaśca dvijātivadhakastathā । atīrthe brahmaṇastyāgī tīrthe cāpratipādakaḥ ॥5॥
html:
avakīrṇī bhavedyaśca dvijātivadhakastathā ।
atīrthe brahmaṇastyāgī tīrthe cāpratipādakaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: avakIrRI BavedyaSca dvijAtivaDakastaTA । atIrTe brahmaRastyAgI tIrTe cApratipAdakaH ॥5॥

text: grāmayājī ca kaunteya rājñaśca parivikrayī । śūdrastrīvadhako yaśca pūrvaḥ pūrvastu garhitaḥ ॥6॥
html:
grāmayājī ca kaunteya rājñaśca parivikrayī ।
śūdrastrīvadhako yaśca pūrvaḥ pūrvastu garhitaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: grAmayAjI ca kOnteya rAjYaSca parivikrayI । SUdrastrIvaDako yaSca pUrvaH pUrvastu garhitaH ॥6॥

text: vṛthāpaśusamālambhī vanadāhasya kārakaḥ । anṛtenopacartā ca pratiroddhā gurostathā ॥7॥
html:
vṛthāpaśusamālambhī vanadāhasya kārakaḥ ।
anṛtenopacartā ca pratiroddhā gurostathā ॥7॥
slp1: vfTApaSusamAlamBI vanadAhasya kArakaH । anftenopacartA ca pratirodDA gurostaTA ॥7॥

text: yaścāgnīnapavidhyeta tathaiva brahmavikrayī । etānyenāṃsi sarvāṇi vyutkrāntasamayaśca yaḥ ॥8॥
html:
yaścāgnīnapavidhyeta tathaiva brahmavikrayī ।
etānyenāṃsi sarvāṇi vyutkrāntasamayaśca yaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: yaScAgnInapaviDyeta taTEva brahmavikrayI । etAnyenAMsi sarvARi vyutkrAntasamayaSca yaH ॥8॥

text: akāryāṇyapi vakṣyāmi yāni tāni nibodha me । lokavedaviruddhāni tānyekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu ॥9॥
html:
akāryāṇyapi vakṣyāmi yāni tāni nibodha me ।
lokavedaviruddhāni tānyekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu ॥9॥
slp1: akAryARyapi vakzyAmi yAni tAni niboDa me । lokavedavirudDAni tAnyekAgramanAH SfRu ॥9॥

text: svadharmasya parityāgaḥ paradharmasya ca kriyā । ayājyayājanaṃ caiva tathābhakṣyasya bhakṣaṇam ॥10॥
html:
svadharmasya parityāgaḥ paradharmasya ca kriyā ।
ayājyayājanaṃ caiva tathābhakṣyasya bhakṣaṇam ॥10॥
slp1: svaDarmasya parityAgaH paraDarmasya ca kriyA । ayAjyayAjanaM cEva taTABakzyasya BakzaRam ॥10॥

text: śaraṇāgatasantyāgo bhṛtyasyābharaṇaṃ tathā । rasānāṃ vikrayaścāpi tiryagyonivadhastathā ॥11॥
html:
śaraṇāgatasantyāgo bhṛtyasyābharaṇaṃ tathā ।
rasānāṃ vikrayaścāpi tiryagyonivadhastathā ॥11॥
slp1: SaraRAgatasantyAgo BftyasyABaraRaM taTA । rasAnAM vikrayaScApi tiryagyonivaDastaTA ॥11॥

text: ādhānādīni karmāṇi śaktimānna karoti yaḥ । aprayacchaṃśca sarvāṇi nityaṃ deyāni bhārata ॥12॥
html:
ādhānādīni karmāṇi śaktimānna karoti yaḥ ।
aprayacchaṃśca sarvāṇi nityaṃ deyāni bhārata ॥12॥
slp1: ADAnAdIni karmARi SaktimAnna karoti yaH । aprayacCaMSca sarvARi nityaM deyAni BArata ॥12॥

text: dakṣiṇānāmadānaṃ ca brāhmaṇasvābhimarśanam । sarvāṇyetānyakāryāṇi prāhurdharmavido janāḥ ॥13॥
html:
dakṣiṇānāmadānaṃ ca brāhmaṇasvābhimarśanam ।
sarvāṇyetānyakāryāṇi prāhurdharmavido janāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: dakziRAnAmadAnaM ca brAhmaRasvABimarSanam । sarvARyetAnyakAryARi prAhurDarmavido janAH ॥13॥

text: pitrā vibhajate putro yaśca syādgurutalpagaḥ । aprajāyannadharmeṇa bhavatyādharmiko janaḥ ॥14॥
html:
pitrā vibhajate putro yaśca syādgurutalpagaḥ ।
aprajāyannadharmeṇa bhavatyādharmiko janaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: pitrA viBajate putro yaSca syAdgurutalpagaH । aprajAyannaDarmeRa BavatyADarmiko janaH ॥14॥

text: uktānyetāni karmāṇi vistareṇetareṇa ca । yāni kurvannakurvaṃśca prāyaścittīyate janaḥ ॥15॥
html:
uktānyetāni karmāṇi vistareṇetareṇa ca ।
yāni kurvannakurvaṃśca prāyaścittīyate janaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: uktAnyetAni karmARi vistareRetareRa ca । yAni kurvannakurvaMSca prAyaScittIyate janaH ॥15॥

text: etānyeva tu karmāṇi kriyamāṇāni mānavān । yeṣu yeṣu nimitteṣu na limpantyatha tacchṛṇu ॥16॥
html:
etānyeva tu karmāṇi kriyamāṇāni mānavān ।
yeṣu yeṣu nimitteṣu na limpantyatha tacchṛṇu ॥16॥
slp1: etAnyeva tu karmARi kriyamARAni mAnavAn । yezu yezu nimittezu na limpantyaTa tacCfRu ॥16॥

text: pragṛhya śastramāyāntamapi vedāntagaṃ raṇe । jighāṃsantaṃ nihatyājau na tena brahmahā bhavet ॥17॥
html:
pragṛhya śastramāyāntamapi vedāntagaṃ raṇe ।
jighāṃsantaṃ nihatyājau na tena brahmahā bhavet ॥17॥
slp1: pragfhya SastramAyAntamapi vedAntagaM raRe । jiGAMsantaM nihatyAjO na tena brahmahA Bavet ॥17॥

text: api cāpyatra kaunteya mantro vedeṣu paṭhyate । vedapramāṇavihitaṃ taṃ dharmaṃ prabravīmi te ॥18॥
html:
api cāpyatra kaunteya mantro vedeṣu paṭhyate ।
vedapramāṇavihitaṃ taṃ dharmaṃ prabravīmi te ॥18॥
slp1: api cApyatra kOnteya mantro vedezu paWyate । vedapramARavihitaM taM DarmaM prabravImi te ॥18॥

text: apetaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vṛttādyo hanyādātatāyinam । na tena brahmahā sa syānmanyustaṃ manyumṛcchati ॥19॥
html:
apetaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vṛttādyo hanyādātatāyinam ।
na tena brahmahā sa syānmanyustaṃ manyumṛcchati ॥19॥
slp1: apetaM brAhmaRaM vfttAdyo hanyAdAtatAyinam । na tena brahmahA sa syAnmanyustaM manyumfcCati ॥19॥

text: prāṇātyaye tathājñānādācaranmadirāmapi । acodito dharmaparaḥ punaḥ saṃskāramarhati ॥20॥
html:
prāṇātyaye tathājñānādācaranmadirāmapi ।
acodito dharmaparaḥ punaḥ saṃskāramarhati ॥20॥
slp1: prARAtyaye taTAjYAnAdAcaranmadirAmapi । acodito DarmaparaH punaH saMskAramarhati ॥20॥

text: etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kaunteyābhakṣyabhakṣaṇam । prāyaścittavidhānena sarvametena śudhyati ॥21॥
html:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kaunteyābhakṣyabhakṣaṇam ।
prāyaścittavidhānena sarvametena śudhyati ॥21॥
slp1: etatte sarvamAKyAtaM kOnteyABakzyaBakzaRam । prAyaScittaviDAnena sarvametena SuDyati ॥21॥

text: gurutalpaṃ hi gurvarthe na dūṣayati mānavam । uddālakaḥ śvetaketuṃ janayāmāsa śiṣyataḥ ॥22॥
html:
gurutalpaṃ hi gurvarthe na dūṣayati mānavam ।
uddālakaḥ śvetaketuṃ janayāmāsa śiṣyataḥ ॥22॥
slp1: gurutalpaM hi gurvarTe na dUzayati mAnavam । uddAlakaH SvetaketuM janayAmAsa SizyataH ॥22॥

text: steyaṃ kurvaṃstu gurvarthamāpatsu na nibadhyate । bahuśaḥ kāmakāreṇa na cedyaḥ sampravartate ॥23॥
html:
steyaṃ kurvaṃstu gurvarthamāpatsu na nibadhyate ।
bahuśaḥ kāmakāreṇa na cedyaḥ sampravartate ॥23॥
slp1: steyaM kurvaMstu gurvarTamApatsu na nibaDyate । bahuSaH kAmakAreRa na cedyaH sampravartate ॥23॥

text: anyatra brāhmaṇasvebhya ādadāno na duṣyati । svayamaprāśitā yaśca na sa pāpena lipyate ॥24॥
html:
anyatra brāhmaṇasvebhya ādadāno na duṣyati ।
svayamaprāśitā yaśca na sa pāpena lipyate ॥24॥
slp1: anyatra brAhmaRasveBya AdadAno na duzyati । svayamaprASitA yaSca na sa pApena lipyate ॥24॥

text: prāṇatrāṇe'nṛtaṃ vācyamātmano vā parasya vā । gurvarthe strīṣu caiva syādvivāhakaraṇeṣu ca ॥25॥
html:
prāṇatrāṇe'nṛtaṃ vācyamātmano vā parasya vā ।
gurvarthe strīṣu caiva syādvivāhakaraṇeṣu ca ॥25॥
slp1: prARatrARe'nftaM vAcyamAtmano vA parasya vA । gurvarTe strIzu cEva syAdvivAhakaraRezu ca ॥25॥

text: nāvartate vrataṃ svapne śukramokṣe kathañcana । ājyahomaḥ samiddhe'gnau prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate ॥26॥
html:
nāvartate vrataṃ svapne śukramokṣe kathañcana ।
ājyahomaḥ samiddhe'gnau prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate ॥26॥
slp1: nAvartate vrataM svapne Sukramokze kaTaYcana । AjyahomaH samidDe'gnO prAyaScittaM viDIyate ॥26॥

text: pārivittyaṃ ca patite nāsti pravrajite tathā । bhikṣite pāradāryaṃ ca na taddharmasya dūṣakam ॥27॥
html:
pārivittyaṃ ca patite nāsti pravrajite tathā ।
bhikṣite pāradāryaṃ ca na taddharmasya dūṣakam ॥27॥
slp1: pArivittyaM ca patite nAsti pravrajite taTA । Bikzite pAradAryaM ca na tadDarmasya dUzakam ॥27॥

text: vṛthāpaśusamālambhaṃ naiva kuryānna kārayet । anugrahaḥ paśūṇāṃ hi saṃskāro vidhicoditaḥ ॥28॥
html:
vṛthāpaśusamālambhaṃ naiva kuryānna kārayet ।
anugrahaḥ paśūṇāṃ hi saṃskāro vidhicoditaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: vfTApaSusamAlamBaM nEva kuryAnna kArayet । anugrahaH paSURAM hi saMskAro viDicoditaH ॥28॥

text: anarhe brāhmaṇe dattamajñānāttanna dūṣakam । sakāraṇaṃ tathā tīrthe'tīrthe vā pratipādanam ॥29॥
html:
anarhe brāhmaṇe dattamajñānāttanna dūṣakam ।
sakāraṇaṃ tathā tīrthe'tīrthe vā pratipādanam ॥29॥
slp1: anarhe brAhmaRe dattamajYAnAttanna dUzakam । sakAraRaM taTA tIrTe'tIrTe vA pratipAdanam ॥29॥

text: striyastathāpacāriṇyo niṣkṛtiḥ syādadūṣikā । api sā pūyate tena na tu bhartā praduṣyate ॥30॥
html:
striyastathāpacāriṇyo niṣkṛtiḥ syādadūṣikā ।
api sā pūyate tena na tu bhartā praduṣyate ॥30॥
slp1: striyastaTApacAriRyo nizkftiH syAdadUzikA । api sA pUyate tena na tu BartA praduzyate ॥30॥

text: tattvaṃ jñātvā tu somasya vikrayaḥ syādadūṣakaḥ । asamarthasya bhṛtyasya visargaḥ syādadoṣavān । vanadāho gavāmarthe kriyamāṇo na dūṣakaḥ ॥31॥
html:
tattvaṃ jñātvā tu somasya vikrayaḥ syādadūṣakaḥ ।
asamarthasya bhṛtyasya visargaḥ syādadoṣavān ।
vanadāho gavāmarthe kriyamāṇo na dūṣakaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: tattvaM jYAtvA tu somasya vikrayaH syAdadUzakaH । asamarTasya Bftyasya visargaH syAdadozavAn । vanadAho gavAmarTe kriyamARo na dUzakaH ॥31॥

text: uktānyetāni karmāṇi yāni kurvanna duṣyati । prāyaścittāni vakṣyāmi vistareṇaiva bhārata] ॥32॥
html:
uktānyetāni karmāṇi yāni kurvanna duṣyati ।
prāyaścittāni vakṣyāmi vistareṇaiva bhārata] ॥32॥
slp1: uktAnyetAni karmARi yAni kurvanna duzyati । prAyaScittAni vakzyAmi vistareREva BArata] ॥32॥

text: tapasā karmabhiścaiva pradānena ca bhārata । punāti pāpaṃ puruṣaḥ pūtaścenna pravartate ॥1॥
html:
tapasā karmabhiścaiva pradānena ca bhārata ।
punāti pāpaṃ puruṣaḥ pūtaścenna pravartate ॥1॥
slp1: tapasA karmaBiScEva pradAnena ca BArata । punAti pApaM puruzaH pUtaScenna pravartate ॥1॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: ekakālaṃ tu bhuñjānaścaranbhaikṣaṃ svakarmakṛt । kapālapāṇiḥ khaṭvāṅgī brahmacārī sadotthitaḥ ॥2॥
html:
ekakālaṃ tu bhuñjānaścaranbhaikṣaṃ svakarmakṛt ।
kapālapāṇiḥ khaṭvāṅgī brahmacārī sadotthitaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: ekakAlaM tu BuYjAnaScaranBEkzaM svakarmakft । kapAlapARiH KawvANgI brahmacArI sadotTitaH ॥2॥

text: anasūyuradhaḥśāyī karma loke prakāśayan । pūrṇairdvādaśabhirvarṣairbrahmahā vipramucyate ॥3॥
html:
anasūyuradhaḥśāyī karma loke prakāśayan ।
pūrṇairdvādaśabhirvarṣairbrahmahā vipramucyate ॥3॥
slp1: anasUyuraDaHSAyI karma loke prakASayan । pUrRErdvAdaSaBirvarzErbrahmahA vipramucyate ॥3॥

text: ṣaḍbhirvarṣaiḥ kṛcchrabhojī brahmahā pūyate naraḥ । māse māse samaśnaṃstu tribhirvarṣaiḥ pramucyate ॥4॥
html:
ṣaḍbhirvarṣaiḥ kṛcchrabhojī brahmahā pūyate naraḥ ।
māse māse samaśnaṃstu tribhirvarṣaiḥ pramucyate ॥4॥
slp1: zaqBirvarzEH kfcCraBojI brahmahA pUyate naraH । mAse mAse samaSnaMstu triBirvarzEH pramucyate ॥4॥

text: saṃvatsareṇa māsāśī pūyate nātra saṃśayaḥ । tathaivoparamanrājansvalpenāpi pramucyate ॥5॥
html:
saṃvatsareṇa māsāśī pūyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
tathaivoparamanrājansvalpenāpi pramucyate ॥5॥
slp1: saMvatsareRa mAsASI pUyate nAtra saMSayaH । taTEvoparamanrAjansvalpenApi pramucyate ॥5॥

text: kratunā cāśvamedhena pūyate nātra saṃśayaḥ । ye cāsyāvabhṛthe snānti kecidevaṃvidhā narāḥ ॥6॥
html:
kratunā cāśvamedhena pūyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
ye cāsyāvabhṛthe snānti kecidevaṃvidhā narāḥ ॥6॥
slp1: kratunA cASvameDena pUyate nAtra saMSayaH । ye cAsyAvaBfTe snAnti kecidevaMviDA narAH ॥6॥

text: te sarve pūtapāpmāno bhavantīti parā śrutiḥ । brāhmaṇārthe hato yuddhe mucyate brahmahatyayā ॥7॥
html:
te sarve pūtapāpmāno bhavantīti parā śrutiḥ ।
brāhmaṇārthe hato yuddhe mucyate brahmahatyayā ॥7॥
slp1: te sarve pUtapApmAno BavantIti parA SrutiH । brAhmaRArTe hato yudDe mucyate brahmahatyayA ॥7॥

text: gavāṃ śatasahasraṃ tu pātrebhyaḥ pratipādayan । brahmahā vipramucyeta sarvapāpebhya eva ca ॥8॥
html:
gavāṃ śatasahasraṃ tu pātrebhyaḥ pratipādayan ।
brahmahā vipramucyeta sarvapāpebhya eva ca ॥8॥
slp1: gavAM SatasahasraM tu pAtreByaH pratipAdayan । brahmahA vipramucyeta sarvapApeBya eva ca ॥8॥

text: kapilānāṃ sahasrāṇi yo dadyātpañcaviṃśatim । dogdhrīṇāṃ sa ca pāpebhyaḥ sarvebhyo vipramucyate ॥9॥
html:
kapilānāṃ sahasrāṇi yo dadyātpañcaviṃśatim ।
dogdhrīṇāṃ sa ca pāpebhyaḥ sarvebhyo vipramucyate ॥9॥
slp1: kapilAnAM sahasrARi yo dadyAtpaYcaviMSatim । dogDrIRAM sa ca pApeByaH sarveByo vipramucyate ॥9॥

text: gosahasraṃ savatsānāṃ dogdhrīṇāṃ prāṇasaṃśaye । sādhubhyo vai daridrebhyo dattvā mucyeta kilbiṣāt ॥10॥
html:
gosahasraṃ savatsānāṃ dogdhrīṇāṃ prāṇasaṃśaye ।
sādhubhyo vai daridrebhyo dattvā mucyeta kilbiṣāt ॥10॥
slp1: gosahasraM savatsAnAM dogDrIRAM prARasaMSaye । sADuByo vE daridreByo dattvA mucyeta kilbizAt ॥10॥

text: śataṃ vai yastu kāmbojānbrāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati । niyatebhyo mahīpāla sa ca pāpātpramucyate ॥11॥
html:
śataṃ vai yastu kāmbojānbrāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati ।
niyatebhyo mahīpāla sa ca pāpātpramucyate ॥11॥
slp1: SataM vE yastu kAmbojAnbrAhmaReByaH prayacCati । niyateByo mahIpAla sa ca pApAtpramucyate ॥11॥

text: manorathaṃ tu yo dadyādekasmā api bhārata । na kīrtayeta dattvā yaḥ sa ca pāpātpramucyate ॥12॥
html:
manorathaṃ tu yo dadyādekasmā api bhārata ।
na kīrtayeta dattvā yaḥ sa ca pāpātpramucyate ॥12॥
slp1: manoraTaM tu yo dadyAdekasmA api BArata । na kIrtayeta dattvA yaH sa ca pApAtpramucyate ॥12॥

text: surāpānaṃ sakṛtpītvā yo'gnivarṇāṃ pibeddvijaḥ । sa pāvayatyathātmānamiha loke paratra ca ॥13॥
html:
surāpānaṃ sakṛtpītvā yo'gnivarṇāṃ pibeddvijaḥ ।
sa pāvayatyathātmānamiha loke paratra ca ॥13॥
slp1: surApAnaM sakftpItvA yo'gnivarRAM pibeddvijaH । sa pAvayatyaTAtmAnamiha loke paratra ca ॥13॥

text: meruprapātaṃ prapatañjvalanaṃ vā samāviśan । mahāprasthānamātiṣṭhanmucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ॥14॥
html:
meruprapātaṃ prapatañjvalanaṃ vā samāviśan ।
mahāprasthānamātiṣṭhanmucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ॥14॥
slp1: meruprapAtaM prapataYjvalanaM vA samAviSan । mahAprasTAnamAtizWanmucyate sarvakilbizEH ॥14॥

text: bṛhaspatisaveneṣṭvā surāpo brāhmaṇaḥ punaḥ । samitiṃ brāhmaṇairgacchediti vai brāhmaṇī śrutiḥ ॥15॥
html:
bṛhaspatisaveneṣṭvā surāpo brāhmaṇaḥ punaḥ ।
samitiṃ brāhmaṇairgacchediti vai brāhmaṇī śrutiḥ ॥15॥
slp1: bfhaspatisavenezwvA surApo brAhmaRaH punaH । samitiM brAhmaRErgacCediti vE brAhmaRI SrutiH ॥15॥

text: bhūmipradānaṃ kuryādyaḥ surāṃ pītvā vimatsaraḥ । punarna ca pibedrājansaṃskṛtaḥ śudhyate naraḥ ॥16॥
html:
bhūmipradānaṃ kuryādyaḥ surāṃ pītvā vimatsaraḥ ।
punarna ca pibedrājansaṃskṛtaḥ śudhyate naraḥ ॥16॥
slp1: BUmipradAnaM kuryAdyaH surAM pItvA vimatsaraH । punarna ca pibedrAjansaMskftaH SuDyate naraH ॥16॥

text: gurutalpī śilāṃ taptāmāyasīmadhisaṃviśet । pāṇāvādhāya vā śephaṃ pravrajedūrdhvadarśanaḥ ॥17॥
html:
gurutalpī śilāṃ taptāmāyasīmadhisaṃviśet ।
pāṇāvādhāya vā śephaṃ pravrajedūrdhvadarśanaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: gurutalpI SilAM taptAmAyasImaDisaMviSet । pARAvADAya vA SePaM pravrajedUrDvadarSanaH ॥17॥

text: śarīrasya vimokṣeṇa mucyate karmaṇo'śubhāt । karmabhyo vipramucyante yattāḥ saṃvatsaraṃ striyaḥ ॥18॥
html:
śarīrasya vimokṣeṇa mucyate karmaṇo'śubhāt ।
karmabhyo vipramucyante yattāḥ saṃvatsaraṃ striyaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: SarIrasya vimokzeRa mucyate karmaRo'SuBAt । karmaByo vipramucyante yattAH saMvatsaraM striyaH ॥18॥

text: mahāvrataṃ caredyastu dadyātsarvasvameva tu । gurvarthe vā hato yuddhe sa mucyetkarmaṇo'śubhāt ॥19॥
html:
mahāvrataṃ caredyastu dadyātsarvasvameva tu ।
gurvarthe vā hato yuddhe sa mucyetkarmaṇo'śubhāt ॥19॥
slp1: mahAvrataM caredyastu dadyAtsarvasvameva tu । gurvarTe vA hato yudDe sa mucyetkarmaRo'SuBAt ॥19॥

text: anṛtenopacartā ca pratiroddhā gurostathā । upahṛtya priyaṃ tasmai tasmātpāpātpramucyate ॥20॥
html:
anṛtenopacartā ca pratiroddhā gurostathā ।
upahṛtya priyaṃ tasmai tasmātpāpātpramucyate ॥20॥
slp1: anftenopacartA ca pratirodDA gurostaTA । upahftya priyaM tasmE tasmAtpApAtpramucyate ॥20॥

text: avakīrṇinimittaṃ tu brahmahatyāvrataṃ caret । kharacarmavāsāḥ ṣaṇmāsaṃ tathā mucyeta kilbiṣāt ॥21॥
html:
avakīrṇinimittaṃ tu brahmahatyāvrataṃ caret ।
kharacarmavāsāḥ ṣaṇmāsaṃ tathā mucyeta kilbiṣāt ॥21॥
slp1: avakIrRinimittaM tu brahmahatyAvrataM caret । KaracarmavAsAH zaRmAsaM taTA mucyeta kilbizAt ॥21॥

text: paradārāpahārī ca parasyāpaharanvasu । saṃvatsaraṃ vratī bhūtvā tathā mucyeta kilbiṣāt ॥22॥
html:
paradārāpahārī ca parasyāpaharanvasu ।
saṃvatsaraṃ vratī bhūtvā tathā mucyeta kilbiṣāt ॥22॥
slp1: paradArApahArI ca parasyApaharanvasu । saMvatsaraM vratI BUtvA taTA mucyeta kilbizAt ॥22॥

text: steyaṃ tu yasyāpaharettasmai dadyātsamaṃ vasu । vividhenābhyupāyena tena mucyeta kilbiṣāt ॥23॥
html:
steyaṃ tu yasyāpaharettasmai dadyātsamaṃ vasu ।
vividhenābhyupāyena tena mucyeta kilbiṣāt ॥23॥
slp1: steyaM tu yasyApaharettasmE dadyAtsamaM vasu । viviDenAByupAyena tena mucyeta kilbizAt ॥23॥

text: kṛcchrāddvādaśarātreṇa svabhyastena daśāvaram । parivettā bhavetpūtaḥ parivittiśca bhārata ॥24॥
html:
kṛcchrāddvādaśarātreṇa svabhyastena daśāvaram ।
parivettā bhavetpūtaḥ parivittiśca bhārata ॥24॥
slp1: kfcCrAddvAdaSarAtreRa svaByastena daSAvaram । parivettA BavetpUtaH parivittiSca BArata ॥24॥

text: niveśyaṃ tu bhavettena sadā tārayitā pitṝn । na tu striyā bhaveddoṣo na tu sā tena lipyate ॥25॥
html:
niveśyaṃ tu bhavettena sadā tārayitā pitṝn ।
na tu striyā bhaveddoṣo na tu sā tena lipyate ॥25॥
slp1: niveSyaM tu Bavettena sadA tArayitA pitFn । na tu striyA Baveddozo na tu sA tena lipyate ॥25॥

text: bhajane hyṛtunā śuddhaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ vidhīyate । striyastena viśudhyanti iti dharmavido viduḥ ॥26॥
html:
bhajane hyṛtunā śuddhaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ vidhīyate ।
striyastena viśudhyanti iti dharmavido viduḥ ॥26॥
slp1: Bajane hyftunA SudDaM cAturmAsyaM viDIyate । striyastena viSuDyanti iti Darmavido viduH ॥26॥

text: striyastvāśaṅkitāḥ pāpairnopagamyā hi jānatā । rajasā tā viśudhyante bhasmanā bhājanaṃ yathā ॥27॥
html:
striyastvāśaṅkitāḥ pāpairnopagamyā hi jānatā ।
rajasā tā viśudhyante bhasmanā bhājanaṃ yathā ॥27॥
slp1: striyastvASaNkitAH pApErnopagamyA hi jAnatA । rajasA tA viSuDyante BasmanA BAjanaM yaTA ॥27॥

text: catuṣpātsakalo dharmo brāhmaṇānāṃ vidhīyate । pādāvakṛṣṭo rājanye tathā dharmo vidhīyate ॥28॥
html:
catuṣpātsakalo dharmo brāhmaṇānāṃ vidhīyate ।
