pādāvakṛṣṭo rājanye tathā dharmo vidhīyate ॥28॥
slp1: catuzpAtsakalo Darmo brAhmaRAnAM viDIyate । pAdAvakfzwo rAjanye taTA Darmo viDIyate ॥28॥

text: tathā vaiśye ca śūdre ca pādaḥ pādo vidhīyate । vidyādevaṃvidhenaiṣāṃ gurulāghavaniścayam ॥29॥
html:
tathā vaiśye ca śūdre ca pādaḥ pādo vidhīyate ।
vidyādevaṃvidhenaiṣāṃ gurulāghavaniścayam ॥29॥
slp1: taTA vESye ca SUdre ca pAdaH pAdo viDIyate । vidyAdevaMviDenEzAM gurulAGavaniScayam ॥29॥

text: tiryagyonivadhaṃ kṛtvā drumāṃśchittvetarānbahūn । trirātraṃ vāyubhakṣaḥ syātkarma ca prathayennaraḥ ॥30॥
html:
tiryagyonivadhaṃ kṛtvā drumāṃśchittvetarānbahūn ।
trirātraṃ vāyubhakṣaḥ syātkarma ca prathayennaraḥ ॥30॥
slp1: tiryagyonivaDaM kftvA drumAMSCittvetarAnbahUn । trirAtraM vAyuBakzaH syAtkarma ca praTayennaraH ॥30॥

text: agamyāgamane rājanprāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate । ārdravastreṇa ṣaṇmāsaṃ vihāryaṃ bhasmaśāyinā ॥31॥
html:
agamyāgamane rājanprāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate ।
ārdravastreṇa ṣaṇmāsaṃ vihāryaṃ bhasmaśāyinā ॥31॥
slp1: agamyAgamane rAjanprAyaScittaM viDIyate । ArdravastreRa zaRmAsaM vihAryaM BasmaSAyinA ॥31॥

text: eṣa eva tu sarveṣāmakāryāṇāṃ vidhirbhavet । brāhmaṇoktena vidhinā dṛṣṭāntāgamahetubhiḥ ॥32॥
html:
eṣa eva tu sarveṣāmakāryāṇāṃ vidhirbhavet ।
brāhmaṇoktena vidhinā dṛṣṭāntāgamahetubhiḥ ॥32॥
slp1: eza eva tu sarvezAmakAryARAM viDirBavet । brAhmaRoktena viDinA dfzwAntAgamahetuBiH ॥32॥

text: sāvitrīmapyadhīyānaḥ śucau deśe mitāśanaḥ । ahiṃsro'mandako'jalpanmucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ॥33॥
html:
sāvitrīmapyadhīyānaḥ śucau deśe mitāśanaḥ ।
ahiṃsro'mandako'jalpanmucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ॥33॥
slp1: sAvitrImapyaDIyAnaH SucO deSe mitASanaH । ahiMsro'mandako'jalpanmucyate sarvakilbizEH ॥33॥

text: ahaḥsu satataṃ tiṣṭhedabhyākāśaṃ niśi svapet । trirahnastrirniśāyāśca savāsā jalamāviśet ॥34॥
html:
ahaḥsu satataṃ tiṣṭhedabhyākāśaṃ niśi svapet ।
trirahnastrirniśāyāśca savāsā jalamāviśet ॥34॥
slp1: ahaHsu satataM tizWedaByAkASaM niSi svapet । trirahnastrirniSAyASca savAsA jalamAviSet ॥34॥

text: strīśūdrapatitāṃścāpi nābhibhāṣedvratānvitaḥ । pāpānyajñānataḥ kṛtvā mucyedevaṃvrato dvijaḥ ॥35॥
html:
strīśūdrapatitāṃścāpi nābhibhāṣedvratānvitaḥ ।
pāpānyajñānataḥ kṛtvā mucyedevaṃvrato dvijaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: strISUdrapatitAMScApi nABiBAzedvratAnvitaH । pApAnyajYAnataH kftvA mucyedevaMvrato dvijaH ॥35॥

text: śubhāśubhaphalaṃ pretya labhate bhūtasākṣikaḥ । atiricyettayoryattu tatkartā labhate phalam ॥36॥
html:
śubhāśubhaphalaṃ pretya labhate bhūtasākṣikaḥ ।
atiricyettayoryattu tatkartā labhate phalam ॥36॥
slp1: SuBASuBaPalaM pretya laBate BUtasAkzikaH । atiricyettayoryattu tatkartA laBate Palam ॥36॥

text: tasmāddānena tapasā karmaṇā ca śubhaṃ phalam । vardhayedaśubhaṃ kṛtvā yathā syādatirekavān ॥37॥
html:
tasmāddānena tapasā karmaṇā ca śubhaṃ phalam ।
vardhayedaśubhaṃ kṛtvā yathā syādatirekavān ॥37॥
slp1: tasmAddAnena tapasA karmaRA ca SuBaM Palam । varDayedaSuBaM kftvA yaTA syAdatirekavAn ॥37॥

text: kuryācchubhāni karmāṇi nimitte pāpakarmaṇām । dadyānnityaṃ ca vittāni tathā mucyeta kilbiṣāt ॥38॥
html:
kuryācchubhāni karmāṇi nimitte pāpakarmaṇām ।
dadyānnityaṃ ca vittāni tathā mucyeta kilbiṣāt ॥38॥
slp1: kuryAcCuBAni karmARi nimitte pApakarmaRAm । dadyAnnityaM ca vittAni taTA mucyeta kilbizAt ॥38॥

text: anurūpaṃ hi pāpasya prāyaścittamudāhṛtam । mahāpātakavarjaṃ tu prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate ॥39॥
html:
anurūpaṃ hi pāpasya prāyaścittamudāhṛtam ।
mahāpātakavarjaṃ tu prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate ॥39॥
slp1: anurUpaM hi pApasya prAyaScittamudAhftam । mahApAtakavarjaM tu prAyaScittaM viDIyate ॥39॥

text: bhakṣyābhakṣyeṣu sarveṣu vācyāvācye tathaiva ca । ajñānajñānayo rājanvihitānyanujānate ॥40॥
html:
bhakṣyābhakṣyeṣu sarveṣu vācyāvācye tathaiva ca ।
ajñānajñānayo rājanvihitānyanujānate ॥40॥
slp1: BakzyABakzyezu sarvezu vAcyAvAcye taTEva ca । ajYAnajYAnayo rAjanvihitAnyanujAnate ॥40॥

text: jānatā tu kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ guru sarvaṃ bhavatyuta । ajñānātskhalite doṣe prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate ॥41॥
html:
jānatā tu kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ guru sarvaṃ bhavatyuta ।
ajñānātskhalite doṣe prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate ॥41॥
slp1: jAnatA tu kftaM pApaM guru sarvaM Bavatyuta । ajYAnAtsKalite doze prAyaScittaM viDIyate ॥41॥

text: śakyate vidhinā pāpaṃ yathoktena vyapohitum । āstike śraddadhāne tu vidhireṣa vidhīyate ॥42॥
html:
śakyate vidhinā pāpaṃ yathoktena vyapohitum ।
āstike śraddadhāne tu vidhireṣa vidhīyate ॥42॥
slp1: Sakyate viDinA pApaM yaToktena vyapohitum । Astike SraddaDAne tu viDireza viDIyate ॥42॥

text: nāstikāśraddadhāneṣu puruṣeṣu kadācana । dambhadoṣapradhāneṣu vidhireṣa na dṛśyate ॥43॥
html:
nāstikāśraddadhāneṣu puruṣeṣu kadācana ।
dambhadoṣapradhāneṣu vidhireṣa na dṛśyate ॥43॥
slp1: nAstikASraddaDAnezu puruzezu kadAcana । damBadozapraDAnezu viDireza na dfSyate ॥43॥

text: śiṣṭācāraśca śiṣṭaśca dharmo dharmabhṛtāṃ vara । sevitavyo naravyāghra pretya ceha sukhārthinā ॥44॥
html:
śiṣṭācāraśca śiṣṭaśca dharmo dharmabhṛtāṃ vara ।
sevitavyo naravyāghra pretya ceha sukhārthinā ॥44॥
slp1: SizwAcAraSca SizwaSca Darmo DarmaBftAM vara । sevitavyo naravyAGra pretya ceha suKArTinA ॥44॥

text: sa rājanmokṣyase pāpāttena pūrveṇa hetunā । trāṇārthaṃ vā vadhenaiṣāmatha vā nṛpakarmaṇā ॥45॥
html:
sa rājanmokṣyase pāpāttena pūrveṇa hetunā ।
trāṇārthaṃ vā vadhenaiṣāmatha vā nṛpakarmaṇā ॥45॥
slp1: sa rAjanmokzyase pApAttena pUrveRa hetunA । trARArTaM vA vaDenEzAmaTa vA nfpakarmaRA ॥45॥

text: atha vā te ghṛṇā kācitprāyaścittaṃ cariṣyasi । mā tvevānāryajuṣṭena karmaṇā nidhanaṃ gamaḥ] ॥46॥
html:
atha vā te ghṛṇā kācitprāyaścittaṃ cariṣyasi ।
mā tvevānāryajuṣṭena karmaṇā nidhanaṃ gamaḥ] ॥46॥
slp1: aTa vA te GfRA kAcitprAyaScittaM carizyasi । mA tvevAnAryajuzwena karmaRA niDanaM gamaH] ॥46॥

text: evamukto bhagavatā dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । cintayitvā muhūrtaṃ tu pratyuvāca tapodhanam ॥1॥
html:
evamukto bhagavatā dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।
cintayitvā muhūrtaṃ tu pratyuvāca tapodhanam ॥1॥
slp1: evamukto BagavatA DarmarAjo yuDizWiraH । cintayitvA muhUrtaM tu pratyuvAca tapoDanam ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: kiṃ bhakṣyaṃ kimabhakṣyaṃ ca kiṃ ca deyaṃ praśasyate । kiṃ ca pātramapātraṃ vā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥2॥
html:
kiṃ bhakṣyaṃ kimabhakṣyaṃ ca kiṃ ca deyaṃ praśasyate ।
kiṃ ca pātramapātraṃ vā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥2॥
slp1: kiM BakzyaM kimaBakzyaM ca kiM ca deyaM praSasyate । kiM ca pAtramapAtraM vA tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥2॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । siddhānāṃ caiva saṃvādaṃ manoścaiva prajāpateḥ ॥3॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
siddhānāṃ caiva saṃvādaṃ manoścaiva prajāpateḥ ॥3॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । sidDAnAM cEva saMvAdaM manoScEva prajApateH ॥3॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: siddhāstapovrataparāḥ samāgamya purā vibhum । dharmaṃ papracchurāsīnamādikāle prajāpatim ॥4॥
html:
siddhāstapovrataparāḥ samāgamya purā vibhum ।
dharmaṃ papracchurāsīnamādikāle prajāpatim ॥4॥
slp1: sidDAstapovrataparAH samAgamya purA viBum । DarmaM papracCurAsInamAdikAle prajApatim ॥4॥

text: kathamannaṃ kathaṃ dānaṃ kathamadhyayanaṃ tapaḥ । kāryākāryaṃ ca naḥ sarvaṃ śaṃsa vai tvaṃ prajāpate ॥5॥
html:
kathamannaṃ kathaṃ dānaṃ kathamadhyayanaṃ tapaḥ ।
kāryākāryaṃ ca naḥ sarvaṃ śaṃsa vai tvaṃ prajāpate ॥5॥
slp1: kaTamannaM kaTaM dAnaM kaTamaDyayanaM tapaH । kAryAkAryaM ca naH sarvaM SaMsa vE tvaM prajApate ॥5॥

text: tairevamukto bhagavānmanuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo'bravīt । śuśrūṣadhvaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ dharmaṃ vyāsasamāsataḥ ॥6॥
html:
tairevamukto bhagavānmanuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo'bravīt ।
śuśrūṣadhvaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ dharmaṃ vyāsasamāsataḥ ॥6॥
slp1: tErevamukto BagavAnmanuH svAyaMBuvo'bravIt । SuSrUzaDvaM yaTAvfttaM DarmaM vyAsasamAsataH ॥6॥

text: adattasyānupādānaṃ dānamadhyayanaṃ tapaḥ । ahiṃsā satyamakrodhaḥ kṣamejyā dharmalakṣaṇam ॥7॥
html:
adattasyānupādānaṃ dānamadhyayanaṃ tapaḥ ।
ahiṃsā satyamakrodhaḥ kṣamejyā dharmalakṣaṇam ॥7॥
slp1: adattasyAnupAdAnaM dAnamaDyayanaM tapaH । ahiMsA satyamakroDaH kzamejyA DarmalakzaRam ॥7॥

text: ya eva dharmaḥ so'dharmo'deśe'kāle pratiṣṭhitaḥ । ādānamanṛtaṃ hiṃsā dharmo vyāvasthikaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥8॥
html:
ya eva dharmaḥ so'dharmo'deśe'kāle pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।
ādānamanṛtaṃ hiṃsā dharmo vyāvasthikaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: ya eva DarmaH so'Darmo'deSe'kAle pratizWitaH । AdAnamanftaM hiMsA Darmo vyAvasTikaH smftaH ॥8॥

text: dvividhau cāpyubhāvetau dharmādharmau vijānatām । apravṛttiḥ pravṛttiśca dvaividhyaṃ lokavedayoḥ ॥9॥
html:
dvividhau cāpyubhāvetau dharmādharmau vijānatām ।
apravṛttiḥ pravṛttiśca dvaividhyaṃ lokavedayoḥ ॥9॥
slp1: dviviDO cApyuBAvetO DarmADarmO vijAnatAm । apravfttiH pravfttiSca dvEviDyaM lokavedayoH ॥9॥

text: apravṛtteramartyatvaṃ martyatvaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam । aśubhasyāśubhaṃ vidyācchubhasya śubhameva ca ॥10॥
html:
apravṛtteramartyatvaṃ martyatvaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam ।
aśubhasyāśubhaṃ vidyācchubhasya śubhameva ca ॥10॥
slp1: apravftteramartyatvaM martyatvaM karmaRaH Palam । aSuBasyASuBaM vidyAcCuBasya SuBameva ca ॥10॥

text: etayoścobhayoḥ syātāṃ śubhāśubhatayā tathā । daivaṃ ca daivayuktaṃ ca prāṇaśca pralayaśca ha ॥11॥
html:
etayoścobhayoḥ syātāṃ śubhāśubhatayā tathā ।
daivaṃ ca daivayuktaṃ ca prāṇaśca pralayaśca ha ॥11॥
slp1: etayoScoBayoH syAtAM SuBASuBatayA taTA । dEvaM ca dEvayuktaM ca prARaSca pralayaSca ha ॥11॥

text: aprekṣāpūrvakaraṇādaśubhānāṃ śubhaṃ phalam । ūrdhvaṃ bhavati sandehādiha dṛṣṭārthameva vā । aprekṣāpūrvakaraṇātprāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate ॥12॥
html:
aprekṣāpūrvakaraṇādaśubhānāṃ śubhaṃ phalam ।
ūrdhvaṃ bhavati sandehādiha dṛṣṭārthameva vā ।
aprekṣāpūrvakaraṇātprāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate ॥12॥
slp1: aprekzApUrvakaraRAdaSuBAnAM SuBaM Palam । UrDvaM Bavati sandehAdiha dfzwArTameva vA । aprekzApUrvakaraRAtprAyaScittaM viDIyate ॥12॥

text: krodhamohakṛte caiva dṛṣṭāntāgamahetubhiḥ । śarīrāṇāmupakleśo manasaśca priyāpriye । tadauṣadhaiśca mantraiśca prāyaścittaiśca śāmyati ॥13॥
html:
krodhamohakṛte caiva dṛṣṭāntāgamahetubhiḥ ।
śarīrāṇāmupakleśo manasaśca priyāpriye ।
tadauṣadhaiśca mantraiśca prāyaścittaiśca śāmyati ॥13॥
slp1: kroDamohakfte cEva dfzwAntAgamahetuBiH । SarIrARAmupakleSo manasaSca priyApriye । tadOzaDESca mantrESca prAyaScittESca SAmyati ॥13॥

text: jātiśreṇyadhivāsānāṃ kuladharmāṃśca sarvataḥ । varjayenna hi taṃ dharmaṃ yeṣāṃ dharmo na vidyate ॥14॥
html:
jātiśreṇyadhivāsānāṃ kuladharmāṃśca sarvataḥ ।
varjayenna hi taṃ dharmaṃ yeṣāṃ dharmo na vidyate ॥14॥
slp1: jAtiSreRyaDivAsAnAM kulaDarmAMSca sarvataH । varjayenna hi taM DarmaM yezAM Darmo na vidyate ॥14॥

text: daśa vā vedaśāstrajñāstrayo vā dharmapāṭhakāḥ । yadbrūyuḥ kārya utpanne sa dharmo dharmasaṃśaye ॥15॥
html:
daśa vā vedaśāstrajñāstrayo vā dharmapāṭhakāḥ ।
yadbrūyuḥ kārya utpanne sa dharmo dharmasaṃśaye ॥15॥
slp1: daSa vA vedaSAstrajYAstrayo vA DarmapAWakAH । yadbrUyuH kArya utpanne sa Darmo DarmasaMSaye ॥15॥

text: aruṇā mṛttikā caiva tathā caiva pipīlakāḥ । śleṣmātakastathā viprairabhakṣyaṃ viṣameva ca ॥16॥
html:
aruṇā mṛttikā caiva tathā caiva pipīlakāḥ ।
śleṣmātakastathā viprairabhakṣyaṃ viṣameva ca ॥16॥
slp1: aruRA mfttikA cEva taTA cEva pipIlakAH । SlezmAtakastaTA viprEraBakzyaM vizameva ca ॥16॥

text: abhakṣyā brāhmaṇairmatsyāḥ śakalairye vivarjitāḥ । catuṣpātkacchapādanyo maṇḍūkā jalajāśca ye ॥17॥
html:
abhakṣyā brāhmaṇairmatsyāḥ śakalairye vivarjitāḥ ।
catuṣpātkacchapādanyo maṇḍūkā jalajāśca ye ॥17॥
slp1: aBakzyA brAhmaRErmatsyAH SakalErye vivarjitAH । catuzpAtkacCapAdanyo maRqUkA jalajASca ye ॥17॥

text: bhāsā haṃsāḥ suparṇāśca cakravākā bakāḥ plavāḥ । kaṅko madguśca gṛdhrāśca kākolūkaṃ tathaiva ca ॥18॥
html:
bhāsā haṃsāḥ suparṇāśca cakravākā bakāḥ plavāḥ ।
kaṅko madguśca gṛdhrāśca kākolūkaṃ tathaiva ca ॥18॥
slp1: BAsA haMsAH suparRASca cakravAkA bakAH plavAH । kaNko madguSca gfDrASca kAkolUkaM taTEva ca ॥18॥

text: kravyādāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sarve catuṣpādāśca daṃṣṭriṇaḥ । yeṣāṃ cobhayato dantāścaturdaṃṣṭrāśca sarvaśaḥ ॥19॥
html:
kravyādāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sarve catuṣpādāśca daṃṣṭriṇaḥ ।
yeṣāṃ cobhayato dantāścaturdaṃṣṭrāśca sarvaśaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: kravyAdAH pakziRaH sarve catuzpAdASca daMzwriRaH । yezAM coBayato dantAScaturdaMzwrASca sarvaSaH ॥19॥

text: eḍakāśvakharoṣṭrīṇāṃ sūtikānāṃ gavāmapi । mānuṣīṇāṃ mṛgīṇāṃ ca na pibedbrāhmaṇaḥ payaḥ ॥20॥
html:
eḍakāśvakharoṣṭrīṇāṃ sūtikānāṃ gavāmapi ।
mānuṣīṇāṃ mṛgīṇāṃ ca na pibedbrāhmaṇaḥ payaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: eqakASvaKarozwrIRAM sUtikAnAM gavAmapi । mAnuzIRAM mfgIRAM ca na pibedbrAhmaRaH payaH ॥20॥

text: pretānnaṃ sūtikānnaṃ ca yacca kiñcidanirdaśam । abhojyaṃ cāpyapeyaṃ ca dhenvā dugdhamanirdaśam ॥21॥
html:
pretānnaṃ sūtikānnaṃ ca yacca kiñcidanirdaśam ।
abhojyaṃ cāpyapeyaṃ ca dhenvā dugdhamanirdaśam ॥21॥
slp1: pretAnnaM sUtikAnnaM ca yacca kiYcidanirdaSam । aBojyaM cApyapeyaM ca DenvA dugDamanirdaSam ॥21॥

text: takṣṇaścarmāvakartuśca puṃścalyā rajakasya ca । cikitsakasya yaccānnamabhojyaṃ rakṣiṇastathā ॥22॥
html:
takṣṇaścarmāvakartuśca puṃścalyā rajakasya ca ।
cikitsakasya yaccānnamabhojyaṃ rakṣiṇastathā ॥22॥
slp1: takzRaScarmAvakartuSca puMScalyA rajakasya ca । cikitsakasya yaccAnnamaBojyaM rakziRastaTA ॥22॥

text: gaṇagrāmābhiśastānāṃ raṅgastrījīvinaśca ye । parivittinapuṃṣāṃ ca bandidyūtavidāṃ tathā ॥23॥
html:
gaṇagrāmābhiśastānāṃ raṅgastrījīvinaśca ye ।
parivittinapuṃṣāṃ ca bandidyūtavidāṃ tathā ॥23॥
slp1: gaRagrAmABiSastAnAM raNgastrIjIvinaSca ye । parivittinapuMzAM ca bandidyUtavidAM taTA ॥23॥

text: vāryamāṇāhṛtaṃ cānnaṃ śuktaṃ paryuṣitaṃ ca yat । surānugatamucchiṣṭamabhojyaṃ śeṣitaṃ ca yat ॥24॥
html:
vāryamāṇāhṛtaṃ cānnaṃ śuktaṃ paryuṣitaṃ ca yat ।
surānugatamucchiṣṭamabhojyaṃ śeṣitaṃ ca yat ॥24॥
slp1: vAryamARAhftaM cAnnaM SuktaM paryuzitaM ca yat । surAnugatamucCizwamaBojyaM SezitaM ca yat ॥24॥

text: piṣṭamāṃsekṣuśākānāṃ vikārāḥ payasastathā । saktudhānākarambhāśca nopabhojyāścirasthitāḥ ॥25॥
html:
piṣṭamāṃsekṣuśākānāṃ vikārāḥ payasastathā ।
saktudhānākarambhāśca nopabhojyāścirasthitāḥ ॥25॥
slp1: pizwamAMsekzuSAkAnAM vikArAH payasastaTA । saktuDAnAkaramBASca nopaBojyAScirasTitAH ॥25॥

text: pāyasaṃ kṛsaraṃ māṃsamapūpāśca vṛthā kṛtāḥ । abhojyāścāpyabhakṣyāśca brāhmaṇairgṛhamedhibhiḥ ॥26॥
html:
pāyasaṃ kṛsaraṃ māṃsamapūpāśca vṛthā kṛtāḥ ।
abhojyāścāpyabhakṣyāśca brāhmaṇairgṛhamedhibhiḥ ॥26॥
slp1: pAyasaM kfsaraM mAMsamapUpASca vfTA kftAH । aBojyAScApyaBakzyASca brAhmaRErgfhameDiBiH ॥26॥

text: devānpitṝnmanuṣyāṃśca munīngṛhyāśca devatāḥ । pūjayitvā tataḥ paścādgṛhastho bhoktumarhati ॥27॥
html:
devānpitṝnmanuṣyāṃśca munīngṛhyāśca devatāḥ ।
pūjayitvā tataḥ paścādgṛhastho bhoktumarhati ॥27॥
slp1: devAnpitFnmanuzyAMSca munIngfhyASca devatAH । pUjayitvA tataH paScAdgfhasTo Boktumarhati ॥27॥

text: yathā pravrajito bhikṣurgṛhasthaḥ svagṛhe vaset । evaṃvṛttaḥ priyairdāraiḥ saṃvasandharmamāpnuyāt ॥28॥
html:
yathā pravrajito bhikṣurgṛhasthaḥ svagṛhe vaset ।
evaṃvṛttaḥ priyairdāraiḥ saṃvasandharmamāpnuyāt ॥28॥
slp1: yaTA pravrajito BikzurgfhasTaH svagfhe vaset । evaMvfttaH priyErdArEH saMvasanDarmamApnuyAt ॥28॥

text: na dadyādyaśase dānaṃ na bhayānnopakāriṇe । na nṛttagītaśīleṣu hāsakeṣu ca dhārmikaḥ ॥29॥
html:
na dadyādyaśase dānaṃ na bhayānnopakāriṇe ।
na nṛttagītaśīleṣu hāsakeṣu ca dhārmikaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: na dadyAdyaSase dAnaM na BayAnnopakAriRe । na nfttagItaSIlezu hAsakezu ca DArmikaH ॥29॥

text: na matte naiva conmatte na stene na cikitsake । na vāgghīne vivarṇe vā nāṅgahīne na vāmane ॥30॥
html:
na matte naiva conmatte na stene na cikitsake ।
na vāgghīne vivarṇe vā nāṅgahīne na vāmane ॥30॥
slp1: na matte nEva conmatte na stene na cikitsake । na vAgGIne vivarRe vA nANgahIne na vAmane ॥30॥

text: na durjane dauṣkule vā vratairvā yo na saṃskṛtaḥ । aśrotriye mṛtaṃ dānaṃ brāhmaṇe'brahmavādini ॥31॥
html:
na durjane dauṣkule vā vratairvā yo na saṃskṛtaḥ ।
aśrotriye mṛtaṃ dānaṃ brāhmaṇe'brahmavādini ॥31॥
slp1: na durjane dOzkule vA vratErvA yo na saMskftaH । aSrotriye mftaM dAnaM brAhmaRe'brahmavAdini ॥31॥

text: asamyakcaiva yaddattamasamyakca pratigrahaḥ । ubhayoḥ syādanarthāya dāturādātureva ca ॥32॥
html:
asamyakcaiva yaddattamasamyakca pratigrahaḥ ।
ubhayoḥ syādanarthāya dāturādātureva ca ॥32॥
slp1: asamyakcEva yaddattamasamyakca pratigrahaH । uBayoH syAdanarTAya dAturAdAtureva ca ॥32॥

text: yathā khadiramālambya śilāṃ vāpyarṇavaṃ taran । majjate majjate tadvaddātā yaśca pratīcchakaḥ ॥33॥
html:
yathā khadiramālambya śilāṃ vāpyarṇavaṃ taran ।
majjate majjate tadvaddātā yaśca pratīcchakaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: yaTA KadiramAlambya SilAM vApyarRavaM taran । majjate majjate tadvaddAtA yaSca pratIcCakaH ॥33॥

text: kāṣṭhairārdrairyathā vahnirupastīrṇo na dīpyate । tapaḥsvādhyāyacāritrairevaṃ hīnaḥ pratigrahī ॥34॥
html:
kāṣṭhairārdrairyathā vahnirupastīrṇo na dīpyate ।
tapaḥsvādhyāyacāritrairevaṃ hīnaḥ pratigrahī ॥34॥
slp1: kAzWErArdrEryaTA vahnirupastIrRo na dIpyate । tapaHsvADyAyacAritrErevaM hInaH pratigrahI ॥34॥

text: kapāle yadvadāpaḥ syuḥ śvadṛtau vā yathā payaḥ । āśrayasthānadoṣeṇa vṛttahīne tathā śrutam ॥35॥
html:
kapāle yadvadāpaḥ syuḥ śvadṛtau vā yathā payaḥ ।
āśrayasthānadoṣeṇa vṛttahīne tathā śrutam ॥35॥
slp1: kapAle yadvadApaH syuH SvadftO vA yaTA payaH । ASrayasTAnadozeRa vfttahIne taTA Srutam ॥35॥

text: nirmantro nirvrato yaḥ syādaśāstrajño'nasūyakaḥ । anukrośātpradātavyaṃ dīneṣvevaṃ nareṣvapi ॥36॥
html:
nirmantro nirvrato yaḥ syādaśāstrajño'nasūyakaḥ ।
anukrośātpradātavyaṃ dīneṣvevaṃ nareṣvapi ॥36॥
slp1: nirmantro nirvrato yaH syAdaSAstrajYo'nasUyakaH । anukroSAtpradAtavyaM dInezvevaM narezvapi ॥36॥

text: na vai deyamanukrośāddīnāyāpyapakāriṇe । āptācaritamityeva dharma ityeva vā punaḥ ॥37॥
html:
na vai deyamanukrośāddīnāyāpyapakāriṇe ।
āptācaritamityeva dharma ityeva vā punaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: na vE deyamanukroSAddInAyApyapakAriRe । AptAcaritamityeva Darma ityeva vA punaH ॥37॥

text: niṣkāraṇaṃ sma taddattaṃ brāhmaṇe dharmavarjite । bhavedapātradoṣeṇa na me'trāsti vicāraṇā ॥38॥
html:
niṣkāraṇaṃ sma taddattaṃ brāhmaṇe dharmavarjite ।
bhavedapātradoṣeṇa na me'trāsti vicāraṇā ॥38॥
slp1: nizkAraRaM sma taddattaM brAhmaRe Darmavarjite । BavedapAtradozeRa na me'trAsti vicAraRA ॥38॥

text: yathā dārumayo hastī yathā carmamayo mṛgaḥ । brāhmaṇaścānadhīyānastrayaste nāmadhārakāḥ ॥39॥
html:
yathā dārumayo hastī yathā carmamayo mṛgaḥ ।
brāhmaṇaścānadhīyānastrayaste nāmadhārakāḥ ॥39॥
slp1: yaTA dArumayo hastI yaTA carmamayo mfgaH । brAhmaRaScAnaDIyAnastrayaste nAmaDArakAH ॥39॥

text: yathā ṣaṇḍho'phalaḥ strīṣu yathā gaurgavi cāphalā । śakunirvāpyapakṣaḥ syānnirmantro brāhmaṇastathā ॥40॥
html:
yathā ṣaṇḍho'phalaḥ strīṣu yathā gaurgavi cāphalā ।
śakunirvāpyapakṣaḥ syānnirmantro brāhmaṇastathā ॥40॥
slp1: yaTA zaRQo'PalaH strIzu yaTA gOrgavi cAPalA । SakunirvApyapakzaH syAnnirmantro brAhmaRastaTA ॥40॥

text: grāmadhānyaṃ yathā śūnyaṃ yathā kūpaśca nirjalaḥ । yathā hutamanagnau ca tathaiva syānnirākṛtau ॥41॥
html:
grāmadhānyaṃ yathā śūnyaṃ yathā kūpaśca nirjalaḥ ।
yathā hutamanagnau ca tathaiva syānnirākṛtau ॥41॥
slp1: grAmaDAnyaM yaTA SUnyaM yaTA kUpaSca nirjalaH । yaTA hutamanagnO ca taTEva syAnnirAkftO ॥41॥

text: devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca havyakavyavināśanaḥ । śatrurarthaharo mūrkho na lokānprāptumarhati ॥42॥
html:
devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca havyakavyavināśanaḥ ।
śatrurarthaharo mūrkho na lokānprāptumarhati ॥42॥
slp1: devatAnAM pitFRAM ca havyakavyavinASanaH । SatrurarTaharo mUrKo na lokAnprAptumarhati ॥42॥

text: etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yathā vṛttaṃ yudhiṣṭhira । samāsena mahaddhyetacchrotavyaṃ bharatarṣabha] ॥43॥
html:
etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yathā vṛttaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
samāsena mahaddhyetacchrotavyaṃ bharatarṣabha] ॥43॥
slp1: etatte kaTitaM sarvaM yaTA vfttaM yuDizWira । samAsena mahadDyetacCrotavyaM BaratarzaBa] ॥43॥

text: śrotumicchāmi bhagavanvistareṇa mahāmune । rājadharmāndvijaśreṣṭha cāturvarṇyasya cākhilān ॥1॥
html:
śrotumicchāmi bhagavanvistareṇa mahāmune ।
rājadharmāndvijaśreṣṭha cāturvarṇyasya cākhilān ॥1॥
slp1: SrotumicCAmi BagavanvistareRa mahAmune । rAjaDarmAndvijaSrezWa cAturvarRyasya cAKilAn ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: āpatsu ca yathā nītirvidhātavyā mahīkṣitā । dharmyamālambya panthānaṃ vijayeyaṃ kathaṃ mahīm ॥2॥
html:
āpatsu ca yathā nītirvidhātavyā mahīkṣitā ।
dharmyamālambya panthānaṃ vijayeyaṃ kathaṃ mahīm ॥2॥
slp1: Apatsu ca yaTA nItirviDAtavyA mahIkzitA । DarmyamAlambya panTAnaM vijayeyaM kaTaM mahIm ॥2॥

text: prāyaścittakathā hyeṣā bhakṣyābhakṣyavivardhitā । kautūhalānupravaṇā harṣaṃ janayatīva me ॥3॥
html:
prāyaścittakathā hyeṣā bhakṣyābhakṣyavivardhitā ।
kautūhalānupravaṇā harṣaṃ janayatīva me ॥3॥
slp1: prAyaScittakaTA hyezA BakzyABakzyavivarDitA । kOtUhalAnupravaRA harzaM janayatIva me ॥3॥

text: dharmacaryā ca rājyaṃ ca nityameva virudhyate । yena muhyati me cetaścintayānasya nityaśaḥ ॥4॥
html:
dharmacaryā ca rājyaṃ ca nityameva virudhyate ।
yena muhyati me cetaścintayānasya nityaśaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: DarmacaryA ca rAjyaM ca nityameva viruDyate । yena muhyati me cetaScintayAnasya nityaSaH ॥4॥

text: tamuvāca mahātejā vyāso vedavidāṃ varaḥ । nāradaṃ samabhiprekṣya sarvaṃ jānanpurātanam ॥5॥
html:
tamuvāca mahātejā vyāso vedavidāṃ varaḥ ।
nāradaṃ samabhiprekṣya sarvaṃ jānanpurātanam ॥5॥
slp1: tamuvAca mahAtejA vyAso vedavidAM varaH । nAradaM samaBiprekzya sarvaM jAnanpurAtanam ॥5॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: śrotumicchasi ceddharmānakhilena yudhiṣṭhira । praihi bhīṣmaṃ mahābāho vṛddhaṃ kurupitāmaham ॥6॥
html:
śrotumicchasi ceddharmānakhilena yudhiṣṭhira ।
praihi bhīṣmaṃ mahābāho vṛddhaṃ kurupitāmaham ॥6॥
slp1: SrotumicCasi cedDarmAnaKilena yuDizWira । prEhi BIzmaM mahAbAho vfdDaM kurupitAmaham ॥6॥

text: sa te sarvarahasyeṣu saṃśayānmanasi sthitān । chettā bhāgīrathīputraḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvadharmavit ॥7॥
html:
sa te sarvarahasyeṣu saṃśayānmanasi sthitān ।
chettā bhāgīrathīputraḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvadharmavit ॥7॥
slp1: sa te sarvarahasyezu saMSayAnmanasi sTitAn । CettA BAgIraTIputraH sarvajYaH sarvaDarmavit ॥7॥

text: janayāmāsa yaṃ devī divyā tripathagā nadī । sākṣāddadarśa yo devānsarvāñśakrapurogamān ॥8॥
html:
janayāmāsa yaṃ devī divyā tripathagā nadī ।
sākṣāddadarśa yo devānsarvāñśakrapurogamān ॥8॥
slp1: janayAmAsa yaM devI divyA tripaTagA nadI । sAkzAddadarSa yo devAnsarvAYSakrapurogamAn ॥8॥

text: bṛhaspatipurogāṃśca devarṣīnasakṛtprabhuḥ । toṣayitvopacāreṇa rājanītimadhītavān ॥9॥
html:
bṛhaspatipurogāṃśca devarṣīnasakṛtprabhuḥ ।
toṣayitvopacāreṇa rājanītimadhītavān ॥9॥
slp1: bfhaspatipurogAMSca devarzInasakftpraBuH । tozayitvopacAreRa rAjanItimaDItavAn ॥9॥

text: uśanā veda yacchāstraṃ devāsuragururdvijaḥ । tacca sarvaṃ savaiyākhyaṃ prāptavānkurusattamaḥ ॥10॥
html:
uśanā veda yacchāstraṃ devāsuragururdvijaḥ ।
tacca sarvaṃ savaiyākhyaṃ prāptavānkurusattamaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: uSanA veda yacCAstraM devAsuragururdvijaH । tacca sarvaM savEyAKyaM prAptavAnkurusattamaH ॥10॥

text: bhārgavāccyavanāccāpi vedānaṅgopabṛṃhitān । pratipede mahābuddhirvasiṣṭhācca yatavratāt ॥11॥
html:
bhārgavāccyavanāccāpi vedānaṅgopabṛṃhitān ।
pratipede mahābuddhirvasiṣṭhācca yatavratāt ॥11॥
slp1: BArgavAccyavanAccApi vedAnaNgopabfMhitAn । pratipede mahAbudDirvasizWAcca yatavratAt ॥11॥

text: pitāmahasutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ kumāraṃ dīptatejasam । adhyātmagatitattvajñamupāśikṣata yaḥ purā ॥12॥
html:
pitāmahasutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ kumāraṃ dīptatejasam ।
adhyātmagatitattvajñamupāśikṣata yaḥ purā ॥12॥
slp1: pitAmahasutaM jyezWaM kumAraM dIptatejasam । aDyAtmagatitattvajYamupASikzata yaH purA ॥12॥

text: mārkaṇḍeyamukhātkṛtsnaṃ yatidharmamavāptavān । rāmādastrāṇi śakrācca prāptavānbharatarṣabha ॥13॥
html:
mārkaṇḍeyamukhātkṛtsnaṃ yatidharmamavāptavān ।
rāmādastrāṇi śakrācca prāptavānbharatarṣabha ॥13॥
slp1: mArkaRqeyamuKAtkftsnaM yatiDarmamavAptavAn । rAmAdastrARi SakrAcca prAptavAnBaratarzaBa ॥13॥

text: mṛtyurātmecchayā yasya jātasya manujeṣvapi । tathānapatyasya sataḥ puṇyalokā divi śrutāḥ ॥14॥
html:
mṛtyurātmecchayā yasya jātasya manujeṣvapi ।
tathānapatyasya sataḥ puṇyalokā divi śrutāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: mftyurAtmecCayA yasya jAtasya manujezvapi । taTAnapatyasya sataH puRyalokA divi SrutAH ॥14॥

text: yasya brahmarṣayaḥ puṇyā nityamāsansabhāsadaḥ । yasya nāviditaṃ kiñcijjñānajñeyeṣu vidyate ॥15॥
html:
yasya brahmarṣayaḥ puṇyā nityamāsansabhāsadaḥ ।
yasya nāviditaṃ kiñcijjñānajñeyeṣu vidyate ॥15॥
slp1: yasya brahmarzayaH puRyA nityamAsansaBAsadaH । yasya nAviditaM kiYcijjYAnajYeyezu vidyate ॥15॥

text: sa te vakṣyati dharmajñaḥ sūkṣmadharmārthatattvavit । tamabhyehi purā prāṇānsa vimuñcati dharmavit ॥16॥
html:
sa te vakṣyati dharmajñaḥ sūkṣmadharmārthatattvavit ।
tamabhyehi purā prāṇānsa vimuñcati dharmavit ॥16॥
slp1: sa te vakzyati DarmajYaH sUkzmaDarmArTatattvavit । tamaByehi purA prARAnsa vimuYcati Darmavit ॥16॥

text: evamuktastu kaunteyo dīrghaprajño mahādyutiḥ । uvāca vadatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vyāsaṃ satyavatīsutam ॥17॥
html:
evamuktastu kaunteyo dīrghaprajño mahādyutiḥ ।
uvāca vadatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vyāsaṃ satyavatīsutam ॥17॥
slp1: evamuktastu kOnteyo dIrGaprajYo mahAdyutiH । uvAca vadatAM SrezWaM vyAsaM satyavatIsutam ॥17॥

text: vaiśasaṃ sumahatkṛtvā jñātīnāṃ lomaharṣaṇam । āgaskṛtsarvalokasya pṛthivīnāśakārakaḥ ॥18॥
html:
vaiśasaṃ sumahatkṛtvā jñātīnāṃ lomaharṣaṇam ।
āgaskṛtsarvalokasya pṛthivīnāśakārakaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: vESasaM sumahatkftvA jYAtInAM lomaharzaRam । Agaskftsarvalokasya pfTivInASakArakaH ॥18॥

text: ghātayitvā tamevājau chalenājihmayodhinam । upasampraṣṭumarhāmi tamahaṃ kena hetunā ॥19॥
html:
ghātayitvā tamevājau chalenājihmayodhinam ।
upasampraṣṭumarhāmi tamahaṃ kena hetunā ॥19॥
slp1: GAtayitvA tamevAjO CalenAjihmayoDinam । upasamprazwumarhAmi tamahaM kena hetunA ॥19॥

text: tatastaṃ nṛpatiśreṣṭhaṃ cāturvarṇyahitepsayā । punarāha mahābāhuryaduśreṣṭho mahādyutiḥ ॥20॥
html:
tatastaṃ nṛpatiśreṣṭhaṃ cāturvarṇyahitepsayā ।
punarāha mahābāhuryaduśreṣṭho mahādyutiḥ ॥20॥
slp1: tatastaM nfpatiSrezWaM cAturvarRyahitepsayA । punarAha mahAbAhuryaduSrezWo mahAdyutiH ॥20॥

text: nedānīmatinirbandhaṃ śoke kartumihārhasi । yadāha bhagavānvyāsastatkuruṣva nṛpottama ॥21॥
html:
nedānīmatinirbandhaṃ śoke kartumihārhasi ।
yadāha bhagavānvyāsastatkuruṣva nṛpottama ॥21॥
slp1: nedAnImatinirbanDaM Soke kartumihArhasi । yadAha BagavAnvyAsastatkuruzva nfpottama ॥21॥

text: brāhmaṇāstvāṃ mahābāho bhrātaraśca mahaujasaḥ । parjanyamiva gharmārtā āśaṃsānā upāsate ॥22॥
html:
brāhmaṇāstvāṃ mahābāho bhrātaraśca mahaujasaḥ ।
parjanyamiva gharmārtā āśaṃsānā upāsate ॥22॥
slp1: brAhmaRAstvAM mahAbAho BrAtaraSca mahOjasaH । parjanyamiva GarmArtA ASaMsAnA upAsate ॥22॥

text: hataśiṣṭāśca rājānaḥ kṛtsnaṃ caiva samāgatam । cāturvarṇyaṃ mahārāja rāṣṭraṃ te kurujāṅgalam ॥23॥
html:
hataśiṣṭāśca rājānaḥ kṛtsnaṃ caiva samāgatam ।
cāturvarṇyaṃ mahārāja rāṣṭraṃ te kurujāṅgalam ॥23॥
slp1: hataSizwASca rAjAnaH kftsnaM cEva samAgatam । cAturvarRyaM mahArAja rAzwraM te kurujANgalam ॥23॥

text: priyārthamapi caiteṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām । niyogādasya ca gurorvyāsasyāmitatejasaḥ ॥24॥
html:
priyārthamapi caiteṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām ।
niyogādasya ca gurorvyāsasyāmitatejasaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: priyArTamapi cEtezAM brAhmaRAnAM mahAtmanAm । niyogAdasya ca gurorvyAsasyAmitatejasaH ॥24॥

text: suhṛdāṃ cāsmadādīnāṃ draupadyāśca parantapa । kuru priyamamitraghna lokasya ca hitaṃ kuru ॥25॥
html:
suhṛdāṃ cāsmadādīnāṃ draupadyāśca parantapa ।
kuru priyamamitraghna lokasya ca hitaṃ kuru ॥25॥
slp1: suhfdAM cAsmadAdInAM drOpadyASca parantapa । kuru priyamamitraGna lokasya ca hitaM kuru ॥25॥

text: evamuktastu kṛṣṇena rājā rājīvalocanaḥ । hitārthaṃ sarvalokasya samuttasthau mahātapāḥ ॥26॥
html:
evamuktastu kṛṣṇena rājā rājīvalocanaḥ ।
hitārthaṃ sarvalokasya samuttasthau mahātapāḥ ॥26॥
slp1: evamuktastu kfzRena rAjA rAjIvalocanaH । hitArTaM sarvalokasya samuttasTO mahAtapAH ॥26॥

text: so'nunīto naravyāghro viṣṭaraśravasā svayam । dvaipāyanena ca tathā devasthānena jiṣṇunā ॥27॥
html:
so'nunīto naravyāghro viṣṭaraśravasā svayam ।
dvaipāyanena ca tathā devasthānena jiṣṇunā ॥27॥
slp1: so'nunIto naravyAGro vizwaraSravasA svayam । dvEpAyanena ca taTA devasTAnena jizRunA ॥27॥

text: etaiścānyaiśca bahubhiranunīto yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । vyajahānmānasaṃ duḥkhaṃ santāpaṃ ca mahāmanāḥ ॥28॥
html:
etaiścānyaiśca bahubhiranunīto yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।
vyajahānmānasaṃ duḥkhaṃ santāpaṃ ca mahāmanāḥ ॥28॥
slp1: etEScAnyESca bahuBiranunIto yuDizWiraH । vyajahAnmAnasaM duHKaM santApaM ca mahAmanAH ॥28॥

text: śrutavākyaḥ śrutanidhiḥ śrutaśravyaviśāradaḥ । vyavasya manasaḥ śāntimagacchatpāṇḍunandanaḥ ॥29॥
html:
śrutavākyaḥ śrutanidhiḥ śrutaśravyaviśāradaḥ ।
vyavasya manasaḥ śāntimagacchatpāṇḍunandanaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: SrutavAkyaH SrutaniDiH SrutaSravyaviSAradaH । vyavasya manasaH SAntimagacCatpARqunandanaH ॥29॥

text: sa taiḥ parivṛto rājā nakṣatrairiva candramāḥ । dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ puraskṛtya svapuraṃ praviveśa ha ॥30॥
html:
sa taiḥ parivṛto rājā nakṣatrairiva candramāḥ ।
dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ puraskṛtya svapuraṃ praviveśa ha ॥30॥
slp1: sa tEH parivfto rAjA nakzatrEriva candramAH । DftarAzwraM puraskftya svapuraM praviveSa ha ॥30॥

text: pravivikṣuḥ sa dharmajñaḥ kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । arcayāmāsa devāṃśca brāhmaṇāṃśca sahasraśaḥ ॥31॥
html:
pravivikṣuḥ sa dharmajñaḥ kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।
arcayāmāsa devāṃśca brāhmaṇāṃśca sahasraśaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: pravivikzuH sa DarmajYaH kuntIputro yuDizWiraH । arcayAmAsa devAMSca brAhmaRAMSca sahasraSaH ॥31॥

text: tato rathaṃ navaṃ śubhraṃ kambalājinasaṃvṛtam । yuktaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirgobhiḥ pāṇḍuraiḥ śubhalakṣaṇaiḥ ॥32॥
html:
tato rathaṃ navaṃ śubhraṃ kambalājinasaṃvṛtam ।
yuktaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirgobhiḥ pāṇḍuraiḥ śubhalakṣaṇaiḥ ॥32॥
slp1: tato raTaM navaM SuBraM kambalAjinasaMvftam । yuktaM zoqaSaBirgoBiH pARqurEH SuBalakzaREH ॥32॥

text: mantrairabhyarcitaḥ puṇyaiḥ stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ । āruroha yathā devaḥ somo'mṛtamayaṃ ratham ॥33॥
html:
mantrairabhyarcitaḥ puṇyaiḥ stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ ।
āruroha yathā devaḥ somo'mṛtamayaṃ ratham ॥33॥
slp1: mantrEraByarcitaH puRyEH stUyamAno maharziBiH । Aruroha yaTA devaH somo'mftamayaM raTam ॥33॥

text: jagrāha raśmīnkaunteyo bhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ । arjunaḥ pāṇḍuraṃ chatraṃ dhārayāmāsa bhānumat ॥34॥
html:
jagrāha raśmīnkaunteyo bhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ ।
arjunaḥ pāṇḍuraṃ chatraṃ dhārayāmāsa bhānumat ॥34॥
slp1: jagrAha raSmInkOnteyo BImo BImaparAkramaH । arjunaH pARquraM CatraM DArayAmAsa BAnumat ॥34॥

text: dhriyamāṇaṃ tu tacchatraṃ pāṇḍuraṃ tasya mūrdhani । śuśubhe tārakārājasitamabhramivāmbare ॥35॥
html:
dhriyamāṇaṃ tu tacchatraṃ pāṇḍuraṃ tasya mūrdhani ।
śuśubhe tārakārājasitamabhramivāmbare ॥35॥
slp1: DriyamARaM tu tacCatraM pARquraM tasya mUrDani । SuSuBe tArakArAjasitamaBramivAmbare ॥35॥

text: cāmaravyajane cāsya vīrau jagṛhatustadā । candraraśmiprabhe śubhre mādrīputrāvalaṅkṛte ॥36॥
html:
cāmaravyajane cāsya vīrau jagṛhatustadā ।
candraraśmiprabhe śubhre mādrīputrāvalaṅkṛte ॥36॥
slp1: cAmaravyajane cAsya vIrO jagfhatustadA । candraraSmipraBe SuBre mAdrIputrAvalaNkfte ॥36॥

text: te pañca rathamāsthāya bhrātaraḥ samalaṅkṛtāḥ । bhūtānīva samastāni rājandadṛśire tadā ॥37॥
html:
te pañca rathamāsthāya bhrātaraḥ samalaṅkṛtāḥ ।
bhūtānīva samastāni rājandadṛśire tadā ॥37॥
slp1: te paYca raTamAsTAya BrAtaraH samalaNkftAH । BUtAnIva samastAni rAjandadfSire tadA ॥37॥

text: āsthāya tu rathaṃ śubhraṃ yuktamaśvairmahājavaiḥ । anvayātpṛṣṭhato rājanyuyutsuḥ pāṇḍavāgrajam ॥38॥
html:
āsthāya tu rathaṃ śubhraṃ yuktamaśvairmahājavaiḥ ।
anvayātpṛṣṭhato rājanyuyutsuḥ pāṇḍavāgrajam ॥38॥
slp1: AsTAya tu raTaM SuBraM yuktamaSvErmahAjavEH । anvayAtpfzWato rAjanyuyutsuH pARqavAgrajam ॥38॥

text: rathaṃ hemamayaṃ śubhraṃ sainyasugrīvayojitam । saha sātyakinā kṛṣṇaḥ samāsthāyānvayātkurūn ॥39॥
html:
rathaṃ hemamayaṃ śubhraṃ sainyasugrīvayojitam ।
saha sātyakinā kṛṣṇaḥ samāsthāyānvayātkurūn ॥39॥
slp1: raTaM hemamayaM SuBraM sEnyasugrIvayojitam । saha sAtyakinA kfzRaH samAsTAyAnvayAtkurUn ॥39॥

text: narayānena tu jyeṣṭhaḥ pitā pārthasya bhārata । agrato dharmarājasya gāndhārīsahito yayau ॥40॥
html:
narayānena tu jyeṣṭhaḥ pitā pārthasya bhārata ।
agrato dharmarājasya gāndhārīsahito yayau ॥40॥
slp1: narayAnena tu jyezWaH pitA pArTasya BArata । agrato DarmarAjasya gAnDArIsahito yayO ॥40॥

text: kurustriyaśca tāḥ sarvāḥ kuntī kṛṣṇā ca draupadī । yānairuccāvacairjagmurvidureṇa puraskṛtāḥ ॥41॥
html:
kurustriyaśca tāḥ sarvāḥ kuntī kṛṣṇā ca draupadī ।
yānairuccāvacairjagmurvidureṇa puraskṛtāḥ ॥41॥
slp1: kurustriyaSca tAH sarvAH kuntI kfzRA ca drOpadI । yAnEruccAvacErjagmurvidureRa puraskftAH ॥41॥

text: tato rathāśca bahulā nāgāśca samalaṅkṛtāḥ । pādātāśca hayāścaiva pṛṣṭhataḥ samanuvrajan ॥42॥
html:
tato rathāśca bahulā nāgāśca samalaṅkṛtāḥ ।
pādātāśca hayāścaiva pṛṣṭhataḥ samanuvrajan ॥42॥
slp1: tato raTASca bahulA nAgASca samalaNkftAH । pAdAtASca hayAScEva pfzWataH samanuvrajan ॥42॥

text: tato vaitālikaiḥ sūtairmāgadhaiśca subhāṣitaiḥ । stūyamāno yayau rājā nagaraṃ nāgasāhvayam ॥43॥
html:
tato vaitālikaiḥ sūtairmāgadhaiśca subhāṣitaiḥ ।
stūyamāno yayau rājā nagaraṃ nāgasāhvayam ॥43॥
slp1: tato vEtAlikEH sUtErmAgaDESca suBAzitEH । stUyamAno yayO rAjA nagaraM nAgasAhvayam ॥43॥

text: tatprayāṇaṃ mahābāhorbabhūvāpratimaṃ bhuvi । ākulākulamutsṛṣṭaṃ hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanānvitam ॥44॥
html:
tatprayāṇaṃ mahābāhorbabhūvāpratimaṃ bhuvi ।
ākulākulamutsṛṣṭaṃ hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanānvitam ॥44॥
slp1: tatprayARaM mahAbAhorbaBUvApratimaM Buvi । AkulAkulamutsfzwaM hfzwapuzwajanAnvitam ॥44॥

text: abhiyāne tu pārthasya narairnagaravāsibhiḥ । nagaraṃ rājamārgaśca yathāvatsamalaṅkṛtam ॥45॥
html:
abhiyāne tu pārthasya narairnagaravāsibhiḥ ।
nagaraṃ rājamārgaśca yathāvatsamalaṅkṛtam ॥45॥
slp1: aBiyAne tu pArTasya narErnagaravAsiBiH । nagaraM rAjamArgaSca yaTAvatsamalaNkftam ॥45॥

text: pāṇḍureṇa ca mālyena patākābhiśca vedibhiḥ । saṃvṛto rājamārgaśca dhūpanaiśca sudhūpitaḥ ॥46॥
html:
pāṇḍureṇa ca mālyena patākābhiśca vedibhiḥ ।
saṃvṛto rājamārgaśca dhūpanaiśca sudhūpitaḥ ॥46॥
slp1: pARqureRa ca mAlyena patAkABiSca vediBiH । saMvfto rAjamArgaSca DUpanESca suDUpitaH ॥46॥

text: atha cūrṇaiśca gandhānāṃ nānāpuṣpaiḥ priyaṅgubhiḥ । mālyadāmabhirāsaktai rājaveśmābhisaṃvṛtam ॥47॥
html:
atha cūrṇaiśca gandhānāṃ nānāpuṣpaiḥ priyaṅgubhiḥ ।
mālyadāmabhirāsaktai rājaveśmābhisaṃvṛtam ॥47॥
slp1: aTa cUrRESca ganDAnAM nAnApuzpEH priyaNguBiH । mAlyadAmaBirAsaktE rAjaveSmABisaMvftam ॥47॥

text: kumbhāśca nagaradvāri vāripūrṇā dṛḍhā navāḥ । kanyāḥ sumanasaśchāgāḥ sthāpitāstatra tatra ha ॥48॥
html:
kumbhāśca nagaradvāri vāripūrṇā dṛḍhā navāḥ ।
kanyāḥ sumanasaśchāgāḥ sthāpitāstatra tatra ha ॥48॥
slp1: kumBASca nagaradvAri vAripUrRA dfQA navAH । kanyAH sumanasaSCAgAH sTApitAstatra tatra ha ॥48॥

text: tathā svalaṅkṛtadvāraṃ nagaraṃ pāṇḍunandanaḥ । stūyamānaḥ śubhairvākyaiḥ praviveśa suhṛdvṛtaḥ] ॥49॥
html:
tathā svalaṅkṛtadvāraṃ nagaraṃ pāṇḍunandanaḥ ।
stūyamānaḥ śubhairvākyaiḥ praviveśa suhṛdvṛtaḥ] ॥49॥
slp1: taTA svalaNkftadvAraM nagaraM pARqunandanaH । stUyamAnaH SuBErvAkyEH praviveSa suhfdvftaH] ॥49॥

text: praveśane tu pārthānāṃ janasya puravāsinaḥ । didṛkṣūṇāṃ sahasrāṇi samājagmurbahūnyatha ॥1॥
html:
praveśane tu pārthānāṃ janasya puravāsinaḥ ।
didṛkṣūṇāṃ sahasrāṇi samājagmurbahūnyatha ॥1॥
slp1: praveSane tu pArTAnAM janasya puravAsinaH । didfkzURAM sahasrARi samAjagmurbahUnyaTa ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: sa rājamārgaḥ śuśubhe samalaṅkṛtacatvaraḥ । yathā candrodaye rājanvardhamāno mahodadhiḥ ॥2॥
html:
sa rājamārgaḥ śuśubhe samalaṅkṛtacatvaraḥ ।
yathā candrodaye rājanvardhamāno mahodadhiḥ ॥2॥
slp1: sa rAjamArgaH SuSuBe samalaNkftacatvaraH । yaTA candrodaye rAjanvarDamAno mahodaDiH ॥2॥

text: gṛhāṇi rājamārge tu ratnavanti bṛhanti ca । prākampanteva bhāreṇa strīṇāṃ pūrṇāni bhārata ॥3॥
html:
gṛhāṇi rājamārge tu ratnavanti bṛhanti ca ।
prākampanteva bhāreṇa strīṇāṃ pūrṇāni bhārata ॥3॥
slp1: gfhARi rAjamArge tu ratnavanti bfhanti ca । prAkampanteva BAreRa strIRAM pUrRAni BArata ॥3॥

text: tāḥ śanairiva savrīḍaṃ praśaśaṃsuryudhiṣṭhiram । bhīmasenārjunau caiva mādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau ॥4॥
html:
tāḥ śanairiva savrīḍaṃ praśaśaṃsuryudhiṣṭhiram ।
bhīmasenārjunau caiva mādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau ॥4॥
slp1: tAH SanEriva savrIqaM praSaSaMsuryuDizWiram । BImasenArjunO cEva mAdrIputrO ca pARqavO ॥4॥

text: dhanyā tvamasi pāñcāli yā tvaṃ puruṣasattamān । upatiṣṭhasi kalyāṇi maharṣīniva gautamī ॥5॥
html:
dhanyā tvamasi pāñcāli yā tvaṃ puruṣasattamān ।
upatiṣṭhasi kalyāṇi maharṣīniva gautamī ॥5॥
slp1: DanyA tvamasi pAYcAli yA tvaM puruzasattamAn । upatizWasi kalyARi maharzIniva gOtamI ॥5॥

text: tava karmāṇyamoghāni vratacaryā ca bhāmini । iti kṛṣṇāṃ mahārāja praśaśaṃsustadā striyaḥ ॥6॥
html:
tava karmāṇyamoghāni vratacaryā ca bhāmini ।
iti kṛṣṇāṃ mahārāja praśaśaṃsustadā striyaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: tava karmARyamoGAni vratacaryA ca BAmini । iti kfzRAM mahArAja praSaSaMsustadA striyaH ॥6॥

text: praśaṃsāvacanaistāsāṃ mithaḥśabdaiśca bhārata । prītijaiśca tadā śabdaiḥ puramāsītsamākulam ॥7॥
html:
praśaṃsāvacanaistāsāṃ mithaḥśabdaiśca bhārata ।
prītijaiśca tadā śabdaiḥ puramāsītsamākulam ॥7॥
slp1: praSaMsAvacanEstAsAM miTaHSabdESca BArata । prItijESca tadA SabdEH puramAsItsamAkulam ॥7॥

text: tamatītya yathāyuktaṃ rājamārgaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । alaṅkṛtaṃ śobhamānamupāyādrājaveśma ha ॥8॥
html:
tamatītya yathāyuktaṃ rājamārgaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।
alaṅkṛtaṃ śobhamānamupāyādrājaveśma ha ॥8॥
slp1: tamatItya yaTAyuktaM rAjamArgaM yuDizWiraH । alaNkftaM SoBamAnamupAyAdrAjaveSma ha ॥8॥

text: tataḥ prakṛtayaḥ sarvāḥ paurajānapadāstathā । ūcuḥ kathāḥ karṇasukhāḥ samupetya tatastataḥ ॥9॥
html:
tataḥ prakṛtayaḥ sarvāḥ paurajānapadāstathā ।
ūcuḥ kathāḥ karṇasukhāḥ samupetya tatastataḥ ॥9॥
slp1: tataH prakftayaH sarvAH pOrajAnapadAstaTA । UcuH kaTAH karRasuKAH samupetya tatastataH ॥9॥

text: diṣṭyā jayasi rājendra śatrūñśatrunisūdana । diṣṭyā rājyaṃ punaḥ prāptaṃ dharmeṇa ca balena ca ॥10॥
html:
diṣṭyā jayasi rājendra śatrūñśatrunisūdana ।
diṣṭyā rājyaṃ punaḥ prāptaṃ dharmeṇa ca balena ca ॥10॥
slp1: dizwyA jayasi rAjendra SatrUYSatrunisUdana । dizwyA rAjyaM punaH prAptaM DarmeRa ca balena ca ॥10॥

text: bhava nastvaṃ mahārāja rājeha śaradāṃ śatam । prajāḥ pālaya dharmeṇa yathendrastridivaṃ nṛpa ॥11॥
html:
bhava nastvaṃ mahārāja rājeha śaradāṃ śatam ।
prajāḥ pālaya dharmeṇa yathendrastridivaṃ nṛpa ॥11॥
slp1: Bava nastvaM mahArAja rAjeha SaradAM Satam । prajAH pAlaya DarmeRa yaTendrastridivaM nfpa ॥11॥

text: evaṃ rājakuladvāri maṅgalairabhipūjitaḥ । āśīrvādāndvijairuktānpratigṛhya samantataḥ ॥12॥
html:
evaṃ rājakuladvāri maṅgalairabhipūjitaḥ ।
āśīrvādāndvijairuktānpratigṛhya samantataḥ ॥12॥
slp1: evaM rAjakuladvAri maNgalEraBipUjitaH । ASIrvAdAndvijEruktAnpratigfhya samantataH ॥12॥

text: praviśya bhavanaṃ rājā devarājagṛhopamam । śrutvā vijayasaṃyuktaṃ rathātpaścādavātarat ॥13॥
html:
praviśya bhavanaṃ rājā devarājagṛhopamam ।
śrutvā vijayasaṃyuktaṃ rathātpaścādavātarat ॥13॥
slp1: praviSya BavanaM rAjA devarAjagfhopamam । SrutvA vijayasaMyuktaM raTAtpaScAdavAtarat ॥13॥

text: praviśyābhyantaraṃ śrīmāndaivatānyabhigamya ca । pūjayāmāsa ratnaiśca gandhairmālyaiśca sarvaśaḥ ॥14॥
html:
praviśyābhyantaraṃ śrīmāndaivatānyabhigamya ca ।
pūjayāmāsa ratnaiśca gandhairmālyaiśca sarvaśaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: praviSyAByantaraM SrImAndEvatAnyaBigamya ca । pUjayAmAsa ratnESca ganDErmAlyESca sarvaSaH ॥14॥

text: niścakrāma tataḥ śrīmānpunareva mahāyaśāḥ । dadarśa brāhmaṇāṃścaiva so'bhirūpānupasthitān ॥15॥
html:
niścakrāma tataḥ śrīmānpunareva mahāyaśāḥ ।
dadarśa brāhmaṇāṃścaiva so'bhirūpānupasthitān ॥15॥
slp1: niScakrAma tataH SrImAnpunareva mahAyaSAH । dadarSa brAhmaRAMScEva so'BirUpAnupasTitAn ॥15॥

text: sa saṃvṛtastadā viprairāśīrvādavivakṣubhiḥ । śuśubhe vimalaścandrastārāgaṇavṛto yathā ॥16॥
html:
sa saṃvṛtastadā viprairāśīrvādavivakṣubhiḥ ।
śuśubhe vimalaścandrastārāgaṇavṛto yathā ॥16॥
slp1: sa saMvftastadA viprErASIrvAdavivakzuBiH । SuSuBe vimalaScandrastArAgaRavfto yaTA ॥16॥

text: tānsa sampūjayāmāsa kaunteyo vidhivaddvijān । dhaumyaṃ guruṃ puraskṛtya jyeṣṭhaṃ pitarameva ca ॥17॥
html:
tānsa sampūjayāmāsa kaunteyo vidhivaddvijān ।
dhaumyaṃ guruṃ puraskṛtya jyeṣṭhaṃ pitarameva ca ॥17॥
slp1: tAnsa sampUjayAmAsa kOnteyo viDivaddvijAn । DOmyaM guruM puraskftya jyezWaM pitarameva ca ॥17॥

text: sumanomodakai ratnairhiraṇyena ca bhūriṇā । gobhirvastraiśca rājendra vividhaiśca kimicchakaiḥ ॥18॥
html:
sumanomodakai ratnairhiraṇyena ca bhūriṇā ।
gobhirvastraiśca rājendra vividhaiśca kimicchakaiḥ ॥18॥
slp1: sumanomodakE ratnErhiraRyena ca BUriRA । goBirvastrESca rAjendra viviDESca kimicCakEH ॥18॥

text: tataḥ puṇyāhaghoṣo'bhūddivaṃ stabdhveva bhārata । suhṛdāṃ harṣajananaḥ puṇyaḥ śrutisukhāvahaḥ ॥19॥
html:
tataḥ puṇyāhaghoṣo'bhūddivaṃ stabdhveva bhārata ।
suhṛdāṃ harṣajananaḥ puṇyaḥ śrutisukhāvahaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: tataH puRyAhaGozo'BUddivaM stabDveva BArata । suhfdAM harzajananaH puRyaH SrutisuKAvahaH ॥19॥

text: haṃsavanneduṣāṃ rājandvijānāṃ tatra bhāratī । śuśruve vedaviduṣāṃ puṣkalārthapadākṣarā ॥20॥
html:
haṃsavanneduṣāṃ rājandvijānāṃ tatra bhāratī ।
śuśruve vedaviduṣāṃ puṣkalārthapadākṣarā ॥20॥
slp1: haMsavanneduzAM rAjandvijAnAM tatra BAratI । SuSruve vedaviduzAM puzkalArTapadAkzarA ॥20॥

text: tato dundubhinirghoṣaḥ śaṅkhānāṃ ca manoramaḥ । jayaṃ pravadatāṃ tatra svanaḥ prādurabhūnnṛpa ॥21॥
html:
tato dundubhinirghoṣaḥ śaṅkhānāṃ ca manoramaḥ ।
jayaṃ pravadatāṃ tatra svanaḥ prādurabhūnnṛpa ॥21॥
slp1: tato dunduBinirGozaH SaNKAnAM ca manoramaH । jayaM pravadatAM tatra svanaH prAduraBUnnfpa ॥21॥

text: niḥśabde ca sthite tatra tato viprajane punaḥ । rājānaṃ brāhmaṇacchadmā cārvāko rākṣaso'bravīt ॥22॥
html:
niḥśabde ca sthite tatra tato viprajane punaḥ ।
rājānaṃ brāhmaṇacchadmā cārvāko rākṣaso'bravīt ॥22॥
slp1: niHSabde ca sTite tatra tato viprajane punaH । rAjAnaM brAhmaRacCadmA cArvAko rAkzaso'bravIt ॥22॥

text: tatra duryodhanasakhā bhikṣurūpeṇa saṃvṛtaḥ । sāṅkhyaḥ śikhī tridaṇḍī ca dhṛṣṭo vigatasādhvasaḥ ॥23॥
html:
tatra duryodhanasakhā bhikṣurūpeṇa saṃvṛtaḥ ।
sāṅkhyaḥ śikhī tridaṇḍī ca dhṛṣṭo vigatasādhvasaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: tatra duryoDanasaKA BikzurUpeRa saMvftaH । sANKyaH SiKI tridaRqI ca Dfzwo vigatasADvasaH ॥23॥

text: vṛtaḥ sarvaistadā viprairāśīrvādavivakṣubhiḥ । paraṃsahasrai rājendra taponiyamasaṃsthitaiḥ ॥24॥
html:
vṛtaḥ sarvaistadā viprairāśīrvādavivakṣubhiḥ ।
paraṃsahasrai rājendra taponiyamasaṃsthitaiḥ ॥24॥
slp1: vftaH sarvEstadA viprErASIrvAdavivakzuBiH । paraMsahasrE rAjendra taponiyamasaMsTitEH ॥24॥

text: sa duṣṭaḥ pāpamāśaṃsanpāṇḍavānāṃ mahātmanām । anāmantryaiva tānviprāṃstamuvāca mahīpatim ॥25॥
html:
sa duṣṭaḥ pāpamāśaṃsanpāṇḍavānāṃ mahātmanām ।
anāmantryaiva tānviprāṃstamuvāca mahīpatim ॥25॥
slp1: sa duzwaH pApamASaMsanpARqavAnAM mahAtmanAm । anAmantryEva tAnviprAMstamuvAca mahIpatim ॥25॥

text: ime prāhurdvijāḥ sarve samāropya vaco mayi । dhigbhavantaṃ kunṛpatiṃ jñātighātinamastu vai ॥26॥
html:
ime prāhurdvijāḥ sarve samāropya vaco mayi ।
dhigbhavantaṃ kunṛpatiṃ jñātighātinamastu vai ॥26॥
slp1: ime prAhurdvijAH sarve samAropya vaco mayi । DigBavantaM kunfpatiM jYAtiGAtinamastu vE ॥26॥

text: kiṃ te rājyena kaunteya kṛtvemaṃ jñātisaṅkṣayam । ghātayitvā gurūṃścaiva mṛtaṃ śreyo na jīvitam ॥27॥
html:
kiṃ te rājyena kaunteya kṛtvemaṃ jñātisaṅkṣayam ।
ghātayitvā gurūṃścaiva mṛtaṃ śreyo na jīvitam ॥27॥
slp1: kiM te rAjyena kOnteya kftvemaM jYAtisaNkzayam । GAtayitvA gurUMScEva mftaM Sreyo na jIvitam ॥27॥

text: iti te vai dvijāḥ śrutvā tasya ghorasya rakṣasaḥ । vivyathuścukruśuścaiva tasya vākyapradharṣitāḥ ॥28॥
html:
iti te vai dvijāḥ śrutvā tasya ghorasya rakṣasaḥ ।
vivyathuścukruśuścaiva tasya vākyapradharṣitāḥ ॥28॥
slp1: iti te vE dvijAH SrutvA tasya Gorasya rakzasaH । vivyaTuScukruSuScEva tasya vAkyapraDarzitAH ॥28॥

text: tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve sa ca rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । vrīḍitāḥ paramodvignāstūṣṇīmāsanviśāmpate ॥29॥
html:
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve sa ca rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।
vrīḍitāḥ paramodvignāstūṣṇīmāsanviśāmpate ॥29॥
slp1: tataste brAhmaRAH sarve sa ca rAjA yuDizWiraH । vrIqitAH paramodvignAstUzRImAsanviSAmpate ॥29॥

text: prasīdantu bhavanto me praṇatasyābhiyācataḥ । pratyāpannaṃ vyasaninaṃ na māṃ dhikkartumarhatha ॥30॥
html:
prasīdantu bhavanto me praṇatasyābhiyācataḥ ।
pratyāpannaṃ vyasaninaṃ na māṃ dhikkartumarhatha ॥30॥
slp1: prasIdantu Bavanto me praRatasyABiyAcataH । pratyApannaM vyasaninaM na mAM DikkartumarhaTa ॥30॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: tato rājanbrāhmaṇāste sarva eva viśāmpate । ūcurnaitadvaco'smākaṃ śrīrastu tava pārthiva ॥31॥
html:
tato rājanbrāhmaṇāste sarva eva viśāmpate ।
ūcurnaitadvaco'smākaṃ śrīrastu tava pārthiva ॥31॥
slp1: tato rAjanbrAhmaRAste sarva eva viSAmpate । UcurnEtadvaco'smAkaM SrIrastu tava pArTiva ॥31॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: jajñuścaiva mahātmānastatastaṃ jñānacakṣuṣā । brāhmaṇā vedavidvāṃsastapobhirvimalīkṛtāḥ ॥32॥
html:
jajñuścaiva mahātmānastatastaṃ jñānacakṣuṣā ।
brāhmaṇā vedavidvāṃsastapobhirvimalīkṛtāḥ ॥32॥
slp1: jajYuScEva mahAtmAnastatastaM jYAnacakzuzA । brAhmaRA vedavidvAMsastapoBirvimalIkftAH ॥32॥

text: eṣa duryodhanasakhā cārvāko nāma rākṣasaḥ । parivrājakarūpeṇa hitaṃ tasya cikīrṣati ॥33॥
html:
eṣa duryodhanasakhā cārvāko nāma rākṣasaḥ ।
parivrājakarūpeṇa hitaṃ tasya cikīrṣati ॥33॥
slp1: eza duryoDanasaKA cArvAko nAma rAkzasaH । parivrAjakarUpeRa hitaM tasya cikIrzati ॥33॥
author: brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ ।

text: na vayaṃ brūma dharmātmanvyetu te bhayamīdṛśam । upatiṣṭhatu kalyāṇaṃ bhavantaṃ bhrātṛbhiḥ saha ॥34॥
html:
na vayaṃ brūma dharmātmanvyetu te bhayamīdṛśam ।
upatiṣṭhatu kalyāṇaṃ bhavantaṃ bhrātṛbhiḥ saha ॥34॥
slp1: na vayaM brUma DarmAtmanvyetu te BayamIdfSam । upatizWatu kalyARaM BavantaM BrAtfBiH saha ॥34॥

text: tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve huṅkāraiḥ krodhamūrchitāḥ । nirbhartsayantaḥ śucayo nijaghnuḥ pāparākṣasam ॥35॥
html:
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve huṅkāraiḥ krodhamūrchitāḥ ।
nirbhartsayantaḥ śucayo nijaghnuḥ pāparākṣasam ॥35॥
slp1: tataste brAhmaRAH sarve huNkArEH kroDamUrCitAH । nirBartsayantaH Sucayo nijaGnuH pAparAkzasam ॥35॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: sa papāta vinirdagdhastejasā brahmavādinām । mahendrāśaninirdagdhaḥ pādapo'ṅkuravāniva ॥36॥
html:
sa papāta vinirdagdhastejasā brahmavādinām ।
mahendrāśaninirdagdhaḥ pādapo'ṅkuravāniva ॥36॥
slp1: sa papAta vinirdagDastejasA brahmavAdinAm । mahendrASaninirdagDaH pAdapo'NkuravAniva ॥36॥

text: pūjitāśca yayurviprā rājānamabhinandya tam । rājā ca harṣamāpede pāṇḍavaḥ sasuhṛjjanaḥ ॥37॥
html:
pūjitāśca yayurviprā rājānamabhinandya tam ।
rājā ca harṣamāpede pāṇḍavaḥ sasuhṛjjanaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: pUjitASca yayurviprA rAjAnamaBinandya tam । rAjA ca harzamApede pARqavaH sasuhfjjanaH ॥37॥

text: brāhmaṇāstāta loke'sminnarcanīyāḥ sadā mama । ete bhūmicarā devā vāgviṣāḥ suprasādakāḥ ॥38॥
html:
brāhmaṇāstāta loke'sminnarcanīyāḥ sadā mama ।
ete bhūmicarā devā vāgviṣāḥ suprasādakāḥ ॥38॥
slp1: brAhmaRAstAta loke'sminnarcanIyAH sadA mama । ete BUmicarA devA vAgvizAH suprasAdakAH ॥38॥
author: vāsudeva uvāca ।

text: purā kṛtayuge tāta cārvāko nāma rākṣasaḥ । tapastepe mahābāho badaryāṃ bahuvatsaram ॥39॥
html:
purā kṛtayuge tāta cārvāko nāma rākṣasaḥ ।
tapastepe mahābāho badaryāṃ bahuvatsaram ॥39॥
slp1: purA kftayuge tAta cArvAko nAma rAkzasaH । tapastepe mahAbAho badaryAM bahuvatsaram ॥39॥

text: chandyamāno vareṇātha brahmaṇā sa punaḥ punaḥ । abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo varayāmāsa bhārata ॥40॥
html:
chandyamāno vareṇātha brahmaṇā sa punaḥ punaḥ ।
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo varayāmāsa bhārata ॥40॥
slp1: CandyamAno vareRATa brahmaRA sa punaH punaH । aBayaM sarvaBUteByo varayAmAsa BArata ॥40॥

text: dvijāvamānādanyatra prādādvaramanuttamam । abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyastatastasmai jagatprabhuḥ ॥41॥
html:
dvijāvamānādanyatra prādādvaramanuttamam ।
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyastatastasmai jagatprabhuḥ ॥41॥
slp1: dvijAvamAnAdanyatra prAdAdvaramanuttamam । aBayaM sarvaBUteByastatastasmE jagatpraBuH ॥41॥

text: sa tu labdhavaraḥ pāpo devānamitavikramaḥ । rākṣasastāpayāmāsa tīvrakarmā mahābalaḥ ॥42॥
html:
sa tu labdhavaraḥ pāpo devānamitavikramaḥ ।
rākṣasastāpayāmāsa tīvrakarmā mahābalaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: sa tu labDavaraH pApo devAnamitavikramaH । rAkzasastApayAmAsa tIvrakarmA mahAbalaH ॥42॥

text: tato devāḥ sametyātha brahmāṇamidamabruvan । vadhāya rakṣasastasya balaviprakṛtāstadā ॥43॥
html:
tato devāḥ sametyātha brahmāṇamidamabruvan ।
vadhāya rakṣasastasya balaviprakṛtāstadā ॥43॥
slp1: tato devAH sametyATa brahmARamidamabruvan । vaDAya rakzasastasya balaviprakftAstadA ॥43॥

text: tānuvācāvyayo devo vihitaṃ tatra vai mayā । yathāsya bhavitā mṛtyuracireṇaiva bhārata ॥44॥
html:
tānuvācāvyayo devo vihitaṃ tatra vai mayā ।
yathāsya bhavitā mṛtyuracireṇaiva bhārata ॥44॥
slp1: tAnuvAcAvyayo devo vihitaM tatra vE mayA । yaTAsya BavitA mftyuracireREva BArata ॥44॥

text: rājā duryodhano nāma sakhāsya bhavitā nṛpa । tasya snehāvabaddho'sau brāhmaṇānavamaṃsyate ॥45॥
html:
rājā duryodhano nāma sakhāsya bhavitā nṛpa ।
tasya snehāvabaddho'sau brāhmaṇānavamaṃsyate ॥45॥
slp1: rAjA duryoDano nAma saKAsya BavitA nfpa । tasya snehAvabadDo'sO brAhmaRAnavamaMsyate ॥45॥

text: tatrainaṃ ruṣitā viprā viprakārapradharṣitāḥ । dhakṣyanti vāgbalāḥ pāpaṃ tato nāśaṃ gamiṣyati ॥46॥
html:
tatrainaṃ ruṣitā viprā viprakārapradharṣitāḥ ।
dhakṣyanti vāgbalāḥ pāpaṃ tato nāśaṃ gamiṣyati ॥46॥
slp1: tatrEnaM ruzitA viprA viprakArapraDarzitAH । Dakzyanti vAgbalAH pApaM tato nASaM gamizyati ॥46॥

text: sa eṣa nihataḥ śete brahmadaṇḍena rākṣasaḥ । cārvāko nṛpatiśreṣṭha mā śuco bharatarṣabha ॥47॥
html:
sa eṣa nihataḥ śete brahmadaṇḍena rākṣasaḥ ।
cārvāko nṛpatiśreṣṭha mā śuco bharatarṣabha ॥47॥
slp1: sa eza nihataH Sete brahmadaRqena rAkzasaH । cArvAko nfpatiSrezWa mA Suco BaratarzaBa ॥47॥

text: hatāste kṣatradharmeṇa jñātayastava pārthiva । svargatāśca mahātmāno vīrāḥ kṣatriyapuṅgavāḥ ॥48॥
html:
hatāste kṣatradharmeṇa jñātayastava pārthiva ।
svargatāśca mahātmāno vīrāḥ kṣatriyapuṅgavāḥ ॥48॥
slp1: hatAste kzatraDarmeRa jYAtayastava pArTiva । svargatASca mahAtmAno vIrAH kzatriyapuNgavAH ॥48॥

text: sa tvamātiṣṭha kalyāṇaṃ mā te bhūdglāniracyuta । śatrūñjahi prajā rakṣa dvijāṃśca pratipālaya] ॥49॥
html:
sa tvamātiṣṭha kalyāṇaṃ mā te bhūdglāniracyuta ।
śatrūñjahi prajā rakṣa dvijāṃśca pratipālaya] ॥49॥
slp1: sa tvamAtizWa kalyARaM mA te BUdglAniracyuta । SatrUYjahi prajA rakza dvijAMSca pratipAlaya] ॥49॥

text: tataḥ kuntīsuto rājā gatamanyurgatajvaraḥ । kāñcane prāṅmukho hṛṣṭo nyaṣīdatparamāsane ॥1॥
html:
tataḥ kuntīsuto rājā gatamanyurgatajvaraḥ ।
kāñcane prāṅmukho hṛṣṭo nyaṣīdatparamāsane ॥1॥
slp1: tataH kuntIsuto rAjA gatamanyurgatajvaraH । kAYcane prANmuKo hfzwo nyazIdatparamAsane ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: tamevābhimukhau pīṭhe sevyāstaraṇasaṃvṛte । sātyakirvāsudevaśca niṣīdaturarindamau ॥2॥
html:
tamevābhimukhau pīṭhe sevyāstaraṇasaṃvṛte ।
sātyakirvāsudevaśca niṣīdaturarindamau ॥2॥

sarvakāmaguṇopetamannaṃ gāśca dhanāni ca ।
ratnāni ca vicitrāṇi mahārhāṇi mahāyaśāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: DftarAzwro dadO rAjA putrARAmOrDvadehikam । sarvakAmaguRopetamannaM gASca DanAni ca । ratnAni ca vicitrARi mahArhARi mahAyaSAH ॥2॥

text: yudhiṣṭhirastu karṇasya droṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ । dhṛṣṭadyumnābhimanyubhyāṃ haiḍimbasya ca rakṣasaḥ ॥3॥
html:
yudhiṣṭhirastu karṇasya droṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ ।
dhṛṣṭadyumnābhimanyubhyāṃ haiḍimbasya ca rakṣasaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: yuDizWirastu karRasya droRasya ca mahAtmanaH । DfzwadyumnABimanyuByAM hEqimbasya ca rakzasaH ॥3॥

text: virāṭaprabhṛtīnāṃ ca suhṛdāmupakāriṇām । drupadadraupadeyānāṃ draupadyā sahito dadau ॥4॥
html:
virāṭaprabhṛtīnāṃ ca suhṛdāmupakāriṇām ।
drupadadraupadeyānāṃ draupadyā sahito dadau ॥4॥
slp1: virAwapraBftInAM ca suhfdAmupakAriRAm । drupadadrOpadeyAnAM drOpadyA sahito dadO ॥4॥

text: brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasrāṇi pṛthagekaikamuddiśan । dhanaiśca vastrai ratnaiśca gobhiśca samatarpayat ॥5॥
html:
brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasrāṇi pṛthagekaikamuddiśan ।
dhanaiśca vastrai ratnaiśca gobhiśca samatarpayat ॥5॥
slp1: brAhmaRAnAM sahasrARi pfTagekEkamuddiSan । DanESca vastrE ratnESca goBiSca samatarpayat ॥5॥

text: ye cānye pṛthivīpālā yeṣāṃ nāsti suhṛjjanaḥ । uddiśyoddiśya teṣāṃ ca cakre rājaurdhvadaihikam ॥6॥
html:
ye cānye pṛthivīpālā yeṣāṃ nāsti suhṛjjanaḥ ।
uddiśyoddiśya teṣāṃ ca cakre rājaurdhvadaihikam ॥6॥
slp1: ye cAnye pfTivIpAlA yezAM nAsti suhfjjanaH । uddiSyoddiSya tezAM ca cakre rAjOrDvadEhikam ॥6॥

text: sabhāḥ prapāśca vividhāstaḍāgāni ca pāṇḍavaḥ । suhṛdāṃ kārayāmāsa sarveṣāmaurdhvadaihikam ॥7॥
html:
sabhāḥ prapāśca vividhāstaḍāgāni ca pāṇḍavaḥ ।
suhṛdāṃ kārayāmāsa sarveṣāmaurdhvadaihikam ॥7॥
slp1: saBAH prapASca viviDAstaqAgAni ca pARqavaH । suhfdAM kArayAmAsa sarvezAmOrDvadEhikam ॥7॥

text: sa teṣāmanṛṇo bhūtvā gatvā lokeṣvavācyatām । kṛtakṛtyo'bhavadrājā prajā dharmeṇa pālayan ॥8॥
html:
sa teṣāmanṛṇo bhūtvā gatvā lokeṣvavācyatām ।
kṛtakṛtyo'bhavadrājā prajā dharmeṇa pālayan ॥8॥
slp1: sa tezAmanfRo BUtvA gatvA lokezvavAcyatAm । kftakftyo'BavadrAjA prajA DarmeRa pAlayan ॥8॥

text: dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ yathāpūrvaṃ gāndhārīṃ viduraṃ tathā । sarvāṃśca kauravāmātyānbhṛtyāṃśca samapūjayat ॥9॥
html:
dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ yathāpūrvaṃ gāndhārīṃ viduraṃ tathā ।
sarvāṃśca kauravāmātyānbhṛtyāṃśca samapūjayat ॥9॥
slp1: DftarAzwraM yaTApUrvaM gAnDArIM viduraM taTA । sarvAMSca kOravAmAtyAnBftyAMSca samapUjayat ॥9॥

text: yāśca tatra striyaḥ kāściddhatavīrā hatātmajāḥ । sarvāstāḥ kauravo rājā sampūjyāpālayadghṛṇī ॥10॥
html:
yāśca tatra striyaḥ kāściddhatavīrā hatātmajāḥ ।
sarvāstāḥ kauravo rājā sampūjyāpālayadghṛṇī ॥10॥
slp1: yASca tatra striyaH kAScidDatavIrA hatAtmajAH । sarvAstAH kOravo rAjA sampUjyApAlayadGfRI ॥10॥

text: dīnāndhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca gṛhācchādanabhojanaiḥ । ānṛśaṃsyaparo rājā cakārānugrahaṃ prabhuḥ ॥11॥
html:
dīnāndhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca gṛhācchādanabhojanaiḥ ।
ānṛśaṃsyaparo rājā cakārānugrahaṃ prabhuḥ ॥11॥
slp1: dInAnDakfpaRAnAM ca gfhAcCAdanaBojanEH । AnfSaMsyaparo rAjA cakArAnugrahaM praBuH ॥11॥

text: sa vijitya mahīṃ kṛtsnāmānṛṇyaṃ prāpya vairiṣu । niḥsapatnaḥ sukhī rājā vijahāra yudhiṣṭhiraḥ] ॥12॥
html:
sa vijitya mahīṃ kṛtsnāmānṛṇyaṃ prāpya vairiṣu ।
niḥsapatnaḥ sukhī rājā vijahāra yudhiṣṭhiraḥ] ॥12॥
slp1: sa vijitya mahIM kftsnAmAnfRyaM prApya vErizu । niHsapatnaH suKI rAjA vijahAra yuDizWiraH] ॥12॥

text: abhiṣikto mahāprājño rājyaṃ prāpya yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । dāśārhaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣamuvāca prāñjaliḥ śuciḥ ॥1॥
html:
abhiṣikto mahāprājño rājyaṃ prāpya yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।
dāśārhaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣamuvāca prāñjaliḥ śuciḥ ॥1॥
slp1: aBizikto mahAprAjYo rAjyaM prApya yuDizWiraH । dASArhaM puRqarIkAkzamuvAca prAYjaliH SuciH ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: tava kṛṣṇa prasādena nayena ca balena ca । buddhyā ca yaduśārdūla tathā vikramaṇena ca ॥2॥
html:
tava kṛṣṇa prasādena nayena ca balena ca ।
buddhyā ca yaduśārdūla tathā vikramaṇena ca ॥2॥
slp1: tava kfzRa prasAdena nayena ca balena ca । budDyA ca yaduSArdUla taTA vikramaRena ca ॥2॥

text: punaḥ prāptamidaṃ rājyaṃ pitṛpaitāmahaṃ mayā । namaste puṇḍarīkākṣa punaḥ punararindama ॥3॥
html:
punaḥ prāptamidaṃ rājyaṃ pitṛpaitāmahaṃ mayā ।
namaste puṇḍarīkākṣa punaḥ punararindama ॥3॥
slp1: punaH prAptamidaM rAjyaM pitfpEtAmahaM mayA । namaste puRqarIkAkza punaH punararindama ॥3॥

text: tvāmekamāhuḥ puruṣaṃ tvāmāhuḥ sātvatāṃ patim । nāmabhistvāṃ bahuvidhaiḥ stuvanti paramarṣayaḥ ॥4॥
html:
tvāmekamāhuḥ puruṣaṃ tvāmāhuḥ sātvatāṃ patim ।
nāmabhistvāṃ bahuvidhaiḥ stuvanti paramarṣayaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: tvAmekamAhuH puruzaM tvAmAhuH sAtvatAM patim । nAmaBistvAM bahuviDEH stuvanti paramarzayaH ॥4॥

text: viśvakarmannamaste'stu viśvātmanviśvasambhava । viṣṇo jiṣṇo hare kṛṣṇa vaikuṇṭha puruṣottama ॥5॥
html:
viśvakarmannamaste'stu viśvātmanviśvasambhava ।
viṣṇo jiṣṇo hare kṛṣṇa vaikuṇṭha puruṣottama ॥5॥
slp1: viSvakarmannamaste'stu viSvAtmanviSvasamBava । vizRo jizRo hare kfzRa vEkuRWa puruzottama ॥5॥

text: adityāḥ saptarātraṃ tu purāṇe garbhatāṃ gataḥ । pṛśnigarbhastvamevaikastriyugaṃ tvāṃ vadantyapi ॥6॥
html:
adityāḥ saptarātraṃ tu purāṇe garbhatāṃ gataḥ ।
pṛśnigarbhastvamevaikastriyugaṃ tvāṃ vadantyapi ॥6॥
slp1: adityAH saptarAtraM tu purARe garBatAM gataH । pfSnigarBastvamevEkastriyugaM tvAM vadantyapi ॥6॥

text: śuciśravā hṛṣīkeśo ghṛtārcirhaṃsa ucyase । tricakṣuḥ śambhurekastvaṃ vibhurdāmodaro'pi ca ॥7॥
html:
śuciśravā hṛṣīkeśo ghṛtārcirhaṃsa ucyase ।
tricakṣuḥ śambhurekastvaṃ vibhurdāmodaro'pi ca ॥7॥
slp1: SuciSravA hfzIkeSo GftArcirhaMsa ucyase । tricakzuH SamBurekastvaM viBurdAmodaro'pi ca ॥7॥

text: varāho'gnirbṛhadbhānurvṛṣaṇastārkṣyalakṣaṇaḥ । anīkasāhaḥ puruṣaḥ śipiviṣṭa urukramaḥ ॥8॥
html:
varāho'gnirbṛhadbhānurvṛṣaṇastārkṣyalakṣaṇaḥ ।
anīkasāhaḥ puruṣaḥ śipiviṣṭa urukramaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: varAho'gnirbfhadBAnurvfzaRastArkzyalakzaRaH । anIkasAhaH puruzaH Sipivizwa urukramaH ॥8॥

text: vāciṣṭha ugraḥ senānīḥ satyo vājasanirguhaḥ । acyutaścyāvano'rīṇāṃ saṅkṛtirvikṛtirvṛṣaḥ ॥9॥
html:
vāciṣṭha ugraḥ senānīḥ satyo vājasanirguhaḥ ।
acyutaścyāvano'rīṇāṃ saṅkṛtirvikṛtirvṛṣaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: vAcizWa ugraH senAnIH satyo vAjasanirguhaH । acyutaScyAvano'rIRAM saNkftirvikftirvfzaH ॥9॥

text: kṛtavartmā tvamevādrirvṛṣagarbho vṛṣākapiḥ । sindhukṣidūrmistrikakuttridhāmā trivṛdacyutaḥ ॥10॥
html:
kṛtavartmā tvamevādrirvṛṣagarbho vṛṣākapiḥ ।
sindhukṣidūrmistrikakuttridhāmā trivṛdacyutaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: kftavartmA tvamevAdrirvfzagarBo vfzAkapiH । sinDukzidUrmistrikakuttriDAmA trivfdacyutaH ॥10॥

text: samrāḍvirāṭsvarāṭcaiva surarāḍdharmado bhavaḥ । vibhurbhūrabhibhūḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇavartmā tvameva ca ॥11॥
html:
samrāḍvirāṭsvarāṭcaiva surarāḍdharmado bhavaḥ ।
vibhurbhūrabhibhūḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇavartmā tvameva ca ॥11॥
slp1: samrAqvirAwsvarAwcEva surarAqDarmado BavaH । viBurBUraBiBUH kfzRaH kfzRavartmA tvameva ca ॥11॥

text: sviṣṭakṛdbhiṣagāvartaḥ kapilastvaṃ ca vāmanaḥ । yajño dhruvaḥ pataṅgaśca jayatsenastvamucyase ॥12॥
html:
sviṣṭakṛdbhiṣagāvartaḥ kapilastvaṃ ca vāmanaḥ ।
yajño dhruvaḥ pataṅgaśca jayatsenastvamucyase ॥12॥
slp1: svizwakfdBizagAvartaH kapilastvaM ca vAmanaH । yajYo DruvaH pataNgaSca jayatsenastvamucyase ॥12॥

text: śikhaṇḍī nahuṣo babhrurdivaspṛktvaṃ punarvasuḥ । subabhrurukṣo rukmastvaṃ suṣeṇo dundubhistathā ॥13॥
html:
śikhaṇḍī nahuṣo babhrurdivaspṛktvaṃ punarvasuḥ ।
subabhrurukṣo rukmastvaṃ suṣeṇo dundubhistathā ॥13॥
slp1: SiKaRqI nahuzo baBrurdivaspfktvaM punarvasuH । subaBrurukzo rukmastvaM suzeRo dunduBistaTA ॥13॥

text: gabhastinemiḥ śrīpadmaṃ puṣkaraṃ puṣpadhāraṇaḥ । ṛbhurvibhuḥ sarvasūkṣmastvaṃ sāvitraṃ ca paṭhyase ॥14॥
html:
gabhastinemiḥ śrīpadmaṃ puṣkaraṃ puṣpadhāraṇaḥ ।
ṛbhurvibhuḥ sarvasūkṣmastvaṃ sāvitraṃ ca paṭhyase ॥14॥
slp1: gaBastinemiH SrIpadmaM puzkaraM puzpaDAraRaH । fBurviBuH sarvasUkzmastvaM sAvitraM ca paWyase ॥14॥

text: ambhonidhistvaṃ brahmā tvaṃ pavitraṃ dhāma dhanva ca । hiraṇyagarbhaṃ tvāmāhuḥ svadhā svāhā ca keśava ॥15॥
html:
ambhonidhistvaṃ brahmā tvaṃ pavitraṃ dhāma dhanva ca ।
hiraṇyagarbhaṃ tvāmāhuḥ svadhā svāhā ca keśava ॥15॥
slp1: amBoniDistvaM brahmA tvaM pavitraM DAma Danva ca । hiraRyagarBaM tvAmAhuH svaDA svAhA ca keSava ॥15॥

text: yonistvamasya pralayaśca kṛṣṇa tvamevedaṃ sṛjasi viśvamagre । viśvaṃ cedaṃ tvadvaśe viśvayone namo'stu te śārṅgacakrāsipāṇe ॥16॥
html:
yonistvamasya pralayaśca kṛṣṇa tvamevedaṃ sṛjasi viśvamagre ।
viśvaṃ cedaṃ tvadvaśe viśvayone namo'stu te śārṅgacakrāsipāṇe ॥16॥
slp1: yonistvamasya pralayaSca kfzRa tvamevedaM sfjasi viSvamagre । viSvaM cedaM tvadvaSe viSvayone namo'stu te SArNgacakrAsipARe ॥16॥

text: evaṃ stuto dharmarājena kṛṣṇaḥ sabhāmadhye prītimānpuṣkarākṣaḥ । tamabhyanandadbhārataṃ puṣkalābhirvāgbhirjyeṣṭhaṃ pāṇḍavaṃ yādavāgryaḥ] ॥17॥
html:
evaṃ stuto dharmarājena kṛṣṇaḥ sabhāmadhye prītimānpuṣkarākṣaḥ ।
tamabhyanandadbhārataṃ puṣkalābhirvāgbhirjyeṣṭhaṃ pāṇḍavaṃ yādavāgryaḥ] ॥17॥
slp1: evaM stuto DarmarAjena kfzRaH saBAmaDye prItimAnpuzkarAkzaH । tamaByanandadBArataM puzkalABirvAgBirjyezWaM pARqavaM yAdavAgryaH] ॥17॥

text: tato visarjayāmāsa sarvāḥ prakṛtayo nṛpaḥ । viviśuścābhyanujñātā yathāsvāni gṛhāṇi ca ॥1॥
html:
tato visarjayāmāsa sarvāḥ prakṛtayo nṛpaḥ ।
viviśuścābhyanujñātā yathāsvāni gṛhāṇi ca ॥1॥
slp1: tato visarjayAmAsa sarvAH prakftayo nfpaH । viviSuScAByanujYAtA yaTAsvAni gfhARi ca ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā bhīmaṃ bhīmaparākramam । sāntvayannabravīddhīmānarjunaṃ yamajau tathā ॥2॥
html:
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā bhīmaṃ bhīmaparākramam ।
sāntvayannabravīddhīmānarjunaṃ yamajau tathā ॥2॥
slp1: tato yuDizWiro rAjA BImaM BImaparAkramam । sAntvayannabravIdDImAnarjunaM yamajO taTA ॥2॥

text: śatrubhirvividhaiḥ śastraiḥ kṛttadehā mahāraṇe । śrāntā bhavantaḥ subhṛśaṃ tāpitāḥ śokamanyubhiḥ ॥3॥
html:
śatrubhirvividhaiḥ śastraiḥ kṛttadehā mahāraṇe ।
śrāntā bhavantaḥ subhṛśaṃ tāpitāḥ śokamanyubhiḥ ॥3॥
slp1: SatruBirviviDEH SastrEH kfttadehA mahAraRe । SrAntA BavantaH suBfSaM tApitAH SokamanyuBiH ॥3॥

text: araṇye duḥkhavasatīrmatkṛte puruṣottamāḥ । bhavadbhiranubhūtāśca yathā kupuruṣaistathā ॥4॥
html:
araṇye duḥkhavasatīrmatkṛte puruṣottamāḥ ।
bhavadbhiranubhūtāśca yathā kupuruṣaistathā ॥4॥
slp1: araRye duHKavasatIrmatkfte puruzottamAH । BavadBiranuBUtASca yaTA kupuruzEstaTA ॥4॥

text: yathāsukhaṃ yathājoṣaṃ jayo'yamanubhūyatām । viśrāntāṁllabdhavijñānāñśvaḥ sametāsmi vaḥ punaḥ ॥5॥
html:
yathāsukhaṃ yathājoṣaṃ jayo'yamanubhūyatām ।
viśrāntāṁllabdhavijñānāñśvaḥ sametāsmi vaḥ punaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: yaTAsuKaM yaTAjozaM jayo'yamanuBUyatAm । viSrAntAṁllabDavijYAnAYSvaH sametAsmi vaH punaH ॥5॥

text: tato duryodhanagṛhaṃ prāsādairupaśobhitam । bahuratnasamākīrṇaṃ dāsīdāsasamākulam ॥6॥
html:
tato duryodhanagṛhaṃ prāsādairupaśobhitam ।
bahuratnasamākīrṇaṃ dāsīdāsasamākulam ॥6॥
slp1: tato duryoDanagfhaM prAsAdErupaSoBitam । bahuratnasamAkIrRaM dAsIdAsasamAkulam ॥6॥

text: dhṛtarāṣṭrābhyanujñātaṃ bhrātrā dattaṃ vṛkodaraḥ । pratipede mahābāhurmandaraṃ maghavāniva ॥7॥
html:
dhṛtarāṣṭrābhyanujñātaṃ bhrātrā dattaṃ vṛkodaraḥ ।
pratipede mahābāhurmandaraṃ maghavāniva ॥7॥
slp1: DftarAzwrAByanujYAtaM BrAtrA dattaM vfkodaraH । pratipede mahAbAhurmandaraM maGavAniva ॥7॥

text: yathā duryodhanagṛhaṃ tathā duḥśāsanasya ca । prāsādamālāsaṃyuktaṃ hematoraṇabhūṣitam ॥8॥
html:
yathā duryodhanagṛhaṃ tathā duḥśāsanasya ca ।
prāsādamālāsaṃyuktaṃ hematoraṇabhūṣitam ॥8॥
slp1: yaTA duryoDanagfhaM taTA duHSAsanasya ca । prAsAdamAlAsaMyuktaM hematoraRaBUzitam ॥8॥

text: dāsīdāsasusampūrṇaṃ prabhūtadhanadhānyavat । pratipede mahābāhurarjuno rājaśāsanāt ॥9॥
html:
dāsīdāsasusampūrṇaṃ prabhūtadhanadhānyavat ।
pratipede mahābāhurarjuno rājaśāsanāt ॥9॥
slp1: dAsIdAsasusampUrRaM praBUtaDanaDAnyavat । pratipede mahAbAhurarjuno rAjaSAsanAt ॥9॥

text: durmarṣaṇasya bhavanaṃ duḥśāsanagṛhādvaram । kuberabhavanaprakhyaṃ maṇihemavibhūṣitam ॥10॥
html:
durmarṣaṇasya bhavanaṃ duḥśāsanagṛhādvaram ।
kuberabhavanaprakhyaṃ maṇihemavibhūṣitam ॥10॥
slp1: durmarzaRasya BavanaM duHSAsanagfhAdvaram । kuberaBavanapraKyaM maRihemaviBUzitam ॥10॥

text: nakulāya varārhāya karśitāya mahāvane । dadau prīto mahārāja dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥11॥
html:
nakulāya varārhāya karśitāya mahāvane ।
dadau prīto mahārāja dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥11॥
slp1: nakulAya varArhAya karSitAya mahAvane । dadO prIto mahArAja DarmarAjo yuDizWiraH ॥11॥

text: durmukhasya ca veśmāgryaṃ śrīmatkanakabhūṣitam । pūrṇaṃ padmadalākṣīṇāṃ strīṇāṃ śayanasaṅkulam ॥12॥
html:
durmukhasya ca veśmāgryaṃ śrīmatkanakabhūṣitam ।
pūrṇaṃ padmadalākṣīṇāṃ strīṇāṃ śayanasaṅkulam ॥12॥
slp1: durmuKasya ca veSmAgryaM SrImatkanakaBUzitam । pUrRaM padmadalAkzIRAM strIRAM SayanasaNkulam ॥12॥

text: pradadau sahadevāya satataṃ priyakāriṇe । mumude tacca labdhvā sa kailāsaṃ dhanado yathā ॥13॥
html:
pradadau sahadevāya satataṃ priyakāriṇe ।
mumude tacca labdhvā sa kailāsaṃ dhanado yathā ॥13॥
slp1: pradadO sahadevAya satataM priyakAriRe । mumude tacca labDvA sa kElAsaM Danado yaTA ॥13॥

text: yuyutsurviduraścaiva sañjayaśca mahādyutiḥ । sudharmā caiva dhaumyaśca yathāsvaṃ jagmurālayān ॥14॥
html:
yuyutsurviduraścaiva sañjayaśca mahādyutiḥ ।
sudharmā caiva dhaumyaśca yathāsvaṃ jagmurālayān ॥14॥
slp1: yuyutsurviduraScEva saYjayaSca mahAdyutiH । suDarmA cEva DOmyaSca yaTAsvaM jagmurAlayAn ॥14॥

text: saha sātyakinā śaurirarjunasya niveśanam । viveśa puruṣavyāghro vyāghro giriguhāmiva ॥15॥
html:
saha sātyakinā śaurirarjunasya niveśanam ।
viveśa puruṣavyāghro vyāghro giriguhāmiva ॥15॥
slp1: saha sAtyakinA SOrirarjunasya niveSanam । viveSa puruzavyAGro vyAGro giriguhAmiva ॥15॥

text: tatra bhakṣānnapānaiste samupetāḥ sukhoṣitāḥ । sukhaprabuddhā rājānamupatasthuryudhiṣṭhiram] ॥16॥
html:
tatra bhakṣānnapānaiste samupetāḥ sukhoṣitāḥ ।
sukhaprabuddhā rājānamupatasthuryudhiṣṭhiram] ॥16॥
slp1: tatra BakzAnnapAnEste samupetAH suKozitAH । suKaprabudDA rAjAnamupatasTuryuDizWiram] ॥16॥

text: prāpya rājyaṃ mahātejā dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । yadanyadakarodvipra tanme vaktumihārhasi ॥1॥
html:
prāpya rājyaṃ mahātejā dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।
yadanyadakarodvipra tanme vaktumihārhasi ॥1॥
slp1: prApya rAjyaM mahAtejA DarmarAjo yuDizWiraH । yadanyadakarodvipra tanme vaktumihArhasi ॥1॥
author: janamejaya uvāca ।

text: bhagavānvā hṛṣīkeśastrailokyasya paro guruḥ । ṛṣe yadakarodvīrastacca vyākhyātumarhasi ॥2॥
html:
bhagavānvā hṛṣīkeśastrailokyasya paro guruḥ ।
ṛṣe yadakarodvīrastacca vyākhyātumarhasi ॥2॥
slp1: BagavAnvA hfzIkeSastrElokyasya paro guruH । fze yadakarodvIrastacca vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥2॥

text: śṛṇu rājendra tattvena kīrtyamānaṃ mayānagha । vāsudevaṃ puraskṛtya yadakurvata pāṇḍavāḥ ॥3॥
html:
śṛṇu rājendra tattvena kīrtyamānaṃ mayānagha ।
vāsudevaṃ puraskṛtya yadakurvata pāṇḍavāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: SfRu rAjendra tattvena kIrtyamAnaM mayAnaGa । vAsudevaM puraskftya yadakurvata pARqavAH ॥3॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: prāpya rājyaṃ mahātejā dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । cāturvarṇyaṃ yathāyogaṃ sve sve dharme nyaveśayat ॥4॥
html:
prāpya rājyaṃ mahātejā dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।
cāturvarṇyaṃ yathāyogaṃ sve sve dharme nyaveśayat ॥4॥
slp1: prApya rAjyaM mahAtejA DarmarAjo yuDizWiraH । cAturvarRyaM yaTAyogaM sve sve Darme nyaveSayat ॥4॥

text: brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasraṃ ca snātakānāṃ mahātmanām । sahasraniṣkamekaikaṃ vācayāmāsa pāṇḍavaḥ ॥5॥
html:
brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasraṃ ca snātakānāṃ mahātmanām ।
sahasraniṣkamekaikaṃ vācayāmāsa pāṇḍavaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: brAhmaRAnAM sahasraM ca snAtakAnAM mahAtmanAm । sahasranizkamekEkaM vAcayAmAsa pARqavaH ॥5॥

text: tathānujīvino bhṛtyānsaṃśritānatithīnapi । kāmaiḥ santarpayāmāsa kṛpaṇāṃstarkakānapi ॥6॥
html:
tathānujīvino bhṛtyānsaṃśritānatithīnapi ।
kāmaiḥ santarpayāmāsa kṛpaṇāṃstarkakānapi ॥6॥
slp1: taTAnujIvino BftyAnsaMSritAnatiTInapi । kAmEH santarpayAmAsa kfpaRAMstarkakAnapi ॥6॥

text: purohitāya dhaumyāya prādādayutaśaḥ sa gāḥ । dhanaṃ suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca ॥7॥
html:
purohitāya dhaumyāya prādādayutaśaḥ sa gāḥ ।
dhanaṃ suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca ॥7॥
slp1: purohitAya DOmyAya prAdAdayutaSaH sa gAH । DanaM suvarRaM rajataM vAsAMsi viviDAni ca ॥7॥

text: kṛpāya ca mahārāja guruvṛttimavartata । vidurāya ca dharmātmā pūjāṃ cakre yatavrataḥ ॥8॥
html:
kṛpāya ca mahārāja guruvṛttimavartata ।
vidurāya ca dharmātmā pūjāṃ cakre yatavrataḥ ॥8॥
slp1: kfpAya ca mahArAja guruvfttimavartata । vidurAya ca DarmAtmA pUjAM cakre yatavrataH ॥8॥

text: bhakṣānnapānairvividhairvāsobhiḥ śayanāsanaiḥ । sarvānsantoṣayāmāsa saṃśritāndadatāṃ varaḥ ॥9॥
html:
bhakṣānnapānairvividhairvāsobhiḥ śayanāsanaiḥ ।
sarvānsantoṣayāmāsa saṃśritāndadatāṃ varaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: BakzAnnapAnErviviDErvAsoBiH SayanAsanEH । sarvAnsantozayAmAsa saMSritAndadatAM varaH ॥9॥

text: labdhapraśamanaṃ kṛtvā sa rājā rājasattama । yuyutsordhārtarāṣṭrasya pūjāṃ cakre mahāyaśāḥ ॥10॥
html:
labdhapraśamanaṃ kṛtvā sa rājā rājasattama ।
yuyutsordhārtarāṣṭrasya pūjāṃ cakre mahāyaśāḥ ॥10॥
slp1: labDapraSamanaM kftvA sa rAjA rAjasattama । yuyutsorDArtarAzwrasya pUjAM cakre mahAyaSAH ॥10॥

text: dhṛtarāṣṭrāya tadrājyaṃ gāndhāryai vidurāya ca । nivedya svasthavadrājannāste rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥11॥
html:
dhṛtarāṣṭrāya tadrājyaṃ gāndhāryai vidurāya ca ।
nivedya svasthavadrājannāste rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥11॥
slp1: DftarAzwrAya tadrAjyaM gAnDAryE vidurAya ca । nivedya svasTavadrAjannAste rAjA yuDizWiraH ॥11॥

text: tathā sarvaṃ sa nagaraṃ prasādya janamejaya । vāsudevaṃ mahātmānamabhyagacchatkṛtāñjaliḥ ॥12॥
html:
tathā sarvaṃ sa nagaraṃ prasādya janamejaya ।
vāsudevaṃ mahātmānamabhyagacchatkṛtāñjaliḥ ॥12॥
slp1: taTA sarvaM sa nagaraM prasAdya janamejaya । vAsudevaM mahAtmAnamaByagacCatkftAYjaliH ॥12॥

text: tato mahati paryaṅke maṇikāñcanabhūṣite । dadarśa kṛṣṇamāsīnaṃ nīlaṃ merāvivāmbudam ॥13॥
html:
tato mahati paryaṅke maṇikāñcanabhūṣite ।
dadarśa kṛṣṇamāsīnaṃ nīlaṃ merāvivāmbudam ॥13॥
slp1: tato mahati paryaNke maRikAYcanaBUzite । dadarSa kfzRamAsInaM nIlaM merAvivAmbudam ॥13॥

text: jājvalyamānaṃ vapuṣā divyābharaṇabhūṣitam । pītakauśeyasaṃvītaṃ hemnīvopahitaṃ maṇim ॥14॥
html:
jājvalyamānaṃ vapuṣā divyābharaṇabhūṣitam ।
pītakauśeyasaṃvītaṃ hemnīvopahitaṃ maṇim ॥14॥
slp1: jAjvalyamAnaM vapuzA divyABaraRaBUzitam । pItakOSeyasaMvItaM hemnIvopahitaM maRim ॥14॥

text: kaustubhena uraḥsthena maṇinābhivirājitam । udyatevodayaṃ śailaṃ sūryeṇāptakirīṭinam । naupamyaṃ vidyate yasya triṣu lokeṣu kiñcana ॥15॥
html:
kaustubhena uraḥsthena maṇinābhivirājitam ।
udyatevodayaṃ śailaṃ sūryeṇāptakirīṭinam ।
naupamyaṃ vidyate yasya triṣu lokeṣu kiñcana ॥15॥
slp1: kOstuBena uraHsTena maRinABivirAjitam । udyatevodayaM SElaM sUryeRAptakirIwinam । nOpamyaM vidyate yasya trizu lokezu kiYcana ॥15॥

text: so'bhigamya mahātmānaṃ viṣṇuṃ puruṣavigraham । uvāca madhurābhāṣaḥ smitapūrvamidaṃ tadā ॥16॥
html:
so'bhigamya mahātmānaṃ viṣṇuṃ puruṣavigraham ।
uvāca madhurābhāṣaḥ smitapūrvamidaṃ tadā ॥16॥
slp1: so'Bigamya mahAtmAnaM vizRuM puruzavigraham । uvAca maDurABAzaH smitapUrvamidaM tadA ॥16॥

text: sukhena te niśā kaccidvyuṣṭā buddhimatāṃ vara । kaccijjñānāni sarvāṇi prasannāni tavācyuta ॥17॥
html:
sukhena te niśā kaccidvyuṣṭā buddhimatāṃ vara ।
kaccijjñānāni sarvāṇi prasannāni tavācyuta ॥17॥
slp1: suKena te niSA kaccidvyuzwA budDimatAM vara । kaccijjYAnAni sarvARi prasannAni tavAcyuta ॥17॥

text: tava hyāśritya tāṃ devīṃ buddhiṃ buddhimatāṃ vara । vayaṃ rājyamanuprāptāḥ pṛthivī ca vaśe sthitā ॥18॥
html:
tava hyāśritya tāṃ devīṃ buddhiṃ buddhimatāṃ vara ।
vayaṃ rājyamanuprāptāḥ pṛthivī ca vaśe sthitā ॥18॥
slp1: tava hyASritya tAM devIM budDiM budDimatAM vara । vayaM rAjyamanuprAptAH pfTivI ca vaSe sTitA ॥18॥

text: bhavatprasādādbhagavaṃstrilokagativikrama । jayaḥ prāpto yaśaścāgryaṃ na ca dharmāccyutā vayam ॥19॥
html:
bhavatprasādādbhagavaṃstrilokagativikrama ।
jayaḥ prāpto yaśaścāgryaṃ na ca dharmāccyutā vayam ॥19॥
slp1: BavatprasAdAdBagavaMstrilokagativikrama । jayaH prApto yaSaScAgryaM na ca DarmAccyutA vayam ॥19॥

text: taṃ tathā bhāṣamāṇaṃ tu dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram । novāca bhagavānkiñciddhyānamevānvapadyata] ॥20॥
html:
taṃ tathā bhāṣamāṇaṃ tu dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram ।
novāca bhagavānkiñciddhyānamevānvapadyata] ॥20॥
slp1: taM taTA BAzamARaM tu DarmarAjaM yuDizWiram । novAca BagavAnkiYcidDyAnamevAnvapadyata] ॥20॥

text: kimidaṃ paramāścaryaṃ dhyāyasyamitavikrama । kaccillokatrayasyāsya svasti lokaparāyaṇa ॥1॥
html:
kimidaṃ paramāścaryaṃ dhyāyasyamitavikrama ।
kaccillokatrayasyāsya svasti lokaparāyaṇa ॥1॥
slp1: kimidaM paramAScaryaM DyAyasyamitavikrama । kaccillokatrayasyAsya svasti lokaparAyaRa ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: caturthaṃ dhyānamārgaṃ tvamālambya puruṣottama । apakrānto yato deva tena me vismitaṃ manaḥ ॥2॥
html:
caturthaṃ dhyānamārgaṃ tvamālambya puruṣottama ।
apakrānto yato deva tena me vismitaṃ manaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: caturTaM DyAnamArgaM tvamAlambya puruzottama । apakrAnto yato deva tena me vismitaM manaH ॥2॥

text: nigṛhīto hi vāyuste pañcakarmā śarīragaḥ । indriyāṇi ca sarvāṇi manasi sthāpitāni te ॥3॥
html:
nigṛhīto hi vāyuste pañcakarmā śarīragaḥ ।
indriyāṇi ca sarvāṇi manasi sthāpitāni te ॥3॥
slp1: nigfhIto hi vAyuste paYcakarmA SarIragaH । indriyARi ca sarvARi manasi sTApitAni te ॥3॥

text: indriyāṇi manaścaiva buddhau saṃveśitāni te । sarvaścaiva gaṇo deva kṣetrajñe te niveśitaḥ ॥4॥
html:
indriyāṇi manaścaiva buddhau saṃveśitāni te ।
sarvaścaiva gaṇo deva kṣetrajñe te niveśitaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: indriyARi manaScEva budDO saMveSitAni te । sarvaScEva gaRo deva kzetrajYe te niveSitaH ॥4॥

text: neṅganti tava romāṇi sthirā buddhistathā manaḥ । sthāṇukuḍyaśilābhūto nirīhaścāsi mādhava ॥5॥
html:
neṅganti tava romāṇi sthirā buddhistathā manaḥ ।
sthāṇukuḍyaśilābhūto nirīhaścāsi mādhava ॥5॥
slp1: neNganti tava romARi sTirA budDistaTA manaH । sTARukuqyaSilABUto nirIhaScAsi mADava ॥5॥

text: yathā dīpo nivātastho niriṅgo jvalate'cyuta । tathāsi bhagavandeva niścalo dṛḍhaniścayaḥ ॥6॥
html:
yathā dīpo nivātastho niriṅgo jvalate'cyuta ।
tathāsi bhagavandeva niścalo dṛḍhaniścayaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: yaTA dIpo nivAtasTo niriNgo jvalate'cyuta । taTAsi Bagavandeva niScalo dfQaniScayaH ॥6॥

text: yadi śrotumihārhāmi na rahasyaṃ ca te yadi । chindhi me saṃśayaṃ deva prapannāyābhiyācate ॥7॥
html:
yadi śrotumihārhāmi na rahasyaṃ ca te yadi ।
chindhi me saṃśayaṃ deva prapannāyābhiyācate ॥7॥
slp1: yadi SrotumihArhAmi na rahasyaM ca te yadi । CinDi me saMSayaM deva prapannAyABiyAcate ॥7॥

text: tvaṃ hi kartā vikartā ca tvaṃ kṣaraṃ cākṣaraṃ ca hi । anādinidhanaścādyastvameva puruṣottama ॥8॥
html:
tvaṃ hi kartā vikartā ca tvaṃ kṣaraṃ cākṣaraṃ ca hi ।
anādinidhanaścādyastvameva puruṣottama ॥8॥
slp1: tvaM hi kartA vikartA ca tvaM kzaraM cAkzaraM ca hi । anAdiniDanaScAdyastvameva puruzottama ॥8॥

text: tvatprapannāya bhaktāya śirasā praṇatāya ca । dhyānasyāsya yathātattvaṃ brūhi dharmabhṛtāṃ vara ॥9॥
html:
tvatprapannāya bhaktāya śirasā praṇatāya ca ।
dhyānasyāsya yathātattvaṃ brūhi dharmabhṛtāṃ vara ॥9॥
slp1: tvatprapannAya BaktAya SirasA praRatAya ca । DyAnasyAsya yaTAtattvaM brUhi DarmaBftAM vara ॥9॥

text: tataḥ svagocare nyasya mano buddhīndriyāṇi ca । smitapūrvamuvācedaṃ bhagavānvāsavānujaḥ ॥10॥
html:
tataḥ svagocare nyasya mano buddhīndriyāṇi ca ।
smitapūrvamuvācedaṃ bhagavānvāsavānujaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: tataH svagocare nyasya mano budDIndriyARi ca । smitapUrvamuvAcedaM BagavAnvAsavAnujaH ॥10॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: śaratalpagato bhīṣmaḥ śāmyanniva hutāśanaḥ । māṃ dhyāti puruṣavyāghrastato me tadgataṃ manaḥ ॥11॥
html:
śaratalpagato bhīṣmaḥ śāmyanniva hutāśanaḥ ।
māṃ dhyāti puruṣavyāghrastato me tadgataṃ manaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: Saratalpagato BIzmaH SAmyanniva hutASanaH । mAM DyAti puruzavyAGrastato me tadgataM manaH ॥11॥

text: yasya jyātalanirghoṣaṃ visphūrjitamivāśaneḥ । na saheddevarājo'pi tamasmi manasā gataḥ ॥12॥
html:
yasya jyātalanirghoṣaṃ visphūrjitamivāśaneḥ ।
na saheddevarājo'pi tamasmi manasā gataḥ ॥12॥
slp1: yasya jyAtalanirGozaM visPUrjitamivASaneH । na saheddevarAjo'pi tamasmi manasA gataH ॥12॥

text: yenābhidrutya tarasā samastaṃ rājamaṇḍalam । ūḍhāstisraḥ purā kanyāstamasmi manasā gataḥ ॥13॥
html:
yenābhidrutya tarasā samastaṃ rājamaṇḍalam ।
ūḍhāstisraḥ purā kanyāstamasmi manasā gataḥ ॥13॥
slp1: yenABidrutya tarasA samastaM rAjamaRqalam । UQAstisraH purA kanyAstamasmi manasA gataH ॥13॥

text: trayoviṃśatirātraṃ yo yodhayāmāsa bhārgavam । na ca rāmeṇa nistīrṇastamasmi manasā gataḥ ॥14॥
html:
trayoviṃśatirātraṃ yo yodhayāmāsa bhārgavam ।
na ca rāmeṇa nistīrṇastamasmi manasā gataḥ ॥14॥
slp1: trayoviMSatirAtraM yo yoDayAmAsa BArgavam । na ca rAmeRa nistIrRastamasmi manasA gataH ॥14॥

text: yaṃ gaṅgā garbhavidhinā dhārayāmāsa pārthivam । vasiṣṭhaśiṣyaṃ taṃ tāta manasāsmi gato nṛpa ॥15॥
html:
yaṃ gaṅgā garbhavidhinā dhārayāmāsa pārthivam ।
vasiṣṭhaśiṣyaṃ taṃ tāta manasāsmi gato nṛpa ॥15॥
slp1: yaM gaNgA garBaviDinA DArayAmAsa pArTivam । vasizWaSizyaM taM tAta manasAsmi gato nfpa ॥15॥

text: divyāstrāṇi mahātejā yo dhārayati buddhimān । sāṅgāṃśca caturo vedāṃstamasmi manasā gataḥ ॥16॥
html:
divyāstrāṇi mahātejā yo dhārayati buddhimān ।
sāṅgāṃśca caturo vedāṃstamasmi manasā gataḥ ॥16॥
slp1: divyAstrARi mahAtejA yo DArayati budDimAn । sANgAMSca caturo vedAMstamasmi manasA gataH ॥16॥

text: rāmasya dayitaṃ śiṣyaṃ jāmadagnyasya pāṇḍava । ādhāraṃ sarvavidyānāṃ tamasmi manasā gataḥ ॥17॥
html:
rāmasya dayitaṃ śiṣyaṃ jāmadagnyasya pāṇḍava ।
ādhāraṃ sarvavidyānāṃ tamasmi manasā gataḥ ॥17॥
slp1: rAmasya dayitaM SizyaM jAmadagnyasya pARqava । ADAraM sarvavidyAnAM tamasmi manasA gataH ॥17॥

text: ekīkṛtyendriyagrāmaṃ manaḥ saṃyamya medhayā । śaraṇaṃ māmupāgacchattato me tadgataṃ manaḥ ॥18॥
html:
ekīkṛtyendriyagrāmaṃ manaḥ saṃyamya medhayā ।
śaraṇaṃ māmupāgacchattato me tadgataṃ manaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: ekIkftyendriyagrAmaM manaH saMyamya meDayA । SaraRaM mAmupAgacCattato me tadgataM manaH ॥18॥

text: sa hi bhūtaṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca bhavacca puruṣarṣabha । vetti dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhastato me tadgataṃ manaḥ ॥19॥
html:
