mahatastamasaḥ pāre puruṣaṃ jvalanadyutim ।
yaṃ jñātvā mṛtyumatyeti tasmai jñeyātmane namaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: mahatastamasaH pAre puruzaM jvalanadyutim । yaM jYAtvA mftyumatyeti tasmE jYeyAtmane namaH ॥25॥

text: yaṃ bṛhantaṃ bṛhatyukthe yamagnau yaṃ mahādhvare । yaṃ viprasaṅghā gāyanti tasmai vedātmane namaḥ ॥26॥
html:
yaṃ bṛhantaṃ bṛhatyukthe yamagnau yaṃ mahādhvare ।
yaṃ viprasaṅghā gāyanti tasmai vedātmane namaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: yaM bfhantaM bfhatyukTe yamagnO yaM mahADvare । yaM viprasaNGA gAyanti tasmE vedAtmane namaH ॥26॥

text: ṛgyajuḥsāmadhāmānaṃ daśārdhahavirākṛtim । yaṃ saptatantuṃ tanvanti tasmai yajñātmane namaḥ ॥27॥
html:
ṛgyajuḥsāmadhāmānaṃ daśārdhahavirākṛtim ।
yaṃ saptatantuṃ tanvanti tasmai yajñātmane namaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: fgyajuHsAmaDAmAnaM daSArDahavirAkftim । yaM saptatantuM tanvanti tasmE yajYAtmane namaH ॥27॥

text: yaḥ suparṇo yajurnāma chandogātrastrivṛcchirāḥ । rathantarabṛhatyakṣastasmai stotrātmane namaḥ ॥28॥
html:
yaḥ suparṇo yajurnāma chandogātrastrivṛcchirāḥ ।
rathantarabṛhatyakṣastasmai stotrātmane namaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: yaH suparRo yajurnAma CandogAtrastrivfcCirAH । raTantarabfhatyakzastasmE stotrAtmane namaH ॥28॥

text: yaḥ sahasrasave satre jajñe viśvasṛjāmṛṣiḥ । hiraṇyavarṇaḥ śakunistasmai haṃsātmane namaḥ ॥29॥
html:
yaḥ sahasrasave satre jajñe viśvasṛjāmṛṣiḥ ।
hiraṇyavarṇaḥ śakunistasmai haṃsātmane namaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: yaH sahasrasave satre jajYe viSvasfjAmfziH । hiraRyavarRaH SakunistasmE haMsAtmane namaH ॥29॥

text: padāṅgaṃ sandhiparvāṇaṃ svaravyañjanalakṣaṇam । yamāhurakṣaraṃ nityaṃ tasmai vāgātmane namaḥ ॥30॥
html:
padāṅgaṃ sandhiparvāṇaṃ svaravyañjanalakṣaṇam ।
yamāhurakṣaraṃ nityaṃ tasmai vāgātmane namaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: padANgaM sanDiparvARaM svaravyaYjanalakzaRam । yamAhurakzaraM nityaM tasmE vAgAtmane namaH ॥30॥

text: yaścinoti satāṃ setumṛtenāmṛtayoninā । dharmārthavyavahārāṅgaistasmai satyātmane namaḥ ॥31॥
html:
yaścinoti satāṃ setumṛtenāmṛtayoninā ।
dharmārthavyavahārāṅgaistasmai satyātmane namaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: yaScinoti satAM setumftenAmftayoninA । DarmArTavyavahArANgEstasmE satyAtmane namaH ॥31॥

text: yaṃ pṛthagdharmacaraṇāḥ pṛthagdharmaphalaiṣiṇaḥ । pṛthagdharmaiḥ samarcanti tasmai dharmātmane namaḥ ॥32॥
html:
yaṃ pṛthagdharmacaraṇāḥ pṛthagdharmaphalaiṣiṇaḥ ।
pṛthagdharmaiḥ samarcanti tasmai dharmātmane namaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: yaM pfTagDarmacaraRAH pfTagDarmaPalEziRaH । pfTagDarmEH samarcanti tasmE DarmAtmane namaH ॥32॥

text: yaṃ taṃ vyaktasthamavyaktaṃ vicinvanti maharṣayaḥ । kṣetre kṣetrajñamāsīnaṃ tasmai kṣetrātmane namaḥ ॥33॥
html:
yaṃ taṃ vyaktasthamavyaktaṃ vicinvanti maharṣayaḥ ।
kṣetre kṣetrajñamāsīnaṃ tasmai kṣetrātmane namaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: yaM taM vyaktasTamavyaktaM vicinvanti maharzayaH । kzetre kzetrajYamAsInaM tasmE kzetrAtmane namaH ॥33॥

text: yaṃ dṛgātmānamātmasthaṃ vṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirguṇaiḥ । prāhuḥ saptadaśaṃ sāṅkhyāstasmai sāṅkhyātmane namaḥ ॥34॥
html:
yaṃ dṛgātmānamātmasthaṃ vṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirguṇaiḥ ।
prāhuḥ saptadaśaṃ sāṅkhyāstasmai sāṅkhyātmane namaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: yaM dfgAtmAnamAtmasTaM vftaM zoqaSaBirguREH । prAhuH saptadaSaM sANKyAstasmE sANKyAtmane namaH ॥34॥

text: yaṃ vinidrā jitaśvāsāḥ sattvasthāḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ । jyotiḥ paśyanti yuñjānāstasmai yogātmane namaḥ ॥35॥
html:
yaṃ vinidrā jitaśvāsāḥ sattvasthāḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ ।
jyotiḥ paśyanti yuñjānāstasmai yogātmane namaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: yaM vinidrA jitaSvAsAH sattvasTAH saMyatendriyAH । jyotiH paSyanti yuYjAnAstasmE yogAtmane namaH ॥35॥

text: apuṇyapuṇyoparame yaṃ punarbhavanirbhayāḥ । śāntāḥ saṃnyāsino yānti tasmai mokṣātmane namaḥ ॥36॥
html:
apuṇyapuṇyoparame yaṃ punarbhavanirbhayāḥ ।
śāntāḥ saṃnyāsino yānti tasmai mokṣātmane namaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: apuRyapuRyoparame yaM punarBavanirBayAH । SAntAH saMnyAsino yAnti tasmE mokzAtmane namaH ॥36॥

text: yo'sau yugasahasrānte pradīptārcirvibhāvasuḥ । saṃbhakṣayati bhūtāni tasmai ghorātmane namaḥ ॥37॥
html:
yo'sau yugasahasrānte pradīptārcirvibhāvasuḥ ।
saṃbhakṣayati bhūtāni tasmai ghorātmane namaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: yo'sO yugasahasrAnte pradIptArcirviBAvasuH । saMBakzayati BUtAni tasmE GorAtmane namaH ॥37॥

text: saṃbhakṣya sarvabhūtāni kṛtvā caikārṇavaṃ jagat । bālaḥ svapiti yaścaikastasmai māyātmane namaḥ ॥38॥
html:
saṃbhakṣya sarvabhūtāni kṛtvā caikārṇavaṃ jagat ।
bālaḥ svapiti yaścaikastasmai māyātmane namaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: saMBakzya sarvaBUtAni kftvA cEkArRavaM jagat । bAlaH svapiti yaScEkastasmE mAyAtmane namaH ॥38॥

text: sahasraśirase tasmai puruṣāyāmitātmane । catuḥsamudraparyāyayoganidrātmane namaḥ ॥39॥
html:
sahasraśirase tasmai puruṣāyāmitātmane ।
catuḥsamudraparyāyayoganidrātmane namaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: sahasraSirase tasmE puruzAyAmitAtmane । catuHsamudraparyAyayoganidrAtmane namaH ॥39॥

text: ajasya nābhāvadhyekaṃ yasminviśvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam । puṣkaraṃ puṣkarākṣasya tasmai padmātmane namaḥ ॥40॥
html:
ajasya nābhāvadhyekaṃ yasminviśvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ।
puṣkaraṃ puṣkarākṣasya tasmai padmātmane namaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: ajasya nABAvaDyekaM yasminviSvaM pratizWitam । puzkaraM puzkarAkzasya tasmE padmAtmane namaH ॥40॥

text: yasya keśeṣu jīmūtā nadyaḥ sarvāṅgasandhiṣu । kukṣau samudrāścatvārastasmai toyātmane namaḥ ॥41॥
html:
yasya keśeṣu jīmūtā nadyaḥ sarvāṅgasandhiṣu ।
kukṣau samudrāścatvārastasmai toyātmane namaḥ ॥41॥
slp1: yasya keSezu jImUtA nadyaH sarvANgasanDizu । kukzO samudrAScatvArastasmE toyAtmane namaH ॥41॥

text: yugeṣvāvartate yoṃ'śairdinartvayanahāyanaiḥ । sargapralayayoḥ kartā tasmai kālātmane namaḥ ॥42॥
html:
yugeṣvāvartate yoṃ'śairdinartvayanahāyanaiḥ ।
sargapralayayoḥ kartā tasmai kālātmane namaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: yugezvAvartate yoM'SErdinartvayanahAyanEH । sargapralayayoH kartA tasmE kAlAtmane namaH ॥42॥

text: brahma vaktraṃ bhujau kṣatraṃ kṛtsnamūrūdaraṃ viśaḥ । pādau yasyāśritāḥ śūdrāstasmai varṇātmane namaḥ ॥43॥
html:
brahma vaktraṃ bhujau kṣatraṃ kṛtsnamūrūdaraṃ viśaḥ ।
pādau yasyāśritāḥ śūdrāstasmai varṇātmane namaḥ ॥43॥
slp1: brahma vaktraM BujO kzatraM kftsnamUrUdaraM viSaH । pAdO yasyASritAH SUdrAstasmE varRAtmane namaH ॥43॥

text: yasyāgnirāsyaṃ dyaurmūrdhā khaṃ nābhiścaraṇau kṣitiḥ । sūryaścakṣurdiśaḥ śrotre tasmai lokātmane namaḥ ॥44॥
html:
yasyāgnirāsyaṃ dyaurmūrdhā khaṃ nābhiścaraṇau kṣitiḥ ।
sūryaścakṣurdiśaḥ śrotre tasmai lokātmane namaḥ ॥44॥
slp1: yasyAgnirAsyaM dyOrmUrDA KaM nABiScaraRO kzitiH । sUryaScakzurdiSaH Srotre tasmE lokAtmane namaH ॥44॥

text: viṣaye vartamānānāṃ yaṃ taṃ vaiśeṣikairguṇaiḥ । prāhurviṣayagoptāraṃ tasmai goptrātmane namaḥ ॥45॥
html:
viṣaye vartamānānāṃ yaṃ taṃ vaiśeṣikairguṇaiḥ ।
prāhurviṣayagoptāraṃ tasmai goptrātmane namaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: vizaye vartamAnAnAM yaM taM vESezikErguREH । prAhurvizayagoptAraM tasmE goptrAtmane namaH ॥45॥

text: annapānendhanamayo rasaprāṇavivardhanaḥ । yo dhārayati bhūtāni tasmai prāṇātmane namaḥ ॥46॥
html:
annapānendhanamayo rasaprāṇavivardhanaḥ ।
yo dhārayati bhūtāni tasmai prāṇātmane namaḥ ॥46॥
slp1: annapAnenDanamayo rasaprARavivarDanaH । yo DArayati BUtAni tasmE prARAtmane namaH ॥46॥

text: paraḥ kālātparo yajñātparaḥ sadasatośca yaḥ । anādirādirviśvasya tasmai viśvātmane namaḥ ॥47॥
html:
paraḥ kālātparo yajñātparaḥ sadasatośca yaḥ ।
anādirādirviśvasya tasmai viśvātmane namaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: paraH kAlAtparo yajYAtparaH sadasatoSca yaH । anAdirAdirviSvasya tasmE viSvAtmane namaH ॥47॥

text: yo mohayati bhūtāni sneharāgānubandhanaiḥ । sargasya rakṣaṇārthāya tasmai mohātmane namaḥ ॥48॥
html:
yo mohayati bhūtāni sneharāgānubandhanaiḥ ।
sargasya rakṣaṇārthāya tasmai mohātmane namaḥ ॥48॥
slp1: yo mohayati BUtAni sneharAgAnubanDanEH । sargasya rakzaRArTAya tasmE mohAtmane namaH ॥48॥

text: ātmajñānamidaṃ jñānaṃ jñātvā pañcasvavasthitam । yaṃ jñānino'dhigacchanti tasmai jñānātmane namaḥ ॥49॥
html:
ātmajñānamidaṃ jñānaṃ jñātvā pañcasvavasthitam ।
yaṃ jñānino'dhigacchanti tasmai jñānātmane namaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: AtmajYAnamidaM jYAnaM jYAtvA paYcasvavasTitam । yaM jYAnino'DigacCanti tasmE jYAnAtmane namaH ॥49॥

text: aprameyaśarīrāya sarvato'nantacakṣuṣe । apāraparimeyāya tasmai cintyātmane namaḥ ॥50॥
html:
aprameyaśarīrāya sarvato'nantacakṣuṣe ।
apāraparimeyāya tasmai cintyātmane namaḥ ॥50॥
slp1: aprameyaSarIrAya sarvato'nantacakzuze । apAraparimeyAya tasmE cintyAtmane namaH ॥50॥

text: jaṭine daṇḍine nityaṃ lambodaraśarīriṇe । kamaṇḍaluniṣaṅgāya tasmai brahmātmane namaḥ ॥51॥
html:
jaṭine daṇḍine nityaṃ lambodaraśarīriṇe ।
kamaṇḍaluniṣaṅgāya tasmai brahmātmane namaḥ ॥51॥
slp1: jawine daRqine nityaM lambodaraSarIriRe । kamaRqalunizaNgAya tasmE brahmAtmane namaH ॥51॥

text: śūline tridaśeśāya tryambakāya mahātmane । bhasmadigdhordhvaliṅgāya tasmai rudrātmane namaḥ ॥52॥
html:
śūline tridaśeśāya tryambakāya mahātmane ।
bhasmadigdhordhvaliṅgāya tasmai rudrātmane namaḥ ॥52॥
slp1: SUline tridaSeSAya tryambakAya mahAtmane । BasmadigDorDvaliNgAya tasmE rudrAtmane namaH ॥52॥

text: pañcabhūtātmabhūtāya bhūtādinidhanātmane । akrodhadrohamohāya tasmai śāntātmane namaḥ ॥53॥
html:
pañcabhūtātmabhūtāya bhūtādinidhanātmane ।
akrodhadrohamohāya tasmai śāntātmane namaḥ ॥53॥
slp1: paYcaBUtAtmaBUtAya BUtAdiniDanAtmane । akroDadrohamohAya tasmE SAntAtmane namaH ॥53॥

text: yasminsarvaṃ yataḥ sarvaṃ yaḥ sarvaṃ sarvataśca yaḥ । yaśca sarvamayo nityaṃ tasmai sarvātmane namaḥ ॥54॥
html:
yasminsarvaṃ yataḥ sarvaṃ yaḥ sarvaṃ sarvataśca yaḥ ।
yaśca sarvamayo nityaṃ tasmai sarvātmane namaḥ ॥54॥
slp1: yasminsarvaM yataH sarvaM yaH sarvaM sarvataSca yaH । yaSca sarvamayo nityaM tasmE sarvAtmane namaH ॥54॥

text: viśvakarmannamaste'stu viśvātmanviśvasambhava । apavargo'si bhūtānāṃ pañcānāṃ parataḥ sthitaḥ ॥55॥
html:
viśvakarmannamaste'stu viśvātmanviśvasambhava ।
apavargo'si bhūtānāṃ pañcānāṃ parataḥ sthitaḥ ॥55॥
slp1: viSvakarmannamaste'stu viSvAtmanviSvasamBava । apavargo'si BUtAnAM paYcAnAM parataH sTitaH ॥55॥

text: namaste triṣu lokeṣu namaste paratastriṣu । namaste dikṣu sarvāsu tvaṃ hi sarvaparāyaṇam ॥56॥
html:
namaste triṣu lokeṣu namaste paratastriṣu ।
namaste dikṣu sarvāsu tvaṃ hi sarvaparāyaṇam ॥56॥
slp1: namaste trizu lokezu namaste paratastrizu । namaste dikzu sarvAsu tvaM hi sarvaparAyaRam ॥56॥

text: namaste bhagavanviṣṇo lokānāṃ prabhavāpyaya । tvaṃ hi kartā hṛṣīkeśa saṃhartā cāparājitaḥ ॥57॥
html:
namaste bhagavanviṣṇo lokānāṃ prabhavāpyaya ।
tvaṃ hi kartā hṛṣīkeśa saṃhartā cāparājitaḥ ॥57॥
slp1: namaste BagavanvizRo lokAnAM praBavApyaya । tvaM hi kartA hfzIkeSa saMhartA cAparAjitaH ॥57॥

text: tena paśyāmi te divyānbhāvānhi triṣu vartmasu । tacca paśyāmi tattvena yatte rūpaṃ sanātanam ॥58॥
html:
tena paśyāmi te divyānbhāvānhi triṣu vartmasu ।
tacca paśyāmi tattvena yatte rūpaṃ sanātanam ॥58॥
slp1: tena paSyAmi te divyAnBAvAnhi trizu vartmasu । tacca paSyAmi tattvena yatte rUpaM sanAtanam ॥58॥

text: divaṃ te śirasā vyāptaṃ padbhyāṃ devī vasundharā । vikrameṇa trayo lokāḥ puruṣo'si sanātanaḥ ॥59॥
html:
divaṃ te śirasā vyāptaṃ padbhyāṃ devī vasundharā ।
vikrameṇa trayo lokāḥ puruṣo'si sanātanaḥ ॥59॥
slp1: divaM te SirasA vyAptaM padByAM devI vasunDarA । vikrameRa trayo lokAH puruzo'si sanAtanaH ॥59॥

text: atasīpuṣpasaṅkāśaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam । ye namasyanti govindaṃ na teṣāṃ vidyate bhayam ॥60॥
html:
atasīpuṣpasaṅkāśaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam ।
ye namasyanti govindaṃ na teṣāṃ vidyate bhayam ॥60॥
slp1: atasIpuzpasaNkASaM pItavAsasamacyutam । ye namasyanti govindaM na tezAM vidyate Bayam ॥60॥

text: yathā viṣṇumayaṃ satyaṃ yathā viṣṇumayaṃ haviḥ । yathā viṣṇumayaṃ sarvaṃ pāpmā me naśyatāṃ tathā ॥61॥
html:
yathā viṣṇumayaṃ satyaṃ yathā viṣṇumayaṃ haviḥ ।
yathā viṣṇumayaṃ sarvaṃ pāpmā me naśyatāṃ tathā ॥61॥
slp1: yaTA vizRumayaM satyaM yaTA vizRumayaM haviH । yaTA vizRumayaM sarvaM pApmA me naSyatAM taTA ॥61॥

text: tvāṃ prapannāya bhaktāya gatimiṣṭāṃ jigīṣave । yacchreyaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣa taddhyāyasva surottama ॥62॥
html:
tvāṃ prapannāya bhaktāya gatimiṣṭāṃ jigīṣave ।
yacchreyaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣa taddhyāyasva surottama ॥62॥
slp1: tvAM prapannAya BaktAya gatimizwAM jigIzave । yacCreyaH puRqarIkAkza tadDyAyasva surottama ॥62॥

text: iti vidyātapoyonirayonirviṣṇurīḍitaḥ । vāgyajñenārcito devaḥ prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ ॥63॥
html:
iti vidyātapoyonirayonirviṣṇurīḍitaḥ ।
vāgyajñenārcito devaḥ prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ ॥63॥
slp1: iti vidyAtapoyonirayonirvizRurIqitaH । vAgyajYenArcito devaH prIyatAM me janArdanaH ॥63॥

text: etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ bhīṣmastadgatamānasaḥ । nama ityeva kṛṣṇāya praṇāmamakarottadā ॥64॥
html:
etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ bhīṣmastadgatamānasaḥ ।
nama ityeva kṛṣṇāya praṇāmamakarottadā ॥64॥
slp1: etAvaduktvA vacanaM BIzmastadgatamAnasaH । nama ityeva kfzRAya praRAmamakarottadA ॥64॥

text: abhigamya tu yogena bhaktiṃ bhīṣmasya mādhavaḥ । traikālyadarśanaṃ jñānaṃ divyaṃ dātuṃ yayau hariḥ ॥65॥
html:
abhigamya tu yogena bhaktiṃ bhīṣmasya mādhavaḥ ।
traikālyadarśanaṃ jñānaṃ divyaṃ dātuṃ yayau hariḥ ॥65॥
slp1: aBigamya tu yogena BaktiM BIzmasya mADavaH । trEkAlyadarSanaM jYAnaM divyaM dAtuM yayO hariH ॥65॥

text: tasminnuparate śabde tataste brahmavādinaḥ । bhīṣmaṃ vāgbhirbāṣpakaṇṭhāstamānarcurmahāmatim ॥66॥
html:
tasminnuparate śabde tataste brahmavādinaḥ ।
bhīṣmaṃ vāgbhirbāṣpakaṇṭhāstamānarcurmahāmatim ॥66॥
slp1: tasminnuparate Sabde tataste brahmavAdinaH । BIzmaM vAgBirbAzpakaRWAstamAnarcurmahAmatim ॥66॥

text: te stuvantaśca viprāgryāḥ keśavaṃ puruṣottamam । bhīṣmaṃ ca śanakaiḥ sarve praśaśaṃsuḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥67॥
html:
te stuvantaśca viprāgryāḥ keśavaṃ puruṣottamam ।
bhīṣmaṃ ca śanakaiḥ sarve praśaśaṃsuḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥67॥
slp1: te stuvantaSca viprAgryAH keSavaM puruzottamam । BIzmaM ca SanakEH sarve praSaSaMsuH punaH punaH ॥67॥

text: viditvā bhaktiyogaṃ tu bhīṣmasya puruṣottamaḥ । sahasotthāya saṃhṛṣṭo yānamevānvapadyata ॥68॥
html:
viditvā bhaktiyogaṃ tu bhīṣmasya puruṣottamaḥ ।
sahasotthāya saṃhṛṣṭo yānamevānvapadyata ॥68॥
slp1: viditvA BaktiyogaM tu BIzmasya puruzottamaH । sahasotTAya saMhfzwo yAnamevAnvapadyata ॥68॥

text: keśavaḥ sātyakiścaiva rathenaikena jagmatuḥ । apareṇa mahātmānau yudhiṣṭhiradhanañjayau ॥69॥
html:
keśavaḥ sātyakiścaiva rathenaikena jagmatuḥ ।
apareṇa mahātmānau yudhiṣṭhiradhanañjayau ॥69॥
slp1: keSavaH sAtyakiScEva raTenEkena jagmatuH । apareRa mahAtmAnO yuDizWiraDanaYjayO ॥69॥

text: bhīmaseno yamau cobhau rathamekaṃ samāsthitau । kṛpo yuyutsuḥ sūtaśca sañjayaścāparaṃ ratham ॥70॥
html:
bhīmaseno yamau cobhau rathamekaṃ samāsthitau ।
kṛpo yuyutsuḥ sūtaśca sañjayaścāparaṃ ratham ॥70॥
slp1: BImaseno yamO coBO raTamekaM samAsTitO । kfpo yuyutsuH sUtaSca saYjayaScAparaM raTam ॥70॥

text: te rathairnagarākāraiḥ prayātāḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ । nemighoṣeṇa mahatā kampayanto vasundharām ॥71॥
html:
te rathairnagarākāraiḥ prayātāḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ ।
nemighoṣeṇa mahatā kampayanto vasundharām ॥71॥
slp1: te raTErnagarAkArEH prayAtAH puruzarzaBAH । nemiGozeRa mahatA kampayanto vasunDarAm ॥71॥

text: tato giraḥ puruṣavarastavānvitā dvijeritāḥ pathi sumanāḥ sa śuśruve । kṛtāñjaliṃ praṇatamathāparaṃ janaṃ sa keśihā muditamanābhyanandata] ॥72॥
html:
tato giraḥ puruṣavarastavānvitā dvijeritāḥ pathi sumanāḥ sa śuśruve ।
kṛtāñjaliṃ praṇatamathāparaṃ janaṃ sa keśihā muditamanābhyanandata] ॥72॥
slp1: tato giraH puruzavarastavAnvitA dvijeritAH paTi sumanAH sa SuSruve । kftAYjaliM praRatamaTAparaM janaM sa keSihA muditamanAByanandata] ॥72॥

text: tataḥ sa ca hṛṣīkeśaḥ sa ca rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । kṛpādayaśca te sarve catvāraḥ pāṇḍavāśca ha ॥1॥
html:
tataḥ sa ca hṛṣīkeśaḥ sa ca rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।
kṛpādayaśca te sarve catvāraḥ pāṇḍavāśca ha ॥1॥
slp1: tataH sa ca hfzIkeSaH sa ca rAjA yuDizWiraH । kfpAdayaSca te sarve catvAraH pARqavASca ha ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: rathaiste nagarākāraiḥ patākādhvajaśobhitaiḥ । yayurāśu kurukṣetraṃ vājibhiḥ śīghragāmibhiḥ ॥2॥
html:
rathaiste nagarākāraiḥ patākādhvajaśobhitaiḥ ।
yayurāśu kurukṣetraṃ vājibhiḥ śīghragāmibhiḥ ॥2॥
slp1: raTEste nagarAkArEH patAkADvajaSoBitEH । yayurASu kurukzetraM vAjiBiH SIGragAmiBiH ॥2॥

text: te'vatīrya kurukṣetraṃ keśamajjāsthisaṅkulam । dehanyāsaḥ kṛto yatra kṣatriyaistairmahātmabhiḥ ॥3॥
html:
te'vatīrya kurukṣetraṃ keśamajjāsthisaṅkulam ।
dehanyāsaḥ kṛto yatra kṣatriyaistairmahātmabhiḥ ॥3॥
slp1: te'vatIrya kurukzetraM keSamajjAsTisaNkulam । dehanyAsaH kfto yatra kzatriyEstErmahAtmaBiH ॥3॥

text: gajāśvadehāsthicayaiḥ parvatairiva sañcitam । naraśīrṣakapālaiśca śaṅkhairiva samācitam ॥4॥
html:
gajāśvadehāsthicayaiḥ parvatairiva sañcitam ।
naraśīrṣakapālaiśca śaṅkhairiva samācitam ॥4॥
slp1: gajASvadehAsTicayEH parvatEriva saYcitam । naraSIrzakapAlESca SaNKEriva samAcitam ॥4॥

text: citāsahasrairnicitaṃ varmaśastrasamākulam । āpānabhūmiṃ kālasya tadā bhuktojjhitāmiva ॥5॥
html:
citāsahasrairnicitaṃ varmaśastrasamākulam ।
āpānabhūmiṃ kālasya tadā bhuktojjhitāmiva ॥5॥
slp1: citAsahasrErnicitaM varmaSastrasamAkulam । ApAnaBUmiM kAlasya tadA BuktojJitAmiva ॥5॥

text: bhūtasaṅghānucaritaṃ rakṣogaṇaniṣevitam । paśyantaste kurukṣetraṃ yayurāśu mahārathāḥ ॥6॥
html:
bhūtasaṅghānucaritaṃ rakṣogaṇaniṣevitam ।
paśyantaste kurukṣetraṃ yayurāśu mahārathāḥ ॥6॥
slp1: BUtasaNGAnucaritaM rakzogaRanizevitam । paSyantaste kurukzetraM yayurASu mahAraTAH ॥6॥

text: gacchanneva mahābāhuḥ sarvayādavanandanaḥ । yudhiṣṭhirāya provāca jāmadagnyasya vikramam ॥7॥
html:
gacchanneva mahābāhuḥ sarvayādavanandanaḥ ।
yudhiṣṭhirāya provāca jāmadagnyasya vikramam ॥7॥
slp1: gacCanneva mahAbAhuH sarvayAdavanandanaH । yuDizWirAya provAca jAmadagnyasya vikramam ॥7॥

text: amī rāmahradāḥ pañca dṛśyante pārtha dūrataḥ । yeṣu santarpayāmāsa pūrvānkṣatriyaśoṇitaiḥ ॥8॥
html:
amī rāmahradāḥ pañca dṛśyante pārtha dūrataḥ ।
yeṣu santarpayāmāsa pūrvānkṣatriyaśoṇitaiḥ ॥8॥
slp1: amI rAmahradAH paYca dfSyante pArTa dUrataH । yezu santarpayAmAsa pUrvAnkzatriyaSoRitEH ॥8॥

text: triḥsaptakṛtvo vasudhāṃ kṛtvā niḥkṣatriyāṃ prabhuḥ । ihedānīṃ tato rāmaḥ karmaṇo virarāma ha ॥9॥
html:
triḥsaptakṛtvo vasudhāṃ kṛtvā niḥkṣatriyāṃ prabhuḥ ।
ihedānīṃ tato rāmaḥ karmaṇo virarāma ha ॥9॥
slp1: triHsaptakftvo vasuDAM kftvA niHkzatriyAM praBuH । ihedAnIM tato rAmaH karmaRo virarAma ha ॥9॥

text: triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivī kṛtā niḥkṣatriyā tadā । rāmeṇeti yadāttha tvamatra me saṃśayo mahān ॥10॥
html:
triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivī kṛtā niḥkṣatriyā tadā ।
rāmeṇeti yadāttha tvamatra me saṃśayo mahān ॥10॥
slp1: triHsaptakftvaH pfTivI kftA niHkzatriyA tadA । rAmeReti yadAtTa tvamatra me saMSayo mahAn ॥10॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kṣatrabījaṃ yadā dagdhaṃ rāmeṇa yadupuṅgava । kathaṃ bhūyaḥ samutpattiḥ kṣatrasyāmitavikrama ॥11॥
html:
kṣatrabījaṃ yadā dagdhaṃ rāmeṇa yadupuṅgava ।
kathaṃ bhūyaḥ samutpattiḥ kṣatrasyāmitavikrama ॥11॥
slp1: kzatrabIjaM yadA dagDaM rAmeRa yadupuNgava । kaTaM BUyaH samutpattiH kzatrasyAmitavikrama ॥11॥

text: mahātmanā bhagavatā rāmeṇa yadupuṅgava । kathamutsāditaṃ kṣatraṃ kathaṃ vṛddhiṃ punargatam ॥12॥
html:
mahātmanā bhagavatā rāmeṇa yadupuṅgava ।
kathamutsāditaṃ kṣatraṃ kathaṃ vṛddhiṃ punargatam ॥12॥
slp1: mahAtmanA BagavatA rAmeRa yadupuNgava । kaTamutsAditaM kzatraM kaTaM vfdDiM punargatam ॥12॥

text: mahābhāratayuddhe hi koṭiśaḥ kṣatriyā hatāḥ । tathābhūcca mahī kīrṇā kṣatriyairvadatāṃ vara ॥13॥
html:
mahābhāratayuddhe hi koṭiśaḥ kṣatriyā hatāḥ ।
tathābhūcca mahī kīrṇā kṣatriyairvadatāṃ vara ॥13॥
slp1: mahABAratayudDe hi kowiSaH kzatriyA hatAH । taTABUcca mahI kIrRA kzatriyErvadatAM vara ॥13॥

text: evaṃ me chindhi vārṣṇeya saṃśayaṃ tārkṣyaketana । āgamo hi paraḥ kṛṣṇa tvatto no vāsavānuja ॥14॥
html:
evaṃ me chindhi vārṣṇeya saṃśayaṃ tārkṣyaketana ।
āgamo hi paraḥ kṛṣṇa tvatto no vāsavānuja ॥14॥
slp1: evaM me CinDi vArzReya saMSayaM tArkzyaketana । Agamo hi paraH kfzRa tvatto no vAsavAnuja ॥14॥

text: tato vrajanneva gadāgrajaḥ prabhuḥ śaśaṃsa tasmai nikhilena tattvataḥ । yudhiṣṭhirāyāpratimaujase tadā yathābhavatkṣatriyasaṅkulā mahī] ॥15॥
html:
tato vrajanneva gadāgrajaḥ prabhuḥ śaśaṃsa tasmai nikhilena tattvataḥ ।
yudhiṣṭhirāyāpratimaujase tadā yathābhavatkṣatriyasaṅkulā mahī] ॥15॥
slp1: tato vrajanneva gadAgrajaH praBuH SaSaMsa tasmE niKilena tattvataH । yuDizWirAyApratimOjase tadA yaTABavatkzatriyasaNkulA mahI] ॥15॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: śṛṇu kaunteya rāmasya mayā yāvatpariśrutam । maharṣīṇāṃ kathayatāṃ kāraṇaṃ tasya janma ca ॥1॥
html:
śṛṇu kaunteya rāmasya mayā yāvatpariśrutam ।
maharṣīṇāṃ kathayatāṃ kāraṇaṃ tasya janma ca ॥1॥
slp1: SfRu kOnteya rAmasya mayA yAvatpariSrutam । maharzIRAM kaTayatAM kAraRaM tasya janma ca ॥1॥
author: vāsudeva uvāca ।

text: yathā ca jāmadagnyena koṭiśaḥ kṣatriyā hatāḥ । udbhūtā rājavaṃśeṣu ye bhūyo bhārate hatāḥ ॥2॥
html:
yathā ca jāmadagnyena koṭiśaḥ kṣatriyā hatāḥ ।
udbhūtā rājavaṃśeṣu ye bhūyo bhārate hatāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: yaTA ca jAmadagnyena kowiSaH kzatriyA hatAH । udBUtA rAjavaMSezu ye BUyo BArate hatAH ॥2॥

text: jahnorajahnustanayo ballavastasya cātmajaḥ । kuśiko nāma dharmajñastasya putro mahīpatiḥ ॥3॥
html:
jahnorajahnustanayo ballavastasya cātmajaḥ ।
kuśiko nāma dharmajñastasya putro mahīpatiḥ ॥3॥
slp1: jahnorajahnustanayo ballavastasya cAtmajaH । kuSiko nAma DarmajYastasya putro mahIpatiH ॥3॥

text: ugraṃ tapaḥ samātiṣṭhatsahasrākṣasamo bhuvi । putraṃ labheyamajitaṃ trilokeśvaramityuta ॥4॥
html:
ugraṃ tapaḥ samātiṣṭhatsahasrākṣasamo bhuvi ।
putraṃ labheyamajitaṃ trilokeśvaramityuta ॥4॥
slp1: ugraM tapaH samAtizWatsahasrAkzasamo Buvi । putraM laBeyamajitaM trilokeSvaramityuta ॥4॥

text: tamugratapasaṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasrākṣaḥ purandaraḥ । samarthaḥ putrajanane svayamevaitya bhārata ॥5॥
html:
tamugratapasaṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasrākṣaḥ purandaraḥ ।
samarthaḥ putrajanane svayamevaitya bhārata ॥5॥
slp1: tamugratapasaM dfzwvA sahasrAkzaH purandaraH । samarTaH putrajanane svayamevEtya BArata ॥5॥

text: putratvamagamadrājaṃstasya lokeśvareśvaraḥ । gādhirnāmābhavatputraḥ kauśikaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ ॥6॥
html:
putratvamagamadrājaṃstasya lokeśvareśvaraḥ ।
gādhirnāmābhavatputraḥ kauśikaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: putratvamagamadrAjaMstasya lokeSvareSvaraH । gADirnAmABavatputraH kOSikaH pAkaSAsanaH ॥6॥

text: tasya kanyābhavadrājannāmnā satyavatī prabho । tāṃ gādhiḥ kaviputrāya sorcīkāya dadau prabhuḥ ॥7॥
html:
tasya kanyābhavadrājannāmnā satyavatī prabho ।
tāṃ gādhiḥ kaviputrāya sorcīkāya dadau prabhuḥ ॥7॥
slp1: tasya kanyABavadrAjannAmnA satyavatI praBo । tAM gADiH kaviputrAya sorcIkAya dadO praBuH ॥7॥

text: tataḥ prītastu kaunteya bhārgavaḥ kurunandana । putrārthe śrapayāmāsa caruṃ gādhestathaiva ca ॥8॥
html:
tataḥ prītastu kaunteya bhārgavaḥ kurunandana ।
putrārthe śrapayāmāsa caruṃ gādhestathaiva ca ॥8॥
slp1: tataH prItastu kOnteya BArgavaH kurunandana । putrArTe SrapayAmAsa caruM gADestaTEva ca ॥8॥

text: āhūya cāha tāṃ bhāryāmṛcīko bhārgavastadā । upayojyaścarurayaṃ tvayā mātrāpyayaṃ tava ॥9॥
html:
āhūya cāha tāṃ bhāryāmṛcīko bhārgavastadā ।
upayojyaścarurayaṃ tvayā mātrāpyayaṃ tava ॥9॥
slp1: AhUya cAha tAM BAryAmfcIko BArgavastadA । upayojyaScarurayaM tvayA mAtrApyayaM tava ॥9॥

text: tasyā janiṣyate putro dīptimānkṣatriyarṣabhaḥ । ajayyaḥ kṣatriyairloke kṣatriyarṣabhasūdanaḥ ॥10॥
html:
tasyā janiṣyate putro dīptimānkṣatriyarṣabhaḥ ।
ajayyaḥ kṣatriyairloke kṣatriyarṣabhasūdanaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: tasyA janizyate putro dIptimAnkzatriyarzaBaH । ajayyaH kzatriyErloke kzatriyarzaBasUdanaH ॥10॥

text: tavāpi putraṃ kalyāṇi dhṛtimantaṃ taponvitam । śamātmakaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ carureṣa vidhāsyati ॥11॥
html:
tavāpi putraṃ kalyāṇi dhṛtimantaṃ taponvitam ।
śamātmakaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ carureṣa vidhāsyati ॥11॥
slp1: tavApi putraM kalyARi DftimantaM taponvitam । SamAtmakaM dvijaSrezWaM carureza viDAsyati ॥11॥

text: ityevamuktvā tāṃ bhāryāmṛcīko bhṛgunandanaḥ । tapasyabhirato dhīmāñjagāmāraṇyameva ha ॥12॥
html:
ityevamuktvā tāṃ bhāryāmṛcīko bhṛgunandanaḥ ।
tapasyabhirato dhīmāñjagāmāraṇyameva ha ॥12॥
slp1: ityevamuktvA tAM BAryAmfcIko BfgunandanaH । tapasyaBirato DImAYjagAmAraRyameva ha ॥12॥

text: etasminneva kāle tu tīrthayātrāparo nṛpaḥ । gādhiḥ sadāraḥ samprāpta ṛcīkasyāśramaṃ prati ॥13॥
html:
etasminneva kāle tu tīrthayātrāparo nṛpaḥ ।
gādhiḥ sadāraḥ samprāpta ṛcīkasyāśramaṃ prati ॥13॥
slp1: etasminneva kAle tu tIrTayAtrAparo nfpaH । gADiH sadAraH samprApta fcIkasyASramaM prati ॥13॥

text: carudvayaṃ gṛhītvā tu rājansatyavatī tadā । bharturvākyādathāvyagrā mātre hṛṣṭā nyavedayat ॥14॥
html:
carudvayaṃ gṛhītvā tu rājansatyavatī tadā ।
bharturvākyādathāvyagrā mātre hṛṣṭā nyavedayat ॥14॥
slp1: carudvayaM gfhItvA tu rAjansatyavatI tadA । BarturvAkyAdaTAvyagrA mAtre hfzwA nyavedayat ॥14॥

text: mātā tu tasyāḥ kaunteya duhitre svaṃ caruṃ dadau । tasyāścarumathājñātamātmasaṃsthaṃ cakāra ha ॥15॥
html:
mātā tu tasyāḥ kaunteya duhitre svaṃ caruṃ dadau ।
tasyāścarumathājñātamātmasaṃsthaṃ cakāra ha ॥15॥
slp1: mAtA tu tasyAH kOnteya duhitre svaM caruM dadO । tasyAScarumaTAjYAtamAtmasaMsTaM cakAra ha ॥15॥

text: atha satyavatī garbhaṃ kṣatriyāntakaraṃ tadā । dhārayāmāsa dīptena vapuṣā ghoradarśanam ॥16॥
html:
atha satyavatī garbhaṃ kṣatriyāntakaraṃ tadā ।
dhārayāmāsa dīptena vapuṣā ghoradarśanam ॥16॥
slp1: aTa satyavatI garBaM kzatriyAntakaraM tadA । DArayAmAsa dIptena vapuzA GoradarSanam ॥16॥

text: tāmṛcīkastadā dṛṣṭvā dhyānayogena vai tataḥ । abravīdrājaśārdūla svāṃ bhāryāṃ varavarṇinīm ॥17॥
html:
tāmṛcīkastadā dṛṣṭvā dhyānayogena vai tataḥ ।
abravīdrājaśārdūla svāṃ bhāryāṃ varavarṇinīm ॥17॥
slp1: tAmfcIkastadA dfzwvA DyAnayogena vE tataH । abravIdrAjaSArdUla svAM BAryAM varavarRinIm ॥17॥

text: mātrāsi vyaṃsitā bhadre caruvyatyāsahetunā । janiṣyate hi te putraḥ krūrakarmā mahābalaḥ ॥18॥
html:
mātrāsi vyaṃsitā bhadre caruvyatyāsahetunā ।
janiṣyate hi te putraḥ krūrakarmā mahābalaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: mAtrAsi vyaMsitA Badre caruvyatyAsahetunA । janizyate hi te putraH krUrakarmA mahAbalaH ॥18॥

text: janiṣyate hi te bhrātā brahmabhūtastapodhanaḥ । viśvaṃ hi brahma tapasā mayā tatra samarpitam ॥19॥
html:
janiṣyate hi te bhrātā brahmabhūtastapodhanaḥ ।
viśvaṃ hi brahma tapasā mayā tatra samarpitam ॥19॥
slp1: janizyate hi te BrAtA brahmaBUtastapoDanaH । viSvaM hi brahma tapasA mayA tatra samarpitam ॥19॥

text: saivamuktā mahābhāgā bhartrā satyavatī tadā । papāta śirasā tasmai vepantī cābravīdidam ॥20॥
html:
saivamuktā mahābhāgā bhartrā satyavatī tadā ।
papāta śirasā tasmai vepantī cābravīdidam ॥20॥
slp1: sEvamuktA mahABAgA BartrA satyavatI tadA । papAta SirasA tasmE vepantI cAbravIdidam ॥20॥

text: nārho'si bhagavannadya vaktumevaṃvidhaṃ vacaḥ । brāhmaṇāpasadaṃ putraṃ prāpsyasīti mahāmune ॥21॥
html:
nārho'si bhagavannadya vaktumevaṃvidhaṃ vacaḥ ।
brāhmaṇāpasadaṃ putraṃ prāpsyasīti mahāmune ॥21॥
slp1: nArho'si Bagavannadya vaktumevaMviDaM vacaH । brAhmaRApasadaM putraM prApsyasIti mahAmune ॥21॥

text: naiṣa saṅkalpitaḥ kāmo mayā bhadre tathā tvayi । ugrakarmā bhavetputraścarurmātā ca kāraṇam ॥22॥
html:
naiṣa saṅkalpitaḥ kāmo mayā bhadre tathā tvayi ।
ugrakarmā bhavetputraścarurmātā ca kāraṇam ॥22॥
slp1: nEza saNkalpitaH kAmo mayA Badre taTA tvayi । ugrakarmA BavetputraScarurmAtA ca kAraRam ॥22॥
author: ṛcīka uvāca ।

text: icchaṁllokānapi mune sṛjethāḥ kiṃ punarmama । śamātmakamṛjuṃ putraṃ labheyaṃ japatāṃ vara ॥23॥
html:
icchaṁllokānapi mune sṛjethāḥ kiṃ punarmama ।
śamātmakamṛjuṃ putraṃ labheyaṃ japatāṃ vara ॥23॥
slp1: icCaṁllokAnapi mune sfjeTAH kiM punarmama । SamAtmakamfjuM putraM laBeyaM japatAM vara ॥23॥
author: satyavatyuvāca ।

text: noktapūrvaṃ mayā bhadre svaireṣvapyanṛtaṃ vacaḥ । kimutāgniṃ samādhāya mantravaccarusādhane ॥24॥
html:
noktapūrvaṃ mayā bhadre svaireṣvapyanṛtaṃ vacaḥ ।
kimutāgniṃ samādhāya mantravaccarusādhane ॥24॥
slp1: noktapUrvaM mayA Badre svErezvapyanftaM vacaH । kimutAgniM samADAya mantravaccarusADane ॥24॥
author: ṛcīka uvāca ।

text: kāmamevaṃ bhavetpautro mameha tava caiva ha । śamātmakamṛjuṃ putraṃ labheyaṃ japatāṃ vara ॥25॥
html:
kāmamevaṃ bhavetpautro mameha tava caiva ha ।
śamātmakamṛjuṃ putraṃ labheyaṃ japatāṃ vara ॥25॥
slp1: kAmamevaM BavetpOtro mameha tava cEva ha । SamAtmakamfjuM putraM laBeyaM japatAM vara ॥25॥
author: satyavatyuvāca ।

text: putre nāsti viśeṣo me pautre vā varavarṇini । yathā tvayoktaṃ tu vacastathā bhadre bhaviṣyati ॥26॥
html:
putre nāsti viśeṣo me pautre vā varavarṇini ।
yathā tvayoktaṃ tu vacastathā bhadre bhaviṣyati ॥26॥
slp1: putre nAsti viSezo me pOtre vA varavarRini । yaTA tvayoktaM tu vacastaTA Badre Bavizyati ॥26॥
author: ṛcīka uvāca ।

text: tataḥ satyavatī putraṃ janayāmāsa bhārgavam । tapasyabhirataṃ śāntaṃ jamadagniṃ śamātmakam ॥27॥
html:
tataḥ satyavatī putraṃ janayāmāsa bhārgavam ।
tapasyabhirataṃ śāntaṃ jamadagniṃ śamātmakam ॥27॥
slp1: tataH satyavatI putraM janayAmAsa BArgavam । tapasyaBirataM SAntaM jamadagniM SamAtmakam ॥27॥
author: vāsudeva uvāca ।

text: viśvāmitraṃ ca dāyādaṃ gādhiḥ kuśikanandanaḥ । prāpa brahmarṣisamitaṃ viśvena brahmaṇā yutam ॥28॥
html:
viśvāmitraṃ ca dāyādaṃ gādhiḥ kuśikanandanaḥ ।
prāpa brahmarṣisamitaṃ viśvena brahmaṇā yutam ॥28॥
slp1: viSvAmitraM ca dAyAdaM gADiH kuSikanandanaH । prApa brahmarzisamitaM viSvena brahmaRA yutam ॥28॥

text: ārcīko janayāmāsa jamadagniḥ sudāruṇam । sarvavidyāntagaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dhanurvede ca pāragam । rāmaṃ kṣatriyahantāraṃ pradīptamiva pāvakam ॥29॥
html:
ārcīko janayāmāsa jamadagniḥ sudāruṇam ।
sarvavidyāntagaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dhanurvede ca pāragam ।
rāmaṃ kṣatriyahantāraṃ pradīptamiva pāvakam ॥29॥
slp1: ArcIko janayAmAsa jamadagniH sudAruRam । sarvavidyAntagaM SrezWaM Danurvede ca pAragam । rAmaM kzatriyahantAraM pradIptamiva pAvakam ॥29॥

text: etasminneva kāle tu kṛtavīryātmajo balī । arjuno nāma tejasvī kṣatriyo haihayānvayaḥ ॥30॥
html:
etasminneva kāle tu kṛtavīryātmajo balī ।
arjuno nāma tejasvī kṣatriyo haihayānvayaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: etasminneva kAle tu kftavIryAtmajo balI । arjuno nAma tejasvI kzatriyo hEhayAnvayaH ॥30॥

text: dadāha pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ saptadvīpāṃ sapattanām । svabāhvastrabalenājau dharmeṇa parameṇa ca ॥31॥
html:
dadāha pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ saptadvīpāṃ sapattanām ।
svabāhvastrabalenājau dharmeṇa parameṇa ca ॥31॥
slp1: dadAha pfTivIM sarvAM saptadvIpAM sapattanAm । svabAhvastrabalenAjO DarmeRa parameRa ca ॥31॥

text: tṛṣitena sa kauravya bhikṣitaścitrabhānunā । sahasrabāhurvikrāntaḥ prādādbhikṣāmathāgnaye ॥32॥
html:
tṛṣitena sa kauravya bhikṣitaścitrabhānunā ।
sahasrabāhurvikrāntaḥ prādādbhikṣāmathāgnaye ॥32॥
slp1: tfzitena sa kOravya BikzitaScitraBAnunA । sahasrabAhurvikrAntaH prAdAdBikzAmaTAgnaye ॥32॥

text: grāmānpurāṇi ghoṣāṃśca pattanāni ca vīryavān । jajvāla tasya bāṇaistu citrabhānurdidhakṣayā ॥33॥
html:
grāmānpurāṇi ghoṣāṃśca pattanāni ca vīryavān ।
jajvāla tasya bāṇaistu citrabhānurdidhakṣayā ॥33॥
slp1: grAmAnpurARi GozAMSca pattanAni ca vIryavAn । jajvAla tasya bAREstu citraBAnurdiDakzayA ॥33॥

text: sa tasya puruṣendrasya prabhāvena mahātapāḥ । dadāha kārtavīryasya śailānatha vanāni ca ॥34॥
html:
sa tasya puruṣendrasya prabhāvena mahātapāḥ ।
dadāha kārtavīryasya śailānatha vanāni ca ॥34॥
slp1: sa tasya puruzendrasya praBAvena mahAtapAH । dadAha kArtavIryasya SElAnaTa vanAni ca ॥34॥

text: sa śūnyamāśramāraṇyaṃ varuṇasyātmajasya tat । dadāha pavaneneddhaścitrabhānuḥ sahaihayaḥ ॥35॥
html:
sa śūnyamāśramāraṇyaṃ varuṇasyātmajasya tat ।
dadāha pavaneneddhaścitrabhānuḥ sahaihayaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: sa SUnyamASramAraRyaM varuRasyAtmajasya tat । dadAha pavanenedDaScitraBAnuH sahEhayaH ॥35॥

text: āpavastaṃ tato roṣācchaśāpārjunamacyuta । dagdhe''śrame mahārāja kārtavīryeṇa vīryavān ॥36॥
html:
āpavastaṃ tato roṣācchaśāpārjunamacyuta ।
dagdhe''śrame mahārāja kārtavīryeṇa vīryavān ॥36॥
slp1: ApavastaM tato rozAcCaSApArjunamacyuta । dagDe''Srame mahArAja kArtavIryeRa vIryavAn ॥36॥

text: tvayā na varjitaṃ mohādyasmādvanamidaṃ mama । dagdhaṃ tasmādraṇe rāmo bāhūṃste chetsyate'rjuna ॥37॥
html:
tvayā na varjitaṃ mohādyasmādvanamidaṃ mama ।
dagdhaṃ tasmādraṇe rāmo bāhūṃste chetsyate'rjuna ॥37॥
slp1: tvayA na varjitaM mohAdyasmAdvanamidaM mama । dagDaM tasmAdraRe rAmo bAhUMste Cetsyate'rjuna ॥37॥

text: arjunastu mahārāja balī nityaṃ śamātmakaḥ । brahmaṇyaśca śaraṇyaśca dātā śūraśca bhārata ॥38॥
html:
arjunastu mahārāja balī nityaṃ śamātmakaḥ ।
brahmaṇyaśca śaraṇyaśca dātā śūraśca bhārata ॥38॥
slp1: arjunastu mahArAja balI nityaM SamAtmakaH । brahmaRyaSca SaraRyaSca dAtA SUraSca BArata ॥38॥

text: tasya putrāḥ subalinaḥ śāpenāsanpiturvadhe । nimittamavaliptā vai nṛśaṃsāścaiva nityadā ॥39॥
html:
tasya putrāḥ subalinaḥ śāpenāsanpiturvadhe ।
nimittamavaliptā vai nṛśaṃsāścaiva nityadā ॥39॥
slp1: tasya putrAH subalinaH SApenAsanpiturvaDe । nimittamavaliptA vE nfSaMsAScEva nityadA ॥39॥

text: jamadagnidhenvāste vatsamāninyurbharatarṣabha । ajñātaṃ kārtavīryasya haihayendrasya dhīmataḥ ॥40॥
html:
jamadagnidhenvāste vatsamāninyurbharatarṣabha ।
ajñātaṃ kārtavīryasya haihayendrasya dhīmataḥ ॥40॥
slp1: jamadagniDenvAste vatsamAninyurBaratarzaBa । ajYAtaM kArtavIryasya hEhayendrasya DImataH ॥40॥

text: tato'rjunasya bāhūṃstu chittvā vai pauruṣānvitaḥ । taṃ ruvantaṃ tato vatsaṃ jāmadagnyaḥ svamāśramam । pratyānayata rājendra teṣāmantaḥpurātprabhuḥ ॥41॥
html:
tato'rjunasya bāhūṃstu chittvā vai pauruṣānvitaḥ ।
taṃ ruvantaṃ tato vatsaṃ jāmadagnyaḥ svamāśramam ।
pratyānayata rājendra teṣāmantaḥpurātprabhuḥ ॥41॥
slp1: tato'rjunasya bAhUMstu CittvA vE pOruzAnvitaH । taM ruvantaM tato vatsaM jAmadagnyaH svamASramam । pratyAnayata rAjendra tezAmantaHpurAtpraBuH ॥41॥

text: arjunasya sutāste tu sambhūyābuddhayastadā । gatvāśramamasaṃbuddhaṃ jamadagnermahātmanaḥ ॥42॥
html:
arjunasya sutāste tu sambhūyābuddhayastadā ।
gatvāśramamasaṃbuddhaṃ jamadagnermahātmanaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: arjunasya sutAste tu samBUyAbudDayastadA । gatvASramamasaMbudDaM jamadagnermahAtmanaH ॥42॥

text: apātayanta bhallāgraiḥ śiraḥ kāyānnarādhipa । samitkuśārthaṃ rāmasya nirgatasya mahātmanaḥ ॥43॥
html:
apātayanta bhallāgraiḥ śiraḥ kāyānnarādhipa ।
samitkuśārthaṃ rāmasya nirgatasya mahātmanaḥ ॥43॥
slp1: apAtayanta BallAgrEH SiraH kAyAnnarADipa । samitkuSArTaM rAmasya nirgatasya mahAtmanaH ॥43॥

text: tataḥ pitṛvadhāmarṣādrāmaḥ paramamanyumān । niḥkṣatriyāṃ pratiśrutya mahīṃ śastramagṛhṇata ॥44॥
html:
tataḥ pitṛvadhāmarṣādrāmaḥ paramamanyumān ।
niḥkṣatriyāṃ pratiśrutya mahīṃ śastramagṛhṇata ॥44॥
slp1: tataH pitfvaDAmarzAdrAmaH paramamanyumAn । niHkzatriyAM pratiSrutya mahIM SastramagfhRata ॥44॥

text: tataḥ sa bhṛguśārdūlaḥ kārtavīryasya vīryavān । vikramya nijaghānāśu putrānpautrāṃśca sarvaśaḥ ॥45॥
html:
tataḥ sa bhṛguśārdūlaḥ kārtavīryasya vīryavān ।
vikramya nijaghānāśu putrānpautrāṃśca sarvaśaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: tataH sa BfguSArdUlaH kArtavIryasya vIryavAn । vikramya nijaGAnASu putrAnpOtrAMSca sarvaSaH ॥45॥

text: sa haihayasahasrāṇi hatvā paramamanyumān । cakāra bhārgavo rājanmahīṃ śoṇitakardamām ॥46॥
html:
sa haihayasahasrāṇi hatvā paramamanyumān ।
cakāra bhārgavo rājanmahīṃ śoṇitakardamām ॥46॥
slp1: sa hEhayasahasrARi hatvA paramamanyumAn । cakAra BArgavo rAjanmahIM SoRitakardamAm ॥46॥

text: sa tathā sumahātejāḥ kṛtvā niḥkṣatriyāṃ mahīm । kṛpayā parayāviṣṭo vanameva jagāma ha ॥47॥
html:
sa tathā sumahātejāḥ kṛtvā niḥkṣatriyāṃ mahīm ।
kṛpayā parayāviṣṭo vanameva jagāma ha ॥47॥
slp1: sa taTA sumahAtejAH kftvA niHkzatriyAM mahIm । kfpayA parayAvizwo vanameva jagAma ha ॥47॥

text: tato varṣasahasreṣu samatīteṣu keṣucit । kṣobhaṃ samprāptavāṃstīvraṃ prakṛtyā kopanaḥ prabhuḥ ॥48॥
html:
tato varṣasahasreṣu samatīteṣu keṣucit ।
kṣobhaṃ samprāptavāṃstīvraṃ prakṛtyā kopanaḥ prabhuḥ ॥48॥
slp1: tato varzasahasrezu samatItezu kezucit । kzoBaM samprAptavAMstIvraM prakftyA kopanaH praBuH ॥48॥

text: viśvāmitrasya pautrastu raibhyaputro mahātapāḥ । parāvasurmahārāja kṣiptvāha janasaṃsadi ॥49॥
html:
viśvāmitrasya pautrastu raibhyaputro mahātapāḥ ।
parāvasurmahārāja kṣiptvāha janasaṃsadi ॥49॥
slp1: viSvAmitrasya pOtrastu rEByaputro mahAtapAH । parAvasurmahArAja kziptvAha janasaMsadi ॥49॥

text: ye te yayātipatane yajñe santaḥ samāgatāḥ । pratardanaprabhṛtayo rāma kiṃ kṣatriyā na te ॥50॥
html:
ye te yayātipatane yajñe santaḥ samāgatāḥ ।
pratardanaprabhṛtayo rāma kiṃ kṣatriyā na te ॥50॥
slp1: ye te yayAtipatane yajYe santaH samAgatAH । pratardanapraBftayo rAma kiM kzatriyA na te ॥50॥

text: mithyāpratijño rāma tvaṃ katthase janasaṃsadi । bhayātkṣatriyavīrāṇāṃ parvataṃ samupāśritaḥ ॥51॥
html:
mithyāpratijño rāma tvaṃ katthase janasaṃsadi ।
bhayātkṣatriyavīrāṇāṃ parvataṃ samupāśritaḥ ॥51॥
slp1: miTyApratijYo rAma tvaM katTase janasaMsadi । BayAtkzatriyavIrARAM parvataM samupASritaH ॥51॥

text: sa punaḥ kṣatriyaśataiḥ pṛthivīmanusantatām । parāvasostadā śrutvā śastraṃ jagrāha bhārgavaḥ ॥52॥
html:
sa punaḥ kṣatriyaśataiḥ pṛthivīmanusantatām ।
parāvasostadā śrutvā śastraṃ jagrāha bhārgavaḥ ॥52॥
slp1: sa punaH kzatriyaSatEH pfTivImanusantatAm । parAvasostadA SrutvA SastraM jagrAha BArgavaH ॥52॥

text: tato ye kṣatriyā rājañśataśastena jīvitāḥ । te vivṛddhā mahāvīryāḥ pṛthivīpatayo'bhavan ॥53॥
html:
tato ye kṣatriyā rājañśataśastena jīvitāḥ ।
te vivṛddhā mahāvīryāḥ pṛthivīpatayo'bhavan ॥53॥
slp1: tato ye kzatriyA rAjaYSataSastena jIvitAH । te vivfdDA mahAvIryAH pfTivIpatayo'Bavan ॥53॥

text: sa punastāñjaghānāśu bālānapi narādhipa । garbhasthaistu mahī vyāptā punarevābhavattadā ॥54॥
html:
sa punastāñjaghānāśu bālānapi narādhipa ।
garbhasthaistu mahī vyāptā punarevābhavattadā ॥54॥
slp1: sa punastAYjaGAnASu bAlAnapi narADipa । garBasTEstu mahI vyAptA punarevABavattadA ॥54॥

text: jātaṃ jātaṃ sa garbhaṃ tu punareva jaghāna ha । arakṣaṃśca sutānkāṃścittadā kṣatriyayoṣitaḥ ॥55॥
html:
jātaṃ jātaṃ sa garbhaṃ tu punareva jaghāna ha ।
arakṣaṃśca sutānkāṃścittadā kṣatriyayoṣitaḥ ॥55॥
slp1: jAtaM jAtaM sa garBaM tu punareva jaGAna ha । arakzaMSca sutAnkAMScittadA kzatriyayozitaH ॥55॥

text: triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivīṃ kṛtvā niḥkṣatriyāṃ prabhuḥ । dakṣiṇāmaśvamedhānte kaśyapāyādadattataḥ ॥56॥
html:
triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivīṃ kṛtvā niḥkṣatriyāṃ prabhuḥ ।
dakṣiṇāmaśvamedhānte kaśyapāyādadattataḥ ॥56॥
slp1: triHsaptakftvaH pfTivIM kftvA niHkzatriyAM praBuH । dakziRAmaSvameDAnte kaSyapAyAdadattataH ॥56॥

text: kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu śeṣārthaṃ kareṇoddiśya kaśyapaḥ । srukpragrahavatā rājañśrīmānvākyamathābravīt ॥57॥
html:
kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu śeṣārthaṃ kareṇoddiśya kaśyapaḥ ।
srukpragrahavatā rājañśrīmānvākyamathābravīt ॥57॥
slp1: kzatriyARAM tu SezArTaM kareRoddiSya kaSyapaH । srukpragrahavatA rAjaYSrImAnvAkyamaTAbravIt ॥57॥

text: gaccha pāraṃ samudrasya dakṣiṇasya mahāmune । na te madviṣaye rāma vastavyamiha karhicit ॥58॥
html:
gaccha pāraṃ samudrasya dakṣiṇasya mahāmune ।
na te madviṣaye rāma vastavyamiha karhicit ॥58॥
slp1: gacCa pAraM samudrasya dakziRasya mahAmune । na te madvizaye rAma vastavyamiha karhicit ॥58॥

text: tataḥ śūrpārakaṃ deśaṃ sāgarastasya nirmame । santrāsājjāmadagnyasya so'parāntaṃ mahītalam ॥59॥
html:
tataḥ śūrpārakaṃ deśaṃ sāgarastasya nirmame ।
santrāsājjāmadagnyasya so'parāntaṃ mahītalam ॥59॥
slp1: tataH SUrpArakaM deSaM sAgarastasya nirmame । santrAsAjjAmadagnyasya so'parAntaM mahItalam ॥59॥

text: kaśyapastu mahārāja pratigṛhya mahīmimām । kṛtvā brāhmaṇasaṃsthāṃ vai praviveśa mahāvanam ॥60॥
html:
kaśyapastu mahārāja pratigṛhya mahīmimām ।
kṛtvā brāhmaṇasaṃsthāṃ vai praviveśa mahāvanam ॥60॥
slp1: kaSyapastu mahArAja pratigfhya mahImimAm । kftvA brAhmaRasaMsTAM vE praviveSa mahAvanam ॥60॥

text: tataḥ śūdrāśca vaiśyāśca yathāsvairapracāriṇaḥ । avartanta dvijāgryāṇāṃ dāreṣu bharatarṣabha ॥61॥
html:
tataḥ śūdrāśca vaiśyāśca yathāsvairapracāriṇaḥ ।
avartanta dvijāgryāṇāṃ dāreṣu bharatarṣabha ॥61॥
slp1: tataH SUdrASca vESyASca yaTAsvErapracAriRaH । avartanta dvijAgryARAM dArezu BaratarzaBa ॥61॥

text: arājake jīvaloke durbalā balavattaraiḥ । bādhyante na ca vitteṣu prabhutvamiha kasyacit ॥62॥
html:
arājake jīvaloke durbalā balavattaraiḥ ।
bādhyante na ca vitteṣu prabhutvamiha kasyacit ॥62॥
slp1: arAjake jIvaloke durbalA balavattarEH । bADyante na ca vittezu praButvamiha kasyacit ॥62॥

text: tataḥ kālena pṛthivī praviveśa rasātalam । arakṣyamāṇā vidhivatkṣatriyairdharmarakṣibhiḥ ॥63॥
html:
tataḥ kālena pṛthivī praviveśa rasātalam ।
arakṣyamāṇā vidhivatkṣatriyairdharmarakṣibhiḥ ॥63॥
slp1: tataH kAlena pfTivI praviveSa rasAtalam । arakzyamARA viDivatkzatriyErDarmarakziBiH ॥63॥

text: tato rāmasya tatkarma śrutvā rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatvā pratyuvāca janārdanam ॥1॥

śakta ekarathenaiva vijetuṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: tvaM hi devAnsaganDarvAnsasurAsurarAkzasAn । Sakta ekaraTenEva vijetuM nAtra saMSayaH ॥25॥

text: tvaṃ hi bhīṣma mahābāho vasūnāṃ vāsavopamaḥ । nityaṃ vipraiḥ samākhyāto navamo'navamo guṇaiḥ ॥26॥
html:
tvaṃ hi bhīṣma mahābāho vasūnāṃ vāsavopamaḥ ।
nityaṃ vipraiḥ samākhyāto navamo'navamo guṇaiḥ ॥26॥
slp1: tvaM hi BIzma mahAbAho vasUnAM vAsavopamaH । nityaM viprEH samAKyAto navamo'navamo guREH ॥26॥

text: ahaṃ hi tvābhijānāmi yastvaṃ puruṣasattama । tridaśeṣvapi vikhyātaḥ svaśaktyā sumahābalaḥ ॥27॥
html:
ahaṃ hi tvābhijānāmi yastvaṃ puruṣasattama ।
tridaśeṣvapi vikhyātaḥ svaśaktyā sumahābalaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: ahaM hi tvABijAnAmi yastvaM puruzasattama । tridaSezvapi viKyAtaH svaSaktyA sumahAbalaH ॥27॥

text: manuṣyeṣu manuṣyendra na dṛṣṭo na ca me śrutaḥ । bhavato yo guṇaistulyaḥ pṛthivyāṃ puruṣaḥ kvacit ॥28॥
html:
manuṣyeṣu manuṣyendra na dṛṣṭo na ca me śrutaḥ ।
bhavato yo guṇaistulyaḥ pṛthivyāṃ puruṣaḥ kvacit ॥28॥
slp1: manuzyezu manuzyendra na dfzwo na ca me SrutaH । Bavato yo guREstulyaH pfTivyAM puruzaH kvacit ॥28॥

text: tvaṃ hi sarvairguṇai rājandevānapyatiricyase । tapasā hi bhavāñśaktaḥ sraṣṭuṃ lokāṃścarācarān ॥29॥
html:
tvaṃ hi sarvairguṇai rājandevānapyatiricyase ।
tapasā hi bhavāñśaktaḥ sraṣṭuṃ lokāṃścarācarān ॥29॥
slp1: tvaM hi sarvErguRE rAjandevAnapyatiricyase । tapasA hi BavAYSaktaH srazwuM lokAMScarAcarAn ॥29॥

text: tadasya tapyamānasya jñātīnāṃ saṅkṣayeṇa vai । jyeṣṭhasya pāṇḍuputrasya śokaṃ bhīṣma vyapānuda ॥30॥
html:
tadasya tapyamānasya jñātīnāṃ saṅkṣayeṇa vai ।
jyeṣṭhasya pāṇḍuputrasya śokaṃ bhīṣma vyapānuda ॥30॥
slp1: tadasya tapyamAnasya jYAtInAM saNkzayeRa vE । jyezWasya pARquputrasya SokaM BIzma vyapAnuda ॥30॥

text: ye hi dharmāḥ samākhyātāścāturvarṇyasya bhārata । cāturāśramyasaṃsṛṣṭāste sarve viditāstava ॥31॥
html:
ye hi dharmāḥ samākhyātāścāturvarṇyasya bhārata ।
cāturāśramyasaṃsṛṣṭāste sarve viditāstava ॥31॥
slp1: ye hi DarmAH samAKyAtAScAturvarRyasya BArata । cAturASramyasaMsfzwAste sarve viditAstava ॥31॥

text: cāturvedye ca ye proktāścāturhotre ca bhārata । sāṅkhye yoge ca niyatā ye ca dharmāḥ sanātanāḥ ॥32॥
html:
cāturvedye ca ye proktāścāturhotre ca bhārata ।
sāṅkhye yoge ca niyatā ye ca dharmāḥ sanātanāḥ ॥32॥
slp1: cAturvedye ca ye proktAScAturhotre ca BArata । sANKye yoge ca niyatA ye ca DarmAH sanAtanAH ॥32॥

text: cāturvarṇyena yaścaiko dharmo na sma virudhyate । sevyamānaḥ sa caivādyo gāṅgeya viditastava ॥33॥
html:
cāturvarṇyena yaścaiko dharmo na sma virudhyate ।
sevyamānaḥ sa caivādyo gāṅgeya viditastava ॥33॥
slp1: cAturvarRyena yaScEko Darmo na sma viruDyate । sevyamAnaH sa cEvAdyo gANgeya viditastava ॥33॥

text: itihāsapurāṇaṃ ca kārtsnyena viditaṃ tava । dharmaśāstraṃ ca sakalaṃ nityaṃ manasi te sthitam ॥34॥
html:
itihāsapurāṇaṃ ca kārtsnyena viditaṃ tava ।
dharmaśāstraṃ ca sakalaṃ nityaṃ manasi te sthitam ॥34॥
slp1: itihAsapurARaM ca kArtsnyena viditaM tava । DarmaSAstraM ca sakalaM nityaM manasi te sTitam ॥34॥

text: ye ca kecana loke'sminnarthāḥ saṃśayakārakāḥ । teṣāṃ chettā nāsti loke tvadanyaḥ puruṣarṣabha ॥35॥
html:
ye ca kecana loke'sminnarthāḥ saṃśayakārakāḥ ।
teṣāṃ chettā nāsti loke tvadanyaḥ puruṣarṣabha ॥35॥
slp1: ye ca kecana loke'sminnarTAH saMSayakArakAH । tezAM CettA nAsti loke tvadanyaH puruzarzaBa ॥35॥

text: sa pāṇḍaveyasya manaḥsamutthitaṃ narendra śokaṃ vyapakarṣa medhayā । bhavadvidhā hyuttamabuddhivistarā vimuhyamānasya janasya śāntaye] ॥36॥
html:
sa pāṇḍaveyasya manaḥsamutthitaṃ narendra śokaṃ vyapakarṣa medhayā ।
bhavadvidhā hyuttamabuddhivistarā vimuhyamānasya janasya śāntaye] ॥36॥
slp1: sa pARqaveyasya manaHsamutTitaM narendra SokaM vyapakarza meDayA । BavadviDA hyuttamabudDivistarA vimuhyamAnasya janasya SAntaye] ॥36॥

text: śrutvā tu vacanaṃ bhīṣmo vāsudevasya dhīmataḥ । kiñcidunnāmya vadanaṃ prāñjalirvākyamabravīt ॥1॥
html:
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ bhīṣmo vāsudevasya dhīmataḥ ।
kiñcidunnāmya vadanaṃ prāñjalirvākyamabravīt ॥1॥
slp1: SrutvA tu vacanaM BIzmo vAsudevasya DImataH । kiYcidunnAmya vadanaM prAYjalirvAkyamabravIt ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: namaste bhagavanviṣṇo lokānāṃ nidhanodbhava । tvaṃ hi kartā hṛṣīkeśa saṃhartā cāparājitaḥ ॥2॥
html:
namaste bhagavanviṣṇo lokānāṃ nidhanodbhava ।
tvaṃ hi kartā hṛṣīkeśa saṃhartā cāparājitaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: namaste BagavanvizRo lokAnAM niDanodBava । tvaM hi kartA hfzIkeSa saMhartA cAparAjitaH ॥2॥

text: viśvakarmannamaste'stu viśvātmanviśvasambhava । apavargo'si bhūtānāṃ pañcānāṃ parataḥ sthitaḥ ॥3॥
html:
viśvakarmannamaste'stu viśvātmanviśvasambhava ।
apavargo'si bhūtānāṃ pañcānāṃ parataḥ sthitaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: viSvakarmannamaste'stu viSvAtmanviSvasamBava । apavargo'si BUtAnAM paYcAnAM parataH sTitaH ॥3॥

text: namaste triṣu lokeṣu namaste paratastriṣu । yogeśvara namaste'stu tvaṃ hi sarvaparāyaṇam ॥4॥
html:
namaste triṣu lokeṣu namaste paratastriṣu ।
yogeśvara namaste'stu tvaṃ hi sarvaparāyaṇam ॥4॥
slp1: namaste trizu lokezu namaste paratastrizu । yogeSvara namaste'stu tvaM hi sarvaparAyaRam ॥4॥

text: matsaṃśritaṃ yadāttha tvaṃ vacaḥ puruṣasattama । tena paśyāmi te divyānbhāvānhi triṣu vartmasu ॥5॥
html:
matsaṃśritaṃ yadāttha tvaṃ vacaḥ puruṣasattama ।
tena paśyāmi te divyānbhāvānhi triṣu vartmasu ॥5॥
slp1: matsaMSritaM yadAtTa tvaM vacaH puruzasattama । tena paSyAmi te divyAnBAvAnhi trizu vartmasu ॥5॥

text: tacca paśyāmi tattvena yatte rūpaṃ sanātanam । sapta mārgā niruddhāste vāyoramitatejasaḥ ॥6॥
html:
tacca paśyāmi tattvena yatte rūpaṃ sanātanam ।
sapta mārgā niruddhāste vāyoramitatejasaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: tacca paSyAmi tattvena yatte rUpaM sanAtanam । sapta mArgA nirudDAste vAyoramitatejasaH ॥6॥

text: divaṃ te śirasā vyāptaṃ padbhyāṃ devī vasundharā । diśo bhujau raviścakṣurvīrye śakraḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ॥7॥
html:
divaṃ te śirasā vyāptaṃ padbhyāṃ devī vasundharā ।
diśo bhujau raviścakṣurvīrye śakraḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: divaM te SirasA vyAptaM padByAM devI vasunDarA । diSo BujO raviScakzurvIrye SakraH pratizWitaH ॥7॥

text: atasīpuṣpasaṅkāśaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam । vapurhyanumimīmaste meghasyeva savidyutaḥ ॥8॥
html:
atasīpuṣpasaṅkāśaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam ।
vapurhyanumimīmaste meghasyeva savidyutaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: atasIpuzpasaNkASaM pItavAsasamacyutam । vapurhyanumimImaste meGasyeva savidyutaH ॥8॥

text: tvatprapannāya bhaktāya gatimiṣṭāṃ jigīṣave । yacchreyaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣa taddhyāyasva surottama ॥9॥
html:
tvatprapannāya bhaktāya gatimiṣṭāṃ jigīṣave ।
yacchreyaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣa taddhyāyasva surottama ॥9॥
slp1: tvatprapannAya BaktAya gatimizwAM jigIzave । yacCreyaH puRqarIkAkza tadDyAyasva surottama ॥9॥

text: yataḥ khalu parā bhaktirmayi te puruṣarṣabha । tato vapurmayā divyaṃ tava rājanpradarśitam ॥10॥
html:
yataḥ khalu parā bhaktirmayi te puruṣarṣabha ।
tato vapurmayā divyaṃ tava rājanpradarśitam ॥10॥
slp1: yataH Kalu parA Baktirmayi te puruzarzaBa । tato vapurmayA divyaM tava rAjanpradarSitam ॥10॥
author: vāsudeva uvāca ।

text: na hyabhaktāya rājendra bhaktāyānṛjave na ca । darśayāmyahamātmānaṃ na cādāntāya bhārata ॥11॥
html:
na hyabhaktāya rājendra bhaktāyānṛjave na ca ।
darśayāmyahamātmānaṃ na cādāntāya bhārata ॥11॥
slp1: na hyaBaktAya rAjendra BaktAyAnfjave na ca । darSayAmyahamAtmAnaM na cAdAntAya BArata ॥11॥

text: bhavāṃstu mama bhaktaśca nityaṃ cārjavamāsthitaḥ । dame tapasi satye ca dāne ca nirataḥ śuciḥ ॥12॥
html:
bhavāṃstu mama bhaktaśca nityaṃ cārjavamāsthitaḥ ।
dame tapasi satye ca dāne ca nirataḥ śuciḥ ॥12॥
slp1: BavAMstu mama BaktaSca nityaM cArjavamAsTitaH । dame tapasi satye ca dAne ca nirataH SuciH ॥12॥

text: arhastvaṃ bhīṣma māṃ draṣṭuṃ tapasā svena pārthiva । tava hyupasthitā lokā yebhyo nāvartate punaḥ ॥13॥
html:
arhastvaṃ bhīṣma māṃ draṣṭuṃ tapasā svena pārthiva ।
tava hyupasthitā lokā yebhyo nāvartate punaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: arhastvaM BIzma mAM drazwuM tapasA svena pArTiva । tava hyupasTitA lokA yeByo nAvartate punaH ॥13॥

text: pañcāśataṃ ṣaṭca kurupravīra śeṣaṃ dinānāṃ tava jīvitasya । tataḥ śubhaiḥ karmaphalodayaistvaṃ sameṣyase bhīṣma vimucya deham ॥14॥
html:
pañcāśataṃ ṣaṭca kurupravīra śeṣaṃ dinānāṃ tava jīvitasya ।
tataḥ śubhaiḥ karmaphalodayaistvaṃ sameṣyase bhīṣma vimucya deham ॥14॥
slp1: paYcASataM zawca kurupravIra SezaM dinAnAM tava jIvitasya । tataH SuBEH karmaPalodayEstvaM samezyase BIzma vimucya deham ॥14॥

text: ete hi devā vasavo vimānānyāsthāya sarve jvalitāgnikalpāḥ । antarhitāstvāṃ pratipālayanti kāṣṭhāṃ prapadyantamudakpataṅgam ॥15॥
html:
ete hi devā vasavo vimānānyāsthāya sarve jvalitāgnikalpāḥ ।
antarhitāstvāṃ pratipālayanti kāṣṭhāṃ prapadyantamudakpataṅgam ॥15॥
slp1: ete hi devA vasavo vimAnAnyAsTAya sarve jvalitAgnikalpAH । antarhitAstvAM pratipAlayanti kAzWAM prapadyantamudakpataNgam ॥15॥

text: vyāvṛttamātre bhagavatyudīcīṃ sūrye diśaṃ kālavaśātprapanne । gantāsi lokānpuruṣapravīra nāvartate yānupalabhya vidvān ॥16॥
html:
vyāvṛttamātre bhagavatyudīcīṃ sūrye diśaṃ kālavaśātprapanne ।
gantāsi lokānpuruṣapravīra nāvartate yānupalabhya vidvān ॥16॥
slp1: vyAvfttamAtre BagavatyudIcIM sUrye diSaM kAlavaSAtprapanne । gantAsi lokAnpuruzapravIra nAvartate yAnupalaBya vidvAn ॥16॥

text: amuṃ ca lokaṃ tvayi bhīṣma yāte jñānāni naṅkṣyantyakhilena vīra । ataḥ sma sarve tvayi sannikarṣaṃ samāgatā dharmavivecanāya ॥17॥
html:
amuṃ ca lokaṃ tvayi bhīṣma yāte jñānāni naṅkṣyantyakhilena vīra ।
ataḥ sma sarve tvayi sannikarṣaṃ samāgatā dharmavivecanāya ॥17॥
slp1: amuM ca lokaM tvayi BIzma yAte jYAnAni naNkzyantyaKilena vIra । ataH sma sarve tvayi sannikarzaM samAgatA DarmavivecanAya ॥17॥

text: tajjñātiśokopahataśrutāya satyābhisandhāya yudhiṣṭhirāya । prabrūhi dharmārthasamādhiyuktamarthyaṃ vaco'syāpanudāsya śokam] ॥18॥
html:
tajjñātiśokopahataśrutāya satyābhisandhāya yudhiṣṭhirāya ।
prabrūhi dharmārthasamādhiyuktamarthyaṃ vaco'syāpanudāsya śokam] ॥18॥
slp1: tajjYAtiSokopahataSrutAya satyABisanDAya yuDizWirAya । prabrUhi DarmArTasamADiyuktamarTyaM vaco'syApanudAsya Sokam] ॥18॥

text: tataḥ kṛṣṇasya tadvākyaṃ dharmārthasahitaṃ hitam । śrutvā śāntanavo bhīṣmaḥ pratyuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ ॥1॥
html:
tataḥ kṛṣṇasya tadvākyaṃ dharmārthasahitaṃ hitam ।
śrutvā śāntanavo bhīṣmaḥ pratyuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ ॥1॥
slp1: tataH kfzRasya tadvAkyaM DarmArTasahitaM hitam । SrutvA SAntanavo BIzmaH pratyuvAca kftAYjaliH ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: lokanātha mahābāho śiva nārāyaṇācyuta । tava vākyamabhiśrutya harṣeṇāsmi pariplutaḥ ॥2॥
html:
lokanātha mahābāho śiva nārāyaṇācyuta ।
tava vākyamabhiśrutya harṣeṇāsmi pariplutaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: lokanATa mahAbAho Siva nArAyaRAcyuta । tava vAkyamaBiSrutya harzeRAsmi pariplutaH ॥2॥

text: kiṃ cāhamabhidhāsyāmi vākpate tava sannidhau । yadā vācogataṃ sarvaṃ tava vāci samāhitam ॥3॥
html:
kiṃ cāhamabhidhāsyāmi vākpate tava sannidhau ।
yadā vācogataṃ sarvaṃ tava vāci samāhitam ॥3॥
slp1: kiM cAhamaBiDAsyAmi vAkpate tava sanniDO । yadA vAcogataM sarvaM tava vAci samAhitam ॥3॥

text: yaddhi kiñcitkṛtaṃ loke kartavyaṃ kriyate ca yat । tvattastanniḥsṛtaṃ deva lokā buddhimayā hi te ॥4॥
html:
yaddhi kiñcitkṛtaṃ loke kartavyaṃ kriyate ca yat ।
tvattastanniḥsṛtaṃ deva lokā buddhimayā hi te ॥4॥
slp1: yadDi kiYcitkftaM loke kartavyaM kriyate ca yat । tvattastanniHsftaM deva lokA budDimayA hi te ॥4॥

text: kathayeddevalokaṃ yo devarājasamīpataḥ । dharmakāmārthaśāstrāṇāṃ so'rthānbrūyāttavāgrataḥ ॥5॥
html:
kathayeddevalokaṃ yo devarājasamīpataḥ ।
dharmakāmārthaśāstrāṇāṃ so'rthānbrūyāttavāgrataḥ ॥5॥
slp1: kaTayeddevalokaM yo devarAjasamIpataH । DarmakAmArTaSAstrARAM so'rTAnbrUyAttavAgrataH ॥5॥

text: śarābhighātādvyathitaṃ mano me madhusūdana । gātrāṇi cāvasīdanti na ca buddhiḥ prasīdati ॥6॥
html:
śarābhighātādvyathitaṃ mano me madhusūdana ।
gātrāṇi cāvasīdanti na ca buddhiḥ prasīdati ॥6॥
slp1: SarABiGAtAdvyaTitaM mano me maDusUdana । gAtrARi cAvasIdanti na ca budDiH prasIdati ॥6॥

text: na ca me pratibhā kācidasti kiñcitprabhāṣitum । pīḍyamānasya govinda viṣānalasamaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥7॥
html:
na ca me pratibhā kācidasti kiñcitprabhāṣitum ।
pīḍyamānasya govinda viṣānalasamaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥7॥
slp1: na ca me pratiBA kAcidasti kiYcitpraBAzitum । pIqyamAnasya govinda vizAnalasamEH SarEH ॥7॥

text: balaṃ medhāḥ prajarati prāṇāḥ santvarayanti ca । marmāṇi paritapyante bhrāntaṃ cetastathaiva ca ॥8॥
html:
balaṃ medhāḥ prajarati prāṇāḥ santvarayanti ca ।
marmāṇi paritapyante bhrāntaṃ cetastathaiva ca ॥8॥
slp1: balaM meDAH prajarati prARAH santvarayanti ca । marmARi paritapyante BrAntaM cetastaTEva ca ॥8॥

text: daurbalyātsajjate vāṅme sa kathaṃ vaktumutsahe । sādhu me tvaṃ prasīdasva dāśārhakulanandana ॥9॥
html:
daurbalyātsajjate vāṅme sa kathaṃ vaktumutsahe ।
sādhu me tvaṃ prasīdasva dāśārhakulanandana ॥9॥
slp1: dOrbalyAtsajjate vANme sa kaTaM vaktumutsahe । sADu me tvaM prasIdasva dASArhakulanandana ॥9॥

text: tatkṣamasva mahābāho na brūyāṃ kiñcidacyuta । tvatsannidhau ca sīdeta vācaspatirapi bruvan ॥10॥
html:
tatkṣamasva mahābāho na brūyāṃ kiñcidacyuta ।
tvatsannidhau ca sīdeta vācaspatirapi bruvan ॥10॥
slp1: tatkzamasva mahAbAho na brUyAM kiYcidacyuta । tvatsanniDO ca sIdeta vAcaspatirapi bruvan ॥10॥

text: na diśaḥ samprajānāmi nākāśaṃ na ca medinīm । kevalaṃ tava vīryeṇa tiṣṭhāmi madhusūdana ॥11॥
html:
na diśaḥ samprajānāmi nākāśaṃ na ca medinīm ।
kevalaṃ tava vīryeṇa tiṣṭhāmi madhusūdana ॥11॥
slp1: na diSaH samprajAnAmi nAkASaM na ca medinIm । kevalaM tava vIryeRa tizWAmi maDusUdana ॥11॥

text: svayameva prabho tasmāddharmarājasya yaddhitam । tadbravīhyāśu sarveṣāmāgamānāṃ tvamāgamaḥ ॥12॥
html:
svayameva prabho tasmāddharmarājasya yaddhitam ।
tadbravīhyāśu sarveṣāmāgamānāṃ tvamāgamaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: svayameva praBo tasmAdDarmarAjasya yadDitam । tadbravIhyASu sarvezAmAgamAnAM tvamAgamaH ॥12॥

text: kathaṃ tvayi sthite loke śāśvate lokakartari । prabrūyānmadvidhaḥ kaścidgurau śiṣya iva sthite ॥13॥
html:
kathaṃ tvayi sthite loke śāśvate lokakartari ।
prabrūyānmadvidhaḥ kaścidgurau śiṣya iva sthite ॥13॥
slp1: kaTaM tvayi sTite loke SASvate lokakartari । prabrUyAnmadviDaH kaScidgurO Sizya iva sTite ॥13॥

text: upapannamidaṃ vākyaṃ kauravāṇāṃ dhurandhare । mahāvīrye mahāsattve sthite sarvārthadarśini ॥14॥
html:
upapannamidaṃ vākyaṃ kauravāṇāṃ dhurandhare ।
mahāvīrye mahāsattve sthite sarvārthadarśini ॥14॥
slp1: upapannamidaM vAkyaM kOravARAM DuranDare । mahAvIrye mahAsattve sTite sarvArTadarSini ॥14॥
author: vāsudeva uvāca ।

text: yacca māmāttha gāṅgeya bāṇaghātarujaṃ prati । gṛhāṇātra varaṃ bhīṣma matprasādakṛtaṃ vibho ॥15॥
html:
yacca māmāttha gāṅgeya bāṇaghātarujaṃ prati ।
gṛhāṇātra varaṃ bhīṣma matprasādakṛtaṃ vibho ॥15॥
slp1: yacca mAmAtTa gANgeya bARaGAtarujaM prati । gfhARAtra varaM BIzma matprasAdakftaM viBo ॥15॥

text: na te glānirna te mūrchā na dāho na ca te rujā । prabhaviṣyanti gāṅgeya kṣutpipāse na cāpyuta ॥16॥
html:
na te glānirna te mūrchā na dāho na ca te rujā ।
prabhaviṣyanti gāṅgeya kṣutpipāse na cāpyuta ॥16॥
slp1: na te glAnirna te mUrCA na dAho na ca te rujA । praBavizyanti gANgeya kzutpipAse na cApyuta ॥16॥

text: jñānāni ca samagrāṇi pratibhāsyanti te'nagha । na ca te kvacidāsaktirbuddheḥ prādurbhaviṣyati ॥17॥
html:
jñānāni ca samagrāṇi pratibhāsyanti te'nagha ।
na ca te kvacidāsaktirbuddheḥ prādurbhaviṣyati ॥17॥
slp1: jYAnAni ca samagrARi pratiBAsyanti te'naGa । na ca te kvacidAsaktirbudDeH prAdurBavizyati ॥17॥

text: sattvasthaṃ ca mano nityaṃ tava bhīṣma bhaviṣyati । rajastamobhyāṃ rahitaṃ ghanairmukta ivoḍurāṭ ॥18॥
html:
sattvasthaṃ ca mano nityaṃ tava bhīṣma bhaviṣyati ।
rajastamobhyāṃ rahitaṃ ghanairmukta ivoḍurāṭ ॥18॥
slp1: sattvasTaM ca mano nityaM tava BIzma Bavizyati । rajastamoByAM rahitaM GanErmukta ivoqurAw ॥18॥

text: yadyacca dharmasaṃyuktamarthayuktamathāpi vā । cintayiṣyasi tatrāgryā buddhistava bhaviṣyati ॥19॥
html:
yadyacca dharmasaṃyuktamarthayuktamathāpi vā ।
cintayiṣyasi tatrāgryā buddhistava bhaviṣyati ॥19॥
slp1: yadyacca DarmasaMyuktamarTayuktamaTApi vA । cintayizyasi tatrAgryA budDistava Bavizyati ॥19॥

text: imaṃ ca rājaśārdūla bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham । cakṣurdivyaṃ samāśritya drakṣyasyamitavikrama ॥20॥
html:
imaṃ ca rājaśārdūla bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham ।
cakṣurdivyaṃ samāśritya drakṣyasyamitavikrama ॥20॥
slp1: imaM ca rAjaSArdUla BUtagrAmaM caturviDam । cakzurdivyaM samASritya drakzyasyamitavikrama ॥20॥

text: caturvidhaṃ prajājālaṃ saṃyukto jñānacakṣuṣā । bhīṣma drakṣyasi tattvena jale mīna ivāmale ॥21॥
html:
caturvidhaṃ prajājālaṃ saṃyukto jñānacakṣuṣā ।
bhīṣma drakṣyasi tattvena jale mīna ivāmale ॥21॥
slp1: caturviDaM prajAjAlaM saMyukto jYAnacakzuzA । BIzma drakzyasi tattvena jale mIna ivAmale ॥21॥

text: tataste vyāsasahitāḥ sarva eva maharṣayaḥ । ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃyuktairvacobhiḥ kṛṣṇamarcayan ॥22॥
html:
tataste vyāsasahitāḥ sarva eva maharṣayaḥ ।
ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃyuktairvacobhiḥ kṛṣṇamarcayan ॥22॥
slp1: tataste vyAsasahitAH sarva eva maharzayaH । fgyajuHsAmasaMyuktErvacoBiH kfzRamarcayan ॥22॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: tataḥ sarvārtavaṃ divyaṃ puṣpavarṣaṃ nabhastalāt । papāta yatra vārṣṇeyaḥ sagāṅgeyaḥ sapāṇḍavaḥ ॥23॥
html:
tataḥ sarvārtavaṃ divyaṃ puṣpavarṣaṃ nabhastalāt ।
papāta yatra vārṣṇeyaḥ sagāṅgeyaḥ sapāṇḍavaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: tataH sarvArtavaM divyaM puzpavarzaM naBastalAt । papAta yatra vArzReyaH sagANgeyaH sapARqavaH ॥23॥

text: vāditrāṇi ca divyāni jaguścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ । na cāhitamaniṣṭaṃ vā kiñcittatra vyadṛśyata ॥24॥
html:
vāditrāṇi ca divyāni jaguścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ।
na cāhitamaniṣṭaṃ vā kiñcittatra vyadṛśyata ॥24॥
slp1: vAditrARi ca divyAni jaguScApsarasAM gaRAH । na cAhitamanizwaM vA kiYcittatra vyadfSyata ॥24॥

text: vavau śivaḥ sukho vāyuḥ sarvagandhavahaḥ śuciḥ । śāntāyāṃ diśi śāntāśca prāvadanmṛgapakṣiṇaḥ ॥25॥
html:
vavau śivaḥ sukho vāyuḥ sarvagandhavahaḥ śuciḥ ।
śāntāyāṃ diśi śāntāśca prāvadanmṛgapakṣiṇaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: vavO SivaH suKo vAyuH sarvaganDavahaH SuciH । SAntAyAM diSi SAntASca prAvadanmfgapakziRaH ॥25॥

text: tato muhūrtādbhagavānsahasrāṃśurdivākaraḥ । dahanvanamivaikānte pratīcyāṃ pratyadṛśyata ॥26॥
html:
tato muhūrtādbhagavānsahasrāṃśurdivākaraḥ ।
dahanvanamivaikānte pratīcyāṃ pratyadṛśyata ॥26॥
slp1: tato muhUrtAdBagavAnsahasrAMSurdivAkaraH । dahanvanamivEkAnte pratIcyAM pratyadfSyata ॥26॥

text: tato maharṣayaḥ sarve samutthāya janārdanam । bhīṣmamāmantrayāṃ cakrū rājānaṃ ca yudhiṣṭhiram ॥27॥
html:
tato maharṣayaḥ sarve samutthāya janārdanam ।
bhīṣmamāmantrayāṃ cakrū rājānaṃ ca yudhiṣṭhiram ॥27॥
slp1: tato maharzayaH sarve samutTAya janArdanam । BIzmamAmantrayAM cakrU rAjAnaM ca yuDizWiram ॥27॥

text: tataḥ praṇāmamakarotkeśavaḥ pāṇḍavastathā । sātyakiḥ sañjayaścaiva sa ca śāradvataḥ kṛpaḥ ॥28॥
html:
tataḥ praṇāmamakarotkeśavaḥ pāṇḍavastathā ।
sātyakiḥ sañjayaścaiva sa ca śāradvataḥ kṛpaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: tataH praRAmamakarotkeSavaH pARqavastaTA । sAtyakiH saYjayaScEva sa ca SAradvataH kfpaH ॥28॥

text: tataste dharmaniratāḥ samyaktairabhipūjitāḥ । śvaḥ sameṣyāma ityuktvā yatheṣṭaṃ tvaritā yayuḥ ॥29॥
html:
tataste dharmaniratāḥ samyaktairabhipūjitāḥ ।
śvaḥ sameṣyāma ityuktvā yatheṣṭaṃ tvaritā yayuḥ ॥29॥
slp1: tataste DarmaniratAH samyaktEraBipUjitAH । SvaH samezyAma ityuktvA yaTezwaM tvaritA yayuH ॥29॥

text: tathaivāmantrya gāṅgeyaṃ keśavaste ca pāṇḍavāḥ । pradakṣiṇamupāvṛtya rathānāruruhuḥ śubhān ॥30॥
html:
tathaivāmantrya gāṅgeyaṃ keśavaste ca pāṇḍavāḥ ।
pradakṣiṇamupāvṛtya rathānāruruhuḥ śubhān ॥30॥
slp1: taTEvAmantrya gANgeyaM keSavaste ca pARqavAH । pradakziRamupAvftya raTAnAruruhuH SuBAn ॥30॥

text: tato rathaiḥ kāñcanadantakūbarairmahīdharābhaiḥ samadaiśca dantibhiḥ । hayaiḥ suparṇairiva cāśugāmibhiḥ padātibhiścāttaśarāsanādibhiḥ ॥31॥
html:
tato rathaiḥ kāñcanadantakūbarairmahīdharābhaiḥ samadaiśca dantibhiḥ ।
hayaiḥ suparṇairiva cāśugāmibhiḥ padātibhiścāttaśarāsanādibhiḥ ॥31॥
slp1: tato raTEH kAYcanadantakUbarErmahIDarABEH samadESca dantiBiH । hayEH suparREriva cASugAmiBiH padAtiBiScAttaSarAsanAdiBiH ॥31॥

text: yayau rathānāṃ purato hi sā camūstathaiva paścādatimātrasāriṇī । puraśca paścācca yathā mahānadī purarkṣavantaṃ girimetya narmadā ॥32॥
html:
yayau rathānāṃ purato hi sā camūstathaiva paścādatimātrasāriṇī ।
puraśca paścācca yathā mahānadī purarkṣavantaṃ girimetya narmadā ॥32॥
slp1: yayO raTAnAM purato hi sA camUstaTEva paScAdatimAtrasAriRI । puraSca paScAcca yaTA mahAnadI purarkzavantaM girimetya narmadA ॥32॥

text: tataḥ purastādbhagavānniśākaraḥ samutthitastāmabhiharṣayaṃścamūm । divākarāpītarasāstathauṣadhīḥ punaḥ svakenaiva guṇena yojayan ॥33॥
html:
tataḥ purastādbhagavānniśākaraḥ samutthitastāmabhiharṣayaṃścamūm ।
divākarāpītarasāstathauṣadhīḥ punaḥ svakenaiva guṇena yojayan ॥33॥
slp1: tataH purastAdBagavAnniSAkaraH samutTitastAmaBiharzayaMScamUm । divAkarApItarasAstaTOzaDIH punaH svakenEva guRena yojayan ॥33॥

text: tataḥ puraṃ surapurasannibhadyuti praviśya te yaduvṛṣapāṇḍavāstadā । yathocitānbhavanavarānsamāviśañśramānvitā mṛgapatayo guhā iva] ॥34॥
html:
tataḥ puraṃ surapurasannibhadyuti praviśya te yaduvṛṣapāṇḍavāstadā ।
yathocitānbhavanavarānsamāviśañśramānvitā mṛgapatayo guhā iva] ॥34॥
slp1: tataH puraM surapurasanniBadyuti praviSya te yaduvfzapARqavAstadA । yaTocitAnBavanavarAnsamAviSaYSramAnvitA mfgapatayo guhA iva] ॥34॥

text: tataḥ praviśya bhavanaṃ prasupto madhusūdanaḥ । yāmamātrāvaśeṣāyāṃ yāminyāṃ pratyabudhyata ॥1॥
html:
tataḥ praviśya bhavanaṃ prasupto madhusūdanaḥ ।
yāmamātrāvaśeṣāyāṃ yāminyāṃ pratyabudhyata ॥1॥
slp1: tataH praviSya BavanaM prasupto maDusUdanaH । yAmamAtrAvaSezAyAM yAminyAM pratyabuDyata ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: sa dhyānapathamāśritya sarvajñānāni mādhavaḥ । avalokya tataḥ paścāddadhyau brahma sanātanam ॥2॥
html:
sa dhyānapathamāśritya sarvajñānāni mādhavaḥ ।
avalokya tataḥ paścāddadhyau brahma sanātanam ॥2॥
slp1: sa DyAnapaTamASritya sarvajYAnAni mADavaH । avalokya tataH paScAddaDyO brahma sanAtanam ॥2॥

text: tataḥ śrutipurāṇajñāḥ śikṣitā raktakaṇṭhinaḥ । astuvanviśvakarmāṇaṃ vāsudevaṃ prajāpatim ॥3॥
html:
tataḥ śrutipurāṇajñāḥ śikṣitā raktakaṇṭhinaḥ ।
astuvanviśvakarmāṇaṃ vāsudevaṃ prajāpatim ॥3॥
slp1: tataH SrutipurARajYAH SikzitA raktakaRWinaH । astuvanviSvakarmARaM vAsudevaM prajApatim ॥3॥

text: paṭhanti pāṇisvanikāstathā gāyanti gāyanāḥ । śaṅkhānakamṛdaṅgāṃśca pravādyanta sahasraśaḥ ॥4॥
html:
paṭhanti pāṇisvanikāstathā gāyanti gāyanāḥ ।
śaṅkhānakamṛdaṅgāṃśca pravādyanta sahasraśaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: paWanti pARisvanikAstaTA gAyanti gAyanAH । SaNKAnakamfdaNgAMSca pravAdyanta sahasraSaH ॥4॥

text: vīṇāpaṇavaveṇūnāṃ svanaścātimanoramaḥ । prahāsa iva vistīrṇaḥ śuśruve tasya veśmanaḥ ॥5॥
html:
vīṇāpaṇavaveṇūnāṃ svanaścātimanoramaḥ ।
prahāsa iva vistīrṇaḥ śuśruve tasya veśmanaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: vIRApaRavaveRUnAM svanaScAtimanoramaH । prahAsa iva vistIrRaH SuSruve tasya veSmanaH ॥5॥

text: tathā yudhiṣṭhirasyāpi rājño maṅgalasaṃhitāḥ । uccerurmadhurā vāco gītavāditrasaṃhitāḥ ॥6॥
html:
tathā yudhiṣṭhirasyāpi rājño maṅgalasaṃhitāḥ ।
uccerurmadhurā vāco gītavāditrasaṃhitāḥ ॥6॥
slp1: taTA yuDizWirasyApi rAjYo maNgalasaMhitAH । uccerurmaDurA vAco gItavAditrasaMhitAH ॥6॥

text: tata utthāya dāśārhaḥ snātaḥ prāñjaliracyutaḥ । japtvā guhyaṃ mahābāhuragnīnāśritya tasthivān ॥7॥
html:
tata utthāya dāśārhaḥ snātaḥ prāñjaliracyutaḥ ।
japtvā guhyaṃ mahābāhuragnīnāśritya tasthivān ॥7॥
slp1: tata utTAya dASArhaH snAtaH prAYjaliracyutaH । japtvA guhyaM mahAbAhuragnInASritya tasTivAn ॥7॥

text: tataḥ sahasraṃ viprāṇāṃ caturvedavidāṃ tathā । gavāṃ sahasreṇaikaikaṃ vācayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ॥8॥
html:
tataḥ sahasraṃ viprāṇāṃ caturvedavidāṃ tathā ।
gavāṃ sahasreṇaikaikaṃ vācayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tataH sahasraM viprARAM caturvedavidAM taTA । gavAM sahasreREkEkaM vAcayAmAsa mADavaH ॥8॥

text: maṅgalālambhanaṃ kṛtvā ātmānamavalokya ca । ādarśe vimale kṛṣṇastataḥ sātyakimabravīt ॥9॥
html:
maṅgalālambhanaṃ kṛtvā ātmānamavalokya ca ।
ādarśe vimale kṛṣṇastataḥ sātyakimabravīt ॥9॥
slp1: maNgalAlamBanaM kftvA AtmAnamavalokya ca । AdarSe vimale kfzRastataH sAtyakimabravIt ॥9॥

text: gaccha śaineya jānīhi gatvā rājaniveśanam । api sajjo mahātejā bhīṣmaṃ draṣṭuṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥10॥
html:
gaccha śaineya jānīhi gatvā rājaniveśanam ।
api sajjo mahātejā bhīṣmaṃ draṣṭuṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥10॥
slp1: gacCa SEneya jAnIhi gatvA rAjaniveSanam । api sajjo mahAtejA BIzmaM drazwuM yuDizWiraH ॥10॥

text: tataḥ kṛṣṇasya vacanātsātyakistvarito yayau । upagamya ca rājānaṃ yudhiṣṭhiramuvāca ha ॥11॥
html:
tataḥ kṛṣṇasya vacanātsātyakistvarito yayau ।
upagamya ca rājānaṃ yudhiṣṭhiramuvāca ha ॥11॥
slp1: tataH kfzRasya vacanAtsAtyakistvarito yayO । upagamya ca rAjAnaM yuDizWiramuvAca ha ॥11॥

text: yukto rathavaro rājanvāsudevasya dhīmataḥ । samīpamāpageyasya prayāsyati janārdanaḥ ॥12॥
html:
yukto rathavaro rājanvāsudevasya dhīmataḥ ।
samīpamāpageyasya prayāsyati janārdanaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: yukto raTavaro rAjanvAsudevasya DImataH । samIpamApageyasya prayAsyati janArdanaH ॥12॥

text: bhavatpratīkṣaḥ kṛṣṇo'sau dharmarāja mahādyute । yadatrānantaraṃ kṛtyaṃ tadbhavānkartumarhati ॥13॥
html:
bhavatpratīkṣaḥ kṛṣṇo'sau dharmarāja mahādyute ।
yadatrānantaraṃ kṛtyaṃ tadbhavānkartumarhati ॥13॥
slp1: BavatpratIkzaH kfzRo'sO DarmarAja mahAdyute । yadatrAnantaraM kftyaM tadBavAnkartumarhati ॥13॥

text: yujyatāṃ me rathavaraḥ phalgunāpratimadyute । na sainikaiśca yātavyaṃ yāsyāmo vayameva hi ॥14॥
html:
yujyatāṃ me rathavaraḥ phalgunāpratimadyute ।
na sainikaiśca yātavyaṃ yāsyāmo vayameva hi ॥14॥
slp1: yujyatAM me raTavaraH PalgunApratimadyute । na sEnikESca yAtavyaM yAsyAmo vayameva hi ॥14॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: na ca pīḍayitavyo me bhīṣmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ । ataḥ puraḥsarāścāpi nivartantu dhanañjaya ॥15॥
html:
na ca pīḍayitavyo me bhīṣmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ।
ataḥ puraḥsarāścāpi nivartantu dhanañjaya ॥15॥
slp1: na ca pIqayitavyo me BIzmo DarmaBftAM varaH । ataH puraHsarAScApi nivartantu DanaYjaya ॥15॥

text: adyaprabhṛti gāṅgeyaḥ paraṃ guhyaṃ pravakṣyati । tato necchāmi kaunteya pṛthagjanasamāgamam ॥16॥
html:
adyaprabhṛti gāṅgeyaḥ paraṃ guhyaṃ pravakṣyati ।
tato necchāmi kaunteya pṛthagjanasamāgamam ॥16॥
slp1: adyapraBfti gANgeyaH paraM guhyaM pravakzyati । tato necCAmi kOnteya pfTagjanasamAgamam ॥16॥

text: tadvākyamākarṇya tathā kuntīputro dhanañjayaḥ । yuktaṃ rathavaraṃ tasmā ācacakṣe nararṣabha ॥17॥
html:
tadvākyamākarṇya tathā kuntīputro dhanañjayaḥ ।
yuktaṃ rathavaraṃ tasmā ācacakṣe nararṣabha ॥17॥
slp1: tadvAkyamAkarRya taTA kuntIputro DanaYjayaH । yuktaM raTavaraM tasmA Acacakze nararzaBa ॥17॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā yamau bhīmārjunāvapi । bhūtānīva samastāni yayuḥ kṛṣṇaniveśanam ॥18॥
html:
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā yamau bhīmārjunāvapi ।
bhūtānīva samastāni yayuḥ kṛṣṇaniveśanam ॥18॥
slp1: tato yuDizWiro rAjA yamO BImArjunAvapi । BUtAnIva samastAni yayuH kfzRaniveSanam ॥18॥

text: āgacchatsvatha kṛṣṇo'pi pāṇḍaveṣu mahātmasu । śaineyasahito dhīmānrathamevānvapadyata ॥19॥
html:
āgacchatsvatha kṛṣṇo'pi pāṇḍaveṣu mahātmasu ।
śaineyasahito dhīmānrathamevānvapadyata ॥19॥
slp1: AgacCatsvaTa kfzRo'pi pARqavezu mahAtmasu । SEneyasahito DImAnraTamevAnvapadyata ॥19॥

text: rathasthāḥ saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā sukhāṃ pṛṣṭvā ca śarvarīm । meghaghoṣai rathavaraiḥ prayayuste mahārathāḥ ॥20॥
html:
rathasthāḥ saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā sukhāṃ pṛṣṭvā ca śarvarīm ।
meghaghoṣai rathavaraiḥ prayayuste mahārathāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: raTasTAH saMvidaM kftvA suKAM pfzwvA ca SarvarIm । meGaGozE raTavarEH prayayuste mahAraTAH ॥20॥

text: meghapuṣpaṃ balāhaṃ ca sainyaṃ sugrīvameva ca । dārukaścodayāmāsa vāsudevasya vājinaḥ ॥21॥
html:
meghapuṣpaṃ balāhaṃ ca sainyaṃ sugrīvameva ca ।
dārukaścodayāmāsa vāsudevasya vājinaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: meGapuzpaM balAhaM ca sEnyaM sugrIvameva ca । dArukaScodayAmAsa vAsudevasya vAjinaH ॥21॥

text: te hayā vāsudevasya dārukeṇa pracoditāḥ । gāṃ khurāgraistathā rājaṁllikhantaḥ prayayustadā ॥22॥
html:
te hayā vāsudevasya dārukeṇa pracoditāḥ ।
gāṃ khurāgraistathā rājaṁllikhantaḥ prayayustadā ॥22॥
slp1: te hayA vAsudevasya dArukeRa pracoditAH । gAM KurAgrEstaTA rAjaṁlliKantaH prayayustadA ॥22॥

text: te grasanta ivākāśaṃ vegavanto mahābalāḥ । kṣetraṃ dharmasya kṛtsnasya kurukṣetramavātaran ॥23॥
html:
te grasanta ivākāśaṃ vegavanto mahābalāḥ ।
kṣetraṃ dharmasya kṛtsnasya kurukṣetramavātaran ॥23॥
slp1: te grasanta ivAkASaM vegavanto mahAbalAH । kzetraM Darmasya kftsnasya kurukzetramavAtaran ॥23॥

text: tato yayuryatra bhīṣmaḥ śaratalpagataḥ prabhuḥ । āste brahmarṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ brahmā devagaṇairyathā ॥24॥
html:
tato yayuryatra bhīṣmaḥ śaratalpagataḥ prabhuḥ ।
āste brahmarṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ brahmā devagaṇairyathā ॥24॥
slp1: tato yayuryatra BIzmaH SaratalpagataH praBuH । Aste brahmarziBiH sArDaM brahmA devagaREryaTA ॥24॥

text: tato'vatīrya govindo rathātsa ca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । bhīmo gāṇḍīvadhanvā ca yamau sātyakireva ca । ṛṣīnabhyarcayāmāsuḥ karānudyamya dakṣiṇān ॥25॥
html:
tato'vatīrya govindo rathātsa ca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।
bhīmo gāṇḍīvadhanvā ca yamau sātyakireva ca ।
ṛṣīnabhyarcayāmāsuḥ karānudyamya dakṣiṇān ॥25॥
slp1: tato'vatIrya govindo raTAtsa ca yuDizWiraH । BImo gARqIvaDanvA ca yamO sAtyakireva ca । fzInaByarcayAmAsuH karAnudyamya dakziRAn ॥25॥

text: sa taiḥ parivṛto rājā nakṣatrairiva candramāḥ । abhyājagāma gāṅgeyaṃ brahmāṇamiva vāsavaḥ ॥26॥
html:
sa taiḥ parivṛto rājā nakṣatrairiva candramāḥ ।
abhyājagāma gāṅgeyaṃ brahmāṇamiva vāsavaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: sa tEH parivfto rAjA nakzatrEriva candramAH । aByAjagAma gANgeyaM brahmARamiva vAsavaH ॥26॥

text: śaratalpe śayānaṃ tamādityaṃ patitaṃ yathā । dadarśa sa mahābāhurbhayādāgatasādhvasaḥ] ॥27॥
html:
śaratalpe śayānaṃ tamādityaṃ patitaṃ yathā ।
dadarśa sa mahābāhurbhayādāgatasādhvasaḥ] ॥27॥
slp1: Saratalpe SayAnaM tamAdityaM patitaM yaTA । dadarSa sa mahAbAhurBayAdAgatasADvasaH] ॥27॥

text: dharmātmani mahāsattve satyasandhe jitātmani । devavrate mahābhāge śaratalpagate'cyute ॥1॥
html:
dharmātmani mahāsattve satyasandhe jitātmani ।
devavrate mahābhāge śaratalpagate'cyute ॥1॥
slp1: DarmAtmani mahAsattve satyasanDe jitAtmani । devavrate mahABAge Saratalpagate'cyute ॥1॥
author: janamejaya uvāca ।

text: śayāne vīraśayane bhīṣme śantanunandane । gāṅgeye puruṣavyāghre pāṇḍavaiḥ paryupasthite ॥2॥
html:
śayāne vīraśayane bhīṣme śantanunandane ।
gāṅgeye puruṣavyāghre pāṇḍavaiḥ paryupasthite ॥2॥
slp1: SayAne vIraSayane BIzme Santanunandane । gANgeye puruzavyAGre pARqavEH paryupasTite ॥2॥

text: kāḥ kathāḥ samavartanta tasminvīrasamāgame । hateṣu sarvasainyeṣu tanme śaṃsa mahāmune ॥3॥
html:
kāḥ kathāḥ samavartanta tasminvīrasamāgame ।
hateṣu sarvasainyeṣu tanme śaṃsa mahāmune ॥3॥
slp1: kAH kaTAH samavartanta tasminvIrasamAgame । hatezu sarvasEnyezu tanme SaMsa mahAmune ॥3॥

text: śaratalpagate bhīṣme kauravāṇāṃ dhurandhare । ājagmurṛṣayaḥ siddhā nāradapramukhā nṛpa ॥4॥
html:
śaratalpagate bhīṣme kauravāṇāṃ dhurandhare ।
ājagmurṛṣayaḥ siddhā nāradapramukhā nṛpa ॥4॥
slp1: Saratalpagate BIzme kOravARAM DuranDare । AjagmurfzayaH sidDA nAradapramuKA nfpa ॥4॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: hataśiṣṭāśca rājāno yudhiṣṭhirapurogamāḥ । dhṛtarāṣṭraśca kṛṣṇaśca bhīmārjunayamāstathā ॥5॥
html:
hataśiṣṭāśca rājāno yudhiṣṭhirapurogamāḥ ।
dhṛtarāṣṭraśca kṛṣṇaśca bhīmārjunayamāstathā ॥5॥
slp1: hataSizwASca rAjAno yuDizWirapurogamAH । DftarAzwraSca kfzRaSca BImArjunayamAstaTA ॥5॥

text: te'bhigamya mahātmāno bharatānāṃ pitāmaham । anvaśocanta gāṅgeyamādityaṃ patitaṃ yathā ॥6॥
html:
te'bhigamya mahātmāno bharatānāṃ pitāmaham ।
anvaśocanta gāṅgeyamādityaṃ patitaṃ yathā ॥6॥
slp1: te'Bigamya mahAtmAno BaratAnAM pitAmaham । anvaSocanta gANgeyamAdityaM patitaM yaTA ॥6॥

text: muhūrtamiva ca dhyātvā nārado devadarśanaḥ । uvāca pāṇḍavānsarvānhataśiṣṭāṃśca pārthivān ॥7॥
html:
muhūrtamiva ca dhyātvā nārado devadarśanaḥ ।
uvāca pāṇḍavānsarvānhataśiṣṭāṃśca pārthivān ॥7॥
slp1: muhUrtamiva ca DyAtvA nArado devadarSanaH । uvAca pARqavAnsarvAnhataSizwAMSca pArTivAn ॥7॥

text: prāptakālaṃ ca ācakṣe bhīṣmo'yamanuyujyatām । astameti hi gāṅgeyo bhānumāniva bhārata ॥8॥
html:
prāptakālaṃ ca ācakṣe bhīṣmo'yamanuyujyatām ।
astameti hi gāṅgeyo bhānumāniva bhārata ॥8॥
slp1: prAptakAlaM ca Acakze BIzmo'yamanuyujyatAm । astameti hi gANgeyo BAnumAniva BArata ॥8॥

text: ayaṃ prāṇānutsisṛkṣustaṃ sarve'bhyetya pṛcchata । kṛtsnānhi vividhāndharmāṃścāturvarṇyasya vettyayam ॥9॥
html:
ayaṃ prāṇānutsisṛkṣustaṃ sarve'bhyetya pṛcchata ।
kṛtsnānhi vividhāndharmāṃścāturvarṇyasya vettyayam ॥9॥
slp1: ayaM prARAnutsisfkzustaM sarve'Byetya pfcCata । kftsnAnhi viviDAnDarmAMScAturvarRyasya vettyayam ॥9॥

text: eṣa vṛddhaḥ purā lokānsamprāpnoti tanutyajām । taṃ śīghramanuyuñjadhvaṃ saṃśayānmanasi sthitān ॥10॥
html:
eṣa vṛddhaḥ purā lokānsamprāpnoti tanutyajām ।
taṃ śīghramanuyuñjadhvaṃ saṃśayānmanasi sthitān ॥10॥
slp1: eza vfdDaH purA lokAnsamprApnoti tanutyajAm । taM SIGramanuyuYjaDvaM saMSayAnmanasi sTitAn ॥10॥

text: evamuktā nāradena bhīṣmamīyurnarādhipāḥ । praṣṭuṃ cāśaknuvantaste vīkṣāṃ cakruḥ parasparam ॥11॥
html:
evamuktā nāradena bhīṣmamīyurnarādhipāḥ ।
praṣṭuṃ cāśaknuvantaste vīkṣāṃ cakruḥ parasparam ॥11॥
slp1: evamuktA nAradena BIzmamIyurnarADipAH । prazwuM cASaknuvantaste vIkzAM cakruH parasparam ॥11॥

text: athovāca hṛṣīkeśaṃ pāṇḍuputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । nānyastvaddevakīputra śaktaḥ praṣṭuṃ pitāmaham ॥12॥
html:
athovāca hṛṣīkeśaṃ pāṇḍuputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।
nānyastvaddevakīputra śaktaḥ praṣṭuṃ pitāmaham ॥12॥
slp1: aTovAca hfzIkeSaM pARquputro yuDizWiraH । nAnyastvaddevakIputra SaktaH prazwuM pitAmaham ॥12॥

text: pravyāhāraya durdharṣa tvamagre madhusūdana । tvaṃ hi nastāta sarveṣāṃ sarvadharmaviduttamaḥ ॥13॥
html:
pravyāhāraya durdharṣa tvamagre madhusūdana ।
tvaṃ hi nastāta sarveṣāṃ sarvadharmaviduttamaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: pravyAhAraya durDarza tvamagre maDusUdana । tvaM hi nastAta sarvezAM sarvaDarmaviduttamaH ॥13॥

text: evamuktaḥ pāṇḍavena bhagavānkeśavastadā । abhigamya durādharṣaṃ pravyāhārayadacyutaḥ ॥14॥
html:
evamuktaḥ pāṇḍavena bhagavānkeśavastadā ।
abhigamya durādharṣaṃ pravyāhārayadacyutaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: evamuktaH pARqavena BagavAnkeSavastadA । aBigamya durADarzaM pravyAhArayadacyutaH ॥14॥

text: kaccitsukhena rajanī vyuṣṭā te rājasattama । vispaṣṭalakṣaṇā buddhiḥ kacciccopasthitā tava ॥15॥
html:
kaccitsukhena rajanī vyuṣṭā te rājasattama ।
vispaṣṭalakṣaṇā buddhiḥ kacciccopasthitā tava ॥15॥
slp1: kaccitsuKena rajanI vyuzwA te rAjasattama । vispazwalakzaRA budDiH kacciccopasTitA tava ॥15॥
author: vāsudeva uvāca ।

text: kaccijjñānāni sarvāṇi pratibhānti ca te'nagha । na glāyate ca hṛdayaṃ na ca te vyākulaṃ manaḥ ॥16॥
html:
kaccijjñānāni sarvāṇi pratibhānti ca te'nagha ।
na glāyate ca hṛdayaṃ na ca te vyākulaṃ manaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: kaccijjYAnAni sarvARi pratiBAnti ca te'naGa । na glAyate ca hfdayaM na ca te vyAkulaM manaH ॥16॥

text: dāho mohaḥ śramaścaiva klamo glānistathā rujā । tava prasādādgovinda sadyo vyapagatānagha ॥17॥
html:
dāho mohaḥ śramaścaiva klamo glānistathā rujā ।
tava prasādādgovinda sadyo vyapagatānagha ॥17॥
slp1: dAho mohaH SramaScEva klamo glAnistaTA rujA । tava prasAdAdgovinda sadyo vyapagatAnaGa ॥17॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yacca bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyacca bhavacca paramadyute । tatsarvamanupaśyāmi pāṇau phalamivāhitam ॥18॥
html:
yacca bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyacca bhavacca paramadyute ।
tatsarvamanupaśyāmi pāṇau phalamivāhitam ॥18॥
slp1: yacca BUtaM Bavizyacca Bavacca paramadyute । tatsarvamanupaSyAmi pARO PalamivAhitam ॥18॥

text: vedoktāścaiva ye dharmā vedāntanihitāśca ye । tānsarvānsamprapaśyāmi varadānāttavācyuta ॥19॥
html:
vedoktāścaiva ye dharmā vedāntanihitāśca ye ।
tānsarvānsamprapaśyāmi varadānāttavācyuta ॥19॥
slp1: vedoktAScEva ye DarmA vedAntanihitASca ye । tAnsarvAnsamprapaSyAmi varadAnAttavAcyuta ॥19॥

text: śiṣṭaiśca dharmo yaḥ proktaḥ sa ca me hṛdi vartate । deśajātikulānāṃ ca dharmajño'smi janārdana ॥20॥
html:
śiṣṭaiśca dharmo yaḥ proktaḥ sa ca me hṛdi vartate ।
deśajātikulānāṃ ca dharmajño'smi janārdana ॥20॥
slp1: SizwESca Darmo yaH proktaH sa ca me hfdi vartate । deSajAtikulAnAM ca DarmajYo'smi janArdana ॥20॥

text: caturṣvāśramadharmeṣu yo'rthaḥ sa ca hṛdi sthitaḥ । rājadharmāṃśca sakalānavagacchāmi keśava ॥21॥
html:
caturṣvāśramadharmeṣu yo'rthaḥ sa ca hṛdi sthitaḥ ।
rājadharmāṃśca sakalānavagacchāmi keśava ॥21॥
slp1: caturzvASramaDarmezu yo'rTaH sa ca hfdi sTitaH । rAjaDarmAMSca sakalAnavagacCAmi keSava ॥21॥

text: yatra yatra ca vaktavyaṃ tadvakṣyāmi janārdana । tava prasādāddhi śubhā mano me buddhirāviśat ॥22॥
html:
yatra yatra ca vaktavyaṃ tadvakṣyāmi janārdana ।
tava prasādāddhi śubhā mano me buddhirāviśat ॥22॥
slp1: yatra yatra ca vaktavyaM tadvakzyAmi janArdana । tava prasAdAdDi SuBA mano me budDirAviSat ॥22॥

text: yuveva cāsmi saṃvṛttastvadanudhyānabṛṃhitaḥ । vaktuṃ śreyaḥ samartho'smi tvatprasādājjanārdana ॥23॥
html:
yuveva cāsmi saṃvṛttastvadanudhyānabṛṃhitaḥ ।
vaktuṃ śreyaḥ samartho'smi tvatprasādājjanārdana ॥23॥
slp1: yuveva cAsmi saMvfttastvadanuDyAnabfMhitaH । vaktuM SreyaH samarTo'smi tvatprasAdAjjanArdana ॥23॥

text: svayaṃ kimarthaṃ tu bhavāñśreyo na prāha pāṇḍavam । kiṃ te vivakṣitaṃ cātra tadāśu vada mādhava ॥24॥
html:
svayaṃ kimarthaṃ tu bhavāñśreyo na prāha pāṇḍavam ।
kiṃ te vivakṣitaṃ cātra tadāśu vada mādhava ॥24॥
slp1: svayaM kimarTaM tu BavAYSreyo na prAha pARqavam । kiM te vivakzitaM cAtra tadASu vada mADava ॥24॥

text: yaśasaḥ śreyasaścaiva mūlaṃ māṃ viddhi kaurava । mattaḥ sarve'bhinirvṛttā bhāvāḥ sadasadātmakāḥ ॥25॥
html:
yaśasaḥ śreyasaścaiva mūlaṃ māṃ viddhi kaurava ।
mattaḥ sarve'bhinirvṛttā bhāvāḥ sadasadātmakāḥ ॥25॥
slp1: yaSasaH SreyasaScEva mUlaM mAM vidDi kOrava । mattaH sarve'BinirvfttA BAvAH sadasadAtmakAH ॥25॥
author: vāsudeva uvāca ।

text: śītāṃśuścandra ityukte ko loke vismayiṣyati । tathaiva yaśasā pūrṇe mayi ko vismayiṣyati ॥26॥
html:
śītāṃśuścandra ityukte ko loke vismayiṣyati ।
tathaiva yaśasā pūrṇe mayi ko vismayiṣyati ॥26॥
slp1: SItAMSuScandra ityukte ko loke vismayizyati । taTEva yaSasA pUrRe mayi ko vismayizyati ॥26॥

text: ādheyaṃ tu mayā bhūyo yaśastava mahādyute । tato me vipulā buddhistvayi bhīṣma samāhitā ॥27॥
html:
ādheyaṃ tu mayā bhūyo yaśastava mahādyute ।
tato me vipulā buddhistvayi bhīṣma samāhitā ॥27॥
slp1: ADeyaM tu mayA BUyo yaSastava mahAdyute । tato me vipulA budDistvayi BIzma samAhitA ॥27॥

text: yāvaddhi pṛthivīpāla pṛthivī sthāsyate dhruvā । tāvattavākṣayā kīrtirlokānanu cariṣyati ॥28॥
html:
yāvaddhi pṛthivīpāla pṛthivī sthāsyate dhruvā ।
tāvattavākṣayā kīrtirlokānanu cariṣyati ॥28॥
slp1: yAvadDi pfTivIpAla pfTivI sTAsyate DruvA । tAvattavAkzayA kIrtirlokAnanu carizyati ॥28॥

text: yacca tvaṃ vakṣyase bhīṣma pāṇḍavāyānupṛcchate । vedapravādā iva te sthāsyanti vasudhātale ॥29॥
html:
yacca tvaṃ vakṣyase bhīṣma pāṇḍavāyānupṛcchate ।
vedapravādā iva te sthāsyanti vasudhātale ॥29॥
slp1: yacca tvaM vakzyase BIzma pARqavAyAnupfcCate । vedapravAdA iva te sTAsyanti vasuDAtale ॥29॥

text: yaścaitena pramāṇena yokṣyatyātmānamātmanā । sa phalaṃ sarvapuṇyānāṃ pretya cānubhaviṣyati ॥30॥
html:
yaścaitena pramāṇena yokṣyatyātmānamātmanā ।
sa phalaṃ sarvapuṇyānāṃ pretya cānubhaviṣyati ॥30॥
slp1: yaScEtena pramARena yokzyatyAtmAnamAtmanA । sa PalaM sarvapuRyAnAM pretya cAnuBavizyati ॥30॥

text: etasmātkāraṇādbhīṣma matirdivyā mayā hi te । dattā yaśo vipratheta kathaṃ bhūyastaveti ha ॥31॥
html:
etasmātkāraṇādbhīṣma matirdivyā mayā hi te ।
dattā yaśo vipratheta kathaṃ bhūyastaveti ha ॥31॥
slp1: etasmAtkAraRAdBIzma matirdivyA mayA hi te । dattA yaSo vipraTeta kaTaM BUyastaveti ha ॥31॥

text: yāvaddhi prathate loke puruṣasya yaśo bhuvi । tāvattasyākṣayaṃ sthānaṃ bhavatīti viniścitam ॥32॥
html:
yāvaddhi prathate loke puruṣasya yaśo bhuvi ।
tāvattasyākṣayaṃ sthānaṃ bhavatīti viniścitam ॥32॥
slp1: yAvadDi praTate loke puruzasya yaSo Buvi । tAvattasyAkzayaM sTAnaM BavatIti viniScitam ॥32॥

text: rājāno hataśiṣṭāstvāṃ rājannabhita āsate । dharmānanuyuyukṣantastebhyaḥ prabrūhi bhārata ॥33॥
html:
rājāno hataśiṣṭāstvāṃ rājannabhita āsate ।
dharmānanuyuyukṣantastebhyaḥ prabrūhi bhārata ॥33॥
slp1: rAjAno hataSizwAstvAM rAjannaBita Asate । DarmAnanuyuyukzantasteByaH prabrUhi BArata ॥33॥

text: bhavānhi vayasā vṛddhaḥ śrutācārasamanvitaḥ । kuśalo rājadharmāṇāṃ pūrveṣāmaparāśca ye ॥34॥
html:
bhavānhi vayasā vṛddhaḥ śrutācārasamanvitaḥ ।
kuśalo rājadharmāṇāṃ pūrveṣāmaparāśca ye ॥34॥
slp1: BavAnhi vayasA vfdDaH SrutAcArasamanvitaH । kuSalo rAjaDarmARAM pUrvezAmaparASca ye ॥34॥

text: janmaprabhṛti te kaścidvṛjinaṃ na dadarśa ha । jñātāramanudharmāṇāṃ tvāṃ viduḥ sarvapārthivāḥ ॥35॥
html:
janmaprabhṛti te kaścidvṛjinaṃ na dadarśa ha ।
jñātāramanudharmāṇāṃ tvāṃ viduḥ sarvapārthivāḥ ॥35॥
slp1: janmapraBfti te kaScidvfjinaM na dadarSa ha । jYAtAramanuDarmARAM tvAM viduH sarvapArTivAH ॥35॥

text: tebhyaḥ piteva putrebhyo rājanbrūhi paraṃ nayam । ṛṣayaśca hi devāśca tvayā nityamupāsitāḥ ॥36॥
html:
tebhyaḥ piteva putrebhyo rājanbrūhi paraṃ nayam ।
ṛṣayaśca hi devāśca tvayā nityamupāsitāḥ ॥36॥
slp1: teByaH piteva putreByo rAjanbrUhi paraM nayam । fzayaSca hi devASca tvayA nityamupAsitAH ॥36॥

text: tasmādvaktavyameveha tvayā paśyāmyaśeṣataḥ । dharmāñśuśrūṣamāṇebhyaḥ pṛṣṭena ca satā punaḥ ॥37॥
html:
tasmādvaktavyameveha tvayā paśyāmyaśeṣataḥ ।
dharmāñśuśrūṣamāṇebhyaḥ pṛṣṭena ca satā punaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: tasmAdvaktavyameveha tvayA paSyAmyaSezataH । DarmAYSuSrUzamAReByaH pfzwena ca satA punaH ॥37॥

text: vaktavyaṃ viduṣā ceti dharmamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ । apratibruvataḥ kaṣṭo doṣo hi bhavati prabho ॥38॥
html:
vaktavyaṃ viduṣā ceti dharmamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ।
apratibruvataḥ kaṣṭo doṣo hi bhavati prabho ॥38॥
slp1: vaktavyaM viduzA ceti DarmamAhurmanIziRaH । apratibruvataH kazwo dozo hi Bavati praBo ॥38॥

text: tasmātputraiśca pautraiśca dharmānpṛṣṭaḥ sanātanān । vidvāñjijñāsamānaistvaṃ prabrūhi bharatarṣabha] ॥39॥
html:
tasmātputraiśca pautraiśca dharmānpṛṣṭaḥ sanātanān ।
vidvāñjijñāsamānaistvaṃ prabrūhi bharatarṣabha] ॥39॥
