slp1: tasmAtputrESca pOtrESca DarmAnpfzwaH sanAtanAn । vidvAYjijYAsamAnEstvaM prabrUhi BaratarzaBa] ॥39॥

text: athābravīnmahātejā vākyaṃ kauravanandanaḥ । hanta dharmānpravakṣyāmi dṛḍhe vāṅmanasī mama । tava prasādādgovinda bhūtātmā hyasi śāśvataḥ ॥1॥
html:
athābravīnmahātejā vākyaṃ kauravanandanaḥ ।
hanta dharmānpravakṣyāmi dṛḍhe vāṅmanasī mama ।
tava prasādādgovinda bhūtātmā hyasi śāśvataḥ ॥1॥
slp1: aTAbravInmahAtejA vAkyaM kOravanandanaH । hanta DarmAnpravakzyAmi dfQe vANmanasI mama । tava prasAdAdgovinda BUtAtmA hyasi SASvataH ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: yudhiṣṭhirastu māṃ rājā dharmānsamanupṛcchatu । evaṃ prīto bhaviṣyāmi dharmānvakṣyāmi cānagha ॥2॥
html:
yudhiṣṭhirastu māṃ rājā dharmānsamanupṛcchatu ।
evaṃ prīto bhaviṣyāmi dharmānvakṣyāmi cānagha ॥2॥
slp1: yuDizWirastu mAM rAjA DarmAnsamanupfcCatu । evaM prIto BavizyAmi DarmAnvakzyAmi cAnaGa ॥2॥

text: yasminrājarṣabhe jāte dharmātmani mahātmani । ahṛṣyannṛṣayaḥ sarve sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥3॥
html:
yasminrājarṣabhe jāte dharmātmani mahātmani ।
ahṛṣyannṛṣayaḥ sarve sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: yasminrAjarzaBe jAte DarmAtmani mahAtmani । ahfzyannfzayaH sarve sa mAM pfcCatu pARqavaH ॥3॥

text: sarveṣāṃ dīptayaśasāṃ kurūṇāṃ dharmacāriṇām । yasya nāsti samaḥ kaścitsa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥4॥
html:
sarveṣāṃ dīptayaśasāṃ kurūṇāṃ dharmacāriṇām ।
yasya nāsti samaḥ kaścitsa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: sarvezAM dIptayaSasAM kurURAM DarmacAriRAm । yasya nAsti samaH kaScitsa mAM pfcCatu pARqavaH ॥4॥

text: dhṛtirdamo brahmacaryaṃ kṣamā dharmaśca nityadā । yasminnojaśca tejaśca sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥5॥
html:
dhṛtirdamo brahmacaryaṃ kṣamā dharmaśca nityadā ।
yasminnojaśca tejaśca sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: Dftirdamo brahmacaryaM kzamA DarmaSca nityadA । yasminnojaSca tejaSca sa mAM pfcCatu pARqavaH ॥5॥

text: satyaṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ śaucaṃ śāntirdākṣyamasambhramaḥ । yasminnetāni sarvāṇi sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥6॥
html:
satyaṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ śaucaṃ śāntirdākṣyamasambhramaḥ ।
yasminnetāni sarvāṇi sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: satyaM dAnaM tapaH SOcaM SAntirdAkzyamasamBramaH । yasminnetAni sarvARi sa mAM pfcCatu pARqavaH ॥6॥

text: yo na kāmānna saṃrambhānna bhayānnārthakāraṇāt । kuryādadharmaṃ dharmātmā sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥7॥
html:
yo na kāmānna saṃrambhānna bhayānnārthakāraṇāt ।
kuryādadharmaṃ dharmātmā sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: yo na kAmAnna saMramBAnna BayAnnArTakAraRAt । kuryAdaDarmaM DarmAtmA sa mAM pfcCatu pARqavaH ॥7॥

text: saṃbandhino'tithīnbhṛtyānsaṃśritopāśritāṃśca yaḥ । sammānayati satkṛtya sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥8॥
html:
saṃbandhino'tithīnbhṛtyānsaṃśritopāśritāṃśca yaḥ ।
sammānayati satkṛtya sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: saMbanDino'tiTInBftyAnsaMSritopASritAMSca yaH । sammAnayati satkftya sa mAM pfcCatu pARqavaH ॥8॥

text: satyanityaḥ kṣamānityo jñānanityo'tithipriyaḥ । yo dadāti satāṃ nityaṃ sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥9॥
html:
satyanityaḥ kṣamānityo jñānanityo'tithipriyaḥ ।
yo dadāti satāṃ nityaṃ sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: satyanityaH kzamAnityo jYAnanityo'tiTipriyaH । yo dadAti satAM nityaM sa mAM pfcCatu pARqavaH ॥9॥

text: ijyādhyayananityaśca dharme ca nirataḥ sadā । śāntaḥ śrutarahasyaśca sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥10॥
html:
ijyādhyayananityaśca dharme ca nirataḥ sadā ।
śāntaḥ śrutarahasyaśca sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: ijyADyayananityaSca Darme ca nirataH sadA । SAntaH SrutarahasyaSca sa mAM pfcCatu pARqavaH ॥10॥

text: lajjayā parayopeto dharmātmā sa yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । abhiśāpabhayādbhīto bhavantaṃ nopasarpati ॥11॥
html:
lajjayā parayopeto dharmātmā sa yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।
abhiśāpabhayādbhīto bhavantaṃ nopasarpati ॥11॥
slp1: lajjayA parayopeto DarmAtmA sa yuDizWiraH । aBiSApaBayAdBIto BavantaM nopasarpati ॥11॥
author: vāsudeva uvāca ।

text: lokasya kadanaṃ kṛtvā lokanātho viśāṃ pate । abhiśāpabhayādbhīto bhavantaṃ nopasarpati ॥12॥
html:
lokasya kadanaṃ kṛtvā lokanātho viśāṃ pate ।
abhiśāpabhayādbhīto bhavantaṃ nopasarpati ॥12॥
slp1: lokasya kadanaM kftvA lokanATo viSAM pate । aBiSApaBayAdBIto BavantaM nopasarpati ॥12॥

text: pūjyānmānyāṃśca bhaktāṃśca gurūnsaṃbandhibāndhavān । arghyārhāniṣubhirhatvā bhavantaṃ nopasarpati ॥13॥
html:
pūjyānmānyāṃśca bhaktāṃśca gurūnsaṃbandhibāndhavān ।
arghyārhāniṣubhirhatvā bhavantaṃ nopasarpati ॥13॥
slp1: pUjyAnmAnyAMSca BaktAMSca gurUnsaMbanDibAnDavAn । arGyArhAnizuBirhatvA BavantaM nopasarpati ॥13॥

text: brāhmaṇānāṃ yathā dharmo dānamadhyayanaṃ tapaḥ । kṣatriyāṇāṃ tathā kṛṣṇa samare dehapātanam ॥14॥
html:
brāhmaṇānāṃ yathā dharmo dānamadhyayanaṃ tapaḥ ।
kṣatriyāṇāṃ tathā kṛṣṇa samare dehapātanam ॥14॥
slp1: brAhmaRAnAM yaTA Darmo dAnamaDyayanaM tapaH । kzatriyARAM taTA kfzRa samare dehapAtanam ॥14॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: pitṝnpitāmahānputrāngurūnsambandhibāndhavān । mithyāpravṛttānyaḥ saṅkhye nihanyāddharma eva saḥ ॥15॥
html:
pitṝnpitāmahānputrāngurūnsambandhibāndhavān ।
mithyāpravṛttānyaḥ saṅkhye nihanyāddharma eva saḥ ॥15॥
slp1: pitFnpitAmahAnputrAngurUnsambanDibAnDavAn । miTyApravfttAnyaH saNKye nihanyAdDarma eva saH ॥15॥

text: samayatyāgino lubdhāngurūnapi ca keśava । nihanti samare pāpānkṣatriyo yaḥ sa dharmavit ॥16॥
html:
samayatyāgino lubdhāngurūnapi ca keśava ।
nihanti samare pāpānkṣatriyo yaḥ sa dharmavit ॥16॥
slp1: samayatyAgino lubDAngurUnapi ca keSava । nihanti samare pApAnkzatriyo yaH sa Darmavit ॥16॥

text: āhūtena raṇe nityaṃ yoddhavyaṃ kṣatrabandhunā । dharmyaṃ svargyaṃ ca lokyaṃ ca yuddhaṃ hi manurabravīt ॥17॥
html:
āhūtena raṇe nityaṃ yoddhavyaṃ kṣatrabandhunā ।
dharmyaṃ svargyaṃ ca lokyaṃ ca yuddhaṃ hi manurabravīt ॥17॥
slp1: AhUtena raRe nityaM yodDavyaM kzatrabanDunA । DarmyaM svargyaM ca lokyaM ca yudDaM hi manurabravIt ॥17॥

text: evamuktastu bhīṣmeṇa dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । vinītavadupāgamya tasthau sandarśane'grataḥ ॥18॥
html:
evamuktastu bhīṣmeṇa dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।
vinītavadupāgamya tasthau sandarśane'grataḥ ॥18॥
slp1: evamuktastu BIzmeRa DarmarAjo yuDizWiraH । vinItavadupAgamya tasTO sandarSane'grataH ॥18॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: athāsya pādau jagrāha bhīṣmaścābhinananda tam । mūrdhni cainamupāghrāya niṣīdetyabravīttadā ॥19॥
html:
athāsya pādau jagrāha bhīṣmaścābhinananda tam ।
mūrdhni cainamupāghrāya niṣīdetyabravīttadā ॥19॥
slp1: aTAsya pAdO jagrAha BIzmaScABinananda tam । mUrDni cEnamupAGrAya nizIdetyabravIttadA ॥19॥

text: tamuvācātha gāṅgeya ṛṣabhaḥ sarvadhanvinām । pṛccha māṃ tāta visrabdhaṃ mā bhaistvaṃ kurusattama] ॥20॥
html:
tamuvācātha gāṅgeya ṛṣabhaḥ sarvadhanvinām ।
pṛccha māṃ tāta visrabdhaṃ mā bhaistvaṃ kurusattama] ॥20॥
slp1: tamuvAcATa gANgeya fzaBaH sarvaDanvinAm । pfcCa mAM tAta visrabDaM mA BEstvaM kurusattama] ॥20॥

text: praṇipatya hṛṣīkeśamabhivādya pitāmaham । anumānya gurūnsarvānparyapṛcchadyudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥1॥
html:
praṇipatya hṛṣīkeśamabhivādya pitāmaham ।
anumānya gurūnsarvānparyapṛcchadyudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥1॥
slp1: praRipatya hfzIkeSamaBivAdya pitAmaham । anumAnya gurUnsarvAnparyapfcCadyuDizWiraH ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: rājyaṃ vai paramo dharma iti dharmavido viduḥ । mahāntametaṃ bhāraṃ ca manye tadbrūhi pārthiva ॥2॥
html:
rājyaṃ vai paramo dharma iti dharmavido viduḥ ।
mahāntametaṃ bhāraṃ ca manye tadbrūhi pārthiva ॥2॥
slp1: rAjyaM vE paramo Darma iti Darmavido viduH । mahAntametaM BAraM ca manye tadbrUhi pArTiva ॥2॥

text: rājadharmānviśeṣeṇa kathayasva pitāmaha । sarvasya jīvalokasya rājadharmāḥ parāyaṇam ॥3॥
html:
rājadharmānviśeṣeṇa kathayasva pitāmaha ।
sarvasya jīvalokasya rājadharmāḥ parāyaṇam ॥3॥
slp1: rAjaDarmAnviSezeRa kaTayasva pitAmaha । sarvasya jIvalokasya rAjaDarmAH parAyaRam ॥3॥

text: trivargo'tra samāsakto rājadharmeṣu kaurava । mokṣadharmaśca vispaṣṭaḥ sakalo'tra samāhitaḥ ॥4॥
html:
trivargo'tra samāsakto rājadharmeṣu kaurava ।
mokṣadharmaśca vispaṣṭaḥ sakalo'tra samāhitaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: trivargo'tra samAsakto rAjaDarmezu kOrava । mokzaDarmaSca vispazwaH sakalo'tra samAhitaH ॥4॥

text: yathā hi raśmayo'śvasya dviradasyāṅkuśo yathā । narendradharmo lokasya tathā pragrahaṇaṃ smṛtam ॥5॥
html:
yathā hi raśmayo'śvasya dviradasyāṅkuśo yathā ।
narendradharmo lokasya tathā pragrahaṇaṃ smṛtam ॥5॥
slp1: yaTA hi raSmayo'Svasya dviradasyANkuSo yaTA । narendraDarmo lokasya taTA pragrahaRaM smftam ॥5॥

text: atra vai sampramūḍhe tu dharme rājarṣisevite । lokasya saṃsthā na bhavetsarvaṃ ca vyākulaṃ bhavet ॥6॥
html:
atra vai sampramūḍhe tu dharme rājarṣisevite ।
lokasya saṃsthā na bhavetsarvaṃ ca vyākulaṃ bhavet ॥6॥
slp1: atra vE sampramUQe tu Darme rAjarzisevite । lokasya saMsTA na BavetsarvaM ca vyAkulaM Bavet ॥6॥

text: udayanhi yathā sūryo nāśayatyāsuraṃ tamaḥ । rājadharmāstathālokyāmākṣipantyaśubhāṃ gatim ॥7॥
html:
udayanhi yathā sūryo nāśayatyāsuraṃ tamaḥ ।
rājadharmāstathālokyāmākṣipantyaśubhāṃ gatim ॥7॥
slp1: udayanhi yaTA sUryo nASayatyAsuraM tamaH । rAjaDarmAstaTAlokyAmAkzipantyaSuBAM gatim ॥7॥

text: tadagre rājadharmāṇāmarthatattvaṃ pitāmaha । prabrūhi bharataśreṣṭha tvaṃ hi buddhimatāṃ varaḥ ॥8॥
html:
tadagre rājadharmāṇāmarthatattvaṃ pitāmaha ।
prabrūhi bharataśreṣṭha tvaṃ hi buddhimatāṃ varaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tadagre rAjaDarmARAmarTatattvaM pitAmaha । prabrUhi BarataSrezWa tvaM hi budDimatAM varaH ॥8॥

text: āgamaśca parastvattaḥ sarveṣāṃ naḥ parantapa । bhavantaṃ hi paraṃ buddhau vāsudevo'bhimanyate ॥9॥
html:
āgamaśca parastvattaḥ sarveṣāṃ naḥ parantapa ।
bhavantaṃ hi paraṃ buddhau vāsudevo'bhimanyate ॥9॥
slp1: AgamaSca parastvattaH sarvezAM naH parantapa । BavantaM hi paraM budDO vAsudevo'Bimanyate ॥9॥

text: namo dharmāya mahate namaḥ kṛṣṇāya vedhase । brāhmaṇebhyo namaskṛtya dharmānvakṣyāmi śāśvatān ॥10॥
html:
namo dharmāya mahate namaḥ kṛṣṇāya vedhase ।
brāhmaṇebhyo namaskṛtya dharmānvakṣyāmi śāśvatān ॥10॥
slp1: namo DarmAya mahate namaH kfzRAya veDase । brAhmaReByo namaskftya DarmAnvakzyAmi SASvatAn ॥10॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: śṛṇu kārtsnyena mattastvaṃ rājadharmānyudhiṣṭhira । nirucyamānānniyato yaccānyadabhivāñchasi ॥11॥
html:
śṛṇu kārtsnyena mattastvaṃ rājadharmānyudhiṣṭhira ।
nirucyamānānniyato yaccānyadabhivāñchasi ॥11॥
slp1: SfRu kArtsnyena mattastvaM rAjaDarmAnyuDizWira । nirucyamAnAnniyato yaccAnyadaBivAYCasi ॥11॥

text: ādāveva kuruśreṣṭha rājñā rañjanakāmyayā । devatānāṃ dvijānāṃ ca vartitavyaṃ yathāvidhi ॥12॥
html:
ādāveva kuruśreṣṭha rājñā rañjanakāmyayā ।
devatānāṃ dvijānāṃ ca vartitavyaṃ yathāvidhi ॥12॥
slp1: AdAveva kuruSrezWa rAjYA raYjanakAmyayA । devatAnAM dvijAnAM ca vartitavyaM yaTAviDi ॥12॥

text: daivatānyarcayitvā hi brāhmaṇāṃśca kurūdvaha । ānṛṇyaṃ yāti dharmasya lokena ca sa mānyate ॥13॥
html:
daivatānyarcayitvā hi brāhmaṇāṃśca kurūdvaha ।
ānṛṇyaṃ yāti dharmasya lokena ca sa mānyate ॥13॥
slp1: dEvatAnyarcayitvA hi brAhmaRAMSca kurUdvaha । AnfRyaM yAti Darmasya lokena ca sa mAnyate ॥13॥

text: utthāne ca sadā putra prayatethā yudhiṣṭhira । na hyutthānamṛte daivaṃ rājñāmarthaprasiddhaye ॥14॥
html:
utthāne ca sadā putra prayatethā yudhiṣṭhira ।
na hyutthānamṛte daivaṃ rājñāmarthaprasiddhaye ॥14॥
slp1: utTAne ca sadA putra prayateTA yuDizWira । na hyutTAnamfte dEvaM rAjYAmarTaprasidDaye ॥14॥

text: sādhāraṇaṃ dvayaṃ hyetaddaivamutthānameva ca । pauruṣaṃ hi paraṃ manye daivaṃ niścityamucyate ॥15॥
html:
sādhāraṇaṃ dvayaṃ hyetaddaivamutthānameva ca ।
pauruṣaṃ hi paraṃ manye daivaṃ niścityamucyate ॥15॥
slp1: sADAraRaM dvayaM hyetaddEvamutTAnameva ca । pOruzaM hi paraM manye dEvaM niScityamucyate ॥15॥

text: vipanne ca samārambhe santāpaṃ mā sma vai kṛthāḥ । ghaṭate vinayastāta rājñāmeṣa nayaḥ paraḥ ॥16॥
html:
vipanne ca samārambhe santāpaṃ mā sma vai kṛthāḥ ।
ghaṭate vinayastāta rājñāmeṣa nayaḥ paraḥ ॥16॥
slp1: vipanne ca samAramBe santApaM mA sma vE kfTAH । Gawate vinayastAta rAjYAmeza nayaH paraH ॥16॥

text: na hi satyādṛte kiñcidrājñāṃ vai siddhikāraṇam । satye hi rājā nirataḥ pretya ceha ca nandati ॥17॥
html:
na hi satyādṛte kiñcidrājñāṃ vai siddhikāraṇam ।
satye hi rājā nirataḥ pretya ceha ca nandati ॥17॥
slp1: na hi satyAdfte kiYcidrAjYAM vE sidDikAraRam । satye hi rAjA nirataH pretya ceha ca nandati ॥17॥

text: ṛṣīṇāmapi rājendra satyameva paraṃ dhanam । tathā rājñaḥ paraṃ satyānnānyadviśvāsakāraṇam ॥18॥
html:
ṛṣīṇāmapi rājendra satyameva paraṃ dhanam ।
tathā rājñaḥ paraṃ satyānnānyadviśvāsakāraṇam ॥18॥
slp1: fzIRAmapi rAjendra satyameva paraM Danam । taTA rAjYaH paraM satyAnnAnyadviSvAsakAraRam ॥18॥

text: guṇavāñśīlavāndānto mṛdurdharmyo jitendriyaḥ । sudarśaḥ sthūlalakṣyaśca na bhraśyeta sadā śriyaḥ ॥19॥
html:
guṇavāñśīlavāndānto mṛdurdharmyo jitendriyaḥ ।
sudarśaḥ sthūlalakṣyaśca na bhraśyeta sadā śriyaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: guRavAYSIlavAndAnto mfdurDarmyo jitendriyaH । sudarSaH sTUlalakzyaSca na BraSyeta sadA SriyaH ॥19॥

text: ārjavaṃ sarvakāryeṣu śrayethāḥ kurunandana । punarnayavicāreṇa trayīsaṃvaraṇena ca ॥20॥
html:
ārjavaṃ sarvakāryeṣu śrayethāḥ kurunandana ।
punarnayavicāreṇa trayīsaṃvaraṇena ca ॥20॥
slp1: ArjavaM sarvakAryezu SrayeTAH kurunandana । punarnayavicAreRa trayIsaMvaraRena ca ॥20॥

text: mṛdurhi rājā satataṃ laṅghyo bhavati sarvaśaḥ । tīkṣṇāccodvijate lokastasmādubhayamācara ॥21॥
html:
mṛdurhi rājā satataṃ laṅghyo bhavati sarvaśaḥ ।
tīkṣṇāccodvijate lokastasmādubhayamācara ॥21॥
slp1: mfdurhi rAjA satataM laNGyo Bavati sarvaSaH । tIkzRAccodvijate lokastasmAduBayamAcara ॥21॥

text: adaṇḍyāścaiva te nityaṃ viprāḥ syurdadatāṃ vara । bhūtametatparaṃ loke brāhmaṇā nāma bhārata ॥22॥
html:
adaṇḍyāścaiva te nityaṃ viprāḥ syurdadatāṃ vara ।
bhūtametatparaṃ loke brāhmaṇā nāma bhārata ॥22॥
slp1: adaRqyAScEva te nityaM viprAH syurdadatAM vara । BUtametatparaM loke brAhmaRA nAma BArata ॥22॥

text: manunā cāpi rājendra gītau ślokau mahātmanā । dharmeṣu sveṣu kauravya hṛdi tau kartumarhasi ॥23॥
html:
manunā cāpi rājendra gītau ślokau mahātmanā ।
dharmeṣu sveṣu kauravya hṛdi tau kartumarhasi ॥23॥
slp1: manunA cApi rAjendra gItO SlokO mahAtmanA । Darmezu svezu kOravya hfdi tO kartumarhasi ॥23॥

text: adbhyo'gnirbrahmataḥ kṣatramaśmano lohamutthitam । teṣāṃ sarvatragaṃ tejaḥ svāsu yoniṣu śāmyati ॥24॥
html:
adbhyo'gnirbrahmataḥ kṣatramaśmano lohamutthitam ।
teṣāṃ sarvatragaṃ tejaḥ svāsu yoniṣu śāmyati ॥24॥
slp1: adByo'gnirbrahmataH kzatramaSmano lohamutTitam । tezAM sarvatragaM tejaH svAsu yonizu SAmyati ॥24॥

text: ayo hanti yadāśmānamagniścāpo'bhipadyate । brahma ca kṣatriyo dveṣṭi tadā sīdanti te trayaḥ ॥25॥
html:
ayo hanti yadāśmānamagniścāpo'bhipadyate ।
brahma ca kṣatriyo dveṣṭi tadā sīdanti te trayaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: ayo hanti yadASmAnamagniScApo'Bipadyate । brahma ca kzatriyo dvezwi tadA sIdanti te trayaH ॥25॥

text: etajjñātvā mahārāja namasyā eva te dvijāḥ । bhaumaṃ brahma dvijaśreṣṭhā dhārayanti śamānvitāḥ ॥26॥
html:
etajjñātvā mahārāja namasyā eva te dvijāḥ ।
bhaumaṃ brahma dvijaśreṣṭhā dhārayanti śamānvitāḥ ॥26॥
slp1: etajjYAtvA mahArAja namasyA eva te dvijAH । BOmaM brahma dvijaSrezWA DArayanti SamAnvitAH ॥26॥

text: evaṃ caiva naravyāghra lokatantravighātakāḥ । nigrāhyā eva satataṃ bāhubhyāṃ ye syurīdṛśāḥ ॥27॥
html:
evaṃ caiva naravyāghra lokatantravighātakāḥ ।
nigrāhyā eva satataṃ bāhubhyāṃ ye syurīdṛśāḥ ॥27॥
slp1: evaM cEva naravyAGra lokatantraviGAtakAH । nigrAhyA eva satataM bAhuByAM ye syurIdfSAH ॥27॥

text: ślokau cośanasā gītau purā tāta maharṣiṇā । tau nibodha mahāprājña tvamekāgramanā nṛpa ॥28॥
html:
ślokau cośanasā gītau purā tāta maharṣiṇā ।
tau nibodha mahāprājña tvamekāgramanā nṛpa ॥28॥
slp1: SlokO coSanasA gItO purA tAta maharziRA । tO niboDa mahAprAjYa tvamekAgramanA nfpa ॥28॥

text: udyamya śastramāyāntamapi vedāntagaṃ raṇe । nigṛhṇīyātsvadharmeṇa dharmāpekṣī nareśvaraḥ ॥29॥
html:
udyamya śastramāyāntamapi vedāntagaṃ raṇe ।
nigṛhṇīyātsvadharmeṇa dharmāpekṣī nareśvaraḥ ॥29॥
slp1: udyamya SastramAyAntamapi vedAntagaM raRe । nigfhRIyAtsvaDarmeRa DarmApekzI nareSvaraH ॥29॥

text: vinaśyamānaṃ dharmaṃ hi yo rakṣati sa dharmavit । na tena bhrūṇahā sa syānmanyustaṃ manumṛcchati ॥30॥
html:
vinaśyamānaṃ dharmaṃ hi yo rakṣati sa dharmavit ।
na tena bhrūṇahā sa syānmanyustaṃ manumṛcchati ॥30॥
slp1: vinaSyamAnaM DarmaM hi yo rakzati sa Darmavit । na tena BrURahA sa syAnmanyustaM manumfcCati ॥30॥

text: evaṃ caiva naraśreṣṭha rakṣyā eva dvijātayaḥ । svaparāddhānapi hi tānviṣayānte samutsṛjet ॥31॥
html:
evaṃ caiva naraśreṣṭha rakṣyā eva dvijātayaḥ ।
svaparāddhānapi hi tānviṣayānte samutsṛjet ॥31॥
slp1: evaM cEva naraSrezWa rakzyA eva dvijAtayaH । svaparAdDAnapi hi tAnvizayAnte samutsfjet ॥31॥

text: abhiśastamapi hyeṣāṃ kṛpāyīta viśāmpate । brahmaghne gurutalpe ca bhrūṇahatye tathaiva ca ॥32॥
html:
abhiśastamapi hyeṣāṃ kṛpāyīta viśāmpate ।
brahmaghne gurutalpe ca bhrūṇahatye tathaiva ca ॥32॥
slp1: aBiSastamapi hyezAM kfpAyIta viSAmpate । brahmaGne gurutalpe ca BrURahatye taTEva ca ॥32॥

text: rājadviṣṭe ca viprasya viṣayānte visarjanam । vidhīyate na śārīraṃ bhayameṣāṃ kadācana ॥33॥
html:
rājadviṣṭe ca viprasya viṣayānte visarjanam ।
vidhīyate na śārīraṃ bhayameṣāṃ kadācana ॥33॥
slp1: rAjadvizwe ca viprasya vizayAnte visarjanam । viDIyate na SArIraM BayamezAM kadAcana ॥33॥

text: dayitāśca narāste syurnityaṃ puruṣasattama । na kośaḥ paramo hyanyo rājñāṃ puruṣasañcayāt ॥34॥
html:
dayitāśca narāste syurnityaṃ puruṣasattama ।
na kośaḥ paramo hyanyo rājñāṃ puruṣasañcayāt ॥34॥
slp1: dayitASca narAste syurnityaM puruzasattama । na koSaH paramo hyanyo rAjYAM puruzasaYcayAt ॥34॥

text: durgeṣu ca mahārāja ṣaṭsu ye śāstraniścitāḥ । sarveṣu teṣu manyante naradurgaṃ sudustaram ॥35॥
html:
durgeṣu ca mahārāja ṣaṭsu ye śāstraniścitāḥ ।
sarveṣu teṣu manyante naradurgaṃ sudustaram ॥35॥
slp1: durgezu ca mahArAja zawsu ye SAstraniScitAH । sarvezu tezu manyante naradurgaM sudustaram ॥35॥

text: tasmānnityaṃ dayā kāryā cāturvarṇye vipaścitā । dharmātmā satyavākcaiva rājā rañjayati prajāḥ ॥36॥
html:
tasmānnityaṃ dayā kāryā cāturvarṇye vipaścitā ।
dharmātmā satyavākcaiva rājā rañjayati prajāḥ ॥36॥
slp1: tasmAnnityaM dayA kAryA cAturvarRye vipaScitA । DarmAtmA satyavAkcEva rAjA raYjayati prajAH ॥36॥

text: na ca kṣāntena te bhāvyaṃ nityaṃ puruṣasattama । adharmyo hi mṛdū rājā kṣamāvāniva kuñjaraḥ ॥37॥
html:
na ca kṣāntena te bhāvyaṃ nityaṃ puruṣasattama ।
adharmyo hi mṛdū rājā kṣamāvāniva kuñjaraḥ ॥37॥
slp1: na ca kzAntena te BAvyaM nityaM puruzasattama । aDarmyo hi mfdU rAjA kzamAvAniva kuYjaraH ॥37॥

text: bārhaspatye ca śāstre vai ślokā viniyatāḥ purā । asminnarthe mahārāja tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ॥38॥
html:
bārhaspatye ca śāstre vai ślokā viniyatāḥ purā ।
asminnarthe mahārāja tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ॥38॥
slp1: bArhaspatye ca SAstre vE SlokA viniyatAH purA । asminnarTe mahArAja tanme nigadataH SfRu ॥38॥

text: kṣamamāṇaṃ nṛpaṃ nityaṃ nīcaḥ paribhavejjanaḥ । hastiyantā gajasyeva śira evārurukṣati ॥39॥
html:
kṣamamāṇaṃ nṛpaṃ nityaṃ nīcaḥ paribhavejjanaḥ ।
hastiyantā gajasyeva śira evārurukṣati ॥39॥
slp1: kzamamARaM nfpaM nityaM nIcaH pariBavejjanaH । hastiyantA gajasyeva Sira evArurukzati ॥39॥

text: tasmānnaiva mṛdurnityaṃ tīkṣṇo vāpi bhavennṛpaḥ । vasante'rka iva śrīmānna śīto na ca gharmadaḥ ॥40॥
html:
tasmānnaiva mṛdurnityaṃ tīkṣṇo vāpi bhavennṛpaḥ ।
vasante'rka iva śrīmānna śīto na ca gharmadaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: tasmAnnEva mfdurnityaM tIkzRo vApi BavennfpaH । vasante'rka iva SrImAnna SIto na ca GarmadaH ॥40॥

text: pratyakṣeṇānumānena tathaupamyopadeśataḥ । parīkṣyāste mahārāja sve pare caiva sarvadā ॥41॥
html:
pratyakṣeṇānumānena tathaupamyopadeśataḥ ।
parīkṣyāste mahārāja sve pare caiva sarvadā ॥41॥
slp1: pratyakzeRAnumAnena taTOpamyopadeSataH । parIkzyAste mahArAja sve pare cEva sarvadA ॥41॥

text: vyasanāni ca sarvāṇi tyajethā bhūridakṣiṇa । na caiva na prayuñjīta saṅgaṃ tu parivarjayet ॥42॥
html:
vyasanāni ca sarvāṇi tyajethā bhūridakṣiṇa ।
na caiva na prayuñjīta saṅgaṃ tu parivarjayet ॥42॥
slp1: vyasanAni ca sarvARi tyajeTA BUridakziRa । na cEva na prayuYjIta saNgaM tu parivarjayet ॥42॥

text: nityaṃ hi vyasanī loke paribhūto bhavatyuta । udvejayati lokaṃ cāpyatidveṣī mahīpatiḥ ॥43॥
html:
nityaṃ hi vyasanī loke paribhūto bhavatyuta ।
udvejayati lokaṃ cāpyatidveṣī mahīpatiḥ ॥43॥
slp1: nityaM hi vyasanI loke pariBUto Bavatyuta । udvejayati lokaM cApyatidvezI mahIpatiH ॥43॥

text: bhavitavyaṃ sadā rājñā garbhiṇīsahadharmiṇā । kāraṇaṃ ca mahārāja śṛṇu yenedamiṣyate ॥44॥
html:
bhavitavyaṃ sadā rājñā garbhiṇīsahadharmiṇā ।
kāraṇaṃ ca mahārāja śṛṇu yenedamiṣyate ॥44॥
slp1: BavitavyaM sadA rAjYA garBiRIsahaDarmiRA । kAraRaM ca mahArAja SfRu yenedamizyate ॥44॥

text: yathā hi garbhiṇī hitvā svaṃ priyaṃ manaso'nugam । garbhasya hitamādhatte tathā rājñāpyasaṃśayam ॥45॥
html:
yathā hi garbhiṇī hitvā svaṃ priyaṃ manaso'nugam ।
garbhasya hitamādhatte tathā rājñāpyasaṃśayam ॥45॥
slp1: yaTA hi garBiRI hitvA svaM priyaM manaso'nugam । garBasya hitamADatte taTA rAjYApyasaMSayam ॥45॥

text: vartitavyaṃ kuruśreṣṭha nityaṃ dharmānuvartinā । svaṃ priyaṃ samabhityajya yadyallokahitaṃ bhavet ॥46॥
html:
vartitavyaṃ kuruśreṣṭha nityaṃ dharmānuvartinā ।
svaṃ priyaṃ samabhityajya yadyallokahitaṃ bhavet ॥46॥
slp1: vartitavyaM kuruSrezWa nityaM DarmAnuvartinA । svaM priyaM samaBityajya yadyallokahitaM Bavet ॥46॥

text: na santyājyaṃ ca te dhairyaṃ kadācidapi pāṇḍava । dhīrasya spaṣṭadaṇḍasya na hyājñā pratihanyate ॥47॥
html:
na santyājyaṃ ca te dhairyaṃ kadācidapi pāṇḍava ।
dhīrasya spaṣṭadaṇḍasya na hyājñā pratihanyate ॥47॥
slp1: na santyAjyaM ca te DEryaM kadAcidapi pARqava । DIrasya spazwadaRqasya na hyAjYA pratihanyate ॥47॥

text: parihāsaśca bhṛtyaiste na nityaṃ vadatāṃ vara । kartavyo rājaśārdūla doṣamatra hi me śṛṇu ॥48॥
html:
parihāsaśca bhṛtyaiste na nityaṃ vadatāṃ vara ।
kartavyo rājaśārdūla doṣamatra hi me śṛṇu ॥48॥
slp1: parihAsaSca BftyEste na nityaM vadatAM vara । kartavyo rAjaSArdUla dozamatra hi me SfRu ॥48॥

text: avamanyanti bhartāraṃ saṃharṣādupajīvinaḥ । sve sthāne na ca tiṣṭhanti laṅghayanti hi tadvacaḥ ॥49॥
html:
avamanyanti bhartāraṃ saṃharṣādupajīvinaḥ ।
sve sthāne na ca tiṣṭhanti laṅghayanti hi tadvacaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: avamanyanti BartAraM saMharzAdupajIvinaH । sve sTAne na ca tizWanti laNGayanti hi tadvacaH ॥49॥

text: preṣyamāṇā vikalpante guhyaṃ cāpyanuyuñjate । ayācyaṃ caiva yācante'bhojyānyāhārayanti ca ॥50॥
html:
preṣyamāṇā vikalpante guhyaṃ cāpyanuyuñjate ।
ayācyaṃ caiva yācante'bhojyānyāhārayanti ca ॥50॥
slp1: prezyamARA vikalpante guhyaM cApyanuyuYjate । ayAcyaM cEva yAcante'BojyAnyAhArayanti ca ॥50॥

text: krudhyanti paridīpyanti bhūmimadhyāsate'sya ca । utkocairvañcanābhiśca kāryāṇyanuvihanti ca ॥51॥
html:
krudhyanti paridīpyanti bhūmimadhyāsate'sya ca ।
utkocairvañcanābhiśca kāryāṇyanuvihanti ca ॥51॥
slp1: kruDyanti paridIpyanti BUmimaDyAsate'sya ca । utkocErvaYcanABiSca kAryARyanuvihanti ca ॥51॥

text: jarjaraṃ cāsya viṣayaṃ kurvanti pratirūpakaiḥ । strīrakṣibhiśca sajjante tulyaveṣā bhavanti ca ॥52॥
html:
jarjaraṃ cāsya viṣayaṃ kurvanti pratirūpakaiḥ ।
strīrakṣibhiśca sajjante tulyaveṣā bhavanti ca ॥52॥
slp1: jarjaraM cAsya vizayaM kurvanti pratirUpakEH । strIrakziBiSca sajjante tulyavezA Bavanti ca ॥52॥

text: vātaṃ ca ṣṭhīvanaṃ caiva kurvate cāsya sannidhau । nirlajjā naraśārdūla vyāharanti ca tadvacaḥ ॥53॥
html:
vātaṃ ca ṣṭhīvanaṃ caiva kurvate cāsya sannidhau ।
nirlajjā naraśārdūla vyāharanti ca tadvacaḥ ॥53॥
slp1: vAtaM ca zWIvanaM cEva kurvate cAsya sanniDO । nirlajjA naraSArdUla vyAharanti ca tadvacaH ॥53॥

text: hayaṃ vā dantinaṃ vāpi rathaṃ nṛpatisammatam । adhirohantyanādṛtya harṣule pārthive mṛdau ॥54॥
html:
hayaṃ vā dantinaṃ vāpi rathaṃ nṛpatisammatam ।
adhirohantyanādṛtya harṣule pārthive mṛdau ॥54॥
slp1: hayaM vA dantinaM vApi raTaM nfpatisammatam । aDirohantyanAdftya harzule pArTive mfdO ॥54॥

text: idaṃ te duṣkaraṃ rājannidaṃ te durviceṣṭitam । ityevaṃ suhṛdo nāma bruvanti pariṣadgatāḥ ॥55॥
html:
idaṃ te duṣkaraṃ rājannidaṃ te durviceṣṭitam ।
ityevaṃ suhṛdo nāma bruvanti pariṣadgatāḥ ॥55॥
slp1: idaM te duzkaraM rAjannidaM te durvicezwitam । ityevaM suhfdo nAma bruvanti parizadgatAH ॥55॥

text: kruddhe cāsminhasantyeva na ca hṛṣyanti pūjitāḥ । saṅgharṣaśīlāśca sadā bhavantyanyonyakāraṇāt ॥56॥
html:
kruddhe cāsminhasantyeva na ca hṛṣyanti pūjitāḥ ।
saṅgharṣaśīlāśca sadā bhavantyanyonyakāraṇāt ॥56॥
slp1: krudDe cAsminhasantyeva na ca hfzyanti pUjitAH । saNGarzaSIlASca sadA BavantyanyonyakAraRAt ॥56॥

text: visraṃsayanti mantraṃ ca vivṛṇvanti ca duṣkṛtam । līlayā caiva kurvanti sāvajñāstasya śāsanam । alaṅkaraṇabhojyaṃ ca tathā snānānulepanam ॥57॥
html:
visraṃsayanti mantraṃ ca vivṛṇvanti ca duṣkṛtam ।
līlayā caiva kurvanti sāvajñāstasya śāsanam ।
alaṅkaraṇabhojyaṃ ca tathā snānānulepanam ॥57॥
slp1: visraMsayanti mantraM ca vivfRvanti ca duzkftam । lIlayA cEva kurvanti sAvajYAstasya SAsanam । alaNkaraRaBojyaM ca taTA snAnAnulepanam ॥57॥

text: helamānā naravyāghra svasthāstasyopaśṛṇvate । nindanti svānadhīkārānsantyajanti ca bhārata ॥58॥
html:
helamānā naravyāghra svasthāstasyopaśṛṇvate ।
nindanti svānadhīkārānsantyajanti ca bhārata ॥58॥
slp1: helamAnA naravyAGra svasTAstasyopaSfRvate । nindanti svAnaDIkArAnsantyajanti ca BArata ॥58॥

text: na vṛttyā parituṣyanti rājadeyaṃ haranti ca । krīḍituṃ tena cecchanti sasūtreṇeva pakṣiṇā । asmatpraṇeyo rājeti loke caiva vadantyuta ॥59॥
html:
na vṛttyā parituṣyanti rājadeyaṃ haranti ca ।
krīḍituṃ tena cecchanti sasūtreṇeva pakṣiṇā ।
asmatpraṇeyo rājeti loke caiva vadantyuta ॥59॥
slp1: na vfttyA parituzyanti rAjadeyaM haranti ca । krIqituM tena cecCanti sasUtreReva pakziRA । asmatpraReyo rAjeti loke cEva vadantyuta ॥59॥

text: ete caivāpare caiva doṣāḥ prādurbhavantyuta । nṛpatau mārdavopete harṣule ca yudhiṣṭhira] ॥60॥
html:
ete caivāpare caiva doṣāḥ prādurbhavantyuta ।
nṛpatau mārdavopete harṣule ca yudhiṣṭhira] ॥60॥
slp1: ete cEvApare cEva dozAH prAdurBavantyuta । nfpatO mArdavopete harzule ca yuDizWira] ॥60॥

text: nityodyuktena vai rājñā bhavitavyaṃ yudhiṣṭhira । praśāmyate ca rājā hi nārīvodyamavarjitaḥ ॥1॥
html:
nityodyuktena vai rājñā bhavitavyaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
praśāmyate ca rājā hi nārīvodyamavarjitaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: nityodyuktena vE rAjYA BavitavyaM yuDizWira । praSAmyate ca rAjA hi nArIvodyamavarjitaH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: bhagavānuśanā cāha ślokamatra viśāmpate । tamihaikamanā rājangadatastvaṃ nibodha me ॥2॥
html:
bhagavānuśanā cāha ślokamatra viśāmpate ।
tamihaikamanā rājangadatastvaṃ nibodha me ॥2॥
slp1: BagavAnuSanA cAha Slokamatra viSAmpate । tamihEkamanA rAjangadatastvaM niboDa me ॥2॥

text: dvāvetau grasate bhūmiḥ sarpo bilaśayāniva । rājānaṃ cāviroddhāraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ cāpravāsinam ॥3॥
html:
dvāvetau grasate bhūmiḥ sarpo bilaśayāniva ।
rājānaṃ cāviroddhāraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ cāpravāsinam ॥3॥
slp1: dvAvetO grasate BUmiH sarpo bilaSayAniva । rAjAnaM cAvirodDAraM brAhmaRaM cApravAsinam ॥3॥

text: tadetannaraśārdūla hṛdi tvaṃ kartumarhasi । sandheyānapi sandhatsva virodhyāṃśca virodhaya ॥4॥
html:
tadetannaraśārdūla hṛdi tvaṃ kartumarhasi ।
sandheyānapi sandhatsva virodhyāṃśca virodhaya ॥4॥
slp1: tadetannaraSArdUla hfdi tvaM kartumarhasi । sanDeyAnapi sanDatsva viroDyAMSca viroDaya ॥4॥

text: saptāṅge yaśca te rājye vaiparītyaṃ samācaret । gururvā yadi vā mitraṃ pratihantavya eva saḥ ॥5॥
html:
saptāṅge yaśca te rājye vaiparītyaṃ samācaret ।
gururvā yadi vā mitraṃ pratihantavya eva saḥ ॥5॥
slp1: saptANge yaSca te rAjye vEparItyaM samAcaret । gururvA yadi vA mitraM pratihantavya eva saH ॥5॥

text: maruttena hi rājñāyaṃ gītaḥ ślokaḥ purātanaḥ । rājyādhikāre rājendra bṛhaspatimataḥ purā ॥6॥
html:
maruttena hi rājñāyaṃ gītaḥ ślokaḥ purātanaḥ ।
rājyādhikāre rājendra bṛhaspatimataḥ purā ॥6॥
slp1: maruttena hi rAjYAyaM gItaH SlokaH purAtanaH । rAjyADikAre rAjendra bfhaspatimataH purA ॥6॥

text: gurorapyavaliptasya kāryākāryamajānataḥ । utpathapratipannasya parityāgo vidhīyate ॥7॥
html:
gurorapyavaliptasya kāryākāryamajānataḥ ।
utpathapratipannasya parityāgo vidhīyate ॥7॥
slp1: gurorapyavaliptasya kAryAkAryamajAnataH । utpaTapratipannasya parityAgo viDIyate ॥7॥

text: bāhoḥ putreṇa rājñā ca sagareṇeha dhīmatā । asamañjāḥ suto jyeṣṭhastyaktaḥ paurahitaiṣiṇā ॥8॥
html:
bāhoḥ putreṇa rājñā ca sagareṇeha dhīmatā ।
asamañjāḥ suto jyeṣṭhastyaktaḥ paurahitaiṣiṇā ॥8॥
slp1: bAhoH putreRa rAjYA ca sagareReha DImatA । asamaYjAH suto jyezWastyaktaH pOrahitEziRA ॥8॥

text: asamañjāḥ sarayvāṃ prākpaurāṇāṃ bālakānnṛpa । nyamajjayadataḥ pitrā nirbhartsya sa vivāsitaḥ ॥9॥
html:
asamañjāḥ sarayvāṃ prākpaurāṇāṃ bālakānnṛpa ।
nyamajjayadataḥ pitrā nirbhartsya sa vivāsitaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: asamaYjAH sarayvAM prAkpOrARAM bAlakAnnfpa । nyamajjayadataH pitrA nirBartsya sa vivAsitaH ॥9॥

text: ṛṣiṇoddālakenāpi śvetaketurmahātapāḥ । mithyā viprānupacaransantyakto dayitaḥ sutaḥ ॥10॥
html:
ṛṣiṇoddālakenāpi śvetaketurmahātapāḥ ।
mithyā viprānupacaransantyakto dayitaḥ sutaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: fziRoddAlakenApi SvetaketurmahAtapAH । miTyA viprAnupacaransantyakto dayitaH sutaH ॥10॥

text: lokarañjanamevātra rājñāṃ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ । satyasya rakṣaṇaṃ caiva vyavahārasya cārjavam ॥11॥
html:
lokarañjanamevātra rājñāṃ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
satyasya rakṣaṇaṃ caiva vyavahārasya cārjavam ॥11॥
slp1: lokaraYjanamevAtra rAjYAM DarmaH sanAtanaH । satyasya rakzaRaM cEva vyavahArasya cArjavam ॥11॥

text: na hiṃsyātparavittāni deyaṃ kāle ca dāpayet । vikrāntaḥ satyavākkṣānto nṛpo na calate pathaḥ ॥12॥
html:
na hiṃsyātparavittāni deyaṃ kāle ca dāpayet ।
vikrāntaḥ satyavākkṣānto nṛpo na calate pathaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: na hiMsyAtparavittAni deyaM kAle ca dApayet । vikrAntaH satyavAkkzAnto nfpo na calate paTaH ॥12॥

text: guptamantro jitakrodho śāstrārthagataniścayaḥ । dharme cārthe ca kāme ca mokṣe ca satataṃ rataḥ ॥13॥
html:
guptamantro jitakrodho śāstrārthagataniścayaḥ ।
dharme cārthe ca kāme ca mokṣe ca satataṃ rataḥ ॥13॥
slp1: guptamantro jitakroDo SAstrArTagataniScayaH । Darme cArTe ca kAme ca mokze ca satataM rataH ॥13॥

text: trayyā saṃvṛtarandhraśca rājā bhavitumarhati । vṛjinasya narendrāṇāṃ nānyatsaṃvaraṇātparam ॥14॥
html:
trayyā saṃvṛtarandhraśca rājā bhavitumarhati ।
vṛjinasya narendrāṇāṃ nānyatsaṃvaraṇātparam ॥14॥
slp1: trayyA saMvftaranDraSca rAjA Bavitumarhati । vfjinasya narendrARAM nAnyatsaMvaraRAtparam ॥14॥

text: cāturvarṇyasya dharmāśca rakṣitavyā mahīkṣitā । dharmasaṅkararakṣā hi rājñāṃ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥15॥
html:
cāturvarṇyasya dharmāśca rakṣitavyā mahīkṣitā ।
dharmasaṅkararakṣā hi rājñāṃ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: cAturvarRyasya DarmASca rakzitavyA mahIkzitA । DarmasaNkararakzA hi rAjYAM DarmaH sanAtanaH ॥15॥

text: na viśvasecca nṛpatirna cātyarthaṃ na viśvaset । ṣāḍguṇyaguṇadoṣāṃśca nityaṃ buddhyāvalokayet ॥16॥
html:
na viśvasecca nṛpatirna cātyarthaṃ na viśvaset ।
ṣāḍguṇyaguṇadoṣāṃśca nityaṃ buddhyāvalokayet ॥16॥
slp1: na viSvasecca nfpatirna cAtyarTaM na viSvaset । zAqguRyaguRadozAMSca nityaM budDyAvalokayet ॥16॥

text: dviṭchidradarśī nṛpatirnityameva praśasyate । trivargaviditārthaśca yuktacāropadhiśca yaḥ ॥17॥
html:
dviṭchidradarśī nṛpatirnityameva praśasyate ।
trivargaviditārthaśca yuktacāropadhiśca yaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: dviwCidradarSI nfpatirnityameva praSasyate । trivargaviditArTaSca yuktacAropaDiSca yaH ॥17॥

text: kośasyopārjanaratiryamavaiśravaṇopamaḥ । vettā ca daśavargasya sthānavṛddhikṣayātmanaḥ ॥18॥
html:
kośasyopārjanaratiryamavaiśravaṇopamaḥ ।
vettā ca daśavargasya sthānavṛddhikṣayātmanaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: koSasyopArjanaratiryamavESravaRopamaH । vettA ca daSavargasya sTAnavfdDikzayAtmanaH ॥18॥

text: abhṛtānāṃ bhavedbhartā bhṛtānāṃ cānvavekṣakaḥ । nṛpatiḥ sumukhaśca syātsmitapūrvābhibhāṣitā ॥19॥
html:
abhṛtānāṃ bhavedbhartā bhṛtānāṃ cānvavekṣakaḥ ।
nṛpatiḥ sumukhaśca syātsmitapūrvābhibhāṣitā ॥19॥
slp1: aBftAnAM BavedBartA BftAnAM cAnvavekzakaH । nfpatiH sumuKaSca syAtsmitapUrvABiBAzitA ॥19॥

text: upāsitā ca vṛddhānāṃ jitatandrīralolupaḥ । satāṃ vṛtte sthitamatiḥ santo hyācāradarśinaḥ ॥20॥
html:
upāsitā ca vṛddhānāṃ jitatandrīralolupaḥ ।
satāṃ vṛtte sthitamatiḥ santo hyācāradarśinaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: upAsitA ca vfdDAnAM jitatandrIralolupaH । satAM vftte sTitamatiH santo hyAcAradarSinaH ॥20॥

text: na cādadīta vittāni satāṃ hastātkadācana । asadbhyastu samādadyātsadbhyaḥ sampratipādayet ॥21॥
html:
na cādadīta vittāni satāṃ hastātkadācana ।
asadbhyastu samādadyātsadbhyaḥ sampratipādayet ॥21॥
slp1: na cAdadIta vittAni satAM hastAtkadAcana । asadByastu samAdadyAtsadByaH sampratipAdayet ॥21॥

text: svayaṃ prahartādātā ca vaśyātmā vaśyasādhanaḥ । kāle dātā ca bhoktā ca śuddhācārastathaiva ca ॥22॥
html:
svayaṃ prahartādātā ca vaśyātmā vaśyasādhanaḥ ।
kāle dātā ca bhoktā ca śuddhācārastathaiva ca ॥22॥
slp1: svayaM prahartAdAtA ca vaSyAtmA vaSyasADanaH । kAle dAtA ca BoktA ca SudDAcArastaTEva ca ॥22॥

text: śūrānbhaktānasaṃhāryānkule jātānarogiṇaḥ । śiṣṭāñśiṣṭābhisaṃbandhānmānino nāvamāninaḥ ॥23॥
html:
śūrānbhaktānasaṃhāryānkule jātānarogiṇaḥ ।
śiṣṭāñśiṣṭābhisaṃbandhānmānino nāvamāninaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: SUrAnBaktAnasaMhAryAnkule jAtAnarogiRaH । SizwAYSizwABisaMbanDAnmAnino nAvamAninaH ॥23॥

text: vidyāvido lokavidaḥ paralokānvavekṣakān । dharmeṣu niratānsādhūnacalānacalāniva ॥24॥
html:
vidyāvido lokavidaḥ paralokānvavekṣakān ।
dharmeṣu niratānsādhūnacalānacalāniva ॥24॥
slp1: vidyAvido lokavidaH paralokAnvavekzakAn । Darmezu niratAnsADUnacalAnacalAniva ॥24॥

text: sahāyānsatataṃ kuryādrājā bhūtipuraskṛtaḥ । taistulyaśca bhavedbhogaiśchatramātrājñayādhikaḥ ॥25॥
html:
sahāyānsatataṃ kuryādrājā bhūtipuraskṛtaḥ ।
taistulyaśca bhavedbhogaiśchatramātrājñayādhikaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: sahAyAnsatataM kuryAdrAjA BUtipuraskftaH । tEstulyaSca BavedBogESCatramAtrAjYayADikaH ॥25॥

text: pratyakṣā ca parokṣā ca vṛttiścāsya bhavetsadā । evaṃ kṛtvā narendro hi na khedamiha vindati ॥26॥
html:
pratyakṣā ca parokṣā ca vṛttiścāsya bhavetsadā ।
evaṃ kṛtvā narendro hi na khedamiha vindati ॥26॥
slp1: pratyakzA ca parokzA ca vfttiScAsya BavetsadA । evaM kftvA narendro hi na Kedamiha vindati ॥26॥

text: sarvātiśaṅkī nṛpatiryaśca sarvaharo bhavet । sa kṣipramanṛjurlubdhaḥ svajanenaiva bādhyate ॥27॥
html:
sarvātiśaṅkī nṛpatiryaśca sarvaharo bhavet ।
sa kṣipramanṛjurlubdhaḥ svajanenaiva bādhyate ॥27॥
slp1: sarvAtiSaNkI nfpatiryaSca sarvaharo Bavet । sa kzipramanfjurlubDaH svajanenEva bADyate ॥27॥

text: śucistu pṛthivīpālo lokacittagrahe rataḥ । na patatyaribhirgrastaḥ patitaścāvatiṣṭhate ॥28॥
html:
śucistu pṛthivīpālo lokacittagrahe rataḥ ।
na patatyaribhirgrastaḥ patitaścāvatiṣṭhate ॥28॥
slp1: Sucistu pfTivIpAlo lokacittagrahe rataH । na patatyariBirgrastaH patitaScAvatizWate ॥28॥

text: akrodhano'thāvyasanī mṛdudaṇḍo jitendriyaḥ । rājā bhavati bhūtānāṃ viśvāsyo himavāniva ॥29॥
html:
akrodhano'thāvyasanī mṛdudaṇḍo jitendriyaḥ ।
rājā bhavati bhūtānāṃ viśvāsyo himavāniva ॥29॥
slp1: akroDano'TAvyasanI mfdudaRqo jitendriyaH । rAjA Bavati BUtAnAM viSvAsyo himavAniva ॥29॥

text: prājño nyāyaguṇopetaḥ pararandhreṣu tatparaḥ । sudarśaḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ nayāpanayavittathā ॥30॥
html:
prājño nyāyaguṇopetaḥ pararandhreṣu tatparaḥ ।
sudarśaḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ nayāpanayavittathā ॥30॥
slp1: prAjYo nyAyaguRopetaH pararanDrezu tatparaH । sudarSaH sarvavarRAnAM nayApanayavittaTA ॥30॥

text: kṣiprakārī jitakrodhaḥ suprasādo mahāmanāḥ । arogaprakṛtiryuktaḥ kriyāvānavikatthanaḥ ॥31॥
html:
kṣiprakārī jitakrodhaḥ suprasādo mahāmanāḥ ।
arogaprakṛtiryuktaḥ kriyāvānavikatthanaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: kziprakArI jitakroDaH suprasAdo mahAmanAH । arogaprakftiryuktaH kriyAvAnavikatTanaH ॥31॥

text: ārabdhānyeva kāryāṇi na paryavasitāni ca । yasya rājñaḥ pradṛśyante sa rājā rājasattamaḥ ॥32॥
html:
ārabdhānyeva kāryāṇi na paryavasitāni ca ।
yasya rājñaḥ pradṛśyante sa rājā rājasattamaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: ArabDAnyeva kAryARi na paryavasitAni ca । yasya rAjYaH pradfSyante sa rAjA rAjasattamaH ॥32॥

text: putrā iva piturgehe viṣaye yasya mānavāḥ । nirbhayā vicariṣyanti sa rājā rājasattamaḥ ॥33॥
html:
putrā iva piturgehe viṣaye yasya mānavāḥ ।
nirbhayā vicariṣyanti sa rājā rājasattamaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: putrA iva piturgehe vizaye yasya mAnavAH । nirBayA vicarizyanti sa rAjA rAjasattamaH ॥33॥

text: agūḍhavibhavā yasya paurā rāṣṭranivāsinaḥ । nayāpanayavettāraḥ sa rājā rājasattamaḥ ॥34॥
html:
agūḍhavibhavā yasya paurā rāṣṭranivāsinaḥ ।
nayāpanayavettāraḥ sa rājā rājasattamaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: agUQaviBavA yasya pOrA rAzwranivAsinaH । nayApanayavettAraH sa rAjA rAjasattamaH ॥34॥

text: svakarmaniratā yasya janā viṣayavāsinaḥ । asaṅghātaratā dāntāḥ pālyamānā yathāvidhi ॥35॥
html:
svakarmaniratā yasya janā viṣayavāsinaḥ ।
asaṅghātaratā dāntāḥ pālyamānā yathāvidhi ॥35॥
slp1: svakarmaniratA yasya janA vizayavAsinaH । asaNGAtaratA dAntAH pAlyamAnA yaTAviDi ॥35॥

text: vaśyā neyā vinītāśca na ca saṅgharṣaśīlinaḥ । viṣaye dānarucayo narā yasya sa pārthivaḥ ॥36॥
html:
vaśyā neyā vinītāśca na ca saṅgharṣaśīlinaḥ ।
viṣaye dānarucayo narā yasya sa pārthivaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: vaSyA neyA vinItASca na ca saNGarzaSIlinaH । vizaye dAnarucayo narA yasya sa pArTivaH ॥36॥

text: na yasya kūṭakapaṭaṃ na māyā na ca matsaraḥ । viṣaye bhūmipālasya tasya dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥37॥
html:
na yasya kūṭakapaṭaṃ na māyā na ca matsaraḥ ।
viṣaye bhūmipālasya tasya dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: na yasya kUwakapawaM na mAyA na ca matsaraH । vizaye BUmipAlasya tasya DarmaH sanAtanaH ॥37॥

text: yaḥ satkaroti jñānāni neyaḥ paurahite rataḥ । satāṃ dharmānugastyāgī sa rājā rājyamarhati ॥38॥
html:
yaḥ satkaroti jñānāni neyaḥ paurahite rataḥ ।
satāṃ dharmānugastyāgī sa rājā rājyamarhati ॥38॥
slp1: yaH satkaroti jYAnAni neyaH pOrahite rataH । satAM DarmAnugastyAgI sa rAjA rAjyamarhati ॥38॥

text: yasya cāraśca mantraśca nityaṃ caiva kṛtākṛte । na jñāyate hi ripubhiḥ sa rājā rājyamarhati ॥39॥
html:
yasya cāraśca mantraśca nityaṃ caiva kṛtākṛte ।
na jñāyate hi ripubhiḥ sa rājā rājyamarhati ॥39॥
slp1: yasya cAraSca mantraSca nityaM cEva kftAkfte । na jYAyate hi ripuBiH sa rAjA rAjyamarhati ॥39॥

text: ślokaścāyaṃ purā gīto bhārgaveṇa mahātmanā । ākhyāte rāmacarite nṛpatiṃ prati bhārata ॥40॥
html:
ślokaścāyaṃ purā gīto bhārgaveṇa mahātmanā ।
ākhyāte rāmacarite nṛpatiṃ prati bhārata ॥40॥
slp1: SlokaScAyaM purA gIto BArgaveRa mahAtmanA । AKyAte rAmacarite nfpatiM prati BArata ॥40॥

text: rājānaṃ prathamaṃ vindettato bhāryāṃ tato dhanam । rājanyasati lokasya kuto bhāryā kuto dhanam ॥41॥
html:
rājānaṃ prathamaṃ vindettato bhāryāṃ tato dhanam ।
rājanyasati lokasya kuto bhāryā kuto dhanam ॥41॥
slp1: rAjAnaM praTamaM vindettato BAryAM tato Danam । rAjanyasati lokasya kuto BAryA kuto Danam ॥41॥

text: tadrājanrājasiṃhānāṃ nānyo dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ । ṛte rakṣāṃ suvispaṣṭāṃ rakṣā lokasya dhāraṇam ॥42॥
html:
tadrājanrājasiṃhānāṃ nānyo dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
ṛte rakṣāṃ suvispaṣṭāṃ rakṣā lokasya dhāraṇam ॥42॥
slp1: tadrAjanrAjasiMhAnAM nAnyo DarmaH sanAtanaH । fte rakzAM suvispazwAM rakzA lokasya DAraRam ॥42॥

text: prācetasena manunā ślokau cemāvudāhṛtau । rājadharmeṣu rājendra tāvihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ॥43॥
html:
prācetasena manunā ślokau cemāvudāhṛtau ।
rājadharmeṣu rājendra tāvihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ॥43॥
slp1: prAcetasena manunA SlokO cemAvudAhftO । rAjaDarmezu rAjendra tAvihEkamanAH SfRu ॥43॥

text: ṣaḍetānpuruṣo jahyādbhinnāṃ nāvamivārṇave । apravaktāramācāryamanadhīyānamṛtvijam ॥44॥
html:
ṣaḍetānpuruṣo jahyādbhinnāṃ nāvamivārṇave ।
apravaktāramācāryamanadhīyānamṛtvijam ॥44॥
slp1: zaqetAnpuruzo jahyAdBinnAM nAvamivArRave । apravaktAramAcAryamanaDIyAnamftvijam ॥44॥

text: arakṣitāraṃ rājānaṃ bhāryāṃ cāpriyavādinīm । grāmakāmaṃ ca gopālaṃ vanakāmaṃ ca nāpitam] ॥45॥
html:
arakṣitāraṃ rājānaṃ bhāryāṃ cāpriyavādinīm ।
grāmakāmaṃ ca gopālaṃ vanakāmaṃ ca nāpitam] ॥45॥
slp1: arakzitAraM rAjAnaM BAryAM cApriyavAdinIm । grAmakAmaM ca gopAlaM vanakAmaM ca nApitam] ॥45॥

text: etatte rājadharmāṇāṃ navanītaṃ yudhiṣṭhira । bṛhaspatirhi bhagavānnānyaṃ dharmaṃ praśaṃsati ॥1॥
html:
etatte rājadharmāṇāṃ navanītaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
bṛhaspatirhi bhagavānnānyaṃ dharmaṃ praśaṃsati ॥1॥
slp1: etatte rAjaDarmARAM navanItaM yuDizWira । bfhaspatirhi BagavAnnAnyaM DarmaM praSaMsati ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: viśālākṣaśca bhagavānkāvyaścaiva mahātapāḥ । sahasrākṣo mahendraśca tathā prācetaso manuḥ ॥2॥
html:
viśālākṣaśca bhagavānkāvyaścaiva mahātapāḥ ।
sahasrākṣo mahendraśca tathā prācetaso manuḥ ॥2॥
slp1: viSAlAkzaSca BagavAnkAvyaScEva mahAtapAH । sahasrAkzo mahendraSca taTA prAcetaso manuH ॥2॥

text: bharadvājaśca bhagavāṃstathā gauraśirā muniḥ । rājaśāstrapraṇetāro brahmaṇyā brahmavādinaḥ ॥3॥
html:
bharadvājaśca bhagavāṃstathā gauraśirā muniḥ ।
rājaśāstrapraṇetāro brahmaṇyā brahmavādinaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: BaradvAjaSca BagavAMstaTA gOraSirA muniH । rAjaSAstrapraRetAro brahmaRyA brahmavAdinaH ॥3॥

text: rakṣāmeva praśaṃsanti dharmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ vara । rājñāṃ rājīvatāmrākṣa sādhanaṃ cātra vai śṛṇu ॥4॥
html:
rakṣāmeva praśaṃsanti dharmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ vara ।
rājñāṃ rājīvatāmrākṣa sādhanaṃ cātra vai śṛṇu ॥4॥
slp1: rakzAmeva praSaMsanti DarmaM DarmaBftAM vara । rAjYAM rAjIvatAmrAkza sADanaM cAtra vE SfRu ॥4॥

text: cāraśca praṇidhiścaiva kāle dānamamatsaraḥ । yuktyādānaṃ na cādānamayogena yudhiṣṭhira ॥5॥
html:
cāraśca praṇidhiścaiva kāle dānamamatsaraḥ ।
yuktyādānaṃ na cādānamayogena yudhiṣṭhira ॥5॥
slp1: cAraSca praRiDiScEva kAle dAnamamatsaraH । yuktyAdAnaM na cAdAnamayogena yuDizWira ॥5॥

text: satāṃ saṅgrahaṇaṃ śauryaṃ dākṣyaṃ satyaṃ prajāhitam । anārjavairārjavaiśca śatrupakṣasya bhedanam ॥6॥
html:
satāṃ saṅgrahaṇaṃ śauryaṃ dākṣyaṃ satyaṃ prajāhitam ।
anārjavairārjavaiśca śatrupakṣasya bhedanam ॥6॥
slp1: satAM saNgrahaRaM SOryaM dAkzyaM satyaM prajAhitam । anArjavErArjavESca Satrupakzasya Bedanam ॥6॥

text: sādhūnāmaparityāgaḥ kulīnānāṃ ca dhāraṇam । nicayaśca niceyānāṃ sevā buddhimatāmapi ॥7॥
html:
sādhūnāmaparityāgaḥ kulīnānāṃ ca dhāraṇam ।
nicayaśca niceyānāṃ sevā buddhimatāmapi ॥7॥
slp1: sADUnAmaparityAgaH kulInAnAM ca DAraRam । nicayaSca niceyAnAM sevA budDimatAmapi ॥7॥

text: balānāṃ harṣaṇaṃ nityaṃ prajānāmanvavekṣaṇam । kāryeṣvakhedaḥ kośasya tathaiva ca vivardhanam ॥8॥
html:
balānāṃ harṣaṇaṃ nityaṃ prajānāmanvavekṣaṇam ।
kāryeṣvakhedaḥ kośasya tathaiva ca vivardhanam ॥8॥
slp1: balAnAM harzaRaM nityaM prajAnAmanvavekzaRam । kAryezvaKedaH koSasya taTEva ca vivarDanam ॥8॥

text: puraguptiraviśvāsaḥ paurasaṅghātabhedanam । ketanānāṃ ca jīrṇānāmavekṣā caiva sīdatām ॥9॥
html:
puraguptiraviśvāsaḥ paurasaṅghātabhedanam ।
ketanānāṃ ca jīrṇānāmavekṣā caiva sīdatām ॥9॥
slp1: puraguptiraviSvAsaH pOrasaNGAtaBedanam । ketanAnAM ca jIrRAnAmavekzA cEva sIdatAm ॥9॥

text: dvividhasya ca daṇḍasya prayogaḥ kālacoditaḥ । arimadhyasthamitrāṇāṃ yathāvaccānvavekṣaṇam ॥10॥
html:
dvividhasya ca daṇḍasya prayogaḥ kālacoditaḥ ।
arimadhyasthamitrāṇāṃ yathāvaccānvavekṣaṇam ॥10॥
slp1: dviviDasya ca daRqasya prayogaH kAlacoditaH । arimaDyasTamitrARAM yaTAvaccAnvavekzaRam ॥10॥

text: upajāpaśca bhṛtyānāmātmanaḥ paradarśanāt । aviśvāsaḥ svayaṃ caiva parasyāśvāsanaṃ tathā ॥11॥
html:
upajāpaśca bhṛtyānāmātmanaḥ paradarśanāt ।
aviśvāsaḥ svayaṃ caiva parasyāśvāsanaṃ tathā ॥11॥
slp1: upajApaSca BftyAnAmAtmanaH paradarSanAt । aviSvAsaH svayaM cEva parasyASvAsanaM taTA ॥11॥

text: nītidharmānusaraṇaṃ nityamutthānameva ca । ripūṇāmanavajñānaṃ nityaṃ cānāryavarjanam ॥12॥
html:
nītidharmānusaraṇaṃ nityamutthānameva ca ।
ripūṇāmanavajñānaṃ nityaṃ cānāryavarjanam ॥12॥
slp1: nItiDarmAnusaraRaM nityamutTAnameva ca । ripURAmanavajYAnaM nityaM cAnAryavarjanam ॥12॥

text: utthānaṃ hi narendrāṇāṃ bṛhaspatirabhāṣata । rājadharmasya yanmūlaṃ ślokāṃścātra nibodha me ॥13॥
html:
utthānaṃ hi narendrāṇāṃ bṛhaspatirabhāṣata ।
rājadharmasya yanmūlaṃ ślokāṃścātra nibodha me ॥13॥
slp1: utTAnaM hi narendrARAM bfhaspatiraBAzata । rAjaDarmasya yanmUlaM SlokAMScAtra niboDa me ॥13॥

text: utthānenāmṛtaṃ labdhamutthānenāsurā hatāḥ । utthānena mahendreṇa śraiṣṭhyaṃ prāptaṃ divīha ca ॥14॥
html:
utthānenāmṛtaṃ labdhamutthānenāsurā hatāḥ ।
utthānena mahendreṇa śraiṣṭhyaṃ prāptaṃ divīha ca ॥14॥
slp1: utTAnenAmftaM labDamutTAnenAsurA hatAH । utTAnena mahendreRa SrEzWyaM prAptaM divIha ca ॥14॥

text: utthānadhīraḥ puruṣo vāgdhīrānadhitiṣṭhati । utthānadhīraṃ vāgdhīrā ramayanta upāsate ॥15॥
html:
utthānadhīraḥ puruṣo vāgdhīrānadhitiṣṭhati ।
utthānadhīraṃ vāgdhīrā ramayanta upāsate ॥15॥
slp1: utTAnaDIraH puruzo vAgDIrAnaDitizWati । utTAnaDIraM vAgDIrA ramayanta upAsate ॥15॥

text: utthānahīno rājā hi buddhimānapi nityaśaḥ । dharṣaṇīyo ripūṇāṃ syādbhujaṅga iva nirviṣaḥ ॥16॥
html:
utthānahīno rājā hi buddhimānapi nityaśaḥ ।
dharṣaṇīyo ripūṇāṃ syādbhujaṅga iva nirviṣaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: utTAnahIno rAjA hi budDimAnapi nityaSaH । DarzaRIyo ripURAM syAdBujaNga iva nirvizaH ॥16॥

text: na ca śatruravajñeyo durbalo'pi balīyasā । alpo'pi hi dahatyagnirviṣamalpaṃ hinasti ca ॥17॥
html:
na ca śatruravajñeyo durbalo'pi balīyasā ।
alpo'pi hi dahatyagnirviṣamalpaṃ hinasti ca ॥17॥
slp1: na ca SatruravajYeyo durbalo'pi balIyasA । alpo'pi hi dahatyagnirvizamalpaM hinasti ca ॥17॥

text: ekāśvenāpi sambhūtaḥ śatrurdurgasamāśritaḥ । taṃ taṃ tāpayate deśamapi rājñaḥ samṛddhinaḥ ॥18॥
html:
ekāśvenāpi sambhūtaḥ śatrurdurgasamāśritaḥ ।
taṃ taṃ tāpayate deśamapi rājñaḥ samṛddhinaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: ekASvenApi samBUtaH SatrurdurgasamASritaH । taM taM tApayate deSamapi rAjYaH samfdDinaH ॥18॥

text: rājño rahasyaṃ yadvākyaṃ jayārthaṃ lokasaṅgrahaḥ । hṛdi yaccāsya jihmaṃ syātkāraṇārthaṃ ca yadbhavet ॥19॥
html:
rājño rahasyaṃ yadvākyaṃ jayārthaṃ lokasaṅgrahaḥ ।
hṛdi yaccāsya jihmaṃ syātkāraṇārthaṃ ca yadbhavet ॥19॥
slp1: rAjYo rahasyaM yadvAkyaM jayArTaM lokasaNgrahaH । hfdi yaccAsya jihmaM syAtkAraRArTaM ca yadBavet ॥19॥

text: yaccāsya kāryaṃ vṛjinamārjavenaiva dhāryate । dambhanārthāya lokasya dharmiṣṭhāmācaretkriyām ॥20॥
html:
yaccāsya kāryaṃ vṛjinamārjavenaiva dhāryate ।
dambhanārthāya lokasya dharmiṣṭhāmācaretkriyām ॥20॥
slp1: yaccAsya kAryaM vfjinamArjavenEva DAryate । damBanArTAya lokasya DarmizWAmAcaretkriyAm ॥20॥

text: rājyaṃ hi sumahattantraṃ durdhāryamakṛtātmabhiḥ । na śakyaṃ mṛdunā voḍhumāghātasthānamuttamam ॥21॥
html:
rājyaṃ hi sumahattantraṃ durdhāryamakṛtātmabhiḥ ।
na śakyaṃ mṛdunā voḍhumāghātasthānamuttamam ॥21॥
slp1: rAjyaM hi sumahattantraM durDAryamakftAtmaBiH । na SakyaM mfdunA voQumAGAtasTAnamuttamam ॥21॥

text: rājyaṃ sarvāmiṣaṃ nityamārjaveneha dhāryate । tasmānmiśreṇa satataṃ vartitavyaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥22॥
html:
rājyaṃ sarvāmiṣaṃ nityamārjaveneha dhāryate ।
tasmānmiśreṇa satataṃ vartitavyaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥22॥
slp1: rAjyaM sarvAmizaM nityamArjaveneha DAryate । tasmAnmiSreRa satataM vartitavyaM yuDizWira ॥22॥

text: yadyapyasya vipattiḥ syādrakṣamāṇasya vai prajāḥ । so'pyasya vipulo dharma evaṃvṛttā hi bhūmipāḥ ॥23॥
html:
yadyapyasya vipattiḥ syādrakṣamāṇasya vai prajāḥ ।
so'pyasya vipulo dharma evaṃvṛttā hi bhūmipāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: yadyapyasya vipattiH syAdrakzamARasya vE prajAH । so'pyasya vipulo Darma evaMvfttA hi BUmipAH ॥23॥

text: eṣa te rājadharmāṇāṃ leśaḥ samanuvarṇitaḥ । bhūyaste yatra sandehastadbrūhi vadatāṃ vara ॥24॥
html:
eṣa te rājadharmāṇāṃ leśaḥ samanuvarṇitaḥ ।
bhūyaste yatra sandehastadbrūhi vadatāṃ vara ॥24॥
slp1: eza te rAjaDarmARAM leSaH samanuvarRitaH । BUyaste yatra sandehastadbrUhi vadatAM vara ॥24॥

text: tato vyāsaśca bhagavāndevasthāno'śmanā saha । vāsudevaḥ kṛpaścaiva sātyakiḥ sañjayastathā ॥25॥
html:
tato vyāsaśca bhagavāndevasthāno'śmanā saha ।
vāsudevaḥ kṛpaścaiva sātyakiḥ sañjayastathā ॥25॥
slp1: tato vyAsaSca BagavAndevasTAno'SmanA saha । vAsudevaH kfpaScEva sAtyakiH saYjayastaTA ॥25॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: sādhu sādhviti saṃhṛṣṭāḥ puṣyamāṇairivānanaiḥ । astuvaṃste naravyāghraṃ bhīṣmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ varam ॥26॥
html:
sādhu sādhviti saṃhṛṣṭāḥ puṣyamāṇairivānanaiḥ ।
astuvaṃste naravyāghraṃ bhīṣmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ varam ॥26॥
slp1: sADu sADviti saMhfzwAH puzyamARErivAnanEH । astuvaMste naravyAGraM BIzmaM DarmaBftAM varam ॥26॥

text: tato dīnamanā bhīṣmamuvāca kurusattamaḥ । netrābhyāmaśrupūrṇābhyāṃ pādau tasya śanaiḥ spṛśan ॥27॥
html:
tato dīnamanā bhīṣmamuvāca kurusattamaḥ ।
netrābhyāmaśrupūrṇābhyāṃ pādau tasya śanaiḥ spṛśan ॥27॥
slp1: tato dInamanA BIzmamuvAca kurusattamaH । netrAByAmaSrupUrRAByAM pAdO tasya SanEH spfSan ॥27॥

text: śva idānīṃ svasandehaṃ prakṣyāmi tvaṃ pitāmaha । upaiti savitāpyastaṃ rasamāpīya pārthivam ॥28॥
html:
śva idānīṃ svasandehaṃ prakṣyāmi tvaṃ pitāmaha ।
upaiti savitāpyastaṃ rasamāpīya pārthivam ॥28॥
slp1: Sva idAnIM svasandehaM prakzyAmi tvaM pitAmaha । upEti savitApyastaM rasamApIya pArTivam ॥28॥

text: tato dvijātīnabhivādya keśavaḥ kṛpaśca te caiva yudhiṣṭhirādayaḥ । pradakṣiṇīkṛtya mahānadīsutaṃ tato rathānāruruhurmudā yutāḥ ॥29॥
html:
tato dvijātīnabhivādya keśavaḥ kṛpaśca te caiva yudhiṣṭhirādayaḥ ।
pradakṣiṇīkṛtya mahānadīsutaṃ tato rathānāruruhurmudā yutāḥ ॥29॥
slp1: tato dvijAtInaBivAdya keSavaH kfpaSca te cEva yuDizWirAdayaH । pradakziRIkftya mahAnadIsutaM tato raTAnAruruhurmudA yutAH ॥29॥

text: dṛṣadvatīṃ cāpyavagāhya suvratāḥ kṛtodakāryāḥ kṛtajapyamaṅgalāḥ । upāsya sandhyāṃ vidhivatparantapāstataḥ puraṃ te viviśurgajāhvayam] ॥30॥
html:
dṛṣadvatīṃ cāpyavagāhya suvratāḥ kṛtodakāryāḥ kṛtajapyamaṅgalāḥ ।
upāsya sandhyāṃ vidhivatparantapāstataḥ puraṃ te viviśurgajāhvayam] ॥30॥
slp1: dfzadvatIM cApyavagAhya suvratAH kftodakAryAH kftajapyamaNgalAH । upAsya sanDyAM viDivatparantapAstataH puraM te viviSurgajAhvayam] ॥30॥

text: tataḥ kālyaṃ samutthāya kṛtapaurvāhṇikakriyāḥ । yayuste nagarākārai rathaiḥ pāṇḍavayādavāḥ ॥1॥
html:
tataḥ kālyaṃ samutthāya kṛtapaurvāhṇikakriyāḥ ।
yayuste nagarākārai rathaiḥ pāṇḍavayādavāḥ ॥1॥
slp1: tataH kAlyaM samutTAya kftapOrvAhRikakriyAH । yayuste nagarAkArE raTEH pARqavayAdavAH ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: prapadya ca kurukṣetraṃ bhīṣmamāsādya cānagham । sukhāṃ ca rajanīṃ pṛṣṭvā gāṅgeyaṃ rathināṃ varam ॥2॥
html:
prapadya ca kurukṣetraṃ bhīṣmamāsādya cānagham ।
sukhāṃ ca rajanīṃ pṛṣṭvā gāṅgeyaṃ rathināṃ varam ॥2॥
slp1: prapadya ca kurukzetraM BIzmamAsAdya cAnaGam । suKAM ca rajanIM pfzwvA gANgeyaM raTinAM varam ॥2॥

text: vyāsādīnabhivādyarṣīnsarvaistaiścābhinanditāḥ । niṣedurabhito bhīṣmaṃ parivārya samantataḥ ॥3॥
html:
vyāsādīnabhivādyarṣīnsarvaistaiścābhinanditāḥ ।
niṣedurabhito bhīṣmaṃ parivārya samantataḥ ॥3॥
slp1: vyAsAdInaBivAdyarzInsarvEstEScABinanditAH । nizeduraBito BIzmaM parivArya samantataH ॥3॥

text: tato rājā mahātejā dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । abravītprāñjalirbhīṣmaṃ pratipūjyābhivādya ca ॥4॥
html:
tato rājā mahātejā dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।
abravītprāñjalirbhīṣmaṃ pratipūjyābhivādya ca ॥4॥
slp1: tato rAjA mahAtejA DarmarAjo yuDizWiraH । abravItprAYjalirBIzmaM pratipUjyABivAdya ca ॥4॥

text: ya eṣa rājā-rājeti śabdaścarati bhārata । kathameṣa samutpannastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥5॥
html:
ya eṣa rājā-rājeti śabdaścarati bhārata ।
kathameṣa samutpannastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥5॥
slp1: ya eza rAjA-rAjeti SabdaScarati BArata । kaTameza samutpannastanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥5॥

text: tulyapāṇiśirogrīvastulyabuddhīndriyātmakaḥ । tulyaduḥkhasukhātmā ca tulyapṛṣṭhabhujodaraḥ ॥6॥
html:
tulyapāṇiśirogrīvastulyabuddhīndriyātmakaḥ ।
tulyaduḥkhasukhātmā ca tulyapṛṣṭhabhujodaraḥ ॥6॥
slp1: tulyapARiSirogrIvastulyabudDIndriyAtmakaH । tulyaduHKasuKAtmA ca tulyapfzWaBujodaraH ॥6॥

text: tulyaśukrāsthimajjaśca tulyamāṃsāsṛgeva ca । niḥśvāsocchvāsatulyaśca tulyaprāṇaśarīravān ॥7॥
html:
tulyaśukrāsthimajjaśca tulyamāṃsāsṛgeva ca ।
niḥśvāsocchvāsatulyaśca tulyaprāṇaśarīravān ॥7॥
slp1: tulyaSukrAsTimajjaSca tulyamAMsAsfgeva ca । niHSvAsocCvAsatulyaSca tulyaprARaSarIravAn ॥7॥

text: samānajanmamaraṇaḥ samaḥ sarvaguṇairnṛṇām । viśiṣṭabuddhīñśūrāṃśca kathameko'dhitiṣṭhati ॥8॥
html:
samānajanmamaraṇaḥ samaḥ sarvaguṇairnṛṇām ।
viśiṣṭabuddhīñśūrāṃśca kathameko'dhitiṣṭhati ॥8॥
slp1: samAnajanmamaraRaH samaH sarvaguRErnfRAm । viSizwabudDIYSUrAMSca kaTameko'DitizWati ॥8॥

text: kathameko mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ vīraśūrāryasaṅkulām । rakṣatyapi ca loko'sya prasādamabhivāñchati ॥9॥
html:
kathameko mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ vīraśūrāryasaṅkulām ।
rakṣatyapi ca loko'sya prasādamabhivāñchati ॥9॥
slp1: kaTameko mahIM kftsnAM vIraSUrAryasaNkulAm । rakzatyapi ca loko'sya prasAdamaBivAYCati ॥9॥

text: ekasya ca prasādena kṛtsno lokaḥ prasīdati । vyākulenākulaḥ sarvo bhavatīti viniścayaḥ ॥10॥
html:
ekasya ca prasādena kṛtsno lokaḥ prasīdati ।
vyākulenākulaḥ sarvo bhavatīti viniścayaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: ekasya ca prasAdena kftsno lokaH prasIdati । vyAkulenAkulaH sarvo BavatIti viniScayaH ॥10॥

text: etadicchāmyahaṃ sarvaṃ tattvena bharatarṣabha । śrotuṃ tanme yathātattvaṃ prabrūhi vadatāṃ vara ॥11॥
html:
etadicchāmyahaṃ sarvaṃ tattvena bharatarṣabha ।
śrotuṃ tanme yathātattvaṃ prabrūhi vadatāṃ vara ॥11॥
slp1: etadicCAmyahaM sarvaM tattvena BaratarzaBa । SrotuM tanme yaTAtattvaM prabrUhi vadatAM vara ॥11॥

text: naitatkāraṇamalpaṃ hi bhaviṣyati viśāmpate । yadekasmiñjagatsarvaṃ devavadyāti sannatim ॥12॥
html:
naitatkāraṇamalpaṃ hi bhaviṣyati viśāmpate ।
yadekasmiñjagatsarvaṃ devavadyāti sannatim ॥12॥
slp1: nEtatkAraRamalpaM hi Bavizyati viSAmpate । yadekasmiYjagatsarvaM devavadyAti sannatim ॥12॥

text: niyatastvaṃ naraśreṣṭha śṛṇu sarvamaśeṣataḥ । yathā rājyaṃ samutpannamādau kṛtayuge'bhavat ॥13॥
html:
niyatastvaṃ naraśreṣṭha śṛṇu sarvamaśeṣataḥ ।
yathā rājyaṃ samutpannamādau kṛtayuge'bhavat ॥13॥
slp1: niyatastvaM naraSrezWa SfRu sarvamaSezataH । yaTA rAjyaM samutpannamAdO kftayuge'Bavat ॥13॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: naiva rājyaṃ na rājāsīnna daṇḍo na ca dāṇḍikaḥ । dharmeṇaiva prajāḥ sarvā rakṣanti ca parasparam ॥14॥
html:
naiva rājyaṃ na rājāsīnna daṇḍo na ca dāṇḍikaḥ ।
dharmeṇaiva prajāḥ sarvā rakṣanti ca parasparam ॥14॥
slp1: nEva rAjyaM na rAjAsInna daRqo na ca dARqikaH । DarmeREva prajAH sarvA rakzanti ca parasparam ॥14॥

text: pālayānāstathānyonyaṃ narā dharmeṇa bhārata । khedaṃ paramamājagmustatastānmoha āviśat ॥15॥
html:
pālayānāstathānyonyaṃ narā dharmeṇa bhārata ।
khedaṃ paramamājagmustatastānmoha āviśat ॥15॥
slp1: pAlayAnAstaTAnyonyaM narA DarmeRa BArata । KedaM paramamAjagmustatastAnmoha AviSat ॥15॥

text: te mohavaśamāpannā mānavā manujarṣabha । pratipattivimohācca dharmasteṣāmanīnaśat ॥16॥
html:
te mohavaśamāpannā mānavā manujarṣabha ।
pratipattivimohācca dharmasteṣāmanīnaśat ॥16॥
slp1: te mohavaSamApannA mAnavA manujarzaBa । pratipattivimohAcca DarmastezAmanInaSat ॥16॥

text: naṣṭāyāṃ pratipattau tu mohavaśyā narāstadā । lobhasya vaśamāpannāḥ sarve bhāratasattama ॥17॥
html:
naṣṭāyāṃ pratipattau tu mohavaśyā narāstadā ।
lobhasya vaśamāpannāḥ sarve bhāratasattama ॥17॥
slp1: nazwAyAM pratipattO tu mohavaSyA narAstadA । loBasya vaSamApannAH sarve BAratasattama ॥17॥

text: aprāptasyābhimarśaṃ tu kurvanto manujāstataḥ । kāmo nāmāparastatra samapadyata vai prabho ॥18॥
html:
aprāptasyābhimarśaṃ tu kurvanto manujāstataḥ ।
kāmo nāmāparastatra samapadyata vai prabho ॥18॥
slp1: aprAptasyABimarSaM tu kurvanto manujAstataH । kAmo nAmAparastatra samapadyata vE praBo ॥18॥

text: tāṃstu kāmavaśaṃ prāptānrāgo nāma samaspṛśat । raktāśca nābhyajānanta kāryākāryaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥19॥
html:
tāṃstu kāmavaśaṃ prāptānrāgo nāma samaspṛśat ।
raktāśca nābhyajānanta kāryākāryaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥19॥
slp1: tAMstu kAmavaSaM prAptAnrAgo nAma samaspfSat । raktASca nAByajAnanta kAryAkAryaM yuDizWira ॥19॥

text: agamyāgamanaṃ caiva vācyāvācyaṃ tathaiva ca । bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ ca rājendra doṣādoṣaṃ ca nātyajan ॥20॥
html:
agamyāgamanaṃ caiva vācyāvācyaṃ tathaiva ca ।
bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ ca rājendra doṣādoṣaṃ ca nātyajan ॥20॥
slp1: agamyAgamanaM cEva vAcyAvAcyaM taTEva ca । BakzyABakzyaM ca rAjendra dozAdozaM ca nAtyajan ॥20॥

text: viplute naraloke'smiṃstato brahma nanāśa ha । nāśācca brahmaṇo rājandharmo nāśamathāgamat ॥21॥
html:
viplute naraloke'smiṃstato brahma nanāśa ha ।
nāśācca brahmaṇo rājandharmo nāśamathāgamat ॥21॥
slp1: viplute naraloke'smiMstato brahma nanASa ha । nASAcca brahmaRo rAjanDarmo nASamaTAgamat ॥21॥

text: naṣṭe brahmaṇi dharme ca devāstrāsamathāgaman । te trastā naraśārdūla brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ॥22॥
html:
naṣṭe brahmaṇi dharme ca devāstrāsamathāgaman ।
te trastā naraśārdūla brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ॥22॥
slp1: nazwe brahmaRi Darme ca devAstrAsamaTAgaman । te trastA naraSArdUla brahmARaM SaraRaM yayuH ॥22॥

text: prapadya bhagavantaṃ te devā lokapitāmaham । ūcuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve duḥkhaśokabhayārditāḥ ॥23॥
html:
prapadya bhagavantaṃ te devā lokapitāmaham ।
ūcuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve duḥkhaśokabhayārditāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: prapadya BagavantaM te devA lokapitAmaham । UcuH prAYjalayaH sarve duHKaSokaBayArditAH ॥23॥

text: bhagavannaralokasthaṃ naṣṭaṃ brahma sanātanam । lobhamohādibhirbhāvaistato no bhayamāviśat ॥24॥
html:
bhagavannaralokasthaṃ naṣṭaṃ brahma sanātanam ।
lobhamohādibhirbhāvaistato no bhayamāviśat ॥24॥
slp1: BagavannaralokasTaM nazwaM brahma sanAtanam । loBamohAdiBirBAvEstato no BayamAviSat ॥24॥

text: brahmaṇaśca praṇāśena dharmo'pyanaśadīśvara । tataḥ sma samatāṃ yātā martyaistribhuvaneśvara ॥25॥
html:
brahmaṇaśca praṇāśena dharmo'pyanaśadīśvara ।
tataḥ sma samatāṃ yātā martyaistribhuvaneśvara ॥25॥
slp1: brahmaRaSca praRASena Darmo'pyanaSadISvara । tataH sma samatAM yAtA martyEstriBuvaneSvara ॥25॥

text: adho hi varṣamasmākaṃ martyāstūrdhvapravarṣiṇaḥ । kriyāvyuparamātteṣāṃ tato'gacchāma saṃśayam ॥26॥
html:
adho hi varṣamasmākaṃ martyāstūrdhvapravarṣiṇaḥ ।
kriyāvyuparamātteṣāṃ tato'gacchāma saṃśayam ॥26॥
slp1: aDo hi varzamasmAkaM martyAstUrDvapravarziRaH । kriyAvyuparamAttezAM tato'gacCAma saMSayam ॥26॥

text: atra niḥśreyasaṃ yannastaddhyāyasva pitāmaha । tvatprabhāvasamuttho'sau prabhāvo no vinaśyati ॥27॥
html:
atra niḥśreyasaṃ yannastaddhyāyasva pitāmaha ।
tvatprabhāvasamuttho'sau prabhāvo no vinaśyati ॥27॥
slp1: atra niHSreyasaM yannastadDyAyasva pitAmaha । tvatpraBAvasamutTo'sO praBAvo no vinaSyati ॥27॥

text: tānuvāca surānsarvānsvayaṃbhūrbhagavāṃstataḥ । śreyo'haṃ cintayiṣyāmi vyetu vo bhīḥ surarṣabhāḥ ॥28॥
html:
tānuvāca surānsarvānsvayaṃbhūrbhagavāṃstataḥ ।
śreyo'haṃ cintayiṣyāmi vyetu vo bhīḥ surarṣabhāḥ ॥28॥
slp1: tAnuvAca surAnsarvAnsvayaMBUrBagavAMstataH । Sreyo'haM cintayizyAmi vyetu vo BIH surarzaBAH ॥28॥

text: tato'dhyāyasahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ cakre svabuddhijam । yatra dharmastathaivārthaḥ kāmaścaivānuvarṇitaḥ ॥29॥
html:
tato'dhyāyasahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ cakre svabuddhijam ।
yatra dharmastathaivārthaḥ kāmaścaivānuvarṇitaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: tato'DyAyasahasrARAM SataM cakre svabudDijam । yatra DarmastaTEvArTaH kAmaScEvAnuvarRitaH ॥29॥

text: trivarga iti vikhyāto gaṇa eṣa svayambhuvā । caturtho mokṣa ityeva pṛthagarthaḥ pṛthaggaṇaḥ ॥30॥
html:
trivarga iti vikhyāto gaṇa eṣa svayambhuvā ।
caturtho mokṣa ityeva pṛthagarthaḥ pṛthaggaṇaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: trivarga iti viKyAto gaRa eza svayamBuvA । caturTo mokza ityeva pfTagarTaH pfTaggaRaH ॥30॥

text: mokṣasyāpi trivargo'nyaḥ proktaḥ sattvaṃ rajastamaḥ । sthānaṃ vṛddhiḥ kṣayaścaiva trivargaścaiva daṇḍajaḥ ॥31॥
html:
mokṣasyāpi trivargo'nyaḥ proktaḥ sattvaṃ rajastamaḥ ।
sthānaṃ vṛddhiḥ kṣayaścaiva trivargaścaiva daṇḍajaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: mokzasyApi trivargo'nyaH proktaH sattvaM rajastamaH । sTAnaM vfdDiH kzayaScEva trivargaScEva daRqajaH ॥31॥

text: ātmā deśaśca kālaścāpyupāyāḥ kṛtyameva ca । sahāyāḥ kāraṇaṃ caiva ṣaḍvargo nītijaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥32॥
html:
ātmā deśaśca kālaścāpyupāyāḥ kṛtyameva ca ।
sahāyāḥ kāraṇaṃ caiva ṣaḍvargo nītijaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: AtmA deSaSca kAlaScApyupAyAH kftyameva ca । sahAyAH kAraRaM cEva zaqvargo nItijaH smftaH ॥32॥

text: trayī cānvīkṣikī caiva vārtā ca bharatarṣabha । daṇḍanītiśca vipulā vidyāstatra nidarśitāḥ ॥33॥
html:
trayī cānvīkṣikī caiva vārtā ca bharatarṣabha ।
daṇḍanītiśca vipulā vidyāstatra nidarśitāḥ ॥33॥
slp1: trayI cAnvIkzikI cEva vArtA ca BaratarzaBa । daRqanItiSca vipulA vidyAstatra nidarSitAH ॥33॥

text: amātyarakṣāpraṇidhī rājaputrasya rakṣaṇam । cāraśca vividhopāyaḥ praṇidhiśca pṛthagvidhaḥ ॥34॥
html:
amātyarakṣāpraṇidhī rājaputrasya rakṣaṇam ।
cāraśca vividhopāyaḥ praṇidhiśca pṛthagvidhaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: amAtyarakzApraRiDI rAjaputrasya rakzaRam । cAraSca viviDopAyaH praRiDiSca pfTagviDaH ॥34॥

text: sāma copapradānaṃ ca bhedo daṇḍaśca pāṇḍava । upekṣā pañcamī cātra kārtsnyena samudāhṛtā ॥35॥
html:
sāma copapradānaṃ ca bhedo daṇḍaśca pāṇḍava ।
upekṣā pañcamī cātra kārtsnyena samudāhṛtā ॥35॥
slp1: sAma copapradAnaM ca Bedo daRqaSca pARqava । upekzA paYcamI cAtra kArtsnyena samudAhftA ॥35॥

text: mantraśca varṇitaḥ kṛtsnastathā bhedārtha eva ca । vibhraṃśaścaiva mantrasya siddhyasiddhyośca yatphalam ॥36॥
html:
mantraśca varṇitaḥ kṛtsnastathā bhedārtha eva ca ।
vibhraṃśaścaiva mantrasya siddhyasiddhyośca yatphalam ॥36॥
slp1: mantraSca varRitaH kftsnastaTA BedArTa eva ca । viBraMSaScEva mantrasya sidDyasidDyoSca yatPalam ॥36॥

text: sandhiśca vividhābhikhyo hīno madhyastathottamaḥ । bhayasatkāravittākhyaḥ kārtsnyena parivarṇitaḥ ॥37॥
html:
sandhiśca vividhābhikhyo hīno madhyastathottamaḥ ।
bhayasatkāravittākhyaḥ kārtsnyena parivarṇitaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: sanDiSca viviDABiKyo hIno maDyastaTottamaH । BayasatkAravittAKyaH kArtsnyena parivarRitaH ॥37॥

text: yātrākālāśca catvārastrivargasya ca vistaraḥ । vijayo dharmayuktaśca tathārthavijayaśca ha ॥38॥
html:
yātrākālāśca catvārastrivargasya ca vistaraḥ ।
vijayo dharmayuktaśca tathārthavijayaśca ha ॥38॥
slp1: yAtrAkAlASca catvArastrivargasya ca vistaraH । vijayo DarmayuktaSca taTArTavijayaSca ha ॥38॥

text: āsuraścaiva vijayastathā kārtsnyena varṇitaḥ । lakṣaṇaṃ pañcavargasya trividhaṃ cātra varṇitam ॥39॥
html:
āsuraścaiva vijayastathā kārtsnyena varṇitaḥ ।
lakṣaṇaṃ pañcavargasya trividhaṃ cātra varṇitam ॥39॥
slp1: AsuraScEva vijayastaTA kArtsnyena varRitaH । lakzaRaM paYcavargasya triviDaM cAtra varRitam ॥39॥

text: prakāśaścāprakāśaśca daṇḍo'tha pariśabditaḥ । prakāśo'ṣṭavidhastatra guhyastu bahuvistaraḥ ॥40॥
html:
prakāśaścāprakāśaśca daṇḍo'tha pariśabditaḥ ।
prakāśo'ṣṭavidhastatra guhyastu bahuvistaraḥ ॥40॥
slp1: prakASaScAprakASaSca daRqo'Ta pariSabditaH । prakASo'zwaviDastatra guhyastu bahuvistaraH ॥40॥

text: rathā nāgā hayāścaiva pādātāścaiva pāṇḍava । viṣṭirnāvaścarāścaiva deśikāḥ pathi cāṣṭakam ॥41॥
html:
rathā nāgā hayāścaiva pādātāścaiva pāṇḍava ।
viṣṭirnāvaścarāścaiva deśikāḥ pathi cāṣṭakam ॥41॥
slp1: raTA nAgA hayAScEva pAdAtAScEva pARqava । vizwirnAvaScarAScEva deSikAH paTi cAzwakam ॥41॥

text: aṅgānyetāni kauravya prakāśāni balasya tu । jaṅgamājaṅgamāścoktāścūrṇayogā viṣādayaḥ ॥42॥
html:
aṅgānyetāni kauravya prakāśāni balasya tu ।
jaṅgamājaṅgamāścoktāścūrṇayogā viṣādayaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: aNgAnyetAni kOravya prakASAni balasya tu । jaNgamAjaNgamAScoktAScUrRayogA vizAdayaH ॥42॥

text: sparśe cābhyavahārye cāpyupāṃśurvividhaḥ smṛtaḥ । arirmitramudāsīna ityete'pyanuvarṇitāḥ ॥43॥
html:
sparśe cābhyavahārye cāpyupāṃśurvividhaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
arirmitramudāsīna ityete'pyanuvarṇitāḥ ॥43॥
slp1: sparSe cAByavahArye cApyupAMSurviviDaH smftaH । arirmitramudAsIna ityete'pyanuvarRitAH ॥43॥

text: kṛtsnā mārgaguṇāścaiva tathā bhūmiguṇāśca ha । ātmarakṣaṇamāśvāsaḥ spaśānāṃ cānvavekṣaṇam ॥44॥
html:
kṛtsnā mārgaguṇāścaiva tathā bhūmiguṇāśca ha ।
ātmarakṣaṇamāśvāsaḥ spaśānāṃ cānvavekṣaṇam ॥44॥
slp1: kftsnA mArgaguRAScEva taTA BUmiguRASca ha । AtmarakzaRamASvAsaH spaSAnAM cAnvavekzaRam ॥44॥

text: kalpanā vividhāścāpi nṛnāgarathavājinām । vyūhāśca vividhābhikhyā vicitraṃ yuddhakauśalam ॥45॥
html:
kalpanā vividhāścāpi nṛnāgarathavājinām ।
vyūhāśca vividhābhikhyā vicitraṃ yuddhakauśalam ॥45॥
slp1: kalpanA viviDAScApi nfnAgaraTavAjinAm । vyUhASca viviDABiKyA vicitraM yudDakOSalam ॥45॥

text: utpātāśca nipātāśca suyuddhaṃ supalāyanam । śastrāṇāṃ pāyanajñānaṃ tathaiva bharatarṣabha ॥46॥
html:
utpātāśca nipātāśca suyuddhaṃ supalāyanam ।
śastrāṇāṃ pāyanajñānaṃ tathaiva bharatarṣabha ॥46॥
slp1: utpAtASca nipAtASca suyudDaM supalAyanam । SastrARAM pAyanajYAnaM taTEva BaratarzaBa ॥46॥

text: balavyasanamuktaṃ ca tathaiva balaharṣaṇam । pīḍanāskandakālaśca bhayakālaśca pāṇḍava ॥47॥
html:
balavyasanamuktaṃ ca tathaiva balaharṣaṇam ।
pīḍanāskandakālaśca bhayakālaśca pāṇḍava ॥47॥
slp1: balavyasanamuktaM ca taTEva balaharzaRam । pIqanAskandakAlaSca BayakAlaSca pARqava ॥47॥

text: tathā khātavidhānaṃ ca yogasañcāra eva ca । caurāṭavyabalaiścograiḥ pararāṣṭrasya pīḍanam ॥48॥
html:
tathā khātavidhānaṃ ca yogasañcāra eva ca ।
caurāṭavyabalaiścograiḥ pararāṣṭrasya pīḍanam ॥48॥
slp1: taTA KAtaviDAnaM ca yogasaYcAra eva ca । cOrAwavyabalEScogrEH pararAzwrasya pIqanam ॥48॥

text: agnidairgaradaiścaiva pratirūpakacārakaiḥ । śreṇimukhyopajāpena vīrudhaśchedanena ca ॥49॥
html:
agnidairgaradaiścaiva pratirūpakacārakaiḥ ।
śreṇimukhyopajāpena vīrudhaśchedanena ca ॥49॥
slp1: agnidErgaradEScEva pratirUpakacArakEH । SreRimuKyopajApena vIruDaSCedanena ca ॥49॥

text: dūṣaṇena ca nāgānāmāśaṅkājananena ca । ārodhanena bhaktasya pathaścopārjanena ca ॥50॥
html:
dūṣaṇena ca nāgānāmāśaṅkājananena ca ।
ārodhanena bhaktasya pathaścopārjanena ca ॥50॥
slp1: dUzaRena ca nAgAnAmASaNkAjananena ca । AroDanena Baktasya paTaScopArjanena ca ॥50॥

text: saptāṅgasya ca rājyasya hrāsavṛddhisamañjasam । dūtasāmarthyayogaśca rāṣṭrasya ca vivardhanam ॥51॥
html:
saptāṅgasya ca rājyasya hrāsavṛddhisamañjasam ।
dūtasāmarthyayogaśca rāṣṭrasya ca vivardhanam ॥51॥
slp1: saptANgasya ca rAjyasya hrAsavfdDisamaYjasam । dUtasAmarTyayogaSca rAzwrasya ca vivarDanam ॥51॥

text: arimadhyasthamitrāṇāṃ samyakcoktaṃ prapañcanam । avamardaḥ pratīghātastathaiva ca balīyasām ॥52॥
html:
arimadhyasthamitrāṇāṃ samyakcoktaṃ prapañcanam ।
avamardaḥ pratīghātastathaiva ca balīyasām ॥52॥
slp1: arimaDyasTamitrARAM samyakcoktaM prapaYcanam । avamardaH pratIGAtastaTEva ca balIyasAm ॥52॥

text: vyavahāraḥ susūkṣmaśca tathā kaṇṭakaśodhanam । śamo vyāyāmayogaśca yogo dravyasya sañcayaḥ ॥53॥
html:
vyavahāraḥ susūkṣmaśca tathā kaṇṭakaśodhanam ।
śamo vyāyāmayogaśca yogo dravyasya sañcayaḥ ॥53॥
slp1: vyavahAraH susUkzmaSca taTA kaRwakaSoDanam । Samo vyAyAmayogaSca yogo dravyasya saYcayaH ॥53॥

text: abhṛtānāṃ ca bharaṇaṃ bhṛtānāṃ cānvavekṣaṇam । arthakāle pradānaṃ ca vyasaneṣvaprasaṅgitā ॥54॥
html:
abhṛtānāṃ ca bharaṇaṃ bhṛtānāṃ cānvavekṣaṇam ।
arthakāle pradānaṃ ca vyasaneṣvaprasaṅgitā ॥54॥
slp1: aBftAnAM ca BaraRaM BftAnAM cAnvavekzaRam । arTakAle pradAnaM ca vyasanezvaprasaNgitA ॥54॥

text: tathā rājaguṇāścaiva senāpatiguṇāśca ye । kāraṇasya ca kartuśca guṇadoṣāstathaiva ca ॥55॥
html:
tathā rājaguṇāścaiva senāpatiguṇāśca ye ।
kāraṇasya ca kartuśca guṇadoṣāstathaiva ca ॥55॥
slp1: taTA rAjaguRAScEva senApatiguRASca ye । kAraRasya ca kartuSca guRadozAstaTEva ca ॥55॥

text: duṣṭeṅgitaṃ ca vividhaṃ vṛttiścaivānujīvinām । śaṅkitatvaṃ ca sarvasya pramādasya ca varjanam ॥56॥
html:
duṣṭeṅgitaṃ ca vividhaṃ vṛttiścaivānujīvinām ।
śaṅkitatvaṃ ca sarvasya pramādasya ca varjanam ॥56॥
slp1: duzweNgitaM ca viviDaM vfttiScEvAnujIvinAm । SaNkitatvaM ca sarvasya pramAdasya ca varjanam ॥56॥

text: alabdhalipsā labdhasya tathaiva ca vivardhanam । pradānaṃ ca vivṛddhasya pātrebhyo vidhivattathā ॥57॥
html:
alabdhalipsā labdhasya tathaiva ca vivardhanam ।
pradānaṃ ca vivṛddhasya pātrebhyo vidhivattathā ॥57॥
slp1: alabDalipsA labDasya taTEva ca vivarDanam । pradAnaM ca vivfdDasya pAtreByo viDivattaTA ॥57॥

text: visargo'rthasya dharmārthamarthārthaṃ kāmahetunā । caturtho vyasanāghāte tathaivātrānuvarṇitaḥ ॥58॥
html:
visargo'rthasya dharmārthamarthārthaṃ kāmahetunā ।
caturtho vyasanāghāte tathaivātrānuvarṇitaḥ ॥58॥
slp1: visargo'rTasya DarmArTamarTArTaM kAmahetunA । caturTo vyasanAGAte taTEvAtrAnuvarRitaH ॥58॥

text: krodhajāni tathogrāṇi kāmajāni tathaiva ca । daśoktāni kuruśreṣṭha vyasanānyatra caiva ha ॥59॥
html:
krodhajāni tathogrāṇi kāmajāni tathaiva ca ।
daśoktāni kuruśreṣṭha vyasanānyatra caiva ha ॥59॥
slp1: kroDajAni taTogrARi kAmajAni taTEva ca । daSoktAni kuruSrezWa vyasanAnyatra cEva ha ॥59॥

text: mṛgayākṣāstathā pānaṃ striyaśca bharatarṣabha । kāmajānyāhurācāryāḥ proktānīha svayaṃbhuvā ॥60॥
html:
mṛgayākṣāstathā pānaṃ striyaśca bharatarṣabha ।
kāmajānyāhurācāryāḥ proktānīha svayaṃbhuvā ॥60॥
slp1: mfgayAkzAstaTA pAnaM striyaSca BaratarzaBa । kAmajAnyAhurAcAryAH proktAnIha svayaMBuvA ॥60॥

text: vākpāruṣyaṃ tathogratvaṃ daṇḍapāruṣyameva ca । ātmano nigrahastyāgo'thārthadūṣaṇameva ca ॥61॥
html:
vākpāruṣyaṃ tathogratvaṃ daṇḍapāruṣyameva ca ।
ātmano nigrahastyāgo'thārthadūṣaṇameva ca ॥61॥
slp1: vAkpAruzyaM taTogratvaM daRqapAruzyameva ca । Atmano nigrahastyAgo'TArTadUzaRameva ca ॥61॥

text: yantrāṇi vividhānyeva kriyāsteṣāṃ ca varṇitāḥ । avamardaḥ pratīghātaḥ ketanānāṃ ca bhañjanam ॥62॥
html:
yantrāṇi vividhānyeva kriyāsteṣāṃ ca varṇitāḥ ।
avamardaḥ pratīghātaḥ ketanānāṃ ca bhañjanam ॥62॥
slp1: yantrARi viviDAnyeva kriyAstezAM ca varRitAH । avamardaH pratIGAtaH ketanAnAM ca BaYjanam ॥62॥

text: caityadrumāṇāmāmardo rodhaḥkarmāntanāśanam । apaskaro'tha gamanaṃ tathopāsyā ca varṇitā ॥63॥
html:
caityadrumāṇāmāmardo rodhaḥkarmāntanāśanam ।
apaskaro'tha gamanaṃ tathopāsyā ca varṇitā ॥63॥
slp1: cEtyadrumARAmAmardo roDaHkarmAntanASanam । apaskaro'Ta gamanaM taTopAsyA ca varRitA ॥63॥

text: paṇavānakaśaṅkhānāṃ bherīṇāṃ ca yudhāṃ vara । upārjanaṃ ca dravyāṇāṃ paramarma ca tāni ṣaṭ ॥64॥
html:
paṇavānakaśaṅkhānāṃ bherīṇāṃ ca yudhāṃ vara ।
upārjanaṃ ca dravyāṇāṃ paramarma ca tāni ṣaṭ ॥64॥
slp1: paRavAnakaSaNKAnAM BerIRAM ca yuDAM vara । upArjanaM ca dravyARAM paramarma ca tAni zaw ॥64॥

text: labdhasya ca praśamanaṃ satāṃ caiva hi pūjanam । vidvadbhirekībhāvaśca prātarhomavidhijñatā ॥65॥
html:
labdhasya ca praśamanaṃ satāṃ caiva hi pūjanam ।
vidvadbhirekībhāvaśca prātarhomavidhijñatā ॥65॥
slp1: labDasya ca praSamanaM satAM cEva hi pUjanam । vidvadBirekIBAvaSca prAtarhomaviDijYatA ॥65॥

text: maṅgalālambhanaṃ caiva śarīrasya pratikriyā । āhārayojanaṃ caiva nityamāstikyameva ca ॥66॥
html:
maṅgalālambhanaṃ caiva śarīrasya pratikriyā ।
āhārayojanaṃ caiva nityamāstikyameva ca ॥66॥
slp1: maNgalAlamBanaM cEva SarIrasya pratikriyA । AhArayojanaM cEva nityamAstikyameva ca ॥66॥

text: ekena ca yathottheyaṃ satyatvaṃ madhurā giraḥ । utsavānāṃ samājānāṃ kriyāḥ ketanajāstathā ॥67॥
html:
ekena ca yathottheyaṃ satyatvaṃ madhurā giraḥ ।
utsavānāṃ samājānāṃ kriyāḥ ketanajāstathā ॥67॥
slp1: ekena ca yaTotTeyaM satyatvaM maDurA giraH । utsavAnAM samAjAnAM kriyAH ketanajAstaTA ॥67॥

text: pratyakṣā ca parokṣā ca sarvādhikaraṇeṣu ca । vṛttirbharataśārdūla nityaṃ caivānvavekṣaṇam ॥68॥
html:
pratyakṣā ca parokṣā ca sarvādhikaraṇeṣu ca ।
vṛttirbharataśārdūla nityaṃ caivānvavekṣaṇam ॥68॥
slp1: pratyakzA ca parokzA ca sarvADikaraRezu ca । vfttirBarataSArdUla nityaM cEvAnvavekzaRam ॥68॥

text: adaṇḍyatvaṃ ca viprāṇāṃ yuktyā daṇḍanipātanam । anujīvisvajātibhyo guṇeṣu parirakṣaṇam ॥69॥
html:
adaṇḍyatvaṃ ca viprāṇāṃ yuktyā daṇḍanipātanam ।
anujīvisvajātibhyo guṇeṣu parirakṣaṇam ॥69॥
slp1: adaRqyatvaM ca viprARAM yuktyA daRqanipAtanam । anujIvisvajAtiByo guRezu parirakzaRam ॥69॥

text: rakṣaṇaṃ caiva paurāṇāṃ svarāṣṭrasya vivardhanam । maṇḍalasthā ca yā cintā rājandvādaśarājikā ॥70॥
html:
rakṣaṇaṃ caiva paurāṇāṃ svarāṣṭrasya vivardhanam ।
maṇḍalasthā ca yā cintā rājandvādaśarājikā ॥70॥
slp1: rakzaRaM cEva pOrARAM svarAzwrasya vivarDanam । maRqalasTA ca yA cintA rAjandvAdaSarAjikA ॥70॥

text: dvāsaptatimatiścaiva proktā yā ca svayaṃbhuvā । deśajātikulānāṃ ca dharmāḥ samanuvarṇitāḥ ॥71॥
html:
dvāsaptatimatiścaiva proktā yā ca svayaṃbhuvā ।
deśajātikulānāṃ ca dharmāḥ samanuvarṇitāḥ ॥71॥
slp1: dvAsaptatimatiScEva proktA yA ca svayaMBuvA । deSajAtikulAnAM ca DarmAH samanuvarRitAH ॥71॥

text: dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca mokṣaścātrānuvarṇitaḥ । upāyaścārthalipsā ca vividhā bhūridakṣiṇāḥ ॥72॥
html:
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca mokṣaścātrānuvarṇitaḥ ।
upāyaścārthalipsā ca vividhā bhūridakṣiṇāḥ ॥72॥
slp1: DarmaScArTaSca kAmaSca mokzaScAtrAnuvarRitaH । upAyaScArTalipsA ca viviDA BUridakziRAH ॥72॥

text: mūlakarmakriyā cātra māyā yogaśca varṇitaḥ । dūṣaṇaṃ srotasāmatra varṇitaṃ ca sthirāmbhasām ॥73॥
html:
mūlakarmakriyā cātra māyā yogaśca varṇitaḥ ।
dūṣaṇaṃ srotasāmatra varṇitaṃ ca sthirāmbhasām ॥73॥
slp1: mUlakarmakriyA cAtra mAyA yogaSca varRitaH । dUzaRaM srotasAmatra varRitaM ca sTirAmBasAm ॥73॥

text: yairyairupāyairlokaśca na caledāryavartmanaḥ । tatsarvaṃ rājaśārdūla nītiśāstre'nuvarṇitam ॥74॥
html:
yairyairupāyairlokaśca na caledāryavartmanaḥ ।
tatsarvaṃ rājaśārdūla nītiśāstre'nuvarṇitam ॥74॥
slp1: yEryErupAyErlokaSca na caledAryavartmanaH । tatsarvaM rAjaSArdUla nItiSAstre'nuvarRitam ॥74॥

text: etatkṛtvā śubhaṃ śāstraṃ tataḥ sa bhagavānprabhuḥ । devānuvāca saṃhṛṣṭaḥ sarvāñśakrapurogamān ॥75॥
html:
etatkṛtvā śubhaṃ śāstraṃ tataḥ sa bhagavānprabhuḥ ।
devānuvāca saṃhṛṣṭaḥ sarvāñśakrapurogamān ॥75॥
slp1: etatkftvA SuBaM SAstraM tataH sa BagavAnpraBuH । devAnuvAca saMhfzwaH sarvAYSakrapurogamAn ॥75॥

text: upakārāya lokasya trivargasthāpanāya ca । navanītaṃ sarasvatyā buddhireṣā prabhāvitā ॥76॥
html:
upakārāya lokasya trivargasthāpanāya ca ।
navanītaṃ sarasvatyā buddhireṣā prabhāvitā ॥76॥
slp1: upakArAya lokasya trivargasTApanAya ca । navanItaM sarasvatyA budDirezA praBAvitA ॥76॥

text: daṇḍena sahitā hyeṣā lokarakṣaṇakārikā । nigrahānugraharatā lokānanu cariṣyati ॥77॥
html:
daṇḍena sahitā hyeṣā lokarakṣaṇakārikā ।
nigrahānugraharatā lokānanu cariṣyati ॥77॥
slp1: daRqena sahitA hyezA lokarakzaRakArikA । nigrahAnugraharatA lokAnanu carizyati ॥77॥

text: daṇḍena nīyate ceyaṃ daṇḍaṃ nayati cāpyuta । daṇḍanītiriti proktā trīṁllokānanuvartate ॥78॥
html:
daṇḍena nīyate ceyaṃ daṇḍaṃ nayati cāpyuta ।
daṇḍanītiriti proktā trīṁllokānanuvartate ॥78॥
slp1: daRqena nIyate ceyaM daRqaM nayati cApyuta । daRqanItiriti proktA trIṁllokAnanuvartate ॥78॥

text: ṣāḍguṇyaguṇasāraiṣā sthāsyatyagre mahātmasu । mahattvāttasya daṇḍasya nītirvispaṣṭalakṣaṇā ॥79॥
html:
ṣāḍguṇyaguṇasāraiṣā sthāsyatyagre mahātmasu ।
mahattvāttasya daṇḍasya nītirvispaṣṭalakṣaṇā ॥79॥
slp1: zAqguRyaguRasArEzA sTAsyatyagre mahAtmasu । mahattvAttasya daRqasya nItirvispazwalakzaRA ॥79॥

text: nayacāraśca vipulo yena sarvamidaṃ tatam । āgamaśca purāṇānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ ca sambhavaḥ ॥80॥
html:
nayacāraśca vipulo yena sarvamidaṃ tatam ।
āgamaśca purāṇānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ ca sambhavaḥ ॥80॥
slp1: nayacAraSca vipulo yena sarvamidaM tatam । AgamaSca purARAnAM maharzIRAM ca samBavaH ॥80॥

text: tīrthavaṃśaśca vaṃśaśca nakṣatrāṇāṃ yudhiṣṭhira । sakalaṃ cāturāśramyaṃ cāturhotraṃ tathaiva ca ॥81॥
html:
tīrthavaṃśaśca vaṃśaśca nakṣatrāṇāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
sakalaṃ cāturāśramyaṃ cāturhotraṃ tathaiva ca ॥81॥
slp1: tIrTavaMSaSca vaMSaSca nakzatrARAM yuDizWira । sakalaM cAturASramyaM cAturhotraM taTEva ca ॥81॥

text: cāturvarṇyaṃ tathaivātra cāturvedyaṃ ca varṇitam । itihāsopavedāśca nyāyaḥ kṛtsnaśca varṇitaḥ ॥82॥
html:
cāturvarṇyaṃ tathaivātra cāturvedyaṃ ca varṇitam ।
itihāsopavedāśca nyāyaḥ kṛtsnaśca varṇitaḥ ॥82॥
slp1: cAturvarRyaM taTEvAtra cAturvedyaM ca varRitam । itihAsopavedASca nyAyaH kftsnaSca varRitaH ॥82॥

text: tapo jñānamahiṃsā ca satyāsatye nayaḥ paraḥ । vṛddhopasevā dānaṃ ca śaucamutthānameva ca ॥83॥
html:
tapo jñānamahiṃsā ca satyāsatye nayaḥ paraḥ ।
vṛddhopasevā dānaṃ ca śaucamutthānameva ca ॥83॥
slp1: tapo jYAnamahiMsA ca satyAsatye nayaH paraH । vfdDopasevA dAnaM ca SOcamutTAnameva ca ॥83॥

text: sarvabhūtānukampā ca sarvamatropavarṇitam । bhuvi vācogataṃ yacca tacca sarvaṃ samarpitam ॥84॥
html:
sarvabhūtānukampā ca sarvamatropavarṇitam ।
bhuvi vācogataṃ yacca tacca sarvaṃ samarpitam ॥84॥
slp1: sarvaBUtAnukampA ca sarvamatropavarRitam । Buvi vAcogataM yacca tacca sarvaM samarpitam ॥84॥

text: tasminpaitāmahe śāstre pāṇḍavaitadasaṃśayam । dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca sakalā hyatra śabditāḥ ॥85॥
html:
tasminpaitāmahe śāstre pāṇḍavaitadasaṃśayam ।
dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca sakalā hyatra śabditāḥ ॥85॥
slp1: tasminpEtAmahe SAstre pARqavEtadasaMSayam । DarmArTakAmamokzASca sakalA hyatra SabditAH ॥85॥

text: tatastāṃ bhagavānnītiṃ pūrvaṃ jagrāha śaṅkaraḥ । bahurūpo viśālākṣaḥ śivaḥ sthāṇurumāpatiḥ ॥86॥
html:
tatastāṃ bhagavānnītiṃ pūrvaṃ jagrāha śaṅkaraḥ ।
bahurūpo viśālākṣaḥ śivaḥ sthāṇurumāpatiḥ ॥86॥
slp1: tatastAM BagavAnnItiM pUrvaM jagrAha SaNkaraH । bahurUpo viSAlAkzaH SivaH sTARurumApatiH ॥86॥

text: yugānāmāyuṣo hrāsaṃ vijñāya bhagavāñśivaḥ । sañcikṣepa tataḥ śāstraṃ mahārthaṃ brahmaṇā kṛtam ॥87॥
html:
yugānāmāyuṣo hrāsaṃ vijñāya bhagavāñśivaḥ ।
sañcikṣepa tataḥ śāstraṃ mahārthaṃ brahmaṇā kṛtam ॥87॥
slp1: yugAnAmAyuzo hrAsaM vijYAya BagavAYSivaH । saYcikzepa tataH SAstraM mahArTaM brahmaRA kftam ॥87॥

text: vaiśālākṣamiti proktaṃ tadindraḥ pratyapadyata । daśādhyāyasahasrāṇi subrahmaṇyo mahātapāḥ ॥88॥
html:
vaiśālākṣamiti proktaṃ tadindraḥ pratyapadyata ।
daśādhyāyasahasrāṇi subrahmaṇyo mahātapāḥ ॥88॥
slp1: vESAlAkzamiti proktaM tadindraH pratyapadyata । daSADyAyasahasrARi subrahmaRyo mahAtapAH ॥88॥

text: bhagavānapi tacchāstraṃ sañcikṣepa purandaraḥ । sahasraiḥ pañcabhistāta yaduktaṃ bāhudantakam ॥89॥
html:
bhagavānapi tacchāstraṃ sañcikṣepa purandaraḥ ।
sahasraiḥ pañcabhistāta yaduktaṃ bāhudantakam ॥89॥
slp1: BagavAnapi tacCAstraM saYcikzepa purandaraH । sahasrEH paYcaBistAta yaduktaM bAhudantakam ॥89॥

text: adhyāyānāṃ sahasraistu tribhireva bṛhaspatiḥ । sañcikṣepeśvaro buddhyā bārhaspatyaṃ taducyate ॥90॥
html:
adhyāyānāṃ sahasraistu tribhireva bṛhaspatiḥ ।
sañcikṣepeśvaro buddhyā bārhaspatyaṃ taducyate ॥90॥
slp1: aDyAyAnAM sahasrEstu triBireva bfhaspatiH । saYcikzepeSvaro budDyA bArhaspatyaM taducyate ॥90॥

text: adhyāyānāṃ sahasreṇa kāvyaḥ saṅkṣepamabravīt । tacchāstramamitaprajño yogācāryo mahātapāḥ ॥91॥
html:
adhyāyānāṃ sahasreṇa kāvyaḥ saṅkṣepamabravīt ।
tacchāstramamitaprajño yogācāryo mahātapāḥ ॥91॥
slp1: aDyAyAnAM sahasreRa kAvyaH saNkzepamabravIt । tacCAstramamitaprajYo yogAcAryo mahAtapAH ॥91॥

text: evaṃ lokānurodhena śāstrametanmaharṣibhiḥ । saṅkṣiptamāyurvijñāya martyānāṃ hrāsi pāṇḍava ॥92॥
html:
evaṃ lokānurodhena śāstrametanmaharṣibhiḥ ।
saṅkṣiptamāyurvijñāya martyānāṃ hrāsi pāṇḍava ॥92॥
slp1: evaM lokAnuroDena SAstrametanmaharziBiH । saNkziptamAyurvijYAya martyAnAM hrAsi pARqava ॥92॥

text: atha devāḥ samāgamya viṣṇumūcuḥ prajāpatim । eko yo'rhati martyebhyaḥ śraiṣṭhyaṃ taṃ vai samādiśa ॥93॥
html:
atha devāḥ samāgamya viṣṇumūcuḥ prajāpatim ।
eko yo'rhati martyebhyaḥ śraiṣṭhyaṃ taṃ vai samādiśa ॥93॥
slp1: aTa devAH samAgamya vizRumUcuH prajApatim । eko yo'rhati martyeByaH SrEzWyaM taM vE samAdiSa ॥93॥

text: tataḥ sañcintya bhagavāndevo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ । taijasaṃ vai virajasaṃ so'sṛjanmānasaṃ sutam ॥94॥
html:
tataḥ sañcintya bhagavāndevo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
taijasaṃ vai virajasaṃ so'sṛjanmānasaṃ sutam ॥94॥
slp1: tataH saYcintya BagavAndevo nArAyaRaH praBuH । tEjasaM vE virajasaM so'sfjanmAnasaM sutam ॥94॥

text: virajāstu mahābhāga vibhutvaṃ bhuvi naicchata । nyāsāyaivābhavadbuddhiḥ praṇītā tasya pāṇḍava ॥95॥
html:
virajāstu mahābhāga vibhutvaṃ bhuvi naicchata ।
nyāsāyaivābhavadbuddhiḥ praṇītā tasya pāṇḍava ॥95॥
slp1: virajAstu mahABAga viButvaM Buvi nEcCata । nyAsAyEvABavadbudDiH praRItA tasya pARqava ॥95॥

text: kīrtimāṃstasya putro'bhūtso'pi pañcātigo'bhavat । kardamastasya ca sutaḥ so'pyatapyanmahattapaḥ ॥96॥
html:
kīrtimāṃstasya putro'bhūtso'pi pañcātigo'bhavat ।
kardamastasya ca sutaḥ so'pyatapyanmahattapaḥ ॥96॥
slp1: kIrtimAMstasya putro'BUtso'pi paYcAtigo'Bavat । kardamastasya ca sutaH so'pyatapyanmahattapaH ॥96॥

text: prajāpateḥ kardamasya anaṅgo nāma vai sutaḥ । prajānāṃ rakṣitā sādhurdaṇḍanītiviśāradaḥ ॥97॥
html:
prajāpateḥ kardamasya anaṅgo nāma vai sutaḥ ।
prajānāṃ rakṣitā sādhurdaṇḍanītiviśāradaḥ ॥97॥
slp1: prajApateH kardamasya anaNgo nAma vE sutaH । prajAnAM rakzitA sADurdaRqanItiviSAradaH ॥97॥

text: anaṅgaputro'tibalo nītimānadhigamya vai । abhipede mahīrājyamathendriyavaśo'bhavat ॥98॥
html:
anaṅgaputro'tibalo nītimānadhigamya vai ।
abhipede mahīrājyamathendriyavaśo'bhavat ॥98॥
slp1: anaNgaputro'tibalo nItimAnaDigamya vE । aBipede mahIrAjyamaTendriyavaSo'Bavat ॥98॥

text: mṛtyostu duhitā rājansunīthā nāma mānasī । prakhyātā triṣu lokeṣu yā sā venamajījanat ॥99॥
html:
mṛtyostu duhitā rājansunīthā nāma mānasī ।
prakhyātā triṣu lokeṣu yā sā venamajījanat ॥99॥
slp1: mftyostu duhitA rAjansunITA nAma mAnasI । praKyAtA trizu lokezu yA sA venamajIjanat ॥99॥

text: taṃ prajāsu vidharmāṇaṃ rāgadveṣavaśānugam । mantrapūtaiḥ kuśairjaghnurṛṣayo brahmavādinaḥ ॥100॥
html:
taṃ prajāsu vidharmāṇaṃ rāgadveṣavaśānugam ।
mantrapūtaiḥ kuśairjaghnurṛṣayo brahmavādinaḥ ॥100॥
slp1: taM prajAsu viDarmARaM rAgadvezavaSAnugam । mantrapUtEH kuSErjaGnurfzayo brahmavAdinaH ॥100॥

text: mamanthurdakṣiṇaṃ corumṛṣayastasya mantrataḥ । tato'sya vikṛto jajñe hrasvāṅgaḥ puruṣo bhuvi ॥101॥
html:
mamanthurdakṣiṇaṃ corumṛṣayastasya mantrataḥ ।
tato'sya vikṛto jajñe hrasvāṅgaḥ puruṣo bhuvi ॥101॥
slp1: mamanTurdakziRaM corumfzayastasya mantrataH । tato'sya vikfto jajYe hrasvANgaH puruzo Buvi ॥101॥

text: dagdhasthāṇupratīkāśo raktākṣaḥ kṛṣṇamūrdhajaḥ । niṣīdetyevamūcustamṛṣayo brahmavādinaḥ ॥102॥
html:
dagdhasthāṇupratīkāśo raktākṣaḥ kṛṣṇamūrdhajaḥ ।
niṣīdetyevamūcustamṛṣayo brahmavādinaḥ ॥102॥
slp1: dagDasTARupratIkASo raktAkzaH kfzRamUrDajaH । nizIdetyevamUcustamfzayo brahmavAdinaH ॥102॥

text: tasmānniṣādāḥ saṃbhūtāḥ krūrāḥ śailavanāśrayāḥ । ye cānye vindhyanilayā mlecchāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ ॥103॥
html:
tasmānniṣādāḥ saṃbhūtāḥ krūrāḥ śailavanāśrayāḥ ।
ye cānye vindhyanilayā mlecchāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ ॥103॥
slp1: tasmAnnizAdAH saMBUtAH krUrAH SElavanASrayAH । ye cAnye vinDyanilayA mlecCAH SatasahasraSaH ॥103॥

text: bhūyo'sya dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇiṃ mamanthuste maharṣayaḥ । tataḥ puruṣa utpanno rūpeṇendra ivāparaḥ ॥104॥
html:
bhūyo'sya dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇiṃ mamanthuste maharṣayaḥ ।
tataḥ puruṣa utpanno rūpeṇendra ivāparaḥ ॥104॥
slp1: BUyo'sya dakziRaM pARiM mamanTuste maharzayaH । tataH puruza utpanno rUpeRendra ivAparaH ॥104॥

text: kavacī baddhanistriṃśaḥ saśaraḥ saśarāsanaḥ । vedavedāṅgaviccaiva dhanurvede ca pāragaḥ ॥105॥
html:
kavacī baddhanistriṃśaḥ saśaraḥ saśarāsanaḥ ।
vedavedāṅgaviccaiva dhanurvede ca pāragaḥ ॥105॥
slp1: kavacI badDanistriMSaH saSaraH saSarAsanaH । vedavedANgaviccEva Danurvede ca pAragaH ॥105॥
