text: taṃ daṇḍanītiḥ sakalā śritā rājannarottamam । tataḥ sa prāñjalirvainyo maharṣīṃstānuvāca ha ॥106॥
html:
taṃ daṇḍanītiḥ sakalā śritā rājannarottamam ।
tataḥ sa prāñjalirvainyo maharṣīṃstānuvāca ha ॥106॥
slp1: taM daRqanItiH sakalA SritA rAjannarottamam । tataH sa prAYjalirvEnyo maharzIMstAnuvAca ha ॥106॥

text: susūkṣmā me samutpannā buddhirdharmārthadarśinī । anayā kiṃ mayā kāryaṃ tanme tattvena śaṃsata ॥107॥
html:
susūkṣmā me samutpannā buddhirdharmārthadarśinī ।
anayā kiṃ mayā kāryaṃ tanme tattvena śaṃsata ॥107॥
slp1: susUkzmA me samutpannA budDirDarmArTadarSinI । anayA kiM mayA kAryaM tanme tattvena SaMsata ॥107॥

text: yanmāṃ bhavanto vakṣyanti kāryamarthasamanvitam । tadahaṃ vai kariṣyāmi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ॥108॥
html:
yanmāṃ bhavanto vakṣyanti kāryamarthasamanvitam ।
tadahaṃ vai kariṣyāmi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ॥108॥
slp1: yanmAM Bavanto vakzyanti kAryamarTasamanvitam । tadahaM vE karizyAmi nAtra kAryA vicAraRA ॥108॥

text: tamūcuratha devāste te caiva paramarṣayaḥ । niyato yatra dharmo vai tamaśaṅkaḥ samācara ॥109॥
html:
tamūcuratha devāste te caiva paramarṣayaḥ ।
niyato yatra dharmo vai tamaśaṅkaḥ samācara ॥109॥
slp1: tamUcuraTa devAste te cEva paramarzayaH । niyato yatra Darmo vE tamaSaNkaH samAcara ॥109॥

text: priyāpriye parityajya samaḥ sarveṣu jantuṣu । kāmakrodhau ca lobhaṃ ca mānaṃ cotsṛjya dūrataḥ ॥110॥
html:
priyāpriye parityajya samaḥ sarveṣu jantuṣu ।
kāmakrodhau ca lobhaṃ ca mānaṃ cotsṛjya dūrataḥ ॥110॥
slp1: priyApriye parityajya samaH sarvezu jantuzu । kAmakroDO ca loBaM ca mAnaM cotsfjya dUrataH ॥110॥

text: yaśca dharmātpravicalelloke kaścana mānavaḥ । nigrāhyaste sa bāhubhyāṃ śaśvaddharmamavekṣataḥ ॥111॥
html:
yaśca dharmātpravicalelloke kaścana mānavaḥ ।
nigrāhyaste sa bāhubhyāṃ śaśvaddharmamavekṣataḥ ॥111॥
slp1: yaSca DarmAtpravicalelloke kaScana mAnavaH । nigrAhyaste sa bAhuByAM SaSvadDarmamavekzataH ॥111॥

text: pratijñāṃ cādhirohasva manasā karmaṇā girā । pālayiṣyāmyahaṃ bhaumaṃ brahma ityeva cāsakṛt ॥112॥
html:
pratijñāṃ cādhirohasva manasā karmaṇā girā ।
pālayiṣyāmyahaṃ bhaumaṃ brahma ityeva cāsakṛt ॥112॥
slp1: pratijYAM cADirohasva manasA karmaRA girA । pAlayizyAmyahaM BOmaM brahma ityeva cAsakft ॥112॥

text: yaścātra dharmanītyukto daṇḍanītivyapāśrayaḥ । tamaśaṅkaḥ kariṣyāmi svavaśo na kadācana ॥113॥
html:
yaścātra dharmanītyukto daṇḍanītivyapāśrayaḥ ।
tamaśaṅkaḥ kariṣyāmi svavaśo na kadācana ॥113॥
slp1: yaScAtra DarmanItyukto daRqanItivyapASrayaH । tamaSaNkaH karizyAmi svavaSo na kadAcana ॥113॥

text: adaṇḍyā me dvijāśceti pratijānīṣva cābhibho । lokaṃ ca saṅkarātkṛtsnāttrātāsmīti parantapa ॥114॥
html:
adaṇḍyā me dvijāśceti pratijānīṣva cābhibho ।
lokaṃ ca saṅkarātkṛtsnāttrātāsmīti parantapa ॥114॥
slp1: adaRqyA me dvijASceti pratijAnIzva cABiBo । lokaM ca saNkarAtkftsnAttrAtAsmIti parantapa ॥114॥

text: vainyastatastānuvāca devānṛṣipurogamān । brāhmaṇā me sahāyāścedevamastu surarṣabhāḥ ॥115॥
html:
vainyastatastānuvāca devānṛṣipurogamān ।
brāhmaṇā me sahāyāścedevamastu surarṣabhāḥ ॥115॥
slp1: vEnyastatastAnuvAca devAnfzipurogamAn । brAhmaRA me sahAyAScedevamastu surarzaBAH ॥115॥

text: evamastviti vainyastu tairukto brahmavādibhiḥ । purodhāścābhavattasya śukro brahmamayo nidhiḥ ॥116॥
html:
evamastviti vainyastu tairukto brahmavādibhiḥ ।
purodhāścābhavattasya śukro brahmamayo nidhiḥ ॥116॥
slp1: evamastviti vEnyastu tErukto brahmavAdiBiH । puroDAScABavattasya Sukro brahmamayo niDiH ॥116॥

text: mantriṇo vālakhilyāstu sārasvatyo gaṇo hyabhūt । maharṣirbhagavāngargastasya sāṃvatsaro'bhavat ॥117॥
html:
mantriṇo vālakhilyāstu sārasvatyo gaṇo hyabhūt ।
maharṣirbhagavāngargastasya sāṃvatsaro'bhavat ॥117॥
slp1: mantriRo vAlaKilyAstu sArasvatyo gaRo hyaBUt । maharzirBagavAngargastasya sAMvatsaro'Bavat ॥117॥

text: ātmanāṣṭama ityeva śrutireṣā parā nṛṣu । utpannau bandinau cāsya tatpūrvau sūtamāgadhau ॥118॥
html:
ātmanāṣṭama ityeva śrutireṣā parā nṛṣu ।
utpannau bandinau cāsya tatpūrvau sūtamāgadhau ॥118॥
slp1: AtmanAzwama ityeva SrutirezA parA nfzu । utpannO bandinO cAsya tatpUrvO sUtamAgaDO ॥118॥

text: samatāṃ vasudhāyāśca sa samyagupapādayat । vaiṣamyaṃ hi paraṃ bhūmerāsīditi ha naḥ śrutam ॥119॥
html:
samatāṃ vasudhāyāśca sa samyagupapādayat ।
vaiṣamyaṃ hi paraṃ bhūmerāsīditi ha naḥ śrutam ॥119॥
slp1: samatAM vasuDAyASca sa samyagupapAdayat । vEzamyaM hi paraM BUmerAsIditi ha naH Srutam ॥119॥

text: sa viṣṇunā ca devena śakreṇa vibudhaiḥ saha । ṛṣibhiśca prajāpālye brahmaṇā cābhiṣecitaḥ ॥120॥
html:
sa viṣṇunā ca devena śakreṇa vibudhaiḥ saha ।
ṛṣibhiśca prajāpālye brahmaṇā cābhiṣecitaḥ ॥120॥
slp1: sa vizRunA ca devena SakreRa vibuDEH saha । fziBiSca prajApAlye brahmaRA cABizecitaH ॥120॥

text: taṃ sākṣātpṛthivī bheje ratnānyādāya pāṇḍava । sāgaraḥ saritāṃ bhartā himavāṃścācalottamaḥ ॥121॥
html:
taṃ sākṣātpṛthivī bheje ratnānyādāya pāṇḍava ।
sāgaraḥ saritāṃ bhartā himavāṃścācalottamaḥ ॥121॥
slp1: taM sAkzAtpfTivI Beje ratnAnyAdAya pARqava । sAgaraH saritAM BartA himavAMScAcalottamaH ॥121॥

text: śakraśca dhanamakṣayyaṃ prādāttasya yudhiṣṭhira । rukmaṃ cāpi mahāmeruḥ svayaṃ kanakaparvataḥ ॥122॥
html:
śakraśca dhanamakṣayyaṃ prādāttasya yudhiṣṭhira ।
rukmaṃ cāpi mahāmeruḥ svayaṃ kanakaparvataḥ ॥122॥
slp1: SakraSca DanamakzayyaM prAdAttasya yuDizWira । rukmaM cApi mahAmeruH svayaM kanakaparvataH ॥122॥

text: yakṣarākṣasabhartā ca bhagavānnaravāhanaḥ । dharme cārthe ca kāme ca samarthaṃ pradadau dhanam ॥123॥
html:
yakṣarākṣasabhartā ca bhagavānnaravāhanaḥ ।
dharme cārthe ca kāme ca samarthaṃ pradadau dhanam ॥123॥
slp1: yakzarAkzasaBartA ca BagavAnnaravAhanaH । Darme cArTe ca kAme ca samarTaM pradadO Danam ॥123॥

text: hayā rathāśca nāgāśca koṭiśaḥ puruṣāstathā । prādurbabhūvurvainyasya cintanādeva pāṇḍava । na jarā na ca durbhikṣaṃ nādhayo vyādhayastathā ॥124॥
html:
hayā rathāśca nāgāśca koṭiśaḥ puruṣāstathā ।
prādurbabhūvurvainyasya cintanādeva pāṇḍava ।
na jarā na ca durbhikṣaṃ nādhayo vyādhayastathā ॥124॥
slp1: hayA raTASca nAgASca kowiSaH puruzAstaTA । prAdurbaBUvurvEnyasya cintanAdeva pARqava । na jarA na ca durBikzaM nADayo vyADayastaTA ॥124॥

text: sarīsṛpebhyaḥ stenebhyo na cānyonyātkadācana । bhayamutpadyate tatra tasya rājño'bhirakṣaṇāt ॥125॥
html:
sarīsṛpebhyaḥ stenebhyo na cānyonyātkadācana ।
bhayamutpadyate tatra tasya rājño'bhirakṣaṇāt ॥125॥
slp1: sarIsfpeByaH steneByo na cAnyonyAtkadAcana । Bayamutpadyate tatra tasya rAjYo'BirakzaRAt ॥125॥

text: teneyaṃ pṛthivī dugdhā sasyāni daśa sapta ca । yakṣarākṣasanāgaiścāpīpsitaṃ yasya yasya yat ॥126॥
html:
teneyaṃ pṛthivī dugdhā sasyāni daśa sapta ca ।
yakṣarākṣasanāgaiścāpīpsitaṃ yasya yasya yat ॥126॥
slp1: teneyaM pfTivI dugDA sasyAni daSa sapta ca । yakzarAkzasanAgEScApIpsitaM yasya yasya yat ॥126॥

text: tena dharmottaraścāyaṃ kṛto loko mahātmanā । rañjitāśca prajāḥ sarvāstena rājeti śabdyate ॥127॥
html:
tena dharmottaraścāyaṃ kṛto loko mahātmanā ।
rañjitāśca prajāḥ sarvāstena rājeti śabdyate ॥127॥
slp1: tena DarmottaraScAyaM kfto loko mahAtmanA । raYjitASca prajAH sarvAstena rAjeti Sabdyate ॥127॥

text: brāhmaṇānāṃ kṣatatrāṇāttataḥ kṣatriya ucyate । prathitā dhanataśceyaṃ pṛthivī sādhubhiḥ smṛtā ॥128॥
html:
brāhmaṇānāṃ kṣatatrāṇāttataḥ kṣatriya ucyate ।
prathitā dhanataśceyaṃ pṛthivī sādhubhiḥ smṛtā ॥128॥
slp1: brAhmaRAnAM kzatatrARAttataH kzatriya ucyate । praTitA DanataSceyaM pfTivI sADuBiH smftA ॥128॥

text: sthāpanaṃ cākarodviṣṇuḥ svayameva sanātanaḥ । nātivartiṣyate kaścidrājaṃstvāmiti pārthiva ॥129॥
html:
sthāpanaṃ cākarodviṣṇuḥ svayameva sanātanaḥ ।
nātivartiṣyate kaścidrājaṃstvāmiti pārthiva ॥129॥
slp1: sTApanaM cAkarodvizRuH svayameva sanAtanaH । nAtivartizyate kaScidrAjaMstvAmiti pArTiva ॥129॥

text: tapasā bhagavānviṣṇurāviveśa ca bhūmipam । devavannaradevānāṃ namate yajjagannṛpa ॥130॥
html:
tapasā bhagavānviṣṇurāviveśa ca bhūmipam ।
devavannaradevānāṃ namate yajjagannṛpa ॥130॥
slp1: tapasA BagavAnvizRurAviveSa ca BUmipam । devavannaradevAnAM namate yajjagannfpa ॥130॥

text: daṇḍanītyā ca satataṃ rakṣitaṃ taṃ nareśvara । nādharṣayattataḥ kaściccāranityācca darśanāt ॥131॥
html:
daṇḍanītyā ca satataṃ rakṣitaṃ taṃ nareśvara ।
nādharṣayattataḥ kaściccāranityācca darśanāt ॥131॥
slp1: daRqanItyA ca satataM rakzitaM taM nareSvara । nADarzayattataH kaSciccAranityAcca darSanAt ॥131॥

text: ātmanā karaṇaiścaiva samasyeha mahīkṣitaḥ । ko heturyadvaśe tiṣṭhelloko daivādṛte guṇāt ॥132॥
html:
ātmanā karaṇaiścaiva samasyeha mahīkṣitaḥ ।
ko heturyadvaśe tiṣṭhelloko daivādṛte guṇāt ॥132॥
slp1: AtmanA karaREScEva samasyeha mahIkzitaH । ko heturyadvaSe tizWelloko dEvAdfte guRAt ॥132॥

text: viṣṇorlalāṭātkamalaṃ sauvarṇamabhavattadā । śrīḥ sambhūtā yato devī patnī dharmasya dhīmataḥ ॥133॥
html:
viṣṇorlalāṭātkamalaṃ sauvarṇamabhavattadā ।
śrīḥ sambhūtā yato devī patnī dharmasya dhīmataḥ ॥133॥
slp1: vizRorlalAwAtkamalaM sOvarRamaBavattadA । SrIH samBUtA yato devI patnI Darmasya DImataH ॥133॥

text: śriyaḥ sakāśādarthaśca jāto dharmeṇa pāṇḍava । atha dharmastathaivārthaḥ śrīśca rājye pratiṣṭhitā ॥134॥
html:
śriyaḥ sakāśādarthaśca jāto dharmeṇa pāṇḍava ।
atha dharmastathaivārthaḥ śrīśca rājye pratiṣṭhitā ॥134॥
slp1: SriyaH sakASAdarTaSca jAto DarmeRa pARqava । aTa DarmastaTEvArTaH SrISca rAjye pratizWitA ॥134॥

text: sukṛtasya kṣayāccaiva svarlokādetya medinīm । pārthivo jāyate tāta daṇḍanītivaśānugaḥ ॥135॥
html:
sukṛtasya kṣayāccaiva svarlokādetya medinīm ।
pārthivo jāyate tāta daṇḍanītivaśānugaḥ ॥135॥
slp1: sukftasya kzayAccEva svarlokAdetya medinIm । pArTivo jAyate tAta daRqanItivaSAnugaH ॥135॥

text: mahattvena ca saṃyukto vaiṣṇavena naro bhuvi । buddhyā bhavati saṃyukto māhātmyaṃ cādhigacchati ॥136॥
html:
mahattvena ca saṃyukto vaiṣṇavena naro bhuvi ।
buddhyā bhavati saṃyukto māhātmyaṃ cādhigacchati ॥136॥
slp1: mahattvena ca saMyukto vEzRavena naro Buvi । budDyA Bavati saMyukto mAhAtmyaM cADigacCati ॥136॥

text: sthāpanāmatha devānāṃ na kaścidativartate । tiṣṭhatyekasya ca vaśe taṃ cedanuvidhīyate ॥137॥
html:
sthāpanāmatha devānāṃ na kaścidativartate ।
tiṣṭhatyekasya ca vaśe taṃ cedanuvidhīyate ॥137॥
slp1: sTApanAmaTa devAnAM na kaScidativartate । tizWatyekasya ca vaSe taM cedanuviDIyate ॥137॥

text: śubhaṃ hi karma rājendra śubhatvāyopakalpate । tulyasyaikasya yasyāyaṃ loko vacasi tiṣṭhati ॥138॥
html:
śubhaṃ hi karma rājendra śubhatvāyopakalpate ।
tulyasyaikasya yasyāyaṃ loko vacasi tiṣṭhati ॥138॥
slp1: SuBaM hi karma rAjendra SuBatvAyopakalpate । tulyasyEkasya yasyAyaM loko vacasi tizWati ॥138॥

text: yo hyasya mukhamadrākṣītsomya so'sya vaśānugaḥ । subhagaṃ cārthavantaṃ ca rūpavantaṃ ca paśyati ॥139॥
html:
yo hyasya mukhamadrākṣītsomya so'sya vaśānugaḥ ।
subhagaṃ cārthavantaṃ ca rūpavantaṃ ca paśyati ॥139॥
slp1: yo hyasya muKamadrAkzItsomya so'sya vaSAnugaH । suBagaM cArTavantaM ca rUpavantaM ca paSyati ॥139॥

text: tato jagati rājendra satataṃ śabditaṃ budhaiḥ । devāśca naradevāśca tulyā iti viśāmpate ॥140॥
html:
tato jagati rājendra satataṃ śabditaṃ budhaiḥ ।
devāśca naradevāśca tulyā iti viśāmpate ॥140॥
slp1: tato jagati rAjendra satataM SabditaM buDEH । devASca naradevASca tulyA iti viSAmpate ॥140॥

text: etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ mahattvaṃ prati rājasu । kārtsnyena bharataśreṣṭha kimanyadiha vartatām] ॥141॥
html:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ mahattvaṃ prati rājasu ।
kārtsnyena bharataśreṣṭha kimanyadiha vartatām] ॥141॥
slp1: etatte sarvamAKyAtaM mahattvaM prati rAjasu । kArtsnyena BarataSrezWa kimanyadiha vartatAm] ॥141॥

text: tataḥ punaḥ sa gāṅgeyamabhivādya pitāmaham । prāñjalirniyato bhūtvā paryapṛcchadyudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥1॥
html:
tataḥ punaḥ sa gāṅgeyamabhivādya pitāmaham ।
prāñjalirniyato bhūtvā paryapṛcchadyudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥1॥
slp1: tataH punaH sa gANgeyamaBivAdya pitAmaham । prAYjalirniyato BUtvA paryapfcCadyuDizWiraH ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: ke dharmāḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ cāturvarṇyasya ke pṛthak । caturṇāmāśramāṇāṃ ca rājadharmāśca ke matāḥ ॥2॥
html:
ke dharmāḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ cāturvarṇyasya ke pṛthak ।
caturṇāmāśramāṇāṃ ca rājadharmāśca ke matāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: ke DarmAH sarvavarRAnAM cAturvarRyasya ke pfTak । caturRAmASramARAM ca rAjaDarmASca ke matAH ॥2॥

text: kena svidvardhate rāṣṭraṃ rājā kena vivardhate । kena paurāśca bhṛtyāśca vardhante bharatarṣabha ॥3॥
html:
kena svidvardhate rāṣṭraṃ rājā kena vivardhate ।
kena paurāśca bhṛtyāśca vardhante bharatarṣabha ॥3॥
slp1: kena svidvarDate rAzwraM rAjA kena vivarDate । kena pOrASca BftyASca varDante BaratarzaBa ॥3॥

text: kośaṃ daṇḍaṃ ca durgaṃ ca sahāyānmantriṇastathā । ṛtvikpurohitācāryānkīdṛśānvarjayennṛpaḥ ॥4॥
html:
kośaṃ daṇḍaṃ ca durgaṃ ca sahāyānmantriṇastathā ।
ṛtvikpurohitācāryānkīdṛśānvarjayennṛpaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: koSaM daRqaM ca durgaM ca sahAyAnmantriRastaTA । ftvikpurohitAcAryAnkIdfSAnvarjayennfpaH ॥4॥

text: keṣu viśvasitavyaṃ syādrājñāṃ kasyāñcidāpadi । kuto vātmā dṛḍho rakṣyastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥5॥
html:
keṣu viśvasitavyaṃ syādrājñāṃ kasyāñcidāpadi ।
kuto vātmā dṛḍho rakṣyastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥5॥
slp1: kezu viSvasitavyaM syAdrAjYAM kasyAYcidApadi । kuto vAtmA dfQo rakzyastanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥5॥

text: namo dharmāya mahate namaḥ kṛṣṇāya vedhase । brāhmaṇebhyo namaskṛtvā dharmānvakṣyāmi śāśvatān ॥6॥
html:
namo dharmāya mahate namaḥ kṛṣṇāya vedhase ।
brāhmaṇebhyo namaskṛtvā dharmānvakṣyāmi śāśvatān ॥6॥
slp1: namo DarmAya mahate namaH kfzRAya veDase । brAhmaReByo namaskftvA DarmAnvakzyAmi SASvatAn ॥6॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: akrodhaḥ satyavacanaṃ saṃvibhāgaḥ kṣamā tathā । prajanaḥ sveṣu dāreṣu śaucamadroha eva ca ॥7॥
html:
akrodhaḥ satyavacanaṃ saṃvibhāgaḥ kṣamā tathā ।
prajanaḥ sveṣu dāreṣu śaucamadroha eva ca ॥7॥
slp1: akroDaH satyavacanaM saMviBAgaH kzamA taTA । prajanaH svezu dArezu SOcamadroha eva ca ॥7॥

text: ārjavaṃ bhṛtyabharaṇaṃ navaite sārvavarṇikāḥ । brāhmaṇasya tu yo dharmastaṃ te vakṣyāmi kevalam ॥8॥
html:
ārjavaṃ bhṛtyabharaṇaṃ navaite sārvavarṇikāḥ ।
brāhmaṇasya tu yo dharmastaṃ te vakṣyāmi kevalam ॥8॥
slp1: ArjavaM BftyaBaraRaM navEte sArvavarRikAH । brAhmaRasya tu yo DarmastaM te vakzyAmi kevalam ॥8॥

text: damameva mahārāja dharmamāhuḥ purātanam । svādhyāyo'dhyāpanaṃ caiva tatra karma samāpyate ॥9॥
html:
damameva mahārāja dharmamāhuḥ purātanam ।
svādhyāyo'dhyāpanaṃ caiva tatra karma samāpyate ॥9॥
slp1: damameva mahArAja DarmamAhuH purAtanam । svADyAyo'DyApanaM cEva tatra karma samApyate ॥9॥

text: taṃ cedvittamupāgacchedvartamānaṃ svakarmaṇi । akurvāṇaṃ vikarmāṇi śāntaṃ prajñānatarpitam ॥10॥
html:
taṃ cedvittamupāgacchedvartamānaṃ svakarmaṇi ।
akurvāṇaṃ vikarmāṇi śāntaṃ prajñānatarpitam ॥10॥
slp1: taM cedvittamupAgacCedvartamAnaM svakarmaRi । akurvARaM vikarmARi SAntaM prajYAnatarpitam ॥10॥

text: kurvītāpatyasantānamatho dadyādyajeta ca । saṃvibhajya hi bhoktavyaṃ dhanaṃ sadbhiritīṣyate ॥11॥
html:
kurvītāpatyasantānamatho dadyādyajeta ca ।
saṃvibhajya hi bhoktavyaṃ dhanaṃ sadbhiritīṣyate ॥11॥
slp1: kurvItApatyasantAnamaTo dadyAdyajeta ca । saMviBajya hi BoktavyaM DanaM sadBiritIzyate ॥11॥

text: pariniṣṭhitakāryastu svādhyāyenaiva brāhmaṇaḥ । kuryādanyanna vā kuryānmaitro brāhmaṇa ucyate ॥12॥
html:
pariniṣṭhitakāryastu svādhyāyenaiva brāhmaṇaḥ ।
kuryādanyanna vā kuryānmaitro brāhmaṇa ucyate ॥12॥
slp1: parinizWitakAryastu svADyAyenEva brAhmaRaH । kuryAdanyanna vA kuryAnmEtro brAhmaRa ucyate ॥12॥

text: kṣatriyasyāpi yo dharmastaṃ te vakṣyāmi bhārata । dadyādrājā na yāceta yajeta na tu yājayet ॥13॥
html:
kṣatriyasyāpi yo dharmastaṃ te vakṣyāmi bhārata ।
dadyādrājā na yāceta yajeta na tu yājayet ॥13॥
slp1: kzatriyasyApi yo DarmastaM te vakzyAmi BArata । dadyAdrAjA na yAceta yajeta na tu yAjayet ॥13॥

text: nādhyāpayedadhīyīta prajāśca paripālayet । nityodyukto dasyuvadhe raṇe kuryātparākramam ॥14॥
html:
nādhyāpayedadhīyīta prajāśca paripālayet ।
nityodyukto dasyuvadhe raṇe kuryātparākramam ॥14॥
slp1: nADyApayedaDIyIta prajASca paripAlayet । nityodyukto dasyuvaDe raRe kuryAtparAkramam ॥14॥

text: ye ca kratubhirījānāḥ śrutavantaśca bhūmipāḥ । ya evāhavajetārasta eṣāṃ lokajittamāḥ ॥15॥
html:
ye ca kratubhirījānāḥ śrutavantaśca bhūmipāḥ ।
ya evāhavajetārasta eṣāṃ lokajittamāḥ ॥15॥
slp1: ye ca kratuBirIjAnAH SrutavantaSca BUmipAH । ya evAhavajetArasta ezAM lokajittamAH ॥15॥

text: avikṣatena dehena samarādyo nivartate । kṣatriyo nāsya tatkarma praśaṃsanti purāvidaḥ ॥16॥
html:
avikṣatena dehena samarādyo nivartate ।
kṣatriyo nāsya tatkarma praśaṃsanti purāvidaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: avikzatena dehena samarAdyo nivartate । kzatriyo nAsya tatkarma praSaMsanti purAvidaH ॥16॥

text: vadhaṃ hi kṣatrabandhūnāṃ dharmamāhuḥ pradhānataḥ । nāsya kṛtyatamaṃ kiñcidanyaddasyunibarhaṇāt ॥17॥
html:
vadhaṃ hi kṣatrabandhūnāṃ dharmamāhuḥ pradhānataḥ ।
nāsya kṛtyatamaṃ kiñcidanyaddasyunibarhaṇāt ॥17॥
slp1: vaDaM hi kzatrabanDUnAM DarmamAhuH praDAnataH । nAsya kftyatamaM kiYcidanyaddasyunibarhaRAt ॥17॥

text: dānamadhyayanaṃ yajño yogaḥ kṣemo vidhīyate । tasmādrājñā viśeṣeṇa yoddhavyaṃ dharmamīpsatā ॥18॥
html:
dānamadhyayanaṃ yajño yogaḥ kṣemo vidhīyate ।
tasmādrājñā viśeṣeṇa yoddhavyaṃ dharmamīpsatā ॥18॥
slp1: dAnamaDyayanaM yajYo yogaH kzemo viDIyate । tasmAdrAjYA viSezeRa yodDavyaM DarmamIpsatA ॥18॥

text: sveṣu dharmeṣvavasthāpya prajāḥ sarvā mahīpatiḥ । dharmeṇa sarvakṛtyāni samaniṣṭhāni kārayet ॥19॥
html:
sveṣu dharmeṣvavasthāpya prajāḥ sarvā mahīpatiḥ ।
dharmeṇa sarvakṛtyāni samaniṣṭhāni kārayet ॥19॥
slp1: svezu DarmezvavasTApya prajAH sarvA mahIpatiH । DarmeRa sarvakftyAni samanizWAni kArayet ॥19॥

text: pariniṣṭhitakāryaḥ syānnṛpatiḥ paripālanāt । kuryādanyanna vā kuryādaindro rājanya ucyate ॥20॥
html:
pariniṣṭhitakāryaḥ syānnṛpatiḥ paripālanāt ।
kuryādanyanna vā kuryādaindro rājanya ucyate ॥20॥
slp1: parinizWitakAryaH syAnnfpatiH paripAlanAt । kuryAdanyanna vA kuryAdEndro rAjanya ucyate ॥20॥

text: vaiśyasyāpīha yo dharmastaṃ te vakṣyāmi bhārata । dānamadhyayanaṃ yajñaḥ śaucena dhanasañcayaḥ ॥21॥
html:
vaiśyasyāpīha yo dharmastaṃ te vakṣyāmi bhārata ।
dānamadhyayanaṃ yajñaḥ śaucena dhanasañcayaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: vESyasyApIha yo DarmastaM te vakzyAmi BArata । dAnamaDyayanaM yajYaH SOcena DanasaYcayaH ॥21॥

text: pitṛvatpālayedvaiśyo yuktaḥ sarvapaśūniha । vikarma tadbhavedanyatkarma yadyatsamācaret । rakṣayā sa hi teṣāṃ vai mahatsukhamavāpnuyāt ॥22॥
html:
pitṛvatpālayedvaiśyo yuktaḥ sarvapaśūniha ।
vikarma tadbhavedanyatkarma yadyatsamācaret ।
rakṣayā sa hi teṣāṃ vai mahatsukhamavāpnuyāt ॥22॥
slp1: pitfvatpAlayedvESyo yuktaH sarvapaSUniha । vikarma tadBavedanyatkarma yadyatsamAcaret । rakzayA sa hi tezAM vE mahatsuKamavApnuyAt ॥22॥

text: prajāpatirhi vaiśyāya sṛṣṭvā paridade paśūn । brāhmaṇāya ca rājñe ca sarvāḥ paridade prajāḥ ॥23॥
html:
prajāpatirhi vaiśyāya sṛṣṭvā paridade paśūn ।
brāhmaṇāya ca rājñe ca sarvāḥ paridade prajāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: prajApatirhi vESyAya sfzwvA paridade paSUn । brAhmaRAya ca rAjYe ca sarvAH paridade prajAH ॥23॥

text: tasya vṛttiṃ pravakṣyāmi yacca tasyopajīvanam । ṣaṇṇāmekāṃ pibeddhenuṃ śatācca mithunaṃ haret ॥24॥
html:
tasya vṛttiṃ pravakṣyāmi yacca tasyopajīvanam ।
ṣaṇṇāmekāṃ pibeddhenuṃ śatācca mithunaṃ haret ॥24॥
slp1: tasya vfttiM pravakzyAmi yacca tasyopajIvanam । zaRRAmekAM pibedDenuM SatAcca miTunaM haret ॥24॥

text: laye ca saptamo bhāgastathā śṛṅge kalā khure । sasyasya sarvabījānāmeṣā sāṃvatsarī bhṛtiḥ ॥25॥
html:
laye ca saptamo bhāgastathā śṛṅge kalā khure ।
sasyasya sarvabījānāmeṣā sāṃvatsarī bhṛtiḥ ॥25॥
slp1: laye ca saptamo BAgastaTA SfNge kalA Kure । sasyasya sarvabIjAnAmezA sAMvatsarI BftiH ॥25॥

text: na ca vaiśyasya kāmaḥ syānna rakṣeyaṃ paśūniti । vaiśye cecchati nānyena rakṣitavyāḥ kathañcana ॥26॥
html:
na ca vaiśyasya kāmaḥ syānna rakṣeyaṃ paśūniti ।
vaiśye cecchati nānyena rakṣitavyāḥ kathañcana ॥26॥
slp1: na ca vESyasya kAmaH syAnna rakzeyaM paSUniti । vESye cecCati nAnyena rakzitavyAH kaTaYcana ॥26॥

text: śūdrasyāpi hi yo dharmastaṃ te vakṣyāmi bhārata । prajāpatirhi varṇānāṃ dāsaṃ śūdramakalpayat ॥27॥
html:
śūdrasyāpi hi yo dharmastaṃ te vakṣyāmi bhārata ।
prajāpatirhi varṇānāṃ dāsaṃ śūdramakalpayat ॥27॥
slp1: SUdrasyApi hi yo DarmastaM te vakzyAmi BArata । prajApatirhi varRAnAM dAsaM SUdramakalpayat ॥27॥

text: tasmācchūdrasya varṇānāṃ paricaryā vidhīyate । teṣāṃ śuśrūṣaṇāccaiva mahatsukhamavāpnuyāt ॥28॥
html:
tasmācchūdrasya varṇānāṃ paricaryā vidhīyate ।
teṣāṃ śuśrūṣaṇāccaiva mahatsukhamavāpnuyāt ॥28॥
slp1: tasmAcCUdrasya varRAnAM paricaryA viDIyate । tezAM SuSrUzaRAccEva mahatsuKamavApnuyAt ॥28॥

text: śūdra etānparicarettrīnvarṇānanasūyakaḥ । sañcayāṃśca na kurvīta jātu śūdraḥ kathañcana ॥29॥
html:
śūdra etānparicarettrīnvarṇānanasūyakaḥ ।
sañcayāṃśca na kurvīta jātu śūdraḥ kathañcana ॥29॥
slp1: SUdra etAnparicarettrInvarRAnanasUyakaH । saYcayAMSca na kurvIta jAtu SUdraH kaTaYcana ॥29॥

text: pāpīyānhi dhanaṃ labdhvā vaśe kuryādgarīyasaḥ । rājñā vā samanujñātaḥ kāmaṃ kurvīta dhārmikaḥ ॥30॥
html:
pāpīyānhi dhanaṃ labdhvā vaśe kuryādgarīyasaḥ ।
rājñā vā samanujñātaḥ kāmaṃ kurvīta dhārmikaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: pApIyAnhi DanaM labDvA vaSe kuryAdgarIyasaH । rAjYA vA samanujYAtaH kAmaM kurvIta DArmikaH ॥30॥

text: tasya vṛttiṃ pravakṣyāmi yacca tasyopajīvanam । avaśyabharaṇīyo hi varṇānāṃ śūdra ucyate ॥31॥
html:
tasya vṛttiṃ pravakṣyāmi yacca tasyopajīvanam ।
avaśyabharaṇīyo hi varṇānāṃ śūdra ucyate ॥31॥
slp1: tasya vfttiM pravakzyAmi yacca tasyopajIvanam । avaSyaBaraRIyo hi varRAnAM SUdra ucyate ॥31॥

text: chatraṃ veṣṭanamauśīramupānadvyajanāni ca । yātayāmāni deyāni śūdrāya paricāriṇe ॥32॥
html:
chatraṃ veṣṭanamauśīramupānadvyajanāni ca ।
yātayāmāni deyāni śūdrāya paricāriṇe ॥32॥
slp1: CatraM vezwanamOSIramupAnadvyajanAni ca । yAtayAmAni deyAni SUdrAya paricAriRe ॥32॥

text: adhāryāṇi viśīrṇāni vasanāni dvijātibhiḥ । śūdrāyaiva vidheyāni tasya dharmadhanaṃ hi tat ॥33॥
html:
adhāryāṇi viśīrṇāni vasanāni dvijātibhiḥ ।
śūdrāyaiva vidheyāni tasya dharmadhanaṃ hi tat ॥33॥
slp1: aDAryARi viSIrRAni vasanAni dvijAtiBiH । SUdrAyEva viDeyAni tasya DarmaDanaM hi tat ॥33॥

text: yaśca kaściddvijātīnāṃ śūdraḥ śuśrūṣurāvrajet । kalpyāṃ tasya tu tenāhurvṛttiṃ dharmavido janāḥ । deyaḥ piṇḍo'napetāya bhartavyau vṛddhadurbalau ॥34॥
html:
yaśca kaściddvijātīnāṃ śūdraḥ śuśrūṣurāvrajet ।
kalpyāṃ tasya tu tenāhurvṛttiṃ dharmavido janāḥ ।
deyaḥ piṇḍo'napetāya bhartavyau vṛddhadurbalau ॥34॥
slp1: yaSca kaSciddvijAtInAM SUdraH SuSrUzurAvrajet । kalpyAM tasya tu tenAhurvfttiM Darmavido janAH । deyaH piRqo'napetAya BartavyO vfdDadurbalO ॥34॥

text: śūdreṇa ca na hātavyo bhartā kasyāñcidāpadi । atirekeṇa bhartavyo bhartā dravyaparikṣaye । na hi svamasti śūdrasya bhartṛhāryadhano hyasau ॥35॥
html:
śūdreṇa ca na hātavyo bhartā kasyāñcidāpadi ।
atirekeṇa bhartavyo bhartā dravyaparikṣaye ।
na hi svamasti śūdrasya bhartṛhāryadhano hyasau ॥35॥
slp1: SUdreRa ca na hAtavyo BartA kasyAYcidApadi । atirekeRa Bartavyo BartA dravyaparikzaye । na hi svamasti SUdrasya BartfhAryaDano hyasO ॥35॥

text: uktastrayāṇāṃ varṇānāṃ yajñastrayyaiva bhārata । svāhākāranamaskārau mantraḥ śūdre vidhīyate ॥36॥
html:
uktastrayāṇāṃ varṇānāṃ yajñastrayyaiva bhārata ।
svāhākāranamaskārau mantraḥ śūdre vidhīyate ॥36॥
slp1: uktastrayARAM varRAnAM yajYastrayyEva BArata । svAhAkAranamaskArO mantraH SUdre viDIyate ॥36॥

text: tābhyāṃ śūdraḥ pākayajñairyajeta vratavānsvayam । pūrṇapātramayīmāhuḥ pākayajñasya dakṣiṇām ॥37॥
html:
tābhyāṃ śūdraḥ pākayajñairyajeta vratavānsvayam ।
pūrṇapātramayīmāhuḥ pākayajñasya dakṣiṇām ॥37॥
slp1: tAByAM SUdraH pAkayajYEryajeta vratavAnsvayam । pUrRapAtramayImAhuH pAkayajYasya dakziRAm ॥37॥

text: śūdraḥ paijavano nāma sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ dadau । aindrāgnena vidhānena dakṣiṇāmiti naḥ śrutam ॥38॥
html:
śūdraḥ paijavano nāma sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ dadau ।
aindrāgnena vidhānena dakṣiṇāmiti naḥ śrutam ॥38॥
slp1: SUdraH pEjavano nAma sahasrARAM SataM dadO । EndrAgnena viDAnena dakziRAmiti naH Srutam ॥38॥

text: ato hi sarvavarṇānāṃ śraddhāyajño vidhīyate । daivataṃ hi mahacchraddhā pavitraṃ yajatāṃ ca yat ॥39॥
html:
ato hi sarvavarṇānāṃ śraddhāyajño vidhīyate ।
daivataṃ hi mahacchraddhā pavitraṃ yajatāṃ ca yat ॥39॥
slp1: ato hi sarvavarRAnAM SradDAyajYo viDIyate । dEvataM hi mahacCradDA pavitraM yajatAM ca yat ॥39॥

text: daivataṃ paramaṃ viprāḥ svena svena parasparam । ayajanniha satraiste taistaiḥ kāmaiḥ sanātanaiḥ ॥40॥
html:
daivataṃ paramaṃ viprāḥ svena svena parasparam ।
ayajanniha satraiste taistaiḥ kāmaiḥ sanātanaiḥ ॥40॥
slp1: dEvataM paramaM viprAH svena svena parasparam । ayajanniha satrEste tEstEH kAmEH sanAtanEH ॥40॥

text: saṃsṛṣṭā brāhmaṇaireva triṣu varṇeṣu sṛṣṭayaḥ । devānāmapi ye devā yadbrūyuste paraṃ hi tat । tasmādvarṇaiḥ sarvayajñāḥ saṃsṛjyante na kāmyayā ॥41॥
html:
saṃsṛṣṭā brāhmaṇaireva triṣu varṇeṣu sṛṣṭayaḥ ।
devānāmapi ye devā yadbrūyuste paraṃ hi tat ।
tasmādvarṇaiḥ sarvayajñāḥ saṃsṛjyante na kāmyayā ॥41॥
slp1: saMsfzwA brAhmaREreva trizu varRezu sfzwayaH । devAnAmapi ye devA yadbrUyuste paraM hi tat । tasmAdvarREH sarvayajYAH saMsfjyante na kAmyayA ॥41॥

text: ṛgyajuḥsāmavitpūjyo nityaṃ syāddevavaddvijaḥ । anṛgyajurasāmā tu prājāpatya upadravaḥ ॥42॥
html:
ṛgyajuḥsāmavitpūjyo nityaṃ syāddevavaddvijaḥ ।
anṛgyajurasāmā tu prājāpatya upadravaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: fgyajuHsAmavitpUjyo nityaM syAddevavaddvijaH । anfgyajurasAmA tu prAjApatya upadravaH ॥42॥

text: yajño manīṣayā tāta sarvavarṇeṣu bhārata । nāsya yajñahano devā īhante netare janāḥ । tasmātsarveṣu varṇeṣu śraddhāyajño vidhīyate ॥43॥
html:
yajño manīṣayā tāta sarvavarṇeṣu bhārata ।
nāsya yajñahano devā īhante netare janāḥ ।
tasmātsarveṣu varṇeṣu śraddhāyajño vidhīyate ॥43॥
slp1: yajYo manIzayA tAta sarvavarRezu BArata । nAsya yajYahano devA Ihante netare janAH । tasmAtsarvezu varRezu SradDAyajYo viDIyate ॥43॥

text: svaṃ daivataṃ brāhmaṇāḥ svena nityaṃ parānvarṇānayajannevamāsīt । ārocitā naḥ sumahānsa dharmaḥ sṛṣṭo brahmaṇā triṣu varṇeṣu dṛṣṭaḥ ॥44॥
html:
svaṃ daivataṃ brāhmaṇāḥ svena nityaṃ parānvarṇānayajannevamāsīt ।
ārocitā naḥ sumahānsa dharmaḥ sṛṣṭo brahmaṇā triṣu varṇeṣu dṛṣṭaḥ ॥44॥
slp1: svaM dEvataM brAhmaRAH svena nityaM parAnvarRAnayajannevamAsIt । ArocitA naH sumahAnsa DarmaH sfzwo brahmaRA trizu varRezu dfzwaH ॥44॥

text: tasmādvarṇā ṛjavo jātidharmāḥ saṃsṛjyante tasya vipāka eṣaḥ । ekaṃ sāma yajurekamṛgekā vipraścaiko'niścayasteṣu dṛṣṭaḥ ॥45॥
html:
tasmādvarṇā ṛjavo jātidharmāḥ saṃsṛjyante tasya vipāka eṣaḥ ।
ekaṃ sāma yajurekamṛgekā vipraścaiko'niścayasteṣu dṛṣṭaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: tasmAdvarRA fjavo jAtiDarmAH saMsfjyante tasya vipAka ezaH । ekaM sAma yajurekamfgekA vipraScEko'niScayastezu dfzwaH ॥45॥

text: atra gāthā yajñagītāḥ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ । vaikhānasānāṃ rājendra munīnāṃ yaṣṭumicchatām ॥46॥
html:
atra gāthā yajñagītāḥ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ ।
vaikhānasānāṃ rājendra munīnāṃ yaṣṭumicchatām ॥46॥
slp1: atra gATA yajYagItAH kIrtayanti purAvidaH । vEKAnasAnAM rAjendra munInAM yazwumicCatAm ॥46॥

text: udite'nudite vāpi śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ । vahniṃ juhoti dharmeṇa śraddhā vai kāraṇaṃ mahat ॥47॥
html:
udite'nudite vāpi śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ ।
vahniṃ juhoti dharmeṇa śraddhā vai kāraṇaṃ mahat ॥47॥
slp1: udite'nudite vApi SraddaDAno jitendriyaH । vahniM juhoti DarmeRa SradDA vE kAraRaM mahat ॥47॥

text: yatskannamasya tatpūrvaṃ yadaskannaṃ taduttaram । bahūni yajñarūpāṇi nānākarmaphalāni ca ॥48॥
html:
yatskannamasya tatpūrvaṃ yadaskannaṃ taduttaram ।
bahūni yajñarūpāṇi nānākarmaphalāni ca ॥48॥
slp1: yatskannamasya tatpUrvaM yadaskannaM taduttaram । bahUni yajYarUpARi nAnAkarmaPalAni ca ॥48॥

text: tāni yaḥ saṃvijānāti jñānaniścayaniścitaḥ । dvijātiḥ śraddhayopetaḥ sa yaṣṭuṃ puruṣo'rhati ॥49॥
html:
tāni yaḥ saṃvijānāti jñānaniścayaniścitaḥ ।
dvijātiḥ śraddhayopetaḥ sa yaṣṭuṃ puruṣo'rhati ॥49॥
slp1: tAni yaH saMvijAnAti jYAnaniScayaniScitaH । dvijAtiH SradDayopetaH sa yazwuM puruzo'rhati ॥49॥

text: steno vā yadi vā pāpo yadi vā pāpakṛttamaḥ । yaṣṭumicchati yajñaṃ yaḥ sādhumeva vadanti tam ॥50॥
html:
steno vā yadi vā pāpo yadi vā pāpakṛttamaḥ ।
yaṣṭumicchati yajñaṃ yaḥ sādhumeva vadanti tam ॥50॥
slp1: steno vA yadi vA pApo yadi vA pApakfttamaH । yazwumicCati yajYaM yaH sADumeva vadanti tam ॥50॥

text: ṛṣayastaṃ praśaṃsanti sādhu caitadasaṃśayam । sarvathā sarvavarṇairhi yaṣṭavyamiti niścayaḥ । na hi yajñasamaṃ kiñcittriṣu lokeṣu vidyate ॥51॥
html:
ṛṣayastaṃ praśaṃsanti sādhu caitadasaṃśayam ।
sarvathā sarvavarṇairhi yaṣṭavyamiti niścayaḥ ।
na hi yajñasamaṃ kiñcittriṣu lokeṣu vidyate ॥51॥
slp1: fzayastaM praSaMsanti sADu cEtadasaMSayam । sarvaTA sarvavarRErhi yazwavyamiti niScayaH । na hi yajYasamaM kiYcittrizu lokezu vidyate ॥51॥

text: tasmādyaṣṭavyamityāhuḥ puruṣeṇānasūyatā । śraddhāpavitramāśritya yathāśakti prayacchatā] ॥52॥
html:
tasmādyaṣṭavyamityāhuḥ puruṣeṇānasūyatā ।
śraddhāpavitramāśritya yathāśakti prayacchatā] ॥52॥
slp1: tasmAdyazwavyamityAhuH puruzeRAnasUyatA । SradDApavitramASritya yaTASakti prayacCatA] ॥52॥

text: āśramāṇāṃ mahābāho śṛṇu satyaparākrama । caturṇāmiha varṇānāṃ karmāṇi ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥1॥
html:
āśramāṇāṃ mahābāho śṛṇu satyaparākrama ।
caturṇāmiha varṇānāṃ karmāṇi ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥1॥
slp1: ASramARAM mahAbAho SfRu satyaparAkrama । caturRAmiha varRAnAM karmARi ca yuDizWira ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: vānaprasthaṃ bhaikṣacaryāṃ gārhasthyaṃ ca mahāśramam । brahmacaryāśramaṃ prāhuścaturthaṃ brāhmaṇairvṛtam ॥2॥
html:
vānaprasthaṃ bhaikṣacaryāṃ gārhasthyaṃ ca mahāśramam ।
brahmacaryāśramaṃ prāhuścaturthaṃ brāhmaṇairvṛtam ॥2॥
slp1: vAnaprasTaM BEkzacaryAM gArhasTyaM ca mahASramam । brahmacaryASramaM prAhuScaturTaM brAhmaRErvftam ॥2॥

text: jaṭākaraṇasaṃskāraṃ dvijātitvamavāpya ca । ādhānādīni karmāṇi prāpya vedamadhītya ca ॥3॥
html:
jaṭākaraṇasaṃskāraṃ dvijātitvamavāpya ca ।
ādhānādīni karmāṇi prāpya vedamadhītya ca ॥3॥
slp1: jawAkaraRasaMskAraM dvijAtitvamavApya ca । ADAnAdIni karmARi prApya vedamaDItya ca ॥3॥

text: sadāro vāpyadāro vā ātmavānsaṃyatendriyaḥ । vānaprasthāśramaṃ gacchetkṛtakṛtyo gṛhāśramāt ॥4॥
html:
sadāro vāpyadāro vā ātmavānsaṃyatendriyaḥ ।
vānaprasthāśramaṃ gacchetkṛtakṛtyo gṛhāśramāt ॥4॥
slp1: sadAro vApyadAro vA AtmavAnsaMyatendriyaH । vAnaprasTASramaM gacCetkftakftyo gfhASramAt ॥4॥

text: tatrāraṇyakaśāstrāṇi samadhītya sa dharmavit । ūrdhvaretāḥ prajāyitvā gacchatyakṣarasātmatām ॥5॥
html:
tatrāraṇyakaśāstrāṇi samadhītya sa dharmavit ।
ūrdhvaretāḥ prajāyitvā gacchatyakṣarasātmatām ॥5॥
slp1: tatrAraRyakaSAstrARi samaDItya sa Darmavit । UrDvaretAH prajAyitvA gacCatyakzarasAtmatAm ॥5॥

text: etānyeva nimittāni munīnāmūrdhvaretasām । kartavyānīha vipreṇa rājannādau vipaścitā ॥6॥
html:
etānyeva nimittāni munīnāmūrdhvaretasām ।
kartavyānīha vipreṇa rājannādau vipaścitā ॥6॥
slp1: etAnyeva nimittAni munInAmUrDvaretasAm । kartavyAnIha vipreRa rAjannAdO vipaScitA ॥6॥

text: caritabrahmacaryasya brāhmaṇasya viśāmpate । bhaikṣacaryāsvadhīkāraḥ praśasta iha mokṣiṇaḥ ॥7॥
html:
caritabrahmacaryasya brāhmaṇasya viśāmpate ।
bhaikṣacaryāsvadhīkāraḥ praśasta iha mokṣiṇaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: caritabrahmacaryasya brAhmaRasya viSAmpate । BEkzacaryAsvaDIkAraH praSasta iha mokziRaH ॥7॥

text: yatrāstamitaśāyī syānniragniraniketanaḥ । yathopalabdhajīvī syānmunirdānto jitendriyaḥ ॥8॥
html:
yatrāstamitaśāyī syānniragniraniketanaḥ ।
yathopalabdhajīvī syānmunirdānto jitendriyaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: yatrAstamitaSAyI syAnniragniraniketanaH । yaTopalabDajIvI syAnmunirdAnto jitendriyaH ॥8॥

text: nirāśīḥ syātsarvasamo nirbhogo nirvikāravān । vipraḥ kṣemāśramaṃ prāpto gacchatyakṣarasātmatām ॥9॥
html:
nirāśīḥ syātsarvasamo nirbhogo nirvikāravān ।
vipraḥ kṣemāśramaṃ prāpto gacchatyakṣarasātmatām ॥9॥
slp1: nirASIH syAtsarvasamo nirBogo nirvikAravAn । vipraH kzemASramaM prApto gacCatyakzarasAtmatAm ॥9॥

text: adhītya vedānkṛtasarvakṛtyaḥ santānamutpādya sukhāni bhuktvā । samāhitaḥ pracaredduścaraṃ taṃ gārhasthyadharmaṃ munidharmadṛṣṭam ॥10॥
html:
adhītya vedānkṛtasarvakṛtyaḥ santānamutpādya sukhāni bhuktvā ।
samāhitaḥ pracaredduścaraṃ taṃ gārhasthyadharmaṃ munidharmadṛṣṭam ॥10॥
slp1: aDItya vedAnkftasarvakftyaH santAnamutpAdya suKAni BuktvA । samAhitaH pracaredduScaraM taM gArhasTyaDarmaM muniDarmadfzwam ॥10॥

text: svadāratuṣṭa ṛtukālagāmī niyogasevī naśaṭho najihmaḥ । mitāśano devaparaḥ kṛtajñaḥ satyo mṛduścānṛśaṃsaḥ kṣamāvān ॥11॥
html:
svadāratuṣṭa ṛtukālagāmī niyogasevī naśaṭho najihmaḥ ।
mitāśano devaparaḥ kṛtajñaḥ satyo mṛduścānṛśaṃsaḥ kṣamāvān ॥11॥
slp1: svadAratuzwa ftukAlagAmI niyogasevI naSaWo najihmaH । mitASano devaparaH kftajYaH satyo mfduScAnfSaMsaH kzamAvAn ॥11॥

text: dānto vidheyo havyakavye'pramatto annasya dātā satataṃ dvijebhyaḥ । amatsarī sarvaliṅgipradātā vaitānanityaśca gṛhāśramī syāt ॥12॥
html:
dānto vidheyo havyakavye'pramatto annasya dātā satataṃ dvijebhyaḥ ।
amatsarī sarvaliṅgipradātā vaitānanityaśca gṛhāśramī syāt ॥12॥
slp1: dAnto viDeyo havyakavye'pramatto annasya dAtA satataM dvijeByaH । amatsarI sarvaliNgipradAtA vEtAnanityaSca gfhASramI syAt ॥12॥

text: athātra nārāyaṇagītamāhurmaharṣayastāta mahānubhāvāḥ । mahārthamatyarthatapaḥprayuktaṃ taducyamānaṃ hi mayā nibodha ॥13॥
html:
athātra nārāyaṇagītamāhurmaharṣayastāta mahānubhāvāḥ ।
mahārthamatyarthatapaḥprayuktaṃ taducyamānaṃ hi mayā nibodha ॥13॥
slp1: aTAtra nArAyaRagItamAhurmaharzayastAta mahAnuBAvAH । mahArTamatyarTatapaHprayuktaM taducyamAnaM hi mayA niboDa ॥13॥

text: satyārjavaṃ cātithipūjanaṃ ca dharmastathārthaśca ratiśca dāre । niṣevitavyāni sukhāni loke hyasminpare caiva mataṃ mamaitat ॥14॥
html:
satyārjavaṃ cātithipūjanaṃ ca dharmastathārthaśca ratiśca dāre ।
niṣevitavyāni sukhāni loke hyasminpare caiva mataṃ mamaitat ॥14॥
slp1: satyArjavaM cAtiTipUjanaM ca DarmastaTArTaSca ratiSca dAre । nizevitavyAni suKAni loke hyasminpare cEva mataM mamEtat ॥14॥

text: bharaṇaṃ putradārāṇāṃ vedānāṃ pāraṇaṃ tathā । satāṃ tamāśramaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vadanti paramarṣayaḥ ॥15॥
html:
bharaṇaṃ putradārāṇāṃ vedānāṃ pāraṇaṃ tathā ।
satāṃ tamāśramaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vadanti paramarṣayaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: BaraRaM putradArARAM vedAnAM pAraRaM taTA । satAM tamASramaM SrezWaM vadanti paramarzayaH ॥15॥

text: evaṃ hi yo brāhmaṇo yajñaśīlo gārhasthyamadhyāvasate yathāvat । gṛhasthavṛttiṃ praviśodhya samyaksvarge viśuddhaṃ phalamāpnute saḥ ॥16॥
html:
evaṃ hi yo brāhmaṇo yajñaśīlo gārhasthyamadhyāvasate yathāvat ।
gṛhasthavṛttiṃ praviśodhya samyaksvarge viśuddhaṃ phalamāpnute saḥ ॥16॥
slp1: evaM hi yo brAhmaRo yajYaSIlo gArhasTyamaDyAvasate yaTAvat । gfhasTavfttiM praviSoDya samyaksvarge viSudDaM PalamApnute saH ॥16॥

text: tasya dehaparityāgādiṣṭāḥ kāmākṣayā matāḥ । ānantyāyopatiṣṭhanti sarvatokṣiśiromukhāḥ ॥17॥
html:
tasya dehaparityāgādiṣṭāḥ kāmākṣayā matāḥ ।
ānantyāyopatiṣṭhanti sarvatokṣiśiromukhāḥ ॥17॥
slp1: tasya dehaparityAgAdizwAH kAmAkzayA matAH । AnantyAyopatizWanti sarvatokziSiromuKAH ॥17॥

text: khādanneko japannekaḥ sarpanneko yudhiṣṭhira । ekasminneva ācārye śuśrūṣurmalapaṅkavān ॥18॥
html:
khādanneko japannekaḥ sarpanneko yudhiṣṭhira ।
ekasminneva ācārye śuśrūṣurmalapaṅkavān ॥18॥
slp1: KAdanneko japannekaH sarpanneko yuDizWira । ekasminneva AcArye SuSrUzurmalapaNkavAn ॥18॥

text: brahmacārī vratī nityaṃ nityaṃ dīkṣāparo vaśī । avicārya tathā vedaṃ kṛtyaṃ kurvanvasetsadā ॥19॥
html:
brahmacārī vratī nityaṃ nityaṃ dīkṣāparo vaśī ।
avicārya tathā vedaṃ kṛtyaṃ kurvanvasetsadā ॥19॥
slp1: brahmacArI vratI nityaM nityaM dIkzAparo vaSI । avicArya taTA vedaM kftyaM kurvanvasetsadA ॥19॥

text: śuśrūṣāṃ satataṃ kurvanguroḥ sampraṇameta ca । ṣaṭkarmasvanivṛttaśca napravṛttaśca sarvaśaḥ ॥20॥
html:
śuśrūṣāṃ satataṃ kurvanguroḥ sampraṇameta ca ।
ṣaṭkarmasvanivṛttaśca napravṛttaśca sarvaśaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: SuSrUzAM satataM kurvanguroH sampraRameta ca । zawkarmasvanivfttaSca napravfttaSca sarvaSaH ॥20॥

text: na caratyadhikāreṇa sevitaṃ dviṣato na ca । eṣo''śramapadastāta brahmacāriṇa iṣyate] ॥21॥
html:
na caratyadhikāreṇa sevitaṃ dviṣato na ca ।
eṣo''śramapadastāta brahmacāriṇa iṣyate] ॥21॥
slp1: na caratyaDikAreRa sevitaM dvizato na ca । ezo''SramapadastAta brahmacAriRa izyate] ॥21॥

text: śivānsukhānmahodarkānahiṃsrāṁllokasammatān । brūhi dharmānsukhopāyānmadvidhānāṃ sukhāvahān ॥1॥
html:
śivānsukhānmahodarkānahiṃsrāṁllokasammatān ।
brūhi dharmānsukhopāyānmadvidhānāṃ sukhāvahān ॥1॥
slp1: SivAnsuKAnmahodarkAnahiMsrAṁllokasammatAn । brUhi DarmAnsuKopAyAnmadviDAnAM suKAvahAn ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: brāhmaṇasyeha catvāra āśramā vihitāḥ prabho । varṇāstānanuvartante trayo bharatasattama ॥2॥
html:
brāhmaṇasyeha catvāra āśramā vihitāḥ prabho ।
varṇāstānanuvartante trayo bharatasattama ॥2॥
slp1: brAhmaRasyeha catvAra ASramA vihitAH praBo । varRAstAnanuvartante trayo Baratasattama ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: uktāni karmāṇi bahūni rājansvargyāṇi rājanyaparāyaṇāni । nemāni dṛṣṭāntavidhau smṛtāni kṣātre hi sarvaṃ vihitaṃ yathāvat ॥3॥
html:
uktāni karmāṇi bahūni rājansvargyāṇi rājanyaparāyaṇāni ।
nemāni dṛṣṭāntavidhau smṛtāni kṣātre hi sarvaṃ vihitaṃ yathāvat ॥3॥
slp1: uktAni karmARi bahUni rAjansvargyARi rAjanyaparAyaRAni । nemAni dfzwAntaviDO smftAni kzAtre hi sarvaM vihitaM yaTAvat ॥3॥

text: kṣātrāṇi vaiśyāni ca sevamānaḥ śaudrāṇi karmāṇi ca brāhmaṇaḥ san । asmiṁlloke nindito mandacetāḥ pare ca loke nirayaṃ prayāti ॥4॥
html:
kṣātrāṇi vaiśyāni ca sevamānaḥ śaudrāṇi karmāṇi ca brāhmaṇaḥ san ।
asmiṁlloke nindito mandacetāḥ pare ca loke nirayaṃ prayāti ॥4॥
slp1: kzAtrARi vESyAni ca sevamAnaH SOdrARi karmARi ca brAhmaRaH san । asmiṁlloke nindito mandacetAH pare ca loke nirayaM prayAti ॥4॥

text: yā sañjñā vihitā loke dāse śuni vṛke paśau । vikarmaṇi sthite vipre tāṃ sañjñāṃ kuru pāṇḍava ॥5॥
html:
yā sañjñā vihitā loke dāse śuni vṛke paśau ।
vikarmaṇi sthite vipre tāṃ sañjñāṃ kuru pāṇḍava ॥5॥
slp1: yA saYjYA vihitA loke dAse Suni vfke paSO । vikarmaRi sTite vipre tAM saYjYAM kuru pARqava ॥5॥

text: ṣaṭkarmasampravṛttasya āśrameṣu caturṣvapi । sarvadharmopapannasya sambhūtasya kṛtātmanaḥ ॥6॥
html:
ṣaṭkarmasampravṛttasya āśrameṣu caturṣvapi ।
sarvadharmopapannasya sambhūtasya kṛtātmanaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: zawkarmasampravfttasya ASramezu caturzvapi । sarvaDarmopapannasya samBUtasya kftAtmanaH ॥6॥

text: brāhmaṇasya viśuddhasya tapasyabhiratasya ca । nirāśiṣo vadānyasya lokā hyakṣarasañjñitāḥ ॥7॥
html:
brāhmaṇasya viśuddhasya tapasyabhiratasya ca ।
nirāśiṣo vadānyasya lokā hyakṣarasañjñitāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: brAhmaRasya viSudDasya tapasyaBiratasya ca । nirASizo vadAnyasya lokA hyakzarasaYjYitAH ॥7॥

text: yo yasminkurute karma yādṛśaṃ yena yatra ca । tādṛśaṃ tādṛśenaiva sa guṇaṃ pratipadyate ॥8॥
html:
yo yasminkurute karma yādṛśaṃ yena yatra ca ।
tādṛśaṃ tādṛśenaiva sa guṇaṃ pratipadyate ॥8॥
slp1: yo yasminkurute karma yAdfSaM yena yatra ca । tAdfSaM tAdfSenEva sa guRaM pratipadyate ॥8॥

text: vṛddhyā kṛṣivaṇiktvena jīvasañjīvanena ca । vettumarhasi rājendra svādhyāyagaṇitaṃ mahat ॥9॥
html:
vṛddhyā kṛṣivaṇiktvena jīvasañjīvanena ca ।
vettumarhasi rājendra svādhyāyagaṇitaṃ mahat ॥9॥
slp1: vfdDyA kfzivaRiktvena jIvasaYjIvanena ca । vettumarhasi rAjendra svADyAyagaRitaM mahat ॥9॥

text: kālasañcoditaḥ kālaḥ kālaparyāyaniścitaḥ । uttamādhamamadhyāni karmāṇi kurute'vaśaḥ ॥10॥
html:
kālasañcoditaḥ kālaḥ kālaparyāyaniścitaḥ ।
uttamādhamamadhyāni karmāṇi kurute'vaśaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: kAlasaYcoditaH kAlaH kAlaparyAyaniScitaH । uttamADamamaDyAni karmARi kurute'vaSaH ॥10॥

text: antavanti pradānāni purā śreyaskarāṇi ca । svakarmanirato loko hyakṣaraḥ sarvatomukhaḥ] ॥11॥
html:
antavanti pradānāni purā śreyaskarāṇi ca ।
svakarmanirato loko hyakṣaraḥ sarvatomukhaḥ] ॥11॥
slp1: antavanti pradAnAni purA SreyaskarARi ca । svakarmanirato loko hyakzaraH sarvatomuKaH] ॥11॥

text: jyākarṣaṇaṃ śatrunibarhaṇaṃ ca kṛṣirvaṇijyā paśupālanaṃ ca । śuśrūṣaṇaṃ cāpi tathārthahetorakāryametatparamaṃ dvijasya ॥1॥
html:
jyākarṣaṇaṃ śatrunibarhaṇaṃ ca kṛṣirvaṇijyā paśupālanaṃ ca ।
śuśrūṣaṇaṃ cāpi tathārthahetorakāryametatparamaṃ dvijasya ॥1॥
slp1: jyAkarzaRaM SatrunibarhaRaM ca kfzirvaRijyA paSupAlanaM ca । SuSrUzaRaM cApi taTArTahetorakAryametatparamaM dvijasya ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sevyaṃ tu brahmaṣaṭkarma gṛhasthena manīṣiṇā । kṛtakṛtyasya cāraṇye vāso viprasya śasyate ॥2॥
html:
sevyaṃ tu brahmaṣaṭkarma gṛhasthena manīṣiṇā ।
kṛtakṛtyasya cāraṇye vāso viprasya śasyate ॥2॥
slp1: sevyaM tu brahmazawkarma gfhasTena manIziRA । kftakftyasya cAraRye vAso viprasya Sasyate ॥2॥

text: rājapraiṣyaṃ kṛṣidhanaṃ jīvanaṃ ca vaṇijyayā । kauṭilyaṃ kaulaṭeyaṃ ca kusīdaṃ ca vivarjayet ॥3॥
html:
rājapraiṣyaṃ kṛṣidhanaṃ jīvanaṃ ca vaṇijyayā ।
kauṭilyaṃ kaulaṭeyaṃ ca kusīdaṃ ca vivarjayet ॥3॥
slp1: rAjaprEzyaM kfziDanaM jIvanaM ca vaRijyayA । kOwilyaM kOlaweyaM ca kusIdaM ca vivarjayet ॥3॥

text: śūdro rājanbhavati brahmabandhurduścāritryo yaśca dharmādapetaḥ । vṛṣalīpatiḥ piśuno nartakaśca grāmapraiṣyo yaśca bhavedvikarmā ॥4॥
html:
śūdro rājanbhavati brahmabandhurduścāritryo yaśca dharmādapetaḥ ।
vṛṣalīpatiḥ piśuno nartakaśca grāmapraiṣyo yaśca bhavedvikarmā ॥4॥
slp1: SUdro rAjanBavati brahmabanDurduScAritryo yaSca DarmAdapetaH । vfzalIpatiH piSuno nartakaSca grAmaprEzyo yaSca BavedvikarmA ॥4॥

text: japanvedānajapaṃścāpi rājansamaḥ śūdrairdāsavaccāpi bhojyaḥ । ete sarve śūdrasamā bhavanti rājannetānvarjayeddevakṛtye ॥5॥
html:
japanvedānajapaṃścāpi rājansamaḥ śūdrairdāsavaccāpi bhojyaḥ ।
ete sarve śūdrasamā bhavanti rājannetānvarjayeddevakṛtye ॥5॥
slp1: japanvedAnajapaMScApi rAjansamaH SUdrErdAsavaccApi BojyaH । ete sarve SUdrasamA Bavanti rAjannetAnvarjayeddevakftye ॥5॥

text: nirmaryāde cāśane krūravṛttau hiṃsātmake tyaktadharmasvavṛtte । havyaṃ kavyaṃ yāni cānyāni rājandeyānyadeyāni bhavanti tasmin ॥6॥
html:
nirmaryāde cāśane krūravṛttau hiṃsātmake tyaktadharmasvavṛtte ।
havyaṃ kavyaṃ yāni cānyāni rājandeyānyadeyāni bhavanti tasmin ॥6॥
slp1: nirmaryAde cASane krUravfttO hiMsAtmake tyaktaDarmasvavftte । havyaM kavyaM yAni cAnyAni rAjandeyAnyadeyAni Bavanti tasmin ॥6॥

text: tasmāddharmo vihito brāhmaṇasya damaḥ śaucaṃ cārjavaṃ cāpi rājan । tathā viprasyāśramāḥ sarva eva purā rājanbrahmaṇā vai nisṛṣṭāḥ ॥7॥
html:
tasmāddharmo vihito brāhmaṇasya damaḥ śaucaṃ cārjavaṃ cāpi rājan ।
tathā viprasyāśramāḥ sarva eva purā rājanbrahmaṇā vai nisṛṣṭāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: tasmAdDarmo vihito brAhmaRasya damaH SOcaM cArjavaM cApi rAjan । taTA viprasyASramAH sarva eva purA rAjanbrahmaRA vE nisfzwAH ॥7॥

text: yaḥ syāddāntaḥ somapa āryaśīlaḥ sānukrośaḥ sarvasaho nirāśīḥ । ṛjurmṛduranṛśaṃsaḥ kṣamāvānsa vai vipro netaraḥ pāpakarmā ॥8॥
html:
yaḥ syāddāntaḥ somapa āryaśīlaḥ sānukrośaḥ sarvasaho nirāśīḥ ।
ṛjurmṛduranṛśaṃsaḥ kṣamāvānsa vai vipro netaraḥ pāpakarmā ॥8॥
slp1: yaH syAddAntaH somapa AryaSIlaH sAnukroSaH sarvasaho nirASIH । fjurmfduranfSaMsaH kzamAvAnsa vE vipro netaraH pApakarmA ॥8॥

text: śūdraṃ vaiśyaṃ rājaputraṃ ca rājaṁllokāḥ sarve saṃśritā dharmakāmāḥ । tasmādvarṇāñjātidharmeṣu saktānmatvā viṣṇurnecchati pāṇḍuputra ॥9॥
html:
śūdraṃ vaiśyaṃ rājaputraṃ ca rājaṁllokāḥ sarve saṃśritā dharmakāmāḥ ।
tasmādvarṇāñjātidharmeṣu saktānmatvā viṣṇurnecchati pāṇḍuputra ॥9॥
slp1: SUdraM vESyaM rAjaputraM ca rAjaṁllokAH sarve saMSritA DarmakAmAH । tasmAdvarRAYjAtiDarmezu saktAnmatvA vizRurnecCati pARquputra ॥9॥

text: loke cedaṃ sarvalokasya na syāccāturvarṇyaṃ vedavādāśca na syuḥ । sarvāścejyāḥ sarvalokakriyāśca sadyaḥ sarve cāśramasthā na vai syuḥ ॥10॥
html:
loke cedaṃ sarvalokasya na syāccāturvarṇyaṃ vedavādāśca na syuḥ ।
sarvāścejyāḥ sarvalokakriyāśca sadyaḥ sarve cāśramasthā na vai syuḥ ॥10॥
slp1: loke cedaM sarvalokasya na syAccAturvarRyaM vedavAdASca na syuH । sarvAScejyAH sarvalokakriyASca sadyaH sarve cASramasTA na vE syuH ॥10॥

text: yaśca trayāṇāṃ varṇānāmicchedāśramasevanam । kartumāśramadṛṣṭāṃśca dharmāṃstāñśṛṇu pāṇḍava ॥11॥
html:
yaśca trayāṇāṃ varṇānāmicchedāśramasevanam ।
kartumāśramadṛṣṭāṃśca dharmāṃstāñśṛṇu pāṇḍava ॥11॥
slp1: yaSca trayARAM varRAnAmicCedASramasevanam । kartumASramadfzwAMSca DarmAMstAYSfRu pARqava ॥11॥

text: śuśrūṣākṛtakṛtyasya kṛtasantānakarmaṇaḥ । abhyanujñāpya rājānaṃ śūdrasya jagatīpate ॥12॥
html:
śuśrūṣākṛtakṛtyasya kṛtasantānakarmaṇaḥ ।
abhyanujñāpya rājānaṃ śūdrasya jagatīpate ॥12॥
slp1: SuSrUzAkftakftyasya kftasantAnakarmaRaH । aByanujYApya rAjAnaM SUdrasya jagatIpate ॥12॥

text: alpāntaragatasyāpi daśadharmagatasya vā । āśramā vihitāḥ sarve varjayitvā nirāśiṣam ॥13॥
html:
alpāntaragatasyāpi daśadharmagatasya vā ।
āśramā vihitāḥ sarve varjayitvā nirāśiṣam ॥13॥
slp1: alpAntaragatasyApi daSaDarmagatasya vA । ASramA vihitAH sarve varjayitvA nirASizam ॥13॥

text: bhaikṣacaryāṃ na tu prāhustasya taddharmacāriṇaḥ । tathā vaiśyasya rājendra rājaputrasya caiva hi ॥14॥
html:
bhaikṣacaryāṃ na tu prāhustasya taddharmacāriṇaḥ ।
tathā vaiśyasya rājendra rājaputrasya caiva hi ॥14॥
slp1: BEkzacaryAM na tu prAhustasya tadDarmacAriRaH । taTA vESyasya rAjendra rAjaputrasya cEva hi ॥14॥

text: kṛtakṛtyo vayotīto rājñaḥ kṛtapariśramaḥ । vaiśyo gacchedanujñāto nṛpeṇāśramamaṇḍalam ॥15॥
html:
kṛtakṛtyo vayotīto rājñaḥ kṛtapariśramaḥ ।
vaiśyo gacchedanujñāto nṛpeṇāśramamaṇḍalam ॥15॥
slp1: kftakftyo vayotIto rAjYaH kftapariSramaH । vESyo gacCedanujYAto nfpeRASramamaRqalam ॥15॥

text: vedānadhītya dharmeṇa rājaśāstrāṇi cānagha । santānādīni karmāṇi kṛtvā somaṃ niṣevya ca ॥16॥
html:
vedānadhītya dharmeṇa rājaśāstrāṇi cānagha ।
santānādīni karmāṇi kṛtvā somaṃ niṣevya ca ॥16॥
slp1: vedAnaDItya DarmeRa rAjaSAstrARi cAnaGa । santAnAdIni karmARi kftvA somaM nizevya ca ॥16॥

text: pālayitvā prajāḥ sarvā dharmeṇa vadatāṃ vara । rājasūyāśvamedhādīnmakhānanyāṃstathaiva ca ॥17॥
html:
pālayitvā prajāḥ sarvā dharmeṇa vadatāṃ vara ।
rājasūyāśvamedhādīnmakhānanyāṃstathaiva ca ॥17॥
slp1: pAlayitvA prajAH sarvA DarmeRa vadatAM vara । rAjasUyASvameDAdInmaKAnanyAMstaTEva ca ॥17॥

text: samānīya yathāpāṭhaṃ viprebhyo dattadakṣiṇaḥ । saṅgrāme vijayaṃ prāpya tathālpaṃ yadi vā bahu ॥18॥
html:
samānīya yathāpāṭhaṃ viprebhyo dattadakṣiṇaḥ ।
saṅgrāme vijayaṃ prāpya tathālpaṃ yadi vā bahu ॥18॥
slp1: samAnIya yaTApAWaM vipreByo dattadakziRaH । saNgrAme vijayaM prApya taTAlpaM yadi vA bahu ॥18॥

text: sthāpayitvā prajāpālaṃ putraṃ rājye ca pāṇḍava । anyagotraṃ praśastaṃ vā kṣatriyaṃ kṣatriyarṣabha ॥19॥
html:
sthāpayitvā prajāpālaṃ putraṃ rājye ca pāṇḍava ।
anyagotraṃ praśastaṃ vā kṣatriyaṃ kṣatriyarṣabha ॥19॥
slp1: sTApayitvA prajApAlaM putraM rAjye ca pARqava । anyagotraM praSastaM vA kzatriyaM kzatriyarzaBa ॥19॥

text: arcayitvā pitṝnsamyakpitṛyajñairyathāvidhi । devānyajñairṛṣīnvedairarcitvā caiva yatnataḥ ॥20॥
html:
arcayitvā pitṝnsamyakpitṛyajñairyathāvidhi ।
devānyajñairṛṣīnvedairarcitvā caiva yatnataḥ ॥20॥
slp1: arcayitvA pitFnsamyakpitfyajYEryaTAviDi । devAnyajYErfzInvedErarcitvA cEva yatnataH ॥20॥

text: antakāle ca samprāpte ya icchedāśramāntaram । ānupūrvyāśramānrājangatvā siddhimavāpnuyāt ॥21॥
html:
antakāle ca samprāpte ya icchedāśramāntaram ।
ānupūrvyāśramānrājangatvā siddhimavāpnuyāt ॥21॥
slp1: antakAle ca samprApte ya icCedASramAntaram । AnupUrvyASramAnrAjangatvA sidDimavApnuyAt ॥21॥

text: rājarṣitvena rājendra bhaikṣacaryādhvasevayā । apetagṛhadharmo'pi carejjīvitakāmyayā ॥22॥
html:
rājarṣitvena rājendra bhaikṣacaryādhvasevayā ।
apetagṛhadharmo'pi carejjīvitakāmyayā ॥22॥
slp1: rAjarzitvena rAjendra BEkzacaryADvasevayA । apetagfhaDarmo'pi carejjIvitakAmyayA ॥22॥

text: na caitannaiṣṭhikaṃ karma trayāṇāṃ bharatarṣabha । caturṇāṃ rājaśārdūla prāhurāśramavāsinām ॥23॥
html:
na caitannaiṣṭhikaṃ karma trayāṇāṃ bharatarṣabha ।
caturṇāṃ rājaśārdūla prāhurāśramavāsinām ॥23॥
slp1: na cEtannEzWikaM karma trayARAM BaratarzaBa । caturRAM rAjaSArdUla prAhurASramavAsinAm ॥23॥

text: bahvāyattaṃ kṣatriyairmānavānāṃ lokaśreṣṭhaṃ dharmamāsevamānaiḥ । sarve dharmāḥ sopadharmāstrayāṇāṃ rājño dharmāditi vedācchṛṇomi ॥24॥
html:
bahvāyattaṃ kṣatriyairmānavānāṃ lokaśreṣṭhaṃ dharmamāsevamānaiḥ ।
sarve dharmāḥ sopadharmāstrayāṇāṃ rājño dharmāditi vedācchṛṇomi ॥24॥
slp1: bahvAyattaM kzatriyErmAnavAnAM lokaSrezWaM DarmamAsevamAnEH । sarve DarmAH sopaDarmAstrayARAM rAjYo DarmAditi vedAcCfRomi ॥24॥

text: yathā rājanhastipade padāni saṃlīyante sarvasattvodbhavāni । evaṃ dharmānrājadharmeṣu sarvānsarvāvasthaṃ sampralīnānnibodha ॥25॥
html:
yathā rājanhastipade padāni saṃlīyante sarvasattvodbhavāni ।
evaṃ dharmānrājadharmeṣu sarvānsarvāvasthaṃ sampralīnānnibodha ॥25॥
slp1: yaTA rAjanhastipade padAni saMlIyante sarvasattvodBavAni । evaM DarmAnrAjaDarmezu sarvAnsarvAvasTaM sampralInAnniboDa ॥25॥

text: alpāśrayānalpaphalānvadanti dharmānanyāndharmavido manuṣyāḥ । mahāśrayaṃ bahukalyāṇarūpaṃ kṣātraṃ dharmaṃ netaraṃ prāhurāryāḥ ॥26॥
html:
alpāśrayānalpaphalānvadanti dharmānanyāndharmavido manuṣyāḥ ।
mahāśrayaṃ bahukalyāṇarūpaṃ kṣātraṃ dharmaṃ netaraṃ prāhurāryāḥ ॥26॥
slp1: alpASrayAnalpaPalAnvadanti DarmAnanyAnDarmavido manuzyAH । mahASrayaM bahukalyARarUpaM kzAtraM DarmaM netaraM prAhurAryAH ॥26॥

text: sarve dharmā rājadharmapradhānāḥ sarve dharmāḥ pālyamānā bhavanti । sarvatyāgo rājadharmeṣu rājaṃstyāge cāhurdharmamagryaṃ purāṇam ॥27॥
html:
sarve dharmā rājadharmapradhānāḥ sarve dharmāḥ pālyamānā bhavanti ।
sarvatyāgo rājadharmeṣu rājaṃstyāge cāhurdharmamagryaṃ purāṇam ॥27॥
slp1: sarve DarmA rAjaDarmapraDAnAH sarve DarmAH pAlyamAnA Bavanti । sarvatyAgo rAjaDarmezu rAjaMstyAge cAhurDarmamagryaM purARam ॥27॥

text: majjettrayī daṇḍanītau hatāyāṃ sarve dharmā na bhaveyurviruddhāḥ । sarve dharmāścāśramāṇāṃ gatāḥ syuḥ kṣātre tyakte rājadharme purāṇe ॥28॥
html:
majjettrayī daṇḍanītau hatāyāṃ sarve dharmā na bhaveyurviruddhāḥ ।
sarve dharmāścāśramāṇāṃ gatāḥ syuḥ kṣātre tyakte rājadharme purāṇe ॥28॥
slp1: majjettrayI daRqanItO hatAyAM sarve DarmA na BaveyurvirudDAH । sarve DarmAScASramARAM gatAH syuH kzAtre tyakte rAjaDarme purARe ॥28॥

text: sarve tyāgā rājadharmeṣu dṛṣṭāḥ sarvā dīkṣā rājadharmeṣu coktāḥ । sarve yogā rājadharmeṣu coktāḥ sarve lokā rājadharmānpraviṣṭāḥ ॥29॥
html:
sarve tyāgā rājadharmeṣu dṛṣṭāḥ sarvā dīkṣā rājadharmeṣu coktāḥ ।
sarve yogā rājadharmeṣu coktāḥ sarve lokā rājadharmānpraviṣṭāḥ ॥29॥
slp1: sarve tyAgA rAjaDarmezu dfzwAH sarvA dIkzA rAjaDarmezu coktAH । sarve yogA rAjaDarmezu coktAH sarve lokA rAjaDarmAnpravizwAH ॥29॥

text: yathā jīvāḥ prakṛtau vadhyamānā dharmāśritānāmupapīḍanāya । evaṃ dharmā rājadharmairviyuktāḥ sarvāvasthaṃ nādriyante svadharmam ] ॥30॥
html:
yathā jīvāḥ prakṛtau vadhyamānā dharmāśritānāmupapīḍanāya ।
evaṃ dharmā rājadharmairviyuktāḥ sarvāvasthaṃ nādriyante svadharmam ] ॥30॥
slp1: yaTA jIvAH prakftO vaDyamAnA DarmASritAnAmupapIqanAya । evaM DarmA rAjaDarmErviyuktAH sarvAvasTaM nAdriyante svaDarmam ] ॥30॥

text: cāturāśramyadharmāśca jātidharmāśca pāṇḍava । lokapālottarāścaiva kṣātre dharme vyavasthitāḥ ॥1॥
html:
cāturāśramyadharmāśca jātidharmāśca pāṇḍava ।
lokapālottarāścaiva kṣātre dharme vyavasthitāḥ ॥1॥
slp1: cAturASramyaDarmASca jAtiDarmASca pARqava । lokapAlottarAScEva kzAtre Darme vyavasTitAH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sarvāṇyetāni dharmāṇi kṣātre bharatasattama । nirāśiṣo jīvaloke kṣātre dharme vyavasthitāḥ ॥2॥
html:
sarvāṇyetāni dharmāṇi kṣātre bharatasattama ।
nirāśiṣo jīvaloke kṣātre dharme vyavasthitāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: sarvARyetAni DarmARi kzAtre Baratasattama । nirASizo jIvaloke kzAtre Darme vyavasTitAH ॥2॥

text: apratyakṣaṃ bahudvāraṃ dharmamāśramavāsinām । prarūpayanti tadbhāvamāgamaireva śāśvatam ॥3॥
html:
apratyakṣaṃ bahudvāraṃ dharmamāśramavāsinām ।
prarūpayanti tadbhāvamāgamaireva śāśvatam ॥3॥
slp1: apratyakzaM bahudvAraM DarmamASramavAsinAm । prarUpayanti tadBAvamAgamEreva SASvatam ॥3॥

text: apare vacanaiḥ puṇyairvādino lokaniścayam । aniścayajñā dharmāṇāmadṛṣṭānte pare ratāḥ ॥4॥
html:
apare vacanaiḥ puṇyairvādino lokaniścayam ।
aniścayajñā dharmāṇāmadṛṣṭānte pare ratāḥ ॥4॥
slp1: apare vacanEH puRyErvAdino lokaniScayam । aniScayajYA DarmARAmadfzwAnte pare ratAH ॥4॥

text: pratyakṣasukhabhūyiṣṭhamātmasākṣikamacchalam । sarvalokahitaṃ dharmaṃ kṣatriyeṣu pratiṣṭhitam ॥5॥
html:
pratyakṣasukhabhūyiṣṭhamātmasākṣikamacchalam ।
sarvalokahitaṃ dharmaṃ kṣatriyeṣu pratiṣṭhitam ॥5॥
slp1: pratyakzasuKaBUyizWamAtmasAkzikamacCalam । sarvalokahitaM DarmaM kzatriyezu pratizWitam ॥5॥

text: dharmāśramavyavasināṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira । yathā trayāṇāṃ varṇānāṃ saṅkhyātopaśrutiḥ purā । rājadharmeṣvanupamā lokyā sucaritairiha ॥6॥
html:
dharmāśramavyavasināṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
yathā trayāṇāṃ varṇānāṃ saṅkhyātopaśrutiḥ purā ।
rājadharmeṣvanupamā lokyā sucaritairiha ॥6॥
slp1: DarmASramavyavasinAM brAhmaRAnAM yuDizWira । yaTA trayARAM varRAnAM saNKyAtopaSrutiH purA । rAjaDarmezvanupamA lokyA sucaritEriha ॥6॥

text: udāhṛtaṃ te rājendra yathā viṣṇuṃ mahaujasam । sarvabhūteśvaraṃ devaṃ prabhuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ purā । jagmuḥ subahavaḥ śūrā rājāno daṇḍanītaye ॥7॥
html:
udāhṛtaṃ te rājendra yathā viṣṇuṃ mahaujasam ।
sarvabhūteśvaraṃ devaṃ prabhuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ purā ।
jagmuḥ subahavaḥ śūrā rājāno daṇḍanītaye ॥7॥
slp1: udAhftaM te rAjendra yaTA vizRuM mahOjasam । sarvaBUteSvaraM devaM praBuM nArAyaRaM purA । jagmuH subahavaH SUrA rAjAno daRqanItaye ॥7॥

text: ekaikamātmanaḥ karma tulayitvāśrame purā । rājānaḥ paryupātiṣṭhandṛṣṭāntavacane sthitāḥ ॥8॥
html:
ekaikamātmanaḥ karma tulayitvāśrame purā ।
rājānaḥ paryupātiṣṭhandṛṣṭāntavacane sthitāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: ekEkamAtmanaH karma tulayitvASrame purA । rAjAnaH paryupAtizWandfzwAntavacane sTitAH ॥8॥

text: sādhyā devā vasavaścāśvinau ca rudrāśca viśve marutāṃ gaṇāśca । sṛṣṭāḥ purā ādidevena devā kṣātre dharme vartayante ca siddhāḥ ॥9॥
html:
sādhyā devā vasavaścāśvinau ca rudrāśca viśve marutāṃ gaṇāśca ।
sṛṣṭāḥ purā ādidevena devā kṣātre dharme vartayante ca siddhāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: sADyA devA vasavaScASvinO ca rudrASca viSve marutAM gaRASca । sfzwAH purA Adidevena devA kzAtre Darme vartayante ca sidDAH ॥9॥

text: atra te vartayiṣyāmi dharmamarthaviniścayam । nirmaryāde vartamāne dānavaikāyane kṛte । babhūva rājā rājendra māndhātā nāma vīryavān ॥10॥
html:
atra te vartayiṣyāmi dharmamarthaviniścayam ।
nirmaryāde vartamāne dānavaikāyane kṛte ।
babhūva rājā rājendra māndhātā nāma vīryavān ॥10॥
slp1: atra te vartayizyAmi DarmamarTaviniScayam । nirmaryAde vartamAne dAnavEkAyane kfte । baBUva rAjA rAjendra mAnDAtA nAma vIryavAn ॥10॥

text: purā vasumatīpālo yajñaṃ cakre didṛkṣayā । anādimadhyanidhanaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prati ॥11॥
html:
purā vasumatīpālo yajñaṃ cakre didṛkṣayā ।
anādimadhyanidhanaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prati ॥11॥
slp1: purA vasumatIpAlo yajYaM cakre didfkzayA । anAdimaDyaniDanaM devaM nArAyaRaM prati ॥11॥

text: sa rājā rājaśārdūla māndhātā parameṣṭhinaḥ । jagrāha śirasā pādau yajñe viṣṇormahātmanaḥ ॥12॥
html:
sa rājā rājaśārdūla māndhātā parameṣṭhinaḥ ।
jagrāha śirasā pādau yajñe viṣṇormahātmanaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: sa rAjA rAjaSArdUla mAnDAtA paramezWinaH । jagrAha SirasA pAdO yajYe vizRormahAtmanaH ॥12॥

text: darśayāmāsa taṃ viṣṇū rūpamāsthāya vāsavam । sa pārthivairvṛtaḥ sadbhirarcayāmāsa taṃ prabhum ॥13॥
html:
darśayāmāsa taṃ viṣṇū rūpamāsthāya vāsavam ।
sa pārthivairvṛtaḥ sadbhirarcayāmāsa taṃ prabhum ॥13॥
slp1: darSayAmAsa taM vizRU rUpamAsTAya vAsavam । sa pArTivErvftaH sadBirarcayAmAsa taM praBum ॥13॥

text: tasya pārthivasaṅghasya tasya caiva mahātmanaḥ । saṃvādo'yaṃ mahānāsīdviṣṇuṃ prati mahādyute ॥14॥
html:
tasya pārthivasaṅghasya tasya caiva mahātmanaḥ ।
saṃvādo'yaṃ mahānāsīdviṣṇuṃ prati mahādyute ॥14॥
slp1: tasya pArTivasaNGasya tasya cEva mahAtmanaH । saMvAdo'yaM mahAnAsIdvizRuM prati mahAdyute ॥14॥

text: kimiṣyate dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha yaddraṣṭukāmo'si tamaprameyam । anantamāyāmitasattvavīryaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ hyādidevaṃ purāṇam ॥15॥
html:
kimiṣyate dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha yaddraṣṭukāmo'si tamaprameyam ।
anantamāyāmitasattvavīryaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ hyādidevaṃ purāṇam ॥15॥
slp1: kimizyate DarmaBftAM varizWa yaddrazwukAmo'si tamaprameyam । anantamAyAmitasattvavIryaM nArAyaRaM hyAdidevaM purARam ॥15॥
author: indra uvāca ।

text: nāsau devo viśvarūpo mayāpi śakyo draṣṭuṃ brahmaṇā vāpi sākṣāt । ye'nye kāmāstava rājanhṛdisthā dāsyāmi tāṃstvaṃ hi martyeṣu rājā ॥16॥
html:
nāsau devo viśvarūpo mayāpi śakyo draṣṭuṃ brahmaṇā vāpi sākṣāt ।
ye'nye kāmāstava rājanhṛdisthā dāsyāmi tāṃstvaṃ hi martyeṣu rājā ॥16॥
slp1: nAsO devo viSvarUpo mayApi Sakyo drazwuM brahmaRA vApi sAkzAt । ye'nye kAmAstava rAjanhfdisTA dAsyAmi tAMstvaM hi martyezu rAjA ॥16॥

text: satye sthito dharmaparo jitendriyaḥ śūro dṛḍhaṃ prītirataḥ surāṇām । buddhyā bhaktyā cottamaśraddhayā ca tataste'haṃ dadmi varaṃ yatheṣṭam ॥17॥
html:
satye sthito dharmaparo jitendriyaḥ śūro dṛḍhaṃ prītirataḥ surāṇām ।
buddhyā bhaktyā cottamaśraddhayā ca tataste'haṃ dadmi varaṃ yatheṣṭam ॥17॥
slp1: satye sTito Darmaparo jitendriyaH SUro dfQaM prItirataH surARAm । budDyA BaktyA cottamaSradDayA ca tataste'haM dadmi varaM yaTezwam ॥17॥

text: asaṃśayaṃ bhagavannādidevaṃ drakṣyāmyahaṃ śirasāhaṃ prasādya । tyaktvā bhogāndharmakāmo hyaraṇyamicche gantuṃ satpathaṃ lokajuṣṭam ॥18॥
html:
asaṃśayaṃ bhagavannādidevaṃ drakṣyāmyahaṃ śirasāhaṃ prasādya ।
tyaktvā bhogāndharmakāmo hyaraṇyamicche gantuṃ satpathaṃ lokajuṣṭam ॥18॥
slp1: asaMSayaM BagavannAdidevaM drakzyAmyahaM SirasAhaM prasAdya । tyaktvA BogAnDarmakAmo hyaraRyamicCe gantuM satpaTaM lokajuzwam ॥18॥
author: māndhātovāca ।

text: kṣātrāddharmādvipulādaprameyāllokāḥ prāptāḥ sthāpitaṃ svaṃ yaśaśca । dharmo yo'sāvādidevātpravṛtto lokajyeṣṭhastaṃ na jānāmi kartum ॥19॥
html:
kṣātrāddharmādvipulādaprameyāllokāḥ prāptāḥ sthāpitaṃ svaṃ yaśaśca ।
dharmo yo'sāvādidevātpravṛtto lokajyeṣṭhastaṃ na jānāmi kartum ॥19॥
slp1: kzAtrAdDarmAdvipulAdaprameyAllokAH prAptAH sTApitaM svaM yaSaSca । Darmo yo'sAvAdidevAtpravftto lokajyezWastaM na jAnAmi kartum ॥19॥

text: asainiko'dharmaparaścarethāḥ parāṃ gatiṃ lapsyase cāpramattaḥ । kṣātro dharmo hyādidevātpravṛttaḥ paścādanye śeṣabhūtāśca dharmāḥ ॥20॥
html:
asainiko'dharmaparaścarethāḥ parāṃ gatiṃ lapsyase cāpramattaḥ ।
kṣātro dharmo hyādidevātpravṛttaḥ paścādanye śeṣabhūtāśca dharmāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: asEniko'DarmaparaScareTAH parAM gatiM lapsyase cApramattaH । kzAtro Darmo hyAdidevAtpravfttaH paScAdanye SezaBUtASca DarmAH ॥20॥
author: indra uvāca ।

text: śeṣāḥ sṛṣṭā hyantavanto hyanantāḥ suprasthānāḥ kṣatradharmāviśiṣṭāḥ । asmindharme sarvadharmāḥ praviṣṭāstasmāddharmaṃ śreṣṭhamimaṃ vadanti ॥21॥
html:
śeṣāḥ sṛṣṭā hyantavanto hyanantāḥ suprasthānāḥ kṣatradharmāviśiṣṭāḥ ।
asmindharme sarvadharmāḥ praviṣṭāstasmāddharmaṃ śreṣṭhamimaṃ vadanti ॥21॥
slp1: SezAH sfzwA hyantavanto hyanantAH suprasTAnAH kzatraDarmAviSizwAH । asminDarme sarvaDarmAH pravizwAstasmAdDarmaM SrezWamimaM vadanti ॥21॥

text: karmaṇā vai purā devā ṛṣayaścāmitaujasaḥ । trātāḥ sarve pramathyārīnkṣatradharmeṇa viṣṇunā ॥22॥
html:
karmaṇā vai purā devā ṛṣayaścāmitaujasaḥ ।
trātāḥ sarve pramathyārīnkṣatradharmeṇa viṣṇunā ॥22॥
slp1: karmaRA vE purA devA fzayaScAmitOjasaH । trAtAH sarve pramaTyArInkzatraDarmeRa vizRunA ॥22॥

text: yadi hyasau bhagavānnāhaniṣyadripūnsarvānvasumānaprameyaḥ । na brāhmaṇā na ca lokādikartā na saddharmā nādidharmā bhaveyuḥ ॥23॥
html:
yadi hyasau bhagavānnāhaniṣyadripūnsarvānvasumānaprameyaḥ ।
na brāhmaṇā na ca lokādikartā na saddharmā nādidharmā bhaveyuḥ ॥23॥
slp1: yadi hyasO BagavAnnAhanizyadripUnsarvAnvasumAnaprameyaH । na brAhmaRA na ca lokAdikartA na sadDarmA nAdiDarmA BaveyuH ॥23॥

text: imāmurvīṃ na jayedvikrameṇa devaśreṣṭho'sau purā cedameyaḥ । cāturvarṇyaṃ cāturāśramyadharmāḥ sarve na syurbrahmaṇo vai vināśāt ॥24॥
html:
imāmurvīṃ na jayedvikrameṇa devaśreṣṭho'sau purā cedameyaḥ ।
cāturvarṇyaṃ cāturāśramyadharmāḥ sarve na syurbrahmaṇo vai vināśāt ॥24॥
slp1: imAmurvIM na jayedvikrameRa devaSrezWo'sO purA cedameyaH । cAturvarRyaM cAturASramyaDarmAH sarve na syurbrahmaRo vE vinASAt ॥24॥

text: dṛṣṭā dharmāḥ śatadhā śāśvatena kṣātreṇa dharmeṇa punaḥ pravṛttāḥ । yuge yuge hyādidharmāḥ pravṛttā lokajyeṣṭhaṃ kṣatradharmaṃ vadanti ॥25॥
html:
dṛṣṭā dharmāḥ śatadhā śāśvatena kṣātreṇa dharmeṇa punaḥ pravṛttāḥ ।
yuge yuge hyādidharmāḥ pravṛttā lokajyeṣṭhaṃ kṣatradharmaṃ vadanti ॥25॥
slp1: dfzwA DarmAH SataDA SASvatena kzAtreRa DarmeRa punaH pravfttAH । yuge yuge hyAdiDarmAH pravfttA lokajyezWaM kzatraDarmaM vadanti ॥25॥

text: ātmatyāgaḥ sarvabhūtānukampā lokajñānaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ pālanaṃ ca । viṣaṇṇānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ pīḍitānāṃ kṣātre dharme vidyate pārthivānām ॥26॥
html:
ātmatyāgaḥ sarvabhūtānukampā lokajñānaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ pālanaṃ ca ।
viṣaṇṇānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ pīḍitānāṃ kṣātre dharme vidyate pārthivānām ॥26॥
slp1: AtmatyAgaH sarvaBUtAnukampA lokajYAnaM mokzaRaM pAlanaM ca । vizaRRAnAM mokzaRaM pIqitAnAM kzAtre Darme vidyate pArTivAnAm ॥26॥

text: nirmaryādāḥ kāmamanyupravṛttā bhītā rājño nādhigacchanti pāpam । śiṣṭāścānye sarvadharmopapannāḥ sādhvācārāḥ sādhu dharmaṃ caranti ॥27॥
html:
nirmaryādāḥ kāmamanyupravṛttā bhītā rājño nādhigacchanti pāpam ।
śiṣṭāścānye sarvadharmopapannāḥ sādhvācārāḥ sādhu dharmaṃ caranti ॥27॥
slp1: nirmaryAdAH kAmamanyupravfttA BItA rAjYo nADigacCanti pApam । SizwAScAnye sarvaDarmopapannAH sADvAcArAH sADu DarmaM caranti ॥27॥

text: putravatparipālyāni liṅgadharmeṇa pārthivaiḥ । loke bhūtāni sarvāṇi vicaranti na saṃśayaḥ ॥28॥
html:
putravatparipālyāni liṅgadharmeṇa pārthivaiḥ ।
loke bhūtāni sarvāṇi vicaranti na saṃśayaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: putravatparipAlyAni liNgaDarmeRa pArTivEH । loke BUtAni sarvARi vicaranti na saMSayaH ॥28॥

text: sarvadharmaparaṃ kṣatraṃ lokajyeṣṭhaṃ sanātanam । śaśvadakṣaraparyantamakṣaraṃ sarvatomukham] ॥29॥
html:
sarvadharmaparaṃ kṣatraṃ lokajyeṣṭhaṃ sanātanam ।
śaśvadakṣaraparyantamakṣaraṃ sarvatomukham] ॥29॥
slp1: sarvaDarmaparaM kzatraM lokajyezWaM sanAtanam । SaSvadakzaraparyantamakzaraM sarvatomuKam] ॥29॥

text: evaṃvīryaḥ sarvadharmopapannaḥ kṣātraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvadharmeṣu dharmaḥ । pālyo yuṣmābhirlokasiṃhairudārairviparyaye syādabhāvaḥ prajānām ॥1॥
html:
evaṃvīryaḥ sarvadharmopapannaḥ kṣātraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvadharmeṣu dharmaḥ ।
pālyo yuṣmābhirlokasiṃhairudārairviparyaye syādabhāvaḥ prajānām ॥1॥
slp1: evaMvIryaH sarvaDarmopapannaH kzAtraH SrezWaH sarvaDarmezu DarmaH । pAlyo yuzmABirlokasiMhErudArErviparyaye syAdaBAvaH prajAnAm ॥1॥
author: indra uvāca ।

text: bhuvaḥ saṃskāraṃ rājasaṃskārayogamabhaikṣacaryāṃ pālanaṃ ca prajānām । vidyādrājā sarvabhūtānukampāṃ dehatyāgaṃ cāhave dharmamagryam ॥2॥
html:
bhuvaḥ saṃskāraṃ rājasaṃskārayogamabhaikṣacaryāṃ pālanaṃ ca prajānām ।
vidyādrājā sarvabhūtānukampāṃ dehatyāgaṃ cāhave dharmamagryam ॥2॥
slp1: BuvaH saMskAraM rAjasaMskArayogamaBEkzacaryAM pAlanaM ca prajAnAm । vidyAdrAjA sarvaBUtAnukampAM dehatyAgaM cAhave Darmamagryam ॥2॥

text: tyāgaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ munayo vai vadanti sarvaśreṣṭho yaḥ śarīraṃ tyajeta । nityaṃ tyaktaṃ rājadharmeṣu sarvaṃ pratyakṣaṃ te bhūmipālāḥ sadaite ॥3॥
html:
tyāgaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ munayo vai vadanti sarvaśreṣṭho yaḥ śarīraṃ tyajeta ।
nityaṃ tyaktaṃ rājadharmeṣu sarvaṃ pratyakṣaṃ te bhūmipālāḥ sadaite ॥3॥
slp1: tyAgaM SrezWaM munayo vE vadanti sarvaSrezWo yaH SarIraM tyajeta । nityaM tyaktaM rAjaDarmezu sarvaM pratyakzaM te BUmipAlAH sadEte ॥3॥

text: bahuśrutyā guruśuśrūṣayā vā parasya vā saṃhananādvadanti । nityaṃ dharmaṃ kṣatriyo brahmacārī caredeko hyāśramaṃ dharmakāmaḥ ॥4॥
html:
bahuśrutyā guruśuśrūṣayā vā parasya vā saṃhananādvadanti ।
nityaṃ dharmaṃ kṣatriyo brahmacārī caredeko hyāśramaṃ dharmakāmaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: bahuSrutyA guruSuSrUzayA vA parasya vA saMhananAdvadanti । nityaM DarmaM kzatriyo brahmacArI caredeko hyASramaM DarmakAmaH ॥4॥

text: sāmānyārthe vyavahāre pravṛtte priyāpriye varjayanneva yatnāt । cāturvarṇyasthāpanātpālanācca taistairyogairniyamairaurasaiśca ॥5॥
html:
sāmānyārthe vyavahāre pravṛtte priyāpriye varjayanneva yatnāt ।
cāturvarṇyasthāpanātpālanācca taistairyogairniyamairaurasaiśca ॥5॥
slp1: sAmAnyArTe vyavahAre pravftte priyApriye varjayanneva yatnAt । cAturvarRyasTApanAtpAlanAcca tEstEryogErniyamErOrasESca ॥5॥

text: sarvodyogairāśramaṃ dharmamāhuḥ kṣātraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ sarvadharmopapannam । svaṃ svaṃ dharmaṃ ye na caranti varṇāstāṃstāndharmānayathāvadvadanti ॥6॥
html:
sarvodyogairāśramaṃ dharmamāhuḥ kṣātraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ sarvadharmopapannam ।
svaṃ svaṃ dharmaṃ ye na caranti varṇāstāṃstāndharmānayathāvadvadanti ॥6॥
slp1: sarvodyogErASramaM DarmamAhuH kzAtraM jyezWaM sarvaDarmopapannam । svaM svaM DarmaM ye na caranti varRAstAMstAnDarmAnayaTAvadvadanti ॥6॥

text: nirmaryāde nityamarthe vinaṣṭānāhustānvai paśubhūtānmanuṣyān । yathā nītiṃ gamayatyarthalobhācchreyāṃstasmādāśramaḥ kṣatradharmaḥ ॥7॥
html:
nirmaryāde nityamarthe vinaṣṭānāhustānvai paśubhūtānmanuṣyān ।
yathā nītiṃ gamayatyarthalobhācchreyāṃstasmādāśramaḥ kṣatradharmaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: nirmaryAde nityamarTe vinazwAnAhustAnvE paSuBUtAnmanuzyAn । yaTA nItiM gamayatyarTaloBAcCreyAMstasmAdASramaH kzatraDarmaH ॥7॥

text: traividyānāṃ yā gatirbrāhmaṇānāṃ yaścaivokto'thāśramo brāhmaṇānām । etatkarma brāhmaṇasyāhuragryamanyatkurvañśūdravacchastravadhyaḥ ॥8॥
html:
traividyānāṃ yā gatirbrāhmaṇānāṃ yaścaivokto'thāśramo brāhmaṇānām ।
etatkarma brāhmaṇasyāhuragryamanyatkurvañśūdravacchastravadhyaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: trEvidyAnAM yA gatirbrAhmaRAnAM yaScEvokto'TASramo brAhmaRAnAm । etatkarma brAhmaRasyAhuragryamanyatkurvaYSUdravacCastravaDyaH ॥8॥

text: cāturāśramyadharmāśca vedadharmāśca pārthiva । brāhmaṇenānugantavyā nānyo vidyātkathañcana ॥9॥
html:
cāturāśramyadharmāśca vedadharmāśca pārthiva ।
brāhmaṇenānugantavyā nānyo vidyātkathañcana ॥9॥
slp1: cAturASramyaDarmASca vedaDarmASca pArTiva । brAhmaRenAnugantavyA nAnyo vidyAtkaTaYcana ॥9॥

text: anyathā vartamānasya na sā vṛttiḥ prakalpyate । karmaṇā vyajyate dharmo yathaiva śvā tathaiva saḥ ॥10॥
html:
anyathā vartamānasya na sā vṛttiḥ prakalpyate ।
karmaṇā vyajyate dharmo yathaiva śvā tathaiva saḥ ॥10॥
slp1: anyaTA vartamAnasya na sA vfttiH prakalpyate । karmaRA vyajyate Darmo yaTEva SvA taTEva saH ॥10॥

text: yo vikarmasthito vipro na sa sanmānamarhati । karmasvanupayuñjānamaviśvāsyaṃ hi taṃ viduḥ ॥11॥
html:
yo vikarmasthito vipro na sa sanmānamarhati ।
karmasvanupayuñjānamaviśvāsyaṃ hi taṃ viduḥ ॥11॥
slp1: yo vikarmasTito vipro na sa sanmAnamarhati । karmasvanupayuYjAnamaviSvAsyaM hi taM viduH ॥11॥

text: ete dharmāḥ sarvavarṇāśca vīrairutkraṣṭavyāḥ kṣatriyaireṣa dharmaḥ । tasmājjyeṣṭhā rājadharmā na cānye vīryajyeṣṭhā vīradharmā matā me ॥12॥
html:
ete dharmāḥ sarvavarṇāśca vīrairutkraṣṭavyāḥ kṣatriyaireṣa dharmaḥ ।
tasmājjyeṣṭhā rājadharmā na cānye vīryajyeṣṭhā vīradharmā matā me ॥12॥
slp1: ete DarmAH sarvavarRASca vIrErutkrazwavyAH kzatriyEreza DarmaH । tasmAjjyezWA rAjaDarmA na cAnye vIryajyezWA vIraDarmA matA me ॥12॥

text: yavanāḥ kirātā gāndhārāścīnāḥ śabarabarbarāḥ । śakāstuṣārāḥ kahvāśca pahlavāścāndhramadrakāḥ ॥13॥
html:
yavanāḥ kirātā gāndhārāścīnāḥ śabarabarbarāḥ ।
śakāstuṣārāḥ kahvāśca pahlavāścāndhramadrakāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: yavanAH kirAtA gAnDArAScInAH SabarabarbarAH । SakAstuzArAH kahvASca pahlavAScAnDramadrakAH ॥13॥
author: māndhātovāca ।

text: oḍrāḥ pulindā ramaṭhāḥ kācā mlecchāśca sarvaśaḥ । brahmakṣatraprasūtāśca vaiśyāḥ śūdrāśca mānavāḥ ॥14॥
html:
oḍrāḥ pulindā ramaṭhāḥ kācā mlecchāśca sarvaśaḥ ।
brahmakṣatraprasūtāśca vaiśyāḥ śūdrāśca mānavāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: oqrAH pulindA ramaWAH kAcA mlecCASca sarvaSaH । brahmakzatraprasUtASca vESyAH SUdrASca mAnavAH ॥14॥

text: kathaṃ dharmaṃ careyuste sarve viṣayavāsinaḥ । madvidhaiśca kathaṃ sthāpyāḥ sarve te dasyujīvinaḥ ॥15॥
html:
kathaṃ dharmaṃ careyuste sarve viṣayavāsinaḥ ।
madvidhaiśca kathaṃ sthāpyāḥ sarve te dasyujīvinaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: kaTaM DarmaM careyuste sarve vizayavAsinaH । madviDESca kaTaM sTApyAH sarve te dasyujIvinaH ॥15॥

text: etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ bhagavaṃstadbravīhi me । tvaṃ bandhubhūto hyasmākaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ sureśvara ॥16॥
html:
etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ bhagavaṃstadbravīhi me ।
tvaṃ bandhubhūto hyasmākaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ sureśvara ॥16॥
slp1: etadicCAmyahaM SrotuM BagavaMstadbravIhi me । tvaM banDuBUto hyasmAkaM kzatriyARAM sureSvara ॥16॥

text: mātāpitrorhi kartavyā śuśrūṣā sarvadasyubhiḥ । ācāryaguruśuśrūṣā tathaivāśramavāsinām ॥17॥
html:
mātāpitrorhi kartavyā śuśrūṣā sarvadasyubhiḥ ।
ācāryaguruśuśrūṣā tathaivāśramavāsinām ॥17॥
slp1: mAtApitrorhi kartavyA SuSrUzA sarvadasyuBiH । AcAryaguruSuSrUzA taTEvASramavAsinAm ॥17॥
author: indra uvāca ।

text: bhūmipālānāṃ ca śuśrūṣā kartavyā sarvadasyubhiḥ । vedadharmakriyāścaiva teṣāṃ dharmo vidhīyate ॥18॥
html:
bhūmipālānāṃ ca śuśrūṣā kartavyā sarvadasyubhiḥ ।
vedadharmakriyāścaiva teṣāṃ dharmo vidhīyate ॥18॥
slp1: BUmipAlAnAM ca SuSrUzA kartavyA sarvadasyuBiH । vedaDarmakriyAScEva tezAM Darmo viDIyate ॥18॥

text: pitṛyajñāstathā kūpāḥ prapāśca śayanāni ca । dānāni ca yathākālaṃ dvijeṣu dadyureva te ॥19॥
html:
pitṛyajñāstathā kūpāḥ prapāśca śayanāni ca ।
dānāni ca yathākālaṃ dvijeṣu dadyureva te ॥19॥
slp1: pitfyajYAstaTA kUpAH prapASca SayanAni ca । dAnAni ca yaTAkAlaM dvijezu dadyureva te ॥19॥

text: ahiṃsā satyamakrodho vṛttidāyānupālanam । bharaṇaṃ putradārāṇāṃ śaucamadroha eva ca ॥20॥
html:
ahiṃsā satyamakrodho vṛttidāyānupālanam ।
bharaṇaṃ putradārāṇāṃ śaucamadroha eva ca ॥20॥
slp1: ahiMsA satyamakroDo vfttidAyAnupAlanam । BaraRaM putradArARAM SOcamadroha eva ca ॥20॥

text: dakṣiṇā sarvayajñānāṃ dātavyā bhūtimicchatā । pākayajñā mahārhāśca kartavyāḥ sarvadasyubhiḥ ॥21॥
html:
dakṣiṇā sarvayajñānāṃ dātavyā bhūtimicchatā ।
pākayajñā mahārhāśca kartavyāḥ sarvadasyubhiḥ ॥21॥
slp1: dakziRA sarvayajYAnAM dAtavyA BUtimicCatA । pAkayajYA mahArhASca kartavyAH sarvadasyuBiH ॥21॥

text: etānyevaṃprakārāṇi vihitāni purānagha । sarvalokasya karmāṇi kartavyānīha pārthiva ॥22॥
html:
etānyevaṃprakārāṇi vihitāni purānagha ।
sarvalokasya karmāṇi kartavyānīha pārthiva ॥22॥
slp1: etAnyevaMprakArARi vihitAni purAnaGa । sarvalokasya karmARi kartavyAnIha pArTiva ॥22॥

text: dṛśyante mānavā loke sarvavarṇeṣu dasyavaḥ । liṅgāntare vartamānā āśrameṣu caturṣvapi ॥23॥
html:
dṛśyante mānavā loke sarvavarṇeṣu dasyavaḥ ।
liṅgāntare vartamānā āśrameṣu caturṣvapi ॥23॥
slp1: dfSyante mAnavA loke sarvavarRezu dasyavaH । liNgAntare vartamAnA ASramezu caturzvapi ॥23॥
author: māndhātovāca ।

text: vinaṣṭāyāṃ daṇḍanītau rājadharme nirākṛte । sampramuhyanti bhūtāni rājadaurātmyato nṛpa ॥24॥
html:
vinaṣṭāyāṃ daṇḍanītau rājadharme nirākṛte ।
sampramuhyanti bhūtāni rājadaurātmyato nṛpa ॥24॥
slp1: vinazwAyAM daRqanItO rAjaDarme nirAkfte । sampramuhyanti BUtAni rAjadOrAtmyato nfpa ॥24॥
author: indra uvāca ।

text: asaṅkhyātā bhaviṣyanti bhikṣavo liṅginastathā । āśramāṇāṃ vikalpāśca nivṛtte'sminkṛte yuge ॥25॥
html:
asaṅkhyātā bhaviṣyanti bhikṣavo liṅginastathā ।
āśramāṇāṃ vikalpāśca nivṛtte'sminkṛte yuge ॥25॥
slp1: asaNKyAtA Bavizyanti Bikzavo liNginastaTA । ASramARAM vikalpASca nivftte'sminkfte yuge ॥25॥

text: aśṛṇvānāḥ purāṇānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ pravarā gatīḥ । utpathaṃ pratipatsyante kāmamanyusamīritāḥ ॥26॥
html:
aśṛṇvānāḥ purāṇānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ pravarā gatīḥ ।
utpathaṃ pratipatsyante kāmamanyusamīritāḥ ॥26॥
slp1: aSfRvAnAH purARAnAM DarmARAM pravarA gatIH । utpaTaM pratipatsyante kAmamanyusamIritAH ॥26॥

text: yadā nivartyate pāpo daṇḍanītyā mahātmabhiḥ । tadā dharmo na calate sadbhūtaḥ śāśvataḥ paraḥ ॥27॥
html:
yadā nivartyate pāpo daṇḍanītyā mahātmabhiḥ ।
tadā dharmo na calate sadbhūtaḥ śāśvataḥ paraḥ ॥27॥
slp1: yadA nivartyate pApo daRqanItyA mahAtmaBiH । tadA Darmo na calate sadBUtaH SASvataH paraH ॥27॥

text: paralokaguruṃ caiva rājānaṃ yo'vamanyate । na tasya dattaṃ na hutaṃ na śrāddhaṃ phalati kvacit ॥28॥
html:
paralokaguruṃ caiva rājānaṃ yo'vamanyate ।
na tasya dattaṃ na hutaṃ na śrāddhaṃ phalati kvacit ॥28॥
slp1: paralokaguruM cEva rAjAnaM yo'vamanyate । na tasya dattaM na hutaM na SrAdDaM Palati kvacit ॥28॥

text: mānuṣāṇāmadhipatiṃ devabhūtaṃ sanātanam । devāśca bahu manyante dharmakāmaṃ nareśvaram ॥29॥
html:
mānuṣāṇāmadhipatiṃ devabhūtaṃ sanātanam ।
devāśca bahu manyante dharmakāmaṃ nareśvaram ॥29॥
slp1: mAnuzARAmaDipatiM devaBUtaM sanAtanam । devASca bahu manyante DarmakAmaM nareSvaram ॥29॥

text: prajāpatirhi bhagavānyaḥ sarvamasṛjajjagat । sa pravṛttinivṛttyarthaṃ dharmāṇāṃ kṣatramicchati ॥30॥
html:
prajāpatirhi bhagavānyaḥ sarvamasṛjajjagat ।
sa pravṛttinivṛttyarthaṃ dharmāṇāṃ kṣatramicchati ॥30॥
slp1: prajApatirhi BagavAnyaH sarvamasfjajjagat । sa pravfttinivfttyarTaM DarmARAM kzatramicCati ॥30॥

text: pravṛttasya hi dharmasya buddhyā yaḥ smarate gatim । sa me mānyaśca pūjyaśca tatra kṣatraṃ pratiṣṭhitam ॥31॥
html:
pravṛttasya hi dharmasya buddhyā yaḥ smarate gatim ।
sa me mānyaśca pūjyaśca tatra kṣatraṃ pratiṣṭhitam ॥31॥
slp1: pravfttasya hi Darmasya budDyA yaH smarate gatim । sa me mAnyaSca pUjyaSca tatra kzatraM pratizWitam ॥31॥

text: evamuktvā sa bhagavānmarudgaṇavṛtaḥ prabhuḥ । jagāma bhavanaṃ viṣṇurakṣaraṃ paramaṃ padam ॥32॥
html:
evamuktvā sa bhagavānmarudgaṇavṛtaḥ prabhuḥ ।
jagāma bhavanaṃ viṣṇurakṣaraṃ paramaṃ padam ॥32॥
slp1: evamuktvA sa BagavAnmarudgaRavftaH praBuH । jagAma BavanaM vizRurakzaraM paramaM padam ॥32॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: evaṃ pravartite dharme purā sucarite'nagha । kaḥ kṣatramavamanyeta cetanāvānbahuśrutaḥ ॥33॥
html:
evaṃ pravartite dharme purā sucarite'nagha ।
kaḥ kṣatramavamanyeta cetanāvānbahuśrutaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: evaM pravartite Darme purA sucarite'naGa । kaH kzatramavamanyeta cetanAvAnbahuSrutaH ॥33॥

text: anyāyena pravṛttāni nivṛttāni tathaiva ca । antarā vilayaṃ yānti yathā pathi vicakṣuṣaḥ ॥34॥
html:
anyāyena pravṛttāni nivṛttāni tathaiva ca ।
antarā vilayaṃ yānti yathā pathi vicakṣuṣaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: anyAyena pravfttAni nivfttAni taTEva ca । antarA vilayaM yAnti yaTA paTi vicakzuzaH ॥34॥

text: ādau pravartite cakre tathaivādiparāyaṇe । vartasva puruṣavyāghra saṃvijānāmi te'nagha] ॥35॥
html:
ādau pravartite cakre tathaivādiparāyaṇe ।
vartasva puruṣavyāghra saṃvijānāmi te'nagha] ॥35॥
slp1: AdO pravartite cakre taTEvAdiparAyaRe । vartasva puruzavyAGra saMvijAnAmi te'naGa] ॥35॥

text: śrutā me kathitāḥ pūrvaiścatvāro mānavāśramāḥ । vyākhyānameṣāmācakṣva pṛcchato me pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
śrutā me kathitāḥ pūrvaiścatvāro mānavāśramāḥ ।
vyākhyānameṣāmācakṣva pṛcchato me pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: SrutA me kaTitAH pUrvEScatvAro mAnavASramAH । vyAKyAnamezAmAcakzva pfcCato me pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: viditāḥ sarva eveha dharmāstava yudhiṣṭhira । yathā mama mahābāho viditāḥ sādhusammatāḥ ॥2॥
html:
viditāḥ sarva eveha dharmāstava yudhiṣṭhira ।
yathā mama mahābāho viditāḥ sādhusammatāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: viditAH sarva eveha DarmAstava yuDizWira । yaTA mama mahAbAho viditAH sADusammatAH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yattu liṅgāntaragataṃ pṛcchase māṃ yudhiṣṭhira । dharmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha tannibodha narādhipa ॥3॥
html:
yattu liṅgāntaragataṃ pṛcchase māṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
dharmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha tannibodha narādhipa ॥3॥
slp1: yattu liNgAntaragataM pfcCase mAM yuDizWira । DarmaM DarmaBftAM SrezWa tanniboDa narADipa ॥3॥

text: sarvāṇyetāni kaunteya vidyante manujarṣabha । sādhvācārapravṛttānāṃ cāturāśramyakarmaṇām ॥4॥
html:
sarvāṇyetāni kaunteya vidyante manujarṣabha ।
sādhvācārapravṛttānāṃ cāturāśramyakarmaṇām ॥4॥
slp1: sarvARyetAni kOnteya vidyante manujarzaBa । sADvAcArapravfttAnAM cAturASramyakarmaRAm ॥4॥

text: akāmadveṣayuktasya daṇḍanītyā yudhiṣṭhira । samekṣiṇaśca bhūteṣu bhaikṣāśramapadaṃ bhavet ॥5॥
html:
akāmadveṣayuktasya daṇḍanītyā yudhiṣṭhira ।
samekṣiṇaśca bhūteṣu bhaikṣāśramapadaṃ bhavet ॥5॥
slp1: akAmadvezayuktasya daRqanItyA yuDizWira । samekziRaSca BUtezu BEkzASramapadaM Bavet ॥5॥

text: vettyādānavisargaṃ yo nigrahānugrahau tathā । yathoktavṛttervīrasya kṣemāśramapadaṃ bhavet ॥6॥
html:
vettyādānavisargaṃ yo nigrahānugrahau tathā ।
yathoktavṛttervīrasya kṣemāśramapadaṃ bhavet ॥6॥
slp1: vettyAdAnavisargaM yo nigrahAnugrahO taTA । yaToktavfttervIrasya kzemASramapadaM Bavet ॥6॥

text: jñātisaṃbandhimitrāṇi vyāpannāni yudhiṣṭhira । samabhyuddharamāṇasya dīkṣāśramapadaṃ bhavet ॥7॥
html:
jñātisaṃbandhimitrāṇi vyāpannāni yudhiṣṭhira ।
samabhyuddharamāṇasya dīkṣāśramapadaṃ bhavet ॥7॥
slp1: jYAtisaMbanDimitrARi vyApannAni yuDizWira । samaByudDaramARasya dIkzASramapadaM Bavet ॥7॥

text: āhnikaṃ bhūtayajñāṃśca pitṛyajñāṃśca mānuṣān । kurvataḥ pārtha vipulānvanyāśramapadaṃ bhavet ॥8॥
html:
āhnikaṃ bhūtayajñāṃśca pitṛyajñāṃśca mānuṣān ।
kurvataḥ pārtha vipulānvanyāśramapadaṃ bhavet ॥8॥
slp1: AhnikaM BUtayajYAMSca pitfyajYAMSca mAnuzAn । kurvataH pArTa vipulAnvanyASramapadaM Bavet ॥8॥

text: pālanātsarvabhūtānāṃ svarāṣṭraparipālanāt । dīkṣā bahuvidhā rājño vanyāśramapadaṃ bhavet ॥9॥
html:
pālanātsarvabhūtānāṃ svarāṣṭraparipālanāt ।
dīkṣā bahuvidhā rājño vanyāśramapadaṃ bhavet ॥9॥
slp1: pAlanAtsarvaBUtAnAM svarAzwraparipAlanAt । dIkzA bahuviDA rAjYo vanyASramapadaM Bavet ॥9॥

text: vedādhyayananityatvaṃ kṣamāthācāryapūjanam । tathopādhyāyaśuśrūṣā brahmāśramapadaṃ bhavet ॥10॥
html:
vedādhyayananityatvaṃ kṣamāthācāryapūjanam ।
tathopādhyāyaśuśrūṣā brahmāśramapadaṃ bhavet ॥10॥
slp1: vedADyayananityatvaM kzamATAcAryapUjanam । taTopADyAyaSuSrUzA brahmASramapadaM Bavet ॥10॥

text: ajihmamaśaṭhaṃ mārgaṃ sevamānasya bhārata । sarvadā sarvabhūteṣu brahmāśramapadaṃ bhavet ॥11॥
html:
ajihmamaśaṭhaṃ mārgaṃ sevamānasya bhārata ।
sarvadā sarvabhūteṣu brahmāśramapadaṃ bhavet ॥11॥
slp1: ajihmamaSaWaM mArgaM sevamAnasya BArata । sarvadA sarvaBUtezu brahmASramapadaM Bavet ॥11॥

text: vānaprastheṣu vipreṣu traividyeṣu ca bhārata । prayacchato'rthānvipulānvanyāśramapadaṃ bhavet ॥12॥
html:
vānaprastheṣu vipreṣu traividyeṣu ca bhārata ।
prayacchato'rthānvipulānvanyāśramapadaṃ bhavet ॥12॥
slp1: vAnaprasTezu viprezu trEvidyezu ca BArata । prayacCato'rTAnvipulAnvanyASramapadaM Bavet ॥12॥

text: sarvabhūteṣvanukrośaṃ kurvatastasya bhārata । ānṛśaṃsyapravṛttasya sarvāvasthaṃ padaṃ bhavet ॥13॥
html:
sarvabhūteṣvanukrośaṃ kurvatastasya bhārata ।
ānṛśaṃsyapravṛttasya sarvāvasthaṃ padaṃ bhavet ॥13॥
slp1: sarvaBUtezvanukroSaM kurvatastasya BArata । AnfSaMsyapravfttasya sarvAvasTaM padaM Bavet ॥13॥

text: bālavṛddheṣu kauravya sarvāvasthaṃ yudhiṣṭhira । anukrośaṃ vidadhataḥ sarvāvasthaṃ padaṃ bhavet ॥14॥
html:
bālavṛddheṣu kauravya sarvāvasthaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
anukrośaṃ vidadhataḥ sarvāvasthaṃ padaṃ bhavet ॥14॥
slp1: bAlavfdDezu kOravya sarvAvasTaM yuDizWira । anukroSaM vidaDataH sarvAvasTaM padaM Bavet ॥14॥

text: balātkṛteṣu bhūteṣu paritrāṇaṃ kurūdvaha । śaraṇāgateṣu kauravya kurvangārhasthyamāvaset ॥15॥
html:
balātkṛteṣu bhūteṣu paritrāṇaṃ kurūdvaha ।
śaraṇāgateṣu kauravya kurvangārhasthyamāvaset ॥15॥
slp1: balAtkftezu BUtezu paritrARaM kurUdvaha । SaraRAgatezu kOravya kurvangArhasTyamAvaset ॥15॥

text: carācarāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ rakṣāmapi ca sarvaśaḥ । yathārhapūjāṃ ca sadā kurvangārhasthyamāvaset ॥16॥
html:
carācarāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ rakṣāmapi ca sarvaśaḥ ।
yathārhapūjāṃ ca sadā kurvangārhasthyamāvaset ॥16॥
slp1: carAcarARAM BUtAnAM rakzAmapi ca sarvaSaH । yaTArhapUjAM ca sadA kurvangArhasTyamAvaset ॥16॥

text: jyeṣṭhānujyeṣṭhapatnīnāṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ putranaptṛṇām । nigrahānugrahau pārtha gārhasthyamiti tattapaḥ ॥17॥
html:
jyeṣṭhānujyeṣṭhapatnīnāṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ putranaptṛṇām ।
nigrahānugrahau pārtha gārhasthyamiti tattapaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: jyezWAnujyezWapatnInAM BrAtFRAM putranaptfRAm । nigrahAnugrahO pArTa gArhasTyamiti tattapaH ॥17॥

text: sādhūnāmarcanīyānāṃ prajāsu viditātmanām । pālanaṃ puruṣavyāghra gṛhāśramapadaṃ bhavet ॥18॥
html:
sādhūnāmarcanīyānāṃ prajāsu viditātmanām ।
pālanaṃ puruṣavyāghra gṛhāśramapadaṃ bhavet ॥18॥
slp1: sADUnAmarcanIyAnAM prajAsu viditAtmanAm । pAlanaM puruzavyAGra gfhASramapadaM Bavet ॥18॥

text: āśramasthāni sarvāṇi yastu veśmani bhārata । ādadīteha bhojyena tadgārhasthyaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥19॥
html:
āśramasthāni sarvāṇi yastu veśmani bhārata ।
ādadīteha bhojyena tadgārhasthyaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥19॥
slp1: ASramasTAni sarvARi yastu veSmani BArata । AdadIteha Bojyena tadgArhasTyaM yuDizWira ॥19॥

text: yaḥ sthitaḥ puruṣo dharme dhātrā sṛṣṭe yathārthavat । āśramāṇāṃ sa sarveṣāṃ phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam ॥20॥
html:
yaḥ sthitaḥ puruṣo dharme dhātrā sṛṣṭe yathārthavat ।
āśramāṇāṃ sa sarveṣāṃ phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam ॥20॥
slp1: yaH sTitaH puruzo Darme DAtrA sfzwe yaTArTavat । ASramARAM sa sarvezAM PalaM prApnotyanuttamam ॥20॥

text: yasminna naśyanti guṇāḥ kaunteya puruṣe sadā । āśramasthaṃ tamapyāhurnaraśreṣṭhaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥21॥
html:
yasminna naśyanti guṇāḥ kaunteya puruṣe sadā ।
āśramasthaṃ tamapyāhurnaraśreṣṭhaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥21॥
slp1: yasminna naSyanti guRAH kOnteya puruze sadA । ASramasTaM tamapyAhurnaraSrezWaM yuDizWira ॥21॥

text: sthānamānaṃ vayomānaṃ kulamānaṃ tathaiva ca । kurvanvasati sarveṣu hyāśrameṣu yudhiṣṭhira ॥22॥
html:
sthānamānaṃ vayomānaṃ kulamānaṃ tathaiva ca ।
kurvanvasati sarveṣu hyāśrameṣu yudhiṣṭhira ॥22॥
slp1: sTAnamAnaM vayomAnaM kulamAnaM taTEva ca । kurvanvasati sarvezu hyASramezu yuDizWira ॥22॥

text: deśadharmāṃśca kaunteya kuladharmāṃstathaiva ca । pālayanpuruṣavyāghra rājā sarvāśramī bhavet ॥23॥
html:
deśadharmāṃśca kaunteya kuladharmāṃstathaiva ca ।
pālayanpuruṣavyāghra rājā sarvāśramī bhavet ॥23॥
slp1: deSaDarmAMSca kOnteya kulaDarmAMstaTEva ca । pAlayanpuruzavyAGra rAjA sarvASramI Bavet ॥23॥

text: kāle vibhūtiṃ bhūtānāmupahārāṃstathaiva ca । arhayanpuruṣavyāghra sādhūnāmāśrame vaset ॥24॥
html:
kāle vibhūtiṃ bhūtānāmupahārāṃstathaiva ca ।
arhayanpuruṣavyāghra sādhūnāmāśrame vaset ॥24॥
slp1: kAle viBUtiM BUtAnAmupahArAMstaTEva ca । arhayanpuruzavyAGra sADUnAmASrame vaset ॥24॥

text: daśadharmagataścāpi yo dharmaṃ pratyavekṣate । sarvalokasya kaunteya rājā bhavati so''śramī ॥25॥
html:
daśadharmagataścāpi yo dharmaṃ pratyavekṣate ।
sarvalokasya kaunteya rājā bhavati so''śramī ॥25॥
slp1: daSaDarmagataScApi yo DarmaM pratyavekzate । sarvalokasya kOnteya rAjA Bavati so''SramI ॥25॥

text: ye dharmakuśalā loke dharmaṃ kurvanti sādhavaḥ । pālitā yasya viṣaye pādoṃ'śastasya bhūpateḥ ॥26॥
html:
ye dharmakuśalā loke dharmaṃ kurvanti sādhavaḥ ।
pālitā yasya viṣaye pādoṃ'śastasya bhūpateḥ ॥26॥
slp1: ye DarmakuSalA loke DarmaM kurvanti sADavaH । pAlitA yasya vizaye pAdoM'Sastasya BUpateH ॥26॥

text: dharmārāmāndharmaparānye na rakṣanti mānavān । pārthivāḥ puruṣavyāghra teṣāṃ pāpaṃ haranti te ॥27॥
html:
