dharmārāmāndharmaparānye na rakṣanti mānavān ।
pārthivāḥ puruṣavyāghra teṣāṃ pāpaṃ haranti te ॥27॥
slp1: DarmArAmAnDarmaparAnye na rakzanti mAnavAn । pArTivAH puruzavyAGra tezAM pApaM haranti te ॥27॥

text: ye ca rakṣāsahāyāḥ syuḥ pārthivānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira । te caivāṃśaharāḥ sarve dharme parakṛte'nagha ॥28॥
html:
ye ca rakṣāsahāyāḥ syuḥ pārthivānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
te caivāṃśaharāḥ sarve dharme parakṛte'nagha ॥28॥
slp1: ye ca rakzAsahAyAH syuH pArTivAnAM yuDizWira । te cEvAMSaharAH sarve Darme parakfte'naGa ॥28॥

text: sarvāśramapade hyāhurgārhasthyaṃ dīptanirṇayam । pāvanaṃ puruṣavyāghra yaṃ vayaṃ paryupāsmahe ॥29॥
html:
sarvāśramapade hyāhurgārhasthyaṃ dīptanirṇayam ।
pāvanaṃ puruṣavyāghra yaṃ vayaṃ paryupāsmahe ॥29॥
slp1: sarvASramapade hyAhurgArhasTyaM dIptanirRayam । pAvanaM puruzavyAGra yaM vayaM paryupAsmahe ॥29॥

text: ātmopamastu bhūteṣu yo vai bhavati mānavaḥ । nyastadaṇḍo jitakrodhaḥ sa pretya labhate sukham ॥30॥
html:
ātmopamastu bhūteṣu yo vai bhavati mānavaḥ ।
nyastadaṇḍo jitakrodhaḥ sa pretya labhate sukham ॥30॥
slp1: Atmopamastu BUtezu yo vE Bavati mAnavaH । nyastadaRqo jitakroDaH sa pretya laBate suKam ॥30॥

text: dharmotthitā sattvavīryā dharmasetuvaṭākarā । tyāgavātādhvagā śīghrā naustvā santārayiṣyati ॥31॥
html:
dharmotthitā sattvavīryā dharmasetuvaṭākarā ।
tyāgavātādhvagā śīghrā naustvā santārayiṣyati ॥31॥
slp1: DarmotTitA sattvavIryA DarmasetuvawAkarA । tyAgavAtADvagA SIGrA nOstvA santArayizyati ॥31॥

text: yadā nivṛttaḥ sarvasmātkāmo yo'sya hṛdi sthitaḥ । tadā bhavati sattvasthastato brahma samaśnute ॥32॥
html:
yadā nivṛttaḥ sarvasmātkāmo yo'sya hṛdi sthitaḥ ।
tadā bhavati sattvasthastato brahma samaśnute ॥32॥
slp1: yadA nivfttaH sarvasmAtkAmo yo'sya hfdi sTitaH । tadA Bavati sattvasTastato brahma samaSnute ॥32॥

text: suprasannastu bhāvena yogena ca narādhipa । dharmaṃ puruṣaśārdūla prāpsyase pālane rataḥ ॥33॥
html:
suprasannastu bhāvena yogena ca narādhipa ।
dharmaṃ puruṣaśārdūla prāpsyase pālane rataḥ ॥33॥
slp1: suprasannastu BAvena yogena ca narADipa । DarmaM puruzaSArdUla prApsyase pAlane rataH ॥33॥

text: vedādhyayanaśīlānāṃ viprāṇāṃ sādhukarmaṇām । pālane yatnamātiṣṭha sarvalokasya cānagha ॥34॥
html:
vedādhyayanaśīlānāṃ viprāṇāṃ sādhukarmaṇām ।
pālane yatnamātiṣṭha sarvalokasya cānagha ॥34॥
slp1: vedADyayanaSIlAnAM viprARAM sADukarmaRAm । pAlane yatnamAtizWa sarvalokasya cAnaGa ॥34॥

text: vane carati yo dharmamāśrameṣu ca bhārata । rakṣayā tacchataguṇaṃ dharmaṃ prāpnoti pārthivaḥ ॥35॥
html:
vane carati yo dharmamāśrameṣu ca bhārata ।
rakṣayā tacchataguṇaṃ dharmaṃ prāpnoti pārthivaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: vane carati yo DarmamASramezu ca BArata । rakzayA tacCataguRaM DarmaM prApnoti pArTivaH ॥35॥

text: eṣa te vividho dharmaḥ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha kīrtitaḥ । anutiṣṭha tvamenaṃ vai pūrvairdṛṣṭaṃ sanātanam ॥36॥
html:
eṣa te vividho dharmaḥ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha kīrtitaḥ ।
anutiṣṭha tvamenaṃ vai pūrvairdṛṣṭaṃ sanātanam ॥36॥
slp1: eza te viviDo DarmaH pARqavaSrezWa kIrtitaH । anutizWa tvamenaM vE pUrvErdfzwaM sanAtanam ॥36॥

text: cāturāśramyamekāgraḥ cāturvarṇyaṃ ca pāṇḍava । dharmaṃ puruṣaśārdūla prāpsyase pālane rataḥ] ॥37॥
html:
cāturāśramyamekāgraḥ cāturvarṇyaṃ ca pāṇḍava ।
dharmaṃ puruṣaśārdūla prāpsyase pālane rataḥ] ॥37॥
slp1: cAturASramyamekAgraH cAturvarRyaM ca pARqava । DarmaM puruzaSArdUla prApsyase pAlane rataH] ॥37॥

text: cāturāśramya ukto'tra cāturvarṇyastathaiva ca । rāṣṭrasya yatkṛtyatamaṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
cāturāśramya ukto'tra cāturvarṇyastathaiva ca ।
rāṣṭrasya yatkṛtyatamaṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: cAturASramya ukto'tra cAturvarRyastaTEva ca । rAzwrasya yatkftyatamaM tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: rāṣṭrasyaitatkṛtyatamaṃ rājña evābhiṣecanam । anindramabalaṃ rāṣṭraṃ dasyavo'bhibhavanti ca ॥2॥
html:
rāṣṭrasyaitatkṛtyatamaṃ rājña evābhiṣecanam ।
anindramabalaṃ rāṣṭraṃ dasyavo'bhibhavanti ca ॥2॥
slp1: rAzwrasyEtatkftyatamaM rAjYa evABizecanam । anindramabalaM rAzwraM dasyavo'BiBavanti ca ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: arājakeṣu rāṣṭreṣu dharmo na vyavatiṣṭhate । parasparaṃ ca khādanti sarvathā dhigarājakam ॥3॥
html:
arājakeṣu rāṣṭreṣu dharmo na vyavatiṣṭhate ।
parasparaṃ ca khādanti sarvathā dhigarājakam ॥3॥
slp1: arAjakezu rAzwrezu Darmo na vyavatizWate । parasparaM ca KAdanti sarvaTA DigarAjakam ॥3॥

text: indramenaṃ pravṛṇute yadrājānamiti śrutiḥ । yathaivendrastathā rājā saṃpūjyo bhūtimicchatā ॥4॥
html:
indramenaṃ pravṛṇute yadrājānamiti śrutiḥ ।
yathaivendrastathā rājā saṃpūjyo bhūtimicchatā ॥4॥
slp1: indramenaM pravfRute yadrAjAnamiti SrutiH । yaTEvendrastaTA rAjA saMpUjyo BUtimicCatA ॥4॥

text: nārājakeṣu rāṣṭreṣu vastavyamiti vaidikam । nārājakeṣu rāṣṭreṣu havyamagnirvahatyapi ॥5॥
html:
nārājakeṣu rāṣṭreṣu vastavyamiti vaidikam ।
nārājakeṣu rāṣṭreṣu havyamagnirvahatyapi ॥5॥
slp1: nArAjakezu rAzwrezu vastavyamiti vEdikam । nArAjakezu rAzwrezu havyamagnirvahatyapi ॥5॥

text: atha cedabhivarteta rājyārthī balavattaraḥ । arājakāni rāṣṭrāṇi hatarājāni vā punaḥ ॥6॥
html:
atha cedabhivarteta rājyārthī balavattaraḥ ।
arājakāni rāṣṭrāṇi hatarājāni vā punaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: aTa cedaBivarteta rAjyArTI balavattaraH । arAjakAni rAzwrARi hatarAjAni vA punaH ॥6॥

text: pratyudgamyābhipūjyaḥ syādetadatra sumantritam । na hi pāpātpāpataramasti kiñcidarājakāt ॥7॥
html:
pratyudgamyābhipūjyaḥ syādetadatra sumantritam ।
na hi pāpātpāpataramasti kiñcidarājakāt ॥7॥
slp1: pratyudgamyABipUjyaH syAdetadatra sumantritam । na hi pApAtpApataramasti kiYcidarAjakAt ॥7॥

text: sa cetsamanupaśyeta samagraṃ kuśalaṃ bhavet । balavānhi prakupitaḥ kuryānniḥśeṣatāmapi ॥8॥
html:
sa cetsamanupaśyeta samagraṃ kuśalaṃ bhavet ।
balavānhi prakupitaḥ kuryānniḥśeṣatāmapi ॥8॥
slp1: sa cetsamanupaSyeta samagraM kuSalaM Bavet । balavAnhi prakupitaH kuryAnniHSezatAmapi ॥8॥

text: bhūyāṃsaṃ labhate kleśaṃ yā gaurbhavati durduhā । suduhā yā tu bhavati naiva tāṃ kleśayantyuta ॥9॥
html:
bhūyāṃsaṃ labhate kleśaṃ yā gaurbhavati durduhā ।
suduhā yā tu bhavati naiva tāṃ kleśayantyuta ॥9॥
slp1: BUyAMsaM laBate kleSaM yA gOrBavati durduhA । suduhA yA tu Bavati nEva tAM kleSayantyuta ॥9॥

text: yadataptaṃ praṇamati na tatsantāpayantyuta । yacca svayaṃ nataṃ dāru na tatsannāmayantyapi ॥10॥
html:
yadataptaṃ praṇamati na tatsantāpayantyuta ।
yacca svayaṃ nataṃ dāru na tatsannāmayantyapi ॥10॥
slp1: yadataptaM praRamati na tatsantApayantyuta । yacca svayaM nataM dAru na tatsannAmayantyapi ॥10॥

text: etayopamayā dhīraḥ sannameta balīyase । indrāya sa praṇamate namate yo balīyase ॥11॥
html:
etayopamayā dhīraḥ sannameta balīyase ।
indrāya sa praṇamate namate yo balīyase ॥11॥
slp1: etayopamayA DIraH sannameta balIyase । indrAya sa praRamate namate yo balIyase ॥11॥

text: tasmādrājaiva kartavyaḥ satataṃ bhūtimicchatā । na dhanārtho na dārārthasteṣāṃ yeṣāmarājakam ॥12॥
html:
tasmādrājaiva kartavyaḥ satataṃ bhūtimicchatā ।
na dhanārtho na dārārthasteṣāṃ yeṣāmarājakam ॥12॥
slp1: tasmAdrAjEva kartavyaH satataM BUtimicCatA । na DanArTo na dArArTastezAM yezAmarAjakam ॥12॥

text: prīyate hi haranpāpaḥ paravittamarājake । yadāsya uddharantyanye tadā rājānamicchati ॥13॥
html:
prīyate hi haranpāpaḥ paravittamarājake ।
yadāsya uddharantyanye tadā rājānamicchati ॥13॥
slp1: prIyate hi haranpApaH paravittamarAjake । yadAsya udDarantyanye tadA rAjAnamicCati ॥13॥

text: pāpā api tadā kṣemaṃ na labhante kadācana । ekasya hi dvau harato dvayośca bahavo'pare ॥14॥
html:
pāpā api tadā kṣemaṃ na labhante kadācana ।
ekasya hi dvau harato dvayośca bahavo'pare ॥14॥
slp1: pApA api tadA kzemaM na laBante kadAcana । ekasya hi dvO harato dvayoSca bahavo'pare ॥14॥

text: adāsaḥ kriyate dāso hriyante ca balātstriyaḥ । etasmātkāraṇāddevāḥ prajāpālānpracakrire ॥15॥
html:
adāsaḥ kriyate dāso hriyante ca balātstriyaḥ ।
etasmātkāraṇāddevāḥ prajāpālānpracakrire ॥15॥
slp1: adAsaH kriyate dAso hriyante ca balAtstriyaH । etasmAtkAraRAddevAH prajApAlAnpracakrire ॥15॥

text: rājā cenna bhavelloke pṛthivyāṃ daṇḍadhārakaḥ । śūle matsyānivāpakṣyandurbalānbalavattarāḥ ॥16॥
html:
rājā cenna bhavelloke pṛthivyāṃ daṇḍadhārakaḥ ।
śūle matsyānivāpakṣyandurbalānbalavattarāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: rAjA cenna Bavelloke pfTivyAM daRqaDArakaH । SUle matsyAnivApakzyandurbalAnbalavattarAH ॥16॥

text: arājakāḥ prajāḥ pūrvaṃ vineśuriti naḥ śrutam । parasparaṃ bhakṣayanto matsyā iva jale kṛśān ॥17॥
html:
arājakāḥ prajāḥ pūrvaṃ vineśuriti naḥ śrutam ।
parasparaṃ bhakṣayanto matsyā iva jale kṛśān ॥17॥
slp1: arAjakAH prajAH pUrvaM vineSuriti naH Srutam । parasparaM Bakzayanto matsyA iva jale kfSAn ॥17॥

text: tāḥ sametya tataścakruḥ samayāniti naḥ śrutam । vākkrūro daṇḍapuruṣo yaśca syātpāradārikaḥ । yaśca na svamathādadyāttyājyā nastādṛśā iti ॥18॥
html:
tāḥ sametya tataścakruḥ samayāniti naḥ śrutam ।
vākkrūro daṇḍapuruṣo yaśca syātpāradārikaḥ ।
yaśca na svamathādadyāttyājyā nastādṛśā iti ॥18॥
slp1: tAH sametya tataScakruH samayAniti naH Srutam । vAkkrUro daRqapuruzo yaSca syAtpAradArikaH । yaSca na svamaTAdadyAttyAjyA nastAdfSA iti ॥18॥

text: viśvāsanārthaṃ varṇānāṃ sarveṣāmaviśeṣataḥ । tāstathā samayaṃ kṛtvā samaye nāvatasthire ॥19॥
html:
viśvāsanārthaṃ varṇānāṃ sarveṣāmaviśeṣataḥ ।
tāstathā samayaṃ kṛtvā samaye nāvatasthire ॥19॥
slp1: viSvAsanArTaM varRAnAM sarvezAmaviSezataH । tAstaTA samayaM kftvA samaye nAvatasTire ॥19॥

text: sahitāstāstadā jagmurasukhārtāḥ pitāmaham । anīśvarā vinaśyāmo bhagavannīśvaraṃ diśa ॥20॥
html:
sahitāstāstadā jagmurasukhārtāḥ pitāmaham ।
anīśvarā vinaśyāmo bhagavannīśvaraṃ diśa ॥20॥
slp1: sahitAstAstadA jagmurasuKArtAH pitAmaham । anISvarA vinaSyAmo BagavannISvaraM diSa ॥20॥

text: yaṃ pūjayema sambhūya yaśca naḥ paripālayet । tābhyo manuṃ vyādideśa manurnābhinananda tāḥ ॥21॥
html:
yaṃ pūjayema sambhūya yaśca naḥ paripālayet ।
tābhyo manuṃ vyādideśa manurnābhinananda tāḥ ॥21॥
slp1: yaM pUjayema samBUya yaSca naH paripAlayet । tAByo manuM vyAdideSa manurnABinananda tAH ॥21॥

text: bibhemi karmaṇaḥ krūrādrājyaṃ hi bhṛśaduṣkaram । viśeṣato manuṣyeṣu mithyāvṛttiṣu nityadā ॥22॥
html:
bibhemi karmaṇaḥ krūrādrājyaṃ hi bhṛśaduṣkaram ।
viśeṣato manuṣyeṣu mithyāvṛttiṣu nityadā ॥22॥
slp1: biBemi karmaRaH krUrAdrAjyaM hi BfSaduzkaram । viSezato manuzyezu miTyAvfttizu nityadA ॥22॥
author: manuruvāca ।

text: tamabruvanprajā mā bhaiḥ karmaṇaino gamiṣyati । paśūnāmadhipañcāśaddhiraṇyasya tathaiva ca । dhānyasya daśamaṃ bhāgaṃ dāsyāmaḥ kośavardhanam ॥23॥
html:
tamabruvanprajā mā bhaiḥ karmaṇaino gamiṣyati ।
paśūnāmadhipañcāśaddhiraṇyasya tathaiva ca ।
dhānyasya daśamaṃ bhāgaṃ dāsyāmaḥ kośavardhanam ॥23॥
slp1: tamabruvanprajA mA BEH karmaREno gamizyati । paSUnAmaDipaYcASadDiraRyasya taTEva ca । DAnyasya daSamaM BAgaM dAsyAmaH koSavarDanam ॥23॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: mukhyena śastrapatreṇa ye manuṣyāḥ pradhānataḥ । bhavantaṃ te'nuyāsyanti mahendramiva devatāḥ ॥24॥
html:
mukhyena śastrapatreṇa ye manuṣyāḥ pradhānataḥ ।
bhavantaṃ te'nuyāsyanti mahendramiva devatāḥ ॥24॥
slp1: muKyena SastrapatreRa ye manuzyAH praDAnataH । BavantaM te'nuyAsyanti mahendramiva devatAH ॥24॥

text: sa tvaṃ jātabalo rājanduṣpradharṣaḥ pratāpavān । sukhe dhāsyasi naḥ sarvānkubera iva nairṛtān ॥25॥
html:
sa tvaṃ jātabalo rājanduṣpradharṣaḥ pratāpavān ।
sukhe dhāsyasi naḥ sarvānkubera iva nairṛtān ॥25॥
slp1: sa tvaM jAtabalo rAjanduzpraDarzaH pratApavAn । suKe DAsyasi naH sarvAnkubera iva nErftAn ॥25॥

text: yaṃ ca dharmaṃ cariṣyanti prajā rājñā surakṣitāḥ । caturthaṃ tasya dharmasya tvatsaṃsthaṃ no bhaviṣyati ॥26॥
html:
yaṃ ca dharmaṃ cariṣyanti prajā rājñā surakṣitāḥ ।
caturthaṃ tasya dharmasya tvatsaṃsthaṃ no bhaviṣyati ॥26॥
slp1: yaM ca DarmaM carizyanti prajA rAjYA surakzitAH । caturTaM tasya Darmasya tvatsaMsTaM no Bavizyati ॥26॥

text: tena dharmeṇa mahatā sukhalabdhena bhāvitaḥ । pāhyasmānsarvato rājandevāniva śatakratuḥ ॥27॥
html:
tena dharmeṇa mahatā sukhalabdhena bhāvitaḥ ।
pāhyasmānsarvato rājandevāniva śatakratuḥ ॥27॥
slp1: tena DarmeRa mahatA suKalabDena BAvitaH । pAhyasmAnsarvato rAjandevAniva SatakratuH ॥27॥

text: vijayāyāśu niryāhi pratapanraśmimāniva । mānaṃ vidhama śatrūṇāṃ dharmo jayatu naḥ sadā ॥28॥
html:
vijayāyāśu niryāhi pratapanraśmimāniva ।
mānaṃ vidhama śatrūṇāṃ dharmo jayatu naḥ sadā ॥28॥
slp1: vijayAyASu niryAhi pratapanraSmimAniva । mAnaM viDama SatrURAM Darmo jayatu naH sadA ॥28॥

text: sa niryayau mahātejā balena mahatā vṛtaḥ । mahābhijanasampannastejasā prajvalanniva ॥29॥
html:
sa niryayau mahātejā balena mahatā vṛtaḥ ।
mahābhijanasampannastejasā prajvalanniva ॥29॥
slp1: sa niryayO mahAtejA balena mahatA vftaH । mahABijanasampannastejasA prajvalanniva ॥29॥

text: tasya tāṃ mahimāṃ dṛṣṭvā mahendrasyeva devatāḥ । apatatrasire sarve svadharme ca dadhurmanaḥ ॥30॥
html:
tasya tāṃ mahimāṃ dṛṣṭvā mahendrasyeva devatāḥ ।
apatatrasire sarve svadharme ca dadhurmanaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: tasya tAM mahimAM dfzwvA mahendrasyeva devatAH । apatatrasire sarve svaDarme ca daDurmanaH ॥30॥

text: tato mahīṃ pariyayau parjanya iva vṛṣṭimān । śamayansarvataḥ pāpānsvakarmasu ca yojayan ॥31॥
html:
tato mahīṃ pariyayau parjanya iva vṛṣṭimān ।
śamayansarvataḥ pāpānsvakarmasu ca yojayan ॥31॥
slp1: tato mahIM pariyayO parjanya iva vfzwimAn । SamayansarvataH pApAnsvakarmasu ca yojayan ॥31॥

text: evaṃ ye bhūtimiccheyuḥ pṛthivyāṃ mānavāḥ kvacit । kuryū rājānamevāgre prajānugrahakāraṇāt ॥32॥
html:
evaṃ ye bhūtimiccheyuḥ pṛthivyāṃ mānavāḥ kvacit ।
kuryū rājānamevāgre prajānugrahakāraṇāt ॥32॥
slp1: evaM ye BUtimicCeyuH pfTivyAM mAnavAH kvacit । kuryU rAjAnamevAgre prajAnugrahakAraRAt ॥32॥

text: namasyeyuśca taṃ bhaktyā śiṣyā iva guruṃ sadā । devā iva sahasrākṣaṃ prajā rājānamantike ॥33॥
html:
namasyeyuśca taṃ bhaktyā śiṣyā iva guruṃ sadā ।
devā iva sahasrākṣaṃ prajā rājānamantike ॥33॥
slp1: namasyeyuSca taM BaktyA SizyA iva guruM sadA । devA iva sahasrAkzaM prajA rAjAnamantike ॥33॥

text: satkṛtaṃ svajaneneha paro'pi bahu manyate । svajanena tvavajñātaṃ pare paribhavantyuta ॥34॥
html:
satkṛtaṃ svajaneneha paro'pi bahu manyate ।
svajanena tvavajñātaṃ pare paribhavantyuta ॥34॥
slp1: satkftaM svajaneneha paro'pi bahu manyate । svajanena tvavajYAtaM pare pariBavantyuta ॥34॥

text: rājñaḥ paraiḥ paribhavaḥ sarveṣāmasukhāvahaḥ । tasmācchatraṃ ca patraṃ ca vāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca ॥35॥
html:
rājñaḥ paraiḥ paribhavaḥ sarveṣāmasukhāvahaḥ ।
tasmācchatraṃ ca patraṃ ca vāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca ॥35॥
slp1: rAjYaH parEH pariBavaH sarvezAmasuKAvahaH । tasmAcCatraM ca patraM ca vAsAMsyABaraRAni ca ॥35॥

text: bhojanānyatha pānāni rājñe dadyurgṛhāṇi ca । āsanāni ca śayyāśca sarvopakaraṇāni ca ॥36॥
html:
bhojanānyatha pānāni rājñe dadyurgṛhāṇi ca ।
āsanāni ca śayyāśca sarvopakaraṇāni ca ॥36॥
slp1: BojanAnyaTa pAnAni rAjYe dadyurgfhARi ca । AsanAni ca SayyASca sarvopakaraRAni ca ॥36॥

text: guptātmā syāddurādharṣaḥ smitapūrvābhibhāṣitā । ābhāṣitaśca madhuraṃ pratibhāṣeta mānavān ॥37॥
html:
guptātmā syāddurādharṣaḥ smitapūrvābhibhāṣitā ।
ābhāṣitaśca madhuraṃ pratibhāṣeta mānavān ॥37॥
slp1: guptAtmA syAddurADarzaH smitapUrvABiBAzitA । ABAzitaSca maDuraM pratiBAzeta mAnavAn ॥37॥

text: kṛtajño dṛḍhabhaktiḥ syātsaṃvibhāgī jitendriyaḥ । īkṣitaḥ prativīkṣeta mṛdu carju ca valgu ca] ॥38॥
html:
kṛtajño dṛḍhabhaktiḥ syātsaṃvibhāgī jitendriyaḥ ।
īkṣitaḥ prativīkṣeta mṛdu carju ca valgu ca] ॥38॥
slp1: kftajYo dfQaBaktiH syAtsaMviBAgI jitendriyaH । IkzitaH prativIkzeta mfdu carju ca valgu ca] ॥38॥

text: kimāhurdaivataṃ viprā rājānaṃ bharatarṣabha । manuṣyāṇāmadhipatiṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
kimāhurdaivataṃ viprā rājānaṃ bharatarṣabha ।
manuṣyāṇāmadhipatiṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: kimAhurdEvataM viprA rAjAnaM BaratarzaBa । manuzyARAmaDipatiM tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । bṛhaspatiṃ vasumanā yathā papraccha bhārata ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
bṛhaspatiṃ vasumanā yathā papraccha bhārata ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । bfhaspatiM vasumanA yaTA papracCa BArata ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: rājā vasumanā nāma kausalyo dhīmatāṃ varaḥ । maharṣiṃ paripapraccha kṛtaprajño bṛhaspatim ॥3॥
html:
rājā vasumanā nāma kausalyo dhīmatāṃ varaḥ ।
maharṣiṃ paripapraccha kṛtaprajño bṛhaspatim ॥3॥
slp1: rAjA vasumanA nAma kOsalyo DImatAM varaH । maharziM paripapracCa kftaprajYo bfhaspatim ॥3॥

text: sarvaṃ vainayikaṃ kṛtvā vinayajño bṛhaspateḥ । dakṣiṇānantaro bhūtvā praṇamya vidhipūrvakam ॥4॥
html:
sarvaṃ vainayikaṃ kṛtvā vinayajño bṛhaspateḥ ।
dakṣiṇānantaro bhūtvā praṇamya vidhipūrvakam ॥4॥
slp1: sarvaM vEnayikaM kftvA vinayajYo bfhaspateH । dakziRAnantaro BUtvA praRamya viDipUrvakam ॥4॥

text: vidhiṃ papraccha rājyasya sarvabhūtahite rataḥ । prajānāṃ hitamanvicchandharmamūlaṃ viśāmpate ॥5॥
html:
vidhiṃ papraccha rājyasya sarvabhūtahite rataḥ ।
prajānāṃ hitamanvicchandharmamūlaṃ viśāmpate ॥5॥
slp1: viDiM papracCa rAjyasya sarvaBUtahite rataH । prajAnAM hitamanvicCanDarmamUlaM viSAmpate ॥5॥

text: kena bhūtāni vardhante kṣayaṃ gacchanti kena ca । kamarcanto mahāprājña sukhamatyantamāpnuyuḥ ॥6॥
html:
kena bhūtāni vardhante kṣayaṃ gacchanti kena ca ।
kamarcanto mahāprājña sukhamatyantamāpnuyuḥ ॥6॥
slp1: kena BUtAni varDante kzayaM gacCanti kena ca । kamarcanto mahAprAjYa suKamatyantamApnuyuH ॥6॥

text: iti pṛṣṭo mahārājñā kausalyenāmitaujasā । rājasatkāramavyagraḥ śaśaṃsāsmai bṛhaspatiḥ ॥7॥
html:
iti pṛṣṭo mahārājñā kausalyenāmitaujasā ।
rājasatkāramavyagraḥ śaśaṃsāsmai bṛhaspatiḥ ॥7॥
slp1: iti pfzwo mahArAjYA kOsalyenAmitOjasA । rAjasatkAramavyagraH SaSaMsAsmE bfhaspatiH ॥7॥

text: rājamūlo mahārāja dharmo lokasya lakṣyate । prajā rājabhayādeva na khādanti parasparam ॥8॥
html:
rājamūlo mahārāja dharmo lokasya lakṣyate ।
prajā rājabhayādeva na khādanti parasparam ॥8॥
slp1: rAjamUlo mahArAja Darmo lokasya lakzyate । prajA rAjaBayAdeva na KAdanti parasparam ॥8॥

text: rājā hyevākhilaṃ lokaṃ samudīrṇaṃ samutsukam । prasādayati dharmeṇa prasādya ca virājate ॥9॥
html:
rājā hyevākhilaṃ lokaṃ samudīrṇaṃ samutsukam ।
prasādayati dharmeṇa prasādya ca virājate ॥9॥
slp1: rAjA hyevAKilaM lokaM samudIrRaM samutsukam । prasAdayati DarmeRa prasAdya ca virAjate ॥9॥

text: yathā hyanudaye rājanbhūtāni śaśisūryayoḥ । andhe tamasi majjeyurapaśyantaḥ parasparam ॥10॥
html:
yathā hyanudaye rājanbhūtāni śaśisūryayoḥ ।
andhe tamasi majjeyurapaśyantaḥ parasparam ॥10॥
slp1: yaTA hyanudaye rAjanBUtAni SaSisUryayoH । anDe tamasi majjeyurapaSyantaH parasparam ॥10॥

text: yathā hyanudake matsyā nirākrande vihaṅgamāḥ । vihareyuryathākāmamabhisṛtya punaḥ punaḥ ॥11॥
html:
yathā hyanudake matsyā nirākrande vihaṅgamāḥ ।
vihareyuryathākāmamabhisṛtya punaḥ punaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: yaTA hyanudake matsyA nirAkrande vihaNgamAH । vihareyuryaTAkAmamaBisftya punaH punaH ॥11॥

text: vimathyātikrameraṃśca viṣahyāpi parasparam । abhāvamacireṇaiva gaccheyurnātra saṃśayaḥ ॥12॥
html:
vimathyātikrameraṃśca viṣahyāpi parasparam ।
abhāvamacireṇaiva gaccheyurnātra saṃśayaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: vimaTyAtikrameraMSca vizahyApi parasparam । aBAvamacireREva gacCeyurnAtra saMSayaH ॥12॥

text: evameva vinā rājñā vinaśyeyurimāḥ prajāḥ । andhe tamasi majjeyuragopāḥ paśavo yathā ॥13॥
html:
evameva vinā rājñā vinaśyeyurimāḥ prajāḥ ।
andhe tamasi majjeyuragopāḥ paśavo yathā ॥13॥
slp1: evameva vinA rAjYA vinaSyeyurimAH prajAH । anDe tamasi majjeyuragopAH paSavo yaTA ॥13॥

text: hareyurbalavanto hi durbalānāṃ parigrahān । hanyurvyāyacchamānāṃśca yadi rājā na pālayet ॥14॥
html:
hareyurbalavanto hi durbalānāṃ parigrahān ।
hanyurvyāyacchamānāṃśca yadi rājā na pālayet ॥14॥
slp1: hareyurbalavanto hi durbalAnAM parigrahAn । hanyurvyAyacCamAnAMSca yadi rAjA na pAlayet ॥14॥

text: yānaṃ vastramalaṅkārānratnāni vividhāni ca । hareyuḥ sahasā pāpā yadi rājā na pālayet ॥15॥
html:
yānaṃ vastramalaṅkārānratnāni vividhāni ca ।
hareyuḥ sahasā pāpā yadi rājā na pālayet ॥15॥
slp1: yAnaM vastramalaNkArAnratnAni viviDAni ca । hareyuH sahasA pApA yadi rAjA na pAlayet ॥15॥

text: mamedamiti loke'sminna bhavetsamparigrahaḥ । viśvalopaḥ pravarteta yadi rājā na pālayet ॥16॥
html:
mamedamiti loke'sminna bhavetsamparigrahaḥ ।
viśvalopaḥ pravarteta yadi rājā na pālayet ॥16॥
slp1: mamedamiti loke'sminna BavetsamparigrahaH । viSvalopaH pravarteta yadi rAjA na pAlayet ॥16॥

text: mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vṛddhamācāryamatithiṃ gurum । kliśnīyurapi hiṃsyurvā yadi rājā na pālayet ॥17॥
html:
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vṛddhamācāryamatithiṃ gurum ।
kliśnīyurapi hiṃsyurvā yadi rājā na pālayet ॥17॥
slp1: mAtaraM pitaraM vfdDamAcAryamatiTiM gurum । kliSnIyurapi hiMsyurvA yadi rAjA na pAlayet ॥17॥

text: patedbahuvidhaṃ śastraṃ bahudhā dharmacāriṣu । adharmaḥ pragṛhītaḥ syādyadi rājā na pālayet ॥18॥
html:
patedbahuvidhaṃ śastraṃ bahudhā dharmacāriṣu ।
adharmaḥ pragṛhītaḥ syādyadi rājā na pālayet ॥18॥
slp1: patedbahuviDaM SastraM bahuDA DarmacArizu । aDarmaH pragfhItaH syAdyadi rAjA na pAlayet ॥18॥

text: vadhabandhaparikleśo nityamarthavatāṃ bhavet । mamatvaṃ ca na vindeyuryadi rājā na pālayet ॥19॥
html:
vadhabandhaparikleśo nityamarthavatāṃ bhavet ।
mamatvaṃ ca na vindeyuryadi rājā na pālayet ॥19॥
slp1: vaDabanDaparikleSo nityamarTavatAM Bavet । mamatvaM ca na vindeyuryadi rAjA na pAlayet ॥19॥

text: antaścākāśameva syālloko'yaṃ dasyusādbhavet । patecca narakaṃ ghoraṃ yadi rājā na pālayet ॥20॥
html:
antaścākāśameva syālloko'yaṃ dasyusādbhavet ।
patecca narakaṃ ghoraṃ yadi rājā na pālayet ॥20॥
slp1: antaScAkASameva syAlloko'yaM dasyusAdBavet । patecca narakaM GoraM yadi rAjA na pAlayet ॥20॥

text: na yonipoṣo varteta na kṛṣirna vaṇikpathaḥ । majjeddharmastrayī na syādyadi rājā na pālayet ॥21॥
html:
na yonipoṣo varteta na kṛṣirna vaṇikpathaḥ ।
majjeddharmastrayī na syādyadi rājā na pālayet ॥21॥
slp1: na yonipozo varteta na kfzirna vaRikpaTaH । majjedDarmastrayI na syAdyadi rAjA na pAlayet ॥21॥

text: na yajñāḥ sampravarteranvidhivatsvāptadakṣiṇāḥ । na vivāhāḥ samājā vā yadi rājā na pālayet ॥22॥
html:
na yajñāḥ sampravarteranvidhivatsvāptadakṣiṇāḥ ।
na vivāhāḥ samājā vā yadi rājā na pālayet ॥22॥
slp1: na yajYAH sampravarteranviDivatsvAptadakziRAH । na vivAhAH samAjA vA yadi rAjA na pAlayet ॥22॥

text: na vṛṣāḥ sampravarteranna mathyeraṃśca gargarāḥ । ghoṣāḥ praṇāśaṃ gaccheyuryadi rājā na pālayet ॥23॥
html:
na vṛṣāḥ sampravarteranna mathyeraṃśca gargarāḥ ।
ghoṣāḥ praṇāśaṃ gaccheyuryadi rājā na pālayet ॥23॥
slp1: na vfzAH sampravarteranna maTyeraMSca gargarAH । GozAH praRASaM gacCeyuryadi rAjA na pAlayet ॥23॥

text: trastamudvignahṛdayaṃ hāhābhūtamacetanam । kṣaṇena vinaśetsarvaṃ yadi rājā na pālayet ॥24॥
html:
trastamudvignahṛdayaṃ hāhābhūtamacetanam ।
kṣaṇena vinaśetsarvaṃ yadi rājā na pālayet ॥24॥
slp1: trastamudvignahfdayaM hAhABUtamacetanam । kzaRena vinaSetsarvaM yadi rAjA na pAlayet ॥24॥

text: na saṃvatsarasatrāṇi tiṣṭheyurakutobhayāḥ । vidhivaddakṣiṇāvanti yadi rājā na pālayet ॥25॥
html:
na saṃvatsarasatrāṇi tiṣṭheyurakutobhayāḥ ।
vidhivaddakṣiṇāvanti yadi rājā na pālayet ॥25॥
slp1: na saMvatsarasatrARi tizWeyurakutoBayAH । viDivaddakziRAvanti yadi rAjA na pAlayet ॥25॥

text: brāhmaṇāścaturo vedānnādhīyeraṃstapasvinaḥ । vidyāsnātāstapaḥsnātā yadi rājā na pālayet ॥26॥
html:
brāhmaṇāścaturo vedānnādhīyeraṃstapasvinaḥ ।
vidyāsnātāstapaḥsnātā yadi rājā na pālayet ॥26॥
slp1: brAhmaRAScaturo vedAnnADIyeraMstapasvinaH । vidyAsnAtAstapaHsnAtA yadi rAjA na pAlayet ॥26॥

text: hasto hastaṃ sa muṣṇīyādbhidyeransarvasetavaḥ । bhayārtaṃ vidravetsarvaṃ yadi rājā na pālayet ॥27॥
html:
hasto hastaṃ sa muṣṇīyādbhidyeransarvasetavaḥ ।
bhayārtaṃ vidravetsarvaṃ yadi rājā na pālayet ॥27॥
slp1: hasto hastaM sa muzRIyAdBidyeransarvasetavaH । BayArtaM vidravetsarvaM yadi rAjA na pAlayet ॥27॥

text: na labheddharmasaṃśleṣaṃ hataviprahato janaḥ । kartā svecchendriyo gacchedyadi rājā na pālayet ॥28॥
html:
na labheddharmasaṃśleṣaṃ hataviprahato janaḥ ।
kartā svecchendriyo gacchedyadi rājā na pālayet ॥28॥
slp1: na laBedDarmasaMSlezaM hataviprahato janaH । kartA svecCendriyo gacCedyadi rAjA na pAlayet ॥28॥

text: anayāḥ sampravarteranbhavedvai varṇasaṅkaraḥ । durbhikṣamāviśedrāṣṭraṃ yadi rājā na pālayet ॥29॥
html:
anayāḥ sampravarteranbhavedvai varṇasaṅkaraḥ ।
durbhikṣamāviśedrāṣṭraṃ yadi rājā na pālayet ॥29॥
slp1: anayAH sampravarteranBavedvE varRasaNkaraH । durBikzamAviSedrAzwraM yadi rAjA na pAlayet ॥29॥

text: vivṛtya hi yathākāmaṃ gṛhadvārāṇi śerate । manuṣyā rakṣitā rājñā samantādakutobhayāḥ ॥30॥
html:
vivṛtya hi yathākāmaṃ gṛhadvārāṇi śerate ।
manuṣyā rakṣitā rājñā samantādakutobhayāḥ ॥30॥
slp1: vivftya hi yaTAkAmaM gfhadvArARi Serate । manuzyA rakzitA rAjYA samantAdakutoBayAH ॥30॥

text: nākruṣṭaṃ sahate kaścitkuto hastasya laṅghanam । yadi rājā manuṣyeṣu trātā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ॥31॥
html:
nākruṣṭaṃ sahate kaścitkuto hastasya laṅghanam ।
yadi rājā manuṣyeṣu trātā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: nAkruzwaM sahate kaScitkuto hastasya laNGanam । yadi rAjA manuzyezu trAtA Bavati DArmikaH ॥31॥

text: striyaścāpuruṣā mārgaṃ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitāḥ । nirbhayāḥ pratipadyante yadā rakṣati bhūmipaḥ ॥32॥
html:
striyaścāpuruṣā mārgaṃ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitāḥ ।
nirbhayāḥ pratipadyante yadā rakṣati bhūmipaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: striyaScApuruzA mArgaM sarvAlaNkAraBUzitAH । nirBayAH pratipadyante yadA rakzati BUmipaH ॥32॥

text: dharmameva prapadyante na hiṃsanti parasparam । anugṛhṇanti cānyonyaṃ yadā rakṣati bhūmipaḥ ॥33॥
html:
dharmameva prapadyante na hiṃsanti parasparam ।
anugṛhṇanti cānyonyaṃ yadā rakṣati bhūmipaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: Darmameva prapadyante na hiMsanti parasparam । anugfhRanti cAnyonyaM yadA rakzati BUmipaH ॥33॥

text: yajante ca trayo varṇā mahāyajñaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ । yuktāścādhīyate śāstraṃ yadā rakṣati bhūmipaḥ ॥34॥
html:
yajante ca trayo varṇā mahāyajñaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ।
yuktāścādhīyate śāstraṃ yadā rakṣati bhūmipaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: yajante ca trayo varRA mahAyajYEH pfTagviDEH । yuktAScADIyate SAstraM yadA rakzati BUmipaH ॥34॥

text: vārtāmūlo hyayaṃ lokastrayyā vai dhāryate sadā । tatsarvaṃ vartate samyagyadā rakṣati bhūmipaḥ ॥35॥
html:
vārtāmūlo hyayaṃ lokastrayyā vai dhāryate sadā ।
tatsarvaṃ vartate samyagyadā rakṣati bhūmipaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: vArtAmUlo hyayaM lokastrayyA vE DAryate sadA । tatsarvaM vartate samyagyadA rakzati BUmipaH ॥35॥

text: yadā rājā dhuraṃ śreṣṭhāmādāya vahati prajāḥ । mahatā balayogena tadā lokaḥ prasīdati ॥36॥
html:
yadā rājā dhuraṃ śreṣṭhāmādāya vahati prajāḥ ।
mahatā balayogena tadā lokaḥ prasīdati ॥36॥
slp1: yadA rAjA DuraM SrezWAmAdAya vahati prajAH । mahatA balayogena tadA lokaH prasIdati ॥36॥

text: yasyābhāve ca bhūtānāmabhāvaḥ syātsamantataḥ । bhāve ca bhāvo nityaḥ syātkastaṃ na pratipūjayet ॥37॥
html:
yasyābhāve ca bhūtānāmabhāvaḥ syātsamantataḥ ।
bhāve ca bhāvo nityaḥ syātkastaṃ na pratipūjayet ॥37॥
slp1: yasyABAve ca BUtAnAmaBAvaH syAtsamantataH । BAve ca BAvo nityaH syAtkastaM na pratipUjayet ॥37॥

text: tasya yo vahate bhāraṃ sarvalokasukhāvaham । tiṣṭhetpriyahite rājña ubhau lokau hi yo jayet ॥38॥
html:
tasya yo vahate bhāraṃ sarvalokasukhāvaham ।
tiṣṭhetpriyahite rājña ubhau lokau hi yo jayet ॥38॥
slp1: tasya yo vahate BAraM sarvalokasuKAvaham । tizWetpriyahite rAjYa uBO lokO hi yo jayet ॥38॥

text: yastasya puruṣaḥ pāpaṃ manasāpyanucintayet । asaṃśayamiha kliṣṭaḥ pretyāpi narakaṃ patet ॥39॥
html:
yastasya puruṣaḥ pāpaṃ manasāpyanucintayet ।
asaṃśayamiha kliṣṭaḥ pretyāpi narakaṃ patet ॥39॥
slp1: yastasya puruzaH pApaM manasApyanucintayet । asaMSayamiha klizwaH pretyApi narakaM patet ॥39॥

text: na hi jātvavamantavyo manuṣya iti bhūmipaḥ । mahatī devatā hyeṣā nararūpeṇa tiṣṭhati ॥40॥
html:
na hi jātvavamantavyo manuṣya iti bhūmipaḥ ।
mahatī devatā hyeṣā nararūpeṇa tiṣṭhati ॥40॥
slp1: na hi jAtvavamantavyo manuzya iti BUmipaH । mahatI devatA hyezA nararUpeRa tizWati ॥40॥

text: kurute pañca rūpāṇi kālayuktāni yaḥ sadā । bhavatyagnistathādityo mṛtyurvaiśravaṇo yamaḥ ॥41॥
html:
kurute pañca rūpāṇi kālayuktāni yaḥ sadā ।
bhavatyagnistathādityo mṛtyurvaiśravaṇo yamaḥ ॥41॥
slp1: kurute paYca rUpARi kAlayuktAni yaH sadA । BavatyagnistaTAdityo mftyurvESravaRo yamaH ॥41॥

text: yadā hyāsīdataḥ pāpāndahatyugreṇa tejasā । mithyopacarito rājā tadā bhavati pāvakaḥ ॥42॥
html:
yadā hyāsīdataḥ pāpāndahatyugreṇa tejasā ।
mithyopacarito rājā tadā bhavati pāvakaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: yadA hyAsIdataH pApAndahatyugreRa tejasA । miTyopacarito rAjA tadA Bavati pAvakaH ॥42॥

text: yadā paśyati cāreṇa sarvabhūtāni bhūmipaḥ । kṣemaṃ ca kṛtvā vrajati tadā bhavati bhāskaraḥ ॥43॥
html:
yadā paśyati cāreṇa sarvabhūtāni bhūmipaḥ ।
kṣemaṃ ca kṛtvā vrajati tadā bhavati bhāskaraḥ ॥43॥
slp1: yadA paSyati cAreRa sarvaBUtAni BUmipaH । kzemaM ca kftvA vrajati tadA Bavati BAskaraH ॥43॥

text: aśucīṃśca yadā kruddhaḥ kṣiṇoti śataśo narān । saputrapautrānsāmātyāṃstadā bhavati so'ntakaḥ ॥44॥
html:
aśucīṃśca yadā kruddhaḥ kṣiṇoti śataśo narān ।
saputrapautrānsāmātyāṃstadā bhavati so'ntakaḥ ॥44॥
slp1: aSucIMSca yadA krudDaH kziRoti SataSo narAn । saputrapOtrAnsAmAtyAMstadA Bavati so'ntakaH ॥44॥

text: yadā tvadhārmikānsarvāṃstīkṣṇairdaṇḍairniyacchati । dhārmikāṃścānugṛhṇāti bhavatyatha yamastadā ॥45॥
html:
yadā tvadhārmikānsarvāṃstīkṣṇairdaṇḍairniyacchati ।
dhārmikāṃścānugṛhṇāti bhavatyatha yamastadā ॥45॥
slp1: yadA tvaDArmikAnsarvAMstIkzRErdaRqErniyacCati । DArmikAMScAnugfhRAti BavatyaTa yamastadA ॥45॥

text: yadā tu dhanadhārābhistarpayatyupakāriṇaḥ । ācchinatti ca ratnāni vividhānyapakāriṇām ॥46॥
html:
yadā tu dhanadhārābhistarpayatyupakāriṇaḥ ।
ācchinatti ca ratnāni vividhānyapakāriṇām ॥46॥
slp1: yadA tu DanaDArABistarpayatyupakAriRaH । AcCinatti ca ratnAni viviDAnyapakAriRAm ॥46॥

text: śriyaṃ dadāti kasmaicitkasmāccidapakarṣati । tadā vaiśravaṇo rājaṁlloke bhavati bhūmipaḥ ॥47॥
html:
śriyaṃ dadāti kasmaicitkasmāccidapakarṣati ।
tadā vaiśravaṇo rājaṁlloke bhavati bhūmipaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: SriyaM dadAti kasmEcitkasmAccidapakarzati । tadA vESravaRo rAjaṁlloke Bavati BUmipaH ॥47॥

text: nāsyāpavāde sthātavyaṃ dakṣeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā । dharmyamākāṅkṣatā lābhamīśvarasyānasūyatā ॥48॥
html:
nāsyāpavāde sthātavyaṃ dakṣeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā ।
dharmyamākāṅkṣatā lābhamīśvarasyānasūyatā ॥48॥
slp1: nAsyApavAde sTAtavyaM dakzeRAklizwakarmaRA । DarmyamAkANkzatA lABamISvarasyAnasUyatA ॥48॥

text: na hi rājñaḥ pratīpāni kurvansukhamavāpnuyāt । putro bhrātā vayasyo vā yadyapyātmasamo bhavet ॥49॥
html:
na hi rājñaḥ pratīpāni kurvansukhamavāpnuyāt ।
putro bhrātā vayasyo vā yadyapyātmasamo bhavet ॥49॥
slp1: na hi rAjYaH pratIpAni kurvansuKamavApnuyAt । putro BrAtA vayasyo vA yadyapyAtmasamo Bavet ॥49॥

text: kuryātkṛṣṇagatiḥ śeṣaṃ jvalito'nilasārathiḥ । na tu rājñābhipannasya śeṣaṃ kvacana vidyate ॥50॥
html:
kuryātkṛṣṇagatiḥ śeṣaṃ jvalito'nilasārathiḥ ।
na tu rājñābhipannasya śeṣaṃ kvacana vidyate ॥50॥
slp1: kuryAtkfzRagatiH SezaM jvalito'nilasAraTiH । na tu rAjYABipannasya SezaM kvacana vidyate ॥50॥

text: tasya sarvāṇi rakṣyāṇi dūrataḥ parivarjayet । mṛtyoriva jugupseta rājasvaharaṇānnaraḥ ॥51॥
html:
tasya sarvāṇi rakṣyāṇi dūrataḥ parivarjayet ।
mṛtyoriva jugupseta rājasvaharaṇānnaraḥ ॥51॥
slp1: tasya sarvARi rakzyARi dUrataH parivarjayet । mftyoriva jugupseta rAjasvaharaRAnnaraH ॥51॥

text: naśyedabhimṛśansadyo mṛgaḥ kūṭamiva spṛśan । ātmasvamiva saṃrakṣedrājasvamiha buddhimān ॥52॥
html:
naśyedabhimṛśansadyo mṛgaḥ kūṭamiva spṛśan ।
ātmasvamiva saṃrakṣedrājasvamiha buddhimān ॥52॥
slp1: naSyedaBimfSansadyo mfgaH kUwamiva spfSan । Atmasvamiva saMrakzedrAjasvamiha budDimAn ॥52॥

text: mahāntaṃ narakaṃ ghoramapratiṣṭhamacetasaḥ । patanti cirarātrāya rājavittāpahāriṇaḥ ॥53॥
html:
mahāntaṃ narakaṃ ghoramapratiṣṭhamacetasaḥ ।
patanti cirarātrāya rājavittāpahāriṇaḥ ॥53॥
slp1: mahAntaM narakaM GoramapratizWamacetasaH । patanti cirarAtrAya rAjavittApahAriRaH ॥53॥

text: rājā bhojo virāṭsamrāṭkṣatriyo bhūpatirnṛpaḥ । ya evaṃ stūyate śabdaiḥ kastaṃ nārcitumicchati ॥54॥
html:
rājā bhojo virāṭsamrāṭkṣatriyo bhūpatirnṛpaḥ ।
ya evaṃ stūyate śabdaiḥ kastaṃ nārcitumicchati ॥54॥
slp1: rAjA Bojo virAwsamrAwkzatriyo BUpatirnfpaH । ya evaM stUyate SabdEH kastaM nArcitumicCati ॥54॥

text: tasmādbubhūṣurniyato jitātmā saṃyatendriyaḥ । medhāvī smṛtimāndakṣaḥ saṃśrayeta mahīpatim ॥55॥
html:
tasmādbubhūṣurniyato jitātmā saṃyatendriyaḥ ।
medhāvī smṛtimāndakṣaḥ saṃśrayeta mahīpatim ॥55॥
slp1: tasmAdbuBUzurniyato jitAtmA saMyatendriyaH । meDAvI smftimAndakzaH saMSrayeta mahIpatim ॥55॥

text: kṛtajñaṃ prājñamakṣudraṃ dṛḍhabhaktiṃ jitendriyam । dharmanityaṃ sthitaṃ sthityāṃ mantriṇaṃ pūjayennṛpaḥ ॥56॥
html:
kṛtajñaṃ prājñamakṣudraṃ dṛḍhabhaktiṃ jitendriyam ।
dharmanityaṃ sthitaṃ sthityāṃ mantriṇaṃ pūjayennṛpaḥ ॥56॥
slp1: kftajYaM prAjYamakzudraM dfQaBaktiM jitendriyam । DarmanityaM sTitaM sTityAM mantriRaM pUjayennfpaH ॥56॥

text: dṛḍhabhaktiṃ kṛtaprajñaṃ dharmajñaṃ saṃyatendriyam । śūramakṣudrakarmāṇaṃ niṣiddhajanamāśrayet ॥57॥
html:
dṛḍhabhaktiṃ kṛtaprajñaṃ dharmajñaṃ saṃyatendriyam ।
śūramakṣudrakarmāṇaṃ niṣiddhajanamāśrayet ॥57॥
slp1: dfQaBaktiM kftaprajYaM DarmajYaM saMyatendriyam । SUramakzudrakarmARaM nizidDajanamASrayet ॥57॥

text: rājā pragalbhaṃ puruṣaṃ karoti rājā kṛśaṃ bṛṃhayate manuṣyam । rājābhipannasya kutaḥ sukhāni rājābhyupetaṃ sukhinaṃ karoti ॥58॥
html:
rājā pragalbhaṃ puruṣaṃ karoti rājā kṛśaṃ bṛṃhayate manuṣyam ।
rājābhipannasya kutaḥ sukhāni rājābhyupetaṃ sukhinaṃ karoti ॥58॥
slp1: rAjA pragalBaM puruzaM karoti rAjA kfSaM bfMhayate manuzyam । rAjABipannasya kutaH suKAni rAjAByupetaM suKinaM karoti ॥58॥

text: rājā prajānāṃ hṛdayaṃ garīyo gatiḥ pratiṣṭhā sukhamuttamaṃ ca । yamāśritā lokamimaṃ paraṃ ca jayanti samyakpuruṣā narendram ॥59॥
html:
rājā prajānāṃ hṛdayaṃ garīyo gatiḥ pratiṣṭhā sukhamuttamaṃ ca ।
yamāśritā lokamimaṃ paraṃ ca jayanti samyakpuruṣā narendram ॥59॥
slp1: rAjA prajAnAM hfdayaM garIyo gatiH pratizWA suKamuttamaM ca । yamASritA lokamimaM paraM ca jayanti samyakpuruzA narendram ॥59॥

text: narādhipaścāpyanuśiṣya medinīṃ damena satyena ca sauhṛdena । mahadbhiriṣṭvā kratubhirmahāyaśāstriviṣṭape sthānamupaiti satkṛtam ॥60॥
html:
narādhipaścāpyanuśiṣya medinīṃ damena satyena ca sauhṛdena ।
mahadbhiriṣṭvā kratubhirmahāyaśāstriviṣṭape sthānamupaiti satkṛtam ॥60॥
slp1: narADipaScApyanuSizya medinIM damena satyena ca sOhfdena । mahadBirizwvA kratuBirmahAyaSAstrivizwape sTAnamupEti satkftam ॥60॥

text: sa evamukto guruṇā kausalyo rājasattamaḥ । prayatnātkṛtavānvīraḥ prajānāṃ paripālanam] ॥61॥
html:
sa evamukto guruṇā kausalyo rājasattamaḥ ।
prayatnātkṛtavānvīraḥ prajānāṃ paripālanam] ॥61॥
slp1: sa evamukto guruRA kOsalyo rAjasattamaH । prayatnAtkftavAnvIraH prajAnAM paripAlanam] ॥61॥

text: pārthivena viśeṣeṇa kiṃ kāryamavaśiṣyate । kathaṃ rakṣyo janapadaḥ kathaṃ rakṣyāśca śatravaḥ ॥1॥
html:
pārthivena viśeṣeṇa kiṃ kāryamavaśiṣyate ।
kathaṃ rakṣyo janapadaḥ kathaṃ rakṣyāśca śatravaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: pArTivena viSezeRa kiM kAryamavaSizyate । kaTaM rakzyo janapadaH kaTaM rakzyASca SatravaH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kathaṃ cāraṃ prayuñjīta varṇānviśvāsayetkatham । kathaṃ bhṛtyānkathaṃ dārānkathaṃ putrāṃśca bhārata ॥2॥
html:
kathaṃ cāraṃ prayuñjīta varṇānviśvāsayetkatham ।
kathaṃ bhṛtyānkathaṃ dārānkathaṃ putrāṃśca bhārata ॥2॥
slp1: kaTaM cAraM prayuYjIta varRAnviSvAsayetkaTam । kaTaM BftyAnkaTaM dArAnkaTaM putrAMSca BArata ॥2॥

text: rājavṛttaṃ mahārāja śṛṇuṣvāvahito'khilam । yatkāryaṃ pārthivenādau pārthivaprakṛtena vā ॥3॥
html:
rājavṛttaṃ mahārāja śṛṇuṣvāvahito'khilam ।
yatkāryaṃ pārthivenādau pārthivaprakṛtena vā ॥3॥
slp1: rAjavfttaM mahArAja SfRuzvAvahito'Kilam । yatkAryaM pArTivenAdO pArTivaprakftena vA ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ātmā jeyaḥ sadā rājñā tato jeyāśca śatravaḥ । ajitātmā narapatirvijayeta kathaṃ ripūn ॥4॥
html:
ātmā jeyaḥ sadā rājñā tato jeyāśca śatravaḥ ।
ajitātmā narapatirvijayeta kathaṃ ripūn ॥4॥
slp1: AtmA jeyaH sadA rAjYA tato jeyASca SatravaH । ajitAtmA narapatirvijayeta kaTaM ripUn ॥4॥

text: etāvānātmavijayaḥ pañcavargavinigrahaḥ । jitendriyo narapatirbādhituṃ śaknuyādarīn ॥5॥
html:
etāvānātmavijayaḥ pañcavargavinigrahaḥ ।
jitendriyo narapatirbādhituṃ śaknuyādarīn ॥5॥
slp1: etAvAnAtmavijayaH paYcavargavinigrahaH । jitendriyo narapatirbADituM SaknuyAdarIn ॥5॥

text: nyaseta gulmāndurgeṣu sandhau ca kurunandana । nagaropavane caiva purodyāneṣu caiva ha ॥6॥
html:
nyaseta gulmāndurgeṣu sandhau ca kurunandana ।
nagaropavane caiva purodyāneṣu caiva ha ॥6॥
slp1: nyaseta gulmAndurgezu sanDO ca kurunandana । nagaropavane cEva purodyAnezu cEva ha ॥6॥

text: saṃsthāneṣu ca sarveṣu pureṣu nagarasya ca । madhye ca naraśārdūla tathā rājaniveśane ॥7॥
html:
saṃsthāneṣu ca sarveṣu pureṣu nagarasya ca ।
madhye ca naraśārdūla tathā rājaniveśane ॥7॥
slp1: saMsTAnezu ca sarvezu purezu nagarasya ca । maDye ca naraSArdUla taTA rAjaniveSane ॥7॥

text: praṇidhīṃśca tataḥ kuryājjaḍāndhabadhirākṛtīn । puṃsaḥ parīkṣitānprājñānkṣutpipāsātapakṣamān ॥8॥
html:
praṇidhīṃśca tataḥ kuryājjaḍāndhabadhirākṛtīn ।
puṃsaḥ parīkṣitānprājñānkṣutpipāsātapakṣamān ॥8॥
slp1: praRiDIMSca tataH kuryAjjaqAnDabaDirAkftIn । puMsaH parIkzitAnprAjYAnkzutpipAsAtapakzamAn ॥8॥

text: amātyeṣu ca sarveṣu mitreṣu trividheṣu ca । putreṣu ca mahārāja praṇidadhyātsamāhitaḥ ॥9॥
html:
amātyeṣu ca sarveṣu mitreṣu trividheṣu ca ।
putreṣu ca mahārāja praṇidadhyātsamāhitaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: amAtyezu ca sarvezu mitrezu triviDezu ca । putrezu ca mahArAja praRidaDyAtsamAhitaH ॥9॥

text: pure janapade caiva tathā sāmantarājasu । yathā na vidyuranyonyaṃ praṇidheyāstathā hi te ॥10॥
html:
pure janapade caiva tathā sāmantarājasu ।
yathā na vidyuranyonyaṃ praṇidheyāstathā hi te ॥10॥
slp1: pure janapade cEva taTA sAmantarAjasu । yaTA na vidyuranyonyaM praRiDeyAstaTA hi te ॥10॥

text: cārāṃśca vidyātprahitānpareṇa bharatarṣabha । āpaṇeṣu vihāreṣu samavāyeṣu bhikṣuṣu ॥11॥
html:
cārāṃśca vidyātprahitānpareṇa bharatarṣabha ।
āpaṇeṣu vihāreṣu samavāyeṣu bhikṣuṣu ॥11॥
slp1: cArAMSca vidyAtprahitAnpareRa BaratarzaBa । ApaRezu vihArezu samavAyezu Bikzuzu ॥11॥

text: ārāmeṣu tathodyāne paṇḍitānāṃ samāgame । veśeṣu catvare caiva sabhāsvāvasatheṣu ca ॥12॥
html:
ārāmeṣu tathodyāne paṇḍitānāṃ samāgame ।
veśeṣu catvare caiva sabhāsvāvasatheṣu ca ॥12॥
slp1: ArAmezu taTodyAne paRqitAnAM samAgame । veSezu catvare cEva saBAsvAvasaTezu ca ॥12॥

text: evaṃ vihanyāccāreṇa paracāraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ । cāreṇa vihataṃ sarvaṃ hataṃ bhavati pāṇḍava ॥13॥
html:
evaṃ vihanyāccāreṇa paracāraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ।
cāreṇa vihataṃ sarvaṃ hataṃ bhavati pāṇḍava ॥13॥
slp1: evaM vihanyAccAreRa paracAraM vicakzaRaH । cAreRa vihataM sarvaM hataM Bavati pARqava ॥13॥

text: yadā tu hīnaṃ nṛpatirvidyādātmānamātmanā । amātyaiḥ saha sammantrya kuryātsandhiṃ balīyasā ॥14॥
html:
yadā tu hīnaṃ nṛpatirvidyādātmānamātmanā ।
amātyaiḥ saha sammantrya kuryātsandhiṃ balīyasā ॥14॥
slp1: yadA tu hInaM nfpatirvidyAdAtmAnamAtmanA । amAtyEH saha sammantrya kuryAtsanDiM balIyasA ॥14॥

text: ajñāyamāno hīnatve kuryātsandhiṃ pareṇa vai । lipsurvā kañcidevārthaṃ tvaramāṇo vicakṣaṇaḥ ॥15॥
html:
ajñāyamāno hīnatve kuryātsandhiṃ pareṇa vai ।
lipsurvā kañcidevārthaṃ tvaramāṇo vicakṣaṇaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: ajYAyamAno hInatve kuryAtsanDiM pareRa vE । lipsurvA kaYcidevArTaM tvaramARo vicakzaRaH ॥15॥

text: guṇavanto mahotsāhā dharmajñāḥ sādhavaśca ye । sandadhīta nṛpastaiśca rāṣṭraṃ dharmeṇa pālayan ॥16॥
html:
guṇavanto mahotsāhā dharmajñāḥ sādhavaśca ye ।
sandadhīta nṛpastaiśca rāṣṭraṃ dharmeṇa pālayan ॥16॥
slp1: guRavanto mahotsAhA DarmajYAH sADavaSca ye । sandaDIta nfpastESca rAzwraM DarmeRa pAlayan ॥16॥

text: ucchidyamānamātmānaṃ jñātvā rājā mahāmatiḥ । pūrvāpakāriṇo hanyāllokadviṣṭāṃśca sarvaśaḥ ॥17॥
html:
ucchidyamānamātmānaṃ jñātvā rājā mahāmatiḥ ।
pūrvāpakāriṇo hanyāllokadviṣṭāṃśca sarvaśaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: ucCidyamAnamAtmAnaM jYAtvA rAjA mahAmatiH । pUrvApakAriRo hanyAllokadvizwAMSca sarvaSaH ॥17॥

text: yo nopakartuṃ śaknoti nāpakartuṃ mahīpatiḥ । aśakyarūpaścoddhartumupekṣyastādṛśo bhavet ॥18॥
html:
yo nopakartuṃ śaknoti nāpakartuṃ mahīpatiḥ ।
aśakyarūpaścoddhartumupekṣyastādṛśo bhavet ॥18॥
slp1: yo nopakartuM Saknoti nApakartuM mahIpatiH । aSakyarUpaScodDartumupekzyastAdfSo Bavet ॥18॥

text: yātrāṃ yāyādavijñātamanākrandamanantaram । vyāsaktaṃ ca pramattaṃ ca durbalaṃ ca vicakṣaṇaḥ ॥19॥
html:
yātrāṃ yāyādavijñātamanākrandamanantaram ।
vyāsaktaṃ ca pramattaṃ ca durbalaṃ ca vicakṣaṇaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: yAtrAM yAyAdavijYAtamanAkrandamanantaram । vyAsaktaM ca pramattaM ca durbalaM ca vicakzaRaH ॥19॥

text: yātrāmājñāpayedvīraḥ kalyapuṣṭabalaḥ sukhī । pūrvaṃ kṛtvā vidhānaṃ ca yātrāyāṃ nagare tathā ॥20॥
html:
yātrāmājñāpayedvīraḥ kalyapuṣṭabalaḥ sukhī ।
pūrvaṃ kṛtvā vidhānaṃ ca yātrāyāṃ nagare tathā ॥20॥
slp1: yAtrAmAjYApayedvIraH kalyapuzwabalaH suKI । pUrvaM kftvA viDAnaM ca yAtrAyAM nagare taTA ॥20॥

text: na ca vaśyo bhavedasya nṛpo yadyapi vīryavān । hīnaśca balavīryābhyāṃ karśayaṃstaṃ parāvaset ॥21॥
html:
na ca vaśyo bhavedasya nṛpo yadyapi vīryavān ।
hīnaśca balavīryābhyāṃ karśayaṃstaṃ parāvaset ॥21॥
slp1: na ca vaSyo Bavedasya nfpo yadyapi vIryavAn । hInaSca balavIryAByAM karSayaMstaM parAvaset ॥21॥

text: rāṣṭraṃ ca pīḍayettasya śastrāgniviṣamūrchanaiḥ । amātyavallabhānāṃ ca vivādāṃstasya kārayet । varjanīyaṃ sadā yuddhaṃ rājyakāmena dhīmatā ॥22॥
html:
rāṣṭraṃ ca pīḍayettasya śastrāgniviṣamūrchanaiḥ ।
amātyavallabhānāṃ ca vivādāṃstasya kārayet ।
varjanīyaṃ sadā yuddhaṃ rājyakāmena dhīmatā ॥22॥
slp1: rAzwraM ca pIqayettasya SastrAgnivizamUrCanEH । amAtyavallaBAnAM ca vivAdAMstasya kArayet । varjanIyaM sadA yudDaM rAjyakAmena DImatA ॥22॥

text: upāyaistribhirādānamarthasyāha bṛhaspatiḥ । sāntvenānupradānena bhedena ca narādhipa । yamarthaṃ śaknuyātprāptuṃ tena tuṣyeddhi paṇḍitaḥ ॥23॥
html:
upāyaistribhirādānamarthasyāha bṛhaspatiḥ ।
sāntvenānupradānena bhedena ca narādhipa ।
yamarthaṃ śaknuyātprāptuṃ tena tuṣyeddhi paṇḍitaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: upAyEstriBirAdAnamarTasyAha bfhaspatiH । sAntvenAnupradAnena Bedena ca narADipa । yamarTaM SaknuyAtprAptuM tena tuzyedDi paRqitaH ॥23॥

text: ādadīta baliṃ caiva prajābhyaḥ kurunandana । ṣaḍbhāgamamitaprajñastāsāmevābhiguptaye ॥24॥
html:
ādadīta baliṃ caiva prajābhyaḥ kurunandana ।
ṣaḍbhāgamamitaprajñastāsāmevābhiguptaye ॥24॥
slp1: AdadIta baliM cEva prajAByaH kurunandana । zaqBAgamamitaprajYastAsAmevABiguptaye ॥24॥

text: daśadharmagatebhyo yadvasu bahvalpameva ca । tannādadīta sahasā paurāṇāṃ rakṣaṇāya vai ॥25॥
html:
daśadharmagatebhyo yadvasu bahvalpameva ca ।
tannādadīta sahasā paurāṇāṃ rakṣaṇāya vai ॥25॥
slp1: daSaDarmagateByo yadvasu bahvalpameva ca । tannAdadIta sahasA pOrARAM rakzaRAya vE ॥25॥

text: yathā putrāstathā paurā draṣṭavyāste na saṃśayaḥ । bhaktiścaiṣāṃ prakartavyā vyavahāre pradarśite ॥26॥
html:
yathā putrāstathā paurā draṣṭavyāste na saṃśayaḥ ।
bhaktiścaiṣāṃ prakartavyā vyavahāre pradarśite ॥26॥
slp1: yaTA putrAstaTA pOrA drazwavyAste na saMSayaH । BaktiScEzAM prakartavyA vyavahAre pradarSite ॥26॥

text: sutaṃ ca sthāpayedrājā prājñaṃ sarvārthadarśinam । vyavahāreṣu satataṃ tatra rājyaṃ vyavasthitam ॥27॥
html:
sutaṃ ca sthāpayedrājā prājñaṃ sarvārthadarśinam ।
vyavahāreṣu satataṃ tatra rājyaṃ vyavasthitam ॥27॥
slp1: sutaM ca sTApayedrAjA prAjYaM sarvArTadarSinam । vyavahArezu satataM tatra rAjyaM vyavasTitam ॥27॥

text: ākare lavaṇe śulke tare nāgavane tathā । nyasedamātyānnṛpatiḥ svāptānvā puruṣānhitān ॥28॥
html:
ākare lavaṇe śulke tare nāgavane tathā ।
nyasedamātyānnṛpatiḥ svāptānvā puruṣānhitān ॥28॥
slp1: Akare lavaRe Sulke tare nAgavane taTA । nyasedamAtyAnnfpatiH svAptAnvA puruzAnhitAn ॥28॥

text: samyagdaṇḍadharo nityaṃ rājā dharmamavāpnuyāt । nṛpasya satataṃ daṇḍaḥ samyagdharme praśasyate ॥29॥
html:
samyagdaṇḍadharo nityaṃ rājā dharmamavāpnuyāt ।
nṛpasya satataṃ daṇḍaḥ samyagdharme praśasyate ॥29॥
slp1: samyagdaRqaDaro nityaM rAjA DarmamavApnuyAt । nfpasya satataM daRqaH samyagDarme praSasyate ॥29॥

text: vedavedāṅgavitprājñaḥ sutapasvī nṛpo bhavet । dānaśīlaśca satataṃ yajñaśīlaśca bhārata ॥30॥
html:
vedavedāṅgavitprājñaḥ sutapasvī nṛpo bhavet ।
dānaśīlaśca satataṃ yajñaśīlaśca bhārata ॥30॥
slp1: vedavedANgavitprAjYaH sutapasvI nfpo Bavet । dAnaSIlaSca satataM yajYaSIlaSca BArata ॥30॥

text: ete guṇāḥ samastāḥ syurnṛpasya satataṃ sthirāḥ । kriyālope tu nṛpateḥ kutaḥ svargaḥ kuto yaśaḥ ॥31॥
html:
ete guṇāḥ samastāḥ syurnṛpasya satataṃ sthirāḥ ।
kriyālope tu nṛpateḥ kutaḥ svargaḥ kuto yaśaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: ete guRAH samastAH syurnfpasya satataM sTirAH । kriyAlope tu nfpateH kutaH svargaH kuto yaSaH ॥31॥

text: yadā tu pīḍito rājā bhavedrājñā balīyasā । tridhā tvākrandya mitrāṇi vidhānamupakalpayet ॥32॥
html:
yadā tu pīḍito rājā bhavedrājñā balīyasā ।
tridhā tvākrandya mitrāṇi vidhānamupakalpayet ॥32॥
slp1: yadA tu pIqito rAjA BavedrAjYA balIyasA । triDA tvAkrandya mitrARi viDAnamupakalpayet ॥32॥

text: ghoṣānnyaseta mārgeṣu grāmānutthāpayedapi । praveśayecca tānsarvāñśākhānagarakeṣvapi ॥33॥
html:
ghoṣānnyaseta mārgeṣu grāmānutthāpayedapi ।
praveśayecca tānsarvāñśākhānagarakeṣvapi ॥33॥
slp1: GozAnnyaseta mArgezu grAmAnutTApayedapi । praveSayecca tAnsarvAYSAKAnagarakezvapi ॥33॥

text: ye guptāścaiva durgāśca deśāsteṣu praveśayet । dhanino balamukhyāṃśca sāntvayitvā punaḥ punaḥ ॥34॥
html:
ye guptāścaiva durgāśca deśāsteṣu praveśayet ।
dhanino balamukhyāṃśca sāntvayitvā punaḥ punaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: ye guptAScEva durgASca deSAstezu praveSayet । Danino balamuKyAMSca sAntvayitvA punaH punaH ॥34॥

text: sasyābhihāraṃ kuryācca svayameva narādhipaḥ । asambhave praveśasya dāhayedagninā bhṛśam ॥35॥
html:
sasyābhihāraṃ kuryācca svayameva narādhipaḥ ।
asambhave praveśasya dāhayedagninā bhṛśam ॥35॥
slp1: sasyABihAraM kuryAcca svayameva narADipaH । asamBave praveSasya dAhayedagninA BfSam ॥35॥

text: kṣetrastheṣu ca sasyeṣu śatrorupajapennarān । vināśayedvā sarvasvaṃ balenātha svakena vai ॥36॥
html:
kṣetrastheṣu ca sasyeṣu śatrorupajapennarān ।
vināśayedvā sarvasvaṃ balenātha svakena vai ॥36॥
slp1: kzetrasTezu ca sasyezu SatrorupajapennarAn । vinASayedvA sarvasvaM balenATa svakena vE ॥36॥

text: nadīṣu mārgeṣu sadā saṅkramānavasādayet । jalaṃ nisrāvayetsarvamanisrāvyaṃ ca dūṣayet ॥37॥
html:
nadīṣu mārgeṣu sadā saṅkramānavasādayet ।
jalaṃ nisrāvayetsarvamanisrāvyaṃ ca dūṣayet ॥37॥
slp1: nadIzu mArgezu sadA saNkramAnavasAdayet । jalaM nisrAvayetsarvamanisrAvyaM ca dUzayet ॥37॥

text: tadātvenāyatībhiśca vivadanbhūmyanantaram । pratīghātaḥ parasyājau mitrakāle'pyupasthite ॥38॥
html:
tadātvenāyatībhiśca vivadanbhūmyanantaram ।
pratīghātaḥ parasyājau mitrakāle'pyupasthite ॥38॥
slp1: tadAtvenAyatIBiSca vivadanBUmyanantaram । pratIGAtaH parasyAjO mitrakAle'pyupasTite ॥38॥

text: durgāṇāṃ cābhito rājā mūlacchedaṃ prakārayet । sarveṣāṃ kṣudravṛkṣāṇāṃ caityavṛkṣānvivarjayet ॥39॥
html:
durgāṇāṃ cābhito rājā mūlacchedaṃ prakārayet ।
sarveṣāṃ kṣudravṛkṣāṇāṃ caityavṛkṣānvivarjayet ॥39॥
slp1: durgARAM cABito rAjA mUlacCedaM prakArayet । sarvezAM kzudravfkzARAM cEtyavfkzAnvivarjayet ॥39॥

text: pravṛddhānāṃ ca vṛkṣāṇāṃ śākhāḥ pracchedayettathā । caityānāṃ sarvathā varjyamapi patrasya pātanam ॥40॥
html:
pravṛddhānāṃ ca vṛkṣāṇāṃ śākhāḥ pracchedayettathā ।
caityānāṃ sarvathā varjyamapi patrasya pātanam ॥40॥
slp1: pravfdDAnAM ca vfkzARAM SAKAH pracCedayettaTA । cEtyAnAM sarvaTA varjyamapi patrasya pAtanam ॥40॥

text: prakaṇṭhīḥ kārayetsamyagākāśajananīstathā । āpūrayecca parikhāḥ sthāṇunakrajhaṣākulāḥ ॥41॥
html:
prakaṇṭhīḥ kārayetsamyagākāśajananīstathā ।
āpūrayecca parikhāḥ sthāṇunakrajhaṣākulāḥ ॥41॥
slp1: prakaRWIH kArayetsamyagAkASajananIstaTA । ApUrayecca pariKAH sTARunakraJazAkulAH ॥41॥

text: kaḍaṅgadvārakāṇi syurucchvāsārthe purasya ha । teṣāṃ ca dvāravadguptiḥ kāryā sarvātmanā bhavet ॥42॥
html:
kaḍaṅgadvārakāṇi syurucchvāsārthe purasya ha ।
teṣāṃ ca dvāravadguptiḥ kāryā sarvātmanā bhavet ॥42॥
slp1: kaqaNgadvArakARi syurucCvAsArTe purasya ha । tezAM ca dvAravadguptiH kAryA sarvAtmanA Bavet ॥42॥

text: dvāreṣu ca gurūṇyeva yantrāṇi sthāpayetsadā । āropayecchataghnīśca svādhīnāni ca kārayet ॥43॥
html:
dvāreṣu ca gurūṇyeva yantrāṇi sthāpayetsadā ।
āropayecchataghnīśca svādhīnāni ca kārayet ॥43॥
slp1: dvArezu ca gurURyeva yantrARi sTApayetsadA । AropayecCataGnISca svADInAni ca kArayet ॥43॥

text: kāṣṭhāni cābhihāryāṇi tathā kūpāṃśca khānayet । saṃśodhayettathā kūpānkṛtānpūrvaṃ payorthibhiḥ ॥44॥
html:
kāṣṭhāni cābhihāryāṇi tathā kūpāṃśca khānayet ।
saṃśodhayettathā kūpānkṛtānpūrvaṃ payorthibhiḥ ॥44॥
slp1: kAzWAni cABihAryARi taTA kUpAMSca KAnayet । saMSoDayettaTA kUpAnkftAnpUrvaM payorTiBiH ॥44॥

text: tṛṇacchannāni veśmāni paṅkenāpi pralepayet । nirharecca tṛṇaṃ māse caitre vahnibhayātpuraḥ ॥45॥
html:
tṛṇacchannāni veśmāni paṅkenāpi pralepayet ।
nirharecca tṛṇaṃ māse caitre vahnibhayātpuraḥ ॥45॥
slp1: tfRacCannAni veSmAni paNkenApi pralepayet । nirharecca tfRaM mAse cEtre vahniBayAtpuraH ॥45॥

text: naktameva ca bhaktāni pācayeta narādhipaḥ । na divāgnirjvaledgehe varjayitvāgnihotrikam ॥46॥
html:
naktameva ca bhaktāni pācayeta narādhipaḥ ।
na divāgnirjvaledgehe varjayitvāgnihotrikam ॥46॥
slp1: naktameva ca BaktAni pAcayeta narADipaH । na divAgnirjvaledgehe varjayitvAgnihotrikam ॥46॥

text: karmārāriṣṭaśālāsu jvaledagniḥ samāhitaḥ । gṛhāṇi ca praviśyātha vidheyaḥ syāddhutāśanaḥ ॥47॥
html:
karmārāriṣṭaśālāsu jvaledagniḥ samāhitaḥ ।
gṛhāṇi ca praviśyātha vidheyaḥ syāddhutāśanaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: karmArArizwaSAlAsu jvaledagniH samAhitaH । gfhARi ca praviSyATa viDeyaH syAdDutASanaH ॥47॥

text: mahādaṇḍaśca tasya syādyasyāgnirvai divā bhavet । praghoṣayedathaivaṃ ca rakṣaṇārthaṃ purasya vai ॥48॥
html:
mahādaṇḍaśca tasya syādyasyāgnirvai divā bhavet ।
praghoṣayedathaivaṃ ca rakṣaṇārthaṃ purasya vai ॥48॥
slp1: mahAdaRqaSca tasya syAdyasyAgnirvE divA Bavet । praGozayedaTEvaM ca rakzaRArTaM purasya vE ॥48॥

text: bhikṣukāṃścākrikāṃścaiva kṣībonmattānkuśīlavān । bāhyānkuryānnaraśreṣṭha doṣāya syurhi te'nyathā ॥49॥
html:
bhikṣukāṃścākrikāṃścaiva kṣībonmattānkuśīlavān ।
bāhyānkuryānnaraśreṣṭha doṣāya syurhi te'nyathā ॥49॥
slp1: BikzukAMScAkrikAMScEva kzIbonmattAnkuSIlavAn । bAhyAnkuryAnnaraSrezWa dozAya syurhi te'nyaTA ॥49॥

text: catvareṣu ca tīrtheṣu sabhāsvāvasatheṣu ca । yathārhavarṇaṃ praṇidhiṃ kuryātsarvatra pārthivaḥ ॥50॥
html:
catvareṣu ca tīrtheṣu sabhāsvāvasatheṣu ca ।
yathārhavarṇaṃ praṇidhiṃ kuryātsarvatra pārthivaḥ ॥50॥
slp1: catvarezu ca tIrTezu saBAsvAvasaTezu ca । yaTArhavarRaM praRiDiM kuryAtsarvatra pArTivaH ॥50॥

text: viśālānrājamārgāṃśca kārayeta narādhipaḥ । prapāśca vipaṇīścaiva yathoddeśaṃ samādiśet ॥51॥
html:
viśālānrājamārgāṃśca kārayeta narādhipaḥ ।
prapāśca vipaṇīścaiva yathoddeśaṃ samādiśet ॥51॥
slp1: viSAlAnrAjamArgAMSca kArayeta narADipaH । prapASca vipaRIScEva yaToddeSaM samAdiSet ॥51॥

text: bhāṇḍāgārāyudhāgārāndhānyāgārāṃśca sarvaśaḥ । aśvāgārāngajāgārānbalādhikaraṇāni ca ॥52॥
html:
bhāṇḍāgārāyudhāgārāndhānyāgārāṃśca sarvaśaḥ ।
aśvāgārāngajāgārānbalādhikaraṇāni ca ॥52॥
slp1: BARqAgArAyuDAgArAnDAnyAgArAMSca sarvaSaH । aSvAgArAngajAgArAnbalADikaraRAni ca ॥52॥

text: parikhāścaiva kauravya pratolīḥ saṅkaṭāni ca । na jātu kaścitpaśyettu guhyametadyudhiṣṭhira ॥53॥
html:
parikhāścaiva kauravya pratolīḥ saṅkaṭāni ca ।
na jātu kaścitpaśyettu guhyametadyudhiṣṭhira ॥53॥
slp1: pariKAScEva kOravya pratolIH saNkawAni ca । na jAtu kaScitpaSyettu guhyametadyuDizWira ॥53॥

text: atha sannicayaṃ kuryādrājā parabalārditaḥ । tailaṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ sasyamauṣadhāni ca sarvaśaḥ ॥54॥
html:
atha sannicayaṃ kuryādrājā parabalārditaḥ ।
tailaṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ sasyamauṣadhāni ca sarvaśaḥ ॥54॥
slp1: aTa sannicayaM kuryAdrAjA parabalArditaH । tElaM maDu GftaM sasyamOzaDAni ca sarvaSaH ॥54॥

text: aṅgārakuśamuñjānāṃ palāśaśaraparṇinām । yavasendhanadigdhānāṃ kārayeta ca sañcayān ॥55॥
html:
aṅgārakuśamuñjānāṃ palāśaśaraparṇinām ।
yavasendhanadigdhānāṃ kārayeta ca sañcayān ॥55॥
slp1: aNgArakuSamuYjAnAM palASaSaraparRinAm । yavasenDanadigDAnAM kArayeta ca saYcayAn ॥55॥

text: āyudhānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ śaktyṛṣṭiprāsavarmaṇām । sañcayānevamādīnāṃ kārayeta narādhipaḥ ॥56॥
html:
āyudhānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ śaktyṛṣṭiprāsavarmaṇām ।
sañcayānevamādīnāṃ kārayeta narādhipaḥ ॥56॥
slp1: AyuDAnAM ca sarvezAM SaktyfzwiprAsavarmaRAm । saYcayAnevamAdInAM kArayeta narADipaH ॥56॥

text: auṣadhāni ca sarvāṇi mūlāni ca phalāni ca । caturvidhāṃśca vaidyānvai saṅgṛhṇīyādviśeṣataḥ ॥57॥
html:
auṣadhāni ca sarvāṇi mūlāni ca phalāni ca ।
caturvidhāṃśca vaidyānvai saṅgṛhṇīyādviśeṣataḥ ॥57॥
slp1: OzaDAni ca sarvARi mUlAni ca PalAni ca । caturviDAMSca vEdyAnvE saNgfhRIyAdviSezataH ॥57॥

text: naṭāśca nartakāścaiva mallā māyāvinastathā । śobhayeyuḥ puravaraṃ modayeyuśca sarvaśaḥ ॥58॥
html:
naṭāśca nartakāścaiva mallā māyāvinastathā ।
śobhayeyuḥ puravaraṃ modayeyuśca sarvaśaḥ ॥58॥
slp1: nawASca nartakAScEva mallA mAyAvinastaTA । SoBayeyuH puravaraM modayeyuSca sarvaSaH ॥58॥

text: yataḥ śaṅkā bhaveccāpi bhṛtyato vāpi mantritaḥ । paurebhyo nṛpatervāpi svādhīnānkārayeta tān ॥59॥
html:
yataḥ śaṅkā bhaveccāpi bhṛtyato vāpi mantritaḥ ।
paurebhyo nṛpatervāpi svādhīnānkārayeta tān ॥59॥
slp1: yataH SaNkA BaveccApi Bftyato vApi mantritaH । pOreByo nfpatervApi svADInAnkArayeta tAn ॥59॥

text: kṛte karmaṇi rājendra pūjayeddhanasañcayaiḥ । mānena ca yathārheṇa sāntvena vividhena ca ॥60॥
html:
kṛte karmaṇi rājendra pūjayeddhanasañcayaiḥ ।
mānena ca yathārheṇa sāntvena vividhena ca ॥60॥
slp1: kfte karmaRi rAjendra pUjayedDanasaYcayEH । mAnena ca yaTArheRa sAntvena viviDena ca ॥60॥

text: nirvedayitvā tu paraṃ hatvā vā kurunandana । gatānṛṇyo bhavedrājā yathā śāstreṣu darśitam ॥61॥
html:
nirvedayitvā tu paraṃ hatvā vā kurunandana ।
gatānṛṇyo bhavedrājā yathā śāstreṣu darśitam ॥61॥
slp1: nirvedayitvA tu paraM hatvA vA kurunandana । gatAnfRyo BavedrAjA yaTA SAstrezu darSitam ॥61॥

text: rājñā saptaiva rakṣyāṇi tāni cāpi nibodha me । ātmāmātyaśca kośaśca daṇḍo mitrāṇi caiva hi ॥62॥
html:
rājñā saptaiva rakṣyāṇi tāni cāpi nibodha me ।
ātmāmātyaśca kośaśca daṇḍo mitrāṇi caiva hi ॥62॥
slp1: rAjYA saptEva rakzyARi tAni cApi niboDa me । AtmAmAtyaSca koSaSca daRqo mitrARi cEva hi ॥62॥

text: tathā janapadaścaiva puraṃ ca kurunandana । etatsaptātmakaṃ rājyaṃ paripālyaṃ prayatnataḥ ॥63॥
html:
tathā janapadaścaiva puraṃ ca kurunandana ।
etatsaptātmakaṃ rājyaṃ paripālyaṃ prayatnataḥ ॥63॥
slp1: taTA janapadaScEva puraM ca kurunandana । etatsaptAtmakaM rAjyaM paripAlyaM prayatnataH ॥63॥

text: ṣāḍguṇyaṃ ca trivargaṃ ca trivargamaparaṃ tathā । yo vetti puruṣavyāghra sa bhunakti mahīmimām ॥64॥
html:
ṣāḍguṇyaṃ ca trivargaṃ ca trivargamaparaṃ tathā ।
yo vetti puruṣavyāghra sa bhunakti mahīmimām ॥64॥
slp1: zAqguRyaM ca trivargaM ca trivargamaparaM taTA । yo vetti puruzavyAGra sa Bunakti mahImimAm ॥64॥

text: ṣāḍguṇyamiti yatproktaṃ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira । sandhāyāsanamityeva yātrāsandhānameva ca ॥65॥
html:
ṣāḍguṇyamiti yatproktaṃ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ।
sandhāyāsanamityeva yātrāsandhānameva ca ॥65॥
slp1: zAqguRyamiti yatproktaM tanniboDa yuDizWira । sanDAyAsanamityeva yAtrAsanDAnameva ca ॥65॥

text: vigṛhyāsanamityeva yātrāṃ samparigṛhya ca । dvaidhībhāvastathānyeṣāṃ saṃśrayo'tha parasya ca ॥66॥
html:
vigṛhyāsanamityeva yātrāṃ samparigṛhya ca ।
dvaidhībhāvastathānyeṣāṃ saṃśrayo'tha parasya ca ॥66॥
slp1: vigfhyAsanamityeva yAtrAM samparigfhya ca । dvEDIBAvastaTAnyezAM saMSrayo'Ta parasya ca ॥66॥

text: trivargaścāpi yaḥ proktastamihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu । kṣayaḥ sthānaṃ ca vṛddhiśca trivargamaparaṃ tathā ॥67॥
html:
trivargaścāpi yaḥ proktastamihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ।
kṣayaḥ sthānaṃ ca vṛddhiśca trivargamaparaṃ tathā ॥67॥
slp1: trivargaScApi yaH proktastamihEkamanAH SfRu । kzayaH sTAnaM ca vfdDiSca trivargamaparaM taTA ॥67॥

text: dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca sevitavyo'tha kālataḥ । dharmeṇa hi mahīpālaściraṃ pālayate mahīm ॥68॥
html:
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca sevitavyo'tha kālataḥ ।
dharmeṇa hi mahīpālaściraṃ pālayate mahīm ॥68॥
slp1: DarmaScArTaSca kAmaSca sevitavyo'Ta kAlataH । DarmeRa hi mahIpAlaSciraM pAlayate mahIm ॥68॥

text: asminnarthe ca yau ślokau gītāvaṅgirasā svayam । yādavīputra bhadraṃ te śrotumarhasi tāvapi ॥69॥
html:
asminnarthe ca yau ślokau gītāvaṅgirasā svayam ।
yādavīputra bhadraṃ te śrotumarhasi tāvapi ॥69॥
slp1: asminnarTe ca yO SlokO gItAvaNgirasA svayam । yAdavIputra BadraM te Srotumarhasi tAvapi ॥69॥

text: kṛtvā sarvāṇi kāryāṇi samyaksampālya medinīm । pālayitvā tathā paurānparatra sukhamedhate ॥70॥
html:
kṛtvā sarvāṇi kāryāṇi samyaksampālya medinīm ।
pālayitvā tathā paurānparatra sukhamedhate ॥70॥
slp1: kftvA sarvARi kAryARi samyaksampAlya medinIm । pAlayitvA taTA pOrAnparatra suKameDate ॥70॥

text: kiṃ tasya tapasā rājñaḥ kiṃ ca tasyādhvarairapi । apālitāḥ prajā yasya sarvā dharmavinākṛtāḥ] ॥71॥
html:
kiṃ tasya tapasā rājñaḥ kiṃ ca tasyādhvarairapi ।
apālitāḥ prajā yasya sarvā dharmavinākṛtāḥ] ॥71॥
slp1: kiM tasya tapasA rAjYaH kiM ca tasyADvarErapi । apAlitAH prajA yasya sarvA DarmavinAkftAH] ॥71॥

text: daṇḍanītiśca rājā ca samastau tāvubhāvapi । kasya kiṃ kurvataḥ siddhyai tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
daṇḍanītiśca rājā ca samastau tāvubhāvapi ।
kasya kiṃ kurvataḥ siddhyai tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: daRqanItiSca rAjA ca samastO tAvuBAvapi । kasya kiM kurvataH sidDyE tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: mahābhāgyaṃ daṇḍanītyāḥ siddhaiḥ śabdaiḥ sahetukaiḥ । śṛṇu me śaṃsato rājanyathāvadiha bhārata ॥2॥
html:
mahābhāgyaṃ daṇḍanītyāḥ siddhaiḥ śabdaiḥ sahetukaiḥ ।
śṛṇu me śaṃsato rājanyathāvadiha bhārata ॥2॥
slp1: mahABAgyaM daRqanItyAH sidDEH SabdEH sahetukEH । SfRu me SaMsato rAjanyaTAvadiha BArata ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: daṇḍanītiḥ svadharmebhyaścāturvarṇyaṃ niyacchati । prayuktā svāminā samyagadharmebhyaśca yacchati ॥3॥
html:
daṇḍanītiḥ svadharmebhyaścāturvarṇyaṃ niyacchati ।
prayuktā svāminā samyagadharmebhyaśca yacchati ॥3॥
slp1: daRqanItiH svaDarmeByaScAturvarRyaM niyacCati । prayuktA svAminA samyagaDarmeByaSca yacCati ॥3॥

text: cāturvarṇye svadharmasthe maryādānāmasaṅkare । daṇḍanītikṛte kṣeme prajānāmakutobhaye ॥4॥
html:
cāturvarṇye svadharmasthe maryādānāmasaṅkare ।
daṇḍanītikṛte kṣeme prajānāmakutobhaye ॥4॥
slp1: cAturvarRye svaDarmasTe maryAdAnAmasaNkare । daRqanItikfte kzeme prajAnAmakutoBaye ॥4॥

text: some prayatnaṃ kurvanti trayo varṇā yathāvidhi । tasmāddevamanuṣyāṇāṃ sukhaṃ viddhi samāhitam ॥5॥
html:
some prayatnaṃ kurvanti trayo varṇā yathāvidhi ।
tasmāddevamanuṣyāṇāṃ sukhaṃ viddhi samāhitam ॥5॥
slp1: some prayatnaM kurvanti trayo varRA yaTAviDi । tasmAddevamanuzyARAM suKaM vidDi samAhitam ॥5॥

text: kālo vā kāraṇaṃ rājño rājā vā kālakāraṇam । iti te saṃśayo mā bhūdrājā kālasya kāraṇam ॥6॥
html:
kālo vā kāraṇaṃ rājño rājā vā kālakāraṇam ।
iti te saṃśayo mā bhūdrājā kālasya kāraṇam ॥6॥
slp1: kAlo vA kAraRaM rAjYo rAjA vA kAlakAraRam । iti te saMSayo mA BUdrAjA kAlasya kAraRam ॥6॥

text: daṇḍanītyā yadā rājā samyakkārtsnyena vartate । tadā kṛtayugaṃ nāma kālaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pravartate ॥7॥
html:
daṇḍanītyā yadā rājā samyakkārtsnyena vartate ।
tadā kṛtayugaṃ nāma kālaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pravartate ॥7॥
slp1: daRqanItyA yadA rAjA samyakkArtsnyena vartate । tadA kftayugaM nAma kAlaH SrezWaH pravartate ॥7॥

text: bhavetkṛtayuge dharmo nādharmo vidyate kvacit । sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ nādharme ramate manaḥ ॥8॥
html:
bhavetkṛtayuge dharmo nādharmo vidyate kvacit ।
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ nādharme ramate manaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: Bavetkftayuge Darmo nADarmo vidyate kvacit । sarvezAmeva varRAnAM nADarme ramate manaH ॥8॥

text: yogakṣemāḥ pravartante prajānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ । vaidikāni ca karmāṇi bhavantyaviguṇānyuta ॥9॥
html:
yogakṣemāḥ pravartante prajānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
vaidikāni ca karmāṇi bhavantyaviguṇānyuta ॥9॥
slp1: yogakzemAH pravartante prajAnAM nAtra saMSayaH । vEdikAni ca karmARi BavantyaviguRAnyuta ॥9॥

text: ṛtavaśca sukhāḥ sarve bhavantyuta nirāmayāḥ । prasīdanti narāṇāṃ ca svaravarṇamanāṃsi ca ॥10॥
html:
ṛtavaśca sukhāḥ sarve bhavantyuta nirāmayāḥ ।
prasīdanti narāṇāṃ ca svaravarṇamanāṃsi ca ॥10॥
slp1: ftavaSca suKAH sarve Bavantyuta nirAmayAH । prasIdanti narARAM ca svaravarRamanAMsi ca ॥10॥

text: vyādhayo na bhavantyatra nālpāyurdṛśyate naraḥ । vidhavā na bhavantyatra nṛśaṃso nābhijāyate ॥11॥
html:
vyādhayo na bhavantyatra nālpāyurdṛśyate naraḥ ।
vidhavā na bhavantyatra nṛśaṃso nābhijāyate ॥11॥
slp1: vyADayo na Bavantyatra nAlpAyurdfSyate naraH । viDavA na Bavantyatra nfSaMso nABijAyate ॥11॥

text: akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī bhavantyoṣadhayastathā । tvakpatraphalamūlāni vīryavanti bhavanti ca ॥12॥
html:
akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī bhavantyoṣadhayastathā ।
tvakpatraphalamūlāni vīryavanti bhavanti ca ॥12॥
slp1: akfzwapacyA pfTivI BavantyozaDayastaTA । tvakpatraPalamUlAni vIryavanti Bavanti ca ॥12॥

text: nādharmo vidyate tatra dharma eva tu kevalaḥ । iti kārtayugānetānguṇānviddhi yudhiṣṭhira ॥13॥
html:
nādharmo vidyate tatra dharma eva tu kevalaḥ ।
iti kārtayugānetānguṇānviddhi yudhiṣṭhira ॥13॥
slp1: nADarmo vidyate tatra Darma eva tu kevalaH । iti kArtayugAnetAnguRAnvidDi yuDizWira ॥13॥

text: daṇḍanītyā yadā rājā trīnaṃśānanuvartate । caturthamaṃśamutsṛjya tadā tretā pravartate ॥14॥
html:
daṇḍanītyā yadā rājā trīnaṃśānanuvartate ।
caturthamaṃśamutsṛjya tadā tretā pravartate ॥14॥
slp1: daRqanItyA yadA rAjA trInaMSAnanuvartate । caturTamaMSamutsfjya tadA tretA pravartate ॥14॥

text: aśubhasya caturthāṃśastrīnaṃśānanuvartate । kṛṣṭapacyaiva pṛthivī bhavantyoṣadhayastathā ॥15॥
html:
aśubhasya caturthāṃśastrīnaṃśānanuvartate ।
kṛṣṭapacyaiva pṛthivī bhavantyoṣadhayastathā ॥15॥
slp1: aSuBasya caturTAMSastrInaMSAnanuvartate । kfzwapacyEva pfTivI BavantyozaDayastaTA ॥15॥

text: ardhaṃ tyaktvā yadā rājā nītyardhamanuvartate । tatastu dvāparaṃ nāma sa kālaḥ saṃpravartate ॥16॥
html:
ardhaṃ tyaktvā yadā rājā nītyardhamanuvartate ।
tatastu dvāparaṃ nāma sa kālaḥ saṃpravartate ॥16॥
slp1: arDaM tyaktvA yadA rAjA nItyarDamanuvartate । tatastu dvAparaM nAma sa kAlaH saMpravartate ॥16॥

text: aśubhasya tadā ardhaṃ dvāvaṃśāvanuvartate । kṛṣṭapacyaiva pṛthivī bhavatyalpaphalā tathā ॥17॥
html:
aśubhasya tadā ardhaṃ dvāvaṃśāvanuvartate ।
kṛṣṭapacyaiva pṛthivī bhavatyalpaphalā tathā ॥17॥
slp1: aSuBasya tadA arDaM dvAvaMSAvanuvartate । kfzwapacyEva pfTivI BavatyalpaPalA taTA ॥17॥

text: daṇḍanītiṃ parityajya yadā kārtsnyena bhūmipaḥ । prajāḥ kliśnātyayogena praviśyati tadā kaliḥ ॥18॥
html:
daṇḍanītiṃ parityajya yadā kārtsnyena bhūmipaḥ ।
prajāḥ kliśnātyayogena praviśyati tadā kaliḥ ॥18॥
slp1: daRqanItiM parityajya yadA kArtsnyena BUmipaH । prajAH kliSnAtyayogena praviSyati tadA kaliH ॥18॥

text: kalāvadharmo bhūyiṣṭhaṃ dharmo bhavati tu kvacit । sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ svadharmāccyavate manaḥ ॥19॥
html:
kalāvadharmo bhūyiṣṭhaṃ dharmo bhavati tu kvacit ।
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ svadharmāccyavate manaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: kalAvaDarmo BUyizWaM Darmo Bavati tu kvacit । sarvezAmeva varRAnAM svaDarmAccyavate manaH ॥19॥

text: śūdrā bhaikṣeṇa jīvanti brāhmaṇāḥ paricaryayā । yogakṣemasya nāśaśca vartate varṇasaṅkaraḥ ॥20॥
html:
śūdrā bhaikṣeṇa jīvanti brāhmaṇāḥ paricaryayā ।
yogakṣemasya nāśaśca vartate varṇasaṅkaraḥ ॥20॥
slp1: SUdrA BEkzeRa jIvanti brAhmaRAH paricaryayA । yogakzemasya nASaSca vartate varRasaNkaraH ॥20॥

text: vaidikāni ca karmāṇi bhavanti viguṇānyuta । ṛtavo nasukhāḥ sarve bhavantyāmayinastathā ॥21॥
html:
vaidikāni ca karmāṇi bhavanti viguṇānyuta ।
ṛtavo nasukhāḥ sarve bhavantyāmayinastathā ॥21॥
slp1: vEdikAni ca karmARi Bavanti viguRAnyuta । ftavo nasuKAH sarve BavantyAmayinastaTA ॥21॥

text: hrasanti ca manuṣyāṇāṃ svaravarṇamanāṃsyuta । vyādhayaśca bhavantyatra mriyante cāgatāyuṣaḥ ॥22॥
html:
hrasanti ca manuṣyāṇāṃ svaravarṇamanāṃsyuta ।
vyādhayaśca bhavantyatra mriyante cāgatāyuṣaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: hrasanti ca manuzyARAM svaravarRamanAMsyuta । vyADayaSca Bavantyatra mriyante cAgatAyuzaH ॥22॥

text: vidhavāśca bhavantyatra nṛśaṃsā jāyate prajā । kvacidvarṣati parjanyaḥ kvacitsasyaṃ prarohati ॥23॥
html:
vidhavāśca bhavantyatra nṛśaṃsā jāyate prajā ।
kvacidvarṣati parjanyaḥ kvacitsasyaṃ prarohati ॥23॥
slp1: viDavASca Bavantyatra nfSaMsA jAyate prajA । kvacidvarzati parjanyaH kvacitsasyaM prarohati ॥23॥

text: rasāḥ sarve kṣayaṃ yānti yadā necchati bhūmipaḥ । prajāḥ saṃrakṣituṃ samyagdaṇḍanītisamāhitaḥ ॥24॥
html:
rasāḥ sarve kṣayaṃ yānti yadā necchati bhūmipaḥ ।
prajāḥ saṃrakṣituṃ samyagdaṇḍanītisamāhitaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: rasAH sarve kzayaM yAnti yadA necCati BUmipaH । prajAH saMrakzituM samyagdaRqanItisamAhitaH ॥24॥

text: rājā kṛtayugasraṣṭā tretāyā dvāparasya ca । yugasya ca caturthasya rājā bhavati kāraṇam ॥25॥
html:
rājā kṛtayugasraṣṭā tretāyā dvāparasya ca ।
yugasya ca caturthasya rājā bhavati kāraṇam ॥25॥
slp1: rAjA kftayugasrazwA tretAyA dvAparasya ca । yugasya ca caturTasya rAjA Bavati kAraRam ॥25॥

text: kṛtasya karaṇādrājā svargamatyantamaśnute । tretāyāḥ karaṇādrājā svargaṃ nātyantamaśnute ॥26॥
html:
kṛtasya karaṇādrājā svargamatyantamaśnute ।
tretāyāḥ karaṇādrājā svargaṃ nātyantamaśnute ॥26॥
slp1: kftasya karaRAdrAjA svargamatyantamaSnute । tretAyAH karaRAdrAjA svargaM nAtyantamaSnute ॥26॥

text: pravartanāddvāparasya yathābhāgamupāśnute । kaleḥ pravartanādrājā pāpamatyantamaśnute ॥27॥
html:
pravartanāddvāparasya yathābhāgamupāśnute ।
kaleḥ pravartanādrājā pāpamatyantamaśnute ॥27॥
slp1: pravartanAddvAparasya yaTABAgamupASnute । kaleH pravartanAdrAjA pApamatyantamaSnute ॥27॥

text: tato vasati duṣkarmā narake śāśvatīḥ samāḥ । prajānāṃ kalmaṣe magno'kīrtiṃ pāpaṃ ca vindati ॥28॥
html:
tato vasati duṣkarmā narake śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ।
prajānāṃ kalmaṣe magno'kīrtiṃ pāpaṃ ca vindati ॥28॥
slp1: tato vasati duzkarmA narake SASvatIH samAH । prajAnAM kalmaze magno'kIrtiM pApaM ca vindati ॥28॥

text: daṇḍanītiṃ puraskṛtya vijānankṣatriyaḥ sadā । anavāptaṃ ca lipseta labdhaṃ ca paripālayet ॥29॥
html:
daṇḍanītiṃ puraskṛtya vijānankṣatriyaḥ sadā ।
anavāptaṃ ca lipseta labdhaṃ ca paripālayet ॥29॥
slp1: daRqanItiM puraskftya vijAnankzatriyaH sadA । anavAptaM ca lipseta labDaM ca paripAlayet ॥29॥

text: lokasya sīmantakarī maryādā lokabhāvanī । samyaṅnītā daṇḍanītiryathā mātā yathā pitā ॥30॥
html:
lokasya sīmantakarī maryādā lokabhāvanī ।
samyaṅnītā daṇḍanītiryathā mātā yathā pitā ॥30॥
slp1: lokasya sImantakarI maryAdA lokaBAvanI । samyaNnItA daRqanItiryaTA mAtA yaTA pitA ॥30॥

text: yasyāṃ bhavanti bhūtāni tadviddhi bharatarṣabha । eṣa eva paro dharmo yadrājā daṇḍanītimān ॥31॥
html:
yasyāṃ bhavanti bhūtāni tadviddhi bharatarṣabha ।
eṣa eva paro dharmo yadrājā daṇḍanītimān ॥31॥
slp1: yasyAM Bavanti BUtAni tadvidDi BaratarzaBa । eza eva paro Darmo yadrAjA daRqanItimAn ॥31॥

text: tasmātkauravya dharmeṇa prajāḥ pālaya nītimān । evaṃvṛttaḥ prajā rakṣansvargaṃ jetāsi durjayam] ॥32॥
html:
tasmātkauravya dharmeṇa prajāḥ pālaya nītimān ।
evaṃvṛttaḥ prajā rakṣansvargaṃ jetāsi durjayam] ॥32॥
slp1: tasmAtkOravya DarmeRa prajAH pAlaya nItimAn । evaMvfttaH prajA rakzansvargaM jetAsi durjayam] ॥32॥

text: kena vṛttena vṛttajña vartamāno mahīpatiḥ । sukhenārthānsukhodarkāniha ca pretya cāpnuyāt ॥1॥
html:
kena vṛttena vṛttajña vartamāno mahīpatiḥ ।
sukhenārthānsukhodarkāniha ca pretya cāpnuyāt ॥1॥
slp1: kena vfttena vfttajYa vartamAno mahIpatiH । suKenArTAnsuKodarkAniha ca pretya cApnuyAt ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: iyaṃ guṇānāṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatṣaṭtriṃśadguṇasaṃyutā । yānguṇāṃstu guṇopetaḥ kurvanguṇamavāpnuyāt ॥2॥
html:
iyaṃ guṇānāṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatṣaṭtriṃśadguṇasaṃyutā ।
yānguṇāṃstu guṇopetaḥ kurvanguṇamavāpnuyāt ॥2॥
slp1: iyaM guRAnAM zawtriMSatzawtriMSadguRasaMyutA । yAnguRAMstu guRopetaH kurvanguRamavApnuyAt ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: careddharmānakaṭuko muñcetsnehaṃ na nāstikaḥ । anṛśaṃsaścaredarthaṃ caretkāmamanuddhataḥ ॥3॥
html:
careddharmānakaṭuko muñcetsnehaṃ na nāstikaḥ ।
anṛśaṃsaścaredarthaṃ caretkāmamanuddhataḥ ॥3॥
slp1: caredDarmAnakawuko muYcetsnehaM na nAstikaH । anfSaMsaScaredarTaM caretkAmamanudDataH ॥3॥

text: priyaṃ brūyādakṛpaṇaḥ śūraḥ syādavikatthanaḥ । dātā nāpātravarṣī syātpragalbhaḥ syādaniṣṭhuraḥ ॥4॥
html:
priyaṃ brūyādakṛpaṇaḥ śūraḥ syādavikatthanaḥ ।
dātā nāpātravarṣī syātpragalbhaḥ syādaniṣṭhuraḥ ॥4॥
slp1: priyaM brUyAdakfpaRaH SUraH syAdavikatTanaH । dAtA nApAtravarzI syAtpragalBaH syAdanizWuraH ॥4॥

text: sandadhīta na cānāryairvigṛhṇīyānna bandhubhiḥ । nānāptaiḥ kārayeccāraṃ kuryātkāryamapīḍayā ॥5॥
html:
sandadhīta na cānāryairvigṛhṇīyānna bandhubhiḥ ।
nānāptaiḥ kārayeccāraṃ kuryātkāryamapīḍayā ॥5॥
slp1: sandaDIta na cAnAryErvigfhRIyAnna banDuBiH । nAnAptEH kArayeccAraM kuryAtkAryamapIqayA ॥5॥

text: arthānbrūyānna cāsatsu guṇānbrūyānna cātmanaḥ । ādadyānna ca sādhubhyo nāsatpuruṣamāśrayet ॥6॥
html:
arthānbrūyānna cāsatsu guṇānbrūyānna cātmanaḥ ।
ādadyānna ca sādhubhyo nāsatpuruṣamāśrayet ॥6॥
slp1: arTAnbrUyAnna cAsatsu guRAnbrUyAnna cAtmanaH । AdadyAnna ca sADuByo nAsatpuruzamASrayet ॥6॥

text: nāparīkṣya nayeddaṇḍaṃ na ca mantraṃ prakāśayet । visṛjenna ca lubdhebhyo viśvasennāpakāriṣu ॥7॥
html:
nāparīkṣya nayeddaṇḍaṃ na ca mantraṃ prakāśayet ।
visṛjenna ca lubdhebhyo viśvasennāpakāriṣu ॥7॥
slp1: nAparIkzya nayeddaRqaM na ca mantraM prakASayet । visfjenna ca lubDeByo viSvasennApakArizu ॥7॥

text: anīrṣurguptadāraḥ syāccokṣaḥ syādaghṛṇī nṛpaḥ । striyaṃ seveta nātyarthaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ bhuñjīta nāhitam ॥8॥
html:
anīrṣurguptadāraḥ syāccokṣaḥ syādaghṛṇī nṛpaḥ ।
striyaṃ seveta nātyarthaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ bhuñjīta nāhitam ॥8॥
slp1: anIrzurguptadAraH syAccokzaH syAdaGfRI nfpaH । striyaM seveta nAtyarTaM mfzwaM BuYjIta nAhitam ॥8॥

text: astabdhaḥ pūjayenmānyāngurūnsevedamāyayā । arceddevānna dambhena śriyamicchedakutsitām ॥9॥
html:
astabdhaḥ pūjayenmānyāngurūnsevedamāyayā ।
arceddevānna dambhena śriyamicchedakutsitām ॥9॥
slp1: astabDaH pUjayenmAnyAngurUnsevedamAyayA । arceddevAnna damBena SriyamicCedakutsitAm ॥9॥

text: seveta praṇayaṃ hitvā dakṣaḥ syānna tvakālavit । sāntvayenna ca bhogārthamanugṛhṇanna cākṣipet ॥10॥
html:
seveta praṇayaṃ hitvā dakṣaḥ syānna tvakālavit ।
sāntvayenna ca bhogārthamanugṛhṇanna cākṣipet ॥10॥
slp1: seveta praRayaM hitvA dakzaH syAnna tvakAlavit । sAntvayenna ca BogArTamanugfhRanna cAkzipet ॥10॥

text: praharenna tvavijñāya hatvā śatrūnna śeṣayet । krodhaṃ kuryānna cākasmānmṛduḥ syānnāpakāriṣu ॥11॥
html:
praharenna tvavijñāya hatvā śatrūnna śeṣayet ।
krodhaṃ kuryānna cākasmānmṛduḥ syānnāpakāriṣu ॥11॥
slp1: praharenna tvavijYAya hatvA SatrUnna Sezayet । kroDaM kuryAnna cAkasmAnmfduH syAnnApakArizu ॥11॥

text: evaṃ carasva rājyastho yadi śreya ihecchasi । ato'nyathā narapatirbhayamṛcchatyanuttamam ॥12॥
html:
evaṃ carasva rājyastho yadi śreya ihecchasi ।
ato'nyathā narapatirbhayamṛcchatyanuttamam ॥12॥
slp1: evaM carasva rAjyasTo yadi Sreya ihecCasi । ato'nyaTA narapatirBayamfcCatyanuttamam ॥12॥

text: iti sarvānguṇānetānyathoktānyo'nuvartate । anubhūyeha bhadrāṇi pretya svarge mahīyate ॥13॥
html:
iti sarvānguṇānetānyathoktānyo'nuvartate ।
anubhūyeha bhadrāṇi pretya svarge mahīyate ॥13॥
slp1: iti sarvAnguRAnetAnyaToktAnyo'nuvartate । anuBUyeha BadrARi pretya svarge mahIyate ॥13॥

text: idaṃ vacaḥ śāntanavasya śuśruvānyudhiṣṭhiraḥ pāṇḍavamukhyasaṃvṛtaḥ । tadā vavande ca pitāmahaṃ nṛpo yathoktametacca cakāra buddhimān] ॥14॥
html:
idaṃ vacaḥ śāntanavasya śuśruvānyudhiṣṭhiraḥ pāṇḍavamukhyasaṃvṛtaḥ ।
tadā vavande ca pitāmahaṃ nṛpo yathoktametacca cakāra buddhimān] ॥14॥
slp1: idaM vacaH SAntanavasya SuSruvAnyuDizWiraH pARqavamuKyasaMvftaH । tadA vavande ca pitAmahaM nfpo yaToktametacca cakAra budDimAn] ॥14॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: kathaṃ rājā prajā rakṣannādhibandhena yujyate । dharme ca nāparādhnoti tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
kathaṃ rājā prajā rakṣannādhibandhena yujyate ।
dharme ca nāparādhnoti tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: kaTaM rAjA prajA rakzannADibanDena yujyate । Darme ca nAparADnoti tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: samāsenaiva te tāta dharmānvakṣyāmi niścitān । vistareṇa hi dharmāṇāṃ na jātvantamavāpnuyāt ॥2॥
html:
samāsenaiva te tāta dharmānvakṣyāmi niścitān ।
vistareṇa hi dharmāṇāṃ na jātvantamavāpnuyāt ॥2॥
slp1: samAsenEva te tAta DarmAnvakzyAmi niScitAn । vistareRa hi DarmARAM na jAtvantamavApnuyAt ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dharmaniṣṭhāñśrutavato vedavratasamāhitān । arcitānvāsayethāstvaṃ gṛhe guṇavato dvijān ॥3॥
html:
dharmaniṣṭhāñśrutavato vedavratasamāhitān ।
arcitānvāsayethāstvaṃ gṛhe guṇavato dvijān ॥3॥
slp1: DarmanizWAYSrutavato vedavratasamAhitAn । arcitAnvAsayeTAstvaM gfhe guRavato dvijAn ॥3॥

text: pratyutthāyopasaṅgṛhya caraṇāvabhivādya ca । atha sarvāṇi kurvīthāḥ kāryāṇi sapurohitaḥ ॥4॥
html:
pratyutthāyopasaṅgṛhya caraṇāvabhivādya ca ।
atha sarvāṇi kurvīthāḥ kāryāṇi sapurohitaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: pratyutTAyopasaNgfhya caraRAvaBivAdya ca । aTa sarvARi kurvITAH kAryARi sapurohitaH ॥4॥

text: dharmakāryāṇi nirvartya maṅgalāni prayujya ca । brāhmaṇānvācayethāstvamarthasiddhijayāśiṣaḥ ॥5॥
html:
dharmakāryāṇi nirvartya maṅgalāni prayujya ca ।
brāhmaṇānvācayethāstvamarthasiddhijayāśiṣaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: DarmakAryARi nirvartya maNgalAni prayujya ca । brAhmaRAnvAcayeTAstvamarTasidDijayASizaH ॥5॥

text: ārjavena ca sampanno dhṛtyā buddhyā ca bhārata । arthārthaṃ parigṛhṇīyātkāmakrodhau ca varjayet ॥6॥
html:
ārjavena ca sampanno dhṛtyā buddhyā ca bhārata ।
arthārthaṃ parigṛhṇīyātkāmakrodhau ca varjayet ॥6॥
slp1: Arjavena ca sampanno DftyA budDyA ca BArata । arTArTaM parigfhRIyAtkAmakroDO ca varjayet ॥6॥

text: kāmakrodhau puraskṛtya yo'rthaṃ rājānutiṣṭhati । na sa dharmaṃ na cāpyarthaṃ parigṛhṇāti bāliśaḥ ॥7॥
html:
kāmakrodhau puraskṛtya yo'rthaṃ rājānutiṣṭhati ।
na sa dharmaṃ na cāpyarthaṃ parigṛhṇāti bāliśaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: kAmakroDO puraskftya yo'rTaM rAjAnutizWati । na sa DarmaM na cApyarTaM parigfhRAti bAliSaH ॥7॥

text: mā sma lubdhāṃśca mūrkhāṃśca kāme cārtheṣu yūyujaḥ । alubdhānbuddhisampannānsarvakarmasu yojayet ॥8॥
html:
mā sma lubdhāṃśca mūrkhāṃśca kāme cārtheṣu yūyujaḥ ।
alubdhānbuddhisampannānsarvakarmasu yojayet ॥8॥
slp1: mA sma lubDAMSca mUrKAMSca kAme cArTezu yUyujaH । alubDAnbudDisampannAnsarvakarmasu yojayet ॥8॥

text: mūrkho hyadhikṛto'rtheṣu kāryāṇāmaviśāradaḥ । prajāḥ kliśnātyayogena kāmadveṣasamanvitaḥ ॥9॥
html:
mūrkho hyadhikṛto'rtheṣu kāryāṇāmaviśāradaḥ ।
prajāḥ kliśnātyayogena kāmadveṣasamanvitaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: mUrKo hyaDikfto'rTezu kAryARAmaviSAradaH । prajAH kliSnAtyayogena kAmadvezasamanvitaH ॥9॥

text: baliṣaṣṭhena śulkena daṇḍenāthāparādhinām । śāstranītena lipsethā vetanena dhanāgamam ॥10॥
html:
baliṣaṣṭhena śulkena daṇḍenāthāparādhinām ।
śāstranītena lipsethā vetanena dhanāgamam ॥10॥
slp1: balizazWena Sulkena daRqenATAparADinAm । SAstranItena lipseTA vetanena DanAgamam ॥10॥

text: dāpayitvā karaṃ dharmyaṃ rāṣṭraṃ nityaṃ yathāvidhi । aśeṣānkalpayedrājā yogakṣemānatandritaḥ ॥11॥
html:
dāpayitvā karaṃ dharmyaṃ rāṣṭraṃ nityaṃ yathāvidhi ।
aśeṣānkalpayedrājā yogakṣemānatandritaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: dApayitvA karaM DarmyaM rAzwraM nityaM yaTAviDi । aSezAnkalpayedrAjA yogakzemAnatandritaH ॥11॥

text: gopāyitāraṃ dātāraṃ dharmanityamatandritam । akāmadveṣasaṃyuktamanurajyanti mānavāḥ ॥12॥
html:
gopāyitāraṃ dātāraṃ dharmanityamatandritam ।
akāmadveṣasaṃyuktamanurajyanti mānavāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: gopAyitAraM dAtAraM Darmanityamatandritam । akAmadvezasaMyuktamanurajyanti mAnavAH ॥12॥

text: mā smādharmeṇa lābhena lipsethāstvaṃ dhanāgamam । dharmārthāvadhruvau tasya yo'paśāstraparo bhavet ॥13॥
html:
mā smādharmeṇa lābhena lipsethāstvaṃ dhanāgamam ।
dharmārthāvadhruvau tasya yo'paśāstraparo bhavet ॥13॥
slp1: mA smADarmeRa lABena lipseTAstvaM DanAgamam । DarmArTAvaDruvO tasya yo'paSAstraparo Bavet ॥13॥

text: apaśāstraparo rājā sañcayānnādhigacchati । asthāne cāsya tadvittaṃ sarvameva vinaśyati ॥14॥
html:
apaśāstraparo rājā sañcayānnādhigacchati ।
asthāne cāsya tadvittaṃ sarvameva vinaśyati ॥14॥
slp1: apaSAstraparo rAjA saYcayAnnADigacCati । asTAne cAsya tadvittaM sarvameva vinaSyati ॥14॥

text: arthamūlo'pahiṃsāṃ ca kurute svayamātmanaḥ । karairaśāstradṛṣṭairhi mohātsampīḍayanprajāḥ ॥15॥
html:
arthamūlo'pahiṃsāṃ ca kurute svayamātmanaḥ ।
karairaśāstradṛṣṭairhi mohātsampīḍayanprajāḥ ॥15॥
slp1: arTamUlo'pahiMsAM ca kurute svayamAtmanaH । karEraSAstradfzwErhi mohAtsampIqayanprajAH ॥15॥

text: ūdhaśchindyāddhi yo dhenvāḥ kṣīrārthī na labhetpayaḥ । evaṃ rāṣṭramayogena pīḍitaṃ na vivardhate ॥16॥
html:
ūdhaśchindyāddhi yo dhenvāḥ kṣīrārthī na labhetpayaḥ ।
evaṃ rāṣṭramayogena pīḍitaṃ na vivardhate ॥16॥
slp1: UDaSCindyAdDi yo DenvAH kzIrArTI na laBetpayaH । evaM rAzwramayogena pIqitaM na vivarDate ॥16॥

text: yo hi dogdhrīmupāste tu sa nityaṃ labhate payaḥ । evaṃ rāṣṭramupāyena bhuñjāno labhate phalam ॥17॥
html:
yo hi dogdhrīmupāste tu sa nityaṃ labhate payaḥ ।
evaṃ rāṣṭramupāyena bhuñjāno labhate phalam ॥17॥
slp1: yo hi dogDrImupAste tu sa nityaM laBate payaH । evaM rAzwramupAyena BuYjAno laBate Palam ॥17॥

text: atha rāṣṭramupāyena bhujyamānaṃ surakṣitam । janayatyatulāṃ nityaṃ kośavṛddhiṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥18॥
html:
atha rāṣṭramupāyena bhujyamānaṃ surakṣitam ।
janayatyatulāṃ nityaṃ kośavṛddhiṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥18॥
slp1: aTa rAzwramupAyena BujyamAnaM surakzitam । janayatyatulAM nityaM koSavfdDiM yuDizWira ॥18॥

text: dogdhi dhānyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca prajā rājñi surakṣitā । nityaṃ svebhyaḥ parebhyaśca tṛptā mātā yathā payaḥ ॥19॥
html:
dogdhi dhānyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca prajā rājñi surakṣitā ।
nityaṃ svebhyaḥ parebhyaśca tṛptā mātā yathā payaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: dogDi DAnyaM hiraRyaM ca prajA rAjYi surakzitA । nityaM sveByaH pareByaSca tfptA mAtA yaTA payaH ॥19॥

text: mālākāropamo rājanbhava māṅgārikopamaḥ । tathā yuktaściraṃ rāṣṭraṃ bhoktuṃ śakyasi pālayan ॥20॥
html:
mālākāropamo rājanbhava māṅgārikopamaḥ ।
tathā yuktaściraṃ rāṣṭraṃ bhoktuṃ śakyasi pālayan ॥20॥
slp1: mAlAkAropamo rAjanBava mANgArikopamaH । taTA yuktaSciraM rAzwraM BoktuM Sakyasi pAlayan ॥20॥

text: paracakrābhiyānena yadi te syāddhanakṣayaḥ । atha sāmnaiva lipsethā dhanamabrāhmaṇeṣu yat ॥21॥
html:
paracakrābhiyānena yadi te syāddhanakṣayaḥ ।
atha sāmnaiva lipsethā dhanamabrāhmaṇeṣu yat ॥21॥
slp1: paracakrABiyAnena yadi te syAdDanakzayaH । aTa sAmnEva lipseTA DanamabrAhmaRezu yat ॥21॥

text: mā sma te brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhanasthaṃ pracalenmanaḥ । antyāyāmapyavasthāyāṃ kimu sphītasya bhārata ॥22॥
html:
mā sma te brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhanasthaṃ pracalenmanaḥ ।
antyāyāmapyavasthāyāṃ kimu sphītasya bhārata ॥22॥
slp1: mA sma te brAhmaRaM dfzwvA DanasTaM pracalenmanaH । antyAyAmapyavasTAyAM kimu sPItasya BArata ॥22॥

text: dhanāni tebhyo dadyāstvaṃ yathāśakti yathārhataḥ । sāntvayanparirakṣaṃśca svargamāpsyasi durjayam ॥23॥
html:
dhanāni tebhyo dadyāstvaṃ yathāśakti yathārhataḥ ।
sāntvayanparirakṣaṃśca svargamāpsyasi durjayam ॥23॥
slp1: DanAni teByo dadyAstvaM yaTASakti yaTArhataH । sAntvayanparirakzaMSca svargamApsyasi durjayam ॥23॥

text: evaṃ dharmeṇa vṛttena prajāstvaṃ paripālayan । svantaṃ puṇyaṃ yaśovantaṃ prāpsyase kurunandana ॥24॥
html:
evaṃ dharmeṇa vṛttena prajāstvaṃ paripālayan ।
svantaṃ puṇyaṃ yaśovantaṃ prāpsyase kurunandana ॥24॥
slp1: evaM DarmeRa vfttena prajAstvaM paripAlayan । svantaM puRyaM yaSovantaM prApsyase kurunandana ॥24॥

text: dharmeṇa vyavahāreṇa prajāḥ pālaya pāṇḍava । yudhiṣṭhira tathā yukto nādhibandhena yokṣyase ॥25॥
html:
dharmeṇa vyavahāreṇa prajāḥ pālaya pāṇḍava ।
yudhiṣṭhira tathā yukto nādhibandhena yokṣyase ॥25॥
slp1: DarmeRa vyavahAreRa prajAH pAlaya pARqava । yuDizWira taTA yukto nADibanDena yokzyase ॥25॥

text: eṣa eva paro dharmo yadrājā rakṣate prajāḥ । bhūtānāṃ hi yathā dharme rakṣaṇaṃ ca parā dayā ॥26॥
html:
eṣa eva paro dharmo yadrājā rakṣate prajāḥ ।
bhūtānāṃ hi yathā dharme rakṣaṇaṃ ca parā dayā ॥26॥
slp1: eza eva paro Darmo yadrAjA rakzate prajAH । BUtAnAM hi yaTA Darme rakzaRaM ca parA dayA ॥26॥

text: tasmādevaṃ paraṃ dharmaṃ manyante dharmakovidāḥ । yadrājā rakṣaṇe yukto bhūteṣu kurute dayām ॥27॥
html:
tasmādevaṃ paraṃ dharmaṃ manyante dharmakovidāḥ ।
yadrājā rakṣaṇe yukto bhūteṣu kurute dayām ॥27॥
slp1: tasmAdevaM paraM DarmaM manyante DarmakovidAH । yadrAjA rakzaRe yukto BUtezu kurute dayAm ॥27॥

text: yadahnā kurute pāpamarakṣanbhayataḥ prajāḥ । rājā varṣasahasreṇa tasyāntamadhigacchati ॥28॥
html:
yadahnā kurute pāpamarakṣanbhayataḥ prajāḥ ।
rājā varṣasahasreṇa tasyāntamadhigacchati ॥28॥
slp1: yadahnA kurute pApamarakzanBayataH prajAH । rAjA varzasahasreRa tasyAntamaDigacCati ॥28॥

text: yadahnā kurute puṇyaṃ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan । daśa varṣasahasrāṇi tasya bhuṅkte phalaṃ divi ॥29॥
html:
yadahnā kurute puṇyaṃ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan ।
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi tasya bhuṅkte phalaṃ divi ॥29॥
slp1: yadahnA kurute puRyaM prajA DarmeRa pAlayan । daSa varzasahasrARi tasya BuNkte PalaM divi ॥29॥

text: sviṣṭiḥ svadhītiḥ sutapā lokāñjayati yāvataḥ । kṣaṇena tānavāpnoti prajā dharmeṇa pālayan ॥30॥
html:
sviṣṭiḥ svadhītiḥ sutapā lokāñjayati yāvataḥ ।
kṣaṇena tānavāpnoti prajā dharmeṇa pālayan ॥30॥
slp1: svizwiH svaDItiH sutapA lokAYjayati yAvataH । kzaRena tAnavApnoti prajA DarmeRa pAlayan ॥30॥

text: evaṃ dharmaṃ prayatnena kaunteya paripālayan । iha puṇyaphalaṃ labdhvā nādhibandhena yokṣyase ॥31॥
html:
evaṃ dharmaṃ prayatnena kaunteya paripālayan ।
iha puṇyaphalaṃ labdhvā nādhibandhena yokṣyase ॥31॥
slp1: evaM DarmaM prayatnena kOnteya paripAlayan । iha puRyaPalaM labDvA nADibanDena yokzyase ॥31॥

text: svargaloke ca mahatīṃ śriyaṃ prāpsyasi pāṇḍava । asambhavaśca dharmāṇāmīdṛśānāmarājasu । tasmādrājaiva nānyo'sti yo mahatphalamāpnuyāt ॥32॥
html:
svargaloke ca mahatīṃ śriyaṃ prāpsyasi pāṇḍava ।
asambhavaśca dharmāṇāmīdṛśānāmarājasu ।
tasmādrājaiva nānyo'sti yo mahatphalamāpnuyāt ॥32॥
slp1: svargaloke ca mahatIM SriyaM prApsyasi pARqava । asamBavaSca DarmARAmIdfSAnAmarAjasu । tasmAdrAjEva nAnyo'sti yo mahatPalamApnuyAt ॥32॥

text: sa rājyamṛddhimatprāpya dharmeṇa paripālayan । indraṃ tarpaya somena kāmaiśca suhṛdo janān] ॥33॥
html:
sa rājyamṛddhimatprāpya dharmeṇa paripālayan ।
indraṃ tarpaya somena kāmaiśca suhṛdo janān] ॥33॥
slp1: sa rAjyamfdDimatprApya DarmeRa paripAlayan । indraM tarpaya somena kAmESca suhfdo janAn] ॥33॥
