text: ya eva tu sato rakṣedasataśca nibarhayet । sa eva rājñā kartavyo rājanrājapurohitaḥ ॥1॥
html:
ya eva tu sato rakṣedasataśca nibarhayet ।
sa eva rājñā kartavyo rājanrājapurohitaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: ya eva tu sato rakzedasataSca nibarhayet । sa eva rAjYA kartavyo rAjanrAjapurohitaH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । purūravasa ailasya saṃvādaṃ mātariśvanaḥ ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
purūravasa ailasya saṃvādaṃ mātariśvanaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । purUravasa Elasya saMvAdaM mAtariSvanaH ॥2॥

text: kutaḥ svidbrāhmaṇo jāto varṇāścāpi kutastrayaḥ । kasmācca bhavati śreyānetadvāyo vicakṣva me ॥3॥
html:
kutaḥ svidbrāhmaṇo jāto varṇāścāpi kutastrayaḥ ।
kasmācca bhavati śreyānetadvāyo vicakṣva me ॥3॥
slp1: kutaH svidbrAhmaRo jAto varRAScApi kutastrayaH । kasmAcca Bavati SreyAnetadvAyo vicakzva me ॥3॥
author: aila uvāca ।

text: brahmaṇo mukhataḥ sṛṣṭo brāhmaṇo rājasattama । bāhubhyāṃ kṣatriyaḥ sṛṣṭa ūrubhyāṃ vaiśya ucyate ॥4॥
html:
brahmaṇo mukhataḥ sṛṣṭo brāhmaṇo rājasattama ।
bāhubhyāṃ kṣatriyaḥ sṛṣṭa ūrubhyāṃ vaiśya ucyate ॥4॥
slp1: brahmaRo muKataH sfzwo brAhmaRo rAjasattama । bAhuByAM kzatriyaH sfzwa UruByAM vESya ucyate ॥4॥
author: vāyuruvāca ।

text: varṇānāṃ paricaryārthaṃ trayāṇāṃ puruṣarṣabha । varṇaścaturthaḥ paścāttu padbhyāṃ śūdro vinirmitaḥ ॥5॥
html:
varṇānāṃ paricaryārthaṃ trayāṇāṃ puruṣarṣabha ।
varṇaścaturthaḥ paścāttu padbhyāṃ śūdro vinirmitaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: varRAnAM paricaryArTaM trayARAM puruzarzaBa । varRaScaturTaH paScAttu padByAM SUdro vinirmitaH ॥5॥

text: brāhmaṇo jātamātrastu pṛthivīmanvajāyata । īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dharmakośasya guptaye ॥6॥
html:
brāhmaṇo jātamātrastu pṛthivīmanvajāyata ।
īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dharmakośasya guptaye ॥6॥
slp1: brAhmaRo jAtamAtrastu pfTivImanvajAyata । ISvaraH sarvaBUtAnAM DarmakoSasya guptaye ॥6॥

text: tataḥ pṛthivyā goptāraṃ kṣatriyaṃ daṇḍadhāriṇam । dvitīyaṃ varṇamakarotprajānāmanuguptaye ॥7॥
html:
tataḥ pṛthivyā goptāraṃ kṣatriyaṃ daṇḍadhāriṇam ।
dvitīyaṃ varṇamakarotprajānāmanuguptaye ॥7॥
slp1: tataH pfTivyA goptAraM kzatriyaM daRqaDAriRam । dvitIyaM varRamakarotprajAnAmanuguptaye ॥7॥

text: vaiśyastu dhanadhānyena trīnvarṇānbibhṛyādimān । śūdro hyenānparicarediti brahmānuśāsanam ॥8॥
html:
vaiśyastu dhanadhānyena trīnvarṇānbibhṛyādimān ।
śūdro hyenānparicarediti brahmānuśāsanam ॥8॥
slp1: vESyastu DanaDAnyena trInvarRAnbiBfyAdimAn । SUdro hyenAnparicarediti brahmAnuSAsanam ॥8॥

text: dvijasya kṣatrabandhorvā kasyeyaṃ pṛthivī bhavet । dharmataḥ saha vittena samyagvāyo pracakṣva me ॥9॥
html:
dvijasya kṣatrabandhorvā kasyeyaṃ pṛthivī bhavet ।
dharmataḥ saha vittena samyagvāyo pracakṣva me ॥9॥
slp1: dvijasya kzatrabanDorvA kasyeyaM pfTivI Bavet । DarmataH saha vittena samyagvAyo pracakzva me ॥9॥
author: aila uvāca ।

text: viprasya sarvamevaitadyatkiñcijjagatīgatam । jyeṣṭhenābhijaneneha taddharmakuśalā viduḥ ॥10॥
html:
viprasya sarvamevaitadyatkiñcijjagatīgatam ।
jyeṣṭhenābhijaneneha taddharmakuśalā viduḥ ॥10॥
slp1: viprasya sarvamevEtadyatkiYcijjagatIgatam । jyezWenABijaneneha tadDarmakuSalA viduH ॥10॥
author: vāyuruvāca ।

text: svameva brāhmaṇo bhuṅkte svaṃ vaste svaṃ dadāti ca । gururhi sarvavarṇānāṃ jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaśca vai dvijaḥ ॥11॥
html:
svameva brāhmaṇo bhuṅkte svaṃ vaste svaṃ dadāti ca ।
gururhi sarvavarṇānāṃ jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaśca vai dvijaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: svameva brAhmaRo BuNkte svaM vaste svaM dadAti ca । gururhi sarvavarRAnAM jyezWaH SrezWaSca vE dvijaH ॥11॥

text: patyabhāve yathā strī hi devaraṃ kurute patim । ānantaryāttathā kṣatraṃ pṛthivī kurute patim ॥12॥
html:
patyabhāve yathā strī hi devaraṃ kurute patim ।
ānantaryāttathā kṣatraṃ pṛthivī kurute patim ॥12॥
slp1: patyaBAve yaTA strI hi devaraM kurute patim । AnantaryAttaTA kzatraM pfTivI kurute patim ॥12॥

text: eṣa te prathamaḥ kalpa āpadyanyo bhavedataḥ । yadi svarge paraṃ sthānaṃ dharmataḥ parimārgasi ॥13॥
html:
eṣa te prathamaḥ kalpa āpadyanyo bhavedataḥ ।
yadi svarge paraṃ sthānaṃ dharmataḥ parimārgasi ॥13॥
slp1: eza te praTamaH kalpa Apadyanyo BavedataH । yadi svarge paraM sTAnaM DarmataH parimArgasi ॥13॥

text: yaḥ kaścidvijayedbhūmiṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet । śrutavṛttopapannāya dharmajñāya tapasvine ॥14॥
html:
yaḥ kaścidvijayedbhūmiṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ।
śrutavṛttopapannāya dharmajñāya tapasvine ॥14॥
slp1: yaH kaScidvijayedBUmiM brAhmaRAya nivedayet । SrutavfttopapannAya DarmajYAya tapasvine ॥14॥

text: svadharmaparitṛptāya yo na vittaparo bhavet । yo rājānaṃ nayedbuddhyā sarvataḥ paripūrṇayā ॥15॥
html:
svadharmaparitṛptāya yo na vittaparo bhavet ।
yo rājānaṃ nayedbuddhyā sarvataḥ paripūrṇayā ॥15॥
slp1: svaDarmaparitfptAya yo na vittaparo Bavet । yo rAjAnaM nayedbudDyA sarvataH paripUrRayA ॥15॥

text: brāhmaṇo hi kule jātaḥ kṛtaprajño vinītavāk । śreyo nayati rājānaṃ bruvaṃścitrāṃ sarasvatīm ॥16॥
html:
brāhmaṇo hi kule jātaḥ kṛtaprajño vinītavāk ।
śreyo nayati rājānaṃ bruvaṃścitrāṃ sarasvatīm ॥16॥
slp1: brAhmaRo hi kule jAtaH kftaprajYo vinItavAk । Sreyo nayati rAjAnaM bruvaMScitrAM sarasvatIm ॥16॥

text: rājā carati yaṃ dharmaṃ brāhmaṇena nidarśitam । śuśrūṣuranahaṃvādī kṣatradharmavrate sthitaḥ ॥17॥
html:
rājā carati yaṃ dharmaṃ brāhmaṇena nidarśitam ।
śuśrūṣuranahaṃvādī kṣatradharmavrate sthitaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: rAjA carati yaM DarmaM brAhmaRena nidarSitam । SuSrUzuranahaMvAdI kzatraDarmavrate sTitaH ॥17॥

text: tāvatā sa kṛtaprajñaściraṃ yaśasi tiṣṭhati । tasya dharmasya sarvasya bhāgī rājapurohitaḥ ॥18॥
html:
tāvatā sa kṛtaprajñaściraṃ yaśasi tiṣṭhati ।
tasya dharmasya sarvasya bhāgī rājapurohitaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: tAvatA sa kftaprajYaSciraM yaSasi tizWati । tasya Darmasya sarvasya BAgI rAjapurohitaH ॥18॥

text: evameva prajāḥ sarvā rājānamabhisaṃśritāḥ । samyagvṛttāḥ svadharmasthā na kutaścidbhayānvitāḥ ॥19॥
html:
evameva prajāḥ sarvā rājānamabhisaṃśritāḥ ।
samyagvṛttāḥ svadharmasthā na kutaścidbhayānvitāḥ ॥19॥
slp1: evameva prajAH sarvA rAjAnamaBisaMSritAH । samyagvfttAH svaDarmasTA na kutaScidBayAnvitAH ॥19॥

text: rāṣṭre caranti yaṃ dharmaṃ rājñā sādhvabhirakṣitāḥ । caturthaṃ tasya dharmasya rājā bhāgaṃ sa vindati ॥20॥
html:
rāṣṭre caranti yaṃ dharmaṃ rājñā sādhvabhirakṣitāḥ ।
caturthaṃ tasya dharmasya rājā bhāgaṃ sa vindati ॥20॥
slp1: rAzwre caranti yaM DarmaM rAjYA sADvaBirakzitAH । caturTaM tasya Darmasya rAjA BAgaM sa vindati ॥20॥

text: devā manuṣyāḥ pitaro gandharvoragarākṣasāḥ । yajñamevopajīvanti nāsti ceṣṭamarājake ॥21॥
html:
devā manuṣyāḥ pitaro gandharvoragarākṣasāḥ ।
yajñamevopajīvanti nāsti ceṣṭamarājake ॥21॥
slp1: devA manuzyAH pitaro ganDarvoragarAkzasAH । yajYamevopajIvanti nAsti cezwamarAjake ॥21॥

text: ito dattena jīvanti devatāḥ pitarastathā । rājanyevāsya dharmasya yogakṣemaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ॥22॥
html:
ito dattena jīvanti devatāḥ pitarastathā ।
rājanyevāsya dharmasya yogakṣemaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: ito dattena jIvanti devatAH pitarastaTA । rAjanyevAsya Darmasya yogakzemaH pratizWitaH ॥22॥

text: chāyāyāmapsu vāyau ca sukhamuṣṇe'dhigacchati । agnau vāsasi sūrye ca sukhaṃ śīte'dhigacchati ॥23॥
html:
chāyāyāmapsu vāyau ca sukhamuṣṇe'dhigacchati ।
agnau vāsasi sūrye ca sukhaṃ śīte'dhigacchati ॥23॥
slp1: CAyAyAmapsu vAyO ca suKamuzRe'DigacCati । agnO vAsasi sUrye ca suKaM SIte'DigacCati ॥23॥

text: śabde sparśe rase rūpe gandhe ca ramate manaḥ । teṣu bhogeṣu sarveṣu nabhīto labhate sukham ॥24॥
html:
śabde sparśe rase rūpe gandhe ca ramate manaḥ ।
teṣu bhogeṣu sarveṣu nabhīto labhate sukham ॥24॥
slp1: Sabde sparSe rase rUpe ganDe ca ramate manaH । tezu Bogezu sarvezu naBIto laBate suKam ॥24॥

text: abhayasyaiva yo dātā tasyaiva sumahatphalam । na hi prāṇasamaṃ dānaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vidyate ॥25॥
html:
abhayasyaiva yo dātā tasyaiva sumahatphalam ।
na hi prāṇasamaṃ dānaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vidyate ॥25॥
slp1: aBayasyEva yo dAtA tasyEva sumahatPalam । na hi prARasamaM dAnaM trizu lokezu vidyate ॥25॥

text: indro rājā yamo rājā dharmo rājā tathaiva ca । rājā bibharti rūpāṇi rājñā sarvamidaṃ dhṛtam] ॥26॥
html:
indro rājā yamo rājā dharmo rājā tathaiva ca ।
rājā bibharti rūpāṇi rājñā sarvamidaṃ dhṛtam] ॥26॥
slp1: indro rAjA yamo rAjA Darmo rAjA taTEva ca । rAjA biBarti rUpARi rAjYA sarvamidaM Dftam] ॥26॥

text: rājñā purohitaḥ kāryo bhavedvidvānbahuśrutaḥ । ubhau samīkṣya dharmārthāvaprameyāvanantaram ॥1॥
html:
rājñā purohitaḥ kāryo bhavedvidvānbahuśrutaḥ ।
ubhau samīkṣya dharmārthāvaprameyāvanantaram ॥1॥
slp1: rAjYA purohitaH kAryo BavedvidvAnbahuSrutaH । uBO samIkzya DarmArTAvaprameyAvanantaram ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dharmātmā dharmavidyeṣāṃ rājñāṃ rājanpurohitaḥ । rājā caivaṃ guṇo yeṣāṃ kuśalaṃ teṣu sarvaśaḥ ॥2॥
html:
dharmātmā dharmavidyeṣāṃ rājñāṃ rājanpurohitaḥ ।
rājā caivaṃ guṇo yeṣāṃ kuśalaṃ teṣu sarvaśaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: DarmAtmA DarmavidyezAM rAjYAM rAjanpurohitaH । rAjA cEvaM guRo yezAM kuSalaM tezu sarvaSaH ॥2॥

text: ubhau prajā vardhayato devānpūrvānparānpitṝn । yau sameyāsthitau dharme śraddheyau sutapasvinau ॥3॥
html:
ubhau prajā vardhayato devānpūrvānparānpitṝn ।
yau sameyāsthitau dharme śraddheyau sutapasvinau ॥3॥
slp1: uBO prajA varDayato devAnpUrvAnparAnpitFn । yO sameyAsTitO Darme SradDeyO sutapasvinO ॥3॥

text: parasparasya suhṛdau sammatau samacetasau । brahmakṣatrasya sammānātprajāḥ sukhamavāpnuyuḥ ॥4॥
html:
parasparasya suhṛdau sammatau samacetasau ।
brahmakṣatrasya sammānātprajāḥ sukhamavāpnuyuḥ ॥4॥
slp1: parasparasya suhfdO sammatO samacetasO । brahmakzatrasya sammAnAtprajAH suKamavApnuyuH ॥4॥

text: vimānanāttayoreva prajā naśyeyureva ha । brahmakṣatraṃ hi sarveṣāṃ dharmāṇāṃ mūlamucyate ॥5॥
html:
vimānanāttayoreva prajā naśyeyureva ha ।
brahmakṣatraṃ hi sarveṣāṃ dharmāṇāṃ mūlamucyate ॥5॥
slp1: vimAnanAttayoreva prajA naSyeyureva ha । brahmakzatraM hi sarvezAM DarmARAM mUlamucyate ॥5॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । ailakaśyapasaṃvādaṃ taṃ nibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥6॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
ailakaśyapasaṃvādaṃ taṃ nibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥6॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । ElakaSyapasaMvAdaM taM niboDa yuDizWira ॥6॥

text: yadā hi brahma prajahāti kṣatraṃ kṣatraṃ yadā vā prajahāti brahma । anvagbalaṃ katame'sminbhajante tathābalyaṃ katame'sminviyanti ॥7॥
html:
yadā hi brahma prajahāti kṣatraṃ kṣatraṃ yadā vā prajahāti brahma ।
anvagbalaṃ katame'sminbhajante tathābalyaṃ katame'sminviyanti ॥7॥
slp1: yadA hi brahma prajahAti kzatraM kzatraM yadA vA prajahAti brahma । anvagbalaM katame'sminBajante taTAbalyaM katame'sminviyanti ॥7॥
author: aila uvāca ।

text: vyṛddhaṃ rāṣṭraṃ bhavati kṣatriyasya brahma kṣatraṃ yatra virudhyate ha । anvagbalaṃ dasyavastadbhajante'balyaṃ tathā tatra viyanti santaḥ ॥8॥
html:
vyṛddhaṃ rāṣṭraṃ bhavati kṣatriyasya brahma kṣatraṃ yatra virudhyate ha ।
anvagbalaṃ dasyavastadbhajante'balyaṃ tathā tatra viyanti santaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: vyfdDaM rAzwraM Bavati kzatriyasya brahma kzatraM yatra viruDyate ha । anvagbalaM dasyavastadBajante'balyaM taTA tatra viyanti santaH ॥8॥
author: kaśyapa uvāca ।

text: naiṣāmukṣā vardhate nota usrā na gargaro mathyate no yajante । naiṣāṃ putrā vedamadhīyate ca yadā brahma kṣatriyāḥ santyajanti ॥9॥
html:
naiṣāmukṣā vardhate nota usrā na gargaro mathyate no yajante ।
naiṣāṃ putrā vedamadhīyate ca yadā brahma kṣatriyāḥ santyajanti ॥9॥
slp1: nEzAmukzA varDate nota usrA na gargaro maTyate no yajante । nEzAM putrA vedamaDIyate ca yadA brahma kzatriyAH santyajanti ॥9॥

text: naiṣāmukṣā vardhate jātu gehe nādhīyate saprajā no yajante । apadhvastā dasyubhūtā bhavanti ye brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyānsanatyajanti ॥10॥
html:
naiṣāmukṣā vardhate jātu gehe nādhīyate saprajā no yajante ।
apadhvastā dasyubhūtā bhavanti ye brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyānsanatyajanti ॥10॥
slp1: nEzAmukzA varDate jAtu gehe nADIyate saprajA no yajante । apaDvastA dasyuBUtA Bavanti ye brAhmaRAH kzatriyAnsanatyajanti ॥10॥

text: etau hi nityasaṃyuktāvitaretaradhāraṇe । kṣatraṃ hi brahmaṇo yoniryoniḥ kṣatrasya ca dvijāḥ ॥11॥
html:
etau hi nityasaṃyuktāvitaretaradhāraṇe ।
kṣatraṃ hi brahmaṇo yoniryoniḥ kṣatrasya ca dvijāḥ ॥11॥
slp1: etO hi nityasaMyuktAvitaretaraDAraRe । kzatraM hi brahmaRo yoniryoniH kzatrasya ca dvijAH ॥11॥

text: ubhāvetau nityamabhiprapannau samprāpaturmahatīṃ śrīpratiṣṭhām । tayoḥ sandhirbhidyate cetpurāṇastataḥ sarvaṃ bhavati hi sampramūḍham ॥12॥
html:
ubhāvetau nityamabhiprapannau samprāpaturmahatīṃ śrīpratiṣṭhām ।
tayoḥ sandhirbhidyate cetpurāṇastataḥ sarvaṃ bhavati hi sampramūḍham ॥12॥
slp1: uBAvetO nityamaBiprapannO samprApaturmahatIM SrIpratizWAm । tayoH sanDirBidyate cetpurARastataH sarvaM Bavati hi sampramUQam ॥12॥

text: nātra plavaṃ labhate pāragāmī mahāgādhe nauriva sampraṇunnā । cāturvarṇyaṃ bhavati ca sampramūḍhaṃ tataḥ prajāḥ kṣayasaṃsthā bhavanti ॥13॥
html:
nātra plavaṃ labhate pāragāmī mahāgādhe nauriva sampraṇunnā ।
cāturvarṇyaṃ bhavati ca sampramūḍhaṃ tataḥ prajāḥ kṣayasaṃsthā bhavanti ॥13॥
slp1: nAtra plavaM laBate pAragAmI mahAgADe nOriva sampraRunnA । cAturvarRyaM Bavati ca sampramUQaM tataH prajAH kzayasaMsTA Bavanti ॥13॥

text: brahmavṛkṣo rakṣyamāṇo madhu hema ca varṣati । arakṣyamāṇaḥ satatamaśru pāpaṃ ca varṣati ॥14॥
html:
brahmavṛkṣo rakṣyamāṇo madhu hema ca varṣati ।
arakṣyamāṇaḥ satatamaśru pāpaṃ ca varṣati ॥14॥
slp1: brahmavfkzo rakzyamARo maDu hema ca varzati । arakzyamARaH satatamaSru pApaM ca varzati ॥14॥

text: abrahmacārī caraṇādapeto yadā brahmā brahmaṇi trāṇamicchet । āścaryaśo varṣati tatra devastatrābhīkṣṇaṃ duḥsahāścāviśanti ॥15॥
html:
abrahmacārī caraṇādapeto yadā brahmā brahmaṇi trāṇamicchet ।
āścaryaśo varṣati tatra devastatrābhīkṣṇaṃ duḥsahāścāviśanti ॥15॥
slp1: abrahmacArI caraRAdapeto yadA brahmA brahmaRi trARamicCet । AScaryaSo varzati tatra devastatrABIkzRaM duHsahAScAviSanti ॥15॥

text: striyaṃ hatvā brāhmaṇaṃ vāpi pāpaḥ sabhāyāṃ yatra labhate'nuvādam । rājñaḥ sakāśe na bibheti cāpi tato bhayaṃ jāyate kṣatriyasya ॥16॥
html:
striyaṃ hatvā brāhmaṇaṃ vāpi pāpaḥ sabhāyāṃ yatra labhate'nuvādam ।
rājñaḥ sakāśe na bibheti cāpi tato bhayaṃ jāyate kṣatriyasya ॥16॥
slp1: striyaM hatvA brAhmaRaM vApi pApaH saBAyAM yatra laBate'nuvAdam । rAjYaH sakASe na biBeti cApi tato BayaM jAyate kzatriyasya ॥16॥

text: pāpaiḥ pāpe kriyamāṇe'tivelaṃ tato rudro jāyate deva eṣaḥ । pāpaiḥ pāpāḥ sañjanayanti rudraṃ tataḥ sarvānsādhvasādhūnhinasti ॥17॥
html:
pāpaiḥ pāpe kriyamāṇe'tivelaṃ tato rudro jāyate deva eṣaḥ ।
pāpaiḥ pāpāḥ sañjanayanti rudraṃ tataḥ sarvānsādhvasādhūnhinasti ॥17॥
slp1: pApEH pApe kriyamARe'tivelaM tato rudro jAyate deva ezaH । pApEH pApAH saYjanayanti rudraM tataH sarvAnsADvasADUnhinasti ॥17॥

text: kuto rudraḥ kīdṛśo vāpi rudraḥ sattvaiḥ sattvaṃ dṛśyate vadhyamānam । etadvidvankaśyapa me pracakṣva yato rudro jāyate deva eṣaḥ ॥18॥
html:
kuto rudraḥ kīdṛśo vāpi rudraḥ sattvaiḥ sattvaṃ dṛśyate vadhyamānam ।
etadvidvankaśyapa me pracakṣva yato rudro jāyate deva eṣaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: kuto rudraH kIdfSo vApi rudraH sattvEH sattvaM dfSyate vaDyamAnam । etadvidvankaSyapa me pracakzva yato rudro jAyate deva ezaH ॥18॥
author: aila uvāca ।

text: ātmā rudro hṛdaye mānavānāṃ svaṃ svaṃ dehaṃ paradehaṃ ca hanti । vātotpātaiḥ sadṛśaṃ rudramāhurdāvairjīmūtaiḥ sadṛśaṃ rūpamasya ॥19॥
html:
ātmā rudro hṛdaye mānavānāṃ svaṃ svaṃ dehaṃ paradehaṃ ca hanti ।
vātotpātaiḥ sadṛśaṃ rudramāhurdāvairjīmūtaiḥ sadṛśaṃ rūpamasya ॥19॥
slp1: AtmA rudro hfdaye mAnavAnAM svaM svaM dehaM paradehaM ca hanti । vAtotpAtEH sadfSaM rudramAhurdAvErjImUtEH sadfSaM rUpamasya ॥19॥
author: kaśyapa uvāca ।

text: na vai vātaṃ parivṛnoti kaścinna jīmūto varṣati naiva dāvaḥ । tathāyukto dṛśyate mānaveṣu kāmadveṣādbadhyate mucyate ca ॥20॥
html:
na vai vātaṃ parivṛnoti kaścinna jīmūto varṣati naiva dāvaḥ ।
tathāyukto dṛśyate mānaveṣu kāmadveṣādbadhyate mucyate ca ॥20॥
slp1: na vE vAtaM parivfnoti kaScinna jImUto varzati nEva dAvaH । taTAyukto dfSyate mAnavezu kAmadvezAdbaDyate mucyate ca ॥20॥
author: aila uvāca ।

text: yathaikagehe jātavedāḥ pradīptaḥ kṛtsnaṃ grāmaṃ pradahetsa tvarāvān । vimohanaṃ kurute deva eṣa tataḥ sarvaṃ spṛśyate puṇyapāpaiḥ ॥21॥
html:
yathaikagehe jātavedāḥ pradīptaḥ kṛtsnaṃ grāmaṃ pradahetsa tvarāvān ।
vimohanaṃ kurute deva eṣa tataḥ sarvaṃ spṛśyate puṇyapāpaiḥ ॥21॥
slp1: yaTEkagehe jAtavedAH pradIptaH kftsnaM grAmaM pradahetsa tvarAvAn । vimohanaM kurute deva eza tataH sarvaM spfSyate puRyapApEH ॥21॥
author: kaśyapa uvāca ।

text: yadi daṇḍaḥ spṛśate puṇyabhājaṃ pāpaiḥ pāpe kriyamāṇe'viśeṣāt । kasya hetoḥ sukṛtaṃ nāma kuryādduṣkṛtaṃ vā kasya hetorna kuryāt ॥22॥
html:
yadi daṇḍaḥ spṛśate puṇyabhājaṃ pāpaiḥ pāpe kriyamāṇe'viśeṣāt ।
kasya hetoḥ sukṛtaṃ nāma kuryādduṣkṛtaṃ vā kasya hetorna kuryāt ॥22॥
slp1: yadi daRqaH spfSate puRyaBAjaM pApEH pApe kriyamARe'viSezAt । kasya hetoH sukftaM nAma kuryAdduzkftaM vA kasya hetorna kuryAt ॥22॥
author: aila uvāca ।

text: asantyāgātpāpakṛtāmapāpāṃstulyo daṇḍaḥ spṛśate miśrabhāvāt । śuṣkeṇārdraṃ dahyate miśrabhāvānna miśraḥ syātpāpakṛdbhiḥ kathañcit ॥23॥
html:
asantyāgātpāpakṛtāmapāpāṃstulyo daṇḍaḥ spṛśate miśrabhāvāt ।
śuṣkeṇārdraṃ dahyate miśrabhāvānna miśraḥ syātpāpakṛdbhiḥ kathañcit ॥23॥
slp1: asantyAgAtpApakftAmapApAMstulyo daRqaH spfSate miSraBAvAt । SuzkeRArdraM dahyate miSraBAvAnna miSraH syAtpApakfdBiH kaTaYcit ॥23॥
author: kaśyapa uvāca ।

text: sādhvasādhūndhārayatīha bhūmiḥ sādhvasādhūṃstāpayatīha sūryaḥ । sādhvasādhūnvātayatīha vāyurāpastathā sādhvasādhūnvahanti ॥24॥
html:
sādhvasādhūndhārayatīha bhūmiḥ sādhvasādhūṃstāpayatīha sūryaḥ ।
sādhvasādhūnvātayatīha vāyurāpastathā sādhvasādhūnvahanti ॥24॥
slp1: sADvasADUnDArayatIha BUmiH sADvasADUMstApayatIha sUryaH । sADvasADUnvAtayatIha vAyurApastaTA sADvasADUnvahanti ॥24॥
author: aila uvāca ।

text: evamasminvartate loka eva nāmutraivaṃ vartate rājaputra । pretyaitayorantaravānviśeṣo yo vai puṇyaṃ carate yaśca pāpam ॥25॥
html:
evamasminvartate loka eva nāmutraivaṃ vartate rājaputra ।
pretyaitayorantaravānviśeṣo yo vai puṇyaṃ carate yaśca pāpam ॥25॥
slp1: evamasminvartate loka eva nAmutrEvaM vartate rAjaputra । pretyEtayorantaravAnviSezo yo vE puRyaM carate yaSca pApam ॥25॥
author: kaśyapa uvāca ।

text: puṇyasya loko madhumānghṛtārcirhiraṇyajyotiramṛtasya nābhiḥ । tatra pretya modate brahmacārī na tatra mṛtyurna jarā nota duḥkham ॥26॥
html:
puṇyasya loko madhumānghṛtārcirhiraṇyajyotiramṛtasya nābhiḥ ।
tatra pretya modate brahmacārī na tatra mṛtyurna jarā nota duḥkham ॥26॥
slp1: puRyasya loko maDumAnGftArcirhiraRyajyotiramftasya nABiH । tatra pretya modate brahmacArI na tatra mftyurna jarA nota duHKam ॥26॥

text: pāpasya loko nirayo'prakāśo nityaṃ duḥkhaḥ śokabhūyiṣṭha eva । tatrātmānaṃ śocate pāpakarmā bahvīḥ samāḥ prapatannapratiṣṭhaḥ ॥27॥
html:
pāpasya loko nirayo'prakāśo nityaṃ duḥkhaḥ śokabhūyiṣṭha eva ।
tatrātmānaṃ śocate pāpakarmā bahvīḥ samāḥ prapatannapratiṣṭhaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: pApasya loko nirayo'prakASo nityaM duHKaH SokaBUyizWa eva । tatrAtmAnaM Socate pApakarmA bahvIH samAH prapatannapratizWaH ॥27॥

text: mitho bhedādbrāhmaṇakṣatriyāṇāṃ prajā duḥkhaṃ duḥsahaṃ cāviśanti । evaṃ jñātvā kārya eveha vidvānpurohito naikavidyo nṛpeṇa ॥28॥
html:
mitho bhedādbrāhmaṇakṣatriyāṇāṃ prajā duḥkhaṃ duḥsahaṃ cāviśanti ।
evaṃ jñātvā kārya eveha vidvānpurohito naikavidyo nṛpeṇa ॥28॥
slp1: miTo BedAdbrAhmaRakzatriyARAM prajA duHKaM duHsahaM cAviSanti । evaM jYAtvA kArya eveha vidvAnpurohito nEkavidyo nfpeRa ॥28॥

text: taṃ caivānvabhiṣicyeta tathā dharmo vidhīyate । agryo hi brāhmaṇaḥ proktaḥ sarvasyaiveha dharmataḥ ॥29॥
html:
taṃ caivānvabhiṣicyeta tathā dharmo vidhīyate ।
agryo hi brāhmaṇaḥ proktaḥ sarvasyaiveha dharmataḥ ॥29॥
slp1: taM cEvAnvaBizicyeta taTA Darmo viDIyate । agryo hi brAhmaRaH proktaH sarvasyEveha DarmataH ॥29॥

text: pūrvaṃ hi brāhmaṇāḥ sṛṣṭā iti dharmavido viduḥ । jyeṣṭhenābhijanenāsya prāptaṃ sarvaṃ yaduttaram ॥30॥
html:
pūrvaṃ hi brāhmaṇāḥ sṛṣṭā iti dharmavido viduḥ ।
jyeṣṭhenābhijanenāsya prāptaṃ sarvaṃ yaduttaram ॥30॥
slp1: pUrvaM hi brAhmaRAH sfzwA iti Darmavido viduH । jyezWenABijanenAsya prAptaM sarvaM yaduttaram ॥30॥

text: tasmānmānyaśca pūjyaśca brāhmaṇaḥ prasṛtāgrabhuk । sarvaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ variṣṭhaṃ ca nivedyaṃ tasya dharmataḥ ॥31॥
html:
tasmānmānyaśca pūjyaśca brāhmaṇaḥ prasṛtāgrabhuk ।
sarvaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ variṣṭhaṃ ca nivedyaṃ tasya dharmataḥ ॥31॥
slp1: tasmAnmAnyaSca pUjyaSca brAhmaRaH prasftAgraBuk । sarvaM SrezWaM varizWaM ca nivedyaM tasya DarmataH ॥31॥

text: avaśyametatkartavyaṃ rājñā balavatāpi hi । brahma vardhayati kṣatraṃ kṣatrato brahma vardhate] ॥32॥
html:
avaśyametatkartavyaṃ rājñā balavatāpi hi ।
brahma vardhayati kṣatraṃ kṣatrato brahma vardhate] ॥32॥
slp1: avaSyametatkartavyaM rAjYA balavatApi hi । brahma varDayati kzatraM kzatrato brahma varDate] ॥32॥

text: yogakṣemo hi rāṣṭrasya rājanyāyatta ucyate । yogakṣemaśca rājño'pi samāyattaḥ purohite ॥1॥
html:
yogakṣemo hi rāṣṭrasya rājanyāyatta ucyate ।
yogakṣemaśca rājño'pi samāyattaḥ purohite ॥1॥
slp1: yogakzemo hi rAzwrasya rAjanyAyatta ucyate । yogakzemaSca rAjYo'pi samAyattaH purohite ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yatādṛṣṭaṃ bhayaṃ brahma prajānāṃ śamayatyuta । dṛṣṭaṃ ca rājā bāhubhyāṃ tadrāṣṭraṃ sukhamedhate ॥2॥
html:
yatādṛṣṭaṃ bhayaṃ brahma prajānāṃ śamayatyuta ।
dṛṣṭaṃ ca rājā bāhubhyāṃ tadrāṣṭraṃ sukhamedhate ॥2॥
slp1: yatAdfzwaM BayaM brahma prajAnAM Samayatyuta । dfzwaM ca rAjA bAhuByAM tadrAzwraM suKameDate ॥2॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । mucukundasya saṃvādaṃ rājño vaiśravaṇasya ca ॥3॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
mucukundasya saṃvādaṃ rājño vaiśravaṇasya ca ॥3॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । mucukundasya saMvAdaM rAjYo vESravaRasya ca ॥3॥

text: mucukundo vijityemāṃ pṛthivīṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ । jijñāsamānaḥ svabalamabhyayādalakādhipam ॥4॥
html:
mucukundo vijityemāṃ pṛthivīṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ ।
jijñāsamānaḥ svabalamabhyayādalakādhipam ॥4॥
slp1: mucukundo vijityemAM pfTivIM pfTivIpatiH । jijYAsamAnaH svabalamaByayAdalakADipam ॥4॥

text: tato vaiśravaṇo rājā rakṣāṃsi samavāsṛjat । te balānyavamṛdnantaḥ prācaraṃstasya nairṛtāḥ ॥5॥
html:
tato vaiśravaṇo rājā rakṣāṃsi samavāsṛjat ।
te balānyavamṛdnantaḥ prācaraṃstasya nairṛtāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: tato vESravaRo rAjA rakzAMsi samavAsfjat । te balAnyavamfdnantaH prAcaraMstasya nErftAH ॥5॥

text: sa hanyamāne sainye sve mucukundo narādhipaḥ । garhayāmāsa vidvāṃsaṃ purohitamarindamaḥ ॥6॥
html:
sa hanyamāne sainye sve mucukundo narādhipaḥ ।
garhayāmāsa vidvāṃsaṃ purohitamarindamaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: sa hanyamAne sEnye sve mucukundo narADipaH । garhayAmAsa vidvAMsaM purohitamarindamaH ॥6॥

text: tata ugraṃ tapastaptvā vasiṣṭho brahmavittamaḥ । rakṣāṃsyapāvadhīttatra panthānaṃ cāpyavindata ॥7॥
html:
tata ugraṃ tapastaptvā vasiṣṭho brahmavittamaḥ ।
rakṣāṃsyapāvadhīttatra panthānaṃ cāpyavindata ॥7॥
slp1: tata ugraM tapastaptvA vasizWo brahmavittamaH । rakzAMsyapAvaDIttatra panTAnaM cApyavindata ॥7॥

text: tato vaiśravaṇo rājā mucukundamadarśayat । vadhyamāneṣu sainyeṣu vacanaṃ cedamabravīt ॥8॥
html:
tato vaiśravaṇo rājā mucukundamadarśayat ।
vadhyamāneṣu sainyeṣu vacanaṃ cedamabravīt ॥8॥
slp1: tato vESravaRo rAjA mucukundamadarSayat । vaDyamAnezu sEnyezu vacanaM cedamabravIt ॥8॥

text: tvatto hi balinaḥ pūrve rājānaḥ sapurohitāḥ । na caivaṃ samavartaṃste yathā tvamiha vartase ॥9॥
html:
tvatto hi balinaḥ pūrve rājānaḥ sapurohitāḥ ।
na caivaṃ samavartaṃste yathā tvamiha vartase ॥9॥
slp1: tvatto hi balinaH pUrve rAjAnaH sapurohitAH । na cEvaM samavartaMste yaTA tvamiha vartase ॥9॥

text: te khalvapi kṛtāstrāśca balavantaśca bhūmipāḥ । āgamya paryupāsante māmīśaṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ ॥10॥
html:
te khalvapi kṛtāstrāśca balavantaśca bhūmipāḥ ।
āgamya paryupāsante māmīśaṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ ॥10॥
slp1: te Kalvapi kftAstrASca balavantaSca BUmipAH । Agamya paryupAsante mAmISaM suKaduHKayoH ॥10॥

text: yadyasti bāhuvīryaṃ te taddarśayitumarhasi । kiṃ brāhmaṇabalena tvamatimātraṃ pravartase ॥11॥
html:
yadyasti bāhuvīryaṃ te taddarśayitumarhasi ।
kiṃ brāhmaṇabalena tvamatimātraṃ pravartase ॥11॥
slp1: yadyasti bAhuvIryaM te taddarSayitumarhasi । kiM brAhmaRabalena tvamatimAtraM pravartase ॥11॥

text: mucukundastataḥ kruddhaḥ pratyuvāca dhaneśvaram । nyāyapūrvamasaṃrabdhamasambhrāntamidaṃ vacaḥ ॥12॥
html:
mucukundastataḥ kruddhaḥ pratyuvāca dhaneśvaram ।
nyāyapūrvamasaṃrabdhamasambhrāntamidaṃ vacaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: mucukundastataH krudDaH pratyuvAca DaneSvaram । nyAyapUrvamasaMrabDamasamBrAntamidaM vacaH ॥12॥

text: brahmakṣatramidaṃ sṛṣṭamekayoni svayambhuvā । pṛthagbalavidhānaṃ ca tallokaṃ parirakṣati ॥13॥
html:
brahmakṣatramidaṃ sṛṣṭamekayoni svayambhuvā ।
pṛthagbalavidhānaṃ ca tallokaṃ parirakṣati ॥13॥
slp1: brahmakzatramidaM sfzwamekayoni svayamBuvA । pfTagbalaviDAnaM ca tallokaM parirakzati ॥13॥

text: tapomantrabalaṃ nityaṃ brāhmaṇeṣu pratiṣṭhitam । astrabāhubalaṃ nityaṃ kṣatriyeṣu pratiṣṭhitam ॥14॥
html:
tapomantrabalaṃ nityaṃ brāhmaṇeṣu pratiṣṭhitam ।
astrabāhubalaṃ nityaṃ kṣatriyeṣu pratiṣṭhitam ॥14॥
slp1: tapomantrabalaM nityaM brAhmaRezu pratizWitam । astrabAhubalaM nityaM kzatriyezu pratizWitam ॥14॥

text: tābhyāṃ sambhūya kartavyaṃ prajānāṃ paripālanam । tathā ca māṃ pravartantaṃ garhayasyalakādhipa ॥15॥
html:
tābhyāṃ sambhūya kartavyaṃ prajānāṃ paripālanam ।
tathā ca māṃ pravartantaṃ garhayasyalakādhipa ॥15॥
slp1: tAByAM samBUya kartavyaM prajAnAM paripAlanam । taTA ca mAM pravartantaM garhayasyalakADipa ॥15॥

text: tato'bravīdvaiśravaṇo rājānaṃ sapurohitam । nāhaṃ rājyamanirdiṣṭaṃ kasmaicidvidadhāmyuta ॥16॥
html:
tato'bravīdvaiśravaṇo rājānaṃ sapurohitam ।
nāhaṃ rājyamanirdiṣṭaṃ kasmaicidvidadhāmyuta ॥16॥
slp1: tato'bravIdvESravaRo rAjAnaM sapurohitam । nAhaM rAjyamanirdizwaM kasmEcidvidaDAmyuta ॥16॥

text: nācchinde cāpi nirdiṣṭamiti jānīhi pārthiva । praśādhi pṛthivīṃ vīra maddattāmakhilāmimām ॥17॥
html:
nācchinde cāpi nirdiṣṭamiti jānīhi pārthiva ।
praśādhi pṛthivīṃ vīra maddattāmakhilāmimām ॥17॥
slp1: nAcCinde cApi nirdizwamiti jAnIhi pArTiva । praSADi pfTivIM vIra maddattAmaKilAmimAm ॥17॥

text: nāhaṃ rājyaṃ bhavaddattaṃ bhoktumicchāmi pārthiva । bāhuvīryārjitaṃ rājyamaśnīyāmiti kāmaye ॥18॥
html:
nāhaṃ rājyaṃ bhavaddattaṃ bhoktumicchāmi pārthiva ।
bāhuvīryārjitaṃ rājyamaśnīyāmiti kāmaye ॥18॥
slp1: nAhaM rAjyaM BavaddattaM BoktumicCAmi pArTiva । bAhuvIryArjitaM rAjyamaSnIyAmiti kAmaye ॥18॥
author: mucukunda uvāca ।

text: tato vaiśravaṇo rājā vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayau । kṣatradharme sthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā mucukundamasambhramam ॥19॥
html:
tato vaiśravaṇo rājā vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayau ।
kṣatradharme sthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā mucukundamasambhramam ॥19॥
slp1: tato vESravaRo rAjA vismayaM paramaM yayO । kzatraDarme sTitaM dfzwvA mucukundamasamBramam ॥19॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tato rājā mucukundaḥ so'nvaśāsadvasundharām । bāhuvīryārjitāṃ samyakkṣatradharmamanuvrataḥ ॥20॥
html:
tato rājā mucukundaḥ so'nvaśāsadvasundharām ।
bāhuvīryārjitāṃ samyakkṣatradharmamanuvrataḥ ॥20॥
slp1: tato rAjA mucukundaH so'nvaSAsadvasunDarAm । bAhuvIryArjitAM samyakkzatraDarmamanuvrataH ॥20॥

text: evaṃ yo brahmavidrājā brahmapūrvaṃ pravartate । jayatyavijitāmurvīṃ yaśaśca mahadaśnute ॥21॥
html:
evaṃ yo brahmavidrājā brahmapūrvaṃ pravartate ।
jayatyavijitāmurvīṃ yaśaśca mahadaśnute ॥21॥
slp1: evaM yo brahmavidrAjA brahmapUrvaM pravartate । jayatyavijitAmurvIM yaSaSca mahadaSnute ॥21॥

text: nityodako brāhmaṇaḥ syānnityaśastraśca kṣatriyaḥ । tayorhi sarvamāyattaṃ yatkiñcijjagatīgatam] ॥22॥
html:
nityodako brāhmaṇaḥ syānnityaśastraśca kṣatriyaḥ ।
tayorhi sarvamāyattaṃ yatkiñcijjagatīgatam] ॥22॥
slp1: nityodako brAhmaRaH syAnnityaSastraSca kzatriyaH । tayorhi sarvamAyattaM yatkiYcijjagatIgatam] ॥22॥

text: yayā vṛttyā mahīpālo vivardhayati mānavān । puṇyāṃśca lokāñjayati tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
yayā vṛttyā mahīpālo vivardhayati mānavān ।
puṇyāṃśca lokāñjayati tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: yayA vfttyA mahIpAlo vivarDayati mAnavAn । puRyAMSca lokAYjayati tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: dānaśīlo bhavedrājā yajñaśīlaśca bhārata । upavāsatapaḥśīlaḥ prajānāṃ pālane rataḥ ॥2॥
html:
dānaśīlo bhavedrājā yajñaśīlaśca bhārata ।
upavāsatapaḥśīlaḥ prajānāṃ pālane rataḥ ॥2॥
slp1: dAnaSIlo BavedrAjA yajYaSIlaSca BArata । upavAsatapaHSIlaH prajAnAM pAlane rataH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sarvāścaiva prajā nityaṃ rājā dharmeṇa pālayet । utthānenāpramādena pūjayeccaiva dhārmikān ॥3॥
html:
sarvāścaiva prajā nityaṃ rājā dharmeṇa pālayet ।
utthānenāpramādena pūjayeccaiva dhārmikān ॥3॥
slp1: sarvAScEva prajA nityaM rAjA DarmeRa pAlayet । utTAnenApramAdena pUjayeccEva DArmikAn ॥3॥

text: rājñā hi pūjito dharmastataḥ sarvatra pūjyate । yadyadācarate rājā tatprajānāṃ hi rocate ॥4॥
html:
rājñā hi pūjito dharmastataḥ sarvatra pūjyate ।
yadyadācarate rājā tatprajānāṃ hi rocate ॥4॥
slp1: rAjYA hi pUjito DarmastataH sarvatra pUjyate । yadyadAcarate rAjA tatprajAnAM hi rocate ॥4॥

text: nityamudyatadaṇḍaśca bhavenmṛtyurivāriṣu । nihanyātsarvato dasyūnna kāmātkasyacitkṣamet ॥5॥
html:
nityamudyatadaṇḍaśca bhavenmṛtyurivāriṣu ।
nihanyātsarvato dasyūnna kāmātkasyacitkṣamet ॥5॥
slp1: nityamudyatadaRqaSca BavenmftyurivArizu । nihanyAtsarvato dasyUnna kAmAtkasyacitkzamet ॥5॥

text: yaṃ hi dharmaṃ carantīha prajā rājñā surakṣitāḥ । caturthaṃ tasya dharmasya rājā bhārata vindati ॥6॥
html:
yaṃ hi dharmaṃ carantīha prajā rājñā surakṣitāḥ ।
caturthaṃ tasya dharmasya rājā bhārata vindati ॥6॥
slp1: yaM hi DarmaM carantIha prajA rAjYA surakzitAH । caturTaM tasya Darmasya rAjA BArata vindati ॥6॥

text: yadadhīte yadyajate yaddadāti yadarcati । rājā caturthabhāktasya prajā dharmeṇa pālayan ॥7॥
html:
yadadhīte yadyajate yaddadāti yadarcati ।
rājā caturthabhāktasya prajā dharmeṇa pālayan ॥7॥
slp1: yadaDIte yadyajate yaddadAti yadarcati । rAjA caturTaBAktasya prajA DarmeRa pAlayan ॥7॥

text: yadrāṣṭre'kuśalaṃ kiñcidrājño'rakṣayataḥ prajāḥ । caturthaṃ tasya pāpasya rājā bhārata vindati ॥8॥
html:
yadrāṣṭre'kuśalaṃ kiñcidrājño'rakṣayataḥ prajāḥ ।
caturthaṃ tasya pāpasya rājā bhārata vindati ॥8॥
slp1: yadrAzwre'kuSalaM kiYcidrAjYo'rakzayataH prajAH । caturTaM tasya pApasya rAjA BArata vindati ॥8॥

text: apyāhuḥ sarvameveti bhūyo'rdhamiti niścayaḥ । karmaṇaḥ pṛthivīpāla nṛśaṃso'nṛtavāgapi । tādṛśātkilbiṣādrājā śṛṇu yena pramucyate ॥9॥
html:
apyāhuḥ sarvameveti bhūyo'rdhamiti niścayaḥ ।
karmaṇaḥ pṛthivīpāla nṛśaṃso'nṛtavāgapi ।
tādṛśātkilbiṣādrājā śṛṇu yena pramucyate ॥9॥
slp1: apyAhuH sarvameveti BUyo'rDamiti niScayaH । karmaRaH pfTivIpAla nfSaMso'nftavAgapi । tAdfSAtkilbizAdrAjA SfRu yena pramucyate ॥9॥

text: pratyāhartumaśakyaṃ syāddhanaṃ corairhṛtaṃ yadi । svakośāttatpradeyaṃ syādaśaktenopajīvatā ॥10॥
html:
pratyāhartumaśakyaṃ syāddhanaṃ corairhṛtaṃ yadi ।
svakośāttatpradeyaṃ syādaśaktenopajīvatā ॥10॥
slp1: pratyAhartumaSakyaM syAdDanaM corErhftaM yadi । svakoSAttatpradeyaM syAdaSaktenopajIvatA ॥10॥

text: sarvavarṇaiḥ sadā rakṣyaṃ brahmasvaṃ brāhmaṇāstathā । na stheyaṃ viṣaye teṣu yo'pakuryāddvijātiṣu ॥11॥
html:
sarvavarṇaiḥ sadā rakṣyaṃ brahmasvaṃ brāhmaṇāstathā ।
na stheyaṃ viṣaye teṣu yo'pakuryāddvijātiṣu ॥11॥
slp1: sarvavarREH sadA rakzyaM brahmasvaM brAhmaRAstaTA । na sTeyaM vizaye tezu yo'pakuryAddvijAtizu ॥11॥

text: brahmasve rakṣyamāṇe hi sarvaṃ bhavati rakṣitam । teṣāṃ prasāde nirvṛtte kṛtakṛtyo bhavennṛpaḥ ॥12॥
html:
brahmasve rakṣyamāṇe hi sarvaṃ bhavati rakṣitam ।
teṣāṃ prasāde nirvṛtte kṛtakṛtyo bhavennṛpaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: brahmasve rakzyamARe hi sarvaM Bavati rakzitam । tezAM prasAde nirvftte kftakftyo BavennfpaH ॥12॥

text: parjanyamiva bhūtāni mahādrumamiva dvijāḥ । narāstamupajīvanti nṛpaṃ sarvārthasādhakam ॥13॥
html:
parjanyamiva bhūtāni mahādrumamiva dvijāḥ ।
narāstamupajīvanti nṛpaṃ sarvārthasādhakam ॥13॥
slp1: parjanyamiva BUtAni mahAdrumamiva dvijAH । narAstamupajIvanti nfpaM sarvArTasADakam ॥13॥

text: na hi kāmātmanā rājñā satataṃ śaṭhabuddhinā । nṛśaṃsenātilubdhena śakyāḥ pālayituṃ prajāḥ ॥14॥
html:
na hi kāmātmanā rājñā satataṃ śaṭhabuddhinā ।
nṛśaṃsenātilubdhena śakyāḥ pālayituṃ prajāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: na hi kAmAtmanA rAjYA satataM SaWabudDinA । nfSaMsenAtilubDena SakyAH pAlayituM prajAH ॥14॥

text: nāhaṃ rājyasukhānveṣī rājyamicchāmyapi kṣaṇam । dharmārthaṃ rocaye rājyaṃ dharmaścātra na vidyate ॥15॥
html:
nāhaṃ rājyasukhānveṣī rājyamicchāmyapi kṣaṇam ।
dharmārthaṃ rocaye rājyaṃ dharmaścātra na vidyate ॥15॥
slp1: nAhaM rAjyasuKAnvezI rAjyamicCAmyapi kzaRam । DarmArTaM rocaye rAjyaM DarmaScAtra na vidyate ॥15॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: tadalaṃ mama rājyena yatra dharmo na vidyate । vanameva gamiṣyāmi tasmāddharmacikīrṣayā ॥16॥
html:
tadalaṃ mama rājyena yatra dharmo na vidyate ।
vanameva gamiṣyāmi tasmāddharmacikīrṣayā ॥16॥
slp1: tadalaM mama rAjyena yatra Darmo na vidyate । vanameva gamizyAmi tasmAdDarmacikIrzayA ॥16॥

text: tatra medhyeṣvaraṇyeṣu nyastadaṇḍo jitendriyaḥ । dharmamārādhayiṣyāmi munirmūlaphalāśanaḥ ॥17॥
html:
tatra medhyeṣvaraṇyeṣu nyastadaṇḍo jitendriyaḥ ।
dharmamārādhayiṣyāmi munirmūlaphalāśanaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: tatra meDyezvaraRyezu nyastadaRqo jitendriyaH । DarmamArADayizyAmi munirmUlaPalASanaH ॥17॥

text: vedāhaṃ tava yā buddhirānṛśaṃsyaguṇaiva sā । na ca śuddhānṛśaṃsyena śakyaṃ mahadupāsitum ॥18॥
html:
vedāhaṃ tava yā buddhirānṛśaṃsyaguṇaiva sā ।
na ca śuddhānṛśaṃsyena śakyaṃ mahadupāsitum ॥18॥
slp1: vedAhaM tava yA budDirAnfSaMsyaguREva sA । na ca SudDAnfSaMsyena SakyaM mahadupAsitum ॥18॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: api tu tvā mṛduṃ dāntamatyāryamatidhārmikam । klībaṃ dharmaghṛṇāyuktaṃ na loko bahu manyate ॥19॥
html:
api tu tvā mṛduṃ dāntamatyāryamatidhārmikam ।
klībaṃ dharmaghṛṇāyuktaṃ na loko bahu manyate ॥19॥
slp1: api tu tvA mfduM dAntamatyAryamatiDArmikam । klIbaM DarmaGfRAyuktaM na loko bahu manyate ॥19॥

text: rājadharmānavekṣasva pitṛpaitāmahocitān । naitadrājñāmatho vṛttaṃ yathā tvaṃ sthātumicchasi ॥20॥
html:
rājadharmānavekṣasva pitṛpaitāmahocitān ।
naitadrājñāmatho vṛttaṃ yathā tvaṃ sthātumicchasi ॥20॥
slp1: rAjaDarmAnavekzasva pitfpEtAmahocitAn । nEtadrAjYAmaTo vfttaM yaTA tvaM sTAtumicCasi ॥20॥

text: na hi vaiklavyasaṃsṛṣṭamānṛśaṃsyamihāsthitaḥ । prajāpālanasambhūtaṃ prāptā dharmaphalaṃ hyasi ॥21॥
html:
na hi vaiklavyasaṃsṛṣṭamānṛśaṃsyamihāsthitaḥ ।
prajāpālanasambhūtaṃ prāptā dharmaphalaṃ hyasi ॥21॥
slp1: na hi vEklavyasaMsfzwamAnfSaMsyamihAsTitaH । prajApAlanasamBUtaM prAptA DarmaPalaM hyasi ॥21॥

text: na hyetāmāśiṣaṃ pāṇḍurna ca kuntyanvayācata । na caitāṃ prājñatāṃ tāta yayā carasi medhayā ॥22॥
html:
na hyetāmāśiṣaṃ pāṇḍurna ca kuntyanvayācata ।
na caitāṃ prājñatāṃ tāta yayā carasi medhayā ॥22॥
slp1: na hyetAmASizaM pARqurna ca kuntyanvayAcata । na cEtAM prAjYatAM tAta yayA carasi meDayA ॥22॥

text: śauryaṃ balaṃ ca sattvaṃ ca pitā tava sadābravīt । māhātmyaṃ balamaudāryaṃ tava kuntyanvayācata ॥23॥
html:
śauryaṃ balaṃ ca sattvaṃ ca pitā tava sadābravīt ।
māhātmyaṃ balamaudāryaṃ tava kuntyanvayācata ॥23॥
slp1: SOryaM balaM ca sattvaM ca pitA tava sadAbravIt । mAhAtmyaM balamOdAryaM tava kuntyanvayAcata ॥23॥

text: nityaṃ svāhā svadhā nityamubhe mānuṣadaivate । putreṣvāśāsate nityaṃ pitaro daivatāni ca ॥24॥
html:
nityaṃ svāhā svadhā nityamubhe mānuṣadaivate ।
putreṣvāśāsate nityaṃ pitaro daivatāni ca ॥24॥
slp1: nityaM svAhA svaDA nityamuBe mAnuzadEvate । putrezvASAsate nityaM pitaro dEvatAni ca ॥24॥

text: dānamadhyayanaṃ yajñaḥ prajānāṃ paripālanam । dharmametamadharmaṃ vā janmanaivābhyajāyithāḥ ॥25॥
html:
dānamadhyayanaṃ yajñaḥ prajānāṃ paripālanam ।
dharmametamadharmaṃ vā janmanaivābhyajāyithāḥ ॥25॥
slp1: dAnamaDyayanaM yajYaH prajAnAM paripAlanam । DarmametamaDarmaM vA janmanEvAByajAyiTAH ॥25॥

text: kāle dhuri niyuktānāṃ vahatāṃ bhāra āhite । sīdatāmapi kaunteya na kīrtiravasīdati ॥26॥
html:
kāle dhuri niyuktānāṃ vahatāṃ bhāra āhite ।
sīdatāmapi kaunteya na kīrtiravasīdati ॥26॥
slp1: kAle Duri niyuktAnAM vahatAM BAra Ahite । sIdatAmapi kOnteya na kIrtiravasIdati ॥26॥

text: samantato viniyato vahatyaskhalito hi yaḥ । nirdoṣakarmavacanātsiddhiḥ karmaṇa eva sā ॥27॥
html:
samantato viniyato vahatyaskhalito hi yaḥ ।
nirdoṣakarmavacanātsiddhiḥ karmaṇa eva sā ॥27॥
slp1: samantato viniyato vahatyasKalito hi yaH । nirdozakarmavacanAtsidDiH karmaRa eva sA ॥27॥

text: naikāntavinipātena vicacāreha kaścana । dharmī gṛhī vā rājā vā brahmacāryatha vā punaḥ ॥28॥
html:
naikāntavinipātena vicacāreha kaścana ।
dharmī gṛhī vā rājā vā brahmacāryatha vā punaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: nEkAntavinipAtena vicacAreha kaScana । DarmI gfhI vA rAjA vA brahmacAryaTa vA punaH ॥28॥

text: alpaṃ tu sādhubhūyiṣṭhaṃ yatkarmodārameva tat । kṛtamevākṛtācchreyo na pāpīyo'styakarmaṇaḥ ॥29॥
html:
alpaṃ tu sādhubhūyiṣṭhaṃ yatkarmodārameva tat ।
kṛtamevākṛtācchreyo na pāpīyo'styakarmaṇaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: alpaM tu sADuBUyizWaM yatkarmodArameva tat । kftamevAkftAcCreyo na pApIyo'styakarmaRaH ॥29॥

text: yadā kulīno dharmajñaḥ prāpnotyaiśvaryamuttamam । yogakṣemastadā rājankuśalāyaiva kalpate ॥30॥
html:
yadā kulīno dharmajñaḥ prāpnotyaiśvaryamuttamam ।
yogakṣemastadā rājankuśalāyaiva kalpate ॥30॥
slp1: yadA kulIno DarmajYaH prApnotyESvaryamuttamam । yogakzemastadA rAjankuSalAyEva kalpate ॥30॥

text: dānenānyaṃ balenānyamanyaṃ sūnṛtayā girā । sarvataḥ parigṛhṇīyādrājyaṃ prāpyeha dhārmikaḥ ॥31॥
html:
dānenānyaṃ balenānyamanyaṃ sūnṛtayā girā ।
sarvataḥ parigṛhṇīyādrājyaṃ prāpyeha dhārmikaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: dAnenAnyaM balenAnyamanyaM sUnftayA girA । sarvataH parigfhRIyAdrAjyaM prApyeha DArmikaH ॥31॥

text: yaṃ hi vaidyāḥ kule jātā avṛttibhayapīḍitāḥ । prāpya tṛptāḥ pratiṣṭhanti dharmaḥ ko'bhyadhikastataḥ ॥32॥
html:
yaṃ hi vaidyāḥ kule jātā avṛttibhayapīḍitāḥ ।
prāpya tṛptāḥ pratiṣṭhanti dharmaḥ ko'bhyadhikastataḥ ॥32॥
slp1: yaM hi vEdyAH kule jAtA avfttiBayapIqitAH । prApya tfptAH pratizWanti DarmaH ko'ByaDikastataH ॥32॥

text: kiṃ nvataḥ paramaṃ svargyaṃ kā nvataḥ prītiruttamā । kiṃ nvataḥ paramaiśvaryaṃ brūhi me yadi manyase ॥33॥
html:
kiṃ nvataḥ paramaṃ svargyaṃ kā nvataḥ prītiruttamā ।
kiṃ nvataḥ paramaiśvaryaṃ brūhi me yadi manyase ॥33॥
slp1: kiM nvataH paramaM svargyaM kA nvataH prItiruttamA । kiM nvataH paramESvaryaM brUhi me yadi manyase ॥33॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: yasminpratiṣṭhitāḥ samyakkṣemaṃ vindanti tatkṣaṇam । sa svargajittamo'smākaṃ satyametadbravīmi te ॥34॥
html:
yasminpratiṣṭhitāḥ samyakkṣemaṃ vindanti tatkṣaṇam ।
sa svargajittamo'smākaṃ satyametadbravīmi te ॥34॥
slp1: yasminpratizWitAH samyakkzemaM vindanti tatkzaRam । sa svargajittamo'smAkaM satyametadbravImi te ॥34॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tvameva prītimāṃstasmātkurūṇāṃ kurusattama । bhava rājā jaya svargaṃ sato rakṣāsato jahi ॥35॥
html:
tvameva prītimāṃstasmātkurūṇāṃ kurusattama ।
bhava rājā jaya svargaṃ sato rakṣāsato jahi ॥35॥
slp1: tvameva prItimAMstasmAtkurURAM kurusattama । Bava rAjA jaya svargaM sato rakzAsato jahi ॥35॥

text: anu tvā tāta jīvantu suhṛdaḥ sādhubhiḥ saha । parjanyamiva bhūtāni svādudrumamivāṇḍajāḥ ॥36॥
html:
anu tvā tāta jīvantu suhṛdaḥ sādhubhiḥ saha ।
parjanyamiva bhūtāni svādudrumamivāṇḍajāḥ ॥36॥
slp1: anu tvA tAta jIvantu suhfdaH sADuBiH saha । parjanyamiva BUtAni svAdudrumamivARqajAH ॥36॥

text: dhṛṣṭaṃ śūraṃ prahartāramanṛśaṃsaṃ jitendriyam । vatsalaṃ saṃvibhaktāramanu jīvantu tvāṃ janāḥ] ॥37॥
html:
dhṛṣṭaṃ śūraṃ prahartāramanṛśaṃsaṃ jitendriyam ।
vatsalaṃ saṃvibhaktāramanu jīvantu tvāṃ janāḥ] ॥37॥
slp1: DfzwaM SUraM prahartAramanfSaMsaM jitendriyam । vatsalaM saMviBaktAramanu jIvantu tvAM janAH] ॥37॥

text: svakarmaṇyapare yuktāstathaivānye vikarmaṇi । teṣāṃ viśeṣamācakṣva brāhmaṇānāṃ pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
svakarmaṇyapare yuktāstathaivānye vikarmaṇi ।
teṣāṃ viśeṣamācakṣva brāhmaṇānāṃ pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: svakarmaRyapare yuktAstaTEvAnye vikarmaRi । tezAM viSezamAcakzva brAhmaRAnAM pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: vidyālakṣaṇasampannāḥ sarvatrāmnāyadarśinaḥ । ete brahmasamā rājanbrāhmaṇāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ॥2॥
html:
vidyālakṣaṇasampannāḥ sarvatrāmnāyadarśinaḥ ।
ete brahmasamā rājanbrāhmaṇāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: vidyAlakzaRasampannAH sarvatrAmnAyadarSinaH । ete brahmasamA rAjanbrAhmaRAH parikIrtitAH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ṛtvigācāryasampannāḥ sveṣu karmasvavasthitāḥ । ete devasamā rājanbrāhmaṇānāṃ bhavantyuta ॥3॥
html:
ṛtvigācāryasampannāḥ sveṣu karmasvavasthitāḥ ।
ete devasamā rājanbrāhmaṇānāṃ bhavantyuta ॥3॥
slp1: ftvigAcAryasampannAH svezu karmasvavasTitAH । ete devasamA rAjanbrAhmaRAnAM Bavantyuta ॥3॥

text: ṛtvikpurohito mantrī dūto'thārthānuśāsakaḥ । ete kṣatrasamā rājanbrāhmaṇānāṃ bhavantyuta ॥4॥
html:
ṛtvikpurohito mantrī dūto'thārthānuśāsakaḥ ।
ete kṣatrasamā rājanbrāhmaṇānāṃ bhavantyuta ॥4॥
slp1: ftvikpurohito mantrI dUto'TArTAnuSAsakaH । ete kzatrasamA rAjanbrAhmaRAnAM Bavantyuta ॥4॥

text: aśvārohā gajārohā rathino'tha padātayaḥ । ete vaiśyasamā rājanbrāhmaṇānāṃ bhavantyuta ॥5॥
html:
aśvārohā gajārohā rathino'tha padātayaḥ ।
ete vaiśyasamā rājanbrāhmaṇānāṃ bhavantyuta ॥5॥
slp1: aSvArohA gajArohA raTino'Ta padAtayaH । ete vESyasamA rAjanbrAhmaRAnAM Bavantyuta ॥5॥

text: janmakarmavihīnā ye kadaryā brahmabandhavaḥ । ete śūdrasamā rājanbrāhmaṇānāṃ bhavantyuta ॥6॥
html:
janmakarmavihīnā ye kadaryā brahmabandhavaḥ ।
ete śūdrasamā rājanbrāhmaṇānāṃ bhavantyuta ॥6॥
slp1: janmakarmavihInA ye kadaryA brahmabanDavaH । ete SUdrasamA rAjanbrAhmaRAnAM Bavantyuta ॥6॥

text: aśrotriyāḥ sarva eva sarve cānāhitāgnayaḥ । tānsarvāndhārmiko rājā baliṃ viṣṭiṃ ca kārayet ॥7॥
html:
aśrotriyāḥ sarva eva sarve cānāhitāgnayaḥ ।
tānsarvāndhārmiko rājā baliṃ viṣṭiṃ ca kārayet ॥7॥
slp1: aSrotriyAH sarva eva sarve cAnAhitAgnayaH । tAnsarvAnDArmiko rAjA baliM vizwiM ca kArayet ॥7॥

text: āhvāyakā devalakā nakṣatragrāmayājakāḥ । ete brāhmaṇacaṇḍālā mahāpathikapañcamāḥ ॥8॥
html:
āhvāyakā devalakā nakṣatragrāmayājakāḥ ।
ete brāhmaṇacaṇḍālā mahāpathikapañcamāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: AhvAyakA devalakA nakzatragrAmayAjakAH । ete brAhmaRacaRqAlA mahApaTikapaYcamAH ॥8॥

text: etebhyo balimādadyāddhīnakośo mahīpatiḥ । ṛte brahmasamebhyaśca devakalpebhya eva ca ॥9॥
html:
etebhyo balimādadyāddhīnakośo mahīpatiḥ ।
ṛte brahmasamebhyaśca devakalpebhya eva ca ॥9॥
slp1: eteByo balimAdadyAdDInakoSo mahIpatiH । fte brahmasameByaSca devakalpeBya eva ca ॥9॥

text: abrāhmaṇānāṃ vittasya svāmī rājeti vaidikam । brāhmaṇānāṃ ca ye kecidvikarmasthā bhavantyuta ॥10॥
html:
abrāhmaṇānāṃ vittasya svāmī rājeti vaidikam ।
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca ye kecidvikarmasthā bhavantyuta ॥10॥
slp1: abrAhmaRAnAM vittasya svAmI rAjeti vEdikam । brAhmaRAnAM ca ye kecidvikarmasTA Bavantyuta ॥10॥

text: vikarmasthāstu nopekṣyā jātu rājñā kathañcana । niyamyāḥ saṃvibhajyāśca dharmānugrahakāmyayā ॥11॥
html:
vikarmasthāstu nopekṣyā jātu rājñā kathañcana ।
niyamyāḥ saṃvibhajyāśca dharmānugrahakāmyayā ॥11॥
slp1: vikarmasTAstu nopekzyA jAtu rAjYA kaTaYcana । niyamyAH saMviBajyASca DarmAnugrahakAmyayA ॥11॥

text: yasya sma viṣaye rājñaḥ steno bhavati vai dvijaḥ । rājña evāparādhaṃ taṃ manyante tadvido janāḥ ॥12॥
html:
yasya sma viṣaye rājñaḥ steno bhavati vai dvijaḥ ।
rājña evāparādhaṃ taṃ manyante tadvido janāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: yasya sma vizaye rAjYaH steno Bavati vE dvijaH । rAjYa evAparADaM taM manyante tadvido janAH ॥12॥

text: avṛttyā yo bhavetsteno vedavitsnātakastathā । rājansa rājñā bhartavya iti dharmavido viduḥ ॥13॥
html:
avṛttyā yo bhavetsteno vedavitsnātakastathā ।
rājansa rājñā bhartavya iti dharmavido viduḥ ॥13॥
slp1: avfttyA yo Bavetsteno vedavitsnAtakastaTA । rAjansa rAjYA Bartavya iti Darmavido viduH ॥13॥

text: sa cenno parivarteta kṛtavṛttiḥ parantapa । tato nirvāsanīyaḥ syāttasmāddeśātsabāndhavaḥ] ॥14॥
html:
sa cenno parivarteta kṛtavṛttiḥ parantapa ।
tato nirvāsanīyaḥ syāttasmāddeśātsabāndhavaḥ] ॥14॥
slp1: sa cenno parivarteta kftavfttiH parantapa । tato nirvAsanIyaH syAttasmAddeSAtsabAnDavaH] ॥14॥

text: keṣāṃ rājā prabhavati vittasya bharatarṣabha । kayā ca vṛttyā varteta tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
keṣāṃ rājā prabhavati vittasya bharatarṣabha ।
kayā ca vṛttyā varteta tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: kezAM rAjA praBavati vittasya BaratarzaBa । kayA ca vfttyA varteta tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: abrāhmaṇānāṃ vittasya svāmī rājeti vaidikam । brāhmaṇānāṃ ca ye kecidvikarmasthā bhavantyuta ॥2॥
html:
abrāhmaṇānāṃ vittasya svāmī rājeti vaidikam ।
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca ye kecidvikarmasthā bhavantyuta ॥2॥
slp1: abrAhmaRAnAM vittasya svAmI rAjeti vEdikam । brAhmaRAnAM ca ye kecidvikarmasTA Bavantyuta ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: vikarmasthāśca nopekṣyā viprā rājñā kathañcana । iti rājñāṃ purāvṛttamabhijalpanti sādhavaḥ ॥3॥
html:
vikarmasthāśca nopekṣyā viprā rājñā kathañcana ।
iti rājñāṃ purāvṛttamabhijalpanti sādhavaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: vikarmasTASca nopekzyA viprA rAjYA kaTaYcana । iti rAjYAM purAvfttamaBijalpanti sADavaH ॥3॥

text: yasya sma viṣaye rājñaḥ steno bhavati vai dvijaḥ । rājña evāparādhaṃ taṃ manyante kilbiṣaṃ nṛpa ॥4॥
html:
yasya sma viṣaye rājñaḥ steno bhavati vai dvijaḥ ।
rājña evāparādhaṃ taṃ manyante kilbiṣaṃ nṛpa ॥4॥
slp1: yasya sma vizaye rAjYaH steno Bavati vE dvijaH । rAjYa evAparADaM taM manyante kilbizaM nfpa ॥4॥

text: abhiśastamivātmānaṃ manyante tena karmaṇā । tasmādrājarṣayaḥ sarve brāhmaṇānanvapālayan ॥5॥
html:
abhiśastamivātmānaṃ manyante tena karmaṇā ।
tasmādrājarṣayaḥ sarve brāhmaṇānanvapālayan ॥5॥
slp1: aBiSastamivAtmAnaM manyante tena karmaRA । tasmAdrAjarzayaH sarve brAhmaRAnanvapAlayan ॥5॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । gītaṃ kekayarājena hriyamāṇena rakṣasā ॥6॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
gītaṃ kekayarājena hriyamāṇena rakṣasā ॥6॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । gItaM kekayarAjena hriyamARena rakzasA ॥6॥

text: kekayānāmadhipatiṃ rakṣo jagrāha dāruṇam । svādhyāyenānvitaṃ rājannaraṇye saṃśitavratam ॥7॥
html:
kekayānāmadhipatiṃ rakṣo jagrāha dāruṇam ।
svādhyāyenānvitaṃ rājannaraṇye saṃśitavratam ॥7॥
slp1: kekayAnAmaDipatiM rakzo jagrAha dAruRam । svADyAyenAnvitaM rAjannaraRye saMSitavratam ॥7॥

text: na me steno janapade na kadaryo na madyapaḥ । nānāhitāgnirnāyajvā māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥8॥
html:
na me steno janapade na kadaryo na madyapaḥ ।
nānāhitāgnirnāyajvā māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: na me steno janapade na kadaryo na madyapaH । nAnAhitAgnirnAyajvA mAmakAntaramAviSaH ॥8॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: na ca me brāhmaṇo'vidvānnāvratī nāpyasomapaḥ । nānāhitāgnirviṣaye māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥9॥
html:
na ca me brāhmaṇo'vidvānnāvratī nāpyasomapaḥ ।
nānāhitāgnirviṣaye māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: na ca me brAhmaRo'vidvAnnAvratI nApyasomapaH । nAnAhitAgnirvizaye mAmakAntaramAviSaH ॥9॥

text: nānāptadakṣiṇairyajñairyajante viṣaye mama । adhīte nāvratī kaścinmāmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥10॥
html:
nānāptadakṣiṇairyajñairyajante viṣaye mama ।
adhīte nāvratī kaścinmāmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: nAnAptadakziREryajYEryajante vizaye mama । aDIte nAvratI kaScinmAmakAntaramAviSaH ॥10॥

text: adhīyate'dhyāpayanti yajante yājayanti ca । dadati pratigṛhṇanti ṣaṭsu karmasvavasthitāḥ ॥11॥
html:
adhīyate'dhyāpayanti yajante yājayanti ca ।
dadati pratigṛhṇanti ṣaṭsu karmasvavasthitāḥ ॥11॥
slp1: aDIyate'DyApayanti yajante yAjayanti ca । dadati pratigfhRanti zawsu karmasvavasTitAH ॥11॥

text: pūjitāḥ saṃvibhaktāśca mṛdavaḥ satyavādinaḥ । brāhmaṇā me svakarmasthā māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥12॥
html:
pūjitāḥ saṃvibhaktāśca mṛdavaḥ satyavādinaḥ ।
brāhmaṇā me svakarmasthā māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: pUjitAH saMviBaktASca mfdavaH satyavAdinaH । brAhmaRA me svakarmasTA mAmakAntaramAviSaH ॥12॥

text: na yācante prayacchanti satyadharmaviśāradāḥ । nādhyāpayantyadhīyante yajante na ca yājakāḥ ॥13॥
html:
na yācante prayacchanti satyadharmaviśāradāḥ ।
nādhyāpayantyadhīyante yajante na ca yājakāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: na yAcante prayacCanti satyaDarmaviSAradAH । nADyApayantyaDIyante yajante na ca yAjakAH ॥13॥

text: brāhmaṇānparirakṣanti saṅgrāmeṣvapalāyinaḥ । kṣatriyā me svakarmasthā māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥14॥
html:
brāhmaṇānparirakṣanti saṅgrāmeṣvapalāyinaḥ ।
kṣatriyā me svakarmasthā māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: brAhmaRAnparirakzanti saNgrAmezvapalAyinaH । kzatriyA me svakarmasTA mAmakAntaramAviSaH ॥14॥

text: kṛṣigorakṣavāṇijyamupajīvantyamāyayā । apramattāḥ kriyāvantaḥ suvratāḥ satyavādinaḥ ॥15॥
html:
kṛṣigorakṣavāṇijyamupajīvantyamāyayā ।
apramattāḥ kriyāvantaḥ suvratāḥ satyavādinaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: kfzigorakzavARijyamupajIvantyamAyayA । apramattAH kriyAvantaH suvratAH satyavAdinaH ॥15॥

text: saṃvibhāgaṃ damaṃ śaucaṃ sauhṛdaṃ ca vyapāśritāḥ । mama vaiśyāḥ svakarmasthā māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥16॥
html:
saṃvibhāgaṃ damaṃ śaucaṃ sauhṛdaṃ ca vyapāśritāḥ ।
mama vaiśyāḥ svakarmasthā māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: saMviBAgaM damaM SOcaM sOhfdaM ca vyapASritAH । mama vESyAH svakarmasTA mAmakAntaramAviSaH ॥16॥

text: trīnvarṇānanutiṣṭhanti yathāvadanasūyakāḥ । mama śūdrāḥ svakarmasthā māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥17॥
html:
trīnvarṇānanutiṣṭhanti yathāvadanasūyakāḥ ।
mama śūdrāḥ svakarmasthā māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: trInvarRAnanutizWanti yaTAvadanasUyakAH । mama SUdrAH svakarmasTA mAmakAntaramAviSaH ॥17॥

text: kṛpaṇānāthavṛddhānāṃ durbalāturayoṣitām । saṃvibhaktāsmi sarveṣāṃ māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥18॥
html:
kṛpaṇānāthavṛddhānāṃ durbalāturayoṣitām ।
saṃvibhaktāsmi sarveṣāṃ māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: kfpaRAnATavfdDAnAM durbalAturayozitAm । saMviBaktAsmi sarvezAM mAmakAntaramAviSaH ॥18॥

text: kuladeśādidharmāṇāṃ prathitānāṃ yathāvidhi । avyucchettāsmi sarveṣāṃ māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥19॥
html:
kuladeśādidharmāṇāṃ prathitānāṃ yathāvidhi ।
avyucchettāsmi sarveṣāṃ māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: kuladeSAdiDarmARAM praTitAnAM yaTAviDi । avyucCettAsmi sarvezAM mAmakAntaramAviSaH ॥19॥

text: tapasvino me viṣaye pūjitāḥ paripālitāḥ । saṃvibhaktāśca satkṛtya māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥20॥
html:
tapasvino me viṣaye pūjitāḥ paripālitāḥ ।
saṃvibhaktāśca satkṛtya māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: tapasvino me vizaye pUjitAH paripAlitAH । saMviBaktASca satkftya mAmakAntaramAviSaH ॥20॥

text: nāsaṃvibhajya bhoktāsmi na viśāmi parastriyam । svatantro jātu na krīḍe māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥21॥
html:
nāsaṃvibhajya bhoktāsmi na viśāmi parastriyam ।
svatantro jātu na krīḍe māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: nAsaMviBajya BoktAsmi na viSAmi parastriyam । svatantro jAtu na krIqe mAmakAntaramAviSaH ॥21॥

text: nābrahmacārī bhikṣāvānbhikṣurvābrahmacārikaḥ । anṛtvijaṃ hutaṃ nāsti māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥22॥
html:
nābrahmacārī bhikṣāvānbhikṣurvābrahmacārikaḥ ।
anṛtvijaṃ hutaṃ nāsti māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: nAbrahmacArI BikzAvAnBikzurvAbrahmacArikaH । anftvijaM hutaM nAsti mAmakAntaramAviSaH ॥22॥

text: nāvajānāmyahaṃ vṛddhānna vaidyānna tapasvinaḥ । rāṣṭre svapati jāgarmi māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥23॥
html:
nāvajānāmyahaṃ vṛddhānna vaidyānna tapasvinaḥ ।
rāṣṭre svapati jāgarmi māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: nAvajAnAmyahaM vfdDAnna vEdyAnna tapasvinaH । rAzwre svapati jAgarmi mAmakAntaramAviSaH ॥23॥

text: vedādhyayanasampannastapasvī sarvadharmavit । svāmī sarvasya rājyasya śrīmānmama purohitaḥ ॥24॥
html:
vedādhyayanasampannastapasvī sarvadharmavit ।
svāmī sarvasya rājyasya śrīmānmama purohitaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: vedADyayanasampannastapasvI sarvaDarmavit । svAmI sarvasya rAjyasya SrImAnmama purohitaH ॥24॥

text: dānena divyānabhivāñchāmi lokānsatyenātho brāhmaṇānāṃ ca guptyā । śuśrūṣayā cāpi gurūnupaimi na me bhayaṃ vidyate rākṣasebhyaḥ ॥25॥
html:
dānena divyānabhivāñchāmi lokānsatyenātho brāhmaṇānāṃ ca guptyā ।
śuśrūṣayā cāpi gurūnupaimi na me bhayaṃ vidyate rākṣasebhyaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: dAnena divyAnaBivAYCAmi lokAnsatyenATo brAhmaRAnAM ca guptyA । SuSrUzayA cApi gurUnupEmi na me BayaM vidyate rAkzaseByaH ॥25॥

text: na me rāṣṭre vidhavā brahmabandhurna brāhmaṇaḥ kṛpaṇo nota coraḥ । na pārajāyī na ca pāpakarmā na me bhayaṃ vidyate rākṣasebhyaḥ ॥26॥
html:
na me rāṣṭre vidhavā brahmabandhurna brāhmaṇaḥ kṛpaṇo nota coraḥ ।
na pārajāyī na ca pāpakarmā na me bhayaṃ vidyate rākṣasebhyaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: na me rAzwre viDavA brahmabanDurna brAhmaRaH kfpaRo nota coraH । na pArajAyI na ca pApakarmA na me BayaM vidyate rAkzaseByaH ॥26॥

text: na me śastrairanirbhinnamaṅge dvyaṅgulamantaram । dharmārthaṃ yudhyamānasya māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥27॥
html:
na me śastrairanirbhinnamaṅge dvyaṅgulamantaram ।
dharmārthaṃ yudhyamānasya māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: na me SastrEranirBinnamaNge dvyaNgulamantaram । DarmArTaM yuDyamAnasya mAmakAntaramAviSaH ॥27॥

text: gobrāhmaṇe ca yajñe ca nityaṃ svastyayanaṃ mama । āśāsate janā rāṣṭre māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥28॥
html:
gobrāhmaṇe ca yajñe ca nityaṃ svastyayanaṃ mama ।
āśāsate janā rāṣṭre māmakāntaramāviśaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: gobrAhmaRe ca yajYe ca nityaM svastyayanaM mama । ASAsate janA rAzwre mAmakAntaramAviSaH ॥28॥

text: yasmātsarvāsvavasthāsu dharmamevānvavekṣase । tasmātprāpnuhi kaikeya gṛhānsvasti vrajāmyaham ॥29॥
html:
yasmātsarvāsvavasthāsu dharmamevānvavekṣase ।
tasmātprāpnuhi kaikeya gṛhānsvasti vrajāmyaham ॥29॥
slp1: yasmAtsarvAsvavasTAsu DarmamevAnvavekzase । tasmAtprApnuhi kEkeya gfhAnsvasti vrajAmyaham ॥29॥
author: rākṣasa uvāca ।

text: yeṣāṃ gobrāhmaṇā rakṣyāḥ prajā rakṣyāśca kekaya । na rakṣobhyo bhayaṃ teṣāṃ kuta eva tu mānuṣāt ॥30॥
html:
yeṣāṃ gobrāhmaṇā rakṣyāḥ prajā rakṣyāśca kekaya ।
na rakṣobhyo bhayaṃ teṣāṃ kuta eva tu mānuṣāt ॥30॥
slp1: yezAM gobrAhmaRA rakzyAH prajA rakzyASca kekaya । na rakzoByo BayaM tezAM kuta eva tu mAnuzAt ॥30॥

text: yeṣāṃ purogamā viprā yeṣāṃ brahmabalaṃ balam । priyātithyāstathā dārāste vai svargajito narāḥ ॥31॥
html:
yeṣāṃ purogamā viprā yeṣāṃ brahmabalaṃ balam ।
priyātithyāstathā dārāste vai svargajito narāḥ ॥31॥
slp1: yezAM purogamA viprA yezAM brahmabalaM balam । priyAtiTyAstaTA dArAste vE svargajito narAH ॥31॥

text: tasmāddvijātīnrakṣeta te hi rakṣanti rakṣitāḥ । āśīreṣāṃ bhavedrājñāṃ rāṣṭraṃ samyakpravardhate ॥32॥
html:
tasmāddvijātīnrakṣeta te hi rakṣanti rakṣitāḥ ।
āśīreṣāṃ bhavedrājñāṃ rāṣṭraṃ samyakpravardhate ॥32॥
slp1: tasmAddvijAtInrakzeta te hi rakzanti rakzitAH । ASIrezAM BavedrAjYAM rAzwraM samyakpravarDate ॥32॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tasmādrājñā viśeṣeṇa vikarmasthā dvijātayaḥ । niyamyāḥ saṃvibhajyāśca prajānugrahakāraṇāt ॥33॥
html:
tasmādrājñā viśeṣeṇa vikarmasthā dvijātayaḥ ।
niyamyāḥ saṃvibhajyāśca prajānugrahakāraṇāt ॥33॥
slp1: tasmAdrAjYA viSezeRa vikarmasTA dvijAtayaH । niyamyAH saMviBajyASca prajAnugrahakAraRAt ॥33॥

text: ya evaṃ vartate rājā paurajānapadeṣviha । anubhūyeha bhadrāṇi prāpnotīndrasalokatām] ॥34॥
html:
ya evaṃ vartate rājā paurajānapadeṣviha ।
anubhūyeha bhadrāṇi prāpnotīndrasalokatām] ॥34॥
slp1: ya evaM vartate rAjA pOrajAnapadezviha । anuBUyeha BadrARi prApnotIndrasalokatAm] ॥34॥

text: vyākhyātā kṣatradharmeṇa vṛttirāpatsu bhārata । kathañcidvaiśyadharmeṇa jīvedvā brāhmaṇo na vā ॥1॥
html:
vyākhyātā kṣatradharmeṇa vṛttirāpatsu bhārata ।
kathañcidvaiśyadharmeṇa jīvedvā brāhmaṇo na vā ॥1॥
slp1: vyAKyAtA kzatraDarmeRa vfttirApatsu BArata । kaTaYcidvESyaDarmeRa jIvedvA brAhmaRo na vA ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: aśaktaḥ kṣatradharmeṇa vaiśyadharmeṇa vartayet । kṛṣigorakṣamāsthāya vyasane vṛttisaṅkṣaye ॥2॥
html:
aśaktaḥ kṣatradharmeṇa vaiśyadharmeṇa vartayet ।
kṛṣigorakṣamāsthāya vyasane vṛttisaṅkṣaye ॥2॥
slp1: aSaktaH kzatraDarmeRa vESyaDarmeRa vartayet । kfzigorakzamAsTAya vyasane vfttisaNkzaye ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kāni paṇyāni vikrīṇansvargalokānna hīyate । brāhmaṇo vaiśyadharmeṇa vartayanbharatarṣabha ॥3॥
html:
kāni paṇyāni vikrīṇansvargalokānna hīyate ।
brāhmaṇo vaiśyadharmeṇa vartayanbharatarṣabha ॥3॥
slp1: kAni paRyAni vikrIRansvargalokAnna hIyate । brAhmaRo vESyaDarmeRa vartayanBaratarzaBa ॥3॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: surā lavaṇamityeva tilānkesariṇaḥ paśūn । ṛṣabhānmadhu māṃsaṃ ca kṛtānnaṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥4॥
html:
surā lavaṇamityeva tilānkesariṇaḥ paśūn ।
ṛṣabhānmadhu māṃsaṃ ca kṛtānnaṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥4॥
slp1: surA lavaRamityeva tilAnkesariRaH paSUn । fzaBAnmaDu mAMsaM ca kftAnnaM ca yuDizWira ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sarvāsvavasthāsvetāni brāhmaṇaḥ parivarjayet । eteṣāṃ vikrayāttāta brāhmaṇo narakaṃ vrajet ॥5॥
html:
sarvāsvavasthāsvetāni brāhmaṇaḥ parivarjayet ।
eteṣāṃ vikrayāttāta brāhmaṇo narakaṃ vrajet ॥5॥
slp1: sarvAsvavasTAsvetAni brAhmaRaH parivarjayet । etezAM vikrayAttAta brAhmaRo narakaM vrajet ॥5॥

text: ajo'gnirvaruṇo meṣaḥ sūryo'śvaḥ pṛthivī virāṭ । dhenuryajñaśca somaśca na vikreyāḥ kathañcana ॥6॥
html:
ajo'gnirvaruṇo meṣaḥ sūryo'śvaḥ pṛthivī virāṭ ।
dhenuryajñaśca somaśca na vikreyāḥ kathañcana ॥6॥
slp1: ajo'gnirvaruRo mezaH sUryo'SvaH pfTivI virAw । DenuryajYaSca somaSca na vikreyAH kaTaYcana ॥6॥

text: pakvenāmasya nimayaṃ na praśaṃsanti sādhavaḥ । nimayetpakvamāmena bhojanārthāya bhārata ॥7॥
html:
pakvenāmasya nimayaṃ na praśaṃsanti sādhavaḥ ।
nimayetpakvamāmena bhojanārthāya bhārata ॥7॥
slp1: pakvenAmasya nimayaM na praSaMsanti sADavaH । nimayetpakvamAmena BojanArTAya BArata ॥7॥

text: vayaṃ siddhamaśiṣyāmo bhavānsādhayatāmidam । evaṃ samīkṣya nimayannādharmo'sti kadācana ॥8॥
html:
vayaṃ siddhamaśiṣyāmo bhavānsādhayatāmidam ।
evaṃ samīkṣya nimayannādharmo'sti kadācana ॥8॥
slp1: vayaM sidDamaSizyAmo BavAnsADayatAmidam । evaM samIkzya nimayannADarmo'sti kadAcana ॥8॥

text: atra te vartayiṣyāmi yathā dharmaḥ purātanaḥ । vyavahārapravṛttānāṃ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥9॥
html:
atra te vartayiṣyāmi yathā dharmaḥ purātanaḥ ।
vyavahārapravṛttānāṃ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥9॥
slp1: atra te vartayizyAmi yaTA DarmaH purAtanaH । vyavahArapravfttAnAM tanniboDa yuDizWira ॥9॥

text: bhavate'haṃ dadānīdaṃ bhavānetatprayacchatu । rucite vartate dharmo na balātsampravartate ॥10॥
html:
bhavate'haṃ dadānīdaṃ bhavānetatprayacchatu ।
rucite vartate dharmo na balātsampravartate ॥10॥
slp1: Bavate'haM dadAnIdaM BavAnetatprayacCatu । rucite vartate Darmo na balAtsampravartate ॥10॥

text: ityevaṃ sampravartanta vyavahārāḥ purātanāḥ । ṛṣīṇāmitareṣāṃ ca sādhu cedamasaṃśayam ॥11॥
html:
ityevaṃ sampravartanta vyavahārāḥ purātanāḥ ।
ṛṣīṇāmitareṣāṃ ca sādhu cedamasaṃśayam ॥11॥
slp1: ityevaM sampravartanta vyavahArAH purAtanAH । fzIRAmitarezAM ca sADu cedamasaMSayam ॥11॥

text: atha tāta yadā sarvāḥ śastramādadate prajāḥ । vyutkrāmanti svadharmebhyaḥ kṣatrasya kṣīyate balam ॥12॥
html:
atha tāta yadā sarvāḥ śastramādadate prajāḥ ।
vyutkrāmanti svadharmebhyaḥ kṣatrasya kṣīyate balam ॥12॥
slp1: aTa tAta yadA sarvAH SastramAdadate prajAH । vyutkrAmanti svaDarmeByaH kzatrasya kzIyate balam ॥12॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: rājā trātā na loke syātkiṃ tadā syātparāyaṇam । etanme saṃśayaṃ brūhi vistareṇa pitāmaha ॥13॥
html:
rājā trātā na loke syātkiṃ tadā syātparāyaṇam ।
etanme saṃśayaṃ brūhi vistareṇa pitāmaha ॥13॥
slp1: rAjA trAtA na loke syAtkiM tadA syAtparAyaRam । etanme saMSayaM brUhi vistareRa pitAmaha ॥13॥

text: dānena tapasā yajñairadroheṇa damena ca । brāhmaṇapramukhā varṇāḥ kṣemamiccheyurātmanaḥ ॥14॥
html:
dānena tapasā yajñairadroheṇa damena ca ।
brāhmaṇapramukhā varṇāḥ kṣemamiccheyurātmanaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: dAnena tapasA yajYEradroheRa damena ca । brAhmaRapramuKA varRAH kzemamicCeyurAtmanaH ॥14॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: teṣāṃ ye vedabalinasta utthāya samantataḥ । rājño balaṃ vardhayeyurmahendrasyeva devatāḥ ॥15॥
html:
teṣāṃ ye vedabalinasta utthāya samantataḥ ।
rājño balaṃ vardhayeyurmahendrasyeva devatāḥ ॥15॥
slp1: tezAM ye vedabalinasta utTAya samantataH । rAjYo balaM varDayeyurmahendrasyeva devatAH ॥15॥

text: rājño hi kṣīyamāṇasya brahmaivāhuḥ parāyaṇam । tasmādbrahmabalenaiva samuttheyaṃ vijānatā ॥16॥
html:
rājño hi kṣīyamāṇasya brahmaivāhuḥ parāyaṇam ।
tasmādbrahmabalenaiva samuttheyaṃ vijānatā ॥16॥
slp1: rAjYo hi kzIyamARasya brahmEvAhuH parAyaRam । tasmAdbrahmabalenEva samutTeyaM vijAnatA ॥16॥

text: yadā tu vijayī rājā kṣemaṃ rāṣṭre'bhisandadhet । tadā varṇā yathādharmamāviśeyuḥ svakarmasu ॥17॥
html:
yadā tu vijayī rājā kṣemaṃ rāṣṭre'bhisandadhet ।
tadā varṇā yathādharmamāviśeyuḥ svakarmasu ॥17॥
slp1: yadA tu vijayI rAjA kzemaM rAzwre'BisandaDet । tadA varRA yaTADarmamAviSeyuH svakarmasu ॥17॥

text: unmaryāde pravṛtte tu dasyubhiḥ saṅkare kṛte । sarve varṇā na duṣyeyuḥ śastravanto yudhiṣṭhira ॥18॥
html:
unmaryāde pravṛtte tu dasyubhiḥ saṅkare kṛte ।
sarve varṇā na duṣyeyuḥ śastravanto yudhiṣṭhira ॥18॥
slp1: unmaryAde pravftte tu dasyuBiH saNkare kfte । sarve varRA na duzyeyuH Sastravanto yuDizWira ॥18॥

text: atha cetsarvataḥ kṣatraṃ praduṣyedbrāhmaṇānprati । kastasya brāhmaṇastrātā ko dharmaḥ kiṃ parāyaṇam ॥19॥
html:
atha cetsarvataḥ kṣatraṃ praduṣyedbrāhmaṇānprati ।
kastasya brāhmaṇastrātā ko dharmaḥ kiṃ parāyaṇam ॥19॥
slp1: aTa cetsarvataH kzatraM praduzyedbrAhmaRAnprati । kastasya brAhmaRastrAtA ko DarmaH kiM parAyaRam ॥19॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: tapasā brahmacaryeṇa śastreṇa ca balena ca । amāyayā māyayā ca niyantavyaṃ tadā bhavet ॥20॥
html:
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa śastreṇa ca balena ca ।
amāyayā māyayā ca niyantavyaṃ tadā bhavet ॥20॥
slp1: tapasA brahmacaryeRa SastreRa ca balena ca । amAyayA mAyayA ca niyantavyaM tadA Bavet ॥20॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kṣatrasyābhipravṛddhasya brāhmaṇeṣu viśeṣataḥ । brahmaiva sanniyantṛ syātkṣatraṃ hi brahmasambhavam ॥21॥
html:
kṣatrasyābhipravṛddhasya brāhmaṇeṣu viśeṣataḥ ।
brahmaiva sanniyantṛ syātkṣatraṃ hi brahmasambhavam ॥21॥
slp1: kzatrasyABipravfdDasya brAhmaRezu viSezataH । brahmEva sanniyantf syAtkzatraM hi brahmasamBavam ॥21॥

text: adbhyo'gnirbrahmataḥ kṣatramaśmano lohamutthitam । teṣāṃ sarvatragaṃ tejaḥ svāsu yoniṣu śāmyati ॥22॥
html:
adbhyo'gnirbrahmataḥ kṣatramaśmano lohamutthitam ।
teṣāṃ sarvatragaṃ tejaḥ svāsu yoniṣu śāmyati ॥22॥
slp1: adByo'gnirbrahmataH kzatramaSmano lohamutTitam । tezAM sarvatragaM tejaH svAsu yonizu SAmyati ॥22॥

text: yadā chinattyayo'śmānamagniścāpo'bhipadyate । kṣatraṃ ca brāhmaṇaṃ dveṣṭi tadā śāmyanti te trayaḥ ॥23॥
html:
yadā chinattyayo'śmānamagniścāpo'bhipadyate ।
kṣatraṃ ca brāhmaṇaṃ dveṣṭi tadā śāmyanti te trayaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: yadA Cinattyayo'SmAnamagniScApo'Bipadyate । kzatraM ca brAhmaRaM dvezwi tadA SAmyanti te trayaH ॥23॥

text: tasmādbrahmaṇi śāmyanti kṣatriyāṇāṃ yudhiṣṭhira । samudīrṇānyajeyāni tejāṃsi ca balāni ca ॥24॥
html:
tasmādbrahmaṇi śāmyanti kṣatriyāṇāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
samudīrṇānyajeyāni tejāṃsi ca balāni ca ॥24॥
slp1: tasmAdbrahmaRi SAmyanti kzatriyARAM yuDizWira । samudIrRAnyajeyAni tejAMsi ca balAni ca ॥24॥

text: brahmavīrye mṛdūbhūte kṣatravīrye ca durbale । duṣṭeṣu sarvavarṇeṣu brāhmaṇānprati sarvaśaḥ ॥25॥
html:
brahmavīrye mṛdūbhūte kṣatravīrye ca durbale ।
duṣṭeṣu sarvavarṇeṣu brāhmaṇānprati sarvaśaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: brahmavIrye mfdUBUte kzatravIrye ca durbale । duzwezu sarvavarRezu brAhmaRAnprati sarvaSaH ॥25॥

text: ye tatra yuddhaṃ kurvanti tyaktvā jīvitamātmanaḥ । brāhmaṇānparirakṣanto dharmamātmānameva ca ॥26॥
html:
ye tatra yuddhaṃ kurvanti tyaktvā jīvitamātmanaḥ ।
brāhmaṇānparirakṣanto dharmamātmānameva ca ॥26॥
slp1: ye tatra yudDaM kurvanti tyaktvA jIvitamAtmanaH । brAhmaRAnparirakzanto DarmamAtmAnameva ca ॥26॥

text: manasvino manyumantaḥ puṇyalokā bhavanti te । brāhmaṇārthaṃ hi sarveṣāṃ śastragrahaṇamiṣyate ॥27॥
html:
manasvino manyumantaḥ puṇyalokā bhavanti te ।
brāhmaṇārthaṃ hi sarveṣāṃ śastragrahaṇamiṣyate ॥27॥
slp1: manasvino manyumantaH puRyalokA Bavanti te । brAhmaRArTaM hi sarvezAM SastragrahaRamizyate ॥27॥

text: ati sviṣṭasvadhītānāṃ lokānati tapasvinām । anāśakāgnyorviśatāṃ śūrā yānti parāṃ gatim । evamevātmanastyāgānnānyaṃ dharmaṃ vidurjanāḥ ॥28॥
html:
ati sviṣṭasvadhītānāṃ lokānati tapasvinām ।
anāśakāgnyorviśatāṃ śūrā yānti parāṃ gatim ।
evamevātmanastyāgānnānyaṃ dharmaṃ vidurjanāḥ ॥28॥
slp1: ati svizwasvaDItAnAM lokAnati tapasvinAm । anASakAgnyorviSatAM SUrA yAnti parAM gatim । evamevAtmanastyAgAnnAnyaM DarmaM vidurjanAH ॥28॥

text: tebhyo namaśca bhadraṃ ca ye śarīrāṇi juhvati । brahmadviṣo niyacchantasteṣāṃ no'stu salokatā । brahmalokajitaḥ svargyānvīrāṃstānmanurabravīt ॥29॥
html:
tebhyo namaśca bhadraṃ ca ye śarīrāṇi juhvati ।
brahmadviṣo niyacchantasteṣāṃ no'stu salokatā ।
brahmalokajitaḥ svargyānvīrāṃstānmanurabravīt ॥29॥
slp1: teByo namaSca BadraM ca ye SarIrARi juhvati । brahmadvizo niyacCantastezAM no'stu salokatA । brahmalokajitaH svargyAnvIrAMstAnmanurabravIt ॥29॥

text: yathāśvamedhāvabhṛthe snātāḥ pūtā bhavantyuta । duṣkṛtaḥ sukṛtaścaiva tathā śastrahatā raṇe ॥30॥
html:
yathāśvamedhāvabhṛthe snātāḥ pūtā bhavantyuta ।
duṣkṛtaḥ sukṛtaścaiva tathā śastrahatā raṇe ॥30॥
slp1: yaTASvameDAvaBfTe snAtAH pUtA Bavantyuta । duzkftaH sukftaScEva taTA SastrahatA raRe ॥30॥

text: bhavatyadharmo dharmo hi dharmādharmāvubhāvapi । kāraṇāddeśakālasya deśakālaḥ sa tādṛśaḥ ॥31॥
html:
bhavatyadharmo dharmo hi dharmādharmāvubhāvapi ।
kāraṇāddeśakālasya deśakālaḥ sa tādṛśaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: BavatyaDarmo Darmo hi DarmADarmAvuBAvapi । kAraRAddeSakAlasya deSakAlaH sa tAdfSaH ॥31॥

text: maitrāḥ krūrāṇi kurvanto jayanti svargamuttamam । dharmyāḥ pāpāni kurvanto gacchanti paramāṃ gatim ॥32॥
html:
maitrāḥ krūrāṇi kurvanto jayanti svargamuttamam ।
dharmyāḥ pāpāni kurvanto gacchanti paramāṃ gatim ॥32॥
slp1: mEtrAH krUrARi kurvanto jayanti svargamuttamam । DarmyAH pApAni kurvanto gacCanti paramAM gatim ॥32॥

text: brāhmaṇastriṣu kāleṣu śastraṃ gṛhṇanna duṣyati । ātmatrāṇe varṇadoṣe durgasya niyameṣu ca ॥33॥
html:
brāhmaṇastriṣu kāleṣu śastraṃ gṛhṇanna duṣyati ।
ātmatrāṇe varṇadoṣe durgasya niyameṣu ca ॥33॥
slp1: brAhmaRastrizu kAlezu SastraM gfhRanna duzyati । AtmatrARe varRadoze durgasya niyamezu ca ॥33॥

text: abhyutthite dasyubale kṣatrārthe varṇasaṅkare । sampramūḍheṣu varṇeṣu yadyanyo'bhibhavedbalī ॥34॥
html:
abhyutthite dasyubale kṣatrārthe varṇasaṅkare ।
sampramūḍheṣu varṇeṣu yadyanyo'bhibhavedbalī ॥34॥
slp1: aByutTite dasyubale kzatrArTe varRasaNkare । sampramUQezu varRezu yadyanyo'BiBavedbalI ॥34॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: brāhmaṇo yadi vā vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā rājasattama । dasyubhyo'tha prajā rakṣeddaṇḍaṃ dharmeṇa dhārayan ॥35॥
html:
brāhmaṇo yadi vā vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā rājasattama ।
dasyubhyo'tha prajā rakṣeddaṇḍaṃ dharmeṇa dhārayan ॥35॥
slp1: brAhmaRo yadi vA vESyaH SUdro vA rAjasattama । dasyuByo'Ta prajA rakzeddaRqaM DarmeRa DArayan ॥35॥

text: kāryaṃ kuryānna vā kuryātsaṃvāryo vā bhavenna vā । na sma śastraṃ grahītavyamanyatra kṣatrabandhutaḥ ॥36॥
html:
kāryaṃ kuryānna vā kuryātsaṃvāryo vā bhavenna vā ।
na sma śastraṃ grahītavyamanyatra kṣatrabandhutaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: kAryaM kuryAnna vA kuryAtsaMvAryo vA Bavenna vA । na sma SastraM grahItavyamanyatra kzatrabanDutaH ॥36॥

text: apāre yo bhavetpāramaplave yaḥ plavo bhavet । śūdro vā yadi vāpyanyaḥ sarvathā mānamarhati ॥37॥
html:
apāre yo bhavetpāramaplave yaḥ plavo bhavet ।
śūdro vā yadi vāpyanyaḥ sarvathā mānamarhati ॥37॥
slp1: apAre yo BavetpAramaplave yaH plavo Bavet । SUdro vA yadi vApyanyaH sarvaTA mAnamarhati ॥37॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yamāśritya narā rājanvartayeyuryathāsukham । anāthāḥ pālyamānā vai dasyubhiḥ paripīḍitāḥ ॥38॥
html:
yamāśritya narā rājanvartayeyuryathāsukham ।
anāthāḥ pālyamānā vai dasyubhiḥ paripīḍitāḥ ॥38॥
slp1: yamASritya narA rAjanvartayeyuryaTAsuKam । anATAH pAlyamAnA vE dasyuBiH paripIqitAH ॥38॥

text: tameva pūjayeraṃste prītyā svamiva bāndhavam । mahaddhyabhīkṣṇaṃ kauravya kartā sanmānamarhati ॥39॥
html:
tameva pūjayeraṃste prītyā svamiva bāndhavam ।
mahaddhyabhīkṣṇaṃ kauravya kartā sanmānamarhati ॥39॥
slp1: tameva pUjayeraMste prItyA svamiva bAnDavam । mahadDyaBIkzRaM kOravya kartA sanmAnamarhati ॥39॥

text: kimukṣṇāvahatā kṛtyaṃ kiṃ dhenvā cāpyadugdhayā । vandhyayā bhāryayā ko'rthaḥ ko'rtho rājñāpyarakṣatā ॥40॥
html:
kimukṣṇāvahatā kṛtyaṃ kiṃ dhenvā cāpyadugdhayā ।
vandhyayā bhāryayā ko'rthaḥ ko'rtho rājñāpyarakṣatā ॥40॥
slp1: kimukzRAvahatA kftyaM kiM DenvA cApyadugDayA । vanDyayA BAryayA ko'rTaH ko'rTo rAjYApyarakzatA ॥40॥

text: yathā dārumayo hastī yathā carmamayo mṛgaḥ । yathā hyanetraḥ śakaṭaḥ pathi kṣetraṃ yathoṣaram ॥41॥
html:
yathā dārumayo hastī yathā carmamayo mṛgaḥ ।
yathā hyanetraḥ śakaṭaḥ pathi kṣetraṃ yathoṣaram ॥41॥
slp1: yaTA dArumayo hastI yaTA carmamayo mfgaH । yaTA hyanetraH SakawaH paTi kzetraM yaTozaram ॥41॥

text: evaṃ brahmānadhīyānaṃ rājā yaśca na rakṣitā । na varṣati ca yo meghaḥ sarva ete nirarthakāḥ ॥42॥
html:
evaṃ brahmānadhīyānaṃ rājā yaśca na rakṣitā ।
na varṣati ca yo meghaḥ sarva ete nirarthakāḥ ॥42॥
slp1: evaM brahmAnaDIyAnaM rAjA yaSca na rakzitA । na varzati ca yo meGaH sarva ete nirarTakAH ॥42॥

text: nityaṃ yastu sato rakṣedasataśca nibarhayet । sa eva rājā kartavyastena sarvamidaṃ dhṛtam] ॥43॥
html:
nityaṃ yastu sato rakṣedasataśca nibarhayet ।
sa eva rājā kartavyastena sarvamidaṃ dhṛtam] ॥43॥
slp1: nityaM yastu sato rakzedasataSca nibarhayet । sa eva rAjA kartavyastena sarvamidaM Dftam] ॥43॥

text: kvasamutthāḥ kathaṃśīlā ṛtvijaḥ syuḥ pitāmaha । kathaṃvidhāśca rājendra tadbrūhi vadatāṃ vara ॥1॥
html:
kvasamutthāḥ kathaṃśīlā ṛtvijaḥ syuḥ pitāmaha ।
kathaṃvidhāśca rājendra tadbrūhi vadatāṃ vara ॥1॥
slp1: kvasamutTAH kaTaMSIlA ftvijaH syuH pitAmaha । kaTaMviDASca rAjendra tadbrUhi vadatAM vara ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: pratikarma purācāra ṛtvijāṃ sma vidhīyate । ādau chandāṃsi vijñāya dvijānāṃ śrutameva ca ॥2॥
html:
pratikarma purācāra ṛtvijāṃ sma vidhīyate ।
ādau chandāṃsi vijñāya dvijānāṃ śrutameva ca ॥2॥
slp1: pratikarma purAcAra ftvijAM sma viDIyate । AdO CandAMsi vijYAya dvijAnAM Srutameva ca ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ye tvekaratayo nityaṃ dhīrā nāpriyavādinaḥ । parasparasya suhṛdaḥ sammatāḥ samadarśinaḥ ॥3॥
html:
ye tvekaratayo nityaṃ dhīrā nāpriyavādinaḥ ।
parasparasya suhṛdaḥ sammatāḥ samadarśinaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: ye tvekaratayo nityaM DIrA nApriyavAdinaH । parasparasya suhfdaH sammatAH samadarSinaH ॥3॥

text: yeṣvānṛśaṃsyaṃ satyaṃ cāpyahiṃsā tapa ārjavam । adroho nābhimānaśca hrīstitikṣā damaḥ śamaḥ ॥4॥
html:
yeṣvānṛśaṃsyaṃ satyaṃ cāpyahiṃsā tapa ārjavam ।
adroho nābhimānaśca hrīstitikṣā damaḥ śamaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: yezvAnfSaMsyaM satyaM cApyahiMsA tapa Arjavam । adroho nABimAnaSca hrIstitikzA damaH SamaH ॥4॥

text: hrīmānsatyadhṛtirdānto bhūtānāmavihiṃsakaḥ । akāmadveṣasaṃyuktastribhiḥ śuklaiḥ samanvitaḥ ॥5॥
html:
hrīmānsatyadhṛtirdānto bhūtānāmavihiṃsakaḥ ।
akāmadveṣasaṃyuktastribhiḥ śuklaiḥ samanvitaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: hrImAnsatyaDftirdAnto BUtAnAmavihiMsakaH । akAmadvezasaMyuktastriBiH SuklEH samanvitaH ॥5॥

text: ahiṃsako jñānatṛptaḥ sa brahmāsanamarhati । ete mahartvijastāta sarve mānyā yathātatham ॥6॥
html:
ahiṃsako jñānatṛptaḥ sa brahmāsanamarhati ।
ete mahartvijastāta sarve mānyā yathātatham ॥6॥
slp1: ahiMsako jYAnatfptaH sa brahmAsanamarhati । ete mahartvijastAta sarve mAnyA yaTAtaTam ॥6॥

text: yadidaṃ vedavacanaṃ dakṣiṇāsu vidhīyate । idaṃ deyamidaṃ deyaṃ na kvacidvyavatiṣṭhate ॥7॥
html:
yadidaṃ vedavacanaṃ dakṣiṇāsu vidhīyate ।
idaṃ deyamidaṃ deyaṃ na kvacidvyavatiṣṭhate ॥7॥
slp1: yadidaM vedavacanaM dakziRAsu viDIyate । idaM deyamidaM deyaM na kvacidvyavatizWate ॥7॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: nedaṃ prati dhanaṃ śāstramāpaddharmamaśāstrataḥ । ājñā śāstrasya ghoreyaṃ na śaktiṃ samavekṣate ॥8॥
html:
nedaṃ prati dhanaṃ śāstramāpaddharmamaśāstrataḥ ।
ājñā śāstrasya ghoreyaṃ na śaktiṃ samavekṣate ॥8॥
slp1: nedaM prati DanaM SAstramApadDarmamaSAstrataH । AjYA SAstrasya GoreyaM na SaktiM samavekzate ॥8॥

text: śraddhāmārabhya yaṣṭavyamityeṣā vaidikī śrutiḥ । mithyopetasya yajñasya kimu śraddhā kariṣyati ॥9॥
html:
śraddhāmārabhya yaṣṭavyamityeṣā vaidikī śrutiḥ ।
mithyopetasya yajñasya kimu śraddhā kariṣyati ॥9॥
slp1: SradDAmAraBya yazwavyamityezA vEdikI SrutiH । miTyopetasya yajYasya kimu SradDA karizyati ॥9॥

text: na vedānāṃ paribhavānna śāṭhyena na māyayā । kaścinmahadavāpnoti mā te bhūdbuddhirīdṛśī ॥10॥
html:
na vedānāṃ paribhavānna śāṭhyena na māyayā ।
kaścinmahadavāpnoti mā te bhūdbuddhirīdṛśī ॥10॥
slp1: na vedAnAM pariBavAnna SAWyena na mAyayA । kaScinmahadavApnoti mA te BUdbudDirIdfSI ॥10॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yajñāṅgaṃ dakṣiṇāstāta vedānāṃ paribṛṃhaṇam । na mantrā dakṣiṇāhīnāstārayanti kathañcana ॥11॥
html:
yajñāṅgaṃ dakṣiṇāstāta vedānāṃ paribṛṃhaṇam ।
na mantrā dakṣiṇāhīnāstārayanti kathañcana ॥11॥
slp1: yajYANgaM dakziRAstAta vedAnAM paribfMhaRam । na mantrA dakziRAhInAstArayanti kaTaYcana ॥11॥

text: śaktistu pūrṇapātreṇa sammitānavamā bhavet । avaśyaṃ tāta yaṣṭavyaṃ tribhirvarṇairyathāvidhi ॥12॥
html:
śaktistu pūrṇapātreṇa sammitānavamā bhavet ।
avaśyaṃ tāta yaṣṭavyaṃ tribhirvarṇairyathāvidhi ॥12॥
slp1: Saktistu pUrRapAtreRa sammitAnavamA Bavet । avaSyaM tAta yazwavyaM triBirvarREryaTAviDi ॥12॥

text: somo rājā brāhmaṇānāmityeṣā vaidikī śrutiḥ । taṃ ca vikretumicchanti na vṛthā vṛttiriṣyate । tena krītena dharmeṇa tato yajñaḥ pratāyate ॥13॥
html:
somo rājā brāhmaṇānāmityeṣā vaidikī śrutiḥ ।
taṃ ca vikretumicchanti na vṛthā vṛttiriṣyate ।
tena krītena dharmeṇa tato yajñaḥ pratāyate ॥13॥
slp1: somo rAjA brAhmaRAnAmityezA vEdikI SrutiH । taM ca vikretumicCanti na vfTA vfttirizyate । tena krItena DarmeRa tato yajYaH pratAyate ॥13॥

text: ityevaṃ dharmataḥ khyātamṛṣibhirdharmavādibhiḥ । pumānyajñaśca somaśca nyāyavṛtto yathā bhavet । anyāyavṛttaḥ puruṣo na parasya na cātmanaḥ ॥14॥
html:
ityevaṃ dharmataḥ khyātamṛṣibhirdharmavādibhiḥ ।
pumānyajñaśca somaśca nyāyavṛtto yathā bhavet ।
anyāyavṛttaḥ puruṣo na parasya na cātmanaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: ityevaM DarmataH KyAtamfziBirDarmavAdiBiH । pumAnyajYaSca somaSca nyAyavftto yaTA Bavet । anyAyavfttaH puruzo na parasya na cAtmanaH ॥14॥

text: śarīraṃ yajñapātrāṇi ityeṣā śrūyate śrutiḥ । tāni samyakpraṇītāni brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām ॥15॥
html:
śarīraṃ yajñapātrāṇi ityeṣā śrūyate śrutiḥ ।
tāni samyakpraṇītāni brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām ॥15॥
slp1: SarIraM yajYapAtrARi ityezA SrUyate SrutiH । tAni samyakpraRItAni brAhmaRAnAM mahAtmanAm ॥15॥

text: tapo yajñādapi śreṣṭhamityeṣā paramā śrutiḥ । tatte tapaḥ pravakṣyāmi vidvaṃstadapi me śṛṇu ॥16॥
html:
tapo yajñādapi śreṣṭhamityeṣā paramā śrutiḥ ।
tatte tapaḥ pravakṣyāmi vidvaṃstadapi me śṛṇu ॥16॥
slp1: tapo yajYAdapi SrezWamityezA paramA SrutiH । tatte tapaH pravakzyAmi vidvaMstadapi me SfRu ॥16॥

text: ahiṃsā satyavacanamānṛśaṃsyaṃ damo ghṛṇā । etattapo vidurdhīrā na śarīrasya śoṣaṇam ॥17॥
html:
ahiṃsā satyavacanamānṛśaṃsyaṃ damo ghṛṇā ।
etattapo vidurdhīrā na śarīrasya śoṣaṇam ॥17॥
slp1: ahiMsA satyavacanamAnfSaMsyaM damo GfRA । etattapo vidurDIrA na SarIrasya SozaRam ॥17॥

text: aprāmāṇyaṃ ca vedānāṃ śāstrāṇāṃ cātilaṅghanam । avyavasthā ca sarvatra tadvai nāśanamātmanaḥ ॥18॥
html:
aprāmāṇyaṃ ca vedānāṃ śāstrāṇāṃ cātilaṅghanam ।
avyavasthā ca sarvatra tadvai nāśanamātmanaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: aprAmARyaM ca vedAnAM SAstrARAM cAtilaNGanam । avyavasTA ca sarvatra tadvE nASanamAtmanaH ॥18॥

text: nibodha daśahotṝṇāṃ vidhānaṃ pārtha yādṛśam । cittiḥ srukcittamājyaṃ ca pavitraṃ jñānamuttamam ॥19॥
html:
nibodha daśahotṝṇāṃ vidhānaṃ pārtha yādṛśam ।
cittiḥ srukcittamājyaṃ ca pavitraṃ jñānamuttamam ॥19॥
slp1: niboDa daSahotFRAM viDAnaM pArTa yAdfSam । cittiH srukcittamAjyaM ca pavitraM jYAnamuttamam ॥19॥

text: sarvaṃ jihmaṃ mṛtyupadamārjavaṃ brahmaṇaḥ padam । etāvāñjñānaviṣayaḥ kiṃ pralāpaḥ kariṣyati] ॥20॥
html:
sarvaṃ jihmaṃ mṛtyupadamārjavaṃ brahmaṇaḥ padam ।
etāvāñjñānaviṣayaḥ kiṃ pralāpaḥ kariṣyati] ॥20॥
slp1: sarvaM jihmaM mftyupadamArjavaM brahmaRaH padam । etAvAYjYAnavizayaH kiM pralApaH karizyati] ॥20॥

text: yadapyalpataraṃ karma tadapyekena duṣkaram । puruṣeṇāsahāyena kimu rājyaṃ pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
yadapyalpataraṃ karma tadapyekena duṣkaram ।
puruṣeṇāsahāyena kimu rājyaṃ pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: yadapyalpataraM karma tadapyekena duzkaram । puruzeRAsahAyena kimu rAjyaM pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kiṃśīlaḥ kiṃsamācāro rājño'rthasacivo bhavet । kīdṛśe viśvasedrājā kīdṛśe nāpi viśvaset ॥2॥
html:
kiṃśīlaḥ kiṃsamācāro rājño'rthasacivo bhavet ।
kīdṛśe viśvasedrājā kīdṛśe nāpi viśvaset ॥2॥
slp1: kiMSIlaH kiMsamAcAro rAjYo'rTasacivo Bavet । kIdfSe viSvasedrAjA kIdfSe nApi viSvaset ॥2॥

text: caturvidhāni mitrāṇi rājñāṃ rājanbhavantyuta । sahārtho bhajamānaśca sahajaḥ kṛtrimastathā ॥3॥
html:
caturvidhāni mitrāṇi rājñāṃ rājanbhavantyuta ।
sahārtho bhajamānaśca sahajaḥ kṛtrimastathā ॥3॥
slp1: caturviDAni mitrARi rAjYAM rAjanBavantyuta । sahArTo BajamAnaSca sahajaH kftrimastaTA ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dharmātmā pañcamaṃ mitraṃ sa tu naikasya na dvayoḥ । yato dharmastato vā syānmadhyastho vā tato bhavet ॥4॥
html:
dharmātmā pañcamaṃ mitraṃ sa tu naikasya na dvayoḥ ।
yato dharmastato vā syānmadhyastho vā tato bhavet ॥4॥
slp1: DarmAtmA paYcamaM mitraM sa tu nEkasya na dvayoH । yato Darmastato vA syAnmaDyasTo vA tato Bavet ॥4॥

text: yastasyārtho na roceta na taṃ tasya prakāśayet । dharmādharmeṇa rājānaścaranti vijigīṣavaḥ ॥5॥
html:
yastasyārtho na roceta na taṃ tasya prakāśayet ।
dharmādharmeṇa rājānaścaranti vijigīṣavaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: yastasyArTo na roceta na taM tasya prakASayet । DarmADarmeRa rAjAnaScaranti vijigIzavaH ॥5॥

text: caturṇāṃ madhyamau śreṣṭhau nityaṃ śaṅkyau tathāparau । sarve nityaṃ śaṅkitavyāḥ pratyakṣaṃ kāryamātmanaḥ ॥6॥
html:
caturṇāṃ madhyamau śreṣṭhau nityaṃ śaṅkyau tathāparau ।
sarve nityaṃ śaṅkitavyāḥ pratyakṣaṃ kāryamātmanaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: caturRAM maDyamO SrezWO nityaM SaNkyO taTAparO । sarve nityaM SaNkitavyAH pratyakzaM kAryamAtmanaH ॥6॥

text: na hi rājñā pramādo vai kartavyo mitrarakṣaṇe । pramādinaṃ hi rājānaṃ lokāḥ paribhavantyuta ॥7॥
html:
na hi rājñā pramādo vai kartavyo mitrarakṣaṇe ।
pramādinaṃ hi rājānaṃ lokāḥ paribhavantyuta ॥7॥
slp1: na hi rAjYA pramAdo vE kartavyo mitrarakzaRe । pramAdinaM hi rAjAnaM lokAH pariBavantyuta ॥7॥

text: asādhuḥ sādhutāmeti sādhurbhavati dāruṇaḥ । ariśca mitraṃ bhavati mitraṃ cāpi praduṣyati ॥8॥
html:
asādhuḥ sādhutāmeti sādhurbhavati dāruṇaḥ ।
ariśca mitraṃ bhavati mitraṃ cāpi praduṣyati ॥8॥
slp1: asADuH sADutAmeti sADurBavati dAruRaH । ariSca mitraM Bavati mitraM cApi praduzyati ॥8॥

text: anityacittaḥ puruṣastasminko jātu viśvaset । tasmātpradhānaṃ yatkāryaṃ pratyakṣaṃ tatsamācaret ॥9॥
html:
anityacittaḥ puruṣastasminko jātu viśvaset ।
tasmātpradhānaṃ yatkāryaṃ pratyakṣaṃ tatsamācaret ॥9॥
slp1: anityacittaH puruzastasminko jAtu viSvaset । tasmAtpraDAnaM yatkAryaM pratyakzaM tatsamAcaret ॥9॥

text: ekāntena hi viśvāsaḥ kṛtsno dharmārthanāśakaḥ । aviśvāsaśca sarvatra mṛtyunā na viśiṣyate ॥10॥
html:
ekāntena hi viśvāsaḥ kṛtsno dharmārthanāśakaḥ ।
aviśvāsaśca sarvatra mṛtyunā na viśiṣyate ॥10॥
slp1: ekAntena hi viSvAsaH kftsno DarmArTanASakaH । aviSvAsaSca sarvatra mftyunA na viSizyate ॥10॥

text: akālamṛtyurviśvāso viśvasanhi vipadyate । yasminkaroti viśvāsamicchatastasya jīvati ॥11॥
html:
akālamṛtyurviśvāso viśvasanhi vipadyate ।
yasminkaroti viśvāsamicchatastasya jīvati ॥11॥
slp1: akAlamftyurviSvAso viSvasanhi vipadyate । yasminkaroti viSvAsamicCatastasya jIvati ॥11॥

text: tasmādviśvasitavyaṃ ca śaṅkitavyaṃ ca keṣucit । eṣā nītigatistāta lakṣmīścaiva sanātanī ॥12॥
html:
tasmādviśvasitavyaṃ ca śaṅkitavyaṃ ca keṣucit ।
eṣā nītigatistāta lakṣmīścaiva sanātanī ॥12॥
slp1: tasmAdviSvasitavyaM ca SaNkitavyaM ca kezucit । ezA nItigatistAta lakzmIScEva sanAtanI ॥12॥

text: yaṃ manyeta mamābhāvādimamarthāgamaḥ spṛśet । nityaṃ tasmācchaṅkitavyamamitraṃ taṃ vidurbudhāḥ ॥13॥
html:
yaṃ manyeta mamābhāvādimamarthāgamaḥ spṛśet ।
nityaṃ tasmācchaṅkitavyamamitraṃ taṃ vidurbudhāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: yaM manyeta mamABAvAdimamarTAgamaH spfSet । nityaM tasmAcCaNkitavyamamitraM taM vidurbuDAH ॥13॥

text: yasya kṣetrādapyudakaṃ kṣetramanyasya gacchati । na tatrānicchatastasya bhidyeransarvasetavaḥ ॥14॥
html:
yasya kṣetrādapyudakaṃ kṣetramanyasya gacchati ।
na tatrānicchatastasya bhidyeransarvasetavaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: yasya kzetrAdapyudakaM kzetramanyasya gacCati । na tatrAnicCatastasya BidyeransarvasetavaH ॥14॥

text: tathaivātyudakādbhītastasya bhedanamicchati । yamevaṃlakṣaṇaṃ vidyāttamamitraṃ vinirdiśet ॥15॥
html:
tathaivātyudakādbhītastasya bhedanamicchati ।
yamevaṃlakṣaṇaṃ vidyāttamamitraṃ vinirdiśet ॥15॥
slp1: taTEvAtyudakAdBItastasya BedanamicCati । yamevaMlakzaRaM vidyAttamamitraM vinirdiSet ॥15॥

text: yaḥ samṛddhyā na tuṣyeta kṣaye dīnataro bhavet । etaduttamamitrasya nimittamabhicakṣate ॥16॥
html:
yaḥ samṛddhyā na tuṣyeta kṣaye dīnataro bhavet ।
etaduttamamitrasya nimittamabhicakṣate ॥16॥
slp1: yaH samfdDyA na tuzyeta kzaye dInataro Bavet । etaduttamamitrasya nimittamaBicakzate ॥16॥

text: yaṃ manyeta mamābhāvādasyābhāvo bhavediti । tasminkurvīta viśvāsaṃ yathā pitari vai tathā ॥17॥
html:
yaṃ manyeta mamābhāvādasyābhāvo bhavediti ।
tasminkurvīta viśvāsaṃ yathā pitari vai tathā ॥17॥
slp1: yaM manyeta mamABAvAdasyABAvo Bavediti । tasminkurvIta viSvAsaM yaTA pitari vE taTA ॥17॥

text: taṃ śaktyā vardhamānaśca sarvataḥ paribṛṃhayet । nityaṃ kṣatādvārayati yo dharmeṣvapi karmasu ॥18॥
html:
taṃ śaktyā vardhamānaśca sarvataḥ paribṛṃhayet ।
nityaṃ kṣatādvārayati yo dharmeṣvapi karmasu ॥18॥
slp1: taM SaktyA varDamAnaSca sarvataH paribfMhayet । nityaM kzatAdvArayati yo Darmezvapi karmasu ॥18॥

text: kṣatādbhītaṃ vijānīyāduttamaṃ mitralakṣaṇam । ye tasya kṣatamicchanti te tasya ripavaḥ smṛtāḥ ॥19॥
html:
kṣatādbhītaṃ vijānīyāduttamaṃ mitralakṣaṇam ।
ye tasya kṣatamicchanti te tasya ripavaḥ smṛtāḥ ॥19॥
slp1: kzatAdBItaM vijAnIyAduttamaM mitralakzaRam । ye tasya kzatamicCanti te tasya ripavaH smftAH ॥19॥

text: vyasanānnityabhīto'sau samṛddhyāmeva tṛpyate । yatsyādevaṃvidhaṃ mitraṃ tadātmasamamucyate ॥20॥
html:
vyasanānnityabhīto'sau samṛddhyāmeva tṛpyate ।
yatsyādevaṃvidhaṃ mitraṃ tadātmasamamucyate ॥20॥
slp1: vyasanAnnityaBIto'sO samfdDyAmeva tfpyate । yatsyAdevaMviDaM mitraM tadAtmasamamucyate ॥20॥

text: rūpavarṇasvaropetastitikṣuranasūyakaḥ । kulīnaḥ śīlasaṃpannaḥ sa te syātpratyanantaraḥ ॥21॥
html:
rūpavarṇasvaropetastitikṣuranasūyakaḥ ।
kulīnaḥ śīlasaṃpannaḥ sa te syātpratyanantaraḥ ॥21॥
slp1: rUpavarRasvaropetastitikzuranasUyakaH । kulInaH SIlasaMpannaH sa te syAtpratyanantaraH ॥21॥
