text: medhāvī smṛtimāndakṣaḥ prakṛtyā cānṛśaṃsavān । yo mānito'mānito vā na sandūṣyetkadācana ॥22॥
html:
medhāvī smṛtimāndakṣaḥ prakṛtyā cānṛśaṃsavān ।
yo mānito'mānito vā na sandūṣyetkadācana ॥22॥
slp1: meDAvI smftimAndakzaH prakftyA cAnfSaMsavAn । yo mAnito'mAnito vA na sandUzyetkadAcana ॥22॥

text: ṛtvigvā yadi vācāryaḥ sakhā vātyantasaṃstutaḥ । gṛhe vasedamātyaste yaḥ syātparamapūjitaḥ ॥23॥
html:
ṛtvigvā yadi vācāryaḥ sakhā vātyantasaṃstutaḥ ।
gṛhe vasedamātyaste yaḥ syātparamapūjitaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: ftvigvA yadi vAcAryaH saKA vAtyantasaMstutaH । gfhe vasedamAtyaste yaH syAtparamapUjitaH ॥23॥

text: sa te vidyātparaṃ mantraṃ prakṛtiṃ cārthadharmayoḥ । viśvāsaste bhavettatra yathā pitari vai tathā ॥24॥
html:
sa te vidyātparaṃ mantraṃ prakṛtiṃ cārthadharmayoḥ ।
viśvāsaste bhavettatra yathā pitari vai tathā ॥24॥
slp1: sa te vidyAtparaM mantraM prakftiM cArTaDarmayoH । viSvAsaste Bavettatra yaTA pitari vE taTA ॥24॥

text: naiva dvau na trayaḥ kāryā na mṛṣyeranparasparam । ekārthādeva bhūtānāṃ bhedo bhavati sarvadā ॥25॥
html:
naiva dvau na trayaḥ kāryā na mṛṣyeranparasparam ।
ekārthādeva bhūtānāṃ bhedo bhavati sarvadā ॥25॥
slp1: nEva dvO na trayaH kAryA na mfzyeranparasparam । ekArTAdeva BUtAnAM Bedo Bavati sarvadA ॥25॥

text: kīrtipradhāno yaśca syādyaśca syātsamaye sthitaḥ । samarthānyaśca na dveṣṭi samarthānkurute ca yaḥ ॥26॥
html:
kīrtipradhāno yaśca syādyaśca syātsamaye sthitaḥ ।
samarthānyaśca na dveṣṭi samarthānkurute ca yaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: kIrtipraDAno yaSca syAdyaSca syAtsamaye sTitaH । samarTAnyaSca na dvezwi samarTAnkurute ca yaH ॥26॥

text: yo na kāmādbhayāllobhātkrodhādvā dharmamutsṛjet । dakṣaḥ paryāptavacanaḥ sa te syātpratyanantaraḥ ॥27॥
html:
yo na kāmādbhayāllobhātkrodhādvā dharmamutsṛjet ।
dakṣaḥ paryāptavacanaḥ sa te syātpratyanantaraḥ ॥27॥
slp1: yo na kAmAdBayAlloBAtkroDAdvA Darmamutsfjet । dakzaH paryAptavacanaH sa te syAtpratyanantaraH ॥27॥

text: śūraścāryaśca vidvāṃśca pratipattiviśāradaḥ । kulīnaḥ śīlasampannastitikṣuranasūyakaḥ ॥28॥
html:
śūraścāryaśca vidvāṃśca pratipattiviśāradaḥ ।
kulīnaḥ śīlasampannastitikṣuranasūyakaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: SUraScAryaSca vidvAMSca pratipattiviSAradaH । kulInaH SIlasampannastitikzuranasUyakaH ॥28॥

text: ete hyamātyāḥ kartavyāḥ sarvakarmasvavasthitāḥ । pūjitāḥ saṃvibhaktāśca susahāyāḥ svanuṣṭhitāḥ ॥29॥
html:
ete hyamātyāḥ kartavyāḥ sarvakarmasvavasthitāḥ ।
pūjitāḥ saṃvibhaktāśca susahāyāḥ svanuṣṭhitāḥ ॥29॥
slp1: ete hyamAtyAH kartavyAH sarvakarmasvavasTitAH । pUjitAH saMviBaktASca susahAyAH svanuzWitAH ॥29॥

text: kṛtsnamete vinikṣiptāḥ pratirūpeṣu karmasu । yuktā mahatsu kāryeṣu śreyāṃsyutpādayanti ca ॥30॥
html:
kṛtsnamete vinikṣiptāḥ pratirūpeṣu karmasu ।
yuktā mahatsu kāryeṣu śreyāṃsyutpādayanti ca ॥30॥
slp1: kftsnamete vinikziptAH pratirUpezu karmasu । yuktA mahatsu kAryezu SreyAMsyutpAdayanti ca ॥30॥

text: ete karmāṇi kurvanti spardhamānā mithaḥ sadā । anutiṣṭhanti caivārthānācakṣāṇāḥ parasparam ॥31॥
html:
ete karmāṇi kurvanti spardhamānā mithaḥ sadā ।
anutiṣṭhanti caivārthānācakṣāṇāḥ parasparam ॥31॥
slp1: ete karmARi kurvanti sparDamAnA miTaH sadA । anutizWanti cEvArTAnAcakzARAH parasparam ॥31॥

text: jñātibhyaścaiva bibhyethā mṛtyoriva yataḥ sadā । uparājeva rājardhiṃ jñātirna sahate sadā ॥32॥
html:
jñātibhyaścaiva bibhyethā mṛtyoriva yataḥ sadā ।
uparājeva rājardhiṃ jñātirna sahate sadā ॥32॥
slp1: jYAtiByaScEva biByeTA mftyoriva yataH sadA । uparAjeva rAjarDiM jYAtirna sahate sadA ॥32॥

text: ṛjormṛdorvadānyasya hrīmataḥ satyavādinaḥ । nānyo jñātermahābāho vināśamabhinandati ॥33॥
html:
ṛjormṛdorvadānyasya hrīmataḥ satyavādinaḥ ।
nānyo jñātermahābāho vināśamabhinandati ॥33॥
slp1: fjormfdorvadAnyasya hrImataH satyavAdinaH । nAnyo jYAtermahAbAho vinASamaBinandati ॥33॥

text: ajñātitā nātisukhā nāvajñeyāstvataḥ param । ajñātimantaṃ puruṣaṃ pare paribhavantyuta ॥34॥
html:
ajñātitā nātisukhā nāvajñeyāstvataḥ param ।

slp1: rAjakoSasya goptAraM rAjakoSavilopakAH । sametya sarve bADante sa vinaSyatyarakzitaH ॥4॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । muniḥ kālakavṛkṣīyaḥ kausalyaṃ yaduvāca ha ॥5॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
muniḥ kālakavṛkṣīyaḥ kausalyaṃ yaduvāca ha ॥5॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । muniH kAlakavfkzIyaH kOsalyaM yaduvAca ha ॥5॥

text: kosalānāmādhipatyaṃ samprāpte kṣemadarśini । muniḥ kālakavṛkṣīya ājagāmeti naḥ śrutam ॥6॥
html:
kosalānāmādhipatyaṃ samprāpte kṣemadarśini ।
muniḥ kālakavṛkṣīya ājagāmeti naḥ śrutam ॥6॥
slp1: kosalAnAmADipatyaM samprApte kzemadarSini । muniH kAlakavfkzIya AjagAmeti naH Srutam ॥6॥

text: sa kākaṃ pañjare baddhvā viṣayaṃ kṣemadarśinaḥ । pūrvaṃ paryacaradyuktaḥ pravṛttyarthī punaḥ punaḥ ॥7॥
html:
sa kākaṃ pañjare baddhvā viṣayaṃ kṣemadarśinaḥ ।
pūrvaṃ paryacaradyuktaḥ pravṛttyarthī punaḥ punaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: sa kAkaM paYjare badDvA vizayaM kzemadarSinaH । pUrvaM paryacaradyuktaH pravfttyarTI punaH punaH ॥7॥

text: adhīye vāyasīṃ vidyāṃ śaṃsanti mama vāyasāḥ । anāgatamatītaṃ ca yacca samprati vartate ॥8॥
html:
adhīye vāyasīṃ vidyāṃ śaṃsanti mama vāyasāḥ ।
anāgatamatītaṃ ca yacca samprati vartate ॥8॥
slp1: aDIye vAyasIM vidyAM SaMsanti mama vAyasAH । anAgatamatItaM ca yacca samprati vartate ॥8॥

text: iti rāṣṭre paripatanbahuśaḥ puruṣaiḥ saha । sarveṣāṃ rājayuktānāṃ duṣkṛtaṃ paripṛṣṭavān ॥9॥
html:
iti rāṣṭre paripatanbahuśaḥ puruṣaiḥ saha ।
sarveṣāṃ rājayuktānāṃ duṣkṛtaṃ paripṛṣṭavān ॥9॥
slp1: iti rAzwre paripatanbahuSaH puruzEH saha । sarvezAM rAjayuktAnAM duzkftaM paripfzwavAn ॥9॥

text: sa buddhvā tasya rāṣṭrasya vyavasāyaṃ hi sarvaśaḥ । rājayuktāpacārāṃśca sarvānbuddhvā tatastataḥ ॥10॥
html:
sa buddhvā tasya rāṣṭrasya vyavasāyaṃ hi sarvaśaḥ ।
rājayuktāpacārāṃśca sarvānbuddhvā tatastataḥ ॥10॥
slp1: sa budDvA tasya rAzwrasya vyavasAyaM hi sarvaSaH । rAjayuktApacArAMSca sarvAnbudDvA tatastataH ॥10॥

text: tameva kākamādāya rājānaṃ draṣṭumāgamat । sarvajño'smīti vacanaṃ bruvāṇaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ ॥11॥
html:
tameva kākamādāya rājānaṃ draṣṭumāgamat ।
sarvajño'smīti vacanaṃ bruvāṇaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ ॥11॥
slp1: tameva kAkamAdAya rAjAnaM drazwumAgamat । sarvajYo'smIti vacanaM bruvARaH saMSitavrataH ॥11॥

text: sa sma kausalyamāgamya rājāmātyamalaṅkṛtam । prāha kākasya vacanādamutredaṃ tvayā kṛtam ॥12॥
html:
sa sma kausalyamāgamya rājāmātyamalaṅkṛtam ।
prāha kākasya vacanādamutredaṃ tvayā kṛtam ॥12॥
slp1: sa sma kOsalyamAgamya rAjAmAtyamalaNkftam । prAha kAkasya vacanAdamutredaM tvayA kftam ॥12॥

text: asau cāsau ca jānīte rājakośastvayā hṛtaḥ । evamākhyāti kāko'yaṃ tacchīghramanugamyatām ॥13॥
html:
asau cāsau ca jānīte rājakośastvayā hṛtaḥ ।
evamākhyāti kāko'yaṃ tacchīghramanugamyatām ॥13॥
slp1: asO cAsO ca jAnIte rAjakoSastvayA hftaH । evamAKyAti kAko'yaM tacCIGramanugamyatAm ॥13॥

text: tathānyānapi sa prāha rājakośaharānsadā । na cāsya vacanaṃ kiñcidakṛtaṃ śrūyate kvacit ॥14॥
html:
tathānyānapi sa prāha rājakośaharānsadā ।
na cāsya vacanaṃ kiñcidakṛtaṃ śrūyate kvacit ॥14॥
slp1: taTAnyAnapi sa prAha rAjakoSaharAnsadA । na cAsya vacanaM kiYcidakftaM SrUyate kvacit ॥14॥

text: tena viprakṛtāḥ sarve rājayuktāḥ kurūdvaha । tamatikramya suptasya niśi kākamapothayan ॥15॥
html:
tena viprakṛtāḥ sarve rājayuktāḥ kurūdvaha ।
tamatikramya suptasya niśi kākamapothayan ॥15॥
slp1: tena viprakftAH sarve rAjayuktAH kurUdvaha । tamatikramya suptasya niSi kAkamapoTayan ॥15॥

text: vāyasaṃ tu vinirbhinnaṃ dṛṣṭvā bāṇena pañjare । pūrvāhṇe brāhmaṇo vākyaṃ kṣemadarśinamabravīt ॥16॥
html:
vāyasaṃ tu vinirbhinnaṃ dṛṣṭvā bāṇena pañjare ।
pūrvāhṇe brāhmaṇo vākyaṃ kṣemadarśinamabravīt ॥16॥
slp1: vAyasaM tu vinirBinnaM dfzwvA bARena paYjare । pUrvAhRe brAhmaRo vAkyaM kzemadarSinamabravIt ॥16॥

text: rājaṃstvāmabhayaṃ yāce prabhuṃ prāṇadhaneśvaram । anujñātastvayā brūyāṃ vacanaṃ tvatpuro hitam ॥17॥
html:
rājaṃstvāmabhayaṃ yāce prabhuṃ prāṇadhaneśvaram ।
anujñātastvayā brūyāṃ vacanaṃ tvatpuro hitam ॥17॥
slp1: rAjaMstvAmaBayaM yAce praBuM prARaDaneSvaram । anujYAtastvayA brUyAM vacanaM tvatpuro hitam ॥17॥

text: mitrārthamabhisantapto bhaktyā sarvātmanā gataḥ । ayaṃ tavārthaṃ harate yo brūyādakṣamānvitaḥ ॥18॥
html:
mitrārthamabhisantapto bhaktyā sarvātmanā gataḥ ।
ayaṃ tavārthaṃ harate yo brūyādakṣamānvitaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: mitrArTamaBisantapto BaktyA sarvAtmanA gataH । ayaM tavArTaM harate yo brUyAdakzamAnvitaH ॥18॥

text: saṃbubodhayiṣurmitraṃ sadaśvamiva sārathiḥ । atimanyuprasakto hi prasajya hitakāraṇam ॥19॥
html:
saṃbubodhayiṣurmitraṃ sadaśvamiva sārathiḥ ।
atimanyuprasakto hi prasajya hitakāraṇam ॥19॥
slp1: saMbuboDayizurmitraM sadaSvamiva sAraTiH । atimanyuprasakto hi prasajya hitakAraRam ॥19॥

text: tathāvidhasya suhṛdaḥ kṣantavyaṃ saṃvijānatā । aiśvaryamicchatā nityaṃ puruṣeṇa bubhūṣatā ॥20॥
html:
tathāvidhasya suhṛdaḥ kṣantavyaṃ saṃvijānatā ।
aiśvaryamicchatā nityaṃ puruṣeṇa bubhūṣatā ॥20॥
slp1: taTAviDasya suhfdaH kzantavyaM saMvijAnatA । ESvaryamicCatA nityaM puruzeRa buBUzatA ॥20॥

text: taṃ rājā pratyuvācedaṃ yanmā kiñcidbhavānvadet । kasmādahaṃ na kṣameyamākāṅkṣannātmano hitam ॥21॥
html:
taṃ rājā pratyuvācedaṃ yanmā kiñcidbhavānvadet ।
kasmādahaṃ na kṣameyamākāṅkṣannātmano hitam ॥21॥
slp1: taM rAjA pratyuvAcedaM yanmA kiYcidBavAnvadet । kasmAdahaM na kzameyamAkANkzannAtmano hitam ॥21॥

text: brāhmaṇa pratijānīhi prabrūhi yadi cecchasi । kariṣyāmi hi te vākyaṃ yadyanmāṃ vipra vakṣyasi ॥22॥
html:
brāhmaṇa pratijānīhi prabrūhi yadi cecchasi ।
kariṣyāmi hi te vākyaṃ yadyanmāṃ vipra vakṣyasi ॥22॥
slp1: brAhmaRa pratijAnIhi prabrUhi yadi cecCasi । karizyAmi hi te vAkyaM yadyanmAM vipra vakzyasi ॥22॥

text: jñātvā nayānapāyāṃśca bhṛtyataste bhayāni ca । bhaktyā vṛttiṃ samākhyātuṃ bhavato'ntikamāgamam ॥23॥
html:
jñātvā nayānapāyāṃśca bhṛtyataste bhayāni ca ।
bhaktyā vṛttiṃ samākhyātuṃ bhavato'ntikamāgamam ॥23॥
slp1: jYAtvA nayAnapAyAMSca Bftyataste BayAni ca । BaktyA vfttiM samAKyAtuM Bavato'ntikamAgamam ॥23॥
author: muniruvāca ।

text: prāgevoktaśca doṣo'yamācāryairnṛpasevinām । agatīkagatirhyeṣā yā rājñā saha jīvikā ॥24॥
html:
prāgevoktaśca doṣo'yamācāryairnṛpasevinām ।
agatīkagatirhyeṣā yā rājñā saha jīvikā ॥24॥
slp1: prAgevoktaSca dozo'yamAcAryErnfpasevinAm । agatIkagatirhyezA yA rAjYA saha jIvikA ॥24॥

text: āśīviṣaiśca tasyāhuḥ saṅgataṃ yasya rājabhiḥ । bahumitrāśca rājāno bahvamitrāstathaiva ca ॥25॥
html:
āśīviṣaiśca tasyāhuḥ saṅgataṃ yasya rājabhiḥ ।
bahumitrāśca rājāno bahvamitrāstathaiva ca ॥25॥
slp1: ASIvizESca tasyAhuH saNgataM yasya rAjaBiH । bahumitrASca rAjAno bahvamitrAstaTEva ca ॥25॥

text: tebhyaḥ sarvebhya evāhurbhayaṃ rājopasevinām । athaiṣāmekato rājanmuhūrtādeva bhīrbhavet ॥26॥
html:
tebhyaḥ sarvebhya evāhurbhayaṃ rājopasevinām ।
athaiṣāmekato rājanmuhūrtādeva bhīrbhavet ॥26॥
slp1: teByaH sarveBya evAhurBayaM rAjopasevinAm । aTEzAmekato rAjanmuhUrtAdeva BIrBavet ॥26॥

text: naikāntenāpramādo hi kartuṃ śakyo mahīpatau । na tu pramādaḥ kartavyaḥ kathañcidbhūtimicchatā ॥27॥
html:
naikāntenāpramādo hi kartuṃ śakyo mahīpatau ।
na tu pramādaḥ kartavyaḥ kathañcidbhūtimicchatā ॥27॥
slp1: nEkAntenApramAdo hi kartuM Sakyo mahIpatO । na tu pramAdaH kartavyaH kaTaYcidBUtimicCatA ॥27॥

text: pramādāddhi skhaledrājā skhalite nāsti jīvitam । agniṃ dīptamivāsīdedrājānamupaśikṣitaḥ ॥28॥
html:
pramādāddhi skhaledrājā skhalite nāsti jīvitam ।
agniṃ dīptamivāsīdedrājānamupaśikṣitaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: pramAdAdDi sKaledrAjA sKalite nAsti jIvitam । agniM dIptamivAsIdedrAjAnamupaSikzitaH ॥28॥

text: āśīviṣamiva kruddhaṃ prabhuṃ prāṇadhaneśvaram । yatnenopacarennityaṃ nāhamasmīti mānavaḥ ॥29॥
html:
āśīviṣamiva kruddhaṃ prabhuṃ prāṇadhaneśvaram ।
yatnenopacarennityaṃ nāhamasmīti mānavaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: ASIvizamiva krudDaM praBuM prARaDaneSvaram । yatnenopacarennityaM nAhamasmIti mAnavaH ॥29॥

text: durvyāhṛtācchaṅkamāno duṣkṛtādduradhiṣṭhitāt । durāsitāddurvrajitādiṅgitādaṅgaceṣṭitāt ॥30॥
html:
durvyāhṛtācchaṅkamāno duṣkṛtādduradhiṣṭhitāt ।
durāsitāddurvrajitādiṅgitādaṅgaceṣṭitāt ॥30॥
slp1: durvyAhftAcCaNkamAno duzkftAdduraDizWitAt । durAsitAddurvrajitAdiNgitAdaNgacezwitAt ॥30॥

text: devateva hi sarvārthānkuryādrājā prasāditaḥ । vaiśvānara iva kruddhaḥ samūlamapi nirdahet । iti rājanmayaḥ prāha vartate ca tathaiva tat ॥31॥
html:
devateva hi sarvārthānkuryādrājā prasāditaḥ ।
vaiśvānara iva kruddhaḥ samūlamapi nirdahet ।
iti rājanmayaḥ prāha vartate ca tathaiva tat ॥31॥
slp1: devateva hi sarvArTAnkuryAdrAjA prasAditaH । vESvAnara iva krudDaH samUlamapi nirdahet । iti rAjanmayaH prAha vartate ca taTEva tat ॥31॥

text: atha bhūyāṃsamevārthaṃ kariṣyāmi punaḥ punaḥ । dadātyasmadvidho'mātyo buddhisāhāyyamāpadi ॥32॥
html:
atha bhūyāṃsamevārthaṃ kariṣyāmi punaḥ punaḥ ।
dadātyasmadvidho'mātyo buddhisāhāyyamāpadi ॥32॥
slp1: aTa BUyAMsamevArTaM karizyAmi punaH punaH । dadAtyasmadviDo'mAtyo budDisAhAyyamApadi ॥32॥

text: vāyasaścaiva me rājannantakāyābhisaṃhitaḥ । na ca me'tra bhavāngarhyo na ca yeṣāṃ bhavānpriyaḥ । hitāhitāṃstu budhyethā mā parokṣamatirbhava ॥33॥
html:
vāyasaścaiva me rājannantakāyābhisaṃhitaḥ ।
na ca me'tra bhavāngarhyo na ca yeṣāṃ bhavānpriyaḥ ।
hitāhitāṃstu budhyethā mā parokṣamatirbhava ॥33॥
slp1: vAyasaScEva me rAjannantakAyABisaMhitaH । na ca me'tra BavAngarhyo na ca yezAM BavAnpriyaH । hitAhitAMstu buDyeTA mA parokzamatirBava ॥33॥

text: ye tvādānaparā eva vasanti bhavato gṛhe । abhūtikāmā bhūtānāṃ tādṛśairme'bhisaṃhitam ॥34॥
html:
ye tvādānaparā eva vasanti bhavato gṛhe ।
abhūtikāmā bhūtānāṃ tādṛśairme'bhisaṃhitam ॥34॥
slp1: ye tvAdAnaparA eva vasanti Bavato gfhe । aBUtikAmA BUtAnAM tAdfSErme'BisaMhitam ॥34॥

text: ye vā bhavadvināśena rājyamicchantyanantaram । antarairabhisandhāya rājansidhyanti nānyathā ॥35॥
html:
ye vā bhavadvināśena rājyamicchantyanantaram ।
antarairabhisandhāya rājansidhyanti nānyathā ॥35॥
slp1: ye vA BavadvinASena rAjyamicCantyanantaram । antarEraBisanDAya rAjansiDyanti nAnyaTA ॥35॥

text: teṣāmahaṃ bhayādrājangamiṣyāmyanyamāśramam । tairhi me sandhito bāṇaḥ kāke nipatitaḥ prabho ॥36॥
html:
teṣāmahaṃ bhayādrājangamiṣyāmyanyamāśramam ।
tairhi me sandhito bāṇaḥ kāke nipatitaḥ prabho ॥36॥
slp1: tezAmahaM BayAdrAjangamizyAmyanyamASramam । tErhi me sanDito bARaH kAke nipatitaH praBo ॥36॥

text: chadmanā mama kākaśca gamito yamasādanam । dṛṣṭaṃ hyetanmayā rājaṃstapodīrgheṇa cakṣuṣā ॥37॥
html:
chadmanā mama kākaśca gamito yamasādanam ।
dṛṣṭaṃ hyetanmayā rājaṃstapodīrgheṇa cakṣuṣā ॥37॥
slp1: CadmanA mama kAkaSca gamito yamasAdanam । dfzwaM hyetanmayA rAjaMstapodIrGeRa cakzuzA ॥37॥

text: bahunakrajhaṣagrāhāṃ timiṅgilagaṇāyutām । kākena baḍiśenemāmatārṣaṃ tvāmahaṃ nadīm ॥38॥
html:
bahunakrajhaṣagrāhāṃ timiṅgilagaṇāyutām ।
kākena baḍiśenemāmatārṣaṃ tvāmahaṃ nadīm ॥38॥
slp1: bahunakraJazagrAhAM timiNgilagaRAyutAm । kAkena baqiSenemAmatArzaM tvAmahaM nadIm ॥38॥

text: sthāṇvaśmakaṇṭakavatīṃ vyāghrasiṃhagajākulām । durāsadāṃ duṣpraveśāṃ guhāṃ haimavatīmiva ॥39॥
html:
sthāṇvaśmakaṇṭakavatīṃ vyāghrasiṃhagajākulām ।
durāsadāṃ duṣpraveśāṃ guhāṃ haimavatīmiva ॥39॥
slp1: sTARvaSmakaRwakavatIM vyAGrasiMhagajAkulAm । durAsadAM duzpraveSAM guhAM hEmavatImiva ॥39॥

text: agninā tāmasaṃ durgaṃ naubhirāpyaṃ ca gamyate । rājadurgāvataraṇe nopāyaṃ paṇḍitā viduḥ ॥40॥
html:
agninā tāmasaṃ durgaṃ naubhirāpyaṃ ca gamyate ।
rājadurgāvataraṇe nopāyaṃ paṇḍitā viduḥ ॥40॥
slp1: agninA tAmasaM durgaM nOBirApyaM ca gamyate । rAjadurgAvataraRe nopAyaM paRqitA viduH ॥40॥

text: gahanaṃ bhavato rājyamandhakāratamovṛtam । neha viśvasituṃ śakyaṃ bhavatāpi kuto mayā ॥41॥
html:
gahanaṃ bhavato rājyamandhakāratamovṛtam ।
neha viśvasituṃ śakyaṃ bhavatāpi kuto mayā ॥41॥
slp1: gahanaM Bavato rAjyamanDakAratamovftam । neha viSvasituM SakyaM BavatApi kuto mayA ॥41॥

text: ato nāyaṃ śubho vāsastulye sadasatī iha । vadho hyevātra sukṛte duṣkṛte na ca saṃśayaḥ ॥42॥
html:
ato nāyaṃ śubho vāsastulye sadasatī iha ।
vadho hyevātra sukṛte duṣkṛte na ca saṃśayaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: ato nAyaM SuBo vAsastulye sadasatI iha । vaDo hyevAtra sukfte duzkfte na ca saMSayaH ॥42॥

text: nyāyato duṣkṛte ghātaḥ sukṛte syātkathaṃ vadhaḥ । neha yuktaṃ ciraṃ sthātuṃ javenāto vrajedbudhaḥ ॥43॥
html:
nyāyato duṣkṛte ghātaḥ sukṛte syātkathaṃ vadhaḥ ।
neha yuktaṃ ciraṃ sthātuṃ javenāto vrajedbudhaḥ ॥43॥
slp1: nyAyato duzkfte GAtaH sukfte syAtkaTaM vaDaH । neha yuktaM ciraM sTAtuM javenAto vrajedbuDaH ॥43॥

text: sītā nāma nadī rājanplavo yasyāṃ nimajjati । tathopamāmimāṃ manye vāgurāṃ sarvaghātinīm ॥44॥
html:
sītā nāma nadī rājanplavo yasyāṃ nimajjati ।
tathopamāmimāṃ manye vāgurāṃ sarvaghātinīm ॥44॥
slp1: sItA nAma nadI rAjanplavo yasyAM nimajjati । taTopamAmimAM manye vAgurAM sarvaGAtinIm ॥44॥

text: madhuprapāto hi bhavānbhojanaṃ viṣasaṃyutam । asatāmiva te bhāvo vartate na satāmiva । āśīviṣaiḥ parivṛtaḥ kūpastvamiva pārthiva ॥45॥
html:
madhuprapāto hi bhavānbhojanaṃ viṣasaṃyutam ।
asatāmiva te bhāvo vartate na satāmiva ।
āśīviṣaiḥ parivṛtaḥ kūpastvamiva pārthiva ॥45॥
slp1: maDuprapAto hi BavAnBojanaM vizasaMyutam । asatAmiva te BAvo vartate na satAmiva । ASIvizEH parivftaH kUpastvamiva pArTiva ॥45॥

text: yeṣāṃ vainayikī buddhiḥ prakṛtā caiva śobhanā । tejo dhairyaṃ kṣamā śaucamanurāga sthitirdhṛtiḥ ॥19॥

yeṣāṃ vainayikī buddhiḥ prakṛtā caiva śobhanā ।
tejo dhairyaṃ kṣamā śaucamanurāga sthitirdhṛtiḥ ॥19॥
slp1: yezAM vEnayikI budDiH prakftA cEva SoBanA । tejo DEryaM kzamA SOcamanurAga sTitirDftiH ॥19॥

text: parīkṣitaguṇānnityaṃ prauḍhabhāvāndhurandharān । pañcopadhāvyatītāṃśca kuryādrājārthakāriṇaḥ ॥20॥
html:
parīkṣitaguṇānnityaṃ prauḍhabhāvāndhurandharān ।
pañcopadhāvyatītāṃśca kuryādrājārthakāriṇaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: parIkzitaguRAnnityaM prOQaBAvAnDuranDarAn । paYcopaDAvyatItAMSca kuryAdrAjArTakAriRaH ॥20॥

text: paryāptavacanānvīrānpratipattiviśāradān । kulīnānsatyasampannāniṅgitajñānaniṣṭhurān ॥21॥
html:
paryāptavacanānvīrānpratipattiviśāradān ।
kulīnānsatyasampannāniṅgitajñānaniṣṭhurān ॥21॥
slp1: paryAptavacanAnvIrAnpratipattiviSAradAn । kulInAnsatyasampannAniNgitajYAnanizWurAn ॥21॥

text: deśakālavidhānajñānbhartṛkāryahitaiṣiṇaḥ । nityamartheṣu sarveṣu rājā kurvīta mantriṇaḥ ॥22॥
html:
deśakālavidhānajñānbhartṛkāryahitaiṣiṇaḥ ।
nityamartheṣu sarveṣu rājā kurvīta mantriṇaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: deSakAlaviDAnajYAnBartfkAryahitEziRaH । nityamarTezu sarvezu rAjA kurvIta mantriRaH ॥22॥

text: hīnatejā hyasaṃhṛṣṭo naiva jātu vyavasyati । avaśyaṃ janayatyeva sarvakarmasu saṃśayān ॥23॥
html:
hīnatejā hyasaṃhṛṣṭo naiva jātu vyavasyati ।
avaśyaṃ janayatyeva sarvakarmasu saṃśayān ॥23॥
slp1: hInatejA hyasaMhfzwo nEva jAtu vyavasyati । avaSyaM janayatyeva sarvakarmasu saMSayAn ॥23॥

text: evamalpaśruto mantrī kalyāṇābhijano'pyuta । dharmārthakāmayukto'pi nālaṃ mantraṃ parīkṣitum ॥24॥
html:
evamalpaśruto mantrī kalyāṇābhijano'pyuta ।
dharmārthakāmayukto'pi nālaṃ mantraṃ parīkṣitum ॥24॥
slp1: evamalpaSruto mantrI kalyARABijano'pyuta । DarmArTakAmayukto'pi nAlaM mantraM parIkzitum ॥24॥

text: tathaivānabhijāto'pi kāmamastu bahuśrutaḥ । anāyaka ivācakṣurmuhyatyūhyeṣu karmasu ॥25॥
html:
tathaivānabhijāto'pi kāmamastu bahuśrutaḥ ।
anāyaka ivācakṣurmuhyatyūhyeṣu karmasu ॥25॥
slp1: taTEvAnaBijAto'pi kAmamastu bahuSrutaH । anAyaka ivAcakzurmuhyatyUhyezu karmasu ॥25॥

text: yo vā hyasthirasaṅkalpo buddhimānāgatāgamaḥ । upāyajño'pi nālaṃ sa karma yāpayituṃ ciram ॥26॥
html:
yo vā hyasthirasaṅkalpo buddhimānāgatāgamaḥ ।
upāyajño'pi nālaṃ sa karma yāpayituṃ ciram ॥26॥
slp1: yo vA hyasTirasaNkalpo budDimAnAgatAgamaH । upAyajYo'pi nAlaM sa karma yApayituM ciram ॥26॥

text: kevalātpunarācārātkarmaṇo nopapadyate । parimarśo viśeṣāṇāmaśrutasyeha durmateḥ ॥27॥
html:
kevalātpunarācārātkarmaṇo nopapadyate ।
parimarśo viśeṣāṇāmaśrutasyeha durmateḥ ॥27॥
slp1: kevalAtpunarAcArAtkarmaRo nopapadyate । parimarSo viSezARAmaSrutasyeha durmateH ॥27॥

text: mantriṇyananurakte tu viśvāso na hi vidyate । tasmādananuraktāya naiva mantraṃ prakāśayet ॥28॥
html:
mantriṇyananurakte tu viśvāso na hi vidyate ।
tasmādananuraktāya naiva mantraṃ prakāśayet ॥28॥
slp1: mantriRyananurakte tu viSvAso na hi vidyate । tasmAdananuraktAya nEva mantraM prakASayet ॥28॥

text: vyathayeddhi sa rājānaṃ mantribhiḥ sahito'nṛjuḥ । mārutopahatacchidraiḥ praviśyāgniriva drumam ॥29॥
html:
vyathayeddhi sa rājānaṃ mantribhiḥ sahito'nṛjuḥ ।
mārutopahatacchidraiḥ praviśyāgniriva drumam ॥29॥
slp1: vyaTayedDi sa rAjAnaM mantriBiH sahito'nfjuH । mArutopahatacCidrEH praviSyAgniriva drumam ॥29॥

text: saṅkrudhyatyekadā svāmī sthānāccaivāpakarṣati । vācā kṣipati saṃrabdhastataḥ paścātprasīdati ॥30॥
html:
saṅkrudhyatyekadā svāmī sthānāccaivāpakarṣati ।
vācā kṣipati saṃrabdhastataḥ paścātprasīdati ॥30॥
slp1: saNkruDyatyekadA svAmI sTAnAccEvApakarzati । vAcA kzipati saMrabDastataH paScAtprasIdati ॥30॥

text: tāni tānyanuraktena śakyānyanutitikṣitum । mantriṇāṃ ca bhavetkrodho visphūrjitamivāśaneḥ ॥31॥
html:
tāni tānyanuraktena śakyānyanutitikṣitum ।
mantriṇāṃ ca bhavetkrodho visphūrjitamivāśaneḥ ॥31॥
slp1: tAni tAnyanuraktena SakyAnyanutitikzitum । mantriRAM ca BavetkroDo visPUrjitamivASaneH ॥31॥

text: yastu saṃharate tāni bhartuḥ priyacikīrṣayā । samānasukhaduḥkhaṃ taṃ pṛcchedartheṣu mānavam ॥32॥
html:
yastu saṃharate tāni bhartuḥ priyacikīrṣayā ।
samānasukhaduḥkhaṃ taṃ pṛcchedartheṣu mānavam ॥32॥
slp1: yastu saMharate tAni BartuH priyacikIrzayA । samAnasuKaduHKaM taM pfcCedarTezu mAnavam ॥32॥

text: anṛjustvanurakto'pi sampannaścetarairguṇaiḥ । rājñaḥ prajñānayukto'pi na mantraṃ śrotumarhati ॥33॥
html:
anṛjustvanurakto'pi sampannaścetarairguṇaiḥ ।
rājñaḥ prajñānayukto'pi na mantraṃ śrotumarhati ॥33॥
slp1: anfjustvanurakto'pi sampannaScetarErguREH । rAjYaH prajYAnayukto'pi na mantraM Srotumarhati ॥33॥

text: yo'mitraiḥ saha saṃbaddho na paurānbahu manyate । sa suhṛttādṛśo rājño na mantraṃ śrotumarhati ॥34॥
html:
yo'mitraiḥ saha saṃbaddho na paurānbahu manyate ।
sa suhṛttādṛśo rājño na mantraṃ śrotumarhati ॥34॥
slp1: yo'mitrEH saha saMbadDo na pOrAnbahu manyate । sa suhfttAdfSo rAjYo na mantraM Srotumarhati ॥34॥

text: avidvānaśuciḥ stabdhaḥ śatrusevī vikatthanaḥ । sa suhṛtkrodhano lubdho na mantraṃ śrotumarhati ॥35॥
html:
avidvānaśuciḥ stabdhaḥ śatrusevī vikatthanaḥ ।
sa suhṛtkrodhano lubdho na mantraṃ śrotumarhati ॥35॥
slp1: avidvAnaSuciH stabDaH SatrusevI vikatTanaH । sa suhftkroDano lubDo na mantraM Srotumarhati ॥35॥

text: āgantuścānurakto'pi kāmamastu bahuśrutaḥ । satkṛtaḥ saṃvibhakto vā na mantraṃ śrotumarhati ॥36॥
html:
āgantuścānurakto'pi kāmamastu bahuśrutaḥ ।
satkṛtaḥ saṃvibhakto vā na mantraṃ śrotumarhati ॥36॥
slp1: AgantuScAnurakto'pi kAmamastu bahuSrutaH । satkftaH saMviBakto vA na mantraM Srotumarhati ॥36॥

text: yastvalpenāpi kāryeṇa sakṛdākṣārito bhavet । punaranyairguṇairyukto na mantraṃ śrotumarhati ॥37॥
html:
yastvalpenāpi kāryeṇa sakṛdākṣārito bhavet ।
punaranyairguṇairyukto na mantraṃ śrotumarhati ॥37॥
slp1: yastvalpenApi kAryeRa sakfdAkzArito Bavet । punaranyErguREryukto na mantraM Srotumarhati ॥37॥

text: kṛtaprajñaśca medhāvī budho jānapadaḥ śuciḥ । sarvakarmasu yaḥ śuddhaḥ sa mantraṃ śrotumarhati ॥38॥
html:
kṛtaprajñaśca medhāvī budho jānapadaḥ śuciḥ ।
sarvakarmasu yaḥ śuddhaḥ sa mantraṃ śrotumarhati ॥38॥
slp1: kftaprajYaSca meDAvI buDo jAnapadaH SuciH । sarvakarmasu yaH SudDaH sa mantraM Srotumarhati ॥38॥

text: jñānavijñānasampannaḥ prakṛtijñaḥ parātmanoḥ । suhṛdātmasamo rājñaḥ sa mantraṃ śrotumarhati ॥39॥
html:
jñānavijñānasampannaḥ prakṛtijñaḥ parātmanoḥ ।
suhṛdātmasamo rājñaḥ sa mantraṃ śrotumarhati ॥39॥
slp1: jYAnavijYAnasampannaH prakftijYaH parAtmanoH । suhfdAtmasamo rAjYaH sa mantraM Srotumarhati ॥39॥

text: satyavākśīlasampanno gambhīraḥ satrapo mṛduḥ । pitṛpaitāmaho yaḥ syātsa mantraṃ śrotumarhati ॥40॥
html:
satyavākśīlasampanno gambhīraḥ satrapo mṛduḥ ।
pitṛpaitāmaho yaḥ syātsa mantraṃ śrotumarhati ॥40॥
slp1: satyavAkSIlasampanno gamBIraH satrapo mfduH । pitfpEtAmaho yaH syAtsa mantraM Srotumarhati ॥40॥

text: santuṣṭaḥ sammataḥ satyaḥ śauṭīro dveṣyapāpakaḥ । mantravitkālavicchūraḥ sa mantraṃ śrotumarhati ॥41॥
html:
santuṣṭaḥ sammataḥ satyaḥ śauṭīro dveṣyapāpakaḥ ।
mantravitkālavicchūraḥ sa mantraṃ śrotumarhati ॥41॥
slp1: santuzwaH sammataH satyaH SOwIro dvezyapApakaH । mantravitkAlavicCUraH sa mantraM Srotumarhati ॥41॥

text: sarvalokaṃ samaṃ śaktaḥ sāntvena kurute vaśe । tasmai mantraḥ prayoktavyo daṇḍamādhitsatā nṛpa ॥42॥
html:
sarvalokaṃ samaṃ śaktaḥ sāntvena kurute vaśe ।
tasmai mantraḥ prayoktavyo daṇḍamādhitsatā nṛpa ॥42॥
slp1: sarvalokaM samaM SaktaH sAntvena kurute vaSe । tasmE mantraH prayoktavyo daRqamADitsatA nfpa ॥42॥

text: paurajānapadā yasminviśvāsaṃ dharmato gatāḥ । yoddhā nayavipaścicca sa mantraṃ śrotumarhati ॥43॥
html:
paurajānapadā yasminviśvāsaṃ dharmato gatāḥ ।
yoddhā nayavipaścicca sa mantraṃ śrotumarhati ॥43॥
slp1: pOrajAnapadA yasminviSvAsaM Darmato gatAH । yodDA nayavipaScicca sa mantraM Srotumarhati ॥43॥

text: tasmātsarvairguṇairetairupapannāḥ supūjitāḥ । mantriṇaḥ prakṛtijñāḥ syustryavarā mahadīpsavaḥ ॥44॥
html:
tasmātsarvairguṇairetairupapannāḥ supūjitāḥ ।
mantriṇaḥ prakṛtijñāḥ syustryavarā mahadīpsavaḥ ॥44॥
slp1: tasmAtsarvErguREretErupapannAH supUjitAH । mantriRaH prakftijYAH syustryavarA mahadIpsavaH ॥44॥

text: svāsu prakṛtiṣu chidraṃ lakṣayeranparasya ca । mantriṇo mantramūlaṃ hi rājño rāṣṭraṃ vivardhate ॥45॥
html:
svāsu prakṛtiṣu chidraṃ lakṣayeranparasya ca ।
mantriṇo mantramūlaṃ hi rājño rāṣṭraṃ vivardhate ॥45॥
slp1: svAsu prakftizu CidraM lakzayeranparasya ca । mantriRo mantramUlaM hi rAjYo rAzwraM vivarDate ॥45॥

text: nāsya chidraṃ paraḥ paśyecchidreṣu paramanviyāt । gūhetkūrma ivāṅgāni rakṣedvivaramātmanaḥ ॥46॥
html:
nāsya chidraṃ paraḥ paśyecchidreṣu paramanviyāt ।
gūhetkūrma ivāṅgāni rakṣedvivaramātmanaḥ ॥46॥
slp1: nAsya CidraM paraH paSyecCidrezu paramanviyAt । gUhetkUrma ivANgAni rakzedvivaramAtmanaH ॥46॥

text: mantragrāhā hi rājyasya mantriṇo ye manīṣiṇaḥ । mantrasaṃhanano rājā mantrāṅgānītaro janaḥ ॥47॥
html:
mantragrāhā hi rājyasya mantriṇo ye manīṣiṇaḥ ।
mantrasaṃhanano rājā mantrāṅgānītaro janaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: mantragrAhA hi rAjyasya mantriRo ye manIziRaH । mantrasaMhanano rAjA mantrANgAnItaro janaH ॥47॥

text: rājyaṃ praṇidhimūlaṃ hi mantrasāraṃ pracakṣate । svāminaṃ tvanuvartanti vṛttyarthamiha mantriṇaḥ ॥48॥
html:
rājyaṃ praṇidhimūlaṃ hi mantrasāraṃ pracakṣate ।
svāminaṃ tvanuvartanti vṛttyarthamiha mantriṇaḥ ॥48॥
slp1: rAjyaM praRiDimUlaM hi mantrasAraM pracakzate । svAminaM tvanuvartanti vfttyarTamiha mantriRaH ॥48॥

text: sa vinīya madakrodhau mānamīrṣyāṃ ca nirvṛtaḥ । nityaṃ pañcopadhātītairmantrayetsaha mantribhiḥ ॥49॥
html:
sa vinīya madakrodhau mānamīrṣyāṃ ca nirvṛtaḥ ।
nityaṃ pañcopadhātītairmantrayetsaha mantribhiḥ ॥49॥
slp1: sa vinIya madakroDO mAnamIrzyAM ca nirvftaH । nityaM paYcopaDAtItErmantrayetsaha mantriBiH ॥49॥

text: teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ vividhaṃ vimarśaṃ budhyeta cittaṃ viniveśya tatra । svaniścayaṃ taṃ paraniścayaṃ ca nivedayeduttaramantrakāle ॥50॥
html:
teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ vividhaṃ vimarśaṃ budhyeta cittaṃ viniveśya tatra ।
svaniścayaṃ taṃ paraniścayaṃ ca nivedayeduttaramantrakāle ॥50॥
slp1: tezAM trayARAM viviDaM vimarSaM buDyeta cittaM viniveSya tatra । svaniScayaM taM paraniScayaM ca nivedayeduttaramantrakAle ॥50॥

text: dharmārthakāmajñamupetya pṛcchedyukto guruṃ brāhmaṇamuttamārtham । niṣṭhā kṛtā tena yadā saha syāttaṃ tatra mārgaṃ praṇayedasaktam ॥51॥
html:
dharmārthakāmajñamupetya pṛcchedyukto guruṃ brāhmaṇamuttamārtham ।
niṣṭhā kṛtā tena yadā saha syāttaṃ tatra mārgaṃ praṇayedasaktam ॥51॥
slp1: DarmArTakAmajYamupetya pfcCedyukto guruM brAhmaRamuttamArTam । nizWA kftA tena yadA saha syAttaM tatra mArgaM praRayedasaktam ॥51॥

text: evaṃ sadā mantrayitavyamāhurye mantratattvārthaviniścayajñāḥ । tasmāttvamevaṃ praṇayeḥ sadaiva mantraṃ prajāsaṅgrahaṇe samartham ॥52॥
html:
evaṃ sadā mantrayitavyamāhurye mantratattvārthaviniścayajñāḥ ।
tasmāttvamevaṃ praṇayeḥ sadaiva mantraṃ prajāsaṅgrahaṇe samartham ॥52॥
slp1: evaM sadA mantrayitavyamAhurye mantratattvArTaviniScayajYAH । tasmAttvamevaM praRayeH sadEva mantraM prajAsaNgrahaRe samarTam ॥52॥

text: na vāmanāḥ kubjakṛśā na khañjā nāndhā jaḍāḥ strī na napuṃsakaṃ ca । na cātra tiryaṅna puro na paścānnordhvaṃ na cādhaḥ pracareta kaścit ॥53॥
html:
na vāmanāḥ kubjakṛśā na khañjā nāndhā jaḍāḥ strī na napuṃsakaṃ ca ।
na cātra tiryaṅna puro na paścānnordhvaṃ na cādhaḥ pracareta kaścit ॥53॥
slp1: na vAmanAH kubjakfSA na KaYjA nAnDA jaqAH strI na napuMsakaM ca । na cAtra tiryaNna puro na paScAnnorDvaM na cADaH pracareta kaScit ॥53॥

text: āruhya vātāyanameva śūnyaṃ sthalaṃ prakāśaṃ kuśakāśahīnam । vāgaṅgadoṣānparihṛtya mantraṃ sammantrayetkāryamahīnakālam] ॥54॥
html:
āruhya vātāyanameva śūnyaṃ sthalaṃ prakāśaṃ kuśakāśahīnam ।
vāgaṅgadoṣānparihṛtya mantraṃ sammantrayetkāryamahīnakālam] ॥54॥
slp1: Aruhya vAtAyanameva SUnyaM sTalaM prakASaM kuSakASahInam । vAgaNgadozAnparihftya mantraM sammantrayetkAryamahInakAlam] ॥54॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । bṛhaspateśca saṃvādaṃ śakrasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥1॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
bṛhaspateśca saṃvādaṃ śakrasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥1॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । bfhaspateSca saMvAdaM Sakrasya ca yuDizWira ॥1॥

text: kiṃ svidekapadaṃ brahmanpuruṣaḥ samyagācaran । pramāṇaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yaśaścaivāpnuyānmahat ॥2॥
html:
kiṃ svidekapadaṃ brahmanpuruṣaḥ samyagācaran ।
pramāṇaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yaśaścaivāpnuyānmahat ॥2॥
slp1: kiM svidekapadaM brahmanpuruzaH samyagAcaran । pramARaM sarvaBUtAnAM yaSaScEvApnuyAnmahat ॥2॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: sāntvamekapadaṃ śakra puruṣaḥ samyagācaran । pramāṇaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yaśaścaivāpnuyānmahat ॥3॥
html:
sāntvamekapadaṃ śakra puruṣaḥ samyagācaran ।
pramāṇaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yaśaścaivāpnuyānmahat ॥3॥
slp1: sAntvamekapadaM Sakra puruzaH samyagAcaran । pramARaM sarvaBUtAnAM yaSaScEvApnuyAnmahat ॥3॥
author: bṛhaspatiruvāca ।

text: etadekapadaṃ śakra sarvalokasukhāvaham । ācaransarvabhūteṣu priyo bhavati sarvadā ॥4॥
html:
etadekapadaṃ śakra sarvalokasukhāvaham ।
ācaransarvabhūteṣu priyo bhavati sarvadā ॥4॥
slp1: etadekapadaM Sakra sarvalokasuKAvaham । AcaransarvaBUtezu priyo Bavati sarvadA ॥4॥

text: yo hi nābhāṣate kiñcitsatataṃ bhrukuṭīmukhaḥ । dveṣyo bhavati bhūtānāṃ sa sāntvamiha nācaran ॥5॥
html:
yo hi nābhāṣate kiñcitsatataṃ bhrukuṭīmukhaḥ ।
dveṣyo bhavati bhūtānāṃ sa sāntvamiha nācaran ॥5॥
slp1: yo hi nABAzate kiYcitsatataM BrukuwImuKaH । dvezyo Bavati BUtAnAM sa sAntvamiha nAcaran ॥5॥

text: yastu pūrvamabhiprekṣya pūrvamevābhibhāṣate । smitapūrvābhibhāṣī ca tasya lokaḥ prasīdati ॥6॥
html:
yastu pūrvamabhiprekṣya pūrvamevābhibhāṣate ।
smitapūrvābhibhāṣī ca tasya lokaḥ prasīdati ॥6॥
slp1: yastu pUrvamaBiprekzya pUrvamevABiBAzate । smitapUrvABiBAzI ca tasya lokaH prasIdati ॥6॥

text: dānameva hi sarvatra sāntvenānabhijalpitam । na prīṇayati bhūtāni nirvyañjanamivāśanam ॥7॥
html:
dānameva hi sarvatra sāntvenānabhijalpitam ।
na prīṇayati bhūtāni nirvyañjanamivāśanam ॥7॥
slp1: dAnameva hi sarvatra sAntvenAnaBijalpitam । na prIRayati BUtAni nirvyaYjanamivASanam ॥7॥

text: adātā hyapi bhūtānāṃ madhurāmīrayangiram । sarvalokamimaṃ śakra sāntvena kurute vaśe ॥8॥
html:
adātā hyapi bhūtānāṃ madhurāmīrayangiram ।
sarvalokamimaṃ śakra sāntvena kurute vaśe ॥8॥
slp1: adAtA hyapi BUtAnAM maDurAmIrayangiram । sarvalokamimaM Sakra sAntvena kurute vaSe ॥8॥

text: tasmātsāntvaṃ prakartavyaṃ daṇḍamādhitsatāmiha । phalaṃ ca janayatyevaṃ na cāsyodvijate janaḥ ॥9॥
html:
tasmātsāntvaṃ prakartavyaṃ daṇḍamādhitsatāmiha ।
phalaṃ ca janayatyevaṃ na cāsyodvijate janaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: tasmAtsAntvaM prakartavyaM daRqamADitsatAmiha । PalaM ca janayatyevaM na cAsyodvijate janaH ॥9॥

text: sukṛtasya hi sāntvasya ślakṣṇasya madhurasya ca । samyagāsevyamānasya tulyaṃ jātu na vidyate ॥10॥
html:
sukṛtasya hi sāntvasya ślakṣṇasya madhurasya ca ।
samyagāsevyamānasya tulyaṃ jātu na vidyate ॥10॥
slp1: sukftasya hi sAntvasya SlakzRasya maDurasya ca । samyagAsevyamAnasya tulyaM jAtu na vidyate ॥10॥

text: ityuktaḥ kṛtavānsarvaṃ tathā śakraḥ purodhasā । tathā tvamapi kaunteya samyagetatsamācara] ॥11॥
html:
ityuktaḥ kṛtavānsarvaṃ tathā śakraḥ purodhasā ।
tathā tvamapi kaunteya samyagetatsamācara] ॥11॥
slp1: ityuktaH kftavAnsarvaM taTA SakraH puroDasA । taTA tvamapi kOnteya samyagetatsamAcara] ॥11॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kathaṃ svidiha rājendra pālayanpārthivaḥ prajāḥ । prati dharmaṃ viśeṣeṇa kīrtimāpnoti śāśvatīm ॥1॥
html:
kathaṃ svidiha rājendra pālayanpārthivaḥ prajāḥ ।
prati dharmaṃ viśeṣeṇa kīrtimāpnoti śāśvatīm ॥1॥
slp1: kaTaM svidiha rAjendra pAlayanpArTivaH prajAH । prati DarmaM viSezeRa kIrtimApnoti SASvatIm ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: vyavahāreṇa śuddhena prajāpālanatatparaḥ । prāpya dharmaṃ ca kīrtiṃ ca lokāvāpnotyubhau śuciḥ ॥2॥
html:
vyavahāreṇa śuddhena prajāpālanatatparaḥ ।
prāpya dharmaṃ ca kīrtiṃ ca lokāvāpnotyubhau śuciḥ ॥2॥
slp1: vyavahAreRa SudDena prajApAlanatatparaH । prApya DarmaM ca kIrtiM ca lokAvApnotyuBO SuciH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kīdṛśaṃ vyavahāraṃ tu kaiśca vyavaharennṛpaḥ । etatpṛṣṭo mahāprājña yathāvadvaktumarhasi ॥3॥
html:
kīdṛśaṃ vyavahāraṃ tu kaiśca vyavaharennṛpaḥ ।
etatpṛṣṭo mahāprājña yathāvadvaktumarhasi ॥3॥
slp1: kIdfSaM vyavahAraM tu kESca vyavaharennfpaH । etatpfzwo mahAprAjYa yaTAvadvaktumarhasi ॥3॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: ye caite pūrvakathitā guṇāste puruṣaṃ prati । naikasminpuruṣe hyete vidyanta iti me matiḥ ॥4॥
html:
ye caite pūrvakathitā guṇāste puruṣaṃ prati ।
naikasminpuruṣe hyete vidyanta iti me matiḥ ॥4॥
slp1: ye cEte pUrvakaTitA guRAste puruzaM prati । nEkasminpuruze hyete vidyanta iti me matiH ॥4॥

text: evametanmahāprājña yathā vadasi buddhimān । durlabhaḥ puruṣaḥ kaścidebhirguṇaguṇairyutaḥ ॥5॥
html:
evametanmahāprājña yathā vadasi buddhimān ।
durlabhaḥ puruṣaḥ kaścidebhirguṇaguṇairyutaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: evametanmahAprAjYa yaTA vadasi budDimAn । durlaBaH puruzaH kaScideBirguRaguREryutaH ॥5॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kiṃ tu saṅkṣepataḥ śīlaṃ prayatne neha durlabham । vakṣyāmi tu yathāmātyānyādṛśāṃśca kariṣyasi ॥6॥
html:
kiṃ tu saṅkṣepataḥ śīlaṃ prayatne neha durlabham ।
vakṣyāmi tu yathāmātyānyādṛśāṃśca kariṣyasi ॥6॥
slp1: kiM tu saNkzepataH SIlaM prayatne neha durlaBam । vakzyAmi tu yaTAmAtyAnyAdfSAMSca karizyasi ॥6॥

text: caturo brāhmaṇānvaidyānpragalbhānsāttvikāñśucīn । trīṃśca śūdrānvinītāṃśca śucīnkarmaṇi pūrvake ॥7॥
html:
caturo brāhmaṇānvaidyānpragalbhānsāttvikāñśucīn ।
trīṃśca śūdrānvinītāṃśca śucīnkarmaṇi pūrvake ॥7॥
slp1: caturo brAhmaRAnvEdyAnpragalBAnsAttvikAYSucIn । trIMSca SUdrAnvinItAMSca SucInkarmaRi pUrvake ॥7॥

text: aṣṭābhiśca guṇairyuktaṃ sūtaṃ paurāṇikaṃ caret । pañcāśadvarṣavayasaṃ pragalbhamanasūyakam ॥8॥
html:
aṣṭābhiśca guṇairyuktaṃ sūtaṃ paurāṇikaṃ caret ।
pañcāśadvarṣavayasaṃ pragalbhamanasūyakam ॥8॥
slp1: azwABiSca guREryuktaM sUtaM pOrARikaM caret । paYcASadvarzavayasaM pragalBamanasUyakam ॥8॥

text: matismṛtisamāyuktaṃ vinītaṃ samadarśanam । kārye vivadamānānāṃ śaktamartheṣvalolupam ॥9॥
html:
matismṛtisamāyuktaṃ vinītaṃ samadarśanam ।
kārye vivadamānānāṃ śaktamartheṣvalolupam ॥9॥
slp1: matismftisamAyuktaM vinItaM samadarSanam । kArye vivadamAnAnAM SaktamarTezvalolupam ॥9॥

text: vivarjitānāṃ vyasanaiḥ sughoraiḥ saptabhirbhṛśam । aṣṭānāṃ mantriṇāṃ madhye mantraṃ rājopadhārayet ॥10॥
html:
vivarjitānāṃ vyasanaiḥ sughoraiḥ saptabhirbhṛśam ।
aṣṭānāṃ mantriṇāṃ madhye mantraṃ rājopadhārayet ॥10॥
slp1: vivarjitAnAM vyasanEH suGorEH saptaBirBfSam । azwAnAM mantriRAM maDye mantraM rAjopaDArayet ॥10॥

text: tataḥ sampreṣayedrāṣṭre rāṣṭrāyātha ca darśayet । anena vyavahāreṇa draṣṭavyāste prajāḥ sadā ॥11॥
html:
tataḥ sampreṣayedrāṣṭre rāṣṭrāyātha ca darśayet ।
anena vyavahāreṇa draṣṭavyāste prajāḥ sadā ॥11॥
slp1: tataH samprezayedrAzwre rAzwrAyATa ca darSayet । anena vyavahAreRa drazwavyAste prajAH sadA ॥11॥

text: na cāpi gūḍhaṃ kāryaṃ te grāhyaṃ kāryopaghātakam । kārye khalu vipanne tvāṃ so'dharmastāṃśca pīḍayet ॥12॥
html:
na cāpi gūḍhaṃ kāryaṃ te grāhyaṃ kāryopaghātakam ।
kārye khalu vipanne tvāṃ so'dharmastāṃśca pīḍayet ॥12॥
slp1: na cApi gUQaM kAryaM te grAhyaM kAryopaGAtakam । kArye Kalu vipanne tvAM so'DarmastAMSca pIqayet ॥12॥

text: vidraveccaiva rāṣṭraṃ te śyenātpakṣigaṇā iva । parisravecca satataṃ naurviśīrṇeva sāgare ॥13॥
html:
vidraveccaiva rāṣṭraṃ te śyenātpakṣigaṇā iva ।
parisravecca satataṃ naurviśīrṇeva sāgare ॥13॥
slp1: vidraveccEva rAzwraM te SyenAtpakzigaRA iva । parisravecca satataM nOrviSIrReva sAgare ॥13॥

text: prajāḥ pālayato'samyagadharmeṇeha bhūpateḥ । hārdaṃ bhayaṃ sambhavati svargaścāsya virudhyate ॥14॥
html:
prajāḥ pālayato'samyagadharmeṇeha bhūpateḥ ।
hārdaṃ bhayaṃ sambhavati svargaścāsya virudhyate ॥14॥
slp1: prajAH pAlayato'samyagaDarmeReha BUpateH । hArdaM BayaM samBavati svargaScAsya viruDyate ॥14॥

text: atha yo'dharmataḥ pāti rājāmātyo'tha vātmajaḥ । dharmāsane niyuktaḥ sandharmamūlaṃ nararṣabha ॥15॥
html:
atha yo'dharmataḥ pāti rājāmātyo'tha vātmajaḥ ।
dharmāsane niyuktaḥ sandharmamūlaṃ nararṣabha ॥15॥
slp1: aTa yo'DarmataH pAti rAjAmAtyo'Ta vAtmajaH । DarmAsane niyuktaH sanDarmamUlaM nararzaBa ॥15॥

text: kāryeṣvadhikṛtāḥ samyagakurvanto nṛpānugāḥ । ātmānaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā yāntyadhaḥ sahapārthivāḥ ॥16॥
html:
kāryeṣvadhikṛtāḥ samyagakurvanto nṛpānugāḥ ।
ātmānaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā yāntyadhaḥ sahapārthivāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: kAryezvaDikftAH samyagakurvanto nfpAnugAH । AtmAnaM purataH kftvA yAntyaDaH sahapArTivAH ॥16॥

text: balātkṛtānāṃ balibhiḥ kṛpaṇaṃ bahu jalpatām । nātho vai bhūmipo nityamanāthānāṃ nṛṇāṃ bhavet ॥17॥
html:
balātkṛtānāṃ balibhiḥ kṛpaṇaṃ bahu jalpatām ।
nātho vai bhūmipo nityamanāthānāṃ nṛṇāṃ bhavet ॥17॥
slp1: balAtkftAnAM baliBiH kfpaRaM bahu jalpatAm । nATo vE BUmipo nityamanATAnAM nfRAM Bavet ॥17॥

text: tataḥ sākṣibalaṃ sādhu dvaidhe vādakṛtaṃ bhavet । asākṣikamanāthaṃ vā parīkṣyaṃ tadviśeṣataḥ ॥18॥
html:
tataḥ sākṣibalaṃ sādhu dvaidhe vādakṛtaṃ bhavet ।
asākṣikamanāthaṃ vā parīkṣyaṃ tadviśeṣataḥ ॥18॥
slp1: tataH sAkzibalaM sADu dvEDe vAdakftaM Bavet । asAkzikamanATaM vA parIkzyaM tadviSezataH ॥18॥

text: aparādhānurūpaṃ ca daṇḍaṃ pāpeṣu pātayet । udvejayeddhanairṛddhāndaridrānvadhabandhanaiḥ ॥19॥
html:
aparādhānurūpaṃ ca daṇḍaṃ pāpeṣu pātayet ।
udvejayeddhanairṛddhāndaridrānvadhabandhanaiḥ ॥19॥
slp1: aparADAnurUpaM ca daRqaM pApezu pAtayet । udvejayedDanErfdDAndaridrAnvaDabanDanEH ॥19॥

text: vinayairapi durvṛttānprahārairapi pārthivaḥ । sāntvenopapradānena śiṣṭāṃśca paripālayet ॥20॥
html:
vinayairapi durvṛttānprahārairapi pārthivaḥ ।
sāntvenopapradānena śiṣṭāṃśca paripālayet ॥20॥
slp1: vinayErapi durvfttAnprahArErapi pArTivaH । sAntvenopapradAnena SizwAMSca paripAlayet ॥20॥

text: rājño vadhaṃ cikīrṣedyastasya citro vadho bhavet । ājīvakasya stenasya varṇasaṅkarakasya ca ॥21॥
html:
rājño vadhaṃ cikīrṣedyastasya citro vadho bhavet ।
ājīvakasya stenasya varṇasaṅkarakasya ca ॥21॥
slp1: rAjYo vaDaM cikIrzedyastasya citro vaDo Bavet । AjIvakasya stenasya varRasaNkarakasya ca ॥21॥

text: samyakpraṇayato daṇḍaṃ bhūmipasya viśāmpate । yuktasya vā nāstyadharmo dharma eveha śāśvataḥ ॥22॥
html:
samyakpraṇayato daṇḍaṃ bhūmipasya viśāmpate ।
yuktasya vā nāstyadharmo dharma eveha śāśvataḥ ॥22॥
slp1: samyakpraRayato daRqaM BUmipasya viSAmpate । yuktasya vA nAstyaDarmo Darma eveha SASvataH ॥22॥

text: kāmakāreṇa daṇḍaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādavicakṣaṇaḥ । sa ihākīrtisaṃyukto mṛto narakamāpnuyāt ॥23॥
html:
kāmakāreṇa daṇḍaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādavicakṣaṇaḥ ।
sa ihākīrtisaṃyukto mṛto narakamāpnuyāt ॥23॥
slp1: kAmakAreRa daRqaM tu yaH kuryAdavicakzaRaH । sa ihAkIrtisaMyukto mfto narakamApnuyAt ॥23॥

text: na parasya śravādeva pareṣāṃ daṇḍamarpayet । āgamānugamaṃ kṛtvā badhnīyānmokṣayeta vā ॥24॥
html:
na parasya śravādeva pareṣāṃ daṇḍamarpayet ।
āgamānugamaṃ kṛtvā badhnīyānmokṣayeta vā ॥24॥
slp1: na parasya SravAdeva parezAM daRqamarpayet । AgamAnugamaM kftvA baDnIyAnmokzayeta vA ॥24॥

text: na tu hanyānnṛpo jātu dūtaṃ kasyāñcidāpadi । dūtasya hantā nirayamāviśetsacivaiḥ saha ॥25॥
html:
na tu hanyānnṛpo jātu dūtaṃ kasyāñcidāpadi ।
dūtasya hantā nirayamāviśetsacivaiḥ saha ॥25॥
slp1: na tu hanyAnnfpo jAtu dUtaM kasyAYcidApadi । dUtasya hantA nirayamAviSetsacivEH saha ॥25॥

text: yathoktavādinaṃ dūtaṃ kṣatradharmarato nṛpaḥ । yo hanyātpitarastasya bhrūṇahatyāmavāpnuyuḥ ॥26॥
html:
yathoktavādinaṃ dūtaṃ kṣatradharmarato nṛpaḥ ।
yo hanyātpitarastasya bhrūṇahatyāmavāpnuyuḥ ॥26॥
slp1: yaToktavAdinaM dUtaM kzatraDarmarato nfpaH । yo hanyAtpitarastasya BrURahatyAmavApnuyuH ॥26॥

text: kulīnaḥ śīlasampanno vāgmī dakṣaḥ priyaṃvadaḥ । yathoktavādī smṛtimāndūtaḥ syātsaptabhirguṇaiḥ ॥27॥
html:
kulīnaḥ śīlasampanno vāgmī dakṣaḥ priyaṃvadaḥ ।
yathoktavādī smṛtimāndūtaḥ syātsaptabhirguṇaiḥ ॥27॥
slp1: kulInaH SIlasampanno vAgmI dakzaH priyaMvadaH । yaToktavAdI smftimAndUtaH syAtsaptaBirguREH ॥27॥

text: etaireva guṇairyuktaḥ pratīhāro'sya rakṣitā । śirorakṣaśca bhavati guṇairetaiḥ samanvitaḥ ॥28॥
html:
etaireva guṇairyuktaḥ pratīhāro'sya rakṣitā ।
śirorakṣaśca bhavati guṇairetaiḥ samanvitaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: etEreva guREryuktaH pratIhAro'sya rakzitA । SirorakzaSca Bavati guREretEH samanvitaH ॥28॥

text: dharmārthaśāstratattvajñaḥ sandhivigrahako bhavet । matimāndhṛtimāndhīmānrahasyavinigūhitā ॥29॥
html:
dharmārthaśāstratattvajñaḥ sandhivigrahako bhavet ।
matimāndhṛtimāndhīmānrahasyavinigūhitā ॥29॥
slp1: DarmArTaSAstratattvajYaH sanDivigrahako Bavet । matimAnDftimAnDImAnrahasyavinigUhitA ॥29॥

text: kulīnaḥ satyasampannaḥ śakto'mātyaḥ praśaṃsitaḥ । etaireva guṇairyuktastathā senāpatirbhavet ॥30॥
html:
kulīnaḥ satyasampannaḥ śakto'mātyaḥ praśaṃsitaḥ ।
etaireva guṇairyuktastathā senāpatirbhavet ॥30॥
slp1: kulInaH satyasampannaH Sakto'mAtyaH praSaMsitaH । etEreva guREryuktastaTA senApatirBavet ॥30॥

text: vyūhayantrāyudhīyānāṃ tattvajño vikramānvitaḥ । varṣaśītoṣṇavātānāṃ sahiṣṇuḥ pararandhravit ॥31॥
html:
vyūhayantrāyudhīyānāṃ tattvajño vikramānvitaḥ ।
varṣaśītoṣṇavātānāṃ sahiṣṇuḥ pararandhravit ॥31॥
slp1: vyUhayantrAyuDIyAnAM tattvajYo vikramAnvitaH । varzaSItozRavAtAnAM sahizRuH pararanDravit ॥31॥

text: viśvāsayetparāṃścaiva viśvasenna tu kasyacit । putreṣvapi hi rājendra viśvāso na praśasyate ॥32॥
html:
viśvāsayetparāṃścaiva viśvasenna tu kasyacit ।
putreṣvapi hi rājendra viśvāso na praśasyate ॥32॥
slp1: viSvAsayetparAMScEva viSvasenna tu kasyacit । putrezvapi hi rAjendra viSvAso na praSasyate ॥32॥

text: etacchāstrārthatattvaṃ tu tavākhyātaṃ mayānagha । aviśvāso narendrāṇāṃ guhyaṃ paramamucyate] ॥33॥
html:
etacchāstrārthatattvaṃ tu tavākhyātaṃ mayānagha ।
aviśvāso narendrāṇāṃ guhyaṃ paramamucyate] ॥33॥
slp1: etacCAstrArTatattvaM tu tavAKyAtaM mayAnaGa । aviSvAso narendrARAM guhyaM paramamucyate] ॥33॥

text: kathaṃvidhaṃ puraṃ rājā svayamāvastumarhati । kṛtaṃ vā kārayitvā vā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
kathaṃvidhaṃ puraṃ rājā svayamāvastumarhati ।
kṛtaṃ vā kārayitvā vā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: kaTaMviDaM puraM rAjA svayamAvastumarhati । kftaM vA kArayitvA vA tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: yatra kaunteya vastavyaṃ saputrabhrātṛbandhunā । nyāyyaṃ tatra paripraṣṭuṃ guptiṃ vṛttiṃ ca bhārata ॥2॥
html:
yatra kaunteya vastavyaṃ saputrabhrātṛbandhunā ।
nyāyyaṃ tatra paripraṣṭuṃ guptiṃ vṛttiṃ ca bhārata ॥2॥
slp1: yatra kOnteya vastavyaM saputraBrAtfbanDunA । nyAyyaM tatra pariprazwuM guptiM vfttiM ca BArata ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tasmātte vartayiṣyāmi durgakarma viśeṣataḥ । śrutvā tathā vidhātavyamanuṣṭheyaṃ ca yatnataḥ ॥3॥
html:
tasmātte vartayiṣyāmi durgakarma viśeṣataḥ ।
śrutvā tathā vidhātavyamanuṣṭheyaṃ ca yatnataḥ ॥3॥
slp1: tasmAtte vartayizyAmi durgakarma viSezataH । SrutvA taTA viDAtavyamanuzWeyaM ca yatnataH ॥3॥

text: ṣaḍvidhaṃ durgamāsthāya purāṇyatha niveśayet । sarvasampatpradhānaṃ yadbāhulyaṃ vāpi sambhavet ॥4॥
html:
ṣaḍvidhaṃ durgamāsthāya purāṇyatha niveśayet ।
sarvasampatpradhānaṃ yadbāhulyaṃ vāpi sambhavet ॥4॥
slp1: zaqviDaM durgamAsTAya purARyaTa niveSayet । sarvasampatpraDAnaM yadbAhulyaM vApi samBavet ॥4॥

text: dhanvadurgaṃ mahīdurgaṃ giridurgaṃ tathaiva ca । manuṣyadurgamabdurgaṃ vanadurgaṃ ca tāni ṣaṭ ॥5॥
html:
dhanvadurgaṃ mahīdurgaṃ giridurgaṃ tathaiva ca ।
manuṣyadurgamabdurgaṃ vanadurgaṃ ca tāni ṣaṭ ॥5॥
slp1: DanvadurgaM mahIdurgaM giridurgaM taTEva ca । manuzyadurgamabdurgaM vanadurgaM ca tAni zaw ॥5॥

text: yatpuraṃ durgasampannaṃ dhānyāyudhasamanvitam । dṛḍhaprākāraparikhaṃ hastyaśvarathasaṅkulam ॥6॥
html:
yatpuraṃ durgasampannaṃ dhānyāyudhasamanvitam ।
dṛḍhaprākāraparikhaṃ hastyaśvarathasaṅkulam ॥6॥
slp1: yatpuraM durgasampannaM DAnyAyuDasamanvitam । dfQaprAkArapariKaM hastyaSvaraTasaNkulam ॥6॥

text: vidvāṃsaḥ śilpino yatra nicayāśca susañcitāḥ । dhārmikaśca jano yatra dākṣyamuttamamāsthitaḥ ॥7॥
html:
vidvāṃsaḥ śilpino yatra nicayāśca susañcitāḥ ।
dhārmikaśca jano yatra dākṣyamuttamamāsthitaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: vidvAMsaH Silpino yatra nicayASca susaYcitAH । DArmikaSca jano yatra dAkzyamuttamamAsTitaH ॥7॥

text: ūrjasvinaranāgāśvaṃ catvarāpaṇaśobhitam । prasiddhavyavahāraṃ ca praśāntamakutobhayam ॥8॥
html:
ūrjasvinaranāgāśvaṃ catvarāpaṇaśobhitam ।
prasiddhavyavahāraṃ ca praśāntamakutobhayam ॥8॥
slp1: UrjasvinaranAgASvaM catvarApaRaSoBitam । prasidDavyavahAraM ca praSAntamakutoBayam ॥8॥

text: suprabhaṃ sānunādaṃ ca supraśastaniveśanam । śūrāḍhyajanasampannaṃ brahmaghoṣānunāditam ॥9॥
html:
suprabhaṃ sānunādaṃ ca supraśastaniveśanam ।
śūrāḍhyajanasampannaṃ brahmaghoṣānunāditam ॥9॥
slp1: supraBaM sAnunAdaM ca supraSastaniveSanam । SUrAQyajanasampannaM brahmaGozAnunAditam ॥9॥

text: samājotsavasampannaṃ sadāpūjitadaivatam । vaśyāmātyabalo rājā tatpuraṃ svayamāvaset ॥10॥
html:
samājotsavasampannaṃ sadāpūjitadaivatam ।
vaśyāmātyabalo rājā tatpuraṃ svayamāvaset ॥10॥
slp1: samAjotsavasampannaM sadApUjitadEvatam । vaSyAmAtyabalo rAjA tatpuraM svayamAvaset ॥10॥

text: tatra kośaṃ balaṃ mitraṃ vyavahāraṃ ca vardhayet । pure janapade caiva sarvadoṣānnivartayet ॥11॥
html:
tatra kośaṃ balaṃ mitraṃ vyavahāraṃ ca vardhayet ।
pure janapade caiva sarvadoṣānnivartayet ॥11॥
slp1: tatra koSaM balaM mitraM vyavahAraM ca varDayet । pure janapade cEva sarvadozAnnivartayet ॥11॥

text: bhāṇḍāgārāyudhāgāraṃ prayatnenābhivardhayet । nicayānvardhayetsarvāṃstathā yantragadāgadān ॥12॥
html:
bhāṇḍāgārāyudhāgāraṃ prayatnenābhivardhayet ।
nicayānvardhayetsarvāṃstathā yantragadāgadān ॥12॥
slp1: BARqAgArAyuDAgAraM prayatnenABivarDayet । nicayAnvarDayetsarvAMstaTA yantragadAgadAn ॥12॥

text: kāṣṭhalohatuṣāṅgāradāruśṛṅgāsthivaiṇavān । majjāsnehavasākṣaudramauṣadhagrāmameva ca ॥13॥
html:
kāṣṭhalohatuṣāṅgāradāruśṛṅgāsthivaiṇavān ।
majjāsnehavasākṣaudramauṣadhagrāmameva ca ॥13॥
slp1: kAzWalohatuzANgAradAruSfNgAsTivERavAn । majjAsnehavasAkzOdramOzaDagrAmameva ca ॥13॥

text: śaṇaṃ sarjarasaṃ dhānyamāyudhāni śarāṃstathā । carma snāyu tathā vetraṃ muñjabalbajadhanvanān ॥14॥
html:
śaṇaṃ sarjarasaṃ dhānyamāyudhāni śarāṃstathā ।
carma snāyu tathā vetraṃ muñjabalbajadhanvanān ॥14॥
slp1: SaRaM sarjarasaM DAnyamAyuDAni SarAMstaTA । carma snAyu taTA vetraM muYjabalbajaDanvanAn ॥14॥

text: āśayāścodapānāśca prabhūtasalilā varāḥ । niroddhavyāḥ sadā rājñā kṣīriṇaśca mahīruhāḥ ॥15॥
html:
āśayāścodapānāśca prabhūtasalilā varāḥ ।
niroddhavyāḥ sadā rājñā kṣīriṇaśca mahīruhāḥ ॥15॥
slp1: ASayAScodapAnASca praBUtasalilA varAH । nirodDavyAH sadA rAjYA kzIriRaSca mahIruhAH ॥15॥

text: satkṛtāśca prayatnena ācāryartvikpurohitāḥ । maheṣvāsāḥ sthapatayaḥ sāṃvatsaracikitsakāḥ ॥16॥
html:
satkṛtāśca prayatnena ācāryartvikpurohitāḥ ।
maheṣvāsāḥ sthapatayaḥ sāṃvatsaracikitsakāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: satkftASca prayatnena AcAryartvikpurohitAH । mahezvAsAH sTapatayaH sAMvatsaracikitsakAH ॥16॥

text: prājñā medhāvino dāntā dakṣāḥ śūrā bahuśrutāḥ । kulīnāḥ sattvasampannā yuktāḥ sarveṣu karmasu ॥17॥
html:
prājñā medhāvino dāntā dakṣāḥ śūrā bahuśrutāḥ ।
kulīnāḥ sattvasampannā yuktāḥ sarveṣu karmasu ॥17॥
slp1: prAjYA meDAvino dAntA dakzAH SUrA bahuSrutAH । kulInAH sattvasampannA yuktAH sarvezu karmasu ॥17॥

text: pūjayeddhārmikānrājā nigṛhṇīyādadhārmikān । niyuñjyācca prayatnena sarvavarṇānsvakarmasu ॥18॥
html:
pūjayeddhārmikānrājā nigṛhṇīyādadhārmikān ।
niyuñjyācca prayatnena sarvavarṇānsvakarmasu ॥18॥
slp1: pUjayedDArmikAnrAjA nigfhRIyAdaDArmikAn । niyuYjyAcca prayatnena sarvavarRAnsvakarmasu ॥18॥

text: bāhyamābhyantaraṃ caiva paurajānapadaṃ janam । cāraiḥ suviditaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ karma prayojayet ॥19॥
html:
bāhyamābhyantaraṃ caiva paurajānapadaṃ janam ।
cāraiḥ suviditaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ karma prayojayet ॥19॥
slp1: bAhyamAByantaraM cEva pOrajAnapadaM janam । cArEH suviditaM kftvA tataH karma prayojayet ॥19॥

text: cārānmantraṃ ca kośaṃ ca mantraṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ । anutiṣṭhetsvayaṃ rājā sarvaṃ hyatra pratiṣṭhitam ॥20॥
html:
cārānmantraṃ ca kośaṃ ca mantraṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ ।
anutiṣṭhetsvayaṃ rājā sarvaṃ hyatra pratiṣṭhitam ॥20॥
slp1: cArAnmantraM ca koSaM ca mantraM cEva viSezataH । anutizWetsvayaM rAjA sarvaM hyatra pratizWitam ॥20॥

text: udāsīnārimitrāṇāṃ sarvameva cikīrṣitam । pure janapade caiva jñātavyaṃ cāracakṣuṣā ॥21॥
html:
udāsīnārimitrāṇāṃ sarvameva cikīrṣitam ।
pure janapade caiva jñātavyaṃ cāracakṣuṣā ॥21॥
slp1: udAsInArimitrARAM sarvameva cikIrzitam । pure janapade cEva jYAtavyaM cAracakzuzA ॥21॥

text: tatastathā vidhātavyaṃ sarvamevāpramādataḥ । bhaktānpūjayatā nityaṃ dviṣataśca nigṛhṇatā ॥22॥
html:
tatastathā vidhātavyaṃ sarvamevāpramādataḥ ।
bhaktānpūjayatā nityaṃ dviṣataśca nigṛhṇatā ॥22॥
slp1: tatastaTA viDAtavyaM sarvamevApramAdataH । BaktAnpUjayatA nityaM dvizataSca nigfhRatA ॥22॥

text: yaṣṭavyaṃ kratubhirnityaṃ dātavyaṃ cāpyapīḍayā । prajānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ na kāryaṃ karma garhitam ॥23॥
html:
yaṣṭavyaṃ kratubhirnityaṃ dātavyaṃ cāpyapīḍayā ।
prajānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ na kāryaṃ karma garhitam ॥23॥
slp1: yazwavyaM kratuBirnityaM dAtavyaM cApyapIqayA । prajAnAM rakzaRaM kAryaM na kAryaM karma garhitam ॥23॥

text: kṛpaṇānāthavṛddhānāṃ vidhavānāṃ ca yoṣitām । yogakṣemaṃ ca vṛttiṃ ca nityameva prakalpayet ॥24॥
html:
kṛpaṇānāthavṛddhānāṃ vidhavānāṃ ca yoṣitām ।
yogakṣemaṃ ca vṛttiṃ ca nityameva prakalpayet ॥24॥
slp1: kfpaRAnATavfdDAnAM viDavAnAM ca yozitAm । yogakzemaM ca vfttiM ca nityameva prakalpayet ॥24॥

text: āśrameṣu yathākālaṃ celabhājanabhojanam । sadaivopaharedrājā satkṛtyānavamanya ca ॥25॥
html:
āśrameṣu yathākālaṃ celabhājanabhojanam ।
sadaivopaharedrājā satkṛtyānavamanya ca ॥25॥
slp1: ASramezu yaTAkAlaM celaBAjanaBojanam । sadEvopaharedrAjA satkftyAnavamanya ca ॥25॥

text: ātmānaṃ sarvakāryāṇi tāpase rājyameva ca । nivedayetprayatnena tiṣṭhetprahvaśca sarvadā ॥26॥
html:
ātmānaṃ sarvakāryāṇi tāpase rājyameva ca ।
nivedayetprayatnena tiṣṭhetprahvaśca sarvadā ॥26॥
slp1: AtmAnaM sarvakAryARi tApase rAjyameva ca । nivedayetprayatnena tizWetprahvaSca sarvadA ॥26॥

text: sarvārthatyāginaṃ rājā kule jātaṃ bahuśrutam । pūjayettādṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvā śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ ॥27॥
html:
sarvārthatyāginaṃ rājā kule jātaṃ bahuśrutam ।
pūjayettādṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvā śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ ॥27॥
slp1: sarvArTatyAginaM rAjA kule jAtaM bahuSrutam । pUjayettAdfSaM dfzwvA SayanAsanaBojanEH ॥27॥

text: tasminkurvīta viśvāsaṃ rājā kasyāñcidāpadi । tāpaseṣu hi viśvāsamapi kurvanti dasyavaḥ ॥28॥
html:
tasminkurvīta viśvāsaṃ rājā kasyāñcidāpadi ।
tāpaseṣu hi viśvāsamapi kurvanti dasyavaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: tasminkurvIta viSvAsaM rAjA kasyAYcidApadi । tApasezu hi viSvAsamapi kurvanti dasyavaH ॥28॥

text: tasminnidhīnādadhīta prajñāṃ paryādadīta ca । na cāpyabhīkṣṇaṃ seveta bhṛśaṃ vā pratipūjayet ॥29॥
html:
tasminnidhīnādadhīta prajñāṃ paryādadīta ca ।
na cāpyabhīkṣṇaṃ seveta bhṛśaṃ vā pratipūjayet ॥29॥
slp1: tasminniDInAdaDIta prajYAM paryAdadIta ca । na cApyaBIkzRaM seveta BfSaM vA pratipUjayet ॥29॥

text: anyaḥ kāryaḥ svarāṣṭreṣu pararāṣṭreṣu cāparaḥ । aṭavīṣvaparaḥ kāryaḥ sāmantanagareṣu ca ॥30॥
html:
anyaḥ kāryaḥ svarāṣṭreṣu pararāṣṭreṣu cāparaḥ ।
aṭavīṣvaparaḥ kāryaḥ sāmantanagareṣu ca ॥30॥
slp1: anyaH kAryaH svarAzwrezu pararAzwrezu cAparaH । awavIzvaparaH kAryaH sAmantanagarezu ca ॥30॥

text: teṣu satkārasaṃskārānsaṃvibhāgāṃśca kārayet । pararāṣṭrāṭavīstheṣu yathā svaviṣaye tathā ॥31॥
html:
teṣu satkārasaṃskārānsaṃvibhāgāṃśca kārayet ।
pararāṣṭrāṭavīstheṣu yathā svaviṣaye tathā ॥31॥
slp1: tezu satkArasaMskArAnsaMviBAgAMSca kArayet । pararAzwrAwavIsTezu yaTA svavizaye taTA ॥31॥

text: te kasyāñcidavasthāyāṃ śaraṇaṃ śaraṇārthine । rājñe dadyuryathākāmaṃ tāpasāḥ saṃśitavratāḥ ॥32॥
html:
te kasyāñcidavasthāyāṃ śaraṇaṃ śaraṇārthine ।
rājñe dadyuryathākāmaṃ tāpasāḥ saṃśitavratāḥ ॥32॥
slp1: te kasyAYcidavasTAyAM SaraRaM SaraRArTine । rAjYe dadyuryaTAkAmaM tApasAH saMSitavratAH ॥32॥

text: eṣa te lakṣaṇoddeśaḥ saṅkṣepeṇa prakīrtitaḥ । yādṛśaṃ nagaraṃ rājā svayamāvastumarhati] ॥33॥
html:
eṣa te lakṣaṇoddeśaḥ saṅkṣepeṇa prakīrtitaḥ ।
yādṛśaṃ nagaraṃ rājā svayamāvastumarhati] ॥33॥
slp1: eza te lakzaRoddeSaH saNkzepeRa prakIrtitaH । yAdfSaM nagaraM rAjA svayamAvastumarhati] ॥33॥

text: rāṣṭraguptiṃ ca me rājanrāṣṭrasyaiva ca saṅgraham । samyagjijñāsamānāya prabrūhi bharatarṣabha ॥1॥
html:
rāṣṭraguptiṃ ca me rājanrāṣṭrasyaiva ca saṅgraham ।
samyagjijñāsamānāya prabrūhi bharatarṣabha ॥1॥
slp1: rAzwraguptiM ca me rAjanrAzwrasyEva ca saNgraham । samyagjijYAsamAnAya prabrUhi BaratarzaBa ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: rāṣṭraguptiṃ ca te samyagrāṣṭrasyaiva ca saṅgraham । hanta sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi tattvamekamanāḥ śṛṇu ॥2॥
html:
rāṣṭraguptiṃ ca te samyagrāṣṭrasyaiva ca saṅgraham ।
hanta sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi tattvamekamanāḥ śṛṇu ॥2॥
slp1: rAzwraguptiM ca te samyagrAzwrasyEva ca saNgraham । hanta sarvaM pravakzyAmi tattvamekamanAH SfRu ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: grāmasyādhipatiḥ kāryo daśagrāmyastathāparaḥ । dviguṇāyāḥ śatasyaivaṃ sahasrasya ca kārayet ॥3॥
html:
grāmasyādhipatiḥ kāryo daśagrāmyastathāparaḥ ।
dviguṇāyāḥ śatasyaivaṃ sahasrasya ca kārayet ॥3॥
slp1: grAmasyADipatiH kAryo daSagrAmyastaTAparaH । dviguRAyAH SatasyEvaM sahasrasya ca kArayet ॥3॥

text: grāme yāngrāmadoṣāṃśca grāmikaḥ paripālayet । tānbrūyāddaśapāyāsau sa tu viṃśatipāya vai ॥4॥
html:
grāme yāngrāmadoṣāṃśca grāmikaḥ paripālayet ।
tānbrūyāddaśapāyāsau sa tu viṃśatipāya vai ॥4॥
slp1: grAme yAngrAmadozAMSca grAmikaH paripAlayet । tAnbrUyAddaSapAyAsO sa tu viMSatipAya vE ॥4॥

text: so'pi viṃśatyadhipatirvṛttaṃ jānapade jane । grāmāṇāṃ śatapālāya sarvameva nivedayet ॥5॥
html:
so'pi viṃśatyadhipatirvṛttaṃ jānapade jane ।
grāmāṇāṃ śatapālāya sarvameva nivedayet ॥5॥
slp1: so'pi viMSatyaDipatirvfttaM jAnapade jane । grAmARAM SatapAlAya sarvameva nivedayet ॥5॥

text: yāni grāmīṇabhojyāni grāmikastānyupāśnuyāt । daśapastena bhartavyastenāpi dviguṇādhipaḥ ॥6॥
html:
yāni grāmīṇabhojyāni grāmikastānyupāśnuyāt ।
daśapastena bhartavyastenāpi dviguṇādhipaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: yAni grAmIRaBojyAni grAmikastAnyupASnuyAt । daSapastena BartavyastenApi dviguRADipaH ॥6॥

text: grāmaṃ grāmaśatādhyakṣo bhoktumarhati satkṛtaḥ । mahāntaṃ bharataśreṣṭha susphītajanasaṅkulam । tatra hyanekamāyattaṃ rājño bhavati bhārata ॥7॥
html:
grāmaṃ grāmaśatādhyakṣo bhoktumarhati satkṛtaḥ ।
mahāntaṃ bharataśreṣṭha susphītajanasaṅkulam ।
tatra hyanekamāyattaṃ rājño bhavati bhārata ॥7॥
slp1: grAmaM grAmaSatADyakzo Boktumarhati satkftaH । mahAntaM BarataSrezWa susPItajanasaNkulam । tatra hyanekamAyattaM rAjYo Bavati BArata ॥7॥

text: śākhānagaramarhastu sahasrapatiruttamam । dhānyahairaṇyabhogena bhoktuṃ rāṣṭriya udyataḥ ॥8॥
html:
śākhānagaramarhastu sahasrapatiruttamam ।
dhānyahairaṇyabhogena bhoktuṃ rāṣṭriya udyataḥ ॥8॥
slp1: SAKAnagaramarhastu sahasrapatiruttamam । DAnyahEraRyaBogena BoktuM rAzwriya udyataH ॥8॥

text: tathā yadgrāmakṛtyaṃ syādgrāmikṛtyaṃ ca te svayam । dharmajñaḥ sacivaḥ kaścittatprapaśyedatandritaḥ ॥9॥
html:
tathā yadgrāmakṛtyaṃ syādgrāmikṛtyaṃ ca te svayam ।
dharmajñaḥ sacivaḥ kaścittatprapaśyedatandritaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: taTA yadgrAmakftyaM syAdgrAmikftyaM ca te svayam । DarmajYaH sacivaH kaScittatprapaSyedatandritaH ॥9॥

text: nagare nagare ca syādekaḥ sarvārthacintakaḥ । uccaiḥsthāne ghorarūpo nakṣatrāṇāmiva grahaḥ । bhavetsa tānparikrāmetsarvāneva sadā svayam ॥10॥
html:
nagare nagare ca syādekaḥ sarvārthacintakaḥ ।
uccaiḥsthāne ghorarūpo nakṣatrāṇāmiva grahaḥ ।
bhavetsa tānparikrāmetsarvāneva sadā svayam ॥10॥
slp1: nagare nagare ca syAdekaH sarvArTacintakaH । uccEHsTAne GorarUpo nakzatrARAmiva grahaH । Bavetsa tAnparikrAmetsarvAneva sadA svayam ॥10॥

text: vikrayaṃ krayamadhvānaṃ bhaktaṃ ca saparivyayam । yogakṣemaṃ ca samprekṣya vaṇijaḥ kārayetkarān ॥11॥
html:
vikrayaṃ krayamadhvānaṃ bhaktaṃ ca saparivyayam ।
yogakṣemaṃ ca samprekṣya vaṇijaḥ kārayetkarān ॥11॥
slp1: vikrayaM krayamaDvAnaM BaktaM ca saparivyayam । yogakzemaM ca samprekzya vaRijaH kArayetkarAn ॥11॥

text: utpattiṃ dānavṛttiṃ ca śilpaṃ samprekṣya cāsakṛt । śilpapratikarāneva śilpinaḥ prati kārayet ॥12॥
html:
utpattiṃ dānavṛttiṃ ca śilpaṃ samprekṣya cāsakṛt ।
śilpapratikarāneva śilpinaḥ prati kārayet ॥12॥
slp1: utpattiM dAnavfttiM ca SilpaM samprekzya cAsakft । SilpapratikarAneva SilpinaH prati kArayet ॥12॥

text: uccāvacakarā nyāyyāḥ pūrvarājñāṃ yudhiṣṭhira । yathā yathā na hīyeraṃstathā kuryānmahīpatiḥ ॥13॥
html:
uccāvacakarā nyāyyāḥ pūrvarājñāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
yathā yathā na hīyeraṃstathā kuryānmahīpatiḥ ॥13॥
slp1: uccAvacakarA nyAyyAH pUrvarAjYAM yuDizWira । yaTA yaTA na hIyeraMstaTA kuryAnmahIpatiH ॥13॥

text: phalaṃ karma ca samprekṣya tataḥ sarvaṃ prakalpayet । phalaṃ karma ca nirhetu na kaścitsampravartayet ॥14॥
html:
phalaṃ karma ca samprekṣya tataḥ sarvaṃ prakalpayet ।
phalaṃ karma ca nirhetu na kaścitsampravartayet ॥14॥
slp1: PalaM karma ca samprekzya tataH sarvaM prakalpayet । PalaM karma ca nirhetu na kaScitsampravartayet ॥14॥

text: yathā rājā ca kartā ca syātāṃ karmaṇi bhāginau । samavekṣya tathā rājñā praṇeyāḥ satataṃ karāḥ ॥15॥
html:
yathā rājā ca kartā ca syātāṃ karmaṇi bhāginau ।
samavekṣya tathā rājñā praṇeyāḥ satataṃ karāḥ ॥15॥
slp1: yaTA rAjA ca kartA ca syAtAM karmaRi BAginO । samavekzya taTA rAjYA praReyAH satataM karAH ॥15॥

text: nocchindyādātmano mūlaṃ pareṣāṃ vāpi tṛṣṇayā । īhādvārāṇi saṃrudhya rājā samprītidarśanaḥ ॥16॥
html:
nocchindyādātmano mūlaṃ pareṣāṃ vāpi tṛṣṇayā ।
īhādvārāṇi saṃrudhya rājā samprītidarśanaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: nocCindyAdAtmano mUlaM parezAM vApi tfzRayA । IhAdvArARi saMruDya rAjA samprItidarSanaH ॥16॥

text: pradviṣanti parikhyātaṃ rājānamatikhādinam । pradviṣṭasya kutaḥ śreyaḥ saṃpriyo labhate priyam ॥17॥
html:
pradviṣanti parikhyātaṃ rājānamatikhādinam ।
pradviṣṭasya kutaḥ śreyaḥ saṃpriyo labhate priyam ॥17॥
slp1: pradvizanti pariKyAtaM rAjAnamatiKAdinam । pradvizwasya kutaH SreyaH saMpriyo laBate priyam ॥17॥

text: vatsaupamyena dogdhavyaṃ rāṣṭramakṣīṇabuddhinā । bhṛto vatso jātabalaḥ pīḍāṃ sahati bhārata ॥18॥
html:
vatsaupamyena dogdhavyaṃ rāṣṭramakṣīṇabuddhinā ।
bhṛto vatso jātabalaḥ pīḍāṃ sahati bhārata ॥18॥
slp1: vatsOpamyena dogDavyaM rAzwramakzIRabudDinA । Bfto vatso jAtabalaH pIqAM sahati BArata ॥18॥

text: na karma kurute vatso bhṛśaṃ dugdho yudhiṣṭhira । rāṣṭramapyatidugdhaṃ hi na karma kurute mahat ॥19॥
html:
na karma kurute vatso bhṛśaṃ dugdho yudhiṣṭhira ।
rāṣṭramapyatidugdhaṃ hi na karma kurute mahat ॥19॥
slp1: na karma kurute vatso BfSaM dugDo yuDizWira । rAzwramapyatidugDaM hi na karma kurute mahat ॥19॥

text: yo rāṣṭramanugṛhṇāti parigṛhya svayaṃ nṛpaḥ । sañjātamupajīvansa labhate sumahatphalam ॥20॥
html:
yo rāṣṭramanugṛhṇāti parigṛhya svayaṃ nṛpaḥ ।
sañjātamupajīvansa labhate sumahatphalam ॥20॥
slp1: yo rAzwramanugfhRAti parigfhya svayaM nfpaH । saYjAtamupajIvansa laBate sumahatPalam ॥20॥

text: āpadarthaṃ hi nicayānrājāna iha cinvate । rāṣṭraṃ ca kośabhūtaṃ syātkośo veśmagatastathā ॥21॥
html:
āpadarthaṃ hi nicayānrājāna iha cinvate ।
rāṣṭraṃ ca kośabhūtaṃ syātkośo veśmagatastathā ॥21॥
slp1: ApadarTaM hi nicayAnrAjAna iha cinvate । rAzwraM ca koSaBUtaM syAtkoSo veSmagatastaTA ॥21॥

text: paurajānapadānsarvānsaṃśritopāśritāṃstathā । yathāśaktyanukampeta sarvānabhyantarānapi ॥22॥
html:
paurajānapadānsarvānsaṃśritopāśritāṃstathā ।
yathāśaktyanukampeta sarvānabhyantarānapi ॥22॥
slp1: pOrajAnapadAnsarvAnsaMSritopASritAMstaTA । yaTASaktyanukampeta sarvAnaByantarAnapi ॥22॥

text: bāhyaṃ janaṃ bhedayitvā bhoktavyo madhyamaḥ sukham । evaṃ na samprakupyante janāḥ sukhitaduḥkhitāḥ ॥23॥
html:
bāhyaṃ janaṃ bhedayitvā bhoktavyo madhyamaḥ sukham ।
evaṃ na samprakupyante janāḥ sukhitaduḥkhitāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: bAhyaM janaM BedayitvA Boktavyo maDyamaH suKam । evaM na samprakupyante janAH suKitaduHKitAH ॥23॥

text: prāgeva tu karādānamanubhāṣya punaḥ punaḥ । sannipatya svaviṣaye bhayaṃ rāṣṭre pradarśayet ॥24॥
html:
prāgeva tu karādānamanubhāṣya punaḥ punaḥ ।
sannipatya svaviṣaye bhayaṃ rāṣṭre pradarśayet ॥24॥
slp1: prAgeva tu karAdAnamanuBAzya punaH punaH । sannipatya svavizaye BayaM rAzwre pradarSayet ॥24॥

text: iyamāpatsamutpannā paracakrabhayaṃ mahat । api nāntāya kalpeta veṇoriva phalāgamaḥ ॥25॥
html:
iyamāpatsamutpannā paracakrabhayaṃ mahat ।
api nāntāya kalpeta veṇoriva phalāgamaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: iyamApatsamutpannA paracakraBayaM mahat । api nAntAya kalpeta veRoriva PalAgamaH ॥25॥

text: arayo me samutthāya bahubhirdasyubhiḥ saha । idamātmavadhāyaiva rāṣṭramicchanti bādhitum ॥26॥
html:
arayo me samutthāya bahubhirdasyubhiḥ saha ।
idamātmavadhāyaiva rāṣṭramicchanti bādhitum ॥26॥
slp1: arayo me samutTAya bahuBirdasyuBiH saha । idamAtmavaDAyEva rAzwramicCanti bADitum ॥26॥

text: asyāmāpadi ghorāyāṃ samprāpte dāruṇe bhaye । paritrāṇāya bhavatāṃ prārthayiṣye dhanāni vaḥ ॥27॥
html:
asyāmāpadi ghorāyāṃ samprāpte dāruṇe bhaye ।
paritrāṇāya bhavatāṃ prārthayiṣye dhanāni vaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: asyAmApadi GorAyAM samprApte dAruRe Baye । paritrARAya BavatAM prArTayizye DanAni vaH ॥27॥

text: pratidāsye ca bhavatāṃ sarvaṃ cāhaṃ bhayakṣaye । nārayaḥ pratidāsyanti yaddhareyurbalāditaḥ ॥28॥
html:
pratidāsye ca bhavatāṃ sarvaṃ cāhaṃ bhayakṣaye ।
nārayaḥ pratidāsyanti yaddhareyurbalāditaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: pratidAsye ca BavatAM sarvaM cAhaM Bayakzaye । nArayaH pratidAsyanti yadDareyurbalAditaH ॥28॥

text: kalatramāditaḥ kṛtvā naśyetsvaṃ svayameva hi । api cetputradārārthamarthasañcaya iṣyate ॥29॥
html:
kalatramāditaḥ kṛtvā naśyetsvaṃ svayameva hi ।
api cetputradārārthamarthasañcaya iṣyate ॥29॥
slp1: kalatramAditaH kftvA naSyetsvaM svayameva hi । api cetputradArArTamarTasaYcaya izyate ॥29॥

text: nandāmi vaḥ prabhāvena putrāṇāmiva codaye । yathāśaktyanugṛhṇāmi rāṣṭrasyāpīḍayā ca vaḥ ॥30॥
html:
nandāmi vaḥ prabhāvena putrāṇāmiva codaye ।
yathāśaktyanugṛhṇāmi rāṣṭrasyāpīḍayā ca vaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: nandAmi vaH praBAvena putrARAmiva codaye । yaTASaktyanugfhRAmi rAzwrasyApIqayA ca vaH ॥30॥

text: āpatsveva ca voḍhavyaṃ bhavadbhiḥ sadgavairiva । na vaḥ priyataraṃ kāryaṃ dhanaṃ kasyāñcidāpadi ॥31॥
html:
āpatsveva ca voḍhavyaṃ bhavadbhiḥ sadgavairiva ।
na vaḥ priyataraṃ kāryaṃ dhanaṃ kasyāñcidāpadi ॥31॥
slp1: Apatsveva ca voQavyaM BavadBiH sadgavEriva । na vaH priyataraM kAryaM DanaM kasyAYcidApadi ॥31॥

text: iti vācā madhurayā ślakṣṇayā sopacārayā । svaraśmīnabhyavasṛjedyugamādāya kālavit ॥32॥
html:
iti vācā madhurayā ślakṣṇayā sopacārayā ।
svaraśmīnabhyavasṛjedyugamādāya kālavit ॥32॥
slp1: iti vAcA maDurayA SlakzRayA sopacArayA । svaraSmInaByavasfjedyugamAdAya kAlavit ॥32॥

text: pracāraṃ bhṛtyabharaṇaṃ vyayaṃ gogrāmato bhayam । yogakṣemaṃ ca saṃprekṣya gominaḥ kārayetkarān ॥33॥
html:
pracāraṃ bhṛtyabharaṇaṃ vyayaṃ gogrāmato bhayam ।
yogakṣemaṃ ca saṃprekṣya gominaḥ kārayetkarān ॥33॥
slp1: pracAraM BftyaBaraRaM vyayaM gogrAmato Bayam । yogakzemaM ca saMprekzya gominaH kArayetkarAn ॥33॥

text: upekṣitā hi naśyeyurgomino'raṇyavāsinaḥ । tasmātteṣu viśeṣeṇa mṛdupūrvaṃ samācaret ॥34॥
html:
upekṣitā hi naśyeyurgomino'raṇyavāsinaḥ ।
tasmātteṣu viśeṣeṇa mṛdupūrvaṃ samācaret ॥34॥
slp1: upekzitA hi naSyeyurgomino'raRyavAsinaH । tasmAttezu viSezeRa mfdupUrvaM samAcaret ॥34॥

text: sāntvanaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ dānamavasthā cāpyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ । gomināṃ pārtha kartavyaṃ saṃvibhāgāḥ priyāṇi ca ॥35॥
html:
sāntvanaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ dānamavasthā cāpyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ ।
gomināṃ pārtha kartavyaṃ saṃvibhāgāḥ priyāṇi ca ॥35॥
slp1: sAntvanaM rakzaRaM dAnamavasTA cApyaBIkzRaSaH । gominAM pArTa kartavyaM saMviBAgAH priyARi ca ॥35॥

text: ajasramupayoktavyaṃ phalaṃ gomiṣu sarvataḥ । prabhāvayati rāṣṭraṃ ca vyavahāraṃ kṛṣiṃ tathā ॥36॥
html:
ajasramupayoktavyaṃ phalaṃ gomiṣu sarvataḥ ।
prabhāvayati rāṣṭraṃ ca vyavahāraṃ kṛṣiṃ tathā ॥36॥
slp1: ajasramupayoktavyaM PalaM gomizu sarvataH । praBAvayati rAzwraM ca vyavahAraM kfziM taTA ॥36॥

text: tasmādgomiṣu yatnena prītiṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ । dayāvānapramattaśca karānsampraṇayanmṛdūn ॥37॥
html:
tasmādgomiṣu yatnena prītiṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ।
dayāvānapramattaśca karānsampraṇayanmṛdūn ॥37॥
slp1: tasmAdgomizu yatnena prItiM kuryAdvicakzaRaH । dayAvAnapramattaSca karAnsampraRayanmfdUn ॥37॥

text: sarvatra kṣemacaraṇaṃ sulabhaṃ tāta gomibhiḥ । na hyataḥ sadṛśaṃ kiñciddhanamasti yudhiṣṭhira] ॥38॥
html:
sarvatra kṣemacaraṇaṃ sulabhaṃ tāta gomibhiḥ ।
na hyataḥ sadṛśaṃ kiñciddhanamasti yudhiṣṭhira] ॥38॥
slp1: sarvatra kzemacaraRaM sulaBaM tAta gomiBiH । na hyataH sadfSaM kiYcidDanamasti yuDizWira] ॥38॥

text: yadā rājā samartho'pi kośārthī syānmahāmate । kathaṃ pravarteta tadā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
yadā rājā samartho'pi kośārthī syānmahāmate ।
kathaṃ pravarteta tadā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: yadA rAjA samarTo'pi koSArTI syAnmahAmate । kaTaM pravarteta tadA tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: yathādeśaṃ yathākālamapi caiva yathābalam । anuśiṣyātprajā rājā dharmārthī taddhite rataḥ ॥2॥
html:
yathādeśaṃ yathākālamapi caiva yathābalam ।
anuśiṣyātprajā rājā dharmārthī taddhite rataḥ ॥2॥
slp1: yaTAdeSaM yaTAkAlamapi cEva yaTAbalam । anuSizyAtprajA rAjA DarmArTI tadDite rataH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yathā tāsāṃ ca manyeta śreya ātmana eva ca । tathā dharmyāṇi sarvāṇi rājā rāṣṭre pravartayet ॥3॥
html:
yathā tāsāṃ ca manyeta śreya ātmana eva ca ।
tathā dharmyāṇi sarvāṇi rājā rāṣṭre pravartayet ॥3॥
slp1: yaTA tAsAM ca manyeta Sreya Atmana eva ca । taTA DarmyARi sarvARi rAjA rAzwre pravartayet ॥3॥

text: madhudohaṃ duhedrāṣṭraṃ bhramarānna vipātayet । vatsāpekṣī duheccaiva stanāṃśca na vikuṭṭayet ॥4॥
html:
madhudohaṃ duhedrāṣṭraṃ bhramarānna vipātayet ।
vatsāpekṣī duheccaiva stanāṃśca na vikuṭṭayet ॥4॥
slp1: maDudohaM duhedrAzwraM BramarAnna vipAtayet । vatsApekzI duheccEva stanAMSca na vikuwwayet ॥4॥

text: jalaukāvatpibedrāṣṭraṃ mṛdunaiva narādhipa । vyāghrīva ca haretputramadaṣṭvā mā patediti ॥5॥
html:
jalaukāvatpibedrāṣṭraṃ mṛdunaiva narādhipa ।
vyāghrīva ca haretputramadaṣṭvā mā patediti ॥5॥
slp1: jalOkAvatpibedrAzwraM mfdunEva narADipa । vyAGrIva ca haretputramadazwvA mA patediti ॥5॥

text: alpenālpena deyena vardhamānaṃ pradāpayet । tato bhūyastato bhūyaḥ kāmaṃ vṛddhiṃ samācaret ॥6॥
html:
alpenālpena deyena vardhamānaṃ pradāpayet ।
tato bhūyastato bhūyaḥ kāmaṃ vṛddhiṃ samācaret ॥6॥
slp1: alpenAlpena deyena varDamAnaM pradApayet । tato BUyastato BUyaH kAmaM vfdDiM samAcaret ॥6॥

text: damayanniva damyānāṃ śaśvadbhāraṃ pravardhayet । mṛdupūrvaṃ prayatnena pāśānabhyavahārayet ॥7॥
html:
damayanniva damyānāṃ śaśvadbhāraṃ pravardhayet ।
mṛdupūrvaṃ prayatnena pāśānabhyavahārayet ॥7॥
slp1: damayanniva damyAnAM SaSvadBAraM pravarDayet । mfdupUrvaM prayatnena pASAnaByavahArayet ॥7॥

text: sakṛtpāśāvakīrṇāste na bhaviṣyanti durdamāḥ । ucitenaiva bhoktavyāste bhaviṣyanti yatnataḥ ॥8॥
html:
sakṛtpāśāvakīrṇāste na bhaviṣyanti durdamāḥ ।
ucitenaiva bhoktavyāste bhaviṣyanti yatnataḥ ॥8॥
slp1: sakftpASAvakIrRAste na Bavizyanti durdamAH । ucitenEva BoktavyAste Bavizyanti yatnataH ॥8॥

text: tasmātsarvasamārambho durlabhaḥ puruṣavrajaḥ । yathāmukhyānsāntvayitvā bhoktavya itaro janaḥ ॥9॥
html:
tasmātsarvasamārambho durlabhaḥ puruṣavrajaḥ ।
yathāmukhyānsāntvayitvā bhoktavya itaro janaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: tasmAtsarvasamAramBo durlaBaH puruzavrajaH । yaTAmuKyAnsAntvayitvA Boktavya itaro janaH ॥9॥

text: tatastānbhedayitvātha parasparavivakṣitān । bhuñjīta sāntvayitvaiva yathāsukhamayatnataḥ ॥10॥
html:
tatastānbhedayitvātha parasparavivakṣitān ।
bhuñjīta sāntvayitvaiva yathāsukhamayatnataḥ ॥10॥
slp1: tatastAnBedayitvATa parasparavivakzitAn । BuYjIta sAntvayitvEva yaTAsuKamayatnataH ॥10॥

text: na cāsthāne na cākāle karānebhyo'nupātayet । ānupūrvyeṇa sāntvena yathākālaṃ yathāvidhi ॥11॥
html:
na cāsthāne na cākāle karānebhyo'nupātayet ।
ānupūrvyeṇa sāntvena yathākālaṃ yathāvidhi ॥11॥
slp1: na cAsTAne na cAkAle karAneByo'nupAtayet । AnupUrvyeRa sAntvena yaTAkAlaM yaTAviDi ॥11॥

text: upāyānprabravīmyetānna me māyā vivakṣitā । anupāyena damayanprakopayati vājinaḥ ॥12॥
html:
upāyānprabravīmyetānna me māyā vivakṣitā ।
anupāyena damayanprakopayati vājinaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: upAyAnprabravImyetAnna me mAyA vivakzitA । anupAyena damayanprakopayati vAjinaH ॥12॥

text: pānāgārāṇi veśāśca veśaprāpaṇikāstathā । kuśīlavāḥ sakitavā ye cānye kecidīdṛśāḥ ॥13॥
html:
pānāgārāṇi veśāśca veśaprāpaṇikāstathā ।
kuśīlavāḥ sakitavā ye cānye kecidīdṛśāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: pAnAgArARi veSASca veSaprApaRikAstaTA । kuSIlavAH sakitavA ye cAnye kecidIdfSAH ॥13॥

text: niyamyāḥ sarva evaite ye rāṣṭrasyopaghātakāḥ । ete rāṣṭre hi tiṣṭhanto bādhante bhadrikāḥ prajāḥ ॥14॥
html:
niyamyāḥ sarva evaite ye rāṣṭrasyopaghātakāḥ ।
ete rāṣṭre hi tiṣṭhanto bādhante bhadrikāḥ prajāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: niyamyAH sarva evEte ye rAzwrasyopaGAtakAH । ete rAzwre hi tizWanto bADante BadrikAH prajAH ॥14॥

text: na kenacidyācitavyaḥ kaścitkiñcidanāpadi । iti vyavasthā bhūtānāṃ purastānmanunā kṛtā ॥15॥
html:
na kenacidyācitavyaḥ kaścitkiñcidanāpadi ।
iti vyavasthā bhūtānāṃ purastānmanunā kṛtā ॥15॥
slp1: na kenacidyAcitavyaH kaScitkiYcidanApadi । iti vyavasTA BUtAnAM purastAnmanunA kftA ॥15॥

text: sarve tathā na jīveyurna kuryuḥ karma cediha । sarva eva trayo lokā na bhaveyurasaṃśayam ॥16॥
html:
sarve tathā na jīveyurna kuryuḥ karma cediha ।
sarva eva trayo lokā na bhaveyurasaṃśayam ॥16॥
slp1: sarve taTA na jIveyurna kuryuH karma cediha । sarva eva trayo lokA na BaveyurasaMSayam ॥16॥

text: prabhurniyamane rājā ya etānna niyacchati । bhuṅkte sa tasya pāpasya caturbhāgamiti śrutiḥ । tathā kṛtasya dharmasya caturbhāgamupāśnute ॥17॥
html:
prabhurniyamane rājā ya etānna niyacchati ।
bhuṅkte sa tasya pāpasya caturbhāgamiti śrutiḥ ।
tathā kṛtasya dharmasya caturbhāgamupāśnute ॥17॥
slp1: praBurniyamane rAjA ya etAnna niyacCati । BuNkte sa tasya pApasya caturBAgamiti SrutiH । taTA kftasya Darmasya caturBAgamupASnute ॥17॥

text: sthānānyetāni saṅgamya prasaṅge bhūtināśanaḥ । kāmaprasaktaḥ puruṣaḥ kimakāryaṃ vivarjayet ॥18॥
html:
sthānānyetāni saṅgamya prasaṅge bhūtināśanaḥ ।
kāmaprasaktaḥ puruṣaḥ kimakāryaṃ vivarjayet ॥18॥
slp1: sTAnAnyetAni saNgamya prasaNge BUtinASanaH । kAmaprasaktaH puruzaH kimakAryaM vivarjayet ॥18॥

text: āpadyeva tu yāceranyeṣāṃ nāsti parigrahaḥ । dātavyaṃ dharmatastebhyastvanukrośāddayārthinā ॥19॥
html:
āpadyeva tu yāceranyeṣāṃ nāsti parigrahaḥ ।
dātavyaṃ dharmatastebhyastvanukrośāddayārthinā ॥19॥
slp1: Apadyeva tu yAceranyezAM nAsti parigrahaH । dAtavyaM DarmatasteByastvanukroSAddayArTinA ॥19॥

text: mā te rāṣṭre yācanakā mā te bhūyuśca dasyavaḥ । iṣṭādātāra evaite naite bhūtasya bhāvakāḥ ॥20॥
html:
mā te rāṣṭre yācanakā mā te bhūyuśca dasyavaḥ ।
iṣṭādātāra evaite naite bhūtasya bhāvakāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: mA te rAzwre yAcanakA mA te BUyuSca dasyavaH । izwAdAtAra evEte nEte BUtasya BAvakAH ॥20॥

text: ye bhūtānyanugṛhṇanti vardhayanti ca ye prajāḥ । te te rāṣṭre pravartantāṃ mā bhūtānāmabhāvakāḥ ॥21॥
html:
ye bhūtānyanugṛhṇanti vardhayanti ca ye prajāḥ ।
te te rāṣṭre pravartantāṃ mā bhūtānāmabhāvakāḥ ॥21॥
slp1: ye BUtAnyanugfhRanti varDayanti ca ye prajAH । te te rAzwre pravartantAM mA BUtAnAmaBAvakAH ॥21॥

text: daṇḍyāste ca mahārāja dhanādānaprayojanāḥ । prayogaṃ kārayeyustānyathā balikarāṃstathā ॥22॥
html:
daṇḍyāste ca mahārāja dhanādānaprayojanāḥ ।
prayogaṃ kārayeyustānyathā balikarāṃstathā ॥22॥
slp1: daRqyAste ca mahArAja DanAdAnaprayojanAH । prayogaM kArayeyustAnyaTA balikarAMstaTA ॥22॥

text: kṛṣigorakṣyavāṇijyaṃ yaccānyatkiñcidīdṛśam । puruṣaiḥ kārayetkarma bahubhiḥ saha karmibhiḥ ॥23॥
html:
kṛṣigorakṣyavāṇijyaṃ yaccānyatkiñcidīdṛśam ।
puruṣaiḥ kārayetkarma bahubhiḥ saha karmibhiḥ ॥23॥
slp1: kfzigorakzyavARijyaM yaccAnyatkiYcidIdfSam । puruzEH kArayetkarma bahuBiH saha karmiBiH ॥23॥

text: naraścetkṛṣigorakṣyaṃ vāṇijyaṃ cāpyanuṣṭhitaḥ । saṃśayaṃ labhate kiñcittena rājā vigarhyate ॥24॥
html:
naraścetkṛṣigorakṣyaṃ vāṇijyaṃ cāpyanuṣṭhitaḥ ।
saṃśayaṃ labhate kiñcittena rājā vigarhyate ॥24॥
slp1: naraScetkfzigorakzyaM vARijyaM cApyanuzWitaH । saMSayaM laBate kiYcittena rAjA vigarhyate ॥24॥

text: dhaninaḥ pūjayennityaṃ yānācchādanabhojanaiḥ । vaktavyāścānugṛhṇīdhvaṃ pūjāḥ saha mayeti ha ॥25॥
html:
dhaninaḥ pūjayennityaṃ yānācchādanabhojanaiḥ ।
vaktavyāścānugṛhṇīdhvaṃ pūjāḥ saha mayeti ha ॥25॥
slp1: DaninaH pUjayennityaM yAnAcCAdanaBojanEH । vaktavyAScAnugfhRIDvaM pUjAH saha mayeti ha ॥25॥

text: aṅgametanmahadrājñāṃ dhanino nāma bhārata । kakudaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dhanastho nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥26॥
html:
aṅgametanmahadrājñāṃ dhanino nāma bhārata ।
kakudaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dhanastho nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: aNgametanmahadrAjYAM Danino nAma BArata । kakudaM sarvaBUtAnAM DanasTo nAtra saMSayaH ॥26॥

text: prājñaḥ śūro dhanasthaśca svāmī dhārmika eva ca । tapasvī satyavādī ca buddhimāṃścābhirakṣati ॥27॥
html:
prājñaḥ śūro dhanasthaśca svāmī dhārmika eva ca ।
tapasvī satyavādī ca buddhimāṃścābhirakṣati ॥27॥
slp1: prAjYaH SUro DanasTaSca svAmI DArmika eva ca । tapasvI satyavAdI ca budDimAMScABirakzati ॥27॥

text: tasmādeteṣu sarveṣu prītimānbhava pārthiva । satyamārjavamakrodhamānṛśaṃsyaṃ ca pālaya ॥28॥
html:
tasmādeteṣu sarveṣu prītimānbhava pārthiva ।
satyamārjavamakrodhamānṛśaṃsyaṃ ca pālaya ॥28॥
slp1: tasmAdetezu sarvezu prItimAnBava pArTiva । satyamArjavamakroDamAnfSaMsyaM ca pAlaya ॥28॥

text: evaṃ daṇḍaṃ ca kośaṃ ca mitraṃ bhūmiṃ ca lapsyase । satyārjavaparo rājanmitrakośasamanvitaḥ] ॥29॥
html:
evaṃ daṇḍaṃ ca kośaṃ ca mitraṃ bhūmiṃ ca lapsyase ।
satyārjavaparo rājanmitrakośasamanvitaḥ] ॥29॥
slp1: evaM daRqaM ca koSaM ca mitraM BUmiM ca lapsyase । satyArjavaparo rAjanmitrakoSasamanvitaH] ॥29॥

text: vanaspatīnbhakṣyaphalānna chindyurviṣaye tava । brāhmaṇānāṃ mūlaphalaṃ dharmyamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥1॥
html:
vanaspatīnbhakṣyaphalānna chindyurviṣaye tava ।
brāhmaṇānāṃ mūlaphalaṃ dharmyamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: vanaspatInBakzyaPalAnna Cindyurvizaye tava । brAhmaRAnAM mUlaPalaM DarmyamAhurmanIziRaH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: brāhmaṇebhyo'tiriktaṃ ca bhuñjīrannitare janāḥ । na brāhmaṇoparodhena haredanyaḥ kathañcana ॥2॥
html:
brāhmaṇebhyo'tiriktaṃ ca bhuñjīrannitare janāḥ ।
na brāhmaṇoparodhena haredanyaḥ kathañcana ॥2॥
slp1: brAhmaReByo'tiriktaM ca BuYjIrannitare janAH । na brAhmaRoparoDena haredanyaH kaTaYcana ॥2॥

text: vipraścettyāgamātiṣṭhedākhyāyāvṛttikarśitaḥ । parikalpyāsya vṛttiḥ syātsadārasya narādhipa ॥3॥
html:
vipraścettyāgamātiṣṭhedākhyāyāvṛttikarśitaḥ ।
parikalpyāsya vṛttiḥ syātsadārasya narādhipa ॥3॥
slp1: vipraScettyAgamAtizWedAKyAyAvfttikarSitaH । parikalpyAsya vfttiH syAtsadArasya narADipa ॥3॥

text: sa cennopanivarteta vācyo brāhmaṇasaṃsadi । kasminnidānīṃ maryādāmayaṃ lokaḥ kariṣyati ॥4॥
html:
sa cennopanivarteta vācyo brāhmaṇasaṃsadi ।
kasminnidānīṃ maryādāmayaṃ lokaḥ kariṣyati ॥4॥
slp1: sa cennopanivarteta vAcyo brAhmaRasaMsadi । kasminnidAnIM maryAdAmayaM lokaH karizyati ॥4॥

text: asaṃśayaṃ nivarteta na cedvakṣyatyataḥ param । pūrvaṃ parokṣaṃ kartavyametatkaunteya śāsanam ॥5॥
html:
asaṃśayaṃ nivarteta na cedvakṣyatyataḥ param ।
pūrvaṃ parokṣaṃ kartavyametatkaunteya śāsanam ॥5॥
slp1: asaMSayaM nivarteta na cedvakzyatyataH param । pUrvaM parokzaM kartavyametatkOnteya SAsanam ॥5॥

text: āhuretajjanā brahmanna caitacchraddadhāmyaham । nimantryaśca bhavedbhogairavṛttyā cettadācaret ॥6॥
html:
āhuretajjanā brahmanna caitacchraddadhāmyaham ।
nimantryaśca bhavedbhogairavṛttyā cettadācaret ॥6॥
slp1: AhuretajjanA brahmanna cEtacCraddaDAmyaham । nimantryaSca BavedBogEravfttyA cettadAcaret ॥6॥

text: kṛṣigorakṣyavāṇijyaṃ lokānāmiha jīvanam । ūrdhvaṃ caiva trayī vidyā sā bhūtānbhāvayatyuta ॥7॥
html:
kṛṣigorakṣyavāṇijyaṃ lokānāmiha jīvanam ।
ūrdhvaṃ caiva trayī vidyā sā bhūtānbhāvayatyuta ॥7॥
slp1: kfzigorakzyavARijyaM lokAnAmiha jIvanam । UrDvaM cEva trayI vidyA sA BUtAnBAvayatyuta ॥7॥

text: tasyāṃ prayatamānāyāṃ ye syustatparipanthinaḥ । dasyavastadvadhāyeha brahmā kṣatramathāsṛjat ॥8॥
html:
tasyāṃ prayatamānāyāṃ ye syustatparipanthinaḥ ।
dasyavastadvadhāyeha brahmā kṣatramathāsṛjat ॥8॥
slp1: tasyAM prayatamAnAyAM ye syustatparipanTinaH । dasyavastadvaDAyeha brahmA kzatramaTAsfjat ॥8॥

text: śatrūñjahi prajā rakṣa yajasva kratubhirnṛpa । yudhyasva samare vīro bhūtvā kauravanandana ॥9॥
html:
śatrūñjahi prajā rakṣa yajasva kratubhirnṛpa ।
yudhyasva samare vīro bhūtvā kauravanandana ॥9॥
slp1: SatrUYjahi prajA rakza yajasva kratuBirnfpa । yuDyasva samare vIro BUtvA kOravanandana ॥9॥

text: saṃrakṣyānpālayedrājā yaḥ sa rājāryakṛttamaḥ । ye kecittānna rakṣanti tairartho nāsti kaścana ॥10॥
html:
saṃrakṣyānpālayedrājā yaḥ sa rājāryakṛttamaḥ ।
ye kecittānna rakṣanti tairartho nāsti kaścana ॥10॥
slp1: saMrakzyAnpAlayedrAjA yaH sa rAjAryakfttamaH । ye kecittAnna rakzanti tErarTo nAsti kaScana ॥10॥

text: sadaiva rājñā boddhavyaṃ sarvalokādyudhiṣṭhira । tasmāddhetorhi bhuñjīta manuṣyāneva mānavaḥ ॥11॥
html:
sadaiva rājñā boddhavyaṃ sarvalokādyudhiṣṭhira ।
tasmāddhetorhi bhuñjīta manuṣyāneva mānavaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: sadEva rAjYA bodDavyaM sarvalokAdyuDizWira । tasmAdDetorhi BuYjIta manuzyAneva mAnavaH ॥11॥

text: antarebhyaḥ parānrakṣanparebhyaḥ punarantarān । parānparebhyaḥ svānsvebhyaḥ sarvānpālaya nityadā ॥12॥
html:
antarebhyaḥ parānrakṣanparebhyaḥ punarantarān ।
parānparebhyaḥ svānsvebhyaḥ sarvānpālaya nityadā ॥12॥
slp1: antareByaH parAnrakzanpareByaH punarantarAn । parAnpareByaH svAnsveByaH sarvAnpAlaya nityadA ॥12॥

text: ātmānaṃ sarvato rakṣanrājā rakṣeta medinīm । ātmamūlamidaṃ sarvamāhurhi viduṣo janāḥ ॥13॥
html:
ātmānaṃ sarvato rakṣanrājā rakṣeta medinīm ।
ātmamūlamidaṃ sarvamāhurhi viduṣo janāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: AtmAnaM sarvato rakzanrAjA rakzeta medinIm । AtmamUlamidaM sarvamAhurhi viduzo janAH ॥13॥

text: kiṃ chidraṃ ko'nuṣaṅgo me kiṃ vāstyavinipātitam । kuto māmāsraveddoṣa iti nityaṃ vicintayet ॥14॥
html:
kiṃ chidraṃ ko'nuṣaṅgo me kiṃ vāstyavinipātitam ।
kuto māmāsraveddoṣa iti nityaṃ vicintayet ॥14॥
slp1: kiM CidraM ko'nuzaNgo me kiM vAstyavinipAtitam । kuto mAmAsraveddoza iti nityaM vicintayet ॥14॥

text: guptaiścārairanumataiḥ pṛthivīmanucārayet । sunītaṃ yadi me vṛttaṃ praśaṃsanti na vā punaḥ । kaccidrocejjanapade kaccidrāṣṭre ca me yaśaḥ ॥15॥
html:
guptaiścārairanumataiḥ pṛthivīmanucārayet ।
sunītaṃ yadi me vṛttaṃ praśaṃsanti na vā punaḥ ।
kaccidrocejjanapade kaccidrāṣṭre ca me yaśaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: guptEScArEranumatEH pfTivImanucArayet । sunItaM yadi me vfttaM praSaMsanti na vA punaH । kaccidrocejjanapade kaccidrAzwre ca me yaSaH ॥15॥

text: dharmajñānāṃ dhṛtimatāṃ saṅgrāmeṣvapalāyinām । rāṣṭraṃ ca ye'nujīvanti ye ca rājño'nujīvinaḥ ॥16॥
html:
dharmajñānāṃ dhṛtimatāṃ saṅgrāmeṣvapalāyinām ।
rāṣṭraṃ ca ye'nujīvanti ye ca rājño'nujīvinaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: DarmajYAnAM DftimatAM saNgrAmezvapalAyinAm । rAzwraM ca ye'nujIvanti ye ca rAjYo'nujIvinaH ॥16॥

text: amātyānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ madhyasthānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ । ye ca tvābhipraśaṃseyurnindeyuratha vā punaḥ । sarvānsupariṇītāṃstānkārayeta yudhiṣṭhira ॥17॥
html:
amātyānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ madhyasthānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ।
ye ca tvābhipraśaṃseyurnindeyuratha vā punaḥ ।
sarvānsupariṇītāṃstānkārayeta yudhiṣṭhira ॥17॥
slp1: amAtyAnAM ca sarvezAM maDyasTAnAM ca sarvaSaH । ye ca tvABipraSaMseyurnindeyuraTa vA punaH । sarvAnsupariRItAMstAnkArayeta yuDizWira ॥17॥

text: ekāntena hi sarveṣāṃ na śakyaṃ tāta rocitum । mitrāmitramatho madhyaṃ sarvabhūteṣu bhārata ॥18॥
html:
ekāntena hi sarveṣāṃ na śakyaṃ tāta rocitum ।
mitrāmitramatho madhyaṃ sarvabhūteṣu bhārata ॥18॥
slp1: ekAntena hi sarvezAM na SakyaM tAta rocitum । mitrAmitramaTo maDyaM sarvaBUtezu BArata ॥18॥

text: tulyabāhubalānāṃ ca guṇairapi niṣevinām । kathaṃ syādadhikaḥ kaścitsa tu bhuñjīta mānavān ॥19॥
html:
tulyabāhubalānāṃ ca guṇairapi niṣevinām ।
kathaṃ syādadhikaḥ kaścitsa tu bhuñjīta mānavān ॥19॥
slp1: tulyabAhubalAnAM ca guRErapi nizevinAm । kaTaM syAdaDikaH kaScitsa tu BuYjIta mAnavAn ॥19॥

text: ye carā hyacarānadyuradaṃṣṭrāndaṃṣṭriṇastathā । āśīviṣā iva kruddhā bhujagā bhujagāniva ॥20॥
html:
ye carā hyacarānadyuradaṃṣṭrāndaṃṣṭriṇastathā ।
āśīviṣā iva kruddhā bhujagā bhujagāniva ॥20॥
slp1: ye carA hyacarAnadyuradaMzwrAndaMzwriRastaTA । ASIvizA iva krudDA BujagA BujagAniva ॥20॥

text: etebhyaścāpramattaḥ syātsadā yatto yudhiṣṭhira । bhāruṇḍasadṛśā hyete nipatanti pramādyataḥ ॥21॥
html:
etebhyaścāpramattaḥ syātsadā yatto yudhiṣṭhira ।
bhāruṇḍasadṛśā hyete nipatanti pramādyataḥ ॥21॥
slp1: eteByaScApramattaH syAtsadA yatto yuDizWira । BAruRqasadfSA hyete nipatanti pramAdyataH ॥21॥

text: kaccitte vaṇijo rāṣṭre nodvijante karārditāḥ । krīṇanto bahu vālpena kāntārakṛtaniśramāḥ ॥22॥
html:
kaccitte vaṇijo rāṣṭre nodvijante karārditāḥ ।
krīṇanto bahu vālpena kāntārakṛtaniśramāḥ ॥22॥
slp1: kaccitte vaRijo rAzwre nodvijante karArditAH । krIRanto bahu vAlpena kAntArakftaniSramAH ॥22॥

text: kaccitkṛṣikarā rāṣṭraṃ na jahatyatipīḍitāḥ । ye vahanti dhuraṃ rājñāṃ sambharantītarānapi ॥23॥
html:
kaccitkṛṣikarā rāṣṭraṃ na jahatyatipīḍitāḥ ।
ye vahanti dhuraṃ rājñāṃ sambharantītarānapi ॥23॥
slp1: kaccitkfzikarA rAzwraM na jahatyatipIqitAH । ye vahanti DuraM rAjYAM samBarantItarAnapi ॥23॥

text: ito dattena jīvanti devāḥ pitṛgaṇāstathā । manuṣyoragarakṣāṃsi vayāṃsi paśavastathā ॥24॥
html:
