ito dattena jīvanti devāḥ pitṛgaṇāstathā ।
manuṣyoragarakṣāṃsi vayāṃsi paśavastathā ॥24॥
slp1: ito dattena jIvanti devAH pitfgaRAstaTA । manuzyoragarakzAMsi vayAMsi paSavastaTA ॥24॥

text: eṣā te rāṣṭravṛttiśca rāṣṭraguptiśca bhārata । etamevārthamāśritya bhūyo vakṣyāmi pāṇḍava] ॥25॥
html:
eṣā te rāṣṭravṛttiśca rāṣṭraguptiśca bhārata ।
etamevārthamāśritya bhūyo vakṣyāmi pāṇḍava] ॥25॥
slp1: ezA te rAzwravfttiSca rAzwraguptiSca BArata । etamevArTamASritya BUyo vakzyAmi pARqava] ॥25॥

text: yānaṅgirāḥ kṣatradharmānutathyo brahmavittamaḥ । māndhātre yauvanāśvāya prītimānabhyabhāṣata ॥1॥
html:
yānaṅgirāḥ kṣatradharmānutathyo brahmavittamaḥ ।
māndhātre yauvanāśvāya prītimānabhyabhāṣata ॥1॥
slp1: yAnaNgirAH kzatraDarmAnutaTyo brahmavittamaH । mAnDAtre yOvanASvAya prItimAnaByaBAzata ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sa yathānuśaśāsainamutathyo brahmavittamaḥ । tatte sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi nikhilena yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
html:
sa yathānuśaśāsainamutathyo brahmavittamaḥ ।
tatte sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi nikhilena yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
slp1: sa yaTAnuSaSAsEnamutaTyo brahmavittamaH । tatte sarvaM pravakzyAmi niKilena yuDizWira ॥2॥

text: dharmāya rājā bhavati na kāmakaraṇāya tu । māndhātarevaṃ jānīhi rājā lokasya rakṣitā ॥3॥
html:
dharmāya rājā bhavati na kāmakaraṇāya tu ।
māndhātarevaṃ jānīhi rājā lokasya rakṣitā ॥3॥
slp1: DarmAya rAjA Bavati na kAmakaraRAya tu । mAnDAtarevaM jAnIhi rAjA lokasya rakzitA ॥3॥
author: utathya uvāca ।

text: rājā carati vai dharmaṃ devatvāyaiva gacchati । na ceddharmaṃ sa carati narakāyaiva gacchati ॥4॥
html:
rājā carati vai dharmaṃ devatvāyaiva gacchati ।
na ceddharmaṃ sa carati narakāyaiva gacchati ॥4॥
slp1: rAjA carati vE DarmaM devatvAyEva gacCati । na cedDarmaM sa carati narakAyEva gacCati ॥4॥

text: dharme tiṣṭhanti bhūtāni dharmo rājani tiṣṭhati । taṃ rājā sādhu yaḥ śāsti sa rājā pṛthivīpatiḥ ॥5॥
html:
dharme tiṣṭhanti bhūtāni dharmo rājani tiṣṭhati ।
taṃ rājā sādhu yaḥ śāsti sa rājā pṛthivīpatiḥ ॥5॥
slp1: Darme tizWanti BUtAni Darmo rAjani tizWati । taM rAjA sADu yaH SAsti sa rAjA pfTivIpatiH ॥5॥

text: rājā paramadharmātmā lakṣmīvānpāpa ucyate । devāśca garhāṃ gacchanti dharmo nāstīti cocyate ॥6॥
html:
rājā paramadharmātmā lakṣmīvānpāpa ucyate ।
devāśca garhāṃ gacchanti dharmo nāstīti cocyate ॥6॥
slp1: rAjA paramaDarmAtmA lakzmIvAnpApa ucyate । devASca garhAM gacCanti Darmo nAstIti cocyate ॥6॥

text: adharme vartamānānāmarthasiddhiḥ pradṛśyate । tadeva maṅgalaṃ sarvaṃ lokaḥ samanuvartate ॥7॥
html:
adharme vartamānānāmarthasiddhiḥ pradṛśyate ।
tadeva maṅgalaṃ sarvaṃ lokaḥ samanuvartate ॥7॥
slp1: aDarme vartamAnAnAmarTasidDiH pradfSyate । tadeva maNgalaM sarvaM lokaH samanuvartate ॥7॥

text: ucchidyate dharmavṛttamadharmo vartate mahān । bhayamāhurdivārātraṃ yadā pāpo na vāryate ॥8॥
html:
ucchidyate dharmavṛttamadharmo vartate mahān ।
bhayamāhurdivārātraṃ yadā pāpo na vāryate ॥8॥
slp1: ucCidyate DarmavfttamaDarmo vartate mahAn । BayamAhurdivArAtraM yadA pApo na vAryate ॥8॥

text: na vedānanuvartanti vratavanto dvijātayaḥ । na yajñāṃstanvate viprā yadā pāpo na vāryate ॥9॥
html:
na vedānanuvartanti vratavanto dvijātayaḥ ।
na yajñāṃstanvate viprā yadā pāpo na vāryate ॥9॥
slp1: na vedAnanuvartanti vratavanto dvijAtayaH । na yajYAMstanvate viprA yadA pApo na vAryate ॥9॥

text: vadhyānāmiva sarveṣāṃ mano bhavati vihvalam । manuṣyāṇāṃ mahārāja yadā pāpo na vāryate ॥10॥
html:
vadhyānāmiva sarveṣāṃ mano bhavati vihvalam ।
manuṣyāṇāṃ mahārāja yadā pāpo na vāryate ॥10॥
slp1: vaDyAnAmiva sarvezAM mano Bavati vihvalam । manuzyARAM mahArAja yadA pApo na vAryate ॥10॥

text: ubhau lokāvabhiprekṣya rājānamṛṣayaḥ svayam । asṛjansumahadbhūtamayaṃ dharmo bhaviṣyati ॥11॥
html:
ubhau lokāvabhiprekṣya rājānamṛṣayaḥ svayam ।
asṛjansumahadbhūtamayaṃ dharmo bhaviṣyati ॥11॥
slp1: uBO lokAvaBiprekzya rAjAnamfzayaH svayam । asfjansumahadBUtamayaM Darmo Bavizyati ॥11॥

text: yasmindharmo virājeta taṃ rājānaṃ pracakṣate । yasminvilīyate dharmastaṃ devā vṛṣalaṃ viduḥ ॥12॥
html:
yasmindharmo virājeta taṃ rājānaṃ pracakṣate ।
yasminvilīyate dharmastaṃ devā vṛṣalaṃ viduḥ ॥12॥
slp1: yasminDarmo virAjeta taM rAjAnaM pracakzate । yasminvilIyate DarmastaM devA vfzalaM viduH ॥12॥

text: vṛṣo hi bhagavāndharmo yastasya kurute hyalam । vṛṣalaṃ taṃ vidurdevāstasmāddharmaṃ na lopayet ॥13॥
html:
vṛṣo hi bhagavāndharmo yastasya kurute hyalam ।
vṛṣalaṃ taṃ vidurdevāstasmāddharmaṃ na lopayet ॥13॥
slp1: vfzo hi BagavAnDarmo yastasya kurute hyalam । vfzalaM taM vidurdevAstasmAdDarmaM na lopayet ॥13॥

text: dharme vardhati vardhanti sarvabhūtāni sarvadā । tasminhrasati hīyante tasmāddharmaṃ pravardhayet ॥14॥
html:
dharme vardhati vardhanti sarvabhūtāni sarvadā ।
tasminhrasati hīyante tasmāddharmaṃ pravardhayet ॥14॥
slp1: Darme varDati varDanti sarvaBUtAni sarvadA । tasminhrasati hIyante tasmAdDarmaM pravarDayet ॥14॥

text: dhanātsravati dharmo hi dhāraṇādveti niścayaḥ । akāryāṇāṃ manuṣyendra sa sīmāntakaraḥ smṛtaḥ ॥15॥
html:
dhanātsravati dharmo hi dhāraṇādveti niścayaḥ ।
akāryāṇāṃ manuṣyendra sa sīmāntakaraḥ smṛtaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: DanAtsravati Darmo hi DAraRAdveti niScayaH । akAryARAM manuzyendra sa sImAntakaraH smftaH ॥15॥

text: prabhavārthaṃ hi bhūtānāṃ dharmaḥ sṛṣṭaḥ svayambhuvā । tasmātpravardhayeddharmaṃ prajānugrahakāraṇāt ॥16॥
html:
prabhavārthaṃ hi bhūtānāṃ dharmaḥ sṛṣṭaḥ svayambhuvā ।
tasmātpravardhayeddharmaṃ prajānugrahakāraṇāt ॥16॥
slp1: praBavArTaM hi BUtAnAM DarmaH sfzwaH svayamBuvA । tasmAtpravarDayedDarmaM prajAnugrahakAraRAt ॥16॥

text: tasmāddhi rājaśārdūla dharmaḥ śreṣṭha iti smṛtaḥ । sa rājā yaḥ prajāḥ śāsti sādhukṛtpuruṣarṣabhaḥ ॥17॥
html:
tasmāddhi rājaśārdūla dharmaḥ śreṣṭha iti smṛtaḥ ।
sa rājā yaḥ prajāḥ śāsti sādhukṛtpuruṣarṣabhaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: tasmAdDi rAjaSArdUla DarmaH SrezWa iti smftaH । sa rAjA yaH prajAH SAsti sADukftpuruzarzaBaH ॥17॥

text: kāmakrodhāvanādṛtya dharmamevānupālayet । dharmaḥ śreyaskaratamo rājñāṃ bharatasattama ॥18॥
html:
kāmakrodhāvanādṛtya dharmamevānupālayet ।
dharmaḥ śreyaskaratamo rājñāṃ bharatasattama ॥18॥
slp1: kAmakroDAvanAdftya DarmamevAnupAlayet । DarmaH Sreyaskaratamo rAjYAM Baratasattama ॥18॥

text: dharmasya brāhmaṇā yonistasmāttānpūjayetsadā । brāhmaṇānāṃ ca māndhātaḥ kāmānkuryādamatsarī ॥19॥
html:
dharmasya brāhmaṇā yonistasmāttānpūjayetsadā ।
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca māndhātaḥ kāmānkuryādamatsarī ॥19॥
slp1: Darmasya brAhmaRA yonistasmAttAnpUjayetsadA । brAhmaRAnAM ca mAnDAtaH kAmAnkuryAdamatsarI ॥19॥

text: teṣāṃ hyakāmakaraṇādrājñaḥ sañjāyate bhayam । mitrāṇi ca na vardhante tathāmitrībhavantyapi ॥20॥
html:
teṣāṃ hyakāmakaraṇādrājñaḥ sañjāyate bhayam ।
mitrāṇi ca na vardhante tathāmitrībhavantyapi ॥20॥
slp1: tezAM hyakAmakaraRAdrAjYaH saYjAyate Bayam । mitrARi ca na varDante taTAmitrIBavantyapi ॥20॥

text: brāhmaṇānvai tadāsūyādyadā vairocano baliḥ । athāsmācchrīrapākrāmadyāsminnāsītpratāpinī ॥21॥
html:
brāhmaṇānvai tadāsūyādyadā vairocano baliḥ ।
athāsmācchrīrapākrāmadyāsminnāsītpratāpinī ॥21॥
slp1: brAhmaRAnvE tadAsUyAdyadA vErocano baliH । aTAsmAcCrIrapAkrAmadyAsminnAsItpratApinI ॥21॥

text: tatastasmādapakramya sāgacchatpākaśāsanam । atha so'nvatapatpaścācchriyaṃ dṛṣṭvā purandare ॥22॥
html:
tatastasmādapakramya sāgacchatpākaśāsanam ।
atha so'nvatapatpaścācchriyaṃ dṛṣṭvā purandare ॥22॥
slp1: tatastasmAdapakramya sAgacCatpAkaSAsanam । aTa so'nvatapatpaScAcCriyaM dfzwvA purandare ॥22॥

text: etatphalamasūyāyā abhimānasya cābhibho । tasmādbudhyasva māndhātarmā tvā jahyātpratāpinī ॥23॥
html:
etatphalamasūyāyā abhimānasya cābhibho ।
tasmādbudhyasva māndhātarmā tvā jahyātpratāpinī ॥23॥
slp1: etatPalamasUyAyA aBimAnasya cABiBo । tasmAdbuDyasva mAnDAtarmA tvA jahyAtpratApinI ॥23॥

text: darpo nāma śriyaḥ putro jajñe'dharmāditi śrutiḥ । tena devāsurā rājannītāḥ subahuśo vaśam ॥24॥
html:
darpo nāma śriyaḥ putro jajñe'dharmāditi śrutiḥ ।
tena devāsurā rājannītāḥ subahuśo vaśam ॥24॥
slp1: darpo nAma SriyaH putro jajYe'DarmAditi SrutiH । tena devAsurA rAjannItAH subahuSo vaSam ॥24॥

text: rājarṣayaśca bahavastasmādbudhyasva pārthiva । rājā bhavati taṃ jitvā dāsastena parājitaḥ ॥25॥
html:
rājarṣayaśca bahavastasmādbudhyasva pārthiva ।
rājā bhavati taṃ jitvā dāsastena parājitaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: rAjarzayaSca bahavastasmAdbuDyasva pArTiva । rAjA Bavati taM jitvA dAsastena parAjitaH ॥25॥

text: sa yathā darpasahitamadharmaṃ nānusevase । tathā vartasva māndhātaściraṃ cetsthātumicchasi ॥26॥
html:
sa yathā darpasahitamadharmaṃ nānusevase ।
tathā vartasva māndhātaściraṃ cetsthātumicchasi ॥26॥
slp1: sa yaTA darpasahitamaDarmaM nAnusevase । taTA vartasva mAnDAtaSciraM cetsTAtumicCasi ॥26॥

text: mattātpramattātpogaṇḍādunmattācca viśeṣataḥ । tadabhyāsādupāvartādahitānāṃ ca sevanāt ॥27॥
html:
mattātpramattātpogaṇḍādunmattācca viśeṣataḥ ।
tadabhyāsādupāvartādahitānāṃ ca sevanāt ॥27॥
slp1: mattAtpramattAtpogaRqAdunmattAcca viSezataH । tadaByAsAdupAvartAdahitAnAM ca sevanAt ॥27॥

text: nigṛhītādamātyācca strībhyaścaiva viśeṣataḥ । parvatādviṣamāddurgāddhastino'śvātsarīsṛpāt ॥28॥
html:
nigṛhītādamātyācca strībhyaścaiva viśeṣataḥ ।
parvatādviṣamāddurgāddhastino'śvātsarīsṛpāt ॥28॥
slp1: nigfhItAdamAtyAcca strIByaScEva viSezataH । parvatAdvizamAddurgAdDastino'SvAtsarIsfpAt ॥28॥

text: etebhyo nityayattaḥ syānnaktañcaryāṃ ca varjayet । atyāyaṃ cātimānaṃ ca dambhaṃ krodhaṃ ca varjayet ॥29॥
html:
etebhyo nityayattaḥ syānnaktañcaryāṃ ca varjayet ।
atyāyaṃ cātimānaṃ ca dambhaṃ krodhaṃ ca varjayet ॥29॥
slp1: eteByo nityayattaH syAnnaktaYcaryAM ca varjayet । atyAyaM cAtimAnaM ca damBaM kroDaM ca varjayet ॥29॥

text: avijñātāsu ca strīṣu klībāsu svairiṇīṣu ca । parabhāryāsu kanyāsu nācarenmaithunaṃ nṛpaḥ ॥30॥
html:
avijñātāsu ca strīṣu klībāsu svairiṇīṣu ca ।
parabhāryāsu kanyāsu nācarenmaithunaṃ nṛpaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: avijYAtAsu ca strIzu klIbAsu svEriRIzu ca । paraBAryAsu kanyAsu nAcarenmETunaM nfpaH ॥30॥

text: kuleṣu pāparakṣāṃsi jāyante varṇasaṅkarāt । apumāṃso'ṅgahīnāśca sthūlajihvā vicetasaḥ ॥31॥
html:
kuleṣu pāparakṣāṃsi jāyante varṇasaṅkarāt ।
apumāṃso'ṅgahīnāśca sthūlajihvā vicetasaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: kulezu pAparakzAMsi jAyante varRasaNkarAt । apumAMso'NgahInASca sTUlajihvA vicetasaH ॥31॥

text: ete cānye ca jāyante yadā rājā pramādyati । tasmādrājñā viśeṣeṇa vartitavyaṃ prajāhite ॥32॥
html:
ete cānye ca jāyante yadā rājā pramādyati ।
tasmādrājñā viśeṣeṇa vartitavyaṃ prajāhite ॥32॥
slp1: ete cAnye ca jAyante yadA rAjA pramAdyati । tasmAdrAjYA viSezeRa vartitavyaM prajAhite ॥32॥

text: kṣatriyasya pramattasya doṣaḥ sañjāyate mahān । adharmāḥ sampravartante prajāsaṅkarakārakāḥ ॥33॥
html:
kṣatriyasya pramattasya doṣaḥ sañjāyate mahān ।
adharmāḥ sampravartante prajāsaṅkarakārakāḥ ॥33॥
slp1: kzatriyasya pramattasya dozaH saYjAyate mahAn । aDarmAH sampravartante prajAsaNkarakArakAH ॥33॥

text: aśīte vidyate śītaṃ śīte śītaṃ na vidyate । avṛṣṭirativṛṣṭiśca vyādhiścāviśati prajāḥ ॥34॥
html:
aśīte vidyate śītaṃ śīte śītaṃ na vidyate ।
avṛṣṭirativṛṣṭiśca vyādhiścāviśati prajāḥ ॥34॥
slp1: aSIte vidyate SItaM SIte SItaM na vidyate । avfzwirativfzwiSca vyADiScAviSati prajAH ॥34॥

text: nakṣatrāṇyupatiṣṭhanti grahā ghorāstathāpare । utpātāścātra dṛśyante bahavo rājanāśanāḥ ॥35॥
html:
nakṣatrāṇyupatiṣṭhanti grahā ghorāstathāpare ।
utpātāścātra dṛśyante bahavo rājanāśanāḥ ॥35॥
slp1: nakzatrARyupatizWanti grahA GorAstaTApare । utpAtAScAtra dfSyante bahavo rAjanASanAH ॥35॥

text: arakṣitātmā yo rājā prajāścāpi na rakṣati । prajāśca tasya kṣīyante tāśca so'nu vinaśyati ॥36॥
html:
arakṣitātmā yo rājā prajāścāpi na rakṣati ।
prajāśca tasya kṣīyante tāśca so'nu vinaśyati ॥36॥
slp1: arakzitAtmA yo rAjA prajAScApi na rakzati । prajASca tasya kzIyante tASca so'nu vinaSyati ॥36॥

text: dvāvādadāte hyekasya dvayośca bahavo'pare । kumāryaḥ sampralupyante tadāhurnṛpadūṣaṇam ॥37॥
html:
dvāvādadāte hyekasya dvayośca bahavo'pare ।
kumāryaḥ sampralupyante tadāhurnṛpadūṣaṇam ॥37॥
slp1: dvAvAdadAte hyekasya dvayoSca bahavo'pare । kumAryaH sampralupyante tadAhurnfpadUzaRam ॥37॥

text: mamaitaditi naikasya manuṣyeṣvavatiṣṭhate । tyaktvā dharmaṃ yadā rājā pramādamanutiṣṭhati] ॥38॥
html:
mamaitaditi naikasya manuṣyeṣvavatiṣṭhate ।
tyaktvā dharmaṃ yadā rājā pramādamanutiṣṭhati] ॥38॥
slp1: mamEtaditi nEkasya manuzyezvavatizWate । tyaktvA DarmaM yadA rAjA pramAdamanutizWati] ॥38॥

text: kālavarṣī ca parjanyo dharmacārī ca pārthivaḥ । sampadyadaiṣā bhavati sā bibharti sukhaṃ prajāḥ ॥1॥
html:
kālavarṣī ca parjanyo dharmacārī ca pārthivaḥ ।
sampadyadaiṣā bhavati sā bibharti sukhaṃ prajāḥ ॥1॥
slp1: kAlavarzI ca parjanyo DarmacArI ca pArTivaH । sampadyadEzA Bavati sA biBarti suKaM prajAH ॥1॥
author: utathya uvāca ।

text: yo na jānāti nirhantuṃ vastrāṇāṃ rajako malam । raktāni vā śodhayituṃ yathā nāsti tathaiva saḥ ॥2॥
html:
yo na jānāti nirhantuṃ vastrāṇāṃ rajako malam ।
raktāni vā śodhayituṃ yathā nāsti tathaiva saḥ ॥2॥
slp1: yo na jAnAti nirhantuM vastrARAM rajako malam । raktAni vA SoDayituM yaTA nAsti taTEva saH ॥2॥

text: evameva dvijendrāṇāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ viśāmapi । śūdrāścaturṇāṃ varṇānāṃ nānākarmasvavasthitāḥ ॥3॥
html:
evameva dvijendrāṇāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ viśāmapi ।
śūdrāścaturṇāṃ varṇānāṃ nānākarmasvavasthitāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: evameva dvijendrARAM kzatriyARAM viSAmapi । SUdrAScaturRAM varRAnAM nAnAkarmasvavasTitAH ॥3॥

text: karma śūdre kṛṣirvaiśye daṇḍanītiśca rājani । brahmacaryaṃ tapo mantrāḥ satyaṃ cāpi dvijātiṣu ॥4॥
html:
karma śūdre kṛṣirvaiśye daṇḍanītiśca rājani ।
brahmacaryaṃ tapo mantrāḥ satyaṃ cāpi dvijātiṣu ॥4॥
slp1: karma SUdre kfzirvESye daRqanItiSca rAjani । brahmacaryaM tapo mantrAH satyaM cApi dvijAtizu ॥4॥

text: teṣāṃ yaḥ kṣatriyo veda vastrāṇāmiva śodhanam । śīladoṣānvinirhantuṃ sa pitā sa prajāpatiḥ ॥5॥
html:
teṣāṃ yaḥ kṣatriyo veda vastrāṇāmiva śodhanam ।
śīladoṣānvinirhantuṃ sa pitā sa prajāpatiḥ ॥5॥
slp1: tezAM yaH kzatriyo veda vastrARAmiva SoDanam । SIladozAnvinirhantuM sa pitA sa prajApatiH ॥5॥

text: kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaśca kaliśca bharatarṣabha । rājavṛttāni sarvāṇi rājaiva yugamucyate ॥6॥
html:
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaśca kaliśca bharatarṣabha ।
rājavṛttāni sarvāṇi rājaiva yugamucyate ॥6॥
slp1: kftaM tretA dvAparaSca kaliSca BaratarzaBa । rAjavfttAni sarvARi rAjEva yugamucyate ॥6॥

text: cāturvarṇyaṃ tathā vedāścāturāśramyameva ca । sarvaṃ pramuhyate hyetadyadā rājā pramādyati ॥7॥
html:
cāturvarṇyaṃ tathā vedāścāturāśramyameva ca ।
sarvaṃ pramuhyate hyetadyadā rājā pramādyati ॥7॥
slp1: cAturvarRyaM taTA vedAScAturASramyameva ca । sarvaM pramuhyate hyetadyadA rAjA pramAdyati ॥7॥

text: rājaiva kartā bhūtānāṃ rājaiva ca vināśakaḥ । dharmātmā yaḥ sa kartā syādadharmātmā vināśakaḥ ॥8॥
html:
rājaiva kartā bhūtānāṃ rājaiva ca vināśakaḥ ।
dharmātmā yaḥ sa kartā syādadharmātmā vināśakaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: rAjEva kartA BUtAnAM rAjEva ca vinASakaH । DarmAtmA yaH sa kartA syAdaDarmAtmA vinASakaH ॥8॥

text: rājño bhāryāśca putrāśca bāndhavāḥ suhṛdastathā । sametya sarve śocanti yadā rājā pramādyati ॥9॥
html:
rājño bhāryāśca putrāśca bāndhavāḥ suhṛdastathā ।
sametya sarve śocanti yadā rājā pramādyati ॥9॥
slp1: rAjYo BAryASca putrASca bAnDavAH suhfdastaTA । sametya sarve Socanti yadA rAjA pramAdyati ॥9॥

text: hastino'śvāśca gāvaścāpyuṣṭrāśvataragardabhāḥ । adharmavṛtte nṛpatau sarve sīdanti pārthiva ॥10॥
html:
hastino'śvāśca gāvaścāpyuṣṭrāśvataragardabhāḥ ।
adharmavṛtte nṛpatau sarve sīdanti pārthiva ॥10॥
slp1: hastino'SvASca gAvaScApyuzwrASvataragardaBAH । aDarmavftte nfpatO sarve sIdanti pArTiva ॥10॥

text: durbalārthaṃ balaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ dhātrā māndhātarucyate । abalaṃ tanmahadbhūtaṃ yasminsarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ॥11॥
html:
durbalārthaṃ balaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ dhātrā māndhātarucyate ।
abalaṃ tanmahadbhūtaṃ yasminsarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ॥11॥
slp1: durbalArTaM balaM sfzwaM DAtrA mAnDAtarucyate । abalaM tanmahadBUtaM yasminsarvaM pratizWitam ॥11॥

text: yacca bhūtaṃ sa bhajate bhūtā ye ca tadanvayāḥ । adharmasthe hi nṛpatau sarve sīdanti pārthiva ॥12॥
html:
yacca bhūtaṃ sa bhajate bhūtā ye ca tadanvayāḥ ।
adharmasthe hi nṛpatau sarve sīdanti pārthiva ॥12॥
slp1: yacca BUtaM sa Bajate BUtA ye ca tadanvayAH । aDarmasTe hi nfpatO sarve sIdanti pArTiva ॥12॥

text: durbalasya hi yaccakṣurmunerāśīviṣasya ca । aviṣahyatamaṃ manye mā sma durbalamāsadaḥ ॥13॥
html:
durbalasya hi yaccakṣurmunerāśīviṣasya ca ।
aviṣahyatamaṃ manye mā sma durbalamāsadaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: durbalasya hi yaccakzurmunerASIvizasya ca । avizahyatamaM manye mA sma durbalamAsadaH ॥13॥

text: durbalāṃstāta budhyethā nityamevāvimānitān । mā tvāṃ durbalacakṣūṃṣi pradaheyuḥ sabāndhavam ॥14॥
html:
durbalāṃstāta budhyethā nityamevāvimānitān ।
mā tvāṃ durbalacakṣūṃṣi pradaheyuḥ sabāndhavam ॥14॥
slp1: durbalAMstAta buDyeTA nityamevAvimAnitAn । mA tvAM durbalacakzUMzi pradaheyuH sabAnDavam ॥14॥

text: na hi durbaladagdhasya kule kiñcitprarohati । āmūlaṃ nirdahatyeva mā sma durbalamāsadaḥ ॥15॥
html:
na hi durbaladagdhasya kule kiñcitprarohati ।
āmūlaṃ nirdahatyeva mā sma durbalamāsadaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: na hi durbaladagDasya kule kiYcitprarohati । AmUlaM nirdahatyeva mA sma durbalamAsadaH ॥15॥

text: abalaṃ vai balācchreyo yaccātibalavadbalam । balasyābaladagdhasya na kiñcidavaśiṣyate ॥16॥
html:
abalaṃ vai balācchreyo yaccātibalavadbalam ।
balasyābaladagdhasya na kiñcidavaśiṣyate ॥16॥
slp1: abalaM vE balAcCreyo yaccAtibalavadbalam । balasyAbaladagDasya na kiYcidavaSizyate ॥16॥

text: vimānito hatotkruṣṭastrātāraṃ cenna vindati । amānuṣakṛtastatra daṇḍo hanti narādhipam ॥17॥
html:
vimānito hatotkruṣṭastrātāraṃ cenna vindati ।
amānuṣakṛtastatra daṇḍo hanti narādhipam ॥17॥
slp1: vimAnito hatotkruzwastrAtAraM cenna vindati । amAnuzakftastatra daRqo hanti narADipam ॥17॥

text: mā sma tāta bale stheyā bādhiṣṭhā māpi durbalam । mā tvā durbalacakṣūṃṣi dhakṣyantyagnirivāśrayam ॥18॥
html:
mā sma tāta bale stheyā bādhiṣṭhā māpi durbalam ।
mā tvā durbalacakṣūṃṣi dhakṣyantyagnirivāśrayam ॥18॥
slp1: mA sma tAta bale sTeyA bADizWA mApi durbalam । mA tvA durbalacakzUMzi DakzyantyagnirivASrayam ॥18॥

text: yāni mithyābhiśastānāṃ patantyaśrūṇi rodatām । tāni putrānpaśūnghnanti teṣāṃ mithyābhiśāsatām ॥19॥
html:
yāni mithyābhiśastānāṃ patantyaśrūṇi rodatām ।
tāni putrānpaśūnghnanti teṣāṃ mithyābhiśāsatām ॥19॥
slp1: yAni miTyABiSastAnAM patantyaSrURi rodatAm । tAni putrAnpaSUnGnanti tezAM miTyABiSAsatAm ॥19॥

text: yadi nātmani putreṣu na cetpautreṣu naptṛṣu । na hi pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ karma sadyaḥ phalati gauriva ॥20॥
html:
yadi nātmani putreṣu na cetpautreṣu naptṛṣu ।
na hi pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ karma sadyaḥ phalati gauriva ॥20॥
slp1: yadi nAtmani putrezu na cetpOtrezu naptfzu । na hi pApaM kftaM karma sadyaH Palati gOriva ॥20॥

text: yatrābalo vadhyamānastrātāraṃ nādhigacchati । mahāndaivakṛtastatra daṇḍaḥ patati dāruṇaḥ ॥21॥
html:
yatrābalo vadhyamānastrātāraṃ nādhigacchati ।
mahāndaivakṛtastatra daṇḍaḥ patati dāruṇaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: yatrAbalo vaDyamAnastrAtAraM nADigacCati । mahAndEvakftastatra daRqaH patati dAruRaH ॥21॥

text: yuktā yadā jānapadā bhikṣante brāhmaṇā iva । abhīkṣṇaṃ bhikṣudoṣeṇa rājānaṃ ghnanti tādṛśāḥ ॥22॥
html:
yuktā yadā jānapadā bhikṣante brāhmaṇā iva ।
abhīkṣṇaṃ bhikṣudoṣeṇa rājānaṃ ghnanti tādṛśāḥ ॥22॥
slp1: yuktA yadA jAnapadA Bikzante brAhmaRA iva । aBIkzRaM BikzudozeRa rAjAnaM Gnanti tAdfSAH ॥22॥

text: rājño yadā janapade bahavo rājapūruṣāḥ । anayenopavartante tadrājñaḥ kilbiṣaṃ mahat ॥23॥
html:
rājño yadā janapade bahavo rājapūruṣāḥ ।
anayenopavartante tadrājñaḥ kilbiṣaṃ mahat ॥23॥
slp1: rAjYo yadA janapade bahavo rAjapUruzAH । anayenopavartante tadrAjYaH kilbizaM mahat ॥23॥

text: yadā yuktā nayantyarthānkāmādarthavaśena vā । kṛpaṇaṃ yācamānānāṃ tadrājño vaiśasaṃ mahat ॥24॥
html:
yadā yuktā nayantyarthānkāmādarthavaśena vā ।
kṛpaṇaṃ yācamānānāṃ tadrājño vaiśasaṃ mahat ॥24॥
slp1: yadA yuktA nayantyarTAnkAmAdarTavaSena vA । kfpaRaM yAcamAnAnAM tadrAjYo vESasaM mahat ॥24॥

text: mahāvṛkṣo jāyate vardhate ca taṃ caiva bhūtāni samāśrayanti । yadā vṛkṣaśchidyate dahyate vā tadāśrayā aniketā bhavanti ॥25॥
html:
mahāvṛkṣo jāyate vardhate ca taṃ caiva bhūtāni samāśrayanti ।
yadā vṛkṣaśchidyate dahyate vā tadāśrayā aniketā bhavanti ॥25॥
slp1: mahAvfkzo jAyate varDate ca taM cEva BUtAni samASrayanti । yadA vfkzaSCidyate dahyate vA tadASrayA aniketA Bavanti ॥25॥

text: yadā rāṣṭre dharmamagryaṃ caranti saṃskāraṃ vā rājaguṇaṃ bruvāṇāḥ । tairevādharmaścarito dharmamohāttūrṇaṃ jahyātsukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ ca ॥26॥
html:
yadā rāṣṭre dharmamagryaṃ caranti saṃskāraṃ vā rājaguṇaṃ bruvāṇāḥ ।
tairevādharmaścarito dharmamohāttūrṇaṃ jahyātsukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ ca ॥26॥
slp1: yadA rAzwre DarmamagryaM caranti saMskAraM vA rAjaguRaM bruvARAH । tErevADarmaScarito DarmamohAttUrRaM jahyAtsukftaM duzkftaM ca ॥26॥

text: yatra pāpā jñāyamānāścaranti satāṃ kalirvindati tatra rājñaḥ । yadā rājā śāsti narānnaśiṣyānna tadrājyaṃ vardhate bhūmipāla ॥27॥
html:
yatra pāpā jñāyamānāścaranti satāṃ kalirvindati tatra rājñaḥ ।
yadā rājā śāsti narānnaśiṣyānna tadrājyaṃ vardhate bhūmipāla ॥27॥
slp1: yatra pApA jYAyamAnAScaranti satAM kalirvindati tatra rAjYaH । yadA rAjA SAsti narAnnaSizyAnna tadrAjyaM varDate BUmipAla ॥27॥

text: yaścāmātyaṃ mānayitvā yathārhaṃ mantre ca yuddhe ca nṛpo niyuñjyāt । pravardhate tasya rāṣṭraṃ nṛpasya bhuṅkte mahīṃ cāpyakhilāṃ cirāya ॥28॥
html:
yaścāmātyaṃ mānayitvā yathārhaṃ mantre ca yuddhe ca nṛpo niyuñjyāt ।
pravardhate tasya rāṣṭraṃ nṛpasya bhuṅkte mahīṃ cāpyakhilāṃ cirāya ॥28॥
slp1: yaScAmAtyaM mAnayitvA yaTArhaM mantre ca yudDe ca nfpo niyuYjyAt । pravarDate tasya rAzwraM nfpasya BuNkte mahIM cApyaKilAM cirAya ॥28॥

text: atrāpi sukṛtaṃ karma vācaṃ caiva subhāṣitām । samīkṣya pūjayanrājā dharmaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam ॥29॥
html:
atrāpi sukṛtaṃ karma vācaṃ caiva subhāṣitām ।
samīkṣya pūjayanrājā dharmaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam ॥29॥
slp1: atrApi sukftaM karma vAcaM cEva suBAzitAm । samIkzya pUjayanrAjA DarmaM prApnotyanuttamam ॥29॥

text: saṃvibhajya yadā bhuṅkte na cānyānavamanyate । nihanti balinaṃ dṛptaṃ sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥30॥
html:
saṃvibhajya yadā bhuṅkte na cānyānavamanyate ।
nihanti balinaṃ dṛptaṃ sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥30॥
slp1: saMviBajya yadA BuNkte na cAnyAnavamanyate । nihanti balinaM dfptaM sa rAjYo Darma ucyate ॥30॥

text: trāyate hi yadā sarvaṃ vācā kāyena karmaṇā । putrasyāpi na mṛṣyecca sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥31॥
html:
trāyate hi yadā sarvaṃ vācā kāyena karmaṇā ।
putrasyāpi na mṛṣyecca sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥31॥
slp1: trAyate hi yadA sarvaM vAcA kAyena karmaRA । putrasyApi na mfzyecca sa rAjYo Darma ucyate ॥31॥

text: yadā śāraṇikānrājā putravatparirakṣati । bhinatti na ca maryādāṃ sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥32॥
html:
yadā śāraṇikānrājā putravatparirakṣati ।
bhinatti na ca maryādāṃ sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥32॥
slp1: yadA SAraRikAnrAjA putravatparirakzati । Binatti na ca maryAdAM sa rAjYo Darma ucyate ॥32॥

text: yadāptadakṣiṇairyajñairyajate śraddhayānvitaḥ । kāmadveṣāvanādṛtya sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥33॥
html:
yadāptadakṣiṇairyajñairyajate śraddhayānvitaḥ ।
kāmadveṣāvanādṛtya sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥33॥
slp1: yadAptadakziREryajYEryajate SradDayAnvitaH । kAmadvezAvanAdftya sa rAjYo Darma ucyate ॥33॥

text: kṛpaṇānāthavṛddhānāṃ yadāśru vyapamārṣṭi vai । harṣaṃ sañjanayannṝṇāṃ sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥34॥
html:
kṛpaṇānāthavṛddhānāṃ yadāśru vyapamārṣṭi vai ।
harṣaṃ sañjanayannṝṇāṃ sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥34॥
slp1: kfpaRAnATavfdDAnAM yadASru vyapamArzwi vE । harzaM saYjanayannFRAM sa rAjYo Darma ucyate ॥34॥

text: vivardhayati mitrāṇi tathārīṃścāpakarṣati । sampūjayati sādhūṃśca sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥35॥
html:
vivardhayati mitrāṇi tathārīṃścāpakarṣati ।
sampūjayati sādhūṃśca sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥35॥
slp1: vivarDayati mitrARi taTArIMScApakarzati । sampUjayati sADUMSca sa rAjYo Darma ucyate ॥35॥

text: satyaṃ pālayati prāptyā nityaṃ bhūmiṃ prayacchati । pūjayatyatithīnbhṛtyānsa rājño dharma ucyate ॥36॥
html:
satyaṃ pālayati prāptyā nityaṃ bhūmiṃ prayacchati ।
pūjayatyatithīnbhṛtyānsa rājño dharma ucyate ॥36॥
slp1: satyaM pAlayati prAptyA nityaM BUmiM prayacCati । pUjayatyatiTInBftyAnsa rAjYo Darma ucyate ॥36॥

text: nigrahānugrahau cobhau yatra syātāṃ pratiṣṭhitau । asmiṁlloke pare caiva rājā tatprāpnute phalam ॥37॥
html:
nigrahānugrahau cobhau yatra syātāṃ pratiṣṭhitau ।
asmiṁlloke pare caiva rājā tatprāpnute phalam ॥37॥
slp1: nigrahAnugrahO coBO yatra syAtAM pratizWitO । asmiṁlloke pare cEva rAjA tatprApnute Palam ॥37॥

text: yamo rājā dhārmikāṇāṃ māndhātaḥ parameśvaraḥ । saṃyacchanbhavati prāṇānnasaṃyacchaṃstu pāpakaḥ ॥38॥
html:
yamo rājā dhārmikāṇāṃ māndhātaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
saṃyacchanbhavati prāṇānnasaṃyacchaṃstu pāpakaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: yamo rAjA DArmikARAM mAnDAtaH parameSvaraH । saMyacCanBavati prARAnnasaMyacCaMstu pApakaH ॥38॥

text: ṛtvikpurohitācāryānsatkṛtyānavamanya ca । yadā samyakpragṛhṇāti sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥39॥
html:
ṛtvikpurohitācāryānsatkṛtyānavamanya ca ।
yadā samyakpragṛhṇāti sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥39॥
slp1: ftvikpurohitAcAryAnsatkftyAnavamanya ca । yadA samyakpragfhRAti sa rAjYo Darma ucyate ॥39॥

text: yamo yacchati bhūtāni sarvāṇyevāviśeṣataḥ । tasya rājñānukartavyaṃ yantavyā vidhivatprajāḥ ॥40॥
html:
yamo yacchati bhūtāni sarvāṇyevāviśeṣataḥ ।
tasya rājñānukartavyaṃ yantavyā vidhivatprajāḥ ॥40॥
slp1: yamo yacCati BUtAni sarvARyevAviSezataH । tasya rAjYAnukartavyaM yantavyA viDivatprajAH ॥40॥

text: sahasrākṣeṇa rājā hi sarva evopamīyate । sa paśyati hi yaṃ dharmaṃ sa dharmaḥ puruṣarṣabha ॥41॥
html:
sahasrākṣeṇa rājā hi sarva evopamīyate ।
sa paśyati hi yaṃ dharmaṃ sa dharmaḥ puruṣarṣabha ॥41॥
slp1: sahasrAkzeRa rAjA hi sarva evopamIyate । sa paSyati hi yaM DarmaM sa DarmaH puruzarzaBa ॥41॥

text: apramādena śikṣethāḥ kṣamāṃ buddhiṃ dhṛtiṃ matim । bhūtānāṃ sattvajijñāsāṃ sādhvasādhu ca sarvadā ॥42॥
html:
apramādena śikṣethāḥ kṣamāṃ buddhiṃ dhṛtiṃ matim ।
bhūtānāṃ sattvajijñāsāṃ sādhvasādhu ca sarvadā ॥42॥
slp1: apramAdena SikzeTAH kzamAM budDiM DftiM matim । BUtAnAM sattvajijYAsAM sADvasADu ca sarvadA ॥42॥

text: saṅgrahaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dānaṃ ca madhurā ca vāk । paurajānapadāścaiva goptavyāḥ svā yathā prajāḥ ॥43॥
html:
saṅgrahaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dānaṃ ca madhurā ca vāk ।
paurajānapadāścaiva goptavyāḥ svā yathā prajāḥ ॥43॥
slp1: saNgrahaH sarvaBUtAnAM dAnaM ca maDurA ca vAk । pOrajAnapadAScEva goptavyAH svA yaTA prajAH ॥43॥

text: na jātvadakṣo nṛpatiḥ prajāḥ śaknoti rakṣitum । bhāro hi sumahāṃstāta rājyaṃ nāma suduṣkaram ॥44॥
html:
na jātvadakṣo nṛpatiḥ prajāḥ śaknoti rakṣitum ।
bhāro hi sumahāṃstāta rājyaṃ nāma suduṣkaram ॥44॥
slp1: na jAtvadakzo nfpatiH prajAH Saknoti rakzitum । BAro hi sumahAMstAta rAjyaM nAma suduzkaram ॥44॥

text: taddaṇḍavinnṛpaḥ prājñaḥ śūraḥ śaknoti rakṣitum । na hi śakyamadaṇḍena klībenābuddhināpi vā ॥45॥
html:
taddaṇḍavinnṛpaḥ prājñaḥ śūraḥ śaknoti rakṣitum ।
na hi śakyamadaṇḍena klībenābuddhināpi vā ॥45॥
slp1: taddaRqavinnfpaH prAjYaH SUraH Saknoti rakzitum । na hi SakyamadaRqena klIbenAbudDinApi vA ॥45॥

text: abhirūpaiḥ kule jātairdakṣairbhaktairbahuśrutaiḥ । sarvā buddhīḥ parīkṣethāstāpasāśramiṇāmapi ॥46॥
html:
abhirūpaiḥ kule jātairdakṣairbhaktairbahuśrutaiḥ ।
sarvā buddhīḥ parīkṣethāstāpasāśramiṇāmapi ॥46॥
slp1: aBirUpEH kule jAtErdakzErBaktErbahuSrutEH । sarvA budDIH parIkzeTAstApasASramiRAmapi ॥46॥

text: tatastvaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dharmaṃ vetsyasi vai param । svadeśe paradeśe vā na te dharmo vinaśyati ॥47॥
html:
tatastvaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dharmaṃ vetsyasi vai param ।
svadeśe paradeśe vā na te dharmo vinaśyati ॥47॥
slp1: tatastvaM sarvaBUtAnAM DarmaM vetsyasi vE param । svadeSe paradeSe vA na te Darmo vinaSyati ॥47॥

text: dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca dharma evottaro bhavet । asmiṁlloke pare caiva dharmavitsukhamedhate ॥48॥
html:
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca dharma evottaro bhavet ।
asmiṁlloke pare caiva dharmavitsukhamedhate ॥48॥
slp1: DarmaScArTaSca kAmaSca Darma evottaro Bavet । asmiṁlloke pare cEva DarmavitsuKameDate ॥48॥

text: tyajanti dārānprāṇāṃśca manuṣyāḥ pratipūjitāḥ । saṅgrahaścaiva bhūtānāṃ dānaṃ ca madhurā ca vāk ॥49॥
html:
tyajanti dārānprāṇāṃśca manuṣyāḥ pratipūjitāḥ ।
saṅgrahaścaiva bhūtānāṃ dānaṃ ca madhurā ca vāk ॥49॥
slp1: tyajanti dArAnprARAMSca manuzyAH pratipUjitAH । saNgrahaScEva BUtAnAM dAnaM ca maDurA ca vAk ॥49॥

text: apramādaśca śaucaṃ ca tāta bhūtikaraṃ mahat । etebhyaścaiva māndhātaḥ satataṃ mā pramādithāḥ ॥50॥
html:
apramādaśca śaucaṃ ca tāta bhūtikaraṃ mahat ।
etebhyaścaiva māndhātaḥ satataṃ mā pramādithāḥ ॥50॥
slp1: apramAdaSca SOcaM ca tAta BUtikaraM mahat । eteByaScEva mAnDAtaH satataM mA pramAdiTAH ॥50॥

text: apramatto bhavedrājā chidradarśī parātmanoḥ । nāsya chidraṃ paraḥ paśyecchidreṣu paramanviyāt ॥51॥
html:
apramatto bhavedrājā chidradarśī parātmanoḥ ।
nāsya chidraṃ paraḥ paśyecchidreṣu paramanviyāt ॥51॥
slp1: apramatto BavedrAjA CidradarSI parAtmanoH । nAsya CidraM paraH paSyecCidrezu paramanviyAt ॥51॥

text: etadvṛttaṃ vāsavasya yamasya varuṇasya ca । rājarṣīṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ tattvamapyanupālaya ॥52॥
html:
etadvṛttaṃ vāsavasya yamasya varuṇasya ca ।
rājarṣīṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ tattvamapyanupālaya ॥52॥
slp1: etadvfttaM vAsavasya yamasya varuRasya ca । rAjarzIRAM ca sarvezAM tattvamapyanupAlaya ॥52॥

text: tatkuruṣva mahārāja vṛttaṃ rājarṣisevitam । ātiṣṭha divyaṃ panthānamahnāya bharatarṣabha ॥53॥
html:
tatkuruṣva mahārāja vṛttaṃ rājarṣisevitam ।
ātiṣṭha divyaṃ panthānamahnāya bharatarṣabha ॥53॥
slp1: tatkuruzva mahArAja vfttaM rAjarzisevitam । AtizWa divyaM panTAnamahnAya BaratarzaBa ॥53॥

text: dharmavṛttaṃ hi rājānaṃ pretya ceha ca bhārata । devarṣipitṛgandharvāḥ kīrtayantyamitaujasaḥ ॥54॥
html:
dharmavṛttaṃ hi rājānaṃ pretya ceha ca bhārata ।
devarṣipitṛgandharvāḥ kīrtayantyamitaujasaḥ ॥54॥
slp1: DarmavfttaM hi rAjAnaM pretya ceha ca BArata । devarzipitfganDarvAH kIrtayantyamitOjasaH ॥54॥

text: sa evamukto māndhātā tenotathyena bhārata । kṛtavānaviśaṅkastadekaḥ prāpa ca medinīm ॥55॥
html:
sa evamukto māndhātā tenotathyena bhārata ।
kṛtavānaviśaṅkastadekaḥ prāpa ca medinīm ॥55॥
slp1: sa evamukto mAnDAtA tenotaTyena BArata । kftavAnaviSaNkastadekaH prApa ca medinIm ॥55॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: bhavānapi tathā samyaṅmāndhāteva mahīpatiḥ । dharmaṃ kṛtvā mahīṃ rakṣansvarge sthānamavāpsyasi] ॥56॥
html:
bhavānapi tathā samyaṅmāndhāteva mahīpatiḥ ।
dharmaṃ kṛtvā mahīṃ rakṣansvarge sthānamavāpsyasi] ॥56॥
slp1: BavAnapi taTA samyaNmAnDAteva mahIpatiH । DarmaM kftvA mahIM rakzansvarge sTAnamavApsyasi] ॥56॥

text: kathaṃ dharme sthātumicchanrājā varteta dhārmikaḥ । pṛcchāmi tvā kuruśreṣṭha tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
kathaṃ dharme sthātumicchanrājā varteta dhārmikaḥ ।
pṛcchāmi tvā kuruśreṣṭha tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: kaTaM Darme sTAtumicCanrAjA varteta DArmikaH । pfcCAmi tvA kuruSrezWa tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । gītaṃ dṛṣṭārthatattvena vāmadevena dhīmatā ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
gītaṃ dṛṣṭārthatattvena vāmadevena dhīmatā ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । gItaM dfzwArTatattvena vAmadevena DImatA ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: rājā vasumanā nāma kausalyo balavāñśuciḥ । maharṣiṃ paripapraccha vāmadevaṃ yaśasvinam ॥3॥
html:
rājā vasumanā nāma kausalyo balavāñśuciḥ ।
maharṣiṃ paripapraccha vāmadevaṃ yaśasvinam ॥3॥
slp1: rAjA vasumanA nAma kOsalyo balavAYSuciH । maharziM paripapracCa vAmadevaM yaSasvinam ॥3॥

text: dharmārthasahitaṃ vākyaṃ bhagavannanuśādhi mām । yena vṛttena vai tiṣṭhanna cyaveyaṃ svadharmataḥ ॥4॥
html:
dharmārthasahitaṃ vākyaṃ bhagavannanuśādhi mām ।
yena vṛttena vai tiṣṭhanna cyaveyaṃ svadharmataḥ ॥4॥
slp1: DarmArTasahitaM vAkyaM BagavannanuSADi mAm । yena vfttena vE tizWanna cyaveyaM svaDarmataH ॥4॥

text: tamabravīdvāmadevastapasvī japatāṃ varaḥ । hemavarṇamupāsīnaṃ yayātimiva nāhuṣam ॥5॥
html:
tamabravīdvāmadevastapasvī japatāṃ varaḥ ।
hemavarṇamupāsīnaṃ yayātimiva nāhuṣam ॥5॥
slp1: tamabravIdvAmadevastapasvI japatAM varaH । hemavarRamupAsInaM yayAtimiva nAhuzam ॥5॥

text: dharmamevānuvartasva na dharmādvidyate param । dharme sthitā hi rājāno jayanti pṛthivīmimām ॥6॥
html:
dharmamevānuvartasva na dharmādvidyate param ।
dharme sthitā hi rājāno jayanti pṛthivīmimām ॥6॥
slp1: DarmamevAnuvartasva na DarmAdvidyate param । Darme sTitA hi rAjAno jayanti pfTivImimAm ॥6॥

text: arthasiddheḥ paraṃ dharmaṃ manyate yo mahīpatiḥ । ṛtāṃ ca kurute buddhiṃ sa dharmeṇa virocate ॥7॥
html:
arthasiddheḥ paraṃ dharmaṃ manyate yo mahīpatiḥ ।
ṛtāṃ ca kurute buddhiṃ sa dharmeṇa virocate ॥7॥
slp1: arTasidDeH paraM DarmaM manyate yo mahIpatiH । ftAM ca kurute budDiM sa DarmeRa virocate ॥7॥

text: adharmadarśī yo rājā balādeva pravartate । kṣipramevāpayāto'smādubhau prathamamadhyamau ॥8॥
html:
adharmadarśī yo rājā balādeva pravartate ।
kṣipramevāpayāto'smādubhau prathamamadhyamau ॥8॥
slp1: aDarmadarSI yo rAjA balAdeva pravartate । kzipramevApayAto'smAduBO praTamamaDyamO ॥8॥

text: asatpāpiṣṭhasacivo vadhyo lokasya dharmahā । sahaiva parivāreṇa kṣipramevāvasīdati ॥9॥
html:
asatpāpiṣṭhasacivo vadhyo lokasya dharmahā ।
sahaiva parivāreṇa kṣipramevāvasīdati ॥9॥
slp1: asatpApizWasacivo vaDyo lokasya DarmahA । sahEva parivAreRa kzipramevAvasIdati ॥9॥

text: arthānāmananuṣṭhātā kāmacārī vikatthanaḥ । api sarvāṃ mahīṃ labdhvā kṣiprameva vinaśyati ॥10॥
html:
arthānāmananuṣṭhātā kāmacārī vikatthanaḥ ।
api sarvāṃ mahīṃ labdhvā kṣiprameva vinaśyati ॥10॥
slp1: arTAnAmananuzWAtA kAmacArI vikatTanaH । api sarvAM mahIM labDvA kziprameva vinaSyati ॥10॥

text: athādadānaḥ kalyāṇamanasūyurjitendriyaḥ । vardhate matimānrājā srotobhiriva sāgaraḥ ॥11॥
html:
athādadānaḥ kalyāṇamanasūyurjitendriyaḥ ।
vardhate matimānrājā srotobhiriva sāgaraḥ ॥11॥
slp1: aTAdadAnaH kalyARamanasUyurjitendriyaH । varDate matimAnrAjA srotoBiriva sAgaraH ॥11॥

text: na pūrṇo'smīti manyeta dharmataḥ kāmato'rthataḥ । buddhito mitrataścāpi satataṃ vasudhādhipaḥ ॥12॥
html:
na pūrṇo'smīti manyeta dharmataḥ kāmato'rthataḥ ।
buddhito mitrataścāpi satataṃ vasudhādhipaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: na pUrRo'smIti manyeta DarmataH kAmato'rTataH । budDito mitrataScApi satataM vasuDADipaH ॥12॥

text: eteṣveva hi sarveṣu lokayātrā pratiṣṭhitā । etāni śṛṇvaṁllabhate yaśaḥ kīrtiṃ śriyaḥ prajāḥ ॥13॥
html:
eteṣveva hi sarveṣu lokayātrā pratiṣṭhitā ।
etāni śṛṇvaṁllabhate yaśaḥ kīrtiṃ śriyaḥ prajāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: etezveva hi sarvezu lokayAtrA pratizWitA । etAni SfRvaṁllaBate yaSaH kIrtiM SriyaH prajAH ॥13॥

text: evaṃ yo dharmasaṃrambhī dharmārthaparicintakaḥ । arthānsamīkṣyārabhate sa dhruvaṃ mahadaśnute ॥14॥
html:
evaṃ yo dharmasaṃrambhī dharmārthaparicintakaḥ ।
arthānsamīkṣyārabhate sa dhruvaṃ mahadaśnute ॥14॥
slp1: evaM yo DarmasaMramBI DarmArTaparicintakaH । arTAnsamIkzyAraBate sa DruvaM mahadaSnute ॥14॥

text: adātā hyanatisneho daṇḍenāvartayanprajāḥ । sāhasaprakṛtī rājā kṣiprameva vinaśyati ॥15॥
html:
adātā hyanatisneho daṇḍenāvartayanprajāḥ ।
sāhasaprakṛtī rājā kṣiprameva vinaśyati ॥15॥
slp1: adAtA hyanatisneho daRqenAvartayanprajAH । sAhasaprakftI rAjA kziprameva vinaSyati ॥15॥

text: atha pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ buddhyā na ca paśyatyabuddhimān । akīrtyāpi samāyukto mṛto narakamaśnute ॥16॥
html:
atha pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ buddhyā na ca paśyatyabuddhimān ।
akīrtyāpi samāyukto mṛto narakamaśnute ॥16॥
slp1: aTa pApaM kftaM budDyA na ca paSyatyabudDimAn । akIrtyApi samAyukto mfto narakamaSnute ॥16॥

text: atha mānayiturdātuḥ śuklasya rasavedinaḥ । vyasanaṃ svamivotpannaṃ vijighāṃsanti mānavāḥ ॥17॥
html:
atha mānayiturdātuḥ śuklasya rasavedinaḥ ।
vyasanaṃ svamivotpannaṃ vijighāṃsanti mānavāḥ ॥17॥
slp1: aTa mAnayiturdAtuH Suklasya rasavedinaH । vyasanaM svamivotpannaM vijiGAMsanti mAnavAH ॥17॥

text: yasya nāsti gururdharme na cānyānanupṛcchati । sukhatantro'rthalābheṣu na ciraṃ mahadaśnute ॥18॥
html:
yasya nāsti gururdharme na cānyānanupṛcchati ।
sukhatantro'rthalābheṣu na ciraṃ mahadaśnute ॥18॥
slp1: yasya nAsti gururDarme na cAnyAnanupfcCati । suKatantro'rTalABezu na ciraM mahadaSnute ॥18॥

text: gurupradhāno dharmeṣu svayamarthānvavekṣitā । dharmapradhāno lokeṣu suciraṃ mahadaśnute] ॥19॥
html:
gurupradhāno dharmeṣu svayamarthānvavekṣitā ।
dharmapradhāno lokeṣu suciraṃ mahadaśnute] ॥19॥
slp1: gurupraDAno Darmezu svayamarTAnvavekzitA । DarmapraDAno lokezu suciraM mahadaSnute] ॥19॥

text: yatrādharmaṃ praṇayate durbale balavattaraḥ । tāṃ vṛttimupajīvanti ye bhavanti tadanvayāḥ ॥1॥
html:
yatrādharmaṃ praṇayate durbale balavattaraḥ ।
tāṃ vṛttimupajīvanti ye bhavanti tadanvayāḥ ॥1॥
slp1: yatrADarmaM praRayate durbale balavattaraH । tAM vfttimupajIvanti ye Bavanti tadanvayAH ॥1॥
author: vāmadeva uvāca ।

text: rājānamanuvartante taṃ pāpābhipravartakam । avinītamanuṣyaṃ tatkṣipraṃ rāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati ॥2॥
html:
rājānamanuvartante taṃ pāpābhipravartakam ।
avinītamanuṣyaṃ tatkṣipraṃ rāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati ॥2॥
slp1: rAjAnamanuvartante taM pApABipravartakam । avinItamanuzyaM tatkzipraM rAzwraM vinaSyati ॥2॥

text: yadvṛttimupajīvanti prakṛtisthasya mānavāḥ । tadeva viṣamasthasya svajano'pi na mṛṣyate ॥3॥
html:
yadvṛttimupajīvanti prakṛtisthasya mānavāḥ ।
tadeva viṣamasthasya svajano'pi na mṛṣyate ॥3॥
slp1: yadvfttimupajIvanti prakftisTasya mAnavAH । tadeva vizamasTasya svajano'pi na mfzyate ॥3॥

text: sāhasaprakṛtiryatra kurute kiñcidulbaṇam । aśāstralakṣaṇo rājā kṣiprameva vinaśyati ॥4॥
html:
sāhasaprakṛtiryatra kurute kiñcidulbaṇam ।
aśāstralakṣaṇo rājā kṣiprameva vinaśyati ॥4॥
slp1: sAhasaprakftiryatra kurute kiYcidulbaRam । aSAstralakzaRo rAjA kziprameva vinaSyati ॥4॥

text: yo'tyantācaritāṃ vṛttiṃ kṣatriyo nānuvartate । jitānāmajitānāṃ ca kṣatradharmādapaiti saḥ ॥5॥
html:
yo'tyantācaritāṃ vṛttiṃ kṣatriyo nānuvartate ।
jitānāmajitānāṃ ca kṣatradharmādapaiti saḥ ॥5॥
slp1: yo'tyantAcaritAM vfttiM kzatriyo nAnuvartate । jitAnAmajitAnAM ca kzatraDarmAdapEti saH ॥5॥

text: dviṣantaṃ kṛtakarmāṇaṃ gṛhītvā nṛpatī raṇe । yo na mānayate dveṣātkṣatradharmādapaiti saḥ ॥6॥
html:
dviṣantaṃ kṛtakarmāṇaṃ gṛhītvā nṛpatī raṇe ।
yo na mānayate dveṣātkṣatradharmādapaiti saḥ ॥6॥
slp1: dvizantaM kftakarmARaM gfhItvA nfpatI raRe । yo na mAnayate dvezAtkzatraDarmAdapEti saH ॥6॥

text: śaktaḥ syātsumukho rājā kuryātkāruṇyamāpadi । priyo bhavati bhūtānāṃ na ca vibhraśyate śriyaḥ ॥7॥
html:
śaktaḥ syātsumukho rājā kuryātkāruṇyamāpadi ।
priyo bhavati bhūtānāṃ na ca vibhraśyate śriyaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: SaktaH syAtsumuKo rAjA kuryAtkAruRyamApadi । priyo Bavati BUtAnAM na ca viBraSyate SriyaH ॥7॥

text: apriyaṃ yasya kurvīta bhūyastasya priyaṃ caret । nacireṇa priyaḥ sa syādyo'priyaḥ priyamācaret ॥8॥
html:
apriyaṃ yasya kurvīta bhūyastasya priyaṃ caret ।
nacireṇa priyaḥ sa syādyo'priyaḥ priyamācaret ॥8॥
slp1: apriyaM yasya kurvIta BUyastasya priyaM caret । nacireRa priyaH sa syAdyo'priyaH priyamAcaret ॥8॥

text: mṛṣāvādaṃ pariharetkuryātpriyamayācitaḥ । na ca kāmānna saṃrambhānna dveṣāddharmamutsṛjet ॥9॥
html:
mṛṣāvādaṃ pariharetkuryātpriyamayācitaḥ ।
na ca kāmānna saṃrambhānna dveṣāddharmamutsṛjet ॥9॥
slp1: mfzAvAdaM pariharetkuryAtpriyamayAcitaH । na ca kAmAnna saMramBAnna dvezAdDarmamutsfjet ॥9॥

text: nāpatrapeta praśneṣu nābhibhavyāṃ giraṃ sṛjet । na tvareta na cāsūyettathā saṅgṛhyate paraḥ ॥10॥
html:
nāpatrapeta praśneṣu nābhibhavyāṃ giraṃ sṛjet ।
na tvareta na cāsūyettathā saṅgṛhyate paraḥ ॥10॥
slp1: nApatrapeta praSnezu nABiBavyAM giraM sfjet । na tvareta na cAsUyettaTA saNgfhyate paraH ॥10॥

text: priye nātibhṛśaṃ hṛṣyedapriye na ca sañjvaret । na muhyedarthakṛcchreṣu prajāhitamanusmaran ॥11॥
html:
priye nātibhṛśaṃ hṛṣyedapriye na ca sañjvaret ।
na muhyedarthakṛcchreṣu prajāhitamanusmaran ॥11॥
slp1: priye nAtiBfSaM hfzyedapriye na ca saYjvaret । na muhyedarTakfcCrezu prajAhitamanusmaran ॥11॥

text: yaḥ priyaṃ kurute nityaṃ guṇato vasudhādhipaḥ । tasya karmāṇi sidhyanti na ca santyajyate śriyā ॥12॥
html:
yaḥ priyaṃ kurute nityaṃ guṇato vasudhādhipaḥ ।
tasya karmāṇi sidhyanti na ca santyajyate śriyā ॥12॥
slp1: yaH priyaM kurute nityaM guRato vasuDADipaH । tasya karmARi siDyanti na ca santyajyate SriyA ॥12॥

text: nivṛttaṃ pratikūlebhyo vartamānamanupriye । bhaktaṃ bhajeta nṛpatistadvai vṛttaṃ satāmiha ॥13॥
html:
nivṛttaṃ pratikūlebhyo vartamānamanupriye ।
bhaktaṃ bhajeta nṛpatistadvai vṛttaṃ satāmiha ॥13॥
slp1: nivfttaM pratikUleByo vartamAnamanupriye । BaktaM Bajeta nfpatistadvE vfttaM satAmiha ॥13॥

text: aprakīrṇendriyaṃ prājñamatyantānugataṃ śucim । śaktaṃ caivānuraktaṃ ca yuñjyānmahati karmaṇi ॥14॥
html:
aprakīrṇendriyaṃ prājñamatyantānugataṃ śucim ।
śaktaṃ caivānuraktaṃ ca yuñjyānmahati karmaṇi ॥14॥
slp1: aprakIrRendriyaM prAjYamatyantAnugataM Sucim । SaktaM cEvAnuraktaM ca yuYjyAnmahati karmaRi ॥14॥

text: evameva guṇairyukto yo na rajyati bhūmipam । bharturartheṣvasūyantaṃ na taṃ yuñjīta karmaṇi ॥15॥
html:
evameva guṇairyukto yo na rajyati bhūmipam ।
bharturartheṣvasūyantaṃ na taṃ yuñjīta karmaṇi ॥15॥
slp1: evameva guREryukto yo na rajyati BUmipam । BarturarTezvasUyantaM na taM yuYjIta karmaRi ॥15॥

text: mūḍhamaindriyakaṃ lubdhamanāryacaritaṃ śaṭham । anatītopadhaṃ hiṃsraṃ durbuddhimabahuśrutam ॥16॥
html:
mūḍhamaindriyakaṃ lubdhamanāryacaritaṃ śaṭham ।
anatītopadhaṃ hiṃsraṃ durbuddhimabahuśrutam ॥16॥
slp1: mUQamEndriyakaM lubDamanAryacaritaM SaWam । anatItopaDaM hiMsraM durbudDimabahuSrutam ॥16॥

text: tyaktopāttaṃ madyarataṃ dyūtastrīmṛgayāparam । kārye mahati yo yuñjyāddhīyate sa nṛpaḥ śriyaḥ ॥17॥
html:
tyaktopāttaṃ madyarataṃ dyūtastrīmṛgayāparam ।
kārye mahati yo yuñjyāddhīyate sa nṛpaḥ śriyaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: tyaktopAttaM madyarataM dyUtastrImfgayAparam । kArye mahati yo yuYjyAdDIyate sa nfpaH SriyaH ॥17॥

text: rakṣitātmā tu yo rājā rakṣyānyaścānurakṣati । prajāśca tasya vardhante dhruvaṃ ca mahadaśnute ॥18॥
html:
rakṣitātmā tu yo rājā rakṣyānyaścānurakṣati ।
prajāśca tasya vardhante dhruvaṃ ca mahadaśnute ॥18॥
slp1: rakzitAtmA tu yo rAjA rakzyAnyaScAnurakzati । prajASca tasya varDante DruvaM ca mahadaSnute ॥18॥

text: ye kecidbhūmipatayastānsarvānanvavekṣayet । suhṛdbhiranabhikhyātaistena rājā na riṣyate ॥19॥
html:
ye kecidbhūmipatayastānsarvānanvavekṣayet ।
suhṛdbhiranabhikhyātaistena rājā na riṣyate ॥19॥
slp1: ye kecidBUmipatayastAnsarvAnanvavekzayet । suhfdBiranaBiKyAtEstena rAjA na rizyate ॥19॥

text: apakṛtya balasthasya dūrastho'smīti nāśvaset । śyenānucaritairhyete nipatanti pramādyataḥ ॥20॥
html:
apakṛtya balasthasya dūrastho'smīti nāśvaset ।
śyenānucaritairhyete nipatanti pramādyataḥ ॥20॥
slp1: apakftya balasTasya dUrasTo'smIti nASvaset । SyenAnucaritErhyete nipatanti pramAdyataH ॥20॥

text: dṛḍhamūlastvaduṣṭātmā viditvā balamātmanaḥ । abalānabhiyuñjīta na tu ye balavattarāḥ ॥21॥
html:
dṛḍhamūlastvaduṣṭātmā viditvā balamātmanaḥ ।
abalānabhiyuñjīta na tu ye balavattarāḥ ॥21॥
slp1: dfQamUlastvaduzwAtmA viditvA balamAtmanaH । abalAnaBiyuYjIta na tu ye balavattarAH ॥21॥

text: vikrameṇa mahīṃ labdhvā prajā dharmeṇa pālayan । āhave nidhanaṃ kuryādrājā dharmaparāyaṇaḥ ॥22॥
html:
vikrameṇa mahīṃ labdhvā prajā dharmeṇa pālayan ।
āhave nidhanaṃ kuryādrājā dharmaparāyaṇaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: vikrameRa mahIM labDvA prajA DarmeRa pAlayan । Ahave niDanaM kuryAdrAjA DarmaparAyaRaH ॥22॥

text: maraṇāntamidaṃ sarvaṃ neha kiñcidanāmayam । tasmāddharme sthito rājā prajā dharmeṇa pālayet ॥23॥
html:
maraṇāntamidaṃ sarvaṃ neha kiñcidanāmayam ।
tasmāddharme sthito rājā prajā dharmeṇa pālayet ॥23॥
slp1: maraRAntamidaM sarvaM neha kiYcidanAmayam । tasmAdDarme sTito rAjA prajA DarmeRa pAlayet ॥23॥

text: rakṣādhikaraṇaṃ yuddhaṃ tathā dharmānuśāsanam । mantracintyaṃ sukhaṃ kāle pañcabhirvardhate mahī ॥24॥
html:
rakṣādhikaraṇaṃ yuddhaṃ tathā dharmānuśāsanam ।
mantracintyaṃ sukhaṃ kāle pañcabhirvardhate mahī ॥24॥
slp1: rakzADikaraRaM yudDaM taTA DarmAnuSAsanam । mantracintyaM suKaM kAle paYcaBirvarDate mahI ॥24॥

text: etāni yasya guptāni sa rājā rājasattama । satataṃ vartamāno'tra rājā bhuṅkte mahīmimām ॥25॥
html:
etāni yasya guptāni sa rājā rājasattama ।
satataṃ vartamāno'tra rājā bhuṅkte mahīmimām ॥25॥
slp1: etAni yasya guptAni sa rAjA rAjasattama । satataM vartamAno'tra rAjA BuNkte mahImimAm ॥25॥

text: naitānyekena śakyāni sātatyenānvavekṣitum । eteṣvāptānpratiṣṭhāpya rājā bhuṅkte mahīṃ ciram ॥26॥
html:
naitānyekena śakyāni sātatyenānvavekṣitum ।
eteṣvāptānpratiṣṭhāpya rājā bhuṅkte mahīṃ ciram ॥26॥
slp1: nEtAnyekena SakyAni sAtatyenAnvavekzitum । etezvAptAnpratizWApya rAjA BuNkte mahIM ciram ॥26॥

text: dātāraṃ saṃvibhaktāraṃ mārdavopagataṃ śucim । asantyaktamanuṣyaṃ ca taṃ janāḥ kurvate priyam ॥27॥
html:
dātāraṃ saṃvibhaktāraṃ mārdavopagataṃ śucim ।
asantyaktamanuṣyaṃ ca taṃ janāḥ kurvate priyam ॥27॥
slp1: dAtAraM saMviBaktAraM mArdavopagataM Sucim । asantyaktamanuzyaM ca taM janAH kurvate priyam ॥27॥

text: yastu niḥśreyasaṃ jñātvā jñānaṃ tatpratipadyate । ātmano matamutsṛjya taṃ loko'nuvidhīyate ॥28॥
html:
yastu niḥśreyasaṃ jñātvā jñānaṃ tatpratipadyate ।
ātmano matamutsṛjya taṃ loko'nuvidhīyate ॥28॥
slp1: yastu niHSreyasaM jYAtvA jYAnaM tatpratipadyate । Atmano matamutsfjya taM loko'nuviDIyate ॥28॥

text: yo'rthakāmasya vacanaṃ prātikūlyānna mṛṣyate । śṛṇoti pratikūlāni vimanā nacirādiva ॥29॥
html:
yo'rthakāmasya vacanaṃ prātikūlyānna mṛṣyate ।
śṛṇoti pratikūlāni vimanā nacirādiva ॥29॥
slp1: yo'rTakAmasya vacanaM prAtikUlyAnna mfzyate । SfRoti pratikUlAni vimanA nacirAdiva ॥29॥

text: agrāmyacaritāṃ buddhimatyantaṃ yo na budhyate । jitānāmajitānāṃ ca kṣatradharmādapaiti saḥ ॥30॥
html:
agrāmyacaritāṃ buddhimatyantaṃ yo na budhyate ।
jitānāmajitānāṃ ca kṣatradharmādapaiti saḥ ॥30॥
slp1: agrAmyacaritAM budDimatyantaM yo na buDyate । jitAnAmajitAnAM ca kzatraDarmAdapEti saH ॥30॥

text: mukhyānamātyānyo hitvā nihīnānkurute priyān । sa vai vyasanamāsādya gādhamārto na vindati ॥31॥
html:
mukhyānamātyānyo hitvā nihīnānkurute priyān ।
sa vai vyasanamāsādya gādhamārto na vindati ॥31॥
slp1: muKyAnamAtyAnyo hitvA nihInAnkurute priyAn । sa vE vyasanamAsAdya gADamArto na vindati ॥31॥

text: yaḥ kalyāṇaguṇāñjñātīndveṣānnaivābhimanyate । adṛḍhātmā dṛḍhakrodho nāsyārtho ramate'ntike ॥32॥
html:
yaḥ kalyāṇaguṇāñjñātīndveṣānnaivābhimanyate ।
adṛḍhātmā dṛḍhakrodho nāsyārtho ramate'ntike ॥32॥
slp1: yaH kalyARaguRAYjYAtIndvezAnnEvABimanyate । adfQAtmA dfQakroDo nAsyArTo ramate'ntike ॥32॥

text: atha yo guṇasampannānhṛdayasyāpriyānapi । priyeṇa kurute vaśyāṃściraṃ yaśasi tiṣṭhati ॥33॥
html:
atha yo guṇasampannānhṛdayasyāpriyānapi ।
priyeṇa kurute vaśyāṃściraṃ yaśasi tiṣṭhati ॥33॥
slp1: aTa yo guRasampannAnhfdayasyApriyAnapi । priyeRa kurute vaSyAMSciraM yaSasi tizWati ॥33॥

text: nākāle praṇayedarthānnāpriye jātu sañjvaret । priye nātibhṛśaṃ hṛṣyedyujyetārogyakarmaṇi ॥34॥
html:
nākāle praṇayedarthānnāpriye jātu sañjvaret ।
priye nātibhṛśaṃ hṛṣyedyujyetārogyakarmaṇi ॥34॥
slp1: nAkAle praRayedarTAnnApriye jAtu saYjvaret । priye nAtiBfSaM hfzyedyujyetArogyakarmaRi ॥34॥

text: ke mānuraktā rājānaḥ ke bhayātsamupāśritāḥ । madhyasthadoṣāḥ ke caiṣāmiti nityaṃ vicintayet ॥35॥
html:
ke mānuraktā rājānaḥ ke bhayātsamupāśritāḥ ।
madhyasthadoṣāḥ ke caiṣāmiti nityaṃ vicintayet ॥35॥
slp1: ke mAnuraktA rAjAnaH ke BayAtsamupASritAH । maDyasTadozAH ke cEzAmiti nityaM vicintayet ॥35॥

text: na jātu balavānbhūtvā durbale viśvasetkvacit । bhāruṇḍasadṛśā hyete nipatanti pramādyataḥ ॥36॥
html:
na jātu balavānbhūtvā durbale viśvasetkvacit ।
bhāruṇḍasadṛśā hyete nipatanti pramādyataḥ ॥36॥
slp1: na jAtu balavAnBUtvA durbale viSvasetkvacit । BAruRqasadfSA hyete nipatanti pramAdyataH ॥36॥

text: api sarvairguṇairyuktaṃ bhartāraṃ priyavādinam । abhidruhyati pāpātmā tasmāddhi vibhiṣejjanāt ॥37॥
html:
api sarvairguṇairyuktaṃ bhartāraṃ priyavādinam ।
abhidruhyati pāpātmā tasmāddhi vibhiṣejjanāt ॥37॥
slp1: api sarvErguREryuktaM BartAraM priyavAdinam । aBidruhyati pApAtmA tasmAdDi viBizejjanAt ॥37॥

text: etāṃ rājopaniṣadaṃ yayātiḥ smāha nāhuṣaḥ । manuṣyavijaye yukto hanti śatrūnanuttamān] ॥38॥
html:
etāṃ rājopaniṣadaṃ yayātiḥ smāha nāhuṣaḥ ।
manuṣyavijaye yukto hanti śatrūnanuttamān] ॥38॥
slp1: etAM rAjopanizadaM yayAtiH smAha nAhuzaH । manuzyavijaye yukto hanti SatrUnanuttamAn] ॥38॥

text: ayuddhenaiva vijayaṃ vardhayedvasudhādhipaḥ । jaghanyamāhurvijayaṃ yo yuddhena narādhipa ॥1॥
html:
ayuddhenaiva vijayaṃ vardhayedvasudhādhipaḥ ।
jaghanyamāhurvijayaṃ yo yuddhena narādhipa ॥1॥
slp1: ayudDenEva vijayaM varDayedvasuDADipaH । jaGanyamAhurvijayaM yo yudDena narADipa ॥1॥
author: vāmadeva uvāca ।

text: na cāpyalabdhaṃ lipseta mūle nātidṛḍhe sati । na hi durbalamūlasya rājño lābho vidhīyate ॥2॥
html:
na cāpyalabdhaṃ lipseta mūle nātidṛḍhe sati ।
na hi durbalamūlasya rājño lābho vidhīyate ॥2॥
slp1: na cApyalabDaM lipseta mUle nAtidfQe sati । na hi durbalamUlasya rAjYo lABo viDIyate ॥2॥

text: yasya sphīto janapadaḥ sampannaḥ priyarājakaḥ । santuṣṭapuṣṭasacivo dṛḍhamūlaḥ sa pārthivaḥ ॥3॥
html:
yasya sphīto janapadaḥ sampannaḥ priyarājakaḥ ।
santuṣṭapuṣṭasacivo dṛḍhamūlaḥ sa pārthivaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: yasya sPIto janapadaH sampannaH priyarAjakaH । santuzwapuzwasacivo dfQamUlaH sa pArTivaH ॥3॥

text: yasya yodhāḥ susantuṣṭāḥ sāntvitāḥ sūpadhāsthitāḥ । alpenāpi sa daṇḍena mahīṃ jayati bhūmipaḥ ॥4॥
html:
yasya yodhāḥ susantuṣṭāḥ sāntvitāḥ sūpadhāsthitāḥ ।
alpenāpi sa daṇḍena mahīṃ jayati bhūmipaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: yasya yoDAH susantuzwAH sAntvitAH sUpaDAsTitAH । alpenApi sa daRqena mahIM jayati BUmipaH ॥4॥

text: paurajānapadā yasya svanuraktāḥ supūjitāḥ । sadhanā dhānyavantaśca dṛḍhamūlaḥ sa pārthivaḥ ॥5॥
html:
paurajānapadā yasya svanuraktāḥ supūjitāḥ ।
sadhanā dhānyavantaśca dṛḍhamūlaḥ sa pārthivaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: pOrajAnapadA yasya svanuraktAH supUjitAH । saDanA DAnyavantaSca dfQamUlaH sa pArTivaH ॥5॥

text: prabhāvakālāvadhikau yadā manyeta cātmanaḥ । tadā lipseta medhāvī parabhūmiṃ dhanānyuta ॥6॥
html:
prabhāvakālāvadhikau yadā manyeta cātmanaḥ ।
tadā lipseta medhāvī parabhūmiṃ dhanānyuta ॥6॥
slp1: praBAvakAlAvaDikO yadA manyeta cAtmanaH । tadA lipseta meDAvI paraBUmiM DanAnyuta ॥6॥

text: bhogeṣvadayamānasya bhūteṣu ca dayāvataḥ । vardhate tvaramāṇasya viṣayo rakṣitātmanaḥ ॥7॥
html:
bhogeṣvadayamānasya bhūteṣu ca dayāvataḥ ।
vardhate tvaramāṇasya viṣayo rakṣitātmanaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: BogezvadayamAnasya BUtezu ca dayAvataH । varDate tvaramARasya vizayo rakzitAtmanaH ॥7॥

text: takṣatyātmānamevaiṣa vanaṃ paraśunā yathā । yaḥ samyagvartamāneṣu sveṣu mithyā pravartate ॥8॥
html:
takṣatyātmānamevaiṣa vanaṃ paraśunā yathā ।
yaḥ samyagvartamāneṣu sveṣu mithyā pravartate ॥8॥
slp1: takzatyAtmAnamevEza vanaM paraSunA yaTA । yaH samyagvartamAnezu svezu miTyA pravartate ॥8॥

text: na vai dviṣantaḥ kṣīyante rājño nityamapi ghnataḥ । krodhaṃ niyantuṃ yo veda tasya dveṣṭā na vidyate ॥9॥
html:
na vai dviṣantaḥ kṣīyante rājño nityamapi ghnataḥ ।
krodhaṃ niyantuṃ yo veda tasya dveṣṭā na vidyate ॥9॥
slp1: na vE dvizantaH kzIyante rAjYo nityamapi GnataH । kroDaM niyantuM yo veda tasya dvezwA na vidyate ॥9॥

text: yadāryajanavidviṣṭaṃ karma tannācaredbudhaḥ । yatkalyāṇamabhidhyāyettatrātmānaṃ niyojayet ॥10॥
html:
yadāryajanavidviṣṭaṃ karma tannācaredbudhaḥ ।
yatkalyāṇamabhidhyāyettatrātmānaṃ niyojayet ॥10॥
slp1: yadAryajanavidvizwaM karma tannAcaredbuDaH । yatkalyARamaBiDyAyettatrAtmAnaM niyojayet ॥10॥

text: nainamanye'vajānanti nātmanā paritapyate । kṛtyaśeṣeṇa yo rājā sukhānyanububhūṣati ॥11॥
html:
nainamanye'vajānanti nātmanā paritapyate ।
kṛtyaśeṣeṇa yo rājā sukhānyanububhūṣati ॥11॥
slp1: nEnamanye'vajAnanti nAtmanA paritapyate । kftyaSezeRa yo rAjA suKAnyanubuBUzati ॥11॥

text: idaṃvṛttaṃ manuṣyeṣu vartate yo mahīpatiḥ । ubhau lokau vinirjitya vijaye sampratiṣṭhate ॥12॥
html:
idaṃvṛttaṃ manuṣyeṣu vartate yo mahīpatiḥ ।
ubhau lokau vinirjitya vijaye sampratiṣṭhate ॥12॥
slp1: idaMvfttaM manuzyezu vartate yo mahIpatiH । uBO lokO vinirjitya vijaye sampratizWate ॥12॥

text: ityukto vāmadevena sarvaṃ tatkṛtavānnṛpaḥ । tathā kurvaṃstvamapyetau lokau jetā na saṃśayaḥ] ॥13॥
html:
ityukto vāmadevena sarvaṃ tatkṛtavānnṛpaḥ ।
tathā kurvaṃstvamapyetau lokau jetā na saṃśayaḥ] ॥13॥
slp1: ityukto vAmadevena sarvaM tatkftavAnnfpaH । taTA kurvaMstvamapyetO lokO jetA na saMSayaH] ॥13॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: atha yo vijigīṣeta kṣatriyaḥ kṣatriyaṃ yudhi । kastasya dharmyo vijaya etatpṛṣṭo bravīhi me ॥1॥
html:
atha yo vijigīṣeta kṣatriyaḥ kṣatriyaṃ yudhi ।
kastasya dharmyo vijaya etatpṛṣṭo bravīhi me ॥1॥
slp1: aTa yo vijigIzeta kzatriyaH kzatriyaM yuDi । kastasya Darmyo vijaya etatpfzwo bravIhi me ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: sasahāyo'sahāyo vā rāṣṭramāgamya bhūmipaḥ । brūyādahaṃ vo rājeti rakṣiṣyāmi ca vaḥ sadā ॥2॥
html:
sasahāyo'sahāyo vā rāṣṭramāgamya bhūmipaḥ ।
brūyādahaṃ vo rājeti rakṣiṣyāmi ca vaḥ sadā ॥2॥
slp1: sasahAyo'sahAyo vA rAzwramAgamya BUmipaH । brUyAdahaM vo rAjeti rakzizyAmi ca vaH sadA ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: mama dharmyaṃ baliṃ datta kiṃ vā māṃ pratipatsyatha । te cettamāgataṃ tatra vṛṇuyuḥ kuśalaṃ bhavet ॥3॥
html:
mama dharmyaṃ baliṃ datta kiṃ vā māṃ pratipatsyatha ।
te cettamāgataṃ tatra vṛṇuyuḥ kuśalaṃ bhavet ॥3॥
slp1: mama DarmyaM baliM datta kiM vA mAM pratipatsyaTa । te cettamAgataM tatra vfRuyuH kuSalaM Bavet ॥3॥

text: te cedakṣatriyāḥ santo virudhyeyuḥ kathañcana । sarvopāyairniyantavyā vikarmasthā narādhipa ॥4॥
html:
te cedakṣatriyāḥ santo virudhyeyuḥ kathañcana ।
sarvopāyairniyantavyā vikarmasthā narādhipa ॥4॥
slp1: te cedakzatriyAH santo viruDyeyuH kaTaYcana । sarvopAyErniyantavyA vikarmasTA narADipa ॥4॥

text: aśaktaṃ kṣatriyaṃ matvā śastraṃ gṛhṇātyathāparaḥ । trāṇāyāpyasamarthaṃ taṃ manyamānamatīva ca ॥5॥
html:
aśaktaṃ kṣatriyaṃ matvā śastraṃ gṛhṇātyathāparaḥ ।
trāṇāyāpyasamarthaṃ taṃ manyamānamatīva ca ॥5॥
slp1: aSaktaM kzatriyaM matvA SastraM gfhRAtyaTAparaH । trARAyApyasamarTaM taM manyamAnamatIva ca ॥5॥

text: atha yaḥ kṣatriyo rājā kṣatriyaṃ pratyupāvrajet । kathaṃ sa pratiyoddhavyastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥6॥
html:
atha yaḥ kṣatriyo rājā kṣatriyaṃ pratyupāvrajet ।
kathaṃ sa pratiyoddhavyastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥6॥
slp1: aTa yaH kzatriyo rAjA kzatriyaM pratyupAvrajet । kaTaM sa pratiyodDavyastanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥6॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: nāsannaddho nākavaco yoddhavyaḥ kṣatriyo raṇe । eka ekena vācyaśca visṛjasva kṣipāmi ca ॥7॥
html:
nāsannaddho nākavaco yoddhavyaḥ kṣatriyo raṇe ।
eka ekena vācyaśca visṛjasva kṣipāmi ca ॥7॥
slp1: nAsannadDo nAkavaco yodDavyaH kzatriyo raRe । eka ekena vAcyaSca visfjasva kzipAmi ca ॥7॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sa cetsannaddha āgacchetsannaddhavyaṃ tato bhavet । sa cetsasainya āgacchetsasainyastamathāhvayet ॥8॥
html:
sa cetsannaddha āgacchetsannaddhavyaṃ tato bhavet ।
sa cetsasainya āgacchetsasainyastamathāhvayet ॥8॥
slp1: sa cetsannadDa AgacCetsannadDavyaM tato Bavet । sa cetsasEnya AgacCetsasEnyastamaTAhvayet ॥8॥

text: sa cennikṛtyā yudhyeta nikṛtyā taṃ prayodhayet । atha ceddharmato yudhyeddharmeṇaiva nivārayet ॥9॥
html:
sa cennikṛtyā yudhyeta nikṛtyā taṃ prayodhayet ।
atha ceddharmato yudhyeddharmeṇaiva nivārayet ॥9॥
slp1: sa cennikftyA yuDyeta nikftyA taM prayoDayet । aTa cedDarmato yuDyedDarmeREva nivArayet ॥9॥

text: nāśvena rathinaṃ yāyādudiyādrathinaṃ rathī । vyasane na prahartavyaṃ na bhītāya jitāya ca ॥10॥
html:
nāśvena rathinaṃ yāyādudiyādrathinaṃ rathī ।
vyasane na prahartavyaṃ na bhītāya jitāya ca ॥10॥
slp1: nASvena raTinaM yAyAdudiyAdraTinaM raTI । vyasane na prahartavyaM na BItAya jitAya ca ॥10॥

text: neṣurlipto na karṇī syādasatāmetadāyudham । jayārthameva yoddhavyaṃ na krudhyedajighāṃsataḥ ॥11॥
html:
neṣurlipto na karṇī syādasatāmetadāyudham ।
jayārthameva yoddhavyaṃ na krudhyedajighāṃsataḥ ॥11॥
slp1: nezurlipto na karRI syAdasatAmetadAyuDam । jayArTameva yodDavyaM na kruDyedajiGAMsataH ॥11॥

text: sādhūnāṃ tu mithobhedātsādhuścedvyasanī bhavet । savraṇo nābhihantavyo nānapatyaḥ kathañcana ॥12॥
html:
sādhūnāṃ tu mithobhedātsādhuścedvyasanī bhavet ।
savraṇo nābhihantavyo nānapatyaḥ kathañcana ॥12॥
slp1: sADUnAM tu miToBedAtsADuScedvyasanI Bavet । savraRo nABihantavyo nAnapatyaH kaTaYcana ॥12॥

text: bhagnaśastro vipannāśvaśchinnajyo hatavāhanaḥ । cikitsyaḥ syātsvaviṣaye prāpyo vā svagṛhānbhavet । nirvraṇo'pi ca moktavya eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥13॥
html:
bhagnaśastro vipannāśvaśchinnajyo hatavāhanaḥ ।
cikitsyaḥ syātsvaviṣaye prāpyo vā svagṛhānbhavet ।
nirvraṇo'pi ca moktavya eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: BagnaSastro vipannASvaSCinnajyo hatavAhanaH । cikitsyaH syAtsvavizaye prApyo vA svagfhAnBavet । nirvraRo'pi ca moktavya eza DarmaH sanAtanaH ॥13॥

text: tasmāddharmeṇa yoddhavyaṃ manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo'bravīt । satsu nityaṃ satāṃ dharmastamāsthāya na nāśayet ॥14॥
html:
tasmāddharmeṇa yoddhavyaṃ manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo'bravīt ।
satsu nityaṃ satāṃ dharmastamāsthāya na nāśayet ॥14॥
slp1: tasmAdDarmeRa yodDavyaM manuH svAyaMBuvo'bravIt । satsu nityaM satAM DarmastamAsTAya na nASayet ॥14॥

text: yo vai jayatyadharmeṇa kṣatriyo vardhamānakaḥ । ātmānamātmanā hanti pāpo nikṛtijīvanaḥ ॥15॥
html:
yo vai jayatyadharmeṇa kṣatriyo vardhamānakaḥ ।
ātmānamātmanā hanti pāpo nikṛtijīvanaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: yo vE jayatyaDarmeRa kzatriyo varDamAnakaH । AtmAnamAtmanA hanti pApo nikftijIvanaH ॥15॥

text: karma caitadasādhūnāmasādhuṃ sādhunā jayet । dharmeṇa nidhanaṃ śreyo na jayaḥ pāpakarmaṇā ॥16॥
html:
karma caitadasādhūnāmasādhuṃ sādhunā jayet ।
dharmeṇa nidhanaṃ śreyo na jayaḥ pāpakarmaṇā ॥16॥
slp1: karma cEtadasADUnAmasADuM sADunA jayet । DarmeRa niDanaM Sreyo na jayaH pApakarmaRA ॥16॥

text: nādharmaścarito rājansadyaḥ phalati gauriva । mūlānyasya praśākhāśca dahansamanugacchati ॥17॥
html:
nādharmaścarito rājansadyaḥ phalati gauriva ।
mūlānyasya praśākhāśca dahansamanugacchati ॥17॥
slp1: nADarmaScarito rAjansadyaH Palati gOriva । mUlAnyasya praSAKASca dahansamanugacCati ॥17॥

text: pāpena karmaṇā vittaṃ labdhvā pāpaḥ prahṛṣyati । sa vardhamānaḥ steyena pāpaḥ pāpe prasajjati ॥18॥
html:
pāpena karmaṇā vittaṃ labdhvā pāpaḥ prahṛṣyati ।
sa vardhamānaḥ steyena pāpaḥ pāpe prasajjati ॥18॥
slp1: pApena karmaRA vittaM labDvA pApaH prahfzyati । sa varDamAnaH steyena pApaH pApe prasajjati ॥18॥

text: na dharmo'stīti manvānaḥ śucīnavahasanniva । aśraddadhānabhāvācca vināśamupagacchati ॥19॥
html:
na dharmo'stīti manvānaḥ śucīnavahasanniva ।
aśraddadhānabhāvācca vināśamupagacchati ॥19॥
slp1: na Darmo'stIti manvAnaH SucInavahasanniva । aSraddaDAnaBAvAcca vinASamupagacCati ॥19॥

text: sa baddho vāruṇaiḥ pāśairamartya iva manyate । mahādṛtirivādhmātaḥ svakṛtena vivardhate ॥20॥
html:
sa baddho vāruṇaiḥ pāśairamartya iva manyate ।
mahādṛtirivādhmātaḥ svakṛtena vivardhate ॥20॥
slp1: sa badDo vAruREH pASEramartya iva manyate । mahAdftirivADmAtaH svakftena vivarDate ॥20॥

text: tataḥ samūlo hriyate nadīkūlādiva drumaḥ । athainamabhinindanti bhinnaṃ kumbhamivāśmani । tasmāddharmeṇa vijayaṃ kāmaṃ lipseta bhūmipaḥ] ॥21॥
html:
tataḥ samūlo hriyate nadīkūlādiva drumaḥ ।
athainamabhinindanti bhinnaṃ kumbhamivāśmani ।
tasmāddharmeṇa vijayaṃ kāmaṃ lipseta bhūmipaḥ] ॥21॥
slp1: tataH samUlo hriyate nadIkUlAdiva drumaH । aTEnamaBinindanti BinnaM kumBamivASmani । tasmAdDarmeRa vijayaM kAmaM lipseta BUmipaH] ॥21॥

text: nādharmeṇa mahīṃ jetuṃ lipseta jagatīpatiḥ । adharmavijayaṃ labdhvā ko'numanyeta bhūmipaḥ ॥1॥
html:
nādharmeṇa mahīṃ jetuṃ lipseta jagatīpatiḥ ।
adharmavijayaṃ labdhvā ko'numanyeta bhūmipaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: nADarmeRa mahIM jetuM lipseta jagatIpatiH । aDarmavijayaM labDvA ko'numanyeta BUmipaH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: adharmayukto vijayo hyadhruvo'svargya eva ca । sādayatyeṣa rājānaṃ mahīṃ ca bharatarṣabha ॥2॥
html:
adharmayukto vijayo hyadhruvo'svargya eva ca ।
sādayatyeṣa rājānaṃ mahīṃ ca bharatarṣabha ॥2॥
slp1: aDarmayukto vijayo hyaDruvo'svargya eva ca । sAdayatyeza rAjAnaM mahIM ca BaratarzaBa ॥2॥

text: viśīrṇakavacaṃ caiva tavāsmīti ca vādinam । kṛtāñjaliṃ nyastaśastraṃ gṛhītvā na vihiṃsayet ॥3॥
html:
viśīrṇakavacaṃ caiva tavāsmīti ca vādinam ।
kṛtāñjaliṃ nyastaśastraṃ gṛhītvā na vihiṃsayet ॥3॥
slp1: viSIrRakavacaM cEva tavAsmIti ca vAdinam । kftAYjaliM nyastaSastraM gfhItvA na vihiMsayet ॥3॥

text: balenāvajito yaśca na taṃ yudhyeta bhūmipaḥ । saṃvatsaraṃ vipraṇayettasmājjātaḥ punarbhavet ॥4॥
html:
balenāvajito yaśca na taṃ yudhyeta bhūmipaḥ ।
saṃvatsaraṃ vipraṇayettasmājjātaḥ punarbhavet ॥4॥
slp1: balenAvajito yaSca na taM yuDyeta BUmipaH । saMvatsaraM vipraRayettasmAjjAtaH punarBavet ॥4॥

text: nārvāksaṃvatsarātkanyā spraṣṭavyā vikramāhṛtā । evameva dhanaṃ sarvaṃ yaccānyatsahasāhṛtam ॥5॥
html:
nārvāksaṃvatsarātkanyā spraṣṭavyā vikramāhṛtā ।
evameva dhanaṃ sarvaṃ yaccānyatsahasāhṛtam ॥5॥
slp1: nArvAksaMvatsarAtkanyA sprazwavyA vikramAhftA । evameva DanaM sarvaM yaccAnyatsahasAhftam ॥5॥

text: na tu vandhyaṃ dhanaṃ tiṣṭhetpibeyurbrāhmaṇāḥ payaḥ । yuñjīranvāpyanaḍuhaḥ kṣantavyaṃ vā tadā bhavet ॥6॥
html:
na tu vandhyaṃ dhanaṃ tiṣṭhetpibeyurbrāhmaṇāḥ payaḥ ।
yuñjīranvāpyanaḍuhaḥ kṣantavyaṃ vā tadā bhavet ॥6॥
slp1: na tu vanDyaM DanaM tizWetpibeyurbrAhmaRAH payaH । yuYjIranvApyanaquhaH kzantavyaM vA tadA Bavet ॥6॥

text: rājñā rājaiva yoddhavyastathā dharmo vidhīyate । nānyo rājānamabhyasedarājanyaḥ kathañcana ॥7॥
html:
rājñā rājaiva yoddhavyastathā dharmo vidhīyate ।
nānyo rājānamabhyasedarājanyaḥ kathañcana ॥7॥
slp1: rAjYA rAjEva yodDavyastaTA Darmo viDIyate । nAnyo rAjAnamaByasedarAjanyaH kaTaYcana ॥7॥

text: anīkayoḥ saṃhatayoryadīyādbrāhmaṇo'ntarā । śāntimicchannubhayato na yoddhavyaṃ tadā bhavet । maryādāṃ śāśvatīṃ bhindyādbrāhmaṇaṃ yo'bhilaṅghayet ॥8॥
html:
anīkayoḥ saṃhatayoryadīyādbrāhmaṇo'ntarā ।
śāntimicchannubhayato na yoddhavyaṃ tadā bhavet ।
maryādāṃ śāśvatīṃ bhindyādbrāhmaṇaṃ yo'bhilaṅghayet ॥8॥
slp1: anIkayoH saMhatayoryadIyAdbrAhmaRo'ntarA । SAntimicCannuBayato na yodDavyaM tadA Bavet । maryAdAM SASvatIM BindyAdbrAhmaRaM yo'BilaNGayet ॥8॥

text: atha cellaṅghayedenāṃ maryādāṃ kṣatriyabruvaḥ । apraśasyastadūrdhvaṃ syādanādeyaśca saṃsadi ॥9॥
html:
atha cellaṅghayedenāṃ maryādāṃ kṣatriyabruvaḥ ।
apraśasyastadūrdhvaṃ syādanādeyaśca saṃsadi ॥9॥
slp1: aTa cellaNGayedenAM maryAdAM kzatriyabruvaH । apraSasyastadUrDvaM syAdanAdeyaSca saMsadi ॥9॥

text: yā tu dharmavilopena maryādābhedanena ca । tāṃ vṛttiṃ nānuvarteta vijigīṣurmahīpatiḥ । dharmalabdhāddhi vijayātko lābho'bhyadhiko bhavet ॥10॥
html:
yā tu dharmavilopena maryādābhedanena ca ।
tāṃ vṛttiṃ nānuvarteta vijigīṣurmahīpatiḥ ।
dharmalabdhāddhi vijayātko lābho'bhyadhiko bhavet ॥10॥
slp1: yA tu Darmavilopena maryAdABedanena ca । tAM vfttiM nAnuvarteta vijigIzurmahIpatiH । DarmalabDAdDi vijayAtko lABo'ByaDiko Bavet ॥10॥

text: sahasā nāmya bhūtāni kṣiprameva prasādayet । sāntvena bhogadānena sa rājñāṃ paramo nayaḥ ॥11॥
html:
sahasā nāmya bhūtāni kṣiprameva prasādayet ।
sāntvena bhogadānena sa rājñāṃ paramo nayaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: sahasA nAmya BUtAni kziprameva prasAdayet । sAntvena BogadAnena sa rAjYAM paramo nayaH ॥11॥

text: bhujyamānā hyayogena svarāṣṭrādabhitāpitāḥ । amitrānparyupāsīranvyasanaughapratīkṣiṇaḥ ॥12॥
html:
bhujyamānā hyayogena svarāṣṭrādabhitāpitāḥ ।
amitrānparyupāsīranvyasanaughapratīkṣiṇaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: BujyamAnA hyayogena svarAzwrAdaBitApitAH । amitrAnparyupAsIranvyasanOGapratIkziRaH ॥12॥

text: amitropagrahaṃ cāsya te kuryuḥ kṣipramāpadi । sanduṣṭāḥ sarvato rājanrājavyasanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ॥13॥
html:
amitropagrahaṃ cāsya te kuryuḥ kṣipramāpadi ।
sanduṣṭāḥ sarvato rājanrājavyasanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: amitropagrahaM cAsya te kuryuH kzipramApadi । sanduzwAH sarvato rAjanrAjavyasanakANkziRaH ॥13॥

text: nāmitro vinikartavyo nāticchedyaḥ kathañcana । jīvitaṃ hyapyaticchinnaḥ santyajatyekadā naraḥ ॥14॥
html:
nāmitro vinikartavyo nāticchedyaḥ kathañcana ।
jīvitaṃ hyapyaticchinnaḥ santyajatyekadā naraḥ ॥14॥
slp1: nAmitro vinikartavyo nAticCedyaH kaTaYcana । jIvitaM hyapyaticCinnaH santyajatyekadA naraH ॥14॥

text: alpenāpi hi saṃyuktastuṣyatyevāparādhikaḥ । śuddhaṃ jīvitamevāpi tādṛśo bahu manyate ॥15॥
html:
alpenāpi hi saṃyuktastuṣyatyevāparādhikaḥ ।
śuddhaṃ jīvitamevāpi tādṛśo bahu manyate ॥15॥
slp1: alpenApi hi saMyuktastuzyatyevAparADikaH । SudDaM jIvitamevApi tAdfSo bahu manyate ॥15॥

text: yasya sphīto janapadaḥ sampannaḥ priyarājakaḥ । santuṣṭabhṛtyasacivo dṛḍhamūlaḥ sa pārthivaḥ ॥16॥
html:
yasya sphīto janapadaḥ sampannaḥ priyarājakaḥ ।
santuṣṭabhṛtyasacivo dṛḍhamūlaḥ sa pārthivaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: yasya sPIto janapadaH sampannaH priyarAjakaH । santuzwaBftyasacivo dfQamUlaH sa pArTivaH ॥16॥

text: ṛtvikpurohitācāryā ye cānye śrutasammatāḥ । pūjārhāḥ pūjitā yasya sa vai lokajiducyate ॥17॥
html:
ṛtvikpurohitācāryā ye cānye śrutasammatāḥ ।
pūjārhāḥ pūjitā yasya sa vai lokajiducyate ॥17॥
slp1: ftvikpurohitAcAryA ye cAnye SrutasammatAH । pUjArhAH pUjitA yasya sa vE lokajiducyate ॥17॥

text: etenaiva ca vṛttena mahīṃ prāpa surottamaḥ । anveva caindraṃ vijayaṃ vyajigīṣanta pārthivāḥ ॥18॥
html:
etenaiva ca vṛttena mahīṃ prāpa surottamaḥ ।
anveva caindraṃ vijayaṃ vyajigīṣanta pārthivāḥ ॥18॥
slp1: etenEva ca vfttena mahIM prApa surottamaH । anveva cEndraM vijayaM vyajigIzanta pArTivAH ॥18॥

text: bhūmivarjaṃ puraṃ rājā jitvā rājānamāhave । amṛtāścauṣadhīḥ śaśvadājahāra pratardanaḥ ॥19॥
html:
bhūmivarjaṃ puraṃ rājā jitvā rājānamāhave ।
amṛtāścauṣadhīḥ śaśvadājahāra pratardanaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: BUmivarjaM puraM rAjA jitvA rAjAnamAhave । amftAScOzaDIH SaSvadAjahAra pratardanaH ॥19॥

text: agnihotrāṇyagniśeṣaṃ havirbhājanameva ca । ājahāra divodāsastato viprakṛto'bhavat ॥20॥
html:
agnihotrāṇyagniśeṣaṃ havirbhājanameva ca ।
ājahāra divodāsastato viprakṛto'bhavat ॥20॥
slp1: agnihotrARyagniSezaM havirBAjanameva ca । AjahAra divodAsastato viprakfto'Bavat ॥20॥

text: sarājakāni rāṣṭrāṇi nābhāgo dakṣiṇāṃ dadau । anyatra śrotriyasvācca tāpasasvācca bhārata ॥21॥
html:
sarājakāni rāṣṭrāṇi nābhāgo dakṣiṇāṃ dadau ।
anyatra śrotriyasvācca tāpasasvācca bhārata ॥21॥
slp1: sarAjakAni rAzwrARi nABAgo dakziRAM dadO । anyatra SrotriyasvAcca tApasasvAcca BArata ॥21॥

text: uccāvacāni vṛttāni dharmajñānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira । āsanrājñāṃ purāṇānāṃ sarvaṃ tanmama rocate ॥22॥
html:
uccāvacāni vṛttāni dharmajñānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
āsanrājñāṃ purāṇānāṃ sarvaṃ tanmama rocate ॥22॥
slp1: uccAvacAni vfttAni DarmajYAnAM yuDizWira । AsanrAjYAM purARAnAM sarvaM tanmama rocate ॥22॥

text: sarvavidyātirekādvā jayamicchenmahīpatiḥ । na māyayā na dambhena ya icchedbhūtimātmanaḥ] ॥23॥
html:
sarvavidyātirekādvā jayamicchenmahīpatiḥ ।
na māyayā na dambhena ya icchedbhūtimātmanaḥ] ॥23॥
slp1: sarvavidyAtirekAdvA jayamicCenmahIpatiH । na mAyayA na damBena ya icCedBUtimAtmanaH] ॥23॥

text: kṣatradharmānna pāpīyāndharmo'sti bharatarṣabha । abhiyāne ca yuddhe ca rājā hanti mahājanam ॥1॥
html:
kṣatradharmānna pāpīyāndharmo'sti bharatarṣabha ।
abhiyāne ca yuddhe ca rājā hanti mahājanam ॥1॥
slp1: kzatraDarmAnna pApIyAnDarmo'sti BaratarzaBa । aBiyAne ca yudDe ca rAjA hanti mahAjanam ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atha sma karmaṇā yena lokāñjayati pārthivaḥ । vidvañjijñāsamānāya prabrūhi bharatarṣabha ॥2॥
html:
atha sma karmaṇā yena lokāñjayati pārthivaḥ ।
vidvañjijñāsamānāya prabrūhi bharatarṣabha ॥2॥
slp1: aTa sma karmaRA yena lokAYjayati pArTivaH । vidvaYjijYAsamAnAya prabrUhi BaratarzaBa ॥2॥

text: nigraheṇa ca pāpānāṃ sādhūnāṃ pragraheṇa ca । yajñairdānaiśca rājāno bhavanti śucayo'malāḥ ॥3॥
html:
nigraheṇa ca pāpānāṃ sādhūnāṃ pragraheṇa ca ।
yajñairdānaiśca rājāno bhavanti śucayo'malāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: nigraheRa ca pApAnAM sADUnAM pragraheRa ca । yajYErdAnESca rAjAno Bavanti Sucayo'malAH ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: uparundhanti rājāno bhūtāni vijayārthinaḥ । ta eva vijayaṃ prāpya vardhayanti punaḥ prajāḥ ॥4॥
html:
uparundhanti rājāno bhūtāni vijayārthinaḥ ।
ta eva vijayaṃ prāpya vardhayanti punaḥ prajāḥ ॥4॥
slp1: uparunDanti rAjAno BUtAni vijayArTinaH । ta eva vijayaM prApya varDayanti punaH prajAH ॥4॥

text: apavidhyanti pāpāni dānayajñatapobalaiḥ । anugraheṇa bhūtānāṃ puṇyameṣāṃ pravardhate ॥5॥
html:
apavidhyanti pāpāni dānayajñatapobalaiḥ ।
anugraheṇa bhūtānāṃ puṇyameṣāṃ pravardhate ॥5॥
slp1: apaviDyanti pApAni dAnayajYatapobalEH । anugraheRa BUtAnAM puRyamezAM pravarDate ॥5॥

text: yathaiva kṣetranirdātā nirdanvai kṣetramekadā । hinasti kakṣaṃ dhānyaṃ ca na ca dhānyaṃ vinaśyati ॥6॥
html:
yathaiva kṣetranirdātā nirdanvai kṣetramekadā ।
hinasti kakṣaṃ dhānyaṃ ca na ca dhānyaṃ vinaśyati ॥6॥
slp1: yaTEva kzetranirdAtA nirdanvE kzetramekadA । hinasti kakzaM DAnyaM ca na ca DAnyaM vinaSyati ॥6॥

text: evaṃ śastrāṇi muñcanto ghnanti vadhyānathaikadā । tasyaiṣā niṣkṛtiḥ kṛtsnā bhūtānāṃ bhāvanaṃ punaḥ ॥7॥
html:
evaṃ śastrāṇi muñcanto ghnanti vadhyānathaikadā ।
tasyaiṣā niṣkṛtiḥ kṛtsnā bhūtānāṃ bhāvanaṃ punaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: evaM SastrARi muYcanto Gnanti vaDyAnaTEkadA । tasyEzA nizkftiH kftsnA BUtAnAM BAvanaM punaH ॥7॥

text: yo bhūtāni dhanajyānādvadhātkleśācca rakṣati । dasyubhyaḥ prāṇadānātsa dhanadaḥ sukhado virāṭ ॥8॥
html:
yo bhūtāni dhanajyānādvadhātkleśācca rakṣati ।
dasyubhyaḥ prāṇadānātsa dhanadaḥ sukhado virāṭ ॥8॥
slp1: yo BUtAni DanajyAnAdvaDAtkleSAcca rakzati । dasyuByaH prARadAnAtsa DanadaH suKado virAw ॥8॥

text: sa sarvayajñairījāno rājāthābhayadakṣiṇaiḥ । anubhūyeha bhadrāṇi prāpnotīndrasalokatām ॥9॥
html:
sa sarvayajñairījāno rājāthābhayadakṣiṇaiḥ ।
anubhūyeha bhadrāṇi prāpnotīndrasalokatām ॥9॥
slp1: sa sarvayajYErIjAno rAjATABayadakziREH । anuBUyeha BadrARi prApnotIndrasalokatAm ॥9॥

text: brāhmaṇārthe samutpanne yo'bhiniḥsṛtya yudhyate । ātmānaṃ yūpamucchritya sa yajño'nantadakṣiṇaḥ ॥10॥
html:
brāhmaṇārthe samutpanne yo'bhiniḥsṛtya yudhyate ।
ātmānaṃ yūpamucchritya sa yajño'nantadakṣiṇaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: brAhmaRArTe samutpanne yo'BiniHsftya yuDyate । AtmAnaM yUpamucCritya sa yajYo'nantadakziRaH ॥10॥

text: abhīto vikirañśatrūnpratigṛhṇañśarāṃstathā । na tasmāttridaśāḥ śreyo bhuvi paśyanti kiñcana ॥11॥
html:
abhīto vikirañśatrūnpratigṛhṇañśarāṃstathā ।
na tasmāttridaśāḥ śreyo bhuvi paśyanti kiñcana ॥11॥
slp1: aBIto vikiraYSatrUnpratigfhRaYSarAMstaTA । na tasmAttridaSAH Sreyo Buvi paSyanti kiYcana ॥11॥

text: tasya yāvanti śastrāṇi tvacaṃ bhindanti saṃyuge । tāvataḥ so'śnute lokānsarvakāmaduho'kṣayān ॥12॥
html:
tasya yāvanti śastrāṇi tvacaṃ bhindanti saṃyuge ।
tāvataḥ so'śnute lokānsarvakāmaduho'kṣayān ॥12॥
slp1: tasya yAvanti SastrARi tvacaM Bindanti saMyuge । tAvataH so'Snute lokAnsarvakAmaduho'kzayAn ॥12॥

text: na tasya rudhiraṃ gātrādāvedhebhyaḥ pravartate । sa ha tenaiva raktena sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ॥13॥
html:
na tasya rudhiraṃ gātrādāvedhebhyaḥ pravartate ।
sa ha tenaiva raktena sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ॥13॥
slp1: na tasya ruDiraM gAtrAdAveDeByaH pravartate । sa ha tenEva raktena sarvapApEH pramucyate ॥13॥

text: yāni duḥkhāni sahate vraṇānāmabhitāpane । na tato'sti tapo bhūya iti dharmavido viduḥ ॥14॥
html:
yāni duḥkhāni sahate vraṇānāmabhitāpane ।
na tato'sti tapo bhūya iti dharmavido viduḥ ॥14॥
slp1: yAni duHKAni sahate vraRAnAmaBitApane । na tato'sti tapo BUya iti Darmavido viduH ॥14॥

text: pṛṣṭhato bhīravaḥ saṅkhye vartante'dhamapūruṣāḥ । śūrāccharaṇamicchantaḥ parjanyādiva jīvanam ॥15॥
html:
pṛṣṭhato bhīravaḥ saṅkhye vartante'dhamapūruṣāḥ ।
śūrāccharaṇamicchantaḥ parjanyādiva jīvanam ॥15॥
slp1: pfzWato BIravaH saNKye vartante'DamapUruzAH । SUrAcCaraRamicCantaH parjanyAdiva jIvanam ॥15॥

text: yadi śūrastathā kṣeme pratirakṣettathā bhaye । pratirūpaṃ janāḥ kuryurna ca tadvartate tathā ॥16॥
html:
yadi śūrastathā kṣeme pratirakṣettathā bhaye ।
pratirūpaṃ janāḥ kuryurna ca tadvartate tathā ॥16॥
slp1: yadi SUrastaTA kzeme pratirakzettaTA Baye । pratirUpaM janAH kuryurna ca tadvartate taTA ॥16॥

text: yadi te kṛtamājñāya namaskuryuḥ sadaiva tam । yuktaṃ nyāyyaṃ ca kuryuste na ca tadvartate tathā ॥17॥
html:
yadi te kṛtamājñāya namaskuryuḥ sadaiva tam ।
yuktaṃ nyāyyaṃ ca kuryuste na ca tadvartate tathā ॥17॥
slp1: yadi te kftamAjYAya namaskuryuH sadEva tam । yuktaM nyAyyaM ca kuryuste na ca tadvartate taTA ॥17॥

text: puruṣāṇāṃ samānānāṃ dṛśyate mahadantaram । saṅgrāme'nīkavelāyāmutkruṣṭe'bhipatatsu ca ॥18॥
html:
puruṣāṇāṃ samānānāṃ dṛśyate mahadantaram ।
saṅgrāme'nīkavelāyāmutkruṣṭe'bhipatatsu ca ॥18॥
slp1: puruzARAM samAnAnAM dfSyate mahadantaram । saNgrAme'nIkavelAyAmutkruzwe'Bipatatsu ca ॥18॥

text: patatyabhimukhaḥ śūraḥ parānbhīruḥ palāyate । āsthāyāsvargyamadhvānaṃ sahāyānviṣame tyajan ॥19॥
html:
patatyabhimukhaḥ śūraḥ parānbhīruḥ palāyate ।
āsthāyāsvargyamadhvānaṃ sahāyānviṣame tyajan ॥19॥
slp1: patatyaBimuKaH SUraH parAnBIruH palAyate । AsTAyAsvargyamaDvAnaM sahAyAnvizame tyajan ॥19॥

text: mā sma tāṃstādṛśāṃstāta janiṣṭhāḥ puruṣādhamān । ye sahāyānraṇe hitvā svastimanto gṛhānyayuḥ ॥20॥
html:
mā sma tāṃstādṛśāṃstāta janiṣṭhāḥ puruṣādhamān ।
ye sahāyānraṇe hitvā svastimanto gṛhānyayuḥ ॥20॥
slp1: mA sma tAMstAdfSAMstAta janizWAH puruzADamAn । ye sahAyAnraRe hitvA svastimanto gfhAnyayuH ॥20॥

text: asvasti tebhyaḥ kurvanti devā indrapurogamāḥ । tyāgena yaḥ sahāyānāṃ svānprāṇāṃstrātumicchati ॥21॥
html:
asvasti tebhyaḥ kurvanti devā indrapurogamāḥ ।
tyāgena yaḥ sahāyānāṃ svānprāṇāṃstrātumicchati ॥21॥
slp1: asvasti teByaH kurvanti devA indrapurogamAH । tyAgena yaH sahAyAnAM svAnprARAMstrAtumicCati ॥21॥

text: taṃ hanyuḥ kāṣṭhaloṣṭairvā daheyurvā kaṭāgninā । paśuvanmārayeyurvā kṣatriyā ye syurīdṛśāḥ ॥22॥
html:
taṃ hanyuḥ kāṣṭhaloṣṭairvā daheyurvā kaṭāgninā ।
paśuvanmārayeyurvā kṣatriyā ye syurīdṛśāḥ ॥22॥
slp1: taM hanyuH kAzWalozwErvA daheyurvA kawAgninA । paSuvanmArayeyurvA kzatriyA ye syurIdfSAH ॥22॥

text: adharmaḥ kṣatriyasyaiṣa yacchayyāmaraṇaṃ bhavet । visṛjañśleṣmapittāni kṛpaṇaṃ paridevayan ॥23॥
html:
adharmaḥ kṣatriyasyaiṣa yacchayyāmaraṇaṃ bhavet ।
visṛjañśleṣmapittāni kṛpaṇaṃ paridevayan ॥23॥
slp1: aDarmaH kzatriyasyEza yacCayyAmaraRaM Bavet । visfjaYSlezmapittAni kfpaRaM paridevayan ॥23॥

text: avikṣatena dehena pralayaṃ yo'dhigacchati । kṣatriyo nāsya tatkarma praśaṃsanti purāvidaḥ ॥24॥
html:
avikṣatena dehena pralayaṃ yo'dhigacchati ।
kṣatriyo nāsya tatkarma praśaṃsanti purāvidaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: avikzatena dehena pralayaM yo'DigacCati । kzatriyo nAsya tatkarma praSaMsanti purAvidaH ॥24॥

text: na gṛhe maraṇaṃ tāta kṣatriyāṇāṃ praśasyate । śauṭīrāṇāmaśauṭīramadharmyaṃ kṛpaṇaṃ ca tat ॥25॥
html:
na gṛhe maraṇaṃ tāta kṣatriyāṇāṃ praśasyate ।
śauṭīrāṇāmaśauṭīramadharmyaṃ kṛpaṇaṃ ca tat ॥25॥
slp1: na gfhe maraRaM tAta kzatriyARAM praSasyate । SOwIrARAmaSOwIramaDarmyaM kfpaRaM ca tat ॥25॥

text: idaṃ duḥkhamaho kaṣṭaṃ pāpīya iti niṣṭanan । pratidhvastamukhaḥ pūtiramātyānbahu śocayan ॥26॥
html:
idaṃ duḥkhamaho kaṣṭaṃ pāpīya iti niṣṭanan ।
pratidhvastamukhaḥ pūtiramātyānbahu śocayan ॥26॥
slp1: idaM duHKamaho kazwaM pApIya iti nizwanan । pratiDvastamuKaH pUtiramAtyAnbahu Socayan ॥26॥

text: arogāṇāṃ spṛhayate muhurmṛtyumapīcchati । vīro dṛpto'bhimānī ca nedṛśaṃ mṛtyumarhati ॥27॥
html:
arogāṇāṃ spṛhayate muhurmṛtyumapīcchati ।
vīro dṛpto'bhimānī ca nedṛśaṃ mṛtyumarhati ॥27॥
slp1: arogARAM spfhayate muhurmftyumapIcCati । vIro dfpto'BimAnI ca nedfSaM mftyumarhati ॥27॥

text: raṇeṣu kadanaṃ kṛtvā jñātibhiḥ parivāritaḥ । tīkṣṇaiḥ śastraiḥ suvikliṣṭaḥ kṣatriyo mṛtyumarhati ॥28॥
html:
raṇeṣu kadanaṃ kṛtvā jñātibhiḥ parivāritaḥ ।
tīkṣṇaiḥ śastraiḥ suvikliṣṭaḥ kṣatriyo mṛtyumarhati ॥28॥
slp1: raRezu kadanaM kftvA jYAtiBiH parivAritaH । tIkzREH SastrEH suviklizwaH kzatriyo mftyumarhati ॥28॥

text: śūro hi satyamanyubhyāmāviṣṭo yudhyate bhṛśam । kṛtyamānāni gātrāṇi parairnaivāvabudhyate ॥29॥
html:
śūro hi satyamanyubhyāmāviṣṭo yudhyate bhṛśam ।
kṛtyamānāni gātrāṇi parairnaivāvabudhyate ॥29॥
slp1: SUro hi satyamanyuByAmAvizwo yuDyate BfSam । kftyamAnAni gAtrARi parErnEvAvabuDyate ॥29॥

text: sa saṅkhye nidhanaṃ prāpya praśastaṃ lokapūjitam । svadharmaṃ vipulaṃ prāpya śakrasyaiti salokatām ॥30॥
html:
sa saṅkhye nidhanaṃ prāpya praśastaṃ lokapūjitam ।
svadharmaṃ vipulaṃ prāpya śakrasyaiti salokatām ॥30॥
slp1: sa saNKye niDanaM prApya praSastaM lokapUjitam । svaDarmaM vipulaM prApya SakrasyEti salokatAm ॥30॥

text: sarvo yodhaḥ paraṃ tyaktumāviṣṭastyaktajīvitaḥ । prāpnotīndrasya sālokyaṃ śūraḥ pṛṣṭhamadarśayan] ॥31॥
html:
sarvo yodhaḥ paraṃ tyaktumāviṣṭastyaktajīvitaḥ ।
prāpnotīndrasya sālokyaṃ śūraḥ pṛṣṭhamadarśayan] ॥31॥
slp1: sarvo yoDaH paraM tyaktumAvizwastyaktajIvitaH । prApnotIndrasya sAlokyaM SUraH pfzWamadarSayan] ॥31॥

text: ke lokā yudhyamānānāṃ śūrāṇāmanivartinām । bhavanti nidhanaṃ prāpya tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
ke lokā yudhyamānānāṃ śūrāṇāmanivartinām ।
bhavanti nidhanaṃ prāpya tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: ke lokA yuDyamAnAnAM SUrARAmanivartinAm । Bavanti niDanaM prApya tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । ambarīṣasya saṃvādamindrasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
ambarīṣasya saṃvādamindrasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । ambarIzasya saMvAdamindrasya ca yuDizWira ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ambarīṣo hi nābhāgaḥ svargaṃ gatvā sudurlabham । dadarśa suralokasthaṃ śakreṇa sacivaṃ saha ॥3॥
html:
ambarīṣo hi nābhāgaḥ svargaṃ gatvā sudurlabham ।
dadarśa suralokasthaṃ śakreṇa sacivaṃ saha ॥3॥
slp1: ambarIzo hi nABAgaH svargaM gatvA sudurlaBam । dadarSa suralokasTaM SakreRa sacivaM saha ॥3॥

text: sarvatejomayaṃ divyaṃ vimānavaramāsthitam । uparyupari gacchantaṃ svaṃ vai senāpatiṃ prabhum ॥4॥
html:
sarvatejomayaṃ divyaṃ vimānavaramāsthitam ।
uparyupari gacchantaṃ svaṃ vai senāpatiṃ prabhum ॥4॥
slp1: sarvatejomayaM divyaM vimAnavaramAsTitam । uparyupari gacCantaM svaM vE senApatiM praBum ॥4॥

text: sa dṛṣṭvopari gacchantaṃ senāpatimudāradhīḥ । ṛddhiṃ dṛṣṭvā sudevasya vismitaḥ prāha vāsavam ॥5॥
html:
sa dṛṣṭvopari gacchantaṃ senāpatimudāradhīḥ ।
ṛddhiṃ dṛṣṭvā sudevasya vismitaḥ prāha vāsavam ॥5॥
slp1: sa dfzwvopari gacCantaM senApatimudAraDIH । fdDiM dfzwvA sudevasya vismitaH prAha vAsavam ॥5॥

text: sāgarāntāṃ mahīṃ kṛtsnāmanuśiṣya yathāvidhi । cāturvarṇye yathāśāstraṃ pravṛtto dharmakāmyayā ॥6॥
html:
sāgarāntāṃ mahīṃ kṛtsnāmanuśiṣya yathāvidhi ।
cāturvarṇye yathāśāstraṃ pravṛtto dharmakāmyayā ॥6॥
slp1: sAgarAntAM mahIM kftsnAmanuSizya yaTAviDi । cAturvarRye yaTASAstraM pravftto DarmakAmyayA ॥6॥

text: brahmacaryeṇa ghoreṇa ācāryakulasevayā । vedānadhītya dharmeṇa rājaśāstraṃ ca kevalam ॥7॥
html:
brahmacaryeṇa ghoreṇa ācāryakulasevayā ।
vedānadhītya dharmeṇa rājaśāstraṃ ca kevalam ॥7॥
slp1: brahmacaryeRa GoreRa AcAryakulasevayA । vedAnaDItya DarmeRa rAjaSAstraM ca kevalam ॥7॥

text: atithīnannapānena pitṝṃśca svadhayā tathā । ṛṣīnsvādhyāyadīkṣābhirdevānyajñairanuttamaiḥ ॥8॥
html:
atithīnannapānena pitṝṃśca svadhayā tathā ।
ṛṣīnsvādhyāyadīkṣābhirdevānyajñairanuttamaiḥ ॥8॥
slp1: atiTInannapAnena pitFMSca svaDayA taTA । fzInsvADyAyadIkzABirdevAnyajYEranuttamEH ॥8॥

text: kṣatradharme sthito bhūtvā yathāśāstraṃ yathāvidhi । udīkṣamāṇaḥ pṛtanāṃ jayāmi yudhi vāsava ॥9॥
html:
kṣatradharme sthito bhūtvā yathāśāstraṃ yathāvidhi ।
udīkṣamāṇaḥ pṛtanāṃ jayāmi yudhi vāsava ॥9॥
slp1: kzatraDarme sTito BUtvA yaTASAstraM yaTAviDi । udIkzamARaH pftanAM jayAmi yuDi vAsava ॥9॥

text: devarāja sudevo'yaṃ mama senāpatiḥ purā । āsīdyodhaḥ praśāntātmā so'yaṃ kasmādatīva mām ॥10॥
html:
devarāja sudevo'yaṃ mama senāpatiḥ purā ।
āsīdyodhaḥ praśāntātmā so'yaṃ kasmādatīva mām ॥10॥
slp1: devarAja sudevo'yaM mama senApatiH purA । AsIdyoDaH praSAntAtmA so'yaM kasmAdatIva mAm ॥10॥

text: nānena kratubhirmukhyairiṣṭaṃ naiva dvijātayaḥ । tarpitā vidhivacchakra so'yaṃ kasmādatīva mām ॥11॥
html:
nānena kratubhirmukhyairiṣṭaṃ naiva dvijātayaḥ ।

slp1: nAnena kratuBirmuKyErizwaM nEva dvijAtayaH । tarpitA viDivacCakra so'yaM kasmAdatIva mAm ॥11॥

text: etasya vitatastāta sudevasya babhūva ha । saṅgrāmayajñaḥ sumahānyaścānyo yudhyate naraḥ ॥12॥
html:
etasya vitatastāta sudevasya babhūva ha ।
saṅgrāmayajñaḥ sumahānyaścānyo yudhyate naraḥ ॥12॥
slp1: etasya vitatastAta sudevasya baBUva ha । saNgrAmayajYaH sumahAnyaScAnyo yuDyate naraH ॥12॥

text: sannaddho dīkṣitaḥ sarvo yodhaḥ prāpya camūmukham । yuddhayajñādhikārastho bhavatīti viniścayaḥ ॥13॥
html:

text: kāni yajñe havīṃṣyatra kimājyaṃ kā ca dakṣiṇā । ṛtvijaścātra ke proktāstanme brūhi śatakrato ॥14॥
html:
kāni yajñe havīṃṣyatra kimājyaṃ kā ca dakṣiṇā ।
ṛtvijaścātra ke proktāstanme brūhi śatakrato ॥14॥
slp1: kAni yajYe havIMzyatra kimAjyaM kA ca dakziRA । ftvijaScAtra ke proktAstanme brUhi Satakrato ॥14॥

text: ṛtvijaḥ kuñjarāstatra vājino'dhvaryavastathā । havīṃṣi paramāṃsāni rudhiraṃ tvājyameva ca ॥15॥
html:

slp1: ftvijaH kuYjarAstatra vAjino'DvaryavastaTA । havIMzi paramAMsAni ruDiraM tvAjyameva ca ॥15॥

text: sṛgālagṛdhrakākolāḥ sadasyāstatra satriṇaḥ । ājyaśeṣaṃ pibantyete haviḥ prāśnanti cādhvare ॥16॥
html:
sṛgālagṛdhrakākolāḥ sadasyāstatra satriṇaḥ ।
ājyaśeṣaṃ pibantyete haviḥ prāśnanti cādhvare ॥16॥
slp1: sfgAlagfDrakAkolAH sadasyAstatra satriRaH । AjyaSezaM pibantyete haviH prASnanti cADvare ॥16॥

text: prāsatomarasaṅghātāḥ khaḍgaśaktiparaśvadhāḥ । jvalanto niśitāḥ pītāḥ srucastasyātha satriṇaḥ ॥17॥
html:
prāsatomarasaṅghātāḥ khaḍgaśaktiparaśvadhāḥ ।

slp1: prAsatomarasaNGAtAH KaqgaSaktiparaSvaDAH । jvalanto niSitAH pItAH srucastasyATa satriRaH ॥17॥

text: cāpavegāyatastīkṣṇaḥ parakāyāvadāraṇaḥ । ṛjuḥ suniśitaḥ pītaḥ sāyako'sya sruvo mahān ॥18॥

text: jvalitairniśitaiḥ pītaiḥ prāsaśaktiparaśvadhaiḥ । śaikyāyasamayaistīkṣṇairabhighāto bhavedvasu ॥20॥

text: havirdhānaṃ tu tasyāhuḥ pareṣāṃ vāhinīmukham । kuñjarāṇāṃ hayānāṃ ca varmiṇāṃ ca samuccayaḥ । agniḥ śyenacito nāma tasya yajñe vidhīyate ॥23॥

kuñjarāṇāṃ hayānāṃ ca varmiṇāṃ ca samuccayaḥ ।

text: uttiṣṭhati kabandho'tra sahasre nihate tu yaḥ । sa yūpastasya śūrasya khādiro'ṣṭāśrirucyate ॥24॥

text: iḍopahūtaṃ krośanti kuñjarā aṅkuśeritāḥ । vyāghuṣṭatalanādena vaṣaṭkāreṇa pārthiva । udgātā tatra saṅgrāme trisāmā dundubhiḥ smṛtaḥ ॥25॥
html:
