slp1: iqopahUtaM kroSanti kuYjarA aNkuSeritAH । vyAGuzwatalanAdena vazawkAreRa pArTiva । udgAtA tatra saNgrAme trisAmA dunduBiH smftaH ॥25॥

text: brahmasve hriyamāṇe yaḥ priyāṃ yuddhe tanuṃ tyajet । ātmānaṃ yūpamucchritya sa yajño'nantadakṣiṇaḥ ॥26॥

slp1: BarturarTe tu yaH SUro vikramedvAhinImuKe । BayAnna ca nivarteta tasya lokA yaTA mama ॥27॥

html:

html:

slp1: yastu nAvekzate kaYcitsahAyaM vijaye sTitaH । vigAhya vAhinImaDyaM tasya lokA yaTA mama ॥29॥

text: hitvā palāyamānasya sahāyānprāṇasaṃśaye । amitrairanubaddhasya dviṣatāmastu nastathā ॥33॥
html:
hitvā palāyamānasya sahāyānprāṇasaṃśaye ।
amitrairanubaddhasya dviṣatāmastu nastathā ॥33॥
slp1: hitvA palAyamAnasya sahAyAnprARasaMSaye । amitrEranubadDasya dvizatAmastu nastaTA ॥33॥

text: manuṣyāpasadā hyete ye bhavanti parāṅmukhāḥ । rāśivardhanamātrāste naiva te pretya no iha ॥34॥
html:
manuṣyāpasadā hyete ye bhavanti parāṅmukhāḥ ।
rāśivardhanamātrāste naiva te pretya no iha ॥34॥
slp1: manuzyApasadA hyete ye Bavanti parANmuKAH । rASivarDanamAtrAste nEva te pretya no iha ॥34॥

text: amitrā hṛṣṭamanasaḥ pratyudyānti palāyinam । jayinaṃ suhṛdastāta vandanairmaṅgalena ca ॥35॥
html:
amitrā hṛṣṭamanasaḥ pratyudyānti palāyinam ।
jayinaṃ suhṛdastāta vandanairmaṅgalena ca ॥35॥
slp1: amitrA hfzwamanasaH pratyudyAnti palAyinam । jayinaM suhfdastAta vandanErmaNgalena ca ॥35॥

text: yasya sma vyasane rājannanumodanti śatravaḥ । tadasahyataraṃ duḥkhamahaṃ manye vadhādapi ॥36॥
html:
yasya sma vyasane rājannanumodanti śatravaḥ ।
tadasahyataraṃ duḥkhamahaṃ manye vadhādapi ॥36॥
slp1: yasya sma vyasane rAjannanumodanti SatravaH । tadasahyataraM duHKamahaM manye vaDAdapi ॥36॥

text: śriyaṃ jānīta dharmasya mūlaṃ sarvasukhasya ca । sā bhīrūṇāṃ parānyāti śūrastāmadhigacchati ॥37॥
html:
śriyaṃ jānīta dharmasya mūlaṃ sarvasukhasya ca ।
sā bhīrūṇāṃ parānyāti śūrastāmadhigacchati ॥37॥
slp1: SriyaM jAnIta Darmasya mUlaM sarvasuKasya ca । sA BIrURAM parAnyAti SUrastAmaDigacCati ॥37॥

text: te vayaṃ svargamicchantaḥ saṅgrāme tyaktajīvitāḥ । jayanto vadhyamānā vā prāptumarhāma sadgatim ॥38॥
html:
te vayaṃ svargamicchantaḥ saṅgrāme tyaktajīvitāḥ ।
jayanto vadhyamānā vā prāptumarhāma sadgatim ॥38॥
slp1: te vayaM svargamicCantaH saNgrAme tyaktajIvitAH । jayanto vaDyamAnA vA prAptumarhAma sadgatim ॥38॥

text: evaṃ saṃśaptaśapathāḥ samabhityaktajīvitāḥ । amitravāhinīṃ vīrāḥ sampragāhantyabhīravaḥ ॥39॥
html:
evaṃ saṃśaptaśapathāḥ samabhityaktajīvitāḥ ।
amitravāhinīṃ vīrāḥ sampragāhantyabhīravaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: evaM saMSaptaSapaTAH samaBityaktajIvitAH । amitravAhinIM vIrAH sampragAhantyaBIravaH ॥39॥

text: agrataḥ puruṣānīkamasicarmavatāṃ bhavet । pṛṣṭhataḥ śakaṭānīkaṃ kalatraṃ madhyatastathā ॥40॥
html:
agrataḥ puruṣānīkamasicarmavatāṃ bhavet ।
pṛṣṭhataḥ śakaṭānīkaṃ kalatraṃ madhyatastathā ॥40॥
slp1: agrataH puruzAnIkamasicarmavatAM Bavet । pfzWataH SakawAnIkaM kalatraM maDyatastaTA ॥40॥

text: pareṣāṃ pratighātārthaṃ padātīnāṃ ca gūhanam । api hyasminpare gṛddhā bhaveyurye purogamāḥ ॥41॥
html:
pareṣāṃ pratighātārthaṃ padātīnāṃ ca gūhanam ।
api hyasminpare gṛddhā bhaveyurye purogamāḥ ॥41॥
slp1: parezAM pratiGAtArTaM padAtInAM ca gUhanam । api hyasminpare gfdDA Baveyurye purogamAH ॥41॥

text: ye purastādabhimatāḥ sattvavanto manasvinaḥ । te pūrvamabhivarteraṃstānanvagitare janāḥ ॥42॥
html:
ye purastādabhimatāḥ sattvavanto manasvinaḥ ।
te pūrvamabhivarteraṃstānanvagitare janāḥ ॥42॥
slp1: ye purastAdaBimatAH sattvavanto manasvinaH । te pUrvamaBivarteraMstAnanvagitare janAH ॥42॥

text: api coddharṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ bhīrūṇāmapi yatnataḥ । skandhadarśanamātraṃ tu tiṣṭheyurvā samīpataḥ ॥43॥
html:
api coddharṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ bhīrūṇāmapi yatnataḥ ।
skandhadarśanamātraṃ tu tiṣṭheyurvā samīpataḥ ॥43॥
slp1: api codDarzaRaM kAryaM BIrURAmapi yatnataH । skanDadarSanamAtraM tu tizWeyurvA samIpataH ॥43॥

text: saṃhatānyodhayedalpānkāmaṃ vistārayedbahūn । sūcīmukhamanīkaṃ syādalpānāṃ bahubhiḥ saha ॥44॥
html:
saṃhatānyodhayedalpānkāmaṃ vistārayedbahūn ।
sūcīmukhamanīkaṃ syādalpānāṃ bahubhiḥ saha ॥44॥
slp1: saMhatAnyoDayedalpAnkAmaM vistArayedbahUn । sUcImuKamanIkaM syAdalpAnAM bahuBiH saha ॥44॥

text: samprayuddhe prahṛṣṭe vā satyaṃ vā yadi vānṛtam । pragṛhya bāhūnkrośeta bhagnā bhagnāḥ parā iti ॥45॥
html:
samprayuddhe prahṛṣṭe vā satyaṃ vā yadi vānṛtam ।
pragṛhya bāhūnkrośeta bhagnā bhagnāḥ parā iti ॥45॥
slp1: samprayudDe prahfzwe vA satyaM vA yadi vAnftam । pragfhya bAhUnkroSeta BagnA BagnAH parA iti ॥45॥

text: āgataṃ no mitrabalaṃ praharadhvamabhītavat । śabdavanto'nudhāveyuḥ kurvanto bhairavaṃ ravam ॥46॥
html:
āgataṃ no mitrabalaṃ praharadhvamabhītavat ।
śabdavanto'nudhāveyuḥ kurvanto bhairavaṃ ravam ॥46॥
slp1: AgataM no mitrabalaM praharaDvamaBItavat । Sabdavanto'nuDAveyuH kurvanto BEravaM ravam ॥46॥

text: kṣveḍāḥ kilakilāḥ śaṅkhāḥ krakacā goviṣāṇikān । bherīmṛdaṅgapaṇavānnādayeyuśca kuñjarān] ॥47॥
html:
kṣveḍāḥ kilakilāḥ śaṅkhāḥ krakacā goviṣāṇikān ।
bherīmṛdaṅgapaṇavānnādayeyuśca kuñjarān] ॥47॥
slp1: kzveqAH kilakilAH SaNKAH krakacA govizARikAn । BerImfdaNgapaRavAnnAdayeyuSca kuYjarAn] ॥47॥

text: kiṃśīlāḥ kiṃsamutthānāḥ kathaṃrūpāśca bhārata । kiṃsannāhāḥ kathaṃśastrā janāḥ syuḥ saṃyuge nṛpa ॥1॥
html:
kiṃśīlāḥ kiṃsamutthānāḥ kathaṃrūpāśca bhārata ।
kiṃsannāhāḥ kathaṃśastrā janāḥ syuḥ saṃyuge nṛpa ॥1॥
slp1: kiMSIlAH kiMsamutTAnAH kaTaMrUpASca BArata । kiMsannAhAH kaTaMSastrA janAH syuH saMyuge nfpa ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: yathācaritamevātra śastrapatraṃ vidhīyate । ācārādeva puruṣastathā karmasu vartate ॥2॥
html:
yathācaritamevātra śastrapatraṃ vidhīyate ।
ācārādeva puruṣastathā karmasu vartate ॥2॥
slp1: yaTAcaritamevAtra SastrapatraM viDIyate । AcArAdeva puruzastaTA karmasu vartate ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: gāndhārāḥ sindhusauvīrā nakharaprāsayodhinaḥ । ābhīravaḥ subalinastadbalaṃ sarvapāragam ॥3॥
html:
gāndhārāḥ sindhusauvīrā nakharaprāsayodhinaḥ ।
ābhīravaḥ subalinastadbalaṃ sarvapāragam ॥3॥
slp1: gAnDArAH sinDusOvIrA naKaraprAsayoDinaH । ABIravaH subalinastadbalaM sarvapAragam ॥3॥

text: sarvaśastreṣu kuśalāḥ sattvavanto hyuśīnarāḥ । prācyā mātaṅgayuddheṣu kuśalāḥ śaṭhayodhinaḥ ॥4॥
html:
sarvaśastreṣu kuśalāḥ sattvavanto hyuśīnarāḥ ।
prācyā mātaṅgayuddheṣu kuśalāḥ śaṭhayodhinaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: sarvaSastrezu kuSalAH sattvavanto hyuSInarAH । prAcyA mAtaNgayudDezu kuSalAH SaWayoDinaH ॥4॥

text: tathā yavanakāmbojā mathurāmabhitaśca ye । ete niyuddhakuśalā dākṣiṇātyāsicarmiṇaḥ ॥5॥
html:
tathā yavanakāmbojā mathurāmabhitaśca ye ।
ete niyuddhakuśalā dākṣiṇātyāsicarmiṇaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: taTA yavanakAmbojA maTurAmaBitaSca ye । ete niyudDakuSalA dAkziRAtyAsicarmiRaH ॥5॥

text: sarvatra śūrā jāyante mahāsattvā mahābalāḥ । prāya eṣa samuddiṣṭo lakṣaṇāni tu me śṛṇu ॥6॥
html:
sarvatra śūrā jāyante mahāsattvā mahābalāḥ ।
prāya eṣa samuddiṣṭo lakṣaṇāni tu me śṛṇu ॥6॥
slp1: sarvatra SUrA jAyante mahAsattvA mahAbalAH । prAya eza samuddizwo lakzaRAni tu me SfRu ॥6॥

text: siṃhaśārdūlavāṅnetrāḥ siṃhaśārdūlagāminaḥ । pārāvatakuliṅgākṣāḥ sarve śūrāḥ pramāthinaḥ ॥7॥
html:
siṃhaśārdūlavāṅnetrāḥ siṃhaśārdūlagāminaḥ ।
pārāvatakuliṅgākṣāḥ sarve śūrāḥ pramāthinaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: siMhaSArdUlavANnetrAH siMhaSArdUlagAminaH । pArAvatakuliNgAkzAH sarve SUrAH pramATinaH ॥7॥

text: mṛgasvarā dvīpinetrā ṛṣabhākṣāstathāpare । pravādinaḥ sucaṇḍāśca krodhinaḥ kinnarīsvanāḥ ॥8॥
html:

pravādinaḥ sucaṇḍāśca krodhinaḥ kinnarīsvanāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: mfgasvarA dvIpinetrA fzaBAkzAstaTApare । pravAdinaH sucaRqASca kroDinaH kinnarIsvanAH ॥8॥

text: meghasvanāḥ kruddhamukhāḥ kecitkarabhanisvanāḥ । jihmanāsānujaṅghāśca dūragā dūrapātinaḥ ॥9॥
html:
meghasvanāḥ kruddhamukhāḥ kecitkarabhanisvanāḥ ।
jihmanāsānujaṅghāśca dūragā dūrapātinaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: meGasvanAH krudDamuKAH kecitkaraBanisvanAH । jihmanAsAnujaNGASca dUragA dUrapAtinaH ॥9॥

text: biḍālakubjāstanavastanukeśāstanutvacaḥ । śūrāścapalacittāśca te bhavanti durāsadāḥ ॥10॥
html:
biḍālakubjāstanavastanukeśāstanutvacaḥ ।
śūrāścapalacittāśca te bhavanti durāsadāḥ ॥10॥
slp1: biqAlakubjAstanavastanukeSAstanutvacaH । SUrAScapalacittASca te Bavanti durAsadAH ॥10॥

text: godhānimīlitāḥ kecinmṛduprakṛtayo'pi ca । turaṅgagatinirghoṣāste narāḥ pārayiṣṇavaḥ ॥11॥
html:
godhānimīlitāḥ kecinmṛduprakṛtayo'pi ca ।
turaṅgagatinirghoṣāste narāḥ pārayiṣṇavaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: goDAnimIlitAH kecinmfduprakftayo'pi ca । turaNgagatinirGozAste narAH pArayizRavaH ॥11॥

text: susaṃhatāḥ pratanavo vyūḍhoraskāḥ susaṃsthitāḥ । pravāditena nṛtyanti hṛṣyanti kalaheṣu ca ॥12॥
html:
susaṃhatāḥ pratanavo vyūḍhoraskāḥ susaṃsthitāḥ ।
pravāditena nṛtyanti hṛṣyanti kalaheṣu ca ॥12॥
slp1: susaMhatAH pratanavo vyUQoraskAH susaMsTitAH । pravAditena nftyanti hfzyanti kalahezu ca ॥12॥

text: gambhīrākṣā niḥsṛtākṣāḥ piṅgalā bhrukuṭīmukhāḥ । nakulākṣāstathā caiva sarve śūrāstanutyajaḥ ॥13॥
html:
gambhīrākṣā niḥsṛtākṣāḥ piṅgalā bhrukuṭīmukhāḥ ।
nakulākṣāstathā caiva sarve śūrāstanutyajaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: gamBIrAkzA niHsftAkzAH piNgalA BrukuwImuKAH । nakulAkzAstaTA cEva sarve SUrAstanutyajaH ॥13॥

text: jihmākṣāḥ pralalāṭāśca nirmāṃsahanavo'pi ca । vakrabāhvaṅgulīsaktāḥ kṛśā dhamanisantatāḥ ॥14॥
html:
jihmākṣāḥ pralalāṭāśca nirmāṃsahanavo'pi ca ।
vakrabāhvaṅgulīsaktāḥ kṛśā dhamanisantatāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: jihmAkzAH pralalAwASca nirmAMsahanavo'pi ca । vakrabAhvaNgulIsaktAH kfSA DamanisantatAH ॥14॥

html:
praviśantyativegena samparāye'bhyupasthite ।
vāraṇā iva sammattāste bhavanti durāsadāḥ ॥15॥
slp1: praviSantyativegena samparAye'ByupasTite । vAraRA iva sammattAste Bavanti durAsadAH ॥15॥

text: dīptasphuṭitakeśāntāḥ sthūlapārśvahanūmukhāḥ । unnatāṃsāḥ pṛthugrīvā vikaṭāḥ sthūlapiṇḍikāḥ ॥16॥
html:
dīptasphuṭitakeśāntāḥ sthūlapārśvahanūmukhāḥ ।
unnatāṃsāḥ pṛthugrīvā vikaṭāḥ sthūlapiṇḍikāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: dIptasPuwitakeSAntAH sTUlapArSvahanUmuKAH । unnatAMsAH pfTugrIvA vikawAH sTUlapiRqikAH ॥16॥

udvṛttāścaiva sugrīvā vinatā vihagā iva ।
piṇḍaśīrṣāhivaktrāśca vṛṣadaṃśamukhā iva ॥17॥
slp1: udvfttAScEva sugrIvA vinatA vihagA iva । piRqaSIrzAhivaktrASca vfzadaMSamuKA iva ॥17॥

text: ugrasvanā manyumanto yuddheṣvārāvasāriṇaḥ । adharmajñāvaliptāśca ghorā raudrapradarśinaḥ ॥18॥
html:
ugrasvanā manyumanto yuddheṣvārāvasāriṇaḥ ।
adharmajñāvaliptāśca ghorā raudrapradarśinaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: ugrasvanA manyumanto yudDezvArAvasAriRaH । aDarmajYAvaliptASca GorA rOdrapradarSinaH ॥18॥

text: tyaktātmānaḥ sarva ete antyajā hyanivartinaḥ । puraskāryāḥ sadā sainye hanyante ghnanti cāpi te ॥19॥
html:

puraskāryāḥ sadā sainye hanyante ghnanti cāpi te ॥19॥
slp1: tyaktAtmAnaH sarva ete antyajA hyanivartinaH । puraskAryAH sadA sEnye hanyante Gnanti cApi te ॥19॥

text: adhārmikā bhinnavṛttāḥ sādhvevaiṣāṃ parābhavaḥ । evameva prakupyanti rājño'pyete hyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ] ॥20॥

adhārmikā bhinnavṛttāḥ sādhvevaiṣāṃ parābhavaḥ ।
evameva prakupyanti rājño'pyete hyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ] ॥20॥
slp1: aDArmikA BinnavfttAH sADvevEzAM parABavaH । evameva prakupyanti rAjYo'pyete hyaBIkzRaSaH] ॥20॥

text: jaitryā vā kāni rūpāṇi bhavanti puruṣarṣabha । pṛtanāyāḥ praśastāni tānīhecchāmi veditum ॥1॥
html:
jaitryā vā kāni rūpāṇi bhavanti puruṣarṣabha ।
pṛtanāyāḥ praśastāni tānīhecchāmi veditum ॥1॥
slp1: jEtryA vA kAni rUpARi Bavanti puruzarzaBa । pftanAyAH praSastAni tAnIhecCAmi veditum ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: jaitryā vā yāni rūpāṇi bhavanti puruṣarṣabha । pṛtanāyāḥ praśastāni tāni vakṣyāmi sarvaśaḥ ॥2॥
html:
jaitryā vā yāni rūpāṇi bhavanti puruṣarṣabha ।
pṛtanāyāḥ praśastāni tāni vakṣyāmi sarvaśaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: jEtryA vA yAni rUpARi Bavanti puruzarzaBa । pftanAyAH praSastAni tAni vakzyAmi sarvaSaH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: daivaṃ pūrvaṃ vikurute mānuṣe kālacodite । tadvidvāṃso'nupaśyanti jñānadīrgheṇa cakṣuṣā ॥3॥
html:
daivaṃ pūrvaṃ vikurute mānuṣe kālacodite ।
tadvidvāṃso'nupaśyanti jñānadīrgheṇa cakṣuṣā ॥3॥
slp1: dEvaM pUrvaM vikurute mAnuze kAlacodite । tadvidvAMso'nupaSyanti jYAnadIrGeRa cakzuzA ॥3॥

text: prāyaścittavidhiṃ cātra japahomāṃśca tadvidaḥ । maṅgalāni ca kurvantaḥ śamayantyahitānyapi ॥4॥
html:
prāyaścittavidhiṃ cātra japahomāṃśca tadvidaḥ ।
maṅgalāni ca kurvantaḥ śamayantyahitānyapi ॥4॥
slp1: prAyaScittaviDiM cAtra japahomAMSca tadvidaH । maNgalAni ca kurvantaH SamayantyahitAnyapi ॥4॥

text: udīrṇamanaso yodhā vāhanāni ca bhārata । yasyāṃ bhavanti senāyāṃ dhruvaṃ tasyāṃ jayaṃ vadet ॥5॥
html:
udīrṇamanaso yodhā vāhanāni ca bhārata ।
yasyāṃ bhavanti senāyāṃ dhruvaṃ tasyāṃ jayaṃ vadet ॥5॥
slp1: udIrRamanaso yoDA vAhanAni ca BArata । yasyAM Bavanti senAyAM DruvaM tasyAM jayaM vadet ॥5॥

text: anvenāṃ vāyavo vānti tathaivendradhanūṃṣi ca । anuplavante meghāśca tathādityasya raśmayaḥ ॥6॥
html:
anvenāṃ vāyavo vānti tathaivendradhanūṃṣi ca ।
anuplavante meghāśca tathādityasya raśmayaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: anvenAM vAyavo vAnti taTEvendraDanUMzi ca । anuplavante meGASca taTAdityasya raSmayaH ॥6॥

text: gomāyavaścānulomā vaḍā gṛdhrāśca sarvaśaḥ । ācareyuryadā senāṃ tadā siddhiranuttamā ॥7॥
html:
gomāyavaścānulomā vaḍā gṛdhrāśca sarvaśaḥ ।
ācareyuryadā senāṃ tadā siddhiranuttamā ॥7॥
slp1: gomAyavaScAnulomA vaqA gfDrASca sarvaSaH । AcareyuryadA senAM tadA sidDiranuttamA ॥7॥

text: prasannabhāḥ pāvaka ūrdhvaraśmiḥ pradakṣiṇāvartaśikho vidhūmaḥ । puṇyā gandhāścāhutīnāṃ pravānti jayasyaitadbhāvino rūpamāhuḥ ॥8॥
html:
prasannabhāḥ pāvaka ūrdhvaraśmiḥ pradakṣiṇāvartaśikho vidhūmaḥ ।
puṇyā gandhāścāhutīnāṃ pravānti jayasyaitadbhāvino rūpamāhuḥ ॥8॥
slp1: prasannaBAH pAvaka UrDvaraSmiH pradakziRAvartaSiKo viDUmaH । puRyA ganDAScAhutInAM pravAnti jayasyEtadBAvino rUpamAhuH ॥8॥

text: gambhīraśabdāśca mahāsvanāśca śaṅkhāśca bheryaśca nadanti yatra । yuyutsavaścāpratīpā bhavanti jayasyaitadbhāvino rūpamāhuḥ ॥9॥
html:
gambhīraśabdāśca mahāsvanāśca śaṅkhāśca bheryaśca nadanti yatra ।
yuyutsavaścāpratīpā bhavanti jayasyaitadbhāvino rūpamāhuḥ ॥9॥
slp1: gamBIraSabdASca mahAsvanASca SaNKASca BeryaSca nadanti yatra । yuyutsavaScApratIpA Bavanti jayasyEtadBAvino rUpamAhuH ॥9॥

text: iṣṭā mṛgāḥ pṛṣṭhato vāmataśca samprasthitānāṃ ca gamiṣyatāṃ ca । jighāṃsatāṃ dakṣiṇāḥ siddhimāhurye tvagrataste pratiṣedhayanti ॥10॥
html:
iṣṭā mṛgāḥ pṛṣṭhato vāmataśca samprasthitānāṃ ca gamiṣyatāṃ ca ।
jighāṃsatāṃ dakṣiṇāḥ siddhimāhurye tvagrataste pratiṣedhayanti ॥10॥
slp1: izwA mfgAH pfzWato vAmataSca samprasTitAnAM ca gamizyatAM ca । jiGAMsatAM dakziRAH sidDimAhurye tvagrataste pratizeDayanti ॥10॥

text: maṅgalyaśabdāḥ śakunā vadanti haṃsāḥ krauñcāḥ śatapatrāśca cāṣāḥ । hṛṣṭā yodhāḥ sattvavanto bhavanti jayasyaitadbhāvino rūpamāhuḥ ॥11॥
html:
maṅgalyaśabdāḥ śakunā vadanti haṃsāḥ krauñcāḥ śatapatrāśca cāṣāḥ ।
hṛṣṭā yodhāḥ sattvavanto bhavanti jayasyaitadbhāvino rūpamāhuḥ ॥11॥
slp1: maNgalyaSabdAH SakunA vadanti haMsAH krOYcAH SatapatrASca cAzAH । hfzwA yoDAH sattvavanto Bavanti jayasyEtadBAvino rUpamAhuH ॥11॥

text: śastraiḥ patraiḥ kavacaiḥ ketubhiśca subhānubhirmukhavarṇaiśca yūnām । bhrājiṣmatī duṣpratiprekṣaṇīyā yeṣāṃ camūste'bhibhavanti śatrūn ॥12॥
html:
śastraiḥ patraiḥ kavacaiḥ ketubhiśca subhānubhirmukhavarṇaiśca yūnām ।
bhrājiṣmatī duṣpratiprekṣaṇīyā yeṣāṃ camūste'bhibhavanti śatrūn ॥12॥
slp1: SastrEH patrEH kavacEH ketuBiSca suBAnuBirmuKavarRESca yUnAm । BrAjizmatI duzpratiprekzaRIyA yezAM camUste'BiBavanti SatrUn ॥12॥

text: śuśrūṣavaścānabhimāninaśca parasparaṃ sauhṛdamāsthitāśca । yeṣāṃ yodhāḥ śaucamanuṣṭhitāśca jayasyaitadbhāvino rūpamāhuḥ ॥13॥
html:
śuśrūṣavaścānabhimāninaśca parasparaṃ sauhṛdamāsthitāśca ।
yeṣāṃ yodhāḥ śaucamanuṣṭhitāśca jayasyaitadbhāvino rūpamāhuḥ ॥13॥
slp1: SuSrUzavaScAnaBimAninaSca parasparaM sOhfdamAsTitASca । yezAM yoDAH SOcamanuzWitASca jayasyEtadBAvino rUpamAhuH ॥13॥

text: śabdāḥ sparśāstathā gandhā vicaranti manaḥpriyāḥ । dhairyaṃ cāviśate yodhānvijayasya mukhaṃ tu tat ॥14॥
html:
śabdāḥ sparśāstathā gandhā vicaranti manaḥpriyāḥ ।
dhairyaṃ cāviśate yodhānvijayasya mukhaṃ tu tat ॥14॥
slp1: SabdAH sparSAstaTA ganDA vicaranti manaHpriyAH । DEryaM cAviSate yoDAnvijayasya muKaM tu tat ॥14॥

text: iṣṭo vāmaḥ praviṣṭasya dakṣiṇaḥ pravivikṣataḥ । paścātsaṃsādhayatyarthaṃ purastātpratiṣedhati ॥15॥
html:
iṣṭo vāmaḥ praviṣṭasya dakṣiṇaḥ pravivikṣataḥ ।
paścātsaṃsādhayatyarthaṃ purastātpratiṣedhati ॥15॥
slp1: izwo vAmaH pravizwasya dakziRaH pravivikzataH । paScAtsaMsADayatyarTaM purastAtpratizeDati ॥15॥

text: saṃbhṛtya mahatīṃ senāṃ caturaṅgāṃ yudhiṣṭhira । sāmnaivāvartane pūrvaṃ prayatethāstato yudhi ॥16॥
html:
saṃbhṛtya mahatīṃ senāṃ caturaṅgāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
sāmnaivāvartane pūrvaṃ prayatethāstato yudhi ॥16॥
slp1: saMBftya mahatIM senAM caturaNgAM yuDizWira । sAmnEvAvartane pUrvaM prayateTAstato yuDi ॥16॥

text: jaghanya eṣa vijayo yadyuddhaṃ nāma bhārata । yādṛcchiko yudhi jayo daivo veti vicāraṇam ॥17॥
html:
jaghanya eṣa vijayo yadyuddhaṃ nāma bhārata ।
yādṛcchiko yudhi jayo daivo veti vicāraṇam ॥17॥
slp1: jaGanya eza vijayo yadyudDaM nAma BArata । yAdfcCiko yuDi jayo dEvo veti vicAraRam ॥17॥

text: apāmiva mahāvegastrastā mṛgagaṇā iva । durnivāryatamā caiva prabhagnā mahatī camūḥ ॥18॥
html:
apāmiva mahāvegastrastā mṛgagaṇā iva ।
durnivāryatamā caiva prabhagnā mahatī camūḥ ॥18॥
slp1: apAmiva mahAvegastrastA mfgagaRA iva । durnivAryatamA cEva praBagnA mahatI camUH ॥18॥

text: bhagnā ityeva bhajyante vidvāṃso'pi nakāraṇam । udārasārā mahatī rurusaṅghopamā camūḥ ॥19॥
html:
bhagnā ityeva bhajyante vidvāṃso'pi nakāraṇam ।
udārasārā mahatī rurusaṅghopamā camūḥ ॥19॥
slp1: BagnA ityeva Bajyante vidvAMso'pi nakAraRam । udArasArA mahatI rurusaNGopamA camUH ॥19॥

text: parasparajñāḥ saṃhṛṣṭāstyaktaprāṇāḥ suniścitāḥ । api pañcāśatiḥ śūrā mṛdnanti paravāhinīm ॥20॥
html:
parasparajñāḥ saṃhṛṣṭāstyaktaprāṇāḥ suniścitāḥ ।
api pañcāśatiḥ śūrā mṛdnanti paravāhinīm ॥20॥
slp1: parasparajYAH saMhfzwAstyaktaprARAH suniScitAH । api paYcASatiH SUrA mfdnanti paravAhinIm ॥20॥

text: atha vā pañca ṣaṭsapta sahitāḥ kṛtaniścayāḥ । kulīnāḥ pūjitāḥ samyagvijayantīha śātravān ॥21॥
html:
atha vā pañca ṣaṭsapta sahitāḥ kṛtaniścayāḥ ।
kulīnāḥ pūjitāḥ samyagvijayantīha śātravān ॥21॥
slp1: aTa vA paYca zawsapta sahitAH kftaniScayAH । kulInAH pUjitAH samyagvijayantIha SAtravAn ॥21॥

text: sannipāto na gantavyaḥ śakye sati kathañcana । sāntvabhedapradānānāṃ yuddhamuttaramucyate ॥22॥
html:
sannipāto na gantavyaḥ śakye sati kathañcana ।
sāntvabhedapradānānāṃ yuddhamuttaramucyate ॥22॥
slp1: sannipAto na gantavyaH Sakye sati kaTaYcana । sAntvaBedapradAnAnAM yudDamuttaramucyate ॥22॥

text: saṃsarpaṇāddhi senāyā bhayaṃ bhīrūnprabādhate । vajrādiva prajvalitādiyaṃ kva nu patiṣyati ॥23॥
html:
saṃsarpaṇāddhi senāyā bhayaṃ bhīrūnprabādhate ।
vajrādiva prajvalitādiyaṃ kva nu patiṣyati ॥23॥
slp1: saMsarpaRAdDi senAyA BayaM BIrUnprabADate । vajrAdiva prajvalitAdiyaM kva nu patizyati ॥23॥

text: abhiprayātāṃ samitiṃ jñātvā ye pratiyāntyatha । teṣāṃ spandanti gātrāṇi yodhānāṃ viṣayasya ca ॥24॥
html:
abhiprayātāṃ samitiṃ jñātvā ye pratiyāntyatha ।
teṣāṃ spandanti gātrāṇi yodhānāṃ viṣayasya ca ॥24॥
slp1: aBiprayAtAM samitiM jYAtvA ye pratiyAntyaTa । tezAM spandanti gAtrARi yoDAnAM vizayasya ca ॥24॥

text: viṣayo vyathate rājansarvaḥ sasthāṇujaṅgamaḥ । śastrapratāpataptānāṃ majjā sīdati dehinām ॥25॥
html:
viṣayo vyathate rājansarvaḥ sasthāṇujaṅgamaḥ ।
śastrapratāpataptānāṃ majjā sīdati dehinām ॥25॥
slp1: vizayo vyaTate rAjansarvaH sasTARujaNgamaH । SastrapratApataptAnAM majjA sIdati dehinAm ॥25॥

text: teṣāṃ sāntvaṃ krūramiśraṃ praṇetavyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ । sampīḍyamānā hi pare yogamāyānti sarvaśaḥ ॥26॥
html:
teṣāṃ sāntvaṃ krūramiśraṃ praṇetavyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
sampīḍyamānā hi pare yogamāyānti sarvaśaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: tezAM sAntvaM krUramiSraM praRetavyaM punaH punaH । sampIqyamAnA hi pare yogamAyAnti sarvaSaH ॥26॥

text: antarāṇāṃ ca bhedārthaṃ cārānabhyavacārayet । yaśca tasmātparo rājā tena sandhiḥ praśasyate ॥27॥
html:
antarāṇāṃ ca bhedārthaṃ cārānabhyavacārayet ।
yaśca tasmātparo rājā tena sandhiḥ praśasyate ॥27॥
slp1: antarARAM ca BedArTaM cArAnaByavacArayet । yaSca tasmAtparo rAjA tena sanDiH praSasyate ॥27॥

text: na hi tasyānyathā pīḍā śakyā kartuṃ tathāvidhā । yathā sārdhamamitreṇa sarvataḥ pratibādhanam ॥28॥
html:
na hi tasyānyathā pīḍā śakyā kartuṃ tathāvidhā ।
yathā sārdhamamitreṇa sarvataḥ pratibādhanam ॥28॥
slp1: na hi tasyAnyaTA pIqA SakyA kartuM taTAviDA । yaTA sArDamamitreRa sarvataH pratibADanam ॥28॥

text: kṣamā vai sādhumāyā hi na hi sādhvakṣamā sadā । kṣamāyāścākṣamāyāśca viddhi pārtha prayojanam ॥29॥
html:
kṣamā vai sādhumāyā hi na hi sādhvakṣamā sadā ।
kṣamāyāścākṣamāyāśca viddhi pārtha prayojanam ॥29॥
slp1: kzamA vE sADumAyA hi na hi sADvakzamA sadA । kzamAyAScAkzamAyASca vidDi pArTa prayojanam ॥29॥

text: vijitya kṣamamāṇasya yaśo rājño'bhivardhate । mahāparādhā hyapyasminviśvasanti hi śatravaḥ ॥30॥
html:
vijitya kṣamamāṇasya yaśo rājño'bhivardhate ।
mahāparādhā hyapyasminviśvasanti hi śatravaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: vijitya kzamamARasya yaSo rAjYo'BivarDate । mahAparADA hyapyasminviSvasanti hi SatravaH ॥30॥

text: manyate karśayitvā tu kṣamā sādhviti śambaraḥ । asantaptaṃ tu yaddāru pratyeti prakṛtiṃ punaḥ ॥31॥
html:
manyate karśayitvā tu kṣamā sādhviti śambaraḥ ।
asantaptaṃ tu yaddāru pratyeti prakṛtiṃ punaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: manyate karSayitvA tu kzamA sADviti SambaraH । asantaptaM tu yaddAru pratyeti prakftiM punaH ॥31॥

text: naitatpraśaṃsantyācāryā na ca sādhu nidarśanam । akleśenāvināśena niyantavyāḥ svaputravat ॥32॥
html:
naitatpraśaṃsantyācāryā na ca sādhu nidarśanam ।
akleśenāvināśena niyantavyāḥ svaputravat ॥32॥
slp1: nEtatpraSaMsantyAcAryA na ca sADu nidarSanam । akleSenAvinASena niyantavyAH svaputravat ॥32॥

text: dveṣyo bhavati bhūtānāmugro rājā yudhiṣṭhira । mṛdumapyavamanyante tasmādubhayabhāgbhavet ॥33॥
html:
dveṣyo bhavati bhūtānāmugro rājā yudhiṣṭhira ।

text: prahariṣyanpriyaṃ brūyātpraharannapi bhārata । prahṛtya ca kṛpāyeta śocanniva rudanniva ॥34॥
html:
prahariṣyanpriyaṃ brūyātpraharannapi bhārata ।
prahṛtya ca kṛpāyeta śocanniva rudanniva ॥34॥
slp1: praharizyanpriyaM brUyAtpraharannapi BArata । prahftya ca kfpAyeta Socanniva rudanniva ॥34॥

text: na me priyaṃ yatsa hataḥ samprāhaivaṃ puro vacaḥ । na cakartha ca me vākyamucyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥35॥
html:
na me priyaṃ yatsa hataḥ samprāhaivaṃ puro vacaḥ ।
na cakartha ca me vākyamucyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: na me priyaM yatsa hataH samprAhEvaM puro vacaH । na cakarTa ca me vAkyamucyamAnaH punaH punaH ॥35॥

text: aho jīvitamākāṅkṣe nedṛśo vadhamarhati । sudurlabhāḥ supuruṣāḥ saṅgrāmeṣvapalāyinaḥ ॥36॥
html:
aho jīvitamākāṅkṣe nedṛśo vadhamarhati ।
sudurlabhāḥ supuruṣāḥ saṅgrāmeṣvapalāyinaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: aho jIvitamAkANkze nedfSo vaDamarhati । sudurlaBAH supuruzAH saNgrAmezvapalAyinaH ॥36॥

text: kṛtaṃ mamāpriyaṃ tena yenāyaṃ nihato mṛdhe । iti vācā vadanhantṝnpūjayeta rahogataḥ ॥37॥
html:
kṛtaṃ mamāpriyaṃ tena yenāyaṃ nihato mṛdhe ।
iti vācā vadanhantṝnpūjayeta rahogataḥ ॥37॥
slp1: kftaM mamApriyaM tena yenAyaM nihato mfDe । iti vAcA vadanhantFnpUjayeta rahogataH ॥37॥

text: hantṝṇāṃ cāhatānāṃ ca yatkuryuraparādhinaḥ । krośedbāhuṃ pragṛhyāpi cikīrṣañjanasaṅgraham ॥38॥
html:
hantṝṇāṃ cāhatānāṃ ca yatkuryuraparādhinaḥ ।
krośedbāhuṃ pragṛhyāpi cikīrṣañjanasaṅgraham ॥38॥
slp1: hantFRAM cAhatAnAM ca yatkuryuraparADinaH । kroSedbAhuM pragfhyApi cikIrzaYjanasaNgraham ॥38॥

html:
evaṃ sarvāsvavasthāsu sāntvapūrvaṃ samācaran ।
priyo bhavati bhūtānāṃ dharmajño vītabhīrnṛpaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: evaM sarvAsvavasTAsu sAntvapUrvaM samAcaran । priyo Bavati BUtAnAM DarmajYo vItaBIrnfpaH ॥39॥

text: viśvāsaṃ cātra gacchanti sarvabhūtāni bhārata । viśvastaḥ śakyate bhoktuṃ yathākāmamupasthitaḥ ॥40॥
html:
viśvāsaṃ cātra gacchanti sarvabhūtāni bhārata ।
viśvastaḥ śakyate bhoktuṃ yathākāmamupasthitaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: viSvAsaM cAtra gacCanti sarvaBUtAni BArata । viSvastaH Sakyate BoktuM yaTAkAmamupasTitaH ॥40॥

text: tasmādviśvāsayedrājā sarvabhūtānyamāyayā । sarvataḥ parirakṣecca yo mahīṃ bhoktumicchati] ॥41॥

text: kathaṃ mṛdau kathaṃ tīkṣṇe mahāpakṣe ca pārthiva । arau varteta nṛpatistanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । bṛhaspateśca saṃvādamindrasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥

text: bṛhaspatiṃ devapatirabhivādya kṛtāñjaliḥ । upasaṅgamya papraccha vāsavaḥ paravīrahā ॥3॥
html:
bṛhaspatiṃ devapatirabhivādya kṛtāñjaliḥ ।

slp1: bfhaspatiM devapatiraBivAdya kftAYjaliH । upasaNgamya papracCa vAsavaH paravIrahA ॥3॥

text: ahiteṣu kathaṃ brahmanvartayeyamatandritaḥ । asamucchidya caivenānniyaccheyamupāyataḥ ॥4॥
html:
ahiteṣu kathaṃ brahmanvartayeyamatandritaḥ ।
asamucchidya caivenānniyaccheyamupāyataḥ ॥4॥
slp1: ahitezu kaTaM brahmanvartayeyamatandritaH । asamucCidya cEvenAnniyacCeyamupAyataH ॥4॥

text: senayorvyatiṣaṅgeṇa jayaḥ sādhāraṇo bhavet । kiṃ kurvāṇaṃ na māṃ jahyājjvalitā śrīḥ pratāpinī ॥5॥
html:
senayorvyatiṣaṅgeṇa jayaḥ sādhāraṇo bhavet ।
kiṃ kurvāṇaṃ na māṃ jahyājjvalitā śrīḥ pratāpinī ॥5॥
slp1: senayorvyatizaNgeRa jayaH sADAraRo Bavet । kiM kurvARaM na mAM jahyAjjvalitA SrIH pratApinI ॥5॥

text: tato dharmārthakāmānāṃ kuśalaḥ pratibhānavān । rājadharmavidhānajñaḥ pratyuvāca purandaram ॥6॥
html:
tato dharmārthakāmānāṃ kuśalaḥ pratibhānavān ।
rājadharmavidhānajñaḥ pratyuvāca purandaram ॥6॥
slp1: tato DarmArTakAmAnAM kuSalaH pratiBAnavAn । rAjaDarmaviDAnajYaH pratyuvAca purandaram ॥6॥

text: na jātu kalahenecchenniyantumapakāriṇaḥ । bālasaṃsevitaṃ hyetadyadamarṣo yadakṣamā । na śatrurvivṛtaḥ kāryo vadhamasyābhikāṅkṣatā ॥7॥
html:
na jātu kalahenecchenniyantumapakāriṇaḥ ।
bālasaṃsevitaṃ hyetadyadamarṣo yadakṣamā ।
na śatrurvivṛtaḥ kāryo vadhamasyābhikāṅkṣatā ॥7॥
slp1: na jAtu kalahenecCenniyantumapakAriRaH । bAlasaMsevitaM hyetadyadamarzo yadakzamA । na SatrurvivftaH kAryo vaDamasyABikANkzatA ॥7॥

text: krodhaṃ balamamarṣaṃ ca niyamyātmajamātmani । amitramupaseveta viśvastavadaviśvasan ॥8॥
html:
krodhaṃ balamamarṣaṃ ca niyamyātmajamātmani ।
amitramupaseveta viśvastavadaviśvasan ॥8॥
slp1: kroDaM balamamarzaM ca niyamyAtmajamAtmani । amitramupaseveta viSvastavadaviSvasan ॥8॥

text: priyameva vadennityaṃ nāpriyaṃ kiñcidācaret । viramecchuṣkavairebhyaḥ kaṇṭhāyāsaṃ ca varjayet ॥9॥
html:
priyameva vadennityaṃ nāpriyaṃ kiñcidācaret ।
viramecchuṣkavairebhyaḥ kaṇṭhāyāsaṃ ca varjayet ॥9॥
slp1: priyameva vadennityaM nApriyaM kiYcidAcaret । viramecCuzkavEreByaH kaRWAyAsaM ca varjayet ॥9॥

text: yathā vaitaṃsiko yukto dvijānāṃ sadṛśasvanaḥ । tāndvijānkurute vaśyāṃstathā yukto mahīpatiḥ । vaśaṃ copanayecchatrūnnihanyācca purandara ॥10॥
html:
yathā vaitaṃsiko yukto dvijānāṃ sadṛśasvanaḥ ।
tāndvijānkurute vaśyāṃstathā yukto mahīpatiḥ ।
vaśaṃ copanayecchatrūnnihanyācca purandara ॥10॥
slp1: yaTA vEtaMsiko yukto dvijAnAM sadfSasvanaH । tAndvijAnkurute vaSyAMstaTA yukto mahIpatiH । vaSaM copanayecCatrUnnihanyAcca purandara ॥10॥

text: na nityaṃ paribhūyārīnsukhaṃ svapiti vāsava । jāgartyeva ca duṣṭātmā saṅkare'gnirivotthitaḥ ॥11॥
html:
na nityaṃ paribhūyārīnsukhaṃ svapiti vāsava ।
jāgartyeva ca duṣṭātmā saṅkare'gnirivotthitaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: na nityaM pariBUyArInsuKaM svapiti vAsava । jAgartyeva ca duzwAtmA saNkare'gnirivotTitaH ॥11॥

text: na sannipātaḥ kartavyaḥ sāmānye vijaye sati । viśvāsyaivopasaṃnyāsyo vaśe kṛtvā ripuḥ prabho ॥12॥
html:
na sannipātaḥ kartavyaḥ sāmānye vijaye sati ।
viśvāsyaivopasaṃnyāsyo vaśe kṛtvā ripuḥ prabho ॥12॥
slp1: na sannipAtaH kartavyaH sAmAnye vijaye sati । viSvAsyEvopasaMnyAsyo vaSe kftvA ripuH praBo ॥12॥

text: sampradhārya sahāmātyairmantravidbhirmahātmabhiḥ । upekṣamāṇo'vajñāte hṛdayenāparājitaḥ ॥13॥
html:
sampradhārya sahāmātyairmantravidbhirmahātmabhiḥ ।
upekṣamāṇo'vajñāte hṛdayenāparājitaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: sampraDArya sahAmAtyErmantravidBirmahAtmaBiH । upekzamARo'vajYAte hfdayenAparAjitaH ॥13॥

text: athāsya praharetkāle kiñcidvicalite pade । daṇḍaṃ ca dūṣayedasya puruṣairāptakāribhiḥ ॥14॥
html:
athāsya praharetkāle kiñcidvicalite pade ।
daṇḍaṃ ca dūṣayedasya puruṣairāptakāribhiḥ ॥14॥
slp1: aTAsya praharetkAle kiYcidvicalite pade । daRqaM ca dUzayedasya puruzErAptakAriBiH ॥14॥

text: ādimadhyāvasānajñaḥ pracchannaṃ ca vicārayet । balāni dūṣayedasya jānaṃścaiva pramāṇataḥ ॥15॥
html:
ādimadhyāvasānajñaḥ pracchannaṃ ca vicārayet ।
balāni dūṣayedasya jānaṃścaiva pramāṇataḥ ॥15॥
slp1: AdimaDyAvasAnajYaH pracCannaM ca vicArayet । balAni dUzayedasya jAnaMScEva pramARataH ॥15॥

text: bhedenopapradānena saṃsṛjannauṣadhaistathā । na tveva celasaṃsargaṃ racayedaribhiḥ saha ॥16॥
html:
bhedenopapradānena saṃsṛjannauṣadhaistathā ।
na tveva celasaṃsargaṃ racayedaribhiḥ saha ॥16॥
slp1: BedenopapradAnena saMsfjannOzaDEstaTA । na tveva celasaMsargaM racayedariBiH saha ॥16॥

text: dīrghakālamapi kṣāntvā vihanyādeva śātravān । kālākāṅkṣī yāmayecca yathā visrambhamāpnuyuḥ ॥17॥
html:
dīrghakālamapi kṣāntvā vihanyādeva śātravān ।
kālākāṅkṣī yāmayecca yathā visrambhamāpnuyuḥ ॥17॥
slp1: dIrGakAlamapi kzAntvA vihanyAdeva SAtravAn । kAlAkANkzI yAmayecca yaTA visramBamApnuyuH ॥17॥

text: na sadyo'rīnvinirhanyāddṛṣṭasya vijayo'jvaraḥ । na yaḥ śalyaṃ ghaṭṭayati navaṃ ca kurute vraṇam ॥18॥
html:
na sadyo'rīnvinirhanyāddṛṣṭasya vijayo'jvaraḥ ।
na yaḥ śalyaṃ ghaṭṭayati navaṃ ca kurute vraṇam ॥18॥
slp1: na sadyo'rInvinirhanyAddfzwasya vijayo'jvaraH । na yaH SalyaM Gawwayati navaM ca kurute vraRam ॥18॥

text: prāpte ca praharetkāle na sa saṃvartate punaḥ । hantukāmasya devendra puruṣasya ripuṃ prati ॥19॥
html:
prāpte ca praharetkāle na sa saṃvartate punaḥ ।
hantukāmasya devendra puruṣasya ripuṃ prati ॥19॥
slp1: prApte ca praharetkAle na sa saMvartate punaH । hantukAmasya devendra puruzasya ripuM prati ॥19॥

text: yaḥ kālo hi vyatikrāmetpuruṣaṃ kālakāṅkṣiṇam । durlabhaḥ sa punaḥ kālaḥ kāladharmacikīrṣuṇā ॥20॥
html:
yaḥ kālo hi vyatikrāmetpuruṣaṃ kālakāṅkṣiṇam ।
durlabhaḥ sa punaḥ kālaḥ kāladharmacikīrṣuṇā ॥20॥
slp1: yaH kAlo hi vyatikrAmetpuruzaM kAlakANkziRam । durlaBaH sa punaH kAlaH kAlaDarmacikIrzuRA ॥20॥

text: aurjasthyaṃ vijayedevaṃ saṅgṛhṇansādhusammatān । kālena sādhayennityaṃ nāprāpte'bhinipīḍayet ॥21॥
html:
aurjasthyaṃ vijayedevaṃ saṅgṛhṇansādhusammatān ।
kālena sādhayennityaṃ nāprāpte'bhinipīḍayet ॥21॥
slp1: OrjasTyaM vijayedevaM saNgfhRansADusammatAn । kAlena sADayennityaM nAprApte'BinipIqayet ॥21॥

text: vihāya kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca tathāhaṅkārameva ca । yukto vivaramanvicchedahitānāṃ purandara ॥22॥
html:
vihāya kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca tathāhaṅkārameva ca ।
yukto vivaramanvicchedahitānāṃ purandara ॥22॥
slp1: vihAya kAmaM kroDaM ca taTAhaNkArameva ca । yukto vivaramanvicCedahitAnAM purandara ॥22॥

text: mārdavaṃ daṇḍa ālasyaṃ pramādaśca surottama । māyāśca vividhāḥ śakra sādhayantyavicakṣaṇam ॥23॥
html:
mārdavaṃ daṇḍa ālasyaṃ pramādaśca surottama ।
māyāśca vividhāḥ śakra sādhayantyavicakṣaṇam ॥23॥
slp1: mArdavaM daRqa AlasyaM pramAdaSca surottama । mAyASca viviDAH Sakra sADayantyavicakzaRam ॥23॥

text: nihatyaitāni catvāri māyāṃ pratividhāya ca । tataḥ śaknoti śatrūṇāṃ prahartumavicārayan ॥24॥
html:
nihatyaitāni catvāri māyāṃ pratividhāya ca ।
tataḥ śaknoti śatrūṇāṃ prahartumavicārayan ॥24॥
slp1: nihatyEtAni catvAri mAyAM prativiDAya ca । tataH Saknoti SatrURAM prahartumavicArayan ॥24॥

text: yadaivaikena śakyeta guhyaṃ kartuṃ tadācaret । yacchanti sacivā guhyaṃ mitho vidrāvayantyapi ॥25॥
html:
yadaivaikena śakyeta guhyaṃ kartuṃ tadācaret ।
yacchanti sacivā guhyaṃ mitho vidrāvayantyapi ॥25॥
slp1: yadEvEkena Sakyeta guhyaM kartuM tadAcaret । yacCanti sacivA guhyaM miTo vidrAvayantyapi ॥25॥

text: aśakyamiti kṛtvā vā tato'nyaiḥ saṃvidaṃ caret । brahmadaṇḍamadṛṣṭeṣu dṛṣṭeṣu caturaṅgiṇīm ॥26॥
html:
aśakyamiti kṛtvā vā tato'nyaiḥ saṃvidaṃ caret ।
brahmadaṇḍamadṛṣṭeṣu dṛṣṭeṣu caturaṅgiṇīm ॥26॥
slp1: aSakyamiti kftvA vA tato'nyEH saMvidaM caret । brahmadaRqamadfzwezu dfzwezu caturaNgiRIm ॥26॥

text: bhedaṃ ca prathamaṃ yuñjyāttūṣṇīndaṇḍaṃ tathaiva ca । kāle prayojayedrājā tasmiṃstasmiṃstadā tadā ॥27॥
html:
bhedaṃ ca prathamaṃ yuñjyāttūṣṇīndaṇḍaṃ tathaiva ca ।
kāle prayojayedrājā tasmiṃstasmiṃstadā tadā ॥27॥
slp1: BedaM ca praTamaM yuYjyAttUzRIndaRqaM taTEva ca । kAle prayojayedrAjA tasmiMstasmiMstadA tadA ॥27॥

text: praṇipātaṃ ca gaccheta kāle śatrorbalīyasaḥ । yukto'sya vadhamanvicchedapramattaḥ pramādyataḥ ॥28॥
html:
praṇipātaṃ ca gaccheta kāle śatrorbalīyasaḥ ।
yukto'sya vadhamanvicchedapramattaḥ pramādyataḥ ॥28॥
slp1: praRipAtaM ca gacCeta kAle SatrorbalIyasaH । yukto'sya vaDamanvicCedapramattaH pramAdyataH ॥28॥

text: praṇipātena dānena vācā madhurayā bruvan । amitramupaseveta na tu jātu viśaṅkayet ॥29॥
html:
praṇipātena dānena vācā madhurayā bruvan ।
amitramupaseveta na tu jātu viśaṅkayet ॥29॥
slp1: praRipAtena dAnena vAcA maDurayA bruvan । amitramupaseveta na tu jAtu viSaNkayet ॥29॥

text: sthānāni śaṅkitānāṃ ca nityameva vivarjayet । na ca teṣvāśvaseddrugdhvā jāgratīha nirākṛtāḥ ॥30॥
html:
sthānāni śaṅkitānāṃ ca nityameva vivarjayet ।
na ca teṣvāśvaseddrugdhvā jāgratīha nirākṛtāḥ ॥30॥
slp1: sTAnAni SaNkitAnAM ca nityameva vivarjayet । na ca tezvASvaseddrugDvA jAgratIha nirAkftAH ॥30॥

text: na hyato duṣkaraṃ karma kiñcidasti surottama । yathā vividhavṛttānāmaiśvaryamamarādhipa ॥31॥
html:
na hyato duṣkaraṃ karma kiñcidasti surottama ।
yathā vividhavṛttānāmaiśvaryamamarādhipa ॥31॥
slp1: na hyato duzkaraM karma kiYcidasti surottama । yaTA viviDavfttAnAmESvaryamamarADipa ॥31॥

text: tathā vividhaśīlānāmapi sambhava ucyate । yateta yogamāsthāya mitrāmitrānavārayan ॥32॥
html:
tathā vividhaśīlānāmapi sambhava ucyate ।
yateta yogamāsthāya mitrāmitrānavārayan ॥32॥
slp1: taTA viviDaSIlAnAmapi samBava ucyate । yateta yogamAsTAya mitrAmitrAnavArayan ॥32॥

text: mṛdumapyavamanyante tīkṣṇādudvijate janaḥ । mātīkṣṇo māmṛdurbhūstvaṃ tīkṣṇo bhava mṛdurbhava ॥33॥
html:
mṛdumapyavamanyante tīkṣṇādudvijate janaḥ ।
mātīkṣṇo māmṛdurbhūstvaṃ tīkṣṇo bhava mṛdurbhava ॥33॥
slp1: mfdumapyavamanyante tIkzRAdudvijate janaH । mAtIkzRo mAmfdurBUstvaM tIkzRo Bava mfdurBava ॥33॥

text: yathā vapre vegavati sarvataḥsamplutodake । nityaṃ vivaraṇādbādhastathā rājyaṃ pramādyataḥ ॥34॥
html:
yathā vapre vegavati sarvataḥsamplutodake ।
nityaṃ vivaraṇādbādhastathā rājyaṃ pramādyataḥ ॥34॥
slp1: yaTA vapre vegavati sarvataHsamplutodake । nityaM vivaraRAdbADastaTA rAjyaM pramAdyataH ॥34॥

text: na bahūnabhiyuñjīta yaugapadyena śātravān । sāmnā dānena bhedena daṇḍena ca purandara ॥35॥
html:
na bahūnabhiyuñjīta yaugapadyena śātravān ।
sāmnā dānena bhedena daṇḍena ca purandara ॥35॥
slp1: na bahUnaBiyuYjIta yOgapadyena SAtravAn । sAmnA dAnena Bedena daRqena ca purandara ॥35॥

text: ekaikameṣāṃ niṣpiṃṣañśiṣṭeṣu nipuṇaṃ caret । na ca śakto'pi medhāvī sarvānevārabhennṛpaḥ ॥36॥
html:
ekaikameṣāṃ niṣpiṃṣañśiṣṭeṣu nipuṇaṃ caret ।
na ca śakto'pi medhāvī sarvānevārabhennṛpaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: ekEkamezAM nizpiMzaYSizwezu nipuRaM caret । na ca Sakto'pi meDAvI sarvAnevAraBennfpaH ॥36॥

text: yadā syānmahatī senā hayanāgarathākulā । padātiyantrabahulā svanuraktā ṣaḍaṅginī ॥37॥
html:
yadā syānmahatī senā hayanāgarathākulā ।
padātiyantrabahulā svanuraktā ṣaḍaṅginī ॥37॥
slp1: yadA syAnmahatI senA hayanAgaraTAkulA । padAtiyantrabahulA svanuraktA zaqaNginI ॥37॥

text: yadā bahuvidhāṃ vṛddhiṃ manyate pratilomataḥ । tadā vivṛtya prahareddasyūnāmavicārayan ॥38॥
html:
yadā bahuvidhāṃ vṛddhiṃ manyate pratilomataḥ ।
tadā vivṛtya prahareddasyūnāmavicārayan ॥38॥
slp1: yadA bahuviDAM vfdDiM manyate pratilomataH । tadA vivftya prahareddasyUnAmavicArayan ॥38॥

text: na sāma daṇḍopaniṣatpraśasyate na mārdavaṃ śatruṣu yātrikaṃ sadā । na sasyaghāto na ca saṅkarakriyā na cāpi bhūyaḥ prakṛtervicāraṇā ॥39॥
html:
na sāma daṇḍopaniṣatpraśasyate na mārdavaṃ śatruṣu yātrikaṃ sadā ।
na sasyaghāto na ca saṅkarakriyā na cāpi bhūyaḥ prakṛtervicāraṇā ॥39॥
slp1: na sAma daRqopanizatpraSasyate na mArdavaM Satruzu yAtrikaM sadA । na sasyaGAto na ca saNkarakriyA na cApi BUyaH prakftervicAraRA ॥39॥

text: māyāvibhedānupasarjanāni pāpaṃ tathaiva spaśasaṃprayogāt । āptairmanuṣyairupacārayeta pureṣu rāṣṭreṣu ca samprayuktaḥ ॥40॥
html:
māyāvibhedānupasarjanāni pāpaṃ tathaiva spaśasaṃprayogāt ।
āptairmanuṣyairupacārayeta pureṣu rāṣṭreṣu ca samprayuktaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: mAyAviBedAnupasarjanAni pApaM taTEva spaSasaMprayogAt । AptErmanuzyErupacArayeta purezu rAzwrezu ca samprayuktaH ॥40॥

text: purāṇi caiṣāmanusṛtya bhūmipāḥ pureṣu bhogānnikhilānihājayan । pureṣu nītiṃ vihitāṃ yathāvidhi prayojayanto balavṛtrasūdana ॥41॥
html:
purāṇi caiṣāmanusṛtya bhūmipāḥ pureṣu bhogānnikhilānihājayan ।
pureṣu nītiṃ vihitāṃ yathāvidhi prayojayanto balavṛtrasūdana ॥41॥
slp1: purARi cEzAmanusftya BUmipAH purezu BogAnniKilAnihAjayan । purezu nItiM vihitAM yaTAviDi prayojayanto balavftrasUdana ॥41॥

text: pradāya gūḍhāni vasūni nāma pracchidya bhogānavadhāya ca svān । duṣṭāḥ svadoṣairiti kīrtayitvā pureṣu rāṣṭreṣu ca yojayanti ॥42॥
html:
pradāya gūḍhāni vasūni nāma pracchidya bhogānavadhāya ca svān ।
duṣṭāḥ svadoṣairiti kīrtayitvā pureṣu rāṣṭreṣu ca yojayanti ॥42॥
slp1: pradAya gUQAni vasUni nAma pracCidya BogAnavaDAya ca svAn । duzwAH svadozEriti kIrtayitvA purezu rAzwrezu ca yojayanti ॥42॥

text: tathaiva cānyai ratiśāstravedibhiḥ svalaṅkṛtaiḥ śāstravidhānadṛṣṭibhiḥ । suśikṣitairbhāṣyakathāviśāradaiḥ pareṣu kṛtyānupadhārayasva ॥43॥
html:
tathaiva cānyai ratiśāstravedibhiḥ svalaṅkṛtaiḥ śāstravidhānadṛṣṭibhiḥ ।
suśikṣitairbhāṣyakathāviśāradaiḥ pareṣu kṛtyānupadhārayasva ॥43॥
slp1: taTEva cAnyE ratiSAstravediBiH svalaNkftEH SAstraviDAnadfzwiBiH । suSikzitErBAzyakaTAviSAradEH parezu kftyAnupaDArayasva ॥43॥

text: kāni liṅgāni duṣṭasya bhavanti dvijasattama । kathaṃ duṣṭaṃ vijānīyādetatpṛṣṭo bravīhi me ॥44॥
html:
kāni liṅgāni duṣṭasya bhavanti dvijasattama ।
kathaṃ duṣṭaṃ vijānīyādetatpṛṣṭo bravīhi me ॥44॥
slp1: kAni liNgAni duzwasya Bavanti dvijasattama । kaTaM duzwaM vijAnIyAdetatpfzwo bravIhi me ॥44॥
author: indra uvāca ।

text: parokṣamaguṇānāha sadguṇānabhyasūyati । parairvā kīrtyamāneṣu tūṣṇīmāste parāṅmukhaḥ ॥45॥
html:
parokṣamaguṇānāha sadguṇānabhyasūyati ।
parairvā kīrtyamāneṣu tūṣṇīmāste parāṅmukhaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: parokzamaguRAnAha sadguRAnaByasUyati । parErvA kIrtyamAnezu tUzRImAste parANmuKaH ॥45॥
author: bṛhaspatiruvāca ।

text: tūṣṇīmbhāve'pi hi jñānaṃ na cedbhavati kāraṇam । viśvāsamoṣṭhasandaṃśaṃ śirasaśca prakampanam ॥46॥
html:
tūṣṇīmbhāve'pi hi jñānaṃ na cedbhavati kāraṇam ।
viśvāsamoṣṭhasandaṃśaṃ śirasaśca prakampanam ॥46॥
slp1: tUzRImBAve'pi hi jYAnaM na cedBavati kAraRam । viSvAsamozWasandaMSaM SirasaSca prakampanam ॥46॥

text: karotyabhīkṣṇaṃ saṃsṛṣṭamasaṃsṛṣṭaśca bhāṣate । adṛṣṭito vikurute dṛṣṭvā vā nābhibhāṣate ॥47॥
html:
karotyabhīkṣṇaṃ saṃsṛṣṭamasaṃsṛṣṭaśca bhāṣate ।

text: dhārmiko'rthānasamprāpya rājāmātyaiḥ prabādhitaḥ । cyutaḥ kośācca daṇḍācca sukhamicchankathaṃ caret ॥1॥

text: atrāyaṃ kṣemadarśīyamitihāso'nugīyate । tatte'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥

text: kṣemadarśaṃ nṛpasutaṃ yatra kṣīṇabalaṃ purā । muniḥ kālakavṛkṣīya ājagāmeti naḥ śrutam । taṃ papracchopasaṅgṛhya kṛcchrāmāpadamāsthitaḥ ॥3॥
html:

text: artheṣu bhāgī puruṣa īhamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ । alabdhvā madvidho rājyaṃ brahmankiṃ kartumarhati ॥4॥

slp1: arTezu BAgI puruza IhamAnaH punaH punaH । alabDvA madviDo rAjyaM brahmankiM kartumarhati ॥4॥

text: vyādhinā cābhipannasya mānasenetareṇa vā । bahuśrutaḥ kṛtaprajñastvadvidhaḥ śaraṇaṃ bhavet ॥6॥
html:

slp1: vyADinA cABipannasya mAnasenetareRa vA । bahuSrutaH kftaprajYastvadviDaH SaraRaM Bavet ॥6॥

text: nirvidya hi naraḥ kāmānniyamya sukhamedhate । tyaktvā prītiṃ ca śokaṃ ca labdhvāprītimayaṃ vasu ॥7॥
html:
nirvidya hi naraḥ kāmānniyamya sukhamedhate ।

slp1: nirvidya hi naraH kAmAnniyamya suKameDate । tyaktvA prItiM ca SokaM ca labDvAprItimayaM vasu ॥7॥

text: sukhamarthāśrayaṃ yeṣāmanuśocāmi tānaham । mama hyarthāḥ subahavo naṣṭāḥ svapna ivāgatāḥ ॥8॥
html:
sukhamarthāśrayaṃ yeṣāmanuśocāmi tānaham ।

slp1: suKamarTASrayaM yezAmanuSocAmi tAnaham । mama hyarTAH subahavo nazwAH svapna ivAgatAH ॥8॥

text: duṣkaraṃ bata kurvanti mahato'rthāṃstyajanti ye । vayaṃ tvenānparityaktumasato'pi na śaknumaḥ ॥9॥
html:

text: imāmavasthāṃ samprāptaṃ dīnamārtaṃ śriyaścyutam । yadanyatsukhamastīha tadbrahmannanuśādhi mām ॥10॥

text: kausalyenaivamuktastu rājaputreṇa dhīmatā । muniḥ kālakavṛkṣīyaḥ pratyuvāca mahādyutiḥ ॥11॥

text: yatkiñcinmanyase'stīti sarvaṃ nāstīti viddhi tat । evaṃ na vyathate prājñaḥ kṛcchrāmapyāpadaṃ gataḥ ॥13॥

text: ātmano'dhruvatāṃ paśyaṃstāṃstvaṃ kimanuśocasi । buddhyā caivānubudhyasva dhruvaṃ hi na bhaviṣyasi ॥18॥

text: anāgataṃ yanna mameti vidyādatikrāntaṃ yanna mameti vidyāt । diṣṭaṃ balīya iti manyamānāste paṇḍitāstatsatāṃ sthānamāhuḥ ॥22॥

text: anāḍhyāścāpi jīvanti rājyaṃ cāpyanuśāsate । buddhipauruṣasampannāstvayā tulyādhikā janāḥ ॥23॥

slp1: na ca tvamiva Socanti tasmAttvamapi mA SucaH । kiM nu tvaM tErna vE SreyAMstulyo vA budDipOruzEH ॥24॥

akāmyānkāmayāno'rthānparācīnānupadrutān ॥36॥
slp1: tvaM punaH prAjYarUpaH sankfpaRaM paritapyase । akAmyAnkAmayAno'rTAnparAcInAnupadrutAn ॥36॥

text: tāṃ buddhimupajijñāsustvamevainānparityaja । anarthāṃścārtharūpeṇa arthāṃścānartharūpataḥ ॥37॥
html:
tāṃ buddhimupajijñāsustvamevainānparityaja ।
anarthāṃścārtharūpeṇa arthāṃścānartharūpataḥ ॥37॥
slp1: tAM budDimupajijYAsustvamevEnAnparityaja । anarTAMScArTarUpeRa arTAMScAnarTarUpataH ॥37॥

text: arthāyaiva hi keṣāñciddhananāśo bhavatyuta । anantyaṃ taṃ sukhaṃ matvā śriyamanyaḥ parīkṣate ॥38॥
html:
arthāyaiva hi keṣāñciddhananāśo bhavatyuta ।
anantyaṃ taṃ sukhaṃ matvā śriyamanyaḥ parīkṣate ॥38॥
slp1: arTAyEva hi kezAYcidDananASo Bavatyuta । anantyaM taM suKaM matvA SriyamanyaH parIkzate ॥38॥

text: ramamāṇaḥ śriyā kaścinnānyacchreyo'bhimanyate । tathā tasyehamānasya samārambho vinaśyati ॥39॥
html:
ramamāṇaḥ śriyā kaścinnānyacchreyo'bhimanyate ।
tathā tasyehamānasya samārambho vinaśyati ॥39॥
slp1: ramamARaH SriyA kaScinnAnyacCreyo'Bimanyate । taTA tasyehamAnasya samAramBo vinaSyati ॥39॥

text: kṛcchrāllabdhamabhipretaṃ yadā kausalya naśyati । tadā nirvidyate so'rthātparibhagnakramo naraḥ ॥40॥
html:
kṛcchrāllabdhamabhipretaṃ yadā kausalya naśyati ।
tadā nirvidyate so'rthātparibhagnakramo naraḥ ॥40॥
slp1: kfcCrAllabDamaBipretaM yadA kOsalya naSyati । tadA nirvidyate so'rTAtpariBagnakramo naraH ॥40॥

text: dharmameke'bhipadyante kalyāṇābhijanā narāḥ । paratra sukhamicchanto nirvidyeyuśca laukikāt ॥41॥
html:
dharmameke'bhipadyante kalyāṇābhijanā narāḥ ।
paratra sukhamicchanto nirvidyeyuśca laukikāt ॥41॥
slp1: Darmameke'Bipadyante kalyARABijanA narAH । paratra suKamicCanto nirvidyeyuSca lOkikAt ॥41॥

text: jīvitaṃ santyajantyeke dhanalobhaparā narāḥ । na jīvitārthaṃ manyante puruṣā hi dhanādṛte ॥42॥
html:
jīvitaṃ santyajantyeke dhanalobhaparā narāḥ ।
na jīvitārthaṃ manyante puruṣā hi dhanādṛte ॥42॥
slp1: jIvitaM santyajantyeke DanaloBaparA narAH । na jIvitArTaM manyante puruzA hi DanAdfte ॥42॥

text: paśya teṣāṃ kṛpaṇatāṃ paśya teṣāmabuddhitām । adhruve jīvite mohādarthatṛṣṇāmupāśritāḥ ॥43॥
html:
paśya teṣāṃ kṛpaṇatāṃ paśya teṣāmabuddhitām ।
adhruve jīvite mohādarthatṛṣṇāmupāśritāḥ ॥43॥
slp1: paSya tezAM kfpaRatAM paSya tezAmabudDitAm । aDruve jIvite mohAdarTatfzRAmupASritAH ॥43॥

text: sañcaye ca vināśānte maraṇānte ca jīvite । saṃyoge viprayogānte ko nu vipraṇayenmanaḥ ॥44॥
html:
sañcaye ca vināśānte maraṇānte ca jīvite ।
saṃyoge viprayogānte ko nu vipraṇayenmanaḥ ॥44॥
slp1: saYcaye ca vinASAnte maraRAnte ca jIvite । saMyoge viprayogAnte ko nu vipraRayenmanaH ॥44॥

text: dhanaṃ vā puruṣaṃ rājanpuruṣo vā punardhanam । avaśyaṃ prajahātyetattadvidvānko'nusañjvaret ॥45॥
html:
dhanaṃ vā puruṣaṃ rājanpuruṣo vā punardhanam ।
avaśyaṃ prajahātyetattadvidvānko'nusañjvaret ॥45॥
slp1: DanaM vA puruzaM rAjanpuruzo vA punarDanam । avaSyaM prajahAtyetattadvidvAnko'nusaYjvaret ॥45॥

text: anyeṣāmapi naśyanti suhṛdaśca dhanāni ca । paśya buddhyā manuṣyāṇāṃ rājannāpadamātmanaḥ । niyaccha yaccha saṃyaccha indriyāṇi mano giram ॥46॥
html:
anyeṣāmapi naśyanti suhṛdaśca dhanāni ca ।
paśya buddhyā manuṣyāṇāṃ rājannāpadamātmanaḥ ।
niyaccha yaccha saṃyaccha indriyāṇi mano giram ॥46॥
slp1: anyezAmapi naSyanti suhfdaSca DanAni ca । paSya budDyA manuzyARAM rAjannApadamAtmanaH । niyacCa yacCa saMyacCa indriyARi mano giram ॥46॥

text: pratiṣiddhānavāpyeṣu durlabheṣvahiteṣu ca । pratikṛṣṭeṣu bhāveṣu vyatikṛṣṭeṣvasambhave । prajñānatṛpto vikrāntastvadvidho nānuśocati ॥47॥
html:
pratiṣiddhānavāpyeṣu durlabheṣvahiteṣu ca ।
pratikṛṣṭeṣu bhāveṣu vyatikṛṣṭeṣvasambhave ।
prajñānatṛpto vikrāntastvadvidho nānuśocati ॥47॥
slp1: pratizidDAnavApyezu durlaBezvahitezu ca । pratikfzwezu BAvezu vyatikfzwezvasamBave । prajYAnatfpto vikrAntastvadviDo nAnuSocati ॥47॥

text: alpamicchannacapalo mṛdurdāntaḥ susaṃśitaḥ । brahmacaryopapannaśca tvadvidho naiva muhyati ॥48॥
html:
alpamicchannacapalo mṛdurdāntaḥ susaṃśitaḥ ।
brahmacaryopapannaśca tvadvidho naiva muhyati ॥48॥
slp1: alpamicCannacapalo mfdurdAntaH susaMSitaH । brahmacaryopapannaSca tvadviDo nEva muhyati ॥48॥

text: na tveva jālmīṃ kāpālīṃ vṛttimeṣitumarhasi । nṛśaṃsavṛttiṃ pāpiṣṭhāṃ duḥkhāṃ kāpuruṣocitām ॥49॥
html:
na tveva jālmīṃ kāpālīṃ vṛttimeṣitumarhasi ।
nṛśaṃsavṛttiṃ pāpiṣṭhāṃ duḥkhāṃ kāpuruṣocitām ॥49॥
slp1: na tveva jAlmIM kApAlIM vfttimezitumarhasi । nfSaMsavfttiM pApizWAM duHKAM kApuruzocitAm ॥49॥

text: api mūlaphalājīvo ramasvaiko mahāvane । vāgyataḥ saṅgṛhītātmā sarvabhūtadayānvitaḥ ॥50॥
html:
api mūlaphalājīvo ramasvaiko mahāvane ।
vāgyataḥ saṅgṛhītātmā sarvabhūtadayānvitaḥ ॥50॥
slp1: api mUlaPalAjIvo ramasvEko mahAvane । vAgyataH saNgfhItAtmA sarvaBUtadayAnvitaH ॥50॥

text: sadṛśaṃ paṇḍitasyaitadīṣādantena dantinā । yadeko ramate'raṇye yaccāpyalpena tuṣyati ॥51॥
html:
sadṛśaṃ paṇḍitasyaitadīṣādantena dantinā ।
yadeko ramate'raṇye yaccāpyalpena tuṣyati ॥51॥
slp1: sadfSaM paRqitasyEtadIzAdantena dantinA । yadeko ramate'raRye yaccApyalpena tuzyati ॥51॥

text: mahāhradaḥ saṅkṣubhita ātmanaiva prasīdati । etadevaṅgatasyāhaṃ sukhaṃ paśyāmi kevalam ॥52॥
html:
mahāhradaḥ saṅkṣubhita ātmanaiva prasīdati ।
etadevaṅgatasyāhaṃ sukhaṃ paśyāmi kevalam ॥52॥
slp1: mahAhradaH saNkzuBita AtmanEva prasIdati । etadevaNgatasyAhaM suKaM paSyAmi kevalam ॥52॥

text: asambhave śriyo rājanhīnasya sacivādibhiḥ । daive pratiniviṣṭe ca kiṃ śreyo manyate bhavān] ॥53॥
html:
asambhave śriyo rājanhīnasya sacivādibhiḥ ।
daive pratiniviṣṭe ca kiṃ śreyo manyate bhavān] ॥53॥
slp1: asamBave Sriyo rAjanhInasya sacivAdiBiH । dEve pratinivizwe ca kiM Sreyo manyate BavAn] ॥53॥

text: atha cetpauruṣaṃ kiñcitkṣatriyātmani paśyasi । bravīmi hanta te nītiṃ rājyasya pratipattaye ॥1॥
html:
atha cetpauruṣaṃ kiñcitkṣatriyātmani paśyasi ।
bravīmi hanta te nītiṃ rājyasya pratipattaye ॥1॥
slp1: aTa cetpOruzaM kiYcitkzatriyAtmani paSyasi । bravImi hanta te nItiM rAjyasya pratipattaye ॥1॥
author: muniruvāca ।

text: tāṃ cecchakṣyasyanuṣṭhātuṃ karma caiva kariṣyasi । śṛṇu sarvamaśeṣeṇa yattvāṃ vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ ॥2॥
html:
tāṃ cecchakṣyasyanuṣṭhātuṃ karma caiva kariṣyasi ।
śṛṇu sarvamaśeṣeṇa yattvāṃ vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ ॥2॥
slp1: tAM cecCakzyasyanuzWAtuM karma cEva karizyasi । SfRu sarvamaSezeRa yattvAM vakzyAmi tattvataH ॥2॥

text: ācariṣyasi cetkarma mahato'rthānavāpsyasi । rājyaṃ rājyasya mantraṃ vā mahatīṃ vā punaḥ śriyam । yadyetadrocate rājanpunarbrūhi bravīmi te ॥3॥
html:
ācariṣyasi cetkarma mahato'rthānavāpsyasi ।
rājyaṃ rājyasya mantraṃ vā mahatīṃ vā punaḥ śriyam ।
yadyetadrocate rājanpunarbrūhi bravīmi te ॥3॥
slp1: Acarizyasi cetkarma mahato'rTAnavApsyasi । rAjyaM rAjyasya mantraM vA mahatIM vA punaH Sriyam । yadyetadrocate rAjanpunarbrUhi bravImi te ॥3॥

text: bravītu bhagavānnītimupapanno'smyahaṃ prabho । amoghamidamadyāstu tvayā saha samāgatam ॥4॥
html:
bravītu bhagavānnītimupapanno'smyahaṃ prabho ।
amoghamidamadyāstu tvayā saha samāgatam ॥4॥
slp1: bravItu BagavAnnItimupapanno'smyahaM praBo । amoGamidamadyAstu tvayA saha samAgatam ॥4॥
author: rājaputra uvāca ।

text: hitvā stambhaṃ ca mānaṃ ca krodhaharṣau bhayaṃ tathā । pratyamitraṃ niṣevasva praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ ॥5॥
html:
hitvā stambhaṃ ca mānaṃ ca krodhaharṣau bhayaṃ tathā ।
pratyamitraṃ niṣevasva praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ ॥5॥
slp1: hitvA stamBaM ca mAnaM ca kroDaharzO BayaM taTA । pratyamitraM nizevasva praRipatya kftAYjaliH ॥5॥
author: muniruvāca ।

text: tamuttamena śaucena karmaṇā cābhirādhaya । dātumarhati te vṛttiṃ vaidehaḥ satyasaṅgaraḥ ॥6॥
html:
tamuttamena śaucena karmaṇā cābhirādhaya ।
dātumarhati te vṛttiṃ vaidehaḥ satyasaṅgaraḥ ॥6॥
slp1: tamuttamena SOcena karmaRA cABirADaya । dAtumarhati te vfttiM vEdehaH satyasaNgaraH ॥6॥

text: pramāṇaṃ sarvabhūteṣu pragrahaṃ ca gamiṣyasi । tataḥ sahāyānsotsāhāṁllapsyase'vyasanāñśucīn ॥7॥
html:
pramāṇaṃ sarvabhūteṣu pragrahaṃ ca gamiṣyasi ।
tataḥ sahāyānsotsāhāṁllapsyase'vyasanāñśucīn ॥7॥
slp1: pramARaM sarvaBUtezu pragrahaM ca gamizyasi । tataH sahAyAnsotsAhAṁllapsyase'vyasanAYSucIn ॥7॥

text: vartamānaḥ svaśāstre vai saṃyatātmā jitendriyaḥ । abhyuddharati cātmānaṃ prasādayati ca prajāḥ ॥8॥
html:
vartamānaḥ svaśāstre vai saṃyatātmā jitendriyaḥ ।
abhyuddharati cātmānaṃ prasādayati ca prajāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: vartamAnaH svaSAstre vE saMyatAtmA jitendriyaH । aByudDarati cAtmAnaM prasAdayati ca prajAH ॥8॥

text: tenaiva tvaṃ dhṛtimatā śrīmatā cābhisatkṛtaḥ । pramāṇaṃ sarvabhūteṣu gatvā pragrahaṇaṃ mahat ॥9॥
html:
tenaiva tvaṃ dhṛtimatā śrīmatā cābhisatkṛtaḥ ।
pramāṇaṃ sarvabhūteṣu gatvā pragrahaṇaṃ mahat ॥9॥
slp1: tenEva tvaM DftimatA SrImatA cABisatkftaH । pramARaM sarvaBUtezu gatvA pragrahaRaM mahat ॥9॥

text: tataḥ suhṛdbalaṃ labdhvā mantrayitvā sumantritam । antarairbhedayitvārīnbilvaṃ bilvena śātaya । parairvā saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā balamapyasya ghātaya ॥10॥
html:
tataḥ suhṛdbalaṃ labdhvā mantrayitvā sumantritam ।
antarairbhedayitvārīnbilvaṃ bilvena śātaya ।
parairvā saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā balamapyasya ghātaya ॥10॥
slp1: tataH suhfdbalaM labDvA mantrayitvA sumantritam । antarErBedayitvArInbilvaM bilvena SAtaya । parErvA saMvidaM kftvA balamapyasya GAtaya ॥10॥

text: alabhyā ye śubhā bhāvāḥ striyaścācchādanāni ca । śayyāsanāni yānāni mahārhāṇi gṛhāṇi ca ॥11॥
html:
alabhyā ye śubhā bhāvāḥ striyaścācchādanāni ca ।
śayyāsanāni yānāni mahārhāṇi gṛhāṇi ca ॥11॥
slp1: alaByA ye SuBA BAvAH striyaScAcCAdanAni ca । SayyAsanAni yAnAni mahArhARi gfhARi ca ॥11॥

text: pakṣiṇo mṛgajātāni rasā gandhāḥ phalāni ca । teṣveva sajjayethāstvaṃ yathā naśyetsvayaṃ paraḥ ॥12॥
html:
pakṣiṇo mṛgajātāni rasā gandhāḥ phalāni ca ।
teṣveva sajjayethāstvaṃ yathā naśyetsvayaṃ paraḥ ॥12॥
slp1: pakziRo mfgajAtAni rasA ganDAH PalAni ca । tezveva sajjayeTAstvaM yaTA naSyetsvayaM paraH ॥12॥

text: yadyeva pratiṣeddhavyo yadyupekṣaṇamarhati । na jātu vivṛtaḥ kāryaḥ śatrurvinayamicchatā ॥13॥
html:
yadyeva pratiṣeddhavyo yadyupekṣaṇamarhati ।
na jātu vivṛtaḥ kāryaḥ śatrurvinayamicchatā ॥13॥
slp1: yadyeva pratizedDavyo yadyupekzaRamarhati । na jAtu vivftaH kAryaH SatrurvinayamicCatA ॥13॥

text: vasasva paramāmitraviṣaye prājñasammate । bhajasva śvetakākīyairmitrādhamamanarthakaiḥ ॥14॥
html:
vasasva paramāmitraviṣaye prājñasammate ।
bhajasva śvetakākīyairmitrādhamamanarthakaiḥ ॥14॥
slp1: vasasva paramAmitravizaye prAjYasammate । Bajasva SvetakAkIyErmitrADamamanarTakEH ॥14॥

text: ārambhāṃścāsya mahato duṣkarāṃstvaṃ prayojaya । nadībandhavirodhāṃśca balavadbhirvirudhyatām ॥15॥
html:
ārambhāṃścāsya mahato duṣkarāṃstvaṃ prayojaya ।
nadībandhavirodhāṃśca balavadbhirvirudhyatām ॥15॥
slp1: AramBAMScAsya mahato duzkarAMstvaM prayojaya । nadIbanDaviroDAMSca balavadBirviruDyatAm ॥15॥

text: udyānāni mahārhāṇi śayanānyāsanāni ca । pratibhogasukhenaiva kośamasya virecaya ॥16॥
html:
udyānāni mahārhāṇi śayanānyāsanāni ca ।
pratibhogasukhenaiva kośamasya virecaya ॥16॥
slp1: udyAnAni mahArhARi SayanAnyAsanAni ca । pratiBogasuKenEva koSamasya virecaya ॥16॥

text: yajñadānapraśaṃsāsmai brāhmaṇeṣvanuvarṇyatām । te tvatpriyaṃ kariṣyanti taṃ ceṣyanti vṛkā iva ॥17॥
html:
yajñadānapraśaṃsāsmai brāhmaṇeṣvanuvarṇyatām ।
te tvatpriyaṃ kariṣyanti taṃ ceṣyanti vṛkā iva ॥17॥
slp1: yajYadAnapraSaMsAsmE brAhmaRezvanuvarRyatAm । te tvatpriyaM karizyanti taM cezyanti vfkA iva ॥17॥

text: asaṃśayaṃ puṇyaśīlaḥ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim । triviṣṭape puṇyatamaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnoti pārthivaḥ । kośakṣaye tvamitrāṇāṃ vaśaṃ kausalya gacchati ॥18॥
html:
asaṃśayaṃ puṇyaśīlaḥ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim ।
triviṣṭape puṇyatamaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnoti pārthivaḥ ।
kośakṣaye tvamitrāṇāṃ vaśaṃ kausalya gacchati ॥18॥
slp1: asaMSayaM puRyaSIlaH prApnoti paramAM gatim । trivizwape puRyatamaM sTAnaM prApnoti pArTivaH । koSakzaye tvamitrARAM vaSaM kOsalya gacCati ॥18॥

text: ubhayatra prasaktasya dharme cādharma eva ca । balārthamūlaṃ vyucchidyettena nandanti śatravaḥ ॥19॥
html:
ubhayatra prasaktasya dharme cādharma eva ca ।
balārthamūlaṃ vyucchidyettena nandanti śatravaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: uBayatra prasaktasya Darme cADarma eva ca । balArTamUlaM vyucCidyettena nandanti SatravaH ॥19॥

text: nindyāsya mānuṣaṃ karma daivamasyopavarṇaya । asaṃśayaṃ daivaparaḥ kṣiprameva vinaśyati ॥20॥
html:
nindyāsya mānuṣaṃ karma daivamasyopavarṇaya ।
asaṃśayaṃ daivaparaḥ kṣiprameva vinaśyati ॥20॥
slp1: nindyAsya mAnuzaM karma dEvamasyopavarRaya । asaMSayaM dEvaparaH kziprameva vinaSyati ॥20॥

text: yājayainaṃ viśvajitā sarvasvena viyujyatām । tato gacchatvasiddhārthaḥ pīḍyamāno mahājanam ॥21॥
html:
yājayainaṃ viśvajitā sarvasvena viyujyatām ।
tato gacchatvasiddhārthaḥ pīḍyamāno mahājanam ॥21॥
slp1: yAjayEnaM viSvajitA sarvasvena viyujyatAm । tato gacCatvasidDArTaH pIqyamAno mahAjanam ॥21॥

text: tyāgadharmavidaṃ muṇḍaṃ kañcidasyopavarṇaya । api tyāgaṃ bubhūṣeta kaccidgacchedanāmayam ॥22॥
html:
tyāgadharmavidaṃ muṇḍaṃ kañcidasyopavarṇaya ।
api tyāgaṃ bubhūṣeta kaccidgacchedanāmayam ॥22॥
slp1: tyAgaDarmavidaM muRqaM kaYcidasyopavarRaya । api tyAgaM buBUzeta kaccidgacCedanAmayam ॥22॥

text: siddhenauṣadhayogena sarvaśatruvināśinā । nāgānaśvānmanuṣyāṃśca kṛtakairupaghātaya ॥23॥
html:
siddhenauṣadhayogena sarvaśatruvināśinā ।
nāgānaśvānmanuṣyāṃśca kṛtakairupaghātaya ॥23॥
slp1: sidDenOzaDayogena sarvaSatruvinASinA । nAgAnaSvAnmanuzyAMSca kftakErupaGAtaya ॥23॥

text: ete cānye ca bahavo dambhayogāḥ suniścitāḥ । śakyā viṣahatā kartuṃ na klībena nṛpātmaja] ॥24॥
html:
ete cānye ca bahavo dambhayogāḥ suniścitāḥ ।
śakyā viṣahatā kartuṃ na klībena nṛpātmaja] ॥24॥
slp1: ete cAnye ca bahavo damBayogAH suniScitAH । SakyA vizahatA kartuM na klIbena nfpAtmaja] ॥24॥

text: na nikṛtyā na dambhena brahmannicchāmi jīvitum । nādharmayuktāniccheyamarthānsumahato'pyaham ॥1॥
html:
na nikṛtyā na dambhena brahmannicchāmi jīvitum ।
nādharmayuktāniccheyamarthānsumahato'pyaham ॥1॥
slp1: na nikftyA na damBena brahmannicCAmi jIvitum । nADarmayuktAnicCeyamarTAnsumahato'pyaham ॥1॥
author: rājaputra uvāca ।

text: purastādeva bhagavanmayaitadapavarjitam । yena māṃ nābhiśaṅketa yadvā kṛtsnaṃ hitaṃ bhavet ॥2॥
html:
purastādeva bhagavanmayaitadapavarjitam ।
yena māṃ nābhiśaṅketa yadvā kṛtsnaṃ hitaṃ bhavet ॥2॥
slp1: purastAdeva BagavanmayEtadapavarjitam । yena mAM nABiSaNketa yadvA kftsnaM hitaM Bavet ॥2॥

text: ānṛśaṃsyena dharmeṇa loke hyasmiñjijīviṣuḥ । nāhametadalaṃ kartuṃ naitanmayyupapadyate ॥3॥
html:
ānṛśaṃsyena dharmeṇa loke hyasmiñjijīviṣuḥ ।
nāhametadalaṃ kartuṃ naitanmayyupapadyate ॥3॥
slp1: AnfSaMsyena DarmeRa loke hyasmiYjijIvizuH । nAhametadalaM kartuM nEtanmayyupapadyate ॥3॥

text: upapannastvametena yathā kṣatriya bhāṣase । prakṛtyā hyupapanno'si buddhyā cādbhutadarśana ॥4॥
html:
upapannastvametena yathā kṣatriya bhāṣase ।
prakṛtyā hyupapanno'si buddhyā cādbhutadarśana ॥4॥
slp1: upapannastvametena yaTA kzatriya BAzase । prakftyA hyupapanno'si budDyA cAdButadarSana ॥4॥
author: muniruvāca ।

text: ubhayoreva vāmarthe yatiṣye tava tasya ca । saṃśleṣaṃ vā kariṣyāmi śāśvataṃ hyanapāyinam ॥5॥
html:
ubhayoreva vāmarthe yatiṣye tava tasya ca ।
saṃśleṣaṃ vā kariṣyāmi śāśvataṃ hyanapāyinam ॥5॥
slp1: uBayoreva vAmarTe yatizye tava tasya ca । saMSlezaM vA karizyAmi SASvataM hyanapAyinam ॥5॥

text: tvādṛśaṃ hi kule jātamanṛśaṃsaṃ bahuśrutam । amātyaṃ ko na kurvīta rājyapraṇayakovidam ॥6॥
html:
tvādṛśaṃ hi kule jātamanṛśaṃsaṃ bahuśrutam ।
amātyaṃ ko na kurvīta rājyapraṇayakovidam ॥6॥
slp1: tvAdfSaM hi kule jAtamanfSaMsaM bahuSrutam । amAtyaM ko na kurvIta rAjyapraRayakovidam ॥6॥

text: yastvaṃ pravrajito rājyādvyasanaṃ cottamaṃ gataḥ । ānṛśaṃsyena vṛttena kṣatriyecchasi jīvitum ॥7॥
html:
yastvaṃ pravrajito rājyādvyasanaṃ cottamaṃ gataḥ ।
ānṛśaṃsyena vṛttena kṣatriyecchasi jīvitum ॥7॥
slp1: yastvaM pravrajito rAjyAdvyasanaM cottamaM gataH । AnfSaMsyena vfttena kzatriyecCasi jIvitum ॥7॥

text: āgantā madgṛhaṃ tāta vaidehaḥ satyasaṅgaraḥ । yathāhaṃ taṃ niyokṣyāmi tatkariṣyatyasaṃśayam ॥8॥
html:
āgantā madgṛhaṃ tāta vaidehaḥ satyasaṅgaraḥ ।
yathāhaṃ taṃ niyokṣyāmi tatkariṣyatyasaṃśayam ॥8॥
slp1: AgantA madgfhaM tAta vEdehaH satyasaNgaraH । yaTAhaM taM niyokzyAmi tatkarizyatyasaMSayam ॥8॥

text: tata āhūya vaidehaṃ munirvacanamabravīt । ayaṃ rājakule jāto viditābhyantaro mama ॥9॥
html:
tata āhūya vaidehaṃ munirvacanamabravīt ।
ayaṃ rājakule jāto viditābhyantaro mama ॥9॥
slp1: tata AhUya vEdehaM munirvacanamabravIt । ayaM rAjakule jAto viditAByantaro mama ॥9॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ādarśa iva śuddhātmā śāradaścandramā iva । nāsminpaśyāmi vṛjinaṃ sarvato me parīkṣitaḥ ॥10॥
html:
ādarśa iva śuddhātmā śāradaścandramā iva ।
nāsminpaśyāmi vṛjinaṃ sarvato me parīkṣitaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: AdarSa iva SudDAtmA SAradaScandramA iva । nAsminpaSyAmi vfjinaM sarvato me parIkzitaH ॥10॥

text: tena te sandhirevāstu viśvasāsminyathā mayi । na rājyamanamātyena śakyaṃ śāstumamitrahan ॥11॥
html:
tena te sandhirevāstu viśvasāsminyathā mayi ।
na rājyamanamātyena śakyaṃ śāstumamitrahan ॥11॥
slp1: tena te sanDirevAstu viSvasAsminyaTA mayi । na rAjyamanamAtyena SakyaM SAstumamitrahan ॥11॥

text: amātyaḥ śūra eva syādbuddhisampanna eva ca । tābhyāṃ caiva bhayaṃ rājñaḥ paśya rājyasya yojanam । dharmātmanāṃ kvacilloke nānyāsti gatirīdṛśī ॥12॥
html:
amātyaḥ śūra eva syādbuddhisampanna eva ca ।
tābhyāṃ caiva bhayaṃ rājñaḥ paśya rājyasya yojanam ।
dharmātmanāṃ kvacilloke nānyāsti gatirīdṛśī ॥12॥
slp1: amAtyaH SUra eva syAdbudDisampanna eva ca । tAByAM cEva BayaM rAjYaH paSya rAjyasya yojanam । DarmAtmanAM kvacilloke nAnyAsti gatirIdfSI ॥12॥

text: kṛtātmā rājaputro'yaṃ satāṃ mārgamanuṣṭhitaḥ । susaṅgṛhītastvevaiṣa tvayā dharmapurogamaḥ । saṃsevyamānaḥ śatrūṃste gṛhṇīyānmahato gaṇān ॥13॥
html:
kṛtātmā rājaputro'yaṃ satāṃ mārgamanuṣṭhitaḥ ।
susaṅgṛhītastvevaiṣa tvayā dharmapurogamaḥ ।
saṃsevyamānaḥ śatrūṃste gṛhṇīyānmahato gaṇān ॥13॥
slp1: kftAtmA rAjaputro'yaM satAM mArgamanuzWitaH । susaNgfhItastvevEza tvayA DarmapurogamaH । saMsevyamAnaH SatrUMste gfhRIyAnmahato gaRAn ॥13॥

text: yadyayaṃ pratiyudhyettvāṃ svakarma kṣatriyasya tat । jigīṣamāṇastvāṃ yuddhe pitṛpaitāmahe pade ॥14॥
html:
yadyayaṃ pratiyudhyettvāṃ svakarma kṣatriyasya tat ।
jigīṣamāṇastvāṃ yuddhe pitṛpaitāmahe pade ॥14॥
slp1: yadyayaM pratiyuDyettvAM svakarma kzatriyasya tat । jigIzamARastvAM yudDe pitfpEtAmahe pade ॥14॥

text: tvaṃ cāpi pratiyudhyethā vijigīṣuvrate sthitaḥ । ayuddhvaiva niyogānme vaśe vaideha te sthitaḥ ॥15॥
html:
tvaṃ cāpi pratiyudhyethā vijigīṣuvrate sthitaḥ ।
ayuddhvaiva niyogānme vaśe vaideha te sthitaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: tvaM cApi pratiyuDyeTA vijigIzuvrate sTitaH । ayudDvEva niyogAnme vaSe vEdeha te sTitaH ॥15॥

text: sa tvaṃ dharmamavekṣasva tyaktvādharmamasāmpratam । na hi kāmānna ca drohātsvadharmaṃ hātumarhasi ॥16॥
html:
sa tvaṃ dharmamavekṣasva tyaktvādharmamasāmpratam ।
na hi kāmānna ca drohātsvadharmaṃ hātumarhasi ॥16॥
slp1: sa tvaM Darmamavekzasva tyaktvADarmamasAmpratam । na hi kAmAnna ca drohAtsvaDarmaM hAtumarhasi ॥16॥

text: naiva nityaṃ jayastāta naiva nityaṃ parājayaḥ । tasmādbhojayitavyaśca bhoktavyaśca paro janaḥ ॥17॥
html:
naiva nityaṃ jayastāta naiva nityaṃ parājayaḥ ।
tasmādbhojayitavyaśca bhoktavyaśca paro janaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: nEva nityaM jayastAta nEva nityaM parAjayaH । tasmAdBojayitavyaSca BoktavyaSca paro janaH ॥17॥

text: ātmanyeva hi sandṛśyāvubhau jayaparājayau । niḥśeṣakāriṇāṃ tāta niḥśeṣakaraṇādbhayam ॥18॥
html:
ātmanyeva hi sandṛśyāvubhau jayaparājayau ।
niḥśeṣakāriṇāṃ tāta niḥśeṣakaraṇādbhayam ॥18॥
slp1: Atmanyeva hi sandfSyAvuBO jayaparAjayO । niHSezakAriRAM tAta niHSezakaraRAdBayam ॥18॥

text: ityuktaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ vacanaṃ brāhmaṇarṣabham । abhipūjyābhisatkṛtya pūjārhamanumānya ca ॥19॥
html:
ityuktaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ vacanaṃ brāhmaṇarṣabham ।
abhipūjyābhisatkṛtya pūjārhamanumānya ca ॥19॥
slp1: ityuktaH pratyuvAcedaM vacanaM brAhmaRarzaBam । aBipUjyABisatkftya pUjArhamanumAnya ca ॥19॥

text: yathā brūyānmahāprājño yathā brūyādbahuśrutaḥ । śreyaskāmo yathā brūyādubhayoryatkṣamaṃ bhavet ॥20॥
html:
yathā brūyānmahāprājño yathā brūyādbahuśrutaḥ ।
śreyaskāmo yathā brūyādubhayoryatkṣamaṃ bhavet ॥20॥
slp1: yaTA brUyAnmahAprAjYo yaTA brUyAdbahuSrutaH । SreyaskAmo yaTA brUyAduBayoryatkzamaM Bavet ॥20॥

text: tathā vacanamukto'smi kariṣyāmi ca tattathā । etaddhi paramaṃ śreyo na me'trāsti vicāraṇā ॥21॥
html:
tathā vacanamukto'smi kariṣyāmi ca tattathā ।
etaddhi paramaṃ śreyo na me'trāsti vicāraṇā ॥21॥
slp1: taTA vacanamukto'smi karizyAmi ca tattaTA । etadDi paramaM Sreyo na me'trAsti vicAraRA ॥21॥

text: tataḥ kausalyamāhūya vaideho vākyamabravīt । dharmato nītitaścaiva balena ca jito mayā ॥22॥
html:
tataḥ kausalyamāhūya vaideho vākyamabravīt ।
dharmato nītitaścaiva balena ca jito mayā ॥22॥
slp1: tataH kOsalyamAhUya vEdeho vAkyamabravIt । Darmato nItitaScEva balena ca jito mayA ॥22॥

text: so'haṃ tvayā tvātmaguṇairjitaḥ pārthivasattama । ātmānamanavajñāya jitavadvartatāṃ bhavān ॥23॥
html:
so'haṃ tvayā tvātmaguṇairjitaḥ pārthivasattama ।
ātmānamanavajñāya jitavadvartatāṃ bhavān ॥23॥
slp1: so'haM tvayA tvAtmaguRErjitaH pArTivasattama । AtmAnamanavajYAya jitavadvartatAM BavAn ॥23॥

text: nāvamanye ca te buddhiṃ nāvamanye ca pauruṣam । nāvamanye jayāmīti jitavadvartatāṃ bhavān ॥24॥
html:
nāvamanye ca te buddhiṃ nāvamanye ca pauruṣam ।
nāvamanye jayāmīti jitavadvartatāṃ bhavān ॥24॥
slp1: nAvamanye ca te budDiM nAvamanye ca pOruzam । nAvamanye jayAmIti jitavadvartatAM BavAn ॥24॥

text: yathāvatpūjito rājangṛhaṃ gantāsi me gṛhāt । tataḥ sampūjya tau vipraṃ viśvastau jagmaturgṛhān ॥25॥
html:
yathāvatpūjito rājangṛhaṃ gantāsi me gṛhāt ।
tataḥ sampūjya tau vipraṃ viśvastau jagmaturgṛhān ॥25॥
slp1: yaTAvatpUjito rAjangfhaM gantAsi me gfhAt । tataH sampUjya tO vipraM viSvastO jagmaturgfhAn ॥25॥

text: vaidehastvatha kausalyaṃ praveśya gṛhamañjasā । pādyārghyamadhuparkaistaṃ pūjārhaṃ pratyapūjayat ॥26॥
html:
vaidehastvatha kausalyaṃ praveśya gṛhamañjasā ।
pādyārghyamadhuparkaistaṃ pūjārhaṃ pratyapūjayat ॥26॥
slp1: vEdehastvaTa kOsalyaM praveSya gfhamaYjasA । pAdyArGyamaDuparkEstaM pUjArhaM pratyapUjayat ॥26॥

text: dadau duhitaraṃ cāsmai ratnāni vividhāni ca । eṣa rājñāṃ paro dharmaḥ sahyau jayaparājayau] ॥27॥
html:
dadau duhitaraṃ cāsmai ratnāni vividhāni ca ।
eṣa rājñāṃ paro dharmaḥ sahyau jayaparājayau] ॥27॥
slp1: dadO duhitaraM cAsmE ratnAni viviDAni ca । eza rAjYAM paro DarmaH sahyO jayaparAjayO] ॥27॥

text: brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca parantapa । dharmo vṛttaṃ ca vṛttiśca vṛttyupāyaphalāni ca ॥1॥
html:
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca parantapa ।
dharmo vṛttaṃ ca vṛttiśca vṛttyupāyaphalāni ca ॥1॥
slp1: brAhmaRakzatriyaviSAM SUdrARAM ca parantapa । Darmo vfttaM ca vfttiSca vfttyupAyaPalAni ca ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: rājñāṃ vṛttaṃ ca kośaśca kośasañjananaṃ mahat । amātyaguṇavṛddhiśca prakṛtīnāṃ ca vardhanam ॥2॥
html:
rājñāṃ vṛttaṃ ca kośaśca kośasañjananaṃ mahat ।
amātyaguṇavṛddhiśca prakṛtīnāṃ ca vardhanam ॥2॥
slp1: rAjYAM vfttaM ca koSaSca koSasaYjananaM mahat । amAtyaguRavfdDiSca prakftInAM ca varDanam ॥2॥

text: ṣāḍguṇyaguṇakalpaśca senānītistathaiva ca । duṣṭasya ca parijñānamaduṣṭasya ca lakṣaṇam ॥3॥
html:
ṣāḍguṇyaguṇakalpaśca senānītistathaiva ca ।
duṣṭasya ca parijñānamaduṣṭasya ca lakṣaṇam ॥3॥
slp1: zAqguRyaguRakalpaSca senAnItistaTEva ca । duzwasya ca parijYAnamaduzwasya ca lakzaRam ॥3॥

text: samahīnādhikānāṃ ca yathāvallakṣaṇoccayaḥ । madhyamasya ca tuṣṭyarthaṃ yathā stheyaṃ vivardhatā ॥4॥
html:
samahīnādhikānāṃ ca yathāvallakṣaṇoccayaḥ ।
madhyamasya ca tuṣṭyarthaṃ yathā stheyaṃ vivardhatā ॥4॥
slp1: samahInADikAnAM ca yaTAvallakzaRoccayaH । maDyamasya ca tuzwyarTaM yaTA sTeyaM vivarDatA ॥4॥

text: kṣīṇasaṅgrahavṛttiśca yathāvatsamprakīrtitā । laghunādeśarūpeṇa granthayogena bhārata ॥5॥
html:
kṣīṇasaṅgrahavṛttiśca yathāvatsamprakīrtitā ।
laghunādeśarūpeṇa granthayogena bhārata ॥5॥
slp1: kzIRasaNgrahavfttiSca yaTAvatsamprakIrtitA । laGunAdeSarUpeRa granTayogena BArata ॥5॥

text: vijigīṣostathāvṛttamuktaṃ caiva tathaiva te । gaṇānāṃ vṛttimicchāmi śrotuṃ matimatāṃ vara ॥6॥
html:
vijigīṣostathāvṛttamuktaṃ caiva tathaiva te ।
gaṇānāṃ vṛttimicchāmi śrotuṃ matimatāṃ vara ॥6॥
slp1: vijigIzostaTAvfttamuktaM cEva taTEva te । gaRAnAM vfttimicCAmi SrotuM matimatAM vara ॥6॥

text: yathā gaṇāḥ pravardhante na bhidyante ca bhārata । arīnhi vijigīṣante suhṛdaḥ prāpnuvanti ca ॥7॥
html:
yathā gaṇāḥ pravardhante na bhidyante ca bhārata ।
arīnhi vijigīṣante suhṛdaḥ prāpnuvanti ca ॥7॥
slp1: yaTA gaRAH pravarDante na Bidyante ca BArata । arInhi vijigIzante suhfdaH prApnuvanti ca ॥7॥

text: bhedamūlo vināśo hi gaṇānāmupalabhyate । mantrasaṃvaraṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ bahūnāmiti me matiḥ ॥8॥
html:
bhedamūlo vināśo hi gaṇānāmupalabhyate ।
mantrasaṃvaraṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ bahūnāmiti me matiḥ ॥8॥
slp1: BedamUlo vinASo hi gaRAnAmupalaByate । mantrasaMvaraRaM duHKaM bahUnAmiti me matiH ॥8॥

text: etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ nikhilena parantapa । yathā ca te na bhidyeraṃstacca me brūhi pārthiva ॥9॥
html:
etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ nikhilena parantapa ।
yathā ca te na bhidyeraṃstacca me brūhi pārthiva ॥9॥
slp1: etadicCAmyahaM SrotuM niKilena parantapa । yaTA ca te na BidyeraMstacca me brUhi pArTiva ॥9॥

text: gaṇānāṃ ca kulānāṃ ca rājñāṃ ca bharatarṣabha । vairasandīpanāvetau lobhāmarṣau janādhipa ॥10॥
html:
gaṇānāṃ ca kulānāṃ ca rājñāṃ ca bharatarṣabha ।
vairasandīpanāvetau lobhāmarṣau janādhipa ॥10॥
slp1: gaRAnAM ca kulAnAM ca rAjYAM ca BaratarzaBa । vErasandIpanAvetO loBAmarzO janADipa ॥10॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: lobhameko hi vṛṇute tato'marṣamanantaram । tau kṣayavyayasaṃyuktāvanyonyajanitāśrayau ॥11॥
html:
lobhameko hi vṛṇute tato'marṣamanantaram ।
tau kṣayavyayasaṃyuktāvanyonyajanitāśrayau ॥11॥
slp1: loBameko hi vfRute tato'marzamanantaram । tO kzayavyayasaMyuktAvanyonyajanitASrayO ॥11॥

text: cāramantrabalādānaiḥ sāmadānavibhedanaiḥ । kṣayavyayabhayopāyaiḥ karśayantītaretaram ॥12॥
html:
cāramantrabalādānaiḥ sāmadānavibhedanaiḥ ।
kṣayavyayabhayopāyaiḥ karśayantītaretaram ॥12॥
slp1: cAramantrabalAdAnEH sAmadAnaviBedanEH । kzayavyayaBayopAyEH karSayantItaretaram ॥12॥

text: tatra dānena bhidyante gaṇāḥ saṅghātavṛttayaḥ । bhinnā vimanasaḥ sarve gacchantyarivaśaṃ bhayāt ॥13॥
html:
tatra dānena bhidyante gaṇāḥ saṅghātavṛttayaḥ ।
bhinnā vimanasaḥ sarve gacchantyarivaśaṃ bhayāt ॥13॥
slp1: tatra dAnena Bidyante gaRAH saNGAtavfttayaH । BinnA vimanasaH sarve gacCantyarivaSaM BayAt ॥13॥

text: bhedādgaṇā vinaśyanti bhinnāḥ sūpajapāḥ paraiḥ । tasmātsaṅghātayogeṣu prayaterangaṇāḥ sadā ॥14॥
html:
bhedādgaṇā vinaśyanti bhinnāḥ sūpajapāḥ paraiḥ ।
tasmātsaṅghātayogeṣu prayaterangaṇāḥ sadā ॥14॥
slp1: BedAdgaRA vinaSyanti BinnAH sUpajapAH parEH । tasmAtsaNGAtayogezu prayaterangaRAH sadA ॥14॥

text: arthā hyevādhigamyante saṅghātabalapauruṣāt । bāhyāśca maitrīṃ kurvanti teṣu saṅghātavṛttiṣu ॥15॥
html:
arthā hyevādhigamyante saṅghātabalapauruṣāt ।
bāhyāśca maitrīṃ kurvanti teṣu saṅghātavṛttiṣu ॥15॥
