mātṛtaḥ pitṛtaścaiva tasmātpūjyatamo guruḥ ।
ṛṣayaśca hi devāśca prīyante pitṛbhiḥ saha ॥23॥
slp1: yena prIRAtyupADyAyaM tena syAdbrahma pUjitam । mAtftaH pitftaScEva tasmAtpUjyatamo guruH । fzayaSca hi devASca prIyante pitfBiH saha ॥23॥

text: na kenacana vṛttena hyavajñeyo gururbhavet । na ca mātā na ca pitā tādṛśo yādṛśo guruḥ ॥24॥
html:
na kenacana vṛttena hyavajñeyo gururbhavet ।
na ca mātā na ca pitā tādṛśo yādṛśo guruḥ ॥24॥
slp1: na kenacana vfttena hyavajYeyo gururBavet । na ca mAtA na ca pitA tAdfSo yAdfSo guruH ॥24॥

text: na te'vamānamarhanti na ca te dūṣayanti tam । gurūṇāmeva satkāraṃ vidurdevāḥ saharṣibhiḥ ॥25॥
html:
na te'vamānamarhanti na ca te dūṣayanti tam ।
gurūṇāmeva satkāraṃ vidurdevāḥ saharṣibhiḥ ॥25॥
slp1: na te'vamAnamarhanti na ca te dUzayanti tam । gurURAmeva satkAraM vidurdevAH saharziBiH ॥25॥

text: upādhyāyaṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca ye'bhidruhyanti manasā karmaṇā vā । teṣāṃ pāpaṃ bhrūṇahatyāviśiṣṭaṃ tasmānnānyaḥ pāpakṛdasti loke ॥26॥
html:
upādhyāyaṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca ye'bhidruhyanti manasā karmaṇā vā ।
teṣāṃ pāpaṃ bhrūṇahatyāviśiṣṭaṃ tasmānnānyaḥ pāpakṛdasti loke ॥26॥
slp1: upADyAyaM pitaraM mAtaraM ca ye'Bidruhyanti manasA karmaRA vA । tezAM pApaM BrURahatyAviSizwaM tasmAnnAnyaH pApakfdasti loke ॥26॥

text: mitradruhaḥ kṛtaghnasya strīghnasya piśunasya ca । caturṇāṃ vayameteṣāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ nānuśuśrumaḥ ॥27॥
html:
mitradruhaḥ kṛtaghnasya strīghnasya piśunasya ca ।
caturṇāṃ vayameteṣāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ nānuśuśrumaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: mitradruhaH kftaGnasya strIGnasya piSunasya ca । caturRAM vayametezAM nizkftiM nAnuSuSrumaH ॥27॥

text: etatsarvamatideśena sṛṣṭaṃ yatkartavyaṃ puruṣeṇeha loke । etacchreyo nānyadasmādviśiṣṭaṃ sarvāndharmānanusṛtyaitaduktam] ॥28॥
html:
etatsarvamatideśena sṛṣṭaṃ yatkartavyaṃ puruṣeṇeha loke ।
etacchreyo nānyadasmādviśiṣṭaṃ sarvāndharmānanusṛtyaitaduktam] ॥28॥
slp1: etatsarvamatideSena sfzwaM yatkartavyaM puruzeReha loke । etacCreyo nAnyadasmAdviSizwaM sarvAnDarmAnanusftyEtaduktam] ॥28॥

text: kathaṃ dharme sthātumicchannaro varteta bhārata । vidvañjijñāsamānāya prabrūhi bharatarṣabha ॥1॥
html:
kathaṃ dharme sthātumicchannaro varteta bhārata ।
vidvañjijñāsamānāya prabrūhi bharatarṣabha ॥1॥
slp1: kaTaM Darme sTAtumicCannaro varteta BArata । vidvaYjijYAsamAnAya prabrUhi BaratarzaBa ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: satyaṃ caivānṛtaṃ cobhe lokānāvṛtya tiṣṭhataḥ । tayoḥ kimācaredrājanpuruṣo dharmaniścitaḥ ॥2॥
html:
satyaṃ caivānṛtaṃ cobhe lokānāvṛtya tiṣṭhataḥ ।
tayoḥ kimācaredrājanpuruṣo dharmaniścitaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: satyaM cEvAnftaM coBe lokAnAvftya tizWataH । tayoH kimAcaredrAjanpuruzo DarmaniScitaH ॥2॥

text: kiṃ svitsatyaṃ kimanṛtaṃ kiṃ sviddharmyaṃ sanātanam । kasminkāle vadetsatyaṃ kasminkāle'nṛtaṃ vadet ॥3॥
html:
kiṃ svitsatyaṃ kimanṛtaṃ kiṃ sviddharmyaṃ sanātanam ।
kasminkāle vadetsatyaṃ kasminkāle'nṛtaṃ vadet ॥3॥
slp1: kiM svitsatyaM kimanftaM kiM svidDarmyaM sanAtanam । kasminkAle vadetsatyaM kasminkAle'nftaM vadet ॥3॥

text: satyasya vacanaṃ sādhu na satyādvidyate param । yadbhūloke sudurjñātaṃ tatte vakṣyāmi bhārata ॥4॥
html:
satyasya vacanaṃ sādhu na satyādvidyate param ।
yadbhūloke sudurjñātaṃ tatte vakṣyāmi bhārata ॥4॥
slp1: satyasya vacanaM sADu na satyAdvidyate param । yadBUloke sudurjYAtaM tatte vakzyAmi BArata ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: bhavetsatyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ vaktavyamanṛtaṃ bhavet । yatrānṛtaṃ bhavetsatyaṃ satyaṃ vāpyanṛtaṃ bhavet ॥5॥
html:
bhavetsatyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ vaktavyamanṛtaṃ bhavet ।
yatrānṛtaṃ bhavetsatyaṃ satyaṃ vāpyanṛtaṃ bhavet ॥5॥
slp1: BavetsatyaM na vaktavyaM vaktavyamanftaM Bavet । yatrAnftaM BavetsatyaM satyaM vApyanftaM Bavet ॥5॥

text: tādṛśe muhyate bālo yatra satyamaniṣṭhitam । satyānṛte viniścitya tato bhavati dharmavit ॥6॥
html:
tādṛśe muhyate bālo yatra satyamaniṣṭhitam ।
satyānṛte viniścitya tato bhavati dharmavit ॥6॥
slp1: tAdfSe muhyate bAlo yatra satyamanizWitam । satyAnfte viniScitya tato Bavati Darmavit ॥6॥

text: apyanāryo'kṛtaprajñaḥ puruṣo'pi sudāruṇaḥ । sumahatprāpnuyātpuṇyaṃ balāko'ndhavadhādiva ॥7॥
html:
apyanāryo'kṛtaprajñaḥ puruṣo'pi sudāruṇaḥ ।
sumahatprāpnuyātpuṇyaṃ balāko'ndhavadhādiva ॥7॥
slp1: apyanAryo'kftaprajYaH puruzo'pi sudAruRaH । sumahatprApnuyAtpuRyaM balAko'nDavaDAdiva ॥7॥

text: kimāścaryaṃ ca yanmūḍho dharmakāmo'pyadharmavit । sumahatprāpnuyātpāpaṃ gaṅgāyāmiva kauśikaḥ ॥8॥
html:
kimāścaryaṃ ca yanmūḍho dharmakāmo'pyadharmavit ।
sumahatprāpnuyātpāpaṃ gaṅgāyāmiva kauśikaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: kimAScaryaM ca yanmUQo DarmakAmo'pyaDarmavit । sumahatprApnuyAtpApaM gaNgAyAmiva kOSikaH ॥8॥

text: tādṛśo'yamanupraśno yatra dharmaḥ sudurvacaḥ । duṣkaraḥ pratisaṅkhyātuṃ tarkeṇātra vyavasyati ॥9॥
html:
tādṛśo'yamanupraśno yatra dharmaḥ sudurvacaḥ ।
duṣkaraḥ pratisaṅkhyātuṃ tarkeṇātra vyavasyati ॥9॥
slp1: tAdfSo'yamanupraSno yatra DarmaH sudurvacaH । duzkaraH pratisaNKyAtuM tarkeRAtra vyavasyati ॥9॥

text: prabhāvārthāya bhūtānāṃ dharmapravacanaṃ kṛtam । yatsyādahiṃsāsaṃyuktaṃ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ ॥10॥
html:
prabhāvārthāya bhūtānāṃ dharmapravacanaṃ kṛtam ।
yatsyādahiṃsāsaṃyuktaṃ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: praBAvArTAya BUtAnAM DarmapravacanaM kftam । yatsyAdahiMsAsaMyuktaM sa Darma iti niScayaH ॥10॥

text: dhāraṇāddharma ityāhurdharmeṇa vidhṛtāḥ prajāḥ । yatsyāddhāraṇasaṃyuktaṃ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ ॥11॥
html:
dhāraṇāddharma ityāhurdharmeṇa vidhṛtāḥ prajāḥ ।
yatsyāddhāraṇasaṃyuktaṃ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: DAraRAdDarma ityAhurDarmeRa viDftAH prajAH । yatsyAdDAraRasaMyuktaM sa Darma iti niScayaH ॥11॥

text: śrutidharma iti hyeke netyāhurapare janāḥ । na tu tatpratyasūyāmo na hi sarvaṃ vidhīyate ॥12॥
html:
śrutidharma iti hyeke netyāhurapare janāḥ ।
na tu tatpratyasūyāmo na hi sarvaṃ vidhīyate ॥12॥
slp1: SrutiDarma iti hyeke netyAhurapare janAH । na tu tatpratyasUyAmo na hi sarvaM viDIyate ॥12॥

text: ye'nyāyena jihīrṣanto dhanamicchanti karhicit । tebhyastanna tadākhyeyaṃ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ ॥13॥
html:
ye'nyāyena jihīrṣanto dhanamicchanti karhicit ।
tebhyastanna tadākhyeyaṃ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: ye'nyAyena jihIrzanto DanamicCanti karhicit । teByastanna tadAKyeyaM sa Darma iti niScayaH ॥13॥

text: akūjanena cenmokṣo nātra kūjetkathañcana । avaśyaṃ kūjitavyaṃ vā śaṅkeranvāpyakūjanāt ॥14॥
html:
akūjanena cenmokṣo nātra kūjetkathañcana ।
avaśyaṃ kūjitavyaṃ vā śaṅkeranvāpyakūjanāt ॥14॥
slp1: akUjanena cenmokzo nAtra kUjetkaTaYcana । avaSyaM kUjitavyaM vA SaNkeranvApyakUjanAt ॥14॥

text: śreyastatrānṛtaṃ vaktuṃ satyāditi vicāritam । yaḥ pāpaiḥ saha sambandhānmucyate śapathāditi ॥15॥
html:
śreyastatrānṛtaṃ vaktuṃ satyāditi vicāritam ।
yaḥ pāpaiḥ saha sambandhānmucyate śapathāditi ॥15॥
slp1: SreyastatrAnftaM vaktuM satyAditi vicAritam । yaH pApEH saha sambanDAnmucyate SapaTAditi ॥15॥

text: na ca tebhyo dhanaṃ deyaṃ śakye sati kathañcana । pāpebhyo hi dhanaṃ dattaṃ dātāramapi pīḍayet ॥16॥
html:
na ca tebhyo dhanaṃ deyaṃ śakye sati kathañcana ।
pāpebhyo hi dhanaṃ dattaṃ dātāramapi pīḍayet ॥16॥
slp1: na ca teByo DanaM deyaM Sakye sati kaTaYcana । pApeByo hi DanaM dattaM dAtAramapi pIqayet ॥16॥

text: svaśarīroparodhena varamādātumicchataḥ । satyasampratipattyarthaṃ ye brūyuḥ sākṣiṇaḥ kvacit । anuktvā tatra tadvācyaṃ sarve te'nṛtavādinaḥ ॥17॥
html:
svaśarīroparodhena varamādātumicchataḥ ।
satyasampratipattyarthaṃ ye brūyuḥ sākṣiṇaḥ kvacit ।
anuktvā tatra tadvācyaṃ sarve te'nṛtavādinaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: svaSarIroparoDena varamAdAtumicCataH । satyasampratipattyarTaM ye brUyuH sAkziRaH kvacit । anuktvA tatra tadvAcyaM sarve te'nftavAdinaH ॥17॥

text: prāṇātyaye vivāhe ca vaktavyamanṛtaṃ bhavet । arthasya rakṣaṇārthāya pareṣāṃ dharmakāraṇāt । pareṣāṃ dharmamākāṅkṣannīcaḥ syāddharmabhikṣukaḥ ॥18॥
html:
prāṇātyaye vivāhe ca vaktavyamanṛtaṃ bhavet ।
arthasya rakṣaṇārthāya pareṣāṃ dharmakāraṇāt ।
pareṣāṃ dharmamākāṅkṣannīcaḥ syāddharmabhikṣukaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: prARAtyaye vivAhe ca vaktavyamanftaM Bavet । arTasya rakzaRArTAya parezAM DarmakAraRAt । parezAM DarmamAkANkzannIcaH syAdDarmaBikzukaH ॥18॥

text: pratiśrutya tu dātavyaṃ śvaḥkāryastu balātkṛtaḥ । yaḥ kaściddharmasamayātpracyuto'dharmamāsthitaḥ ॥19॥
html:
pratiśrutya tu dātavyaṃ śvaḥkāryastu balātkṛtaḥ ।
yaḥ kaściddharmasamayātpracyuto'dharmamāsthitaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: pratiSrutya tu dAtavyaM SvaHkAryastu balAtkftaH । yaH kaScidDarmasamayAtpracyuto'DarmamAsTitaH ॥19॥

text: śaṭhaḥ svadharmamutsṛjya tamicchedupajīvitum । sarvopāyairnihantavyaḥ pāpo nikṛtijīvanaḥ ॥20॥
html:
śaṭhaḥ svadharmamutsṛjya tamicchedupajīvitum ।
sarvopāyairnihantavyaḥ pāpo nikṛtijīvanaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: SaWaH svaDarmamutsfjya tamicCedupajIvitum । sarvopAyErnihantavyaH pApo nikftijIvanaH ॥20॥

text: dhanamityeva pāpānāṃ sarveṣāmiha niścayaḥ । ye'viṣahyā hyasaṃbhojyā nikṛtyā patanaṃ gatāḥ ॥21॥
html:
dhanamityeva pāpānāṃ sarveṣāmiha niścayaḥ ।
ye'viṣahyā hyasaṃbhojyā nikṛtyā patanaṃ gatāḥ ॥21॥
slp1: Danamityeva pApAnAM sarvezAmiha niScayaH । ye'vizahyA hyasaMBojyA nikftyA patanaM gatAH ॥21॥

text: cyutā devamanuṣyebhyo yathā pretāstathaiva te । dhanādānādduḥkhataraṃ jīvitādviprayojanam ॥22॥
html:
cyutā devamanuṣyebhyo yathā pretāstathaiva te ।
dhanādānādduḥkhataraṃ jīvitādviprayojanam ॥22॥
slp1: cyutA devamanuzyeByo yaTA pretAstaTEva te । DanAdAnAdduHKataraM jIvitAdviprayojanam ॥22॥

text: ayaṃ vo rocatāṃ dharma iti vācyaḥ prayatnataḥ । na kaścidasti pāpānāṃ dharma ityeṣa niścayaḥ ॥23॥
html:
ayaṃ vo rocatāṃ dharma iti vācyaḥ prayatnataḥ ।
na kaścidasti pāpānāṃ dharma ityeṣa niścayaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: ayaM vo rocatAM Darma iti vAcyaH prayatnataH । na kaScidasti pApAnAM Darma ityeza niScayaH ॥23॥

text: tathāgataṃ ca yo hanyānnāsau pāpena lipyate । svakarmaṇā hataṃ hanti hata eva sa hanyate । teṣu yaḥ samayaṃ kaścitkurvīta hatabuddhiṣu ॥24॥
html:
tathāgataṃ ca yo hanyānnāsau pāpena lipyate ।
svakarmaṇā hataṃ hanti hata eva sa hanyate ।
teṣu yaḥ samayaṃ kaścitkurvīta hatabuddhiṣu ॥24॥
slp1: taTAgataM ca yo hanyAnnAsO pApena lipyate । svakarmaRA hataM hanti hata eva sa hanyate । tezu yaH samayaM kaScitkurvIta hatabudDizu ॥24॥

text: yathā kākaśca gṛdhraśca tathaivopadhijīvinaḥ । ūrdhvaṃ dehavimokṣānte bhavantyetāsu yoniṣu ॥25॥
html:
yathā kākaśca gṛdhraśca tathaivopadhijīvinaḥ ।
ūrdhvaṃ dehavimokṣānte bhavantyetāsu yoniṣu ॥25॥
slp1: yaTA kAkaSca gfDraSca taTEvopaDijIvinaH । UrDvaM dehavimokzAnte BavantyetAsu yonizu ॥25॥

text: yasminyathā vartate yo manuṣyastasmiṃstathā vartitavyaṃ sa dharmaḥ । māyācāro māyayā vartitavyaḥ sādhvācāraḥ sādhunā pratyudeyaḥ] ॥26॥
html:
yasminyathā vartate yo manuṣyastasmiṃstathā vartitavyaṃ sa dharmaḥ ।
māyācāro māyayā vartitavyaḥ sādhvācāraḥ sādhunā pratyudeyaḥ] ॥26॥
slp1: yasminyaTA vartate yo manuzyastasmiMstaTA vartitavyaM sa DarmaH । mAyAcAro mAyayA vartitavyaH sADvAcAraH sADunA pratyudeyaH] ॥26॥

text: kliśyamāneṣu bhūteṣu taistairbhāvaistatastataḥ । durgāṇyatitaredyena tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
kliśyamāneṣu bhūteṣu taistairbhāvaistatastataḥ ।
durgāṇyatitaredyena tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: kliSyamAnezu BUtezu tEstErBAvEstatastataH । durgARyatitaredyena tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: āśrameṣu yathokteṣu yathoktaṃ ye dvijātayaḥ । vartante saṃyatātmāno durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥2॥
html:
āśrameṣu yathokteṣu yathoktaṃ ye dvijātayaḥ ।
vartante saṃyatātmāno durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥2॥
slp1: ASramezu yaToktezu yaToktaM ye dvijAtayaH । vartante saMyatAtmAno durgARyatitaranti te ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ye dambhānna japanti sma yeṣāṃ vṛttiśca saṃvṛtā । viṣayāṃśca nigṛhṇanti durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥3॥
html:
ye dambhānna japanti sma yeṣāṃ vṛttiśca saṃvṛtā ।
viṣayāṃśca nigṛhṇanti durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥3॥
slp1: ye damBAnna japanti sma yezAM vfttiSca saMvftA । vizayAMSca nigfhRanti durgARyatitaranti te ॥3॥

text: vāsayantyatithīnnityaṃ nityaṃ ye cānasūyakāḥ । nityaṃ svādhyāyaśīlāśca durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥4॥
html:
vāsayantyatithīnnityaṃ nityaṃ ye cānasūyakāḥ ।
nityaṃ svādhyāyaśīlāśca durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥4॥
slp1: vAsayantyatiTInnityaM nityaM ye cAnasUyakAH । nityaM svADyAyaSIlASca durgARyatitaranti te ॥4॥

text: mātāpitrośca ye vṛttiṃ vartante dharmakovidāḥ । varjayanti divāsvapnaṃ durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥5॥
html:
mātāpitrośca ye vṛttiṃ vartante dharmakovidāḥ ।
varjayanti divāsvapnaṃ durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥5॥
slp1: mAtApitroSca ye vfttiM vartante DarmakovidAH । varjayanti divAsvapnaM durgARyatitaranti te ॥5॥

text: sveṣu dāreṣu vartante nyāyavṛtteṣvṛtāvṛtau । agnihotraparāḥ santo durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥6॥
html:
sveṣu dāreṣu vartante nyāyavṛtteṣvṛtāvṛtau ।
agnihotraparāḥ santo durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥6॥
slp1: svezu dArezu vartante nyAyavfttezvftAvftO । agnihotraparAH santo durgARyatitaranti te ॥6॥

text: ye na lobhānnayantyarthānrājāno rajasāvṛtāḥ । viṣayānparirakṣanto durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥7॥
html:
ye na lobhānnayantyarthānrājāno rajasāvṛtāḥ ।
viṣayānparirakṣanto durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥7॥
slp1: ye na loBAnnayantyarTAnrAjAno rajasAvftAH । vizayAnparirakzanto durgARyatitaranti te ॥7॥

text: āhaveṣu ca ye śūrāstyaktvā maraṇajaṃ bhayam । dharmeṇa jayamicchanto durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥8॥
html:
āhaveṣu ca ye śūrāstyaktvā maraṇajaṃ bhayam ।
dharmeṇa jayamicchanto durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥8॥
slp1: Ahavezu ca ye SUrAstyaktvA maraRajaM Bayam । DarmeRa jayamicCanto durgARyatitaranti te ॥8॥

text: ye pāpāni na kurvanti karmaṇā manasā girā । nikṣiptadaṇḍā bhūteṣu durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥9॥
html:
ye pāpāni na kurvanti karmaṇā manasā girā ।
nikṣiptadaṇḍā bhūteṣu durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥9॥
slp1: ye pApAni na kurvanti karmaRA manasA girA । nikziptadaRqA BUtezu durgARyatitaranti te ॥9॥

text: ye vadantīha satyāni prāṇatyāge'pyupasthite । pramāṇabhūtā bhūtānāṃ durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥10॥
html:
ye vadantīha satyāni prāṇatyāge'pyupasthite ।
pramāṇabhūtā bhūtānāṃ durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥10॥
slp1: ye vadantIha satyAni prARatyAge'pyupasTite । pramARaBUtA BUtAnAM durgARyatitaranti te ॥10॥

text: anadhyāyeṣu ye viprāḥ svādhyāyaṃ naiva kurvate । taponityāḥ sutapaso durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥11॥
html:
anadhyāyeṣu ye viprāḥ svādhyāyaṃ naiva kurvate ।
taponityāḥ sutapaso durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥11॥
slp1: anaDyAyezu ye viprAH svADyAyaM nEva kurvate । taponityAH sutapaso durgARyatitaranti te ॥11॥

text: karmāṇyakuhakārthāni yeṣāṃ vācaśca sūnṛtāḥ । yeṣāmarthāśca sādhvarthā durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥12॥
html:
karmāṇyakuhakārthāni yeṣāṃ vācaśca sūnṛtāḥ ।
yeṣāmarthāśca sādhvarthā durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥12॥
slp1: karmARyakuhakArTAni yezAM vAcaSca sUnftAH । yezAmarTASca sADvarTA durgARyatitaranti te ॥12॥

text: ye tapaśca tapasyanti kaumārabrahmacāriṇaḥ । vidyāvedavratasnātā durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥13॥
html:
ye tapaśca tapasyanti kaumārabrahmacāriṇaḥ ।
vidyāvedavratasnātā durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥13॥
slp1: ye tapaSca tapasyanti kOmArabrahmacAriRaH । vidyAvedavratasnAtA durgARyatitaranti te ॥13॥

text: ye ca saṃśāntarajasaḥ saṃśāntatamasaśca ye । satye sthitā mahātmāno durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥14॥
html:
ye ca saṃśāntarajasaḥ saṃśāntatamasaśca ye ।
satye sthitā mahātmāno durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥14॥
slp1: ye ca saMSAntarajasaH saMSAntatamasaSca ye । satye sTitA mahAtmAno durgARyatitaranti te ॥14॥

text: yeṣāṃ na kaścittrasati trasanti na ca kasyacit । yeṣāmātmasamo loko durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥15॥
html:
yeṣāṃ na kaścittrasati trasanti na ca kasyacit ।
yeṣāmātmasamo loko durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥15॥
slp1: yezAM na kaScittrasati trasanti na ca kasyacit । yezAmAtmasamo loko durgARyatitaranti te ॥15॥

text: paraśriyā na tapyante ye santaḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ । grāmyādannānnivṛttāśca durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥16॥
html:
paraśriyā na tapyante ye santaḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ ।
grāmyādannānnivṛttāśca durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥16॥
slp1: paraSriyA na tapyante ye santaH puruzarzaBAH । grAmyAdannAnnivfttASca durgARyatitaranti te ॥16॥

text: sarvāndevānnamasyanti sarvāndharmāṃśca śṛṇvate । ye śraddadhānā dāntāśca durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥17॥
html:
sarvāndevānnamasyanti sarvāndharmāṃśca śṛṇvate ।
ye śraddadhānā dāntāśca durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥17॥
slp1: sarvAndevAnnamasyanti sarvAnDarmAMSca SfRvate । ye SraddaDAnA dAntASca durgARyatitaranti te ॥17॥

text: ye na mānitamicchanti mānayanti ca ye param । mānyamānā na manyante durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥18॥
html:
ye na mānitamicchanti mānayanti ca ye param ।
mānyamānā na manyante durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥18॥
slp1: ye na mAnitamicCanti mAnayanti ca ye param । mAnyamAnA na manyante durgARyatitaranti te ॥18॥

text: ye śrāddhāni ca kurvanti tithyāṃ tithyāṃ prajārthinaḥ । suviśuddhena manasā durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥19॥
html:
ye śrāddhāni ca kurvanti tithyāṃ tithyāṃ prajārthinaḥ ।
suviśuddhena manasā durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥19॥
slp1: ye SrAdDAni ca kurvanti tiTyAM tiTyAM prajArTinaH । suviSudDena manasA durgARyatitaranti te ॥19॥

text: ye krodhaṃ naiva kurvanti kruddhānsaṃśamayanti ca । na ca kupyanti bhṛtyebhyo durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥20॥
html:
ye krodhaṃ naiva kurvanti kruddhānsaṃśamayanti ca ।
na ca kupyanti bhṛtyebhyo durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥20॥
slp1: ye kroDaM nEva kurvanti krudDAnsaMSamayanti ca । na ca kupyanti BftyeByo durgARyatitaranti te ॥20॥

text: madhu māṃsaṃ ca ye nityaṃ varjayantīha mānavāḥ । janmaprabhṛti madyaṃ ca durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥21॥
html:
madhu māṃsaṃ ca ye nityaṃ varjayantīha mānavāḥ ।
janmaprabhṛti madyaṃ ca durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥21॥
slp1: maDu mAMsaM ca ye nityaM varjayantIha mAnavAH । janmapraBfti madyaM ca durgARyatitaranti te ॥21॥

text: yātrārthaṃ bhojanaṃ yeṣāṃ santānārthaṃ ca maithunam । vāksatyavacanārthāya durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥22॥
html:
yātrārthaṃ bhojanaṃ yeṣāṃ santānārthaṃ ca maithunam ।
vāksatyavacanārthāya durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥22॥
slp1: yAtrArTaM BojanaM yezAM santAnArTaM ca mETunam । vAksatyavacanArTAya durgARyatitaranti te ॥22॥

text: īśvaraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ jagataḥ prabhavāpyayam । bhaktā nārāyaṇaṃ ye ca durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥23॥
html:
īśvaraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ jagataḥ prabhavāpyayam ।
bhaktā nārāyaṇaṃ ye ca durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥23॥
slp1: ISvaraM sarvaBUtAnAM jagataH praBavApyayam । BaktA nArAyaRaM ye ca durgARyatitaranti te ॥23॥

text: ya eṣa raktapadmākṣaḥ pītavāsā mahābhujaḥ । suhṛdbhrātā ca mitraṃ ca saṃbandhī ca tavācyutaḥ ॥24॥
html:
ya eṣa raktapadmākṣaḥ pītavāsā mahābhujaḥ ।
suhṛdbhrātā ca mitraṃ ca saṃbandhī ca tavācyutaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: ya eza raktapadmAkzaH pItavAsA mahABujaH । suhfdBrAtA ca mitraM ca saMbanDI ca tavAcyutaH ॥24॥

text: ya imānsakalāṁllokāṃścarmavatpariveṣṭayet । icchanprabhuracintyātmā govindaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥25॥
html:
ya imānsakalāṁllokāṃścarmavatpariveṣṭayet ।
icchanprabhuracintyātmā govindaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: ya imAnsakalAṁllokAMScarmavatparivezwayet । icCanpraBuracintyAtmA govindaH puruzottamaH ॥25॥

text: sthitaḥ priyahite jiṣṇoḥ sa eṣa puruṣarṣabha । rājaṃstava ca durdharṣo vaikuṇṭhaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥26॥
html:
sthitaḥ priyahite jiṣṇoḥ sa eṣa puruṣarṣabha ।
rājaṃstava ca durdharṣo vaikuṇṭhaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: sTitaH priyahite jizRoH sa eza puruzarzaBa । rAjaMstava ca durDarzo vEkuRWaH puruzottamaH ॥26॥

text: ya enaṃ saṃśrayantīha bhaktyā nārāyaṇaṃ harim । te tarantīha durgāṇi na me'trāsti vicāraṇā ॥27॥
html:
ya enaṃ saṃśrayantīha bhaktyā nārāyaṇaṃ harim ।
te tarantīha durgāṇi na me'trāsti vicāraṇā ॥27॥
slp1: ya enaM saMSrayantIha BaktyA nArAyaRaM harim । te tarantIha durgARi na me'trAsti vicAraRA ॥27॥

text: durgātitaraṇaṃ ye ca paṭhanti śrāvayanti ca । pāṭhayanti ca viprebhyo durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥28॥
html:
durgātitaraṇaṃ ye ca paṭhanti śrāvayanti ca ।
pāṭhayanti ca viprebhyo durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥28॥
slp1: durgAtitaraRaM ye ca paWanti SrAvayanti ca । pAWayanti ca vipreByo durgARyatitaranti te ॥28॥

text: iti kṛtyasamuddeśaḥ kīrtitaste mayānagha । santaredyena durgāṇi paratreha ca mānavaḥ] ॥29॥
html:
iti kṛtyasamuddeśaḥ kīrtitaste mayānagha ।
santaredyena durgāṇi paratreha ca mānavaḥ] ॥29॥
slp1: iti kftyasamuddeSaH kIrtitaste mayAnaGa । santaredyena durgARi paratreha ca mAnavaH] ॥29॥

text: asaumyāḥ saumyarūpeṇa saumyāścāsaumyadarśinaḥ । īdṛśānpuruṣāṃstāta kathaṃ vidyāmahe vayam ॥1॥
html:
asaumyāḥ saumyarūpeṇa saumyāścāsaumyadarśinaḥ ।
īdṛśānpuruṣāṃstāta kathaṃ vidyāmahe vayam ॥1॥
slp1: asOmyAH sOmyarUpeRa sOmyAScAsOmyadarSinaH । IdfSAnpuruzAMstAta kaTaM vidyAmahe vayam ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । vyāghragomāyusaṃvādaṃ taṃ nibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
vyāghragomāyusaṃvādaṃ taṃ nibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । vyAGragomAyusaMvAdaM taM niboDa yuDizWira ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: purikāyāṃ puri purā śrīmatyāṃ pauriko nṛpaḥ । parahiṃsāruciḥ krūro babhūva puruṣādhamaḥ ॥3॥
html:
purikāyāṃ puri purā śrīmatyāṃ pauriko nṛpaḥ ।
parahiṃsāruciḥ krūro babhūva puruṣādhamaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: purikAyAM puri purA SrImatyAM pOriko nfpaH । parahiMsAruciH krUro baBUva puruzADamaH ॥3॥

text: sa tvāyuṣi parikṣīṇe jagāmānīpsitāṃ gatim । gomāyutvaṃ ca samprāpto dūṣitaḥ pūrvakarmaṇā ॥4॥
html:
sa tvāyuṣi parikṣīṇe jagāmānīpsitāṃ gatim ।
gomāyutvaṃ ca samprāpto dūṣitaḥ pūrvakarmaṇā ॥4॥
slp1: sa tvAyuzi parikzIRe jagAmAnIpsitAM gatim । gomAyutvaM ca samprApto dUzitaH pUrvakarmaRA ॥4॥

text: saṃsmṛtya pūrvajātiṃ sa nirvedaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ । na bhakṣayati māṃsāni parairupahṛtānyapi ॥5॥
html:
saṃsmṛtya pūrvajātiṃ sa nirvedaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ।
na bhakṣayati māṃsāni parairupahṛtānyapi ॥5॥
slp1: saMsmftya pUrvajAtiM sa nirvedaM paramaM gataH । na Bakzayati mAMsAni parErupahftAnyapi ॥5॥

text: ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūteṣu satyavāksudṛḍhavrataḥ । cakāra ca yathākāmamāhāraṃ patitaiḥ phalaiḥ ॥6॥
html:
ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūteṣu satyavāksudṛḍhavrataḥ ।
cakāra ca yathākāmamāhāraṃ patitaiḥ phalaiḥ ॥6॥
slp1: ahiMsraH sarvaBUtezu satyavAksudfQavrataH । cakAra ca yaTAkAmamAhAraM patitEH PalEH ॥6॥

text: śmaśāne tasya cāvāso gomāyoḥ sammato'bhavat । janmabhūmyanurodhācca nānyadvāsamarocayat ॥7॥
html:
śmaśāne tasya cāvāso gomāyoḥ sammato'bhavat ।
janmabhūmyanurodhācca nānyadvāsamarocayat ॥7॥
slp1: SmaSAne tasya cAvAso gomAyoH sammato'Bavat । janmaBUmyanuroDAcca nAnyadvAsamarocayat ॥7॥

text: tasya śaucamamṛṣyantaḥ sarve te sahajātayaḥ । cālayanti sma tāṃ buddhiṃ vacanaiḥ praśrayottaraiḥ ॥8॥
html:
tasya śaucamamṛṣyantaḥ sarve te sahajātayaḥ ।
cālayanti sma tāṃ buddhiṃ vacanaiḥ praśrayottaraiḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tasya SOcamamfzyantaH sarve te sahajAtayaH । cAlayanti sma tAM budDiM vacanEH praSrayottarEH ॥8॥

text: vasanpitṛvane raudre śaucaṃ lapsitumicchasi । iyaṃ vipratipattiste yadā tvaṃ piśitāśanaḥ ॥9॥
html:
vasanpitṛvane raudre śaucaṃ lapsitumicchasi ।
iyaṃ vipratipattiste yadā tvaṃ piśitāśanaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: vasanpitfvane rOdre SOcaM lapsitumicCasi । iyaM vipratipattiste yadA tvaM piSitASanaH ॥9॥

text: tatsamo vā bhavāsmābhirbhakṣyāndāsyāmahe vayam । bhuṅkṣva śaucaṃ parityajya yaddhi bhuktaṃ tadasti te ॥10॥
html:
tatsamo vā bhavāsmābhirbhakṣyāndāsyāmahe vayam ।
bhuṅkṣva śaucaṃ parityajya yaddhi bhuktaṃ tadasti te ॥10॥
slp1: tatsamo vA BavAsmABirBakzyAndAsyAmahe vayam । BuNkzva SOcaM parityajya yadDi BuktaM tadasti te ॥10॥

text: iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā pratyuvāca samāhitaḥ । madhuraiḥ praśritairvākyairhetumadbhiraniṣṭhuraiḥ ॥11॥
html:
iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā pratyuvāca samāhitaḥ ।
madhuraiḥ praśritairvākyairhetumadbhiraniṣṭhuraiḥ ॥11॥
slp1: iti tezAM vacaH SrutvA pratyuvAca samAhitaH । maDurEH praSritErvAkyErhetumadBiranizWurEH ॥11॥

text: apramāṇaṃ prasūtirme śīlataḥ kriyate kulam । prārthayiṣye tu tatkarma yena vistīryate yaśaḥ ॥12॥
html:
apramāṇaṃ prasūtirme śīlataḥ kriyate kulam ।
prārthayiṣye tu tatkarma yena vistīryate yaśaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: apramARaM prasUtirme SIlataH kriyate kulam । prArTayizye tu tatkarma yena vistIryate yaSaH ॥12॥

text: śmaśāne yadi vāso me samādhirme niśāmyatām । ātmā phalati karmāṇi nāśramo dharmalakṣaṇam ॥13॥
html:
śmaśāne yadi vāso me samādhirme niśāmyatām ।
ātmā phalati karmāṇi nāśramo dharmalakṣaṇam ॥13॥
slp1: SmaSAne yadi vAso me samADirme niSAmyatAm । AtmA Palati karmARi nASramo DarmalakzaRam ॥13॥

text: āśrame yo dvijaṃ hanyādgāṃ vā dadyādanāśrame । kiṃ nu tatpātakaṃ na syāttadvā dattaṃ vṛthā bhavet ॥14॥
html:
āśrame yo dvijaṃ hanyādgāṃ vā dadyādanāśrame ।
kiṃ nu tatpātakaṃ na syāttadvā dattaṃ vṛthā bhavet ॥14॥
slp1: ASrame yo dvijaM hanyAdgAM vA dadyAdanASrame । kiM nu tatpAtakaM na syAttadvA dattaM vfTA Bavet ॥14॥

text: bhavantaḥ sarvalobhena kevalaṃ bhakṣaṇe ratāḥ । anubandhe tu ye doṣāstānna paśyanti mohitāḥ ॥15॥
html:
bhavantaḥ sarvalobhena kevalaṃ bhakṣaṇe ratāḥ ।
anubandhe tu ye doṣāstānna paśyanti mohitāḥ ॥15॥
slp1: BavantaH sarvaloBena kevalaM BakzaRe ratAH । anubanDe tu ye dozAstAnna paSyanti mohitAH ॥15॥

text: apratyayakṛtāṃ garhyāmarthāpanayadūṣitām । iha cāmutra cāniṣṭāṃ tasmādvṛttiṃ na rocaye ॥16॥
html:
apratyayakṛtāṃ garhyāmarthāpanayadūṣitām ।
iha cāmutra cāniṣṭāṃ tasmādvṛttiṃ na rocaye ॥16॥
slp1: apratyayakftAM garhyAmarTApanayadUzitAm । iha cAmutra cAnizwAM tasmAdvfttiM na rocaye ॥16॥

text: taṃ śuciṃ paṇḍitaṃ matvā śārdūlaḥ khyātavikramaḥ । kṛtvātmasadṛśāṃ pūjāṃ sācivye'vardhayatsvayam ॥17॥
html:
taṃ śuciṃ paṇḍitaṃ matvā śārdūlaḥ khyātavikramaḥ ।
kṛtvātmasadṛśāṃ pūjāṃ sācivye'vardhayatsvayam ॥17॥
slp1: taM SuciM paRqitaM matvA SArdUlaH KyAtavikramaH । kftvAtmasadfSAM pUjAM sAcivye'varDayatsvayam ॥17॥

text: saumya vijñātarūpastvaṃ gaccha yātrāṃ mayā saha । vriyantāmīpsitā bhogāḥ parihāryāśca puṣkalāḥ ॥18॥
html:
saumya vijñātarūpastvaṃ gaccha yātrāṃ mayā saha ।
vriyantāmīpsitā bhogāḥ parihāryāśca puṣkalāḥ ॥18॥
slp1: sOmya vijYAtarUpastvaM gacCa yAtrAM mayA saha । vriyantAmIpsitA BogAH parihAryASca puzkalAH ॥18॥

text: tīkṣṇā vayamiti khyātā bhavato jñāpayāmahe । mṛdupūrvaṃ ghātinaste śreyaścādhigamiṣyati ॥19॥
html:
tīkṣṇā vayamiti khyātā bhavato jñāpayāmahe ।
mṛdupūrvaṃ ghātinaste śreyaścādhigamiṣyati ॥19॥
slp1: tIkzRA vayamiti KyAtA Bavato jYApayAmahe । mfdupUrvaM GAtinaste SreyaScADigamizyati ॥19॥

text: atha sampūjya tadvākyaṃ mṛgendrasya mahātmanaḥ । gomāyuḥ praśritaṃ vākyaṃ babhāṣe kiñcidānataḥ ॥20॥
html:
atha sampūjya tadvākyaṃ mṛgendrasya mahātmanaḥ ।
gomāyuḥ praśritaṃ vākyaṃ babhāṣe kiñcidānataḥ ॥20॥
slp1: aTa sampUjya tadvAkyaM mfgendrasya mahAtmanaH । gomAyuH praSritaM vAkyaM baBAze kiYcidAnataH ॥20॥

text: sadṛśaṃ mṛgarājaitattava vākyaṃ madantare । yatsahāyānmṛgayase dharmārthakuśalāñśucīn ॥21॥
html:
sadṛśaṃ mṛgarājaitattava vākyaṃ madantare ।
yatsahāyānmṛgayase dharmārthakuśalāñśucīn ॥21॥
slp1: sadfSaM mfgarAjEtattava vAkyaM madantare । yatsahAyAnmfgayase DarmArTakuSalAYSucIn ॥21॥

text: na śakyamanamātyena mahattvamanuśāsitum । duṣṭāmātyena vā vīra śarīraparipanthinā ॥22॥
html:
na śakyamanamātyena mahattvamanuśāsitum ।
duṣṭāmātyena vā vīra śarīraparipanthinā ॥22॥
slp1: na SakyamanamAtyena mahattvamanuSAsitum । duzwAmAtyena vA vIra SarIraparipanTinA ॥22॥

text: sahāyānanuraktāṃstu yatetānupasaṃhitān । parasparamasaṅghuṣṭānvijigīṣūnalolupān ॥23॥
html:
sahāyānanuraktāṃstu yatetānupasaṃhitān ।
parasparamasaṅghuṣṭānvijigīṣūnalolupān ॥23॥

text: kiṃ tu svenāsmi santuṣṭo duḥkhā vṛttiranuṣṭhitā । sevāyāścāpi nābhijñaḥ svacchandena vanecaraḥ ॥29॥

html:

pānīyaṃ vā nirāyāsaṃ svādvannaṃ vā bhayottaram ।

text: aparādhairna tāvanto bhṛtyāḥ śiṣṭā narādhipaiḥ । upaghātairyathā bhṛtyā dūṣitā nidhanaṃ gatāḥ ॥33॥
html:

html:

text: eka ekena saṅgamya raho brūyāṃ hitaṃ tava । na ca te jñātikāryeṣu praṣṭavyo'haṃ hitāhite ॥37॥
html:

text: mayā saṃmantrya paścācca na hiṃsyāḥ sacivāstvayā । madīyānāṃ ca kupito mā tvaṃ daṇḍaṃ nipātayeḥ ॥38॥
html:

html:

parīkṣya jñāpayanhyarthānna paścātparitapyate ॥63॥
slp1: tasmAtpratyakzadfzwo'pi yuktamarTaH parIkzitum । parIkzya jYApayanhyarTAnna paScAtparitapyate ॥63॥

text: na duṣkaramidaṃ putra yatprabhurghātayetparam । ślāghanīyā ca varyā ca loke prabhavatāṃ kṣamā ॥64॥
html:
na duṣkaramidaṃ putra yatprabhurghātayetparam ।
ślāghanīyā ca varyā ca loke prabhavatāṃ kṣamā ॥64॥
slp1: na duzkaramidaM putra yatpraBurGAtayetparam । SlAGanIyA ca varyA ca loke praBavatAM kzamA ॥64॥

text: sthāpito'yaṃ putra tvayā sāmanteṣvadhi viśrutaḥ । duḥkhenāsādyate pātraṃ dhāryatāmeṣa te suhṛt ॥65॥
html:
sthāpito'yaṃ putra tvayā sāmanteṣvadhi viśrutaḥ ।
duḥkhenāsādyate pātraṃ dhāryatāmeṣa te suhṛt ॥65॥
slp1: sTApito'yaM putra tvayA sAmantezvaDi viSrutaH । duHKenAsAdyate pAtraM DAryatAmeza te suhft ॥65॥

text: dūṣitaṃ paradoṣairhi gṛhṇīte yo'nyathā śucim । svayaṃ sandūṣitāmātyaḥ kṣiprameva vinaśyati ॥66॥
html:
dūṣitaṃ paradoṣairhi gṛhṇīte yo'nyathā śucim ।
svayaṃ sandūṣitāmātyaḥ kṣiprameva vinaśyati ॥66॥
slp1: dUzitaM paradozErhi gfhRIte yo'nyaTA Sucim । svayaM sandUzitAmAtyaH kziprameva vinaSyati ॥66॥

text: tasmādathārisaṅghātādgomāyoḥ kaścidāgataḥ । dharmātmā tena cākhyātaṃ yathaitatkapaṭaṃ kṛtam ॥67॥
html:
tasmādathārisaṅghātādgomāyoḥ kaścidāgataḥ ।
dharmātmā tena cākhyātaṃ yathaitatkapaṭaṃ kṛtam ॥67॥
slp1: tasmAdaTArisaNGAtAdgomAyoH kaScidAgataH । DarmAtmA tena cAKyAtaM yaTEtatkapawaM kftam ॥67॥

text: tato vijñātacāritraḥ satkṛtya sa vimokṣitaḥ । pariṣvaktaśca sasnehaṃ mṛgendreṇa punaḥ punaḥ ॥68॥
html:
tato vijñātacāritraḥ satkṛtya sa vimokṣitaḥ ।
pariṣvaktaśca sasnehaṃ mṛgendreṇa punaḥ punaḥ ॥68॥
slp1: tato vijYAtacAritraH satkftya sa vimokzitaH । parizvaktaSca sasnehaM mfgendreRa punaH punaH ॥68॥

text: anujñāpya mṛgendraṃ tu gomāyurnītiśāstravit । tenāmarṣeṇa santaptaḥ prāyamāsitumaicchata ॥69॥
html:
anujñāpya mṛgendraṃ tu gomāyurnītiśāstravit ।
tenāmarṣeṇa santaptaḥ prāyamāsitumaicchata ॥69॥
slp1: anujYApya mfgendraM tu gomAyurnItiSAstravit । tenAmarzeRa santaptaH prAyamAsitumEcCata ॥69॥

text: śārdūlastatra gomāyuṃ snehātprasrutalocanaḥ । avārayatsa dharmiṣṭhaṃ pūjayā pratipūjayan ॥70॥
html:
śārdūlastatra gomāyuṃ snehātprasrutalocanaḥ ।
avārayatsa dharmiṣṭhaṃ pūjayā pratipūjayan ॥70॥
slp1: SArdUlastatra gomAyuM snehAtprasrutalocanaH । avArayatsa DarmizWaM pUjayA pratipUjayan ॥70॥

text: taṃ sa gomāyurālokya snehādāgatasambhramam । babhāṣe praṇato vākyaṃ bāṣpagadgadayā girā ॥71॥
html:
taṃ sa gomāyurālokya snehādāgatasambhramam ।
babhāṣe praṇato vākyaṃ bāṣpagadgadayā girā ॥71॥
slp1: taM sa gomAyurAlokya snehAdAgatasamBramam । baBAze praRato vAkyaM bAzpagadgadayA girA ॥71॥

text: pūjito'haṃ tvayā pūrvaṃ paścāccaiva vimānitaḥ । pareṣāmāspadaṃ nīto vastuṃ nārhāmyahaṃ tvayi ॥72॥
html:
pūjito'haṃ tvayā pūrvaṃ paścāccaiva vimānitaḥ ।
pareṣāmāspadaṃ nīto vastuṃ nārhāmyahaṃ tvayi ॥72॥
slp1: pUjito'haM tvayA pUrvaM paScAccEva vimAnitaH । parezAmAspadaM nIto vastuM nArhAmyahaM tvayi ॥72॥

text: svasantuṣṭāścyutāḥ sthānānmānātpratyavaropitāḥ । svayaṃ copahṛtā bhṛtyā ye cāpyupahṛtāḥ paraiḥ ॥73॥
html:
svasantuṣṭāścyutāḥ sthānānmānātpratyavaropitāḥ ।
svayaṃ copahṛtā bhṛtyā ye cāpyupahṛtāḥ paraiḥ ॥73॥
slp1: svasantuzwAScyutAH sTAnAnmAnAtpratyavaropitAH । svayaM copahftA BftyA ye cApyupahftAH parEH ॥73॥

text: parikṣīṇāśca lubdhāśca krūrāḥ kārābhitāpitāḥ । hṛtasvā mānino ye ca tyaktopāttā mahepsavaḥ ॥74॥
html:
parikṣīṇāśca lubdhāśca krūrāḥ kārābhitāpitāḥ ।
hṛtasvā mānino ye ca tyaktopāttā mahepsavaḥ ॥74॥
slp1: parikzIRASca lubDASca krUrAH kArABitApitAH । hftasvA mAnino ye ca tyaktopAttA mahepsavaH ॥74॥

text: santāpitāśca ye kecidvyasanaughapratīkṣiṇaḥ । antarhitāḥ sopahitāḥ sarve te parasādhanāḥ ॥75॥
html:
santāpitāśca ye kecidvyasanaughapratīkṣiṇaḥ ।
antarhitāḥ sopahitāḥ sarve te parasādhanāḥ ॥75॥
slp1: santApitASca ye kecidvyasanOGapratIkziRaH । antarhitAH sopahitAH sarve te parasADanAH ॥75॥

text: avamānena yuktasya sthāpitasya ca me punaḥ । kathaṃ yāsyasi viśvāsamahameṣyāmi vā punaḥ ॥76॥
html:
avamānena yuktasya sthāpitasya ca me punaḥ ।
kathaṃ yāsyasi viśvāsamahameṣyāmi vā punaḥ ॥76॥
slp1: avamAnena yuktasya sTApitasya ca me punaH । kaTaM yAsyasi viSvAsamahamezyAmi vA punaH ॥76॥

text: samartha iti saṅgṛhya sthāpayitvā parīkṣya ca । kṛtaṃ ca samayaṃ bhittvā tvayāhamavamānitaḥ ॥77॥
html:
samartha iti saṅgṛhya sthāpayitvā parīkṣya ca ।
kṛtaṃ ca samayaṃ bhittvā tvayāhamavamānitaḥ ॥77॥
slp1: samarTa iti saNgfhya sTApayitvA parIkzya ca । kftaM ca samayaM BittvA tvayAhamavamAnitaH ॥77॥

text: prathamaṃ yaḥ samākhyātaḥ śīlavāniti saṃsadi । na vācyaṃ tasya vaiguṇyaṃ pratijñāṃ parirakṣatā ॥78॥
html:
prathamaṃ yaḥ samākhyātaḥ śīlavāniti saṃsadi ।
na vācyaṃ tasya vaiguṇyaṃ pratijñāṃ parirakṣatā ॥78॥
slp1: praTamaM yaH samAKyAtaH SIlavAniti saMsadi । na vAcyaM tasya vEguRyaM pratijYAM parirakzatA ॥78॥

text: evaṃ cāvamatasyeha viśvāsaṃ kiṃ prayāsyasi । tvayi caiva hyaviśvāse mamodvego bhaviṣyati ॥79॥
html:
evaṃ cāvamatasyeha viśvāsaṃ kiṃ prayāsyasi ।
tvayi caiva hyaviśvāse mamodvego bhaviṣyati ॥79॥
slp1: evaM cAvamatasyeha viSvAsaM kiM prayAsyasi । tvayi cEva hyaviSvAse mamodvego Bavizyati ॥79॥

text: śaṅkitastvamahaṃ bhītaḥ pare chidrānudarśinaḥ । asnigdhāścaiva dustoṣāḥ karma caitadbahucchalam ॥80॥
html:
śaṅkitastvamahaṃ bhītaḥ pare chidrānudarśinaḥ ।
asnigdhāścaiva dustoṣāḥ karma caitadbahucchalam ॥80॥
slp1: SaNkitastvamahaM BItaH pare CidrAnudarSinaH । asnigDAScEva dustozAH karma cEtadbahucCalam ॥80॥

text: duḥkhena śleṣyate bhinnaṃ śliṣṭaṃ duḥkhena bhidyate । bhinnaśliṣṭā tu yā prītirna sā snehena vartate ॥81॥
html:
duḥkhena śleṣyate bhinnaṃ śliṣṭaṃ duḥkhena bhidyate ।
bhinnaśliṣṭā tu yā prītirna sā snehena vartate ॥81॥
slp1: duHKena Slezyate BinnaM SlizwaM duHKena Bidyate । BinnaSlizwA tu yA prItirna sA snehena vartate ॥81॥

text: kaścideva hi bhītastu dṛśyate na parātmanoḥ । kāryāpekṣā hi vartante bhāvāḥ snigdhāstu durlabhāḥ ॥82॥
html:
kaścideva hi bhītastu dṛśyate na parātmanoḥ ।
kāryāpekṣā hi vartante bhāvāḥ snigdhāstu durlabhāḥ ॥82॥
slp1: kaScideva hi BItastu dfSyate na parAtmanoH । kAryApekzA hi vartante BAvAH snigDAstu durlaBAH ॥82॥

text: suduḥkhaṃ puruṣajñānaṃ cittaṃ hyeṣāṃ calācalam । samartho vāpyaśakto vā śateṣveko'dhigamyate ॥83॥
html:
suduḥkhaṃ puruṣajñānaṃ cittaṃ hyeṣāṃ calācalam ।
samartho vāpyaśakto vā śateṣveko'dhigamyate ॥83॥
slp1: suduHKaM puruzajYAnaM cittaM hyezAM calAcalam । samarTo vApyaSakto vA Satezveko'Digamyate ॥83॥

text: akasmātprakriyā nṝṇāmakasmāccāpakarṣaṇam । śubhāśubhe mahattvaṃ ca prakartuṃ buddhilāghavāt ॥84॥
html:
akasmātprakriyā nṝṇāmakasmāccāpakarṣaṇam ।
śubhāśubhe mahattvaṃ ca prakartuṃ buddhilāghavāt ॥84॥
slp1: akasmAtprakriyA nFRAmakasmAccApakarzaRam । SuBASuBe mahattvaM ca prakartuM budDilAGavAt ॥84॥

text: evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ sāntvamuktvā dharmārthahetumat । prasādayitvā rājānaṃ gomāyurvanamabhyagāt ॥85॥
html:
evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ sāntvamuktvā dharmārthahetumat ।
prasādayitvā rājānaṃ gomāyurvanamabhyagāt ॥85॥
slp1: evaM bahuviDaM sAntvamuktvA DarmArTahetumat । prasAdayitvA rAjAnaM gomAyurvanamaByagAt ॥85॥

text: agṛhyānunayaṃ tasya mṛgendrasya sa buddhimān । gomāyuḥ prāyamāsīnastyaktvā dehaṃ divaṃ yayau] ॥86॥
html:
agṛhyānunayaṃ tasya mṛgendrasya sa buddhimān ।
gomāyuḥ prāyamāsīnastyaktvā dehaṃ divaṃ yayau] ॥86॥
slp1: agfhyAnunayaM tasya mfgendrasya sa budDimAn । gomAyuH prAyamAsInastyaktvA dehaM divaM yayO] ॥86॥

text: kiṃ pārthivena kartavyaṃ kiṃ ca kṛtvā sukhī bhavet । tanmamācakṣva tattvena sarvaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ vara ॥1॥
html:
kiṃ pārthivena kartavyaṃ kiṃ ca kṛtvā sukhī bhavet ।
tanmamācakṣva tattvena sarvaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ vara ॥1॥
slp1: kiM pArTivena kartavyaM kiM ca kftvA suKI Bavet । tanmamAcakzva tattvena sarvaM DarmaBftAM vara ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: hanta te'haṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu kāryaikaniścayam । yathā rājñeha kartavyaṃ yacca kṛtvā sukhī bhavet ॥2॥
html:
hanta te'haṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu kāryaikaniścayam ।
yathā rājñeha kartavyaṃ yacca kṛtvā sukhī bhavet ॥2॥
slp1: hanta te'haM pravakzyAmi SfRu kAryEkaniScayam । yaTA rAjYeha kartavyaM yacca kftvA suKI Bavet ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: na tvevaṃ vartitavyaṃ sma yathedamanuśuśrumaḥ । uṣṭrasya sumahadvṛttaṃ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥3॥
html:
na tvevaṃ vartitavyaṃ sma yathedamanuśuśrumaḥ ।
uṣṭrasya sumahadvṛttaṃ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥3॥
slp1: na tvevaM vartitavyaM sma yaTedamanuSuSrumaH । uzwrasya sumahadvfttaM tanniboDa yuDizWira ॥3॥

text: jātismaro mahānuṣṭraḥ prājāpatyayugodbhavaḥ । tapaḥ sumahadātiṣṭhadaraṇye saṃśitavrataḥ ॥4॥
html:
jātismaro mahānuṣṭraḥ prājāpatyayugodbhavaḥ ।
tapaḥ sumahadātiṣṭhadaraṇye saṃśitavrataḥ ॥4॥
slp1: jAtismaro mahAnuzwraH prAjApatyayugodBavaH । tapaH sumahadAtizWadaraRye saMSitavrataH ॥4॥

text: tapasastasya cānte vai prītimānabhavatprabhuḥ । vareṇa chandayāmāsa tataścainaṃ pitāmahaḥ ॥5॥
html:
tapasastasya cānte vai prītimānabhavatprabhuḥ ।
vareṇa chandayāmāsa tataścainaṃ pitāmahaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: tapasastasya cAnte vE prItimAnaBavatpraBuH । vareRa CandayAmAsa tataScEnaM pitAmahaH ॥5॥

text: bhagavaṃstvatprasādānme dīrghā grīvā bhavediyam । yojanānāṃ śataṃ sāgraṃ yā gaccheccarituṃ vibho ॥6॥
html:
bhagavaṃstvatprasādānme dīrghā grīvā bhavediyam ।
yojanānāṃ śataṃ sāgraṃ yā gaccheccarituṃ vibho ॥6॥
slp1: BagavaMstvatprasAdAnme dIrGA grIvA Bavediyam । yojanAnAM SataM sAgraM yA gacCeccarituM viBo ॥6॥
author: uṣṭra uvāca ।

text: evamastviti coktaḥ sa varadena mahātmanā । pratilabhya varaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yayāvuṣṭraḥ svakaṃ vanam ॥7॥
html:
evamastviti coktaḥ sa varadena mahātmanā ।
pratilabhya varaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yayāvuṣṭraḥ svakaṃ vanam ॥7॥
slp1: evamastviti coktaH sa varadena mahAtmanA । pratilaBya varaM SrezWaM yayAvuzwraH svakaM vanam ॥7॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sa cakāra tadālasyaṃ varadānātsa durmatiḥ । na caicchaccarituṃ gantuṃ durātmā kālamohitaḥ ॥8॥
html:
sa cakāra tadālasyaṃ varadānātsa durmatiḥ ।
na caicchaccarituṃ gantuṃ durātmā kālamohitaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: sa cakAra tadAlasyaM varadAnAtsa durmatiH । na cEcCaccarituM gantuM durAtmA kAlamohitaH ॥8॥

text: sa kadācitprasāryaivaṃ tāṃ grīvāṃ śatayojanām । cacārāśrāntahṛdayo vātaścāgāttato mahān ॥9॥
html:
sa kadācitprasāryaivaṃ tāṃ grīvāṃ śatayojanām ।
cacārāśrāntahṛdayo vātaścāgāttato mahān ॥9॥
slp1: sa kadAcitprasAryEvaM tAM grIvAM SatayojanAm । cacArASrAntahfdayo vAtaScAgAttato mahAn ॥9॥

text: sa guhāyāṃ śirogrīvaṃ nidhāya paśurātmanaḥ । āstātha varṣamabhyāgātsumahatplāvayajjagat ॥10॥
html:
sa guhāyāṃ śirogrīvaṃ nidhāya paśurātmanaḥ ।
āstātha varṣamabhyāgātsumahatplāvayajjagat ॥10॥
slp1: sa guhAyAM SirogrIvaM niDAya paSurAtmanaH । AstATa varzamaByAgAtsumahatplAvayajjagat ॥10॥

text: atha śītaparītāṅgo jambukaḥ kṣucchramānvitaḥ । sadārastāṃ guhāmāśu praviveśa jalārditaḥ ॥11॥
html:
atha śītaparītāṅgo jambukaḥ kṣucchramānvitaḥ ।
sadārastāṃ guhāmāśu praviveśa jalārditaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: aTa SItaparItANgo jambukaH kzucCramAnvitaH । sadArastAM guhAmASu praviveSa jalArditaH ॥11॥

text: sa dṛṣṭvā māṃsajīvī tu subhṛśaṃ kṣucchramānvitaḥ । abhakṣayattato grīvāmuṣṭrasya bharatarṣabha ॥12॥
html:
sa dṛṣṭvā māṃsajīvī tu subhṛśaṃ kṣucchramānvitaḥ ।
abhakṣayattato grīvāmuṣṭrasya bharatarṣabha ॥12॥
slp1: sa dfzwvA mAMsajIvI tu suBfSaM kzucCramAnvitaH । aBakzayattato grIvAmuzwrasya BaratarzaBa ॥12॥

text: yadā tvabudhyatātmānaṃ bhakṣyamāṇaṃ sa vai paśuḥ । tadā saṅkocane yatnamakarodbhṛśaduḥkhitaḥ ॥13॥
html:
yadā tvabudhyatātmānaṃ bhakṣyamāṇaṃ sa vai paśuḥ ।
tadā saṅkocane yatnamakarodbhṛśaduḥkhitaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: yadA tvabuDyatAtmAnaM BakzyamARaM sa vE paSuH । tadA saNkocane yatnamakarodBfSaduHKitaH ॥13॥

text: yāvadūrdhvamadhaścaiva grīvāṃ saṅkṣipate paśuḥ । tāvattena sadāreṇa jambukena sa bhakṣitaḥ ॥14॥
html:
yāvadūrdhvamadhaścaiva grīvāṃ saṅkṣipate paśuḥ ।
tāvattena sadāreṇa jambukena sa bhakṣitaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: yAvadUrDvamaDaScEva grIvAM saNkzipate paSuH । tAvattena sadAreRa jambukena sa BakzitaH ॥14॥

text: sa hatvā bhakṣayitvā ca jambukoṣṭraṃ tatastadā । vigate vātavarṣe ca niścakrāma guhāmukhāt ॥15॥
html:
sa hatvā bhakṣayitvā ca jambukoṣṭraṃ tatastadā ।
vigate vātavarṣe ca niścakrāma guhāmukhāt ॥15॥
slp1: sa hatvA BakzayitvA ca jambukozwraM tatastadA । vigate vAtavarze ca niScakrAma guhAmuKAt ॥15॥

text: evaṃ durbuddhinā prāptamuṣṭreṇa nidhanaṃ tadā । ālasyasya kramātpaśya mahaddoṣamupāgatam ॥16॥
html:
evaṃ durbuddhinā prāptamuṣṭreṇa nidhanaṃ tadā ।
ālasyasya kramātpaśya mahaddoṣamupāgatam ॥16॥
slp1: evaM durbudDinA prAptamuzwreRa niDanaM tadA । Alasyasya kramAtpaSya mahaddozamupAgatam ॥16॥

text: tvamapyetaṃ vidhiṃ tyaktvā yogena niyatendriyaḥ । vartasva buddhimūlaṃ hi vijayaṃ manurabravīt ॥17॥
html:
tvamapyetaṃ vidhiṃ tyaktvā yogena niyatendriyaḥ ।
vartasva buddhimūlaṃ hi vijayaṃ manurabravīt ॥17॥
slp1: tvamapyetaM viDiM tyaktvA yogena niyatendriyaH । vartasva budDimUlaM hi vijayaM manurabravIt ॥17॥

text: buddhiśreṣṭhāni karmāṇi bāhumadhyāni bhārata । tāni jaṅghājaghanyāni bhārapratyavarāṇi ca ॥18॥
html:
buddhiśreṣṭhāni karmāṇi bāhumadhyāni bhārata ।
tāni jaṅghājaghanyāni bhārapratyavarāṇi ca ॥18॥
slp1: budDiSrezWAni karmARi bAhumaDyAni BArata । tAni jaNGAjaGanyAni BArapratyavarARi ca ॥18॥

text: rājyaṃ tiṣṭhati dakṣasya saṅgṛhītendriyasya ca । guptamantraśrutavataḥ susahāyasya cānagha ॥19॥
html:
rājyaṃ tiṣṭhati dakṣasya saṅgṛhītendriyasya ca ।
guptamantraśrutavataḥ susahāyasya cānagha ॥19॥
slp1: rAjyaM tizWati dakzasya saNgfhItendriyasya ca । guptamantraSrutavataH susahAyasya cAnaGa ॥19॥

text: parīkṣyakāriṇo'rthāśca tiṣṭhantīha yudhiṣṭhira । sahāyayuktena mahī kṛtsnā śakyā praśāsitum ॥20॥
html:
parīkṣyakāriṇo'rthāśca tiṣṭhantīha yudhiṣṭhira ।
sahāyayuktena mahī kṛtsnā śakyā praśāsitum ॥20॥
slp1: parIkzyakAriRo'rTASca tizWantIha yuDizWira । sahAyayuktena mahI kftsnA SakyA praSAsitum ॥20॥

text: idaṃ hi sadbhiḥ kathitaṃ vidhijñaiḥ purā mahendrapratimaprabhāva । mayāpi coktaṃ tava śāstradṛṣṭyā tvamatra yuktaḥ pracarasva rājan] ॥21॥
html:
idaṃ hi sadbhiḥ kathitaṃ vidhijñaiḥ purā mahendrapratimaprabhāva ।
mayāpi coktaṃ tava śāstradṛṣṭyā tvamatra yuktaḥ pracarasva rājan] ॥21॥
slp1: idaM hi sadBiH kaTitaM viDijYEH purA mahendrapratimapraBAva । mayApi coktaM tava SAstradfzwyA tvamatra yuktaH pracarasva rAjan] ॥21॥

text: rājā rājyamanuprāpya durbalo bharatarṣabha । amitrasyātivṛddhasya kathaṃ tiṣṭhedasādhanaḥ ॥1॥
html:
rājā rājyamanuprāpya durbalo bharatarṣabha ।
amitrasyātivṛddhasya kathaṃ tiṣṭhedasādhanaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: rAjA rAjyamanuprApya durbalo BaratarzaBa । amitrasyAtivfdDasya kaTaM tizWedasADanaH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । saritāṃ caiva saṃvādaṃ sāgarasya ca bhārata ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
saritāṃ caiva saṃvādaṃ sāgarasya ca bhārata ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । saritAM cEva saMvAdaM sAgarasya ca BArata ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: surārinilayaḥ śaśvatsāgaraḥ saritāṃ patiḥ । papraccha saritaḥ sarvāḥ saṃśayaṃ jātamātmanaḥ ॥3॥
html:
surārinilayaḥ śaśvatsāgaraḥ saritāṃ patiḥ ।
papraccha saritaḥ sarvāḥ saṃśayaṃ jātamātmanaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: surArinilayaH SaSvatsAgaraH saritAM patiH । papracCa saritaH sarvAH saMSayaM jAtamAtmanaH ॥3॥

text: samūlaśākhānpaśyāmi nihatāṃśchāyino drumān । yuṣmābhiriha pūrṇābhiranyāṃstatra na vetasam ॥4॥
html:
samūlaśākhānpaśyāmi nihatāṃśchāyino drumān ।
yuṣmābhiriha pūrṇābhiranyāṃstatra na vetasam ॥4॥
slp1: samUlaSAKAnpaSyAmi nihatAMSCAyino drumAn । yuzmABiriha pUrRABiranyAMstatra na vetasam ॥4॥

text: akāyaścālpasāraśca vetasaḥ kūlajaśca vaḥ । avajñāya na śakyo vā kiñcidvā tena vaḥ kṛtam ॥5॥
html:
akāyaścālpasāraśca vetasaḥ kūlajaśca vaḥ ।
avajñāya na śakyo vā kiñcidvā tena vaḥ kṛtam ॥5॥
slp1: akAyaScAlpasAraSca vetasaH kUlajaSca vaH । avajYAya na Sakyo vA kiYcidvA tena vaH kftam ॥5॥

text: tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi sarvāsāmeva vo matam । yathā kūlāni cemāni bhittvā nānīyate vaśam ॥6॥
html:
tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi sarvāsāmeva vo matam ।
yathā kūlāni cemāni bhittvā nānīyate vaśam ॥6॥
slp1: tadahaM SrotumicCAmi sarvAsAmeva vo matam । yaTA kUlAni cemAni BittvA nAnIyate vaSam ॥6॥

text: tataḥ prāha nadī gaṅgā vākyamuttaramarthavat । hetumadgrāhakaṃ caiva sāgaraṃ saritāṃ patim ॥7॥
html:
tataḥ prāha nadī gaṅgā vākyamuttaramarthavat ।
hetumadgrāhakaṃ caiva sāgaraṃ saritāṃ patim ॥7॥
slp1: tataH prAha nadI gaNgA vAkyamuttaramarTavat । hetumadgrAhakaM cEva sAgaraM saritAM patim ॥7॥

text: tiṣṭhantyete yathāsthānaṃ nagā hyekaniketanāḥ । tatastyajanti tatsthānaṃ prātilomyādacetasaḥ ॥8॥
html:
tiṣṭhantyete yathāsthānaṃ nagā hyekaniketanāḥ ।
tatastyajanti tatsthānaṃ prātilomyādacetasaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tizWantyete yaTAsTAnaM nagA hyekaniketanAH । tatastyajanti tatsTAnaM prAtilomyAdacetasaH ॥8॥

text: vetaso vegamāyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā namati netaraḥ । sa ca vege'bhyatikrānte sthānamāsādya tiṣṭhati ॥9॥
html:
vetaso vegamāyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā namati netaraḥ ।
sa ca vege'bhyatikrānte sthānamāsādya tiṣṭhati ॥9॥
slp1: vetaso vegamAyAntaM dfzwvA namati netaraH । sa ca vege'ByatikrAnte sTAnamAsAdya tizWati ॥9॥

text: kālajñaḥ samayajñaśca sadā vaśyaśca nodrumaḥ । anulomastathāstabdhastena nābhyeti vetasaḥ ॥10॥
html:
kālajñaḥ samayajñaśca sadā vaśyaśca nodrumaḥ ।
anulomastathāstabdhastena nābhyeti vetasaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: kAlajYaH samayajYaSca sadA vaSyaSca nodrumaH । anulomastaTAstabDastena nAByeti vetasaH ॥10॥

text: mārutodakavegena ye namantyunnamanti ca । oṣadhyaḥ pādapā gulmā na te yānti parābhavam ॥11॥
html:
mārutodakavegena ye namantyunnamanti ca ।
oṣadhyaḥ pādapā gulmā na te yānti parābhavam ॥11॥
slp1: mArutodakavegena ye namantyunnamanti ca । ozaDyaH pAdapA gulmA na te yAnti parABavam ॥11॥

text: yo hi śatrorvivṛddhasya prabhorvadhavināśane । pūrvaṃ na sahate vegaṃ kṣiprameva sa naśyati ॥12॥
html:
yo hi śatrorvivṛddhasya prabhorvadhavināśane ।
pūrvaṃ na sahate vegaṃ kṣiprameva sa naśyati ॥12॥
slp1: yo hi SatrorvivfdDasya praBorvaDavinASane । pUrvaM na sahate vegaM kziprameva sa naSyati ॥12॥

text: sārāsāraṃ balaṃ vīryamātmano dviṣataśca yaḥ । jānanvicarati prājño na sa yāti parābhavam ॥13॥
html:
sārāsāraṃ balaṃ vīryamātmano dviṣataśca yaḥ ।
jānanvicarati prājño na sa yāti parābhavam ॥13॥
slp1: sArAsAraM balaM vIryamAtmano dvizataSca yaH । jAnanvicarati prAjYo na sa yAti parABavam ॥13॥

text: evameva yadā vidvānmanyetātibalaṃ ripum । saṃśrayedvaitasīṃ vṛttimevaṃ prajñānalakṣaṇam] ॥14॥
html:
evameva yadā vidvānmanyetātibalaṃ ripum ।
saṃśrayedvaitasīṃ vṛttimevaṃ prajñānalakṣaṇam] ॥14॥
slp1: evameva yadA vidvAnmanyetAtibalaM ripum । saMSrayedvEtasIM vfttimevaM prajYAnalakzaRam] ॥14॥

text: vidvānmūrkhapragalbhena mṛdustīkṣṇena bhārata । ākruśyamānaḥ sadasi kathaṃ kuryādarindama ॥1॥
html:
vidvānmūrkhapragalbhena mṛdustīkṣṇena bhārata ।
ākruśyamānaḥ sadasi kathaṃ kuryādarindama ॥1॥
slp1: vidvAnmUrKapragalBena mfdustIkzRena BArata । AkruSyamAnaH sadasi kaTaM kuryAdarindama ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: śrūyatāṃ pṛthivīpāla yathaiṣo'rtho'nugīyate । sadā sucetāḥ sahate narasyehālpacetasaḥ ॥2॥
html:
śrūyatāṃ pṛthivīpāla yathaiṣo'rtho'nugīyate ।
sadā sucetāḥ sahate narasyehālpacetasaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: SrUyatAM pfTivIpAla yaTEzo'rTo'nugIyate । sadA sucetAH sahate narasyehAlpacetasaH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: aruṣyankruśyamānasya sukṛtaṃ nāma vindati । duṣkṛtaṃ cātmano marṣī ruṣyatyevāpamārṣṭi vai ॥3॥
html:
aruṣyankruśyamānasya sukṛtaṃ nāma vindati ।
duṣkṛtaṃ cātmano marṣī ruṣyatyevāpamārṣṭi vai ॥3॥
slp1: aruzyankruSyamAnasya sukftaM nAma vindati । duzkftaM cAtmano marzI ruzyatyevApamArzwi vE ॥3॥

text: ṭiṭṭibhaṃ tamupekṣeta vāśamānamivāturam । lokavidveṣamāpanno niṣphalaṃ pratipadyate ॥4॥
html:
ṭiṭṭibhaṃ tamupekṣeta vāśamānamivāturam ।
lokavidveṣamāpanno niṣphalaṃ pratipadyate ॥4॥
slp1: wiwwiBaM tamupekzeta vASamAnamivAturam । lokavidvezamApanno nizPalaM pratipadyate ॥4॥

text: iti sa ślāghate nityaṃ tena pāpena karmaṇā । idamukto mayā kaścitsammato janasaṃsadi । sa tatra vrīḍitaḥ śuṣko mṛtakalpo'vatiṣṭhati ॥5॥
html:
iti sa ślāghate nityaṃ tena pāpena karmaṇā ।
idamukto mayā kaścitsammato janasaṃsadi ।
sa tatra vrīḍitaḥ śuṣko mṛtakalpo'vatiṣṭhati ॥5॥
slp1: iti sa SlAGate nityaM tena pApena karmaRA । idamukto mayA kaScitsammato janasaMsadi । sa tatra vrIqitaH Suzko mftakalpo'vatizWati ॥5॥

text: ślāghannaślāghanīyena karmaṇā nirapatrapaḥ । upekṣitavyo dāntena tādṛśaḥ puruṣādhamaḥ ॥6॥
html:
ślāghannaślāghanīyena karmaṇā nirapatrapaḥ ।
upekṣitavyo dāntena tādṛśaḥ puruṣādhamaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: SlAGannaSlAGanIyena karmaRA nirapatrapaH । upekzitavyo dAntena tAdfSaH puruzADamaH ॥6॥

text: yadyadbrūyādalpamatistattadasya sahetsadā । prākṛto hi praśaṃsanvā nindanvā kiṃ kariṣyati । vane kāka ivābuddhirvāśamāno nirarthakam ॥7॥
html:
yadyadbrūyādalpamatistattadasya sahetsadā ।
prākṛto hi praśaṃsanvā nindanvā kiṃ kariṣyati ।
vane kāka ivābuddhirvāśamāno nirarthakam ॥7॥
slp1: yadyadbrUyAdalpamatistattadasya sahetsadA । prAkfto hi praSaMsanvA nindanvA kiM karizyati । vane kAka ivAbudDirvASamAno nirarTakam ॥7॥

text: yadi vāgbhiḥ prayogaḥ syātprayoge pāpakarmaṇaḥ । vāgevārtho bhavettasya na hyevārtho jighāṃsataḥ ॥8॥
html:
yadi vāgbhiḥ prayogaḥ syātprayoge pāpakarmaṇaḥ ।
vāgevārtho bhavettasya na hyevārtho jighāṃsataḥ ॥8॥
slp1: yadi vAgBiH prayogaH syAtprayoge pApakarmaRaH । vAgevArTo Bavettasya na hyevArTo jiGAMsataH ॥8॥

text: niṣekaṃ viparītaṃ sa ācaṣṭe vṛttaceṣṭayā । mayūra iva kaupīnaṃ nṛtyansandarśayanniva ॥9॥
html:
niṣekaṃ viparītaṃ sa ācaṣṭe vṛttaceṣṭayā ।
mayūra iva kaupīnaṃ nṛtyansandarśayanniva ॥9॥
slp1: nizekaM viparItaM sa Acazwe vfttacezwayA । mayUra iva kOpInaM nftyansandarSayanniva ॥9॥

text: yasyāvācyaṃ na loke'sti nākāryaṃ vāpi kiñcana । vācaṃ tena na sandadhyācchuciḥ saṅkliṣṭakarmaṇā ॥10॥
html:
yasyāvācyaṃ na loke'sti nākāryaṃ vāpi kiñcana ।
vācaṃ tena na sandadhyācchuciḥ saṅkliṣṭakarmaṇā ॥10॥
slp1: yasyAvAcyaM na loke'sti nAkAryaM vApi kiYcana । vAcaM tena na sandaDyAcCuciH saNklizwakarmaRA ॥10॥

text: pratyakṣaṃ guṇavādī yaḥ parokṣaṃ tu vinindakaḥ । sa mānavaḥ śvavalloke naṣṭalokaparāyaṇaḥ ॥11॥
html:
pratyakṣaṃ guṇavādī yaḥ parokṣaṃ tu vinindakaḥ ।
sa mānavaḥ śvavalloke naṣṭalokaparāyaṇaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: pratyakzaM guRavAdI yaH parokzaM tu vinindakaH । sa mAnavaH Svavalloke nazwalokaparAyaRaH ॥11॥

text: tādṛgjanaśatasyāpi yaddadāti juhoti ca । parokṣeṇāpavādena tannāśayati sa kṣaṇāt ॥12॥
html:
tādṛgjanaśatasyāpi yaddadāti juhoti ca ।
parokṣeṇāpavādena tannāśayati sa kṣaṇāt ॥12॥
slp1: tAdfgjanaSatasyApi yaddadAti juhoti ca । parokzeRApavAdena tannASayati sa kzaRAt ॥12॥

text: tasmātprājño naraḥ sadyastādṛśaṃ pāpacetasam । varjayetsādhubhirvarjyaṃ sārameyāmiṣaṃ yathā ॥13॥
html:
tasmātprājño naraḥ sadyastādṛśaṃ pāpacetasam ।
varjayetsādhubhirvarjyaṃ sārameyāmiṣaṃ yathā ॥13॥
slp1: tasmAtprAjYo naraH sadyastAdfSaM pApacetasam । varjayetsADuBirvarjyaM sArameyAmizaM yaTA ॥13॥

text: parivādaṃ bruvāṇo hi durātmā vai mahātmane । prakāśayati doṣānsvānsarpaḥ phaṇamivocchritam ॥14॥
html:
parivādaṃ bruvāṇo hi durātmā vai mahātmane ।
prakāśayati doṣānsvānsarpaḥ phaṇamivocchritam ॥14॥
slp1: parivAdaM bruvARo hi durAtmA vE mahAtmane । prakASayati dozAnsvAnsarpaH PaRamivocCritam ॥14॥

text: taṃ svakarmāṇi kurvāṇaṃ pratikartuṃ ya icchati । bhasmakūṭa ivābuddhiḥ kharo rajasi majjati ॥15॥
html:
taṃ svakarmāṇi kurvāṇaṃ pratikartuṃ ya icchati ।
bhasmakūṭa ivābuddhiḥ kharo rajasi majjati ॥15॥
slp1: taM svakarmARi kurvARaM pratikartuM ya icCati । BasmakUwa ivAbudDiH Karo rajasi majjati ॥15॥

text: manuṣyaśālāvṛkamapraśāntaṃ janāpavāde satataṃ niviṣṭam । mātaṅgamunmattamivonnadantaṃ tyajeta taṃ śvānamivātiraudram ॥16॥
html:
manuṣyaśālāvṛkamapraśāntaṃ janāpavāde satataṃ niviṣṭam ।
mātaṅgamunmattamivonnadantaṃ tyajeta taṃ śvānamivātiraudram ॥16॥
slp1: manuzyaSAlAvfkamapraSAntaM janApavAde satataM nivizwam । mAtaNgamunmattamivonnadantaM tyajeta taM SvAnamivAtirOdram ॥16॥

text: adhīrajuṣṭe pathi vartamānaṃ damādapetaṃ vinayācca pāpam । arivrataṃ nityamabhūtikāmaṃ dhigastu taṃ pāpamatiṃ manuṣyam ॥17॥
html:
adhīrajuṣṭe pathi vartamānaṃ damādapetaṃ vinayācca pāpam ।
arivrataṃ nityamabhūtikāmaṃ dhigastu taṃ pāpamatiṃ manuṣyam ॥17॥
slp1: aDIrajuzwe paTi vartamAnaM damAdapetaM vinayAcca pApam । arivrataM nityamaBUtikAmaM Digastu taM pApamatiM manuzyam ॥17॥

text: pratyucyamānastu hi bhūya ebhirniśāmya mā bhūstvamathārtarūpaḥ । uccasya nīcena hi samprayogaṃ vigarhayanti sthirabuddhayo ye ॥18॥
html:
pratyucyamānastu hi bhūya ebhirniśāmya mā bhūstvamathārtarūpaḥ ।
uccasya nīcena hi samprayogaṃ vigarhayanti sthirabuddhayo ye ॥18॥
slp1: pratyucyamAnastu hi BUya eBirniSAmya mA BUstvamaTArtarUpaH । uccasya nIcena hi samprayogaM vigarhayanti sTirabudDayo ye ॥18॥

text: kruddho daśārdhena hi tāḍayedvā sa pāṃsubhirvāpakirettuṣairvā । vivṛtya dantāṃśca vibhīṣayedvā siddhaṃ hi mūrkhe kupite nṛśaṃse ॥19॥
html:
kruddho daśārdhena hi tāḍayedvā sa pāṃsubhirvāpakirettuṣairvā ।
vivṛtya dantāṃśca vibhīṣayedvā siddhaṃ hi mūrkhe kupite nṛśaṃse ॥19॥
slp1: krudDo daSArDena hi tAqayedvA sa pAMsuBirvApakirettuzErvA । vivftya dantAMSca viBIzayedvA sidDaM hi mUrKe kupite nfSaMse ॥19॥

text: vigarhaṇāṃ paramadurātmanā kṛtāṃ saheta yaḥ saṃsadi durjanānnaraḥ । paṭhedidaṃ cāpi nidarśanaṃ sadā na vāṅmayaṃ sa labhati kiñcidapriyam] ॥20॥
html:
vigarhaṇāṃ paramadurātmanā kṛtāṃ saheta yaḥ saṃsadi durjanānnaraḥ ।
paṭhedidaṃ cāpi nidarśanaṃ sadā na vāṅmayaṃ sa labhati kiñcidapriyam] ॥20॥
slp1: vigarhaRAM paramadurAtmanA kftAM saheta yaH saMsadi durjanAnnaraH । paWedidaM cApi nidarSanaM sadA na vANmayaM sa laBati kiYcidapriyam] ॥20॥

text: pitāmaha mahāprājña saṃśayo me mahānayam । sa cchettavyastvayā rājanbhavānkulakaro hi naḥ ॥1॥
html:
pitāmaha mahāprājña saṃśayo me mahānayam ।
sa cchettavyastvayā rājanbhavānkulakaro hi naḥ ॥1॥
slp1: pitAmaha mahAprAjYa saMSayo me mahAnayam । sa cCettavyastvayA rAjanBavAnkulakaro hi naH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: puruṣāṇāmayaṃ tāta durvṛttānāṃ durātmanām । kathito vākyasañcārastato vijñāpayāmi te ॥2॥
html:
puruṣāṇāmayaṃ tāta durvṛttānāṃ durātmanām ।
kathito vākyasañcārastato vijñāpayāmi te ॥2॥
slp1: puruzARAmayaM tAta durvfttAnAM durAtmanAm । kaTito vAkyasaYcArastato vijYApayAmi te ॥2॥

text: yaddhitaṃ rājyatantrasya kulasya ca sukhodayam । āyatyāṃ ca tadātve ca kṣemavṛddhikaraṃ ca yat ॥3॥
html:
yaddhitaṃ rājyatantrasya kulasya ca sukhodayam ।
āyatyāṃ ca tadātve ca kṣemavṛddhikaraṃ ca yat ॥3॥
slp1: yadDitaM rAjyatantrasya kulasya ca suKodayam । AyatyAM ca tadAtve ca kzemavfdDikaraM ca yat ॥3॥

text: na hi praśāstuṃ rājyaṃ hi śakyamekena bhārata । asahāyavatā tāta naivārthāḥ kecidapyuta । labdhuṃ labdhvā cāpi sadā rakṣituṃ bharatarṣabha ॥13॥

text: yasya nārto janapadaḥ sannikarṣagataḥ sadā । akṣudraḥ satpathālambī sa rājyaphalabhāgbhavet ॥18॥
