html:
vyāghrastūṭajamūlasthastṛptaḥ supto hatairmṛgaiḥ ।
nāgaścāgāttamuddeśaṃ matto megha ivotthitaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: vyAGrastUwajamUlasTastfptaH supto hatErmfgEH । nAgaScAgAttamuddeSaM matto meGa ivotTitaH ॥22॥

text: prabhinnakaraṭaḥ prāṃśuḥ padmī vitatamastakaḥ । suviṣāṇo mahākāyo meghagambhīranisvanaḥ ॥23॥
html:
prabhinnakaraṭaḥ prāṃśuḥ padmī vitatamastakaḥ ।
suviṣāṇo mahākāyo meghagambhīranisvanaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: praBinnakarawaH prAMSuH padmI vitatamastakaH । suvizARo mahAkAyo meGagamBIranisvanaH ॥23॥

text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā kuñjaraṃ mattamāyāntaṃ madagarvitam । vyāghro hastibhayāttrastastamṛṣiṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ॥24॥
html:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā kuñjaraṃ mattamāyāntaṃ madagarvitam ।
vyāghro hastibhayāttrastastamṛṣiṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ॥24॥
slp1: taM dfzwvA kuYjaraM mattamAyAntaM madagarvitam । vyAGro hastiBayAttrastastamfziM SaraRaM yayO ॥24॥

text: tato'nayatkuñjaratāṃ taṃ vyāghramṛṣisattamaḥ । mahāmeghopamaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ sa bhīto'bhavadgajaḥ ॥25॥
html:
tato'nayatkuñjaratāṃ taṃ vyāghramṛṣisattamaḥ ।
mahāmeghopamaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ sa bhīto'bhavadgajaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: tato'nayatkuYjaratAM taM vyAGramfzisattamaH । mahAmeGopamaM dfzwvA taM sa BIto'BavadgajaH ॥25॥

text: tataḥ kamalaṣaṇḍāni śallakīgahanāni ca । vyacaratsa mudā yuktaḥ padmareṇuvibhūṣitaḥ ॥26॥
html:
tataḥ kamalaṣaṇḍāni śallakīgahanāni ca ।
vyacaratsa mudā yuktaḥ padmareṇuvibhūṣitaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: tataH kamalazaRqAni SallakIgahanAni ca । vyacaratsa mudA yuktaH padmareRuviBUzitaH ॥26॥

text: kadācidramamāṇasya hastinaḥ sumukhaṃ tadā । ṛṣestasyoṭajasthasya kālo'gacchanniśāniśam ॥27॥
html:
kadācidramamāṇasya hastinaḥ sumukhaṃ tadā ।
ṛṣestasyoṭajasthasya kālo'gacchanniśāniśam ॥27॥
slp1: kadAcidramamARasya hastinaH sumuKaM tadA । fzestasyowajasTasya kAlo'gacCanniSAniSam ॥27॥

text: athājagāma taṃ deśaṃ kesarī kesarāruṇaḥ । girikandarajo bhīmaḥ siṃho nāgakulāntakaḥ ॥28॥
html:
athājagāma taṃ deśaṃ kesarī kesarāruṇaḥ ।
girikandarajo bhīmaḥ siṃho nāgakulāntakaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: aTAjagAma taM deSaM kesarI kesarAruRaH । girikandarajo BImaH siMho nAgakulAntakaH ॥28॥

text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā siṃhamāyāntaṃ nāgaḥ siṃhabhayākulaḥ । ṛṣiṃ śaraṇamāpede vepamāno bhayāturaḥ ॥29॥
html:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā siṃhamāyāntaṃ nāgaḥ siṃhabhayākulaḥ ।
ṛṣiṃ śaraṇamāpede vepamāno bhayāturaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: taM dfzwvA siMhamAyAntaM nAgaH siMhaBayAkulaH । fziM SaraRamApede vepamAno BayAturaH ॥29॥

text: tataḥ sa siṃhatāṃ nīto nāgendro muninā tadā । vanyaṃ nāgaṇayatsiṃhaṃ tulyajātisamanvayāt ॥30॥
html:
tataḥ sa siṃhatāṃ nīto nāgendro muninā tadā ।
vanyaṃ nāgaṇayatsiṃhaṃ tulyajātisamanvayāt ॥30॥
slp1: tataH sa siMhatAM nIto nAgendro muninA tadA । vanyaM nAgaRayatsiMhaM tulyajAtisamanvayAt ॥30॥

text: dṛṣṭvā ca so'naśatsiṃho vanyo bhīsannavāgbalaḥ । sa cāśrame'vasatsiṃhastasminneva vane sukhī ॥31॥
html:
dṛṣṭvā ca so'naśatsiṃho vanyo bhīsannavāgbalaḥ ।
sa cāśrame'vasatsiṃhastasminneva vane sukhī ॥31॥
slp1: dfzwvA ca so'naSatsiMho vanyo BIsannavAgbalaH । sa cASrame'vasatsiMhastasminneva vane suKI ॥31॥

text: na tvanye kṣudrapaśavastapovananivāsinaḥ । vyadṛśyanta bhayatrastā jīvitākāṅkṣiṇaḥ sadā ॥32॥
html:
na tvanye kṣudrapaśavastapovananivāsinaḥ ।
vyadṛśyanta bhayatrastā jīvitākāṅkṣiṇaḥ sadā ॥32॥
slp1: na tvanye kzudrapaSavastapovananivAsinaH । vyadfSyanta BayatrastA jIvitAkANkziRaH sadA ॥32॥

text: kadācitkālayogena sarvaprāṇivihiṃsakaḥ । balavānkṣatajāhāro nānāsattvabhayaṅkaraḥ ॥33॥
html:
kadācitkālayogena sarvaprāṇivihiṃsakaḥ ।
balavānkṣatajāhāro nānāsattvabhayaṅkaraḥ ॥33॥
slp1: kadAcitkAlayogena sarvaprARivihiMsakaH । balavAnkzatajAhAro nAnAsattvaBayaNkaraH ॥33॥

text: aṣṭapādūrdhvacaraṇaḥ śarabho vanagocaraḥ । taṃ siṃhaṃ hantumāgacchanmunestasya niveśanam ॥34॥
html:
aṣṭapādūrdhvacaraṇaḥ śarabho vanagocaraḥ ।
taṃ siṃhaṃ hantumāgacchanmunestasya niveśanam ॥34॥
slp1: azwapAdUrDvacaraRaH SaraBo vanagocaraH । taM siMhaM hantumAgacCanmunestasya niveSanam ॥34॥

text: taṃ muniḥ śarabhaṃ cakre balotkaṭamarindama । tataḥ sa śarabho vanyo muneḥ śarabhamagrataḥ । dṛṣṭvā balinamatyugraṃ drutaṃ samprādravadbhayāt ॥35॥
html:
taṃ muniḥ śarabhaṃ cakre balotkaṭamarindama ।
tataḥ sa śarabho vanyo muneḥ śarabhamagrataḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā balinamatyugraṃ drutaṃ samprādravadbhayāt ॥35॥
slp1: taM muniH SaraBaM cakre balotkawamarindama । tataH sa SaraBo vanyo muneH SaraBamagrataH । dfzwvA balinamatyugraM drutaM samprAdravadBayAt ॥35॥

text: sa evaṃ śarabhasthāne nyasto vai muninā tadā । muneḥ pārśvagato nityaṃ śārabhyaṃ sukhamāptavān ॥36॥
html:
sa evaṃ śarabhasthāne nyasto vai muninā tadā ।
muneḥ pārśvagato nityaṃ śārabhyaṃ sukhamāptavān ॥36॥
slp1: sa evaM SaraBasTAne nyasto vE muninA tadA । muneH pArSvagato nityaM SAraByaM suKamAptavAn ॥36॥

text: tataḥ śarabhasantrastāḥ sarve mṛgagaṇā vanāt । diśaḥ samprādravanrājanbhayājjīvitakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ॥37॥
html:
tataḥ śarabhasantrastāḥ sarve mṛgagaṇā vanāt ।
diśaḥ samprādravanrājanbhayājjīvitakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: tataH SaraBasantrastAH sarve mfgagaRA vanAt । diSaH samprAdravanrAjanBayAjjIvitakANkziRaH ॥37॥

text: śarabho'pyatisanduṣṭo nityaṃ prāṇivadhe rataḥ । phalamūlāśanaṃ śāntaṃ naicchatsa piśitāśanaḥ ॥38॥
html:
śarabho'pyatisanduṣṭo nityaṃ prāṇivadhe rataḥ ।
phalamūlāśanaṃ śāntaṃ naicchatsa piśitāśanaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: SaraBo'pyatisanduzwo nityaM prARivaDe rataH । PalamUlASanaM SAntaM nEcCatsa piSitASanaH ॥38॥

text: tato rudhiratarṣeṇa balinā śarabho'nvitaḥ । iyeṣa taṃ muniṃ hantumakṛtajñaḥ śvayonijaḥ ॥39॥
html:
tato rudhiratarṣeṇa balinā śarabho'nvitaḥ ।
iyeṣa taṃ muniṃ hantumakṛtajñaḥ śvayonijaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: tato ruDiratarzeRa balinA SaraBo'nvitaH । iyeza taM muniM hantumakftajYaH SvayonijaH ॥39॥

text: tatastena tapaḥśaktyā vidito jñānacakṣuṣā । vijñāya ca mahāprājño muniḥ śvānaṃ tamuktavān ॥40॥
html:
tatastena tapaḥśaktyā vidito jñānacakṣuṣā ।
vijñāya ca mahāprājño muniḥ śvānaṃ tamuktavān ॥40॥
slp1: tatastena tapaHSaktyA vidito jYAnacakzuzA । vijYAya ca mahAprAjYo muniH SvAnaM tamuktavAn ॥40॥

text: śvā tvaṃ dvīpitvamāpanno dvīpī vyāghratvamāgataḥ । vyāghro nāgo madapaṭurnāgaḥ siṃhatvamāptavān ॥41॥
html:
śvā tvaṃ dvīpitvamāpanno dvīpī vyāghratvamāgataḥ ।
vyāghro nāgo madapaṭurnāgaḥ siṃhatvamāptavān ॥41॥
slp1: SvA tvaM dvIpitvamApanno dvIpI vyAGratvamAgataH । vyAGro nAgo madapawurnAgaH siMhatvamAptavAn ॥41॥

text: siṃho'tibalasaṃyukto bhūyaḥ śarabhatāṃ gataḥ । mayā snehaparītena na vimṛṣṭaḥ kulānvayaḥ ॥42॥
html:
siṃho'tibalasaṃyukto bhūyaḥ śarabhatāṃ gataḥ ।
mayā snehaparītena na vimṛṣṭaḥ kulānvayaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: siMho'tibalasaMyukto BUyaH SaraBatAM gataH । mayA snehaparItena na vimfzwaH kulAnvayaH ॥42॥

text: yasmādevamapāpaṃ māṃ pāpa hiṃsitumicchasi । tasmātsvayonimāpannaḥ śvaiva tvaṃ hi bhaviṣyasi ॥43॥
html:
yasmādevamapāpaṃ māṃ pāpa hiṃsitumicchasi ।
tasmātsvayonimāpannaḥ śvaiva tvaṃ hi bhaviṣyasi ॥43॥
slp1: yasmAdevamapApaM mAM pApa hiMsitumicCasi । tasmAtsvayonimApannaH SvEva tvaM hi Bavizyasi ॥43॥

text: tato munijanadveṣādduṣṭātmā śvākṛto'budhaḥ । ṛṣiṇā śarabhaḥ śaptaḥ svaṃ rūpaṃ punarāptavān] ॥44॥
html:
tato munijanadveṣādduṣṭātmā śvākṛto'budhaḥ ।
ṛṣiṇā śarabhaḥ śaptaḥ svaṃ rūpaṃ punarāptavān] ॥44॥
slp1: tato munijanadvezAdduzwAtmA SvAkfto'buDaH । fziRA SaraBaH SaptaH svaM rUpaM punarAptavAn] ॥44॥

text: sa śvā prakṛtimāpannaḥ paraṃ dainyamupāgamat । ṛṣiṇā huṅkṛtaḥ pāpastapovanabahiṣkṛtaḥ ॥1॥
html:
sa śvā prakṛtimāpannaḥ paraṃ dainyamupāgamat ।
ṛṣiṇā huṅkṛtaḥ pāpastapovanabahiṣkṛtaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: sa SvA prakftimApannaH paraM dEnyamupAgamat । fziRA huNkftaH pApastapovanabahizkftaH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: evaṃ rājñā matimatā viditvā śīlaśaucatām । ārjavaṃ prakṛtiṃ sattvaṃ kulaṃ vṛttaṃ śrutaṃ damam ॥2॥
html:
evaṃ rājñā matimatā viditvā śīlaśaucatām ।
ārjavaṃ prakṛtiṃ sattvaṃ kulaṃ vṛttaṃ śrutaṃ damam ॥2॥
slp1: evaM rAjYA matimatA viditvA SIlaSOcatAm । ArjavaM prakftiM sattvaM kulaM vfttaM SrutaM damam ॥2॥

text: anukrośaṃ balaṃ vīryaṃ bhāvaṃ sampraśamaṃ kṣamām । bhṛtyā ye yatra yogyāḥ syustatra sthāpyāḥ suśikṣitāḥ ॥3॥
html:
anukrośaṃ balaṃ vīryaṃ bhāvaṃ sampraśamaṃ kṣamām ।
bhṛtyā ye yatra yogyāḥ syustatra sthāpyāḥ suśikṣitāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: anukroSaM balaM vIryaM BAvaM sampraSamaM kzamAm । BftyA ye yatra yogyAH syustatra sTApyAH suSikzitAH ॥3॥

text: nāparīkṣya mahīpālaḥ prakartuṃ bhṛtyamarhati । akulīnanarākīrṇo na rājā sukhamedhate ॥4॥
html:
nāparīkṣya mahīpālaḥ prakartuṃ bhṛtyamarhati ।
akulīnanarākīrṇo na rājā sukhamedhate ॥4॥
slp1: nAparIkzya mahIpAlaH prakartuM Bftyamarhati । akulInanarAkIrRo na rAjA suKameDate ॥4॥

text: kulajaḥ prakṛto rājñā tatkulīnatayā sadā । na pāpe kurute buddhiṃ nindyamāno'pyanāgasi ॥5॥
html:
kulajaḥ prakṛto rājñā tatkulīnatayā sadā ।
na pāpe kurute buddhiṃ nindyamāno'pyanāgasi ॥5॥
slp1: kulajaH prakfto rAjYA tatkulInatayA sadA । na pApe kurute budDiM nindyamAno'pyanAgasi ॥5॥

text: akulīnastu puruṣaḥ prakṛtaḥ sādhusaṅkṣayāt । durlabhaiśvaryatāṃ prāpto ninditaḥ śatrutāṃ vrajet ॥6॥
html:
akulīnastu puruṣaḥ prakṛtaḥ sādhusaṅkṣayāt ।
durlabhaiśvaryatāṃ prāpto ninditaḥ śatrutāṃ vrajet ॥6॥
slp1: akulInastu puruzaH prakftaH sADusaNkzayAt । durlaBESvaryatAM prApto ninditaH SatrutAM vrajet ॥6॥

text: kulīnaṃ śikṣitaṃ prājñaṃ jñānavijñānakovidam । sarvaśāstrārthatattvajñaṃ sahiṣṇuṃ deśajaṃ tathā ॥7॥
html:
kulīnaṃ śikṣitaṃ prājñaṃ jñānavijñānakovidam ।
sarvaśāstrārthatattvajñaṃ sahiṣṇuṃ deśajaṃ tathā ॥7॥
slp1: kulInaM SikzitaM prAjYaM jYAnavijYAnakovidam । sarvaSAstrArTatattvajYaM sahizRuM deSajaM taTA ॥7॥

text: kṛtajñaṃ balavantaṃ ca kṣāntaṃ dāntaṃ jitendriyam । alubdhaṃ labdhasantuṣṭaṃ svāmimitrabubhūṣakam ॥8॥
html:
kṛtajñaṃ balavantaṃ ca kṣāntaṃ dāntaṃ jitendriyam ।
alubdhaṃ labdhasantuṣṭaṃ svāmimitrabubhūṣakam ॥8॥
slp1: kftajYaM balavantaM ca kzAntaM dAntaM jitendriyam । alubDaM labDasantuzwaM svAmimitrabuBUzakam ॥8॥

text: sacivaṃ deśakālajñaṃ sarvasaṅgrahaṇe ratam । satkṛtaṃ yuktamanasaṃ hitaiṣiṇamatandritam ॥9॥
html:
sacivaṃ deśakālajñaṃ sarvasaṅgrahaṇe ratam ।
satkṛtaṃ yuktamanasaṃ hitaiṣiṇamatandritam ॥9॥
slp1: sacivaM deSakAlajYaM sarvasaNgrahaRe ratam । satkftaM yuktamanasaM hitEziRamatandritam ॥9॥

text: yuktācāraṃ svaviṣaye sandhivigrahakovidam । rājñastrivargavettāraṃ paurajānapadapriyam ॥10॥
html:
yuktācāraṃ svaviṣaye sandhivigrahakovidam ।
rājñastrivargavettāraṃ paurajānapadapriyam ॥10॥
slp1: yuktAcAraM svavizaye sanDivigrahakovidam । rAjYastrivargavettAraM pOrajAnapadapriyam ॥10॥

text: khātakavyūhatattvajñaṃ balaharṣaṇakovidam । iṅgitākāratattvajñaṃ yātrāyānaviśāradam ॥11॥
html:
khātakavyūhatattvajñaṃ balaharṣaṇakovidam ।
iṅgitākāratattvajñaṃ yātrāyānaviśāradam ॥11॥
slp1: KAtakavyUhatattvajYaM balaharzaRakovidam । iNgitAkAratattvajYaM yAtrAyAnaviSAradam ॥11॥

text: hastiśikṣāsu tattvajñamahaṅkāravivarjitam । pragalbhaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ dāntaṃ balinaṃ yuktakāriṇam ॥12॥
html:
hastiśikṣāsu tattvajñamahaṅkāravivarjitam ।
pragalbhaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ dāntaṃ balinaṃ yuktakāriṇam ॥12॥
slp1: hastiSikzAsu tattvajYamahaNkAravivarjitam । pragalBaM dakziRaM dAntaM balinaM yuktakAriRam ॥12॥

text: cokṣaṃ cokṣajanākīrṇaṃ suveṣaṃ sukhadarśanam । nāyakaṃ nītikuśalaṃ guṇaṣaṣṭyā samanvitam ॥13॥
html:
cokṣaṃ cokṣajanākīrṇaṃ suveṣaṃ sukhadarśanam ।
nāyakaṃ nītikuśalaṃ guṇaṣaṣṭyā samanvitam ॥13॥
slp1: cokzaM cokzajanAkIrRaM suvezaM suKadarSanam । nAyakaM nItikuSalaM guRazazwyA samanvitam ॥13॥

text: astabdhaṃ praśritaṃ śaktaṃ mṛduvādinameva ca । dhīraṃ ślakṣṇaṃ maharddhiṃ ca deśakālopapādakam ॥14॥
html:
astabdhaṃ praśritaṃ śaktaṃ mṛduvādinameva ca ।
dhīraṃ ślakṣṇaṃ maharddhiṃ ca deśakālopapādakam ॥14॥
slp1: astabDaM praSritaM SaktaM mfduvAdinameva ca । DIraM SlakzRaM mahardDiM ca deSakAlopapAdakam ॥14॥

text: sacivaṃ yaḥ prakurute na cainamavamanyate । tasya vistīryate rājyaṃ jyotsnā grahapateriva ॥15॥
html:
sacivaṃ yaḥ prakurute na cainamavamanyate ।
tasya vistīryate rājyaṃ jyotsnā grahapateriva ॥15॥
slp1: sacivaM yaH prakurute na cEnamavamanyate । tasya vistIryate rAjyaM jyotsnA grahapateriva ॥15॥

text: etaireva guṇairyukto rājā śāstraviśāradaḥ । eṣṭavyo dharmaparamaḥ prajāpālanatatparaḥ ॥16॥
html:
etaireva guṇairyukto rājā śāstraviśāradaḥ ।
eṣṭavyo dharmaparamaḥ prajāpālanatatparaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: etEreva guREryukto rAjA SAstraviSAradaH । ezwavyo DarmaparamaH prajApAlanatatparaH ॥16॥

text: dhīro marṣī śuciḥ śīghraḥ kāle puruṣakāravit । śuśrūṣuḥ śrutavāñśrotā ūhāpohaviśāradaḥ ॥17॥
html:
dhīro marṣī śuciḥ śīghraḥ kāle puruṣakāravit ।
śuśrūṣuḥ śrutavāñśrotā ūhāpohaviśāradaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: DIro marzI SuciH SIGraH kAle puruzakAravit । SuSrUzuH SrutavAYSrotA UhApohaviSAradaH ॥17॥

text: medhāvī dhāraṇāyukto yathānyāyopapādakaḥ । dāntaḥ sadā priyābhāṣī kṣamāvāṃśca viparyaye ॥18॥
html:
medhāvī dhāraṇāyukto yathānyāyopapādakaḥ ।
dāntaḥ sadā priyābhāṣī kṣamāvāṃśca viparyaye ॥18॥
slp1: meDAvI DAraRAyukto yaTAnyAyopapAdakaH । dAntaH sadA priyABAzI kzamAvAMSca viparyaye ॥18॥

text: dānācchede svayaṅkārī sudvāraḥ sukhadarśanaḥ । ārtahastaprado nityamāptaṃmanyo naye rataḥ ॥19॥
html:
dānācchede svayaṅkārī sudvāraḥ sukhadarśanaḥ ।
ārtahastaprado nityamāptaṃmanyo naye rataḥ ॥19॥
slp1: dAnAcCede svayaNkArI sudvAraH suKadarSanaH । Artahastaprado nityamAptaMmanyo naye rataH ॥19॥

text: nāhaṃvādī na nirdvandvo na yatkiñcanakārakaḥ । kṛte karmaṇyamoghānāṃ kartā bhṛtyajanapriyaḥ ॥20॥
html:
nāhaṃvādī na nirdvandvo na yatkiñcanakārakaḥ ।
kṛte karmaṇyamoghānāṃ kartā bhṛtyajanapriyaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: nAhaMvAdI na nirdvandvo na yatkiYcanakArakaH । kfte karmaRyamoGAnAM kartA BftyajanapriyaH ॥20॥

text: saṅgṛhītajano'stabdhaḥ prasannavadanaḥ sadā । dātā bhṛtyajanāvekṣī na krodhī sumahāmanāḥ ॥21॥
html:
saṅgṛhītajano'stabdhaḥ prasannavadanaḥ sadā ।
dātā bhṛtyajanāvekṣī na krodhī sumahāmanāḥ ॥21॥
slp1: saNgfhItajano'stabDaH prasannavadanaH sadA । dAtA BftyajanAvekzI na kroDI sumahAmanAH ॥21॥

text: yuktadaṇḍo na nirdaṇḍo dharmakāryānuśāsakaḥ । cāranetraḥ parāvekṣī dharmārthakuśalaḥ sadā ॥22॥
html:
yuktadaṇḍo na nirdaṇḍo dharmakāryānuśāsakaḥ ।
cāranetraḥ parāvekṣī dharmārthakuśalaḥ sadā ॥22॥
slp1: yuktadaRqo na nirdaRqo DarmakAryAnuSAsakaH । cAranetraH parAvekzI DarmArTakuSalaH sadA ॥22॥

text: rājā guṇaśatākīrṇa eṣṭavyastādṛśo bhavet । yodhāścaiva manuṣyendra sarvairguṇaguṇairvṛtāḥ ॥23॥
html:
rājā guṇaśatākīrṇa eṣṭavyastādṛśo bhavet ।
yodhāścaiva manuṣyendra sarvairguṇaguṇairvṛtāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: rAjA guRaSatAkIrRa ezwavyastAdfSo Bavet । yoDAScEva manuzyendra sarvErguRaguRErvftAH ॥23॥

text: anveṣṭavyāḥ supuruṣāḥ sahāyā rājyadhāraṇāḥ । na vimānayitavyāśca rājñā vṛddhimabhīpsatā ॥24॥
html:
anveṣṭavyāḥ supuruṣāḥ sahāyā rājyadhāraṇāḥ ।
na vimānayitavyāśca rājñā vṛddhimabhīpsatā ॥24॥
slp1: anvezwavyAH supuruzAH sahAyA rAjyaDAraRAH । na vimAnayitavyASca rAjYA vfdDimaBIpsatA ॥24॥

text: yodhāḥ samaraśauṭīrāḥ kṛtajñāḥ śastrakovidāḥ । dharmaśāstrasamāyuktāḥ padātijanasaṃyutāḥ ॥25॥
html:
yodhāḥ samaraśauṭīrāḥ kṛtajñāḥ śastrakovidāḥ ।
dharmaśāstrasamāyuktāḥ padātijanasaṃyutāḥ ॥25॥
slp1: yoDAH samaraSOwIrAH kftajYAH SastrakovidAH । DarmaSAstrasamAyuktAH padAtijanasaMyutAH ॥25॥

text: arthamānavivṛddhāśca rathacaryāviśāradāḥ । iṣvastrakuśalā yasya tasyeyaṃ nṛpatermahī ॥26॥
html:
arthamānavivṛddhāśca rathacaryāviśāradāḥ ।
iṣvastrakuśalā yasya tasyeyaṃ nṛpatermahī ॥26॥
slp1: arTamAnavivfdDASca raTacaryAviSAradAH । izvastrakuSalA yasya tasyeyaM nfpatermahI ॥26॥

text: sarvasaṅgrahaṇe yukto nṛpo bhavati yaḥ sadā । utthānaśīlo mitrāḍhyaḥ sa rājā rājasattamaḥ ॥27॥
html:
sarvasaṅgrahaṇe yukto nṛpo bhavati yaḥ sadā ।
utthānaśīlo mitrāḍhyaḥ sa rājā rājasattamaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: sarvasaNgrahaRe yukto nfpo Bavati yaH sadA । utTAnaSIlo mitrAQyaH sa rAjA rAjasattamaH ॥27॥

text: śakyā aśvasahasreṇa vīrāroheṇa bhārata । saṅgṛhītamanuṣyeṇa kṛtsnā jetuṃ vasundharā] ॥28॥
html:
śakyā aśvasahasreṇa vīrāroheṇa bhārata ।
saṅgṛhītamanuṣyeṇa kṛtsnā jetuṃ vasundharā] ॥28॥
slp1: SakyA aSvasahasreRa vIrAroheRa BArata । saNgfhItamanuzyeRa kftsnA jetuM vasunDarA] ॥28॥

text: evaṃ śunāsamānbhṛtyānsvasthāne yo narādhipaḥ । niyojayati kṛtyeṣu sa rājyaphalamaśnute ॥1॥
html:
evaṃ śunāsamānbhṛtyānsvasthāne yo narādhipaḥ ।
niyojayati kṛtyeṣu sa rājyaphalamaśnute ॥1॥
slp1: evaM SunAsamAnBftyAnsvasTAne yo narADipaH । niyojayati kftyezu sa rAjyaPalamaSnute ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: na śvā svasthānamutkramya pramāṇamabhi satkṛtaḥ । āropyaḥ śvā svakātsthānādutkramyānyatprapadyate ॥2॥
html:
na śvā svasthānamutkramya pramāṇamabhi satkṛtaḥ ।
āropyaḥ śvā svakātsthānādutkramyānyatprapadyate ॥2॥
slp1: na SvA svasTAnamutkramya pramARamaBi satkftaH । AropyaH SvA svakAtsTAnAdutkramyAnyatprapadyate ॥2॥

text: svajātikulasampannāḥ sveṣu karmasvavasthitāḥ । prakartavyā budhā bhṛtyā nāsthāne prakriyā kṣamā ॥3॥
html:
svajātikulasampannāḥ sveṣu karmasvavasthitāḥ ।
prakartavyā budhā bhṛtyā nāsthāne prakriyā kṣamā ॥3॥
slp1: svajAtikulasampannAH svezu karmasvavasTitAH । prakartavyA buDA BftyA nAsTAne prakriyA kzamA ॥3॥

text: anurūpāṇi karmāṇi bhṛtyebhyo yaḥ prayacchati । sa bhṛtyaguṇasampannaṃ rājā phalamupāśnute ॥4॥
html:
anurūpāṇi karmāṇi bhṛtyebhyo yaḥ prayacchati ।
sa bhṛtyaguṇasampannaṃ rājā phalamupāśnute ॥4॥
slp1: anurUpARi karmARi BftyeByo yaH prayacCati । sa BftyaguRasampannaM rAjA PalamupASnute ॥4॥

text: śarabhaḥ śarabhasthāne siṃhaḥ siṃha ivorjitaḥ । vyāghro vyāghra iva sthāpyo dvīpī dvīpī yathā tathā ॥5॥
html:
śarabhaḥ śarabhasthāne siṃhaḥ siṃha ivorjitaḥ ।
vyāghro vyāghra iva sthāpyo dvīpī dvīpī yathā tathā ॥5॥
slp1: SaraBaH SaraBasTAne siMhaH siMha ivorjitaH । vyAGro vyAGra iva sTApyo dvIpI dvIpI yaTA taTA ॥5॥

text: karmasvihānurūpeṣu nyasyā bhṛtyā yathāvidhi । pratilomaṃ na bhṛtyāste sthāpyāḥ karmaphalaiṣiṇā ॥6॥
html:
karmasvihānurūpeṣu nyasyā bhṛtyā yathāvidhi ।
pratilomaṃ na bhṛtyāste sthāpyāḥ karmaphalaiṣiṇā ॥6॥
slp1: karmasvihAnurUpezu nyasyA BftyA yaTAviDi । pratilomaM na BftyAste sTApyAH karmaPalEziRA ॥6॥

text: yaḥ pramāṇamatikramya pratilomaṃ narādhipaḥ । bhṛtyānsthāpayate'buddhirna sa rañjayate prajāḥ ॥7॥
html:
yaḥ pramāṇamatikramya pratilomaṃ narādhipaḥ ।
bhṛtyānsthāpayate'buddhirna sa rañjayate prajāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: yaH pramARamatikramya pratilomaM narADipaH । BftyAnsTApayate'budDirna sa raYjayate prajAH ॥7॥

text: na bāliśā na ca kṣudrā na cāpratimitendriyāḥ । nākulīnā narāḥ pārśve sthāpyā rājñā hitaiṣiṇā ॥8॥
html:
na bāliśā na ca kṣudrā na cāpratimitendriyāḥ ।
nākulīnā narāḥ pārśve sthāpyā rājñā hitaiṣiṇā ॥8॥
slp1: na bAliSA na ca kzudrA na cApratimitendriyAH । nAkulInA narAH pArSve sTApyA rAjYA hitEziRA ॥8॥

text: sādhavaḥ kuśalāḥ śūrā jñānavanto'nasūyakāḥ । akṣudrāḥ śucayo dakṣā narāḥ syuḥ pāripārśvakāḥ ॥9॥
html:
sādhavaḥ kuśalāḥ śūrā jñānavanto'nasūyakāḥ ।
akṣudrāḥ śucayo dakṣā narāḥ syuḥ pāripārśvakāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: sADavaH kuSalAH SUrA jYAnavanto'nasUyakAH । akzudrAH Sucayo dakzA narAH syuH pAripArSvakAH ॥9॥

text: nyagbhūtāstatparāḥ kṣāntāścaukṣāḥ prakṛtijāḥ śubhāḥ । sve sve sthāne'parikruṣṭāste syū rājño bahiścarāḥ ॥10॥
html:
nyagbhūtāstatparāḥ kṣāntāścaukṣāḥ prakṛtijāḥ śubhāḥ ।
sve sve sthāne'parikruṣṭāste syū rājño bahiścarāḥ ॥10॥
slp1: nyagBUtAstatparAH kzAntAScOkzAH prakftijAH SuBAH । sve sve sTAne'parikruzwAste syU rAjYo bahiScarAH ॥10॥

text: siṃhasya satataṃ pārśve siṃha eva jano bhavet । asiṃhaḥ siṃhasahitaḥ siṃhavallabhate phalam ॥11॥
html:
siṃhasya satataṃ pārśve siṃha eva jano bhavet ।
asiṃhaḥ siṃhasahitaḥ siṃhavallabhate phalam ॥11॥
slp1: siMhasya satataM pArSve siMha eva jano Bavet । asiMhaH siMhasahitaH siMhavallaBate Palam ॥11॥

text: yastu siṃhaḥ śvabhiḥ kīrṇaḥ siṃhakarmaphale rataḥ । na sa siṃhaphalaṃ bhoktuṃ śaktaḥ śvabhirupāsitaḥ ॥12॥
html:
yastu siṃhaḥ śvabhiḥ kīrṇaḥ siṃhakarmaphale rataḥ ।
na sa siṃhaphalaṃ bhoktuṃ śaktaḥ śvabhirupāsitaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: yastu siMhaH SvaBiH kIrRaH siMhakarmaPale rataH । na sa siMhaPalaM BoktuM SaktaH SvaBirupAsitaH ॥12॥

text: evametairmanuṣyendra śūraiḥ prājñairbahuśrutaiḥ । kulīnaiḥ saha śakyeta kṛtsnāṃ jetuṃ vasundharām ॥13॥
html:
evametairmanuṣyendra śūraiḥ prājñairbahuśrutaiḥ ।
kulīnaiḥ saha śakyeta kṛtsnāṃ jetuṃ vasundharām ॥13॥
slp1: evametErmanuzyendra SUrEH prAjYErbahuSrutEH । kulInEH saha Sakyeta kftsnAM jetuM vasunDarAm ॥13॥

text: nāvaidyo nānṛjuḥ pārśve nāvidyo nāmahādhanaḥ । saṅgrāhyo vasudhāpālairbhṛtyo bhṛtyavatāṃ vara ॥14॥
html:
nāvaidyo nānṛjuḥ pārśve nāvidyo nāmahādhanaḥ ।
saṅgrāhyo vasudhāpālairbhṛtyo bhṛtyavatāṃ vara ॥14॥
slp1: nAvEdyo nAnfjuH pArSve nAvidyo nAmahADanaH । saNgrAhyo vasuDApAlErBftyo BftyavatAM vara ॥14॥

text: bāṇavadvisṛtā yānti svāmikāryaparā janāḥ । ye bhṛtyāḥ pārthivahitāsteṣāṃ sāntvaṃ prayojayet ॥15॥
html:
bāṇavadvisṛtā yānti svāmikāryaparā janāḥ ।
ye bhṛtyāḥ pārthivahitāsteṣāṃ sāntvaṃ prayojayet ॥15॥
slp1: bARavadvisftA yAnti svAmikAryaparA janAH । ye BftyAH pArTivahitAstezAM sAntvaM prayojayet ॥15॥

text: kośaśca satataṃ rakṣyo yatnamāsthāya rājabhiḥ । kośamūlā hi rājānaḥ kośamūlakaro bhava ॥16॥
html:
kośaśca satataṃ rakṣyo yatnamāsthāya rājabhiḥ ।
kośamūlā hi rājānaḥ kośamūlakaro bhava ॥16॥
slp1: koSaSca satataM rakzyo yatnamAsTAya rAjaBiH । koSamUlA hi rAjAnaH koSamUlakaro Bava ॥16॥

text: koṣṭhāgāraṃ ca te nityaṃ sphītaṃ dhānyaiḥ susañcitam । sadāstu satsu saṃnyastaṃ dhanadhānyaparo bhava ॥17॥
html:
koṣṭhāgāraṃ ca te nityaṃ sphītaṃ dhānyaiḥ susañcitam ।
sadāstu satsu saṃnyastaṃ dhanadhānyaparo bhava ॥17॥
slp1: kozWAgAraM ca te nityaM sPItaM DAnyEH susaYcitam । sadAstu satsu saMnyastaM DanaDAnyaparo Bava ॥17॥

text: nityayuktāśca te bhṛtyā bhavantu raṇakovidāḥ । vājināṃ ca prayogeṣu vaiśāradyamiheṣyate ॥18॥
html:
nityayuktāśca te bhṛtyā bhavantu raṇakovidāḥ ।
vājināṃ ca prayogeṣu vaiśāradyamiheṣyate ॥18॥
slp1: nityayuktASca te BftyA Bavantu raRakovidAH । vAjinAM ca prayogezu vESAradyamihezyate ॥18॥

text: jñātibandhujanāvekṣī mitrasambandhisaṃvṛtaḥ । paurakāryahitānveṣī bhava kauravanandana ॥19॥
html:
jñātibandhujanāvekṣī mitrasambandhisaṃvṛtaḥ ।
paurakāryahitānveṣī bhava kauravanandana ॥19॥
slp1: jYAtibanDujanAvekzI mitrasambanDisaMvftaH । pOrakAryahitAnvezI Bava kOravanandana ॥19॥

text: eṣā te naiṣṭhikī buddhiḥ prajñā cābhihitā mayā । śvā te nidarśanaṃ tāta kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi] ॥20॥
html:
eṣā te naiṣṭhikī buddhiḥ prajñā cābhihitā mayā ।
śvā te nidarśanaṃ tāta kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi] ॥20॥
slp1: ezA te nEzWikI budDiH prajYA cABihitA mayA । SvA te nidarSanaM tAta kiM BUyaH SrotumicCasi] ॥20॥

text: rājavṛttānyanekāni tvayā proktāni bhārata । pūrvaiḥ pūrvaniyuktāni rājadharmārthavedibhiḥ ॥1॥
html:
rājavṛttānyanekāni tvayā proktāni bhārata ।
pūrvaiḥ pūrvaniyuktāni rājadharmārthavedibhiḥ ॥1॥
slp1: rAjavfttAnyanekAni tvayA proktAni BArata । pUrvEH pUrvaniyuktAni rAjaDarmArTavediBiH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: tadeva vistareṇoktaṃ pūrvairdṛṣṭaṃ satāṃ matam । praṇayaṃ rājadharmāṇāṃ prabrūhi bharatarṣabha ॥2॥
html:
tadeva vistareṇoktaṃ pūrvairdṛṣṭaṃ satāṃ matam ।
praṇayaṃ rājadharmāṇāṃ prabrūhi bharatarṣabha ॥2॥
slp1: tadeva vistareRoktaM pUrvErdfzwaM satAM matam । praRayaM rAjaDarmARAM prabrUhi BaratarzaBa ॥2॥

text: rakṣaṇaṃ sarvabhūtānāmiti kṣatre paraṃ matam । tadyathā rakṣaṇaṃ kuryāttathā śṛṇu mahīpate ॥3॥
html:
rakṣaṇaṃ sarvabhūtānāmiti kṣatre paraṃ matam ।
tadyathā rakṣaṇaṃ kuryāttathā śṛṇu mahīpate ॥3॥
slp1: rakzaRaM sarvaBUtAnAmiti kzatre paraM matam । tadyaTA rakzaRaM kuryAttaTA SfRu mahIpate ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yathā barhāṇi citrāṇi bibharti bhujagāśanaḥ । tathā bahuvidhaṃ rājā rūpaṃ kurvīta dharmavit ॥4॥
html:
yathā barhāṇi citrāṇi bibharti bhujagāśanaḥ ।
tathā bahuvidhaṃ rājā rūpaṃ kurvīta dharmavit ॥4॥
slp1: yaTA barhARi citrARi biBarti BujagASanaH । taTA bahuviDaM rAjA rUpaM kurvIta Darmavit ॥4॥

text: taikṣṇyaṃ jihmatvamādāntyaṃ satyamārjavameva ca । madhyasthaḥ sattvamātiṣṭhaṃstathā vai sukhamṛcchati ॥5॥
html:
taikṣṇyaṃ jihmatvamādāntyaṃ satyamārjavameva ca ।
madhyasthaḥ sattvamātiṣṭhaṃstathā vai sukhamṛcchati ॥5॥
slp1: tEkzRyaM jihmatvamAdAntyaM satyamArjavameva ca । maDyasTaH sattvamAtizWaMstaTA vE suKamfcCati ॥5॥

text: yasminnarthe hitaṃ yatsyāttadvarṇaṃ rūpamāviśet । bahurūpasya rājño hi sūkṣmo'pyartho na sīdati ॥6॥
html:
yasminnarthe hitaṃ yatsyāttadvarṇaṃ rūpamāviśet ।
bahurūpasya rājño hi sūkṣmo'pyartho na sīdati ॥6॥
slp1: yasminnarTe hitaM yatsyAttadvarRaM rUpamAviSet । bahurUpasya rAjYo hi sUkzmo'pyarTo na sIdati ॥6॥

text: nityaṃ rakṣitamantraḥ syādyathā mūkaḥ śaracchikhī । ślakṣṇākṣaratanuḥ śrīmānbhavecchāstraviśāradaḥ ॥7॥
html:
nityaṃ rakṣitamantraḥ syādyathā mūkaḥ śaracchikhī ।
ślakṣṇākṣaratanuḥ śrīmānbhavecchāstraviśāradaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: nityaM rakzitamantraH syAdyaTA mUkaH SaracCiKI । SlakzRAkzaratanuH SrImAnBavecCAstraviSAradaH ॥7॥

text: āpaddvāreṣu yattaḥ syājjalaprasravaṇeṣviva । śailavarṣodakānīva dvijānsiddhānsamāśrayet ॥8॥
html:
āpaddvāreṣu yattaḥ syājjalaprasravaṇeṣviva ।
śailavarṣodakānīva dvijānsiddhānsamāśrayet ॥8॥
slp1: ApaddvArezu yattaH syAjjalaprasravaRezviva । SElavarzodakAnIva dvijAnsidDAnsamASrayet ॥8॥

text: arthakāmaḥ śikhāṃ rājā kuryāddharmadhvajopamām । nityamudyatadaṇḍaḥ syādācareccāpramādataḥ । loke cāyavyayau dṛṣṭvā vṛkṣādvṛkṣamivāplavan ॥9॥
html:
arthakāmaḥ śikhāṃ rājā kuryāddharmadhvajopamām ।
nityamudyatadaṇḍaḥ syādācareccāpramādataḥ ।
loke cāyavyayau dṛṣṭvā vṛkṣādvṛkṣamivāplavan ॥9॥
slp1: arTakAmaH SiKAM rAjA kuryAdDarmaDvajopamAm । nityamudyatadaRqaH syAdAcareccApramAdataH । loke cAyavyayO dfzwvA vfkzAdvfkzamivAplavan ॥9॥

text: mṛjāvānsyātsvayūthyeṣu bhāvāni caraṇaiḥ kṣipet । jātapakṣaḥ parispandedrakṣedvaikalyamātmanaḥ ॥10॥
html:
mṛjāvānsyātsvayūthyeṣu bhāvāni caraṇaiḥ kṣipet ।
jātapakṣaḥ parispandedrakṣedvaikalyamātmanaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: mfjAvAnsyAtsvayUTyezu BAvAni caraREH kzipet । jAtapakzaH parispandedrakzedvEkalyamAtmanaH ॥10॥

text: doṣānvivṛṇuyācchatroḥ parapakṣānvidhūnayet । kānaneṣviva puṣpāṇi barhīvārthānsamācaret ॥11॥
html:
doṣānvivṛṇuyācchatroḥ parapakṣānvidhūnayet ।
kānaneṣviva puṣpāṇi barhīvārthānsamācaret ॥11॥
slp1: dozAnvivfRuyAcCatroH parapakzAnviDUnayet । kAnanezviva puzpARi barhIvArTAnsamAcaret ॥11॥

text: ucchritānāśrayetsphītānnarendrānacalopamān । śrayecchāyāmavijñātāṃ guptaṃ śaraṇamāśrayet ॥12॥
html:
ucchritānāśrayetsphītānnarendrānacalopamān ।
śrayecchāyāmavijñātāṃ guptaṃ śaraṇamāśrayet ॥12॥
slp1: ucCritAnASrayetsPItAnnarendrAnacalopamAn । SrayecCAyAmavijYAtAM guptaM SaraRamASrayet ॥12॥

text: prāvṛṣīvāsitagrīvo majjeta niśi nirjane । māyūreṇa guṇenaiva strībhiścālakṣitaścaret । na jahyācca tanutrāṇaṃ rakṣedātmānamātmanā ॥13॥
html:
prāvṛṣīvāsitagrīvo majjeta niśi nirjane ।
māyūreṇa guṇenaiva strībhiścālakṣitaścaret ।
na jahyācca tanutrāṇaṃ rakṣedātmānamātmanā ॥13॥
slp1: prAvfzIvAsitagrIvo majjeta niSi nirjane । mAyUreRa guRenEva strIBiScAlakzitaScaret । na jahyAcca tanutrARaM rakzedAtmAnamAtmanA ॥13॥

text: cārabhūmiṣvabhigamānpāśāṃśca parivarjayet । pīḍayeccāpi tāṃ bhūmiṃ praṇaśyedgahane punaḥ ॥14॥
html:
cārabhūmiṣvabhigamānpāśāṃśca parivarjayet ।
pīḍayeccāpi tāṃ bhūmiṃ praṇaśyedgahane punaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: cAraBUmizvaBigamAnpASAMSca parivarjayet । pIqayeccApi tAM BUmiM praRaSyedgahane punaH ॥14॥

text: hanyātkruddhānativiṣānye jihmagatayo'hitān । nāśrayedbālabarhāṇi sannivāsāni vāsayet ॥15॥
html:
hanyātkruddhānativiṣānye jihmagatayo'hitān ।
nāśrayedbālabarhāṇi sannivāsāni vāsayet ॥15॥
slp1: hanyAtkrudDAnativizAnye jihmagatayo'hitAn । nASrayedbAlabarhARi sannivAsAni vAsayet ॥15॥

text: sadā barhinibhaḥ kāmaṃ prasaktikṛtamācaret । sarvataścādadetprajñāṃ pataṅgāngahaneṣviva । evaṃ mayūravadrājā svarāṣṭraṃ paripālayet ॥16॥
html:
sadā barhinibhaḥ kāmaṃ prasaktikṛtamācaret ।
sarvataścādadetprajñāṃ pataṅgāngahaneṣviva ।
evaṃ mayūravadrājā svarāṣṭraṃ paripālayet ॥16॥
slp1: sadA barhiniBaH kAmaM prasaktikftamAcaret । sarvataScAdadetprajYAM pataNgAngahanezviva । evaM mayUravadrAjA svarAzwraM paripAlayet ॥16॥

text: ātmavṛddhikarīṃ nītiṃ vidadhīta vicakṣaṇaḥ । ātmasaṃyamanaṃ buddhyā parabuddhyāvatāraṇam । buddhyā cātmaguṇaprāptiretacchāstranidarśanam ॥17॥
html:
ātmavṛddhikarīṃ nītiṃ vidadhīta vicakṣaṇaḥ ।
ātmasaṃyamanaṃ buddhyā parabuddhyāvatāraṇam ।
buddhyā cātmaguṇaprāptiretacchāstranidarśanam ॥17॥
slp1: AtmavfdDikarIM nItiM vidaDIta vicakzaRaH । AtmasaMyamanaM budDyA parabudDyAvatAraRam । budDyA cAtmaguRaprAptiretacCAstranidarSanam ॥17॥

text: paraṃ cāśvāsayetsāmnā svaśaktiṃ copalakṣayet । ātmanaḥ parimarśena buddhiṃ buddhyā vicārayet । sāntvayogamatiḥ prājñaḥ kāryākāryavicārakaḥ ॥18॥
html:
paraṃ cāśvāsayetsāmnā svaśaktiṃ copalakṣayet ।
ātmanaḥ parimarśena buddhiṃ buddhyā vicārayet ।
sāntvayogamatiḥ prājñaḥ kāryākāryavicārakaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: paraM cASvAsayetsAmnA svaSaktiM copalakzayet । AtmanaH parimarSena budDiM budDyA vicArayet । sAntvayogamatiH prAjYaH kAryAkAryavicArakaH ॥18॥

text: nigūḍhabuddhirdhīraḥ syādvaktavye vakṣyate tathā । sannikṛṣṭāṃ kathāṃ prājño yadi buddhyā bṛhaspatiḥ । svabhāvameṣyate taptaṃ kṛṣṇāyasamivodake ॥19॥
html:
nigūḍhabuddhirdhīraḥ syādvaktavye vakṣyate tathā ।
sannikṛṣṭāṃ kathāṃ prājño yadi buddhyā bṛhaspatiḥ ।
svabhāvameṣyate taptaṃ kṛṣṇāyasamivodake ॥19॥
slp1: nigUQabudDirDIraH syAdvaktavye vakzyate taTA । sannikfzwAM kaTAM prAjYo yadi budDyA bfhaspatiH । svaBAvamezyate taptaM kfzRAyasamivodake ॥19॥

text: anuyuñjīta kṛtyāni sarvāṇyeva mahīpatiḥ । āgamairupadiṣṭāni svasya caiva parasya ca ॥20॥
html:
anuyuñjīta kṛtyāni sarvāṇyeva mahīpatiḥ ।
āgamairupadiṣṭāni svasya caiva parasya ca ॥20॥
slp1: anuyuYjIta kftyAni sarvARyeva mahIpatiH । AgamErupadizwAni svasya cEva parasya ca ॥20॥

text: kṣudraṃ krūraṃ tathā prājñaṃ śūraṃ cārthaviśāradam । svakarmaṇi niyuñjīta ye cānye vacanādhikāḥ ॥21॥
html:
kṣudraṃ krūraṃ tathā prājñaṃ śūraṃ cārthaviśāradam ।
svakarmaṇi niyuñjīta ye cānye vacanādhikāḥ ॥21॥
slp1: kzudraM krUraM taTA prAjYaM SUraM cArTaviSAradam । svakarmaRi niyuYjIta ye cAnye vacanADikAH ॥21॥

text: apyadṛṣṭvā niyuktāni anurūpeṣu karmasu । sarvāṃstānanuvarteta svarāṃstantrīrivāyatā ॥22॥
html:
apyadṛṣṭvā niyuktāni anurūpeṣu karmasu ।
sarvāṃstānanuvarteta svarāṃstantrīrivāyatā ॥22॥
slp1: apyadfzwvA niyuktAni anurUpezu karmasu । sarvAMstAnanuvarteta svarAMstantrIrivAyatA ॥22॥

text: dharmāṇāmavirodhena sarveṣāṃ priyamācaret । mamāyamiti rājā yaḥ sa parvata ivācalaḥ ॥23॥
html:
dharmāṇāmavirodhena sarveṣāṃ priyamācaret ।
mamāyamiti rājā yaḥ sa parvata ivācalaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: DarmARAmaviroDena sarvezAM priyamAcaret । mamAyamiti rAjA yaH sa parvata ivAcalaH ॥23॥

text: vyavasāyaṃ samādhāya sūryo raśmimivāyatām । dharmamevābhirakṣeta kṛtvā tulye priyāpriye ॥24॥
html:
vyavasāyaṃ samādhāya sūryo raśmimivāyatām ।
dharmamevābhirakṣeta kṛtvā tulye priyāpriye ॥24॥
slp1: vyavasAyaM samADAya sUryo raSmimivAyatAm । DarmamevABirakzeta kftvA tulye priyApriye ॥24॥

text: kulaprakṛtideśānāṃ dharmajñānmṛdubhāṣiṇaḥ । madhye vayasi nirdoṣānhite yuktāñjitendriyān ॥25॥
html:
kulaprakṛtideśānāṃ dharmajñānmṛdubhāṣiṇaḥ ।
madhye vayasi nirdoṣānhite yuktāñjitendriyān ॥25॥
slp1: kulaprakftideSAnAM DarmajYAnmfduBAziRaH । maDye vayasi nirdozAnhite yuktAYjitendriyAn ॥25॥

text: alubdhāñśikṣitāndāntāndharmeṣu pariniṣṭhitān । sthāpayetsarvakāryeṣu rājā dharmārtharakṣiṇaḥ ॥26॥
html:
alubdhāñśikṣitāndāntāndharmeṣu pariniṣṭhitān ।
sthāpayetsarvakāryeṣu rājā dharmārtharakṣiṇaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: alubDAYSikzitAndAntAnDarmezu parinizWitAn । sTApayetsarvakAryezu rAjA DarmArTarakziRaH ॥26॥

text: etenaiva prakāreṇa kṛtyānāmāgatiṃ gatim । yuktaḥ samanutiṣṭheta tuṣṭaścārairupaskṛtaḥ ॥27॥
html:
etenaiva prakāreṇa kṛtyānāmāgatiṃ gatim ।
yuktaḥ samanutiṣṭheta tuṣṭaścārairupaskṛtaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: etenEva prakAreRa kftyAnAmAgatiM gatim । yuktaH samanutizWeta tuzwaScArErupaskftaH ॥27॥

text: amoghakrodhaharṣasya svayaṃ kṛtyānvavekṣiṇaḥ । ātmapratyayakośasya vasudhaiva vasundharā ॥28॥
html:
amoghakrodhaharṣasya svayaṃ kṛtyānvavekṣiṇaḥ ।
ātmapratyayakośasya vasudhaiva vasundharā ॥28॥
slp1: amoGakroDaharzasya svayaM kftyAnvavekziRaH । AtmapratyayakoSasya vasuDEva vasunDarA ॥28॥

text: vyaktaścānugraho yasya yathārthaścāpi nigrahaḥ । guptātmā guptarāṣṭraśca sa rājā rājadharmavit ॥29॥
html:
vyaktaścānugraho yasya yathārthaścāpi nigrahaḥ ।
guptātmā guptarāṣṭraśca sa rājā rājadharmavit ॥29॥
slp1: vyaktaScAnugraho yasya yaTArTaScApi nigrahaH । guptAtmA guptarAzwraSca sa rAjA rAjaDarmavit ॥29॥

text: nityaṃ rāṣṭramavekṣeta gobhiḥ sūrya ivotpatan । cārāṃśca nacarānvidyāttathā buddhyā na sañjvaret ॥30॥
html:
nityaṃ rāṣṭramavekṣeta gobhiḥ sūrya ivotpatan ।
cārāṃśca nacarānvidyāttathā buddhyā na sañjvaret ॥30॥
slp1: nityaM rAzwramavekzeta goBiH sUrya ivotpatan । cArAMSca nacarAnvidyAttaTA budDyA na saYjvaret ॥30॥

text: kālaprāptamupādadyānnārthaṃ rājā prasūcayet । ahanyahani sanduhyānmahīṃ gāmiva buddhimān ॥31॥
html:
kālaprāptamupādadyānnārthaṃ rājā prasūcayet ।
ahanyahani sanduhyānmahīṃ gāmiva buddhimān ॥31॥
slp1: kAlaprAptamupAdadyAnnArTaM rAjA prasUcayet । ahanyahani sanduhyAnmahIM gAmiva budDimAn ॥31॥

text: yathā krameṇa puṣpebhyaścinoti madhu ṣaṭpadaḥ । tathā dravyamupādāya rājā kurvīta sañcayam ॥32॥
html:
yathā krameṇa puṣpebhyaścinoti madhu ṣaṭpadaḥ ।
tathā dravyamupādāya rājā kurvīta sañcayam ॥32॥
slp1: yaTA krameRa puzpeByaScinoti maDu zawpadaH । taTA dravyamupAdAya rAjA kurvIta saYcayam ॥32॥

text: yaddhi guptāvaśiṣṭaṃ syāttaddhitaṃ dharmakāmayoḥ । sañcayānuvisargī syādrājā śāstravidātmavān ॥33॥
html:
yaddhi guptāvaśiṣṭaṃ syāttaddhitaṃ dharmakāmayoḥ ।
sañcayānuvisargī syādrājā śāstravidātmavān ॥33॥
slp1: yadDi guptAvaSizwaM syAttadDitaM DarmakAmayoH । saYcayAnuvisargI syAdrAjA SAstravidAtmavAn ॥33॥

text: nālpamarthaṃ paribhavennāvamanyeta śātravān । buddhyāvabudhyedātmānaṃ na cābuddhiṣu viśvaset ॥34॥
html:
nālpamarthaṃ paribhavennāvamanyeta śātravān ।
buddhyāvabudhyedātmānaṃ na cābuddhiṣu viśvaset ॥34॥
slp1: nAlpamarTaM pariBavennAvamanyeta SAtravAn । budDyAvabuDyedAtmAnaM na cAbudDizu viSvaset ॥34॥

text: dhṛtirdākṣyaṃ saṃyamo buddhiragryā dhairyaṃ śauryaṃ deśakālo'pramādaḥ । svalpasya vā mahato vāpi vṛddhau dhanasyaitānyaṣṭa samindhanāni ॥35॥
html:
dhṛtirdākṣyaṃ saṃyamo buddhiragryā dhairyaṃ śauryaṃ deśakālo'pramādaḥ ।
svalpasya vā mahato vāpi vṛddhau dhanasyaitānyaṣṭa samindhanāni ॥35॥
slp1: DftirdAkzyaM saMyamo budDiragryA DEryaM SOryaM deSakAlo'pramAdaH । svalpasya vA mahato vApi vfdDO DanasyEtAnyazwa saminDanAni ॥35॥

text: agnistoko vardhate hyājyasikto bījaṃ caikaṃ bahusāhasrameti । kṣayodayau vipulau sanniśāmya tasmādalpaṃ nāvamanyeta vidvān ॥36॥
html:
agnistoko vardhate hyājyasikto bījaṃ caikaṃ bahusāhasrameti ।
kṣayodayau vipulau sanniśāmya tasmādalpaṃ nāvamanyeta vidvān ॥36॥
slp1: agnistoko varDate hyAjyasikto bIjaM cEkaM bahusAhasrameti । kzayodayO vipulO sanniSAmya tasmAdalpaM nAvamanyeta vidvAn ॥36॥

text: bālo'bālaḥ sthaviro vā ripuryaḥ sadā pramattaṃ puruṣaṃ nihanyāt । kālenānyastasya mūlaṃ hareta kālajñātā pārthivānāṃ variṣṭhaḥ ॥37॥
html:
bālo'bālaḥ sthaviro vā ripuryaḥ sadā pramattaṃ puruṣaṃ nihanyāt ।
kālenānyastasya mūlaṃ hareta kālajñātā pārthivānāṃ variṣṭhaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: bAlo'bAlaH sTaviro vA ripuryaH sadA pramattaM puruzaM nihanyAt । kAlenAnyastasya mUlaM hareta kAlajYAtA pArTivAnAM varizWaH ॥37॥

text: haretkīrtiṃ dharmamasyoparundhyādarthe dīrghaṃ vīryamasyopahanyāt । ripurdveṣṭā durbalo vā balī vā tasmācchatrau naiva heḍedyatātmā ॥38॥
html:
haretkīrtiṃ dharmamasyoparundhyādarthe dīrghaṃ vīryamasyopahanyāt ।
ripurdveṣṭā durbalo vā balī vā tasmācchatrau naiva heḍedyatātmā ॥38॥
slp1: haretkIrtiM DarmamasyoparunDyAdarTe dIrGaM vIryamasyopahanyAt । ripurdvezwA durbalo vA balI vA tasmAcCatrO nEva heqedyatAtmA ॥38॥

text: kṣayaṃ śatroḥ sañcayaṃ pālanaṃ cāpyubhau cārthau sahitau dharmakāmau । ataścānyanmatimānsandadhīta tasmādrājā buddhimantaṃ śrayeta ॥39॥
html:
kṣayaṃ śatroḥ sañcayaṃ pālanaṃ cāpyubhau cārthau sahitau dharmakāmau ।
ataścānyanmatimānsandadhīta tasmādrājā buddhimantaṃ śrayeta ॥39॥
slp1: kzayaM SatroH saYcayaM pAlanaM cApyuBO cArTO sahitO DarmakAmO । ataScAnyanmatimAnsandaDIta tasmAdrAjA budDimantaM Srayeta ॥39॥

text: buddhirdīptā balavantaṃ hinasti balaṃ buddhyā vardhate pālyamānam । śatrurbuddhyā sīdate vardhamāno buddheḥ paścātkarma yattatpraśastam ॥40॥
html:
buddhirdīptā balavantaṃ hinasti balaṃ buddhyā vardhate pālyamānam ।
śatrurbuddhyā sīdate vardhamāno buddheḥ paścātkarma yattatpraśastam ॥40॥
slp1: budDirdIptA balavantaM hinasti balaM budDyA varDate pAlyamAnam । SatrurbudDyA sIdate varDamAno budDeH paScAtkarma yattatpraSastam ॥40॥

text: sarvānkāmānkāmayāno hi dhīraḥ sattvenālpenāplute hīnadehaḥ । yathātmānaṃ prārthayate'rthamānaiḥ śreyaḥpātraṃ pūrayate hyanalpam ॥41॥
html:
sarvānkāmānkāmayāno hi dhīraḥ sattvenālpenāplute hīnadehaḥ ।
yathātmānaṃ prārthayate'rthamānaiḥ śreyaḥpātraṃ pūrayate hyanalpam ॥41॥
slp1: sarvAnkAmAnkAmayAno hi DIraH sattvenAlpenAplute hInadehaH । yaTAtmAnaM prArTayate'rTamAnEH SreyaHpAtraM pUrayate hyanalpam ॥41॥

text: tasmādrājā pragṛhītaḥ pareṣu mūlaṃ lakṣmyāḥ sarvato'bhyādadīta । dīrghaṃ kālamapi sampīḍyamāno vidyutsampātamiva mānorjitaḥ syāt ॥42॥
html:
tasmādrājā pragṛhītaḥ pareṣu mūlaṃ lakṣmyāḥ sarvato'bhyādadīta ।
dīrghaṃ kālamapi sampīḍyamāno vidyutsampātamiva mānorjitaḥ syāt ॥42॥
slp1: tasmAdrAjA pragfhItaH parezu mUlaM lakzmyAH sarvato'ByAdadIta । dIrGaM kAlamapi sampIqyamAno vidyutsampAtamiva mAnorjitaH syAt ॥42॥

text: vidyā tapo vā vipulaṃ dhanaṃ vā sarvametadvyavasāyena śakyam । brahma yattaṃ nivasati dehavatsu tasmādvidyādvyavasāyaṃ prabhūtam ॥43॥
html:
vidyā tapo vā vipulaṃ dhanaṃ vā sarvametadvyavasāyena śakyam ।
brahma yattaṃ nivasati dehavatsu tasmādvidyādvyavasāyaṃ prabhūtam ॥43॥
slp1: vidyA tapo vA vipulaM DanaM vA sarvametadvyavasAyena Sakyam । brahma yattaM nivasati dehavatsu tasmAdvidyAdvyavasAyaM praBUtam ॥43॥

text: yatrāsate matimanto manasvinaḥ śakro viṣṇuryatra sarasvatī ca । vasanti bhūtāni ca yatra nityaṃ tasmādvidvānnāvamanyeta deham ॥44॥
html:
yatrāsate matimanto manasvinaḥ śakro viṣṇuryatra sarasvatī ca ।
vasanti bhūtāni ca yatra nityaṃ tasmādvidvānnāvamanyeta deham ॥44॥
slp1: yatrAsate matimanto manasvinaH Sakro vizRuryatra sarasvatI ca । vasanti BUtAni ca yatra nityaM tasmAdvidvAnnAvamanyeta deham ॥44॥

text: lubdhaṃ hanyātsampradānena nityaṃ lubdhastṛptiṃ paravittasya naiti । sarvo lubdhaḥ karmaguṇopabhoge yo'rthairhīno dharmakāmau jahāti ॥45॥
html:
lubdhaṃ hanyātsampradānena nityaṃ lubdhastṛptiṃ paravittasya naiti ।
sarvo lubdhaḥ karmaguṇopabhoge yo'rthairhīno dharmakāmau jahāti ॥45॥
slp1: lubDaM hanyAtsampradAnena nityaM lubDastfptiM paravittasya nEti । sarvo lubDaH karmaguRopaBoge yo'rTErhIno DarmakAmO jahAti ॥45॥

text: dhanaṃ bhojyaṃ putradāraṃ samṛddhiṃ sarvo lubdhaḥ prārthayate pareṣām । lubdhe doṣāḥ sambhavantīha sarve tasmādrājā na pragṛhṇīta lubdhān ॥46॥
html:
dhanaṃ bhojyaṃ putradāraṃ samṛddhiṃ sarvo lubdhaḥ prārthayate pareṣām ।
lubdhe doṣāḥ sambhavantīha sarve tasmādrājā na pragṛhṇīta lubdhān ॥46॥
slp1: DanaM BojyaM putradAraM samfdDiM sarvo lubDaH prArTayate parezAm । lubDe dozAH samBavantIha sarve tasmAdrAjA na pragfhRIta lubDAn ॥46॥

text: sandarśane satpuruṣaṃ jaghanyamapi codayet । ārambhāndviṣatāṃ prājñaḥ sarvānarthāṃstu sūdayet ॥47॥
html:
sandarśane satpuruṣaṃ jaghanyamapi codayet ।
ārambhāndviṣatāṃ prājñaḥ sarvānarthāṃstu sūdayet ॥47॥
slp1: sandarSane satpuruzaM jaGanyamapi codayet । AramBAndvizatAM prAjYaH sarvAnarTAMstu sUdayet ॥47॥

text: dharmānviteṣu vijñāto mantrī guptaśca pāṇḍava । āpto rājankulīnaśca paryāpto rājyasaṅgrahe ॥48॥
html:
dharmānviteṣu vijñāto mantrī guptaśca pāṇḍava ।
āpto rājankulīnaśca paryāpto rājyasaṅgrahe ॥48॥
slp1: DarmAnvitezu vijYAto mantrI guptaSca pARqava । Apto rAjankulInaSca paryApto rAjyasaNgrahe ॥48॥

text: vidhipravṛttānnaradevadharmānuktānsamāsena nibodha buddhyā । imānvidadhyādvyanusṛtya yo vai rājā mahīṃ pālayituṃ sa śaktaḥ ॥49॥
html:
vidhipravṛttānnaradevadharmānuktānsamāsena nibodha buddhyā ।
imānvidadhyādvyanusṛtya yo vai rājā mahīṃ pālayituṃ sa śaktaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: viDipravfttAnnaradevaDarmAnuktAnsamAsena niboDa budDyA । imAnvidaDyAdvyanusftya yo vE rAjA mahIM pAlayituM sa SaktaH ॥49॥

text: anītijaṃ yadyavidhānajaṃ sukhaṃ haṭhapraṇītaṃ vividhaṃ pradṛśyate । na vidyate tasya gatirmahīpaterna vidyate rāṣṭrajamuttamaṃ sukham ॥50॥
html:
anītijaṃ yadyavidhānajaṃ sukhaṃ haṭhapraṇītaṃ vividhaṃ pradṛśyate ।
na vidyate tasya gatirmahīpaterna vidyate rāṣṭrajamuttamaṃ sukham ॥50॥
slp1: anItijaM yadyaviDAnajaM suKaM haWapraRItaM viviDaM pradfSyate । na vidyate tasya gatirmahIpaterna vidyate rAzwrajamuttamaM suKam ॥50॥

text: dhanairviśiṣṭānmatiśīlapūjitānguṇopapannānyudhi dṛṣṭavikramān । guṇeṣu dṛṣṭānacirādihātmavānsato'bhisandhāya nihanti śātravān ॥51॥
html:
dhanairviśiṣṭānmatiśīlapūjitānguṇopapannānyudhi dṛṣṭavikramān ।
guṇeṣu dṛṣṭānacirādihātmavānsato'bhisandhāya nihanti śātravān ॥51॥
slp1: DanErviSizwAnmatiSIlapUjitAnguRopapannAnyuDi dfzwavikramAn । guRezu dfzwAnacirAdihAtmavAnsato'BisanDAya nihanti SAtravAn ॥51॥

text: paśyedupāyānvividhaiḥ kriyāpathairna cānupāyena matiṃ niveśayet । śriyaṃ viśiṣṭāṃ vipulaṃ yaśo dhanaṃ na doṣadarśī puruṣaḥ samaśnute ॥52॥
html:
paśyedupāyānvividhaiḥ kriyāpathairna cānupāyena matiṃ niveśayet ।
śriyaṃ viśiṣṭāṃ vipulaṃ yaśo dhanaṃ na doṣadarśī puruṣaḥ samaśnute ॥52॥
slp1: paSyedupAyAnviviDEH kriyApaTErna cAnupAyena matiM niveSayet । SriyaM viSizwAM vipulaM yaSo DanaM na dozadarSI puruzaH samaSnute ॥52॥

text: prītipravṛttau vinivartane tathā suhṛtsu vijñāya nivṛtya cobhayoḥ । yadeva mitraṃ gurubhāramāvahettadeva susnigdhamudāharedbudhaḥ ॥53॥
html:
prītipravṛttau vinivartane tathā suhṛtsu vijñāya nivṛtya cobhayoḥ ।
yadeva mitraṃ gurubhāramāvahettadeva susnigdhamudāharedbudhaḥ ॥53॥
slp1: prItipravfttO vinivartane taTA suhftsu vijYAya nivftya coBayoH । yadeva mitraM guruBAramAvahettadeva susnigDamudAharedbuDaH ॥53॥

text: etānmayoktāṃstava rājadharmānnṛṇāṃ ca guptau matimādadhatsva । avāpsyase puṇyaphalaṃ sukhena sarvo hi lokottamadharmamūlaḥ] ॥54॥
html:
etānmayoktāṃstava rājadharmānnṛṇāṃ ca guptau matimādadhatsva ।
avāpsyase puṇyaphalaṃ sukhena sarvo hi lokottamadharmamūlaḥ] ॥54॥
slp1: etAnmayoktAMstava rAjaDarmAnnfRAM ca guptO matimAdaDatsva । avApsyase puRyaPalaM suKena sarvo hi lokottamaDarmamUlaH] ॥54॥

text: ayaṃ pitāmahenokto rājadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ । īśvaraśca mahādaṇḍo daṇḍe sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ॥1॥
html:
ayaṃ pitāmahenokto rājadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
īśvaraśca mahādaṇḍo daṇḍe sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ॥1॥
slp1: ayaM pitAmahenokto rAjaDarmaH sanAtanaH । ISvaraSca mahAdaRqo daRqe sarvaM pratizWitam ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ ca mahātmanām । yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācānāṃ martyānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ॥2॥
html:
devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ ca mahātmanām ।
yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācānāṃ martyānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ॥2॥
slp1: devatAnAmfzIRAM ca pitFRAM ca mahAtmanAm । yakzarakzaHpiSAcAnAM martyAnAM ca viSezataH ॥2॥

text: sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ loke tiryakṣvapi nivāsinām । sarvavyāpī mahātejā daṇḍaḥ śreyāniti prabho ॥3॥
html:
sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ loke tiryakṣvapi nivāsinām ।
sarvavyāpī mahātejā daṇḍaḥ śreyāniti prabho ॥3॥
slp1: sarvezAM prARinAM loke tiryakzvapi nivAsinAm । sarvavyApI mahAtejA daRqaH SreyAniti praBo ॥3॥

text: ityetaduktaṃ bhavatā sarvaṃ daṇḍyaṃ carācaram । dṛśyate lokamāsaktaṃ sasurāsuramānuṣam ॥4॥
html:
ityetaduktaṃ bhavatā sarvaṃ daṇḍyaṃ carācaram ।
dṛśyate lokamāsaktaṃ sasurāsuramānuṣam ॥4॥
slp1: ityetaduktaM BavatA sarvaM daRqyaM carAcaram । dfSyate lokamAsaktaM sasurAsuramAnuzam ॥4॥

text: etadicchāmyahaṃ jñātuṃ tattvena bharatarṣabha । ko daṇḍaḥ kīdṛśo daṇḍaḥ kiṃrūpaḥ kimparāyaṇaḥ ॥5॥
html:
etadicchāmyahaṃ jñātuṃ tattvena bharatarṣabha ।
ko daṇḍaḥ kīdṛśo daṇḍaḥ kiṃrūpaḥ kimparāyaṇaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: etadicCAmyahaM jYAtuM tattvena BaratarzaBa । ko daRqaH kIdfSo daRqaH kiMrUpaH kimparAyaRaH ॥5॥

text: kimātmakaḥ kathaṃbhūtaḥ katimūrtiḥ kathamprabhuḥ । jāgarti sa kathaṃ daṇḍaḥ prajāsvavahitātmakaḥ ॥6॥
html:
kimātmakaḥ kathaṃbhūtaḥ katimūrtiḥ kathamprabhuḥ ।
jāgarti sa kathaṃ daṇḍaḥ prajāsvavahitātmakaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: kimAtmakaH kaTaMBUtaH katimUrtiH kaTampraBuH । jAgarti sa kaTaM daRqaH prajAsvavahitAtmakaH ॥6॥

text: kaśca pūrvāparamidaṃ jāgarti paripālayan । kaśca vijñāyate pūrvaṃ ko'paro daṇḍasañjñitaḥ । kiṃsaṃsthaśca bhaveddaṇḍaḥ kā cāsya gatiriṣyate ॥7॥
html:
kaśca pūrvāparamidaṃ jāgarti paripālayan ।
kaśca vijñāyate pūrvaṃ ko'paro daṇḍasañjñitaḥ ।
kiṃsaṃsthaśca bhaveddaṇḍaḥ kā cāsya gatiriṣyate ॥7॥
slp1: kaSca pUrvAparamidaM jAgarti paripAlayan । kaSca vijYAyate pUrvaM ko'paro daRqasaYjYitaH । kiMsaMsTaSca BaveddaRqaH kA cAsya gatirizyate ॥7॥

text: śṛṇu kauravya yo daṇḍo vyavahāryo yathā ca saḥ । yasminhi sarvamāyattaṃ sa daṇḍa iha kevalaḥ ॥8॥
html:
śṛṇu kauravya yo daṇḍo vyavahāryo yathā ca saḥ ।
yasminhi sarvamāyattaṃ sa daṇḍa iha kevalaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: SfRu kOravya yo daRqo vyavahAryo yaTA ca saH । yasminhi sarvamAyattaM sa daRqa iha kevalaH ॥8॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dharmasyākhyā mahārāja vyavahāra itīṣyate । tasya lopaḥ kathaṃ na syāllokeṣvavahitātmanaḥ । ityarthaṃ vyavahārasya vyavahāratvamiṣyate ॥9॥
html:
dharmasyākhyā mahārāja vyavahāra itīṣyate ।
tasya lopaḥ kathaṃ na syāllokeṣvavahitātmanaḥ ।
ityarthaṃ vyavahārasya vyavahāratvamiṣyate ॥9॥
slp1: DarmasyAKyA mahArAja vyavahAra itIzyate । tasya lopaH kaTaM na syAllokezvavahitAtmanaH । ityarTaM vyavahArasya vyavahAratvamizyate ॥9॥

text: api caitatpurā rājanmanunā proktamāditaḥ । supraṇītena daṇḍena priyāpriyasamātmanā । prajā rakṣati yaḥ samyagdharma eva sa kevalaḥ ॥10॥
html:
api caitatpurā rājanmanunā proktamāditaḥ ।
supraṇītena daṇḍena priyāpriyasamātmanā ।
prajā rakṣati yaḥ samyagdharma eva sa kevalaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: api cEtatpurA rAjanmanunA proktamAditaH । supraRItena daRqena priyApriyasamAtmanA । prajA rakzati yaH samyagDarma eva sa kevalaH ॥10॥

text: athoktametadvacanaṃ prāgeva manunā purā । janma coktaṃ vasiṣṭhena brahmaṇo vacanaṃ mahat ॥11॥
html:
athoktametadvacanaṃ prāgeva manunā purā ।
janma coktaṃ vasiṣṭhena brahmaṇo vacanaṃ mahat ॥11॥
slp1: aToktametadvacanaM prAgeva manunA purA । janma coktaM vasizWena brahmaRo vacanaM mahat ॥11॥

text: prāgidaṃ vacanaṃ proktamataḥ prāgvacanaṃ viduḥ । vyavahārasya cākhyānādvyavahāra ihocyate ॥12॥
html:
prāgidaṃ vacanaṃ proktamataḥ prāgvacanaṃ viduḥ ।
vyavahārasya cākhyānādvyavahāra ihocyate ॥12॥
slp1: prAgidaM vacanaM proktamataH prAgvacanaM viduH । vyavahArasya cAKyAnAdvyavahAra ihocyate ॥12॥

text: daṇḍāttrivargaḥ satataṃ supraṇītātpravartate । daivaṃ hi paramo daṇḍo rūpato'gnirivocchikhaḥ ॥13॥
html:
daṇḍāttrivargaḥ satataṃ supraṇītātpravartate ।
daivaṃ hi paramo daṇḍo rūpato'gnirivocchikhaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: daRqAttrivargaH satataM supraRItAtpravartate । dEvaM hi paramo daRqo rUpato'gnirivocCiKaH ॥13॥

text: nīlotpaladalaśyāmaścaturdaṃṣṭraścaturbhujaḥ । aṣṭapānnaikanayanaḥ śaṅkukarṇordhvaromavān ॥14॥
html:
nīlotpaladalaśyāmaścaturdaṃṣṭraścaturbhujaḥ ।
aṣṭapānnaikanayanaḥ śaṅkukarṇordhvaromavān ॥14॥
slp1: nIlotpaladalaSyAmaScaturdaMzwraScaturBujaH । azwapAnnEkanayanaH SaNkukarRorDvaromavAn ॥14॥

text: jaṭī dvijihvastāmrāsyo mṛgarājatanucchadaḥ । etadrūpaṃ bibhartyugraṃ daṇḍo nityaṃ durāvaraḥ ॥15॥
html:
jaṭī dvijihvastāmrāsyo mṛgarājatanucchadaḥ ।
etadrūpaṃ bibhartyugraṃ daṇḍo nityaṃ durāvaraḥ ॥15॥
slp1: jawI dvijihvastAmrAsyo mfgarAjatanucCadaH । etadrUpaM biBartyugraM daRqo nityaM durAvaraH ॥15॥

text: asirgadā dhanuḥ śaktistriśūlaṃ mudgaraḥ śaraḥ । musalaṃ paraśuścakraṃ prāso daṇḍarṣṭitomarāḥ ॥16॥
html:
asirgadā dhanuḥ śaktistriśūlaṃ mudgaraḥ śaraḥ ।
musalaṃ paraśuścakraṃ prāso daṇḍarṣṭitomarāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: asirgadA DanuH SaktistriSUlaM mudgaraH SaraH । musalaM paraSuScakraM prAso daRqarzwitomarAH ॥16॥

text: sarvapraharaṇīyāni santi yānīha kānicit । daṇḍa eva hi sarvātmā loke carati mūrtimān ॥17॥
html:
sarvapraharaṇīyāni santi yānīha kānicit ।
daṇḍa eva hi sarvātmā loke carati mūrtimān ॥17॥
slp1: sarvapraharaRIyAni santi yAnIha kAnicit । daRqa eva hi sarvAtmA loke carati mUrtimAn ॥17॥

text: bhindaṃśchindanrujankṛntandārayanpāṭayaṃstathā । ghātayannabhidhāvaṃśca daṇḍa eva caratyuta ॥18॥
html:
bhindaṃśchindanrujankṛntandārayanpāṭayaṃstathā ।
ghātayannabhidhāvaṃśca daṇḍa eva caratyuta ॥18॥
slp1: BindaMSCindanrujankfntandArayanpAwayaMstaTA । GAtayannaBiDAvaMSca daRqa eva caratyuta ॥18॥

text: asirviśasano dharmastīkṣṇavartmā durāsadaḥ । śrīgarbho vijayaḥ śāstā vyavahāraḥ prajāgaraḥ ॥19॥
html:
asirviśasano dharmastīkṣṇavartmā durāsadaḥ ।
śrīgarbho vijayaḥ śāstā vyavahāraḥ prajāgaraḥ ॥19॥
slp1: asirviSasano DarmastIkzRavartmA durAsadaH । SrIgarBo vijayaH SAstA vyavahAraH prajAgaraH ॥19॥

text: śāstraṃ brāhmaṇamantraśca śāstā prāgvacanaṃ gataḥ । dharmapālo'kṣaro devaḥ satyago nityago grahaḥ ॥20॥
html:
śāstraṃ brāhmaṇamantraśca śāstā prāgvacanaṃ gataḥ ।
dharmapālo'kṣaro devaḥ satyago nityago grahaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: SAstraM brAhmaRamantraSca SAstA prAgvacanaM gataH । DarmapAlo'kzaro devaH satyago nityago grahaH ॥20॥

text: asaṅgo rudratanayo manujyeṣṭhaḥ śivaṅkaraḥ । nāmānyetāni daṇḍasya kīrtitāni yudhiṣṭhira ॥21॥
html:
asaṅgo rudratanayo manujyeṣṭhaḥ śivaṅkaraḥ ।
nāmānyetāni daṇḍasya kīrtitāni yudhiṣṭhira ॥21॥
slp1: asaNgo rudratanayo manujyezWaH SivaNkaraH । nAmAnyetAni daRqasya kIrtitAni yuDizWira ॥21॥

text: daṇḍo hi bhagavānviṣṇuryajño nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ । śaśvadrūpaṃ mahadbibhranmahāpuruṣa ucyate ॥22॥
html:
daṇḍo hi bhagavānviṣṇuryajño nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
śaśvadrūpaṃ mahadbibhranmahāpuruṣa ucyate ॥22॥
slp1: daRqo hi BagavAnvizRuryajYo nArAyaRaH praBuH । SaSvadrUpaM mahadbiBranmahApuruza ucyate ॥22॥

text: yathoktā brahmakanyeti lakṣmīrnītiḥ sarasvatī । daṇḍanītirjagaddhātrī daṇḍo hi bahuvigrahaḥ ॥23॥
html:
yathoktā brahmakanyeti lakṣmīrnītiḥ sarasvatī ।
daṇḍanītirjagaddhātrī daṇḍo hi bahuvigrahaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: yaToktA brahmakanyeti lakzmIrnItiH sarasvatI । daRqanItirjagadDAtrI daRqo hi bahuvigrahaH ॥23॥

text: arthānarthau sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ dharmādharmau balābale । daurbhāgyaṃ bhāgadheyaṃ ca puṇyāpuṇye guṇāguṇau ॥24॥
html:
arthānarthau sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ dharmādharmau balābale ।
daurbhāgyaṃ bhāgadheyaṃ ca puṇyāpuṇye guṇāguṇau ॥24॥
slp1: arTAnarTO suKaM duHKaM DarmADarmO balAbale । dOrBAgyaM BAgaDeyaM ca puRyApuRye guRAguRO ॥24॥

text: kāmākāmāvṛturmāsaḥ śarvarī divasaḥ kṣaṇaḥ । aprasādaḥ prasādaśca harṣaḥ krodhaḥ śamo damaḥ ॥25॥
html:
kāmākāmāvṛturmāsaḥ śarvarī divasaḥ kṣaṇaḥ ।
aprasādaḥ prasādaśca harṣaḥ krodhaḥ śamo damaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: kAmAkAmAvfturmAsaH SarvarI divasaH kzaRaH । aprasAdaH prasAdaSca harzaH kroDaH Samo damaH ॥25॥

text: daivaṃ puruṣakāraśca mokṣāmokṣau bhayābhaye । hiṃsāhiṃse tapo yajñaḥ saṃyamo'tha viṣāviṣam ॥26॥
html:
daivaṃ puruṣakāraśca mokṣāmokṣau bhayābhaye ।
hiṃsāhiṃse tapo yajñaḥ saṃyamo'tha viṣāviṣam ॥26॥
slp1: dEvaM puruzakAraSca mokzAmokzO BayABaye । hiMsAhiMse tapo yajYaH saMyamo'Ta vizAvizam ॥26॥

text: antaścādiśca madhyaṃ ca kṛtyānāṃ ca prapañcanam । madaḥ pramādo darpaśca dambho dhairyaṃ nayānayau ॥27॥
html:
antaścādiśca madhyaṃ ca kṛtyānāṃ ca prapañcanam ।
madaḥ pramādo darpaśca dambho dhairyaṃ nayānayau ॥27॥
slp1: antaScAdiSca maDyaM ca kftyAnAM ca prapaYcanam । madaH pramAdo darpaSca damBo DEryaM nayAnayO ॥27॥

text: aśaktiḥ śaktirityeva mānastambhau vyayāvyayau । vinayaśca visargaśca kālākālau ca bhārata ॥28॥
html:
aśaktiḥ śaktirityeva mānastambhau vyayāvyayau ।
vinayaśca visargaśca kālākālau ca bhārata ॥28॥
slp1: aSaktiH Saktirityeva mAnastamBO vyayAvyayO । vinayaSca visargaSca kAlAkAlO ca BArata ॥28॥

text: anṛtaṃ jñājñatā satyaṃ śraddhāśraddhe tathaiva ca । klībatā vyavasāyaśca lābhālābhau jayājayau ॥29॥
html:
anṛtaṃ jñājñatā satyaṃ śraddhāśraddhe tathaiva ca ।
klībatā vyavasāyaśca lābhālābhau jayājayau ॥29॥
slp1: anftaM jYAjYatA satyaM SradDASradDe taTEva ca । klIbatA vyavasAyaSca lABAlABO jayAjayO ॥29॥

text: tīkṣṇatā mṛdutā mṛtyurāgamānāgamau tathā । virāddhiścaiva rāddhiśca kāryākārye balābale ॥30॥
html:
tīkṣṇatā mṛdutā mṛtyurāgamānāgamau tathā ।
virāddhiścaiva rāddhiśca kāryākārye balābale ॥30॥
slp1: tIkzRatA mfdutA mftyurAgamAnAgamO taTA । virAdDiScEva rAdDiSca kAryAkArye balAbale ॥30॥

text: asūyā cānasūyā ca dharmādharmau tathaiva ca । apatrapānapatrape hrīśca sampadvipacca ha ॥31॥
html:
asūyā cānasūyā ca dharmādharmau tathaiva ca ।
apatrapānapatrape hrīśca sampadvipacca ha ॥31॥
slp1: asUyA cAnasUyA ca DarmADarmO taTEva ca । apatrapAnapatrape hrISca sampadvipacca ha ॥31॥

text: tejaḥ karmaṇi pāṇḍityaṃ vākśaktistattvabuddhitā । evaṃ daṇḍasya kauravya loke'sminbahurūpatā ॥32॥
html:
tejaḥ karmaṇi pāṇḍityaṃ vākśaktistattvabuddhitā ।
evaṃ daṇḍasya kauravya loke'sminbahurūpatā ॥32॥
slp1: tejaH karmaRi pARqityaM vAkSaktistattvabudDitA । evaM daRqasya kOravya loke'sminbahurUpatA ॥32॥

text: na syādyadīha daṇḍo vai pramatheyuḥ parasparam । bhayāddaṇḍasya cānyonyaṃ ghnanti naiva yudhiṣṭhira ॥33॥
html:
na syādyadīha daṇḍo vai pramatheyuḥ parasparam ।
bhayāddaṇḍasya cānyonyaṃ ghnanti naiva yudhiṣṭhira ॥33॥
slp1: na syAdyadIha daRqo vE pramaTeyuH parasparam । BayAddaRqasya cAnyonyaM Gnanti nEva yuDizWira ॥33॥

text: daṇḍena rakṣyamāṇā hi rājannaharahaḥ prajāḥ । rājānaṃ vardhayantīha tasmāddaṇḍaḥ parāyaṇam ॥34॥
html:
daṇḍena rakṣyamāṇā hi rājannaharahaḥ prajāḥ ।
rājānaṃ vardhayantīha tasmāddaṇḍaḥ parāyaṇam ॥34॥
slp1: daRqena rakzyamARA hi rAjannaharahaH prajAH । rAjAnaM varDayantIha tasmAddaRqaH parAyaRam ॥34॥

text: vyavasthāpayati kṣipramimaṃ lokaṃ nareśvara । satye vyavasthito dharmo brāhmaṇeṣvavatiṣṭhate ॥35॥
html:
vyavasthāpayati kṣipramimaṃ lokaṃ nareśvara ।
satye vyavasthito dharmo brāhmaṇeṣvavatiṣṭhate ॥35॥
slp1: vyavasTApayati kzipramimaM lokaM nareSvara । satye vyavasTito Darmo brAhmaRezvavatizWate ॥35॥

text: dharmayuktā dvijāḥ śreṣṭhā vedayuktā bhavanti ca । babhūva yajño vedebhyo yajñaḥ prīṇāti devatāḥ ॥36॥
html:
dharmayuktā dvijāḥ śreṣṭhā vedayuktā bhavanti ca ।
babhūva yajño vedebhyo yajñaḥ prīṇāti devatāḥ ॥36॥
slp1: DarmayuktA dvijAH SrezWA vedayuktA Bavanti ca । baBUva yajYo vedeByo yajYaH prIRAti devatAH ॥36॥

text: prītāśca devatā nityamindre paridadatyuta । annaṃ dadāti śakraścāpyanugṛhṇannimāḥ prajāḥ ॥37॥
html:
prītāśca devatā nityamindre paridadatyuta ।
annaṃ dadāti śakraścāpyanugṛhṇannimāḥ prajāḥ ॥37॥
slp1: prItASca devatA nityamindre paridadatyuta । annaM dadAti SakraScApyanugfhRannimAH prajAH ॥37॥

text: prāṇāśca sarvabhūtānāṃ nityamanne pratiṣṭhitāḥ । tasmātprajāḥ pratiṣṭhante daṇḍo jāgarti tāsu ca ॥38॥
html:
prāṇāśca sarvabhūtānāṃ nityamanne pratiṣṭhitāḥ ।
tasmātprajāḥ pratiṣṭhante daṇḍo jāgarti tāsu ca ॥38॥
slp1: prARASca sarvaBUtAnAM nityamanne pratizWitAH । tasmAtprajAH pratizWante daRqo jAgarti tAsu ca ॥38॥

text: evaṃprayojanaścaiva daṇḍaḥ kṣatriyatāṃ gataḥ । rakṣanprajāḥ prajāgarti nityaṃ suvihito'kṣaraḥ ॥39॥
html:
evaṃprayojanaścaiva daṇḍaḥ kṣatriyatāṃ gataḥ ।
rakṣanprajāḥ prajāgarti nityaṃ suvihito'kṣaraḥ ॥39॥
slp1: evaMprayojanaScEva daRqaH kzatriyatAM gataH । rakzanprajAH prajAgarti nityaM suvihito'kzaraH ॥39॥

text: īśvaraḥ puruṣaḥ prāṇaḥ sattvaṃ vittaṃ prajāpatiḥ । bhūtātmā jīva ityeva nāmabhiḥ procyate'ṣṭabhiḥ ॥40॥
html:
īśvaraḥ puruṣaḥ prāṇaḥ sattvaṃ vittaṃ prajāpatiḥ ।
bhūtātmā jīva ityeva nāmabhiḥ procyate'ṣṭabhiḥ ॥40॥
slp1: ISvaraH puruzaH prARaH sattvaM vittaM prajApatiH । BUtAtmA jIva ityeva nAmaBiH procyate'zwaBiH ॥40॥

text: adadaddaṇḍa evāsmai dhruvamaiśvaryameva ca । bale nayaśca saṃyuktaḥ sadā pañcavidhātmakaḥ ॥41॥
html:
adadaddaṇḍa evāsmai dhruvamaiśvaryameva ca ।
bale nayaśca saṃyuktaḥ sadā pañcavidhātmakaḥ ॥41॥
slp1: adadaddaRqa evAsmE DruvamESvaryameva ca । bale nayaSca saMyuktaH sadA paYcaviDAtmakaH ॥41॥

text: kulabāhudhanāmātyāḥ prajñā coktā balāni ca । āhāryaṃ cāṣṭakairdravyairbalamanyadyudhiṣṭhira ॥42॥
html:
kulabāhudhanāmātyāḥ prajñā coktā balāni ca ।
āhāryaṃ cāṣṭakairdravyairbalamanyadyudhiṣṭhira ॥42॥
slp1: kulabAhuDanAmAtyAH prajYA coktA balAni ca । AhAryaM cAzwakErdravyErbalamanyadyuDizWira ॥42॥

text: hastino'śvā rathāḥ pattirnāvo viṣṭistathaiva ca । daiśikāścārakāścaiva tadaṣṭāṅgaṃ balaṃ smṛtam ॥43॥
html:
hastino'śvā rathāḥ pattirnāvo viṣṭistathaiva ca ।
daiśikāścārakāścaiva tadaṣṭāṅgaṃ balaṃ smṛtam ॥43॥
slp1: hastino'SvA raTAH pattirnAvo vizwistaTEva ca । dESikAScArakAScEva tadazwANgaM balaM smftam ॥43॥

text: aṣṭāṅgasya tu yuktasya hastino hastiyāyinaḥ । aśvārohāḥ padātāśca mantriṇo rasadāśca ye ॥44॥
html:
aṣṭāṅgasya tu yuktasya hastino hastiyāyinaḥ ।
aśvārohāḥ padātāśca mantriṇo rasadāśca ye ॥44॥
slp1: azwANgasya tu yuktasya hastino hastiyAyinaH । aSvArohAH padAtASca mantriRo rasadASca ye ॥44॥

text: bhikṣukāḥ prāḍvivākāśca mauhūrtā daivacintakāḥ । kośo mitrāṇi dhānyaṃ ca sarvopakaraṇāni ca ॥45॥
html:
bhikṣukāḥ prāḍvivākāśca mauhūrtā daivacintakāḥ ।
kośo mitrāṇi dhānyaṃ ca sarvopakaraṇāni ca ॥45॥
slp1: BikzukAH prAqvivAkASca mOhUrtA dEvacintakAH । koSo mitrARi DAnyaM ca sarvopakaraRAni ca ॥45॥

text: saptaprakṛti cāṣṭāṅgaṃ śarīramiha yadviduḥ । rājyasya daṇḍa evāṅgaṃ daṇḍaḥ prabhava eva ca ॥46॥
html:
saptaprakṛti cāṣṭāṅgaṃ śarīramiha yadviduḥ ।
rājyasya daṇḍa evāṅgaṃ daṇḍaḥ prabhava eva ca ॥46॥
slp1: saptaprakfti cAzwANgaM SarIramiha yadviduH । rAjyasya daRqa evANgaM daRqaH praBava eva ca ॥46॥

text: īśvareṇa prayatnena dhāraṇe kṣatriyasya hi । daṇḍo dattaḥ samānātmā daṇḍo hīdaṃ sanātanam । rājñāṃ pūjyatamo nānyo yathādharmapradarśanaḥ ॥47॥
html:
īśvareṇa prayatnena dhāraṇe kṣatriyasya hi ।
daṇḍo dattaḥ samānātmā daṇḍo hīdaṃ sanātanam ।
rājñāṃ pūjyatamo nānyo yathādharmapradarśanaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: ISvareRa prayatnena DAraRe kzatriyasya hi । daRqo dattaH samAnAtmA daRqo hIdaM sanAtanam । rAjYAM pUjyatamo nAnyo yaTADarmapradarSanaH ॥47॥

text: brahmaṇā lokarakṣārthaṃ svadharmasthāpanāya ca । bhartṛpratyaya utpanno vyavahārastathāparaḥ । tasmādyaḥ sahito dṛṣṭo bhartṛpratyayalakṣaṇaḥ ॥48॥
html:
brahmaṇā lokarakṣārthaṃ svadharmasthāpanāya ca ।
bhartṛpratyaya utpanno vyavahārastathāparaḥ ।
tasmādyaḥ sahito dṛṣṭo bhartṛpratyayalakṣaṇaḥ ॥48॥
slp1: brahmaRA lokarakzArTaM svaDarmasTApanAya ca । Bartfpratyaya utpanno vyavahArastaTAparaH । tasmAdyaH sahito dfzwo BartfpratyayalakzaRaH ॥48॥

text: vyavahārastu vedātmā vedapratyaya ucyate । maulaśca naraśārdūla śāstroktaśca tathāparaḥ ॥49॥
html:
vyavahārastu vedātmā vedapratyaya ucyate ।
maulaśca naraśārdūla śāstroktaśca tathāparaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: vyavahArastu vedAtmA vedapratyaya ucyate । mOlaSca naraSArdUla SAstroktaSca taTAparaH ॥49॥

text: ukto yaścāpi daṇḍo'sau bhartṛpratyayalakṣaṇaḥ । jñeyo na sa narendrastho daṇḍapratyaya eva ca ॥50॥
html:
ukto yaścāpi daṇḍo'sau bhartṛpratyayalakṣaṇaḥ ।
jñeyo na sa narendrastho daṇḍapratyaya eva ca ॥50॥
slp1: ukto yaScApi daRqo'sO BartfpratyayalakzaRaH । jYeyo na sa narendrasTo daRqapratyaya eva ca ॥50॥

text: daṇḍapratyayadṛṣṭo'pi vyavahārātmakaḥ smṛtaḥ । vyavahāraḥ smṛto yaśca sa vedaviṣayātmakaḥ ॥51॥
html:
daṇḍapratyayadṛṣṭo'pi vyavahārātmakaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
vyavahāraḥ smṛto yaśca sa vedaviṣayātmakaḥ ॥51॥
slp1: daRqapratyayadfzwo'pi vyavahArAtmakaH smftaH । vyavahAraH smfto yaSca sa vedavizayAtmakaH ॥51॥

text: yaśca vedaprasūtātmā sa dharmo guṇadarśakaḥ । dharmapratyaya utpanno yathādharmaḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ ॥52॥
html:
yaśca vedaprasūtātmā sa dharmo guṇadarśakaḥ ।
dharmapratyaya utpanno yathādharmaḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ ॥52॥
slp1: yaSca vedaprasUtAtmA sa Darmo guRadarSakaH । Darmapratyaya utpanno yaTADarmaH kftAtmaBiH ॥52॥

text: vyavahāraḥ prajāgoptā brahmadiṣṭo yudhiṣṭhira । trīndhārayati lokānvai satyātmā bhūtivardhanaḥ ॥53॥
html:
vyavahāraḥ prajāgoptā brahmadiṣṭo yudhiṣṭhira ।
trīndhārayati lokānvai satyātmā bhūtivardhanaḥ ॥53॥
slp1: vyavahAraH prajAgoptA brahmadizwo yuDizWira । trInDArayati lokAnvE satyAtmA BUtivarDanaH ॥53॥

text: yaśca daṇḍaḥ sa dṛṣṭo no vyavahāraḥ sanātanaḥ । vyavahāraśca yo dṛṣṭaḥ sa dharma iti naḥ śrutaḥ । yaśca vedaḥ sa vai dharmo yaśca dharmaḥ sa satpathaḥ ॥54॥
html:
yaśca daṇḍaḥ sa dṛṣṭo no vyavahāraḥ sanātanaḥ ।
vyavahāraśca yo dṛṣṭaḥ sa dharma iti naḥ śrutaḥ ।
yaśca vedaḥ sa vai dharmo yaśca dharmaḥ sa satpathaḥ ॥54॥
slp1: yaSca daRqaH sa dfzwo no vyavahAraH sanAtanaH । vyavahAraSca yo dfzwaH sa Darma iti naH SrutaH । yaSca vedaH sa vE Darmo yaSca DarmaH sa satpaTaH ॥54॥

text: brahmā prajāpatiḥ pūrvaṃ babhūvātha pitāmahaḥ । lokānāṃ sa hi sarveṣāṃ sasurāsurarakṣasām । samanuṣyoragavatāṃ kartā caiva sa bhūtakṛt ॥55॥
html:
brahmā prajāpatiḥ pūrvaṃ babhūvātha pitāmahaḥ ।
lokānāṃ sa hi sarveṣāṃ sasurāsurarakṣasām ।
samanuṣyoragavatāṃ kartā caiva sa bhūtakṛt ॥55॥
slp1: brahmA prajApatiH pUrvaM baBUvATa pitAmahaH । lokAnAM sa hi sarvezAM sasurAsurarakzasAm । samanuzyoragavatAM kartA cEva sa BUtakft ॥55॥

text: tato no vyavahāro'yaṃ bhartṛpratyayalakṣaṇaḥ । tasmādidamavocāma vyavahāranidarśanam ॥56॥
html:
tato no vyavahāro'yaṃ bhartṛpratyayalakṣaṇaḥ ।
tasmādidamavocāma vyavahāranidarśanam ॥56॥
slp1: tato no vyavahAro'yaM BartfpratyayalakzaRaH । tasmAdidamavocAma vyavahAranidarSanam ॥56॥

text: mātā pitā ca bhrātā ca bhāryā cātha purohitaḥ । nādaṇḍyo vidyate rājñāṃ yaḥ svadharme na tiṣṭhati] ॥57॥
html:
mātā pitā ca bhrātā ca bhāryā cātha purohitaḥ ।
nādaṇḍyo vidyate rājñāṃ yaḥ svadharme na tiṣṭhati] ॥57॥
slp1: mAtA pitA ca BrAtA ca BAryA cATa purohitaH । nAdaRqyo vidyate rAjYAM yaH svaDarme na tizWati] ॥57॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । aṅgeṣu rājā dyutimānvasuhoma iti śrutaḥ ॥1॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
aṅgeṣu rājā dyutimānvasuhoma iti śrutaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । aNgezu rAjA dyutimAnvasuhoma iti SrutaH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sa rājā dharmanityaḥ sansaha patnyā mahātapāḥ । muñjapṛṣṭhaṃ jagāmātha devarṣigaṇapūjitam ॥2॥
html:
sa rājā dharmanityaḥ sansaha patnyā mahātapāḥ ।
muñjapṛṣṭhaṃ jagāmātha devarṣigaṇapūjitam ॥2॥
slp1: sa rAjA DarmanityaH sansaha patnyA mahAtapAH । muYjapfzWaM jagAmATa devarzigaRapUjitam ॥2॥

text: tatra śṛṅge himavato merau kanakaparvate । yatra muñjavaṭe rāmo jaṭāharaṇamādiśat ॥3॥
html:
tatra śṛṅge himavato merau kanakaparvate ।
yatra muñjavaṭe rāmo jaṭāharaṇamādiśat ॥3॥
slp1: tatra SfNge himavato merO kanakaparvate । yatra muYjavawe rAmo jawAharaRamAdiSat ॥3॥

text: tadāprabhṛti rājendra ṛṣibhiḥ saṃśitavrataiḥ । muñjapṛṣṭha iti proktaḥ sa deśo rudrasevitaḥ ॥4॥
html:
tadāprabhṛti rājendra ṛṣibhiḥ saṃśitavrataiḥ ।
muñjapṛṣṭha iti proktaḥ sa deśo rudrasevitaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: tadApraBfti rAjendra fziBiH saMSitavratEH । muYjapfzWa iti proktaH sa deSo rudrasevitaH ॥4॥

text: sa tatra bahubhiryuktaḥ sadā śrutimayairguṇaiḥ । brāhmaṇānāmanumato devarṣisadṛśo'bhavat ॥5॥
html:
sa tatra bahubhiryuktaḥ sadā śrutimayairguṇaiḥ ।
brāhmaṇānāmanumato devarṣisadṛśo'bhavat ॥5॥
slp1: sa tatra bahuBiryuktaH sadA SrutimayErguREH । brAhmaRAnAmanumato devarzisadfSo'Bavat ॥5॥

text: taṃ kadācidadīnātmā sakhā śakrasya mānitaḥ । abhyāgacchanmahīpālo māndhātā śatrukarśanaḥ ॥6॥
html:
taṃ kadācidadīnātmā sakhā śakrasya mānitaḥ ।
abhyāgacchanmahīpālo māndhātā śatrukarśanaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: taM kadAcidadInAtmA saKA Sakrasya mAnitaH । aByAgacCanmahIpAlo mAnDAtA SatrukarSanaH ॥6॥

text: so'bhisṛtya tu māndhātā vasuhomaṃ narādhipam । dṛṣṭvā prakṛṣṭaṃ tapasā vinayenābhyatiṣṭhata ॥7॥
html:
so'bhisṛtya tu māndhātā vasuhomaṃ narādhipam ।
dṛṣṭvā prakṛṣṭaṃ tapasā vinayenābhyatiṣṭhata ॥7॥
slp1: so'Bisftya tu mAnDAtA vasuhomaM narADipam । dfzwvA prakfzwaM tapasA vinayenAByatizWata ॥7॥

text: vasuhomo'pi rājño vai gāmarghyaṃ ca nyavedayat । aṣṭāṅgasya ca rājyasya papraccha kuśalaṃ tadā ॥8॥
html:
vasuhomo'pi rājño vai gāmarghyaṃ ca nyavedayat ।
aṣṭāṅgasya ca rājyasya papraccha kuśalaṃ tadā ॥8॥
slp1: vasuhomo'pi rAjYo vE gAmarGyaM ca nyavedayat । azwANgasya ca rAjyasya papracCa kuSalaM tadA ॥8॥

text: sadbhirācaritaṃ pūrvaṃ yathāvadanuyāyinam । apṛcchadvasuhomastaṃ rājankiṃ karavāṇi te ॥9॥
html:
sadbhirācaritaṃ pūrvaṃ yathāvadanuyāyinam ।
apṛcchadvasuhomastaṃ rājankiṃ karavāṇi te ॥9॥
slp1: sadBirAcaritaM pUrvaM yaTAvadanuyAyinam । apfcCadvasuhomastaM rAjankiM karavARi te ॥9॥

text: so'bravītparamaprīto māndhātā rājasattamam । vasuhomaṃ mahāprājñamāsīnaṃ kurunandana ॥10॥
html:
so'bravītparamaprīto māndhātā rājasattamam ।
vasuhomaṃ mahāprājñamāsīnaṃ kurunandana ॥10॥
slp1: so'bravItparamaprIto mAnDAtA rAjasattamam । vasuhomaM mahAprAjYamAsInaM kurunandana ॥10॥

text: bṛhaspatermataṃ rājannadhītaṃ sakalaṃ tvayā । tathaivauśanasaṃ śāstraṃ vijñātaṃ te narādhipa ॥11॥
html:
bṛhaspatermataṃ rājannadhītaṃ sakalaṃ tvayā ।
tathaivauśanasaṃ śāstraṃ vijñātaṃ te narādhipa ॥11॥
slp1: bfhaspatermataM rAjannaDItaM sakalaM tvayA । taTEvOSanasaM SAstraM vijYAtaM te narADipa ॥11॥

text: tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi daṇḍa utpadyate katham । kiṃ vāpi pūrvaṃ jāgarti kiṃ vā paramamucyate ॥12॥
html:
tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi daṇḍa utpadyate katham ।
kiṃ vāpi pūrvaṃ jāgarti kiṃ vā paramamucyate ॥12॥
slp1: tadahaM SrotumicCAmi daRqa utpadyate kaTam । kiM vApi pUrvaM jAgarti kiM vA paramamucyate ॥12॥

text: kathaṃ kṣatriyasaṃsthaśca daṇḍaḥ sampratyavasthitaḥ । brūhi me sumahāprājña dadāmyācāryavetanam ॥13॥
html:
kathaṃ kṣatriyasaṃsthaśca daṇḍaḥ sampratyavasthitaḥ ।
brūhi me sumahāprājña dadāmyācāryavetanam ॥13॥
slp1: kaTaM kzatriyasaMsTaSca daRqaH sampratyavasTitaH । brUhi me sumahAprAjYa dadAmyAcAryavetanam ॥13॥

text: śṛṇu rājanyathā daṇḍaḥ sambhūto lokasaṅgrahaḥ । prajāvinayarakṣārthaṃ dharmasyātmā sanātanaḥ ॥14॥
html:
śṛṇu rājanyathā daṇḍaḥ sambhūto lokasaṅgrahaḥ ।
prajāvinayarakṣārthaṃ dharmasyātmā sanātanaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: SfRu rAjanyaTA daRqaH samBUto lokasaNgrahaH । prajAvinayarakzArTaM DarmasyAtmA sanAtanaH ॥14॥
author: vasuhoma uvāca ।

text: brahmā yiyakṣurbhagavānsarvalokapitāmahaḥ । ṛtvijaṃ nātmanā tulyaṃ dadarśeti hi naḥ śrutam ॥15॥
html:
brahmā yiyakṣurbhagavānsarvalokapitāmahaḥ ।
ṛtvijaṃ nātmanā tulyaṃ dadarśeti hi naḥ śrutam ॥15॥
slp1: brahmA yiyakzurBagavAnsarvalokapitAmahaH । ftvijaM nAtmanA tulyaM dadarSeti hi naH Srutam ॥15॥

text: sa garbhaṃ śirasā devo varṣapūgānadhārayat । pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu sa garbhaḥ kṣuvato'patat ॥16॥
html:
sa garbhaṃ śirasā devo varṣapūgānadhārayat ।
pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu sa garbhaḥ kṣuvato'patat ॥16॥
slp1: sa garBaM SirasA devo varzapUgAnaDArayat । pUrRe varzasahasre tu sa garBaH kzuvato'patat ॥16॥

text: sa kṣupo nāma sambhūtaḥ prajāpatirarindama । ṛtvigāsīttadā rājanyajñe tasya mahātmanaḥ ॥17॥
html:
sa kṣupo nāma sambhūtaḥ prajāpatirarindama ।
ṛtvigāsīttadā rājanyajñe tasya mahātmanaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: sa kzupo nAma samBUtaH prajApatirarindama । ftvigAsIttadA rAjanyajYe tasya mahAtmanaH ॥17॥

text: tasminpravṛtte satre tu brahmaṇaḥ pārthivarṣabha । hṛṣṭarūpapracāratvāddaṇḍaḥ so'ntarhito'bhavat ॥18॥
html:
tasminpravṛtte satre tu brahmaṇaḥ pārthivarṣabha ।
hṛṣṭarūpapracāratvāddaṇḍaḥ so'ntarhito'bhavat ॥18॥
slp1: tasminpravftte satre tu brahmaRaH pArTivarzaBa । hfzwarUpapracAratvAddaRqaH so'ntarhito'Bavat ॥18॥

text: tasminnantarhite cātha prajānāṃ saṅkaro'bhavat । naiva kāryaṃ na cākāryaṃ bhojyābhojyaṃ na vidyate ॥19॥
html:
tasminnantarhite cātha prajānāṃ saṅkaro'bhavat ।
naiva kāryaṃ na cākāryaṃ bhojyābhojyaṃ na vidyate ॥19॥
slp1: tasminnantarhite cATa prajAnAM saNkaro'Bavat । nEva kAryaM na cAkAryaM BojyABojyaM na vidyate ॥19॥

text: peyāpeyaṃ kutaḥ siddhirhiṃsanti ca parasparam । gamyāgamyaṃ tadā nāsītparasvaṃ svaṃ ca vai samam ॥20॥
html:
peyāpeyaṃ kutaḥ siddhirhiṃsanti ca parasparam ।
gamyāgamyaṃ tadā nāsītparasvaṃ svaṃ ca vai samam ॥20॥
slp1: peyApeyaM kutaH sidDirhiMsanti ca parasparam । gamyAgamyaM tadA nAsItparasvaM svaM ca vE samam ॥20॥

text: parasparaṃ vilumpante sārameyā ivāmiṣam । abalaṃ balino jaghnurnirmaryādamavartata ॥21॥
html:
parasparaṃ vilumpante sārameyā ivāmiṣam ।
abalaṃ balino jaghnurnirmaryādamavartata ॥21॥
slp1: parasparaM vilumpante sArameyA ivAmizam । abalaM balino jaGnurnirmaryAdamavartata ॥21॥

text: tataḥ pitāmaho viṣṇuṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam । sampūjya varadaṃ devaṃ mahādevamathābravīt ॥22॥
html:
tataḥ pitāmaho viṣṇuṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।
sampūjya varadaṃ devaṃ mahādevamathābravīt ॥22॥
slp1: tataH pitAmaho vizRuM BagavantaM sanAtanam । sampUjya varadaM devaM mahAdevamaTAbravIt ॥22॥

text: atra sādhvanukampāṃ vai kartumarhasi kevalam । saṅkaro na bhavedatra yathā vai tadvidhīyatām ॥23॥
html:
atra sādhvanukampāṃ vai kartumarhasi kevalam ।
saṅkaro na bhavedatra yathā vai tadvidhīyatām ॥23॥
slp1: atra sADvanukampAM vE kartumarhasi kevalam । saNkaro na Bavedatra yaTA vE tadviDIyatAm ॥23॥

text: tataḥ sa bhagavāndhyātvā ciraṃ śūlajaṭādharaḥ । ātmānamātmanā daṇḍamasṛjaddevasattamaḥ ॥24॥
html:
tataḥ sa bhagavāndhyātvā ciraṃ śūlajaṭādharaḥ ।
ātmānamātmanā daṇḍamasṛjaddevasattamaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: tataH sa BagavAnDyAtvA ciraM SUlajawADaraH । AtmAnamAtmanA daRqamasfjaddevasattamaH ॥24॥

text: tasmācca dharmacaraṇāṃ nītiṃ devīṃ sarasvatīm । asṛjaddaṇḍanītiḥ sā triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā ॥25॥
html:
tasmācca dharmacaraṇāṃ nītiṃ devīṃ sarasvatīm ।
asṛjaddaṇḍanītiḥ sā triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā ॥25॥
slp1: tasmAcca DarmacaraRAM nItiM devIM sarasvatIm । asfjaddaRqanItiH sA trizu lokezu viSrutA ॥25॥

text: bhūyaḥ sa bhagavāndhyātvā ciraṃ śūlavarāyudhaḥ । tasya tasya nikāyasya cakāraikaikamīśaram ॥26॥
html:
bhūyaḥ sa bhagavāndhyātvā ciraṃ śūlavarāyudhaḥ ।
tasya tasya nikāyasya cakāraikaikamīśaram ॥26॥
slp1: BUyaH sa BagavAnDyAtvA ciraM SUlavarAyuDaH । tasya tasya nikAyasya cakArEkEkamISaram ॥26॥

text: devānāmīśvaraṃ cakre devaṃ daśaśatekṣaṇam । yamaṃ vaivasvataṃ cāpi pitṝṇāmakarotpatim ॥27॥
html:
devānāmīśvaraṃ cakre devaṃ daśaśatekṣaṇam ।
yamaṃ vaivasvataṃ cāpi pitṝṇāmakarotpatim ॥27॥
slp1: devAnAmISvaraM cakre devaM daSaSatekzaRam । yamaM vEvasvataM cApi pitFRAmakarotpatim ॥27॥

text: dhanānāṃ rakṣasāṃ cāpi kuberamapi ceśvaram । parvatānāṃ patiṃ meruṃ saritāṃ ca mahodadhim ॥28॥
html:
dhanānāṃ rakṣasāṃ cāpi kuberamapi ceśvaram ।
parvatānāṃ patiṃ meruṃ saritāṃ ca mahodadhim ॥28॥
slp1: DanAnAM rakzasAM cApi kuberamapi ceSvaram । parvatAnAM patiM meruM saritAM ca mahodaDim ॥28॥

text: apāṃ rājye surāṇāṃ ca vidadhe varuṇaṃ prabhum । mṛtyuṃ prāṇeśvaramatho tejasāṃ ca hutāśanam ॥29॥
html:
apāṃ rājye surāṇāṃ ca vidadhe varuṇaṃ prabhum ।
mṛtyuṃ prāṇeśvaramatho tejasāṃ ca hutāśanam ॥29॥
slp1: apAM rAjye surARAM ca vidaDe varuRaM praBum । mftyuM prAReSvaramaTo tejasAM ca hutASanam ॥29॥

text: rudrāṇāmapi ceśānaṃ goptāraṃ vidadhe prabhuḥ । mahātmānaṃ mahādevaṃ viśālākṣaṃ sanātanam ॥30॥
html:
rudrāṇāmapi ceśānaṃ goptāraṃ vidadhe prabhuḥ ।
mahātmānaṃ mahādevaṃ viśālākṣaṃ sanātanam ॥30॥
slp1: rudrARAmapi ceSAnaM goptAraM vidaDe praBuH । mahAtmAnaM mahAdevaM viSAlAkzaM sanAtanam ॥30॥

text: vasiṣṭhamīśaṃ viprāṇāṃ vasūnāṃ jātavedasam । tejasāṃ bhāskaraṃ cakre nakṣatrāṇāṃ niśākaram ॥31॥
html:
vasiṣṭhamīśaṃ viprāṇāṃ vasūnāṃ jātavedasam ।
tejasāṃ bhāskaraṃ cakre nakṣatrāṇāṃ niśākaram ॥31॥
slp1: vasizWamISaM viprARAM vasUnAM jAtavedasam । tejasAM BAskaraM cakre nakzatrARAM niSAkaram ॥31॥

text: vīrudhāmaṃśumantaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ ca prabhuṃ varam । kumāraṃ dvādaśabhujaṃ skandaṃ rājānamādiśat ॥32॥
html:
vīrudhāmaṃśumantaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ ca prabhuṃ varam ।
kumāraṃ dvādaśabhujaṃ skandaṃ rājānamādiśat ॥32॥
slp1: vIruDAmaMSumantaM ca BUtAnAM ca praBuM varam । kumAraM dvAdaSaBujaM skandaM rAjAnamAdiSat ॥32॥

text: kālaṃ sarveśamakarotsaṃhāravinayātmakam । mṛtyoścaturvibhāgasya duḥkhasya ca sukhasya ca ॥33॥
html:
kālaṃ sarveśamakarotsaṃhāravinayātmakam ।
mṛtyoścaturvibhāgasya duḥkhasya ca sukhasya ca ॥33॥
slp1: kAlaM sarveSamakarotsaMhAravinayAtmakam । mftyoScaturviBAgasya duHKasya ca suKasya ca ॥33॥

text: īśvaraḥ sarvadehastu rājarājo dhanādhipaḥ । sarveṣāmeva rudrāṇāṃ śūlapāṇiriti śrutiḥ ॥34॥
html:
īśvaraḥ sarvadehastu rājarājo dhanādhipaḥ ।
sarveṣāmeva rudrāṇāṃ śūlapāṇiriti śrutiḥ ॥34॥
slp1: ISvaraH sarvadehastu rAjarAjo DanADipaH । sarvezAmeva rudrARAM SUlapARiriti SrutiH ॥34॥

text: tamekaṃ brahmaṇaḥ putramanujātaṃ kṣupaṃ dadau । prajānāmadhipaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvadharmabhṛtāmapi ॥35॥
html:
tamekaṃ brahmaṇaḥ putramanujātaṃ kṣupaṃ dadau ।
prajānāmadhipaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvadharmabhṛtāmapi ॥35॥
slp1: tamekaM brahmaRaH putramanujAtaM kzupaM dadO । prajAnAmaDipaM SrezWaM sarvaDarmaBftAmapi ॥35॥

text: mahādevastatastasminvṛtte yajñe yathāvidhi । daṇḍaṃ dharmasya goptāraṃ viṣṇave satkṛtaṃ dadau ॥36॥
html:
mahādevastatastasminvṛtte yajñe yathāvidhi ।
daṇḍaṃ dharmasya goptāraṃ viṣṇave satkṛtaṃ dadau ॥36॥
slp1: mahAdevastatastasminvftte yajYe yaTAviDi । daRqaM Darmasya goptAraM vizRave satkftaM dadO ॥36॥

text: viṣṇuraṅgirase prādādaṅgirā munisattamaḥ । prādādindramarīcibhyāṃ marīcirbhṛgave dadau ॥37॥
html:
viṣṇuraṅgirase prādādaṅgirā munisattamaḥ ।
prādādindramarīcibhyāṃ marīcirbhṛgave dadau ॥37॥
slp1: vizRuraNgirase prAdAdaNgirA munisattamaH । prAdAdindramarIciByAM marIcirBfgave dadO ॥37॥

text: bhṛgurdadāvṛṣibhyastu taṃ daṇḍaṃ dharmasaṃhitam । ṛṣayo lokapālebhyo lokapālāḥ kṣupāya ca ॥38॥
html:
bhṛgurdadāvṛṣibhyastu taṃ daṇḍaṃ dharmasaṃhitam ।
ṛṣayo lokapālebhyo lokapālāḥ kṣupāya ca ॥38॥
slp1: BfgurdadAvfziByastu taM daRqaM DarmasaMhitam । fzayo lokapAleByo lokapAlAH kzupAya ca ॥38॥

text: kṣupastu manave prādādādityatanayāya ca । putrebhyaḥ śrāddhadevastu sūkṣmadharmārthakāraṇāt । taṃ dadau sūryaputrastu manurvai rakṣaṇātmakam ॥39॥
html:
kṣupastu manave prādādādityatanayāya ca ।
putrebhyaḥ śrāddhadevastu sūkṣmadharmārthakāraṇāt ।
taṃ dadau sūryaputrastu manurvai rakṣaṇātmakam ॥39॥
slp1: kzupastu manave prAdAdAdityatanayAya ca । putreByaH SrAdDadevastu sUkzmaDarmArTakAraRAt । taM dadO sUryaputrastu manurvE rakzaRAtmakam ॥39॥

text: vibhajya daṇḍaḥ kartavyo dharmeṇa na yadṛcchayā । durvācā nigraho bandho hiraṇyaṃ bāhyataḥkriyā ॥40॥
html:
vibhajya daṇḍaḥ kartavyo dharmeṇa na yadṛcchayā ।
durvācā nigraho bandho hiraṇyaṃ bāhyataḥkriyā ॥40॥
slp1: viBajya daRqaH kartavyo DarmeRa na yadfcCayA । durvAcA nigraho banDo hiraRyaM bAhyataHkriyA ॥40॥

text: vyaṅgatvaṃ ca śarīrasya vadho vā nālpakāraṇāt । śarīrapīḍāstāstāstu dehatyāgo vivāsanam ॥41॥
html:
vyaṅgatvaṃ ca śarīrasya vadho vā nālpakāraṇāt ।
śarīrapīḍāstāstāstu dehatyāgo vivāsanam ॥41॥
slp1: vyaNgatvaM ca SarIrasya vaDo vA nAlpakAraRAt । SarIrapIqAstAstAstu dehatyAgo vivAsanam ॥41॥

text: ānupūrvyā ca daṇḍo'sau prajā jāgarti pālayan । indro jāgarti bhagavānindrādagnirvibhāvasuḥ ॥42॥
html:
ānupūrvyā ca daṇḍo'sau prajā jāgarti pālayan ।
indro jāgarti bhagavānindrādagnirvibhāvasuḥ ॥42॥
slp1: AnupUrvyA ca daRqo'sO prajA jAgarti pAlayan । indro jAgarti BagavAnindrAdagnirviBAvasuH ॥42॥

text: agnerjāgarti varuṇo varuṇācca prajāpatiḥ । prajāpatestato dharmo jāgarti vinayātmakaḥ ॥43॥
html:
agnerjāgarti varuṇo varuṇācca prajāpatiḥ ।
prajāpatestato dharmo jāgarti vinayātmakaḥ ॥43॥
slp1: agnerjAgarti varuRo varuRAcca prajApatiH । prajApatestato Darmo jAgarti vinayAtmakaH ॥43॥

text: dharmācca brahmaṇaḥ putro vyavasāyaḥ sanātanaḥ । vyavasāyāttatastejo jāgarti paripālayan ॥44॥
html:
dharmācca brahmaṇaḥ putro vyavasāyaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
vyavasāyāttatastejo jāgarti paripālayan ॥44॥
slp1: DarmAcca brahmaRaH putro vyavasAyaH sanAtanaH । vyavasAyAttatastejo jAgarti paripAlayan ॥44॥

text: oṣadhyastejasastasmādoṣadhibhyaśca parvatāḥ । parvatebhyaśca jāgarti raso rasaguṇāttathā ॥45॥
html:
oṣadhyastejasastasmādoṣadhibhyaśca parvatāḥ ।
parvatebhyaśca jāgarti raso rasaguṇāttathā ॥45॥
slp1: ozaDyastejasastasmAdozaDiByaSca parvatAH । parvateByaSca jAgarti raso rasaguRAttaTA ॥45॥

text: jāgarti nirṛtirdevī jyotīṃṣi nirṛterapi । vedāḥ pratiṣṭhā jyotirbhyastato hayaśirāḥ prabhuḥ ॥46॥
html:
jāgarti nirṛtirdevī jyotīṃṣi nirṛterapi ।
vedāḥ pratiṣṭhā jyotirbhyastato hayaśirāḥ prabhuḥ ॥46॥
slp1: jAgarti nirftirdevI jyotIMzi nirfterapi । vedAH pratizWA jyotirByastato hayaSirAH praBuH ॥46॥

text: brahmā pitāmahastasmājjāgarti prabhuravyayaḥ । pitāmahānmahādevo jāgarti bhagavāñśivaḥ ॥47॥
html:
brahmā pitāmahastasmājjāgarti prabhuravyayaḥ ।
pitāmahānmahādevo jāgarti bhagavāñśivaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: brahmA pitAmahastasmAjjAgarti praBuravyayaH । pitAmahAnmahAdevo jAgarti BagavAYSivaH ॥47॥

text: viśvedevāḥ śivāccāpi viśvebhyaśca tatharṣayaḥ । ṛṣibhyo bhagavānsomaḥ somāddevāḥ sanātanāḥ ॥48॥
html:
viśvedevāḥ śivāccāpi viśvebhyaśca tatharṣayaḥ ।
ṛṣibhyo bhagavānsomaḥ somāddevāḥ sanātanāḥ ॥48॥
slp1: viSvedevAH SivAccApi viSveByaSca taTarzayaH । fziByo BagavAnsomaH somAddevAH sanAtanAH ॥48॥

text: devebhyo brāhmaṇā loke jāgratītyupadhāraya । brāhmaṇebhyaśca rājanyā lokānrakṣanti dharmataḥ । sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva kṣatriyebhyaḥ sanātanam ॥49॥
html:
devebhyo brāhmaṇā loke jāgratītyupadhāraya ।
brāhmaṇebhyaśca rājanyā lokānrakṣanti dharmataḥ ।
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva kṣatriyebhyaḥ sanātanam ॥49॥
slp1: deveByo brAhmaRA loke jAgratItyupaDAraya । brAhmaReByaSca rAjanyA lokAnrakzanti DarmataH । sTAvaraM jaNgamaM cEva kzatriyeByaH sanAtanam ॥49॥

text: prajā jāgrati loke'smindaṇḍo jāgarti tāsu ca । sarvasaṅkṣepako daṇḍaḥ pitāmahasamaḥ prabhuḥ ॥50॥
html:
prajā jāgrati loke'smindaṇḍo jāgarti tāsu ca ।
sarvasaṅkṣepako daṇḍaḥ pitāmahasamaḥ prabhuḥ ॥50॥
slp1: prajA jAgrati loke'smindaRqo jAgarti tAsu ca । sarvasaNkzepako daRqaH pitAmahasamaH praBuH ॥50॥

text: jāgarti kālaḥ pūrvaṃ ca madhye cānte ca bhārata । īśvaraḥ sarvalokasya mahādevaḥ prajāpatiḥ ॥51॥
html:
jāgarti kālaḥ pūrvaṃ ca madhye cānte ca bhārata ।
īśvaraḥ sarvalokasya mahādevaḥ prajāpatiḥ ॥51॥
slp1: jAgarti kAlaH pUrvaM ca maDye cAnte ca BArata । ISvaraH sarvalokasya mahAdevaH prajApatiH ॥51॥

text: devadevaḥ śivaḥ śarvo jāgarti satataṃ prabhuḥ । kapardī śaṅkaro rudro bhavaḥ sthāṇurumāpatiḥ ॥52॥
html:
devadevaḥ śivaḥ śarvo jāgarti satataṃ prabhuḥ ।
kapardī śaṅkaro rudro bhavaḥ sthāṇurumāpatiḥ ॥52॥
slp1: devadevaH SivaH Sarvo jAgarti satataM praBuH । kapardI SaNkaro rudro BavaH sTARurumApatiH ॥52॥

text: ityeṣa daṇḍo vikhyāta ādau madhye tathāvare । bhūmipālo yathānyāyaṃ vartetānena dharmavit ॥53॥
html:
ityeṣa daṇḍo vikhyāta ādau madhye tathāvare ।
bhūmipālo yathānyāyaṃ vartetānena dharmavit ॥53॥
slp1: ityeza daRqo viKyAta AdO maDye taTAvare । BUmipAlo yaTAnyAyaM vartetAnena Darmavit ॥53॥

text: itīdaṃ vasuhomasya śṛṇuyādyo mataṃ naraḥ । śrutvā ca samyagvarteta sa kāmānāpnuyānnṛpaḥ ॥54॥
html:
itīdaṃ vasuhomasya śṛṇuyādyo mataṃ naraḥ ।
śrutvā ca samyagvarteta sa kāmānāpnuyānnṛpaḥ ॥54॥
slp1: itIdaM vasuhomasya SfRuyAdyo mataM naraH । SrutvA ca samyagvarteta sa kAmAnApnuyAnnfpaH ॥54॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: iti te sarvamākhyātaṃ yo daṇḍo manujarṣabha । niyantā sarvalokasya dharmākrāntasya bhārata] ॥55॥
html:
iti te sarvamākhyātaṃ yo daṇḍo manujarṣabha ।
niyantā sarvalokasya dharmākrāntasya bhārata] ॥55॥
slp1: iti te sarvamAKyAtaM yo daRqo manujarzaBa । niyantA sarvalokasya DarmAkrAntasya BArata] ॥55॥

text: tāta dharmārthakāmānāṃ śrotumicchāmi niścayam । lokayātrā hi kārtsnyena triṣveteṣu pratiṣṭhitā ॥1॥
html:
tāta dharmārthakāmānāṃ śrotumicchāmi niścayam ।
lokayātrā hi kārtsnyena triṣveteṣu pratiṣṭhitā ॥1॥
slp1: tAta DarmArTakAmAnAM SrotumicCAmi niScayam । lokayAtrA hi kArtsnyena trizvetezu pratizWitA ॥1॥

text: dharmārthakāmāḥ kiṃmūlāstrayāṇāṃ prabhavaśca kaḥ । anyonyaṃ cānuṣajjante vartante ca pṛthakpṛthak ॥2॥

text: yadā te syuḥ sumanaso lokasaṃsthārthaniścaye । kālaprabhavasaṃsthāsu sajjante ca trayastadā ॥3॥

text: dharmamūlastu deho'rthaḥ kāmo'rthaphalamucyate । saṅkalpamūlāste sarve saṅkalpo viṣayātmakaḥ ॥4॥

text: viṣayāścaiva kārtsnyena sarva āhārasiddhaye । mūlametattrivargasya nivṛttirmokṣa ucyate ॥5॥

text: sannikṛṣṭāṃścaredenānna cainānmanasā tyajet । vimuktastamasā sarvāndharmādīnkāmanaiṣṭhikān ॥7॥

text: śreṣṭhabuddhistrivargasya yadayaṃ prāpnuyātkṣaṇāt । buddhyā budhyedihārthe na tadahnā tu nikṛṣṭayā ॥8॥
html:

text: kāmandamṛṣimāsīnamabhivādya narādhipaḥ । aṅgāriṣṭho'tha papraccha kṛtvā samayaparyayam ॥11॥
html:

text: yaḥ pāpaṃ kurute rājā kāmamohabalātkṛtaḥ । pratyāsannasya tasyarṣe kiṃ syātpāpapraṇāśanam ॥12॥

text: prajñāpraṇāśako mohastathā dharmārthanāśakaḥ । tasmānnāstikatā caiva durācāraśca jāyate ॥15॥

text: taṃ prajā nānuvartante brāhmaṇā na ca sādhavaḥ । tataḥ saṅkṣayamāpnoti tathā vadhyatvameti ca ॥17॥
