text: tato bṛhaspatiṃ śakraḥ prāñjaliḥ samupasthitaḥ । uvāca ca mahāprājñaḥ śreya icchāmi veditum ॥20॥
html:
tato bṛhaspatiṃ śakraḥ prāñjaliḥ samupasthitaḥ ।
uvāca ca mahāprājñaḥ śreya icchāmi veditum ॥20॥
slp1: tato bfhaspatiM SakraH prAYjaliH samupasTitaH । uvAca ca mahAprAjYaH Sreya icCAmi veditum ॥20॥

text: tato bṛhaspatistasmai jñānaṃ naiḥśreyasaṃ param । kathayāmāsa bhagavāndevendrāya kurūdvaha ॥21॥
html:
tato bṛhaspatistasmai jñānaṃ naiḥśreyasaṃ param ।
kathayāmāsa bhagavāndevendrāya kurūdvaha ॥21॥
slp1: tato bfhaspatistasmE jYAnaM nEHSreyasaM param । kaTayAmAsa BagavAndevendrAya kurUdvaha ॥21॥

text: etāvacchreya ityeva bṛhaspatirabhāṣata । indrastu bhūyaḥ papraccha kva viśeṣo bhavediti ॥22॥
html:
etāvacchreya ityeva bṛhaspatirabhāṣata ।
indrastu bhūyaḥ papraccha kva viśeṣo bhavediti ॥22॥
slp1: etAvacCreya ityeva bfhaspatiraBAzata । indrastu BUyaH papracCa kva viSezo Bavediti ॥22॥

text: viśeṣo'sti mahāṃstāta bhārgavasya mahātmanaḥ । tatrāgamaya bhadraṃ te bhūya eva purandara ॥23॥
html:
viśeṣo'sti mahāṃstāta bhārgavasya mahātmanaḥ ।
tatrāgamaya bhadraṃ te bhūya eva purandara ॥23॥
slp1: viSezo'sti mahAMstAta BArgavasya mahAtmanaH । tatrAgamaya BadraM te BUya eva purandara ॥23॥
author: bṛhaspatiruvāca ।

text: ātmanastu tataḥ śreyo bhārgavātsumahāyaśāḥ । jñānamāgamayatprītyā punaḥ sa paramadyutiḥ ॥24॥
html:
ātmanastu tataḥ śreyo bhārgavātsumahāyaśāḥ ।
jñānamāgamayatprītyā punaḥ sa paramadyutiḥ ॥24॥
slp1: Atmanastu tataH Sreyo BArgavAtsumahAyaSAH । jYAnamAgamayatprItyA punaH sa paramadyutiH ॥24॥
author: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca ।

text: tenāpi samanujñāto bhārgaveṇa mahātmanā । śreyo'stīti punarbhūyaḥ śukramāha śatakratuḥ ॥25॥
html:
tenāpi samanujñāto bhārgaveṇa mahātmanā ।
śreyo'stīti punarbhūyaḥ śukramāha śatakratuḥ ॥25॥
slp1: tenApi samanujYAto BArgaveRa mahAtmanA । Sreyo'stIti punarBUyaH SukramAha SatakratuH ॥25॥

text: bhārgavastvāha dharmajñaḥ prahrādasya mahātmanaḥ । jñānamasti viśeṣeṇa tato hṛṣṭaśca so'bhavat ॥26॥
html:
bhārgavastvāha dharmajñaḥ prahrādasya mahātmanaḥ ।
jñānamasti viśeṣeṇa tato hṛṣṭaśca so'bhavat ॥26॥
slp1: BArgavastvAha DarmajYaH prahrAdasya mahAtmanaH । jYAnamasti viSezeRa tato hfzwaSca so'Bavat ॥26॥

text: sa tato brāhmaṇo bhūtvā prahrādaṃ pākaśāsanaḥ । sṛtvā provāca medhāvī śreya icchāmi veditum ॥27॥
html:
sa tato brāhmaṇo bhūtvā prahrādaṃ pākaśāsanaḥ ।
sṛtvā provāca medhāvī śreya icchāmi veditum ॥27॥
slp1: sa tato brAhmaRo BUtvA prahrAdaM pAkaSAsanaH । sftvA provAca meDAvI Sreya icCAmi veditum ॥27॥

text: prahrādastvabravīdvipraṃ kṣaṇo nāsti dvijarṣabha । trailokyarājye saktasya tato nopadiśāmi te ॥28॥
html:
prahrādastvabravīdvipraṃ kṣaṇo nāsti dvijarṣabha ।
trailokyarājye saktasya tato nopadiśāmi te ॥28॥
slp1: prahrAdastvabravIdvipraM kzaRo nAsti dvijarzaBa । trElokyarAjye saktasya tato nopadiSAmi te ॥28॥

text: brāhmaṇastvabravīdvākyaṃ kasminkāle kṣaṇo bhavet । tatopadiṣṭamicchāmi yadyatkāryāntaraṃ bhavet ॥29॥
html:
brāhmaṇastvabravīdvākyaṃ kasminkāle kṣaṇo bhavet ।
tatopadiṣṭamicchāmi yadyatkāryāntaraṃ bhavet ॥29॥
slp1: brAhmaRastvabravIdvAkyaM kasminkAle kzaRo Bavet । tatopadizwamicCAmi yadyatkAryAntaraM Bavet ॥29॥

text: tataḥ prīto'bhavadrājā prahrādo brahmavādine । tathetyuktvā śubhe kāle jñānatattvaṃ dadau tadā ॥30॥
html:
tataḥ prīto'bhavadrājā prahrādo brahmavādine ।
tathetyuktvā śubhe kāle jñānatattvaṃ dadau tadā ॥30॥
slp1: tataH prIto'BavadrAjA prahrAdo brahmavAdine । taTetyuktvA SuBe kAle jYAnatattvaM dadO tadA ॥30॥

text: brāhmaṇo'pi yathānyāyaṃ guruvṛttimanuttamām । cakāra sarvabhāvena yadvatsa manasecchati ॥31॥
html:
brāhmaṇo'pi yathānyāyaṃ guruvṛttimanuttamām ।
cakāra sarvabhāvena yadvatsa manasecchati ॥31॥
slp1: brAhmaRo'pi yaTAnyAyaM guruvfttimanuttamAm । cakAra sarvaBAvena yadvatsa manasecCati ॥31॥

text: pṛṣṭaśca tena bahuśaḥ prāptaṃ kathamarindama । trailokyarājyaṃ dharmajña kāraṇaṃ tadbravīhi me ॥32॥
html:
pṛṣṭaśca tena bahuśaḥ prāptaṃ kathamarindama ।
trailokyarājyaṃ dharmajña kāraṇaṃ tadbravīhi me ॥32॥
slp1: pfzwaSca tena bahuSaH prAptaM kaTamarindama । trElokyarAjyaM DarmajYa kAraRaM tadbravIhi me ॥32॥

text: nāsūyāmi dvijaśreṣṭha rājāsmīti kadācana । kavyāni vadatāṃ tāta saṃyacchāmi vahāmi ca ॥33॥
html:
nāsūyāmi dvijaśreṣṭha rājāsmīti kadācana ।
kavyāni vadatāṃ tāta saṃyacchāmi vahāmi ca ॥33॥
slp1: nAsUyAmi dvijaSrezWa rAjAsmIti kadAcana । kavyAni vadatAM tAta saMyacCAmi vahAmi ca ॥33॥
author: prahrāda uvāca ।

text: te visrabdhāḥ prabhāṣante saṃyacchanti ca māṃ sadā । te mā kavyapade saktaṃ śuśrūṣumanasūyakam ॥34॥
html:
te visrabdhāḥ prabhāṣante saṃyacchanti ca māṃ sadā ।
te mā kavyapade saktaṃ śuśrūṣumanasūyakam ॥34॥
slp1: te visrabDAH praBAzante saMyacCanti ca mAM sadA । te mA kavyapade saktaM SuSrUzumanasUyakam ॥34॥

text: dharmātmānaṃ jitakrodhaṃ saṃyataṃ saṃyatendriyam । samācinvanti śāstāraḥ kṣaudraṃ madhviva makṣikāḥ ॥35॥
html:
dharmātmānaṃ jitakrodhaṃ saṃyataṃ saṃyatendriyam ।
samācinvanti śāstāraḥ kṣaudraṃ madhviva makṣikāḥ ॥35॥
slp1: DarmAtmAnaM jitakroDaM saMyataM saMyatendriyam । samAcinvanti SAstAraH kzOdraM maDviva makzikAH ॥35॥

text: so'haṃ vāgagrapiṣṭānāṃ rasānāmavalehitā । svajātyānadhitiṣṭhāmi nakṣatrāṇīva candramāḥ ॥36॥
html:
so'haṃ vāgagrapiṣṭānāṃ rasānāmavalehitā ।
svajātyānadhitiṣṭhāmi nakṣatrāṇīva candramāḥ ॥36॥
slp1: so'haM vAgagrapizwAnAM rasAnAmavalehitA । svajAtyAnaDitizWAmi nakzatrARIva candramAH ॥36॥

text: etatpṛthivyāmamṛtametaccakṣuranuttamam । yadbrāhmaṇamukhe kavyametacchrutvā pravartate ॥37॥
html:
etatpṛthivyāmamṛtametaccakṣuranuttamam ।
yadbrāhmaṇamukhe kavyametacchrutvā pravartate ॥37॥
slp1: etatpfTivyAmamftametaccakzuranuttamam । yadbrAhmaRamuKe kavyametacCrutvA pravartate ॥37॥

text: etāvacchreya ityāha prahrādo brahmavādinam । śuśrūṣitastena tadā daityendro vākyamabravīt ॥38॥
html:
etāvacchreya ityāha prahrādo brahmavādinam ।
śuśrūṣitastena tadā daityendro vākyamabravīt ॥38॥
slp1: etAvacCreya ityAha prahrAdo brahmavAdinam । SuSrUzitastena tadA dEtyendro vAkyamabravIt ॥38॥
author: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca ।

text: yathāvadguruvṛttyā te prīto'smi dvijasattama । varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te pradātāsmi na saṃśayaḥ ॥39॥
html:
yathāvadguruvṛttyā te prīto'smi dvijasattama ।
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te pradātāsmi na saṃśayaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: yaTAvadguruvfttyA te prIto'smi dvijasattama । varaM vfRIzva BadraM te pradAtAsmi na saMSayaH ॥39॥

text: kṛtamityeva daityendramuvāca sa ca vai dvijaḥ । prahrādastvabravītprīto gṛhyatāṃ vara ityuta ॥40॥
html:
kṛtamityeva daityendramuvāca sa ca vai dvijaḥ ।
prahrādastvabravītprīto gṛhyatāṃ vara ityuta ॥40॥
slp1: kftamityeva dEtyendramuvAca sa ca vE dvijaH । prahrAdastvabravItprIto gfhyatAM vara ityuta ॥40॥

text: yadi rājanprasannastvaṃ mama cecchasi ceddhitam । bhavataḥ śīlamicchāmi prāptumeṣa varo mama ॥41॥
html:
yadi rājanprasannastvaṃ mama cecchasi ceddhitam ।
bhavataḥ śīlamicchāmi prāptumeṣa varo mama ॥41॥
slp1: yadi rAjanprasannastvaM mama cecCasi cedDitam । BavataH SIlamicCAmi prAptumeza varo mama ॥41॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: tataḥ prītaśca daityendro bhayaṃ cāsyābhavanmahat । vare pradiṣṭe vipreṇa nālpatejāyamityuta ॥42॥
html:
tataḥ prītaśca daityendro bhayaṃ cāsyābhavanmahat ।
vare pradiṣṭe vipreṇa nālpatejāyamityuta ॥42॥
slp1: tataH prItaSca dEtyendro BayaM cAsyABavanmahat । vare pradizwe vipreRa nAlpatejAyamityuta ॥42॥
author: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca ।

text: evamastviti taṃ prāha prahrādo vismitastadā । upākṛtya tu viprāya varaṃ duḥkhānvito'bhavat ॥43॥
html:
evamastviti taṃ prāha prahrādo vismitastadā ।
upākṛtya tu viprāya varaṃ duḥkhānvito'bhavat ॥43॥
slp1: evamastviti taM prAha prahrAdo vismitastadA । upAkftya tu viprAya varaM duHKAnvito'Bavat ॥43॥

text: datte vare gate vipre cintāsīnmahatī tataḥ । prahrādasya mahārāja niścayaṃ na ca jagmivān ॥44॥
html:
datte vare gate vipre cintāsīnmahatī tataḥ ।
prahrādasya mahārāja niścayaṃ na ca jagmivān ॥44॥
slp1: datte vare gate vipre cintAsInmahatI tataH । prahrAdasya mahArAja niScayaM na ca jagmivAn ॥44॥

text: tasya cintayatastāta chāyābhūtaṃ mahādyute । tejo vigrahavattāta śarīramajahāttadā ॥45॥
html:
tasya cintayatastāta chāyābhūtaṃ mahādyute ।
tejo vigrahavattāta śarīramajahāttadā ॥45॥
slp1: tasya cintayatastAta CAyABUtaM mahAdyute । tejo vigrahavattAta SarIramajahAttadA ॥45॥

text: tamapṛcchanmahākāyaṃ prahrādaḥ ko bhavāniti । pratyāha nanu śīlo'smi tyakto gacchāmyahaṃ tvayā ॥46॥
html:
tamapṛcchanmahākāyaṃ prahrādaḥ ko bhavāniti ।
pratyāha nanu śīlo'smi tyakto gacchāmyahaṃ tvayā ॥46॥
slp1: tamapfcCanmahAkAyaM prahrAdaH ko BavAniti । pratyAha nanu SIlo'smi tyakto gacCAmyahaM tvayA ॥46॥

text: tasmindvijavare rājanvatsyāmyahamaninditam । yo'sau śiṣyatvamāgamya tvayi nityaṃ samāhitaḥ । ityuktvāntarhitaṃ tadvai śakraṃ cānvaviśatprabho ॥47॥
html:
tasmindvijavare rājanvatsyāmyahamaninditam ।
yo'sau śiṣyatvamāgamya tvayi nityaṃ samāhitaḥ ।
ityuktvāntarhitaṃ tadvai śakraṃ cānvaviśatprabho ॥47॥
slp1: tasmindvijavare rAjanvatsyAmyahamaninditam । yo'sO SizyatvamAgamya tvayi nityaM samAhitaH । ityuktvAntarhitaM tadvE SakraM cAnvaviSatpraBo ॥47॥

text: tasmiṃstejasi yāte tu tādṛgrūpastato'paraḥ । śarīrānniḥsṛtastasya ko bhavāniti cābravīt ॥48॥
html:
tasmiṃstejasi yāte tu tādṛgrūpastato'paraḥ ।
śarīrānniḥsṛtastasya ko bhavāniti cābravīt ॥48॥
slp1: tasmiMstejasi yAte tu tAdfgrUpastato'paraH । SarIrAnniHsftastasya ko BavAniti cAbravIt ॥48॥

text: dharmaṃ prahrāda māṃ viddhi yatrāsau dvijasattamaḥ । tatra yāsyāmi daityendra yataḥ śīlaṃ tato hyaham ॥49॥
html:
dharmaṃ prahrāda māṃ viddhi yatrāsau dvijasattamaḥ ।
tatra yāsyāmi daityendra yataḥ śīlaṃ tato hyaham ॥49॥
slp1: DarmaM prahrAda mAM vidDi yatrAsO dvijasattamaH । tatra yAsyAmi dEtyendra yataH SIlaM tato hyaham ॥49॥

text: tato'paro mahārāja prajvalanniva tejasā । śarīrānniḥsṛtastasya prahrādasya mahātmanaḥ ॥50॥
html:
tato'paro mahārāja prajvalanniva tejasā ।
śarīrānniḥsṛtastasya prahrādasya mahātmanaḥ ॥50॥
slp1: tato'paro mahArAja prajvalanniva tejasA । SarIrAnniHsftastasya prahrAdasya mahAtmanaH ॥50॥

text: ko bhavāniti pṛṣṭaśca tamāha sa mahādyutiḥ । satyamasmyasurendrāgrya yāsye'haṃ dharmamanviha ॥51॥
html:
ko bhavāniti pṛṣṭaśca tamāha sa mahādyutiḥ ।
satyamasmyasurendrāgrya yāsye'haṃ dharmamanviha ॥51॥
slp1: ko BavAniti pfzwaSca tamAha sa mahAdyutiH । satyamasmyasurendrAgrya yAsye'haM Darmamanviha ॥51॥

text: tasminnanugate dharmaṃ puruṣe puruṣo'paraḥ । niścakrāma tatastasmātpṛṣṭaścāha mahātmanā । vṛttaṃ prahrāda māṃ viddhi yataḥ satyaṃ tato hyaham ॥52॥
html:
tasminnanugate dharmaṃ puruṣe puruṣo'paraḥ ।
niścakrāma tatastasmātpṛṣṭaścāha mahātmanā ।
vṛttaṃ prahrāda māṃ viddhi yataḥ satyaṃ tato hyaham ॥52॥
slp1: tasminnanugate DarmaM puruze puruzo'paraH । niScakrAma tatastasmAtpfzwaScAha mahAtmanA । vfttaM prahrAda mAM vidDi yataH satyaM tato hyaham ॥52॥

text: tasmingate mahāśvetaḥ śarīrāttasya niryayau । pṛṣṭaścāha balaṃ viddhi yato vṛttamahaṃ tataḥ । ityuktvā ca yayau tatra yato vṛttaṃ narādhipa ॥53॥
html:
tasmingate mahāśvetaḥ śarīrāttasya niryayau ।
pṛṣṭaścāha balaṃ viddhi yato vṛttamahaṃ tataḥ ।
ityuktvā ca yayau tatra yato vṛttaṃ narādhipa ॥53॥
slp1: tasmingate mahASvetaH SarIrAttasya niryayO । pfzwaScAha balaM vidDi yato vfttamahaM tataH । ityuktvA ca yayO tatra yato vfttaM narADipa ॥53॥

text: tataḥ prabhāmayī devī śarīrāttasya niryayau । tāmapṛcchatsa daityendraḥ sā śrīrityevamabravīt ॥54॥
html:
tataḥ prabhāmayī devī śarīrāttasya niryayau ।
tāmapṛcchatsa daityendraḥ sā śrīrityevamabravīt ॥54॥
slp1: tataH praBAmayI devI SarIrAttasya niryayO । tAmapfcCatsa dEtyendraH sA SrIrityevamabravIt ॥54॥

text: uṣitāsmi sukhaṃ vīra tvayi satyaparākrame । tvayā tyaktā gamiṣyāmi balaṃ yatra tato hyaham ॥55॥
html:
uṣitāsmi sukhaṃ vīra tvayi satyaparākrame ।
tvayā tyaktā gamiṣyāmi balaṃ yatra tato hyaham ॥55॥
slp1: uzitAsmi suKaM vIra tvayi satyaparAkrame । tvayA tyaktA gamizyAmi balaM yatra tato hyaham ॥55॥

text: tato bhayaṃ prādurāsītprahrādasya mahātmanaḥ । apṛcchata ca tāṃ bhūyaḥ kva yāsi kamalālaye ॥56॥
html:
tato bhayaṃ prādurāsītprahrādasya mahātmanaḥ ।
apṛcchata ca tāṃ bhūyaḥ kva yāsi kamalālaye ॥56॥
slp1: tato BayaM prAdurAsItprahrAdasya mahAtmanaH । apfcCata ca tAM BUyaH kva yAsi kamalAlaye ॥56॥

text: tvaṃ hi satyavratā devī lokasya parameśvarī । kaścāsau brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhastattvamicchāmi veditum ॥57॥
html:
tvaṃ hi satyavratā devī lokasya parameśvarī ।
kaścāsau brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhastattvamicchāmi veditum ॥57॥
slp1: tvaM hi satyavratA devI lokasya parameSvarI । kaScAsO brAhmaRaSrezWastattvamicCAmi veditum ॥57॥

text: sa śakro brahmacārī ca yastvayā copaśikṣitaḥ । trailokye te yadaiśvaryaṃ tattenāpahṛtaṃ prabho ॥58॥
html:
sa śakro brahmacārī ca yastvayā copaśikṣitaḥ ।
trailokye te yadaiśvaryaṃ tattenāpahṛtaṃ prabho ॥58॥
slp1: sa Sakro brahmacArI ca yastvayA copaSikzitaH । trElokye te yadESvaryaM tattenApahftaM praBo ॥58॥
author: śrīruvāca ।

text: śīlena hi tvayā lokāḥ sarve dharmajña nirjitāḥ । tadvijñāya mahendreṇa tava śīlaṃ hṛtaṃ prabho ॥59॥
html:
śīlena hi tvayā lokāḥ sarve dharmajña nirjitāḥ ।
tadvijñāya mahendreṇa tava śīlaṃ hṛtaṃ prabho ॥59॥
slp1: SIlena hi tvayA lokAH sarve DarmajYa nirjitAH । tadvijYAya mahendreRa tava SIlaM hftaM praBo ॥59॥

text: dharmaḥ satyaṃ tathā vṛttaṃ balaṃ caiva tathā hyaham । śīlamūlā mahāprājña sadā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ॥60॥
html:
dharmaḥ satyaṃ tathā vṛttaṃ balaṃ caiva tathā hyaham ।
śīlamūlā mahāprājña sadā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ॥60॥
slp1: DarmaH satyaM taTA vfttaM balaM cEva taTA hyaham । SIlamUlA mahAprAjYa sadA nAstyatra saMSayaH ॥60॥

text: evamuktvā gatā tu śrīste ca sarve yudhiṣṭhira । duryodhanastu pitaraṃ bhūya evābravīdidam ॥61॥
html:
evamuktvā gatā tu śrīste ca sarve yudhiṣṭhira ।
duryodhanastu pitaraṃ bhūya evābravīdidam ॥61॥
slp1: evamuktvA gatA tu SrIste ca sarve yuDizWira । duryoDanastu pitaraM BUya evAbravIdidam ॥61॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: śīlasya tattvamicchāmi vettuṃ kauravanandana । prāpyate ca yathā śīlaṃ tamupāyaṃ vadasva me ॥62॥
html:
śīlasya tattvamicchāmi vettuṃ kauravanandana ।
prāpyate ca yathā śīlaṃ tamupāyaṃ vadasva me ॥62॥
slp1: SIlasya tattvamicCAmi vettuM kOravanandana । prApyate ca yaTA SIlaM tamupAyaM vadasva me ॥62॥

text: sopāyaṃ pūrvamuddiṣṭaṃ prahrādena mahātmanā । saṅkṣepatastu śīlasya śṛṇu prāptiṃ narādhipa ॥63॥
html:
sopāyaṃ pūrvamuddiṣṭaṃ prahrādena mahātmanā ।
saṅkṣepatastu śīlasya śṛṇu prāptiṃ narādhipa ॥63॥
slp1: sopAyaM pUrvamuddizwaM prahrAdena mahAtmanA । saNkzepatastu SIlasya SfRu prAptiM narADipa ॥63॥
author: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca ।

text: adrohaḥ sarvabhūteṣu karmaṇā manasā girā । anugrahaśca dānaṃ ca śīlametatpraśasyate ॥64॥
html:
adrohaḥ sarvabhūteṣu karmaṇā manasā girā ।
anugrahaśca dānaṃ ca śīlametatpraśasyate ॥64॥
slp1: adrohaH sarvaBUtezu karmaRA manasA girA । anugrahaSca dAnaM ca SIlametatpraSasyate ॥64॥

text: yadanyeṣāṃ hitaṃ na syādātmanaḥ karma pauruṣam । apatrapeta vā yena na tatkuryātkathañcana ॥65॥
html:
yadanyeṣāṃ hitaṃ na syādātmanaḥ karma pauruṣam ।
apatrapeta vā yena na tatkuryātkathañcana ॥65॥
slp1: yadanyezAM hitaM na syAdAtmanaH karma pOruzam । apatrapeta vA yena na tatkuryAtkaTaYcana ॥65॥

text: tattu karma tathā kuryādyena ślāgheta saṃsadi । etacchīlaṃ samāsena kathitaṃ kurusattama ॥66॥
html:
tattu karma tathā kuryādyena ślāgheta saṃsadi ।
etacchīlaṃ samāsena kathitaṃ kurusattama ॥66॥
slp1: tattu karma taTA kuryAdyena SlAGeta saMsadi । etacCIlaM samAsena kaTitaM kurusattama ॥66॥

text: yadyapyaśīlā nṛpate prāpnuvanti kvacicchriyam । na bhuñjate ciraṃ tāta samūlāśca patanti te ॥67॥
html:
yadyapyaśīlā nṛpate prāpnuvanti kvacicchriyam ।
na bhuñjate ciraṃ tāta samūlāśca patanti te ॥67॥
slp1: yadyapyaSIlA nfpate prApnuvanti kvacicCriyam । na BuYjate ciraM tAta samUlASca patanti te ॥67॥

text: etadviditvā tattvena śīlavānbhava putraka । yadīcchasi śriyaṃ tāta suviśiṣṭāṃ yudhiṣṭhirāt ॥68॥
html:
etadviditvā tattvena śīlavānbhava putraka ।
yadīcchasi śriyaṃ tāta suviśiṣṭāṃ yudhiṣṭhirāt ॥68॥
slp1: etadviditvA tattvena SIlavAnBava putraka । yadIcCasi SriyaM tAta suviSizwAM yuDizWirAt ॥68॥

text: etatkathitavānputre dhṛtarāṣṭro narādhipa । etatkuruṣva kaunteya tataḥ prāpsyasi tatphalam] ॥69॥
html:
etatkathitavānputre dhṛtarāṣṭro narādhipa ।
etatkuruṣva kaunteya tataḥ prāpsyasi tatphalam] ॥69॥
slp1: etatkaTitavAnputre DftarAzwro narADipa । etatkuruzva kOnteya tataH prApsyasi tatPalam] ॥69॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: śīlaṃ pradhānaṃ puruṣe kathitaṃ te pitāmaha । kathamāśā samutpannā yā ca sā tadvadasva me ॥1॥
html:
śīlaṃ pradhānaṃ puruṣe kathitaṃ te pitāmaha ।
kathamāśā samutpannā yā ca sā tadvadasva me ॥1॥
slp1: SIlaM praDAnaM puruze kaTitaM te pitAmaha । kaTamASA samutpannA yA ca sA tadvadasva me ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: saṃśayo me mahāneṣa samutpannaḥ pitāmaha । chettā ca tasya nānyo'sti tvattaḥ parapurañjaya ॥2॥
html:
saṃśayo me mahāneṣa samutpannaḥ pitāmaha ।
chettā ca tasya nānyo'sti tvattaḥ parapurañjaya ॥2॥
slp1: saMSayo me mahAneza samutpannaH pitAmaha । CettA ca tasya nAnyo'sti tvattaH parapuraYjaya ॥2॥

text: pitāmahāśā mahatī mamāsīddhi suyodhane । prāpte yuddhe tu yadyuktaṃ tatkartāyamiti prabho ॥3॥
html:
pitāmahāśā mahatī mamāsīddhi suyodhane ।
prāpte yuddhe tu yadyuktaṃ tatkartāyamiti prabho ॥3॥
slp1: pitAmahASA mahatI mamAsIdDi suyoDane । prApte yudDe tu yadyuktaM tatkartAyamiti praBo ॥3॥

text: sarvasyāśā sumahatī puruṣasyopajāyate । tasyāṃ vihanyamānāyāṃ duḥkho mṛtyurasaṃśayam ॥4॥
html:
sarvasyāśā sumahatī puruṣasyopajāyate ।
tasyāṃ vihanyamānāyāṃ duḥkho mṛtyurasaṃśayam ॥4॥
slp1: sarvasyASA sumahatI puruzasyopajAyate । tasyAM vihanyamAnAyAM duHKo mftyurasaMSayam ॥4॥

text: so'haṃ hatāśo durbuddhiḥ kṛtastena durātmanā । dhārtarāṣṭreṇa rājendra paśya mandātmatāṃ mama ॥5॥
html:
so'haṃ hatāśo durbuddhiḥ kṛtastena durātmanā ।
dhārtarāṣṭreṇa rājendra paśya mandātmatāṃ mama ॥5॥
slp1: so'haM hatASo durbudDiH kftastena durAtmanA । DArtarAzwreRa rAjendra paSya mandAtmatAM mama ॥5॥

text: āśāṃ mahattarāṃ manye parvatādapi sadrumāt । ākāśādapi vā rājannaprameyaiva vā punaḥ ॥6॥
html:
āśāṃ mahattarāṃ manye parvatādapi sadrumāt ।
ākāśādapi vā rājannaprameyaiva vā punaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: ASAM mahattarAM manye parvatAdapi sadrumAt । AkASAdapi vA rAjannaprameyEva vA punaH ॥6॥

text: eṣā caiva kuruśreṣṭha durvicintyā sudurlabhā । durlabhatvācca paśyāmi kimanyaddurlabhaṃ tataḥ ॥7॥
html:
eṣā caiva kuruśreṣṭha durvicintyā sudurlabhā ।
durlabhatvācca paśyāmi kimanyaddurlabhaṃ tataḥ ॥7॥
slp1: ezA cEva kuruSrezWa durvicintyA sudurlaBA । durlaBatvAcca paSyAmi kimanyaddurlaBaM tataH ॥7॥

text: atra te vartayiṣyāmi yudhiṣṭhira nibodha tat । itihāsaṃ sumitrasya nirvṛttamṛṣabhasya ca ॥8॥
html:
atra te vartayiṣyāmi yudhiṣṭhira nibodha tat ।
itihāsaṃ sumitrasya nirvṛttamṛṣabhasya ca ॥8॥
slp1: atra te vartayizyAmi yuDizWira niboDa tat । itihAsaM sumitrasya nirvfttamfzaBasya ca ॥8॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sumitro nāma rājarṣirhaihayo mṛgayāṃ gataḥ । sasāra sa mṛgaṃ viddhvā bāṇena nataparvaṇā ॥9॥
html:
sumitro nāma rājarṣirhaihayo mṛgayāṃ gataḥ ।
sasāra sa mṛgaṃ viddhvā bāṇena nataparvaṇā ॥9॥
slp1: sumitro nAma rAjarzirhEhayo mfgayAM gataH । sasAra sa mfgaM vidDvA bARena nataparvaRA ॥9॥

text: sa mṛgo bāṇamādāya yayāvamitavikramaḥ । sa ca rājā balī tūrṇaṃ sasāra mṛgamantikāt ॥10॥
html:
sa mṛgo bāṇamādāya yayāvamitavikramaḥ ।
sa ca rājā balī tūrṇaṃ sasāra mṛgamantikāt ॥10॥
slp1: sa mfgo bARamAdAya yayAvamitavikramaH । sa ca rAjA balI tUrRaM sasAra mfgamantikAt ॥10॥

text: tato nimnaṃ sthalaṃ caiva sa mṛgo'dravadāśugaḥ । muhūrtameva rājendra samena sa pathāgamat ॥11॥
html:
tato nimnaṃ sthalaṃ caiva sa mṛgo'dravadāśugaḥ ।
muhūrtameva rājendra samena sa pathāgamat ॥11॥
slp1: tato nimnaM sTalaM cEva sa mfgo'dravadASugaH । muhUrtameva rAjendra samena sa paTAgamat ॥11॥

text: tataḥ sa rājā tāruṇyādaurasena balena ca । sasāra bāṇāsanabhṛtsakhaḍgo haṃsavattadā ॥12॥
html:
tataḥ sa rājā tāruṇyādaurasena balena ca ।
sasāra bāṇāsanabhṛtsakhaḍgo haṃsavattadā ॥12॥
slp1: tataH sa rAjA tAruRyAdOrasena balena ca । sasAra bARAsanaBftsaKaqgo haMsavattadA ॥12॥

text: tīrtvā nadānnadīścaiva palvalāni vanāni ca । atikramyābhyatikramya sasāraiva vane caran ॥13॥
html:
tīrtvā nadānnadīścaiva palvalāni vanāni ca ।
atikramyābhyatikramya sasāraiva vane caran ॥13॥
slp1: tIrtvA nadAnnadIScEva palvalAni vanAni ca । atikramyAByatikramya sasArEva vane caran ॥13॥

text: sa tu kāmānmṛgo rājannāsādyāsādya taṃ nṛpam । punarabhyeti javano javena mahatā tataḥ ॥14॥
html:
sa tu kāmānmṛgo rājannāsādyāsādya taṃ nṛpam ।
punarabhyeti javano javena mahatā tataḥ ॥14॥
slp1: sa tu kAmAnmfgo rAjannAsAdyAsAdya taM nfpam । punaraByeti javano javena mahatA tataH ॥14॥

text: sa tasya bāṇairbahubhiḥ samabhyasto vanecaraḥ । prakrīḍanniva rājendra punarabhyeti cāntikam ॥15॥
html:
sa tasya bāṇairbahubhiḥ samabhyasto vanecaraḥ ।
prakrīḍanniva rājendra punarabhyeti cāntikam ॥15॥
slp1: sa tasya bARErbahuBiH samaByasto vanecaraH । prakrIqanniva rAjendra punaraByeti cAntikam ॥15॥

text: punaśca javamāsthāya javano mṛgayūthapaḥ । atītyātītya rājendra punarabhyeti cāntikam ॥16॥
html:
punaśca javamāsthāya javano mṛgayūthapaḥ ।
atītyātītya rājendra punarabhyeti cāntikam ॥16॥
slp1: punaSca javamAsTAya javano mfgayUTapaH । atItyAtItya rAjendra punaraByeti cAntikam ॥16॥

text: tasya marmacchidaṃ ghoraṃ sumitro'mitrakarśanaḥ । samādāya śaraśreṣṭhaṃ kārmukānniravāsṛjat ॥17॥
html:
tasya marmacchidaṃ ghoraṃ sumitro'mitrakarśanaḥ ।
samādāya śaraśreṣṭhaṃ kārmukānniravāsṛjat ॥17॥
slp1: tasya marmacCidaM GoraM sumitro'mitrakarSanaH । samAdAya SaraSrezWaM kArmukAnniravAsfjat ॥17॥

text: tato gavyūtimātreṇa mṛgayūthapayūthapaḥ । tasya bāṇapathaṃ tyaktvā tasthivānprahasanniva ॥18॥
html:
tato gavyūtimātreṇa mṛgayūthapayūthapaḥ ।
tasya bāṇapathaṃ tyaktvā tasthivānprahasanniva ॥18॥
slp1: tato gavyUtimAtreRa mfgayUTapayUTapaH । tasya bARapaTaM tyaktvA tasTivAnprahasanniva ॥18॥

text: tasminnipatite bāṇe bhūmau prajvalite tataḥ । praviveśa mahāraṇyaṃ mṛgo rājāpyathādravat ॥19॥
html:
tasminnipatite bāṇe bhūmau prajvalite tataḥ ।
praviveśa mahāraṇyaṃ mṛgo rājāpyathādravat ॥19॥
slp1: tasminnipatite bARe BUmO prajvalite tataH । praviveSa mahAraRyaM mfgo rAjApyaTAdravat ॥19॥

text: praviśya tu mahāraṇyaṃ tāpasānāmathāśramam । āsasāda tato rājā śrāntaścopāviśatpunaḥ ॥20॥
html:
praviśya tu mahāraṇyaṃ tāpasānāmathāśramam ।
āsasāda tato rājā śrāntaścopāviśatpunaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: praviSya tu mahAraRyaM tApasAnAmaTASramam । AsasAda tato rAjA SrAntaScopAviSatpunaH ॥20॥

text: taṃ kārmukadharaṃ dṛṣṭvā śramārtaṃ kṣudhitaṃ tadā । sametya ṛṣayastasminpūjāṃ cakruryathāvidhi ॥21॥
html:
taṃ kārmukadharaṃ dṛṣṭvā śramārtaṃ kṣudhitaṃ tadā ।
sametya ṛṣayastasminpūjāṃ cakruryathāvidhi ॥21॥
slp1: taM kArmukaDaraM dfzwvA SramArtaM kzuDitaM tadA । sametya fzayastasminpUjAM cakruryaTAviDi ॥21॥

text: ṛṣayo rājaśārdūlamapṛcchansvaṃ prayojanam । kena bhadramukhārthena samprāpto'si tapovanam ॥22॥
html:
ṛṣayo rājaśārdūlamapṛcchansvaṃ prayojanam ।
kena bhadramukhārthena samprāpto'si tapovanam ॥22॥
slp1: fzayo rAjaSArdUlamapfcCansvaM prayojanam । kena BadramuKArTena samprApto'si tapovanam ॥22॥

text: padātirbaddhanistriṃśo dhanvī bāṇī nareśvara । etadicchāma vijñātuṃ kutaḥ prāpto'si mānada । kasminkule hi jātastvaṃ kiṃnāmāsi bravīhi naḥ ॥23॥
html:
padātirbaddhanistriṃśo dhanvī bāṇī nareśvara ।
etadicchāma vijñātuṃ kutaḥ prāpto'si mānada ।
kasminkule hi jātastvaṃ kiṃnāmāsi bravīhi naḥ ॥23॥
slp1: padAtirbadDanistriMSo DanvI bARI nareSvara । etadicCAma vijYAtuM kutaH prApto'si mAnada । kasminkule hi jAtastvaM kiMnAmAsi bravIhi naH ॥23॥

text: tataḥ sa rājā sarvebhyo dvijebhyaḥ puruṣarṣabha । ācakhyau tadyathānyāyaṃ paricaryāṃ ca bhārata ॥24॥
html:
tataḥ sa rājā sarvebhyo dvijebhyaḥ puruṣarṣabha ।
ācakhyau tadyathānyāyaṃ paricaryāṃ ca bhārata ॥24॥
slp1: tataH sa rAjA sarveByo dvijeByaH puruzarzaBa । AcaKyO tadyaTAnyAyaM paricaryAM ca BArata ॥24॥

text: haihayānāṃ kule jātaḥ sumitro mitranandanaḥ । carāmi mṛgayūthāni nighnanbāṇaiḥ sahasraśaḥ । balena mahatā guptaḥ sāmātyaḥ sāvarodhanaḥ ॥25॥
html:
haihayānāṃ kule jātaḥ sumitro mitranandanaḥ ।
carāmi mṛgayūthāni nighnanbāṇaiḥ sahasraśaḥ ।
balena mahatā guptaḥ sāmātyaḥ sāvarodhanaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: hEhayAnAM kule jAtaH sumitro mitranandanaH । carAmi mfgayUTAni niGnanbAREH sahasraSaH । balena mahatA guptaH sAmAtyaH sAvaroDanaH ॥25॥

text: mṛgastu viddho bāṇena mayā sarati śalyavān । taṃ dravantamanu prāpto vanametadyadṛcchayā । bhavatsakāśe naṣṭaśrīrhatāśaḥ śramakarśitaḥ ॥26॥
html:
mṛgastu viddho bāṇena mayā sarati śalyavān ।
taṃ dravantamanu prāpto vanametadyadṛcchayā ।
bhavatsakāśe naṣṭaśrīrhatāśaḥ śramakarśitaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: mfgastu vidDo bARena mayA sarati SalyavAn । taM dravantamanu prApto vanametadyadfcCayA । BavatsakASe nazwaSrIrhatASaH SramakarSitaH ॥26॥

text: kiṃ nu duḥkhamato'nyadvai yadahaṃ śramakarśitaḥ । bhavatāmāśramaṃ prāpto hatāśo naṣṭalakṣaṇaḥ ॥27॥
html:
kiṃ nu duḥkhamato'nyadvai yadahaṃ śramakarśitaḥ ।
bhavatāmāśramaṃ prāpto hatāśo naṣṭalakṣaṇaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: kiM nu duHKamato'nyadvE yadahaM SramakarSitaH । BavatAmASramaM prApto hatASo nazwalakzaRaH ॥27॥

text: na rājalakṣaṇatyāgo na purasya tapodhanāḥ । duḥkhaṃ karoti tattīvraṃ yathāśā vihatā mama ॥28॥
html:
na rājalakṣaṇatyāgo na purasya tapodhanāḥ ।
duḥkhaṃ karoti tattīvraṃ yathāśā vihatā mama ॥28॥
slp1: na rAjalakzaRatyAgo na purasya tapoDanAH । duHKaM karoti tattIvraM yaTASA vihatA mama ॥28॥

text: himavānvā mahāśailaḥ samudro vā mahodadhiḥ । mahattvānnānvapadyetāṃ rodasyorantaraṃ yathā । āśāyāstapasi śreṣṭhāstathā nāntamahaṃ gataḥ ॥29॥
html:
himavānvā mahāśailaḥ samudro vā mahodadhiḥ ।
mahattvānnānvapadyetāṃ rodasyorantaraṃ yathā ।
āśāyāstapasi śreṣṭhāstathā nāntamahaṃ gataḥ ॥29॥
slp1: himavAnvA mahASElaH samudro vA mahodaDiH । mahattvAnnAnvapadyetAM rodasyorantaraM yaTA । ASAyAstapasi SrezWAstaTA nAntamahaM gataH ॥29॥

text: bhavatāṃ viditaṃ sarvaṃ sarvajñā hi tapodhanāḥ । bhavantaḥ sumahābhāgāstasmātprakṣyāmi saṃśayam ॥30॥
html:
bhavatāṃ viditaṃ sarvaṃ sarvajñā hi tapodhanāḥ ।
bhavantaḥ sumahābhāgāstasmātprakṣyāmi saṃśayam ॥30॥
slp1: BavatAM viditaM sarvaM sarvajYA hi tapoDanAH । BavantaH sumahABAgAstasmAtprakzyAmi saMSayam ॥30॥

text: āśāvānpuruṣo yaḥ syādantarikṣamathāpi vā । kiṃ nu jyāyastaraṃ loke mahattvātpratibhāti vaḥ । etadicchāmi tattvena śrotuṃ kimiha durlabham ॥31॥
html:
āśāvānpuruṣo yaḥ syādantarikṣamathāpi vā ।
kiṃ nu jyāyastaraṃ loke mahattvātpratibhāti vaḥ ।
etadicchāmi tattvena śrotuṃ kimiha durlabham ॥31॥
slp1: ASAvAnpuruzo yaH syAdantarikzamaTApi vA । kiM nu jyAyastaraM loke mahattvAtpratiBAti vaH । etadicCAmi tattvena SrotuM kimiha durlaBam ॥31॥

text: yadi guhyaṃ taponityā na vo brūteha māciram । na hi guhyamataḥ śrotumicchāmi dvijapuṅgavāḥ ॥32॥
html:
yadi guhyaṃ taponityā na vo brūteha māciram ।
na hi guhyamataḥ śrotumicchāmi dvijapuṅgavāḥ ॥32॥
slp1: yadi guhyaM taponityA na vo brUteha mAciram । na hi guhyamataH SrotumicCAmi dvijapuNgavAH ॥32॥

text: bhavattapovighāto vā yena syādvirame tataḥ । yadi vāsti kathāyogo yo'yaṃ praśno mayeritaḥ ॥33॥
html:
bhavattapovighāto vā yena syādvirame tataḥ ।
yadi vāsti kathāyogo yo'yaṃ praśno mayeritaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: BavattapoviGAto vA yena syAdvirame tataH । yadi vAsti kaTAyogo yo'yaM praSno mayeritaH ॥33॥

text: etatkāraṇasāmagryaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ । bhavanto hi taponityā brūyuretatsamāhitāḥ] ॥34॥
html:
etatkāraṇasāmagryaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ।
bhavanto hi taponityā brūyuretatsamāhitāḥ] ॥34॥
slp1: etatkAraRasAmagryaM SrotumicCAmi tattvataH । Bavanto hi taponityA brUyuretatsamAhitAH] ॥34॥

text: tatasteṣāṃ samastānāmṛṣīṇāmṛṣisattamaḥ । ṛṣabho nāma viprarṣiḥ smayanniva tato'bravīt ॥1॥

html:

text: anyairnarairmahābāho vapuṣāṣṭaguṇānvitam । kṛśatā cāpi rājarṣe na dṛṣṭā tādṛśī kvacit ॥7॥

html:

slp1: SarIramapi rAjendra tasya kAnizWikAsamam । grIvA bAhU taTA pAdO keSAScAdButadarSanAH ॥8॥

html:

slp1: SiraH kAyAnurUpaM ca karRO netre taTEva ca । tasya vAkcEva cezwA ca sAmAnye rAjasattama ॥9॥

text: dṛṣṭvāhaṃ taṃ kṛśaṃ vipraṃ bhītaḥ paramadurmanāḥ । pādau tasyābhivādyātha sthitaḥ prāñjaliragrataḥ ॥10॥

slp1: dfzwvAhaM taM kfSaM vipraM BItaH paramadurmanAH । pAdO tasyABivAdyATa sTitaH prAYjaliragrataH ॥10॥

text: nivedya nāma gotraṃ ca pitaraṃ ca nararṣabha । pradiṣṭe cāsane tena śanairahamupāviśam ॥11॥
html:

slp1: nivedya nAma gotraM ca pitaraM ca nararzaBa । pradizwe cAsane tena SanErahamupAviSam ॥11॥

text: tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa kathā dharmārthasaṃhitāḥ । ṛṣimadhye mahārāja tatra dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ॥12॥
html:
tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa kathā dharmārthasaṃhitāḥ ।
ṛṣimadhye mahārāja tatra dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: tataH sa kaTayAmAsa kaTA DarmArTasaMhitAH । fzimaDye mahArAja tatra DarmaBftAM varaH ॥12॥

text: tasmiṃstu kathayatyeva rājā rājīvalocanaḥ । upāyājjavanairaśvaiḥ sabalaḥ sāvarodhanaḥ ॥13॥
html:

upāyājjavanairaśvaiḥ sabalaḥ sāvarodhanaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: tasmiMstu kaTayatyeva rAjA rAjIvalocanaH । upAyAjjavanEraSvEH sabalaH sAvaroDanaH ॥13॥

text: smaranputramaraṇye vai naṣṭaṃ paramadurmanāḥ । bhūridyumnapitā dhīmānraghuśreṣṭho mahāyaśāḥ ॥14॥
html:

text: iha drakṣyāmi taṃ putraṃ drakṣyāmīheti pārthivaḥ । evamāśākṛto rājaṃścaranvanamidaṃ purā ॥15॥
html:
iha drakṣyāmi taṃ putraṃ drakṣyāmīheti pārthivaḥ ।

slp1: iha drakzyAmi taM putraM drakzyAmIheti pArTivaH । evamASAkfto rAjaMScaranvanamidaM purA ॥15॥

text: durlabhaḥ sa mayā draṣṭuṃ nūnaṃ paramadhārmikaḥ । ekaḥ putro mahāraṇye naṣṭa ityasakṛttadā ॥16॥
html:
durlabhaḥ sa mayā draṣṭuṃ nūnaṃ paramadhārmikaḥ ।
ekaḥ putro mahāraṇye naṣṭa ityasakṛttadā ॥16॥
slp1: durlaBaH sa mayA drazwuM nUnaM paramaDArmikaH । ekaH putro mahAraRye nazwa ityasakfttadA ॥16॥

text: durlabhaḥ sa mayā draṣṭumāśā ca mahatī mama । tayā parītagātro'haṃ mumūrṣurnātra saṃśayaḥ ॥17॥
html:
durlabhaḥ sa mayā draṣṭumāśā ca mahatī mama ।
tayā parītagātro'haṃ mumūrṣurnātra saṃśayaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: durlaBaH sa mayA drazwumASA ca mahatI mama । tayA parItagAtro'haM mumUrzurnAtra saMSayaH ॥17॥

text: etacchrutvā sa bhagavāṃstanurmunivarottamaḥ । avākśirā dhyānaparo muhūrtamiva tasthivān ॥18॥
html:

slp1: etacCrutvA sa BagavAMstanurmunivarottamaH । avAkSirA DyAnaparo muhUrtamiva tasTivAn ॥18॥

text: tamanudhyāntamālakṣya rājā paramadurmanāḥ । uvāca vākyaṃ dīnātmā mandaṃ mandamivāsakṛt ॥19॥
html:

slp1: tamanuDyAntamAlakzya rAjA paramadurmanAH । uvAca vAkyaM dInAtmA mandaM mandamivAsakft ॥19॥

html:

text: maharṣirbhagavāṃstena pūrvamāsīdvimānitaḥ । bāliśāṃ buddhimāsthāya mandabhāgyatayātmanaḥ ॥21॥
html:
maharṣirbhagavāṃstena pūrvamāsīdvimānitaḥ ।

slp1: maharzirBagavAMstena pUrvamAsIdvimAnitaH । bAliSAM budDimAsTAya mandaBAgyatayAtmanaH ॥21॥

text: arthayankalaśaṃ rājankāñcanaṃ valkalāni ca । nirviṇṇaḥ sa tu viprarṣirnirāśaḥ samapadyata ॥22॥
html:
arthayankalaśaṃ rājankāñcanaṃ valkalāni ca ।

text: evamuktvābhivādyātha tamṛṣiṃ lokapūjitam । śrānto nyaṣīdaddharmātmā yathā tvaṃ narasattama ॥23॥
html:
evamuktvābhivādyātha tamṛṣiṃ lokapūjitam ।

slp1: arGyaM tataH samAnIya pAdyaM cEva mahAnfziH । AraRyakena viDinA rAjYe sarvaM nyavedayat ॥24॥

text: tataste munayaḥ sarve parivārya nararṣabham । upāviśanpuraskṛtya saptarṣaya iva dhruvam ॥25॥

text: vīradyumna iti khyāto rājāhaṃ dikṣu viśrutaḥ । bhūridyumnaṃ sutaṃ naṣṭamanveṣṭuṃ vanamāgataḥ ॥27॥
html:

text: ekaputraḥ sa viprāgrya bāla eva ca so'nagha । na dṛśyate vane cāsmiṃstamanveṣṭuṃ carāmyaham ॥28॥

na dṛśyate vane cāsmiṃstamanveṣṭuṃ carāmyaham ॥28॥
slp1: ekaputraH sa viprAgrya bAla eva ca so'naGa । na dfSyate vane cAsmiMstamanvezwuM carAmyaham ॥28॥

text: evamukte tu vacane rājñā muniradhomukhaḥ । tūṣṇīmevābhavattatra na ca pratyuktavānnṛpam ॥29॥

text: sa hi tena purā vipro rājñā nātyarthamānitaḥ । āśākṛśaṃ ca rājendra tapo dīrghaṃ samāsthitaḥ ॥30॥
html:

āśākṛśaṃ ca rājendra tapo dīrghaṃ samāsthitaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: sa hi tena purA vipro rAjYA nAtyarTamAnitaH । ASAkfSaM ca rAjendra tapo dIrGaM samAsTitaH ॥30॥

html:

slp1: pratigrahamahaM rAjYAM na karizye kaTaYcana । anyezAM cEva varRAnAmiti kftvA DiyaM tadA ॥31॥

text: āśā hi puruṣaṃ bālaṃ lālāpayati tasthuṣī । tāmahaṃ vyapaneṣyāmi iti kṛtvā vyavasthitaḥ ॥32॥

text: āśāyāḥ kiṃ kṛśatvaṃ ca kiṃ ceha bhuvi durlabham । bravītu bhagavānetattvaṃ hi dharmārthadarśivān ॥33॥
html:
āśāyāḥ kiṃ kṛśatvaṃ ca kiṃ ceha bhuvi durlabham ।

slp1: ASAyAH kiM kfSatvaM ca kiM ceha Buvi durlaBam । bravItu BagavAnetattvaM hi DarmArTadarSivAn ॥33॥

text: tataḥ saṃsmṛtya tatsarvaṃ smārayiṣyannivābravīt । rājānaṃ bhagavānviprastataḥ kṛśatanustanuḥ ॥34॥
html:
tataḥ saṃsmṛtya tatsarvaṃ smārayiṣyannivābravīt ।

slp1: tataH saMsmftya tatsarvaM smArayizyannivAbravIt । rAjAnaM BagavAnviprastataH kfSatanustanuH ॥34॥

text: kṛśatve na samaṃ rājannāśāyā vidyate nṛpa । tasyā vai durlabhatvāttu prārthitāḥ pārthivā mayā ॥35॥
html:
kṛśatve na samaṃ rājannāśāyā vidyate nṛpa ।

slp1: kfSatve na samaM rAjannASAyA vidyate nfpa । tasyA vE durlaBatvAttu prArTitAH pArTivA mayA ॥35॥

html:
kṛśākṛśe mayā brahmangṛhīte vacanāttava ।

slp1: kfSAkfSe mayA brahmangfhIte vacanAttava । durlaBatvaM ca tasyEva vedavAkyamiva dvija ॥36॥

text: saṃśayastu mahāprājña sañjāto hṛdaye mama । tanme sattama tattvena vaktumarhasi pṛcchataḥ ॥37॥

html:
tvattaḥ kṛśataraṃ kiṃ nu bravītu bhagavānidam ।
yadi guhyaṃ na te vipra loke'sminkiṃ nu durlabham ॥38॥
slp1: tvattaH kfSataraM kiM nu bravItu BagavAnidam । yadi guhyaM na te vipra loke'sminkiM nu durlaBam ॥38॥

text: durlabho'pyatha vā nāsti yo'rthī dhṛtimivāpnuyāt । sudurlabhatarastāta yo'rthinaṃ nāvamanyate ॥39॥
html:
durlabho'pyatha vā nāsti yo'rthī dhṛtimivāpnuyāt ।

slp1: durlaBo'pyaTa vA nAsti yo'rTI DftimivApnuyAt । sudurlaBatarastAta yo'rTinaM nAvamanyate ॥39॥

text: saṃśrutya nopakriyate paraṃ śaktyā yathārhataḥ । saktā yā sarvabhūteṣu sāśā kṛśatarī mayā ॥40॥
html:
saṃśrutya nopakriyate paraṃ śaktyā yathārhataḥ ।

slp1: saMSrutya nopakriyate paraM SaktyA yaTArhataH । saktA yA sarvaBUtezu sASA kfSatarI mayA ॥40॥

html:
ekaputraḥ pitā putre naṣṭe vā proṣite tathā ।
pravṛttiṃ yo na jānāti sāśā kṛśatarī mayā ॥41॥
slp1: ekaputraH pitA putre nazwe vA prozite taTA । pravfttiM yo na jAnAti sASA kfSatarI mayA ॥41॥

text: prasave caiva nārīṇāṃ vṛddhānāṃ putrakāritā । tathā narendra dhanināmāśā kṛśatarī mayā ॥42॥
html:
prasave caiva nārīṇāṃ vṛddhānāṃ putrakāritā ।
tathā narendra dhanināmāśā kṛśatarī mayā ॥42॥
slp1: prasave cEva nArIRAM vfdDAnAM putrakAritA । taTA narendra DaninAmASA kfSatarI mayA ॥42॥

text: etacchrutvā tato rājansa rājā sāvarodhanaḥ । saṃspṛśya pādau śirasā nipapāta dvijarṣabhe ॥43॥
html:
etacchrutvā tato rājansa rājā sāvarodhanaḥ ।
saṃspṛśya pādau śirasā nipapāta dvijarṣabhe ॥43॥
slp1: etacCrutvA tato rAjansa rAjA sAvaroDanaH । saMspfSya pAdO SirasA nipapAta dvijarzaBe ॥43॥
author: ṛṣabha uvāca ।

text: prasādaye tvā bhagavanputreṇecchāmi saṅgatim । vṛṇīṣva ca varaṃ vipra yamicchasi yathāvidhi ॥44॥
html:
prasādaye tvā bhagavanputreṇecchāmi saṅgatim ।
vṛṇīṣva ca varaṃ vipra yamicchasi yathāvidhi ॥44॥
slp1: prasAdaye tvA BagavanputreRecCAmi saNgatim । vfRIzva ca varaM vipra yamicCasi yaTAviDi ॥44॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: abravīcca hi taṃ vākyaṃ rājā rājīvalocanaḥ । satyametadyathā vipra tvayoktaṃ nāstyato mṛṣā ॥45॥
html:
abravīcca hi taṃ vākyaṃ rājā rājīvalocanaḥ ।
satyametadyathā vipra tvayoktaṃ nāstyato mṛṣā ॥45॥
slp1: abravIcca hi taM vAkyaM rAjA rAjIvalocanaH । satyametadyaTA vipra tvayoktaM nAstyato mfzA ॥45॥
author: ṛṣabha uvāca ।

text: tataḥ prahasya bhagavāṃstanurdharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ । putramasyānayatkṣipraṃ tapasā ca śrutena ca ॥46॥
html:
tataḥ prahasya bhagavāṃstanurdharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ।
putramasyānayatkṣipraṃ tapasā ca śrutena ca ॥46॥
slp1: tataH prahasya BagavAMstanurDarmaBftAM varaH । putramasyAnayatkzipraM tapasA ca Srutena ca ॥46॥

text: taṃ samānāyya putraṃ tu tadopālabhya pārthivam । ātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa dharmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ॥47॥
html:
taṃ samānāyya putraṃ tu tadopālabhya pārthivam ।
ātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa dharmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: taM samAnAyya putraM tu tadopAlaBya pArTivam । AtmAnaM darSayAmAsa DarmaM DarmaBftAM varaH ॥47॥

text: sandarśayitvā cātmānaṃ divyamadbhutadarśanam । vipāpmā vigatakrodhaścacāra vanamantikāt ॥48॥
html:
sandarśayitvā cātmānaṃ divyamadbhutadarśanam ।
vipāpmā vigatakrodhaścacāra vanamantikāt ॥48॥
slp1: sandarSayitvA cAtmAnaM divyamadButadarSanam । vipApmA vigatakroDaScacAra vanamantikAt ॥48॥

text: etaddṛṣṭaṃ mayā rājaṃstataśca vacanaṃ śrutam । āśāmapanayasvāśu tataḥ kṛśatarīmimām ॥49॥
html:
etaddṛṣṭaṃ mayā rājaṃstataśca vacanaṃ śrutam ।
āśāmapanayasvāśu tataḥ kṛśatarīmimām ॥49॥
slp1: etaddfzwaM mayA rAjaMstataSca vacanaM Srutam । ASAmapanayasvASu tataH kfSatarImimAm ॥49॥

text: sa tatrokto mahārāja ṛṣabheṇa mahātmanā । sumitro'panayatkṣipramāśāṃ kṛśatarīṃ tadā ॥50॥
html:
sa tatrokto mahārāja ṛṣabheṇa mahātmanā ।
sumitro'panayatkṣipramāśāṃ kṛśatarīṃ tadā ॥50॥
slp1: sa tatrokto mahArAja fzaBeRa mahAtmanA । sumitro'panayatkzipramASAM kfSatarIM tadA ॥50॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: evaṃ tvamapi kaunteya śrutvā vāṇīmimāṃ mama । sthiro bhava yathā rājanhimavānacalottamaḥ ॥51॥
html:
evaṃ tvamapi kaunteya śrutvā vāṇīmimāṃ mama ।
sthiro bhava yathā rājanhimavānacalottamaḥ ॥51॥
slp1: evaM tvamapi kOnteya SrutvA vARImimAM mama । sTiro Bava yaTA rAjanhimavAnacalottamaH ॥51॥

text: tvaṃ hi draṣṭā ca śrotā ca kṛcchreṣvarthakṛteṣviha । śrutvā mama mahārāja na santaptumihārhasi] ॥52॥
html:
tvaṃ hi draṣṭā ca śrotā ca kṛcchreṣvarthakṛteṣviha ।
śrutvā mama mahārāja na santaptumihārhasi] ॥52॥
slp1: tvaM hi drazwA ca SrotA ca kfcCrezvarTakftezviha । SrutvA mama mahArAja na santaptumihArhasi] ॥52॥

text: nāmṛtasyeva paryāptirmamāsti bruvati tvayi । tasmātkathaya bhūyastvaṃ dharmameva pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
nāmṛtasyeva paryāptirmamāsti bruvati tvayi ।
tasmātkathaya bhūyastvaṃ dharmameva pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: nAmftasyeva paryAptirmamAsti bruvati tvayi । tasmAtkaTaya BUyastvaM Darmameva pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । gautamasya ca saṃvādaṃ yamasya ca mahātmanaḥ ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
gautamasya ca saṃvādaṃ yamasya ca mahātmanaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । gOtamasya ca saMvAdaM yamasya ca mahAtmanaH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: pāriyātragiriṃ prāpya gautamasyāśramo mahān । uvāsa gautamo yatra kālaṃ tadapi me śṛṇu ॥3॥
html:
pāriyātragiriṃ prāpya gautamasyāśramo mahān ।
uvāsa gautamo yatra kālaṃ tadapi me śṛṇu ॥3॥
slp1: pAriyAtragiriM prApya gOtamasyASramo mahAn । uvAsa gOtamo yatra kAlaM tadapi me SfRu ॥3॥

text: ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣasahasrāṇi so'tapyadgautamastapaḥ । tamugratapasaṃ yuktaṃ tapasā bhāvitaṃ munim ॥4॥
html:
ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣasahasrāṇi so'tapyadgautamastapaḥ ।
tamugratapasaṃ yuktaṃ tapasā bhāvitaṃ munim ॥4॥
slp1: zazwiM varzasahasrARi so'tapyadgOtamastapaH । tamugratapasaM yuktaM tapasA BAvitaM munim ॥4॥

text: upayāto naravyāghra lokapālo yamastadā । tamapaśyatsutapasamṛṣiṃ vai gautamaṃ munim ॥5॥
html:
upayāto naravyāghra lokapālo yamastadā ।
tamapaśyatsutapasamṛṣiṃ vai gautamaṃ munim ॥5॥
slp1: upayAto naravyAGra lokapAlo yamastadA । tamapaSyatsutapasamfziM vE gOtamaM munim ॥5॥

text: sa taṃ viditvā brahmarṣiryamamāgatamojasā । prāñjaliḥ prayato bhūtvā upasṛptastapodhanaḥ ॥6॥
html:
sa taṃ viditvā brahmarṣiryamamāgatamojasā ।
prāñjaliḥ prayato bhūtvā upasṛptastapodhanaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: sa taM viditvA brahmarziryamamAgatamojasA । prAYjaliH prayato BUtvA upasfptastapoDanaH ॥6॥

text: taṃ dharmarājo dṛṣṭvaiva namaskṛtya nararṣabham । nyamantrayata dharmeṇa kriyatāṃ kimiti bruvan ॥7॥
html:
taṃ dharmarājo dṛṣṭvaiva namaskṛtya nararṣabham ।
nyamantrayata dharmeṇa kriyatāṃ kimiti bruvan ॥7॥
slp1: taM DarmarAjo dfzwvEva namaskftya nararzaBam । nyamantrayata DarmeRa kriyatAM kimiti bruvan ॥7॥

text: mātāpitṛbhyāmānṛṇyaṃ kiṃ kṛtvā samavāpnuyāt । kathaṃ ca lokānaśnāti puruṣo durlabhāñśubhān ॥8॥
html:
mātāpitṛbhyāmānṛṇyaṃ kiṃ kṛtvā samavāpnuyāt ।
kathaṃ ca lokānaśnāti puruṣo durlabhāñśubhān ॥8॥
slp1: mAtApitfByAmAnfRyaM kiM kftvA samavApnuyAt । kaTaM ca lokAnaSnAti puruzo durlaBAYSuBAn ॥8॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: tapaḥśaucavatā nityaṃ satyadharmaratena ca । mātāpitroraharahaḥ pūjanaṃ kāryamañjasā ॥9॥
html:
tapaḥśaucavatā nityaṃ satyadharmaratena ca ।
mātāpitroraharahaḥ pūjanaṃ kāryamañjasā ॥9॥
slp1: tapaHSOcavatA nityaM satyaDarmaratena ca । mAtApitroraharahaH pUjanaM kAryamaYjasA ॥9॥
author: yama uvāca ।

text: aśvamedhaiśca yaṣṭavyaṃ bahubhiḥ svāptadakṣiṇaiḥ । tena lokānupāśnāti puruṣo'dbhutadarśanān] ॥10॥
html:
aśvamedhaiśca yaṣṭavyaṃ bahubhiḥ svāptadakṣiṇaiḥ ।
tena lokānupāśnāti puruṣo'dbhutadarśanān] ॥10॥
slp1: aSvameDESca yazwavyaM bahuBiH svAptadakziREH । tena lokAnupASnAti puruzo'dButadarSanAn] ॥10॥

text: mitraiḥ prahīyamāṇasya bahvamitrasya kā gatiḥ । rājñaḥ saṅkṣīṇakośasya balahīnasya bhārata ॥1॥
html:
mitraiḥ prahīyamāṇasya bahvamitrasya kā gatiḥ ।
rājñaḥ saṅkṣīṇakośasya balahīnasya bhārata ॥1॥
slp1: mitrEH prahIyamARasya bahvamitrasya kA gatiH । rAjYaH saNkzIRakoSasya balahInasya BArata ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: duṣṭāmātyasahāyasya srutamantrasya sarvataḥ । rājyātpracyavamānasya gatimanyāmapaśyataḥ ॥2॥
html:
duṣṭāmātyasahāyasya srutamantrasya sarvataḥ ।
rājyātpracyavamānasya gatimanyāmapaśyataḥ ॥2॥
slp1: duzwAmAtyasahAyasya srutamantrasya sarvataH । rAjyAtpracyavamAnasya gatimanyAmapaSyataH ॥2॥

text: paracakrābhiyātasya durbalasya balīyasā । asaṃvihitarāṣṭrasya deśakālāvajānataḥ ॥3॥
html:
paracakrābhiyātasya durbalasya balīyasā ।
asaṃvihitarāṣṭrasya deśakālāvajānataḥ ॥3॥
slp1: paracakrABiyAtasya durbalasya balIyasA । asaMvihitarAzwrasya deSakAlAvajAnataH ॥3॥

text: aprāpyaṃ ca bhavetsāntvaṃ bhedo vāpyatipīḍanāt । jīvitaṃ cārthahetorvā tatra kiṃ sukṛtaṃ bhavet ॥4॥
html:
aprāpyaṃ ca bhavetsāntvaṃ bhedo vāpyatipīḍanāt ।
jīvitaṃ cārthahetorvā tatra kiṃ sukṛtaṃ bhavet ॥4॥
slp1: aprApyaM ca BavetsAntvaM Bedo vApyatipIqanAt । jIvitaM cArTahetorvA tatra kiM sukftaM Bavet ॥4॥

text: guhyaṃ mā dharmamaprākṣīratīva bharatarṣabha । apṛṣṭo notsahe vaktuṃ dharmamenaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥5॥
html:
guhyaṃ mā dharmamaprākṣīratīva bharatarṣabha ।
apṛṣṭo notsahe vaktuṃ dharmamenaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥5॥
slp1: guhyaM mA DarmamaprAkzIratIva BaratarzaBa । apfzwo notsahe vaktuM DarmamenaM yuDizWira ॥5॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dharmo hyaṇīyānvacanādbuddheśca bharatarṣabha । śrutvopāsya sadācāraiḥ sādhurbhavati sa kvacit ॥6॥
html:
dharmo hyaṇīyānvacanādbuddheśca bharatarṣabha ।
śrutvopāsya sadācāraiḥ sādhurbhavati sa kvacit ॥6॥
slp1: Darmo hyaRIyAnvacanAdbudDeSca BaratarzaBa । SrutvopAsya sadAcArEH sADurBavati sa kvacit ॥6॥

text: karmaṇā buddhipūrveṇa bhavatyāḍhyo na vā punaḥ । tādṛśo'yamanupraśnaḥ sa vyavasyastvayā dhiyā ॥7॥
html:
karmaṇā buddhipūrveṇa bhavatyāḍhyo na vā punaḥ ।
tādṛśo'yamanupraśnaḥ sa vyavasyastvayā dhiyā ॥7॥
slp1: karmaRA budDipUrveRa BavatyAQyo na vA punaH । tAdfSo'yamanupraSnaH sa vyavasyastvayA DiyA ॥7॥

text: upāyaṃ dharmabahulaṃ yātrārthaṃ śṛṇu bhārata । nāhametādṛśaṃ dharmaṃ bubhūṣe dharmakāraṇāt । duḥkhādāna ihāḍhyeṣu syāttu paścātkṣamo mataḥ ॥8॥
html:
upāyaṃ dharmabahulaṃ yātrārthaṃ śṛṇu bhārata ।
nāhametādṛśaṃ dharmaṃ bubhūṣe dharmakāraṇāt ।
duḥkhādāna ihāḍhyeṣu syāttu paścātkṣamo mataḥ ॥8॥
slp1: upAyaM DarmabahulaM yAtrArTaM SfRu BArata । nAhametAdfSaM DarmaM buBUze DarmakAraRAt । duHKAdAna ihAQyezu syAttu paScAtkzamo mataH ॥8॥

text: anugamya gatīnāṃ ca sarvāsāmeva niścayam । yathā yathā hi puruṣo nityaṃ śāstramavekṣate । tathā tathā vijānāti vijñānaṃ cāsya rocate ॥9॥
html:
anugamya gatīnāṃ ca sarvāsāmeva niścayam ।
yathā yathā hi puruṣo nityaṃ śāstramavekṣate ।
tathā tathā vijānāti vijñānaṃ cāsya rocate ॥9॥
slp1: anugamya gatInAM ca sarvAsAmeva niScayam । yaTA yaTA hi puruzo nityaM SAstramavekzate । taTA taTA vijAnAti vijYAnaM cAsya rocate ॥9॥

text: avijñānādayogaśca puruṣasyopajāyate । avijñānādayogo hi yogo bhūtikaraḥ punaḥ ॥10॥
html:
avijñānādayogaśca puruṣasyopajāyate ।
avijñānādayogo hi yogo bhūtikaraḥ punaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: avijYAnAdayogaSca puruzasyopajAyate । avijYAnAdayogo hi yogo BUtikaraH punaH ॥10॥

text: aśaṅkamāno vacanamanasūyuridaṃ śṛṇu । rājñaḥ kośakṣayādeva jāyate balasaṅkṣayaḥ ॥11॥
html:
aśaṅkamāno vacanamanasūyuridaṃ śṛṇu ।
rājñaḥ kośakṣayādeva jāyate balasaṅkṣayaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: aSaNkamAno vacanamanasUyuridaM SfRu । rAjYaH koSakzayAdeva jAyate balasaNkzayaH ॥11॥

text: kośaṃ sañjanayedrājā nirjalebhyo yathā jalam । kālaṃ prāpyānugṛhṇīyādeṣa dharmo'tra sāmpratam ॥12॥
html:
kośaṃ sañjanayedrājā nirjalebhyo yathā jalam ।
kālaṃ prāpyānugṛhṇīyādeṣa dharmo'tra sāmpratam ॥12॥
slp1: koSaM saYjanayedrAjA nirjaleByo yaTA jalam । kAlaM prApyAnugfhRIyAdeza Darmo'tra sAmpratam ॥12॥

text: upāyadharmaṃ prāpyainaṃ pūrvairācaritaṃ janaiḥ । anyo dharmaḥ samarthānāmāpatsvanyaśca bhārata ॥13॥
html:
upāyadharmaṃ prāpyainaṃ pūrvairācaritaṃ janaiḥ ।
anyo dharmaḥ samarthānāmāpatsvanyaśca bhārata ॥13॥
slp1: upAyaDarmaM prApyEnaM pUrvErAcaritaM janEH । anyo DarmaH samarTAnAmApatsvanyaSca BArata ॥13॥

text: prākkośaḥ procyate dharmo buddhirdharmādgarīyasī । dharmaṃ prāpya nyāyavṛttimabalīyānna vindati ॥14॥
html:
prākkośaḥ procyate dharmo buddhirdharmādgarīyasī ।
dharmaṃ prāpya nyāyavṛttimabalīyānna vindati ॥14॥
slp1: prAkkoSaH procyate Darmo budDirDarmAdgarIyasI । DarmaM prApya nyAyavfttimabalIyAnna vindati ॥14॥

text: yasmāddhanasyopapattirekāntena na vidyate । tasmādāpadyadharmo'pi śrūyate dharmalakṣaṇaḥ ॥15॥
html:
yasmāddhanasyopapattirekāntena na vidyate ।
tasmādāpadyadharmo'pi śrūyate dharmalakṣaṇaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: yasmAdDanasyopapattirekAntena na vidyate । tasmAdApadyaDarmo'pi SrUyate DarmalakzaRaH ॥15॥

text: adharmo jāyate yasminniti vai kavayo viduḥ । anantaraḥ kṣatriyasya iti vai vicikitsase ॥16॥
html:
adharmo jāyate yasminniti vai kavayo viduḥ ।
anantaraḥ kṣatriyasya iti vai vicikitsase ॥16॥
slp1: aDarmo jAyate yasminniti vE kavayo viduH । anantaraH kzatriyasya iti vE vicikitsase ॥16॥

text: yathāsya dharmo na glāyenneyācchatruvaśaṃ yathā । tatkartavyamihetyāhurnātmānamavasādayet ॥17॥
html:
yathāsya dharmo na glāyenneyācchatruvaśaṃ yathā ।
tatkartavyamihetyāhurnātmānamavasādayet ॥17॥
slp1: yaTAsya Darmo na glAyenneyAcCatruvaSaM yaTA । tatkartavyamihetyAhurnAtmAnamavasAdayet ॥17॥

text: sannātmā naiva dharmasya na parasya na cātmanaḥ । sarvopāyairujjihīrṣedātmānamiti niścayaḥ ॥18॥
html:
sannātmā naiva dharmasya na parasya na cātmanaḥ ।
sarvopāyairujjihīrṣedātmānamiti niścayaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: sannAtmA nEva Darmasya na parasya na cAtmanaH । sarvopAyErujjihIrzedAtmAnamiti niScayaH ॥18॥

text: tatra dharmavidāṃ tāta niścayo dharmanaipuṇe । udyamo jīvanaṃ kṣatre bāhuvīryāditi śrutiḥ ॥19॥
html:
tatra dharmavidāṃ tāta niścayo dharmanaipuṇe ।
udyamo jīvanaṃ kṣatre bāhuvīryāditi śrutiḥ ॥19॥
slp1: tatra DarmavidAM tAta niScayo DarmanEpuRe । udyamo jIvanaM kzatre bAhuvIryAditi SrutiH ॥19॥

text: kṣatriyo vṛttisaṃrodhe kasya nādātumarhati । anyatra tāpasasvācca brāhmaṇasvācca bhārata ॥20॥
html:
kṣatriyo vṛttisaṃrodhe kasya nādātumarhati ।
anyatra tāpasasvācca brāhmaṇasvācca bhārata ॥20॥
slp1: kzatriyo vfttisaMroDe kasya nAdAtumarhati । anyatra tApasasvAcca brAhmaRasvAcca BArata ॥20॥

text: yathā vai brāhmaṇaḥ sīdannayājyamapi yājayet । abhojyānnāni cāśnīyāttathedaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥21॥
html:
yathā vai brāhmaṇaḥ sīdannayājyamapi yājayet ।
abhojyānnāni cāśnīyāttathedaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: yaTA vE brAhmaRaH sIdannayAjyamapi yAjayet । aBojyAnnAni cASnIyAttaTedaM nAtra saMSayaH ॥21॥

text: pīḍitasya kimadvāramutpatho nidhṛtasya vā । advārataḥ pradravati yadā bhavati pīḍitaḥ ॥22॥
html:
pīḍitasya kimadvāramutpatho nidhṛtasya vā ।
advārataḥ pradravati yadā bhavati pīḍitaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: pIqitasya kimadvAramutpaTo niDftasya vA । advArataH pradravati yadA Bavati pIqitaH ॥22॥

text: tasya kośabalajyānyā sarvalokaparābhavaḥ । bhaikṣacaryā na vihitā na ca viṭśūdrajīvikā ॥23॥
html:
tasya kośabalajyānyā sarvalokaparābhavaḥ ।
bhaikṣacaryā na vihitā na ca viṭśūdrajīvikā ॥23॥
slp1: tasya koSabalajyAnyA sarvalokaparABavaH । BEkzacaryA na vihitA na ca viwSUdrajIvikA ॥23॥

text: svadharmānantarā vṛttiryānyānanupajīvataḥ । vahataḥ prathamaṃ kalpamanukalpena jīvanam ॥24॥
html:
svadharmānantarā vṛttiryānyānanupajīvataḥ ।
vahataḥ prathamaṃ kalpamanukalpena jīvanam ॥24॥
slp1: svaDarmAnantarA vfttiryAnyAnanupajIvataH । vahataH praTamaM kalpamanukalpena jIvanam ॥24॥

text: āpadgatena dharmāṇāmanyāyenopajīvanam । api hyetadbrāhmaṇeṣu dṛṣṭaṃ vṛttiparikṣaye ॥25॥
html:
āpadgatena dharmāṇāmanyāyenopajīvanam ।
api hyetadbrāhmaṇeṣu dṛṣṭaṃ vṛttiparikṣaye ॥25॥
slp1: Apadgatena DarmARAmanyAyenopajIvanam । api hyetadbrAhmaRezu dfzwaM vfttiparikzaye ॥25॥

text: kṣatriye saṃśayaḥ kaḥ syādityetanniścitaṃ sadā । ādadīta viśiṣṭebhyo nāvasīdetkathañcana ॥26॥
html:
kṣatriye saṃśayaḥ kaḥ syādityetanniścitaṃ sadā ।
ādadīta viśiṣṭebhyo nāvasīdetkathañcana ॥26॥
slp1: kzatriye saMSayaH kaH syAdityetanniScitaM sadA । AdadIta viSizweByo nAvasIdetkaTaYcana ॥26॥

text: hantāraṃ rakṣitāraṃ ca prajānāṃ kṣatriyaṃ viduḥ । tasmātsaṃrakṣatā kāryamādānaṃ kṣatrabandhunā ॥27॥
html:
hantāraṃ rakṣitāraṃ ca prajānāṃ kṣatriyaṃ viduḥ ।
tasmātsaṃrakṣatā kāryamādānaṃ kṣatrabandhunā ॥27॥
slp1: hantAraM rakzitAraM ca prajAnAM kzatriyaM viduH । tasmAtsaMrakzatA kAryamAdAnaM kzatrabanDunA ॥27॥

text: anyatra rājanhiṃsāyā vṛttirnehāsti kasyacit । apyaraṇyasamutthasya ekasya carato muneḥ ॥28॥
html:
anyatra rājanhiṃsāyā vṛttirnehāsti kasyacit ।
apyaraṇyasamutthasya ekasya carato muneḥ ॥28॥
slp1: anyatra rAjanhiMsAyA vfttirnehAsti kasyacit । apyaraRyasamutTasya ekasya carato muneH ॥28॥

text: na śaṅkhalikhitāṃ vṛttiṃ śakyamāsthāya jīvitum । viśeṣataḥ kuruśreṣṭha prajāpālanamīpsatā ॥29॥
html:
na śaṅkhalikhitāṃ vṛttiṃ śakyamāsthāya jīvitum ।
viśeṣataḥ kuruśreṣṭha prajāpālanamīpsatā ॥29॥
slp1: na SaNKaliKitAM vfttiM SakyamAsTAya jIvitum । viSezataH kuruSrezWa prajApAlanamIpsatA ॥29॥

text: parasparābhisaṃrakṣā rājñā rāṣṭreṇa cāpadi । nityameveha kartavyā eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥30॥
html:
parasparābhisaṃrakṣā rājñā rāṣṭreṇa cāpadi ।
nityameveha kartavyā eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: parasparABisaMrakzA rAjYA rAzwreRa cApadi । nityameveha kartavyA eza DarmaH sanAtanaH ॥30॥

text: rājā rāṣṭraṃ yathāpatsu dravyaughaiḥ parirakṣati । rāṣṭreṇa rājā vyasane parirakṣyastathā bhavet ॥31॥
html:
rājā rāṣṭraṃ yathāpatsu dravyaughaiḥ parirakṣati ।
rāṣṭreṇa rājā vyasane parirakṣyastathā bhavet ॥31॥
slp1: rAjA rAzwraM yaTApatsu dravyOGEH parirakzati । rAzwreRa rAjA vyasane parirakzyastaTA Bavet ॥31॥

text: kośaṃ daṇḍaṃ balaṃ mitraṃ yadanyadapi sañcitam । na kurvītāntaraṃ rāṣṭre rājā parigate kṣudhā ॥32॥
html:
kośaṃ daṇḍaṃ balaṃ mitraṃ yadanyadapi sañcitam ।
na kurvītāntaraṃ rāṣṭre rājā parigate kṣudhā ॥32॥
slp1: koSaM daRqaM balaM mitraM yadanyadapi saYcitam । na kurvItAntaraM rAzwre rAjA parigate kzuDA ॥32॥

text: bījaṃ bhaktena sampādyamiti dharmavido viduḥ । atraitacchambarasyāhurmahāmāyasya darśanam ॥33॥
html:
bījaṃ bhaktena sampādyamiti dharmavido viduḥ ।
atraitacchambarasyāhurmahāmāyasya darśanam ॥33॥
slp1: bIjaM Baktena sampAdyamiti Darmavido viduH । atrEtacCambarasyAhurmahAmAyasya darSanam ॥33॥

text: dhiktasya jīvitaṃ rājño rāṣṭre yasyāvasīdati । avṛttyāntyamanuṣyo'pi yo vai veda śibervacaḥ ॥34॥
html:
dhiktasya jīvitaṃ rājño rāṣṭre yasyāvasīdati ।
avṛttyāntyamanuṣyo'pi yo vai veda śibervacaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: Diktasya jIvitaM rAjYo rAzwre yasyAvasIdati । avfttyAntyamanuzyo'pi yo vE veda SibervacaH ॥34॥

text: rājñaḥ kośabalaṃ mūlaṃ kośamūlaṃ punarbalam । tanmūlaṃ sarvadharmāṇāṃ dharmamūlāḥ punaḥ prajāḥ ॥35॥
html:
rājñaḥ kośabalaṃ mūlaṃ kośamūlaṃ punarbalam ।
tanmūlaṃ sarvadharmāṇāṃ dharmamūlāḥ punaḥ prajāḥ ॥35॥
slp1: rAjYaH koSabalaM mUlaM koSamUlaM punarbalam । tanmUlaM sarvaDarmARAM DarmamUlAH punaH prajAH ॥35॥

text: nānyānapīḍayitveha kośaḥ śakyaḥ kuto balam । tadarthaṃ pīḍayitvā ca doṣaṃ na prāptumarhati ॥36॥
html:
nānyānapīḍayitveha kośaḥ śakyaḥ kuto balam ।
tadarthaṃ pīḍayitvā ca doṣaṃ na prāptumarhati ॥36॥
slp1: nAnyAnapIqayitveha koSaH SakyaH kuto balam । tadarTaM pIqayitvA ca dozaM na prAptumarhati ॥36॥

text: akāryamapi yajñārthaṃ kriyate yajñakarmasu । etasmātkāraṇādrājā na doṣaṃ prāptumarhati ॥37॥
html:
akāryamapi yajñārthaṃ kriyate yajñakarmasu ।
etasmātkāraṇādrājā na doṣaṃ prāptumarhati ॥37॥
slp1: akAryamapi yajYArTaM kriyate yajYakarmasu । etasmAtkAraRAdrAjA na dozaM prAptumarhati ॥37॥

text: arthārthamanyadbhavati viparītamathāparam । anarthārthamathāpyanyattatsarvaṃ hyarthalakṣaṇam । evaṃ buddhyā samprapaśyenmedhāvī kāryaniścayam ॥38॥
html:
arthārthamanyadbhavati viparītamathāparam ।
anarthārthamathāpyanyattatsarvaṃ hyarthalakṣaṇam ।
evaṃ buddhyā samprapaśyenmedhāvī kāryaniścayam ॥38॥
slp1: arTArTamanyadBavati viparItamaTAparam । anarTArTamaTApyanyattatsarvaM hyarTalakzaRam । evaM budDyA samprapaSyenmeDAvI kAryaniScayam ॥38॥

text: yajñārthamanyadbhavati yajñe nārthastathāparaḥ । yajñasyārthārthamevānyattatsarvaṃ yajñasādhanam ॥39॥
html:
yajñārthamanyadbhavati yajñe nārthastathāparaḥ ।
yajñasyārthārthamevānyattatsarvaṃ yajñasādhanam ॥39॥
slp1: yajYArTamanyadBavati yajYe nArTastaTAparaH । yajYasyArTArTamevAnyattatsarvaM yajYasADanam ॥39॥

text: upamāmatra vakṣyāmi dharmatattvaprakāśinīm । yūpaṃ chindanti yajñārthaṃ tatra ye paripanthinaḥ ॥40॥
html:
upamāmatra vakṣyāmi dharmatattvaprakāśinīm ।
yūpaṃ chindanti yajñārthaṃ tatra ye paripanthinaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: upamAmatra vakzyAmi DarmatattvaprakASinIm । yUpaM Cindanti yajYArTaM tatra ye paripanTinaH ॥40॥

text: drumāḥ kecana sāmantā dhruvaṃ chindanti tānapi । te cāpi nipatanto'nyānnighnanti ca vanaspatīn ॥41॥
html:
drumāḥ kecana sāmantā dhruvaṃ chindanti tānapi ।
te cāpi nipatanto'nyānnighnanti ca vanaspatīn ॥41॥
slp1: drumAH kecana sAmantA DruvaM Cindanti tAnapi । te cApi nipatanto'nyAnniGnanti ca vanaspatIn ॥41॥

text: evaṃ kośasya mahato ye narāḥ paripanthinaḥ । tānahatvā na paśyāmi siddhimatra parantapa ॥42॥
html:
evaṃ kośasya mahato ye narāḥ paripanthinaḥ ।
tānahatvā na paśyāmi siddhimatra parantapa ॥42॥
slp1: evaM koSasya mahato ye narAH paripanTinaH । tAnahatvA na paSyAmi sidDimatra parantapa ॥42॥

text: dhanena jayate lokāvubhau paramimaṃ tathā । satyaṃ ca dharmavacanaṃ yathā nāstyadhanastathā ॥43॥
html:
dhanena jayate lokāvubhau paramimaṃ tathā ।
satyaṃ ca dharmavacanaṃ yathā nāstyadhanastathā ॥43॥
slp1: Danena jayate lokAvuBO paramimaM taTA । satyaM ca DarmavacanaM yaTA nAstyaDanastaTA ॥43॥

text: sarvopāyairādadīta dhanaṃ yajñaprayojanam । na tulyadoṣaḥ syādevaṃ kāryākāryeṣu bhārata ॥44॥
html:
sarvopāyairādadīta dhanaṃ yajñaprayojanam ।
na tulyadoṣaḥ syādevaṃ kāryākāryeṣu bhārata ॥44॥
slp1: sarvopAyErAdadIta DanaM yajYaprayojanam । na tulyadozaH syAdevaM kAryAkAryezu BArata ॥44॥

text: naitau sambhavato rājankathañcidapi bhārata । na hyaraṇyeṣu paśyāmi dhanavṛddhānahaṃ kvacit ॥45॥
html:
naitau sambhavato rājankathañcidapi bhārata ।
na hyaraṇyeṣu paśyāmi dhanavṛddhānahaṃ kvacit ॥45॥
slp1: nEtO samBavato rAjankaTaYcidapi BArata । na hyaraRyezu paSyAmi DanavfdDAnahaM kvacit ॥45॥

text: yadidaṃ dṛśyate vittaṃ pṛthivyāmiha kiñcana । mamedaṃ syānmamedaṃ syādityayaṃ kāṅkṣate janaḥ ॥46॥
html:
yadidaṃ dṛśyate vittaṃ pṛthivyāmiha kiñcana ।
mamedaṃ syānmamedaṃ syādityayaṃ kāṅkṣate janaḥ ॥46॥
slp1: yadidaM dfSyate vittaM pfTivyAmiha kiYcana । mamedaM syAnmamedaM syAdityayaM kANkzate janaH ॥46॥

text: na ca rājyasamo dharmaḥ kaścidasti parantapa । dharmaṃ śaṃsanti te rājñāmāpadarthamito'nyathā ॥47॥
html:
na ca rājyasamo dharmaḥ kaścidasti parantapa ।
dharmaṃ śaṃsanti te rājñāmāpadarthamito'nyathā ॥47॥
slp1: na ca rAjyasamo DarmaH kaScidasti parantapa । DarmaM SaMsanti te rAjYAmApadarTamito'nyaTA ॥47॥

text: dānena karmaṇā cānye tapasānye tapasvinaḥ । buddhyā dākṣyeṇa cāpyanye cinvanti dhanasañcayān ॥48॥
html:
dānena karmaṇā cānye tapasānye tapasvinaḥ ।
buddhyā dākṣyeṇa cāpyanye cinvanti dhanasañcayān ॥48॥
slp1: dAnena karmaRA cAnye tapasAnye tapasvinaH । budDyA dAkzyeRa cApyanye cinvanti DanasaYcayAn ॥48॥

text: adhanaṃ durbalaṃ prāhurdhanena balavānbhavet । sarvaṃ dhanavataḥ prāpyaṃ sarvaṃ tarati kośavān । kośāddharmaśca kāmaśca paro lokastathāpyayam] ॥49॥
html:
adhanaṃ durbalaṃ prāhurdhanena balavānbhavet ।
sarvaṃ dhanavataḥ prāpyaṃ sarvaṃ tarati kośavān ।
kośāddharmaśca kāmaśca paro lokastathāpyayam] ॥49॥
slp1: aDanaM durbalaM prAhurDanena balavAnBavet । sarvaM DanavataH prApyaM sarvaM tarati koSavAn । koSAdDarmaSca kAmaSca paro lokastaTApyayam] ॥49॥

text: kṣīṇasya dīrghasūtrasya sānukrośasya bandhuṣu । viraktapaurarāṣṭrasya nirdravyanicayasya ca ॥1॥
html:
kṣīṇasya dīrghasūtrasya sānukrośasya bandhuṣu ।
viraktapaurarāṣṭrasya nirdravyanicayasya ca ॥1॥
slp1: kzIRasya dIrGasUtrasya sAnukroSasya banDuzu । viraktapOrarAzwrasya nirdravyanicayasya ca ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: pariśaṅkitamukhyasya srutamantrasya bhārata । asambhāvitamitrasya bhinnāmātyasya sarvaśaḥ ॥2॥
html:
pariśaṅkitamukhyasya srutamantrasya bhārata ।
asambhāvitamitrasya bhinnāmātyasya sarvaśaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: pariSaNkitamuKyasya srutamantrasya BArata । asamBAvitamitrasya BinnAmAtyasya sarvaSaH ॥2॥

text: paracakrābhiyātasya durbalasya balīyasā । āpannacetaso brūhi kiṃ kāryamavaśiṣyate ॥3॥
html:
paracakrābhiyātasya durbalasya balīyasā ।
āpannacetaso brūhi kiṃ kāryamavaśiṣyate ॥3॥
slp1: paracakrABiyAtasya durbalasya balIyasA । Apannacetaso brUhi kiM kAryamavaSizyate ॥3॥

text: bāhyaścedvijigīṣuḥ syāddharmārthakuśalaḥ śuciḥ । javena sandhiṃ kurvīta pūrvānpūrvānvimokṣayan ॥4॥
html:
bāhyaścedvijigīṣuḥ syāddharmārthakuśalaḥ śuciḥ ।
javena sandhiṃ kurvīta pūrvānpūrvānvimokṣayan ॥4॥
slp1: bAhyaScedvijigIzuH syAdDarmArTakuSalaH SuciH । javena sanDiM kurvIta pUrvAnpUrvAnvimokzayan ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: adharmavijigīṣuścedbalavānpāpaniścayaḥ । ātmanaḥ sannirodhena sandhiṃ tenābhiyojayet ॥5॥
html:
adharmavijigīṣuścedbalavānpāpaniścayaḥ ।
ātmanaḥ sannirodhena sandhiṃ tenābhiyojayet ॥5॥
slp1: aDarmavijigIzuScedbalavAnpApaniScayaH । AtmanaH sanniroDena sanDiM tenABiyojayet ॥5॥

text: apāsya rājadhānīṃ vā taredanyena vāpadam । tadbhāvabhāve dravyāṇi jīvanpunarupārjayet ॥6॥
html:
apāsya rājadhānīṃ vā taredanyena vāpadam ।
tadbhāvabhāve dravyāṇi jīvanpunarupārjayet ॥6॥
slp1: apAsya rAjaDAnIM vA taredanyena vApadam । tadBAvaBAve dravyARi jIvanpunarupArjayet ॥6॥

text: yāstu syuḥ kevalatyāgācchakyāstaritumāpadaḥ । kastatrādhikamātmānaṃ santyajedarthadharmavit ॥7॥
html:
yāstu syuḥ kevalatyāgācchakyāstaritumāpadaḥ ।
kastatrādhikamātmānaṃ santyajedarthadharmavit ॥7॥
slp1: yAstu syuH kevalatyAgAcCakyAstaritumApadaH । kastatrADikamAtmAnaM santyajedarTaDarmavit ॥7॥

text: avarodhājjugupseta kā sapatnadhane dayā । na tvevātmā pradātavyaḥ śakye sati kathañcana ॥8॥
html:
avarodhājjugupseta kā sapatnadhane dayā ।
na tvevātmā pradātavyaḥ śakye sati kathañcana ॥8॥
slp1: avaroDAjjugupseta kA sapatnaDane dayA । na tvevAtmA pradAtavyaH Sakye sati kaTaYcana ॥8॥

text: ābhyantare prakupite bāhye copanipīḍite । kṣīṇe kośe srute mantre kiṃ kāryamavaśiṣyate ॥9॥
html:
ābhyantare prakupite bāhye copanipīḍite ।
kṣīṇe kośe srute mantre kiṃ kāryamavaśiṣyate ॥9॥
slp1: AByantare prakupite bAhye copanipIqite । kzIRe koSe srute mantre kiM kAryamavaSizyate ॥9॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kṣipraṃ vā sandhikāmaḥ syātkṣipraṃ vā tīkṣṇavikramaḥ । padāpanayanaṃ kṣiprametāvatsāmparāyikam ॥10॥
html:
kṣipraṃ vā sandhikāmaḥ syātkṣipraṃ vā tīkṣṇavikramaḥ ।
padāpanayanaṃ kṣiprametāvatsāmparāyikam ॥10॥
slp1: kzipraM vA sanDikAmaH syAtkzipraM vA tIkzRavikramaH । padApanayanaM kziprametAvatsAmparAyikam ॥10॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: anuraktena puṣṭena hṛṣṭena jagatīpate । alpenāpi hi sainyena mahīṃ jayati pārthivaḥ ॥11॥
html:
anuraktena puṣṭena hṛṣṭena jagatīpate ।
alpenāpi hi sainyena mahīṃ jayati pārthivaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: anuraktena puzwena hfzwena jagatIpate । alpenApi hi sEnyena mahIM jayati pArTivaH ॥11॥

text: hato vā divamārohedvijayī kṣitimāvaset । yuddhe tu santyajanprāṇāñśakrasyaiti salokatām ॥12॥
html:
hato vā divamārohedvijayī kṣitimāvaset ।
yuddhe tu santyajanprāṇāñśakrasyaiti salokatām ॥12॥
slp1: hato vA divamArohedvijayI kzitimAvaset । yudDe tu santyajanprARAYSakrasyEti salokatAm ॥12॥

text: sarvalokāgamaṃ kṛtvā mṛdutvaṃ gantumeva ca । viśvāsādvinayaṃ kuryādvyavasyedvāpyupānahau ॥13॥
html:
sarvalokāgamaṃ kṛtvā mṛdutvaṃ gantumeva ca ।
viśvāsādvinayaṃ kuryādvyavasyedvāpyupānahau ॥13॥
slp1: sarvalokAgamaM kftvA mfdutvaM gantumeva ca । viSvAsAdvinayaM kuryAdvyavasyedvApyupAnahO ॥13॥

text: apakramitumicchedvā yathākāmaṃ tu sāntvayet । viliṅgamitvā mitreṇa tataḥ svayamupakramet] ॥14॥
html:
apakramitumicchedvā yathākāmaṃ tu sāntvayet ।
viliṅgamitvā mitreṇa tataḥ svayamupakramet] ॥14॥
slp1: apakramitumicCedvA yaTAkAmaM tu sAntvayet । viliNgamitvA mitreRa tataH svayamupakramet] ॥14॥

text: hīne paramake dharme sarvalokātilaṅghini । sarvasmindasyusādbhūte pṛthivyāmupajīvane ॥1॥
html:
hīne paramake dharme sarvalokātilaṅghini ।
sarvasmindasyusādbhūte pṛthivyāmupajīvane ॥1॥
slp1: hIne paramake Darme sarvalokAtilaNGini । sarvasmindasyusAdBUte pfTivyAmupajIvane ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kenāsminbrāhmaṇo jīvejjaghanye kāla āgate । asantyajanputrapautrānanukrośātpitāmaha ॥2॥
html:
kenāsminbrāhmaṇo jīvejjaghanye kāla āgate ।
asantyajanputrapautrānanukrośātpitāmaha ॥2॥
slp1: kenAsminbrAhmaRo jIvejjaGanye kAla Agate । asantyajanputrapOtrAnanukroSAtpitAmaha ॥2॥

text: vijñānabalamāsthāya jīvitavyaṃ tathāgate । sarvaṃ sādhvarthamevedamasādhvarthaṃ na kiñcana ॥3॥
html:
vijñānabalamāsthāya jīvitavyaṃ tathāgate ।
sarvaṃ sādhvarthamevedamasādhvarthaṃ na kiñcana ॥3॥
slp1: vijYAnabalamAsTAya jIvitavyaM taTAgate । sarvaM sADvarTamevedamasADvarTaM na kiYcana ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: asādhubhyo nirādāya sādhubhyo yaḥ prayacchati । ātmānaṃ saṅkramaṃ kṛtvā kṛtsnadharmavideva saḥ ॥4॥
html:
asādhubhyo nirādāya sādhubhyo yaḥ prayacchati ।
ātmānaṃ saṅkramaṃ kṛtvā kṛtsnadharmavideva saḥ ॥4॥
slp1: asADuByo nirAdAya sADuByo yaH prayacCati । AtmAnaM saNkramaM kftvA kftsnaDarmavideva saH ॥4॥

text: suroṣeṇātmano rājanrājye sthitimakopayan । adattamapyādadīta dāturvittaṃ mameti vā ॥5॥
html:
suroṣeṇātmano rājanrājye sthitimakopayan ।
adattamapyādadīta dāturvittaṃ mameti vā ॥5॥
slp1: surozeRAtmano rAjanrAjye sTitimakopayan । adattamapyAdadIta dAturvittaM mameti vA ॥5॥

text: vijñānabalapūto yo vartate ninditeṣvapi । vṛttavijñānavāndhīraḥ kastaṃ kiṃ vaktumarhati ॥6॥
html:
vijñānabalapūto yo vartate ninditeṣvapi ।
vṛttavijñānavāndhīraḥ kastaṃ kiṃ vaktumarhati ॥6॥
slp1: vijYAnabalapUto yo vartate ninditezvapi । vfttavijYAnavAnDIraH kastaM kiM vaktumarhati ॥6॥

text: yeṣāṃ balakṛtā vṛttirnaiṣāmanyābhirocate । tejasābhipravardhante balavanto yudhiṣṭhira ॥7॥
html:
yeṣāṃ balakṛtā vṛttirnaiṣāmanyābhirocate ।
tejasābhipravardhante balavanto yudhiṣṭhira ॥7॥
slp1: yezAM balakftA vfttirnEzAmanyABirocate । tejasABipravarDante balavanto yuDizWira ॥7॥

text: yadeva prakṛtaṃ śāstramaviśeṣeṇa vindati । tadeva madhyāḥ sevante medhāvī cāpyathottaram ॥8॥
html:
yadeva prakṛtaṃ śāstramaviśeṣeṇa vindati ।
tadeva madhyāḥ sevante medhāvī cāpyathottaram ॥8॥
slp1: yadeva prakftaM SAstramaviSezeRa vindati । tadeva maDyAH sevante meDAvI cApyaTottaram ॥8॥

text: ṛtvikpurohitācāryānsatkṛtairabhipūjitān । na brāhmaṇānyātayeta doṣānprāpnoti yātayan ॥9॥
html:
ṛtvikpurohitācāryānsatkṛtairabhipūjitān ।
na brāhmaṇānyātayeta doṣānprāpnoti yātayan ॥9॥
slp1: ftvikpurohitAcAryAnsatkftEraBipUjitAn । na brAhmaRAnyAtayeta dozAnprApnoti yAtayan ॥9॥

text: etatpramāṇaṃ lokasya cakṣuretatsanātanam । tatpramāṇo'vagāheta tena tatsādhvasādhu vā ॥10॥
html:
etatpramāṇaṃ lokasya cakṣuretatsanātanam ।
tatpramāṇo'vagāheta tena tatsādhvasādhu vā ॥10॥
slp1: etatpramARaM lokasya cakzuretatsanAtanam । tatpramARo'vagAheta tena tatsADvasADu vA ॥10॥

text: bahūni grāmavāstavyā roṣādbrūyuḥ parasparam । na teṣāṃ vacanādrājā satkuryādyātayeta vā ॥11॥
html:
bahūni grāmavāstavyā roṣādbrūyuḥ parasparam ।
na teṣāṃ vacanādrājā satkuryādyātayeta vā ॥11॥
slp1: bahUni grAmavAstavyA rozAdbrUyuH parasparam । na tezAM vacanAdrAjA satkuryAdyAtayeta vA ॥11॥

text: na vācyaḥ parivādo vai na śrotavyaḥ kathañcana । karṇāveva pidhātavyau prastheyaṃ vā tato'nyataḥ ॥12॥
html:
na vācyaḥ parivādo vai na śrotavyaḥ kathañcana ।
karṇāveva pidhātavyau prastheyaṃ vā tato'nyataḥ ॥12॥
slp1: na vAcyaH parivAdo vE na SrotavyaH kaTaYcana । karRAveva piDAtavyO prasTeyaM vA tato'nyataH ॥12॥

text: na vai satāṃ vṛttametatparivādo na paiśunam । guṇānāmeva vaktāraḥ santaḥ satsu yudhiṣṭhira ॥13॥
html:
na vai satāṃ vṛttametatparivādo na paiśunam ।
guṇānāmeva vaktāraḥ santaḥ satsu yudhiṣṭhira ॥13॥
slp1: na vE satAM vfttametatparivAdo na pESunam । guRAnAmeva vaktAraH santaH satsu yuDizWira ॥13॥

text: yathā samadhurau damyau sudāntau sādhuvāhinau । dhuramudyamya vahatastathā varteta vai nṛpaḥ । yathā yathāsya vahataḥ sahāyāḥ syustathāpare ॥14॥
html:
yathā samadhurau damyau sudāntau sādhuvāhinau ।
dhuramudyamya vahatastathā varteta vai nṛpaḥ ।
yathā yathāsya vahataḥ sahāyāḥ syustathāpare ॥14॥
slp1: yaTA samaDurO damyO sudAntO sADuvAhinO । Duramudyamya vahatastaTA varteta vE nfpaH । yaTA yaTAsya vahataH sahAyAH syustaTApare ॥14॥

text: ācārameva manyante garīyo dharmalakṣaṇam । apare naivamicchanti ye śaṅkhalikhitapriyāḥ । mārdavādatha lobhādvā te brūyurvākyamīdṛśam ॥15॥
html:
ācārameva manyante garīyo dharmalakṣaṇam ।
apare naivamicchanti ye śaṅkhalikhitapriyāḥ ।
mārdavādatha lobhādvā te brūyurvākyamīdṛśam ॥15॥
slp1: AcArameva manyante garIyo DarmalakzaRam । apare nEvamicCanti ye SaNKaliKitapriyAH । mArdavAdaTa loBAdvA te brUyurvAkyamIdfSam ॥15॥

text: ārṣamapyatra paśyanti vikarmasthasya yāpanam । na cārṣātsadṛśaṃ kiñcitpramāṇaṃ vidyate kvacit ॥16॥
html:
ārṣamapyatra paśyanti vikarmasthasya yāpanam ।
na cārṣātsadṛśaṃ kiñcitpramāṇaṃ vidyate kvacit ॥16॥
slp1: Arzamapyatra paSyanti vikarmasTasya yApanam । na cArzAtsadfSaM kiYcitpramARaM vidyate kvacit ॥16॥

text: devā api vikarmasthaṃ yātayanti narādhamam । vyājena vindanvittaṃ hi dharmāttu parihīyate ॥17॥
html:
devā api vikarmasthaṃ yātayanti narādhamam ।
vyājena vindanvittaṃ hi dharmāttu parihīyate ॥17॥
slp1: devA api vikarmasTaM yAtayanti narADamam । vyAjena vindanvittaM hi DarmAttu parihIyate ॥17॥

text: sarvataḥ satkṛtaḥ sadbhirbhūtiprabhavakāraṇaiḥ । hṛdayenābhyanujñāto yo dharmastaṃ vyavasyati ॥18॥
html:
sarvataḥ satkṛtaḥ sadbhirbhūtiprabhavakāraṇaiḥ ।
hṛdayenābhyanujñāto yo dharmastaṃ vyavasyati ॥18॥
slp1: sarvataH satkftaH sadBirBUtipraBavakAraREH । hfdayenAByanujYAto yo DarmastaM vyavasyati ॥18॥

text: yaścaturguṇasampannaṃ dharmaṃ veda sa dharmavit । aheriva hi dharmasya padaṃ duḥkhaṃ gaveṣitum ॥19॥
html:
yaścaturguṇasampannaṃ dharmaṃ veda sa dharmavit ।
aheriva hi dharmasya padaṃ duḥkhaṃ gaveṣitum ॥19॥
slp1: yaScaturguRasampannaM DarmaM veda sa Darmavit । aheriva hi Darmasya padaM duHKaM gavezitum ॥19॥

text: yathā mṛgasya viddhasya mṛgavyādhaḥ padaṃ nayet । kakṣe rudhirapātena tathā dharmapadaṃ nayet ॥20॥
html:
yathā mṛgasya viddhasya mṛgavyādhaḥ padaṃ nayet ।
kakṣe rudhirapātena tathā dharmapadaṃ nayet ॥20॥
slp1: yaTA mfgasya vidDasya mfgavyADaH padaM nayet । kakze ruDirapAtena taTA DarmapadaM nayet ॥20॥

text: evaṃ sadbhirvinītena pathā gantavyamacyuta । rājarṣīṇāṃ vṛttametadavagaccha yudhiṣṭhira] ॥21॥
html:
evaṃ sadbhirvinītena pathā gantavyamacyuta ।
rājarṣīṇāṃ vṛttametadavagaccha yudhiṣṭhira] ॥21॥
slp1: evaM sadBirvinItena paTA gantavyamacyuta । rAjarzIRAM vfttametadavagacCa yuDizWira] ॥21॥

text: svarāṣṭrātpararāṣṭrācca kośaṃ sañjanayennṛpaḥ । kośāddhi dharmaḥ kaunteya rājyamūlaḥ pravartate ॥1॥
html:
svarāṣṭrātpararāṣṭrācca kośaṃ sañjanayennṛpaḥ ।
kośāddhi dharmaḥ kaunteya rājyamūlaḥ pravartate ॥1॥
slp1: svarAzwrAtpararAzwrAcca koSaM saYjanayennfpaH । koSAdDi DarmaH kOnteya rAjyamUlaH pravartate ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tasmātsañjanayetkośaṃ saṃhṛtya paripālayet । paripālyānugṛhṇīyādeṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥2॥
html:
tasmātsañjanayetkośaṃ saṃhṛtya paripālayet ।
paripālyānugṛhṇīyādeṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: tasmAtsaYjanayetkoSaM saMhftya paripAlayet । paripAlyAnugfhRIyAdeza DarmaH sanAtanaH ॥2॥

text: na kośaḥ śuddhaśaucena na nṛśaṃsena jāyate । padaṃ madhyamamāsthāya kośasaṅgrahaṇaṃ caret ॥3॥
html:
na kośaḥ śuddhaśaucena na nṛśaṃsena jāyate ।
padaṃ madhyamamāsthāya kośasaṅgrahaṇaṃ caret ॥3॥
slp1: na koSaH SudDaSOcena na nfSaMsena jAyate । padaM maDyamamAsTAya koSasaNgrahaRaM caret ॥3॥

text: abalasya kutaḥ kośo hyakośasya kuto balam । abalasya kuto rājyamarājñaḥ śrīḥ kuto bhavet ॥4॥
html:
abalasya kutaḥ kośo hyakośasya kuto balam ।
abalasya kuto rājyamarājñaḥ śrīḥ kuto bhavet ॥4॥
slp1: abalasya kutaH koSo hyakoSasya kuto balam । abalasya kuto rAjyamarAjYaH SrIH kuto Bavet ॥4॥

text: uccairvṛtteḥ śriyo hāniryathaiva maraṇaṃ tathā । tasmātkośaṃ balaṃ mitrāṇyatha rājā vivardhayet ॥5॥
html:
uccairvṛtteḥ śriyo hāniryathaiva maraṇaṃ tathā ।
tasmātkośaṃ balaṃ mitrāṇyatha rājā vivardhayet ॥5॥
slp1: uccErvftteH Sriyo hAniryaTEva maraRaM taTA । tasmAtkoSaM balaM mitrARyaTa rAjA vivarDayet ॥5॥

text: hīnakośaṃ hi rājānamavajānanti mānavāḥ । na cāsyālpena tuṣyanti kāryamabhyutsahanti ca ॥6॥
html:
hīnakośaṃ hi rājānamavajānanti mānavāḥ ।
na cāsyālpena tuṣyanti kāryamabhyutsahanti ca ॥6॥
slp1: hInakoSaM hi rAjAnamavajAnanti mAnavAH । na cAsyAlpena tuzyanti kAryamaByutsahanti ca ॥6॥

text: śriyo hi kāraṇādrājā satkriyāṃ labhate parām । sāsya gūhati pāpāni vāso guhyamiva striyāḥ ॥7॥
html:
śriyo hi kāraṇādrājā satkriyāṃ labhate parām ।
sāsya gūhati pāpāni vāso guhyamiva striyāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: Sriyo hi kAraRAdrAjA satkriyAM laBate parAm । sAsya gUhati pApAni vAso guhyamiva striyAH ॥7॥

text: ṛddhimasyānuvartante purā viprakṛtā janāḥ । śālāvṛkā ivājasraṃ jighāṃsūniva vindati । īdṛśasya kuto rājñaḥ sukhaṃ bharatasattama ॥8॥
html:
ṛddhimasyānuvartante purā viprakṛtā janāḥ ।
śālāvṛkā ivājasraṃ jighāṃsūniva vindati ।
īdṛśasya kuto rājñaḥ sukhaṃ bharatasattama ॥8॥
slp1: fdDimasyAnuvartante purA viprakftA janAH । SAlAvfkA ivAjasraM jiGAMsUniva vindati । IdfSasya kuto rAjYaH suKaM Baratasattama ॥8॥

text: udyacchedeva na glāyedudyamo hyeva pauruṣam । apyaparvaṇi bhajyeta na nameteha kasyacit ॥9॥
html:
udyacchedeva na glāyedudyamo hyeva pauruṣam ।
apyaparvaṇi bhajyeta na nameteha kasyacit ॥9॥
slp1: udyacCedeva na glAyedudyamo hyeva pOruzam । apyaparvaRi Bajyeta na nameteha kasyacit ॥9॥

text: apyaraṇyaṃ samāśritya careddasyugaṇaiḥ saha । na tvevoddhṛtamaryādairdasyubhiḥ sahitaścaret । dasyūnāṃ sulabhā senā raudrakarmasu bhārata ॥10॥
html:
apyaraṇyaṃ samāśritya careddasyugaṇaiḥ saha ।
na tvevoddhṛtamaryādairdasyubhiḥ sahitaścaret ।
dasyūnāṃ sulabhā senā raudrakarmasu bhārata ॥10॥
slp1: apyaraRyaM samASritya careddasyugaREH saha । na tvevodDftamaryAdErdasyuBiH sahitaScaret । dasyUnAM sulaBA senA rOdrakarmasu BArata ॥10॥

text: ekāntena hyamaryādātsarvo'pyudvijate janaḥ । dasyavo'pyupaśaṅkante niranukrośakāriṇaḥ ॥11॥
html:
ekāntena hyamaryādātsarvo'pyudvijate janaḥ ।
dasyavo'pyupaśaṅkante niranukrośakāriṇaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: ekAntena hyamaryAdAtsarvo'pyudvijate janaH । dasyavo'pyupaSaNkante niranukroSakAriRaH ॥11॥

text: sthāpayedeva maryādāṃ janacittaprasādinīm । alpāpyatheha maryādā loke bhavati pūjitā ॥12॥
html:
sthāpayedeva maryādāṃ janacittaprasādinīm ।
alpāpyatheha maryādā loke bhavati pūjitā ॥12॥
slp1: sTApayedeva maryAdAM janacittaprasAdinIm । alpApyaTeha maryAdA loke Bavati pUjitA ॥12॥

text: nāyaṃ loko'sti na para iti vyavasito janaḥ । nālaṃ gantuṃ ca viśvāsaṃ nāstike bhayaśaṅkini ॥13॥
html:
nāyaṃ loko'sti na para iti vyavasito janaḥ ।
nālaṃ gantuṃ ca viśvāsaṃ nāstike bhayaśaṅkini ॥13॥
slp1: nAyaM loko'sti na para iti vyavasito janaH । nAlaM gantuM ca viSvAsaM nAstike BayaSaNkini ॥13॥

text: yathā sadbhiḥ parādānamahiṃsā dasyubhistathā । anurajyanti bhūtāni samaryādeṣu dasyuṣu ॥14॥
html:
yathā sadbhiḥ parādānamahiṃsā dasyubhistathā ।
anurajyanti bhūtāni samaryādeṣu dasyuṣu ॥14॥
slp1: yaTA sadBiH parAdAnamahiMsA dasyuBistaTA । anurajyanti BUtAni samaryAdezu dasyuzu ॥14॥

text: ayudhyamānasya vadho dārāmarśaḥ kṛtaghnatā । brahmavittasya cādānaṃ niḥśeṣakaraṇaṃ tathā । striyā moṣaḥ paristhānaṃ dasyuṣvetadvigarhitam ॥15॥
html:
ayudhyamānasya vadho dārāmarśaḥ kṛtaghnatā ।
brahmavittasya cādānaṃ niḥśeṣakaraṇaṃ tathā ।
striyā moṣaḥ paristhānaṃ dasyuṣvetadvigarhitam ॥15॥
slp1: ayuDyamAnasya vaDo dArAmarSaH kftaGnatA । brahmavittasya cAdAnaM niHSezakaraRaM taTA । striyA mozaH parisTAnaM dasyuzvetadvigarhitam ॥15॥

text: sa eṣa eva bhavati dasyuretāni varjayan । abhisandadhate ye na vināśāyāsya bhārata । na śeṣamevopālabhya na kurvantīti niścayaḥ ॥16॥
html:
sa eṣa eva bhavati dasyuretāni varjayan ।
abhisandadhate ye na vināśāyāsya bhārata ।
na śeṣamevopālabhya na kurvantīti niścayaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: sa eza eva Bavati dasyuretAni varjayan । aBisandaDate ye na vinASAyAsya BArata । na SezamevopAlaBya na kurvantIti niScayaH ॥16॥

text: tasmātsaśeṣaṃ kartavyaṃ svādhīnamapi dasyubhiḥ । na balastho'hamasmīti nṛśaṃsāni samācaret ॥17॥
html:
tasmātsaśeṣaṃ kartavyaṃ svādhīnamapi dasyubhiḥ ।
na balastho'hamasmīti nṛśaṃsāni samācaret ॥17॥
slp1: tasmAtsaSezaM kartavyaM svADInamapi dasyuBiH । na balasTo'hamasmIti nfSaMsAni samAcaret ॥17॥

text: saśeṣakāriṇastāta śeṣaṃ paśyanti sarvataḥ । niḥśeṣakāriṇo nityamaśeṣakaraṇādbhayam] ॥18॥
html:
saśeṣakāriṇastāta śeṣaṃ paśyanti sarvataḥ ।
niḥśeṣakāriṇo nityamaśeṣakaraṇādbhayam] ॥18॥
slp1: saSezakAriRastAta SezaM paSyanti sarvataH । niHSezakAriRo nityamaSezakaraRAdBayam] ॥18॥

text: atra karmāntavacanaṃ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ । pratyakṣāveva dharmārthau kṣatriyasya vijānataḥ । tatra na vyavadhātavyaṃ parokṣā dharmayāpanā ॥1॥
html:
atra karmāntavacanaṃ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ ।
pratyakṣāveva dharmārthau kṣatriyasya vijānataḥ ।
tatra na vyavadhātavyaṃ parokṣā dharmayāpanā ॥1॥
slp1: atra karmAntavacanaM kIrtayanti purAvidaH । pratyakzAveva DarmArTO kzatriyasya vijAnataH । tatra na vyavaDAtavyaM parokzA DarmayApanA ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: adharmo dharma ityetadyathā vṛkapadaṃ tathā । dharmādharmaphale jātu na dadarśeha kaścana ॥2॥
html:
adharmo dharma ityetadyathā vṛkapadaṃ tathā ।
dharmādharmaphale jātu na dadarśeha kaścana ॥2॥
slp1: aDarmo Darma ityetadyaTA vfkapadaM taTA । DarmADarmaPale jAtu na dadarSeha kaScana ॥2॥

text: bubhūṣedbalavāneva sarvaṃ balavato vaśe । śriyaṃ balamamātyāṃśca balavāniha vindati ॥3॥
html:
bubhūṣedbalavāneva sarvaṃ balavato vaśe ।
śriyaṃ balamamātyāṃśca balavāniha vindati ॥3॥
slp1: buBUzedbalavAneva sarvaM balavato vaSe । SriyaM balamamAtyAMSca balavAniha vindati ॥3॥

text: yo hyanāḍhyaḥ sa patitastaducchiṣṭaṃ yadalpakam । bahvapathyaṃ balavati na kiñcittrāyate bhayāt ॥4॥
html:
yo hyanāḍhyaḥ sa patitastaducchiṣṭaṃ yadalpakam ।
bahvapathyaṃ balavati na kiñcittrāyate bhayāt ॥4॥
slp1: yo hyanAQyaH sa patitastaducCizwaM yadalpakam । bahvapaTyaM balavati na kiYcittrAyate BayAt ॥4॥

text: ubhau satyādhikārau tau trāyete mahato bhayāt । ati dharmādbalaṃ manye balāddharmaḥ pravartate ॥5॥
html:
ubhau satyādhikārau tau trāyete mahato bhayāt ।
ati dharmādbalaṃ manye balāddharmaḥ pravartate ॥5॥
slp1: uBO satyADikArO tO trAyete mahato BayAt । ati DarmAdbalaM manye balAdDarmaH pravartate ॥5॥

text: bale pratiṣṭhito dharmo dharaṇyāmiva jaṅgamaḥ । dhūmo vāyoriva vaśaṃ balaṃ dharmo'nuvartate ॥6॥
html:
bale pratiṣṭhito dharmo dharaṇyāmiva jaṅgamaḥ ।
dhūmo vāyoriva vaśaṃ balaṃ dharmo'nuvartate ॥6॥
slp1: bale pratizWito Darmo DaraRyAmiva jaNgamaH । DUmo vAyoriva vaSaM balaM Darmo'nuvartate ॥6॥

text: anīśvare balaṃ dharmo drumaṃ vallīva saṃśritā । vaśyo balavatāṃ dharmaḥ sukhaṃ bhogavatāmiva । nāstyasādhyaṃ balavatāṃ sarvaṃ balavatāṃ śuci ॥7॥
html:
anīśvare balaṃ dharmo drumaṃ vallīva saṃśritā ।
vaśyo balavatāṃ dharmaḥ sukhaṃ bhogavatāmiva ।
nāstyasādhyaṃ balavatāṃ sarvaṃ balavatāṃ śuci ॥7॥
slp1: anISvare balaM Darmo drumaM vallIva saMSritA । vaSyo balavatAM DarmaH suKaM BogavatAmiva । nAstyasADyaM balavatAM sarvaM balavatAM Suci ॥7॥

text: durācāraḥ kṣīṇabalaḥ parimāṇaṃ niyacchati । atha tasmādudvijate sarvo loko vṛkādiva ॥8॥
html:
durācāraḥ kṣīṇabalaḥ parimāṇaṃ niyacchati ।
atha tasmādudvijate sarvo loko vṛkādiva ॥8॥
slp1: durAcAraH kzIRabalaH parimARaM niyacCati । aTa tasmAdudvijate sarvo loko vfkAdiva ॥8॥

text: apadhvasto hyavamato duḥkhaṃ jīvati jīvitam । jīvitaṃ yadavakṣiptaṃ yathaiva maraṇaṃ tathā ॥9॥
html:
apadhvasto hyavamato duḥkhaṃ jīvati jīvitam ।
jīvitaṃ yadavakṣiptaṃ yathaiva maraṇaṃ tathā ॥9॥
slp1: apaDvasto hyavamato duHKaM jIvati jIvitam । jIvitaM yadavakziptaM yaTEva maraRaM taTA ॥9॥

text: yadenamāhuḥ pāpena cāritreṇa vinikṣatam । sa bhṛśaṃ tapyate'nena vākśalyena parikṣataḥ ॥10॥
html:
yadenamāhuḥ pāpena cāritreṇa vinikṣatam ।
sa bhṛśaṃ tapyate'nena vākśalyena parikṣataḥ ॥10॥
slp1: yadenamAhuH pApena cAritreRa vinikzatam । sa BfSaM tapyate'nena vAkSalyena parikzataH ॥10॥

text: atraitadāhurācāryāḥ pāpasya parimokṣaṇe । trayīṃ vidyāṃ niṣeveta tathopāsīta sa dvijān ॥11॥
html:
atraitadāhurācāryāḥ pāpasya parimokṣaṇe ।
trayīṃ vidyāṃ niṣeveta tathopāsīta sa dvijān ॥11॥
slp1: atrEtadAhurAcAryAH pApasya parimokzaRe । trayIM vidyAM nizeveta taTopAsIta sa dvijAn ॥11॥

text: prasādayenmadhurayā vācāpyatha ca karmaṇā । mahāmanāścaiva bhavedvivahecca mahākule ॥12॥
html:
prasādayenmadhurayā vācāpyatha ca karmaṇā ।
mahāmanāścaiva bhavedvivahecca mahākule ॥12॥
slp1: prasAdayenmaDurayA vAcApyaTa ca karmaRA । mahAmanAScEva Bavedvivahecca mahAkule ॥12॥

text: ityasmīti vadedevaṃ pareṣāṃ kīrtayanguṇān । japedudakaśīlaḥ syātpeśalo nātijalpanaḥ ॥13॥
html:
ityasmīti vadedevaṃ pareṣāṃ kīrtayanguṇān ।
japedudakaśīlaḥ syātpeśalo nātijalpanaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: ityasmIti vadedevaM parezAM kIrtayanguRAn । japedudakaSIlaH syAtpeSalo nAtijalpanaH ॥13॥

text: brahmakṣatraṃ sampraviśedbahu kṛtvā suduṣkaram । ucyamāno'pi lokena bahu tattadacintayan ॥14॥
html:
brahmakṣatraṃ sampraviśedbahu kṛtvā suduṣkaram ।
ucyamāno'pi lokena bahu tattadacintayan ॥14॥
slp1: brahmakzatraM sampraviSedbahu kftvA suduzkaram । ucyamAno'pi lokena bahu tattadacintayan ॥14॥

text: apāpo hyevamācāraḥ kṣipraṃ bahumato bhavet । sukhaṃ vittaṃ ca bhuñjīta vṛttenaitena gopayet । loke ca labhate pūjāṃ paratra ca mahatphalam] ॥15॥
html:
apāpo hyevamācāraḥ kṣipraṃ bahumato bhavet ।
sukhaṃ vittaṃ ca bhuñjīta vṛttenaitena gopayet ।
loke ca labhate pūjāṃ paratra ca mahatphalam] ॥15॥
slp1: apApo hyevamAcAraH kzipraM bahumato Bavet । suKaM vittaM ca BuYjIta vfttenEtena gopayet । loke ca laBate pUjAM paratra ca mahatPalam] ॥15॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । yathā dasyuḥ samaryādaḥ pretyabhāve na naśyati ॥1॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
yathā dasyuḥ samaryādaḥ pretyabhāve na naśyati ॥1॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । yaTA dasyuH samaryAdaH pretyaBAve na naSyati ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: prahartā matimāñśūraḥ śrutavānanṛśaṃsavān । rakṣannakṣayiṇaṃ dharmaṃ brahmaṇyo gurupūjakaḥ ॥2॥
html:
prahartā matimāñśūraḥ śrutavānanṛśaṃsavān ।
rakṣannakṣayiṇaṃ dharmaṃ brahmaṇyo gurupūjakaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: prahartA matimAYSUraH SrutavAnanfSaMsavAn । rakzannakzayiRaM DarmaM brahmaRyo gurupUjakaH ॥2॥

text: niṣādyāṃ kṣatriyājjātaḥ kṣatradharmānupālakaḥ । kāpavyo nāma naiṣādirdasyutvātsiddhimāptavān ॥3॥
html:
niṣādyāṃ kṣatriyājjātaḥ kṣatradharmānupālakaḥ ।
kāpavyo nāma naiṣādirdasyutvātsiddhimāptavān ॥3॥
slp1: nizAdyAM kzatriyAjjAtaH kzatraDarmAnupAlakaH । kApavyo nAma nEzAdirdasyutvAtsidDimAptavAn ॥3॥

text: araṇye sāyapūrvāhṇe mṛgayūthaprakopitā । vidhijño mṛgajātīnāṃ nipānānāṃ ca kovidaḥ ॥4॥
html:
araṇye sāyapūrvāhṇe mṛgayūthaprakopitā ।
vidhijño mṛgajātīnāṃ nipānānāṃ ca kovidaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: araRye sAyapUrvAhRe mfgayUTaprakopitA । viDijYo mfgajAtInAM nipAnAnAM ca kovidaH ॥4॥

text: sarvakānanadeśajñaḥ pāriyātracaraḥ sadā । dharmajñaḥ sarvabhūtānāmamogheṣurdṛḍhāyudhaḥ ॥5॥
html:
sarvakānanadeśajñaḥ pāriyātracaraḥ sadā ।
dharmajñaḥ sarvabhūtānāmamogheṣurdṛḍhāyudhaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: sarvakAnanadeSajYaH pAriyAtracaraH sadA । DarmajYaH sarvaBUtAnAmamoGezurdfQAyuDaH ॥5॥

text: apyanekaśatāḥ senā eka eva jigāya saḥ । sa vṛddhāvandhapitarau mahāraṇye'bhyapūjayat ॥6॥
html:
apyanekaśatāḥ senā eka eva jigāya saḥ ।
sa vṛddhāvandhapitarau mahāraṇye'bhyapūjayat ॥6॥
slp1: apyanekaSatAH senA eka eva jigAya saH । sa vfdDAvanDapitarO mahAraRye'ByapUjayat ॥6॥

text: madhumāṃsairmūlaphalairannairuccāvacairapi । satkṛtya bhojayāmāsa samyakparicacāra ca ॥7॥
html:
madhumāṃsairmūlaphalairannairuccāvacairapi ।
satkṛtya bhojayāmāsa samyakparicacāra ca ॥7॥
slp1: maDumAMsErmUlaPalErannEruccAvacErapi । satkftya BojayAmAsa samyakparicacAra ca ॥7॥

text: āraṇyakānpravrajitānbrāhmaṇānparipālayan । api tebhyo mṛgānhatvā nināya ca mahāvane ॥8॥
html:
āraṇyakānpravrajitānbrāhmaṇānparipālayan ।
api tebhyo mṛgānhatvā nināya ca mahāvane ॥8॥
slp1: AraRyakAnpravrajitAnbrAhmaRAnparipAlayan । api teByo mfgAnhatvA ninAya ca mahAvane ॥8॥

text: ye sma na pratigṛhṇanti dasyubhojanaśaṅkayā । teṣāmāsajya geheṣu kālya eva sa gacchati ॥9॥
html:
ye sma na pratigṛhṇanti dasyubhojanaśaṅkayā ।
teṣāmāsajya geheṣu kālya eva sa gacchati ॥9॥
slp1: ye sma na pratigfhRanti dasyuBojanaSaNkayA । tezAmAsajya gehezu kAlya eva sa gacCati ॥9॥

text: taṃ bahūni sahasrāṇi grāmaṇitve'bhivavrire । nirmaryādāni dasyūnāṃ niranukrośakāriṇām ॥10॥
html:
taṃ bahūni sahasrāṇi grāmaṇitve'bhivavrire ।
nirmaryādāni dasyūnāṃ niranukrośakāriṇām ॥10॥
slp1: taM bahUni sahasrARi grAmaRitve'Bivavrire । nirmaryAdAni dasyUnAM niranukroSakAriRAm ॥10॥

text: muhūrtadeśakālajña prājña śīladṛḍhāyudha । grāmaṇīrbhava no mukhyaḥ sarveṣāmeva saṃmataḥ ॥11॥
html:
muhūrtadeśakālajña prājña śīladṛḍhāyudha ।
grāmaṇīrbhava no mukhyaḥ sarveṣāmeva saṃmataḥ ॥11॥
