slp1: muhUrtadeSakAlajYa prAjYa SIladfQAyuDa । grAmaRIrBava no muKyaH sarvezAmeva saMmataH ॥11॥
author: dasyava ūcuḥ ।

text: yathā yathā vakṣyasi naḥ kariṣyāmastathā tathā । pālayāsmānyathānyāyaṃ yathā mātā yathā pitā ॥12॥
html:
yathā yathā vakṣyasi naḥ kariṣyāmastathā tathā ।
pālayāsmānyathānyāyaṃ yathā mātā yathā pitā ॥12॥
slp1: yaTA yaTA vakzyasi naH karizyAmastaTA taTA । pAlayAsmAnyaTAnyAyaM yaTA mAtA yaTA pitA ॥12॥

text: mā vadhīstvaṃ striyaṃ bhīruṃ mā śiśuṃ mā tapasvinam । nāyudhyamāno hantavyo na ca grāhyā balātstriyaḥ ॥13॥
html:
mā vadhīstvaṃ striyaṃ bhīruṃ mā śiśuṃ mā tapasvinam ।
nāyudhyamāno hantavyo na ca grāhyā balātstriyaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: mA vaDIstvaM striyaM BIruM mA SiSuM mA tapasvinam । nAyuDyamAno hantavyo na ca grAhyA balAtstriyaH ॥13॥
author: kāpavya uvāca ।

text: sarvathā strī na hantavyā sarvasattveṣu yudhyatā । nityaṃ gobrāhmaṇe svasti yoddhavyaṃ ca tadarthataḥ ॥14॥
html:
sarvathā strī na hantavyā sarvasattveṣu yudhyatā ।
nityaṃ gobrāhmaṇe svasti yoddhavyaṃ ca tadarthataḥ ॥14॥
slp1: sarvaTA strI na hantavyA sarvasattvezu yuDyatA । nityaM gobrAhmaRe svasti yodDavyaM ca tadarTataH ॥14॥

text: sasyaṃ ca nāpahantavyaṃ sīravighnaṃ ca mā kṛthāḥ । pūjyante yatra devāśca pitaro'tithayastathā ॥15॥
html:
sasyaṃ ca nāpahantavyaṃ sīravighnaṃ ca mā kṛthāḥ ।
pūjyante yatra devāśca pitaro'tithayastathā ॥15॥
slp1: sasyaM ca nApahantavyaM sIraviGnaM ca mA kfTAH । pUjyante yatra devASca pitaro'tiTayastaTA ॥15॥

text: sarvabhūteṣvapi ca vai brāhmaṇo mokṣamarhati । kāryā cāpacitisteṣāṃ sarvasvenāpi yā bhavet ॥16॥
html:
sarvabhūteṣvapi ca vai brāhmaṇo mokṣamarhati ।
kāryā cāpacitisteṣāṃ sarvasvenāpi yā bhavet ॥16॥
slp1: sarvaBUtezvapi ca vE brAhmaRo mokzamarhati । kAryA cApacitistezAM sarvasvenApi yA Bavet ॥16॥

text: yasya hyete sampraruṣṭā mantrayanti parābhavam । na tasya triṣu lokeṣu trātā bhavati kaścana ॥17॥
html:
yasya hyete sampraruṣṭā mantrayanti parābhavam ।
na tasya triṣu lokeṣu trātā bhavati kaścana ॥17॥
slp1: yasya hyete sampraruzwA mantrayanti parABavam । na tasya trizu lokezu trAtA Bavati kaScana ॥17॥

text: yo brāhmaṇānparibhavedvināśaṃ vāpi rocayet । sūryodaya ivāvaśyaṃ dhruvaṃ tasya parābhavaḥ ॥18॥
html:
yo brāhmaṇānparibhavedvināśaṃ vāpi rocayet ।
sūryodaya ivāvaśyaṃ dhruvaṃ tasya parābhavaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: yo brAhmaRAnpariBavedvinASaM vApi rocayet । sUryodaya ivAvaSyaM DruvaM tasya parABavaH ॥18॥

text: ihaiva phalamāsīnaḥ pratyākāṅkṣati śaktitaḥ । ye ye no na pradāsyanti tāṃstānsenābhiyāsyati ॥19॥
html:
ihaiva phalamāsīnaḥ pratyākāṅkṣati śaktitaḥ ।
ye ye no na pradāsyanti tāṃstānsenābhiyāsyati ॥19॥
slp1: ihEva PalamAsInaH pratyAkANkzati SaktitaH । ye ye no na pradAsyanti tAMstAnsenABiyAsyati ॥19॥

text: śiṣṭyarthaṃ vihito daṇḍo na vadhārthaṃ viniścayaḥ । ye ca śiṣṭānprabādhante dharmasteṣāṃ vadhaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥20॥
html:
śiṣṭyarthaṃ vihito daṇḍo na vadhārthaṃ viniścayaḥ ।
ye ca śiṣṭānprabādhante dharmasteṣāṃ vadhaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: SizwyarTaM vihito daRqo na vaDArTaM viniScayaH । ye ca SizwAnprabADante DarmastezAM vaDaH smftaH ॥20॥

text: ye hi rāṣṭroparodhena vṛttiṃ kurvanti kecana । tadeva te'nu mīyante kuṇapaṃ kṛmayo yathā ॥21॥
html:
ye hi rāṣṭroparodhena vṛttiṃ kurvanti kecana ।
tadeva te'nu mīyante kuṇapaṃ kṛmayo yathā ॥21॥
slp1: ye hi rAzwroparoDena vfttiM kurvanti kecana । tadeva te'nu mIyante kuRapaM kfmayo yaTA ॥21॥

text: ye punardharmaśāstreṇa varteranniha dasyavaḥ । api te dasyavo bhūtvā kṣipraṃ siddhimavāpnuyuḥ ॥22॥
html:
ye punardharmaśāstreṇa varteranniha dasyavaḥ ।
api te dasyavo bhūtvā kṣipraṃ siddhimavāpnuyuḥ ॥22॥
slp1: ye punarDarmaSAstreRa varteranniha dasyavaH । api te dasyavo BUtvA kzipraM sidDimavApnuyuH ॥22॥

text: tatsarvamupacakruste kāpavyasyānuśāsanam । vṛttiṃ ca lebhire sarve pāpebhyaścāpyupāraman ॥23॥
html:
tatsarvamupacakruste kāpavyasyānuśāsanam ।
vṛttiṃ ca lebhire sarve pāpebhyaścāpyupāraman ॥23॥
slp1: tatsarvamupacakruste kApavyasyAnuSAsanam । vfttiM ca leBire sarve pApeByaScApyupAraman ॥23॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kāpavyaḥ karmaṇā tena mahatīṃ siddhimāptavān । sādhūnāmācarankṣemaṃ dasyūnpāpānnivartayan ॥24॥
html:
kāpavyaḥ karmaṇā tena mahatīṃ siddhimāptavān ।
sādhūnāmācarankṣemaṃ dasyūnpāpānnivartayan ॥24॥
slp1: kApavyaH karmaRA tena mahatIM sidDimAptavAn । sADUnAmAcarankzemaM dasyUnpApAnnivartayan ॥24॥

text: idaṃ kāpavyacaritaṃ yo nityamanukīrtayet । nāraṇyebhyaḥ sa bhūtebhyo bhayamārchetkadācana ॥25॥
html:
idaṃ kāpavyacaritaṃ yo nityamanukīrtayet ।
nāraṇyebhyaḥ sa bhūtebhyo bhayamārchetkadācana ॥25॥
slp1: idaM kApavyacaritaM yo nityamanukIrtayet । nAraRyeByaH sa BUteByo BayamArCetkadAcana ॥25॥

text: bhayaṃ tasya na martyebhyo nāmartyebhyaḥ kathañcana । na sato nāsato rājansa hyaraṇyeṣu gopatiḥ] ॥26॥
html:
bhayaṃ tasya na martyebhyo nāmartyebhyaḥ kathañcana ।
na sato nāsato rājansa hyaraṇyeṣu gopatiḥ] ॥26॥
slp1: BayaM tasya na martyeByo nAmartyeByaH kaTaYcana । na sato nAsato rAjansa hyaraRyezu gopatiH] ॥26॥

text: atra gāthā brahmagītāḥ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ । yena mārgeṇa rājānaḥ kośaṃ sañjanayanti ca ॥1॥
html:
atra gāthā brahmagītāḥ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ ।
yena mārgeṇa rājānaḥ kośaṃ sañjanayanti ca ॥1॥
slp1: atra gATA brahmagItAH kIrtayanti purAvidaH । yena mArgeRa rAjAnaH koSaM saYjanayanti ca ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: na dhanaṃ yajñaśīlānāṃ hāryaṃ devasvameva tat । dasyūnāṃ niṣkriyāṇāṃ ca kṣatriyo hartumarhati ॥2॥
html:
na dhanaṃ yajñaśīlānāṃ hāryaṃ devasvameva tat ।
dasyūnāṃ niṣkriyāṇāṃ ca kṣatriyo hartumarhati ॥2॥
slp1: na DanaM yajYaSIlAnAM hAryaM devasvameva tat । dasyUnAM nizkriyARAM ca kzatriyo hartumarhati ॥2॥

text: imāḥ prajāḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ rakṣyāścādyāśca bhārata । dhanaṃ hi kṣatriyasyeha dvitīyasya na vidyate ॥3॥
html:
imāḥ prajāḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ rakṣyāścādyāśca bhārata ।
dhanaṃ hi kṣatriyasyeha dvitīyasya na vidyate ॥3॥
slp1: imAH prajAH kzatriyARAM rakzyAScAdyASca BArata । DanaM hi kzatriyasyeha dvitIyasya na vidyate ॥3॥

text: tadasya syādbalārthaṃ vā dhanaṃ yajñārthameva vā । abhogyā hyoṣadhīśchittvā bhogyā eva pacantyuta ॥4॥
html:
tadasya syādbalārthaṃ vā dhanaṃ yajñārthameva vā ।
abhogyā hyoṣadhīśchittvā bhogyā eva pacantyuta ॥4॥
slp1: tadasya syAdbalArTaM vA DanaM yajYArTameva vA । aBogyA hyozaDISCittvA BogyA eva pacantyuta ॥4॥

text: yo vai na devānna pitṝnna martyānhaviṣārcati । ānantikāṃ tāṃ dhanitāmāhurvedavido janāḥ ॥5॥
html:
yo vai na devānna pitṝnna martyānhaviṣārcati ।
ānantikāṃ tāṃ dhanitāmāhurvedavido janāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: yo vE na devAnna pitFnna martyAnhavizArcati । AnantikAM tAM DanitAmAhurvedavido janAH ॥5॥

text: harettaddraviṇaṃ rājandhārmikaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ । na hi tatprīṇayellokānna kośaṃ tadvidhaṃ nṛpaḥ ॥6॥
html:
harettaddraviṇaṃ rājandhārmikaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ ।
na hi tatprīṇayellokānna kośaṃ tadvidhaṃ nṛpaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: harettaddraviRaM rAjanDArmikaH pfTivIpatiH । na hi tatprIRayellokAnna koSaM tadviDaM nfpaH ॥6॥

text: asādhubhyo nirādāya sādhubhyo yaḥ prayacchati । ātmānaṃ saṅkramaṃ kṛtvā manye dharmavideva saḥ ॥7॥
html:
asādhubhyo nirādāya sādhubhyo yaḥ prayacchati ।
ātmānaṃ saṅkramaṃ kṛtvā manye dharmavideva saḥ ॥7॥
slp1: asADuByo nirAdAya sADuByo yaH prayacCati । AtmAnaM saNkramaM kftvA manye Darmavideva saH ॥7॥

text: audbhijjā jantavaḥ kecidyuktavāco yathā tathā । aniṣṭataḥ sambhavanti tathāyajñaḥ pratāyate ॥8॥
html:
audbhijjā jantavaḥ kecidyuktavāco yathā tathā ।
aniṣṭataḥ sambhavanti tathāyajñaḥ pratāyate ॥8॥
slp1: OdBijjA jantavaH kecidyuktavAco yaTA taTA । anizwataH samBavanti taTAyajYaH pratAyate ॥8॥

text: yathaiva daṃśamaśakaṃ yathā cāṇḍapipīlikam । saiva vṛttirayajñeṣu tathā dharmo vidhīyate ॥9॥
html:
yathaiva daṃśamaśakaṃ yathā cāṇḍapipīlikam ।
saiva vṛttirayajñeṣu tathā dharmo vidhīyate ॥9॥
slp1: yaTEva daMSamaSakaM yaTA cARqapipIlikam । sEva vfttirayajYezu taTA Darmo viDIyate ॥9॥

text: yathā hyakasmādbhavati bhūmau pāṃsutṛṇolapam । tathaiveha bhaveddharmaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sūkṣmataro'pi ca] ॥10॥
html:
yathā hyakasmādbhavati bhūmau pāṃsutṛṇolapam ।
tathaiveha bhaveddharmaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sūkṣmataro'pi ca] ॥10॥
slp1: yaTA hyakasmAdBavati BUmO pAMsutfRolapam । taTEveha BavedDarmaH sUkzmaH sUkzmataro'pi ca] ॥10॥

text: atraiva cedamavyagraḥ śṛṇvākhyānamanuttamam । dīrghasūtraṃ samāśritya kāryākāryaviniścaye ॥1॥
html:
atraiva cedamavyagraḥ śṛṇvākhyānamanuttamam ।
dīrghasūtraṃ samāśritya kāryākāryaviniścaye ॥1॥
slp1: atrEva cedamavyagraH SfRvAKyAnamanuttamam । dIrGasUtraM samASritya kAryAkAryaviniScaye ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: nātigādhe jalasthāye suhṛdaḥ śakulāstrayaḥ । prabhūtamatsye kaunteya babhūvuḥ sahacāriṇaḥ ॥2॥
html:
nātigādhe jalasthāye suhṛdaḥ śakulāstrayaḥ ।
prabhūtamatsye kaunteya babhūvuḥ sahacāriṇaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: nAtigADe jalasTAye suhfdaH SakulAstrayaH । praBUtamatsye kOnteya baBUvuH sahacAriRaH ॥2॥

text: atraikaḥ prāptakālajño dīrghadarśī tathāparaḥ । dīrghasūtraśca tatraikastrayāṇāṃ jalacāriṇām ॥3॥
html:
atraikaḥ prāptakālajño dīrghadarśī tathāparaḥ ।
dīrghasūtraśca tatraikastrayāṇāṃ jalacāriṇām ॥3॥
slp1: atrEkaH prAptakAlajYo dIrGadarSI taTAparaH । dIrGasUtraSca tatrEkastrayARAM jalacAriRAm ॥3॥

text: kadācittajjalasthāyaṃ matsyabandhāḥ samantataḥ । niḥsrāvayāmāsuratho nimneṣu vividhairmukhaiḥ ॥4॥
html:
kadācittajjalasthāyaṃ matsyabandhāḥ samantataḥ ।
niḥsrāvayāmāsuratho nimneṣu vividhairmukhaiḥ ॥4॥
slp1: kadAcittajjalasTAyaM matsyabanDAH samantataH । niHsrAvayAmAsuraTo nimnezu viviDErmuKEH ॥4॥

text: prakṣīyamāṇaṃ taṃ buddhvā jalasthāyaṃ bhayāgame । abravīddīrghadarśī tu tāvubhau suhṛdau tadā ॥5॥
html:
prakṣīyamāṇaṃ taṃ buddhvā jalasthāyaṃ bhayāgame ।
abravīddīrghadarśī tu tāvubhau suhṛdau tadā ॥5॥
slp1: prakzIyamARaM taM budDvA jalasTAyaM BayAgame । abravIddIrGadarSI tu tAvuBO suhfdO tadA ॥5॥

text: iyamāpatsamutpannā sarveṣāṃ salilaukasām । śīghramanyatra gacchāmaḥ panthā yāvanna duṣyati ॥6॥
html:
iyamāpatsamutpannā sarveṣāṃ salilaukasām ।
śīghramanyatra gacchāmaḥ panthā yāvanna duṣyati ॥6॥
slp1: iyamApatsamutpannA sarvezAM salilOkasAm । SIGramanyatra gacCAmaH panTA yAvanna duzyati ॥6॥

text: anāgatamanarthaṃ hi sunayairyaḥ prabādhate । na sa saṃśayamāpnoti rocatāṃ vāṃ vrajāmahe ॥7॥
html:
anāgatamanarthaṃ hi sunayairyaḥ prabādhate ।
na sa saṃśayamāpnoti rocatāṃ vāṃ vrajāmahe ॥7॥
slp1: anAgatamanarTaM hi sunayEryaH prabADate । na sa saMSayamApnoti rocatAM vAM vrajAmahe ॥7॥

text: dīrghasūtrastu yastatra so'bravītsamyagucyate । na tu kāryā tvarā yāvaditi me niścitā matiḥ ॥8॥
html:
dīrghasūtrastu yastatra so'bravītsamyagucyate ।
na tu kāryā tvarā yāvaditi me niścitā matiḥ ॥8॥
slp1: dIrGasUtrastu yastatra so'bravItsamyagucyate । na tu kAryA tvarA yAvaditi me niScitA matiH ॥8॥

text: atha sampratipattijñaḥ prābravīddīrghadarśinam । prāpte kāle na me kiñcinnyāyataḥ parihāsyate ॥9॥
html:
atha sampratipattijñaḥ prābravīddīrghadarśinam ।
prāpte kāle na me kiñcinnyāyataḥ parihāsyate ॥9॥
slp1: aTa sampratipattijYaH prAbravIddIrGadarSinam । prApte kAle na me kiYcinnyAyataH parihAsyate ॥9॥

text: evamukto nirākrāmaddīrghadarśī mahāmatiḥ । jagāma srotasaikena gambhīrasalilāśayam ॥10॥
html:
evamukto nirākrāmaddīrghadarśī mahāmatiḥ ।
jagāma srotasaikena gambhīrasalilāśayam ॥10॥
slp1: evamukto nirAkrAmaddIrGadarSI mahAmatiH । jagAma srotasEkena gamBIrasalilASayam ॥10॥

text: tataḥ prasrutatoyaṃ taṃ samīkṣya salilāśayam । babandhurvividhairyogairmatsyānmatsyopajīvinaḥ ॥11॥
html:
tataḥ prasrutatoyaṃ taṃ samīkṣya salilāśayam ।
babandhurvividhairyogairmatsyānmatsyopajīvinaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: tataH prasrutatoyaM taM samIkzya salilASayam । babanDurviviDEryogErmatsyAnmatsyopajIvinaH ॥11॥

text: viloḍyamāne tasmiṃstu srutatoye jalāśaye । agacchadgrahaṇaṃ tatra dīrghasūtraḥ sahāparaiḥ ॥12॥
html:
viloḍyamāne tasmiṃstu srutatoye jalāśaye ।
agacchadgrahaṇaṃ tatra dīrghasūtraḥ sahāparaiḥ ॥12॥
slp1: viloqyamAne tasmiMstu srutatoye jalASaye । agacCadgrahaRaM tatra dIrGasUtraH sahAparEH ॥12॥

text: uddānaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ ca matsyānāṃ vīkṣya rajjubhiḥ । praviśyāntaramanyeṣāmagrasatpratipattimān ॥13॥
html:
uddānaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ ca matsyānāṃ vīkṣya rajjubhiḥ ।
praviśyāntaramanyeṣāmagrasatpratipattimān ॥13॥
slp1: uddAnaM kriyamARaM ca matsyAnAM vIkzya rajjuBiH । praviSyAntaramanyezAmagrasatpratipattimAn ॥13॥

text: grastameva taduddānaṃ gṛhītvāsta tathaiva saḥ । sarvāneva tu tāṃstatra te vidurgrathitā iti ॥14॥
html:
grastameva taduddānaṃ gṛhītvāsta tathaiva saḥ ।
sarvāneva tu tāṃstatra te vidurgrathitā iti ॥14॥
slp1: grastameva taduddAnaM gfhItvAsta taTEva saH । sarvAneva tu tAMstatra te vidurgraTitA iti ॥14॥

text: tataḥ prakṣālyamāneṣu matsyeṣu vimale jale । tyaktvā rajjuṃ vimukto'bhūcchīghraṃ sampratipattimān ॥15॥
html:
tataḥ prakṣālyamāneṣu matsyeṣu vimale jale ।
tyaktvā rajjuṃ vimukto'bhūcchīghraṃ sampratipattimān ॥15॥
slp1: tataH prakzAlyamAnezu matsyezu vimale jale । tyaktvA rajjuM vimukto'BUcCIGraM sampratipattimAn ॥15॥

text: dīrghasūtrastu mandātmā hīnabuddhiracetanaḥ । maraṇaṃ prāptavānmūḍho yathaivopahatendriyaḥ ॥16॥
html:
dīrghasūtrastu mandātmā hīnabuddhiracetanaḥ ।
maraṇaṃ prāptavānmūḍho yathaivopahatendriyaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: dIrGasUtrastu mandAtmA hInabudDiracetanaH । maraRaM prAptavAnmUQo yaTEvopahatendriyaH ॥16॥

text: evaṃ prāptatamaṃ kālaṃ yo mohānnāvabudhyate । sa vinaśyati vai kṣipraṃ dīrghasūtro yathā jhaṣaḥ ॥17॥
html:
evaṃ prāptatamaṃ kālaṃ yo mohānnāvabudhyate ।
sa vinaśyati vai kṣipraṃ dīrghasūtro yathā jhaṣaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: evaM prAptatamaM kAlaM yo mohAnnAvabuDyate । sa vinaSyati vE kzipraM dIrGasUtro yaTA JazaH ॥17॥

text: ādau na kurute śreyaḥ kuśalo'smīti yaḥ pumān । sa saṃśayamavāpnoti yathā sampratipattimān ॥18॥
html:
ādau na kurute śreyaḥ kuśalo'smīti yaḥ pumān ।
sa saṃśayamavāpnoti yathā sampratipattimān ॥18॥
slp1: AdO na kurute SreyaH kuSalo'smIti yaH pumAn । sa saMSayamavApnoti yaTA sampratipattimAn ॥18॥

text: anāgatavidhānaṃ tu yo naraḥ kurute kṣamam । śreyaḥ prāpnoti so'tyarthaṃ dīrghadarśī yathā hyasau ॥19॥
html:
anāgatavidhānaṃ tu yo naraḥ kurute kṣamam ।
śreyaḥ prāpnoti so'tyarthaṃ dīrghadarśī yathā hyasau ॥19॥
slp1: anAgataviDAnaM tu yo naraH kurute kzamam । SreyaH prApnoti so'tyarTaM dIrGadarSI yaTA hyasO ॥19॥

text: kalāḥ kāṣṭhā muhūrtāśca dinā nāḍyaḥ kṣaṇā lavāḥ । pakṣā māsāśca ṛtavastulyāḥ saṃvatsarāṇi ca ॥20॥
html:
kalāḥ kāṣṭhā muhūrtāśca dinā nāḍyaḥ kṣaṇā lavāḥ ।
pakṣā māsāśca ṛtavastulyāḥ saṃvatsarāṇi ca ॥20॥
slp1: kalAH kAzWA muhUrtASca dinA nAqyaH kzaRA lavAH । pakzA mAsASca ftavastulyAH saMvatsarARi ca ॥20॥

text: pṛthivī deśa ityuktaḥ kālaḥ sa ca na dṛśyate । abhipretārthasiddhyarthaṃ nyāyato yacca tattathā ॥21॥
html:
pṛthivī deśa ityuktaḥ kālaḥ sa ca na dṛśyate ।
abhipretārthasiddhyarthaṃ nyāyato yacca tattathā ॥21॥
slp1: pfTivI deSa ityuktaH kAlaH sa ca na dfSyate । aBipretArTasidDyarTaM nyAyato yacca tattaTA ॥21॥

text: etau dharmārthaśāstreṣu mokṣaśāstreṣu carṣibhiḥ । pradhānāviti nirdiṣṭau kāmeśābhimatau nṛṇām ॥22॥
html:
etau dharmārthaśāstreṣu mokṣaśāstreṣu carṣibhiḥ ।
pradhānāviti nirdiṣṭau kāmeśābhimatau nṛṇām ॥22॥
slp1: etO DarmArTaSAstrezu mokzaSAstrezu carziBiH । praDAnAviti nirdizwO kAmeSABimatO nfRAm ॥22॥

text: parīkṣyakārī yuktastu samyaksamupapādayet । deśakālāvabhipretau tābhyāṃ phalamavāpnuyāt] ॥23॥
html:
parīkṣyakārī yuktastu samyaksamupapādayet ।
deśakālāvabhipretau tābhyāṃ phalamavāpnuyāt] ॥23॥
slp1: parIkzyakArI yuktastu samyaksamupapAdayet । deSakAlAvaBipretO tAByAM PalamavApnuyAt] ॥23॥

text: sarvatra buddhiḥ kathitā śreṣṭhā te bharatarṣabha । anāgatā tathotpannā dīrghasūtrā vināśinī ॥1॥
html:
sarvatra buddhiḥ kathitā śreṣṭhā te bharatarṣabha ।
anāgatā tathotpannā dīrghasūtrā vināśinī ॥1॥
slp1: sarvatra budDiH kaTitA SrezWA te BaratarzaBa । anAgatA taTotpannA dIrGasUtrA vinASinI ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: tadicchāmi parāṃ buddhiṃ śrotuṃ bharatasattama । yathā rājanna muhyeta śatrubhiḥ parivāritaḥ ॥2॥
html:
tadicchāmi parāṃ buddhiṃ śrotuṃ bharatasattama ।
yathā rājanna muhyeta śatrubhiḥ parivāritaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: tadicCAmi parAM budDiM SrotuM Baratasattama । yaTA rAjanna muhyeta SatruBiH parivAritaH ॥2॥

text: dharmārthakuśala prājña sarvaśāstraviśārada । pṛcchāmi tvā kuruśreṣṭha tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥3॥
html:
dharmārthakuśala prājña sarvaśāstraviśārada ।
pṛcchāmi tvā kuruśreṣṭha tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥3॥
slp1: DarmArTakuSala prAjYa sarvaSAstraviSArada । pfcCAmi tvA kuruSrezWa tanme vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥3॥

text: śatrubhirbahubhirgrasto yathā varteta pārthivaḥ । etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ sarvameva yathāvidhi ॥4॥
html:
śatrubhirbahubhirgrasto yathā varteta pārthivaḥ ।
etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ sarvameva yathāvidhi ॥4॥
slp1: SatruBirbahuBirgrasto yaTA varteta pArTivaH । etadicCAmyahaM SrotuM sarvameva yaTAviDi ॥4॥

text: viṣamasthaṃ hi rājānaṃ śatravaḥ paripanthinaḥ । bahavo'pyekamuddhartuṃ yatante pūrvatāpitāḥ ॥5॥
html:
viṣamasthaṃ hi rājānaṃ śatravaḥ paripanthinaḥ ।
bahavo'pyekamuddhartuṃ yatante pūrvatāpitāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: vizamasTaM hi rAjAnaM SatravaH paripanTinaH । bahavo'pyekamudDartuM yatante pUrvatApitAH ॥5॥

text: sarvataḥ prārthyamānena durbalena mahābalaiḥ । ekenaivāsahāyena śakyaṃ sthātuṃ kathaṃ bhavet ॥6॥
html:
sarvataḥ prārthyamānena durbalena mahābalaiḥ ।
ekenaivāsahāyena śakyaṃ sthātuṃ kathaṃ bhavet ॥6॥
slp1: sarvataH prArTyamAnena durbalena mahAbalEH । ekenEvAsahAyena SakyaM sTAtuM kaTaM Bavet ॥6॥

text: kathaṃ mitramariṃ caiva vindeta bharatarṣabha । ceṣṭitavyaṃ kathaṃ cātra śatrormitrasya cāntare ॥7॥
html:
kathaṃ mitramariṃ caiva vindeta bharatarṣabha ।
ceṣṭitavyaṃ kathaṃ cātra śatrormitrasya cāntare ॥7॥
slp1: kaTaM mitramariM cEva vindeta BaratarzaBa । cezwitavyaM kaTaM cAtra Satrormitrasya cAntare ॥7॥

text: prajñātalakṣaṇe rājannamitre mitratāṃ gate । kathaṃ nu puruṣaḥ kuryātkiṃ vā kṛtvā sukhī bhavet ॥8॥
html:
prajñātalakṣaṇe rājannamitre mitratāṃ gate ।
kathaṃ nu puruṣaḥ kuryātkiṃ vā kṛtvā sukhī bhavet ॥8॥
slp1: prajYAtalakzaRe rAjannamitre mitratAM gate । kaTaM nu puruzaH kuryAtkiM vA kftvA suKI Bavet ॥8॥

text: vigrahaṃ kena vā kuryātsandhiṃ vā kena yojayet । kathaṃ vā śatrumadhyastho vartetābalavāniti ॥9॥
html:
vigrahaṃ kena vā kuryātsandhiṃ vā kena yojayet ।
kathaṃ vā śatrumadhyastho vartetābalavāniti ॥9॥
slp1: vigrahaM kena vA kuryAtsanDiM vA kena yojayet । kaTaM vA SatrumaDyasTo vartetAbalavAniti ॥9॥

text: etadvai sarvakṛtyānāṃ paraṃ kṛtyaṃ parantapa । naitasya kaścidvaktāsti śrotā cāpi sudurlabhaḥ ॥10॥
html:
etadvai sarvakṛtyānāṃ paraṃ kṛtyaṃ parantapa ।
naitasya kaścidvaktāsti śrotā cāpi sudurlabhaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: etadvE sarvakftyAnAM paraM kftyaM parantapa । nEtasya kaScidvaktAsti SrotA cApi sudurlaBaH ॥10॥

text: ṛte śāntanavādbhīṣmātsatyasandhājjitendriyāt । tadanviṣya mahābāho sarvametadvadasva me ॥11॥
html:
ṛte śāntanavādbhīṣmātsatyasandhājjitendriyāt ।
tadanviṣya mahābāho sarvametadvadasva me ॥11॥
slp1: fte SAntanavAdBIzmAtsatyasanDAjjitendriyAt । tadanvizya mahAbAho sarvametadvadasva me ॥11॥

text: tvadyukto'yamanupraśno yudhiṣṭhira guṇodayaḥ । śṛṇu me putra kārtsnyena guhyamāpatsu bhārata ॥12॥
html:
tvadyukto'yamanupraśno yudhiṣṭhira guṇodayaḥ ।
śṛṇu me putra kārtsnyena guhyamāpatsu bhārata ॥12॥
slp1: tvadyukto'yamanupraSno yuDizWira guRodayaH । SfRu me putra kArtsnyena guhyamApatsu BArata ॥12॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: amitro mitratāṃ yāti mitraṃ cāpi praduṣyati । sāmarthyayogātkāryāṇāṃ tadgatyā hi sadā gatiḥ ॥13॥
html:
amitro mitratāṃ yāti mitraṃ cāpi praduṣyati ।
sāmarthyayogātkāryāṇāṃ tadgatyā hi sadā gatiḥ ॥13॥
slp1: amitro mitratAM yAti mitraM cApi praduzyati । sAmarTyayogAtkAryARAM tadgatyA hi sadA gatiH ॥13॥

text: tasmādviśvasitavyaṃ ca vigrahaṃ ca samācaret । deśaṃ kālaṃ ca vijñāya kāryākāryaviniścaye ॥14॥
html:
tasmādviśvasitavyaṃ ca vigrahaṃ ca samācaret ।
deśaṃ kālaṃ ca vijñāya kāryākāryaviniścaye ॥14॥
slp1: tasmAdviSvasitavyaM ca vigrahaM ca samAcaret । deSaM kAlaM ca vijYAya kAryAkAryaviniScaye ॥14॥

text: sandhātavyaṃ budhairnityaṃ vyavasyaṃ ca hitārthibhiḥ । amitrairapi sandheyaṃ prāṇā rakṣyāśca bhārata ॥15॥
html:
sandhātavyaṃ budhairnityaṃ vyavasyaṃ ca hitārthibhiḥ ।
amitrairapi sandheyaṃ prāṇā rakṣyāśca bhārata ॥15॥
slp1: sanDAtavyaM buDErnityaM vyavasyaM ca hitArTiBiH । amitrErapi sanDeyaM prARA rakzyASca BArata ॥15॥

text: yo hyamitrairnaro nityaṃ na sandadhyādapaṇḍitaḥ । na so'rthamāpnuyātkiñcitphalānyapi ca bhārata ॥16॥
html:
yo hyamitrairnaro nityaṃ na sandadhyādapaṇḍitaḥ ।
na so'rthamāpnuyātkiñcitphalānyapi ca bhārata ॥16॥
slp1: yo hyamitrErnaro nityaM na sandaDyAdapaRqitaH । na so'rTamApnuyAtkiYcitPalAnyapi ca BArata ॥16॥

text: yastvamitreṇa sandhatte mitreṇa ca virudhyate । arthayuktiṃ samālokya sumahadvindate phalam ॥17॥
html:
yastvamitreṇa sandhatte mitreṇa ca virudhyate ।
arthayuktiṃ samālokya sumahadvindate phalam ॥17॥
slp1: yastvamitreRa sanDatte mitreRa ca viruDyate । arTayuktiM samAlokya sumahadvindate Palam ॥17॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । mārjārasya ca saṃvādaṃ nyagrodhe mūṣakasya ca ॥18॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
mārjārasya ca saṃvādaṃ nyagrodhe mūṣakasya ca ॥18॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । mArjArasya ca saMvAdaM nyagroDe mUzakasya ca ॥18॥

text: vane mahati kasmiṃścinnyagrodhaḥ sumahānabhūt । latājālaparicchanno nānādvijagaṇāyutaḥ ॥19॥
html:
vane mahati kasmiṃścinnyagrodhaḥ sumahānabhūt ।
latājālaparicchanno nānādvijagaṇāyutaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: vane mahati kasmiMScinnyagroDaH sumahAnaBUt । latAjAlaparicCanno nAnAdvijagaRAyutaH ॥19॥

text: skandhavānmeghasaṅkāśaḥ śītacchāyo manoramaḥ । vairantyamabhito jātastarurvyālamṛgākulaḥ ॥20॥
html:
skandhavānmeghasaṅkāśaḥ śītacchāyo manoramaḥ ।
vairantyamabhito jātastarurvyālamṛgākulaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: skanDavAnmeGasaNkASaH SItacCAyo manoramaH । vErantyamaBito jAtastarurvyAlamfgAkulaH ॥20॥

text: tasya mūlaṃ samāśritya kṛtvā śatamukhaṃ bilam । vasati sma mahāprājñaḥ palito nāma mūṣakaḥ ॥21॥
html:
tasya mūlaṃ samāśritya kṛtvā śatamukhaṃ bilam ।
vasati sma mahāprājñaḥ palito nāma mūṣakaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: tasya mUlaM samASritya kftvA SatamuKaM bilam । vasati sma mahAprAjYaH palito nAma mUzakaH ॥21॥

text: śākhāśca tasya saṃśritya vasati sma sukhaṃ puraḥ । lomaśo nāma mārjāraḥ pakṣisattvāvasādakaḥ ॥22॥
html:
śākhāśca tasya saṃśritya vasati sma sukhaṃ puraḥ ।
lomaśo nāma mārjāraḥ pakṣisattvāvasādakaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: SAKASca tasya saMSritya vasati sma suKaM puraH । lomaSo nAma mArjAraH pakzisattvAvasAdakaH ॥22॥

text: tatra cāgatya caṇḍālo vairantyakṛtaketanaḥ । ayojayattamunmāthaṃ nityamastaṃ gate ravau ॥23॥
html:
tatra cāgatya caṇḍālo vairantyakṛtaketanaḥ ।
ayojayattamunmāthaṃ nityamastaṃ gate ravau ॥23॥
slp1: tatra cAgatya caRqAlo vErantyakftaketanaH । ayojayattamunmATaM nityamastaM gate ravO ॥23॥

text: tatra snāyumayānpāśānyathāvatsannidhāya saḥ । gṛhaṃ gatvā sukhaṃ śete prabhātāmeti śarvarīm ॥24॥
html:
tatra snāyumayānpāśānyathāvatsannidhāya saḥ ।
gṛhaṃ gatvā sukhaṃ śete prabhātāmeti śarvarīm ॥24॥
slp1: tatra snAyumayAnpASAnyaTAvatsanniDAya saH । gfhaM gatvA suKaM Sete praBAtAmeti SarvarIm ॥24॥

text: tatra sma nityaṃ badhyante naktaṃ bahuvidhā mṛgāḥ । kadācittatra mārjārastvapramatto'pyabadhyata ॥25॥
html:
tatra sma nityaṃ badhyante naktaṃ bahuvidhā mṛgāḥ ।
kadācittatra mārjārastvapramatto'pyabadhyata ॥25॥
slp1: tatra sma nityaM baDyante naktaM bahuviDA mfgAH । kadAcittatra mArjArastvapramatto'pyabaDyata ॥25॥

text: tasminbaddhe mahāprājñaḥ śatrau nityātatāyini । taṃ kālaṃ palito jñātvā vicacāra sunirbhayaḥ ॥26॥
html:
tasminbaddhe mahāprājñaḥ śatrau nityātatāyini ।
taṃ kālaṃ palito jñātvā vicacāra sunirbhayaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: tasminbadDe mahAprAjYaH SatrO nityAtatAyini । taM kAlaM palito jYAtvA vicacAra sunirBayaH ॥26॥

text: tenānucaratā tasminvane viśvastacāriṇā । bhakṣaṃ vicaramāṇena nacirāddṛṣṭamāmiṣam ॥27॥
html:
tenānucaratā tasminvane viśvastacāriṇā ।
bhakṣaṃ vicaramāṇena nacirāddṛṣṭamāmiṣam ॥27॥
slp1: tenAnucaratA tasminvane viSvastacAriRA । BakzaM vicaramARena nacirAddfzwamAmizam ॥27॥

text: sa tamunmāthamāruhya tadāmiṣamabhakṣayat । tasyopari sapatnasya baddhasya manasā hasan ॥28॥
html:
sa tamunmāthamāruhya tadāmiṣamabhakṣayat ।
tasyopari sapatnasya baddhasya manasā hasan ॥28॥
slp1: sa tamunmATamAruhya tadAmizamaBakzayat । tasyopari sapatnasya badDasya manasA hasan ॥28॥

text: āmiṣe tu prasaktaḥ sa kadācidavalokayan । apaśyadaparaṃ ghoramātmanaḥ śatrumāgatam ॥29॥
html:
āmiṣe tu prasaktaḥ sa kadācidavalokayan ।
apaśyadaparaṃ ghoramātmanaḥ śatrumāgatam ॥29॥
slp1: Amize tu prasaktaH sa kadAcidavalokayan । apaSyadaparaM GoramAtmanaH SatrumAgatam ॥29॥

text: śaraprasūnasaṅkāśaṃ mahīvivaraśāyinam । nakulaṃ harikaṃ nāma capalaṃ tāmralocanam ॥30॥
html:
śaraprasūnasaṅkāśaṃ mahīvivaraśāyinam ।
nakulaṃ harikaṃ nāma capalaṃ tāmralocanam ॥30॥
slp1: SaraprasUnasaNkASaM mahIvivaraSAyinam । nakulaM harikaM nAma capalaM tAmralocanam ॥30॥

text: tena mūṣakagandhena tvaramāṇamupāgatam । bhakṣārthaṃ lelihadvaktraṃ bhūmāvūrdhvamukhaṃ sthitam ॥31॥
html:
tena mūṣakagandhena tvaramāṇamupāgatam ।
bhakṣārthaṃ lelihadvaktraṃ bhūmāvūrdhvamukhaṃ sthitam ॥31॥
slp1: tena mUzakaganDena tvaramARamupAgatam । BakzArTaM lelihadvaktraM BUmAvUrDvamuKaM sTitam ॥31॥

text: śākhāgatamariṃ cānyadapaśyatkoṭarālayam । ulūkaṃ candrakaṃ nāma tīkṣṇatuṇḍaṃ kṣapācaram ॥32॥
html:
śākhāgatamariṃ cānyadapaśyatkoṭarālayam ।
ulūkaṃ candrakaṃ nāma tīkṣṇatuṇḍaṃ kṣapācaram ॥32॥
slp1: SAKAgatamariM cAnyadapaSyatkowarAlayam । ulUkaM candrakaM nAma tIkzRatuRqaM kzapAcaram ॥32॥

text: gatasya viṣayaṃ tasya nakulolūkayostadā । athāsyāsīdiyaṃ cintā tatprāpya sumahadbhayam ॥33॥
html:
gatasya viṣayaṃ tasya nakulolūkayostadā ।
athāsyāsīdiyaṃ cintā tatprāpya sumahadbhayam ॥33॥
slp1: gatasya vizayaM tasya nakulolUkayostadA । aTAsyAsIdiyaM cintA tatprApya sumahadBayam ॥33॥

text: āpadyasyāṃ sukaṣṭāyāṃ maraṇe samupasthite । samantādbhaya utpanne kathaṃ kāryaṃ hitaiṣiṇā ॥34॥
html:
āpadyasyāṃ sukaṣṭāyāṃ maraṇe samupasthite ।
samantādbhaya utpanne kathaṃ kāryaṃ hitaiṣiṇā ॥34॥
slp1: ApadyasyAM sukazwAyAM maraRe samupasTite । samantAdBaya utpanne kaTaM kAryaM hitEziRA ॥34॥

text: sa tathā sarvato ruddhaḥ sarvatra samadarśanaḥ । abhavadbhayasantaptaścakre cemāṃ parāṃ gatim ॥35॥
html:
sa tathā sarvato ruddhaḥ sarvatra samadarśanaḥ ।
abhavadbhayasantaptaścakre cemāṃ parāṃ gatim ॥35॥
slp1: sa taTA sarvato rudDaH sarvatra samadarSanaH । aBavadBayasantaptaScakre cemAM parAM gatim ॥35॥

text: āpadvināśabhūyiṣṭhā śataikīyaṃ ca jīvitam । samantasaṃśayā ceyamasmānāpadupasthitā ॥36॥
html:
āpadvināśabhūyiṣṭhā śataikīyaṃ ca jīvitam ।
samantasaṃśayā ceyamasmānāpadupasthitā ॥36॥
slp1: ApadvinASaBUyizWA SatEkIyaM ca jIvitam । samantasaMSayA ceyamasmAnApadupasTitA ॥36॥

text: gataṃ hi sahasā bhūmiṃ nakulo māṃ samāpnuyāt । ulūkaśceha tiṣṭhantaṃ mārjāraḥ pāśasaṅkṣayāt ॥37॥
html:
gataṃ hi sahasā bhūmiṃ nakulo māṃ samāpnuyāt ।
ulūkaśceha tiṣṭhantaṃ mārjāraḥ pāśasaṅkṣayāt ॥37॥
slp1: gataM hi sahasA BUmiM nakulo mAM samApnuyAt । ulUkaSceha tizWantaM mArjAraH pASasaNkzayAt ॥37॥

text: na tvevāsmadvidhaḥ prājñaḥ sammohaṃ gantumarhati । kariṣye jīvite yatnaṃ yāvaducchvāsanigraham ॥38॥
html:
na tvevāsmadvidhaḥ prājñaḥ sammohaṃ gantumarhati ।
kariṣye jīvite yatnaṃ yāvaducchvāsanigraham ॥38॥
slp1: na tvevAsmadviDaH prAjYaH sammohaM gantumarhati । karizye jIvite yatnaM yAvaducCvAsanigraham ॥38॥

text: na hi buddhyānvitāḥ prājñā nītiśāstraviśāradāḥ । sambhramantyāpadaṃ prāpya mahato'rthānavāpya ca ॥39॥
html:
na hi buddhyānvitāḥ prājñā nītiśāstraviśāradāḥ ।
sambhramantyāpadaṃ prāpya mahato'rthānavāpya ca ॥39॥
slp1: na hi budDyAnvitAH prAjYA nItiSAstraviSAradAH । samBramantyApadaM prApya mahato'rTAnavApya ca ॥39॥

text: na tvanyāmiha mārjārādgatiṃ paśyāmi sāmpratam । viṣamastho hyayaṃ jantuḥ kṛtyaṃ cāsya mahanmayā ॥40॥
html:
na tvanyāmiha mārjārādgatiṃ paśyāmi sāmpratam ।
viṣamastho hyayaṃ jantuḥ kṛtyaṃ cāsya mahanmayā ॥40॥
slp1: na tvanyAmiha mArjArAdgatiM paSyAmi sAmpratam । vizamasTo hyayaM jantuH kftyaM cAsya mahanmayA ॥40॥

text: jīvitārthī kathaṃ tvadya prārthitaḥ śatrubhistribhiḥ । tasmādimamahaṃ śatruṃ mārjāraṃ saṃśrayāmi vai ॥41॥
html:
jīvitārthī kathaṃ tvadya prārthitaḥ śatrubhistribhiḥ ।
tasmādimamahaṃ śatruṃ mārjāraṃ saṃśrayāmi vai ॥41॥
slp1: jIvitArTI kaTaM tvadya prArTitaH SatruBistriBiH । tasmAdimamahaM SatruM mArjAraM saMSrayAmi vE ॥41॥

text: kṣatravidyāṃ samāśritya hitamasyopadhāraye । yenemaṃ śatrusaṅghātaṃ matipūrveṇa vañcaye ॥42॥
html:
kṣatravidyāṃ samāśritya hitamasyopadhāraye ।
yenemaṃ śatrusaṅghātaṃ matipūrveṇa vañcaye ॥42॥
slp1: kzatravidyAM samASritya hitamasyopaDAraye । yenemaM SatrusaNGAtaM matipUrveRa vaYcaye ॥42॥

text: ayamatyantaśatrurme vaiṣamyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ । mūḍho grāhayituṃ svārthaṃ saṅgatyā yadi śakyate ॥43॥
html:
ayamatyantaśatrurme vaiṣamyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ।
mūḍho grāhayituṃ svārthaṃ saṅgatyā yadi śakyate ॥43॥
slp1: ayamatyantaSatrurme vEzamyaM paramaM gataH । mUQo grAhayituM svArTaM saNgatyA yadi Sakyate ॥43॥

text: kadācidvyasanaṃ prāpya sandhiṃ kuryānmayā saha । balinā sanniviṣṭasya śatrorapi parigrahaḥ । kārya ityāhurācāryā viṣame jīvitārthinā ॥44॥
html:
kadācidvyasanaṃ prāpya sandhiṃ kuryānmayā saha ।
balinā sanniviṣṭasya śatrorapi parigrahaḥ ।
kārya ityāhurācāryā viṣame jīvitārthinā ॥44॥
slp1: kadAcidvyasanaM prApya sanDiM kuryAnmayA saha । balinA sannivizwasya Satrorapi parigrahaH । kArya ityAhurAcAryA vizame jIvitArTinA ॥44॥

text: śreyānhi paṇḍitaḥ śatrurna ca mitramapaṇḍitam । mama hyamitre mārjāre jīvitaṃ sampratiṣṭhitam ॥45॥
html:
śreyānhi paṇḍitaḥ śatrurna ca mitramapaṇḍitam ।
mama hyamitre mārjāre jīvitaṃ sampratiṣṭhitam ॥45॥
slp1: SreyAnhi paRqitaH Satrurna ca mitramapaRqitam । mama hyamitre mArjAre jIvitaM sampratizWitam ॥45॥

text: hantainaṃ sampravakṣyāmi hetumātmābhirakṣaṇe । apīdānīmayaṃ śatruḥ saṅgatyā paṇḍito bhavet ॥46॥
html:
hantainaṃ sampravakṣyāmi hetumātmābhirakṣaṇe ।
apīdānīmayaṃ śatruḥ saṅgatyā paṇḍito bhavet ॥46॥
slp1: hantEnaM sampravakzyAmi hetumAtmABirakzaRe । apIdAnImayaM SatruH saNgatyA paRqito Bavet ॥46॥

text: tato'rthagatitattvajñaḥ sandhivigrahakālavit । sāntvapūrvamidaṃ vākyaṃ mārjāraṃ mūṣako'bravīt ॥47॥
html:
tato'rthagatitattvajñaḥ sandhivigrahakālavit ।
sāntvapūrvamidaṃ vākyaṃ mārjāraṃ mūṣako'bravīt ॥47॥
slp1: tato'rTagatitattvajYaH sanDivigrahakAlavit । sAntvapUrvamidaM vAkyaM mArjAraM mUzako'bravIt ॥47॥

text: sauhṛdenābhibhāṣe tvā kaccinmārjāra jīvasi । jīvitaṃ hi tavecchāmi śreyaḥ sādhāraṇaṃ hi nau ॥48॥
html:
sauhṛdenābhibhāṣe tvā kaccinmārjāra jīvasi ।
jīvitaṃ hi tavecchāmi śreyaḥ sādhāraṇaṃ hi nau ॥48॥
slp1: sOhfdenABiBAze tvA kaccinmArjAra jIvasi । jIvitaM hi tavecCAmi SreyaH sADAraRaM hi nO ॥48॥

text: na te saumya viṣattavyaṃ jīviṣyasi yathā purā । ahaṃ tvāmuddhariṣyāmi prāṇāñjahyāṃ hi te kṛte ॥49॥
html:
na te saumya viṣattavyaṃ jīviṣyasi yathā purā ।
ahaṃ tvāmuddhariṣyāmi prāṇāñjahyāṃ hi te kṛte ॥49॥
slp1: na te sOmya vizattavyaM jIvizyasi yaTA purA । ahaM tvAmudDarizyAmi prARAYjahyAM hi te kfte ॥49॥

text: asti kaścidupāyo'tra puṣkalaḥ pratibhāti mām । yena śakyastvayā mokṣaḥ prāptuṃ śreyo yathā mayā ॥50॥
html:
asti kaścidupāyo'tra puṣkalaḥ pratibhāti mām ।
yena śakyastvayā mokṣaḥ prāptuṃ śreyo yathā mayā ॥50॥
slp1: asti kaScidupAyo'tra puzkalaH pratiBAti mAm । yena SakyastvayA mokzaH prAptuM Sreyo yaTA mayA ॥50॥

text: mayā hyupāyo dṛṣṭo'yaṃ vicārya matimātmanaḥ । ātmārthaṃ ca tvadarthaṃ ca śreyaḥ sādhāraṇaṃ hi nau ॥51॥
html:
mayā hyupāyo dṛṣṭo'yaṃ vicārya matimātmanaḥ ।
ātmārthaṃ ca tvadarthaṃ ca śreyaḥ sādhāraṇaṃ hi nau ॥51॥
slp1: mayA hyupAyo dfzwo'yaM vicArya matimAtmanaH । AtmArTaM ca tvadarTaM ca SreyaH sADAraRaM hi nO ॥51॥

text: idaṃ hi nakulolūkaṃ pāpabuddhyabhitaḥ sthitam । na dharṣayati mārjāra tena me svasti sāmpratam ॥52॥
html:
idaṃ hi nakulolūkaṃ pāpabuddhyabhitaḥ sthitam ।
na dharṣayati mārjāra tena me svasti sāmpratam ॥52॥
slp1: idaM hi nakulolUkaM pApabudDyaBitaH sTitam । na Darzayati mArjAra tena me svasti sAmpratam ॥52॥

text: kūjaṃścapalanetro'yaṃ kauśiko māṃ nirīkṣate । nagaśākhāgrahastiṣṭhaṃstasyāhaṃ bhṛśamudvije ॥53॥
html:
kūjaṃścapalanetro'yaṃ kauśiko māṃ nirīkṣate ।
nagaśākhāgrahastiṣṭhaṃstasyāhaṃ bhṛśamudvije ॥53॥
slp1: kUjaMScapalanetro'yaM kOSiko mAM nirIkzate । nagaSAKAgrahastizWaMstasyAhaM BfSamudvije ॥53॥

text: satāṃ sāptapadaṃ sakhyaṃ savāso me'si paṇḍitaḥ । sāṃvāsyakaṃ kariṣyāmi nāsti te mṛtyuto bhayam ॥54॥
html:
satāṃ sāptapadaṃ sakhyaṃ savāso me'si paṇḍitaḥ ।
sāṃvāsyakaṃ kariṣyāmi nāsti te mṛtyuto bhayam ॥54॥
slp1: satAM sAptapadaM saKyaM savAso me'si paRqitaH । sAMvAsyakaM karizyAmi nAsti te mftyuto Bayam ॥54॥

text: na hi śaknoṣi mārjāra pāśaṃ chettuṃ vinā mayā । ahaṃ chetsyāmi te pāśaṃ yadi māṃ tvaṃ na hiṃsasi ॥55॥
html:
na hi śaknoṣi mārjāra pāśaṃ chettuṃ vinā mayā ।
ahaṃ chetsyāmi te pāśaṃ yadi māṃ tvaṃ na hiṃsasi ॥55॥
slp1: na hi Saknozi mArjAra pASaM CettuM vinA mayA । ahaM CetsyAmi te pASaM yadi mAM tvaM na hiMsasi ॥55॥

text: tvamāśrito nagasyāgraṃ mūlaṃ tvahamupāśritaḥ । ciroṣitāvihāvāṃ vai vṛkṣe'sminviditaṃ hi te ॥56॥
html:
tvamāśrito nagasyāgraṃ mūlaṃ tvahamupāśritaḥ ।
ciroṣitāvihāvāṃ vai vṛkṣe'sminviditaṃ hi te ॥56॥
slp1: tvamASrito nagasyAgraM mUlaM tvahamupASritaH । cirozitAvihAvAM vE vfkze'sminviditaM hi te ॥56॥

text: yasminnāśvasate kaścidyaśca nāśvasate kvacit । na tau dhīrāḥ praśaṃsanti nityamudvignacetasau ॥57॥
html:
yasminnāśvasate kaścidyaśca nāśvasate kvacit ।
na tau dhīrāḥ praśaṃsanti nityamudvignacetasau ॥57॥
slp1: yasminnASvasate kaScidyaSca nASvasate kvacit । na tO DIrAH praSaMsanti nityamudvignacetasO ॥57॥

text: tasmādvivardhatāṃ prītiḥ satyā saṅgatirastu nau । kālātītamapārthaṃ hi na praśaṃsanti paṇḍitāḥ ॥58॥
html:
tasmādvivardhatāṃ prītiḥ satyā saṅgatirastu nau ।
kālātītamapārthaṃ hi na praśaṃsanti paṇḍitāḥ ॥58॥
slp1: tasmAdvivarDatAM prItiH satyA saNgatirastu nO । kAlAtItamapArTaM hi na praSaMsanti paRqitAH ॥58॥

text: arthayuktimimāṃ tāvadyathābhūtāṃ niśāmaya । tava jīvitamicchāmi tvaṃ mamecchasi jīvitam ॥59॥
html:
arthayuktimimāṃ tāvadyathābhūtāṃ niśāmaya ।
tava jīvitamicchāmi tvaṃ mamecchasi jīvitam ॥59॥
slp1: arTayuktimimAM tAvadyaTABUtAM niSAmaya । tava jIvitamicCAmi tvaM mamecCasi jIvitam ॥59॥

text: kaścittarati kāṣṭhena sugambhīrāṃ mahānadīm । sa tārayati tatkāṣṭhaṃ sa ca kāṣṭhena tāryate ॥60॥
html:
kaścittarati kāṣṭhena sugambhīrāṃ mahānadīm ।
sa tārayati tatkāṣṭhaṃ sa ca kāṣṭhena tāryate ॥60॥
slp1: kaScittarati kAzWena sugamBIrAM mahAnadIm । sa tArayati tatkAzWaM sa ca kAzWena tAryate ॥60॥

text: īdṛśo nau samāyogo bhaviṣyati sunistaraḥ । ahaṃ tvāṃ tārayiṣyāmi tvaṃ ca māṃ tārayiṣyasi ॥61॥
html:
īdṛśo nau samāyogo bhaviṣyati sunistaraḥ ।
ahaṃ tvāṃ tārayiṣyāmi tvaṃ ca māṃ tārayiṣyasi ॥61॥
slp1: IdfSo nO samAyogo Bavizyati sunistaraH । ahaM tvAM tArayizyAmi tvaM ca mAM tArayizyasi ॥61॥

text: evamuktvā tu palitastadarthamubhayorhitam । hetumadgrahaṇīyaṃ ca kālākāṅkṣī vyapaikṣata ॥62॥
html:
evamuktvā tu palitastadarthamubhayorhitam ।
hetumadgrahaṇīyaṃ ca kālākāṅkṣī vyapaikṣata ॥62॥
slp1: evamuktvA tu palitastadarTamuBayorhitam । hetumadgrahaRIyaM ca kAlAkANkzI vyapEkzata ॥62॥

text: atha suvyāhṛtaṃ tasya śrutvā śatrurvicakṣaṇaḥ । hetumadgrahaṇīyārthaṃ mārjāro vākyamabravīt ॥63॥
html:
atha suvyāhṛtaṃ tasya śrutvā śatrurvicakṣaṇaḥ ।
hetumadgrahaṇīyārthaṃ mārjāro vākyamabravīt ॥63॥
slp1: aTa suvyAhftaM tasya SrutvA SatrurvicakzaRaH । hetumadgrahaRIyArTaM mArjAro vAkyamabravIt ॥63॥

text: buddhimānvākyasampannastadvākyamanuvarṇayan । tāmavasthāmavekṣyāntyāṃ sāmnaiva pratyapūjayat ॥64॥
html:
buddhimānvākyasampannastadvākyamanuvarṇayan ।
tāmavasthāmavekṣyāntyāṃ sāmnaiva pratyapūjayat ॥64॥
slp1: budDimAnvAkyasampannastadvAkyamanuvarRayan । tAmavasTAmavekzyAntyAM sAmnEva pratyapUjayat ॥64॥

text: tatastīkṣṇāgradaśano vaiḍūryamaṇilocanaḥ । mūṣakaṃ mandamudvīkṣya mārjāro lomaśo'bravīt ॥65॥
html:
tatastīkṣṇāgradaśano vaiḍūryamaṇilocanaḥ ।
mūṣakaṃ mandamudvīkṣya mārjāro lomaśo'bravīt ॥65॥
slp1: tatastIkzRAgradaSano vEqUryamaRilocanaH । mUzakaM mandamudvIkzya mArjAro lomaSo'bravIt ॥65॥

text: nandāmi saumya bhadraṃ te yo māṃ jīvantamicchasi । śreyaśca yadi jānīṣe kriyatāṃ mā vicāraya ॥66॥
html:
nandāmi saumya bhadraṃ te yo māṃ jīvantamicchasi ।
śreyaśca yadi jānīṣe kriyatāṃ mā vicāraya ॥66॥
slp1: nandAmi sOmya BadraM te yo mAM jIvantamicCasi । SreyaSca yadi jAnIze kriyatAM mA vicAraya ॥66॥

text: ahaṃ hi dṛḍhamāpannastvamāpannataro mayā । dvayorāpannayoḥ sandhiḥ kriyatāṃ mā vicāraya ॥67॥
html:
ahaṃ hi dṛḍhamāpannastvamāpannataro mayā ।
dvayorāpannayoḥ sandhiḥ kriyatāṃ mā vicāraya ॥67॥
slp1: ahaM hi dfQamApannastvamApannataro mayA । dvayorApannayoH sanDiH kriyatAM mA vicAraya ॥67॥

text: vidhatsva prāptakālaṃ yatkāryaṃ sidhyatu cāvayoḥ । mayi kṛcchrādvinirmukte na vinaṅkṣyati te kṛtam ॥68॥
html:
vidhatsva prāptakālaṃ yatkāryaṃ sidhyatu cāvayoḥ ।
mayi kṛcchrādvinirmukte na vinaṅkṣyati te kṛtam ॥68॥
slp1: viDatsva prAptakAlaM yatkAryaM siDyatu cAvayoH । mayi kfcCrAdvinirmukte na vinaNkzyati te kftam ॥68॥

text: nyastamāno'smi bhakto'smi śiṣyastvaddhitakṛttathā । nideśavaśavartī ca bhavantaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ॥69॥
html:
nyastamāno'smi bhakto'smi śiṣyastvaddhitakṛttathā ।
nideśavaśavartī ca bhavantaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ॥69॥
slp1: nyastamAno'smi Bakto'smi SizyastvadDitakfttaTA । nideSavaSavartI ca BavantaM SaraRaM gataH ॥69॥

text: ityevamuktaḥ palito mārjāraṃ vaśamāgatam । vākyaṃ hitamuvācedamabhinītārthamarthavat ॥70॥
html:
ityevamuktaḥ palito mārjāraṃ vaśamāgatam ।
vākyaṃ hitamuvācedamabhinītārthamarthavat ॥70॥
slp1: ityevamuktaH palito mArjAraM vaSamAgatam । vAkyaM hitamuvAcedamaBinItArTamarTavat ॥70॥

text: udāraṃ yadbhavānāha naitaccitraṃ bhavadvidhe । vidito yastu mārgo me hitārthaṃ śṛṇu taṃ mama ॥71॥
html:
udāraṃ yadbhavānāha naitaccitraṃ bhavadvidhe ।
vidito yastu mārgo me hitārthaṃ śṛṇu taṃ mama ॥71॥
slp1: udAraM yadBavAnAha nEtaccitraM BavadviDe । vidito yastu mArgo me hitArTaM SfRu taM mama ॥71॥

text: ahaṃ tvānupravekṣyāmi nakulānme mahadbhayam । trāyasva māṃ mā vadhīśca śakto'smi tava mokṣaṇe ॥72॥
html:
ahaṃ tvānupravekṣyāmi nakulānme mahadbhayam ।
trāyasva māṃ mā vadhīśca śakto'smi tava mokṣaṇe ॥72॥
slp1: ahaM tvAnupravekzyAmi nakulAnme mahadBayam । trAyasva mAM mA vaDISca Sakto'smi tava mokzaRe ॥72॥

text: ulūkāccaiva māṃ rakṣa kṣudraḥ prārthayate hi mām । ahaṃ chetsyāmi te pāśānsakhe satyena te śape ॥73॥
html:
ulūkāccaiva māṃ rakṣa kṣudraḥ prārthayate hi mām ।
ahaṃ chetsyāmi te pāśānsakhe satyena te śape ॥73॥
slp1: ulUkAccEva mAM rakza kzudraH prArTayate hi mAm । ahaM CetsyAmi te pASAnsaKe satyena te Sape ॥73॥

text: tadvacaḥ saṅgataṃ śrutvā lomaśo yuktamarthavat । harṣādudvīkṣya palitaṃ svāgatenābhyapūjayat ॥74॥
html:
tadvacaḥ saṅgataṃ śrutvā lomaśo yuktamarthavat ।
harṣādudvīkṣya palitaṃ svāgatenābhyapūjayat ॥74॥
slp1: tadvacaH saNgataM SrutvA lomaSo yuktamarTavat । harzAdudvIkzya palitaM svAgatenAByapUjayat ॥74॥

text: sa taṃ sampūjya palitaṃ mārjāraḥ sauhṛde sthitaḥ । suvicintyābravīddhīraḥ prītastvarita eva hi ॥75॥
html:
sa taṃ sampūjya palitaṃ mārjāraḥ sauhṛde sthitaḥ ।
suvicintyābravīddhīraḥ prītastvarita eva hi ॥75॥
slp1: sa taM sampUjya palitaM mArjAraH sOhfde sTitaH । suvicintyAbravIdDIraH prItastvarita eva hi ॥75॥

text: kṣipramāgaccha bhadraṃ te tvaṃ me prāṇasamaḥ sakhā । tava prājña prasādāddhi kṣipraṃ prāpsyāmi jīvitam ॥76॥
html:
kṣipramāgaccha bhadraṃ te tvaṃ me prāṇasamaḥ sakhā ।
tava prājña prasādāddhi kṣipraṃ prāpsyāmi jīvitam ॥76॥
slp1: kzipramAgacCa BadraM te tvaM me prARasamaH saKA । tava prAjYa prasAdAdDi kzipraM prApsyAmi jIvitam ॥76॥

text: yadyadevaṅgatenādya śakyaṃ kartuṃ mayā tava । tadājñāpaya kartāhaṃ sandhirevāstu nau sakhe ॥77॥
html:
yadyadevaṅgatenādya śakyaṃ kartuṃ mayā tava ।
tadājñāpaya kartāhaṃ sandhirevāstu nau sakhe ॥77॥
slp1: yadyadevaNgatenAdya SakyaM kartuM mayA tava । tadAjYApaya kartAhaM sanDirevAstu nO saKe ॥77॥

text: asmātte saṃśayānmuktaḥ samitragaṇabāndhavaḥ । sarvakāryāṇi kartāhaṃ priyāṇi ca hitāni ca ॥78॥
html:
asmātte saṃśayānmuktaḥ samitragaṇabāndhavaḥ ।
sarvakāryāṇi kartāhaṃ priyāṇi ca hitāni ca ॥78॥
slp1: asmAtte saMSayAnmuktaH samitragaRabAnDavaH । sarvakAryARi kartAhaM priyARi ca hitAni ca ॥78॥

text: muktaśca vyasanādasmātsaumyāhamapi nāma te । prītimutpādayeyaṃ ca pratikartuṃ ca śaknuyām ॥79॥
html:
muktaśca vyasanādasmātsaumyāhamapi nāma te ।
prītimutpādayeyaṃ ca pratikartuṃ ca śaknuyām ॥79॥
slp1: muktaSca vyasanAdasmAtsOmyAhamapi nAma te । prItimutpAdayeyaM ca pratikartuM ca SaknuyAm ॥79॥

text: grāhayitvā tu taṃ svārthaṃ mārjāraṃ mūṣakastadā । praviveśa suvisrabdhaḥ samyagarthāṃścacāra ha ॥80॥
html:
grāhayitvā tu taṃ svārthaṃ mārjāraṃ mūṣakastadā ।
praviveśa suvisrabdhaḥ samyagarthāṃścacāra ha ॥80॥
slp1: grAhayitvA tu taM svArTaM mArjAraM mUzakastadA । praviveSa suvisrabDaH samyagarTAMScacAra ha ॥80॥

text: evamāśvāsito vidvānmārjāreṇa sa mūṣakaḥ । mārjārorasi visrabdhaḥ suṣvāpa pitṛmātṛvat ॥81॥
html:
evamāśvāsito vidvānmārjāreṇa sa mūṣakaḥ ।
mārjārorasi visrabdhaḥ suṣvāpa pitṛmātṛvat ॥81॥
slp1: evamASvAsito vidvAnmArjAreRa sa mUzakaH । mArjArorasi visrabDaH suzvApa pitfmAtfvat ॥81॥

text: līnaṃ tu tasya gātreṣu mārjārasyātha mūṣakam । tau dṛṣṭvā nakulolūkau nirāśau jagmaturgṛhān ॥82॥
html:
līnaṃ tu tasya gātreṣu mārjārasyātha mūṣakam ।
tau dṛṣṭvā nakulolūkau nirāśau jagmaturgṛhān ॥82॥
slp1: lInaM tu tasya gAtrezu mArjArasyATa mUzakam । tO dfzwvA nakulolUkO nirASO jagmaturgfhAn ॥82॥

text: līnastu tasya gātreṣu palito deśakālavit । ciccheda pāśānnṛpate kālākāṅkṣī śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ॥83॥
html:
līnastu tasya gātreṣu palito deśakālavit ।
ciccheda pāśānnṛpate kālākāṅkṣī śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ॥83॥
slp1: lInastu tasya gAtrezu palito deSakAlavit । cicCeda pASAnnfpate kAlAkANkzI SanEH SanEH ॥83॥

text: atha bandhaparikliṣṭo mārjāro vīkṣya mūṣakam । chindantaṃ vai tadā pāśānatvarantaṃ tvarānvitaḥ ॥84॥
html:
atha bandhaparikliṣṭo mārjāro vīkṣya mūṣakam ।
chindantaṃ vai tadā pāśānatvarantaṃ tvarānvitaḥ ॥84॥
slp1: aTa banDapariklizwo mArjAro vIkzya mUzakam । CindantaM vE tadA pASAnatvarantaM tvarAnvitaH ॥84॥

text: tamatvarantaṃ palitaṃ pāśānāṃ chedane tadā । sañcodayitumārebhe mārjāro mūṣakaṃ tadā ॥85॥
html:
tamatvarantaṃ palitaṃ pāśānāṃ chedane tadā ।
sañcodayitumārebhe mārjāro mūṣakaṃ tadā ॥85॥
slp1: tamatvarantaM palitaM pASAnAM Cedane tadA । saYcodayitumAreBe mArjAro mUzakaM tadA ॥85॥

text: kiṃ saumya nābhitvarase kiṃ kṛtārtho'vamanyase । chindhi pāśānamitraghna purā śvapaca eti saḥ ॥86॥
html:
kiṃ saumya nābhitvarase kiṃ kṛtārtho'vamanyase ।
chindhi pāśānamitraghna purā śvapaca eti saḥ ॥86॥
slp1: kiM sOmya nABitvarase kiM kftArTo'vamanyase । CinDi pASAnamitraGna purA Svapaca eti saH ॥86॥

text: ityuktastvaratā tena matimānpalito'bravīt । mārjāramakṛtaprajñaṃ vaśyamātmahitaṃ vacaḥ ॥87॥
html:
ityuktastvaratā tena matimānpalito'bravīt ।
mārjāramakṛtaprajñaṃ vaśyamātmahitaṃ vacaḥ ॥87॥
slp1: ityuktastvaratA tena matimAnpalito'bravIt । mArjAramakftaprajYaM vaSyamAtmahitaM vacaH ॥87॥

text: tūṣṇīṃ bhava na te saumya tvarā kāryā na sambhramaḥ । vayamevātra kālajñā na kālaḥ parihāsyate ॥88॥
html:
tūṣṇīṃ bhava na te saumya tvarā kāryā na sambhramaḥ ।
vayamevātra kālajñā na kālaḥ parihāsyate ॥88॥
slp1: tUzRIM Bava na te sOmya tvarA kAryA na samBramaH । vayamevAtra kAlajYA na kAlaH parihAsyate ॥88॥

text: akāle kṛtyamārabdhaṃ kartuṃ nārthāya kalpate । tadeva kāla ārabdhaṃ mahate'rthāya kalpate ॥89॥
html:
akāle kṛtyamārabdhaṃ kartuṃ nārthāya kalpate ।
tadeva kāla ārabdhaṃ mahate'rthāya kalpate ॥89॥
slp1: akAle kftyamArabDaM kartuM nArTAya kalpate । tadeva kAla ArabDaM mahate'rTAya kalpate ॥89॥

text: akālavipramuktānme tvatta eva bhayaṃ bhavet । tasmātkālaṃ pratīkṣasva kimiti tvarase sakhe ॥90॥
html:
akālavipramuktānme tvatta eva bhayaṃ bhavet ।
tasmātkālaṃ pratīkṣasva kimiti tvarase sakhe ॥90॥
slp1: akAlavipramuktAnme tvatta eva BayaM Bavet । tasmAtkAlaM pratIkzasva kimiti tvarase saKe ॥90॥

text: yāvatpaśyāmi caṇḍālamāyāntaṃ śastrapāṇinam । tataśchetsyāmi te pāśaṃ prāpte sādhāraṇe bhaye ॥91॥
html:
yāvatpaśyāmi caṇḍālamāyāntaṃ śastrapāṇinam ।
tataśchetsyāmi te pāśaṃ prāpte sādhāraṇe bhaye ॥91॥
slp1: yAvatpaSyAmi caRqAlamAyAntaM SastrapARinam । tataSCetsyAmi te pASaM prApte sADAraRe Baye ॥91॥

text: tasminkāle pramuktastvaṃ tarumevādhirohasi । na hi te jīvitādanyatkiñcitkṛtyaṃ bhaviṣyati ॥92॥
html:
tasminkāle pramuktastvaṃ tarumevādhirohasi ।
na hi te jīvitādanyatkiñcitkṛtyaṃ bhaviṣyati ॥92॥
slp1: tasminkAle pramuktastvaM tarumevADirohasi । na hi te jIvitAdanyatkiYcitkftyaM Bavizyati ॥92॥

text: tato bhavatyatikrānte traste bhīte ca lomaśa । ahaṃ bilaṃ pravekṣyāmi bhavāñśākhāṃ gamiṣyati ॥93॥
html:
tato bhavatyatikrānte traste bhīte ca lomaśa ।
ahaṃ bilaṃ pravekṣyāmi bhavāñśākhāṃ gamiṣyati ॥93॥
slp1: tato BavatyatikrAnte traste BIte ca lomaSa । ahaM bilaM pravekzyAmi BavAYSAKAM gamizyati ॥93॥

text: evamuktastu mārjāro mūṣakeṇātmano hitam । vacanaṃ vākyatattvajño jīvitārthī mahāmatiḥ ॥94॥
html:
evamuktastu mārjāro mūṣakeṇātmano hitam ।
vacanaṃ vākyatattvajño jīvitārthī mahāmatiḥ ॥94॥
slp1: evamuktastu mArjAro mUzakeRAtmano hitam । vacanaM vAkyatattvajYo jIvitArTI mahAmatiH ॥94॥

text: athātmakṛtyatvaritaḥ samyakpraśrayamācaran । uvāca lomaśo vākyaṃ mūṣakaṃ cirakāriṇam ॥95॥
html:
athātmakṛtyatvaritaḥ samyakpraśrayamācaran ।
uvāca lomaśo vākyaṃ mūṣakaṃ cirakāriṇam ॥95॥
slp1: aTAtmakftyatvaritaH samyakpraSrayamAcaran । uvAca lomaSo vAkyaM mUzakaM cirakAriRam ॥95॥

text: na hyevaṃ mitrakāryāṇi prītyā kurvanti sādhavaḥ । yathā tvaṃ mokṣitaḥ kṛcchrāttvaramāṇena vai mayā ॥96॥
html:
na hyevaṃ mitrakāryāṇi prītyā kurvanti sādhavaḥ ।
yathā tvaṃ mokṣitaḥ kṛcchrāttvaramāṇena vai mayā ॥96॥
slp1: na hyevaM mitrakAryARi prItyA kurvanti sADavaH । yaTA tvaM mokzitaH kfcCrAttvaramARena vE mayA ॥96॥

text: tathaiva tvaramāṇena tvayā kāryaṃ hitaṃ mama । yatnaṃ kuru mahāprājña yathā svastyāvayorbhavet ॥97॥
html:
tathaiva tvaramāṇena tvayā kāryaṃ hitaṃ mama ।
yatnaṃ kuru mahāprājña yathā svastyāvayorbhavet ॥97॥
slp1: taTEva tvaramARena tvayA kAryaM hitaM mama । yatnaM kuru mahAprAjYa yaTA svastyAvayorBavet ॥97॥

text: atha vā pūrvavairaṃ tvaṃ smarankālaṃ vikarṣasi । paśya duṣkṛtakarmatvaṃ vyaktamāyuḥkṣayo mama ॥98॥
html:
atha vā pūrvavairaṃ tvaṃ smarankālaṃ vikarṣasi ।
paśya duṣkṛtakarmatvaṃ vyaktamāyuḥkṣayo mama ॥98॥
slp1: aTa vA pUrvavEraM tvaM smarankAlaM vikarzasi । paSya duzkftakarmatvaM vyaktamAyuHkzayo mama ॥98॥

text: yacca kiñcinmayājñānātpurastādvipriyaṃ kṛtam । na tanmanasi kartavyaṃ kṣamaye tvāṃ prasīda me ॥99॥
html:
yacca kiñcinmayājñānātpurastādvipriyaṃ kṛtam ।
na tanmanasi kartavyaṃ kṣamaye tvāṃ prasīda me ॥99॥
slp1: yacca kiYcinmayAjYAnAtpurastAdvipriyaM kftam । na tanmanasi kartavyaM kzamaye tvAM prasIda me ॥99॥

text: tamevaṃvādinaṃ prājñaḥ śāstravidbuddhisammataḥ । uvācedaṃ vacaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ mārjāraṃ mūṣakastadā ॥100॥
html:
tamevaṃvādinaṃ prājñaḥ śāstravidbuddhisammataḥ ।
uvācedaṃ vacaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ mārjāraṃ mūṣakastadā ॥100॥
slp1: tamevaMvAdinaM prAjYaH SAstravidbudDisammataH । uvAcedaM vacaH SrezWaM mArjAraM mUzakastadA ॥100॥

text: śrutaṃ me tava mārjāra svamarthaṃ parigṛhṇataḥ । mamāpi tvaṃ vijānīhi svamarthaṃ parigṛhṇataḥ ॥101॥
html:
śrutaṃ me tava mārjāra svamarthaṃ parigṛhṇataḥ ।
mamāpi tvaṃ vijānīhi svamarthaṃ parigṛhṇataḥ ॥101॥
slp1: SrutaM me tava mArjAra svamarTaM parigfhRataH । mamApi tvaM vijAnIhi svamarTaM parigfhRataH ॥101॥

text: yanmitraṃ bhītavatsādhyaṃ yanmitraṃ bhayasaṃhitam । surakṣitaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ pāṇiḥ sarpamukhādiva ॥102॥
html:
yanmitraṃ bhītavatsādhyaṃ yanmitraṃ bhayasaṃhitam ।
surakṣitaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ pāṇiḥ sarpamukhādiva ॥102॥
slp1: yanmitraM BItavatsADyaM yanmitraM BayasaMhitam । surakzitaM tataH kAryaM pARiH sarpamuKAdiva ॥102॥

text: kṛtvā balavatā sandhimātmānaṃ yo na rakṣati । apathyamiva tadbhuktaṃ tasyānarthāya kalpate ॥103॥
html:
kṛtvā balavatā sandhimātmānaṃ yo na rakṣati ।
apathyamiva tadbhuktaṃ tasyānarthāya kalpate ॥103॥
slp1: kftvA balavatA sanDimAtmAnaM yo na rakzati । apaTyamiva tadBuktaM tasyAnarTAya kalpate ॥103॥

text: na kaścitkasyacinmitraṃ na kaścitkasyacitsuhṛt । arthairarthā nibadhyante gajairvanagajā iva ॥104॥
html:
na kaścitkasyacinmitraṃ na kaścitkasyacitsuhṛt ।
arthairarthā nibadhyante gajairvanagajā iva ॥104॥
slp1: na kaScitkasyacinmitraM na kaScitkasyacitsuhft । arTErarTA nibaDyante gajErvanagajA iva ॥104॥

text: na hi kaścitkṛte kārye kartāraṃ samavekṣate । tasmātsarvāṇi kāryāṇi sāvaśeṣāṇi kārayet ॥105॥
html:
na hi kaścitkṛte kārye kartāraṃ samavekṣate ।
tasmātsarvāṇi kāryāṇi sāvaśeṣāṇi kārayet ॥105॥
slp1: na hi kaScitkfte kArye kartAraM samavekzate । tasmAtsarvARi kAryARi sAvaSezARi kArayet ॥105॥

text: tasminkāle'pi ca bhavāndivākīrtibhayānvitaḥ । mama na grahaṇe śaktaḥ palāyanaparāyaṇaḥ ॥106॥
html:
tasminkāle'pi ca bhavāndivākīrtibhayānvitaḥ ।
mama na grahaṇe śaktaḥ palāyanaparāyaṇaḥ ॥106॥
slp1: tasminkAle'pi ca BavAndivAkIrtiBayAnvitaH । mama na grahaRe SaktaH palAyanaparAyaRaH ॥106॥

text: chinnaṃ tu tantubāhulyaṃ tantureko'vaśeṣitaḥ । chetsyāmyahaṃ tadapyāśu nirvṛto bhava lomaśa ॥107॥
html:
chinnaṃ tu tantubāhulyaṃ tantureko'vaśeṣitaḥ ।
chetsyāmyahaṃ tadapyāśu nirvṛto bhava lomaśa ॥107॥
slp1: CinnaM tu tantubAhulyaM tantureko'vaSezitaH । CetsyAmyahaM tadapyASu nirvfto Bava lomaSa ॥107॥

text: tayoḥ saṃvadatorevaṃ tathaivāpannayordvayoḥ । kṣayaṃ jagāma sā rātrirlomaśaṃ cāviśadbhayam ॥108॥
html:
tayoḥ saṃvadatorevaṃ tathaivāpannayordvayoḥ ।
kṣayaṃ jagāma sā rātrirlomaśaṃ cāviśadbhayam ॥108॥
slp1: tayoH saMvadatorevaM taTEvApannayordvayoH । kzayaM jagAma sA rAtrirlomaSaM cAviSadBayam ॥108॥

text: tataḥ prabhātasamaye vikṛtaḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgalaḥ । sthūlasphigvikaco rūkṣaḥ śvacakraparivāritaḥ ॥109॥
html:
tataḥ prabhātasamaye vikṛtaḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgalaḥ ।
sthūlasphigvikaco rūkṣaḥ śvacakraparivāritaḥ ॥109॥
slp1: tataH praBAtasamaye vikftaH kfzRapiNgalaH । sTUlasPigvikaco rUkzaH SvacakraparivAritaH ॥109॥

text: śaṅkukarṇo mahāvaktraḥ palito ghoradarśanaḥ । parigho nāma caṇḍālaḥ śastrapāṇiradṛśyata ॥110॥
html:
śaṅkukarṇo mahāvaktraḥ palito ghoradarśanaḥ ।
parigho nāma caṇḍālaḥ śastrapāṇiradṛśyata ॥110॥
slp1: SaNkukarRo mahAvaktraH palito GoradarSanaH । pariGo nAma caRqAlaH SastrapARiradfSyata ॥110॥

text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā yamadūtābhaṃ mārjārastrastacetanaḥ । uvāca palitaṃ bhītaḥ kimidānīṃ kariṣyasi ॥111॥
html:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā yamadūtābhaṃ mārjārastrastacetanaḥ ।
uvāca palitaṃ bhītaḥ kimidānīṃ kariṣyasi ॥111॥
slp1: taM dfzwvA yamadUtABaM mArjArastrastacetanaH । uvAca palitaM BItaH kimidAnIM karizyasi ॥111॥

text: atha cāpi susantrastau taṃ dṛṣṭvā ghoradarśanam । kṣaṇena nakulolūkau nairāśyaṃ jagmatustadā ॥112॥
html:
atha cāpi susantrastau taṃ dṛṣṭvā ghoradarśanam ।
kṣaṇena nakulolūkau nairāśyaṃ jagmatustadā ॥112॥
slp1: aTa cApi susantrastO taM dfzwvA GoradarSanam । kzaRena nakulolUkO nErASyaM jagmatustadA ॥112॥

text: balinau matimantau ca saṅghātaṃ cāpyupāgatau । aśakyau sunayāttasmātsampradharṣayituṃ balāt ॥113॥
html:
balinau matimantau ca saṅghātaṃ cāpyupāgatau ।
aśakyau sunayāttasmātsampradharṣayituṃ balāt ॥113॥
slp1: balinO matimantO ca saNGAtaM cApyupAgatO । aSakyO sunayAttasmAtsampraDarzayituM balAt ॥113॥

text: kāryārthaṃ kṛtasandhī tau dṛṣṭvā mārjāramūṣakau । ulūkanakulau tūrṇaṃ jagmatuḥ svaṃ svamālayam ॥114॥
html:
kāryārthaṃ kṛtasandhī tau dṛṣṭvā mārjāramūṣakau ।
ulūkanakulau tūrṇaṃ jagmatuḥ svaṃ svamālayam ॥114॥
slp1: kAryArTaM kftasanDI tO dfzwvA mArjAramUzakO । ulUkanakulO tUrRaM jagmatuH svaM svamAlayam ॥114॥

text: tataściccheda taṃ tantuṃ mārjārasya sa mūṣakaḥ । vipramukto'tha mārjārastamevābhyapataddrumam ॥115॥
html:
tataściccheda taṃ tantuṃ mārjārasya sa mūṣakaḥ ।
vipramukto'tha mārjārastamevābhyapataddrumam ॥115॥
slp1: tataScicCeda taM tantuM mArjArasya sa mUzakaH । vipramukto'Ta mArjArastamevAByapataddrumam ॥115॥

text: sa ca tasmādbhayānmukto mukto ghoreṇa śatruṇā । bilaṃ viveśa palitaḥ śākhāṃ bheje ca lomaśaḥ ॥116॥
html:
sa ca tasmādbhayānmukto mukto ghoreṇa śatruṇā ।
bilaṃ viveśa palitaḥ śākhāṃ bheje ca lomaśaḥ ॥116॥
slp1: sa ca tasmAdBayAnmukto mukto GoreRa SatruRA । bilaM viveSa palitaH SAKAM Beje ca lomaSaH ॥116॥

text: unmāthamapyathādāya caṇḍālo vīkṣya sarvaśaḥ । vihatāśaḥ kṣaṇenātha tasmāddeśādapākramat । jagāma ca svabhavanaṃ caṇḍālo bharatarṣabha ॥117॥
html:
unmāthamapyathādāya caṇḍālo vīkṣya sarvaśaḥ ।
vihatāśaḥ kṣaṇenātha tasmāddeśādapākramat ।
jagāma ca svabhavanaṃ caṇḍālo bharatarṣabha ॥117॥
slp1: unmATamapyaTAdAya caRqAlo vIkzya sarvaSaH । vihatASaH kzaRenATa tasmAddeSAdapAkramat । jagAma ca svaBavanaM caRqAlo BaratarzaBa ॥117॥

text: tatastasmādbhayānmukto durlabhaṃ prāpya jīvitam । bilasthaṃ pādapāgrasthaḥ palitaṃ lomaśo'bravīt ॥118॥
html:
tatastasmādbhayānmukto durlabhaṃ prāpya jīvitam ।
bilasthaṃ pādapāgrasthaḥ palitaṃ lomaśo'bravīt ॥118॥
slp1: tatastasmAdBayAnmukto durlaBaM prApya jIvitam । bilasTaM pAdapAgrasTaH palitaM lomaSo'bravIt ॥118॥

text: akṛtvā saṃvidaṃ kāñcitsahasāhamupaplutaḥ । kṛtajñaṃ kṛtakalyāṇaṃ kaccinmāṃ nābhiśaṅkase ॥119॥
html:
akṛtvā saṃvidaṃ kāñcitsahasāhamupaplutaḥ ।
kṛtajñaṃ kṛtakalyāṇaṃ kaccinmāṃ nābhiśaṅkase ॥119॥
slp1: akftvA saMvidaM kAYcitsahasAhamupaplutaH । kftajYaM kftakalyARaM kaccinmAM nABiSaNkase ॥119॥

text: gatvā ca mama viśvāsaṃ dattvā ca mama jīvitam । mitropabhogasamaye kiṃ tvaṃ naivopasarpasi ॥120॥
html:
gatvā ca mama viśvāsaṃ dattvā ca mama jīvitam ।
mitropabhogasamaye kiṃ tvaṃ naivopasarpasi ॥120॥
slp1: gatvA ca mama viSvAsaM dattvA ca mama jIvitam । mitropaBogasamaye kiM tvaM nEvopasarpasi ॥120॥

text: kṛtvā hi pūrvaṃ mitrāṇi yaḥ paścānnānutiṣṭhati । na sa mitrāṇi labhate kṛcchrāsvāpatsu durmatiḥ ॥121॥
html:
kṛtvā hi pūrvaṃ mitrāṇi yaḥ paścānnānutiṣṭhati ।
na sa mitrāṇi labhate kṛcchrāsvāpatsu durmatiḥ ॥121॥
slp1: kftvA hi pUrvaM mitrARi yaH paScAnnAnutizWati । na sa mitrARi laBate kfcCrAsvApatsu durmatiH ॥121॥

text: tatkṛto'haṃ tvayā mitraṃ sāmarthyādātmanaḥ sakhe । sa māṃ mitratvamāpannamupabhoktuṃ tvamarhasi ॥122॥
html:
tatkṛto'haṃ tvayā mitraṃ sāmarthyādātmanaḥ sakhe ।
sa māṃ mitratvamāpannamupabhoktuṃ tvamarhasi ॥122॥
slp1: tatkfto'haM tvayA mitraM sAmarTyAdAtmanaH saKe । sa mAM mitratvamApannamupaBoktuM tvamarhasi ॥122॥

text: yāni me santi mitrāṇi ye ca me santi bāndhavāḥ । sarve tvāṃ pūjayiṣyanti śiṣyā gurumiva priyam ॥123॥
html:
yāni me santi mitrāṇi ye ca me santi bāndhavāḥ ।
sarve tvāṃ pūjayiṣyanti śiṣyā gurumiva priyam ॥123॥
slp1: yAni me santi mitrARi ye ca me santi bAnDavAH । sarve tvAM pUjayizyanti SizyA gurumiva priyam ॥123॥

text: ahaṃ ca pūjayiṣye tvāṃ samitragaṇabāndhavam । jīvitasya pradātāraṃ kṛtajñaḥ ko na pūjayet ॥124॥
html:
ahaṃ ca pūjayiṣye tvāṃ samitragaṇabāndhavam ।
jīvitasya pradātāraṃ kṛtajñaḥ ko na pūjayet ॥124॥
slp1: ahaM ca pUjayizye tvAM samitragaRabAnDavam । jIvitasya pradAtAraM kftajYaH ko na pUjayet ॥124॥

text: īśvaro me bhavānastu śarīrasya gṛhasya ca । arthānāṃ caiva sarveṣāmanuśāstā ca me bhava ॥125॥
html:
īśvaro me bhavānastu śarīrasya gṛhasya ca ।
arthānāṃ caiva sarveṣāmanuśāstā ca me bhava ॥125॥
slp1: ISvaro me BavAnastu SarIrasya gfhasya ca । arTAnAM cEva sarvezAmanuSAstA ca me Bava ॥125॥

text: amātyo me bhava prājña piteva hi praśādhi mām । na te'sti bhayamasmatto jīvitenātmanaḥ śape ॥126॥
html:
amātyo me bhava prājña piteva hi praśādhi mām ।
na te'sti bhayamasmatto jīvitenātmanaḥ śape ॥126॥
slp1: amAtyo me Bava prAjYa piteva hi praSADi mAm । na te'sti Bayamasmatto jIvitenAtmanaH Sape ॥126॥

text: buddhyā tvamuśanāḥ sākṣādbale tvadhikṛtā vayam । tvanmantrabalayukto hi vindeta jayameva ha ॥127॥
html:
buddhyā tvamuśanāḥ sākṣādbale tvadhikṛtā vayam ।
tvanmantrabalayukto hi vindeta jayameva ha ॥127॥
slp1: budDyA tvamuSanAH sAkzAdbale tvaDikftA vayam । tvanmantrabalayukto hi vindeta jayameva ha ॥127॥

text: evamuktaḥ paraṃ sāntvaṃ mārjāreṇa sa mūṣakaḥ । uvāca paramārthajñaḥ ślakṣṇamātmahitaṃ vacaḥ ॥128॥
html:
evamuktaḥ paraṃ sāntvaṃ mārjāreṇa sa mūṣakaḥ ।
uvāca paramārthajñaḥ ślakṣṇamātmahitaṃ vacaḥ ॥128॥
slp1: evamuktaH paraM sAntvaM mArjAreRa sa mUzakaH । uvAca paramArTajYaH SlakzRamAtmahitaM vacaH ॥128॥

text: yadbhavānāha tatsarvaṃ mayā te lomaśa śrutam । mamāpi tāvadbruvataḥ śṛṇu yatpratibhāti mām ॥129॥
html:
yadbhavānāha tatsarvaṃ mayā te lomaśa śrutam ।
mamāpi tāvadbruvataḥ śṛṇu yatpratibhāti mām ॥129॥
slp1: yadBavAnAha tatsarvaM mayA te lomaSa Srutam । mamApi tAvadbruvataH SfRu yatpratiBAti mAm ॥129॥

text: veditavyāni mitrāṇi boddhavyāścāpi śatravaḥ । etatsusūkṣmaṃ loke'smindṛśyate prājñasammatam ॥130॥
html:
veditavyāni mitrāṇi boddhavyāścāpi śatravaḥ ।
etatsusūkṣmaṃ loke'smindṛśyate prājñasammatam ॥130॥
slp1: veditavyAni mitrARi bodDavyAScApi SatravaH । etatsusUkzmaM loke'smindfSyate prAjYasammatam ॥130॥

text: śatrurūpāśca suhṛdo mitrarūpāśca śatravaḥ । sāntvitāste na budhyante rāgalobhavaśaṃ gatāḥ ॥131॥
html:
śatrurūpāśca suhṛdo mitrarūpāśca śatravaḥ ।
sāntvitāste na budhyante rāgalobhavaśaṃ gatāḥ ॥131॥
slp1: SatrurUpASca suhfdo mitrarUpASca SatravaH । sAntvitAste na buDyante rAgaloBavaSaM gatAH ॥131॥

text: nāsti jātyā ripurnāma mitraṃ nāma na vidyate । sāmarthyayogājjāyante mitrāṇi ripavastathā ॥132॥
html:
nāsti jātyā ripurnāma mitraṃ nāma na vidyate ।
sāmarthyayogājjāyante mitrāṇi ripavastathā ॥132॥
slp1: nAsti jAtyA ripurnAma mitraM nAma na vidyate । sAmarTyayogAjjAyante mitrARi ripavastaTA ॥132॥

text: yo yasmiñjīvati svārthaṃ paśyettāvatsa jīvati । sa tasya tāvanmitraṃ syādyāvanna syādviparyayaḥ ॥133॥
html:
yo yasmiñjīvati svārthaṃ paśyettāvatsa jīvati ।
sa tasya tāvanmitraṃ syādyāvanna syādviparyayaḥ ॥133॥
slp1: yo yasmiYjIvati svArTaM paSyettAvatsa jIvati । sa tasya tAvanmitraM syAdyAvanna syAdviparyayaH ॥133॥

text: nāsti maitrī sthirā nāma na ca dhruvamasauhṛdam । arthayuktyā hi jāyante mitrāṇi ripavastathā ॥134॥
html:
nāsti maitrī sthirā nāma na ca dhruvamasauhṛdam ।
arthayuktyā hi jāyante mitrāṇi ripavastathā ॥134॥
slp1: nAsti mEtrI sTirA nAma na ca DruvamasOhfdam । arTayuktyA hi jAyante mitrARi ripavastaTA ॥134॥

text: mitraṃ ca śatrutāmeti kasmiṃścitkālaparyaye । śatruśca mitratāmeti svārtho hi balavattaraḥ ॥135॥
html:
mitraṃ ca śatrutāmeti kasmiṃścitkālaparyaye ।
śatruśca mitratāmeti svārtho hi balavattaraḥ ॥135॥
slp1: mitraM ca SatrutAmeti kasmiMScitkAlaparyaye । SatruSca mitratAmeti svArTo hi balavattaraH ॥135॥

text: yo viśvasati mitreṣu na cāśvasati śatruṣu । arthayuktimavijñāya calitaṃ tasya jīvitam ॥136॥
html:
yo viśvasati mitreṣu na cāśvasati śatruṣu ।
arthayuktimavijñāya calitaṃ tasya jīvitam ॥136॥
slp1: yo viSvasati mitrezu na cASvasati Satruzu । arTayuktimavijYAya calitaM tasya jIvitam ॥136॥

text: arthayuktimavijñāya yaḥ śubhe kurute matim । mitre vā yadi vā śatrau tasyāpi calitā matiḥ ॥137॥
html:
arthayuktimavijñāya yaḥ śubhe kurute matim ।
mitre vā yadi vā śatrau tasyāpi calitā matiḥ ॥137॥
slp1: arTayuktimavijYAya yaH SuBe kurute matim । mitre vA yadi vA SatrO tasyApi calitA matiH ॥137॥

text: na viśvasedaviśvaste viśvaste'pi na viśvaset । viśvāsādbhayamutpannaṃ mūlānyapi nikṛntati ॥138॥
html:
na viśvasedaviśvaste viśvaste'pi na viśvaset ।
viśvāsādbhayamutpannaṃ mūlānyapi nikṛntati ॥138॥
slp1: na viSvasedaviSvaste viSvaste'pi na viSvaset । viSvAsAdBayamutpannaM mUlAnyapi nikfntati ॥138॥

text: arthayuktyā hi dṛśyante pitā mātā sutāstathā । mātulā bhāgineyāśca tathā sambandhibāndhavāḥ ॥139॥
html:
arthayuktyā hi dṛśyante pitā mātā sutāstathā ।
mātulā bhāgineyāśca tathā sambandhibāndhavāḥ ॥139॥
slp1: arTayuktyA hi dfSyante pitA mAtA sutAstaTA । mAtulA BAgineyASca taTA sambanDibAnDavAH ॥139॥

text: putraṃ hi mātāpitarau tyajataḥ patitaṃ priyam । loko rakṣati cātmānaṃ paśya svārthasya sāratām ॥140॥
html:
putraṃ hi mātāpitarau tyajataḥ patitaṃ priyam ।
loko rakṣati cātmānaṃ paśya svārthasya sāratām ॥140॥
slp1: putraM hi mAtApitarO tyajataH patitaM priyam । loko rakzati cAtmAnaM paSya svArTasya sAratAm ॥140॥

text: taṃ manye nikṛtiprajñaṃ yo mokṣaṃ pratyanantaram । kṛtyaṃ mṛgayase kartuṃ sukhopāyamasaṃśayam ॥141॥
html:
taṃ manye nikṛtiprajñaṃ yo mokṣaṃ pratyanantaram ।
kṛtyaṃ mṛgayase kartuṃ sukhopāyamasaṃśayam ॥141॥
slp1: taM manye nikftiprajYaM yo mokzaM pratyanantaram । kftyaM mfgayase kartuM suKopAyamasaMSayam ॥141॥

text: asminnilaya eva tvaṃ nyagrodhādavatāritaḥ । pūrvaṃ niviṣṭamunmāthaṃ capalatvānna buddhavān ॥142॥
html:
asminnilaya eva tvaṃ nyagrodhādavatāritaḥ ।
pūrvaṃ niviṣṭamunmāthaṃ capalatvānna buddhavān ॥142॥
slp1: asminnilaya eva tvaM nyagroDAdavatAritaH । pUrvaM nivizwamunmATaM capalatvAnna budDavAn ॥142॥

text: ātmanaścapalo nāsti kuto'nyeṣāṃ bhaviṣyati । tasmātsarvāṇi kāryāṇi capalo hantyasaṃśayam ॥143॥
html:
ātmanaścapalo nāsti kuto'nyeṣāṃ bhaviṣyati ।
tasmātsarvāṇi kāryāṇi capalo hantyasaṃśayam ॥143॥
slp1: AtmanaScapalo nAsti kuto'nyezAM Bavizyati । tasmAtsarvARi kAryARi capalo hantyasaMSayam ॥143॥

text: bravīti madhuraṃ kañcitpriyo me ha bhavāniti । tanmithyākaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ vistareṇāpi me śṛṇu ॥144॥
html:
bravīti madhuraṃ kañcitpriyo me ha bhavāniti ।
tanmithyākaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ vistareṇāpi me śṛṇu ॥144॥
slp1: bravIti maDuraM kaYcitpriyo me ha BavAniti । tanmiTyAkaraRaM sarvaM vistareRApi me SfRu ॥144॥

text: kāraṇātpriyatāmeti dveṣyo bhavati kāraṇāt । arthārthī jīvaloko'yaṃ na kaścitkasyacitpriyaḥ ॥145॥
html:
kāraṇātpriyatāmeti dveṣyo bhavati kāraṇāt ।
arthārthī jīvaloko'yaṃ na kaścitkasyacitpriyaḥ ॥145॥
slp1: kAraRAtpriyatAmeti dvezyo Bavati kAraRAt । arTArTI jIvaloko'yaM na kaScitkasyacitpriyaH ॥145॥

text: sakhyaṃ sodarayorbhrātrordampatyorvā parasparam । kasyacinnābhijānāmi prītiṃ niṣkāraṇāmiha ॥146॥
html:
sakhyaṃ sodarayorbhrātrordampatyorvā parasparam ।
kasyacinnābhijānāmi prītiṃ niṣkāraṇāmiha ॥146॥
slp1: saKyaM sodarayorBrAtrordampatyorvA parasparam । kasyacinnABijAnAmi prItiM nizkAraRAmiha ॥146॥

text: yadyapi bhrātaraḥ kruddhā bhāryā vā kāraṇāntare । svabhāvataste prīyante netaraḥ prīyate janaḥ ॥147॥
html:
yadyapi bhrātaraḥ kruddhā bhāryā vā kāraṇāntare ।
svabhāvataste prīyante netaraḥ prīyate janaḥ ॥147॥
slp1: yadyapi BrAtaraH krudDA BAryA vA kAraRAntare । svaBAvataste prIyante netaraH prIyate janaH ॥147॥

text: priyo bhavati dānena priyavādena cāparaḥ । mantrahomajapairanyaḥ kāryārthaṃ prīyate janaḥ ॥148॥
html:
priyo bhavati dānena priyavādena cāparaḥ ।
mantrahomajapairanyaḥ kāryārthaṃ prīyate janaḥ ॥148॥
slp1: priyo Bavati dAnena priyavAdena cAparaH । mantrahomajapEranyaH kAryArTaM prIyate janaH ॥148॥

text: utpanne kāraṇe prītirnāsti nau kāraṇāntare । pradhvaste kāraṇasthāne sā prītirvinivartate ॥149॥
html:
utpanne kāraṇe prītirnāsti nau kāraṇāntare ।
pradhvaste kāraṇasthāne sā prītirvinivartate ॥149॥
slp1: utpanne kAraRe prItirnAsti nO kAraRAntare । praDvaste kAraRasTAne sA prItirvinivartate ॥149॥

text: kiṃ nu tatkāraṇaṃ manye yenāhaṃ bhavataḥ priyaḥ । anyatrābhyavahārārthāttatrāpi ca budhā vayam ॥150॥
html:
kiṃ nu tatkāraṇaṃ manye yenāhaṃ bhavataḥ priyaḥ ।
anyatrābhyavahārārthāttatrāpi ca budhā vayam ॥150॥
slp1: kiM nu tatkAraRaM manye yenAhaM BavataH priyaH । anyatrAByavahArArTAttatrApi ca buDA vayam ॥150॥

text: kālo hetuṃ vikurute svārthastamanuvartate । svārthaṃ prājño'bhijānāti prājñaṃ loko'nuvartate ॥151॥
html:
kālo hetuṃ vikurute svārthastamanuvartate ।
svārthaṃ prājño'bhijānāti prājñaṃ loko'nuvartate ॥151॥
slp1: kAlo hetuM vikurute svArTastamanuvartate । svArTaM prAjYo'BijAnAti prAjYaM loko'nuvartate ॥151॥

text: na tvīdṛśaṃ tvayā vācyaṃ viduṣi svārthapaṇḍite । akāle'viṣamasthasya svārthaheturayaṃ tava ॥152॥
html:
na tvīdṛśaṃ tvayā vācyaṃ viduṣi svārthapaṇḍite ।
akāle'viṣamasthasya svārthaheturayaṃ tava ॥152॥
slp1: na tvIdfSaM tvayA vAcyaM viduzi svArTapaRqite । akAle'vizamasTasya svArTaheturayaM tava ॥152॥

text: tasmānnāhaṃ cale svārthātsusthitaḥ sandhivigrahe । abhrāṇāmiva rūpāṇi vikurvanti kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ॥153॥
html:
tasmānnāhaṃ cale svārthātsusthitaḥ sandhivigrahe ।
abhrāṇāmiva rūpāṇi vikurvanti kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ॥153॥
slp1: tasmAnnAhaM cale svArTAtsusTitaH sanDivigrahe । aBrARAmiva rUpARi vikurvanti kzaRe kzaRe ॥153॥

text: adyaiva hi ripurbhūtvā punaradyaiva sauhṛdam । punaśca ripuradyaiva yuktīnāṃ paśya cāpalam ॥154॥
html:
adyaiva hi ripurbhūtvā punaradyaiva sauhṛdam ।
punaśca ripuradyaiva yuktīnāṃ paśya cāpalam ॥154॥
slp1: adyEva hi ripurBUtvA punaradyEva sOhfdam । punaSca ripuradyEva yuktInAM paSya cApalam ॥154॥

text: āsīttāvattu maitrī nau yāvaddheturabhūtpurā । sā gatā saha tenaiva kālayuktena hetunā ॥155॥
html:
āsīttāvattu maitrī nau yāvaddheturabhūtpurā ।
sā gatā saha tenaiva kālayuktena hetunā ॥155॥
slp1: AsIttAvattu mEtrI nO yAvadDeturaBUtpurA । sA gatA saha tenEva kAlayuktena hetunA ॥155॥

text: tvaṃ hi me'tyantataḥ śatruḥ sāmarthyānmitratāṃ gataḥ । tatkṛtyamabhinirvṛttaṃ prakṛtiḥ śatrutāṃ gatā ॥156॥
html:
tvaṃ hi me'tyantataḥ śatruḥ sāmarthyānmitratāṃ gataḥ ।
tatkṛtyamabhinirvṛttaṃ prakṛtiḥ śatrutāṃ gatā ॥156॥
slp1: tvaM hi me'tyantataH SatruH sAmarTyAnmitratAM gataH । tatkftyamaBinirvfttaM prakftiH SatrutAM gatA ॥156॥

text: so'hamevaṃ praṇītāni jñātvā śāstrāṇi tattvataḥ । praviśeyaṃ kathaṃ pāśaṃ tvatkṛtaṃ tadvadasva me ॥157॥
html:
so'hamevaṃ praṇītāni jñātvā śāstrāṇi tattvataḥ ।
praviśeyaṃ kathaṃ pāśaṃ tvatkṛtaṃ tadvadasva me ॥157॥
slp1: so'hamevaM praRItAni jYAtvA SAstrARi tattvataH । praviSeyaM kaTaM pASaM tvatkftaM tadvadasva me ॥157॥

text: tvadvīryeṇa vimukto'haṃ madvīryeṇa tathā bhavān । anyonyānugrahe vṛtte nāsti bhūyaḥ samāgamaḥ ॥158॥
html:
tvadvīryeṇa vimukto'haṃ madvīryeṇa tathā bhavān ।
anyonyānugrahe vṛtte nāsti bhūyaḥ samāgamaḥ ॥158॥
slp1: tvadvIryeRa vimukto'haM madvIryeRa taTA BavAn । anyonyAnugrahe vftte nAsti BUyaH samAgamaH ॥158॥

text: tvaṃ hi saumya kṛtārtho'dya nirvṛttārthāstathā vayam । na te'styanyanmayā kṛtyaṃ kiñcidanyatra bhakṣaṇāt ॥159॥
html:
tvaṃ hi saumya kṛtārtho'dya nirvṛttārthāstathā vayam ।
na te'styanyanmayā kṛtyaṃ kiñcidanyatra bhakṣaṇāt ॥159॥
slp1: tvaM hi sOmya kftArTo'dya nirvfttArTAstaTA vayam । na te'styanyanmayA kftyaM kiYcidanyatra BakzaRAt ॥159॥

text: ahamannaṃ bhavānbhoktā durbalo'haṃ bhavānbalī । nāvayorvidyate sandhirniyukte viṣame bale ॥160॥
html:
ahamannaṃ bhavānbhoktā durbalo'haṃ bhavānbalī ।
nāvayorvidyate sandhirniyukte viṣame bale ॥160॥
slp1: ahamannaM BavAnBoktA durbalo'haM BavAnbalI । nAvayorvidyate sanDirniyukte vizame bale ॥160॥

text: sammanye'haṃ tava prajñāṃ yanmokṣātpratyanantaram । bhakṣyaṃ mṛgayase nūnaṃ sukhopāyamasaṃśayam ॥161॥
html:
sammanye'haṃ tava prajñāṃ yanmokṣātpratyanantaram ।
bhakṣyaṃ mṛgayase nūnaṃ sukhopāyamasaṃśayam ॥161॥
slp1: sammanye'haM tava prajYAM yanmokzAtpratyanantaram । BakzyaM mfgayase nUnaM suKopAyamasaMSayam ॥161॥

text: bhakṣyārthameva baddhastvaṃ sa muktaḥ prasṛtaḥ kṣudhā । śāstrajñamabhisandhāya nūnaṃ bhakṣayitādya mām ॥162॥
html:
bhakṣyārthameva baddhastvaṃ sa muktaḥ prasṛtaḥ kṣudhā ।
śāstrajñamabhisandhāya nūnaṃ bhakṣayitādya mām ॥162॥
slp1: BakzyArTameva badDastvaM sa muktaH prasftaH kzuDA । SAstrajYamaBisanDAya nUnaM BakzayitAdya mAm ॥162॥

text: jānāmi kṣudhitaṃ hi tvāmāhārasamayaśca te । sa tvaṃ māmabhisandhāya bhakṣyaṃ mṛgayase punaḥ ॥163॥
html:
jānāmi kṣudhitaṃ hi tvāmāhārasamayaśca te ।
sa tvaṃ māmabhisandhāya bhakṣyaṃ mṛgayase punaḥ ॥163॥
slp1: jAnAmi kzuDitaM hi tvAmAhArasamayaSca te । sa tvaM mAmaBisanDAya BakzyaM mfgayase punaH ॥163॥

text: yaccāpi putradāraṃ svaṃ tatsannisṛjase mayi । śuśrūṣāṃ nāma me kartuṃ sakhe mama na tatkṣamam ॥164॥
html:
yaccāpi putradāraṃ svaṃ tatsannisṛjase mayi ।
śuśrūṣāṃ nāma me kartuṃ sakhe mama na tatkṣamam ॥164॥
slp1: yaccApi putradAraM svaM tatsannisfjase mayi । SuSrUzAM nAma me kartuM saKe mama na tatkzamam ॥164॥

text: tvayā māṃ sahitaṃ dṛṣṭvā priyā bhāryā sutāśca ye । kasmānmāṃ te na khādeyurhṛṣṭāḥ praṇayinastvayi ॥165॥
html:
tvayā māṃ sahitaṃ dṛṣṭvā priyā bhāryā sutāśca ye ।
kasmānmāṃ te na khādeyurhṛṣṭāḥ praṇayinastvayi ॥165॥
slp1: tvayA mAM sahitaM dfzwvA priyA BAryA sutASca ye । kasmAnmAM te na KAdeyurhfzwAH praRayinastvayi ॥165॥

text: nāhaṃ tvayā sameṣyāmi vṛtto hetuḥ samāgame । śivaṃ dhyāyasva me'trasthaḥ sukṛtaṃ smaryate yadi ॥166॥
html:
nāhaṃ tvayā sameṣyāmi vṛtto hetuḥ samāgame ।
śivaṃ dhyāyasva me'trasthaḥ sukṛtaṃ smaryate yadi ॥166॥
slp1: nAhaM tvayA samezyAmi vftto hetuH samAgame । SivaM DyAyasva me'trasTaH sukftaM smaryate yadi ॥166॥

text: śatrorannādyabhūtaḥ sankliṣṭasya kṣudhitasya ca । bhakṣyaṃ mṛgayamāṇasya kaḥ prājño viṣayaṃ vrajet ॥167॥
html:
śatrorannādyabhūtaḥ sankliṣṭasya kṣudhitasya ca ।
bhakṣyaṃ mṛgayamāṇasya kaḥ prājño viṣayaṃ vrajet ॥167॥
slp1: SatrorannAdyaBUtaH sanklizwasya kzuDitasya ca । BakzyaM mfgayamARasya kaH prAjYo vizayaM vrajet ॥167॥

text: svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi dūrādapi tavodvije । nāhaṃ tvayā sameṣyāmi nirvṛto bhava lomaśa ॥168॥
html:
svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi dūrādapi tavodvije ।
nāhaṃ tvayā sameṣyāmi nirvṛto bhava lomaśa ॥168॥
slp1: svasti te'stu gamizyAmi dUrAdapi tavodvije । nAhaM tvayA samezyAmi nirvfto Bava lomaSa ॥168॥

text: balavatsannikarṣo hi na kadācitpraśasyate । praśāntādapi me prājña bhetavyaṃ balinaḥ sadā ॥169॥
html:
balavatsannikarṣo hi na kadācitpraśasyate ।
praśāntādapi me prājña bhetavyaṃ balinaḥ sadā ॥169॥
slp1: balavatsannikarzo hi na kadAcitpraSasyate । praSAntAdapi me prAjYa BetavyaM balinaH sadA ॥169॥

text: yadi tvarthena me kāryaṃ brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te । kāmaṃ sarvaṃ pradāsyāmi na tvātmānaṃ kadācana ॥170॥
html:
yadi tvarthena me kāryaṃ brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te ।
kāmaṃ sarvaṃ pradāsyāmi na tvātmānaṃ kadācana ॥170॥
slp1: yadi tvarTena me kAryaM brUhi kiM karavARi te । kAmaM sarvaM pradAsyAmi na tvAtmAnaM kadAcana ॥170॥

text: ātmārthe santatistyājyā rājyaṃ ratnaṃ dhanaṃ tathā । api sarvasvamutsṛjya rakṣedātmānamātmanā ॥171॥
html:
ātmārthe santatistyājyā rājyaṃ ratnaṃ dhanaṃ tathā ।
api sarvasvamutsṛjya rakṣedātmānamātmanā ॥171॥
slp1: AtmArTe santatistyAjyA rAjyaM ratnaM DanaM taTA । api sarvasvamutsfjya rakzedAtmAnamAtmanA ॥171॥

text: aiśvaryadhanaratnānāṃ pratyamitre'pi tiṣṭhatām । dṛṣṭā hi punarāvṛttirjīvatāmiti naḥ śrutam ॥172॥
html:
aiśvaryadhanaratnānāṃ pratyamitre'pi tiṣṭhatām ।
dṛṣṭā hi punarāvṛttirjīvatāmiti naḥ śrutam ॥172॥
slp1: ESvaryaDanaratnAnAM pratyamitre'pi tizWatAm । dfzwA hi punarAvfttirjIvatAmiti naH Srutam ॥172॥

text: na tvātmanaḥ sampradānaṃ dhanaratnavadiṣyate । ātmā tu sarvato rakṣyo dārairapi dhanairapi ॥173॥
html:
na tvātmanaḥ sampradānaṃ dhanaratnavadiṣyate ।
ātmā tu sarvato rakṣyo dārairapi dhanairapi ॥173॥
slp1: na tvAtmanaH sampradAnaM Danaratnavadizyate । AtmA tu sarvato rakzyo dArErapi DanErapi ॥173॥

text: ātmarakṣitatantrāṇāṃ suparīkṣitakāriṇām । āpado nopapadyante puruṣāṇāṃ svadoṣajāḥ ॥174॥
html:
ātmarakṣitatantrāṇāṃ suparīkṣitakāriṇām ।
āpado nopapadyante puruṣāṇāṃ svadoṣajāḥ ॥174॥
slp1: AtmarakzitatantrARAM suparIkzitakAriRAm । Apado nopapadyante puruzARAM svadozajAH ॥174॥

text: śatrūnsamyagvijānanti durbalā ye balīyasaḥ । teṣāṃ na cālyate buddhirātmārthaṃ kṛtaniścayā ॥175॥
html:
śatrūnsamyagvijānanti durbalā ye balīyasaḥ ।
teṣāṃ na cālyate buddhirātmārthaṃ kṛtaniścayā ॥175॥
slp1: SatrUnsamyagvijAnanti durbalA ye balIyasaH । tezAM na cAlyate budDirAtmArTaM kftaniScayA ॥175॥

text: ityabhivyaktamevāsau palitenāvabhartsitaḥ । mārjāro vrīḍito bhūtvā mūṣakaṃ vākyamabravīt ॥176॥
html:
ityabhivyaktamevāsau palitenāvabhartsitaḥ ।
mārjāro vrīḍito bhūtvā mūṣakaṃ vākyamabravīt ॥176॥
slp1: ityaBivyaktamevAsO palitenAvaBartsitaH । mArjAro vrIqito BUtvA mUzakaM vAkyamabravIt ॥176॥

text: sammanye'haṃ tava prajñāṃ yastvaṃ mama hite rataḥ । uktavānarthatattvena mayā sambhinnadarśanaḥ ॥177॥
html:
sammanye'haṃ tava prajñāṃ yastvaṃ mama hite rataḥ ।
uktavānarthatattvena mayā sambhinnadarśanaḥ ॥177॥
slp1: sammanye'haM tava prajYAM yastvaM mama hite rataH । uktavAnarTatattvena mayA samBinnadarSanaH ॥177॥

text: na tu māmanyathā sādho tvaṃ vijñātumihārhasi । prāṇapradānajaṃ tvatto mama sauhṛdamāgatam ॥178॥
html:
na tu māmanyathā sādho tvaṃ vijñātumihārhasi ।
prāṇapradānajaṃ tvatto mama sauhṛdamāgatam ॥178॥
slp1: na tu mAmanyaTA sADo tvaM vijYAtumihArhasi । prARapradAnajaM tvatto mama sOhfdamAgatam ॥178॥

text: dharmajño'smi guṇajño'smi kṛtajño'smi viśeṣataḥ । mitreṣu vatsalaścāsmi tvadvidheṣu viśeṣataḥ ॥179॥
html:
dharmajño'smi guṇajño'smi kṛtajño'smi viśeṣataḥ ।
mitreṣu vatsalaścāsmi tvadvidheṣu viśeṣataḥ ॥179॥
slp1: DarmajYo'smi guRajYo'smi kftajYo'smi viSezataH । mitrezu vatsalaScAsmi tvadviDezu viSezataH ॥179॥

text: tanmāmevaṅgate sādho na yāvayitumarhasi । tvayā hi yāvyamāno'haṃ prāṇāñjahyāṃ sabāndhavaḥ ॥180॥
html:
tanmāmevaṅgate sādho na yāvayitumarhasi ।
tvayā hi yāvyamāno'haṃ prāṇāñjahyāṃ sabāndhavaḥ ॥180॥
slp1: tanmAmevaNgate sADo na yAvayitumarhasi । tvayA hi yAvyamAno'haM prARAYjahyAM sabAnDavaH ॥180॥

text: dhikśabdo hi budhairdṛṣṭo madvidheṣu manasviṣu । maraṇaṃ dharmatattvajña na māṃ śaṅkitumarhasi ॥181॥
html:
dhikśabdo hi budhairdṛṣṭo madvidheṣu manasviṣu ।
maraṇaṃ dharmatattvajña na māṃ śaṅkitumarhasi ॥181॥
slp1: DikSabdo hi buDErdfzwo madviDezu manasvizu । maraRaM DarmatattvajYa na mAM SaNkitumarhasi ॥181॥

text: iti saṃstūyamāno hi mārjāreṇa sa mūṣakaḥ । manasā bhāvagambhīraṃ mārjāraṃ vākyamabravīt ॥182॥
html:
iti saṃstūyamāno hi mārjāreṇa sa mūṣakaḥ ।
manasā bhāvagambhīraṃ mārjāraṃ vākyamabravīt ॥182॥
slp1: iti saMstUyamAno hi mArjAreRa sa mUzakaH । manasA BAvagamBIraM mArjAraM vAkyamabravIt ॥182॥

text: sādhurbhavāñśrutārtho'smi prīyate na ca viśvase । saṃstavairvā dhanaughairvā nāhaṃ śakyaḥ punastvayā ॥183॥
html:
sādhurbhavāñśrutārtho'smi prīyate na ca viśvase ।
saṃstavairvā dhanaughairvā nāhaṃ śakyaḥ punastvayā ॥183॥
slp1: sADurBavAYSrutArTo'smi prIyate na ca viSvase । saMstavErvA DanOGErvA nAhaM SakyaH punastvayA ॥183॥

text: na hyamitravaśaṃ yānti prājñā niṣkāraṇaṃ sakhe । asminnarthe ca gāthe dve nibodhośanasā kṛte ॥184॥
html:
na hyamitravaśaṃ yānti prājñā niṣkāraṇaṃ sakhe ।
asminnarthe ca gāthe dve nibodhośanasā kṛte ॥184॥
slp1: na hyamitravaSaM yAnti prAjYA nizkAraRaM saKe । asminnarTe ca gATe dve niboDoSanasA kfte ॥184॥

text: śatrusādhāraṇe kṛtye kṛtvā sandhiṃ balīyasā । samāhitaścaredyuktyā kṛtārthaśca na viśvaset ॥185॥
html:
śatrusādhāraṇe kṛtye kṛtvā sandhiṃ balīyasā ।
samāhitaścaredyuktyā kṛtārthaśca na viśvaset ॥185॥
slp1: SatrusADAraRe kftye kftvA sanDiM balIyasA । samAhitaScaredyuktyA kftArTaSca na viSvaset ॥185॥

text: tasmātsarvāsvavasthāsu rakṣejjīvitamātmanaḥ । dravyāṇi santatiścaiva sarvaṃ bhavati jīvataḥ ॥186॥
html:
tasmātsarvāsvavasthāsu rakṣejjīvitamātmanaḥ ।
dravyāṇi santatiścaiva sarvaṃ bhavati jīvataḥ ॥186॥
slp1: tasmAtsarvAsvavasTAsu rakzejjIvitamAtmanaH । dravyARi santatiScEva sarvaM Bavati jIvataH ॥186॥

text: saṅkṣepo nītiśāstrāṇāmaviśvāsaḥ paro mataḥ । nṛṣu tasmādaviśvāsaḥ puṣkalaṃ hitamātmanaḥ ॥187॥
html:
saṅkṣepo nītiśāstrāṇāmaviśvāsaḥ paro mataḥ ।
nṛṣu tasmādaviśvāsaḥ puṣkalaṃ hitamātmanaḥ ॥187॥
slp1: saNkzepo nItiSAstrARAmaviSvAsaH paro mataH । nfzu tasmAdaviSvAsaH puzkalaM hitamAtmanaH ॥187॥

text: vadhyante na hyaviśvastāḥ śatrubhirdurbalā api । viśvastāstvāśu vadhyante balavanto'pi durbalaiḥ ॥188॥
html:
vadhyante na hyaviśvastāḥ śatrubhirdurbalā api ।
viśvastāstvāśu vadhyante balavanto'pi durbalaiḥ ॥188॥
slp1: vaDyante na hyaviSvastAH SatruBirdurbalA api । viSvastAstvASu vaDyante balavanto'pi durbalEH ॥188॥

text: tvadvidhebhyo mayā hyātmā rakṣyo mārjāra sarvadā । rakṣa tvamapi cātmānaṃ caṇḍālājjātikilbiṣāt ॥189॥
html:
tvadvidhebhyo mayā hyātmā rakṣyo mārjāra sarvadā ।
rakṣa tvamapi cātmānaṃ caṇḍālājjātikilbiṣāt ॥189॥
slp1: tvadviDeByo mayA hyAtmA rakzyo mArjAra sarvadA । rakza tvamapi cAtmAnaM caRqAlAjjAtikilbizAt ॥189॥

text: sa tasya bruvatastvevaṃ santrāsājjātasādhvasaḥ । svabilaṃ hi javenāśu mārjāraḥ prayayau tataḥ ॥190॥
html:
sa tasya bruvatastvevaṃ santrāsājjātasādhvasaḥ ।
svabilaṃ hi javenāśu mārjāraḥ prayayau tataḥ ॥190॥
slp1: sa tasya bruvatastvevaM santrAsAjjAtasADvasaH । svabilaM hi javenASu mArjAraH prayayO tataH ॥190॥

text: tataḥ śāstrārthatattvajño buddhisāmarthyamātmanaḥ । viśrāvya palitaḥ prājño bilamanyajjagāma ha ॥191॥
html:
tataḥ śāstrārthatattvajño buddhisāmarthyamātmanaḥ ।
viśrāvya palitaḥ prājño bilamanyajjagāma ha ॥191॥
slp1: tataH SAstrArTatattvajYo budDisAmarTyamAtmanaH । viSrAvya palitaH prAjYo bilamanyajjagAma ha ॥191॥

text: evaṃ prajñāvatā buddhyā durbalena mahābalāḥ । ekena bahavo'mitrāḥ palitenābhisandhitāḥ ॥192॥
html:
evaṃ prajñāvatā buddhyā durbalena mahābalāḥ ।
ekena bahavo'mitrāḥ palitenābhisandhitāḥ ॥192॥
slp1: evaM prajYAvatA budDyA durbalena mahAbalAH । ekena bahavo'mitrAH palitenABisanDitAH ॥192॥

text: ariṇāpi samarthena sandhiṃ kurvīta paṇḍitaḥ । mūṣakaśca biḍālaśca muktāvanyonyasaṃśrayāt ॥193॥
html:
ariṇāpi samarthena sandhiṃ kurvīta paṇḍitaḥ ।
mūṣakaśca biḍālaśca muktāvanyonyasaṃśrayāt ॥193॥
slp1: ariRApi samarTena sanDiM kurvIta paRqitaH । mUzakaSca biqAlaSca muktAvanyonyasaMSrayAt ॥193॥

text: ityeṣa kṣatradharmasya mayā mārgo'nudarśitaḥ । vistareṇa mahīpāla saṅkṣepeṇa punaḥ śṛṇu ॥194॥
html:
ityeṣa kṣatradharmasya mayā mārgo'nudarśitaḥ ।
vistareṇa mahīpāla saṅkṣepeṇa punaḥ śṛṇu ॥194॥
slp1: ityeza kzatraDarmasya mayA mArgo'nudarSitaH । vistareRa mahIpAla saNkzepeRa punaH SfRu ॥194॥

text: anyonyakṛtavairau tu cakratuḥ prītimuttamām । anyonyamabhisandhātumabhūccaiva tayormatiḥ ॥195॥
html:
anyonyakṛtavairau tu cakratuḥ prītimuttamām ।
anyonyamabhisandhātumabhūccaiva tayormatiḥ ॥195॥
slp1: anyonyakftavErO tu cakratuH prItimuttamAm । anyonyamaBisanDAtumaBUccEva tayormatiH ॥195॥

text: tatra prājño'bhisandhatte samyagbuddhibalāśrayāt । abhisandhīyate prājñaḥ pramādādapi cābudhaiḥ ॥196॥
html:
tatra prājño'bhisandhatte samyagbuddhibalāśrayāt ।
abhisandhīyate prājñaḥ pramādādapi cābudhaiḥ ॥196॥
slp1: tatra prAjYo'BisanDatte samyagbudDibalASrayAt । aBisanDIyate prAjYaH pramAdAdapi cAbuDEH ॥196॥

text: tasmādabhītavadbhīto viśvastavadaviśvasan । na hyapramattaścalati calito vā vinaśyati ॥197॥
html:
tasmādabhītavadbhīto viśvastavadaviśvasan ।
na hyapramattaścalati calito vā vinaśyati ॥197॥
slp1: tasmAdaBItavadBIto viSvastavadaviSvasan । na hyapramattaScalati calito vA vinaSyati ॥197॥

text: kālena ripuṇā sandhiḥ kāle mitreṇa vigrahaḥ । kārya ityeva tattvajñāḥ prāhurnityaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥198॥
html:
kālena ripuṇā sandhiḥ kāle mitreṇa vigrahaḥ ।
kārya ityeva tattvajñāḥ prāhurnityaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥198॥
slp1: kAlena ripuRA sanDiH kAle mitreRa vigrahaH । kArya ityeva tattvajYAH prAhurnityaM yuDizWira ॥198॥

text: evaṃ matvā mahārāja śāstrārthamabhigamya ca । abhiyukto'pramattaśca prāgbhayādbhītavaccaret ॥199॥
html:
evaṃ matvā mahārāja śāstrārthamabhigamya ca ।
abhiyukto'pramattaśca prāgbhayādbhītavaccaret ॥199॥
slp1: evaM matvA mahArAja SAstrArTamaBigamya ca । aBiyukto'pramattaSca prAgBayAdBItavaccaret ॥199॥

text: bhītavatsaṃvidhiḥ kāryaḥ pratisandhistathaiva ca । bhayādutpadyate buddhirapramattābhiyogajā ॥200॥
html:
bhītavatsaṃvidhiḥ kāryaḥ pratisandhistathaiva ca ।
bhayādutpadyate buddhirapramattābhiyogajā ॥200॥
slp1: BItavatsaMviDiH kAryaH pratisanDistaTEva ca । BayAdutpadyate budDirapramattABiyogajA ॥200॥

text: na bhayaṃ vidyate rājanbhītasyānāgate bhaye । abhītasya tu visrambhātsumahajjāyate bhayam ॥201॥
html:
na bhayaṃ vidyate rājanbhītasyānāgate bhaye ।
abhītasya tu visrambhātsumahajjāyate bhayam ॥201॥
slp1: na BayaM vidyate rAjanBItasyAnAgate Baye । aBItasya tu visramBAtsumahajjAyate Bayam ॥201॥

text: na bhīruriti cātyantaṃ mantro'deyaḥ kathañcana । avijñānāddhi vijñāte gacchedāspadadarśiṣu ॥202॥
html:
na bhīruriti cātyantaṃ mantro'deyaḥ kathañcana ।
avijñānāddhi vijñāte gacchedāspadadarśiṣu ॥202॥
slp1: na BIruriti cAtyantaM mantro'deyaH kaTaYcana । avijYAnAdDi vijYAte gacCedAspadadarSizu ॥202॥

text: tasmādabhītavadbhīto viśvastavadaviśvasan । kāryāṇāṃ gurutāṃ buddhvā nānṛtaṃ kiñcidācaret ॥203॥
html:
tasmādabhītavadbhīto viśvastavadaviśvasan ।
kāryāṇāṃ gurutāṃ buddhvā nānṛtaṃ kiñcidācaret ॥203॥
slp1: tasmAdaBItavadBIto viSvastavadaviSvasan । kAryARAM gurutAM budDvA nAnftaM kiYcidAcaret ॥203॥

text: evametanmayā proktamitihāsaṃ yudhiṣṭhira । śrutvā tvaṃ suhṛdāṃ madhye yathāvatsamupācara ॥204॥
html:
evametanmayā proktamitihāsaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
śrutvā tvaṃ suhṛdāṃ madhye yathāvatsamupācara ॥204॥
slp1: evametanmayA proktamitihAsaM yuDizWira । SrutvA tvaM suhfdAM maDye yaTAvatsamupAcara ॥204॥

text: upalabhya matiṃ cāgryāmarimitrāntaraṃ tathā । sandhivigrahakālaṃ ca mokṣopāyaṃ tathāpadi ॥205॥
html:
upalabhya matiṃ cāgryāmarimitrāntaraṃ tathā ।
sandhivigrahakālaṃ ca mokṣopāyaṃ tathāpadi ॥205॥
slp1: upalaBya matiM cAgryAmarimitrAntaraM taTA । sanDivigrahakAlaM ca mokzopAyaM taTApadi ॥205॥

text: śatrusādhāraṇe kṛtye kṛtvā sandhiṃ balīyasā । samāgamaṃ caredyuktyā kṛtārtho na ca viśvaset ॥206॥
html:
śatrusādhāraṇe kṛtye kṛtvā sandhiṃ balīyasā ।
samāgamaṃ caredyuktyā kṛtārtho na ca viśvaset ॥206॥
slp1: SatrusADAraRe kftye kftvA sanDiM balIyasA । samAgamaM caredyuktyA kftArTo na ca viSvaset ॥206॥

text: aviruddhāṃ trivargeṇa nītimetāṃ yudhiṣṭhira । abhyuttiṣṭha śrutādasmādbhūyastvaṃ rañjayanprajāḥ ॥207॥
html:
aviruddhāṃ trivargeṇa nītimetāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
abhyuttiṣṭha śrutādasmādbhūyastvaṃ rañjayanprajāḥ ॥207॥
slp1: avirudDAM trivargeRa nItimetAM yuDizWira । aByuttizWa SrutAdasmAdBUyastvaM raYjayanprajAH ॥207॥

text: brāhmaṇaiścāpi te sārdhaṃ yātrā bhavatu pāṇḍava । brāhmaṇā hi paraṃ śreyo divi ceha ca bhārata ॥208॥
html:
brāhmaṇaiścāpi te sārdhaṃ yātrā bhavatu pāṇḍava ।
brāhmaṇā hi paraṃ śreyo divi ceha ca bhārata ॥208॥
slp1: brAhmaREScApi te sArDaM yAtrA Bavatu pARqava । brAhmaRA hi paraM Sreyo divi ceha ca BArata ॥208॥

text: ete dharmasya vettāraḥ kṛtajñāḥ satataṃ prabho । pūjitāḥ śubhakarmāṇaḥ pūrvajityā narādhipa ॥209॥
html:
ete dharmasya vettāraḥ kṛtajñāḥ satataṃ prabho ।
pūjitāḥ śubhakarmāṇaḥ pūrvajityā narādhipa ॥209॥
slp1: ete Darmasya vettAraH kftajYAH satataM praBo । pUjitAH SuBakarmARaH pUrvajityA narADipa ॥209॥

text: rājyaṃ śreyaḥ paraṃ rājanyaśaḥ kīrtiṃ ca lapsyase । kulasya santatiṃ caiva yathānyāyaṃ yathākramam ॥210॥
html:
