rājyaṃ śreyaḥ paraṃ rājanyaśaḥ kīrtiṃ ca lapsyase ।
kulasya santatiṃ caiva yathānyāyaṃ yathākramam ॥210॥
slp1: rAjyaM SreyaH paraM rAjanyaSaH kIrtiM ca lapsyase । kulasya santatiM cEva yaTAnyAyaM yaTAkramam ॥210॥

text: dvayorimaṃ bhārata sandhivigrahaṃ subhāṣitaṃ buddhiviśeṣakāritam । tathānvavekṣya kṣitipena sarvadā niṣevitavyaṃ nṛpa śatrumaṇḍale] ॥211॥
html:
dvayorimaṃ bhārata sandhivigrahaṃ subhāṣitaṃ buddhiviśeṣakāritam ।
tathānvavekṣya kṣitipena sarvadā niṣevitavyaṃ nṛpa śatrumaṇḍale] ॥211॥
slp1: dvayorimaM BArata sanDivigrahaM suBAzitaM budDiviSezakAritam । taTAnvavekzya kzitipena sarvadA nizevitavyaM nfpa SatrumaRqale] ॥211॥

text: ukto mantro mahābāho na viśvāso'sti śatruṣu । kathaṃ hi rājā varteta yadi sarvatra nāśvaset ॥1॥
html:
ukto mantro mahābāho na viśvāso'sti śatruṣu ।
kathaṃ hi rājā varteta yadi sarvatra nāśvaset ॥1॥
slp1: ukto mantro mahAbAho na viSvAso'sti Satruzu । kaTaM hi rAjA varteta yadi sarvatra nASvaset ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: viśvāsāddhi paraṃ rājño rājannutpadyate bhayam । kathaṃ vai nāśvasanrājā śatrūñjayati pārthiva ॥2॥
html:
viśvāsāddhi paraṃ rājño rājannutpadyate bhayam ।
kathaṃ vai nāśvasanrājā śatrūñjayati pārthiva ॥2॥
slp1: viSvAsAdDi paraM rAjYo rAjannutpadyate Bayam । kaTaM vE nASvasanrAjA SatrUYjayati pArTiva ॥2॥

text: etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi mano me sampramuhyati । aviśvāsakathāmetāmupaśrutya pitāmaha ॥3॥
html:
etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi mano me sampramuhyati ।
aviśvāsakathāmetāmupaśrutya pitāmaha ॥3॥
slp1: etanme saMSayaM CinDi mano me sampramuhyati । aviSvAsakaTAmetAmupaSrutya pitAmaha ॥3॥

text: śṛṇu kaunteya yo vṛtto brahmadattaniveśane । pūjanyā saha saṃvādo brahmadattasya pārthiva ॥4॥
html:
śṛṇu kaunteya yo vṛtto brahmadattaniveśane ।
pūjanyā saha saṃvādo brahmadattasya pārthiva ॥4॥
slp1: SfRu kOnteya yo vftto brahmadattaniveSane । pUjanyA saha saMvAdo brahmadattasya pArTiva ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kāmpilye brahmadattasya antaḥpuranivāsinī । pūjanī nāma śakunī dīrghakālaṃ sahoṣitā ॥5॥
html:
kāmpilye brahmadattasya antaḥpuranivāsinī ।
pūjanī nāma śakunī dīrghakālaṃ sahoṣitā ॥5॥
slp1: kAmpilye brahmadattasya antaHpuranivAsinI । pUjanI nAma SakunI dIrGakAlaM sahozitA ॥5॥

text: rutajñā sarvabhūtānāṃ yathā vai jīvajīvakaḥ । sarvajñā sarvadharmajñā tiryagyonigatāpi sā ॥6॥
html:
rutajñā sarvabhūtānāṃ yathā vai jīvajīvakaḥ ।
sarvajñā sarvadharmajñā tiryagyonigatāpi sā ॥6॥
slp1: rutajYA sarvaBUtAnAM yaTA vE jIvajIvakaH । sarvajYA sarvaDarmajYA tiryagyonigatApi sA ॥6॥

text: abhiprajātā sā tatra putramekaṃ suvarcasam । samakālaṃ ca rājño'pi devyāḥ putro vyajāyata ॥7॥
html:
abhiprajātā sā tatra putramekaṃ suvarcasam ।
samakālaṃ ca rājño'pi devyāḥ putro vyajāyata ॥7॥
slp1: aBiprajAtA sA tatra putramekaM suvarcasam । samakAlaM ca rAjYo'pi devyAH putro vyajAyata ॥7॥

text: samudratīraṃ gatvā sā tvājahāra phaladvayam । puṣṭyarthaṃ ca svaputrasya rājaputrasya caiva ha ॥8॥
html:
samudratīraṃ gatvā sā tvājahāra phaladvayam ।
puṣṭyarthaṃ ca svaputrasya rājaputrasya caiva ha ॥8॥
slp1: samudratIraM gatvA sA tvAjahAra Paladvayam । puzwyarTaM ca svaputrasya rAjaputrasya cEva ha ॥8॥

text: phalamekaṃ sutāyādādrājaputrāya cāparam । amṛtāsvādasadṛśaṃ balatejovivardhanam । tatrāgacchatparāṃ vṛddhiṃ rājaputraḥ phalāśanāt ॥9॥
html:
phalamekaṃ sutāyādādrājaputrāya cāparam ।
amṛtāsvādasadṛśaṃ balatejovivardhanam ।
tatrāgacchatparāṃ vṛddhiṃ rājaputraḥ phalāśanāt ॥9॥
slp1: PalamekaM sutAyAdAdrAjaputrAya cAparam । amftAsvAdasadfSaM balatejovivarDanam । tatrAgacCatparAM vfdDiM rAjaputraH PalASanAt ॥9॥

text: dhātryā hastagataścāpi tenākrīḍata pakṣiṇā । śūnye tu tamupādāya pakṣiṇaṃ samajātakam । hatvā tataḥ sa rājendra dhātryā hastamupāgamat ॥10॥
html:
dhātryā hastagataścāpi tenākrīḍata pakṣiṇā ।
śūnye tu tamupādāya pakṣiṇaṃ samajātakam ।
hatvā tataḥ sa rājendra dhātryā hastamupāgamat ॥10॥
slp1: DAtryA hastagataScApi tenAkrIqata pakziRA । SUnye tu tamupAdAya pakziRaM samajAtakam । hatvA tataH sa rAjendra DAtryA hastamupAgamat ॥10॥

text: atha sā śakunī rājannāgamatphalahārikā । apaśyannihataṃ putraṃ tena bālena bhūtale ॥11॥
html:
atha sā śakunī rājannāgamatphalahārikā ।
apaśyannihataṃ putraṃ tena bālena bhūtale ॥11॥
slp1: aTa sA SakunI rAjannAgamatPalahArikA । apaSyannihataM putraM tena bAlena BUtale ॥11॥

text: bāṣpapūrṇamukhī dīnā dṛṣṭvā sā tu hataṃ sutam । pūjanī duḥkhasantaptā rudatī vākyamabravīt ॥12॥
html:
bāṣpapūrṇamukhī dīnā dṛṣṭvā sā tu hataṃ sutam ।
pūjanī duḥkhasantaptā rudatī vākyamabravīt ॥12॥
slp1: bAzpapUrRamuKI dInA dfzwvA sA tu hataM sutam । pUjanI duHKasantaptA rudatI vAkyamabravIt ॥12॥

text: kṣatriye saṅgataṃ nāsti na prītirna ca sauhṛdam । kāraṇe sambhajantīha kṛtārthāḥ santyajanti ca ॥13॥
html:
kṣatriye saṅgataṃ nāsti na prītirna ca sauhṛdam ।
kāraṇe sambhajantīha kṛtārthāḥ santyajanti ca ॥13॥
slp1: kzatriye saNgataM nAsti na prItirna ca sOhfdam । kAraRe samBajantIha kftArTAH santyajanti ca ॥13॥

text: kṣatriyeṣu na viśvāsaḥ kāryaḥ sarvopaghātiṣu । apakṛtyāpi satataṃ sāntvayanti nirarthakam ॥14॥
html:
kṣatriyeṣu na viśvāsaḥ kāryaḥ sarvopaghātiṣu ।
apakṛtyāpi satataṃ sāntvayanti nirarthakam ॥14॥
slp1: kzatriyezu na viSvAsaH kAryaH sarvopaGAtizu । apakftyApi satataM sAntvayanti nirarTakam ॥14॥

text: ahamasya karomyadya sadṛśīṃ vairayātanām । kṛtaghnasya nṛśaṃsasya bhṛśaṃ viśvāsaghātinaḥ ॥15॥
html:
ahamasya karomyadya sadṛśīṃ vairayātanām ।
kṛtaghnasya nṛśaṃsasya bhṛśaṃ viśvāsaghātinaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: ahamasya karomyadya sadfSIM vErayAtanAm । kftaGnasya nfSaMsasya BfSaM viSvAsaGAtinaH ॥15॥

text: sahasañjātavṛddhasya tathaiva sahabhojinaḥ । śaraṇāgatasya ca vadhastrividhaṃ hyasya kilbiṣam ॥16॥
html:
sahasañjātavṛddhasya tathaiva sahabhojinaḥ ।
śaraṇāgatasya ca vadhastrividhaṃ hyasya kilbiṣam ॥16॥
slp1: sahasaYjAtavfdDasya taTEva sahaBojinaH । SaraRAgatasya ca vaDastriviDaM hyasya kilbizam ॥16॥

text: ityuktvā caraṇābhyāṃ tu netre nṛpasutasya sā । bhittvā svasthā tata idaṃ pūjanī vākyamabravīt ॥17॥
html:
ityuktvā caraṇābhyāṃ tu netre nṛpasutasya sā ।
bhittvā svasthā tata idaṃ pūjanī vākyamabravīt ॥17॥
slp1: ityuktvA caraRAByAM tu netre nfpasutasya sA । BittvA svasTA tata idaM pUjanI vAkyamabravIt ॥17॥

text: icchayaiva kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ sadya evopasarpati । kṛtapratikriyaṃ teṣāṃ na naśyati śubhāśubham ॥18॥
html:
icchayaiva kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ sadya evopasarpati ।
kṛtapratikriyaṃ teṣāṃ na naśyati śubhāśubham ॥18॥
slp1: icCayEva kftaM pApaM sadya evopasarpati । kftapratikriyaM tezAM na naSyati SuBASuBam ॥18॥

text: pāpaṃ karma kṛtaṃ kiñcinna tasminyadi vidyate । nipātyate'sya putreṣu na cetpautreṣu naptṛṣu ॥19॥
html:
pāpaṃ karma kṛtaṃ kiñcinna tasminyadi vidyate ।
nipātyate'sya putreṣu na cetpautreṣu naptṛṣu ॥19॥
slp1: pApaM karma kftaM kiYcinna tasminyadi vidyate । nipAtyate'sya putrezu na cetpOtrezu naptfzu ॥19॥

text: asti vai kṛtamasmābhirasti pratikṛtaṃ tvayā । ubhayaṃ tatsamībhūtaṃ vasa pūjani mā gamaḥ ॥20॥
html:
asti vai kṛtamasmābhirasti pratikṛtaṃ tvayā ।
ubhayaṃ tatsamībhūtaṃ vasa pūjani mā gamaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: asti vE kftamasmABirasti pratikftaM tvayA । uBayaM tatsamIBUtaM vasa pUjani mA gamaH ॥20॥
author: brahmadatta uvāca ।

text: sakṛtkṛtāparādhasya tatraiva parilambataḥ । na tadbudhāḥ praśaṃsanti śreyastatrāpasarpaṇam ॥21॥
html:
sakṛtkṛtāparādhasya tatraiva parilambataḥ ।
na tadbudhāḥ praśaṃsanti śreyastatrāpasarpaṇam ॥21॥
slp1: sakftkftAparADasya tatrEva parilambataH । na tadbuDAH praSaMsanti SreyastatrApasarpaRam ॥21॥
author: pūjanyuvāca ।

text: sāntve prayukte nṛpate kṛtavaire na viśvaset । kṣipraṃ prabadhyate mūḍho na hi vairaṃ praśāmyati ॥22॥
html:
sāntve prayukte nṛpate kṛtavaire na viśvaset ।
kṣipraṃ prabadhyate mūḍho na hi vairaṃ praśāmyati ॥22॥
slp1: sAntve prayukte nfpate kftavEre na viSvaset । kzipraM prabaDyate mUQo na hi vEraM praSAmyati ॥22॥

text: anyonyaṃ kṛtavairāṇāṃ putrapautraṃ nigacchati । putrapautre vinaṣṭe tu paralokaṃ nigacchati ॥23॥
html:
anyonyaṃ kṛtavairāṇāṃ putrapautraṃ nigacchati ।
putrapautre vinaṣṭe tu paralokaṃ nigacchati ॥23॥
slp1: anyonyaM kftavErARAM putrapOtraM nigacCati । putrapOtre vinazwe tu paralokaM nigacCati ॥23॥

text: sarveṣāṃ kṛtavairāṇāmaviśvāsaḥ sukhāvahaḥ । ekāntato na viśvāsaḥ kāryo viśvāsaghātakaḥ ॥24॥
html:
sarveṣāṃ kṛtavairāṇāmaviśvāsaḥ sukhāvahaḥ ।
ekāntato na viśvāsaḥ kāryo viśvāsaghātakaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: sarvezAM kftavErARAmaviSvAsaH suKAvahaH । ekAntato na viSvAsaH kAryo viSvAsaGAtakaH ॥24॥

text: na viśvasedaviśvaste viśvaste'pi na viśvaset । kāmaṃ viśvāsayedanyānpareṣāṃ tu na viśvaset ॥25॥
html:
na viśvasedaviśvaste viśvaste'pi na viśvaset ।
kāmaṃ viśvāsayedanyānpareṣāṃ tu na viśvaset ॥25॥
slp1: na viSvasedaviSvaste viSvaste'pi na viSvaset । kAmaM viSvAsayedanyAnparezAM tu na viSvaset ॥25॥

text: mātā pitā bāndhavānāṃ variṣṭhau bhāryā jarā bījamātraṃ tu putraḥ । bhrātā śatruḥ klinnapāṇirvayasya ātmā hyekaḥ sukhaduḥkhasya vettā ॥26॥
html:
mātā pitā bāndhavānāṃ variṣṭhau bhāryā jarā bījamātraṃ tu putraḥ ।
bhrātā śatruḥ klinnapāṇirvayasya ātmā hyekaḥ sukhaduḥkhasya vettā ॥26॥
slp1: mAtA pitA bAnDavAnAM varizWO BAryA jarA bIjamAtraM tu putraH । BrAtA SatruH klinnapARirvayasya AtmA hyekaH suKaduHKasya vettA ॥26॥

text: anyonyakṛtavairāṇāṃ na sandhirupapadyate । sa ca heturatikrānto yadarthamahamāvasam ॥27॥
html:
anyonyakṛtavairāṇāṃ na sandhirupapadyate ।
sa ca heturatikrānto yadarthamahamāvasam ॥27॥
slp1: anyonyakftavErARAM na sanDirupapadyate । sa ca heturatikrAnto yadarTamahamAvasam ॥27॥

text: pūjitasyārthamānābhyāṃ jantoḥ pūrvāpakāriṇaḥ । ceto bhavatyaviśvastaṃ pūrvaṃ trāsayate balāt ॥28॥
html:
pūjitasyārthamānābhyāṃ jantoḥ pūrvāpakāriṇaḥ ।
ceto bhavatyaviśvastaṃ pūrvaṃ trāsayate balāt ॥28॥
slp1: pUjitasyArTamAnAByAM jantoH pUrvApakAriRaH । ceto BavatyaviSvastaM pUrvaM trAsayate balAt ॥28॥

text: pūrvaṃ sammānanā yatra paścāccaiva vimānanā । jahyāttaṃ sattvavānvāsaṃ sammānitavimānitaḥ ॥29॥
html:
pūrvaṃ sammānanā yatra paścāccaiva vimānanā ।
jahyāttaṃ sattvavānvāsaṃ sammānitavimānitaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: pUrvaM sammAnanA yatra paScAccEva vimAnanA । jahyAttaM sattvavAnvAsaM sammAnitavimAnitaH ॥29॥

text: uṣitāsmi tavāgāre dīrghakālamahiṃsitā । tadidaṃ vairamutpannaṃ sukhamāssva vrajāmyaham ॥30॥
html:
uṣitāsmi tavāgāre dīrghakālamahiṃsitā ।
tadidaṃ vairamutpannaṃ sukhamāssva vrajāmyaham ॥30॥
slp1: uzitAsmi tavAgAre dIrGakAlamahiMsitA । tadidaM vEramutpannaM suKamAssva vrajAmyaham ॥30॥

text: yatkṛte pratikuryādvai na sa tatrāparādhnuyāt । anṛṇastena bhavati vasa pūjani mā gamaḥ ॥31॥
html:
yatkṛte pratikuryādvai na sa tatrāparādhnuyāt ।
anṛṇastena bhavati vasa pūjani mā gamaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: yatkfte pratikuryAdvE na sa tatrAparADnuyAt । anfRastena Bavati vasa pUjani mA gamaH ॥31॥
author: brahmadatta uvāca ।

text: na kṛtasya na kartuśca sakhyaṃ sandhīyate punaḥ । hṛdayaṃ tatra jānāti kartuścaiva kṛtasya ca ॥32॥
html:
na kṛtasya na kartuśca sakhyaṃ sandhīyate punaḥ ।
hṛdayaṃ tatra jānāti kartuścaiva kṛtasya ca ॥32॥
slp1: na kftasya na kartuSca saKyaM sanDIyate punaH । hfdayaM tatra jAnAti kartuScEva kftasya ca ॥32॥
author: pūjanyuvāca ।

text: kṛtasya caiva kartuśca sakhyaṃ sandhīyate punaḥ । vairasyopaśamo dṛṣṭaḥ pāpaṃ nopāśnute punaḥ ॥33॥
html:
kṛtasya caiva kartuśca sakhyaṃ sandhīyate punaḥ ।
vairasyopaśamo dṛṣṭaḥ pāpaṃ nopāśnute punaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: kftasya cEva kartuSca saKyaM sanDIyate punaH । vErasyopaSamo dfzwaH pApaM nopASnute punaH ॥33॥
author: brahmadatta uvāca ।

text: nāsti vairamupakrāntaṃ sāntvito'smīti nāśvaset । viśvāsādbadhyate bālastasmācchreyo hyadarśanam ॥34॥
html:
nāsti vairamupakrāntaṃ sāntvito'smīti nāśvaset ।
viśvāsādbadhyate bālastasmācchreyo hyadarśanam ॥34॥
slp1: nAsti vEramupakrAntaM sAntvito'smIti nASvaset । viSvAsAdbaDyate bAlastasmAcCreyo hyadarSanam ॥34॥
author: pūjanyuvāca ।

text: tarasā ye na śakyante śastraiḥ suniśitairapi । sāmnā te vinigṛhyante gajā iva kareṇubhiḥ ॥35॥
html:
tarasā ye na śakyante śastraiḥ suniśitairapi ।
sāmnā te vinigṛhyante gajā iva kareṇubhiḥ ॥35॥
slp1: tarasA ye na Sakyante SastrEH suniSitErapi । sAmnA te vinigfhyante gajA iva kareRuBiH ॥35॥

text: saṃvāsājjāyate sneho jīvitāntakareṣvapi । anyonyasya ca viśvāsaḥ śvapacena śuno yathā ॥36॥
html:
saṃvāsājjāyate sneho jīvitāntakareṣvapi ।
anyonyasya ca viśvāsaḥ śvapacena śuno yathā ॥36॥
slp1: saMvAsAjjAyate sneho jIvitAntakarezvapi । anyonyasya ca viSvAsaH Svapacena Suno yaTA ॥36॥
author: brahmadatta uvāca ।

text: anyonyakṛtavairāṇāṃ saṃvāsānmṛdutāṃ gatam । naiva tiṣṭhati tadvairaṃ puṣkarasthamivodakam ॥37॥
html:
anyonyakṛtavairāṇāṃ saṃvāsānmṛdutāṃ gatam ।
naiva tiṣṭhati tadvairaṃ puṣkarasthamivodakam ॥37॥
slp1: anyonyakftavErARAM saMvAsAnmfdutAM gatam । nEva tizWati tadvEraM puzkarasTamivodakam ॥37॥

text: vairaṃ pañcasamutthānaṃ tacca budhyanti paṇḍitāḥ । strīkṛtaṃ vāstujaṃ vāgjaṃ sasapatnāparādhajam ॥38॥
html:
vairaṃ pañcasamutthānaṃ tacca budhyanti paṇḍitāḥ ।
strīkṛtaṃ vāstujaṃ vāgjaṃ sasapatnāparādhajam ॥38॥
slp1: vEraM paYcasamutTAnaM tacca buDyanti paRqitAH । strIkftaM vAstujaM vAgjaM sasapatnAparADajam ॥38॥
author: pūjanyuvāca ।

text: tatra dātā nihantavyaḥ kṣatriyeṇa viśeṣataḥ । prakāśaṃ vāprakāśaṃ vā buddhvā deśabalādikam ॥39॥
html:
tatra dātā nihantavyaḥ kṣatriyeṇa viśeṣataḥ ।
prakāśaṃ vāprakāśaṃ vā buddhvā deśabalādikam ॥39॥
slp1: tatra dAtA nihantavyaH kzatriyeRa viSezataH । prakASaM vAprakASaM vA budDvA deSabalAdikam ॥39॥

text: kṛtavaire na viśvāsaḥ kāryastviha suhṛdyapi । channaṃ santiṣṭhate vairaṃ gūḍho'gniriva dāruṣu ॥40॥
html:
kṛtavaire na viśvāsaḥ kāryastviha suhṛdyapi ।
channaṃ santiṣṭhate vairaṃ gūḍho'gniriva dāruṣu ॥40॥
slp1: kftavEre na viSvAsaH kAryastviha suhfdyapi । CannaM santizWate vEraM gUQo'gniriva dAruzu ॥40॥

text: na vittena na pāruṣyairna sāntvena na ca śrutaiḥ । vairāgniḥ śāmyate rājannaurvāgniriva sāgare ॥41॥
html:
na vittena na pāruṣyairna sāntvena na ca śrutaiḥ ।
vairāgniḥ śāmyate rājannaurvāgniriva sāgare ॥41॥
slp1: na vittena na pAruzyErna sAntvena na ca SrutEH । vErAgniH SAmyate rAjannOrvAgniriva sAgare ॥41॥

text: na hi vairāgnirudbhūtaḥ karma vāpyaparādhajam । śāmyatyadagdhvā nṛpate vinā hyekatarakṣayāt ॥42॥
html:
na hi vairāgnirudbhūtaḥ karma vāpyaparādhajam ।
śāmyatyadagdhvā nṛpate vinā hyekatarakṣayāt ॥42॥
slp1: na hi vErAgnirudBUtaH karma vApyaparADajam । SAmyatyadagDvA nfpate vinA hyekatarakzayAt ॥42॥

text: satkṛtasyārthamānābhyāṃ syāttu pūrvāpakāriṇaḥ । naiva śāntirna viśvāsaḥ karma trāsayate balāt ॥43॥
html:
satkṛtasyārthamānābhyāṃ syāttu pūrvāpakāriṇaḥ ।
naiva śāntirna viśvāsaḥ karma trāsayate balāt ॥43॥
slp1: satkftasyArTamAnAByAM syAttu pUrvApakAriRaH । nEva SAntirna viSvAsaH karma trAsayate balAt ॥43॥

text: naivāpakāre kasmiṃścidahaṃ tvayi tathā bhavān । viśvāsāduṣitā pūrvaṃ nedānīṃ viśvasāmyaham ॥44॥
html:
naivāpakāre kasmiṃścidahaṃ tvayi tathā bhavān ।
viśvāsāduṣitā pūrvaṃ nedānīṃ viśvasāmyaham ॥44॥
slp1: nEvApakAre kasmiMScidahaM tvayi taTA BavAn । viSvAsAduzitA pUrvaM nedAnIM viSvasAmyaham ॥44॥

text: kālena kriyate kāryaṃ tathaiva vividhāḥ kriyāḥ । kālenaiva pravartante kaḥ kasyehāparādhyati ॥45॥
html:
kālena kriyate kāryaṃ tathaiva vividhāḥ kriyāḥ ।
kālenaiva pravartante kaḥ kasyehāparādhyati ॥45॥
slp1: kAlena kriyate kAryaM taTEva viviDAH kriyAH । kAlenEva pravartante kaH kasyehAparADyati ॥45॥
author: brahmadatta uvāca ।

text: tulyaṃ cobhe pravartete maraṇaṃ janma caiva ha । kāryate caiva kālena tannimittaṃ hi jīvati ॥46॥
html:
tulyaṃ cobhe pravartete maraṇaṃ janma caiva ha ।
kāryate caiva kālena tannimittaṃ hi jīvati ॥46॥
slp1: tulyaM coBe pravartete maraRaM janma cEva ha । kAryate cEva kAlena tannimittaM hi jIvati ॥46॥

text: badhyante yugapatkecidekaikasya na cāpare । kālo dahati bhūtāni samprāpyāgnirivendhanam ॥47॥
html:
badhyante yugapatkecidekaikasya na cāpare ।
kālo dahati bhūtāni samprāpyāgnirivendhanam ॥47॥
slp1: baDyante yugapatkecidekEkasya na cApare । kAlo dahati BUtAni samprApyAgnirivenDanam ॥47॥

text: nāhaṃ pramāṇaṃ naiva tvamanyonyakaraṇe śubhe । kālo nityamupādhatte sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca dehinām ॥48॥
html:
nāhaṃ pramāṇaṃ naiva tvamanyonyakaraṇe śubhe ।
kālo nityamupādhatte sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca dehinām ॥48॥
slp1: nAhaM pramARaM nEva tvamanyonyakaraRe SuBe । kAlo nityamupADatte suKaM duHKaM ca dehinAm ॥48॥

text: evaṃ vaseha sasnehā yathākālamahiṃsitā । yatkṛtaṃ tacca me kṣāntaṃ tvaṃ caiva kṣama pūjani ॥49॥
html:
evaṃ vaseha sasnehā yathākālamahiṃsitā ।
yatkṛtaṃ tacca me kṣāntaṃ tvaṃ caiva kṣama pūjani ॥49॥
slp1: evaM vaseha sasnehA yaTAkAlamahiMsitA । yatkftaM tacca me kzAntaM tvaM cEva kzama pUjani ॥49॥

text: yadi kālaḥ pramāṇaṃ te na vairaṃ kasyacidbhavet । kasmāttvapacitiṃ yānti bāndhavā bāndhave hate ॥50॥
html:
yadi kālaḥ pramāṇaṃ te na vairaṃ kasyacidbhavet ।
kasmāttvapacitiṃ yānti bāndhavā bāndhave hate ॥50॥
slp1: yadi kAlaH pramARaM te na vEraM kasyacidBavet । kasmAttvapacitiM yAnti bAnDavA bAnDave hate ॥50॥
author: pūjanyuvāca ।

text: kasmāddevāsurāḥ pūrvamanyonyamabhijaghnire । yadi kālena niryāṇaṃ sukhaduḥkhe bhavābhavau ॥51॥
html:
kasmāddevāsurāḥ pūrvamanyonyamabhijaghnire ।
yadi kālena niryāṇaṃ sukhaduḥkhe bhavābhavau ॥51॥
slp1: kasmAddevAsurAH pUrvamanyonyamaBijaGnire । yadi kAlena niryARaM suKaduHKe BavABavO ॥51॥

text: bhiṣajo bheṣajaṃ kartuṃ kasmādicchanti rogiṇe । yadi kālena pacyante bheṣajaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam ॥52॥
html:
bhiṣajo bheṣajaṃ kartuṃ kasmādicchanti rogiṇe ।
yadi kālena pacyante bheṣajaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam ॥52॥
slp1: Bizajo BezajaM kartuM kasmAdicCanti rogiRe । yadi kAlena pacyante BezajEH kiM prayojanam ॥52॥

text: pralāpaḥ kriyate kasmātsumahāñśokamūrchitaiḥ । yadi kālaḥ pramāṇaṃ te kasmāddharmo'sti kartṛṣu ॥53॥
html:
pralāpaḥ kriyate kasmātsumahāñśokamūrchitaiḥ ।
yadi kālaḥ pramāṇaṃ te kasmāddharmo'sti kartṛṣu ॥53॥
slp1: pralApaH kriyate kasmAtsumahAYSokamUrCitEH । yadi kAlaH pramARaM te kasmAdDarmo'sti kartfzu ॥53॥

text: tava putro mamāpatyaṃ hatavānhiṃsito mayā । anantaraṃ tvayā cāhaṃ bandhanīyā mahīpate ॥54॥
html:
tava putro mamāpatyaṃ hatavānhiṃsito mayā ।
anantaraṃ tvayā cāhaṃ bandhanīyā mahīpate ॥54॥
slp1: tava putro mamApatyaM hatavAnhiMsito mayA । anantaraM tvayA cAhaM banDanIyA mahIpate ॥54॥

text: ahaṃ hi putraśokena kṛtapāpā tavātmaje । tathā tvayā prahartavyaṃ mayi tattvaṃ ca me śṛṇu ॥55॥
html:
ahaṃ hi putraśokena kṛtapāpā tavātmaje ।
tathā tvayā prahartavyaṃ mayi tattvaṃ ca me śṛṇu ॥55॥
slp1: ahaM hi putraSokena kftapApA tavAtmaje । taTA tvayA prahartavyaM mayi tattvaM ca me SfRu ॥55॥

text: bhakṣārthaṃ krīḍanārthaṃ vā narā vāñchanti pakṣiṇaḥ । tṛtīyo nāsti saṃyogo vadhabandhādṛte kṣamaḥ ॥56॥
html:
bhakṣārthaṃ krīḍanārthaṃ vā narā vāñchanti pakṣiṇaḥ ।
tṛtīyo nāsti saṃyogo vadhabandhādṛte kṣamaḥ ॥56॥
slp1: BakzArTaM krIqanArTaM vA narA vAYCanti pakziRaH । tftIyo nAsti saMyogo vaDabanDAdfte kzamaH ॥56॥

text: vadhabandhabhayādeke mokṣatantramupāgatāḥ । maraṇotpātajaṃ duḥkhamāhurdharmavido janāḥ ॥57॥
html:
vadhabandhabhayādeke mokṣatantramupāgatāḥ ।
maraṇotpātajaṃ duḥkhamāhurdharmavido janāḥ ॥57॥
slp1: vaDabanDaBayAdeke mokzatantramupAgatAH । maraRotpAtajaM duHKamAhurDarmavido janAH ॥57॥

text: sarvasya dayitāḥ prāṇāḥ sarvasya dayitāḥ sutāḥ । duḥkhādudvijate sarvaḥ sarvasya sukhamīpsitam ॥58॥
html:
sarvasya dayitāḥ prāṇāḥ sarvasya dayitāḥ sutāḥ ।
duḥkhādudvijate sarvaḥ sarvasya sukhamīpsitam ॥58॥
slp1: sarvasya dayitAH prARAH sarvasya dayitAH sutAH । duHKAdudvijate sarvaH sarvasya suKamIpsitam ॥58॥

text: duḥkhaṃ jarā brahmadatta duḥkhamarthaviparyayaḥ । duḥkhaṃ cāniṣṭasaṃvāso duḥkhamiṣṭaviyogajam ॥59॥
html:
duḥkhaṃ jarā brahmadatta duḥkhamarthaviparyayaḥ ।
duḥkhaṃ cāniṣṭasaṃvāso duḥkhamiṣṭaviyogajam ॥59॥
slp1: duHKaM jarA brahmadatta duHKamarTaviparyayaH । duHKaM cAnizwasaMvAso duHKamizwaviyogajam ॥59॥

text: vairabandhakṛtaṃ duḥkhaṃ hiṃsājaṃ strīkṛtaṃ tathā । duḥkhaṃ sukhena satataṃ janādviparivartate ॥60॥
html:
vairabandhakṛtaṃ duḥkhaṃ hiṃsājaṃ strīkṛtaṃ tathā ।
duḥkhaṃ sukhena satataṃ janādviparivartate ॥60॥
slp1: vErabanDakftaM duHKaM hiMsAjaM strIkftaM taTA । duHKaM suKena satataM janAdviparivartate ॥60॥

text: na duḥkhaṃ paraduḥkhe vai kecidāhurabuddhayaḥ । yo duḥkhaṃ nābhijānāti sa jalpati mahājane ॥61॥
html:
na duḥkhaṃ paraduḥkhe vai kecidāhurabuddhayaḥ ।
yo duḥkhaṃ nābhijānāti sa jalpati mahājane ॥61॥
slp1: na duHKaM paraduHKe vE kecidAhurabudDayaH । yo duHKaM nABijAnAti sa jalpati mahAjane ॥61॥

text: yastu śocati duḥkhārtaḥ sa kathaṃ vaktumutsahet । rasajñaḥ sarvaduḥkhasya yathātmani tathā pare ॥62॥
html:
yastu śocati duḥkhārtaḥ sa kathaṃ vaktumutsahet ।
rasajñaḥ sarvaduḥkhasya yathātmani tathā pare ॥62॥
slp1: yastu Socati duHKArtaH sa kaTaM vaktumutsahet । rasajYaH sarvaduHKasya yaTAtmani taTA pare ॥62॥

text: yatkṛtaṃ te mayā rājaṃstvayā ca mama yatkṛtam । na tadvarṣaśataiḥ śakyaṃ vyapohitumarindama ॥63॥
html:
yatkṛtaṃ te mayā rājaṃstvayā ca mama yatkṛtam ।
na tadvarṣaśataiḥ śakyaṃ vyapohitumarindama ॥63॥
slp1: yatkftaM te mayA rAjaMstvayA ca mama yatkftam । na tadvarzaSatEH SakyaM vyapohitumarindama ॥63॥

text: āvayoḥ kṛtamanyonyaṃ tatra sandhirna vidyate । smṛtvā smṛtvā hi te putraṃ navaṃ vairaṃ bhaviṣyati ॥64॥
html:
āvayoḥ kṛtamanyonyaṃ tatra sandhirna vidyate ।
smṛtvā smṛtvā hi te putraṃ navaṃ vairaṃ bhaviṣyati ॥64॥
slp1: AvayoH kftamanyonyaM tatra sanDirna vidyate । smftvA smftvA hi te putraM navaM vEraM Bavizyati ॥64॥

text: vairamantikamāsajya yaḥ prītiṃ kartumicchati । mṛnmayasyeva bhagnasya tasya sandhirna vidyate ॥65॥
html:
vairamantikamāsajya yaḥ prītiṃ kartumicchati ।
mṛnmayasyeva bhagnasya tasya sandhirna vidyate ॥65॥
slp1: vEramantikamAsajya yaH prItiM kartumicCati । mfnmayasyeva Bagnasya tasya sanDirna vidyate ॥65॥

text: niścitaścārthaśāstrajñairaviśvāsaḥ sukhodayaḥ । uśanāścātha gāthe dve prahrādāyābravītpurā ॥66॥
html:
niścitaścārthaśāstrajñairaviśvāsaḥ sukhodayaḥ ।
uśanāścātha gāthe dve prahrādāyābravītpurā ॥66॥
slp1: niScitaScArTaSAstrajYEraviSvAsaH suKodayaH । uSanAScATa gATe dve prahrAdAyAbravItpurA ॥66॥

text: ye vairiṇaḥ śraddadhate satye satyetare'pi vā । te śraddadhānā vadhyante madhu śuṣkatṛṇairyathā ॥67॥
html:
ye vairiṇaḥ śraddadhate satye satyetare'pi vā ।
te śraddadhānā vadhyante madhu śuṣkatṛṇairyathā ॥67॥
slp1: ye vEriRaH SraddaDate satye satyetare'pi vA । te SraddaDAnA vaDyante maDu SuzkatfREryaTA ॥67॥

text: na hi vairāṇi śāmyanti kuleṣvā daśamādyugāt । ākhyātāraśca vidyante kule cedvidyate pumān ॥68॥
html:
na hi vairāṇi śāmyanti kuleṣvā daśamādyugāt ।
ākhyātāraśca vidyante kule cedvidyate pumān ॥68॥
slp1: na hi vErARi SAmyanti kulezvA daSamAdyugAt । AKyAtAraSca vidyante kule cedvidyate pumAn ॥68॥

text: upaguhya hi vairāṇi sāntvayanti narādhipāḥ । athainaṃ pratipiṃṣanti pūrṇaṃ ghaṭamivāśmani ॥69॥
html:
upaguhya hi vairāṇi sāntvayanti narādhipāḥ ।
athainaṃ pratipiṃṣanti pūrṇaṃ ghaṭamivāśmani ॥69॥
slp1: upaguhya hi vErARi sAntvayanti narADipAH । aTEnaM pratipiMzanti pUrRaM GawamivASmani ॥69॥

text: sadā na viśvasedrājanpāpaṃ kṛtveha kasyacit । apakṛtya pareṣāṃ hi viśvāsādduḥkhamaśnute ॥70॥
html:
sadā na viśvasedrājanpāpaṃ kṛtveha kasyacit ।
apakṛtya pareṣāṃ hi viśvāsādduḥkhamaśnute ॥70॥
slp1: sadA na viSvasedrAjanpApaM kftveha kasyacit । apakftya parezAM hi viSvAsAdduHKamaSnute ॥70॥

text: nāviśvāsāccinvate'rthānnehante cāpi kiñcana । bhayādekatarānnityaṃ mṛtakalpā bhavanti ca ॥71॥
html:
nāviśvāsāccinvate'rthānnehante cāpi kiñcana ।
bhayādekatarānnityaṃ mṛtakalpā bhavanti ca ॥71॥
slp1: nAviSvAsAccinvate'rTAnnehante cApi kiYcana । BayAdekatarAnnityaM mftakalpA Bavanti ca ॥71॥
author: brahmadatta uvāca ।

text: yasyeha vraṇinau pādau padbhyāṃ ca parisarpati । kṣaṇyete tasya tau pādau suguptamabhidhāvataḥ ॥72॥
html:
yasyeha vraṇinau pādau padbhyāṃ ca parisarpati ।
kṣaṇyete tasya tau pādau suguptamabhidhāvataḥ ॥72॥
slp1: yasyeha vraRinO pAdO padByAM ca parisarpati । kzaRyete tasya tO pAdO suguptamaBiDAvataH ॥72॥
author: pūjanyuvāca ।

text: netrābhyāṃ sarujābhyāṃ yaḥ prativātamudīkṣate । tasya vāyurujātyarthaṃ netrayorbhavati dhruvam ॥73॥
html:
netrābhyāṃ sarujābhyāṃ yaḥ prativātamudīkṣate ।
tasya vāyurujātyarthaṃ netrayorbhavati dhruvam ॥73॥
slp1: netrAByAM sarujAByAM yaH prativAtamudIkzate । tasya vAyurujAtyarTaM netrayorBavati Druvam ॥73॥

text: duṣṭaṃ panthānamāśritya yo mohādabhipadyate । ātmano balamajñātvā tadantaṃ tasya jīvitam ॥74॥
html:
duṣṭaṃ panthānamāśritya yo mohādabhipadyate ।
ātmano balamajñātvā tadantaṃ tasya jīvitam ॥74॥
slp1: duzwaM panTAnamASritya yo mohAdaBipadyate । Atmano balamajYAtvA tadantaM tasya jIvitam ॥74॥

text: yastu varṣamavijñāya kṣetraṃ kṛṣati mānavaḥ । hīnaṃ puruṣakāreṇa sasyaṃ naivāpnute punaḥ ॥75॥
html:
yastu varṣamavijñāya kṣetraṃ kṛṣati mānavaḥ ।
hīnaṃ puruṣakāreṇa sasyaṃ naivāpnute punaḥ ॥75॥
slp1: yastu varzamavijYAya kzetraM kfzati mAnavaH । hInaM puruzakAreRa sasyaM nEvApnute punaH ॥75॥

text: yaśca tiktaṃ kaṣāyaṃ vāpyāsvādavidhuraṃ hitam । āhāraṃ kurute nityaṃ so'mṛtatvāya kalpate ॥76॥
html:
yaśca tiktaṃ kaṣāyaṃ vāpyāsvādavidhuraṃ hitam ।
āhāraṃ kurute nityaṃ so'mṛtatvāya kalpate ॥76॥
slp1: yaSca tiktaM kazAyaM vApyAsvAdaviDuraM hitam । AhAraM kurute nityaM so'mftatvAya kalpate ॥76॥

text: pathyaṃ bhuktvā naro lobhādyo'nyadaśnāti bhojanam । pariṇāmamavijñāya tadantaṃ tasya jīvitam ॥77॥
html:
pathyaṃ bhuktvā naro lobhādyo'nyadaśnāti bhojanam ।
pariṇāmamavijñāya tadantaṃ tasya jīvitam ॥77॥
slp1: paTyaM BuktvA naro loBAdyo'nyadaSnAti Bojanam । pariRAmamavijYAya tadantaM tasya jIvitam ॥77॥

text: daivaṃ puruṣakāraśca sthitāvanyonyasaṃśrayāt । udāttānāṃ karma tantraṃ daivaṃ klībā upāsate ॥78॥
html:
daivaṃ puruṣakāraśca sthitāvanyonyasaṃśrayāt ।
udāttānāṃ karma tantraṃ daivaṃ klībā upāsate ॥78॥
slp1: dEvaM puruzakAraSca sTitAvanyonyasaMSrayAt । udAttAnAM karma tantraM dEvaM klIbA upAsate ॥78॥

text: karma cātmahitaṃ kāryaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ vā yadi vā mṛdu । grasyate'karmaśīlastu sadānarthairakiñcanaḥ ॥79॥
html:
karma cātmahitaṃ kāryaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ vā yadi vā mṛdu ।
grasyate'karmaśīlastu sadānarthairakiñcanaḥ ॥79॥
slp1: karma cAtmahitaM kAryaM tIkzRaM vA yadi vA mfdu । grasyate'karmaSIlastu sadAnarTErakiYcanaH ॥79॥

text: tasmātsaṃśayite'pyarthe kārya eva parākramaḥ । sarvasvamapi santyajya kāryamātmahitaṃ naraiḥ ॥80॥
html:
tasmātsaṃśayite'pyarthe kārya eva parākramaḥ ।
sarvasvamapi santyajya kāryamātmahitaṃ naraiḥ ॥80॥
slp1: tasmAtsaMSayite'pyarTe kArya eva parAkramaH । sarvasvamapi santyajya kAryamAtmahitaM narEH ॥80॥

text: vidyā śauryaṃ ca dākṣyaṃ ca balaṃ dhairyaṃ ca pañcamam । mitrāṇi sahajānyāhurvartayantīha yairbudhāḥ ॥81॥
html:
vidyā śauryaṃ ca dākṣyaṃ ca balaṃ dhairyaṃ ca pañcamam ।
mitrāṇi sahajānyāhurvartayantīha yairbudhāḥ ॥81॥
slp1: vidyA SOryaM ca dAkzyaM ca balaM DEryaM ca paYcamam । mitrARi sahajAnyAhurvartayantIha yErbuDAH ॥81॥

text: niveśanaṃ ca kupyaṃ ca kṣetraṃ bhāryā suhṛjjanaḥ । etānyupacitānyāhuḥ sarvatra labhate pumān ॥82॥
html:
niveśanaṃ ca kupyaṃ ca kṣetraṃ bhāryā suhṛjjanaḥ ।
etānyupacitānyāhuḥ sarvatra labhate pumān ॥82॥
slp1: niveSanaM ca kupyaM ca kzetraM BAryA suhfjjanaH । etAnyupacitAnyAhuH sarvatra laBate pumAn ॥82॥

text: sarvatra ramate prājñaḥ sarvatra ca virocate । na vibhīṣayate kañcidbhīṣito na bibheti ca ॥83॥
html:
sarvatra ramate prājñaḥ sarvatra ca virocate ।
na vibhīṣayate kañcidbhīṣito na bibheti ca ॥83॥
slp1: sarvatra ramate prAjYaH sarvatra ca virocate । na viBIzayate kaYcidBIzito na biBeti ca ॥83॥

text: nityaṃ buddhimato hyarthaḥ svalpako'pi vivardhate । dākṣyeṇa kurute karma saṃyamātpratitiṣṭhati ॥84॥
html:
nityaṃ buddhimato hyarthaḥ svalpako'pi vivardhate ।
dākṣyeṇa kurute karma saṃyamātpratitiṣṭhati ॥84॥
slp1: nityaM budDimato hyarTaH svalpako'pi vivarDate । dAkzyeRa kurute karma saMyamAtpratitizWati ॥84॥

text: gṛhasnehāvabaddhānāṃ narāṇāmalpamedhasām । kustrī khādati māṃsāni māghamā segavāmiva ॥85॥
html:
gṛhasnehāvabaddhānāṃ narāṇāmalpamedhasām ।
kustrī khādati māṃsāni māghamā segavāmiva ॥85॥
slp1: gfhasnehAvabadDAnAM narARAmalpameDasAm । kustrI KAdati mAMsAni mAGamA segavAmiva ॥85॥

text: gṛhaṃ kṣetrāṇi mitrāṇi svadeśa iti cāpare । ityevamavasīdanti narā buddhiviparyaye ॥86॥
html:
gṛhaṃ kṣetrāṇi mitrāṇi svadeśa iti cāpare ।
ityevamavasīdanti narā buddhiviparyaye ॥86॥
slp1: gfhaM kzetrARi mitrARi svadeSa iti cApare । ityevamavasIdanti narA budDiviparyaye ॥86॥

text: utpatetsarujāddeśādvyādhidurbhikṣapīḍitāt । anyatra vastuṃ gacchedvā vasedvā nityamānitaḥ ॥87॥
html:
utpatetsarujāddeśādvyādhidurbhikṣapīḍitāt ।
anyatra vastuṃ gacchedvā vasedvā nityamānitaḥ ॥87॥
slp1: utpatetsarujAddeSAdvyADidurBikzapIqitAt । anyatra vastuM gacCedvA vasedvA nityamAnitaH ॥87॥

text: tasmādanyatra yāsyāmi vastuṃ nāhamihotsahe । kṛtametadanāhāryaṃ tava putreṇa pārthiva ॥88॥
html:
tasmādanyatra yāsyāmi vastuṃ nāhamihotsahe ।
kṛtametadanāhāryaṃ tava putreṇa pārthiva ॥88॥
slp1: tasmAdanyatra yAsyAmi vastuM nAhamihotsahe । kftametadanAhAryaM tava putreRa pArTiva ॥88॥

text: kubhāryāṃ ca kuputraṃ ca kurājānaṃ kusauhṛdam । kusambandhaṃ kudeśaṃ ca dūrataḥ parivarjayet ॥89॥
html:
kubhāryāṃ ca kuputraṃ ca kurājānaṃ kusauhṛdam ।
kusambandhaṃ kudeśaṃ ca dūrataḥ parivarjayet ॥89॥
slp1: kuBAryAM ca kuputraM ca kurAjAnaM kusOhfdam । kusambanDaM kudeSaM ca dUrataH parivarjayet ॥89॥

text: kumitre nāsti viśvāsaḥ kubhāryāyāṃ kuto ratiḥ । kurājye nirvṛtirnāsti kudeśe na prajīvyate ॥90॥
html:
kumitre nāsti viśvāsaḥ kubhāryāyāṃ kuto ratiḥ ।
kurājye nirvṛtirnāsti kudeśe na prajīvyate ॥90॥
slp1: kumitre nAsti viSvAsaH kuBAryAyAM kuto ratiH । kurAjye nirvftirnAsti kudeSe na prajIvyate ॥90॥

text: kumitre saṅgataṃ nāsti nityamasthirasauhṛde । avamānaḥ kusambandhe bhavatyarthaviparyaye ॥91॥
html:
kumitre saṅgataṃ nāsti nityamasthirasauhṛde ।
avamānaḥ kusambandhe bhavatyarthaviparyaye ॥91॥
slp1: kumitre saNgataM nAsti nityamasTirasOhfde । avamAnaH kusambanDe BavatyarTaviparyaye ॥91॥

text: sā bhāryā yā priyaṃ brūte sa putro yatra nirvṛtiḥ । tanmitraṃ yatra viśvāsaḥ sa deśo yatra jīvyate ॥92॥
html:
sā bhāryā yā priyaṃ brūte sa putro yatra nirvṛtiḥ ।
tanmitraṃ yatra viśvāsaḥ sa deśo yatra jīvyate ॥92॥
slp1: sA BAryA yA priyaM brUte sa putro yatra nirvftiH । tanmitraM yatra viSvAsaH sa deSo yatra jIvyate ॥92॥

text: yatra nāsti balātkāraḥ sa rājā tīvraśāsanaḥ । na caiva hyabhisambandho daridraṃ yo bubhūṣati ॥93॥
html:
yatra nāsti balātkāraḥ sa rājā tīvraśāsanaḥ ।
na caiva hyabhisambandho daridraṃ yo bubhūṣati ॥93॥
slp1: yatra nAsti balAtkAraH sa rAjA tIvraSAsanaH । na cEva hyaBisambanDo daridraM yo buBUzati ॥93॥

text: bhāryā deśo'tha mitrāṇi putrasambandhibāndhavāḥ । etatsarvaṃ guṇavati dharmanetre mahīpatau ॥94॥
html:
bhāryā deśo'tha mitrāṇi putrasambandhibāndhavāḥ ।
etatsarvaṃ guṇavati dharmanetre mahīpatau ॥94॥
slp1: BAryA deSo'Ta mitrARi putrasambanDibAnDavAH । etatsarvaM guRavati Darmanetre mahIpatO ॥94॥

text: adharmajñasya vilayaṃ prajā gacchantyanigrahāt । rājā mūlaṃ trivargasya apramatto'nupālayan ॥95॥
html:
adharmajñasya vilayaṃ prajā gacchantyanigrahāt ।
rājā mūlaṃ trivargasya apramatto'nupālayan ॥95॥
slp1: aDarmajYasya vilayaM prajA gacCantyanigrahAt । rAjA mUlaM trivargasya apramatto'nupAlayan ॥95॥

text: baliṣaḍbhāgamuddhṛtya baliṃ tamupayojayet । na rakṣati prajāḥ samyagyaḥ sa pārthivataskaraḥ ॥96॥
html:
baliṣaḍbhāgamuddhṛtya baliṃ tamupayojayet ।
na rakṣati prajāḥ samyagyaḥ sa pārthivataskaraḥ ॥96॥
slp1: balizaqBAgamudDftya baliM tamupayojayet । na rakzati prajAH samyagyaH sa pArTivataskaraH ॥96॥

text: dattvābhayaṃ yaḥ svayameva rājā na tatpramāṇaṃ kurute yathāvat । sa sarvalokādupalabhya pāpamadharmabuddhirnirayaṃ prayāti ॥97॥
html:
dattvābhayaṃ yaḥ svayameva rājā na tatpramāṇaṃ kurute yathāvat ।
sa sarvalokādupalabhya pāpamadharmabuddhirnirayaṃ prayāti ॥97॥
slp1: dattvABayaM yaH svayameva rAjA na tatpramARaM kurute yaTAvat । sa sarvalokAdupalaBya pApamaDarmabudDirnirayaM prayAti ॥97॥

text: dattvābhayaṃ yaḥ sma rājā pramāṇaṃ kurute sadā । sa sarvasukhakṛjjñeyaḥ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan ॥98॥
html:
dattvābhayaṃ yaḥ sma rājā pramāṇaṃ kurute sadā ।
sa sarvasukhakṛjjñeyaḥ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan ॥98॥
slp1: dattvABayaM yaH sma rAjA pramARaM kurute sadA । sa sarvasuKakfjjYeyaH prajA DarmeRa pAlayan ॥98॥

text: pitā mātā gururgoptā vahnirvaiśravaṇo yamaḥ । sapta rājño guṇānetānmanurāha prajāpatiḥ ॥99॥
html:
pitā mātā gururgoptā vahnirvaiśravaṇo yamaḥ ।
sapta rājño guṇānetānmanurāha prajāpatiḥ ॥99॥
slp1: pitA mAtA gururgoptA vahnirvESravaRo yamaH । sapta rAjYo guRAnetAnmanurAha prajApatiH ॥99॥

text: pitā hi rājā rāṣṭrasya prajānāṃ yo'nukampakaḥ । tasminmithyāpraṇīte hi tiryaggacchati mānavaḥ ॥100॥
html:
pitā hi rājā rāṣṭrasya prajānāṃ yo'nukampakaḥ ।
tasminmithyāpraṇīte hi tiryaggacchati mānavaḥ ॥100॥
slp1: pitA hi rAjA rAzwrasya prajAnAM yo'nukampakaH । tasminmiTyApraRIte hi tiryaggacCati mAnavaH ॥100॥

text: sambhāvayati māteva dīnamabhyavapadyate । dahatyagnirivāniṣṭānyamayanbhavate yamaḥ ॥101॥
html:
sambhāvayati māteva dīnamabhyavapadyate ।
dahatyagnirivāniṣṭānyamayanbhavate yamaḥ ॥101॥
slp1: samBAvayati mAteva dInamaByavapadyate । dahatyagnirivAnizwAnyamayanBavate yamaH ॥101॥

text: iṣṭeṣu visṛjatyarthānkubera iva kāmadaḥ । gururdharmopadeśena goptā ca paripālanāt ॥102॥
html:
iṣṭeṣu visṛjatyarthānkubera iva kāmadaḥ ।
gururdharmopadeśena goptā ca paripālanāt ॥102॥
slp1: izwezu visfjatyarTAnkubera iva kAmadaH । gururDarmopadeSena goptA ca paripAlanAt ॥102॥

text: yastu rañjayate rājā paurajānapadānguṇaiḥ । na tasya bhraśyate rājyaṃ guṇadharmānupālanāt ॥103॥
html:
yastu rañjayate rājā paurajānapadānguṇaiḥ ।
na tasya bhraśyate rājyaṃ guṇadharmānupālanāt ॥103॥
slp1: yastu raYjayate rAjA pOrajAnapadAnguREH । na tasya BraSyate rAjyaM guRaDarmAnupAlanAt ॥103॥

text: svayaṃ samupajānanhi paurajānapadakriyāḥ । sa sukhaṃ modate bhūpa iha loke paratra ca ॥104॥
html:
svayaṃ samupajānanhi paurajānapadakriyāḥ ।
sa sukhaṃ modate bhūpa iha loke paratra ca ॥104॥
slp1: svayaM samupajAnanhi pOrajAnapadakriyAH । sa suKaM modate BUpa iha loke paratra ca ॥104॥

text: nityodvignāḥ prajā yasya karabhāraprapīḍitāḥ । anarthairvipralupyante sa gacchati parābhavam ॥105॥
html:
nityodvignāḥ prajā yasya karabhāraprapīḍitāḥ ।
anarthairvipralupyante sa gacchati parābhavam ॥105॥
slp1: nityodvignAH prajA yasya karaBAraprapIqitAH । anarTErvipralupyante sa gacCati parABavam ॥105॥

text: prajā yasya vivardhante sarasīva mahotpalam । sa sarvayajñaphalabhāgrājā loke mahīyate ॥106॥
html:
prajā yasya vivardhante sarasīva mahotpalam ।
sa sarvayajñaphalabhāgrājā loke mahīyate ॥106॥
slp1: prajA yasya vivarDante sarasIva mahotpalam । sa sarvayajYaPalaBAgrAjA loke mahIyate ॥106॥

text: balinā vigraho rājanna kathañcitpraśasyate । balinā vigṛhītasya kuto rājyaṃ kutaḥ sukham ॥107॥
html:
balinā vigraho rājanna kathañcitpraśasyate ।
balinā vigṛhītasya kuto rājyaṃ kutaḥ sukham ॥107॥
slp1: balinA vigraho rAjanna kaTaYcitpraSasyate । balinA vigfhItasya kuto rAjyaM kutaH suKam ॥107॥

text: saivamuktvā śakunikā brahmadattaṃ narādhipam । rājānaṃ samanujñāpya jagāmāthepsitāṃ diśam ॥108॥
html:
saivamuktvā śakunikā brahmadattaṃ narādhipam ।
rājānaṃ samanujñāpya jagāmāthepsitāṃ diśam ॥108॥
slp1: sEvamuktvA SakunikA brahmadattaM narADipam । rAjAnaM samanujYApya jagAmATepsitAM diSam ॥108॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: etatte brahmadattasya pūjanyā saha bhāṣitam । mayoktaṃ bharataśreṣṭha kimanyacchrotumicchasi] ॥109॥
html:
etatte brahmadattasya pūjanyā saha bhāṣitam ।
mayoktaṃ bharataśreṣṭha kimanyacchrotumicchasi] ॥109॥
slp1: etatte brahmadattasya pUjanyA saha BAzitam । mayoktaM BarataSrezWa kimanyacCrotumicCasi] ॥109॥

text: yugakṣayātparikṣīṇe dharme loke ca bhārata । dasyubhiḥ pīḍyamāne ca kathaṃ stheyaṃ pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
yugakṣayātparikṣīṇe dharme loke ca bhārata ।
dasyubhiḥ pīḍyamāne ca kathaṃ stheyaṃ pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: yugakzayAtparikzIRe Darme loke ca BArata । dasyuBiH pIqyamAne ca kaTaM sTeyaM pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi nītimāpatsu bhārata । utsṛjyāpi ghṛṇāṃ kāle yathā varteta bhūmipaḥ ॥2॥
html:
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi nītimāpatsu bhārata ।
utsṛjyāpi ghṛṇāṃ kāle yathā varteta bhūmipaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: hanta te kaTayizyAmi nItimApatsu BArata । utsfjyApi GfRAM kAle yaTA varteta BUmipaH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । bharadvājasya saṃvādaṃ rājñaḥ śatruntapasya ca ॥3॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
bharadvājasya saṃvādaṃ rājñaḥ śatruntapasya ca ॥3॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । BaradvAjasya saMvAdaM rAjYaH Satruntapasya ca ॥3॥

text: rājā śatruntapo nāma sauvīrāṇāṃ mahārathaḥ । kaṇiṅkamupasaṅgamya papracchārthaviniścayam ॥4॥
html:
rājā śatruntapo nāma sauvīrāṇāṃ mahārathaḥ ।
kaṇiṅkamupasaṅgamya papracchārthaviniścayam ॥4॥
slp1: rAjA Satruntapo nAma sOvIrARAM mahAraTaH । kaRiNkamupasaNgamya papracCArTaviniScayam ॥4॥

text: alabdhasya kathaṃ lipsā labdhaṃ kena vivardhate । vardhitaṃ pālayetkena pālitaṃ praṇayetkatham ॥5॥
html:
alabdhasya kathaṃ lipsā labdhaṃ kena vivardhate ।
vardhitaṃ pālayetkena pālitaṃ praṇayetkatham ॥5॥
slp1: alabDasya kaTaM lipsA labDaM kena vivarDate । varDitaM pAlayetkena pAlitaM praRayetkaTam ॥5॥

text: tasmai viniścayārthaṃ sa paripṛṣṭārthaniścayaḥ । uvāca brāhmaṇo vākyamidaṃ hetumaduttaram ॥6॥
html:
tasmai viniścayārthaṃ sa paripṛṣṭārthaniścayaḥ ।
uvāca brāhmaṇo vākyamidaṃ hetumaduttaram ॥6॥
slp1: tasmE viniScayArTaM sa paripfzwArTaniScayaH । uvAca brAhmaRo vAkyamidaM hetumaduttaram ॥6॥

text: nityamudyatadaṇḍaḥ syānnityaṃ vivṛtapauruṣaḥ । acchidraśchidradarśī ca pareṣāṃ vivarānugaḥ ॥7॥
html:
nityamudyatadaṇḍaḥ syānnityaṃ vivṛtapauruṣaḥ ।
acchidraśchidradarśī ca pareṣāṃ vivarānugaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: nityamudyatadaRqaH syAnnityaM vivftapOruzaH । acCidraSCidradarSI ca parezAM vivarAnugaH ॥7॥

text: nityamudyatadaṇḍasya bhṛśamudvijate janaḥ । tasmātsarvāṇi bhūtāni daṇḍenaiva prarodhayet ॥8॥
html:
nityamudyatadaṇḍasya bhṛśamudvijate janaḥ ।
tasmātsarvāṇi bhūtāni daṇḍenaiva prarodhayet ॥8॥
slp1: nityamudyatadaRqasya BfSamudvijate janaH । tasmAtsarvARi BUtAni daRqenEva praroDayet ॥8॥

text: evameva praśaṃsanti paṇḍitāstattvadarśinaḥ । tasmāccatuṣṭaye tasminpradhāno daṇḍa ucyate ॥9॥
html:
evameva praśaṃsanti paṇḍitāstattvadarśinaḥ ।
tasmāccatuṣṭaye tasminpradhāno daṇḍa ucyate ॥9॥
slp1: evameva praSaMsanti paRqitAstattvadarSinaH । tasmAccatuzwaye tasminpraDAno daRqa ucyate ॥9॥

text: chinnamūle hyadhiṣṭhāne sarve tajjīvino hatāḥ । kathaṃ hi śākhāstiṣṭheyuśchinnamūle vanaspatau ॥10॥
html:
chinnamūle hyadhiṣṭhāne sarve tajjīvino hatāḥ ।
kathaṃ hi śākhāstiṣṭheyuśchinnamūle vanaspatau ॥10॥
slp1: CinnamUle hyaDizWAne sarve tajjIvino hatAH । kaTaM hi SAKAstizWeyuSCinnamUle vanaspatO ॥10॥

text: mūlamevāditaśchindyātparapakṣasya paṇḍitaḥ । tataḥ sahāyānpakṣaṃ ca sarvamevānusārayet ॥11॥
html:
mūlamevāditaśchindyātparapakṣasya paṇḍitaḥ ।
tataḥ sahāyānpakṣaṃ ca sarvamevānusārayet ॥11॥
slp1: mUlamevAditaSCindyAtparapakzasya paRqitaH । tataH sahAyAnpakzaM ca sarvamevAnusArayet ॥11॥

text: sumantritaṃ suvikrāntaṃ suyuddhaṃ supalāyitam । āpadāṃ padakāleṣu kurvīta na vicārayet ॥12॥
html:
sumantritaṃ suvikrāntaṃ suyuddhaṃ supalāyitam ।
āpadāṃ padakāleṣu kurvīta na vicārayet ॥12॥
slp1: sumantritaM suvikrAntaM suyudDaM supalAyitam । ApadAM padakAlezu kurvIta na vicArayet ॥12॥

text: vāṅmātreṇa vinītaḥ syāddhṛdayena yathā kṣuraḥ । ślakṣṇapūrvābhibhāṣī ca kāmakrodhau vivarjayet ॥13॥
html:
vāṅmātreṇa vinītaḥ syāddhṛdayena yathā kṣuraḥ ।
ślakṣṇapūrvābhibhāṣī ca kāmakrodhau vivarjayet ॥13॥
slp1: vANmAtreRa vinItaH syAdDfdayena yaTA kzuraH । SlakzRapUrvABiBAzI ca kAmakroDO vivarjayet ॥13॥

text: sapatnasahite kārye kṛtvā sandhiṃ na viśvaset । apakrāmettataḥ kṣipraṃ kṛtakāryo vicakṣaṇaḥ ॥14॥
html:
sapatnasahite kārye kṛtvā sandhiṃ na viśvaset ।
apakrāmettataḥ kṣipraṃ kṛtakāryo vicakṣaṇaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: sapatnasahite kArye kftvA sanDiM na viSvaset । apakrAmettataH kzipraM kftakAryo vicakzaRaH ॥14॥

text: śatruṃ ca mitrarūpeṇa sāntvenaivābhisāntvayet । nityaśaścodvijettasmātsarpādveśmagatādiva ॥15॥
html:
śatruṃ ca mitrarūpeṇa sāntvenaivābhisāntvayet ।
nityaśaścodvijettasmātsarpādveśmagatādiva ॥15॥
slp1: SatruM ca mitrarUpeRa sAntvenEvABisAntvayet । nityaSaScodvijettasmAtsarpAdveSmagatAdiva ॥15॥

text: yasya buddhiṃ paribhavettamatītena sāntvayet । anāgatena duṣprajñaṃ pratyutpannena paṇḍitam ॥16॥
html:
yasya buddhiṃ paribhavettamatītena sāntvayet ।
anāgatena duṣprajñaṃ pratyutpannena paṇḍitam ॥16॥
slp1: yasya budDiM pariBavettamatItena sAntvayet । anAgatena duzprajYaM pratyutpannena paRqitam ॥16॥

text: añjaliṃ śapathaṃ sāntvaṃ praṇamya śirasā vadet । aśruprapātanaṃ caiva kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā ॥17॥
html:
añjaliṃ śapathaṃ sāntvaṃ praṇamya śirasā vadet ।
aśruprapātanaṃ caiva kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā ॥17॥
slp1: aYjaliM SapaTaM sAntvaM praRamya SirasA vadet । aSruprapAtanaM cEva kartavyaM BUtimicCatA ॥17॥

text: vahedamitraṃ skandhena yāvatkālaviparyayaḥ । athainamāgate kāle bhindyādghaṭamivāśmani ॥18॥
html:
vahedamitraṃ skandhena yāvatkālaviparyayaḥ ।
athainamāgate kāle bhindyādghaṭamivāśmani ॥18॥
slp1: vahedamitraM skanDena yAvatkAlaviparyayaH । aTEnamAgate kAle BindyAdGawamivASmani ॥18॥

text: muhūrtamapi rājendra tindukālātavajjvalet । na tuṣāgnirivānarcirdhūmāyeta naraściram ॥19॥
html:
muhūrtamapi rājendra tindukālātavajjvalet ।
na tuṣāgnirivānarcirdhūmāyeta naraściram ॥19॥
slp1: muhUrtamapi rAjendra tindukAlAtavajjvalet । na tuzAgnirivAnarcirDUmAyeta naraSciram ॥19॥

text: nānarthakenārthavattvaṃ kṛtaghnena samācaret । arthe tu śakyate bhoktuṃ kṛtakāryo'vamanyate । tasmātsarvāṇi kāryāṇi sāvaśeṣāṇi kārayet ॥20॥
html:
nānarthakenārthavattvaṃ kṛtaghnena samācaret ।
arthe tu śakyate bhoktuṃ kṛtakāryo'vamanyate ।
tasmātsarvāṇi kāryāṇi sāvaśeṣāṇi kārayet ॥20॥
slp1: nAnarTakenArTavattvaM kftaGnena samAcaret । arTe tu Sakyate BoktuM kftakAryo'vamanyate । tasmAtsarvARi kAryARi sAvaSezARi kArayet ॥20॥

text: kokilasya varāhasya meroḥ śūnyasya veśmanaḥ । vyāḍasya bhakticitrasya yacchreṣṭhaṃ tatsamācaret ॥21॥
html:
kokilasya varāhasya meroḥ śūnyasya veśmanaḥ ।
vyāḍasya bhakticitrasya yacchreṣṭhaṃ tatsamācaret ॥21॥
slp1: kokilasya varAhasya meroH SUnyasya veSmanaH । vyAqasya Bakticitrasya yacCrezWaM tatsamAcaret ॥21॥

text: utthāyotthāya gacchecca nityayukto riporgṛhān । kuśalaṃ cāpi pṛccheta yadyapyakuśalaṃ bhavet ॥22॥
html:
utthāyotthāya gacchecca nityayukto riporgṛhān ।
kuśalaṃ cāpi pṛccheta yadyapyakuśalaṃ bhavet ॥22॥
slp1: utTAyotTAya gacCecca nityayukto riporgfhAn । kuSalaM cApi pfcCeta yadyapyakuSalaM Bavet ॥22॥

text: nālasāḥ prāpnuvantyarthānna klībā na ca māninaḥ । na ca lokaravādbhītā na ca śaśvatpratīkṣiṇaḥ ॥23॥
html:
nālasāḥ prāpnuvantyarthānna klībā na ca māninaḥ ।
na ca lokaravādbhītā na ca śaśvatpratīkṣiṇaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: nAlasAH prApnuvantyarTAnna klIbA na ca mAninaH । na ca lokaravAdBItA na ca SaSvatpratIkziRaH ॥23॥

text: nāsya chidraṃ paro vidyādvidyācchidraṃ parasya tu । gūhetkūrma ivāṅgāni rakṣedvivaramātmanaḥ ॥24॥
html:
nāsya chidraṃ paro vidyādvidyācchidraṃ parasya tu ।
gūhetkūrma ivāṅgāni rakṣedvivaramātmanaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: nAsya CidraM paro vidyAdvidyAcCidraM parasya tu । gUhetkUrma ivANgAni rakzedvivaramAtmanaH ॥24॥

text: bakavaccintayedarthānsiṃhavacca parākramet । vṛkavaccāvalumpeta śaśavacca viniṣpatet ॥25॥
html:
bakavaccintayedarthānsiṃhavacca parākramet ।
vṛkavaccāvalumpeta śaśavacca viniṣpatet ॥25॥
slp1: bakavaccintayedarTAnsiMhavacca parAkramet । vfkavaccAvalumpeta SaSavacca vinizpatet ॥25॥

text: pānamakṣāstathā nāryo mṛgayā gītavāditam । etāni yuktyā seveta prasaṅgo hyatra doṣavān ॥26॥
html:
pānamakṣāstathā nāryo mṛgayā gītavāditam ।
etāni yuktyā seveta prasaṅgo hyatra doṣavān ॥26॥
slp1: pAnamakzAstaTA nAryo mfgayA gItavAditam । etAni yuktyA seveta prasaNgo hyatra dozavAn ॥26॥

text: kuryāttṛṇamayaṃ cāpaṃ śayīta mṛgaśāyikām । andhaḥ syādandhavelāyāṃ bādhiryamapi saṃśrayet ॥27॥
html:
kuryāttṛṇamayaṃ cāpaṃ śayīta mṛgaśāyikām ।
andhaḥ syādandhavelāyāṃ bādhiryamapi saṃśrayet ॥27॥
slp1: kuryAttfRamayaM cApaM SayIta mfgaSAyikAm । anDaH syAdanDavelAyAM bADiryamapi saMSrayet ॥27॥

text: deśaṃ kālaṃ samāsādya vikrameta vicakṣaṇaḥ । deśakālābhyatīto hi vikramo niṣphalo bhavet ॥28॥
html:
deśaṃ kālaṃ samāsādya vikrameta vicakṣaṇaḥ ।
deśakālābhyatīto hi vikramo niṣphalo bhavet ॥28॥
slp1: deSaM kAlaM samAsAdya vikrameta vicakzaRaH । deSakAlAByatIto hi vikramo nizPalo Bavet ॥28॥

text: kālākālau sampradhārya balābalamathātmanaḥ । parasparabalaṃ jñātvā tathātmānaṃ niyojayet ॥29॥
html:
kālākālau sampradhārya balābalamathātmanaḥ ।
parasparabalaṃ jñātvā tathātmānaṃ niyojayet ॥29॥
slp1: kAlAkAlO sampraDArya balAbalamaTAtmanaH । parasparabalaM jYAtvA taTAtmAnaM niyojayet ॥29॥

text: daṇḍenopanataṃ śatruṃ yo rājā na niyacchati । sa mṛtyumupagūhyāste garbhamaśvatarī yathā ॥30॥
html:
daṇḍenopanataṃ śatruṃ yo rājā na niyacchati ।
sa mṛtyumupagūhyāste garbhamaśvatarī yathā ॥30॥
slp1: daRqenopanataM SatruM yo rAjA na niyacCati । sa mftyumupagUhyAste garBamaSvatarI yaTA ॥30॥

text: supuṣpitaḥ syādaphalaḥ phalavānsyāddurāruhaḥ । āmaḥ syātpakvasaṅkāśo na ca śīryeta kasyacit ॥31॥
html:
supuṣpitaḥ syādaphalaḥ phalavānsyāddurāruhaḥ ।
āmaḥ syātpakvasaṅkāśo na ca śīryeta kasyacit ॥31॥
slp1: supuzpitaH syAdaPalaH PalavAnsyAddurAruhaH । AmaH syAtpakvasaNkASo na ca SIryeta kasyacit ॥31॥

text: āśāṃ kālavatīṃ kuryāttāṃ ca vighnena yojayet । vighnaṃ nimittato brūyānnimittaṃ cāpi hetutaḥ ॥32॥
html:
āśāṃ kālavatīṃ kuryāttāṃ ca vighnena yojayet ।
vighnaṃ nimittato brūyānnimittaṃ cāpi hetutaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: ASAM kAlavatIM kuryAttAM ca viGnena yojayet । viGnaM nimittato brUyAnnimittaM cApi hetutaH ॥32॥

text: bhītavatsaṃvidhātavyaṃ yāvadbhayamanāgatam । āgataṃ tu bhayaṃ dṛṣṭvā prahartavyamabhītavat ॥33॥
html:
bhītavatsaṃvidhātavyaṃ yāvadbhayamanāgatam ।
āgataṃ tu bhayaṃ dṛṣṭvā prahartavyamabhītavat ॥33॥
slp1: BItavatsaMviDAtavyaM yAvadBayamanAgatam । AgataM tu BayaM dfzwvA prahartavyamaBItavat ॥33॥

text: na saṃśayamanāruhya naro bhadrāṇi paśyati । saṃśayaṃ punarāruhya yadi jīvati paśyati ॥34॥
html:
na saṃśayamanāruhya naro bhadrāṇi paśyati ।
saṃśayaṃ punarāruhya yadi jīvati paśyati ॥34॥
slp1: na saMSayamanAruhya naro BadrARi paSyati । saMSayaM punarAruhya yadi jIvati paSyati ॥34॥

text: anāgataṃ vijānīyādyacchedbhayamupasthitam । punarvṛddhikṣayātkiñcidabhivṛttaṃ niśāmayet ॥35॥
html:
anāgataṃ vijānīyādyacchedbhayamupasthitam ।
punarvṛddhikṣayātkiñcidabhivṛttaṃ niśāmayet ॥35॥
slp1: anAgataM vijAnIyAdyacCedBayamupasTitam । punarvfdDikzayAtkiYcidaBivfttaM niSAmayet ॥35॥

text: pratyupasthitakālasya sukhasya parivarjanam । anāgatasukhāśā ca naiṣa buddhimatāṃ nayaḥ ॥36॥
html:
pratyupasthitakālasya sukhasya parivarjanam ।
anāgatasukhāśā ca naiṣa buddhimatāṃ nayaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: pratyupasTitakAlasya suKasya parivarjanam । anAgatasuKASA ca nEza budDimatAM nayaH ॥36॥

text: yo'riṇā saha sandhāya sukhaṃ svapiti viśvasan । sa vṛkṣāgraprasupto vā patitaḥ pratibudhyate ॥37॥
html:
yo'riṇā saha sandhāya sukhaṃ svapiti viśvasan ।
sa vṛkṣāgraprasupto vā patitaḥ pratibudhyate ॥37॥
slp1: yo'riRA saha sanDAya suKaM svapiti viSvasan । sa vfkzAgraprasupto vA patitaH pratibuDyate ॥37॥

text: karmaṇā yena teneha mṛdunā dāruṇena vā । uddhareddīnamātmānaṃ samartho dharmamācaret ॥38॥
html:
karmaṇā yena teneha mṛdunā dāruṇena vā ।
uddhareddīnamātmānaṃ samartho dharmamācaret ॥38॥
slp1: karmaRA yena teneha mfdunA dAruRena vA । udDareddInamAtmAnaM samarTo DarmamAcaret ॥38॥

text: ye sapatnāḥ sapatnānāṃ sarvāṃstānapavatsayet । ātmanaścāpi boddhavyāścārāḥ praṇihitāḥ paraiḥ ॥39॥
html:
ye sapatnāḥ sapatnānāṃ sarvāṃstānapavatsayet ।
ātmanaścāpi boddhavyāścārāḥ praṇihitāḥ paraiḥ ॥39॥
slp1: ye sapatnAH sapatnAnAM sarvAMstAnapavatsayet । AtmanaScApi bodDavyAScArAH praRihitAH parEH ॥39॥

text: cāraḥ suvihitaḥ kārya ātmano'tha parasya ca । pāṣaṇḍāṃstāpasādīṃśca pararāṣṭraṃ praveśayet ॥40॥
html:
cāraḥ suvihitaḥ kārya ātmano'tha parasya ca ।
pāṣaṇḍāṃstāpasādīṃśca pararāṣṭraṃ praveśayet ॥40॥
slp1: cAraH suvihitaH kArya Atmano'Ta parasya ca । pAzaRqAMstApasAdIMSca pararAzwraM praveSayet ॥40॥

text: udyāneṣu vihāreṣu prapāsvāvasatheṣu ca । pānāgāreṣu veśeṣu tīrtheṣu ca sabhāsu ca ॥41॥
html:
udyāneṣu vihāreṣu prapāsvāvasatheṣu ca ।
pānāgāreṣu veśeṣu tīrtheṣu ca sabhāsu ca ॥41॥
slp1: udyAnezu vihArezu prapAsvAvasaTezu ca । pAnAgArezu veSezu tIrTezu ca saBAsu ca ॥41॥

text: dharmābhicāriṇaḥ pāpāścārā lokasya kaṇṭakāḥ । samāgacchanti tānbuddhvā niyacchecchamayedapi ॥42॥
html:
dharmābhicāriṇaḥ pāpāścārā lokasya kaṇṭakāḥ ।
samāgacchanti tānbuddhvā niyacchecchamayedapi ॥42॥
slp1: DarmABicAriRaH pApAScArA lokasya kaRwakAH । samAgacCanti tAnbudDvA niyacCecCamayedapi ॥42॥

text: na viśvasedaviśvaste viśvaste nāpi viśvaset । viśvastaṃ bhayamanveti nāparīkṣya ca viśvaset ॥43॥
html:
na viśvasedaviśvaste viśvaste nāpi viśvaset ।
viśvastaṃ bhayamanveti nāparīkṣya ca viśvaset ॥43॥
slp1: na viSvasedaviSvaste viSvaste nApi viSvaset । viSvastaM Bayamanveti nAparIkzya ca viSvaset ॥43॥

text: viśvāsayitvā tu paraṃ tattvabhūtena hetunā । athāsya praharetkāle kiñcidvicalite pade ॥44॥
html:
viśvāsayitvā tu paraṃ tattvabhūtena hetunā ।
athāsya praharetkāle kiñcidvicalite pade ॥44॥
slp1: viSvAsayitvA tu paraM tattvaBUtena hetunA । aTAsya praharetkAle kiYcidvicalite pade ॥44॥

text: aśaṅkyamapi śaṅketa nityaṃ śaṅketa śaṅkitāt । bhayaṃ hi śaṅkitājjātaṃ samūlamapi kṛntati ॥45॥
html:
aśaṅkyamapi śaṅketa nityaṃ śaṅketa śaṅkitāt ।
bhayaṃ hi śaṅkitājjātaṃ samūlamapi kṛntati ॥45॥
slp1: aSaNkyamapi SaNketa nityaM SaNketa SaNkitAt । BayaM hi SaNkitAjjAtaM samUlamapi kfntati ॥45॥

text: avadhānena maunena kāṣāyeṇa jaṭājinaiḥ । viśvāsayitvā dveṣṭāramavalumpedyathā vṛkaḥ ॥46॥
html:
avadhānena maunena kāṣāyeṇa jaṭājinaiḥ ।
viśvāsayitvā dveṣṭāramavalumpedyathā vṛkaḥ ॥46॥
slp1: avaDAnena mOnena kAzAyeRa jawAjinEH । viSvAsayitvA dvezwAramavalumpedyaTA vfkaH ॥46॥

text: putro vā yadi vā bhrātā pitā vā yadi vā suhṛt । arthasya vighnaṃ kurvāṇā hantavyā bhūtivardhanāḥ ॥47॥
html:
putro vā yadi vā bhrātā pitā vā yadi vā suhṛt ।
arthasya vighnaṃ kurvāṇā hantavyā bhūtivardhanāḥ ॥47॥
slp1: putro vA yadi vA BrAtA pitA vA yadi vA suhft । arTasya viGnaM kurvARA hantavyA BUtivarDanAH ॥47॥

text: gurorapyavaliptasya kāryākāryamajānataḥ । utpathapratipannasya daṇḍo bhavati śāsanam ॥48॥
html:
gurorapyavaliptasya kāryākāryamajānataḥ ।
utpathapratipannasya daṇḍo bhavati śāsanam ॥48॥
slp1: gurorapyavaliptasya kAryAkAryamajAnataH । utpaTapratipannasya daRqo Bavati SAsanam ॥48॥

text: pratyutthānābhivādābhyāṃ sampradānena kasyacit । pratipuṣkalaghātī syāttīkṣṇatuṇḍa iva dvijaḥ ॥49॥
html:
pratyutthānābhivādābhyāṃ sampradānena kasyacit ।
pratipuṣkalaghātī syāttīkṣṇatuṇḍa iva dvijaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: pratyutTAnABivAdAByAM sampradAnena kasyacit । pratipuzkalaGAtI syAttIkzRatuRqa iva dvijaH ॥49॥

text: nācchittvā paramarmāṇi nākṛtvā karma dāruṇam । nāhatvā matsyaghātīva prāpnoti paramāṃ śriyam ॥50॥
html:
nācchittvā paramarmāṇi nākṛtvā karma dāruṇam ।
nāhatvā matsyaghātīva prāpnoti paramāṃ śriyam ॥50॥
slp1: nAcCittvA paramarmARi nAkftvA karma dAruRam । nAhatvA matsyaGAtIva prApnoti paramAM Sriyam ॥50॥

text: nāsti jātyā ripurnāma mitraṃ nāma na vidyate । sāmarthyayogājjāyante mitrāṇi ripavastathā ॥51॥
html:
nāsti jātyā ripurnāma mitraṃ nāma na vidyate ।
sāmarthyayogājjāyante mitrāṇi ripavastathā ॥51॥
slp1: nAsti jAtyA ripurnAma mitraM nAma na vidyate । sAmarTyayogAjjAyante mitrARi ripavastaTA ॥51॥

text: amitraṃ naiva muñceta bruvantaṃ karuṇānyapi । duḥkhaṃ tatra na kurvīta hanyātpūrvāpakāriṇam ॥52॥
html:
amitraṃ naiva muñceta bruvantaṃ karuṇānyapi ।
duḥkhaṃ tatra na kurvīta hanyātpūrvāpakāriṇam ॥52॥
slp1: amitraM nEva muYceta bruvantaM karuRAnyapi । duHKaM tatra na kurvIta hanyAtpUrvApakAriRam ॥52॥

text: saṅgrahānugrahe yatnaḥ sadā kāryo'nasūyatā । nigrahaścāpi yatnena kartavyo bhūtimicchatā ॥53॥
html:
saṅgrahānugrahe yatnaḥ sadā kāryo'nasūyatā ।
nigrahaścāpi yatnena kartavyo bhūtimicchatā ॥53॥
slp1: saNgrahAnugrahe yatnaH sadA kAryo'nasUyatA । nigrahaScApi yatnena kartavyo BUtimicCatA ॥53॥

text: prahariṣyanpriyaṃ brūyātprahṛtyāpi priyottaram । api cāsya śiraśchittvā rudyācchocedathāpi vā ॥54॥
html:
prahariṣyanpriyaṃ brūyātprahṛtyāpi priyottaram ।
api cāsya śiraśchittvā rudyācchocedathāpi vā ॥54॥
slp1: praharizyanpriyaM brUyAtprahftyApi priyottaram । api cAsya SiraSCittvA rudyAcCocedaTApi vA ॥54॥

text: nimantrayeta sāntvena sammānena titikṣayā । āśākāraṇamityetatkartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā ॥55॥
html:
nimantrayeta sāntvena sammānena titikṣayā ।
āśākāraṇamityetatkartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā ॥55॥
slp1: nimantrayeta sAntvena sammAnena titikzayA । ASAkAraRamityetatkartavyaM BUtimicCatA ॥55॥

text: na śuṣkavairaṃ kurvīta na bāhubhyāṃ nadīṃ taret । apārthakamanāyuṣyaṃ goviṣāṇasya bhakṣaṇam । dantāśca parighṛṣyante rasaścāpi na labhyate ॥56॥
html:
na śuṣkavairaṃ kurvīta na bāhubhyāṃ nadīṃ taret ।
apārthakamanāyuṣyaṃ goviṣāṇasya bhakṣaṇam ।
dantāśca parighṛṣyante rasaścāpi na labhyate ॥56॥
slp1: na SuzkavEraM kurvIta na bAhuByAM nadIM taret । apArTakamanAyuzyaM govizARasya BakzaRam । dantASca pariGfzyante rasaScApi na laByate ॥56॥

text: trivarge trividhā pīḍānubandhāstraya eva ca । anubandhavadhau jñātvā pīḍāṃ hi parivarjayet ॥57॥
html:
trivarge trividhā pīḍānubandhāstraya eva ca ।
anubandhavadhau jñātvā pīḍāṃ hi parivarjayet ॥57॥
slp1: trivarge triviDA pIqAnubanDAstraya eva ca । anubanDavaDO jYAtvA pIqAM hi parivarjayet ॥57॥

text: ṛṇaśeṣo'gniśeṣaśca śatruśeṣastathaiva ca । punaḥ punarvivardheta svalpo'pyanivāritaḥ ॥58॥
html:
ṛṇaśeṣo'gniśeṣaśca śatruśeṣastathaiva ca ।
punaḥ punarvivardheta svalpo'pyanivāritaḥ ॥58॥
slp1: fRaSezo'gniSezaSca SatruSezastaTEva ca । punaH punarvivarDeta svalpo'pyanivAritaH ॥58॥

text: vardhamānamṛṇaṃ tiṣṭhatparibhūtāśca śatravaḥ । āvahantyanayaṃ tīvraṃ vyādhayaścāpyupekṣitāḥ ॥59॥
html:
vardhamānamṛṇaṃ tiṣṭhatparibhūtāśca śatravaḥ ।
āvahantyanayaṃ tīvraṃ vyādhayaścāpyupekṣitāḥ ॥59॥
slp1: varDamAnamfRaM tizWatpariBUtASca SatravaH । AvahantyanayaM tIvraM vyADayaScApyupekzitAH ॥59॥

text: nāsamyakkṛtakārī syādapramattaḥ sadā bhavet । kaṇṭako'pi hi duśchinno vikāraṃ kurute ciram ॥60॥
html:
nāsamyakkṛtakārī syādapramattaḥ sadā bhavet ।
kaṇṭako'pi hi duśchinno vikāraṃ kurute ciram ॥60॥
slp1: nAsamyakkftakArI syAdapramattaH sadA Bavet । kaRwako'pi hi duSCinno vikAraM kurute ciram ॥60॥

text: vadhena ca manuṣyāṇāṃ mārgāṇāṃ dūṣaṇena ca । ākarāṇāṃ vināśaiśca pararāṣṭraṃ vināśayet ॥61॥
html:
vadhena ca manuṣyāṇāṃ mārgāṇāṃ dūṣaṇena ca ।
ākarāṇāṃ vināśaiśca pararāṣṭraṃ vināśayet ॥61॥
slp1: vaDena ca manuzyARAM mArgARAM dUzaRena ca । AkarARAM vinASESca pararAzwraM vinASayet ॥61॥

text: gṛdhradṛṣṭirbakālīnaḥ śvaceṣṭaḥ siṃhavikramaḥ । anudvignaḥ kākaśaṅkī bhujaṅgacaritaṃ caret ॥62॥
html:
gṛdhradṛṣṭirbakālīnaḥ śvaceṣṭaḥ siṃhavikramaḥ ।
anudvignaḥ kākaśaṅkī bhujaṅgacaritaṃ caret ॥62॥
slp1: gfDradfzwirbakAlInaH SvacezwaH siMhavikramaH । anudvignaH kAkaSaNkI BujaNgacaritaM caret ॥62॥

text: śreṇimukhyopajāpeṣu vallabhānunayeṣu ca । amātyānparirakṣeta bhedasaṅghātayorapi ॥63॥
html:
śreṇimukhyopajāpeṣu vallabhānunayeṣu ca ।
amātyānparirakṣeta bhedasaṅghātayorapi ॥63॥
slp1: SreRimuKyopajApezu vallaBAnunayezu ca । amAtyAnparirakzeta BedasaNGAtayorapi ॥63॥

text: mṛdurityavamanyante tīkṣṇa ityudvijanti ca । tīkṣṇakāle ca tīkṣṇaḥ syānmṛdukāle mṛdurbhavet ॥64॥
html:
mṛdurityavamanyante tīkṣṇa ityudvijanti ca ।
tīkṣṇakāle ca tīkṣṇaḥ syānmṛdukāle mṛdurbhavet ॥64॥
slp1: mfdurityavamanyante tIkzRa ityudvijanti ca । tIkzRakAle ca tIkzRaH syAnmfdukAle mfdurBavet ॥64॥

text: mṛdunā sumṛduṃ hanti mṛdunā hanti dāruṇam । nāsādhyaṃ mṛdunā kiñcittasmāttīkṣṇataraṃ mṛdu ॥65॥
html:
mṛdunā sumṛduṃ hanti mṛdunā hanti dāruṇam ।
nāsādhyaṃ mṛdunā kiñcittasmāttīkṣṇataraṃ mṛdu ॥65॥
slp1: mfdunA sumfduM hanti mfdunA hanti dAruRam । nAsADyaM mfdunA kiYcittasmAttIkzRataraM mfdu ॥65॥

text: kāle mṛduryo bhavati kāle bhavati dāruṇaḥ । sa sādhayati kṛtyāni śatrūṃścaivādhitiṣṭhati ॥66॥
html:
kāle mṛduryo bhavati kāle bhavati dāruṇaḥ ।
sa sādhayati kṛtyāni śatrūṃścaivādhitiṣṭhati ॥66॥
slp1: kAle mfduryo Bavati kAle Bavati dAruRaH । sa sADayati kftyAni SatrUMScEvADitizWati ॥66॥

text: paṇḍitena viruddhaḥ sandūre'smīti na viśvaset । dīrghau buddhimato bāhū yābhyāṃ hiṃsati hiṃsitaḥ ॥67॥
html:
paṇḍitena viruddhaḥ sandūre'smīti na viśvaset ।
dīrghau buddhimato bāhū yābhyāṃ hiṃsati hiṃsitaḥ ॥67॥
slp1: paRqitena virudDaH sandUre'smIti na viSvaset । dIrGO budDimato bAhU yAByAM hiMsati hiMsitaH ॥67॥

text: na tattaredyasya na pāramuttarenna taddharedyatpunarāharetparaḥ । na tatkhanedyasya na mūlamutkhanenna taṃ hanyādyasya śiro na pātayet ॥68॥
html:
na tattaredyasya na pāramuttarenna taddharedyatpunarāharetparaḥ ।
na tatkhanedyasya na mūlamutkhanenna taṃ hanyādyasya śiro na pātayet ॥68॥
slp1: na tattaredyasya na pAramuttarenna tadDaredyatpunarAharetparaH । na tatKanedyasya na mUlamutKanenna taM hanyAdyasya Siro na pAtayet ॥68॥

text: itīdamuktaṃ vṛjinābhisaṃhitaṃ na caitadevaṃ puruṣaḥ samācaret । paraprayuktaṃ tu kathaṃ niśāmayedato mayoktaṃ bhavato hitārthinā ॥69॥
html:
itīdamuktaṃ vṛjinābhisaṃhitaṃ na caitadevaṃ puruṣaḥ samācaret ।
paraprayuktaṃ tu kathaṃ niśāmayedato mayoktaṃ bhavato hitārthinā ॥69॥
slp1: itIdamuktaM vfjinABisaMhitaM na cEtadevaM puruzaH samAcaret । paraprayuktaM tu kaTaM niSAmayedato mayoktaM Bavato hitArTinA ॥69॥

text: yathāvaduktaṃ vacanaṃ hitaṃ tadā niśamya vipreṇa suvīrarāṣṭriyaḥ । tathākarodvākyamadīnacetanaḥ śriyaṃ ca dīptāṃ bubhuje sabāndhavaḥ] ॥70॥
html:
yathāvaduktaṃ vacanaṃ hitaṃ tadā niśamya vipreṇa suvīrarāṣṭriyaḥ ।
tathākarodvākyamadīnacetanaḥ śriyaṃ ca dīptāṃ bubhuje sabāndhavaḥ] ॥70॥
slp1: yaTAvaduktaM vacanaM hitaM tadA niSamya vipreRa suvIrarAzwriyaH । taTAkarodvAkyamadInacetanaH SriyaM ca dIptAM buBuje sabAnDavaH] ॥70॥

text: hīne paramake dharme sarvalokātilaṅghini । adharme dharmatāṃ nīte dharme cādharmatāṃ gate ॥1॥
html:
hīne paramake dharme sarvalokātilaṅghini ।
adharme dharmatāṃ nīte dharme cādharmatāṃ gate ॥1॥
slp1: hIne paramake Darme sarvalokAtilaNGini । aDarme DarmatAM nIte Darme cADarmatAM gate ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: maryādāsu prabhinnāsu kṣubhite dharmaniścaye । rājabhiḥ pīḍite loke corairvāpi viśāmpate ॥2॥
html:
maryādāsu prabhinnāsu kṣubhite dharmaniścaye ।
rājabhiḥ pīḍite loke corairvāpi viśāmpate ॥2॥
slp1: maryAdAsu praBinnAsu kzuBite DarmaniScaye । rAjaBiH pIqite loke corErvApi viSAmpate ॥2॥

text: sarvāśrameṣu mūḍheṣu karmasūpahateṣu ca । kāmānmohācca lobhācca bhayaṃ paśyatsu bhārata ॥3॥
html:
sarvāśrameṣu mūḍheṣu karmasūpahateṣu ca ।
kāmānmohācca lobhācca bhayaṃ paśyatsu bhārata ॥3॥
slp1: sarvASramezu mUQezu karmasUpahatezu ca । kAmAnmohAcca loBAcca BayaM paSyatsu BArata ॥3॥

text: aviśvasteṣu sarveṣu nityabhīteṣu pārthiva । nikṛtyā hanyamāneṣu vañcayatsu parasparam ॥4॥
html:
aviśvasteṣu sarveṣu nityabhīteṣu pārthiva ।
nikṛtyā hanyamāneṣu vañcayatsu parasparam ॥4॥
slp1: aviSvastezu sarvezu nityaBItezu pArTiva । nikftyA hanyamAnezu vaYcayatsu parasparam ॥4॥

text: sampradīpteṣu deśeṣu brāhmaṇye cābhipīḍite । avarṣati ca parjanye mitho bhede samutthite ॥5॥
html:
sampradīpteṣu deśeṣu brāhmaṇye cābhipīḍite ।
avarṣati ca parjanye mitho bhede samutthite ॥5॥
slp1: sampradIptezu deSezu brAhmaRye cABipIqite । avarzati ca parjanye miTo Bede samutTite ॥5॥

text: sarvasmindasyusādbhūte pṛthivyāmupajīvane । kena svidbrāhmaṇo jīvejjaghanye kāla āgate ॥6॥
html:
sarvasmindasyusādbhūte pṛthivyāmupajīvane ।
kena svidbrāhmaṇo jīvejjaghanye kāla āgate ॥6॥
slp1: sarvasmindasyusAdBUte pfTivyAmupajIvane । kena svidbrAhmaRo jIvejjaGanye kAla Agate ॥6॥

text: atityakṣuḥ putrapautrānanukrośānnarādhipa । kathamāpatsu varteta tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥7॥
html:
atityakṣuḥ putrapautrānanukrośānnarādhipa ।
kathamāpatsu varteta tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥7॥
slp1: atityakzuH putrapOtrAnanukroSAnnarADipa । kaTamApatsu varteta tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥7॥

text: kathaṃ ca rājā varteta loke kaluṣatāṃ gate । kathamarthācca dharmācca na hīyeta parantapa ॥8॥
html:
kathaṃ ca rājā varteta loke kaluṣatāṃ gate ।
kathamarthācca dharmācca na hīyeta parantapa ॥8॥
slp1: kaTaM ca rAjA varteta loke kaluzatAM gate । kaTamarTAcca DarmAcca na hIyeta parantapa ॥8॥

text: rājamūlā mahārāja yogakṣemasuvṛṣṭayaḥ । prajāsu vyādhayaścaiva maraṇaṃ ca bhayāni ca ॥9॥
html:
rājamūlā mahārāja yogakṣemasuvṛṣṭayaḥ ।
prajāsu vyādhayaścaiva maraṇaṃ ca bhayāni ca ॥9॥
slp1: rAjamUlA mahArAja yogakzemasuvfzwayaH । prajAsu vyADayaScEva maraRaM ca BayAni ca ॥9॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaśca kaliśca bharatarṣabha । rājamūlāni sarvāṇi mama nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ॥10॥
html:
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaśca kaliśca bharatarṣabha ।
rājamūlāni sarvāṇi mama nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: kftaM tretA dvAparaSca kaliSca BaratarzaBa । rAjamUlAni sarvARi mama nAstyatra saMSayaH ॥10॥

text: tasmiṃstvabhyāgate kāle prajānāṃ doṣakārake । vijñānabalamāsthāya jīvitavyaṃ tadā bhavet ॥11॥
html:
tasmiṃstvabhyāgate kāle prajānāṃ doṣakārake ।
vijñānabalamāsthāya jīvitavyaṃ tadā bhavet ॥11॥
slp1: tasmiMstvaByAgate kAle prajAnAM dozakArake । vijYAnabalamAsTAya jIvitavyaM tadA Bavet ॥11॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । viśvāmitrasya saṃvādaṃ caṇḍālasya ca pakkaṇe ॥12॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
viśvāmitrasya saṃvādaṃ caṇḍālasya ca pakkaṇe ॥12॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । viSvAmitrasya saMvAdaM caRqAlasya ca pakkaRe ॥12॥

text: tretādvāparayoḥ sandhau purā daivavidhikramāt । anāvṛṣṭirabhūdghorā rājandvādaśavārṣikī ॥13॥
html:
tretādvāparayoḥ sandhau purā daivavidhikramāt ।
anāvṛṣṭirabhūdghorā rājandvādaśavārṣikī ॥13॥
slp1: tretAdvAparayoH sanDO purA dEvaviDikramAt । anAvfzwiraBUdGorA rAjandvAdaSavArzikI ॥13॥

text: prajānāmabhivṛddhānāṃ yugānte paryupasthite । tretānirmokṣasamaye dvāparapratipādane ॥14॥
html:
prajānāmabhivṛddhānāṃ yugānte paryupasthite ।
tretānirmokṣasamaye dvāparapratipādane ॥14॥
slp1: prajAnAmaBivfdDAnAM yugAnte paryupasTite । tretAnirmokzasamaye dvAparapratipAdane ॥14॥

text: na vavarṣa sahasrākṣaḥ pratilomo'bhavadguruḥ । jagāma dakṣiṇaṃ mārgaṃ somo vyāvṛttalakṣaṇaḥ ॥15॥
html:
na vavarṣa sahasrākṣaḥ pratilomo'bhavadguruḥ ।
jagāma dakṣiṇaṃ mārgaṃ somo vyāvṛttalakṣaṇaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: na vavarza sahasrAkzaH pratilomo'BavadguruH । jagAma dakziRaM mArgaM somo vyAvfttalakzaRaH ॥15॥

text: nāvaśyāyo'pi rātryante kuta evābhrarājayaḥ । nadyaḥ saṅkṣiptatoyaughāḥ kvacidantargatābhavan ॥16॥
html:
nāvaśyāyo'pi rātryante kuta evābhrarājayaḥ ।
nadyaḥ saṅkṣiptatoyaughāḥ kvacidantargatābhavan ॥16॥
slp1: nAvaSyAyo'pi rAtryante kuta evABrarAjayaH । nadyaH saNkziptatoyOGAH kvacidantargatABavan ॥16॥

text: sarāṃsi saritaścaiva kūpāḥ prasravaṇāni ca । hatatviṭkānyalakṣyanta nisargāddaivakāritāt ॥17॥
html:
sarāṃsi saritaścaiva kūpāḥ prasravaṇāni ca ।
hatatviṭkānyalakṣyanta nisargāddaivakāritāt ॥17॥
slp1: sarAMsi saritaScEva kUpAH prasravaRAni ca । hatatviwkAnyalakzyanta nisargAddEvakAritAt ॥17॥

text: upaśuṣkajalasthāyā vinivṛttasabhāprapā । nivṛttayajñasvādhyāyā nirvaṣaṭkāramaṅgalā ॥18॥
html:
upaśuṣkajalasthāyā vinivṛttasabhāprapā ।
nivṛttayajñasvādhyāyā nirvaṣaṭkāramaṅgalā ॥18॥
slp1: upaSuzkajalasTAyA vinivfttasaBAprapA । nivfttayajYasvADyAyA nirvazawkAramaNgalA ॥18॥

text: utsannakṛṣigorakṣyā nivṛttavipaṇāpaṇā । nivṛttapūgasamayā sampranaṣṭamahotsavā ॥19॥
html:
utsannakṛṣigorakṣyā nivṛttavipaṇāpaṇā ।
nivṛttapūgasamayā sampranaṣṭamahotsavā ॥19॥
slp1: utsannakfzigorakzyA nivfttavipaRApaRA । nivfttapUgasamayA sampranazwamahotsavA ॥19॥

text: asthikaṅkālasaṅkīrṇā hāhābhūtajanākulā । śūnyabhūyiṣṭhanagarā dagdhagrāmaniveśanā ॥20॥
html:
asthikaṅkālasaṅkīrṇā hāhābhūtajanākulā ।
śūnyabhūyiṣṭhanagarā dagdhagrāmaniveśanā ॥20॥
slp1: asTikaNkAlasaNkIrRA hAhABUtajanAkulA । SUnyaBUyizWanagarA dagDagrAmaniveSanA ॥20॥

text: kvaciccoraiḥ kvacicchastraiḥ kvacidrājabhirāturaiḥ । parasparabhayāccaiva śūnyabhūyiṣṭhanirjanā ॥21॥
html:
kvaciccoraiḥ kvacicchastraiḥ kvacidrājabhirāturaiḥ ।
parasparabhayāccaiva śūnyabhūyiṣṭhanirjanā ॥21॥
slp1: kvaciccorEH kvacicCastrEH kvacidrAjaBirAturEH । parasparaBayAccEva SUnyaBUyizWanirjanA ॥21॥

text: gatadaivatasaṅkalpā vṛddhabālavinākṛtā । gojāvimahiṣairhīnā parasparaharāharā ॥22॥
html:
gatadaivatasaṅkalpā vṛddhabālavinākṛtā ।
gojāvimahiṣairhīnā parasparaharāharā ॥22॥
slp1: gatadEvatasaNkalpA vfdDabAlavinAkftA । gojAvimahizErhInA parasparaharAharA ॥22॥

text: hataviprā hatārakṣā pranaṣṭauṣadhisañcayā । śyāvabhūtanaraprāyā babhūva vasudhā tadā ॥23॥
html:
hataviprā hatārakṣā pranaṣṭauṣadhisañcayā ।
śyāvabhūtanaraprāyā babhūva vasudhā tadā ॥23॥
slp1: hataviprA hatArakzA pranazwOzaDisaYcayA । SyAvaBUtanaraprAyA baBUva vasuDA tadA ॥23॥

text: tasminpratibhaye kāle kṣīṇe dharme yudhiṣṭhira । babhramuḥ kṣudhitā martyāḥ khādantaḥ sma parasparam ॥24॥
html:
tasminpratibhaye kāle kṣīṇe dharme yudhiṣṭhira ।
babhramuḥ kṣudhitā martyāḥ khādantaḥ sma parasparam ॥24॥
slp1: tasminpratiBaye kAle kzIRe Darme yuDizWira । baBramuH kzuDitA martyAH KAdantaH sma parasparam ॥24॥

text: ṛṣayo niyamāṃstyaktvā parityaktāgnidaivatāḥ । āśramānsamparityajya paryadhāvannitastataḥ ॥25॥
html:
ṛṣayo niyamāṃstyaktvā parityaktāgnidaivatāḥ ।
āśramānsamparityajya paryadhāvannitastataḥ ॥25॥
slp1: fzayo niyamAMstyaktvA parityaktAgnidEvatAH । ASramAnsamparityajya paryaDAvannitastataH ॥25॥

text: viśvāmitro'tha bhagavānmaharṣiraniketanaḥ । kṣudhā parigato dhīmānsamantātparyadhāvata ॥26॥
html:
viśvāmitro'tha bhagavānmaharṣiraniketanaḥ ।
kṣudhā parigato dhīmānsamantātparyadhāvata ॥26॥
slp1: viSvAmitro'Ta BagavAnmaharziraniketanaH । kzuDA parigato DImAnsamantAtparyaDAvata ॥26॥

text: sa kadācitparipatañśvapacānāṃ niveśanam । hiṃsrāṇāṃ prāṇihantṝṇāmāsasāda vane kvacit ॥27॥
html:
sa kadācitparipatañśvapacānāṃ niveśanam ।
hiṃsrāṇāṃ prāṇihantṝṇāmāsasāda vane kvacit ॥27॥
slp1: sa kadAcitparipataYSvapacAnAM niveSanam । hiMsrARAM prARihantFRAmAsasAda vane kvacit ॥27॥

text: vibhinnakalaśākīrṇaṃ śvacarmācchādanāyutam । varāhakharabhagnāsthikapālaghaṭasaṅkulam ॥28॥
html:
vibhinnakalaśākīrṇaṃ śvacarmācchādanāyutam ।
varāhakharabhagnāsthikapālaghaṭasaṅkulam ॥28॥
slp1: viBinnakalaSAkIrRaM SvacarmAcCAdanAyutam । varAhaKaraBagnAsTikapAlaGawasaNkulam ॥28॥

text: mṛtacelaparistīrṇaṃ nirmālyakṛtabhūṣaṇam । sarpanirmokamālābhiḥ kṛtacihnakuṭīmaṭham ॥29॥
html:
mṛtacelaparistīrṇaṃ nirmālyakṛtabhūṣaṇam ।
sarpanirmokamālābhiḥ kṛtacihnakuṭīmaṭham ॥29॥
slp1: mftacelaparistIrRaM nirmAlyakftaBUzaRam । sarpanirmokamAlABiH kftacihnakuwImaWam ॥29॥

text: ulūkapakṣadhvajibhirdevatāyatanairvṛtam । lohaghaṇṭāpariṣkāraṃ śvayūthaparivāritam ॥30॥
html:
ulūkapakṣadhvajibhirdevatāyatanairvṛtam ।
lohaghaṇṭāpariṣkāraṃ śvayūthaparivāritam ॥30॥
slp1: ulUkapakzaDvajiBirdevatAyatanErvftam । lohaGaRwAparizkAraM SvayUTaparivAritam ॥30॥

text: tatpraviśya kṣudhāviṣṭo gādheḥ putro mahānṛṣiḥ । āhārānveṣaṇe yuktaḥ paraṃ yatnaṃ samāsthitaḥ ॥31॥
html:
tatpraviśya kṣudhāviṣṭo gādheḥ putro mahānṛṣiḥ ।
āhārānveṣaṇe yuktaḥ paraṃ yatnaṃ samāsthitaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: tatpraviSya kzuDAvizwo gADeH putro mahAnfziH । AhArAnvezaRe yuktaH paraM yatnaM samAsTitaH ॥31॥

text: na ca kvacidavindatsa bhikṣamāṇo'pi kauśikaḥ । māṃsamannaṃ mūlaphalamanyadvā tatra kiñcana ॥32॥
html:
na ca kvacidavindatsa bhikṣamāṇo'pi kauśikaḥ ।
māṃsamannaṃ mūlaphalamanyadvā tatra kiñcana ॥32॥
slp1: na ca kvacidavindatsa BikzamARo'pi kOSikaH । mAMsamannaM mUlaPalamanyadvA tatra kiYcana ॥32॥

text: aho kṛcchraṃ mayā prāptamiti niścitya kauśikaḥ । papāta bhūmau daurbalyāttasmiṃścaṇḍālapakkaṇe ॥33॥
html:
aho kṛcchraṃ mayā prāptamiti niścitya kauśikaḥ ।
papāta bhūmau daurbalyāttasmiṃścaṇḍālapakkaṇe ॥33॥
slp1: aho kfcCraM mayA prAptamiti niScitya kOSikaH । papAta BUmO dOrbalyAttasmiMScaRqAlapakkaRe ॥33॥

text: cintayāmāsa sa muniḥ kiṃ nu me sukṛtaṃ bhavet । kathaṃ vṛthā na mṛtyuḥ syāditi pārthivasattama ॥34॥
html:
cintayāmāsa sa muniḥ kiṃ nu me sukṛtaṃ bhavet ।
kathaṃ vṛthā na mṛtyuḥ syāditi pārthivasattama ॥34॥
slp1: cintayAmAsa sa muniH kiM nu me sukftaM Bavet । kaTaM vfTA na mftyuH syAditi pArTivasattama ॥34॥

text: sa dadarśa śvamāṃsasya kutantīṃ vitatāṃ muniḥ । caṇḍālasya gṛhe rājansadyaḥ śastrahatasya ca ॥35॥
html:
sa dadarśa śvamāṃsasya kutantīṃ vitatāṃ muniḥ ।
caṇḍālasya gṛhe rājansadyaḥ śastrahatasya ca ॥35॥
slp1: sa dadarSa SvamAMsasya kutantIM vitatAM muniH । caRqAlasya gfhe rAjansadyaH Sastrahatasya ca ॥35॥

text: sa cintayāmāsa tadā steyaṃ kāryamito mayā । na hīdānīmupāyo'nyo vidyate prāṇadhāraṇe ॥36॥
html:
sa cintayāmāsa tadā steyaṃ kāryamito mayā ।
na hīdānīmupāyo'nyo vidyate prāṇadhāraṇe ॥36॥
slp1: sa cintayAmAsa tadA steyaM kAryamito mayA । na hIdAnImupAyo'nyo vidyate prARaDAraRe ॥36॥

text: āpatsu vihitaṃ steyaṃ viśiṣṭasamahīnataḥ । paraṃ paraṃ bhavetpūrvamasteyamiti niścayaḥ ॥37॥
html:
āpatsu vihitaṃ steyaṃ viśiṣṭasamahīnataḥ ।
paraṃ paraṃ bhavetpūrvamasteyamiti niścayaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: Apatsu vihitaM steyaM viSizwasamahInataH । paraM paraM BavetpUrvamasteyamiti niScayaH ॥37॥

text: hīnādādeyamādau syātsamānāttadanantaram । asambhavādādadīta viśiṣṭādapi dhārmikāt ॥38॥
html:
hīnādādeyamādau syātsamānāttadanantaram ।
asambhavādādadīta viśiṣṭādapi dhārmikāt ॥38॥
slp1: hInAdAdeyamAdO syAtsamAnAttadanantaram । asamBavAdAdadIta viSizwAdapi DArmikAt ॥38॥

text: so'hamantāvasānānāṃ haramāṇaḥ parigrahāt । na steyadoṣaṃ paśyāmi hariṣyāmyetadāmiṣam ॥39॥
html:
so'hamantāvasānānāṃ haramāṇaḥ parigrahāt ।
na steyadoṣaṃ paśyāmi hariṣyāmyetadāmiṣam ॥39॥
slp1: so'hamantAvasAnAnAM haramARaH parigrahAt । na steyadozaM paSyAmi harizyAmyetadAmizam ॥39॥

text: etāṃ buddhiṃ samāsthāya viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ । tasmindeśe prasuṣvāpa patito yatra bhārata ॥40॥
html:
etāṃ buddhiṃ samāsthāya viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ।
tasmindeśe prasuṣvāpa patito yatra bhārata ॥40॥
slp1: etAM budDiM samAsTAya viSvAmitro mahAmuniH । tasmindeSe prasuzvApa patito yatra BArata ॥40॥

text: sa vigāḍhāṃ niśāṃ dṛṣṭvā supte caṇḍālapakkaṇe । śanairutthāya bhagavānpraviveśa kuṭīmaṭham ॥41॥
html:
sa vigāḍhāṃ niśāṃ dṛṣṭvā supte caṇḍālapakkaṇe ।
śanairutthāya bhagavānpraviveśa kuṭīmaṭham ॥41॥
slp1: sa vigAQAM niSAM dfzwvA supte caRqAlapakkaRe । SanErutTAya BagavAnpraviveSa kuwImaWam ॥41॥

text: sa supta eva caṇḍālaḥ śleṣmāpihitalocanaḥ । paribhinnasvaro rūkṣa uvācāpriyadarśanaḥ ॥42॥
html:
sa supta eva caṇḍālaḥ śleṣmāpihitalocanaḥ ।
paribhinnasvaro rūkṣa uvācāpriyadarśanaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: sa supta eva caRqAlaH SlezmApihitalocanaH । pariBinnasvaro rUkza uvAcApriyadarSanaH ॥42॥

text: kaḥ kutantīṃ ghaṭṭayati supte caṇḍālapakkaṇe । jāgarmi nāvasupto'smi hato'sīti ca dāruṇaḥ ॥43॥
html:
kaḥ kutantīṃ ghaṭṭayati supte caṇḍālapakkaṇe ।
jāgarmi nāvasupto'smi hato'sīti ca dāruṇaḥ ॥43॥
slp1: kaH kutantIM Gawwayati supte caRqAlapakkaRe । jAgarmi nAvasupto'smi hato'sIti ca dAruRaH ॥43॥

text: viśvāmitro'hamityeva sahasā tamuvāca saḥ । sahasābhyāgatabhayaḥ sodvegastena karmaṇā ॥44॥
html:
viśvāmitro'hamityeva sahasā tamuvāca saḥ ।
sahasābhyāgatabhayaḥ sodvegastena karmaṇā ॥44॥
slp1: viSvAmitro'hamityeva sahasA tamuvAca saH । sahasAByAgataBayaH sodvegastena karmaRA ॥44॥

text: caṇḍālastadvacaḥ śrutvā maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ । śayanādupasaṃbhrānta iyeṣotpatituṃ tataḥ ॥45॥
html:
caṇḍālastadvacaḥ śrutvā maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ ।
śayanādupasaṃbhrānta iyeṣotpatituṃ tataḥ ॥45॥
slp1: caRqAlastadvacaH SrutvA maharzerBAvitAtmanaH । SayanAdupasaMBrAnta iyezotpatituM tataH ॥45॥

text: sa visṛjyāśru netrābhyāṃ bahumānātkṛtāñjaliḥ । uvāca kauśikaṃ rātrau brahmankiṃ te cikīrṣitam ॥46॥
html:
sa visṛjyāśru netrābhyāṃ bahumānātkṛtāñjaliḥ ।
uvāca kauśikaṃ rātrau brahmankiṃ te cikīrṣitam ॥46॥
slp1: sa visfjyASru netrAByAM bahumAnAtkftAYjaliH । uvAca kOSikaM rAtrO brahmankiM te cikIrzitam ॥46॥

text: viśvāmitrastu mātaṅgamuvāca parisāntvayan । kṣudhito'haṃ gataprāṇo hariṣyāmi śvajāghanīm ॥47॥
html:
viśvāmitrastu mātaṅgamuvāca parisāntvayan ।
kṣudhito'haṃ gataprāṇo hariṣyāmi śvajāghanīm ॥47॥
slp1: viSvAmitrastu mAtaNgamuvAca parisAntvayan । kzuDito'haM gataprARo harizyAmi SvajAGanIm ॥47॥

text: avasīdanti me prāṇāḥ smṛtirme naśyati kṣudhā । svadharmaṃ budhyamāno'pi hariṣyāmi śvajāghanīm ॥48॥
html:
avasīdanti me prāṇāḥ smṛtirme naśyati kṣudhā ।
svadharmaṃ budhyamāno'pi hariṣyāmi śvajāghanīm ॥48॥
slp1: avasIdanti me prARAH smftirme naSyati kzuDA । svaDarmaM buDyamAno'pi harizyAmi SvajAGanIm ॥48॥

text: aṭanbhaikṣaṃ na vindāmi yadā yuṣmākamālaye । tadā buddhiḥ kṛtā pāpe hariṣyāmi śvajāghanīm ॥49॥
html:
aṭanbhaikṣaṃ na vindāmi yadā yuṣmākamālaye ।
tadā buddhiḥ kṛtā pāpe hariṣyāmi śvajāghanīm ॥49॥
slp1: awanBEkzaM na vindAmi yadA yuzmAkamAlaye । tadA budDiH kftA pApe harizyAmi SvajAGanIm ॥49॥

text: tṛṣitaḥ kaluṣaṃ pātā nāsti hrīraśanārthinaḥ । kṣuddharmaṃ dūṣayatyatra hariṣyāmi śvajāghanīm ॥50॥
html:
tṛṣitaḥ kaluṣaṃ pātā nāsti hrīraśanārthinaḥ ।
kṣuddharmaṃ dūṣayatyatra hariṣyāmi śvajāghanīm ॥50॥
slp1: tfzitaH kaluzaM pAtA nAsti hrIraSanArTinaH । kzudDarmaM dUzayatyatra harizyAmi SvajAGanIm ॥50॥

text: agnirmukhaṃ purodhāśca devānāṃ śucipādvibhuḥ । yathā sa sarvabhugbrahmā tathā māṃ viddhi dharmataḥ ॥51॥
html:
agnirmukhaṃ purodhāśca devānāṃ śucipādvibhuḥ ।
yathā sa sarvabhugbrahmā tathā māṃ viddhi dharmataḥ ॥51॥
slp1: agnirmuKaM puroDASca devAnAM SucipAdviBuH । yaTA sa sarvaBugbrahmA taTA mAM vidDi DarmataH ॥51॥

text: tamuvāca sa caṇḍālo maharṣe śṛṇu me vacaḥ । śrutvā tathā samātiṣṭha yathā dharmānna hīyase ॥52॥
html:
tamuvāca sa caṇḍālo maharṣe śṛṇu me vacaḥ ।
śrutvā tathā samātiṣṭha yathā dharmānna hīyase ॥52॥
slp1: tamuvAca sa caRqAlo maharze SfRu me vacaH । SrutvA taTA samAtizWa yaTA DarmAnna hIyase ॥52॥

text: mṛgāṇāmadhamaṃ śvānaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ । tasyāpyadhama uddeśaḥ śarīrasyorujāghanī ॥53॥
html:
mṛgāṇāmadhamaṃ śvānaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ।
tasyāpyadhama uddeśaḥ śarīrasyorujāghanī ॥53॥
slp1: mfgARAmaDamaM SvAnaM pravadanti manIziRaH । tasyApyaDama uddeSaH SarIrasyorujAGanI ॥53॥

text: nedaṃ samyagvyavasitaṃ maharṣe karma vaikṛtam । caṇḍālasvasya haraṇamabhakṣyasya viśeṣataḥ ॥54॥
html:
nedaṃ samyagvyavasitaṃ maharṣe karma vaikṛtam ।
caṇḍālasvasya haraṇamabhakṣyasya viśeṣataḥ ॥54॥
slp1: nedaM samyagvyavasitaM maharze karma vEkftam । caRqAlasvasya haraRamaBakzyasya viSezataH ॥54॥

text: sādhvanyamanupaśya tvamupāyaṃ prāṇadhāraṇe । na māṃsalobhāttapaso nāśaste syānmahāmune ॥55॥
html:
sādhvanyamanupaśya tvamupāyaṃ prāṇadhāraṇe ।
na māṃsalobhāttapaso nāśaste syānmahāmune ॥55॥
slp1: sADvanyamanupaSya tvamupAyaM prARaDAraRe । na mAMsaloBAttapaso nASaste syAnmahAmune ॥55॥

text: jānato'vihito mārgo na kāryo dharmasaṅkaraḥ । mā sma dharmaṃ parityākṣīstvaṃ hi dharmaviduttamaḥ ॥56॥
html:
jānato'vihito mārgo na kāryo dharmasaṅkaraḥ ।
mā sma dharmaṃ parityākṣīstvaṃ hi dharmaviduttamaḥ ॥56॥
slp1: jAnato'vihito mArgo na kAryo DarmasaNkaraH । mA sma DarmaM parityAkzIstvaM hi DarmaviduttamaH ॥56॥

text: viśvāmitrastato rājannityukto bharatarṣabha । kṣudhārtaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ punareva mahāmuniḥ ॥57॥
html:
viśvāmitrastato rājannityukto bharatarṣabha ।
kṣudhārtaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ punareva mahāmuniḥ ॥57॥
slp1: viSvAmitrastato rAjannityukto BaratarzaBa । kzuDArtaH pratyuvAcedaM punareva mahAmuniH ॥57॥

text: nirāhārasya sumahānmama kālo'bhidhāvataḥ । na vidyate'bhyupāyaśca kaścinme prāṇadhāraṇe ॥58॥
html:
nirāhārasya sumahānmama kālo'bhidhāvataḥ ।
na vidyate'bhyupāyaśca kaścinme prāṇadhāraṇe ॥58॥
slp1: nirAhArasya sumahAnmama kAlo'BiDAvataH । na vidyate'ByupAyaSca kaScinme prARaDAraRe ॥58॥

text: yena tena viśeṣeṇa karmaṇā yena kenacit । abhyujjīvetsīdamānaḥ samartho dharmamācaret ॥59॥
html:
yena tena viśeṣeṇa karmaṇā yena kenacit ।
abhyujjīvetsīdamānaḥ samartho dharmamācaret ॥59॥
slp1: yena tena viSezeRa karmaRA yena kenacit । aByujjIvetsIdamAnaH samarTo DarmamAcaret ॥59॥

text: aindro dharmaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ brāhmaṇānāmathāgnikaḥ । brahmavahnirmama balaṃ bhakṣyāmi samayaṃ kṣudhā ॥60॥
html:
aindro dharmaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ brāhmaṇānāmathāgnikaḥ ।
brahmavahnirmama balaṃ bhakṣyāmi samayaṃ kṣudhā ॥60॥
slp1: Endro DarmaH kzatriyARAM brAhmaRAnAmaTAgnikaH । brahmavahnirmama balaM BakzyAmi samayaM kzuDA ॥60॥

text: yathā yathā vai jīveddhi tatkartavyamapīḍayā । jīvitaṃ maraṇācchreyo jīvandharmamavāpnuyāt ॥61॥
html:
yathā yathā vai jīveddhi tatkartavyamapīḍayā ।
jīvitaṃ maraṇācchreyo jīvandharmamavāpnuyāt ॥61॥
slp1: yaTA yaTA vE jIvedDi tatkartavyamapIqayA । jIvitaM maraRAcCreyo jIvanDarmamavApnuyAt ॥61॥

text: so'haṃ jīvitamākāṅkṣannabhakṣasyāpi bhakṣaṇam । vyavasye buddhipūrvaṃ vai tadbhavānanumanyatām ॥62॥
html:
so'haṃ jīvitamākāṅkṣannabhakṣasyāpi bhakṣaṇam ।
vyavasye buddhipūrvaṃ vai tadbhavānanumanyatām ॥62॥
slp1: so'haM jIvitamAkANkzannaBakzasyApi BakzaRam । vyavasye budDipUrvaM vE tadBavAnanumanyatAm ॥62॥

text: jīvandharmaṃ cariṣyāmi praṇotsyāmyaśubhāni ca । tapobhirvidyayā caiva jyotīṃṣīva mahattamaḥ ॥63॥
html:
jīvandharmaṃ cariṣyāmi praṇotsyāmyaśubhāni ca ।
tapobhirvidyayā caiva jyotīṃṣīva mahattamaḥ ॥63॥
slp1: jIvanDarmaM carizyAmi praRotsyAmyaSuBAni ca । tapoBirvidyayA cEva jyotIMzIva mahattamaH ॥63॥

text: naitatkhādanprāpsyase prāṇamanyaṃ nāyurdīrghaṃ nāmṛtasyeva tṛptim । bhikṣāmanyāṃ bhikṣa mā te mano'stu śvabhakṣaṇe śvā hyabhakṣo dvijānām ॥64॥
html:
naitatkhādanprāpsyase prāṇamanyaṃ nāyurdīrghaṃ nāmṛtasyeva tṛptim ।
bhikṣāmanyāṃ bhikṣa mā te mano'stu śvabhakṣaṇe śvā hyabhakṣo dvijānām ॥64॥
slp1: nEtatKAdanprApsyase prARamanyaM nAyurdIrGaM nAmftasyeva tfptim । BikzAmanyAM Bikza mA te mano'stu SvaBakzaRe SvA hyaBakzo dvijAnAm ॥64॥
author: śvapaca uvāca ।

text: na durbhikṣe sulabhaṃ māṃsamanyacchvapāka nānnaṃ na ca me'sti vittam । kṣudhārtaścāhamagatirnirāśaḥ śvamāṃse cāsminṣaḍrasānsādhu manye ॥65॥
html:
na durbhikṣe sulabhaṃ māṃsamanyacchvapāka nānnaṃ na ca me'sti vittam ।
kṣudhārtaścāhamagatirnirāśaḥ śvamāṃse cāsminṣaḍrasānsādhu manye ॥65॥
slp1: na durBikze sulaBaM mAMsamanyacCvapAka nAnnaM na ca me'sti vittam । kzuDArtaScAhamagatirnirASaH SvamAMse cAsminzaqrasAnsADu manye ॥65॥
author: viśvāmitra uvāca ।

text: pañca pañcanakhā bhakṣyā brahmakṣatrasya vai dvija । yadi śāstraṃ pramāṇaṃ te mā bhakṣye mānasaṃ kṛthāḥ ॥66॥
html:
pañca pañcanakhā bhakṣyā brahmakṣatrasya vai dvija ।
yadi śāstraṃ pramāṇaṃ te mā bhakṣye mānasaṃ kṛthāḥ ॥66॥
slp1: paYca paYcanaKA BakzyA brahmakzatrasya vE dvija । yadi SAstraM pramARaM te mA Bakzye mAnasaM kfTAH ॥66॥
author: śvapaca uvāca ।

text: agastyenāsuro jagdho vātāpiḥ kṣudhitena vai । ahamāpadgataḥ kṣubdho bhakṣayiṣye śvajāghanīm ॥67॥
html:
agastyenāsuro jagdho vātāpiḥ kṣudhitena vai ।
ahamāpadgataḥ kṣubdho bhakṣayiṣye śvajāghanīm ॥67॥
slp1: agastyenAsuro jagDo vAtApiH kzuDitena vE । ahamApadgataH kzubDo Bakzayizye SvajAGanIm ॥67॥
author: viśvāmitra uvāca ।

text: bhikṣāmanyāmāhareti na caitatkartumarhasi । na nūnaṃ kāryametadvai hara kāmaṃ śvajāghanīm ॥68॥
html:
bhikṣāmanyāmāhareti na caitatkartumarhasi ।
na nūnaṃ kāryametadvai hara kāmaṃ śvajāghanīm ॥68॥
slp1: BikzAmanyAmAhareti na cEtatkartumarhasi । na nUnaM kAryametadvE hara kAmaM SvajAGanIm ॥68॥
author: śvapaca uvāca ।

text: śiṣṭā vai kāraṇaṃ dharme tadvṛttamanuvartaye । parāṃ medhyāśanādetāṃ bhakṣyāṃ manye śvajāghanīm ॥69॥
html:
śiṣṭā vai kāraṇaṃ dharme tadvṛttamanuvartaye ।
parāṃ medhyāśanādetāṃ bhakṣyāṃ manye śvajāghanīm ॥69॥
slp1: SizwA vE kAraRaM Darme tadvfttamanuvartaye । parAM meDyASanAdetAM BakzyAM manye SvajAGanIm ॥69॥
author: viśvāmitra uvāca ।

text: asatā yatsamācīrṇaṃ na sa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ । nāvṛttamanukāryaṃ vai mā chalenānṛtaṃ kṛthāḥ ॥70॥
html:
asatā yatsamācīrṇaṃ na sa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
nāvṛttamanukāryaṃ vai mā chalenānṛtaṃ kṛthāḥ ॥70॥
slp1: asatA yatsamAcIrRaM na sa DarmaH sanAtanaH । nAvfttamanukAryaM vE mA CalenAnftaM kfTAH ॥70॥
author: śvapaca uvāca ।

text: na pātakaṃ nāvamatamṛṣiḥ sankartumarhasi । samau ca śvamṛgau manye tasmādbhakṣyā śvajāghanī ॥71॥
html:
na pātakaṃ nāvamatamṛṣiḥ sankartumarhasi ।
samau ca śvamṛgau manye tasmādbhakṣyā śvajāghanī ॥71॥
slp1: na pAtakaM nAvamatamfziH sankartumarhasi । samO ca SvamfgO manye tasmAdBakzyA SvajAGanI ॥71॥
author: viśvāmitra uvāca ।

text: yadbrāhmaṇārthe kṛtamarthitena tenarṣiṇā tacca bhakṣyādhikāram । sa vai dharmo yatra na pāpamasti sarvairupāyairhi sa rakṣitavyaḥ ॥72॥
html:
yadbrāhmaṇārthe kṛtamarthitena tenarṣiṇā tacca bhakṣyādhikāram ।
sa vai dharmo yatra na pāpamasti sarvairupāyairhi sa rakṣitavyaḥ ॥72॥
slp1: yadbrAhmaRArTe kftamarTitena tenarziRA tacca BakzyADikAram । sa vE Darmo yatra na pApamasti sarvErupAyErhi sa rakzitavyaH ॥72॥
author: śvapaca uvāca ।

text: mitraṃ ca me brāhmaṇaścāyamātmā priyaśca me pūjyatamaśca loke । taṃ bhartukāmo'hamimāṃ hariṣye nṛśaṃsānāmīdṛśānāṃ na bibhye ॥73॥
html:
mitraṃ ca me brāhmaṇaścāyamātmā priyaśca me pūjyatamaśca loke ।
taṃ bhartukāmo'hamimāṃ hariṣye nṛśaṃsānāmīdṛśānāṃ na bibhye ॥73॥
slp1: mitraM ca me brAhmaRaScAyamAtmA priyaSca me pUjyatamaSca loke । taM BartukAmo'hamimAM harizye nfSaMsAnAmIdfSAnAM na biBye ॥73॥
author: viśvāmitra uvāca ।

text: kāmaṃ narā jīvitaṃ santyajanti na cābhakṣyaiḥ pratikurvanti tatra । sarvānkāmānprāpnuvantīha vidvanpriyasva kāmaṃ sahitaḥ kṣudhā vai ॥74॥
html:
kāmaṃ narā jīvitaṃ santyajanti na cābhakṣyaiḥ pratikurvanti tatra ।
sarvānkāmānprāpnuvantīha vidvanpriyasva kāmaṃ sahitaḥ kṣudhā vai ॥74॥
slp1: kAmaM narA jIvitaM santyajanti na cABakzyEH pratikurvanti tatra । sarvAnkAmAnprApnuvantIha vidvanpriyasva kAmaM sahitaH kzuDA vE ॥74॥
author: śvapaca uvāca ।

text: sthāne tāvatsaṃśayaḥ pretyabhāve niḥsaṃśayaṃ karmaṇāṃ vā vināśaḥ । ahaṃ punarvarta ityāśayātmā mūlaṃ rakṣanbhakṣayiṣyāmyabhakṣyam ॥75॥
html:
sthāne tāvatsaṃśayaḥ pretyabhāve niḥsaṃśayaṃ karmaṇāṃ vā vināśaḥ ।
ahaṃ punarvarta ityāśayātmā mūlaṃ rakṣanbhakṣayiṣyāmyabhakṣyam ॥75॥
slp1: sTAne tAvatsaMSayaH pretyaBAve niHsaMSayaM karmaRAM vA vinASaH । ahaM punarvarta ityASayAtmA mUlaM rakzanBakzayizyAmyaBakzyam ॥75॥
author: viśvāmitra uvāca ।
