text: buddhyātmake vyastamastīti tuṣṭo mohādekatvaṃ yathā carma cakṣuḥ । yadyapyenaḥ saṃśayādācarāmi nāhaṃ bhaviṣyāmi yathā tvameva ॥76॥
html:
buddhyātmake vyastamastīti tuṣṭo mohādekatvaṃ yathā carma cakṣuḥ ।
yadyapyenaḥ saṃśayādācarāmi nāhaṃ bhaviṣyāmi yathā tvameva ॥76॥
slp1: budDyAtmake vyastamastIti tuzwo mohAdekatvaM yaTA carma cakzuH । yadyapyenaH saMSayAdAcarAmi nAhaM BavizyAmi yaTA tvameva ॥76॥

text: patanīyamidaṃ duḥkhamiti me vartate matiḥ । duṣkṛtī brāhmaṇaṃ santaṃ yastvāmahamupālabhe ॥77॥
html:
patanīyamidaṃ duḥkhamiti me vartate matiḥ ।
duṣkṛtī brāhmaṇaṃ santaṃ yastvāmahamupālabhe ॥77॥
slp1: patanIyamidaM duHKamiti me vartate matiH । duzkftI brAhmaRaM santaM yastvAmahamupAlaBe ॥77॥
author: śvapaca uvāca ।

text: pibantyevodakaṃ gāvo maṇḍūkeṣu ruvatsvapi । na te'dhikāro dharme'sti mā bhūrātmapraśaṃsakaḥ ॥78॥
html:
pibantyevodakaṃ gāvo maṇḍūkeṣu ruvatsvapi ।
na te'dhikāro dharme'sti mā bhūrātmapraśaṃsakaḥ ॥78॥
slp1: pibantyevodakaM gAvo maRqUkezu ruvatsvapi । na te'DikAro Darme'sti mA BUrAtmapraSaMsakaH ॥78॥
author: viśvāmitra uvāca ।

text: suhṛdbhūtvānuśāsmi tvā kṛpā hi tvayi me dvija । tadevaṃ śreya ādhatsva mā lobhācchvānamādithāḥ ॥79॥
html:
suhṛdbhūtvānuśāsmi tvā kṛpā hi tvayi me dvija ।
tadevaṃ śreya ādhatsva mā lobhācchvānamādithāḥ ॥79॥
slp1: suhfdBUtvAnuSAsmi tvA kfpA hi tvayi me dvija । tadevaM Sreya ADatsva mA loBAcCvAnamAdiTAH ॥79॥
author: śvapaca uvāca ।

text: suhṛnme tvaṃ sukhepsuścedāpado māṃ samuddhara । jāne'haṃ dharmato''tmānaṃ śvānīmutsṛja jāghanīm ॥80॥
html:
suhṛnme tvaṃ sukhepsuścedāpado māṃ samuddhara ।
jāne'haṃ dharmato''tmānaṃ śvānīmutsṛja jāghanīm ॥80॥
slp1: suhfnme tvaM suKepsuScedApado mAM samudDara । jAne'haM Darmato''tmAnaM SvAnImutsfja jAGanIm ॥80॥
author: viśvāmitra uvāca ।

text: naivotsahe bhavate dātumetāṃ nopekṣituṃ hriyamāṇaṃ svamannam । ubhau syāvaḥ svamalenāvaliptau dātāhaṃ ca tvaṃ ca vipra pratīcchan ॥81॥
html:
naivotsahe bhavate dātumetāṃ nopekṣituṃ hriyamāṇaṃ svamannam ।
ubhau syāvaḥ svamalenāvaliptau dātāhaṃ ca tvaṃ ca vipra pratīcchan ॥81॥
slp1: nEvotsahe Bavate dAtumetAM nopekzituM hriyamARaM svamannam । uBO syAvaH svamalenAvaliptO dAtAhaM ca tvaM ca vipra pratIcCan ॥81॥
author: śvapaca uvāca ।

text: adyāhametadvṛjinaṃ karma kṛtvā jīvaṃścariṣyāmi mahāpavitram । prapūtātmā dharmamevābhipatsye yadetayorguru tadvai bravīhi ॥82॥
html:
adyāhametadvṛjinaṃ karma kṛtvā jīvaṃścariṣyāmi mahāpavitram ।
prapūtātmā dharmamevābhipatsye yadetayorguru tadvai bravīhi ॥82॥
slp1: adyAhametadvfjinaM karma kftvA jIvaMScarizyAmi mahApavitram । prapUtAtmA DarmamevABipatsye yadetayorguru tadvE bravIhi ॥82॥
author: viśvāmitra uvāca ।

text: ātmaiva sākṣī kila lokakṛtye tvameva jānāsi yadatra duṣṭam । yo hyādriyedbhakṣyamiti śvamāṃsaṃ manye na tasyāsti vivarjanīyam ॥83॥
html:
ātmaiva sākṣī kila lokakṛtye tvameva jānāsi yadatra duṣṭam ।
yo hyādriyedbhakṣyamiti śvamāṃsaṃ manye na tasyāsti vivarjanīyam ॥83॥
slp1: AtmEva sAkzI kila lokakftye tvameva jAnAsi yadatra duzwam । yo hyAdriyedBakzyamiti SvamAMsaM manye na tasyAsti vivarjanIyam ॥83॥
author: śvapaca uvāca ।

text: upādāne khādane vāsya doṣaḥ kāryo nyāyairnityamatrāpavādaḥ । yasminna hiṃsā nānṛte vākyaleśo bhakṣyakriyā tatra na tadgarīyaḥ ॥84॥
html:
upādāne khādane vāsya doṣaḥ kāryo nyāyairnityamatrāpavādaḥ ।
yasminna hiṃsā nānṛte vākyaleśo bhakṣyakriyā tatra na tadgarīyaḥ ॥84॥
slp1: upAdAne KAdane vAsya dozaH kAryo nyAyErnityamatrApavAdaH । yasminna hiMsA nAnfte vAkyaleSo BakzyakriyA tatra na tadgarIyaH ॥84॥
author: viśvāmitra uvāca ।

text: yadyeṣa hetustava khādanasya na te vedaḥ kāraṇaṃ nānyadharmaḥ । tasmādabhakṣye bhakṣaṇādvā dvijendra doṣaṃ na paśyāmi yathedamāttha ॥85॥
html:
yadyeṣa hetustava khādanasya na te vedaḥ kāraṇaṃ nānyadharmaḥ ।
tasmādabhakṣye bhakṣaṇādvā dvijendra doṣaṃ na paśyāmi yathedamāttha ॥85॥
slp1: yadyeza hetustava KAdanasya na te vedaH kAraRaM nAnyaDarmaH । tasmAdaBakzye BakzaRAdvA dvijendra dozaM na paSyAmi yaTedamAtTa ॥85॥
author: śvapaca uvāca ।

text: na pātakaṃ bhakṣaṇamasya dṛṣṭaṃ surāṃ pītvā patatītīha śabdaḥ । anyonyakarmāṇi tathā tathaiva na leśamātreṇa kṛtyaṃ hinasti ॥86॥
html:
na pātakaṃ bhakṣaṇamasya dṛṣṭaṃ surāṃ pītvā patatītīha śabdaḥ ।
anyonyakarmāṇi tathā tathaiva na leśamātreṇa kṛtyaṃ hinasti ॥86॥
slp1: na pAtakaM BakzaRamasya dfzwaM surAM pItvA patatItIha SabdaH । anyonyakarmARi taTA taTEva na leSamAtreRa kftyaM hinasti ॥86॥
author: viśvāmitra uvāca ।

text: asthānato hīnataḥ kutsitādvā taṃ vidvāṃsaṃ bādhate sādhuvṛttam । sthānaṃ punaryo labhate niṣaṅgāttenāpi daṇḍaḥ sahitavya eva ॥87॥
html:
asthānato hīnataḥ kutsitādvā taṃ vidvāṃsaṃ bādhate sādhuvṛttam ।
sthānaṃ punaryo labhate niṣaṅgāttenāpi daṇḍaḥ sahitavya eva ॥87॥
slp1: asTAnato hInataH kutsitAdvA taM vidvAMsaM bADate sADuvfttam । sTAnaM punaryo laBate nizaNgAttenApi daRqaH sahitavya eva ॥87॥
author: śvapaca uvāca ।

text: evamuktvā nivavṛte mātaṅgaḥ kauśikaṃ tadā । viśvāmitro jahāraiva kṛtabuddhiḥ śvajāghanīm ॥88॥
html:
evamuktvā nivavṛte mātaṅgaḥ kauśikaṃ tadā ।
viśvāmitro jahāraiva kṛtabuddhiḥ śvajāghanīm ॥88॥
slp1: evamuktvA nivavfte mAtaNgaH kOSikaM tadA । viSvAmitro jahArEva kftabudDiH SvajAGanIm ॥88॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tato jagrāha pañcāṅgīṃ jīvitārthī mahāmuniḥ । sadārastāmupākṛtya vane yāto mahāmuniḥ ॥89॥
html:
tato jagrāha pañcāṅgīṃ jīvitārthī mahāmuniḥ ।
sadārastāmupākṛtya vane yāto mahāmuniḥ ॥89॥
slp1: tato jagrAha paYcANgIM jIvitArTI mahAmuniH । sadArastAmupAkftya vane yAto mahAmuniH ॥89॥

text: etasminneva kāle tu pravavarṣātha vāsavaḥ । sañjīvayanprajāḥ sarvā janayāmāsa cauṣadhīḥ ॥90॥
html:
etasminneva kāle tu pravavarṣātha vāsavaḥ ।
sañjīvayanprajāḥ sarvā janayāmāsa cauṣadhīḥ ॥90॥
slp1: etasminneva kAle tu pravavarzATa vAsavaH । saYjIvayanprajAH sarvA janayAmAsa cOzaDIH ॥90॥

text: viśvāmitro'pi bhagavāṃstapasā dagdhakilbiṣaḥ । kālena mahatā siddhimavāpa paramādbhutām ॥91॥
html:
viśvāmitro'pi bhagavāṃstapasā dagdhakilbiṣaḥ ।
kālena mahatā siddhimavāpa paramādbhutām ॥91॥
slp1: viSvAmitro'pi BagavAMstapasA dagDakilbizaH । kAlena mahatA sidDimavApa paramAdButAm ॥91॥

text: evaṃ vidvānadīnātmā vyasanastho jijīviṣuḥ । sarvopāyairupāyajño dīnamātmānamuddharet ॥92॥
html:
evaṃ vidvānadīnātmā vyasanastho jijīviṣuḥ ।
sarvopāyairupāyajño dīnamātmānamuddharet ॥92॥
slp1: evaM vidvAnadInAtmA vyasanasTo jijIvizuH । sarvopAyErupAyajYo dInamAtmAnamudDaret ॥92॥

text: etāṃ buddhiṃ samāsthāya jīvitavyaṃ sadā bhavet । jīvanpuṇyamavāpnoti naro bhadrāṇi paśyati ॥93॥
html:
etāṃ buddhiṃ samāsthāya jīvitavyaṃ sadā bhavet ।
jīvanpuṇyamavāpnoti naro bhadrāṇi paśyati ॥93॥
slp1: etAM budDiM samAsTAya jIvitavyaM sadA Bavet । jIvanpuRyamavApnoti naro BadrARi paSyati ॥93॥

text: tasmātkaunteya viduṣā dharmādharmaviniścaye । buddhimāsthāya loke'sminvartitavyaṃ yatātmanā] ॥94॥
html:
tasmātkaunteya viduṣā dharmādharmaviniścaye ।
buddhimāsthāya loke'sminvartitavyaṃ yatātmanā] ॥94॥
slp1: tasmAtkOnteya viduzA DarmADarmaviniScaye । budDimAsTAya loke'sminvartitavyaM yatAtmanA] ॥94॥

text: yadidaṃ ghoramuddiṣṭamaśraddheyamivānṛtam । asti sviddasyumaryādā yāmahaṃ parivarjaye ॥1॥
html:
yadidaṃ ghoramuddiṣṭamaśraddheyamivānṛtam ।
asti sviddasyumaryādā yāmahaṃ parivarjaye ॥1॥
slp1: yadidaM GoramuddizwamaSradDeyamivAnftam । asti sviddasyumaryAdA yAmahaM parivarjaye ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: sammuhyāmi viṣīdāmi dharmo me śithilīkṛtaḥ । udyamaṃ nādhigacchāmi kutaścitparicintayan ॥2॥
html:
sammuhyāmi viṣīdāmi dharmo me śithilīkṛtaḥ ।
udyamaṃ nādhigacchāmi kutaścitparicintayan ॥2॥
slp1: sammuhyAmi vizIdAmi Darmo me SiTilIkftaH । udyamaM nADigacCAmi kutaScitparicintayan ॥2॥

text: naitacchuddhāgamādeva tava dharmānuśāsanam । prajñāsamavatāro'yaṃ kavibhiḥ sambhṛtaṃ madhu ॥3॥
html:
naitacchuddhāgamādeva tava dharmānuśāsanam ।
prajñāsamavatāro'yaṃ kavibhiḥ sambhṛtaṃ madhu ॥3॥
slp1: nEtacCudDAgamAdeva tava DarmAnuSAsanam । prajYAsamavatAro'yaM kaviBiH samBftaM maDu ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: bahvyaḥ pratividhātavyāḥ prajñā rājñā tatastataḥ । naikaśākhena dharmeṇa yātraiṣā sampravartate ॥4॥
html:
bahvyaḥ pratividhātavyāḥ prajñā rājñā tatastataḥ ।
naikaśākhena dharmeṇa yātraiṣā sampravartate ॥4॥
slp1: bahvyaH prativiDAtavyAH prajYA rAjYA tatastataH । nEkaSAKena DarmeRa yAtrEzA sampravartate ॥4॥

text: buddhisañjananaṃ rājñāṃ dharmamācaratāṃ sadā । jayo bhavati kauravya tadā tadviddhi me vacaḥ ॥5॥
html:
buddhisañjananaṃ rājñāṃ dharmamācaratāṃ sadā ।
jayo bhavati kauravya tadā tadviddhi me vacaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: budDisaYjananaM rAjYAM DarmamAcaratAM sadA । jayo Bavati kOravya tadA tadvidDi me vacaH ॥5॥

text: buddhiśreṣṭhā hi rājāno jayanti vijayaiṣiṇaḥ । dharmaḥ pratividhātavyo buddhyā rājñā tatastataḥ ॥6॥
html:
buddhiśreṣṭhā hi rājāno jayanti vijayaiṣiṇaḥ ।
dharmaḥ pratividhātavyo buddhyā rājñā tatastataḥ ॥6॥
slp1: budDiSrezWA hi rAjAno jayanti vijayEziRaH । DarmaH prativiDAtavyo budDyA rAjYA tatastataH ॥6॥

text: naikaśākhena dharmeṇa rājñāṃ dharmo vidhīyate । durbalasya kutaḥ prajñā purastādanudāhṛtā ॥7॥
html:
naikaśākhena dharmeṇa rājñāṃ dharmo vidhīyate ।
durbalasya kutaḥ prajñā purastādanudāhṛtā ॥7॥
slp1: nEkaSAKena DarmeRa rAjYAM Darmo viDIyate । durbalasya kutaH prajYA purastAdanudAhftA ॥7॥

text: advaidhajñaḥ pathi dvaidhe saṃśayaṃ prāptumarhati । buddhidvaidhaṃ veditavyaṃ purastādeva bhārata ॥8॥
html:
advaidhajñaḥ pathi dvaidhe saṃśayaṃ prāptumarhati ।
buddhidvaidhaṃ veditavyaṃ purastādeva bhārata ॥8॥
slp1: advEDajYaH paTi dvEDe saMSayaM prAptumarhati । budDidvEDaM veditavyaM purastAdeva BArata ॥8॥

text: pārśvataḥkaraṇaṃ prajñā viṣūcī tvāpagā iva । janastūccāritaṃ dharmaṃ vijānātyanyathānyathā ॥9॥
html:
pārśvataḥkaraṇaṃ prajñā viṣūcī tvāpagā iva ।
janastūccāritaṃ dharmaṃ vijānātyanyathānyathā ॥9॥
slp1: pArSvataHkaraRaM prajYA vizUcI tvApagA iva । janastUccAritaM DarmaM vijAnAtyanyaTAnyaTA ॥9॥

text: samyagvijñāninaḥ kecinmithyāvijñānino'pare । tadvai yathātathaṃ buddhvā jñānamādadate satām ॥10॥
html:
samyagvijñāninaḥ kecinmithyāvijñānino'pare ।
tadvai yathātathaṃ buddhvā jñānamādadate satām ॥10॥
slp1: samyagvijYAninaH kecinmiTyAvijYAnino'pare । tadvE yaTAtaTaM budDvA jYAnamAdadate satAm ॥10॥

text: parimuṣṇanti śāstrāṇi dharmasya paripanthinaḥ । vaiṣamyamarthavidyānāṃ nairarthyātkhyāpayanti te ॥11॥
html:
parimuṣṇanti śāstrāṇi dharmasya paripanthinaḥ ।
vaiṣamyamarthavidyānāṃ nairarthyātkhyāpayanti te ॥11॥
slp1: parimuzRanti SAstrARi Darmasya paripanTinaH । vEzamyamarTavidyAnAM nErarTyAtKyApayanti te ॥11॥

text: ājijīviṣavo vidyāṃ yaśaskāmāḥ samantataḥ । te sarve narapāpiṣṭhā dharmasya paripanthinaḥ ॥12॥
html:
ājijīviṣavo vidyāṃ yaśaskāmāḥ samantataḥ ।
te sarve narapāpiṣṭhā dharmasya paripanthinaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: AjijIvizavo vidyAM yaSaskAmAH samantataH । te sarve narapApizWA Darmasya paripanTinaH ॥12॥

text: apakvamatayo mandā na jānanti yathātatham । sadā hyaśāstrakuśalāḥ sarvatrāpariniṣṭhitāḥ ॥13॥
html:
apakvamatayo mandā na jānanti yathātatham ।
sadā hyaśāstrakuśalāḥ sarvatrāpariniṣṭhitāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: apakvamatayo mandA na jAnanti yaTAtaTam । sadA hyaSAstrakuSalAH sarvatrAparinizWitAH ॥13॥

text: parimuṣṇanti śāstrāṇi śāstradoṣānudarśinaḥ । vijñānamatha vidyānāṃ na samyagiti vartate ॥14॥
html:
parimuṣṇanti śāstrāṇi śāstradoṣānudarśinaḥ ।
vijñānamatha vidyānāṃ na samyagiti vartate ॥14॥
slp1: parimuzRanti SAstrARi SAstradozAnudarSinaH । vijYAnamaTa vidyAnAM na samyagiti vartate ॥14॥

text: nindayā paravidyānāṃ svāṃ vidyāṃ khyāpayanti ye । vāgastrā vākchurīmattvā dugdhavidyāphalā iva । tānvidyāvaṇijo viddhi rākṣasāniva bhārata ॥15॥
html:
nindayā paravidyānāṃ svāṃ vidyāṃ khyāpayanti ye ।
vāgastrā vākchurīmattvā dugdhavidyāphalā iva ।
tānvidyāvaṇijo viddhi rākṣasāniva bhārata ॥15॥
slp1: nindayA paravidyAnAM svAM vidyAM KyApayanti ye । vAgastrA vAkCurImattvA dugDavidyAPalA iva । tAnvidyAvaRijo vidDi rAkzasAniva BArata ॥15॥

text: vyājena kṛtsno vidito dharmaste parihāsyate । na dharmavacanaṃ vācā na buddhyā ceti naḥ śrutam ॥16॥
html:
vyājena kṛtsno vidito dharmaste parihāsyate ।
na dharmavacanaṃ vācā na buddhyā ceti naḥ śrutam ॥16॥
slp1: vyAjena kftsno vidito Darmaste parihAsyate । na DarmavacanaM vAcA na budDyA ceti naH Srutam ॥16॥

text: iti bārhaspataṃ jñānaṃ provāca maghavā svayam । na tveva vacanaṃ kiñcidanimittādihocyate ॥17॥
html:
iti bārhaspataṃ jñānaṃ provāca maghavā svayam ।
na tveva vacanaṃ kiñcidanimittādihocyate ॥17॥
slp1: iti bArhaspataM jYAnaM provAca maGavA svayam । na tveva vacanaM kiYcidanimittAdihocyate ॥17॥

text: svavinītena śāstreṇa vyavasyanti tathāpare । lokayātrāmihaike tu dharmamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥18॥
html:
svavinītena śāstreṇa vyavasyanti tathāpare ।
lokayātrāmihaike tu dharmamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: svavinItena SAstreRa vyavasyanti taTApare । lokayAtrAmihEke tu DarmamAhurmanIziRaH ॥18॥

text: samuddiṣṭaṃ satāṃ dharmaṃ svayamūhenna paṇḍitaḥ । amarṣācchāstrasammohādavijñānācca bhārata ॥19॥
html:
samuddiṣṭaṃ satāṃ dharmaṃ svayamūhenna paṇḍitaḥ ।
amarṣācchāstrasammohādavijñānācca bhārata ॥19॥
slp1: samuddizwaM satAM DarmaM svayamUhenna paRqitaH । amarzAcCAstrasammohAdavijYAnAcca BArata ॥19॥

text: śāstraṃ prājñasya vadataḥ samūhe yātyadarśanam । āgatāgamayā buddhyā vacanena praśasyate ॥20॥
html:
śāstraṃ prājñasya vadataḥ samūhe yātyadarśanam ।
āgatāgamayā buddhyā vacanena praśasyate ॥20॥
slp1: SAstraM prAjYasya vadataH samUhe yAtyadarSanam । AgatAgamayA budDyA vacanena praSasyate ॥20॥

text: ajñānājjñānahetutvādvacanaṃ sādhu manyate । anapāhatamevedaṃ nedaṃ śāstramapārthakam ॥21॥
html:
ajñānājjñānahetutvādvacanaṃ sādhu manyate ।
anapāhatamevedaṃ nedaṃ śāstramapārthakam ॥21॥
slp1: ajYAnAjjYAnahetutvAdvacanaM sADu manyate । anapAhatamevedaM nedaM SAstramapArTakam ॥21॥

text: daiteyānuśanāḥ prāha saṃśayacchedane purā । jñānamavyapadeśyaṃ hi yathā nāsti tathaiva tat ॥22॥
html:
daiteyānuśanāḥ prāha saṃśayacchedane purā ।
jñānamavyapadeśyaṃ hi yathā nāsti tathaiva tat ॥22॥
slp1: dEteyAnuSanAH prAha saMSayacCedane purA । jYAnamavyapadeSyaM hi yaTA nAsti taTEva tat ॥22॥

text: tena tvaṃ chinnamūlena kaṃ toṣayitumarhasi । atathyavihitaṃ yo vā nedaṃ vākyamupāśnuyāt ॥23॥
html:
tena tvaṃ chinnamūlena kaṃ toṣayitumarhasi ।
atathyavihitaṃ yo vā nedaṃ vākyamupāśnuyāt ॥23॥
slp1: tena tvaM CinnamUlena kaM tozayitumarhasi । ataTyavihitaM yo vA nedaM vAkyamupASnuyAt ॥23॥

text: ugrāyaiva hi sṛṣṭo'si karmaṇe na tvavekṣase । aṅgemāmanvavekṣasva rājanītiṃ bubhūṣitum । yayā pramucyate tvanyo yadarthaṃ ca pramodate ॥24॥
html:
ugrāyaiva hi sṛṣṭo'si karmaṇe na tvavekṣase ।
aṅgemāmanvavekṣasva rājanītiṃ bubhūṣitum ।
yayā pramucyate tvanyo yadarthaṃ ca pramodate ॥24॥
slp1: ugrAyEva hi sfzwo'si karmaRe na tvavekzase । aNgemAmanvavekzasva rAjanItiM buBUzitum । yayA pramucyate tvanyo yadarTaM ca pramodate ॥24॥

text: ajo'śvaḥ kṣatramityetatsadṛśaṃ brahmaṇā kṛtam । tasmānnatīkṣṇabhūtānāṃ yātrā kācitprasidhyati ॥25॥
html:
ajo'śvaḥ kṣatramityetatsadṛśaṃ brahmaṇā kṛtam ।
tasmānnatīkṣṇabhūtānāṃ yātrā kācitprasidhyati ॥25॥
slp1: ajo'SvaH kzatramityetatsadfSaM brahmaRA kftam । tasmAnnatIkzRaBUtAnAM yAtrA kAcitprasiDyati ॥25॥

text: yastvavadhyavadhe doṣaḥ sa vadhyasyāvadhe smṛtaḥ । eṣaiva khalu maryādā yāmayaṃ parivarjayet ॥26॥
html:
yastvavadhyavadhe doṣaḥ sa vadhyasyāvadhe smṛtaḥ ।
eṣaiva khalu maryādā yāmayaṃ parivarjayet ॥26॥
slp1: yastvavaDyavaDe dozaH sa vaDyasyAvaDe smftaH । ezEva Kalu maryAdA yAmayaM parivarjayet ॥26॥

text: tasmāttīkṣṇaḥ prajā rājā svadharme sthāpayeduta । anyonyaṃ bhakṣayanto hi pracareyurvṛkā iva ॥27॥
html:
tasmāttīkṣṇaḥ prajā rājā svadharme sthāpayeduta ।
anyonyaṃ bhakṣayanto hi pracareyurvṛkā iva ॥27॥
slp1: tasmAttIkzRaH prajA rAjA svaDarme sTApayeduta । anyonyaM Bakzayanto hi pracareyurvfkA iva ॥27॥

text: yasya dasyugaṇā rāṣṭre dhvāṅkṣā matsyāñjalādiva । viharanti parasvāni sa vai kṣatriyapāṃsanaḥ ॥28॥
html:
yasya dasyugaṇā rāṣṭre dhvāṅkṣā matsyāñjalādiva ।
viharanti parasvāni sa vai kṣatriyapāṃsanaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: yasya dasyugaRA rAzwre DvANkzA matsyAYjalAdiva । viharanti parasvAni sa vE kzatriyapAMsanaH ॥28॥

text: kulīnānsacivānkṛtvā vedavidyāsamanvitān । praśādhi pṛthivīṃ rājanprajā dharmeṇa pālayan ॥29॥
html:
kulīnānsacivānkṛtvā vedavidyāsamanvitān ।
praśādhi pṛthivīṃ rājanprajā dharmeṇa pālayan ॥29॥
slp1: kulInAnsacivAnkftvA vedavidyAsamanvitAn । praSADi pfTivIM rAjanprajA DarmeRa pAlayan ॥29॥

text: vihīnajamakarmāṇaṃ yaḥ pragṛhṇāti bhūmipaḥ । ubhayasyāviśeṣajñastadvai kṣatraṃ napuṃsakam ॥30॥
html:
vihīnajamakarmāṇaṃ yaḥ pragṛhṇāti bhūmipaḥ ।
ubhayasyāviśeṣajñastadvai kṣatraṃ napuṃsakam ॥30॥
slp1: vihInajamakarmARaM yaH pragfhRAti BUmipaH । uBayasyAviSezajYastadvE kzatraM napuMsakam ॥30॥

text: naivograṃ naiva cānugraṃ dharmeṇeha praśasyate । ubhayaṃ na vyatikrāmedugro bhūtvā mṛdurbhava ॥31॥
html:
naivograṃ naiva cānugraṃ dharmeṇeha praśasyate ।
ubhayaṃ na vyatikrāmedugro bhūtvā mṛdurbhava ॥31॥
slp1: nEvograM nEva cAnugraM DarmeReha praSasyate । uBayaM na vyatikrAmedugro BUtvA mfdurBava ॥31॥

text: kaṣṭaḥ kṣatriyadharmo'yaṃ sauhṛdaṃ tvayi yatsthitam । ugre karmaṇi sṛṣṭo'si tasmādrājyaṃ praśādhi vai ॥32॥
html:
kaṣṭaḥ kṣatriyadharmo'yaṃ sauhṛdaṃ tvayi yatsthitam ।
ugre karmaṇi sṛṣṭo'si tasmādrājyaṃ praśādhi vai ॥32॥
slp1: kazwaH kzatriyaDarmo'yaM sOhfdaM tvayi yatsTitam । ugre karmaRi sfzwo'si tasmAdrAjyaM praSADi vE ॥32॥

text: aśiṣṭanigraho nityaṃ śiṣṭasya paripālanam । iti śakro'bravīddhīmānāpatsu bharatarṣabha ॥33॥
html:
aśiṣṭanigraho nityaṃ śiṣṭasya paripālanam ।
iti śakro'bravīddhīmānāpatsu bharatarṣabha ॥33॥
slp1: aSizwanigraho nityaM Sizwasya paripAlanam । iti Sakro'bravIdDImAnApatsu BaratarzaBa ॥33॥

text: asti sviddasyumaryādā yāmanyo nātilaṅghayet । pṛcchāmi tvāṃ satāṃ śreṣṭha tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥34॥
html:
asti sviddasyumaryādā yāmanyo nātilaṅghayet ।
pṛcchāmi tvāṃ satāṃ śreṣṭha tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥34॥
slp1: asti sviddasyumaryAdA yAmanyo nAtilaNGayet । pfcCAmi tvAM satAM SrezWa tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥34॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: brāhmaṇāneva seveta vidyāvṛddhāṃstapasvinaḥ । śrutacāritravṛttāḍhyānpavitraṃ hyetaduttamam ॥35॥
html:
brāhmaṇāneva seveta vidyāvṛddhāṃstapasvinaḥ ।
śrutacāritravṛttāḍhyānpavitraṃ hyetaduttamam ॥35॥
slp1: brAhmaRAneva seveta vidyAvfdDAMstapasvinaH । SrutacAritravfttAQyAnpavitraM hyetaduttamam ॥35॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yā devatāsu vṛttiste sāstu vipreṣu sarvadā । kruddhairhi vipraiḥ karmāṇi kṛtāni bahudhā nṛpa ॥36॥
html:
yā devatāsu vṛttiste sāstu vipreṣu sarvadā ।
kruddhairhi vipraiḥ karmāṇi kṛtāni bahudhā nṛpa ॥36॥
slp1: yA devatAsu vfttiste sAstu viprezu sarvadA । krudDErhi viprEH karmARi kftAni bahuDA nfpa ॥36॥

text: teṣāṃ prītyā yaśo mukhyamaprītyā tu viparyayaḥ । prītyā hyamṛtavadviprāḥ kruddhāścaiva yathā viṣam] ॥37॥
html:
teṣāṃ prītyā yaśo mukhyamaprītyā tu viparyayaḥ ।
prītyā hyamṛtavadviprāḥ kruddhāścaiva yathā viṣam] ॥37॥
slp1: tezAM prItyA yaSo muKyamaprItyA tu viparyayaH । prItyA hyamftavadviprAH krudDAScEva yaTA vizam] ॥37॥

text: pitāmaha mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada । śaraṇaṃ pālayānasya yo dharmastaṃ vadasva me ॥1॥
html:
pitāmaha mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada ।
śaraṇaṃ pālayānasya yo dharmastaṃ vadasva me ॥1॥
slp1: pitAmaha mahAprAjYa sarvaSAstraviSArada । SaraRaM pAlayAnasya yo DarmastaM vadasva me ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: mahāndharmo mahārāja śaraṇāgatapālane । arhaḥ praṣṭuṃ bhavāṃścaiva praśnaṃ bharatasattama ॥2॥
html:
mahāndharmo mahārāja śaraṇāgatapālane ।
arhaḥ praṣṭuṃ bhavāṃścaiva praśnaṃ bharatasattama ॥2॥
slp1: mahAnDarmo mahArAja SaraRAgatapAlane । arhaH prazwuM BavAMScEva praSnaM Baratasattama ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: nṛgaprabhṛtayo rājanrājānaḥ śaraṇāgatān । paripālya mahārāja saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ ॥3॥
html:
nṛgaprabhṛtayo rājanrājānaḥ śaraṇāgatān ।
paripālya mahārāja saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: nfgapraBftayo rAjanrAjAnaH SaraRAgatAn । paripAlya mahArAja saMsidDiM paramAM gatAH ॥3॥

text: śrūyate hi kapotena śatruḥ śaraṇamāgataḥ । pūjitaśca yathānyāyaṃ svaiśca māṃsairnimantritaḥ ॥4॥
html:
śrūyate hi kapotena śatruḥ śaraṇamāgataḥ ।
pūjitaśca yathānyāyaṃ svaiśca māṃsairnimantritaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: SrUyate hi kapotena SatruH SaraRamAgataH । pUjitaSca yaTAnyAyaM svESca mAMsErnimantritaH ॥4॥

text: kathaṃ kapotena purā śatruḥ śaraṇamāgataḥ । svamāṃsairbhojitaḥ kāṃ ca gatiṃ lebhe sa bhārata ॥5॥
html:
kathaṃ kapotena purā śatruḥ śaraṇamāgataḥ ।
svamāṃsairbhojitaḥ kāṃ ca gatiṃ lebhe sa bhārata ॥5॥
slp1: kaTaM kapotena purA SatruH SaraRamAgataH । svamAMsErBojitaH kAM ca gatiM leBe sa BArata ॥5॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: śṛṇu rājankathāṃ divyāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm । nṛpatermucukundasya kathitāṃ bhārgaveṇa ha ॥6॥
html:
śṛṇu rājankathāṃ divyāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm ।
nṛpatermucukundasya kathitāṃ bhārgaveṇa ha ॥6॥
slp1: SfRu rAjankaTAM divyAM sarvapApapraRASinIm । nfpatermucukundasya kaTitAM BArgaveRa ha ॥6॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: imamarthaṃ purā pārtha mucukundo narādhipaḥ । bhārgavaṃ paripapraccha praṇato bharatarṣabha ॥7॥
html:
imamarthaṃ purā pārtha mucukundo narādhipaḥ ।
bhārgavaṃ paripapraccha praṇato bharatarṣabha ॥7॥
slp1: imamarTaM purA pArTa mucukundo narADipaH । BArgavaM paripapracCa praRato BaratarzaBa ॥7॥

text: tasmai śuśrūṣamāṇāya bhārgavo'kathayatkathām । iyaṃ yathā kapotena siddhiḥ prāptā narādhipa ॥8॥
html:
tasmai śuśrūṣamāṇāya bhārgavo'kathayatkathām ।
iyaṃ yathā kapotena siddhiḥ prāptā narādhipa ॥8॥
slp1: tasmE SuSrUzamARAya BArgavo'kaTayatkaTAm । iyaM yaTA kapotena sidDiH prAptA narADipa ॥8॥

text: dharmaniścayasaṃyuktāṃ kāmārthasahitāṃ kathām । śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājangadato me mahābhuja ॥9॥
html:
dharmaniścayasaṃyuktāṃ kāmārthasahitāṃ kathām ।
śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājangadato me mahābhuja ॥9॥
slp1: DarmaniScayasaMyuktAM kAmArTasahitAM kaTAm । SfRuzvAvahito rAjangadato me mahABuja ॥9॥

text: kaścitkṣudrasamācāraḥ pṛthivyāṃ kālasammataḥ । cacāra pṛthivīṃ pāpo ghoraḥ śakunilubdhakaḥ ॥10॥
html:
kaścitkṣudrasamācāraḥ pṛthivyāṃ kālasammataḥ ।
cacāra pṛthivīṃ pāpo ghoraḥ śakunilubdhakaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: kaScitkzudrasamAcAraH pfTivyAM kAlasammataH । cacAra pfTivIM pApo GoraH SakunilubDakaH ॥10॥

text: kākola iva kṛṣṇāṅgo rūkṣaḥ pāpasamāhitaḥ । yavamadhyaḥ kṛśagrīvo hrasvapādo mahāhanuḥ ॥11॥
html:
kākola iva kṛṣṇāṅgo rūkṣaḥ pāpasamāhitaḥ ।
yavamadhyaḥ kṛśagrīvo hrasvapādo mahāhanuḥ ॥11॥
slp1: kAkola iva kfzRANgo rUkzaH pApasamAhitaH । yavamaDyaH kfSagrIvo hrasvapAdo mahAhanuH ॥11॥

text: naiva tasya suhṛtkaścinna sambandhī na bāndhavaḥ । sa hi taiḥ samparityaktastena ghoreṇa karmaṇā ॥12॥
html:
naiva tasya suhṛtkaścinna sambandhī na bāndhavaḥ ।
sa hi taiḥ samparityaktastena ghoreṇa karmaṇā ॥12॥
slp1: nEva tasya suhftkaScinna sambanDI na bAnDavaH । sa hi tEH samparityaktastena GoreRa karmaRA ॥12॥

text: sa vai kṣārakamādāya dvijānhatvā vane sadā । cakāra vikrayaṃ teṣāṃ pataṅgānāṃ narādhipa ॥13॥
html:
sa vai kṣārakamādāya dvijānhatvā vane sadā ।
cakāra vikrayaṃ teṣāṃ pataṅgānāṃ narādhipa ॥13॥
slp1: sa vE kzArakamAdAya dvijAnhatvA vane sadA । cakAra vikrayaM tezAM pataNgAnAM narADipa ॥13॥

text: evaṃ tu vartamānasya tasya vṛttiṃ durātmanaḥ । agamatsumahānkālo na cādharmamabudhyata ॥14॥
html:
evaṃ tu vartamānasya tasya vṛttiṃ durātmanaḥ ।
agamatsumahānkālo na cādharmamabudhyata ॥14॥
slp1: evaM tu vartamAnasya tasya vfttiM durAtmanaH । agamatsumahAnkAlo na cADarmamabuDyata ॥14॥

text: tasya bhāryāsahāyasya ramamāṇasya śāśvatam । daivayogavimūḍhasya nānyā vṛttirarocata ॥15॥
html:
tasya bhāryāsahāyasya ramamāṇasya śāśvatam ।
daivayogavimūḍhasya nānyā vṛttirarocata ॥15॥
slp1: tasya BAryAsahAyasya ramamARasya SASvatam । dEvayogavimUQasya nAnyA vfttirarocata ॥15॥

text: tataḥ kadācittasyātha vanasthasya samudgataḥ । pātayanniva vṛkṣāṃstānsumahānvātasambhramaḥ ॥16॥
html:
tataḥ kadācittasyātha vanasthasya samudgataḥ ।
pātayanniva vṛkṣāṃstānsumahānvātasambhramaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: tataH kadAcittasyATa vanasTasya samudgataH । pAtayanniva vfkzAMstAnsumahAnvAtasamBramaH ॥16॥

text: meghasaṅkulamākāśaṃ vidyunmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam । sañchannaṃ sumuhūrtena nausthāneneva sāgaraḥ ॥17॥
html:
meghasaṅkulamākāśaṃ vidyunmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam ।
sañchannaṃ sumuhūrtena nausthāneneva sāgaraḥ ॥17॥
slp1: meGasaNkulamAkASaM vidyunmaRqalamaRqitam । saYCannaM sumuhUrtena nOsTAneneva sAgaraH ॥17॥

text: vāridhārāsamūhaiśca saṃprahṛṣṭaḥ śatakratuḥ । kṣaṇena pūrayāmāsa salilena vasundharām ॥18॥
html:
vāridhārāsamūhaiśca saṃprahṛṣṭaḥ śatakratuḥ ।
kṣaṇena pūrayāmāsa salilena vasundharām ॥18॥
slp1: vAriDArAsamUhESca saMprahfzwaH SatakratuH । kzaRena pUrayAmAsa salilena vasunDarAm ॥18॥

text: tato dhārākule loke saṃbhramannaṣṭacetanaḥ । śītārtastadvanaṃ sarvamākulenāntarātmanā ॥19॥
html:
tato dhārākule loke saṃbhramannaṣṭacetanaḥ ।
śītārtastadvanaṃ sarvamākulenāntarātmanā ॥19॥
slp1: tato DArAkule loke saMBramannazwacetanaH । SItArtastadvanaM sarvamAkulenAntarAtmanA ॥19॥

text: naiva nimnaṃ sthalaṃ vāpi so'vindata vihaṅgahā । pūrito hi jalaughena mārgastasya vanasya vai ॥20॥
html:
naiva nimnaṃ sthalaṃ vāpi so'vindata vihaṅgahā ।
pūrito hi jalaughena mārgastasya vanasya vai ॥20॥
slp1: nEva nimnaM sTalaM vApi so'vindata vihaNgahA । pUrito hi jalOGena mArgastasya vanasya vE ॥20॥

text: pakṣiṇo vātavegena hatā līnāstadābhavan । mṛgāḥ siṃhā varāhāśca sthalānyāśritya tasthire ॥21॥
html:
pakṣiṇo vātavegena hatā līnāstadābhavan ।
mṛgāḥ siṃhā varāhāśca sthalānyāśritya tasthire ॥21॥
slp1: pakziRo vAtavegena hatA lInAstadABavan । mfgAH siMhA varAhASca sTalAnyASritya tasTire ॥21॥

text: mahatā vātavarṣeṇa trāsitāste vanaukasaḥ । bhayārtāśca kṣudhārtāśca babhramuḥ sahitā vane ॥22॥
html:
mahatā vātavarṣeṇa trāsitāste vanaukasaḥ ।
bhayārtāśca kṣudhārtāśca babhramuḥ sahitā vane ॥22॥
slp1: mahatA vAtavarzeRa trAsitAste vanOkasaH । BayArtASca kzuDArtASca baBramuH sahitA vane ॥22॥

text: sa tu śītahatairgātrairjagāmaiva na tasthivān । so'paśyadvanaṣaṇḍeṣu meghanīlaṃ vanaspatim ॥23॥
html:
sa tu śītahatairgātrairjagāmaiva na tasthivān ।
so'paśyadvanaṣaṇḍeṣu meghanīlaṃ vanaspatim ॥23॥
slp1: sa tu SItahatErgAtrErjagAmEva na tasTivAn । so'paSyadvanazaRqezu meGanIlaM vanaspatim ॥23॥

text: tārāḍhyaṃ kumudākāramākāśaṃ nirmalaṃ ca ha । meghairmuktaṃ nabho dṛṣṭvā lubdhakaḥ śītavihvalaḥ ॥24॥
html:
tārāḍhyaṃ kumudākāramākāśaṃ nirmalaṃ ca ha ।
meghairmuktaṃ nabho dṛṣṭvā lubdhakaḥ śītavihvalaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: tArAQyaM kumudAkAramAkASaM nirmalaM ca ha । meGErmuktaM naBo dfzwvA lubDakaH SItavihvalaH ॥24॥

text: diśo'valokayāmāsa velāṃ caiva durātmavān । dūre grāmaniveśaśca tasmāddeśāditi prabho । kṛtabuddhirvane tasminvastuṃ tāṃ rajanīṃ tadā ॥25॥
html:
diśo'valokayāmāsa velāṃ caiva durātmavān ।
dūre grāmaniveśaśca tasmāddeśāditi prabho ।
kṛtabuddhirvane tasminvastuṃ tāṃ rajanīṃ tadā ॥25॥
slp1: diSo'valokayAmAsa velAM cEva durAtmavAn । dUre grAmaniveSaSca tasmAddeSAditi praBo । kftabudDirvane tasminvastuM tAM rajanIM tadA ॥25॥

text: so'ñjaliṃ prayataḥ kṛtvā vākyamāha vanaspatim । śaraṇaṃ yāmi yānyasmindaivatānīha bhārata ॥26॥
html:
so'ñjaliṃ prayataḥ kṛtvā vākyamāha vanaspatim ।
śaraṇaṃ yāmi yānyasmindaivatānīha bhārata ॥26॥
slp1: so'YjaliM prayataH kftvA vAkyamAha vanaspatim । SaraRaM yAmi yAnyasmindEvatAnIha BArata ॥26॥

text: sa śilāyāṃ śiraḥ kṛtvā parṇānyāstīrya bhūtale । duḥkhena mahatāviṣṭastataḥ suṣvāpa pakṣihā] ॥27॥
html:
sa śilāyāṃ śiraḥ kṛtvā parṇānyāstīrya bhūtale ।
duḥkhena mahatāviṣṭastataḥ suṣvāpa pakṣihā] ॥27॥
slp1: sa SilAyAM SiraH kftvA parRAnyAstIrya BUtale । duHKena mahatAvizwastataH suzvApa pakzihA] ॥27॥

text: atha vṛkṣasya śākhāyāṃ vihaṅgaḥ sasuhṛjjanaḥ । dīrghakāloṣito rājaṃstatra citratanūruhaḥ ॥1॥
html:
atha vṛkṣasya śākhāyāṃ vihaṅgaḥ sasuhṛjjanaḥ ।
dīrghakāloṣito rājaṃstatra citratanūruhaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: aTa vfkzasya SAKAyAM vihaNgaH sasuhfjjanaH । dIrGakAlozito rAjaMstatra citratanUruhaH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tasya kālyaṃ gatā bhāryā carituṃ nābhyavartata । prāptāṃ ca rajanīṃ dṛṣṭvā sa pakṣī paryatapyata ॥2॥
html:
tasya kālyaṃ gatā bhāryā carituṃ nābhyavartata ।
prāptāṃ ca rajanīṃ dṛṣṭvā sa pakṣī paryatapyata ॥2॥
slp1: tasya kAlyaM gatA BAryA carituM nAByavartata । prAptAM ca rajanIM dfzwvA sa pakzI paryatapyata ॥2॥

text: vātavarṣaṃ mahaccāsīnna cāgacchati me priyā । kiṃ nu tatkāraṇaṃ yena sādyāpi na nivartate ॥3॥
html:
vātavarṣaṃ mahaccāsīnna cāgacchati me priyā ।
kiṃ nu tatkāraṇaṃ yena sādyāpi na nivartate ॥3॥
slp1: vAtavarzaM mahaccAsInna cAgacCati me priyA । kiM nu tatkAraRaM yena sAdyApi na nivartate ॥3॥

text: api svasti bhavettasyāḥ priyāyā mama kānane । tayā virahitaṃ hīdaṃ śūnyamadya gṛhaṃ mama ॥4॥
html:
api svasti bhavettasyāḥ priyāyā mama kānane ।
tayā virahitaṃ hīdaṃ śūnyamadya gṛhaṃ mama ॥4॥
slp1: api svasti BavettasyAH priyAyA mama kAnane । tayA virahitaM hIdaM SUnyamadya gfhaM mama ॥4॥

text: yadi sā raktanetrāntā citrāṅgī madhurasvarā । adya nābhyeti me kāntā na kāryaṃ jīvitena me ॥5॥
html:
yadi sā raktanetrāntā citrāṅgī madhurasvarā ।
adya nābhyeti me kāntā na kāryaṃ jīvitena me ॥5॥
slp1: yadi sA raktanetrAntA citrANgI maDurasvarA । adya nAByeti me kAntA na kAryaM jIvitena me ॥5॥

text: patidharmaratā sādhvī prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī । sā hi śrāntaṃ kṣudhārtaṃ ca jānīte māṃ tapasvinī ॥6॥
html:
patidharmaratā sādhvī prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī ।
sā hi śrāntaṃ kṣudhārtaṃ ca jānīte māṃ tapasvinī ॥6॥
slp1: patiDarmaratA sADvI prAReByo'pi garIyasI । sA hi SrAntaM kzuDArtaM ca jAnIte mAM tapasvinI ॥6॥

text: anuraktā hitā caiva snigdhā caiva pativratā । yasya vai tādṛśī bhāryā dhanyaḥ sa manujo bhuvi ॥7॥
html:
anuraktā hitā caiva snigdhā caiva pativratā ।
yasya vai tādṛśī bhāryā dhanyaḥ sa manujo bhuvi ॥7॥
slp1: anuraktA hitA cEva snigDA cEva pativratA । yasya vE tAdfSI BAryA DanyaH sa manujo Buvi ॥7॥

text: bhāryā hi paramo nāthaḥ puruṣasyeha paṭhyate । asahāyasya loke'smiṁllokayātrāsahāyinī ॥8॥
html:
bhāryā hi paramo nāthaḥ puruṣasyeha paṭhyate ।
asahāyasya loke'smiṁllokayātrāsahāyinī ॥8॥
slp1: BAryA hi paramo nATaH puruzasyeha paWyate । asahAyasya loke'smiṁllokayAtrAsahAyinI ॥8॥

text: tathā rogābhibhūtasya nityaṃ kṛcchragatasya ca । nāsti bhāryāsamaṃ kiñcinnarasyārtasya bheṣajam ॥9॥
html:
tathā rogābhibhūtasya nityaṃ kṛcchragatasya ca ।
nāsti bhāryāsamaṃ kiñcinnarasyārtasya bheṣajam ॥9॥
slp1: taTA rogABiBUtasya nityaM kfcCragatasya ca । nAsti BAryAsamaM kiYcinnarasyArtasya Bezajam ॥9॥

text: nāsti bhāryāsamo bandhurnāsti bhāryāsamā gatiḥ । nāsti bhāryāsamo loke sahāyo dharmasādhanaḥ ॥10॥
html:
nāsti bhāryāsamo bandhurnāsti bhāryāsamā gatiḥ ।
nāsti bhāryāsamo loke sahāyo dharmasādhanaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: nAsti BAryAsamo banDurnAsti BAryAsamA gatiH । nAsti BAryAsamo loke sahAyo DarmasADanaH ॥10॥

text: evaṃ vilapatastasya dvijasyārtasya tatra vai । gṛhītā śakunaghnena bhāryā śuśrāva bhāratīm ॥11॥
html:
evaṃ vilapatastasya dvijasyārtasya tatra vai ।
gṛhītā śakunaghnena bhāryā śuśrāva bhāratīm ॥11॥
slp1: evaM vilapatastasya dvijasyArtasya tatra vE । gfhItA SakunaGnena BAryA SuSrAva BAratIm ॥11॥

text: na sā strītyabhibhāṣā syādyasyā bhartā na tuṣyati । agnisākṣikamapyetadbhartā hi śaraṇaṃ striyaḥ ॥12॥
html:
na sā strītyabhibhāṣā syādyasyā bhartā na tuṣyati ।
agnisākṣikamapyetadbhartā hi śaraṇaṃ striyaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: na sA strItyaBiBAzA syAdyasyA BartA na tuzyati । agnisAkzikamapyetadBartA hi SaraRaM striyaH ॥12॥

text: iti sañcintya duḥkhārtā bhartāraṃ duḥkhitaṃ tadā । kapotī lubdhakenātha yattā vacanamabravīt ॥13॥
html:
iti sañcintya duḥkhārtā bhartāraṃ duḥkhitaṃ tadā ।
kapotī lubdhakenātha yattā vacanamabravīt ॥13॥
slp1: iti saYcintya duHKArtA BartAraM duHKitaM tadA । kapotI lubDakenATa yattA vacanamabravIt ॥13॥

text: hanta vakṣyāmi te śreyaḥ śrutvā ca kuru tattathā । śaraṇāgatasantrātā bhava kānta viśeṣataḥ ॥14॥
html:
hanta vakṣyāmi te śreyaḥ śrutvā ca kuru tattathā ।
śaraṇāgatasantrātā bhava kānta viśeṣataḥ ॥14॥
slp1: hanta vakzyAmi te SreyaH SrutvA ca kuru tattaTA । SaraRAgatasantrAtA Bava kAnta viSezataH ॥14॥

text: eṣa śākunikaḥ śete tava vāsaṃ samāśritaḥ । śītārtaśca kṣudhārtaśca pūjāmasmai prayojaya ॥15॥
html:
eṣa śākunikaḥ śete tava vāsaṃ samāśritaḥ ।
śītārtaśca kṣudhārtaśca pūjāmasmai prayojaya ॥15॥
slp1: eza SAkunikaH Sete tava vAsaM samASritaH । SItArtaSca kzuDArtaSca pUjAmasmE prayojaya ॥15॥

text: yo hi kaściddvijaṃ hanyādgāṃ vā lokasya mātaram । śaraṇāgataṃ ca yo hanyāttulyaṃ teṣāṃ ca pātakam ॥16॥
html:
yo hi kaściddvijaṃ hanyādgāṃ vā lokasya mātaram ।
śaraṇāgataṃ ca yo hanyāttulyaṃ teṣāṃ ca pātakam ॥16॥
slp1: yo hi kaSciddvijaM hanyAdgAM vA lokasya mAtaram । SaraRAgataM ca yo hanyAttulyaM tezAM ca pAtakam ॥16॥

text: yāsmākaṃ vihitā vṛttiḥ kāpotī jātidharmataḥ । sā nyāyyātmavatā nityaṃ tvadvidhenābhivartitum ॥17॥
html:
yāsmākaṃ vihitā vṛttiḥ kāpotī jātidharmataḥ ।
sā nyāyyātmavatā nityaṃ tvadvidhenābhivartitum ॥17॥
slp1: yAsmAkaM vihitA vfttiH kApotI jAtiDarmataH । sA nyAyyAtmavatA nityaM tvadviDenABivartitum ॥17॥

text: yastu dharmaṃ yathāśakti gṛhastho hyanuvartate । sa pretya labhate lokānakṣayāniti śuśruma ॥18॥
html:
yastu dharmaṃ yathāśakti gṛhastho hyanuvartate ।
sa pretya labhate lokānakṣayāniti śuśruma ॥18॥
slp1: yastu DarmaM yaTASakti gfhasTo hyanuvartate । sa pretya laBate lokAnakzayAniti SuSruma ॥18॥

text: sa tvaṃ santānavānadya putravānapi ca dvija । tatsvadehe dayāṃ tyaktvā dharmārthau parigṛhya vai । pūjāmasmai prayuṅkṣva tvaṃ prīyetāsya mano yathā ॥19॥
html:
sa tvaṃ santānavānadya putravānapi ca dvija ।
tatsvadehe dayāṃ tyaktvā dharmārthau parigṛhya vai ।
pūjāmasmai prayuṅkṣva tvaṃ prīyetāsya mano yathā ॥19॥
slp1: sa tvaM santAnavAnadya putravAnapi ca dvija । tatsvadehe dayAM tyaktvA DarmArTO parigfhya vE । pUjAmasmE prayuNkzva tvaM prIyetAsya mano yaTA ॥19॥

text: iti sā śakunī vākyaṃ kṣārakasthā tapasvinī । atiduḥkhānvitā procya bhartāraṃ samudaikṣata ॥20॥
html:
iti sā śakunī vākyaṃ kṣārakasthā tapasvinī ।
atiduḥkhānvitā procya bhartāraṃ samudaikṣata ॥20॥
slp1: iti sA SakunI vAkyaM kzArakasTA tapasvinI । atiduHKAnvitA procya BartAraM samudEkzata ॥20॥

text: sa patnyā vacanaṃ śrutvā dharmayuktisamanvitam । harṣeṇa mahatā yukto bāṣpavyākulalocanaḥ ॥21॥
html:
sa patnyā vacanaṃ śrutvā dharmayuktisamanvitam ।
harṣeṇa mahatā yukto bāṣpavyākulalocanaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: sa patnyA vacanaM SrutvA Darmayuktisamanvitam । harzeRa mahatA yukto bAzpavyAkulalocanaH ॥21॥

text: taṃ vai śākunikaṃ dṛṣṭvā vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā । pūjayāmāsa yatnena sa pakṣī pakṣijīvinam ॥22॥
html:
taṃ vai śākunikaṃ dṛṣṭvā vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ।
pūjayāmāsa yatnena sa pakṣī pakṣijīvinam ॥22॥
slp1: taM vE SAkunikaM dfzwvA viDidfzwena karmaRA । pUjayAmAsa yatnena sa pakzI pakzijIvinam ॥22॥

text: uvāca ca svāgataṃ te brūhi kiṃ karavāṇyaham । santāpaśca na kartavyaḥ svagṛhe vartate bhavān ॥23॥
html:
uvāca ca svāgataṃ te brūhi kiṃ karavāṇyaham ।
santāpaśca na kartavyaḥ svagṛhe vartate bhavān ॥23॥
slp1: uvAca ca svAgataM te brUhi kiM karavARyaham । santApaSca na kartavyaH svagfhe vartate BavAn ॥23॥

text: tadbravītu bhavānkṣipraṃ kiṃ karomi kimicchasi । praṇayena bravīmi tvāṃ tvaṃ hi naḥ śaraṇāgataḥ ॥24॥
html:
tadbravītu bhavānkṣipraṃ kiṃ karomi kimicchasi ।
praṇayena bravīmi tvāṃ tvaṃ hi naḥ śaraṇāgataḥ ॥24॥
slp1: tadbravItu BavAnkzipraM kiM karomi kimicCasi । praRayena bravImi tvAM tvaM hi naH SaraRAgataH ॥24॥

text: śaraṇāgatasya kartavyamātithyamiha yatnataḥ । pañcayajñapravṛttena gṛhasthena viśeṣataḥ ॥25॥
html:
śaraṇāgatasya kartavyamātithyamiha yatnataḥ ।
pañcayajñapravṛttena gṛhasthena viśeṣataḥ ॥25॥
slp1: SaraRAgatasya kartavyamAtiTyamiha yatnataH । paYcayajYapravfttena gfhasTena viSezataH ॥25॥

text: pañcayajñāṃstu yo mohānna karoti gṛhāśramī । tasya nāyaṃ na ca paro loko bhavati dharmataḥ ॥26॥
html:
pañcayajñāṃstu yo mohānna karoti gṛhāśramī ।
tasya nāyaṃ na ca paro loko bhavati dharmataḥ ॥26॥
slp1: paYcayajYAMstu yo mohAnna karoti gfhASramI । tasya nAyaM na ca paro loko Bavati DarmataH ॥26॥

text: tadbrūhi tvaṃ suvisrabdho yattvaṃ vācā vadiṣyasi । tatkariṣyāmyahaṃ sarvaṃ mā tvaṃ śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ ॥27॥
html:
tadbrūhi tvaṃ suvisrabdho yattvaṃ vācā vadiṣyasi ।
tatkariṣyāmyahaṃ sarvaṃ mā tvaṃ śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ ॥27॥
slp1: tadbrUhi tvaM suvisrabDo yattvaM vAcA vadizyasi । tatkarizyAmyahaM sarvaM mA tvaM Soke manaH kfTAH ॥27॥

text: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śakunerlubdhako'bravīt । bādhate khalu mā śītaṃ himatrāṇaṃ vidhīyatām ॥28॥
html:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śakunerlubdhako'bravīt ।
bādhate khalu mā śītaṃ himatrāṇaṃ vidhīyatām ॥28॥
slp1: tasya tadvacanaM SrutvA SakunerlubDako'bravIt । bADate Kalu mA SItaM himatrARaM viDIyatAm ॥28॥

text: evamuktastataḥ pakṣī parṇānyāstīrya bhūtale । yathāśuṣkāṇi yatnena jvalanārthaṃ drutaṃ yayau ॥29॥
html:
evamuktastataḥ pakṣī parṇānyāstīrya bhūtale ।
yathāśuṣkāṇi yatnena jvalanārthaṃ drutaṃ yayau ॥29॥
slp1: evamuktastataH pakzI parRAnyAstIrya BUtale । yaTASuzkARi yatnena jvalanArTaM drutaM yayO ॥29॥

text: sa gatvāṅgārakarmāntaṃ gṛhītvāgnimathāgamat । tataḥ śuṣkeṣu parṇeṣu pāvakaṃ so'bhyadīdipat ॥30॥
html:
sa gatvāṅgārakarmāntaṃ gṛhītvāgnimathāgamat ।
tataḥ śuṣkeṣu parṇeṣu pāvakaṃ so'bhyadīdipat ॥30॥
slp1: sa gatvANgArakarmAntaM gfhItvAgnimaTAgamat । tataH Suzkezu parRezu pAvakaM so'ByadIdipat ॥30॥

text: susandīptaṃ mahatkṛtvā tamāha śaraṇāgatam । pratāpaya suvisrabdhaṃ svagātrāṇyakutobhayaḥ ॥31॥
html:
susandīptaṃ mahatkṛtvā tamāha śaraṇāgatam ।
pratāpaya suvisrabdhaṃ svagātrāṇyakutobhayaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: susandIptaM mahatkftvA tamAha SaraRAgatam । pratApaya suvisrabDaM svagAtrARyakutoBayaH ॥31॥

text: sa tathoktastathetyuktvā lubdho gātrāṇyatāpayat । agnipratyāgataprāṇastataḥ prāha vihaṅgamam ॥32॥
html:
sa tathoktastathetyuktvā lubdho gātrāṇyatāpayat ।
agnipratyāgataprāṇastataḥ prāha vihaṅgamam ॥32॥
slp1: sa taToktastaTetyuktvA lubDo gAtrARyatApayat । agnipratyAgataprARastataH prAha vihaNgamam ॥32॥

text: dattamāhāramicchāmi tvayā kṣudbādhate hi mām । tadvacaḥ sa pratiśrutya vākyamāha vihaṅgamaḥ ॥33॥
html:
dattamāhāramicchāmi tvayā kṣudbādhate hi mām ।
tadvacaḥ sa pratiśrutya vākyamāha vihaṅgamaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: dattamAhAramicCAmi tvayA kzudbADate hi mAm । tadvacaH sa pratiSrutya vAkyamAha vihaNgamaH ॥33॥

text: na me'sti vibhavo yena nāśayāmi tava kṣudhām । utpannena hi jīvāmo vayaṃ nityaṃ vanaukasaḥ ॥34॥
html:
na me'sti vibhavo yena nāśayāmi tava kṣudhām ।
utpannena hi jīvāmo vayaṃ nityaṃ vanaukasaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: na me'sti viBavo yena nASayAmi tava kzuDAm । utpannena hi jIvAmo vayaM nityaM vanOkasaH ॥34॥

text: sañcayo nāsti cāsmākaṃ munīnāmiva kānane । ityuktvā sa tadā tatra vivarṇavadano'bhavat ॥35॥
html:
sañcayo nāsti cāsmākaṃ munīnāmiva kānane ।
ityuktvā sa tadā tatra vivarṇavadano'bhavat ॥35॥
slp1: saYcayo nAsti cAsmAkaM munInAmiva kAnane । ityuktvA sa tadA tatra vivarRavadano'Bavat ॥35॥

text: kathaṃ nu khalu kartavyamiti cintāparaḥ sadā । babhūva bharataśreṣṭha garhayanvṛttimātmanaḥ ॥36॥
html:
kathaṃ nu khalu kartavyamiti cintāparaḥ sadā ।
babhūva bharataśreṣṭha garhayanvṛttimātmanaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: kaTaM nu Kalu kartavyamiti cintAparaH sadA । baBUva BarataSrezWa garhayanvfttimAtmanaH ॥36॥

text: muhūrtāllabdhasañjñastu sa pakṣī pakṣighātakam । uvāca tarpayiṣye tvāṃ muhūrtaṃ pratipālaya ॥37॥
html:
muhūrtāllabdhasañjñastu sa pakṣī pakṣighātakam ।
uvāca tarpayiṣye tvāṃ muhūrtaṃ pratipālaya ॥37॥
slp1: muhUrtAllabDasaYjYastu sa pakzI pakziGAtakam । uvAca tarpayizye tvAM muhUrtaM pratipAlaya ॥37॥

text: ityuktvā śuṣkaparṇaiḥ sa samprajvālya hutāśanam । harṣeṇa mahatā yuktaḥ kapotaḥ punarabravīt ॥38॥
html:
ityuktvā śuṣkaparṇaiḥ sa samprajvālya hutāśanam ।
harṣeṇa mahatā yuktaḥ kapotaḥ punarabravīt ॥38॥
slp1: ityuktvA SuzkaparREH sa samprajvAlya hutASanam । harzeRa mahatA yuktaH kapotaH punarabravIt ॥38॥

text: devānāṃ ca munīnāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ ca mahātmanām । śrutapūrvo mayā dharmo mahānatithipūjane ॥39॥
html:
devānāṃ ca munīnāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ ca mahātmanām ।
śrutapūrvo mayā dharmo mahānatithipūjane ॥39॥
slp1: devAnAM ca munInAM ca pitFRAM ca mahAtmanAm । SrutapUrvo mayA Darmo mahAnatiTipUjane ॥39॥

text: kuruṣvānugrahaṃ me'dya satyametadbravīmi te । niścitā khalu me buddhiratithipratipūjane ॥40॥
html:
kuruṣvānugrahaṃ me'dya satyametadbravīmi te ।
niścitā khalu me buddhiratithipratipūjane ॥40॥
slp1: kuruzvAnugrahaM me'dya satyametadbravImi te । niScitA Kalu me budDiratiTipratipUjane ॥40॥

text: tataḥ satyapratijño vai sa pakṣī prahasanniva । tamagniṃ triḥ parikramya praviveśa mahīpate ॥41॥
html:
tataḥ satyapratijño vai sa pakṣī prahasanniva ।
tamagniṃ triḥ parikramya praviveśa mahīpate ॥41॥
slp1: tataH satyapratijYo vE sa pakzI prahasanniva । tamagniM triH parikramya praviveSa mahIpate ॥41॥

text: agnimadhyaṃ praviṣṭaṃ taṃ lubdho dṛṣṭvātha pakṣiṇam । cintayāmāsa manasā kimidaṃ nu kṛtaṃ mayā ॥42॥
html:
agnimadhyaṃ praviṣṭaṃ taṃ lubdho dṛṣṭvātha pakṣiṇam ।
cintayāmāsa manasā kimidaṃ nu kṛtaṃ mayā ॥42॥
slp1: agnimaDyaM pravizwaM taM lubDo dfzwvATa pakziRam । cintayAmAsa manasA kimidaM nu kftaM mayA ॥42॥

text: aho mama nṛśaṃsasya garhitasya svakarmaṇā । adharmaḥ sumahānghoro bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ॥43॥
html:
aho mama nṛśaṃsasya garhitasya svakarmaṇā ।
adharmaḥ sumahānghoro bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ॥43॥
slp1: aho mama nfSaMsasya garhitasya svakarmaRA । aDarmaH sumahAnGoro Bavizyati na saMSayaH ॥43॥

text: evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ bhūri vilalāpa sa lubdhakaḥ । garhayansvāni karmāṇi dvijaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathāgatam] ॥44॥
html:
evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ bhūri vilalāpa sa lubdhakaḥ ।
garhayansvāni karmāṇi dvijaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathāgatam] ॥44॥
slp1: evaM bahuviDaM BUri vilalApa sa lubDakaH । garhayansvAni karmARi dvijaM dfzwvA taTAgatam] ॥44॥

text: tatastaṃ lubdhakaḥ paśyankṛpayābhipariplutaḥ । kapotamagnau patitaṃ vākyaṃ punaruvāca ha ॥1॥
html:
tatastaṃ lubdhakaḥ paśyankṛpayābhipariplutaḥ ।
kapotamagnau patitaṃ vākyaṃ punaruvāca ha ॥1॥
slp1: tatastaM lubDakaH paSyankfpayABipariplutaH । kapotamagnO patitaM vAkyaM punaruvAca ha ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kimīdṛśaṃ nṛśaṃsena mayā kṛtamabuddhinā । bhaviṣyati hi me nityaṃ pātakaṃ hṛdi jīvataḥ ॥2॥
html:
kimīdṛśaṃ nṛśaṃsena mayā kṛtamabuddhinā ।
bhaviṣyati hi me nityaṃ pātakaṃ hṛdi jīvataḥ ॥2॥
slp1: kimIdfSaM nfSaMsena mayA kftamabudDinA । Bavizyati hi me nityaM pAtakaM hfdi jIvataH ॥2॥

text: sa vinindannathātmānaṃ punaḥ punaruvāca ha । dhiṅmāmastu sudurbuddhiṃ sadā nikṛtiniścayam । śubhaṃ karma parityajya yo'haṃ śakunilubdhakaḥ ॥3॥
html:
sa vinindannathātmānaṃ punaḥ punaruvāca ha ।
dhiṅmāmastu sudurbuddhiṃ sadā nikṛtiniścayam ।
śubhaṃ karma parityajya yo'haṃ śakunilubdhakaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: sa vinindannaTAtmAnaM punaH punaruvAca ha । DiNmAmastu sudurbudDiM sadA nikftiniScayam । SuBaM karma parityajya yo'haM SakunilubDakaH ॥3॥

text: nṛśaṃsasya mamādyāyaṃ pratyādeśo na saṃśayaḥ । dattaḥ svamāṃsaṃ dadatā kapotena mahātmanā ॥4॥
html:
nṛśaṃsasya mamādyāyaṃ pratyādeśo na saṃśayaḥ ।
dattaḥ svamāṃsaṃ dadatā kapotena mahātmanā ॥4॥
slp1: nfSaMsasya mamAdyAyaM pratyAdeSo na saMSayaH । dattaH svamAMsaM dadatA kapotena mahAtmanA ॥4॥

text: so'haṃ tyakṣye priyānprāṇānputradāraṃ visṛjya ca । upadiṣṭo hi me dharmaḥ kapotenātidharmiṇā ॥5॥
html:
so'haṃ tyakṣye priyānprāṇānputradāraṃ visṛjya ca ।
upadiṣṭo hi me dharmaḥ kapotenātidharmiṇā ॥5॥
slp1: so'haM tyakzye priyAnprARAnputradAraM visfjya ca । upadizwo hi me DarmaH kapotenAtiDarmiRA ॥5॥

text: adya prabhṛti dehaṃ svaṃ sarvabhogairvivarjitam । yathā svalpaṃ jalaṃ grīṣme śoṣayiṣyāmyahaṃ tathā ॥6॥
html:
adya prabhṛti dehaṃ svaṃ sarvabhogairvivarjitam ।
yathā svalpaṃ jalaṃ grīṣme śoṣayiṣyāmyahaṃ tathā ॥6॥
slp1: adya praBfti dehaM svaM sarvaBogErvivarjitam । yaTA svalpaM jalaM grIzme SozayizyAmyahaM taTA ॥6॥

text: kṣutpipāsātapasahaḥ kṛśo dhamanisantataḥ । upavāsairbahuvidhaiścariṣye pāralaukikam ॥7॥
html:
kṣutpipāsātapasahaḥ kṛśo dhamanisantataḥ ।
upavāsairbahuvidhaiścariṣye pāralaukikam ॥7॥
slp1: kzutpipAsAtapasahaH kfSo DamanisantataH । upavAsErbahuviDEScarizye pAralOkikam ॥7॥

text: aho dehapradānena darśitātithipūjanā । tasmāddharmaṃ cariṣyāmi dharmo hi paramā gatiḥ । dṛṣṭo hi dharmo dharmiṣṭhairyādṛśo vihagottame ॥8॥
html:
aho dehapradānena darśitātithipūjanā ।
tasmāddharmaṃ cariṣyāmi dharmo hi paramā gatiḥ ।
dṛṣṭo hi dharmo dharmiṣṭhairyādṛśo vihagottame ॥8॥
slp1: aho dehapradAnena darSitAtiTipUjanA । tasmAdDarmaM carizyAmi Darmo hi paramA gatiH । dfzwo hi Darmo DarmizWEryAdfSo vihagottame ॥8॥

text: evamuktvā viniścitya raudrakarmā sa lubdhakaḥ । mahāprasthānamāśritya prayayau saṃśitavrataḥ ॥9॥
html:
evamuktvā viniścitya raudrakarmā sa lubdhakaḥ ।
mahāprasthānamāśritya prayayau saṃśitavrataḥ ॥9॥
slp1: evamuktvA viniScitya rOdrakarmA sa lubDakaH । mahAprasTAnamASritya prayayO saMSitavrataH ॥9॥

text: tato yaṣṭiṃ śalākāśca kṣārakaṃ pañjaraṃ tathā । tāṃśca baddhā kapotānsa sampramucyotsasarja ha] ॥10॥
html:
tato yaṣṭiṃ śalākāśca kṣārakaṃ pañjaraṃ tathā ।
tāṃśca baddhā kapotānsa sampramucyotsasarja ha] ॥10॥
slp1: tato yazwiM SalAkASca kzArakaM paYjaraM taTA । tAMSca badDA kapotAnsa sampramucyotsasarja ha] ॥10॥

text: tato gate śākunike kapotī prāha duḥkhitā । saṃsmṛtya bhartāramatho rudatī śokamūrchitā ॥1॥
html:
tato gate śākunike kapotī prāha duḥkhitā ।
saṃsmṛtya bhartāramatho rudatī śokamūrchitā ॥1॥
slp1: tato gate SAkunike kapotI prAha duHKitA । saMsmftya BartAramaTo rudatI SokamUrCitA ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: nāhaṃ te vipriyaṃ kānta kadācidapi saṃsmare । sarvā vai vidhavā nārī bahuputrāpi khecara । śocyā bhavati bandhūnāṃ patihīnā manasvinī ॥2॥
html:
nāhaṃ te vipriyaṃ kānta kadācidapi saṃsmare ।
sarvā vai vidhavā nārī bahuputrāpi khecara ।
śocyā bhavati bandhūnāṃ patihīnā manasvinī ॥2॥
slp1: nAhaM te vipriyaM kAnta kadAcidapi saMsmare । sarvA vE viDavA nArI bahuputrApi Kecara । SocyA Bavati banDUnAM patihInA manasvinI ॥2॥

text: lālitāhaṃ tvayā nityaṃ bahumānācca sāntvitā । vacanairmadhuraiḥ snigdhairasakṛtsumanoharaiḥ ॥3॥
html:
lālitāhaṃ tvayā nityaṃ bahumānācca sāntvitā ।
vacanairmadhuraiḥ snigdhairasakṛtsumanoharaiḥ ॥3॥
slp1: lAlitAhaM tvayA nityaM bahumAnAcca sAntvitA । vacanErmaDurEH snigDErasakftsumanoharEH ॥3॥

text: kandareṣu ca śailānāṃ nadīnāṃ nirjhareṣu ca । drumāgreṣu ca ramyeṣu ramitāhaṃ tvayā priya ॥4॥
html:
kandareṣu ca śailānāṃ nadīnāṃ nirjhareṣu ca ।
drumāgreṣu ca ramyeṣu ramitāhaṃ tvayā priya ॥4॥
slp1: kandarezu ca SElAnAM nadInAM nirJarezu ca । drumAgrezu ca ramyezu ramitAhaM tvayA priya ॥4॥

text: ākāśagamane caiva sukhitāhaṃ tvayā sukham । vihṛtāsmi tvayā kānta tanme nādyāsti kiñcana ॥5॥
html:
ākāśagamane caiva sukhitāhaṃ tvayā sukham ।
vihṛtāsmi tvayā kānta tanme nādyāsti kiñcana ॥5॥
slp1: AkASagamane cEva suKitAhaM tvayA suKam । vihftAsmi tvayA kAnta tanme nAdyAsti kiYcana ॥5॥

text: mitaṃ dadāti hi pitā mitaṃ mātā mitaṃ sutaḥ । amitasya tu dātāraṃ bhartāraṃ kā na pūjayet ॥6॥
html:
mitaṃ dadāti hi pitā mitaṃ mātā mitaṃ sutaḥ ।
amitasya tu dātāraṃ bhartāraṃ kā na pūjayet ॥6॥
slp1: mitaM dadAti hi pitA mitaM mAtA mitaM sutaH । amitasya tu dAtAraM BartAraM kA na pUjayet ॥6॥

text: nāsti bhartṛsamo nātho na ca bhartṛsamaṃ sukham । visṛjya dhanasarvasvaṃ bhartā vai śaraṇaṃ striyāḥ ॥7॥
html:
nāsti bhartṛsamo nātho na ca bhartṛsamaṃ sukham ।
visṛjya dhanasarvasvaṃ bhartā vai śaraṇaṃ striyāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: nAsti Bartfsamo nATo na ca BartfsamaM suKam । visfjya DanasarvasvaM BartA vE SaraRaM striyAH ॥7॥

text: na kāryamiha me nātha jīvitena tvayā vinā । patihīnāpi kā nārī satī jīvitumutsahet ॥8॥
html:
na kāryamiha me nātha jīvitena tvayā vinā ।
patihīnāpi kā nārī satī jīvitumutsahet ॥8॥
slp1: na kAryamiha me nATa jIvitena tvayA vinA । patihInApi kA nArI satI jIvitumutsahet ॥8॥

text: evaṃ vilapya bahudhā karuṇaṃ sā suduḥkhitā । pativratā sampradīptaṃ praviveśa hutāśanam ॥9॥
html:
evaṃ vilapya bahudhā karuṇaṃ sā suduḥkhitā ।
pativratā sampradīptaṃ praviveśa hutāśanam ॥9॥
slp1: evaM vilapya bahuDA karuRaM sA suduHKitA । pativratA sampradIptaM praviveSa hutASanam ॥9॥

text: tataścitrāmbaradharaṃ bhartāraṃ sānvapaśyata । vimānasthaṃ sukṛtibhiḥ pūjyamānaṃ mahātmabhiḥ ॥10॥
html:
tataścitrāmbaradharaṃ bhartāraṃ sānvapaśyata ।
vimānasthaṃ sukṛtibhiḥ pūjyamānaṃ mahātmabhiḥ ॥10॥
slp1: tataScitrAmbaraDaraM BartAraM sAnvapaSyata । vimAnasTaM sukftiBiH pUjyamAnaM mahAtmaBiH ॥10॥

text: citramālyāmbaradharaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam । vimānaśatakoṭībhirāvṛtaṃ puṇyakīrtibhiḥ ॥11॥
html:
citramālyāmbaradharaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ।
vimānaśatakoṭībhirāvṛtaṃ puṇyakīrtibhiḥ ॥11॥
slp1: citramAlyAmbaraDaraM sarvABaraRaBUzitam । vimAnaSatakowIBirAvftaM puRyakIrtiBiH ॥11॥

text: tataḥ svargagataḥ pakṣī bhāryayā saha saṅgataḥ । karmaṇā pūjitastena reme tatra sa bhāryayā] ॥12॥
html:
tataḥ svargagataḥ pakṣī bhāryayā saha saṅgataḥ ।
karmaṇā pūjitastena reme tatra sa bhāryayā] ॥12॥
slp1: tataH svargagataH pakzI BAryayA saha saNgataH । karmaRA pUjitastena reme tatra sa BAryayA] ॥12॥

text: vimānasthau tu tau rājaṁllubdhako vai dadarśa ha । dṛṣṭvā tau dampatī duḥkhādacintayata sadgatim ॥1॥
html:
vimānasthau tu tau rājaṁllubdhako vai dadarśa ha ।
dṛṣṭvā tau dampatī duḥkhādacintayata sadgatim ॥1॥
slp1: vimAnasTO tu tO rAjaṁllubDako vE dadarSa ha । dfzwvA tO dampatI duHKAdacintayata sadgatim ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kīdṛśeneha tapasā gaccheyaṃ paramāṃ gatim । iti buddhyā viniścitya gamanāyopacakrame ॥2॥
html:
kīdṛśeneha tapasā gaccheyaṃ paramāṃ gatim ।
iti buddhyā viniścitya gamanāyopacakrame ॥2॥
slp1: kIdfSeneha tapasA gacCeyaM paramAM gatim । iti budDyA viniScitya gamanAyopacakrame ॥2॥

text: mahāprasthānamāśritya lubdhakaḥ pakṣijīvanaḥ । niśceṣṭo mārutāhāro nirmamaḥ svargakāṅkṣayā ॥3॥
html:
mahāprasthānamāśritya lubdhakaḥ pakṣijīvanaḥ ।
niśceṣṭo mārutāhāro nirmamaḥ svargakāṅkṣayā ॥3॥
slp1: mahAprasTAnamASritya lubDakaH pakzijIvanaH । niScezwo mArutAhAro nirmamaH svargakANkzayA ॥3॥

text: tato'paśyatsuvistīrṇaṃ hṛdyaṃ padmavibhūṣitam । nānādvijagaṇākīrṇaṃ saraḥ śītajalaṃ śubham । pipāsārto'pi taddṛṣṭvā tṛptaḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ॥4॥
html:
tato'paśyatsuvistīrṇaṃ hṛdyaṃ padmavibhūṣitam ।
nānādvijagaṇākīrṇaṃ saraḥ śītajalaṃ śubham ।
pipāsārto'pi taddṛṣṭvā tṛptaḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: tato'paSyatsuvistIrRaM hfdyaM padmaviBUzitam । nAnAdvijagaRAkIrRaM saraH SItajalaM SuBam । pipAsArto'pi taddfzwvA tfptaH syAnnAtra saMSayaH ॥4॥

text: upavāsakṛśo'tyarthaṃ sa tu pārthiva lubdhakaḥ । upasarpata saṃhṛṣṭaḥ śvāpadādhyuṣitaṃ vanam ॥5॥
html:
upavāsakṛśo'tyarthaṃ sa tu pārthiva lubdhakaḥ ।
upasarpata saṃhṛṣṭaḥ śvāpadādhyuṣitaṃ vanam ॥5॥
slp1: upavAsakfSo'tyarTaM sa tu pArTiva lubDakaH । upasarpata saMhfzwaH SvApadADyuzitaM vanam ॥5॥

text: mahāntaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā lubdhakaḥ praviveśa ha । praviśanneva ca vanaṃ nigṛhītaḥ sa kaṇṭakaiḥ ॥6॥
html:
mahāntaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā lubdhakaḥ praviveśa ha ।
praviśanneva ca vanaṃ nigṛhītaḥ sa kaṇṭakaiḥ ॥6॥
slp1: mahAntaM niScayaM kftvA lubDakaH praviveSa ha । praviSanneva ca vanaM nigfhItaH sa kaRwakEH ॥6॥

text: sa kaṇṭakavibhugnāṅgo lohitārdrīkṛtacchaviḥ । babhrāma tasminvijane nānāmṛgasamākule ॥7॥
html:
sa kaṇṭakavibhugnāṅgo lohitārdrīkṛtacchaviḥ ।
babhrāma tasminvijane nānāmṛgasamākule ॥7॥
slp1: sa kaRwakaviBugnANgo lohitArdrIkftacCaviH । baBrAma tasminvijane nAnAmfgasamAkule ॥7॥

text: tato drumāṇāṃ mahatāṃ pavanena vane tadā । udatiṣṭhata saṅgharṣātsumahānhavyavāhanaḥ ॥8॥
html:
tato drumāṇāṃ mahatāṃ pavanena vane tadā ।
udatiṣṭhata saṅgharṣātsumahānhavyavāhanaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tato drumARAM mahatAM pavanena vane tadA । udatizWata saNGarzAtsumahAnhavyavAhanaH ॥8॥

text: tadvanaṃ vṛkṣasaṅkīrṇaṃ latāviṭapasaṅkulam । dadāha pāvakaḥ kruddho yugāntāgnisamaprabhaḥ ॥9॥
html:
tadvanaṃ vṛkṣasaṅkīrṇaṃ latāviṭapasaṅkulam ।
dadāha pāvakaḥ kruddho yugāntāgnisamaprabhaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: tadvanaM vfkzasaNkIrRaM latAviwapasaNkulam । dadAha pAvakaH krudDo yugAntAgnisamapraBaH ॥9॥

text: sajvālaiḥ pavanoddhūtairvisphuliṅgaiḥ samanvitaḥ । dadāha tadvanaṃ ghoraṃ mṛgapakṣisamākulam ॥10॥
html:
sajvālaiḥ pavanoddhūtairvisphuliṅgaiḥ samanvitaḥ ।
dadāha tadvanaṃ ghoraṃ mṛgapakṣisamākulam ॥10॥
slp1: sajvAlEH pavanodDUtErvisPuliNgEH samanvitaH । dadAha tadvanaM GoraM mfgapakzisamAkulam ॥10॥

text: tataḥ sa dehamokṣārthaṃ samprahṛṣṭena cetasā । abhyadhāvata saṃvṛddhaṃ pāvakaṃ lubdhakastadā ॥11॥
html:
tataḥ sa dehamokṣārthaṃ samprahṛṣṭena cetasā ।
abhyadhāvata saṃvṛddhaṃ pāvakaṃ lubdhakastadā ॥11॥
slp1: tataH sa dehamokzArTaM samprahfzwena cetasA । aByaDAvata saMvfdDaM pAvakaM lubDakastadA ॥11॥

text: tatastenāgninā dagdho lubdhako naṣṭakilbiṣaḥ । jagāma paramāṃ siddhiṃ tadā bharatasattama ॥12॥
html:
tatastenāgninā dagdho lubdhako naṣṭakilbiṣaḥ ।
jagāma paramāṃ siddhiṃ tadā bharatasattama ॥12॥
slp1: tatastenAgninA dagDo lubDako nazwakilbizaH । jagAma paramAM sidDiM tadA Baratasattama ॥12॥

text: tataḥ svargasthamātmānaṃ so'paśyadvigatajvaraḥ । yakṣagandharvasiddhānāṃ madhye bhrājantamindravat ॥13॥
html:
tataḥ svargasthamātmānaṃ so'paśyadvigatajvaraḥ ।
yakṣagandharvasiddhānāṃ madhye bhrājantamindravat ॥13॥
slp1: tataH svargasTamAtmAnaM so'paSyadvigatajvaraH । yakzaganDarvasidDAnAM maDye BrAjantamindravat ॥13॥

text: evaṃ khalu kapotaśca kapotī ca pativratā । lubdhakena saha svargaṃ gatāḥ puṇyena karmaṇā ॥14॥
html:
evaṃ khalu kapotaśca kapotī ca pativratā ।
lubdhakena saha svargaṃ gatāḥ puṇyena karmaṇā ॥14॥
slp1: evaM Kalu kapotaSca kapotI ca pativratA । lubDakena saha svargaM gatAH puRyena karmaRA ॥14॥

text: yāpi caivaṃvidhā nārī bhartāramanuvartate । virājate hi sā kṣipraṃ kapotīva divi sthitā ॥15॥
html:
yāpi caivaṃvidhā nārī bhartāramanuvartate ।
virājate hi sā kṣipraṃ kapotīva divi sthitā ॥15॥
slp1: yApi cEvaMviDA nArI BartAramanuvartate । virAjate hi sA kzipraM kapotIva divi sTitA ॥15॥

text: evametatpurā vṛttaṃ lubdhakasya mahātmanaḥ । kapotasya ca dharmiṣṭhā gatiḥ puṇyena karmaṇā ॥16॥
html:
evametatpurā vṛttaṃ lubdhakasya mahātmanaḥ ।
kapotasya ca dharmiṣṭhā gatiḥ puṇyena karmaṇā ॥16॥
slp1: evametatpurA vfttaM lubDakasya mahAtmanaH । kapotasya ca DarmizWA gatiH puRyena karmaRA ॥16॥

text: yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ yaścedaṃ parikīrtayet । nāśubhaṃ vidyate tasya manasāpi pramādyataḥ ॥17॥
html:
yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ yaścedaṃ parikīrtayet ।
nāśubhaṃ vidyate tasya manasāpi pramādyataḥ ॥17॥
slp1: yaScedaM SfRuyAnnityaM yaScedaM parikIrtayet । nASuBaM vidyate tasya manasApi pramAdyataH ॥17॥

text: yudhiṣṭhira mahāneṣa dharmo dharmabhṛtāṃ vara । goghneṣvapi bhavedasminniṣkṛtiḥ pāpakarmaṇaḥ । niṣkṛtirna bhavettasminyo hanyāccharaṇāgatam] ॥18॥
html:
yudhiṣṭhira mahāneṣa dharmo dharmabhṛtāṃ vara ।
goghneṣvapi bhavedasminniṣkṛtiḥ pāpakarmaṇaḥ ।
niṣkṛtirna bhavettasminyo hanyāccharaṇāgatam] ॥18॥
slp1: yuDizWira mahAneza Darmo DarmaBftAM vara । goGnezvapi BavedasminnizkftiH pApakarmaRaH । nizkftirna Bavettasminyo hanyAcCaraRAgatam] ॥18॥

text: abuddhipūrvaṃ yaḥ pāpaṃ kuryādbharatasattama । mucyate sa kathaṃ tasmādenasastadvadasva me ॥1॥
html:
abuddhipūrvaṃ yaḥ pāpaṃ kuryādbharatasattama ।
mucyate sa kathaṃ tasmādenasastadvadasva me ॥1॥
slp1: abudDipUrvaM yaH pApaM kuryAdBaratasattama । mucyate sa kaTaM tasmAdenasastadvadasva me ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atra te varṇayiṣye'hamitihāsaṃ purātanam । indrotaḥ śaunako vipro yadāha janamejayam ॥2॥
html:
atra te varṇayiṣye'hamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
indrotaḥ śaunako vipro yadāha janamejayam ॥2॥
slp1: atra te varRayizye'hamitihAsaM purAtanam । indrotaH SOnako vipro yadAha janamejayam ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: āsīdrājā mahāvīryaḥ pārikṣijjanamejayaḥ । abuddhipūrvaṃ brahmahatyā tamāgacchanmahīpatim ॥3॥
html:
āsīdrājā mahāvīryaḥ pārikṣijjanamejayaḥ ।
abuddhipūrvaṃ brahmahatyā tamāgacchanmahīpatim ॥3॥
slp1: AsIdrAjA mahAvIryaH pArikzijjanamejayaH । abudDipUrvaM brahmahatyA tamAgacCanmahIpatim ॥3॥

text: taṃ brāhmaṇāḥ sarva eva tatyajuḥ sapurohitāḥ । jagāma sa vanaṃ rājā dahyamāno divāniśam ॥4॥
html:
taṃ brāhmaṇāḥ sarva eva tatyajuḥ sapurohitāḥ ।
jagāma sa vanaṃ rājā dahyamāno divāniśam ॥4॥
slp1: taM brAhmaRAH sarva eva tatyajuH sapurohitAH । jagAma sa vanaM rAjA dahyamAno divAniSam ॥4॥

text: sa prajābhiḥ parityaktaścakāra kuśalaṃ mahat । ativelaṃ tapastepe dahyamānaḥ sa manyunā ॥5॥
html:
sa prajābhiḥ parityaktaścakāra kuśalaṃ mahat ।
ativelaṃ tapastepe dahyamānaḥ sa manyunā ॥5॥
slp1: sa prajABiH parityaktaScakAra kuSalaM mahat । ativelaM tapastepe dahyamAnaH sa manyunA ॥5॥

text: tatretihāsaṃ vakṣyāmi dharmasyāsyopabṛṃhaṇam । dahyamānaḥ pāpakṛtyā jagāma janamejayaḥ ॥6॥
html:
tatretihāsaṃ vakṣyāmi dharmasyāsyopabṛṃhaṇam ।
dahyamānaḥ pāpakṛtyā jagāma janamejayaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: tatretihAsaM vakzyAmi DarmasyAsyopabfMhaRam । dahyamAnaH pApakftyA jagAma janamejayaH ॥6॥

text: variṣyamāṇa indrotaṃ śaunakaṃ saṃśitavratam । samāsādyopajagrāha pādayoḥ paripīḍayan ॥7॥
html:
variṣyamāṇa indrotaṃ śaunakaṃ saṃśitavratam ।
samāsādyopajagrāha pādayoḥ paripīḍayan ॥7॥
slp1: varizyamARa indrotaM SOnakaM saMSitavratam । samAsAdyopajagrAha pAdayoH paripIqayan ॥7॥

text: tato bhīto mahāprājño jagarhe subhṛśaṃ tadā । kartā pāpasya mahato bhrūṇahā kimihāgataḥ ॥8॥
html:
tato bhīto mahāprājño jagarhe subhṛśaṃ tadā ।
kartā pāpasya mahato bhrūṇahā kimihāgataḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tato BIto mahAprAjYo jagarhe suBfSaM tadA । kartA pApasya mahato BrURahA kimihAgataH ॥8॥

text: kiṃ tavāsmāsu kartavyaṃ mā mā sprākṣīḥ kathañcana । gaccha gaccha na te sthānaṃ prīṇātyasmāniha dhruvam ॥9॥
html:
kiṃ tavāsmāsu kartavyaṃ mā mā sprākṣīḥ kathañcana ।
gaccha gaccha na te sthānaṃ prīṇātyasmāniha dhruvam ॥9॥
slp1: kiM tavAsmAsu kartavyaM mA mA sprAkzIH kaTaYcana । gacCa gacCa na te sTAnaM prIRAtyasmAniha Druvam ॥9॥

text: rudhirasyeva te gandhaḥ śavasyeva ca darśanam । aśivaḥ śivasaṅkāśo mṛto jīvannivāṭasi ॥10॥
html:
rudhirasyeva te gandhaḥ śavasyeva ca darśanam ।
aśivaḥ śivasaṅkāśo mṛto jīvannivāṭasi ॥10॥
slp1: ruDirasyeva te ganDaH Savasyeva ca darSanam । aSivaH SivasaNkASo mfto jIvannivAwasi ॥10॥

text: antarmṛtyuraśuddhātmā pāpamevānucintayan । prabudhyase prasvapiṣi vartase carase sukhī ॥11॥
html:
antarmṛtyuraśuddhātmā pāpamevānucintayan ।
prabudhyase prasvapiṣi vartase carase sukhī ॥11॥
slp1: antarmftyuraSudDAtmA pApamevAnucintayan । prabuDyase prasvapizi vartase carase suKI ॥11॥

text: moghaṃ te jīvitaṃ rājanparikliṣṭaṃ ca jīvasi । pāpāyeva ca sṛṣṭo'si karmaṇe ha yavīyase ॥12॥
html:
moghaṃ te jīvitaṃ rājanparikliṣṭaṃ ca jīvasi ।
pāpāyeva ca sṛṣṭo'si karmaṇe ha yavīyase ॥12॥
slp1: moGaM te jIvitaM rAjanpariklizwaM ca jIvasi । pApAyeva ca sfzwo'si karmaRe ha yavIyase ॥12॥

text: bahu kalyāṇamicchanta īhante pitaraḥ sutān । tapasā devatejyābhirvandanena titikṣayā ॥13॥
html:
bahu kalyāṇamicchanta īhante pitaraḥ sutān ।
tapasā devatejyābhirvandanena titikṣayā ॥13॥
slp1: bahu kalyARamicCanta Ihante pitaraH sutAn । tapasA devatejyABirvandanena titikzayA ॥13॥

text: pitṛvaṃśamimaṃ paśya tvatkṛte narakaṃ gatam । nirarthāḥ sarva evaiṣāmāśābandhāstvadāśrayāḥ ॥14॥
html:
pitṛvaṃśamimaṃ paśya tvatkṛte narakaṃ gatam ।
nirarthāḥ sarva evaiṣāmāśābandhāstvadāśrayāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: pitfvaMSamimaM paSya tvatkfte narakaM gatam । nirarTAH sarva evEzAmASAbanDAstvadASrayAH ॥14॥

text: yānpūjayanto vindanti svargamāyuryaśaḥ sukham । teṣu te satataṃ dveṣo brāhmaṇeṣu nirarthakaḥ ॥15॥
html:
yānpūjayanto vindanti svargamāyuryaśaḥ sukham ।
teṣu te satataṃ dveṣo brāhmaṇeṣu nirarthakaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: yAnpUjayanto vindanti svargamAyuryaSaH suKam । tezu te satataM dvezo brAhmaRezu nirarTakaH ॥15॥

text: imaṃ lokaṃ vimucya tvamavāṅmūrdhā patiṣyasi । aśāśvatīḥ śāśvatīśca samāḥ pāpena karmaṇā ॥16॥
html:
imaṃ lokaṃ vimucya tvamavāṅmūrdhā patiṣyasi ।
aśāśvatīḥ śāśvatīśca samāḥ pāpena karmaṇā ॥16॥
slp1: imaM lokaM vimucya tvamavANmUrDA patizyasi । aSASvatIH SASvatISca samAH pApena karmaRA ॥16॥

text: adyamāno jantugṛdhraiḥ śitikaṇṭhairayomukhaiḥ । tato'pi punarāvṛttaḥ pāpayoniṃ gamiṣyasi ॥17॥
html:
adyamāno jantugṛdhraiḥ śitikaṇṭhairayomukhaiḥ ।
tato'pi punarāvṛttaḥ pāpayoniṃ gamiṣyasi ॥17॥
slp1: adyamAno jantugfDrEH SitikaRWErayomuKEH । tato'pi punarAvfttaH pApayoniM gamizyasi ॥17॥

text: yadidaṃ manyase rājannāyamasti paraḥ kutaḥ । pratismārayitārastvāṃ yamadūtā yamakṣaye] ॥18॥
html:
yadidaṃ manyase rājannāyamasti paraḥ kutaḥ ।
pratismārayitārastvāṃ yamadūtā yamakṣaye] ॥18॥
slp1: yadidaM manyase rAjannAyamasti paraH kutaH । pratismArayitArastvAM yamadUtA yamakzaye] ॥18॥

text: evamuktaḥ pratyuvāca taṃ muniṃ janamejayaḥ । garhyaṃ bhavāngarhayati nindyaṃ nindati mā bhavān ॥1॥
html:
evamuktaḥ pratyuvāca taṃ muniṃ janamejayaḥ ।
garhyaṃ bhavāngarhayati nindyaṃ nindati mā bhavān ॥1॥
slp1: evamuktaH pratyuvAca taM muniM janamejayaH । garhyaM BavAngarhayati nindyaM nindati mA BavAn ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dhikkāryaṃ mā dhikkurute tasmāttvāhaṃ prasādaye । sarvaṃ hīdaṃ svakṛtaṃ me jvalāmyagnāvivāhitaḥ ॥2॥
html:
dhikkāryaṃ mā dhikkurute tasmāttvāhaṃ prasādaye ।
sarvaṃ hīdaṃ svakṛtaṃ me jvalāmyagnāvivāhitaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: DikkAryaM mA Dikkurute tasmAttvAhaM prasAdaye । sarvaM hIdaM svakftaM me jvalAmyagnAvivAhitaH ॥2॥

text: svakarmāṇyabhisandhāya nābhinandati me manaḥ । prāptaṃ nūnaṃ mayā ghoraṃ bhayaṃ vaivasvatādapi ॥3॥
html:
svakarmāṇyabhisandhāya nābhinandati me manaḥ ।
prāptaṃ nūnaṃ mayā ghoraṃ bhayaṃ vaivasvatādapi ॥3॥
slp1: svakarmARyaBisanDAya nABinandati me manaH । prAptaM nUnaM mayA GoraM BayaM vEvasvatAdapi ॥3॥

text: tattu śalyamanirhṛtya kathaṃ śakṣyāmi jīvitum । sarvamanyūnvinīya tvamabhi mā vada śaunaka ॥4॥
html:
tattu śalyamanirhṛtya kathaṃ śakṣyāmi jīvitum ।
sarvamanyūnvinīya tvamabhi mā vada śaunaka ॥4॥
slp1: tattu Salyamanirhftya kaTaM SakzyAmi jIvitum । sarvamanyUnvinIya tvamaBi mA vada SOnaka ॥4॥

text: mahānasaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ bhaviṣyāmyarthavānpunaḥ । astu śeṣaṃ kulasyāsya mā parābhūdidaṃ kulam ॥5॥
html:
mahānasaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ bhaviṣyāmyarthavānpunaḥ ।
astu śeṣaṃ kulasyāsya mā parābhūdidaṃ kulam ॥5॥
slp1: mahAnasaM brAhmaRAnAM BavizyAmyarTavAnpunaH । astu SezaM kulasyAsya mA parABUdidaM kulam ॥5॥

text: na hi no brahmaśaptānāṃ śeṣo bhavitumarhati । śrutīralabhamānānāṃ saṃvidaṃ vedaniścayāt ॥6॥
html:
na hi no brahmaśaptānāṃ śeṣo bhavitumarhati ।
śrutīralabhamānānāṃ saṃvidaṃ vedaniścayāt ॥6॥
slp1: na hi no brahmaSaptAnAM Sezo Bavitumarhati । SrutIralaBamAnAnAM saMvidaM vedaniScayAt ॥6॥

text: nirvidyamānaḥ subhṛśaṃ bhūyo vakṣyāmi sāṃpratam । bhūyaścaivābhinaṅkṣanti nirdharmā nirjapā iva ॥7॥
html:
nirvidyamānaḥ subhṛśaṃ bhūyo vakṣyāmi sāṃpratam ।
bhūyaścaivābhinaṅkṣanti nirdharmā nirjapā iva ॥7॥
slp1: nirvidyamAnaH suBfSaM BUyo vakzyAmi sAMpratam । BUyaScEvABinaNkzanti nirDarmA nirjapA iva ॥7॥

text: arvākca pratitiṣṭhanti pulindaśabarā iva । na hyayajñā amuṃ lokaṃ prāpnuvanti kathañcana ॥8॥
html:
arvākca pratitiṣṭhanti pulindaśabarā iva ।
na hyayajñā amuṃ lokaṃ prāpnuvanti kathañcana ॥8॥
slp1: arvAkca pratitizWanti pulindaSabarA iva । na hyayajYA amuM lokaM prApnuvanti kaTaYcana ॥8॥

text: avijñāyaiva me prajñāṃ bālasyeva supaṇḍitaḥ । brahmanpiteva putrebhyaḥ prati māṃ vāñcha śaunaka ॥9॥
html:
avijñāyaiva me prajñāṃ bālasyeva supaṇḍitaḥ ।
brahmanpiteva putrebhyaḥ prati māṃ vāñcha śaunaka ॥9॥
slp1: avijYAyEva me prajYAM bAlasyeva supaRqitaH । brahmanpiteva putreByaH prati mAM vAYCa SOnaka ॥9॥

text: kimāścaryaṃ yataḥ prājño bahu kuryāddhi sāmpratam । iti vai paṇḍito bhūtvā bhūtānāṃ nopatapyati ॥10॥
html:
kimāścaryaṃ yataḥ prājño bahu kuryāddhi sāmpratam ।
iti vai paṇḍito bhūtvā bhūtānāṃ nopatapyati ॥10॥
slp1: kimAScaryaM yataH prAjYo bahu kuryAdDi sAmpratam । iti vE paRqito BUtvA BUtAnAM nopatapyati ॥10॥
author: śaunaka uvāca ।

text: prajñāprāsādamāruhya aśocyaḥ śocate janān । jagatīsthānivādristhaḥ prajñayā pratipaśyati ॥11॥
html:
prajñāprāsādamāruhya aśocyaḥ śocate janān ।
jagatīsthānivādristhaḥ prajñayā pratipaśyati ॥11॥
slp1: prajYAprAsAdamAruhya aSocyaH Socate janAn । jagatIsTAnivAdrisTaH prajYayA pratipaSyati ॥11॥

text: na copalabhate tatra na ca kāryāṇi paśyati । nirviṇṇātmā parokṣo vā dhikkṛtaḥ sarvasādhuṣu ॥12॥
html:
na copalabhate tatra na ca kāryāṇi paśyati ।
nirviṇṇātmā parokṣo vā dhikkṛtaḥ sarvasādhuṣu ॥12॥
slp1: na copalaBate tatra na ca kAryARi paSyati । nirviRRAtmA parokzo vA DikkftaH sarvasADuzu ॥12॥

text: viditvobhayato vīryaṃ māhātmyaṃ veda āgame । kuruṣveha mahāśāntiṃ brahmā śaraṇamastu te ॥13॥
html:
viditvobhayato vīryaṃ māhātmyaṃ veda āgame ।
kuruṣveha mahāśāntiṃ brahmā śaraṇamastu te ॥13॥
slp1: viditvoBayato vIryaM mAhAtmyaM veda Agame । kuruzveha mahASAntiM brahmA SaraRamastu te ॥13॥

text: tadvai pāratrikaṃ cāru brāhmaṇānāmakupyatām । atha cettapyase pāpairdharmaṃ cedanupaśyasi ॥14॥
html:
tadvai pāratrikaṃ cāru brāhmaṇānāmakupyatām ।
atha cettapyase pāpairdharmaṃ cedanupaśyasi ॥14॥
slp1: tadvE pAratrikaM cAru brAhmaRAnAmakupyatAm । aTa cettapyase pApErDarmaM cedanupaSyasi ॥14॥

text: anutapye ca pāpena na cādharmaṃ carāmyaham । bubhūṣuṃ bhajamānaṃ ca prativāñchāmi śaunaka ॥15॥
html:
anutapye ca pāpena na cādharmaṃ carāmyaham ।
bubhūṣuṃ bhajamānaṃ ca prativāñchāmi śaunaka ॥15॥
slp1: anutapye ca pApena na cADarmaM carAmyaham । buBUzuM BajamAnaM ca prativAYCAmi SOnaka ॥15॥
author: janamejaya uvāca ।

text: chittvā stambhaṃ ca mānaṃ ca prītimicchāmi te nṛpa । sarvabhūtahite tiṣṭha dharmaṃ caiva pratismara ॥16॥
html:
chittvā stambhaṃ ca mānaṃ ca prītimicchāmi te nṛpa ।
sarvabhūtahite tiṣṭha dharmaṃ caiva pratismara ॥16॥
slp1: CittvA stamBaM ca mAnaM ca prItimicCAmi te nfpa । sarvaBUtahite tizWa DarmaM cEva pratismara ॥16॥
author: śaunaka uvāca ।

text: na bhayānna ca kārpaṇyānna lobhāttvāmupāhvaye । tāṃ me devā giraṃ satyāṃ śṛṇvantu brāhmaṇaiḥ saha ॥17॥
html:
na bhayānna ca kārpaṇyānna lobhāttvāmupāhvaye ।
tāṃ me devā giraṃ satyāṃ śṛṇvantu brāhmaṇaiḥ saha ॥17॥
slp1: na BayAnna ca kArpaRyAnna loBAttvAmupAhvaye । tAM me devA giraM satyAM SfRvantu brAhmaREH saha ॥17॥

text: so'haṃ na kenaciccārthī tvāṃ ca dharmamupāhvaye । krośatāṃ sarvabhūtānāmaho dhigiti kurvatām ॥18॥
html:
so'haṃ na kenaciccārthī tvāṃ ca dharmamupāhvaye ।
krośatāṃ sarvabhūtānāmaho dhigiti kurvatām ॥18॥
slp1: so'haM na kenaciccArTI tvAM ca DarmamupAhvaye । kroSatAM sarvaBUtAnAmaho Digiti kurvatAm ॥18॥

text: vakṣyanti māmadharmajñā vakṣyantyasuhṛdo janāḥ । vācastāḥ suhṛdaḥ śrutvā sañjvariṣyanti me bhṛśam ॥19॥
html:
vakṣyanti māmadharmajñā vakṣyantyasuhṛdo janāḥ ।
vācastāḥ suhṛdaḥ śrutvā sañjvariṣyanti me bhṛśam ॥19॥
slp1: vakzyanti mAmaDarmajYA vakzyantyasuhfdo janAH । vAcastAH suhfdaH SrutvA saYjvarizyanti me BfSam ॥19॥

text: kecideva mahāprājñāḥ parijñāsyanti kāryatām । jānīhi me kṛtaṃ tāta brāhmaṇānprati bhārata ॥20॥
html:
kecideva mahāprājñāḥ parijñāsyanti kāryatām ।
jānīhi me kṛtaṃ tāta brāhmaṇānprati bhārata ॥20॥
slp1: kecideva mahAprAjYAH parijYAsyanti kAryatAm । jAnIhi me kftaM tAta brAhmaRAnprati BArata ॥20॥

text: yathā te matkṛte kṣemaṃ labheraṃstattathā kuru । pratijānīhi cādrohaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ narādhipa ॥21॥
html:
yathā te matkṛte kṣemaṃ labheraṃstattathā kuru ।
pratijānīhi cādrohaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ narādhipa ॥21॥
slp1: yaTA te matkfte kzemaM laBeraMstattaTA kuru । pratijAnIhi cAdrohaM brAhmaRAnAM narADipa ॥21॥

text: naiva vācā na manasā na punarjātu karmaṇā । drogdhāsmi brāhmaṇānvipra caraṇāveva te spṛśe] ॥22॥
html:
naiva vācā na manasā na punarjātu karmaṇā ।
drogdhāsmi brāhmaṇānvipra caraṇāveva te spṛśe] ॥22॥
slp1: nEva vAcA na manasA na punarjAtu karmaRA । drogDAsmi brAhmaRAnvipra caraRAveva te spfSe] ॥22॥
author: janamejaya uvāca ।

text: tasmātte'haṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmamāvṛttacetase । śrīmānmahābalastuṣṭo yastvaṃ dharmamavekṣase । purastāddāruṇo bhūtvā sucitratarameva tat ॥1॥
html:
tasmātte'haṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmamāvṛttacetase ।
śrīmānmahābalastuṣṭo yastvaṃ dharmamavekṣase ।
purastāddāruṇo bhūtvā sucitratarameva tat ॥1॥
slp1: tasmAtte'haM pravakzyAmi DarmamAvfttacetase । SrImAnmahAbalastuzwo yastvaM Darmamavekzase । purastAddAruRo BUtvA sucitratarameva tat ॥1॥
author: śaunaka uvāca ।

text: anugṛhṇanti bhūtāni svena vṛttena pārthiva । kṛtsne nūnaṃ sadasatī iti loko vyavasyati । yatra tvaṃ tādṛśo bhūtvā dharmamadyānupaśyasi ॥2॥
html:
anugṛhṇanti bhūtāni svena vṛttena pārthiva ।
kṛtsne nūnaṃ sadasatī iti loko vyavasyati ।
yatra tvaṃ tādṛśo bhūtvā dharmamadyānupaśyasi ॥2॥
slp1: anugfhRanti BUtAni svena vfttena pArTiva । kftsne nUnaM sadasatI iti loko vyavasyati । yatra tvaM tAdfSo BUtvA DarmamadyAnupaSyasi ॥2॥

text: hitvā suruciraṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhogāṃśca tapa āsthitaḥ । ityetadapi bhūtānāmadbhutaṃ janamejaya ॥3॥
html:
hitvā suruciraṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhogāṃśca tapa āsthitaḥ ।
ityetadapi bhūtānāmadbhutaṃ janamejaya ॥3॥
slp1: hitvA suruciraM BakzyaM BogAMSca tapa AsTitaH । ityetadapi BUtAnAmadButaM janamejaya ॥3॥

text: yo durbalo bhaveddātā kṛpaṇo vā tapodhanaḥ । anāścaryaṃ tadityāhurnātidūre hi vartate ॥4॥
html:
yo durbalo bhaveddātā kṛpaṇo vā tapodhanaḥ ।
anāścaryaṃ tadityāhurnātidūre hi vartate ॥4॥
slp1: yo durbalo BaveddAtA kfpaRo vA tapoDanaH । anAScaryaM tadityAhurnAtidUre hi vartate ॥4॥

text: etadeva hi kārpaṇyaṃ samagramasamīkṣitam । tasmātsamīkṣayaiva syādbhavettasmiṃstato guṇaḥ ॥5॥
html:
etadeva hi kārpaṇyaṃ samagramasamīkṣitam ।
tasmātsamīkṣayaiva syādbhavettasmiṃstato guṇaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: etadeva hi kArpaRyaM samagramasamIkzitam । tasmAtsamIkzayEva syAdBavettasmiMstato guRaH ॥5॥

text: yajño dānaṃ dayā vedāḥ satyaṃ ca pṛthivīpate । pañcaitāni pavitrāṇi ṣaṣṭhaṃ sucaritaṃ tapaḥ ॥6॥
html:
yajño dānaṃ dayā vedāḥ satyaṃ ca pṛthivīpate ।
pañcaitāni pavitrāṇi ṣaṣṭhaṃ sucaritaṃ tapaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: yajYo dAnaM dayA vedAH satyaM ca pfTivIpate । paYcEtAni pavitrARi zazWaM sucaritaM tapaH ॥6॥

text: tadeva rājñāṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ janamejaya । tena samyaggṛhītena śreyāṃsaṃ dharmamāpsyasi ॥7॥
html:
tadeva rājñāṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ janamejaya ।
tena samyaggṛhītena śreyāṃsaṃ dharmamāpsyasi ॥7॥
slp1: tadeva rAjYAM paramaM pavitraM janamejaya । tena samyaggfhItena SreyAMsaM DarmamApsyasi ॥7॥

text: puṇyadeśābhigamanaṃ pavitraṃ paramaṃ smṛtam । api hyudāharantīmā gāthā gītā yayātinā ॥8॥
html:
puṇyadeśābhigamanaṃ pavitraṃ paramaṃ smṛtam ।
api hyudāharantīmā gāthā gītā yayātinā ॥8॥
slp1: puRyadeSABigamanaM pavitraM paramaM smftam । api hyudAharantImA gATA gItA yayAtinA ॥8॥

text: yo martyaḥ pratipadyeta āyurjīveta vā punaḥ । yajñamekāntataḥ kṛtvā tatsaṃnyasya tapaścaret ॥9॥
html:
yo martyaḥ pratipadyeta āyurjīveta vā punaḥ ।
yajñamekāntataḥ kṛtvā tatsaṃnyasya tapaścaret ॥9॥
slp1: yo martyaH pratipadyeta AyurjIveta vA punaH । yajYamekAntataH kftvA tatsaMnyasya tapaScaret ॥9॥

text: puṇyamāhuḥ kurukṣetraṃ sarasvatyāṃ pṛthūdakam । yatrāvagāhya pītvā vā naivaṃ śvomaraṇaṃ tapet ॥10॥
html:
puṇyamāhuḥ kurukṣetraṃ sarasvatyāṃ pṛthūdakam ।
yatrāvagāhya pītvā vā naivaṃ śvomaraṇaṃ tapet ॥10॥
slp1: puRyamAhuH kurukzetraM sarasvatyAM pfTUdakam । yatrAvagAhya pItvA vA nEvaM SvomaraRaM tapet ॥10॥

text: mahāsaraḥ puṣkarāṇi prabhāsottaramānase । kālodaṃ tveva gantāsi labdhāyurjīvite punaḥ ॥11॥
html:
mahāsaraḥ puṣkarāṇi prabhāsottaramānase ।
kālodaṃ tveva gantāsi labdhāyurjīvite punaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: mahAsaraH puzkarARi praBAsottaramAnase । kAlodaM tveva gantAsi labDAyurjIvite punaH ॥11॥

text: sarasvatīdṛṣadvatyau sevamāno'nusañcareḥ । svādhyāyaśīlaḥ sthāneṣu sarveṣu samupaspṛśeḥ ॥12॥
html:
sarasvatīdṛṣadvatyau sevamāno'nusañcareḥ ।
svādhyāyaśīlaḥ sthāneṣu sarveṣu samupaspṛśeḥ ॥12॥
slp1: sarasvatIdfzadvatyO sevamAno'nusaYcareH । svADyAyaSIlaH sTAnezu sarvezu samupaspfSeH ॥12॥

text: tyāgadharmaṃ pavitrāṇāṃ saṃnyāsaṃ paramabravīt । atrāpyudāharantīmā gāthāḥ satyavatā kṛtāḥ ॥13॥
html:
tyāgadharmaṃ pavitrāṇāṃ saṃnyāsaṃ paramabravīt ।
atrāpyudāharantīmā gāthāḥ satyavatā kṛtāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: tyAgaDarmaM pavitrARAM saMnyAsaM paramabravIt । atrApyudAharantImA gATAH satyavatA kftAH ॥13॥

text: yathā kumāraḥ satyo vai na puṇyo na ca pāpakṛt । na hyasti sarvabhūteṣu duḥkhamasminkutaḥ sukham ॥14॥
html:
yathā kumāraḥ satyo vai na puṇyo na ca pāpakṛt ।
na hyasti sarvabhūteṣu duḥkhamasminkutaḥ sukham ॥14॥
slp1: yaTA kumAraH satyo vE na puRyo na ca pApakft । na hyasti sarvaBUtezu duHKamasminkutaH suKam ॥14॥

text: evaṃ prakṛtibhūtānāṃ sarvasaṃsargayāyinām । tyajatāṃ jīvitaṃ prāyo vivṛte puṇyapātake ॥15॥
html:
evaṃ prakṛtibhūtānāṃ sarvasaṃsargayāyinām ।
tyajatāṃ jīvitaṃ prāyo vivṛte puṇyapātake ॥15॥
slp1: evaM prakftiBUtAnAM sarvasaMsargayAyinAm । tyajatAM jIvitaM prAyo vivfte puRyapAtake ॥15॥

text: yattveva rājño jyāyo vai kāryāṇāṃ tadvadāmi te । balena saṃvibhāgaiśca jaya svargaṃ punīṣva ca ॥16॥
html:
yattveva rājño jyāyo vai kāryāṇāṃ tadvadāmi te ।
balena saṃvibhāgaiśca jaya svargaṃ punīṣva ca ॥16॥
slp1: yattveva rAjYo jyAyo vE kAryARAM tadvadAmi te । balena saMviBAgESca jaya svargaM punIzva ca ॥16॥

text: yasyaivaṃ balamojaśca sa dharmasya prabhurnaraḥ । brāhmaṇānāṃ sukhārthaṃ tvaṃ paryehi pṛthivīmimām ॥17॥
html:
yasyaivaṃ balamojaśca sa dharmasya prabhurnaraḥ ।
brāhmaṇānāṃ sukhārthaṃ tvaṃ paryehi pṛthivīmimām ॥17॥
slp1: yasyEvaM balamojaSca sa Darmasya praBurnaraH । brAhmaRAnAM suKArTaM tvaM paryehi pfTivImimAm ॥17॥

text: yathaivainānpurākṣaipsīstathaivainānprasādaya । api dhikkriyamāṇo'pi tyajyamāno'pyanekadhā ॥18॥
html:
yathaivainānpurākṣaipsīstathaivainānprasādaya ।
api dhikkriyamāṇo'pi tyajyamāno'pyanekadhā ॥18॥
slp1: yaTEvEnAnpurAkzEpsIstaTEvEnAnprasAdaya । api DikkriyamARo'pi tyajyamAno'pyanekaDA ॥18॥

text: ātmano darśanaṃ vidvannāhantāsmīti mā krudhaḥ । ghaṭamānaḥ svakāryeṣu kuru naiḥśreyasaṃ param ॥19॥
html:
ātmano darśanaṃ vidvannāhantāsmīti mā krudhaḥ ।
ghaṭamānaḥ svakāryeṣu kuru naiḥśreyasaṃ param ॥19॥
slp1: Atmano darSanaM vidvannAhantAsmIti mA kruDaH । GawamAnaH svakAryezu kuru nEHSreyasaM param ॥19॥

text: himāgnighorasadṛśo rājā bhavati kaścana । lāṅgalāśanikalpo vā bhavatyanyaḥ parantapa ॥20॥
html:
himāgnighorasadṛśo rājā bhavati kaścana ।
lāṅgalāśanikalpo vā bhavatyanyaḥ parantapa ॥20॥
slp1: himAgniGorasadfSo rAjA Bavati kaScana । lANgalASanikalpo vA BavatyanyaH parantapa ॥20॥

text: na niḥśeṣeṇa mantavyamacikitsyena vā punaḥ । na jātu nāhamasmīti prasaktavyamasādhuṣu ॥21॥
html:
na niḥśeṣeṇa mantavyamacikitsyena vā punaḥ ।
na jātu nāhamasmīti prasaktavyamasādhuṣu ॥21॥
slp1: na niHSezeRa mantavyamacikitsyena vA punaH । na jAtu nAhamasmIti prasaktavyamasADuzu ॥21॥

text: vikarmaṇā tapyamānaḥ pādātpāpasya mucyate । naitatkāryaṃ punariti dvitīyātparimucyate । cariṣye dharmameveti tṛtīyātparimucyate ॥22॥
html:
vikarmaṇā tapyamānaḥ pādātpāpasya mucyate ।
naitatkāryaṃ punariti dvitīyātparimucyate ।
cariṣye dharmameveti tṛtīyātparimucyate ॥22॥
slp1: vikarmaRA tapyamAnaH pAdAtpApasya mucyate । nEtatkAryaM punariti dvitIyAtparimucyate । carizye Darmameveti tftIyAtparimucyate ॥22॥

text: kalyāṇamanumantavyaṃ puruṣeṇa bubhūṣatā । ye sugandhīni sevante tathāgandhā bhavanti te । ye durgandhīni sevante tathāgandhā bhavanti te ॥23॥
html:
kalyāṇamanumantavyaṃ puruṣeṇa bubhūṣatā ।
ye sugandhīni sevante tathāgandhā bhavanti te ।
ye durgandhīni sevante tathāgandhā bhavanti te ॥23॥
slp1: kalyARamanumantavyaM puruzeRa buBUzatA । ye suganDIni sevante taTAganDA Bavanti te । ye durganDIni sevante taTAganDA Bavanti te ॥23॥

text: tapaścaryāparaḥ sadyaḥ pāpāddhi parimucyate । saṃvatsaramupāsyāgnimabhiśastaḥ pramucyate । trīṇi varṣāṇyupāsyāgniṃ bhrūṇahā vipramucyate ॥24॥
html:
tapaścaryāparaḥ sadyaḥ pāpāddhi parimucyate ।
saṃvatsaramupāsyāgnimabhiśastaḥ pramucyate ।
trīṇi varṣāṇyupāsyāgniṃ bhrūṇahā vipramucyate ॥24॥
slp1: tapaScaryAparaH sadyaH pApAdDi parimucyate । saMvatsaramupAsyAgnimaBiSastaH pramucyate । trIRi varzARyupAsyAgniM BrURahA vipramucyate ॥24॥

text: yāvataḥ prāṇino hanyāttajjātīyānsvabhāvataḥ । pramīyamāṇānunmocya bhrūṇahā vipramucyate ॥25॥
html:
yāvataḥ prāṇino hanyāttajjātīyānsvabhāvataḥ ।
pramīyamāṇānunmocya bhrūṇahā vipramucyate ॥25॥
slp1: yAvataH prARino hanyAttajjAtIyAnsvaBAvataH । pramIyamARAnunmocya BrURahA vipramucyate ॥25॥

text: api vāpsu nimajjeta trirjapannaghamarṣaṇam । yathāśvamedhāvabhṛthastathā tanmanurabravīt ॥26॥
html:
api vāpsu nimajjeta trirjapannaghamarṣaṇam ।
yathāśvamedhāvabhṛthastathā tanmanurabravīt ॥26॥
slp1: api vApsu nimajjeta trirjapannaGamarzaRam । yaTASvameDAvaBfTastaTA tanmanurabravIt ॥26॥

text: kṣipraṃ praṇudate pāpaṃ satkāraṃ labhate tathā । api cainaṃ prasīdanti bhūtāni jaḍamūkavat ॥27॥
html:
kṣipraṃ praṇudate pāpaṃ satkāraṃ labhate tathā ।
api cainaṃ prasīdanti bhūtāni jaḍamūkavat ॥27॥
slp1: kzipraM praRudate pApaM satkAraM laBate taTA । api cEnaM prasIdanti BUtAni jaqamUkavat ॥27॥

text: bṛhaspatiṃ devaguruṃ surāsurāḥ sametya sarve nṛpate'nvayuñjan । dharme phalaṃ vettha kṛte maharṣe tathetarasminnarake pāpaloke ॥28॥
html:
bṛhaspatiṃ devaguruṃ surāsurāḥ sametya sarve nṛpate'nvayuñjan ।
dharme phalaṃ vettha kṛte maharṣe tathetarasminnarake pāpaloke ॥28॥
slp1: bfhaspatiM devaguruM surAsurAH sametya sarve nfpate'nvayuYjan । Darme PalaM vetTa kfte maharze taTetarasminnarake pApaloke ॥28॥

text: ubhe tu yasya sukṛte bhavetāṃ kiṃ svittayostatra jayottaraṃ syāt । ācakṣva naḥ karmaphalaṃ maharṣe kathaṃ pāpaṃ nudate puṇyaśīlaḥ ॥29॥
html:
ubhe tu yasya sukṛte bhavetāṃ kiṃ svittayostatra jayottaraṃ syāt ।
ācakṣva naḥ karmaphalaṃ maharṣe kathaṃ pāpaṃ nudate puṇyaśīlaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: uBe tu yasya sukfte BavetAM kiM svittayostatra jayottaraM syAt । Acakzva naH karmaPalaM maharze kaTaM pApaM nudate puRyaSIlaH ॥29॥

text: kṛtvā pāpaṃ pūrvamabuddhipūrvaṃ puṇyāni yaḥ kurute buddhipūrvam । sa tatpāpaṃ nudate puṇyaśīlo vāso yathā malinaṃ kṣārayuktyā ॥30॥
html:
kṛtvā pāpaṃ pūrvamabuddhipūrvaṃ puṇyāni yaḥ kurute buddhipūrvam ।
sa tatpāpaṃ nudate puṇyaśīlo vāso yathā malinaṃ kṣārayuktyā ॥30॥
slp1: kftvA pApaM pUrvamabudDipUrvaM puRyAni yaH kurute budDipUrvam । sa tatpApaM nudate puRyaSIlo vAso yaTA malinaM kzArayuktyA ॥30॥
author: bṛhaspatiruvāca ।

text: pāpaṃ kṛtvā na manyeta nāhamasmīti pūruṣaḥ । cikīrṣedeva kalyāṇaṃ śraddadhāno'nasūyakaḥ ॥31॥
html:
pāpaṃ kṛtvā na manyeta nāhamasmīti pūruṣaḥ ।
cikīrṣedeva kalyāṇaṃ śraddadhāno'nasūyakaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: pApaM kftvA na manyeta nAhamasmIti pUruzaH । cikIrzedeva kalyARaM SraddaDAno'nasUyakaH ॥31॥

text: chidrāṇi vasanasyeva sādhunā vivṛṇoti yaḥ । yaḥ pāpaṃ puruṣaḥ kṛtvā kalyāṇamabhipadyate ॥32॥
html:
chidrāṇi vasanasyeva sādhunā vivṛṇoti yaḥ ।
yaḥ pāpaṃ puruṣaḥ kṛtvā kalyāṇamabhipadyate ॥32॥
slp1: CidrARi vasanasyeva sADunA vivfRoti yaH । yaH pApaM puruzaH kftvA kalyARamaBipadyate ॥32॥

text: yathādityaḥ punarudyaṃstamaḥ sarvaṃ vyapohati । kalyāṇamācarannevaṃ sarvaṃ pāpaṃ vyapohati ॥33॥
html:
yathādityaḥ punarudyaṃstamaḥ sarvaṃ vyapohati ।
kalyāṇamācarannevaṃ sarvaṃ pāpaṃ vyapohati ॥33॥
slp1: yaTAdityaH punarudyaMstamaH sarvaM vyapohati । kalyARamAcarannevaM sarvaM pApaM vyapohati ॥33॥

text: evamuktvā sa rājānamindroto janamejayam । yājayāmāsa vidhivadvājimedhena śaunakaḥ ॥34॥
html:
evamuktvā sa rājānamindroto janamejayam ।
yājayāmāsa vidhivadvājimedhena śaunakaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: evamuktvA sa rAjAnamindroto janamejayam । yAjayAmAsa viDivadvAjimeDena SOnakaH ॥34॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tataḥ sa rājā vyapanītakalmaṣaḥ śriyā yutaḥ prajvalitāgnirūpayā । viveśa rājyaṃ svamamitrakarśano divaṃ yathā pūrṇavapurniśākaraḥ] ॥35॥
html:
tataḥ sa rājā vyapanītakalmaṣaḥ śriyā yutaḥ prajvalitāgnirūpayā ।
viveśa rājyaṃ svamamitrakarśano divaṃ yathā pūrṇavapurniśākaraḥ] ॥35॥
slp1: tataH sa rAjA vyapanItakalmazaH SriyA yutaH prajvalitAgnirUpayA । viveSa rAjyaM svamamitrakarSano divaM yaTA pUrRavapurniSAkaraH] ॥35॥

text: śṛṇu pārtha yathāvṛttamitihāsaṃ purātanam । gṛdhrajambukasaṃvādaṃ yo vṛtto vaidiśe purā ॥1॥
html:
śṛṇu pārtha yathāvṛttamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
gṛdhrajambukasaṃvādaṃ yo vṛtto vaidiśe purā ॥1॥
slp1: SfRu pArTa yaTAvfttamitihAsaM purAtanam । gfDrajambukasaMvAdaM yo vftto vEdiSe purA ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: duḥkhitāḥ kecidādāya bālamaprāptayauvanam । kulasarvasvabhūtaṃ vai rudantaḥ śokavihvalāḥ ॥2॥
html:
duḥkhitāḥ kecidādāya bālamaprāptayauvanam ।
kulasarvasvabhūtaṃ vai rudantaḥ śokavihvalāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: duHKitAH kecidAdAya bAlamaprAptayOvanam । kulasarvasvaBUtaM vE rudantaH SokavihvalAH ॥2॥

text: bālaṃ mṛtaṃ gṛhītvātha śmaśānābhimukhāḥ sthitāḥ । aṅkenāṅkaṃ ca saṅkramya rurudurbhūtale tadā ॥3॥
html:
bālaṃ mṛtaṃ gṛhītvātha śmaśānābhimukhāḥ sthitāḥ ।
aṅkenāṅkaṃ ca saṅkramya rurudurbhūtale tadā ॥3॥
slp1: bAlaM mftaM gfhItvATa SmaSAnABimuKAH sTitAH । aNkenANkaM ca saNkramya rurudurBUtale tadA ॥3॥

text: teṣāṃ ruditaśabdena gṛdhro'bhyetya vaco'bravīt । ekātmakamimaṃ loke tyaktvā gacchata māciram ॥4॥
html:
teṣāṃ ruditaśabdena gṛdhro'bhyetya vaco'bravīt ।
ekātmakamimaṃ loke tyaktvā gacchata māciram ॥4॥
slp1: tezAM ruditaSabdena gfDro'Byetya vaco'bravIt । ekAtmakamimaM loke tyaktvA gacCata mAciram ॥4॥

text: iha puṃsāṃ sahasrāṇi strīsahasrāṇi caiva hi । samānītāni kālena kiṃ te vai jātvabāndhavāḥ ॥5॥
html:
iha puṃsāṃ sahasrāṇi strīsahasrāṇi caiva hi ।
samānītāni kālena kiṃ te vai jātvabāndhavāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: iha puMsAM sahasrARi strIsahasrARi cEva hi । samAnItAni kAlena kiM te vE jAtvabAnDavAH ॥5॥

text: saṃpaśyata jagatsarvaṃ sukhaduḥkhairadhiṣṭhitam । saṃyogo viprayogaśca paryāyeṇopalabhyate ॥6॥
html:
saṃpaśyata jagatsarvaṃ sukhaduḥkhairadhiṣṭhitam ।
saṃyogo viprayogaśca paryāyeṇopalabhyate ॥6॥
slp1: saMpaSyata jagatsarvaM suKaduHKEraDizWitam । saMyogo viprayogaSca paryAyeRopalaByate ॥6॥

text: gṛhītvā ye ca gacchanti ye'nuyānti ca tānmṛtān । te'pyāyuṣaḥ pramāṇena svena gacchanti jantavaḥ ॥7॥
html:
gṛhītvā ye ca gacchanti ye'nuyānti ca tānmṛtān ।
te'pyāyuṣaḥ pramāṇena svena gacchanti jantavaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: gfhItvA ye ca gacCanti ye'nuyAnti ca tAnmftAn । te'pyAyuzaH pramARena svena gacCanti jantavaH ॥7॥

text: alaṃ sthitvā śmaśāne'smingṛdhragomāyusaṅkule । kaṅkālabahule ghore sarvaprāṇibhayaṅkare ॥8॥
html:
alaṃ sthitvā śmaśāne'smingṛdhragomāyusaṅkule ।
kaṅkālabahule ghore sarvaprāṇibhayaṅkare ॥8॥
slp1: alaM sTitvA SmaSAne'smingfDragomAyusaNkule । kaNkAlabahule Gore sarvaprARiBayaNkare ॥8॥

text: na punarjīvitaḥ kaścitkāladharmamupāgataḥ । priyo vā yadi vā dveṣyaḥ prāṇināṃ gatirīdṛśī ॥9॥
html:
na punarjīvitaḥ kaścitkāladharmamupāgataḥ ।
priyo vā yadi vā dveṣyaḥ prāṇināṃ gatirīdṛśī ॥9॥
