slp1: na punarjIvitaH kaScitkAlaDarmamupAgataH । priyo vA yadi vA dvezyaH prARinAM gatirIdfSI ॥9॥

text: sarveṇa khalu martavyaṃ martyaloke prasūyatā । kṛtāntavihite mārge ko mṛtaṃ jīvayiṣyati ॥10॥
html:
sarveṇa khalu martavyaṃ martyaloke prasūyatā ।
kṛtāntavihite mārge ko mṛtaṃ jīvayiṣyati ॥10॥
slp1: sarveRa Kalu martavyaM martyaloke prasUyatA । kftAntavihite mArge ko mftaM jIvayizyati ॥10॥

text: karmāntavihite loke cāstaṃ gacchati bhāskare । gamyatāṃ svamadhiṣṭhānaṃ sutasnehaṃ visṛjya vai ॥11॥
html:
karmāntavihite loke cāstaṃ gacchati bhāskare ।
gamyatāṃ svamadhiṣṭhānaṃ sutasnehaṃ visṛjya vai ॥11॥
slp1: karmAntavihite loke cAstaM gacCati BAskare । gamyatAM svamaDizWAnaM sutasnehaM visfjya vE ॥11॥

text: tato gṛdhravacaḥ śrutvā vikrośantastadā nṛpa । bāndhavāste'bhyagacchanta putramutsṛjya bhūtale ॥12॥
html:
tato gṛdhravacaḥ śrutvā vikrośantastadā nṛpa ।
bāndhavāste'bhyagacchanta putramutsṛjya bhūtale ॥12॥
slp1: tato gfDravacaH SrutvA vikroSantastadA nfpa । bAnDavAste'ByagacCanta putramutsfjya BUtale ॥12॥

text: viniścityātha ca tataḥ santyajantaḥ svamātmajam । nirāśā jīvite tasya mārgamāruhya dhiṣṭhitāḥ ॥13॥
html:
viniścityātha ca tataḥ santyajantaḥ svamātmajam ।
nirāśā jīvite tasya mārgamāruhya dhiṣṭhitāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: viniScityATa ca tataH santyajantaH svamAtmajam । nirASA jIvite tasya mArgamAruhya DizWitAH ॥13॥

text: dhvāṅkṣābhrasamavarṇastu bilānniḥsṛtya jambukaḥ । gacchamānānsma tānāha nirghṛṇāḥ khalu mānavāḥ ॥14॥
html:
dhvāṅkṣābhrasamavarṇastu bilānniḥsṛtya jambukaḥ ।
gacchamānānsma tānāha nirghṛṇāḥ khalu mānavāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: DvANkzABrasamavarRastu bilAnniHsftya jambukaH । gacCamAnAnsma tAnAha nirGfRAH Kalu mAnavAH ॥14॥

text: ādityo'yaṃ sthito mūḍhāḥ snehaṃ kuruta mā bhayam । bahurūpo muhūrtaśca jīvetāpi kadācana ॥15॥
html:
ādityo'yaṃ sthito mūḍhāḥ snehaṃ kuruta mā bhayam ।
bahurūpo muhūrtaśca jīvetāpi kadācana ॥15॥
slp1: Adityo'yaM sTito mUQAH snehaM kuruta mA Bayam । bahurUpo muhUrtaSca jIvetApi kadAcana ॥15॥

text: yūyaṃ bhūmau vinikṣipya putrasnehavinākṛtāḥ । śmaśāne putramutsṛjya kasmādgacchatha nirghṛṇāḥ ॥16॥
html:
yūyaṃ bhūmau vinikṣipya putrasnehavinākṛtāḥ ।
śmaśāne putramutsṛjya kasmādgacchatha nirghṛṇāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: yUyaM BUmO vinikzipya putrasnehavinAkftAH । SmaSAne putramutsfjya kasmAdgacCaTa nirGfRAH ॥16॥

text: na vo'styasminsute sneho bāle madhurabhāṣiṇi । yasya bhāṣitamātreṇa prasādamupagacchatha ॥17॥
html:
na vo'styasminsute sneho bāle madhurabhāṣiṇi ।
yasya bhāṣitamātreṇa prasādamupagacchatha ॥17॥
slp1: na vo'styasminsute sneho bAle maDuraBAziRi । yasya BAzitamAtreRa prasAdamupagacCaTa ॥17॥

text: na paśyatha sutasnehaṃ yādṛśaḥ paśupakṣiṇām । na yeṣāṃ dhārayitvā tānkaścidasti phalāgamaḥ ॥18॥
html:
na paśyatha sutasnehaṃ yādṛśaḥ paśupakṣiṇām ।
na yeṣāṃ dhārayitvā tānkaścidasti phalāgamaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: na paSyaTa sutasnehaM yAdfSaH paSupakziRAm । na yezAM DArayitvA tAnkaScidasti PalAgamaH ॥18॥

text: catuṣpātpakṣikīṭānāṃ prāṇināṃ snehasaṅginām । paralokagatisthānāṃ muniyajñakriyā iva ॥19॥
html:
catuṣpātpakṣikīṭānāṃ prāṇināṃ snehasaṅginām ।
paralokagatisthānāṃ muniyajñakriyā iva ॥19॥
slp1: catuzpAtpakzikIwAnAM prARinAM snehasaNginAm । paralokagatisTAnAM muniyajYakriyA iva ॥19॥

text: teṣāṃ putrābhirāmāṇāmiha loke paratra ca । na guṇo dṛśyate kaścitprajāḥ sandhārayanti ca ॥20॥
html:
teṣāṃ putrābhirāmāṇāmiha loke paratra ca ।
na guṇo dṛśyate kaścitprajāḥ sandhārayanti ca ॥20॥
slp1: tezAM putrABirAmARAmiha loke paratra ca । na guRo dfSyate kaScitprajAH sanDArayanti ca ॥20॥

text: apaśyatāṃ priyānputrānnaiṣāṃ śoko'nutiṣṭhati । na ca puṣṇanti saṃvṛddhāste mātāpitarau kvacit ॥21॥
html:
apaśyatāṃ priyānputrānnaiṣāṃ śoko'nutiṣṭhati ।
na ca puṣṇanti saṃvṛddhāste mātāpitarau kvacit ॥21॥
slp1: apaSyatAM priyAnputrAnnEzAM Soko'nutizWati । na ca puzRanti saMvfdDAste mAtApitarO kvacit ॥21॥

text: mānuṣāṇāṃ kutaḥ sneho yeṣāṃ śoko bhaviṣyati । imaṃ kulakaraṃ putraṃ kathaṃ tyaktvā gamiṣyatha ॥22॥
html:
mānuṣāṇāṃ kutaḥ sneho yeṣāṃ śoko bhaviṣyati ।
imaṃ kulakaraṃ putraṃ kathaṃ tyaktvā gamiṣyatha ॥22॥
slp1: mAnuzARAM kutaH sneho yezAM Soko Bavizyati । imaM kulakaraM putraM kaTaM tyaktvA gamizyaTa ॥22॥

text: ciraṃ muñcata bāṣpaṃ ca ciraṃ snehena paśyata । evaṃvidhāni hīṣṭāni dustyajāni viśeṣataḥ ॥23॥
html:
ciraṃ muñcata bāṣpaṃ ca ciraṃ snehena paśyata ।
evaṃvidhāni hīṣṭāni dustyajāni viśeṣataḥ ॥23॥
slp1: ciraM muYcata bAzpaM ca ciraM snehena paSyata । evaMviDAni hIzwAni dustyajAni viSezataH ॥23॥

text: kṣīṇasyāthābhiyuktasya śmaśānābhimukhasya ca । bāndhavā yatra tiṣṭhanti tatrānyo nāvatiṣṭhate ॥24॥
html:
kṣīṇasyāthābhiyuktasya śmaśānābhimukhasya ca ।
bāndhavā yatra tiṣṭhanti tatrānyo nāvatiṣṭhate ॥24॥
slp1: kzIRasyATABiyuktasya SmaSAnABimuKasya ca । bAnDavA yatra tizWanti tatrAnyo nAvatizWate ॥24॥

text: sarvasya dayitāḥ prāṇāḥ sarvaḥ snehaṃ ca vindati । tiryagyoniṣvapi satāṃ snehaṃ paśyata yādṛśam ॥25॥
html:
sarvasya dayitāḥ prāṇāḥ sarvaḥ snehaṃ ca vindati ।
tiryagyoniṣvapi satāṃ snehaṃ paśyata yādṛśam ॥25॥
slp1: sarvasya dayitAH prARAH sarvaH snehaM ca vindati । tiryagyonizvapi satAM snehaM paSyata yAdfSam ॥25॥

text: tyaktvā kathaṃ gacchethemaṃ padmalolāyatākṣakam । yathā navodvāhakṛtaṃ snānamālyavibhūṣitam ॥26॥
html:
tyaktvā kathaṃ gacchethemaṃ padmalolāyatākṣakam ।
yathā navodvāhakṛtaṃ snānamālyavibhūṣitam ॥26॥
slp1: tyaktvA kaTaM gacCeTemaM padmalolAyatAkzakam । yaTA navodvAhakftaM snAnamAlyaviBUzitam ॥26॥

text: jambukasya vacaḥ śrutvā kṛpaṇaṃ paridevataḥ । nyavartanta tadā sarve śavārthaṃ te sma mānuṣāḥ ॥27॥
html:
jambukasya vacaḥ śrutvā kṛpaṇaṃ paridevataḥ ।
nyavartanta tadā sarve śavārthaṃ te sma mānuṣāḥ ॥27॥
slp1: jambukasya vacaH SrutvA kfpaRaM paridevataH । nyavartanta tadA sarve SavArTaM te sma mAnuzAH ॥27॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: aho dhiksunṛśaṃsena jambukenālpamedhasā । kṣudreṇoktā hīnasattvā mānuṣāḥ kiṃ nivartatha ॥28॥
html:
aho dhiksunṛśaṃsena jambukenālpamedhasā ।
kṣudreṇoktā hīnasattvā mānuṣāḥ kiṃ nivartatha ॥28॥
slp1: aho DiksunfSaMsena jambukenAlpameDasA । kzudreRoktA hInasattvA mAnuzAH kiM nivartaTa ॥28॥
author: gṛdhra uvāca ।

text: pañcabhūtaparityaktaṃ śūnyaṃ kāṣṭhatvamāgatam । kasmācchocatha niśceṣṭamātmānaṃ kiṃ na śocatha ॥29॥
html:
pañcabhūtaparityaktaṃ śūnyaṃ kāṣṭhatvamāgatam ।
kasmācchocatha niśceṣṭamātmānaṃ kiṃ na śocatha ॥29॥
slp1: paYcaBUtaparityaktaM SUnyaM kAzWatvamAgatam । kasmAcCocaTa niScezwamAtmAnaM kiM na SocaTa ॥29॥

text: tapaḥ kuruta vai tīvraṃ mucyadhvaṃ yena kilbiṣāt । tapasā labhyate sarvaṃ vilāpaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati ॥30॥
html:
tapaḥ kuruta vai tīvraṃ mucyadhvaṃ yena kilbiṣāt ।
tapasā labhyate sarvaṃ vilāpaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati ॥30॥
slp1: tapaH kuruta vE tIvraM mucyaDvaM yena kilbizAt । tapasA laByate sarvaM vilApaH kiM karizyati ॥30॥

text: aniṣṭāni ca bhāgyāni jānīta saha mūrtibhiḥ । yena gacchati loko'yaṃ dattvā śokamanantakam ॥31॥
html:
aniṣṭāni ca bhāgyāni jānīta saha mūrtibhiḥ ।
yena gacchati loko'yaṃ dattvā śokamanantakam ॥31॥
slp1: anizwAni ca BAgyAni jAnIta saha mUrtiBiH । yena gacCati loko'yaM dattvA Sokamanantakam ॥31॥

text: dhanaṃ gāśca suvarṇaṃ ca maṇiratnamathāpi ca । apatyaṃ ca tapomūlaṃ tapoyogācca labhyate ॥32॥
html:
dhanaṃ gāśca suvarṇaṃ ca maṇiratnamathāpi ca ।
apatyaṃ ca tapomūlaṃ tapoyogācca labhyate ॥32॥
slp1: DanaM gASca suvarRaM ca maRiratnamaTApi ca । apatyaM ca tapomUlaM tapoyogAcca laByate ॥32॥

text: yathākṛtā ca bhūteṣu prāpyate sukhaduḥkhatā । gṛhītvā jāyate janturduḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca ॥33॥
html:
yathākṛtā ca bhūteṣu prāpyate sukhaduḥkhatā ।
gṛhītvā jāyate janturduḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca ॥33॥
slp1: yaTAkftA ca BUtezu prApyate suKaduHKatA । gfhItvA jAyate janturduHKAni ca suKAni ca ॥33॥

text: na karmaṇā pituḥ putraḥ pitā vā putrakarmaṇā । mārgeṇānyena gacchanti tyaktvā sukṛtaduṣkṛte ॥34॥
html:
na karmaṇā pituḥ putraḥ pitā vā putrakarmaṇā ।
mārgeṇānyena gacchanti tyaktvā sukṛtaduṣkṛte ॥34॥
slp1: na karmaRA pituH putraH pitA vA putrakarmaRA । mArgeRAnyena gacCanti tyaktvA sukftaduzkfte ॥34॥

text: dharmaṃ carata yatnena tathādharmānnivartata । vartadhvaṃ ca yathākālaṃ daivateṣu dvijeṣu ca ॥35॥
html:
dharmaṃ carata yatnena tathādharmānnivartata ।
vartadhvaṃ ca yathākālaṃ daivateṣu dvijeṣu ca ॥35॥
slp1: DarmaM carata yatnena taTADarmAnnivartata । vartaDvaM ca yaTAkAlaM dEvatezu dvijezu ca ॥35॥

text: śokaṃ tyajata dainyaṃ ca sutasnehānnivartata । tyajyatāmayamākāśe tataḥ śīghraṃ nivartata ॥36॥
html:
śokaṃ tyajata dainyaṃ ca sutasnehānnivartata ।
tyajyatāmayamākāśe tataḥ śīghraṃ nivartata ॥36॥
slp1: SokaM tyajata dEnyaM ca sutasnehAnnivartata । tyajyatAmayamAkASe tataH SIGraM nivartata ॥36॥

text: yatkaroti śubhaṃ karma tathādharmaṃ sudāruṇam । tatkartaiva samaśnāti bāndhavānāṃ kimatra hi ॥37॥
html:
yatkaroti śubhaṃ karma tathādharmaṃ sudāruṇam ।
tatkartaiva samaśnāti bāndhavānāṃ kimatra hi ॥37॥
slp1: yatkaroti SuBaM karma taTADarmaM sudAruRam । tatkartEva samaSnAti bAnDavAnAM kimatra hi ॥37॥

text: iha tyaktvā na tiṣṭhanti bāndhavā bāndhavaṃ priyam । snehamutsṛjya gacchanti bāṣpapūrṇāvilekṣaṇāḥ ॥38॥
html:
iha tyaktvā na tiṣṭhanti bāndhavā bāndhavaṃ priyam ।
snehamutsṛjya gacchanti bāṣpapūrṇāvilekṣaṇāḥ ॥38॥
slp1: iha tyaktvA na tizWanti bAnDavA bAnDavaM priyam । snehamutsfjya gacCanti bAzpapUrRAvilekzaRAH ॥38॥

text: prājño vā yadi vā mūrkhaḥ sadhano nirdhano'pi vā । sarvaḥ kālavaśaṃ yāti śubhāśubhasamanvitaḥ ॥39॥
html:
prājño vā yadi vā mūrkhaḥ sadhano nirdhano'pi vā ।
sarvaḥ kālavaśaṃ yāti śubhāśubhasamanvitaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: prAjYo vA yadi vA mUrKaH saDano nirDano'pi vA । sarvaH kAlavaSaM yAti SuBASuBasamanvitaH ॥39॥

text: kiṃ kariṣyatha śocitvā mṛtaṃ kimanuśocatha । sarvasya hi prabhuḥ kālo dharmataḥ samadarśanaḥ ॥40॥
html:
kiṃ kariṣyatha śocitvā mṛtaṃ kimanuśocatha ।
sarvasya hi prabhuḥ kālo dharmataḥ samadarśanaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: kiM karizyaTa SocitvA mftaM kimanuSocaTa । sarvasya hi praBuH kAlo DarmataH samadarSanaH ॥40॥

text: yauvanasthāṃśca bālāṃśca vṛddhāngarbhagatānapi । sarvānāviśate mṛtyurevaṃbhūtamidaṃ jagat ॥41॥
html:
yauvanasthāṃśca bālāṃśca vṛddhāngarbhagatānapi ।
sarvānāviśate mṛtyurevaṃbhūtamidaṃ jagat ॥41॥
slp1: yOvanasTAMSca bAlAMSca vfdDAngarBagatAnapi । sarvAnAviSate mftyurevaMBUtamidaM jagat ॥41॥

text: aho mandīkṛtaḥ sneho gṛdhreṇehālpamedhasā । putrasnehābhibhūtānāṃ yuṣmākaṃ śocatāṃ bhṛśam ॥42॥
html:
aho mandīkṛtaḥ sneho gṛdhreṇehālpamedhasā ।
putrasnehābhibhūtānāṃ yuṣmākaṃ śocatāṃ bhṛśam ॥42॥
slp1: aho mandIkftaH sneho gfDreRehAlpameDasA । putrasnehABiBUtAnAM yuzmAkaM SocatAM BfSam ॥42॥
author: jambuka uvāca ।

text: samaiḥ samyakprayuktaiśca vacanaiḥ praśrayottaraiḥ । yadgacchatha jalasthāyaṃ snehamutsṛjya dustyajam ॥43॥
html:
samaiḥ samyakprayuktaiśca vacanaiḥ praśrayottaraiḥ ।
yadgacchatha jalasthāyaṃ snehamutsṛjya dustyajam ॥43॥
slp1: samEH samyakprayuktESca vacanEH praSrayottarEH । yadgacCaTa jalasTAyaM snehamutsfjya dustyajam ॥43॥

text: aho putraviyogena mṛtaśūnyopasevanāt । krośatāṃ vai bhṛśaṃ duḥkhaṃ vivatsānāṃ gavāmiva ॥44॥
html:
aho putraviyogena mṛtaśūnyopasevanāt ।
krośatāṃ vai bhṛśaṃ duḥkhaṃ vivatsānāṃ gavāmiva ॥44॥
slp1: aho putraviyogena mftaSUnyopasevanAt । kroSatAM vE BfSaM duHKaM vivatsAnAM gavAmiva ॥44॥

text: adya śokaṃ vijānāmi mānuṣāṇāṃ mahītale । snehaṃ hi karuṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā mamāpyaśrūṇyathāgaman ॥45॥
html:
adya śokaṃ vijānāmi mānuṣāṇāṃ mahītale ।
snehaṃ hi karuṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā mamāpyaśrūṇyathāgaman ॥45॥
slp1: adya SokaM vijAnAmi mAnuzARAM mahItale । snehaM hi karuRaM dfzwvA mamApyaSrURyaTAgaman ॥45॥

text: yatno hi satataṃ kāryaḥ kṛto daivena sidhyati । daivaṃ puruṣakāraśca kṛtāntenopapadyate ॥46॥
html:
yatno hi satataṃ kāryaḥ kṛto daivena sidhyati ।
daivaṃ puruṣakāraśca kṛtāntenopapadyate ॥46॥
slp1: yatno hi satataM kAryaH kfto dEvena siDyati । dEvaM puruzakAraSca kftAntenopapadyate ॥46॥

text: anirvedaḥ sadā kāryo nirvedāddhi kutaḥ sukham । prayatnātprāpyate hyarthaḥ kasmādgacchatha nirdayāḥ ॥47॥
html:
anirvedaḥ sadā kāryo nirvedāddhi kutaḥ sukham ।
prayatnātprāpyate hyarthaḥ kasmādgacchatha nirdayāḥ ॥47॥
slp1: anirvedaH sadA kAryo nirvedAdDi kutaH suKam । prayatnAtprApyate hyarTaH kasmAdgacCaTa nirdayAH ॥47॥

text: ātmamāṃsopavṛttaṃ ca śarīrārdhamayīṃ tanum । pitṝṇāṃ vaṃśakartāraṃ vane tyaktvā kva yāsyatha ॥48॥
html:
ātmamāṃsopavṛttaṃ ca śarīrārdhamayīṃ tanum ।
pitṝṇāṃ vaṃśakartāraṃ vane tyaktvā kva yāsyatha ॥48॥
slp1: AtmamAMsopavfttaM ca SarIrArDamayIM tanum । pitFRAM vaMSakartAraM vane tyaktvA kva yAsyaTa ॥48॥

text: atha vāstaṃ gate sūrye sandhyākāla upasthite । tato neṣyatha vā putramihasthā vā bhaviṣyatha ॥49॥
html:
atha vāstaṃ gate sūrye sandhyākāla upasthite ।
tato neṣyatha vā putramihasthā vā bhaviṣyatha ॥49॥
slp1: aTa vAstaM gate sUrye sanDyAkAla upasTite । tato nezyaTa vA putramihasTA vA BavizyaTa ॥49॥

text: adya varṣasahasraṃ me sāgraṃ jātasya mānuṣāḥ । na ca paśyāmi jīvantaṃ mṛtaṃ strīpuṃnapuṃsakam ॥50॥
html:
adya varṣasahasraṃ me sāgraṃ jātasya mānuṣāḥ ।
na ca paśyāmi jīvantaṃ mṛtaṃ strīpuṃnapuṃsakam ॥50॥
slp1: adya varzasahasraM me sAgraM jAtasya mAnuzAH । na ca paSyAmi jIvantaM mftaM strIpuMnapuMsakam ॥50॥
author: gṛdhra uvāca ।

text: mṛtā garbheṣu jāyante mriyante jātamātrakāḥ । vikramanto mriyante ca yauvanasthāstathāpare ॥51॥
html:
mṛtā garbheṣu jāyante mriyante jātamātrakāḥ ।
vikramanto mriyante ca yauvanasthāstathāpare ॥51॥
slp1: mftA garBezu jAyante mriyante jAtamAtrakAH । vikramanto mriyante ca yOvanasTAstaTApare ॥51॥

text: anityānīha bhāgyāni catuṣpātpakṣiṇāmapi । jaṅgamājaṅgamānāṃ cāpyāyuragre'vatiṣṭhate ॥52॥
html:
anityānīha bhāgyāni catuṣpātpakṣiṇāmapi ।
jaṅgamājaṅgamānāṃ cāpyāyuragre'vatiṣṭhate ॥52॥
slp1: anityAnIha BAgyAni catuzpAtpakziRAmapi । jaNgamAjaNgamAnAM cApyAyuragre'vatizWate ॥52॥

text: iṣṭadāraviyuktāśca putraśokānvitāstathā । dahyamānāḥ sma śokena gṛhaṃ gacchanti nityadā ॥53॥
html:
iṣṭadāraviyuktāśca putraśokānvitāstathā ।
dahyamānāḥ sma śokena gṛhaṃ gacchanti nityadā ॥53॥
slp1: izwadAraviyuktASca putraSokAnvitAstaTA । dahyamAnAH sma Sokena gfhaM gacCanti nityadA ॥53॥

text: aniṣṭānāṃ sahasrāṇi tatheṣṭānāṃ śatāni ca । utsṛjyeha prayātā vai bāndhavā bhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ ॥54॥
html:
aniṣṭānāṃ sahasrāṇi tatheṣṭānāṃ śatāni ca ।
utsṛjyeha prayātā vai bāndhavā bhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ ॥54॥
slp1: anizwAnAM sahasrARi taTezwAnAM SatAni ca । utsfjyeha prayAtA vE bAnDavA BfSaduHKitAH ॥54॥

text: tyajyatāmeṣa nistejāḥ śūnyaḥ kāṣṭhatvamāgataḥ । anyadehaviṣakto hi śāvaṃ kāṣṭhamupāsate ॥55॥
html:
tyajyatāmeṣa nistejāḥ śūnyaḥ kāṣṭhatvamāgataḥ ।
anyadehaviṣakto hi śāvaṃ kāṣṭhamupāsate ॥55॥
slp1: tyajyatAmeza nistejAH SUnyaH kAzWatvamAgataH । anyadehavizakto hi SAvaM kAzWamupAsate ॥55॥

text: bhrāntajīvasya vai bāṣpaṃ kasmāddhitvā na gacchatha । nirarthako hyayaṃ sneho nirarthaśca parigrahaḥ ॥56॥
html:
bhrāntajīvasya vai bāṣpaṃ kasmāddhitvā na gacchatha ।
nirarthako hyayaṃ sneho nirarthaśca parigrahaḥ ॥56॥
slp1: BrAntajIvasya vE bAzpaM kasmAdDitvA na gacCaTa । nirarTako hyayaM sneho nirarTaSca parigrahaH ॥56॥

text: na cakṣurbhyāṃ na karṇābhyāṃ saṃśṛṇoti samīkṣate । tasmādenaṃ samutsṛjya svagṛhāngacchatāśu vai ॥57॥
html:
na cakṣurbhyāṃ na karṇābhyāṃ saṃśṛṇoti samīkṣate ।
tasmādenaṃ samutsṛjya svagṛhāngacchatāśu vai ॥57॥
slp1: na cakzurByAM na karRAByAM saMSfRoti samIkzate । tasmAdenaM samutsfjya svagfhAngacCatASu vE ॥57॥

text: mokṣadharmāśritairvākyairhetumadbhiraniṣṭhuraiḥ । mayoktā gacchata kṣipraṃ svaṃ svameva niveśanam ॥58॥
html:
mokṣadharmāśritairvākyairhetumadbhiraniṣṭhuraiḥ ।
mayoktā gacchata kṣipraṃ svaṃ svameva niveśanam ॥58॥
slp1: mokzaDarmASritErvAkyErhetumadBiranizWurEH । mayoktA gacCata kzipraM svaM svameva niveSanam ॥58॥

text: prajñāvijñānayuktena buddhisañjñāpradāyinā । vacanaṃ śrāvitā rūkṣaṃ mānuṣāḥ sannivartata ॥59॥
html:
prajñāvijñānayuktena buddhisañjñāpradāyinā ।
vacanaṃ śrāvitā rūkṣaṃ mānuṣāḥ sannivartata ॥59॥
slp1: prajYAvijYAnayuktena budDisaYjYApradAyinA । vacanaM SrAvitA rUkzaM mAnuzAH sannivartata ॥59॥

text: imaṃ kanakavarṇābhaṃ bhūṣaṇaiḥ samalaṅkṛtam । gṛdhravākyātkathaṃ putraṃ tyajadhvaṃ pitṛpiṇḍadam ॥60॥
html:
imaṃ kanakavarṇābhaṃ bhūṣaṇaiḥ samalaṅkṛtam ।
gṛdhravākyātkathaṃ putraṃ tyajadhvaṃ pitṛpiṇḍadam ॥60॥
slp1: imaM kanakavarRABaM BUzaREH samalaNkftam । gfDravAkyAtkaTaM putraM tyajaDvaM pitfpiRqadam ॥60॥
author: jambuka uvāca ।

text: na snehasya virodho'sti vilāparuditasya vai । mṛtasyāsya parityāgāttāpo vai bhavitā dhruvam ॥61॥
html:
na snehasya virodho'sti vilāparuditasya vai ।
mṛtasyāsya parityāgāttāpo vai bhavitā dhruvam ॥61॥
slp1: na snehasya viroDo'sti vilAparuditasya vE । mftasyAsya parityAgAttApo vE BavitA Druvam ॥61॥

text: śrūyate śambuke śūdre hate brāhmaṇadārakaḥ । jīvito dharmamāsādya rāmātsatyaparākramāt ॥62॥
html:
śrūyate śambuke śūdre hate brāhmaṇadārakaḥ ।
jīvito dharmamāsādya rāmātsatyaparākramāt ॥62॥
slp1: SrUyate Sambuke SUdre hate brAhmaRadArakaH । jIvito DarmamAsAdya rAmAtsatyaparAkramAt ॥62॥

text: tathā śvetasya rājarṣerbālo diṣṭāntamāgataḥ । śvo'bhūte dharmanityena mṛtaḥ sañjīvitaḥ punaḥ ॥63॥
html:
tathā śvetasya rājarṣerbālo diṣṭāntamāgataḥ ।
śvo'bhūte dharmanityena mṛtaḥ sañjīvitaḥ punaḥ ॥63॥
slp1: taTA Svetasya rAjarzerbAlo dizwAntamAgataH । Svo'BUte Darmanityena mftaH saYjIvitaH punaH ॥63॥

text: tathā kaścidbhavetsiddho munirvā devatāpi vā । kṛpaṇānāmanukrośaṃ kuryādvo rudatāmiha ॥64॥
html:
tathā kaścidbhavetsiddho munirvā devatāpi vā ।
kṛpaṇānāmanukrośaṃ kuryādvo rudatāmiha ॥64॥
slp1: taTA kaScidBavetsidDo munirvA devatApi vA । kfpaRAnAmanukroSaM kuryAdvo rudatAmiha ॥64॥

text: ityuktāḥ saṃnyavartanta śokārtāḥ putravatsalāḥ । aṅke śiraḥ samādhāya rurudurbahuvistaram ॥65॥
html:
ityuktāḥ saṃnyavartanta śokārtāḥ putravatsalāḥ ।
aṅke śiraḥ samādhāya rurudurbahuvistaram ॥65॥
slp1: ityuktAH saMnyavartanta SokArtAH putravatsalAH । aNke SiraH samADAya rurudurbahuvistaram ॥65॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: aśrupātapariklinnaḥ pāṇisparśanapīḍitaḥ । dharmarājaprayogācca dīrghāṃ nidrāṃ praveśitaḥ ॥66॥
html:
aśrupātapariklinnaḥ pāṇisparśanapīḍitaḥ ।
dharmarājaprayogācca dīrghāṃ nidrāṃ praveśitaḥ ॥66॥
slp1: aSrupAtapariklinnaH pARisparSanapIqitaH । DarmarAjaprayogAcca dIrGAM nidrAM praveSitaH ॥66॥
author: gṛdhra uvāca ।

text: tapasāpi hi saṃyukto na kāle nopahanyate । sarvasnehāvasānaṃ tadidaṃ tatpretapattanam ॥67॥
html:
tapasāpi hi saṃyukto na kāle nopahanyate ।
sarvasnehāvasānaṃ tadidaṃ tatpretapattanam ॥67॥
slp1: tapasApi hi saMyukto na kAle nopahanyate । sarvasnehAvasAnaM tadidaM tatpretapattanam ॥67॥

text: bālavṛddhasahasrāṇi sadā santyajya bāndhavāḥ । dināni caiva rātrīśca duḥkhaṃ tiṣṭhanti bhūtale ॥68॥
html:
bālavṛddhasahasrāṇi sadā santyajya bāndhavāḥ ।
dināni caiva rātrīśca duḥkhaṃ tiṣṭhanti bhūtale ॥68॥
slp1: bAlavfdDasahasrARi sadA santyajya bAnDavAH । dinAni cEva rAtrISca duHKaM tizWanti BUtale ॥68॥

text: alaṃ nirbandhamāgamya śokasya parivāraṇam । apratyayaṃ kuto hyasya punaradyeha jīvitam ॥69॥
html:
alaṃ nirbandhamāgamya śokasya parivāraṇam ।
apratyayaṃ kuto hyasya punaradyeha jīvitam ॥69॥
slp1: alaM nirbanDamAgamya Sokasya parivAraRam । apratyayaM kuto hyasya punaradyeha jIvitam ॥69॥

text: naiṣa jambukavākyena punaḥ prāpsyati jīvitam । mṛtasyotsṛṣṭadehasya punardeho na vidyate ॥70॥
html:
naiṣa jambukavākyena punaḥ prāpsyati jīvitam ।
mṛtasyotsṛṣṭadehasya punardeho na vidyate ॥70॥
slp1: nEza jambukavAkyena punaH prApsyati jIvitam । mftasyotsfzwadehasya punardeho na vidyate ॥70॥

text: na vai mūrtipradānena na jambukaśatairapi । śakyo jīvayituṃ hyeṣa bālo varṣaśatairapi ॥71॥
html:
na vai mūrtipradānena na jambukaśatairapi ।
śakyo jīvayituṃ hyeṣa bālo varṣaśatairapi ॥71॥
slp1: na vE mUrtipradAnena na jambukaSatErapi । Sakyo jIvayituM hyeza bAlo varzaSatErapi ॥71॥

text: api rudraḥ kumāro vā brahmā vā viṣṇureva vā । varamasmai prayaccheyustato jīvedayaṃ śiśuḥ ॥72॥
html:
api rudraḥ kumāro vā brahmā vā viṣṇureva vā ।
varamasmai prayaccheyustato jīvedayaṃ śiśuḥ ॥72॥
slp1: api rudraH kumAro vA brahmA vA vizRureva vA । varamasmE prayacCeyustato jIvedayaM SiSuH ॥72॥

text: na ca bāṣpavimokṣeṇa na cāśvāsakṛtena vai । na dīrgharuditeneha punarjīvo bhaviṣyati ॥73॥
html:
na ca bāṣpavimokṣeṇa na cāśvāsakṛtena vai ।
na dīrgharuditeneha punarjīvo bhaviṣyati ॥73॥
slp1: na ca bAzpavimokzeRa na cASvAsakftena vE । na dIrGaruditeneha punarjIvo Bavizyati ॥73॥

text: ahaṃ ca kroṣṭukaścaiva yūyaṃ caivāsya bāndhavāḥ । dharmādharmau gṛhītveha sarve vartāmahe'dhvani ॥74॥
html:
ahaṃ ca kroṣṭukaścaiva yūyaṃ caivāsya bāndhavāḥ ।
dharmādharmau gṛhītveha sarve vartāmahe'dhvani ॥74॥
slp1: ahaM ca krozwukaScEva yUyaM cEvAsya bAnDavAH । DarmADarmO gfhItveha sarve vartAmahe'Dvani ॥74॥

text: apriyaṃ paruṣaṃ cāpi paradrohaṃ parastriyam । adharmamanṛtaṃ caiva dūrātprājño nivartayet ॥75॥
html:
apriyaṃ paruṣaṃ cāpi paradrohaṃ parastriyam ।
adharmamanṛtaṃ caiva dūrātprājño nivartayet ॥75॥
slp1: apriyaM paruzaM cApi paradrohaM parastriyam । aDarmamanftaM cEva dUrAtprAjYo nivartayet ॥75॥

text: satyaṃ dharmaṃ śubhaṃ nyāyyaṃ prāṇināṃ mahatīṃ dayām । ajihmatvamaśāṭhyaṃ ca yatnataḥ parimārgata ॥76॥
html:
satyaṃ dharmaṃ śubhaṃ nyāyyaṃ prāṇināṃ mahatīṃ dayām ।
ajihmatvamaśāṭhyaṃ ca yatnataḥ parimārgata ॥76॥
slp1: satyaM DarmaM SuBaM nyAyyaM prARinAM mahatIM dayAm । ajihmatvamaSAWyaM ca yatnataH parimArgata ॥76॥

text: mātaraṃ pitaraṃ caiva bāndhavānsuhṛdastathā । jīvato ye na paśyanti teṣāṃ dharmaviparyayaḥ ॥77॥
html:
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ caiva bāndhavānsuhṛdastathā ।
jīvato ye na paśyanti teṣāṃ dharmaviparyayaḥ ॥77॥
slp1: mAtaraM pitaraM cEva bAnDavAnsuhfdastaTA । jIvato ye na paSyanti tezAM DarmaviparyayaH ॥77॥

text: yo na paśyati cakṣurbhyāṃ neṅgate ca kathañcana । tasya niṣṭhāvasānānte rudantaḥ kiṃ kariṣyatha ॥78॥
html:
yo na paśyati cakṣurbhyāṃ neṅgate ca kathañcana ।
tasya niṣṭhāvasānānte rudantaḥ kiṃ kariṣyatha ॥78॥
slp1: yo na paSyati cakzurByAM neNgate ca kaTaYcana । tasya nizWAvasAnAnte rudantaH kiM karizyaTa ॥78॥

text: ityuktāstaṃ sutaṃ tyaktvā bhūmau śokapariplutāḥ । dahyamānāḥ sutasnehātprayayurbāndhavā gṛhān ॥79॥
html:
ityuktāstaṃ sutaṃ tyaktvā bhūmau śokapariplutāḥ ।
dahyamānāḥ sutasnehātprayayurbāndhavā gṛhān ॥79॥
slp1: ityuktAstaM sutaM tyaktvA BUmO SokapariplutAH । dahyamAnAH sutasnehAtprayayurbAnDavA gfhAn ॥79॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dāruṇo martyaloko'yaṃ sarvaprāṇivināśanaḥ । iṣṭabandhuviyogaśca tathaivālpaṃ ca jīvitam ॥80॥
html:
dāruṇo martyaloko'yaṃ sarvaprāṇivināśanaḥ ।
iṣṭabandhuviyogaśca tathaivālpaṃ ca jīvitam ॥80॥
slp1: dAruRo martyaloko'yaM sarvaprARivinASanaH । izwabanDuviyogaSca taTEvAlpaM ca jIvitam ॥80॥
author: jambuka uvāca ।

text: bahvalīkamasatyaṃ ca prativādāpriyaṃvadam । imaṃ prekṣya punarbhāvaṃ duḥkhaśokābhivardhanam ॥81॥
html:
bahvalīkamasatyaṃ ca prativādāpriyaṃvadam ।
imaṃ prekṣya punarbhāvaṃ duḥkhaśokābhivardhanam ॥81॥
slp1: bahvalIkamasatyaM ca prativAdApriyaMvadam । imaM prekzya punarBAvaM duHKaSokABivarDanam ॥81॥

text: na me mānuṣaloko'yaṃ muhūrtamapi rocate । aho dhiggṛdhravākyena sannivartatha mānuṣāḥ ॥82॥
html:
na me mānuṣaloko'yaṃ muhūrtamapi rocate ।
aho dhiggṛdhravākyena sannivartatha mānuṣāḥ ॥82॥
slp1: na me mAnuzaloko'yaM muhUrtamapi rocate । aho DiggfDravAkyena sannivartaTa mAnuzAH ॥82॥

text: pradīptāḥ putraśokena yathaivābuddhayastathā । kathaṃ gacchatha sasnehāḥ sutasnehaṃ visṛjya ca । śrutvā gṛdhrasya vacanaṃ pāpasyehākṛtātmanaḥ ॥83॥
html:
pradīptāḥ putraśokena yathaivābuddhayastathā ।
kathaṃ gacchatha sasnehāḥ sutasnehaṃ visṛjya ca ।
śrutvā gṛdhrasya vacanaṃ pāpasyehākṛtātmanaḥ ॥83॥
slp1: pradIptAH putraSokena yaTEvAbudDayastaTA । kaTaM gacCaTa sasnehAH sutasnehaM visfjya ca । SrutvA gfDrasya vacanaM pApasyehAkftAtmanaH ॥83॥

text: sukhasyānantaraṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhasyānantaraṃ sukham । sukhaduḥkhānvite loke nehāstyekamanantakam ॥84॥
html:
sukhasyānantaraṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhasyānantaraṃ sukham ।
sukhaduḥkhānvite loke nehāstyekamanantakam ॥84॥
slp1: suKasyAnantaraM duHKaM duHKasyAnantaraM suKam । suKaduHKAnvite loke nehAstyekamanantakam ॥84॥

text: imaṃ kṣititale nyasya bālaṃ rūpasamanvitam । kulaśokākaraṃ mūḍhāḥ putraṃ tyaktvā kva yāsyatha ॥85॥
html:
imaṃ kṣititale nyasya bālaṃ rūpasamanvitam ।
kulaśokākaraṃ mūḍhāḥ putraṃ tyaktvā kva yāsyatha ॥85॥
slp1: imaM kzititale nyasya bAlaM rUpasamanvitam । kulaSokAkaraM mUQAH putraM tyaktvA kva yAsyaTa ॥85॥

text: rūpayauvanasampannaṃ dyotamānamiva śriyā । jīvantamenaṃ paśyāmi manasā nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥86॥
html:
rūpayauvanasampannaṃ dyotamānamiva śriyā ।
jīvantamenaṃ paśyāmi manasā nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥86॥
slp1: rUpayOvanasampannaM dyotamAnamiva SriyA । jIvantamenaM paSyAmi manasA nAtra saMSayaH ॥86॥

text: vināśaścāpyanarho'sya sukhaṃ prāpsyatha mānuṣāḥ । putraśokāgnidagdhānāṃ mṛtamapyadya vaḥ kṣamam ॥87॥
html:
vināśaścāpyanarho'sya sukhaṃ prāpsyatha mānuṣāḥ ।
putraśokāgnidagdhānāṃ mṛtamapyadya vaḥ kṣamam ॥87॥
slp1: vinASaScApyanarho'sya suKaM prApsyaTa mAnuzAH । putraSokAgnidagDAnAM mftamapyadya vaH kzamam ॥87॥

text: duḥkhasambhāvanāṃ kṛtvā dhārayitvā svayaṃ sukham । tyaktvā gamiṣyatha kvādya samutsṛjyālpabuddhivat ॥88॥
html:
duḥkhasambhāvanāṃ kṛtvā dhārayitvā svayaṃ sukham ।
tyaktvā gamiṣyatha kvādya samutsṛjyālpabuddhivat ॥88॥
slp1: duHKasamBAvanAM kftvA DArayitvA svayaM suKam । tyaktvA gamizyaTa kvAdya samutsfjyAlpabudDivat ॥88॥

text: tathā dharmavirodhena priyamithyābhidhyāyinā । śmaśānavāsinā nityaṃ rātriṃ mṛgayatā tadā ॥89॥
html:
tathā dharmavirodhena priyamithyābhidhyāyinā ।
śmaśānavāsinā nityaṃ rātriṃ mṛgayatā tadā ॥89॥
slp1: taTA DarmaviroDena priyamiTyABiDyAyinA । SmaSAnavAsinA nityaM rAtriM mfgayatA tadA ॥89॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tato madhyasthatāṃ nītā vacanairamṛtopamaiḥ । jambukena svakāryārthaṃ bāndhavāstasya dhiṣṭhitāḥ ॥90॥
html:
tato madhyasthatāṃ nītā vacanairamṛtopamaiḥ ।
jambukena svakāryārthaṃ bāndhavāstasya dhiṣṭhitāḥ ॥90॥
slp1: tato maDyasTatAM nItA vacanEramftopamEH । jambukena svakAryArTaM bAnDavAstasya DizWitAH ॥90॥

text: ayaṃ pretasamākīrṇo yakṣarākṣasasevitaḥ । dāruṇaḥ kānanoddeśaḥ kauśikairabhināditaḥ ॥91॥
html:
ayaṃ pretasamākīrṇo yakṣarākṣasasevitaḥ ।
dāruṇaḥ kānanoddeśaḥ kauśikairabhināditaḥ ॥91॥
slp1: ayaM pretasamAkIrRo yakzarAkzasasevitaH । dAruRaH kAnanoddeSaH kOSikEraBinAditaH ॥91॥
author: gṛdhra uvāca ।

text: bhīmaḥ sughoraśca tathā nīlameghasamaprabhaḥ । asmiñśavaṃ parityajya pretakāryāṇyupāsata ॥92॥
html:
bhīmaḥ sughoraśca tathā nīlameghasamaprabhaḥ ।
asmiñśavaṃ parityajya pretakāryāṇyupāsata ॥92॥
slp1: BImaH suGoraSca taTA nIlameGasamapraBaH । asmiYSavaM parityajya pretakAryARyupAsata ॥92॥

text: bhānuryāvanna yātyastaṃ yāvacca vimalā diśaḥ । tāvadenaṃ parityajya pretakāryāṇyupāsata ॥93॥
html:
bhānuryāvanna yātyastaṃ yāvacca vimalā diśaḥ ।
tāvadenaṃ parityajya pretakāryāṇyupāsata ॥93॥
slp1: BAnuryAvanna yAtyastaM yAvacca vimalA diSaH । tAvadenaM parityajya pretakAryARyupAsata ॥93॥

text: nadanti paruṣaṃ śyenāḥ śivāḥ krośanti dāruṇāḥ । mṛgendrāḥ pratinandanti ravirastaṃ ca gacchati ॥94॥
html:
nadanti paruṣaṃ śyenāḥ śivāḥ krośanti dāruṇāḥ ।
mṛgendrāḥ pratinandanti ravirastaṃ ca gacchati ॥94॥
slp1: nadanti paruzaM SyenAH SivAH kroSanti dAruRAH । mfgendrAH pratinandanti ravirastaM ca gacCati ॥94॥

text: citādhūmena nīlena saṃrajyante ca pādapāḥ । śmaśāne ca nirāhārāḥ pratinandanti dehinaḥ ॥95॥
html:
citādhūmena nīlena saṃrajyante ca pādapāḥ ।
śmaśāne ca nirāhārāḥ pratinandanti dehinaḥ ॥95॥
slp1: citADUmena nIlena saMrajyante ca pAdapAH । SmaSAne ca nirAhArAH pratinandanti dehinaH ॥95॥

text: sarve vikrāntavīryāśca asmindeśe sudāruṇāḥ । yuṣmānpradharṣayiṣyanti vikṛtā māṃsabhojanāḥ ॥96॥
html:
sarve vikrāntavīryāśca asmindeśe sudāruṇāḥ ।
yuṣmānpradharṣayiṣyanti vikṛtā māṃsabhojanāḥ ॥96॥
slp1: sarve vikrAntavIryASca asmindeSe sudAruRAH । yuzmAnpraDarzayizyanti vikftA mAMsaBojanAH ॥96॥

text: dūrāccāyaṃ vanoddeśo bhayamatra bhaviṣyati । tyajyatāṃ kāṣṭhabhūto'yaṃ mṛṣyatāṃ jāmbukaṃ vacaḥ ॥97॥
html:
dūrāccāyaṃ vanoddeśo bhayamatra bhaviṣyati ।
tyajyatāṃ kāṣṭhabhūto'yaṃ mṛṣyatāṃ jāmbukaṃ vacaḥ ॥97॥
slp1: dUrAccAyaM vanoddeSo Bayamatra Bavizyati । tyajyatAM kAzWaBUto'yaM mfzyatAM jAmbukaM vacaH ॥97॥

text: yadi jambukavākyāni niṣphalānyanṛtāni ca । śroṣyatha bhraṣṭavijñānāstataḥ sarve vinaṅkṣyatha ॥98॥
html:
yadi jambukavākyāni niṣphalānyanṛtāni ca ।
śroṣyatha bhraṣṭavijñānāstataḥ sarve vinaṅkṣyatha ॥98॥
slp1: yadi jambukavAkyAni nizPalAnyanftAni ca । SrozyaTa BrazwavijYAnAstataH sarve vinaNkzyaTa ॥98॥

text: sthīyatāṃ neha bhetavyaṃ yāvattapati bhāskaraḥ । tāvadasminsutasnehādanirvedena vartata ॥99॥
html:
sthīyatāṃ neha bhetavyaṃ yāvattapati bhāskaraḥ ।
tāvadasminsutasnehādanirvedena vartata ॥99॥
slp1: sTIyatAM neha BetavyaM yAvattapati BAskaraH । tAvadasminsutasnehAdanirvedena vartata ॥99॥
author: jambuka uvāca ।

text: svairaṃ rudata visrabdhāḥ svairaṃ snehena paśyata । sthīyatāṃ yāvadādityaḥ kiṃ vaḥ kravyādabhāṣitaiḥ ॥100॥
html:
svairaṃ rudata visrabdhāḥ svairaṃ snehena paśyata ।
sthīyatāṃ yāvadādityaḥ kiṃ vaḥ kravyādabhāṣitaiḥ ॥100॥
slp1: svEraM rudata visrabDAH svEraM snehena paSyata । sTIyatAM yAvadAdityaH kiM vaH kravyAdaBAzitEH ॥100॥

text: yadi gṛdhrasya vākyāni tīvrāṇi rabhasāni ca । gṛhṇīta mohitātmānaḥ suto vo na bhaviṣyati ॥101॥
html:
yadi gṛdhrasya vākyāni tīvrāṇi rabhasāni ca ।
gṛhṇīta mohitātmānaḥ suto vo na bhaviṣyati ॥101॥
slp1: yadi gfDrasya vAkyAni tIvrARi raBasAni ca । gfhRIta mohitAtmAnaH suto vo na Bavizyati ॥101॥

text: gṛdhro'nastamite tvāha gate'stamiti jambukaḥ । mṛtasya taṃ parijanamūcatustau kṣudhānvitau ॥102॥
html:
gṛdhro'nastamite tvāha gate'stamiti jambukaḥ ।
mṛtasya taṃ parijanamūcatustau kṣudhānvitau ॥102॥
slp1: gfDro'nastamite tvAha gate'stamiti jambukaH । mftasya taM parijanamUcatustO kzuDAnvitO ॥102॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: svakāryadakṣiṇau rājangṛdhro jambuka eva ca । kṣutpipāsāpariśrāntau śāstramālambya jalpataḥ ॥103॥
html:
svakāryadakṣiṇau rājangṛdhro jambuka eva ca ।
kṣutpipāsāpariśrāntau śāstramālambya jalpataḥ ॥103॥
slp1: svakAryadakziRO rAjangfDro jambuka eva ca । kzutpipAsApariSrAntO SAstramAlambya jalpataH ॥103॥

text: tayorvijñānaviduṣordvayorjambukapatriṇoḥ । vākyairamṛtakalpairhi prātiṣṭhanta vrajanti ca ॥104॥
html:
tayorvijñānaviduṣordvayorjambukapatriṇoḥ ।
vākyairamṛtakalpairhi prātiṣṭhanta vrajanti ca ॥104॥
slp1: tayorvijYAnaviduzordvayorjambukapatriRoH । vAkyEramftakalpErhi prAtizWanta vrajanti ca ॥104॥

text: śokadainyasamāviṣṭā rudantastasthire tadā । svakāryakuśalābhyāṃ te sambhrāmyante ha naipuṇāt ॥105॥
html:
śokadainyasamāviṣṭā rudantastasthire tadā ।
svakāryakuśalābhyāṃ te sambhrāmyante ha naipuṇāt ॥105॥
slp1: SokadEnyasamAvizwA rudantastasTire tadA । svakAryakuSalAByAM te samBrAmyante ha nEpuRAt ॥105॥

text: tathā tayorvivadatorvijñānaviduṣordvayoḥ । bāndhavānāṃ sthitānāṃ ca upātiṣṭhata śaṅkaraḥ ॥106॥
html:
tathā tayorvivadatorvijñānaviduṣordvayoḥ ।
bāndhavānāṃ sthitānāṃ ca upātiṣṭhata śaṅkaraḥ ॥106॥
slp1: taTA tayorvivadatorvijYAnaviduzordvayoH । bAnDavAnAM sTitAnAM ca upAtizWata SaNkaraH ॥106॥

text: tatastānāha manujānvarado'smīti śūlabhṛt । te pratyūcuridaṃ vākyaṃ duḥkhitāḥ praṇatāḥ sthitāḥ ॥107॥
html:
tatastānāha manujānvarado'smīti śūlabhṛt ।
te pratyūcuridaṃ vākyaṃ duḥkhitāḥ praṇatāḥ sthitāḥ ॥107॥
slp1: tatastAnAha manujAnvarado'smIti SUlaBft । te pratyUcuridaM vAkyaM duHKitAH praRatAH sTitAH ॥107॥

text: ekaputravihīnānāṃ sarveṣāṃ jīvitārthinām । putrasya no jīvadānājjīvitaṃ dātumarhasi ॥108॥
html:
ekaputravihīnānāṃ sarveṣāṃ jīvitārthinām ।
putrasya no jīvadānājjīvitaṃ dātumarhasi ॥108॥
slp1: ekaputravihInAnAM sarvezAM jIvitArTinAm । putrasya no jIvadAnAjjIvitaM dAtumarhasi ॥108॥

text: evamuktaḥ sa bhagavānvāripūrṇena pāṇinā । jīvaṃ tasmai kumārāya prādādvarṣaśatāya vai ॥109॥
html:
evamuktaḥ sa bhagavānvāripūrṇena pāṇinā ।
jīvaṃ tasmai kumārāya prādādvarṣaśatāya vai ॥109॥
slp1: evamuktaH sa BagavAnvAripUrRena pARinA । jIvaM tasmE kumArAya prAdAdvarzaSatAya vE ॥109॥

text: tathā gomāyugṛdhrābhyāmadadatkṣudvināśanam । varaṃ pinākī bhagavānsarvabhūtahite rataḥ ॥110॥
html:
tathā gomāyugṛdhrābhyāmadadatkṣudvināśanam ।
varaṃ pinākī bhagavānsarvabhūtahite rataḥ ॥110॥
slp1: taTA gomAyugfDrAByAmadadatkzudvinASanam । varaM pinAkI BagavAnsarvaBUtahite rataH ॥110॥

text: tataḥ praṇamya taṃ devaṃ śreyoharṣasamanvitāḥ । kṛtakṛtyāḥ sukhaṃ hṛṣṭāḥ prātiṣṭhanta tadā vibho ॥111॥
html:
tataḥ praṇamya taṃ devaṃ śreyoharṣasamanvitāḥ ।
kṛtakṛtyāḥ sukhaṃ hṛṣṭāḥ prātiṣṭhanta tadā vibho ॥111॥
slp1: tataH praRamya taM devaM SreyoharzasamanvitAH । kftakftyAH suKaM hfzwAH prAtizWanta tadA viBo ॥111॥

text: anirvedena dīrgheṇa niścayena dhruveṇa ca । devadevaprasādācca kṣipraṃ phalamavāpyate ॥112॥
html:
anirvedena dīrgheṇa niścayena dhruveṇa ca ।
devadevaprasādācca kṣipraṃ phalamavāpyate ॥112॥
slp1: anirvedena dIrGeRa niScayena DruveRa ca । devadevaprasAdAcca kzipraM PalamavApyate ॥112॥

text: paśya devasya saṃyogaṃ bāndhavānāṃ ca niścayam । kṛpaṇānāṃ hi rudatāṃ kṛtamaśrupramārjanam ॥113॥
html:
paśya devasya saṃyogaṃ bāndhavānāṃ ca niścayam ।
kṛpaṇānāṃ hi rudatāṃ kṛtamaśrupramārjanam ॥113॥
slp1: paSya devasya saMyogaM bAnDavAnAM ca niScayam । kfpaRAnAM hi rudatAM kftamaSrupramArjanam ॥113॥

text: paśya cālpena kālena niścayānveṣaṇena ca । prasādaṃ śaṅkarātprāpya duḥkhitāḥ sukhamāpnuvan ॥114॥
html:
paśya cālpena kālena niścayānveṣaṇena ca ।
prasādaṃ śaṅkarātprāpya duḥkhitāḥ sukhamāpnuvan ॥114॥
slp1: paSya cAlpena kAlena niScayAnvezaRena ca । prasAdaM SaNkarAtprApya duHKitAH suKamApnuvan ॥114॥

text: te vismitāḥ prahṛṣṭāśca putrasañjīvanātpunaḥ । babhūvurbharataśreṣṭha prasādācchaṅkarasya vai ॥115॥
html:
te vismitāḥ prahṛṣṭāśca putrasañjīvanātpunaḥ ।
babhūvurbharataśreṣṭha prasādācchaṅkarasya vai ॥115॥
slp1: te vismitAH prahfzwASca putrasaYjIvanAtpunaH । baBUvurBarataSrezWa prasAdAcCaNkarasya vE ॥115॥

text: tataste tvaritā rājañśrutvā śokamaghodbhavam । viviśuḥ putramādāya nagaraṃ hṛṣṭamānasāḥ । eṣā buddhiḥ samastānāṃ cāturvarṇye nidarśitā ॥116॥
html:
tataste tvaritā rājañśrutvā śokamaghodbhavam ।
viviśuḥ putramādāya nagaraṃ hṛṣṭamānasāḥ ।
eṣā buddhiḥ samastānāṃ cāturvarṇye nidarśitā ॥116॥
slp1: tataste tvaritA rAjaYSrutvA SokamaGodBavam । viviSuH putramAdAya nagaraM hfzwamAnasAH । ezA budDiH samastAnAM cAturvarRye nidarSitA ॥116॥

text: dharmārthamokṣasaṃyuktamitihāsamimaṃ śubham । śrutvā manuṣyaḥ satatamiha pretya ca modate] ॥117॥
html:
dharmārthamokṣasaṃyuktamitihāsamimaṃ śubham ।
śrutvā manuṣyaḥ satatamiha pretya ca modate] ॥117॥
slp1: DarmArTamokzasaMyuktamitihAsamimaM SuBam । SrutvA manuzyaH satatamiha pretya ca modate] ॥117॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । saṃvādaṃ bharataśreṣṭha śalmaleḥ pavanasya ca ॥1॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
saṃvādaṃ bharataśreṣṭha śalmaleḥ pavanasya ca ॥1॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । saMvAdaM BarataSrezWa SalmaleH pavanasya ca ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: himavantaṃ samāsādya mahānāsīdvanaspatiḥ । varṣapūgābhisaṃvṛddhaḥ śākhāskandhapalāśavān ॥2॥
html:
himavantaṃ samāsādya mahānāsīdvanaspatiḥ ।
varṣapūgābhisaṃvṛddhaḥ śākhāskandhapalāśavān ॥2॥
slp1: himavantaM samAsAdya mahAnAsIdvanaspatiH । varzapUgABisaMvfdDaH SAKAskanDapalASavAn ॥2॥

text: tatra sma mattā mātaṅgā dharmārtāḥ śramakarśitāḥ । viśramanti mahābāho tathānyā mṛgajātayaḥ ॥3॥
html:
tatra sma mattā mātaṅgā dharmārtāḥ śramakarśitāḥ ।
viśramanti mahābāho tathānyā mṛgajātayaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: tatra sma mattA mAtaNgA DarmArtAH SramakarSitAH । viSramanti mahAbAho taTAnyA mfgajAtayaH ॥3॥

text: nalvamātraparīṇāho ghanacchāyo vanaspatiḥ । śukaśārikasaṅghuṣṭaḥ phalavānpuṣpavānapi ॥4॥
html:
nalvamātraparīṇāho ghanacchāyo vanaspatiḥ ।
śukaśārikasaṅghuṣṭaḥ phalavānpuṣpavānapi ॥4॥
slp1: nalvamAtraparIRAho GanacCAyo vanaspatiH । SukaSArikasaNGuzwaH PalavAnpuzpavAnapi ॥4॥

text: sārthikā vaṇijaścāpi tāpasāśca vanaukasaḥ । vasanti vāsānmārgasthāḥ suramye tarusattame ॥5॥
html:
sārthikā vaṇijaścāpi tāpasāśca vanaukasaḥ ।
vasanti vāsānmārgasthāḥ suramye tarusattame ॥5॥
slp1: sArTikA vaRijaScApi tApasASca vanOkasaH । vasanti vAsAnmArgasTAH suramye tarusattame ॥5॥

text: tasyā tā vipulāḥ śākhā dṛṣṭvā skandhāṃśca sarvataḥ । abhigamyābravīdenaṃ nārado bharatarṣabha ॥6॥
html:
tasyā tā vipulāḥ śākhā dṛṣṭvā skandhāṃśca sarvataḥ ।
abhigamyābravīdenaṃ nārado bharatarṣabha ॥6॥
slp1: tasyA tA vipulAH SAKA dfzwvA skanDAMSca sarvataH । aBigamyAbravIdenaM nArado BaratarzaBa ॥6॥

text: aho nu ramaṇīyastvamaho cāsi manoramaḥ । prīyāmahe tvayā nityaṃ tarupravara śalmale ॥7॥
html:
aho nu ramaṇīyastvamaho cāsi manoramaḥ ।
prīyāmahe tvayā nityaṃ tarupravara śalmale ॥7॥
slp1: aho nu ramaRIyastvamaho cAsi manoramaH । prIyAmahe tvayA nityaM tarupravara Salmale ॥7॥

text: sadaiva śakunāstāta mṛgāścādhastathā gajāḥ । vasanti tava saṃhṛṣṭā manoharatarāstathā ॥8॥
html:
sadaiva śakunāstāta mṛgāścādhastathā gajāḥ ।
vasanti tava saṃhṛṣṭā manoharatarāstathā ॥8॥
slp1: sadEva SakunAstAta mfgAScADastaTA gajAH । vasanti tava saMhfzwA manoharatarAstaTA ॥8॥

text: tava śākhā mahāśākha skandhaṃ ca vipulaṃ tathā । na vai prabhagnānpaśyāmi mārutena kathañcana ॥9॥
html:
tava śākhā mahāśākha skandhaṃ ca vipulaṃ tathā ।
na vai prabhagnānpaśyāmi mārutena kathañcana ॥9॥
slp1: tava SAKA mahASAKa skanDaM ca vipulaM taTA । na vE praBagnAnpaSyAmi mArutena kaTaYcana ॥9॥

text: kiṃ nu te mārutastāta prītimānatha vā suhṛt । tvāṃ rakṣati sadā yena vane'sminpavano dhruvam ॥10॥
html:
kiṃ nu te mārutastāta prītimānatha vā suhṛt ।
tvāṃ rakṣati sadā yena vane'sminpavano dhruvam ॥10॥
slp1: kiM nu te mArutastAta prItimAnaTa vA suhft । tvAM rakzati sadA yena vane'sminpavano Druvam ॥10॥

text: vivānhi pavanaḥ sthānādvṛkṣānuccāvacānapi । parvatānāṃ ca śikharāṇyācālayati vegavān ॥11॥
html:
vivānhi pavanaḥ sthānādvṛkṣānuccāvacānapi ।
parvatānāṃ ca śikharāṇyācālayati vegavān ॥11॥
slp1: vivAnhi pavanaH sTAnAdvfkzAnuccAvacAnapi । parvatAnAM ca SiKarARyAcAlayati vegavAn ॥11॥

text: śoṣayatyeva pātālaṃ vivāngandhavahaḥ śuciḥ । hradāṃśca saritaścaiva sāgarāṃśca tathaiva ha ॥12॥
html:
śoṣayatyeva pātālaṃ vivāngandhavahaḥ śuciḥ ।
hradāṃśca saritaścaiva sāgarāṃśca tathaiva ha ॥12॥
slp1: Sozayatyeva pAtAlaM vivAnganDavahaH SuciH । hradAMSca saritaScEva sAgarAMSca taTEva ha ॥12॥

text: tvāṃ saṃrakṣeta pavanaḥ sakhitvena na saṃśayaḥ । tasmādbahalaśākho'si parṇavānpuṣpavānapi ॥13॥
html:
tvāṃ saṃrakṣeta pavanaḥ sakhitvena na saṃśayaḥ ।
tasmādbahalaśākho'si parṇavānpuṣpavānapi ॥13॥
slp1: tvAM saMrakzeta pavanaH saKitvena na saMSayaH । tasmAdbahalaSAKo'si parRavAnpuzpavAnapi ॥13॥

text: idaṃ ca ramaṇīyaṃ te pratibhāti vanaspate । yadime vihagāstāta ramante muditāstvayi ॥14॥
html:
idaṃ ca ramaṇīyaṃ te pratibhāti vanaspate ।
yadime vihagāstāta ramante muditāstvayi ॥14॥
slp1: idaM ca ramaRIyaM te pratiBAti vanaspate । yadime vihagAstAta ramante muditAstvayi ॥14॥

text: eṣāṃ pṛthaksamastānāṃ śrūyate madhuraḥ svaraḥ । puṣpasaṃmodane kāle vāśatāṃ sumanoharam ॥15॥
html:
eṣāṃ pṛthaksamastānāṃ śrūyate madhuraḥ svaraḥ ।
puṣpasaṃmodane kāle vāśatāṃ sumanoharam ॥15॥
slp1: ezAM pfTaksamastAnAM SrUyate maDuraH svaraH । puzpasaMmodane kAle vASatAM sumanoharam ॥15॥

text: tatheme muditā nāgāḥ svayūthakulaśobhinaḥ । gharmārtāstvāṃ samāsādya sukhaṃ vindanti śalmale ॥16॥
html:
tatheme muditā nāgāḥ svayūthakulaśobhinaḥ ।
gharmārtāstvāṃ samāsādya sukhaṃ vindanti śalmale ॥16॥
slp1: taTeme muditA nAgAH svayUTakulaSoBinaH । GarmArtAstvAM samAsAdya suKaM vindanti Salmale ॥16॥

text: tathaiva mṛgajātībhiranyābhirupaśobhase । tathā sārthādhivāsaiśca śobhase meruvaddruma ॥17॥
html:
tathaiva mṛgajātībhiranyābhirupaśobhase ।
tathā sārthādhivāsaiśca śobhase meruvaddruma ॥17॥
slp1: taTEva mfgajAtIBiranyABirupaSoBase । taTA sArTADivAsESca SoBase meruvaddruma ॥17॥

text: brāhmaṇaiśca tapaḥsiddhaistāpasaiḥ śramaṇairapi । triviṣṭapasamaṃ manye tavāyatanameva ha ॥18॥
html:
brāhmaṇaiśca tapaḥsiddhaistāpasaiḥ śramaṇairapi ।
triviṣṭapasamaṃ manye tavāyatanameva ha ॥18॥
slp1: brAhmaRESca tapaHsidDEstApasEH SramaRErapi । trivizwapasamaM manye tavAyatanameva ha ॥18॥

text: bandhutvādatha vā sakhyācchalmale nātra saṃśayaḥ । pālayatyeva satataṃ bhīmaḥ sarvatrago'nilaḥ ॥19॥
html:
bandhutvādatha vā sakhyācchalmale nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
pālayatyeva satataṃ bhīmaḥ sarvatrago'nilaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: banDutvAdaTa vA saKyAcCalmale nAtra saMSayaH । pAlayatyeva satataM BImaH sarvatrago'nilaH ॥19॥

text: nyagbhāvaṃ paramaṃ vāyoḥ śalmale tvamupāgataḥ । tavāhamasmīti sadā yena rakṣati mārutaḥ ॥20॥
html:
nyagbhāvaṃ paramaṃ vāyoḥ śalmale tvamupāgataḥ ।
tavāhamasmīti sadā yena rakṣati mārutaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: nyagBAvaM paramaM vAyoH Salmale tvamupAgataH । tavAhamasmIti sadA yena rakzati mArutaH ॥20॥

text: na taṃ paśyāmyahaṃ vṛkṣaṃ parvataṃ vāpi taṃ dṛḍham । yo na vāyubalādbhagnaḥ pṛthivyāmiti me matiḥ ॥21॥
html:
na taṃ paśyāmyahaṃ vṛkṣaṃ parvataṃ vāpi taṃ dṛḍham ।
yo na vāyubalādbhagnaḥ pṛthivyāmiti me matiḥ ॥21॥
slp1: na taM paSyAmyahaM vfkzaM parvataM vApi taM dfQam । yo na vAyubalAdBagnaH pfTivyAmiti me matiH ॥21॥

text: tvaṃ punaḥ kāraṇairnūnaṃ śalmale rakṣyase sadā । vāyunā saparīvārastena tiṣṭhasyasaṃśayam ॥22॥
html:
tvaṃ punaḥ kāraṇairnūnaṃ śalmale rakṣyase sadā ।
vāyunā saparīvārastena tiṣṭhasyasaṃśayam ॥22॥
slp1: tvaM punaH kAraRErnUnaM Salmale rakzyase sadA । vAyunA saparIvArastena tizWasyasaMSayam ॥22॥

text: na me vāyuḥ sakhā brahmanna bandhurna ca me suhṛt । parameṣṭhī tathā naiva yena rakṣati mānilaḥ ॥23॥
html:
na me vāyuḥ sakhā brahmanna bandhurna ca me suhṛt ।
parameṣṭhī tathā naiva yena rakṣati mānilaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: na me vAyuH saKA brahmanna banDurna ca me suhft । paramezWI taTA nEva yena rakzati mAnilaH ॥23॥
author: śalmaliruvāca ।

text: mama tejobalaṃ vāyorbhīmamapi hi nārada । kalāmaṣṭādaśīṃ prāṇairna me prāpnoti mārutaḥ ॥24॥
html:
mama tejobalaṃ vāyorbhīmamapi hi nārada ।
kalāmaṣṭādaśīṃ prāṇairna me prāpnoti mārutaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: mama tejobalaM vAyorBImamapi hi nArada । kalAmazwAdaSIM prARErna me prApnoti mArutaH ॥24॥

text: āgacchanparamo vāyurmayā viṣṭambhito balāt । rujandrumānparvatāṃśca yaccānyadapi kiñcana ॥25॥
html:
āgacchanparamo vāyurmayā viṣṭambhito balāt ।
rujandrumānparvatāṃśca yaccānyadapi kiñcana ॥25॥
slp1: AgacCanparamo vAyurmayA vizwamBito balAt । rujandrumAnparvatAMSca yaccAnyadapi kiYcana ॥25॥

text: sa mayā bahuśo bhagnaḥ prabhañjanvai prabhañjanaḥ । tasmānna bibhye devarṣe kruddhādapi samīraṇāt ॥26॥
html:
sa mayā bahuśo bhagnaḥ prabhañjanvai prabhañjanaḥ ।
tasmānna bibhye devarṣe kruddhādapi samīraṇāt ॥26॥
slp1: sa mayA bahuSo BagnaH praBaYjanvE praBaYjanaH । tasmAnna biBye devarze krudDAdapi samIraRAt ॥26॥

text: śalmale viparītaṃ te darśanaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ । na hi vāyorbalenāsti bhūtaṃ tulyabalaṃ kvacit ॥27॥
html:
śalmale viparītaṃ te darśanaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
na hi vāyorbalenāsti bhūtaṃ tulyabalaṃ kvacit ॥27॥
slp1: Salmale viparItaM te darSanaM nAtra saMSayaH । na hi vAyorbalenAsti BUtaM tulyabalaM kvacit ॥27॥
author: nārada uvāca ।

text: indro yamo vaiśravaṇo varuṇaśca jaleśvaraḥ । na te'pi tulyā marutaḥ kiṃ punastvaṃ vanaspate ॥28॥
html:
indro yamo vaiśravaṇo varuṇaśca jaleśvaraḥ ।
na te'pi tulyā marutaḥ kiṃ punastvaṃ vanaspate ॥28॥
slp1: indro yamo vESravaRo varuRaSca jaleSvaraH । na te'pi tulyA marutaH kiM punastvaM vanaspate ॥28॥

text: yaddhi kiñcidiha prāṇi śalmale ceṣṭate bhuvi । sarvatra bhagavānvāyuśceṣṭāprāṇakaraḥ prabhuḥ ॥29॥
html:
yaddhi kiñcidiha prāṇi śalmale ceṣṭate bhuvi ।
sarvatra bhagavānvāyuśceṣṭāprāṇakaraḥ prabhuḥ ॥29॥
slp1: yadDi kiYcidiha prARi Salmale cezwate Buvi । sarvatra BagavAnvAyuScezwAprARakaraH praBuH ॥29॥

text: eṣa ceṣṭayate samyakprāṇinaḥ samyagāyataḥ । asamyagāyato bhūyaśceṣṭate vikṛto nṛṣu ॥30॥
html:
eṣa ceṣṭayate samyakprāṇinaḥ samyagāyataḥ ।
asamyagāyato bhūyaśceṣṭate vikṛto nṛṣu ॥30॥
slp1: eza cezwayate samyakprARinaH samyagAyataH । asamyagAyato BUyaScezwate vikfto nfzu ॥30॥

text: sa tvamevaṃvidhaṃ vāyuṃ sarvasattvabhṛtāṃ varam । na pūjayasi pūjyaṃ taṃ kimanyadbuddhilāghavāt ॥31॥
html:
sa tvamevaṃvidhaṃ vāyuṃ sarvasattvabhṛtāṃ varam ।
na pūjayasi pūjyaṃ taṃ kimanyadbuddhilāghavāt ॥31॥
slp1: sa tvamevaMviDaM vAyuM sarvasattvaBftAM varam । na pUjayasi pUjyaM taM kimanyadbudDilAGavAt ॥31॥

text: asāraścāsi durbuddhe kevalaṃ bahu bhāṣase । krodhādibhiravacchanno mithyā vadasi śalmale ॥32॥
html:
asāraścāsi durbuddhe kevalaṃ bahu bhāṣase ।
krodhādibhiravacchanno mithyā vadasi śalmale ॥32॥
slp1: asAraScAsi durbudDe kevalaM bahu BAzase । kroDAdiBiravacCanno miTyA vadasi Salmale ॥32॥

text: mama roṣaḥ samutpannastvayyevaṃ samprabhāṣati । bravīmyeṣa svayaṃ vāyostava durbhāṣitaṃ bahu ॥33॥
html:
mama roṣaḥ samutpannastvayyevaṃ samprabhāṣati ।
bravīmyeṣa svayaṃ vāyostava durbhāṣitaṃ bahu ॥33॥
slp1: mama rozaH samutpannastvayyevaM sampraBAzati । bravImyeza svayaM vAyostava durBAzitaM bahu ॥33॥

text: candanaiḥ spandanaiḥ śālaiḥ saralairdevadārubhiḥ । vetasairbandhanaiścāpi ye cānye balavattarāḥ ॥34॥
html:
candanaiḥ spandanaiḥ śālaiḥ saralairdevadārubhiḥ ।
vetasairbandhanaiścāpi ye cānye balavattarāḥ ॥34॥
slp1: candanEH spandanEH SAlEH saralErdevadAruBiH । vetasErbanDanEScApi ye cAnye balavattarAH ॥34॥

text: taiścāpi naivaṃ durbuddhe kṣipto vāyuḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ । te hi jānanti vāyośca balamātmana eva ca ॥35॥
html:
taiścāpi naivaṃ durbuddhe kṣipto vāyuḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ ।
te hi jānanti vāyośca balamātmana eva ca ॥35॥
slp1: tEScApi nEvaM durbudDe kzipto vAyuH kftAtmaBiH । te hi jAnanti vAyoSca balamAtmana eva ca ॥35॥

text: tasmātte vai namasyanti śvasanaṃ drumasattamāḥ । tvaṃ tu mohānna jānīṣe vāyorbalamanantakam] ॥36॥
html:
tasmātte vai namasyanti śvasanaṃ drumasattamāḥ ।
tvaṃ tu mohānna jānīṣe vāyorbalamanantakam] ॥36॥
slp1: tasmAtte vE namasyanti SvasanaM drumasattamAH । tvaM tu mohAnna jAnIze vAyorbalamanantakam] ॥36॥

text: evamuktvā tu rājendra śalmaliṃ brahmavittamaḥ । nāradaḥ pavane sarvaṃ śalmalervākyamabravīt ॥1॥
html:
evamuktvā tu rājendra śalmaliṃ brahmavittamaḥ ।
nāradaḥ pavane sarvaṃ śalmalervākyamabravīt ॥1॥
slp1: evamuktvA tu rAjendra SalmaliM brahmavittamaH । nAradaH pavane sarvaM SalmalervAkyamabravIt ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: himavatpṛṣṭhajaḥ kaścicchalmaliḥ parivāravān । bṛhanmūlo bṛhacchākhaḥ sa tvāṃ vāyo'vamanyate ॥2॥
html:
himavatpṛṣṭhajaḥ kaścicchalmaliḥ parivāravān ।
bṛhanmūlo bṛhacchākhaḥ sa tvāṃ vāyo'vamanyate ॥2॥
slp1: himavatpfzWajaH kaScicCalmaliH parivAravAn । bfhanmUlo bfhacCAKaH sa tvAM vAyo'vamanyate ॥2॥

text: bahūnyākṣepayuktāni tvāmāha vacanāni saḥ । na yuktāni mayā vāyo tāni vaktuṃ tvayi prabho ॥3॥
html:
bahūnyākṣepayuktāni tvāmāha vacanāni saḥ ।
na yuktāni mayā vāyo tāni vaktuṃ tvayi prabho ॥3॥
slp1: bahUnyAkzepayuktAni tvAmAha vacanAni saH । na yuktAni mayA vAyo tAni vaktuM tvayi praBo ॥3॥

text: jānāmi tvāmahaṃ vāyo sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ varam । variṣṭhaṃ ca gariṣṭhaṃ ca krodhe vaivasvataṃ yathā ॥4॥
html:
jānāmi tvāmahaṃ vāyo sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ varam ।
variṣṭhaṃ ca gariṣṭhaṃ ca krodhe vaivasvataṃ yathā ॥4॥
slp1: jAnAmi tvAmahaM vAyo sarvaprARaBftAM varam । varizWaM ca garizWaM ca kroDe vEvasvataM yaTA ॥4॥

text: evaṃ tu vacanaṃ śrutvā nāradasya samīraṇaḥ । śalmaliṃ tamupāgamya kruddho vacanamabravīt ॥5॥
html:
evaṃ tu vacanaṃ śrutvā nāradasya samīraṇaḥ ।
śalmaliṃ tamupāgamya kruddho vacanamabravīt ॥5॥
slp1: evaM tu vacanaM SrutvA nAradasya samIraRaH । SalmaliM tamupAgamya krudDo vacanamabravIt ॥5॥

text: śalmale nārade yattattvayoktaṃ madvigarhaṇam । ahaṃ vāyuḥ prabhāvaṃ te darśayāmyātmano balam ॥6॥
html:
śalmale nārade yattattvayoktaṃ madvigarhaṇam ।
ahaṃ vāyuḥ prabhāvaṃ te darśayāmyātmano balam ॥6॥
slp1: Salmale nArade yattattvayoktaM madvigarhaRam । ahaM vAyuH praBAvaM te darSayAmyAtmano balam ॥6॥

text: nāhaṃ tvā nābhijānāmi viditaścāsi me druma । pitāmahaḥ prajāsarge tvayi viśrāntavānprabhuḥ ॥7॥
html:
nāhaṃ tvā nābhijānāmi viditaścāsi me druma ।
pitāmahaḥ prajāsarge tvayi viśrāntavānprabhuḥ ॥7॥
slp1: nAhaM tvA nABijAnAmi viditaScAsi me druma । pitAmahaH prajAsarge tvayi viSrAntavAnpraBuH ॥7॥

text: tasya viśramaṇādeva prasādo yaḥ kṛtastava । rakṣyase tena durbuddhe nātmavīryāddrumādhama ॥8॥
html:
tasya viśramaṇādeva prasādo yaḥ kṛtastava ।
rakṣyase tena durbuddhe nātmavīryāddrumādhama ॥8॥
slp1: tasya viSramaRAdeva prasAdo yaH kftastava । rakzyase tena durbudDe nAtmavIryAddrumADama ॥8॥

text: yanmā tvamavajānīṣe yathānyaṃ prākṛtaṃ tathā । darśayāmyeṣa ātmānaṃ yathā māmavabhotsyase ॥9॥
html:
yanmā tvamavajānīṣe yathānyaṃ prākṛtaṃ tathā ।
darśayāmyeṣa ātmānaṃ yathā māmavabhotsyase ॥9॥
slp1: yanmA tvamavajAnIze yaTAnyaM prAkftaM taTA । darSayAmyeza AtmAnaM yaTA mAmavaBotsyase ॥9॥

text: evamuktastataḥ prāha śalmaliḥ prahasanniva । pavana tvaṃ vane kruddho darśayātmānamātmanā ॥10॥
html:
evamuktastataḥ prāha śalmaliḥ prahasanniva ।
pavana tvaṃ vane kruddho darśayātmānamātmanā ॥10॥
slp1: evamuktastataH prAha SalmaliH prahasanniva । pavana tvaM vane krudDo darSayAtmAnamAtmanA ॥10॥

text: mayi vai tyajyatāṃ krodhaḥ kiṃ me kruddhaḥ kariṣyasi । na te bibhemi pavana yadyapi tvaṃ svayaṃprabhuḥ ॥11॥
html:
mayi vai tyajyatāṃ krodhaḥ kiṃ me kruddhaḥ kariṣyasi ।
na te bibhemi pavana yadyapi tvaṃ svayaṃprabhuḥ ॥11॥
slp1: mayi vE tyajyatAM kroDaH kiM me krudDaH karizyasi । na te biBemi pavana yadyapi tvaM svayaMpraBuH ॥11॥

text: ityevamuktaḥ pavanaḥ śva ityevābravīdvacaḥ । darśayiṣyāmi te tejastato rātrirupāgamat ॥12॥
html:
ityevamuktaḥ pavanaḥ śva ityevābravīdvacaḥ ।
darśayiṣyāmi te tejastato rātrirupāgamat ॥12॥
slp1: ityevamuktaH pavanaH Sva ityevAbravIdvacaH । darSayizyAmi te tejastato rAtrirupAgamat ॥12॥

text: atha niścitya manasā śalmalirvātakāritam । paśyamānastadātmānamasamaṃ mātariśvanaḥ ॥13॥
html:
atha niścitya manasā śalmalirvātakāritam ।
paśyamānastadātmānamasamaṃ mātariśvanaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: aTa niScitya manasA SalmalirvAtakAritam । paSyamAnastadAtmAnamasamaM mAtariSvanaH ॥13॥

text: nārade yanmayā proktaṃ pavanaṃ prati tanmṛṣā । asamartho hyahaṃ vāyorbalena balavānhi saḥ ॥14॥
html:
nārade yanmayā proktaṃ pavanaṃ prati tanmṛṣā ।
asamartho hyahaṃ vāyorbalena balavānhi saḥ ॥14॥
slp1: nArade yanmayA proktaM pavanaM prati tanmfzA । asamarTo hyahaM vAyorbalena balavAnhi saH ॥14॥

text: māruto balavānnityaṃ yathainaṃ nārado'bravīt । ahaṃ hi durbalo'nyebhyo vṛkṣebhyo nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥15॥
html:
māruto balavānnityaṃ yathainaṃ nārado'bravīt ।
ahaṃ hi durbalo'nyebhyo vṛkṣebhyo nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: mAruto balavAnnityaM yaTEnaM nArado'bravIt । ahaM hi durbalo'nyeByo vfkzeByo nAtra saMSayaH ॥15॥

text: kiṃ tu buddhyā samo nāsti mama kaścidvanaspatiḥ । tadahaṃ buddhimāsthāya bhayaṃ mokṣye samīraṇāt ॥16॥
html:
kiṃ tu buddhyā samo nāsti mama kaścidvanaspatiḥ ।
tadahaṃ buddhimāsthāya bhayaṃ mokṣye samīraṇāt ॥16॥
slp1: kiM tu budDyA samo nAsti mama kaScidvanaspatiH । tadahaM budDimAsTAya BayaM mokzye samIraRAt ॥16॥

text: yadi tāṃ buddhimāsthāya careyuḥ parṇino vane । ariṣṭāḥ syuḥ sadā kruddhātpavanānnātra saṃśayaḥ ॥17॥
html:
yadi tāṃ buddhimāsthāya careyuḥ parṇino vane ।
ariṣṭāḥ syuḥ sadā kruddhātpavanānnātra saṃśayaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: yadi tAM budDimAsTAya careyuH parRino vane । arizwAH syuH sadA krudDAtpavanAnnAtra saMSayaH ॥17॥

text: te'tra bālā na jānanti yathā nainānsamīraṇaḥ । samīrayeta saṅkruddho yathā jānāmyahaṃ tathā ॥18॥
html:
te'tra bālā na jānanti yathā nainānsamīraṇaḥ ।
samīrayeta saṅkruddho yathā jānāmyahaṃ tathā ॥18॥
slp1: te'tra bAlA na jAnanti yaTA nEnAnsamIraRaH । samIrayeta saNkrudDo yaTA jAnAmyahaM taTA ॥18॥

text: tato niścitya manasā śalmaliḥ kṣubhitastadā । śākhāḥ skandhānpraśākhāśca svayameva vyaśātayat ॥19॥
html:
tato niścitya manasā śalmaliḥ kṣubhitastadā ।
śākhāḥ skandhānpraśākhāśca svayameva vyaśātayat ॥19॥
slp1: tato niScitya manasA SalmaliH kzuBitastadA । SAKAH skanDAnpraSAKASca svayameva vyaSAtayat ॥19॥

text: sa parityajya śākhāśca patrāṇi kusumāni ca । prabhāte vāyumāyāntaṃ pratyaikṣata vanaspatiḥ ॥20॥
html:
sa parityajya śākhāśca patrāṇi kusumāni ca ।
prabhāte vāyumāyāntaṃ pratyaikṣata vanaspatiḥ ॥20॥
slp1: sa parityajya SAKASca patrARi kusumAni ca । praBAte vAyumAyAntaM pratyEkzata vanaspatiH ॥20॥

text: tataḥ kruddhaḥ śvasanvāyuḥ pātayanvai mahādrumān । ājagāmātha taṃ deśaṃ sthito yatra sa śalmaliḥ ॥21॥
html:
tataḥ kruddhaḥ śvasanvāyuḥ pātayanvai mahādrumān ।
ājagāmātha taṃ deśaṃ sthito yatra sa śalmaliḥ ॥21॥
slp1: tataH krudDaH SvasanvAyuH pAtayanvE mahAdrumAn । AjagAmATa taM deSaM sTito yatra sa SalmaliH ॥21॥

text: taṃ hīnaparṇaṃ patitāgraśākhaṃ viśīrṇapuṣpaṃ prasamīkṣya vāyuḥ । uvāca vākyaṃ smayamāna enaṃ mudā yutaṃ śalmaliṃ rugṇaśākham ॥22॥
html:
taṃ hīnaparṇaṃ patitāgraśākhaṃ viśīrṇapuṣpaṃ prasamīkṣya vāyuḥ ।
uvāca vākyaṃ smayamāna enaṃ mudā yutaṃ śalmaliṃ rugṇaśākham ॥22॥
slp1: taM hInaparRaM patitAgraSAKaM viSIrRapuzpaM prasamIkzya vAyuH । uvAca vAkyaM smayamAna enaM mudA yutaM SalmaliM rugRaSAKam ॥22॥

text: ahamapyevameva tvāṃ kurvāṇaḥ śalmale ruṣā । ātmanā yatkṛtaṃ kṛtsnaṃ śākhānāmapakarṣaṇam ॥23॥
html:
ahamapyevameva tvāṃ kurvāṇaḥ śalmale ruṣā ।
ātmanā yatkṛtaṃ kṛtsnaṃ śākhānāmapakarṣaṇam ॥23॥
slp1: ahamapyevameva tvAM kurvARaH Salmale ruzA । AtmanA yatkftaM kftsnaM SAKAnAmapakarzaRam ॥23॥

text: hīnapuṣpāgraśākhastvaṃ śīrṇāṅkurapalāśavān । ātmadurmantriteneha madvīryavaśago'bhavaḥ ॥24॥
html:
hīnapuṣpāgraśākhastvaṃ śīrṇāṅkurapalāśavān ।
ātmadurmantriteneha madvīryavaśago'bhavaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: hInapuzpAgraSAKastvaM SIrRANkurapalASavAn । Atmadurmantriteneha madvIryavaSago'BavaH ॥24॥

text: etacchrutvā vaco vāyoḥ śalmalirvrīḍitastadā । atapyata vacaḥ smṛtvā nārado yattadābravīt ॥25॥
html:
etacchrutvā vaco vāyoḥ śalmalirvrīḍitastadā ।
atapyata vacaḥ smṛtvā nārado yattadābravīt ॥25॥
slp1: etacCrutvA vaco vAyoH SalmalirvrIqitastadA । atapyata vacaH smftvA nArado yattadAbravIt ॥25॥

text: evaṃ yo rājaśārdūla durbalaḥ sanbalīyasā । vairamāsajjate bālastapyate śalmaliryathā ॥26॥
html:
evaṃ yo rājaśārdūla durbalaḥ sanbalīyasā ।
vairamāsajjate bālastapyate śalmaliryathā ॥26॥
slp1: evaM yo rAjaSArdUla durbalaH sanbalIyasA । vEramAsajjate bAlastapyate SalmaliryaTA ॥26॥

text: tasmādvairaṃ na kurvīta durbalo balavattaraiḥ । śoceddhi vairaṃ kurvāṇo yathā vai śalmalistathā ॥27॥
html:
tasmādvairaṃ na kurvīta durbalo balavattaraiḥ ।
śoceddhi vairaṃ kurvāṇo yathā vai śalmalistathā ॥27॥
slp1: tasmAdvEraM na kurvIta durbalo balavattarEH । SocedDi vEraM kurvARo yaTA vE SalmalistaTA ॥27॥

text: na hi vairaṃ mahātmāno vivṛṇvantyapakāriṣu । śanaiḥ śanairmahārāja darśayanti sma te balam ॥28॥
html:
na hi vairaṃ mahātmāno vivṛṇvantyapakāriṣu ।
śanaiḥ śanairmahārāja darśayanti sma te balam ॥28॥
slp1: na hi vEraM mahAtmAno vivfRvantyapakArizu । SanEH SanErmahArAja darSayanti sma te balam ॥28॥

text: vairaṃ na kurvīta naro durbuddhirbuddhijīvinā । buddhirbuddhimato yāti tūleṣviva hutāśanaḥ ॥29॥
html:
vairaṃ na kurvīta naro durbuddhirbuddhijīvinā ।
buddhirbuddhimato yāti tūleṣviva hutāśanaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: vEraM na kurvIta naro durbudDirbudDijIvinA । budDirbudDimato yAti tUlezviva hutASanaH ॥29॥

text: na hi buddhyā samaṃ kiñcidvidyate puruṣe nṛpa । tathā balena rājendra na samo'stīti cintayet ॥30॥
html:
na hi buddhyā samaṃ kiñcidvidyate puruṣe nṛpa ।
tathā balena rājendra na samo'stīti cintayet ॥30॥
slp1: na hi budDyA samaM kiYcidvidyate puruze nfpa । taTA balena rAjendra na samo'stIti cintayet ॥30॥

text: tasmātkṣameta bālāya jaḍāya badhirāya ca । balādhikāya rājendra taddṛṣṭaṃ tvayi śatruhan ॥31॥
html:
tasmātkṣameta bālāya jaḍāya badhirāya ca ।
balādhikāya rājendra taddṛṣṭaṃ tvayi śatruhan ॥31॥
slp1: tasmAtkzameta bAlAya jaqAya baDirAya ca । balADikAya rAjendra taddfzwaM tvayi Satruhan ॥31॥

text: akṣauhiṇyo daśaikā ca sapta caiva mahādyute । balena na samā rājannarjunasya mahātmanaḥ ॥32॥
html:
akṣauhiṇyo daśaikā ca sapta caiva mahādyute ।
balena na samā rājannarjunasya mahātmanaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: akzOhiRyo daSEkA ca sapta cEva mahAdyute । balena na samA rAjannarjunasya mahAtmanaH ॥32॥

text: hatāstāścaiva bhagnāśca pāṇḍavena yaśasvinā । caratā balamāsthāya pākaśāsaninā mṛdhe ॥33॥
html:
hatāstāścaiva bhagnāśca pāṇḍavena yaśasvinā ।
caratā balamāsthāya pākaśāsaninā mṛdhe ॥33॥
slp1: hatAstAScEva BagnASca pARqavena yaSasvinA । caratA balamAsTAya pAkaSAsaninA mfDe ॥33॥

text: uktāste rājadharmāśca āpaddharmāśca bhārata । vistareṇa mahārāja kiṃ bhūyaḥ prabravīmi te] ॥34॥
html:
uktāste rājadharmāśca āpaddharmāśca bhārata ।
vistareṇa mahārāja kiṃ bhūyaḥ prabravīmi te] ॥34॥
slp1: uktAste rAjaDarmASca ApadDarmASca BArata । vistareRa mahArAja kiM BUyaH prabravImi te] ॥34॥

text: pāpasya yadadhiṣṭhānaṃ yataḥ pāpaṃ pravartate । etadicchāmyahaṃ jñātuṃ tattvena bharatarṣabha ॥1॥
html:
pāpasya yadadhiṣṭhānaṃ yataḥ pāpaṃ pravartate ।
etadicchāmyahaṃ jñātuṃ tattvena bharatarṣabha ॥1॥
slp1: pApasya yadaDizWAnaM yataH pApaM pravartate । etadicCAmyahaM jYAtuM tattvena BaratarzaBa ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: pāpasya yadadhiṣṭhānaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa । eko lobho mahāgrāho lobhātpāpaṃ pravartate ॥2॥
html:
pāpasya yadadhiṣṭhānaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa ।
eko lobho mahāgrāho lobhātpāpaṃ pravartate ॥2॥
slp1: pApasya yadaDizWAnaM tacCfRuzva narADipa । eko loBo mahAgrAho loBAtpApaM pravartate ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ataḥ pāpamadharmaśca tathā duḥkhamanuttamam । nikṛtyā mūlametaddhi yena pāpakṛto janāḥ ॥3॥
html:
ataḥ pāpamadharmaśca tathā duḥkhamanuttamam ।
nikṛtyā mūlametaddhi yena pāpakṛto janāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: ataH pApamaDarmaSca taTA duHKamanuttamam । nikftyA mUlametadDi yena pApakfto janAH ॥3॥

text: lobhātkrodhaḥ prabhavati lobhātkāmaḥ pravartate । lobhānmohaśca māyā ca mānastambhaḥ parāsutā ॥4॥
html:
lobhātkrodhaḥ prabhavati lobhātkāmaḥ pravartate ।
lobhānmohaśca māyā ca mānastambhaḥ parāsutā ॥4॥
slp1: loBAtkroDaH praBavati loBAtkAmaH pravartate । loBAnmohaSca mAyA ca mAnastamBaH parAsutA ॥4॥

text: akṣamā hrīparityāgaḥ śrīnāśo dharmasaṅkṣayaḥ । abhidhyāprajñatā caiva sarvaṃ lobhātpravartate ॥5॥
html:
akṣamā hrīparityāgaḥ śrīnāśo dharmasaṅkṣayaḥ ।
abhidhyāprajñatā caiva sarvaṃ lobhātpravartate ॥5॥
slp1: akzamA hrIparityAgaH SrInASo DarmasaNkzayaH । aBiDyAprajYatA cEva sarvaM loBAtpravartate ॥5॥

text: anyāyaścāvitarkaśca vikarmasu ca yāḥ kriyāḥ । kūṭavidyādayaścaiva rūpaiśvaryamadastathā ॥6॥
html:
anyāyaścāvitarkaśca vikarmasu ca yāḥ kriyāḥ ।
kūṭavidyādayaścaiva rūpaiśvaryamadastathā ॥6॥
slp1: anyAyaScAvitarkaSca vikarmasu ca yAH kriyAH । kUwavidyAdayaScEva rUpESvaryamadastaTA ॥6॥

text: sarvabhūteṣvaviśvāsaḥ sarvabhūteṣvanārjavam । sarvabhūteṣvabhidrohaḥ sarvabhūteṣvayuktatā । haraṇaṃ paravittānāṃ paradārābhimarśanam ॥7॥
html:
sarvabhūteṣvaviśvāsaḥ sarvabhūteṣvanārjavam ।
sarvabhūteṣvabhidrohaḥ sarvabhūteṣvayuktatā ।
haraṇaṃ paravittānāṃ paradārābhimarśanam ॥7॥
slp1: sarvaBUtezvaviSvAsaH sarvaBUtezvanArjavam । sarvaBUtezvaBidrohaH sarvaBUtezvayuktatA । haraRaM paravittAnAM paradArABimarSanam ॥7॥

text: vāgvego mānaso vego nindāvegastathaiva ca । upasthodarayorvego mṛtyuvegaśca dāruṇaḥ ॥8॥
html:
vāgvego mānaso vego nindāvegastathaiva ca ।
upasthodarayorvego mṛtyuvegaśca dāruṇaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: vAgvego mAnaso vego nindAvegastaTEva ca । upasTodarayorvego mftyuvegaSca dAruRaH ॥8॥

text: īrṣyāvegaśca balavānmithyāvegaśca dustyajaḥ । rasavegaśca durvāraḥ śrotravegaśca duḥsahaḥ ॥9॥
html:
īrṣyāvegaśca balavānmithyāvegaśca dustyajaḥ ।
rasavegaśca durvāraḥ śrotravegaśca duḥsahaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: IrzyAvegaSca balavAnmiTyAvegaSca dustyajaH । rasavegaSca durvAraH SrotravegaSca duHsahaH ॥9॥

text: kutsā vikatthā mātsaryaṃ pāpaṃ duṣkarakāritā । sāhasānāṃ ca sarveṣāmakāryāṇāṃ kriyāstathā ॥10॥
html:
kutsā vikatthā mātsaryaṃ pāpaṃ duṣkarakāritā ।
sāhasānāṃ ca sarveṣāmakāryāṇāṃ kriyāstathā ॥10॥
slp1: kutsA vikatTA mAtsaryaM pApaM duzkarakAritA । sAhasAnAM ca sarvezAmakAryARAM kriyAstaTA ॥10॥

text: jātau bālye'tha kaumāre yauvane cāpi mānavaḥ । na santyajatyātmakarma yanna jīryati jīryataḥ ॥11॥
html:
jātau bālye'tha kaumāre yauvane cāpi mānavaḥ ।
na santyajatyātmakarma yanna jīryati jīryataḥ ॥11॥
slp1: jAtO bAlye'Ta kOmAre yOvane cApi mAnavaH । na santyajatyAtmakarma yanna jIryati jIryataH ॥11॥

text: yo na pūrayituṃ śakyo lobhaḥ prāptyā kurūdvaha । nityaṃ gambhīratoyābhirāpagābhirivodadhiḥ । na prahṛṣyati lābhairyo yaśca kāmairna tṛpyati ॥12॥
html:
yo na pūrayituṃ śakyo lobhaḥ prāptyā kurūdvaha ।
nityaṃ gambhīratoyābhirāpagābhirivodadhiḥ ।
na prahṛṣyati lābhairyo yaśca kāmairna tṛpyati ॥12॥
slp1: yo na pUrayituM Sakyo loBaH prAptyA kurUdvaha । nityaM gamBIratoyABirApagABirivodaDiH । na prahfzyati lABEryo yaSca kAmErna tfpyati ॥12॥

text: yo na devairna gandharvairnāsurairna mahoragaiḥ । jñāyate nṛpa tattvena sarvairbhūtagaṇaistathā । sa lobhaḥ saha mohena vijetavyo jitātmanā ॥13॥
html:
yo na devairna gandharvairnāsurairna mahoragaiḥ ।
jñāyate nṛpa tattvena sarvairbhūtagaṇaistathā ।
sa lobhaḥ saha mohena vijetavyo jitātmanā ॥13॥
slp1: yo na devErna ganDarvErnAsurErna mahoragEH । jYAyate nfpa tattvena sarvErBUtagaREstaTA । sa loBaH saha mohena vijetavyo jitAtmanA ॥13॥

text: dambho drohaśca nindā ca paiśunyaṃ matsarastathā । bhavantyetāni kauravya lubdhānāmakṛtātmanām ॥14॥
html:
dambho drohaśca nindā ca paiśunyaṃ matsarastathā ।
bhavantyetāni kauravya lubdhānāmakṛtātmanām ॥14॥
slp1: damBo drohaSca nindA ca pESunyaM matsarastaTA । BavantyetAni kOravya lubDAnAmakftAtmanAm ॥14॥

text: sumahāntyapi śāstrāṇi dhārayanti bahuśrutāḥ । chettāraḥ saṃśayānāṃ ca kliśyantīhālpabuddhayaḥ ॥15॥
html:
sumahāntyapi śāstrāṇi dhārayanti bahuśrutāḥ ।
chettāraḥ saṃśayānāṃ ca kliśyantīhālpabuddhayaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: sumahAntyapi SAstrARi DArayanti bahuSrutAH । CettAraH saMSayAnAM ca kliSyantIhAlpabudDayaH ॥15॥

text: dveṣakrodhaprasaktāśca śiṣṭācārabahiṣkṛtāḥ । antaḥkṣurā vāṅmadhurāḥ kūpāśchannāstṛṇairiva । dharmavaitaṃsikāḥ kṣudrā muṣṇanti dhvajino jagat ॥16॥
html:
dveṣakrodhaprasaktāśca śiṣṭācārabahiṣkṛtāḥ ।
antaḥkṣurā vāṅmadhurāḥ kūpāśchannāstṛṇairiva ।
dharmavaitaṃsikāḥ kṣudrā muṣṇanti dhvajino jagat ॥16॥
slp1: dvezakroDaprasaktASca SizwAcArabahizkftAH । antaHkzurA vANmaDurAH kUpASCannAstfREriva । DarmavEtaMsikAH kzudrA muzRanti Dvajino jagat ॥16॥

text: kurvate ca bahūnmārgāṃstāṃstānhetubalāśritāḥ । sarvaṃ mārgaṃ vilumpanti lobhājñāneṣu niṣṭhitāḥ ॥17॥
html:
kurvate ca bahūnmārgāṃstāṃstānhetubalāśritāḥ ।
sarvaṃ mārgaṃ vilumpanti lobhājñāneṣu niṣṭhitāḥ ॥17॥
slp1: kurvate ca bahUnmArgAMstAMstAnhetubalASritAH । sarvaM mArgaM vilumpanti loBAjYAnezu nizWitAH ॥17॥

text: dharmasyāhriyamāṇasya lobhagrastairdurātmabhiḥ । yā yā vikriyate saṃsthā tataḥ sābhiprapadyate ॥18॥
html:
dharmasyāhriyamāṇasya lobhagrastairdurātmabhiḥ ।
yā yā vikriyate saṃsthā tataḥ sābhiprapadyate ॥18॥
slp1: DarmasyAhriyamARasya loBagrastErdurAtmaBiH । yA yA vikriyate saMsTA tataH sABiprapadyate ॥18॥

text: darpaḥ krodho madaḥ svapno harṣaḥ śoko'timānitā । tata eva hi kauravya dṛśyante lubdhabuddhiṣu । etānaśiṣṭānbudhyasva nityaṃ lobhasamanvitān ॥19॥
html:
darpaḥ krodho madaḥ svapno harṣaḥ śoko'timānitā ।
tata eva hi kauravya dṛśyante lubdhabuddhiṣu ।
etānaśiṣṭānbudhyasva nityaṃ lobhasamanvitān ॥19॥
slp1: darpaH kroDo madaH svapno harzaH Soko'timAnitA । tata eva hi kOravya dfSyante lubDabudDizu । etAnaSizwAnbuDyasva nityaM loBasamanvitAn ॥19॥

text: śiṣṭāṃstu paripṛcchethā yānvakṣyāmi śucivratān । yeṣu vṛttibhayaṃ nāsti paralokabhayaṃ na ca ॥20॥
html:
śiṣṭāṃstu paripṛcchethā yānvakṣyāmi śucivratān ।
yeṣu vṛttibhayaṃ nāsti paralokabhayaṃ na ca ॥20॥
slp1: SizwAMstu paripfcCeTA yAnvakzyAmi SucivratAn । yezu vfttiBayaM nAsti paralokaBayaM na ca ॥20॥

text: nāmiṣeṣu prasaṅgo'sti na priyeṣvapriyeṣu ca । śiṣṭācāraḥ priyo yeṣu damo yeṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ ॥21॥
html:
nāmiṣeṣu prasaṅgo'sti na priyeṣvapriyeṣu ca ।
śiṣṭācāraḥ priyo yeṣu damo yeṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: nAmizezu prasaNgo'sti na priyezvapriyezu ca । SizwAcAraH priyo yezu damo yezu pratizWitaH ॥21॥

text: sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ paraṃ yeṣāṃ satyaṃ yeṣāṃ parāyaṇam । dātāro na gṛhītāro dayāvantastathaiva ca ॥22॥
html:
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ paraṃ yeṣāṃ satyaṃ yeṣāṃ parāyaṇam ।
dātāro na gṛhītāro dayāvantastathaiva ca ॥22॥
slp1: suKaM duHKaM paraM yezAM satyaM yezAM parAyaRam । dAtAro na gfhItAro dayAvantastaTEva ca ॥22॥

text: pitṛdevātitheyāśca nityodyuktāstathaiva ca । sarvopakāriṇo dhīrāḥ sarvadharmānupālakāḥ ॥23॥
html:
pitṛdevātitheyāśca nityodyuktāstathaiva ca ।
sarvopakāriṇo dhīrāḥ sarvadharmānupālakāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: pitfdevAtiTeyASca nityodyuktAstaTEva ca । sarvopakAriRo DIrAH sarvaDarmAnupAlakAH ॥23॥

text: sarvabhūtahitāścaiva sarvadeyāśca bhārata । na te cālayituṃ śakyā dharmavyāpārapāragāḥ ॥24॥
html:
sarvabhūtahitāścaiva sarvadeyāśca bhārata ।
na te cālayituṃ śakyā dharmavyāpārapāragāḥ ॥24॥
slp1: sarvaBUtahitAScEva sarvadeyASca BArata । na te cAlayituM SakyA DarmavyApArapAragAH ॥24॥

text: na teṣāṃ bhidyate vṛttaṃ yatpurā sādhubhiḥ kṛtam । na trāsino na capalā na raudrāḥ satpathe sthitāḥ ॥25॥
html:
na teṣāṃ bhidyate vṛttaṃ yatpurā sādhubhiḥ kṛtam ।
na trāsino na capalā na raudrāḥ satpathe sthitāḥ ॥25॥
slp1: na tezAM Bidyate vfttaM yatpurA sADuBiH kftam । na trAsino na capalA na rOdrAH satpaTe sTitAH ॥25॥

text: te sevyāḥ sādhubhirnityaṃ yeṣvahiṃsā pratiṣṭhitā । kāmakrodhavyapetā ye nirmamā nirahaṅkṛtāḥ । suvratāḥ sthiramaryādāstānupāssva ca pṛccha ca ॥26॥
html:
te sevyāḥ sādhubhirnityaṃ yeṣvahiṃsā pratiṣṭhitā ।
kāmakrodhavyapetā ye nirmamā nirahaṅkṛtāḥ ।
suvratāḥ sthiramaryādāstānupāssva ca pṛccha ca ॥26॥
slp1: te sevyAH sADuBirnityaM yezvahiMsA pratizWitA । kAmakroDavyapetA ye nirmamA nirahaNkftAH । suvratAH sTiramaryAdAstAnupAssva ca pfcCa ca ॥26॥

text: na gavārthaṃ yaśorthaṃ vā dharmasteṣāṃ yudhiṣṭhira । avaśyakārya ityeva śarīrasya kriyāstathā ॥27॥
html:
na gavārthaṃ yaśorthaṃ vā dharmasteṣāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
avaśyakārya ityeva śarīrasya kriyāstathā ॥27॥
slp1: na gavArTaM yaSorTaM vA DarmastezAM yuDizWira । avaSyakArya ityeva SarIrasya kriyAstaTA ॥27॥

text: na bhayaṃ krodhacāpalyaṃ na śokasteṣu vidyate । na dharmadhvajinaścaiva na guhyaṃ kiñcidāsthitāḥ ॥28॥
html:
na bhayaṃ krodhacāpalyaṃ na śokasteṣu vidyate ।
na dharmadhvajinaścaiva na guhyaṃ kiñcidāsthitāḥ ॥28॥
slp1: na BayaM kroDacApalyaM na Sokastezu vidyate । na DarmaDvajinaScEva na guhyaM kiYcidAsTitAH ॥28॥

text: yeṣvalobhastathāmoho ye ca satyārjave ratāḥ । teṣu kaunteya rajyethā yeṣvatandrīkṛtaṃ manaḥ ॥29॥
html:
yeṣvalobhastathāmoho ye ca satyārjave ratāḥ ।
teṣu kaunteya rajyethā yeṣvatandrīkṛtaṃ manaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: yezvaloBastaTAmoho ye ca satyArjave ratAH । tezu kOnteya rajyeTA yezvatandrIkftaM manaH ॥29॥

text: ye na hṛṣyanti lābheṣu nālābheṣu vyathanti ca । nirmamā nirahaṅkārāḥ sattvasthāḥ samadarśinaḥ ॥30॥
html:
ye na hṛṣyanti lābheṣu nālābheṣu vyathanti ca ।
nirmamā nirahaṅkārāḥ sattvasthāḥ samadarśinaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: ye na hfzyanti lABezu nAlABezu vyaTanti ca । nirmamA nirahaNkArAH sattvasTAH samadarSinaH ॥30॥

text: lābhālābhau sukhaduḥkhe ca tāta priyāpriye maraṇaṃ jīvitaṃ ca । samāni yeṣāṃ sthiravikramāṇāṃ buddhātmanāṃ sattvamavasthitānām ॥31॥
html:
lābhālābhau sukhaduḥkhe ca tāta priyāpriye maraṇaṃ jīvitaṃ ca ।
samāni yeṣāṃ sthiravikramāṇāṃ buddhātmanāṃ sattvamavasthitānām ॥31॥
slp1: lABAlABO suKaduHKe ca tAta priyApriye maraRaM jIvitaM ca । samAni yezAM sTiravikramARAM budDAtmanAM sattvamavasTitAnAm ॥31॥

text: sukhapriyaistānsumahāpratāpānyatto'pramattaśca samarthayethāḥ । daivātsarve guṇavanto bhavanti śubhāśubhā vākpralāpā yathaiva] ॥32॥
html:
sukhapriyaistānsumahāpratāpānyatto'pramattaśca samarthayethāḥ ।
daivātsarve guṇavanto bhavanti śubhāśubhā vākpralāpā yathaiva] ॥32॥
slp1: suKapriyEstAnsumahApratApAnyatto'pramattaSca samarTayeTAH । dEvAtsarve guRavanto Bavanti SuBASuBA vAkpralApA yaTEva] ॥32॥

text: anarthānāmadhiṣṭhānamukto lobhaḥ pitāmaha । ajñānamapi vai tāta śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ॥1॥
html:
anarthānāmadhiṣṭhānamukto lobhaḥ pitāmaha ।
ajñānamapi vai tāta śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ॥1॥
slp1: anarTAnAmaDizWAnamukto loBaH pitAmaha । ajYAnamapi vE tAta SrotumicCAmi tattvataH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: karoti pāpaṃ yo'jñānānnātmano vetti ca kṣamam । pradveṣṭi sādhuvṛttāṃśca sa lokasyaiti vācyatām ॥2॥
html:
karoti pāpaṃ yo'jñānānnātmano vetti ca kṣamam ।
pradveṣṭi sādhuvṛttāṃśca sa lokasyaiti vācyatām ॥2॥
slp1: karoti pApaM yo'jYAnAnnAtmano vetti ca kzamam । pradvezwi sADuvfttAMSca sa lokasyEti vAcyatAm ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ajñānānnirayaṃ yāti tathājñānena durgatim । ajñānātkleśamāpnoti tathāpatsu nimajjati ॥3॥
html:
ajñānānnirayaṃ yāti tathājñānena durgatim ।
ajñānātkleśamāpnoti tathāpatsu nimajjati ॥3॥
slp1: ajYAnAnnirayaM yAti taTAjYAnena durgatim । ajYAnAtkleSamApnoti taTApatsu nimajjati ॥3॥

text: ajñānasya pravṛttiṃ ca sthānaṃ vṛddhiṃ kṣayodayau । mūlaṃ yogaṃ gatiṃ kālaṃ kāraṇaṃ hetumeva ca ॥4॥
html:
ajñānasya pravṛttiṃ ca sthānaṃ vṛddhiṃ kṣayodayau ।
mūlaṃ yogaṃ gatiṃ kālaṃ kāraṇaṃ hetumeva ca ॥4॥
slp1: ajYAnasya pravfttiM ca sTAnaM vfdDiM kzayodayO । mUlaM yogaM gatiM kAlaM kAraRaM hetumeva ca ॥4॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: śrotumicchāmi tattvena yathāvadiha pārthiva । ajñānaprabhavaṃ hīdaṃ yadduḥkhamupalabhyate ॥5॥
html:
śrotumicchāmi tattvena yathāvadiha pārthiva ।
ajñānaprabhavaṃ hīdaṃ yadduḥkhamupalabhyate ॥5॥
slp1: SrotumicCAmi tattvena yaTAvadiha pArTiva । ajYAnapraBavaM hIdaM yadduHKamupalaByate ॥5॥

text: rāgo dveṣastathā moho harṣaḥ śoko'bhimānitā । kāmaḥ krodhaśca darpaśca tandrīrālasyameva ca ॥6॥
html:
rāgo dveṣastathā moho harṣaḥ śoko'bhimānitā ।
kāmaḥ krodhaśca darpaśca tandrīrālasyameva ca ॥6॥
slp1: rAgo dvezastaTA moho harzaH Soko'BimAnitA । kAmaH kroDaSca darpaSca tandrIrAlasyameva ca ॥6॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: icchā dveṣastathā tāpaḥ paravṛddhyupatāpitā । ajñānametannirdiṣṭaṃ pāpānāṃ caiva yāḥ kriyāḥ ॥7॥
html:
icchā dveṣastathā tāpaḥ paravṛddhyupatāpitā ।
ajñānametannirdiṣṭaṃ pāpānāṃ caiva yāḥ kriyāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: icCA dvezastaTA tApaH paravfdDyupatApitA । ajYAnametannirdizwaM pApAnAM cEva yAH kriyAH ॥7॥

text: etayā yā pravṛttiśca vṛddhyādīnyāṃśca pṛcchasi । vistareṇa mahābāho śṛṇu tacca viśāṃ pate ॥8॥
html:
etayā yā pravṛttiśca vṛddhyādīnyāṃśca pṛcchasi ।
vistareṇa mahābāho śṛṇu tacca viśāṃ pate ॥8॥
slp1: etayA yA pravfttiSca vfdDyAdInyAMSca pfcCasi । vistareRa mahAbAho SfRu tacca viSAM pate ॥8॥

text: ubhāvetau samaphalau samadoṣau ca bhārata । ajñānaṃ cātilobhaścāpyekaṃ jānīhi pārthiva ॥9॥
html:
ubhāvetau samaphalau samadoṣau ca bhārata ।
ajñānaṃ cātilobhaścāpyekaṃ jānīhi pārthiva ॥9॥
slp1: uBAvetO samaPalO samadozO ca BArata । ajYAnaM cAtiloBaScApyekaM jAnIhi pArTiva ॥9॥

text: lobhaprabhavamajñānaṃ vṛddhaṃ bhūyaḥ pravardhate । sthāne sthānaṃ kṣaye kṣaiṇyamupaiti vividhāṃ gatim ॥10॥
html:
lobhaprabhavamajñānaṃ vṛddhaṃ bhūyaḥ pravardhate ।
sthāne sthānaṃ kṣaye kṣaiṇyamupaiti vividhāṃ gatim ॥10॥
slp1: loBapraBavamajYAnaM vfdDaM BUyaH pravarDate । sTAne sTAnaM kzaye kzERyamupEti viviDAM gatim ॥10॥

text: mūlaṃ lobhasya mahataḥ kālātmagatireva ca । chinne'cchinne tathā lobhe kāraṇaṃ kāla eva hi ॥11॥
html:
mūlaṃ lobhasya mahataḥ kālātmagatireva ca ।
chinne'cchinne tathā lobhe kāraṇaṃ kāla eva hi ॥11॥
slp1: mUlaM loBasya mahataH kAlAtmagatireva ca । Cinne'cCinne taTA loBe kAraRaM kAla eva hi ॥11॥

text: tasyājñānāttu lobho hi lobhādajñānameva ca । sarve doṣāstathā lobhāttasmāllobhaṃ vivarjayet ॥12॥
html:
tasyājñānāttu lobho hi lobhādajñānameva ca ।
sarve doṣāstathā lobhāttasmāllobhaṃ vivarjayet ॥12॥
slp1: tasyAjYAnAttu loBo hi loBAdajYAnameva ca । sarve dozAstaTA loBAttasmAlloBaM vivarjayet ॥12॥

text: janako yuvanāśvaśca vṛṣādarbhiḥ prasenajit । lobhakṣayāddivaṃ prāptāstathaivānye janādhipāḥ ॥13॥
html:
janako yuvanāśvaśca vṛṣādarbhiḥ prasenajit ।
lobhakṣayāddivaṃ prāptāstathaivānye janādhipāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: janako yuvanASvaSca vfzAdarBiH prasenajit । loBakzayAddivaM prAptAstaTEvAnye janADipAH ॥13॥

text: pratyakṣaṃ tu kuruśreṣṭha tyaja lobhamihātmanā । tyaktvā lobhaṃ sukhaṃ loke pretya cānucariṣyasi] ॥14॥
html:
pratyakṣaṃ tu kuruśreṣṭha tyaja lobhamihātmanā ।
tyaktvā lobhaṃ sukhaṃ loke pretya cānucariṣyasi] ॥14॥
slp1: pratyakzaM tu kuruSrezWa tyaja loBamihAtmanA । tyaktvA loBaM suKaM loke pretya cAnucarizyasi] ॥14॥

text: svādhyāyakṛtayatnasya brāhmaṇasya pitāmaha । dharmakāmasya dharmātmankiṃ nu śreya ihocyate ॥1॥
html:
svādhyāyakṛtayatnasya brāhmaṇasya pitāmaha ।
dharmakāmasya dharmātmankiṃ nu śreya ihocyate ॥1॥
slp1: svADyAyakftayatnasya brAhmaRasya pitAmaha । DarmakAmasya DarmAtmankiM nu Sreya ihocyate ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: bahudhādarśane loke śreyo yadiha manyase । asmiṁlloke pare caiva tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥2॥
html:
bahudhādarśane loke śreyo yadiha manyase ।
asmiṁlloke pare caiva tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥2॥
slp1: bahuDAdarSane loke Sreyo yadiha manyase । asmiṁlloke pare cEva tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥2॥

text: mahānayaṃ dharmapatho bahuśākhaśca bhārata । kiṃ svideveha dharmāṇāmanuṣṭheyatamaṃ matam ॥3॥
html:
mahānayaṃ dharmapatho bahuśākhaśca bhārata ।
kiṃ svideveha dharmāṇāmanuṣṭheyatamaṃ matam ॥3॥
slp1: mahAnayaM DarmapaTo bahuSAKaSca BArata । kiM svideveha DarmARAmanuzWeyatamaM matam ॥3॥

text: dharmasya mahato rājanbahuśākhasya tattvataḥ । yanmūlaṃ paramaṃ tāta tatsarvaṃ brūhyatandritaḥ ॥4॥
html:
dharmasya mahato rājanbahuśākhasya tattvataḥ ।
yanmūlaṃ paramaṃ tāta tatsarvaṃ brūhyatandritaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: Darmasya mahato rAjanbahuSAKasya tattvataH । yanmUlaM paramaM tAta tatsarvaM brUhyatandritaH ॥4॥

text: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi yena śreyaḥ prapatsyase । pītvāmṛtamiva prājño jñānatṛpto bhaviṣyasi ॥5॥
html:
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi yena śreyaḥ prapatsyase ।
pītvāmṛtamiva prājño jñānatṛpto bhaviṣyasi ॥5॥
slp1: hanta te kaTayizyAmi yena SreyaH prapatsyase । pItvAmftamiva prAjYo jYAnatfpto Bavizyasi ॥5॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dharmasya vidhayo naike te te proktā maharṣibhiḥ । svaṃ svaṃ vijñānamāśritya damasteṣāṃ parāyaṇam ॥6॥
html:
dharmasya vidhayo naike te te proktā maharṣibhiḥ ।
svaṃ svaṃ vijñānamāśritya damasteṣāṃ parāyaṇam ॥6॥
slp1: Darmasya viDayo nEke te te proktA maharziBiH । svaM svaM vijYAnamASritya damastezAM parAyaRam ॥6॥

text: damaṃ niḥśreyasaṃ prāhurvṛddhā niścayadarśinaḥ । brāhmaṇasya viśeṣeṇa damo dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥7॥
html:
damaṃ niḥśreyasaṃ prāhurvṛddhā niścayadarśinaḥ ।
brāhmaṇasya viśeṣeṇa damo dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: damaM niHSreyasaM prAhurvfdDA niScayadarSinaH । brAhmaRasya viSezeRa damo DarmaH sanAtanaH ॥7॥

text: nādāntasya kriyāsiddhiryathāvadupalabhyate । damo dānaṃ tathā yajñānadhītaṃ cātivartate ॥8॥
html:
nādāntasya kriyāsiddhiryathāvadupalabhyate ।
damo dānaṃ tathā yajñānadhītaṃ cātivartate ॥8॥
slp1: nAdAntasya kriyAsidDiryaTAvadupalaByate । damo dAnaM taTA yajYAnaDItaM cAtivartate ॥8॥

text: damastejo vardhayati pavitraṃ ca damaḥ param । vipāpmā tejasā yuktaḥ puruṣo vindate mahat ॥9॥
html:
damastejo vardhayati pavitraṃ ca damaḥ param ।
vipāpmā tejasā yuktaḥ puruṣo vindate mahat ॥9॥
slp1: damastejo varDayati pavitraM ca damaH param । vipApmA tejasA yuktaH puruzo vindate mahat ॥9॥

text: damena sadṛśaṃ dharmaṃ nānyaṃ lokeṣu śuśruma । damo hi paramo loke praśastaḥ sarvadharmiṇām ॥10॥
html:
damena sadṛśaṃ dharmaṃ nānyaṃ lokeṣu śuśruma ।
damo hi paramo loke praśastaḥ sarvadharmiṇām ॥10॥
slp1: damena sadfSaM DarmaM nAnyaM lokezu SuSruma । damo hi paramo loke praSastaH sarvaDarmiRAm ॥10॥

text: pretya cāpi manuṣyendra paramaṃ vindate sukham । damena hi samāyukto mahāntaṃ dharmamaśnute ॥11॥
html:
pretya cāpi manuṣyendra paramaṃ vindate sukham ।
damena hi samāyukto mahāntaṃ dharmamaśnute ॥11॥
slp1: pretya cApi manuzyendra paramaM vindate suKam । damena hi samAyukto mahAntaM DarmamaSnute ॥11॥

text: sukhaṃ dāntaḥ prasvapiti sukhaṃ ca pratibudhyate । sukhaṃ paryeti lokāṃśca manaścāsya prasīdati ॥12॥
html:
sukhaṃ dāntaḥ prasvapiti sukhaṃ ca pratibudhyate ।
sukhaṃ paryeti lokāṃśca manaścāsya prasīdati ॥12॥
slp1: suKaM dAntaH prasvapiti suKaM ca pratibuDyate । suKaM paryeti lokAMSca manaScAsya prasIdati ॥12॥

text: adāntaḥ puruṣaḥ kleśamabhīkṣṇaṃ pratipadyate । anarthāṃśca bahūnanyānprasṛjatyātmadoṣajān ॥13॥
html:
adāntaḥ puruṣaḥ kleśamabhīkṣṇaṃ pratipadyate ।
anarthāṃśca bahūnanyānprasṛjatyātmadoṣajān ॥13॥
slp1: adAntaH puruzaH kleSamaBIkzRaM pratipadyate । anarTAMSca bahUnanyAnprasfjatyAtmadozajAn ॥13॥

text: āśrameṣu caturṣvāhurdamamevottamaṃ vratam । tasya liṅgāni vakṣyāmi yeṣāṃ samudayo damaḥ ॥14॥
html:
āśrameṣu caturṣvāhurdamamevottamaṃ vratam ।
tasya liṅgāni vakṣyāmi yeṣāṃ samudayo damaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: ASramezu caturzvAhurdamamevottamaM vratam । tasya liNgAni vakzyAmi yezAM samudayo damaH ॥14॥

text: kṣamā dhṛtirahiṃsā ca samatā satyamārjavam । indriyāvajayo dākṣyaṃ mārdavaṃ hrīracāpalam ॥15॥
html:
kṣamā dhṛtirahiṃsā ca samatā satyamārjavam ।
indriyāvajayo dākṣyaṃ mārdavaṃ hrīracāpalam ॥15॥
slp1: kzamA DftirahiMsA ca samatA satyamArjavam । indriyAvajayo dAkzyaM mArdavaM hrIracApalam ॥15॥

text: akārpaṇyamasaṃrambhaḥ santoṣaḥ priyavāditā । avivitsānasūyā cāpyeṣāṃ samudayo damaḥ ॥16॥
html:
akārpaṇyamasaṃrambhaḥ santoṣaḥ priyavāditā ।
avivitsānasūyā cāpyeṣāṃ samudayo damaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: akArpaRyamasaMramBaH santozaH priyavAditA । avivitsAnasUyA cApyezAM samudayo damaH ॥16॥

text: gurupūjā ca kauravya dayā bhūteṣvapaiśunam । janavādo'mṛṣāvādaḥ stutinindāvivarjanam ॥17॥
html:
gurupūjā ca kauravya dayā bhūteṣvapaiśunam ।
janavādo'mṛṣāvādaḥ stutinindāvivarjanam ॥17॥
slp1: gurupUjA ca kOravya dayA BUtezvapESunam । janavAdo'mfzAvAdaH stutinindAvivarjanam ॥17॥

text: kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca darpaḥ stambho vikatthanam । moha īrṣyāvamānaścetyetaddānto na sevate ॥18॥
html:
kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca darpaḥ stambho vikatthanam ।
moha īrṣyāvamānaścetyetaddānto na sevate ॥18॥
slp1: kAmaH kroDaSca loBaSca darpaH stamBo vikatTanam । moha IrzyAvamAnaScetyetaddAnto na sevate ॥18॥

text: anindito hyakāmātmāthālpeccho'thānasūyakaḥ । samudrakalpaḥ sa naro na kadācana pūryate ॥19॥
html:
anindito hyakāmātmāthālpeccho'thānasūyakaḥ ।
samudrakalpaḥ sa naro na kadācana pūryate ॥19॥
slp1: anindito hyakAmAtmATAlpecCo'TAnasUyakaH । samudrakalpaH sa naro na kadAcana pUryate ॥19॥

text: ahaṃ tvayi mama tvaṃ ca mayi te teṣu cāpyaham । pūrvasaṃbandhisaṃyogānnaitaddānto niṣevate ॥20॥
html:
ahaṃ tvayi mama tvaṃ ca mayi te teṣu cāpyaham ।
pūrvasaṃbandhisaṃyogānnaitaddānto niṣevate ॥20॥
slp1: ahaM tvayi mama tvaM ca mayi te tezu cApyaham । pUrvasaMbanDisaMyogAnnEtaddAnto nizevate ॥20॥

text: sarvā grāmyāstathāraṇyā yāśca loke pravṛttayaḥ । nindāṃ caiva praśaṃsāṃ ca yo nāśrayati mucyate ॥21॥
html:
sarvā grāmyāstathāraṇyā yāśca loke pravṛttayaḥ ।
nindāṃ caiva praśaṃsāṃ ca yo nāśrayati mucyate ॥21॥
slp1: sarvA grAmyAstaTAraRyA yASca loke pravfttayaH । nindAM cEva praSaMsAM ca yo nASrayati mucyate ॥21॥

text: maitro'tha śīlasampannaḥ susahāyaparaśca yaḥ । muktaśca vividhaiḥ saṅgaistasya pretya mahatphalam ॥22॥
html:
maitro'tha śīlasampannaḥ susahāyaparaśca yaḥ ।
muktaśca vividhaiḥ saṅgaistasya pretya mahatphalam ॥22॥
slp1: mEtro'Ta SIlasampannaH susahAyaparaSca yaH । muktaSca viviDEH saNgEstasya pretya mahatPalam ॥22॥

text: suvṛttaḥ śīlasampannaḥ prasannātmātmavidbudhaḥ । prāpyeha loke satkāraṃ sugatiṃ pratipadyate ॥23॥
html:
suvṛttaḥ śīlasampannaḥ prasannātmātmavidbudhaḥ ।
prāpyeha loke satkāraṃ sugatiṃ pratipadyate ॥23॥
slp1: suvfttaH SIlasampannaH prasannAtmAtmavidbuDaH । prApyeha loke satkAraM sugatiM pratipadyate ॥23॥

text: karma yacchubhameveha sadbhirācaritaṃ ca yat । tadeva jñānayuktasya munerdharmo na hīyate ॥24॥
html:
karma yacchubhameveha sadbhirācaritaṃ ca yat ।
tadeva jñānayuktasya munerdharmo na hīyate ॥24॥
slp1: karma yacCuBameveha sadBirAcaritaM ca yat । tadeva jYAnayuktasya munerDarmo na hIyate ॥24॥

text: niṣkramya vanamāsthāya jñānayukto jitendriyaḥ । kālākāṅkṣī carannevaṃ brahmabhūyāya kalpate ॥25॥
html:
niṣkramya vanamāsthāya jñānayukto jitendriyaḥ ।
kālākāṅkṣī carannevaṃ brahmabhūyāya kalpate ॥25॥
slp1: nizkramya vanamAsTAya jYAnayukto jitendriyaH । kAlAkANkzI carannevaM brahmaBUyAya kalpate ॥25॥

text: abhayaṃ yasya bhūtebhyo bhūtānāmabhayaṃ yataḥ । tasya dehādvimuktasya bhayaṃ nāsti kutaścana ॥26॥
html:
abhayaṃ yasya bhūtebhyo bhūtānāmabhayaṃ yataḥ ।
tasya dehādvimuktasya bhayaṃ nāsti kutaścana ॥26॥
slp1: aBayaM yasya BUteByo BUtAnAmaBayaM yataH । tasya dehAdvimuktasya BayaM nAsti kutaScana ॥26॥

text: avācinoti karmāṇi na ca sampracinoti ha । samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu maitrāyaṇagatiścaret ॥27॥
html:
avācinoti karmāṇi na ca sampracinoti ha ।
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu maitrāyaṇagatiścaret ॥27॥
slp1: avAcinoti karmARi na ca sampracinoti ha । samaH sarvezu BUtezu mEtrAyaRagatiScaret ॥27॥

text: śakunīnāmivākāśe jale vāricarasya vā । yathā gatirna dṛśyeta tathā tasya na saṃśayaḥ ॥28॥
html:
śakunīnāmivākāśe jale vāricarasya vā ।
yathā gatirna dṛśyeta tathā tasya na saṃśayaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: SakunInAmivAkASe jale vAricarasya vA । yaTA gatirna dfSyeta taTA tasya na saMSayaH ॥28॥

text: gṛhānutsṛjya yo rājanmokṣamevābhipadyate । lokāstejomayāstasya kalpante śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ॥29॥
html:
gṛhānutsṛjya yo rājanmokṣamevābhipadyate ।
lokāstejomayāstasya kalpante śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ॥29॥
slp1: gfhAnutsfjya yo rAjanmokzamevABipadyate । lokAstejomayAstasya kalpante SASvatIH samAH ॥29॥

text: saṃnyasya sarvakarmāṇi saṃnyasya vidhivattapaḥ । saṃnyasya vividhā vidyāḥ sarvaṃ saṃnyasya caiva ha ॥30॥
html:
saṃnyasya sarvakarmāṇi saṃnyasya vidhivattapaḥ ।
saṃnyasya vividhā vidyāḥ sarvaṃ saṃnyasya caiva ha ॥30॥
slp1: saMnyasya sarvakarmARi saMnyasya viDivattapaH । saMnyasya viviDA vidyAH sarvaM saMnyasya cEva ha ॥30॥

text: kāmeṣu cāpyanāvṛttaḥ prasannātmātmavicchuciḥ । prāpyeha loke satkāraṃ svargaṃ samabhipadyate ॥31॥
html:
kāmeṣu cāpyanāvṛttaḥ prasannātmātmavicchuciḥ ।
prāpyeha loke satkāraṃ svargaṃ samabhipadyate ॥31॥
slp1: kAmezu cApyanAvfttaH prasannAtmAtmavicCuciH । prApyeha loke satkAraM svargaM samaBipadyate ॥31॥

text: yacca paitāmahaṃ sthānaṃ brahmarāśisamudbhavam । guhāyāṃ pihitaṃ nityaṃ taddamenābhipadyate ॥32॥
html:
yacca paitāmahaṃ sthānaṃ brahmarāśisamudbhavam ।
guhāyāṃ pihitaṃ nityaṃ taddamenābhipadyate ॥32॥
