slp1: yacca pEtAmahaM sTAnaM brahmarASisamudBavam । guhAyAM pihitaM nityaM taddamenABipadyate ॥32॥

text: jñānārāmasya buddhasya sarvabhūtāvirodhinaḥ । nāvṛttibhayamastīha paraloke bhayaṃ kutaḥ ॥33॥
html:
jñānārāmasya buddhasya sarvabhūtāvirodhinaḥ ।
nāvṛttibhayamastīha paraloke bhayaṃ kutaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: jYAnArAmasya budDasya sarvaBUtAviroDinaH । nAvfttiBayamastIha paraloke BayaM kutaH ॥33॥

text: eka eva dame doṣo dvitīyo nopapadyate । yadenaṃ kṣamayā yuktamaśaktaṃ manyate janaḥ ॥34॥
html:
eka eva dame doṣo dvitīyo nopapadyate ।
yadenaṃ kṣamayā yuktamaśaktaṃ manyate janaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: eka eva dame dozo dvitIyo nopapadyate । yadenaM kzamayA yuktamaSaktaM manyate janaH ॥34॥

text: etasya tu mahāprājña doṣasya sumahānguṇaḥ । kṣamāyāṃ vipulā lokāḥ sulabhā hi sahiṣṇunā ॥35॥
html:
etasya tu mahāprājña doṣasya sumahānguṇaḥ ।
kṣamāyāṃ vipulā lokāḥ sulabhā hi sahiṣṇunā ॥35॥
slp1: etasya tu mahAprAjYa dozasya sumahAnguRaH । kzamAyAM vipulA lokAH sulaBA hi sahizRunA ॥35॥

text: dāntasya kimaraṇyena tathādāntasya bhārata । yatraiva hi vaseddāntastadaraṇyaṃ sa āśramaḥ ॥36॥
html:
dāntasya kimaraṇyena tathādāntasya bhārata ।
yatraiva hi vaseddāntastadaraṇyaṃ sa āśramaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: dAntasya kimaraRyena taTAdAntasya BArata । yatrEva hi vaseddAntastadaraRyaM sa ASramaH ॥36॥

text: etadbhīṣmasya vacanaṃ śrutvā rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । amṛteneva santṛptaḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ samapadyata ॥37॥
html:
etadbhīṣmasya vacanaṃ śrutvā rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।
amṛteneva santṛptaḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ samapadyata ॥37॥
slp1: etadBIzmasya vacanaM SrutvA rAjA yuDizWiraH । amfteneva santfptaH prahfzwaH samapadyata ॥37॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: punaśca paripapraccha bhīṣmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ varam । tapaḥ prati sa covāca tasmai sarvaṃ kurūdvaha] ॥38॥
html:
punaśca paripapraccha bhīṣmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ varam ।
tapaḥ prati sa covāca tasmai sarvaṃ kurūdvaha] ॥38॥
slp1: punaSca paripapracCa BIzmaM DarmaBftAM varam । tapaH prati sa covAca tasmE sarvaM kurUdvaha] ॥38॥

text: sarvametattapomūlaṃ kavayaḥ paricakṣate । na hyataptatapā mūḍhaḥ kriyāphalamavāpyate ॥1॥
html:
sarvametattapomūlaṃ kavayaḥ paricakṣate ।
na hyataptatapā mūḍhaḥ kriyāphalamavāpyate ॥1॥
slp1: sarvametattapomUlaM kavayaH paricakzate । na hyataptatapA mUQaH kriyAPalamavApyate ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: prajāpatiridaṃ sarvaṃ tapasaivāsṛjatprabhuḥ । tathaiva vedānṛṣayastapasā pratipedire ॥2॥
html:
prajāpatiridaṃ sarvaṃ tapasaivāsṛjatprabhuḥ ।
tathaiva vedānṛṣayastapasā pratipedire ॥2॥
slp1: prajApatiridaM sarvaM tapasEvAsfjatpraBuH । taTEva vedAnfzayastapasA pratipedire ॥2॥

text: tapaso hyānupūrvyeṇa phalamūlānilāśanāḥ । trīṁllokāṃstapasā siddhāḥ paśyanti susamāhitāḥ ॥3॥
html:
tapaso hyānupūrvyeṇa phalamūlānilāśanāḥ ।
trīṁllokāṃstapasā siddhāḥ paśyanti susamāhitāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: tapaso hyAnupUrvyeRa PalamUlAnilASanAH । trIṁllokAMstapasA sidDAH paSyanti susamAhitAH ॥3॥

text: auṣadhānyagadādīni tisro vidyāśca saṃskṛtāḥ । tapasaiva hi sidhyanti tapomūlaṃ hi sādhanam ॥4॥
html:
auṣadhānyagadādīni tisro vidyāśca saṃskṛtāḥ ।
tapasaiva hi sidhyanti tapomūlaṃ hi sādhanam ॥4॥
slp1: OzaDAnyagadAdIni tisro vidyASca saMskftAH । tapasEva hi siDyanti tapomUlaM hi sADanam ॥4॥

text: yaddurāpaṃ durāmnāyaṃ durādharṣaṃ durutsaham । sarvaṃ tattapasā śakyaṃ tapo hi duratikramam ॥5॥
html:
yaddurāpaṃ durāmnāyaṃ durādharṣaṃ durutsaham ।
sarvaṃ tattapasā śakyaṃ tapo hi duratikramam ॥5॥
slp1: yaddurApaM durAmnAyaM durADarzaM durutsaham । sarvaM tattapasA SakyaM tapo hi duratikramam ॥5॥

text: surāpo'sammatādāyī bhrūṇahā gurutalpagaḥ । tapasaiva sutaptena naraḥ pāpādvimucyate ॥6॥
html:
surāpo'sammatādāyī bhrūṇahā gurutalpagaḥ ।
tapasaiva sutaptena naraḥ pāpādvimucyate ॥6॥
slp1: surApo'sammatAdAyI BrURahA gurutalpagaH । tapasEva sutaptena naraH pApAdvimucyate ॥6॥

text: tapaso bahurūpasya taistairdvāraiḥ pravartataḥ । nivṛttyā vartamānasya tapo nānaśanātparam ॥7॥
html:
tapaso bahurūpasya taistairdvāraiḥ pravartataḥ ।
nivṛttyā vartamānasya tapo nānaśanātparam ॥7॥
slp1: tapaso bahurUpasya tEstErdvArEH pravartataH । nivfttyA vartamAnasya tapo nAnaSanAtparam ॥7॥

text: ahiṃsā satyavacanaṃ dānamindriyanigrahaḥ । etebhyo hi mahārāja tapo nānaśanātparam ॥8॥
html:
ahiṃsā satyavacanaṃ dānamindriyanigrahaḥ ।
etebhyo hi mahārāja tapo nānaśanātparam ॥8॥
slp1: ahiMsA satyavacanaM dAnamindriyanigrahaH । eteByo hi mahArAja tapo nAnaSanAtparam ॥8॥

text: na duṣkarataraṃ dānānnātimātaramāśramaḥ । traividyebhyaḥ paraṃ nāsti saṃnyāsaḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ ॥9॥
html:
na duṣkarataraṃ dānānnātimātaramāśramaḥ ।
traividyebhyaḥ paraṃ nāsti saṃnyāsaḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: na duzkarataraM dAnAnnAtimAtaramASramaH । trEvidyeByaH paraM nAsti saMnyAsaH paramaM tapaH ॥9॥

text: indriyāṇīha rakṣanti dhanadhānyābhiguptaye । tasmādarthe ca dharme ca tapo nānaśanātparam ॥10॥
html:
indriyāṇīha rakṣanti dhanadhānyābhiguptaye ।
tasmādarthe ca dharme ca tapo nānaśanātparam ॥10॥
slp1: indriyARIha rakzanti DanaDAnyABiguptaye । tasmAdarTe ca Darme ca tapo nAnaSanAtparam ॥10॥

text: ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā manuṣyā mṛgasattamāḥ । yāni cānyāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ॥11॥
html:
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā manuṣyā mṛgasattamāḥ ।
yāni cānyāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ॥11॥
slp1: fzayaH pitaro devA manuzyA mfgasattamAH । yAni cAnyAni BUtAni sTAvarARi carARi ca ॥11॥

text: tapaḥparāyaṇāḥ sarve sidhyanti tapasā ca te । ityevaṃ tapasā devā mahattvaṃ cāpyavāpnuvan ॥12॥
html:
tapaḥparāyaṇāḥ sarve sidhyanti tapasā ca te ।
ityevaṃ tapasā devā mahattvaṃ cāpyavāpnuvan ॥12॥
slp1: tapaHparAyaRAH sarve siDyanti tapasA ca te । ityevaM tapasA devA mahattvaM cApyavApnuvan ॥12॥

text: imānīṣṭavibhāgāni phalāni tapasā sadā । tapasā śakyate prāptuṃ devatvamapi niścayāt] ॥13॥
html:
imānīṣṭavibhāgāni phalāni tapasā sadā ।
tapasā śakyate prāptuṃ devatvamapi niścayāt] ॥13॥
slp1: imAnIzwaviBAgAni PalAni tapasA sadA । tapasA Sakyate prAptuM devatvamapi niScayAt] ॥13॥

text: satyaṃ dharme praśaṃsanti viprarṣipitṛdevatāḥ । satyamicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
satyaṃ dharme praśaṃsanti viprarṣipitṛdevatāḥ ।
satyamicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: satyaM Darme praSaMsanti viprarzipitfdevatAH । satyamicCAmyahaM SrotuM tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: satyaṃ kiṃlakṣaṇaṃ rājankathaṃ vā tadavāpyate । satyaṃ prāpya bhavetkiṃ ca kathaṃ caiva taducyate ॥2॥
html:
satyaṃ kiṃlakṣaṇaṃ rājankathaṃ vā tadavāpyate ।
satyaṃ prāpya bhavetkiṃ ca kathaṃ caiva taducyate ॥2॥
slp1: satyaM kiMlakzaRaM rAjankaTaM vA tadavApyate । satyaM prApya BavetkiM ca kaTaM cEva taducyate ॥2॥

text: cāturvarṇyasya dharmāṇāṃ saṅkaro na praśasyate । avikāritamaṃ satyaṃ sarvavarṇeṣu bhārata ॥3॥
html:
cāturvarṇyasya dharmāṇāṃ saṅkaro na praśasyate ।
avikāritamaṃ satyaṃ sarvavarṇeṣu bhārata ॥3॥
slp1: cAturvarRyasya DarmARAM saNkaro na praSasyate । avikAritamaM satyaM sarvavarRezu BArata ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: satyaṃ satsu sadā dharmaḥ satyaṃ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ । satyameva namasyeta satyaṃ hi paramā gatiḥ ॥4॥
html:
satyaṃ satsu sadā dharmaḥ satyaṃ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
satyameva namasyeta satyaṃ hi paramā gatiḥ ॥4॥
slp1: satyaM satsu sadA DarmaH satyaM DarmaH sanAtanaH । satyameva namasyeta satyaM hi paramA gatiH ॥4॥

text: satyaṃ dharmastapo yogaḥ satyaṃ brahma sanātanam । satyaṃ yajñaḥ paraḥ proktaḥ satye sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ॥5॥
html:
satyaṃ dharmastapo yogaḥ satyaṃ brahma sanātanam ।
satyaṃ yajñaḥ paraḥ proktaḥ satye sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ॥5॥
slp1: satyaM Darmastapo yogaH satyaM brahma sanAtanam । satyaM yajYaH paraH proktaH satye sarvaM pratizWitam ॥5॥

text: ācārāniha satyasya yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ । lakṣaṇaṃ ca pravakṣyāmi satyasyeha yathākramam ॥6॥
html:
ācārāniha satyasya yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ ।
lakṣaṇaṃ ca pravakṣyāmi satyasyeha yathākramam ॥6॥
slp1: AcArAniha satyasya yaTAvadanupUrvaSaH । lakzaRaM ca pravakzyAmi satyasyeha yaTAkramam ॥6॥

text: prāpyate hi yathā satyaṃ tacca śrotuṃ tvamarhasi । satyaṃ trayodaśavidhaṃ sarvalokeṣu bhārata ॥7॥
html:
prāpyate hi yathā satyaṃ tacca śrotuṃ tvamarhasi ।
satyaṃ trayodaśavidhaṃ sarvalokeṣu bhārata ॥7॥
slp1: prApyate hi yaTA satyaM tacca SrotuM tvamarhasi । satyaM trayodaSaviDaM sarvalokezu BArata ॥7॥

text: satyaṃ ca samatā caiva damaścaiva na saṃśayaḥ । amātsaryaṃ kṣamā caiva hrīstitikṣānasūyatā ॥8॥
html:
satyaṃ ca samatā caiva damaścaiva na saṃśayaḥ ।
amātsaryaṃ kṣamā caiva hrīstitikṣānasūyatā ॥8॥
slp1: satyaM ca samatA cEva damaScEva na saMSayaH । amAtsaryaM kzamA cEva hrIstitikzAnasUyatA ॥8॥

text: tyāgo dhyānamathāryatvaṃ dhṛtiśca satataṃ sthirā । ahiṃsā caiva rājendra satyākārāstrayodaśa ॥9॥
html:
tyāgo dhyānamathāryatvaṃ dhṛtiśca satataṃ sthirā ।
ahiṃsā caiva rājendra satyākārāstrayodaśa ॥9॥
slp1: tyAgo DyAnamaTAryatvaM DftiSca satataM sTirA । ahiMsA cEva rAjendra satyAkArAstrayodaSa ॥9॥

text: satyaṃ nāmāvyayaṃ nityamavikāri tathaiva ca । sarvadharmāviruddhaṃ ca yogenaitadavāpyate ॥10॥
html:
satyaṃ nāmāvyayaṃ nityamavikāri tathaiva ca ।
sarvadharmāviruddhaṃ ca yogenaitadavāpyate ॥10॥
slp1: satyaM nAmAvyayaM nityamavikAri taTEva ca । sarvaDarmAvirudDaM ca yogenEtadavApyate ॥10॥

text: ātmanīṣṭe tathāniṣṭe ripau ca samatā tathā । icchādveṣakṣayaṃ prāpya kāmakrodhakṣayaṃ tathā ॥11॥
html:
ātmanīṣṭe tathāniṣṭe ripau ca samatā tathā ।
icchādveṣakṣayaṃ prāpya kāmakrodhakṣayaṃ tathā ॥11॥
slp1: AtmanIzwe taTAnizwe ripO ca samatA taTA । icCAdvezakzayaM prApya kAmakroDakzayaM taTA ॥11॥

text: damo nānyaspṛhā nityaṃ dhairyaṃ gāmbhīryameva ca । abhayaṃ krodhaśamanaṃ jñānenaitadavāpyate ॥12॥
html:
damo nānyaspṛhā nityaṃ dhairyaṃ gāmbhīryameva ca ।
abhayaṃ krodhaśamanaṃ jñānenaitadavāpyate ॥12॥
slp1: damo nAnyaspfhA nityaM DEryaM gAmBIryameva ca । aBayaM kroDaSamanaM jYAnenEtadavApyate ॥12॥

text: amātsaryaṃ budhāḥ prāhurdānaṃ dharme ca saṃyamam । avasthitena nityaṃ ca satyenāmatsarī bhavet ॥13॥
html:
amātsaryaṃ budhāḥ prāhurdānaṃ dharme ca saṃyamam ।
avasthitena nityaṃ ca satyenāmatsarī bhavet ॥13॥
slp1: amAtsaryaM buDAH prAhurdAnaM Darme ca saMyamam । avasTitena nityaM ca satyenAmatsarI Bavet ॥13॥

text: akṣamāyāḥ kṣamāyāśca priyāṇīhāpriyāṇi ca । kṣamate sarvataḥ sādhuḥ sādhvāpnoti ca satyavān ॥14॥
html:
akṣamāyāḥ kṣamāyāśca priyāṇīhāpriyāṇi ca ।
kṣamate sarvataḥ sādhuḥ sādhvāpnoti ca satyavān ॥14॥
slp1: akzamAyAH kzamAyASca priyARIhApriyARi ca । kzamate sarvataH sADuH sADvApnoti ca satyavAn ॥14॥

text: kalyāṇaṃ kurute gāḍhaṃ hrīmānna ślāghate kvacit । praśāntavāṅmanā nityaṃ hrīstu dharmādavāpyate ॥15॥
html:
kalyāṇaṃ kurute gāḍhaṃ hrīmānna ślāghate kvacit ।
praśāntavāṅmanā nityaṃ hrīstu dharmādavāpyate ॥15॥
slp1: kalyARaM kurute gAQaM hrImAnna SlAGate kvacit । praSAntavANmanA nityaM hrIstu DarmAdavApyate ॥15॥

text: dharmārthahetoḥ kṣamate titikṣā kṣāntirucyate । lokasaṅgrahaṇārthaṃ tu sā tu dhairyeṇa labhyate ॥16॥
html:
dharmārthahetoḥ kṣamate titikṣā kṣāntirucyate ।
lokasaṅgrahaṇārthaṃ tu sā tu dhairyeṇa labhyate ॥16॥
slp1: DarmArTahetoH kzamate titikzA kzAntirucyate । lokasaNgrahaRArTaM tu sA tu DEryeRa laByate ॥16॥

text: tyāgaḥ snehasya yastyāgo viṣayāṇāṃ tathaiva ca । rāgadveṣaprahīṇasya tyāgo bhavati nānyathā ॥17॥
html:
tyāgaḥ snehasya yastyāgo viṣayāṇāṃ tathaiva ca ।
rāgadveṣaprahīṇasya tyāgo bhavati nānyathā ॥17॥
slp1: tyAgaH snehasya yastyAgo vizayARAM taTEva ca । rAgadvezaprahIRasya tyAgo Bavati nAnyaTA ॥17॥

text: āryatā nāma bhūtānāṃ yaḥ karoti prayatnataḥ । śubhaṃ karma nirākāro vītarāgatvameva ca ॥18॥
html:
āryatā nāma bhūtānāṃ yaḥ karoti prayatnataḥ ।
śubhaṃ karma nirākāro vītarāgatvameva ca ॥18॥
slp1: AryatA nAma BUtAnAM yaH karoti prayatnataH । SuBaM karma nirAkAro vItarAgatvameva ca ॥18॥

text: dhṛtirnāma sukhe duḥkhe yathā nāpnoti vikriyām । tāṃ bhajeta sadā prājño ya icchedbhūtimātmanaḥ ॥19॥
html:
dhṛtirnāma sukhe duḥkhe yathā nāpnoti vikriyām ।
tāṃ bhajeta sadā prājño ya icchedbhūtimātmanaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: DftirnAma suKe duHKe yaTA nApnoti vikriyAm । tAM Bajeta sadA prAjYo ya icCedBUtimAtmanaH ॥19॥

text: sarvathā kṣamiṇā bhāvyaṃ tathā satyapareṇa ca । vītaharṣabhayakrodho dhṛtimāpnoti paṇḍitaḥ ॥20॥
html:
sarvathā kṣamiṇā bhāvyaṃ tathā satyapareṇa ca ।
vītaharṣabhayakrodho dhṛtimāpnoti paṇḍitaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: sarvaTA kzamiRA BAvyaM taTA satyapareRa ca । vItaharzaBayakroDo DftimApnoti paRqitaH ॥20॥

text: adrohaḥ sarvabhūteṣu karmaṇā manasā girā । anugrahaśca dānaṃ ca satāṃ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥21॥
html:
adrohaḥ sarvabhūteṣu karmaṇā manasā girā ।
anugrahaśca dānaṃ ca satāṃ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: adrohaH sarvaBUtezu karmaRA manasA girA । anugrahaSca dAnaM ca satAM DarmaH sanAtanaH ॥21॥

text: ete trayodaśākārāḥ pṛthaksatyaikalakṣaṇāḥ । bhajante satyameveha bṛṃhayanti ca bhārata ॥22॥
html:
ete trayodaśākārāḥ pṛthaksatyaikalakṣaṇāḥ ।
bhajante satyameveha bṛṃhayanti ca bhārata ॥22॥
slp1: ete trayodaSAkArAH pfTaksatyEkalakzaRAH । Bajante satyameveha bfMhayanti ca BArata ॥22॥

text: nāntaḥ śakyo guṇānāṃ hi vaktuṃ satyasya bhārata । ataḥ satyaṃ praśaṃsanti viprāḥ sapitṛdevatāḥ ॥23॥
html:
nāntaḥ śakyo guṇānāṃ hi vaktuṃ satyasya bhārata ।
ataḥ satyaṃ praśaṃsanti viprāḥ sapitṛdevatāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: nAntaH Sakyo guRAnAM hi vaktuM satyasya BArata । ataH satyaM praSaMsanti viprAH sapitfdevatAH ॥23॥

text: nāsti satyātparo dharmo nānṛtātpātakaṃ param । sthitirhi satyaṃ dharmasya tasmātsatyaṃ na lopayet ॥24॥
html:
nāsti satyātparo dharmo nānṛtātpātakaṃ param ।
sthitirhi satyaṃ dharmasya tasmātsatyaṃ na lopayet ॥24॥
slp1: nAsti satyAtparo Darmo nAnftAtpAtakaM param । sTitirhi satyaM Darmasya tasmAtsatyaM na lopayet ॥24॥

text: upaiti satyāddānaṃ hi tathā yajñāḥ sadakṣiṇāḥ । vratāgnihotraṃ vedāśca ye cānye dharmaniścayāḥ ॥25॥
html:
upaiti satyāddānaṃ hi tathā yajñāḥ sadakṣiṇāḥ ।
vratāgnihotraṃ vedāśca ye cānye dharmaniścayāḥ ॥25॥
slp1: upEti satyAddAnaM hi taTA yajYAH sadakziRAH । vratAgnihotraM vedASca ye cAnye DarmaniScayAH ॥25॥

text: aśvamedhasahasraṃ ca satyaṃ ca tulayā dhṛtam । aśvamedhasahasrāddhi satyamevātiricyate] ॥26॥
html:
aśvamedhasahasraṃ ca satyaṃ ca tulayā dhṛtam ।
aśvamedhasahasrāddhi satyamevātiricyate] ॥26॥
slp1: aSvameDasahasraM ca satyaM ca tulayA Dftam । aSvameDasahasrAdDi satyamevAtiricyate] ॥26॥

text: yataḥ prabhavati krodhaḥ kāmaśca bharatarṣabha । śokamohau vivitsā ca parāsutvaṃ tathā madaḥ ॥1॥
html:
yataḥ prabhavati krodhaḥ kāmaśca bharatarṣabha ।
śokamohau vivitsā ca parāsutvaṃ tathā madaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: yataH praBavati kroDaH kAmaSca BaratarzaBa । SokamohO vivitsA ca parAsutvaM taTA madaH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: lobho mātsaryamīrṣyā ca kutsāsūyā kṛpā tathā । etatsarvaṃ mahāprājña yāthātathyena me vada ॥2॥
html:
lobho mātsaryamīrṣyā ca kutsāsūyā kṛpā tathā ।
etatsarvaṃ mahāprājña yāthātathyena me vada ॥2॥
slp1: loBo mAtsaryamIrzyA ca kutsAsUyA kfpA taTA । etatsarvaM mahAprAjYa yATAtaTyena me vada ॥2॥

text: trayodaśaite'tibalāḥ śatravaḥ prāṇināṃ smṛtāḥ । upāsate mahārāja samastāḥ puruṣāniha ॥3॥
html:
trayodaśaite'tibalāḥ śatravaḥ prāṇināṃ smṛtāḥ ।
upāsate mahārāja samastāḥ puruṣāniha ॥3॥
slp1: trayodaSEte'tibalAH SatravaH prARinAM smftAH । upAsate mahArAja samastAH puruzAniha ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ete pramattaṃ puruṣamapramattā nudanti hi । vṛkā iva vilumpanti dṛṣṭvaiva puruṣetarān ॥4॥
html:
ete pramattaṃ puruṣamapramattā nudanti hi ।
vṛkā iva vilumpanti dṛṣṭvaiva puruṣetarān ॥4॥
slp1: ete pramattaM puruzamapramattA nudanti hi । vfkA iva vilumpanti dfzwvEva puruzetarAn ॥4॥

text: ebhyaḥ pravartate duḥkhamebhyaḥ pāpaṃ pravartate । iti martyo vijānīyātsatataṃ bharatarṣabha ॥5॥
html:
ebhyaḥ pravartate duḥkhamebhyaḥ pāpaṃ pravartate ।
iti martyo vijānīyātsatataṃ bharatarṣabha ॥5॥
slp1: eByaH pravartate duHKameByaH pApaM pravartate । iti martyo vijAnIyAtsatataM BaratarzaBa ॥5॥

text: eteṣāmudayaṃ sthānaṃ kṣayaṃ ca puruṣottama । hanta te vartayiṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ॥6॥
html:
eteṣāmudayaṃ sthānaṃ kṣayaṃ ca puruṣottama ।
hanta te vartayiṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ॥6॥
slp1: etezAmudayaM sTAnaM kzayaM ca puruzottama । hanta te vartayizyAmi tanme nigadataH SfRu ॥6॥

text: lobhātkrodhaḥ prabhavati paradoṣairudīryate । kṣamayā tiṣṭhate rājañśrīmāṃśca vinivartate ॥7॥
html:
lobhātkrodhaḥ prabhavati paradoṣairudīryate ।
kṣamayā tiṣṭhate rājañśrīmāṃśca vinivartate ॥7॥
slp1: loBAtkroDaH praBavati paradozErudIryate । kzamayA tizWate rAjaYSrImAMSca vinivartate ॥7॥

text: saṅkalpājjāyate kāmaḥ sevyamāno vivardhate । avadyadarśanādvyeti tattvajñānācca dhīmatām ॥8॥
html:
saṅkalpājjāyate kāmaḥ sevyamāno vivardhate ।
avadyadarśanādvyeti tattvajñānācca dhīmatām ॥8॥
slp1: saNkalpAjjAyate kAmaH sevyamAno vivarDate । avadyadarSanAdvyeti tattvajYAnAcca DImatAm ॥8॥

text: viruddhāni hi śāstrāṇi paśyantīhālpabuddhayaḥ । vivitsā jāyate tatra tattvajñānānnivartate ॥9॥
html:
viruddhāni hi śāstrāṇi paśyantīhālpabuddhayaḥ ।
vivitsā jāyate tatra tattvajñānānnivartate ॥9॥
slp1: virudDAni hi SAstrARi paSyantIhAlpabudDayaH । vivitsA jAyate tatra tattvajYAnAnnivartate ॥9॥

text: prīteḥ śokaḥ prabhavati viyogāttasya dehinaḥ । yadā nirarthakaṃ vetti tadā sadyaḥ praṇaśyati ॥10॥
html:
prīteḥ śokaḥ prabhavati viyogāttasya dehinaḥ ।
yadā nirarthakaṃ vetti tadā sadyaḥ praṇaśyati ॥10॥
slp1: prIteH SokaH praBavati viyogAttasya dehinaH । yadA nirarTakaM vetti tadA sadyaH praRaSyati ॥10॥

text: parāsutā krodhalobhādabhyāsācca pravartate । dayayā sarvabhūtānāṃ nirvedātsā nivartate ॥11॥
html:
parāsutā krodhalobhādabhyāsācca pravartate ।
dayayā sarvabhūtānāṃ nirvedātsā nivartate ॥11॥
slp1: parAsutA kroDaloBAdaByAsAcca pravartate । dayayA sarvaBUtAnAM nirvedAtsA nivartate ॥11॥

text: sattvatyāgāttu mātsaryamahitāni ca sevate । etattu kṣīyate tāta sādhūnāmupasevanāt ॥12॥
html:
sattvatyāgāttu mātsaryamahitāni ca sevate ।
etattu kṣīyate tāta sādhūnāmupasevanāt ॥12॥
slp1: sattvatyAgAttu mAtsaryamahitAni ca sevate । etattu kzIyate tAta sADUnAmupasevanAt ॥12॥

text: kulājjñānāttathaiśvaryānmado bhavati dehinām । ebhireva tu vijñātairmadaḥ sadyaḥ praṇaśyati ॥13॥
html:
kulājjñānāttathaiśvaryānmado bhavati dehinām ।
ebhireva tu vijñātairmadaḥ sadyaḥ praṇaśyati ॥13॥
slp1: kulAjjYAnAttaTESvaryAnmado Bavati dehinAm । eBireva tu vijYAtErmadaH sadyaH praRaSyati ॥13॥

text: īrṣyā kāmātprabhavati saṅgharṣāccaiva bhārata । itareṣāṃ tu martyānāṃ prajñayā sā praṇaśyati ॥14॥
html:
īrṣyā kāmātprabhavati saṅgharṣāccaiva bhārata ।
itareṣāṃ tu martyānāṃ prajñayā sā praṇaśyati ॥14॥
slp1: IrzyA kAmAtpraBavati saNGarzAccEva BArata । itarezAM tu martyAnAM prajYayA sA praRaSyati ॥14॥

text: vibhramāllokabāhyānāṃ dveṣyairvākyairasaṅgataiḥ । kutsā sañjāyate rājannupekṣābhiḥ praśāmyati ॥15॥
html:
vibhramāllokabāhyānāṃ dveṣyairvākyairasaṅgataiḥ ।
kutsā sañjāyate rājannupekṣābhiḥ praśāmyati ॥15॥
slp1: viBramAllokabAhyAnAM dvezyErvAkyErasaNgatEH । kutsA saYjAyate rAjannupekzABiH praSAmyati ॥15॥

text: pratikartumaśakyāya balasthāyāpakāriṇe । asūyā jāyate tīvrā kāruṇyādvinivartate ॥16॥
html:
pratikartumaśakyāya balasthāyāpakāriṇe ।
asūyā jāyate tīvrā kāruṇyādvinivartate ॥16॥
slp1: pratikartumaSakyAya balasTAyApakAriRe । asUyA jAyate tIvrA kAruRyAdvinivartate ॥16॥

text: kṛpaṇānsatataṃ dṛṣṭvā tataḥ sañjāyate kṛpā । dharmaniṣṭhāṃ yadā vetti tadā śāmyati sā kṛpā ॥17॥
html:
kṛpaṇānsatataṃ dṛṣṭvā tataḥ sañjāyate kṛpā ।
dharmaniṣṭhāṃ yadā vetti tadā śāmyati sā kṛpā ॥17॥
slp1: kfpaRAnsatataM dfzwvA tataH saYjAyate kfpA । DarmanizWAM yadA vetti tadA SAmyati sA kfpA ॥17॥

text: etānyeva jitānyāhuḥ praśamācca trayodaśa । ete hi dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ sarve doṣāstrayodaśa । tvayā sarvātmanā nityaṃ vijitā jeṣyase ca tān] ॥18॥
html:
etānyeva jitānyāhuḥ praśamācca trayodaśa ।
ete hi dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ sarve doṣāstrayodaśa ।
tvayā sarvātmanā nityaṃ vijitā jeṣyase ca tān] ॥18॥
slp1: etAnyeva jitAnyAhuH praSamAcca trayodaSa । ete hi DArtarAzwrARAM sarve dozAstrayodaSa । tvayA sarvAtmanA nityaM vijitA jezyase ca tAn] ॥18॥

text: ānṛśaṃsyaṃ vijānāmi darśanena satāṃ sadā । nṛśaṃsānna vijānāmi teṣāṃ karma ca bhārata ॥1॥
html:
ānṛśaṃsyaṃ vijānāmi darśanena satāṃ sadā ।
nṛśaṃsānna vijānāmi teṣāṃ karma ca bhārata ॥1॥
slp1: AnfSaMsyaM vijAnAmi darSanena satAM sadA । nfSaMsAnna vijAnAmi tezAM karma ca BArata ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kaṇṭakānkūpamagniṃ ca varjayanti yathā narāḥ । tathā nṛśaṃsakarmāṇaṃ varjayanti narā naram ॥2॥
html:
kaṇṭakānkūpamagniṃ ca varjayanti yathā narāḥ ।
tathā nṛśaṃsakarmāṇaṃ varjayanti narā naram ॥2॥
slp1: kaRwakAnkUpamagniM ca varjayanti yaTA narAH । taTA nfSaMsakarmARaM varjayanti narA naram ॥2॥

text: nṛśaṃso hyadhamo nityaṃ pretya ceha ca bhārata । tasmādbravīhi kauravya tasya dharmaviniścayam ॥3॥
html:
nṛśaṃso hyadhamo nityaṃ pretya ceha ca bhārata ।
tasmādbravīhi kauravya tasya dharmaviniścayam ॥3॥
slp1: nfSaMso hyaDamo nityaM pretya ceha ca BArata । tasmAdbravIhi kOravya tasya DarmaviniScayam ॥3॥

text: spṛhāsyāntarhitā caiva viditārthā ca karmaṇā । ākroṣṭā kruśyate caiva bandhitā badhyate ca yaḥ ॥4॥
html:
spṛhāsyāntarhitā caiva viditārthā ca karmaṇā ।
ākroṣṭā kruśyate caiva bandhitā badhyate ca yaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: spfhAsyAntarhitA cEva viditArTA ca karmaRA । AkrozwA kruSyate cEva banDitA baDyate ca yaH ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dattānukīrtirviṣamaḥ kṣudro naikṛtikaḥ śaṭhaḥ । asambhogī ca mānī ca tathā saṅgī vikatthanaḥ ॥5॥
html:
dattānukīrtirviṣamaḥ kṣudro naikṛtikaḥ śaṭhaḥ ।
asambhogī ca mānī ca tathā saṅgī vikatthanaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: dattAnukIrtirvizamaH kzudro nEkftikaH SaWaH । asamBogI ca mAnI ca taTA saNgI vikatTanaH ॥5॥

text: sarvātiśaṅkī paruṣo bāliśaḥ kṛpaṇastathā । vargapraśaṃsī satatamāśramadveṣasaṅkarī ॥6॥
html:
sarvātiśaṅkī paruṣo bāliśaḥ kṛpaṇastathā ।
vargapraśaṃsī satatamāśramadveṣasaṅkarī ॥6॥
slp1: sarvAtiSaNkI paruzo bAliSaH kfpaRastaTA । vargapraSaMsI satatamASramadvezasaNkarI ॥6॥

text: hiṃsāvihārī satatamaviśeṣaguṇāguṇaḥ । bahvalīko manasvī ca lubdho'tyarthaṃ nṛśaṃsakṛt ॥7॥
html:
hiṃsāvihārī satatamaviśeṣaguṇāguṇaḥ ।
bahvalīko manasvī ca lubdho'tyarthaṃ nṛśaṃsakṛt ॥7॥
slp1: hiMsAvihArI satatamaviSezaguRAguRaH । bahvalIko manasvI ca lubDo'tyarTaM nfSaMsakft ॥7॥

text: dharmaśīlaṃ guṇopetaṃ pāpa ityavagacchati । ātmaśīlānumānena na viśvasiti kasyacit ॥8॥
html:
dharmaśīlaṃ guṇopetaṃ pāpa ityavagacchati ।
ātmaśīlānumānena na viśvasiti kasyacit ॥8॥
slp1: DarmaSIlaM guRopetaM pApa ityavagacCati । AtmaSIlAnumAnena na viSvasiti kasyacit ॥8॥

text: pareṣāṃ yatra doṣaḥ syāttadguhyaṃ samprakāśayet । samāneṣveva doṣeṣu vṛttyarthamupaghātayet ॥9॥
html:
pareṣāṃ yatra doṣaḥ syāttadguhyaṃ samprakāśayet ।
samāneṣveva doṣeṣu vṛttyarthamupaghātayet ॥9॥
slp1: parezAM yatra dozaH syAttadguhyaM samprakASayet । samAnezveva dozezu vfttyarTamupaGAtayet ॥9॥

text: tathopakāriṇaṃ caiva manyate vañcitaṃ param । dattvāpi ca dhanaṃ kāle santapatyupakāriṇe ॥10॥
html:
tathopakāriṇaṃ caiva manyate vañcitaṃ param ।
dattvāpi ca dhanaṃ kāle santapatyupakāriṇe ॥10॥
slp1: taTopakAriRaM cEva manyate vaYcitaM param । dattvApi ca DanaM kAle santapatyupakAriRe ॥10॥

text: bhakṣyaṃ bhojyamatho lehyaṃ yaccānyatsādhu bhojanam । prekṣamāṇeṣu yo'śnīyānnṛśaṃsa iti taṃ viduḥ ॥11॥
html:
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyamatho lehyaṃ yaccānyatsādhu bhojanam ।
prekṣamāṇeṣu yo'śnīyānnṛśaṃsa iti taṃ viduḥ ॥11॥
slp1: BakzyaM BojyamaTo lehyaM yaccAnyatsADu Bojanam । prekzamARezu yo'SnIyAnnfSaMsa iti taM viduH ॥11॥

text: brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāyāgraṃ yaḥ suhṛdbhiḥ sahāśnute । sa pretya labhate svargamiha cānantyamaśnute ॥12॥
html:
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāyāgraṃ yaḥ suhṛdbhiḥ sahāśnute ।
sa pretya labhate svargamiha cānantyamaśnute ॥12॥
slp1: brAhmaReByaH pradAyAgraM yaH suhfdBiH sahASnute । sa pretya laBate svargamiha cAnantyamaSnute ॥12॥

text: eṣa te bharataśreṣṭha nṛśaṃsaḥ parikīrtitaḥ । sadā vivarjanīyo vai puruṣeṇa bubhūṣatā] ॥13॥
html:
eṣa te bharataśreṣṭha nṛśaṃsaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ।
sadā vivarjanīyo vai puruṣeṇa bubhūṣatā] ॥13॥
slp1: eza te BarataSrezWa nfSaMsaH parikIrtitaH । sadA vivarjanIyo vE puruzeRa buBUzatA] ॥13॥

text: kṛtārtho yakṣyamāṇaśca sarvavedāntagaśca yaḥ । ācāryapitṛbhāryārthaṃ svādhyāyārthamathāpi vā ॥1॥
html:
kṛtārtho yakṣyamāṇaśca sarvavedāntagaśca yaḥ ।
ācāryapitṛbhāryārthaṃ svādhyāyārthamathāpi vā ॥1॥
slp1: kftArTo yakzyamARaSca sarvavedAntagaSca yaH । AcAryapitfBAryArTaM svADyAyArTamaTApi vA ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ete vai sādhavo dṛṣṭā brāhmaṇā dharmabhikṣavaḥ । asvebhyo deyametebhyo dānaṃ vidyāviśeṣataḥ ॥2॥
html:
ete vai sādhavo dṛṣṭā brāhmaṇā dharmabhikṣavaḥ ।
asvebhyo deyametebhyo dānaṃ vidyāviśeṣataḥ ॥2॥
slp1: ete vE sADavo dfzwA brAhmaRA DarmaBikzavaH । asveByo deyameteByo dAnaM vidyAviSezataH ॥2॥

text: anyatra dakṣiṇā yā tu deyā bharatasattama । anyebhyo hi bahirvedyāṃ nākṛtānnaṃ vidhīyate ॥3॥
html:
anyatra dakṣiṇā yā tu deyā bharatasattama ।
anyebhyo hi bahirvedyāṃ nākṛtānnaṃ vidhīyate ॥3॥
slp1: anyatra dakziRA yA tu deyA Baratasattama । anyeByo hi bahirvedyAM nAkftAnnaM viDIyate ॥3॥

text: sarvaratnāni rājā ca yathārhaṃ pratipādayet । brāhmaṇāścaiva yajñāśca sahānnāḥ sahadakṣiṇāḥ ॥4॥
html:
sarvaratnāni rājā ca yathārhaṃ pratipādayet ।
brāhmaṇāścaiva yajñāśca sahānnāḥ sahadakṣiṇāḥ ॥4॥
slp1: sarvaratnAni rAjA ca yaTArhaM pratipAdayet । brAhmaRAScEva yajYASca sahAnnAH sahadakziRAH ॥4॥

text: yasya traivārṣikaṃ bhaktaṃ paryāptaṃ bhṛtyavṛttaye । adhikaṃ vāpi vidyeta sa somaṃ pātumarhati ॥5॥
html:
yasya traivārṣikaṃ bhaktaṃ paryāptaṃ bhṛtyavṛttaye ।
adhikaṃ vāpi vidyeta sa somaṃ pātumarhati ॥5॥
slp1: yasya trEvArzikaM BaktaM paryAptaM Bftyavfttaye । aDikaM vApi vidyeta sa somaM pAtumarhati ॥5॥

text: yajñaścetpratividdhaḥ syādaṅgenaikena yajvanaḥ । brāhmaṇasya viśeṣeṇa dhārmike sati rājani ॥6॥
html:
yajñaścetpratividdhaḥ syādaṅgenaikena yajvanaḥ ।
brāhmaṇasya viśeṣeṇa dhārmike sati rājani ॥6॥
slp1: yajYaScetpratividDaH syAdaNgenEkena yajvanaH । brAhmaRasya viSezeRa DArmike sati rAjani ॥6॥

text: yo vaiśyaḥ syādbahupaśurhīnakraturasomapaḥ । kuṭumbāttasya taddravyaṃ yajñārthaṃ pārthivo haret ॥7॥
html:
yo vaiśyaḥ syādbahupaśurhīnakraturasomapaḥ ।
kuṭumbāttasya taddravyaṃ yajñārthaṃ pārthivo haret ॥7॥
slp1: yo vESyaH syAdbahupaSurhInakraturasomapaH । kuwumbAttasya taddravyaM yajYArTaM pArTivo haret ॥7॥

text: āharedveśmataḥ kiñcitkāmaṃ śūdrasya dravyataḥ । na hi veśmani śūdrasya kaścidasti parigrahaḥ ॥8॥
html:
āharedveśmataḥ kiñcitkāmaṃ śūdrasya dravyataḥ ।
na hi veśmani śūdrasya kaścidasti parigrahaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: AharedveSmataH kiYcitkAmaM SUdrasya dravyataH । na hi veSmani SUdrasya kaScidasti parigrahaH ॥8॥

text: yo'nāhitāgniḥ śatagurayajvā ca sahasraguḥ । tayorapi kuṭumbābhyāmāharedavicārayan ॥9॥
html:
yo'nāhitāgniḥ śatagurayajvā ca sahasraguḥ ।
tayorapi kuṭumbābhyāmāharedavicārayan ॥9॥
slp1: yo'nAhitAgniH SatagurayajvA ca sahasraguH । tayorapi kuwumbAByAmAharedavicArayan ॥9॥

text: adātṛbhyo harennityaṃ vyākhyāpya nṛpatiḥ prabho । tathā hyācarato dharmo nṛpateḥ syādathākhilaḥ ॥10॥
html:
adātṛbhyo harennityaṃ vyākhyāpya nṛpatiḥ prabho ।
tathā hyācarato dharmo nṛpateḥ syādathākhilaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: adAtfByo harennityaM vyAKyApya nfpatiH praBo । taTA hyAcarato Darmo nfpateH syAdaTAKilaH ॥10॥

text: tathaiva saptame bhakte bhaktāni ṣaḍanaśnatā । aśvastanavidhānena hartavyaṃ hīnakarmaṇaḥ । khalātkṣetrāttathāgārādyato vāpyupapadyate ॥11॥
html:
tathaiva saptame bhakte bhaktāni ṣaḍanaśnatā ।
aśvastanavidhānena hartavyaṃ hīnakarmaṇaḥ ।
khalātkṣetrāttathāgārādyato vāpyupapadyate ॥11॥
slp1: taTEva saptame Bakte BaktAni zaqanaSnatA । aSvastanaviDAnena hartavyaM hInakarmaRaH । KalAtkzetrAttaTAgArAdyato vApyupapadyate ॥11॥

text: ākhyātavyaṃ nṛpasyaitatpṛcchato'pṛcchato'pi vā । na tasmai dhārayeddaṇḍaṃ rājā dharmeṇa dharmavit ॥12॥
html:
ākhyātavyaṃ nṛpasyaitatpṛcchato'pṛcchato'pi vā ।
na tasmai dhārayeddaṇḍaṃ rājā dharmeṇa dharmavit ॥12॥
slp1: AKyAtavyaM nfpasyEtatpfcCato'pfcCato'pi vA । na tasmE DArayeddaRqaM rAjA DarmeRa Darmavit ॥12॥

text: kṣatriyasya hi bāliśyādbrāhmaṇaḥ kliśyate kṣudhā । śrutaśīle samājñāya vṛttimasya prakalpayet । athainaṃ parirakṣeta pitā putramivaurasam ॥13॥
html:
kṣatriyasya hi bāliśyādbrāhmaṇaḥ kliśyate kṣudhā ।
śrutaśīle samājñāya vṛttimasya prakalpayet ।
athainaṃ parirakṣeta pitā putramivaurasam ॥13॥
slp1: kzatriyasya hi bAliSyAdbrAhmaRaH kliSyate kzuDA । SrutaSIle samAjYAya vfttimasya prakalpayet । aTEnaM parirakzeta pitA putramivOrasam ॥13॥

text: iṣṭiṃ vaiśvānarīṃ nityaṃ nirvapedabdaparyaye । avikalpaḥ purādharmo dharmavādaistu kevalam ॥14॥
html:
iṣṭiṃ vaiśvānarīṃ nityaṃ nirvapedabdaparyaye ।
avikalpaḥ purādharmo dharmavādaistu kevalam ॥14॥
slp1: izwiM vESvAnarIM nityaM nirvapedabdaparyaye । avikalpaH purADarmo DarmavAdEstu kevalam ॥14॥

text: viśvaistu devaiḥ sādhyaiśca brāhmaṇaiśca maharṣibhiḥ । āpatsu maraṇādbhītairliṅgapratinidhiḥ kṛtaḥ ॥15॥
html:
viśvaistu devaiḥ sādhyaiśca brāhmaṇaiśca maharṣibhiḥ ।
āpatsu maraṇādbhītairliṅgapratinidhiḥ kṛtaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: viSvEstu devEH sADyESca brAhmaRESca maharziBiH । Apatsu maraRAdBItErliNgapratiniDiH kftaH ॥15॥

text: prabhuḥ prathamakalpasya yo'nukalpena vartate । na sāmparāyikaṃ tasya durmatervidyate phalam ॥16॥
html:
prabhuḥ prathamakalpasya yo'nukalpena vartate ।
na sāmparāyikaṃ tasya durmatervidyate phalam ॥16॥
slp1: praBuH praTamakalpasya yo'nukalpena vartate । na sAmparAyikaM tasya durmatervidyate Palam ॥16॥

text: na brāhmaṇānvedayeta kaścidrājani mānavaḥ । avīryo vedanādvidyātsuvīryo vīryavattaram ॥17॥
html:
na brāhmaṇānvedayeta kaścidrājani mānavaḥ ।
avīryo vedanādvidyātsuvīryo vīryavattaram ॥17॥
slp1: na brAhmaRAnvedayeta kaScidrAjani mAnavaH । avIryo vedanAdvidyAtsuvIryo vIryavattaram ॥17॥

text: tasmādrājñā sadā tejo duḥsahaṃ brahmavādinām । mantā śāstā vidhātā ca brāhmaṇo deva ucyate । tasminnākuśalaṃ brūyānna śuktāmīrayedgiram ॥18॥
html:
tasmādrājñā sadā tejo duḥsahaṃ brahmavādinām ।
mantā śāstā vidhātā ca brāhmaṇo deva ucyate ।
tasminnākuśalaṃ brūyānna śuktāmīrayedgiram ॥18॥
slp1: tasmAdrAjYA sadA tejo duHsahaM brahmavAdinAm । mantA SAstA viDAtA ca brAhmaRo deva ucyate । tasminnAkuSalaM brUyAnna SuktAmIrayedgiram ॥18॥

text: kṣatriyo bāhuvīryeṇa taratyāpadamātmanaḥ । dhanena vaiśyaḥ śūdraśca mantrairhomaiśca vai dvijaḥ ॥19॥
html:
kṣatriyo bāhuvīryeṇa taratyāpadamātmanaḥ ।
dhanena vaiśyaḥ śūdraśca mantrairhomaiśca vai dvijaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: kzatriyo bAhuvIryeRa taratyApadamAtmanaH । Danena vESyaH SUdraSca mantrErhomESca vE dvijaH ॥19॥

text: na vai kanyā na yuvatirnāmantro na ca bāliśaḥ । pariveṣṭāgnihotrasya bhavennāsaṃskṛtastathā । narake nipatantyete juhvānāḥ sa ca yasya tat ॥20॥
html:
na vai kanyā na yuvatirnāmantro na ca bāliśaḥ ।
pariveṣṭāgnihotrasya bhavennāsaṃskṛtastathā ।
narake nipatantyete juhvānāḥ sa ca yasya tat ॥20॥
slp1: na vE kanyA na yuvatirnAmantro na ca bAliSaH । parivezwAgnihotrasya BavennAsaMskftastaTA । narake nipatantyete juhvAnAH sa ca yasya tat ॥20॥

text: prājāpatyamadattvāśvamagnyādheyasya dakṣiṇām । anāhitāgniriti sa procyate dharmadarśibhiḥ ॥21॥
html:
prājāpatyamadattvāśvamagnyādheyasya dakṣiṇām ।
anāhitāgniriti sa procyate dharmadarśibhiḥ ॥21॥
slp1: prAjApatyamadattvASvamagnyADeyasya dakziRAm । anAhitAgniriti sa procyate DarmadarSiBiH ॥21॥

text: puṇyānyanyāni kurvīta śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ । anāptadakṣiṇairyajñairna yajeta kathañcana ॥22॥
html:
puṇyānyanyāni kurvīta śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ ।
anāptadakṣiṇairyajñairna yajeta kathañcana ॥22॥
slp1: puRyAnyanyAni kurvIta SraddaDAno jitendriyaH । anAptadakziREryajYErna yajeta kaTaYcana ॥22॥

text: prajāḥ paśūṃśca svargaṃ ca hanti yajño hyadakṣiṇaḥ । indriyāṇi yaśaḥ kīrtimāyuścāsyopakṛntati ॥23॥
html:
prajāḥ paśūṃśca svargaṃ ca hanti yajño hyadakṣiṇaḥ ।
indriyāṇi yaśaḥ kīrtimāyuścāsyopakṛntati ॥23॥
slp1: prajAH paSUMSca svargaM ca hanti yajYo hyadakziRaH । indriyARi yaSaH kIrtimAyuScAsyopakfntati ॥23॥

text: udakyā hyāsate ye ca ye ca kecidanagnayaḥ । kulaṃ cāśrotriyaṃ yeṣāṃ sarve te śūdradharmiṇaḥ ॥24॥
html:
udakyā hyāsate ye ca ye ca kecidanagnayaḥ ।
kulaṃ cāśrotriyaṃ yeṣāṃ sarve te śūdradharmiṇaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: udakyA hyAsate ye ca ye ca kecidanagnayaH । kulaM cASrotriyaM yezAM sarve te SUdraDarmiRaH ॥24॥

text: udapānodake grāme brāhmaṇo vṛṣalīpatiḥ । uṣitvā dvādaśa samāḥ śūdrakarmeha gacchati ॥25॥
html:
udapānodake grāme brāhmaṇo vṛṣalīpatiḥ ।
uṣitvā dvādaśa samāḥ śūdrakarmeha gacchati ॥25॥
slp1: udapAnodake grAme brAhmaRo vfzalIpatiH । uzitvA dvAdaSa samAH SUdrakarmeha gacCati ॥25॥

text: anāryāṃ śayane bibhradujjhanbibhracca yo dvijām । abrāhmaṇo manyamānastṛṇeṣvāsīta pṛṣṭhataḥ । tathā sa śudhyate rājañśṛṇu cātra vaco mama ॥26॥
html:
anāryāṃ śayane bibhradujjhanbibhracca yo dvijām ।
abrāhmaṇo manyamānastṛṇeṣvāsīta pṛṣṭhataḥ ।
tathā sa śudhyate rājañśṛṇu cātra vaco mama ॥26॥
slp1: anAryAM Sayane biBradujJanbiBracca yo dvijAm । abrAhmaRo manyamAnastfRezvAsIta pfzWataH । taTA sa SuDyate rAjaYSfRu cAtra vaco mama ॥26॥

text: yadekarātreṇa karoti pāpaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ varṇaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ sevamānaḥ । sthānāsanābhyāṃ vicaranvratī saṃstribhirvarṣaiḥ śamayedātmapāpam ॥27॥
html:
yadekarātreṇa karoti pāpaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ varṇaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ sevamānaḥ ।
sthānāsanābhyāṃ vicaranvratī saṃstribhirvarṣaiḥ śamayedātmapāpam ॥27॥
slp1: yadekarAtreRa karoti pApaM kfzRaM varRaM brAhmaRaH sevamAnaH । sTAnAsanAByAM vicaranvratI saMstriBirvarzEH SamayedAtmapApam ॥27॥

text: na narmayuktaṃ vacanaṃ hinasti na strīṣu rājanna vivāhakāle । na gurvarthe nātmano jīvitārthe pañcānṛtānyāhurapātakāni ॥28॥
html:
na narmayuktaṃ vacanaṃ hinasti na strīṣu rājanna vivāhakāle ।
na gurvarthe nātmano jīvitārthe pañcānṛtānyāhurapātakāni ॥28॥
slp1: na narmayuktaM vacanaM hinasti na strIzu rAjanna vivAhakAle । na gurvarTe nAtmano jIvitArTe paYcAnftAnyAhurapAtakAni ॥28॥

text: śraddadhānaḥ śubhāṃ vidyāṃ hīnādapi samācaret । suvarṇamapi cāmedhyādādadīteti dhāraṇā ॥29॥
html:
śraddadhānaḥ śubhāṃ vidyāṃ hīnādapi samācaret ।
suvarṇamapi cāmedhyādādadīteti dhāraṇā ॥29॥
slp1: SraddaDAnaH SuBAM vidyAM hInAdapi samAcaret । suvarRamapi cAmeDyAdAdadIteti DAraRA ॥29॥

text: strīratnaṃ duṣkulāccāpi viṣādapyamṛtaṃ pibet । aduṣṭā hi striyo ratnamāpa ityeva dharmataḥ ॥30॥
html:
strīratnaṃ duṣkulāccāpi viṣādapyamṛtaṃ pibet ।
aduṣṭā hi striyo ratnamāpa ityeva dharmataḥ ॥30॥
slp1: strIratnaM duzkulAccApi vizAdapyamftaM pibet । aduzwA hi striyo ratnamApa ityeva DarmataH ॥30॥

text: gobrāhmaṇahitārthaṃ ca varṇānāṃ saṅkareṣu ca । gṛhṇīyāttu dhanurvaiśyaḥ paritrāṇāya cātmanaḥ ॥31॥
html:
gobrāhmaṇahitārthaṃ ca varṇānāṃ saṅkareṣu ca ।
gṛhṇīyāttu dhanurvaiśyaḥ paritrāṇāya cātmanaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: gobrAhmaRahitArTaM ca varRAnAM saNkarezu ca । gfhRIyAttu DanurvESyaH paritrARAya cAtmanaH ॥31॥

text: surāpānaṃ brahmahatyā gurutalpamathāpi vā । anirdeśyāni manyante prāṇāntānīti dhāraṇā ॥32॥
html:
surāpānaṃ brahmahatyā gurutalpamathāpi vā ।
anirdeśyāni manyante prāṇāntānīti dhāraṇā ॥32॥
slp1: surApAnaM brahmahatyA gurutalpamaTApi vA । anirdeSyAni manyante prARAntAnIti DAraRA ॥32॥

text: suvarṇaharaṇaṃ stainyaṃ viprāsaṅgaśca pātakam । viharanmadyapānaṃ cāpyagamyāgamanaṃ tathā ॥33॥
html:
suvarṇaharaṇaṃ stainyaṃ viprāsaṅgaśca pātakam ।
viharanmadyapānaṃ cāpyagamyāgamanaṃ tathā ॥33॥
slp1: suvarRaharaRaM stEnyaM viprAsaNgaSca pAtakam । viharanmadyapAnaM cApyagamyAgamanaM taTA ॥33॥

text: patitaiḥ samprayogācca brāhmaṇairyonitastathā । acireṇa mahārāja tādṛśo vai bhavatyuta ॥34॥
html:
patitaiḥ samprayogācca brāhmaṇairyonitastathā ।
acireṇa mahārāja tādṛśo vai bhavatyuta ॥34॥
slp1: patitEH samprayogAcca brAhmaREryonitastaTA । acireRa mahArAja tAdfSo vE Bavatyuta ॥34॥

text: saṃvatsareṇa patati patitena sahācaran । yājanādhyāpanādyaunānna tu yānāsanāśanāt ॥35॥
html:
saṃvatsareṇa patati patitena sahācaran ।
yājanādhyāpanādyaunānna tu yānāsanāśanāt ॥35॥
slp1: saMvatsareRa patati patitena sahAcaran । yAjanADyApanAdyOnAnna tu yAnAsanASanAt ॥35॥

text: etāni ca tato'nyāni nirdeśyānīti dhāraṇā । nirdeśyakena vidhinā kālenāvyasanī bhavet ॥36॥
html:
etāni ca tato'nyāni nirdeśyānīti dhāraṇā ।
nirdeśyakena vidhinā kālenāvyasanī bhavet ॥36॥
slp1: etAni ca tato'nyAni nirdeSyAnIti DAraRA । nirdeSyakena viDinA kAlenAvyasanI Bavet ॥36॥

text: annaṃ tiryaṅna hotavyaṃ pretakarmaṇyapātite । triṣu tveteṣu pūrveṣu na kurvīta vicāraṇām ॥37॥
html:
annaṃ tiryaṅna hotavyaṃ pretakarmaṇyapātite ।
triṣu tveteṣu pūrveṣu na kurvīta vicāraṇām ॥37॥
slp1: annaM tiryaNna hotavyaM pretakarmaRyapAtite । trizu tvetezu pUrvezu na kurvIta vicAraRAm ॥37॥

text: amātyānvā gurūnvāpi jahyāddharmeṇa dhārmikaḥ । prāyaścittamakurvāṇairnaitairarhati saṃvidam ॥38॥
html:
amātyānvā gurūnvāpi jahyāddharmeṇa dhārmikaḥ ।
prāyaścittamakurvāṇairnaitairarhati saṃvidam ॥38॥
slp1: amAtyAnvA gurUnvApi jahyAdDarmeRa DArmikaH । prAyaScittamakurvARErnEtErarhati saMvidam ॥38॥

text: adharmakārī dharmeṇa tapasā hanti kilbiṣam । bruvanstena iti stenaṃ tāvatprāpnoti kilbiṣam । astenaṃ stena ityuktvā dviguṇaṃ pāpamāpnuyāt ॥39॥
html:
adharmakārī dharmeṇa tapasā hanti kilbiṣam ।
bruvanstena iti stenaṃ tāvatprāpnoti kilbiṣam ।
astenaṃ stena ityuktvā dviguṇaṃ pāpamāpnuyāt ॥39॥
slp1: aDarmakArI DarmeRa tapasA hanti kilbizam । bruvanstena iti stenaM tAvatprApnoti kilbizam । astenaM stena ityuktvA dviguRaM pApamApnuyAt ॥39॥

text: tribhāgaṃ brahmahatyāyāḥ kanyā prāpnoti duṣyatī । yastu dūṣayitā tasyāḥ śeṣaṃ prāpnoti kilbiṣam ॥40॥
html:
tribhāgaṃ brahmahatyāyāḥ kanyā prāpnoti duṣyatī ।
yastu dūṣayitā tasyāḥ śeṣaṃ prāpnoti kilbiṣam ॥40॥
slp1: triBAgaM brahmahatyAyAH kanyA prApnoti duzyatI । yastu dUzayitA tasyAH SezaM prApnoti kilbizam ॥40॥

text: brāhmaṇāyāvagūryeha spṛṣṭvā gurutaraṃ bhavet । varṣāṇāṃ hi śataṃ pāpaḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ nādhigacchati ॥41॥
html:
brāhmaṇāyāvagūryeha spṛṣṭvā gurutaraṃ bhavet ।
varṣāṇāṃ hi śataṃ pāpaḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ nādhigacchati ॥41॥
slp1: brAhmaRAyAvagUryeha spfzwvA gurutaraM Bavet । varzARAM hi SataM pApaH pratizWAM nADigacCati ॥41॥

text: sahasraṃ tveva varṣāṇāṃ nipātya narake vaset । tasmānnaivāvagūryāddhi naiva jātu nipātayet ॥42॥
html:
sahasraṃ tveva varṣāṇāṃ nipātya narake vaset ।
tasmānnaivāvagūryāddhi naiva jātu nipātayet ॥42॥
slp1: sahasraM tveva varzARAM nipAtya narake vaset । tasmAnnEvAvagUryAdDi nEva jAtu nipAtayet ॥42॥

text: śoṇitaṃ yāvataḥ pāṃsūnsaṅgṛhṇīyāddvijakṣatāt । tāvatīḥ sa samā rājannarake parivartate ॥43॥
html:
śoṇitaṃ yāvataḥ pāṃsūnsaṅgṛhṇīyāddvijakṣatāt ।
tāvatīḥ sa samā rājannarake parivartate ॥43॥
slp1: SoRitaM yAvataH pAMsUnsaNgfhRIyAddvijakzatAt । tAvatIH sa samA rAjannarake parivartate ॥43॥

text: bhrūṇahāhavamadhye tu śudhyate śastrapātitaḥ । ātmānaṃ juhuyādvahnau samiddhe tena śudhyati ॥44॥
html:
bhrūṇahāhavamadhye tu śudhyate śastrapātitaḥ ।
ātmānaṃ juhuyādvahnau samiddhe tena śudhyati ॥44॥
slp1: BrURahAhavamaDye tu SuDyate SastrapAtitaH । AtmAnaM juhuyAdvahnO samidDe tena SuDyati ॥44॥

text: surāpo vāruṇīmuṣṇāṃ pītvā pāpādvimucyate । tayā sa kāye nirdagdhe mṛtyunā pretya śudhyati । lokāṃśca labhate vipro nānyathā labhate hi saḥ ॥45॥
html:
surāpo vāruṇīmuṣṇāṃ pītvā pāpādvimucyate ।
tayā sa kāye nirdagdhe mṛtyunā pretya śudhyati ।
lokāṃśca labhate vipro nānyathā labhate hi saḥ ॥45॥
slp1: surApo vAruRImuzRAM pItvA pApAdvimucyate । tayA sa kAye nirdagDe mftyunA pretya SuDyati । lokAMSca laBate vipro nAnyaTA laBate hi saH ॥45॥

text: gurutalpamadhiṣṭhāya durātmā pāpacetanaḥ । sūrmīṃ jvalantīmāśliṣya mṛtyunā sa viśudhyati ॥46॥
html:
gurutalpamadhiṣṭhāya durātmā pāpacetanaḥ ।
sūrmīṃ jvalantīmāśliṣya mṛtyunā sa viśudhyati ॥46॥
slp1: gurutalpamaDizWAya durAtmA pApacetanaH । sUrmIM jvalantImASlizya mftyunA sa viSuDyati ॥46॥

text: atha vā śiśnavṛṣaṇāvādāyāñjalinā svayam । nairṛtīṃ diśamāsthāya nipatetsa tvajihmagaḥ ॥47॥
html:
atha vā śiśnavṛṣaṇāvādāyāñjalinā svayam ।
nairṛtīṃ diśamāsthāya nipatetsa tvajihmagaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: aTa vA SiSnavfzaRAvAdAyAYjalinA svayam । nErftIM diSamAsTAya nipatetsa tvajihmagaH ॥47॥

text: brāhmaṇārthe'pi vā prāṇānsantyajettena śudhyati । aśvamedhena vāpīṣṭvā gomedhenāpi vā punaḥ । agniṣṭomena vā samyagiha pretya ca pūyate ॥48॥
html:
brāhmaṇārthe'pi vā prāṇānsantyajettena śudhyati ।
aśvamedhena vāpīṣṭvā gomedhenāpi vā punaḥ ।
agniṣṭomena vā samyagiha pretya ca pūyate ॥48॥
slp1: brAhmaRArTe'pi vA prARAnsantyajettena SuDyati । aSvameDena vApIzwvA gomeDenApi vA punaH । agnizwomena vA samyagiha pretya ca pUyate ॥48॥

text: tathaiva dvādaśa samāḥ kapālī brahmahā bhavet । brahmacārī caredbhaikṣaṃ svakarmodāharanmuniḥ ॥49॥
html:
tathaiva dvādaśa samāḥ kapālī brahmahā bhavet ।
brahmacārī caredbhaikṣaṃ svakarmodāharanmuniḥ ॥49॥
slp1: taTEva dvAdaSa samAH kapAlI brahmahA Bavet । brahmacArI caredBEkzaM svakarmodAharanmuniH ॥49॥

text: evaṃ vā tapasā yukto brahmahā savanī bhavet । evaṃ vā garbhamajñātā cātreyīṃ yo'bhigacchati । dviguṇā brahmahatyā vai ātreyīvyasane bhavet ॥50॥
html:
evaṃ vā tapasā yukto brahmahā savanī bhavet ।
evaṃ vā garbhamajñātā cātreyīṃ yo'bhigacchati ।
dviguṇā brahmahatyā vai ātreyīvyasane bhavet ॥50॥
slp1: evaM vA tapasA yukto brahmahA savanI Bavet । evaM vA garBamajYAtA cAtreyIM yo'BigacCati । dviguRA brahmahatyA vE AtreyIvyasane Bavet ॥50॥

text: surāpo niyatāhāro brahmacārī kṣamācaraḥ । ūrdhvaṃ tribhyo'tha varṣebhyo yajetāgniṣṭutā param । ṛṣabhaikasahasraṃ gā dattvā śubhamavāpnuyāt ॥51॥
html:
surāpo niyatāhāro brahmacārī kṣamācaraḥ ।
ūrdhvaṃ tribhyo'tha varṣebhyo yajetāgniṣṭutā param ।
ṛṣabhaikasahasraṃ gā dattvā śubhamavāpnuyāt ॥51॥
slp1: surApo niyatAhAro brahmacArI kzamAcaraH । UrDvaM triByo'Ta varzeByo yajetAgnizwutA param । fzaBEkasahasraM gA dattvA SuBamavApnuyAt ॥51॥

text: vaiśyaṃ hatvā tu varṣe dve ṛṣabhaikaśatāśca gāḥ । śūdraṃ hatvābdamevaikamṛṣabhaikādaśāśca gāḥ ॥52॥

text: śvabarbarakharānhatvā śaudrameva vrataṃ caret । mārjāracāṣamaṇḍūkānkākaṃ bhāsaṃ ca mūṣakam ॥53॥

text: uktaḥ paśusamo dharmo rājanprāṇinipātanāt । prāyaścittānyathānyāni pravakṣyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ ॥54॥
html:

slp1: uktaH paSusamo Darmo rAjanprARinipAtanAt । prAyaScittAnyaTAnyAni pravakzyAmyanupUrvaSaH ॥54॥

text: talpe cānyasya caurye ca pṛthaksaṃvatsaraṃ caret । trīṇi śrotriyabhāryāyāṃ paradāre tu dve smṛte ॥55॥
html:

slp1: talpe cAnyasya cOrye ca pfTaksaMvatsaraM caret । trIRi SrotriyaBAryAyAM paradAre tu dve smfte ॥55॥

text: kāle caturthe bhuñjāno brahmacārī vratī bhavet । sthānāsanābhyāṃ viharettrirahno'bhyuditādapaḥ । evameva nirācānto yaścāgnīnapavidhyati ॥56॥
html:

sthānāsanābhyāṃ viharettrirahno'bhyuditādapaḥ ।

slp1: kAle caturTe BuYjAno brahmacArI vratI Bavet । sTAnAsanAByAM viharettrirahno'ByuditAdapaH । evameva nirAcAnto yaScAgnInapaviDyati ॥56॥

text: tyajatyakāraṇe yaśca pitaraṃ mātaraṃ tathā । patitaḥ syātsa kauravya tathā dharmeṣu niścayaḥ ॥57॥
html:

patitaḥ syātsa kauravya tathā dharmeṣu niścayaḥ ॥57॥
slp1: tyajatyakAraRe yaSca pitaraM mAtaraM taTA । patitaH syAtsa kOravya taTA Darmezu niScayaH ॥57॥

text: grāsācchādanamatyarthaṃ dadyāditi nidarśanam । bhāryāyāṃ vyabhicāriṇyāṃ niruddhāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ । yatpuṃsāṃ paradāreṣu taccaināṃ cārayedvratam ॥58॥
html:
grāsācchādanamatyarthaṃ dadyāditi nidarśanam ।
bhāryāyāṃ vyabhicāriṇyāṃ niruddhāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ।
yatpuṃsāṃ paradāreṣu taccaināṃ cārayedvratam ॥58॥
slp1: grAsAcCAdanamatyarTaM dadyAditi nidarSanam । BAryAyAM vyaBicAriRyAM nirudDAyAM viSezataH । yatpuMsAM paradArezu taccEnAM cArayedvratam ॥58॥

text: śreyāṃsaṃ śayane hitvā yā pāpīyāṃsamṛcchati । śvabhistāṃ khādayedrājā saṃsthāne bahusaṃvṛte ॥59॥

śreyāṃsaṃ śayane hitvā yā pāpīyāṃsamṛcchati ।

slp1: SreyAMsaM Sayane hitvA yA pApIyAMsamfcCati । SvaBistAM KAdayedrAjA saMsTAne bahusaMvfte ॥59॥

text: pumāṃsaṃ bandhayetprājñaḥ śayane tapta āyase । apyādadhīta dārūṇi tatra dahyeta pāpakṛt ॥60॥
html:
pumāṃsaṃ bandhayetprājñaḥ śayane tapta āyase ।
apyādadhīta dārūṇi tatra dahyeta pāpakṛt ॥60॥
slp1: pumAMsaM banDayetprAjYaH Sayane tapta Ayase । apyAdaDIta dArURi tatra dahyeta pApakft ॥60॥

text: eṣa daṇḍo mahārāja strīṇāṃ bhartṛvyatikrame । saṃvatsarābhiśastasya duṣṭasya dviguṇo bhavet ॥61॥
html:
eṣa daṇḍo mahārāja strīṇāṃ bhartṛvyatikrame ।
saṃvatsarābhiśastasya duṣṭasya dviguṇo bhavet ॥61॥
slp1: eza daRqo mahArAja strIRAM Bartfvyatikrame । saMvatsarABiSastasya duzwasya dviguRo Bavet ॥61॥

text: dve tasya trīṇi varṣāṇi catvāri sahasevinaḥ । kucaraḥ pañca varṣāṇi caredbhaikṣaṃ munivrataḥ ॥62॥
html:
dve tasya trīṇi varṣāṇi catvāri sahasevinaḥ ।

html:

text: amānuṣīṣu govarjamanāvṛṣṭirna duṣyati । adhiṣṭhātāramattāraṃ paśūnāṃ puruṣaṃ viduḥ ॥66॥

text: bhavettu mānuṣeṣvevaṃ prāyaścittamanuttamam । dānaṃ vādānasakteṣu sarvameva prakalpayet । anāstikeṣu gomātraṃ prāṇamekaṃ pracakṣate ॥69॥

text: śvavarāhamanuṣyāṇāṃ kukkuṭasya kharasya ca । māṃsaṃ mūtrapurīṣaṃ ca prāśya saṃskāramarhati ॥70॥

text: kathāntaramathāsādya khaḍgayuddhaviśāradaḥ । nakulaḥ śaratalpasthamidamāha pitāmaham ॥1॥

text: dhanuḥ praharaṇaṃ śreṣṭhamiti vādaḥ pitāmaha । matastu mama dharmajña khaḍga eva susaṃśitaḥ ॥2॥

text: kathaṃ cotpāditaḥ khaḍgaḥ kasyārthāya ca kena vā । pūrvācāryaṃ ca khaḍgasya prabrūhi prapitāmaha ॥6॥

text: adhisṛjyātha putraṃ svaṃ prajānāmadhipaṃ tataḥ । manuḥ prajānāṃ rakṣārthaṃ kṣupāya pradadāvasim ॥71॥

slp1: aDisfjyATa putraM svaM prajAnAmaDipaM tataH । manuH prajAnAM rakzArTaM kzupAya pradadAvasim ॥71॥

text: kṣupājjagrāha cekṣvākurikṣvākośca purūravāḥ । āyuśca tasmāllebhe taṃ nahuṣaśca tato bhuvi ॥72॥

html:
vijayī hyarthavāndharmamārādhayitumuttamam ।
kāmaṃ ca carituṃ śakto duṣprāpamakṛtātmabhiḥ ॥12॥
slp1: vijayI hyarTavAnDarmamArADayitumuttamam । kAmaM ca carituM Sakto duzprApamakftAtmaBiH ॥12॥

text: arthasyāvayavāvetau dharmakāmāviti śrutiḥ । arthasiddhyā hi nirvṛttāvubhāvetau bhaviṣyataḥ ॥13॥
html:
arthasyāvayavāvetau dharmakāmāviti śrutiḥ ।
arthasiddhyā hi nirvṛttāvubhāvetau bhaviṣyataḥ ॥13॥
slp1: arTasyAvayavAvetO DarmakAmAviti SrutiH । arTasidDyA hi nirvfttAvuBAvetO BavizyataH ॥13॥

text: udbhūtārthaṃ hi puruṣaṃ viśiṣṭatarayonayaḥ । brahmāṇamiva bhūtāni satataṃ paryupāsate ॥14॥
html:
udbhūtārthaṃ hi puruṣaṃ viśiṣṭatarayonayaḥ ।
brahmāṇamiva bhūtāni satataṃ paryupāsate ॥14॥
slp1: udBUtArTaM hi puruzaM viSizwatarayonayaH । brahmARamiva BUtAni satataM paryupAsate ॥14॥

text: jaṭājinadharā dāntāḥ paṅkadigdhā jitendriyāḥ । muṇḍā nistantavaścāpi vasantyarthārthinaḥ pṛthak ॥15॥
html:
jaṭājinadharā dāntāḥ paṅkadigdhā jitendriyāḥ ।
muṇḍā nistantavaścāpi vasantyarthārthinaḥ pṛthak ॥15॥
slp1: jawAjinaDarA dAntAH paNkadigDA jitendriyAH । muRqA nistantavaScApi vasantyarTArTinaH pfTak ॥15॥

text: kāṣāyavasanāścānye śmaśrulā hrīsusaṃvṛtāḥ । vidvāṃsaścaiva śāntāśca muktāḥ sarvaparigrahaiḥ ॥16॥
html:
kāṣāyavasanāścānye śmaśrulā hrīsusaṃvṛtāḥ ।
vidvāṃsaścaiva śāntāśca muktāḥ sarvaparigrahaiḥ ॥16॥
slp1: kAzAyavasanAScAnye SmaSrulA hrIsusaMvftAH । vidvAMsaScEva SAntASca muktAH sarvaparigrahEH ॥16॥

text: arthārthinaḥ santi kecidapare svargakāṅkṣiṇaḥ । kulapratyāgamāścaike svaṃ svaṃ mārgamanuṣṭhitāḥ ॥17॥
html:
arthārthinaḥ santi kecidapare svargakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ।
kulapratyāgamāścaike svaṃ svaṃ mārgamanuṣṭhitāḥ ॥17॥
slp1: arTArTinaH santi kecidapare svargakANkziRaH । kulapratyAgamAScEke svaM svaM mArgamanuzWitAH ॥17॥

text: āstikā nāstikāścaiva niyatāḥ saṃyame pare । aprajñānaṃ tamobhūtaṃ prajñānaṃ tu prakāśatā ॥18॥
html:
āstikā nāstikāścaiva niyatāḥ saṃyame pare ।
aprajñānaṃ tamobhūtaṃ prajñānaṃ tu prakāśatā ॥18॥
slp1: AstikA nAstikAScEva niyatAH saMyame pare । aprajYAnaM tamoBUtaM prajYAnaM tu prakASatA ॥18॥

text: bhṛtyānbhogairdviṣo daṇḍairyo yojayati so'rthavān । etanmatimatāṃ śreṣṭha mataṃ mama yathātatham । anayostu nibodha tvaṃ vacanaṃ vākyakaṇṭhayoḥ ॥19॥
html:
bhṛtyānbhogairdviṣo daṇḍairyo yojayati so'rthavān ।
etanmatimatāṃ śreṣṭha mataṃ mama yathātatham ।
anayostu nibodha tvaṃ vacanaṃ vākyakaṇṭhayoḥ ॥19॥
slp1: BftyAnBogErdvizo daRqEryo yojayati so'rTavAn । etanmatimatAM SrezWa mataM mama yaTAtaTam । anayostu niboDa tvaM vacanaM vAkyakaRWayoH ॥19॥

text: tato dharmārthakuśalau mādrīputrāvanantaram । nakulaḥ sahadevaśca vākyaṃ jagadatuḥ param ॥20॥
html:
tato dharmārthakuśalau mādrīputrāvanantaram ।
nakulaḥ sahadevaśca vākyaṃ jagadatuḥ param ॥20॥
slp1: tato DarmArTakuSalO mAdrIputrAvanantaram । nakulaH sahadevaSca vAkyaM jagadatuH param ॥20॥

text: āsīnaśca śayānaśca vicarannapi ca sthitaḥ । arthayogaṃ dṛḍhaṃ kuryādyogairuccāvacairapi ॥21॥
html:
āsīnaśca śayānaśca vicarannapi ca sthitaḥ ।
arthayogaṃ dṛḍhaṃ kuryādyogairuccāvacairapi ॥21॥
slp1: AsInaSca SayAnaSca vicarannapi ca sTitaH । arTayogaM dfQaM kuryAdyogEruccAvacErapi ॥21॥

text: asmiṃstu vai susaṃvṛtte durlabhe paramapriye । iha kāmānavāpnoti pratyakṣaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥22॥
html:
asmiṃstu vai susaṃvṛtte durlabhe paramapriye ।
iha kāmānavāpnoti pratyakṣaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: asmiMstu vE susaMvftte durlaBe paramapriye । iha kAmAnavApnoti pratyakzaM nAtra saMSayaH ॥22॥

text: yo'rtho dharmeṇa saṃyukto dharmo yaścārthasaṃyutaḥ । madhvivāmṛtasaṃyuktaṃ tasmādetau matāviha ॥23॥
html:
yo'rtho dharmeṇa saṃyukto dharmo yaścārthasaṃyutaḥ ।
madhvivāmṛtasaṃyuktaṃ tasmādetau matāviha ॥23॥
slp1: yo'rTo DarmeRa saMyukto Darmo yaScArTasaMyutaH । maDvivAmftasaMyuktaM tasmAdetO matAviha ॥23॥

text: anarthasya na kāmo'sti tathārtho'dharmiṇaḥ kutaḥ । tasmādudvijate loko dharmārthādyo bahiṣkṛtaḥ ॥24॥
html:
anarthasya na kāmo'sti tathārtho'dharmiṇaḥ kutaḥ ।
tasmādudvijate loko dharmārthādyo bahiṣkṛtaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: anarTasya na kAmo'sti taTArTo'DarmiRaH kutaH । tasmAdudvijate loko DarmArTAdyo bahizkftaH ॥24॥

text: tasmāddharmapradhānena sādhyo'rthaḥ saṃyatātmanā । viśvasteṣu ca bhūteṣu kalpate sarva eva hi ॥25॥
html:
tasmāddharmapradhānena sādhyo'rthaḥ saṃyatātmanā ।
viśvasteṣu ca bhūteṣu kalpate sarva eva hi ॥25॥
slp1: tasmAdDarmapraDAnena sADyo'rTaH saMyatAtmanA । viSvastezu ca BUtezu kalpate sarva eva hi ॥25॥

text: dharmaṃ samācaretpūrvaṃ tathārthaṃ dharmasaṃyutam । tataḥ kāmaṃ caretpaścātsiddhārthasya hi tatphalam ॥26॥
html:
dharmaṃ samācaretpūrvaṃ tathārthaṃ dharmasaṃyutam ।
tataḥ kāmaṃ caretpaścātsiddhārthasya hi tatphalam ॥26॥
slp1: DarmaM samAcaretpUrvaM taTArTaM DarmasaMyutam । tataH kAmaM caretpaScAtsidDArTasya hi tatPalam ॥26॥

text: virematustu tadvākyamuktvā tāvaśvinoḥ sutau । bhīmasenastadā vākyamidaṃ vaktuṃ pracakrame ॥27॥
html:
virematustu tadvākyamuktvā tāvaśvinoḥ sutau ।
bhīmasenastadā vākyamidaṃ vaktuṃ pracakrame ॥27॥
slp1: virematustu tadvAkyamuktvA tAvaSvinoH sutO । BImasenastadA vAkyamidaM vaktuM pracakrame ॥27॥

text: nākāmaḥ kāmayatyarthaṃ nākāmo dharmamicchati । nākāmaḥ kāmayāno'sti tasmātkāmo viśiṣyate ॥28॥
html:
nākāmaḥ kāmayatyarthaṃ nākāmo dharmamicchati ।
nākāmaḥ kāmayāno'sti tasmātkāmo viśiṣyate ॥28॥
slp1: nAkAmaH kAmayatyarTaM nAkAmo DarmamicCati । nAkAmaH kAmayAno'sti tasmAtkAmo viSizyate ॥28॥

text: kāmena yuktā ṛṣayastapasyeva samāhitāḥ । palāśaphalamūlāśā vāyubhakṣāḥ susaṃyatāḥ ॥29॥
html:
kāmena yuktā ṛṣayastapasyeva samāhitāḥ ।
palāśaphalamūlāśā vāyubhakṣāḥ susaṃyatāḥ ॥29॥
slp1: kAmena yuktA fzayastapasyeva samAhitAH । palASaPalamUlASA vAyuBakzAH susaMyatAH ॥29॥

text: vedopavādeṣvapare yuktāḥ svādhyāyapāragāḥ । śrāddhayajñakriyāyāṃ ca tathā dānapratigrahe ॥30॥
html:
vedopavādeṣvapare yuktāḥ svādhyāyapāragāḥ ।
śrāddhayajñakriyāyāṃ ca tathā dānapratigrahe ॥30॥
slp1: vedopavAdezvapare yuktAH svADyAyapAragAH । SrAdDayajYakriyAyAM ca taTA dAnapratigrahe ॥30॥

text: vaṇijaḥ karṣakā gopāḥ kāravaḥ śilpinastathā । daivakarmakṛtaścaiva yuktāḥ kāmena karmasu ॥31॥
html:
vaṇijaḥ karṣakā gopāḥ kāravaḥ śilpinastathā ।
daivakarmakṛtaścaiva yuktāḥ kāmena karmasu ॥31॥
slp1: vaRijaH karzakA gopAH kAravaH SilpinastaTA । dEvakarmakftaScEva yuktAH kAmena karmasu ॥31॥

text: samudraṃ cāviśantyanye narāḥ kāmena saṃyutāḥ । kāmo hi vividhākāraḥ sarvaṃ kāmena santatam ॥32॥
html:
samudraṃ cāviśantyanye narāḥ kāmena saṃyutāḥ ।
kāmo hi vividhākāraḥ sarvaṃ kāmena santatam ॥32॥
slp1: samudraM cAviSantyanye narAH kAmena saMyutAH । kAmo hi viviDAkAraH sarvaM kAmena santatam ॥32॥

text: nāsti nāsīnnābhaviṣyadbhūtaṃ kāmātmakātparam । etatsāraṃ mahārāja dharmārthāvatra saṃśritau ॥33॥
html:
nāsti nāsīnnābhaviṣyadbhūtaṃ kāmātmakātparam ।
etatsāraṃ mahārāja dharmārthāvatra saṃśritau ॥33॥
slp1: nAsti nAsInnABavizyadBUtaM kAmAtmakAtparam । etatsAraM mahArAja DarmArTAvatra saMSritO ॥33॥

text: navanītaṃ yathā dadhnastathā kāmo'rthadharmataḥ । śreyastailaṃ ca piṇyākādghṛtaṃ śreya udaśvitaḥ ॥34॥
html:
navanītaṃ yathā dadhnastathā kāmo'rthadharmataḥ ।
śreyastailaṃ ca piṇyākādghṛtaṃ śreya udaśvitaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: navanItaM yaTA daDnastaTA kAmo'rTaDarmataH । SreyastElaM ca piRyAkAdGftaM Sreya udaSvitaH ॥34॥

text: śreyaḥ puṣpaphalaṃ kāṣṭhātkāmo dharmārthayorvaraḥ । puṣpato madhviva rasaḥ kāmātsañjāyate sukham ॥35॥
html:
śreyaḥ puṣpaphalaṃ kāṣṭhātkāmo dharmārthayorvaraḥ ।
puṣpato madhviva rasaḥ kāmātsañjāyate sukham ॥35॥
slp1: SreyaH puzpaPalaM kAzWAtkAmo DarmArTayorvaraH । puzpato maDviva rasaH kAmAtsaYjAyate suKam ॥35॥

text: sucāruveṣābhiralaṅkṛtābhirmadotkaṭābhiḥ priyavādinībhiḥ । ramasva yoṣābhirupetya kāmaṃ kāmo hi rājaṃstarasābhipātī ॥36॥
html:
sucāruveṣābhiralaṅkṛtābhirmadotkaṭābhiḥ priyavādinībhiḥ ।
ramasva yoṣābhirupetya kāmaṃ kāmo hi rājaṃstarasābhipātī ॥36॥
slp1: sucAruvezABiralaNkftABirmadotkawABiH priyavAdinIBiH । ramasva yozABirupetya kAmaM kAmo hi rAjaMstarasABipAtI ॥36॥

text: buddhirmamaiṣā pariṣatsthitasya mā bhūdvicārastava dharmaputra । syātsaṃhitaṃ sadbhiraphalgusāraṃ sametya vākyaṃ paramānṛśaṃsyam ॥37॥
html:
buddhirmamaiṣā pariṣatsthitasya mā bhūdvicārastava dharmaputra ।
syātsaṃhitaṃ sadbhiraphalgusāraṃ sametya vākyaṃ paramānṛśaṃsyam ॥37॥
slp1: budDirmamEzA parizatsTitasya mA BUdvicArastava Darmaputra । syAtsaMhitaM sadBiraPalgusAraM sametya vAkyaM paramAnfSaMsyam ॥37॥

text: dharmārthakāmāḥ samameva sevyā yastvekasevī sa naro jaghanyaḥ । dvayostu dakṣaṃ pravadanti madhyaṃ sa uttamo yo niratastrivarge ॥38॥
html:
dharmārthakāmāḥ samameva sevyā yastvekasevī sa naro jaghanyaḥ ।
dvayostu dakṣaṃ pravadanti madhyaṃ sa uttamo yo niratastrivarge ॥38॥
slp1: DarmArTakAmAH samameva sevyA yastvekasevI sa naro jaGanyaH । dvayostu dakzaM pravadanti maDyaM sa uttamo yo niratastrivarge ॥38॥

text: prājñaḥ suhṛccandanasāralipto vicitramālyābharaṇairupetaḥ । tato vacaḥ saṅgrahavigraheṇa proktvā yavīyānvirarāma bhīmaḥ ॥39॥
html:
prājñaḥ suhṛccandanasāralipto vicitramālyābharaṇairupetaḥ ।
tato vacaḥ saṅgrahavigraheṇa proktvā yavīyānvirarāma bhīmaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: prAjYaH suhfccandanasAralipto vicitramAlyABaraRErupetaH । tato vacaH saNgrahavigraheRa proktvA yavIyAnvirarAma BImaH ॥39॥

text: tato muhūrtādatha dharmarājo vākyāni teṣāmanucintya samyak । uvāca vācāvitathaṃ smayanvai bahuśruto dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhaḥ ॥40॥
html:
tato muhūrtādatha dharmarājo vākyāni teṣāmanucintya samyak ।
uvāca vācāvitathaṃ smayanvai bahuśruto dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: tato muhUrtAdaTa DarmarAjo vAkyAni tezAmanucintya samyak । uvAca vAcAvitaTaM smayanvE bahuSruto DarmaBftAM varizWaH ॥40॥

text: niḥsaṃśayaṃ niścitadharmaśāstrāḥ sarve bhavanto viditapramāṇāḥ । vijñātukāmasya mameha vākyamuktaṃ yadvai naiṣṭhikaṃ tacchrutaṃ me । iha tvavaśyaṃ gadato mamāpi vākyaṃ nibodhadhvamananyabhāvāḥ ॥41॥
html:
niḥsaṃśayaṃ niścitadharmaśāstrāḥ sarve bhavanto viditapramāṇāḥ ।
vijñātukāmasya mameha vākyamuktaṃ yadvai naiṣṭhikaṃ tacchrutaṃ me ।
iha tvavaśyaṃ gadato mamāpi vākyaṃ nibodhadhvamananyabhāvāḥ ॥41॥
slp1: niHsaMSayaM niScitaDarmaSAstrAH sarve Bavanto viditapramARAH । vijYAtukAmasya mameha vAkyamuktaM yadvE nEzWikaM tacCrutaM me । iha tvavaSyaM gadato mamApi vAkyaM niboDaDvamananyaBAvAH ॥41॥

text: yo vai na pāpe nirato na puṇye nārthe na dharme manujo na kāme । vimuktadoṣaḥ samaloṣṭakāñcanaḥ sa mucyate duḥkhasukhārthasiddheḥ ॥42॥
html:
yo vai na pāpe nirato na puṇye nārthe na dharme manujo na kāme ।
vimuktadoṣaḥ samaloṣṭakāñcanaḥ sa mucyate duḥkhasukhārthasiddheḥ ॥42॥
slp1: yo vE na pApe nirato na puRye nArTe na Darme manujo na kAme । vimuktadozaH samalozwakAYcanaH sa mucyate duHKasuKArTasidDeH ॥42॥

text: bhūtāni jātīmaraṇānvitāni jarāvikāraiśca samanvitāni । bhūyaśca taistaiḥ pratibodhitāni mokṣaṃ praśaṃsanti na taṃ ca vidmaḥ ॥43॥
html:
bhūtāni jātīmaraṇānvitāni jarāvikāraiśca samanvitāni ।
bhūyaśca taistaiḥ pratibodhitāni mokṣaṃ praśaṃsanti na taṃ ca vidmaḥ ॥43॥
slp1: BUtAni jAtImaraRAnvitAni jarAvikArESca samanvitAni । BUyaSca tEstEH pratiboDitAni mokzaM praSaMsanti na taM ca vidmaH ॥43॥

text: snehe nabaddhasya na santi tānītyevaṃ svayaṃbhūrbhagavānuvāca । budhāśca nirvāṇaparā vadanti tasmānna kuryātpriyamapriyaṃ ca ॥44॥
html:
snehe nabaddhasya na santi tānītyevaṃ svayaṃbhūrbhagavānuvāca ।
budhāśca nirvāṇaparā vadanti tasmānna kuryātpriyamapriyaṃ ca ॥44॥
slp1: snehe nabadDasya na santi tAnItyevaM svayaMBUrBagavAnuvAca । buDASca nirvARaparA vadanti tasmAnna kuryAtpriyamapriyaM ca ॥44॥

text: etatpradhānaṃ na tu kāmakāro yathā niyukto'smi tathā carāmi । bhūtāni sarvāṇi vidhirniyuṅkte vidhirbalīyāniti vitta sarve ॥45॥
html:
etatpradhānaṃ na tu kāmakāro yathā niyukto'smi tathā carāmi ।
bhūtāni sarvāṇi vidhirniyuṅkte vidhirbalīyāniti vitta sarve ॥45॥
slp1: etatpraDAnaM na tu kAmakAro yaTA niyukto'smi taTA carAmi । BUtAni sarvARi viDirniyuNkte viDirbalIyAniti vitta sarve ॥45॥

text: na karmaṇāpnotyanavāpyamarthaṃ yadbhāvi sarvaṃ bhavatīti vitta । trivargahīno'pi hi vindate'rthaṃ tasmādidaṃ lokahitāya guhyam ॥46॥
html:
na karmaṇāpnotyanavāpyamarthaṃ yadbhāvi sarvaṃ bhavatīti vitta ।
trivargahīno'pi hi vindate'rthaṃ tasmādidaṃ lokahitāya guhyam ॥46॥
slp1: na karmaRApnotyanavApyamarTaM yadBAvi sarvaM BavatIti vitta । trivargahIno'pi hi vindate'rTaM tasmAdidaM lokahitAya guhyam ॥46॥

text: tatastadagryaṃ vacanaṃ manonugaṃ samastamājñāya tato'tihetumat । tadā praṇeduśca jaharṣire ca te kurupravīrāya ca cakrurañjalīn ॥47॥
html:
tatastadagryaṃ vacanaṃ manonugaṃ samastamājñāya tato'tihetumat ।
tadā praṇeduśca jaharṣire ca te kurupravīrāya ca cakrurañjalīn ॥47॥
slp1: tatastadagryaM vacanaM manonugaM samastamAjYAya tato'tihetumat । tadA praReduSca jaharzire ca te kurupravIrAya ca cakruraYjalIn ॥47॥

text: sucāruvarṇākṣaraśabdabhūṣitāṃ manonugāṃ nirdhutavākyakaṇṭakām । niśamya tāṃ pārthiva pārthabhāṣitāṃ giraṃ narendrāḥ praśaśaṃsureva te । punaśca papraccha saridvarāsutaṃ tataḥ paraṃ dharmamahīnasattvaḥ] ॥48॥
html:
sucāruvarṇākṣaraśabdabhūṣitāṃ manonugāṃ nirdhutavākyakaṇṭakām ।
niśamya tāṃ pārthiva pārthabhāṣitāṃ giraṃ narendrāḥ praśaśaṃsureva te ।
punaśca papraccha saridvarāsutaṃ tataḥ paraṃ dharmamahīnasattvaḥ] ॥48॥
slp1: sucAruvarRAkzaraSabdaBUzitAM manonugAM nirDutavAkyakaRwakAm । niSamya tAM pArTiva pArTaBAzitAM giraM narendrAH praSaSaMsureva te । punaSca papracCa saridvarAsutaM tataH paraM DarmamahInasattvaH] ॥48॥

text: pitāmaha mahāprājña kurūṇāṃ kīrtivardhana । praśnaṃ kañcitpravakṣyāmi tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥1॥
html:
pitāmaha mahāprājña kurūṇāṃ kīrtivardhana ।
praśnaṃ kañcitpravakṣyāmi tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥1॥
slp1: pitAmaha mahAprAjYa kurURAM kIrtivarDana । praSnaM kaYcitpravakzyAmi tanme vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kīdṛśā mānavāḥ saumyāḥ kaiḥ prītiḥ paramā bhavet । āyatyāṃ ca tadātve ca ke kṣamāstānvadasva me ॥2॥
html:
kīdṛśā mānavāḥ saumyāḥ kaiḥ prītiḥ paramā bhavet ।
āyatyāṃ ca tadātve ca ke kṣamāstānvadasva me ॥2॥
slp1: kIdfSA mAnavAH sOmyAH kEH prItiH paramA Bavet । AyatyAM ca tadAtve ca ke kzamAstAnvadasva me ॥2॥

text: na hi tatra dhanaṃ sphītaṃ na ca sambandhibāndhavāḥ । tiṣṭhanti yatra suhṛdastiṣṭhantīti matirmama ॥3॥
html:
na hi tatra dhanaṃ sphītaṃ na ca sambandhibāndhavāḥ ।
tiṣṭhanti yatra suhṛdastiṣṭhantīti matirmama ॥3॥
slp1: na hi tatra DanaM sPItaM na ca sambanDibAnDavAH । tizWanti yatra suhfdastizWantIti matirmama ॥3॥

text: durlabho hi suhṛcchrotā durlabhaśca hitaḥ suhṛt । etaddharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha sarvaṃ vyākhyātumarhasi ॥4॥
html:
durlabho hi suhṛcchrotā durlabhaśca hitaḥ suhṛt ।
etaddharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha sarvaṃ vyākhyātumarhasi ॥4॥
slp1: durlaBo hi suhfcCrotA durlaBaSca hitaH suhft । etadDarmaBftAM SrezWa sarvaM vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥4॥

text: sandheyānpuruṣānrājannasandheyāṃśca tattvataḥ । vadato me nibodha tvaṃ nikhilena yudhiṣṭhira ॥5॥
html:
sandheyānpuruṣānrājannasandheyāṃśca tattvataḥ ।
vadato me nibodha tvaṃ nikhilena yudhiṣṭhira ॥5॥
slp1: sanDeyAnpuruzAnrAjannasanDeyAMSca tattvataH । vadato me niboDa tvaM niKilena yuDizWira ॥5॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: lubdhaḥ krūrastyaktadharmā nikṛtaḥ śaṭha eva ca । kṣudraḥ pāpasamācāraḥ sarvaśaṅkī tathālasaḥ ॥6॥
html:
lubdhaḥ krūrastyaktadharmā nikṛtaḥ śaṭha eva ca ।
kṣudraḥ pāpasamācāraḥ sarvaśaṅkī tathālasaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: lubDaH krUrastyaktaDarmA nikftaH SaWa eva ca । kzudraH pApasamAcAraH sarvaSaNkI taTAlasaH ॥6॥

text: dīrghasūtro'nṛjuḥ kaṣṭo gurudārapradharṣakaḥ । vyasane yaḥ parityāgī durātmā nirapatrapaḥ ॥7॥
html:
dīrghasūtro'nṛjuḥ kaṣṭo gurudārapradharṣakaḥ ।
vyasane yaḥ parityāgī durātmā nirapatrapaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: dIrGasUtro'nfjuH kazwo gurudArapraDarzakaH । vyasane yaH parityAgI durAtmA nirapatrapaH ॥7॥

text: sarvataḥ pāpadarśī ca nāstiko vedanindakaḥ । samprakīrṇendriyo loke yaḥ kāmanirataścaret ॥8॥
html:
sarvataḥ pāpadarśī ca nāstiko vedanindakaḥ ।
samprakīrṇendriyo loke yaḥ kāmanirataścaret ॥8॥
slp1: sarvataH pApadarSI ca nAstiko vedanindakaH । samprakIrRendriyo loke yaH kAmanirataScaret ॥8॥

text: asatyo lokavidviṣṭaḥ samaye cānavasthitaḥ । piśuno'thākṛtaprajño matsarī pāpaniścayaḥ ॥9॥
html:
asatyo lokavidviṣṭaḥ samaye cānavasthitaḥ ।
piśuno'thākṛtaprajño matsarī pāpaniścayaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: asatyo lokavidvizwaH samaye cAnavasTitaH । piSuno'TAkftaprajYo matsarI pApaniScayaH ॥9॥

text: duḥśīlo'thākṛtātmā ca nṛśaṃsaḥ kitavastathā । mitrairarthakṛtī nityamicchatyarthaparaśca yaḥ ॥10॥
html:
duḥśīlo'thākṛtātmā ca nṛśaṃsaḥ kitavastathā ।
mitrairarthakṛtī nityamicchatyarthaparaśca yaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: duHSIlo'TAkftAtmA ca nfSaMsaH kitavastaTA । mitrErarTakftI nityamicCatyarTaparaSca yaH ॥10॥

text: vahataśca yathāśakti yo na tuṣyati mandadhīḥ । amitramiva yo bhuṅkte sadā mitraṃ nararṣabha ॥11॥
html:
vahataśca yathāśakti yo na tuṣyati mandadhīḥ ।
amitramiva yo bhuṅkte sadā mitraṃ nararṣabha ॥11॥
slp1: vahataSca yaTASakti yo na tuzyati mandaDIH । amitramiva yo BuNkte sadA mitraM nararzaBa ॥11॥

text: asthānakrodhano yaśca akasmācca virajyate । suhṛdaścaiva kalyāṇānāśu tyajati kilbiṣī ॥12॥
html:
asthānakrodhano yaśca akasmācca virajyate ।
suhṛdaścaiva kalyāṇānāśu tyajati kilbiṣī ॥12॥
slp1: asTAnakroDano yaSca akasmAcca virajyate । suhfdaScEva kalyARAnASu tyajati kilbizI ॥12॥

text: alpe'pyapakṛte mūḍhastathājñānātkṛte'pi ca । kāryopasevī mitreṣu mitradveṣī narādhipa ॥13॥
html:
alpe'pyapakṛte mūḍhastathājñānātkṛte'pi ca ।
kāryopasevī mitreṣu mitradveṣī narādhipa ॥13॥
slp1: alpe'pyapakfte mUQastaTAjYAnAtkfte'pi ca । kAryopasevI mitrezu mitradvezI narADipa ॥13॥

text: śatrurmitramukho yaśca jihmaprekṣī vilobhanaḥ । na rajyati ca kalyāṇe yastyajettādṛśaṃ naram ॥14॥
html:
śatrurmitramukho yaśca jihmaprekṣī vilobhanaḥ ।
na rajyati ca kalyāṇe yastyajettādṛśaṃ naram ॥14॥
slp1: SatrurmitramuKo yaSca jihmaprekzI viloBanaH । na rajyati ca kalyARe yastyajettAdfSaM naram ॥14॥

text: pānapo dveṣaṇaḥ krūro nirghṛṇaḥ paruṣastathā । paropatāpī mitradhruktathā prāṇivadhe rataḥ ॥15॥
html:
pānapo dveṣaṇaḥ krūro nirghṛṇaḥ paruṣastathā ।
paropatāpī mitradhruktathā prāṇivadhe rataḥ ॥15॥
slp1: pAnapo dvezaRaH krUro nirGfRaH paruzastaTA । paropatApI mitraDruktaTA prARivaDe rataH ॥15॥

text: kṛtaghnaścādhamo loke na sandheyaḥ kathañcana । chidrānveṣī na sandheyaḥ sandheyānapi me śṛṇu ॥16॥
html:
kṛtaghnaścādhamo loke na sandheyaḥ kathañcana ।
chidrānveṣī na sandheyaḥ sandheyānapi me śṛṇu ॥16॥
slp1: kftaGnaScADamo loke na sanDeyaH kaTaYcana । CidrAnvezI na sanDeyaH sanDeyAnapi me SfRu ॥16॥

text: kulīnā vākyasampannā jñānavijñānakovidāḥ । mitrajñāśca kṛtajñāśca sarvajñāḥ śokavarjitāḥ ॥17॥
html:
kulīnā vākyasampannā jñānavijñānakovidāḥ ।
mitrajñāśca kṛtajñāśca sarvajñāḥ śokavarjitāḥ ॥17॥
slp1: kulInA vAkyasampannA jYAnavijYAnakovidAH । mitrajYASca kftajYASca sarvajYAH SokavarjitAH ॥17॥

text: mādhuryaguṇasampannāḥ satyasandhā jitendriyāḥ । vyāyāmaśīlāḥ satataṃ bhṛtaputrāḥ kulodgatāḥ ॥18॥
html:
mādhuryaguṇasampannāḥ satyasandhā jitendriyāḥ ।
vyāyāmaśīlāḥ satataṃ bhṛtaputrāḥ kulodgatāḥ ॥18॥
slp1: mADuryaguRasampannAH satyasanDA jitendriyAH । vyAyAmaSIlAH satataM BftaputrAH kulodgatAH ॥18॥

text: rūpavanto guṇopetāstathālubdhā jitaśramāḥ । doṣairviyuktāḥ prathitaiste grāhyāḥ pārthivena ha ॥19॥
html:
rūpavanto guṇopetāstathālubdhā jitaśramāḥ ।
doṣairviyuktāḥ prathitaiste grāhyāḥ pārthivena ha ॥19॥
slp1: rUpavanto guRopetAstaTAlubDA jitaSramAH । dozErviyuktAH praTitEste grAhyAH pArTivena ha ॥19॥

text: yathāśaktisamācārāḥ santastuṣyanti hi prabho । nāsthāne krodhavantaśca na cākasmādvirāgiṇaḥ ॥20॥
html:
yathāśaktisamācārāḥ santastuṣyanti hi prabho ।
nāsthāne krodhavantaśca na cākasmādvirāgiṇaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: yaTASaktisamAcArAH santastuzyanti hi praBo । nAsTAne kroDavantaSca na cAkasmAdvirAgiRaH ॥20॥

text: viraktāśca na ruṣyanti manasāpyarthakovidāḥ । ātmānaṃ pīḍayitvāpi suhṛtkāryaparāyaṇāḥ । na virajyanti mitrebhyo vāso raktamivāvikam ॥21॥
html:
viraktāśca na ruṣyanti manasāpyarthakovidāḥ ।
ātmānaṃ pīḍayitvāpi suhṛtkāryaparāyaṇāḥ ।
na virajyanti mitrebhyo vāso raktamivāvikam ॥21॥
slp1: viraktASca na ruzyanti manasApyarTakovidAH । AtmAnaM pIqayitvApi suhftkAryaparAyaRAH । na virajyanti mitreByo vAso raktamivAvikam ॥21॥

text: doṣāṃśca lobhamohādīnartheṣu yuvatiṣvatha । na darśayanti suhṛdāṃ viśvastā bandhuvatsalāḥ ॥22॥
html:
doṣāṃśca lobhamohādīnartheṣu yuvatiṣvatha ।
na darśayanti suhṛdāṃ viśvastā bandhuvatsalāḥ ॥22॥
slp1: dozAMSca loBamohAdInarTezu yuvatizvaTa । na darSayanti suhfdAM viSvastA banDuvatsalAH ॥22॥

text: loṣṭakāñcanatulyārthāḥ suhṛtsvaśaṭhabuddhayaḥ । ye carantyanabhīmānā nisṛṣṭārthavibhūṣaṇāḥ । saṅgṛhṇantaḥ parijanaṃ svāmyarthaparamāḥ sadā ॥23॥
html:
loṣṭakāñcanatulyārthāḥ suhṛtsvaśaṭhabuddhayaḥ ।
ye carantyanabhīmānā nisṛṣṭārthavibhūṣaṇāḥ ।
saṅgṛhṇantaḥ parijanaṃ svāmyarthaparamāḥ sadā ॥23॥
slp1: lozwakAYcanatulyArTAH suhftsvaSaWabudDayaH । ye carantyanaBImAnA nisfzwArTaviBUzaRAH । saNgfhRantaH parijanaM svAmyarTaparamAH sadA ॥23॥

text: īdṛśaiḥ puruṣaśreṣṭhaiḥ sandhiṃ yaḥ kurute nṛpaḥ । tasya vistīryate rāṣṭraṃ jyotsnā grahapateriva ॥24॥
html:
īdṛśaiḥ puruṣaśreṣṭhaiḥ sandhiṃ yaḥ kurute nṛpaḥ ।
tasya vistīryate rāṣṭraṃ jyotsnā grahapateriva ॥24॥
slp1: IdfSEH puruzaSrezWEH sanDiM yaH kurute nfpaH । tasya vistIryate rAzwraM jyotsnA grahapateriva ॥24॥

text: śāstranityā jitakrodhā balavanto raṇapriyāḥ । kṣāntāḥ śīlaguṇopetāḥ sandheyāḥ puruṣottamāḥ ॥25॥
html:
śāstranityā jitakrodhā balavanto raṇapriyāḥ ।
kṣāntāḥ śīlaguṇopetāḥ sandheyāḥ puruṣottamāḥ ॥25॥
slp1: SAstranityA jitakroDA balavanto raRapriyAH । kzAntAH SIlaguRopetAH sanDeyAH puruzottamAH ॥25॥

text: ye ca doṣasamāyuktā narāḥ proktā mayānagha । teṣāmapyadhamo rājankṛtaghno mitraghātakaḥ । tyaktavyaḥ sa durācāraḥ sarveṣāmiti niścayaḥ ॥26॥
html:
ye ca doṣasamāyuktā narāḥ proktā mayānagha ।
teṣāmapyadhamo rājankṛtaghno mitraghātakaḥ ।
tyaktavyaḥ sa durācāraḥ sarveṣāmiti niścayaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: ye ca dozasamAyuktA narAH proktA mayAnaGa । tezAmapyaDamo rAjankftaGno mitraGAtakaH । tyaktavyaH sa durAcAraH sarvezAmiti niScayaH ॥26॥

text: vistareṇārthasambandhaṃ śrotumicchāmi pārthiva । mitradrohī kṛtaghnaśca yaḥ proktastaṃ ca me vada ॥27॥
html:
vistareṇārthasambandhaṃ śrotumicchāmi pārthiva ।
mitradrohī kṛtaghnaśca yaḥ proktastaṃ ca me vada ॥27॥
slp1: vistareRArTasambanDaM SrotumicCAmi pArTiva । mitradrohI kftaGnaSca yaH proktastaM ca me vada ॥27॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: hanta te vartayiṣye'hamitihāsaṃ purātanam । udīcyāṃ diśi yadvṛttaṃ mleccheṣu manujādhipa ॥28॥
html:
hanta te vartayiṣye'hamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
udīcyāṃ diśi yadvṛttaṃ mleccheṣu manujādhipa ॥28॥
slp1: hanta te vartayizye'hamitihAsaM purAtanam । udIcyAM diSi yadvfttaM mlecCezu manujADipa ॥28॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: brāhmaṇo madhyadeśīyaḥ kṛṣṇāṅgo brahmavarjitaḥ । grāmaṃ prekṣya janākīrṇaṃ prāviśadbhaikṣakāṅkṣayā ॥29॥
html:
brāhmaṇo madhyadeśīyaḥ kṛṣṇāṅgo brahmavarjitaḥ ।
grāmaṃ prekṣya janākīrṇaṃ prāviśadbhaikṣakāṅkṣayā ॥29॥
slp1: brAhmaRo maDyadeSIyaH kfzRANgo brahmavarjitaH । grAmaM prekzya janAkIrRaM prAviSadBEkzakANkzayA ॥29॥

text: tatra dasyurdhanayutaḥ sarvavarṇaviśeṣavit । brahmaṇyaḥ satyasandhaśca dāne ca nirato'bhavat ॥30॥
html:
tatra dasyurdhanayutaḥ sarvavarṇaviśeṣavit ।
brahmaṇyaḥ satyasandhaśca dāne ca nirato'bhavat ॥30॥
slp1: tatra dasyurDanayutaH sarvavarRaviSezavit । brahmaRyaH satyasanDaSca dAne ca nirato'Bavat ॥30॥

text: tasya kṣayamupāgamya tato bhikṣāmayācata । pratiśrayaṃ ca vāsārthaṃ bhikṣāṃ caivātha vārṣikīm ॥31॥
html:
tasya kṣayamupāgamya tato bhikṣāmayācata ।
pratiśrayaṃ ca vāsārthaṃ bhikṣāṃ caivātha vārṣikīm ॥31॥
slp1: tasya kzayamupAgamya tato BikzAmayAcata । pratiSrayaM ca vAsArTaM BikzAM cEvATa vArzikIm ॥31॥

text: prādāttasmai sa viprāya vastraṃ ca sadṛśaṃ navam । nārīṃ cāpi vayopetāṃ bhartrā virahitāṃ tadā ॥32॥
html:
prādāttasmai sa viprāya vastraṃ ca sadṛśaṃ navam ।
nārīṃ cāpi vayopetāṃ bhartrā virahitāṃ tadā ॥32॥
slp1: prAdAttasmE sa viprAya vastraM ca sadfSaM navam । nArIM cApi vayopetAM BartrA virahitAM tadA ॥32॥

text: etatsamprāpya hṛṣṭātmā dasyoḥ sarvaṃ dvijastadā । tasmingṛhavare rājaṃstayā reme sa gautamaḥ ॥33॥
html:
etatsamprāpya hṛṣṭātmā dasyoḥ sarvaṃ dvijastadā ।
tasmingṛhavare rājaṃstayā reme sa gautamaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: etatsamprApya hfzwAtmA dasyoH sarvaM dvijastadA । tasmingfhavare rAjaMstayA reme sa gOtamaH ॥33॥

text: kuṭumbārtheṣu dasyoḥ sa sāhāyyaṃ cāpyathākarot । tatrāvasatso'tha varṣāḥ samṛddhe śabarālaye । bāṇavedhye paraṃ yatnamakaroccaiva gautamaḥ ॥34॥
html:
kuṭumbārtheṣu dasyoḥ sa sāhāyyaṃ cāpyathākarot ।
tatrāvasatso'tha varṣāḥ samṛddhe śabarālaye ।
bāṇavedhye paraṃ yatnamakaroccaiva gautamaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: kuwumbArTezu dasyoH sa sAhAyyaM cApyaTAkarot । tatrAvasatso'Ta varzAH samfdDe SabarAlaye । bARaveDye paraM yatnamakaroccEva gOtamaH ॥34॥

text: vakrāṅgāṃstu sa nityaṃ vai sarvato bāṇagocare । jaghāna gautamo rājanyathā dasyugaṇastathā ॥35॥
html:
vakrāṅgāṃstu sa nityaṃ vai sarvato bāṇagocare ।
jaghāna gautamo rājanyathā dasyugaṇastathā ॥35॥
slp1: vakrANgAMstu sa nityaM vE sarvato bARagocare । jaGAna gOtamo rAjanyaTA dasyugaRastaTA ॥35॥

text: hiṃsāparo ghṛṇāhīnaḥ sadā prāṇivadhe rataḥ । gautamaḥ sannikarṣeṇa dasyubhiḥ samatāmiyāt ॥36॥
html:
hiṃsāparo ghṛṇāhīnaḥ sadā prāṇivadhe rataḥ ।
gautamaḥ sannikarṣeṇa dasyubhiḥ samatāmiyāt ॥36॥
slp1: hiMsAparo GfRAhInaH sadA prARivaDe rataH । gOtamaH sannikarzeRa dasyuBiH samatAmiyAt ॥36॥

text: tathā tu vasatastasya dasyugrāme sukhaṃ tadā । agacchanbahavo māsā nighnataḥ pakṣiṇo bahūn ॥37॥
html:
tathā tu vasatastasya dasyugrāme sukhaṃ tadā ।
agacchanbahavo māsā nighnataḥ pakṣiṇo bahūn ॥37॥
slp1: taTA tu vasatastasya dasyugrAme suKaM tadA । agacCanbahavo mAsA niGnataH pakziRo bahUn ॥37॥

text: tataḥ kadācidaparo dvijastaṃ deśamāgamat । jaṭī cīrājinadharaḥ svādhyāyaparamaḥ śuciḥ ॥38॥
html:
tataḥ kadācidaparo dvijastaṃ deśamāgamat ।
jaṭī cīrājinadharaḥ svādhyāyaparamaḥ śuciḥ ॥38॥
slp1: tataH kadAcidaparo dvijastaM deSamAgamat । jawI cIrAjinaDaraH svADyAyaparamaH SuciH ॥38॥

text: vinīto niyatāhāro brahmaṇyo vedapāragaḥ । sabrahmacārī taddeśyaḥ sakhā tasyaiva supriyam । taṃ dasyugrāmamagamadyatrāsau gautamo'bhavat ॥39॥
html:
vinīto niyatāhāro brahmaṇyo vedapāragaḥ ।
sabrahmacārī taddeśyaḥ sakhā tasyaiva supriyam ।
taṃ dasyugrāmamagamadyatrāsau gautamo'bhavat ॥39॥
slp1: vinIto niyatAhAro brahmaRyo vedapAragaH । sabrahmacArI taddeSyaH saKA tasyEva supriyam । taM dasyugrAmamagamadyatrAsO gOtamo'Bavat ॥39॥

text: sa tu vipragṛhānveṣī śūdrānnaparivarjakaḥ । grāme dasyujanākīrṇe vyacaratsarvatodiśam ॥40॥
html:
sa tu vipragṛhānveṣī śūdrānnaparivarjakaḥ ।
grāme dasyujanākīrṇe vyacaratsarvatodiśam ॥40॥
slp1: sa tu vipragfhAnvezI SUdrAnnaparivarjakaH । grAme dasyujanAkIrRe vyacaratsarvatodiSam ॥40॥

text: tataḥ sa gautamagṛhaṃ praviveśa dvijottamaḥ । gautamaścāpi samprāptastāvanyonyena saṅgatau ॥41॥
html:
tataḥ sa gautamagṛhaṃ praviveśa dvijottamaḥ ।
gautamaścāpi samprāptastāvanyonyena saṅgatau ॥41॥
slp1: tataH sa gOtamagfhaM praviveSa dvijottamaH । gOtamaScApi samprAptastAvanyonyena saNgatO ॥41॥

text: vakrāṅgabhārahastaṃ taṃ dhanuṣpāṇiṃ kṛtāgasam । rudhireṇāvasiktāṅgaṃ gṛhadvāramupāgatam ॥42॥
html:
vakrāṅgabhārahastaṃ taṃ dhanuṣpāṇiṃ kṛtāgasam ।
rudhireṇāvasiktāṅgaṃ gṛhadvāramupāgatam ॥42॥
slp1: vakrANgaBArahastaM taM DanuzpARiM kftAgasam । ruDireRAvasiktANgaM gfhadvAramupAgatam ॥42॥

text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā puruṣādābhamapadhvastaṃ kṣayāgatam । abhijñāya dvijo vrīḍāmagamadvākyamāha ca ॥43॥
html:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā puruṣādābhamapadhvastaṃ kṣayāgatam ।
abhijñāya dvijo vrīḍāmagamadvākyamāha ca ॥43॥
slp1: taM dfzwvA puruzAdABamapaDvastaM kzayAgatam । aBijYAya dvijo vrIqAmagamadvAkyamAha ca ॥43॥

text: kimidaṃ kuruṣe mauḍhyādviprastvaṃ hi kulodgataḥ । madhyadeśaparijñāto dasyubhāvaṃ gataḥ katham ॥44॥
html:
kimidaṃ kuruṣe mauḍhyādviprastvaṃ hi kulodgataḥ ।
madhyadeśaparijñāto dasyubhāvaṃ gataḥ katham ॥44॥
slp1: kimidaM kuruze mOQyAdviprastvaM hi kulodgataH । maDyadeSaparijYAto dasyuBAvaM gataH kaTam ॥44॥

text: pūrvānsmara dvijāgryāṃstānprakhyātānvedapāragān । yeṣāṃ vaṃśe'bhijātastvamīdṛśaḥ kulapāṃsanaḥ ॥45॥
html:
pūrvānsmara dvijāgryāṃstānprakhyātānvedapāragān ।
yeṣāṃ vaṃśe'bhijātastvamīdṛśaḥ kulapāṃsanaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: pUrvAnsmara dvijAgryAMstAnpraKyAtAnvedapAragAn । yezAM vaMSe'BijAtastvamIdfSaH kulapAMsanaH ॥45॥

text: avabudhyātmanātmānaṃ satyaṃ śīlaṃ śrutaṃ damam । anukrośaṃ ca saṃsmṛtya tyaja vāsamimaṃ dvija ॥46॥
html:
avabudhyātmanātmānaṃ satyaṃ śīlaṃ śrutaṃ damam ।
anukrośaṃ ca saṃsmṛtya tyaja vāsamimaṃ dvija ॥46॥
slp1: avabuDyAtmanAtmAnaM satyaM SIlaM SrutaM damam । anukroSaM ca saMsmftya tyaja vAsamimaM dvija ॥46॥

text: evamuktaḥ sa suhṛdā tadā tena hitaiṣiṇā । pratyuvāca tato rājanviniścitya tadārtavat ॥47॥
html:
evamuktaḥ sa suhṛdā tadā tena hitaiṣiṇā ।
pratyuvāca tato rājanviniścitya tadārtavat ॥47॥
slp1: evamuktaH sa suhfdA tadA tena hitEziRA । pratyuvAca tato rAjanviniScitya tadArtavat ॥47॥

text: adhano'smi dvijaśreṣṭha na ca vedavidapyaham । vṛttyarthamiha samprāptaṃ viddhi māṃ dvijasattama ॥48॥
html:
adhano'smi dvijaśreṣṭha na ca vedavidapyaham ।
vṛttyarthamiha samprāptaṃ viddhi māṃ dvijasattama ॥48॥
slp1: aDano'smi dvijaSrezWa na ca vedavidapyaham । vfttyarTamiha samprAptaM vidDi mAM dvijasattama ॥48॥

text: tvaddarśanāttu viprarṣe kṛtārthaṃ vedmyahaṃ dvija । ātmānaṃ saha yāsyāvaḥ śvo vasādyeha śarvarīm] ॥49॥
html:
tvaddarśanāttu viprarṣe kṛtārthaṃ vedmyahaṃ dvija ।
ātmānaṃ saha yāsyāvaḥ śvo vasādyeha śarvarīm] ॥49॥
slp1: tvaddarSanAttu viprarze kftArTaM vedmyahaM dvija । AtmAnaM saha yAsyAvaH Svo vasAdyeha SarvarIm] ॥49॥

text: tasyāṃ niśāyāṃ vyuṣṭāyāṃ gate tasmindvijottame । niṣkramya gautamo'gacchatsamudraṃ prati bhārata ॥1॥
html:
tasyāṃ niśāyāṃ vyuṣṭāyāṃ gate tasmindvijottame ।
niṣkramya gautamo'gacchatsamudraṃ prati bhārata ॥1॥
slp1: tasyAM niSAyAM vyuzwAyAM gate tasmindvijottame । nizkramya gOtamo'gacCatsamudraM prati BArata ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sāmudrakānsa vaṇijastato'paśyatsthitānpathi । sa tena sārthena saha prayayau sāgaraṃ prati ॥2॥
html:
sāmudrakānsa vaṇijastato'paśyatsthitānpathi ।
sa tena sārthena saha prayayau sāgaraṃ prati ॥2॥
slp1: sAmudrakAnsa vaRijastato'paSyatsTitAnpaTi । sa tena sArTena saha prayayO sAgaraM prati ॥2॥

text: sa tu sārtho mahārāja kasmiṃścidgirigahvare । mattena dviradenātha nihataḥ prāyaśo'bhavat ॥3॥
html:
sa tu sārtho mahārāja kasmiṃścidgirigahvare ।
mattena dviradenātha nihataḥ prāyaśo'bhavat ॥3॥
slp1: sa tu sArTo mahArAja kasmiMScidgirigahvare । mattena dviradenATa nihataH prAyaSo'Bavat ॥3॥

text: sa kathañcittatastasmātsārthānmukto dvijastadā । kāndigbhūto jīvitārthī pradudrāvottarāṃ diśam ॥4॥
html:
sa kathañcittatastasmātsārthānmukto dvijastadā ।
kāndigbhūto jīvitārthī pradudrāvottarāṃ diśam ॥4॥
slp1: sa kaTaYcittatastasmAtsArTAnmukto dvijastadA । kAndigBUto jIvitArTI pradudrAvottarAM diSam ॥4॥

text: sa sarvataḥ paribhraṣṭaḥ sārthāddeśāttathārthataḥ । ekākī vyadravattatra vane kiṃpuruṣo yathā ॥5॥
html:
sa sarvataḥ paribhraṣṭaḥ sārthāddeśāttathārthataḥ ।
ekākī vyadravattatra vane kiṃpuruṣo yathā ॥5॥
slp1: sa sarvataH pariBrazwaH sArTAddeSAttaTArTataH । ekAkI vyadravattatra vane kiMpuruzo yaTA ॥5॥

text: sa panthānamathāsādya samudrābhisaraṃ tadā । āsasāda vanaṃ ramyaṃ mahatpuṣpitapādapam ॥6॥
html:
sa panthānamathāsādya samudrābhisaraṃ tadā ।
āsasāda vanaṃ ramyaṃ mahatpuṣpitapādapam ॥6॥
slp1: sa panTAnamaTAsAdya samudrABisaraM tadA । AsasAda vanaM ramyaM mahatpuzpitapAdapam ॥6॥

text: sarvartukairāmravanaiḥ puṣpitairupaśobhitam । nandanoddeśasadṛśaṃ yakṣakinnarasevitam ॥7॥
html:
sarvartukairāmravanaiḥ puṣpitairupaśobhitam ।
nandanoddeśasadṛśaṃ yakṣakinnarasevitam ॥7॥
slp1: sarvartukErAmravanEH puzpitErupaSoBitam । nandanoddeSasadfSaM yakzakinnarasevitam ॥7॥

text: śālatāladhavāśvatthatvacāguruvanaistathā । candanasya ca mukhyasya pādapairupaśobhitam । giriprastheṣu ramyeṣu śubheṣu susugandhiṣu ॥8॥
html:
śālatāladhavāśvatthatvacāguruvanaistathā ।
candanasya ca mukhyasya pādapairupaśobhitam ।
giriprastheṣu ramyeṣu śubheṣu susugandhiṣu ॥8॥
slp1: SAlatAlaDavASvatTatvacAguruvanEstaTA । candanasya ca muKyasya pAdapErupaSoBitam । giriprasTezu ramyezu SuBezu susuganDizu ॥8॥

text: samantato dvijaśreṣṭhā valgu kūjanti tatra vai । manuṣyavadanāstvanye bhāruṇḍā iti viśrutāḥ । bhūliṅgaśakunāścānye samudraṃ sarvato'bhavan ॥9॥
html:
samantato dvijaśreṣṭhā valgu kūjanti tatra vai ।
manuṣyavadanāstvanye bhāruṇḍā iti viśrutāḥ ।
bhūliṅgaśakunāścānye samudraṃ sarvato'bhavan ॥9॥
slp1: samantato dvijaSrezWA valgu kUjanti tatra vE । manuzyavadanAstvanye BAruRqA iti viSrutAH । BUliNgaSakunAScAnye samudraM sarvato'Bavan ॥9॥

text: sa tānyatimanojñāni vihaṅgābhirutāni vai । śṛṇvansuramaṇīyāni vipro'gacchata gautamaḥ ॥10॥
html:
sa tānyatimanojñāni vihaṅgābhirutāni vai ।
śṛṇvansuramaṇīyāni vipro'gacchata gautamaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: sa tAnyatimanojYAni vihaNgABirutAni vE । SfRvansuramaRIyAni vipro'gacCata gOtamaH ॥10॥

text: tato'paśyatsuramye sa suvarṇasikatācite । deśabhāge same citre svargoddeśasamaprabhe ॥11॥
html:
tato'paśyatsuramye sa suvarṇasikatācite ।
deśabhāge same citre svargoddeśasamaprabhe ॥11॥
slp1: tato'paSyatsuramye sa suvarRasikatAcite । deSaBAge same citre svargoddeSasamapraBe ॥11॥

text: śriyā juṣṭaṃ mahāvṛkṣaṃ nyagrodhaṃ parimaṇḍalam । śākhābhiranurūpābhirbhūṣitaṃ chatrasannibham ॥12॥
html:
śriyā juṣṭaṃ mahāvṛkṣaṃ nyagrodhaṃ parimaṇḍalam ।
śākhābhiranurūpābhirbhūṣitaṃ chatrasannibham ॥12॥
slp1: SriyA juzwaM mahAvfkzaM nyagroDaM parimaRqalam । SAKABiranurUpABirBUzitaM CatrasanniBam ॥12॥

text: tasya mūlaṃ susaṃsiktaṃ varacandanavāriṇā । divyapuṣpānvitaṃ śrīmatpitāmahasadopamam ॥13॥
html:
tasya mūlaṃ susaṃsiktaṃ varacandanavāriṇā ।
divyapuṣpānvitaṃ śrīmatpitāmahasadopamam ॥13॥
slp1: tasya mUlaM susaMsiktaM varacandanavAriRA । divyapuzpAnvitaM SrImatpitAmahasadopamam ॥13॥

text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā gautamaḥ prīto munikāntamanuttamam । medhyaṃ suragṛhaprakhyaṃ puṣpitaiḥ pādapairvṛtam । tamāgamya mudā yuktastasyādhastādupāviśat ॥14॥
html:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā gautamaḥ prīto munikāntamanuttamam ।
medhyaṃ suragṛhaprakhyaṃ puṣpitaiḥ pādapairvṛtam ।
tamāgamya mudā yuktastasyādhastādupāviśat ॥14॥
slp1: taM dfzwvA gOtamaH prIto munikAntamanuttamam । meDyaM suragfhapraKyaM puzpitEH pAdapErvftam । tamAgamya mudA yuktastasyADastAdupAviSat ॥14॥

text: tatrāsīnasya kauravya gautamasya sukhaḥ śivaḥ । puṣpāṇi samupaspṛśya pravavāvanilaḥ śuciḥ । hlādayansarvagātrāṇi gautamasya tadā nṛpa ॥15॥
html:
tatrāsīnasya kauravya gautamasya sukhaḥ śivaḥ ।
puṣpāṇi samupaspṛśya pravavāvanilaḥ śuciḥ ।
hlādayansarvagātrāṇi gautamasya tadā nṛpa ॥15॥
slp1: tatrAsInasya kOravya gOtamasya suKaH SivaH । puzpARi samupaspfSya pravavAvanilaH SuciH । hlAdayansarvagAtrARi gOtamasya tadA nfpa ॥15॥

text: sa tu vipraḥ pariśrāntaḥ spṛṣṭaḥ puṇyena vāyunā । sukhamāsādya suṣvāpa bhāskaraścāstamabhyagāt ॥16॥
html:
sa tu vipraḥ pariśrāntaḥ spṛṣṭaḥ puṇyena vāyunā ।
sukhamāsādya suṣvāpa bhāskaraścāstamabhyagāt ॥16॥
slp1: sa tu vipraH pariSrAntaH spfzwaH puRyena vAyunA । suKamAsAdya suzvApa BAskaraScAstamaByagAt ॥16॥

text: tato'staṃ bhāskare yāte sandhyākāla upasthite । ājagāma svabhavanaṃ brahmalokātkhagottamaḥ ॥17॥
html:
tato'staṃ bhāskare yāte sandhyākāla upasthite ।
ājagāma svabhavanaṃ brahmalokātkhagottamaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: tato'staM BAskare yAte sanDyAkAla upasTite । AjagAma svaBavanaM brahmalokAtKagottamaH ॥17॥

text: nāḍījaṅgha iti khyāto dayito brahmaṇaḥ sakhā । bakarājo mahāprājñaḥ kaśyapasyātmasambhavaḥ ॥18॥
html:
nāḍījaṅgha iti khyāto dayito brahmaṇaḥ sakhā ।
bakarājo mahāprājñaḥ kaśyapasyātmasambhavaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: nAqIjaNGa iti KyAto dayito brahmaRaH saKA । bakarAjo mahAprAjYaH kaSyapasyAtmasamBavaH ॥18॥

text: rājadharmeti vikhyāto babhūvāpratimo bhuvi । devakanyāsutaḥ śrīmānvidvāndevapatiprabhaḥ ॥19॥
html:
rājadharmeti vikhyāto babhūvāpratimo bhuvi ।
devakanyāsutaḥ śrīmānvidvāndevapatiprabhaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: rAjaDarmeti viKyAto baBUvApratimo Buvi । devakanyAsutaH SrImAnvidvAndevapatipraBaH ॥19॥

text: mṛṣṭahāṭakasañchanno bhūṣaṇairarkasannibhaiḥ । bhūṣitaḥ sarvagātreṣu devagarbhaḥ śriyā jvalan ॥20॥
html:
mṛṣṭahāṭakasañchanno bhūṣaṇairarkasannibhaiḥ ।
bhūṣitaḥ sarvagātreṣu devagarbhaḥ śriyā jvalan ॥20॥
slp1: mfzwahAwakasaYCanno BUzaRErarkasanniBEH । BUzitaH sarvagAtrezu devagarBaH SriyA jvalan ॥20॥

text: tamāgataṃ dvijaṃ dṛṣṭvā vismito gautamo'bhavat । kṣutpipāsāparītātmā hiṃsārthī cāpyavaikṣata ॥21॥
html:
tamāgataṃ dvijaṃ dṛṣṭvā vismito gautamo'bhavat ।
kṣutpipāsāparītātmā hiṃsārthī cāpyavaikṣata ॥21॥
slp1: tamAgataM dvijaM dfzwvA vismito gOtamo'Bavat । kzutpipAsAparItAtmA hiMsArTI cApyavEkzata ॥21॥

text: svāgataṃ bhavate vipra diṣṭyā prāpto'si me gṛham । astaṃ ca savitā yātaḥ sandhyeyaṃ samupasthitā ॥22॥
html:
svāgataṃ bhavate vipra diṣṭyā prāpto'si me gṛham ।
astaṃ ca savitā yātaḥ sandhyeyaṃ samupasthitā ॥22॥
