slp1: svAgataM Bavate vipra dizwyA prApto'si me gfham । astaM ca savitA yAtaH sanDyeyaM samupasTitA ॥22॥
author: rājadharmovāca ।

text: mama tvaṃ nilayaṃ prāptaḥ priyātithiraninditaḥ । pūjito yāsyasi prātarvidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā] ॥23॥
html:
mama tvaṃ nilayaṃ prāptaḥ priyātithiraninditaḥ ।
pūjito yāsyasi prātarvidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā] ॥23॥
slp1: mama tvaM nilayaM prAptaH priyAtiTiraninditaH । pUjito yAsyasi prAtarviDidfzwena karmaRA] ॥23॥

text: giraṃ tāṃ madhurāṃ śrutvā gautamo vismitastadā । kautūhalānvito rājanrājadharmāṇamaikṣata ॥1॥
html:
giraṃ tāṃ madhurāṃ śrutvā gautamo vismitastadā ।
kautūhalānvito rājanrājadharmāṇamaikṣata ॥1॥
slp1: giraM tAM maDurAM SrutvA gOtamo vismitastadA । kOtUhalAnvito rAjanrAjaDarmARamEkzata ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: bhoḥ kaśyapasya putro'haṃ mātā dākṣāyaṇī ca me । atithistvaṃ guṇopetaḥ svāgataṃ te dvijarṣabha ॥2॥
html:
bhoḥ kaśyapasya putro'haṃ mātā dākṣāyaṇī ca me ।
atithistvaṃ guṇopetaḥ svāgataṃ te dvijarṣabha ॥2॥
slp1: BoH kaSyapasya putro'haM mAtA dAkzAyaRI ca me । atiTistvaM guRopetaH svAgataM te dvijarzaBa ॥2॥
author: rājadharmovāca ।

text: tasmai dattvā sa satkāraṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā । śālapuṣpamayīṃ divyāṃ bṛsīṃ samupakalpayat ॥3॥
html:
tasmai dattvā sa satkāraṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ।
śālapuṣpamayīṃ divyāṃ bṛsīṃ samupakalpayat ॥3॥
slp1: tasmE dattvA sa satkAraM viDidfzwena karmaRA । SAlapuzpamayIM divyAM bfsIM samupakalpayat ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: bhagīratharathākrāntāndeśāngaṅgāniṣevitān । ye caranti mahāmīnāstāṃśca tasyānvakalpayat ॥4॥
html:
bhagīratharathākrāntāndeśāngaṅgāniṣevitān ।
ye caranti mahāmīnāstāṃśca tasyānvakalpayat ॥4॥
slp1: BagIraTaraTAkrAntAndeSAngaNgAnizevitAn । ye caranti mahAmInAstAMSca tasyAnvakalpayat ॥4॥

text: vahniṃ cāpi susandīptaṃ mīnāṃścaiva supīvarān । sa gautamāyātithaye nyavedayata kāśyapaḥ ॥5॥
html:
vahniṃ cāpi susandīptaṃ mīnāṃścaiva supīvarān ।
sa gautamāyātithaye nyavedayata kāśyapaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: vahniM cApi susandIptaM mInAMScEva supIvarAn । sa gOtamAyAtiTaye nyavedayata kASyapaH ॥5॥

text: bhuktavantaṃ ca taṃ vipraṃ prītātmānaṃ mahāmanāḥ । klamāpanayanārthaṃ sa pakṣābhyāmabhyavījayat ॥6॥
html:
bhuktavantaṃ ca taṃ vipraṃ prītātmānaṃ mahāmanāḥ ।
klamāpanayanārthaṃ sa pakṣābhyāmabhyavījayat ॥6॥
slp1: BuktavantaM ca taM vipraM prItAtmAnaM mahAmanAH । klamApanayanArTaM sa pakzAByAmaByavIjayat ॥6॥

text: tato viśrāntamāsīnaṃ gotrapraśnamapṛcchata । so'bravīdgautamo'smīti brāhma nānyadudāharat ॥7॥
html:
tato viśrāntamāsīnaṃ gotrapraśnamapṛcchata ।
so'bravīdgautamo'smīti brāhma nānyadudāharat ॥7॥
slp1: tato viSrAntamAsInaM gotrapraSnamapfcCata । so'bravIdgOtamo'smIti brAhma nAnyadudAharat ॥7॥

text: tasmai parṇamayaṃ divyaṃ divyapuṣpādhivāsitam । gandhāḍhyaṃ śayanaṃ prādātsa śiśye tatra vai sukham ॥8॥
html:
tasmai parṇamayaṃ divyaṃ divyapuṣpādhivāsitam ।
gandhāḍhyaṃ śayanaṃ prādātsa śiśye tatra vai sukham ॥8॥
slp1: tasmE parRamayaM divyaM divyapuzpADivAsitam । ganDAQyaM SayanaM prAdAtsa SiSye tatra vE suKam ॥8॥

text: athopaviṣṭaṃ śayane gautamaṃ bakarāṭtadā । papraccha kāśyapo vāgmī kimāgamanakāraṇam ॥9॥
html:
athopaviṣṭaṃ śayane gautamaṃ bakarāṭtadā ।
papraccha kāśyapo vāgmī kimāgamanakāraṇam ॥9॥
slp1: aTopavizwaM Sayane gOtamaM bakarAwtadA । papracCa kASyapo vAgmI kimAgamanakAraRam ॥9॥

text: tato'bravīdgautamastaṃ daridro'haṃ mahāmate । samudragamanākāṅkṣī dravyārthamiti bhārata ॥10॥
html:
tato'bravīdgautamastaṃ daridro'haṃ mahāmate ।
samudragamanākāṅkṣī dravyārthamiti bhārata ॥10॥
slp1: tato'bravIdgOtamastaM daridro'haM mahAmate । samudragamanAkANkzI dravyArTamiti BArata ॥10॥

text: taṃ kāśyapo'bravītprīto notkaṇṭhāṃ kartumarhasi । kṛtakāryo dvijaśreṣṭha sadravyo yāsyase gṛhān ॥11॥
html:
taṃ kāśyapo'bravītprīto notkaṇṭhāṃ kartumarhasi ।
kṛtakāryo dvijaśreṣṭha sadravyo yāsyase gṛhān ॥11॥
slp1: taM kASyapo'bravItprIto notkaRWAM kartumarhasi । kftakAryo dvijaSrezWa sadravyo yAsyase gfhAn ॥11॥

text: caturvidhā hyarthagatirbṛhaspatimataṃ yathā । pāraṃparyaṃ tathā daivaṃ karma mitramiti prabho ॥12॥
html:
caturvidhā hyarthagatirbṛhaspatimataṃ yathā ।
pāraṃparyaṃ tathā daivaṃ karma mitramiti prabho ॥12॥
slp1: caturviDA hyarTagatirbfhaspatimataM yaTA । pAraMparyaM taTA dEvaM karma mitramiti praBo ॥12॥

text: prādurbhūto'smi te mitraṃ suhṛttvaṃ ca mama tvayi । so'haṃ tathā yatiṣyāmi bhaviṣyasi yathārthavān ॥13॥
html:
prādurbhūto'smi te mitraṃ suhṛttvaṃ ca mama tvayi ।
so'haṃ tathā yatiṣyāmi bhaviṣyasi yathārthavān ॥13॥
slp1: prAdurBUto'smi te mitraM suhfttvaM ca mama tvayi । so'haM taTA yatizyAmi Bavizyasi yaTArTavAn ॥13॥

text: tataḥ prabhātasamaye sukhaṃ pṛṣṭvābravīdidam । gaccha saumya pathānena kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyasi ॥14॥
html:
tataḥ prabhātasamaye sukhaṃ pṛṣṭvābravīdidam ।
gaccha saumya pathānena kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyasi ॥14॥
slp1: tataH praBAtasamaye suKaM pfzwvAbravIdidam । gacCa sOmya paTAnena kftakftyo Bavizyasi ॥14॥

text: itastriyojanaṃ gatvā rākṣasādhipatirmahān । virūpākṣa iti khyātaḥ sakhā mama mahābalaḥ ॥15॥
html:
itastriyojanaṃ gatvā rākṣasādhipatirmahān ।
virūpākṣa iti khyātaḥ sakhā mama mahābalaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: itastriyojanaM gatvA rAkzasADipatirmahAn । virUpAkza iti KyAtaH saKA mama mahAbalaH ॥15॥

text: taṃ gaccha dvijamukhya tvaṃ mama vākyapracoditaḥ । kāmānabhīpsitāṃstubhyaṃ dātā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ॥16॥
html:
taṃ gaccha dvijamukhya tvaṃ mama vākyapracoditaḥ ।
kāmānabhīpsitāṃstubhyaṃ dātā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: taM gacCa dvijamuKya tvaM mama vAkyapracoditaH । kAmAnaBIpsitAMstuByaM dAtA nAstyatra saMSayaH ॥16॥

text: ityuktaḥ prayayau rājangautamo vigataklamaḥ । phalānyamṛtakalpāni bhakṣayansma yatheṣṭataḥ ॥17॥
html:
ityuktaḥ prayayau rājangautamo vigataklamaḥ ।
phalānyamṛtakalpāni bhakṣayansma yatheṣṭataḥ ॥17॥
slp1: ityuktaH prayayO rAjangOtamo vigataklamaH । PalAnyamftakalpAni Bakzayansma yaTezwataH ॥17॥

text: candanāgurumukhyāni tvakpatrāṇāṃ vanāni ca । tasminpathi mahārāja sevamāno drutaṃ yayau ॥18॥
html:
candanāgurumukhyāni tvakpatrāṇāṃ vanāni ca ।
tasminpathi mahārāja sevamāno drutaṃ yayau ॥18॥
slp1: candanAgurumuKyAni tvakpatrARAM vanAni ca । tasminpaTi mahArAja sevamAno drutaM yayO ॥18॥

text: tato meruvrajaṃ nāma nagaraṃ śailatoraṇam । śailaprākāravapraṃ ca śailayantrārgalaṃ tathā ॥19॥
html:
tato meruvrajaṃ nāma nagaraṃ śailatoraṇam ।
śailaprākāravapraṃ ca śailayantrārgalaṃ tathā ॥19॥
slp1: tato meruvrajaM nAma nagaraM SElatoraRam । SElaprAkAravapraM ca SElayantrArgalaM taTA ॥19॥

text: viditaścābhavattasya rākṣasendrasya dhīmataḥ । prahitaḥ suhṛdā rājanprīyatā vai priyātithiḥ ॥20॥
html:
viditaścābhavattasya rākṣasendrasya dhīmataḥ ।
prahitaḥ suhṛdā rājanprīyatā vai priyātithiḥ ॥20॥
slp1: viditaScABavattasya rAkzasendrasya DImataH । prahitaH suhfdA rAjanprIyatA vE priyAtiTiH ॥20॥

text: tataḥ sa rākṣasendraḥ svānpreṣyānāha yudhiṣṭhira । gautamo nagaradvārācchīghramānīyatāmiti ॥21॥
html:
tataḥ sa rākṣasendraḥ svānpreṣyānāha yudhiṣṭhira ।
gautamo nagaradvārācchīghramānīyatāmiti ॥21॥
slp1: tataH sa rAkzasendraH svAnprezyAnAha yuDizWira । gOtamo nagaradvArAcCIGramAnIyatAmiti ॥21॥

text: tataḥ puravarāttasmātpuruṣāḥ śvetaveṣṭanāḥ । gautametyabhibhāṣantaḥ puradvāramupāgaman ॥22॥
html:
tataḥ puravarāttasmātpuruṣāḥ śvetaveṣṭanāḥ ।
gautametyabhibhāṣantaḥ puradvāramupāgaman ॥22॥
slp1: tataH puravarAttasmAtpuruzAH SvetavezwanAH । gOtametyaBiBAzantaH puradvAramupAgaman ॥22॥

text: te tamūcurmahārāja preṣyā rakṣaḥpaterdvijam । tvarasva tūrṇamāgaccha rājā tvāṃ draṣṭumicchati ॥23॥
html:
te tamūcurmahārāja preṣyā rakṣaḥpaterdvijam ।
tvarasva tūrṇamāgaccha rājā tvāṃ draṣṭumicchati ॥23॥
slp1: te tamUcurmahArAja prezyA rakzaHpaterdvijam । tvarasva tUrRamAgacCa rAjA tvAM drazwumicCati ॥23॥

text: rākṣasādhipatirvīro virūpākṣa iti śrutaḥ । sa tvāṃ tvarati vai draṣṭuṃ tatkṣipraṃ saṃvidhīyatām ॥24॥
html:
rākṣasādhipatirvīro virūpākṣa iti śrutaḥ ।
sa tvāṃ tvarati vai draṣṭuṃ tatkṣipraṃ saṃvidhīyatām ॥24॥
slp1: rAkzasADipatirvIro virUpAkza iti SrutaH । sa tvAM tvarati vE drazwuM tatkzipraM saMviDIyatAm ॥24॥

text: tataḥ sa prādravadvipro vismayādvigataklamaḥ । gautamo nagararddhiṃ tāṃ paśyanparamavismitaḥ ॥25॥
html:
tataḥ sa prādravadvipro vismayādvigataklamaḥ ।
gautamo nagararddhiṃ tāṃ paśyanparamavismitaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: tataH sa prAdravadvipro vismayAdvigataklamaH । gOtamo nagarardDiM tAM paSyanparamavismitaH ॥25॥

text: taireva sahito rājño veśma tūrṇamupādravat । darśanaṃ rākṣasendrasya kāṅkṣamāṇo dvijastadā] ॥26॥
html:
taireva sahito rājño veśma tūrṇamupādravat ।
darśanaṃ rākṣasendrasya kāṅkṣamāṇo dvijastadā] ॥26॥
slp1: tEreva sahito rAjYo veSma tUrRamupAdravat । darSanaM rAkzasendrasya kANkzamARo dvijastadA] ॥26॥

text: tataḥ sa vidito rājñaḥ praviśya gṛhamuttamam । pūjito rākṣasendreṇa niṣasādāsanottame ॥1॥
html:
tataḥ sa vidito rājñaḥ praviśya gṛhamuttamam ।
pūjito rākṣasendreṇa niṣasādāsanottame ॥1॥
slp1: tataH sa vidito rAjYaH praviSya gfhamuttamam । pUjito rAkzasendreRa nizasAdAsanottame ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: pṛṣṭaśca gotracaraṇaṃ svādhyāyaṃ brahmacārikam । na tatra vyājahārānyadgotramātrādṛte dvijaḥ ॥2॥
html:
pṛṣṭaśca gotracaraṇaṃ svādhyāyaṃ brahmacārikam ।
na tatra vyājahārānyadgotramātrādṛte dvijaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: pfzwaSca gotracaraRaM svADyAyaM brahmacArikam । na tatra vyAjahArAnyadgotramAtrAdfte dvijaH ॥2॥

text: brahmavarcasahīnasya svādhyāyaviratasya ca । gotramātravido rājā nivāsaṃ samapṛcchata ॥3॥
html:
brahmavarcasahīnasya svādhyāyaviratasya ca ।
gotramātravido rājā nivāsaṃ samapṛcchata ॥3॥
slp1: brahmavarcasahInasya svADyAyaviratasya ca । gotramAtravido rAjA nivAsaM samapfcCata ॥3॥

text: kva te nivāsaḥ kalyāṇa kiṅgotrā brāhmaṇī ca te । tattvaṃ brūhi na bhīḥ kāryā viśramasva yathāsukham ॥4॥
html:
kva te nivāsaḥ kalyāṇa kiṅgotrā brāhmaṇī ca te ।
tattvaṃ brūhi na bhīḥ kāryā viśramasva yathāsukham ॥4॥
slp1: kva te nivAsaH kalyARa kiNgotrA brAhmaRI ca te । tattvaM brUhi na BIH kAryA viSramasva yaTAsuKam ॥4॥

text: madhyadeśaprasūto'haṃ vāso me śabarālaye । śūdrā punarbhūrbhāryā me satyametadbravīmi te ॥5॥
html:
madhyadeśaprasūto'haṃ vāso me śabarālaye ।
śūdrā punarbhūrbhāryā me satyametadbravīmi te ॥5॥
slp1: maDyadeSaprasUto'haM vAso me SabarAlaye । SUdrA punarBUrBAryA me satyametadbravImi te ॥5॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: tato rājā vimamṛśe kathaṃ kāryamidaṃ bhavet । kathaṃ vā sukṛtaṃ me syāditi buddhyānvacintayat ॥6॥
html:
tato rājā vimamṛśe kathaṃ kāryamidaṃ bhavet ।
kathaṃ vā sukṛtaṃ me syāditi buddhyānvacintayat ॥6॥
slp1: tato rAjA vimamfSe kaTaM kAryamidaM Bavet । kaTaM vA sukftaM me syAditi budDyAnvacintayat ॥6॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ayaṃ vai jananādvipraḥ suhṛttasya mahātmanaḥ । sampreṣitaśca tenāyaṃ kāśyapena mamāntikam ॥7॥
html:
ayaṃ vai jananādvipraḥ suhṛttasya mahātmanaḥ ।
sampreṣitaśca tenāyaṃ kāśyapena mamāntikam ॥7॥
slp1: ayaM vE jananAdvipraH suhfttasya mahAtmanaH । samprezitaSca tenAyaM kASyapena mamAntikam ॥7॥

text: tasya priyaṃ kariṣyāmi sa hi māmāśritaḥ sadā । bhrātā me bāndhavaścāsau sakhā ca hṛdayaṅgamaḥ ॥8॥
html:
tasya priyaṃ kariṣyāmi sa hi māmāśritaḥ sadā ।
bhrātā me bāndhavaścāsau sakhā ca hṛdayaṅgamaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tasya priyaM karizyAmi sa hi mAmASritaH sadA । BrAtA me bAnDavaScAsO saKA ca hfdayaNgamaH ॥8॥

text: kārttikyāmadya bhoktāraḥ sahasraṃ me dvijottamāḥ । tatrāyamapi bhoktā vai deyamasmai ca me dhanam ॥9॥
html:
kārttikyāmadya bhoktāraḥ sahasraṃ me dvijottamāḥ ।
tatrāyamapi bhoktā vai deyamasmai ca me dhanam ॥9॥
slp1: kArttikyAmadya BoktAraH sahasraM me dvijottamAH । tatrAyamapi BoktA vE deyamasmE ca me Danam ॥9॥

text: tataḥ sahasraṃ viprāṇāṃ viduṣāṃ samalaṅkṛtam । snātānāmanusamprāptamahatakṣaumavāsasām ॥10॥
html:
tataḥ sahasraṃ viprāṇāṃ viduṣāṃ samalaṅkṛtam ।
snātānāmanusamprāptamahatakṣaumavāsasām ॥10॥
slp1: tataH sahasraM viprARAM viduzAM samalaNkftam । snAtAnAmanusamprAptamahatakzOmavAsasAm ॥10॥

text: tānāgatāndvijaśreṣṭhānvirūpākṣo viśāmpate । yathārhaṃ pratijagrāha vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ॥11॥
html:
tānāgatāndvijaśreṣṭhānvirūpākṣo viśāmpate ।
yathārhaṃ pratijagrāha vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ॥11॥
slp1: tAnAgatAndvijaSrezWAnvirUpAkzo viSAmpate । yaTArhaM pratijagrAha viDidfzwena karmaRA ॥11॥

text: bṛsyasteṣāṃ tu saṃnyastā rākṣasendrasya śāsanāt । bhūmau varakuthāstīrṇāḥ preṣyairbharatasattama ॥12॥
html:
bṛsyasteṣāṃ tu saṃnyastā rākṣasendrasya śāsanāt ।
bhūmau varakuthāstīrṇāḥ preṣyairbharatasattama ॥12॥
slp1: bfsyastezAM tu saMnyastA rAkzasendrasya SAsanAt । BUmO varakuTAstIrRAH prezyErBaratasattama ॥12॥

text: tāsu te pūjitā rājñā niṣaṇṇā dvijasattamāḥ । vyarājanta mahārāja nakṣatrapatayo yathā ॥13॥
html:
tāsu te pūjitā rājñā niṣaṇṇā dvijasattamāḥ ।
vyarājanta mahārāja nakṣatrapatayo yathā ॥13॥
slp1: tAsu te pUjitA rAjYA nizaRRA dvijasattamAH । vyarAjanta mahArAja nakzatrapatayo yaTA ॥13॥

text: tato jāmbūnadāḥ pātrīrvajrāṅkā vimalāḥ śubhāḥ । varānnapūrṇā viprebhyaḥ prādānmadhughṛtāplutāḥ ॥14॥
html:
tato jāmbūnadāḥ pātrīrvajrāṅkā vimalāḥ śubhāḥ ।
varānnapūrṇā viprebhyaḥ prādānmadhughṛtāplutāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: tato jAmbUnadAH pAtrIrvajrANkA vimalAH SuBAH । varAnnapUrRA vipreByaH prAdAnmaDuGftAplutAH ॥14॥

text: tasya nityaṃ tathāṣāḍhyāṃ māghyāṃ ca bahavo dvijāḥ । īpsitaṃ bhojanavaraṃ labhante satkṛtaṃ sadā ॥15॥
html:
tasya nityaṃ tathāṣāḍhyāṃ māghyāṃ ca bahavo dvijāḥ ।
īpsitaṃ bhojanavaraṃ labhante satkṛtaṃ sadā ॥15॥
slp1: tasya nityaM taTAzAQyAM mAGyAM ca bahavo dvijAH । IpsitaM BojanavaraM laBante satkftaM sadA ॥15॥

text: viśeṣatastu kārttikyāṃ dvijebhyaḥ samprayacchati । śaradvyapāye ratnāni paurṇamāsyāmiti śrutiḥ ॥16॥
html:
viśeṣatastu kārttikyāṃ dvijebhyaḥ samprayacchati ।
śaradvyapāye ratnāni paurṇamāsyāmiti śrutiḥ ॥16॥
slp1: viSezatastu kArttikyAM dvijeByaH samprayacCati । SaradvyapAye ratnAni pOrRamAsyAmiti SrutiH ॥16॥

text: suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ caiva maṇīnatha ca mauktikam । vajrānmahādhanāṃścaiva vaiḍūryājinarāṅkavān ॥17॥
html:
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ caiva maṇīnatha ca mauktikam ।
vajrānmahādhanāṃścaiva vaiḍūryājinarāṅkavān ॥17॥
slp1: suvarRaM rajataM cEva maRInaTa ca mOktikam । vajrAnmahADanAMScEva vEqUryAjinarANkavAn ॥17॥

text: ratnarāśīnvinikṣipya dakṣiṇārthe sa bhārata । tataḥ prāha dvijaśreṣṭhānvirūpākṣo mahāyaśāḥ ॥18॥
html:
ratnarāśīnvinikṣipya dakṣiṇārthe sa bhārata ।
tataḥ prāha dvijaśreṣṭhānvirūpākṣo mahāyaśāḥ ॥18॥
slp1: ratnarASInvinikzipya dakziRArTe sa BArata । tataH prAha dvijaSrezWAnvirUpAkzo mahAyaSAH ॥18॥

text: gṛhṇīta ratnānyetāni yathotsāhaṃ yatheṣṭataḥ । yeṣu yeṣu ca bhāṇḍeṣu bhuktaṃ vo dvijasattamāḥ । tānyevādāya gacchadhvaṃ svaveśmānīti bhārata ॥19॥
html:
gṛhṇīta ratnānyetāni yathotsāhaṃ yatheṣṭataḥ ।
yeṣu yeṣu ca bhāṇḍeṣu bhuktaṃ vo dvijasattamāḥ ।
tānyevādāya gacchadhvaṃ svaveśmānīti bhārata ॥19॥
slp1: gfhRIta ratnAnyetAni yaTotsAhaM yaTezwataH । yezu yezu ca BARqezu BuktaM vo dvijasattamAH । tAnyevAdAya gacCaDvaM svaveSmAnIti BArata ॥19॥

text: ityuktavacane tasminrākṣasendre mahātmani । yatheṣṭaṃ tāni ratnāni jagṛhurbrāhmaṇarṣabhāḥ ॥20॥
html:
ityuktavacane tasminrākṣasendre mahātmani ।
yatheṣṭaṃ tāni ratnāni jagṛhurbrāhmaṇarṣabhāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: ityuktavacane tasminrAkzasendre mahAtmani । yaTezwaM tAni ratnAni jagfhurbrAhmaRarzaBAH ॥20॥

text: tato mahārhaiste sarve ratnairabhyarcitāḥ śubhaiḥ । brāhmaṇā mṛṣṭavasanāḥ suprītāḥ sma tadābhavan ॥21॥
html:
tato mahārhaiste sarve ratnairabhyarcitāḥ śubhaiḥ ।
brāhmaṇā mṛṣṭavasanāḥ suprītāḥ sma tadābhavan ॥21॥
slp1: tato mahArhEste sarve ratnEraByarcitAH SuBEH । brAhmaRA mfzwavasanAH suprItAH sma tadABavan ॥21॥

text: tatastānrākṣasendraśca dvijānāha punarvacaḥ । nānādigāgatānrājanrākṣasānpratiṣidhya vai ॥22॥
html:
tatastānrākṣasendraśca dvijānāha punarvacaḥ ।
nānādigāgatānrājanrākṣasānpratiṣidhya vai ॥22॥
slp1: tatastAnrAkzasendraSca dvijAnAha punarvacaH । nAnAdigAgatAnrAjanrAkzasAnpratiziDya vE ॥22॥

text: adhyaikadivasaṃ viprā na vo'stīha bhayaṃ kvacit । rākṣasebhyaḥ pramodadhvamiṣṭato yāta māciram ॥23॥
html:
adhyaikadivasaṃ viprā na vo'stīha bhayaṃ kvacit ।
rākṣasebhyaḥ pramodadhvamiṣṭato yāta māciram ॥23॥
slp1: aDyEkadivasaM viprA na vo'stIha BayaM kvacit । rAkzaseByaH pramodaDvamizwato yAta mAciram ॥23॥

text: tataḥ pradudruvuḥ sarve viprasaṅghāḥ samantataḥ । gautamo'pi suvarṇasya bhāramādāya satvaraḥ ॥24॥
html:
tataḥ pradudruvuḥ sarve viprasaṅghāḥ samantataḥ ।
gautamo'pi suvarṇasya bhāramādāya satvaraḥ ॥24॥
slp1: tataH pradudruvuH sarve viprasaNGAH samantataH । gOtamo'pi suvarRasya BAramAdAya satvaraH ॥24॥

text: kṛcchrātsamudvahanvīra nyagrodhaṃ samupāgamat । nyaṣīdacca pariśrāntaḥ klāntaśca kṣudhitaśca ha ॥25॥
html:
kṛcchrātsamudvahanvīra nyagrodhaṃ samupāgamat ।
nyaṣīdacca pariśrāntaḥ klāntaśca kṣudhitaśca ha ॥25॥
slp1: kfcCrAtsamudvahanvIra nyagroDaM samupAgamat । nyazIdacca pariSrAntaH klAntaSca kzuDitaSca ha ॥25॥

text: tatastamabhyagādrājanrājadharmā khagottamaḥ । svāgatenābhyanandacca gautamaṃ mitravatsalaḥ ॥26॥
html:
tatastamabhyagādrājanrājadharmā khagottamaḥ ।
svāgatenābhyanandacca gautamaṃ mitravatsalaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: tatastamaByagAdrAjanrAjaDarmA KagottamaH । svAgatenAByanandacca gOtamaM mitravatsalaH ॥26॥

text: tasya pakṣāgravikṣepaiḥ klamaṃ vyapanayatkhagaḥ । pūjāṃ cāpyakaroddhīmānbhojanaṃ cāpyakalpayat ॥27॥
html:
tasya pakṣāgravikṣepaiḥ klamaṃ vyapanayatkhagaḥ ।
pūjāṃ cāpyakaroddhīmānbhojanaṃ cāpyakalpayat ॥27॥
slp1: tasya pakzAgravikzepEH klamaM vyapanayatKagaH । pUjAM cApyakarodDImAnBojanaM cApyakalpayat ॥27॥

text: sa bhuktavānsuviśrānto gautamo'cintayattadā । hāṭakasyābhirūpasya bhāro'yaṃ sumahānmayā । gṛhīto lobhamohādvai dūraṃ ca gamanaṃ mama ॥28॥
html:
sa bhuktavānsuviśrānto gautamo'cintayattadā ।
hāṭakasyābhirūpasya bhāro'yaṃ sumahānmayā ।
gṛhīto lobhamohādvai dūraṃ ca gamanaṃ mama ॥28॥
slp1: sa BuktavAnsuviSrAnto gOtamo'cintayattadA । hAwakasyABirUpasya BAro'yaM sumahAnmayA । gfhIto loBamohAdvE dUraM ca gamanaM mama ॥28॥

text: na cāsti pathi bhoktavyaṃ prāṇasandhāraṇaṃ mama । kiṃ kṛtvā dhārayeyaṃ vai prāṇānityabhyacintayat ॥29॥
html:
na cāsti pathi bhoktavyaṃ prāṇasandhāraṇaṃ mama ।
kiṃ kṛtvā dhārayeyaṃ vai prāṇānityabhyacintayat ॥29॥
slp1: na cAsti paTi BoktavyaM prARasanDAraRaM mama । kiM kftvA DArayeyaM vE prARAnityaByacintayat ॥29॥

text: tataḥ sa pathi bhoktavyaṃ prekṣamāṇo na kiñcana । kṛtaghnaḥ puruṣavyāghra manasedamacintayat ॥30॥
html:
tataḥ sa pathi bhoktavyaṃ prekṣamāṇo na kiñcana ।
kṛtaghnaḥ puruṣavyāghra manasedamacintayat ॥30॥
slp1: tataH sa paTi BoktavyaM prekzamARo na kiYcana । kftaGnaH puruzavyAGra manasedamacintayat ॥30॥

text: ayaṃ bakapatiḥ pārśve māṃsarāśiḥ sthito mama । imaṃ hatvā gṛhītvā ca yāsye'haṃ samabhidrutam] ॥31॥
html:
ayaṃ bakapatiḥ pārśve māṃsarāśiḥ sthito mama ।
imaṃ hatvā gṛhītvā ca yāsye'haṃ samabhidrutam] ॥31॥
slp1: ayaM bakapatiH pArSve mAMsarASiH sTito mama । imaM hatvA gfhItvA ca yAsye'haM samaBidrutam] ॥31॥

text: atha tatra mahārciṣmānanalo vātasārathiḥ । tasyāvidūre rakṣārthaṃ khagendreṇa kṛto'bhavat ॥1॥
html:
atha tatra mahārciṣmānanalo vātasārathiḥ ।
tasyāvidūre rakṣārthaṃ khagendreṇa kṛto'bhavat ॥1॥
slp1: aTa tatra mahArcizmAnanalo vAtasAraTiH । tasyAvidUre rakzArTaM KagendreRa kfto'Bavat ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sa cāpi pārśve suṣvāpa viśvasto bakarāṭtadā । kṛtaghnastu sa duṣṭātmā taṃ jighāṃsurajāgarat ॥2॥
html:
sa cāpi pārśve suṣvāpa viśvasto bakarāṭtadā ।
kṛtaghnastu sa duṣṭātmā taṃ jighāṃsurajāgarat ॥2॥
slp1: sa cApi pArSve suzvApa viSvasto bakarAwtadA । kftaGnastu sa duzwAtmA taM jiGAMsurajAgarat ॥2॥

text: tato'lātena dīptena viśvastaṃ nijaghāna tam । nihatya ca mudā yuktaḥ so'nubandhaṃ na dṛṣṭavān ॥3॥
html:
tato'lātena dīptena viśvastaṃ nijaghāna tam ।
nihatya ca mudā yuktaḥ so'nubandhaṃ na dṛṣṭavān ॥3॥
slp1: tato'lAtena dIptena viSvastaM nijaGAna tam । nihatya ca mudA yuktaH so'nubanDaM na dfzwavAn ॥3॥

text: sa taṃ vipakṣaromāṇaṃ kṛtvāgnāvapacattadā । taṃ gṛhītvā suvarṇaṃ ca yayau drutataraṃ dvijaḥ ॥4॥
html:
sa taṃ vipakṣaromāṇaṃ kṛtvāgnāvapacattadā ।
taṃ gṛhītvā suvarṇaṃ ca yayau drutataraṃ dvijaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: sa taM vipakzaromARaM kftvAgnAvapacattadA । taM gfhItvA suvarRaM ca yayO drutataraM dvijaH ॥4॥

text: tato'nyasmingate cāhni virūpākṣo'bravītsutam । na prekṣe rājadharmāṇamadya putra khagottamam ॥5॥
html:
tato'nyasmingate cāhni virūpākṣo'bravītsutam ।
na prekṣe rājadharmāṇamadya putra khagottamam ॥5॥
slp1: tato'nyasmingate cAhni virUpAkzo'bravItsutam । na prekze rAjaDarmARamadya putra Kagottamam ॥5॥

text: sa pūrvasandhyāṃ brahmāṇaṃ vandituṃ yāti sarvadā । māṃ cādṛṣṭvā kadācitsa na gacchati gṛhānkhagaḥ ॥6॥
html:
sa pūrvasandhyāṃ brahmāṇaṃ vandituṃ yāti sarvadā ।
māṃ cādṛṣṭvā kadācitsa na gacchati gṛhānkhagaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: sa pUrvasanDyAM brahmARaM vandituM yAti sarvadA । mAM cAdfzwvA kadAcitsa na gacCati gfhAnKagaH ॥6॥

text: ubhe dvirātraṃ sandhye vai nābhyagātsa mamālayam । tasmānna śudhyate bhāvo mama sa jñāyatāṃ suhṛt ॥7॥
html:
ubhe dvirātraṃ sandhye vai nābhyagātsa mamālayam ।
tasmānna śudhyate bhāvo mama sa jñāyatāṃ suhṛt ॥7॥
slp1: uBe dvirAtraM sanDye vE nAByagAtsa mamAlayam । tasmAnna SuDyate BAvo mama sa jYAyatAM suhft ॥7॥

text: svādhyāyena viyukto hi brahmavarcasavarjitaḥ । taṃ gatastatra me śaṅkā hanyāttaṃ sa dvijādhamaḥ ॥8॥
html:
svādhyāyena viyukto hi brahmavarcasavarjitaḥ ।
taṃ gatastatra me śaṅkā hanyāttaṃ sa dvijādhamaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: svADyAyena viyukto hi brahmavarcasavarjitaH । taM gatastatra me SaNkA hanyAttaM sa dvijADamaH ॥8॥

text: durācārastu durbuddhiriṅgitairlakṣito mayā । niṣkriyo dāruṇākāraḥ kṛṣṇo dasyurivādhamaḥ ॥9॥
html:
durācārastu durbuddhiriṅgitairlakṣito mayā ।
niṣkriyo dāruṇākāraḥ kṛṣṇo dasyurivādhamaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: durAcArastu durbudDiriNgitErlakzito mayA । nizkriyo dAruRAkAraH kfzRo dasyurivADamaH ॥9॥

text: gautamaḥ sa gatastatra tenodvignaṃ mano mama । putra śīghramito gatvā rājadharmaniveśanam । jñāyatāṃ sa viśuddhātmā yadi jīvati māciram ॥10॥
html:
gautamaḥ sa gatastatra tenodvignaṃ mano mama ।
putra śīghramito gatvā rājadharmaniveśanam ।
jñāyatāṃ sa viśuddhātmā yadi jīvati māciram ॥10॥
slp1: gOtamaH sa gatastatra tenodvignaM mano mama । putra SIGramito gatvA rAjaDarmaniveSanam । jYAyatAM sa viSudDAtmA yadi jIvati mAciram ॥10॥

text: sa evamuktastvarito rakṣobhiḥ sahito yayau । nyagrodhaṃ tatra cāpaśyatkaṅkālaṃ rājadharmaṇaḥ ॥11॥
html:
sa evamuktastvarito rakṣobhiḥ sahito yayau ।
nyagrodhaṃ tatra cāpaśyatkaṅkālaṃ rājadharmaṇaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: sa evamuktastvarito rakzoBiH sahito yayO । nyagroDaM tatra cApaSyatkaNkAlaM rAjaDarmaRaH ॥11॥

text: sa rudannagamatputro rākṣasendrasya dhīmataḥ । tvaramāṇaḥ paraṃ śaktyā gautamagrahaṇāya vai ॥12॥
html:
sa rudannagamatputro rākṣasendrasya dhīmataḥ ।
tvaramāṇaḥ paraṃ śaktyā gautamagrahaṇāya vai ॥12॥
slp1: sa rudannagamatputro rAkzasendrasya DImataH । tvaramARaH paraM SaktyA gOtamagrahaRAya vE ॥12॥

text: tato'vidūre jagṛhurgautamaṃ rākṣasāstadā । rājadharmaśarīraṃ ca pakṣāsthicaraṇojjhitam ॥13॥
html:
tato'vidūre jagṛhurgautamaṃ rākṣasāstadā ।
rājadharmaśarīraṃ ca pakṣāsthicaraṇojjhitam ॥13॥
slp1: tato'vidUre jagfhurgOtamaM rAkzasAstadA । rAjaDarmaSarIraM ca pakzAsTicaraRojJitam ॥13॥

text: tamādāyātha rakṣāṃsi drutaṃ meruvrajaṃ yayuḥ । rājñaśca darśayāmāsuḥ śarīraṃ rājadharmaṇaḥ । kṛtaghnaṃ puruṣaṃ taṃ ca gautamaṃ pāpacetasam ॥14॥
html:
tamādāyātha rakṣāṃsi drutaṃ meruvrajaṃ yayuḥ ।
rājñaśca darśayāmāsuḥ śarīraṃ rājadharmaṇaḥ ।
kṛtaghnaṃ puruṣaṃ taṃ ca gautamaṃ pāpacetasam ॥14॥
slp1: tamAdAyATa rakzAMsi drutaM meruvrajaM yayuH । rAjYaSca darSayAmAsuH SarIraM rAjaDarmaRaH । kftaGnaM puruzaM taM ca gOtamaM pApacetasam ॥14॥

text: ruroda rājā taṃ dṛṣṭvā sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ । ārtanādaśca sumahānabhūttasya niveśane ॥15॥
html:
ruroda rājā taṃ dṛṣṭvā sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ ।
ārtanādaśca sumahānabhūttasya niveśane ॥15॥
slp1: ruroda rAjA taM dfzwvA sAmAtyaH sapurohitaH । ArtanAdaSca sumahAnaBUttasya niveSane ॥15॥

text: sastrīkumāraṃ ca puraṃ babhūvāsvasthamānasam । athābravīnnṛpaḥ putraṃ pāpo'yaṃ vadhyatāmiti ॥16॥
html:
sastrīkumāraṃ ca puraṃ babhūvāsvasthamānasam ।
athābravīnnṛpaḥ putraṃ pāpo'yaṃ vadhyatāmiti ॥16॥
slp1: sastrIkumAraM ca puraM baBUvAsvasTamAnasam । aTAbravInnfpaH putraM pApo'yaM vaDyatAmiti ॥16॥

text: asya māṃsairime sarve viharantu yatheṣṭataḥ । pāpācāraḥ pāpakarmā pāpātmā pāpaniścayaḥ । hantavyo'yaṃ mama matirbhavadbhiriti rākṣasāḥ ॥17॥
html:
asya māṃsairime sarve viharantu yatheṣṭataḥ ।
pāpācāraḥ pāpakarmā pāpātmā pāpaniścayaḥ ।
hantavyo'yaṃ mama matirbhavadbhiriti rākṣasāḥ ॥17॥
slp1: asya mAMsErime sarve viharantu yaTezwataH । pApAcAraH pApakarmA pApAtmA pApaniScayaH । hantavyo'yaM mama matirBavadBiriti rAkzasAH ॥17॥

text: ityuktā rākṣasendreṇa rākṣasā ghoravikramāḥ । naicchanta taṃ bhakṣayituṃ pāpakarmāyamityuta ॥18॥
html:
ityuktā rākṣasendreṇa rākṣasā ghoravikramāḥ ।
naicchanta taṃ bhakṣayituṃ pāpakarmāyamityuta ॥18॥
slp1: ityuktA rAkzasendreRa rAkzasA GoravikramAH । nEcCanta taM BakzayituM pApakarmAyamityuta ॥18॥

text: dasyūnāṃ dīyatāmeṣa sādhvadya puruṣādhamaḥ । ityūcustaṃ mahārāja rākṣasendraṃ niśācarāḥ ॥19॥
html:
dasyūnāṃ dīyatāmeṣa sādhvadya puruṣādhamaḥ ।
ityūcustaṃ mahārāja rākṣasendraṃ niśācarāḥ ॥19॥
slp1: dasyUnAM dIyatAmeza sADvadya puruzADamaH । ityUcustaM mahArAja rAkzasendraM niSAcarAH ॥19॥

text: śirobhiśca gatā bhūmimūcū rakṣogaṇādhipam । na dātumarhasi tvaṃ no bhakṣaṇāyāsya kilbiṣam ॥20॥
html:
śirobhiśca gatā bhūmimūcū rakṣogaṇādhipam ।
na dātumarhasi tvaṃ no bhakṣaṇāyāsya kilbiṣam ॥20॥
slp1: SiroBiSca gatA BUmimUcU rakzogaRADipam । na dAtumarhasi tvaM no BakzaRAyAsya kilbizam ॥20॥

text: evamastviti tānāha rākṣasendro niśācarān । dasyūnāṃ dīyatāmeṣa kṛtaghno'dyaiva rākṣasāḥ ॥21॥
html:
evamastviti tānāha rākṣasendro niśācarān ।
dasyūnāṃ dīyatāmeṣa kṛtaghno'dyaiva rākṣasāḥ ॥21॥
slp1: evamastviti tAnAha rAkzasendro niSAcarAn । dasyUnAM dIyatAmeza kftaGno'dyEva rAkzasAH ॥21॥

text: ityukte tasya te dāsāḥ śūlamudgarapāṇayaḥ । chittvā taṃ khaṇḍaśaḥ pāpaṃ dasyubhyaḥ pradadustadā ॥22॥
html:
ityukte tasya te dāsāḥ śūlamudgarapāṇayaḥ ।
chittvā taṃ khaṇḍaśaḥ pāpaṃ dasyubhyaḥ pradadustadā ॥22॥
slp1: ityukte tasya te dAsAH SUlamudgarapARayaH । CittvA taM KaRqaSaH pApaM dasyuByaH pradadustadA ॥22॥

text: dasyavaścāpi naicchanta tamattuṃ pāpakāriṇam । kravyādā api rājendra kṛtaghnaṃ nopabhuñjate ॥23॥
html:
dasyavaścāpi naicchanta tamattuṃ pāpakāriṇam ।
kravyādā api rājendra kṛtaghnaṃ nopabhuñjate ॥23॥
slp1: dasyavaScApi nEcCanta tamattuM pApakAriRam । kravyAdA api rAjendra kftaGnaM nopaBuYjate ॥23॥

text: brahmaghne ca surāpe ca core bhagnavrate tathā । niṣkṛtirvihitā rājankṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ ॥24॥
html:
brahmaghne ca surāpe ca core bhagnavrate tathā ।
niṣkṛtirvihitā rājankṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ ॥24॥
slp1: brahmaGne ca surApe ca core Bagnavrate taTA । nizkftirvihitA rAjankftaGne nAsti nizkftiH ॥24॥

text: mitradrohī nṛśaṃsaśca kṛtaghnaśca narādhamaḥ । kravyādaiḥ kṛmibhiścānyairna bhujyante hi tādṛśāḥ] ॥25॥
html:
mitradrohī nṛśaṃsaśca kṛtaghnaśca narādhamaḥ ।
kravyādaiḥ kṛmibhiścānyairna bhujyante hi tādṛśāḥ] ॥25॥
slp1: mitradrohI nfSaMsaSca kftaGnaSca narADamaH । kravyAdEH kfmiBiScAnyErna Bujyante hi tAdfSAH] ॥25॥

text: tataścitāṃ bakapateḥ kārayāmāsa rākṣasaḥ । ratnairgandhaiśca bahubhirvastraiśca samalaṅkṛtām ॥1॥
html:
tataścitāṃ bakapateḥ kārayāmāsa rākṣasaḥ ।
ratnairgandhaiśca bahubhirvastraiśca samalaṅkṛtām ॥1॥
slp1: tataScitAM bakapateH kArayAmAsa rAkzasaH । ratnErganDESca bahuBirvastrESca samalaNkftAm ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tatra prajvālya nṛpate bakarājaṃ pratāpavān । pretakāryāṇi vidhivadrākṣasendraścakāra ha ॥2॥
html:
tatra prajvālya nṛpate bakarājaṃ pratāpavān ।
pretakāryāṇi vidhivadrākṣasendraścakāra ha ॥2॥
slp1: tatra prajvAlya nfpate bakarAjaM pratApavAn । pretakAryARi viDivadrAkzasendraScakAra ha ॥2॥

text: tasminkāle'tha surabhirdevī dākṣāyaṇī śubhā । upariṣṭāttatastasya sā babhūva payasvinī ॥3॥
html:
tasminkāle'tha surabhirdevī dākṣāyaṇī śubhā ।
upariṣṭāttatastasya sā babhūva payasvinī ॥3॥
slp1: tasminkAle'Ta suraBirdevI dAkzAyaRI SuBA । uparizwAttatastasya sA baBUva payasvinI ॥3॥

text: tasyā vaktrāccyutaḥ phenaḥ kṣīramiśrastadānagha । so'patadvai tatastasyāṃ citāyāṃ rājadharmaṇaḥ ॥4॥
html:
tasyā vaktrāccyutaḥ phenaḥ kṣīramiśrastadānagha ।
so'patadvai tatastasyāṃ citāyāṃ rājadharmaṇaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: tasyA vaktrAccyutaH PenaH kzIramiSrastadAnaGa । so'patadvE tatastasyAM citAyAM rAjaDarmaRaH ॥4॥

text: tataḥ sañjīvitastena bakarājastadānagha । utpatya ca sameyāya virūpākṣaṃ bakādhipaḥ ॥5॥
html:
tataḥ sañjīvitastena bakarājastadānagha ।
utpatya ca sameyāya virūpākṣaṃ bakādhipaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: tataH saYjIvitastena bakarAjastadAnaGa । utpatya ca sameyAya virUpAkzaM bakADipaH ॥5॥

text: tato'bhyayāddevarājo virūpākṣapuraṃ tadā । prāha cedaṃ virūpākṣaṃ diṣṭyāyaṃ jīvatītyuta ॥6॥
html:
tato'bhyayāddevarājo virūpākṣapuraṃ tadā ।
prāha cedaṃ virūpākṣaṃ diṣṭyāyaṃ jīvatītyuta ॥6॥
slp1: tato'ByayAddevarAjo virUpAkzapuraM tadA । prAha cedaM virUpAkzaM dizwyAyaM jIvatItyuta ॥6॥

text: śrāvayāmāsa cendrastaṃ virūpākṣaṃ purātanam । yathā śāpaḥ purā datto brahmaṇā rājadharmaṇaḥ ॥7॥
html:
śrāvayāmāsa cendrastaṃ virūpākṣaṃ purātanam ।
yathā śāpaḥ purā datto brahmaṇā rājadharmaṇaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: SrAvayAmAsa cendrastaM virUpAkzaM purAtanam । yaTA SApaH purA datto brahmaRA rAjaDarmaRaH ॥7॥

text: yadā bakapatī rājanbrahmāṇaṃ nopasarpati । tato roṣādidaṃ prāha bakendrāya pitāmahaḥ ॥8॥
html:
yadā bakapatī rājanbrahmāṇaṃ nopasarpati ।
tato roṣādidaṃ prāha bakendrāya pitāmahaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: yadA bakapatI rAjanbrahmARaM nopasarpati । tato rozAdidaM prAha bakendrAya pitAmahaH ॥8॥

text: yasmānmūḍho mama sado nāgato'sau bakādhamaḥ । tasmādvadhaṃ sa duṣṭātmā nacirātsamavāpsyati ॥9॥
html:
yasmānmūḍho mama sado nāgato'sau bakādhamaḥ ।
tasmādvadhaṃ sa duṣṭātmā nacirātsamavāpsyati ॥9॥
slp1: yasmAnmUQo mama sado nAgato'sO bakADamaH । tasmAdvaDaM sa duzwAtmA nacirAtsamavApsyati ॥9॥

text: tadāyaṃ tasya vacanānnihato gautamena vai । tenaivāmṛtasiktaśca punaḥ sañjīvito bakaḥ ॥10॥
html:
tadāyaṃ tasya vacanānnihato gautamena vai ।
tenaivāmṛtasiktaśca punaḥ sañjīvito bakaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: tadAyaM tasya vacanAnnihato gOtamena vE । tenEvAmftasiktaSca punaH saYjIvito bakaH ॥10॥

text: rājadharmā tataḥ prāha praṇipatya purandaram । yadi te'nugrahakṛtā mayi buddhiḥ purandara । sakhāyaṃ me sudayitaṃ gautamaṃ jīvayetyuta ॥11॥
html:
rājadharmā tataḥ prāha praṇipatya purandaram ।
yadi te'nugrahakṛtā mayi buddhiḥ purandara ।
sakhāyaṃ me sudayitaṃ gautamaṃ jīvayetyuta ॥11॥
slp1: rAjaDarmA tataH prAha praRipatya purandaram । yadi te'nugrahakftA mayi budDiH purandara । saKAyaM me sudayitaM gOtamaM jIvayetyuta ॥11॥

text: tasya vākyaṃ samājñāya vāsavaḥ puruṣarṣabha । sañjīvayitvā sakhye vai prādāttaṃ gautamaṃ tadā ॥12॥
html:
tasya vākyaṃ samājñāya vāsavaḥ puruṣarṣabha ।
sañjīvayitvā sakhye vai prādāttaṃ gautamaṃ tadā ॥12॥
slp1: tasya vAkyaM samAjYAya vAsavaH puruzarzaBa । saYjIvayitvA saKye vE prAdAttaM gOtamaM tadA ॥12॥

text: sabhāṇḍopaskaraṃ rājaṃstamāsādya bakādhipaḥ । sampariṣvajya suhṛdaṃ prītyā paramayā yutaḥ ॥13॥
html:
sabhāṇḍopaskaraṃ rājaṃstamāsādya bakādhipaḥ ।
sampariṣvajya suhṛdaṃ prītyā paramayā yutaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: saBARqopaskaraM rAjaMstamAsAdya bakADipaH । samparizvajya suhfdaM prItyA paramayA yutaH ॥13॥

text: atha taṃ pāpakarmāṇaṃ rājadharmā bakādhipaḥ । visarjayitvā sadhanaṃ praviveśa svamālayam ॥14॥
html:
atha taṃ pāpakarmāṇaṃ rājadharmā bakādhipaḥ ।
visarjayitvā sadhanaṃ praviveśa svamālayam ॥14॥
slp1: aTa taM pApakarmARaM rAjaDarmA bakADipaH । visarjayitvA saDanaM praviveSa svamAlayam ॥14॥

text: yathocitaṃ ca sa bako yayau brahmasadastadā । brahmā ca taṃ mahātmānamātithyenābhyapūjayat ॥15॥
html:
yathocitaṃ ca sa bako yayau brahmasadastadā ।
brahmā ca taṃ mahātmānamātithyenābhyapūjayat ॥15॥
slp1: yaTocitaM ca sa bako yayO brahmasadastadA । brahmA ca taM mahAtmAnamAtiTyenAByapUjayat ॥15॥

text: gautamaścāpi samprāpya punastaṃ śabarālayam । śūdrāyāṃ janayāmāsa putrānduṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ ॥16॥
html:
gautamaścāpi samprāpya punastaṃ śabarālayam ।
śūdrāyāṃ janayāmāsa putrānduṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: gOtamaScApi samprApya punastaM SabarAlayam । SUdrAyAM janayAmAsa putrAnduzkftakAriRaH ॥16॥

text: śāpaśca sumahāṃstasya dattaḥ suragaṇaistadā । kukṣau punarbhvāṃ bhāryāyāṃ janayitvā cirātsutān । nirayaṃ prāpsyati mahatkṛtaghno'yamiti prabho ॥17॥
html:
śāpaśca sumahāṃstasya dattaḥ suragaṇaistadā ।
kukṣau punarbhvāṃ bhāryāyāṃ janayitvā cirātsutān ।
nirayaṃ prāpsyati mahatkṛtaghno'yamiti prabho ॥17॥
slp1: SApaSca sumahAMstasya dattaH suragaREstadA । kukzO punarBvAM BAryAyAM janayitvA cirAtsutAn । nirayaM prApsyati mahatkftaGno'yamiti praBo ॥17॥

text: etatprāha purā sarvaṃ nārado mama bhārata । saṃsmṛtya cāpi sumahadākhyānaṃ puruṣarṣabha । mayāpi bhavate sarvaṃ yathāvadupavarṇitam ॥18॥
html:
etatprāha purā sarvaṃ nārado mama bhārata ।
saṃsmṛtya cāpi sumahadākhyānaṃ puruṣarṣabha ।
mayāpi bhavate sarvaṃ yathāvadupavarṇitam ॥18॥
slp1: etatprAha purA sarvaM nArado mama BArata । saMsmftya cApi sumahadAKyAnaM puruzarzaBa । mayApi Bavate sarvaM yaTAvadupavarRitam ॥18॥

text: kutaḥ kṛtaghnasya yaśaḥ kutaḥ sthānaṃ kutaḥ sukham । aśraddheyaḥ kṛtaghno hi kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ ॥19॥
html:
kutaḥ kṛtaghnasya yaśaḥ kutaḥ sthānaṃ kutaḥ sukham ।
aśraddheyaḥ kṛtaghno hi kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ ॥19॥
slp1: kutaH kftaGnasya yaSaH kutaH sTAnaM kutaH suKam । aSradDeyaH kftaGno hi kftaGne nAsti nizkftiH ॥19॥

text: mitradroho na kartavyaḥ puruṣeṇa viśeṣataḥ । mitradhruṅnirayaṃ ghoramanantaṃ pratipadyate ॥20॥
html:
mitradroho na kartavyaḥ puruṣeṇa viśeṣataḥ ।
mitradhruṅnirayaṃ ghoramanantaṃ pratipadyate ॥20॥
slp1: mitradroho na kartavyaH puruzeRa viSezataH । mitraDruNnirayaM GoramanantaM pratipadyate ॥20॥

text: kṛtajñena sadā bhāvyaṃ mitrakāmena cānagha । mitrātprabhavate satyaṃ mitrātprabhavate balam । satkārairuttamairmitraṃ pūjayeta vicakṣaṇaḥ ॥21॥
html:
kṛtajñena sadā bhāvyaṃ mitrakāmena cānagha ।
mitrātprabhavate satyaṃ mitrātprabhavate balam ।
satkārairuttamairmitraṃ pūjayeta vicakṣaṇaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: kftajYena sadA BAvyaM mitrakAmena cAnaGa । mitrAtpraBavate satyaM mitrAtpraBavate balam । satkArEruttamErmitraM pUjayeta vicakzaRaH ॥21॥

text: parityājyo budhaiḥ pāpaḥ kṛtaghno nirapatrapaḥ । mitradrohī kulāṅgāraḥ pāpakarmā narādhamaḥ ॥22॥
html:
parityājyo budhaiḥ pāpaḥ kṛtaghno nirapatrapaḥ ।
mitradrohī kulāṅgāraḥ pāpakarmā narādhamaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: parityAjyo buDEH pApaH kftaGno nirapatrapaH । mitradrohI kulANgAraH pApakarmA narADamaH ॥22॥

text: eṣa dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha proktaḥ pāpo mayā tava । mitradrohī kṛtaghno vai kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ॥23॥
html:
eṣa dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha proktaḥ pāpo mayā tava ।
mitradrohī kṛtaghno vai kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ॥23॥
slp1: eza DarmaBftAM SrezWa proktaH pApo mayA tava । mitradrohI kftaGno vE kiM BUyaH SrotumicCasi ॥23॥

text: etacchrutvā tadā vākyaṃ bhīṣmeṇoktaṃ mahātmanā । yudhiṣṭhiraḥ prītamanā babhūva janamejaya] ॥24॥
html:
etacchrutvā tadā vākyaṃ bhīṣmeṇoktaṃ mahātmanā ।
yudhiṣṭhiraḥ prītamanā babhūva janamejaya] ॥24॥
slp1: etacCrutvA tadA vAkyaM BIzmeRoktaM mahAtmanA । yuDizWiraH prItamanA baBUva janamejaya] ॥24॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: dharmāḥ pitāmahenoktā rājadharmāśritāḥ śubhāḥ । dharmamāśramiṇāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vaktumarhasi pārthiva ॥1॥
html:
dharmāḥ pitāmahenoktā rājadharmāśritāḥ śubhāḥ ।
dharmamāśramiṇāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vaktumarhasi pārthiva ॥1॥
slp1: DarmAH pitAmahenoktA rAjaDarmASritAH SuBAH । DarmamASramiRAM SrezWaM vaktumarhasi pArTiva ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: sarvatra vihito dharmaḥ svargyaḥ satyaphalaṃ tapaḥ । bahudvārasya dharmasya nehāsti viphalā kriyā ॥2॥
html:
sarvatra vihito dharmaḥ svargyaḥ satyaphalaṃ tapaḥ ।
bahudvārasya dharmasya nehāsti viphalā kriyā ॥2॥
slp1: sarvatra vihito DarmaH svargyaH satyaPalaM tapaH । bahudvArasya Darmasya nehAsti viPalA kriyA ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yasminyasmiṃstu vinaye yo yo yāti viniścayam । sa tamevābhijānāti nānyaṃ bharatasattama ॥3॥
html:
yasminyasmiṃstu vinaye yo yo yāti viniścayam ।
sa tamevābhijānāti nānyaṃ bharatasattama ॥3॥
slp1: yasminyasmiMstu vinaye yo yo yAti viniScayam । sa tamevABijAnAti nAnyaM Baratasattama ॥3॥

text: yathā yathā ca paryeti lokatantramasāravat । tathā tathā virāgo'tra jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥4॥
html:
yathā yathā ca paryeti lokatantramasāravat ।
tathā tathā virāgo'tra jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: yaTA yaTA ca paryeti lokatantramasAravat । taTA taTA virAgo'tra jAyate nAtra saMSayaH ॥4॥

text: evaṃ vyavasite loke bahudoṣe yudhiṣṭhira । ātmamokṣanimittaṃ vai yateta matimānnaraḥ ॥5॥
html:
evaṃ vyavasite loke bahudoṣe yudhiṣṭhira ।
ātmamokṣanimittaṃ vai yateta matimānnaraḥ ॥5॥
slp1: evaM vyavasite loke bahudoze yuDizWira । AtmamokzanimittaM vE yateta matimAnnaraH ॥5॥

text: naṣṭe dhane vā dāre vā putre pitari vā mṛte । yayā buddhyā nudecchokaṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥6॥
html:
naṣṭe dhane vā dāre vā putre pitari vā mṛte ।
yayā buddhyā nudecchokaṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥6॥
slp1: nazwe Dane vA dAre vA putre pitari vA mfte । yayA budDyA nudecCokaM tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥6॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: naṣṭe dhane vā dāre vā putre pitari vā mṛte । aho duḥkhamiti dhyāyañśokasyāpacitiṃ caret ॥7॥
html:
naṣṭe dhane vā dāre vā putre pitari vā mṛte ।
aho duḥkhamiti dhyāyañśokasyāpacitiṃ caret ॥7॥
slp1: nazwe Dane vA dAre vA putre pitari vA mfte । aho duHKamiti DyAyaYSokasyApacitiM caret ॥7॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । yathā senajitaṃ vipraḥ kaścidityabravīdvacaḥ ॥8॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
yathā senajitaṃ vipraḥ kaścidityabravīdvacaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । yaTA senajitaM vipraH kaScidityabravIdvacaH ॥8॥

text: putraśokābhisantaptaṃ rājānaṃ śokavihvalam । viṣaṇṇavadanaṃ dṛṣṭvā vipro vacanamabravīt ॥9॥
html:
putraśokābhisantaptaṃ rājānaṃ śokavihvalam ।
viṣaṇṇavadanaṃ dṛṣṭvā vipro vacanamabravīt ॥9॥
slp1: putraSokABisantaptaM rAjAnaM Sokavihvalam । vizaRRavadanaM dfzwvA vipro vacanamabravIt ॥9॥

text: kiṃ nu khalvasi mūḍhastvaṃ śocyaḥ kimanuśocasi । yadā tvāmapi śocantaḥ śocyā yāsyanti tāṃ gatim ॥10॥
html:
kiṃ nu khalvasi mūḍhastvaṃ śocyaḥ kimanuśocasi ।
yadā tvāmapi śocantaḥ śocyā yāsyanti tāṃ gatim ॥10॥
slp1: kiM nu Kalvasi mUQastvaM SocyaH kimanuSocasi । yadA tvAmapi SocantaH SocyA yAsyanti tAM gatim ॥10॥

text: tvaṃ caivāhaṃ ca ye cānye tvāṃ rājanparyupāsate । sarve tatra gamiṣyāmo yata evāgatā vayam ॥11॥
html:
tvaṃ caivāhaṃ ca ye cānye tvāṃ rājanparyupāsate ।
sarve tatra gamiṣyāmo yata evāgatā vayam ॥11॥
slp1: tvaM cEvAhaM ca ye cAnye tvAM rAjanparyupAsate । sarve tatra gamizyAmo yata evAgatA vayam ॥11॥

text: kā buddhiḥ kiṃ tapo vipra kaḥ samādhistapodhana । kiṃ jñānaṃ kiṃ śrutaṃ vā te yatprāpya na viṣīdasi ॥12॥
html:
kā buddhiḥ kiṃ tapo vipra kaḥ samādhistapodhana ।
kiṃ jñānaṃ kiṃ śrutaṃ vā te yatprāpya na viṣīdasi ॥12॥
slp1: kA budDiH kiM tapo vipra kaH samADistapoDana । kiM jYAnaM kiM SrutaM vA te yatprApya na vizIdasi ॥12॥
author: senajiduvāca ।

text: paśya bhūtāni duḥkhena vyatiṣaktāni sarvaśaḥ । ātmāpi cāyaṃ na mama sarvā vā pṛthivī mama ॥13॥
html:
paśya bhūtāni duḥkhena vyatiṣaktāni sarvaśaḥ ।
ātmāpi cāyaṃ na mama sarvā vā pṛthivī mama ॥13॥
slp1: paSya BUtAni duHKena vyatizaktAni sarvaSaH । AtmApi cAyaM na mama sarvA vA pfTivI mama ॥13॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: yathā mama tathānyeṣāmiti buddhyā na me vyathā । etāṃ buddhimahaṃ prāpya na prahṛṣye na ca vyathe ॥14॥
html:
yathā mama tathānyeṣāmiti buddhyā na me vyathā ।
etāṃ buddhimahaṃ prāpya na prahṛṣye na ca vyathe ॥14॥
slp1: yaTA mama taTAnyezAmiti budDyA na me vyaTA । etAM budDimahaM prApya na prahfzye na ca vyaTe ॥14॥

text: yathā kāṣṭhaṃ ca kāṣṭhaṃ ca sameyātāṃ mahodadhau । sametya ca vyapeyātāṃ tadvadbhūtasamāgamaḥ ॥15॥
html:
yathā kāṣṭhaṃ ca kāṣṭhaṃ ca sameyātāṃ mahodadhau ।
sametya ca vyapeyātāṃ tadvadbhūtasamāgamaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: yaTA kAzWaM ca kAzWaM ca sameyAtAM mahodaDO । sametya ca vyapeyAtAM tadvadBUtasamAgamaH ॥15॥

text: evaṃ putrāśca pautrāśca jñātayo bāndhavāstathā । teṣu sneho na kartavyo viprayogo hi tairdhruvam ॥16॥
html:
evaṃ putrāśca pautrāśca jñātayo bāndhavāstathā ।
teṣu sneho na kartavyo viprayogo hi tairdhruvam ॥16॥
slp1: evaM putrASca pOtrASca jYAtayo bAnDavAstaTA । tezu sneho na kartavyo viprayogo hi tErDruvam ॥16॥

text: adarśanādāpatitaḥ punaścādarśanaṃ gataḥ । na tvāsau veda na tvaṃ taṃ kaḥ sankamanuśocasi ॥17॥
html:
adarśanādāpatitaḥ punaścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ।
na tvāsau veda na tvaṃ taṃ kaḥ sankamanuśocasi ॥17॥
slp1: adarSanAdApatitaH punaScAdarSanaM gataH । na tvAsO veda na tvaM taM kaH sankamanuSocasi ॥17॥

text: tṛṣṇārtiprabhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhārtiprabhavaṃ sukham । sukhātsañjāyate duḥkhamevametatpunaḥ punaḥ । sukhasyānantaraṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhasyānantaraṃ sukham ॥18॥
html:
tṛṣṇārtiprabhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhārtiprabhavaṃ sukham ।
sukhātsañjāyate duḥkhamevametatpunaḥ punaḥ ।
sukhasyānantaraṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhasyānantaraṃ sukham ॥18॥
slp1: tfzRArtipraBavaM duHKaM duHKArtipraBavaM suKam । suKAtsaYjAyate duHKamevametatpunaH punaH । suKasyAnantaraM duHKaM duHKasyAnantaraM suKam ॥18॥

text: sukhāttvaṃ duḥkhamāpannaḥ punarāpatsyase sukham । na nityaṃ labhate duḥkhaṃ na nityaṃ labhate sukham ॥19॥
html:
sukhāttvaṃ duḥkhamāpannaḥ punarāpatsyase sukham ।
na nityaṃ labhate duḥkhaṃ na nityaṃ labhate sukham ॥19॥
slp1: suKAttvaM duHKamApannaH punarApatsyase suKam । na nityaM laBate duHKaM na nityaM laBate suKam ॥19॥

text: nālaṃ sukhāya suhṛdo nālaṃ duḥkhāya śatravaḥ । na ca prajñālamarthānāṃ na sukhānāmalaṃ dhanam ॥20॥
html:
nālaṃ sukhāya suhṛdo nālaṃ duḥkhāya śatravaḥ ।
na ca prajñālamarthānāṃ na sukhānāmalaṃ dhanam ॥20॥
slp1: nAlaM suKAya suhfdo nAlaM duHKAya SatravaH । na ca prajYAlamarTAnAM na suKAnAmalaM Danam ॥20॥

text: na buddhirdhanalābhāya na jāḍyamasamṛddhaye । lokaparyāyavṛttāntaṃ prājño jānāti netaraḥ ॥21॥
html:
na buddhirdhanalābhāya na jāḍyamasamṛddhaye ।
lokaparyāyavṛttāntaṃ prājño jānāti netaraḥ ॥21॥
slp1: na budDirDanalABAya na jAqyamasamfdDaye । lokaparyAyavfttAntaM prAjYo jAnAti netaraH ॥21॥

text: buddhimantaṃ ca mūḍhaṃ ca śūraṃ bhīruṃ jaḍaṃ kavim । durbalaṃ balavantaṃ ca bhāginaṃ bhajate sukham ॥22॥
html:
buddhimantaṃ ca mūḍhaṃ ca śūraṃ bhīruṃ jaḍaṃ kavim ।
durbalaṃ balavantaṃ ca bhāginaṃ bhajate sukham ॥22॥
slp1: budDimantaM ca mUQaM ca SUraM BIruM jaqaM kavim । durbalaM balavantaM ca BAginaM Bajate suKam ॥22॥

text: dhenurvatsasya gopasya svāminastaskarasya ca । payaḥ pibati yastasyā dhenustasyeti niścayaḥ ॥23॥
html:
dhenurvatsasya gopasya svāminastaskarasya ca ।
payaḥ pibati yastasyā dhenustasyeti niścayaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: Denurvatsasya gopasya svAminastaskarasya ca । payaH pibati yastasyA Denustasyeti niScayaH ॥23॥

text: ye ca mūḍhatamā loke ye ca buddheḥ paraṃ gatāḥ । te narāḥ sukhamedhante kliśyatyantarito janaḥ ॥24॥
html:
ye ca mūḍhatamā loke ye ca buddheḥ paraṃ gatāḥ ।
te narāḥ sukhamedhante kliśyatyantarito janaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: ye ca mUQatamA loke ye ca budDeH paraM gatAH । te narAH suKameDante kliSyatyantarito janaH ॥24॥

text: antyeṣu remire dhīrā na te madhyeṣu remire । antyaprāptiṃ sukhāmāhurduḥkhamantaramantayoḥ ॥25॥
html:
antyeṣu remire dhīrā na te madhyeṣu remire ।
antyaprāptiṃ sukhāmāhurduḥkhamantaramantayoḥ ॥25॥
slp1: antyezu remire DIrA na te maDyezu remire । antyaprAptiM suKAmAhurduHKamantaramantayoH ॥25॥

text: ye tu buddhisukhaṃ prāptā dvandvātītā vimatsarāḥ । tānnaivārthā na cānarthā vyathayanti kadācana ॥26॥
html:
ye tu buddhisukhaṃ prāptā dvandvātītā vimatsarāḥ ।
tānnaivārthā na cānarthā vyathayanti kadācana ॥26॥
slp1: ye tu budDisuKaM prAptA dvandvAtItA vimatsarAH । tAnnEvArTA na cAnarTA vyaTayanti kadAcana ॥26॥

text: atha ye buddhimaprāptā vyatikrāntāśca mūḍhatām । te'tivelaṃ prahṛṣyanti santāpamupayānti ca ॥27॥
html:
atha ye buddhimaprāptā vyatikrāntāśca mūḍhatām ।
te'tivelaṃ prahṛṣyanti santāpamupayānti ca ॥27॥
slp1: aTa ye budDimaprAptA vyatikrAntASca mUQatAm । te'tivelaM prahfzyanti santApamupayAnti ca ॥27॥

text: nityapramuditā mūḍhā divi devagaṇā iva । avalepena mahatā paridṛbdhā vicetasaḥ ॥28॥
html:
nityapramuditā mūḍhā divi devagaṇā iva ।
avalepena mahatā paridṛbdhā vicetasaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: nityapramuditA mUQA divi devagaRA iva । avalepena mahatA paridfbDA vicetasaH ॥28॥

text: sukhaṃ duḥkhāntamālasyaṃ duḥkhaṃ dākṣyaṃ sukhodayam । bhūtiścaiva śriyā sārdhaṃ dakṣe vasati nālase ॥29॥
html:
sukhaṃ duḥkhāntamālasyaṃ duḥkhaṃ dākṣyaṃ sukhodayam ।
bhūtiścaiva śriyā sārdhaṃ dakṣe vasati nālase ॥29॥
slp1: suKaM duHKAntamAlasyaM duHKaM dAkzyaM suKodayam । BUtiScEva SriyA sArDaM dakze vasati nAlase ॥29॥

text: sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ dveṣyaṃ vā yadi vā priyam । prāptaṃ prāptamupāsīta hṛdayenāparājitaḥ ॥30॥
html:
sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ dveṣyaṃ vā yadi vā priyam ।
prāptaṃ prāptamupāsīta hṛdayenāparājitaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: suKaM vA yadi vA duHKaM dvezyaM vA yadi vA priyam । prAptaM prAptamupAsIta hfdayenAparAjitaH ॥30॥

text: śokasthānasahasrāṇi harṣasthānaśatāni ca । divase divase mūḍhamāviśanti na paṇḍitam ॥31॥
html:
śokasthānasahasrāṇi harṣasthānaśatāni ca ।
divase divase mūḍhamāviśanti na paṇḍitam ॥31॥
slp1: SokasTAnasahasrARi harzasTAnaSatAni ca । divase divase mUQamAviSanti na paRqitam ॥31॥

text: buddhimantaṃ kṛtaprajñaṃ śuśrūṣumanasūyakam । dāntaṃ jitendriyaṃ cāpi śoko na spṛśate naram ॥32॥
html:
buddhimantaṃ kṛtaprajñaṃ śuśrūṣumanasūyakam ।
dāntaṃ jitendriyaṃ cāpi śoko na spṛśate naram ॥32॥
slp1: budDimantaM kftaprajYaM SuSrUzumanasUyakam । dAntaM jitendriyaM cApi Soko na spfSate naram ॥32॥

text: etāṃ buddhiṃ samāsthāya guptacittaścaredbudhaḥ । udayāstamayajñaṃ hi na śokaḥ spraṣṭumarhati ॥33॥
html:
etāṃ buddhiṃ samāsthāya guptacittaścaredbudhaḥ ।
udayāstamayajñaṃ hi na śokaḥ spraṣṭumarhati ॥33॥
slp1: etAM budDiM samAsTAya guptacittaScaredbuDaH । udayAstamayajYaM hi na SokaH sprazwumarhati ॥33॥

text: yannimittaṃ bhavecchokastrāso vā duḥkhameva vā । āyāso vā yatomūlastadekāṅgamapi tyajet ॥34॥
html:
yannimittaṃ bhavecchokastrāso vā duḥkhameva vā ।
āyāso vā yatomūlastadekāṅgamapi tyajet ॥34॥
slp1: yannimittaM BavecCokastrAso vA duHKameva vA । AyAso vA yatomUlastadekANgamapi tyajet ॥34॥

text: yadyattyajati kāmānāṃ tatsukhasyābhipūryate । kāmānusārī puruṣaḥ kāmānanu vinaśyati ॥35॥
html:
yadyattyajati kāmānāṃ tatsukhasyābhipūryate ।
kāmānusārī puruṣaḥ kāmānanu vinaśyati ॥35॥
slp1: yadyattyajati kAmAnAM tatsuKasyABipUryate । kAmAnusArI puruzaH kAmAnanu vinaSyati ॥35॥

text: yacca kāmasukhaṃ loke yacca divyaṃ mahatsukham । tṛṣṇākṣayasukhasyaite nārhataḥ ṣoḍaśīṃ kalām ॥36॥
html:
yacca kāmasukhaṃ loke yacca divyaṃ mahatsukham ।
tṛṣṇākṣayasukhasyaite nārhataḥ ṣoḍaśīṃ kalām ॥36॥
slp1: yacca kAmasuKaM loke yacca divyaM mahatsuKam । tfzRAkzayasuKasyEte nArhataH zoqaSIM kalAm ॥36॥

text: pūrvadehakṛtaṃ karma śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham । prājñaṃ mūḍhaṃ tathā śūraṃ bhajate yādṛśaṃ kṛtam ॥37॥
html:
pūrvadehakṛtaṃ karma śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham ।
prājñaṃ mūḍhaṃ tathā śūraṃ bhajate yādṛśaṃ kṛtam ॥37॥
slp1: pUrvadehakftaM karma SuBaM vA yadi vASuBam । prAjYaM mUQaM taTA SUraM Bajate yAdfSaM kftam ॥37॥

text: evameva kilaitāni priyāṇyevāpriyāṇi ca । jīveṣu parivartante duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca ॥38॥
html:
evameva kilaitāni priyāṇyevāpriyāṇi ca ।
jīveṣu parivartante duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca ॥38॥
slp1: evameva kilEtAni priyARyevApriyARi ca । jIvezu parivartante duHKAni ca suKAni ca ॥38॥

text: tadevaṃ buddhimāsthāya sukhaṃ jīvedguṇānvitaḥ । sarvānkāmāñjugupseta saṅgānkurvīta pṛṣṭhataḥ । vṛtta eṣa hṛdi prauḍho mṛtyureṣa manomayaḥ ॥39॥
html:
tadevaṃ buddhimāsthāya sukhaṃ jīvedguṇānvitaḥ ।
sarvānkāmāñjugupseta saṅgānkurvīta pṛṣṭhataḥ ।
vṛtta eṣa hṛdi prauḍho mṛtyureṣa manomayaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: tadevaM budDimAsTAya suKaM jIvedguRAnvitaH । sarvAnkAmAYjugupseta saNgAnkurvIta pfzWataH । vftta eza hfdi prOQo mftyureza manomayaH ॥39॥

text: yadā saṃharate kāmānkūrmo'ṅgānīva sarvaśaḥ । tadātmajyotirātmā ca ātmanyeva prasīdati ॥40॥
html:
yadā saṃharate kāmānkūrmo'ṅgānīva sarvaśaḥ ।
tadātmajyotirātmā ca ātmanyeva prasīdati ॥40॥
slp1: yadA saMharate kAmAnkUrmo'NgAnIva sarvaSaH । tadAtmajyotirAtmA ca Atmanyeva prasIdati ॥40॥

text: kiñcideva mamatvena yadā bhavati kalpitam । tadeva paritāpārthaṃ sarvaṃ sampadyate tadā ॥41॥
html:
kiñcideva mamatvena yadā bhavati kalpitam ।
tadeva paritāpārthaṃ sarvaṃ sampadyate tadā ॥41॥
slp1: kiYcideva mamatvena yadA Bavati kalpitam । tadeva paritApArTaM sarvaM sampadyate tadA ॥41॥

text: na bibheti yadā cāyaṃ yadā cāsmānna bibhyati । yadā necchati na dveṣṭi brahma sampadyate tadā ॥42॥
html:
na bibheti yadā cāyaṃ yadā cāsmānna bibhyati ।
yadā necchati na dveṣṭi brahma sampadyate tadā ॥42॥
slp1: na biBeti yadA cAyaM yadA cAsmAnna biByati । yadA necCati na dvezwi brahma sampadyate tadA ॥42॥

text: ubhe satyānṛte tyaktvā śokānandau bhayābhaye । priyāpriye parityajya praśāntātmā bhaviṣyasi ॥43॥
html:
ubhe satyānṛte tyaktvā śokānandau bhayābhaye ।
priyāpriye parityajya praśāntātmā bhaviṣyasi ॥43॥
slp1: uBe satyAnfte tyaktvA SokAnandO BayABaye । priyApriye parityajya praSAntAtmA Bavizyasi ॥43॥

text: yadā na kurute dhīraḥ sarvabhūteṣu pāpakam । karmaṇā manasā vācā brahma sampadyate tadā ॥44॥
html:
yadā na kurute dhīraḥ sarvabhūteṣu pāpakam ।
karmaṇā manasā vācā brahma sampadyate tadā ॥44॥
slp1: yadA na kurute DIraH sarvaBUtezu pApakam । karmaRA manasA vAcA brahma sampadyate tadA ॥44॥

text: yā dustyajā durmatibhiryā na jīryati jīryataḥ । yo'sau prāṇāntiko rogastāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ tyajataḥ sukham ॥45॥
html:
yā dustyajā durmatibhiryā na jīryati jīryataḥ ।
yo'sau prāṇāntiko rogastāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ tyajataḥ sukham ॥45॥
slp1: yA dustyajA durmatiBiryA na jIryati jIryataH । yo'sO prARAntiko rogastAM tfzRAM tyajataH suKam ॥45॥

text: atra piṅgalayā gītā gāthāḥ śrūyanti pārthiva । yathā sā kṛcchrakāle'pi lebhe dharmaṃ sanātanam ॥46॥
html:
atra piṅgalayā gītā gāthāḥ śrūyanti pārthiva ।
yathā sā kṛcchrakāle'pi lebhe dharmaṃ sanātanam ॥46॥
slp1: atra piNgalayA gItA gATAH SrUyanti pArTiva । yaTA sA kfcCrakAle'pi leBe DarmaM sanAtanam ॥46॥

text: saṅkete piṅgalā veśyā kāntenāsīdvinākṛtā । atha kṛcchragatā śāntāṃ buddhimāsthāpayattadā ॥47॥
html:
saṅkete piṅgalā veśyā kāntenāsīdvinākṛtā ।
atha kṛcchragatā śāntāṃ buddhimāsthāpayattadā ॥47॥
slp1: saNkete piNgalA veSyA kAntenAsIdvinAkftA । aTa kfcCragatA SAntAM budDimAsTApayattadA ॥47॥

text: … Пингала сказал
html: … Пингала сказал

text: piṅgalovāca । unmattāhamanunmattaṃ kāntamanvavasaṃ ciram । antike ramaṇaṃ santaṃ nainamadhyagamaṃ purā ॥48॥
html:
piṅgalovāca ।
unmattāhamanunmattaṃ kāntamanvavasaṃ ciram ।
antike ramaṇaṃ santaṃ nainamadhyagamaṃ purā ॥48॥
slp1: piNgalovAca । unmattAhamanunmattaM kAntamanvavasaM ciram । antike ramaRaM santaM nEnamaDyagamaM purA ॥48॥

text: ekasthūṇaṃ navadvāramapidhāsyāmyagārakam । kā hi kāntamihāyāntamayaṃ kānteti maṃsyate ॥49॥
html:
ekasthūṇaṃ navadvāramapidhāsyāmyagārakam ।
kā hi kāntamihāyāntamayaṃ kānteti maṃsyate ॥49॥
slp1: ekasTURaM navadvAramapiDAsyAmyagArakam । kA hi kAntamihAyAntamayaM kAnteti maMsyate ॥49॥

text: akāmāḥ kāmarūpeṇa dhūrtā narakarūpiṇaḥ । na punarvañcayiṣyanti pratibuddhāsmi jāgṛmi ॥50॥
html:
akāmāḥ kāmarūpeṇa dhūrtā narakarūpiṇaḥ ।
na punarvañcayiṣyanti pratibuddhāsmi jāgṛmi ॥50॥
slp1: akAmAH kAmarUpeRa DUrtA narakarUpiRaH । na punarvaYcayizyanti pratibudDAsmi jAgfmi ॥50॥

text: anartho'pi bhavatyartho daivātpūrvakṛtena vā । saṃbuddhāhaṃ nirākārā nāhamadyājitendriyā ॥51॥
html:
anartho'pi bhavatyartho daivātpūrvakṛtena vā ।
saṃbuddhāhaṃ nirākārā nāhamadyājitendriyā ॥51॥
slp1: anarTo'pi BavatyarTo dEvAtpUrvakftena vA । saMbudDAhaM nirAkArA nAhamadyAjitendriyA ॥51॥

text: sukhaṃ nirāśaḥ svapiti nairāśyaṃ paramaṃ sukham । āśāmanāśāṃ kṛtvā hi sukhaṃ svapiti piṅgalā ॥52॥
html:
sukhaṃ nirāśaḥ svapiti nairāśyaṃ paramaṃ sukham ।
āśāmanāśāṃ kṛtvā hi sukhaṃ svapiti piṅgalā ॥52॥
slp1: suKaM nirASaH svapiti nErASyaM paramaM suKam । ASAmanASAM kftvA hi suKaM svapiti piNgalA ॥52॥

text: etaiścānyaiśca viprasya hetumadbhiḥ prabhāṣitaiḥ । paryavasthāpito rājā senajinmumude sukham] ॥53॥
html:
etaiścānyaiśca viprasya hetumadbhiḥ prabhāṣitaiḥ ।
paryavasthāpito rājā senajinmumude sukham] ॥53॥
slp1: etEScAnyESca viprasya hetumadBiH praBAzitEH । paryavasTApito rAjA senajinmumude suKam] ॥53॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: atikrāmati kāle'sminsarvabhūtakṣayāvahe । kiṃ śreyaḥ pratipadyeta tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
atikrāmati kāle'sminsarvabhūtakṣayāvahe ।
kiṃ śreyaḥ pratipadyeta tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: atikrAmati kAle'sminsarvaBUtakzayAvahe । kiM SreyaH pratipadyeta tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । pituḥ putreṇa saṃvādaṃ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
pituḥ putreṇa saṃvādaṃ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । pituH putreRa saMvAdaM tanniboDa yuDizWira ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dvijāteḥ kasyacitpārtha svādhyāyaniratasya vai । babhūva putro medhāvī medhāvī nāma nāmataḥ ॥3॥
html:
dvijāteḥ kasyacitpārtha svādhyāyaniratasya vai ।
babhūva putro medhāvī medhāvī nāma nāmataḥ ॥3॥
slp1: dvijAteH kasyacitpArTa svADyAyaniratasya vE । baBUva putro meDAvI meDAvI nAma nAmataH ॥3॥

text: so'bravītpitaraṃ putraḥ svādhyāyakaraṇe ratam । mokṣadharmārthakuśalo lokatattvavicakṣaṇaḥ ॥4॥
html:
so'bravītpitaraṃ putraḥ svādhyāyakaraṇe ratam ।
mokṣadharmārthakuśalo lokatattvavicakṣaṇaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: so'bravItpitaraM putraH svADyAyakaraRe ratam । mokzaDarmArTakuSalo lokatattvavicakzaRaH ॥4॥

text: dhīraḥ kiṃ svittāta kuryātprajānankṣipraṃ hyāyurbhraśyate mānavānām । pitastadācakṣva yathārthayogaṃ mamānupūrvyā yena dharmaṃ careyam ॥5॥
html:
dhīraḥ kiṃ svittāta kuryātprajānankṣipraṃ hyāyurbhraśyate mānavānām ।
pitastadācakṣva yathārthayogaṃ mamānupūrvyā yena dharmaṃ careyam ॥5॥
slp1: DIraH kiM svittAta kuryAtprajAnankzipraM hyAyurBraSyate mAnavAnAm । pitastadAcakzva yaTArTayogaM mamAnupUrvyA yena DarmaM careyam ॥5॥

text: vedānadhītya brahmacaryeṇa putra putrānicchetpāvanārthaṃ pitṝṇām । agnīnādhāya vidhivacceṣṭayajño vanaṃ praviśyātha munirbubhūṣet ॥6॥
html:
vedānadhītya brahmacaryeṇa putra putrānicchetpāvanārthaṃ pitṝṇām ।
agnīnādhāya vidhivacceṣṭayajño vanaṃ praviśyātha munirbubhūṣet ॥6॥
slp1: vedAnaDItya brahmacaryeRa putra putrAnicCetpAvanArTaM pitFRAm । agnInADAya viDivaccezwayajYo vanaM praviSyATa munirbuBUzet ॥6॥
author: pitovāca ।

text: evamabhyāhate loke samantātparivārite । amoghāsu patantīṣu kiṃ dhīra iva bhāṣase ॥7॥
html:
evamabhyāhate loke samantātparivārite ।
amoghāsu patantīṣu kiṃ dhīra iva bhāṣase ॥7॥
slp1: evamaByAhate loke samantAtparivArite । amoGAsu patantIzu kiM DIra iva BAzase ॥7॥
author: putra uvāca ।

text: kathamabhyāhato lokaḥ kena vā parivāritaḥ । amoghāḥ kāḥ patantīha kiṃ nu bhīṣayasīva mām ॥8॥
html:
kathamabhyāhato lokaḥ kena vā parivāritaḥ ।
amoghāḥ kāḥ patantīha kiṃ nu bhīṣayasīva mām ॥8॥
slp1: kaTamaByAhato lokaH kena vA parivAritaH । amoGAH kAH patantIha kiM nu BIzayasIva mAm ॥8॥
author: pitovāca ।

text: mṛtyunābhyāhato loko jarayā parivāritaḥ । ahorātrāḥ patantyete nanu kasmānna budhyase ॥9॥
html:
mṛtyunābhyāhato loko jarayā parivāritaḥ ।
ahorātrāḥ patantyete nanu kasmānna budhyase ॥9॥
slp1: mftyunAByAhato loko jarayA parivAritaH । ahorAtrAH patantyete nanu kasmAnna buDyase ॥9॥
author: putra uvāca ।

text: yadāhametajjānāmi na mṛtyustiṣṭhatīti ha । so'haṃ kathaṃ pratīkṣiṣye jālenāpihitaścaran ॥10॥
html:
yadāhametajjānāmi na mṛtyustiṣṭhatīti ha ।
so'haṃ kathaṃ pratīkṣiṣye jālenāpihitaścaran ॥10॥
slp1: yadAhametajjAnAmi na mftyustizWatIti ha । so'haM kaTaM pratIkzizye jAlenApihitaScaran ॥10॥

text: rātryāṃ rātryāṃ vyatītāyāmāyuralpataraṃ yadā । gādhodake matsya iva sukhaṃ vindeta kastadā । tadeva vandhyaṃ divasamiti vidyādvicakṣaṇaḥ ॥11॥
html:
rātryāṃ rātryāṃ vyatītāyāmāyuralpataraṃ yadā ।
gādhodake matsya iva sukhaṃ vindeta kastadā ।
tadeva vandhyaṃ divasamiti vidyādvicakṣaṇaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: rAtryAM rAtryAM vyatItAyAmAyuralpataraM yadA । gADodake matsya iva suKaM vindeta kastadA । tadeva vanDyaM divasamiti vidyAdvicakzaRaH ॥11॥

text: anavāpteṣu kāmeṣu mṛtyurabhyeti mānavam । śaṣpāṇīva vicinvantamanyatragatamānasam । vṛkīvoraṇamāsādya mṛtyurādāya gacchati ॥12॥
html:
anavāpteṣu kāmeṣu mṛtyurabhyeti mānavam ।
śaṣpāṇīva vicinvantamanyatragatamānasam ।
vṛkīvoraṇamāsādya mṛtyurādāya gacchati ॥12॥
slp1: anavAptezu kAmezu mftyuraByeti mAnavam । SazpARIva vicinvantamanyatragatamAnasam । vfkIvoraRamAsAdya mftyurAdAya gacCati ॥12॥

text: adyaiva kuru yacchreyo mā tvā kālo'tyagādayam । akṛteṣveva kāryeṣu mṛtyurvai samprakarṣati ॥13॥
html:
adyaiva kuru yacchreyo mā tvā kālo'tyagādayam ।
akṛteṣveva kāryeṣu mṛtyurvai samprakarṣati ॥13॥
slp1: adyEva kuru yacCreyo mA tvA kAlo'tyagAdayam । akftezveva kAryezu mftyurvE samprakarzati ॥13॥

text: śvaḥkāryamadya kurvīta pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇikam । na hi pratīkṣate mṛtyuḥ kṛtaṃ vāsya na vā kṛtam । ko hi jānāti kasyādya mṛtyusenā nivekṣyate ॥14॥
html:
śvaḥkāryamadya kurvīta pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇikam ।
na hi pratīkṣate mṛtyuḥ kṛtaṃ vāsya na vā kṛtam ।
ko hi jānāti kasyādya mṛtyusenā nivekṣyate ॥14॥
slp1: SvaHkAryamadya kurvIta pUrvAhRe cAparAhRikam । na hi pratIkzate mftyuH kftaM vAsya na vA kftam । ko hi jAnAti kasyAdya mftyusenA nivekzyate ॥14॥

text: yuvaiva dharmaśīlaḥ syādanimittaṃ hi jīvitam । kṛte dharme bhavetkīrtiriha pretya ca vai sukham ॥15॥
html:
yuvaiva dharmaśīlaḥ syādanimittaṃ hi jīvitam ।
kṛte dharme bhavetkīrtiriha pretya ca vai sukham ॥15॥
slp1: yuvEva DarmaSIlaH syAdanimittaM hi jIvitam । kfte Darme BavetkIrtiriha pretya ca vE suKam ॥15॥

text: mohena hi samāviṣṭaḥ putradārārthamudyataḥ । kṛtvā kāryamakāryaṃ vā puṣṭimeṣāṃ prayacchati ॥16॥
html:
mohena hi samāviṣṭaḥ putradārārthamudyataḥ ।
kṛtvā kāryamakāryaṃ vā puṣṭimeṣāṃ prayacchati ॥16॥
slp1: mohena hi samAvizwaH putradArArTamudyataH । kftvA kAryamakAryaM vA puzwimezAM prayacCati ॥16॥

text: taṃ putrapaśusaṃmattaṃ vyāsaktamanasaṃ naram । suptaṃ vyāghraṃ mahaugho vā mṛtyurādāya gacchati ॥17॥
html:
taṃ putrapaśusaṃmattaṃ vyāsaktamanasaṃ naram ।
suptaṃ vyāghraṃ mahaugho vā mṛtyurādāya gacchati ॥17॥
slp1: taM putrapaSusaMmattaM vyAsaktamanasaM naram । suptaM vyAGraM mahOGo vA mftyurAdAya gacCati ॥17॥

text: sañcinvānakamevaikaṃ kāmānāmavitṛptakam । vyāghraḥ paśumivādāya mṛtyurādāya gacchati ॥18॥
html:
sañcinvānakamevaikaṃ kāmānāmavitṛptakam ।
vyāghraḥ paśumivādāya mṛtyurādāya gacchati ॥18॥
slp1: saYcinvAnakamevEkaM kAmAnAmavitfptakam । vyAGraH paSumivAdAya mftyurAdAya gacCati ॥18॥

text: idaṃ kṛtamidaṃ kāryamidamanyatkṛtākṛtam । evamīhāsukhāsaktaṃ kṛtāntaḥ kurute vaśe ॥19॥
html:
idaṃ kṛtamidaṃ kāryamidamanyatkṛtākṛtam ।
evamīhāsukhāsaktaṃ kṛtāntaḥ kurute vaśe ॥19॥
slp1: idaM kftamidaM kAryamidamanyatkftAkftam । evamIhAsuKAsaktaM kftAntaH kurute vaSe ॥19॥

text: kṛtānāṃ phalamaprāptaṃ karmaṇāṃ phalasaṅginam । kṣetrāpaṇagṛhāsaktaṃ mṛtyurādāya gacchati ॥20॥
html:
kṛtānāṃ phalamaprāptaṃ karmaṇāṃ phalasaṅginam ।
kṣetrāpaṇagṛhāsaktaṃ mṛtyurādāya gacchati ॥20॥
slp1: kftAnAM PalamaprAptaM karmaRAM PalasaNginam । kzetrApaRagfhAsaktaM mftyurAdAya gacCati ॥20॥

text: mṛtyurjarā ca vyādhiśca duḥkhaṃ cānekakāraṇam । anuṣaktaṃ yadā dehe kiṃ svastha iva tiṣṭhasi ॥21॥
html:
mṛtyurjarā ca vyādhiśca duḥkhaṃ cānekakāraṇam ।
anuṣaktaṃ yadā dehe kiṃ svastha iva tiṣṭhasi ॥21॥
slp1: mftyurjarA ca vyADiSca duHKaM cAnekakAraRam । anuzaktaM yadA dehe kiM svasTa iva tizWasi ॥21॥

text: jātamevāntako'ntāya jarā cānveti dehinam । anuṣaktā dvayenaite bhāvāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ ॥22॥
html:
jātamevāntako'ntāya jarā cānveti dehinam ।
anuṣaktā dvayenaite bhāvāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ ॥22॥
slp1: jAtamevAntako'ntAya jarA cAnveti dehinam । anuzaktA dvayenEte BAvAH sTAvarajaNgamAH ॥22॥

text: mṛtyorvā gṛhamevaitadyā grāme vasato ratiḥ । devānāmeṣa vai goṣṭho yadaraṇyamiti śrutiḥ ॥23॥
html:
mṛtyorvā gṛhamevaitadyā grāme vasato ratiḥ ।
devānāmeṣa vai goṣṭho yadaraṇyamiti śrutiḥ ॥23॥
slp1: mftyorvA gfhamevEtadyA grAme vasato ratiH । devAnAmeza vE gozWo yadaraRyamiti SrutiH ॥23॥

text: nibandhanī rajjureṣā yā grāme vasato ratiḥ । chittvaināṃ sukṛto yānti naināṃ chindanti duṣkṛtaḥ ॥24॥
html:
nibandhanī rajjureṣā yā grāme vasato ratiḥ ।
chittvaināṃ sukṛto yānti naināṃ chindanti duṣkṛtaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: nibanDanI rajjurezA yA grAme vasato ratiH । CittvEnAM sukfto yAnti nEnAM Cindanti duzkftaH ॥24॥

text: na hiṃsayati yaḥ prāṇānmanovākkāyahetubhiḥ । jīvitārthāpanayanaiḥ karmabhirna sa badhyate ॥25॥
html:
na hiṃsayati yaḥ prāṇānmanovākkāyahetubhiḥ ।
jīvitārthāpanayanaiḥ karmabhirna sa badhyate ॥25॥
slp1: na hiMsayati yaH prARAnmanovAkkAyahetuBiH । jIvitArTApanayanEH karmaBirna sa baDyate ॥25॥

text: na mṛtyusenāmāyāntīṃ jātu kaścitprabādhate । ṛte satyamasantyājyaṃ satye hyamṛtamāśritam ॥26॥
html:
na mṛtyusenāmāyāntīṃ jātu kaścitprabādhate ।
ṛte satyamasantyājyaṃ satye hyamṛtamāśritam ॥26॥
slp1: na mftyusenAmAyAntIM jAtu kaScitprabADate । fte satyamasantyAjyaM satye hyamftamASritam ॥26॥

text: tasmātsatyavratācāraḥ satyayogaparāyaṇaḥ । satyārāmaḥ samo dāntaḥ satyenaivāntakaṃ jayet ॥27॥
html:
tasmātsatyavratācāraḥ satyayogaparāyaṇaḥ ।
satyārāmaḥ samo dāntaḥ satyenaivāntakaṃ jayet ॥27॥
slp1: tasmAtsatyavratAcAraH satyayogaparAyaRaH । satyArAmaH samo dAntaH satyenEvAntakaM jayet ॥27॥

text: amṛtaṃ caiva mṛtyuśca dvayaṃ dehe pratiṣṭhitam । mṛtyumāpadyate mohātsatyenāpadyate'mṛtam ॥28॥
html:
amṛtaṃ caiva mṛtyuśca dvayaṃ dehe pratiṣṭhitam ।
mṛtyumāpadyate mohātsatyenāpadyate'mṛtam ॥28॥
slp1: amftaM cEva mftyuSca dvayaM dehe pratizWitam । mftyumApadyate mohAtsatyenApadyate'mftam ॥28॥

text: so'haṃ hyahiṃsraḥ satyārthī kāmakrodhabahiṣkṛtaḥ । samaduḥkhasukhaḥ kṣemī mṛtyuṃ hāsyāmyamartyavat ॥29॥
html:
so'haṃ hyahiṃsraḥ satyārthī kāmakrodhabahiṣkṛtaḥ ।
samaduḥkhasukhaḥ kṣemī mṛtyuṃ hāsyāmyamartyavat ॥29॥
slp1: so'haM hyahiMsraH satyArTI kAmakroDabahizkftaH । samaduHKasuKaH kzemI mftyuM hAsyAmyamartyavat ॥29॥

text: śāntiyajñarato dānto brahmayajñe sthito muniḥ । vāṅmanaḥkarmayajñaśca bhaviṣyāmyudagāyane ॥30॥
html:
śāntiyajñarato dānto brahmayajñe sthito muniḥ ।
vāṅmanaḥkarmayajñaśca bhaviṣyāmyudagāyane ॥30॥
slp1: SAntiyajYarato dAnto brahmayajYe sTito muniH । vANmanaHkarmayajYaSca BavizyAmyudagAyane ॥30॥

text: paśuyajñaiḥ kathaṃ hiṃsrairmādṛśo yaṣṭumarhati । antavadbhiruta prājñaḥ kṣatrayajñaiḥ piśācavat ॥31॥
html:
paśuyajñaiḥ kathaṃ hiṃsrairmādṛśo yaṣṭumarhati ।
antavadbhiruta prājñaḥ kṣatrayajñaiḥ piśācavat ॥31॥
slp1: paSuyajYEH kaTaM hiMsrErmAdfSo yazwumarhati । antavadBiruta prAjYaH kzatrayajYEH piSAcavat ॥31॥

text: yasya vāṅmanasī syātāṃ samyakpraṇihite sadā । tapastyāgaśca yogaśca sa vai sarvamavāpnuyāt ॥32॥
html:
yasya vāṅmanasī syātāṃ samyakpraṇihite sadā ।
tapastyāgaśca yogaśca sa vai sarvamavāpnuyāt ॥32॥
slp1: yasya vANmanasI syAtAM samyakpraRihite sadA । tapastyAgaSca yogaSca sa vE sarvamavApnuyAt ॥32॥

text: nāsti vidyāsamaṃ cakṣurnāsti vidyāsamaṃ balam । nāsti rāgasamaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāsti tyāgasamaṃ sukham ॥33॥
html:
nāsti vidyāsamaṃ cakṣurnāsti vidyāsamaṃ balam ।
nāsti rāgasamaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāsti tyāgasamaṃ sukham ॥33॥
slp1: nAsti vidyAsamaM cakzurnAsti vidyAsamaM balam । nAsti rAgasamaM duHKaM nAsti tyAgasamaM suKam ॥33॥

text: ātmanyevātmanā jāta ātmaniṣṭho'prajo'pi vā । ātmanyeva bhaviṣyāmi na māṃ tārayati prajā ॥34॥
html:
ātmanyevātmanā jāta ātmaniṣṭho'prajo'pi vā ।
ātmanyeva bhaviṣyāmi na māṃ tārayati prajā ॥34॥
slp1: AtmanyevAtmanA jAta AtmanizWo'prajo'pi vA । Atmanyeva BavizyAmi na mAM tArayati prajA ॥34॥

text: naitādṛśaṃ brāhmaṇasyāsti vittaṃ yathaikatā samatā satyatā ca । śīle sthitirdaṇḍanidhānamārjavaṃ tatastataścoparamaḥ kriyābhyaḥ ॥35॥
html:
naitādṛśaṃ brāhmaṇasyāsti vittaṃ yathaikatā samatā satyatā ca ।
śīle sthitirdaṇḍanidhānamārjavaṃ tatastataścoparamaḥ kriyābhyaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: nEtAdfSaM brAhmaRasyAsti vittaM yaTEkatA samatA satyatA ca । SIle sTitirdaRqaniDAnamArjavaM tatastataScoparamaH kriyAByaH ॥35॥

text: kiṃ te dhanairbāndhavairvāpi kiṃ te kiṃ te dārairbrāhmaṇa yo mariṣyasi । ātmānamanviccha guhāṃ praviṣṭaṃ pitāmahaste kva gataḥ pitā ca ॥36॥
html:
kiṃ te dhanairbāndhavairvāpi kiṃ te kiṃ te dārairbrāhmaṇa yo mariṣyasi ।
ātmānamanviccha guhāṃ praviṣṭaṃ pitāmahaste kva gataḥ pitā ca ॥36॥
slp1: kiM te DanErbAnDavErvApi kiM te kiM te dArErbrAhmaRa yo marizyasi । AtmAnamanvicCa guhAM pravizwaM pitAmahaste kva gataH pitA ca ॥36॥

text: putrasyaitadvacaḥ śrutvā tathākārṣītpitā nṛpa । tathā tvamapi vartasva satyadharmaparāyaṇaḥ] ॥37॥
html:
putrasyaitadvacaḥ śrutvā tathākārṣītpitā nṛpa ।
tathā tvamapi vartasva satyadharmaparāyaṇaḥ] ॥37॥
slp1: putrasyEtadvacaH SrutvA taTAkArzItpitA nfpa । taTA tvamapi vartasva satyaDarmaparAyaRaH] ॥37॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dhanino vādhanā ye ca vartayanti svatantriṇaḥ । sukhaduḥkhāgamasteṣāṃ kaḥ kathaṃ vā pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
dhanino vādhanā ye ca vartayanti svatantriṇaḥ ।
sukhaduḥkhāgamasteṣāṃ kaḥ kathaṃ vā pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: Danino vADanA ye ca vartayanti svatantriRaH । suKaduHKAgamastezAM kaH kaTaM vA pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । śamyākena vimuktena gītaṃ śāntigatena ha ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
śamyākena vimuktena gītaṃ śāntigatena ha ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । SamyAkena vimuktena gItaM SAntigatena ha ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: abravīnmāṃ purā kaścidbrāhmaṇastyāgamāsthitaḥ । kliśyamānaḥ kudāreṇa kucailena bubhukṣayā ॥3॥
html:
abravīnmāṃ purā kaścidbrāhmaṇastyāgamāsthitaḥ ।
kliśyamānaḥ kudāreṇa kucailena bubhukṣayā ॥3॥
slp1: abravInmAM purA kaScidbrAhmaRastyAgamAsTitaH । kliSyamAnaH kudAreRa kucElena buBukzayA ॥3॥

text: utpannamiha loke vai janmaprabhṛti mānavam । vividhānyupavartante duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca ॥4॥
html:
utpannamiha loke vai janmaprabhṛti mānavam ।
vividhānyupavartante duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca ॥4॥
slp1: utpannamiha loke vE janmapraBfti mAnavam । viviDAnyupavartante duHKAni ca suKAni ca ॥4॥

text: tayorekatare mārge yadyenamabhisaṃnayet । na sukhaṃ prāpya saṃhṛṣyenna duḥkhaṃ prāpya sañjvaret ॥5॥
html:
tayorekatare mārge yadyenamabhisaṃnayet ।
na sukhaṃ prāpya saṃhṛṣyenna duḥkhaṃ prāpya sañjvaret ॥5॥
slp1: tayorekatare mArge yadyenamaBisaMnayet । na suKaM prApya saMhfzyenna duHKaM prApya saYjvaret ॥5॥

text: na vai carasi yacchreya ātmano vā yadīhase । akāmātmāpi hi sadā dhuramudyamya caiva hi ॥6॥
html:
na vai carasi yacchreya ātmano vā yadīhase ।
akāmātmāpi hi sadā dhuramudyamya caiva hi ॥6॥
slp1: na vE carasi yacCreya Atmano vA yadIhase । akAmAtmApi hi sadA Duramudyamya cEva hi ॥6॥

text: akiñcanaḥ paripatansukhamāsvādayiṣyasi । akiñcanaḥ sukhaṃ śete samuttiṣṭhati caiva hi ॥7॥
html:
akiñcanaḥ paripatansukhamāsvādayiṣyasi ।
akiñcanaḥ sukhaṃ śete samuttiṣṭhati caiva hi ॥7॥
slp1: akiYcanaH paripatansuKamAsvAdayizyasi । akiYcanaH suKaM Sete samuttizWati cEva hi ॥7॥

text: ākiñcanyaṃ sukhaṃ loke pathyaṃ śivamanāmayam । anamitramatho hyetaddurlabhaṃ sulabhaṃ satām ॥8॥
html:
ākiñcanyaṃ sukhaṃ loke pathyaṃ śivamanāmayam ।
anamitramatho hyetaddurlabhaṃ sulabhaṃ satām ॥8॥
slp1: AkiYcanyaM suKaM loke paTyaM SivamanAmayam । anamitramaTo hyetaddurlaBaM sulaBaM satAm ॥8॥

text: akiñcanasya śuddhasya upapannasya sarvaśaḥ । avekṣamāṇastrīṁllokānna tulyamupalakṣaye ॥9॥
html:
akiñcanasya śuddhasya upapannasya sarvaśaḥ ।
avekṣamāṇastrīṁllokānna tulyamupalakṣaye ॥9॥
slp1: akiYcanasya SudDasya upapannasya sarvaSaH । avekzamARastrIṁllokAnna tulyamupalakzaye ॥9॥

text: ākiñcanyaṃ ca rājyaṃ ca tulayā samatolayam । atyaricyata dāridryaṃ rājyādapi guṇādhikam ॥10॥
html:
ākiñcanyaṃ ca rājyaṃ ca tulayā samatolayam ।
atyaricyata dāridryaṃ rājyādapi guṇādhikam ॥10॥
slp1: AkiYcanyaM ca rAjyaM ca tulayA samatolayam । atyaricyata dAridryaM rAjyAdapi guRADikam ॥10॥

text: ākiñcanye ca rājye ca viśeṣaḥ sumahānayam । nityodvigno hi dhanavānmṛtyorāsyagato yathā ॥11॥
html:
ākiñcanye ca rājye ca viśeṣaḥ sumahānayam ।
nityodvigno hi dhanavānmṛtyorāsyagato yathā ॥11॥
slp1: AkiYcanye ca rAjye ca viSezaH sumahAnayam । nityodvigno hi DanavAnmftyorAsyagato yaTA ॥11॥

text: naivāsyāgnirna cādityo na mṛtyurna ca dasyavaḥ । prabhavanti dhanajyāninirmuktasya nirāśiṣaḥ ॥12॥
html:
naivāsyāgnirna cādityo na mṛtyurna ca dasyavaḥ ।
prabhavanti dhanajyāninirmuktasya nirāśiṣaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: nEvAsyAgnirna cAdityo na mftyurna ca dasyavaH । praBavanti DanajyAninirmuktasya nirASizaH ॥12॥

text: taṃ vai sadā kāmacaramanupastīrṇaśāyinam । bāhūpadhānaṃ śāmyantaṃ praśaṃsanti divaukasaḥ ॥13॥
html:
taṃ vai sadā kāmacaramanupastīrṇaśāyinam ।
bāhūpadhānaṃ śāmyantaṃ praśaṃsanti divaukasaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: taM vE sadA kAmacaramanupastIrRaSAyinam । bAhUpaDAnaM SAmyantaM praSaMsanti divOkasaH ॥13॥

text: dhanavānkrodhalobhābhyāmāviṣṭo naṣṭacetanaḥ । tiryagīkṣaḥ śuṣkamukhaḥ pāpako bhrukuṭīmukhaḥ ॥14॥
html:
dhanavānkrodhalobhābhyāmāviṣṭo naṣṭacetanaḥ ।
tiryagīkṣaḥ śuṣkamukhaḥ pāpako bhrukuṭīmukhaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: DanavAnkroDaloBAByAmAvizwo nazwacetanaH । tiryagIkzaH SuzkamuKaH pApako BrukuwImuKaH ॥14॥

text: nirdaśaṃścādharoṣṭhaṃ ca kruddho dāruṇabhāṣitā । kastamicchetparidraṣṭuṃ dātumicchati cenmahīm ॥15॥
html:
nirdaśaṃścādharoṣṭhaṃ ca kruddho dāruṇabhāṣitā ।
kastamicchetparidraṣṭuṃ dātumicchati cenmahīm ॥15॥
slp1: nirdaSaMScADarozWaM ca krudDo dAruRaBAzitA । kastamicCetparidrazwuM dAtumicCati cenmahIm ॥15॥

text: śriyā hyabhīkṣṇaṃ saṃvāso mohayatyavicakṣaṇam । sā tasya cittaṃ harati śāradābhramivānilaḥ ॥16॥
html:
śriyā hyabhīkṣṇaṃ saṃvāso mohayatyavicakṣaṇam ।
sā tasya cittaṃ harati śāradābhramivānilaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: SriyA hyaBIkzRaM saMvAso mohayatyavicakzaRam । sA tasya cittaM harati SAradABramivAnilaH ॥16॥

text: athainaṃ rūpamānaśca dhanamānaśca vindati । abhijāto'smi siddho'smi nāsmi kevalamānuṣaḥ । ityebhiḥ kāraṇaistasya tribhiścittaṃ prasicyate ॥17॥
html:
athainaṃ rūpamānaśca dhanamānaśca vindati ।
abhijāto'smi siddho'smi nāsmi kevalamānuṣaḥ ।
ityebhiḥ kāraṇaistasya tribhiścittaṃ prasicyate ॥17॥
slp1: aTEnaM rUpamAnaSca DanamAnaSca vindati । aBijAto'smi sidDo'smi nAsmi kevalamAnuzaH । ityeBiH kAraREstasya triBiScittaM prasicyate ॥17॥

text: sa prasiktamanā bhogānvisṛjya pitṛsañcitān । parikṣīṇaḥ parasvānāmādānaṃ sādhu manyate ॥18॥
html:
sa prasiktamanā bhogānvisṛjya pitṛsañcitān ।
parikṣīṇaḥ parasvānāmādānaṃ sādhu manyate ॥18॥
slp1: sa prasiktamanA BogAnvisfjya pitfsaYcitAn । parikzIRaH parasvAnAmAdAnaM sADu manyate ॥18॥

text: tamatikrāntamaryādamādadānaṃ tatastataḥ । pratiṣedhanti rājāno lubdhā mṛgamiveṣubhiḥ ॥19॥
html:
tamatikrāntamaryādamādadānaṃ tatastataḥ ।
pratiṣedhanti rājāno lubdhā mṛgamiveṣubhiḥ ॥19॥
slp1: tamatikrAntamaryAdamAdadAnaM tatastataH । pratizeDanti rAjAno lubDA mfgamivezuBiH ॥19॥

text: evametāni duḥkhāni tāni tānīha mānavam । vividhānyupavartante gātrasaṃsparśajāni ca ॥20॥
html:
evametāni duḥkhāni tāni tānīha mānavam ।
vividhānyupavartante gātrasaṃsparśajāni ca ॥20॥
slp1: evametAni duHKAni tAni tAnIha mAnavam । viviDAnyupavartante gAtrasaMsparSajAni ca ॥20॥

text: teṣāṃ paramaduḥkhānāṃ buddhyā bhaiṣajyamācaret । lokadharmaṃ samājñāya dhruvāṇāmadhruvaiḥ saha ॥21॥
html:
teṣāṃ paramaduḥkhānāṃ buddhyā bhaiṣajyamācaret ।
lokadharmaṃ samājñāya dhruvāṇāmadhruvaiḥ saha ॥21॥
slp1: tezAM paramaduHKAnAM budDyA BEzajyamAcaret । lokaDarmaM samAjYAya DruvARAmaDruvEH saha ॥21॥

text: nātyaktvā sukhamāpnoti nātyaktvā vindate param । nātyaktvā cābhayaḥ śete tyaktvā sarvaṃ sukhī bhava ॥22॥
html:
nātyaktvā sukhamāpnoti nātyaktvā vindate param ।
nātyaktvā cābhayaḥ śete tyaktvā sarvaṃ sukhī bhava ॥22॥
slp1: nAtyaktvA suKamApnoti nAtyaktvA vindate param । nAtyaktvA cABayaH Sete tyaktvA sarvaM suKI Bava ॥22॥

text: ityetaddhāstinapure brāhmaṇenopavarṇitam । śamyākena purā mahyaṃ tasmāttyāgaḥ paro mataḥ] ॥23॥
html:
ityetaddhāstinapure brāhmaṇenopavarṇitam ।
śamyākena purā mahyaṃ tasmāttyāgaḥ paro mataḥ] ॥23॥
slp1: ityetadDAstinapure brAhmaRenopavarRitam । SamyAkena purA mahyaM tasmAttyAgaH paro mataH] ॥23॥

text: īhamānaḥ samārambhānyadi nāsādayeddhanam । dhanatṛṣṇābhibhūtaśca kiṃ kurvansukhamāpnuyāt ॥1॥
html:
īhamānaḥ samārambhānyadi nāsādayeddhanam ।
dhanatṛṣṇābhibhūtaśca kiṃ kurvansukhamāpnuyāt ॥1॥
slp1: IhamAnaH samAramBAnyadi nAsAdayedDanam । DanatfzRABiBUtaSca kiM kurvansuKamApnuyAt ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: sarvasāmyamanāyāsaḥ satyavākyaṃ ca bhārata । nirvedaścāvivitsā ca yasya syātsa sukhī naraḥ ॥2॥
html:
sarvasāmyamanāyāsaḥ satyavākyaṃ ca bhārata ।
nirvedaścāvivitsā ca yasya syātsa sukhī naraḥ ॥2॥
slp1: sarvasAmyamanAyAsaH satyavAkyaM ca BArata । nirvedaScAvivitsA ca yasya syAtsa suKI naraH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: etānyeva padānyāhuḥ pañca vṛddhāḥ praśāntaye । eṣa svargaśca dharmaśca sukhaṃ cānuttamaṃ satām ॥3॥
html:
etānyeva padānyāhuḥ pañca vṛddhāḥ praśāntaye ।
eṣa svargaśca dharmaśca sukhaṃ cānuttamaṃ satām ॥3॥
slp1: etAnyeva padAnyAhuH paYca vfdDAH praSAntaye । eza svargaSca DarmaSca suKaM cAnuttamaM satAm ॥3॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । nirvedānmaṅkinā gītaṃ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥4॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
nirvedānmaṅkinā gītaṃ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥4॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । nirvedAnmaNkinA gItaM tanniboDa yuDizWira ॥4॥

text: īhamāno dhanaṃ maṅkirbhagnehaśca punaḥ punaḥ । kenaciddhanaśeṣeṇa krītavāndamyagoyugam ॥5॥
html:
īhamāno dhanaṃ maṅkirbhagnehaśca punaḥ punaḥ ।
kenaciddhanaśeṣeṇa krītavāndamyagoyugam ॥5॥
slp1: IhamAno DanaM maNkirBagnehaSca punaH punaH । kenacidDanaSezeRa krItavAndamyagoyugam ॥5॥

text: susaṃbaddhau tu tau damyau damanāyābhiniḥsṛtau । āsīnamuṣṭraṃ madhyena sahasaivābhyadhāvatām ॥6॥
html:
susaṃbaddhau tu tau damyau damanāyābhiniḥsṛtau ।
āsīnamuṣṭraṃ madhyena sahasaivābhyadhāvatām ॥6॥
slp1: susaMbadDO tu tO damyO damanAyABiniHsftO । AsInamuzwraM maDyena sahasEvAByaDAvatAm ॥6॥

text: tayoḥ samprāptayoruṣṭraḥ skandhadeśamamarṣaṇaḥ । utthāyotkṣipya tau damyau prasasāra mahājavaḥ ॥7॥
html:
tayoḥ samprāptayoruṣṭraḥ skandhadeśamamarṣaṇaḥ ।
utthāyotkṣipya tau damyau prasasāra mahājavaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: tayoH samprAptayoruzwraH skanDadeSamamarzaRaH । utTAyotkzipya tO damyO prasasAra mahAjavaH ॥7॥

text: hriyamāṇau tu tau damyau tenoṣṭreṇa pramāthinā । mriyamāṇau ca samprekṣya maṅkistatrābravīdidam ॥8॥
html:
hriyamāṇau tu tau damyau tenoṣṭreṇa pramāthinā ।
mriyamāṇau ca samprekṣya maṅkistatrābravīdidam ॥8॥
slp1: hriyamARO tu tO damyO tenozwreRa pramATinA । mriyamARO ca samprekzya maNkistatrAbravIdidam ॥8॥

text: na caivāvihitaṃ śakyaṃ dakṣeṇāpīhituṃ dhanam । yuktena śraddhayā samyagīhāṃ samanutiṣṭhatā ॥9॥
html:
na caivāvihitaṃ śakyaṃ dakṣeṇāpīhituṃ dhanam ।
yuktena śraddhayā samyagīhāṃ samanutiṣṭhatā ॥9॥
slp1: na cEvAvihitaM SakyaM dakzeRApIhituM Danam । yuktena SradDayA samyagIhAM samanutizWatA ॥9॥

text: kṛtasya pūrvaṃ cānarthairyuktasyāpyanutiṣṭhataḥ । imaṃ paśyata saṅgatyā mama daivamupaplavam ॥10॥
html:
kṛtasya pūrvaṃ cānarthairyuktasyāpyanutiṣṭhataḥ ।
imaṃ paśyata saṅgatyā mama daivamupaplavam ॥10॥
slp1: kftasya pUrvaM cAnarTEryuktasyApyanutizWataH । imaM paSyata saNgatyA mama dEvamupaplavam ॥10॥

text: udyamyodyamya me damyau viṣameṇeva gacchati । utkṣipya kākatālīyamunmātheneva jambukaḥ ॥11॥
html:
udyamyodyamya me damyau viṣameṇeva gacchati ।
utkṣipya kākatālīyamunmātheneva jambukaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: udyamyodyamya me damyO vizameReva gacCati । utkzipya kAkatAlIyamunmATeneva jambukaH ॥11॥

text: maṇī voṣṭrasya lambete priyau vatsatarau mama । śuddhaṃ hi daivamevedamato naivāsti pauruṣam ॥12॥
html:
maṇī voṣṭrasya lambete priyau vatsatarau mama ।
śuddhaṃ hi daivamevedamato naivāsti pauruṣam ॥12॥
slp1: maRI vozwrasya lambete priyO vatsatarO mama । SudDaM hi dEvamevedamato nEvAsti pOruzam ॥12॥

text: yadi vāpyupapadyeta pauruṣaṃ nāma karhicit । anviṣyamāṇaṃ tadapi daivamevāvatiṣṭhate ॥13॥
html:
yadi vāpyupapadyeta pauruṣaṃ nāma karhicit ।
anviṣyamāṇaṃ tadapi daivamevāvatiṣṭhate ॥13॥
slp1: yadi vApyupapadyeta pOruzaM nAma karhicit । anvizyamARaM tadapi dEvamevAvatizWate ॥13॥

text: tasmānnirveda eveha gantavyaḥ sukhamīpsatā । sukhaṃ svapiti nirviṇṇo nirāśaścārthasādhane ॥14॥
html:
tasmānnirveda eveha gantavyaḥ sukhamīpsatā ।
sukhaṃ svapiti nirviṇṇo nirāśaścārthasādhane ॥14॥
slp1: tasmAnnirveda eveha gantavyaH suKamIpsatA । suKaM svapiti nirviRRo nirASaScArTasADane ॥14॥

text: aho samyakśukenoktaṃ sarvataḥ parimucyatā । pratiṣṭhatā mahāraṇyaṃ janakasya niveśanāt ॥15॥
html:
aho samyakśukenoktaṃ sarvataḥ parimucyatā ।
pratiṣṭhatā mahāraṇyaṃ janakasya niveśanāt ॥15॥
slp1: aho samyakSukenoktaM sarvataH parimucyatA । pratizWatA mahAraRyaM janakasya niveSanAt ॥15॥

text: yaḥ kāmānprāpnuyātsarvānyaścainānkevalāṃstyajet । prāpaṇātsarvakāmānāṃ parityāgo viśiṣyate ॥16॥
html:
yaḥ kāmānprāpnuyātsarvānyaścainānkevalāṃstyajet ।
prāpaṇātsarvakāmānāṃ parityāgo viśiṣyate ॥16॥
slp1: yaH kAmAnprApnuyAtsarvAnyaScEnAnkevalAMstyajet । prApaRAtsarvakAmAnAM parityAgo viSizyate ॥16॥

text: nāntaṃ sarvavivitsānāṃ gatapūrvo'sti kaścana । śarīre jīvite caiva tṛṣṇā mandasya vardhate ॥17॥
html:
nāntaṃ sarvavivitsānāṃ gatapūrvo'sti kaścana ।
śarīre jīvite caiva tṛṣṇā mandasya vardhate ॥17॥
slp1: nAntaM sarvavivitsAnAM gatapUrvo'sti kaScana । SarIre jIvite cEva tfzRA mandasya varDate ॥17॥

text: nivartasva vivitsābhyaḥ śāmya nirvidya māmaka । asakṛccāsi nikṛto na ca nirvidyase tano ॥18॥
html:
nivartasva vivitsābhyaḥ śāmya nirvidya māmaka ।
asakṛccāsi nikṛto na ca nirvidyase tano ॥18॥
slp1: nivartasva vivitsAByaH SAmya nirvidya mAmaka । asakfccAsi nikfto na ca nirvidyase tano ॥18॥

text: yadi nāhaṃ vināśyaste yadyevaṃ ramase mayā । mā māṃ yojaya lobhena vṛthā tvaṃ vittakāmuka ॥19॥
html:
yadi nāhaṃ vināśyaste yadyevaṃ ramase mayā ।
mā māṃ yojaya lobhena vṛthā tvaṃ vittakāmuka ॥19॥
slp1: yadi nAhaM vinASyaste yadyevaM ramase mayA । mA mAM yojaya loBena vfTA tvaM vittakAmuka ॥19॥

text: sañcitaṃ sañcitaṃ dravyaṃ naṣṭaṃ tava punaḥ punaḥ । kadā vimokṣyase mūḍha dhanehāṃ dhanakāmuka ॥20॥
html:
sañcitaṃ sañcitaṃ dravyaṃ naṣṭaṃ tava punaḥ punaḥ ।
kadā vimokṣyase mūḍha dhanehāṃ dhanakāmuka ॥20॥
slp1: saYcitaM saYcitaM dravyaM nazwaM tava punaH punaH । kadA vimokzyase mUQa DanehAM DanakAmuka ॥20॥

text: aho nu mama bāliśyaṃ yo'haṃ krīḍanakastava । kiṃ naiva jātu puruṣaḥ pareṣāṃ preṣyatāmiyāt ॥21॥
html:
aho nu mama bāliśyaṃ yo'haṃ krīḍanakastava ।
kiṃ naiva jātu puruṣaḥ pareṣāṃ preṣyatāmiyāt ॥21॥
slp1: aho nu mama bAliSyaM yo'haM krIqanakastava । kiM nEva jAtu puruzaH parezAM prezyatAmiyAt ॥21॥

text: na pūrve nāpare jātu kāmānāmantamāpnuvan । tyaktvā sarvasamārambhānpratibuddho'smi jāgṛmi ॥22॥
html:
na pūrve nāpare jātu kāmānāmantamāpnuvan ।
tyaktvā sarvasamārambhānpratibuddho'smi jāgṛmi ॥22॥
slp1: na pUrve nApare jAtu kAmAnAmantamApnuvan । tyaktvA sarvasamAramBAnpratibudDo'smi jAgfmi ॥22॥

text: nūnaṃ te hṛdayaṃ kāma vajrasāramayaṃ dṛdham । yadanarthaśatāviṣṭaṃ śatadhā na vidīryate ॥23॥
html:
nūnaṃ te hṛdayaṃ kāma vajrasāramayaṃ dṛdham ।
yadanarthaśatāviṣṭaṃ śatadhā na vidīryate ॥23॥
slp1: nUnaM te hfdayaM kAma vajrasAramayaM dfDam । yadanarTaSatAvizwaM SataDA na vidIryate ॥23॥

text: tyajāmi kāma tvāṃ caiva yacca kiñcitpriyaṃ tava । tavāhaṃ sukhamanvicchannātmanyupalabhe sukham ॥24॥
html:
tyajāmi kāma tvāṃ caiva yacca kiñcitpriyaṃ tava ।
tavāhaṃ sukhamanvicchannātmanyupalabhe sukham ॥24॥
slp1: tyajAmi kAma tvAM cEva yacca kiYcitpriyaM tava । tavAhaM suKamanvicCannAtmanyupalaBe suKam ॥24॥

text: kāma jānāmi te mūlaṃ saṅkalpātkila jāyase । na tvāṃ saṅkalpayiṣyāmi samūlo na bhaviṣyasi ॥25॥
html:
kāma jānāmi te mūlaṃ saṅkalpātkila jāyase ।
na tvāṃ saṅkalpayiṣyāmi samūlo na bhaviṣyasi ॥25॥
slp1: kAma jAnAmi te mUlaM saNkalpAtkila jAyase । na tvAM saNkalpayizyAmi samUlo na Bavizyasi ॥25॥

text: īhā dhanasya na sukhā labdhvā cintā ca bhūyasī । labdhanāśo yathā mṛtyurlabdhaṃ bhavati vā na vā ॥26॥
html:
īhā dhanasya na sukhā labdhvā cintā ca bhūyasī ।
labdhanāśo yathā mṛtyurlabdhaṃ bhavati vā na vā ॥26॥
slp1: IhA Danasya na suKA labDvA cintA ca BUyasI । labDanASo yaTA mftyurlabDaM Bavati vA na vA ॥26॥

text: paretya yo na labhate tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim । na ca tuṣyati labdhena bhūya eva ca mārgati ॥27॥
html:
paretya yo na labhate tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।
na ca tuṣyati labdhena bhūya eva ca mārgati ॥27॥
slp1: paretya yo na laBate tato duHKataraM nu kim । na ca tuzyati labDena BUya eva ca mArgati ॥27॥

text: anutarṣula evārthaḥ svādu gāṅgamivodakam । madvilāpanametattu pratibuddho'smi santyaja ॥28॥
html:
anutarṣula evārthaḥ svādu gāṅgamivodakam ।
madvilāpanametattu pratibuddho'smi santyaja ॥28॥
slp1: anutarzula evArTaH svAdu gANgamivodakam । madvilApanametattu pratibudDo'smi santyaja ॥28॥

text: ya imaṃ māmakaṃ dehaṃ bhūtagrāmaḥ samāśritaḥ । sa yātvito yathākāmaṃ vasatāṃ vā yathāsukham ॥29॥
html:
ya imaṃ māmakaṃ dehaṃ bhūtagrāmaḥ samāśritaḥ ।
sa yātvito yathākāmaṃ vasatāṃ vā yathāsukham ॥29॥
slp1: ya imaM mAmakaM dehaM BUtagrAmaH samASritaH । sa yAtvito yaTAkAmaM vasatAM vA yaTAsuKam ॥29॥

text: na yuṣmāsviha me prītiḥ kāmalobhānusāriṣu । tasmādutsṛjya sarvānvaḥ satyamevāśrayāmyaham ॥30॥
html:
na yuṣmāsviha me prītiḥ kāmalobhānusāriṣu ।
tasmādutsṛjya sarvānvaḥ satyamevāśrayāmyaham ॥30॥
slp1: na yuzmAsviha me prItiH kAmaloBAnusArizu । tasmAdutsfjya sarvAnvaH satyamevASrayAmyaham ॥30॥

text: sarvabhūtānyahaṃ dehe paśyanmanasi cātmanaḥ । yoge buddhiṃ śrute sattvaṃ mano brahmaṇi dhārayan ॥31॥
html:
sarvabhūtānyahaṃ dehe paśyanmanasi cātmanaḥ ।
yoge buddhiṃ śrute sattvaṃ mano brahmaṇi dhārayan ॥31॥
slp1: sarvaBUtAnyahaM dehe paSyanmanasi cAtmanaH । yoge budDiM Srute sattvaM mano brahmaRi DArayan ॥31॥

text: vihariṣyāmyanāsaktaḥ sukhī lokānnirāmayaḥ । yathā mā tvaṃ punarnaivaṃ duḥkheṣu praṇidhāsyasi ॥32॥
html:
vihariṣyāmyanāsaktaḥ sukhī lokānnirāmayaḥ ।
yathā mā tvaṃ punarnaivaṃ duḥkheṣu praṇidhāsyasi ॥32॥
slp1: viharizyAmyanAsaktaH suKI lokAnnirAmayaH । yaTA mA tvaM punarnEvaM duHKezu praRiDAsyasi ॥32॥
