text: tvayā hi me praṇunnasya gatiranyā na vidyate । tṛṣṇāśokaśramāṇāṃ hi tvaṃ kāma prabhavaḥ sadā ॥33॥
html:
tvayā hi me praṇunnasya gatiranyā na vidyate ।
tṛṣṇāśokaśramāṇāṃ hi tvaṃ kāma prabhavaḥ sadā ॥33॥
slp1: tvayA hi me praRunnasya gatiranyA na vidyate । tfzRASokaSramARAM hi tvaM kAma praBavaH sadA ॥33॥

text: dhananāśo'dhikaṃ duḥkhaṃ manye sarvamahattaram । jñātayo hyavamanyante mitrāṇi ca dhanacyutam ॥34॥
html:
dhananāśo'dhikaṃ duḥkhaṃ manye sarvamahattaram ।
jñātayo hyavamanyante mitrāṇi ca dhanacyutam ॥34॥
slp1: DananASo'DikaM duHKaM manye sarvamahattaram । jYAtayo hyavamanyante mitrARi ca Danacyutam ॥34॥

text: avajñānasahasraistu doṣāḥ kaṣṭatarādhane । dhane sukhakalā yā ca sāpi duḥkhairvidhīyate ॥35॥
html:
avajñānasahasraistu doṣāḥ kaṣṭatarādhane ।
dhane sukhakalā yā ca sāpi duḥkhairvidhīyate ॥35॥
slp1: avajYAnasahasrEstu dozAH kazwatarADane । Dane suKakalA yA ca sApi duHKErviDIyate ॥35॥

text: dhanamasyeti puruṣaṃ purā nighnanti dasyavaḥ । kliśyanti vividhairdaṇḍairnityamudvejayanti ca ॥36॥
html:
dhanamasyeti puruṣaṃ purā nighnanti dasyavaḥ ।
kliśyanti vividhairdaṇḍairnityamudvejayanti ca ॥36॥
slp1: Danamasyeti puruzaM purA niGnanti dasyavaH । kliSyanti viviDErdaRqErnityamudvejayanti ca ॥36॥

text: mandalolupatā duḥkhamiti buddhaṃ cirānmayā । yadyadālambase kāma tattadevānurudhyase ॥37॥
html:
mandalolupatā duḥkhamiti buddhaṃ cirānmayā ।
yadyadālambase kāma tattadevānurudhyase ॥37॥
slp1: mandalolupatA duHKamiti budDaM cirAnmayA । yadyadAlambase kAma tattadevAnuruDyase ॥37॥

text: atattvajño'si bālaśca dustoṣo'pūraṇo'nalaḥ । naiva tvaṃ vettha sulabhaṃ naiva tvaṃ vettha durlabham ॥38॥
html:
atattvajño'si bālaśca dustoṣo'pūraṇo'nalaḥ ।
naiva tvaṃ vettha sulabhaṃ naiva tvaṃ vettha durlabham ॥38॥
slp1: atattvajYo'si bAlaSca dustozo'pUraRo'nalaH । nEva tvaM vetTa sulaBaM nEva tvaM vetTa durlaBam ॥38॥

text: pātālamiva duṣpūro māṃ duḥkhairyoktumicchasi । nāhamadya samāveṣṭuṃ śakyaḥ kāma punastvayā ॥39॥
html:
pātālamiva duṣpūro māṃ duḥkhairyoktumicchasi ।
nāhamadya samāveṣṭuṃ śakyaḥ kāma punastvayā ॥39॥
slp1: pAtAlamiva duzpUro mAM duHKEryoktumicCasi । nAhamadya samAvezwuM SakyaH kAma punastvayA ॥39॥

text: nirvedamahamāsādya dravyanāśādyadṛcchayā । nirvṛtiṃ paramāṃ prāpya nādya kāmānvicintaye ॥40॥
html:
nirvedamahamāsādya dravyanāśādyadṛcchayā ।
nirvṛtiṃ paramāṃ prāpya nādya kāmānvicintaye ॥40॥
slp1: nirvedamahamAsAdya dravyanASAdyadfcCayA । nirvftiM paramAM prApya nAdya kAmAnvicintaye ॥40॥

text: atikleśānsahāmīha nāhaṃ budhyāmyabuddhimān । nikṛto dhananāśena śaye sarvāṅgavijvaraḥ ॥41॥
html:
atikleśānsahāmīha nāhaṃ budhyāmyabuddhimān ।
nikṛto dhananāśena śaye sarvāṅgavijvaraḥ ॥41॥
slp1: atikleSAnsahAmIha nAhaM buDyAmyabudDimAn । nikfto DananASena Saye sarvANgavijvaraH ॥41॥

text: parityajāmi kāma tvāṃ hitvā sarvamanogatīḥ । na tvaṃ mayā punaḥ kāma nasyoteneva raṃsyase ॥42॥
html:
parityajāmi kāma tvāṃ hitvā sarvamanogatīḥ ।
na tvaṃ mayā punaḥ kāma nasyoteneva raṃsyase ॥42॥
slp1: parityajAmi kAma tvAM hitvA sarvamanogatIH । na tvaM mayA punaH kAma nasyoteneva raMsyase ॥42॥

text: kṣamiṣye'kṣamamāṇānāṃ na hiṃsiṣye ca hiṃsitaḥ । dveṣyamuktaḥ priyaṃ vakṣyāmyanādṛtya tadapriyam ॥43॥
html:
kṣamiṣye'kṣamamāṇānāṃ na hiṃsiṣye ca hiṃsitaḥ ।
dveṣyamuktaḥ priyaṃ vakṣyāmyanādṛtya tadapriyam ॥43॥
slp1: kzamizye'kzamamARAnAM na hiMsizye ca hiMsitaH । dvezyamuktaH priyaM vakzyAmyanAdftya tadapriyam ॥43॥

text: tṛptaḥ svasthendriyo nityaṃ yathālabdhena vartayan । na sakāmaṃ kariṣyāmi tvāmahaṃ śatrumātmanaḥ ॥44॥
html:
tṛptaḥ svasthendriyo nityaṃ yathālabdhena vartayan ।
na sakāmaṃ kariṣyāmi tvāmahaṃ śatrumātmanaḥ ॥44॥
slp1: tfptaH svasTendriyo nityaM yaTAlabDena vartayan । na sakAmaM karizyAmi tvAmahaM SatrumAtmanaH ॥44॥

text: nirvedaṃ nirvṛtiṃ tṛptiṃ śāntiṃ satyaṃ damaṃ kṣamām । sarvabhūtadayāṃ caiva viddhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam ॥45॥
html:
nirvedaṃ nirvṛtiṃ tṛptiṃ śāntiṃ satyaṃ damaṃ kṣamām ।
sarvabhūtadayāṃ caiva viddhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam ॥45॥
slp1: nirvedaM nirvftiM tfptiM SAntiM satyaM damaM kzamAm । sarvaBUtadayAM cEva vidDi mAM SaraRAgatam ॥45॥

text: tasmātkāmaśca lobhaśca tṛṣṇā kārpaṇyameva ca । tyajantu māṃ pratiṣṭhantaṃ sattvastho hyasmi sāmpratam ॥46॥
html:
tasmātkāmaśca lobhaśca tṛṣṇā kārpaṇyameva ca ।
tyajantu māṃ pratiṣṭhantaṃ sattvastho hyasmi sāmpratam ॥46॥
slp1: tasmAtkAmaSca loBaSca tfzRA kArpaRyameva ca । tyajantu mAM pratizWantaM sattvasTo hyasmi sAmpratam ॥46॥

text: prahāya kāmaṃ lobhaṃ ca krodhaṃ pāruṣyameva ca । nādya lobhavaśaṃ prāpto duḥkhaṃ prāpsyāmyanātmavān ॥47॥
html:
prahāya kāmaṃ lobhaṃ ca krodhaṃ pāruṣyameva ca ।
nādya lobhavaśaṃ prāpto duḥkhaṃ prāpsyāmyanātmavān ॥47॥
slp1: prahAya kAmaM loBaM ca kroDaM pAruzyameva ca । nAdya loBavaSaM prApto duHKaM prApsyAmyanAtmavAn ॥47॥

text: yadyattyajati kāmānāṃ tatsukhasyābhipūryate । kāmasya vaśago nityaṃ duḥkhameva prapadyate ॥48॥
html:
yadyattyajati kāmānāṃ tatsukhasyābhipūryate ।
kāmasya vaśago nityaṃ duḥkhameva prapadyate ॥48॥
slp1: yadyattyajati kAmAnAM tatsuKasyABipUryate । kAmasya vaSago nityaM duHKameva prapadyate ॥48॥

text: kāmānvyudasya dhunute yatkiñcitpuruṣo rajaḥ । kāmakrodhodbhavaṃ duḥkhamahrīraratireva ca ॥49॥
html:
kāmānvyudasya dhunute yatkiñcitpuruṣo rajaḥ ।
kāmakrodhodbhavaṃ duḥkhamahrīraratireva ca ॥49॥
slp1: kAmAnvyudasya Dunute yatkiYcitpuruzo rajaH । kAmakroDodBavaM duHKamahrIraratireva ca ॥49॥

text: eṣa brahmapraviṣṭo'haṃ grīṣme śītamiva hradam । śāmyāmi parinirvāmi sukhamāse ca kevalam ॥50॥
html:
eṣa brahmapraviṣṭo'haṃ grīṣme śītamiva hradam ।
śāmyāmi parinirvāmi sukhamāse ca kevalam ॥50॥
slp1: eza brahmapravizwo'haM grIzme SItamiva hradam । SAmyAmi parinirvAmi suKamAse ca kevalam ॥50॥

text: yacca kāmasukhaṃ loke yacca divyaṃ mahatsukham । tṛṣṇākṣayasukhasyaite nārhataḥ ṣoḍaśīṃ kalām ॥51॥
html:
yacca kāmasukhaṃ loke yacca divyaṃ mahatsukham ।
tṛṣṇākṣayasukhasyaite nārhataḥ ṣoḍaśīṃ kalām ॥51॥
slp1: yacca kAmasuKaM loke yacca divyaM mahatsuKam । tfzRAkzayasuKasyEte nArhataH zoqaSIM kalAm ॥51॥

text: ātmanā saptamaṃ kāmaṃ hatvā śatrumivottamam । prāpyāvadhyaṃ brahmapuraṃ rājeva syāmahaṃ sukhī ॥52॥
html:
ātmanā saptamaṃ kāmaṃ hatvā śatrumivottamam ।
prāpyāvadhyaṃ brahmapuraṃ rājeva syāmahaṃ sukhī ॥52॥
slp1: AtmanA saptamaM kAmaM hatvA Satrumivottamam । prApyAvaDyaM brahmapuraM rAjeva syAmahaM suKI ॥52॥

text: etāṃ buddhiṃ samāsthāya maṅkirnirvedamāgataḥ । sarvānkāmānparityajya prāpya brahma mahatsukham ॥53॥
html:
etāṃ buddhiṃ samāsthāya maṅkirnirvedamāgataḥ ।
sarvānkāmānparityajya prāpya brahma mahatsukham ॥53॥
slp1: etAM budDiM samAsTAya maNkirnirvedamAgataH । sarvAnkAmAnparityajya prApya brahma mahatsuKam ॥53॥

text: damyanāśakṛte maṅkiramaratvaṃ kilāgamat । acchinatkāmamūlaṃ sa tena prāpa mahatsukham ॥54॥
html:
damyanāśakṛte maṅkiramaratvaṃ kilāgamat ।
acchinatkāmamūlaṃ sa tena prāpa mahatsukham ॥54॥
slp1: damyanASakfte maNkiramaratvaM kilAgamat । acCinatkAmamUlaM sa tena prApa mahatsuKam ॥54॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । gītaṃ videharājena janakena praśāmyatā ॥55॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
gītaṃ videharājena janakena praśāmyatā ॥55॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । gItaM videharAjena janakena praSAmyatA ॥55॥

text: anantaṃ bata me vittaṃ yasya me nāsti kiñcana । mithilāyāṃ pradīptāyāṃ na me dahyati kiñcana ॥56॥
html:
anantaṃ bata me vittaṃ yasya me nāsti kiñcana ।
mithilāyāṃ pradīptāyāṃ na me dahyati kiñcana ॥56॥
slp1: anantaM bata me vittaM yasya me nAsti kiYcana । miTilAyAM pradIptAyAM na me dahyati kiYcana ॥56॥

text: atraivodāharantīmaṃ bodhyasya padasañcayam । nirvedaṃ prati vinyastaṃ pratibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥57॥
html:
atraivodāharantīmaṃ bodhyasya padasañcayam ।
nirvedaṃ prati vinyastaṃ pratibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥57॥
slp1: atrEvodAharantImaM boDyasya padasaYcayam । nirvedaM prati vinyastaM pratiboDa yuDizWira ॥57॥

text: bodhyaṃ dāntamṛṣiṃ rājā nahuṣaḥ paryapṛcchata । nirvedācchāntimāpannaṃ śāntaṃ prajñānatarpitam ॥58॥
html:
bodhyaṃ dāntamṛṣiṃ rājā nahuṣaḥ paryapṛcchata ।
nirvedācchāntimāpannaṃ śāntaṃ prajñānatarpitam ॥58॥
slp1: boDyaM dAntamfziM rAjA nahuzaH paryapfcCata । nirvedAcCAntimApannaM SAntaM prajYAnatarpitam ॥58॥

text: upadeśaṃ mahāprājña śamasyopadiśasva me । kāṃ buddhiṃ samanudhyāya śāntaścarasi nirvṛtaḥ ॥59॥
html:
upadeśaṃ mahāprājña śamasyopadiśasva me ।
kāṃ buddhiṃ samanudhyāya śāntaścarasi nirvṛtaḥ ॥59॥
slp1: upadeSaM mahAprAjYa SamasyopadiSasva me । kAM budDiM samanuDyAya SAntaScarasi nirvftaH ॥59॥

text: upadeśena vartāmi nānuśāsmīha kañcana । lakṣaṇaṃ tasya vakṣye'haṃ tatsvayaṃ pravimṛśyatām ॥60॥
html:
upadeśena vartāmi nānuśāsmīha kañcana ।
lakṣaṇaṃ tasya vakṣye'haṃ tatsvayaṃ pravimṛśyatām ॥60॥
slp1: upadeSena vartAmi nAnuSAsmIha kaYcana । lakzaRaM tasya vakzye'haM tatsvayaM pravimfSyatAm ॥60॥
author: bodhya uvāca ।

text: piṅgalā kuraraḥ sarpaḥ sāraṅgānveṣaṇaṃ vane । iṣukāraḥ kumārī ca ṣaḍete guravo mama] ॥61॥
html:
piṅgalā kuraraḥ sarpaḥ sāraṅgānveṣaṇaṃ vane ।
iṣukāraḥ kumārī ca ṣaḍete guravo mama] ॥61॥
slp1: piNgalA kuraraH sarpaH sAraNgAnvezaRaM vane । izukAraH kumArI ca zaqete guravo mama] ॥61॥

text: kena vṛttena vṛttajña vītaśokaścarenmahīm । kiṃ ca kurvannaro loke prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim ॥1॥
html:
kena vṛttena vṛttajña vītaśokaścarenmahīm ।
kiṃ ca kurvannaro loke prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim ॥1॥
slp1: kena vfttena vfttajYa vItaSokaScarenmahIm । kiM ca kurvannaro loke prApnoti paramAM gatim ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । prahrādasya ca saṃvādaṃ munerājagarasya ca ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
prahrādasya ca saṃvādaṃ munerājagarasya ca ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । prahrAdasya ca saMvAdaM munerAjagarasya ca ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: carantaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kañcitkalyacittamanāmayam । papraccha rājanprahrādo buddhimānprājñasammataḥ ॥3॥
html:
carantaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kañcitkalyacittamanāmayam ।
papraccha rājanprahrādo buddhimānprājñasammataḥ ॥3॥
slp1: carantaM brAhmaRaM kaYcitkalyacittamanAmayam । papracCa rAjanprahrAdo budDimAnprAjYasammataH ॥3॥

text: svasthaḥ śakto mṛdurdānto nirvivitso'nasūyakaḥ । suvāgbahumato loke prājñaścarasi bālavat ॥4॥
html:
svasthaḥ śakto mṛdurdānto nirvivitso'nasūyakaḥ ।
suvāgbahumato loke prājñaścarasi bālavat ॥4॥
slp1: svasTaH Sakto mfdurdAnto nirvivitso'nasUyakaH । suvAgbahumato loke prAjYaScarasi bAlavat ॥4॥

text: naiva prārthayase lābhaṃ nālābheṣvanuśocasi । nityatṛpta iva brahmanna kiñcidavamanyase ॥5॥
html:
naiva prārthayase lābhaṃ nālābheṣvanuśocasi ।
nityatṛpta iva brahmanna kiñcidavamanyase ॥5॥
slp1: nEva prArTayase lABaM nAlABezvanuSocasi । nityatfpta iva brahmanna kiYcidavamanyase ॥5॥

text: srotasā hriyamāṇāsu prajāsvavimanā iva । dharmakāmārthakāryeṣu kūṭastha iva lakṣyase ॥6॥
html:
srotasā hriyamāṇāsu prajāsvavimanā iva ।
dharmakāmārthakāryeṣu kūṭastha iva lakṣyase ॥6॥
slp1: srotasA hriyamARAsu prajAsvavimanA iva । DarmakAmArTakAryezu kUwasTa iva lakzyase ॥6॥

text: nānutiṣṭhasi dharmārthau na kāme cāpi vartase । indriyārthānanādṛtya muktaścarasi sākṣivat ॥7॥
html:
nānutiṣṭhasi dharmārthau na kāme cāpi vartase ।
indriyārthānanādṛtya muktaścarasi sākṣivat ॥7॥
slp1: nAnutizWasi DarmArTO na kAme cApi vartase । indriyArTAnanAdftya muktaScarasi sAkzivat ॥7॥

text: kā nu prajñā śrutaṃ vā kiṃ vṛttirvā kā nu te mune । kṣipramācakṣva me brahmañśreyo yadiha manyase ॥8॥
html:
kā nu prajñā śrutaṃ vā kiṃ vṛttirvā kā nu te mune ।
kṣipramācakṣva me brahmañśreyo yadiha manyase ॥8॥
slp1: kA nu prajYA SrutaM vA kiM vfttirvA kA nu te mune । kzipramAcakzva me brahmaYSreyo yadiha manyase ॥8॥

text: anuyuktaḥ sa medhāvī lokadharmavidhānavit । uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā prahrādamanapārthayā ॥9॥
html:
anuyuktaḥ sa medhāvī lokadharmavidhānavit ।
uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā prahrādamanapārthayā ॥9॥
slp1: anuyuktaH sa meDAvI lokaDarmaviDAnavit । uvAca SlakzRayA vAcA prahrAdamanapArTayA ॥9॥

text: paśyanprahrāda bhūtānāmutpattimanimittataḥ । hrāsaṃ vṛddhiṃ vināśaṃ ca na prahṛṣye na ca vyathe ॥10॥
html:
paśyanprahrāda bhūtānāmutpattimanimittataḥ ।
hrāsaṃ vṛddhiṃ vināśaṃ ca na prahṛṣye na ca vyathe ॥10॥
slp1: paSyanprahrAda BUtAnAmutpattimanimittataH । hrAsaM vfdDiM vinASaM ca na prahfzye na ca vyaTe ॥10॥

text: svabhāvādeva sandṛśya vartamānāḥ pravṛttayaḥ । svabhāvaniratāḥ sarvāḥ paritapye na kenacit ॥11॥
html:
svabhāvādeva sandṛśya vartamānāḥ pravṛttayaḥ ।
svabhāvaniratāḥ sarvāḥ paritapye na kenacit ॥11॥
slp1: svaBAvAdeva sandfSya vartamAnAH pravfttayaH । svaBAvaniratAH sarvAH paritapye na kenacit ॥11॥

text: paśyanprahrāda saṃyogānviprayogaparāyaṇān । sañcayāṃśca vināśāntānna kvacidvidadhe manaḥ ॥12॥
html:
paśyanprahrāda saṃyogānviprayogaparāyaṇān ।
sañcayāṃśca vināśāntānna kvacidvidadhe manaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: paSyanprahrAda saMyogAnviprayogaparAyaRAn । saYcayAMSca vinASAntAnna kvacidvidaDe manaH ॥12॥

text: antavanti ca bhūtāni guṇayuktāni paśyataḥ । utpattinidhanajñasya kiṃ kāryamavaśiṣyate ॥13॥
html:
antavanti ca bhūtāni guṇayuktāni paśyataḥ ।
utpattinidhanajñasya kiṃ kāryamavaśiṣyate ॥13॥
slp1: antavanti ca BUtAni guRayuktAni paSyataH । utpattiniDanajYasya kiM kAryamavaSizyate ॥13॥

text: jalajānāmapi hyantaṃ paryāyeṇopalakṣaye । mahatāmapi kāyānāṃ sūkṣmāṇāṃ ca mahodadhau ॥14॥
html:
jalajānāmapi hyantaṃ paryāyeṇopalakṣaye ।
mahatāmapi kāyānāṃ sūkṣmāṇāṃ ca mahodadhau ॥14॥
slp1: jalajAnAmapi hyantaM paryAyeRopalakzaye । mahatAmapi kAyAnAM sUkzmARAM ca mahodaDO ॥14॥

text: jaṅgamasthāvarāṇāṃ ca bhūtānāmasurādhipa । pārthivānāmapi vyaktaṃ mṛtyuṃ paśyāmi sarvaśaḥ ॥15॥
html:
jaṅgamasthāvarāṇāṃ ca bhūtānāmasurādhipa ।
pārthivānāmapi vyaktaṃ mṛtyuṃ paśyāmi sarvaśaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: jaNgamasTAvarARAM ca BUtAnAmasurADipa । pArTivAnAmapi vyaktaM mftyuM paSyAmi sarvaSaH ॥15॥

text: antarikṣacarāṇāṃ ca dānavottama pakṣiṇām । uttiṣṭhati yathākālaṃ mṛtyurbalavatāmapi ॥16॥
html:
antarikṣacarāṇāṃ ca dānavottama pakṣiṇām ।
uttiṣṭhati yathākālaṃ mṛtyurbalavatāmapi ॥16॥
slp1: antarikzacarARAM ca dAnavottama pakziRAm । uttizWati yaTAkAlaM mftyurbalavatAmapi ॥16॥

text: divi sañcaramāṇāni hrasvāni ca mahānti ca । jyotīṃṣi ca yathākālaṃ patamānāni lakṣaye ॥17॥
html:
divi sañcaramāṇāni hrasvāni ca mahānti ca ।
jyotīṃṣi ca yathākālaṃ patamānāni lakṣaye ॥17॥
slp1: divi saYcaramARAni hrasvAni ca mahAnti ca । jyotIMzi ca yaTAkAlaM patamAnAni lakzaye ॥17॥

text: iti bhūtāni saṃpaśyannanuṣaktāni mṛtyunā । sarvasāmānyato vidvānkṛtakṛtyaḥ sukhaṃ svape ॥18॥
html:
iti bhūtāni saṃpaśyannanuṣaktāni mṛtyunā ।
sarvasāmānyato vidvānkṛtakṛtyaḥ sukhaṃ svape ॥18॥
slp1: iti BUtAni saMpaSyannanuzaktAni mftyunA । sarvasAmAnyato vidvAnkftakftyaH suKaM svape ॥18॥

text: sumahāntamapi grāsaṃ grase labdhaṃ yadṛcchayā । śaye punarabhuñjāno divasāni bahūnyapi ॥19॥
html:
sumahāntamapi grāsaṃ grase labdhaṃ yadṛcchayā ।
śaye punarabhuñjāno divasāni bahūnyapi ॥19॥
slp1: sumahAntamapi grAsaM grase labDaM yadfcCayA । Saye punaraBuYjAno divasAni bahUnyapi ॥19॥

text: āsravatyapi māmannaṃ punarbahuguṇaṃ bahu । punaralpaguṇaṃ stokaṃ punarnaivopapadyate ॥20॥
html:
āsravatyapi māmannaṃ punarbahuguṇaṃ bahu ।
punaralpaguṇaṃ stokaṃ punarnaivopapadyate ॥20॥
slp1: Asravatyapi mAmannaM punarbahuguRaM bahu । punaralpaguRaM stokaM punarnEvopapadyate ॥20॥

text: kaṇānkadācitkhādāmi piṇyākamapi ca grase । bhakṣaye śālimāṃsāni bhakṣāṃścoccāvacānpunaḥ ॥21॥
html:
kaṇānkadācitkhādāmi piṇyākamapi ca grase ।
bhakṣaye śālimāṃsāni bhakṣāṃścoccāvacānpunaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: kaRAnkadAcitKAdAmi piRyAkamapi ca grase । Bakzaye SAlimAMsAni BakzAMScoccAvacAnpunaH ॥21॥

text: śaye kadācitparyaṅke bhūmāvapi punaḥ śaye । prāsāde'pi ca me śayyā kadācidupapadyate ॥22॥
html:
śaye kadācitparyaṅke bhūmāvapi punaḥ śaye ।
prāsāde'pi ca me śayyā kadācidupapadyate ॥22॥
slp1: Saye kadAcitparyaNke BUmAvapi punaH Saye । prAsAde'pi ca me SayyA kadAcidupapadyate ॥22॥

text: dhārayāmi ca cīrāṇi śāṇīṃ kṣaumājināni ca । mahārhāṇi ca vāsāṃsi dhārayāmyahamekadā ॥23॥
html:
dhārayāmi ca cīrāṇi śāṇīṃ kṣaumājināni ca ।
mahārhāṇi ca vāsāṃsi dhārayāmyahamekadā ॥23॥
slp1: DArayAmi ca cIrARi SARIM kzOmAjinAni ca । mahArhARi ca vAsAMsi DArayAmyahamekadA ॥23॥

text: na sannipatitaṃ dharmyamupabhogaṃ yadṛcchayā । pratyācakṣe na cāpyenamanurudhye sudurlabham ॥24॥
html:
na sannipatitaṃ dharmyamupabhogaṃ yadṛcchayā ।
pratyācakṣe na cāpyenamanurudhye sudurlabham ॥24॥
slp1: na sannipatitaM DarmyamupaBogaM yadfcCayA । pratyAcakze na cApyenamanuruDye sudurlaBam ॥24॥

text: acalamanidhanaṃ śivaṃ viśokaṃ śucimatulaṃ viduṣāṃ mate niviṣṭam । anabhimatamasevitaṃ ca mūḍhairvratamidamājagaraṃ śuciścarāmi ॥25॥
html:
acalamanidhanaṃ śivaṃ viśokaṃ śucimatulaṃ viduṣāṃ mate niviṣṭam ।
anabhimatamasevitaṃ ca mūḍhairvratamidamājagaraṃ śuciścarāmi ॥25॥
slp1: acalamaniDanaM SivaM viSokaM SucimatulaM viduzAM mate nivizwam । anaBimatamasevitaM ca mUQErvratamidamAjagaraM SuciScarAmi ॥25॥

text: acalitamatiracyutaḥ svadharmātparimitasaṃsaraṇaḥ parāvarajñaḥ । vigatabhayakaṣāyalobhamoho vratamidamājagaraṃ śuciścarāmi ॥26॥
html:
acalitamatiracyutaḥ svadharmātparimitasaṃsaraṇaḥ parāvarajñaḥ ।
vigatabhayakaṣāyalobhamoho vratamidamājagaraṃ śuciścarāmi ॥26॥
slp1: acalitamatiracyutaH svaDarmAtparimitasaMsaraRaH parAvarajYaH । vigataBayakazAyaloBamoho vratamidamAjagaraM SuciScarAmi ॥26॥

text: aniyataphalabhakṣyabhojyapeyaṃ vidhipariṇāmavibhaktadeśakālam । hṛdayasukhamasevitaṃ kadaryairvratamidamājagaraṃ śuciścarāmi ॥27॥
html:
aniyataphalabhakṣyabhojyapeyaṃ vidhipariṇāmavibhaktadeśakālam ।
hṛdayasukhamasevitaṃ kadaryairvratamidamājagaraṃ śuciścarāmi ॥27॥
slp1: aniyataPalaBakzyaBojyapeyaM viDipariRAmaviBaktadeSakAlam । hfdayasuKamasevitaM kadaryErvratamidamAjagaraM SuciScarAmi ॥27॥

text: idamidamiti tṛṣṇayābhibhūtaṃ janamanavāptadhanaṃ viṣīdamānam । nipuṇamanuniśāmya tattvabuddhyā vratamidamājagaraṃ śuciścarāmi ॥28॥
html:
idamidamiti tṛṣṇayābhibhūtaṃ janamanavāptadhanaṃ viṣīdamānam ।
nipuṇamanuniśāmya tattvabuddhyā vratamidamājagaraṃ śuciścarāmi ॥28॥
slp1: idamidamiti tfzRayABiBUtaM janamanavAptaDanaM vizIdamAnam । nipuRamanuniSAmya tattvabudDyA vratamidamAjagaraM SuciScarAmi ॥28॥

text: bahuvidhamanudṛśya cārthahetoḥ kṛpaṇamihāryamanāryamāśrayantam । upaśamarucirātmavānpraśānto vratamidamājagaraṃ śuciścarāmi ॥29॥
html:
bahuvidhamanudṛśya cārthahetoḥ kṛpaṇamihāryamanāryamāśrayantam ।
upaśamarucirātmavānpraśānto vratamidamājagaraṃ śuciścarāmi ॥29॥
slp1: bahuviDamanudfSya cArTahetoH kfpaRamihAryamanAryamASrayantam । upaSamarucirAtmavAnpraSAnto vratamidamAjagaraM SuciScarAmi ॥29॥

text: sukhamasukhamanarthamarthalābhaṃ ratimaratiṃ maraṇaṃ ca jīvitaṃ ca । vidhiniyatamavekṣya tattvato'haṃ vratamidamājagaraṃ śuciścarāmi ॥30॥
html:
sukhamasukhamanarthamarthalābhaṃ ratimaratiṃ maraṇaṃ ca jīvitaṃ ca ।
vidhiniyatamavekṣya tattvato'haṃ vratamidamājagaraṃ śuciścarāmi ॥30॥
slp1: suKamasuKamanarTamarTalABaM ratimaratiM maraRaM ca jIvitaM ca । viDiniyatamavekzya tattvato'haM vratamidamAjagaraM SuciScarAmi ॥30॥

text: apagatabhayarāgamohadarpo dhṛtimatibuddhisamanvitaḥ praśāntaḥ । upagataphalabhogino niśāmya vratamidamājagaraṃ śuciścarāmi ॥31॥
html:
apagatabhayarāgamohadarpo dhṛtimatibuddhisamanvitaḥ praśāntaḥ ।
upagataphalabhogino niśāmya vratamidamājagaraṃ śuciścarāmi ॥31॥
slp1: apagataBayarAgamohadarpo DftimatibudDisamanvitaH praSAntaH । upagataPalaBogino niSAmya vratamidamAjagaraM SuciScarAmi ॥31॥

text: aniyataśayanāsanaḥ prakṛtyā damaniyamavratasatyaśaucayuktaḥ । apagataphalasañcayaḥ prahṛṣṭo vratamidamājagaraṃ śuciścarāmi ॥32॥
html:
aniyataśayanāsanaḥ prakṛtyā damaniyamavratasatyaśaucayuktaḥ ।
apagataphalasañcayaḥ prahṛṣṭo vratamidamājagaraṃ śuciścarāmi ॥32॥
slp1: aniyataSayanAsanaH prakftyA damaniyamavratasatyaSOcayuktaH । apagataPalasaYcayaH prahfzwo vratamidamAjagaraM SuciScarAmi ॥32॥

text: abhigatamasukhārthamīhanārthairupagatabuddhiravekṣya cātmasaṃsthaḥ । tṛṣitamaniyataṃ mano niyantuṃ vratamidamājagaraṃ śuciścarāmi ॥33॥
html:
abhigatamasukhārthamīhanārthairupagatabuddhiravekṣya cātmasaṃsthaḥ ।
tṛṣitamaniyataṃ mano niyantuṃ vratamidamājagaraṃ śuciścarāmi ॥33॥
slp1: aBigatamasuKArTamIhanArTErupagatabudDiravekzya cAtmasaMsTaH । tfzitamaniyataM mano niyantuM vratamidamAjagaraM SuciScarAmi ॥33॥

text: na hṛdayamanurudhyate mano vā priyasukhadurlabhatāmanityatāṃ ca । tadubhayamupalakṣayannivāhaṃ vratamidamājagaraṃ śuciścarāmi ॥34॥
html:
na hṛdayamanurudhyate mano vā priyasukhadurlabhatāmanityatāṃ ca ।
tadubhayamupalakṣayannivāhaṃ vratamidamājagaraṃ śuciścarāmi ॥34॥
slp1: na hfdayamanuruDyate mano vA priyasuKadurlaBatAmanityatAM ca । taduBayamupalakzayannivAhaM vratamidamAjagaraM SuciScarAmi ॥34॥

text: bahu kathitamidaṃ hi buddhimadbhiḥ kavibhirabhiprathayadbhirātmakīrtim । idamidamiti tatra tatra tattatsvaparamatairgahanaṃ pratarkayadbhiḥ ॥35॥
html:
bahu kathitamidaṃ hi buddhimadbhiḥ kavibhirabhiprathayadbhirātmakīrtim ।
idamidamiti tatra tatra tattatsvaparamatairgahanaṃ pratarkayadbhiḥ ॥35॥
slp1: bahu kaTitamidaM hi budDimadBiH kaviBiraBipraTayadBirAtmakIrtim । idamidamiti tatra tatra tattatsvaparamatErgahanaM pratarkayadBiH ॥35॥

text: tadahamanuniśāmya viprayātaṃ pṛthagabhipannamihābudhairmanuṣyaiḥ । anavasitamanantadoṣapāraṃ nṛṣu viharāmi vinītaroṣatṛṣṇaḥ ॥36॥
html:
tadahamanuniśāmya viprayātaṃ pṛthagabhipannamihābudhairmanuṣyaiḥ ।
anavasitamanantadoṣapāraṃ nṛṣu viharāmi vinītaroṣatṛṣṇaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: tadahamanuniSAmya viprayAtaM pfTagaBipannamihAbuDErmanuzyEH । anavasitamanantadozapAraM nfzu viharAmi vinItarozatfzRaH ॥36॥

text: ajagaracaritaṃ vrataṃ mahātmā ya iha naro'nucaredvinītarāgaḥ । apagatabhayamanyulobhamohaḥ sa khalu sukhī viharedimaṃ vihāram] ॥37॥
html:
ajagaracaritaṃ vrataṃ mahātmā ya iha naro'nucaredvinītarāgaḥ ।
apagatabhayamanyulobhamohaḥ sa khalu sukhī viharedimaṃ vihāram] ॥37॥
slp1: ajagaracaritaM vrataM mahAtmA ya iha naro'nucaredvinItarAgaH । apagataBayamanyuloBamohaH sa Kalu suKI viharedimaM vihAram] ॥37॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: bāndhavāḥ karma vittaṃ vā prajñā veha pitāmaha । narasya kā pratiṣṭhā syādetatpṛṣṭo vadasva me ॥1॥
html:
bāndhavāḥ karma vittaṃ vā prajñā veha pitāmaha ।
narasya kā pratiṣṭhā syādetatpṛṣṭo vadasva me ॥1॥
slp1: bAnDavAH karma vittaM vA prajYA veha pitAmaha । narasya kA pratizWA syAdetatpfzwo vadasva me ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: prajñā pratiṣṭhā bhūtānāṃ prajñā lābhaḥ paro mataḥ । prajñā naiḥśreyasī loke prajñā svargo mataḥ satām ॥2॥
html:
prajñā pratiṣṭhā bhūtānāṃ prajñā lābhaḥ paro mataḥ ।
prajñā naiḥśreyasī loke prajñā svargo mataḥ satām ॥2॥
slp1: prajYA pratizWA BUtAnAM prajYA lABaH paro mataH । prajYA nEHSreyasI loke prajYA svargo mataH satAm ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: prajñayā prāpitārtho hi baliraiśvaryasaṅkṣaye । prahrādo namucirmaṅkistasyāḥ kiṃ vidyate param ॥3॥
html:
prajñayā prāpitārtho hi baliraiśvaryasaṅkṣaye ।
prahrādo namucirmaṅkistasyāḥ kiṃ vidyate param ॥3॥
slp1: prajYayA prApitArTo hi balirESvaryasaNkzaye । prahrAdo namucirmaNkistasyAH kiM vidyate param ॥3॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । indrakāśyapasaṃvādaṃ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥4॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
indrakāśyapasaṃvādaṃ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥4॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । indrakASyapasaMvAdaM tanniboDa yuDizWira ॥4॥

text: vaiśyaḥ kaścidṛṣiṃ tāta kāśyapaṃ saṃśitavratam । rathena pātayāmāsa śrīmāndṛptastapasvinam ॥5॥
html:
vaiśyaḥ kaścidṛṣiṃ tāta kāśyapaṃ saṃśitavratam ।
rathena pātayāmāsa śrīmāndṛptastapasvinam ॥5॥
slp1: vESyaH kaScidfziM tAta kASyapaM saMSitavratam । raTena pAtayAmAsa SrImAndfptastapasvinam ॥5॥

text: ārtaḥ sa patitaḥ kruddhastyaktvātmānamathābravīt । mariṣyāmyadhanasyeha jīvitārtho na vidyate ॥6॥
html:
ārtaḥ sa patitaḥ kruddhastyaktvātmānamathābravīt ।
mariṣyāmyadhanasyeha jīvitārtho na vidyate ॥6॥
slp1: ArtaH sa patitaH krudDastyaktvAtmAnamaTAbravIt । marizyAmyaDanasyeha jIvitArTo na vidyate ॥6॥

text: tathā mumūrṣumāsīnamakūjantamacetasam । indraḥ sṛgālarūpeṇa babhāṣe kruddhamānasam ॥7॥
html:
tathā mumūrṣumāsīnamakūjantamacetasam ।
indraḥ sṛgālarūpeṇa babhāṣe kruddhamānasam ॥7॥
slp1: taTA mumUrzumAsInamakUjantamacetasam । indraH sfgAlarUpeRa baBAze krudDamAnasam ॥7॥

text: manuṣyayonimicchanti sarvabhūtāni sarvaśaḥ । manuṣyatve ca vipratvaṃ sarva evābhinandati ॥8॥
html:
manuṣyayonimicchanti sarvabhūtāni sarvaśaḥ ।
manuṣyatve ca vipratvaṃ sarva evābhinandati ॥8॥
slp1: manuzyayonimicCanti sarvaBUtAni sarvaSaH । manuzyatve ca vipratvaM sarva evABinandati ॥8॥

text: manuṣyo brāhmaṇaścāsi śrotriyaścāsi kāśyapa । sudurlabhamavāpyaitadadoṣānmartumicchasi ॥9॥
html:
manuṣyo brāhmaṇaścāsi śrotriyaścāsi kāśyapa ।
sudurlabhamavāpyaitadadoṣānmartumicchasi ॥9॥
slp1: manuzyo brAhmaRaScAsi SrotriyaScAsi kASyapa । sudurlaBamavApyEtadadozAnmartumicCasi ॥9॥

text: sarve lābhāḥ sābhimānā iti satyā bata śrutiḥ । santoṣaṇīyarūpo'si lobhādyadabhimanyase ॥10॥
html:
sarve lābhāḥ sābhimānā iti satyā bata śrutiḥ ।
santoṣaṇīyarūpo'si lobhādyadabhimanyase ॥10॥
slp1: sarve lABAH sABimAnA iti satyA bata SrutiH । santozaRIyarUpo'si loBAdyadaBimanyase ॥10॥

text: aho siddhārthatā teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ santīha pāṇayaḥ । pāṇimadbhyaḥ spṛhāsmākaṃ yathā tava dhanasya vai ॥11॥
html:
aho siddhārthatā teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ santīha pāṇayaḥ ।
pāṇimadbhyaḥ spṛhāsmākaṃ yathā tava dhanasya vai ॥11॥
slp1: aho sidDArTatA tezAM yezAM santIha pARayaH । pARimadByaH spfhAsmAkaM yaTA tava Danasya vE ॥11॥

text: na pāṇilābhādadhiko lābhaḥ kaścana vidyate । apāṇitvādvayaṃ brahmankaṇṭakānnoddharāmahe ॥12॥
html:
na pāṇilābhādadhiko lābhaḥ kaścana vidyate ।
apāṇitvādvayaṃ brahmankaṇṭakānnoddharāmahe ॥12॥
slp1: na pARilABAdaDiko lABaH kaScana vidyate । apARitvAdvayaM brahmankaRwakAnnodDarAmahe ॥12॥

text: atha yeṣāṃ punaḥ pāṇī devadattau daśāṅgulī । uddharanti kṛmīnaṅgāddaśamānānkaṣanti ca ॥13॥
html:
atha yeṣāṃ punaḥ pāṇī devadattau daśāṅgulī ।
uddharanti kṛmīnaṅgāddaśamānānkaṣanti ca ॥13॥
slp1: aTa yezAM punaH pARI devadattO daSANgulI । udDaranti kfmInaNgAddaSamAnAnkazanti ca ॥13॥

text: himavarṣātapānāṃ ca paritrāṇāni kurvate । celamannaṃ sukhaṃ śayyāṃ nivātaṃ copabhuñjate ॥14॥
html:
himavarṣātapānāṃ ca paritrāṇāni kurvate ।
celamannaṃ sukhaṃ śayyāṃ nivātaṃ copabhuñjate ॥14॥
slp1: himavarzAtapAnAM ca paritrARAni kurvate । celamannaM suKaM SayyAM nivAtaM copaBuYjate ॥14॥

text: adhiṣṭhāya ca gāṃ loke bhuñjate vāhayanti ca । upāyairbahubhiścaiva vaśyānātmani kurvate ॥15॥
html:
adhiṣṭhāya ca gāṃ loke bhuñjate vāhayanti ca ।
upāyairbahubhiścaiva vaśyānātmani kurvate ॥15॥
slp1: aDizWAya ca gAM loke BuYjate vAhayanti ca । upAyErbahuBiScEva vaSyAnAtmani kurvate ॥15॥

text: ye khalvajihvāḥ kṛpaṇā alpaprāṇā apāṇayaḥ । sahante tāni duḥkhāni diṣṭyā tvaṃ na tathā mune ॥16॥
html:
ye khalvajihvāḥ kṛpaṇā alpaprāṇā apāṇayaḥ ।
sahante tāni duḥkhāni diṣṭyā tvaṃ na tathā mune ॥16॥
slp1: ye KalvajihvAH kfpaRA alpaprARA apARayaH । sahante tAni duHKAni dizwyA tvaM na taTA mune ॥16॥

text: diṣṭyā tvaṃ na sṛgālo vai na kṛmirna ca mūṣakaḥ । na sarpo na ca maṇḍūko na cānyaḥ pāpayonijaḥ ॥17॥
html:
diṣṭyā tvaṃ na sṛgālo vai na kṛmirna ca mūṣakaḥ ।
na sarpo na ca maṇḍūko na cānyaḥ pāpayonijaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: dizwyA tvaM na sfgAlo vE na kfmirna ca mUzakaH । na sarpo na ca maRqUko na cAnyaH pApayonijaH ॥17॥

text: etāvatāpi lābhena toṣṭumarhasi kāśyapa । kiṃ punaryo'si sattvānāṃ sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇottamaḥ ॥18॥
html:
etāvatāpi lābhena toṣṭumarhasi kāśyapa ।
kiṃ punaryo'si sattvānāṃ sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇottamaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: etAvatApi lABena tozwumarhasi kASyapa । kiM punaryo'si sattvAnAM sarvezAM brAhmaRottamaH ॥18॥

text: ime māṃ kṛmayo'danti teṣāmuddharaṇāya me । nāsti śaktirapāṇitvātpaśyāvasthāmimāṃ mama ॥19॥
html:
ime māṃ kṛmayo'danti teṣāmuddharaṇāya me ।
nāsti śaktirapāṇitvātpaśyāvasthāmimāṃ mama ॥19॥
slp1: ime mAM kfmayo'danti tezAmudDaraRAya me । nAsti SaktirapARitvAtpaSyAvasTAmimAM mama ॥19॥

text: akāryamiti caivemaṃ nātmānaṃ santyajāmyaham । netaḥ pāpīyasīṃ yoniṃ pateyamaparāmiti ॥20॥
html:
akāryamiti caivemaṃ nātmānaṃ santyajāmyaham ।
netaḥ pāpīyasīṃ yoniṃ pateyamaparāmiti ॥20॥
slp1: akAryamiti cEvemaM nAtmAnaM santyajAmyaham । netaH pApIyasIM yoniM pateyamaparAmiti ॥20॥

text: madhye vai pāpayonīnāṃ sārgālī yāmahaṃ gataḥ । pāpīyasyo bahutarā ito'nyāḥ pāpayonayaḥ ॥21॥
html:
madhye vai pāpayonīnāṃ sārgālī yāmahaṃ gataḥ ।
pāpīyasyo bahutarā ito'nyāḥ pāpayonayaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: maDye vE pApayonInAM sArgAlI yAmahaM gataH । pApIyasyo bahutarA ito'nyAH pApayonayaH ॥21॥

text: jātyaivaike sukhatarāḥ santyanye bhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ । naikāntasukhameveha kvacitpaśyāmi kasyacit ॥22॥
html:
jātyaivaike sukhatarāḥ santyanye bhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ ।
naikāntasukhameveha kvacitpaśyāmi kasyacit ॥22॥
slp1: jAtyEvEke suKatarAH santyanye BfSaduHKitAH । nEkAntasuKameveha kvacitpaSyAmi kasyacit ॥22॥

text: manuṣyā hyāḍhyatāṃ prāpya rājyamicchantyanantaram । rājyāddevatvamicchanti devatvādindratāmapi ॥23॥
html:
manuṣyā hyāḍhyatāṃ prāpya rājyamicchantyanantaram ।
rājyāddevatvamicchanti devatvādindratāmapi ॥23॥
slp1: manuzyA hyAQyatAM prApya rAjyamicCantyanantaram । rAjyAddevatvamicCanti devatvAdindratAmapi ॥23॥

text: bhavestvaṃ yadyapi tvāḍhyo na rājā na ca daivatam । devatvaṃ prāpya cendratvaṃ naiva tuṣyestathā sati ॥24॥
html:
bhavestvaṃ yadyapi tvāḍhyo na rājā na ca daivatam ।
devatvaṃ prāpya cendratvaṃ naiva tuṣyestathā sati ॥24॥
slp1: BavestvaM yadyapi tvAQyo na rAjA na ca dEvatam । devatvaM prApya cendratvaM nEva tuzyestaTA sati ॥24॥

text: na tṛptiḥ priyalābhe'sti tṛṣṇā nādbhiḥ praśāmyati । samprajvalati sā bhūyaḥ samidbhiriva pāvakaḥ ॥25॥
html:
na tṛptiḥ priyalābhe'sti tṛṣṇā nādbhiḥ praśāmyati ।
samprajvalati sā bhūyaḥ samidbhiriva pāvakaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: na tfptiH priyalABe'sti tfzRA nAdBiH praSAmyati । samprajvalati sA BUyaH samidBiriva pAvakaH ॥25॥

text: astyeva tvayi śoko vai harṣaścāsti tathā tvayi । sukhaduḥkhe tathā cobhe tatra kā paridevanā ॥26॥
html:
astyeva tvayi śoko vai harṣaścāsti tathā tvayi ।
sukhaduḥkhe tathā cobhe tatra kā paridevanā ॥26॥
slp1: astyeva tvayi Soko vE harzaScAsti taTA tvayi । suKaduHKe taTA coBe tatra kA paridevanA ॥26॥

text: paricchidyaiva kāmānāṃ sarveṣāṃ caiva karmaṇām । mūlaṃ rundhīndriyagrāmaṃ śakuntāniva pañjare ॥27॥
html:
paricchidyaiva kāmānāṃ sarveṣāṃ caiva karmaṇām ।
mūlaṃ rundhīndriyagrāmaṃ śakuntāniva pañjare ॥27॥
slp1: paricCidyEva kAmAnAM sarvezAM cEva karmaRAm । mUlaM runDIndriyagrAmaM SakuntAniva paYjare ॥27॥

text: na khalvapyarasajñasya kāmaḥ kvacana jāyate । saṃsparśāddarśanādvāpi śravaṇādvāpi jāyate ॥28॥
html:
na khalvapyarasajñasya kāmaḥ kvacana jāyate ।
saṃsparśāddarśanādvāpi śravaṇādvāpi jāyate ॥28॥
slp1: na KalvapyarasajYasya kAmaH kvacana jAyate । saMsparSAddarSanAdvApi SravaRAdvApi jAyate ॥28॥

text: na tvaṃ smarasi vāruṇyā laṭvākānāṃ ca pakṣiṇām । tābhyāṃ cābhyadhiko bhakṣyo na kaścidvidyate kvacit ॥29॥
html:
na tvaṃ smarasi vāruṇyā laṭvākānāṃ ca pakṣiṇām ।
tābhyāṃ cābhyadhiko bhakṣyo na kaścidvidyate kvacit ॥29॥
slp1: na tvaM smarasi vAruRyA lawvAkAnAM ca pakziRAm । tAByAM cAByaDiko Bakzyo na kaScidvidyate kvacit ॥29॥

text: yāni cānyāni dūreṣu bhakṣyabhojyāni kāśyapa । yeṣāmabhuktapūrvaṃ te teṣāmasmṛtireva ca ॥30॥
html:
yāni cānyāni dūreṣu bhakṣyabhojyāni kāśyapa ।
yeṣāmabhuktapūrvaṃ te teṣāmasmṛtireva ca ॥30॥
slp1: yAni cAnyAni dUrezu BakzyaBojyAni kASyapa । yezAmaBuktapUrvaM te tezAmasmftireva ca ॥30॥

text: aprāśanamasaṃsparśamasandarśanameva ca । puruṣasyaiṣa niyamo manye śreyo na saṃśayaḥ ॥31॥
html:
aprāśanamasaṃsparśamasandarśanameva ca ।
puruṣasyaiṣa niyamo manye śreyo na saṃśayaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: aprASanamasaMsparSamasandarSanameva ca । puruzasyEza niyamo manye Sreyo na saMSayaH ॥31॥

text: pāṇimanto dhanairyuktā balavanto na saṃśayaḥ । manuṣyā mānuṣaireva dāsatvamupapāditāḥ ॥32॥
html:
pāṇimanto dhanairyuktā balavanto na saṃśayaḥ ।
manuṣyā mānuṣaireva dāsatvamupapāditāḥ ॥32॥
slp1: pARimanto DanEryuktA balavanto na saMSayaH । manuzyA mAnuzEreva dAsatvamupapAditAH ॥32॥

text: vadhabandhaparikleśaiḥ kliśyante ca punaḥ punaḥ । te khalvapi ramante ca modante ca hasanti ca ॥33॥
html:
vadhabandhaparikleśaiḥ kliśyante ca punaḥ punaḥ ।
te khalvapi ramante ca modante ca hasanti ca ॥33॥
slp1: vaDabanDaparikleSEH kliSyante ca punaH punaH । te Kalvapi ramante ca modante ca hasanti ca ॥33॥

text: apare bāhubalinaḥ kṛtavidyā manasvinaḥ । jugupsitāṃ sukṛpaṇāṃ pāpāṃ vṛttimupāsate ॥34॥
html:
apare bāhubalinaḥ kṛtavidyā manasvinaḥ ।
jugupsitāṃ sukṛpaṇāṃ pāpāṃ vṛttimupāsate ॥34॥
slp1: apare bAhubalinaH kftavidyA manasvinaH । jugupsitAM sukfpaRAM pApAM vfttimupAsate ॥34॥

text: utsahante ca te vṛttimanyāmapyupasevitum । svakarmaṇā tu niyataṃ bhavitavyaṃ tu tattathā ॥35॥
html:
utsahante ca te vṛttimanyāmapyupasevitum ।
svakarmaṇā tu niyataṃ bhavitavyaṃ tu tattathā ॥35॥
slp1: utsahante ca te vfttimanyAmapyupasevitum । svakarmaRA tu niyataM BavitavyaM tu tattaTA ॥35॥

text: na pulkaso na caṇḍāla ātmānaṃ tyaktumicchati । asantuṣṭaḥ svayā yonyā māyāṃ paśyasva yādṛśīm ॥36॥
html:
na pulkaso na caṇḍāla ātmānaṃ tyaktumicchati ।
asantuṣṭaḥ svayā yonyā māyāṃ paśyasva yādṛśīm ॥36॥
slp1: na pulkaso na caRqAla AtmAnaM tyaktumicCati । asantuzwaH svayA yonyA mAyAM paSyasva yAdfSIm ॥36॥

text: dṛṣṭvā kuṇīnpakṣahatānmanuṣyānāmayāvinaḥ । susaṃpūrṇaḥ svayā yonyā labdhalābho'si kāśyapa ॥37॥
html:
dṛṣṭvā kuṇīnpakṣahatānmanuṣyānāmayāvinaḥ ।
susaṃpūrṇaḥ svayā yonyā labdhalābho'si kāśyapa ॥37॥
slp1: dfzwvA kuRInpakzahatAnmanuzyAnAmayAvinaH । susaMpUrRaH svayA yonyA labDalABo'si kASyapa ॥37॥

text: yadi brāhmaṇa dehaste nirātaṅko nirāmayaḥ । aṅgāni ca samagrāṇi na ca lokeṣu dhikkṛtaḥ ॥38॥
html:
yadi brāhmaṇa dehaste nirātaṅko nirāmayaḥ ।
aṅgāni ca samagrāṇi na ca lokeṣu dhikkṛtaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: yadi brAhmaRa dehaste nirAtaNko nirAmayaH । aNgAni ca samagrARi na ca lokezu DikkftaH ॥38॥

text: na kenacitpravādena satyenaivāpahāriṇā । dharmāyottiṣṭha viprarṣe nātmānaṃ tyaktumarhasi ॥39॥
html:
na kenacitpravādena satyenaivāpahāriṇā ।
dharmāyottiṣṭha viprarṣe nātmānaṃ tyaktumarhasi ॥39॥
slp1: na kenacitpravAdena satyenEvApahAriRA । DarmAyottizWa viprarze nAtmAnaM tyaktumarhasi ॥39॥

text: yadi brahmañśṛṇoṣyetacchraddadhāsi ca me vacaḥ । vedoktasya ca dharmasya phalaṃ mukhyamavāpsyasi ॥40॥
html:
yadi brahmañśṛṇoṣyetacchraddadhāsi ca me vacaḥ ।
vedoktasya ca dharmasya phalaṃ mukhyamavāpsyasi ॥40॥
slp1: yadi brahmaYSfRozyetacCraddaDAsi ca me vacaH । vedoktasya ca Darmasya PalaM muKyamavApsyasi ॥40॥

text: svādhyāyamagnisaṃskāramapramatto'nupālaya । satyaṃ damaṃ ca dānaṃ ca spardhiṣṭhā mā ca kenacit ॥41॥
html:
svādhyāyamagnisaṃskāramapramatto'nupālaya ।
satyaṃ damaṃ ca dānaṃ ca spardhiṣṭhā mā ca kenacit ॥41॥
slp1: svADyAyamagnisaMskAramapramatto'nupAlaya । satyaM damaM ca dAnaM ca sparDizWA mA ca kenacit ॥41॥

text: ye kecana svadhyayanāḥ prāptā yajanayājanam । kathaṃ te jātu śoceyurdhyāyeyurvāpyaśobhanam ॥42॥
html:
ye kecana svadhyayanāḥ prāptā yajanayājanam ।
kathaṃ te jātu śoceyurdhyāyeyurvāpyaśobhanam ॥42॥
slp1: ye kecana svaDyayanAH prAptA yajanayAjanam । kaTaM te jAtu SoceyurDyAyeyurvApyaSoBanam ॥42॥

text: icchantaste vihārāya sukhaṃ mahadavāpnuyuḥ । uta jātāḥ sunakṣatre sutīrthāḥ sumuhūrtajāḥ ॥43॥
html:
icchantaste vihārāya sukhaṃ mahadavāpnuyuḥ ।
uta jātāḥ sunakṣatre sutīrthāḥ sumuhūrtajāḥ ॥43॥
slp1: icCantaste vihArAya suKaM mahadavApnuyuH । uta jAtAH sunakzatre sutIrTAH sumuhUrtajAH ॥43॥

text: nakṣatreṣvāsureṣvanye dustīrthā durmuhūrtajāḥ । saṃpatantyāsurīṃ yoniṃ yajñaprasavavarjitām ॥44॥
html:
nakṣatreṣvāsureṣvanye dustīrthā durmuhūrtajāḥ ।
saṃpatantyāsurīṃ yoniṃ yajñaprasavavarjitām ॥44॥
slp1: nakzatrezvAsurezvanye dustIrTA durmuhUrtajAH । saMpatantyAsurIM yoniM yajYaprasavavarjitAm ॥44॥

text: ahamāsaṃ paṇḍitako haituko vedanindakaḥ । ānvīkṣikīṃ tarkavidyāmanurakto nirarthikām ॥45॥
html:
ahamāsaṃ paṇḍitako haituko vedanindakaḥ ।
ānvīkṣikīṃ tarkavidyāmanurakto nirarthikām ॥45॥
slp1: ahamAsaM paRqitako hEtuko vedanindakaH । AnvIkzikIM tarkavidyAmanurakto nirarTikAm ॥45॥

text: hetuvādānpravaditā vaktā saṃsatsu hetumat । ākroṣṭā cābhivaktā ca brahmayajñeṣu vai dvijān ॥46॥
html:
hetuvādānpravaditā vaktā saṃsatsu hetumat ।
ākroṣṭā cābhivaktā ca brahmayajñeṣu vai dvijān ॥46॥
slp1: hetuvAdAnpravaditA vaktA saMsatsu hetumat । AkrozwA cABivaktA ca brahmayajYezu vE dvijAn ॥46॥

text: nāstikaḥ sarvaśaṅkī ca mūrkhaḥ paṇḍitamānikaḥ । tasyeyaṃ phalanirvṛttiḥ sṛgālatvaṃ mama dvija ॥47॥
html:
nāstikaḥ sarvaśaṅkī ca mūrkhaḥ paṇḍitamānikaḥ ।
tasyeyaṃ phalanirvṛttiḥ sṛgālatvaṃ mama dvija ॥47॥
slp1: nAstikaH sarvaSaNkI ca mUrKaH paRqitamAnikaH । tasyeyaM PalanirvfttiH sfgAlatvaM mama dvija ॥47॥

text: api jātu tathā tatsyādahorātraśatairapi । yadahaṃ mānuṣīṃ yoniṃ sṛgālaḥ prāpnuyāṃ punaḥ ॥48॥
html:
api jātu tathā tatsyādahorātraśatairapi ।
yadahaṃ mānuṣīṃ yoniṃ sṛgālaḥ prāpnuyāṃ punaḥ ॥48॥
slp1: api jAtu taTA tatsyAdahorAtraSatErapi । yadahaM mAnuzIM yoniM sfgAlaH prApnuyAM punaH ॥48॥

text: santuṣṭaścāpramattaśca yajñadānataporatiḥ । jñeyajñātā bhaveyaṃ vai varjyavarjayitā tathā ॥49॥
html:
santuṣṭaścāpramattaśca yajñadānataporatiḥ ।
jñeyajñātā bhaveyaṃ vai varjyavarjayitā tathā ॥49॥
slp1: santuzwaScApramattaSca yajYadAnataporatiH । jYeyajYAtA BaveyaM vE varjyavarjayitA taTA ॥49॥

text: tataḥ sa munirutthāya kāśyapastamuvāca ha । aho batāsi kuśalo buddhimāniti vismitaḥ ॥50॥
html:
tataḥ sa munirutthāya kāśyapastamuvāca ha ।
aho batāsi kuśalo buddhimāniti vismitaḥ ॥50॥
slp1: tataH sa munirutTAya kASyapastamuvAca ha । aho batAsi kuSalo budDimAniti vismitaH ॥50॥

text: samavaikṣata taṃ vipro jñānadīrgheṇa cakṣuṣā । dadarśa cainaṃ devānāmindraṃ devaṃ śacīpatim ॥51॥
html:
samavaikṣata taṃ vipro jñānadīrgheṇa cakṣuṣā ।
dadarśa cainaṃ devānāmindraṃ devaṃ śacīpatim ॥51॥
slp1: samavEkzata taM vipro jYAnadIrGeRa cakzuzA । dadarSa cEnaM devAnAmindraM devaM SacIpatim ॥51॥

text: tataḥ sampūjayāmāsa kāśyapo harivāhanam । anujñātaśca tenātha praviveśa svamāśramam] ॥52॥
html:
tataḥ sampūjayāmāsa kāśyapo harivāhanam ।
anujñātaśca tenātha praviveśa svamāśramam] ॥52॥
slp1: tataH sampUjayAmAsa kASyapo harivAhanam । anujYAtaSca tenATa praviveSa svamASramam] ॥52॥

text: yadyasti dattamiṣṭaṃ vā tapastaptaṃ tathaiva ca । gurūṇāṃ cāpi śuśrūṣā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
yadyasti dattamiṣṭaṃ vā tapastaptaṃ tathaiva ca ।
gurūṇāṃ cāpi śuśrūṣā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: yadyasti dattamizwaM vA tapastaptaM taTEva ca । gurURAM cApi SuSrUzA tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: ātmanānarthayuktena pāpe niviśate manaḥ । sa karma kaluṣaṃ kṛtvā kleśe mahati dhīyate ॥2॥
html:
ātmanānarthayuktena pāpe niviśate manaḥ ।
sa karma kaluṣaṃ kṛtvā kleśe mahati dhīyate ॥2॥
slp1: AtmanAnarTayuktena pApe niviSate manaH । sa karma kaluzaM kftvA kleSe mahati DIyate ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: durbhikṣādeva durbhikṣaṃ kleśātkleśaṃ bhayādbhayam । mṛtebhyaḥ pramṛtaṃ yānti daridrāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ ॥3॥
html:
durbhikṣādeva durbhikṣaṃ kleśātkleśaṃ bhayādbhayam ।
mṛtebhyaḥ pramṛtaṃ yānti daridrāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: durBikzAdeva durBikzaM kleSAtkleSaM BayAdBayam । mfteByaH pramftaM yAnti daridrAH pApakAriRaH ॥3॥

text: utsavādutsavaṃ yānti svargātsvargaṃ sukhātsukham । śraddadhānāśca dāntāśca dhanāḍhyāḥ śubhakāriṇaḥ ॥4॥
html:
utsavādutsavaṃ yānti svargātsvargaṃ sukhātsukham ।
śraddadhānāśca dāntāśca dhanāḍhyāḥ śubhakāriṇaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: utsavAdutsavaM yAnti svargAtsvargaM suKAtsuKam । SraddaDAnASca dAntASca DanAQyAH SuBakAriRaH ॥4॥

text: vyālakuñjaradurgeṣu sarpacorabhayeṣu ca । hastāvāpena gacchanti nāstikāḥ kimataḥ param ॥5॥
html:
vyālakuñjaradurgeṣu sarpacorabhayeṣu ca ।
hastāvāpena gacchanti nāstikāḥ kimataḥ param ॥5॥
slp1: vyAlakuYjaradurgezu sarpacoraBayezu ca । hastAvApena gacCanti nAstikAH kimataH param ॥5॥

text: priyadevātitheyāśca vadānyāḥ priyasādhavaḥ । kṣemyamātmavatāṃ mārgamāsthitā hastadakṣiṇam ॥6॥
html:
priyadevātitheyāśca vadānyāḥ priyasādhavaḥ ।
kṣemyamātmavatāṃ mārgamāsthitā hastadakṣiṇam ॥6॥
slp1: priyadevAtiTeyASca vadAnyAH priyasADavaH । kzemyamAtmavatAM mArgamAsTitA hastadakziRam ॥6॥

text: pulākā iva dhānyeṣu puttikā iva pakṣiṣu । tadvidhāste manuṣyeṣu yeṣāṃ dharmo na kāraṇam ॥7॥
html:
pulākā iva dhānyeṣu puttikā iva pakṣiṣu ।
tadvidhāste manuṣyeṣu yeṣāṃ dharmo na kāraṇam ॥7॥
slp1: pulAkA iva DAnyezu puttikA iva pakzizu । tadviDAste manuzyezu yezAM Darmo na kAraRam ॥7॥

text: suśīghramapi dhāvantaṃ vidhānamanudhāvati । śete saha śayānena yena yena yathā kṛtam ॥8॥
html:
suśīghramapi dhāvantaṃ vidhānamanudhāvati ।
śete saha śayānena yena yena yathā kṛtam ॥8॥
slp1: suSIGramapi DAvantaM viDAnamanuDAvati । Sete saha SayAnena yena yena yaTA kftam ॥8॥

text: upatiṣṭhati tiṣṭhantaṃ gacchantamanugacchati । karoti kurvataḥ karma chāyevānuvidhīyate ॥9॥
html:
upatiṣṭhati tiṣṭhantaṃ gacchantamanugacchati ।
karoti kurvataḥ karma chāyevānuvidhīyate ॥9॥
slp1: upatizWati tizWantaM gacCantamanugacCati । karoti kurvataH karma CAyevAnuviDIyate ॥9॥

text: yena yena yathā yadyatpurā karma samācitam । tattadeva naro bhuṅkte nityaṃ vihitamātmanā ॥10॥
html:
yena yena yathā yadyatpurā karma samācitam ।
tattadeva naro bhuṅkte nityaṃ vihitamātmanā ॥10॥
slp1: yena yena yaTA yadyatpurA karma samAcitam । tattadeva naro BuNkte nityaM vihitamAtmanA ॥10॥

text: svakarmaphalavikṣiptaṃ vidhānaparirakṣitam । bhūtagrāmamimaṃ kālaḥ samantātparikarṣati ॥11॥
html:
svakarmaphalavikṣiptaṃ vidhānaparirakṣitam ।
bhūtagrāmamimaṃ kālaḥ samantātparikarṣati ॥11॥
slp1: svakarmaPalavikziptaM viDAnaparirakzitam । BUtagrAmamimaM kAlaH samantAtparikarzati ॥11॥

text: acodyamānāni yathā puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca । svakālaṃ nātivartante tathā karma purākṛtam ॥12॥
html:
acodyamānāni yathā puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca ।
svakālaṃ nātivartante tathā karma purākṛtam ॥12॥
slp1: acodyamAnAni yaTA puzpARi ca PalAni ca । svakAlaM nAtivartante taTA karma purAkftam ॥12॥

text: saṃmānaścāvamānaśca lābhālābhau kṣayodayau । pravṛttā vinivartante vidhānānte punaḥ punaḥ ॥13॥
html:

slp1: saMmAnaScAvamAnaSca lABAlABO kzayodayO । pravfttA vinivartante viDAnAnte punaH punaH ॥13॥

text: ātmanā vihitaṃ duḥkhamātmanā vihitaṃ sukham । garbhaśayyāmupādāya bhujyate paurvadehikam ॥14॥

slp1: SakunInAmivAkASe matsyAnAmiva codake । padaM yaTA na dfSyeta taTA jYAnavidAM gatiH ॥19॥

text: alamanyairupālambhaiḥ kīrtitaiśca vyatikramaiḥ । peśalaṃ cānurūpaṃ ca kartavyaṃ hitamātmanaḥ] ॥20॥

peśalaṃ cānurūpaṃ ca kartavyaṃ hitamātmanaḥ] ॥20॥

text: kutaḥ sṛṣṭamidaṃ viśvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam । pralaye ca kamabhyeti tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:

slp1: kutaH sfzwamidaM viSvaM jagatsTAvarajaNgamam । pralaye ca kamaByeti tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥

text: sasāgaraḥ sagaganaḥ saśailaḥ sabalāhakaḥ । sabhūmiḥ sāgnipavano loko'yaṃ kena nirmitaḥ ॥2॥
html:
sasāgaraḥ sagaganaḥ saśailaḥ sabalāhakaḥ ।
sabhūmiḥ sāgnipavano loko'yaṃ kena nirmitaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: sasAgaraH sagaganaH saSElaH sabalAhakaH । saBUmiH sAgnipavano loko'yaM kena nirmitaH ॥2॥

text: kathaṃ sṛṣṭāni bhūtāni kathaṃ varṇavibhaktayaḥ । śaucāśaucaṃ kathaṃ teṣāṃ dharmādharmāvatho katham ॥3॥
html:
kathaṃ sṛṣṭāni bhūtāni kathaṃ varṇavibhaktayaḥ ।
śaucāśaucaṃ kathaṃ teṣāṃ dharmādharmāvatho katham ॥3॥
slp1: kaTaM sfzwAni BUtAni kaTaM varRaviBaktayaH । SOcASOcaM kaTaM tezAM DarmADarmAvaTo kaTam ॥3॥

text: kīdṛśo jīvatāṃ jīvaḥ kva vā gacchanti ye mṛtāḥ । asmāllokādamuṃ lokaṃ sarvaṃ śaṃsatu no bhavān ॥4॥
html:
kīdṛśo jīvatāṃ jīvaḥ kva vā gacchanti ye mṛtāḥ ।
asmāllokādamuṃ lokaṃ sarvaṃ śaṃsatu no bhavān ॥4॥
slp1: kIdfSo jIvatAM jIvaH kva vA gacCanti ye mftAH । asmAllokAdamuM lokaM sarvaM SaMsatu no BavAn ॥4॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । bhṛguṇābhihitaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bharadvājāya pṛcchate ॥5॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।

slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । BfguRABihitaM SrezWaM BaradvAjAya pfcCate ॥5॥

text: kailāsaśikhare dṛṣṭvā dīpyamānamivaujasā । bhṛguṃ maharṣimāsīnaṃ bharadvājo'nvapṛcchata ॥6॥
html:

slp1: kElAsaSiKare dfzwvA dIpyamAnamivOjasA । BfguM maharzimAsInaM BaradvAjo'nvapfcCata ॥6॥

text: sasāgaraḥ sagaganaḥ saśailaḥ sabalāhakaḥ । sabhūmiḥ sāgnipavano loko'yaṃ kena nirmitaḥ ॥7॥

slp1: sasAgaraH sagaganaH saSElaH sabalAhakaH । saBUmiH sAgnipavano loko'yaM kena nirmitaH ॥7॥

text: kathaṃ sṛṣṭāni bhūtāni kathaṃ varṇavibhaktayaḥ । śaucāśaucaṃ kathaṃ teṣāṃ dharmādharmāvatho katham ॥8॥

slp1: kaTaM sfzwAni BUtAni kaTaM varRaviBaktayaH । SOcASOcaM kaTaM tezAM DarmADarmAvaTo kaTam ॥8॥

text: kīdṛśo jīvatāṃ jīvaḥ kva vā gacchanti ye mṛtāḥ । paralokamimaṃ cāpi sarvaṃ śaṃsatu no bhavān ॥9॥
html:
kīdṛśo jīvatāṃ jīvaḥ kva vā gacchanti ye mṛtāḥ ।
paralokamimaṃ cāpi sarvaṃ śaṃsatu no bhavān ॥9॥
slp1: kIdfSo jIvatAM jIvaH kva vA gacCanti ye mftAH । paralokamimaM cApi sarvaM SaMsatu no BavAn ॥9॥

text: evaṃ sa bhagavānpṛṣṭo bharadvājena saṃśayam । maharṣirbrahmasaṅkāśaḥ sarvaṃ tasmai tato'bravīt ॥10॥
html:
evaṃ sa bhagavānpṛṣṭo bharadvājena saṃśayam ।
maharṣirbrahmasaṅkāśaḥ sarvaṃ tasmai tato'bravīt ॥10॥
slp1: evaM sa BagavAnpfzwo BaradvAjena saMSayam । maharzirbrahmasaNkASaH sarvaM tasmE tato'bravIt ॥10॥

text: mānaso nāma vikhyātaḥ śrutapūrvo maharṣibhiḥ । anādinidhano devastathābhedyo'jarāmaraḥ ॥11॥
html:
mānaso nāma vikhyātaḥ śrutapūrvo maharṣibhiḥ ।
anādinidhano devastathābhedyo'jarāmaraḥ ॥11॥
slp1: mAnaso nAma viKyAtaH SrutapUrvo maharziBiH । anAdiniDano devastaTABedyo'jarAmaraH ॥11॥

text: avyakta iti vikhyātaḥ śāśvato'thākṣaro'vyayaḥ । yataḥ sṛṣṭāni bhūtāni jāyante ca mriyanti ca ॥12॥
html:
avyakta iti vikhyātaḥ śāśvato'thākṣaro'vyayaḥ ।
yataḥ sṛṣṭāni bhūtāni jāyante ca mriyanti ca ॥12॥
slp1: avyakta iti viKyAtaH SASvato'TAkzaro'vyayaH । yataH sfzwAni BUtAni jAyante ca mriyanti ca ॥12॥

text: so'sṛjatprathamaṃ devo mahāntaṃ nāma nāmataḥ । ākāśamiti vikhyātaṃ sarvabhūtadharaḥ prabhuḥ ॥13॥
html:
so'sṛjatprathamaṃ devo mahāntaṃ nāma nāmataḥ ।
ākāśamiti vikhyātaṃ sarvabhūtadharaḥ prabhuḥ ॥13॥
slp1: so'sfjatpraTamaM devo mahAntaM nAma nAmataH । AkASamiti viKyAtaM sarvaBUtaDaraH praBuH ॥13॥

text: ākāśādabhavadvāri salilādagnimārutau । agnimārutasaṃyogāttataḥ samabhavanmahī ॥14॥
html:
ākāśādabhavadvāri salilādagnimārutau ।

slp1: AkASAdaBavadvAri salilAdagnimArutO । agnimArutasaMyogAttataH samaBavanmahI ॥14॥

text: tatastejomayaṃ divyaṃ padmaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ svayambhuvā । tasmātpadmātsamabhavadbrahmā vedamayo nidhiḥ ॥15॥
html:

slp1: tatastejomayaM divyaM padmaM sfzwaM svayamBuvA । tasmAtpadmAtsamaBavadbrahmA vedamayo niDiH ॥15॥

text: ahaṅkāra iti khyātaḥ sarvabhūtātmabhūtakṛt । brahmā vai sumahātejā ya ete pañca dhātavaḥ ॥16॥
html:
ahaṅkāra iti khyātaḥ sarvabhūtātmabhūtakṛt ।

slp1: ahaNkAra iti KyAtaH sarvaBUtAtmaBUtakft । brahmA vE sumahAtejA ya ete paYca DAtavaH ॥16॥

text: śailāstasyāsthisañjñāstu medo māṃsaṃ ca medinī । samudrāstasya rudhiramākāśamudaraṃ tathā ॥17॥

text: pavanaścaiva niḥśvāsastejo'gnirnimnagāḥ sirāḥ । agnīṣomau tu candrārkau nayane tasya viśrute ॥18॥

slp1: pavanaScEva niHSvAsastejo'gnirnimnagAH sirAH । agnIzomO tu candrArkO nayane tasya viSrute ॥18॥

text: nabhaścordhvaṃ śirastasya kṣitiḥ pādau diśo bhujau । durvijñeyo hyanantatvātsiddhairapi na saṃśayaḥ ॥19॥
html:
nabhaścordhvaṃ śirastasya kṣitiḥ pādau diśo bhujau ।
durvijñeyo hyanantatvātsiddhairapi na saṃśayaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: naBaScorDvaM Sirastasya kzitiH pAdO diSo BujO । durvijYeyo hyanantatvAtsidDErapi na saMSayaH ॥19॥

text: sa eva bhagavānviṣṇurananta iti viśrutaḥ । sarvabhūtātmabhūtastho durvijñeyo'kṛtātmabhiḥ ॥20॥
html:
sa eva bhagavānviṣṇurananta iti viśrutaḥ ।
sarvabhūtātmabhūtastho durvijñeyo'kṛtātmabhiḥ ॥20॥
slp1: sa eva BagavAnvizRurananta iti viSrutaH । sarvaBUtAtmaBUtasTo durvijYeyo'kftAtmaBiH ॥20॥

text: ahaṅkārasya yaḥ sraṣṭā sarvabhūtabhavāya vai । yataḥ samabhavadviśvaṃ pṛṣṭo'haṃ yadiha tvayā ॥21॥
html:
ahaṅkārasya yaḥ sraṣṭā sarvabhūtabhavāya vai ।
yataḥ samabhavadviśvaṃ pṛṣṭo'haṃ yadiha tvayā ॥21॥
slp1: ahaNkArasya yaH srazwA sarvaBUtaBavAya vE । yataH samaBavadviSvaM pfzwo'haM yadiha tvayA ॥21॥

text: gaganasya diśāṃ caiva bhūtalasyānilasya ca । kānyatra parimāṇāni saṃśayaṃ chindhi me'rthataḥ ॥22॥
html:
gaganasya diśāṃ caiva bhūtalasyānilasya ca ।
kānyatra parimāṇāni saṃśayaṃ chindhi me'rthataḥ ॥22॥
slp1: gaganasya diSAM cEva BUtalasyAnilasya ca । kAnyatra parimARAni saMSayaM CinDi me'rTataH ॥22॥

text: anantametadākāśaṃ siddhacāraṇasevitam । ramyaṃ nānāśrayākīrṇaṃ yasyānto nādhigamyate ॥23॥

slp1: anantametadAkASaM sidDacAraRasevitam । ramyaM nAnASrayAkIrRaM yasyAnto nADigamyate ॥23॥

text: ūrdhvaṃ gateradhastāttu candrādityau na dṛśyataḥ । tatra devāḥ svayaṃ dīptā bhāsvarāścāgnivarcasaḥ ॥24॥
html:
ūrdhvaṃ gateradhastāttu candrādityau na dṛśyataḥ ।
tatra devāḥ svayaṃ dīptā bhāsvarāścāgnivarcasaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: UrDvaM gateraDastAttu candrAdityO na dfSyataH । tatra devAH svayaM dIptA BAsvarAScAgnivarcasaH ॥24॥

text: te cāpyantaṃ na paśyanti nabhasaḥ prathitaujasaḥ । durgamatvādanantatvāditi me viddhi mānada ॥25॥
html:
te cāpyantaṃ na paśyanti nabhasaḥ prathitaujasaḥ ।
durgamatvādanantatvāditi me viddhi mānada ॥25॥
slp1: te cApyantaM na paSyanti naBasaH praTitOjasaH । durgamatvAdanantatvAditi me vidDi mAnada ॥25॥

html:
upariṣṭopariṣṭāttu prajvaladbhiḥ svayaṃprabhaiḥ ।

slp1: uparizwoparizwAttu prajvaladBiH svayaMpraBEH । nirudDametadAkASamaprameyaM surErapi ॥26॥

text: pṛthivyante samudrāstu samudrānte tamaḥ smṛtam । tamaso'nte jalaṃ prāhurjalasyānte'gnireva ca ॥27॥

pṛthivyante samudrāstu samudrānte tamaḥ smṛtam ।
tamaso'nte jalaṃ prāhurjalasyānte'gnireva ca ॥27॥
slp1: pfTivyante samudrAstu samudrAnte tamaH smftam । tamaso'nte jalaM prAhurjalasyAnte'gnireva ca ॥27॥

text: rasātalānte salilaṃ jalānte pannagādhipaḥ । tadante punarākāśamākāśānte punarjalam ॥28॥
html:
rasātalānte salilaṃ jalānte pannagādhipaḥ ।

slp1: rasAtalAnte salilaM jalAnte pannagADipaH । tadante punarAkASamAkASAnte punarjalam ॥28॥

text: evamantaṃ bhagavataḥ pramāṇaṃ salilasya ca । agnimārutatoyebhyo durjñeyaṃ daivatairapi ॥29॥
html:

agnimārutatoyebhyo durjñeyaṃ daivatairapi ॥29॥
slp1: evamantaM BagavataH pramARaM salilasya ca । agnimArutatoyeByo durjYeyaM dEvatErapi ॥29॥

text: agnimārutatoyānāṃ varṇāḥ kṣititalasya ca । ākāśasadṛśā hyete bhidyante tattvadarśanāt ॥30॥
html:
