ākāśasadṛśā hyete bhidyante tattvadarśanāt ॥30॥
slp1: agnimArutatoyAnAM varRAH kzititalasya ca । AkASasadfSA hyete Bidyante tattvadarSanAt ॥30॥

text: paṭhanti caiva munayaḥ śāstreṣu vividheṣu ca । trailokye sāgare caiva pramāṇaṃ vihitaṃ yathā । adṛśyāya tvagamyāya kaḥ pramāṇamudāharet ॥31॥
html:
paṭhanti caiva munayaḥ śāstreṣu vividheṣu ca ।
trailokye sāgare caiva pramāṇaṃ vihitaṃ yathā ।
adṛśyāya tvagamyāya kaḥ pramāṇamudāharet ॥31॥
slp1: paWanti cEva munayaH SAstrezu viviDezu ca । trElokye sAgare cEva pramARaM vihitaM yaTA । adfSyAya tvagamyAya kaH pramARamudAharet ॥31॥

text: siddhānāṃ devatānāṃ ca yadā parimitā gatiḥ । tadā gauṇamanantasya nāmānanteti viśrutam । nāmadheyānurūpasya mānasasya mahātmanaḥ ॥32॥
html:
siddhānāṃ devatānāṃ ca yadā parimitā gatiḥ ।
tadā gauṇamanantasya nāmānanteti viśrutam ।
nāmadheyānurūpasya mānasasya mahātmanaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: sidDAnAM devatAnAM ca yadA parimitA gatiH । tadA gORamanantasya nAmAnanteti viSrutam । nAmaDeyAnurUpasya mAnasasya mahAtmanaH ॥32॥

text: yadā tu divyaṃ tadrūpaṃ hrasate vardhate punaḥ । ko'nyastadvedituṃ śakto yo'pi syāttadvidho'paraḥ ॥33॥
html:
yadā tu divyaṃ tadrūpaṃ hrasate vardhate punaḥ ।
ko'nyastadvedituṃ śakto yo'pi syāttadvidho'paraḥ ॥33॥
slp1: yadA tu divyaM tadrUpaM hrasate varDate punaH । ko'nyastadvedituM Sakto yo'pi syAttadviDo'paraH ॥33॥

text: tataḥ puṣkarataḥ sṛṣṭaḥ sarvajño mūrtimānprabhuḥ । brahmā dharmamayaḥ pūrvaḥ prajāpatiranuttamaḥ ॥34॥
html:
tataḥ puṣkarataḥ sṛṣṭaḥ sarvajño mūrtimānprabhuḥ ।
brahmā dharmamayaḥ pūrvaḥ prajāpatiranuttamaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: tataH puzkarataH sfzwaH sarvajYo mUrtimAnpraBuH । brahmA DarmamayaH pUrvaH prajApatiranuttamaH ॥34॥

text: puṣkarādyadi saṃbhūto jyeṣṭhaṃ bhavati puṣkaram । brahmāṇaṃ pūrvajaṃ cāha bhavānsandeha eva me ॥35॥
html:
puṣkarādyadi saṃbhūto jyeṣṭhaṃ bhavati puṣkaram ।
brahmāṇaṃ pūrvajaṃ cāha bhavānsandeha eva me ॥35॥
slp1: puzkarAdyadi saMBUto jyezWaM Bavati puzkaram । brahmARaM pUrvajaM cAha BavAnsandeha eva me ॥35॥
author: bharadvāja uvāca ।

text: mānasasyeha yā mūrtirbrahmatvaṃ samupāgatā । tasyāsanavidhānārthaṃ pṛthivī padmamucyate ॥36॥
html:
mānasasyeha yā mūrtirbrahmatvaṃ samupāgatā ।
tasyāsanavidhānārthaṃ pṛthivī padmamucyate ॥36॥
slp1: mAnasasyeha yA mUrtirbrahmatvaM samupAgatA । tasyAsanaviDAnArTaM pfTivI padmamucyate ॥36॥
author: bhṛguruvāca ।

text: karṇikā tasya padmasya merurgaganamucchritaḥ । tasya madhye sthito lokānsṛjate jagataḥ prabhuḥ] ॥37॥
html:
karṇikā tasya padmasya merurgaganamucchritaḥ ।
tasya madhye sthito lokānsṛjate jagataḥ prabhuḥ] ॥37॥
slp1: karRikA tasya padmasya merurgaganamucCritaH । tasya maDye sTito lokAnsfjate jagataH praBuH] ॥37॥

text: prajāvisargaṃ vividhaṃ kathaṃ sa sṛjate prabhuḥ । merumadhye sthito brahmā tadbrūhi dvijasattama ॥1॥
html:
prajāvisargaṃ vividhaṃ kathaṃ sa sṛjate prabhuḥ ।
merumadhye sthito brahmā tadbrūhi dvijasattama ॥1॥
slp1: prajAvisargaM viviDaM kaTaM sa sfjate praBuH । merumaDye sTito brahmA tadbrUhi dvijasattama ॥1॥
author: bharadvāja uvāca ।

text: prajāvisargaṃ vividhaṃ mānaso manasāsṛjat । sandhukṣaṇārthaṃ bhūtānāṃ sṛṣṭaṃ prathamato jalam ॥2॥
html:
prajāvisargaṃ vividhaṃ mānaso manasāsṛjat ।
sandhukṣaṇārthaṃ bhūtānāṃ sṛṣṭaṃ prathamato jalam ॥2॥
slp1: prajAvisargaM viviDaM mAnaso manasAsfjat । sanDukzaRArTaM BUtAnAM sfzwaM praTamato jalam ॥2॥
author: bhṛguruvāca ।

text: yatprāṇāḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ vardhante yena ca prajāḥ । parityaktāśca naśyanti tenedaṃ sarvamāvṛtam ॥3॥
html:
yatprāṇāḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ vardhante yena ca prajāḥ ।
parityaktāśca naśyanti tenedaṃ sarvamāvṛtam ॥3॥
slp1: yatprARAH sarvaBUtAnAM varDante yena ca prajAH । parityaktASca naSyanti tenedaM sarvamAvftam ॥3॥

text: pṛthivī parvatā meghā mūrtimantaśca ye pare । sarvaṃ tadvāruṇaṃ jñeyamāpastastambhire punaḥ ॥4॥
html:
pṛthivī parvatā meghā mūrtimantaśca ye pare ।
sarvaṃ tadvāruṇaṃ jñeyamāpastastambhire punaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: pfTivI parvatA meGA mUrtimantaSca ye pare । sarvaM tadvAruRaM jYeyamApastastamBire punaH ॥4॥

text: kathaṃ salilamutpannaṃ kathaṃ caivāgnimārutau । kathaṃ ca medinī sṛṣṭetyatra me saṃśayo mahān ॥5॥
html:
kathaṃ salilamutpannaṃ kathaṃ caivāgnimārutau ।
kathaṃ ca medinī sṛṣṭetyatra me saṃśayo mahān ॥5॥
slp1: kaTaM salilamutpannaM kaTaM cEvAgnimArutO । kaTaM ca medinI sfzwetyatra me saMSayo mahAn ॥5॥
author: bharadvāja uvāca ।

text: brahmakalpe purā brahmanbrahmarṣīṇāṃ samāgame । lokasambhavasandehaḥ samutpanno mahātmanām ॥6॥
html:
brahmakalpe purā brahmanbrahmarṣīṇāṃ samāgame ।
lokasambhavasandehaḥ samutpanno mahātmanām ॥6॥
slp1: brahmakalpe purA brahmanbrahmarzIRAM samAgame । lokasamBavasandehaH samutpanno mahAtmanAm ॥6॥
author: bhṛguruvāca ।

text: te'tiṣṭhandhyānamālambya maunamāsthāya niścalāḥ । tyaktāhārāḥ pavanapā divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ dvijāḥ ॥7॥
html:
te'tiṣṭhandhyānamālambya maunamāsthāya niścalāḥ ।
tyaktāhārāḥ pavanapā divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ dvijāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: te'tizWanDyAnamAlambya mOnamAsTAya niScalAH । tyaktAhArAH pavanapA divyaM varzaSataM dvijAH ॥7॥

text: teṣāṃ dharmamayī vāṇī sarveṣāṃ śrotramāgamat । divyā sarasvatī tatra saṃbabhūva nabhastalāt ॥8॥
html:
teṣāṃ dharmamayī vāṇī sarveṣāṃ śrotramāgamat ।
divyā sarasvatī tatra saṃbabhūva nabhastalāt ॥8॥
slp1: tezAM DarmamayI vARI sarvezAM SrotramAgamat । divyA sarasvatI tatra saMbaBUva naBastalAt ॥8॥

text: purā stimitaniḥśabdamākāśamacalopamam । naṣṭacandrārkapavanaṃ prasuptamiva saṃbabhau ॥9॥
html:
purā stimitaniḥśabdamākāśamacalopamam ।
naṣṭacandrārkapavanaṃ prasuptamiva saṃbabhau ॥9॥
slp1: purA stimitaniHSabdamAkASamacalopamam । nazwacandrArkapavanaM prasuptamiva saMbaBO ॥9॥

text: tataḥ salilamutpannaṃ tamasīvāparaṃ tamaḥ । tasmācca salilotpīḍādudatiṣṭhata mārutaḥ ॥10॥
html:
tataḥ salilamutpannaṃ tamasīvāparaṃ tamaḥ ।
tasmācca salilotpīḍādudatiṣṭhata mārutaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: tataH salilamutpannaM tamasIvAparaM tamaH । tasmAcca salilotpIqAdudatizWata mArutaH ॥10॥

text: yathā bhājanamacchidraṃ niḥśabdamiva lakṣyate । taccāmbhasā pūryamāṇaṃ saśabdaṃ kurute'nilaḥ ॥11॥
html:
yathā bhājanamacchidraṃ niḥśabdamiva lakṣyate ।
taccāmbhasā pūryamāṇaṃ saśabdaṃ kurute'nilaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: yaTA BAjanamacCidraM niHSabdamiva lakzyate । taccAmBasA pUryamARaM saSabdaM kurute'nilaH ॥11॥

text: tathā salilasaṃruddhe nabhaso'nte nirantare । bhittvārṇavatalaṃ vāyuḥ samutpatati ghoṣavān ॥12॥
html:
tathā salilasaṃruddhe nabhaso'nte nirantare ।
bhittvārṇavatalaṃ vāyuḥ samutpatati ghoṣavān ॥12॥
slp1: taTA salilasaMrudDe naBaso'nte nirantare । BittvArRavatalaM vAyuH samutpatati GozavAn ॥12॥

text: sa eṣa carate vāyurarṇavotpīḍasambhavaḥ । ākāśasthānamāsādya praśāntiṃ nādhigacchati ॥13॥
html:
sa eṣa carate vāyurarṇavotpīḍasambhavaḥ ।
ākāśasthānamāsādya praśāntiṃ nādhigacchati ॥13॥
slp1: sa eza carate vAyurarRavotpIqasamBavaH । AkASasTAnamAsAdya praSAntiM nADigacCati ॥13॥

text: tasminvāyvambusaṅgharṣe dīptatejā mahābalaḥ । prādurbhavatyūrdhvaśikhaḥ kṛtvā vitimiraṃ nabhaḥ ॥14॥
html:
tasminvāyvambusaṅgharṣe dīptatejā mahābalaḥ ।
prādurbhavatyūrdhvaśikhaḥ kṛtvā vitimiraṃ nabhaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: tasminvAyvambusaNGarze dIptatejA mahAbalaH । prAdurBavatyUrDvaSiKaH kftvA vitimiraM naBaH ॥14॥

text: agniḥ pavanasaṃyuktaḥ khātsamutpatate jalam । so'gnirmārutasaṃyogādghanatvamupapadyate ॥15॥
html:
agniḥ pavanasaṃyuktaḥ khātsamutpatate jalam ।
so'gnirmārutasaṃyogādghanatvamupapadyate ॥15॥
slp1: agniH pavanasaMyuktaH KAtsamutpatate jalam । so'gnirmArutasaMyogAdGanatvamupapadyate ॥15॥

text: tasyākāśe nipatitaḥ snehastiṣṭhati yo'paraḥ । sa saṅghātatvamāpanno bhūmitvamupagacchati ॥16॥
html:
tasyākāśe nipatitaḥ snehastiṣṭhati yo'paraḥ ।
sa saṅghātatvamāpanno bhūmitvamupagacchati ॥16॥
slp1: tasyAkASe nipatitaH snehastizWati yo'paraH । sa saNGAtatvamApanno BUmitvamupagacCati ॥16॥

text: rasānāṃ sarvagandhānāṃ snehānāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā । bhūmiryoniriha jñeyā yasyāṃ sarvaṃ prasūyate] ॥17॥
html:
rasānāṃ sarvagandhānāṃ snehānāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā ।
bhūmiryoniriha jñeyā yasyāṃ sarvaṃ prasūyate] ॥17॥
slp1: rasAnAM sarvaganDAnAM snehAnAM prARinAM taTA । BUmiryoniriha jYeyA yasyAM sarvaM prasUyate] ॥17॥

text: ete te dhātavaḥ pañca brahmā yānasṛjatpurā । āvṛtā yairime lokā mahābhūtābhisañjñitaiḥ ॥1॥
html:
ete te dhātavaḥ pañca brahmā yānasṛjatpurā ।
āvṛtā yairime lokā mahābhūtābhisañjñitaiḥ ॥1॥
slp1: ete te DAtavaH paYca brahmA yAnasfjatpurA । AvftA yErime lokA mahABUtABisaYjYitEH ॥1॥
author: bharadvāja uvāca ।

text: yadāsṛjatsahasrāṇi bhūtānāṃ sa mahāmatiḥ । pañcānāmeva bhūtatvaṃ kathaṃ samupapadyate ॥2॥
html:
yadāsṛjatsahasrāṇi bhūtānāṃ sa mahāmatiḥ ।
pañcānāmeva bhūtatvaṃ kathaṃ samupapadyate ॥2॥
slp1: yadAsfjatsahasrARi BUtAnAM sa mahAmatiH । paYcAnAmeva BUtatvaM kaTaM samupapadyate ॥2॥

text: amitānāṃ mahāśabdo yānti bhūtāni sambhavam । tatasteṣāṃ mahābhūtaśabdo'yamupapadyate ॥3॥
html:
amitānāṃ mahāśabdo yānti bhūtāni sambhavam ।
tatasteṣāṃ mahābhūtaśabdo'yamupapadyate ॥3॥
slp1: amitAnAM mahASabdo yAnti BUtAni samBavam । tatastezAM mahABUtaSabdo'yamupapadyate ॥3॥
author: bhṛguruvāca ।

text: ceṣṭā vayūḥ khamākāśamūṣmāgniḥ salilaṃ dravaḥ । pṛthivī cātra saṅghātaḥ śarīraṃ pāñcabhautikam ॥4॥
html:
ceṣṭā vayūḥ khamākāśamūṣmāgniḥ salilaṃ dravaḥ ।
pṛthivī cātra saṅghātaḥ śarīraṃ pāñcabhautikam ॥4॥
slp1: cezwA vayUH KamAkASamUzmAgniH salilaM dravaH । pfTivI cAtra saNGAtaH SarIraM pAYcaBOtikam ॥4॥

text: ityetaiḥ pañcabhirbhūtairyuktaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam । śrotraṃ ghrāṇaṃ rasaḥ sparśo dṛṣṭiścendriyasañjñitāḥ ॥5॥
html:
ityetaiḥ pañcabhirbhūtairyuktaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam ।
śrotraṃ ghrāṇaṃ rasaḥ sparśo dṛṣṭiścendriyasañjñitāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: ityetEH paYcaBirBUtEryuktaM sTAvarajaNgamam । SrotraM GrARaM rasaH sparSo dfzwiScendriyasaYjYitAH ॥5॥

text: pañcabhiryadi bhūtaistu yuktāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ । sthāvarāṇāṃ na dṛśyante śarīre pañca dhātavaḥ ॥6॥
html:
pañcabhiryadi bhūtaistu yuktāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ ।
sthāvarāṇāṃ na dṛśyante śarīre pañca dhātavaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: paYcaBiryadi BUtEstu yuktAH sTAvarajaNgamAH । sTAvarARAM na dfSyante SarIre paYca DAtavaH ॥6॥
author: bharadvāja uvāca ।

text: anūṣmaṇāmaceṣṭānāṃ ghanānāṃ caiva tattvataḥ । vṛkṣāṇāṃ nopalabhyante śarīre pañca dhātavaḥ ॥7॥
html:
anūṣmaṇāmaceṣṭānāṃ ghanānāṃ caiva tattvataḥ ।
vṛkṣāṇāṃ nopalabhyante śarīre pañca dhātavaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: anUzmaRAmacezwAnAM GanAnAM cEva tattvataH । vfkzARAM nopalaByante SarIre paYca DAtavaH ॥7॥

text: na śṛṇvanti na paśyanti na gandharasavedinaḥ । na ca sparśaṃ vijānanti te kathaṃ pāñcabhautikāḥ ॥8॥
html:
na śṛṇvanti na paśyanti na gandharasavedinaḥ ।
na ca sparśaṃ vijānanti te kathaṃ pāñcabhautikāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: na SfRvanti na paSyanti na ganDarasavedinaH । na ca sparSaM vijAnanti te kaTaM pAYcaBOtikAH ॥8॥

text: adravatvādanagnitvādabhaumatvādavāyutaḥ । ākāśasyāprameyatvādvṛkṣāṇāṃ nāsti bhautikam ॥9॥
html:
adravatvādanagnitvādabhaumatvādavāyutaḥ ।
ākāśasyāprameyatvādvṛkṣāṇāṃ nāsti bhautikam ॥9॥
slp1: adravatvAdanagnitvAdaBOmatvAdavAyutaH । AkASasyAprameyatvAdvfkzARAM nAsti BOtikam ॥9॥

text: ghanānāmapi vṛkṣāṇāmākāśo'sti na saṃśayaḥ । teṣāṃ puṣpaphale vyaktirnityaṃ samupalabhyate ॥10॥
html:
ghanānāmapi vṛkṣāṇāmākāśo'sti na saṃśayaḥ ।
teṣāṃ puṣpaphale vyaktirnityaṃ samupalabhyate ॥10॥
slp1: GanAnAmapi vfkzARAmAkASo'sti na saMSayaH । tezAM puzpaPale vyaktirnityaM samupalaByate ॥10॥
author: bhṛguruvāca ।

text: ūṣmato glānaparṇānāṃ tvakphalaṃ puṣpameva ca । mlāyate caiva śīte na sparśastenātra vidyate ॥11॥
html:
ūṣmato glānaparṇānāṃ tvakphalaṃ puṣpameva ca ।
mlāyate caiva śīte na sparśastenātra vidyate ॥11॥
slp1: Uzmato glAnaparRAnAM tvakPalaM puzpameva ca । mlAyate cEva SIte na sparSastenAtra vidyate ॥11॥

text: vāyvagnyaśaniniṣpeṣaiḥ phalapuṣpaṃ viśīryate । śrotreṇa gṛhyate śabdastasmācchṛṇvanti pādapāḥ ॥12॥
html:
vāyvagnyaśaniniṣpeṣaiḥ phalapuṣpaṃ viśīryate ।
śrotreṇa gṛhyate śabdastasmācchṛṇvanti pādapāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: vAyvagnyaSaninizpezEH PalapuzpaM viSIryate । SrotreRa gfhyate SabdastasmAcCfRvanti pAdapAH ॥12॥

text: vallī veṣṭayate vṛkṣaṃ sarvataścaiva gacchati । na hyadṛṣṭeśca mārgo'sti tasmātpaśyanti pādapāḥ ॥13॥
html:
vallī veṣṭayate vṛkṣaṃ sarvataścaiva gacchati ।
na hyadṛṣṭeśca mārgo'sti tasmātpaśyanti pādapāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: vallI vezwayate vfkzaM sarvataScEva gacCati । na hyadfzweSca mArgo'sti tasmAtpaSyanti pAdapAH ॥13॥

text: puṇyāpuṇyaistathā gandhairdhūpaiśca vividhairapi । arogāḥ puṣpitāḥ santi tasmājjighranti pādapāḥ ॥14॥
html:
puṇyāpuṇyaistathā gandhairdhūpaiśca vividhairapi ।
arogāḥ puṣpitāḥ santi tasmājjighranti pādapāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: puRyApuRyEstaTA ganDErDUpESca viviDErapi । arogAH puzpitAH santi tasmAjjiGranti pAdapAH ॥14॥

text: pādaiḥ salilapānaṃ ca vyādhīnāmapi darśanam । vyādhipratikriyatvācca vidyate rasanaṃ drume ॥15॥
html:
pādaiḥ salilapānaṃ ca vyādhīnāmapi darśanam ।
vyādhipratikriyatvācca vidyate rasanaṃ drume ॥15॥
slp1: pAdEH salilapAnaM ca vyADInAmapi darSanam । vyADipratikriyatvAcca vidyate rasanaM drume ॥15॥

text: vaktreṇotpalanālena yathordhvaṃ jalamādadet । tathā pavanasaṃyuktaḥ pādaiḥ pibati pādapaḥ ॥16॥
html:
vaktreṇotpalanālena yathordhvaṃ jalamādadet ।
tathā pavanasaṃyuktaḥ pādaiḥ pibati pādapaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: vaktreRotpalanAlena yaTorDvaM jalamAdadet । taTA pavanasaMyuktaH pAdEH pibati pAdapaH ॥16॥

text: grahaṇātsukhaduḥkhasya chinnasya ca virohaṇāt । jīvaṃ paśyāmi vṛkṣāṇāmacaitanyaṃ na vidyate ॥17॥
html:
grahaṇātsukhaduḥkhasya chinnasya ca virohaṇāt ।
jīvaṃ paśyāmi vṛkṣāṇāmacaitanyaṃ na vidyate ॥17॥
slp1: grahaRAtsuKaduHKasya Cinnasya ca virohaRAt । jIvaM paSyAmi vfkzARAmacEtanyaM na vidyate ॥17॥

text: tena tajjalamādattaṃ jarayatyagnimārutau । āhārapariṇāmācca sneho vṛddhiśca jāyate ॥18॥
html:
tena tajjalamādattaṃ jarayatyagnimārutau ।
āhārapariṇāmācca sneho vṛddhiśca jāyate ॥18॥
slp1: tena tajjalamAdattaM jarayatyagnimArutO । AhArapariRAmAcca sneho vfdDiSca jAyate ॥18॥

text: jaṅgamānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ śarīre pañca dhātavaḥ । pratyekaśaḥ prabhidyante yaiḥ śarīraṃ viceṣṭate ॥19॥
html:
jaṅgamānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ śarīre pañca dhātavaḥ ।
pratyekaśaḥ prabhidyante yaiḥ śarīraṃ viceṣṭate ॥19॥
slp1: jaNgamAnAM ca sarvezAM SarIre paYca DAtavaH । pratyekaSaH praBidyante yEH SarIraM vicezwate ॥19॥

text: tvakca māṃsaṃ tathāsthīni majjā snāyu ca pañcamam । ityetadiha saṅkhyātaṃ śarīre pṛthivīmayam ॥20॥
html:
tvakca māṃsaṃ tathāsthīni majjā snāyu ca pañcamam ।
ityetadiha saṅkhyātaṃ śarīre pṛthivīmayam ॥20॥
slp1: tvakca mAMsaM taTAsTIni majjA snAyu ca paYcamam । ityetadiha saNKyAtaM SarIre pfTivImayam ॥20॥

text: tejo'gniśca tathā krodhaścakṣurūṣmā tathaiva ca । agnirjarayate cāpi pañcāgneyāḥ śarīriṇaḥ ॥21॥
html:
tejo'gniśca tathā krodhaścakṣurūṣmā tathaiva ca ।
agnirjarayate cāpi pañcāgneyāḥ śarīriṇaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: tejo'gniSca taTA kroDaScakzurUzmA taTEva ca । agnirjarayate cApi paYcAgneyAH SarIriRaH ॥21॥

text: śrotraṃ ghrāṇamathāsyaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ koṣṭhameva ca । ākāśātprāṇināmete śarīre pañca dhātavaḥ ॥22॥
html:
śrotraṃ ghrāṇamathāsyaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ koṣṭhameva ca ।
ākāśātprāṇināmete śarīre pañca dhātavaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: SrotraM GrARamaTAsyaM ca hfdayaM kozWameva ca । AkASAtprARinAmete SarIre paYca DAtavaH ॥22॥

text: śleṣmā pittamatha svedo vasā śoṇitameva ca । ityāpaḥ pañcadhā dehe bhavanti prāṇināṃ sadā ॥23॥
html:
śleṣmā pittamatha svedo vasā śoṇitameva ca ।
ityāpaḥ pañcadhā dehe bhavanti prāṇināṃ sadā ॥23॥
slp1: SlezmA pittamaTa svedo vasA SoRitameva ca । ityApaH paYcaDA dehe Bavanti prARinAM sadA ॥23॥

text: prāṇātpraṇīyate prāṇī vyānādvyāyacchate tathā । gacchatyapāno'vākcaiva samāno hṛdyavasthitaḥ ॥24॥
html:
prāṇātpraṇīyate prāṇī vyānādvyāyacchate tathā ।
gacchatyapāno'vākcaiva samāno hṛdyavasthitaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: prARAtpraRIyate prARI vyAnAdvyAyacCate taTA । gacCatyapAno'vAkcEva samAno hfdyavasTitaH ॥24॥

text: udānāducchvasiti ca pratibhedācca bhāṣate । ityete vāyavaḥ pañca ceṣṭayantīha dehinam ॥25॥
html:
udānāducchvasiti ca pratibhedācca bhāṣate ।
ityete vāyavaḥ pañca ceṣṭayantīha dehinam ॥25॥
slp1: udAnAducCvasiti ca pratiBedAcca BAzate । ityete vAyavaH paYca cezwayantIha dehinam ॥25॥

text: bhūmergandhaguṇānvetti rasaṃ cādbhyaḥ śarīravān । jyotiḥ paśyati cakṣurbhyāṃ sparśaṃ vetti ca vāyunā ॥26॥
html:
bhūmergandhaguṇānvetti rasaṃ cādbhyaḥ śarīravān ।
jyotiḥ paśyati cakṣurbhyāṃ sparśaṃ vetti ca vāyunā ॥26॥
slp1: BUmerganDaguRAnvetti rasaM cAdByaH SarIravAn । jyotiH paSyati cakzurByAM sparSaM vetti ca vAyunA ॥26॥

text: tasya gandhasya vakṣyāmi vistarābhihitānguṇān । iṣṭaścāniṣṭagandhaśca madhuraḥ kaṭureva ca ॥27॥
html:
tasya gandhasya vakṣyāmi vistarābhihitānguṇān ।
iṣṭaścāniṣṭagandhaśca madhuraḥ kaṭureva ca ॥27॥
slp1: tasya ganDasya vakzyAmi vistarABihitAnguRAn । izwaScAnizwaganDaSca maDuraH kawureva ca ॥27॥

text: nirhārī saṃhataḥ snigdho rūkṣo viśada eva ca । evaṃ navavidho jñeyaḥ pārthivo gandhavistaraḥ ॥28॥
html:
nirhārī saṃhataḥ snigdho rūkṣo viśada eva ca ।
evaṃ navavidho jñeyaḥ pārthivo gandhavistaraḥ ॥28॥
slp1: nirhArI saMhataH snigDo rUkzo viSada eva ca । evaM navaviDo jYeyaH pArTivo ganDavistaraH ॥28॥

text: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca rasaścāpāṃ guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ । rasajñānaṃ tu vakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ॥29॥
html:
śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca rasaścāpāṃ guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ।
rasajñānaṃ tu vakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ॥29॥
slp1: SabdaH sparSaSca rUpaM ca rasaScApAM guRAH smftAH । rasajYAnaM tu vakzyAmi tanme nigadataH SfRu ॥29॥

text: raso bahuvidhaḥ proktaḥ sūribhiḥ prathitātmabhiḥ । madhuro lavaṇastiktaḥ kaṣāyo'mlaḥ kaṭustathā । eṣa ṣaḍvidhavistāro raso vārimayaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥30॥
html:
raso bahuvidhaḥ proktaḥ sūribhiḥ prathitātmabhiḥ ।
madhuro lavaṇastiktaḥ kaṣāyo'mlaḥ kaṭustathā ।
eṣa ṣaḍvidhavistāro raso vārimayaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: raso bahuviDaH proktaH sUriBiH praTitAtmaBiH । maDuro lavaRastiktaH kazAyo'mlaH kawustaTA । eza zaqviDavistAro raso vArimayaH smftaH ॥30॥

text: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca triguṇaṃ jyotirucyate । jyotiḥ paśyati rūpāṇi rūpaṃ ca bahudhā smṛtam ॥31॥
html:
śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca triguṇaṃ jyotirucyate ।
jyotiḥ paśyati rūpāṇi rūpaṃ ca bahudhā smṛtam ॥31॥
slp1: SabdaH sparSaSca rUpaM ca triguRaM jyotirucyate । jyotiH paSyati rUpARi rUpaM ca bahuDA smftam ॥31॥

text: hrasvo dīrghastathā sthūlaścaturasro'ṇu vṛttavān । śuklaḥ kṛṣṇastathā rakto nīlaḥ pīto'ruṇastathā । evaṃ dvādaśavistāro jyotīrūpaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥32॥
html:
hrasvo dīrghastathā sthūlaścaturasro'ṇu vṛttavān ।
śuklaḥ kṛṣṇastathā rakto nīlaḥ pīto'ruṇastathā ।
evaṃ dvādaśavistāro jyotīrūpaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: hrasvo dIrGastaTA sTUlaScaturasro'Ru vfttavAn । SuklaH kfzRastaTA rakto nIlaH pIto'ruRastaTA । evaM dvAdaSavistAro jyotIrUpaguRaH smftaH ॥32॥

text: śabdasparśau tu vijñeyau dviguṇo vāyurucyate । vāyavyastu guṇaḥ sparśaḥ sparśaśca bahudhā smṛtaḥ ॥33॥
html:
śabdasparśau tu vijñeyau dviguṇo vāyurucyate ।
vāyavyastu guṇaḥ sparśaḥ sparśaśca bahudhā smṛtaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: SabdasparSO tu vijYeyO dviguRo vAyurucyate । vAyavyastu guRaH sparSaH sparSaSca bahuDA smftaH ॥33॥

text: kaṭhinaścikkaṇaḥ ślakṣṇaḥ picchalo mṛdudāruṇaḥ । uṣṇaḥ śītaḥ sukho duḥkhaḥ snigdho viśada eva ca । evaṃ dvādaśavistāro vāyavyo guṇa ucyate ॥34॥
html:
kaṭhinaścikkaṇaḥ ślakṣṇaḥ picchalo mṛdudāruṇaḥ ।
uṣṇaḥ śītaḥ sukho duḥkhaḥ snigdho viśada eva ca ।
evaṃ dvādaśavistāro vāyavyo guṇa ucyate ॥34॥
slp1: kaWinaScikkaRaH SlakzRaH picCalo mfdudAruRaH । uzRaH SItaH suKo duHKaH snigDo viSada eva ca । evaM dvAdaSavistAro vAyavyo guRa ucyate ॥34॥

text: tatraikaguṇamākāśaṃ śabda ityeva tatsmṛtam । tasya śabdasya vakṣyāmi vistaraṃ vividhātmakam ॥35॥
html:
tatraikaguṇamākāśaṃ śabda ityeva tatsmṛtam ।
tasya śabdasya vakṣyāmi vistaraṃ vividhātmakam ॥35॥
slp1: tatrEkaguRamAkASaM Sabda ityeva tatsmftam । tasya Sabdasya vakzyAmi vistaraM viviDAtmakam ॥35॥

text: ṣaḍja ṛṣabhagāndhārau madhyamaḥ pañcamastathā । dhaivataścāpi vijñeyastathā cāpi niṣādakaḥ ॥36॥
html:
ṣaḍja ṛṣabhagāndhārau madhyamaḥ pañcamastathā ।
dhaivataścāpi vijñeyastathā cāpi niṣādakaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: zaqja fzaBagAnDArO maDyamaH paYcamastaTA । DEvataScApi vijYeyastaTA cApi nizAdakaH ॥36॥

text: eṣa saptavidhaḥ prokto guṇa ākāśalakṣaṇaḥ । traisvaryeṇa tu sarvatra sthito'pi paṭahādiṣu ॥37॥
html:
eṣa saptavidhaḥ prokto guṇa ākāśalakṣaṇaḥ ।
traisvaryeṇa tu sarvatra sthito'pi paṭahādiṣu ॥37॥
slp1: eza saptaviDaH prokto guRa AkASalakzaRaH । trEsvaryeRa tu sarvatra sTito'pi pawahAdizu ॥37॥

text: ākāśajaṃ śabdamāhurebhirvāyuguṇaiḥ saha । avyāhataiścetayate na vetti viṣamāgataiḥ ॥38॥
html:
ākāśajaṃ śabdamāhurebhirvāyuguṇaiḥ saha ।
avyāhataiścetayate na vetti viṣamāgataiḥ ॥38॥
slp1: AkASajaM SabdamAhureBirvAyuguREH saha । avyAhatEScetayate na vetti vizamAgatEH ॥38॥

text: āpyāyante ca te nityaṃ dhātavastaistu dhātubhiḥ । āpo'gnirmārutaścaiva nityaṃ jāgrati dehiṣu] ॥39॥
html:
āpyāyante ca te nityaṃ dhātavastaistu dhātubhiḥ ।
āpo'gnirmārutaścaiva nityaṃ jāgrati dehiṣu] ॥39॥
slp1: ApyAyante ca te nityaM DAtavastEstu DAtuBiH । Apo'gnirmArutaScEva nityaM jAgrati dehizu] ॥39॥

text: pārthivaṃ dhātumāśritya śārīro'gniḥ kathaṃ bhavet । avakāśaviśeṣeṇa kathaṃ vartayate'nilaḥ ॥1॥
html:
pārthivaṃ dhātumāśritya śārīro'gniḥ kathaṃ bhavet ।
avakāśaviśeṣeṇa kathaṃ vartayate'nilaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: pArTivaM DAtumASritya SArIro'gniH kaTaM Bavet । avakASaviSezeRa kaTaM vartayate'nilaH ॥1॥
author: bharadvāja uvāca ।

text: vāyorgatimahaṃ brahmankīrtayiṣyāmi te'nagha । prāṇināmanilo dehānyathā ceṣṭayate balī ॥2॥
html:
vāyorgatimahaṃ brahmankīrtayiṣyāmi te'nagha ।
prāṇināmanilo dehānyathā ceṣṭayate balī ॥2॥
slp1: vAyorgatimahaM brahmankIrtayizyAmi te'naGa । prARinAmanilo dehAnyaTA cezwayate balI ॥2॥
author: bhṛguruvāca ।

text: śrito mūrdhānamagnistu śarīraṃ paripālayan । prāṇo mūrdhani cāgnau ca vartamāno viceṣṭate ॥3॥
html:
śrito mūrdhānamagnistu śarīraṃ paripālayan ।
prāṇo mūrdhani cāgnau ca vartamāno viceṣṭate ॥3॥
slp1: Srito mUrDAnamagnistu SarIraM paripAlayan । prARo mUrDani cAgnO ca vartamAno vicezwate ॥3॥

text: sa jantuḥ sarvabhūtātmā puruṣaḥ sa sanātanaḥ । mano buddhirahaṅkāro bhūtāni viṣayāśca saḥ ॥4॥
html:
sa jantuḥ sarvabhūtātmā puruṣaḥ sa sanātanaḥ ।
mano buddhirahaṅkāro bhūtāni viṣayāśca saḥ ॥4॥
slp1: sa jantuH sarvaBUtAtmA puruzaH sa sanAtanaH । mano budDirahaNkAro BUtAni vizayASca saH ॥4॥

text: evaṃ tviha sa sarvatra prāṇena paripālyate । pṛṣṭhataśca samānena svāṃ svāṃ gatimupāśritaḥ ॥5॥
html:
evaṃ tviha sa sarvatra prāṇena paripālyate ।
pṛṣṭhataśca samānena svāṃ svāṃ gatimupāśritaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: evaM tviha sa sarvatra prARena paripAlyate । pfzWataSca samAnena svAM svAM gatimupASritaH ॥5॥

text: vastimūlaṃ gudaṃ caiva pāvakaṃ ca samāśritaḥ । vahanmūtraṃ purīṣaṃ cāpyapānaḥ parivartate ॥6॥
html:
vastimūlaṃ gudaṃ caiva pāvakaṃ ca samāśritaḥ ।
vahanmūtraṃ purīṣaṃ cāpyapānaḥ parivartate ॥6॥
slp1: vastimUlaM gudaM cEva pAvakaM ca samASritaH । vahanmUtraM purIzaM cApyapAnaH parivartate ॥6॥

text: prayatne karmaṇi bale ya ekastriṣu vartate । udāna iti taṃ prāhuradhyātmaviduṣo janāḥ ॥7॥
html:
prayatne karmaṇi bale ya ekastriṣu vartate ।
udāna iti taṃ prāhuradhyātmaviduṣo janāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: prayatne karmaRi bale ya ekastrizu vartate । udAna iti taM prAhuraDyAtmaviduzo janAH ॥7॥

text: sandhiṣvapi ca sarveṣu sanniviṣṭastathānilaḥ । śarīreṣu manuṣyāṇāṃ vyāna ityupadiśyate ॥8॥
html:
sandhiṣvapi ca sarveṣu sanniviṣṭastathānilaḥ ।
śarīreṣu manuṣyāṇāṃ vyāna ityupadiśyate ॥8॥
slp1: sanDizvapi ca sarvezu sannivizwastaTAnilaH । SarIrezu manuzyARAM vyAna ityupadiSyate ॥8॥

text: dhātuṣvagnistu vitataḥ samānena samīritaḥ । rasāndhātūṃśca doṣāṃśca vartayannavatiṣṭhati ॥9॥
html:
dhātuṣvagnistu vitataḥ samānena samīritaḥ ।
rasāndhātūṃśca doṣāṃśca vartayannavatiṣṭhati ॥9॥
slp1: DAtuzvagnistu vitataH samAnena samIritaH । rasAnDAtUMSca dozAMSca vartayannavatizWati ॥9॥

text: apānaprāṇayormadhye prāṇāpānasamāhitaḥ । samanvitaḥ svadhiṣṭhānaḥ samyakpacati pāvakaḥ ॥10॥
html:
apānaprāṇayormadhye prāṇāpānasamāhitaḥ ।
samanvitaḥ svadhiṣṭhānaḥ samyakpacati pāvakaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: apAnaprARayormaDye prARApAnasamAhitaH । samanvitaH svaDizWAnaH samyakpacati pAvakaH ॥10॥

text: āsyaṃ hi pāyusaṃyuktamante syādgudasañjñitam । srotastasmātprajāyante sarvasrotāṃsi dehinām ॥11॥
html:
āsyaṃ hi pāyusaṃyuktamante syādgudasañjñitam ।
srotastasmātprajāyante sarvasrotāṃsi dehinām ॥11॥
slp1: AsyaM hi pAyusaMyuktamante syAdgudasaYjYitam । srotastasmAtprajAyante sarvasrotAMsi dehinAm ॥11॥

text: prāṇānāṃ sannipātācca sannipātaḥ prajāyate । ūṣmā cāgniriti jñeyo yo'nnaṃ pacati dehinām ॥12॥
html:
prāṇānāṃ sannipātācca sannipātaḥ prajāyate ।
ūṣmā cāgniriti jñeyo yo'nnaṃ pacati dehinām ॥12॥
slp1: prARAnAM sannipAtAcca sannipAtaH prajAyate । UzmA cAgniriti jYeyo yo'nnaM pacati dehinAm ॥12॥

text: agnivegavahaḥ prāṇo gudānte pratihanyate । sa ūrdhvamāgamya punaḥ samutkṣipati pāvakam ॥13॥
html:
agnivegavahaḥ prāṇo gudānte pratihanyate ।
sa ūrdhvamāgamya punaḥ samutkṣipati pāvakam ॥13॥
slp1: agnivegavahaH prARo gudAnte pratihanyate । sa UrDvamAgamya punaH samutkzipati pAvakam ॥13॥

text: pakvāśayastvadho nābherūrdhvamāmāśayaḥ sthitaḥ । nābhimadhye śarīrasya sarve prāṇāḥ samāhitāḥ ॥14॥
html:
pakvāśayastvadho nābherūrdhvamāmāśayaḥ sthitaḥ ।
nābhimadhye śarīrasya sarve prāṇāḥ samāhitāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: pakvASayastvaDo nABerUrDvamAmASayaH sTitaH । nABimaDye SarIrasya sarve prARAH samAhitAH ॥14॥

text: prasṛtā hṛdayātsarve tiryagūrdhvamadhastathā । vahantyannarasānnāḍyo daśa prāṇapracoditāḥ ॥15॥
html:
prasṛtā hṛdayātsarve tiryagūrdhvamadhastathā ।
vahantyannarasānnāḍyo daśa prāṇapracoditāḥ ॥15॥
slp1: prasftA hfdayAtsarve tiryagUrDvamaDastaTA । vahantyannarasAnnAqyo daSa prARapracoditAH ॥15॥

text: eṣa mārgo'tha yogānāṃ yena gacchanti tatpadam । jitaklamāsanā dhīrā mūrdhanyātmānamādadhuḥ ॥16॥
html:
eṣa mārgo'tha yogānāṃ yena gacchanti tatpadam ।
jitaklamāsanā dhīrā mūrdhanyātmānamādadhuḥ ॥16॥
slp1: eza mArgo'Ta yogAnAM yena gacCanti tatpadam । jitaklamAsanA DIrA mUrDanyAtmAnamAdaDuH ॥16॥

text: evaṃ sarveṣu vihitaḥ prāṇāpāneṣu dehinām । tasminsthito nityamagniḥ sthālyāmiva samāhitaḥ] ॥17॥
html:
evaṃ sarveṣu vihitaḥ prāṇāpāneṣu dehinām ।
tasminsthito nityamagniḥ sthālyāmiva samāhitaḥ] ॥17॥
slp1: evaM sarvezu vihitaH prARApAnezu dehinAm । tasminsTito nityamagniH sTAlyAmiva samAhitaH] ॥17॥

text: yadi prāṇāyate vāyurvāyureva viceṣṭate । śvasityābhāṣate caiva tasmājjīvo nirarthakaḥ ॥1॥
html:
yadi prāṇāyate vāyurvāyureva viceṣṭate ।
śvasityābhāṣate caiva tasmājjīvo nirarthakaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: yadi prARAyate vAyurvAyureva vicezwate । SvasityABAzate cEva tasmAjjIvo nirarTakaH ॥1॥
author: bharadvāja uvāca ।

text: yadyūṣmabhāva āgneyo vahninā pacyate yadi । agnirjarayate caiva tasmājjīvo nirarthakaḥ ॥2॥
html:
yadyūṣmabhāva āgneyo vahninā pacyate yadi ।
agnirjarayate caiva tasmājjīvo nirarthakaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: yadyUzmaBAva Agneyo vahninA pacyate yadi । agnirjarayate cEva tasmAjjIvo nirarTakaH ॥2॥

text: jantoḥ pramīyamāṇasya jīvo naivopalabhyate । vāyureva jahātyenamūṣmabhāvaśca naśyati ॥3॥
html:
jantoḥ pramīyamāṇasya jīvo naivopalabhyate ।
vāyureva jahātyenamūṣmabhāvaśca naśyati ॥3॥
slp1: jantoH pramIyamARasya jIvo nEvopalaByate । vAyureva jahAtyenamUzmaBAvaSca naSyati ॥3॥

text: yadi vātopamo jīvaḥ saṃśleṣo yadi vāyunā । vāyumaṇḍalavaddṛśyo gacchetsaha marudgaṇaiḥ ॥4॥
html:
yadi vātopamo jīvaḥ saṃśleṣo yadi vāyunā ।
vāyumaṇḍalavaddṛśyo gacchetsaha marudgaṇaiḥ ॥4॥
slp1: yadi vAtopamo jIvaH saMSlezo yadi vAyunA । vAyumaRqalavaddfSyo gacCetsaha marudgaREH ॥4॥

text: śleṣo yadi ca vātena yadi tasmātpraṇaśyati । mahārṇavavimuktatvādanyatsalilabhājanam ॥5॥
html:
śleṣo yadi ca vātena yadi tasmātpraṇaśyati ।
mahārṇavavimuktatvādanyatsalilabhājanam ॥5॥
slp1: Slezo yadi ca vAtena yadi tasmAtpraRaSyati । mahArRavavimuktatvAdanyatsalilaBAjanam ॥5॥

text: kūpe vā salilaṃ dadyātpradīpaṃ vā hutāśane । prakṣiptaṃ naśyati kṣipraṃ yathā naśyatyasau tathā ॥6॥
html:
kūpe vā salilaṃ dadyātpradīpaṃ vā hutāśane ।
prakṣiptaṃ naśyati kṣipraṃ yathā naśyatyasau tathā ॥6॥
slp1: kUpe vA salilaM dadyAtpradIpaM vA hutASane । prakziptaM naSyati kzipraM yaTA naSyatyasO taTA ॥6॥

text: pañcasādhāraṇe hyasmiñśarīre jīvitaṃ kutaḥ । yeṣāmanyataratyāgāccaturṇāṃ nāsti saṅgrahaḥ ॥7॥
html:
pañcasādhāraṇe hyasmiñśarīre jīvitaṃ kutaḥ ।
yeṣāmanyataratyāgāccaturṇāṃ nāsti saṅgrahaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: paYcasADAraRe hyasmiYSarIre jIvitaM kutaH । yezAmanyataratyAgAccaturRAM nAsti saNgrahaH ॥7॥

text: naśyantyāpo hyanāhārādvāyurucchvāsanigrahāt । naśyate koṣṭhabhedātkhamagnirnaśyatyabhojanāt ॥8॥
html:
naśyantyāpo hyanāhārādvāyurucchvāsanigrahāt ।
naśyate koṣṭhabhedātkhamagnirnaśyatyabhojanāt ॥8॥
slp1: naSyantyApo hyanAhArAdvAyurucCvAsanigrahAt । naSyate kozWaBedAtKamagnirnaSyatyaBojanAt ॥8॥

text: vyādhivraṇaparikleśairmedinī caiva śīryate । pīḍite'nyatare hyeṣāṃ saṅghāto yāti pañcadhā ॥9॥
html:
vyādhivraṇaparikleśairmedinī caiva śīryate ।
pīḍite'nyatare hyeṣāṃ saṅghāto yāti pañcadhā ॥9॥
slp1: vyADivraRaparikleSErmedinI cEva SIryate । pIqite'nyatare hyezAM saNGAto yAti paYcaDA ॥9॥

text: tasminpañcatvamāpanne jīvaḥ kimanudhāvati । kiṃ vedayati vā jīvaḥ kiṃ śṛṇoti bravīti vā ॥10॥
html:
tasminpañcatvamāpanne jīvaḥ kimanudhāvati ।
kiṃ vedayati vā jīvaḥ kiṃ śṛṇoti bravīti vā ॥10॥
slp1: tasminpaYcatvamApanne jIvaH kimanuDAvati । kiM vedayati vA jIvaH kiM SfRoti bravIti vA ॥10॥

text: eṣā gauḥ paralokasthaṃ tārayiṣyati māmiti । yo dattvā mriyate jantuḥ sā gauḥ kaṃ tārayiṣyati ॥11॥
html:
eṣā gauḥ paralokasthaṃ tārayiṣyati māmiti ।
yo dattvā mriyate jantuḥ sā gauḥ kaṃ tārayiṣyati ॥11॥
slp1: ezA gOH paralokasTaM tArayizyati mAmiti । yo dattvA mriyate jantuH sA gOH kaM tArayizyati ॥11॥

text: gauśca pratigrahītā ca dātā caiva samaṃ yadā । ihaiva vilayaṃ yānti kutasteṣāṃ samāgamaḥ ॥12॥
html:
gauśca pratigrahītā ca dātā caiva samaṃ yadā ।
ihaiva vilayaṃ yānti kutasteṣāṃ samāgamaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: gOSca pratigrahItA ca dAtA cEva samaM yadA । ihEva vilayaM yAnti kutastezAM samAgamaH ॥12॥

text: vihagairupayuktasya śailāgrātpatitasya vā । agninā copayuktasya kutaḥ sañjīvanaṃ punaḥ ॥13॥
html:
vihagairupayuktasya śailāgrātpatitasya vā ।
agninā copayuktasya kutaḥ sañjīvanaṃ punaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: vihagErupayuktasya SElAgrAtpatitasya vA । agninA copayuktasya kutaH saYjIvanaM punaH ॥13॥

text: chinnasya yadi vṛkṣasya na mūlaṃ pratirohati । bījānyasya pravartante mṛtaḥ kva punareṣyati ॥14॥
html:
chinnasya yadi vṛkṣasya na mūlaṃ pratirohati ।
bījānyasya pravartante mṛtaḥ kva punareṣyati ॥14॥
slp1: Cinnasya yadi vfkzasya na mUlaM pratirohati । bIjAnyasya pravartante mftaH kva punarezyati ॥14॥

text: bījamātraṃ purā sṛṣṭaṃ yadetatparivartate । mṛtā mṛtāḥ praṇaśyanti bījādbījaṃ pravartate] ॥15॥
html:
bījamātraṃ purā sṛṣṭaṃ yadetatparivartate ।
mṛtā mṛtāḥ praṇaśyanti bījādbījaṃ pravartate] ॥15॥
slp1: bIjamAtraM purA sfzwaM yadetatparivartate । mftA mftAH praRaSyanti bIjAdbIjaM pravartate] ॥15॥

text: na praṇāśo'sti jīvānāṃ dattasya ca kṛtasya ca । yāti dehāntaraṃ prāṇī śarīraṃ tu viśīryate ॥1॥
html:
na praṇāśo'sti jīvānāṃ dattasya ca kṛtasya ca ।
yāti dehāntaraṃ prāṇī śarīraṃ tu viśīryate ॥1॥
slp1: na praRASo'sti jIvAnAM dattasya ca kftasya ca । yAti dehAntaraM prARI SarIraM tu viSIryate ॥1॥
author: bhṛguruvāca ।

text: na śarīrāśrito jīvastasminnaṣṭe praṇaśyati । yathā samitsu dagdhāsu na praṇaśyati pāvakaḥ ॥2॥
html:
na śarīrāśrito jīvastasminnaṣṭe praṇaśyati ।
yathā samitsu dagdhāsu na praṇaśyati pāvakaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: na SarIrASrito jIvastasminnazwe praRaSyati । yaTA samitsu dagDAsu na praRaSyati pAvakaH ॥2॥

text: agneryathā tathā tasya yadi nāśo na vidyate । indhanasyopayogānte sa cāgnirnopalabhyate ॥3॥
html:
agneryathā tathā tasya yadi nāśo na vidyate ।
indhanasyopayogānte sa cāgnirnopalabhyate ॥3॥
slp1: agneryaTA taTA tasya yadi nASo na vidyate । inDanasyopayogAnte sa cAgnirnopalaByate ॥3॥
author: bharadvāja uvāca ।

text: naśyatītyeva jānāmi śāntamagnimanindhanam । gatiryasya pramāṇaṃ vā saṃsthānaṃ vā na dṛśyate ॥4॥
html:
naśyatītyeva jānāmi śāntamagnimanindhanam ।
gatiryasya pramāṇaṃ vā saṃsthānaṃ vā na dṛśyate ॥4॥
slp1: naSyatItyeva jAnAmi SAntamagnimaninDanam । gatiryasya pramARaM vA saMsTAnaM vA na dfSyate ॥4॥

text: samidhāmupayogānte sannevāgnirna dṛśyate । ākāśānugatatvāddhi durgrahaḥ sa nirāśrayaḥ ॥5॥
html:
samidhāmupayogānte sannevāgnirna dṛśyate ।
ākāśānugatatvāddhi durgrahaḥ sa nirāśrayaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: samiDAmupayogAnte sannevAgnirna dfSyate । AkASAnugatatvAdDi durgrahaH sa nirASrayaH ॥5॥
author: bhṛguruvāca ।

text: tathā śarīrasantyāge jīvo hyākāśavatsthitaḥ । na gṛhyate susūkṣmatvādyathā jyotirna saṃśayaḥ ॥6॥
html:
tathā śarīrasantyāge jīvo hyākāśavatsthitaḥ ।
na gṛhyate susūkṣmatvādyathā jyotirna saṃśayaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: taTA SarIrasantyAge jIvo hyAkASavatsTitaH । na gfhyate susUkzmatvAdyaTA jyotirna saMSayaH ॥6॥

text: prāṇāndhārayate hyagniḥ sa jīva upadhāryatām । vāyusandhāraṇo hyagnirnaśyatyucchvāsanigrahāt ॥7॥
html:
prāṇāndhārayate hyagniḥ sa jīva upadhāryatām ।
vāyusandhāraṇo hyagnirnaśyatyucchvāsanigrahāt ॥7॥
slp1: prARAnDArayate hyagniH sa jIva upaDAryatAm । vAyusanDAraRo hyagnirnaSyatyucCvAsanigrahAt ॥7॥

text: tasminnaṣṭe śarīrāgnau śarīraṃ tadacetanam । patitaṃ yāti bhūmitvamayanaṃ tasya hi kṣitiḥ ॥8॥
html:
tasminnaṣṭe śarīrāgnau śarīraṃ tadacetanam ।
patitaṃ yāti bhūmitvamayanaṃ tasya hi kṣitiḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tasminnazwe SarIrAgnO SarIraM tadacetanam । patitaM yAti BUmitvamayanaM tasya hi kzitiH ॥8॥

text: jaṅgamānāṃ hi sarveṣāṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca । ākāśaṃ pavano'bhyeti jyotistamanugacchati । tatra trayāṇāmekatvaṃ dvayaṃ bhūmau pratiṣṭhitam ॥9॥
html:
jaṅgamānāṃ hi sarveṣāṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca ।
ākāśaṃ pavano'bhyeti jyotistamanugacchati ।
tatra trayāṇāmekatvaṃ dvayaṃ bhūmau pratiṣṭhitam ॥9॥
slp1: jaNgamAnAM hi sarvezAM sTAvarARAM taTEva ca । AkASaM pavano'Byeti jyotistamanugacCati । tatra trayARAmekatvaM dvayaM BUmO pratizWitam ॥9॥

text: yatra khaṃ tatra pavanastatrāgniryatra mārutaḥ । amūrtayaste vijñeyā āpo mūrtāstathā kṣitiḥ ॥10॥
html:
yatra khaṃ tatra pavanastatrāgniryatra mārutaḥ ।
amūrtayaste vijñeyā āpo mūrtāstathā kṣitiḥ ॥10॥
slp1: yatra KaM tatra pavanastatrAgniryatra mArutaH । amUrtayaste vijYeyA Apo mUrtAstaTA kzitiH ॥10॥

text: yadyagnimārutau bhūmiḥ khamāpaśca śarīriṣu । jīvaḥ kiṃlakṣaṇastatretyetadācakṣva me'nagha ॥11॥
html:
yadyagnimārutau bhūmiḥ khamāpaśca śarīriṣu ।
jīvaḥ kiṃlakṣaṇastatretyetadācakṣva me'nagha ॥11॥
slp1: yadyagnimArutO BUmiH KamApaSca SarIrizu । jIvaH kiMlakzaRastatretyetadAcakzva me'naGa ॥11॥
author: bharadvāja uvāca ।

text: pañcātmake pañcaratau pañcavijñānasaṃyute । śarīre prāṇināṃ jīvaṃ jñātumicchāmi yādṛśam ॥12॥
html:
pañcātmake pañcaratau pañcavijñānasaṃyute ।
śarīre prāṇināṃ jīvaṃ jñātumicchāmi yādṛśam ॥12॥
slp1: paYcAtmake paYcaratO paYcavijYAnasaMyute । SarIre prARinAM jIvaM jYAtumicCAmi yAdfSam ॥12॥

text: māṃsaśoṇitasaṅghāte medaḥsnāyvasthisañcaye । bhidyamāne śarīre tu jīvo naivopalabhyate ॥13॥
html:
māṃsaśoṇitasaṅghāte medaḥsnāyvasthisañcaye ।
bhidyamāne śarīre tu jīvo naivopalabhyate ॥13॥
slp1: mAMsaSoRitasaNGAte medaHsnAyvasTisaYcaye । BidyamAne SarIre tu jIvo nEvopalaByate ॥13॥

text: yadyajīvaṃ śarīraṃ tu pañcabhūtasamanvitam । śārīre mānase duḥkhe kastāṃ vedayate rujam ॥14॥
html:
yadyajīvaṃ śarīraṃ tu pañcabhūtasamanvitam ।
śārīre mānase duḥkhe kastāṃ vedayate rujam ॥14॥
slp1: yadyajIvaM SarIraM tu paYcaBUtasamanvitam । SArIre mAnase duHKe kastAM vedayate rujam ॥14॥

text: śṛṇoti kathitaṃ jīvaḥ karṇābhyāṃ na śṛṇoti tat । maharṣe manasi vyagre tasmājjīvo nirarthakaḥ ॥15॥
html:
śṛṇoti kathitaṃ jīvaḥ karṇābhyāṃ na śṛṇoti tat ।
maharṣe manasi vyagre tasmājjīvo nirarthakaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: SfRoti kaTitaM jIvaH karRAByAM na SfRoti tat । maharze manasi vyagre tasmAjjIvo nirarTakaH ॥15॥

text: sarvaṃ paśyati yaddṛśyaṃ manoyuktena cakṣuṣā । manasi vyākule taddhi paśyannapi na paśyati ॥16॥
html:
sarvaṃ paśyati yaddṛśyaṃ manoyuktena cakṣuṣā ।
manasi vyākule taddhi paśyannapi na paśyati ॥16॥
slp1: sarvaM paSyati yaddfSyaM manoyuktena cakzuzA । manasi vyAkule tadDi paSyannapi na paSyati ॥16॥

text: na paśyati na ca brūte na śṛṇoti na jighrati । na ca sparśarasau vetti nidrāvaśagataḥ punaḥ ॥17॥
html:
na paśyati na ca brūte na śṛṇoti na jighrati ।
na ca sparśarasau vetti nidrāvaśagataḥ punaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: na paSyati na ca brUte na SfRoti na jiGrati । na ca sparSarasO vetti nidrAvaSagataH punaH ॥17॥

text: hṛṣyati krudhyati ca kaḥ śocatyudvijate ca kaḥ । icchati dhyāyati dveṣṭi vācamīrayate ca kaḥ ॥18॥
html:
hṛṣyati krudhyati ca kaḥ śocatyudvijate ca kaḥ ।
icchati dhyāyati dveṣṭi vācamīrayate ca kaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: hfzyati kruDyati ca kaH Socatyudvijate ca kaH । icCati DyAyati dvezwi vAcamIrayate ca kaH ॥18॥

text: na pañcasādhāraṇamatra kiñciccharīrameko vahate'ntarātmā । sa vetti gandhāṃśca rasāñśrutiṃ ca sparśaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca guṇāśca ye'nye ॥19॥
html:
na pañcasādhāraṇamatra kiñciccharīrameko vahate'ntarātmā ।
sa vetti gandhāṃśca rasāñśrutiṃ ca sparśaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca guṇāśca ye'nye ॥19॥
slp1: na paYcasADAraRamatra kiYcicCarIrameko vahate'ntarAtmA । sa vetti ganDAMSca rasAYSrutiM ca sparSaM ca rUpaM ca guRASca ye'nye ॥19॥
author: bhṛguruvāca ।

text: pañcātmake pañcaguṇapradarśī sa sarvagātrānugato'ntarātmā । sa vetti duḥkhāni sukhāni cātra tadviprayogāttu na vetti dehaḥ ॥20॥
html:
pañcātmake pañcaguṇapradarśī sa sarvagātrānugato'ntarātmā ।
sa vetti duḥkhāni sukhāni cātra tadviprayogāttu na vetti dehaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: paYcAtmake paYcaguRapradarSI sa sarvagAtrAnugato'ntarAtmA । sa vetti duHKAni suKAni cAtra tadviprayogAttu na vetti dehaH ॥20॥

text: yadā na rūpaṃ na sparśo noṣmabhāvaśca pāvake । tadā śānte śarīrāgnau dehaṃ tyaktvā sa naśyati ॥21॥
html:
yadā na rūpaṃ na sparśo noṣmabhāvaśca pāvake ।
tadā śānte śarīrāgnau dehaṃ tyaktvā sa naśyati ॥21॥
slp1: yadA na rUpaM na sparSo nozmaBAvaSca pAvake । tadA SAnte SarIrAgnO dehaM tyaktvA sa naSyati ॥21॥

text: ammayaṃ sarvamevedamāpo mūrtiḥ śarīriṇām । tatrātmā mānaso brahmā sarvabhūteṣu lokakṛt ॥22॥
html:
ammayaṃ sarvamevedamāpo mūrtiḥ śarīriṇām ।
tatrātmā mānaso brahmā sarvabhūteṣu lokakṛt ॥22॥
slp1: ammayaM sarvamevedamApo mUrtiH SarIriRAm । tatrAtmA mAnaso brahmA sarvaBUtezu lokakft ॥22॥

text: ātmānaṃ taṃ vijānīhi sarvalokahitātmakam । tasminyaḥ sañśrito dehe hyabbinduriva puṣkare ॥23॥
html:
ātmānaṃ taṃ vijānīhi sarvalokahitātmakam ।
tasminyaḥ sañśrito dehe hyabbinduriva puṣkare ॥23॥
slp1: AtmAnaM taM vijAnIhi sarvalokahitAtmakam । tasminyaH saYSrito dehe hyabbinduriva puzkare ॥23॥

text: kṣetrajñaṃ taṃ vijānīhi nityaṃ lokahitātmakam । tamo rajaśca sattvaṃ ca viddhi jīvaguṇānimān ॥24॥
html:
kṣetrajñaṃ taṃ vijānīhi nityaṃ lokahitātmakam ।
tamo rajaśca sattvaṃ ca viddhi jīvaguṇānimān ॥24॥
slp1: kzetrajYaM taM vijAnIhi nityaM lokahitAtmakam । tamo rajaSca sattvaM ca vidDi jIvaguRAnimAn ॥24॥

text: sacetanaṃ jīvaguṇaṃ vadanti sa ceṣṭate ceṣṭayate ca sarvam । tataḥ paraṃ kṣetravidaṃ vadanti prāvartayadyo bhuvanāni sapta ॥25॥
html:
sacetanaṃ jīvaguṇaṃ vadanti sa ceṣṭate ceṣṭayate ca sarvam ।
tataḥ paraṃ kṣetravidaṃ vadanti prāvartayadyo bhuvanāni sapta ॥25॥
slp1: sacetanaM jIvaguRaM vadanti sa cezwate cezwayate ca sarvam । tataH paraM kzetravidaM vadanti prAvartayadyo BuvanAni sapta ॥25॥

text: na jīvanāśo'sti hi dehabhede mithyaitadāhurmṛta ityabuddhāḥ । jīvastu dehāntaritaḥ prayāti daśārdhataivāsya śarīrabhedaḥ ॥26॥
html:
na jīvanāśo'sti hi dehabhede mithyaitadāhurmṛta ityabuddhāḥ ।
jīvastu dehāntaritaḥ prayāti daśārdhataivāsya śarīrabhedaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: na jIvanASo'sti hi dehaBede miTyEtadAhurmfta ityabudDAH । jIvastu dehAntaritaH prayAti daSArDatEvAsya SarIraBedaH ॥26॥

text: evaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu gūḍhaścarati saṃvṛtaḥ । dṛśyate tvagryayā buddhyā sūkṣmayā tattvadarśibhiḥ ॥27॥
html:
evaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu gūḍhaścarati saṃvṛtaḥ ।
dṛśyate tvagryayā buddhyā sūkṣmayā tattvadarśibhiḥ ॥27॥
slp1: evaM sarvezu BUtezu gUQaScarati saMvftaH । dfSyate tvagryayA budDyA sUkzmayA tattvadarSiBiH ॥27॥

text: taṃ pūrvāpararātreṣu yuñjānaḥ satataṃ budhaḥ । laghvāhāro viśuddhātmā paśyatyātmānamātmani ॥28॥
html:
taṃ pūrvāpararātreṣu yuñjānaḥ satataṃ budhaḥ ।
laghvāhāro viśuddhātmā paśyatyātmānamātmani ॥28॥
slp1: taM pUrvApararAtrezu yuYjAnaH satataM buDaH । laGvAhAro viSudDAtmA paSyatyAtmAnamAtmani ॥28॥

text: cittasya hi prasādena hitvā karma śubhāśubham । prasannātmātmani sthitvā sukhamakṣayamaśnute ॥29॥
html:
cittasya hi prasādena hitvā karma śubhāśubham ।
prasannātmātmani sthitvā sukhamakṣayamaśnute ॥29॥
slp1: cittasya hi prasAdena hitvA karma SuBASuBam । prasannAtmAtmani sTitvA suKamakzayamaSnute ॥29॥

text: mānaso'gniḥ śarīreṣu jīva ityabhidhīyate । sṛṣṭiḥ prajāpatereṣā bhūtādhyātmaviniścaye] ॥30॥
html:
mānaso'gniḥ śarīreṣu jīva ityabhidhīyate ।
sṛṣṭiḥ prajāpatereṣā bhūtādhyātmaviniścaye] ॥30॥
slp1: mAnaso'gniH SarIrezu jIva ityaBiDIyate । sfzwiH prajApaterezA BUtADyAtmaviniScaye] ॥30॥

text: asṛjadbrāhmaṇāneva pūrvaṃ brahmā prajāpatiḥ । ātmatejobhinirvṛttānbhāskarāgnisamaprabhān ॥1॥
html:
asṛjadbrāhmaṇāneva pūrvaṃ brahmā prajāpatiḥ ।
ātmatejobhinirvṛttānbhāskarāgnisamaprabhān ॥1॥
slp1: asfjadbrAhmaRAneva pUrvaM brahmA prajApatiH । AtmatejoBinirvfttAnBAskarAgnisamapraBAn ॥1॥
author: bhṛguruvāca ।

text: tataḥ satyaṃ ca dharmaṃ ca tapo brahma ca śāśvatam । ācāraṃ caiva śaucaṃ ca svargāya vidadhe prabhuḥ ॥2॥
html:
tataḥ satyaṃ ca dharmaṃ ca tapo brahma ca śāśvatam ।
ācāraṃ caiva śaucaṃ ca svargāya vidadhe prabhuḥ ॥2॥
slp1: tataH satyaM ca DarmaM ca tapo brahma ca SASvatam । AcAraM cEva SOcaM ca svargAya vidaDe praBuH ॥2॥

text: devadānavagandharvadaityāsuramahoragāḥ । yakṣarākṣasanāgāśca piśācā manujāstathā ॥3॥
html:
devadānavagandharvadaityāsuramahoragāḥ ।
yakṣarākṣasanāgāśca piśācā manujāstathā ॥3॥
slp1: devadAnavaganDarvadEtyAsuramahoragAH । yakzarAkzasanAgASca piSAcA manujAstaTA ॥3॥

text: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāśca dvijasattama । ye cānye bhūtasaṅghānāṃ saṅghāstāṃścāpi nirmame ॥4॥
html:
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāśca dvijasattama ।
ye cānye bhūtasaṅghānāṃ saṅghāstāṃścāpi nirmame ॥4॥
slp1: brAhmaRAH kzatriyA vESyAH SUdrASca dvijasattama । ye cAnye BUtasaNGAnAM saNGAstAMScApi nirmame ॥4॥

text: brāhmaṇānāṃ sito varṇaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu lohitaḥ । vaiśyānāṃ pītako varṇaḥ śūdrāṇāmasitastathā ॥5॥
html:
brāhmaṇānāṃ sito varṇaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu lohitaḥ ।
vaiśyānāṃ pītako varṇaḥ śūdrāṇāmasitastathā ॥5॥
slp1: brAhmaRAnAM sito varRaH kzatriyARAM tu lohitaH । vESyAnAM pItako varRaH SUdrARAmasitastaTA ॥5॥

text: cāturvarṇyasya varṇena yadi varṇo vibhajyate । sarveṣāṃ khalu varṇānāṃ dṛśyate varṇasaṅkaraḥ ॥6॥
html:
cāturvarṇyasya varṇena yadi varṇo vibhajyate ।
sarveṣāṃ khalu varṇānāṃ dṛśyate varṇasaṅkaraḥ ॥6॥
slp1: cAturvarRyasya varRena yadi varRo viBajyate । sarvezAM Kalu varRAnAM dfSyate varRasaNkaraH ॥6॥
author: bharadvāja uvāca ।

text: kāmaḥ krodho bhayaṃ lobhaḥ śokaścintā kṣudhā śramaḥ । sarveṣāṃ naḥ prabhavati kasmādvarṇo vibhajyate ॥7॥
html:
kāmaḥ krodho bhayaṃ lobhaḥ śokaścintā kṣudhā śramaḥ ।
sarveṣāṃ naḥ prabhavati kasmādvarṇo vibhajyate ॥7॥
slp1: kAmaH kroDo BayaM loBaH SokaScintA kzuDA SramaH । sarvezAM naH praBavati kasmAdvarRo viBajyate ॥7॥

text: svedamūtrapurīṣāṇi śleṣmā pittaṃ saśoṇitam । tanuḥ kṣarati sarveṣāṃ kasmādvarṇo vibhajyate ॥8॥
html:
svedamūtrapurīṣāṇi śleṣmā pittaṃ saśoṇitam ।
tanuḥ kṣarati sarveṣāṃ kasmādvarṇo vibhajyate ॥8॥
slp1: svedamUtrapurIzARi SlezmA pittaM saSoRitam । tanuH kzarati sarvezAM kasmAdvarRo viBajyate ॥8॥

text: jaṅgamānāmasaṅkhyeyāḥ sthāvarāṇāṃ ca jātayaḥ । teṣāṃ vividhavarṇānāṃ kuto varṇaviniścayaḥ ॥9॥
html:
jaṅgamānāmasaṅkhyeyāḥ sthāvarāṇāṃ ca jātayaḥ ।
teṣāṃ vividhavarṇānāṃ kuto varṇaviniścayaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: jaNgamAnAmasaNKyeyAH sTAvarARAM ca jAtayaH । tezAM viviDavarRAnAM kuto varRaviniScayaH ॥9॥

text: na viśeṣo'sti varṇānāṃ sarvaṃ brāhmamidaṃ jagat । brahmaṇā pūrvasṛṣṭaṃ hi karmabhirvarṇatāṃ gatam ॥10॥
html:
na viśeṣo'sti varṇānāṃ sarvaṃ brāhmamidaṃ jagat ।
brahmaṇā pūrvasṛṣṭaṃ hi karmabhirvarṇatāṃ gatam ॥10॥
slp1: na viSezo'sti varRAnAM sarvaM brAhmamidaM jagat । brahmaRA pUrvasfzwaM hi karmaBirvarRatAM gatam ॥10॥
author: bhṛguruvāca ।

text: kāmabhogapriyāstīkṣṇāḥ krodhanāḥ priyasāhasāḥ । tyaktasvadharmā raktāṅgāste dvijāḥ kṣatratāṃ gatāḥ ॥11॥
html:
kāmabhogapriyāstīkṣṇāḥ krodhanāḥ priyasāhasāḥ ।
tyaktasvadharmā raktāṅgāste dvijāḥ kṣatratāṃ gatāḥ ॥11॥
slp1: kAmaBogapriyAstIkzRAH kroDanAH priyasAhasAH । tyaktasvaDarmA raktANgAste dvijAH kzatratAM gatAH ॥11॥

text: goṣu vṛttiṃ samādhāya pītāḥ kṛṣyupajīvinaḥ । svadharmaṃ nānutiṣṭhanti te dvijā vaiśyatāṃ gatāḥ ॥12॥
html:
goṣu vṛttiṃ samādhāya pītāḥ kṛṣyupajīvinaḥ ।
svadharmaṃ nānutiṣṭhanti te dvijā vaiśyatāṃ gatāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: gozu vfttiM samADAya pItAH kfzyupajIvinaH । svaDarmaM nAnutizWanti te dvijA vESyatAM gatAH ॥12॥

text: hiṃsānṛtapriyā lubdhāḥ sarvakarmopajīvinaḥ । kṛṣṇāḥ śaucaparibhraṣṭāste dvijāḥ śūdratāṃ gatāḥ ॥13॥
html:
hiṃsānṛtapriyā lubdhāḥ sarvakarmopajīvinaḥ ।
kṛṣṇāḥ śaucaparibhraṣṭāste dvijāḥ śūdratāṃ gatāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: hiMsAnftapriyA lubDAH sarvakarmopajIvinaH । kfzRAH SOcapariBrazwAste dvijAH SUdratAM gatAH ॥13॥

text: ityetaiḥ karmabhirvyastā dvijā varṇāntaraṃ gatāḥ । dharmo yajñakriyā caiṣāṃ nityaṃ na pratiṣidhyate ॥14॥
html:
ityetaiḥ karmabhirvyastā dvijā varṇāntaraṃ gatāḥ ।
dharmo yajñakriyā caiṣāṃ nityaṃ na pratiṣidhyate ॥14॥
slp1: ityetEH karmaBirvyastA dvijA varRAntaraM gatAH । Darmo yajYakriyA cEzAM nityaM na pratiziDyate ॥14॥

text: varṇāścatvāra ete hi yeṣāṃ brāhmī sarasvatī । vihitā brahmaṇā pūrvaṃ lobhāttvajñānatāṃ gatāḥ ॥15॥
html:
varṇāścatvāra ete hi yeṣāṃ brāhmī sarasvatī ।
vihitā brahmaṇā pūrvaṃ lobhāttvajñānatāṃ gatāḥ ॥15॥
slp1: varRAScatvAra ete hi yezAM brAhmI sarasvatI । vihitA brahmaRA pUrvaM loBAttvajYAnatAM gatAH ॥15॥

text: brāhmaṇā dharmatantrasthāstapasteṣāṃ na naśyati । brahma dhārayatāṃ nityaṃ vratāni niyamāṃstathā ॥16॥
html:
brāhmaṇā dharmatantrasthāstapasteṣāṃ na naśyati ।
brahma dhārayatāṃ nityaṃ vratāni niyamāṃstathā ॥16॥
slp1: brAhmaRA DarmatantrasTAstapastezAM na naSyati । brahma DArayatAM nityaM vratAni niyamAMstaTA ॥16॥

text: brahma caitatpurā sṛṣṭaṃ ye na jānantyatadvidaḥ । teṣāṃ bahuvidhāstvanyāstatra tatra hi jātayaḥ ॥17॥
html:
brahma caitatpurā sṛṣṭaṃ ye na jānantyatadvidaḥ ।
teṣāṃ bahuvidhāstvanyāstatra tatra hi jātayaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: brahma cEtatpurA sfzwaM ye na jAnantyatadvidaH । tezAM bahuviDAstvanyAstatra tatra hi jAtayaH ॥17॥

text: piśācā rākṣasāḥ pretā bahudhā mlecchajātayaḥ । pranaṣṭajñānavijñānāḥ svacchandācāraceṣṭitāḥ ॥18॥
html:
piśācā rākṣasāḥ pretā bahudhā mlecchajātayaḥ ।
pranaṣṭajñānavijñānāḥ svacchandācāraceṣṭitāḥ ॥18॥
slp1: piSAcA rAkzasAH pretA bahuDA mlecCajAtayaH । pranazwajYAnavijYAnAH svacCandAcAracezwitAH ॥18॥

text: prajā brāhmaṇasaṃskārāḥ svadharmakṛtaniścayāḥ । ṛṣibhiḥ svena tapasā sṛjyante cāpare paraiḥ ॥19॥
html:
prajā brāhmaṇasaṃskārāḥ svadharmakṛtaniścayāḥ ।
ṛṣibhiḥ svena tapasā sṛjyante cāpare paraiḥ ॥19॥
slp1: prajA brAhmaRasaMskArAH svaDarmakftaniScayAH । fziBiH svena tapasA sfjyante cApare parEH ॥19॥

text: ādidevasamudbhūtā brahmamūlākṣayāvyayā । sā sṛṣṭirmānasī nāma dharmatantraparāyaṇā] ॥20॥
html:
ādidevasamudbhūtā brahmamūlākṣayāvyayā ।
sā sṛṣṭirmānasī nāma dharmatantraparāyaṇā] ॥20॥
slp1: AdidevasamudBUtA brahmamUlAkzayAvyayA । sA sfzwirmAnasI nAma DarmatantraparAyaRA] ॥20॥

text: brāhmaṇaḥ kena bhavati kṣatriyo vā dvijottama । vaiśyaḥ śūdraśca viprarṣe tadbrūhi vadatāṃ vara ॥1॥
html:
brāhmaṇaḥ kena bhavati kṣatriyo vā dvijottama ।
vaiśyaḥ śūdraśca viprarṣe tadbrūhi vadatāṃ vara ॥1॥
slp1: brAhmaRaH kena Bavati kzatriyo vA dvijottama । vESyaH SUdraSca viprarze tadbrUhi vadatAM vara ॥1॥
author: bharadvāja uvāca ।

text: jātakarmādibhiryastu saṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛtaḥ śuciḥ । vedādhyayanasampannaḥ ṣaṭsu karmasvavasthitaḥ ॥2॥
html:
jātakarmādibhiryastu saṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛtaḥ śuciḥ ।
vedādhyayanasampannaḥ ṣaṭsu karmasvavasthitaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: jAtakarmAdiBiryastu saMskArEH saMskftaH SuciH । vedADyayanasampannaH zawsu karmasvavasTitaH ॥2॥
author: bhṛguruvāca ।

text: śaucācārasthitaḥ samyagvighasāśī gurupriyaḥ । nityavratī satyaparaḥ sa vai brāhmaṇa ucyate ॥3॥
html:
śaucācārasthitaḥ samyagvighasāśī gurupriyaḥ ।
nityavratī satyaparaḥ sa vai brāhmaṇa ucyate ॥3॥
slp1: SOcAcArasTitaH samyagviGasASI gurupriyaH । nityavratI satyaparaH sa vE brAhmaRa ucyate ॥3॥

text: satyaṃ dānaṃ damo'droha ānṛśaṃsyaṃ kṣamā ghṛṇā । tapaśca dṛśyate yatra sa brāhmaṇa iti smṛtaḥ ॥4॥
html:
satyaṃ dānaṃ damo'droha ānṛśaṃsyaṃ kṣamā ghṛṇā ।
tapaśca dṛśyate yatra sa brāhmaṇa iti smṛtaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: satyaM dAnaM damo'droha AnfSaMsyaM kzamA GfRA । tapaSca dfSyate yatra sa brAhmaRa iti smftaH ॥4॥

text: kṣatrajaṃ sevate karma vedādhyayanasammataḥ । dānādānaratiryaśca sa vai kṣatriya ucyate ॥5॥
html:
kṣatrajaṃ sevate karma vedādhyayanasammataḥ ।
dānādānaratiryaśca sa vai kṣatriya ucyate ॥5॥
slp1: kzatrajaM sevate karma vedADyayanasammataH । dAnAdAnaratiryaSca sa vE kzatriya ucyate ॥5॥

text: kṛṣigorakṣyavāṇijyaṃ yo viśatyaniśaṃ śuciḥ । vedādhyayanasampannaḥ sa vaiśya iti sañjñitaḥ ॥6॥
html:
kṛṣigorakṣyavāṇijyaṃ yo viśatyaniśaṃ śuciḥ ।
vedādhyayanasampannaḥ sa vaiśya iti sañjñitaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: kfzigorakzyavARijyaM yo viSatyaniSaM SuciH । vedADyayanasampannaH sa vESya iti saYjYitaH ॥6॥

text: sarvabhakṣaratirnityaṃ sarvakarmakaro'śuciḥ । tyaktavedastvanācāraḥ sa vai śūdra iti smṛtaḥ ॥7॥
html:
sarvabhakṣaratirnityaṃ sarvakarmakaro'śuciḥ ।
tyaktavedastvanācāraḥ sa vai śūdra iti smṛtaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: sarvaBakzaratirnityaM sarvakarmakaro'SuciH । tyaktavedastvanAcAraH sa vE SUdra iti smftaH ॥7॥

text: śūdre caitadbhavellakṣyaṃ dvije caitanna vidyate । na vai śūdro bhavecchūdro brāhmaṇo na ca brāhmaṇaḥ ॥8॥
html:
śūdre caitadbhavellakṣyaṃ dvije caitanna vidyate ।
na vai śūdro bhavecchūdro brāhmaṇo na ca brāhmaṇaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: SUdre cEtadBavellakzyaM dvije cEtanna vidyate । na vE SUdro BavecCUdro brAhmaRo na ca brAhmaRaH ॥8॥

text: sarvopāyaistu lobhasya krodhasya ca vinigrahaḥ । etatpavitraṃ jñātavyaṃ tathā caivātmasaṃyamaḥ ॥9॥
html:
sarvopāyaistu lobhasya krodhasya ca vinigrahaḥ ।
etatpavitraṃ jñātavyaṃ tathā caivātmasaṃyamaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: sarvopAyEstu loBasya kroDasya ca vinigrahaH । etatpavitraM jYAtavyaM taTA cEvAtmasaMyamaH ॥9॥

text: nityaṃ krodhāttapo rakṣecchriyaṃ rakṣeta matsarāt । vidyāṃ mānāvamānābhyāmātmānaṃ tu pramādataḥ ॥10॥
html:
nityaṃ krodhāttapo rakṣecchriyaṃ rakṣeta matsarāt ।
vidyāṃ mānāvamānābhyāmātmānaṃ tu pramādataḥ ॥10॥
slp1: nityaM kroDAttapo rakzecCriyaM rakzeta matsarAt । vidyAM mAnAvamAnAByAmAtmAnaM tu pramAdataH ॥10॥

text: yasya sarve samārambhā nirāśīrbandhanāstviha । tyāge yasya hutaṃ sarvaṃ sa tyāgī sa ca buddhimān ॥11॥
html:
yasya sarve samārambhā nirāśīrbandhanāstviha ।
tyāge yasya hutaṃ sarvaṃ sa tyāgī sa ca buddhimān ॥11॥
slp1: yasya sarve samAramBA nirASIrbanDanAstviha । tyAge yasya hutaM sarvaM sa tyAgI sa ca budDimAn ॥11॥

text: ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ maitrāyaṇagataścaret । avisrambhe na gantavyaṃ visrambhe dhārayenmanaḥ ॥12॥
html:
ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ maitrāyaṇagataścaret ।
avisrambhe na gantavyaṃ visrambhe dhārayenmanaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: ahiMsraH sarvaBUtAnAM mEtrAyaRagataScaret । avisramBe na gantavyaM visramBe DArayenmanaH ॥12॥

text: parigrahānparityajya bhavedbuddhyā jitendriyaḥ । aśokaṃ sthānamātiṣṭhediha cāmutra cābhayam ॥13॥
html:
parigrahānparityajya bhavedbuddhyā jitendriyaḥ ।
aśokaṃ sthānamātiṣṭhediha cāmutra cābhayam ॥13॥
slp1: parigrahAnparityajya BavedbudDyA jitendriyaH । aSokaM sTAnamAtizWediha cAmutra cABayam ॥13॥

text: taponityena dāntena muninā saṃyatātmanā । ajitaṃ jetukāmena bhāvyaṃ saṅgeṣvasaṅginā ॥14॥
html:
taponityena dāntena muninā saṃyatātmanā ।
ajitaṃ jetukāmena bhāvyaṃ saṅgeṣvasaṅginā ॥14॥
slp1: taponityena dAntena muninA saMyatAtmanA । ajitaM jetukAmena BAvyaM saNgezvasaNginA ॥14॥

text: indriyairgṛhyate yadyattattadvyaktamiti sthitiḥ । avyaktamiti vijñeyaṃ liṅgagrāhyamatīndriyam ॥15॥
html:
indriyairgṛhyate yadyattattadvyaktamiti sthitiḥ ।
avyaktamiti vijñeyaṃ liṅgagrāhyamatīndriyam ॥15॥
slp1: indriyErgfhyate yadyattattadvyaktamiti sTitiH । avyaktamiti vijYeyaM liNgagrAhyamatIndriyam ॥15॥

text: manaḥ prāṇe nigṛhṇīyātprāṇaṃ brahmaṇi dhārayet । nirvāṇādeva nirvāṇo na ca kiñcidvicintayet । sukhaṃ vai brāhmaṇo brahma sa vai tenādhigacchati ॥16॥
html:
manaḥ prāṇe nigṛhṇīyātprāṇaṃ brahmaṇi dhārayet ।
nirvāṇādeva nirvāṇo na ca kiñcidvicintayet ।
sukhaṃ vai brāhmaṇo brahma sa vai tenādhigacchati ॥16॥
slp1: manaH prARe nigfhRIyAtprARaM brahmaRi DArayet । nirvARAdeva nirvARo na ca kiYcidvicintayet । suKaM vE brAhmaRo brahma sa vE tenADigacCati ॥16॥

text: śaucena satataṃ yuktastathācārasamanvitaḥ । sānukrośaśca bhūteṣu taddvijātiṣu lakṣaṇam] ॥17॥
html:
śaucena satataṃ yuktastathācārasamanvitaḥ ।
sānukrośaśca bhūteṣu taddvijātiṣu lakṣaṇam] ॥17॥
slp1: SOcena satataM yuktastaTAcArasamanvitaH । sAnukroSaSca BUtezu taddvijAtizu lakzaRam] ॥17॥

text: satyaṃ brahma tapaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ sṛjati ca prajāḥ । satyena dhāryate lokaḥ svargaṃ satyena gacchati ॥1॥
html:
satyaṃ brahma tapaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ sṛjati ca prajāḥ ।
satyena dhāryate lokaḥ svargaṃ satyena gacchati ॥1॥
slp1: satyaM brahma tapaH satyaM satyaM sfjati ca prajAH । satyena DAryate lokaH svargaM satyena gacCati ॥1॥
author: bhṛguruvāca ।

text: anṛtaṃ tamaso rūpaṃ tamasā nīyate hyadhaḥ । tamograstā na paśyanti prakāśaṃ tamasāvṛtam ॥2॥
html:
anṛtaṃ tamaso rūpaṃ tamasā nīyate hyadhaḥ ।
tamograstā na paśyanti prakāśaṃ tamasāvṛtam ॥2॥
slp1: anftaM tamaso rUpaM tamasA nIyate hyaDaH । tamograstA na paSyanti prakASaM tamasAvftam ॥2॥

text: svargaḥ prakāśa ityāhurnarakaṃ tama eva ca । satyānṛtāttadubhayaṃ prāpyate jagatīcaraiḥ ॥3॥
html:
svargaḥ prakāśa ityāhurnarakaṃ tama eva ca ।
satyānṛtāttadubhayaṃ prāpyate jagatīcaraiḥ ॥3॥
slp1: svargaH prakASa ityAhurnarakaM tama eva ca । satyAnftAttaduBayaM prApyate jagatIcarEH ॥3॥

text: tatra tvevaṃvidhā vṛttirloke satyānṛtā bhavet । dharmādharmau prakāśaśca tamo duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ tathā ॥4॥
html:
tatra tvevaṃvidhā vṛttirloke satyānṛtā bhavet ।
dharmādharmau prakāśaśca tamo duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ tathā ॥4॥
slp1: tatra tvevaMviDA vfttirloke satyAnftA Bavet । DarmADarmO prakASaSca tamo duHKaM suKaM taTA ॥4॥

text: tatra yatsatyaṃ sa dharmo yo dharmaḥ sa prakāśo yaḥ prakāśastatsukhamiti ॥005A॥ tatra yadanṛtaṃ so'dharmo yo'dharmastattamo yattamastadduḥkhamiti ॥005B॥
html:
tatra yatsatyaṃ sa dharmo yo dharmaḥ sa prakāśo yaḥ prakāśastatsukhamiti ॥005A॥
tatra yadanṛtaṃ so'dharmo yo'dharmastattamo yattamastadduḥkhamiti ॥005B॥
slp1: tatra yatsatyaM sa Darmo yo DarmaH sa prakASo yaH prakASastatsuKamiti ॥005a॥ tatra yadanftaM so'Darmo yo'Darmastattamo yattamastadduHKamiti ॥005b॥

text: atrocyate ॥006A॥ śārīrairmānasairduḥkhaiḥ sukhaiścāpyasukhodayaiḥ । lokasṛṣṭiṃ prapaśyanto na muhyanti vicakṣaṇāḥ ॥6॥
html:
atrocyate ॥006A॥
śārīrairmānasairduḥkhaiḥ sukhaiścāpyasukhodayaiḥ ।
lokasṛṣṭiṃ prapaśyanto na muhyanti vicakṣaṇāḥ ॥6॥
slp1: atrocyate ॥006a॥ SArIrErmAnasErduHKEH suKEScApyasuKodayEH । lokasfzwiM prapaSyanto na muhyanti vicakzaRAH ॥6॥

text: tatra duḥkhavimokṣārthaṃ prayateta vicakṣaṇaḥ । sukhaṃ hyanityaṃ bhūtānāmiha loke paratra ca ॥7॥
html:
tatra duḥkhavimokṣārthaṃ prayateta vicakṣaṇaḥ ।
sukhaṃ hyanityaṃ bhūtānāmiha loke paratra ca ॥7॥
slp1: tatra duHKavimokzArTaM prayateta vicakzaRaH । suKaM hyanityaM BUtAnAmiha loke paratra ca ॥7॥

text: rāhugrastasya somasya yathā jyotsnā na bhāsate । tathā tamobhibhūtānāṃ bhūtānāṃ bhraśyate sukham ॥8॥
html:
rāhugrastasya somasya yathā jyotsnā na bhāsate ।
tathā tamobhibhūtānāṃ bhūtānāṃ bhraśyate sukham ॥8॥
slp1: rAhugrastasya somasya yaTA jyotsnA na BAsate । taTA tamoBiBUtAnAM BUtAnAM BraSyate suKam ॥8॥

text: tatkhalu dvividhaṃ sukhamucyate śārīraṃ mānasaṃ ca ॥009A॥ iha khalvamuṣmiṃśca loke sarvārambhapravṛttayaḥ sukhārthā abhidhīyante ॥009B॥ na hyatastrivargaphalaṃ viśiṣṭataramasti ॥009C॥ sa eṣa kāmyo guṇaviśeṣo dharmārthayorārambhastaddheturasyotpattiḥ sukhaprayojanā ॥009D॥
html:
tatkhalu dvividhaṃ sukhamucyate śārīraṃ mānasaṃ ca ॥009A॥
iha khalvamuṣmiṃśca loke sarvārambhapravṛttayaḥ sukhārthā abhidhīyante ॥009B॥
na hyatastrivargaphalaṃ viśiṣṭataramasti ॥009C॥
sa eṣa kāmyo guṇaviśeṣo dharmārthayorārambhastaddheturasyotpattiḥ sukhaprayojanā ॥009D॥
slp1: tatKalu dviviDaM suKamucyate SArIraM mAnasaM ca ॥009a॥ iha KalvamuzmiMSca loke sarvAramBapravfttayaH suKArTA aBiDIyante ॥009b॥ na hyatastrivargaPalaM viSizwataramasti ॥009c॥ sa eza kAmyo guRaviSezo DarmArTayorAramBastadDeturasyotpattiH suKaprayojanA ॥009d॥

text: bharadvāja uvāca ॥10॥ yadetadbhavatābhihitaṃ sukhānāṃ paramāḥ striya iti tanna gṛhṇīmaḥ ॥010A॥ na hyeṣāmṛṣīṇāṃ mahati sthitānāmaprāpya eṣa guṇaviśeṣo na cainamabhilaṣanti ॥010B॥ śrūyate ca bhagavāṃstrilokakṛdbrahmā prabhurekākī tiṣṭhati ॥010C॥ brahmacārī na kāmasukheṣvātmānamavadadhāti ॥010D॥ api ca bhagavānviśveśvara umāpatiḥ kāmamabhivartamānamanaṅgatvena śamamanayat ॥010E॥ tasmādbrūmo na mahātmabhirayaṃ pratigṛhīto na tveṣa tāvadviśiṣṭo guṇa iti naitadbhagavataḥ pratyemi ॥010F॥ bhagavatā tūktaṃ sukhānāṃ paramāḥ striya iti ॥010G॥ lokapravādo'pi ca bhavati dvividhaḥ phalodayaḥ sukṛtātsukhamavāpyate duṣkṛtādduḥkhamiti ॥010H॥ atrocyatām ॥010I॥
html:
bharadvāja uvāca ॥10॥
yadetadbhavatābhihitaṃ sukhānāṃ paramāḥ striya iti tanna gṛhṇīmaḥ ॥010A॥
na hyeṣāmṛṣīṇāṃ mahati sthitānāmaprāpya eṣa guṇaviśeṣo na cainamabhilaṣanti ॥010B॥
śrūyate ca bhagavāṃstrilokakṛdbrahmā prabhurekākī tiṣṭhati ॥010C॥
brahmacārī na kāmasukheṣvātmānamavadadhāti ॥010D॥
api ca bhagavānviśveśvara umāpatiḥ kāmamabhivartamānamanaṅgatvena śamamanayat ॥010E॥
tasmādbrūmo na mahātmabhirayaṃ pratigṛhīto na tveṣa tāvadviśiṣṭo guṇa iti naitadbhagavataḥ pratyemi ॥010F॥
bhagavatā tūktaṃ sukhānāṃ paramāḥ striya iti ॥010G॥
lokapravādo'pi ca bhavati dvividhaḥ phalodayaḥ sukṛtātsukhamavāpyate duṣkṛtādduḥkhamiti ॥010H॥
atrocyatām ॥010I॥
slp1: BaradvAja uvAca ॥10॥ yadetadBavatABihitaM suKAnAM paramAH striya iti tanna gfhRImaH ॥010a॥ na hyezAmfzIRAM mahati sTitAnAmaprApya eza guRaviSezo na cEnamaBilazanti ॥010b॥ SrUyate ca BagavAMstrilokakfdbrahmA praBurekAkI tizWati ॥010c॥ brahmacArI na kAmasuKezvAtmAnamavadaDAti ॥010d॥ api ca BagavAnviSveSvara umApatiH kAmamaBivartamAnamanaNgatvena Samamanayat ॥010e॥ tasmAdbrUmo na mahAtmaBirayaM pratigfhIto na tveza tAvadviSizwo guRa iti nEtadBagavataH pratyemi ॥010P0॥ BagavatA tUktaM suKAnAM paramAH striya iti ॥010g॥ lokapravAdo'pi ca Bavati dviviDaH PalodayaH sukftAtsuKamavApyate duzkftAdduHKamiti ॥010h॥ atrocyatAm ॥010i॥

text: bhṛguruvāca ॥11॥ anṛtātkhalu tamaḥ prādurbhūtaṃ tamograstā adharmamevānuvartante na dharmam ॥011A॥ krodhalobhamohamānānṛtādibhiravacchannā na khalvasmiṁlloke na cāmutra sukhamāpnuvanti ॥011B॥ vividhavyādhigaṇopatāpairavakīryante ॥011C॥ vadhabandharogaparikleśādibhiśca kṣutpipāsāśramakṛtairupatāpairupatapyante ॥011D॥ caṇḍavātātyuṣṇātiśītakṛtaiśca pratibhayaiḥ śārīrairduḥkhairupatapyante ॥011E॥ bandhudhanavināśaviprayogakṛtaiśca mānasaiḥ śokairabhibhūyante jarāmṛtyukṛtaiścānyairiti ॥011F॥
html:
bhṛguruvāca ॥11॥
anṛtātkhalu tamaḥ prādurbhūtaṃ tamograstā adharmamevānuvartante na dharmam ॥011A॥
krodhalobhamohamānānṛtādibhiravacchannā na khalvasmiṁlloke na cāmutra sukhamāpnuvanti ॥011B॥
vividhavyādhigaṇopatāpairavakīryante ॥011C॥
vadhabandharogaparikleśādibhiśca kṣutpipāsāśramakṛtairupatāpairupatapyante ॥011D॥
caṇḍavātātyuṣṇātiśītakṛtaiśca pratibhayaiḥ śārīrairduḥkhairupatapyante ॥011E॥
bandhudhanavināśaviprayogakṛtaiśca mānasaiḥ śokairabhibhūyante jarāmṛtyukṛtaiścānyairiti ॥011F॥
slp1: BfguruvAca ॥11॥ anftAtKalu tamaH prAdurBUtaM tamograstA aDarmamevAnuvartante na Darmam ॥011a॥ kroDaloBamohamAnAnftAdiBiravacCannA na Kalvasmiṁlloke na cAmutra suKamApnuvanti ॥011b॥ viviDavyADigaRopatApEravakIryante ॥011c॥ vaDabanDarogaparikleSAdiBiSca kzutpipAsASramakftErupatApErupatapyante ॥011d॥ caRqavAtAtyuzRAtiSItakftESca pratiBayEH SArIrErduHKErupatapyante ॥011e॥ banDuDanavinASaviprayogakftESca mAnasEH SokEraBiBUyante jarAmftyukftEScAnyEriti ॥011P0॥

text: yastvetaiḥ śārīrairmānasairduḥkhairna spṛśyate sa sukhaṃ veda ॥012A॥ na caite doṣāḥ svarge prādurbhavanti ॥012B॥ tatra bhavati khalu ॥012C॥
html:
yastvetaiḥ śārīrairmānasairduḥkhairna spṛśyate sa sukhaṃ veda ॥012A॥
na caite doṣāḥ svarge prādurbhavanti ॥012B॥
tatra bhavati khalu ॥012C॥
slp1: yastvetEH SArIrErmAnasErduHKErna spfSyate sa suKaM veda ॥012a॥ na cEte dozAH svarge prAdurBavanti ॥012b॥ tatra Bavati Kalu ॥012c॥

text: susukhaḥ pavanaḥ svarge gandhaśca surabhistathā । kṣutpipāsāśramo nāsti na jarā na ca pāpakam ॥13॥
html:
susukhaḥ pavanaḥ svarge gandhaśca surabhistathā ।
kṣutpipāsāśramo nāsti na jarā na ca pāpakam ॥13॥
slp1: susuKaH pavanaH svarge ganDaSca suraBistaTA । kzutpipAsASramo nAsti na jarA na ca pApakam ॥13॥

text: nityameva sukhaṃ svarge sukhaṃ duḥkhamihobhayam । narake duḥkhamevāhuḥ samaṃ tu paramaṃ padam ॥14॥
html:
nityameva sukhaṃ svarge sukhaṃ duḥkhamihobhayam ।
narake duḥkhamevāhuḥ samaṃ tu paramaṃ padam ॥14॥
slp1: nityameva suKaM svarge suKaM duHKamihoBayam । narake duHKamevAhuH samaM tu paramaM padam ॥14॥

text: pṛthivī sarvabhūtānāṃ janitrī tadvidhāḥ striyaḥ । pumānprajāpatistatra śukraṃ tejomayaṃ viduḥ ॥15॥
html:
pṛthivī sarvabhūtānāṃ janitrī tadvidhāḥ striyaḥ ।
pumānprajāpatistatra śukraṃ tejomayaṃ viduḥ ॥15॥
slp1: pfTivI sarvaBUtAnAM janitrI tadviDAH striyaH । pumAnprajApatistatra SukraM tejomayaM viduH ॥15॥

text: ityetallokanirmāṇaṃ brahmaṇā vihitaṃ purā । prajā viparivartante svaiḥ svaiḥ karmabhirāvṛtāḥ] ॥16॥
html:
ityetallokanirmāṇaṃ brahmaṇā vihitaṃ purā ।
prajā viparivartante svaiḥ svaiḥ karmabhirāvṛtāḥ] ॥16॥
slp1: ityetallokanirmARaM brahmaRA vihitaM purA । prajA viparivartante svEH svEH karmaBirAvftAH] ॥16॥

text: dānasya kiṃ phalaṃ prāhurdharmasya caritasya ca । tapasaśca sutaptasya svādhyāyasya hutasya ca ॥1॥
html:
dānasya kiṃ phalaṃ prāhurdharmasya caritasya ca ।
tapasaśca sutaptasya svādhyāyasya hutasya ca ॥1॥
slp1: dAnasya kiM PalaM prAhurDarmasya caritasya ca । tapasaSca sutaptasya svADyAyasya hutasya ca ॥1॥
author: bharadvāja uvāca ।

text: hutena śāmyate pāpaṃ svādhyāye śāntiruttamā । dānena bhoga ityāhustapasā sarvamāpnuyāt ॥2॥
html:
hutena śāmyate pāpaṃ svādhyāye śāntiruttamā ।
dānena bhoga ityāhustapasā sarvamāpnuyāt ॥2॥
slp1: hutena SAmyate pApaM svADyAye SAntiruttamA । dAnena Boga ityAhustapasA sarvamApnuyAt ॥2॥
author: bhṛguruvāca ।

text: dānaṃ tu dvividhaṃ prāhuḥ paratrārthamihaiva ca । sadbhyo yaddīyate kiñcittatparatropatiṣṭhati ॥3॥
html:
dānaṃ tu dvividhaṃ prāhuḥ paratrārthamihaiva ca ।
sadbhyo yaddīyate kiñcittatparatropatiṣṭhati ॥3॥
slp1: dAnaM tu dviviDaM prAhuH paratrArTamihEva ca । sadByo yaddIyate kiYcittatparatropatizWati ॥3॥

text: asatsu dīyate yattu taddānamiha bhujyate । yādṛśaṃ dīyate dānaṃ tādṛśaṃ phalamāpyate ॥4॥
html:
asatsu dīyate yattu taddānamiha bhujyate ।
yādṛśaṃ dīyate dānaṃ tādṛśaṃ phalamāpyate ॥4॥
slp1: asatsu dIyate yattu taddAnamiha Bujyate । yAdfSaM dIyate dAnaM tAdfSaM PalamApyate ॥4॥

text: kiṃ kasya dharmacaraṇaṃ kiṃ vā dharmasya lakṣaṇam । dharmaḥ katividho vāpi tadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥5॥
html:
kiṃ kasya dharmacaraṇaṃ kiṃ vā dharmasya lakṣaṇam ।
dharmaḥ katividho vāpi tadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥5॥
slp1: kiM kasya DarmacaraRaM kiM vA Darmasya lakzaRam । DarmaH kativiDo vApi tadBavAnvaktumarhati ॥5॥
author: bharadvāja uvāca ।

text: svadharmacaraṇe yuktā ye bhavanti manīṣiṇaḥ । teṣāṃ dharmaphalāvāptiryo'nyathā sa vimuhyati ॥6॥
html:
svadharmacaraṇe yuktā ye bhavanti manīṣiṇaḥ ।
teṣāṃ dharmaphalāvāptiryo'nyathā sa vimuhyati ॥6॥
slp1: svaDarmacaraRe yuktA ye Bavanti manIziRaH । tezAM DarmaPalAvAptiryo'nyaTA sa vimuhyati ॥6॥
author: bhṛguruvāca ।

text: yadetaccāturāśramyaṃ brahmarṣivihitaṃ purā । teṣāṃ sve sve ya ācārāstānme vaktumihārhasi ॥7॥
html:
yadetaccāturāśramyaṃ brahmarṣivihitaṃ purā ।
teṣāṃ sve sve ya ācārāstānme vaktumihārhasi ॥7॥
slp1: yadetaccAturASramyaM brahmarzivihitaM purA । tezAM sve sve ya AcArAstAnme vaktumihArhasi ॥7॥
author: bharadvāja uvāca ।

text: bhṛguruvāca ॥8॥ pūrvameva bhagavatā lokahitamanutiṣṭhatā dharmasaṃrakṣaṇārthamāśramāścatvāro'bhinirdiṣṭāḥ ॥008A॥ tatra gurukulavāsameva tāvatprathamamāśramamudāharanti ॥008B॥ samyagatra śaucasaṃskāravinayaniyamapraṇīto vinītātmā ubhe sandhye bhāskarāgnidaivatānyupasthāya vihāya tandrālasye gurorabhivādanavedābhyāsaśravaṇapavitrīkṛtāntarātmā triṣavaṇamupaspṛśya brahmacaryāgniparicaraṇaguruśuśrūṣānityo bhaikṣādisarvaniveditāntarātmā guruvacananirdeśānuṣṭhānāpratikūlo guruprasādalabdhasvādhyāyatatparaḥ syāt ॥008C॥
html:
bhṛguruvāca ॥8॥
pūrvameva bhagavatā lokahitamanutiṣṭhatā dharmasaṃrakṣaṇārthamāśramāścatvāro'bhinirdiṣṭāḥ ॥008A॥
tatra gurukulavāsameva tāvatprathamamāśramamudāharanti ॥008B॥
samyagatra śaucasaṃskāravinayaniyamapraṇīto vinītātmā ubhe sandhye bhāskarāgnidaivatānyupasthāya vihāya tandrālasye gurorabhivādanavedābhyāsaśravaṇapavitrīkṛtāntarātmā triṣavaṇamupaspṛśya brahmacaryāgniparicaraṇaguruśuśrūṣānityo bhaikṣādisarvaniveditāntarātmā guruvacananirdeśānuṣṭhānāpratikūlo guruprasādalabdhasvādhyāyatatparaḥ syāt ॥008C॥
slp1: BfguruvAca ॥8॥ pUrvameva BagavatA lokahitamanutizWatA DarmasaMrakzaRArTamASramAScatvAro'BinirdizwAH ॥008a॥ tatra gurukulavAsameva tAvatpraTamamASramamudAharanti ॥008b॥ samyagatra SOcasaMskAravinayaniyamapraRIto vinItAtmA uBe sanDye BAskarAgnidEvatAnyupasTAya vihAya tandrAlasye guroraBivAdanavedAByAsaSravaRapavitrIkftAntarAtmA trizavaRamupaspfSya brahmacaryAgniparicaraRaguruSuSrUzAnityo BEkzAdisarvaniveditAntarAtmA guruvacananirdeSAnuzWAnApratikUlo guruprasAdalabDasvADyAyatatparaH syAt ॥008c॥

text: bhavati cātra ślokaḥ ॥009A॥ guruṃ yastu samārādhya dvijo vedamavāpnuyāt । tasya svargaphalāvāptiḥ sidhyate cāsya mānasam ॥9॥
html:
bhavati cātra ślokaḥ ॥009A॥
guruṃ yastu samārādhya dvijo vedamavāpnuyāt ।
tasya svargaphalāvāptiḥ sidhyate cāsya mānasam ॥9॥
slp1: Bavati cAtra SlokaH ॥009a॥ guruM yastu samArADya dvijo vedamavApnuyAt । tasya svargaPalAvAptiH siDyate cAsya mAnasam ॥9॥

text: gārhasthyaṃ khalu dvitīyamāśramaṃ vadanti ॥010A॥ tasya samudācāralakṣaṇaṃ sarvamanuvyākhyāsyāmaḥ ॥010B॥ samāvṛttānāṃ sadārāṇāṃ sahadharmacaryāphalārthināṃ gṛhāśramo vidhīyate ॥010C॥ dharmārthakāmāvāptirhyatra trivargasādhanamavekṣyāgarhitena karmaṇā dhanānyādāya svādhyāyaprakarṣopalabdhena brahmarṣinirmitena vā adrisāragatena vā havyaniyamābhyāsadaivataprasādopalabdhena vā dhanena gṛhastho gārhasthyaṃ pravartayet ॥010D॥ taddhi sarvāśramāṇāṃ mūlamudāharanti ॥010E॥ gurukulavāsinaḥ parivrājakā ye cānye saṅkalpitavrataniyamadharmānuṣṭhāyinasteṣāmapyata eva bhikṣābalisaṃvibhāgāḥ pravartante ॥010F॥
html:
gārhasthyaṃ khalu dvitīyamāśramaṃ vadanti ॥010A॥
tasya samudācāralakṣaṇaṃ sarvamanuvyākhyāsyāmaḥ ॥010B॥
samāvṛttānāṃ sadārāṇāṃ sahadharmacaryāphalārthināṃ gṛhāśramo vidhīyate ॥010C॥
dharmārthakāmāvāptirhyatra trivargasādhanamavekṣyāgarhitena karmaṇā dhanānyādāya svādhyāyaprakarṣopalabdhena brahmarṣinirmitena vā adrisāragatena vā havyaniyamābhyāsadaivataprasādopalabdhena vā dhanena gṛhastho gārhasthyaṃ pravartayet ॥010D॥
taddhi sarvāśramāṇāṃ mūlamudāharanti ॥010E॥
gurukulavāsinaḥ parivrājakā ye cānye saṅkalpitavrataniyamadharmānuṣṭhāyinasteṣāmapyata eva bhikṣābalisaṃvibhāgāḥ pravartante ॥010F॥
slp1: gArhasTyaM Kalu dvitIyamASramaM vadanti ॥010a॥ tasya samudAcAralakzaRaM sarvamanuvyAKyAsyAmaH ॥010b॥ samAvfttAnAM sadArARAM sahaDarmacaryAPalArTinAM gfhASramo viDIyate ॥010c॥ DarmArTakAmAvAptirhyatra trivargasADanamavekzyAgarhitena karmaRA DanAnyAdAya svADyAyaprakarzopalabDena brahmarzinirmitena vA adrisAragatena vA havyaniyamAByAsadEvataprasAdopalabDena vA Danena gfhasTo gArhasTyaM pravartayet ॥010d॥ tadDi sarvASramARAM mUlamudAharanti ॥010e॥ gurukulavAsinaH parivrAjakA ye cAnye saNkalpitavrataniyamaDarmAnuzWAyinastezAmapyata eva BikzAbalisaMviBAgAH pravartante ॥010P0॥

text: vānaprasthānāṃ dravyopaskāra iti prāyaśaḥ khalvete sādhavaḥ sādhupathyadarśanāḥ svādhyāyaprasaṅginastīrthābhigamanadeśadarśanārthaṃ pṛthivīṃ paryaṭanti ॥011A॥ teṣāṃ pratyutthānābhivādanānasūyāvākpradānasaumukhyaśaktyāsanaśayanābhyavahārasatkriyāśceti ॥011B॥
html:
vānaprasthānāṃ dravyopaskāra iti prāyaśaḥ khalvete sādhavaḥ sādhupathyadarśanāḥ svādhyāyaprasaṅginastīrthābhigamanadeśadarśanārthaṃ pṛthivīṃ paryaṭanti ॥011A॥
teṣāṃ pratyutthānābhivādanānasūyāvākpradānasaumukhyaśaktyāsanaśayanābhyavahārasatkriyāśceti ॥011B॥

text: bhṛguruvāca ॥1॥ vānaprasthāḥ khalu ṛṣidharmamanusarantaḥ puṇyāni tīrthāni nadīprasravaṇāni suvivikteṣvaraṇyeṣu mṛgamahiṣavarāhasṛmaragajākīrṇeṣu tapasyanto'nusañcaranti ॥001A॥ tyaktagrāmyavastrāhāropabhogā vanyauṣadhimūlaphalaparṇaparimitavicitraniyatāhārāḥ sthānāsanino bhūmipāṣāṇasikatāśarkarāvālukābhasmaśāyinaḥ kāśakuśacarmavalkalasaṃvṛtāṅgāḥ keśaśmaśrunakharomadhāriṇo niyatakālopasparśanā askannahomabalikālānuṣṭhāyinaḥ samitkuśakusumopahārahomārjanalabdhaviśrāmāḥ śītoṣṇapavananiṣṭaptavibhinnasarvatvaco vividhaniyamayogacaryāvihitadharmānuṣṭhānahṛtamāṃsaśoṇitāstvagasthibhūtā dhṛtiparāḥ sattvayogāccharīrāṇyudvahanti ॥001B॥
html:
bhṛguruvāca ॥1॥
vānaprasthāḥ khalu ṛṣidharmamanusarantaḥ puṇyāni tīrthāni nadīprasravaṇāni suvivikteṣvaraṇyeṣu mṛgamahiṣavarāhasṛmaragajākīrṇeṣu tapasyanto'nusañcaranti ॥001A॥

text: yastvetāṃ niyataścaryāṃ brahmarṣivihitāṃ caret । sa dahedagnivaddoṣāñjayellokāṃśca durjayān ॥2॥

text: parivrājakānāṃ punarācārastadyathā ॥003A॥ vimucyāgnidhanakalatraparibarhasaṅgānātmanaḥ snehapāśānavadhūya parivrajanti samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanāstrivargapravṛtteṣvārambheṣvasaktabuddhayo'rimitrodāsīneṣu tulyavṛttayaḥ sthāvarajarāyujāṇḍajasvedajodbhijjānāṃ bhūtānāṃ vāṅmanaḥkarmabhiranabhidrohiṇo'niketāḥ parvatapulinavṛkṣamūladevatāyatanānyanucaranto vāsārthamupeyurnagaraṃ grāmaṃ vā nagare pañcarātrikā grāmaikarātrikāḥ ॥003B॥ praviśya ca prāṇadhāraṇamātrārthaṃ dvijātīnāṃ bhavanānyasaṅkīrṇakarmaṇāmupatiṣṭheyuḥ pātrapatitāyācitabhaikṣāḥ kāmakrodhadarpamohalobhakārpaṇyadambhaparivādābhimānahiṃsānivṛttā iti ॥003C॥
html:
parivrājakānāṃ punarācārastadyathā ॥003A॥
vimucyāgnidhanakalatraparibarhasaṅgānātmanaḥ snehapāśānavadhūya parivrajanti samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanāstrivargapravṛtteṣvārambheṣvasaktabuddhayo'rimitrodāsīneṣu tulyavṛttayaḥ sthāvarajarāyujāṇḍajasvedajodbhijjānāṃ bhūtānāṃ vāṅmanaḥkarmabhiranabhidrohiṇo'niketāḥ parvatapulinavṛkṣamūladevatāyatanānyanucaranto vāsārthamupeyurnagaraṃ grāmaṃ vā nagare pañcarātrikā grāmaikarātrikāḥ ॥003B॥
praviśya ca prāṇadhāraṇamātrārthaṃ dvijātīnāṃ bhavanānyasaṅkīrṇakarmaṇāmupatiṣṭheyuḥ pātrapatitāyācitabhaikṣāḥ kāmakrodhadarpamohalobhakārpaṇyadambhaparivādābhimānahiṃsānivṛttā iti ॥003C॥
slp1: parivrAjakAnAM punarAcArastadyaTA ॥003a॥ vimucyAgniDanakalatraparibarhasaNgAnAtmanaH snehapASAnavaDUya parivrajanti samalozwASmakAYcanAstrivargapravfttezvAramBezvasaktabudDayo'rimitrodAsInezu tulyavfttayaH sTAvarajarAyujARqajasvedajodBijjAnAM BUtAnAM vANmanaHkarmaBiranaBidrohiRo'niketAH parvatapulinavfkzamUladevatAyatanAnyanucaranto vAsArTamupeyurnagaraM grAmaM vA nagare paYcarAtrikA grAmEkarAtrikAH ॥003b॥ praviSya ca prARaDAraRamAtrArTaM dvijAtInAM BavanAnyasaNkIrRakarmaRAmupatizWeyuH pAtrapatitAyAcitaBEkzAH kAmakroDadarpamohaloBakArpaRyadamBaparivAdABimAnahiMsAnivfttA iti ॥003c॥

text: bhavati cātra ślokaḥ ॥004A॥ abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo dattvā carati yo muniḥ । na tasya sarvabhūtebhyo bhayamutpadyate kvacit ॥4॥
html:
bhavati cātra ślokaḥ ॥004A॥
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo dattvā carati yo muniḥ ।
na tasya sarvabhūtebhyo bhayamutpadyate kvacit ॥4॥

text: kṛtvāgnihotraṃ svaśarīrasaṃsthaṃ śārīramagniṃ svamukhe juhoti । yo bhaikṣacaryopagatairhavirbhiścitāgnināṃ sa vyatiyāti lokān ॥5॥
html:
kṛtvāgnihotraṃ svaśarīrasaṃsthaṃ śārīramagniṃ svamukhe juhoti ।
yo bhaikṣacaryopagatairhavirbhiścitāgnināṃ sa vyatiyāti lokān ॥5॥
slp1: kftvAgnihotraM svaSarIrasaMsTaM SArIramagniM svamuKe juhoti । yo BEkzacaryopagatErhavirBiScitAgninAM sa vyatiyAti lokAn ॥5॥

text: mokṣāśramaṃ yaḥ kurute yathoktaṃ śuciḥ susaṅkalpitabuddhiyuktaḥ । anindhanaṃ jyotiriva praśāntaṃ sa brahmalokaṃ śrayate dvijātiḥ ॥6॥
html:
mokṣāśramaṃ yaḥ kurute yathoktaṃ śuciḥ susaṅkalpitabuddhiyuktaḥ ।
anindhanaṃ jyotiriva praśāntaṃ sa brahmalokaṃ śrayate dvijātiḥ ॥6॥
slp1: mokzASramaM yaH kurute yaToktaM SuciH susaNkalpitabudDiyuktaH । aninDanaM jyotiriva praSAntaM sa brahmalokaM Srayate dvijAtiH ॥6॥

text: asmāllokātparo lokaḥ śrūyate nopalabhyate । tamahaṃ jñātumicchāmi tadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥7॥
html:
asmāllokātparo lokaḥ śrūyate nopalabhyate ।
tamahaṃ jñātumicchāmi tadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥7॥
slp1: asmAllokAtparo lokaH SrUyate nopalaByate । tamahaM jYAtumicCAmi tadBavAnvaktumarhati ॥7॥

text: uttare himavatpārśve puṇye sarvaguṇānvite । puṇyaḥ kṣemyaśca kāmyaśca sa varo loka ucyate ॥8॥
html:
uttare himavatpārśve puṇye sarvaguṇānvite ।
puṇyaḥ kṣemyaśca kāmyaśca sa varo loka ucyate ॥8॥
slp1: uttare himavatpArSve puRye sarvaguRAnvite । puRyaH kzemyaSca kAmyaSca sa varo loka ucyate ॥8॥

text: tatra hyapāpakarmāṇaḥ śucayo'tyantanirmalāḥ । lobhamohaparityaktā mānavā nirupadravāḥ ॥9॥

tatra hyapāpakarmāṇaḥ śucayo'tyantanirmalāḥ ।
lobhamohaparityaktā mānavā nirupadravāḥ ॥9॥

text: sa svargasadṛśo deśastatra hyuktāḥ śubhā guṇāḥ । kāle mṛtyuḥ prabhavati spṛśanti vyādhayo na ca ॥10॥
html:
sa svargasadṛśo deśastatra hyuktāḥ śubhā guṇāḥ ।
kāle mṛtyuḥ prabhavati spṛśanti vyādhayo na ca ॥10॥
slp1: sa svargasadfSo deSastatra hyuktAH SuBA guRAH । kAle mftyuH praBavati spfSanti vyADayo na ca ॥10॥

text: na lobhaḥ paradāreṣu svadāranirato janaḥ । na cānyonyavadhastatra dravyeṣu na ca vismayaḥ । parokṣadharmo naivāsti sandeho nāpi jāyate ॥11॥
html:
na lobhaḥ paradāreṣu svadāranirato janaḥ ।
na cānyonyavadhastatra dravyeṣu na ca vismayaḥ ।
parokṣadharmo naivāsti sandeho nāpi jāyate ॥11॥
slp1: na loBaH paradArezu svadAranirato janaH । na cAnyonyavaDastatra dravyezu na ca vismayaH । parokzaDarmo nEvAsti sandeho nApi jAyate ॥11॥

text: kṛtasya tu phalaṃ tatra pratyakṣamupalabhyate । śayyāyānāsanopetāḥ prāsādabhavanāśrayāḥ । sarvakāmairvṛtāḥ keciddhemābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ॥12॥
html:
kṛtasya tu phalaṃ tatra pratyakṣamupalabhyate ।
śayyāyānāsanopetāḥ prāsādabhavanāśrayāḥ ।
sarvakāmairvṛtāḥ keciddhemābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: kftasya tu PalaM tatra pratyakzamupalaByate । SayyAyAnAsanopetAH prAsAdaBavanASrayAH । sarvakAmErvftAH kecidDemABaraRaBUzitAH ॥12॥

text: prāṇadhāraṇamātraṃ tu keṣāñcidupapadyate । śrameṇa mahatā kecitkurvanti prāṇadhāraṇam ॥13॥
html:
prāṇadhāraṇamātraṃ tu keṣāñcidupapadyate ।
śrameṇa mahatā kecitkurvanti prāṇadhāraṇam ॥13॥
slp1: prARaDAraRamAtraM tu kezAYcidupapadyate । SrameRa mahatA kecitkurvanti prARaDAraRam ॥13॥

text: iha dharmaparāḥ kecitkecinnaikṛtikā narāḥ । sukhitā duḥkhitāḥ kecinnirdhanā dhanino'pare ॥14॥
html:
iha dharmaparāḥ kecitkecinnaikṛtikā narāḥ ।
sukhitā duḥkhitāḥ kecinnirdhanā dhanino'pare ॥14॥
slp1: iha DarmaparAH kecitkecinnEkftikA narAH । suKitA duHKitAH kecinnirDanA Danino'pare ॥14॥

text: iha śramo bhayaṃ mohaḥ kṣudhā tīvrā ca jāyate । lobhaścārthakṛto nṝṇāṃ yena muhyanti paṇḍitāḥ ॥15॥
html:
iha śramo bhayaṃ mohaḥ kṣudhā tīvrā ca jāyate ।
lobhaścārthakṛto nṝṇāṃ yena muhyanti paṇḍitāḥ ॥15॥
slp1: iha Sramo BayaM mohaH kzuDA tIvrA ca jAyate । loBaScArTakfto nFRAM yena muhyanti paRqitAH ॥15॥

text: iha cintā bahuvidhā dharmādharmasya karmaṇaḥ । yastadvedobhayaṃ prājñaḥ pāpmanā na sa lipyate ॥16॥
html:
iha cintā bahuvidhā dharmādharmasya karmaṇaḥ ।
yastadvedobhayaṃ prājñaḥ pāpmanā na sa lipyate ॥16॥
slp1: iha cintA bahuviDA DarmADarmasya karmaRaH । yastadvedoBayaM prAjYaH pApmanA na sa lipyate ॥16॥

text: sopadhaṃ nikṛtiḥ steyaṃ parivādo'bhyasūyatā । paropaghāto hiṃsā ca paiśunyamanṛtaṃ tathā ॥17॥
html:
sopadhaṃ nikṛtiḥ steyaṃ parivādo'bhyasūyatā ।
paropaghāto hiṃsā ca paiśunyamanṛtaṃ tathā ॥17॥
slp1: sopaDaM nikftiH steyaM parivAdo'ByasUyatA । paropaGAto hiMsA ca pESunyamanftaM taTA ॥17॥

text: etānāsevate yastu tapastasya prahīyate । yastvetānnācaredvidvāṃstapastasyābhivardhate ॥18॥
html:
etānāsevate yastu tapastasya prahīyate ।
yastvetānnācaredvidvāṃstapastasyābhivardhate ॥18॥
slp1: etAnAsevate yastu tapastasya prahIyate । yastvetAnnAcaredvidvAMstapastasyABivarDate ॥18॥

text: karmabhūmiriyaṃ loka iha kṛtvā śubhāśubham । śubhaiḥ śubhamavāpnoti kṛtvāśubhamato'nyathā ॥19॥
html:
karmabhūmiriyaṃ loka iha kṛtvā śubhāśubham ।
śubhaiḥ śubhamavāpnoti kṛtvāśubhamato'nyathā ॥19॥

text: iha prajāpatiḥ pūrvaṃ devāḥ sarṣigaṇāstathā । iṣṭveṣṭatapasaḥ pūtā brahmalokamupāśritāḥ ॥20॥
html:
iha prajāpatiḥ pūrvaṃ devāḥ sarṣigaṇāstathā ।
iṣṭveṣṭatapasaḥ pūtā brahmalokamupāśritāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: iha prajApatiH pUrvaM devAH sarzigaRAstaTA । izwvezwatapasaH pUtA brahmalokamupASritAH ॥20॥

text: uttaraḥ pṛthivībhāgaḥ sarvapuṇyatamaḥ śubhaḥ । ihatyāstatra jāyante ye vai puṇyakṛto janāḥ ॥21॥
html:
uttaraḥ pṛthivībhāgaḥ sarvapuṇyatamaḥ śubhaḥ ।
ihatyāstatra jāyante ye vai puṇyakṛto janāḥ ॥21॥
slp1: uttaraH pfTivIBAgaH sarvapuRyatamaH SuBaH । ihatyAstatra jAyante ye vE puRyakfto janAH ॥21॥

text: asatkarmāṇi kurvantastiryagyoniṣu cāpare । kṣīṇāyuṣastathaivānye naśyanti pṛthivītale ॥22॥
html:
asatkarmāṇi kurvantastiryagyoniṣu cāpare ।
kṣīṇāyuṣastathaivānye naśyanti pṛthivītale ॥22॥
slp1: asatkarmARi kurvantastiryagyonizu cApare । kzIRAyuzastaTEvAnye naSyanti pfTivItale ॥22॥

text: anyonyabhakṣaṇe saktā lobhamohasamanvitāḥ । ihaiva parivartante na te yāntyuttarāṃ diśam ॥23॥
html:
anyonyabhakṣaṇe saktā lobhamohasamanvitāḥ ।
ihaiva parivartante na te yāntyuttarāṃ diśam ॥23॥
slp1: anyonyaBakzaRe saktA loBamohasamanvitAH । ihEva parivartante na te yAntyuttarAM diSam ॥23॥

text: ye gurūnupasevante niyatā brahmacāriṇaḥ । panthānaṃ sarvalokānāṃ te jānanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥24॥
html:
ye gurūnupasevante niyatā brahmacāriṇaḥ ।
panthānaṃ sarvalokānāṃ te jānanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: ye gurUnupasevante niyatA brahmacAriRaH । panTAnaM sarvalokAnAM te jAnanti manIziRaH ॥24॥

text: ityukto'yaṃ mayā dharmaḥ saṅkṣepādbrahmanirmitaḥ । dharmādharmau hi lokasya yo vai vetti sa buddhimān ॥25॥
html:
ityukto'yaṃ mayā dharmaḥ saṅkṣepādbrahmanirmitaḥ ।
dharmādharmau hi lokasya yo vai vetti sa buddhimān ॥25॥
slp1: ityukto'yaM mayA DarmaH saNkzepAdbrahmanirmitaH । DarmADarmO hi lokasya yo vE vetti sa budDimAn ॥25॥

text: ityukto bhṛguṇā rājanbharadvājaḥ pratāpavān । bhṛguṃ paramadharmātmā vismitaḥ pratyapūjayat ॥26॥
html:
ityukto bhṛguṇā rājanbharadvājaḥ pratāpavān ।
bhṛguṃ paramadharmātmā vismitaḥ pratyapūjayat ॥26॥
slp1: ityukto BfguRA rAjanBaradvAjaH pratApavAn । BfguM paramaDarmAtmA vismitaH pratyapUjayat ॥26॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: eṣa te prabhavo rājañjagataḥ samprakīrtitaḥ । nikhilena mahāprājña kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi] ॥27॥
html:
eṣa te prabhavo rājañjagataḥ samprakīrtitaḥ ।
nikhilena mahāprājña kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi] ॥27॥
slp1: eza te praBavo rAjaYjagataH samprakIrtitaH । niKilena mahAprAjYa kiM BUyaH SrotumicCasi] ॥27॥

text: ācārasya vidhiṃ tāta procyamānaṃ tvayānagha । śrotumicchāmi dharmajña sarvajño hyasi me mataḥ ॥1॥
html:
ācārasya vidhiṃ tāta procyamānaṃ tvayānagha ।
śrotumicchāmi dharmajña sarvajño hyasi me mataḥ ॥1॥
slp1: AcArasya viDiM tAta procyamAnaM tvayAnaGa । SrotumicCAmi DarmajYa sarvajYo hyasi me mataH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: durācārā durviceṣṭā duṣprajñāḥ priyasāhasāḥ । asanto hyabhivikhyātāḥ santaścācāralakṣaṇāḥ ॥2॥
html:
durācārā durviceṣṭā duṣprajñāḥ priyasāhasāḥ ।
asanto hyabhivikhyātāḥ santaścācāralakṣaṇāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: durAcArA durvicezwA duzprajYAH priyasAhasAH । asanto hyaBiviKyAtAH santaScAcAralakzaRAH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: purīṣaṃ yadi vā mūtraṃ ye na kurvanti mānavāḥ । rājamārge gavāṃ madhye dhānyamadhye ca te śubhāḥ ॥3॥
html:
purīṣaṃ yadi vā mūtraṃ ye na kurvanti mānavāḥ ।
rājamārge gavāṃ madhye dhānyamadhye ca te śubhāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: purIzaM yadi vA mUtraM ye na kurvanti mAnavAH । rAjamArge gavAM maDye DAnyamaDye ca te SuBAH ॥3॥

text: śaucamāvaśyakaṃ kṛtvā devatānāṃ ca tarpaṇam । dharmamāhurmanuṣyāṇāmupaspṛśya nadīṃ taret ॥4॥
html:
śaucamāvaśyakaṃ kṛtvā devatānāṃ ca tarpaṇam ।
dharmamāhurmanuṣyāṇāmupaspṛśya nadīṃ taret ॥4॥
slp1: SOcamAvaSyakaM kftvA devatAnAM ca tarpaRam । DarmamAhurmanuzyARAmupaspfSya nadIM taret ॥4॥

text: sūryaṃ sadopatiṣṭheta na svapyādbhāskarodaye । sāyaṃ prātarjapansandhyāṃ tiṣṭhetpūrvāṃ tathāparām ॥5॥
html:
sūryaṃ sadopatiṣṭheta na svapyādbhāskarodaye ।
sāyaṃ prātarjapansandhyāṃ tiṣṭhetpūrvāṃ tathāparām ॥5॥
slp1: sUryaM sadopatizWeta na svapyAdBAskarodaye । sAyaM prAtarjapansanDyAM tizWetpUrvAM taTAparAm ॥5॥

text: pañcārdro bhojanaṃ kuryātprāṅmukho maunamāsthitaḥ । na nindedannabhakṣyāṃśca svādvasvādu ca bhakṣayet ॥6॥
html:
pañcārdro bhojanaṃ kuryātprāṅmukho maunamāsthitaḥ ।
na nindedannabhakṣyāṃśca svādvasvādu ca bhakṣayet ॥6॥
slp1: paYcArdro BojanaM kuryAtprANmuKo mOnamAsTitaH । na nindedannaBakzyAMSca svAdvasvAdu ca Bakzayet ॥6॥

text: nārdrapāṇiḥ samuttiṣṭhennārdrapādaḥ svapenniśi । devarṣināradaproktametadācāralakṣaṇam ॥7॥
html:
nārdrapāṇiḥ samuttiṣṭhennārdrapādaḥ svapenniśi ।
devarṣināradaproktametadācāralakṣaṇam ॥7॥
slp1: nArdrapARiH samuttizWennArdrapAdaH svapenniSi । devarzinAradaproktametadAcAralakzaRam ॥7॥

text: śucikāmamanaḍvāhaṃ devagoṣṭhaṃ catuṣpatham । brāhmaṇaṃ dhārmikaṃ caiva nityaṃ kuryātpradakṣiṇam ॥8॥
html:
śucikāmamanaḍvāhaṃ devagoṣṭhaṃ catuṣpatham ।
brāhmaṇaṃ dhārmikaṃ caiva nityaṃ kuryātpradakṣiṇam ॥8॥
slp1: SucikAmamanaqvAhaM devagozWaM catuzpaTam । brAhmaRaM DArmikaM cEva nityaM kuryAtpradakziRam ॥8॥

text: atithīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ preṣyāṇāṃ svajanasya ca । sāmānyaṃ bhojanaṃ bhṛtyaiḥ puruṣasya praśasyate ॥9॥
html:
atithīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ preṣyāṇāṃ svajanasya ca ।
sāmānyaṃ bhojanaṃ bhṛtyaiḥ puruṣasya praśasyate ॥9॥
slp1: atiTInAM ca sarvezAM prezyARAM svajanasya ca । sAmAnyaM BojanaM BftyEH puruzasya praSasyate ॥9॥

text: sāyaṃ prātarmanuṣyāṇāmaśanaṃ devanirmitam । nāntarā bhojanaṃ dṛṣṭamupavāsī tathā bhavet ॥10॥
html:
sāyaṃ prātarmanuṣyāṇāmaśanaṃ devanirmitam ।
nāntarā bhojanaṃ dṛṣṭamupavāsī tathā bhavet ॥10॥
slp1: sAyaM prAtarmanuzyARAmaSanaM devanirmitam । nAntarA BojanaM dfzwamupavAsI taTA Bavet ॥10॥
