text: homakāle tathā juhvannṛtukāle tathā vrajan । ananyastrījanaḥ prājño brahmacārī tathā bhavet ॥11॥
html:
homakāle tathā juhvannṛtukāle tathā vrajan ।
ananyastrījanaḥ prājño brahmacārī tathā bhavet ॥11॥
slp1: homakAle taTA juhvannftukAle taTA vrajan । ananyastrIjanaH prAjYo brahmacArI taTA Bavet ॥11॥

text: amṛtaṃ brāhmaṇocchiṣṭaṃ jananyā hṛdayaṃ kṛtam । upāsīta janaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ santa upāsate ॥12॥
html:
amṛtaṃ brāhmaṇocchiṣṭaṃ jananyā hṛdayaṃ kṛtam ।
upāsīta janaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ santa upāsate ॥12॥
slp1: amftaM brAhmaRocCizwaM jananyA hfdayaM kftam । upAsIta janaH satyaM satyaM santa upAsate ॥12॥

text: yajuṣā saṃskṛtaṃ māṃsaṃ nivṛtto māṃsabhakṣaṇāt । na bhakṣayedvṛthāmāṃsaṃ pṛṣṭhamāṃsaṃ ca varjayet ॥13॥
html:
yajuṣā saṃskṛtaṃ māṃsaṃ nivṛtto māṃsabhakṣaṇāt ।
na bhakṣayedvṛthāmāṃsaṃ pṛṣṭhamāṃsaṃ ca varjayet ॥13॥
slp1: yajuzA saMskftaM mAMsaM nivftto mAMsaBakzaRAt । na BakzayedvfTAmAMsaM pfzWamAMsaM ca varjayet ॥13॥

text: svadeśe paradeśe vā atithiṃ nopavāsayet । kāmyaṃ karmaphalaṃ labdhvā gurūṇāmupapādayet ॥14॥
html:
svadeśe paradeśe vā atithiṃ nopavāsayet ।
kāmyaṃ karmaphalaṃ labdhvā gurūṇāmupapādayet ॥14॥
slp1: svadeSe paradeSe vA atiTiM nopavAsayet । kAmyaM karmaPalaM labDvA gurURAmupapAdayet ॥14॥

text: gurubhya āsanaṃ deyaṃ kartavyaṃ cābhivādanam । gurūnabhyarcya yujyante āyuṣā yaśasā śriyā ॥15॥
html:
gurubhya āsanaṃ deyaṃ kartavyaṃ cābhivādanam ।
gurūnabhyarcya yujyante āyuṣā yaśasā śriyā ॥15॥
slp1: guruBya AsanaM deyaM kartavyaM cABivAdanam । gurUnaByarcya yujyante AyuzA yaSasA SriyA ॥15॥

text: nekṣetādityamudyantaṃ na ca nagnāṃ parastriyam । maithunaṃ samaye dharmyaṃ guhyaṃ caiva samācaret ॥16॥
html:
nekṣetādityamudyantaṃ na ca nagnāṃ parastriyam ।
maithunaṃ samaye dharmyaṃ guhyaṃ caiva samācaret ॥16॥
slp1: nekzetAdityamudyantaM na ca nagnAM parastriyam । mETunaM samaye DarmyaM guhyaM cEva samAcaret ॥16॥

text: tīrthānāṃ hṛdayaṃ tīrthaṃ śucīnāṃ hṛdayaṃ śuciḥ । sarvamāryakṛtaṃ śaucaṃ vālasaṃsparśanāni ca ॥17॥
html:
tīrthānāṃ hṛdayaṃ tīrthaṃ śucīnāṃ hṛdayaṃ śuciḥ ।
sarvamāryakṛtaṃ śaucaṃ vālasaṃsparśanāni ca ॥17॥
slp1: tIrTAnAM hfdayaM tIrTaM SucInAM hfdayaM SuciH । sarvamAryakftaM SOcaM vAlasaMsparSanAni ca ॥17॥

text: darśane darśane nityaṃ sukhapraśnamudāharet । sāyaṃ prātaśca viprāṇāṃ pradiṣṭamabhivādanam ॥18॥
html:
darśane darśane nityaṃ sukhapraśnamudāharet ।
sāyaṃ prātaśca viprāṇāṃ pradiṣṭamabhivādanam ॥18॥
slp1: darSane darSane nityaM suKapraSnamudAharet । sAyaM prAtaSca viprARAM pradizwamaBivAdanam ॥18॥

text: devagoṣṭhe gavāṃ madhye brāhmaṇānāṃ kriyāpathe । svādhyāye bhojane caiva dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇimuddharet ॥19॥
html:
devagoṣṭhe gavāṃ madhye brāhmaṇānāṃ kriyāpathe ।
svādhyāye bhojane caiva dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇimuddharet ॥19॥
slp1: devagozWe gavAM maDye brAhmaRAnAM kriyApaTe । svADyAye Bojane cEva dakziRaM pARimudDaret ॥19॥

text: paṇyānāṃ śobhanaṃ paṇyaṃ kṛṣīṇāṃ bādyate kṛṣiḥ । bahukāraṃ ca sasyānāṃ vāhye vāhyaṃ tathā gavām ॥20॥
html:
paṇyānāṃ śobhanaṃ paṇyaṃ kṛṣīṇāṃ bādyate kṛṣiḥ ।
bahukāraṃ ca sasyānāṃ vāhye vāhyaṃ tathā gavām ॥20॥
slp1: paRyAnAM SoBanaM paRyaM kfzIRAM bAdyate kfziH । bahukAraM ca sasyAnAM vAhye vAhyaM taTA gavAm ॥20॥

text: sampannaṃ bhojane nityaṃ pānīye tarpaṇaṃ tathā । suśṛtaṃ pāyase brūyādyavāgvāṃ kṛsare tathā ॥21॥
html:
sampannaṃ bhojane nityaṃ pānīye tarpaṇaṃ tathā ।
suśṛtaṃ pāyase brūyādyavāgvāṃ kṛsare tathā ॥21॥
slp1: sampannaM Bojane nityaM pAnIye tarpaRaM taTA । suSftaM pAyase brUyAdyavAgvAM kfsare taTA ॥21॥

text: śmaśrukarmaṇi samprāpte kṣute snāne'tha bhojane । vyādhitānāṃ ca sarveṣāmāyuṣyamabhinandanam ॥22॥
html:
śmaśrukarmaṇi samprāpte kṣute snāne'tha bhojane ।
vyādhitānāṃ ca sarveṣāmāyuṣyamabhinandanam ॥22॥
slp1: SmaSrukarmaRi samprApte kzute snAne'Ta Bojane । vyADitAnAM ca sarvezAmAyuzyamaBinandanam ॥22॥

text: pratyādityaṃ na meheta na paśyedātmanaḥ śakṛt । sutastriyā ca śayanaṃ sahabhojyaṃ ca varjayet ॥23॥
html:
pratyādityaṃ na meheta na paśyedātmanaḥ śakṛt ।
sutastriyā ca śayanaṃ sahabhojyaṃ ca varjayet ॥23॥
slp1: pratyAdityaM na meheta na paSyedAtmanaH Sakft । sutastriyA ca SayanaM sahaBojyaM ca varjayet ॥23॥

text: tvaṅkāraṃ nāmadheyaṃ ca jyeṣṭhānāṃ parivarjayet । avarāṇāṃ samānānāmubhayeṣāṃ na duṣyati ॥24॥
html:
tvaṅkāraṃ nāmadheyaṃ ca jyeṣṭhānāṃ parivarjayet ।
avarāṇāṃ samānānāmubhayeṣāṃ na duṣyati ॥24॥
slp1: tvaNkAraM nAmaDeyaM ca jyezWAnAM parivarjayet । avarARAM samAnAnAmuBayezAM na duzyati ॥24॥

text: hṛdayaṃ pāpavṛttānāṃ pāpamākhyāti vaikṛtam । jñānapūrvaṃ vinaśyanti gūhamānā mahājane ॥25॥
html:
hṛdayaṃ pāpavṛttānāṃ pāpamākhyāti vaikṛtam ।
jñānapūrvaṃ vinaśyanti gūhamānā mahājane ॥25॥
slp1: hfdayaM pApavfttAnAM pApamAKyAti vEkftam । jYAnapUrvaM vinaSyanti gUhamAnA mahAjane ॥25॥

text: jñānapūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ chādayantyabahuśrutāḥ । nainaṃ manuṣyāḥ paśyanti paśyanti tridivaukasaḥ ॥26॥
html:
jñānapūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ chādayantyabahuśrutāḥ ।
nainaṃ manuṣyāḥ paśyanti paśyanti tridivaukasaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: jYAnapUrvaM kftaM pApaM CAdayantyabahuSrutAH । nEnaM manuzyAH paSyanti paSyanti tridivOkasaH ॥26॥

text: pāpena hi kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ pāpamevānuvartate । dhārmikeṇa kṛto dharmaḥ kartāramanuvartate ॥27॥
html:
pāpena hi kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ pāpamevānuvartate ।
dhārmikeṇa kṛto dharmaḥ kartāramanuvartate ॥27॥
slp1: pApena hi kftaM pApaM pApamevAnuvartate । DArmikeRa kfto DarmaH kartAramanuvartate ॥27॥

text: pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ na smaratīha mūḍho vivartamānasya tadeti kartuḥ । rāhuryathā candramupaiti cāpi tathābudhaṃ pāpamupaiti karma ॥28॥
html:
pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ na smaratīha mūḍho vivartamānasya tadeti kartuḥ ।
rāhuryathā candramupaiti cāpi tathābudhaṃ pāpamupaiti karma ॥28॥
slp1: pApaM kftaM na smaratIha mUQo vivartamAnasya tadeti kartuH । rAhuryaTA candramupEti cApi taTAbuDaM pApamupEti karma ॥28॥

text: āśayā sañcitaṃ dravyaṃ yatkāle neha bhujyate । tadbudhā na praśaṃsanti maraṇaṃ na pratīkṣate ॥29॥
html:
āśayā sañcitaṃ dravyaṃ yatkāle neha bhujyate ।
tadbudhā na praśaṃsanti maraṇaṃ na pratīkṣate ॥29॥
slp1: ASayA saYcitaM dravyaM yatkAle neha Bujyate । tadbuDA na praSaMsanti maraRaM na pratIkzate ॥29॥

text: mānasaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dharmamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ । tasmātsarveṣu bhūteṣu manasā śivamācaret ॥30॥
html:
mānasaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dharmamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ।
tasmātsarveṣu bhūteṣu manasā śivamācaret ॥30॥
slp1: mAnasaM sarvaBUtAnAM DarmamAhurmanIziRaH । tasmAtsarvezu BUtezu manasA SivamAcaret ॥30॥

text: eka eva careddharmaṃ nāsti dharme sahāyatā । kevalaṃ vidhimāsādya sahāyaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati ॥31॥
html:
eka eva careddharmaṃ nāsti dharme sahāyatā ।
kevalaṃ vidhimāsādya sahāyaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati ॥31॥
slp1: eka eva caredDarmaM nAsti Darme sahAyatA । kevalaM viDimAsAdya sahAyaH kiM karizyati ॥31॥

text: devā yonirmanuṣyāṇāṃ devānāmamṛtaṃ divi । pretyabhāve sukhaṃ dharmācchaśvattairupabhujyate] ॥32॥
html:
devā yonirmanuṣyāṇāṃ devānāmamṛtaṃ divi ।
pretyabhāve sukhaṃ dharmācchaśvattairupabhujyate] ॥32॥
slp1: devA yonirmanuzyARAM devAnAmamftaM divi । pretyaBAve suKaM DarmAcCaSvattErupaBujyate] ॥32॥

text: adhyātmaṃ nāma yadidaṃ puruṣasyeha cintyate । yadadhyātmaṃ yataścaitattanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
adhyātmaṃ nāma yadidaṃ puruṣasyeha cintyate ।
yadadhyātmaṃ yataścaitattanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: aDyAtmaM nAma yadidaM puruzasyeha cintyate । yadaDyAtmaM yataScEtattanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: adhyātmamiti māṃ pārtha yadetadanupṛcchasi । tadvyākhyāsyāmi te tāta śreyaskarataraṃ sukham ॥2॥
html:
adhyātmamiti māṃ pārtha yadetadanupṛcchasi ।
tadvyākhyāsyāmi te tāta śreyaskarataraṃ sukham ॥2॥
slp1: aDyAtmamiti mAM pArTa yadetadanupfcCasi । tadvyAKyAsyAmi te tAta SreyaskarataraM suKam ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yajjñātvā puruṣo loke prītiṃ saukhyaṃ ca vindati । phalalābhaśca sadyaḥ syātsarvabhūtahitaṃ ca tat ॥3॥
html:
yajjñātvā puruṣo loke prītiṃ saukhyaṃ ca vindati ।
phalalābhaśca sadyaḥ syātsarvabhūtahitaṃ ca tat ॥3॥
slp1: yajjYAtvA puruzo loke prItiM sOKyaM ca vindati । PalalABaSca sadyaH syAtsarvaBUtahitaM ca tat ॥3॥

text: pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam । mahābhūtāni bhūtānāṃ sarveṣāṃ prabhavāpyayau ॥4॥
html:
pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam ।
mahābhūtāni bhūtānāṃ sarveṣāṃ prabhavāpyayau ॥4॥
slp1: pfTivI vAyurAkASamApo jyotiSca paYcamam । mahABUtAni BUtAnAM sarvezAM praBavApyayO ॥4॥

text: tataḥ sṛṣṭāni tatraiva tāni yānti punaḥ punaḥ । mahābhūtāni bhūteṣu sāgarasyormayo yathā ॥5॥
html:
tataḥ sṛṣṭāni tatraiva tāni yānti punaḥ punaḥ ।
mahābhūtāni bhūteṣu sāgarasyormayo yathā ॥5॥
slp1: tataH sfzwAni tatrEva tAni yAnti punaH punaH । mahABUtAni BUtezu sAgarasyormayo yaTA ॥5॥

text: prasārya ca yathāṅgāni kūrmaḥ saṃharate punaḥ । tadvadbhūtāni bhūtātmā sṛṣṭvā saṃharate punaḥ ॥6॥
html:
prasārya ca yathāṅgāni kūrmaḥ saṃharate punaḥ ।
tadvadbhūtāni bhūtātmā sṛṣṭvā saṃharate punaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: prasArya ca yaTANgAni kUrmaH saMharate punaH । tadvadBUtAni BUtAtmA sfzwvA saMharate punaH ॥6॥

text: mahābhūtāni pañcaiva sarvabhūteṣu bhūtakṛt । akarotteṣu vaiṣamyaṃ tattu jīvo'nu paśyati ॥7॥
html:
mahābhūtāni pañcaiva sarvabhūteṣu bhūtakṛt ।
akarotteṣu vaiṣamyaṃ tattu jīvo'nu paśyati ॥7॥
slp1: mahABUtAni paYcEva sarvaBUtezu BUtakft । akarottezu vEzamyaM tattu jIvo'nu paSyati ॥7॥

text: śabdaḥ śrotraṃ tathā khāni trayamākāśayonijam । vāyostvaksparśaceṣṭāśca vāgityetaccatuṣṭayam ॥8॥
html:
śabdaḥ śrotraṃ tathā khāni trayamākāśayonijam ।
vāyostvaksparśaceṣṭāśca vāgityetaccatuṣṭayam ॥8॥
slp1: SabdaH SrotraM taTA KAni trayamAkASayonijam । vAyostvaksparSacezwASca vAgityetaccatuzwayam ॥8॥

text: rūpaṃ cakṣustathā paktistrividhaṃ teja ucyate । rasaḥ kledaśca jihvā ca trayo jalaguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ॥9॥
html:
rūpaṃ cakṣustathā paktistrividhaṃ teja ucyate ।
rasaḥ kledaśca jihvā ca trayo jalaguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: rUpaM cakzustaTA paktistriviDaM teja ucyate । rasaH kledaSca jihvA ca trayo jalaguRAH smftAH ॥9॥

text: ghreyaṃ ghrāṇaṃ śarīraṃ ca te tu bhūmiguṇāstrayaḥ । mahābhūtāni pañcaiva ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu mana ucyate ॥10॥
html:
ghreyaṃ ghrāṇaṃ śarīraṃ ca te tu bhūmiguṇāstrayaḥ ।
mahābhūtāni pañcaiva ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu mana ucyate ॥10॥
slp1: GreyaM GrARaM SarIraM ca te tu BUmiguRAstrayaH । mahABUtAni paYcEva zazWaM tu mana ucyate ॥10॥

text: indriyāṇi manaścaiva vijñānānyasya bhārata । saptamī buddhirityāhuḥ kṣetrajñaḥ punaraṣṭamaḥ ॥11॥
html:
indriyāṇi manaścaiva vijñānānyasya bhārata ।
saptamī buddhirityāhuḥ kṣetrajñaḥ punaraṣṭamaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: indriyARi manaScEva vijYAnAnyasya BArata । saptamI budDirityAhuH kzetrajYaH punarazwamaH ॥11॥

text: cakṣurālokanāyaiva saṃśayaṃ kurute manaḥ । buddhiradhyavasāyāya kṣetrajñaḥ sākṣivatsthitaḥ ॥12॥
html:
cakṣurālokanāyaiva saṃśayaṃ kurute manaḥ ।
buddhiradhyavasāyāya kṣetrajñaḥ sākṣivatsthitaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: cakzurAlokanAyEva saMSayaM kurute manaH । budDiraDyavasAyAya kzetrajYaH sAkzivatsTitaH ॥12॥

text: ūrdhvaṃ pādatalābhyāṃ yadarvāgūrdhvaṃ ca paśyati । etena sarvamevedaṃ viddhyabhivyāptamantaram ॥13॥
html:
ūrdhvaṃ pādatalābhyāṃ yadarvāgūrdhvaṃ ca paśyati ।
etena sarvamevedaṃ viddhyabhivyāptamantaram ॥13॥
slp1: UrDvaM pAdatalAByAM yadarvAgUrDvaM ca paSyati । etena sarvamevedaM vidDyaBivyAptamantaram ॥13॥

text: puruṣe cendriyāṇīha veditavyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ । tamo rajaśca sattvaṃ ca viddhi bhāvāṃstadāśrayān ॥14॥
html:
puruṣe cendriyāṇīha veditavyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ ।
tamo rajaśca sattvaṃ ca viddhi bhāvāṃstadāśrayān ॥14॥
slp1: puruze cendriyARIha veditavyAni kftsnaSaH । tamo rajaSca sattvaM ca vidDi BAvAMstadASrayAn ॥14॥

text: etāṃ buddhvā naro buddhyā bhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatim । samavekṣya śanaiścaiva labhate śamamuttamam ॥15॥
html:
etāṃ buddhvā naro buddhyā bhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatim ।
samavekṣya śanaiścaiva labhate śamamuttamam ॥15॥
slp1: etAM budDvA naro budDyA BUtAnAmAgatiM gatim । samavekzya SanEScEva laBate Samamuttamam ॥15॥

text: guṇānnenīyate buddhirbuddhirevendriyāṇyapi । manaḥṣaṣṭhāni sarvāṇi buddhyabhāve kuto guṇāḥ ॥16॥
html:
guṇānnenīyate buddhirbuddhirevendriyāṇyapi ।
manaḥṣaṣṭhāni sarvāṇi buddhyabhāve kuto guṇāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: guRAnnenIyate budDirbudDirevendriyARyapi । manaHzazWAni sarvARi budDyaBAve kuto guRAH ॥16॥

text: iti tanmayamevaitatsarvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam । pralīyate codbhavati tasmānnirdiśyate tathā ॥17॥
html:
iti tanmayamevaitatsarvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam ।
pralīyate codbhavati tasmānnirdiśyate tathā ॥17॥
slp1: iti tanmayamevEtatsarvaM sTAvarajaNgamam । pralIyate codBavati tasmAnnirdiSyate taTA ॥17॥

text: yena paśyati taccakṣuḥ śṛṇoti śrotramucyate । jighrati ghrāṇamityāhū rasaṃ jānāti jihvayā ॥18॥
html:
yena paśyati taccakṣuḥ śṛṇoti śrotramucyate ।
jighrati ghrāṇamityāhū rasaṃ jānāti jihvayā ॥18॥
slp1: yena paSyati taccakzuH SfRoti Srotramucyate । jiGrati GrARamityAhU rasaM jAnAti jihvayA ॥18॥

text: tvacā spṛśati ca sparśānbuddhirvikriyate'sakṛt । yena saṅkalpayatyarthaṃ kiñcidbhavati tanmanaḥ ॥19॥
html:
tvacā spṛśati ca sparśānbuddhirvikriyate'sakṛt ।
yena saṅkalpayatyarthaṃ kiñcidbhavati tanmanaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: tvacA spfSati ca sparSAnbudDirvikriyate'sakft । yena saNkalpayatyarTaM kiYcidBavati tanmanaH ॥19॥

text: adhiṣṭhānāni buddherhi pṛthagarthāni pañcadhā । pañcendriyāṇi yānyāhustānyadṛśyo'dhitiṣṭhati ॥20॥
html:
adhiṣṭhānāni buddherhi pṛthagarthāni pañcadhā ।
pañcendriyāṇi yānyāhustānyadṛśyo'dhitiṣṭhati ॥20॥
slp1: aDizWAnAni budDerhi pfTagarTAni paYcaDA । paYcendriyARi yAnyAhustAnyadfSyo'DitizWati ॥20॥

text: puruṣādhiṣṭhitā buddhistriṣu bhāveṣu vartate । kadācillabhate prītiṃ kadācidanuśocati ॥21॥
html:
puruṣādhiṣṭhitā buddhistriṣu bhāveṣu vartate ।
kadācillabhate prītiṃ kadācidanuśocati ॥21॥
slp1: puruzADizWitA budDistrizu BAvezu vartate । kadAcillaBate prItiM kadAcidanuSocati ॥21॥

text: na sukhena na duḥkhena kadācidapi vartate । evaṃ narāṇāṃ manasi triṣu bhāveṣvavasthitā ॥22॥
html:
na sukhena na duḥkhena kadācidapi vartate ।
evaṃ narāṇāṃ manasi triṣu bhāveṣvavasthitā ॥22॥
slp1: na suKena na duHKena kadAcidapi vartate । evaM narARAM manasi trizu BAvezvavasTitA ॥22॥

text: seyaṃ bhāvātmikā bhāvāṃstrīnetānnātivartate । saritāṃ sāgaro bhartā mahāvelāmivormimān ॥23॥
html:
seyaṃ bhāvātmikā bhāvāṃstrīnetānnātivartate ।
saritāṃ sāgaro bhartā mahāvelāmivormimān ॥23॥
slp1: seyaM BAvAtmikA BAvAMstrInetAnnAtivartate । saritAM sAgaro BartA mahAvelAmivormimAn ॥23॥

text: atibhāvagatā buddhirbhāve manasi vartate । pravartamānaṃ hi rajastadbhāvamanuvartate ॥24॥
html:
atibhāvagatā buddhirbhāve manasi vartate ।
pravartamānaṃ hi rajastadbhāvamanuvartate ॥24॥
slp1: atiBAvagatA budDirBAve manasi vartate । pravartamAnaM hi rajastadBAvamanuvartate ॥24॥

text: indriyāṇi hi sarvāṇi pradarśayati sā sadā । prītiḥ sattvaṃ rajaḥ śokastamo mohaśca te trayaḥ ॥25॥
html:
indriyāṇi hi sarvāṇi pradarśayati sā sadā ।
prītiḥ sattvaṃ rajaḥ śokastamo mohaśca te trayaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: indriyARi hi sarvARi pradarSayati sA sadA । prItiH sattvaM rajaH Sokastamo mohaSca te trayaH ॥25॥

text: ye ye ca bhāvā loke'sminsarveṣveteṣu te triṣu । iti buddhigatiḥ sarvā vyākhyātā tava bhārata ॥26॥
html:
ye ye ca bhāvā loke'sminsarveṣveteṣu te triṣu ।
iti buddhigatiḥ sarvā vyākhyātā tava bhārata ॥26॥
slp1: ye ye ca BAvA loke'sminsarvezvetezu te trizu । iti budDigatiH sarvA vyAKyAtA tava BArata ॥26॥

text: indriyāṇi ca sarvāṇi vijetavyāni dhīmatā । sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva prāṇināṃ saṃśritāḥ sadā ॥27॥
html:
indriyāṇi ca sarvāṇi vijetavyāni dhīmatā ।
sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva prāṇināṃ saṃśritāḥ sadā ॥27॥
slp1: indriyARi ca sarvARi vijetavyAni DImatA । sattvaM rajastamaScEva prARinAM saMSritAH sadA ॥27॥

text: trividhā vedanā caiva sarvasattveṣu dṛśyate । sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ceti bhārata ॥28॥
html:
trividhā vedanā caiva sarvasattveṣu dṛśyate ।
sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ceti bhārata ॥28॥
slp1: triviDA vedanA cEva sarvasattvezu dfSyate । sAttvikI rAjasI cEva tAmasI ceti BArata ॥28॥

text: sukhasparśaḥ sattvaguṇo duḥkhasparśo rajoguṇaḥ । tamoguṇena saṃyuktau bhavato'vyāvahārikau ॥29॥
html:
sukhasparśaḥ sattvaguṇo duḥkhasparśo rajoguṇaḥ ।
tamoguṇena saṃyuktau bhavato'vyāvahārikau ॥29॥
slp1: suKasparSaH sattvaguRo duHKasparSo rajoguRaH । tamoguRena saMyuktO Bavato'vyAvahArikO ॥29॥

text: tatra yatprītisaṃyuktaṃ kāye manasi vā bhavet । vartate sāttviko bhāva ityavekṣeta tattadā ॥30॥
html:
tatra yatprītisaṃyuktaṃ kāye manasi vā bhavet ।
vartate sāttviko bhāva ityavekṣeta tattadā ॥30॥
slp1: tatra yatprItisaMyuktaM kAye manasi vA Bavet । vartate sAttviko BAva ityavekzeta tattadA ॥30॥

text: atha yadduḥkhasaṃyuktamatuṣṭikaramātmanaḥ । pravṛttaṃ raja ityeva tannasaṃrabhya cintayet ॥31॥
html:
atha yadduḥkhasaṃyuktamatuṣṭikaramātmanaḥ ।
pravṛttaṃ raja ityeva tannasaṃrabhya cintayet ॥31॥
slp1: aTa yadduHKasaMyuktamatuzwikaramAtmanaH । pravfttaM raja ityeva tannasaMraBya cintayet ॥31॥

text: atha yanmohasaṃyuktamavyaktamiva yadbhavet । apratarkyamavijñeyaṃ tamastadupadhārayet ॥32॥
html:
atha yanmohasaṃyuktamavyaktamiva yadbhavet ।
apratarkyamavijñeyaṃ tamastadupadhārayet ॥32॥
slp1: aTa yanmohasaMyuktamavyaktamiva yadBavet । apratarkyamavijYeyaM tamastadupaDArayet ॥32॥

text: praharṣaḥ prītirānandaḥ sukhaṃ saṃśāntacittatā । kathañcidabhivartanta ityete sāttvikā guṇāḥ ॥33॥
html:
praharṣaḥ prītirānandaḥ sukhaṃ saṃśāntacittatā ।
kathañcidabhivartanta ityete sāttvikā guṇāḥ ॥33॥
slp1: praharzaH prItirAnandaH suKaM saMSAntacittatA । kaTaYcidaBivartanta ityete sAttvikA guRAH ॥33॥

text: atuṣṭiḥ paritāpaśca śoko lobhastathākṣamā । liṅgāni rajasastāni dṛśyante hetvahetubhiḥ ॥34॥
html:
atuṣṭiḥ paritāpaśca śoko lobhastathākṣamā ।
liṅgāni rajasastāni dṛśyante hetvahetubhiḥ ॥34॥
slp1: atuzwiH paritApaSca Soko loBastaTAkzamA । liNgAni rajasastAni dfSyante hetvahetuBiH ॥34॥

text: abhimānastathā mohaḥ pramādaḥ svapnatandritā । kathañcidabhivartante vividhāstāmasā guṇāḥ ॥35॥
html:
abhimānastathā mohaḥ pramādaḥ svapnatandritā ।
kathañcidabhivartante vividhāstāmasā guṇāḥ ॥35॥
slp1: aBimAnastaTA mohaH pramAdaH svapnatandritA । kaTaYcidaBivartante viviDAstAmasA guRAH ॥35॥

text: dūragaṃ bahudhāgāmi prārthanāsaṃśayātmakam । manaḥ suniyataṃ yasya sa sukhī pretya ceha ca ॥36॥
html:
dūragaṃ bahudhāgāmi prārthanāsaṃśayātmakam ।
manaḥ suniyataṃ yasya sa sukhī pretya ceha ca ॥36॥
slp1: dUragaM bahuDAgAmi prArTanAsaMSayAtmakam । manaH suniyataM yasya sa suKI pretya ceha ca ॥36॥

text: sattvakṣetrajñayoretadantaraṃ paśya sūkṣmayoḥ । sṛjate tu guṇāneka eko na sṛjate guṇān ॥37॥
html:
sattvakṣetrajñayoretadantaraṃ paśya sūkṣmayoḥ ।
sṛjate tu guṇāneka eko na sṛjate guṇān ॥37॥
slp1: sattvakzetrajYayoretadantaraM paSya sUkzmayoH । sfjate tu guRAneka eko na sfjate guRAn ॥37॥

text: maśakodumbarau cāpi saṃprayuktau yathā sadā । anyonyamanyau ca yathā samprayogastathā tayoḥ ॥38॥
html:
maśakodumbarau cāpi saṃprayuktau yathā sadā ।
anyonyamanyau ca yathā samprayogastathā tayoḥ ॥38॥
slp1: maSakodumbarO cApi saMprayuktO yaTA sadA । anyonyamanyO ca yaTA samprayogastaTA tayoH ॥38॥

text: pṛthagbhūtau prakṛtyā tau samprayuktau ca sarvadā । yathā matsyo jalaṃ caiva samprayuktau tathaiva tau ॥39॥
html:
pṛthagbhūtau prakṛtyā tau samprayuktau ca sarvadā ।
yathā matsyo jalaṃ caiva samprayuktau tathaiva tau ॥39॥
slp1: pfTagBUtO prakftyA tO samprayuktO ca sarvadA । yaTA matsyo jalaM cEva samprayuktO taTEva tO ॥39॥

text: na guṇā vidurātmānaṃ sa guṇānvetti sarvaśaḥ । paridraṣṭā guṇānāṃ ca saṃsraṣṭā manyate sadā ॥40॥
html:
na guṇā vidurātmānaṃ sa guṇānvetti sarvaśaḥ ।
paridraṣṭā guṇānāṃ ca saṃsraṣṭā manyate sadā ॥40॥
slp1: na guRA vidurAtmAnaM sa guRAnvetti sarvaSaH । paridrazwA guRAnAM ca saMsrazwA manyate sadA ॥40॥

text: indriyaistu pradīpārthaṃ kurute buddhisaptamaiḥ । nirviceṣṭairajānadbhiḥ paramātmā pradīpavat ॥41॥
html:
indriyaistu pradīpārthaṃ kurute buddhisaptamaiḥ ।
nirviceṣṭairajānadbhiḥ paramātmā pradīpavat ॥41॥
slp1: indriyEstu pradIpArTaM kurute budDisaptamEH । nirvicezwErajAnadBiH paramAtmA pradIpavat ॥41॥

text: sṛjate hi guṇānsattvaṃ kṣetrajñaḥ paripaśyati । samprayogastayoreṣa sattvakṣetrajñayordhruvaḥ ॥42॥
html:
sṛjate hi guṇānsattvaṃ kṣetrajñaḥ paripaśyati ।
samprayogastayoreṣa sattvakṣetrajñayordhruvaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: sfjate hi guRAnsattvaM kzetrajYaH paripaSyati । samprayogastayoreza sattvakzetrajYayorDruvaH ॥42॥

text: āśrayo nāsti sattvasya kṣetrajñasya ca kaścana । sattvaṃ manaḥ saṃsṛjati na guṇānvai kadācana ॥43॥
html:
āśrayo nāsti sattvasya kṣetrajñasya ca kaścana ।
sattvaṃ manaḥ saṃsṛjati na guṇānvai kadācana ॥43॥
slp1: ASrayo nAsti sattvasya kzetrajYasya ca kaScana । sattvaM manaH saMsfjati na guRAnvE kadAcana ॥43॥

text: raśmīṃsteṣāṃ sa manasā yadā samyaṅniyacchati । tadā prakāśate'syātmā ghaṭe dīpo jvalanniva ॥44॥
html:
raśmīṃsteṣāṃ sa manasā yadā samyaṅniyacchati ।
tadā prakāśate'syātmā ghaṭe dīpo jvalanniva ॥44॥
slp1: raSmIMstezAM sa manasA yadA samyaNniyacCati । tadA prakASate'syAtmA Gawe dIpo jvalanniva ॥44॥

text: tyaktvā yaḥ prākṛtaṃ karma nityamātmaratirmuniḥ । sarvabhūtātmabhūtaḥ syātsa gacchetparamāṃ gatim ॥45॥
html:
tyaktvā yaḥ prākṛtaṃ karma nityamātmaratirmuniḥ ।
sarvabhūtātmabhūtaḥ syātsa gacchetparamāṃ gatim ॥45॥
slp1: tyaktvA yaH prAkftaM karma nityamAtmaratirmuniH । sarvaBUtAtmaBUtaH syAtsa gacCetparamAM gatim ॥45॥

text: yathā vāricaraḥ pakṣī lipyamāno na lipyate । evameva kṛtaprajño bhūteṣu parivartate ॥46॥
html:
yathā vāricaraḥ pakṣī lipyamāno na lipyate ।
evameva kṛtaprajño bhūteṣu parivartate ॥46॥
slp1: yaTA vAricaraH pakzI lipyamAno na lipyate । evameva kftaprajYo BUtezu parivartate ॥46॥

text: evaṃsvabhāvamevaitatsvabuddhyā viharennaraḥ । aśocannaprahṛṣyaṃśca caredvigatamatsaraḥ ॥47॥
html:
evaṃsvabhāvamevaitatsvabuddhyā viharennaraḥ ।
aśocannaprahṛṣyaṃśca caredvigatamatsaraḥ ॥47॥
slp1: evaMsvaBAvamevEtatsvabudDyA viharennaraH । aSocannaprahfzyaMSca caredvigatamatsaraH ॥47॥

text: svabhāvasiddhyā saṃsiddhānsa nityaṃ sṛjate guṇān । ūrṇanābhiryathā sraṣṭā vijñeyāstantuvadguṇāḥ ॥48॥
html:
svabhāvasiddhyā saṃsiddhānsa nityaṃ sṛjate guṇān ।
ūrṇanābhiryathā sraṣṭā vijñeyāstantuvadguṇāḥ ॥48॥
slp1: svaBAvasidDyA saMsidDAnsa nityaM sfjate guRAn । UrRanABiryaTA srazwA vijYeyAstantuvadguRAH ॥48॥

text: pradhvastā na nivartante nivṛttirnopalabhyate । pratyakṣeṇa parokṣaṃ tadanumānena sidhyati ॥49॥
html:
pradhvastā na nivartante nivṛttirnopalabhyate ।
pratyakṣeṇa parokṣaṃ tadanumānena sidhyati ॥49॥
slp1: praDvastA na nivartante nivfttirnopalaByate । pratyakzeRa parokzaM tadanumAnena siDyati ॥49॥

text: evameke vyavasyanti nivṛttiriti cāpare । ubhayaṃ sampradhāryaitadadhyavasyedyathāmati ॥50॥
html:
evameke vyavasyanti nivṛttiriti cāpare ।
ubhayaṃ sampradhāryaitadadhyavasyedyathāmati ॥50॥
slp1: evameke vyavasyanti nivfttiriti cApare । uBayaM sampraDAryEtadaDyavasyedyaTAmati ॥50॥

text: itīmaṃ hṛdayagranthiṃ buddhibhedamayaṃ dṛḍham । vimucya sukhamāsīta na śocecchinnasaṃśayaḥ ॥51॥
html:
itīmaṃ hṛdayagranthiṃ buddhibhedamayaṃ dṛḍham ।
vimucya sukhamāsīta na śocecchinnasaṃśayaḥ ॥51॥
slp1: itImaM hfdayagranTiM budDiBedamayaM dfQam । vimucya suKamAsIta na SocecCinnasaMSayaH ॥51॥

text: malināḥ prāpnuyuḥ śuddhiṃ yathā pūrṇāṃ nadīṃ narāḥ । avagāhya suvidvaṃso viddhi jñānamidaṃ tathā ॥52॥
html:
malināḥ prāpnuyuḥ śuddhiṃ yathā pūrṇāṃ nadīṃ narāḥ ।
avagāhya suvidvaṃso viddhi jñānamidaṃ tathā ॥52॥
slp1: malinAH prApnuyuH SudDiM yaTA pUrRAM nadIM narAH । avagAhya suvidvaMso vidDi jYAnamidaM taTA ॥52॥

text: mahānadīṃ hi pārajñastapyate na taranyathā । evaṃ ye viduradhyātmaṃ kaivalyaṃ jñānamuttamam ॥53॥
html:
mahānadīṃ hi pārajñastapyate na taranyathā ।
evaṃ ye viduradhyātmaṃ kaivalyaṃ jñānamuttamam ॥53॥
slp1: mahAnadIM hi pArajYastapyate na taranyaTA । evaM ye viduraDyAtmaM kEvalyaM jYAnamuttamam ॥53॥

text: etāṃ buddhvā naraḥ sarvāṃ bhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatim । avekṣya ca śanairbuddhyā labhate śaṃ paraṃ tataḥ ॥54॥
html:
etāṃ buddhvā naraḥ sarvāṃ bhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatim ।
avekṣya ca śanairbuddhyā labhate śaṃ paraṃ tataḥ ॥54॥
slp1: etAM budDvA naraH sarvAM BUtAnAmAgatiM gatim । avekzya ca SanErbudDyA laBate SaM paraM tataH ॥54॥

text: trivargo yasya viditaḥ prāgjyotiḥ sa vimucyate । anviṣya manasā yuktastattvadarśī nirutsukaḥ ॥55॥
html:
trivargo yasya viditaḥ prāgjyotiḥ sa vimucyate ।
anviṣya manasā yuktastattvadarśī nirutsukaḥ ॥55॥
slp1: trivargo yasya viditaH prAgjyotiH sa vimucyate । anvizya manasA yuktastattvadarSI nirutsukaH ॥55॥

text: na cātmā śakyate draṣṭumindriyeṣu vibhāgaśaḥ । tatra tatra visṛṣṭeṣu durjayeṣvakṛtātmabhiḥ ॥56॥
html:
na cātmā śakyate draṣṭumindriyeṣu vibhāgaśaḥ ।
tatra tatra visṛṣṭeṣu durjayeṣvakṛtātmabhiḥ ॥56॥
slp1: na cAtmA Sakyate drazwumindriyezu viBAgaSaH । tatra tatra visfzwezu durjayezvakftAtmaBiH ॥56॥

text: etadbuddhvā bhavedbuddhaḥ kimanyadbuddhalakṣaṇam । vijñāya taddhi manyante kṛtakṛtyā manīṣiṇaḥ ॥57॥
html:
etadbuddhvā bhavedbuddhaḥ kimanyadbuddhalakṣaṇam ।
vijñāya taddhi manyante kṛtakṛtyā manīṣiṇaḥ ॥57॥
slp1: etadbudDvA BavedbudDaH kimanyadbudDalakzaRam । vijYAya tadDi manyante kftakftyA manIziRaH ॥57॥

text: na bhavati viduṣāṃ tato bhayaṃ yadaviduṣāṃ sumahadbhayaṃ bhavet । na hi gatiradhikāsti kasya citsati hi guṇe pravadantyatulyatām ॥58॥
html:
na bhavati viduṣāṃ tato bhayaṃ yadaviduṣāṃ sumahadbhayaṃ bhavet ।
na hi gatiradhikāsti kasya citsati hi guṇe pravadantyatulyatām ॥58॥
slp1: na Bavati viduzAM tato BayaM yadaviduzAM sumahadBayaM Bavet । na hi gatiraDikAsti kasya citsati hi guRe pravadantyatulyatAm ॥58॥

text: yatkarotyanabhisandhipūrvakaṃ tacca nirṇudati yatpurā kṛtam । nāpriyaṃ tadubhayaṃ kutaḥ priyaṃ tasya tajjanayatīha kurvataḥ ॥59॥
html:
yatkarotyanabhisandhipūrvakaṃ tacca nirṇudati yatpurā kṛtam ।
nāpriyaṃ tadubhayaṃ kutaḥ priyaṃ tasya tajjanayatīha kurvataḥ ॥59॥
slp1: yatkarotyanaBisanDipUrvakaM tacca nirRudati yatpurA kftam । nApriyaM taduBayaM kutaH priyaM tasya tajjanayatIha kurvataH ॥59॥

text: loka āturajanānvirāviṇastattadeva bahu paśya śocataḥ । tatra paśya kuśalānaśocato ye vidustadubhayaṃ padaṃ sadā] ॥60॥
html:
loka āturajanānvirāviṇastattadeva bahu paśya śocataḥ ।
tatra paśya kuśalānaśocato ye vidustadubhayaṃ padaṃ sadā] ॥60॥
slp1: loka AturajanAnvirAviRastattadeva bahu paSya SocataH । tatra paSya kuSalAnaSocato ye vidustaduBayaM padaM sadA] ॥60॥

text: hanta vakṣyāmi te pārtha dhyānayogaṃ caturvidham । yaṃ jñātvā śāśvatīṃ siddhiṃ gacchanti paramarṣayaḥ ॥1॥
html:
hanta vakṣyāmi te pārtha dhyānayogaṃ caturvidham ।
yaṃ jñātvā śāśvatīṃ siddhiṃ gacchanti paramarṣayaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: hanta vakzyAmi te pArTa DyAnayogaM caturviDam । yaM jYAtvA SASvatIM sidDiM gacCanti paramarzayaH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yathā svanuṣṭhitaṃ dhyānaṃ tathā kurvanti yoginaḥ । maharṣayo jñānatṛptā nirvāṇagatamānasāḥ ॥2॥
html:
yathā svanuṣṭhitaṃ dhyānaṃ tathā kurvanti yoginaḥ ।
maharṣayo jñānatṛptā nirvāṇagatamānasāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: yaTA svanuzWitaM DyAnaM taTA kurvanti yoginaH । maharzayo jYAnatfptA nirvARagatamAnasAH ॥2॥

text: nāvartante punaḥ pārtha muktāḥ saṃsāradoṣataḥ । janmadoṣaparikṣīṇāḥ svabhāve paryavasthitāḥ ॥3॥
html:
nāvartante punaḥ pārtha muktāḥ saṃsāradoṣataḥ ।
janmadoṣaparikṣīṇāḥ svabhāve paryavasthitāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: nAvartante punaH pArTa muktAH saMsAradozataH । janmadozaparikzIRAH svaBAve paryavasTitAH ॥3॥

text: nirdvandvā nityasattvasthā vimuktā nityamāśritāḥ । asaṅgīnyavivādīni manaḥśāntikarāṇi ca ॥4॥
html:
nirdvandvā nityasattvasthā vimuktā nityamāśritāḥ ।
asaṅgīnyavivādīni manaḥśāntikarāṇi ca ॥4॥
slp1: nirdvandvA nityasattvasTA vimuktA nityamASritAH । asaNgInyavivAdIni manaHSAntikarARi ca ॥4॥

text: tatra svādhyāyasaṃśliṣṭamekāgraṃ dhārayenmanaḥ । piṇḍīkṛtyendriyagrāmamāsīnaḥ kāṣṭhavanmuniḥ ॥5॥
html:
tatra svādhyāyasaṃśliṣṭamekāgraṃ dhārayenmanaḥ ।
piṇḍīkṛtyendriyagrāmamāsīnaḥ kāṣṭhavanmuniḥ ॥5॥
slp1: tatra svADyAyasaMSlizwamekAgraM DArayenmanaH । piRqIkftyendriyagrAmamAsInaH kAzWavanmuniH ॥5॥

text: śabdaṃ na vindecchrotreṇa sparśaṃ tvacā na vedayet । rūpaṃ na cakṣuṣā vidyājjihvayā na rasāṃstathā ॥6॥
html:
śabdaṃ na vindecchrotreṇa sparśaṃ tvacā na vedayet ।
rūpaṃ na cakṣuṣā vidyājjihvayā na rasāṃstathā ॥6॥
slp1: SabdaM na vindecCrotreRa sparSaM tvacA na vedayet । rUpaM na cakzuzA vidyAjjihvayA na rasAMstaTA ॥6॥

text: ghreyāṇyapi ca sarvāṇi jahyāddhyānena yogavit । pañcavargapramāthīni neccheccaitāni vīryavān ॥7॥
html:
ghreyāṇyapi ca sarvāṇi jahyāddhyānena yogavit ।
pañcavargapramāthīni neccheccaitāni vīryavān ॥7॥
slp1: GreyARyapi ca sarvARi jahyAdDyAnena yogavit । paYcavargapramATIni necCeccEtAni vIryavAn ॥7॥

text: tato manasi saṃsajya pañcavargaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ । samādadhyānmano bhrāntamindriyaiḥ saha pañcabhiḥ ॥8॥
html:
tato manasi saṃsajya pañcavargaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ।
samādadhyānmano bhrāntamindriyaiḥ saha pañcabhiḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tato manasi saMsajya paYcavargaM vicakzaRaH । samAdaDyAnmano BrAntamindriyEH saha paYcaBiH ॥8॥

text: visañcāri nirālambaṃ pañcadvāraṃ calācalam । pūrve dhyānapathe dhīraḥ samādadhyānmano'ntaram ॥9॥
html:
visañcāri nirālambaṃ pañcadvāraṃ calācalam ।
pūrve dhyānapathe dhīraḥ samādadhyānmano'ntaram ॥9॥
slp1: visaYcAri nirAlambaM paYcadvAraM calAcalam । pUrve DyAnapaTe DIraH samAdaDyAnmano'ntaram ॥9॥

text: indriyāṇi manaścaiva yadā piṇḍīkarotyayam । eṣa dhyānapathaḥ pūrvo mayā samanuvarṇitaḥ ॥10॥
html:
indriyāṇi manaścaiva yadā piṇḍīkarotyayam ।
eṣa dhyānapathaḥ pūrvo mayā samanuvarṇitaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: indriyARi manaScEva yadA piRqIkarotyayam । eza DyAnapaTaH pUrvo mayA samanuvarRitaH ॥10॥

text: tasya tatpūrvasaṃruddhaṃ manaḥṣaṣṭhamanantaram । sphuriṣyati samudbhrāntaṃ vidyudambudhare yathā ॥11॥
html:
tasya tatpūrvasaṃruddhaṃ manaḥṣaṣṭhamanantaram ।
sphuriṣyati samudbhrāntaṃ vidyudambudhare yathā ॥11॥
slp1: tasya tatpUrvasaMrudDaM manaHzazWamanantaram । sPurizyati samudBrAntaM vidyudambuDare yaTA ॥11॥

text: jalabinduryathā lolaḥ parṇasthaḥ sarvataścalaḥ । evamevāsya taccittaṃ bhavati dhyānavartmani ॥12॥
html:
jalabinduryathā lolaḥ parṇasthaḥ sarvataścalaḥ ।
evamevāsya taccittaṃ bhavati dhyānavartmani ॥12॥
slp1: jalabinduryaTA lolaH parRasTaH sarvataScalaH । evamevAsya taccittaM Bavati DyAnavartmani ॥12॥

text: samāhitaṃ kṣaṇaṃ kiñciddhyānavartmani tiṣṭhati । punarvāyupathaṃ bhrāntaṃ mano bhavati vāyuvat ॥13॥
html:
samāhitaṃ kṣaṇaṃ kiñciddhyānavartmani tiṣṭhati ।
punarvāyupathaṃ bhrāntaṃ mano bhavati vāyuvat ॥13॥
slp1: samAhitaM kzaRaM kiYcidDyAnavartmani tizWati । punarvAyupaTaM BrAntaM mano Bavati vAyuvat ॥13॥

text: anirvedo gatakleśo gatatandrīramatsaraḥ । samādadhyātpunaśceto dhyānena dhyānayogavit ॥14॥
html:
anirvedo gatakleśo gatatandrīramatsaraḥ ।
samādadhyātpunaśceto dhyānena dhyānayogavit ॥14॥
slp1: anirvedo gatakleSo gatatandrIramatsaraH । samAdaDyAtpunaSceto DyAnena DyAnayogavit ॥14॥

text: vicāraśca vitarkaśca vivekaścopajāyate । muneḥ samādadhānasya prathamaṃ dhyānamāditaḥ ॥15॥
html:
vicāraśca vitarkaśca vivekaścopajāyate ।
muneḥ samādadhānasya prathamaṃ dhyānamāditaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: vicAraSca vitarkaSca vivekaScopajAyate । muneH samAdaDAnasya praTamaM DyAnamAditaH ॥15॥

text: manasā kliśyamānastu samādhānaṃ ca kārayet । na nirvedaṃ munirgacchetkuryādevātmano hitam ॥16॥
html:
manasā kliśyamānastu samādhānaṃ ca kārayet ।
na nirvedaṃ munirgacchetkuryādevātmano hitam ॥16॥
slp1: manasA kliSyamAnastu samADAnaM ca kArayet । na nirvedaM munirgacCetkuryAdevAtmano hitam ॥16॥

text: pāṃsubhasmakarīṣāṇāṃ yathā vai rāśayaścitāḥ । sahasā vāriṇā siktā na yānti paribhāvanām ॥17॥
html:
pāṃsubhasmakarīṣāṇāṃ yathā vai rāśayaścitāḥ ।
sahasā vāriṇā siktā na yānti paribhāvanām ॥17॥
slp1: pAMsuBasmakarIzARAM yaTA vE rASayaScitAH । sahasA vAriRA siktA na yAnti pariBAvanAm ॥17॥

text: kiñcitsnigdhaṃ yathā ca syācchuṣkacūrṇamabhāvitam । kramaśastu śanairgacchetsarvaṃ tatparibhāvanam ॥18॥
html:
kiñcitsnigdhaṃ yathā ca syācchuṣkacūrṇamabhāvitam ।
kramaśastu śanairgacchetsarvaṃ tatparibhāvanam ॥18॥
slp1: kiYcitsnigDaM yaTA ca syAcCuzkacUrRamaBAvitam । kramaSastu SanErgacCetsarvaM tatpariBAvanam ॥18॥

text: evamevendriyagrāmaṃ śanaiḥ saṃparibhāvayet । saṃharetkramaśaścaiva sa samyakpraśamiṣyati ॥19॥
html:
evamevendriyagrāmaṃ śanaiḥ saṃparibhāvayet ।
saṃharetkramaśaścaiva sa samyakpraśamiṣyati ॥19॥
slp1: evamevendriyagrAmaM SanEH saMpariBAvayet । saMharetkramaSaScEva sa samyakpraSamizyati ॥19॥

text: svayameva manaścaiva pañcavargaśca bhārata । pūrvaṃ dhyānapathaṃ prāpya nityayogena śāmyati ॥20॥
html:
svayameva manaścaiva pañcavargaśca bhārata ।
pūrvaṃ dhyānapathaṃ prāpya nityayogena śāmyati ॥20॥
slp1: svayameva manaScEva paYcavargaSca BArata । pUrvaM DyAnapaTaM prApya nityayogena SAmyati ॥20॥

text: na tatpuruṣakāreṇa na ca daivena kenacit । sukhameṣyati tattasya yadevaṃ saṃyatātmanaḥ ॥21॥
html:
na tatpuruṣakāreṇa na ca daivena kenacit ।
sukhameṣyati tattasya yadevaṃ saṃyatātmanaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: na tatpuruzakAreRa na ca dEvena kenacit । suKamezyati tattasya yadevaM saMyatAtmanaH ॥21॥

text: sukhena tena saṃyukto raṃsyate dhyānakarmaṇi । gacchanti yogino hyevaṃ nirvāṇaṃ tannirāmayam] ॥22॥
html:
sukhena tena saṃyukto raṃsyate dhyānakarmaṇi ।
gacchanti yogino hyevaṃ nirvāṇaṃ tannirāmayam] ॥22॥
slp1: suKena tena saMyukto raMsyate DyAnakarmaRi । gacCanti yogino hyevaM nirvARaM tannirAmayam] ॥22॥

text: cāturāśramyamuktaṃ te rājadharmāstathaiva ca । nānāśrayāśca bahava itihāsāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ ॥1॥
html:
cāturāśramyamuktaṃ te rājadharmāstathaiva ca ।
nānāśrayāśca bahava itihāsāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ ॥1॥
slp1: cAturASramyamuktaM te rAjaDarmAstaTEva ca । nAnASrayASca bahava itihAsAH pfTagviDAH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: śrutāstvattaḥ kathāścaiva dharmayuktā mahāmate । sandeho'sti tu kaścinme tadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥2॥
html:
śrutāstvattaḥ kathāścaiva dharmayuktā mahāmate ।
sandeho'sti tu kaścinme tadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥2॥
slp1: SrutAstvattaH kaTAScEva DarmayuktA mahAmate । sandeho'sti tu kaScinme tadBavAnvaktumarhati ॥2॥

text: jāpakānāṃ phalāvāptiṃ śrotumicchāmi bhārata । kiṃ phalaṃ japatāmuktaṃ kva vā tiṣṭhanti jāpakāḥ ॥3॥
html:
jāpakānāṃ phalāvāptiṃ śrotumicchāmi bhārata ।
kiṃ phalaṃ japatāmuktaṃ kva vā tiṣṭhanti jāpakāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: jApakAnAM PalAvAptiM SrotumicCAmi BArata । kiM PalaM japatAmuktaM kva vA tizWanti jApakAH ॥3॥

text: japasya ca vidhiṃ kṛtsnaṃ vaktumarhasi me'nagha । jāpakā iti kiṃ caitatsāṅkhyayogakriyāvidhiḥ ॥4॥
html:
japasya ca vidhiṃ kṛtsnaṃ vaktumarhasi me'nagha ।
jāpakā iti kiṃ caitatsāṅkhyayogakriyāvidhiḥ ॥4॥
slp1: japasya ca viDiM kftsnaM vaktumarhasi me'naGa । jApakA iti kiM cEtatsANKyayogakriyAviDiH ॥4॥

text: kiṃ yajñavidhirevaiṣa kimetajjapyamucyate । etanme sarvamācakṣva sarvajño hyasi me mataḥ ॥5॥
html:
kiṃ yajñavidhirevaiṣa kimetajjapyamucyate ।
etanme sarvamācakṣva sarvajño hyasi me mataḥ ॥5॥
slp1: kiM yajYaviDirevEza kimetajjapyamucyate । etanme sarvamAcakzva sarvajYo hyasi me mataH ॥5॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । yamasya yatpurā vṛttaṃ kālasya brāhmaṇasya ca ॥6॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
yamasya yatpurā vṛttaṃ kālasya brāhmaṇasya ca ॥6॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । yamasya yatpurA vfttaM kAlasya brAhmaRasya ca ॥6॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: saṃnyāsa eva vedānte vartate japanaṃ prati । vedavādābhinirvṛttā śāntirbrahmaṇyavasthitau । mārgau tāvapyubhāvetau saṃśritau na ca saṃśritau ॥7॥
html:
saṃnyāsa eva vedānte vartate japanaṃ prati ।
vedavādābhinirvṛttā śāntirbrahmaṇyavasthitau ।
mārgau tāvapyubhāvetau saṃśritau na ca saṃśritau ॥7॥
slp1: saMnyAsa eva vedAnte vartate japanaM prati । vedavAdABinirvfttA SAntirbrahmaRyavasTitO । mArgO tAvapyuBAvetO saMSritO na ca saMSritO ॥7॥

text: yathā saṃśrūyate rājankāraṇaṃ cātra vakṣyate । manaḥsamādhiratrāpi tathendriyajayaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥8॥
html:
yathā saṃśrūyate rājankāraṇaṃ cātra vakṣyate ।
manaḥsamādhiratrāpi tathendriyajayaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: yaTA saMSrUyate rAjankAraRaM cAtra vakzyate । manaHsamADiratrApi taTendriyajayaH smftaH ॥8॥

text: satyamagniparīcāro viviktānāṃ ca sevanam । dhyānaṃ tapo damaḥ kṣāntiranasūyā mitāśanam ॥9॥
html:
satyamagniparīcāro viviktānāṃ ca sevanam ।
dhyānaṃ tapo damaḥ kṣāntiranasūyā mitāśanam ॥9॥
slp1: satyamagniparIcAro viviktAnAM ca sevanam । DyAnaM tapo damaH kzAntiranasUyA mitASanam ॥9॥

text: viṣayapratisaṃhāro mitajalpastathā śamaḥ । eṣa pravṛttako dharmo nivṛttakamatho śṛṇu ॥10॥
html:
viṣayapratisaṃhāro mitajalpastathā śamaḥ ।
eṣa pravṛttako dharmo nivṛttakamatho śṛṇu ॥10॥
slp1: vizayapratisaMhAro mitajalpastaTA SamaH । eza pravfttako Darmo nivfttakamaTo SfRu ॥10॥

text: yathā nivartate karma japato brahmacāriṇaḥ । etatsarvamaśeṣeṇa yathoktaṃ parivarjayet । trividhaṃ mārgamāsādya vyaktāvyaktamanāśrayam ॥11॥
html:
yathā nivartate karma japato brahmacāriṇaḥ ।
etatsarvamaśeṣeṇa yathoktaṃ parivarjayet ।
trividhaṃ mārgamāsādya vyaktāvyaktamanāśrayam ॥11॥
slp1: yaTA nivartate karma japato brahmacAriRaH । etatsarvamaSezeRa yaToktaM parivarjayet । triviDaM mArgamAsAdya vyaktAvyaktamanASrayam ॥11॥

text: kuśoccayaniṣaṇṇaḥ sankuśahastaḥ kuśaiḥ śikhī । cīraiḥ parivṛtastasminmadhye channaḥ kuśaistathā ॥12॥
html:
kuśoccayaniṣaṇṇaḥ sankuśahastaḥ kuśaiḥ śikhī ।
cīraiḥ parivṛtastasminmadhye channaḥ kuśaistathā ॥12॥
slp1: kuSoccayanizaRRaH sankuSahastaH kuSEH SiKI । cIrEH parivftastasminmaDye CannaH kuSEstaTA ॥12॥

text: viṣayebhyo namaskuryādviṣayānna ca bhāvayet । sāmyamutpādya manaso manasyeva mano dadhat ॥13॥
html:
viṣayebhyo namaskuryādviṣayānna ca bhāvayet ।
sāmyamutpādya manaso manasyeva mano dadhat ॥13॥
slp1: vizayeByo namaskuryAdvizayAnna ca BAvayet । sAmyamutpAdya manaso manasyeva mano daDat ॥13॥

text: taddhiyā dhyāyati brahma japanvai saṃhitāṃ hitām । saṃnyasyatyatha vā tāṃ vai samādhau paryavasthitaḥ ॥14॥
html:
taddhiyā dhyāyati brahma japanvai saṃhitāṃ hitām ।
saṃnyasyatyatha vā tāṃ vai samādhau paryavasthitaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: tadDiyA DyAyati brahma japanvE saMhitAM hitAm । saMnyasyatyaTa vA tAM vE samADO paryavasTitaH ॥14॥

text: dhyānamutpādayatyatra saṃhitābalasaṃśrayāt । śuddhātmā tapasā dānto nivṛttadveṣakāmavān ॥15॥
html:
dhyānamutpādayatyatra saṃhitābalasaṃśrayāt ।
śuddhātmā tapasā dānto nivṛttadveṣakāmavān ॥15॥
slp1: DyAnamutpAdayatyatra saMhitAbalasaMSrayAt । SudDAtmA tapasA dAnto nivfttadvezakAmavAn ॥15॥

text: arāgamoho nirdvandvo na śocati na sajjate । na kartākaraṇīyānāṃ na kāryāṇāmiti sthitiḥ ॥16॥
html:
arāgamoho nirdvandvo na śocati na sajjate ।
na kartākaraṇīyānāṃ na kāryāṇāmiti sthitiḥ ॥16॥
slp1: arAgamoho nirdvandvo na Socati na sajjate । na kartAkaraRIyAnAM na kAryARAmiti sTitiH ॥16॥

text: na cāhaṅkārayogena manaḥ prasthāpayetkvacit । na cātmagrahaṇe yukto nāvamānī na cākriyaḥ ॥17॥
html:
na cāhaṅkārayogena manaḥ prasthāpayetkvacit ।
na cātmagrahaṇe yukto nāvamānī na cākriyaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: na cAhaNkArayogena manaH prasTApayetkvacit । na cAtmagrahaRe yukto nAvamAnI na cAkriyaH ॥17॥

text: dhyānakriyāparo yukto dhyānavāndhyānaniścayaḥ । dhyāne samādhimutpādya tadapi tyajati kramāt ॥18॥
html:
dhyānakriyāparo yukto dhyānavāndhyānaniścayaḥ ।
dhyāne samādhimutpādya tadapi tyajati kramāt ॥18॥
slp1: DyAnakriyAparo yukto DyAnavAnDyAnaniScayaH । DyAne samADimutpAdya tadapi tyajati kramAt ॥18॥

text: sa vai tasyāmavasthāyāṃ sarvatyāgakṛtaḥ sukhī । nirīhastyajati prāṇānbrāhmīṃ saṃśrayate tanum ॥19॥
html:
sa vai tasyāmavasthāyāṃ sarvatyāgakṛtaḥ sukhī ।
nirīhastyajati prāṇānbrāhmīṃ saṃśrayate tanum ॥19॥
slp1: sa vE tasyAmavasTAyAM sarvatyAgakftaH suKI । nirIhastyajati prARAnbrAhmIM saMSrayate tanum ॥19॥

text: atha vā necchate tatra brahmakāyaniṣevaṇam । utkrāmati ca mārgastho naiva kvacana jāyate ॥20॥
html:
atha vā necchate tatra brahmakāyaniṣevaṇam ।
utkrāmati ca mārgastho naiva kvacana jāyate ॥20॥
slp1: aTa vA necCate tatra brahmakAyanizevaRam । utkrAmati ca mArgasTo nEva kvacana jAyate ॥20॥

text: ātmabuddhiṃ samāsthāya śāntībhūto nirāmayaḥ । amṛtaṃ virajaḥśuddhamātmānaṃ pratipadyate] ॥21॥
html:
ātmabuddhiṃ samāsthāya śāntībhūto nirāmayaḥ ।
amṛtaṃ virajaḥśuddhamātmānaṃ pratipadyate] ॥21॥
slp1: AtmabudDiM samAsTAya SAntIBUto nirAmayaH । amftaM virajaHSudDamAtmAnaM pratipadyate] ॥21॥

text: gatīnāmuttamā prāptiḥ kathitā jāpakeṣviha । ekaivaiṣā gatisteṣāmuta yāntyaparāmapi ॥1॥
html:
gatīnāmuttamā prāptiḥ kathitā jāpakeṣviha ।
ekaivaiṣā gatisteṣāmuta yāntyaparāmapi ॥1॥
slp1: gatInAmuttamA prAptiH kaTitA jApakezviha । ekEvEzA gatistezAmuta yAntyaparAmapi ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājañjāpakānāṃ gatiṃ vibho । yathā gacchanti nirayamanekaṃ puruṣarṣabha ॥2॥
html:
śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājañjāpakānāṃ gatiṃ vibho ।
yathā gacchanti nirayamanekaṃ puruṣarṣabha ॥2॥
slp1: SfRuzvAvahito rAjaYjApakAnAM gatiM viBo । yaTA gacCanti nirayamanekaM puruzarzaBa ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yathoktametatpūrvaṃ yo nānutiṣṭhati jāpakaḥ । ekadeśakriyaścātra nirayaṃ sa nigacchati ॥3॥
html:
yathoktametatpūrvaṃ yo nānutiṣṭhati jāpakaḥ ।
ekadeśakriyaścātra nirayaṃ sa nigacchati ॥3॥
slp1: yaToktametatpUrvaM yo nAnutizWati jApakaH । ekadeSakriyaScAtra nirayaM sa nigacCati ॥3॥

text: avajñānena kurute na tuṣyati na śocati । īdṛśo jāpako yāti nirayaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥4॥
html:
avajñānena kurute na tuṣyati na śocati ।
īdṛśo jāpako yāti nirayaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: avajYAnena kurute na tuzyati na Socati । IdfSo jApako yAti nirayaM nAtra saMSayaH ॥4॥

text: ahaṅkārakṛtaścaiva sarve nirayagāminaḥ । parāvamānī puruṣo bhavitā nirayopagaḥ ॥5॥
html:
ahaṅkārakṛtaścaiva sarve nirayagāminaḥ ।
parāvamānī puruṣo bhavitā nirayopagaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: ahaNkArakftaScEva sarve nirayagAminaH । parAvamAnI puruzo BavitA nirayopagaH ॥5॥

text: abhidhyāpūrvakaṃ japyaṃ kurute yaśca mohitaḥ । yatrābhidhyāṃ sa kurute taṃ vai nirayamṛcchati ॥6॥
html:
abhidhyāpūrvakaṃ japyaṃ kurute yaśca mohitaḥ ।
yatrābhidhyāṃ sa kurute taṃ vai nirayamṛcchati ॥6॥
slp1: aBiDyApUrvakaM japyaM kurute yaSca mohitaH । yatrABiDyAM sa kurute taM vE nirayamfcCati ॥6॥

text: athaiśvaryapravṛttaḥ sañjāpakastatra rajyate । sa eva nirayastasya nāsau tasmātpramucyate ॥7॥
html:
athaiśvaryapravṛttaḥ sañjāpakastatra rajyate ।
sa eva nirayastasya nāsau tasmātpramucyate ॥7॥
slp1: aTESvaryapravfttaH saYjApakastatra rajyate । sa eva nirayastasya nAsO tasmAtpramucyate ॥7॥

text: rāgeṇa jāpako japyaṃ kurute tatra mohitaḥ । yatrāsya rāgaḥ patati tatra tatropajāyate ॥8॥
html:
rāgeṇa jāpako japyaṃ kurute tatra mohitaḥ ।
yatrāsya rāgaḥ patati tatra tatropajāyate ॥8॥
slp1: rAgeRa jApako japyaM kurute tatra mohitaH । yatrAsya rAgaH patati tatra tatropajAyate ॥8॥

text: durbuddhirakṛtaprajñaścale manasi tiṣṭhati । calāmeva gatiṃ yāti nirayaṃ vādhigacchati ॥9॥
html:
durbuddhirakṛtaprajñaścale manasi tiṣṭhati ।
calāmeva gatiṃ yāti nirayaṃ vādhigacchati ॥9॥
slp1: durbudDirakftaprajYaScale manasi tizWati । calAmeva gatiM yAti nirayaM vADigacCati ॥9॥

text: akṛtaprajñako bālo mohaṃ gacchati jāpakaḥ । sa mohānnirayaṃ yāti tatra gatvānuśocati ॥10॥
html:
akṛtaprajñako bālo mohaṃ gacchati jāpakaḥ ।
sa mohānnirayaṃ yāti tatra gatvānuśocati ॥10॥
slp1: akftaprajYako bAlo mohaM gacCati jApakaH । sa mohAnnirayaM yAti tatra gatvAnuSocati ॥10॥

text: dṛḍhagrāhī karomīti japyaṃ japati jāpakaḥ । na saṃpūrṇo na vā yukto nirayaṃ so'dhigacchati ॥11॥
html:
dṛḍhagrāhī karomīti japyaṃ japati jāpakaḥ ।
na saṃpūrṇo na vā yukto nirayaṃ so'dhigacchati ॥11॥
slp1: dfQagrAhI karomIti japyaM japati jApakaH । na saMpUrRo na vA yukto nirayaM so'DigacCati ॥11॥

text: animittaṃ paraṃ yattadavyaktaṃ brahmaṇi sthitam । sadbhūto jāpakaḥ kasmātsa śarīramathāviśet ॥12॥
html:
animittaṃ paraṃ yattadavyaktaṃ brahmaṇi sthitam ।
sadbhūto jāpakaḥ kasmātsa śarīramathāviśet ॥12॥
slp1: animittaM paraM yattadavyaktaM brahmaRi sTitam । sadBUto jApakaH kasmAtsa SarIramaTAviSet ॥12॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: duṣprajñānena nirayā bahavaḥ samudāhṛtāḥ । praśastaṃ jāpakatvaṃ ca doṣāścaite tadātmakāḥ] ॥13॥
html:
duṣprajñānena nirayā bahavaḥ samudāhṛtāḥ ।
praśastaṃ jāpakatvaṃ ca doṣāścaite tadātmakāḥ] ॥13॥
slp1: duzprajYAnena nirayA bahavaH samudAhftAH । praSastaM jApakatvaM ca dozAScEte tadAtmakAH] ॥13॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kīdṛśo jāpako yāti nirayaṃ varṇayasva me । kautūhalaṃ hi me jātaṃ tadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥1॥
html:
kīdṛśo jāpako yāti nirayaṃ varṇayasva me ।
kautūhalaṃ hi me jātaṃ tadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥1॥
slp1: kIdfSo jApako yAti nirayaM varRayasva me । kOtUhalaM hi me jAtaM tadBavAnvaktumarhati ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: dharmasyāṃśaḥ prasūto'si dharmiṣṭho'si svabhāvataḥ । dharmamūlāśrayaṃ vākyaṃ śṛṇuṣvāvahito'nagha ॥2॥
html:
dharmasyāṃśaḥ prasūto'si dharmiṣṭho'si svabhāvataḥ ।
dharmamūlāśrayaṃ vākyaṃ śṛṇuṣvāvahito'nagha ॥2॥
slp1: DarmasyAMSaH prasUto'si DarmizWo'si svaBAvataH । DarmamUlASrayaM vAkyaM SfRuzvAvahito'naGa ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: amūni yāni sthānāni devānāṃ paramātmanām । nānāsaṃsthānavarṇāni nānārūpaphalāni ca ॥3॥
html:
amūni yāni sthānāni devānāṃ paramātmanām ।
nānāsaṃsthānavarṇāni nānārūpaphalāni ca ॥3॥
slp1: amUni yAni sTAnAni devAnAM paramAtmanAm । nAnAsaMsTAnavarRAni nAnArUpaPalAni ca ॥3॥

text: divyāni kāmacārīṇi vimānāni sabhāstathā । ākrīḍā vividhā rājanpadminyaścāmalodakāḥ ॥4॥
html:
divyāni kāmacārīṇi vimānāni sabhāstathā ।
ākrīḍā vividhā rājanpadminyaścāmalodakāḥ ॥4॥
slp1: divyAni kAmacArIRi vimAnAni saBAstaTA । AkrIqA viviDA rAjanpadminyaScAmalodakAH ॥4॥

text: caturṇāṃ lokapālānāṃ śukrasyātha bṛhaspateḥ । marutāṃ viśvadevānāṃ sādhyānāmaśvinorapi ॥5॥
html:
caturṇāṃ lokapālānāṃ śukrasyātha bṛhaspateḥ ।
marutāṃ viśvadevānāṃ sādhyānāmaśvinorapi ॥5॥
slp1: caturRAM lokapAlAnAM SukrasyATa bfhaspateH । marutAM viSvadevAnAM sADyAnAmaSvinorapi ॥5॥

text: rudrādityavasūnāṃ ca tathānyeṣāṃ divaukasām । ete vai nirayāstāta sthānasya paramātmanaḥ ॥6॥
html:
rudrādityavasūnāṃ ca tathānyeṣāṃ divaukasām ।
ete vai nirayāstāta sthānasya paramātmanaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: rudrAdityavasUnAM ca taTAnyezAM divOkasAm । ete vE nirayAstAta sTAnasya paramAtmanaH ॥6॥

text: abhayaṃ cānimittaṃ ca na ca kleśabhayāvṛtam । dvābhyāṃ muktaṃ tribhirmuktamaṣṭābhistribhireva ca ॥7॥
html:
abhayaṃ cānimittaṃ ca na ca kleśabhayāvṛtam ।
dvābhyāṃ muktaṃ tribhirmuktamaṣṭābhistribhireva ca ॥7॥
slp1: aBayaM cAnimittaM ca na ca kleSaBayAvftam । dvAByAM muktaM triBirmuktamazwABistriBireva ca ॥7॥

text: caturlakṣaṇavarjaṃ tu catuṣkāraṇavarjitam । apraharṣamanānandamaśokaṃ vigataklamam ॥8॥
html:
caturlakṣaṇavarjaṃ tu catuṣkāraṇavarjitam ।
apraharṣamanānandamaśokaṃ vigataklamam ॥8॥
slp1: caturlakzaRavarjaM tu catuzkAraRavarjitam । apraharzamanAnandamaSokaM vigataklamam ॥8॥

text: kālaḥ sampacyate tatra na kālastatra vai prabhuḥ । sa kālasya prabhū rājansvargasyāpi tatheśvaraḥ ॥9॥
html:
kālaḥ sampacyate tatra na kālastatra vai prabhuḥ ।
sa kālasya prabhū rājansvargasyāpi tatheśvaraḥ ॥9॥
slp1: kAlaH sampacyate tatra na kAlastatra vE praBuH । sa kAlasya praBU rAjansvargasyApi taTeSvaraH ॥9॥

text: ātmakevalatāṃ prāptastatra gatvā na śocati । īdṛśaṃ paramaṃ sthānaṃ nirayāste ca tādṛśāḥ ॥10॥
html:
ātmakevalatāṃ prāptastatra gatvā na śocati ।
īdṛśaṃ paramaṃ sthānaṃ nirayāste ca tādṛśāḥ ॥10॥
slp1: AtmakevalatAM prAptastatra gatvA na Socati । IdfSaM paramaM sTAnaM nirayAste ca tAdfSAH ॥10॥

text: ete te nirayāḥ proktāḥ sarva eva yathātatham । tasya sthānavarasyeha sarve nirayasañjñitāḥ] ॥11॥
html:
ete te nirayāḥ proktāḥ sarva eva yathātatham ।
tasya sthānavarasyeha sarve nirayasañjñitāḥ] ॥11॥
slp1: ete te nirayAH proktAH sarva eva yaTAtaTam । tasya sTAnavarasyeha sarve nirayasaYjYitAH] ॥11॥

text: kālamṛtyuyamānāṃ ca brāhmaṇasya ca sattama । vivādo vyāhṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ tadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥1॥
html:
kālamṛtyuyamānāṃ ca brāhmaṇasya ca sattama ।
vivādo vyāhṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ tadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥1॥
slp1: kAlamftyuyamAnAM ca brAhmaRasya ca sattama । vivAdo vyAhftaH pUrvaM tadBavAnvaktumarhati ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । ikṣvākoḥ sūryaputrasya yadvṛttaṃ brāhmaṇasya ca ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
ikṣvākoḥ sūryaputrasya yadvṛttaṃ brāhmaṇasya ca ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । ikzvAkoH sUryaputrasya yadvfttaM brAhmaRasya ca ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kālasya mṛtyośca tathā yadvṛttaṃ tannibodha me । yathā sa teṣāṃ saṃvādo yasminsthāne'pi cābhavat ॥3॥
html:
kālasya mṛtyośca tathā yadvṛttaṃ tannibodha me ।
yathā sa teṣāṃ saṃvādo yasminsthāne'pi cābhavat ॥3॥
slp1: kAlasya mftyoSca taTA yadvfttaM tanniboDa me । yaTA sa tezAM saMvAdo yasminsTAne'pi cABavat ॥3॥

text: brāhmaṇo jāpakaḥ kaściddharmavṛtto mahāyaśāḥ । ṣaḍaṅgavinmahāprājñaḥ paippalādiḥ sa kauśikaḥ ॥4॥
html:
brāhmaṇo jāpakaḥ kaściddharmavṛtto mahāyaśāḥ ।
ṣaḍaṅgavinmahāprājñaḥ paippalādiḥ sa kauśikaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: brAhmaRo jApakaH kaScidDarmavftto mahAyaSAH । zaqaNgavinmahAprAjYaH pEppalAdiH sa kOSikaH ॥4॥

text: tasyāparokṣaṃ vijñānaṃ ṣaḍaṅgeṣu tathaiva ca । vedeṣu caiva niṣṇāto himavatpādasaṃśrayaḥ ॥5॥
html:
tasyāparokṣaṃ vijñānaṃ ṣaḍaṅgeṣu tathaiva ca ।
vedeṣu caiva niṣṇāto himavatpādasaṃśrayaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: tasyAparokzaM vijYAnaM zaqaNgezu taTEva ca । vedezu cEva nizRAto himavatpAdasaMSrayaH ॥5॥

text: so'ntyaṃ brāhmaṃ tapastepe saṃhitāṃ saṃyato japan । tasya varṣasahasraṃ tu niyamena tathā gatam ॥6॥
html:
so'ntyaṃ brāhmaṃ tapastepe saṃhitāṃ saṃyato japan ।
tasya varṣasahasraṃ tu niyamena tathā gatam ॥6॥
slp1: so'ntyaM brAhmaM tapastepe saMhitAM saMyato japan । tasya varzasahasraM tu niyamena taTA gatam ॥6॥

text: sa devyā darśitaḥ sākṣātprītāsmīti tadā kila । japyamāvartayaṃstūṣṇīṃ na ca tāṃ kiñcidabravīt ॥7॥
html:
sa devyā darśitaḥ sākṣātprītāsmīti tadā kila ।
japyamāvartayaṃstūṣṇīṃ na ca tāṃ kiñcidabravīt ॥7॥
slp1: sa devyA darSitaH sAkzAtprItAsmIti tadA kila । japyamAvartayaMstUzRIM na ca tAM kiYcidabravIt ॥7॥

text: tasyānukampayā devī prītā samabhavattadā । vedamātā tatastasya tajjapyaṃ samapūjayat ॥8॥
html:
tasyānukampayā devī prītā samabhavattadā ।
vedamātā tatastasya tajjapyaṃ samapūjayat ॥8॥
slp1: tasyAnukampayA devI prItA samaBavattadA । vedamAtA tatastasya tajjapyaM samapUjayat ॥8॥

text: samāptajapyastūtthāya śirasā pādayostathā । papāta devyā dharmātmā vacanaṃ cedamabravīt ॥9॥
html:
samāptajapyastūtthāya śirasā pādayostathā ।
papāta devyā dharmātmā vacanaṃ cedamabravīt ॥9॥
slp1: samAptajapyastUtTAya SirasA pAdayostaTA । papAta devyA DarmAtmA vacanaM cedamabravIt ॥9॥

text: diṣṭyā devi prasannā tvaṃ darśanaṃ cāgatā mama । yadi vāpi prasannāsi japye me ramatāṃ manaḥ ॥10॥
html:
diṣṭyā devi prasannā tvaṃ darśanaṃ cāgatā mama ।
yadi vāpi prasannāsi japye me ramatāṃ manaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: dizwyA devi prasannA tvaM darSanaM cAgatA mama । yadi vApi prasannAsi japye me ramatAM manaH ॥10॥

text: kiṃ prārthayasi viprarṣe kiṃ ceṣṭaṃ karavāṇi te । prabrūhi japatāṃ śreṣṭha sarvaṃ tatte bhaviṣyati ॥11॥
html:
kiṃ prārthayasi viprarṣe kiṃ ceṣṭaṃ karavāṇi te ।
prabrūhi japatāṃ śreṣṭha sarvaṃ tatte bhaviṣyati ॥11॥
slp1: kiM prArTayasi viprarze kiM cezwaM karavARi te । prabrUhi japatAM SrezWa sarvaM tatte Bavizyati ॥11॥
author: sāvitryuvāca ।

text: ityuktaḥ sa tadā devyā vipraḥ provāca dharmavit । japyaṃ prati mameccheyaṃ vardhatviti punaḥ punaḥ ॥12॥
html:
ityuktaḥ sa tadā devyā vipraḥ provāca dharmavit ।
japyaṃ prati mameccheyaṃ vardhatviti punaḥ punaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: ityuktaH sa tadA devyA vipraH provAca Darmavit । japyaM prati mamecCeyaM varDatviti punaH punaH ॥12॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: manasaśca samādhirme vardhetāharahaḥ śubhe । tattatheti tato devī madhuraṃ pratyabhāṣata ॥13॥
html:
manasaśca samādhirme vardhetāharahaḥ śubhe ।
tattatheti tato devī madhuraṃ pratyabhāṣata ॥13॥
slp1: manasaSca samADirme varDetAharahaH SuBe । tattaTeti tato devI maDuraM pratyaBAzata ॥13॥

text: idaṃ caivāparaṃ prāha devī tatpriyakāmyayā । nirayaṃ naiva yātāsi yatra yātā dvijarṣabhāḥ ॥14॥
html:
idaṃ caivāparaṃ prāha devī tatpriyakāmyayā ।
nirayaṃ naiva yātāsi yatra yātā dvijarṣabhāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: idaM cEvAparaM prAha devI tatpriyakAmyayA । nirayaM nEva yAtAsi yatra yAtA dvijarzaBAH ॥14॥

text: yāsyasi brahmaṇaḥ sthānamanimittamaninditam । sādhaye bhavitā caitadyattvayāhamihārthitā ॥15॥
html:
yāsyasi brahmaṇaḥ sthānamanimittamaninditam ।
sādhaye bhavitā caitadyattvayāhamihārthitā ॥15॥
slp1: yAsyasi brahmaRaH sTAnamanimittamaninditam । sADaye BavitA cEtadyattvayAhamihArTitA ॥15॥

text: niyato japa caikāgro dharmastvāṃ samupaiṣyati । kālo mṛtyuryamaścaiva samāyāsyanti te'ntikam । bhavitā ca vivādo'tra tava teṣāṃ ca dharmataḥ ॥16॥
html:
niyato japa caikāgro dharmastvāṃ samupaiṣyati ।
kālo mṛtyuryamaścaiva samāyāsyanti te'ntikam ।
bhavitā ca vivādo'tra tava teṣāṃ ca dharmataḥ ॥16॥
slp1: niyato japa cEkAgro DarmastvAM samupEzyati । kAlo mftyuryamaScEva samAyAsyanti te'ntikam । BavitA ca vivAdo'tra tava tezAM ca DarmataH ॥16॥

text: evamuktvā bhagavatī jagāma bhavanaṃ svakam । brāhmaṇo'pi japannāste divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ tadā ॥17॥
html:
evamuktvā bhagavatī jagāma bhavanaṃ svakam ।
brāhmaṇo'pi japannāste divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ tadā ॥17॥
slp1: evamuktvA BagavatI jagAma BavanaM svakam । brAhmaRo'pi japannAste divyaM varzaSataM tadA ॥17॥

text: samāpte niyame tasminnatha viprasya dhīmataḥ । sākṣātprītastadā dharmo darśayāmāsa taṃ dvijam ॥18॥
html:
samāpte niyame tasminnatha viprasya dhīmataḥ ।
sākṣātprītastadā dharmo darśayāmāsa taṃ dvijam ॥18॥
slp1: samApte niyame tasminnaTa viprasya DImataH । sAkzAtprItastadA Darmo darSayAmAsa taM dvijam ॥18॥

text: dvijāte paśya māṃ dharmamahaṃ tvāṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ । japyasya ca phalaṃ yatte samprāptaṃ tacca me śṛṇu ॥19॥
html:
dvijāte paśya māṃ dharmamahaṃ tvāṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ ।
japyasya ca phalaṃ yatte samprāptaṃ tacca me śṛṇu ॥19॥
slp1: dvijAte paSya mAM DarmamahaM tvAM drazwumAgataH । japyasya ca PalaM yatte samprAptaM tacca me SfRu ॥19॥
author: dharma uvāca ।

text: jitā lokāstvayā sarve ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ । devānāṃ nirayānsādho sarvānutkramya yāsyasi ॥20॥
html:
jitā lokāstvayā sarve ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ ।
devānāṃ nirayānsādho sarvānutkramya yāsyasi ॥20॥
slp1: jitA lokAstvayA sarve ye divyA ye ca mAnuzAH । devAnAM nirayAnsADo sarvAnutkramya yAsyasi ॥20॥

text: prāṇatyāgaṃ kuru mune gaccha lokānyathepsitān । tyaktvātmanaḥ śarīraṃ ca tato lokānavāpsyasi ॥21॥
html:
prāṇatyāgaṃ kuru mune gaccha lokānyathepsitān ।
tyaktvātmanaḥ śarīraṃ ca tato lokānavāpsyasi ॥21॥
slp1: prARatyAgaM kuru mune gacCa lokAnyaTepsitAn । tyaktvAtmanaH SarIraM ca tato lokAnavApsyasi ॥21॥

text: kṛtaṃ lokairhi me dharma gaccha ca tvaṃ yathāsukham । bahuduḥkhasukhaṃ dehaṃ notsṛjeyamahaṃ vibho ॥22॥
html:
kṛtaṃ lokairhi me dharma gaccha ca tvaṃ yathāsukham ।
bahuduḥkhasukhaṃ dehaṃ notsṛjeyamahaṃ vibho ॥22॥
slp1: kftaM lokErhi me Darma gacCa ca tvaM yaTAsuKam । bahuduHKasuKaM dehaM notsfjeyamahaM viBo ॥22॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: avaśyaṃ bhoḥ śarīraṃ te tyaktavyaṃ munipuṅgava । svarga ārohyatāṃ vipra kiṃ vā te rocate'nagha ॥23॥
html:
avaśyaṃ bhoḥ śarīraṃ te tyaktavyaṃ munipuṅgava ।
svarga ārohyatāṃ vipra kiṃ vā te rocate'nagha ॥23॥
slp1: avaSyaM BoH SarIraM te tyaktavyaM munipuNgava । svarga ArohyatAM vipra kiM vA te rocate'naGa ॥23॥
author: dharma uvāca ।

text: na rocaye svargavāsaṃ vinā dehādahaṃ vibho । gaccha dharma na me śraddhā svargaṃ gantuṃ vinātmanā ॥24॥
html:
na rocaye svargavāsaṃ vinā dehādahaṃ vibho ।
gaccha dharma na me śraddhā svargaṃ gantuṃ vinātmanā ॥24॥
slp1: na rocaye svargavAsaM vinA dehAdahaM viBo । gacCa Darma na me SradDA svargaM gantuM vinAtmanA ॥24॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: alaṃ dehe manaḥ kṛtvā tyaktvā dehaṃ sukhī bhava । gaccha lokānarajaso yatra gatvā na śocasi ॥25॥
html:
alaṃ dehe manaḥ kṛtvā tyaktvā dehaṃ sukhī bhava ।
gaccha lokānarajaso yatra gatvā na śocasi ॥25॥
slp1: alaM dehe manaH kftvA tyaktvA dehaM suKI Bava । gacCa lokAnarajaso yatra gatvA na Socasi ॥25॥
author: dharma uvāca ।

text: rame japanmahābhāga kṛtaṃ lokaiḥ sanātanaiḥ । saśarīreṇa gantavyo mayā svargo na vā vibho ॥26॥
html:
rame japanmahābhāga kṛtaṃ lokaiḥ sanātanaiḥ ।
saśarīreṇa gantavyo mayā svargo na vā vibho ॥26॥
slp1: rame japanmahABAga kftaM lokEH sanAtanEH । saSarIreRa gantavyo mayA svargo na vA viBo ॥26॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: yadi tvaṃ necchasi tyaktuṃ śarīraṃ paśya vai dvija । eṣa kālastathā mṛtyuryamaśca tvāmupāgatāḥ ॥27॥
html:
yadi tvaṃ necchasi tyaktuṃ śarīraṃ paśya vai dvija ।
eṣa kālastathā mṛtyuryamaśca tvāmupāgatāḥ ॥27॥
slp1: yadi tvaM necCasi tyaktuM SarIraM paSya vE dvija । eza kAlastaTA mftyuryamaSca tvAmupAgatAH ॥27॥
author: dharma uvāca ।

text: atha vaivasvataḥ kālo mṛtyuśca tritayaṃ vibho । brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ mahābhāgamupāgamyedamabruvan ॥28॥
html:
atha vaivasvataḥ kālo mṛtyuśca tritayaṃ vibho ।
brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ mahābhāgamupāgamyedamabruvan ॥28॥
slp1: aTa vEvasvataH kAlo mftyuSca tritayaM viBo । brAhmaRaM taM mahABAgamupAgamyedamabruvan ॥28॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tapaso'sya sutaptasya tathā sucaritasya ca । phalaprāptistava śreṣṭhā yamo'haṃ tvāmupabruve ॥29॥
html:
tapaso'sya sutaptasya tathā sucaritasya ca ।
phalaprāptistava śreṣṭhā yamo'haṃ tvāmupabruve ॥29॥
slp1: tapaso'sya sutaptasya taTA sucaritasya ca । PalaprAptistava SrezWA yamo'haM tvAmupabruve ॥29॥

text: yathāvadasya japyasya phalaṃ prāptastvamuttamam । kālaste svargamāroḍhuṃ kālo'haṃ tvāmupāgataḥ ॥30॥
html:
yathāvadasya japyasya phalaṃ prāptastvamuttamam ।
kālaste svargamāroḍhuṃ kālo'haṃ tvāmupāgataḥ ॥30॥
slp1: yaTAvadasya japyasya PalaM prAptastvamuttamam । kAlaste svargamAroQuM kAlo'haM tvAmupAgataH ॥30॥

text: mṛtyuṃ mā viddhi dharmajña rūpiṇaṃ svayamāgatam । kālena coditaṃ vipra tvāmito netumadya vai ॥31॥
html:
mṛtyuṃ mā viddhi dharmajña rūpiṇaṃ svayamāgatam ।
kālena coditaṃ vipra tvāmito netumadya vai ॥31॥
slp1: mftyuM mA vidDi DarmajYa rUpiRaM svayamAgatam । kAlena coditaM vipra tvAmito netumadya vE ॥31॥

text: svāgataṃ sūryaputrāya kālāya ca mahātmane । mṛtyave cātha dharmāya kiṃ kāryaṃ karavāṇi vaḥ ॥32॥
html:
svāgataṃ sūryaputrāya kālāya ca mahātmane ।
mṛtyave cātha dharmāya kiṃ kāryaṃ karavāṇi vaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: svAgataM sUryaputrAya kAlAya ca mahAtmane । mftyave cATa DarmAya kiM kAryaM karavARi vaH ॥32॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: arghyaṃ pādyaṃ ca dattvā sa tebhyastatra samāgame । abravītparamaprītaḥ svaśaktyā kiṃ karomi vaḥ ॥33॥
html:
arghyaṃ pādyaṃ ca dattvā sa tebhyastatra samāgame ।
abravītparamaprītaḥ svaśaktyā kiṃ karomi vaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: arGyaM pAdyaM ca dattvA sa teByastatra samAgame । abravItparamaprItaH svaSaktyA kiM karomi vaH ॥33॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tasminnevātha kāle tu tīrthayātrāmupāgataḥ । ikṣvākuragamattatra sametā yatra te vibho ॥34॥
html:
tasminnevātha kāle tu tīrthayātrāmupāgataḥ ।
ikṣvākuragamattatra sametā yatra te vibho ॥34॥
slp1: tasminnevATa kAle tu tIrTayAtrAmupAgataH । ikzvAkuragamattatra sametA yatra te viBo ॥34॥

text: sarvāneva tu rājarṣiḥ sampūjyābhipraṇamya ca । kuśalapraśnamakarotsarveṣāṃ rājasattamaḥ ॥35॥
html:
sarvāneva tu rājarṣiḥ sampūjyābhipraṇamya ca ।
kuśalapraśnamakarotsarveṣāṃ rājasattamaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: sarvAneva tu rAjarziH sampUjyABipraRamya ca । kuSalapraSnamakarotsarvezAM rAjasattamaH ॥35॥

text: tasmai so'thāsanaṃ dattvā pādyamarghyaṃ tathaiva ca । abravīdbrāhmaṇo vākyaṃ kṛtvā kuśalasaṃvidam ॥36॥
html:
tasmai so'thāsanaṃ dattvā pādyamarghyaṃ tathaiva ca ।
abravīdbrāhmaṇo vākyaṃ kṛtvā kuśalasaṃvidam ॥36॥
slp1: tasmE so'TAsanaM dattvA pAdyamarGyaM taTEva ca । abravIdbrAhmaRo vAkyaM kftvA kuSalasaMvidam ॥36॥

text: svāgataṃ te mahārāja brūhi yadyadihecchasi । svaśaktyā kiṃ karomīha tadbhavānprabravītu me ॥37॥
html:
svāgataṃ te mahārāja brūhi yadyadihecchasi ।
svaśaktyā kiṃ karomīha tadbhavānprabravītu me ॥37॥
slp1: svAgataM te mahArAja brUhi yadyadihecCasi । svaSaktyA kiM karomIha tadBavAnprabravItu me ॥37॥

text: rājāhaṃ brāhmaṇaśca tvaṃ yadi ṣaṭkarmasaṃsthitaḥ । dadāmi vasu kiñcitte prārthitaṃ tadvadasva me ॥38॥
html:
rājāhaṃ brāhmaṇaśca tvaṃ yadi ṣaṭkarmasaṃsthitaḥ ।
dadāmi vasu kiñcitte prārthitaṃ tadvadasva me ॥38॥
slp1: rAjAhaM brAhmaRaSca tvaM yadi zawkarmasaMsTitaH । dadAmi vasu kiYcitte prArTitaM tadvadasva me ॥38॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: dvividhā brāhmaṇā rājandharmaśca dvividhaḥ smṛtaḥ । pravṛttaśca nivṛttaśca nivṛtto'smi pratigrahāt ॥39॥
html:
dvividhā brāhmaṇā rājandharmaśca dvividhaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
pravṛttaśca nivṛttaśca nivṛtto'smi pratigrahāt ॥39॥
slp1: dviviDA brAhmaRA rAjanDarmaSca dviviDaH smftaH । pravfttaSca nivfttaSca nivftto'smi pratigrahAt ॥39॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: tebhyaḥ prayaccha dānāni ye pravṛttā narādhipa । ahaṃ na pratigṛhṇāmi kimiṣṭaṃ kiṃ dadāni te । brūhi tvaṃ nṛpatiśreṣṭha tapasā sādhayāmi kim ॥40॥
html:
tebhyaḥ prayaccha dānāni ye pravṛttā narādhipa ।
ahaṃ na pratigṛhṇāmi kimiṣṭaṃ kiṃ dadāni te ।
brūhi tvaṃ nṛpatiśreṣṭha tapasā sādhayāmi kim ॥40॥
slp1: teByaH prayacCa dAnAni ye pravfttA narADipa । ahaM na pratigfhRAmi kimizwaM kiM dadAni te । brUhi tvaM nfpatiSrezWa tapasA sADayAmi kim ॥40॥

text: kṣatriyo'haṃ na jānāmi dehīti vacanaṃ kvacit । prayaccha yuddhamityevaṃ vādinaḥ smo dvijottama ॥41॥
html:
kṣatriyo'haṃ na jānāmi dehīti vacanaṃ kvacit ।
prayaccha yuddhamityevaṃ vādinaḥ smo dvijottama ॥41॥
slp1: kzatriyo'haM na jAnAmi dehIti vacanaM kvacit । prayacCa yudDamityevaM vAdinaH smo dvijottama ॥41॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: tuṣyasi tvaṃ svadharmeṇa tathā tuṣṭā vayaṃ nṛpa । anyonyasyottaraṃ nāsti yadiṣṭaṃ tatsamācara ॥42॥
html:
tuṣyasi tvaṃ svadharmeṇa tathā tuṣṭā vayaṃ nṛpa ।
anyonyasyottaraṃ nāsti yadiṣṭaṃ tatsamācara ॥42॥
slp1: tuzyasi tvaM svaDarmeRa taTA tuzwA vayaM nfpa । anyonyasyottaraM nAsti yadizwaM tatsamAcara ॥42॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: svaśaktyāhaṃ dadānīti tvayā pūrvaṃ prabhāṣitam । yāce tvāṃ dīyatāṃ mahyaṃ japyasyāsya phalaṃ dvija ॥43॥
html:
svaśaktyāhaṃ dadānīti tvayā pūrvaṃ prabhāṣitam ।
yāce tvāṃ dīyatāṃ mahyaṃ japyasyāsya phalaṃ dvija ॥43॥
slp1: svaSaktyAhaM dadAnIti tvayA pUrvaM praBAzitam । yAce tvAM dIyatAM mahyaM japyasyAsya PalaM dvija ॥43॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: yuddhaṃ mama sadā vāṇī yācatīti vikatthase । na ca yuddhaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ kimarthaṃ yācase punaḥ ॥44॥
html:
yuddhaṃ mama sadā vāṇī yācatīti vikatthase ।
na ca yuddhaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ kimarthaṃ yācase punaḥ ॥44॥
slp1: yudDaM mama sadA vARI yAcatIti vikatTase । na ca yudDaM mayA sArDaM kimarTaM yAcase punaH ॥44॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: vāgvajrā brāhmaṇāḥ proktāḥ kṣatriyā bāhujīvinaḥ । vāgyuddhaṃ tadidaṃ tīvraṃ mama vipra tvayā saha ॥45॥
html:
vāgvajrā brāhmaṇāḥ proktāḥ kṣatriyā bāhujīvinaḥ ।
vāgyuddhaṃ tadidaṃ tīvraṃ mama vipra tvayā saha ॥45॥
slp1: vAgvajrA brAhmaRAH proktAH kzatriyA bAhujIvinaH । vAgyudDaM tadidaM tIvraM mama vipra tvayA saha ॥45॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: saivādyāpi pratijñā me svaśaktyā kiṃ pradīyatām । brūhi dāsyāmi rājendra vibhave sati māciram ॥46॥
html:
saivādyāpi pratijñā me svaśaktyā kiṃ pradīyatām ।
brūhi dāsyāmi rājendra vibhave sati māciram ॥46॥
slp1: sEvAdyApi pratijYA me svaSaktyA kiM pradIyatAm । brUhi dAsyAmi rAjendra viBave sati mAciram ॥46॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: yattadvarṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ japyaṃ vai japatā tvayā । phalaṃ prāptaṃ tatprayaccha mama ditsurbhavānyadi ॥47॥
html:
yattadvarṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ japyaṃ vai japatā tvayā ।
phalaṃ prāptaṃ tatprayaccha mama ditsurbhavānyadi ॥47॥
slp1: yattadvarzaSataM pUrRaM japyaM vE japatA tvayA । PalaM prAptaM tatprayacCa mama ditsurBavAnyadi ॥47॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: paramaṃ gṛhyatāṃ tasya phalaṃ yajjapitaṃ mayā । ardhaṃ tvamavicāreṇa phalaṃ tasya samāpnuhi ॥48॥
html:
paramaṃ gṛhyatāṃ tasya phalaṃ yajjapitaṃ mayā ।
ardhaṃ tvamavicāreṇa phalaṃ tasya samāpnuhi ॥48॥
slp1: paramaM gfhyatAM tasya PalaM yajjapitaM mayA । arDaM tvamavicAreRa PalaM tasya samApnuhi ॥48॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: atha vā sarvameveha japyakaṃ māmakaṃ phalam । rājanprāpnuhi kāmaṃ tvaṃ yadi sarvamihecchasi ॥49॥
html:
atha vā sarvameveha japyakaṃ māmakaṃ phalam ।
rājanprāpnuhi kāmaṃ tvaṃ yadi sarvamihecchasi ॥49॥
slp1: aTa vA sarvameveha japyakaM mAmakaM Palam । rAjanprApnuhi kAmaM tvaM yadi sarvamihecCasi ॥49॥

text: kṛtaṃ sarveṇa bhadraṃ te japyaṃ yadyācitaṃ mayā । svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi kiṃ ca tasya phalaṃ vada ॥50॥
html:
kṛtaṃ sarveṇa bhadraṃ te japyaṃ yadyācitaṃ mayā ।
svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi kiṃ ca tasya phalaṃ vada ॥50॥
slp1: kftaM sarveRa BadraM te japyaM yadyAcitaM mayA । svasti te'stu gamizyAmi kiM ca tasya PalaM vada ॥50॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: phalaprāptiṃ na jānāmi dattaṃ yajjapitaṃ mayā । ayaṃ dharmaśca kālaśca yamo mṛtyuśca sākṣiṇaḥ ॥51॥
html:
phalaprāptiṃ na jānāmi dattaṃ yajjapitaṃ mayā ।
ayaṃ dharmaśca kālaśca yamo mṛtyuśca sākṣiṇaḥ ॥51॥
slp1: PalaprAptiM na jAnAmi dattaM yajjapitaM mayA । ayaM DarmaSca kAlaSca yamo mftyuSca sAkziRaH ॥51॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: ajñātamasya dharmasya phalaṃ me kiṃ kariṣyati । prāpnotu tatphalaṃ vipro nāhamicche sasaṃśayam ॥52॥
html:
ajñātamasya dharmasya phalaṃ me kiṃ kariṣyati ।
prāpnotu tatphalaṃ vipro nāhamicche sasaṃśayam ॥52॥
slp1: ajYAtamasya Darmasya PalaM me kiM karizyati । prApnotu tatPalaM vipro nAhamicCe sasaMSayam ॥52॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: nādade'paravaktavyaṃ dattaṃ vācā phalaṃ mayā । vākyaṃ pramāṇaṃ rājarṣe mamāpi tava caiva hi ॥53॥
html:
nādade'paravaktavyaṃ dattaṃ vācā phalaṃ mayā ।
vākyaṃ pramāṇaṃ rājarṣe mamāpi tava caiva hi ॥53॥
slp1: nAdade'paravaktavyaM dattaM vAcA PalaM mayA । vAkyaM pramARaM rAjarze mamApi tava cEva hi ॥53॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: nābhisandhirmayā japye kṛtapūrvaḥ kathañcana । japyasya rājaśārdūla kathaṃ jñāsyāmyahaṃ phalam ॥54॥
html:
nābhisandhirmayā japye kṛtapūrvaḥ kathañcana ।
japyasya rājaśārdūla kathaṃ jñāsyāmyahaṃ phalam ॥54॥
slp1: nABisanDirmayA japye kftapUrvaH kaTaYcana । japyasya rAjaSArdUla kaTaM jYAsyAmyahaM Palam ॥54॥

text: dadasveti tvayā coktaṃ dadāmīti tathā mayā । na vācaṃ dūṣayiṣyāmi satyaṃ rakṣa sthiro bhava ॥55॥
html:
dadasveti tvayā coktaṃ dadāmīti tathā mayā ।
na vācaṃ dūṣayiṣyāmi satyaṃ rakṣa sthiro bhava ॥55॥
slp1: dadasveti tvayA coktaM dadAmIti taTA mayA । na vAcaM dUzayizyAmi satyaM rakza sTiro Bava ॥55॥

text: athaivaṃ vadato me'dya vacanaṃ na kariṣyasi । mahānadharmo bhavitā tava rājanmṛṣākṛtaḥ ॥56॥
html:
athaivaṃ vadato me'dya vacanaṃ na kariṣyasi ।
mahānadharmo bhavitā tava rājanmṛṣākṛtaḥ ॥56॥
slp1: aTEvaM vadato me'dya vacanaM na karizyasi । mahAnaDarmo BavitA tava rAjanmfzAkftaH ॥56॥

text: na yuktaṃ tu mṛṣā vāṇī tvayā vaktumarindama । tathā mayāpyabhyadhikaṃ mṛṣā vaktuṃ na śakyate ॥57॥
html:
na yuktaṃ tu mṛṣā vāṇī tvayā vaktumarindama ।
tathā mayāpyabhyadhikaṃ mṛṣā vaktuṃ na śakyate ॥57॥
slp1: na yuktaM tu mfzA vARI tvayA vaktumarindama । taTA mayApyaByaDikaM mfzA vaktuM na Sakyate ॥57॥

text: saṃśrutaṃ ca mayā pūrvaṃ dadānītyavicāritam । tadgṛhṇīṣvāvicāreṇa yadi satye sthito bhavān ॥58॥
html:
saṃśrutaṃ ca mayā pūrvaṃ dadānītyavicāritam ।
tadgṛhṇīṣvāvicāreṇa yadi satye sthito bhavān ॥58॥
slp1: saMSrutaM ca mayA pUrvaM dadAnItyavicAritam । tadgfhRIzvAvicAreRa yadi satye sTito BavAn ॥58॥

text: ihāgamya hi māṃ rājañjāpyaṃ phalamayācithāḥ । tanmannisṛṣṭaṃ gṛhṇīṣva bhava satye sthiro'pi ca ॥59॥
html:
ihāgamya hi māṃ rājañjāpyaṃ phalamayācithāḥ ।
tanmannisṛṣṭaṃ gṛhṇīṣva bhava satye sthiro'pi ca ॥59॥
slp1: ihAgamya hi mAM rAjaYjApyaM PalamayAciTAH । tanmannisfzwaM gfhRIzva Bava satye sTiro'pi ca ॥59॥

text: nāyaṃ loko'sti na paro na ca pūrvānsa tārayet । kuta evāvarānrājanmṛṣāvādaparāyaṇaḥ ॥60॥
html:
nāyaṃ loko'sti na paro na ca pūrvānsa tārayet ।
kuta evāvarānrājanmṛṣāvādaparāyaṇaḥ ॥60॥
slp1: nAyaM loko'sti na paro na ca pUrvAnsa tArayet । kuta evAvarAnrAjanmfzAvAdaparAyaRaH ॥60॥

text: na yajñādhyayane dānaṃ niyamāstārayanti hi । tathā satyaṃ pare loke yathā vai puruṣarṣabha ॥61॥
html:
na yajñādhyayane dānaṃ niyamāstārayanti hi ।
tathā satyaṃ pare loke yathā vai puruṣarṣabha ॥61॥
slp1: na yajYADyayane dAnaM niyamAstArayanti hi । taTA satyaM pare loke yaTA vE puruzarzaBa ॥61॥

text: tapāṃsi yāni cīrṇāni cariṣyasi ca yattapaḥ । samāḥ śataiḥ sahasraiśca tatsatyānna viśiṣyate ॥62॥
html:
tapāṃsi yāni cīrṇāni cariṣyasi ca yattapaḥ ।
samāḥ śataiḥ sahasraiśca tatsatyānna viśiṣyate ॥62॥
slp1: tapAMsi yAni cIrRAni carizyasi ca yattapaH । samAH SatEH sahasrESca tatsatyAnna viSizyate ॥62॥

text: satyamekākṣaraṃ brahma satyamekākṣaraṃ tapaḥ । satyamekākṣaro yajñaḥ satyamekākṣaraṃ śrutam ॥63॥
html:
satyamekākṣaraṃ brahma satyamekākṣaraṃ tapaḥ ।
satyamekākṣaro yajñaḥ satyamekākṣaraṃ śrutam ॥63॥
slp1: satyamekAkzaraM brahma satyamekAkzaraM tapaH । satyamekAkzaro yajYaH satyamekAkzaraM Srutam ॥63॥

text: satyaṃ vedeṣu jāgarti phalaṃ satye paraṃ smṛtam । satyāddharmo damaścaiva sarvaṃ satye pratiṣṭhitam ॥64॥
html:
satyaṃ vedeṣu jāgarti phalaṃ satye paraṃ smṛtam ।
satyāddharmo damaścaiva sarvaṃ satye pratiṣṭhitam ॥64॥
slp1: satyaM vedezu jAgarti PalaM satye paraM smftam । satyAdDarmo damaScEva sarvaM satye pratizWitam ॥64॥

text: satyaṃ vedāstathāṅgāni satyaṃ yajñastathā vidhiḥ । vratacaryāstathā satyamoṅkāraḥ satyameva ca ॥65॥
html:
satyaṃ vedāstathāṅgāni satyaṃ yajñastathā vidhiḥ ।
vratacaryāstathā satyamoṅkāraḥ satyameva ca ॥65॥
slp1: satyaM vedAstaTANgAni satyaM yajYastaTA viDiH । vratacaryAstaTA satyamoNkAraH satyameva ca ॥65॥

text: prāṇināṃ jananaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ santatireva ca । satyena vāyurabhyeti satyena tapate raviḥ ॥66॥
html:
prāṇināṃ jananaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ santatireva ca ।
satyena vāyurabhyeti satyena tapate raviḥ ॥66॥
slp1: prARinAM jananaM satyaM satyaM santatireva ca । satyena vAyuraByeti satyena tapate raviH ॥66॥

text: satyena cāgnirdahati svargaḥ satye pratiṣṭhitaḥ । satyaṃ yajñastapo vedāḥ stobhā mantrāḥ sarasvatī ॥67॥
html:
satyena cāgnirdahati svargaḥ satye pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।
satyaṃ yajñastapo vedāḥ stobhā mantrāḥ sarasvatī ॥67॥
slp1: satyena cAgnirdahati svargaH satye pratizWitaH । satyaM yajYastapo vedAH stoBA mantrAH sarasvatI ॥67॥

text: tulāmāropito dharmaḥ satyaṃ caiveti naḥ śrutam । samāṃ kakṣāṃ dhārayato yataḥ satyaṃ tato'dhikam ॥68॥
html:
tulāmāropito dharmaḥ satyaṃ caiveti naḥ śrutam ।
samāṃ kakṣāṃ dhārayato yataḥ satyaṃ tato'dhikam ॥68॥
slp1: tulAmAropito DarmaH satyaM cEveti naH Srutam । samAM kakzAM DArayato yataH satyaM tato'Dikam ॥68॥

text: yato dharmastataḥ satyaṃ sarvaṃ satyena vardhate । kimarthamanṛtaṃ karma kartuṃ rājaṃstvamicchasi ॥69॥
html:
yato dharmastataḥ satyaṃ sarvaṃ satyena vardhate ।
kimarthamanṛtaṃ karma kartuṃ rājaṃstvamicchasi ॥69॥
slp1: yato DarmastataH satyaM sarvaM satyena varDate । kimarTamanftaM karma kartuM rAjaMstvamicCasi ॥69॥

text: satye kuru sthiraṃ bhāvaṃ mā rājannanṛtaṃ kṛthāḥ । kasmāttvamanṛtaṃ vākyaṃ dehīti kuruṣe'śubham ॥70॥
html:
satye kuru sthiraṃ bhāvaṃ mā rājannanṛtaṃ kṛthāḥ ।
kasmāttvamanṛtaṃ vākyaṃ dehīti kuruṣe'śubham ॥70॥
slp1: satye kuru sTiraM BAvaM mA rAjannanftaM kfTAH । kasmAttvamanftaM vAkyaM dehIti kuruze'SuBam ॥70॥

text: yadi japyaphalaṃ dattaṃ mayā neṣiṣyase nṛpa । svadharmebhyaḥ paribhraṣṭo lokānanucariṣyasi ॥71॥
html:
yadi japyaphalaṃ dattaṃ mayā neṣiṣyase nṛpa ।
svadharmebhyaḥ paribhraṣṭo lokānanucariṣyasi ॥71॥
slp1: yadi japyaPalaM dattaM mayA nezizyase nfpa । svaDarmeByaH pariBrazwo lokAnanucarizyasi ॥71॥

text: saṃśrutya yo na ditseta yācitvā yaśca necchati । ubhāvānṛtikāvetau na mṛṣā kartumarhasi ॥72॥
html:
saṃśrutya yo na ditseta yācitvā yaśca necchati ।
ubhāvānṛtikāvetau na mṛṣā kartumarhasi ॥72॥
slp1: saMSrutya yo na ditseta yAcitvA yaSca necCati । uBAvAnftikAvetO na mfzA kartumarhasi ॥72॥

text: yoddhavyaṃ rakṣitavyaṃ ca kṣatradharmaḥ kila dvija । dātāraḥ kṣatriyāḥ proktā gṛhṇīyāṃ bhavataḥ katham ॥73॥
html:
yoddhavyaṃ rakṣitavyaṃ ca kṣatradharmaḥ kila dvija ।
dātāraḥ kṣatriyāḥ proktā gṛhṇīyāṃ bhavataḥ katham ॥73॥
slp1: yodDavyaM rakzitavyaM ca kzatraDarmaH kila dvija । dAtAraH kzatriyAH proktA gfhRIyAM BavataH kaTam ॥73॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: na chandayāmi te rājannāpi te gṛhamāvrajam । ihāgamya tu yācitvā na gṛhṇīṣe punaḥ katham ॥74॥
html:
na chandayāmi te rājannāpi te gṛhamāvrajam ।
ihāgamya tu yācitvā na gṛhṇīṣe punaḥ katham ॥74॥
slp1: na CandayAmi te rAjannApi te gfhamAvrajam । ihAgamya tu yAcitvA na gfhRIze punaH kaTam ॥74॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: avivādo'stu yuvayorvittaṃ māṃ dharmamāgatam । dvijo dānaphalairyukto rājā satyaphalena ca ॥75॥
html:
avivādo'stu yuvayorvittaṃ māṃ dharmamāgatam ।
dvijo dānaphalairyukto rājā satyaphalena ca ॥75॥
slp1: avivAdo'stu yuvayorvittaM mAM DarmamAgatam । dvijo dAnaPalEryukto rAjA satyaPalena ca ॥75॥
author: dharma uvāca ।

text: svargaṃ māṃ viddhi rājendra rūpiṇaṃ svayamāgatam । avivādo'stu yuvayorubhau tulyaphalau yuvām ॥76॥
html:
svargaṃ māṃ viddhi rājendra rūpiṇaṃ svayamāgatam ।
avivādo'stu yuvayorubhau tulyaphalau yuvām ॥76॥
slp1: svargaM mAM vidDi rAjendra rUpiRaM svayamAgatam । avivAdo'stu yuvayoruBO tulyaPalO yuvAm ॥76॥
author: svarga uvāca ।

text: kṛtaṃ svargeṇa me kāryaṃ gaccha svarga yathāsukham । vipro yadīcchate dātuṃ pratīcchatu ca me dhanam ॥77॥
html:
kṛtaṃ svargeṇa me kāryaṃ gaccha svarga yathāsukham ।
vipro yadīcchate dātuṃ pratīcchatu ca me dhanam ॥77॥
slp1: kftaM svargeRa me kAryaM gacCa svarga yaTAsuKam । vipro yadIcCate dAtuM pratIcCatu ca me Danam ॥77॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: bālye yadi syādajñānānmayā hastaḥ prasāritaḥ । nivṛttilakṣaṇaṃ dharmamupāse saṃhitāṃ japan ॥78॥
html:
bālye yadi syādajñānānmayā hastaḥ prasāritaḥ ।
nivṛttilakṣaṇaṃ dharmamupāse saṃhitāṃ japan ॥78॥
slp1: bAlye yadi syAdajYAnAnmayA hastaH prasAritaH । nivfttilakzaRaM DarmamupAse saMhitAM japan ॥78॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: nivṛttaṃ māṃ ciraṃ rājanvipraṃ lobhayase katham । svena kāryaṃ kariṣyāmi tvatto necche phalaṃ nṛpa । tapaḥsvādhyāyaśīlo'haṃ nivṛttaśca pratigrahāt ॥79॥
html:
nivṛttaṃ māṃ ciraṃ rājanvipraṃ lobhayase katham ।
svena kāryaṃ kariṣyāmi tvatto necche phalaṃ nṛpa ।
tapaḥsvādhyāyaśīlo'haṃ nivṛttaśca pratigrahāt ॥79॥
slp1: nivfttaM mAM ciraM rAjanvipraM loBayase kaTam । svena kAryaM karizyAmi tvatto necCe PalaM nfpa । tapaHsvADyAyaSIlo'haM nivfttaSca pratigrahAt ॥79॥

text: yadi vipra nisṛṣṭaṃ te japyasya phalamuttamam । āvayoryatphalaṃ kiñcitsahitaṃ nau tadastviha ॥80॥
html:
yadi vipra nisṛṣṭaṃ te japyasya phalamuttamam ।
āvayoryatphalaṃ kiñcitsahitaṃ nau tadastviha ॥80॥
slp1: yadi vipra nisfzwaM te japyasya Palamuttamam । AvayoryatPalaM kiYcitsahitaM nO tadastviha ॥80॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: dvijāḥ pratigrahe yuktā dātāro rājavaṃśajāḥ । yadi dharmaḥ śruto vipra sahaiva phalamastu nau ॥81॥
html:
dvijāḥ pratigrahe yuktā dātāro rājavaṃśajāḥ ।
yadi dharmaḥ śruto vipra sahaiva phalamastu nau ॥81॥
slp1: dvijAH pratigrahe yuktA dAtAro rAjavaMSajAH । yadi DarmaH Sruto vipra sahEva Palamastu nO ॥81॥

text: mā vā bhūtsahabhojyaṃ nau madīyaṃ phalamāpnuhi । pratīccha matkṛtaṃ dharmaṃ yadi te mayyanugrahaḥ ॥82॥
html:
mā vā bhūtsahabhojyaṃ nau madīyaṃ phalamāpnuhi ।
pratīccha matkṛtaṃ dharmaṃ yadi te mayyanugrahaḥ ॥82॥
slp1: mA vA BUtsahaBojyaM nO madIyaM PalamApnuhi । pratIcCa matkftaM DarmaM yadi te mayyanugrahaH ॥82॥

text: tato vikṛtaceṣṭau dvau puruṣau samupasthitau । gṛhītvānyonyamāveṣṭya kucelāvūcaturvacaḥ ॥83॥
html:
tato vikṛtaceṣṭau dvau puruṣau samupasthitau ।
gṛhītvānyonyamāveṣṭya kucelāvūcaturvacaḥ ॥83॥
slp1: tato vikftacezwO dvO puruzO samupasTitO । gfhItvAnyonyamAvezwya kucelAvUcaturvacaH ॥83॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: na me dhārayasītyeko dhārayāmīti cāparaḥ । ihāsti nau vivādo'yamayaṃ rājānuśāsakaḥ ॥84॥
html:
na me dhārayasītyeko dhārayāmīti cāparaḥ ।
ihāsti nau vivādo'yamayaṃ rājānuśāsakaḥ ॥84॥
slp1: na me DArayasItyeko DArayAmIti cAparaH । ihAsti nO vivAdo'yamayaM rAjAnuSAsakaH ॥84॥

text: satyaṃ bravīmyahamidaṃ na me dhārayate bhavān । anṛtaṃ vadasīha tvamṛṇaṃ te dhārayāmyaham ॥85॥
html:
satyaṃ bravīmyahamidaṃ na me dhārayate bhavān ।
anṛtaṃ vadasīha tvamṛṇaṃ te dhārayāmyaham ॥85॥
slp1: satyaM bravImyahamidaM na me DArayate BavAn । anftaM vadasIha tvamfRaM te DArayAmyaham ॥85॥

text: tāvubhau bhṛśasantaptau rājānamidamūcatuḥ । parīkṣyatāṃ yathā syāva nāvāmiha vigarhitau ॥86॥
html:
tāvubhau bhṛśasantaptau rājānamidamūcatuḥ ।
parīkṣyatāṃ yathā syāva nāvāmiha vigarhitau ॥86॥
slp1: tAvuBO BfSasantaptO rAjAnamidamUcatuH । parIkzyatAM yaTA syAva nAvAmiha vigarhitO ॥86॥

text: dhārayāmi naravyāghra vikṛtasyeha goḥ phalam । dadataśca na gṛhṇāti vikṛto me mahīpate ॥87॥
html:
dhārayāmi naravyāghra vikṛtasyeha goḥ phalam ।
dadataśca na gṛhṇāti vikṛto me mahīpate ॥87॥
slp1: DArayAmi naravyAGra vikftasyeha goH Palam । dadataSca na gfhRAti vikfto me mahIpate ॥87॥
author: virūpa uvāca ।

text: na me dhārayate kiñcidvirūpo'yaṃ narādhipa । mithyā bravītyayaṃ hi tvā mithyābhāsaṃ narādhipa ॥88॥
html:
na me dhārayate kiñcidvirūpo'yaṃ narādhipa ।
mithyā bravītyayaṃ hi tvā mithyābhāsaṃ narādhipa ॥88॥
slp1: na me DArayate kiYcidvirUpo'yaM narADipa । miTyA bravItyayaM hi tvA miTyABAsaM narADipa ॥88॥
author: vikṛta uvāca ।

text: virūpa kiṃ dhārayate bhavānasya vadasva me । śrutvā tathā kariṣyāmītyevaṃ me dhīyate matiḥ ॥89॥
html:
virūpa kiṃ dhārayate bhavānasya vadasva me ।
śrutvā tathā kariṣyāmītyevaṃ me dhīyate matiḥ ॥89॥
slp1: virUpa kiM DArayate BavAnasya vadasva me । SrutvA taTA karizyAmItyevaM me DIyate matiH ॥89॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājanyathaitaddhārayāmyaham । vikṛtasyāsya rājarṣe nikhilena nararṣabha ॥90॥
html:
śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājanyathaitaddhārayāmyaham ।
vikṛtasyāsya rājarṣe nikhilena nararṣabha ॥90॥
slp1: SfRuzvAvahito rAjanyaTEtadDArayAmyaham । vikftasyAsya rAjarze niKilena nararzaBa ॥90॥
author: virūpa uvāca ।

text: anena dharmaprāptyarthaṃ śubhā dattā purānagha । dhenurviprāya rājarṣe tapaḥsvādhyāyaśīline ॥91॥
html:
anena dharmaprāptyarthaṃ śubhā dattā purānagha ।
dhenurviprāya rājarṣe tapaḥsvādhyāyaśīline ॥91॥
slp1: anena DarmaprAptyarTaM SuBA dattA purAnaGa । DenurviprAya rAjarze tapaHsvADyAyaSIline ॥91॥

text: tasyāścāyaṃ mayā rājanphalamabhyetya yācitaḥ । vikṛtena ca me dattaṃ viśūddhenāntarātmanā ॥92॥
html:
tasyāścāyaṃ mayā rājanphalamabhyetya yācitaḥ ।
vikṛtena ca me dattaṃ viśūddhenāntarātmanā ॥92॥
slp1: tasyAScAyaM mayA rAjanPalamaByetya yAcitaH । vikftena ca me dattaM viSUdDenAntarAtmanA ॥92॥

text: tato me sukṛtaṃ karma kṛtamātmaviśuddhaye । gāvau hi kapile krītvā vatsale bahudohane ॥93॥
html:
tato me sukṛtaṃ karma kṛtamātmaviśuddhaye ।
gāvau hi kapile krītvā vatsale bahudohane ॥93॥
slp1: tato me sukftaM karma kftamAtmaviSudDaye । gAvO hi kapile krItvA vatsale bahudohane ॥93॥

text: te coñchavṛttaye rājanmayā samapavarjite । yathāvidhi yathāśraddhaṃ tadasyāhaṃ punaḥ prabho ॥94॥
html:
te coñchavṛttaye rājanmayā samapavarjite ।
yathāvidhi yathāśraddhaṃ tadasyāhaṃ punaḥ prabho ॥94॥
slp1: te coYCavfttaye rAjanmayA samapavarjite । yaTAviDi yaTASradDaM tadasyAhaM punaH praBo ॥94॥

text: ihādya vai gṛhītvā tatprayacche dviguṇaṃ phalam । ekasyāḥ puruṣavyāghra kaḥ śuddhaḥ ko'tra doṣavān ॥95॥
html:
ihādya vai gṛhītvā tatprayacche dviguṇaṃ phalam ।
ekasyāḥ puruṣavyāghra kaḥ śuddhaḥ ko'tra doṣavān ॥95॥
slp1: ihAdya vE gfhItvA tatprayacCe dviguRaM Palam । ekasyAH puruzavyAGra kaH SudDaH ko'tra dozavAn ॥95॥

text: evaṃ vivadamānau svastvāmihābhyāgatau nṛpa । kuru dharmamadharmaṃ vā vinaye nau samādhaya ॥96॥
html:
evaṃ vivadamānau svastvāmihābhyāgatau nṛpa ।
kuru dharmamadharmaṃ vā vinaye nau samādhaya ॥96॥
slp1: evaM vivadamAnO svastvAmihAByAgatO nfpa । kuru DarmamaDarmaM vA vinaye nO samADaya ॥96॥

text: yadi necchati me dānaṃ yathā dattamanena vai । bhavānatra sthiro bhūtvā mārge sthāpayatu prabhuḥ ॥97॥
html:
yadi necchati me dānaṃ yathā dattamanena vai ।
bhavānatra sthiro bhūtvā mārge sthāpayatu prabhuḥ ॥97॥
slp1: yadi necCati me dAnaM yaTA dattamanena vE । BavAnatra sTiro BUtvA mArge sTApayatu praBuH ॥97॥

text: dīyamānaṃ na gṛhṇāsi ṛṇaṃ kasmāttvamadya vai । yathaiva te'bhyanujñātaṃ tathā gṛhṇīṣva māciram ॥98॥
html:
dīyamānaṃ na gṛhṇāsi ṛṇaṃ kasmāttvamadya vai ।
yathaiva te'bhyanujñātaṃ tathā gṛhṇīṣva māciram ॥98॥
slp1: dIyamAnaM na gfhRAsi fRaM kasmAttvamadya vE । yaTEva te'ByanujYAtaM taTA gfhRIzva mAciram ॥98॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: dīyatāmityanenoktaṃ dadānīti tathā mayā । nāyaṃ me dhārayatyatra gamyatāṃ yatra vāñchati ॥99॥
html:
dīyatāmityanenoktaṃ dadānīti tathā mayā ।
nāyaṃ me dhārayatyatra gamyatāṃ yatra vāñchati ॥99॥
slp1: dIyatAmityanenoktaM dadAnIti taTA mayA । nAyaM me DArayatyatra gamyatAM yatra vAYCati ॥99॥
author: vikṛta uvāca ।

text: dadato'sya na gṛhṇāsi viṣamaṃ pratibhāti me । daṇḍyo hi tvaṃ mama mato nāstyatra khalu saṃśayaḥ ॥100॥
html:
dadato'sya na gṛhṇāsi viṣamaṃ pratibhāti me ।
daṇḍyo hi tvaṃ mama mato nāstyatra khalu saṃśayaḥ ॥100॥
slp1: dadato'sya na gfhRAsi vizamaM pratiBAti me । daRqyo hi tvaM mama mato nAstyatra Kalu saMSayaH ॥100॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: mayāsya dattaṃ rājarṣe gṛhṇīyāṃ tatkathaṃ punaḥ । kāmamatrāparādho me daṇḍyamājñāpaya prabho ॥101॥
html:
mayāsya dattaṃ rājarṣe gṛhṇīyāṃ tatkathaṃ punaḥ ।
kāmamatrāparādho me daṇḍyamājñāpaya prabho ॥101॥
slp1: mayAsya dattaM rAjarze gfhRIyAM tatkaTaM punaH । kAmamatrAparADo me daRqyamAjYApaya praBo ॥101॥
author: vikṛta uvāca ।

text: dīyamānaṃ yadi mayā neṣiṣyasi kathañcana । niyaṃsyati tvā nṛpatirayaṃ dharmānuśāsakaḥ ॥102॥
html:
dīyamānaṃ yadi mayā neṣiṣyasi kathañcana ।
niyaṃsyati tvā nṛpatirayaṃ dharmānuśāsakaḥ ॥102॥
slp1: dIyamAnaM yadi mayA nezizyasi kaTaYcana । niyaMsyati tvA nfpatirayaM DarmAnuSAsakaH ॥102॥
author: virūpa uvāca ।

text: svaṃ mayā yāciteneha dattaṃ kathamihādya tat । gṛhṇīyāṃ gacchatu bhavānabhyanujñāṃ dadāni te ॥103॥
html:
svaṃ mayā yāciteneha dattaṃ kathamihādya tat ।
gṛhṇīyāṃ gacchatu bhavānabhyanujñāṃ dadāni te ॥103॥
slp1: svaM mayA yAciteneha dattaM kaTamihAdya tat । gfhRIyAM gacCatu BavAnaByanujYAM dadAni te ॥103॥
author: vikṛta uvāca ।

text: śrutametattvayā rājannanayoḥ kathitaṃ dvayoḥ । pratijñātaṃ mayā yatte tadgṛhāṇāvicāritam ॥104॥
html:
śrutametattvayā rājannanayoḥ kathitaṃ dvayoḥ ।
pratijñātaṃ mayā yatte tadgṛhāṇāvicāritam ॥104॥
slp1: SrutametattvayA rAjannanayoH kaTitaM dvayoH । pratijYAtaM mayA yatte tadgfhARAvicAritam ॥104॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: prastutaṃ sumahatkāryamāvayorgahvaraṃ yathā । jāpakasya dṛḍhīkāraḥ kathametadbhaviṣyati ॥105॥
html:
prastutaṃ sumahatkāryamāvayorgahvaraṃ yathā ।
jāpakasya dṛḍhīkāraḥ kathametadbhaviṣyati ॥105॥
