slp1: prastutaM sumahatkAryamAvayorgahvaraM yaTA । jApakasya dfQIkAraH kaTametadBavizyati ॥105॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: yadi tāvanna gṛhṇāmi brāhmaṇenāpavarjitam । kathaṃ na lipyeyamahaṃ doṣeṇa mahatādya vai ॥106॥
html:
yadi tāvanna gṛhṇāmi brāhmaṇenāpavarjitam ।
kathaṃ na lipyeyamahaṃ doṣeṇa mahatādya vai ॥106॥
slp1: yadi tAvanna gfhRAmi brAhmaRenApavarjitam । kaTaM na lipyeyamahaM dozeRa mahatAdya vE ॥106॥

text: tau covāca sa rājarṣiḥ kṛtakāryau gamiṣyathaḥ । nedānīṃ māmihāsādya rājadharmo bhavenmṛṣā ॥107॥
html:
tau covāca sa rājarṣiḥ kṛtakāryau gamiṣyathaḥ ।
nedānīṃ māmihāsādya rājadharmo bhavenmṛṣā ॥107॥
slp1: tO covAca sa rAjarziH kftakAryO gamizyaTaH । nedAnIM mAmihAsAdya rAjaDarmo BavenmfzA ॥107॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: svadharmaḥ paripālyaśca rājñāmeṣa viniścayaḥ । vipradharmaśca sugururmāmanātmānamāviśat ॥108॥
html:
svadharmaḥ paripālyaśca rājñāmeṣa viniścayaḥ ।
vipradharmaśca sugururmāmanātmānamāviśat ॥108॥
slp1: svaDarmaH paripAlyaSca rAjYAmeza viniScayaH । vipraDarmaSca sugururmAmanAtmAnamAviSat ॥108॥

text: gṛhāṇa dhāraye'haṃ te yācitaṃ te śrutaṃ mayā । na cedgrahīṣyase rājañśapiṣye tvāṃ na saṃśayaḥ ॥109॥
html:
gṛhāṇa dhāraye'haṃ te yācitaṃ te śrutaṃ mayā ।
na cedgrahīṣyase rājañśapiṣye tvāṃ na saṃśayaḥ ॥109॥
slp1: gfhARa DAraye'haM te yAcitaM te SrutaM mayA । na cedgrahIzyase rAjaYSapizye tvAM na saMSayaH ॥109॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: dhigrājadharmaṃ yasyāyaṃ kāryasyeha viniścayaḥ । ityarthaṃ me grahītavyaṃ kathaṃ tulyaṃ bhavediti ॥110॥
html:
dhigrājadharmaṃ yasyāyaṃ kāryasyeha viniścayaḥ ।
ityarthaṃ me grahītavyaṃ kathaṃ tulyaṃ bhavediti ॥110॥
slp1: DigrAjaDarmaM yasyAyaM kAryasyeha viniScayaH । ityarTaM me grahItavyaM kaTaM tulyaM Bavediti ॥110॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: eṣa pāṇirapūrvaṃ bho nikṣepārthaṃ prasāritaḥ । yanme dhārayase vipra tadidānīṃ pradīyatām ॥111॥
html:
eṣa pāṇirapūrvaṃ bho nikṣepārthaṃ prasāritaḥ ।
yanme dhārayase vipra tadidānīṃ pradīyatām ॥111॥
slp1: eza pARirapUrvaM Bo nikzepArTaM prasAritaH । yanme DArayase vipra tadidAnIM pradIyatAm ॥111॥

text: saṃhitāṃ japatā yāvānmayā kaścidguṇaḥ kṛtaḥ । tatsarvaṃ pratigṛhṇīṣva yadi kiñcidihāsti me ॥112॥
html:
saṃhitāṃ japatā yāvānmayā kaścidguṇaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
tatsarvaṃ pratigṛhṇīṣva yadi kiñcidihāsti me ॥112॥
slp1: saMhitAM japatA yAvAnmayA kaScidguRaH kftaH । tatsarvaM pratigfhRIzva yadi kiYcidihAsti me ॥112॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: jalametannipatitaṃ mama pāṇau dvijottama । samamastu sahaivāstu pratigṛhṇātu vai bhavān ॥113॥
html:
jalametannipatitaṃ mama pāṇau dvijottama ।
samamastu sahaivāstu pratigṛhṇātu vai bhavān ॥113॥
slp1: jalametannipatitaM mama pARO dvijottama । samamastu sahEvAstu pratigfhRAtu vE BavAn ॥113॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: kāmakrodhau viddhi nau tvamāvābhyāṃ kārito bhavān । sameti ca yaduktaṃ te samā lokāstavāsya ca ॥114॥
html:
kāmakrodhau viddhi nau tvamāvābhyāṃ kārito bhavān ।
sameti ca yaduktaṃ te samā lokāstavāsya ca ॥114॥
slp1: kAmakroDO vidDi nO tvamAvAByAM kArito BavAn । sameti ca yaduktaM te samA lokAstavAsya ca ॥114॥
author: virūpa uvāca ।

text: nāyaṃ dhārayate kiñcijjijñāsā tvatkṛte kṛtā । kālo dharmastathā mṛtyuḥ kāmakrodhau tathā yuvām ॥115॥
html:
nāyaṃ dhārayate kiñcijjijñāsā tvatkṛte kṛtā ।
kālo dharmastathā mṛtyuḥ kāmakrodhau tathā yuvām ॥115॥
slp1: nAyaM DArayate kiYcijjijYAsA tvatkfte kftA । kAlo DarmastaTA mftyuH kAmakroDO taTA yuvAm ॥115॥

text: sarvamanyonyanikaṣe nighṛṣṭaṃ paśyatastava । gaccha lokāñjitānsvena karmaṇā yatra vāñchasi ॥116॥
html:
sarvamanyonyanikaṣe nighṛṣṭaṃ paśyatastava ।
gaccha lokāñjitānsvena karmaṇā yatra vāñchasi ॥116॥
slp1: sarvamanyonyanikaze niGfzwaM paSyatastava । gacCa lokAYjitAnsvena karmaRA yatra vAYCasi ॥116॥

text: jāpakānāṃ phalāvāptirmayā te samprakīrtitā । gatiḥ sthānaṃ ca lokāśca jāpakena yathā jitāḥ ॥117॥
html:
jāpakānāṃ phalāvāptirmayā te samprakīrtitā ।
gatiḥ sthānaṃ ca lokāśca jāpakena yathā jitāḥ ॥117॥
slp1: jApakAnAM PalAvAptirmayA te samprakIrtitA । gatiH sTAnaM ca lokASca jApakena yaTA jitAH ॥117॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: prayāti saṃhitādhyāyī brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam । atha vāgniṃ samāyāti sūryamāviśate'pi vā ॥118॥
html:
prayāti saṃhitādhyāyī brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam ।
atha vāgniṃ samāyāti sūryamāviśate'pi vā ॥118॥
slp1: prayAti saMhitADyAyI brahmARaM paramezWinam । aTa vAgniM samAyAti sUryamAviSate'pi vA ॥118॥

text: sa taijasena bhāvena yadi tatrāśnute ratim । guṇāṃsteṣāṃ samādatte rāgeṇa pratimohitaḥ ॥119॥
html:
sa taijasena bhāvena yadi tatrāśnute ratim ।
guṇāṃsteṣāṃ samādatte rāgeṇa pratimohitaḥ ॥119॥
slp1: sa tEjasena BAvena yadi tatrASnute ratim । guRAMstezAM samAdatte rAgeRa pratimohitaH ॥119॥

text: evaṃ some tathā vāyau bhūmyākāśaśarīragaḥ । sarāgastatra vasati guṇāṃsteṣāṃ samācaran ॥120॥
html:
evaṃ some tathā vāyau bhūmyākāśaśarīragaḥ ।
sarāgastatra vasati guṇāṃsteṣāṃ samācaran ॥120॥
slp1: evaM some taTA vAyO BUmyAkASaSarIragaH । sarAgastatra vasati guRAMstezAM samAcaran ॥120॥

text: atha tatra virāgī sa gacchati tvatha saṃśayam । paramavyayamicchansa tamevāviśate punaḥ ॥121॥
html:
atha tatra virāgī sa gacchati tvatha saṃśayam ।
paramavyayamicchansa tamevāviśate punaḥ ॥121॥
slp1: aTa tatra virAgI sa gacCati tvaTa saMSayam । paramavyayamicCansa tamevAviSate punaH ॥121॥

text: amṛtāccāmṛtaṃ prāptaḥ śītībhūto nirātmavān । brahmabhūtaḥ sa nirdvandvaḥ sukhī śānto nirāmayaḥ ॥122॥
html:
amṛtāccāmṛtaṃ prāptaḥ śītībhūto nirātmavān ।
brahmabhūtaḥ sa nirdvandvaḥ sukhī śānto nirāmayaḥ ॥122॥
slp1: amftAccAmftaM prAptaH SItIBUto nirAtmavAn । brahmaBUtaH sa nirdvandvaH suKI SAnto nirAmayaH ॥122॥

text: brahmasthānamanāvartamekamakṣarasañjñakam । aduḥkhamajaraṃ śāntaṃ sthānaṃ tatpratipadyate ॥123॥
html:
brahmasthānamanāvartamekamakṣarasañjñakam ।
aduḥkhamajaraṃ śāntaṃ sthānaṃ tatpratipadyate ॥123॥
slp1: brahmasTAnamanAvartamekamakzarasaYjYakam । aduHKamajaraM SAntaM sTAnaM tatpratipadyate ॥123॥

text: caturbhirlakṣaṇairhīnaṃ tathā ṣaḍbhiḥ saṣoḍaśaiḥ । puruṣaṃ samatikramya ākāśaṃ pratipadyate ॥124॥
html:
caturbhirlakṣaṇairhīnaṃ tathā ṣaḍbhiḥ saṣoḍaśaiḥ ।
puruṣaṃ samatikramya ākāśaṃ pratipadyate ॥124॥
slp1: caturBirlakzaRErhInaM taTA zaqBiH sazoqaSEH । puruzaM samatikramya AkASaM pratipadyate ॥124॥

text: atha vecchati rāgātmā sarvaṃ tadadhitiṣṭhati । yacca prārthayate tacca manasā pratipadyate ॥125॥
html:
atha vecchati rāgātmā sarvaṃ tadadhitiṣṭhati ।
yacca prārthayate tacca manasā pratipadyate ॥125॥
slp1: aTa vecCati rAgAtmA sarvaM tadaDitizWati । yacca prArTayate tacca manasA pratipadyate ॥125॥

text: atha vā vīkṣate lokānsarvānnirayasaṃsthitān । niḥspṛhaḥ sarvato muktastatraiva ramate sukhī ॥126॥
html:
atha vā vīkṣate lokānsarvānnirayasaṃsthitān ।
niḥspṛhaḥ sarvato muktastatraiva ramate sukhī ॥126॥
slp1: aTa vA vIkzate lokAnsarvAnnirayasaMsTitAn । niHspfhaH sarvato muktastatrEva ramate suKI ॥126॥

text: evameṣā mahārāja jāpakasya gatiryathā । etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi] ॥127॥
html:
evameṣā mahārāja jāpakasya gatiryathā ।
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi] ॥127॥
slp1: evamezA mahArAja jApakasya gatiryaTA । etatte sarvamAKyAtaM kiM BUyaH SrotumicCasi] ॥127॥

text: kimuttaraṃ tadā tau sma cakratustena bhāṣite । brāhmaṇo vātha vā rājā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
kimuttaraṃ tadā tau sma cakratustena bhāṣite ।
brāhmaṇo vātha vā rājā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: kimuttaraM tadA tO sma cakratustena BAzite । brAhmaRo vATa vA rAjA tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atha vā tau gatau tatra yadetatkīrtitaṃ tvayā । saṃvādo vā tayoḥ ko'bhūtkiṃ vā tau tatra cakratuḥ ॥2॥
html:
atha vā tau gatau tatra yadetatkīrtitaṃ tvayā ।
saṃvādo vā tayoḥ ko'bhūtkiṃ vā tau tatra cakratuḥ ॥2॥
slp1: aTa vA tO gatO tatra yadetatkIrtitaM tvayA । saMvAdo vA tayoH ko'BUtkiM vA tO tatra cakratuH ॥2॥

text: tathetyevaṃ pratiśrutya dharmaṃ sampūjya cābhibho । yamaṃ kālaṃ ca mṛtyuṃ ca svargaṃ sampūjya cārhataḥ ॥3॥
html:
tathetyevaṃ pratiśrutya dharmaṃ sampūjya cābhibho ।
yamaṃ kālaṃ ca mṛtyuṃ ca svargaṃ sampūjya cārhataḥ ॥3॥
slp1: taTetyevaM pratiSrutya DarmaM sampUjya cABiBo । yamaM kAlaM ca mftyuM ca svargaM sampUjya cArhataH ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: pūrvaṃ ye cāpare tatra sametā brāhmaṇarṣabhāḥ । sarvānsampūjya śirasā rājānaṃ so'bravīdvacaḥ ॥4॥
html:
pūrvaṃ ye cāpare tatra sametā brāhmaṇarṣabhāḥ ।
sarvānsampūjya śirasā rājānaṃ so'bravīdvacaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: pUrvaM ye cApare tatra sametA brAhmaRarzaBAH । sarvAnsampUjya SirasA rAjAnaM so'bravIdvacaH ॥4॥

text: phalenānena saṃyukto rājarṣe gaccha puṇyatām । bhavatā cābhyanujñāto japeyaṃ bhūya eva hi ॥5॥
html:
phalenānena saṃyukto rājarṣe gaccha puṇyatām ।
bhavatā cābhyanujñāto japeyaṃ bhūya eva hi ॥5॥
slp1: PalenAnena saMyukto rAjarze gacCa puRyatAm । BavatA cAByanujYAto japeyaM BUya eva hi ॥5॥

text: varaśca mama pūrvaṃ hi devyā datto mahābala । śraddhā te japato nityaṃ bhaviteti viśāmpate ॥6॥
html:
varaśca mama pūrvaṃ hi devyā datto mahābala ।
śraddhā te japato nityaṃ bhaviteti viśāmpate ॥6॥
slp1: varaSca mama pUrvaM hi devyA datto mahAbala । SradDA te japato nityaM Baviteti viSAmpate ॥6॥

text: yadyevamaphalā siddhiḥ śraddhā ca japituṃ tava । gaccha vipra mayā sārdhaṃ jāpakaṃ phalamāpnuhi ॥7॥
html:
yadyevamaphalā siddhiḥ śraddhā ca japituṃ tava ।
gaccha vipra mayā sārdhaṃ jāpakaṃ phalamāpnuhi ॥7॥
slp1: yadyevamaPalA sidDiH SradDA ca japituM tava । gacCa vipra mayA sArDaM jApakaM PalamApnuhi ॥7॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: kṛtaḥ prayatnaḥ sumahānsarveṣāṃ sannidhāviha । saha tulyaphalau cāvāṃ gacchāvo yatra nau gatiḥ ॥8॥
html:
kṛtaḥ prayatnaḥ sumahānsarveṣāṃ sannidhāviha ।
saha tulyaphalau cāvāṃ gacchāvo yatra nau gatiḥ ॥8॥
slp1: kftaH prayatnaH sumahAnsarvezAM sanniDAviha । saha tulyaPalO cAvAM gacCAvo yatra nO gatiH ॥8॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: vyavasāyaṃ tayostatra viditvā tridaśeśvaraḥ । saha devairupayayau lokapālaistathaiva ca ॥9॥
html:
vyavasāyaṃ tayostatra viditvā tridaśeśvaraḥ ।
saha devairupayayau lokapālaistathaiva ca ॥9॥
slp1: vyavasAyaM tayostatra viditvA tridaSeSvaraH । saha devErupayayO lokapAlEstaTEva ca ॥9॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sādhyā viśve'tha maruto jyotīṃṣi sumahānti ca । nadyaḥ śailāḥ samudrāśca tīrthāni vividhāni ca ॥10॥
html:
sādhyā viśve'tha maruto jyotīṃṣi sumahānti ca ।
nadyaḥ śailāḥ samudrāśca tīrthāni vividhāni ca ॥10॥
slp1: sADyA viSve'Ta maruto jyotIMzi sumahAnti ca । nadyaH SElAH samudrASca tIrTAni viviDAni ca ॥10॥

text: tapāṃsi saṃyogavidhirvedāḥ stobhāḥ sarasvatī । nāradaḥ parvataścaiva viśvāvasurhahā huhūḥ ॥11॥
html:
tapāṃsi saṃyogavidhirvedāḥ stobhāḥ sarasvatī ।
nāradaḥ parvataścaiva viśvāvasurhahā huhūḥ ॥11॥
slp1: tapAMsi saMyogaviDirvedAH stoBAH sarasvatI । nAradaH parvataScEva viSvAvasurhahA huhUH ॥11॥

text: gandharvaścitrasenaśca parivāragaṇairyutaḥ । nāgāḥ siddhāśca munayo devadevaḥ prajāpatiḥ । viṣṇuḥ sahasraśīrṣaśca devo'cintyaḥ samāgamat ॥12॥
html:
gandharvaścitrasenaśca parivāragaṇairyutaḥ ।
nāgāḥ siddhāśca munayo devadevaḥ prajāpatiḥ ।
viṣṇuḥ sahasraśīrṣaśca devo'cintyaḥ samāgamat ॥12॥
slp1: ganDarvaScitrasenaSca parivAragaREryutaH । nAgAH sidDASca munayo devadevaH prajApatiH । vizRuH sahasraSIrzaSca devo'cintyaH samAgamat ॥12॥

text: avādyantāntarikṣe ca bheryastūryāṇi cābhibho । puṣpavarṣāṇi divyāni tatra teṣāṃ mahātmanām । nanṛtuścāpsaraḥsaṅghāstatra tatra samantataḥ ॥13॥
html:
avādyantāntarikṣe ca bheryastūryāṇi cābhibho ।
puṣpavarṣāṇi divyāni tatra teṣāṃ mahātmanām ।
nanṛtuścāpsaraḥsaṅghāstatra tatra samantataḥ ॥13॥
slp1: avAdyantAntarikze ca BeryastUryARi cABiBo । puzpavarzARi divyAni tatra tezAM mahAtmanAm । nanftuScApsaraHsaNGAstatra tatra samantataH ॥13॥

text: atha svargastathā rūpī brāhmaṇaṃ vākyamabravīt । saṃsiddhastvaṃ mahābhāga tvaṃ ca siddhastathā nṛpa ॥14॥
html:
atha svargastathā rūpī brāhmaṇaṃ vākyamabravīt ।
saṃsiddhastvaṃ mahābhāga tvaṃ ca siddhastathā nṛpa ॥14॥
slp1: aTa svargastaTA rUpI brAhmaRaM vAkyamabravIt । saMsidDastvaM mahABAga tvaM ca sidDastaTA nfpa ॥14॥

text: atha tau sahitau rājannanyonyena vidhānataḥ । viṣayapratisaṃhāramubhāveva pracakratuḥ ॥15॥
html:
atha tau sahitau rājannanyonyena vidhānataḥ ।
viṣayapratisaṃhāramubhāveva pracakratuḥ ॥15॥
slp1: aTa tO sahitO rAjannanyonyena viDAnataH । vizayapratisaMhAramuBAveva pracakratuH ॥15॥

text: prāṇāpānau tathodānaṃ samānaṃ vyānameva ca । evaṃ tānmanasi sthāpya dadhatuḥ prāṇayormanaḥ ॥16॥
html:
prāṇāpānau tathodānaṃ samānaṃ vyānameva ca ।
evaṃ tānmanasi sthāpya dadhatuḥ prāṇayormanaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: prARApAnO taTodAnaM samAnaM vyAnameva ca । evaM tAnmanasi sTApya daDatuH prARayormanaH ॥16॥

text: upasthitakṛtau tatra nāsikāgramadho bhruvau । kuṅkuṇyāṃ caiva manasā śanairdhārayataḥ sma tau ॥17॥
html:
upasthitakṛtau tatra nāsikāgramadho bhruvau ।
kuṅkuṇyāṃ caiva manasā śanairdhārayataḥ sma tau ॥17॥
slp1: upasTitakftO tatra nAsikAgramaDo BruvO । kuNkuRyAM cEva manasA SanErDArayataH sma tO ॥17॥

text: niśceṣṭābhyāṃ śarīrābhyāṃ sthiradṛṣṭī samāhitau । jitāsanau tathādhāya mūrdhanyātmānameva ca ॥18॥
html:
niśceṣṭābhyāṃ śarīrābhyāṃ sthiradṛṣṭī samāhitau ।
jitāsanau tathādhāya mūrdhanyātmānameva ca ॥18॥
slp1: niScezwAByAM SarIrAByAM sTiradfzwI samAhitO । jitAsanO taTADAya mUrDanyAtmAnameva ca ॥18॥

text: tāludeśamathoddālya brāhmaṇasya mahātmanaḥ । jyotirjvālā sumahatī jagāma tridivaṃ tadā ॥19॥
html:
tāludeśamathoddālya brāhmaṇasya mahātmanaḥ ।
jyotirjvālā sumahatī jagāma tridivaṃ tadā ॥19॥
slp1: tAludeSamaToddAlya brAhmaRasya mahAtmanaH । jyotirjvAlA sumahatI jagAma tridivaM tadA ॥19॥

text: hāhākārastato dikṣu sarvāsu sumahānabhūt । tajjyotiḥ stūyamānaṃ sma brahmāṇaṃ prāviśattadā ॥20॥
html:
hāhākārastato dikṣu sarvāsu sumahānabhūt ।
tajjyotiḥ stūyamānaṃ sma brahmāṇaṃ prāviśattadā ॥20॥
slp1: hAhAkArastato dikzu sarvAsu sumahAnaBUt । tajjyotiH stUyamAnaM sma brahmARaM prAviSattadA ॥20॥

text: tataḥ svāgatamityāha tattejaḥ sa pitāmahaḥ । prādeśamātraṃ puruṣaṃ pratyudgamya viśāmpate ॥21॥
html:
tataḥ svāgatamityāha tattejaḥ sa pitāmahaḥ ।
prādeśamātraṃ puruṣaṃ pratyudgamya viśāmpate ॥21॥
slp1: tataH svAgatamityAha tattejaH sa pitAmahaH । prAdeSamAtraM puruzaM pratyudgamya viSAmpate ॥21॥

text: bhūyaścaivāparaṃ prāha vacanaṃ madhuraṃ sma saḥ । jāpakaistulyaphalatā yogānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥22॥
html:
bhūyaścaivāparaṃ prāha vacanaṃ madhuraṃ sma saḥ ।
jāpakaistulyaphalatā yogānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: BUyaScEvAparaM prAha vacanaM maDuraM sma saH । jApakEstulyaPalatA yogAnAM nAtra saMSayaH ॥22॥

text: yogasya tāvadetebhyaḥ phalaṃ pratyakṣadarśanam । jāpakānāṃ viśiṣṭaṃ tu pratyutthānaṃ samādhikam ॥23॥
html:
yogasya tāvadetebhyaḥ phalaṃ pratyakṣadarśanam ।
jāpakānāṃ viśiṣṭaṃ tu pratyutthānaṃ samādhikam ॥23॥
slp1: yogasya tAvadeteByaH PalaM pratyakzadarSanam । jApakAnAM viSizwaM tu pratyutTAnaM samADikam ॥23॥

text: uṣyatāṃ mayi cetyuktvācetayatsa tataḥ punaḥ । athāsya praviveśāsyaṃ brāhmaṇo vigatajvaraḥ ॥24॥
html:
uṣyatāṃ mayi cetyuktvācetayatsa tataḥ punaḥ ।
athāsya praviveśāsyaṃ brāhmaṇo vigatajvaraḥ ॥24॥
slp1: uzyatAM mayi cetyuktvAcetayatsa tataH punaH । aTAsya praviveSAsyaM brAhmaRo vigatajvaraH ॥24॥

text: rājāpyetena vidhinā bhagavantaṃ pitāmaham । yathaiva dvijaśārdūlastathaiva prāviśattadā ॥25॥
html:
rājāpyetena vidhinā bhagavantaṃ pitāmaham ।
yathaiva dvijaśārdūlastathaiva prāviśattadā ॥25॥
slp1: rAjApyetena viDinA BagavantaM pitAmaham । yaTEva dvijaSArdUlastaTEva prAviSattadA ॥25॥

text: svayaṃbhuvamatho devā abhivādya tato'bruvan । jāpakārthamayaṃ yatnastadarthaṃ vayamāgatāḥ ॥26॥
html:
svayaṃbhuvamatho devā abhivādya tato'bruvan ।
jāpakārthamayaṃ yatnastadarthaṃ vayamāgatāḥ ॥26॥
slp1: svayaMBuvamaTo devA aBivAdya tato'bruvan । jApakArTamayaM yatnastadarTaM vayamAgatAH ॥26॥

text: kṛtapūjāvimau tulyaṃ tvayā tulyaphalāvimau । yogajāpakayordṛṣṭaṃ phalaṃ sumahadadya vai । sarvāṁllokānatītyaitau gacchetāṃ yatra vāñchitam ॥27॥
html:
kṛtapūjāvimau tulyaṃ tvayā tulyaphalāvimau ।
yogajāpakayordṛṣṭaṃ phalaṃ sumahadadya vai ।
sarvāṁllokānatītyaitau gacchetāṃ yatra vāñchitam ॥27॥
slp1: kftapUjAvimO tulyaM tvayA tulyaPalAvimO । yogajApakayordfzwaM PalaM sumahadadya vE । sarvAṁllokAnatItyEtO gacCetAM yatra vAYCitam ॥27॥

text: mahāsmṛtiṃ paṭhedyastu tathaivānusmṛtiṃ śubhām । tāvapyetena vidhinā gacchetāṃ matsalokatām ॥28॥
html:
mahāsmṛtiṃ paṭhedyastu tathaivānusmṛtiṃ śubhām ।
tāvapyetena vidhinā gacchetāṃ matsalokatām ॥28॥
slp1: mahAsmftiM paWedyastu taTEvAnusmftiM SuBAm । tAvapyetena viDinA gacCetAM matsalokatAm ॥28॥
author: brahmovāca ।

text: yaśca yoge bhavedbhaktaḥ so'pi nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ । vidhinānena dehānte mama lokānavāpnuyāt । gamyatāṃ sādhayiṣyāmi yathāsthānāni siddhaye ॥29॥
html:
yaśca yoge bhavedbhaktaḥ so'pi nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ।
vidhinānena dehānte mama lokānavāpnuyāt ।
gamyatāṃ sādhayiṣyāmi yathāsthānāni siddhaye ॥29॥
slp1: yaSca yoge BavedBaktaH so'pi nAstyatra saMSayaH । viDinAnena dehAnte mama lokAnavApnuyAt । gamyatAM sADayizyAmi yaTAsTAnAni sidDaye ॥29॥

text: ityuktvā sa tadā devastatraivāntaradhīyata । āmantrya taṃ tato devā yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niveśanam ॥30॥
html:
ityuktvā sa tadā devastatraivāntaradhīyata ।
āmantrya taṃ tato devā yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niveśanam ॥30॥
slp1: ityuktvA sa tadA devastatrEvAntaraDIyata । Amantrya taM tato devA yayuH svaM svaM niveSanam ॥30॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: te ca sarve mahātmāno dharmaṃ satkṛtya tatra vai । pṛṣṭhato'nuyayū rājansarve suprītamānasāḥ ॥31॥
html:
te ca sarve mahātmāno dharmaṃ satkṛtya tatra vai ।
pṛṣṭhato'nuyayū rājansarve suprītamānasāḥ ॥31॥
slp1: te ca sarve mahAtmAno DarmaM satkftya tatra vE । pfzWato'nuyayU rAjansarve suprItamAnasAH ॥31॥

text: etatphalaṃ jāpakānāṃ gatiścaiva prakīrtitā । yathāśrutaṃ mahārāja kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi] ॥32॥
html:
etatphalaṃ jāpakānāṃ gatiścaiva prakīrtitā ।
yathāśrutaṃ mahārāja kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi] ॥32॥
slp1: etatPalaM jApakAnAM gatiScEva prakIrtitA । yaTASrutaM mahArAja kiM BUyaH SrotumicCasi] ॥32॥

text: kiṃ phalaṃ jñānayogasya vedānāṃ niyamasya ca । bhūtātmā vā kathaṃ jñeyastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
kiṃ phalaṃ jñānayogasya vedānāṃ niyamasya ca ।
bhūtātmā vā kathaṃ jñeyastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: kiM PalaM jYAnayogasya vedAnAM niyamasya ca । BUtAtmA vA kaTaM jYeyastanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । manoḥ prajāpatervādaṃ maharṣeśca bṛhaspateḥ ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
manoḥ prajāpatervādaṃ maharṣeśca bṛhaspateḥ ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । manoH prajApatervAdaM maharzeSca bfhaspateH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: prajāpatiṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ pṛthivyāṃ devarṣisaṅghapravaro maharṣiḥ । bṛhaspatiḥ praśnamimaṃ purāṇaṃ papraccha śiṣyo'tha guruṃ praṇamya ॥3॥
html:
prajāpatiṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ pṛthivyāṃ devarṣisaṅghapravaro maharṣiḥ ।
bṛhaspatiḥ praśnamimaṃ purāṇaṃ papraccha śiṣyo'tha guruṃ praṇamya ॥3॥
slp1: prajApatiM SrezWatamaM pfTivyAM devarzisaNGapravaro maharziH । bfhaspatiH praSnamimaM purARaM papracCa Sizyo'Ta guruM praRamya ॥3॥

text: yatkāraṇaṃ mantravidhiḥ pravṛtto jñāne phalaṃ yatpravadanti viprāḥ । yanmantraśabdairakṛtaprakāśaṃ taducyatāṃ me bhagavanyathāvat ॥4॥
html:
yatkāraṇaṃ mantravidhiḥ pravṛtto jñāne phalaṃ yatpravadanti viprāḥ ।
yanmantraśabdairakṛtaprakāśaṃ taducyatāṃ me bhagavanyathāvat ॥4॥
slp1: yatkAraRaM mantraviDiH pravftto jYAne PalaM yatpravadanti viprAH । yanmantraSabdErakftaprakASaM taducyatAM me BagavanyaTAvat ॥4॥

text: yadarthaśāstrāgamamantravidbhiryajñairanekairvaragopradānaiḥ । phalaṃ mahadbhiryadupāsyate ca tatkiṃ kathaṃ vā bhavitā kva vā tat ॥5॥
html:
yadarthaśāstrāgamamantravidbhiryajñairanekairvaragopradānaiḥ ।
phalaṃ mahadbhiryadupāsyate ca tatkiṃ kathaṃ vā bhavitā kva vā tat ॥5॥
slp1: yadarTaSAstrAgamamantravidBiryajYEranekErvaragopradAnEH । PalaM mahadBiryadupAsyate ca tatkiM kaTaM vA BavitA kva vA tat ॥5॥

text: mahī mahījāḥ pavano'ntarikṣaṃ jalaukasaścaiva jalaṃ divaṃ ca । divaukasaścaiva yataḥ prasūtāstaducyatāṃ me bhagavanpurāṇam ॥6॥
html:
mahī mahījāḥ pavano'ntarikṣaṃ jalaukasaścaiva jalaṃ divaṃ ca ।
divaukasaścaiva yataḥ prasūtāstaducyatāṃ me bhagavanpurāṇam ॥6॥
slp1: mahI mahIjAH pavano'ntarikzaM jalOkasaScEva jalaM divaM ca । divOkasaScEva yataH prasUtAstaducyatAM me BagavanpurARam ॥6॥

text: jñānaṃ yataḥ prārthayate naro vai tatastadarthā bhavati pravṛttiḥ । na cāpyahaṃ veda paraṃ purāṇaṃ mithyāpravṛttiṃ ca kathaṃ nu kuryām ॥7॥
html:
jñānaṃ yataḥ prārthayate naro vai tatastadarthā bhavati pravṛttiḥ ।
na cāpyahaṃ veda paraṃ purāṇaṃ mithyāpravṛttiṃ ca kathaṃ nu kuryām ॥7॥
slp1: jYAnaM yataH prArTayate naro vE tatastadarTA Bavati pravfttiH । na cApyahaM veda paraM purARaM miTyApravfttiM ca kaTaM nu kuryAm ॥7॥

text: ṛksāmasaṅghāṃśca yajūṃṣi cāhaṃ chandāṃsi nakṣatragatiṃ niruktam । adhītya ca vyākaraṇaṃ sakalpaṃ śikṣāṃ ca bhūtaprakṛtiṃ na vedmi ॥8॥
html:
ṛksāmasaṅghāṃśca yajūṃṣi cāhaṃ chandāṃsi nakṣatragatiṃ niruktam ।
adhītya ca vyākaraṇaṃ sakalpaṃ śikṣāṃ ca bhūtaprakṛtiṃ na vedmi ॥8॥
slp1: fksAmasaNGAMSca yajUMzi cAhaM CandAMsi nakzatragatiM niruktam । aDItya ca vyAkaraRaM sakalpaM SikzAM ca BUtaprakftiM na vedmi ॥8॥

text: sa me bhavāñśaṃsatu sarvametajjñāne phalaṃ karmaṇi vā yadasti । yathā ca dehāccyavate śarīrī punaḥ śarīraṃ ca yathābhyupaiti ॥9॥
html:
sa me bhavāñśaṃsatu sarvametajjñāne phalaṃ karmaṇi vā yadasti ।
yathā ca dehāccyavate śarīrī punaḥ śarīraṃ ca yathābhyupaiti ॥9॥
slp1: sa me BavAYSaMsatu sarvametajjYAne PalaM karmaRi vA yadasti । yaTA ca dehAccyavate SarIrI punaH SarIraM ca yaTAByupEti ॥9॥

text: yadyatpriyaṃ yasya sukhaṃ tadāhustadeva duḥkhaṃ pravadantyaniṣṭam । iṣṭaṃ ca me syāditaracca na syādetatkṛte karmavidhiḥ pravṛttaḥ । iṣṭaṃ tvaniṣṭaṃ ca na māṃ bhajetetyetatkṛte jñānavidhiḥ pravṛttaḥ ॥10॥
html:
yadyatpriyaṃ yasya sukhaṃ tadāhustadeva duḥkhaṃ pravadantyaniṣṭam ।
iṣṭaṃ ca me syāditaracca na syādetatkṛte karmavidhiḥ pravṛttaḥ ।
iṣṭaṃ tvaniṣṭaṃ ca na māṃ bhajetetyetatkṛte jñānavidhiḥ pravṛttaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: yadyatpriyaM yasya suKaM tadAhustadeva duHKaM pravadantyanizwam । izwaM ca me syAditaracca na syAdetatkfte karmaviDiH pravfttaH । izwaM tvanizwaM ca na mAM Bajetetyetatkfte jYAnaviDiH pravfttaH ॥10॥
author: manuruvāca ।

text: kāmātmakāśchandasi karmayogā ebhirvimuktaḥ paramaśnuvīta । nānāvidhe karmapathe sukhārthī naraḥ pravṛtto na paraṃ prayāti । paraṃ hi tatkarmapathādapetaṃ nirāśiṣaṃ brahmaparaṃ hyavaśyam ॥11॥
html:
kāmātmakāśchandasi karmayogā ebhirvimuktaḥ paramaśnuvīta ।
nānāvidhe karmapathe sukhārthī naraḥ pravṛtto na paraṃ prayāti ।
paraṃ hi tatkarmapathādapetaṃ nirāśiṣaṃ brahmaparaṃ hyavaśyam ॥11॥
slp1: kAmAtmakASCandasi karmayogA eBirvimuktaH paramaSnuvIta । nAnAviDe karmapaTe suKArTI naraH pravftto na paraM prayAti । paraM hi tatkarmapaTAdapetaM nirASizaM brahmaparaM hyavaSyam ॥11॥

text: prajāḥ sṛṣṭā manasā karmaṇā ca dvāvapyetau satpathau lokajuṣṭau । dṛṣṭvā karma śāśvataṃ cāntavacca manastyāgaḥ kāraṇaṃ nānyadasti ॥12॥
html:
prajāḥ sṛṣṭā manasā karmaṇā ca dvāvapyetau satpathau lokajuṣṭau ।
dṛṣṭvā karma śāśvataṃ cāntavacca manastyāgaḥ kāraṇaṃ nānyadasti ॥12॥
slp1: prajAH sfzwA manasA karmaRA ca dvAvapyetO satpaTO lokajuzwO । dfzwvA karma SASvataM cAntavacca manastyAgaH kAraRaM nAnyadasti ॥12॥

text: svenātmanā cakṣuriva praṇetā niśātyaye tamasā saṃvṛtātmā । jñānaṃ tu vijñānaguṇena yuktaṃ karmāśubhaṃ paśyati varjanīyam ॥13॥
html:
svenātmanā cakṣuriva praṇetā niśātyaye tamasā saṃvṛtātmā ।
jñānaṃ tu vijñānaguṇena yuktaṃ karmāśubhaṃ paśyati varjanīyam ॥13॥
slp1: svenAtmanA cakzuriva praRetA niSAtyaye tamasA saMvftAtmA । jYAnaM tu vijYAnaguRena yuktaM karmASuBaM paSyati varjanIyam ॥13॥

text: sarpānkuśāgrāṇi tathodapānaṃ jñātvā manuṣyāḥ parivarjayanti । ajñānatastatra patanti mūḍhā jñāne phalaṃ paśya yathā viśiṣṭam ॥14॥
html:
sarpānkuśāgrāṇi tathodapānaṃ jñātvā manuṣyāḥ parivarjayanti ।
ajñānatastatra patanti mūḍhā jñāne phalaṃ paśya yathā viśiṣṭam ॥14॥
slp1: sarpAnkuSAgrARi taTodapAnaM jYAtvA manuzyAH parivarjayanti । ajYAnatastatra patanti mUQA jYAne PalaM paSya yaTA viSizwam ॥14॥

text: kṛtsnastu mantro vidhivatprayukto yajñā yathoktāstvatha dakṣiṇāśca । annapradānaṃ manasaḥ samādhiḥ pañcātmakaṃ karmaphalaṃ vadanti ॥15॥
html:
kṛtsnastu mantro vidhivatprayukto yajñā yathoktāstvatha dakṣiṇāśca ।
annapradānaṃ manasaḥ samādhiḥ pañcātmakaṃ karmaphalaṃ vadanti ॥15॥
slp1: kftsnastu mantro viDivatprayukto yajYA yaToktAstvaTa dakziRASca । annapradAnaM manasaH samADiH paYcAtmakaM karmaPalaM vadanti ॥15॥

text: guṇātmakaṃ karma vadanti vedāstasmānmantrā mantramūlaṃ hi karma । vidhirvidheyaṃ manasopapattiḥ phalasya bhoktā tu yathā śarīrī ॥16॥
html:
guṇātmakaṃ karma vadanti vedāstasmānmantrā mantramūlaṃ hi karma ।
vidhirvidheyaṃ manasopapattiḥ phalasya bhoktā tu yathā śarīrī ॥16॥
slp1: guRAtmakaM karma vadanti vedAstasmAnmantrA mantramUlaM hi karma । viDirviDeyaM manasopapattiH Palasya BoktA tu yaTA SarIrI ॥16॥

text: śabdāśca rūpāṇi rasāśca puṇyāḥ sparśāśca gandhāśca śubhāstathaiva । naro nasaṃsthānagataḥ prabhuḥ syādetatphalaṃ sidhyati karmaloke ॥17॥
html:
śabdāśca rūpāṇi rasāśca puṇyāḥ sparśāśca gandhāśca śubhāstathaiva ।
naro nasaṃsthānagataḥ prabhuḥ syādetatphalaṃ sidhyati karmaloke ॥17॥
slp1: SabdASca rUpARi rasASca puRyAH sparSASca ganDASca SuBAstaTEva । naro nasaMsTAnagataH praBuH syAdetatPalaM siDyati karmaloke ॥17॥

text: yadyaccharīreṇa karoti karma śarīrayuktaḥ samupāśnute tat । śarīramevāyatanaṃ sukhasya duḥkhasya cāpyāyatanaṃ śarīram ॥18॥
html:
yadyaccharīreṇa karoti karma śarīrayuktaḥ samupāśnute tat ।
śarīramevāyatanaṃ sukhasya duḥkhasya cāpyāyatanaṃ śarīram ॥18॥
slp1: yadyacCarIreRa karoti karma SarIrayuktaH samupASnute tat । SarIramevAyatanaM suKasya duHKasya cApyAyatanaM SarIram ॥18॥

text: vācā tu yatkarma karoti kiñcidvācaiva sarvaṃ samupāśnute tat । manastu yatkarma karoti kiñcinmanaḥstha evāyamupāśnute tat ॥19॥
html:
vācā tu yatkarma karoti kiñcidvācaiva sarvaṃ samupāśnute tat ।
manastu yatkarma karoti kiñcinmanaḥstha evāyamupāśnute tat ॥19॥
slp1: vAcA tu yatkarma karoti kiYcidvAcEva sarvaM samupASnute tat । manastu yatkarma karoti kiYcinmanaHsTa evAyamupASnute tat ॥19॥

text: yathāguṇaṃ karmagaṇaṃ phalārthī karotyayaṃ karmaphale niviṣṭaḥ । tathā tathāyaṃ guṇasamprayuktaḥ śubhāśubhaṃ karmaphalaṃ bhunakti ॥20॥
html:
yathāguṇaṃ karmagaṇaṃ phalārthī karotyayaṃ karmaphale niviṣṭaḥ ।
tathā tathāyaṃ guṇasamprayuktaḥ śubhāśubhaṃ karmaphalaṃ bhunakti ॥20॥
slp1: yaTAguRaM karmagaRaM PalArTI karotyayaM karmaPale nivizwaH । taTA taTAyaM guRasamprayuktaH SuBASuBaM karmaPalaM Bunakti ॥20॥

text: matsyo yathā srota ivābhipātī tathā kṛtaṃ pūrvamupaiti karma । śubhe tvasau tuṣyati duṣkṛte tu na tuṣyate vai paramaḥ śarīrī ॥21॥
html:
matsyo yathā srota ivābhipātī tathā kṛtaṃ pūrvamupaiti karma ।
śubhe tvasau tuṣyati duṣkṛte tu na tuṣyate vai paramaḥ śarīrī ॥21॥
slp1: matsyo yaTA srota ivABipAtI taTA kftaM pUrvamupEti karma । SuBe tvasO tuzyati duzkfte tu na tuzyate vE paramaH SarIrI ॥21॥

text: yato jagatsarvamidaṃ prasūtaṃ jñātvātmavanto vyatiyānti yattat । yanmantraśabdairakṛtaprakāśaṃ taducyamānaṃ śṛṇu me paraṃ yat ॥22॥
html:
yato jagatsarvamidaṃ prasūtaṃ jñātvātmavanto vyatiyānti yattat ।
yanmantraśabdairakṛtaprakāśaṃ taducyamānaṃ śṛṇu me paraṃ yat ॥22॥
slp1: yato jagatsarvamidaM prasUtaM jYAtvAtmavanto vyatiyAnti yattat । yanmantraSabdErakftaprakASaM taducyamAnaM SfRu me paraM yat ॥22॥

text: rasairviyuktaṃ vividhaiśca gandhairaśabdamasparśamarūpavacca । agrāhyamavyaktamavarṇamekaṃ pañcaprakāraṃ sasṛje prajānām ॥23॥
html:
rasairviyuktaṃ vividhaiśca gandhairaśabdamasparśamarūpavacca ।
agrāhyamavyaktamavarṇamekaṃ pañcaprakāraṃ sasṛje prajānām ॥23॥
slp1: rasErviyuktaM viviDESca ganDEraSabdamasparSamarUpavacca । agrAhyamavyaktamavarRamekaM paYcaprakAraM sasfje prajAnAm ॥23॥

text: na strī pumānvāpi napuṃsakaṃ ca na sanna cāsatsadasacca tanna । paśyanti yadbrahmavido manuṣyāstadakṣaraṃ na kṣaratīti viddhi] ॥24॥
html:
na strī pumānvāpi napuṃsakaṃ ca na sanna cāsatsadasacca tanna ।
paśyanti yadbrahmavido manuṣyāstadakṣaraṃ na kṣaratīti viddhi] ॥24॥
slp1: na strI pumAnvApi napuMsakaM ca na sanna cAsatsadasacca tanna । paSyanti yadbrahmavido manuzyAstadakzaraM na kzaratIti vidDi] ॥24॥

text: akṣarātkhaṃ tato vāyurvāyorjyotistato jalam । jalātprasūtā jagatī jagatyāṃ jāyate jagat ॥1॥
html:
akṣarātkhaṃ tato vāyurvāyorjyotistato jalam ।
jalātprasūtā jagatī jagatyāṃ jāyate jagat ॥1॥
slp1: akzarAtKaM tato vAyurvAyorjyotistato jalam । jalAtprasUtA jagatI jagatyAM jAyate jagat ॥1॥
author: manuruvāca ।

text: ime śarīrairjalameva gatvā jalācca tejaḥ pavano'ntarikṣam । khādvai nivartanti nabhāvinaste ye bhāvinaste paramāpnuvanti ॥2॥
html:
ime śarīrairjalameva gatvā jalācca tejaḥ pavano'ntarikṣam ।
khādvai nivartanti nabhāvinaste ye bhāvinaste paramāpnuvanti ॥2॥
slp1: ime SarIrErjalameva gatvA jalAcca tejaH pavano'ntarikzam । KAdvE nivartanti naBAvinaste ye BAvinaste paramApnuvanti ॥2॥

text: noṣṇaṃ na śītaṃ mṛdu nāpi tīkṣṇaṃ nāmlaṃ kaṣāyaṃ madhuraṃ na tiktam । na śabdavannāpi ca gandhavattanna rūpavattatparamasvabhāvam ॥3॥
html:
noṣṇaṃ na śītaṃ mṛdu nāpi tīkṣṇaṃ nāmlaṃ kaṣāyaṃ madhuraṃ na tiktam ।
na śabdavannāpi ca gandhavattanna rūpavattatparamasvabhāvam ॥3॥
slp1: nozRaM na SItaM mfdu nApi tIkzRaM nAmlaM kazAyaM maDuraM na tiktam । na SabdavannApi ca ganDavattanna rUpavattatparamasvaBAvam ॥3॥

text: sparśaṃ tanurveda rasaṃ tu jihvā ghrāṇaṃ ca gandhāñśravaṇe ca śabdān । rūpāṇi cakṣurna ca tatparaṃ yadgṛhṇantyanadhyātmavido manuṣyāḥ ॥4॥
html:
sparśaṃ tanurveda rasaṃ tu jihvā ghrāṇaṃ ca gandhāñśravaṇe ca śabdān ।
rūpāṇi cakṣurna ca tatparaṃ yadgṛhṇantyanadhyātmavido manuṣyāḥ ॥4॥
slp1: sparSaM tanurveda rasaM tu jihvA GrARaM ca ganDAYSravaRe ca SabdAn । rUpARi cakzurna ca tatparaM yadgfhRantyanaDyAtmavido manuzyAH ॥4॥

text: nivartayitvā rasanaṃ rasebhyo ghrāṇaṃ ca gandhācchravaṇe ca śabdāt । sparśāttanuṃ rūpaguṇāttu cakṣustataḥ paraṃ paśyati svaṃ svabhāvam ॥5॥
html:
nivartayitvā rasanaṃ rasebhyo ghrāṇaṃ ca gandhācchravaṇe ca śabdāt ।
sparśāttanuṃ rūpaguṇāttu cakṣustataḥ paraṃ paśyati svaṃ svabhāvam ॥5॥
slp1: nivartayitvA rasanaM raseByo GrARaM ca ganDAcCravaRe ca SabdAt । sparSAttanuM rUpaguRAttu cakzustataH paraM paSyati svaM svaBAvam ॥5॥

text: yato gṛhītvā hi karoti yacca yasmiṃśca tāmārabhate pravṛttim । yasmiṃśca yadyena ca yaśca kartā tatkāraṇaṃ taṃ samupāyamāhuḥ ॥6॥
html:
yato gṛhītvā hi karoti yacca yasmiṃśca tāmārabhate pravṛttim ।
yasmiṃśca yadyena ca yaśca kartā tatkāraṇaṃ taṃ samupāyamāhuḥ ॥6॥
slp1: yato gfhItvA hi karoti yacca yasmiMSca tAmAraBate pravfttim । yasmiMSca yadyena ca yaSca kartA tatkAraRaM taM samupAyamAhuH ॥6॥

text: yaccābhibhūḥ sādhakaṃ vyāpakaṃ ca yanmantravacchaṃsyate caiva loke । yaḥ sarvahetuḥ paramārthakārī tatkāraṇaṃ kāryamato yadanyat ॥7॥
html:
yaccābhibhūḥ sādhakaṃ vyāpakaṃ ca yanmantravacchaṃsyate caiva loke ।
yaḥ sarvahetuḥ paramārthakārī tatkāraṇaṃ kāryamato yadanyat ॥7॥
slp1: yaccABiBUH sADakaM vyApakaM ca yanmantravacCaMsyate cEva loke । yaH sarvahetuH paramArTakArI tatkAraRaM kAryamato yadanyat ॥7॥

text: yathā ca kaścitsukṛtairmanuṣyaḥ śubhāśubhaṃ prāpnute'thāvirodhāt । evaṃ śarīreṣu śubhāśubheṣu svakarmajairjñānamidaṃ nibaddham ॥8॥
html:
yathā ca kaścitsukṛtairmanuṣyaḥ śubhāśubhaṃ prāpnute'thāvirodhāt ।
evaṃ śarīreṣu śubhāśubheṣu svakarmajairjñānamidaṃ nibaddham ॥8॥
slp1: yaTA ca kaScitsukftErmanuzyaH SuBASuBaM prApnute'TAviroDAt । evaM SarIrezu SuBASuBezu svakarmajErjYAnamidaM nibadDam ॥8॥

text: yathā pradīpaḥ purataḥ pradīptaḥ prakāśamanyasya karoti dīpyan । tatheha pañcendriyadīpavṛkṣā jñānapradīptāḥ paravanta eva ॥9॥
html:
yathā pradīpaḥ purataḥ pradīptaḥ prakāśamanyasya karoti dīpyan ।
tatheha pañcendriyadīpavṛkṣā jñānapradīptāḥ paravanta eva ॥9॥
slp1: yaTA pradIpaH purataH pradIptaH prakASamanyasya karoti dIpyan । taTeha paYcendriyadIpavfkzA jYAnapradIptAH paravanta eva ॥9॥

text: yathā hi rājño bahavo hyamātyāḥ pṛthakpramāṇaṃ pravadanti yuktāḥ । tadvaccharīreṣu bhavanti pañca jñānaikadeśaḥ paramaḥ sa tebhyaḥ ॥10॥
html:
yathā hi rājño bahavo hyamātyāḥ pṛthakpramāṇaṃ pravadanti yuktāḥ ।
tadvaccharīreṣu bhavanti pañca jñānaikadeśaḥ paramaḥ sa tebhyaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: yaTA hi rAjYo bahavo hyamAtyAH pfTakpramARaM pravadanti yuktAH । tadvacCarIrezu Bavanti paYca jYAnEkadeSaH paramaH sa teByaH ॥10॥

text: yathārciṣo'gneḥ pavanasya vegā marīcayo'rkasya nadīṣu cāpaḥ । gacchanti cāyānti ca tanyamānāstadvaccharīrāṇi śarīriṇāṃ tu ॥11॥
html:
yathārciṣo'gneḥ pavanasya vegā marīcayo'rkasya nadīṣu cāpaḥ ।
gacchanti cāyānti ca tanyamānāstadvaccharīrāṇi śarīriṇāṃ tu ॥11॥
slp1: yaTArcizo'gneH pavanasya vegA marIcayo'rkasya nadIzu cApaH । gacCanti cAyAnti ca tanyamAnAstadvacCarIrARi SarIriRAM tu ॥11॥

text: yathā ca kaścitparaśuṃ gṛhītvā dhūmaṃ na paśyejjvalanaṃ ca kāṣṭhe । tadvaccharīrodarapāṇipādaṃ chittvā na paśyanti tato yadanyat ॥12॥
html:
yathā ca kaścitparaśuṃ gṛhītvā dhūmaṃ na paśyejjvalanaṃ ca kāṣṭhe ।
tadvaccharīrodarapāṇipādaṃ chittvā na paśyanti tato yadanyat ॥12॥
slp1: yaTA ca kaScitparaSuM gfhItvA DUmaM na paSyejjvalanaM ca kAzWe । tadvacCarIrodarapARipAdaM CittvA na paSyanti tato yadanyat ॥12॥

text: tānyeva kāṣṭhāni yathā vimathya dhūmaṃ ca paśyejjvalanaṃ ca yogāt । tadvatsubuddhiḥ samamindriyatvādbudhaḥ paraṃ paśyati svaṃ svabhāvam ॥13॥
html:
tānyeva kāṣṭhāni yathā vimathya dhūmaṃ ca paśyejjvalanaṃ ca yogāt ।
tadvatsubuddhiḥ samamindriyatvādbudhaḥ paraṃ paśyati svaṃ svabhāvam ॥13॥
slp1: tAnyeva kAzWAni yaTA vimaTya DUmaM ca paSyejjvalanaM ca yogAt । tadvatsubudDiH samamindriyatvAdbuDaH paraM paSyati svaM svaBAvam ॥13॥

text: yathātmano'ṅgaṃ patitaṃ pṛthivyāṃ svapnāntare paśyati cātmano'nyat । śrotrādiyuktaḥ sumanāḥ subuddhirliṅgāttathā gacchati liṅgamanyat ॥14॥
html:
yathātmano'ṅgaṃ patitaṃ pṛthivyāṃ svapnāntare paśyati cātmano'nyat ।
śrotrādiyuktaḥ sumanāḥ subuddhirliṅgāttathā gacchati liṅgamanyat ॥14॥
slp1: yaTAtmano'NgaM patitaM pfTivyAM svapnAntare paSyati cAtmano'nyat । SrotrAdiyuktaH sumanAH subudDirliNgAttaTA gacCati liNgamanyat ॥14॥

text: utpattivṛddhikṣayasannipātairna yujyate'sau paramaḥ śarīrī । anena liṅgena tu liṅgamanyadgacchatyadṛṣṭaḥ pratisandhiyogāt ॥15॥
html:
utpattivṛddhikṣayasannipātairna yujyate'sau paramaḥ śarīrī ।
anena liṅgena tu liṅgamanyadgacchatyadṛṣṭaḥ pratisandhiyogāt ॥15॥
slp1: utpattivfdDikzayasannipAtErna yujyate'sO paramaH SarIrI । anena liNgena tu liNgamanyadgacCatyadfzwaH pratisanDiyogAt ॥15॥

text: na cakṣuṣā paśyati rūpamātmano na cāpi saṃsparśamupaiti kiñcit । na cāpi taiḥ sādhayate'tha kāryaṃ te taṃ na paśyanti sa paśyate tān ॥16॥
html:
na cakṣuṣā paśyati rūpamātmano na cāpi saṃsparśamupaiti kiñcit ।
na cāpi taiḥ sādhayate'tha kāryaṃ te taṃ na paśyanti sa paśyate tān ॥16॥
slp1: na cakzuzA paSyati rUpamAtmano na cApi saMsparSamupEti kiYcit । na cApi tEH sADayate'Ta kAryaM te taM na paSyanti sa paSyate tAn ॥16॥

text: yathā pradīpe jvalato'nalasya santāpajaṃ rūpamupaiti kiñcit । na cāntaraṃ rūpaguṇaṃ bibharti tathaiva taddṛśyate rūpamasya ॥17॥
html:
yathā pradīpe jvalato'nalasya santāpajaṃ rūpamupaiti kiñcit ।
na cāntaraṃ rūpaguṇaṃ bibharti tathaiva taddṛśyate rūpamasya ॥17॥
slp1: yaTA pradIpe jvalato'nalasya santApajaM rUpamupEti kiYcit । na cAntaraM rUpaguRaM biBarti taTEva taddfSyate rUpamasya ॥17॥

text: yathā manuṣyaḥ parimucya kāyamadṛśyamanyadviśate śarīram । visṛjya bhūteṣu mahatsu dehaṃ tadāśrayaṃ caiva bibharti rūpam ॥18॥
html:
yathā manuṣyaḥ parimucya kāyamadṛśyamanyadviśate śarīram ।
visṛjya bhūteṣu mahatsu dehaṃ tadāśrayaṃ caiva bibharti rūpam ॥18॥
slp1: yaTA manuzyaH parimucya kAyamadfSyamanyadviSate SarIram । visfjya BUtezu mahatsu dehaM tadASrayaM cEva biBarti rUpam ॥18॥

text: khaṃ vāyumagniṃ salilaṃ tathorvīṃ samantato'bhyāviśate śarīrī । nānāśrayāḥ karmasu vartamānāḥ śrotrādayaḥ pañca guṇāñśrayante ॥19॥
html:
khaṃ vāyumagniṃ salilaṃ tathorvīṃ samantato'bhyāviśate śarīrī ।
nānāśrayāḥ karmasu vartamānāḥ śrotrādayaḥ pañca guṇāñśrayante ॥19॥
slp1: KaM vAyumagniM salilaM taTorvIM samantato'ByAviSate SarIrI । nAnASrayAH karmasu vartamAnAH SrotrAdayaH paYca guRAYSrayante ॥19॥

text: śrotraṃ khato ghrāṇamatho pṛthivyāstejomayaṃ rūpamatho vipākaḥ । jalāśrayaḥ sveda ukto rasaśca vāyvātmakaḥ sparśakṛto guṇaśca ॥20॥
html:
śrotraṃ khato ghrāṇamatho pṛthivyāstejomayaṃ rūpamatho vipākaḥ ।
jalāśrayaḥ sveda ukto rasaśca vāyvātmakaḥ sparśakṛto guṇaśca ॥20॥
slp1: SrotraM Kato GrARamaTo pfTivyAstejomayaM rUpamaTo vipAkaH । jalASrayaH sveda ukto rasaSca vAyvAtmakaH sparSakfto guRaSca ॥20॥

text: mahatsu bhūteṣu vasanti pañca pañcendriyārthāśca tathendriyeṣu । sarvāṇi caitāni manonugāni buddhiṃ mano'nveti manaḥ svabhāvam ॥21॥
html:

sarvāṇi caitāni manonugāni buddhiṃ mano'nveti manaḥ svabhāvam ॥21॥

text: śubhāśubhaṃ karma kṛtaṃ yadasya tadeva pratyādadate svadehe । mano'nuvartanti parāvarāṇi jalaukasaḥ srota ivānukūlam ॥22॥
html:
śubhāśubhaṃ karma kṛtaṃ yadasya tadeva pratyādadate svadehe ।
mano'nuvartanti parāvarāṇi jalaukasaḥ srota ivānukūlam ॥22॥
slp1: SuBASuBaM karma kftaM yadasya tadeva pratyAdadate svadehe । mano'nuvartanti parAvarARi jalOkasaH srota ivAnukUlam ॥22॥

text: calaṃ yathā dṛṣṭipathaṃ paraiti sūkṣmaṃ mahadrūpamivābhipāti । svarūpamālocayate ca rūpaṃ paraṃ tathā buddhipathaṃ paraiti] ॥23॥
html:
calaṃ yathā dṛṣṭipathaṃ paraiti sūkṣmaṃ mahadrūpamivābhipāti ।
svarūpamālocayate ca rūpaṃ paraṃ tathā buddhipathaṃ paraiti] ॥23॥

text: yadindriyaistūpakṛtānpurastātprāptānguṇānsaṃsmarate cirāya । teṣvindriyeṣūpahateṣu paścātsa buddhirūpaḥ paramaḥ svabhāvaḥ ॥1॥
html:
yadindriyaistūpakṛtānpurastātprāptānguṇānsaṃsmarate cirāya ।
teṣvindriyeṣūpahateṣu paścātsa buddhirūpaḥ paramaḥ svabhāvaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: yadindriyEstUpakftAnpurastAtprAptAnguRAnsaMsmarate cirAya । tezvindriyezUpahatezu paScAtsa budDirUpaH paramaH svaBAvaH ॥1॥
author: manuruvāca ।

text: yathendriyārthānyugapatsamastānnāvekṣate kṛtsnamatulyakālam । yathābalaṃ sañcarate sa vidvāṃstasmātsa ekaḥ paramaḥ śarīrī ॥2॥
html:
yathendriyārthānyugapatsamastānnāvekṣate kṛtsnamatulyakālam ।
yathābalaṃ sañcarate sa vidvāṃstasmātsa ekaḥ paramaḥ śarīrī ॥2॥
slp1: yaTendriyArTAnyugapatsamastAnnAvekzate kftsnamatulyakAlam । yaTAbalaM saYcarate sa vidvAMstasmAtsa ekaH paramaH SarIrI ॥2॥

text: rajastamaḥ sattvamatho tṛtīyaṃ gacchatyasau jñānaguṇānvirūpān । tathendriyāṇyāviśate śarīrī hutāśanaṃ vāyurivendhanastham ॥3॥
html:
rajastamaḥ sattvamatho tṛtīyaṃ gacchatyasau jñānaguṇānvirūpān ।
tathendriyāṇyāviśate śarīrī hutāśanaṃ vāyurivendhanastham ॥3॥
slp1: rajastamaH sattvamaTo tftIyaM gacCatyasO jYAnaguRAnvirUpAn । taTendriyARyAviSate SarIrI hutASanaM vAyurivenDanasTam ॥3॥

text: na cakṣuṣā paśyati rūpamātmano na paśyati sparśanamindriyendriyam । na śrotraliṅgaṃ śravaṇe nidarśanaṃ tathāgataṃ paśyati tadvinaśyati ॥4॥
html:
na cakṣuṣā paśyati rūpamātmano na paśyati sparśanamindriyendriyam ।
na śrotraliṅgaṃ śravaṇe nidarśanaṃ tathāgataṃ paśyati tadvinaśyati ॥4॥
slp1: na cakzuzA paSyati rUpamAtmano na paSyati sparSanamindriyendriyam । na SrotraliNgaM SravaRe nidarSanaM taTAgataM paSyati tadvinaSyati ॥4॥

text: śrotrādīni na paśyanti svaṃ svamātmānamātmanā । sarvajñaḥ sarvadarśī ca kṣetrajñastāni paśyati ॥5॥
html:
śrotrādīni na paśyanti svaṃ svamātmānamātmanā ।
sarvajñaḥ sarvadarśī ca kṣetrajñastāni paśyati ॥5॥
slp1: SrotrAdIni na paSyanti svaM svamAtmAnamAtmanA । sarvajYaH sarvadarSI ca kzetrajYastAni paSyati ॥5॥

text: yathā himavataḥ pārśvaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ candramaso yathā । na dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ manujairna ca tannāsti tāvatā ॥6॥
html:
yathā himavataḥ pārśvaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ candramaso yathā ।
na dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ manujairna ca tannāsti tāvatā ॥6॥
slp1: yaTA himavataH pArSvaM pfzWaM candramaso yaTA । na dfzwapUrvaM manujErna ca tannAsti tAvatA ॥6॥

text: tadvadbhūteṣu bhūtātmā sūkṣmo jñānātmavānasau । adṛṣṭapūrvaścakṣurbhyāṃ na cāsau nāsti tāvatā ॥7॥
html:
tadvadbhūteṣu bhūtātmā sūkṣmo jñānātmavānasau ।
adṛṣṭapūrvaścakṣurbhyāṃ na cāsau nāsti tāvatā ॥7॥
slp1: tadvadBUtezu BUtAtmA sUkzmo jYAnAtmavAnasO । adfzwapUrvaScakzurByAM na cAsO nAsti tAvatA ॥7॥

text: paśyannapi yathā lakṣma jagatsome na vindati । evamasti na vetyetanna ca tanna parāyaṇam ॥8॥
html:
paśyannapi yathā lakṣma jagatsome na vindati ।
evamasti na vetyetanna ca tanna parāyaṇam ॥8॥
slp1: paSyannapi yaTA lakzma jagatsome na vindati । evamasti na vetyetanna ca tanna parAyaRam ॥8॥

text: rūpavantamarūpatvādudayāstamaye budhāḥ । dhiyā samanupaśyanti tadgatāḥ saviturgatim ॥9॥
html:
rūpavantamarūpatvādudayāstamaye budhāḥ ।
dhiyā samanupaśyanti tadgatāḥ saviturgatim ॥9॥
slp1: rUpavantamarUpatvAdudayAstamaye buDAH । DiyA samanupaSyanti tadgatAH saviturgatim ॥9॥

text: tathā buddhipradīpena dūrasthaṃ suvipaścitaḥ । pratyāsannaṃ ninīṣanti jñeyaṃ jñānābhisaṃhitam ॥10॥
html:
tathā buddhipradīpena dūrasthaṃ suvipaścitaḥ ।
pratyāsannaṃ ninīṣanti jñeyaṃ jñānābhisaṃhitam ॥10॥
slp1: taTA budDipradIpena dUrasTaM suvipaScitaH । pratyAsannaM ninIzanti jYeyaM jYAnABisaMhitam ॥10॥

text: na hi khalvanupāyena kaścidartho'bhisidhyati । sūtrajālairyathā matsyānbadhnanti jalajīvinaḥ ॥11॥
html:

slp1: na hi KalvanupAyena kaScidarTo'BisiDyati । sUtrajAlEryaTA matsyAnbaDnanti jalajIvinaH ॥11॥

text: mṛgairmṛgāṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ pakṣiṇāṃ pakṣibhiryathā । gajānāṃ ca gajairevaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānena gṛhyate ॥12॥
html:
mṛgairmṛgāṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ pakṣiṇāṃ pakṣibhiryathā ।
gajānāṃ ca gajairevaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānena gṛhyate ॥12॥
slp1: mfgErmfgARAM grahaRaM pakziRAM pakziBiryaTA । gajAnAM ca gajErevaM jYeyaM jYAnena gfhyate ॥12॥

text: ahireva hyaheḥ pādānpaśyatīti nidarśanam । tadvanmūrtiṣu mūrtiṣṭhaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānena paśyati ॥13॥
html:
ahireva hyaheḥ pādānpaśyatīti nidarśanam ।
tadvanmūrtiṣu mūrtiṣṭhaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānena paśyati ॥13॥
slp1: ahireva hyaheH pAdAnpaSyatIti nidarSanam । tadvanmUrtizu mUrtizWaM jYeyaM jYAnena paSyati ॥13॥

text: notsahante yathā vettumindriyairindriyāṇyapi । tathaiveha parā buddhiḥ paraṃ buddhyā na paśyati ॥14॥
html:

text: yathā candro hyamāvāsyāmaliṅgatvānna dṛśyate । na ca nāśo'sya bhavati tathā viddhi śarīriṇam ॥15॥

yathā candro hyamāvāsyāmaliṅgatvānna dṛśyate ।

slp1: yaTA candro hyamAvAsyAmaliNgatvAnna dfSyate । na ca nASo'sya Bavati taTA vidDi SarIriRam ॥15॥

html:
kṣīṇakośo hyamāvāsyāṃ candramā na prakāśate ।
tadvanmūrtiviyuktaḥ sañśarīrī nopalabhyate ॥16॥
slp1: kzIRakoSo hyamAvAsyAM candramA na prakASate । tadvanmUrtiviyuktaH saYSarIrI nopalaByate ॥16॥

text: yathā kośāntaraṃ prāpya candramā bhrājate punaḥ । tadvalliṅgāntaraṃ prāpya śarīrī bhrājate punaḥ ॥17॥
html:
yathā kośāntaraṃ prāpya candramā bhrājate punaḥ ।
tadvalliṅgāntaraṃ prāpya śarīrī bhrājate punaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: yaTA koSAntaraM prApya candramA BrAjate punaH । tadvalliNgAntaraM prApya SarIrI BrAjate punaH ॥17॥

html:
janmavṛddhikṣayaścāsya pratyakṣeṇopalabhyate ।

slp1: janmavfdDikzayaScAsya pratyakzeRopalaByate । sA tu candramaso vyaktirna tu tasya SarIriRaH ॥18॥

text: utpattivṛddhivyayato yathā sa iti gṛhyate । candra eva tvamāvāsyāṃ tathā bhavati mūrtimān ॥19॥

utpattivṛddhivyayato yathā sa iti gṛhyate ।

slp1: utpattivfdDivyayato yaTA sa iti gfhyate । candra eva tvamAvAsyAM taTA Bavati mUrtimAn ॥19॥

text: nābhisarpadvimuñcadvā śaśinaṃ dṛśyate tamaḥ । visṛjaṃścopasarpaṃśca tadvatpaśya śarīriṇam ॥20॥
html:
nābhisarpadvimuñcadvā śaśinaṃ dṛśyate tamaḥ ।

html:
yathā candrārkasaṃyuktaṃ tamastadupalabhyate ।
tadvaccharīrasaṃyuktaḥ śarīrītyupalabhyate ॥21॥
slp1: yaTA candrArkasaMyuktaM tamastadupalaByate । tadvacCarIrasaMyuktaH SarIrItyupalaByate ॥21॥

html:
yathā candrārkanirmuktaḥ sa rāhurnopalabhyate ।
tadvaccharīranirmuktaḥ śarīrī nopalabhyate ॥22॥
slp1: yaTA candrArkanirmuktaH sa rAhurnopalaByate । tadvacCarIranirmuktaH SarIrI nopalaByate ॥22॥

text: yathā candro hyamāvāsyāṃ nakṣatrairyujyate gataḥ । tadvaccharīranirmuktaḥ phalairyujyati karmaṇaḥ] ॥23॥

yathā candro hyamāvāsyāṃ nakṣatrairyujyate gataḥ ।
tadvaccharīranirmuktaḥ phalairyujyati karmaṇaḥ] ॥23॥
slp1: yaTA candro hyamAvAsyAM nakzatrEryujyate gataH । tadvacCarIranirmuktaH PalEryujyati karmaRaH] ॥23॥

jñānamindriyasaṃyuktaṃ tadvatpretya bhavābhavau ॥1॥
slp1: yaTA vyaktamidaM Sete svapne carati cetanam । jYAnamindriyasaMyuktaM tadvatpretya BavABavO ॥1॥
author: manuruvāca ।

text: yathāmbhasi prasanne tu rūpaṃ paśyati cakṣuṣā । tadvatprasannendriyavāñjñeyaṃ jñānena paśyati ॥2॥
html:
yathāmbhasi prasanne tu rūpaṃ paśyati cakṣuṣā ।
tadvatprasannendriyavāñjñeyaṃ jñānena paśyati ॥2॥
slp1: yaTAmBasi prasanne tu rUpaM paSyati cakzuzA । tadvatprasannendriyavAYjYeyaM jYAnena paSyati ॥2॥

sa eva lulite tasminyathā rūpaṃ na paśyati ।
tathendriyākulībhāve jñeyaṃ jñāne na paśyati ॥3॥

text: abuddhirajñānakṛtā abuddhyā duṣyate manaḥ । duṣṭasya manasaḥ pañca sampraduṣyanti mānasāḥ ॥4॥
html:
abuddhirajñānakṛtā abuddhyā duṣyate manaḥ ।

html:
ajñānatṛpto viṣayeṣvavagāḍho na dṛśyate ।

tarṣacchedo na bhavati puruṣasyeha kalmaṣāt ।

html:
viṣayeṣu ca saṃsargācchāśvatasya na saṃśrayāt ।

text: jñānamutpadyate puṃsāṃ kṣayātpāpasya karmaṇaḥ । athādarśatalaprakhye paśyatyātmānamātmani ॥8॥
html:
jñānamutpadyate puṃsāṃ kṣayātpāpasya karmaṇaḥ ।
athādarśatalaprakhye paśyatyātmānamātmani ॥8॥
slp1: jYAnamutpadyate puMsAM kzayAtpApasya karmaRaH । aTAdarSatalapraKye paSyatyAtmAnamAtmani ॥8॥

text: prasṛtairindriyairduḥkhī taireva niyataiḥ sukhī । tasmādindriyarūpebhyo yacchedātmānamātmanā ॥9॥
html:
prasṛtairindriyairduḥkhī taireva niyataiḥ sukhī ।
tasmādindriyarūpebhyo yacchedātmānamātmanā ॥9॥
slp1: prasftErindriyErduHKI tEreva niyatEH suKI । tasmAdindriyarUpeByo yacCedAtmAnamAtmanA ॥9॥

text: indriyebhyo manaḥ pūrvaṃ buddhiḥ paratarā tataḥ । buddheḥ parataraṃ jñānaṃ jñānātparataraṃ param ॥10॥
html:
indriyebhyo manaḥ pūrvaṃ buddhiḥ paratarā tataḥ ।
buddheḥ parataraṃ jñānaṃ jñānātparataraṃ param ॥10॥
slp1: indriyeByo manaH pUrvaM budDiH paratarA tataH । budDeH parataraM jYAnaM jYAnAtparataraM param ॥10॥

text: avyaktātprasṛtaṃ jñānaṃ tato buddhistato manaḥ । manaḥ śrotrādibhiryuktaṃ śabdādīnsādhu paśyati ॥11॥
html:
avyaktātprasṛtaṃ jñānaṃ tato buddhistato manaḥ ।
manaḥ śrotrādibhiryuktaṃ śabdādīnsādhu paśyati ॥11॥
slp1: avyaktAtprasftaM jYAnaM tato budDistato manaH । manaH SrotrAdiBiryuktaM SabdAdInsADu paSyati ॥11॥

text: yastāṃstyajati śabdādīnsarvāśca vyaktayastathā । vimuñcatyākṛtigrāmāṃstānmuktvāmṛtamaśnute ॥12॥
html:
yastāṃstyajati śabdādīnsarvāśca vyaktayastathā ।
vimuñcatyākṛtigrāmāṃstānmuktvāmṛtamaśnute ॥12॥
slp1: yastAMstyajati SabdAdInsarvASca vyaktayastaTA । vimuYcatyAkftigrAmAMstAnmuktvAmftamaSnute ॥12॥

text: udyanhi savitā yadvatsṛjate raśmimaṇḍalam । sa evāstamupāgacchaṃstadevātmani yacchati ॥13॥
html:
udyanhi savitā yadvatsṛjate raśmimaṇḍalam ।
sa evāstamupāgacchaṃstadevātmani yacchati ॥13॥
slp1: udyanhi savitA yadvatsfjate raSmimaRqalam । sa evAstamupAgacCaMstadevAtmani yacCati ॥13॥

text: antarātmā tathā dehamāviśyendriyaraśmibhiḥ । prāpyendriyaguṇānpañca so'stamāvṛtya gacchati ॥14॥
html:
antarātmā tathā dehamāviśyendriyaraśmibhiḥ ।
prāpyendriyaguṇānpañca so'stamāvṛtya gacchati ॥14॥
slp1: antarAtmA taTA dehamAviSyendriyaraSmiBiH । prApyendriyaguRAnpaYca so'stamAvftya gacCati ॥14॥

text: praṇītaṃ karmaṇā mārgaṃ nīyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ । prāpnotyayaṃ karmaphalaṃ pravṛddhaṃ dharmamātmavān ॥15॥
html:
praṇītaṃ karmaṇā mārgaṃ nīyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
prāpnotyayaṃ karmaphalaṃ pravṛddhaṃ dharmamātmavān ॥15॥
slp1: praRItaM karmaRA mArgaM nIyamAnaH punaH punaH । prApnotyayaM karmaPalaM pravfdDaM DarmamAtmavAn ॥15॥

text: viṣayā vinivartante nirāhārasya dehinaḥ । rasavarjaṃ raso'pyasya paraṃ dṛṣṭvā nivartate ॥16॥
html:
viṣayā vinivartante nirāhārasya dehinaḥ ।
rasavarjaṃ raso'pyasya paraṃ dṛṣṭvā nivartate ॥16॥
slp1: vizayA vinivartante nirAhArasya dehinaH । rasavarjaM raso'pyasya paraM dfzwvA nivartate ॥16॥

text: buddhiḥ karmaguṇairhīnā yadā manasi vartate । tadā sampadyate brahma tatraiva pralayaṃ gatam ॥17॥
html:
buddhiḥ karmaguṇairhīnā yadā manasi vartate ।
tadā sampadyate brahma tatraiva pralayaṃ gatam ॥17॥
slp1: budDiH karmaguRErhInA yadA manasi vartate । tadA sampadyate brahma tatrEva pralayaM gatam ॥17॥

text: asparśanamaśṛṇvānamanāsvādamadarśanam । aghrāṇamavitarkaṃ ca sattvaṃ praviśate param ॥18॥
html:
asparśanamaśṛṇvānamanāsvādamadarśanam ।
aghrāṇamavitarkaṃ ca sattvaṃ praviśate param ॥18॥
slp1: asparSanamaSfRvAnamanAsvAdamadarSanam । aGrARamavitarkaM ca sattvaM praviSate param ॥18॥

text: manasyākṛtayo magnā manastvatigataṃ matim । matistvatigatā jñānaṃ jñānaṃ tvabhigataṃ param ॥19॥
html:
manasyākṛtayo magnā manastvatigataṃ matim ।
matistvatigatā jñānaṃ jñānaṃ tvabhigataṃ param ॥19॥
slp1: manasyAkftayo magnA manastvatigataM matim । matistvatigatA jYAnaM jYAnaM tvaBigataM param ॥19॥

text: indriyairmanasaḥ siddhirna buddhiṃ budhyate manaḥ । na buddhirbudhyate'vyaktaṃ sūkṣmastvetāni paśyati] ॥20॥
html:
indriyairmanasaḥ siddhirna buddhiṃ budhyate manaḥ ।
na buddhirbudhyate'vyaktaṃ sūkṣmastvetāni paśyati] ॥20॥
slp1: indriyErmanasaH sidDirna budDiM buDyate manaH । na budDirbuDyate'vyaktaM sUkzmastvetAni paSyati] ॥20॥

text: jñānaṃ jñeyābhinirvṛttaṃ viddhi jñānaguṇaṃ manaḥ । prajñākaraṇasaṃyuktaṃ tato buddhiḥ pravartate ॥1॥
html:
jñānaṃ jñeyābhinirvṛttaṃ viddhi jñānaguṇaṃ manaḥ ।
prajñākaraṇasaṃyuktaṃ tato buddhiḥ pravartate ॥1॥
slp1: jYAnaM jYeyABinirvfttaM vidDi jYAnaguRaM manaH । prajYAkaraRasaMyuktaM tato budDiH pravartate ॥1॥
author: manuruvāca ।

text: yadā karmaguṇopetā buddhirmanasi vartate । tadā prajñāyate brahma dhyānayogasamādhinā ॥2॥
html:
yadā karmaguṇopetā buddhirmanasi vartate ।
tadā prajñāyate brahma dhyānayogasamādhinā ॥2॥
slp1: yadA karmaguRopetA budDirmanasi vartate । tadA prajYAyate brahma DyAnayogasamADinA ॥2॥

text: seyaṃ guṇavatī buddhirguṇeṣvevābhivartate । avatārābhiniḥsrotaṃ gireḥ śṛṅgādivodakam ॥3॥
html:
seyaṃ guṇavatī buddhirguṇeṣvevābhivartate ।
avatārābhiniḥsrotaṃ gireḥ śṛṅgādivodakam ॥3॥
slp1: seyaM guRavatI budDirguRezvevABivartate । avatArABiniHsrotaM gireH SfNgAdivodakam ॥3॥

text: yadā nirguṇamāpnoti dhyānaṃ manasi pūrvajam । tadā prajñāyate brahma nikaṣyaṃ nikaṣe yathā ॥4॥
html:
yadā nirguṇamāpnoti dhyānaṃ manasi pūrvajam ।
tadā prajñāyate brahma nikaṣyaṃ nikaṣe yathā ॥4॥
slp1: yadA nirguRamApnoti DyAnaM manasi pUrvajam । tadA prajYAyate brahma nikazyaM nikaze yaTA ॥4॥

text: manastvapahṛtaṃ buddhimindriyārthanidarśanam । na samakṣaṃ guṇāvekṣi nirguṇasya nidarśanam ॥5॥
html:
manastvapahṛtaṃ buddhimindriyārthanidarśanam ।
na samakṣaṃ guṇāvekṣi nirguṇasya nidarśanam ॥5॥
slp1: manastvapahftaM budDimindriyArTanidarSanam । na samakzaM guRAvekzi nirguRasya nidarSanam ॥5॥

text: sarvāṇyetāni saṃvārya dvārāṇi manasi sthitaḥ । manasyekāgratāṃ kṛtvā tatparaṃ pratipadyate ॥6॥
html:
sarvāṇyetāni saṃvārya dvārāṇi manasi sthitaḥ ।
manasyekāgratāṃ kṛtvā tatparaṃ pratipadyate ॥6॥
slp1: sarvARyetAni saMvArya dvArARi manasi sTitaH । manasyekAgratAM kftvA tatparaM pratipadyate ॥6॥

text: yathā mahānti bhūtāni nivartante guṇakṣaye । tathendriyāṇyupādāya buddhirmanasi vartate ॥7॥
html:
yathā mahānti bhūtāni nivartante guṇakṣaye ।
tathendriyāṇyupādāya buddhirmanasi vartate ॥7॥
slp1: yaTA mahAnti BUtAni nivartante guRakzaye । taTendriyARyupAdAya budDirmanasi vartate ॥7॥

text: yadā manasi sā buddhirvartate'ntaracāriṇī । vyavasāyaguṇopetā tadā sampadyate manaḥ ॥8॥
html:
yadā manasi sā buddhirvartate'ntaracāriṇī ।
vyavasāyaguṇopetā tadā sampadyate manaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: yadA manasi sA budDirvartate'ntaracAriRI । vyavasAyaguRopetA tadA sampadyate manaH ॥8॥

text: guṇavadbhirguṇopetaṃ yadā dhyānaguṇaṃ manaḥ । tadā sarvaguṇānhitvā nirguṇaṃ pratipadyate ॥9॥
html:
guṇavadbhirguṇopetaṃ yadā dhyānaguṇaṃ manaḥ ।
tadā sarvaguṇānhitvā nirguṇaṃ pratipadyate ॥9॥
slp1: guRavadBirguRopetaM yadA DyAnaguRaM manaH । tadA sarvaguRAnhitvA nirguRaM pratipadyate ॥9॥

text: avyaktasyeha vijñāne nāsti tulyaṃ nidarśanam । yatra nāsti padanyāsaḥ kastaṃ viṣayamāpnuyāt ॥10॥
html:
avyaktasyeha vijñāne nāsti tulyaṃ nidarśanam ।
yatra nāsti padanyāsaḥ kastaṃ viṣayamāpnuyāt ॥10॥
slp1: avyaktasyeha vijYAne nAsti tulyaM nidarSanam । yatra nAsti padanyAsaH kastaM vizayamApnuyAt ॥10॥

text: tapasā cānumānena guṇairjātyā śrutena ca । ninīṣettatparaṃ brahma viśuddhenāntarātmanā ॥11॥
html:
tapasā cānumānena guṇairjātyā śrutena ca ।
ninīṣettatparaṃ brahma viśuddhenāntarātmanā ॥11॥
slp1: tapasA cAnumAnena guRErjAtyA Srutena ca । ninIzettatparaM brahma viSudDenAntarAtmanA ॥11॥

text: guṇahīno hi taṃ mārgaṃ bahiḥ samanuvartate । guṇābhāvātprakṛtyā ca nistarkyaṃ jñeyasammitam ॥12॥
html:
guṇahīno hi taṃ mārgaṃ bahiḥ samanuvartate ।
guṇābhāvātprakṛtyā ca nistarkyaṃ jñeyasammitam ॥12॥
slp1: guRahIno hi taM mArgaM bahiH samanuvartate । guRABAvAtprakftyA ca nistarkyaM jYeyasammitam ॥12॥

text: nairguṇyādbrahma cāpnoti saguṇatvānnivartate । guṇaprasāriṇī buddhirhutāśana ivendhane ॥13॥
html:
nairguṇyādbrahma cāpnoti saguṇatvānnivartate ।
guṇaprasāriṇī buddhirhutāśana ivendhane ॥13॥
slp1: nErguRyAdbrahma cApnoti saguRatvAnnivartate । guRaprasAriRI budDirhutASana ivenDane ॥13॥

text: yathā pañca vimuktāni indriyāṇi svakarmabhiḥ । tathā tatparamaṃ brahma vimuktaṃ prakṛteḥ param ॥14॥
html:
yathā pañca vimuktāni indriyāṇi svakarmabhiḥ ।
tathā tatparamaṃ brahma vimuktaṃ prakṛteḥ param ॥14॥
slp1: yaTA paYca vimuktAni indriyARi svakarmaBiH । taTA tatparamaM brahma vimuktaM prakfteH param ॥14॥

text: evaṃ prakṛtitaḥ sarve prabhavanti śarīriṇaḥ । nivartante nivṛttau ca sargaṃ naivopayānti ca ॥15॥
html:
evaṃ prakṛtitaḥ sarve prabhavanti śarīriṇaḥ ।
nivartante nivṛttau ca sargaṃ naivopayānti ca ॥15॥
slp1: evaM prakftitaH sarve praBavanti SarIriRaH । nivartante nivfttO ca sargaM nEvopayAnti ca ॥15॥

text: puruṣaḥ prakṛtirbuddhirviśeṣāścendriyāṇi ca । ahaṅkāro'bhimānaśca sambhūto bhūtasañjñakaḥ ॥16॥
html:
puruṣaḥ prakṛtirbuddhirviśeṣāścendriyāṇi ca ।
ahaṅkāro'bhimānaśca sambhūto bhūtasañjñakaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: puruzaH prakftirbudDirviSezAScendriyARi ca । ahaNkAro'BimAnaSca samBUto BUtasaYjYakaH ॥16॥

text: ekasyādyā pravṛttistu pradhānātsampravartate । dvitīyā mithunavyaktimaviśeṣānniyacchati ॥17॥
html:
ekasyādyā pravṛttistu pradhānātsampravartate ।
dvitīyā mithunavyaktimaviśeṣānniyacchati ॥17॥
slp1: ekasyAdyA pravfttistu praDAnAtsampravartate । dvitIyA miTunavyaktimaviSezAnniyacCati ॥17॥

text: dharmādutkṛṣyate śreyastathāśreyo'pyadharmataḥ । rāgavānprakṛtiṃ hyeti virakto jñānavānbhavet] ॥18॥
html:
dharmādutkṛṣyate śreyastathāśreyo'pyadharmataḥ ।
rāgavānprakṛtiṃ hyeti virakto jñānavānbhavet] ॥18॥
slp1: DarmAdutkfzyate SreyastaTASreyo'pyaDarmataH । rAgavAnprakftiM hyeti virakto jYAnavAnBavet] ॥18॥

text: yadā te pañcabhiḥ pañca vimuktā manasā saha । atha taddrakṣyase brahma maṇau sūtramivārpitam ॥1॥
html:
yadā te pañcabhiḥ pañca vimuktā manasā saha ।
atha taddrakṣyase brahma maṇau sūtramivārpitam ॥1॥
slp1: yadA te paYcaBiH paYca vimuktA manasA saha । aTa taddrakzyase brahma maRO sUtramivArpitam ॥1॥
author: manuruvāca ।

text: tadeva ca yathā sūtraṃ suvarṇe vartate punaḥ । muktāsvatha pravāleṣu mṛnmaye rājate tathā ॥2॥
html:
tadeva ca yathā sūtraṃ suvarṇe vartate punaḥ ।
muktāsvatha pravāleṣu mṛnmaye rājate tathā ॥2॥
slp1: tadeva ca yaTA sUtraM suvarRe vartate punaH । muktAsvaTa pravAlezu mfnmaye rAjate taTA ॥2॥

text: tadvadgoṣu manuṣyeṣu tadvaddhastimṛgādiṣu । tadvatkīṭapataṅgeṣu prasaktātmā svakarmabhiḥ ॥3॥
html:
tadvadgoṣu manuṣyeṣu tadvaddhastimṛgādiṣu ।
tadvatkīṭapataṅgeṣu prasaktātmā svakarmabhiḥ ॥3॥
slp1: tadvadgozu manuzyezu tadvadDastimfgAdizu । tadvatkIwapataNgezu prasaktAtmA svakarmaBiH ॥3॥

text: yena yena śarīreṇa yadyatkarma karotyayam । tena tena śarīreṇa tattatphalamupāśnute ॥4॥
html:
yena yena śarīreṇa yadyatkarma karotyayam ।
tena tena śarīreṇa tattatphalamupāśnute ॥4॥
slp1: yena yena SarIreRa yadyatkarma karotyayam । tena tena SarIreRa tattatPalamupASnute ॥4॥

text: yathā hyekarasā bhūmiroṣadhyātmānusāriṇī । tathā karmānugā buddhirantarātmānudarśinī ॥5॥
html:
yathā hyekarasā bhūmiroṣadhyātmānusāriṇī ।
tathā karmānugā buddhirantarātmānudarśinī ॥5॥
slp1: yaTA hyekarasA BUmirozaDyAtmAnusAriRI । taTA karmAnugA budDirantarAtmAnudarSinI ॥5॥

text: jñānapūrvodbhavā lipsā lipsāpūrvābhisandhitā । abhisandhipūrvakaṃ karma karmamūlaṃ tataḥ phalam ॥6॥
html:
jñānapūrvodbhavā lipsā lipsāpūrvābhisandhitā ।
abhisandhipūrvakaṃ karma karmamūlaṃ tataḥ phalam ॥6॥
slp1: jYAnapUrvodBavA lipsA lipsApUrvABisanDitA । aBisanDipUrvakaM karma karmamUlaM tataH Palam ॥6॥

text: phalaṃ karmātmakaṃ vidyātkarma jñeyātmakaṃ tathā । jñeyaṃ jñānātmakaṃ vidyājjñānaṃ sadasadātmakam ॥7॥
html:
phalaṃ karmātmakaṃ vidyātkarma jñeyātmakaṃ tathā ।
jñeyaṃ jñānātmakaṃ vidyājjñānaṃ sadasadātmakam ॥7॥
slp1: PalaM karmAtmakaM vidyAtkarma jYeyAtmakaM taTA । jYeyaM jYAnAtmakaM vidyAjjYAnaM sadasadAtmakam ॥7॥

text: jñānānāṃ ca phalānāṃ ca jñeyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ tathā । kṣayānte tatphalaṃ divyaṃ jñānaṃ jñeyapratiṣṭhitam ॥8॥
html:
jñānānāṃ ca phalānāṃ ca jñeyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ tathā ।
kṣayānte tatphalaṃ divyaṃ jñānaṃ jñeyapratiṣṭhitam ॥8॥
slp1: jYAnAnAM ca PalAnAM ca jYeyAnAM karmaRAM taTA । kzayAnte tatPalaM divyaM jYAnaM jYeyapratizWitam ॥8॥

text: mahaddhi paramaṃ bhūtaṃ yuktāḥ paśyanti yoginaḥ । abudhāstaṃ na paśyanti hyātmasthā guṇabuddhayaḥ ॥9॥
html:
mahaddhi paramaṃ bhūtaṃ yuktāḥ paśyanti yoginaḥ ।
abudhāstaṃ na paśyanti hyātmasthā guṇabuddhayaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: mahadDi paramaM BUtaM yuktAH paSyanti yoginaH । abuDAstaM na paSyanti hyAtmasTA guRabudDayaH ॥9॥

text: pṛthivīrūpato rūpamapāmiha mahattaram । adbhyo mahattaraṃ tejastejasaḥ pavano mahān ॥10॥
html:
pṛthivīrūpato rūpamapāmiha mahattaram ।
adbhyo mahattaraṃ tejastejasaḥ pavano mahān ॥10॥
slp1: pfTivIrUpato rUpamapAmiha mahattaram । adByo mahattaraM tejastejasaH pavano mahAn ॥10॥

text: pavanācca mahadvyoma tasmātparataraṃ manaḥ । manaso mahatī buddhirbuddheḥ kālo mahānsmṛtaḥ ॥11॥
html:
pavanācca mahadvyoma tasmātparataraṃ manaḥ ।
manaso mahatī buddhirbuddheḥ kālo mahānsmṛtaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: pavanAcca mahadvyoma tasmAtparataraM manaH । manaso mahatI budDirbudDeH kAlo mahAnsmftaH ॥11॥

text: kālātsa bhagavānviṣṇuryasya sarvamidaṃ jagat । nādirna madhyaṃ naivāntastasya devasya vidyate ॥12॥
html:
kālātsa bhagavānviṣṇuryasya sarvamidaṃ jagat ।
nādirna madhyaṃ naivāntastasya devasya vidyate ॥12॥
slp1: kAlAtsa BagavAnvizRuryasya sarvamidaM jagat । nAdirna maDyaM nEvAntastasya devasya vidyate ॥12॥

text: anāditvādamadhyatvādanantatvācca so'vyayaḥ । atyeti sarvaduḥkhāni duḥkhaṃ hyantavaducyate ॥13॥
html:
anāditvādamadhyatvādanantatvācca so'vyayaḥ ।
atyeti sarvaduḥkhāni duḥkhaṃ hyantavaducyate ॥13॥
slp1: anAditvAdamaDyatvAdanantatvAcca so'vyayaH । atyeti sarvaduHKAni duHKaM hyantavaducyate ॥13॥

text: tadbrahma paramaṃ proktaṃ taddhāma paramaṃ smṛtam । tadgatvā kālaviṣayādvimuktā mokṣamāśritāḥ ॥14॥
html:
tadbrahma paramaṃ proktaṃ taddhāma paramaṃ smṛtam ।
tadgatvā kālaviṣayādvimuktā mokṣamāśritāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: tadbrahma paramaM proktaM tadDAma paramaM smftam । tadgatvA kAlavizayAdvimuktA mokzamASritAH ॥14॥

text: guṇaistvetaiḥ prakāśante nirguṇatvāttataḥ param । nivṛttilakṣaṇo dharmastathānantyāya kalpate ॥15॥
html:
guṇaistvetaiḥ prakāśante nirguṇatvāttataḥ param ।
nivṛttilakṣaṇo dharmastathānantyāya kalpate ॥15॥
slp1: guREstvetEH prakASante nirguRatvAttataH param । nivfttilakzaRo DarmastaTAnantyAya kalpate ॥15॥

text: ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni śarīrāṇi vyapāśritāḥ । jihvāgreṣu pravartante yatnasādhyā vināśinaḥ ॥16॥
html:
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni śarīrāṇi vyapāśritāḥ ।
jihvāgreṣu pravartante yatnasādhyā vināśinaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: fco yajUMzi sAmAni SarIrARi vyapASritAH । jihvAgrezu pravartante yatnasADyA vinASinaH ॥16॥

text: na caivamiṣyate brahma śarīrāśrayasambhavam । na yatnasādhyaṃ tadbrahma nādimadhyaṃ na cāntavat ॥17॥
html:
na caivamiṣyate brahma śarīrāśrayasambhavam ।
na yatnasādhyaṃ tadbrahma nādimadhyaṃ na cāntavat ॥17॥
slp1: na cEvamizyate brahma SarIrASrayasamBavam । na yatnasADyaM tadbrahma nAdimaDyaM na cAntavat ॥17॥

text: ṛcāmādistathā sāmnāṃ yajuṣāmādirucyate । antaścādimatāṃ dṛṣṭo na cādirbrahmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥18॥
html:
ṛcāmādistathā sāmnāṃ yajuṣāmādirucyate ।
antaścādimatāṃ dṛṣṭo na cādirbrahmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: fcAmAdistaTA sAmnAM yajuzAmAdirucyate । antaScAdimatAM dfzwo na cAdirbrahmaRaH smftaH ॥18॥

text: anāditvādanantatvāttadanantamathāvyayam । avyayatvācca nirdvandvaṃ dvandvābhāvāttataḥ param ॥19॥
html:
anāditvādanantatvāttadanantamathāvyayam ।
avyayatvācca nirdvandvaṃ dvandvābhāvāttataḥ param ॥19॥
slp1: anAditvAdanantatvAttadanantamaTAvyayam । avyayatvAcca nirdvandvaM dvandvABAvAttataH param ॥19॥

text: adṛṣṭato'nupāyāccāpyabhisandheśca karmaṇaḥ । na tena martyāḥ paśyanti yena gacchanti tatparam ॥20॥
html:
adṛṣṭato'nupāyāccāpyabhisandheśca karmaṇaḥ ।
na tena martyāḥ paśyanti yena gacchanti tatparam ॥20॥
slp1: adfzwato'nupAyAccApyaBisanDeSca karmaRaH । na tena martyAH paSyanti yena gacCanti tatparam ॥20॥

text: viṣayeṣu ca saṃsargācchāśvatasya ca darśanāt । manasā cānyadākāṅkṣanparaṃ na pratipadyate ॥21॥
html:
viṣayeṣu ca saṃsargācchāśvatasya ca darśanāt ।
manasā cānyadākāṅkṣanparaṃ na pratipadyate ॥21॥
slp1: vizayezu ca saMsargAcCASvatasya ca darSanAt । manasA cAnyadAkANkzanparaM na pratipadyate ॥21॥

text: guṇānyadiha paśyanti tadicchantyapare janāḥ । paraṃ naivābhikāṅkṣanti nirguṇatvādguṇārthinaḥ ॥22॥
html:
guṇānyadiha paśyanti tadicchantyapare janāḥ ।
paraṃ naivābhikāṅkṣanti nirguṇatvādguṇārthinaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: guRAnyadiha paSyanti tadicCantyapare janAH । paraM nEvABikANkzanti nirguRatvAdguRArTinaH ॥22॥

text: guṇairyastvavarairyuktaḥ kathaṃ vidyādguṇānimān । anumānāddhi gantavyaṃ guṇairavayavaiḥ saha ॥23॥
html:
guṇairyastvavarairyuktaḥ kathaṃ vidyādguṇānimān ।
anumānāddhi gantavyaṃ guṇairavayavaiḥ saha ॥23॥
slp1: guREryastvavarEryuktaH kaTaM vidyAdguRAnimAn । anumAnAdDi gantavyaM guREravayavEH saha ॥23॥

text: sūkṣmeṇa manasā vidmo vācā vaktuṃ na śaknumaḥ । mano hi manasā grāhyaṃ darśanena ca darśanam ॥24॥
html:
sūkṣmeṇa manasā vidmo vācā vaktuṃ na śaknumaḥ ।
mano hi manasā grāhyaṃ darśanena ca darśanam ॥24॥
slp1: sUkzmeRa manasA vidmo vAcA vaktuM na SaknumaH । mano hi manasA grAhyaM darSanena ca darSanam ॥24॥

text: jñānena nirmalīkṛtya buddhiṃ buddhyā tathā manaḥ । manasā cendriyagrāmamanantaṃ pratipadyate ॥25॥
html:
jñānena nirmalīkṛtya buddhiṃ buddhyā tathā manaḥ ।
manasā cendriyagrāmamanantaṃ pratipadyate ॥25॥
slp1: jYAnena nirmalIkftya budDiM budDyA taTA manaH । manasA cendriyagrAmamanantaM pratipadyate ॥25॥

text: buddhiprahīṇo manasāsamṛddhastathā nirāśīrguṇatāmupaiti । paraṃ tyajantīha vilobhyamānā hutāśanaṃ vāyurivendhanastham ॥26॥
html:
buddhiprahīṇo manasāsamṛddhastathā nirāśīrguṇatāmupaiti ।
paraṃ tyajantīha vilobhyamānā hutāśanaṃ vāyurivendhanastham ॥26॥
slp1: budDiprahIRo manasAsamfdDastaTA nirASIrguRatAmupEti । paraM tyajantIha viloByamAnA hutASanaM vAyurivenDanasTam ॥26॥

text: guṇādāne viprayoge ca teṣāṃ manaḥ sadā buddhiparāvarābhyām । anenaiva vidhinā saṃpravṛtto guṇādāne brahmaśarīrameti ॥27॥
html:
guṇādāne viprayoge ca teṣāṃ manaḥ sadā buddhiparāvarābhyām ।
anenaiva vidhinā saṃpravṛtto guṇādāne brahmaśarīrameti ॥27॥
slp1: guRAdAne viprayoge ca tezAM manaH sadA budDiparAvarAByAm । anenEva viDinA saMpravftto guRAdAne brahmaSarIrameti ॥27॥

text: avyaktātmā puruṣo'vyaktakarmā so'vyaktatvaṃ gacchati hyantakāle । tairevāyaṃ cendriyairvardhamānairglāyadbhirvā vartate karmarūpaḥ ॥28॥
html:
avyaktātmā puruṣo'vyaktakarmā so'vyaktatvaṃ gacchati hyantakāle ।
tairevāyaṃ cendriyairvardhamānairglāyadbhirvā vartate karmarūpaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: avyaktAtmA puruzo'vyaktakarmA so'vyaktatvaM gacCati hyantakAle । tErevAyaM cendriyErvarDamAnErglAyadBirvA vartate karmarUpaH ॥28॥

text: sarvairayaṃ cendriyaiḥ saṃprayukto dehaḥ prāptaḥ pañcabhūtāśrayaḥ syāt । nāsāmarthyādgacchati karmaṇeha hīnastena parameṇāvyayena ॥29॥
html:
sarvairayaṃ cendriyaiḥ saṃprayukto dehaḥ prāptaḥ pañcabhūtāśrayaḥ syāt ।
nāsāmarthyādgacchati karmaṇeha hīnastena parameṇāvyayena ॥29॥
slp1: sarvErayaM cendriyEH saMprayukto dehaH prAptaH paYcaBUtASrayaH syAt । nAsAmarTyAdgacCati karmaReha hInastena parameRAvyayena ॥29॥

text: pṛthvyā naraḥ paśyati nāntamasyā hyantaścāsyā bhavitā ceti viddhi । paraṃ nayantīha vilobhyamānaṃ yathā plavaṃ vāyurivārṇavastham ॥30॥
html:
pṛthvyā naraḥ paśyati nāntamasyā hyantaścāsyā bhavitā ceti viddhi ।
paraṃ nayantīha vilobhyamānaṃ yathā plavaṃ vāyurivārṇavastham ॥30॥
slp1: pfTvyA naraH paSyati nAntamasyA hyantaScAsyA BavitA ceti vidDi । paraM nayantIha viloByamAnaM yaTA plavaM vAyurivArRavasTam ॥30॥

text: divākaro guṇamupalabhya nirguṇo yathā bhavedvyapagataraśmimaṇḍalaḥ । tathā hyasau muniriha nirviśeṣavānsa nirguṇaṃ praviśati brahma cāvyayam ॥31॥
html:
divākaro guṇamupalabhya nirguṇo yathā bhavedvyapagataraśmimaṇḍalaḥ ।
tathā hyasau muniriha nirviśeṣavānsa nirguṇaṃ praviśati brahma cāvyayam ॥31॥
slp1: divAkaro guRamupalaBya nirguRo yaTA BavedvyapagataraSmimaRqalaH । taTA hyasO muniriha nirviSezavAnsa nirguRaM praviSati brahma cAvyayam ॥31॥

text: anāgatiṃ sukṛtimatāṃ parāṃ gatiṃ svayaṃbhuvaṃ prabhavanidhānamavyayam । sanātanaṃ yadamṛtamavyayaṃ padaṃ vicārya taṃ śamamamṛtatvamaśnute] ॥32॥
html:
anāgatiṃ sukṛtimatāṃ parāṃ gatiṃ svayaṃbhuvaṃ prabhavanidhānamavyayam ।
sanātanaṃ yadamṛtamavyayaṃ padaṃ vicārya taṃ śamamamṛtatvamaśnute] ॥32॥
slp1: anAgatiM sukftimatAM parAM gatiM svayaMBuvaM praBavaniDAnamavyayam । sanAtanaM yadamftamavyayaM padaM vicArya taM SamamamftatvamaSnute] ॥32॥

text: pitāmaha mahāprājña puṇḍarīkākṣamacyutam । kartāramakṛtaṃ viṣṇuṃ bhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayam ॥1॥
html:
pitāmaha mahāprājña puṇḍarīkākṣamacyutam ।
kartāramakṛtaṃ viṣṇuṃ bhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayam ॥1॥
slp1: pitAmaha mahAprAjYa puRqarIkAkzamacyutam । kartAramakftaM vizRuM BUtAnAM praBavApyayam ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: nārāyaṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ govindamaparājitam । tattvena bharataśreṣṭha śrotumicchāmi keśavam ॥2॥
html:
nārāyaṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ govindamaparājitam ।
tattvena bharataśreṣṭha śrotumicchāmi keśavam ॥2॥
slp1: nArAyaRaM hfzIkeSaM govindamaparAjitam । tattvena BarataSrezWa SrotumicCAmi keSavam ॥2॥

text: śruto'yamartho rāmasya jāmadagnyasya jalpataḥ । nāradasya ca devarṣeḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanasya ca ॥3॥
html:
śruto'yamartho rāmasya jāmadagnyasya jalpataḥ ।
nāradasya ca devarṣeḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanasya ca ॥3॥
slp1: Sruto'yamarTo rAmasya jAmadagnyasya jalpataH । nAradasya ca devarzeH kfzRadvEpAyanasya ca ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: asito devalastāta vālmīkiśca mahātapāḥ । mārkaṇḍeyaśca govinde kathayatyadbhutaṃ mahat ॥4॥
html:
asito devalastāta vālmīkiśca mahātapāḥ ।
mārkaṇḍeyaśca govinde kathayatyadbhutaṃ mahat ॥4॥
slp1: asito devalastAta vAlmIkiSca mahAtapAH । mArkaRqeyaSca govinde kaTayatyadButaM mahat ॥4॥

text: keśavo bharataśreṣṭha bhagavānīśvaraḥ prabhuḥ । puruṣaḥ sarvamityeva śrūyate bahudhā vibhuḥ ॥5॥
html:
keśavo bharataśreṣṭha bhagavānīśvaraḥ prabhuḥ ।
puruṣaḥ sarvamityeva śrūyate bahudhā vibhuḥ ॥5॥
slp1: keSavo BarataSrezWa BagavAnISvaraH praBuH । puruzaH sarvamityeva SrUyate bahuDA viBuH ॥5॥

text: kiṃ tu yāni vidurloke brāhmaṇāḥ śārṅgadhanvanaḥ । māhātmyāni mahābāho śṛṇu tāni yudhiṣṭhira ॥6॥
html:
kiṃ tu yāni vidurloke brāhmaṇāḥ śārṅgadhanvanaḥ ।
māhātmyāni mahābāho śṛṇu tāni yudhiṣṭhira ॥6॥
slp1: kiM tu yAni vidurloke brAhmaRAH SArNgaDanvanaH । mAhAtmyAni mahAbAho SfRu tAni yuDizWira ॥6॥

text: yāni cāhurmanuṣyendra ye purāṇavido janāḥ । aśeṣeṇa hi govinde kīrtayiṣyāmi tānyaham ॥7॥
html:
yāni cāhurmanuṣyendra ye purāṇavido janāḥ ।
aśeṣeṇa hi govinde kīrtayiṣyāmi tānyaham ॥7॥
slp1: yAni cAhurmanuzyendra ye purARavido janAH । aSezeRa hi govinde kIrtayizyAmi tAnyaham ॥7॥

text: mahābhūtāni bhūtātmā mahātmā puruṣottamaḥ । vāyurjyotistathā cāpaḥ khaṃ gāṃ caivānvakalpayat ॥8॥
html:
mahābhūtāni bhūtātmā mahātmā puruṣottamaḥ ।
vāyurjyotistathā cāpaḥ khaṃ gāṃ caivānvakalpayat ॥8॥
slp1: mahABUtAni BUtAtmA mahAtmA puruzottamaH । vAyurjyotistaTA cApaH KaM gAM cEvAnvakalpayat ॥8॥

text: sa dṛṣṭvā pṛthivīṃ caiva sarvabhūteśvaraḥ prabhuḥ । apsveva śayanaṃ cakre mahātmā puruṣottamaḥ ॥9॥
html:
sa dṛṣṭvā pṛthivīṃ caiva sarvabhūteśvaraḥ prabhuḥ ।
apsveva śayanaṃ cakre mahātmā puruṣottamaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: sa dfzwvA pfTivIM cEva sarvaBUteSvaraH praBuH । apsveva SayanaM cakre mahAtmA puruzottamaH ॥9॥

text: sarvatejomayastasmiñśayānaḥ śayane śubhe । so'grajaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ saṅkarṣaṇamacintayat ॥10॥
html:
sarvatejomayastasmiñśayānaḥ śayane śubhe ।
so'grajaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ saṅkarṣaṇamacintayat ॥10॥
slp1: sarvatejomayastasmiYSayAnaH Sayane SuBe । so'grajaM sarvaBUtAnAM saNkarzaRamacintayat ॥10॥

text: āśrayaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ manaseti viśuśruma । sa dhārayati bhūtātmā ubhe bhūtabhaviṣyatī ॥11॥
html:
āśrayaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ manaseti viśuśruma ।
sa dhārayati bhūtātmā ubhe bhūtabhaviṣyatī ॥11॥
slp1: ASrayaM sarvaBUtAnAM manaseti viSuSruma । sa DArayati BUtAtmA uBe BUtaBavizyatI ॥11॥

text: tatastasminmahābāho prādurbhūte mahātmani । bhāskarapratimaṃ divyaṃ nābhyāṃ padmamajāyata ॥12॥
html:
tatastasminmahābāho prādurbhūte mahātmani ।
bhāskarapratimaṃ divyaṃ nābhyāṃ padmamajāyata ॥12॥
slp1: tatastasminmahAbAho prAdurBUte mahAtmani । BAskarapratimaM divyaM nAByAM padmamajAyata ॥12॥

text: sa tatra bhagavāndevaḥ puṣkare bhāsayandiśaḥ । brahmā samabhavattāta sarvabhūtapitāmahaḥ ॥13॥
html:
sa tatra bhagavāndevaḥ puṣkare bhāsayandiśaḥ ।
brahmā samabhavattāta sarvabhūtapitāmahaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: sa tatra BagavAndevaH puzkare BAsayandiSaH । brahmA samaBavattAta sarvaBUtapitAmahaH ॥13॥

text: tasminnapi mahābāho prādurbhūte mahātmani । tamasaḥ pūrvajo jajñe madhurnāma mahāsuraḥ ॥14॥
html:
tasminnapi mahābāho prādurbhūte mahātmani ।
tamasaḥ pūrvajo jajñe madhurnāma mahāsuraḥ ॥14॥
slp1: tasminnapi mahAbAho prAdurBUte mahAtmani । tamasaH pUrvajo jajYe maDurnAma mahAsuraH ॥14॥

text: tamugramugrakarmāṇamugrāṃ buddhiṃ samāsthitam । brahmaṇopacitiṃ kurvañjaghāna puruṣottamaḥ ॥15॥
html:
tamugramugrakarmāṇamugrāṃ buddhiṃ samāsthitam ।
brahmaṇopacitiṃ kurvañjaghāna puruṣottamaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: tamugramugrakarmARamugrAM budDiM samAsTitam । brahmaRopacitiM kurvaYjaGAna puruzottamaH ॥15॥

text: tasya tāta vadhātsarve devadānavamānavāḥ । madhusūdanamityāhurvṛṣabhaṃ sarvasātvatām ॥16॥
html:
tasya tāta vadhātsarve devadānavamānavāḥ ।
madhusūdanamityāhurvṛṣabhaṃ sarvasātvatām ॥16॥
slp1: tasya tAta vaDAtsarve devadAnavamAnavAH । maDusUdanamityAhurvfzaBaM sarvasAtvatAm ॥16॥

text: brahmā tu sasṛje putrānmānasāndakṣasaptamān । marīcimatryaṅgirasau pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum ॥17॥
html:
brahmā tu sasṛje putrānmānasāndakṣasaptamān ।
marīcimatryaṅgirasau pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum ॥17॥
slp1: brahmA tu sasfje putrAnmAnasAndakzasaptamAn । marIcimatryaNgirasO pulastyaM pulahaM kratum ॥17॥

text: marīciḥ kaśyapaṃ tāta putraṃ cāsṛjadagrajam । mānasaṃ janayāmāsa taijasaṃ brahmasattamam ॥18॥
html:
marīciḥ kaśyapaṃ tāta putraṃ cāsṛjadagrajam ।
mānasaṃ janayāmāsa taijasaṃ brahmasattamam ॥18॥
slp1: marIciH kaSyapaM tAta putraM cAsfjadagrajam । mAnasaM janayAmAsa tEjasaM brahmasattamam ॥18॥

text: aṅguṣṭhādasṛjadbrahmā marīcerapi pūrvajam । so'bhavadbharataśreṣṭha dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ ॥19॥
html:
aṅguṣṭhādasṛjadbrahmā marīcerapi pūrvajam ।
so'bhavadbharataśreṣṭha dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ ॥19॥
slp1: aNguzWAdasfjadbrahmA marIcerapi pUrvajam । so'BavadBarataSrezWa dakzo nAma prajApatiH ॥19॥

text: tasya pūrvamajāyanta daśa tisraśca bhārata । prajāpaterduhitarastāsāṃ jyeṣṭhābhavadditiḥ ॥20॥
html:
tasya pūrvamajāyanta daśa tisraśca bhārata ।
prajāpaterduhitarastāsāṃ jyeṣṭhābhavadditiḥ ॥20॥
slp1: tasya pUrvamajAyanta daSa tisraSca BArata । prajApaterduhitarastAsAM jyezWABavadditiH ॥20॥

text: sarvadharmaviśeṣajñaḥ puṇyakīrtirmahāyaśāḥ । mārīcaḥ kaśyapastāta sarvāsāmabhavatpatiḥ ॥21॥
html:
sarvadharmaviśeṣajñaḥ puṇyakīrtirmahāyaśāḥ ।
mārīcaḥ kaśyapastāta sarvāsāmabhavatpatiḥ ॥21॥
slp1: sarvaDarmaviSezajYaH puRyakIrtirmahAyaSAH । mArIcaH kaSyapastAta sarvAsAmaBavatpatiH ॥21॥

text: utpādya tu mahābhāgastāsāmavarajā daśa । dadau dharmāya dharmajño dakṣa eva prajāpatiḥ ॥22॥
html:
utpādya tu mahābhāgastāsāmavarajā daśa ।
dadau dharmāya dharmajño dakṣa eva prajāpatiḥ ॥22॥
slp1: utpAdya tu mahABAgastAsAmavarajA daSa । dadO DarmAya DarmajYo dakza eva prajApatiH ॥22॥

text: dharmasya vasavaḥ putrā rudrāścāmitatejasaḥ । viśvedevāśca sādhyāśca marutvantaśca bhārata ॥23॥
html:
dharmasya vasavaḥ putrā rudrāścāmitatejasaḥ ।
viśvedevāśca sādhyāśca marutvantaśca bhārata ॥23॥
slp1: Darmasya vasavaH putrA rudrAScAmitatejasaH । viSvedevASca sADyASca marutvantaSca BArata ॥23॥

text: aparāstu yavīyasyastābhyo'nyāḥ saptaviṃśatiḥ । somastāsāṃ mahābhāgaḥ sarvāsāmabhavatpatiḥ ॥24॥
html:
aparāstu yavīyasyastābhyo'nyāḥ saptaviṃśatiḥ ।
somastāsāṃ mahābhāgaḥ sarvāsāmabhavatpatiḥ ॥24॥
slp1: aparAstu yavIyasyastAByo'nyAH saptaviMSatiH । somastAsAM mahABAgaH sarvAsAmaBavatpatiH ॥24॥

text: itarāstu vyajāyanta gandharvāṃsturagāndvijān । gāśca kiṃpuruṣānmatsyānaudbhidāṃśca vanaspatīn ॥25॥
html:
itarāstu vyajāyanta gandharvāṃsturagāndvijān ।
gāśca kiṃpuruṣānmatsyānaudbhidāṃśca vanaspatīn ॥25॥
slp1: itarAstu vyajAyanta ganDarvAMsturagAndvijAn । gASca kiMpuruzAnmatsyAnOdBidAMSca vanaspatIn ॥25॥

text: ādityānaditirjajñe devaśreṣṭhānmahābalān । teṣāṃ viṣṇurvāmano'bhūdgovindaścābhavatprabhuḥ ॥26॥
html:
ādityānaditirjajñe devaśreṣṭhānmahābalān ।
teṣāṃ viṣṇurvāmano'bhūdgovindaścābhavatprabhuḥ ॥26॥
slp1: AdityAnaditirjajYe devaSrezWAnmahAbalAn । tezAM vizRurvAmano'BUdgovindaScABavatpraBuH ॥26॥

text: tasya vikramaṇādeva devānāṃ śrīrvyavardhata । dānavāśca parābhūtā daiteyī cāsurī prajā ॥27॥
html:
tasya vikramaṇādeva devānāṃ śrīrvyavardhata ।
dānavāśca parābhūtā daiteyī cāsurī prajā ॥27॥
slp1: tasya vikramaRAdeva devAnAM SrIrvyavarData । dAnavASca parABUtA dEteyI cAsurI prajA ॥27॥

text: vipracittipradhānāṃśca dānavānasṛjaddanuḥ । ditistu sarvānasurānmahāsattvānvyajāyata ॥28॥
html:
vipracittipradhānāṃśca dānavānasṛjaddanuḥ ।
ditistu sarvānasurānmahāsattvānvyajāyata ॥28॥
slp1: vipracittipraDAnAMSca dAnavAnasfjaddanuH । ditistu sarvAnasurAnmahAsattvAnvyajAyata ॥28॥

text: ahorātraṃ ca kālaṃ ca yathartu madhusūdanaḥ । pūrvāhṇaṃ cāparāhṇaṃ ca sarvamevānvakalpayat ॥29॥
html:
ahorātraṃ ca kālaṃ ca yathartu madhusūdanaḥ ।
pūrvāhṇaṃ cāparāhṇaṃ ca sarvamevānvakalpayat ॥29॥
slp1: ahorAtraM ca kAlaM ca yaTartu maDusUdanaH । pUrvAhRaM cAparAhRaM ca sarvamevAnvakalpayat ॥29॥

text: buddhyāpaḥ so'sṛjanmeghāṃstathā sthāvarajaṅgamān । pṛthivīṃ so'sṛjadviśvāṃ sahitāṃ bhūritejasā ॥30॥
html:
buddhyāpaḥ so'sṛjanmeghāṃstathā sthāvarajaṅgamān ।
pṛthivīṃ so'sṛjadviśvāṃ sahitāṃ bhūritejasā ॥30॥
slp1: budDyApaH so'sfjanmeGAMstaTA sTAvarajaNgamAn । pfTivIM so'sfjadviSvAM sahitAM BUritejasA ॥30॥

text: tataḥ kṛṣṇo mahābāhuḥ punareva yudhiṣṭhira । brāhmaṇānāṃ śataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mukhādasṛjata prabhuḥ ॥31॥
html:
tataḥ kṛṣṇo mahābāhuḥ punareva yudhiṣṭhira ।
brāhmaṇānāṃ śataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mukhādasṛjata prabhuḥ ॥31॥
slp1: tataH kfzRo mahAbAhuH punareva yuDizWira । brAhmaRAnAM SataM SrezWaM muKAdasfjata praBuH ॥31॥

text: bāhubhyāṃ kṣatriyaśataṃ vaiśyānāmūrutaḥ śatam । padbhyāṃ śūdraśataṃ caiva keśavo bharatarṣabha ॥32॥
html:
bāhubhyāṃ kṣatriyaśataṃ vaiśyānāmūrutaḥ śatam ।
padbhyāṃ śūdraśataṃ caiva keśavo bharatarṣabha ॥32॥
slp1: bAhuByAM kzatriyaSataM vESyAnAmUrutaH Satam । padByAM SUdraSataM cEva keSavo BaratarzaBa ॥32॥

text: sa evaṃ caturo varṇānsamutpādya mahāyaśāḥ । adhyakṣaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dhātāramakarotprabhuḥ ॥33॥
html:
sa evaṃ caturo varṇānsamutpādya mahāyaśāḥ ।
adhyakṣaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dhātāramakarotprabhuḥ ॥33॥
slp1: sa evaM caturo varRAnsamutpAdya mahAyaSAH । aDyakzaM sarvaBUtAnAM DAtAramakarotpraBuH ॥33॥

text: yāvadyāvadabhūcchraddhā dehaṃ dhārayituṃ nṛṇām । tāvattāvadajīvaṃste nāsīdyamakṛtaṃ bhayam ॥34॥
html:
yāvadyāvadabhūcchraddhā dehaṃ dhārayituṃ nṛṇām ।
tāvattāvadajīvaṃste nāsīdyamakṛtaṃ bhayam ॥34॥
slp1: yAvadyAvadaBUcCradDA dehaM DArayituM nfRAm । tAvattAvadajIvaMste nAsIdyamakftaM Bayam ॥34॥

text: na caiṣāṃ maithuno dharmo babhūva bharatarṣabha । saṅkalpādeva caiteṣāmapatyamudapadyata ॥35॥
html:
na caiṣāṃ maithuno dharmo babhūva bharatarṣabha ।
saṅkalpādeva caiteṣāmapatyamudapadyata ॥35॥
slp1: na cEzAM mETuno Darmo baBUva BaratarzaBa । saNkalpAdeva cEtezAmapatyamudapadyata ॥35॥

text: tatra tretāyuge kāle saṅkalpājjāyate prajā । na hyabhūnmaithuno dharmasteṣāmapi janādhipa ॥36॥
html:
tatra tretāyuge kāle saṅkalpājjāyate prajā ।
na hyabhūnmaithuno dharmasteṣāmapi janādhipa ॥36॥
slp1: tatra tretAyuge kAle saNkalpAjjAyate prajA । na hyaBUnmETuno DarmastezAmapi janADipa ॥36॥

text: dvāpare maithuno dharmaḥ prajānāmabhavannṛpa । tathā kaliyuge rājandvandvamāpedire janāḥ ॥37॥
html:
dvāpare maithuno dharmaḥ prajānāmabhavannṛpa ।
tathā kaliyuge rājandvandvamāpedire janāḥ ॥37॥
slp1: dvApare mETuno DarmaH prajAnAmaBavannfpa । taTA kaliyuge rAjandvandvamApedire janAH ॥37॥

text: eṣa bhūtapatistāta svadhyakṣaśca prakīrtitaḥ । niradhyakṣāṃstu kaunteya kīrtayiṣyāmi tānapi ॥38॥
html:
eṣa bhūtapatistāta svadhyakṣaśca prakīrtitaḥ ।
niradhyakṣāṃstu kaunteya kīrtayiṣyāmi tānapi ॥38॥
slp1: eza BUtapatistAta svaDyakzaSca prakIrtitaH । niraDyakzAMstu kOnteya kIrtayizyAmi tAnapi ॥38॥

text: dakṣiṇāpathajanmānaḥ sarve talavarāndhrakāḥ । utsāḥ pulindāḥ śabarāścūcupā maṇḍapaiḥ saha ॥39॥
html:
dakṣiṇāpathajanmānaḥ sarve talavarāndhrakāḥ ।
utsāḥ pulindāḥ śabarāścūcupā maṇḍapaiḥ saha ॥39॥
slp1: dakziRApaTajanmAnaH sarve talavarAnDrakAH । utsAH pulindAH SabarAScUcupA maRqapEH saha ॥39॥

text: uttarāpathajanmānaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi tānapi । yaunakāmbojagāndhārāḥ kirātā barbaraiḥ saha ॥40॥
html:
uttarāpathajanmānaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi tānapi ।
yaunakāmbojagāndhārāḥ kirātā barbaraiḥ saha ॥40॥
slp1: uttarApaTajanmAnaH kIrtayizyAmi tAnapi । yOnakAmbojagAnDArAH kirAtA barbarEH saha ॥40॥

text: ete pāpakṛtastāta caranti pṛthivīmimām । śvakākabalagṛdhrāṇāṃ sadharmāṇo narādhipa ॥41॥
html:
ete pāpakṛtastāta caranti pṛthivīmimām ।
śvakākabalagṛdhrāṇāṃ sadharmāṇo narādhipa ॥41॥
slp1: ete pApakftastAta caranti pfTivImimAm । SvakAkabalagfDrARAM saDarmARo narADipa ॥41॥

text: naite kṛtayuge tāta caranti pṛthivīmimām । tretāprabhṛti vartante te janā bharatarṣabha ॥42॥
html:
naite kṛtayuge tāta caranti pṛthivīmimām ।
tretāprabhṛti vartante te janā bharatarṣabha ॥42॥
slp1: nEte kftayuge tAta caranti pfTivImimAm । tretApraBfti vartante te janA BaratarzaBa ॥42॥

text: tatastasminmahāghore sandhyākāle yugāntike । rājānaḥ samasajjanta samāsādyetaretaram ॥43॥
html:
tatastasminmahāghore sandhyākāle yugāntike ।
rājānaḥ samasajjanta samāsādyetaretaram ॥43॥
slp1: tatastasminmahAGore sanDyAkAle yugAntike । rAjAnaH samasajjanta samAsAdyetaretaram ॥43॥

text: evameṣa kuruśreṣṭha prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ । devadevarṣirācaṣṭa nāradaḥ sarvalokadṛk ॥44॥
html:
evameṣa kuruśreṣṭha prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ ।
devadevarṣirācaṣṭa nāradaḥ sarvalokadṛk ॥44॥
slp1: evameza kuruSrezWa prAdurBAvo mahAtmanaH । devadevarzirAcazwa nAradaH sarvalokadfk ॥44॥

text: nārado'pyatha kṛṣṇasya paraṃ mene narādhipa । śāśvatatvaṃ mahābāho yathāvadbharatarṣabha ॥45॥
html:
nārado'pyatha kṛṣṇasya paraṃ mene narādhipa ।
śāśvatatvaṃ mahābāho yathāvadbharatarṣabha ॥45॥
slp1: nArado'pyaTa kfzRasya paraM mene narADipa । SASvatatvaM mahAbAho yaTAvadBaratarzaBa ॥45॥

text: evameṣa mahābāhuḥ keśavaḥ satyavikramaḥ । acintyaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣo naiṣa kevalamānuṣaḥ] ॥46॥
html:
evameṣa mahābāhuḥ keśavaḥ satyavikramaḥ ।
acintyaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣo naiṣa kevalamānuṣaḥ] ॥46॥
slp1: evameza mahAbAhuH keSavaH satyavikramaH । acintyaH puRqarIkAkzo nEza kevalamAnuzaH] ॥46॥

text: ke pūrvamāsanpatayaḥ prajānāṃ bharatarṣabha । ke carṣayo mahābhāgā dikṣu pratyekaśaḥ smṛtāḥ ॥1॥
html:
ke pūrvamāsanpatayaḥ prajānāṃ bharatarṣabha ।
ke carṣayo mahābhāgā dikṣu pratyekaśaḥ smṛtāḥ ॥1॥
slp1: ke pUrvamAsanpatayaH prajAnAM BaratarzaBa । ke carzayo mahABAgA dikzu pratyekaSaH smftAH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: śrūyatāṃ bharataśreṣṭha yanmā tvaṃ paripṛcchasi । prajānāṃ patayo ye sma dikṣu pratyekaśaḥ smṛtāḥ ॥2॥
html:
śrūyatāṃ bharataśreṣṭha yanmā tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ।
prajānāṃ patayo ye sma dikṣu pratyekaśaḥ smṛtāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: SrUyatAM BarataSrezWa yanmA tvaM paripfcCasi । prajAnAM patayo ye sma dikzu pratyekaSaH smftAH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ekaḥ svayaṃbhūrbhagavānādyo brahmā sanātanaḥ । brahmaṇaḥ sapta putrā vai mahātmānaḥ svayambhuvaḥ ॥3॥
html:
ekaḥ svayaṃbhūrbhagavānādyo brahmā sanātanaḥ ।
brahmaṇaḥ sapta putrā vai mahātmānaḥ svayambhuvaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: ekaH svayaMBUrBagavAnAdyo brahmA sanAtanaH । brahmaRaH sapta putrA vE mahAtmAnaH svayamBuvaH ॥3॥

text: marīciratryaṅgirasau pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ । vasiṣṭhaśca mahābhāgaḥ sadṛśā vai svayaṃbhuvā ॥4॥
html:
marīciratryaṅgirasau pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ ।
vasiṣṭhaśca mahābhāgaḥ sadṛśā vai svayaṃbhuvā ॥4॥
slp1: marIciratryaNgirasO pulastyaH pulahaH kratuH । vasizWaSca mahABAgaH sadfSA vE svayaMBuvA ॥4॥

text: sapta brahmāṇa ityeṣa purāṇe niścayo gataḥ । ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvāneva prajāpatīn ॥5॥
html:
sapta brahmāṇa ityeṣa purāṇe niścayo gataḥ ।
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvāneva prajāpatīn ॥5॥
slp1: sapta brahmARa ityeza purARe niScayo gataH । ata UrDvaM pravakzyAmi sarvAneva prajApatIn ॥5॥

text: atrivaṃśasamutpanno brahmayoniḥ sanātanaḥ । prācīnabarhirbhagavāṃstasmātprācetaso daśa ॥6॥
html:
atrivaṃśasamutpanno brahmayoniḥ sanātanaḥ ।
prācīnabarhirbhagavāṃstasmātprācetaso daśa ॥6॥
slp1: atrivaMSasamutpanno brahmayoniH sanAtanaH । prAcInabarhirBagavAMstasmAtprAcetaso daSa ॥6॥

text: daśānāṃ tanayastveko dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ । tasya dve nāmanī loke dakṣaḥ ka iti cocyate ॥7॥
html:
daśānāṃ tanayastveko dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ ।
tasya dve nāmanī loke dakṣaḥ ka iti cocyate ॥7॥
slp1: daSAnAM tanayastveko dakzo nAma prajApatiH । tasya dve nAmanI loke dakzaH ka iti cocyate ॥7॥

text: marīceḥ kaśyapaḥ putrastasya dve nāmanī śrute । ariṣṭanemirityekaṃ kaśyapetyaparaṃ viduḥ ॥8॥
html:
