marīceḥ kaśyapaḥ putrastasya dve nāmanī śrute ।
ariṣṭanemirityekaṃ kaśyapetyaparaṃ viduḥ ॥8॥
slp1: marIceH kaSyapaH putrastasya dve nAmanI Srute । arizwanemirityekaM kaSyapetyaparaM viduH ॥8॥

text: aṅgaścaivaurasaḥ śrīmānrājā bhaumaśca vīryavān । sahasraṃ yaśca divyānāṃ yugānāṃ paryupāsitā ॥9॥
html:
aṅgaścaivaurasaḥ śrīmānrājā bhaumaśca vīryavān ।
sahasraṃ yaśca divyānāṃ yugānāṃ paryupāsitā ॥9॥
slp1: aNgaScEvOrasaH SrImAnrAjA BOmaSca vIryavAn । sahasraM yaSca divyAnAM yugAnAM paryupAsitA ॥9॥

text: aryamā caiva bhagavānye cānye tanayā vibho । ete pradeśāḥ kathitā bhuvanānāṃ prabhāvanāḥ ॥10॥
html:
aryamā caiva bhagavānye cānye tanayā vibho ।
ete pradeśāḥ kathitā bhuvanānāṃ prabhāvanāḥ ॥10॥
slp1: aryamA cEva BagavAnye cAnye tanayA viBo । ete pradeSAH kaTitA BuvanAnAM praBAvanAH ॥10॥

text: śaśabindośca bhāryāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi daśācyuta । ekaikasyāṃ sahasraṃ tu tanayānāmabhūttadā ॥11॥
html:
śaśabindośca bhāryāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi daśācyuta ।
ekaikasyāṃ sahasraṃ tu tanayānāmabhūttadā ॥11॥
slp1: SaSabindoSca BAryARAM sahasrARi daSAcyuta । ekEkasyAM sahasraM tu tanayAnAmaBUttadA ॥11॥

text: evaṃ śatasahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ । putrāṇāṃ na ca te kañcidicchantyanyaṃ prajāpatim ॥12॥
html:
evaṃ śatasahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ ।
putrāṇāṃ na ca te kañcidicchantyanyaṃ prajāpatim ॥12॥
slp1: evaM SatasahasrARAM SataM tasya mahAtmanaH । putrARAM na ca te kaYcidicCantyanyaM prajApatim ॥12॥

text: prajāmācakṣate viprāḥ paurāṇīṃ śāśabindavīm । sa vṛṣṇivaṃśaprabhavo mahānvaṃśaḥ prajāpateḥ ॥13॥
html:
prajāmācakṣate viprāḥ paurāṇīṃ śāśabindavīm ।
sa vṛṣṇivaṃśaprabhavo mahānvaṃśaḥ prajāpateḥ ॥13॥
slp1: prajAmAcakzate viprAH pOrARIM SASabindavIm । sa vfzRivaMSapraBavo mahAnvaMSaH prajApateH ॥13॥

text: ete prajānāṃ patayaḥ samuddiṣṭā yaśasvinaḥ । ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi devāṃstribhuvaneśvarān ॥14॥
html:
ete prajānāṃ patayaḥ samuddiṣṭā yaśasvinaḥ ।
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi devāṃstribhuvaneśvarān ॥14॥
slp1: ete prajAnAM patayaH samuddizwA yaSasvinaH । ataH paraM pravakzyAmi devAMstriBuvaneSvarAn ॥14॥

text: bhagoṃ'śaścāryamā caiva mitro'tha varuṇastathā । savitā caiva dhātā ca vivasvāṃśca mahābalaḥ ॥15॥
html:
bhagoṃ'śaścāryamā caiva mitro'tha varuṇastathā ।
savitā caiva dhātā ca vivasvāṃśca mahābalaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: BagoM'SaScAryamA cEva mitro'Ta varuRastaTA । savitA cEva DAtA ca vivasvAMSca mahAbalaH ॥15॥

text: pūṣā tvaṣṭā tathaivendro dvādaśo viṣṇurucyate । ta ete dvādaśādityāḥ kaśyapasyātmasambhavāḥ ॥16॥
html:
pūṣā tvaṣṭā tathaivendro dvādaśo viṣṇurucyate ।
ta ete dvādaśādityāḥ kaśyapasyātmasambhavāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: pUzA tvazwA taTEvendro dvAdaSo vizRurucyate । ta ete dvAdaSAdityAH kaSyapasyAtmasamBavAH ॥16॥

text: nāsatyaścaiva dasraśca smṛtau dvāvaśvināvapi । mārtāṇḍasyātmajāvetāvaṣṭamasya prajāpateḥ ॥17॥
html:
nāsatyaścaiva dasraśca smṛtau dvāvaśvināvapi ।
mārtāṇḍasyātmajāvetāvaṣṭamasya prajāpateḥ ॥17॥
slp1: nAsatyaScEva dasraSca smftO dvAvaSvinAvapi । mArtARqasyAtmajAvetAvazwamasya prajApateH ॥17॥

text: tvaṣṭuścaivātmajaḥ śrīmānviśvarūpo mahāyaśāḥ । ajaikapādahirbudhnyo virūpākṣo'tha raivataḥ ॥18॥
html:
tvaṣṭuścaivātmajaḥ śrīmānviśvarūpo mahāyaśāḥ ।
ajaikapādahirbudhnyo virūpākṣo'tha raivataḥ ॥18॥
slp1: tvazwuScEvAtmajaH SrImAnviSvarUpo mahAyaSAH । ajEkapAdahirbuDnyo virUpAkzo'Ta rEvataH ॥18॥

text: haraśca bahurūpaśca tryambakaśca sureśvaraḥ । sāvitraśca jayantaśca pinākī cāparājitaḥ । pūrvameva mahābhāgā vasavo'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ ॥19॥
html:
haraśca bahurūpaśca tryambakaśca sureśvaraḥ ।
sāvitraśca jayantaśca pinākī cāparājitaḥ ।
pūrvameva mahābhāgā vasavo'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ ॥19॥
slp1: haraSca bahurUpaSca tryambakaSca sureSvaraH । sAvitraSca jayantaSca pinAkI cAparAjitaH । pUrvameva mahABAgA vasavo'zwO prakIrtitAH ॥19॥

text: eta evaṃvidhā devā manoreva prajāpateḥ । te ca pūrve surāśceti dvividhāḥ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ ॥20॥
html:
eta evaṃvidhā devā manoreva prajāpateḥ ।
te ca pūrve surāśceti dvividhāḥ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: eta evaMviDA devA manoreva prajApateH । te ca pUrve surASceti dviviDAH pitaraH smftAH ॥20॥

text: śīlarūparatāstvanye tathānye siddhasādhyayoḥ । ṛbhavo marutaścaiva devānāṃ coditā gaṇāḥ ॥21॥
html:
śīlarūparatāstvanye tathānye siddhasādhyayoḥ ।
ṛbhavo marutaścaiva devānāṃ coditā gaṇāḥ ॥21॥
slp1: SIlarUparatAstvanye taTAnye sidDasADyayoH । fBavo marutaScEva devAnAM coditA gaRAH ॥21॥

text: evamete samāmnātā viśvedevāstathāśvinau । ādityāḥ kṣatriyāsteṣāṃ viśastu marutastathā ॥22॥
html:
evamete samāmnātā viśvedevāstathāśvinau ।
ādityāḥ kṣatriyāsteṣāṃ viśastu marutastathā ॥22॥
slp1: evamete samAmnAtA viSvedevAstaTASvinO । AdityAH kzatriyAstezAM viSastu marutastaTA ॥22॥

text: aśvinau tu matau śūdrau tapasyugre samāhitau । smṛtāstvaṅgiraso devā brāhmaṇā iti niścayaḥ । ityetatsarvadevānāṃ cāturvarṇyaṃ prakīrtitam ॥23॥
html:
aśvinau tu matau śūdrau tapasyugre samāhitau ।
smṛtāstvaṅgiraso devā brāhmaṇā iti niścayaḥ ।
ityetatsarvadevānāṃ cāturvarṇyaṃ prakīrtitam ॥23॥
slp1: aSvinO tu matO SUdrO tapasyugre samAhitO । smftAstvaNgiraso devA brAhmaRA iti niScayaH । ityetatsarvadevAnAM cAturvarRyaM prakIrtitam ॥23॥

text: etānvai prātarutthāya devānyastu prakīrtayet । svajādanyakṛtāccaiva sarvapāpātpramucyate ॥24॥
html:
etānvai prātarutthāya devānyastu prakīrtayet ।
svajādanyakṛtāccaiva sarvapāpātpramucyate ॥24॥
slp1: etAnvE prAtarutTAya devAnyastu prakIrtayet । svajAdanyakftAccEva sarvapApAtpramucyate ॥24॥

text: yavakrīto'tha raibhyaśca arvāvasuparāvasū । auśijaścaiva kakṣīvānnalaścāṅgirasaḥ sutāḥ ॥25॥
html:
yavakrīto'tha raibhyaśca arvāvasuparāvasū ।
auśijaścaiva kakṣīvānnalaścāṅgirasaḥ sutāḥ ॥25॥
slp1: yavakrIto'Ta rEByaSca arvAvasuparAvasU । OSijaScEva kakzIvAnnalaScANgirasaH sutAH ॥25॥

text: ṛṣermedhātitheḥ putraḥ kaṇvo barhiṣadastathā । trailokyabhāvanāstāta prācyāṃ saptarṣayastathā ॥26॥
html:
ṛṣermedhātitheḥ putraḥ kaṇvo barhiṣadastathā ।
trailokyabhāvanāstāta prācyāṃ saptarṣayastathā ॥26॥
slp1: fzermeDAtiTeH putraH kaRvo barhizadastaTA । trElokyaBAvanAstAta prAcyAM saptarzayastaTA ॥26॥

text: unmuco vimucaścaiva svastyātreyaśca vīryavān । pramucaścedhmavāhaśca bhagavāṃśca dṛḍhavrataḥ ॥27॥
html:
unmuco vimucaścaiva svastyātreyaśca vīryavān ।
pramucaścedhmavāhaśca bhagavāṃśca dṛḍhavrataḥ ॥27॥
slp1: unmuco vimucaScEva svastyAtreyaSca vIryavAn । pramucaSceDmavAhaSca BagavAMSca dfQavrataH ॥27॥

text: mitrāvaruṇayoḥ putrastathāgastyaḥ pratāpavān । ete brahmarṣayo nityamāśritā dakṣiṇāṃ diśam ॥28॥
html:
mitrāvaruṇayoḥ putrastathāgastyaḥ pratāpavān ।
ete brahmarṣayo nityamāśritā dakṣiṇāṃ diśam ॥28॥
slp1: mitrAvaruRayoH putrastaTAgastyaH pratApavAn । ete brahmarzayo nityamASritA dakziRAM diSam ॥28॥

text: ruṣadguḥ kavaṣo dhaumyaḥ parivyādhaśca vīryavān । ekataśca dvitaścaiva tritaścaiva maharṣayaḥ ॥29॥
html:
ruṣadguḥ kavaṣo dhaumyaḥ parivyādhaśca vīryavān ।
ekataśca dvitaścaiva tritaścaiva maharṣayaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: ruzadguH kavazo DOmyaH parivyADaSca vIryavAn । ekataSca dvitaScEva tritaScEva maharzayaH ॥29॥

text: atreḥ putraśca bhagavāṃstathā sārasvataḥ prabhuḥ । ete nava mahātmānaḥ paścimāmāśritā diśam ॥30॥
html:
atreḥ putraśca bhagavāṃstathā sārasvataḥ prabhuḥ ।
ete nava mahātmānaḥ paścimāmāśritā diśam ॥30॥
slp1: atreH putraSca BagavAMstaTA sArasvataH praBuH । ete nava mahAtmAnaH paScimAmASritA diSam ॥30॥

text: ātreyaśca vasiṣṭhaśca kaśyapaśca mahānṛṣiḥ । gautamaḥ sabharadvājo viśvāmitro'tha kauśikaḥ ॥31॥
html:
ātreyaśca vasiṣṭhaśca kaśyapaśca mahānṛṣiḥ ।
gautamaḥ sabharadvājo viśvāmitro'tha kauśikaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: AtreyaSca vasizWaSca kaSyapaSca mahAnfziH । gOtamaH saBaradvAjo viSvAmitro'Ta kOSikaH ॥31॥

text: tathaiva putro bhagavānṛcīkasya mahātmanaḥ । jamadagniśca saptaite udīcīṃ diśamāśritāḥ ॥32॥
html:
tathaiva putro bhagavānṛcīkasya mahātmanaḥ ।
jamadagniśca saptaite udīcīṃ diśamāśritāḥ ॥32॥
slp1: taTEva putro BagavAnfcIkasya mahAtmanaH । jamadagniSca saptEte udIcIM diSamASritAH ॥32॥

text: ete pratidiśaṃ sarve kīrtitāstigmatejasaḥ । sākṣibhūtā mahātmāno bhuvanānāṃ prabhāvanāḥ ॥33॥
html:
ete pratidiśaṃ sarve kīrtitāstigmatejasaḥ ।
sākṣibhūtā mahātmāno bhuvanānāṃ prabhāvanāḥ ॥33॥
slp1: ete pratidiSaM sarve kIrtitAstigmatejasaH । sAkziBUtA mahAtmAno BuvanAnAM praBAvanAH ॥33॥

text: evamete mahātmānaḥ sthitāḥ pratyekaśo diśaḥ । eteṣāṃ kīrtanaṃ kṛtvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ॥34॥
html:
evamete mahātmānaḥ sthitāḥ pratyekaśo diśaḥ ।
eteṣāṃ kīrtanaṃ kṛtvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ॥34॥
slp1: evamete mahAtmAnaH sTitAH pratyekaSo diSaH । etezAM kIrtanaM kftvA sarvapApEH pramucyate ॥34॥

text: yasyāṃ yasyāṃ diśi hyete tāṃ diśaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ । mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ svastimāṃśca gṛhānvrajet] ॥35॥
html:
yasyāṃ yasyāṃ diśi hyete tāṃ diśaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ।
mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ svastimāṃśca gṛhānvrajet] ॥35॥
slp1: yasyAM yasyAM diSi hyete tAM diSaM SaraRaM gataH । mucyate sarvapApeByaH svastimAMSca gfhAnvrajet] ॥35॥

text: pitāmaha mahāprājña yudhi satyaparākrama । śrotumicchāmi kārtsnyena kṛṣṇamavyayamīśvaram ॥1॥
html:
pitāmaha mahāprājña yudhi satyaparākrama ।
śrotumicchāmi kārtsnyena kṛṣṇamavyayamīśvaram ॥1॥
slp1: pitAmaha mahAprAjYa yuDi satyaparAkrama । SrotumicCAmi kArtsnyena kfzRamavyayamISvaram ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: yaccāsya tejaḥ sumahadyacca karma purātanam । tanme sarvaṃ yathātattvaṃ prabrūhi bharatarṣabha ॥2॥
html:
yaccāsya tejaḥ sumahadyacca karma purātanam ।
tanme sarvaṃ yathātattvaṃ prabrūhi bharatarṣabha ॥2॥
slp1: yaccAsya tejaH sumahadyacca karma purAtanam । tanme sarvaM yaTAtattvaM prabrUhi BaratarzaBa ॥2॥

text: tiryagyonigataṃ rūpaṃ kathaṃ dhāritavānhariḥ । kena kāryavisargeṇa tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥3॥
html:
tiryagyonigataṃ rūpaṃ kathaṃ dhāritavānhariḥ ।
kena kāryavisargeṇa tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥3॥
slp1: tiryagyonigataM rUpaM kaTaM DAritavAnhariH । kena kAryavisargeRa tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥3॥

text: purāhaṃ mṛgayāṃ yāto mārkaṇḍeyāśrame sthitaḥ । tatrāpaśyaṃ munigaṇānsamāsīnānsahasraśaḥ ॥4॥
html:
purāhaṃ mṛgayāṃ yāto mārkaṇḍeyāśrame sthitaḥ ।
tatrāpaśyaṃ munigaṇānsamāsīnānsahasraśaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: purAhaM mfgayAM yAto mArkaRqeyASrame sTitaH । tatrApaSyaM munigaRAnsamAsInAnsahasraSaH ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tataste madhuparkeṇa pūjāṃ cakruratho mayi । pratigṛhya ca tāṃ pūjāṃ pratyanandamṛṣīnaham ॥5॥
html:
tataste madhuparkeṇa pūjāṃ cakruratho mayi ।
pratigṛhya ca tāṃ pūjāṃ pratyanandamṛṣīnaham ॥5॥
slp1: tataste maDuparkeRa pUjAM cakruraTo mayi । pratigfhya ca tAM pUjAM pratyanandamfzInaham ॥5॥

text: kathaiṣā kathitā tatra kaśyapena maharṣiṇā । manaḥprahlādinīṃ divyāṃ tāmihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ॥6॥
html:
kathaiṣā kathitā tatra kaśyapena maharṣiṇā ।
manaḥprahlādinīṃ divyāṃ tāmihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ॥6॥
slp1: kaTEzA kaTitA tatra kaSyapena maharziRA । manaHprahlAdinIM divyAM tAmihEkamanAH SfRu ॥6॥

text: purā dānavamukhyā hi krodhalobhasamanvitāḥ । balena mattāḥ śataśo narakādyā mahāsurāḥ ॥7॥
html:
purā dānavamukhyā hi krodhalobhasamanvitāḥ ।
balena mattāḥ śataśo narakādyā mahāsurāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: purA dAnavamuKyA hi kroDaloBasamanvitAH । balena mattAH SataSo narakAdyA mahAsurAH ॥7॥

text: tathaiva cānye bahavo dānavā yuddhadurmadāḥ । na sahante sma devānāṃ samṛddhiṃ tāmanuttamām ॥8॥
html:
tathaiva cānye bahavo dānavā yuddhadurmadāḥ ।
na sahante sma devānāṃ samṛddhiṃ tāmanuttamām ॥8॥
slp1: taTEva cAnye bahavo dAnavA yudDadurmadAH । na sahante sma devAnAM samfdDiM tAmanuttamAm ॥8॥

text: dānavairardyamānāstu devā devarṣayastathā । na śarma lebhire rājanviśamānāstatastataḥ ॥9॥
html:
dānavairardyamānāstu devā devarṣayastathā ।
na śarma lebhire rājanviśamānāstatastataḥ ॥9॥
slp1: dAnavErardyamAnAstu devA devarzayastaTA । na Sarma leBire rAjanviSamAnAstatastataH ॥9॥

text: pṛthivīṃ cārtarūpāṃ te samapaśyandivaukasaḥ । dānavairabhisaṅkīrṇāṃ ghorarūpairmahābalaiḥ । bhārārtāmapakṛṣṭāṃ ca duḥkhitāṃ sannimajjatīm ॥10॥
html:
pṛthivīṃ cārtarūpāṃ te samapaśyandivaukasaḥ ।
dānavairabhisaṅkīrṇāṃ ghorarūpairmahābalaiḥ ।
bhārārtāmapakṛṣṭāṃ ca duḥkhitāṃ sannimajjatīm ॥10॥
slp1: pfTivIM cArtarUpAM te samapaSyandivOkasaH । dAnavEraBisaNkIrRAM GorarUpErmahAbalEH । BArArtAmapakfzwAM ca duHKitAM sannimajjatIm ॥10॥

text: athāditeyāḥ santrastā brahmāṇamidamabruvan । kathaṃ śakyāmahe brahmandānavairupamardanam ॥11॥
html:
athāditeyāḥ santrastā brahmāṇamidamabruvan ।
kathaṃ śakyāmahe brahmandānavairupamardanam ॥11॥
slp1: aTAditeyAH santrastA brahmARamidamabruvan । kaTaM SakyAmahe brahmandAnavErupamardanam ॥11॥

text: svayaṃbhūstānuvācedaṃ nisṛṣṭo'tra vidhirmayā । te vareṇābhisaṃmattā balena ca madena ca ॥12॥
html:
svayaṃbhūstānuvācedaṃ nisṛṣṭo'tra vidhirmayā ।
te vareṇābhisaṃmattā balena ca madena ca ॥12॥
slp1: svayaMBUstAnuvAcedaM nisfzwo'tra viDirmayA । te vareRABisaMmattA balena ca madena ca ॥12॥

text: nāvabhotsyanti saṃmūḍhā viṣṇumavyaktadarśanam । varāharūpiṇaṃ devamadhṛṣyamamarairapi ॥13॥
html:
nāvabhotsyanti saṃmūḍhā viṣṇumavyaktadarśanam ।
varāharūpiṇaṃ devamadhṛṣyamamarairapi ॥13॥
slp1: nAvaBotsyanti saMmUQA vizRumavyaktadarSanam । varAharUpiRaM devamaDfzyamamarErapi ॥13॥

text: eṣa vegena gatvā hi yatra te dānavādhamāḥ । antarbhūmigatā ghorā nivasanti sahasraśaḥ । śamayiṣyati śrutvā te jahṛṣuḥ surasattamāḥ ॥14॥
html:
eṣa vegena gatvā hi yatra te dānavādhamāḥ ।
antarbhūmigatā ghorā nivasanti sahasraśaḥ ।
śamayiṣyati śrutvā te jahṛṣuḥ surasattamāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: eza vegena gatvA hi yatra te dAnavADamAH । antarBUmigatA GorA nivasanti sahasraSaH । Samayizyati SrutvA te jahfzuH surasattamAH ॥14॥

text: tato viṣṇurmahātejā vārāhaṃ rūpamāśritaḥ । antarbhūmiṃ sampraviśya jagāma ditijānprati ॥15॥
html:
tato viṣṇurmahātejā vārāhaṃ rūpamāśritaḥ ।
antarbhūmiṃ sampraviśya jagāma ditijānprati ॥15॥
slp1: tato vizRurmahAtejA vArAhaM rUpamASritaH । antarBUmiM sampraviSya jagAma ditijAnprati ॥15॥

text: dṛṣṭvā ca sahitāḥ sarve daityāḥ sattvamamānuṣam । prasahya sahasā sarve santasthuḥ kālamohitāḥ ॥16॥
html:
dṛṣṭvā ca sahitāḥ sarve daityāḥ sattvamamānuṣam ।
prasahya sahasā sarve santasthuḥ kālamohitāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: dfzwvA ca sahitAH sarve dEtyAH sattvamamAnuzam । prasahya sahasA sarve santasTuH kAlamohitAH ॥16॥

text: sarve ca samabhidrutya varāhaṃ jagṛhuḥ samam । saṅkruddhāśca varāhaṃ taṃ vyakarṣanta samantataḥ ॥17॥
html:
sarve ca samabhidrutya varāhaṃ jagṛhuḥ samam ।
saṅkruddhāśca varāhaṃ taṃ vyakarṣanta samantataḥ ॥17॥
slp1: sarve ca samaBidrutya varAhaM jagfhuH samam । saNkrudDASca varAhaM taM vyakarzanta samantataH ॥17॥

text: dānavendrā mahākāyā mahāvīryā balocchritāḥ । nāśaknuvaṃśca kiñcitte tasya kartuṃ tadā vibho ॥18॥
html:
dānavendrā mahākāyā mahāvīryā balocchritāḥ ।
nāśaknuvaṃśca kiñcitte tasya kartuṃ tadā vibho ॥18॥
slp1: dAnavendrA mahAkAyA mahAvIryA balocCritAH । nASaknuvaMSca kiYcitte tasya kartuM tadA viBo ॥18॥

text: tato'gamanvismayaṃ te dānavendrā bhayāttadā । saṃśayaṃ gatamātmānaṃ menire ca sahasraśaḥ ॥19॥
html:
tato'gamanvismayaṃ te dānavendrā bhayāttadā ।
saṃśayaṃ gatamātmānaṃ menire ca sahasraśaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: tato'gamanvismayaM te dAnavendrA BayAttadA । saMSayaM gatamAtmAnaM menire ca sahasraSaH ॥19॥

text: tato devādidevaḥ sa yogātmā yogasārathiḥ । yogamāsthāya bhagavāṃstadā bharatasattama ॥20॥
html:
tato devādidevaḥ sa yogātmā yogasārathiḥ ।
yogamāsthāya bhagavāṃstadā bharatasattama ॥20॥
slp1: tato devAdidevaH sa yogAtmA yogasAraTiH । yogamAsTAya BagavAMstadA Baratasattama ॥20॥

text: vinanāda mahānādaṃ kṣobhayandaityadānavān । sannāditā yena lokāḥ sarvāścaiva diśo daśa ॥21॥
html:
vinanāda mahānādaṃ kṣobhayandaityadānavān ।
sannāditā yena lokāḥ sarvāścaiva diśo daśa ॥21॥
slp1: vinanAda mahAnAdaM kzoBayandEtyadAnavAn । sannAditA yena lokAH sarvAScEva diSo daSa ॥21॥

text: tena sannādaśabdena lokāḥ saṅkṣobhamāgaman । sambhrāntāśca diśaḥ sarvā devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ ॥22॥
html:
tena sannādaśabdena lokāḥ saṅkṣobhamāgaman ।
sambhrāntāśca diśaḥ sarvā devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ ॥22॥
slp1: tena sannAdaSabdena lokAH saNkzoBamAgaman । samBrAntASca diSaH sarvA devAH SakrapurogamAH ॥22॥

text: nirviceṣṭaṃ jagaccāpi babhūvātibhṛśaṃ tadā । sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva tena nādena mohitam ॥23॥
html:
nirviceṣṭaṃ jagaccāpi babhūvātibhṛśaṃ tadā ।
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva tena nādena mohitam ॥23॥
slp1: nirvicezwaM jagaccApi baBUvAtiBfSaM tadA । sTAvaraM jaNgamaM cEva tena nAdena mohitam ॥23॥

text: tataste dānavāḥ sarve tena śabdena bhīṣitāḥ । peturgatāsavaścaiva viṣṇutejovimohitāḥ ॥24॥
html:
tataste dānavāḥ sarve tena śabdena bhīṣitāḥ ।
peturgatāsavaścaiva viṣṇutejovimohitāḥ ॥24॥
slp1: tataste dAnavAH sarve tena Sabdena BIzitAH । peturgatAsavaScEva vizRutejovimohitAH ॥24॥

text: rasātalagatāṃścaiva varāhastridaśadviṣaḥ । khuraiḥ sandārayāmāsa māṃsamedosthisañcayam ॥25॥
html:
rasātalagatāṃścaiva varāhastridaśadviṣaḥ ।
khuraiḥ sandārayāmāsa māṃsamedosthisañcayam ॥25॥
slp1: rasAtalagatAMScEva varAhastridaSadvizaH । KurEH sandArayAmAsa mAMsamedosTisaYcayam ॥25॥

text: nādena tena mahatā sanātana iti smṛtaḥ । padmanābho mahāyogī bhūtācāryaḥ sa bhūtarāṭ ॥26॥
html:
nādena tena mahatā sanātana iti smṛtaḥ ।
padmanābho mahāyogī bhūtācāryaḥ sa bhūtarāṭ ॥26॥
slp1: nAdena tena mahatA sanAtana iti smftaH । padmanABo mahAyogI BUtAcAryaH sa BUtarAw ॥26॥

text: tato devagaṇāḥ sarve pitāmahamupābruvan । nādo'yaṃ kīdṛśo deva nainaṃ vidma vayaṃ vibho । ko'sau hi kasya vā nādo yena vihvalitaṃ jagat ॥27॥
html:
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve pitāmahamupābruvan ।
nādo'yaṃ kīdṛśo deva nainaṃ vidma vayaṃ vibho ।
ko'sau hi kasya vā nādo yena vihvalitaṃ jagat ॥27॥
slp1: tato devagaRAH sarve pitAmahamupAbruvan । nAdo'yaM kIdfSo deva nEnaM vidma vayaM viBo । ko'sO hi kasya vA nAdo yena vihvalitaM jagat ॥27॥

text: etasminnantare viṣṇurvārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ । udatiṣṭhanmahādevaḥ stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ ॥28॥
html:
etasminnantare viṣṇurvārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ ।
udatiṣṭhanmahādevaḥ stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ ॥28॥
slp1: etasminnantare vizRurvArAhaM rUpamAsTitaH । udatizWanmahAdevaH stUyamAno maharziBiH ॥28॥

text: nihatya dānavapatīnmahāvarṣmā mahābalaḥ । eṣa devo mahāyogī bhūtātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ ॥29॥
html:
nihatya dānavapatīnmahāvarṣmā mahābalaḥ ।
eṣa devo mahāyogī bhūtātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: nihatya dAnavapatInmahAvarzmA mahAbalaH । eza devo mahAyogI BUtAtmA BUtaBAvanaH ॥29॥
author: pitāmaha uvāca ।

text: sarvabhūteśvaro yogī yonirātmā tathātmanaḥ । sthirībhavata kṛṣṇo'yaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ ॥30॥
html:
sarvabhūteśvaro yogī yonirātmā tathātmanaḥ ।
sthirībhavata kṛṣṇo'yaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: sarvaBUteSvaro yogI yonirAtmA taTAtmanaH । sTirIBavata kfzRo'yaM sarvapApapraRASanaH ॥30॥

text: kṛtvā karmātisādhvetadaśakyamamitaprabhaḥ । samāyātaḥ svamātmānaṃ mahābhāgo mahādyutiḥ । padmanābho mahāyogī bhūtātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ ॥31॥
html:
kṛtvā karmātisādhvetadaśakyamamitaprabhaḥ ।
samāyātaḥ svamātmānaṃ mahābhāgo mahādyutiḥ ।
padmanābho mahāyogī bhūtātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: kftvA karmAtisADvetadaSakyamamitapraBaH । samAyAtaH svamAtmAnaM mahABAgo mahAdyutiH । padmanABo mahAyogI BUtAtmA BUtaBAvanaH ॥31॥

text: na santāpo na bhīḥ kāryā śoko vā surasattamāḥ । vidhireṣa prabhāvaśca kālaḥ saṅkṣayakārakaḥ । lokāndhārayatānena nādo mukto mahātmanā ॥32॥
html:
na santāpo na bhīḥ kāryā śoko vā surasattamāḥ ।
vidhireṣa prabhāvaśca kālaḥ saṅkṣayakārakaḥ ।
lokāndhārayatānena nādo mukto mahātmanā ॥32॥
slp1: na santApo na BIH kAryA Soko vA surasattamAH । viDireza praBAvaSca kAlaH saNkzayakArakaH । lokAnDArayatAnena nAdo mukto mahAtmanA ॥32॥

text: sa eva hi mahābhāgaḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ । acyutaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ sarvabhūtasamudbhavaḥ] ॥33॥
html:
sa eva hi mahābhāgaḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ ।
acyutaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ sarvabhūtasamudbhavaḥ] ॥33॥
slp1: sa eva hi mahABAgaH sarvalokanamaskftaH । acyutaH puRqarIkAkzaH sarvaBUtasamudBavaH] ॥33॥

text: yogaṃ me paramaṃ tāta mokṣasya vada bhārata । tamahaṃ tattvato jñātumicchāmi vadatāṃ vara ॥1॥
html:
yogaṃ me paramaṃ tāta mokṣasya vada bhārata ।
tamahaṃ tattvato jñātumicchāmi vadatāṃ vara ॥1॥
slp1: yogaM me paramaM tAta mokzasya vada BArata । tamahaM tattvato jYAtumicCAmi vadatAM vara ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । saṃvādaṃ mokṣasaṃyuktaṃ śiṣyasya guruṇā saha ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
saṃvādaṃ mokṣasaṃyuktaṃ śiṣyasya guruṇā saha ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । saMvAdaM mokzasaMyuktaM Sizyasya guruRA saha ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kaścidbrāhmaṇamāsīnamācāryamṛṣisattamam । śiṣyaḥ paramamedhāvī śreyorthī susamāhitaḥ । caraṇāvupasaṅgṛhya sthitaḥ prāñjalirabravīt ॥3॥
html:
kaścidbrāhmaṇamāsīnamācāryamṛṣisattamam ।
śiṣyaḥ paramamedhāvī śreyorthī susamāhitaḥ ।
caraṇāvupasaṅgṛhya sthitaḥ prāñjalirabravīt ॥3॥
slp1: kaScidbrAhmaRamAsInamAcAryamfzisattamam । SizyaH paramameDAvI SreyorTI susamAhitaH । caraRAvupasaNgfhya sTitaH prAYjalirabravIt ॥3॥

text: upāsanātprasanno'si yadi vai bhagavanmama । saṃśayo me mahānkaścittanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥4॥
html:
upāsanātprasanno'si yadi vai bhagavanmama ।
saṃśayo me mahānkaścittanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥4॥
slp1: upAsanAtprasanno'si yadi vE Bagavanmama । saMSayo me mahAnkaScittanme vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥4॥

text: kutaścāhaṃ kutaśca tvaṃ tatsamyagbrūhi yatparam । kathaṃ ca sarvabhūteṣu sameṣu dvijasattama । samyagvṛttā nivartante viparītāḥ kṣayodayāḥ ॥5॥
html:
kutaścāhaṃ kutaśca tvaṃ tatsamyagbrūhi yatparam ।
kathaṃ ca sarvabhūteṣu sameṣu dvijasattama ।
samyagvṛttā nivartante viparītāḥ kṣayodayāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: kutaScAhaM kutaSca tvaM tatsamyagbrUhi yatparam । kaTaM ca sarvaBUtezu samezu dvijasattama । samyagvfttA nivartante viparItAH kzayodayAH ॥5॥

text: vedeṣu cāpi yadvākyaṃ laukikaṃ vyāpakaṃ ca yat । etadvidvanyathātattvaṃ sarvaṃ vyākhyātumarhasi ॥6॥
html:
vedeṣu cāpi yadvākyaṃ laukikaṃ vyāpakaṃ ca yat ।
etadvidvanyathātattvaṃ sarvaṃ vyākhyātumarhasi ॥6॥
slp1: vedezu cApi yadvAkyaM lOkikaM vyApakaM ca yat । etadvidvanyaTAtattvaM sarvaM vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥6॥

text: śṛṇu śiṣya mahāprājña brahmaguhyamidaṃ param । adhyātmaṃ sarvabhūtānāmāgamānāṃ ca yadvasu ॥7॥
html:
śṛṇu śiṣya mahāprājña brahmaguhyamidaṃ param ।
adhyātmaṃ sarvabhūtānāmāgamānāṃ ca yadvasu ॥7॥
slp1: SfRu Sizya mahAprAjYa brahmaguhyamidaM param । aDyAtmaM sarvaBUtAnAmAgamAnAM ca yadvasu ॥7॥
author: gururuvāca ।

text: vāsudevaḥ sarvamidaṃ viśvasya brahmaṇo mukham । satyaṃ dānamatho yajñastitikṣā dama ārjavam ॥8॥
html:
vāsudevaḥ sarvamidaṃ viśvasya brahmaṇo mukham ।
satyaṃ dānamatho yajñastitikṣā dama ārjavam ॥8॥
slp1: vAsudevaH sarvamidaM viSvasya brahmaRo muKam । satyaM dAnamaTo yajYastitikzA dama Arjavam ॥8॥

text: puruṣaṃ sanātanaṃ viṣṇuṃ yattadvedavido viduḥ । sargapralayakartāramavyaktaṃ brahma śāśvatam । tadidaṃ brahma vārṣṇeyamitihāsaṃ śṛṇuṣva me ॥9॥
html:
puruṣaṃ sanātanaṃ viṣṇuṃ yattadvedavido viduḥ ।
sargapralayakartāramavyaktaṃ brahma śāśvatam ।
tadidaṃ brahma vārṣṇeyamitihāsaṃ śṛṇuṣva me ॥9॥
slp1: puruzaM sanAtanaM vizRuM yattadvedavido viduH । sargapralayakartAramavyaktaM brahma SASvatam । tadidaM brahma vArzReyamitihAsaM SfRuzva me ॥9॥

text: brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇaiḥ śrāvyo rājanyaḥ kṣatriyaistathā । māhātmyaṃ devadevasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ । arhastvamasi kalyāṇa vārṣṇeyaṃ śṛṇu yatparam ॥10॥
html:
brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇaiḥ śrāvyo rājanyaḥ kṣatriyaistathā ।
māhātmyaṃ devadevasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ ।
arhastvamasi kalyāṇa vārṣṇeyaṃ śṛṇu yatparam ॥10॥
slp1: brAhmaRo brAhmaREH SrAvyo rAjanyaH kzatriyEstaTA । mAhAtmyaM devadevasya vizRoramitatejasaH । arhastvamasi kalyARa vArzReyaM SfRu yatparam ॥10॥

text: kālacakramanādyantaṃ bhāvābhāvasvalakṣaṇam । trailokyaṃ sarvabhūteṣu cakravatparivartate ॥11॥
html:
kālacakramanādyantaṃ bhāvābhāvasvalakṣaṇam ।
trailokyaṃ sarvabhūteṣu cakravatparivartate ॥11॥
slp1: kAlacakramanAdyantaM BAvABAvasvalakzaRam । trElokyaM sarvaBUtezu cakravatparivartate ॥11॥

text: yattadakṣaramavyaktamamṛtaṃ brahma śāśvatam । vadanti puruṣavyāghraṃ keśavaṃ puruṣarṣabham ॥12॥
html:
yattadakṣaramavyaktamamṛtaṃ brahma śāśvatam ।
vadanti puruṣavyāghraṃ keśavaṃ puruṣarṣabham ॥12॥
slp1: yattadakzaramavyaktamamftaM brahma SASvatam । vadanti puruzavyAGraM keSavaM puruzarzaBam ॥12॥

text: pitṝndevānṛṣīṃścaiva tathā vai yakṣadānavān । nāgāsuramanuṣyāṃśca sṛjate paramo'vyayaḥ ॥13॥
html:
pitṝndevānṛṣīṃścaiva tathā vai yakṣadānavān ।
nāgāsuramanuṣyāṃśca sṛjate paramo'vyayaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: pitFndevAnfzIMScEva taTA vE yakzadAnavAn । nAgAsuramanuzyAMSca sfjate paramo'vyayaH ॥13॥

text: tathaiva vedaśāstrāṇi lokadharmāṃśca śāśvatān । pralaye prakṛtiṃ prāpya yugādau sṛjate prabhuḥ ॥14॥
html:
tathaiva vedaśāstrāṇi lokadharmāṃśca śāśvatān ।
pralaye prakṛtiṃ prāpya yugādau sṛjate prabhuḥ ॥14॥
slp1: taTEva vedaSAstrARi lokaDarmAMSca SASvatAn । pralaye prakftiM prApya yugAdO sfjate praBuH ॥14॥

text: yathartuṣvṛtuliṅgāni nānārūpāṇi paryaye । dṛśyante tāni tānyeva tathā brahmāharātriṣu ॥15॥
html:
yathartuṣvṛtuliṅgāni nānārūpāṇi paryaye ।
dṛśyante tāni tānyeva tathā brahmāharātriṣu ॥15॥
slp1: yaTartuzvftuliNgAni nAnArUpARi paryaye । dfSyante tAni tAnyeva taTA brahmAharAtrizu ॥15॥

text: atha yadyadyadā bhāvi kālayogādyugādiṣu । tattadutpadyate jñānaṃ lokayātrāvidhānajam ॥16॥
html:
atha yadyadyadā bhāvi kālayogādyugādiṣu ।
tattadutpadyate jñānaṃ lokayātrāvidhānajam ॥16॥
slp1: aTa yadyadyadA BAvi kAlayogAdyugAdizu । tattadutpadyate jYAnaM lokayAtrAviDAnajam ॥16॥

text: yugānte'ntarhitānvedānsetihāsānmaharṣayaḥ । lebhire tapasā pūrvamanujñātāḥ svayambhuvā ॥17॥
html:
yugānte'ntarhitānvedānsetihāsānmaharṣayaḥ ।
lebhire tapasā pūrvamanujñātāḥ svayambhuvā ॥17॥
slp1: yugAnte'ntarhitAnvedAnsetihAsAnmaharzayaH । leBire tapasA pUrvamanujYAtAH svayamBuvA ॥17॥

text: vedavidveda bhagavānvedāṅgāni bṛhaspatiḥ । bhārgavo nītiśāstraṃ ca jagāda jagato hitam ॥18॥
html:
vedavidveda bhagavānvedāṅgāni bṛhaspatiḥ ।
bhārgavo nītiśāstraṃ ca jagāda jagato hitam ॥18॥
slp1: vedavidveda BagavAnvedANgAni bfhaspatiH । BArgavo nItiSAstraM ca jagAda jagato hitam ॥18॥

text: gāndharvaṃ nārado vedaṃ bharadvājo dhanurgraham । devarṣicaritaṃ gārgyaḥ kṛṣṇātreyaścikitsitam ॥19॥
html:
gāndharvaṃ nārado vedaṃ bharadvājo dhanurgraham ।
devarṣicaritaṃ gārgyaḥ kṛṣṇātreyaścikitsitam ॥19॥
slp1: gAnDarvaM nArado vedaM BaradvAjo Danurgraham । devarzicaritaM gArgyaH kfzRAtreyaScikitsitam ॥19॥

text: nyāyatantrāṇyanekāni taistairuktāni vādibhiḥ । hetvāgamasadācārairyaduktaṃ tadupāsyate ॥20॥
html:
nyāyatantrāṇyanekāni taistairuktāni vādibhiḥ ।
hetvāgamasadācārairyaduktaṃ tadupāsyate ॥20॥
slp1: nyAyatantrARyanekAni tEstEruktAni vAdiBiH । hetvAgamasadAcArEryaduktaM tadupAsyate ॥20॥

text: anādyaṃ yatparaṃ brahma na devā narṣayo viduḥ । ekastadveda bhagavāndhātā nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ॥21॥
html:
anādyaṃ yatparaṃ brahma na devā narṣayo viduḥ ।
ekastadveda bhagavāndhātā nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ॥21॥
slp1: anAdyaM yatparaM brahma na devA narzayo viduH । ekastadveda BagavAnDAtA nArAyaRaH praBuH ॥21॥

text: nārāyaṇādṛṣigaṇāstathā mukhyāḥ surāsurāḥ । rājarṣayaḥ purāṇāśca paramaṃ duḥkhabheṣajam ॥22॥
html:
nārāyaṇādṛṣigaṇāstathā mukhyāḥ surāsurāḥ ।
rājarṣayaḥ purāṇāśca paramaṃ duḥkhabheṣajam ॥22॥
slp1: nArAyaRAdfzigaRAstaTA muKyAH surAsurAH । rAjarzayaH purARASca paramaM duHKaBezajam ॥22॥

text: puruṣādhiṣṭhitaṃ bhāvaṃ prakṛtiḥ sūyate sadā । hetuyuktamataḥ sarvaṃ jagatsamparivartate ॥23॥
html:
puruṣādhiṣṭhitaṃ bhāvaṃ prakṛtiḥ sūyate sadā ।
hetuyuktamataḥ sarvaṃ jagatsamparivartate ॥23॥
slp1: puruzADizWitaM BAvaM prakftiH sUyate sadA । hetuyuktamataH sarvaM jagatsamparivartate ॥23॥

text: dīpādanye yathā dīpāḥ pravartante sahasraśaḥ । prakṛtiḥ sṛjate tadvadānantyānnāpacīyate ॥24॥
html:
dīpādanye yathā dīpāḥ pravartante sahasraśaḥ ।
prakṛtiḥ sṛjate tadvadānantyānnāpacīyate ॥24॥
slp1: dIpAdanye yaTA dIpAH pravartante sahasraSaH । prakftiH sfjate tadvadAnantyAnnApacIyate ॥24॥

text: avyaktakarmajā buddhirahaṅkāraṃ prasūyate । ākāśaṃ cāpyahaṅkārādvāyurākāśasambhavaḥ ॥25॥
html:
avyaktakarmajā buddhirahaṅkāraṃ prasūyate ।
ākāśaṃ cāpyahaṅkārādvāyurākāśasambhavaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: avyaktakarmajA budDirahaNkAraM prasUyate । AkASaM cApyahaNkArAdvAyurAkASasamBavaH ॥25॥

text: vāyostejastataścāpastvadbhyo hi vasudhodgatā । mūlaprakṛtayo'ṣṭau tā jagadetāsvavasthitam ॥26॥
html:
vāyostejastataścāpastvadbhyo hi vasudhodgatā ।
mūlaprakṛtayo'ṣṭau tā jagadetāsvavasthitam ॥26॥
slp1: vAyostejastataScApastvadByo hi vasuDodgatA । mUlaprakftayo'zwO tA jagadetAsvavasTitam ॥26॥

text: jñānendriyāṇyataḥ pañca pañca karmendriyāṇyapi । viṣayāḥ pañca caikaṃ ca vikāre ṣoḍaśaṃ manaḥ ॥27॥
html:
jñānendriyāṇyataḥ pañca pañca karmendriyāṇyapi ।
viṣayāḥ pañca caikaṃ ca vikāre ṣoḍaśaṃ manaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: jYAnendriyARyataH paYca paYca karmendriyARyapi । vizayAH paYca cEkaM ca vikAre zoqaSaM manaH ॥27॥

text: śrotraṃ tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā ghrāṇaṃ pañcendriyāṇyapi । pādau pāyurupasthaśca hastau vākkarmaṇāmapi ॥28॥
html:
śrotraṃ tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā ghrāṇaṃ pañcendriyāṇyapi ।
pādau pāyurupasthaśca hastau vākkarmaṇāmapi ॥28॥
slp1: SrotraM tvakcakzuzI jihvA GrARaM paYcendriyARyapi । pAdO pAyurupasTaSca hastO vAkkarmaRAmapi ॥28॥

text: śabdaḥ sparśo'tha rūpaṃ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca । vijñeyaṃ vyāpakaṃ cittaṃ teṣu sarvagataṃ manaḥ ॥29॥
html:
śabdaḥ sparśo'tha rūpaṃ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca ।
vijñeyaṃ vyāpakaṃ cittaṃ teṣu sarvagataṃ manaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: SabdaH sparSo'Ta rUpaM ca raso ganDastaTEva ca । vijYeyaM vyApakaM cittaM tezu sarvagataM manaH ॥29॥

text: rasajñāne tu jihveyaṃ vyāhṛte vāktathaiva ca । indriyairvividhairyuktaṃ sarvaṃ vyastaṃ manastathā ॥30॥
html:
rasajñāne tu jihveyaṃ vyāhṛte vāktathaiva ca ।
indriyairvividhairyuktaṃ sarvaṃ vyastaṃ manastathā ॥30॥
slp1: rasajYAne tu jihveyaM vyAhfte vAktaTEva ca । indriyErviviDEryuktaM sarvaM vyastaM manastaTA ॥30॥

text: vidyāttu ṣoḍaśaitāni daivatāni vibhāgaśaḥ । deheṣu jñānakartāramupāsīnamupāsate ॥31॥
html:
vidyāttu ṣoḍaśaitāni daivatāni vibhāgaśaḥ ।
deheṣu jñānakartāramupāsīnamupāsate ॥31॥
slp1: vidyAttu zoqaSEtAni dEvatAni viBAgaSaH । dehezu jYAnakartAramupAsInamupAsate ॥31॥

text: tadvatsomaguṇā jihvā gandhastu pṛthivīguṇaḥ । śrotraṃ śabdaguṇaṃ caiva cakṣuragnerguṇastathā । sparśaṃ vāyuguṇaṃ vidyātsarvabhūteṣu sarvadā ॥32॥
html:
tadvatsomaguṇā jihvā gandhastu pṛthivīguṇaḥ ।
śrotraṃ śabdaguṇaṃ caiva cakṣuragnerguṇastathā ।
sparśaṃ vāyuguṇaṃ vidyātsarvabhūteṣu sarvadā ॥32॥
slp1: tadvatsomaguRA jihvA ganDastu pfTivIguRaH । SrotraM SabdaguRaM cEva cakzuragnerguRastaTA । sparSaM vAyuguRaM vidyAtsarvaBUtezu sarvadA ॥32॥

text: manaḥ sattvaguṇaṃ prāhuḥ sattvamavyaktajaṃ tathā । sarvabhūtātmabhūtasthaṃ tasmādbudhyeta buddhimān ॥33॥
html:
manaḥ sattvaguṇaṃ prāhuḥ sattvamavyaktajaṃ tathā ।
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasthaṃ tasmādbudhyeta buddhimān ॥33॥
slp1: manaH sattvaguRaM prAhuH sattvamavyaktajaM taTA । sarvaBUtAtmaBUtasTaM tasmAdbuDyeta budDimAn ॥33॥

text: ete bhāvā jagatsarvaṃ vahanti sacarācaram । śritā virajasaṃ devaṃ yamāhuḥ paramaṃ padam ॥34॥
html:
ete bhāvā jagatsarvaṃ vahanti sacarācaram ।
śritā virajasaṃ devaṃ yamāhuḥ paramaṃ padam ॥34॥
slp1: ete BAvA jagatsarvaM vahanti sacarAcaram । SritA virajasaM devaM yamAhuH paramaM padam ॥34॥

text: navadvāraṃ puraṃ puṇyametairbhāvaiḥ samanvitam । vyāpya śete mahānātmā tasmātpuruṣa ucyate ॥35॥
html:
navadvāraṃ puraṃ puṇyametairbhāvaiḥ samanvitam ।
vyāpya śete mahānātmā tasmātpuruṣa ucyate ॥35॥
slp1: navadvAraM puraM puRyametErBAvEH samanvitam । vyApya Sete mahAnAtmA tasmAtpuruza ucyate ॥35॥

text: ajaraḥ so'maraścaiva vyaktāvyaktopadeśavān । vyāpakaḥ saguṇaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sarvabhūtaguṇāśrayaḥ ॥36॥
html:
ajaraḥ so'maraścaiva vyaktāvyaktopadeśavān ।
vyāpakaḥ saguṇaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sarvabhūtaguṇāśrayaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: ajaraH so'maraScEva vyaktAvyaktopadeSavAn । vyApakaH saguRaH sUkzmaH sarvaBUtaguRASrayaH ॥36॥

text: yathā dīpaḥ prakāśātmā hrasvo vā yadi vā mahān । jñānātmānaṃ tathā vidyātpuruṣaṃ sarvajantuṣu ॥37॥
html:
yathā dīpaḥ prakāśātmā hrasvo vā yadi vā mahān ।
jñānātmānaṃ tathā vidyātpuruṣaṃ sarvajantuṣu ॥37॥
slp1: yaTA dIpaH prakASAtmA hrasvo vA yadi vA mahAn । jYAnAtmAnaM taTA vidyAtpuruzaM sarvajantuzu ॥37॥

text: so'tra vedayate vedyaṃ sa śṛṇoti sa paśyati । kāraṇaṃ tasya deho'yaṃ sa kartā sarvakarmaṇām ॥38॥
html:
so'tra vedayate vedyaṃ sa śṛṇoti sa paśyati ।
kāraṇaṃ tasya deho'yaṃ sa kartā sarvakarmaṇām ॥38॥
slp1: so'tra vedayate vedyaM sa SfRoti sa paSyati । kAraRaM tasya deho'yaM sa kartA sarvakarmaRAm ॥38॥

text: agnirdārugato yadvadbhinne dārau na dṛśyate । tathaivātmā śarīrastho yogenaivātra dṛśyate ॥39॥
html:
agnirdārugato yadvadbhinne dārau na dṛśyate ।
tathaivātmā śarīrastho yogenaivātra dṛśyate ॥39॥
slp1: agnirdArugato yadvadBinne dArO na dfSyate । taTEvAtmA SarIrasTo yogenEvAtra dfSyate ॥39॥

text: nadīṣvāpo yathā yuktā yathā sūrye marīcayaḥ । santanvānā yathā yānti tathā dehāḥ śarīriṇām ॥40॥
html:
nadīṣvāpo yathā yuktā yathā sūrye marīcayaḥ ।
santanvānā yathā yānti tathā dehāḥ śarīriṇām ॥40॥
slp1: nadIzvApo yaTA yuktA yaTA sUrye marIcayaH । santanvAnA yaTA yAnti taTA dehAH SarIriRAm ॥40॥

text: svapnayoge yathaivātmā pañcendriyasamāgataḥ । dehamutsṛjya vai yāti tathaivātropalabhyate ॥41॥
html:
svapnayoge yathaivātmā pañcendriyasamāgataḥ ।
dehamutsṛjya vai yāti tathaivātropalabhyate ॥41॥
slp1: svapnayoge yaTEvAtmA paYcendriyasamAgataH । dehamutsfjya vE yAti taTEvAtropalaByate ॥41॥

text: karmaṇā vyāpyate pūrvaṃ karmaṇā copapadyate । karmaṇā nīyate'nyatra svakṛtena balīyasā ॥42॥
html:
karmaṇā vyāpyate pūrvaṃ karmaṇā copapadyate ।
karmaṇā nīyate'nyatra svakṛtena balīyasā ॥42॥
slp1: karmaRA vyApyate pUrvaM karmaRA copapadyate । karmaRA nIyate'nyatra svakftena balIyasA ॥42॥

text: sa tu dehādyathā dehaṃ tyaktvānyaṃ pratipadyate । tathā taṃ sampravakṣyāmi bhūtagrāmaṃ svakarmajam] ॥43॥
html:
sa tu dehādyathā dehaṃ tyaktvānyaṃ pratipadyate ।
tathā taṃ sampravakṣyāmi bhūtagrāmaṃ svakarmajam] ॥43॥
slp1: sa tu dehAdyaTA dehaM tyaktvAnyaM pratipadyate । taTA taM sampravakzyAmi BUtagrAmaM svakarmajam] ॥43॥

text: caturvidhāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca । avyaktaprabhavānyāhuravyaktanidhanāni ca । avyaktanidhanaṃ vidyādavyaktātmātmakaṃ manaḥ ॥1॥
html:
caturvidhāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ।
avyaktaprabhavānyāhuravyaktanidhanāni ca ।
avyaktanidhanaṃ vidyādavyaktātmātmakaṃ manaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: caturviDAni BUtAni sTAvarARi carARi ca । avyaktapraBavAnyAhuravyaktaniDanAni ca । avyaktaniDanaM vidyAdavyaktAtmAtmakaM manaH ॥1॥
author: gururuvāca ।

text: yathāśvatthakaṇīkāyāmantarbhūto mahādrumaḥ । niṣpanno dṛśyate vyaktamavyaktātsaṃbhavastathā ॥2॥
html:
yathāśvatthakaṇīkāyāmantarbhūto mahādrumaḥ ।
niṣpanno dṛśyate vyaktamavyaktātsaṃbhavastathā ॥2॥
slp1: yaTASvatTakaRIkAyAmantarBUto mahAdrumaH । nizpanno dfSyate vyaktamavyaktAtsaMBavastaTA ॥2॥

text: abhidravatyayaskāntamayo niścetanāvubhau । svabhāvahetujā bhāvā yadvadanyadapīdṛśam ॥3॥
html:
abhidravatyayaskāntamayo niścetanāvubhau ।
svabhāvahetujā bhāvā yadvadanyadapīdṛśam ॥3॥
slp1: aBidravatyayaskAntamayo niScetanAvuBO । svaBAvahetujA BAvA yadvadanyadapIdfSam ॥3॥

text: tadvadavyaktajā bhāvāḥ kartuḥ kāraṇalakṣaṇāḥ । acetanāścetayituḥ kāraṇādabhisaṃhitāḥ ॥4॥
html:
tadvadavyaktajā bhāvāḥ kartuḥ kāraṇalakṣaṇāḥ ।
acetanāścetayituḥ kāraṇādabhisaṃhitāḥ ॥4॥
slp1: tadvadavyaktajA BAvAH kartuH kAraRalakzaRAH । acetanAScetayituH kAraRAdaBisaMhitAH ॥4॥

text: na bhūḥ khaṃ dyaurna bhūtāni narṣayo na surāsurāḥ । nānyadāsīdṛte jīvamāsedurna tu saṃhitam ॥5॥
html:
na bhūḥ khaṃ dyaurna bhūtāni narṣayo na surāsurāḥ ।
nānyadāsīdṛte jīvamāsedurna tu saṃhitam ॥5॥
slp1: na BUH KaM dyOrna BUtAni narzayo na surAsurAH । nAnyadAsIdfte jIvamAsedurna tu saMhitam ॥5॥

text: sarvanītyā sarvagataṃ manohetu salakṣaṇam । ajñānakarma nirdiṣṭametatkāraṇalakṣaṇam ॥6॥
html:
sarvanītyā sarvagataṃ manohetu salakṣaṇam ।
ajñānakarma nirdiṣṭametatkāraṇalakṣaṇam ॥6॥
slp1: sarvanItyA sarvagataM manohetu salakzaRam । ajYAnakarma nirdizwametatkAraRalakzaRam ॥6॥

text: tatkāraṇairhi saṃyuktaṃ kāryasaṅgrahakārakam । yenaitadvartate cakramanādinidhanaṃ mahat ॥7॥
html:
tatkāraṇairhi saṃyuktaṃ kāryasaṅgrahakārakam ।
yenaitadvartate cakramanādinidhanaṃ mahat ॥7॥
slp1: tatkAraRErhi saMyuktaM kAryasaNgrahakArakam । yenEtadvartate cakramanAdiniDanaM mahat ॥7॥

text: avyaktanābhaṃ vyaktāraṃ vikāraparimaṇḍalam । kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitaṃ cakraṃ snigdhākṣaṃ vartate dhruvam ॥8॥
html:
avyaktanābhaṃ vyaktāraṃ vikāraparimaṇḍalam ।
kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitaṃ cakraṃ snigdhākṣaṃ vartate dhruvam ॥8॥
slp1: avyaktanABaM vyaktAraM vikAraparimaRqalam । kzetrajYADizWitaM cakraM snigDAkzaM vartate Druvam ॥8॥

text: snigdhatvāttilavatsarvaṃ cakre'sminpīḍyate jagat । tilapīḍairivākramya bhogairajñānasambhavaiḥ ॥9॥
html:
snigdhatvāttilavatsarvaṃ cakre'sminpīḍyate jagat ।
tilapīḍairivākramya bhogairajñānasambhavaiḥ ॥9॥
slp1: snigDatvAttilavatsarvaM cakre'sminpIqyate jagat । tilapIqErivAkramya BogErajYAnasamBavEH ॥9॥

text: karma tatkurute tarṣādahaṅkāraparigraham । kāryakāraṇasaṃyoge sa heturupapāditaḥ ॥10॥
html:
karma tatkurute tarṣādahaṅkāraparigraham ।
kāryakāraṇasaṃyoge sa heturupapāditaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: karma tatkurute tarzAdahaNkAraparigraham । kAryakAraRasaMyoge sa heturupapAditaH ॥10॥

text: nātyeti kāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ na kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ tathā । kāryāṇāṃ tūpakaraṇe kālo bhavati hetumān ॥11॥
html:
nātyeti kāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ na kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ tathā ।
kāryāṇāṃ tūpakaraṇe kālo bhavati hetumān ॥11॥
slp1: nAtyeti kAraRaM kAryaM na kAryaM kAraRaM taTA । kAryARAM tUpakaraRe kAlo Bavati hetumAn ॥11॥

text: hetuyuktāḥ prakṛtayo vikārāśca parasparam । anyonyamabhivartante puruṣādhiṣṭhitāḥ sadā ॥12॥
html:
hetuyuktāḥ prakṛtayo vikārāśca parasparam ।
anyonyamabhivartante puruṣādhiṣṭhitāḥ sadā ॥12॥
slp1: hetuyuktAH prakftayo vikArASca parasparam । anyonyamaBivartante puruzADizWitAH sadA ॥12॥

text: sarajastāmasairbhāvaiścyuto hetubalānvitaḥ । kṣetrajñamevānuyāti pāṃsurvāterito yathā । na ca taiḥ spṛśyate bhāvo na te tena mahātmanā ॥13॥
html:
sarajastāmasairbhāvaiścyuto hetubalānvitaḥ ।
kṣetrajñamevānuyāti pāṃsurvāterito yathā ।
na ca taiḥ spṛśyate bhāvo na te tena mahātmanā ॥13॥
slp1: sarajastAmasErBAvEScyuto hetubalAnvitaH । kzetrajYamevAnuyAti pAMsurvAterito yaTA । na ca tEH spfSyate BAvo na te tena mahAtmanA ॥13॥

text: sarajasko'rajaskaśca sa vai vāyuryathā bhavet । tathaitadantaraṃ vidyātkṣetrakṣetrajñayorbudhaḥ । abhyāsātsa tathā yukto na gacchetprakṛtiṃ punaḥ ॥14॥
html:
sarajasko'rajaskaśca sa vai vāyuryathā bhavet ।
tathaitadantaraṃ vidyātkṣetrakṣetrajñayorbudhaḥ ।
abhyāsātsa tathā yukto na gacchetprakṛtiṃ punaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: sarajasko'rajaskaSca sa vE vAyuryaTA Bavet । taTEtadantaraM vidyAtkzetrakzetrajYayorbuDaH । aByAsAtsa taTA yukto na gacCetprakftiM punaH ॥14॥

text: sandehametamutpannamacchinadbhagavānṛṣiḥ । tathā vārtāṃ samīkṣeta kṛtalakṣaṇasammitām ॥15॥
html:
sandehametamutpannamacchinadbhagavānṛṣiḥ ।
tathā vārtāṃ samīkṣeta kṛtalakṣaṇasammitām ॥15॥
slp1: sandehametamutpannamacCinadBagavAnfziH । taTA vArtAM samIkzeta kftalakzaRasammitAm ॥15॥

text: bījānyagnyupadagdhāni na rohanti yathā punaḥ । jñānadagdhaistathā kleśairnātmā sambadhyate punaḥ] ॥16॥
html:
bījānyagnyupadagdhāni na rohanti yathā punaḥ ।
jñānadagdhaistathā kleśairnātmā sambadhyate punaḥ] ॥16॥
slp1: bIjAnyagnyupadagDAni na rohanti yaTA punaH । jYAnadagDEstaTA kleSErnAtmA sambaDyate punaH] ॥16॥

text: pravṛttilakṣaṇo dharmo yathāyamupapadyate । teṣāṃ vijñānaniṣṭhānāmanyattattvaṃ na rocate ॥1॥
html:
pravṛttilakṣaṇo dharmo yathāyamupapadyate ।
teṣāṃ vijñānaniṣṭhānāmanyattattvaṃ na rocate ॥1॥
slp1: pravfttilakzaRo Darmo yaTAyamupapadyate । tezAM vijYAnanizWAnAmanyattattvaM na rocate ॥1॥
author: gururuvāca ।

text: durlabhā vedavidvāṃso vedokteṣu vyavasthitāḥ । prayojanamatastvatra mārgamicchanti saṃstutam ॥2॥
html:
durlabhā vedavidvāṃso vedokteṣu vyavasthitāḥ ।
prayojanamatastvatra mārgamicchanti saṃstutam ॥2॥
slp1: durlaBA vedavidvAMso vedoktezu vyavasTitAH । prayojanamatastvatra mArgamicCanti saMstutam ॥2॥

text: sadbhirācaritatvāttu vṛttametadagarhitam । iyaṃ sā buddhiranyeyaṃ yayā yāti parāṃ gatim ॥3॥
html:
sadbhirācaritatvāttu vṛttametadagarhitam ।
iyaṃ sā buddhiranyeyaṃ yayā yāti parāṃ gatim ॥3॥
slp1: sadBirAcaritatvAttu vfttametadagarhitam । iyaM sA budDiranyeyaM yayA yAti parAM gatim ॥3॥

text: śarīravānupādatte mohātsarvaparigrahān । kāmakrodhādibhirbhāvairyukto rājasatāmasaiḥ ॥4॥
html:
śarīravānupādatte mohātsarvaparigrahān ।
kāmakrodhādibhirbhāvairyukto rājasatāmasaiḥ ॥4॥
slp1: SarIravAnupAdatte mohAtsarvaparigrahAn । kAmakroDAdiBirBAvEryukto rAjasatAmasEH ॥4॥

text: nāśuddhamācarettasmādabhīpsandehayāpanam । karmaṇo vivaraṃ kurvanna lokānāpnuyācchubhān ॥5॥
html:
nāśuddhamācarettasmādabhīpsandehayāpanam ।
karmaṇo vivaraṃ kurvanna lokānāpnuyācchubhān ॥5॥
slp1: nASudDamAcarettasmAdaBIpsandehayApanam । karmaRo vivaraM kurvanna lokAnApnuyAcCuBAn ॥5॥

text: lohayuktaṃ yathā hema vipakvaṃ na virājate । tathāpakvakaṣāyākhyaṃ vijñānaṃ na prakāśate ॥6॥
html:
lohayuktaṃ yathā hema vipakvaṃ na virājate ।
tathāpakvakaṣāyākhyaṃ vijñānaṃ na prakāśate ॥6॥
slp1: lohayuktaM yaTA hema vipakvaM na virAjate । taTApakvakazAyAKyaM vijYAnaM na prakASate ॥6॥

text: yaścādharmaṃ carenmohātkāmalobhāvanu plavan । dharmyaṃ panthānamākramya sānubandho vinaśyati ॥7॥
html:
yaścādharmaṃ carenmohātkāmalobhāvanu plavan ।
dharmyaṃ panthānamākramya sānubandho vinaśyati ॥7॥
slp1: yaScADarmaM carenmohAtkAmaloBAvanu plavan । DarmyaM panTAnamAkramya sAnubanDo vinaSyati ॥7॥

text: śabdādīnviṣayāṃstasmādasaṃrāgādanuplavet । krodhaharṣau viṣādaśca jāyante hi parasparam ॥8॥
html:
śabdādīnviṣayāṃstasmādasaṃrāgādanuplavet ।
krodhaharṣau viṣādaśca jāyante hi parasparam ॥8॥
slp1: SabdAdInvizayAMstasmAdasaMrAgAdanuplavet । kroDaharzO vizAdaSca jAyante hi parasparam ॥8॥

text: pañcabhūtātmake dehe sattvarājasatāmase । kamabhiṣṭuvate cāyaṃ kaṃ vā krośati kiṃ vadet ॥9॥
html:
pañcabhūtātmake dehe sattvarājasatāmase ।
kamabhiṣṭuvate cāyaṃ kaṃ vā krośati kiṃ vadet ॥9॥
slp1: paYcaBUtAtmake dehe sattvarAjasatAmase । kamaBizwuvate cAyaM kaM vA kroSati kiM vadet ॥9॥

text: sparśarūparasādyeṣu saṅgaṃ gacchanti bāliśāḥ । nāvagacchantyavijñānādātmajaṃ pārthivaṃ guṇam ॥10॥
html:
sparśarūparasādyeṣu saṅgaṃ gacchanti bāliśāḥ ।
nāvagacchantyavijñānādātmajaṃ pārthivaṃ guṇam ॥10॥
slp1: sparSarUparasAdyezu saNgaM gacCanti bAliSAH । nAvagacCantyavijYAnAdAtmajaM pArTivaM guRam ॥10॥

text: mṛnmayaṃ śaraṇaṃ yadvanmṛdaiva parilipyate । pārthivo'yaṃ tathā deho mṛdvikārairvilipyate ॥11॥
html:
mṛnmayaṃ śaraṇaṃ yadvanmṛdaiva parilipyate ।
pārthivo'yaṃ tathā deho mṛdvikārairvilipyate ॥11॥
slp1: mfnmayaM SaraRaM yadvanmfdEva parilipyate । pArTivo'yaM taTA deho mfdvikArErvilipyate ॥11॥

text: madhu tailaṃ payaḥ sarpirmāṃsāni lavaṇaṃ guḍaḥ । dhānyāni phalamūlāni mṛdvikārāḥ sahāmbhasā ॥12॥
html:
madhu tailaṃ payaḥ sarpirmāṃsāni lavaṇaṃ guḍaḥ ।
dhānyāni phalamūlāni mṛdvikārāḥ sahāmbhasā ॥12॥
slp1: maDu tElaM payaH sarpirmAMsAni lavaRaM guqaH । DAnyAni PalamUlAni mfdvikArAH sahAmBasA ॥12॥

text: yadvatkāntāramātiṣṭhannautsukyaṃ samanuvrajet । śramādāhāramādadyādasvādvapi hi yāpanam ॥13॥
html:
yadvatkāntāramātiṣṭhannautsukyaṃ samanuvrajet ।
śramādāhāramādadyādasvādvapi hi yāpanam ॥13॥
slp1: yadvatkAntAramAtizWannOtsukyaM samanuvrajet । SramAdAhAramAdadyAdasvAdvapi hi yApanam ॥13॥

text: tadvatsaṃsārakāntāramātiṣṭhañśramatatparaḥ । yātrārthamadyādāhāraṃ vyādhito bheṣajaṃ yathā ॥14॥
html:
tadvatsaṃsārakāntāramātiṣṭhañśramatatparaḥ ।
yātrārthamadyādāhāraṃ vyādhito bheṣajaṃ yathā ॥14॥
slp1: tadvatsaMsArakAntAramAtizWaYSramatatparaH । yAtrArTamadyAdAhAraM vyADito BezajaM yaTA ॥14॥

text: satyaśaucārjavatyāgairyaśasā vikrameṇa ca । kṣāntyā dhṛtyā ca buddhyā ca manasā tapasaiva ca ॥15॥
html:
satyaśaucārjavatyāgairyaśasā vikrameṇa ca ।
kṣāntyā dhṛtyā ca buddhyā ca manasā tapasaiva ca ॥15॥
slp1: satyaSOcArjavatyAgEryaSasA vikrameRa ca । kzAntyA DftyA ca budDyA ca manasA tapasEva ca ॥15॥

text: bhāvānsarvānyathāvṛttānsaṃvaseta yathākramam । śāntimicchannadīnātmā saṃyacchedindriyāṇi ca ॥16॥
html:
bhāvānsarvānyathāvṛttānsaṃvaseta yathākramam ।
śāntimicchannadīnātmā saṃyacchedindriyāṇi ca ॥16॥
slp1: BAvAnsarvAnyaTAvfttAnsaMvaseta yaTAkramam । SAntimicCannadInAtmA saMyacCedindriyARi ca ॥16॥

text: sattvena rajasā caiva tamasā caiva mohitāḥ । cakravatparivartante hyajñānājjantavo bhṛśam ॥17॥
html:
sattvena rajasā caiva tamasā caiva mohitāḥ ।
cakravatparivartante hyajñānājjantavo bhṛśam ॥17॥
slp1: sattvena rajasA cEva tamasA cEva mohitAH । cakravatparivartante hyajYAnAjjantavo BfSam ॥17॥

text: tasmātsamyakparīkṣeta doṣānajñānasambhavān । ajñānaprabhavaṃ nityamahaṅkāraṃ parityajet ॥18॥
html:
tasmātsamyakparīkṣeta doṣānajñānasambhavān ।
ajñānaprabhavaṃ nityamahaṅkāraṃ parityajet ॥18॥
slp1: tasmAtsamyakparIkzeta dozAnajYAnasamBavAn । ajYAnapraBavaM nityamahaNkAraM parityajet ॥18॥

text: mahābhūtānīndriyāṇi guṇāḥ sattvaṃ rajastamaḥ । trailokyaṃ seśvaraṃ sarvamahaṅkāre pratiṣṭhitam ॥19॥
html:
mahābhūtānīndriyāṇi guṇāḥ sattvaṃ rajastamaḥ ।
trailokyaṃ seśvaraṃ sarvamahaṅkāre pratiṣṭhitam ॥19॥
slp1: mahABUtAnIndriyARi guRAH sattvaM rajastamaH । trElokyaM seSvaraM sarvamahaNkAre pratizWitam ॥19॥

text: yatheha niyataṃ kālo darśayatyārtavānguṇān । tadvadbhūteṣvahaṅkāraṃ vidyādbhūtapravartakam ॥20॥
html:
yatheha niyataṃ kālo darśayatyārtavānguṇān ।
tadvadbhūteṣvahaṅkāraṃ vidyādbhūtapravartakam ॥20॥
slp1: yaTeha niyataM kAlo darSayatyArtavAnguRAn । tadvadBUtezvahaNkAraM vidyAdBUtapravartakam ॥20॥

text: sammohakaṃ tamo vidyātkṛṣṇamajñānasambhavam । prītiduḥkhanibaddhāṃśca samastāṃstrīnatho guṇān । sattvasya rajasaścaiva tamasaśca nibodha tān ॥21॥
html:
sammohakaṃ tamo vidyātkṛṣṇamajñānasambhavam ।
prītiduḥkhanibaddhāṃśca samastāṃstrīnatho guṇān ।
sattvasya rajasaścaiva tamasaśca nibodha tān ॥21॥
slp1: sammohakaM tamo vidyAtkfzRamajYAnasamBavam । prItiduHKanibadDAMSca samastAMstrInaTo guRAn । sattvasya rajasaScEva tamasaSca niboDa tAn ॥21॥

text: pramoho harṣajaḥ prītirasandeho dhṛtiḥ smṛtiḥ । etānsattvaguṇānvidyādimānrājasatāmasān ॥22॥
html:
pramoho harṣajaḥ prītirasandeho dhṛtiḥ smṛtiḥ ।
etānsattvaguṇānvidyādimānrājasatāmasān ॥22॥
slp1: pramoho harzajaH prItirasandeho DftiH smftiH । etAnsattvaguRAnvidyAdimAnrAjasatAmasAn ॥22॥

text: kāmakrodhau pramādaśca lobhamohau bhayaṃ klamaḥ । viṣādaśokāvaratirmānadarpāvanāryatā ॥23॥
html:
kāmakrodhau pramādaśca lobhamohau bhayaṃ klamaḥ ।
viṣādaśokāvaratirmānadarpāvanāryatā ॥23॥
slp1: kAmakroDO pramAdaSca loBamohO BayaM klamaH । vizAdaSokAvaratirmAnadarpAvanAryatA ॥23॥

text: doṣāṇāmevamādīnāṃ parīkṣya gurulāghavam । vimṛśedātmasaṃsthānāmekaikamanusantatam ॥24॥
html:
doṣāṇāmevamādīnāṃ parīkṣya gurulāghavam ।
vimṛśedātmasaṃsthānāmekaikamanusantatam ॥24॥
slp1: dozARAmevamAdInAM parIkzya gurulAGavam । vimfSedAtmasaMsTAnAmekEkamanusantatam ॥24॥

text: ke doṣā manasā tyaktāḥ ke buddhyā śithilīkṛtāḥ । ke punaḥ punarāyānti ke mohādaphalā iva ॥25॥
html:
ke doṣā manasā tyaktāḥ ke buddhyā śithilīkṛtāḥ ।
ke punaḥ punarāyānti ke mohādaphalā iva ॥25॥
slp1: ke dozA manasA tyaktAH ke budDyA SiTilIkftAH । ke punaH punarAyAnti ke mohAdaPalA iva ॥25॥
author: śiṣya uvāca ।

text: keṣāṃ balābalaṃ buddhyā hetubhirvimṛśedbudhaḥ । etatsarvaṃ samācakṣva yathā vidyāmahaṃ prabho ॥26॥
html:
keṣāṃ balābalaṃ buddhyā hetubhirvimṛśedbudhaḥ ।
etatsarvaṃ samācakṣva yathā vidyāmahaṃ prabho ॥26॥
slp1: kezAM balAbalaM budDyA hetuBirvimfSedbuDaH । etatsarvaM samAcakzva yaTA vidyAmahaM praBo ॥26॥

text: doṣairmūlādavacchinnairviśuddhātmā vimucyate । vināśayati sambhūtamayasmayamayo yathā । tathākṛtātmā sahajairdoṣairnaśyati rājasaiḥ ॥27॥
html:
doṣairmūlādavacchinnairviśuddhātmā vimucyate ।
vināśayati sambhūtamayasmayamayo yathā ।
tathākṛtātmā sahajairdoṣairnaśyati rājasaiḥ ॥27॥
slp1: dozErmUlAdavacCinnErviSudDAtmA vimucyate । vinASayati samBUtamayasmayamayo yaTA । taTAkftAtmA sahajErdozErnaSyati rAjasEH ॥27॥
author: gururuvāca ।

text: rājasaṃ tāmasaṃ caiva śuddhātmākarmasambhavam । tatsarvaṃ dehināṃ bījaṃ sarvamātmavataḥ samam ॥28॥
html:
rājasaṃ tāmasaṃ caiva śuddhātmākarmasambhavam ।
tatsarvaṃ dehināṃ bījaṃ sarvamātmavataḥ samam ॥28॥
slp1: rAjasaM tAmasaM cEva SudDAtmAkarmasamBavam । tatsarvaM dehinAM bIjaM sarvamAtmavataH samam ॥28॥

text: tasmādātmavatā varjyaṃ rajaśca tama eva ca । rajastamobhyāṃ nirmuktaṃ sattvaṃ nirmalatāmiyāt ॥29॥
html:
tasmādātmavatā varjyaṃ rajaśca tama eva ca ।
rajastamobhyāṃ nirmuktaṃ sattvaṃ nirmalatāmiyāt ॥29॥
slp1: tasmAdAtmavatA varjyaM rajaSca tama eva ca । rajastamoByAM nirmuktaM sattvaM nirmalatAmiyAt ॥29॥

text: atha vā mantravadbrūyurmāṃsādānāṃ yajuṣkṛtam । hetuḥ sa evānādāne śuddhadharmānupālane ॥30॥
html:
atha vā mantravadbrūyurmāṃsādānāṃ yajuṣkṛtam ।
hetuḥ sa evānādāne śuddhadharmānupālane ॥30॥
slp1: aTa vA mantravadbrUyurmAMsAdAnAM yajuzkftam । hetuH sa evAnAdAne SudDaDarmAnupAlane ॥30॥

text: rajasā dharmayuktāni kāryāṇyapi samāpnuyāt । arthayuktāni cātyarthaṃ kāmānsarvāṃśca sevate ॥31॥
html:
rajasā dharmayuktāni kāryāṇyapi samāpnuyāt ।
arthayuktāni cātyarthaṃ kāmānsarvāṃśca sevate ॥31॥
slp1: rajasA DarmayuktAni kAryARyapi samApnuyAt । arTayuktAni cAtyarTaM kAmAnsarvAMSca sevate ॥31॥

text: tamasā lobhayuktāni krodhajāni ca sevate । hiṃsāvihārābhiratastandrīnidrāsamanvitaḥ ॥32॥
html:
tamasā lobhayuktāni krodhajāni ca sevate ।
hiṃsāvihārābhiratastandrīnidrāsamanvitaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: tamasA loBayuktAni kroDajAni ca sevate । hiMsAvihArABiratastandrInidrAsamanvitaH ॥32॥

text: sattvasthaḥ sāttvikānbhāvāñśuddhānpaśyati saṃśritaḥ । sa dehī vimalaḥ śrīmāñśuddho vidyāsamanvitaḥ] ॥33॥
html:
sattvasthaḥ sāttvikānbhāvāñśuddhānpaśyati saṃśritaḥ ।
sa dehī vimalaḥ śrīmāñśuddho vidyāsamanvitaḥ] ॥33॥
slp1: sattvasTaH sAttvikAnBAvAYSudDAnpaSyati saMSritaH । sa dehI vimalaH SrImAYSudDo vidyAsamanvitaH] ॥33॥

text: rajasā sādhyate mohastamasā ca nararṣabha । krodhalobhau bhayaṃ darpa eteṣāṃ sādhanācchuciḥ ॥1॥
html:
rajasā sādhyate mohastamasā ca nararṣabha ।
krodhalobhau bhayaṃ darpa eteṣāṃ sādhanācchuciḥ ॥1॥
slp1: rajasA sADyate mohastamasA ca nararzaBa । kroDaloBO BayaM darpa etezAM sADanAcCuciH ॥1॥
author: gururuvāca ।

text: paramaṃ paramātmānaṃ devamakṣayamavyayam । viṣṇumavyaktasaṃsthānaṃ viśante devasattamam ॥2॥
html:
paramaṃ paramātmānaṃ devamakṣayamavyayam ।
viṣṇumavyaktasaṃsthānaṃ viśante devasattamam ॥2॥
slp1: paramaM paramAtmAnaM devamakzayamavyayam । vizRumavyaktasaMsTAnaM viSante devasattamam ॥2॥

text: tasya māyāvidagdhāṅgā jñānabhraṣṭā nirāśiṣaḥ । mānavā jñānasammohāttataḥ kāmaṃ prayānti vai ॥3॥
html:
tasya māyāvidagdhāṅgā jñānabhraṣṭā nirāśiṣaḥ ।
mānavā jñānasammohāttataḥ kāmaṃ prayānti vai ॥3॥
slp1: tasya mAyAvidagDANgA jYAnaBrazwA nirASizaH । mAnavA jYAnasammohAttataH kAmaM prayAnti vE ॥3॥

text: kāmātkrodhamavāpyātha lobhamohau ca mānavāḥ । mānadarpādahaṅkāramahaṅkārāttataḥ kriyāḥ ॥4॥
html:
kāmātkrodhamavāpyātha lobhamohau ca mānavāḥ ।
mānadarpādahaṅkāramahaṅkārāttataḥ kriyāḥ ॥4॥
slp1: kAmAtkroDamavApyATa loBamohO ca mAnavAH । mAnadarpAdahaNkAramahaNkArAttataH kriyAH ॥4॥

text: kriyābhiḥ snehasaṃbandhaḥ snehācchokamanantaram । sukhaduḥkhasamārambhājjanmājanmakṛtakṣaṇāḥ ॥5॥
html:
kriyābhiḥ snehasaṃbandhaḥ snehācchokamanantaram ।
sukhaduḥkhasamārambhājjanmājanmakṛtakṣaṇāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: kriyABiH snehasaMbanDaH snehAcCokamanantaram । suKaduHKasamAramBAjjanmAjanmakftakzaRAH ॥5॥

text: janmato garbhavāsaṃ tu śukraśoṇitasambhavam । purīṣamūtravikledaśoṇitaprabhavāvilam ॥6॥
html:
janmato garbhavāsaṃ tu śukraśoṇitasambhavam ।
purīṣamūtravikledaśoṇitaprabhavāvilam ॥6॥
slp1: janmato garBavAsaM tu SukraSoRitasamBavam । purIzamUtravikledaSoRitapraBavAvilam ॥6॥

text: tṛṣṇābhibhūtastairbaddhastānevābhipariplavan । saṃsāratantravāhinyastatra budhyeta yoṣitaḥ ॥7॥
html:
tṛṣṇābhibhūtastairbaddhastānevābhipariplavan ।
saṃsāratantravāhinyastatra budhyeta yoṣitaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: tfzRABiBUtastErbadDastAnevABipariplavan । saMsAratantravAhinyastatra buDyeta yozitaH ॥7॥

text: prakṛtyā kṣetrabhūtāstā narāḥ kṣetrajñalakṣaṇāḥ । tasmādetā viśeṣeṇa naro'tīyurvipaścitaḥ ॥8॥
html:
prakṛtyā kṣetrabhūtāstā narāḥ kṣetrajñalakṣaṇāḥ ।
tasmādetā viśeṣeṇa naro'tīyurvipaścitaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: prakftyA kzetraBUtAstA narAH kzetrajYalakzaRAH । tasmAdetA viSezeRa naro'tIyurvipaScitaH ॥8॥

text: kṛtyā hyetā ghorarūpā mohayantyavicakṣaṇān । rajasyantarhitā mūrtirindriyāṇāṃ sanātanī ॥9॥
html:
kṛtyā hyetā ghorarūpā mohayantyavicakṣaṇān ।
rajasyantarhitā mūrtirindriyāṇāṃ sanātanī ॥9॥
slp1: kftyA hyetA GorarUpA mohayantyavicakzaRAn । rajasyantarhitA mUrtirindriyARAM sanAtanI ॥9॥

text: tasmāttarṣātmakādrāgādbījājjāyanti jantavaḥ । svadehajānasvasañjñānyadvadaṅgātkṛmīṃstyajet । svasañjñānasvajāṃstadvatsutasañjñānkṛmīṃstyajet ॥10॥
html:
tasmāttarṣātmakādrāgādbījājjāyanti jantavaḥ ।
svadehajānasvasañjñānyadvadaṅgātkṛmīṃstyajet ।
svasañjñānasvajāṃstadvatsutasañjñānkṛmīṃstyajet ॥10॥
slp1: tasmAttarzAtmakAdrAgAdbIjAjjAyanti jantavaH । svadehajAnasvasaYjYAnyadvadaNgAtkfmIMstyajet । svasaYjYAnasvajAMstadvatsutasaYjYAnkfmIMstyajet ॥10॥

text: śukrato rasataścaiva snehājjāyanti jantavaḥ । svabhāvātkarmayogādvā tānupekṣeta buddhimān ॥11॥
html:
śukrato rasataścaiva snehājjāyanti jantavaḥ ।
svabhāvātkarmayogādvā tānupekṣeta buddhimān ॥11॥
slp1: Sukrato rasataScEva snehAjjAyanti jantavaH । svaBAvAtkarmayogAdvA tAnupekzeta budDimAn ॥11॥

text: rajastamasi paryastaṃ sattvaṃ tamasi saṃsthitam । jñānādhiṣṭhānamajñānaṃ buddhyahaṅkāralakṣaṇam ॥12॥
html:
rajastamasi paryastaṃ sattvaṃ tamasi saṃsthitam ।
jñānādhiṣṭhānamajñānaṃ buddhyahaṅkāralakṣaṇam ॥12॥
slp1: rajastamasi paryastaM sattvaM tamasi saMsTitam । jYAnADizWAnamajYAnaM budDyahaNkAralakzaRam ॥12॥

text: tadbījaṃ dehināmāhustadbījaṃ jīvasañjñitam । karmaṇā kālayuktena saṃsāraparivartakam ॥13॥
html:
tadbījaṃ dehināmāhustadbījaṃ jīvasañjñitam ।
karmaṇā kālayuktena saṃsāraparivartakam ॥13॥
slp1: tadbIjaM dehinAmAhustadbIjaM jIvasaYjYitam । karmaRA kAlayuktena saMsAraparivartakam ॥13॥

text: ramatyayaṃ yathā svapne manasā dehavāniva । karmagarbhairguṇairdehī garbhe tadupapadyate ॥14॥
html:
ramatyayaṃ yathā svapne manasā dehavāniva ।
karmagarbhairguṇairdehī garbhe tadupapadyate ॥14॥
slp1: ramatyayaM yaTA svapne manasA dehavAniva । karmagarBErguRErdehI garBe tadupapadyate ॥14॥

text: karmaṇā bījabhūtena codyate yadyadindriyam । jāyate tadahaṅkārādrāgayuktena cetasā ॥15॥
html:
karmaṇā bījabhūtena codyate yadyadindriyam ।
jāyate tadahaṅkārādrāgayuktena cetasā ॥15॥
slp1: karmaRA bIjaBUtena codyate yadyadindriyam । jAyate tadahaNkArAdrAgayuktena cetasA ॥15॥

text: śabdarāgācchrotramasya jāyate bhāvitātmanaḥ । rūparāgāttathā cakṣurghrāṇaṃ gandhacikīrṣayā ॥16॥
html:
śabdarāgācchrotramasya jāyate bhāvitātmanaḥ ।
rūparāgāttathā cakṣurghrāṇaṃ gandhacikīrṣayā ॥16॥
slp1: SabdarAgAcCrotramasya jAyate BAvitAtmanaH । rUparAgAttaTA cakzurGrARaM ganDacikIrzayA ॥16॥

text: sparśanebhyastathā vāyuḥ prāṇāpānavyapāśrayaḥ । vyānodānau samānaśca pañcadhā dehayāpanā ॥17॥
html:
sparśanebhyastathā vāyuḥ prāṇāpānavyapāśrayaḥ ।
vyānodānau samānaśca pañcadhā dehayāpanā ॥17॥
slp1: sparSaneByastaTA vAyuH prARApAnavyapASrayaH । vyAnodAnO samAnaSca paYcaDA dehayApanA ॥17॥

text: sañjātairjāyate gātraiḥ karmajairbrahmaṇā vṛtaḥ । duḥkhādyantairduḥkhamadhyairnaraḥ śārīramānasaiḥ ॥18॥
html:
sañjātairjāyate gātraiḥ karmajairbrahmaṇā vṛtaḥ ।
duḥkhādyantairduḥkhamadhyairnaraḥ śārīramānasaiḥ ॥18॥
slp1: saYjAtErjAyate gAtrEH karmajErbrahmaRA vftaH । duHKAdyantErduHKamaDyErnaraH SArIramAnasEH ॥18॥

text: duḥkhaṃ vidyādupādānādabhimānācca vardhate । tyāgāttebhyo nirodhaḥ syānnirodhajño vimucyate ॥19॥
html:
duḥkhaṃ vidyādupādānādabhimānācca vardhate ।
tyāgāttebhyo nirodhaḥ syānnirodhajño vimucyate ॥19॥
slp1: duHKaM vidyAdupAdAnAdaBimAnAcca varDate । tyAgAtteByo niroDaH syAnniroDajYo vimucyate ॥19॥

text: indriyāṇāṃ rajasyeva prabhavapralayāvubhau । parīkṣya sañcaredvidvānyathāvacchāstracakṣuṣā ॥20॥
html:
indriyāṇāṃ rajasyeva prabhavapralayāvubhau ।
parīkṣya sañcaredvidvānyathāvacchāstracakṣuṣā ॥20॥
slp1: indriyARAM rajasyeva praBavapralayAvuBO । parIkzya saYcaredvidvAnyaTAvacCAstracakzuzA ॥20॥

text: jñānendriyāṇīndriyārthānnopasarpantyatarṣulam । jñātaiśca kāraṇairdehī na dehaṃ punararhati] ॥21॥
html:
jñānendriyāṇīndriyārthānnopasarpantyatarṣulam ।
jñātaiśca kāraṇairdehī na dehaṃ punararhati] ॥21॥
slp1: jYAnendriyARIndriyArTAnnopasarpantyatarzulam । jYAtESca kAraRErdehI na dehaM punararhati] ॥21॥

text: atropāyaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvacchāstracakṣuṣā । tadvijñānāccaranprājñaḥ prāpnuyātparamāṃ gatim ॥1॥
html:
atropāyaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvacchāstracakṣuṣā ।
tadvijñānāccaranprājñaḥ prāpnuyātparamāṃ gatim ॥1॥

tāneva ca yathā dasyūnkṣiptvā gacchecchivāṃ diśam ।
tathā rajastamaḥkarmāṇyutsṛjya prāpnuyātsukham ॥14॥
slp1: tAneva ca yaTA dasyUnkziptvA gacCecCivAM diSam । taTA rajastamaHkarmARyutsfjya prApnuyAtsuKam ॥14॥

text: niḥsandigdhamanīho vai muktaḥ sarvaparigrahaiḥ । viviktacārī laghvāśī tapasvī niyatendriyaḥ ॥15॥
html:
niḥsandigdhamanīho vai muktaḥ sarvaparigrahaiḥ ।
viviktacārī laghvāśī tapasvī niyatendriyaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: niHsandigDamanIho vE muktaH sarvaparigrahEH । viviktacArI laGvASI tapasvI niyatendriyaH ॥15॥

text: jñānadagdhaparikleśaḥ prayogaratirātmavān । niṣpracāreṇa manasā paraṃ tadadhigacchati ॥16॥
html:
jñānadagdhaparikleśaḥ prayogaratirātmavān ।
niṣpracāreṇa manasā paraṃ tadadhigacchati ॥16॥
slp1: jYAnadagDaparikleSaH prayogaratirAtmavAn । nizpracAreRa manasA paraM tadaDigacCati ॥16॥

text: dhṛtimānātmavānbuddhiṃ nigṛhṇīyādasaṃśayam । mano buddhyā nigṛhṇīyādviṣayānmanasātmanaḥ ॥17॥
html:
dhṛtimānātmavānbuddhiṃ nigṛhṇīyādasaṃśayam ।
mano buddhyā nigṛhṇīyādviṣayānmanasātmanaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: DftimAnAtmavAnbudDiM nigfhRIyAdasaMSayam । mano budDyA nigfhRIyAdvizayAnmanasAtmanaH ॥17॥

text: nigṛhītendriyasyāsya kurvāṇasya mano vaśe । devatāstāḥ prakāśante hṛṣṭā yānti tamīśvaram ॥18॥
html:
nigṛhītendriyasyāsya kurvāṇasya mano vaśe ।
devatāstāḥ prakāśante hṛṣṭā yānti tamīśvaram ॥18॥
slp1: nigfhItendriyasyAsya kurvARasya mano vaSe । devatAstAH prakASante hfzwA yAnti tamISvaram ॥18॥

text: tābhiḥ saṃsaktamanaso brahmavatsamprakāśate । etaiścāpagataiḥ sarvairbrahmabhūyāya kalpate ॥19॥
html:
tābhiḥ saṃsaktamanaso brahmavatsamprakāśate ।
etaiścāpagataiḥ sarvairbrahmabhūyāya kalpate ॥19॥
slp1: tABiH saMsaktamanaso brahmavatsamprakASate । etEScApagatEH sarvErbrahmaBUyAya kalpate ॥19॥

text: atha vā na pravarteta yogatantrairupakramet । yena tantramayaṃ tantraṃ vṛttiḥ syāttattadācaret ॥20॥
html:
atha vā na pravarteta yogatantrairupakramet ।
yena tantramayaṃ tantraṃ vṛttiḥ syāttattadācaret ॥20॥
slp1: aTa vA na pravarteta yogatantrErupakramet । yena tantramayaM tantraM vfttiH syAttattadAcaret ॥20॥

text: kaṇapiṇyākakulmāṣaśākayāvakasaktavaḥ । tathā mūlaphalaṃ bhaikṣaṃ paryāyeṇopayojayet ॥21॥
html:
kaṇapiṇyākakulmāṣaśākayāvakasaktavaḥ ।
tathā mūlaphalaṃ bhaikṣaṃ paryāyeṇopayojayet ॥21॥
slp1: kaRapiRyAkakulmAzaSAkayAvakasaktavaH । taTA mUlaPalaM BEkzaM paryAyeRopayojayet ॥21॥

text: āhāraṃ niyataṃ caiva deśe kāle ca sāttvikam । tatparīkṣyānuvarteta yatpravṛttyanuvartakam ॥22॥
html:
āhāraṃ niyataṃ caiva deśe kāle ca sāttvikam ।
tatparīkṣyānuvarteta yatpravṛttyanuvartakam ॥22॥
slp1: AhAraM niyataM cEva deSe kAle ca sAttvikam । tatparIkzyAnuvarteta yatpravfttyanuvartakam ॥22॥

text: pravṛttaṃ noparundheta śanairagnimivendhayet । jñānendhitaṃ tato jñānamarkavatsamprakāśate ॥23॥
html:
pravṛttaṃ noparundheta śanairagnimivendhayet ।
jñānendhitaṃ tato jñānamarkavatsamprakāśate ॥23॥
slp1: pravfttaM noparunDeta SanEragnimivenDayet । jYAnenDitaM tato jYAnamarkavatsamprakASate ॥23॥

text: jñānādhiṣṭhānamajñānaṃ trīṁllokānadhitiṣṭhati । vijñānānugataṃ jñānamajñānādapakṛṣyate ॥24॥
html:
jñānādhiṣṭhānamajñānaṃ trīṁllokānadhitiṣṭhati ।
vijñānānugataṃ jñānamajñānādapakṛṣyate ॥24॥
slp1: jYAnADizWAnamajYAnaM trIṁllokAnaDitizWati । vijYAnAnugataM jYAnamajYAnAdapakfzyate ॥24॥

text: pṛthaktvātsamprayogācca nāsūyurveda śāśvatam । sa tayorapavargajño vītarāgo vimucyate ॥25॥
html:
pṛthaktvātsamprayogācca nāsūyurveda śāśvatam ।
sa tayorapavargajño vītarāgo vimucyate ॥25॥
slp1: pfTaktvAtsamprayogAcca nAsUyurveda SASvatam । sa tayorapavargajYo vItarAgo vimucyate ॥25॥

text: vayotīto jarāmṛtyū jitvā brahma sanātanam । amṛtaṃ tadavāpnoti yattadakṣaramavyayam] ॥26॥
html:
vayotīto jarāmṛtyū jitvā brahma sanātanam ।
amṛtaṃ tadavāpnoti yattadakṣaramavyayam] ॥26॥
slp1: vayotIto jarAmftyU jitvA brahma sanAtanam । amftaM tadavApnoti yattadakzaramavyayam] ॥26॥

text: niṣkalmaṣaṃ brahmacaryamicchatā carituṃ sadā । nidrā sarvātmanā tyājyā svapnadoṣānavekṣatā ॥1॥
html:
niṣkalmaṣaṃ brahmacaryamicchatā carituṃ sadā ।
nidrā sarvātmanā tyājyā svapnadoṣānavekṣatā ॥1॥
slp1: nizkalmazaM brahmacaryamicCatA carituM sadA । nidrA sarvAtmanA tyAjyA svapnadozAnavekzatA ॥1॥
author: gururuvāca ।

text: svapne hi rajasā dehī tamasā cābhibhūyate । dehāntaramivāpannaścaratyapagatasmṛtiḥ ॥2॥
html:
svapne hi rajasā dehī tamasā cābhibhūyate ।
dehāntaramivāpannaścaratyapagatasmṛtiḥ ॥2॥
slp1: svapne hi rajasA dehI tamasA cABiBUyate । dehAntaramivApannaScaratyapagatasmftiH ॥2॥

text: jñānābhyāsājjāgarato jijñāsārthamanantaram । vijñānābhiniveśāttu jāgaratyaniśaṃ sadā ॥3॥
html:
jñānābhyāsājjāgarato jijñāsārthamanantaram ।
vijñānābhiniveśāttu jāgaratyaniśaṃ sadā ॥3॥
slp1: jYAnAByAsAjjAgarato jijYAsArTamanantaram । vijYAnABiniveSAttu jAgaratyaniSaM sadA ॥3॥

text: atrāha ko nvayaṃ bhāvaḥ svapne viṣayavāniva । pralīnairindriyairdehī vartate dehavāniva ॥4॥
html:
atrāha ko nvayaṃ bhāvaḥ svapne viṣayavāniva ।
pralīnairindriyairdehī vartate dehavāniva ॥4॥
slp1: atrAha ko nvayaM BAvaH svapne vizayavAniva । pralInErindriyErdehI vartate dehavAniva ॥4॥

text: atrocyate yathā hyetadveda yogeśvaro hariḥ । tathaitadupapannārthaṃ varṇayanti maharṣayaḥ ॥5॥
html:
atrocyate yathā hyetadveda yogeśvaro hariḥ ।
tathaitadupapannārthaṃ varṇayanti maharṣayaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: atrocyate yaTA hyetadveda yogeSvaro hariH । taTEtadupapannArTaM varRayanti maharzayaH ॥5॥

text: indriyāṇāṃ śramātsvapnamāhuḥ sarvagataṃ budhāḥ । manasastu pralīnatvāttattadāhurnidarśanam ॥6॥
html:
indriyāṇāṃ śramātsvapnamāhuḥ sarvagataṃ budhāḥ ।
manasastu pralīnatvāttattadāhurnidarśanam ॥6॥
slp1: indriyARAM SramAtsvapnamAhuH sarvagataM buDAH । manasastu pralInatvAttattadAhurnidarSanam ॥6॥

text: kāryavyāsaktamanasaḥ saṅkalpo jāgrato hyapi । yadvanmanorathaiśvaryaṃ svapne tadvanmanogatam ॥7॥
html:
kāryavyāsaktamanasaḥ saṅkalpo jāgrato hyapi ।
yadvanmanorathaiśvaryaṃ svapne tadvanmanogatam ॥7॥
slp1: kAryavyAsaktamanasaH saNkalpo jAgrato hyapi । yadvanmanoraTESvaryaM svapne tadvanmanogatam ॥7॥

text: saṃsārāṇāmasaṅkhyānāṃ kāmātmā tadavāpnuyāt । manasyantarhitaṃ sarvaṃ veda sottamapūruṣaḥ ॥8॥
html:
saṃsārāṇāmasaṅkhyānāṃ kāmātmā tadavāpnuyāt ।
manasyantarhitaṃ sarvaṃ veda sottamapūruṣaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: saMsArARAmasaNKyAnAM kAmAtmA tadavApnuyAt । manasyantarhitaM sarvaM veda sottamapUruzaH ॥8॥

text: guṇānāmapi yadyattatkarma jānātyupasthitam । tattacchaṃsanti bhūtāni mano yadbhāvitaṃ yathā ॥9॥
html:
guṇānāmapi yadyattatkarma jānātyupasthitam ।
tattacchaṃsanti bhūtāni mano yadbhāvitaṃ yathā ॥9॥
slp1: guRAnAmapi yadyattatkarma jAnAtyupasTitam । tattacCaMsanti BUtAni mano yadBAvitaM yaTA ॥9॥

text: tatastamupavartante guṇā rājasatāmasāḥ । sāttviko vā yathāyogamānantaryaphalodayaḥ ॥10॥
html:
tatastamupavartante guṇā rājasatāmasāḥ ।
sāttviko vā yathāyogamānantaryaphalodayaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: tatastamupavartante guRA rAjasatAmasAH । sAttviko vA yaTAyogamAnantaryaPalodayaH ॥10॥

text: tataḥ paśyatyasaṃbaddhānvātapittakaphottarān । rajastamobhavairbhāvaistadapyāhurduranvayam ॥11॥
html:
tataḥ paśyatyasaṃbaddhānvātapittakaphottarān ।
rajastamobhavairbhāvaistadapyāhurduranvayam ॥11॥
slp1: tataH paSyatyasaMbadDAnvAtapittakaPottarAn । rajastamoBavErBAvEstadapyAhurduranvayam ॥11॥

text: prasannairindriyairyadyatsaṅkalpayati mānasam । tattatsvapne'pyuparate manodṛṣṭirnirīkṣate ॥12॥
html:
prasannairindriyairyadyatsaṅkalpayati mānasam ।
tattatsvapne'pyuparate manodṛṣṭirnirīkṣate ॥12॥
slp1: prasannErindriyEryadyatsaNkalpayati mAnasam । tattatsvapne'pyuparate manodfzwirnirIkzate ॥12॥

text: vyāpakaṃ sarvabhūteṣu vartate'pratighaṃ manaḥ । manasyantarhitaṃ dvāraṃ dehamāsthāya mānasam ॥13॥
html:
vyāpakaṃ sarvabhūteṣu vartate'pratighaṃ manaḥ ।
manasyantarhitaṃ dvāraṃ dehamāsthāya mānasam ॥13॥
slp1: vyApakaM sarvaBUtezu vartate'pratiGaM manaH । manasyantarhitaM dvAraM dehamAsTAya mAnasam ॥13॥

text: yattatsadasadavyaktaṃ svapityasminnidarśanam । sarvabhūtātmabhūtasthaṃ tadadhyātmaguṇaṃ viduḥ ॥14॥
html:
yattatsadasadavyaktaṃ svapityasminnidarśanam ।
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasthaṃ tadadhyātmaguṇaṃ viduḥ ॥14॥
slp1: yattatsadasadavyaktaM svapityasminnidarSanam । sarvaBUtAtmaBUtasTaM tadaDyAtmaguRaM viduH ॥14॥

text: lipseta manasā yaśca saṅkalpādaiśvaraṃ guṇam । ātmaprabhāvāttaṃ vidyātsarvā hyātmani devatāḥ ॥15॥
html:
lipseta manasā yaśca saṅkalpādaiśvaraṃ guṇam ।
ātmaprabhāvāttaṃ vidyātsarvā hyātmani devatāḥ ॥15॥
slp1: lipseta manasA yaSca saNkalpAdESvaraM guRam । AtmapraBAvAttaM vidyAtsarvA hyAtmani devatAH ॥15॥

text: evaṃ hi tapasā yuktamarkavattamasaḥ param । trailokyaprakṛtirdehī tapasā taṃ maheśvaram ॥16॥
html:
evaṃ hi tapasā yuktamarkavattamasaḥ param ।
trailokyaprakṛtirdehī tapasā taṃ maheśvaram ॥16॥
slp1: evaM hi tapasA yuktamarkavattamasaH param । trElokyaprakftirdehI tapasA taM maheSvaram ॥16॥

text: tapo hyadhiṣṭhitaṃ devaistapoghnamasuraistamaḥ । etaddevāsurairguptaṃ tadāhurjñānalakṣaṇam ॥17॥
html:
tapo hyadhiṣṭhitaṃ devaistapoghnamasuraistamaḥ ।
etaddevāsurairguptaṃ tadāhurjñānalakṣaṇam ॥17॥
slp1: tapo hyaDizWitaM devEstapoGnamasurEstamaH । etaddevAsurErguptaM tadAhurjYAnalakzaRam ॥17॥

text: sattvaṃ rajastamaśceti devāsuraguṇānviduḥ । sattvaṃ devaguṇaṃ vidyāditarāvāsurau guṇau ॥18॥
html:
sattvaṃ rajastamaśceti devāsuraguṇānviduḥ ।
sattvaṃ devaguṇaṃ vidyāditarāvāsurau guṇau ॥18॥
slp1: sattvaM rajastamaSceti devAsuraguRAnviduH । sattvaM devaguRaM vidyAditarAvAsurO guRO ॥18॥

text: brahma tatparamaṃ vedyamamṛtaṃ jyotirakṣaram । ye vidurbhāvitātmānaste yānti paramāṃ gatim ॥19॥
html:
brahma tatparamaṃ vedyamamṛtaṃ jyotirakṣaram ।
ye vidurbhāvitātmānaste yānti paramāṃ gatim ॥19॥
slp1: brahma tatparamaM vedyamamftaM jyotirakzaram । ye vidurBAvitAtmAnaste yAnti paramAM gatim ॥19॥

text: hetumacchakyamākhyātumetāvajjñānacakṣuṣā । pratyāhāreṇa vā śakyamavyaktaṃ brahma veditum] ॥20॥
html:
hetumacchakyamākhyātumetāvajjñānacakṣuṣā ।
pratyāhāreṇa vā śakyamavyaktaṃ brahma veditum] ॥20॥
slp1: hetumacCakyamAKyAtumetAvajjYAnacakzuzA । pratyAhAreRa vA SakyamavyaktaM brahma veditum] ॥20॥

text: na sa veda paraṃ dharmaṃ yo na veda catuṣṭayam । vyaktāvyakte ca yattattvaṃ saṃprāptaṃ paramarṣiṇā ॥1॥
html:
na sa veda paraṃ dharmaṃ yo na veda catuṣṭayam ।
vyaktāvyakte ca yattattvaṃ saṃprāptaṃ paramarṣiṇā ॥1॥
slp1: na sa veda paraM DarmaM yo na veda catuzwayam । vyaktAvyakte ca yattattvaM saMprAptaM paramarziRA ॥1॥
author: gururuvāca ।

text: vyaktaṃ mṛtyumukhaṃ vidyādavyaktamamṛtaṃ padam । pravṛttilakṣaṇaṃ dharmamṛṣirnārāyaṇo'bravīt ॥2॥
html:
vyaktaṃ mṛtyumukhaṃ vidyādavyaktamamṛtaṃ padam ।
pravṛttilakṣaṇaṃ dharmamṛṣirnārāyaṇo'bravīt ॥2॥
slp1: vyaktaM mftyumuKaM vidyAdavyaktamamftaM padam । pravfttilakzaRaM DarmamfzirnArAyaRo'bravIt ॥2॥

text: atraivāvasthitaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram । nivṛttilakṣaṇaṃ dharmamavyaktaṃ brahma śāśvatam ॥3॥
html:
atraivāvasthitaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram ।
nivṛttilakṣaṇaṃ dharmamavyaktaṃ brahma śāśvatam ॥3॥
slp1: atrEvAvasTitaM sarvaM trElokyaM sacarAcaram । nivfttilakzaRaM DarmamavyaktaM brahma SASvatam ॥3॥

text: pravṛttilakṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ prajāpatirathābravīt । pravṛttiḥ punarāvṛttirnivṛttiḥ paramā gatiḥ ॥4॥
html:
pravṛttilakṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ prajāpatirathābravīt ।
pravṛttiḥ punarāvṛttirnivṛttiḥ paramā gatiḥ ॥4॥
slp1: pravfttilakzaRaM DarmaM prajApatiraTAbravIt । pravfttiH punarAvfttirnivfttiH paramA gatiH ॥4॥

text: tāṃ gatiṃ paramāmeti nivṛttiparamo muniḥ । jñānatattvaparo nityaṃ śubhāśubhanidarśakaḥ ॥5॥
html:
tāṃ gatiṃ paramāmeti nivṛttiparamo muniḥ ।
jñānatattvaparo nityaṃ śubhāśubhanidarśakaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: tAM gatiM paramAmeti nivfttiparamo muniH । jYAnatattvaparo nityaM SuBASuBanidarSakaH ॥5॥

text: tadevametau vijñeyāvavyaktapuruṣāvubhau । avyaktapuruṣābhyāṃ tu yatsyādanyanmahattaram ॥6॥
html:
tadevametau vijñeyāvavyaktapuruṣāvubhau ।
avyaktapuruṣābhyāṃ tu yatsyādanyanmahattaram ॥6॥
slp1: tadevametO vijYeyAvavyaktapuruzAvuBO । avyaktapuruzAByAM tu yatsyAdanyanmahattaram ॥6॥

text: taṃ viśeṣamavekṣeta viśeṣeṇa vicakṣaṇaḥ । anādyantāvubhāvetāvaliṅgau cāpyubhāvapi ॥7॥
html:
taṃ viśeṣamavekṣeta viśeṣeṇa vicakṣaṇaḥ ।
anādyantāvubhāvetāvaliṅgau cāpyubhāvapi ॥7॥
slp1: taM viSezamavekzeta viSezeRa vicakzaRaH । anAdyantAvuBAvetAvaliNgO cApyuBAvapi ॥7॥

text: ubhau nityau sūkṣmatarau mahadbhyaśca mahattarau । sāmānyametadubhayorevaṃ hyanyadviśeṣaṇam ॥8॥
html:
ubhau nityau sūkṣmatarau mahadbhyaśca mahattarau ।
sāmānyametadubhayorevaṃ hyanyadviśeṣaṇam ॥8॥
slp1: uBO nityO sUkzmatarO mahadByaSca mahattarO । sAmAnyametaduBayorevaM hyanyadviSezaRam ॥8॥

text: prakṛtyā sargadharmiṇyā tathā trividhasattvayā । viparītamato vidyātkṣetrajñasya ca lakṣaṇam ॥9॥
html:
prakṛtyā sargadharmiṇyā tathā trividhasattvayā ।
viparītamato vidyātkṣetrajñasya ca lakṣaṇam ॥9॥
slp1: prakftyA sargaDarmiRyA taTA triviDasattvayA । viparItamato vidyAtkzetrajYasya ca lakzaRam ॥9॥

text: prakṛteśca vikārāṇāṃ draṣṭāramaguṇānvitam । agrāhyau puruṣāvetāvaliṅgatvādasaṃhitau ॥10॥
html:
prakṛteśca vikārāṇāṃ draṣṭāramaguṇānvitam ।
agrāhyau puruṣāvetāvaliṅgatvādasaṃhitau ॥10॥
slp1: prakfteSca vikArARAM drazwAramaguRAnvitam । agrAhyO puruzAvetAvaliNgatvAdasaMhitO ॥10॥

text: saṃyogalakṣaṇotpattiḥ karmajā gṛhyate yayā । karaṇaiḥ karmanirvṛttaiḥ kartā yadyadviceṣṭate । kīrtyate śabdasañjñābhiḥ ko'hameṣo'pyasāviti ॥11॥
html:
saṃyogalakṣaṇotpattiḥ karmajā gṛhyate yayā ।
karaṇaiḥ karmanirvṛttaiḥ kartā yadyadviceṣṭate ।
kīrtyate śabdasañjñābhiḥ ko'hameṣo'pyasāviti ॥11॥
slp1: saMyogalakzaRotpattiH karmajA gfhyate yayA । karaREH karmanirvfttEH kartA yadyadvicezwate । kIrtyate SabdasaYjYABiH ko'hamezo'pyasAviti ॥11॥

text: uṣṇīṣavānyathā vastraistribhirbhavati saṃvṛtaḥ । saṃvṛto'yaṃ tathā dehī sattvarājasatāmasaiḥ ॥12॥
html:
uṣṇīṣavānyathā vastraistribhirbhavati saṃvṛtaḥ ।
saṃvṛto'yaṃ tathā dehī sattvarājasatāmasaiḥ ॥12॥
slp1: uzRIzavAnyaTA vastrEstriBirBavati saMvftaH । saMvfto'yaM taTA dehI sattvarAjasatAmasEH ॥12॥

text: tasmāccatuṣṭayaṃ vedyametairhetubhirācitam । yathāsañjño hyayaṃ samyagantakāle na muhyati ॥13॥
html:

slp1: tasmAccatuzwayaM vedyametErhetuBirAcitam । yaTAsaYjYo hyayaM samyagantakAle na muhyati ॥13॥

text: śriyaṃ divyāmabhiprepsurbrahma vāṅmanasā śuciḥ । śārīrairniyamairugraiścarenniṣkalmaṣaṃ tapaḥ ॥14॥
html:

śārīrairniyamairugraiścarenniṣkalmaṣaṃ tapaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: SriyaM divyAmaBiprepsurbrahma vANmanasA SuciH । SArIrErniyamErugrEScarennizkalmazaM tapaH ॥14॥

text: trailokyaṃ tapasā vyāptamantarbhūtena bhāsvatā । sūryaśca candramāścaiva bhāsatastapasā divi ॥15॥
html:
trailokyaṃ tapasā vyāptamantarbhūtena bhāsvatā ।
sūryaśca candramāścaiva bhāsatastapasā divi ॥15॥
slp1: trElokyaM tapasA vyAptamantarBUtena BAsvatA । sUryaSca candramAScEva BAsatastapasA divi ॥15॥

text: pratāpastapaso jñānaṃ loke saṃśabditaṃ tapaḥ । rajastamoghnaṃ yatkarma tapasastatsvalakṣaṇam ॥16॥
html:
pratāpastapaso jñānaṃ loke saṃśabditaṃ tapaḥ ।
rajastamoghnaṃ yatkarma tapasastatsvalakṣaṇam ॥16॥
slp1: pratApastapaso jYAnaM loke saMSabditaM tapaH । rajastamoGnaM yatkarma tapasastatsvalakzaRam ॥16॥

text: brahmacaryamahiṃsā ca śārīraṃ tapa ucyate । vāṅmanoniyamaḥ sāmyaṃ mānasaṃ tapa ucyate ॥17॥
html:
brahmacaryamahiṃsā ca śārīraṃ tapa ucyate ।
vāṅmanoniyamaḥ sāmyaṃ mānasaṃ tapa ucyate ॥17॥
slp1: brahmacaryamahiMsA ca SArIraM tapa ucyate । vANmanoniyamaH sAmyaM mAnasaM tapa ucyate ॥17॥

text: vidhijñebhyo dvijātibhyo grāhyamannaṃ viśiṣyate । āhāraniyamenāsya pāpmā naśyati rājasaḥ ॥18॥
html:
vidhijñebhyo dvijātibhyo grāhyamannaṃ viśiṣyate ।
āhāraniyamenāsya pāpmā naśyati rājasaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: viDijYeByo dvijAtiByo grAhyamannaM viSizyate । AhAraniyamenAsya pApmA naSyati rAjasaH ॥18॥

text: vaimanasyaṃ ca viṣaye yāntyasya karaṇāni ca । tasmāttanmātramādadyādyāvadatra prayojanam ॥19॥
html:
vaimanasyaṃ ca viṣaye yāntyasya karaṇāni ca ।
tasmāttanmātramādadyādyāvadatra prayojanam ॥19॥
slp1: vEmanasyaM ca vizaye yAntyasya karaRAni ca । tasmAttanmAtramAdadyAdyAvadatra prayojanam ॥19॥

text: antakāle vayotkarṣācchanaiḥ kuryādanāturaḥ । evaṃ yuktena manasā jñānaṃ tadupapadyate ॥20॥
html:
antakāle vayotkarṣācchanaiḥ kuryādanāturaḥ ।
evaṃ yuktena manasā jñānaṃ tadupapadyate ॥20॥
slp1: antakAle vayotkarzAcCanEH kuryAdanAturaH । evaM yuktena manasA jYAnaM tadupapadyate ॥20॥

text: rajasā cāpyayaṃ dehī dehavāñśabdavaccaret । kāryairavyāhatamatirvairāgyātprakṛtau sthitaḥ । ā dehādapramādācca dehāntādvipramucyate ॥21॥
html:
rajasā cāpyayaṃ dehī dehavāñśabdavaccaret ।
kāryairavyāhatamatirvairāgyātprakṛtau sthitaḥ ।
ā dehādapramādācca dehāntādvipramucyate ॥21॥
slp1: rajasA cApyayaM dehI dehavAYSabdavaccaret । kAryEravyAhatamatirvErAgyAtprakftO sTitaH । A dehAdapramAdAcca dehAntAdvipramucyate ॥21॥

text: hetuyuktaḥ sadotsargo bhūtānāṃ pralayastathā । parapratyayasarge tu niyataṃ nātivartate ॥22॥
html:
hetuyuktaḥ sadotsargo bhūtānāṃ pralayastathā ।
parapratyayasarge tu niyataṃ nātivartate ॥22॥
slp1: hetuyuktaH sadotsargo BUtAnAM pralayastaTA । parapratyayasarge tu niyataM nAtivartate ॥22॥

text: bhavāntaprabhavaprajñā āsate ye viparyayam । dhṛtyā dehāndhārayanto buddhisaṅkṣiptamānasāḥ । sthānebhyo dhvaṃsamānāśca sūkṣmatvāttānupāsate ॥23॥
html:
bhavāntaprabhavaprajñā āsate ye viparyayam ।
dhṛtyā dehāndhārayanto buddhisaṅkṣiptamānasāḥ ।
sthānebhyo dhvaṃsamānāśca sūkṣmatvāttānupāsate ॥23॥
slp1: BavAntapraBavaprajYA Asate ye viparyayam । DftyA dehAnDArayanto budDisaNkziptamAnasAH । sTAneByo DvaMsamAnASca sUkzmatvAttAnupAsate ॥23॥

text: yathāgamaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ buddhyā tannaiva budhyate । dehāntaṃ kaścidanvāste bhāvitātmā nirāśrayaḥ । yukto dhāraṇayā kaścitsattāṃ kecidupāsate ॥24॥
html:
yathāgamaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ buddhyā tannaiva budhyate ।
dehāntaṃ kaścidanvāste bhāvitātmā nirāśrayaḥ ।
yukto dhāraṇayā kaścitsattāṃ kecidupāsate ॥24॥
slp1: yaTAgamaM ca tatsarvaM budDyA tannEva buDyate । dehAntaM kaScidanvAste BAvitAtmA nirASrayaH । yukto DAraRayA kaScitsattAM kecidupAsate ॥24॥

text: abhyasyanti paraṃ devaṃ vidyutsaṃśabditākṣaram । antakāle hyupāsannāstapasā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ ॥25॥
html:
abhyasyanti paraṃ devaṃ vidyutsaṃśabditākṣaram ।
antakāle hyupāsannāstapasā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ ॥25॥
slp1: aByasyanti paraM devaM vidyutsaMSabditAkzaram । antakAle hyupAsannAstapasA dagDakilbizAH ॥25॥

text: sarva ete mahātmāno gacchanti paramāṃ gatim । sūkṣmaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ teṣāmavekṣecchāstracakṣuṣā ॥26॥
html:
sarva ete mahātmāno gacchanti paramāṃ gatim ।
sūkṣmaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ teṣāmavekṣecchāstracakṣuṣā ॥26॥
slp1: sarva ete mahAtmAno gacCanti paramAM gatim । sUkzmaM viSezaRaM tezAmavekzecCAstracakzuzA ॥26॥

text: dehaṃ tu paramaṃ vidyādvimuktamaparigraham । antarikṣādanyataraṃ dhāraṇāsaktamānasam ॥27॥
html:
dehaṃ tu paramaṃ vidyādvimuktamaparigraham ।
antarikṣādanyataraṃ dhāraṇāsaktamānasam ॥27॥
slp1: dehaM tu paramaM vidyAdvimuktamaparigraham । antarikzAdanyataraM DAraRAsaktamAnasam ॥27॥

text: martyalokādvimucyante vidyāsaṃyuktamānasāḥ । brahmabhūtā virajasastato yānti parāṃ gatim ॥28॥
html:
martyalokādvimucyante vidyāsaṃyuktamānasāḥ ।
brahmabhūtā virajasastato yānti parāṃ gatim ॥28॥
slp1: martyalokAdvimucyante vidyAsaMyuktamAnasAH । brahmaBUtA virajasastato yAnti parAM gatim ॥28॥

text: kaṣāyavarjitaṃ jñānaṃ yeṣāmutpadyate'calam । te yānti paramāṁllokānviśudhyanto yathābalam ॥29॥
html:
kaṣāyavarjitaṃ jñānaṃ yeṣāmutpadyate'calam ।
te yānti paramāṁllokānviśudhyanto yathābalam ॥29॥
slp1: kazAyavarjitaM jYAnaM yezAmutpadyate'calam । te yAnti paramAṁllokAnviSuDyanto yaTAbalam ॥29॥

text: bhagavantamajaṃ divyaṃ viṣṇumavyaktasañjñitam । bhāvena yānti śuddhā ye jñānatṛptā nirāśiṣaḥ ॥30॥
html:
bhagavantamajaṃ divyaṃ viṣṇumavyaktasañjñitam ।
bhāvena yānti śuddhā ye jñānatṛptā nirāśiṣaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: BagavantamajaM divyaM vizRumavyaktasaYjYitam । BAvena yAnti SudDA ye jYAnatfptA nirASizaH ॥30॥

text: jñātvātmasthaṃ hariṃ caiva nivartante na te'vyayāḥ । prāpya tatparamaṃ sthānaṃ modante'kṣaramavyayam ॥31॥
html:
jñātvātmasthaṃ hariṃ caiva nivartante na te'vyayāḥ ।
prāpya tatparamaṃ sthānaṃ modante'kṣaramavyayam ॥31॥
slp1: jYAtvAtmasTaM hariM cEva nivartante na te'vyayAH । prApya tatparamaM sTAnaM modante'kzaramavyayam ॥31॥

text: etāvadetadvijñānametadasti ca nāsti ca । tṛṣṇābaddhaṃ jagatsarvaṃ cakravatparivartate ॥32॥
html:
etāvadetadvijñānametadasti ca nāsti ca ।
tṛṣṇābaddhaṃ jagatsarvaṃ cakravatparivartate ॥32॥
slp1: etAvadetadvijYAnametadasti ca nAsti ca । tfzRAbadDaM jagatsarvaM cakravatparivartate ॥32॥

text: bisatanturyathaivāyamantaḥsthaḥ sarvato bise । tṛṣṇātanturanādyantastathā dehagataḥ sadā ॥33॥
html:
bisatanturyathaivāyamantaḥsthaḥ sarvato bise ।
tṛṣṇātanturanādyantastathā dehagataḥ sadā ॥33॥
slp1: bisatanturyaTEvAyamantaHsTaH sarvato bise । tfzRAtanturanAdyantastaTA dehagataH sadA ॥33॥

text: sūcyā sūtraṃ yathā vastre saṃsārayati vāyakaḥ । tadvatsaṃsārasūtraṃ hi tṛṣṇāsūcyā nibadhyate ॥34॥
html:
sūcyā sūtraṃ yathā vastre saṃsārayati vāyakaḥ ।
tadvatsaṃsārasūtraṃ hi tṛṣṇāsūcyā nibadhyate ॥34॥
slp1: sUcyA sUtraM yaTA vastre saMsArayati vAyakaH । tadvatsaMsArasUtraM hi tfzRAsUcyA nibaDyate ॥34॥

text: vikāraṃ prakṛtiṃ caiva puruṣaṃ ca sanātanam । yo yathāvadvijānāti sa vitṛṣṇo vimucyate ॥35॥
html:
vikāraṃ prakṛtiṃ caiva puruṣaṃ ca sanātanam ।
yo yathāvadvijānāti sa vitṛṣṇo vimucyate ॥35॥
slp1: vikAraM prakftiM cEva puruzaM ca sanAtanam । yo yaTAvadvijAnAti sa vitfzRo vimucyate ॥35॥

text: prakāśaṃ bhagavānetadṛṣirnārāyaṇo'mṛtam । bhūtānāmanukampārthaṃ jagāda jagato hitam] ॥36॥
html:
prakāśaṃ bhagavānetadṛṣirnārāyaṇo'mṛtam ।
bhūtānāmanukampārthaṃ jagāda jagato hitam] ॥36॥
slp1: prakASaM BagavAnetadfzirnArAyaRo'mftam । BUtAnAmanukampArTaM jagAda jagato hitam] ॥36॥

text: kena vṛttena vṛttajño janako mithilādhipaḥ । jagāma mokṣaṃ dharmajño bhogānutsṛjya mānuṣān ॥1॥
html:
kena vṛttena vṛttajño janako mithilādhipaḥ ।
jagāma mokṣaṃ dharmajño bhogānutsṛjya mānuṣān ॥1॥
slp1: kena vfttena vfttajYo janako miTilADipaH । jagAma mokzaM DarmajYo BogAnutsfjya mAnuzAn ॥1॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । yena vṛttena vṛttajñaḥ sa jagāma mahatsukham ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
yena vṛttena vṛttajñaḥ sa jagāma mahatsukham ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । yena vfttena vfttajYaH sa jagAma mahatsuKam ॥2॥
