text: janako janadevastu mithilāyāṃ janādhipaḥ । aurdhvadehikadharmāṇāmāsīdyukto vicintane ॥3॥
html:
janako janadevastu mithilāyāṃ janādhipaḥ ।
aurdhvadehikadharmāṇāmāsīdyukto vicintane ॥3॥
slp1: janako janadevastu miTilAyAM janADipaH । OrDvadehikaDarmARAmAsIdyukto vicintane ॥3॥

text: tasya sma śatamācāryā vasanti satataṃ gṛhe । darśayantaḥ pṛthagdharmānnānāpāṣaṇḍavādinaḥ ॥4॥
html:
tasya sma śatamācāryā vasanti satataṃ gṛhe ।
darśayantaḥ pṛthagdharmānnānāpāṣaṇḍavādinaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: tasya sma SatamAcAryA vasanti satataM gfhe । darSayantaH pfTagDarmAnnAnApAzaRqavAdinaH ॥4॥

text: sa teṣāṃ pretyabhāve ca pretyajātau viniścaye । āgamasthaḥ sa bhūyiṣṭhamātmatattve na tuṣyati ॥5॥
html:
sa teṣāṃ pretyabhāve ca pretyajātau viniścaye ।
āgamasthaḥ sa bhūyiṣṭhamātmatattve na tuṣyati ॥5॥
slp1: sa tezAM pretyaBAve ca pretyajAtO viniScaye । AgamasTaH sa BUyizWamAtmatattve na tuzyati ॥5॥

text: tatra pañcaśikho nāma kāpileyo mahāmuniḥ । paridhāvanmahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ jagāma mithilāmapi ॥6॥
html:
tatra pañcaśikho nāma kāpileyo mahāmuniḥ ।
paridhāvanmahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ jagāma mithilāmapi ॥6॥
slp1: tatra paYcaSiKo nAma kApileyo mahAmuniH । pariDAvanmahIM kftsnAM jagAma miTilAmapi ॥6॥

text: sarvasaṃnyāsadharmāṇāṃ tattvajñānaviniścaye । suparyavasitārthaśca nirdvandvo naṣṭasaṃśayaḥ ॥7॥
html:
sarvasaṃnyāsadharmāṇāṃ tattvajñānaviniścaye ।
suparyavasitārthaśca nirdvandvo naṣṭasaṃśayaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: sarvasaMnyAsaDarmARAM tattvajYAnaviniScaye । suparyavasitArTaSca nirdvandvo nazwasaMSayaH ॥7॥

text: ṛṣīṇāmāhurekaṃ yaṃ kāmādavasitaṃ nṛṣu । śāśvataṃ sukhamatyantamanvicchansa sudurlabham ॥8॥
html:
ṛṣīṇāmāhurekaṃ yaṃ kāmādavasitaṃ nṛṣu ।
śāśvataṃ sukhamatyantamanvicchansa sudurlabham ॥8॥
slp1: fzIRAmAhurekaM yaM kAmAdavasitaM nfzu । SASvataM suKamatyantamanvicCansa sudurlaBam ॥8॥

text: yamāhuḥ kapilaṃ sāṅkhyāḥ paramarṣiṃ prajāpatim । sa manye tena rūpeṇa vismāpayati hi svayam ॥9॥
html:
yamāhuḥ kapilaṃ sāṅkhyāḥ paramarṣiṃ prajāpatim ।
sa manye tena rūpeṇa vismāpayati hi svayam ॥9॥
slp1: yamAhuH kapilaM sANKyAH paramarziM prajApatim । sa manye tena rUpeRa vismApayati hi svayam ॥9॥

text: āsureḥ prathamaṃ śiṣyaṃ yamāhuścirajīvinam । pañcasrotasi yaḥ satramāste varṣasahasrikam ॥10॥
html:
āsureḥ prathamaṃ śiṣyaṃ yamāhuścirajīvinam ।
pañcasrotasi yaḥ satramāste varṣasahasrikam ॥10॥
slp1: AsureH praTamaM SizyaM yamAhuScirajIvinam । paYcasrotasi yaH satramAste varzasahasrikam ॥10॥

text: taṃ samāsīnamāgamya maṇḍalaṃ kāpilaṃ mahat । puruṣāvasthamavyaktaṃ paramārthaṃ nibodhayat ॥11॥
html:
taṃ samāsīnamāgamya maṇḍalaṃ kāpilaṃ mahat ।
puruṣāvasthamavyaktaṃ paramārthaṃ nibodhayat ॥11॥
slp1: taM samAsInamAgamya maRqalaM kApilaM mahat । puruzAvasTamavyaktaM paramArTaM niboDayat ॥11॥

text: iṣṭisatreṇa saṃsiddho bhūyaśca tapasā muniḥ । kṣetrakṣetrajñayorvyaktiṃ bubudhe devadarśanaḥ ॥12॥
html:
iṣṭisatreṇa saṃsiddho bhūyaśca tapasā muniḥ ।
kṣetrakṣetrajñayorvyaktiṃ bubudhe devadarśanaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: izwisatreRa saMsidDo BUyaSca tapasA muniH । kzetrakzetrajYayorvyaktiM bubuDe devadarSanaH ॥12॥

text: yattadekākṣaraṃ brahma nānārūpaṃ pradṛśyate । āsurirmaṇḍale tasminpratipede tadavyayam ॥13॥
html:
yattadekākṣaraṃ brahma nānārūpaṃ pradṛśyate ।
āsurirmaṇḍale tasminpratipede tadavyayam ॥13॥
slp1: yattadekAkzaraM brahma nAnArUpaM pradfSyate । AsurirmaRqale tasminpratipede tadavyayam ॥13॥

text: tasya pañcaśikhaḥ śiṣyo mānuṣyā payasā bhṛtaḥ । brāhmaṇī kapilā nāma kācidāsītkuṭumbinī ॥14॥
html:
tasya pañcaśikhaḥ śiṣyo mānuṣyā payasā bhṛtaḥ ।
brāhmaṇī kapilā nāma kācidāsītkuṭumbinī ॥14॥
slp1: tasya paYcaSiKaH Sizyo mAnuzyA payasA BftaH । brAhmaRI kapilA nAma kAcidAsItkuwumbinI ॥14॥

text: tasyāḥ putratvamāgamya striyāḥ sa pibati stanau । tataḥ sa kāpileyatvaṃ lebhe buddhiṃ ca naiṣṭhikīm ॥15॥
html:
tasyāḥ putratvamāgamya striyāḥ sa pibati stanau ।
tataḥ sa kāpileyatvaṃ lebhe buddhiṃ ca naiṣṭhikīm ॥15॥
slp1: tasyAH putratvamAgamya striyAH sa pibati stanO । tataH sa kApileyatvaM leBe budDiM ca nEzWikIm ॥15॥

text: etanme bhagavānāha kāpileyāya saṃbhavam । tasya tatkāpileyatvaṃ sarvavittvamanuttamam ॥16॥
html:
etanme bhagavānāha kāpileyāya saṃbhavam ।
tasya tatkāpileyatvaṃ sarvavittvamanuttamam ॥16॥
slp1: etanme BagavAnAha kApileyAya saMBavam । tasya tatkApileyatvaM sarvavittvamanuttamam ॥16॥

text: sāmānyaṃ kapilo jñātvā dharmajñānāmanuttamam । upetya śatamācāryānmohayāmāsa hetubhiḥ ॥17॥
html:
sāmānyaṃ kapilo jñātvā dharmajñānāmanuttamam ।
upetya śatamācāryānmohayāmāsa hetubhiḥ ॥17॥
slp1: sAmAnyaM kapilo jYAtvA DarmajYAnAmanuttamam । upetya SatamAcAryAnmohayAmAsa hetuBiH ॥17॥

text: janakastvabhisaṃraktaḥ kāpileyānudarśanāt । utsṛjya śatamācāryānpṛṣṭhato'nujagāma tam ॥18॥
html:
janakastvabhisaṃraktaḥ kāpileyānudarśanāt ।
utsṛjya śatamācāryānpṛṣṭhato'nujagāma tam ॥18॥
slp1: janakastvaBisaMraktaH kApileyAnudarSanAt । utsfjya SatamAcAryAnpfzWato'nujagAma tam ॥18॥

text: tasmai paramakalyāya praṇatāya ca dharmataḥ । abravītparamaṃ mokṣaṃ yattatsāṅkhyaṃ vidhīyate ॥19॥
html:
tasmai paramakalyāya praṇatāya ca dharmataḥ ।
abravītparamaṃ mokṣaṃ yattatsāṅkhyaṃ vidhīyate ॥19॥
slp1: tasmE paramakalyAya praRatAya ca DarmataH । abravItparamaM mokzaM yattatsANKyaM viDIyate ॥19॥

text: jātinirvedamuktvā hi karmanirvedamabravīt । karmanirvedamuktvā ca sarvanirvedamabravīt ॥20॥
html:
jātinirvedamuktvā hi karmanirvedamabravīt ।
karmanirvedamuktvā ca sarvanirvedamabravīt ॥20॥
slp1: jAtinirvedamuktvA hi karmanirvedamabravIt । karmanirvedamuktvA ca sarvanirvedamabravIt ॥20॥

text: yadarthaṃ karmasaṃsargaḥ karmaṇāṃ ca phalodayaḥ । tadanāśvāsikaṃ moghaṃ vināśi calamadhruvam ॥21॥
html:
yadarthaṃ karmasaṃsargaḥ karmaṇāṃ ca phalodayaḥ ।
tadanāśvāsikaṃ moghaṃ vināśi calamadhruvam ॥21॥
slp1: yadarTaM karmasaMsargaH karmaRAM ca PalodayaH । tadanASvAsikaM moGaM vinASi calamaDruvam ॥21॥

text: dṛśyamāne vināśe ca pratyakṣe lokasākṣike । āgamātparamastīti bruvannapi parājitaḥ ॥22॥
html:
dṛśyamāne vināśe ca pratyakṣe lokasākṣike ।
āgamātparamastīti bruvannapi parājitaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: dfSyamAne vinASe ca pratyakze lokasAkzike । AgamAtparamastIti bruvannapi parAjitaH ॥22॥

text: anātmā hyātmano mṛtyuḥ kleśo mṛtyurjarāmayaḥ । ātmānaṃ manyate mohāttadasamyakparaṃ matam ॥23॥
html:
anātmā hyātmano mṛtyuḥ kleśo mṛtyurjarāmayaḥ ।
ātmānaṃ manyate mohāttadasamyakparaṃ matam ॥23॥
slp1: anAtmA hyAtmano mftyuH kleSo mftyurjarAmayaH । AtmAnaM manyate mohAttadasamyakparaM matam ॥23॥

text: atha cedevamapyasti yalloke nopapadyate । ajaro'yamamṛtyuśca rājāsau manyate tathā ॥24॥
html:
atha cedevamapyasti yalloke nopapadyate ।
ajaro'yamamṛtyuśca rājāsau manyate tathā ॥24॥
slp1: aTa cedevamapyasti yalloke nopapadyate । ajaro'yamamftyuSca rAjAsO manyate taTA ॥24॥

text: asti nāstīti cāpyetattasminnasati lakṣaṇe । kimadhiṣṭhāya tadbrūyāllokayātrāviniścayam ॥25॥
html:
asti nāstīti cāpyetattasminnasati lakṣaṇe ।
kimadhiṣṭhāya tadbrūyāllokayātrāviniścayam ॥25॥
slp1: asti nAstIti cApyetattasminnasati lakzaRe । kimaDizWAya tadbrUyAllokayAtrAviniScayam ॥25॥

text: pratyakṣaṃ hyetayormūlaṃ kṛtāntaitihyayorapi । pratyakṣo hyāgamo'bhinnaḥ kṛtānto vā na kiñcana ॥26॥
html:
pratyakṣaṃ hyetayormūlaṃ kṛtāntaitihyayorapi ।
pratyakṣo hyāgamo'bhinnaḥ kṛtānto vā na kiñcana ॥26॥
slp1: pratyakzaM hyetayormUlaM kftAntEtihyayorapi । pratyakzo hyAgamo'BinnaH kftAnto vA na kiYcana ॥26॥

text: yatra tatrānumāne'sti kṛtaṃ bhāvayate'pi vā । anyo jīvaḥ śarīrasya nāstikānāṃ mate smṛtaḥ ॥27॥
html:
yatra tatrānumāne'sti kṛtaṃ bhāvayate'pi vā ।
anyo jīvaḥ śarīrasya nāstikānāṃ mate smṛtaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: yatra tatrAnumAne'sti kftaM BAvayate'pi vA । anyo jIvaH SarIrasya nAstikAnAM mate smftaH ॥27॥

text: reto vaṭakaṇīkāyāṃ ghṛtapākādhivāsanam । jātismṛtirayaskāntaḥ sūryakānto'mbubhakṣaṇam ॥28॥
html:
reto vaṭakaṇīkāyāṃ ghṛtapākādhivāsanam ।
jātismṛtirayaskāntaḥ sūryakānto'mbubhakṣaṇam ॥28॥
slp1: reto vawakaRIkAyAM GftapAkADivAsanam । jAtismftirayaskAntaH sUryakAnto'mbuBakzaRam ॥28॥

text: pretya bhūtātyayaścaiva devatābhyupayācanam । mṛte karmanivṛttiśca pramāṇamiti niścayaḥ ॥29॥
html:
pretya bhūtātyayaścaiva devatābhyupayācanam ।
mṛte karmanivṛttiśca pramāṇamiti niścayaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: pretya BUtAtyayaScEva devatAByupayAcanam । mfte karmanivfttiSca pramARamiti niScayaH ॥29॥

text: na tvete hetavaḥ santi ye kecinmūrtisaṃsthitāḥ । amartyasya hi martyena sāmānyaṃ nopapadyate ॥30॥
html:
na tvete hetavaḥ santi ye kecinmūrtisaṃsthitāḥ ।
amartyasya hi martyena sāmānyaṃ nopapadyate ॥30॥
slp1: na tvete hetavaH santi ye kecinmUrtisaMsTitAH । amartyasya hi martyena sAmAnyaM nopapadyate ॥30॥

text: avidyākarmaceṣṭānāṃ kecidāhuḥ punarbhavam । kāraṇaṃ lobhamohau tu doṣāṇāṃ ca niṣevaṇam ॥31॥
html:
avidyākarmaceṣṭānāṃ kecidāhuḥ punarbhavam ।
kāraṇaṃ lobhamohau tu doṣāṇāṃ ca niṣevaṇam ॥31॥
slp1: avidyAkarmacezwAnAM kecidAhuH punarBavam । kAraRaM loBamohO tu dozARAM ca nizevaRam ॥31॥

text: avidyāṃ kṣetramāhurhi karma bījaṃ tathā kṛtam । tṛṣṇāsañjananaṃ sneha eṣa teṣāṃ punarbhavaḥ ॥32॥
html:
avidyāṃ kṣetramāhurhi karma bījaṃ tathā kṛtam ।
tṛṣṇāsañjananaṃ sneha eṣa teṣāṃ punarbhavaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: avidyAM kzetramAhurhi karma bIjaM taTA kftam । tfzRAsaYjananaM sneha eza tezAM punarBavaH ॥32॥

text: tasminvyūḍhe ca dagdhe ca citte maraṇadharmiṇi । anyo'nyājjāyate dehastamāhuḥ sattvasaṅkṣayam ॥33॥
html:
tasminvyūḍhe ca dagdhe ca citte maraṇadharmiṇi ।
anyo'nyājjāyate dehastamāhuḥ sattvasaṅkṣayam ॥33॥
slp1: tasminvyUQe ca dagDe ca citte maraRaDarmiRi । anyo'nyAjjAyate dehastamAhuH sattvasaNkzayam ॥33॥

text: yadā sa rūpataścānyo jātitaḥ śrutito'rthataḥ । kathamasminsa ityeva saṃbandhaḥ syādasaṃhitaḥ ॥34॥
html:
yadā sa rūpataścānyo jātitaḥ śrutito'rthataḥ ।
kathamasminsa ityeva saṃbandhaḥ syādasaṃhitaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: yadA sa rUpataScAnyo jAtitaH Srutito'rTataH । kaTamasminsa ityeva saMbanDaH syAdasaMhitaH ॥34॥

text: evaṃ sati ca kā prītirdānavidyātapobalaiḥ । yadanyācaritaṃ karma sarvamanyaḥ prapadyate ॥35॥
html:
evaṃ sati ca kā prītirdānavidyātapobalaiḥ ।
yadanyācaritaṃ karma sarvamanyaḥ prapadyate ॥35॥
slp1: evaM sati ca kA prItirdAnavidyAtapobalEH । yadanyAcaritaM karma sarvamanyaH prapadyate ॥35॥

text: yadā hyayamihaivānyaiḥ prākṛtairduḥkhito bhavet । sukhitairduḥkhitairvāpi dṛśyo'pyasya vinirṇayaḥ ॥36॥
html:
yadā hyayamihaivānyaiḥ prākṛtairduḥkhito bhavet ।
sukhitairduḥkhitairvāpi dṛśyo'pyasya vinirṇayaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: yadA hyayamihEvAnyEH prAkftErduHKito Bavet । suKitErduHKitErvApi dfSyo'pyasya vinirRayaH ॥36॥

text: tathā hi musalairhanyuḥ śarīraṃ tatpunarbhavet । pṛthagjñānaṃ yadanyacca yenaitannopalabhyate ॥37॥
html:
tathā hi musalairhanyuḥ śarīraṃ tatpunarbhavet ।
pṛthagjñānaṃ yadanyacca yenaitannopalabhyate ॥37॥
slp1: taTA hi musalErhanyuH SarIraM tatpunarBavet । pfTagjYAnaM yadanyacca yenEtannopalaByate ॥37॥

text: ṛtuḥ saṃvatsarastithyaḥ śītoṣṇe ca priyāpriye । yathātītāni paśyanti tādṛśaḥ sattvasaṅkṣayaḥ ॥38॥
html:
ṛtuḥ saṃvatsarastithyaḥ śītoṣṇe ca priyāpriye ।
yathātītāni paśyanti tādṛśaḥ sattvasaṅkṣayaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: ftuH saMvatsarastiTyaH SItozRe ca priyApriye । yaTAtItAni paSyanti tAdfSaH sattvasaNkzayaH ॥38॥

text: jarayā hi parītasya mṛtyunā vā vināśinā । durbalaṃ durbalaṃ pūrvaṃ gṛhasyeva vinaśyati ॥39॥
html:
jarayā hi parītasya mṛtyunā vā vināśinā ।
durbalaṃ durbalaṃ pūrvaṃ gṛhasyeva vinaśyati ॥39॥
slp1: jarayA hi parItasya mftyunA vA vinASinA । durbalaM durbalaM pUrvaM gfhasyeva vinaSyati ॥39॥

text: indriyāṇi mano vāyuḥ śoṇitaṃ māṃsamasthi ca । ānupūrvyā vinaśyanti svaṃ dhātumupayānti ca ॥40॥
html:
indriyāṇi mano vāyuḥ śoṇitaṃ māṃsamasthi ca ।
ānupūrvyā vinaśyanti svaṃ dhātumupayānti ca ॥40॥
slp1: indriyARi mano vAyuH SoRitaM mAMsamasTi ca । AnupUrvyA vinaSyanti svaM DAtumupayAnti ca ॥40॥

text: lokayātrāvidhānaṃ ca dānadharmaphalāgamaḥ । yadarthaṃ vedaśabdāśca vyavahārāśca laukikāḥ ॥41॥
html:
lokayātrāvidhānaṃ ca dānadharmaphalāgamaḥ ।
yadarthaṃ vedaśabdāśca vyavahārāśca laukikāḥ ॥41॥
slp1: lokayAtrAviDAnaM ca dAnaDarmaPalAgamaH । yadarTaM vedaSabdASca vyavahArASca lOkikAH ॥41॥

text: iti samyaṅmanasyete bahavaḥ santi hetavaḥ । etadastīdamastīti na kiñcitpratipadyate ॥42॥
html:
iti samyaṅmanasyete bahavaḥ santi hetavaḥ ।
etadastīdamastīti na kiñcitpratipadyate ॥42॥
slp1: iti samyaNmanasyete bahavaH santi hetavaH । etadastIdamastIti na kiYcitpratipadyate ॥42॥

text: teṣāṃ vimṛśatāmevaṃ tattatsamabhidhāvatām । kvacinniviśate buddhistatra jīryati vṛkṣavat ॥43॥
html:
teṣāṃ vimṛśatāmevaṃ tattatsamabhidhāvatām ।
kvacinniviśate buddhistatra jīryati vṛkṣavat ॥43॥
slp1: tezAM vimfSatAmevaM tattatsamaBiDAvatAm । kvacinniviSate budDistatra jIryati vfkzavat ॥43॥

text: evamarthairanarthaiśca duḥkhitāḥ sarvajantavaḥ । āgamairapakṛṣyante hastipairhastino yathā ॥44॥
html:
evamarthairanarthaiśca duḥkhitāḥ sarvajantavaḥ ।
āgamairapakṛṣyante hastipairhastino yathā ॥44॥
slp1: evamarTEranarTESca duHKitAH sarvajantavaH । AgamErapakfzyante hastipErhastino yaTA ॥44॥

text: arthāṃstathātyantasukhāvahāṃśca lipsanta ete bahavo viśulkāḥ । mahattaraṃ duḥkhamabhiprapannā hitvāmiṣaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ prayānti ॥45॥
html:
arthāṃstathātyantasukhāvahāṃśca lipsanta ete bahavo viśulkāḥ ।
mahattaraṃ duḥkhamabhiprapannā hitvāmiṣaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ prayānti ॥45॥
slp1: arTAMstaTAtyantasuKAvahAMSca lipsanta ete bahavo viSulkAH । mahattaraM duHKamaBiprapannA hitvAmizaM mftyuvaSaM prayAnti ॥45॥

text: vināśino hyadhruvajīvitasya kiṃ bandhubhirmitraparigrahaiśca । vihāya yo gacchati sarvameva kṣaṇena gatvā na nivartate ca ॥46॥
html:
vināśino hyadhruvajīvitasya kiṃ bandhubhirmitraparigrahaiśca ।
vihāya yo gacchati sarvameva kṣaṇena gatvā na nivartate ca ॥46॥
slp1: vinASino hyaDruvajIvitasya kiM banDuBirmitraparigrahESca । vihAya yo gacCati sarvameva kzaRena gatvA na nivartate ca ॥46॥

text: bhūvyomatoyānalavāyavo hi sadā śarīraṃ paripālayanti । itīdamālakṣya kuto ratirbhavedvināśino hyasya na śarma vidyate ॥47॥
html:
bhūvyomatoyānalavāyavo hi sadā śarīraṃ paripālayanti ।
itīdamālakṣya kuto ratirbhavedvināśino hyasya na śarma vidyate ॥47॥
slp1: BUvyomatoyAnalavAyavo hi sadA SarIraM paripAlayanti । itIdamAlakzya kuto ratirBavedvinASino hyasya na Sarma vidyate ॥47॥

text: idamanupadhi vākyamacchalaṃ paramanirāmayamātmasākṣikam । narapatirabhivīkṣya vismitaḥ punaranuyoktumidaṃ pracakrame] ॥48॥
html:
idamanupadhi vākyamacchalaṃ paramanirāmayamātmasākṣikam ।
narapatirabhivīkṣya vismitaḥ punaranuyoktumidaṃ pracakrame] ॥48॥
slp1: idamanupaDi vAkyamacCalaM paramanirAmayamAtmasAkzikam । narapatiraBivIkzya vismitaH punaranuyoktumidaM pracakrame] ॥48॥

text: janako janadevastu jñāpitaḥ paramarṣiṇā । punarevānupapraccha sāṃparāye bhavābhavau ॥1॥
html:
janako janadevastu jñāpitaḥ paramarṣiṇā ।
punarevānupapraccha sāṃparāye bhavābhavau ॥1॥
slp1: janako janadevastu jYApitaH paramarziRA । punarevAnupapracCa sAMparAye BavABavO ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: bhagavanyadidaṃ pretya sañjñā bhavati kasyacit । evaṃ sati kimajñānaṃ jñānaṃ vā kiṃ kariṣyati ॥2॥
html:
bhagavanyadidaṃ pretya sañjñā bhavati kasyacit ।
evaṃ sati kimajñānaṃ jñānaṃ vā kiṃ kariṣyati ॥2॥
slp1: BagavanyadidaM pretya saYjYA Bavati kasyacit । evaM sati kimajYAnaM jYAnaM vA kiM karizyati ॥2॥

text: sarvamucchedaniṣṭhaṃ syātpaśya caitaddvijottama । apramattaḥ pramatto vā kiṃ viśeṣaṃ kariṣyati ॥3॥
html:
sarvamucchedaniṣṭhaṃ syātpaśya caitaddvijottama ।
apramattaḥ pramatto vā kiṃ viśeṣaṃ kariṣyati ॥3॥
slp1: sarvamucCedanizWaM syAtpaSya cEtaddvijottama । apramattaH pramatto vA kiM viSezaM karizyati ॥3॥

text: asaṃsargo hi bhūteṣu saṃsargo vā vināśiṣu । kasmai kriyeta kalpena niścayaḥ ko'tra tattvataḥ ॥4॥
html:
asaṃsargo hi bhūteṣu saṃsargo vā vināśiṣu ।
kasmai kriyeta kalpena niścayaḥ ko'tra tattvataḥ ॥4॥
slp1: asaMsargo hi BUtezu saMsargo vA vinASizu । kasmE kriyeta kalpena niScayaH ko'tra tattvataH ॥4॥

text: tamasā hi praticchannaṃ vibhrāntamiva cāturam । punaḥ praśamayanvākyaiḥ kaviḥ pañcaśikho'bravīt ॥5॥
html:
tamasā hi praticchannaṃ vibhrāntamiva cāturam ।
punaḥ praśamayanvākyaiḥ kaviḥ pañcaśikho'bravīt ॥5॥
slp1: tamasA hi praticCannaM viBrAntamiva cAturam । punaH praSamayanvAkyEH kaviH paYcaSiKo'bravIt ॥5॥

text: ucchedaniṣṭhā nehāsti bhāvaniṣṭhā na vidyate । ayaṃ hyapi samāhāraḥ śarīrendriyacetasām । vartate pṛthaganyonyamapyapāśritya karmasu ॥6॥
html:
ucchedaniṣṭhā nehāsti bhāvaniṣṭhā na vidyate ।
ayaṃ hyapi samāhāraḥ śarīrendriyacetasām ।
vartate pṛthaganyonyamapyapāśritya karmasu ॥6॥
slp1: ucCedanizWA nehAsti BAvanizWA na vidyate । ayaM hyapi samAhAraH SarIrendriyacetasAm । vartate pfTaganyonyamapyapASritya karmasu ॥6॥

text: dhātavaḥ pañcaśākho'yaṃ khaṃ vāyurjyotirambu bhūḥ । te svabhāvena tiṣṭhanti viyujyante svabhāvataḥ ॥7॥
html:
dhātavaḥ pañcaśākho'yaṃ khaṃ vāyurjyotirambu bhūḥ ।
te svabhāvena tiṣṭhanti viyujyante svabhāvataḥ ॥7॥
slp1: DAtavaH paYcaSAKo'yaM KaM vAyurjyotirambu BUH । te svaBAvena tizWanti viyujyante svaBAvataH ॥7॥

text: ākāśaṃ vāyurūṣmā ca sneho yaccāpi pārthivam । eṣa pañcasamāhāraḥ śarīramiti naikadhā । jñānamūṣmā ca vāyuśca trividhaḥ karmasaṅgrahaḥ ॥8॥
html:
ākāśaṃ vāyurūṣmā ca sneho yaccāpi pārthivam ।
eṣa pañcasamāhāraḥ śarīramiti naikadhā ।
jñānamūṣmā ca vāyuśca trividhaḥ karmasaṅgrahaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: AkASaM vAyurUzmA ca sneho yaccApi pArTivam । eza paYcasamAhAraH SarIramiti nEkaDA । jYAnamUzmA ca vAyuSca triviDaH karmasaNgrahaH ॥8॥

text: indriyāṇīndriyārthāśca svabhāvaścetanā manaḥ । prāṇāpānau vikāraśca dhātavaścātra niḥsṛtāḥ ॥9॥
html:
indriyāṇīndriyārthāśca svabhāvaścetanā manaḥ ।
prāṇāpānau vikāraśca dhātavaścātra niḥsṛtāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: indriyARIndriyArTASca svaBAvaScetanA manaH । prARApAnO vikAraSca DAtavaScAtra niHsftAH ॥9॥

text: śravaṇaṃ sparśanaṃ jihvā dṛṣṭirnāsā tathaiva ca । indriyāṇīti pañcaite cittapūrvaṅgamā guṇāḥ ॥10॥
html:
śravaṇaṃ sparśanaṃ jihvā dṛṣṭirnāsā tathaiva ca ।
indriyāṇīti pañcaite cittapūrvaṅgamā guṇāḥ ॥10॥
slp1: SravaRaM sparSanaM jihvA dfzwirnAsA taTEva ca । indriyARIti paYcEte cittapUrvaNgamA guRAH ॥10॥

text: tatra vijñānasaṃyuktā trividhā vedanā dhruvā । sukhaduḥkheti yāmāhuraduḥkhetyasukheti ca ॥11॥
html:
tatra vijñānasaṃyuktā trividhā vedanā dhruvā ।
sukhaduḥkheti yāmāhuraduḥkhetyasukheti ca ॥11॥
slp1: tatra vijYAnasaMyuktA triviDA vedanA DruvA । suKaduHKeti yAmAhuraduHKetyasuKeti ca ॥11॥

text: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaśca mūrtyatha । ete hyāmaraṇātpañca ṣaḍguṇā jñānasiddhaye ॥12॥
html:
śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaśca mūrtyatha ।
ete hyāmaraṇātpañca ṣaḍguṇā jñānasiddhaye ॥12॥
slp1: SabdaH sparSaSca rUpaM ca raso ganDaSca mUrtyaTa । ete hyAmaraRAtpaYca zaqguRA jYAnasidDaye ॥12॥

text: teṣu karmanisargaśca sarvatattvārthaniścayaḥ । tamāhuḥ paramaṃ śukraṃ buddhirityavyayaṃ mahat ॥13॥
html:
teṣu karmanisargaśca sarvatattvārthaniścayaḥ ।
tamāhuḥ paramaṃ śukraṃ buddhirityavyayaṃ mahat ॥13॥
slp1: tezu karmanisargaSca sarvatattvArTaniScayaH । tamAhuH paramaM SukraM budDirityavyayaM mahat ॥13॥

text: imaṃ guṇasamāhāramātmabhāvena paśyataḥ । asamyagdarśanairduḥkhamanantaṃ nopaśāmyati ॥14॥
html:
imaṃ guṇasamāhāramātmabhāvena paśyataḥ ।
asamyagdarśanairduḥkhamanantaṃ nopaśāmyati ॥14॥
slp1: imaM guRasamAhAramAtmaBAvena paSyataH । asamyagdarSanErduHKamanantaM nopaSAmyati ॥14॥

text: anātmeti ca yaddṛṣṭaṃ tenāhaṃ na mametyapi । vartate kimadhiṣṭhānā prasaktā duḥkhasantatiḥ ॥15॥
html:
anātmeti ca yaddṛṣṭaṃ tenāhaṃ na mametyapi ।
vartate kimadhiṣṭhānā prasaktā duḥkhasantatiḥ ॥15॥
slp1: anAtmeti ca yaddfzwaM tenAhaM na mametyapi । vartate kimaDizWAnA prasaktA duHKasantatiH ॥15॥

text: tatra samyaṅmano nāma tyāgaśāstramanuttamam । śṛṇu yattava mokṣāya bhāṣyamāṇaṃ bhaviṣyati ॥16॥
html:
tatra samyaṅmano nāma tyāgaśāstramanuttamam ।
śṛṇu yattava mokṣāya bhāṣyamāṇaṃ bhaviṣyati ॥16॥
slp1: tatra samyaNmano nAma tyAgaSAstramanuttamam । SfRu yattava mokzAya BAzyamARaM Bavizyati ॥16॥

text: tyāga eva hi sarveṣāmuktānāmapi karmaṇām । nityaṃ mithyāvinītānāṃ kleśo duḥkhāvaho mataḥ ॥17॥
html:
tyāga eva hi sarveṣāmuktānāmapi karmaṇām ।
nityaṃ mithyāvinītānāṃ kleśo duḥkhāvaho mataḥ ॥17॥
slp1: tyAga eva hi sarvezAmuktAnAmapi karmaRAm । nityaM miTyAvinItAnAM kleSo duHKAvaho mataH ॥17॥

text: dravyatyāge tu karmāṇi bhogatyāge vratānyapi । sukhatyāge tapoyogaḥ sarvatyāge samāpanā ॥18॥
html:
dravyatyāge tu karmāṇi bhogatyāge vratānyapi ।
sukhatyāge tapoyogaḥ sarvatyāge samāpanā ॥18॥
slp1: dravyatyAge tu karmARi BogatyAge vratAnyapi । suKatyAge tapoyogaH sarvatyAge samApanA ॥18॥

text: tasya mārgo'yamadvaidhaḥ sarvatyāgasya darśitaḥ । viprahāṇāya duḥkhasya durgatirhyanyathā bhavet ॥19॥
html:
tasya mārgo'yamadvaidhaḥ sarvatyāgasya darśitaḥ ।
viprahāṇāya duḥkhasya durgatirhyanyathā bhavet ॥19॥
slp1: tasya mArgo'yamadvEDaH sarvatyAgasya darSitaH । viprahARAya duHKasya durgatirhyanyaTA Bavet ॥19॥

text: pañca jñānendriyāṇyuktvā manaḥṣaṣṭhāni cetasi । manaḥṣaṣṭhāni vakṣyāmi pañca karmendriyāṇi tu ॥20॥
html:
pañca jñānendriyāṇyuktvā manaḥṣaṣṭhāni cetasi ।
manaḥṣaṣṭhāni vakṣyāmi pañca karmendriyāṇi tu ॥20॥
slp1: paYca jYAnendriyARyuktvA manaHzazWAni cetasi । manaHzazWAni vakzyAmi paYca karmendriyARi tu ॥20॥

text: hastau karmendriyaṃ jñeyamatha pādau gatīndriyam । prajanānandayoḥ śepho visarge pāyurindriyam ॥21॥
html:
hastau karmendriyaṃ jñeyamatha pādau gatīndriyam ।
prajanānandayoḥ śepho visarge pāyurindriyam ॥21॥
slp1: hastO karmendriyaM jYeyamaTa pAdO gatIndriyam । prajanAnandayoH SePo visarge pAyurindriyam ॥21॥

text: vāktu śabdaviśeṣārthaṃ gatiṃ pañcānvitāṃ viduḥ । evamekādaśaitāni buddhyā tvavasṛjenmanaḥ ॥22॥
html:
vāktu śabdaviśeṣārthaṃ gatiṃ pañcānvitāṃ viduḥ ।
evamekādaśaitāni buddhyā tvavasṛjenmanaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: vAktu SabdaviSezArTaM gatiM paYcAnvitAM viduH । evamekAdaSEtAni budDyA tvavasfjenmanaH ॥22॥

text: karṇau śabdaśca cittaṃ ca trayaḥ śravaṇasaṅgrahe । tathā sparśe tathā rūpe tathaiva rasagandhayoḥ ॥23॥
html:
karṇau śabdaśca cittaṃ ca trayaḥ śravaṇasaṅgrahe ।
tathā sparśe tathā rūpe tathaiva rasagandhayoḥ ॥23॥
slp1: karRO SabdaSca cittaM ca trayaH SravaRasaNgrahe । taTA sparSe taTA rUpe taTEva rasaganDayoH ॥23॥

text: evaṃ pañcatrikā hyete guṇāstadupalabdhaye । yena yastrividho bhāvaḥ paryāyātsamupasthitaḥ ॥24॥
html:
evaṃ pañcatrikā hyete guṇāstadupalabdhaye ।
yena yastrividho bhāvaḥ paryāyātsamupasthitaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: evaM paYcatrikA hyete guRAstadupalabDaye । yena yastriviDo BAvaH paryAyAtsamupasTitaH ॥24॥

text: sāttviko rājasaścaiva tāmasaścaiva te trayaḥ । trividhā vedanā yeṣu prasūtā sarvasādhanā ॥25॥
html:
sāttviko rājasaścaiva tāmasaścaiva te trayaḥ ।
trividhā vedanā yeṣu prasūtā sarvasādhanā ॥25॥
slp1: sAttviko rAjasaScEva tAmasaScEva te trayaH । triviDA vedanA yezu prasUtA sarvasADanA ॥25॥

text: praharṣaḥ prītirānandaḥ sukhaṃ saṃśāntacittatā । akutaścitkutaścidvā cittataḥ sāttviko guṇaḥ ॥26॥
html:
praharṣaḥ prītirānandaḥ sukhaṃ saṃśāntacittatā ।
akutaścitkutaścidvā cittataḥ sāttviko guṇaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: praharzaH prItirAnandaH suKaM saMSAntacittatA । akutaScitkutaScidvA cittataH sAttviko guRaH ॥26॥

text: atuṣṭiḥ paritāpaśca śoko lobhastathākṣamā । liṅgāni rajasastāni dṛśyante hetvahetutaḥ ॥27॥
html:
atuṣṭiḥ paritāpaśca śoko lobhastathākṣamā ।
liṅgāni rajasastāni dṛśyante hetvahetutaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: atuzwiH paritApaSca Soko loBastaTAkzamA । liNgAni rajasastAni dfSyante hetvahetutaH ॥27॥

text: avivekastathā mohaḥ pramādaḥ svapnatandritā । kathañcidapi vartante vividhāstāmasā guṇāḥ ॥28॥
html:
avivekastathā mohaḥ pramādaḥ svapnatandritā ।
kathañcidapi vartante vividhāstāmasā guṇāḥ ॥28॥
slp1: avivekastaTA mohaH pramAdaH svapnatandritA । kaTaYcidapi vartante viviDAstAmasA guRAH ॥28॥

text: tatra yatprītisaṃyuktaṃ kāye manasi vā bhavet । vartate sāttviko bhāva ityapekṣeta tattathā ॥29॥
html:
tatra yatprītisaṃyuktaṃ kāye manasi vā bhavet ।
vartate sāttviko bhāva ityapekṣeta tattathā ॥29॥
slp1: tatra yatprItisaMyuktaM kAye manasi vA Bavet । vartate sAttviko BAva ityapekzeta tattaTA ॥29॥

text: yattu santāpasaṃyuktamaprītikaramātmanaḥ । pravṛttaṃ raja ityeva tatastadabhicintayet ॥30॥
html:
yattu santāpasaṃyuktamaprītikaramātmanaḥ ।
pravṛttaṃ raja ityeva tatastadabhicintayet ॥30॥
slp1: yattu santApasaMyuktamaprItikaramAtmanaH । pravfttaM raja ityeva tatastadaBicintayet ॥30॥

text: atha yanmohasaṃyuktaṃ kāye manasi vā bhavet । apratarkyamavijñeyaṃ tamastadupadhārayet ॥31॥
html:
atha yanmohasaṃyuktaṃ kāye manasi vā bhavet ।
apratarkyamavijñeyaṃ tamastadupadhārayet ॥31॥
slp1: aTa yanmohasaMyuktaM kAye manasi vA Bavet । apratarkyamavijYeyaM tamastadupaDArayet ॥31॥

text: taddhi śrotrāśrayaṃ bhūtaṃ śabdaḥ śrotraṃ samāśritaḥ । nobhayaṃ śabdavijñāne vijñānasyetarasya vā ॥32॥
html:
taddhi śrotrāśrayaṃ bhūtaṃ śabdaḥ śrotraṃ samāśritaḥ ।
nobhayaṃ śabdavijñāne vijñānasyetarasya vā ॥32॥
slp1: tadDi SrotrASrayaM BUtaM SabdaH SrotraM samASritaH । noBayaM SabdavijYAne vijYAnasyetarasya vA ॥32॥

text: evaṃ tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā caiva pañcamī । sparśe rūpe rase gandhe tāni ceto manaśca tat ॥33॥
html:
evaṃ tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā caiva pañcamī ।
sparśe rūpe rase gandhe tāni ceto manaśca tat ॥33॥
slp1: evaM tvakcakzuzI jihvA nAsikA cEva paYcamI । sparSe rUpe rase ganDe tAni ceto manaSca tat ॥33॥

text: svakarmayugapadbhāvo daśasveteṣu tiṣṭhati । cittamekādaśaṃ viddhi buddhirdvādaśamī bhavet ॥34॥
html:
svakarmayugapadbhāvo daśasveteṣu tiṣṭhati ।
cittamekādaśaṃ viddhi buddhirdvādaśamī bhavet ॥34॥
slp1: svakarmayugapadBAvo daSasvetezu tizWati । cittamekAdaSaM vidDi budDirdvAdaSamI Bavet ॥34॥

text: teṣāmayugapadbhāva ucchedo nāsti tāmasaḥ । āsthito yugapadbhāve vyavahāraḥ sa laukikaḥ ॥35॥
html:
teṣāmayugapadbhāva ucchedo nāsti tāmasaḥ ।
āsthito yugapadbhāve vyavahāraḥ sa laukikaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: tezAmayugapadBAva ucCedo nAsti tAmasaH । AsTito yugapadBAve vyavahAraH sa lOkikaH ॥35॥

text: indriyāṇyavasṛjyāpi dṛṣṭvā pūrvaṃ śrutāgamam । cintayannānuparyeti tribhirevānvito guṇaiḥ ॥36॥
html:
indriyāṇyavasṛjyāpi dṛṣṭvā pūrvaṃ śrutāgamam ।
cintayannānuparyeti tribhirevānvito guṇaiḥ ॥36॥
slp1: indriyARyavasfjyApi dfzwvA pUrvaM SrutAgamam । cintayannAnuparyeti triBirevAnvito guREH ॥36॥

text: yattamopahataṃ cittamāśu sañcāramadhruvam । karotyuparamaṃ kāle tadāhustāmasaṃ sukham ॥37॥
html:
yattamopahataṃ cittamāśu sañcāramadhruvam ।
karotyuparamaṃ kāle tadāhustāmasaṃ sukham ॥37॥
slp1: yattamopahataM cittamASu saYcAramaDruvam । karotyuparamaM kAle tadAhustAmasaM suKam ॥37॥

text: yadyadāgamasaṃyuktaṃ na kṛtsnamupaśāmyati । atha tatrāpyupādatte tamo vyaktamivānṛtam ॥38॥
html:
yadyadāgamasaṃyuktaṃ na kṛtsnamupaśāmyati ।
atha tatrāpyupādatte tamo vyaktamivānṛtam ॥38॥
slp1: yadyadAgamasaMyuktaM na kftsnamupaSAmyati । aTa tatrApyupAdatte tamo vyaktamivAnftam ॥38॥

text: evameṣa prasaṅkhyātaḥ svakarmapratyayī guṇaḥ । kathañcidvartate samyakkeṣāñcidvā na vartate ॥39॥
html:
evameṣa prasaṅkhyātaḥ svakarmapratyayī guṇaḥ ।
kathañcidvartate samyakkeṣāñcidvā na vartate ॥39॥
slp1: evameza prasaNKyAtaH svakarmapratyayI guRaH । kaTaYcidvartate samyakkezAYcidvA na vartate ॥39॥

text: evamāhuḥ samāhāraṃ kṣetramadhyātmacintakāḥ । sthito manasi yo bhāvaḥ sa vai kṣetrajña ucyate ॥40॥
html:
evamāhuḥ samāhāraṃ kṣetramadhyātmacintakāḥ ।
sthito manasi yo bhāvaḥ sa vai kṣetrajña ucyate ॥40॥
slp1: evamAhuH samAhAraM kzetramaDyAtmacintakAH । sTito manasi yo BAvaH sa vE kzetrajYa ucyate ॥40॥

text: evaṃ sati ka ucchedaḥ śāśvato vā kathaṃ bhavet । svabhāvādvartamāneṣu sarvabhūteṣu hetutaḥ ॥41॥
html:
evaṃ sati ka ucchedaḥ śāśvato vā kathaṃ bhavet ।
svabhāvādvartamāneṣu sarvabhūteṣu hetutaḥ ॥41॥
slp1: evaM sati ka ucCedaH SASvato vA kaTaM Bavet । svaBAvAdvartamAnezu sarvaBUtezu hetutaH ॥41॥

text: yathārṇavagatā nadyo vyaktīrjahati nāma ca । na ca svatāṃ niyacchanti tādṛśaḥ sattvasaṅkṣayaḥ ॥42॥
html:
yathārṇavagatā nadyo vyaktīrjahati nāma ca ।
na ca svatāṃ niyacchanti tādṛśaḥ sattvasaṅkṣayaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: yaTArRavagatA nadyo vyaktIrjahati nAma ca । na ca svatAM niyacCanti tAdfSaH sattvasaNkzayaH ॥42॥

text: evaṃ sati kutaḥ sañjñā pretyabhāve punarbhavet । pratisammiśrite jīve gṛhyamāṇe ca madhyataḥ ॥43॥
html:
evaṃ sati kutaḥ sañjñā pretyabhāve punarbhavet ।
pratisammiśrite jīve gṛhyamāṇe ca madhyataḥ ॥43॥
slp1: evaM sati kutaH saYjYA pretyaBAve punarBavet । pratisammiSrite jIve gfhyamARe ca maDyataH ॥43॥

text: imāṃ tu yo veda vimokṣabuddhimātmānamanvicchati cāpramattaḥ । na lipyate karmaphalairaniṣṭaiḥ patraṃ bisasyeva jalena siktam ॥44॥
html:
imāṃ tu yo veda vimokṣabuddhimātmānamanvicchati cāpramattaḥ ।
na lipyate karmaphalairaniṣṭaiḥ patraṃ bisasyeva jalena siktam ॥44॥
slp1: imAM tu yo veda vimokzabudDimAtmAnamanvicCati cApramattaH । na lipyate karmaPalEranizwEH patraM bisasyeva jalena siktam ॥44॥

text: dṛḍhaiśca pāśairbahubhirvimuktaḥ prajānimittairapi daivataiśca । yadā hyasau sukhaduḥkhe jahāti muktastadāgryāṃ gatimetyaliṅgaḥ । śrutipramāṇāgamamaṅgalaiśca śete jarāmṛtyubhayādatītaḥ ॥45॥
html:
dṛḍhaiśca pāśairbahubhirvimuktaḥ prajānimittairapi daivataiśca ।
yadā hyasau sukhaduḥkhe jahāti muktastadāgryāṃ gatimetyaliṅgaḥ ।
śrutipramāṇāgamamaṅgalaiśca śete jarāmṛtyubhayādatītaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: dfQESca pASErbahuBirvimuktaH prajAnimittErapi dEvatESca । yadA hyasO suKaduHKe jahAti muktastadAgryAM gatimetyaliNgaH । SrutipramARAgamamaNgalESca Sete jarAmftyuBayAdatItaH ॥45॥

text: kṣīṇe ca puṇye vigate ca pāpe tatonimitte ca phale vinaṣṭe । alepamākāśamaliṅgamevamāsthāya paśyanti mahaddhyasaktāḥ ॥46॥
html:
kṣīṇe ca puṇye vigate ca pāpe tatonimitte ca phale vinaṣṭe ।
alepamākāśamaliṅgamevamāsthāya paśyanti mahaddhyasaktāḥ ॥46॥
slp1: kzIRe ca puRye vigate ca pApe tatonimitte ca Pale vinazwe । alepamAkASamaliNgamevamAsTAya paSyanti mahadDyasaktAH ॥46॥

text: yathorṇanābhiḥ parivartamānastantukṣaye tiṣṭhati pātyamānaḥ । tathā vimuktaḥ prajahāti duḥkhaṃ vidhvaṃsate loṣṭa ivādrimarcchan ॥47॥
html:
yathorṇanābhiḥ parivartamānastantukṣaye tiṣṭhati pātyamānaḥ ।
tathā vimuktaḥ prajahāti duḥkhaṃ vidhvaṃsate loṣṭa ivādrimarcchan ॥47॥
slp1: yaTorRanABiH parivartamAnastantukzaye tizWati pAtyamAnaH । taTA vimuktaH prajahAti duHKaM viDvaMsate lozwa ivAdrimarcCan ॥47॥

text: yathā ruruḥ śṛṅgamatho purāṇaṃ hitvā tvacaṃ vāpyurago yathāvat । vihāya gacchatyanavekṣamāṇastathā vimukto vijahāti duḥkham ॥48॥
html:
yathā ruruḥ śṛṅgamatho purāṇaṃ hitvā tvacaṃ vāpyurago yathāvat ।
vihāya gacchatyanavekṣamāṇastathā vimukto vijahāti duḥkham ॥48॥
slp1: yaTA ruruH SfNgamaTo purARaM hitvA tvacaM vApyurago yaTAvat । vihAya gacCatyanavekzamARastaTA vimukto vijahAti duHKam ॥48॥

text: drumaṃ yathā vāpyudake patantamutsṛjya pakṣī prapatatyasaktaḥ । tathā hyasau sukhaduḥkhe vihāya muktaḥ parārdhyāṃ gatimetyaliṅgaḥ ॥49॥
html:
drumaṃ yathā vāpyudake patantamutsṛjya pakṣī prapatatyasaktaḥ ।
tathā hyasau sukhaduḥkhe vihāya muktaḥ parārdhyāṃ gatimetyaliṅgaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: drumaM yaTA vApyudake patantamutsfjya pakzI prapatatyasaktaH । taTA hyasO suKaduHKe vihAya muktaH parArDyAM gatimetyaliNgaH ॥49॥

text: api ca bhavati maithilena gītaṃ nagaramupāhitamagninābhivīkṣya । na khalu mama tuṣo'pi dahyate'tra svayamidamāha kila sma bhūmipālaḥ ॥50॥
html:
api ca bhavati maithilena gītaṃ nagaramupāhitamagninābhivīkṣya ।
na khalu mama tuṣo'pi dahyate'tra svayamidamāha kila sma bhūmipālaḥ ॥50॥
slp1: api ca Bavati mETilena gItaM nagaramupAhitamagninABivIkzya । na Kalu mama tuzo'pi dahyate'tra svayamidamAha kila sma BUmipAlaH ॥50॥

text: idamamṛtapadaṃ videharājaḥ svayamiha pañcaśikhena bhāṣyamāṇaḥ । nikhilamabhisamīkṣya niścitārthaṃ paramasukhī vijahāra vītaśokaḥ ॥51॥
html:
idamamṛtapadaṃ videharājaḥ svayamiha pañcaśikhena bhāṣyamāṇaḥ ।
nikhilamabhisamīkṣya niścitārthaṃ paramasukhī vijahāra vītaśokaḥ ॥51॥
slp1: idamamftapadaM videharAjaH svayamiha paYcaSiKena BAzyamARaH । niKilamaBisamIkzya niScitArTaM paramasuKI vijahAra vItaSokaH ॥51॥

text: imaṃ hi yaḥ paṭhati vimokṣaniścayaṃ na hīyate satatamavekṣate tathā । upadravānnānubhavatyaduḥkhitaḥ pramucyate kapilamivaitya maithilaḥ] ॥52॥
html:
imaṃ hi yaḥ paṭhati vimokṣaniścayaṃ na hīyate satatamavekṣate tathā ।
upadravānnānubhavatyaduḥkhitaḥ pramucyate kapilamivaitya maithilaḥ] ॥52॥
slp1: imaM hi yaH paWati vimokzaniScayaM na hIyate satatamavekzate taTA । upadravAnnAnuBavatyaduHKitaH pramucyate kapilamivEtya mETilaH] ॥52॥

text: kiṃ kurvansukhamāpnoti kiṃ kurvanduḥkhamāpnute । kiṃ kurvannirbhayo loke siddhaścarati bhārata ॥1॥
html:
kiṃ kurvansukhamāpnoti kiṃ kurvanduḥkhamāpnute ।
kiṃ kurvannirbhayo loke siddhaścarati bhārata ॥1॥
slp1: kiM kurvansuKamApnoti kiM kurvanduHKamApnute । kiM kurvannirBayo loke sidDaScarati BArata ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: damameva praśaṃsanti vṛddhāḥ śrutisamādhayaḥ । sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ ॥2॥
html:
damameva praśaṃsanti vṛddhāḥ śrutisamādhayaḥ ।
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ ॥2॥
slp1: damameva praSaMsanti vfdDAH SrutisamADayaH । sarvezAmeva varRAnAM brAhmaRasya viSezataH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: nādāntasya kriyāsiddhiryathāvadupalabhyate । kriyā tapaśca vedāśca dame sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ॥3॥
html:
nādāntasya kriyāsiddhiryathāvadupalabhyate ।
kriyā tapaśca vedāśca dame sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ॥3॥
slp1: nAdAntasya kriyAsidDiryaTAvadupalaByate । kriyA tapaSca vedASca dame sarvaM pratizWitam ॥3॥

text: damastejo vardhayati pavitraṃ dama ucyate । vipāpmā nirbhayo dāntaḥ puruṣo vindate mahat ॥4॥
html:
damastejo vardhayati pavitraṃ dama ucyate ।
vipāpmā nirbhayo dāntaḥ puruṣo vindate mahat ॥4॥
slp1: damastejo varDayati pavitraM dama ucyate । vipApmA nirBayo dAntaH puruzo vindate mahat ॥4॥

text: sukhaṃ dāntaḥ prasvapiti sukhaṃ ca pratibudhyate । sukhaṃ loke viparyeti manaścāsya prasīdati ॥5॥
html:
sukhaṃ dāntaḥ prasvapiti sukhaṃ ca pratibudhyate ।
sukhaṃ loke viparyeti manaścāsya prasīdati ॥5॥
slp1: suKaM dAntaH prasvapiti suKaM ca pratibuDyate । suKaM loke viparyeti manaScAsya prasIdati ॥5॥

text: tejo damena dhriyate na tattīkṣṇo'dhigacchati । amitrāṃśca bahūnnityaṃ pṛthagātmani paśyati ॥6॥
html:
tejo damena dhriyate na tattīkṣṇo'dhigacchati ।
amitrāṃśca bahūnnityaṃ pṛthagātmani paśyati ॥6॥
slp1: tejo damena Driyate na tattIkzRo'DigacCati । amitrAMSca bahUnnityaM pfTagAtmani paSyati ॥6॥

text: kravyādbhya iva bhūtānāmadāntebhyaḥ sadā bhayam । teṣāṃ vipratiṣedhārthaṃ rājā sṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃbhuvā ॥7॥
html:
kravyādbhya iva bhūtānāmadāntebhyaḥ sadā bhayam ।
teṣāṃ vipratiṣedhārthaṃ rājā sṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃbhuvā ॥7॥
slp1: kravyAdBya iva BUtAnAmadAnteByaH sadA Bayam । tezAM vipratizeDArTaM rAjA sfzwaH svayaMBuvA ॥7॥

text: āśrameṣu ca sarveṣu dama eva viśiṣyate । yacca teṣu phalaṃ dharme bhūyo dānte taducyate ॥8॥
html:
āśrameṣu ca sarveṣu dama eva viśiṣyate ।
yacca teṣu phalaṃ dharme bhūyo dānte taducyate ॥8॥
slp1: ASramezu ca sarvezu dama eva viSizyate । yacca tezu PalaM Darme BUyo dAnte taducyate ॥8॥

text: teṣāṃ liṅgāni vakṣyāmi yeṣāṃ samudayo damaḥ । akārpaṇyamasaṃrambhaḥ santoṣaḥ śraddadhānatā ॥9॥
html:
teṣāṃ liṅgāni vakṣyāmi yeṣāṃ samudayo damaḥ ।
akārpaṇyamasaṃrambhaḥ santoṣaḥ śraddadhānatā ॥9॥
slp1: tezAM liNgAni vakzyAmi yezAM samudayo damaH । akArpaRyamasaMramBaH santozaH SraddaDAnatA ॥9॥

text: akrodha ārjavaṃ nityaṃ nātivādo na mānitā । gurupūjānasūyā ca dayā bhūteṣvapaiśunam ॥10॥
html:
akrodha ārjavaṃ nityaṃ nātivādo na mānitā ।
gurupūjānasūyā ca dayā bhūteṣvapaiśunam ॥10॥
slp1: akroDa ArjavaM nityaM nAtivAdo na mAnitA । gurupUjAnasUyA ca dayA BUtezvapESunam ॥10॥

text: janavādamṛṣāvādastutinindāvivarjanam । sādhukāmaścāspṛhayannāyāti pratyayaṃ nṛṣu ॥11॥
html:
janavādamṛṣāvādastutinindāvivarjanam ।
sādhukāmaścāspṛhayannāyāti pratyayaṃ nṛṣu ॥11॥
slp1: janavAdamfzAvAdastutinindAvivarjanam । sADukAmaScAspfhayannAyAti pratyayaM nfzu ॥11॥

text: avairakṛtsūpacāraḥ samo nindāpraśaṃsayoḥ । suvṛttaḥ śīlasampannaḥ prasannātmātmavānbudhaḥ । prāpya loke ca satkāraṃ svargaṃ vai pretya gacchati ॥12॥
html:
avairakṛtsūpacāraḥ samo nindāpraśaṃsayoḥ ।
suvṛttaḥ śīlasampannaḥ prasannātmātmavānbudhaḥ ।
prāpya loke ca satkāraṃ svargaṃ vai pretya gacchati ॥12॥
slp1: avErakftsUpacAraH samo nindApraSaMsayoH । suvfttaH SIlasampannaH prasannAtmAtmavAnbuDaH । prApya loke ca satkAraM svargaM vE pretya gacCati ॥12॥

text: sarvabhūtahite yukto na smayāddveṣṭi vai janam । mahāhrada ivākṣobhya prajñātṛptaḥ prasīdati ॥13॥
html:
sarvabhūtahite yukto na smayāddveṣṭi vai janam ।
mahāhrada ivākṣobhya prajñātṛptaḥ prasīdati ॥13॥
slp1: sarvaBUtahite yukto na smayAddvezwi vE janam । mahAhrada ivAkzoBya prajYAtfptaH prasIdati ॥13॥

text: abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyaḥ sarveṣāmabhayaṃ yataḥ । namasyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dānto bhavati jñānavān ॥14॥
html:
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyaḥ sarveṣāmabhayaṃ yataḥ ।
namasyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dānto bhavati jñānavān ॥14॥
slp1: aBayaM sarvaBUteByaH sarvezAmaBayaM yataH । namasyaH sarvaBUtAnAM dAnto Bavati jYAnavAn ॥14॥

text: na hṛṣyati mahatyarthe vyasane ca na śocati । sa vai parimitaprajñaḥ sa dānto dvija ucyate ॥15॥
html:
na hṛṣyati mahatyarthe vyasane ca na śocati ।
sa vai parimitaprajñaḥ sa dānto dvija ucyate ॥15॥
slp1: na hfzyati mahatyarTe vyasane ca na Socati । sa vE parimitaprajYaH sa dAnto dvija ucyate ॥15॥

text: karmabhiḥ śrutasaṃpannaḥ sadbhirācaritaiḥ śubhaiḥ । sadaiva damasaṃyuktastasya bhuṅkte mahatphalam ॥16॥
html:
karmabhiḥ śrutasaṃpannaḥ sadbhirācaritaiḥ śubhaiḥ ।
sadaiva damasaṃyuktastasya bhuṅkte mahatphalam ॥16॥
slp1: karmaBiH SrutasaMpannaH sadBirAcaritEH SuBEH । sadEva damasaMyuktastasya BuNkte mahatPalam ॥16॥

text: anasūyā kṣamā śāntiḥ santoṣaḥ priyavāditā । satyaṃ dānamanāyāso naiṣa mārgo durātmanām ॥17॥
html:
anasūyā kṣamā śāntiḥ santoṣaḥ priyavāditā ।
satyaṃ dānamanāyāso naiṣa mārgo durātmanām ॥17॥
slp1: anasUyA kzamA SAntiH santozaH priyavAditA । satyaM dAnamanAyAso nEza mArgo durAtmanAm ॥17॥

text: kāmakrodhau vaśe kṛtvā brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ । vikramya ghore tapasi brāhmaṇaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ । kālākāṅkṣī carellokānnirapāya ivātmavān] ॥18॥
html:
kāmakrodhau vaśe kṛtvā brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ ।
vikramya ghore tapasi brāhmaṇaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ ।
kālākāṅkṣī carellokānnirapāya ivātmavān] ॥18॥
slp1: kAmakroDO vaSe kftvA brahmacArI jitendriyaH । vikramya Gore tapasi brAhmaRaH saMSitavrataH । kAlAkANkzI carellokAnnirapAya ivAtmavAn] ॥18॥

text: dvijātayo vratopetā yadidaṃ bhuñjate haviḥ । annaṃ brāhmaṇakāmāya kathametatpitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
dvijātayo vratopetā yadidaṃ bhuñjate haviḥ ।
annaṃ brāhmaṇakāmāya kathametatpitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: dvijAtayo vratopetA yadidaM BuYjate haviH । annaM brAhmaRakAmAya kaTametatpitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: avedoktavratopetā bhuñjānāḥ kāryakāriṇaḥ । vedokteṣu ca bhuñjānā vrataluptā yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
html:
avedoktavratopetā bhuñjānāḥ kāryakāriṇaḥ ।
vedokteṣu ca bhuñjānā vrataluptā yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
slp1: avedoktavratopetA BuYjAnAH kAryakAriRaH । vedoktezu ca BuYjAnA vrataluptA yuDizWira ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yadidaṃ tapa ityāhurupavāsaṃ pṛthagjanāḥ । etattapo mahārāja utāho kiṃ tapo bhavet ॥3॥
html:
yadidaṃ tapa ityāhurupavāsaṃ pṛthagjanāḥ ।
etattapo mahārāja utāho kiṃ tapo bhavet ॥3॥
slp1: yadidaM tapa ityAhurupavAsaM pfTagjanAH । etattapo mahArAja utAho kiM tapo Bavet ॥3॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: māsapakṣopavāsena manyante yattapo janāḥ । ātmatantropaghātaḥ sa na tapastatsatāṃ matam । tyāgaśca sannatiścaiva śiṣyate tapa uttamam ॥4॥
html:
māsapakṣopavāsena manyante yattapo janāḥ ।
ātmatantropaghātaḥ sa na tapastatsatāṃ matam ।
tyāgaśca sannatiścaiva śiṣyate tapa uttamam ॥4॥
slp1: mAsapakzopavAsena manyante yattapo janAH । AtmatantropaGAtaH sa na tapastatsatAM matam । tyAgaSca sannatiScEva Sizyate tapa uttamam ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sadopavāsī ca bhavedbrahmacārī sadaiva ca । muniśca syātsadā vipro daivataṃ ca sadā bhajet ॥5॥
html:
sadopavāsī ca bhavedbrahmacārī sadaiva ca ।
muniśca syātsadā vipro daivataṃ ca sadā bhajet ॥5॥
slp1: sadopavAsI ca BavedbrahmacArI sadEva ca । muniSca syAtsadA vipro dEvataM ca sadA Bajet ॥5॥

text: kuṭumbiko dharmakāmaḥ sadāsvapnaśca bhārata । amāṃsāśī sadā ca syātpavitraṃ ca sadā japet ॥6॥
html:
kuṭumbiko dharmakāmaḥ sadāsvapnaśca bhārata ।
amāṃsāśī sadā ca syātpavitraṃ ca sadā japet ॥6॥
slp1: kuwumbiko DarmakAmaH sadAsvapnaSca BArata । amAMsASI sadA ca syAtpavitraM ca sadA japet ॥6॥

text: amṛtāśī sadā ca syānna ca syādviṣabhojanaḥ । vighasāśī sadā ca syātsadā caivātithipriyaḥ ॥7॥
html:
amṛtāśī sadā ca syānna ca syādviṣabhojanaḥ ।
vighasāśī sadā ca syātsadā caivātithipriyaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: amftASI sadA ca syAnna ca syAdvizaBojanaH । viGasASI sadA ca syAtsadA cEvAtiTipriyaH ॥7॥

text: kathaṃ sadopavāsī syādbrahmacārī kathaṃ bhavet । vighasāśī kathaṃ ca syātsadā caivātithipriyaḥ ॥8॥
html:
kathaṃ sadopavāsī syādbrahmacārī kathaṃ bhavet ।
vighasāśī kathaṃ ca syātsadā caivātithipriyaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: kaTaM sadopavAsI syAdbrahmacArI kaTaM Bavet । viGasASI kaTaM ca syAtsadA cEvAtiTipriyaH ॥8॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: antarā prātarāśaṃ ca sāyamāśaṃ tathaiva ca । sadopavāsī ca bhavedyo na bhuṅkte kathañcana ॥9॥
html:
antarā prātarāśaṃ ca sāyamāśaṃ tathaiva ca ।
sadopavāsī ca bhavedyo na bhuṅkte kathañcana ॥9॥
slp1: antarA prAtarASaM ca sAyamASaM taTEva ca । sadopavAsI ca Bavedyo na BuNkte kaTaYcana ॥9॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: bhāryāṃ gacchanbrahmacārī ṛtau bhavati brāhmaṇaḥ । ṛtavādī sadā ca syājjñānanityaśca yo naraḥ ॥10॥
html:
bhāryāṃ gacchanbrahmacārī ṛtau bhavati brāhmaṇaḥ ।
ṛtavādī sadā ca syājjñānanityaśca yo naraḥ ॥10॥
slp1: BAryAM gacCanbrahmacArI ftO Bavati brAhmaRaH । ftavAdI sadA ca syAjjYAnanityaSca yo naraH ॥10॥

text: abhakṣayanvṛthāmāṃsamamāṃsāśī bhavatyuta । dānanityaḥ pavitraśca asvapnaśca divāsvapan ॥11॥
html:
abhakṣayanvṛthāmāṃsamamāṃsāśī bhavatyuta ।
dānanityaḥ pavitraśca asvapnaśca divāsvapan ॥11॥
slp1: aBakzayanvfTAmAMsamamAMsASI Bavatyuta । dAnanityaH pavitraSca asvapnaSca divAsvapan ॥11॥

text: bhṛtyātithiṣu yo bhuṅkte bhuktavatsu sadā sa ha । amṛtaṃ sakalaṃ bhuṅkta iti viddhi yudhiṣṭhira ॥12॥
html:
bhṛtyātithiṣu yo bhuṅkte bhuktavatsu sadā sa ha ।
amṛtaṃ sakalaṃ bhuṅkta iti viddhi yudhiṣṭhira ॥12॥
slp1: BftyAtiTizu yo BuNkte Buktavatsu sadA sa ha । amftaM sakalaM BuNkta iti vidDi yuDizWira ॥12॥

text: abhuktavatsu nāśnānaḥ satataṃ yastu vai dvijaḥ । abhojanena tenāsya jitaḥ svargo bhavatyuta ॥13॥
html:
abhuktavatsu nāśnānaḥ satataṃ yastu vai dvijaḥ ।
abhojanena tenāsya jitaḥ svargo bhavatyuta ॥13॥
slp1: aBuktavatsu nASnAnaH satataM yastu vE dvijaH । aBojanena tenAsya jitaH svargo Bavatyuta ॥13॥

text: devatābhyaḥ pitṛbhyaśca bhṛtyebhyo'tithibhiḥ saha । avaśiṣṭaṃ tu yo'śnāti tamāhurvighasāśinam ॥14॥
html:
devatābhyaḥ pitṛbhyaśca bhṛtyebhyo'tithibhiḥ saha ।
avaśiṣṭaṃ tu yo'śnāti tamāhurvighasāśinam ॥14॥
slp1: devatAByaH pitfByaSca BftyeByo'tiTiBiH saha । avaSizwaM tu yo'SnAti tamAhurviGasASinam ॥14॥

text: teṣāṃ lokā hyaparyantāḥ sadane brahmaṇā saha । upasthitāścāpsarobhiḥ pariyānti divaukasaḥ ॥15॥
html:
teṣāṃ lokā hyaparyantāḥ sadane brahmaṇā saha ।
upasthitāścāpsarobhiḥ pariyānti divaukasaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: tezAM lokA hyaparyantAH sadane brahmaRA saha । upasTitAScApsaroBiH pariyAnti divOkasaH ॥15॥

text: devatābhiśca ye sārdhaṃ pitṛbhiścopabhuñjate । ramante putrapautraiśca teṣāṃ gatiranuttamā] ॥16॥
html:
devatābhiśca ye sārdhaṃ pitṛbhiścopabhuñjate ।
ramante putrapautraiśca teṣāṃ gatiranuttamā] ॥16॥
slp1: devatABiSca ye sArDaM pitfBiScopaBuYjate । ramante putrapOtrESca tezAM gatiranuttamA] ॥16॥

text: yadidaṃ karma loke'smiñśubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham । puruṣaṃ yojayatyeva phalayogena bhārata ॥1॥
html:
yadidaṃ karma loke'smiñśubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham ।
puruṣaṃ yojayatyeva phalayogena bhārata ॥1॥
slp1: yadidaM karma loke'smiYSuBaM vA yadi vASuBam । puruzaM yojayatyeva Palayogena BArata ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kartā svittasya puruṣa utāho neti saṃśayaḥ । etadicchāmi tattvena tvattaḥ śrotuṃ pitāmaha ॥2॥
html:
kartā svittasya puruṣa utāho neti saṃśayaḥ ।
etadicchāmi tattvena tvattaḥ śrotuṃ pitāmaha ॥2॥
slp1: kartA svittasya puruza utAho neti saMSayaH । etadicCAmi tattvena tvattaH SrotuM pitAmaha ॥2॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । prahrādasya ca saṃvādamindrasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥3॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
prahrādasya ca saṃvādamindrasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥3॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । prahrAdasya ca saMvAdamindrasya ca yuDizWira ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: asaktaṃ dhūtapāpmānaṃ kule jātaṃ bahuśrutam । astambhamanahaṅkāraṃ sattvasthaṃ samaye ratam ॥4॥
html:
asaktaṃ dhūtapāpmānaṃ kule jātaṃ bahuśrutam ।
astambhamanahaṅkāraṃ sattvasthaṃ samaye ratam ॥4॥
slp1: asaktaM DUtapApmAnaM kule jAtaM bahuSrutam । astamBamanahaNkAraM sattvasTaM samaye ratam ॥4॥

text: tulyanindāstutiṃ dāntaṃ śūnyāgāraniveśanam । carācarāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ viditaprabhavāpyayam ॥5॥
html:
tulyanindāstutiṃ dāntaṃ śūnyāgāraniveśanam ।
carācarāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ viditaprabhavāpyayam ॥5॥
slp1: tulyanindAstutiM dAntaM SUnyAgAraniveSanam । carAcarARAM BUtAnAM viditapraBavApyayam ॥5॥

text: akrudhyantamahṛṣyantamapriyeṣu priyeṣu ca । kāñcane vātha loṣṭe vā ubhayoḥ samadarśanam ॥6॥
html:
akrudhyantamahṛṣyantamapriyeṣu priyeṣu ca ।
kāñcane vātha loṣṭe vā ubhayoḥ samadarśanam ॥6॥
slp1: akruDyantamahfzyantamapriyezu priyezu ca । kAYcane vATa lozwe vA uBayoH samadarSanam ॥6॥

text: ātmaniḥśreyasajñāne dhīraṃ niścitaniścayam । parāvarajñaṃ bhūtānāṃ sarvajñaṃ samadarśanam ॥7॥
html:
ātmaniḥśreyasajñāne dhīraṃ niścitaniścayam ।
parāvarajñaṃ bhūtānāṃ sarvajñaṃ samadarśanam ॥7॥
slp1: AtmaniHSreyasajYAne DIraM niScitaniScayam । parAvarajYaM BUtAnAM sarvajYaM samadarSanam ॥7॥

text: śakraḥ prahrādamāsīnamekānte saṃyatendriyam । bubhutsamānastatprajñāmabhigamyedamabravīt ॥8॥
html:
śakraḥ prahrādamāsīnamekānte saṃyatendriyam ।
bubhutsamānastatprajñāmabhigamyedamabravīt ॥8॥
slp1: SakraH prahrAdamAsInamekAnte saMyatendriyam । buButsamAnastatprajYAmaBigamyedamabravIt ॥8॥

text: yaiḥ kaiścitsammato loke guṇaiḥ syātpuruṣo nṛṣu । bhavatyanapagānsarvāṃstānguṇāṁllakṣayāmahe ॥9॥
html:
yaiḥ kaiścitsammato loke guṇaiḥ syātpuruṣo nṛṣu ।
bhavatyanapagānsarvāṃstānguṇāṁllakṣayāmahe ॥9॥
slp1: yEH kEScitsammato loke guREH syAtpuruzo nfzu । BavatyanapagAnsarvAMstAnguRAṁllakzayAmahe ॥9॥

text: atha te lakṣyate buddhiḥ samā bālajanairiha । ātmānaṃ manyamānaḥ sañśreyaḥ kimiha manyase ॥10॥
html:
atha te lakṣyate buddhiḥ samā bālajanairiha ।
ātmānaṃ manyamānaḥ sañśreyaḥ kimiha manyase ॥10॥
slp1: aTa te lakzyate budDiH samA bAlajanEriha । AtmAnaM manyamAnaH saYSreyaH kimiha manyase ॥10॥

text: baddhaḥ pāśaiścyutaḥ sthānāddviṣatāṃ vaśamāgataḥ । śriyā vihīnaḥ prahrāda śocitavye na śocasi ॥11॥
html:
baddhaḥ pāśaiścyutaḥ sthānāddviṣatāṃ vaśamāgataḥ ।
śriyā vihīnaḥ prahrāda śocitavye na śocasi ॥11॥
slp1: badDaH pASEScyutaH sTAnAddvizatAM vaSamAgataH । SriyA vihInaH prahrAda Socitavye na Socasi ॥11॥

text: prajñālābhāttu daiteya utāho dhṛtimattayā । prahrāda svastharūpo'si paśyanvyasanamātmanaḥ ॥12॥
html:
prajñālābhāttu daiteya utāho dhṛtimattayā ।
prahrāda svastharūpo'si paśyanvyasanamātmanaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: prajYAlABAttu dEteya utAho DftimattayA । prahrAda svasTarUpo'si paSyanvyasanamAtmanaH ॥12॥

text: iti sañcoditastena dhīro niścitaniścayaḥ । uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā svāṃ prajñāmanuvarṇayan ॥13॥
html:
iti sañcoditastena dhīro niścitaniścayaḥ ।
uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā svāṃ prajñāmanuvarṇayan ॥13॥
slp1: iti saYcoditastena DIro niScitaniScayaH । uvAca SlakzRayA vAcA svAM prajYAmanuvarRayan ॥13॥

text: pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca bhūtānāṃ yo na budhyate । tasya stambho bhavedbālyānnāsti stambho'nupaśyataḥ ॥14॥
html:
pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca bhūtānāṃ yo na budhyate ।
tasya stambho bhavedbālyānnāsti stambho'nupaśyataḥ ॥14॥
slp1: pravfttiM ca nivfttiM ca BUtAnAM yo na buDyate । tasya stamBo BavedbAlyAnnAsti stamBo'nupaSyataH ॥14॥

text: svabhāvātsampravartante nivartante tathaiva ca । sarve bhāvāstathābhāvāḥ puruṣārtho na vidyate ॥15॥
html:
svabhāvātsampravartante nivartante tathaiva ca ।
sarve bhāvāstathābhāvāḥ puruṣārtho na vidyate ॥15॥
slp1: svaBAvAtsampravartante nivartante taTEva ca । sarve BAvAstaTABAvAH puruzArTo na vidyate ॥15॥

text: puruṣārthasya cābhāve nāsti kaścitsvakārakaḥ । svayaṃ tu kurvatastasya jātu māno bhavediha ॥16॥
html:
puruṣārthasya cābhāve nāsti kaścitsvakārakaḥ ।
svayaṃ tu kurvatastasya jātu māno bhavediha ॥16॥
slp1: puruzArTasya cABAve nAsti kaScitsvakArakaH । svayaM tu kurvatastasya jAtu mAno Bavediha ॥16॥

text: yastu kartāramātmānaṃ manyate sādhvasādhunoḥ । tasya doṣavatī prajñā svamūrtyajñeti me matiḥ ॥17॥
html:
yastu kartāramātmānaṃ manyate sādhvasādhunoḥ ।
tasya doṣavatī prajñā svamūrtyajñeti me matiḥ ॥17॥
slp1: yastu kartAramAtmAnaM manyate sADvasADunoH । tasya dozavatI prajYA svamUrtyajYeti me matiH ॥17॥

text: yadi syātpuruṣaḥ kartā śakrātmaśreyase dhruvam । ārambhāstasya sidhyeranna ca jātu parābhavet ॥18॥
html:
yadi syātpuruṣaḥ kartā śakrātmaśreyase dhruvam ।
ārambhāstasya sidhyeranna ca jātu parābhavet ॥18॥
slp1: yadi syAtpuruzaH kartA SakrAtmaSreyase Druvam । AramBAstasya siDyeranna ca jAtu parABavet ॥18॥

text: aniṣṭasya hi nirvṛttiranivṛttiḥ priyasya ca । lakṣyate yatamānānāṃ puruṣārthastataḥ kutaḥ ॥19॥
html:
aniṣṭasya hi nirvṛttiranivṛttiḥ priyasya ca ।
lakṣyate yatamānānāṃ puruṣārthastataḥ kutaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: anizwasya hi nirvfttiranivfttiH priyasya ca । lakzyate yatamAnAnAM puruzArTastataH kutaH ॥19॥

text: aniṣṭasyābhinirvṛttimiṣṭasaṃvṛttimeva ca । aprayatnena paśyāmaḥ keṣāñcittatsvabhāvataḥ ॥20॥
html:
aniṣṭasyābhinirvṛttimiṣṭasaṃvṛttimeva ca ।
aprayatnena paśyāmaḥ keṣāñcittatsvabhāvataḥ ॥20॥
slp1: anizwasyABinirvfttimizwasaMvfttimeva ca । aprayatnena paSyAmaH kezAYcittatsvaBAvataH ॥20॥

text: pratirūpadharāḥ keciddṛśyante buddhisattamāḥ । virūpebhyo'lpabuddhibhyo lipsamānā dhanāgamam ॥21॥
html:
pratirūpadharāḥ keciddṛśyante buddhisattamāḥ ।
virūpebhyo'lpabuddhibhyo lipsamānā dhanāgamam ॥21॥
slp1: pratirUpaDarAH keciddfSyante budDisattamAH । virUpeByo'lpabudDiByo lipsamAnA DanAgamam ॥21॥

text: svabhāvapreritāḥ sarve niviśante guṇā yadā । śubhāśubhāstadā tatra tasya kiṃ mānakāraṇam ॥22॥
html:
svabhāvapreritāḥ sarve niviśante guṇā yadā ।
śubhāśubhāstadā tatra tasya kiṃ mānakāraṇam ॥22॥
slp1: svaBAvapreritAH sarve niviSante guRA yadA । SuBASuBAstadA tatra tasya kiM mAnakAraRam ॥22॥

text: svabhāvādeva tatsarvamiti me niścitā matiḥ । ātmapratiṣṭhitā prajñā mama nāsti tato'nyathā ॥23॥
html:
svabhāvādeva tatsarvamiti me niścitā matiḥ ।
ātmapratiṣṭhitā prajñā mama nāsti tato'nyathā ॥23॥
slp1: svaBAvAdeva tatsarvamiti me niScitA matiH । AtmapratizWitA prajYA mama nAsti tato'nyaTA ॥23॥

text: karmajaṃ tviha manye'haṃ phalayogaṃ śubhāśubham । karmaṇāṃ viṣayaṃ kṛtsnamahaṃ vakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu ॥24॥
html:
karmajaṃ tviha manye'haṃ phalayogaṃ śubhāśubham ।
karmaṇāṃ viṣayaṃ kṛtsnamahaṃ vakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu ॥24॥
slp1: karmajaM tviha manye'haM PalayogaM SuBASuBam । karmaRAM vizayaM kftsnamahaM vakzyAmi tacCfRu ॥24॥

text: yathā vedayate kaścidodanaṃ vāyaso vadan । evaṃ sarvāṇi karmāṇi svabhāvasyaiva lakṣaṇam ॥25॥
html:
yathā vedayate kaścidodanaṃ vāyaso vadan ।
evaṃ sarvāṇi karmāṇi svabhāvasyaiva lakṣaṇam ॥25॥
slp1: yaTA vedayate kaScidodanaM vAyaso vadan । evaM sarvARi karmARi svaBAvasyEva lakzaRam ॥25॥

text: vikārāneva yo veda na veda prakṛtiṃ parām । tasya stambho bhavedbālyānnāsti stambho'nupaśyataḥ ॥26॥
html:
vikārāneva yo veda na veda prakṛtiṃ parām ।
tasya stambho bhavedbālyānnāsti stambho'nupaśyataḥ ॥26॥
slp1: vikArAneva yo veda na veda prakftiM parAm । tasya stamBo BavedbAlyAnnAsti stamBo'nupaSyataH ॥26॥

text: svabhāvabhāvino bhāvānsarvāneveha niścaye । budhyamānasya darpo vā māno vā kiṃ kariṣyati ॥27॥
html:
svabhāvabhāvino bhāvānsarvāneveha niścaye ।
budhyamānasya darpo vā māno vā kiṃ kariṣyati ॥27॥
slp1: svaBAvaBAvino BAvAnsarvAneveha niScaye । buDyamAnasya darpo vA mAno vA kiM karizyati ॥27॥

text: veda dharmavidhiṃ kṛtsnaṃ bhūtānāṃ cāpyanityatām । tasmācchakra na śocāmi sarvaṃ hyevedamantavat ॥28॥

veda dharmavidhiṃ kṛtsnaṃ bhūtānāṃ cāpyanityatām ।

slp1: veda DarmaviDiM kftsnaM BUtAnAM cApyanityatAm । tasmAcCakra na SocAmi sarvaM hyevedamantavat ॥28॥

text: nirmamo nirahaṅkāro nirīho muktabandhanaḥ । svastho'vyapetaḥ paśyāmi bhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayau ॥29॥
html:
nirmamo nirahaṅkāro nirīho muktabandhanaḥ ।
svastho'vyapetaḥ paśyāmi bhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayau ॥29॥
slp1: nirmamo nirahaNkAro nirIho muktabanDanaH । svasTo'vyapetaH paSyAmi BUtAnAM praBavApyayO ॥29॥

text: kṛtaprajñasya dāntasya vitṛṣṇasya nirāśiṣaḥ । nāyāso vidyate śakra paśyato lokavidyayā ॥30॥
html:
kṛtaprajñasya dāntasya vitṛṣṇasya nirāśiṣaḥ ।
nāyāso vidyate śakra paśyato lokavidyayā ॥30॥
slp1: kftaprajYasya dAntasya vitfzRasya nirASizaH । nAyAso vidyate Sakra paSyato lokavidyayA ॥30॥

text: prakṛtau ca vikāre ca na me prītirna ca dviṣe । dveṣṭāraṃ na ca paśyāmi yo mamādya mamāyate ॥31॥
html:
prakṛtau ca vikāre ca na me prītirna ca dviṣe ।
dveṣṭāraṃ na ca paśyāmi yo mamādya mamāyate ॥31॥
slp1: prakftO ca vikAre ca na me prItirna ca dvize । dvezwAraM na ca paSyAmi yo mamAdya mamAyate ॥31॥

text: nordhvaṃ nāvāṅna tiryakca na kvacicchakra kāmaye । na vijñāne na vijñeye nājñāne śarma vidyate ॥32॥
html:
nordhvaṃ nāvāṅna tiryakca na kvacicchakra kāmaye ।
na vijñāne na vijñeye nājñāne śarma vidyate ॥32॥
slp1: norDvaM nAvANna tiryakca na kvacicCakra kAmaye । na vijYAne na vijYeye nAjYAne Sarma vidyate ॥32॥

text: yenaiṣā labhyate prajñā yena śāntiravāpyate । prabrūhi tamupāyaṃ me samyakprahrāda pṛcchate ॥33॥
html:
yenaiṣā labhyate prajñā yena śāntiravāpyate ।

slp1: yenEzA laByate prajYA yena SAntiravApyate । prabrUhi tamupAyaM me samyakprahrAda pfcCate ॥33॥

text: ārjavenāpramādena prasādenātmavattayā । vṛddhaśuśrūṣayā śakra puruṣo labhate mahat ॥34॥
html:
ārjavenāpramādena prasādenātmavattayā ।

slp1: ArjavenApramAdena prasAdenAtmavattayA । vfdDaSuSrUzayA Sakra puruzo laBate mahat ॥34॥

text: svabhāvāllabhate prajñāṃ śāntimeti svabhāvataḥ । svabhāvādeva tatsarvaṃ yatkiñcidanupaśyasi ॥35॥
html:
svabhāvāllabhate prajñāṃ śāntimeti svabhāvataḥ ।
svabhāvādeva tatsarvaṃ yatkiñcidanupaśyasi ॥35॥
slp1: svaBAvAllaBate prajYAM SAntimeti svaBAvataH । svaBAvAdeva tatsarvaM yatkiYcidanupaSyasi ॥35॥

text: ityukto daityapatinā śakro vismayamāgamat । prītimāṃśca tadā rājaṃstadvākyaṃ pratyapūjayat ॥36॥
html:
ityukto daityapatinā śakro vismayamāgamat ।

slp1: ityukto dEtyapatinA Sakro vismayamAgamat । prItimAMSca tadA rAjaMstadvAkyaM pratyapUjayat ॥36॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sa tadābhyarcya daityendraṃ trailokyapatirīśvaraḥ । asurendramupāmantrya jagāma svaṃ niveśanam] ॥37॥
html:

asurendramupāmantrya jagāma svaṃ niveśanam] ॥37॥
slp1: sa tadAByarcya dEtyendraM trElokyapatirISvaraH । asurendramupAmantrya jagAma svaM niveSanam] ॥37॥

text: yayā buddhyā mahīpālo bhraṣṭaśrīrvicarenmahīm । kāladaṇḍaviniṣpiṣṭastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
yayā buddhyā mahīpālo bhraṣṭaśrīrvicarenmahīm ।
kāladaṇḍaviniṣpiṣṭastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: yayA budDyA mahIpAlo BrazwaSrIrvicarenmahIm । kAladaRqavinizpizwastanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । vāsavasya ca saṃvādaṃ balervairocanasya ca ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।

slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । vAsavasya ca saMvAdaM balervErocanasya ca ॥2॥

text: pitāmahamupāgatya praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ । sarvānevāsurāñjitvā baliṃ papraccha vāsavaḥ ॥3॥
html:
pitāmahamupāgatya praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ ।

slp1: pitAmahamupAgatya praRipatya kftAYjaliH । sarvAnevAsurAYjitvA baliM papracCa vAsavaH ॥3॥

text: yasya sma dadato vittaṃ na kadācana hīyate । taṃ baliṃ nādhigacchāmi brahmannācakṣva me balim ॥4॥
html:

taṃ baliṃ nādhigacchāmi brahmannācakṣva me balim ॥4॥
slp1: yasya sma dadato vittaM na kadAcana hIyate । taM baliM nADigacCAmi brahmannAcakzva me balim ॥4॥

text: sa eva hyastamayate sa sma vidyotate diśaḥ । sa varṣati sma varṣāṇi yathākālamatandritaḥ । taṃ baliṃ nādhigacchāmi brahmannācakṣva me balim ॥5॥
html:
sa eva hyastamayate sa sma vidyotate diśaḥ ।
sa varṣati sma varṣāṇi yathākālamatandritaḥ ।
taṃ baliṃ nādhigacchāmi brahmannācakṣva me balim ॥5॥
slp1: sa eva hyastamayate sa sma vidyotate diSaH । sa varzati sma varzARi yaTAkAlamatandritaH । taM baliM nADigacCAmi brahmannAcakzva me balim ॥5॥

text: sa vāyurvaruṇaścaiva sa raviḥ sa ca candramāḥ । so'gnistapati bhūtāni pṛthivī ca bhavatyuta । taṃ baliṃ nādhigacchāmi brahmannācakṣva me balim ॥6॥
html:
sa vāyurvaruṇaścaiva sa raviḥ sa ca candramāḥ ।
so'gnistapati bhūtāni pṛthivī ca bhavatyuta ।
taṃ baliṃ nādhigacchāmi brahmannācakṣva me balim ॥6॥
slp1: sa vAyurvaruRaScEva sa raviH sa ca candramAH । so'gnistapati BUtAni pfTivI ca Bavatyuta । taM baliM nADigacCAmi brahmannAcakzva me balim ॥6॥

text: naitatte sādhu maghavanyadetadanupṛcchasi । pṛṣṭastu nānṛtaṃ brūyāttasmādvakṣyāmi te balim ॥7॥
html:
naitatte sādhu maghavanyadetadanupṛcchasi ।
pṛṣṭastu nānṛtaṃ brūyāttasmādvakṣyāmi te balim ॥7॥
slp1: nEtatte sADu maGavanyadetadanupfcCasi । pfzwastu nAnftaM brUyAttasmAdvakzyAmi te balim ॥7॥

text: uṣṭreṣu yadi vā goṣu khareṣvaśveṣu vā punaḥ । variṣṭho bhavitā jantuḥ śūnyāgāre śacīpate ॥8॥
html:
uṣṭreṣu yadi vā goṣu khareṣvaśveṣu vā punaḥ ।
variṣṭho bhavitā jantuḥ śūnyāgāre śacīpate ॥8॥
slp1: uzwrezu yadi vA gozu KarezvaSvezu vA punaH । varizWo BavitA jantuH SUnyAgAre SacIpate ॥8॥

text: yadi sma balinā brahmañśūnyāgāre sameyivān । hanyāmenaṃ na vā hanyāṃ tadbrahmannanuśādhi mām ॥9॥
html:
yadi sma balinā brahmañśūnyāgāre sameyivān ।
hanyāmenaṃ na vā hanyāṃ tadbrahmannanuśādhi mām ॥9॥
slp1: yadi sma balinA brahmaYSUnyAgAre sameyivAn । hanyAmenaM na vA hanyAM tadbrahmannanuSADi mAm ॥9॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: mā sma śakra baliṃ hiṃsīrna balirvadhamarhati । nyāyāṃstu śakra praṣṭavyastvayā vāsava kāmyayā ॥10॥
html:
mā sma śakra baliṃ hiṃsīrna balirvadhamarhati ।
nyāyāṃstu śakra praṣṭavyastvayā vāsava kāmyayā ॥10॥
slp1: mA sma Sakra baliM hiMsIrna balirvaDamarhati । nyAyAMstu Sakra prazwavyastvayA vAsava kAmyayA ॥10॥
author: brahmovāca ।

text: evamukto bhagavatā mahendraḥ pṛthivīṃ tadā । cacārairāvataskandhamadhiruhya śriyā vṛtaḥ ॥11॥
html:
evamukto bhagavatā mahendraḥ pṛthivīṃ tadā ।
cacārairāvataskandhamadhiruhya śriyā vṛtaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: evamukto BagavatA mahendraH pfTivIM tadA । cacArErAvataskanDamaDiruhya SriyA vftaH ॥11॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tato dadarśa sa baliṃ kharaveṣeṇa saṃvṛtam । yathākhyātaṃ bhagavatā śūnyāgārakṛtālayam ॥12॥
html:
tato dadarśa sa baliṃ kharaveṣeṇa saṃvṛtam ।
yathākhyātaṃ bhagavatā śūnyāgārakṛtālayam ॥12॥
slp1: tato dadarSa sa baliM KaravezeRa saMvftam । yaTAKyAtaM BagavatA SUnyAgArakftAlayam ॥12॥

text: kharayonimanuprāptastuṣabhakṣo'si dānava । iyaṃ te yoniradhamā śocasyāho na śocasi ॥13॥
html:

slp1: KarayonimanuprAptastuzaBakzo'si dAnava । iyaM te yoniraDamA SocasyAho na Socasi ॥13॥

text: adṛṣṭaṃ bata paśyāmi dviṣatāṃ vaśamāgatam । śriyā vihīnaṃ mitraiśca bhraṣṭavīryaparākramam ॥14॥
html:

śriyā vihīnaṃ mitraiśca bhraṣṭavīryaparākramam ॥14॥
slp1: adfzwaM bata paSyAmi dvizatAM vaSamAgatam । SriyA vihInaM mitrESca BrazwavIryaparAkramam ॥14॥

text: yattadyānasahasreṇa jñātibhiḥ parivāritaḥ । lokānpratāpayansarvānyāsyasmānavitarkayan ॥15॥
html:
yattadyānasahasreṇa jñātibhiḥ parivāritaḥ ।
lokānpratāpayansarvānyāsyasmānavitarkayan ॥15॥

text: tvanmukhāścaiva daiteyā vyatiṣṭhaṃstava śāsane । akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī tavaiśvarye babhūva ha । idaṃ ca te'dya vyasanaṃ śocasyāho na śocasi ॥16॥
html:
tvanmukhāścaiva daiteyā vyatiṣṭhaṃstava śāsane ।
akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī tavaiśvarye babhūva ha ।
idaṃ ca te'dya vyasanaṃ śocasyāho na śocasi ॥16॥
slp1: tvanmuKAScEva dEteyA vyatizWaMstava SAsane । akfzwapacyA pfTivI tavESvarye baBUva ha । idaM ca te'dya vyasanaM SocasyAho na Socasi ॥16॥

text: yadātiṣṭhaḥ samudrasya pūrvakūle vilelihan । jñātibhyo vibhajanvittaṃ tadāsītte manaḥ katham ॥17॥
html:
yadātiṣṭhaḥ samudrasya pūrvakūle vilelihan ।
jñātibhyo vibhajanvittaṃ tadāsītte manaḥ katham ॥17॥
slp1: yadAtizWaH samudrasya pUrvakUle vilelihan । jYAtiByo viBajanvittaM tadAsItte manaH kaTam ॥17॥

text: yatte sahasrasamitā nanṛturdevayoṣitaḥ । bahūni varṣapūgāni vihāre dīpyataḥ śriyā ॥18॥
html:
yatte sahasrasamitā nanṛturdevayoṣitaḥ ।
bahūni varṣapūgāni vihāre dīpyataḥ śriyā ॥18॥
slp1: yatte sahasrasamitA nanfturdevayozitaH । bahUni varzapUgAni vihAre dIpyataH SriyA ॥18॥

text: sarvāḥ puṣkaramālinyaḥ sarvāḥ kāñcanasaprabhāḥ । kathamadya tadā caiva manaste dānaveśvara ॥19॥
html:
sarvāḥ puṣkaramālinyaḥ sarvāḥ kāñcanasaprabhāḥ ।
kathamadya tadā caiva manaste dānaveśvara ॥19॥
slp1: sarvAH puzkaramAlinyaH sarvAH kAYcanasapraBAH । kaTamadya tadA cEva manaste dAnaveSvara ॥19॥

text: chatraṃ tavāsītsumahatsauvarṇaṃ maṇibhūṣitam । nanṛturyatra gandharvāḥ ṣaṭsahasrāṇi saptadhā ॥20॥
html:
chatraṃ tavāsītsumahatsauvarṇaṃ maṇibhūṣitam ।
nanṛturyatra gandharvāḥ ṣaṭsahasrāṇi saptadhā ॥20॥
slp1: CatraM tavAsItsumahatsOvarRaM maRiBUzitam । nanfturyatra ganDarvAH zawsahasrARi saptaDA ॥20॥

text: yūpastavāsītsumahānyajataḥ sarvakāñcanaḥ । yatrādadaḥ sahasrāṇāmayutāni gavāṃ daśa ॥21॥
html:
yūpastavāsītsumahānyajataḥ sarvakāñcanaḥ ।
yatrādadaḥ sahasrāṇāmayutāni gavāṃ daśa ॥21॥
slp1: yUpastavAsItsumahAnyajataH sarvakAYcanaH । yatrAdadaH sahasrARAmayutAni gavAM daSa ॥21॥

text: yadā tu pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ yajamāno'nuparyayāḥ । śamyākṣepeṇa vidhinā tadāsītkiṃ nu te hṛdi ॥22॥
html:
yadā tu pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ yajamāno'nuparyayāḥ ।
śamyākṣepeṇa vidhinā tadāsītkiṃ nu te hṛdi ॥22॥
slp1: yadA tu pfTivIM sarvAM yajamAno'nuparyayAH । SamyAkzepeRa viDinA tadAsItkiM nu te hfdi ॥22॥

text: na te paśyāmi bhṛṅgāraṃ na chatraṃ vyajanaṃ na ca । brahmadattāṃ ca te mālāṃ na paśyāmyasurādhipa ॥23॥
html:
na te paśyāmi bhṛṅgāraṃ na chatraṃ vyajanaṃ na ca ।
brahmadattāṃ ca te mālāṃ na paśyāmyasurādhipa ॥23॥
slp1: na te paSyAmi BfNgAraM na CatraM vyajanaM na ca । brahmadattAM ca te mAlAM na paSyAmyasurADipa ॥23॥

text: na tvaṃ paśyasi bhṛṅgāraṃ na chatraṃ vyajanaṃ na ca । brahmadattāṃ ca me mālāṃ na tvaṃ drakṣyasi vāsava ॥24॥
html:
na tvaṃ paśyasi bhṛṅgāraṃ na chatraṃ vyajanaṃ na ca ।
brahmadattāṃ ca me mālāṃ na tvaṃ drakṣyasi vāsava ॥24॥
slp1: na tvaM paSyasi BfNgAraM na CatraM vyajanaM na ca । brahmadattAM ca me mAlAM na tvaM drakzyasi vAsava ॥24॥
author: baliruvāca ।

text: guhāyāṃ nihitāni tvaṃ mama ratnāni pṛcchasi । yadā me bhavitā kālastadā tvaṃ tāni drakṣyasi ॥25॥
html:
guhāyāṃ nihitāni tvaṃ mama ratnāni pṛcchasi ।
yadā me bhavitā kālastadā tvaṃ tāni drakṣyasi ॥25॥
slp1: guhAyAM nihitAni tvaM mama ratnAni pfcCasi । yadA me BavitA kAlastadA tvaM tAni drakzyasi ॥25॥

text: na tvetadanurūpaṃ te yaśaso vā kulasya vā । samṛddhārtho'samṛddhārthaṃ yanmāṃ katthitumicchasi ॥26॥
html:
na tvetadanurūpaṃ te yaśaso vā kulasya vā ।
samṛddhārtho'samṛddhārthaṃ yanmāṃ katthitumicchasi ॥26॥
slp1: na tvetadanurUpaM te yaSaso vA kulasya vA । samfdDArTo'samfdDArTaM yanmAM katTitumicCasi ॥26॥

text: na hi duḥkheṣu śocanti na prahṛṣyanti carddhiṣu । kṛtaprajñā jñānatṛptāḥ kṣāntāḥ santo manīṣiṇaḥ ॥27॥
html:
na hi duḥkheṣu śocanti na prahṛṣyanti carddhiṣu ।
kṛtaprajñā jñānatṛptāḥ kṣāntāḥ santo manīṣiṇaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: na hi duHKezu Socanti na prahfzyanti cardDizu । kftaprajYA jYAnatfptAH kzAntAH santo manIziRaH ॥27॥

text: tvaṃ tu prākṛtayā buddhyā purandara vikatthase । yadāhamiva bhāvī tvaṃ tadā naivaṃ vadiṣyasi] ॥28॥
html:
tvaṃ tu prākṛtayā buddhyā purandara vikatthase ।
yadāhamiva bhāvī tvaṃ tadā naivaṃ vadiṣyasi] ॥28॥
slp1: tvaM tu prAkftayA budDyA purandara vikatTase । yadAhamiva BAvI tvaM tadA nEvaM vadizyasi] ॥28॥

text: punareva tu taṃ śakraḥ prahasannidamabravīt । niḥśvasantaṃ yathā nāgaṃ pravyāhārāya bhārata ॥1॥
html:
punareva tu taṃ śakraḥ prahasannidamabravīt ।
niḥśvasantaṃ yathā nāgaṃ pravyāhārāya bhārata ॥1॥
slp1: punareva tu taM SakraH prahasannidamabravIt । niHSvasantaM yaTA nAgaM pravyAhArAya BArata ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yattadyānasahasreṇa jñātibhiḥ parivāritaḥ । lokānpratāpayansarvānyāsyasmānavitarkayan ॥2॥
html:
yattadyānasahasreṇa jñātibhiḥ parivāritaḥ ।
lokānpratāpayansarvānyāsyasmānavitarkayan ॥2॥

text: dṛṣṭvā sukṛpaṇāṃ cemāmavasthāmātmano bale । jñātimitraparityaktaḥ śocasyāho na śocasi ॥3॥
html:
dṛṣṭvā sukṛpaṇāṃ cemāmavasthāmātmano bale ।
jñātimitraparityaktaḥ śocasyāho na śocasi ॥3॥
slp1: dfzwvA sukfpaRAM cemAmavasTAmAtmano bale । jYAtimitraparityaktaH SocasyAho na Socasi ॥3॥

text: prītiṃ prāpyātulāṃ pūrvaṃ lokāṃścātmavaśe sthitān । vinipātamimaṃ cādya śocasyāho na śocasi ॥4॥
html:
prītiṃ prāpyātulāṃ pūrvaṃ lokāṃścātmavaśe sthitān ।
vinipātamimaṃ cādya śocasyāho na śocasi ॥4॥
slp1: prItiM prApyAtulAM pUrvaM lokAMScAtmavaSe sTitAn । vinipAtamimaM cAdya SocasyAho na Socasi ॥4॥

text: anityamupalakṣyedaṃ kālaparyāyamātmanaḥ । tasmācchakra na śocāmi sarvaṃ hyevedamantavat ॥5॥

text: antavanta ime dehā bhūtānāmamarādhipa । tena śakra na śocāmi nāparādhādidaṃ mama ॥6॥

slp1: antavanta ime dehA BUtAnAmamarADipa । tena Sakra na SocAmi nAparADAdidaM mama ॥6॥

text: jīvitaṃ ca śarīraṃ ca pretya vai saha jāyate । ubhe saha vivardhete ubhe saha vinaśyataḥ ॥7॥

slp1: jIvitaM ca SarIraM ca pretya vE saha jAyate । uBe saha vivarDete uBe saha vinaSyataH ॥7॥

text: tadīdṛśamidaṃ bhāvamavaśaḥ prāpya kevalam । yadyevamabhijānāmi kā vyathā me vijānataḥ ॥8॥
html:
tadīdṛśamidaṃ bhāvamavaśaḥ prāpya kevalam ।
yadyevamabhijānāmi kā vyathā me vijānataḥ ॥8॥

text: bhūtānāṃ nidhanaṃ niṣṭhā srotasāmiva sāgaraḥ । naitatsamyagvijānanto narā muhyanti vajrabhṛt ॥9॥
html:
bhūtānāṃ nidhanaṃ niṣṭhā srotasāmiva sāgaraḥ ।

slp1: BUtAnAM niDanaM nizWA srotasAmiva sAgaraH । nEtatsamyagvijAnanto narA muhyanti vajraBft ॥9॥

text: ye tvevaṃ nābhijānanti rajomohaparāyaṇāḥ । te kṛcchraṃ prāpya sīdanti buddhiryeṣāṃ praṇaśyati ॥10॥

text: buddhilābhe hi puruṣaḥ sarvaṃ nudati kilbiṣam । vipāpmā labhate sattvaṃ sattvasthaḥ samprasīdati ॥11॥
html:
buddhilābhe hi puruṣaḥ sarvaṃ nudati kilbiṣam ।
vipāpmā labhate sattvaṃ sattvasthaḥ samprasīdati ॥11॥
slp1: budDilABe hi puruzaH sarvaM nudati kilbizam । vipApmA laBate sattvaM sattvasTaH samprasIdati ॥11॥

text: tatastu ye nivartante jāyante vā punaḥ punaḥ । kṛpaṇāḥ paritapyante te'narthaiḥ paricoditāḥ ॥12॥
html:
tatastu ye nivartante jāyante vā punaḥ punaḥ ।
kṛpaṇāḥ paritapyante te'narthaiḥ paricoditāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: tatastu ye nivartante jAyante vA punaH punaH । kfpaRAH paritapyante te'narTEH paricoditAH ॥12॥

text: arthasiddhimanarthaṃ ca jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ tathā । sukhaduḥkhaphalaṃ caiva na dveṣmi na ca kāmaye ॥13॥
html:
arthasiddhimanarthaṃ ca jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ tathā ।
sukhaduḥkhaphalaṃ caiva na dveṣmi na ca kāmaye ॥13॥
slp1: arTasidDimanarTaM ca jIvitaM maraRaM taTA । suKaduHKaPalaM cEva na dvezmi na ca kAmaye ॥13॥

text: hataṃ hanti hato hyeva yo naro hanti kañcana । ubhau tau na vijānīto yaśca hanti hataśca yaḥ ॥14॥
html:
hataṃ hanti hato hyeva yo naro hanti kañcana ।
ubhau tau na vijānīto yaśca hanti hataśca yaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: hataM hanti hato hyeva yo naro hanti kaYcana । uBO tO na vijAnIto yaSca hanti hataSca yaH ॥14॥

text: hatvā jitvā ca maghavanyaḥ kaścitpuruṣāyate । akartā hyeva bhavati kartā tveva karoti tat ॥15॥
html:
hatvā jitvā ca maghavanyaḥ kaścitpuruṣāyate ।
akartā hyeva bhavati kartā tveva karoti tat ॥15॥
slp1: hatvA jitvA ca maGavanyaH kaScitpuruzAyate । akartA hyeva Bavati kartA tveva karoti tat ॥15॥

text: ko hi lokasya kurute vināśaprabhavāvubhau । kṛtaṃ hi tatkṛtenaiva kartā tasyāpi cāparaḥ ॥16॥
html:

slp1: ko hi lokasya kurute vinASapraBavAvuBO । kftaM hi tatkftenEva kartA tasyApi cAparaH ॥16॥

text: pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam । etadyonīni bhūtāni tatra kā paridevanā ॥17॥
html:
pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam ।
etadyonīni bhūtāni tatra kā paridevanā ॥17॥
slp1: pfTivI vAyurAkASamApo jyotiSca paYcamam । etadyonIni BUtAni tatra kA paridevanA ॥17॥

text: mahāvidyo'lpavidyaśca balavāndurbalaśca yaḥ । darśanīyo virūpaśca subhago durbhagaśca yaḥ ॥18॥

text: sarvaṃ kālaḥ samādatte gambhīraḥ svena tejasā । tasminkālavaśaṃ prāpte kā vyathā me vijānataḥ ॥19॥
html:
sarvaṃ kālaḥ samādatte gambhīraḥ svena tejasā ।
tasminkālavaśaṃ prāpte kā vyathā me vijānataḥ ॥19॥
slp1: sarvaM kAlaH samAdatte gamBIraH svena tejasA । tasminkAlavaSaM prApte kA vyaTA me vijAnataH ॥19॥

text: dagdhamevānudahati hatamevānuhanti ca । naśyate naṣṭamevāgre labdhavyaṃ labhate naraḥ ॥20॥
html:

slp1: dagDamevAnudahati hatamevAnuhanti ca । naSyate nazwamevAgre labDavyaM laBate naraH ॥20॥

text: nāsya dvīpaḥ kutaḥ pāraṃ nāvāraḥ sampradṛśyate । nāntamasya prapaśyāmi vidherdivyasya cintayan ॥21॥
html:
nāsya dvīpaḥ kutaḥ pāraṃ nāvāraḥ sampradṛśyate ।
nāntamasya prapaśyāmi vidherdivyasya cintayan ॥21॥
slp1: nAsya dvIpaH kutaH pAraM nAvAraH sampradfSyate । nAntamasya prapaSyAmi viDerdivyasya cintayan ॥21॥

text: yadi me paśyataḥ kālo bhūtāni na vināśayet । syānme harṣaśca darpaśca krodhaścaiva śacīpate ॥22॥
html:
yadi me paśyataḥ kālo bhūtāni na vināśayet ।
syānme harṣaśca darpaśca krodhaścaiva śacīpate ॥22॥
slp1: yadi me paSyataH kAlo BUtAni na vinASayet । syAnme harzaSca darpaSca kroDaScEva SacIpate ॥22॥

text: tuṣabhakṣaṃ tu māṃ jñātvā praviviktajane gṛhe । bibhrataṃ gārdabhaṃ rūpamādiśya parigarhase ॥23॥
html:
tuṣabhakṣaṃ tu māṃ jñātvā praviviktajane gṛhe ।
bibhrataṃ gārdabhaṃ rūpamādiśya parigarhase ॥23॥
slp1: tuzaBakzaM tu mAM jYAtvA praviviktajane gfhe । biBrataM gArdaBaM rUpamAdiSya parigarhase ॥23॥

text: icchannahaṃ vikuryāṃ hi rūpāṇi bahudhātmanaḥ । vibhīṣaṇāni yānīkṣya palāyethāstvameva me ॥24॥
html:
icchannahaṃ vikuryāṃ hi rūpāṇi bahudhātmanaḥ ।
vibhīṣaṇāni yānīkṣya palāyethāstvameva me ॥24॥
slp1: icCannahaM vikuryAM hi rUpARi bahuDAtmanaH । viBIzaRAni yAnIkzya palAyeTAstvameva me ॥24॥

text: kālaḥ sarvaṃ samādatte kālaḥ sarvaṃ prayacchati । kālena vidhṛtaṃ sarvaṃ mā kṛthāḥ śakra pauruṣam ॥25॥
html:
