purā sarvaṃ pravyathate mayi kruddhe purandara ।
avaimi tvasya lokasya dharmaṃ śakra sanātanam ॥26॥
slp1: purA sarvaM pravyaTate mayi krudDe purandara । avEmi tvasya lokasya DarmaM Sakra sanAtanam ॥26॥

text: tvamapyevamapekṣasva mātmanā vismayaṃ gamaḥ । prabhavaśca prabhāvaśca nātmasaṃsthaḥ kadācana ॥27॥
html:
tvamapyevamapekṣasva mātmanā vismayaṃ gamaḥ ।
prabhavaśca prabhāvaśca nātmasaṃsthaḥ kadācana ॥27॥
slp1: tvamapyevamapekzasva mAtmanA vismayaM gamaH । praBavaSca praBAvaSca nAtmasaMsTaH kadAcana ॥27॥

text: kaumārameva te cittaṃ tathaivādya yathā purā । samavekṣasva maghavanbuddhiṃ vindasva naiṣṭhikīm ॥28॥
html:
kaumārameva te cittaṃ tathaivādya yathā purā ।
samavekṣasva maghavanbuddhiṃ vindasva naiṣṭhikīm ॥28॥
slp1: kOmArameva te cittaM taTEvAdya yaTA purA । samavekzasva maGavanbudDiM vindasva nEzWikIm ॥28॥

text: devā manuṣyāḥ pitaro gandharvoragarākṣasāḥ । āsansarve mama vaśe tatsarvaṃ vettha vāsava ॥29॥
html:
devā manuṣyāḥ pitaro gandharvoragarākṣasāḥ ।
āsansarve mama vaśe tatsarvaṃ vettha vāsava ॥29॥
slp1: devA manuzyAH pitaro ganDarvoragarAkzasAH । Asansarve mama vaSe tatsarvaM vetTa vAsava ॥29॥

text: namastasyai diśe'pyastu yasyāṃ vairocano baliḥ । iti māmabhyapadyanta buddhimātsaryamohitāḥ ॥30॥
html:
namastasyai diśe'pyastu yasyāṃ vairocano baliḥ ।
iti māmabhyapadyanta buddhimātsaryamohitāḥ ॥30॥
slp1: namastasyE diSe'pyastu yasyAM vErocano baliH । iti mAmaByapadyanta budDimAtsaryamohitAH ॥30॥

text: nāhaṃ tadanuśocāmi nātmabhraṃśaṃ śacīpate । evaṃ me niścitā buddhiḥ śāstustiṣṭhāmyahaṃ vaśe ॥31॥
html:
nāhaṃ tadanuśocāmi nātmabhraṃśaṃ śacīpate ।
evaṃ me niścitā buddhiḥ śāstustiṣṭhāmyahaṃ vaśe ॥31॥
slp1: nAhaM tadanuSocAmi nAtmaBraMSaM SacIpate । evaM me niScitA budDiH SAstustizWAmyahaM vaSe ॥31॥

text: dṛśyate hi kule jāto darśanīyaḥ pratāpavān । duḥkhaṃ jīvansahāmātyo bhavitavyaṃ hi tattathā ॥32॥
html:
dṛśyate hi kule jāto darśanīyaḥ pratāpavān ।
duḥkhaṃ jīvansahāmātyo bhavitavyaṃ hi tattathā ॥32॥
slp1: dfSyate hi kule jAto darSanIyaH pratApavAn । duHKaM jIvansahAmAtyo BavitavyaM hi tattaTA ॥32॥

text: dauṣkuleyastathā mūḍho durjātaḥ śakra dṛśyate । sukhaṃ jīvansahāmātyo bhavitavyaṃ hi tattathā ॥33॥
html:
dauṣkuleyastathā mūḍho durjātaḥ śakra dṛśyate ।
sukhaṃ jīvansahāmātyo bhavitavyaṃ hi tattathā ॥33॥
slp1: dOzkuleyastaTA mUQo durjAtaH Sakra dfSyate । suKaM jIvansahAmAtyo BavitavyaM hi tattaTA ॥33॥

text: kalyāṇī rūpasampannā durbhagā śakra dṛśyate । alakṣaṇā virūpā ca subhagā śakra dṛśyate ॥34॥
html:
kalyāṇī rūpasampannā durbhagā śakra dṛśyate ।
alakṣaṇā virūpā ca subhagā śakra dṛśyate ॥34॥
slp1: kalyARI rUpasampannA durBagA Sakra dfSyate । alakzaRA virUpA ca suBagA Sakra dfSyate ॥34॥

text: naitadasmatkṛtaṃ śakra naitacchakra tvayā kṛtam । yattvamevaṅgato vajrinyadvāpyevaṅgatā vayam ॥35॥
html:
naitadasmatkṛtaṃ śakra naitacchakra tvayā kṛtam ।
yattvamevaṅgato vajrinyadvāpyevaṅgatā vayam ॥35॥
slp1: nEtadasmatkftaM Sakra nEtacCakra tvayA kftam । yattvamevaNgato vajrinyadvApyevaNgatA vayam ॥35॥

text: na karma tava nānyeṣāṃ kuto mama śatakrato । ṛddhirvāpyatha vā narddhiḥ paryāyakṛtameva tat ॥36॥
html:
na karma tava nānyeṣāṃ kuto mama śatakrato ।
ṛddhirvāpyatha vā narddhiḥ paryāyakṛtameva tat ॥36॥
slp1: na karma tava nAnyezAM kuto mama Satakrato । fdDirvApyaTa vA nardDiH paryAyakftameva tat ॥36॥

text: paśyāmi tvā virājantaṃ devarājamavasthitam । śrīmantaṃ dyutimantaṃ ca garjantaṃ ca mamopari ॥37॥
html:
paśyāmi tvā virājantaṃ devarājamavasthitam ।
śrīmantaṃ dyutimantaṃ ca garjantaṃ ca mamopari ॥37॥
slp1: paSyAmi tvA virAjantaM devarAjamavasTitam । SrImantaM dyutimantaM ca garjantaM ca mamopari ॥37॥

text: etaccaivaṃ na cetkālo māmākramya sthito bhavet । pātayeyamahaṃ tvādya savajramapi muṣṭinā ॥38॥
html:
etaccaivaṃ na cetkālo māmākramya sthito bhavet ।
pātayeyamahaṃ tvādya savajramapi muṣṭinā ॥38॥
slp1: etaccEvaM na cetkAlo mAmAkramya sTito Bavet । pAtayeyamahaM tvAdya savajramapi muzwinA ॥38॥

text: na tu vikramakālo'yaṃ kṣamākālo'yamāgataḥ । kālaḥ sthāpayate sarvaṃ kālaḥ pacati vai tathā ॥39॥
html:
na tu vikramakālo'yaṃ kṣamākālo'yamāgataḥ ।
kālaḥ sthāpayate sarvaṃ kālaḥ pacati vai tathā ॥39॥
slp1: na tu vikramakAlo'yaM kzamAkAlo'yamAgataH । kAlaH sTApayate sarvaM kAlaH pacati vE taTA ॥39॥

text: māṃ cedabhyāgataḥ kālo dānaveśvaramūrjitam । garjantaṃ pratapantaṃ ca kamanyaṃ nāgamiṣyati ॥40॥
html:
māṃ cedabhyāgataḥ kālo dānaveśvaramūrjitam ।
garjantaṃ pratapantaṃ ca kamanyaṃ nāgamiṣyati ॥40॥
slp1: mAM cedaByAgataH kAlo dAnaveSvaramUrjitam । garjantaM pratapantaM ca kamanyaM nAgamizyati ॥40॥

text: dvādaśānāṃ hi bhavatāmādityānāṃ mahātmanām । tejāṃsyekena sarveṣāṃ devarāja hṛtāni me ॥41॥
html:
dvādaśānāṃ hi bhavatāmādityānāṃ mahātmanām ।
tejāṃsyekena sarveṣāṃ devarāja hṛtāni me ॥41॥
slp1: dvAdaSAnAM hi BavatAmAdityAnAM mahAtmanAm । tejAMsyekena sarvezAM devarAja hftAni me ॥41॥

text: ahamevodvahāmyāpo visṛjāmi ca vāsava । tapāmi caiva trailokyaṃ vidyotāmyahameva ca ॥42॥
html:
ahamevodvahāmyāpo visṛjāmi ca vāsava ।
tapāmi caiva trailokyaṃ vidyotāmyahameva ca ॥42॥
slp1: ahamevodvahAmyApo visfjAmi ca vAsava । tapAmi cEva trElokyaM vidyotAmyahameva ca ॥42॥

text: saṃrakṣāmi vilumpāmi dadāmyahamathādade । saṃyacchāmi niyacchāmi lokeṣu prabhurīśvaraḥ ॥43॥
html:
saṃrakṣāmi vilumpāmi dadāmyahamathādade ।
saṃyacchāmi niyacchāmi lokeṣu prabhurīśvaraḥ ॥43॥
slp1: saMrakzAmi vilumpAmi dadAmyahamaTAdade । saMyacCAmi niyacCAmi lokezu praBurISvaraH ॥43॥

text: tadadya vinivṛttaṃ me prabhutvamamarādhipa । kālasainyāvagāḍhasya sarvaṃ na pratibhāti me ॥44॥
html:
tadadya vinivṛttaṃ me prabhutvamamarādhipa ।
kālasainyāvagāḍhasya sarvaṃ na pratibhāti me ॥44॥
slp1: tadadya vinivfttaM me praButvamamarADipa । kAlasEnyAvagAQasya sarvaM na pratiBAti me ॥44॥

text: nāhaṃ kartā na caiva tvaṃ nānyaḥ kartā śacīpate । paryāyeṇa hi bhujyante lokāḥ śakra yadṛcchayā ॥45॥
html:
nāhaṃ kartā na caiva tvaṃ nānyaḥ kartā śacīpate ।
paryāyeṇa hi bhujyante lokāḥ śakra yadṛcchayā ॥45॥
slp1: nAhaM kartA na cEva tvaM nAnyaH kartA SacIpate । paryAyeRa hi Bujyante lokAH Sakra yadfcCayA ॥45॥

text: māsārdhamāsaveśmānamahorātrābhisaṃvṛtam । ṛtudvāraṃ varṣamukhamāhurvedavido janāḥ ॥46॥
html:
māsārdhamāsaveśmānamahorātrābhisaṃvṛtam ।
ṛtudvāraṃ varṣamukhamāhurvedavido janāḥ ॥46॥
slp1: mAsArDamAsaveSmAnamahorAtrABisaMvftam । ftudvAraM varzamuKamAhurvedavido janAH ॥46॥

text: āhuḥ sarvamidaṃ cintyaṃ janāḥ kecinmanīṣayā । asyāḥ pañcaiva cintāyāḥ paryeṣyāmi ca pañcadhā ॥47॥
html:
āhuḥ sarvamidaṃ cintyaṃ janāḥ kecinmanīṣayā ।
asyāḥ pañcaiva cintāyāḥ paryeṣyāmi ca pañcadhā ॥47॥
slp1: AhuH sarvamidaM cintyaM janAH kecinmanIzayA । asyAH paYcEva cintAyAH paryezyAmi ca paYcaDA ॥47॥

text: gambhīraṃ gahanaṃ brahma mahattoyārṇavaṃ yathā । anādinidhanaṃ cāhurakṣaraṃ parameva ca ॥48॥
html:
gambhīraṃ gahanaṃ brahma mahattoyārṇavaṃ yathā ।
anādinidhanaṃ cāhurakṣaraṃ parameva ca ॥48॥
slp1: gamBIraM gahanaM brahma mahattoyArRavaM yaTA । anAdiniDanaM cAhurakzaraM parameva ca ॥48॥

text: sattveṣu liṅgamāveśya naliṅgamapi tatsvayam । manyante dhruvamevainaṃ ye narāstattvadarśinaḥ ॥49॥
html:
sattveṣu liṅgamāveśya naliṅgamapi tatsvayam ।
manyante dhruvamevainaṃ ye narāstattvadarśinaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: sattvezu liNgamAveSya naliNgamapi tatsvayam । manyante DruvamevEnaM ye narAstattvadarSinaH ॥49॥

text: bhūtānāṃ tu viparyāsaṃ manyate gatavāniti । na hyetāvadbhavedgamyaṃ na yasmātprakṛteḥ paraḥ ॥50॥
html:
bhūtānāṃ tu viparyāsaṃ manyate gatavāniti ।
na hyetāvadbhavedgamyaṃ na yasmātprakṛteḥ paraḥ ॥50॥
slp1: BUtAnAM tu viparyAsaM manyate gatavAniti । na hyetAvadBavedgamyaM na yasmAtprakfteH paraH ॥50॥

text: gatiṃ hi sarvabhūtānāmagatvā kva gamiṣyasi । yo dhāvatā na hātavyastiṣṭhannapi na hīyate । tamindriyāṇi sarvāṇi nānupaśyanti pañcadhā ॥51॥
html:
gatiṃ hi sarvabhūtānāmagatvā kva gamiṣyasi ।
yo dhāvatā na hātavyastiṣṭhannapi na hīyate ।
tamindriyāṇi sarvāṇi nānupaśyanti pañcadhā ॥51॥
slp1: gatiM hi sarvaBUtAnAmagatvA kva gamizyasi । yo DAvatA na hAtavyastizWannapi na hIyate । tamindriyARi sarvARi nAnupaSyanti paYcaDA ॥51॥

text: āhuścainaṃ kecidagniṃ kecidāhuḥ prajāpatim । ṛtumāsārdhamāsāṃśca divasāṃstu kṣaṇāṃstathā ॥52॥
html:
āhuścainaṃ kecidagniṃ kecidāhuḥ prajāpatim ।
ṛtumāsārdhamāsāṃśca divasāṃstu kṣaṇāṃstathā ॥52॥
slp1: AhuScEnaM kecidagniM kecidAhuH prajApatim । ftumAsArDamAsAMSca divasAMstu kzaRAMstaTA ॥52॥

text: pūrvāhṇamaparāhṇaṃ ca madhyāhnamapi cāpare । muhūrtamapi caivāhurekaṃ santamanekadhā । taṃ kālamavajānīhi yasya sarvamidaṃ vaśe ॥53॥
html:
pūrvāhṇamaparāhṇaṃ ca madhyāhnamapi cāpare ।
muhūrtamapi caivāhurekaṃ santamanekadhā ।
taṃ kālamavajānīhi yasya sarvamidaṃ vaśe ॥53॥
slp1: pUrvAhRamaparAhRaM ca maDyAhnamapi cApare । muhUrtamapi cEvAhurekaM santamanekaDA । taM kAlamavajAnIhi yasya sarvamidaM vaSe ॥53॥

text: bahūnīndrasahasrāṇi samatītāni vāsava । balavīryopapannāni yathaiva tvaṃ śacīpate ॥54॥
html:
bahūnīndrasahasrāṇi samatītāni vāsava ।
balavīryopapannāni yathaiva tvaṃ śacīpate ॥54॥
slp1: bahUnIndrasahasrARi samatItAni vAsava । balavIryopapannAni yaTEva tvaM SacIpate ॥54॥

text: tvāmapyatibalaṃ śakraṃ devarājaṃ balotkaṭam । prāpte kāle mahāvīryaḥ kālaḥ saṃśamayiṣyati ॥55॥
html:
tvāmapyatibalaṃ śakraṃ devarājaṃ balotkaṭam ।
prāpte kāle mahāvīryaḥ kālaḥ saṃśamayiṣyati ॥55॥
slp1: tvAmapyatibalaM SakraM devarAjaM balotkawam । prApte kAle mahAvIryaH kAlaH saMSamayizyati ॥55॥

text: ya idaṃ sarvamādatte tasmācchakra sthiro bhava । mayā tvayā ca pūrvaiśca na sa śakyo'tivartitum ॥56॥
html:
ya idaṃ sarvamādatte tasmācchakra sthiro bhava ।
mayā tvayā ca pūrvaiśca na sa śakyo'tivartitum ॥56॥
slp1: ya idaM sarvamAdatte tasmAcCakra sTiro Bava । mayA tvayA ca pUrvESca na sa Sakyo'tivartitum ॥56॥

text: yāmetāṃ prāpya jānīṣe rājaśriyamanuttamām । sthitā mayīti tanmithyā naiṣā hyekatra tiṣṭhati ॥57॥
html:
yāmetāṃ prāpya jānīṣe rājaśriyamanuttamām ।
sthitā mayīti tanmithyā naiṣā hyekatra tiṣṭhati ॥57॥
slp1: yAmetAM prApya jAnIze rAjaSriyamanuttamAm । sTitA mayIti tanmiTyA nEzA hyekatra tizWati ॥57॥

text: sthitā hīndrasahasreṣu tvadviśiṣṭatameṣviyam । māṃ ca lolā parityajya tvāmagādvibudhādhipa ॥58॥
html:
sthitā hīndrasahasreṣu tvadviśiṣṭatameṣviyam ।
māṃ ca lolā parityajya tvāmagādvibudhādhipa ॥58॥
slp1: sTitA hIndrasahasrezu tvadviSizwatamezviyam । mAM ca lolA parityajya tvAmagAdvibuDADipa ॥58॥

text: maivaṃ śakra punaḥ kārṣīḥ śānto bhavitumarhasi । tvāmapyevaṅgataṃ tyaktvā kṣipramanyaṃ gamiṣyati] ॥59॥
html:
maivaṃ śakra punaḥ kārṣīḥ śānto bhavitumarhasi ।
tvāmapyevaṅgataṃ tyaktvā kṣipramanyaṃ gamiṣyati] ॥59॥
slp1: mEvaM Sakra punaH kArzIH SAnto Bavitumarhasi । tvAmapyevaNgataM tyaktvA kzipramanyaM gamizyati] ॥59॥

text: śatakraturathāpaśyadbalerdīptāṃ mahātmanaḥ । svarūpiṇīṃ śarīrāddhi tadā niṣkrāmatīṃ śriyam ॥1॥
html:
śatakraturathāpaśyadbalerdīptāṃ mahātmanaḥ ।
svarūpiṇīṃ śarīrāddhi tadā niṣkrāmatīṃ śriyam ॥1॥
slp1: SatakraturaTApaSyadbalerdIptAM mahAtmanaH । svarUpiRIM SarIrAdDi tadA nizkrAmatIM Sriyam ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tāṃ dīptāṃ prabhayā dṛṣṭvā bhagavānpākaśāsanaḥ । vismayotphullanayano baliṃ papraccha vāsavaḥ ॥2॥
html:
tāṃ dīptāṃ prabhayā dṛṣṭvā bhagavānpākaśāsanaḥ ।
vismayotphullanayano baliṃ papraccha vāsavaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: tAM dIptAM praBayA dfzwvA BagavAnpAkaSAsanaH । vismayotPullanayano baliM papracCa vAsavaH ॥2॥

text: bale keyamapakrāntā rocamānā śikhaṇḍinī । tvattaḥ sthitā sakeyūrā dīpyamānā svatejasā ॥3॥
html:
bale keyamapakrāntā rocamānā śikhaṇḍinī ।
tvattaḥ sthitā sakeyūrā dīpyamānā svatejasā ॥3॥
slp1: bale keyamapakrAntA rocamAnA SiKaRqinI । tvattaH sTitA sakeyUrA dIpyamAnA svatejasA ॥3॥

text: na hīmāmāsurīṃ vedmi na daivīṃ na ca mānuṣīm । tvamevaināṃ pṛccha mā vā yatheṣṭaṃ kuru vāsava ॥4॥
html:
na hīmāmāsurīṃ vedmi na daivīṃ na ca mānuṣīm ।
tvamevaināṃ pṛccha mā vā yatheṣṭaṃ kuru vāsava ॥4॥
slp1: na hImAmAsurIM vedmi na dEvIM na ca mAnuzIm । tvamevEnAM pfcCa mA vA yaTezwaM kuru vAsava ॥4॥
author: baliruvāca ।

text: kā tvaṃ balerapakrāntā rocamānā śikhaṇḍinī । ajānato mamācakṣva nāmadheyaṃ śucismite ॥5॥
html:
kā tvaṃ balerapakrāntā rocamānā śikhaṇḍinī ।
ajānato mamācakṣva nāmadheyaṃ śucismite ॥5॥
slp1: kA tvaM balerapakrAntA rocamAnA SiKaRqinI । ajAnato mamAcakzva nAmaDeyaM Sucismite ॥5॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: kā tvaṃ tiṣṭhasi māyeva dīpyamānā svatejasā । hitvā daityeśvaraṃ subhru tanmamācakṣva tattvataḥ ॥6॥
html:
kā tvaṃ tiṣṭhasi māyeva dīpyamānā svatejasā ।
hitvā daityeśvaraṃ subhru tanmamācakṣva tattvataḥ ॥6॥
slp1: kA tvaM tizWasi mAyeva dIpyamAnA svatejasA । hitvA dEtyeSvaraM suBru tanmamAcakzva tattvataH ॥6॥

text: na mā virocano veda na mā vairocano baliḥ । āhurmāṃ duḥsahetyevaṃ vidhitseti ca māṃ viduḥ ॥7॥
html:
na mā virocano veda na mā vairocano baliḥ ।
āhurmāṃ duḥsahetyevaṃ vidhitseti ca māṃ viduḥ ॥7॥
slp1: na mA virocano veda na mA vErocano baliH । AhurmAM duHsahetyevaM viDitseti ca mAM viduH ॥7॥
author: śrīruvāca ।

text: bhūtirlakṣmīti māmāhuḥ śrīrityevaṃ ca vāsava । tvaṃ māṃ śakra na jānīṣe sarve devā na māṃ viduḥ ॥8॥
html:
bhūtirlakṣmīti māmāhuḥ śrīrityevaṃ ca vāsava ।
tvaṃ māṃ śakra na jānīṣe sarve devā na māṃ viduḥ ॥8॥
slp1: BUtirlakzmIti mAmAhuH SrIrityevaM ca vAsava । tvaM mAM Sakra na jAnIze sarve devA na mAM viduH ॥8॥

text: kimidaṃ tvaṃ mama kṛte utāho balinaḥ kṛte । duḥsahe vijahāsyenaṃ cirasaṃvāsinī satī ॥9॥
html:
kimidaṃ tvaṃ mama kṛte utāho balinaḥ kṛte ।
duḥsahe vijahāsyenaṃ cirasaṃvāsinī satī ॥9॥
slp1: kimidaM tvaM mama kfte utAho balinaH kfte । duHsahe vijahAsyenaM cirasaMvAsinI satI ॥9॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: na dhātā na vidhātā māṃ vidadhāti kathañcana । kālastu śakra paryāyānmainaṃ śakrāvamanyathāḥ ॥10॥
html:
na dhātā na vidhātā māṃ vidadhāti kathañcana ।
kālastu śakra paryāyānmainaṃ śakrāvamanyathāḥ ॥10॥
slp1: na DAtA na viDAtA mAM vidaDAti kaTaYcana । kAlastu Sakra paryAyAnmEnaM SakrAvamanyaTAH ॥10॥
author: śrīruvāca ।

text: kathaṃ tvayā balistyaktaḥ kimarthaṃ vā śikhaṇḍini । kathaṃ ca māṃ na jahyāstvaṃ tanme brūhi śucismite ॥11॥
html:
kathaṃ tvayā balistyaktaḥ kimarthaṃ vā śikhaṇḍini ।
kathaṃ ca māṃ na jahyāstvaṃ tanme brūhi śucismite ॥11॥
slp1: kaTaM tvayA balistyaktaH kimarTaM vA SiKaRqini । kaTaM ca mAM na jahyAstvaM tanme brUhi Sucismite ॥11॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: satye sthitāsmi dāne ca vrate tapasi caiva hi । parākrame ca dharme ca parācīnastato baliḥ ॥12॥
html:
satye sthitāsmi dāne ca vrate tapasi caiva hi ।
parākrame ca dharme ca parācīnastato baliḥ ॥12॥
slp1: satye sTitAsmi dAne ca vrate tapasi cEva hi । parAkrame ca Darme ca parAcInastato baliH ॥12॥
author: śrīruvāca ।

text: brahmaṇyo'yaṃ sadā bhūtvā satyavādī jitendriyaḥ । abhyasūyadbrāhmaṇānvai ucchiṣṭaścāspṛśadghṛtam ॥13॥
html:
brahmaṇyo'yaṃ sadā bhūtvā satyavādī jitendriyaḥ ।
abhyasūyadbrāhmaṇānvai ucchiṣṭaścāspṛśadghṛtam ॥13॥
slp1: brahmaRyo'yaM sadA BUtvA satyavAdI jitendriyaH । aByasUyadbrAhmaRAnvE ucCizwaScAspfSadGftam ॥13॥

text: yajñaśīlaḥ purā bhūtvā māmeva yajatetyayam । provāca lokānmūḍhātmā kālenopanipīḍitaḥ ॥14॥
html:
yajñaśīlaḥ purā bhūtvā māmeva yajatetyayam ।
provāca lokānmūḍhātmā kālenopanipīḍitaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: yajYaSIlaH purA BUtvA mAmeva yajatetyayam । provAca lokAnmUQAtmA kAlenopanipIqitaH ॥14॥

text: apākṛtā tataḥ śakra tvayi vatsyāmi vāsava । apramattena dhāryāsmi tapasā vikrameṇa ca ॥15॥
html:
apākṛtā tataḥ śakra tvayi vatsyāmi vāsava ।
apramattena dhāryāsmi tapasā vikrameṇa ca ॥15॥
slp1: apAkftA tataH Sakra tvayi vatsyAmi vAsava । apramattena DAryAsmi tapasA vikrameRa ca ॥15॥

text: asti devamanuṣyeṣu sarvabhūteṣu vā pumān । yastvāmeko viṣahituṃ śaknuyātkamalālaye ॥16॥
html:
asti devamanuṣyeṣu sarvabhūteṣu vā pumān ।
yastvāmeko viṣahituṃ śaknuyātkamalālaye ॥16॥
slp1: asti devamanuzyezu sarvaBUtezu vA pumAn । yastvAmeko vizahituM SaknuyAtkamalAlaye ॥16॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: naiva devo na gandharvo nāsuro na ca rākṣasaḥ । yo māmeko viṣahituṃ śaktaḥ kaścitpurandara ॥17॥
html:
naiva devo na gandharvo nāsuro na ca rākṣasaḥ ।
yo māmeko viṣahituṃ śaktaḥ kaścitpurandara ॥17॥
slp1: nEva devo na ganDarvo nAsuro na ca rAkzasaH । yo mAmeko vizahituM SaktaH kaScitpurandara ॥17॥
author: śrīruvāca ।

text: tiṣṭhethā mayi nityaṃ tvaṃ yathā tadbrūhi me śubhe । tatkariṣyāmi te vākyamṛtaṃ tvaṃ vaktumarhasi ॥18॥
html:
tiṣṭhethā mayi nityaṃ tvaṃ yathā tadbrūhi me śubhe ।
tatkariṣyāmi te vākyamṛtaṃ tvaṃ vaktumarhasi ॥18॥
slp1: tizWeTA mayi nityaM tvaM yaTA tadbrUhi me SuBe । tatkarizyAmi te vAkyamftaM tvaM vaktumarhasi ॥18॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: sthāsyāmi nityaṃ devendra yathā tvayi nibodha tat । vidhinā vedadṛṣṭena caturdhā vibhajasva mām ॥19॥
html:
sthāsyāmi nityaṃ devendra yathā tvayi nibodha tat ।
vidhinā vedadṛṣṭena caturdhā vibhajasva mām ॥19॥
slp1: sTAsyAmi nityaM devendra yaTA tvayi niboDa tat । viDinA vedadfzwena caturDA viBajasva mAm ॥19॥
author: śrīruvāca ।

text: ahaṃ vai tvā nidhāsyāmi yathāśakti yathābalam । na tu me'tikramaḥ syādvai sadā lakṣmi tavāntike ॥20॥
html:
ahaṃ vai tvā nidhāsyāmi yathāśakti yathābalam ।
na tu me'tikramaḥ syādvai sadā lakṣmi tavāntike ॥20॥
slp1: ahaM vE tvA niDAsyAmi yaTASakti yaTAbalam । na tu me'tikramaH syAdvE sadA lakzmi tavAntike ॥20॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: bhūmireva manuṣyeṣu dhāraṇī bhūtabhāvinī । sā te pādaṃ titikṣeta samarthā hīti me matiḥ ॥21॥
html:
bhūmireva manuṣyeṣu dhāraṇī bhūtabhāvinī ।
sā te pādaṃ titikṣeta samarthā hīti me matiḥ ॥21॥
slp1: BUmireva manuzyezu DAraRI BUtaBAvinI । sA te pAdaM titikzeta samarTA hIti me matiH ॥21॥

text: eṣa me nihitaḥ pādo yo'yaṃ bhūmau pratiṣṭhitaḥ । dvitīyaṃ śakra pādaṃ me tasmātsunihitaṃ kuru ॥22॥
html:
eṣa me nihitaḥ pādo yo'yaṃ bhūmau pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।
dvitīyaṃ śakra pādaṃ me tasmātsunihitaṃ kuru ॥22॥
slp1: eza me nihitaH pAdo yo'yaM BUmO pratizWitaH । dvitIyaM Sakra pAdaM me tasmAtsunihitaM kuru ॥22॥
author: śrīruvāca ।

text: āpa eva manuṣyeṣu dravantyaḥ paricārikāḥ । tāste pādaṃ titikṣantāmalamāpastitikṣitum ॥23॥
html:
āpa eva manuṣyeṣu dravantyaḥ paricārikāḥ ।
tāste pādaṃ titikṣantāmalamāpastitikṣitum ॥23॥
slp1: Apa eva manuzyezu dravantyaH paricArikAH । tAste pAdaM titikzantAmalamApastitikzitum ॥23॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: eṣa me nihitaḥ pādo yo'yamapsu pratiṣṭhitaḥ । tṛtīyaṃ śakra pādaṃ me tasmātsunihitaṃ kuru ॥24॥
html:
eṣa me nihitaḥ pādo yo'yamapsu pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।
tṛtīyaṃ śakra pādaṃ me tasmātsunihitaṃ kuru ॥24॥
slp1: eza me nihitaH pAdo yo'yamapsu pratizWitaH । tftIyaM Sakra pAdaM me tasmAtsunihitaM kuru ॥24॥
author: śrīruvāca ।

text: yasmindevāśca yajñāśca yasminvedāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ । tṛtīyaṃ pādamagniste sudhṛtaṃ dhārayiṣyati ॥25॥
html:
yasmindevāśca yajñāśca yasminvedāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ।
tṛtīyaṃ pādamagniste sudhṛtaṃ dhārayiṣyati ॥25॥
slp1: yasmindevASca yajYASca yasminvedAH pratizWitAH । tftIyaM pAdamagniste suDftaM DArayizyati ॥25॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: eṣa me nihitaḥ pādo yo'yamagnau pratiṣṭhitaḥ । caturthaṃ śakra pādaṃ me tasmātsunihitaṃ kuru ॥26॥
html:
eṣa me nihitaḥ pādo yo'yamagnau pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।
caturthaṃ śakra pādaṃ me tasmātsunihitaṃ kuru ॥26॥
slp1: eza me nihitaH pAdo yo'yamagnO pratizWitaH । caturTaM Sakra pAdaM me tasmAtsunihitaM kuru ॥26॥
author: śrīruvāca ।

text: ye vai santo manuṣyeṣu brahmaṇyāḥ satyavādinaḥ । te te pādaṃ titikṣantāmalaṃ santastitikṣitum ॥27॥
html:
ye vai santo manuṣyeṣu brahmaṇyāḥ satyavādinaḥ ।
te te pādaṃ titikṣantāmalaṃ santastitikṣitum ॥27॥
slp1: ye vE santo manuzyezu brahmaRyAH satyavAdinaH । te te pAdaM titikzantAmalaM santastitikzitum ॥27॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: eṣa me nihitaḥ pādo yo'yaṃ satsu pratiṣṭhitaḥ । evaṃ vinihitāṃ śakra bhūteṣu paridhatsva mām ॥28॥
html:
eṣa me nihitaḥ pādo yo'yaṃ satsu pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।
evaṃ vinihitāṃ śakra bhūteṣu paridhatsva mām ॥28॥
slp1: eza me nihitaH pAdo yo'yaM satsu pratizWitaH । evaM vinihitAM Sakra BUtezu pariDatsva mAm ॥28॥
author: śrīruvāca ।

text: bhūtānāmiha vai yastvā mayā vinihitāṃ satīm । upahanyātsa me dviṣyāttathā śṛṇvantu me vacaḥ ॥29॥
html:
bhūtānāmiha vai yastvā mayā vinihitāṃ satīm ।
upahanyātsa me dviṣyāttathā śṛṇvantu me vacaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: BUtAnAmiha vE yastvA mayA vinihitAM satIm । upahanyAtsa me dvizyAttaTA SfRvantu me vacaH ॥29॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: tatastyaktaḥ śriyā rājā daityānāṃ balirabravīt । yāvatpurastātpratapettāvadvai dakṣiṇāṃ diśam ॥30॥
html:
tatastyaktaḥ śriyā rājā daityānāṃ balirabravīt ।
yāvatpurastātpratapettāvadvai dakṣiṇāṃ diśam ॥30॥
slp1: tatastyaktaH SriyA rAjA dEtyAnAM balirabravIt । yAvatpurastAtpratapettAvadvE dakziRAM diSam ॥30॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: paścimāṃ tāvadevāpi tathodīcīṃ divākaraḥ । tathā madhyandine sūryo astameti yadā tadā । punardevāsuraṃ yuddhaṃ bhāvi jetāsmi vastadā ॥31॥
html:
paścimāṃ tāvadevāpi tathodīcīṃ divākaraḥ ।
tathā madhyandine sūryo astameti yadā tadā ।
punardevāsuraṃ yuddhaṃ bhāvi jetāsmi vastadā ॥31॥
slp1: paScimAM tAvadevApi taTodIcIM divAkaraH । taTA maDyandine sUryo astameti yadA tadA । punardevAsuraM yudDaM BAvi jetAsmi vastadA ॥31॥

text: sarvāṁllokānyadāditya ekasthastāpayiṣyati । tadā devāsure yuddhe jetāhaṃ tvāṃ śatakrato ॥32॥
html:
sarvāṁllokānyadāditya ekasthastāpayiṣyati ।
tadā devāsure yuddhe jetāhaṃ tvāṃ śatakrato ॥32॥
slp1: sarvAṁllokAnyadAditya ekasTastApayizyati । tadA devAsure yudDe jetAhaM tvAM Satakrato ॥32॥

text: brahmaṇāsmi samādiṣṭo na hantavyo bhavāniti । tena te'haṃ bale vajraṃ na vimuñcāmi mūrdhani ॥33॥
html:
brahmaṇāsmi samādiṣṭo na hantavyo bhavāniti ।
tena te'haṃ bale vajraṃ na vimuñcāmi mūrdhani ॥33॥
slp1: brahmaRAsmi samAdizwo na hantavyo BavAniti । tena te'haM bale vajraM na vimuYcAmi mUrDani ॥33॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: yatheṣṭaṃ gaccha daityendra svasti te'stu mahāsura । ādityo nāvatapitā kadācinmadhyataḥ sthitaḥ ॥34॥
html:
yatheṣṭaṃ gaccha daityendra svasti te'stu mahāsura ।
ādityo nāvatapitā kadācinmadhyataḥ sthitaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: yaTezwaM gacCa dEtyendra svasti te'stu mahAsura । Adityo nAvatapitA kadAcinmaDyataH sTitaH ॥34॥

text: sthāpito hyasya samayaḥ pūrvameva svayambhuvā । ajasraṃ pariyātyeṣa satyenāvatapanprajāḥ ॥35॥
html:
sthāpito hyasya samayaḥ pūrvameva svayambhuvā ।
ajasraṃ pariyātyeṣa satyenāvatapanprajāḥ ॥35॥
slp1: sTApito hyasya samayaH pUrvameva svayamBuvA । ajasraM pariyAtyeza satyenAvatapanprajAH ॥35॥

text: ayanaṃ tasya ṣaṇmāsā uttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ tathā । yena saṃyāti lokeṣu śītoṣṇe visṛjanraviḥ ॥36॥
html:
ayanaṃ tasya ṣaṇmāsā uttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ tathā ।
yena saṃyāti lokeṣu śītoṣṇe visṛjanraviḥ ॥36॥
slp1: ayanaM tasya zaRmAsA uttaraM dakziRaM taTA । yena saMyAti lokezu SItozRe visfjanraviH ॥36॥

text: evamuktastu daityendro balirindreṇa bhārata । jagāma dakṣiṇāmāśāmudīcīṃ tu purandaraḥ ॥37॥
html:
evamuktastu daityendro balirindreṇa bhārata ।
jagāma dakṣiṇāmāśāmudīcīṃ tu purandaraḥ ॥37॥
slp1: evamuktastu dEtyendro balirindreRa BArata । jagAma dakziRAmASAmudIcIM tu purandaraH ॥37॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ityetadbalinā gītamanahaṅkārasañjñitam । vākyaṃ śrutvā sahasrākṣaḥ khamevāruruhe tadā] ॥38॥
html:
ityetadbalinā gītamanahaṅkārasañjñitam ।
vākyaṃ śrutvā sahasrākṣaḥ khamevāruruhe tadā] ॥38॥
slp1: ityetadbalinA gItamanahaNkArasaYjYitam । vAkyaM SrutvA sahasrAkzaH KamevAruruhe tadA] ॥38॥

text: atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । śatakratośca saṃvādaṃ namuceśca yudhiṣṭhira ॥1॥
html:
atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
śatakratośca saṃvādaṃ namuceśca yudhiṣṭhira ॥1॥
slp1: atrEvodAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । SatakratoSca saMvAdaM namuceSca yuDizWira ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: śriyā vihīnamāsīnamakṣobhyamiva sāgaram । bhavābhavajñaṃ bhūtānāmityuvāca purandaraḥ ॥2॥
html:
śriyā vihīnamāsīnamakṣobhyamiva sāgaram ।
bhavābhavajñaṃ bhūtānāmityuvāca purandaraḥ ॥2॥
slp1: SriyA vihInamAsInamakzoByamiva sAgaram । BavABavajYaM BUtAnAmityuvAca purandaraH ॥2॥

text: baddhaḥ pāśaiścyutaḥ sthānāddviṣatāṃ vaśamāgataḥ । śriyā vihīno namuce śocasyāho na śocasi ॥3॥
html:
baddhaḥ pāśaiścyutaḥ sthānāddviṣatāṃ vaśamāgataḥ ।
śriyā vihīno namuce śocasyāho na śocasi ॥3॥
slp1: badDaH pASEScyutaH sTAnAddvizatAM vaSamAgataH । SriyA vihIno namuce SocasyAho na Socasi ॥3॥

text: anavāpyaṃ ca śokena śarīraṃ copatapyate । amitrāśca prahṛṣyanti nāsti śoke sahāyatā ॥4॥
html:
anavāpyaṃ ca śokena śarīraṃ copatapyate ।
amitrāśca prahṛṣyanti nāsti śoke sahāyatā ॥4॥
slp1: anavApyaM ca Sokena SarIraM copatapyate । amitrASca prahfzyanti nAsti Soke sahAyatA ॥4॥
author: namuciruvāca ।

text: tasmācchakra na śocāmi sarvaṃ hyevedamantavat । santāpādbhraśyate rūpaṃ dharmaścaiva sureśvara ॥5॥
html:
tasmācchakra na śocāmi sarvaṃ hyevedamantavat ।
santāpādbhraśyate rūpaṃ dharmaścaiva sureśvara ॥5॥
slp1: tasmAcCakra na SocAmi sarvaM hyevedamantavat । santApAdBraSyate rUpaM DarmaScEva sureSvara ॥5॥

text: vinīya khalu tadduḥkhamāgataṃ vaimanasyajam । dhyātavyaṃ manasā hṛdyaṃ kalyāṇaṃ saṃvijānatā ॥6॥
html:
vinīya khalu tadduḥkhamāgataṃ vaimanasyajam ।
dhyātavyaṃ manasā hṛdyaṃ kalyāṇaṃ saṃvijānatā ॥6॥
slp1: vinIya Kalu tadduHKamAgataM vEmanasyajam । DyAtavyaM manasA hfdyaM kalyARaM saMvijAnatA ॥6॥

text: yathā yathā hi puruṣaḥ kalyāṇe kurute manaḥ । tadaivāsya prasīdanti sarvārthā nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥7॥
html:
yathā yathā hi puruṣaḥ kalyāṇe kurute manaḥ ।
tadaivāsya prasīdanti sarvārthā nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: yaTA yaTA hi puruzaH kalyARe kurute manaH । tadEvAsya prasIdanti sarvArTA nAtra saMSayaH ॥7॥

text: ekaḥ śāstā na dvitīyo'sti śāstā garbhe śayānaṃ puruṣaṃ śāsti śāstā । tenānuśiṣṭaḥ pravaṇādivodakaṃ yathā niyukto'smi tathā vahāmi ॥8॥
html:
ekaḥ śāstā na dvitīyo'sti śāstā garbhe śayānaṃ puruṣaṃ śāsti śāstā ।
tenānuśiṣṭaḥ pravaṇādivodakaṃ yathā niyukto'smi tathā vahāmi ॥8॥
slp1: ekaH SAstA na dvitIyo'sti SAstA garBe SayAnaM puruzaM SAsti SAstA । tenAnuSizwaH pravaRAdivodakaM yaTA niyukto'smi taTA vahAmi ॥8॥

text: bhāvābhāvāvabhijānangarīyo jānāmi śreyo na tu tatkaromi । āśāḥ suśarmyāḥ suhṛdāṃ sukurvanyathā niyukto'smi tathā vahāmi ॥9॥
html:
bhāvābhāvāvabhijānangarīyo jānāmi śreyo na tu tatkaromi ।
āśāḥ suśarmyāḥ suhṛdāṃ sukurvanyathā niyukto'smi tathā vahāmi ॥9॥
slp1: BAvABAvAvaBijAnangarIyo jAnAmi Sreyo na tu tatkaromi । ASAH suSarmyAH suhfdAM sukurvanyaTA niyukto'smi taTA vahAmi ॥9॥

text: yathā yathāsya prāptavyaṃ prāpnotyeva tathā tathā । bhavitavyaṃ yathā yacca bhavatyeva tathā tathā ॥10॥
html:
yathā yathāsya prāptavyaṃ prāpnotyeva tathā tathā ।
bhavitavyaṃ yathā yacca bhavatyeva tathā tathā ॥10॥
slp1: yaTA yaTAsya prAptavyaM prApnotyeva taTA taTA । BavitavyaM yaTA yacca Bavatyeva taTA taTA ॥10॥

text: yatra yatraiva saṃyuṅkte dhātā garbhaṃ punaḥ punaḥ । tatra tatraiva vasati na yatra svayamicchati ॥11॥
html:
yatra yatraiva saṃyuṅkte dhātā garbhaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
tatra tatraiva vasati na yatra svayamicchati ॥11॥
slp1: yatra yatrEva saMyuNkte DAtA garBaM punaH punaH । tatra tatrEva vasati na yatra svayamicCati ॥11॥

text: bhāvo yo'yamanuprāpto bhavitavyamidaṃ mama । iti yasya sadā bhāvo na sa muhyetkadācana ॥12॥
html:
bhāvo yo'yamanuprāpto bhavitavyamidaṃ mama ।
iti yasya sadā bhāvo na sa muhyetkadācana ॥12॥
slp1: BAvo yo'yamanuprApto BavitavyamidaM mama । iti yasya sadA BAvo na sa muhyetkadAcana ॥12॥

text: na vidyā na tapo dānaṃ na mitrāṇi na bāndhavāḥ । śaknuvanti paritrātuṃ naraṃ kālena pīḍitam ॥31॥
html:
na vidyā na tapo dānaṃ na mitrāṇi na bāndhavāḥ ।
śaknuvanti paritrātuṃ naraṃ kālena pīḍitam ॥31॥
slp1: na vidyA na tapo dAnaM na mitrARi na bAnDavAH । Saknuvanti paritrAtuM naraM kAlena pIqitam ॥31॥

text: nāgāminamanarthaṃ hi pratighātaśatairapi । śaknuvanti prativyoḍhumṛte buddhibalānnarāḥ ॥32॥
html:
nāgāminamanarthaṃ hi pratighātaśatairapi ।
śaknuvanti prativyoḍhumṛte buddhibalānnarāḥ ॥32॥
slp1: nAgAminamanarTaM hi pratiGAtaSatErapi । Saknuvanti prativyoQumfte budDibalAnnarAH ॥32॥

text: paryāyairhanyamānānāṃ paritrātā na vidyate । idaṃ tu duḥkhaṃ yacchakra kartāhamiti manyate ॥33॥
html:
paryāyairhanyamānānāṃ paritrātā na vidyate ।
idaṃ tu duḥkhaṃ yacchakra kartāhamiti manyate ॥33॥
slp1: paryAyErhanyamAnAnAM paritrAtA na vidyate । idaM tu duHKaM yacCakra kartAhamiti manyate ॥33॥

text: yadi kartā bhavetkartā na kriyeta kadācana । yasmāttu kriyate kartā tasmātkartāpyanīśvaraḥ ॥34॥
html:
yadi kartā bhavetkartā na kriyeta kadācana ।
yasmāttu kriyate kartā tasmātkartāpyanīśvaraḥ ॥34॥
slp1: yadi kartA BavetkartA na kriyeta kadAcana । yasmAttu kriyate kartA tasmAtkartApyanISvaraH ॥34॥

text: kālena tvāhamajayaṃ kālenāhaṃ jitastvayā । gantā gatimatāṃ kālaḥ kālaḥ kalayati prajāḥ ॥35॥
html:
kālena tvāhamajayaṃ kālenāhaṃ jitastvayā ।
gantā gatimatāṃ kālaḥ kālaḥ kalayati prajāḥ ॥35॥
slp1: kAlena tvAhamajayaM kAlenAhaM jitastvayA । gantA gatimatAM kAlaH kAlaH kalayati prajAH ॥35॥

text: indra prākṛtayā buddhyā pralapannāvabudhyase । kecittvāṃ bahu manyante śraiṣṭhyaṃ prāptaṃ svakarmaṇā ॥36॥
html:
indra prākṛtayā buddhyā pralapannāvabudhyase ।
kecittvāṃ bahu manyante śraiṣṭhyaṃ prāptaṃ svakarmaṇā ॥36॥
slp1: indra prAkftayA budDyA pralapannAvabuDyase । kecittvAM bahu manyante SrEzWyaM prAptaM svakarmaRA ॥36॥

text: kathamasmadvidho nāma jānaṁllokapravṛttayaḥ । kālenābhyāhataḥ śocenmuhyedvāpyarthasambhrame ॥37॥
html:
kathamasmadvidho nāma jānaṁllokapravṛttayaḥ ।
kālenābhyāhataḥ śocenmuhyedvāpyarthasambhrame ॥37॥
slp1: kaTamasmadviDo nAma jAnaṁllokapravfttayaH । kAlenAByAhataH SocenmuhyedvApyarTasamBrame ॥37॥

text: nityaṃ kālaparītasya mama vā madvidhasya vā । buddhirvyasanamāsādya bhinnā nauriva sīdati ॥38॥
html:
nityaṃ kālaparītasya mama vā madvidhasya vā ।
buddhirvyasanamāsādya bhinnā nauriva sīdati ॥38॥
slp1: nityaM kAlaparItasya mama vA madviDasya vA । budDirvyasanamAsAdya BinnA nOriva sIdati ॥38॥

text: ahaṃ ca tvaṃ ca ye cānye bhaviṣyanti surādhipāḥ । te sarve śakra yāsyanti mārgamindraśatairgatam ॥39॥
html:
ahaṃ ca tvaṃ ca ye cānye bhaviṣyanti surādhipāḥ ।
te sarve śakra yāsyanti mārgamindraśatairgatam ॥39॥
slp1: ahaM ca tvaM ca ye cAnye Bavizyanti surADipAH । te sarve Sakra yAsyanti mArgamindraSatErgatam ॥39॥

text: tvāmapyevaṃ sudurdharṣaṃ jvalantaṃ parayā śriyā । kāle pariṇate kālaḥ kālayiṣyati māmiva ॥40॥
html:
tvāmapyevaṃ sudurdharṣaṃ jvalantaṃ parayā śriyā ।
kāle pariṇate kālaḥ kālayiṣyati māmiva ॥40॥
slp1: tvAmapyevaM sudurDarzaM jvalantaM parayA SriyA । kAle pariRate kAlaH kAlayizyati mAmiva ॥40॥

text: bahūnīndrasahasrāṇi daiteyānāṃ yuge yuge । abhyatītāni kālena kālo hi duratikramaḥ ॥41॥
html:
bahūnīndrasahasrāṇi daiteyānāṃ yuge yuge ।
abhyatītāni kālena kālo hi duratikramaḥ ॥41॥
slp1: bahUnIndrasahasrARi dEteyAnAM yuge yuge । aByatItAni kAlena kAlo hi duratikramaH ॥41॥

text: idaṃ tu labdhvā tvaṃ sthānamātmānaṃ bahu manyase । sarvabhūtabhavaṃ devaṃ brahmāṇamiva śāśvatam ॥42॥
html:
idaṃ tu labdhvā tvaṃ sthānamātmānaṃ bahu manyase ।
sarvabhūtabhavaṃ devaṃ brahmāṇamiva śāśvatam ॥42॥
slp1: idaM tu labDvA tvaM sTAnamAtmAnaM bahu manyase । sarvaBUtaBavaM devaM brahmARamiva SASvatam ॥42॥

text: na cedamacalaṃ sthānamanantaṃ vāpi kasyacit । tvaṃ tu bāliśayā buddhyā mamedamiti manyase ॥43॥
html:
na cedamacalaṃ sthānamanantaṃ vāpi kasyacit ।
tvaṃ tu bāliśayā buddhyā mamedamiti manyase ॥43॥
slp1: na cedamacalaM sTAnamanantaM vApi kasyacit । tvaM tu bAliSayA budDyA mamedamiti manyase ॥43॥

text: aviśvāsye viśvasiṣi manyase cādhruvaṃ dhruvam । mameyamiti mohāttvaṃ rājaśriyamabhīpsasi ॥44॥
html:
aviśvāsye viśvasiṣi manyase cādhruvaṃ dhruvam ।
mameyamiti mohāttvaṃ rājaśriyamabhīpsasi ॥44॥
slp1: aviSvAsye viSvasizi manyase cADruvaM Druvam । mameyamiti mohAttvaM rAjaSriyamaBIpsasi ॥44॥

text: neyaṃ tava na cāsmākaṃ na cānyeṣāṃ sthirā matā । atikramya bahūnanyāṃstvayi tāvadiyaṃ sthitā ॥45॥
html:
neyaṃ tava na cāsmākaṃ na cānyeṣāṃ sthirā matā ।
atikramya bahūnanyāṃstvayi tāvadiyaṃ sthitā ॥45॥
slp1: neyaM tava na cAsmAkaM na cAnyezAM sTirA matA । atikramya bahUnanyAMstvayi tAvadiyaM sTitA ॥45॥

text: kañcitkālamiyaṃ sthitvā tvayi vāsava cañcalā । gaurnipānamivotsṛjya punaranyaṃ gamiṣyati ॥46॥
html:
kañcitkālamiyaṃ sthitvā tvayi vāsava cañcalā ।
gaurnipānamivotsṛjya punaranyaṃ gamiṣyati ॥46॥
slp1: kaYcitkAlamiyaM sTitvA tvayi vAsava caYcalA । gOrnipAnamivotsfjya punaranyaM gamizyati ॥46॥

text: rājalokā hyatikrāntā yānna saṅkhyātumutsahe । tvatto bahutarāścānye bhaviṣyanti purandara ॥47॥
html:
rājalokā hyatikrāntā yānna saṅkhyātumutsahe ।
tvatto bahutarāścānye bhaviṣyanti purandara ॥47॥
slp1: rAjalokA hyatikrAntA yAnna saNKyAtumutsahe । tvatto bahutarAScAnye Bavizyanti purandara ॥47॥

text: savṛkṣauṣadhiratneyaṃ sasaritparvatākarā । tānidānīṃ na paśyāmi yairbhukteyaṃ purā mahī ॥48॥
html:
savṛkṣauṣadhiratneyaṃ sasaritparvatākarā ।
tānidānīṃ na paśyāmi yairbhukteyaṃ purā mahī ॥48॥
slp1: savfkzOzaDiratneyaM sasaritparvatAkarA । tAnidAnIM na paSyAmi yErBukteyaM purA mahI ॥48॥

text: pṛthurailo mayo bhaumo narakaḥ śambarastathā । aśvagrīvaḥ pulomā ca svarbhānuramitadhvajaḥ ॥49॥
html:
pṛthurailo mayo bhaumo narakaḥ śambarastathā ।
aśvagrīvaḥ pulomā ca svarbhānuramitadhvajaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: pfTurElo mayo BOmo narakaH SambarastaTA । aSvagrIvaH pulomA ca svarBAnuramitaDvajaH ॥49॥

text: prahrādo namucirdakṣo vipracittirvirocanaḥ । hrīniṣedhaḥ suhotraśca bhūrihā puṣpavānvṛṣaḥ ॥50॥
html:
prahrādo namucirdakṣo vipracittirvirocanaḥ ।
hrīniṣedhaḥ suhotraśca bhūrihā puṣpavānvṛṣaḥ ॥50॥
slp1: prahrAdo namucirdakzo vipracittirvirocanaH । hrInizeDaH suhotraSca BUrihA puzpavAnvfzaH ॥50॥

text: satyeṣurṛṣabho rāhuḥ kapilāśvo virūpakaḥ । bāṇaḥ kārtasvaro vahnirviśvadaṃṣṭro'tha nairṛtaḥ ॥51॥
html:
satyeṣurṛṣabho rāhuḥ kapilāśvo virūpakaḥ ।
bāṇaḥ kārtasvaro vahnirviśvadaṃṣṭro'tha nairṛtaḥ ॥51॥
slp1: satyezurfzaBo rAhuH kapilASvo virUpakaH । bARaH kArtasvaro vahnirviSvadaMzwro'Ta nErftaH ॥51॥

text: ritthāhutthau vīratāmrau varāhāśvo ruciḥ prabhuḥ । viśvajitpratiśauriśca vṛṣāṇḍo viṣkaro madhuḥ ॥52॥
html:
ritthāhutthau vīratāmrau varāhāśvo ruciḥ prabhuḥ ।
viśvajitpratiśauriśca vṛṣāṇḍo viṣkaro madhuḥ ॥52॥
slp1: ritTAhutTO vIratAmrO varAhASvo ruciH praBuH । viSvajitpratiSOriSca vfzARqo vizkaro maDuH ॥52॥

text: hiraṇyakaśipuścaiva kaiṭabhaścaiva dānavaḥ । daityāśca kālakhañjāśca sarve te nairṛtaiḥ saha ॥53॥
html:
hiraṇyakaśipuścaiva kaiṭabhaścaiva dānavaḥ ।
daityāśca kālakhañjāśca sarve te nairṛtaiḥ saha ॥53॥
slp1: hiraRyakaSipuScEva kEwaBaScEva dAnavaH । dEtyASca kAlaKaYjASca sarve te nErftEH saha ॥53॥

text: ete cānye ca bahavaḥ pūrve pūrvatarāśca ye । daityendrā dānavendrāśca yāṃścānyānanuśuśruma ॥54॥
html:
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ pūrve pūrvatarāśca ye ।
daityendrā dānavendrāśca yāṃścānyānanuśuśruma ॥54॥
slp1: ete cAnye ca bahavaH pUrve pUrvatarASca ye । dEtyendrA dAnavendrASca yAMScAnyAnanuSuSruma ॥54॥

text: bahavaḥ pūrvadaityendrāḥ santyajya pṛthivīṃ gatāḥ । kālenābhyāhatāḥ sarve kālo hi balavattaraḥ ॥55॥
html:
bahavaḥ pūrvadaityendrāḥ santyajya pṛthivīṃ gatāḥ ।
kālenābhyāhatāḥ sarve kālo hi balavattaraḥ ॥55॥
slp1: bahavaH pUrvadEtyendrAH santyajya pfTivIM gatAH । kAlenAByAhatAH sarve kAlo hi balavattaraH ॥55॥

text: sarvaiḥ kratuśatairiṣṭaṃ na tvamekaḥ śatakratuḥ । sarve dharmaparāścāsansarve satatasatriṇaḥ ॥56॥
html:
sarvaiḥ kratuśatairiṣṭaṃ na tvamekaḥ śatakratuḥ ।
sarve dharmaparāścāsansarve satatasatriṇaḥ ॥56॥
slp1: sarvEH kratuSatErizwaM na tvamekaH SatakratuH । sarve DarmaparAScAsansarve satatasatriRaH ॥56॥

text: antarikṣacarāḥ sarve sarve'bhimukhayodhinaḥ । sarve saṃhananopetāḥ sarve parighabāhavaḥ ॥57॥
html:
antarikṣacarāḥ sarve sarve'bhimukhayodhinaḥ ।
sarve saṃhananopetāḥ sarve parighabāhavaḥ ॥57॥
slp1: antarikzacarAH sarve sarve'BimuKayoDinaH । sarve saMhananopetAH sarve pariGabAhavaH ॥57॥

text: sarve māyāśatadharāḥ sarve te kāmacāriṇaḥ । sarve samaramāsādya na śrūyante parājitāḥ ॥58॥
html:
sarve māyāśatadharāḥ sarve te kāmacāriṇaḥ ।
sarve samaramāsādya na śrūyante parājitāḥ ॥58॥
slp1: sarve mAyASataDarAH sarve te kAmacAriRaH । sarve samaramAsAdya na SrUyante parAjitAH ॥58॥

text: sarve satyavrataparāḥ sarve kāmavihāriṇaḥ । sarve vedavrataparāḥ sarve cāsanbahuśrutāḥ ॥59॥
html:
sarve satyavrataparāḥ sarve kāmavihāriṇaḥ ।
sarve vedavrataparāḥ sarve cāsanbahuśrutāḥ ॥59॥
slp1: sarve satyavrataparAH sarve kAmavihAriRaH । sarve vedavrataparAH sarve cAsanbahuSrutAH ॥59॥

text: sarve saṃhatamaiśvaryamīśvarāḥ pratipedire । na caiśvaryamadasteṣāṃ bhūtapūrvo mahātmanām ॥60॥
html:
sarve saṃhatamaiśvaryamīśvarāḥ pratipedire ।
na caiśvaryamadasteṣāṃ bhūtapūrvo mahātmanām ॥60॥
slp1: sarve saMhatamESvaryamISvarAH pratipedire । na cESvaryamadastezAM BUtapUrvo mahAtmanAm ॥60॥

text: sarve yathārthadātāraḥ sarve vigatamatsarāḥ । sarve sarveṣu bhūteṣu yathāvatpratipedire ॥61॥
html:
sarve yathārthadātāraḥ sarve vigatamatsarāḥ ।
sarve sarveṣu bhūteṣu yathāvatpratipedire ॥61॥
slp1: sarve yaTArTadAtAraH sarve vigatamatsarAH । sarve sarvezu BUtezu yaTAvatpratipedire ॥61॥

text: sarve dākṣāyaṇīputrāḥ prājāpatyā mahābalāḥ । jvalantaḥ pratapantaśca kālena pratisaṃhṛtāḥ ॥62॥
html:
sarve dākṣāyaṇīputrāḥ prājāpatyā mahābalāḥ ।
jvalantaḥ pratapantaśca kālena pratisaṃhṛtāḥ ॥62॥
slp1: sarve dAkzAyaRIputrAH prAjApatyA mahAbalAH । jvalantaH pratapantaSca kAlena pratisaMhftAH ॥62॥

text: tvaṃ caivemāṃ yadā bhuktvā pṛthivīṃ tyakṣyase punaḥ । na śakṣyasi tadā śakra niyantuṃ śokamātmanaḥ ॥63॥
html:
tvaṃ caivemāṃ yadā bhuktvā pṛthivīṃ tyakṣyase punaḥ ।
na śakṣyasi tadā śakra niyantuṃ śokamātmanaḥ ॥63॥
slp1: tvaM cEvemAM yadA BuktvA pfTivIM tyakzyase punaH । na Sakzyasi tadA Sakra niyantuM SokamAtmanaH ॥63॥

text: muñcecchāṃ kāmabhogeṣu muñcemaṃ śrībhavaṃ madam । evaṃ svarājyanāśe tvaṃ śokaṃ samprasahiṣyasi ॥64॥
html:
muñcecchāṃ kāmabhogeṣu muñcemaṃ śrībhavaṃ madam ।
evaṃ svarājyanāśe tvaṃ śokaṃ samprasahiṣyasi ॥64॥
slp1: muYcecCAM kAmaBogezu muYcemaM SrIBavaM madam । evaM svarAjyanASe tvaM SokaM samprasahizyasi ॥64॥

text: śokakāle śuco mā tvaṃ harṣakāle ca mā hṛṣaḥ । atītānāgate hitvā pratyutpannena vartaya ॥65॥
html:
śokakāle śuco mā tvaṃ harṣakāle ca mā hṛṣaḥ ।
atītānāgate hitvā pratyutpannena vartaya ॥65॥
slp1: SokakAle Suco mA tvaM harzakAle ca mA hfzaH । atItAnAgate hitvA pratyutpannena vartaya ॥65॥

text: māṃ cedabhyāgataḥ kālaḥ sadāyuktamatandritam । kṣamasva nacirādindra tvāmapyupagamiṣyati ॥66॥
html:
māṃ cedabhyāgataḥ kālaḥ sadāyuktamatandritam ।
kṣamasva nacirādindra tvāmapyupagamiṣyati ॥66॥
slp1: mAM cedaByAgataH kAlaH sadAyuktamatandritam । kzamasva nacirAdindra tvAmapyupagamizyati ॥66॥

text: trāsayanniva devendra vāgbhistakṣasi māmiha । saṃyate mayi nūnaṃ tvamātmānaṃ bahu manyase ॥67॥
html:
trāsayanniva devendra vāgbhistakṣasi māmiha ।
saṃyate mayi nūnaṃ tvamātmānaṃ bahu manyase ॥67॥
slp1: trAsayanniva devendra vAgBistakzasi mAmiha । saMyate mayi nUnaM tvamAtmAnaM bahu manyase ॥67॥

text: kālaḥ prathamamāyānmāṃ paścāttvāmanudhāvati । tena garjasi devendra pūrvaṃ kālahate mayi ॥68॥
html:
kālaḥ prathamamāyānmāṃ paścāttvāmanudhāvati ।
tena garjasi devendra pūrvaṃ kālahate mayi ॥68॥
slp1: kAlaH praTamamAyAnmAM paScAttvAmanuDAvati । tena garjasi devendra pUrvaM kAlahate mayi ॥68॥

text: ko hi sthātumalaṃ loke kruddhasya mama saṃyuge । kālastu balavānprāptastena tiṣṭhasi vāsava ॥69॥
html:
ko hi sthātumalaṃ loke kruddhasya mama saṃyuge ।
kālastu balavānprāptastena tiṣṭhasi vāsava ॥69॥
slp1: ko hi sTAtumalaM loke krudDasya mama saMyuge । kAlastu balavAnprAptastena tizWasi vAsava ॥69॥

text: yattadvarṣasahasrāntaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhavitumarhati । yathā me sarvagātrāṇi nasvasthāni hataujasaḥ ॥70॥
html:
yattadvarṣasahasrāntaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhavitumarhati ।
yathā me sarvagātrāṇi nasvasthāni hataujasaḥ ॥70॥
slp1: yattadvarzasahasrAntaM pUrRaM Bavitumarhati । yaTA me sarvagAtrARi nasvasTAni hatOjasaH ॥70॥

text: ahamaindraccyutaḥ sthānāttvamindraḥ prakṛto divi । sucitre jīvaloke'sminnupāsyaḥ kālaparyayāt ॥71॥
html:
ahamaindraccyutaḥ sthānāttvamindraḥ prakṛto divi ।
sucitre jīvaloke'sminnupāsyaḥ kālaparyayāt ॥71॥
slp1: ahamEndraccyutaH sTAnAttvamindraH prakfto divi । sucitre jIvaloke'sminnupAsyaH kAlaparyayAt ॥71॥

text: kiṃ hi kṛtvā tvamindro'dya kiṃ hi kṛtvā cyutā vayam । kālaḥ kartā vikartā ca sarvamanyadakāraṇam ॥72॥
html:
kiṃ hi kṛtvā tvamindro'dya kiṃ hi kṛtvā cyutā vayam ।
kālaḥ kartā vikartā ca sarvamanyadakāraṇam ॥72॥
slp1: kiM hi kftvA tvamindro'dya kiM hi kftvA cyutA vayam । kAlaH kartA vikartA ca sarvamanyadakAraRam ॥72॥

text: nāśaṃ vināśamaiśvaryaṃ sukhaduḥkhe bhavābhavau । vidvānprāpyaivamatyarthaṃ na prahṛṣyenna ca vyathet ॥73॥
html:
nāśaṃ vināśamaiśvaryaṃ sukhaduḥkhe bhavābhavau ।
vidvānprāpyaivamatyarthaṃ na prahṛṣyenna ca vyathet ॥73॥
slp1: nASaM vinASamESvaryaM suKaduHKe BavABavO । vidvAnprApyEvamatyarTaM na prahfzyenna ca vyaTet ॥73॥

text: tvameva hīndra vetthāsmānvedāhaṃ tvāṃ ca vāsava । vikatthase māṃ kiṃ baddhaṃ kālena nirapatrapa ॥74॥
html:
tvameva hīndra vetthāsmānvedāhaṃ tvāṃ ca vāsava ।
vikatthase māṃ kiṃ baddhaṃ kālena nirapatrapa ॥74॥
slp1: tvameva hIndra vetTAsmAnvedAhaM tvAM ca vAsava । vikatTase mAM kiM badDaM kAlena nirapatrapa ॥74॥

text: tvameva hi purā vettha yattadā pauruṣaṃ mama । samareṣu ca vikrāntaṃ paryāptaṃ tannidarśanam ॥75॥
html:
tvameva hi purā vettha yattadā pauruṣaṃ mama ।
samareṣu ca vikrāntaṃ paryāptaṃ tannidarśanam ॥75॥
slp1: tvameva hi purA vetTa yattadA pOruzaM mama । samarezu ca vikrAntaM paryAptaM tannidarSanam ॥75॥

text: ādityāścaiva rudrāśca sādhyāśca vasubhiḥ saha । mayā vinirjitāḥ sarve marutaśca śacīpate ॥76॥
html:
ādityāścaiva rudrāśca sādhyāśca vasubhiḥ saha ।
mayā vinirjitāḥ sarve marutaśca śacīpate ॥76॥
slp1: AdityAScEva rudrASca sADyASca vasuBiH saha । mayA vinirjitAH sarve marutaSca SacIpate ॥76॥

text: tvameva śakra jānāsi devāsurasamāgame । sametā vibudhā bhagnāstarasā samare mayā ॥77॥
html:
tvameva śakra jānāsi devāsurasamāgame ।
sametā vibudhā bhagnāstarasā samare mayā ॥77॥
slp1: tvameva Sakra jAnAsi devAsurasamAgame । sametA vibuDA BagnAstarasA samare mayA ॥77॥

text: parvatāścāsakṛtkṣiptāḥ savanāḥ savanaukasaḥ । saṭaṅkaśikharā ghorāḥ samare mūrdhni te mayā ॥78॥
html:
parvatāścāsakṛtkṣiptāḥ savanāḥ savanaukasaḥ ।
saṭaṅkaśikharā ghorāḥ samare mūrdhni te mayā ॥78॥
slp1: parvatAScAsakftkziptAH savanAH savanOkasaH । sawaNkaSiKarA GorAH samare mUrDni te mayA ॥78॥

text: kiṃ nu śakyaṃ mayā kartuṃ yatkālo duratikramaḥ । na hi tvāṃ notsahe hantuṃ savajramapi muṣṭinā ॥79॥
html:
kiṃ nu śakyaṃ mayā kartuṃ yatkālo duratikramaḥ ।
na hi tvāṃ notsahe hantuṃ savajramapi muṣṭinā ॥79॥
slp1: kiM nu SakyaM mayA kartuM yatkAlo duratikramaH । na hi tvAM notsahe hantuM savajramapi muzwinA ॥79॥

text: na tu vikramakālo'yaṃ kṣamākālo'yamāgataḥ । tena tvā marṣaye śakra durmarṣaṇatarastvayā ॥80॥
html:
na tu vikramakālo'yaṃ kṣamākālo'yamāgataḥ ।
tena tvā marṣaye śakra durmarṣaṇatarastvayā ॥80॥
slp1: na tu vikramakAlo'yaM kzamAkAlo'yamAgataH । tena tvA marzaye Sakra durmarzaRatarastvayA ॥80॥

text: tvaṃ mā pariṇate kāle parītaṃ kālavahninā । niyataṃ kālapāśena baddhaṃ śakra vikatthase ॥81॥
html:
tvaṃ mā pariṇate kāle parītaṃ kālavahninā ।
niyataṃ kālapāśena baddhaṃ śakra vikatthase ॥81॥
slp1: tvaM mA pariRate kAle parItaM kAlavahninA । niyataM kAlapASena badDaM Sakra vikatTase ॥81॥

text: ayaṃ sa puruṣaḥ śyāmo lokasya duratikramaḥ । baddhvā tiṣṭhati māṃ raudraḥ paśuṃ raśanayā yathā ॥82॥
html:
ayaṃ sa puruṣaḥ śyāmo lokasya duratikramaḥ ।
baddhvā tiṣṭhati māṃ raudraḥ paśuṃ raśanayā yathā ॥82॥
slp1: ayaM sa puruzaH SyAmo lokasya duratikramaH । badDvA tizWati mAM rOdraH paSuM raSanayA yaTA ॥82॥

text: lābhālābhau sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ kāmakrodhau bhavābhavau । vadho bandhaḥ pramokṣaśca sarvaṃ kālena labhyate ॥83॥
html:
lābhālābhau sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ kāmakrodhau bhavābhavau ।
vadho bandhaḥ pramokṣaśca sarvaṃ kālena labhyate ॥83॥
slp1: lABAlABO suKaM duHKaM kAmakroDO BavABavO । vaDo banDaH pramokzaSca sarvaM kAlena laByate ॥83॥

text: nāhaṃ kartā na kartā tvaṃ kartā yastu sadā prabhuḥ । so'yaṃ pacati kālo māṃ vṛkṣe phalamivāgatam ॥84॥
html:
nāhaṃ kartā na kartā tvaṃ kartā yastu sadā prabhuḥ ।
so'yaṃ pacati kālo māṃ vṛkṣe phalamivāgatam ॥84॥
slp1: nAhaM kartA na kartA tvaM kartA yastu sadA praBuH । so'yaM pacati kAlo mAM vfkze PalamivAgatam ॥84॥

text: yānyeva puruṣaḥ kurvansukhaiḥ kālena yujyate । punastānyeva kurvāṇo duḥkhaiḥ kālena yujyate ॥85॥
html:
yānyeva puruṣaḥ kurvansukhaiḥ kālena yujyate ।
punastānyeva kurvāṇo duḥkhaiḥ kālena yujyate ॥85॥
slp1: yAnyeva puruzaH kurvansuKEH kAlena yujyate । punastAnyeva kurvARo duHKEH kAlena yujyate ॥85॥

text: na ca kālena kālajñaḥ spṛṣṭaḥ śocitumarhati । tena śakra na śocāmi nāsti śoke sahāyatā ॥86॥
html:
na ca kālena kālajñaḥ spṛṣṭaḥ śocitumarhati ।
tena śakra na śocāmi nāsti śoke sahāyatā ॥86॥
slp1: na ca kAlena kAlajYaH spfzwaH Socitumarhati । tena Sakra na SocAmi nAsti Soke sahAyatA ॥86॥

text: yadā hi śocatāṃ śoko vyasanaṃ nāpakarṣati । sāmarthyaṃ śocato nāsti nādya śocāmyahaṃ tataḥ ॥87॥
html:
yadā hi śocatāṃ śoko vyasanaṃ nāpakarṣati ।
sāmarthyaṃ śocato nāsti nādya śocāmyahaṃ tataḥ ॥87॥
slp1: yadA hi SocatAM Soko vyasanaM nApakarzati । sAmarTyaM Socato nAsti nAdya SocAmyahaM tataH ॥87॥

text: evamuktaḥ sahasrākṣo bhagavānpākaśāsanaḥ । pratisaṃhṛtya saṃrambhamityuvāca śatakratuḥ ॥88॥
html:
evamuktaḥ sahasrākṣo bhagavānpākaśāsanaḥ ।
pratisaṃhṛtya saṃrambhamityuvāca śatakratuḥ ॥88॥
slp1: evamuktaH sahasrAkzo BagavAnpAkaSAsanaH । pratisaMhftya saMramBamityuvAca SatakratuH ॥88॥

text: savajramudyataṃ bāhuṃ dṛṣṭvā pāśāṃśca vāruṇān । kasyeha na vyathedbuddhirmṛtyorapi jighāṃsataḥ ॥89॥
html:
savajramudyataṃ bāhuṃ dṛṣṭvā pāśāṃśca vāruṇān ।
kasyeha na vyathedbuddhirmṛtyorapi jighāṃsataḥ ॥89॥
slp1: savajramudyataM bAhuM dfzwvA pASAMSca vAruRAn । kasyeha na vyaTedbudDirmftyorapi jiGAMsataH ॥89॥

text: sā te na vyathate buddhiracalā tattvadarśinī । bruvanna vyathase sa tvaṃ vākyaṃ satyaparākrama ॥90॥
html:
sā te na vyathate buddhiracalā tattvadarśinī ।
bruvanna vyathase sa tvaṃ vākyaṃ satyaparākrama ॥90॥
slp1: sA te na vyaTate budDiracalA tattvadarSinI । bruvanna vyaTase sa tvaM vAkyaM satyaparAkrama ॥90॥

text: ko hi viśvāsamartheṣu śarīre vā śarīrabhṛt । kartumutsahate loke dṛṣṭvā saṃprasthitaṃ jagat ॥91॥
html:
ko hi viśvāsamartheṣu śarīre vā śarīrabhṛt ।
kartumutsahate loke dṛṣṭvā saṃprasthitaṃ jagat ॥91॥
slp1: ko hi viSvAsamarTezu SarIre vA SarIraBft । kartumutsahate loke dfzwvA saMprasTitaM jagat ॥91॥

text: ahamapyevamevainaṃ lokaṃ jānāmyaśāśvatam । kālāgnāvāhitaṃ ghore guhye satatage'kṣare ॥92॥
html:
ahamapyevamevainaṃ lokaṃ jānāmyaśāśvatam ।
kālāgnāvāhitaṃ ghore guhye satatage'kṣare ॥92॥
slp1: ahamapyevamevEnaM lokaM jAnAmyaSASvatam । kAlAgnAvAhitaM Gore guhye satatage'kzare ॥92॥

text: na cātra parihāro'sti kālaspṛṣṭasya kasyacit । sūkṣmāṇāṃ mahatāṃ caiva bhūtānāṃ paripacyatām ॥93॥
html:
na cātra parihāro'sti kālaspṛṣṭasya kasyacit ।
sūkṣmāṇāṃ mahatāṃ caiva bhūtānāṃ paripacyatām ॥93॥
slp1: na cAtra parihAro'sti kAlaspfzwasya kasyacit । sUkzmARAM mahatAM cEva BUtAnAM paripacyatAm ॥93॥

text: anīśasyāpramattasya bhūtāni pacataḥ sadā । anivṛttasya kālasya kṣayaṃ prāpto na mucyate ॥94॥
html:
anīśasyāpramattasya bhūtāni pacataḥ sadā ।
anivṛttasya kālasya kṣayaṃ prāpto na mucyate ॥94॥
slp1: anISasyApramattasya BUtAni pacataH sadA । anivfttasya kAlasya kzayaM prApto na mucyate ॥94॥

text: apramattaḥ pramatteṣu kālo jāgarti dehiṣu । prayatnenāpyatikrānto dṛṣṭapūrvo na kenacit ॥95॥
html:
apramattaḥ pramatteṣu kālo jāgarti dehiṣu ।
prayatnenāpyatikrānto dṛṣṭapūrvo na kenacit ॥95॥
slp1: apramattaH pramattezu kAlo jAgarti dehizu । prayatnenApyatikrAnto dfzwapUrvo na kenacit ॥95॥

text: purāṇaḥ śāśvato dharmaḥ sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ samaḥ । kālo na parihāryaśca na cāsyāsti vyatikramaḥ ॥96॥
html:
purāṇaḥ śāśvato dharmaḥ sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ samaḥ ।
kālo na parihāryaśca na cāsyāsti vyatikramaḥ ॥96॥
slp1: purARaH SASvato DarmaH sarvaprARaBftAM samaH । kAlo na parihAryaSca na cAsyAsti vyatikramaH ॥96॥

text: ahorātrāṃśca māsāṃśca kṣaṇānkāṣṭhāḥ kalā lavān । sampiṇḍayati naḥ kālo vṛddhiṃ vārdhuṣiko yathā ॥97॥
html:
ahorātrāṃśca māsāṃśca kṣaṇānkāṣṭhāḥ kalā lavān ।
sampiṇḍayati naḥ kālo vṛddhiṃ vārdhuṣiko yathā ॥97॥
slp1: ahorAtrAMSca mAsAMSca kzaRAnkAzWAH kalA lavAn । sampiRqayati naH kAlo vfdDiM vArDuziko yaTA ॥97॥

text: idamadya kariṣyāmi śvaḥ kartāsmīti vādinam । kālo harati samprāpto nadīvega ivoḍupam ॥98॥
html:
idamadya kariṣyāmi śvaḥ kartāsmīti vādinam ।
kālo harati samprāpto nadīvega ivoḍupam ॥98॥
slp1: idamadya karizyAmi SvaH kartAsmIti vAdinam । kAlo harati samprApto nadIvega ivoqupam ॥98॥

text: idānīṃ tāvadevāsau mayā dṛṣṭaḥ kathaṃ mṛtaḥ । iti kālena hriyatāṃ pralāpaḥ śrūyate nṛṇām ॥99॥
html:
idānīṃ tāvadevāsau mayā dṛṣṭaḥ kathaṃ mṛtaḥ ।
iti kālena hriyatāṃ pralāpaḥ śrūyate nṛṇām ॥99॥
slp1: idAnIM tAvadevAsO mayA dfzwaH kaTaM mftaH । iti kAlena hriyatAM pralApaH SrUyate nfRAm ॥99॥

text: naśyantyarthāstathā bhogāḥ sthānamaiśvaryameva ca । anityamadhruvaṃ sarvaṃ vyavasāyo hi duṣkaraḥ । ucchrāyā vinipātāntā bhāvo'bhāvastha eva ca ॥100॥
html:
naśyantyarthāstathā bhogāḥ sthānamaiśvaryameva ca ।
anityamadhruvaṃ sarvaṃ vyavasāyo hi duṣkaraḥ ।
ucchrāyā vinipātāntā bhāvo'bhāvastha eva ca ॥100॥
slp1: naSyantyarTAstaTA BogAH sTAnamESvaryameva ca । anityamaDruvaM sarvaM vyavasAyo hi duzkaraH । ucCrAyA vinipAtAntA BAvo'BAvasTa eva ca ॥100॥

text: sā te na vyathate buddhiracalā tattvadarśinī । ahamāsaṃ purā ceti manasāpi na budhyase ॥101॥
html:
sā te na vyathate buddhiracalā tattvadarśinī ।
ahamāsaṃ purā ceti manasāpi na budhyase ॥101॥
slp1: sA te na vyaTate budDiracalA tattvadarSinI । ahamAsaM purA ceti manasApi na buDyase ॥101॥

text: kālenākramya loke'sminpacyamāne balīyasā । ajyeṣṭhamakaniṣṭhaṃ ca kṣipyamāṇo na budhyase ॥102॥
html:
kālenākramya loke'sminpacyamāne balīyasā ।
ajyeṣṭhamakaniṣṭhaṃ ca kṣipyamāṇo na budhyase ॥102॥
slp1: kAlenAkramya loke'sminpacyamAne balIyasA । ajyezWamakanizWaM ca kzipyamARo na buDyase ॥102॥

text: īrṣyābhimānalobheṣu kāmakrodhabhayeṣu ca । spṛhāmohābhimāneṣu lokaḥ sakto vimuhyati ॥103॥
html:
īrṣyābhimānalobheṣu kāmakrodhabhayeṣu ca ।
spṛhāmohābhimāneṣu lokaḥ sakto vimuhyati ॥103॥
slp1: IrzyABimAnaloBezu kAmakroDaBayezu ca । spfhAmohABimAnezu lokaH sakto vimuhyati ॥103॥

text: bhavāṃstu bhāvatattvajño vidvāñjñānataponvitaḥ । kālaṃ paśyati suvyaktaṃ pāṇāvāmalakaṃ yathā ॥104॥
html:
bhavāṃstu bhāvatattvajño vidvāñjñānataponvitaḥ ।
kālaṃ paśyati suvyaktaṃ pāṇāvāmalakaṃ yathā ॥104॥
slp1: BavAMstu BAvatattvajYo vidvAYjYAnataponvitaH । kAlaM paSyati suvyaktaM pARAvAmalakaM yaTA ॥104॥

text: kālacāritratattvajñaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ । vairocane kṛtātmāsi spṛhaṇīyo vijānatām ॥105॥
html:
kālacāritratattvajñaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ ।
vairocane kṛtātmāsi spṛhaṇīyo vijānatām ॥105॥
slp1: kAlacAritratattvajYaH sarvaSAstraviSAradaH । vErocane kftAtmAsi spfhaRIyo vijAnatAm ॥105॥

text: sarvaloko hyayaṃ manye buddhyā parigatastvayā । viharansarvatomukto na kvacitpariṣajjase ॥106॥
html:
sarvaloko hyayaṃ manye buddhyā parigatastvayā ।
viharansarvatomukto na kvacitpariṣajjase ॥106॥
slp1: sarvaloko hyayaM manye budDyA parigatastvayA । viharansarvatomukto na kvacitparizajjase ॥106॥

text: rajaśca hi tamaśca tvā spṛśato na jitendriyam । niṣprītiṃ naṣṭasantāpaṃ tvamātmānamupāsase ॥107॥
html:
rajaśca hi tamaśca tvā spṛśato na jitendriyam ।
niṣprītiṃ naṣṭasantāpaṃ tvamātmānamupāsase ॥107॥
slp1: rajaSca hi tamaSca tvA spfSato na jitendriyam । nizprItiM nazwasantApaM tvamAtmAnamupAsase ॥107॥

text: suhṛdaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ nirvairaṃ śāntamānasam । dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ mama sañjātā tvayyanukrośinī matiḥ ॥108॥
html:
suhṛdaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ nirvairaṃ śāntamānasam ।
dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ mama sañjātā tvayyanukrośinī matiḥ ॥108॥
slp1: suhfdaM sarvaBUtAnAM nirvEraM SAntamAnasam । dfzwvA tvAM mama saYjAtA tvayyanukroSinI matiH ॥108॥

text: nāhametādṛśaṃ buddhaṃ hantumicchāmi bandhane । ānṛśaṃsyaṃ paro dharmo anukrośastathā tvayi ॥109॥
html:
nāhametādṛśaṃ buddhaṃ hantumicchāmi bandhane ।
ānṛśaṃsyaṃ paro dharmo anukrośastathā tvayi ॥109॥
slp1: nAhametAdfSaM budDaM hantumicCAmi banDane । AnfSaMsyaM paro Darmo anukroSastaTA tvayi ॥109॥

text: mokṣyante vāruṇāḥ pāśāstaveme kālaparyayāt । prajānāmapacāreṇa svasti te'stu mahāsura ॥110॥
html:
mokṣyante vāruṇāḥ pāśāstaveme kālaparyayāt ।
prajānāmapacāreṇa svasti te'stu mahāsura ॥110॥
slp1: mokzyante vAruRAH pASAstaveme kAlaparyayAt । prajAnAmapacAreRa svasti te'stu mahAsura ॥110॥

text: yadā śvaśrūṃ snuṣā vṛddhāṃ paricāreṇa yokṣyate । putraśca pitaraṃ mohātpreṣayiṣyati karmasu ॥111॥
html:
yadā śvaśrūṃ snuṣā vṛddhāṃ paricāreṇa yokṣyate ।
putraśca pitaraṃ mohātpreṣayiṣyati karmasu ॥111॥
slp1: yadA SvaSrUM snuzA vfdDAM paricAreRa yokzyate । putraSca pitaraM mohAtprezayizyati karmasu ॥111॥

text: brāhmaṇaiḥ kārayiṣyanti vṛṣalāḥ pādadhāvanam । śūdrāśca brāhmaṇīṃ bhāryāmupayāsyanti nirbhayāḥ ॥112॥
html:
brāhmaṇaiḥ kārayiṣyanti vṛṣalāḥ pādadhāvanam ।
śūdrāśca brāhmaṇīṃ bhāryāmupayāsyanti nirbhayāḥ ॥112॥
slp1: brAhmaREH kArayizyanti vfzalAH pAdaDAvanam । SUdrASca brAhmaRIM BAryAmupayAsyanti nirBayAH ॥112॥

text: viyoniṣu ca bījāni mokṣyante puruṣā yadā । saṅkaraṃ kāṃsyabhāṇḍaiśca baliṃ cāpi kupātrakaiḥ ॥113॥
html:
viyoniṣu ca bījāni mokṣyante puruṣā yadā ।
saṅkaraṃ kāṃsyabhāṇḍaiśca baliṃ cāpi kupātrakaiḥ ॥113॥
slp1: viyonizu ca bIjAni mokzyante puruzA yadA । saNkaraM kAMsyaBARqESca baliM cApi kupAtrakEH ॥113॥

text: cāturvarṇyaṃ yadā kṛtsnamunmaryādaṃ bhaviṣyati । ekaikaste tadā pāśaḥ kramaśaḥ pratimokṣyate ॥114॥
html:
cāturvarṇyaṃ yadā kṛtsnamunmaryādaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
ekaikaste tadā pāśaḥ kramaśaḥ pratimokṣyate ॥114॥
slp1: cAturvarRyaM yadA kftsnamunmaryAdaM Bavizyati । ekEkaste tadA pASaH kramaSaH pratimokzyate ॥114॥

text: asmattaste bhayaṃ nāsti samayaṃ pratipālaya । sukhī bhava nirābādhaḥ svasthacetā nirāmayaḥ ॥115॥
html:
asmattaste bhayaṃ nāsti samayaṃ pratipālaya ।
sukhī bhava nirābādhaḥ svasthacetā nirāmayaḥ ॥115॥
slp1: asmattaste BayaM nAsti samayaM pratipAlaya । suKI Bava nirAbADaH svasTacetA nirAmayaH ॥115॥

text: tamevamuktvā bhagavāñśatakratuḥ pratiprayāto gajarājavāhanaḥ । vijitya sarvānasurānsurādhipo nananda harṣeṇa babhūva caikarāṭ ॥116॥
html:
tamevamuktvā bhagavāñśatakratuḥ pratiprayāto gajarājavāhanaḥ ।
vijitya sarvānasurānsurādhipo nananda harṣeṇa babhūva caikarāṭ ॥116॥
slp1: tamevamuktvA BagavAYSatakratuH pratiprayAto gajarAjavAhanaH । vijitya sarvAnasurAnsurADipo nananda harzeRa baBUva cEkarAw ॥116॥

text: maharṣayastuṣṭuvurañjasā ca taṃ vṛṣākapiṃ sarvacarācareśvaram । himāpaho havyamudāvahaṃstvaraṃstathāmṛtaṃ cārpitamīśvarāya ha ॥117॥
html:
maharṣayastuṣṭuvurañjasā ca taṃ vṛṣākapiṃ sarvacarācareśvaram ।
himāpaho havyamudāvahaṃstvaraṃstathāmṛtaṃ cārpitamīśvarāya ha ॥117॥
slp1: maharzayastuzwuvuraYjasA ca taM vfzAkapiM sarvacarAcareSvaram । himApaho havyamudAvahaMstvaraMstaTAmftaM cArpitamISvarAya ha ॥117॥

text: dvijottamaiḥ sarvagatairabhiṣṭuto vidīptatejā gatamanyurīśvaraḥ । praśāntacetā muditaḥ svamālayaṃ triviṣṭapaṃ prāpya mumoda vāsavaḥ] ॥118॥
html:
dvijottamaiḥ sarvagatairabhiṣṭuto vidīptatejā gatamanyurīśvaraḥ ।
praśāntacetā muditaḥ svamālayaṃ triviṣṭapaṃ prāpya mumoda vāsavaḥ] ॥118॥
slp1: dvijottamEH sarvagatEraBizwuto vidIptatejA gatamanyurISvaraH । praSAntacetA muditaH svamAlayaM trivizwapaM prApya mumoda vAsavaH] ॥118॥

text: pūrvarūpāṇi me rājanpuruṣasya bhaviṣyataḥ । parābhaviṣyataścaiva tvaṃ me brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
pūrvarūpāṇi me rājanpuruṣasya bhaviṣyataḥ ।
parābhaviṣyataścaiva tvaṃ me brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: pUrvarUpARi me rAjanpuruzasya BavizyataH । parABavizyataScEva tvaM me brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: mana eva manuṣyasya pūrvarūpāṇi śaṃsati । bhaviṣyataśca bhadraṃ te tathaiva na bhaviṣyataḥ ॥2॥
html:
mana eva manuṣyasya pūrvarūpāṇi śaṃsati ।
bhaviṣyataśca bhadraṃ te tathaiva na bhaviṣyataḥ ॥2॥
slp1: mana eva manuzyasya pUrvarUpARi SaMsati । BavizyataSca BadraM te taTEva na BavizyataH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । śriyā śakrasya saṃvādaṃ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥3॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
śriyā śakrasya saṃvādaṃ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥3॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । SriyA Sakrasya saMvAdaM tanniboDa yuDizWira ॥3॥

text: mahatastapaso vyuṣṭyā paśyaṁllokau parāvarau । sāmānyamṛṣibhirgatvā brahmalokanivāsibhiḥ ॥4॥
html:
mahatastapaso vyuṣṭyā paśyaṁllokau parāvarau ।
sāmānyamṛṣibhirgatvā brahmalokanivāsibhiḥ ॥4॥
slp1: mahatastapaso vyuzwyA paSyaṁllokO parAvarO । sAmAnyamfziBirgatvA brahmalokanivAsiBiH ॥4॥

text: brahmaivāmitadīptaujāḥ śāntapāpmā mahātapāḥ । vicacāra yathākāmaṃ triṣu lokeṣu nāradaḥ ॥5॥
html:
brahmaivāmitadīptaujāḥ śāntapāpmā mahātapāḥ ।
vicacāra yathākāmaṃ triṣu lokeṣu nāradaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: brahmEvAmitadIptOjAH SAntapApmA mahAtapAH । vicacAra yaTAkAmaM trizu lokezu nAradaH ॥5॥

text: kadācitprātarutthāya pispṛkṣuḥ salilaṃ śuci । dhruvadvārabhavāṃ gaṅgāṃ jagāmāvatatāra ca ॥6॥
html:
kadācitprātarutthāya pispṛkṣuḥ salilaṃ śuci ।
dhruvadvārabhavāṃ gaṅgāṃ jagāmāvatatāra ca ॥6॥
slp1: kadAcitprAtarutTAya pispfkzuH salilaM Suci । DruvadvAraBavAM gaNgAM jagAmAvatatAra ca ॥6॥

text: sahasranayanaścāpi vajrī śambarapākahā । tasyā devarṣijuṣṭāyāstīramabhyājagāma ha ॥7॥
html:
sahasranayanaścāpi vajrī śambarapākahā ।
tasyā devarṣijuṣṭāyāstīramabhyājagāma ha ॥7॥
slp1: sahasranayanaScApi vajrI SambarapAkahA । tasyA devarzijuzwAyAstIramaByAjagAma ha ॥7॥

text: tāvāplutya yatātmānau kṛtajapyau samāsatuḥ । nadyāḥ pulinamāsādya sūkṣmakāñcanavālukam ॥8॥
html:
tāvāplutya yatātmānau kṛtajapyau samāsatuḥ ।
nadyāḥ pulinamāsādya sūkṣmakāñcanavālukam ॥8॥
slp1: tAvAplutya yatAtmAnO kftajapyO samAsatuH । nadyAH pulinamAsAdya sUkzmakAYcanavAlukam ॥8॥

text: puṇyakarmabhirākhyātā devarṣikathitāḥ kathāḥ । cakratustau kathāśīlau śucisaṃhṛṣṭamānasau । pūrvavṛttavyapetāni kathayantau samāhitau ॥9॥
html:
puṇyakarmabhirākhyātā devarṣikathitāḥ kathāḥ ।
cakratustau kathāśīlau śucisaṃhṛṣṭamānasau ।
pūrvavṛttavyapetāni kathayantau samāhitau ॥9॥
slp1: puRyakarmaBirAKyAtA devarzikaTitAH kaTAH । cakratustO kaTASIlO SucisaMhfzwamAnasO । pUrvavfttavyapetAni kaTayantO samAhitO ॥9॥

text: atha bhāskaramudyantaṃ raśmijālapuraskṛtam । pūrṇamaṇḍalamālokya tāvutthāyopatasthatuḥ ॥10॥
html:
atha bhāskaramudyantaṃ raśmijālapuraskṛtam ।
pūrṇamaṇḍalamālokya tāvutthāyopatasthatuḥ ॥10॥
slp1: aTa BAskaramudyantaM raSmijAlapuraskftam । pUrRamaRqalamAlokya tAvutTAyopatasTatuH ॥10॥

text: abhitastūdayantaṃ tamarkamarkamivāparam । ākāśe dadṛśe jyotirudyatārciḥ samaprabham ॥11॥
html:
abhitastūdayantaṃ tamarkamarkamivāparam ।
ākāśe dadṛśe jyotirudyatārciḥ samaprabham ॥11॥
slp1: aBitastUdayantaM tamarkamarkamivAparam । AkASe dadfSe jyotirudyatArciH samapraBam ॥11॥

text: tayoḥ samīpaṃ samprāptaṃ pratyadṛśyata bhārata । tatsuparṇārkacaritamāsthitaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ padam । bhābhirapratimaṃ bhāti trailokyamavabhāsayat ॥12॥
html:
tayoḥ samīpaṃ samprāptaṃ pratyadṛśyata bhārata ।
tatsuparṇārkacaritamāsthitaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ padam ।
bhābhirapratimaṃ bhāti trailokyamavabhāsayat ॥12॥
slp1: tayoH samIpaM samprAptaM pratyadfSyata BArata । tatsuparRArkacaritamAsTitaM vEzRavaM padam । BABirapratimaM BAti trElokyamavaBAsayat ॥12॥

text: divyābhirūpaśobhābhirapsarobhiḥ puraskṛtām । bṛhatīmaṃśumatprakhyāṃ bṛhadbhānorivārciṣam ॥13॥
html:
divyābhirūpaśobhābhirapsarobhiḥ puraskṛtām ।
bṛhatīmaṃśumatprakhyāṃ bṛhadbhānorivārciṣam ॥13॥
slp1: divyABirUpaSoBABirapsaroBiH puraskftAm । bfhatImaMSumatpraKyAM bfhadBAnorivArcizam ॥13॥

text: nakṣatrakalpābharaṇāṃ tārābhaktisamasrajam । śriyaṃ dadṛśatuḥ padmāṃ sākṣātpadmatalasthitām ॥14॥
html:
nakṣatrakalpābharaṇāṃ tārābhaktisamasrajam ।
śriyaṃ dadṛśatuḥ padmāṃ sākṣātpadmatalasthitām ॥14॥
slp1: nakzatrakalpABaraRAM tArABaktisamasrajam । SriyaM dadfSatuH padmAM sAkzAtpadmatalasTitAm ॥14॥

text: sāvaruhya vimānāgrādaṅganānāmanuttamā । abhyagacchattrilokeśaṃ śakraṃ carṣiṃ ca nāradam ॥15॥
html:
sāvaruhya vimānāgrādaṅganānāmanuttamā ।
abhyagacchattrilokeśaṃ śakraṃ carṣiṃ ca nāradam ॥15॥
slp1: sAvaruhya vimAnAgrAdaNganAnAmanuttamA । aByagacCattrilokeSaM SakraM carziM ca nAradam ॥15॥

text: nāradānugataḥ sākṣānmaghavāṃstāmupāgamat । kṛtāñjalipuṭo devīṃ nivedyātmānamātmanā ॥16॥
html:
nāradānugataḥ sākṣānmaghavāṃstāmupāgamat ।
kṛtāñjalipuṭo devīṃ nivedyātmānamātmanā ॥16॥
slp1: nAradAnugataH sAkzAnmaGavAMstAmupAgamat । kftAYjalipuwo devIM nivedyAtmAnamAtmanA ॥16॥

text: cakre cānupamāṃ pūjāṃ tasyāścāpi sa sarvavit । devarājaḥ śriyaṃ rājanvākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha ॥17॥
html:
cakre cānupamāṃ pūjāṃ tasyāścāpi sa sarvavit ।
devarājaḥ śriyaṃ rājanvākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha ॥17॥
slp1: cakre cAnupamAM pUjAM tasyAScApi sa sarvavit । devarAjaH SriyaM rAjanvAkyaM cedamuvAca ha ॥17॥

text: kā tvaṃ kena ca kāryeṇa samprāptā cāruhāsini । kutaścāgamyate subhru gantavyaṃ kva ca te śubhe ॥18॥
html:
kā tvaṃ kena ca kāryeṇa samprāptā cāruhāsini ।
kutaścāgamyate subhru gantavyaṃ kva ca te śubhe ॥18॥
slp1: kA tvaM kena ca kAryeRa samprAptA cAruhAsini । kutaScAgamyate suBru gantavyaM kva ca te SuBe ॥18॥

text: puṇyeṣu triṣu lokeṣu sarve sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ । mamātmabhāvamicchanto yatante paramātmanā ॥19॥
html:
puṇyeṣu triṣu lokeṣu sarve sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ ।
mamātmabhāvamicchanto yatante paramātmanā ॥19॥
slp1: puRyezu trizu lokezu sarve sTAvarajaNgamAH । mamAtmaBAvamicCanto yatante paramAtmanA ॥19॥
author: śrīruvāca ।

text: sāhaṃ vai paṅkaje jātā sūryaraśmivibodhite । bhūtyarthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ padmā śrīḥ padmamālinī ॥20॥
html:
sāhaṃ vai paṅkaje jātā sūryaraśmivibodhite ।
bhūtyarthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ padmā śrīḥ padmamālinī ॥20॥
slp1: sAhaM vE paNkaje jAtA sUryaraSmiviboDite । BUtyarTaM sarvaBUtAnAM padmA SrIH padmamAlinI ॥20॥

text: ahaṃ lakṣmīrahaṃ bhūtiḥ śrīścāhaṃ balasūdana । ahaṃ śraddhā ca medhā ca sannatirvijitiḥ sthitiḥ ॥21॥
html:
ahaṃ lakṣmīrahaṃ bhūtiḥ śrīścāhaṃ balasūdana ।
ahaṃ śraddhā ca medhā ca sannatirvijitiḥ sthitiḥ ॥21॥
slp1: ahaM lakzmIrahaM BUtiH SrIScAhaM balasUdana । ahaM SradDA ca meDA ca sannatirvijitiH sTitiH ॥21॥

text: ahaṃ dhṛtirahaṃ siddhirahaṃ tviḍbhūtireva ca । ahaṃ svāhā svadhā caiva saṃstutirniyatiḥ kṛtiḥ ॥22॥
html:
ahaṃ dhṛtirahaṃ siddhirahaṃ tviḍbhūtireva ca ।
ahaṃ svāhā svadhā caiva saṃstutirniyatiḥ kṛtiḥ ॥22॥
slp1: ahaM DftirahaM sidDirahaM tviqBUtireva ca । ahaM svAhA svaDA cEva saMstutirniyatiH kftiH ॥22॥

text: rājñāṃ vijayamānānāṃ senāgreṣu dhvajeṣu ca । nivāse dharmaśīlānāṃ viṣayeṣu pureṣu ca ॥23॥
html:
rājñāṃ vijayamānānāṃ senāgreṣu dhvajeṣu ca ।
nivāse dharmaśīlānāṃ viṣayeṣu pureṣu ca ॥23॥
slp1: rAjYAM vijayamAnAnAM senAgrezu Dvajezu ca । nivAse DarmaSIlAnAM vizayezu purezu ca ॥23॥

text: jitakāśini śūre ca saṅgrāmeṣvanivartini । nivasāmi manuṣyendre sadaiva balasūdana ॥24॥
html:
jitakāśini śūre ca saṅgrāmeṣvanivartini ।
nivasāmi manuṣyendre sadaiva balasūdana ॥24॥
slp1: jitakASini SUre ca saNgrAmezvanivartini । nivasAmi manuzyendre sadEva balasUdana ॥24॥

text: dharmanitye mahābuddhau brahmaṇye satyavādini । praśrite dānaśīle ca sadaiva nivasāmyaham ॥25॥
html:
dharmanitye mahābuddhau brahmaṇye satyavādini ।
praśrite dānaśīle ca sadaiva nivasāmyaham ॥25॥
slp1: Darmanitye mahAbudDO brahmaRye satyavAdini । praSrite dAnaSIle ca sadEva nivasAmyaham ॥25॥

text: asureṣvavasaṃ pūrvaṃ satyadharmanibandhanā । viparītāṃstu tānbuddhvā tvayi vāsamarocayam ॥26॥
html:
asureṣvavasaṃ pūrvaṃ satyadharmanibandhanā ।
viparītāṃstu tānbuddhvā tvayi vāsamarocayam ॥26॥
slp1: asurezvavasaM pUrvaM satyaDarmanibanDanA । viparItAMstu tAnbudDvA tvayi vAsamarocayam ॥26॥

text: kathaṃvṛtteṣu daityeṣu tvamavātsīrvarānane । dṛṣṭvā ca kimihāgāstvaṃ hitvā daiteyadānavān ॥27॥
html:
kathaṃvṛtteṣu daityeṣu tvamavātsīrvarānane ।
dṛṣṭvā ca kimihāgāstvaṃ hitvā daiteyadānavān ॥27॥
slp1: kaTaMvfttezu dEtyezu tvamavAtsIrvarAnane । dfzwvA ca kimihAgAstvaM hitvA dEteyadAnavAn ॥27॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: svadharmamanutiṣṭhatsu dhairyādacaliteṣu ca । svargamārgābhirāmeṣu sattveṣu niratā hyaham ॥28॥
html:
svadharmamanutiṣṭhatsu dhairyādacaliteṣu ca ।
svargamārgābhirāmeṣu sattveṣu niratā hyaham ॥28॥
slp1: svaDarmamanutizWatsu DEryAdacalitezu ca । svargamArgABirAmezu sattvezu niratA hyaham ॥28॥
author: śrīruvāca ।

text: dānādhyayanayajñejyā gurudaivatapūjanam । viprāṇāmatithīnāṃ ca teṣāṃ nityamavartata ॥29॥
html:
dānādhyayanayajñejyā gurudaivatapūjanam ।
viprāṇāmatithīnāṃ ca teṣāṃ nityamavartata ॥29॥
slp1: dAnADyayanayajYejyA gurudEvatapUjanam । viprARAmatiTInAM ca tezAM nityamavartata ॥29॥

text: susaṃmṛṣṭagṛhāścāsañjitastrīkā hutāgnayaḥ । guruśuśrūṣavo dāntā brahmaṇyāḥ satyavādinaḥ ॥30॥
html:
susaṃmṛṣṭagṛhāścāsañjitastrīkā hutāgnayaḥ ।
guruśuśrūṣavo dāntā brahmaṇyāḥ satyavādinaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: susaMmfzwagfhAScAsaYjitastrIkA hutAgnayaH । guruSuSrUzavo dAntA brahmaRyAH satyavAdinaH ॥30॥

text: śraddadhānā jitakrodhā dānaśīlānasūyakāḥ । bhṛtaputrā bhṛtāmātyā bhṛtadārā hyanīrṣavaḥ ॥31॥
html:
śraddadhānā jitakrodhā dānaśīlānasūyakāḥ ।
bhṛtaputrā bhṛtāmātyā bhṛtadārā hyanīrṣavaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: SraddaDAnA jitakroDA dAnaSIlAnasUyakAH । BftaputrA BftAmAtyA BftadArA hyanIrzavaH ॥31॥

text: amarṣaṇā na cānyonyaṃ spṛhayanti kadācana । na ca jātūpatapyante dhīrāḥ parasamṛddhibhiḥ ॥32॥
html:
amarṣaṇā na cānyonyaṃ spṛhayanti kadācana ।
na ca jātūpatapyante dhīrāḥ parasamṛddhibhiḥ ॥32॥
slp1: amarzaRA na cAnyonyaM spfhayanti kadAcana । na ca jAtUpatapyante DIrAH parasamfdDiBiH ॥32॥

text: dātāraḥ saṅgṛhītāra āryāḥ karuṇavedinaḥ । mahāprasādā ṛjavo dṛḍhabhaktā jitendriyāḥ ॥33॥
html:
dātāraḥ saṅgṛhītāra āryāḥ karuṇavedinaḥ ।
mahāprasādā ṛjavo dṛḍhabhaktā jitendriyāḥ ॥33॥
slp1: dAtAraH saNgfhItAra AryAH karuRavedinaH । mahAprasAdA fjavo dfQaBaktA jitendriyAH ॥33॥

text: santuṣṭabhṛtyasacivāḥ kṛtajñāḥ priyavādinaḥ । yathārthamānārthakarā hrīniṣedhā yatavratāḥ ॥34॥
html:
santuṣṭabhṛtyasacivāḥ kṛtajñāḥ priyavādinaḥ ।
yathārthamānārthakarā hrīniṣedhā yatavratāḥ ॥34॥
slp1: santuzwaBftyasacivAH kftajYAH priyavAdinaH । yaTArTamAnArTakarA hrInizeDA yatavratAH ॥34॥

text: nityaṃ parvasu susnātāḥ svanuliptāḥ svalaṅkṛtāḥ । upavāsatapaḥśīlāḥ pratītā brahmavādinaḥ ॥35॥
html:
nityaṃ parvasu susnātāḥ svanuliptāḥ svalaṅkṛtāḥ ।
upavāsatapaḥśīlāḥ pratītā brahmavādinaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: nityaM parvasu susnAtAH svanuliptAH svalaNkftAH । upavAsatapaHSIlAH pratItA brahmavAdinaH ॥35॥

text: nainānabhyudiyātsūryo na cāpyāsanprageniśāḥ । rātrau dadhi ca saktūṃśca nityameva vyavarjayan ॥36॥
html:
nainānabhyudiyātsūryo na cāpyāsanprageniśāḥ ।
rātrau dadhi ca saktūṃśca nityameva vyavarjayan ॥36॥
slp1: nEnAnaByudiyAtsUryo na cApyAsanprageniSAH । rAtrO daDi ca saktUMSca nityameva vyavarjayan ॥36॥

text: kālyaṃ ghṛtaṃ cānvavekṣanprayatā brahmacāriṇaḥ । maṅgalānapi cāpaśyanbrāhmaṇāṃścāpyapūjayan ॥37॥
html:
kālyaṃ ghṛtaṃ cānvavekṣanprayatā brahmacāriṇaḥ ।
maṅgalānapi cāpaśyanbrāhmaṇāṃścāpyapūjayan ॥37॥
slp1: kAlyaM GftaM cAnvavekzanprayatA brahmacAriRaH । maNgalAnapi cApaSyanbrAhmaRAMScApyapUjayan ॥37॥

text: sadā hi dadatāṃ dharmaḥ sadā cāpratigṛhṇatām । ardhaṃ ca rātryāḥ svapatāṃ divā cāsvapatāṃ tathā ॥38॥
html:
sadā hi dadatāṃ dharmaḥ sadā cāpratigṛhṇatām ।

slp1: tAM mAM svayamanuprAptAmaBinanda SacIpate । tvayArcitAM mAM deveSa puroDAsyanti devatAH ॥80॥

text: yatrāhaṃ tatra matkāntā madviśiṣṭā madarpaṇāḥ । sapta devyo mayāṣṭamyo vāsaṃ ceṣyanti me'ṣṭadhā ॥81॥
html:
yatrāhaṃ tatra matkāntā madviśiṣṭā madarpaṇāḥ ।
sapta devyo mayāṣṭamyo vāsaṃ ceṣyanti me'ṣṭadhā ॥81॥
slp1: yatrAhaM tatra matkAntA madviSizwA madarpaRAH । sapta devyo mayAzwamyo vAsaM cezyanti me'zwaDA ॥81॥

text: āśā śraddhā dhṛtiḥ kāntirvijitiḥ sannatiḥ kṣamā । aṣṭamī vṛttiretāsāṃ purogā pākaśāsana ॥82॥
html:
āśā śraddhā dhṛtiḥ kāntirvijitiḥ sannatiḥ kṣamā ।
aṣṭamī vṛttiretāsāṃ purogā pākaśāsana ॥82॥
slp1: ASA SradDA DftiH kAntirvijitiH sannatiH kzamA । azwamI vfttiretAsAM purogA pAkaSAsana ॥82॥

text: tāścāhaṃ cāsurāṃstyaktvā yuṣmadviṣayamāgatā । tridaśeṣu nivatsyāmo dharmaniṣṭhāntarātmasu ॥83॥
html:
tāścāhaṃ cāsurāṃstyaktvā yuṣmadviṣayamāgatā ।
tridaśeṣu nivatsyāmo dharmaniṣṭhāntarātmasu ॥83॥
slp1: tAScAhaM cAsurAMstyaktvA yuzmadvizayamAgatA । tridaSezu nivatsyAmo DarmanizWAntarAtmasu ॥83॥

text: ityuktavacanāṃ devīmatyarthaṃ tau nanandatuḥ । nāradaśca trilokarṣirvṛtrahantā ca vāsavaḥ ॥84॥
html:
ityuktavacanāṃ devīmatyarthaṃ tau nanandatuḥ ।
nāradaśca trilokarṣirvṛtrahantā ca vāsavaḥ ॥84॥
slp1: ityuktavacanAM devImatyarTaM tO nanandatuH । nAradaSca trilokarzirvftrahantA ca vAsavaH ॥84॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tato'nalasakho vāyuḥ pravavau devaveśmasu । iṣṭagandhaḥ sukhasparśaḥ sarvendriyasukhāvahaḥ ॥85॥
html:
tato'nalasakho vāyuḥ pravavau devaveśmasu ।
iṣṭagandhaḥ sukhasparśaḥ sarvendriyasukhāvahaḥ ॥85॥
slp1: tato'nalasaKo vAyuH pravavO devaveSmasu । izwaganDaH suKasparSaH sarvendriyasuKAvahaH ॥85॥

text: śucau cābhyarcite deśe tridaśāḥ prāyaśaḥ sthitāḥ । lakṣmyā sahitamāsīnaṃ maghavantaṃ didṛkṣavaḥ ॥86॥
html:
śucau cābhyarcite deśe tridaśāḥ prāyaśaḥ sthitāḥ ।
lakṣmyā sahitamāsīnaṃ maghavantaṃ didṛkṣavaḥ ॥86॥
slp1: SucO cAByarcite deSe tridaSAH prAyaSaH sTitAH । lakzmyA sahitamAsInaM maGavantaM didfkzavaH ॥86॥

text: tato divaṃ prāpya sahasralocanaḥ śriyopapannaḥ suhṛdā surarṣiṇā । rathena haryaśvayujā surarṣabhaḥ sadaḥ surāṇāmabhisatkṛto yayau ॥87॥
html:
tato divaṃ prāpya sahasralocanaḥ śriyopapannaḥ suhṛdā surarṣiṇā ।
rathena haryaśvayujā surarṣabhaḥ sadaḥ surāṇāmabhisatkṛto yayau ॥87॥
slp1: tato divaM prApya sahasralocanaH SriyopapannaH suhfdA surarziRA । raTena haryaSvayujA surarzaBaH sadaH surARAmaBisatkfto yayO ॥87॥

text: atheṅgitaṃ vajradharasya nāradaḥ śriyāśca devyā manasā vicārayan । śriyai śaśaṃsāmaradṛṣṭapauruṣaḥ śivena tatrāgamanaṃ maharddhimat ॥88॥
html:
atheṅgitaṃ vajradharasya nāradaḥ śriyāśca devyā manasā vicārayan ।
śriyai śaśaṃsāmaradṛṣṭapauruṣaḥ śivena tatrāgamanaṃ maharddhimat ॥88॥
slp1: aTeNgitaM vajraDarasya nAradaH SriyASca devyA manasA vicArayan । SriyE SaSaMsAmaradfzwapOruzaH Sivena tatrAgamanaM mahardDimat ॥88॥

text: tato'mṛtaṃ dyauḥ pravavarṣa bhāsvatī pitāmahasyāyatane svayaṃbhuvaḥ । anāhatā dundubhayaśca nedire tathā prasannāśca diśaścakāśire ॥89॥
html:
tato'mṛtaṃ dyauḥ pravavarṣa bhāsvatī pitāmahasyāyatane svayaṃbhuvaḥ ।
anāhatā dundubhayaśca nedire tathā prasannāśca diśaścakāśire ॥89॥
slp1: tato'mftaM dyOH pravavarza BAsvatI pitAmahasyAyatane svayaMBuvaH । anAhatA dunduBayaSca nedire taTA prasannASca diSaScakASire ॥89॥

text: yathartu sasyeṣu vavarṣa vāsavo na dharmamārgādvicacāla kaścana । anekaratnākarabhūṣaṇā ca bhūḥ sughoṣaghoṣā bhuvanaukasāṃ jaye ॥90॥
html:
yathartu sasyeṣu vavarṣa vāsavo na dharmamārgādvicacāla kaścana ।
anekaratnākarabhūṣaṇā ca bhūḥ sughoṣaghoṣā bhuvanaukasāṃ jaye ॥90॥
slp1: yaTartu sasyezu vavarza vAsavo na DarmamArgAdvicacAla kaScana । anekaratnAkaraBUzaRA ca BUH suGozaGozA BuvanOkasAM jaye ॥90॥

text: kriyābhirāmā manujā yaśasvino babhuḥ śubhe puṇyakṛtāṃ pathi sthitāḥ । narāmarāḥ kinnarayakṣarākṣasāḥ samṛddhimantaḥ sukhino yaśasvinaḥ ॥91॥
html:
kriyābhirāmā manujā yaśasvino babhuḥ śubhe puṇyakṛtāṃ pathi sthitāḥ ।
narāmarāḥ kinnarayakṣarākṣasāḥ samṛddhimantaḥ sukhino yaśasvinaḥ ॥91॥
slp1: kriyABirAmA manujA yaSasvino baBuH SuBe puRyakftAM paTi sTitAH । narAmarAH kinnarayakzarAkzasAH samfdDimantaH suKino yaSasvinaH ॥91॥

text: na jātvakāle kusumaṃ kutaḥ phalaṃ papāta vṛkṣātpavaneritādapi । rasapradāḥ kāmadughāśca dhenavo na dāruṇā vāgvicacāra kasyacit ॥92॥
html:
na jātvakāle kusumaṃ kutaḥ phalaṃ papāta vṛkṣātpavaneritādapi ।
rasapradāḥ kāmadughāśca dhenavo na dāruṇā vāgvicacāra kasyacit ॥92॥
slp1: na jAtvakAle kusumaM kutaH PalaM papAta vfkzAtpavaneritAdapi । rasapradAH kAmaduGASca Denavo na dAruRA vAgvicacAra kasyacit ॥92॥

text: imāṃ saparyāṃ saha sarvakāmadaiḥ śriyāśca śakrapramukhaiśca daivataiḥ । paṭhanti ye viprasadaḥ samāgame samṛddhakāmāḥ śriyamāpnuvanti te ॥93॥
html:
imāṃ saparyāṃ saha sarvakāmadaiḥ śriyāśca śakrapramukhaiśca daivataiḥ ।
paṭhanti ye viprasadaḥ samāgame samṛddhakāmāḥ śriyamāpnuvanti te ॥93॥
slp1: imAM saparyAM saha sarvakAmadEH SriyASca SakrapramuKESca dEvatEH । paWanti ye viprasadaH samAgame samfdDakAmAH SriyamApnuvanti te ॥93॥

text: tvayā kurūṇāṃ vara yatpracoditaṃ bhavābhavasyeha paraṃ nidarśanam । tadadya sarvaṃ parikīrtitaṃ mayā parīkṣya tattvaṃ parigantumarhasi] ॥94॥
html:
tvayā kurūṇāṃ vara yatpracoditaṃ bhavābhavasyeha paraṃ nidarśanam ।
tadadya sarvaṃ parikīrtitaṃ mayā parīkṣya tattvaṃ parigantumarhasi] ॥94॥
slp1: tvayA kurURAM vara yatpracoditaM BavABavasyeha paraM nidarSanam । tadadya sarvaM parikIrtitaM mayA parIkzya tattvaM parigantumarhasi] ॥94॥

text: kiṃśīlaḥ kiṃsamācāraḥ kiṃvidyaḥ kiṃparāyaṇaḥ । prāpnoti brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ yatparaṃ prakṛterdhruvam ॥1॥
html:
kiṃśīlaḥ kiṃsamācāraḥ kiṃvidyaḥ kiṃparāyaṇaḥ ।
prāpnoti brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ yatparaṃ prakṛterdhruvam ॥1॥
slp1: kiMSIlaH kiMsamAcAraH kiMvidyaH kiMparAyaRaH । prApnoti brahmaRaH sTAnaM yatparaM prakfterDruvam ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: mokṣadharmeṣu niyato laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ । prāpnoti brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ yatparaṃ prakṛterdhruvam ॥2॥
html:
mokṣadharmeṣu niyato laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ ।
prāpnoti brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ yatparaṃ prakṛterdhruvam ॥2॥
slp1: mokzaDarmezu niyato laGvAhAro jitendriyaH । prApnoti brahmaRaH sTAnaM yatparaM prakfterDruvam ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । jaigīṣavyasya saṃvādamasitasya ca bhārata ॥3॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
jaigīṣavyasya saṃvādamasitasya ca bhārata ॥3॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । jEgIzavyasya saMvAdamasitasya ca BArata ॥3॥

text: jaigīṣavyaṃ mahāprājñaṃ dharmāṇāmāgatāgamam । akrudhyantamahṛṣyantamasito devalo'bravīt ॥4॥
html:
jaigīṣavyaṃ mahāprājñaṃ dharmāṇāmāgatāgamam ।
akrudhyantamahṛṣyantamasito devalo'bravīt ॥4॥
slp1: jEgIzavyaM mahAprAjYaM DarmARAmAgatAgamam । akruDyantamahfzyantamasito devalo'bravIt ॥4॥

text: na prīyase vandyamāno nindyamāno na kupyasi । kā te prajñā kutaścaiṣā kiṃ caitasyāḥ parāyaṇam ॥5॥
html:
na prīyase vandyamāno nindyamāno na kupyasi ।
kā te prajñā kutaścaiṣā kiṃ caitasyāḥ parāyaṇam ॥5॥
slp1: na prIyase vandyamAno nindyamAno na kupyasi । kA te prajYA kutaScEzA kiM cEtasyAH parAyaRam ॥5॥

text: iti tenānuyuktaḥ sa tamuvāca mahātapāḥ । mahadvākyamasandigdhaṃ puṣkalārthapadaṃ śuci ॥6॥
html:
iti tenānuyuktaḥ sa tamuvāca mahātapāḥ ।
mahadvākyamasandigdhaṃ puṣkalārthapadaṃ śuci ॥6॥
slp1: iti tenAnuyuktaH sa tamuvAca mahAtapAH । mahadvAkyamasandigDaM puzkalArTapadaM Suci ॥6॥

text: yā gatiryā parā niṣṭhā yā śāntiḥ puṇyakarmaṇām । tāṃ te'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi yanmāṃ pṛcchasi vai dvija ॥7॥
html:
yā gatiryā parā niṣṭhā yā śāntiḥ puṇyakarmaṇām ।
tāṃ te'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi yanmāṃ pṛcchasi vai dvija ॥7॥
slp1: yA gatiryA parA nizWA yA SAntiH puRyakarmaRAm । tAM te'haM sampravakzyAmi yanmAM pfcCasi vE dvija ॥7॥

text: nindatsu ca samo nityaṃ praśaṃsatsu ca devala । nihnuvanti ca ye teṣāṃ samayaṃ sukṛtaṃ ca ye ॥8॥
html:
nindatsu ca samo nityaṃ praśaṃsatsu ca devala ।
nihnuvanti ca ye teṣāṃ samayaṃ sukṛtaṃ ca ye ॥8॥
slp1: nindatsu ca samo nityaM praSaMsatsu ca devala । nihnuvanti ca ye tezAM samayaM sukftaM ca ye ॥8॥

text: uktāśca na vivakṣanti vaktāramahite ratam । pratihantuṃ na cecchanti hantāraṃ vai manīṣiṇaḥ ॥9॥
html:
uktāśca na vivakṣanti vaktāramahite ratam ।
pratihantuṃ na cecchanti hantāraṃ vai manīṣiṇaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: uktASca na vivakzanti vaktAramahite ratam । pratihantuM na cecCanti hantAraM vE manIziRaH ॥9॥

text: nāprāptamanuśocanti prāptakālāni kurvate । na cātītāni śocanti na cainānpratijānate ॥10॥
html:
nāprāptamanuśocanti prāptakālāni kurvate ।
na cātītāni śocanti na cainānpratijānate ॥10॥
slp1: nAprAptamanuSocanti prAptakAlAni kurvate । na cAtItAni Socanti na cEnAnpratijAnate ॥10॥

text: samprāptānāṃ ca pūjyānāṃ kāmādartheṣu devala । yathopapattiṃ kurvanti śaktimantaḥ kṛtavratāḥ ॥11॥
html:
samprāptānāṃ ca pūjyānāṃ kāmādartheṣu devala ।
yathopapattiṃ kurvanti śaktimantaḥ kṛtavratāḥ ॥11॥
slp1: samprAptAnAM ca pUjyAnAM kAmAdarTezu devala । yaTopapattiM kurvanti SaktimantaH kftavratAH ॥11॥

text: pakvavidyā mahāprājñā jitakrodhā jitendriyāḥ । manasā karmaṇā vācā nāparādhyanti kasyacit ॥12॥
html:
pakvavidyā mahāprājñā jitakrodhā jitendriyāḥ ।
manasā karmaṇā vācā nāparādhyanti kasyacit ॥12॥
slp1: pakvavidyA mahAprAjYA jitakroDA jitendriyAH । manasA karmaRA vAcA nAparADyanti kasyacit ॥12॥

text: anīrṣavo na cānyonyaṃ vihiṃsanti kadācana । na ca jātūpatapyante dhīrāḥ parasamṛddhibhiḥ ॥13॥
html:
anīrṣavo na cānyonyaṃ vihiṃsanti kadācana ।
na ca jātūpatapyante dhīrāḥ parasamṛddhibhiḥ ॥13॥
slp1: anIrzavo na cAnyonyaM vihiMsanti kadAcana । na ca jAtUpatapyante DIrAH parasamfdDiBiH ॥13॥

text: nindāpraśaṃse cātyarthaṃ na vadanti parasya ye । na ca nindāpraśaṃsābhyāṃ vikriyante kadācana ॥14॥
html:
nindāpraśaṃse cātyarthaṃ na vadanti parasya ye ।
na ca nindāpraśaṃsābhyāṃ vikriyante kadācana ॥14॥
slp1: nindApraSaMse cAtyarTaM na vadanti parasya ye । na ca nindApraSaMsAByAM vikriyante kadAcana ॥14॥

text: sarvataśca praśāntā ye sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ । na krudhyanti na hṛṣyanti nāparādhyanti kasyacit । vimucya hṛdayagranthīṃścaṅkamyante yathāsukham ॥15॥
html:
sarvataśca praśāntā ye sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ।
na krudhyanti na hṛṣyanti nāparādhyanti kasyacit ।
vimucya hṛdayagranthīṃścaṅkamyante yathāsukham ॥15॥
slp1: sarvataSca praSAntA ye sarvaBUtahite ratAH । na kruDyanti na hfzyanti nAparADyanti kasyacit । vimucya hfdayagranTIMScaNkamyante yaTAsuKam ॥15॥

text: na yeṣāṃ bāndhavāḥ santi ye cānyeṣāṃ na bāndhavāḥ । amitrāśca na santyeṣāṃ ye cāmitrā na kasyacit ॥16॥
html:
na yeṣāṃ bāndhavāḥ santi ye cānyeṣāṃ na bāndhavāḥ ।
amitrāśca na santyeṣāṃ ye cāmitrā na kasyacit ॥16॥
slp1: na yezAM bAnDavAH santi ye cAnyezAM na bAnDavAH । amitrASca na santyezAM ye cAmitrA na kasyacit ॥16॥

text: ya evaṃ kurvate martyāḥ sukhaṃ jīvanti sarvadā । dharmamevānuvartante dharmajñā dvijasattama । ye hyato vicyutā mārgātte hṛṣyantyudvijanti ca ॥17॥
html:
ya evaṃ kurvate martyāḥ sukhaṃ jīvanti sarvadā ।
dharmamevānuvartante dharmajñā dvijasattama ।
ye hyato vicyutā mārgātte hṛṣyantyudvijanti ca ॥17॥
slp1: ya evaM kurvate martyAH suKaM jIvanti sarvadA । DarmamevAnuvartante DarmajYA dvijasattama । ye hyato vicyutA mArgAtte hfzyantyudvijanti ca ॥17॥

text: āsthitastamahaṃ mārgamasūyiṣyāmi kaṃ katham । nindyamānaḥ praśasto vā hṛṣyeyaṃ kena hetunā ॥18॥
html:
āsthitastamahaṃ mārgamasūyiṣyāmi kaṃ katham ।
nindyamānaḥ praśasto vā hṛṣyeyaṃ kena hetunā ॥18॥
slp1: AsTitastamahaM mArgamasUyizyAmi kaM kaTam । nindyamAnaH praSasto vA hfzyeyaM kena hetunA ॥18॥

text: yadyadicchanti tanmārgamabhigacchanti mānavāḥ । na me nindāpraśaṃsābhyāṃ hrāsavṛddhī bhaviṣyataḥ ॥19॥
html:
yadyadicchanti tanmārgamabhigacchanti mānavāḥ ।
na me nindāpraśaṃsābhyāṃ hrāsavṛddhī bhaviṣyataḥ ॥19॥
slp1: yadyadicCanti tanmArgamaBigacCanti mAnavAH । na me nindApraSaMsAByAM hrAsavfdDI BavizyataH ॥19॥

text: amṛtasyeva santṛpyedavamānasya tattvavit । viṣasyevodvijennityaṃ sammānasya vicakṣaṇaḥ ॥20॥
html:
amṛtasyeva santṛpyedavamānasya tattvavit ।
viṣasyevodvijennityaṃ sammānasya vicakṣaṇaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: amftasyeva santfpyedavamAnasya tattvavit । vizasyevodvijennityaM sammAnasya vicakzaRaH ॥20॥

text: avajñātaḥ sukhaṃ śete iha cāmutra cobhayoḥ । vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo yo'vamantā sa badhyate ॥21॥
html:
avajñātaḥ sukhaṃ śete iha cāmutra cobhayoḥ ।
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo yo'vamantā sa badhyate ॥21॥
slp1: avajYAtaH suKaM Sete iha cAmutra coBayoH । vimuktaH sarvapApeByo yo'vamantA sa baDyate ॥21॥

text: parāṃ gatiṃ ca ye kecitprārthayanti manīṣiṇaḥ । etadvrataṃ samāśritya sukhamedhanti te janāḥ ॥22॥
html:
parāṃ gatiṃ ca ye kecitprārthayanti manīṣiṇaḥ ।
etadvrataṃ samāśritya sukhamedhanti te janāḥ ॥22॥
slp1: parAM gatiM ca ye kecitprArTayanti manIziRaH । etadvrataM samASritya suKameDanti te janAH ॥22॥

text: sarvataśca samāhṛtya kratūnsarvāñjitendriyaḥ । prāpnoti brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ yatparaṃ prakṛterdhruvam ॥23॥
html:
sarvataśca samāhṛtya kratūnsarvāñjitendriyaḥ ।
prāpnoti brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ yatparaṃ prakṛterdhruvam ॥23॥
slp1: sarvataSca samAhftya kratUnsarvAYjitendriyaH । prApnoti brahmaRaH sTAnaM yatparaM prakfterDruvam ॥23॥

text: nāsya devā na gandharvā na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ । padamanvavarohanti prāptasya paramāṃ gatim] ॥24॥
html:
nāsya devā na gandharvā na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ ।
padamanvavarohanti prāptasya paramāṃ gatim] ॥24॥
slp1: nAsya devA na ganDarvA na piSAcA na rAkzasAH । padamanvavarohanti prAptasya paramAM gatim] ॥24॥

text: priyaḥ sarvasya lokasya sarvasattvābhinanditā । guṇaiḥ sarvairupetaśca ko nvasti bhuvi mānavaḥ ॥1॥
html:
priyaḥ sarvasya lokasya sarvasattvābhinanditā ।
guṇaiḥ sarvairupetaśca ko nvasti bhuvi mānavaḥ ॥1॥

text: ādyantaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ śrotumicchāmi kaurava । dhyānaṃ karma ca kālaṃ ca tathaivāyuryuge yuge ॥1॥

html:
