catvāryāhuḥ sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ tatkṛtaṃ yugam ।
tasya tāvacchatī sandhyā sandhyāṃśaśca tathāvidhaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: catvAryAhuH sahasrARi varzARAM tatkftaM yugam । tasya tAvacCatI sanDyA sanDyAMSaSca taTAviDaH ॥19॥

text: itareṣu sasandhyeṣu sasandhyāṃśeṣu ca triṣu । ekāpāyena saṃyānti sahasrāṇi śatāni ca ॥20॥
html:
itareṣu sasandhyeṣu sasandhyāṃśeṣu ca triṣu ।
ekāpāyena saṃyānti sahasrāṇi śatāni ca ॥20॥
slp1: itarezu sasanDyezu sasanDyAMSezu ca trizu । ekApAyena saMyAnti sahasrARi SatAni ca ॥20॥

text: etāni śāśvatāṁllokāndhārayanti sanātanān । etadbrahmavidāṃ tāta viditaṃ brahma śāśvatam ॥21॥
html:
etāni śāśvatāṁllokāndhārayanti sanātanān ।
etadbrahmavidāṃ tāta viditaṃ brahma śāśvatam ॥21॥
slp1: etAni SASvatAṁllokAnDArayanti sanAtanAn । etadbrahmavidAM tAta viditaM brahma SASvatam ॥21॥

text: catuṣpātsakalo dharmaḥ satyaṃ caiva kṛte yuge । nādharmeṇāgamaḥ kaścitparastasya pravartate ॥22॥
html:
catuṣpātsakalo dharmaḥ satyaṃ caiva kṛte yuge ।
nādharmeṇāgamaḥ kaścitparastasya pravartate ॥22॥
slp1: catuzpAtsakalo DarmaH satyaM cEva kfte yuge । nADarmeRAgamaH kaScitparastasya pravartate ॥22॥

text: itareṣvāgamāddharmaḥ pādaśastvavaropyate । caurikānṛtamāyābhiradharmaścopacīyate ॥23॥
html:
itareṣvāgamāddharmaḥ pādaśastvavaropyate ।
caurikānṛtamāyābhiradharmaścopacīyate ॥23॥
slp1: itarezvAgamAdDarmaH pAdaSastvavaropyate । cOrikAnftamAyABiraDarmaScopacIyate ॥23॥

text: arogāḥ sarvasiddhārthāścaturvarṣaśatāyuṣaḥ । kṛte tretādiṣveteṣāṃ pādaśo hrasate vayaḥ ॥24॥
html:
arogāḥ sarvasiddhārthāścaturvarṣaśatāyuṣaḥ ।
kṛte tretādiṣveteṣāṃ pādaśo hrasate vayaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: arogAH sarvasidDArTAScaturvarzaSatAyuzaH । kfte tretAdizvetezAM pAdaSo hrasate vayaH ॥24॥

text: vedavādāścānuyugaṃ hrasantīti ca naḥ śrutam । āyūṃṣi cāśiṣaścaiva vedasyaiva ca yatphalam ॥25॥
html:
vedavādāścānuyugaṃ hrasantīti ca naḥ śrutam ।
āyūṃṣi cāśiṣaścaiva vedasyaiva ca yatphalam ॥25॥
slp1: vedavAdAScAnuyugaM hrasantIti ca naH Srutam । AyUMzi cASizaScEva vedasyEva ca yatPalam ॥25॥

text: anye kṛtayuge dharmāstretāyāṃ dvāpare'pare । anye kaliyuge dharmā yathāśaktikṛtā iva ॥26॥
html:
anye kṛtayuge dharmāstretāyāṃ dvāpare'pare ।
anye kaliyuge dharmā yathāśaktikṛtā iva ॥26॥
slp1: anye kftayuge DarmAstretAyAM dvApare'pare । anye kaliyuge DarmA yaTASaktikftA iva ॥26॥

text: tapaḥ paraṃ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ jñānamuttamam । dvāpare yajñamevāhurdānameva kalau yuge ॥27॥
html:
tapaḥ paraṃ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ jñānamuttamam ।
dvāpare yajñamevāhurdānameva kalau yuge ॥27॥
slp1: tapaH paraM kftayuge tretAyAM jYAnamuttamam । dvApare yajYamevAhurdAnameva kalO yuge ॥27॥

text: etāṃ dvādaśasāhasrīṃ yugākhyāṃ kavayo viduḥ । sahasraṃ parivṛttaṃ tadbrāhmaṃ divasamucyate ॥28॥
html:
etāṃ dvādaśasāhasrīṃ yugākhyāṃ kavayo viduḥ ।
sahasraṃ parivṛttaṃ tadbrāhmaṃ divasamucyate ॥28॥
slp1: etAM dvAdaSasAhasrIM yugAKyAM kavayo viduH । sahasraM parivfttaM tadbrAhmaM divasamucyate ॥28॥

text: rātristāvattithī brāhmī tadādau viśvamīśvaraḥ । pralaye'dhyātmamāviśya suptvā so'nte vibudhyate ॥29॥
html:
rātristāvattithī brāhmī tadādau viśvamīśvaraḥ ।
pralaye'dhyātmamāviśya suptvā so'nte vibudhyate ॥29॥
slp1: rAtristAvattiTI brAhmI tadAdO viSvamISvaraH । pralaye'DyAtmamAviSya suptvA so'nte vibuDyate ॥29॥

text: sahasrayugaparyantamaharyadbrahmaṇo viduḥ । rātriṃ yugasahasrāntāṃ te'horātravido janāḥ ॥30॥
html:
sahasrayugaparyantamaharyadbrahmaṇo viduḥ ।
rātriṃ yugasahasrāntāṃ te'horātravido janāḥ ॥30॥
slp1: sahasrayugaparyantamaharyadbrahmaRo viduH । rAtriM yugasahasrAntAM te'horAtravido janAH ॥30॥

text: pratibuddho vikurute brahmākṣayyaṃ kṣapākṣaye । sṛjate ca mahadbhūtaṃ tasmādvyaktātmakaṃ manaḥ ॥31॥
html:
pratibuddho vikurute brahmākṣayyaṃ kṣapākṣaye ।
sṛjate ca mahadbhūtaṃ tasmādvyaktātmakaṃ manaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: pratibudDo vikurute brahmAkzayyaM kzapAkzaye । sfjate ca mahadBUtaM tasmAdvyaktAtmakaM manaH ॥31॥

text: brahma tejomayaṃ śukraṃ yasya sarvamidaṃ jagat । ekasya bhūtaṃ bhūtasya dvayaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam ॥32॥
html:
brahma tejomayaṃ śukraṃ yasya sarvamidaṃ jagat ।
ekasya bhūtaṃ bhūtasya dvayaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam ॥32॥
slp1: brahma tejomayaM SukraM yasya sarvamidaM jagat । ekasya BUtaM BUtasya dvayaM sTAvarajaNgamam ॥32॥

text: aharmukhe vibuddhaḥ sansṛjate vidyayā jagat । agra eva mahābhūtamāśu vyaktātmakaṃ manaḥ ॥33॥
html:
aharmukhe vibuddhaḥ sansṛjate vidyayā jagat ।
agra eva mahābhūtamāśu vyaktātmakaṃ manaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: aharmuKe vibudDaH sansfjate vidyayA jagat । agra eva mahABUtamASu vyaktAtmakaM manaH ॥33॥

text: abhibhūyeha cārciṣmadvyasṛjatsapta mānasān । dūragaṃ bahudhāgāmi prārthanāsaṃśayātmakam ॥34॥
html:
abhibhūyeha cārciṣmadvyasṛjatsapta mānasān ।
dūragaṃ bahudhāgāmi prārthanāsaṃśayātmakam ॥34॥
slp1: aBiBUyeha cArcizmadvyasfjatsapta mAnasAn । dUragaM bahuDAgAmi prArTanAsaMSayAtmakam ॥34॥

text: manaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ vikurute codyamānaṃ sisṛkṣayā । ākāśaṃ jāyate tasmāttasya śabdo guṇo mataḥ ॥35॥
html:
manaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ vikurute codyamānaṃ sisṛkṣayā ।
ākāśaṃ jāyate tasmāttasya śabdo guṇo mataḥ ॥35॥
slp1: manaH sfzwiM vikurute codyamAnaM sisfkzayA । AkASaM jAyate tasmAttasya Sabdo guRo mataH ॥35॥

text: ākāśāttu vikurvāṇātsarvagandhavahaḥ śuciḥ । balavāñjāyate vāyustasya sparśo guṇo mataḥ ॥36॥
html:
ākāśāttu vikurvāṇātsarvagandhavahaḥ śuciḥ ।
balavāñjāyate vāyustasya sparśo guṇo mataḥ ॥36॥
slp1: AkASAttu vikurvARAtsarvaganDavahaH SuciH । balavAYjAyate vAyustasya sparSo guRo mataH ॥36॥

text: vāyorapi vikurvāṇājjyotirbhūtaṃ tamonudam । rociṣṇu jāyate tatra tadrūpaguṇamucyate ॥37॥
html:
vāyorapi vikurvāṇājjyotirbhūtaṃ tamonudam ।
rociṣṇu jāyate tatra tadrūpaguṇamucyate ॥37॥
slp1: vAyorapi vikurvARAjjyotirBUtaM tamonudam । rocizRu jAyate tatra tadrUpaguRamucyate ॥37॥

text: jyotiṣo'pi vikurvāṇādbhavantyāpo rasātmikāḥ । adbhyo gandhaguṇā bhūmiḥ pūrvaiṣā sṛṣṭirucyate ॥38॥
html:
jyotiṣo'pi vikurvāṇādbhavantyāpo rasātmikāḥ ।
adbhyo gandhaguṇā bhūmiḥ pūrvaiṣā sṛṣṭirucyate ॥38॥
slp1: jyotizo'pi vikurvARAdBavantyApo rasAtmikAH । adByo ganDaguRA BUmiH pUrvEzA sfzwirucyate ॥38॥

text: guṇāḥ pūrvasya pūrvasya prāpnuvantyuttarottaram । teṣāṃ yāvattithaṃ yadyattattattāvadguṇaṃ smṛtam ॥39॥
html:
guṇāḥ pūrvasya pūrvasya prāpnuvantyuttarottaram ।
teṣāṃ yāvattithaṃ yadyattattattāvadguṇaṃ smṛtam ॥39॥
slp1: guRAH pUrvasya pUrvasya prApnuvantyuttarottaram । tezAM yAvattiTaM yadyattattattAvadguRaM smftam ॥39॥

text: upalabhyāpsu cedgandhaṃ kecidbrūyuranaipuṇāt । pṛthivyāmeva taṃ vidyādāpo vāyuṃ ca saṃśritam ॥40॥
html:
upalabhyāpsu cedgandhaṃ kecidbrūyuranaipuṇāt ।
pṛthivyāmeva taṃ vidyādāpo vāyuṃ ca saṃśritam ॥40॥
slp1: upalaByApsu cedganDaM kecidbrUyuranEpuRAt । pfTivyAmeva taM vidyAdApo vAyuM ca saMSritam ॥40॥

text: ete tu sapta puruṣā nānāviryāḥ pṛthakpṛthak । nāśaknuvanprajāḥ sraṣṭumasamāgamya sarvataḥ ॥41॥
html:
ete tu sapta puruṣā nānāviryāḥ pṛthakpṛthak ।
nāśaknuvanprajāḥ sraṣṭumasamāgamya sarvataḥ ॥41॥
slp1: ete tu sapta puruzA nAnAviryAH pfTakpfTak । nASaknuvanprajAH srazwumasamAgamya sarvataH ॥41॥

text: te sametya mahātmānamanyonyamabhisaṃśritāḥ । śarīrāśrayaṇaṃ prāptāstataḥ puruṣa ucyate ॥42॥
html:
te sametya mahātmānamanyonyamabhisaṃśritāḥ ।
śarīrāśrayaṇaṃ prāptāstataḥ puruṣa ucyate ॥42॥
slp1: te sametya mahAtmAnamanyonyamaBisaMSritAH । SarIrASrayaRaM prAptAstataH puruza ucyate ॥42॥

text: śrayaṇāccharīraṃ bhavati mūrtimatṣoḍaśātmakam । tadāviśanti bhūtāni mahānti saha karmaṇā ॥43॥
html:
śrayaṇāccharīraṃ bhavati mūrtimatṣoḍaśātmakam ।
tadāviśanti bhūtāni mahānti saha karmaṇā ॥43॥
slp1: SrayaRAcCarIraM Bavati mUrtimatzoqaSAtmakam । tadAviSanti BUtAni mahAnti saha karmaRA ॥43॥

text: sarvabhūtāni cādāya tapasaścaraṇāya ca । ādikartā mahābhūtaṃ tamevāhuḥ prajāpatim ॥44॥
html:
sarvabhūtāni cādāya tapasaścaraṇāya ca ।
ādikartā mahābhūtaṃ tamevāhuḥ prajāpatim ॥44॥
slp1: sarvaBUtAni cAdAya tapasaScaraRAya ca । AdikartA mahABUtaM tamevAhuH prajApatim ॥44॥

text: sa vai sṛjati bhūtāni sa eva puruṣaḥ paraḥ । ajo janayate brahmā devarṣipitṛmānavān ॥45॥
html:
sa vai sṛjati bhūtāni sa eva puruṣaḥ paraḥ ।
ajo janayate brahmā devarṣipitṛmānavān ॥45॥
slp1: sa vE sfjati BUtAni sa eva puruzaH paraH । ajo janayate brahmA devarzipitfmAnavAn ॥45॥

text: lokānnadīḥ samudrāṃśca diśaḥ śailānvanaspatīn । narakinnararakṣāṃsi vayaḥpaśumṛgoragān । avyayaṃ ca vyayaṃ caiva dvayaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam ॥46॥
html:
lokānnadīḥ samudrāṃśca diśaḥ śailānvanaspatīn ।
narakinnararakṣāṃsi vayaḥpaśumṛgoragān ।
avyayaṃ ca vyayaṃ caiva dvayaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam ॥46॥
slp1: lokAnnadIH samudrAMSca diSaH SElAnvanaspatIn । narakinnararakzAMsi vayaHpaSumfgoragAn । avyayaM ca vyayaM cEva dvayaM sTAvarajaNgamam ॥46॥

text: teṣāṃ ye yāni karmāṇi prāksṛṣṭyāṃ pratipedire । tānyeva pratipadyante sṛjyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥47॥
html:
teṣāṃ ye yāni karmāṇi prāksṛṣṭyāṃ pratipedire ।
tānyeva pratipadyante sṛjyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: tezAM ye yAni karmARi prAksfzwyAM pratipedire । tAnyeva pratipadyante sfjyamAnAH punaH punaH ॥47॥

text: hiṃsrāhiṃsre mṛdukrūre dharmādharme ṛtānṛte । ato yanmanyate dhātā tasmāttattasya rocate ॥48॥
html:
hiṃsrāhiṃsre mṛdukrūre dharmādharme ṛtānṛte ।
ato yanmanyate dhātā tasmāttattasya rocate ॥48॥
slp1: hiMsrAhiMsre mfdukrUre DarmADarme ftAnfte । ato yanmanyate DAtA tasmAttattasya rocate ॥48॥

text: mahābhūteṣu nānātvamindriyārtheṣu mūrtiṣu । viniyogaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ dhātaiva vidadhātyuta ॥49॥
html:
mahābhūteṣu nānātvamindriyārtheṣu mūrtiṣu ।
viniyogaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ dhātaiva vidadhātyuta ॥49॥
slp1: mahABUtezu nAnAtvamindriyArTezu mUrtizu । viniyogaM ca BUtAnAM DAtEva vidaDAtyuta ॥49॥

text: kecitpuruṣakāraṃ tu prāhuḥ karmavido janāḥ । daivamityapare viprāḥ svabhāvaṃ bhūtacintakāḥ ॥50॥
html:
kecitpuruṣakāraṃ tu prāhuḥ karmavido janāḥ ।
daivamityapare viprāḥ svabhāvaṃ bhūtacintakāḥ ॥50॥
slp1: kecitpuruzakAraM tu prAhuH karmavido janAH । dEvamityapare viprAH svaBAvaM BUtacintakAH ॥50॥

text: pauruṣaṃ karma daivaṃ ca phalavṛttisvabhāvataḥ । traya ete'pṛthagbhūtā navivekaṃ tu kecana ॥51॥
html:
pauruṣaṃ karma daivaṃ ca phalavṛttisvabhāvataḥ ।
traya ete'pṛthagbhūtā navivekaṃ tu kecana ॥51॥
slp1: pOruzaM karma dEvaM ca PalavfttisvaBAvataH । traya ete'pfTagBUtA navivekaM tu kecana ॥51॥

text: evametacca naivaṃ ca yadbhūtaṃ sṛjate jagat । karmasthā viṣamaṃ brūyuḥ sattvasthāḥ samadarśinaḥ ॥52॥
html:
evametacca naivaṃ ca yadbhūtaṃ sṛjate jagat ।
karmasthā viṣamaṃ brūyuḥ sattvasthāḥ samadarśinaḥ ॥52॥
slp1: evametacca nEvaM ca yadBUtaM sfjate jagat । karmasTA vizamaM brUyuH sattvasTAH samadarSinaH ॥52॥

text: tapo niḥśreyasaṃ jantostasya mūlaṃ damaḥ śamaḥ । tena sarvānavāpnoti yānkāmānmanasecchati ॥53॥
html:
tapo niḥśreyasaṃ jantostasya mūlaṃ damaḥ śamaḥ ।
tena sarvānavāpnoti yānkāmānmanasecchati ॥53॥
slp1: tapo niHSreyasaM jantostasya mUlaM damaH SamaH । tena sarvAnavApnoti yAnkAmAnmanasecCati ॥53॥

text: tapasā tadavāpnoti yadbhūtaṃ sṛjate jagat । sa tadbhūtaśca sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ bhavati prabhuḥ ॥54॥
html:
tapasā tadavāpnoti yadbhūtaṃ sṛjate jagat ।
sa tadbhūtaśca sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ bhavati prabhuḥ ॥54॥
slp1: tapasA tadavApnoti yadBUtaM sfjate jagat । sa tadBUtaSca sarvezAM BUtAnAM Bavati praBuH ॥54॥

text: ṛṣayastapasā vedānadhyaiṣanta divāniśam । anādinidhanā nityā vāgutsṛṣṭā svayambhuvā ॥55॥
html:
ṛṣayastapasā vedānadhyaiṣanta divāniśam ।
anādinidhanā nityā vāgutsṛṣṭā svayambhuvā ॥55॥
slp1: fzayastapasA vedAnaDyEzanta divAniSam । anAdiniDanA nityA vAgutsfzwA svayamBuvA ॥55॥

text: ṛṣīṇāṃ nāmadheyāni yāśca vedeṣu sṛṣṭayaḥ । śarvaryanteṣu jātānāṃ tānyevaibhyo dadāti saḥ ॥56॥
html:
ṛṣīṇāṃ nāmadheyāni yāśca vedeṣu sṛṣṭayaḥ ।
śarvaryanteṣu jātānāṃ tānyevaibhyo dadāti saḥ ॥56॥
slp1: fzIRAM nAmaDeyAni yASca vedezu sfzwayaH । Sarvaryantezu jAtAnAM tAnyevEByo dadAti saH ॥56॥

text: nāmabhedastapaḥkarmayajñākhyā lokasiddhayaḥ । ātmasiddhistu vedeṣu procyate daśabhiḥ kramaiḥ ॥57॥
html:
nāmabhedastapaḥkarmayajñākhyā lokasiddhayaḥ ।
ātmasiddhistu vedeṣu procyate daśabhiḥ kramaiḥ ॥57॥
slp1: nAmaBedastapaHkarmayajYAKyA lokasidDayaH । AtmasidDistu vedezu procyate daSaBiH kramEH ॥57॥

text: yaduktaṃ vedavādeṣu gahanaṃ vedadṛṣṭibhiḥ । tadanteṣu yathāyuktaṃ kramayogena lakṣyate ॥58॥
html:
yaduktaṃ vedavādeṣu gahanaṃ vedadṛṣṭibhiḥ ।
tadanteṣu yathāyuktaṃ kramayogena lakṣyate ॥58॥
slp1: yaduktaM vedavAdezu gahanaM vedadfzwiBiH । tadantezu yaTAyuktaM kramayogena lakzyate ॥58॥

text: karmajo'yaṃ pṛthagbhāvo dvandvayukto viyoginaḥ । ātmasiddhistu vijñātā jahāti prāyaśo balam ॥59॥
html:
karmajo'yaṃ pṛthagbhāvo dvandvayukto viyoginaḥ ।
ātmasiddhistu vijñātā jahāti prāyaśo balam ॥59॥
slp1: karmajo'yaM pfTagBAvo dvandvayukto viyoginaH । AtmasidDistu vijYAtA jahAti prAyaSo balam ॥59॥

text: dve brahmaṇī veditavye śabdabrahma paraṃ ca yat । śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati ॥60॥
html:
dve brahmaṇī veditavye śabdabrahma paraṃ ca yat ।
śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati ॥60॥
slp1: dve brahmaRI veditavye Sabdabrahma paraM ca yat । SabdabrahmaRi nizRAtaH paraM brahmADigacCati ॥60॥

text: ārambhayajñāḥ kṣatrasya haviryajñā viśastathā । paricārayajñāḥ śūdrāstu tapoyajñā dvijātayaḥ ॥61॥
html:
ārambhayajñāḥ kṣatrasya haviryajñā viśastathā ।

yājyataḥ śiṣyato vāpi kanyayā vā dhanaṃ mahat ।
yadyāgacchedyajeddadyānnaiko'śnīyātkathañcana ॥12॥
slp1: yAjyataH Sizyato vApi kanyayA vA DanaM mahat । yadyAgacCedyajeddadyAnnEko'SnIyAtkaTaYcana ॥12॥

text: gṛhamāvasato hyasya nānyattīrthaṃ pratigrahāt । devarṣipitṛgurvarthaṃ vṛddhāturabubhukṣatām ॥13॥
html:
gṛhamāvasato hyasya nānyattīrthaṃ pratigrahāt ।
devarṣipitṛgurvarthaṃ vṛddhāturabubhukṣatām ॥13॥
slp1: gfhamAvasato hyasya nAnyattIrTaM pratigrahAt । devarzipitfgurvarTaM vfdDAturabuBukzatAm ॥13॥

text: antarhitābhitaptānāṃ yathāśakti bubhūṣatām । dravyāṇāmatiśaktyāpi deyameṣāṃ kṛtādapi ॥14॥
html:
antarhitābhitaptānāṃ yathāśakti bubhūṣatām ।
dravyāṇāmatiśaktyāpi deyameṣāṃ kṛtādapi ॥14॥
slp1: antarhitABitaptAnAM yaTASakti buBUzatAm । dravyARAmatiSaktyApi deyamezAM kftAdapi ॥14॥

text: arhatāmanurūpāṇāṃ nādeyaṃ hyasti kiñcana । uccaiḥśravasamapyaśvaṃ prāpaṇīyaṃ satāṃ viduḥ ॥15॥
html:
arhatāmanurūpāṇāṃ nādeyaṃ hyasti kiñcana ।
uccaiḥśravasamapyaśvaṃ prāpaṇīyaṃ satāṃ viduḥ ॥15॥
slp1: arhatAmanurUpARAM nAdeyaM hyasti kiYcana । uccEHSravasamapyaSvaM prApaRIyaM satAM viduH ॥15॥

text: anunīya tathā kāvyaḥ satyasandho mahāvrataḥ । svaiḥ prāṇairbrāhmaṇaprāṇānparitrāya divaṃ gataḥ ॥16॥
html:
anunīya tathā kāvyaḥ satyasandho mahāvrataḥ ।
svaiḥ prāṇairbrāhmaṇaprāṇānparitrāya divaṃ gataḥ ॥16॥
slp1: anunIya taTA kAvyaH satyasanDo mahAvrataH । svEH prARErbrAhmaRaprARAnparitrAya divaM gataH ॥16॥

text: rantidevaśca sāṅkṛtyo vasiṣṭhāya mahātmane । apaḥ pradāya śītoṣṇā nākapṛṣṭhe mahīyate ॥17॥
html:
rantidevaśca sāṅkṛtyo vasiṣṭhāya mahātmane ।
apaḥ pradāya śītoṣṇā nākapṛṣṭhe mahīyate ॥17॥
slp1: rantidevaSca sANkftyo vasizWAya mahAtmane । apaH pradAya SItozRA nAkapfzWe mahIyate ॥17॥

text: ātreyaścandradamayorarhatorvividhaṃ dhanam । dattvā lokānyayau dhīmānanantānsa mahīpatiḥ ॥18॥
html:
ātreyaścandradamayorarhatorvividhaṃ dhanam ।
dattvā lokānyayau dhīmānanantānsa mahīpatiḥ ॥18॥
slp1: AtreyaScandradamayorarhatorviviDaM Danam । dattvA lokAnyayO DImAnanantAnsa mahIpatiH ॥18॥

text: śibirauśīnaro'ṅgāni sutaṃ ca priyamaurasam । brāhmaṇārthamupākṛtya nākapṛṣṭhamito gataḥ ॥19॥
html:
śibirauśīnaro'ṅgāni sutaṃ ca priyamaurasam ।
brāhmaṇārthamupākṛtya nākapṛṣṭhamito gataḥ ॥19॥
slp1: SibirOSInaro'NgAni sutaM ca priyamOrasam । brAhmaRArTamupAkftya nAkapfzWamito gataH ॥19॥

text: pratardanaḥ kāśipatiḥ pradāya nayane svake । brāhmaṇāyātulāṃ kīrtimiha cāmutra cāśnute ॥20॥
html:
pratardanaḥ kāśipatiḥ pradāya nayane svake ।
brāhmaṇāyātulāṃ kīrtimiha cāmutra cāśnute ॥20॥
slp1: pratardanaH kASipatiH pradAya nayane svake । brAhmaRAyAtulAM kIrtimiha cAmutra cASnute ॥20॥

text: divyaṃ mṛṣṭaśalākaṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ paramarddhimat । chatraṃ devāvṛdho dattvā sarāṣṭro'bhyapataddivam ॥21॥
html:
divyaṃ mṛṣṭaśalākaṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ paramarddhimat ।
chatraṃ devāvṛdho dattvā sarāṣṭro'bhyapataddivam ॥21॥
slp1: divyaM mfzwaSalAkaM tu sOvarRaM paramardDimat । CatraM devAvfDo dattvA sarAzwro'Byapataddivam ॥21॥

text: sāṅkṛtiśca tathātreyaḥ śiṣyebhyo brahma nirguṇam । upadiśya mahātejā gato lokānanuttamān ॥22॥
html:
sāṅkṛtiśca tathātreyaḥ śiṣyebhyo brahma nirguṇam ।
upadiśya mahātejā gato lokānanuttamān ॥22॥
slp1: sANkftiSca taTAtreyaH SizyeByo brahma nirguRam । upadiSya mahAtejA gato lokAnanuttamAn ॥22॥

text: ambarīṣo gavāṃ dattvā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pratāpavān । arbudāni daśaikaṃ ca sarāṣṭro'bhyapataddivam ॥23॥
html:
ambarīṣo gavāṃ dattvā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pratāpavān ।
arbudāni daśaikaṃ ca sarāṣṭro'bhyapataddivam ॥23॥
slp1: ambarIzo gavAM dattvA brAhmaReByaH pratApavAn । arbudAni daSEkaM ca sarAzwro'Byapataddivam ॥23॥

text: sāvitrī kuṇḍale divye śarīraṃ janamejayaḥ । brāhmaṇārthe parityajya jagmaturlokamuttamam ॥24॥
html:
sāvitrī kuṇḍale divye śarīraṃ janamejayaḥ ।
brāhmaṇārthe parityajya jagmaturlokamuttamam ॥24॥
slp1: sAvitrI kuRqale divye SarIraM janamejayaH । brAhmaRArTe parityajya jagmaturlokamuttamam ॥24॥

text: sarvaratnaṃ vṛṣādarbho yuvanāśvaḥ priyāḥ striyaḥ । ramyamāvasathaṃ caiva dattvāmuṃ lokamāsthitaḥ ॥25॥
html:
sarvaratnaṃ vṛṣādarbho yuvanāśvaḥ priyāḥ striyaḥ ।
ramyamāvasathaṃ caiva dattvāmuṃ lokamāsthitaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: sarvaratnaM vfzAdarBo yuvanASvaH priyAH striyaH । ramyamAvasaTaM cEva dattvAmuM lokamAsTitaH ॥25॥

text: nimī rāṣṭraṃ ca vaideho jāmadagnyo vasundharām । brāhmaṇebhyo dadau cāpi gayaścorvīṃ sapattanām ॥26॥
html:
nimī rāṣṭraṃ ca vaideho jāmadagnyo vasundharām ।
brāhmaṇebhyo dadau cāpi gayaścorvīṃ sapattanām ॥26॥
slp1: nimI rAzwraM ca vEdeho jAmadagnyo vasunDarAm । brAhmaReByo dadO cApi gayaScorvIM sapattanAm ॥26॥

text: avarṣati ca parjanye sarvabhūtāni cāsakṛt । vasiṣṭho jīvayāmāsa prajāpatiriva prajāḥ ॥27॥
html:
avarṣati ca parjanye sarvabhūtāni cāsakṛt ।
vasiṣṭho jīvayāmāsa prajāpatiriva prajāḥ ॥27॥
slp1: avarzati ca parjanye sarvaBUtAni cAsakft । vasizWo jIvayAmAsa prajApatiriva prajAH ॥27॥

text: karandhamasya putrastu marutto nṛpatistathā । kanyāmaṅgirase dattvā divamāśu jagāma ha ॥28॥
html:
karandhamasya putrastu marutto nṛpatistathā ।
kanyāmaṅgirase dattvā divamāśu jagāma ha ॥28॥
slp1: karanDamasya putrastu marutto nfpatistaTA । kanyAmaNgirase dattvA divamASu jagAma ha ॥28॥

text: brahmadattaśca pāñcālyo rājā buddhimatāṃ varaḥ । nidhiṃ śaṅkhaṃ dvijāgryebhyo dattvā lokānavāptavān ॥29॥
html:
brahmadattaśca pāñcālyo rājā buddhimatāṃ varaḥ ।
nidhiṃ śaṅkhaṃ dvijāgryebhyo dattvā lokānavāptavān ॥29॥
slp1: brahmadattaSca pAYcAlyo rAjA budDimatAM varaH । niDiM SaNKaM dvijAgryeByo dattvA lokAnavAptavAn ॥29॥

text: rājā mitrasahaścāpi vasiṣṭhāya mahātmane । madayantīṃ priyāṃ dattvā tayā saha divaṃ gataḥ ॥30॥
html:
rājā mitrasahaścāpi vasiṣṭhāya mahātmane ।
madayantīṃ priyāṃ dattvā tayā saha divaṃ gataḥ ॥30॥
slp1: rAjA mitrasahaScApi vasizWAya mahAtmane । madayantIM priyAM dattvA tayA saha divaM gataH ॥30॥

text: sahasrajicca rājarṣiḥ prāṇāniṣṭānmahāyaśāḥ । brāhmaṇārthe parityajya gato lokānanuttamān ॥31॥
html:
sahasrajicca rājarṣiḥ prāṇāniṣṭānmahāyaśāḥ ।
brāhmaṇārthe parityajya gato lokānanuttamān ॥31॥
slp1: sahasrajicca rAjarziH prARAnizwAnmahAyaSAH । brAhmaRArTe parityajya gato lokAnanuttamAn ॥31॥

text: sarvakāmaiśca sampūrṇaṃ dattvā veśma hiraṇmayam । mudgalāya gataḥ svargaṃ śatadyumno mahīpatiḥ ॥32॥
html:
sarvakāmaiśca sampūrṇaṃ dattvā veśma hiraṇmayam ।
mudgalāya gataḥ svargaṃ śatadyumno mahīpatiḥ ॥32॥
slp1: sarvakAmESca sampUrRaM dattvA veSma hiraRmayam । mudgalAya gataH svargaM Satadyumno mahIpatiH ॥32॥

text: nāmnā ca dyutimānnāma śālvarājaḥ pratāpavān । dattvā rājyamṛcīkāya gato lokānanuttamān ॥33॥
html:
nāmnā ca dyutimānnāma śālvarājaḥ pratāpavān ।
dattvā rājyamṛcīkāya gato lokānanuttamān ॥33॥
slp1: nAmnA ca dyutimAnnAma SAlvarAjaH pratApavAn । dattvA rAjyamfcIkAya gato lokAnanuttamAn ॥33॥

text: madirāśvaśca rājarṣirdattvā kanyāṃ sumadhyamām । hiraṇyahastāya gato lokāndevairabhiṣṭutān ॥34॥
html:
madirāśvaśca rājarṣirdattvā kanyāṃ sumadhyamām ।
hiraṇyahastāya gato lokāndevairabhiṣṭutān ॥34॥
slp1: madirASvaSca rAjarzirdattvA kanyAM sumaDyamAm । hiraRyahastAya gato lokAndevEraBizwutAn ॥34॥

text: lomapādaśca rājarṣiḥ śāntāṃ dattvā sutāṃ prabhuḥ । ṛśyaśṛṅgāya vipulaiḥ sarvakāmairayujyata ॥35॥
html:
lomapādaśca rājarṣiḥ śāntāṃ dattvā sutāṃ prabhuḥ ।
ṛśyaśṛṅgāya vipulaiḥ sarvakāmairayujyata ॥35॥
slp1: lomapAdaSca rAjarziH SAntAM dattvA sutAM praBuH । fSyaSfNgAya vipulEH sarvakAmErayujyata ॥35॥

text: dattvā śatasahasraṃ tu gavāṃ rājā prasenajit । savatsānāṃ mahātejā gato lokānanuttamān ॥36॥
html:
dattvā śatasahasraṃ tu gavāṃ rājā prasenajit ।
savatsānāṃ mahātejā gato lokānanuttamān ॥36॥
slp1: dattvA SatasahasraM tu gavAM rAjA prasenajit । savatsAnAM mahAtejA gato lokAnanuttamAn ॥36॥

text: ete cānye ca bahavo dānena tapasā ca ha । mahātmāno gatāḥ svargaṃ śiṣṭātmāno jitendriyāḥ ॥37॥
html:
ete cānye ca bahavo dānena tapasā ca ha ।
mahātmāno gatāḥ svargaṃ śiṣṭātmāno jitendriyāḥ ॥37॥
slp1: ete cAnye ca bahavo dAnena tapasA ca ha । mahAtmAno gatAH svargaM SizwAtmAno jitendriyAH ॥37॥

text: teṣāṃ pratiṣṭhitā kīrtiryāvatsthāsyati medinī । dānayajñaprajāsargairete hi divamāpnuvan] ॥38॥
html:
teṣāṃ pratiṣṭhitā kīrtiryāvatsthāsyati medinī ।
dānayajñaprajāsargairete hi divamāpnuvan] ॥38॥
slp1: tezAM pratizWitA kIrtiryAvatsTAsyati medinI । dAnayajYaprajAsargErete hi divamApnuvan] ॥38॥

text: trayīvidyāmavekṣeta vedeṣūktāmathāṅgataḥ । ṛksāmavarṇākṣarato yajuṣo'tharvaṇastathā ॥1॥
html:
trayīvidyāmavekṣeta vedeṣūktāmathāṅgataḥ ।
ṛksāmavarṇākṣarato yajuṣo'tharvaṇastathā ॥1॥
slp1: trayIvidyAmavekzeta vedezUktAmaTANgataH । fksAmavarRAkzarato yajuzo'TarvaRastaTA ॥1॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: vedavādeṣu kuśalā hyadhyātmakuśalāśca ye । sattvavanto mahābhāgāḥ paśyanti prabhavāpyayau ॥2॥
html:
vedavādeṣu kuśalā hyadhyātmakuśalāśca ye ।
sattvavanto mahābhāgāḥ paśyanti prabhavāpyayau ॥2॥
slp1: vedavAdezu kuSalA hyaDyAtmakuSalASca ye । sattvavanto mahABAgAH paSyanti praBavApyayO ॥2॥

text: evaṃ dharmeṇa varteta kriyāḥ śiṣṭavadācaret । asaṃrodhena bhūtānāṃ vṛttiṃ lipseta vai dvijaḥ ॥3॥
html:
evaṃ dharmeṇa varteta kriyāḥ śiṣṭavadācaret ।
asaṃrodhena bhūtānāṃ vṛttiṃ lipseta vai dvijaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: evaM DarmeRa varteta kriyAH SizwavadAcaret । asaMroDena BUtAnAM vfttiM lipseta vE dvijaH ॥3॥

text: sadbhya āgatavijñānaḥ śiṣṭaḥ śāstravicakṣaṇaḥ । svadharmeṇa kriyā loke kurvāṇaḥ satyasaṅgaraḥ ॥4॥
html:
sadbhya āgatavijñānaḥ śiṣṭaḥ śāstravicakṣaṇaḥ ।
svadharmeṇa kriyā loke kurvāṇaḥ satyasaṅgaraḥ ॥4॥
slp1: sadBya AgatavijYAnaH SizwaH SAstravicakzaRaH । svaDarmeRa kriyA loke kurvARaH satyasaNgaraH ॥4॥

text: tiṣṭhatyeteṣu gṛhavānṣaṭsu karmasu sa dvijaḥ । pañcabhiḥ satataṃ yajñaiḥ śraddadhāno yajeta ca ॥5॥
html:
tiṣṭhatyeteṣu gṛhavānṣaṭsu karmasu sa dvijaḥ ।
pañcabhiḥ satataṃ yajñaiḥ śraddadhāno yajeta ca ॥5॥
slp1: tizWatyetezu gfhavAnzawsu karmasu sa dvijaH । paYcaBiH satataM yajYEH SraddaDAno yajeta ca ॥5॥

text: dhṛtimānapramattaśca dānto dharmavidātmavān । vītaharṣabhayakrodho brāhmaṇo nāvasīdati ॥6॥
html:
dhṛtimānapramattaśca dānto dharmavidātmavān ।
vītaharṣabhayakrodho brāhmaṇo nāvasīdati ॥6॥
slp1: DftimAnapramattaSca dAnto DarmavidAtmavAn । vItaharzaBayakroDo brAhmaRo nAvasIdati ॥6॥

text: dānamadhyayanaṃ yajñastapo hrīrārjavaṃ damaḥ । etairvardhayate tejaḥ pāpmānaṃ cāpakarṣati ॥7॥
html:
dānamadhyayanaṃ yajñastapo hrīrārjavaṃ damaḥ ।
etairvardhayate tejaḥ pāpmānaṃ cāpakarṣati ॥7॥
slp1: dAnamaDyayanaM yajYastapo hrIrArjavaM damaH । etErvarDayate tejaH pApmAnaM cApakarzati ॥7॥

text: dhūtapāpmā tu medhāvī laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ । kāmakrodhau vaśe kṛtvā ninīṣedbrahmaṇaḥ padam ॥8॥
html:
dhūtapāpmā tu medhāvī laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ ।
kāmakrodhau vaśe kṛtvā ninīṣedbrahmaṇaḥ padam ॥8॥
slp1: DUtapApmA tu meDAvI laGvAhAro jitendriyaH । kAmakroDO vaSe kftvA ninIzedbrahmaRaH padam ॥8॥

text: agnīṃśca brāhmaṇāṃścārceddevatāḥ praṇameta ca । varjayedruṣatīṃ vācaṃ hiṃsāṃ cādharmasaṃhitām ॥9॥
html:
agnīṃśca brāhmaṇāṃścārceddevatāḥ praṇameta ca ।
varjayedruṣatīṃ vācaṃ hiṃsāṃ cādharmasaṃhitām ॥9॥
slp1: agnIMSca brAhmaRAMScArceddevatAH praRameta ca । varjayedruzatIM vAcaM hiMsAM cADarmasaMhitAm ॥9॥

text: eṣā pūrvatarā vṛttirbrāhmaṇasya vidhīyate । jñānāgamena karmāṇi kurvankarmasu sidhyati ॥10॥
html:
eṣā pūrvatarā vṛttirbrāhmaṇasya vidhīyate ।
jñānāgamena karmāṇi kurvankarmasu sidhyati ॥10॥
slp1: ezA pUrvatarA vfttirbrAhmaRasya viDIyate । jYAnAgamena karmARi kurvankarmasu siDyati ॥10॥

text: pañcendriyajalāṃ ghorāṃ lobhakūlāṃ sudustarām । manyupaṅkāmanādhṛṣyāṃ nadīṃ tarati buddhimān ॥11॥
html:
pañcendriyajalāṃ ghorāṃ lobhakūlāṃ sudustarām ।
manyupaṅkāmanādhṛṣyāṃ nadīṃ tarati buddhimān ॥11॥
slp1: paYcendriyajalAM GorAM loBakUlAM sudustarAm । manyupaNkAmanADfzyAM nadIM tarati budDimAn ॥11॥

text: kāmamanyūddhataṃ yatsyānnityamatyantamohitam । mahatā vidhidṛṣṭena balenāpratighātinā । svabhāvasrotasā vṛttamuhyate satataṃ jagat ॥12॥
html:
kāmamanyūddhataṃ yatsyānnityamatyantamohitam ।
mahatā vidhidṛṣṭena balenāpratighātinā ।
svabhāvasrotasā vṛttamuhyate satataṃ jagat ॥12॥
slp1: kAmamanyUdDataM yatsyAnnityamatyantamohitam । mahatA viDidfzwena balenApratiGAtinA । svaBAvasrotasA vfttamuhyate satataM jagat ॥12॥

text: kālodakena mahatā varṣāvartena santatam । māsormiṇartuvegena pakṣolapatṛṇena ca ॥13॥
html:
kālodakena mahatā varṣāvartena santatam ।
māsormiṇartuvegena pakṣolapatṛṇena ca ॥13॥
slp1: kAlodakena mahatA varzAvartena santatam । mAsormiRartuvegena pakzolapatfRena ca ॥13॥

text: nimeṣonmeṣaphenena ahorātrajavena ca । kāmagrāheṇa ghoreṇa vedayajñaplavena ca ॥14॥
html:
nimeṣonmeṣaphenena ahorātrajavena ca ।
kāmagrāheṇa ghoreṇa vedayajñaplavena ca ॥14॥
slp1: nimezonmezaPenena ahorAtrajavena ca । kAmagrAheRa GoreRa vedayajYaplavena ca ॥14॥

text: dharmadvīpena bhūtānāṃ cārthakāmaraveṇa ca । ṛtasopānatīreṇa vihiṃsātaruvāhinā ॥15॥
html:
dharmadvīpena bhūtānāṃ cārthakāmaraveṇa ca ।
ṛtasopānatīreṇa vihiṃsātaruvāhinā ॥15॥
slp1: DarmadvIpena BUtAnAM cArTakAmaraveRa ca । ftasopAnatIreRa vihiMsAtaruvAhinA ॥15॥

text: yugahradaughamadhyena brahmaprāyabhavena ca । dhātrā sṛṣṭāni bhūtāni kṛṣyante yamasādanam ॥16॥
html:
yugahradaughamadhyena brahmaprāyabhavena ca ।
dhātrā sṛṣṭāni bhūtāni kṛṣyante yamasādanam ॥16॥
slp1: yugahradOGamaDyena brahmaprAyaBavena ca । DAtrA sfzwAni BUtAni kfzyante yamasAdanam ॥16॥

text: etatprajñāmayairdhīrā nistaranti manīṣiṇaḥ । plavairaplavavanto hi kiṃ kariṣyantyacetasaḥ ॥17॥
html:
etatprajñāmayairdhīrā nistaranti manīṣiṇaḥ ।
plavairaplavavanto hi kiṃ kariṣyantyacetasaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: etatprajYAmayErDIrA nistaranti manIziRaH । plavEraplavavanto hi kiM karizyantyacetasaH ॥17॥

text: upapannaṃ hi yatprājño nistarennetaro janaḥ । dūrato guṇadoṣau hi prājñaḥ sarvatra paśyati ॥18॥
html:
upapannaṃ hi yatprājño nistarennetaro janaḥ ।
dūrato guṇadoṣau hi prājñaḥ sarvatra paśyati ॥18॥
slp1: upapannaM hi yatprAjYo nistarennetaro janaH । dUrato guRadozO hi prAjYaH sarvatra paSyati ॥18॥

text: saṃśayātmā sa kāmātmā calacitto'lpacetanaḥ । aprājño na taratyeva yo hyāste na sa gacchati ॥19॥
html:
saṃśayātmā sa kāmātmā calacitto'lpacetanaḥ ।
aprājño na taratyeva yo hyāste na sa gacchati ॥19॥
slp1: saMSayAtmA sa kAmAtmA calacitto'lpacetanaH । aprAjYo na taratyeva yo hyAste na sa gacCati ॥19॥

text: aplavo hi mahādoṣamuhyamāno'dhigacchati । kāmagrāhagṛhītasya jñānamapyasya na plavaḥ ॥20॥
html:
aplavo hi mahādoṣamuhyamāno'dhigacchati ।
kāmagrāhagṛhītasya jñānamapyasya na plavaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: aplavo hi mahAdozamuhyamAno'DigacCati । kAmagrAhagfhItasya jYAnamapyasya na plavaH ॥20॥

text: tasmādunmajjanasyārthe prayateta vicakṣaṇaḥ । etadunmajjanaṃ tasya yadayaṃ brāhmaṇo bhavet ॥21॥
html:
tasmādunmajjanasyārthe prayateta vicakṣaṇaḥ ।
etadunmajjanaṃ tasya yadayaṃ brāhmaṇo bhavet ॥21॥
slp1: tasmAdunmajjanasyArTe prayateta vicakzaRaH । etadunmajjanaM tasya yadayaM brAhmaRo Bavet ॥21॥

text: tryavadāte kule jātastrisandehastrikarmakṛt । tasmādunmajjanastiṣṭhennistaretprajñayā yathā ॥22॥
html:
tryavadāte kule jātastrisandehastrikarmakṛt ।
tasmādunmajjanastiṣṭhennistaretprajñayā yathā ॥22॥
slp1: tryavadAte kule jAtastrisandehastrikarmakft । tasmAdunmajjanastizWennistaretprajYayA yaTA ॥22॥

text: saṃskṛtasya hi dāntasya niyatasya kṛtātmanaḥ । prājñasyānantarā siddhiriha loke paratra ca ॥23॥
html:
saṃskṛtasya hi dāntasya niyatasya kṛtātmanaḥ ।
prājñasyānantarā siddhiriha loke paratra ca ॥23॥
slp1: saMskftasya hi dAntasya niyatasya kftAtmanaH । prAjYasyAnantarA sidDiriha loke paratra ca ॥23॥

text: vartate teṣu gṛhavānakrudhyannanasūyakaḥ । pañcabhiḥ satataṃ yajñairvighasāśī yajeta ca ॥24॥
html:
vartate teṣu gṛhavānakrudhyannanasūyakaḥ ।
pañcabhiḥ satataṃ yajñairvighasāśī yajeta ca ॥24॥
slp1: vartate tezu gfhavAnakruDyannanasUyakaH । paYcaBiH satataM yajYErviGasASI yajeta ca ॥24॥

text: satāṃ vṛttena varteta kriyāḥ śiṣṭavadācaret । asaṃrodhena dharmasya vṛttiṃ lipsedagarhitām ॥25॥
html:
satāṃ vṛttena varteta kriyāḥ śiṣṭavadācaret ।
asaṃrodhena dharmasya vṛttiṃ lipsedagarhitām ॥25॥
slp1: satAM vfttena varteta kriyAH SizwavadAcaret । asaMroDena Darmasya vfttiM lipsedagarhitAm ॥25॥

text: śrutivijñānatattvajñaḥ śiṣṭācāro vicakṣaṇaḥ । svadharmeṇa kriyāvāṃśca karmaṇā so'pyasaṅkaraḥ ॥26॥
html:
śrutivijñānatattvajñaḥ śiṣṭācāro vicakṣaṇaḥ ।
svadharmeṇa kriyāvāṃśca karmaṇā so'pyasaṅkaraḥ ॥26॥
slp1: SrutivijYAnatattvajYaH SizwAcAro vicakzaRaH । svaDarmeRa kriyAvAMSca karmaRA so'pyasaNkaraH ॥26॥

text: kriyāvāñśraddadhānaśca dātā prājño'nasūyakaḥ । dharmādharmaviśeṣajñaḥ sarvaṃ tarati dustaram ॥27॥
html:
kriyāvāñśraddadhānaśca dātā prājño'nasūyakaḥ ।
dharmādharmaviśeṣajñaḥ sarvaṃ tarati dustaram ॥27॥
slp1: kriyAvAYSraddaDAnaSca dAtA prAjYo'nasUyakaH । DarmADarmaviSezajYaH sarvaM tarati dustaram ॥27॥

text: dhṛtimānapramattaśca dānto dharmavidātmavān । vītaharṣabhayakrodho brāhmaṇo nāvasīdati ॥28॥
html:
dhṛtimānapramattaśca dānto dharmavidātmavān ।
vītaharṣabhayakrodho brāhmaṇo nāvasīdati ॥28॥
slp1: DftimAnapramattaSca dAnto DarmavidAtmavAn । vItaharzaBayakroDo brAhmaRo nAvasIdati ॥28॥

text: eṣā pūrvatarā vṛttirbrāhmaṇasya vidhīyate । jñānavittvena karmāṇi kurvansarvatra sidhyati ॥29॥
html:
eṣā pūrvatarā vṛttirbrāhmaṇasya vidhīyate ।
jñānavittvena karmāṇi kurvansarvatra sidhyati ॥29॥
slp1: ezA pUrvatarA vfttirbrAhmaRasya viDIyate । jYAnavittvena karmARi kurvansarvatra siDyati ॥29॥

text: adharmaṃ dharmakāmo hi karotīhāvicakṣaṇaḥ । dharmaṃ cādharmasaṅkāśaṃ śocanniva karoti saḥ ॥30॥
html:
adharmaṃ dharmakāmo hi karotīhāvicakṣaṇaḥ ।
dharmaṃ cādharmasaṅkāśaṃ śocanniva karoti saḥ ॥30॥
slp1: aDarmaM DarmakAmo hi karotIhAvicakzaRaH । DarmaM cADarmasaNkASaM Socanniva karoti saH ॥30॥

text: dharmaṃ karomīti karotyadharmamadharmakāmaśca karoti dharmam । ubhe bālaḥ karmaṇī na prajānansa jāyate mriyate cāpi dehī] ॥31॥
html:
dharmaṃ karomīti karotyadharmamadharmakāmaśca karoti dharmam ।
ubhe bālaḥ karmaṇī na prajānansa jāyate mriyate cāpi dehī] ॥31॥
slp1: DarmaM karomIti karotyaDarmamaDarmakAmaSca karoti Darmam । uBe bAlaH karmaRI na prajAnansa jAyate mriyate cApi dehI] ॥31॥

text: atha cedrocayedetaddruhyeta manasā tathā । unmajjaṃśca nimajjaṃśca jñānavānplavavānbhavet ॥1॥
html:
atha cedrocayedetaddruhyeta manasā tathā ।
unmajjaṃśca nimajjaṃśca jñānavānplavavānbhavet ॥1॥
slp1: aTa cedrocayedetaddruhyeta manasA taTA । unmajjaMSca nimajjaMSca jYAnavAnplavavAnBavet ॥1॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: prajñayā nirmitairdhīrāstārayantyabudhānplavaiḥ । nābudhāstārayantyanyānātmānaṃ vā kathañcana ॥2॥
html:
prajñayā nirmitairdhīrāstārayantyabudhānplavaiḥ ।
nābudhāstārayantyanyānātmānaṃ vā kathañcana ॥2॥
slp1: prajYayA nirmitErDIrAstArayantyabuDAnplavEH । nAbuDAstArayantyanyAnAtmAnaM vA kaTaYcana ॥2॥

text: chinnadoṣo muniryogānyukto yuñjīta dvādaśa । daśakarmasukhānarthānupāyāpāyanirbhayaḥ ॥3॥
html:
chinnadoṣo muniryogānyukto yuñjīta dvādaśa ।
daśakarmasukhānarthānupāyāpāyanirbhayaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: Cinnadozo muniryogAnyukto yuYjIta dvAdaSa । daSakarmasuKAnarTAnupAyApAyanirBayaH ॥3॥

text: cakṣurācāravitprājño manasā darśanena ca । yacchedvāṅmanasī buddhyā ya icchejjñānamuttamam । jñānena yacchedātmānaṃ ya icchecchāntimātmanaḥ ॥4॥
html:
cakṣurācāravitprājño manasā darśanena ca ।
yacchedvāṅmanasī buddhyā ya icchejjñānamuttamam ।
jñānena yacchedātmānaṃ ya icchecchāntimātmanaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: cakzurAcAravitprAjYo manasA darSanena ca । yacCedvANmanasI budDyA ya icCejjYAnamuttamam । jYAnena yacCedAtmAnaM ya icCecCAntimAtmanaH ॥4॥

text: eteṣāṃ cedanudraṣṭā puruṣo'pi sudāruṇaḥ । yadi vā sarvavedajño yadi vāpyanṛco'japaḥ ॥5॥
html:
eteṣāṃ cedanudraṣṭā puruṣo'pi sudāruṇaḥ ।
yadi vā sarvavedajño yadi vāpyanṛco'japaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: etezAM cedanudrazwA puruzo'pi sudAruRaH । yadi vA sarvavedajYo yadi vApyanfco'japaH ॥5॥

text: yadi vā dhārmiko yajvā yadi vā pāpakṛttamaḥ । yadi vā puruṣavyāghro yadi vā klaibyadhāritā ॥6॥
html:
yadi vā dhārmiko yajvā yadi vā pāpakṛttamaḥ ।
yadi vā puruṣavyāghro yadi vā klaibyadhāritā ॥6॥
slp1: yadi vA DArmiko yajvA yadi vA pApakfttamaH । yadi vA puruzavyAGro yadi vA klEbyaDAritA ॥6॥

text: taratyeva mahādurgaṃ jarāmaraṇasāgaram । evaṃ hyetena yogena yuñjāno'pyekamantataḥ । api jijñāsamāno hi śabdabrahmātivartate ॥7॥
html:
taratyeva mahādurgaṃ jarāmaraṇasāgaram ।
evaṃ hyetena yogena yuñjāno'pyekamantataḥ ।
api jijñāsamāno hi śabdabrahmātivartate ॥7॥
slp1: taratyeva mahAdurgaM jarAmaraRasAgaram । evaM hyetena yogena yuYjAno'pyekamantataH । api jijYAsamAno hi SabdabrahmAtivartate ॥7॥

text: dharmopastho hrīvarūtha upāyāpāyakūbaraḥ । apānākṣaḥ prāṇayugaḥ prajñāyurjīvabandhanaḥ ॥8॥
html:
dharmopastho hrīvarūtha upāyāpāyakūbaraḥ ।
apānākṣaḥ prāṇayugaḥ prajñāyurjīvabandhanaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: DarmopasTo hrIvarUTa upAyApAyakUbaraH । apAnAkzaH prARayugaH prajYAyurjIvabanDanaH ॥8॥

text: cetanābandhuraścārurācāragrahanemivān । darśanasparśanavaho ghrāṇaśravaṇavāhanaḥ ॥9॥
html:
cetanābandhuraścārurācāragrahanemivān ।
darśanasparśanavaho ghrāṇaśravaṇavāhanaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: cetanAbanDuraScArurAcAragrahanemivAn । darSanasparSanavaho GrARaSravaRavAhanaH ॥9॥

text: prajñānābhiḥ sarvatantrapratodo jñānasārathiḥ । kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhito dhīraḥ śraddhādamapuraḥsaraḥ ॥10॥
html:
prajñānābhiḥ sarvatantrapratodo jñānasārathiḥ ।
kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhito dhīraḥ śraddhādamapuraḥsaraḥ ॥10॥
slp1: prajYAnABiH sarvatantrapratodo jYAnasAraTiH । kzetrajYADizWito DIraH SradDAdamapuraHsaraH ॥10॥

text: tyāgavartmānugaḥ kṣemyaḥ śaucago dhyānagocaraḥ । jīvayukto ratho divyo brahmaloke virājate ॥11॥
html:
tyāgavartmānugaḥ kṣemyaḥ śaucago dhyānagocaraḥ ।
jīvayukto ratho divyo brahmaloke virājate ॥11॥
slp1: tyAgavartmAnugaH kzemyaH SOcago DyAnagocaraH । jIvayukto raTo divyo brahmaloke virAjate ॥11॥

text: atha santvaramāṇasya rathametaṃ yuyukṣataḥ । akṣaraṃ gantumanaso vidhiṃ vakṣyāmi śīghragam ॥12॥
html:
atha santvaramāṇasya rathametaṃ yuyukṣataḥ ।
akṣaraṃ gantumanaso vidhiṃ vakṣyāmi śīghragam ॥12॥
slp1: aTa santvaramARasya raTametaM yuyukzataH । akzaraM gantumanaso viDiM vakzyAmi SIGragam ॥12॥

text: sapta yo dhāraṇāḥ kṛtsnā vāgyataḥ pratipadyate । pṛṣṭhataḥ pārśvataścānyā yāvatyastāḥ pradhāraṇāḥ ॥13॥
html:
sapta yo dhāraṇāḥ kṛtsnā vāgyataḥ pratipadyate ।
pṛṣṭhataḥ pārśvataścānyā yāvatyastāḥ pradhāraṇāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: sapta yo DAraRAH kftsnA vAgyataH pratipadyate । pfzWataH pArSvataScAnyA yAvatyastAH praDAraRAH ॥13॥

text: kramaśaḥ pārthivaṃ yacca vāyavyaṃ khaṃ tathā payaḥ । jyotiṣo yattadaiśvaryamahaṅkārasya buddhitaḥ ॥14॥
html:
kramaśaḥ pārthivaṃ yacca vāyavyaṃ khaṃ tathā payaḥ ।
jyotiṣo yattadaiśvaryamahaṅkārasya buddhitaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: kramaSaH pArTivaM yacca vAyavyaM KaM taTA payaH । jyotizo yattadESvaryamahaNkArasya budDitaH ॥14॥

text: avyaktasya tathaiśvaryaṃ kramaśaḥ pratipadyate । vikramāścāpi yasyaite tathā yuṅkte sa yogataḥ ॥15॥
html:
avyaktasya tathaiśvaryaṃ kramaśaḥ pratipadyate ।
vikramāścāpi yasyaite tathā yuṅkte sa yogataḥ ॥15॥
slp1: avyaktasya taTESvaryaM kramaSaH pratipadyate । vikramAScApi yasyEte taTA yuNkte sa yogataH ॥15॥

text: athāsya yogayuktasya siddhimātmani paśyataḥ । nirmathyamānaḥ sūkṣmatvādrūpāṇīmāni darśayet ॥16॥
html:
athāsya yogayuktasya siddhimātmani paśyataḥ ।
nirmathyamānaḥ sūkṣmatvādrūpāṇīmāni darśayet ॥16॥
slp1: aTAsya yogayuktasya sidDimAtmani paSyataH । nirmaTyamAnaH sUkzmatvAdrUpARImAni darSayet ॥16॥

text: śaiśirastu yathā dhūmaḥ sūkṣmaḥ saṃśrayate nabhaḥ । tathā dehādvimuktasya pūrvarūpaṃ bhavatyuta ॥17॥
html:
śaiśirastu yathā dhūmaḥ sūkṣmaḥ saṃśrayate nabhaḥ ।
tathā dehādvimuktasya pūrvarūpaṃ bhavatyuta ॥17॥
slp1: SESirastu yaTA DUmaH sUkzmaH saMSrayate naBaH । taTA dehAdvimuktasya pUrvarUpaM Bavatyuta ॥17॥

text: atha dhūmasya virame dvitīyaṃ rūpadarśanam । jalarūpamivākāśe tatraivātmani paśyati ॥18॥
html:
atha dhūmasya virame dvitīyaṃ rūpadarśanam ।
jalarūpamivākāśe tatraivātmani paśyati ॥18॥
slp1: aTa DUmasya virame dvitIyaM rUpadarSanam । jalarUpamivAkASe tatrEvAtmani paSyati ॥18॥

text: apāṃ vyatikrame cāpi vahnirūpaṃ prakāśate । tasminnuparate cāsya pītavastravadiṣyate । ūrṇārūpasavarṇaṃ ca tasya rūpaṃ prakāśate ॥19॥
html:
apāṃ vyatikrame cāpi vahnirūpaṃ prakāśate ।
tasminnuparate cāsya pītavastravadiṣyate ।
ūrṇārūpasavarṇaṃ ca tasya rūpaṃ prakāśate ॥19॥
slp1: apAM vyatikrame cApi vahnirUpaM prakASate । tasminnuparate cAsya pItavastravadizyate । UrRArUpasavarRaM ca tasya rUpaM prakASate ॥19॥

text: atha śvetāṃ gatiṃ gatvā vāyavyaṃ sūkṣmamapyajaḥ । aśuklaṃ cetasaḥ saukṣmyamavyaktaṃ brahmaṇo'sya vai ॥20॥
html:
atha śvetāṃ gatiṃ gatvā vāyavyaṃ sūkṣmamapyajaḥ ।
aśuklaṃ cetasaḥ saukṣmyamavyaktaṃ brahmaṇo'sya vai ॥20॥
slp1: aTa SvetAM gatiM gatvA vAyavyaM sUkzmamapyajaH । aSuklaM cetasaH sOkzmyamavyaktaM brahmaRo'sya vE ॥20॥

text: eteṣvapi hi jāteṣu phalajātāni me śṛṇu । jātasya pārthivaiśvarye sṛṣṭiriṣṭā vidhīyate ॥21॥
html:
eteṣvapi hi jāteṣu phalajātāni me śṛṇu ।
jātasya pārthivaiśvarye sṛṣṭiriṣṭā vidhīyate ॥21॥
slp1: etezvapi hi jAtezu PalajAtAni me SfRu । jAtasya pArTivESvarye sfzwirizwA viDIyate ॥21॥

text: prajāpatirivākṣobhyaḥ śarīrātsṛjati prajāḥ । aṅgulyaṅguṣṭhamātreṇa hastapādena vā tathā ॥22॥
html:
prajāpatirivākṣobhyaḥ śarīrātsṛjati prajāḥ ।
aṅgulyaṅguṣṭhamātreṇa hastapādena vā tathā ॥22॥
slp1: prajApatirivAkzoByaH SarIrAtsfjati prajAH । aNgulyaNguzWamAtreRa hastapAdena vA taTA ॥22॥

text: pṛthivīṃ kampayatyeko guṇo vāyoriti smṛtaḥ । ākāśabhūtaścākāśe savarṇatvātpraṇaśyati ॥23॥
html:
pṛthivīṃ kampayatyeko guṇo vāyoriti smṛtaḥ ।
ākāśabhūtaścākāśe savarṇatvātpraṇaśyati ॥23॥
slp1: pfTivIM kampayatyeko guRo vAyoriti smftaH । AkASaBUtaScAkASe savarRatvAtpraRaSyati ॥23॥

text: varṇato gṛhyate cāpi kāmātpibati cāśayān । na cāsya tejasā rūpaṃ dṛśyate śāmyate tathā ॥24॥
html:
varṇato gṛhyate cāpi kāmātpibati cāśayān ।
na cāsya tejasā rūpaṃ dṛśyate śāmyate tathā ॥24॥
slp1: varRato gfhyate cApi kAmAtpibati cASayAn । na cAsya tejasA rUpaM dfSyate SAmyate taTA ॥24॥

text: ahaṅkārasya vijiteḥ pañcaite syurvaśānugāḥ । ṣaṇṇāmātmani buddhau ca jitāyāṃ prabhavatyatha ॥25॥
html:
ahaṅkārasya vijiteḥ pañcaite syurvaśānugāḥ ।
ṣaṇṇāmātmani buddhau ca jitāyāṃ prabhavatyatha ॥25॥
slp1: ahaNkArasya vijiteH paYcEte syurvaSAnugAH । zaRRAmAtmani budDO ca jitAyAM praBavatyaTa ॥25॥

text: nirdoṣā pratibhā hyenaṃ kṛtsnā samabhivartate । tathaiva vyaktamātmānamavyaktaṃ pratipadyate ॥26॥
html:
nirdoṣā pratibhā hyenaṃ kṛtsnā samabhivartate ।
tathaiva vyaktamātmānamavyaktaṃ pratipadyate ॥26॥
slp1: nirdozA pratiBA hyenaM kftsnA samaBivartate । taTEva vyaktamAtmAnamavyaktaM pratipadyate ॥26॥

text: yato niḥsarate loko bhavati vyaktasañjñakaḥ । tatrāvyaktamayīṃ vyākhyāṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ vistareṇa me । tathā vyaktamayīṃ caiva saṅkhyāṃ pūrvaṃ nibodha me ॥27॥
html:
yato niḥsarate loko bhavati vyaktasañjñakaḥ ।
tatrāvyaktamayīṃ vyākhyāṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ vistareṇa me ।
tathā vyaktamayīṃ caiva saṅkhyāṃ pūrvaṃ nibodha me ॥27॥
slp1: yato niHsarate loko Bavati vyaktasaYjYakaH । tatrAvyaktamayIM vyAKyAM SfRu tvaM vistareRa me । taTA vyaktamayIM cEva saNKyAM pUrvaM niboDa me ॥27॥

text: pañcaviṃśatitattvāni tulyānyubhayataḥ samam । yoge sāṅkhye'pi ca tathā viśeṣāṃstatra me śṛṇu ॥28॥
html:
pañcaviṃśatitattvāni tulyānyubhayataḥ samam ।
yoge sāṅkhye'pi ca tathā viśeṣāṃstatra me śṛṇu ॥28॥
slp1: paYcaviMSatitattvAni tulyAnyuBayataH samam । yoge sANKye'pi ca taTA viSezAMstatra me SfRu ॥28॥

text: proktaṃ tadvyaktamityeva jāyate vardhate ca yat । jīryate mriyate caiva caturbhirlakṣaṇairyutam ॥29॥
html:
proktaṃ tadvyaktamityeva jāyate vardhate ca yat ।
jīryate mriyate caiva caturbhirlakṣaṇairyutam ॥29॥
slp1: proktaM tadvyaktamityeva jAyate varDate ca yat । jIryate mriyate cEva caturBirlakzaREryutam ॥29॥

text: viparītamato yattu tadavyaktamudāhṛtam । dvāvātmānau ca vedeṣu siddhānteṣvapyudāhṛtau ॥30॥
html:
viparītamato yattu tadavyaktamudāhṛtam ।
dvāvātmānau ca vedeṣu siddhānteṣvapyudāhṛtau ॥30॥
slp1: viparItamato yattu tadavyaktamudAhftam । dvAvAtmAnO ca vedezu sidDAntezvapyudAhftO ॥30॥

text: caturlakṣaṇajaṃ tvanyaṃ caturvargaṃ pracakṣate । vyaktamavyaktajaṃ caiva tathā buddhamathetarat । sattvaṃ kṣetrajña ityetaddvayamapyanudarśitam ॥31॥
html:
caturlakṣaṇajaṃ tvanyaṃ caturvargaṃ pracakṣate ।
vyaktamavyaktajaṃ caiva tathā buddhamathetarat ।
sattvaṃ kṣetrajña ityetaddvayamapyanudarśitam ॥31॥
slp1: caturlakzaRajaM tvanyaM caturvargaM pracakzate । vyaktamavyaktajaM cEva taTA budDamaTetarat । sattvaM kzetrajYa ityetaddvayamapyanudarSitam ॥31॥

text: dvāvātmānau ca vedeṣu viṣayeṣu ca rajyataḥ । viṣayātpratisaṃhāraḥ sāṅkhyānāṃ siddhilakṣaṇam ॥32॥
html:
dvāvātmānau ca vedeṣu viṣayeṣu ca rajyataḥ ।
viṣayātpratisaṃhāraḥ sāṅkhyānāṃ siddhilakṣaṇam ॥32॥
slp1: dvAvAtmAnO ca vedezu vizayezu ca rajyataH । vizayAtpratisaMhAraH sANKyAnAM sidDilakzaRam ॥32॥

text: nirmamaścānahaṅkāro nirdvandvaśchinnasaṃśayaḥ । naiva krudhyati na dveṣṭi nānṛtā bhāṣate giraḥ ॥33॥
html:
nirmamaścānahaṅkāro nirdvandvaśchinnasaṃśayaḥ ।
naiva krudhyati na dveṣṭi nānṛtā bhāṣate giraḥ ॥33॥
slp1: nirmamaScAnahaNkAro nirdvandvaSCinnasaMSayaH । nEva kruDyati na dvezwi nAnftA BAzate giraH ॥33॥

text: ākruṣṭastāḍitaścaiva maitreṇa dhyāti nāśubham । vāgdaṇḍakarmamanasāṃ trayāṇāṃ ca nivartakaḥ ॥34॥
html:
ākruṣṭastāḍitaścaiva maitreṇa dhyāti nāśubham ।
vāgdaṇḍakarmamanasāṃ trayāṇāṃ ca nivartakaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: AkruzwastAqitaScEva mEtreRa DyAti nASuBam । vAgdaRqakarmamanasAM trayARAM ca nivartakaH ॥34॥

text: samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu brahmāṇamabhivartate । naivecchati na cāniccho yātrāmātravyavasthitaḥ ॥35॥
html:
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu brahmāṇamabhivartate ।
naivecchati na cāniccho yātrāmātravyavasthitaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: samaH sarvezu BUtezu brahmARamaBivartate । nEvecCati na cAnicCo yAtrAmAtravyavasTitaH ॥35॥

text: alolupo'vyatho dānto na kṛtī na nirākṛtiḥ । nāsyendriyamanekāgraṃ nātikṣiptamanorathaḥ । ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūtānāmīdṛksāṅkhyo vimucyate ॥36॥
html:
alolupo'vyatho dānto na kṛtī na nirākṛtiḥ ।
nāsyendriyamanekāgraṃ nātikṣiptamanorathaḥ ।
ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūtānāmīdṛksāṅkhyo vimucyate ॥36॥
slp1: alolupo'vyaTo dAnto na kftI na nirAkftiH । nAsyendriyamanekAgraM nAtikziptamanoraTaH । ahiMsraH sarvaBUtAnAmIdfksANKyo vimucyate ॥36॥

text: atha yogādvimucyante kāraṇairyairnibodha me । yogaiśvaryamatikrānto yo'tikrāmati mucyate ॥37॥
html:
atha yogādvimucyante kāraṇairyairnibodha me ।
yogaiśvaryamatikrānto yo'tikrāmati mucyate ॥37॥
slp1: aTa yogAdvimucyante kAraREryErniboDa me । yogESvaryamatikrAnto yo'tikrAmati mucyate ॥37॥

text: ityeṣā bhāvajā buddhiḥ kathitā te na saṃśayaḥ । evaṃ bhavati nirdvandvo brahmāṇaṃ cādhigacchati] ॥38॥
html:
ityeṣā bhāvajā buddhiḥ kathitā te na saṃśayaḥ ।
evaṃ bhavati nirdvandvo brahmāṇaṃ cādhigacchati] ॥38॥
slp1: ityezA BAvajA budDiH kaTitA te na saMSayaH । evaM Bavati nirdvandvo brahmARaM cADigacCati] ॥38॥

text: atha jñānaplavaṃ dhīro gṛhītvā śāntimāsthitaḥ । unmajjaṃśca nimajjaṃśca jñānamevābhisaṃśrayet ॥1॥
html:
atha jñānaplavaṃ dhīro gṛhītvā śāntimāsthitaḥ ।
unmajjaṃśca nimajjaṃśca jñānamevābhisaṃśrayet ॥1॥
slp1: aTa jYAnaplavaM DIro gfhItvA SAntimAsTitaH । unmajjaMSca nimajjaMSca jYAnamevABisaMSrayet ॥1॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: kiṃ tajjñānamatho vidyā yayā nistarati dvayam । pravṛttilakṣaṇo dharmo nivṛttiriti caiva hi ॥2॥
html:
kiṃ tajjñānamatho vidyā yayā nistarati dvayam ।
pravṛttilakṣaṇo dharmo nivṛttiriti caiva hi ॥2॥
slp1: kiM tajjYAnamaTo vidyA yayA nistarati dvayam । pravfttilakzaRo Darmo nivfttiriti cEva hi ॥2॥
author: śuka uvāca ।

text: yastu paśyetsvabhāvena vinā bhāvamacetanaḥ । puṣyate ca punaḥ sarvānprajñayā muktahetukaḥ ॥3॥
html:
yastu paśyetsvabhāvena vinā bhāvamacetanaḥ ।
puṣyate ca punaḥ sarvānprajñayā muktahetukaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: yastu paSyetsvaBAvena vinA BAvamacetanaH । puzyate ca punaH sarvAnprajYayA muktahetukaH ॥3॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: yeṣāṃ caikāntabhāvena svabhāvaḥ kāraṇaṃ matam । pūtvā tṛṇabusīkāṃ vai te labhante na kiñcana ॥4॥
html:
yeṣāṃ caikāntabhāvena svabhāvaḥ kāraṇaṃ matam ।
pūtvā tṛṇabusīkāṃ vai te labhante na kiñcana ॥4॥
slp1: yezAM cEkAntaBAvena svaBAvaH kAraRaM matam । pUtvA tfRabusIkAM vE te laBante na kiYcana ॥4॥

text: ye cainaṃ pakṣamāśritya vartayantyalpacetasaḥ । svabhāvaṃ kāraṇaṃ jñātvā na śreyaḥ prāpnuvanti te ॥5॥
html:
ye cainaṃ pakṣamāśritya vartayantyalpacetasaḥ ।
svabhāvaṃ kāraṇaṃ jñātvā na śreyaḥ prāpnuvanti te ॥5॥
slp1: ye cEnaM pakzamASritya vartayantyalpacetasaH । svaBAvaM kAraRaM jYAtvA na SreyaH prApnuvanti te ॥5॥

text: svabhāvo hi vināśāya mohakarmamanobhavaḥ । niruktametayoretatsvabhāvaparabhāvayoḥ ॥6॥
html:
svabhāvo hi vināśāya mohakarmamanobhavaḥ ।
niruktametayoretatsvabhāvaparabhāvayoḥ ॥6॥
slp1: svaBAvo hi vinASAya mohakarmamanoBavaH । niruktametayoretatsvaBAvaparaBAvayoH ॥6॥

text: kṛṣyādīni hi karmāṇi sasyasaṃharaṇāni ca । prajñāvadbhiḥ prakḷptāni yānāsanagṛhāṇi ca ॥7॥
html:
kṛṣyādīni hi karmāṇi sasyasaṃharaṇāni ca ।
prajñāvadbhiḥ prakḷptāni yānāsanagṛhāṇi ca ॥7॥
slp1: kfzyAdIni hi karmARi sasyasaMharaRAni ca । prajYAvadBiH prakxptAni yAnAsanagfhARi ca ॥7॥

text: ākrīḍānāṃ gṛhāṇāṃ ca gadānāmagadasya ca । prajñāvantaḥ pravaktāro jñānavadbhiranuṣṭhitāḥ ॥8॥
html:
ākrīḍānāṃ gṛhāṇāṃ ca gadānāmagadasya ca ।
prajñāvantaḥ pravaktāro jñānavadbhiranuṣṭhitāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: AkrIqAnAM gfhARAM ca gadAnAmagadasya ca । prajYAvantaH pravaktAro jYAnavadBiranuzWitAH ॥8॥

text: prajñā saṃyojayatyarthaiḥ prajñā śreyo'dhigacchati । rājāno bhuñjate rājyaṃ prajñayā tulyalakṣaṇāḥ ॥9॥
html:
prajñā saṃyojayatyarthaiḥ prajñā śreyo'dhigacchati ।
rājāno bhuñjate rājyaṃ prajñayā tulyalakṣaṇāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: prajYA saMyojayatyarTEH prajYA Sreyo'DigacCati । rAjAno BuYjate rAjyaM prajYayA tulyalakzaRAH ॥9॥

text: pārāvaryaṃ tu bhūtānāṃ jñānenaivopalabhyate । vidyayā tāta sṛṣṭānāṃ vidyaiva paramā gatiḥ ॥10॥
html:
pārāvaryaṃ tu bhūtānāṃ jñānenaivopalabhyate ।
vidyayā tāta sṛṣṭānāṃ vidyaiva paramā gatiḥ ॥10॥
slp1: pArAvaryaM tu BUtAnAM jYAnenEvopalaByate । vidyayA tAta sfzwAnAM vidyEva paramA gatiH ॥10॥

text: bhūtānāṃ janma sarveṣāṃ vividhānāṃ caturvidham । jarāyvaṇḍamathodbhedaṃ svedaṃ cāpyupalakṣayet ॥11॥
html:
bhūtānāṃ janma sarveṣāṃ vividhānāṃ caturvidham ।
jarāyvaṇḍamathodbhedaṃ svedaṃ cāpyupalakṣayet ॥11॥
slp1: BUtAnAM janma sarvezAM viviDAnAM caturviDam । jarAyvaRqamaTodBedaM svedaM cApyupalakzayet ॥11॥

text: sthāvarebhyo viśiṣṭāni jaṅgamānyupalakṣayet । upapannaṃ hi yacceṣṭā viśiṣyeta viśeṣyayoḥ ॥12॥
html:
sthāvarebhyo viśiṣṭāni jaṅgamānyupalakṣayet ।
upapannaṃ hi yacceṣṭā viśiṣyeta viśeṣyayoḥ ॥12॥
slp1: sTAvareByo viSizwAni jaNgamAnyupalakzayet । upapannaM hi yaccezwA viSizyeta viSezyayoH ॥12॥

text: āhurdvibahupādāni jaṅgamāni dvayāni ca । bahupādbhyo viśiṣṭāni dvipādāni bahūnyapi ॥13॥
html:
āhurdvibahupādāni jaṅgamāni dvayāni ca ।
bahupādbhyo viśiṣṭāni dvipādāni bahūnyapi ॥13॥
slp1: AhurdvibahupAdAni jaNgamAni dvayAni ca । bahupAdByo viSizwAni dvipAdAni bahUnyapi ॥13॥

text: dvipadāni dvayānyāhuḥ pārthivānītarāṇi ca । pārthivāni viśiṣṭāni tāni hyannāni bhuñjate ॥14॥
html:
dvipadāni dvayānyāhuḥ pārthivānītarāṇi ca ।
pārthivāni viśiṣṭāni tāni hyannāni bhuñjate ॥14॥
slp1: dvipadAni dvayAnyAhuH pArTivAnItarARi ca । pArTivAni viSizwAni tAni hyannAni BuYjate ॥14॥

text: pārthivāni dvayānyāhurmadhyamānyuttamāni ca । madhyamāni viśiṣṭāni jātidharmopadhāraṇāt ॥15॥
html:
pārthivāni dvayānyāhurmadhyamānyuttamāni ca ।
madhyamāni viśiṣṭāni jātidharmopadhāraṇāt ॥15॥
slp1: pArTivAni dvayAnyAhurmaDyamAnyuttamAni ca । maDyamAni viSizwAni jAtiDarmopaDAraRAt ॥15॥

text: madhyamāni dvayānyāhurdharmajñānītarāṇi ca । dharmajñāni viśiṣṭāni kāryākāryopadhāraṇāt ॥16॥
html:
madhyamāni dvayānyāhurdharmajñānītarāṇi ca ।
dharmajñāni viśiṣṭāni kāryākāryopadhāraṇāt ॥16॥
slp1: maDyamAni dvayAnyAhurDarmajYAnItarARi ca । DarmajYAni viSizwAni kAryAkAryopaDAraRAt ॥16॥

text: dharmajñāni dvayānyāhurvedajñānītarāṇi ca । vedajñāni viśiṣṭāni vedo hyeṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ ॥17॥
html:
dharmajñāni dvayānyāhurvedajñānītarāṇi ca ।
vedajñāni viśiṣṭāni vedo hyeṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: DarmajYAni dvayAnyAhurvedajYAnItarARi ca । vedajYAni viSizwAni vedo hyezu pratizWitaH ॥17॥

text: vedajñāni dvayānyāhuḥ pravaktṝṇītarāṇi ca । pravaktṝṇi viśiṣṭāni sarvadharmopadhāraṇāt ॥18॥
html:
vedajñāni dvayānyāhuḥ pravaktṝṇītarāṇi ca ।
pravaktṝṇi viśiṣṭāni sarvadharmopadhāraṇāt ॥18॥
slp1: vedajYAni dvayAnyAhuH pravaktFRItarARi ca । pravaktFRi viSizwAni sarvaDarmopaDAraRAt ॥18॥

text: vijñāyante hi yairvedāḥ sarvadharmakriyāphalāḥ । sayajñāḥ sakhilā vedāḥ pravaktṛbhyo viniḥsṛtāḥ ॥19॥
html:
vijñāyante hi yairvedāḥ sarvadharmakriyāphalāḥ ।
sayajñāḥ sakhilā vedāḥ pravaktṛbhyo viniḥsṛtāḥ ॥19॥
slp1: vijYAyante hi yErvedAH sarvaDarmakriyAPalAH । sayajYAH saKilA vedAH pravaktfByo viniHsftAH ॥19॥

text: pravaktṝṇi dvayānyāhurātmajñānītarāṇi ca । ātmajñāni viśiṣṭāni janmājanmopadhāraṇāt ॥20॥
html:
pravaktṝṇi dvayānyāhurātmajñānītarāṇi ca ।
ātmajñāni viśiṣṭāni janmājanmopadhāraṇāt ॥20॥
slp1: pravaktFRi dvayAnyAhurAtmajYAnItarARi ca । AtmajYAni viSizwAni janmAjanmopaDAraRAt ॥20॥

text: dharmadvayaṃ hi yo veda sa sarvaḥ sarvadharmavid । sa tyāgī satyasaṅkalpaḥ sa tu kṣāntaḥ sa īśvaraḥ ॥21॥
html:
dharmadvayaṃ hi yo veda sa sarvaḥ sarvadharmavid ।
sa tyāgī satyasaṅkalpaḥ sa tu kṣāntaḥ sa īśvaraḥ ॥21॥
slp1: DarmadvayaM hi yo veda sa sarvaH sarvaDarmavid । sa tyAgI satyasaNkalpaH sa tu kzAntaH sa ISvaraH ॥21॥

text: dharmajñānapratiṣṭhaṃ hi taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ । śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaṃ pare ca kṛtaniścayam ॥22॥
html:
dharmajñānapratiṣṭhaṃ hi taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ ।
śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaṃ pare ca kṛtaniścayam ॥22॥
slp1: DarmajYAnapratizWaM hi taM devA brAhmaRaM viduH । SabdabrahmaRi nizRAtaM pare ca kftaniScayam ॥22॥

text: antaḥsthaṃ ca bahiṣṭhaṃ ca ye''dhiyajñādhidaivatam । jānanti tānnamasyāmaste devāstāta te dvijāḥ ॥23॥
html:
antaḥsthaṃ ca bahiṣṭhaṃ ca ye''dhiyajñādhidaivatam ।
jānanti tānnamasyāmaste devāstāta te dvijāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: antaHsTaM ca bahizWaM ca ye''DiyajYADidEvatam । jAnanti tAnnamasyAmaste devAstAta te dvijAH ॥23॥

text: teṣu viśvamidaṃ bhūtaṃ sāgraṃ ca jagadāhitam । teṣāṃ māhātmyabhāvasya sadṛśaṃ nāsti kiñcana ॥24॥
html:
teṣu viśvamidaṃ bhūtaṃ sāgraṃ ca jagadāhitam ।
teṣāṃ māhātmyabhāvasya sadṛśaṃ nāsti kiñcana ॥24॥
slp1: tezu viSvamidaM BUtaM sAgraM ca jagadAhitam । tezAM mAhAtmyaBAvasya sadfSaM nAsti kiYcana ॥24॥

text: ādiṃ te nidhanaṃ caiva karma cātītya sarvaśaḥ । caturvidhasya bhūtasya sarvasyeśāḥ svayambhuvaḥ] ॥25॥
html:
ādiṃ te nidhanaṃ caiva karma cātītya sarvaśaḥ ।
caturvidhasya bhūtasya sarvasyeśāḥ svayambhuvaḥ] ॥25॥
slp1: AdiM te niDanaM cEva karma cAtItya sarvaSaH । caturviDasya BUtasya sarvasyeSAH svayamBuvaH] ॥25॥

text: eṣā pūrvatarā vṛttirbrāhmaṇasya vidhīyate । jñānavāneva karmāṇi kurvansarvatra sidhyati ॥1॥
html:
eṣā pūrvatarā vṛttirbrāhmaṇasya vidhīyate ।
jñānavāneva karmāṇi kurvansarvatra sidhyati ॥1॥
slp1: ezA pUrvatarA vfttirbrAhmaRasya viDIyate । jYAnavAneva karmARi kurvansarvatra siDyati ॥1॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: tatra cenna bhavedevaṃ saṃśayaḥ karmaniścaye । kiṃ nu karma svabhāvo'yaṃ jñānaṃ karmeti vā punaḥ ॥2॥
html:
tatra cenna bhavedevaṃ saṃśayaḥ karmaniścaye ।
kiṃ nu karma svabhāvo'yaṃ jñānaṃ karmeti vā punaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: tatra cenna BavedevaM saMSayaH karmaniScaye । kiM nu karma svaBAvo'yaM jYAnaM karmeti vA punaH ॥2॥

text: tatra ceha vivitsā syājjñānaṃ cetpuruṣaṃ prati । upapattyupalabdhibhyāṃ varṇayiṣyāmi tacchṛṇu ॥3॥
html:
tatra ceha vivitsā syājjñānaṃ cetpuruṣaṃ prati ।
upapattyupalabdhibhyāṃ varṇayiṣyāmi tacchṛṇu ॥3॥
slp1: tatra ceha vivitsA syAjjYAnaM cetpuruzaM prati । upapattyupalabDiByAM varRayizyAmi tacCfRu ॥3॥

text: pauruṣaṃ kāraṇaṃ kecidāhuḥ karmasu mānavāḥ । daivameke praśaṃsanti svabhāvaṃ cāpare janāḥ ॥4॥
html:
pauruṣaṃ kāraṇaṃ kecidāhuḥ karmasu mānavāḥ ।
daivameke praśaṃsanti svabhāvaṃ cāpare janāḥ ॥4॥
slp1: pOruzaM kAraRaM kecidAhuH karmasu mAnavAH । dEvameke praSaMsanti svaBAvaM cApare janAH ॥4॥

text: pauruṣaṃ karma daivaṃ ca phalavṛttisvabhāvataḥ । trayametatpṛthagbhūtamavivekaṃ tu kecana ॥5॥
html:
pauruṣaṃ karma daivaṃ ca phalavṛttisvabhāvataḥ ।
trayametatpṛthagbhūtamavivekaṃ tu kecana ॥5॥
slp1: pOruzaM karma dEvaM ca PalavfttisvaBAvataH । trayametatpfTagBUtamavivekaM tu kecana ॥5॥

text: evametanna cāpyevamubhe cāpi na cāpyubhe । karmasthā viṣamaṃ brūyuḥ sattvasthāḥ samadarśinaḥ ॥6॥
html:
evametanna cāpyevamubhe cāpi na cāpyubhe ।
karmasthā viṣamaṃ brūyuḥ sattvasthāḥ samadarśinaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: evametanna cApyevamuBe cApi na cApyuBe । karmasTA vizamaM brUyuH sattvasTAH samadarSinaH ॥6॥

text: tretāyāṃ dvāpare caiva kalijāśca sasaṃśayāḥ । tapasvinaḥ praśāntāśca sattvasthāśca kṛte yuge ॥7॥
html:
tretāyāṃ dvāpare caiva kalijāśca sasaṃśayāḥ ।
tapasvinaḥ praśāntāśca sattvasthāśca kṛte yuge ॥7॥
slp1: tretAyAM dvApare cEva kalijASca sasaMSayAH । tapasvinaH praSAntASca sattvasTASca kfte yuge ॥7॥

text: apṛthagdarśinaḥ sarve ṛksāmasu yajuḥṣu ca । kāmadveṣau pṛthagdṛṣṭvā tapaḥ kṛta upāsate ॥8॥
html:
apṛthagdarśinaḥ sarve ṛksāmasu yajuḥṣu ca ।
kāmadveṣau pṛthagdṛṣṭvā tapaḥ kṛta upāsate ॥8॥
slp1: apfTagdarSinaH sarve fksAmasu yajuHzu ca । kAmadvezO pfTagdfzwvA tapaH kfta upAsate ॥8॥

text: tapodharmeṇa saṃyuktastaponityaḥ susaṃśitaḥ । tena sarvānavāpnoti kāmānyānmanasecchati ॥9॥
html:
tapodharmeṇa saṃyuktastaponityaḥ susaṃśitaḥ ।
tena sarvānavāpnoti kāmānyānmanasecchati ॥9॥
slp1: tapoDarmeRa saMyuktastaponityaH susaMSitaH । tena sarvAnavApnoti kAmAnyAnmanasecCati ॥9॥

text: tapasā tadavāpnoti yadbhūtvā sṛjate jagat । tadbhūtaśca tataḥ sarvo bhūtānāṃ bhavati prabhuḥ ॥10॥
html:
tapasā tadavāpnoti yadbhūtvā sṛjate jagat ।
tadbhūtaśca tataḥ sarvo bhūtānāṃ bhavati prabhuḥ ॥10॥
slp1: tapasA tadavApnoti yadBUtvA sfjate jagat । tadBUtaSca tataH sarvo BUtAnAM Bavati praBuH ॥10॥

text: taduktaṃ vedavādeṣu gahanaṃ vedadarśibhiḥ । vedānteṣu punarvyaktaṃ kramayogena lakṣyate ॥11॥
html:
taduktaṃ vedavādeṣu gahanaṃ vedadarśibhiḥ ।
vedānteṣu punarvyaktaṃ kramayogena lakṣyate ॥11॥
slp1: taduktaM vedavAdezu gahanaM vedadarSiBiH । vedAntezu punarvyaktaM kramayogena lakzyate ॥11॥

text: ārambhayajñāḥ kṣatrasya haviryajñā viśaḥ smṛtāḥ । paricārayajñāḥ śūdrāśca japayajñā dvijātayaḥ ॥12॥
html:
ārambhayajñāḥ kṣatrasya haviryajñā viśaḥ smṛtāḥ ।
paricārayajñāḥ śūdrāśca japayajñā dvijātayaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: AramBayajYAH kzatrasya haviryajYA viSaH smftAH । paricArayajYAH SUdrASca japayajYA dvijAtayaH ॥12॥

text: pariniṣṭhitakāryo hi svādhyāyena dvijo bhavet । kuryādanyanna vā kuryānmaitro brāhmaṇa ucyate ॥13॥
html:
pariniṣṭhitakāryo hi svādhyāyena dvijo bhavet ।
kuryādanyanna vā kuryānmaitro brāhmaṇa ucyate ॥13॥
slp1: parinizWitakAryo hi svADyAyena dvijo Bavet । kuryAdanyanna vA kuryAnmEtro brAhmaRa ucyate ॥13॥

text: tretādau sakalā vedā yajñā varṇāśramāstathā । saṃrodhādāyuṣastvete vyasyante dvāpare yuge ॥14॥
html:
tretādau sakalā vedā yajñā varṇāśramāstathā ।
saṃrodhādāyuṣastvete vyasyante dvāpare yuge ॥14॥
slp1: tretAdO sakalA vedA yajYA varRASramAstaTA । saMroDAdAyuzastvete vyasyante dvApare yuge ॥14॥

text: dvāpare viplavaṃ yānti vedāḥ kaliyuge tathā । dṛśyante nāpi dṛśyante kalerante punaḥ punaḥ ॥15॥
html:
dvāpare viplavaṃ yānti vedāḥ kaliyuge tathā ।
dṛśyante nāpi dṛśyante kalerante punaḥ punaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: dvApare viplavaM yAnti vedAH kaliyuge taTA । dfSyante nApi dfSyante kalerante punaH punaH ॥15॥

text: utsīdanti svadharmāśca tatrādharmeṇa pīḍitāḥ । gavāṃ bhūmeśca ye cāpāmoṣadhīnāṃ ca ye rasāḥ ॥16॥
html:
utsīdanti svadharmāśca tatrādharmeṇa pīḍitāḥ ।
gavāṃ bhūmeśca ye cāpāmoṣadhīnāṃ ca ye rasāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: utsIdanti svaDarmASca tatrADarmeRa pIqitAH । gavAM BUmeSca ye cApAmozaDInAM ca ye rasAH ॥16॥

text: adharmāntarhitā vedā vedadharmāstathāśramāḥ । vikriyante svadharmasthāḥ sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ॥17॥
html:
adharmāntarhitā vedā vedadharmāstathāśramāḥ ।
vikriyante svadharmasthāḥ sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ॥17॥
slp1: aDarmAntarhitA vedA vedaDarmAstaTASramAH । vikriyante svaDarmasTAH sTAvarARi carARi ca ॥17॥

text: yathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni vṛṣṭirbhaumāni varṣati । sṛjate sarvato'ṅgāni tathā vedā yuge yuge ॥18॥
html:
yathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni vṛṣṭirbhaumāni varṣati ।
sṛjate sarvato'ṅgāni tathā vedā yuge yuge ॥18॥
slp1: yaTA sarvARi BUtAni vfzwirBOmAni varzati । sfjate sarvato'NgAni taTA vedA yuge yuge ॥18॥

text: visṛtaṃ kālanānātvamanādinidhanaṃ ca yat । kīrtitaṃ tatpurastānme yataḥ saṃyānti yānti ca ॥19॥
html:
visṛtaṃ kālanānātvamanādinidhanaṃ ca yat ।
kīrtitaṃ tatpurastānme yataḥ saṃyānti yānti ca ॥19॥
slp1: visftaM kAlanAnAtvamanAdiniDanaM ca yat । kIrtitaM tatpurastAnme yataH saMyAnti yAnti ca ॥19॥

text: dhātedaṃ prabhavasthānaṃ bhūtānāṃ saṃyamo yamaḥ । svabhāvena pravartante dvandvasṛṣṭāni bhūriśaḥ ॥20॥
html:
dhātedaṃ prabhavasthānaṃ bhūtānāṃ saṃyamo yamaḥ ।
svabhāvena pravartante dvandvasṛṣṭāni bhūriśaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: DAtedaM praBavasTAnaM BUtAnAM saMyamo yamaH । svaBAvena pravartante dvandvasfzwAni BUriSaH ॥20॥

text: sargaḥ kālo dhṛtirvedāḥ kartā kāryaṃ kriyā phalam । etatte kathitaṃ tāta yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi] ॥21॥
html:
sargaḥ kālo dhṛtirvedāḥ kartā kāryaṃ kriyā phalam ।
etatte kathitaṃ tāta yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi] ॥21॥
slp1: sargaH kAlo DftirvedAH kartA kAryaM kriyA Palam । etatte kaTitaM tAta yanmAM tvaM paripfcCasi] ॥21॥

text: ityukto'bhipraśasyaitatparamarṣestu śāsanam । mokṣadharmārthasaṃyuktamidaṃ praṣṭuṃ pracakrame ॥1॥
html:
ityukto'bhipraśasyaitatparamarṣestu śāsanam ।
mokṣadharmārthasaṃyuktamidaṃ praṣṭuṃ pracakrame ॥1॥
slp1: ityukto'BipraSasyEtatparamarzestu SAsanam । mokzaDarmArTasaMyuktamidaM prazwuM pracakrame ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: prajāvāñśrotriyo yajvā vṛddhaḥ prajño'nasūyakaḥ । anāgatamanaitihyaṃ kathaṃ brahmādhigacchati ॥2॥
html:
prajāvāñśrotriyo yajvā vṛddhaḥ prajño'nasūyakaḥ ।
anāgatamanaitihyaṃ kathaṃ brahmādhigacchati ॥2॥
slp1: prajAvAYSrotriyo yajvA vfdDaH prajYo'nasUyakaH । anAgatamanEtihyaM kaTaM brahmADigacCati ॥2॥
author: śuka uvāca ।

text: tapasā brahmacaryeṇa sarvatyāgena medhayā । sāṅkhye vā yadi vā yoge etatpṛṣṭo'bhidhatsva me ॥3॥
html:
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa sarvatyāgena medhayā ।
sāṅkhye vā yadi vā yoge etatpṛṣṭo'bhidhatsva me ॥3॥
slp1: tapasA brahmacaryeRa sarvatyAgena meDayA । sANKye vA yadi vA yoge etatpfzwo'BiDatsva me ॥3॥

text: manasaścendriyāṇāṃ cāpyaikāgryaṃ samavāpyate । yenopāyena puruṣaistacca vyākhyātumarhasi ॥4॥
html:
manasaścendriyāṇāṃ cāpyaikāgryaṃ samavāpyate ।
yenopāyena puruṣaistacca vyākhyātumarhasi ॥4॥
slp1: manasaScendriyARAM cApyEkAgryaM samavApyate । yenopAyena puruzEstacca vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥4॥

text: nānyatra vidyātapasornānyatrendriyanigrahāt । nānyatra sarvasantyāgātsiddhiṃ vindati kaścana ॥5॥
html:
nānyatra vidyātapasornānyatrendriyanigrahāt ।
nānyatra sarvasantyāgātsiddhiṃ vindati kaścana ॥5॥
slp1: nAnyatra vidyAtapasornAnyatrendriyanigrahAt । nAnyatra sarvasantyAgAtsidDiM vindati kaScana ॥5॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: mahābhūtāni sarvāṇi pūrvasṛṣṭiḥ svayaṃbhuvaḥ । bhūyiṣṭhaṃ prāṇabhṛdgrāme niviṣṭāni śarīriṣu ॥6॥
html:
mahābhūtāni sarvāṇi pūrvasṛṣṭiḥ svayaṃbhuvaḥ ।
bhūyiṣṭhaṃ prāṇabhṛdgrāme niviṣṭāni śarīriṣu ॥6॥
slp1: mahABUtAni sarvARi pUrvasfzwiH svayaMBuvaH । BUyizWaM prARaBfdgrAme nivizwAni SarIrizu ॥6॥

text: bhūmerdeho jalātsāro jyotiṣaścakṣuṣī smṛte । prāṇāpānāśrayo vāyuḥ kheṣvākāśaṃ śarīriṇām ॥7॥
html:
bhūmerdeho jalātsāro jyotiṣaścakṣuṣī smṛte ।
prāṇāpānāśrayo vāyuḥ kheṣvākāśaṃ śarīriṇām ॥7॥
slp1: BUmerdeho jalAtsAro jyotizaScakzuzI smfte । prARApAnASrayo vAyuH KezvAkASaM SarIriRAm ॥7॥

text: krānte viṣṇurbale śakraḥ koṣṭhe'gnirbhuktamarchati । karṇayoḥ pradiśaḥ śrotre jihvāyāṃ vāksarasvatī ॥8॥
html:
krānte viṣṇurbale śakraḥ koṣṭhe'gnirbhuktamarchati ।
karṇayoḥ pradiśaḥ śrotre jihvāyāṃ vāksarasvatī ॥8॥
slp1: krAnte vizRurbale SakraH kozWe'gnirBuktamarCati । karRayoH pradiSaH Srotre jihvAyAM vAksarasvatI ॥8॥

text: karṇau tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā caiva pañcamī । darśanānīndriyoktāni dvārāṇyāhārasiddhaye ॥9॥
html:
karṇau tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā caiva pañcamī ।
darśanānīndriyoktāni dvārāṇyāhārasiddhaye ॥9॥
slp1: karRO tvakcakzuzI jihvA nAsikA cEva paYcamI । darSanAnIndriyoktAni dvArARyAhArasidDaye ॥9॥

text: śabdaṃ sparśaṃ tathā rūpaṃ rasaṃ gandhaṃ ca pañcamam । indriyāṇi pṛthaktvarthānmanaso darśayantyuta ॥10॥
html:
śabdaṃ sparśaṃ tathā rūpaṃ rasaṃ gandhaṃ ca pañcamam ।
indriyāṇi pṛthaktvarthānmanaso darśayantyuta ॥10॥
slp1: SabdaM sparSaM taTA rUpaM rasaM ganDaM ca paYcamam । indriyARi pfTaktvarTAnmanaso darSayantyuta ॥10॥

text: indriyāṇi mano yuṅkte vaśyānyanteva vājinaḥ । manaścāpi sadā yuṅkte bhūtātmā hṛdayāśritaḥ ॥11॥
html:
indriyāṇi mano yuṅkte vaśyānyanteva vājinaḥ ।
manaścāpi sadā yuṅkte bhūtātmā hṛdayāśritaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: indriyARi mano yuNkte vaSyAnyanteva vAjinaH । manaScApi sadA yuNkte BUtAtmA hfdayASritaH ॥11॥

text: indriyāṇāṃ tathaiveṣāṃ sarveṣāmīśvaraṃ manaḥ । niyame ca visarge ca bhūtātmā manasastathā ॥12॥
html:
indriyāṇāṃ tathaiveṣāṃ sarveṣāmīśvaraṃ manaḥ ।
niyame ca visarge ca bhūtātmā manasastathā ॥12॥
slp1: indriyARAM taTEvezAM sarvezAmISvaraM manaH । niyame ca visarge ca BUtAtmA manasastaTA ॥12॥

text: indriyāṇīndriyārthāśca svabhāvaścetanā manaḥ । prāṇāpānau ca jīvaśca nityaṃ deheṣu dehinām ॥13॥
html:
indriyāṇīndriyārthāśca svabhāvaścetanā manaḥ ।
prāṇāpānau ca jīvaśca nityaṃ deheṣu dehinām ॥13॥
slp1: indriyARIndriyArTASca svaBAvaScetanA manaH । prARApAnO ca jIvaSca nityaM dehezu dehinAm ॥13॥

text: āśrayo nāsti sattvasya guṇaśabdo na cetanā । sattvaṃ hi tejaḥ sṛjati na guṇānvai kadācana ॥14॥
html:
āśrayo nāsti sattvasya guṇaśabdo na cetanā ।
sattvaṃ hi tejaḥ sṛjati na guṇānvai kadācana ॥14॥
slp1: ASrayo nAsti sattvasya guRaSabdo na cetanA । sattvaM hi tejaH sfjati na guRAnvE kadAcana ॥14॥

text: evaṃ saptadaśaṃ dehe vṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirguṇaiḥ । manīṣī manasā vipraḥ paśyatyātmānamātmani ॥15॥
html:
evaṃ saptadaśaṃ dehe vṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirguṇaiḥ ।
manīṣī manasā vipraḥ paśyatyātmānamātmani ॥15॥
slp1: evaM saptadaSaM dehe vftaM zoqaSaBirguREH । manIzI manasA vipraH paSyatyAtmAnamAtmani ॥15॥

text: na hyayaṃ cakṣuṣā dṛśyo na ca sarvairapīndriyaiḥ । manasā sampradīptena mahānātmā prakāśate ॥16॥
html:
na hyayaṃ cakṣuṣā dṛśyo na ca sarvairapīndriyaiḥ ।
manasā sampradīptena mahānātmā prakāśate ॥16॥
slp1: na hyayaM cakzuzA dfSyo na ca sarvErapIndriyEH । manasA sampradIptena mahAnAtmA prakASate ॥16॥

text: aśabdasparśarūpaṃ tadarasāgandhamavyayam । aśarīraṃ śarīre sve nirīkṣeta nirindriyam ॥17॥
html:
aśabdasparśarūpaṃ tadarasāgandhamavyayam ।
aśarīraṃ śarīre sve nirīkṣeta nirindriyam ॥17॥
slp1: aSabdasparSarUpaM tadarasAganDamavyayam । aSarIraM SarIre sve nirIkzeta nirindriyam ॥17॥

text: avyaktaṃ vyaktadeheṣu martyeṣvamaramāśritam । yo'nupaśyati sa pretya kalpate brahmabhūyase ॥18॥
html:
avyaktaṃ vyaktadeheṣu martyeṣvamaramāśritam ।
yo'nupaśyati sa pretya kalpate brahmabhūyase ॥18॥
slp1: avyaktaM vyaktadehezu martyezvamaramASritam । yo'nupaSyati sa pretya kalpate brahmaBUyase ॥18॥

text: vidyābhijanasampanne brāhmaṇe gavi hastini । śuni caiva śvapāke ca paṇḍitāḥ samadarśinaḥ ॥19॥
html:
vidyābhijanasampanne brāhmaṇe gavi hastini ।
śuni caiva śvapāke ca paṇḍitāḥ samadarśinaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: vidyABijanasampanne brAhmaRe gavi hastini । Suni cEva SvapAke ca paRqitAH samadarSinaH ॥19॥

text: sa hi sarveṣu bhūteṣu jaṅgameṣu dhruveṣu ca । vasatyeko mahānātmā yena sarvamidaṃ tatam ॥20॥
html:
sa hi sarveṣu bhūteṣu jaṅgameṣu dhruveṣu ca ।
vasatyeko mahānātmā yena sarvamidaṃ tatam ॥20॥
slp1: sa hi sarvezu BUtezu jaNgamezu Druvezu ca । vasatyeko mahAnAtmA yena sarvamidaM tatam ॥20॥

text: sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani । yadā paśyati bhūtātmā brahma sampadyate tadā ॥21॥
html:
sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani ।
yadā paśyati bhūtātmā brahma sampadyate tadā ॥21॥
slp1: sarvaBUtezu cAtmAnaM sarvaBUtAni cAtmani । yadA paSyati BUtAtmA brahma sampadyate tadA ॥21॥

text: yāvānātmani vedātmā tāvānātmā parātmani । ya evaṃ satataṃ veda so'mṛtatvāya kalpate ॥22॥
html:
yāvānātmani vedātmā tāvānātmā parātmani ।
ya evaṃ satataṃ veda so'mṛtatvāya kalpate ॥22॥
slp1: yAvAnAtmani vedAtmA tAvAnAtmA parAtmani । ya evaM satataM veda so'mftatvAya kalpate ॥22॥

text: sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya sarvabhūtahitasya ca । devāpi mārge muhyanti apadasya padaiṣiṇaḥ ॥23॥
html:
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya sarvabhūtahitasya ca ।
devāpi mārge muhyanti apadasya padaiṣiṇaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: sarvaBUtAtmaBUtasya sarvaBUtahitasya ca । devApi mArge muhyanti apadasya padEziRaH ॥23॥

text: śakunīnāmivākāśe jale vāricarasya vā । yathā gatirna dṛśyeta tathaiva sumahātmanaḥ ॥24॥
html:
śakunīnāmivākāśe jale vāricarasya vā ।
yathā gatirna dṛśyeta tathaiva sumahātmanaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: SakunInAmivAkASe jale vAricarasya vA । yaTA gatirna dfSyeta taTEva sumahAtmanaH ॥24॥

text: kālaḥ pacati bhūtāni sarvāṇyevātmanātmani । yasmiṃstu pacyate kālastaṃ na vedeha kaścana ॥25॥
html:
kālaḥ pacati bhūtāni sarvāṇyevātmanātmani ।
yasmiṃstu pacyate kālastaṃ na vedeha kaścana ॥25॥
slp1: kAlaH pacati BUtAni sarvARyevAtmanAtmani । yasmiMstu pacyate kAlastaM na vedeha kaScana ॥25॥

text: na tadūrdhvaṃ na tiryakca nādho na ca tiraḥ punaḥ । na madhye pratigṛhṇīte naiva kaścitkutaścana ॥26॥
html:
na tadūrdhvaṃ na tiryakca nādho na ca tiraḥ punaḥ ।
na madhye pratigṛhṇīte naiva kaścitkutaścana ॥26॥
slp1: na tadUrDvaM na tiryakca nADo na ca tiraH punaH । na maDye pratigfhRIte nEva kaScitkutaScana ॥26॥

text: sarve'ntaḥsthā ime lokā bāhyameṣāṃ na kiñcana । yaḥ sahasraṃ samāgacchedyathā bāṇo guṇacyutaḥ ॥27॥
html:
sarve'ntaḥsthā ime lokā bāhyameṣāṃ na kiñcana ।
yaḥ sahasraṃ samāgacchedyathā bāṇo guṇacyutaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: sarve'ntaHsTA ime lokA bAhyamezAM na kiYcana । yaH sahasraM samAgacCedyaTA bARo guRacyutaH ॥27॥

text: naivāntaṃ kāraṇasyeyādyadyapi syānmanojavaḥ । tasmātsūkṣmātsūkṣmataraṃ nāsti sthūlataraṃ tataḥ ॥28॥
html:
naivāntaṃ kāraṇasyeyādyadyapi syānmanojavaḥ ।
tasmātsūkṣmātsūkṣmataraṃ nāsti sthūlataraṃ tataḥ ॥28॥
slp1: nEvAntaM kAraRasyeyAdyadyapi syAnmanojavaH । tasmAtsUkzmAtsUkzmataraM nAsti sTUlataraM tataH ॥28॥

text: sarvataḥpāṇipādāntaṃ sarvatokṣiśiromukham । sarvataḥśrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati ॥29॥
html:
sarvataḥpāṇipādāntaṃ sarvatokṣiśiromukham ।
sarvataḥśrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati ॥29॥
slp1: sarvataHpARipAdAntaM sarvatokziSiromuKam । sarvataHSrutimalloke sarvamAvftya tizWati ॥29॥

text: tadevāṇoraṇutaraṃ tanmahadbhyo mahattaram । tadantaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dhruvaṃ tiṣṭhanna dṛśyate ॥30॥
html:
tadevāṇoraṇutaraṃ tanmahadbhyo mahattaram ।
tadantaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dhruvaṃ tiṣṭhanna dṛśyate ॥30॥
slp1: tadevARoraRutaraM tanmahadByo mahattaram । tadantaH sarvaBUtAnAM DruvaM tizWanna dfSyate ॥30॥

text: akṣaraṃ ca kṣaraṃ caiva dvaidhībhāvo'yamātmanaḥ । kṣaraḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu divyaṃ hyamṛtamakṣaram ॥31॥
html:
akṣaraṃ ca kṣaraṃ caiva dvaidhībhāvo'yamātmanaḥ ।
kṣaraḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu divyaṃ hyamṛtamakṣaram ॥31॥
slp1: akzaraM ca kzaraM cEva dvEDIBAvo'yamAtmanaH । kzaraH sarvezu BUtezu divyaM hyamftamakzaram ॥31॥

text: navadvāraṃ puraṃ gatvā haṃso hi niyato vaśī । īśaḥ sarvasya bhūtasya sthāvarasya carasya ca ॥32॥
html:
navadvāraṃ puraṃ gatvā haṃso hi niyato vaśī ।
īśaḥ sarvasya bhūtasya sthāvarasya carasya ca ॥32॥
slp1: navadvAraM puraM gatvA haMso hi niyato vaSI । ISaH sarvasya BUtasya sTAvarasya carasya ca ॥32॥

text: hānibhaṅgavikalpānāṃ navānāṃ saṃśrayeṇa ca । śarīrāṇāmajasyāhurhaṃsatvaṃ pāradarśinaḥ ॥33॥
html:
hānibhaṅgavikalpānāṃ navānāṃ saṃśrayeṇa ca ।
śarīrāṇāmajasyāhurhaṃsatvaṃ pāradarśinaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: hAniBaNgavikalpAnAM navAnAM saMSrayeRa ca । SarIrARAmajasyAhurhaMsatvaM pAradarSinaH ॥33॥

text: haṃsoktaṃ cākṣaraṃ caiva kūṭasthaṃ yattadakṣaram । tadvidvānakṣaraṃ prāpya jahāti prāṇajanmanī] ॥34॥
html:
haṃsoktaṃ cākṣaraṃ caiva kūṭasthaṃ yattadakṣaram ।
tadvidvānakṣaraṃ prāpya jahāti prāṇajanmanī] ॥34॥
slp1: haMsoktaM cAkzaraM cEva kUwasTaM yattadakzaram । tadvidvAnakzaraM prApya jahAti prARajanmanI] ॥34॥

text: pṛcchatastava satputra yathāvadiha tattvataḥ । sāṅkhyanyāyena saṃyuktaṃ yadetatkīrtitaṃ mayā ॥1॥
html:
pṛcchatastava satputra yathāvadiha tattvataḥ ।
sāṅkhyanyāyena saṃyuktaṃ yadetatkīrtitaṃ mayā ॥1॥
slp1: pfcCatastava satputra yaTAvadiha tattvataH । sANKyanyAyena saMyuktaM yadetatkIrtitaM mayA ॥1॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: yogakṛtyaṃ tu te kṛtsnaṃ vartayiṣyāmi tacchṛṇu । ekatvaṃ buddhimanasorindriyāṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ । ātmano dhyāyinastāta jñānametadanuttamam ॥2॥
html:
yogakṛtyaṃ tu te kṛtsnaṃ vartayiṣyāmi tacchṛṇu ।
ekatvaṃ buddhimanasorindriyāṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ।
ātmano dhyāyinastāta jñānametadanuttamam ॥2॥
slp1: yogakftyaM tu te kftsnaM vartayizyAmi tacCfRu । ekatvaM budDimanasorindriyARAM ca sarvaSaH । Atmano DyAyinastAta jYAnametadanuttamam ॥2॥

text: tadetadupaśāntena dāntenādhyātmaśīlinā । ātmārāmeṇa buddhena boddhavyaṃ śucikarmaṇā ॥3॥
html:
tadetadupaśāntena dāntenādhyātmaśīlinā ।
ātmārāmeṇa buddhena boddhavyaṃ śucikarmaṇā ॥3॥
slp1: tadetadupaSAntena dAntenADyAtmaSIlinA । AtmArAmeRa budDena bodDavyaM SucikarmaRA ॥3॥

text: yogadoṣānsamucchidya pañca yānkavayo viduḥ । kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca bhayaṃ svapnaṃ ca pañcamam ॥4॥
html:
yogadoṣānsamucchidya pañca yānkavayo viduḥ ।
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca bhayaṃ svapnaṃ ca pañcamam ॥4॥
slp1: yogadozAnsamucCidya paYca yAnkavayo viduH । kAmaM kroDaM ca loBaM ca BayaM svapnaM ca paYcamam ॥4॥

text: krodhaṃ śamena jayati kāmaṃ saṅkalpavarjanāt । sattvasaṃsevanāddhīro nidrāmucchettumarhati ॥5॥
html:
krodhaṃ śamena jayati kāmaṃ saṅkalpavarjanāt ।
sattvasaṃsevanāddhīro nidrāmucchettumarhati ॥5॥
slp1: kroDaM Samena jayati kAmaM saNkalpavarjanAt । sattvasaMsevanAdDIro nidrAmucCettumarhati ॥5॥

text: dhṛtyā śiśnodaraṃ rakṣetpāṇipādaṃ ca cakṣuṣā । cakṣuḥ śrotre ca manasā mano vācaṃ ca karmaṇā ॥6॥
html:
dhṛtyā śiśnodaraṃ rakṣetpāṇipādaṃ ca cakṣuṣā ।
cakṣuḥ śrotre ca manasā mano vācaṃ ca karmaṇā ॥6॥
slp1: DftyA SiSnodaraM rakzetpARipAdaM ca cakzuzA । cakzuH Srotre ca manasA mano vAcaM ca karmaRA ॥6॥

text: apramādādbhayaṃ jahyāllobhaṃ prājñopasevanāt । evametānyogadoṣāñjayennityamatandritaḥ ॥7॥
html:
apramādādbhayaṃ jahyāllobhaṃ prājñopasevanāt ।
evametānyogadoṣāñjayennityamatandritaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: apramAdAdBayaM jahyAlloBaM prAjYopasevanAt । evametAnyogadozAYjayennityamatandritaH ॥7॥

text: agnīṃśca brāhmaṇāṃścārceddevatāḥ praṇameta ca । varjayedruṣitāṃ vācaṃ hiṃsāyuktāṃ manonugām ॥8॥
html:
agnīṃśca brāhmaṇāṃścārceddevatāḥ praṇameta ca ।
varjayedruṣitāṃ vācaṃ hiṃsāyuktāṃ manonugām ॥8॥
slp1: agnIMSca brAhmaRAMScArceddevatAH praRameta ca । varjayedruzitAM vAcaM hiMsAyuktAM manonugAm ॥8॥

text: brahma tejomayaṃ śukraṃ yasya sarvamidaṃ rasaḥ । ekasya bhūtaṃ bhūtasya dvayaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam ॥9॥
html:
brahma tejomayaṃ śukraṃ yasya sarvamidaṃ rasaḥ ।
ekasya bhūtaṃ bhūtasya dvayaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam ॥9॥
slp1: brahma tejomayaM SukraM yasya sarvamidaM rasaH । ekasya BUtaM BUtasya dvayaM sTAvarajaNgamam ॥9॥

text: dhyānamadhyayanaṃ dānaṃ satyaṃ hrīrārjavaṃ kṣamā । śaucamāhārasaṃśuddhirindriyāṇāṃ ca nigrahaḥ ॥10॥
html:
dhyānamadhyayanaṃ dānaṃ satyaṃ hrīrārjavaṃ kṣamā ।
śaucamāhārasaṃśuddhirindriyāṇāṃ ca nigrahaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: DyAnamaDyayanaM dAnaM satyaM hrIrArjavaM kzamA । SOcamAhArasaMSudDirindriyARAM ca nigrahaH ॥10॥

text: etairvivardhate tejaḥ pāpmānaṃ cāpakarṣati । sidhyanti cāsya sarvārthā vijñānaṃ ca pravartate ॥11॥
html:
etairvivardhate tejaḥ pāpmānaṃ cāpakarṣati ।
sidhyanti cāsya sarvārthā vijñānaṃ ca pravartate ॥11॥
slp1: etErvivarDate tejaH pApmAnaM cApakarzati । siDyanti cAsya sarvArTA vijYAnaM ca pravartate ॥11॥

text: samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu labdhālabdhena vartayan । dhutapāpmā tu tejasvī laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ । kāmakrodhau vaśe kṛtvā ninīṣedbrahmaṇaḥ padam ॥12॥
html:
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu labdhālabdhena vartayan ।
dhutapāpmā tu tejasvī laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ ।
kāmakrodhau vaśe kṛtvā ninīṣedbrahmaṇaḥ padam ॥12॥
slp1: samaH sarvezu BUtezu labDAlabDena vartayan । DutapApmA tu tejasvI laGvAhAro jitendriyaH । kAmakroDO vaSe kftvA ninIzedbrahmaRaH padam ॥12॥

text: manasaścendriyāṇāṃ ca kṛtvaikāgryaṃ samāhitaḥ । prāgrātrāpararātreṣu dhārayenmana ātmanā ॥13॥
html:
manasaścendriyāṇāṃ ca kṛtvaikāgryaṃ samāhitaḥ ।
prāgrātrāpararātreṣu dhārayenmana ātmanā ॥13॥
slp1: manasaScendriyARAM ca kftvEkAgryaM samAhitaH । prAgrAtrApararAtrezu DArayenmana AtmanA ॥13॥

text: jantoḥ pañcendriyasyāsya yadekaṃ chidramindriyam । tato'sya sravati prajñā dṛteḥ pādādivodakam ॥14॥
html:
jantoḥ pañcendriyasyāsya yadekaṃ chidramindriyam ।
tato'sya sravati prajñā dṛteḥ pādādivodakam ॥14॥
slp1: jantoH paYcendriyasyAsya yadekaM Cidramindriyam । tato'sya sravati prajYA dfteH pAdAdivodakam ॥14॥

text: manastu pūrvamādadyātkumīnāniva matsyahā । tataḥ śrotraṃ tataścakṣurjihvāṃ ghrāṇaṃ ca yogavit ॥15॥
html:
manastu pūrvamādadyātkumīnāniva matsyahā ।
tataḥ śrotraṃ tataścakṣurjihvāṃ ghrāṇaṃ ca yogavit ॥15॥
slp1: manastu pUrvamAdadyAtkumInAniva matsyahA । tataH SrotraM tataScakzurjihvAM GrARaM ca yogavit ॥15॥

text: tata etāni saṃyamya manasi sthāpayedyatiḥ । tathaivāpohya saṅkalpānmano hyātmani dhārayet ॥16॥
html:
tata etāni saṃyamya manasi sthāpayedyatiḥ ।
tathaivāpohya saṅkalpānmano hyātmani dhārayet ॥16॥
slp1: tata etAni saMyamya manasi sTApayedyatiH । taTEvApohya saNkalpAnmano hyAtmani DArayet ॥16॥

text: pañca jñānena sandhāya manasi sthāpayedyatiḥ । yadaitānyavatiṣṭhante manaḥṣaṣṭhāni cātmani । prasīdanti ca saṃsthāya tadā brahma prakāśate ॥17॥
html:
pañca jñānena sandhāya manasi sthāpayedyatiḥ ।
yadaitānyavatiṣṭhante manaḥṣaṣṭhāni cātmani ।
prasīdanti ca saṃsthāya tadā brahma prakāśate ॥17॥
slp1: paYca jYAnena sanDAya manasi sTApayedyatiH । yadEtAnyavatizWante manaHzazWAni cAtmani । prasIdanti ca saMsTAya tadA brahma prakASate ॥17॥

text: vidhūma iva dīptārcirāditya iva dīptimān । vaidyuto'gnirivākāśe paśyatyātmānamātmanā । sarvaṃ ca tatra sarvatra vyāpakatvācca dṛśyate ॥18॥
html:
vidhūma iva dīptārcirāditya iva dīptimān ।
vaidyuto'gnirivākāśe paśyatyātmānamātmanā ।
sarvaṃ ca tatra sarvatra vyāpakatvācca dṛśyate ॥18॥
slp1: viDUma iva dIptArcirAditya iva dIptimAn । vEdyuto'gnirivAkASe paSyatyAtmAnamAtmanA । sarvaM ca tatra sarvatra vyApakatvAcca dfSyate ॥18॥

text: taṃ paśyanti mahātmāno brāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ । dhṛtimanto mahāprājñāḥ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ॥19॥
html:
taṃ paśyanti mahātmāno brāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ ।
dhṛtimanto mahāprājñāḥ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ॥19॥
slp1: taM paSyanti mahAtmAno brAhmaRA ye manIziRaH । Dftimanto mahAprAjYAH sarvaBUtahite ratAH ॥19॥

text: evaṃ parimitaṃ kālamācaransaṃśitavrataḥ । āsīno hi rahasyeko gacchedakṣarasātmyatām ॥20॥
html:
evaṃ parimitaṃ kālamācaransaṃśitavrataḥ ।
āsīno hi rahasyeko gacchedakṣarasātmyatām ॥20॥
slp1: evaM parimitaM kAlamAcaransaMSitavrataH । AsIno hi rahasyeko gacCedakzarasAtmyatAm ॥20॥

text: pramoho bhrama āvarto ghrāṇaśravaṇadarśane । adbhutāni rasasparśe śītoṣṇe mārutākṛtiḥ ॥21॥
html:
pramoho bhrama āvarto ghrāṇaśravaṇadarśane ।
adbhutāni rasasparśe śītoṣṇe mārutākṛtiḥ ॥21॥
slp1: pramoho Brama Avarto GrARaSravaRadarSane । adButAni rasasparSe SItozRe mArutAkftiH ॥21॥

text: pratibhāmupasargāṃścāpyupasaṅgṛhya yogataḥ । tāṃstattvavidanādṛtya svātmanaiva nivartayet ॥22॥
html:
pratibhāmupasargāṃścāpyupasaṅgṛhya yogataḥ ।
tāṃstattvavidanādṛtya svātmanaiva nivartayet ॥22॥
slp1: pratiBAmupasargAMScApyupasaNgfhya yogataH । tAMstattvavidanAdftya svAtmanEva nivartayet ॥22॥

text: kuryātparicayaṃ yoge traikālyaṃ niyato muniḥ । giriśṛṅge tathā caitye vṛkṣāgreṣu ca yojajet ॥23॥
html:
kuryātparicayaṃ yoge traikālyaṃ niyato muniḥ ।
giriśṛṅge tathā caitye vṛkṣāgreṣu ca yojajet ॥23॥
slp1: kuryAtparicayaM yoge trEkAlyaM niyato muniH । giriSfNge taTA cEtye vfkzAgrezu ca yojajet ॥23॥

text: sanniyamyendriyagrāmaṃ goṣṭhe bhāṇḍamanā iva । ekāgraścintayennityaṃ yogānnodvejayenmanaḥ ॥24॥
html:
sanniyamyendriyagrāmaṃ goṣṭhe bhāṇḍamanā iva ।
ekāgraścintayennityaṃ yogānnodvejayenmanaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: sanniyamyendriyagrAmaM gozWe BARqamanA iva । ekAgraScintayennityaM yogAnnodvejayenmanaH ॥24॥

text: yenopāyena śakyeta sanniyantuṃ calaṃ manaḥ । taṃ taṃ yukto niṣeveta na caiva vicalettataḥ ॥25॥
html:
yenopāyena śakyeta sanniyantuṃ calaṃ manaḥ ।
taṃ taṃ yukto niṣeveta na caiva vicalettataḥ ॥25॥
slp1: yenopAyena Sakyeta sanniyantuM calaM manaH । taM taM yukto nizeveta na cEva vicalettataH ॥25॥

text: śūnyā giriguhāścaiva devatāyatanāni ca । śūnyāgārāṇi caikāgro nivāsārthamupakramet ॥26॥
html:
śūnyā giriguhāścaiva devatāyatanāni ca ।
śūnyāgārāṇi caikāgro nivāsārthamupakramet ॥26॥
slp1: SUnyA giriguhAScEva devatAyatanAni ca । SUnyAgArARi cEkAgro nivAsArTamupakramet ॥26॥

text: nābhiṣvajetparaṃ vācā karmaṇā manasāpi vā । upekṣako yatāhāro labdhālabdhe samo bhavet ॥27॥
html:
nābhiṣvajetparaṃ vācā karmaṇā manasāpi vā ।
upekṣako yatāhāro labdhālabdhe samo bhavet ॥27॥
slp1: nABizvajetparaM vAcA karmaRA manasApi vA । upekzako yatAhAro labDAlabDe samo Bavet ॥27॥

text: yaścainamabhinandeta yaścainamapavādayet । samastayoścāpyubhayornābhidhyāyecchubhāśubham ॥28॥
html:
yaścainamabhinandeta yaścainamapavādayet ।
samastayoścāpyubhayornābhidhyāyecchubhāśubham ॥28॥
slp1: yaScEnamaBinandeta yaScEnamapavAdayet । samastayoScApyuBayornABiDyAyecCuBASuBam ॥28॥

text: na prahṛṣyeta lābheṣu nālābheṣu ca cintayet । samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu sadharmā mātariśvanaḥ ॥29॥
html:
na prahṛṣyeta lābheṣu nālābheṣu ca cintayet ।
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu sadharmā mātariśvanaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: na prahfzyeta lABezu nAlABezu ca cintayet । samaH sarvezu BUtezu saDarmA mAtariSvanaH ॥29॥

text: evaṃ sarvātmanaḥ sādhoḥ sarvatra samadarśinaḥ । ṣaṇmāsānnityayuktasya śabdabrahmātivartate ॥30॥
html:
evaṃ sarvātmanaḥ sādhoḥ sarvatra samadarśinaḥ ।
ṣaṇmāsānnityayuktasya śabdabrahmātivartate ॥30॥
slp1: evaM sarvAtmanaH sADoH sarvatra samadarSinaH । zaRmAsAnnityayuktasya SabdabrahmAtivartate ॥30॥

text: vedanārtāḥ prajā dṛṣṭvā samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ । etasminnirato mārge viramenna vimohitaḥ ॥31॥
html:
vedanārtāḥ prajā dṛṣṭvā samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ ।
etasminnirato mārge viramenna vimohitaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: vedanArtAH prajA dfzwvA samalozwASmakAYcanaH । etasminnirato mArge viramenna vimohitaH ॥31॥

text: api varṇāvakṛṣṭastu nārī vā dharmakāṅkṣiṇī । tāvapyetena mārgeṇa gacchetāṃ paramāṃ gatim ॥32॥
html:
api varṇāvakṛṣṭastu nārī vā dharmakāṅkṣiṇī ।
tāvapyetena mārgeṇa gacchetāṃ paramāṃ gatim ॥32॥
slp1: api varRAvakfzwastu nArI vA DarmakANkziRI । tAvapyetena mArgeRa gacCetAM paramAM gatim ॥32॥

text: ajaṃ purāṇamajaraṃ sanātanaṃ yadindriyairupalabhate naro'calaḥ । aṇoraṇīyo mahato mahattaraṃ tadātmanā paśyati yukta ātmavān ॥33॥
html:
ajaṃ purāṇamajaraṃ sanātanaṃ yadindriyairupalabhate naro'calaḥ ।
aṇoraṇīyo mahato mahattaraṃ tadātmanā paśyati yukta ātmavān ॥33॥
slp1: ajaM purARamajaraM sanAtanaM yadindriyErupalaBate naro'calaH । aRoraRIyo mahato mahattaraM tadAtmanA paSyati yukta AtmavAn ॥33॥

text: idaṃ maharṣervacanaṃ mahātmano yathāvaduktaṃ manasānudṛśya ca । avekṣya ceyātparameṣṭhisātmyatāṃ prayānti yāṃ bhūtagatiṃ manīṣiṇaḥ] ॥34॥
html:
idaṃ maharṣervacanaṃ mahātmano yathāvaduktaṃ manasānudṛśya ca ।
avekṣya ceyātparameṣṭhisātmyatāṃ prayānti yāṃ bhūtagatiṃ manīṣiṇaḥ] ॥34॥
slp1: idaM maharzervacanaM mahAtmano yaTAvaduktaM manasAnudfSya ca । avekzya ceyAtparamezWisAtmyatAM prayAnti yAM BUtagatiM manIziRaH] ॥34॥

text: yadidaṃ vedavacanaṃ kuru karma tyajeti ca । kāṃ diśaṃ vidyayā yānti kāṃ ca gacchanti karmaṇā ॥1॥
html:
yadidaṃ vedavacanaṃ kuru karma tyajeti ca ।
kāṃ diśaṃ vidyayā yānti kāṃ ca gacchanti karmaṇā ॥1॥
slp1: yadidaM vedavacanaM kuru karma tyajeti ca । kAM diSaM vidyayA yAnti kAM ca gacCanti karmaRA ॥1॥
author: śuka uvāca ।

text: etadvai śrotumicchāmi tadbhavānprabravītu me । etattvanyonyavairūpye vartate pratikūlataḥ ॥2॥
html:
etadvai śrotumicchāmi tadbhavānprabravītu me ।
etattvanyonyavairūpye vartate pratikūlataḥ ॥2॥
slp1: etadvE SrotumicCAmi tadBavAnprabravItu me । etattvanyonyavErUpye vartate pratikUlataH ॥2॥

text: ityuktaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ parāśarasutaḥ sutam । karmavidyāmayāvetau vyākhyāsyāmi kṣarākṣarau ॥3॥
html:
ityuktaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ parāśarasutaḥ sutam ।
karmavidyāmayāvetau vyākhyāsyāmi kṣarākṣarau ॥3॥
slp1: ityuktaH pratyuvAcedaM parASarasutaH sutam । karmavidyAmayAvetO vyAKyAsyAmi kzarAkzarO ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yāṃ diśaṃ vidyayā yānti yāṃ ca gacchanti karmaṇā । śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ putra gahvaraṃ hyetadantaram ॥4॥
html:
yāṃ diśaṃ vidyayā yānti yāṃ ca gacchanti karmaṇā ।
śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ putra gahvaraṃ hyetadantaram ॥4॥
slp1: yAM diSaM vidyayA yAnti yAM ca gacCanti karmaRA । SfRuzvEkamanAH putra gahvaraM hyetadantaram ॥4॥

text: asti dharma iti proktaṃ nāstītyatraiva yo vadet । tasya pakṣasya sadṛśamidaṃ mama bhavedatha ॥5॥
html:
asti dharma iti proktaṃ nāstītyatraiva yo vadet ।
tasya pakṣasya sadṛśamidaṃ mama bhavedatha ॥5॥
slp1: asti Darma iti proktaM nAstItyatrEva yo vadet । tasya pakzasya sadfSamidaM mama BavedaTa ॥5॥

text: dvāvimāvatha panthānau yatra vedāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ । pravṛttilakṣaṇo dharmo nivṛttau ca subhāṣitaḥ ॥6॥
html:
