dvāvimāvatha panthānau yatra vedāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ।
pravṛttilakṣaṇo dharmo nivṛttau ca subhāṣitaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: dvAvimAvaTa panTAnO yatra vedAH pratizWitAH । pravfttilakzaRo Darmo nivfttO ca suBAzitaH ॥6॥

text: karmaṇā badhyate janturvidyayā tu pramucyate । tasmātkarma na kurvanti yatayaḥ pāradarśinaḥ ॥7॥
html:
karmaṇā badhyate janturvidyayā tu pramucyate ।
tasmātkarma na kurvanti yatayaḥ pāradarśinaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: karmaRA baDyate janturvidyayA tu pramucyate । tasmAtkarma na kurvanti yatayaH pAradarSinaH ॥7॥

text: karmaṇā jāyate pretya mūrtimānṣoḍaśātmakaḥ । vidyayā jāyate nityamavyayo hyavyayātmakaḥ ॥8॥
html:
karmaṇā jāyate pretya mūrtimānṣoḍaśātmakaḥ ।
vidyayā jāyate nityamavyayo hyavyayātmakaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: karmaRA jAyate pretya mUrtimAnzoqaSAtmakaH । vidyayA jAyate nityamavyayo hyavyayAtmakaH ॥8॥

text: karma tveke praśaṃsanti svalpabuddhitarā narāḥ । tena te dehajālāni ramayanta upāsate ॥9॥
html:
karma tveke praśaṃsanti svalpabuddhitarā narāḥ ।
tena te dehajālāni ramayanta upāsate ॥9॥
slp1: karma tveke praSaMsanti svalpabudDitarA narAH । tena te dehajAlAni ramayanta upAsate ॥9॥

text: ye tu buddhiṃ parāṃ prāptā dharmanaipuṇyadarśinaḥ । na te karma praśaṃsanti kūpaṃ nadyāṃ pibanniva ॥10॥
html:
ye tu buddhiṃ parāṃ prāptā dharmanaipuṇyadarśinaḥ ।
na te karma praśaṃsanti kūpaṃ nadyāṃ pibanniva ॥10॥
slp1: ye tu budDiM parAM prAptA DarmanEpuRyadarSinaH । na te karma praSaMsanti kUpaM nadyAM pibanniva ॥10॥

text: karmaṇaḥ phalamāpnoti sukhaduḥkhe bhavābhavau । vidyayā tadavāpnoti yatra gatvā na śocati ॥11॥
html:
karmaṇaḥ phalamāpnoti sukhaduḥkhe bhavābhavau ।
vidyayā tadavāpnoti yatra gatvā na śocati ॥11॥
slp1: karmaRaH PalamApnoti suKaduHKe BavABavO । vidyayA tadavApnoti yatra gatvA na Socati ॥11॥

text: yatra gatvā na mriyate yatra gatvā na jāyate । na jīryate yatra gatvā yatra gatvā na vardhate ॥12॥
html:
yatra gatvā na mriyate yatra gatvā na jāyate ।
na jīryate yatra gatvā yatra gatvā na vardhate ॥12॥
slp1: yatra gatvA na mriyate yatra gatvA na jAyate । na jIryate yatra gatvA yatra gatvA na varDate ॥12॥

text: yatra tadbrahma paramamavyaktamajaraṃ dhruvam । avyāhatamanāyāsamamṛtaṃ cāviyogi ca ॥13॥
html:
yatra tadbrahma paramamavyaktamajaraṃ dhruvam ।
avyāhatamanāyāsamamṛtaṃ cāviyogi ca ॥13॥
slp1: yatra tadbrahma paramamavyaktamajaraM Druvam । avyAhatamanAyAsamamftaM cAviyogi ca ॥13॥

text: dvandvairyatra na bādhyante mānasena ca karmaṇā । samāḥ sarvatra maitrāśca sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ॥14॥
html:
dvandvairyatra na bādhyante mānasena ca karmaṇā ।
samāḥ sarvatra maitrāśca sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: dvandvEryatra na bADyante mAnasena ca karmaRA । samAH sarvatra mEtrASca sarvaBUtahite ratAH ॥14॥

text: vidyāmayo'nyaḥ puruṣastāta karmamayo'paraḥ । viddhi candramasaṃ darśe sūkṣmayā kalayā sthitam ॥15॥
html:
vidyāmayo'nyaḥ puruṣastāta karmamayo'paraḥ ।
viddhi candramasaṃ darśe sūkṣmayā kalayā sthitam ॥15॥
slp1: vidyAmayo'nyaH puruzastAta karmamayo'paraH । vidDi candramasaM darSe sUkzmayA kalayA sTitam ॥15॥

text: tadetadṛṣiṇā proktaṃ vistareṇānumīyate । navajaṃ śaśinaṃ dṛṣṭvā vakraṃ tantumivāmbare ॥16॥
html:
tadetadṛṣiṇā proktaṃ vistareṇānumīyate ।
navajaṃ śaśinaṃ dṛṣṭvā vakraṃ tantumivāmbare ॥16॥
slp1: tadetadfziRA proktaM vistareRAnumIyate । navajaM SaSinaM dfzwvA vakraM tantumivAmbare ॥16॥

text: ekādaśavikārātmā kalāsambhārasambhṛtaḥ । mūrtimāniti taṃ viddhi tāta karmaguṇātmakam ॥17॥
html:
ekādaśavikārātmā kalāsambhārasambhṛtaḥ ।
mūrtimāniti taṃ viddhi tāta karmaguṇātmakam ॥17॥
slp1: ekAdaSavikArAtmA kalAsamBArasamBftaH । mUrtimAniti taM vidDi tAta karmaguRAtmakam ॥17॥

text: devo yaḥ saṃśritastasminnabbinduriva puṣkare । kṣetrajñaṃ taṃ vijānīyānnityaṃ tyāgajitātmakam ॥18॥
html:
devo yaḥ saṃśritastasminnabbinduriva puṣkare ।
kṣetrajñaṃ taṃ vijānīyānnityaṃ tyāgajitātmakam ॥18॥
slp1: devo yaH saMSritastasminnabbinduriva puzkare । kzetrajYaM taM vijAnIyAnnityaM tyAgajitAtmakam ॥18॥

text: tamo rajaśca sattvaṃ ca viddhi jīvaguṇānimān । jīvamātmaguṇaṃ vidyādātmānaṃ paramātmanaḥ ॥19॥
html:
tamo rajaśca sattvaṃ ca viddhi jīvaguṇānimān ।
jīvamātmaguṇaṃ vidyādātmānaṃ paramātmanaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: tamo rajaSca sattvaM ca vidDi jIvaguRAnimAn । jIvamAtmaguRaM vidyAdAtmAnaM paramAtmanaH ॥19॥

text: sacetanaṃ jīvaguṇaṃ vadanti sa ceṣṭate ceṣṭayate ca sarvam । tataḥ paraṃ kṣetravido vadanti prāvartayadyo bhuvanāni sapta] ॥20॥
html:
sacetanaṃ jīvaguṇaṃ vadanti sa ceṣṭate ceṣṭayate ca sarvam ।
tataḥ paraṃ kṣetravido vadanti prāvartayadyo bhuvanāni sapta] ॥20॥
slp1: sacetanaM jIvaguRaM vadanti sa cezwate cezwayate ca sarvam । tataH paraM kzetravido vadanti prAvartayadyo BuvanAni sapta] ॥20॥

text: kṣarātprabhṛti yaḥ sargaḥ saguṇānīndriyāṇi ca । buddhyaiśvaryābhisargārthaṃ yaddhyānaṃ cātmanaḥ śubham ॥1॥
html:
kṣarātprabhṛti yaḥ sargaḥ saguṇānīndriyāṇi ca ।
buddhyaiśvaryābhisargārthaṃ yaddhyānaṃ cātmanaḥ śubham ॥1॥
slp1: kzarAtpraBfti yaH sargaH saguRAnIndriyARi ca । budDyESvaryABisargArTaM yadDyAnaM cAtmanaH SuBam ॥1॥
author: śuka uvāca ।

text: bhūya eva tu loke'sminsadvṛttiṃ vṛttihaitukīm । yayā santaḥ pravartante tadicchāmyanuvarṇitam ॥2॥
html:
bhūya eva tu loke'sminsadvṛttiṃ vṛttihaitukīm ।
yayā santaḥ pravartante tadicchāmyanuvarṇitam ॥2॥
slp1: BUya eva tu loke'sminsadvfttiM vfttihEtukIm । yayA santaH pravartante tadicCAmyanuvarRitam ॥2॥

text: vede vacanamuktaṃ tu kuru karma tyajeti ca । kathametadvijānīyāṃ tacca vyākhyātumarhasi ॥3॥
html:
vede vacanamuktaṃ tu kuru karma tyajeti ca ।
kathametadvijānīyāṃ tacca vyākhyātumarhasi ॥3॥
slp1: vede vacanamuktaM tu kuru karma tyajeti ca । kaTametadvijAnIyAM tacca vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥3॥

text: lokavṛttāntatattvajñaḥ pūto'haṃ guruśāsanāt । kṛtvā buddhiṃ viyuktātmā tyakṣyāmyātmānamavyathaḥ ॥4॥
html:
lokavṛttāntatattvajñaḥ pūto'haṃ guruśāsanāt ।
kṛtvā buddhiṃ viyuktātmā tyakṣyāmyātmānamavyathaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: lokavfttAntatattvajYaH pUto'haM guruSAsanAt । kftvA budDiM viyuktAtmA tyakzyAmyAtmAnamavyaTaH ॥4॥

text: yaiṣā vai vihitā vṛttiḥ purastādbrahmaṇā svayam । eṣā pūrvataraiḥ sadbhirācīrṇā paramarṣibhiḥ ॥5॥
html:
yaiṣā vai vihitā vṛttiḥ purastādbrahmaṇā svayam ।
eṣā pūrvataraiḥ sadbhirācīrṇā paramarṣibhiḥ ॥5॥
slp1: yEzA vE vihitA vfttiH purastAdbrahmaRA svayam । ezA pUrvatarEH sadBirAcIrRA paramarziBiH ॥5॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: brahmacaryeṇa vai lokāñjayanti paramarṣayaḥ । ātmanaśca hṛdi śreyastvanviccha manasātmani ॥6॥
html:
brahmacaryeṇa vai lokāñjayanti paramarṣayaḥ ।
ātmanaśca hṛdi śreyastvanviccha manasātmani ॥6॥
slp1: brahmacaryeRa vE lokAYjayanti paramarzayaH । AtmanaSca hfdi SreyastvanvicCa manasAtmani ॥6॥

text: vane mūlaphalāśī ca tapyansuvipulaṃ tapaḥ । puṇyāyatanacārī ca bhūtānāmavihiṃsakaḥ ॥7॥
html:
vane mūlaphalāśī ca tapyansuvipulaṃ tapaḥ ।
puṇyāyatanacārī ca bhūtānāmavihiṃsakaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: vane mUlaPalASI ca tapyansuvipulaM tapaH । puRyAyatanacArI ca BUtAnAmavihiMsakaH ॥7॥

text: vidhūme sannamusale vānaprasthapratiśraye । kāle prāpte caranbhaikṣaṃ kalpate brahmabhūyase ॥8॥
html:
vidhūme sannamusale vānaprasthapratiśraye ।
kāle prāpte caranbhaikṣaṃ kalpate brahmabhūyase ॥8॥
slp1: viDUme sannamusale vAnaprasTapratiSraye । kAle prApte caranBEkzaM kalpate brahmaBUyase ॥8॥

text: niḥstutirnirnamaskāraḥ parityajya śubhāśubhe । araṇye vicaraikākī yena kenacidāśitaḥ ॥9॥
html:
niḥstutirnirnamaskāraḥ parityajya śubhāśubhe ।
araṇye vicaraikākī yena kenacidāśitaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: niHstutirnirnamaskAraH parityajya SuBASuBe । araRye vicarEkAkI yena kenacidASitaH ॥9॥

text: yadidaṃ vedavacanaṃ lokavāde virudhyate । pramāṇe cāpramāṇe ca viruddhe śāstratā kutaḥ ॥10॥
html:
yadidaṃ vedavacanaṃ lokavāde virudhyate ।
pramāṇe cāpramāṇe ca viruddhe śāstratā kutaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: yadidaM vedavacanaM lokavAde viruDyate । pramARe cApramARe ca virudDe SAstratA kutaH ॥10॥
author: śuka uvāca ।

text: ityetacchrotumicchāmi bhagavānprabravītu me । karmaṇāmavirodhena kathametatpravartate ॥11॥
html:
ityetacchrotumicchāmi bhagavānprabravītu me ।
karmaṇāmavirodhena kathametatpravartate ॥11॥
slp1: ityetacCrotumicCAmi BagavAnprabravItu me । karmaRAmaviroDena kaTametatpravartate ॥11॥

text: ityuktaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ gandhavatyāḥ sutaḥ sutam । ṛṣistatpūjayanvākyaṃ putrasyāmitatejasaḥ ॥12॥
html:
ityuktaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ gandhavatyāḥ sutaḥ sutam ।
ṛṣistatpūjayanvākyaṃ putrasyāmitatejasaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: ityuktaH pratyuvAcedaM ganDavatyAH sutaH sutam । fzistatpUjayanvAkyaM putrasyAmitatejasaH ॥12॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: gṛhastho brahmacārī ca vānaprastho'tha bhikṣukaḥ । yathoktakāriṇaḥ sarve gacchanti paramāṃ gatim ॥13॥
html:
gṛhastho brahmacārī ca vānaprastho'tha bhikṣukaḥ ।
yathoktakāriṇaḥ sarve gacchanti paramāṃ gatim ॥13॥
slp1: gfhasTo brahmacArI ca vAnaprasTo'Ta BikzukaH । yaToktakAriRaH sarve gacCanti paramAM gatim ॥13॥

text: eko ya āśramānetānanutiṣṭhedyathāvidhi । akāmadveṣasaṃyuktaḥ sa paratra mahīyate ॥14॥
html:
eko ya āśramānetānanutiṣṭhedyathāvidhi ।
akāmadveṣasaṃyuktaḥ sa paratra mahīyate ॥14॥
slp1: eko ya ASramAnetAnanutizWedyaTAviDi । akAmadvezasaMyuktaH sa paratra mahIyate ॥14॥

text: catuṣpadī hi niḥśreṇī brahmaṇyeṣā pratiṣṭhitā । etāmāśritya niḥśreṇīṃ brahmaloke mahīyate ॥15॥
html:
catuṣpadī hi niḥśreṇī brahmaṇyeṣā pratiṣṭhitā ।
etāmāśritya niḥśreṇīṃ brahmaloke mahīyate ॥15॥
slp1: catuzpadI hi niHSreRI brahmaRyezA pratizWitA । etAmASritya niHSreRIM brahmaloke mahIyate ॥15॥

text: āyuṣastu caturbhāgaṃ brahmacāryanasūyakaḥ । gurau vā guruputre vā vaseddharmārthakovidaḥ ॥16॥
html:
āyuṣastu caturbhāgaṃ brahmacāryanasūyakaḥ ।
gurau vā guruputre vā vaseddharmārthakovidaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: Ayuzastu caturBAgaM brahmacAryanasUyakaH । gurO vA guruputre vA vasedDarmArTakovidaH ॥16॥

text: karmātirekeṇa guroradhyetavyaṃ bubhūṣatā । dakṣiṇo nāpavādī syādāhūto gurumāśrayet ॥17॥
html:
karmātirekeṇa guroradhyetavyaṃ bubhūṣatā ।
dakṣiṇo nāpavādī syādāhūto gurumāśrayet ॥17॥
slp1: karmAtirekeRa guroraDyetavyaM buBUzatA । dakziRo nApavAdI syAdAhUto gurumASrayet ॥17॥

text: jaghanyaśāyī pūrvaṃ syādutthāyī guruveśmani । yacca śiṣyeṇa kartavyaṃ kāryaṃ dāsena vā punaḥ ॥18॥
html:
jaghanyaśāyī pūrvaṃ syādutthāyī guruveśmani ।
yacca śiṣyeṇa kartavyaṃ kāryaṃ dāsena vā punaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: jaGanyaSAyI pUrvaM syAdutTAyI guruveSmani । yacca SizyeRa kartavyaM kAryaM dAsena vA punaH ॥18॥

text: kṛtamityeva tatsarvaṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭheta pārśvataḥ । kiṅkaraḥ sarvakārī ca sarvakarmasu kovidaḥ ॥19॥
html:
kṛtamityeva tatsarvaṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭheta pārśvataḥ ।
kiṅkaraḥ sarvakārī ca sarvakarmasu kovidaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: kftamityeva tatsarvaM kftvA tizWeta pArSvataH । kiNkaraH sarvakArI ca sarvakarmasu kovidaH ॥19॥

text: śucirdakṣo guṇopeto brūyādiṣurivātvaraḥ । cakṣuṣā gurumavyagro nirīkṣeta jitendriyaḥ ॥20॥
html:
śucirdakṣo guṇopeto brūyādiṣurivātvaraḥ ।
cakṣuṣā gurumavyagro nirīkṣeta jitendriyaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: Sucirdakzo guRopeto brUyAdizurivAtvaraH । cakzuzA gurumavyagro nirIkzeta jitendriyaH ॥20॥

text: nābhuktavati cāśnīyādapītavati no pibet । na tiṣṭhati tathāsīta nāsupte prasvapeta ca ॥21॥
html:
nābhuktavati cāśnīyādapītavati no pibet ।
na tiṣṭhati tathāsīta nāsupte prasvapeta ca ॥21॥
slp1: nABuktavati cASnIyAdapItavati no pibet । na tizWati taTAsIta nAsupte prasvapeta ca ॥21॥

text: uttānābhyāṃ ca pāṇibhyāṃ pādāvasya mṛdu spṛśet । dakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇenaiva savyaṃ savyena pīḍayet ॥22॥
html:
uttānābhyāṃ ca pāṇibhyāṃ pādāvasya mṛdu spṛśet ।
dakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇenaiva savyaṃ savyena pīḍayet ॥22॥
slp1: uttAnAByAM ca pARiByAM pAdAvasya mfdu spfSet । dakziRaM dakziRenEva savyaM savyena pIqayet ॥22॥

text: abhivādya guruṃ brūyādadhīṣva bhagavanniti । idaṃ kariṣye bhagavannidaṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ mayā ॥23॥
html:
abhivādya guruṃ brūyādadhīṣva bhagavanniti ।
idaṃ kariṣye bhagavannidaṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ mayā ॥23॥
slp1: aBivAdya guruM brUyAdaDIzva Bagavanniti । idaM karizye BagavannidaM cApi kftaM mayA ॥23॥

text: iti sarvamanujñāpya nivedya gurave dhanam । kuryātkṛtvā ca tatsarvamākhyeyaṃ gurave punaḥ ॥24॥
html:
iti sarvamanujñāpya nivedya gurave dhanam ।
kuryātkṛtvā ca tatsarvamākhyeyaṃ gurave punaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: iti sarvamanujYApya nivedya gurave Danam । kuryAtkftvA ca tatsarvamAKyeyaM gurave punaH ॥24॥

text: yāṃstu gandhānrasānvāpi brahmacārī na sevate । seveta tānsamāvṛtta iti dharmeṣu niścayaḥ ॥25॥
html:
yāṃstu gandhānrasānvāpi brahmacārī na sevate ।
seveta tānsamāvṛtta iti dharmeṣu niścayaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: yAMstu ganDAnrasAnvApi brahmacArI na sevate । seveta tAnsamAvftta iti Darmezu niScayaH ॥25॥

text: ye kecidvistareṇoktā niyamā brahmacāriṇaḥ । tānsarvānanugṛhṇīyādbhaveccānapago guroḥ ॥26॥
html:
ye kecidvistareṇoktā niyamā brahmacāriṇaḥ ।
tānsarvānanugṛhṇīyādbhaveccānapago guroḥ ॥26॥
slp1: ye kecidvistareRoktA niyamA brahmacAriRaH । tAnsarvAnanugfhRIyAdBaveccAnapago guroH ॥26॥

text: sa evaṃ gurave prītimupahṛtya yathābalam । āśrameṣvāśrameṣvevaṃ śiṣyo varteta karmaṇā ॥27॥
html:
sa evaṃ gurave prītimupahṛtya yathābalam ।
āśrameṣvāśrameṣvevaṃ śiṣyo varteta karmaṇā ॥27॥
slp1: sa evaM gurave prItimupahftya yaTAbalam । ASramezvASramezvevaM Sizyo varteta karmaRA ॥27॥

text: vedavratopavāsena caturthe cāyuṣo gate । gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā samāvartedyathāvidhi ॥28॥
html:
vedavratopavāsena caturthe cāyuṣo gate ।
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā samāvartedyathāvidhi ॥28॥
slp1: vedavratopavAsena caturTe cAyuzo gate । gurave dakziRAM dattvA samAvartedyaTAviDi ॥28॥

text: dharmalabdhairyuto dārairagnīnutpādya dharmataḥ । dvitīyamāyuṣo bhāgaṃ gṛhamedhivratī bhavet] ॥29॥
html:
dharmalabdhairyuto dārairagnīnutpādya dharmataḥ ।
dvitīyamāyuṣo bhāgaṃ gṛhamedhivratī bhavet] ॥29॥
slp1: DarmalabDEryuto dArEragnInutpAdya DarmataH । dvitIyamAyuzo BAgaM gfhameDivratI Bavet] ॥29॥

text: dvitīyamāyuṣo bhāgaṃ gṛhamedhī gṛhe vaset । dharmalabdhairyuto dārairagnīnutpādya suvrataḥ ॥1॥
html:
dvitīyamāyuṣo bhāgaṃ gṛhamedhī gṛhe vaset ।
dharmalabdhairyuto dārairagnīnutpādya suvrataḥ ॥1॥
slp1: dvitIyamAyuzo BAgaM gfhameDI gfhe vaset । DarmalabDEryuto dArEragnInutpAdya suvrataH ॥1॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: gṛhasthavṛttayaścaiva catasraḥ kavibhiḥ smṛtāḥ । kusūladhānyaḥ prathamaḥ kumbhīdhānyastvanantaram ॥2॥
html:
gṛhasthavṛttayaścaiva catasraḥ kavibhiḥ smṛtāḥ ।
kusūladhānyaḥ prathamaḥ kumbhīdhānyastvanantaram ॥2॥
slp1: gfhasTavfttayaScEva catasraH kaviBiH smftAH । kusUlaDAnyaH praTamaH kumBIDAnyastvanantaram ॥2॥

text: aśvastano'tha kāpotīmāśrito vṛttimāharet । teṣāṃ paraḥ paro jyāyāndharmato lokajittamaḥ ॥3॥
html:
aśvastano'tha kāpotīmāśrito vṛttimāharet ।
teṣāṃ paraḥ paro jyāyāndharmato lokajittamaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: aSvastano'Ta kApotImASrito vfttimAharet । tezAM paraH paro jyAyAnDarmato lokajittamaH ॥3॥

text: ṣaṭkarmā vartayatyekastribhiranyaḥ pravartate । dvābhyāmekaścaturthastu brahmasatre vyavasthitaḥ । gṛhamedhivratānyatra mahāntīha pracakṣate ॥4॥
html:
ṣaṭkarmā vartayatyekastribhiranyaḥ pravartate ।
dvābhyāmekaścaturthastu brahmasatre vyavasthitaḥ ।
gṛhamedhivratānyatra mahāntīha pracakṣate ॥4॥
slp1: zawkarmA vartayatyekastriBiranyaH pravartate । dvAByAmekaScaturTastu brahmasatre vyavasTitaH । gfhameDivratAnyatra mahAntIha pracakzate ॥4॥

text: nātmārthaṃ pācayedannaṃ na vṛthā ghātayetpaśūn । prāṇī vā yadi vāprāṇī saṃskāraṃ yajuṣārhati ॥5॥
html:
nātmārthaṃ pācayedannaṃ na vṛthā ghātayetpaśūn ।
prāṇī vā yadi vāprāṇī saṃskāraṃ yajuṣārhati ॥5॥
slp1: nAtmArTaM pAcayedannaM na vfTA GAtayetpaSUn । prARI vA yadi vAprARI saMskAraM yajuzArhati ॥5॥

text: na divā prasvapejjātu na pūrvāpararātrayoḥ । na bhuñjītāntarākāle nānṛtāvāhvayetstriyam ॥6॥
html:
na divā prasvapejjātu na pūrvāpararātrayoḥ ।
na bhuñjītāntarākāle nānṛtāvāhvayetstriyam ॥6॥
slp1: na divA prasvapejjAtu na pUrvApararAtrayoH । na BuYjItAntarAkAle nAnftAvAhvayetstriyam ॥6॥

text: nāsyānaśnanvasedvipro gṛhe kaścidapūjitaḥ । tathāsyātithayaḥ pūjyā havyakavyavahāḥ sadā ॥7॥
html:
nāsyānaśnanvasedvipro gṛhe kaścidapūjitaḥ ।
tathāsyātithayaḥ pūjyā havyakavyavahāḥ sadā ॥7॥
slp1: nAsyAnaSnanvasedvipro gfhe kaScidapUjitaH । taTAsyAtiTayaH pUjyA havyakavyavahAH sadA ॥7॥

text: vedavidyāvratasnātāḥ śrotriyā vedapāragāḥ । svadharmajīvino dāntāḥ kriyāvantastapasvinaḥ । teṣāṃ havyaṃ ca kavyaṃ cāpyarhaṇārthaṃ vidhīyate ॥8॥
html:
vedavidyāvratasnātāḥ śrotriyā vedapāragāḥ ।
svadharmajīvino dāntāḥ kriyāvantastapasvinaḥ ।
teṣāṃ havyaṃ ca kavyaṃ cāpyarhaṇārthaṃ vidhīyate ॥8॥
slp1: vedavidyAvratasnAtAH SrotriyA vedapAragAH । svaDarmajIvino dAntAH kriyAvantastapasvinaH । tezAM havyaM ca kavyaM cApyarhaRArTaM viDIyate ॥8॥

text: na kharaiḥ saṃprayātasya svadharmājñānakasya ca । apaviddhāgnihotrasya gurorvālīkakāriṇaḥ ॥9॥
html:
na kharaiḥ saṃprayātasya svadharmājñānakasya ca ।
apaviddhāgnihotrasya gurorvālīkakāriṇaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: na KarEH saMprayAtasya svaDarmAjYAnakasya ca । apavidDAgnihotrasya gurorvAlIkakAriRaH ॥9॥

text: saṃvibhāgo'tra bhūtānāṃ sarveṣāmeva śiṣyate । tathaivāpacamānebhyaḥ pradeyaṃ gṛhamedhinā ॥10॥
html:
saṃvibhāgo'tra bhūtānāṃ sarveṣāmeva śiṣyate ।
tathaivāpacamānebhyaḥ pradeyaṃ gṛhamedhinā ॥10॥
slp1: saMviBAgo'tra BUtAnAM sarvezAmeva Sizyate । taTEvApacamAneByaH pradeyaM gfhameDinA ॥10॥

text: vighasāśī bhavennityaṃ nityaṃ cāmṛtabhojanaḥ । amṛtaṃ yajñaśeṣaṃ syādbhojanaṃ haviṣā samam । bhṛtyaśeṣaṃ tu yo'śnāti tamāhurvighasāśinam ॥11॥
html:
vighasāśī bhavennityaṃ nityaṃ cāmṛtabhojanaḥ ।
amṛtaṃ yajñaśeṣaṃ syādbhojanaṃ haviṣā samam ।
bhṛtyaśeṣaṃ tu yo'śnāti tamāhurvighasāśinam ॥11॥
slp1: viGasASI BavennityaM nityaM cAmftaBojanaH । amftaM yajYaSezaM syAdBojanaM havizA samam । BftyaSezaM tu yo'SnAti tamAhurviGasASinam ॥11॥

text: svadāranirato dānto hyanasūyurjitendriyaḥ । ṛtvikpurohitācāryairmātulātithisaṃśritaiḥ ॥12॥
html:
svadāranirato dānto hyanasūyurjitendriyaḥ ।
ṛtvikpurohitācāryairmātulātithisaṃśritaiḥ ॥12॥
slp1: svadAranirato dAnto hyanasUyurjitendriyaH । ftvikpurohitAcAryErmAtulAtiTisaMSritEH ॥12॥

text: vṛddhabālāturairvaidyairjñātisaṃbandhibāndhavaiḥ । mātāpitṛbhyāṃ jāmībhirbhrātrā putreṇa bhāryayā ॥13॥
html:
vṛddhabālāturairvaidyairjñātisaṃbandhibāndhavaiḥ ।
mātāpitṛbhyāṃ jāmībhirbhrātrā putreṇa bhāryayā ॥13॥
slp1: vfdDabAlAturErvEdyErjYAtisaMbanDibAnDavEH । mAtApitfByAM jAmIBirBrAtrA putreRa BAryayA ॥13॥

text: duhitrā dāsavargeṇa vivādaṃ na samācaret । etānvimucya saṃvādānsarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ॥14॥
html:
duhitrā dāsavargeṇa vivādaṃ na samācaret ।
etānvimucya saṃvādānsarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ॥14॥
slp1: duhitrA dAsavargeRa vivAdaM na samAcaret । etAnvimucya saMvAdAnsarvapApEH pramucyate ॥14॥

text: etairjitaistu jayati sarvāṁllokānna saṃśayaḥ । ācāryo brahmalokeśaḥ prājāpatye pitā prabhuḥ ॥15॥
html:
etairjitaistu jayati sarvāṁllokānna saṃśayaḥ ।
ācāryo brahmalokeśaḥ prājāpatye pitā prabhuḥ ॥15॥
slp1: etErjitEstu jayati sarvAṁllokAnna saMSayaH । AcAryo brahmalokeSaH prAjApatye pitA praBuH ॥15॥

text: atithistvindralokeśo devalokasya cartvijaḥ । jāmayo'psarasāṃ loke vaiśvadeve tu jñātayaḥ ॥16॥
html:
atithistvindralokeśo devalokasya cartvijaḥ ।
jāmayo'psarasāṃ loke vaiśvadeve tu jñātayaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: atiTistvindralokeSo devalokasya cartvijaH । jAmayo'psarasAM loke vESvadeve tu jYAtayaH ॥16॥

text: saṃbandhibāndhavā dikṣu pṛthivyāṃ mātṛmātulau । vṛddhabālāturakṛśāstvākāśe prabhaviṣṇavaḥ ॥17॥
html:
saṃbandhibāndhavā dikṣu pṛthivyāṃ mātṛmātulau ।
vṛddhabālāturakṛśāstvākāśe prabhaviṣṇavaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: saMbanDibAnDavA dikzu pfTivyAM mAtfmAtulO । vfdDabAlAturakfSAstvAkASe praBavizRavaH ॥17॥

text: bhrātā jyeṣṭhaḥ samaḥ pitrā bhāryā putraḥ svakā tanuḥ । chāyā svā dāśavargastu duhitā kṛpaṇaṃ param ॥18॥
html:
bhrātā jyeṣṭhaḥ samaḥ pitrā bhāryā putraḥ svakā tanuḥ ।
chāyā svā dāśavargastu duhitā kṛpaṇaṃ param ॥18॥
slp1: BrAtA jyezWaH samaH pitrA BAryA putraH svakA tanuH । CAyA svA dASavargastu duhitA kfpaRaM param ॥18॥

text: tasmādetairadhikṣiptaḥ sahennityamasañjvaraḥ । gṛhadharmarato vidvāndharmanityo jitaklamaḥ ॥19॥
html:
tasmādetairadhikṣiptaḥ sahennityamasañjvaraḥ ।
gṛhadharmarato vidvāndharmanityo jitaklamaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: tasmAdetEraDikziptaH sahennityamasaYjvaraH । gfhaDarmarato vidvAnDarmanityo jitaklamaH ॥19॥

text: na cārthabaddhaḥ karmāṇi dharmaṃ vā kañcidācaret । gṛhasthavṛttayastisrastāsāṃ niḥśreyasaṃ param ॥20॥
html:
na cārthabaddhaḥ karmāṇi dharmaṃ vā kañcidācaret ।
gṛhasthavṛttayastisrastāsāṃ niḥśreyasaṃ param ॥20॥
slp1: na cArTabadDaH karmARi DarmaM vA kaYcidAcaret । gfhasTavfttayastisrastAsAM niHSreyasaM param ॥20॥

text: parasparaṃ tathaivāhuścāturāśramyameva tat । ye coktā niyamāsteṣāṃ sarvaṃ kāryaṃ bubhūṣatā ॥21॥
html:
parasparaṃ tathaivāhuścāturāśramyameva tat ।
ye coktā niyamāsteṣāṃ sarvaṃ kāryaṃ bubhūṣatā ॥21॥
slp1: parasparaM taTEvAhuScAturASramyameva tat । ye coktA niyamAstezAM sarvaM kAryaM buBUzatA ॥21॥

text: kumbhīdhānyairuñchaśilaiḥ kāpotīṃ cāsthitaistathā । yasmiṃścaite vasantyarhāstadrāṣṭramabhivardhate ॥22॥
html:
kumbhīdhānyairuñchaśilaiḥ kāpotīṃ cāsthitaistathā ।
yasmiṃścaite vasantyarhāstadrāṣṭramabhivardhate ॥22॥
slp1: kumBIDAnyEruYCaSilEH kApotIM cAsTitEstaTA । yasmiMScEte vasantyarhAstadrAzwramaBivarDate ॥22॥

text: daśa pūrvāndaśa parānpunāti ca pitāmahān । gṛhasthavṛttayastvetā vartayedyo gatavyathaḥ ॥23॥
html:
daśa pūrvāndaśa parānpunāti ca pitāmahān ।
gṛhasthavṛttayastvetā vartayedyo gatavyathaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: daSa pUrvAndaSa parAnpunAti ca pitAmahAn । gfhasTavfttayastvetA vartayedyo gatavyaTaH ॥23॥

text: sa cakracaralokānāṃ sadṛśīṃ prāpnuyādgatim । yatendriyāṇāmatha vā gatireṣā vidhīyate ॥24॥
html:
sa cakracaralokānāṃ sadṛśīṃ prāpnuyādgatim ।
yatendriyāṇāmatha vā gatireṣā vidhīyate ॥24॥
slp1: sa cakracaralokAnAM sadfSIM prApnuyAdgatim । yatendriyARAmaTa vA gatirezA viDIyate ॥24॥

text: svargaloko gṛhasthānāmudāramanasāṃ hitaḥ । svargo vimānasaṃyukto vedadṛṣṭaḥ supuṣpitaḥ ॥25॥
html:
svargaloko gṛhasthānāmudāramanasāṃ hitaḥ ।
svargo vimānasaṃyukto vedadṛṣṭaḥ supuṣpitaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: svargaloko gfhasTAnAmudAramanasAM hitaH । svargo vimAnasaMyukto vedadfzwaH supuzpitaH ॥25॥

text: svargaloke gṛhasthānāṃ pratiṣṭhā niyatātmanām । brahmaṇā vihitā śreṇireṣā yasmātpramucyate । dvitīyaṃ kramaśaḥ prāpya svargaloke mahīyate ॥26॥
html:
svargaloke gṛhasthānāṃ pratiṣṭhā niyatātmanām ।
brahmaṇā vihitā śreṇireṣā yasmātpramucyate ।
dvitīyaṃ kramaśaḥ prāpya svargaloke mahīyate ॥26॥
slp1: svargaloke gfhasTAnAM pratizWA niyatAtmanAm । brahmaRA vihitA SreRirezA yasmAtpramucyate । dvitIyaM kramaSaH prApya svargaloke mahIyate ॥26॥

text: ataḥ paraṃ paramamudāramāśramaṃ tṛtīyamāhustyajatāṃ kalevaram । vanaukasāṃ gṛhapatināmanuttamaṃ śṛṇuṣvaitatkliṣṭaśarīrakāriṇām] ॥27॥
html:
ataḥ paraṃ paramamudāramāśramaṃ tṛtīyamāhustyajatāṃ kalevaram ।
vanaukasāṃ gṛhapatināmanuttamaṃ śṛṇuṣvaitatkliṣṭaśarīrakāriṇām] ॥27॥
slp1: ataH paraM paramamudAramASramaM tftIyamAhustyajatAM kalevaram । vanOkasAM gfhapatinAmanuttamaM SfRuzvEtatklizwaSarIrakAriRAm] ॥27॥

text: proktā gṛhasthavṛttiste vihitā yā manīṣiṇām । tadanantaramuktaṃ yattannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥1॥
html:
proktā gṛhasthavṛttiste vihitā yā manīṣiṇām ।
tadanantaramuktaṃ yattannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥1॥
slp1: proktA gfhasTavfttiste vihitA yA manIziRAm । tadanantaramuktaM yattanniboDa yuDizWira ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kramaśastvavadhūyaināṃ tṛtīyāṃ vṛttimuttamām । saṃyogavratakhinnānāṃ vānaprasthāśramaukasām ॥2॥
html:
kramaśastvavadhūyaināṃ tṛtīyāṃ vṛttimuttamām ।
saṃyogavratakhinnānāṃ vānaprasthāśramaukasām ॥2॥
slp1: kramaSastvavaDUyEnAM tftIyAM vfttimuttamAm । saMyogavrataKinnAnAM vAnaprasTASramOkasAm ॥2॥

text: śrūyatāṃ pārtha bhadraṃ te sarvalokāśrayātmanām । prekṣāpūrvaṃ pravṛttānāṃ puṇyadeśanivāsinām ॥3॥
html:
śrūyatāṃ pārtha bhadraṃ te sarvalokāśrayātmanām ।
prekṣāpūrvaṃ pravṛttānāṃ puṇyadeśanivāsinām ॥3॥
slp1: SrUyatAM pArTa BadraM te sarvalokASrayAtmanAm । prekzApUrvaM pravfttAnAM puRyadeSanivAsinAm ॥3॥

text: gṛhasthastu yadā paśyedvalīpalitamātmanaḥ । apatyasyaiva cāpatyaṃ vanameva tadāśrayet ॥4॥
html:
gṛhasthastu yadā paśyedvalīpalitamātmanaḥ ।
apatyasyaiva cāpatyaṃ vanameva tadāśrayet ॥4॥
slp1: gfhasTastu yadA paSyedvalIpalitamAtmanaH । apatyasyEva cApatyaM vanameva tadASrayet ॥4॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: tṛtīyamāyuṣo bhāgaṃ vānaprasthāśrame vaset । tānevāgnīnparicaredyajamāno divaukasaḥ ॥5॥
html:
tṛtīyamāyuṣo bhāgaṃ vānaprasthāśrame vaset ।

slp1: tftIyamAyuzo BAgaM vAnaprasTASrame vaset । tAnevAgnInparicaredyajamAno divOkasaH ॥5॥

text: niyato niyatāhāraḥ ṣaṣṭhabhakto'pramādavān । tadagnihotraṃ tā gāvo yajñāṅgāni ca sarvaśaḥ ॥6॥

html:
vānaprasthāśrame'pyetāścatasro vṛttayaḥ smṛtāḥ ।

html:

text: vartayanti yathānyāyaṃ vaikhānasamataṃ śritāḥ । etāścānyāśca vividhā dīkṣāsteṣāṃ manīṣiṇām ॥14॥
html:

text: caturthaścaupaniṣado dharmaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ । vānaprastho gṛhasthaśca tato'nyaḥ sampravartate ॥15॥

slp1: caturTaScOpanizado DarmaH sADAraRaH smftaH । vAnaprasTo gfhasTaSca tato'nyaH sampravartate ॥15॥

text: asminneva yuge tāta vipraiḥ sarvārthadarśibhiḥ । agastyaḥ sapta ṛṣayo madhucchando'ghamarṣaṇaḥ ॥16॥
html:

text: sāṅkṛtiḥ sudivā taṇḍiryavānno'tha kṛtaśramaḥ । ahovīryastathā kāvyastāṇḍyo medhātithirbudhaḥ ॥17॥
html:

ahovīryastathā kāvyastāṇḍyo medhātithirbudhaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: sANkftiH sudivA taRqiryavAnno'Ta kftaSramaH । ahovIryastaTA kAvyastARqyo meDAtiTirbuDaH ॥17॥

text: śalo vākaśca nirvākaḥ śūnyapālaḥ kṛtaśramaḥ । evandharmasu vidvāṃsastataḥ svargamupāgaman ॥18॥
html:
śalo vākaśca nirvākaḥ śūnyapālaḥ kṛtaśramaḥ ।
evandharmasu vidvāṃsastataḥ svargamupāgaman ॥18॥
slp1: Salo vAkaSca nirvAkaH SUnyapAlaH kftaSramaH । evanDarmasu vidvAMsastataH svargamupAgaman ॥18॥

text: tāta pratyakṣadharmāṇastathā yāyāvarā gaṇāḥ । ṛṣīṇāmugratapasāṃ dharmanaipuṇadarśinām ॥19॥
html:
tāta pratyakṣadharmāṇastathā yāyāvarā gaṇāḥ ।
ṛṣīṇāmugratapasāṃ dharmanaipuṇadarśinām ॥19॥
slp1: tAta pratyakzaDarmARastaTA yAyAvarA gaRAH । fzIRAmugratapasAM DarmanEpuRadarSinAm ॥19॥

text: avācyāparimeyāśca brāhmaṇā vanamāśritāḥ । vaikhānasā vālakhilyāḥ sikatāśca tathāpare ॥20॥
html:
avācyāparimeyāśca brāhmaṇā vanamāśritāḥ ।
vaikhānasā vālakhilyāḥ sikatāśca tathāpare ॥20॥
slp1: avAcyAparimeyASca brAhmaRA vanamASritAH । vEKAnasA vAlaKilyAH sikatASca taTApare ॥20॥

text: karmabhiste nirānandā dharmanityā jitendriyāḥ । gatāḥ pratyakṣadharmāṇaste sarve vanamāśritāḥ । anakṣatrā anādhṛṣyā dṛśyante jyotiṣāṃ gaṇāḥ ॥21॥
html:

anakṣatrā anādhṛṣyā dṛśyante jyotiṣāṃ gaṇāḥ ॥21॥
slp1: karmaBiste nirAnandA DarmanityA jitendriyAH । gatAH pratyakzaDarmARaste sarve vanamASritAH । anakzatrA anADfzyA dfSyante jyotizAM gaRAH ॥21॥

text: jarayā ca paridyūno vyādhinā ca prapīḍitaḥ । caturthe cāyuṣaḥ śeṣe vānaprasthāśramaṃ tyajet । sadyaskārāṃ nirūpyeṣṭiṃ sarvavedasadakṣiṇām ॥22॥
html:
jarayā ca paridyūno vyādhinā ca prapīḍitaḥ ।
caturthe cāyuṣaḥ śeṣe vānaprasthāśramaṃ tyajet ।
sadyaskārāṃ nirūpyeṣṭiṃ sarvavedasadakṣiṇām ॥22॥
slp1: jarayA ca paridyUno vyADinA ca prapIqitaH । caturTe cAyuzaH Seze vAnaprasTASramaM tyajet । sadyaskArAM nirUpyezwiM sarvavedasadakziRAm ॥22॥

text: ātmayājī so''tmaratirātmakrīḍātmasaṃśrayaḥ । ātmanyagnīnsamāropya tyaktvā sarvaparigrahān ॥23॥

html:
sadyaskrāṃśca yajedyajñāniṣṭīścaiveha sarvadā ।

slp1: keSalomanaKAnvApya vAnaprasTo munistataH । ASramAdASramaM sadyaH pUto gacCati karmaBiH ॥26॥

text: vartamānastathaivātra vānaprasthāśrame yathā । yoktavyo''tmā yathā śaktyā paraṃ vai kāṅkṣatā padam ॥1॥

text: prāpya saṃskārametābhyāmāśramābhyāṃ tataḥ param । yatkāryaṃ paramārthārthaṃ tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ॥2॥

yatkāryaṃ paramārthārthaṃ tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ॥2॥
slp1: prApya saMskArametAByAmASramAByAM tataH param । yatkAryaM paramArTArTaM tadihEkamanAH SfRu ॥2॥

text: kaṣāyaṃ pācayitvā tu śreṇisthāneṣu ca triṣu । pravrajecca paraṃ sthānaṃ parivrajyāmanuttamām ॥3॥
html:
kaṣāyaṃ pācayitvā tu śreṇisthāneṣu ca triṣu ।
pravrajecca paraṃ sthānaṃ parivrajyāmanuttamām ॥3॥
slp1: kazAyaM pAcayitvA tu SreRisTAnezu ca trizu । pravrajecca paraM sTAnaM parivrajyAmanuttamAm ॥3॥

text: tadbhavānevamabhyasya vartatāṃ śrūyatāṃ tathā । eka eva carennityaṃ siddhyarthamasahāyavān ॥4॥

tadbhavānevamabhyasya vartatāṃ śrūyatāṃ tathā ।
eka eva carennityaṃ siddhyarthamasahāyavān ॥4॥
slp1: tadBavAnevamaByasya vartatAM SrUyatAM taTA । eka eva carennityaM sidDyarTamasahAyavAn ॥4॥

text: ekaścarati yaḥ paśyanna jahāti na hīyate । anagniraniketaḥ syādgrāmamannārthamāśrayet ॥5॥

ekaścarati yaḥ paśyanna jahāti na hīyate ।
anagniraniketaḥ syādgrāmamannārthamāśrayet ॥5॥
slp1: ekaScarati yaH paSyanna jahAti na hIyate । anagniraniketaH syAdgrAmamannArTamASrayet ॥5॥

text: aśvastanavidhānaḥ syānmunirbhāvasamanvitaḥ । laghvāśī niyatāhāraḥ sakṛdannaniṣevitā ॥6॥

aśvastanavidhānaḥ syānmunirbhāvasamanvitaḥ ।

slp1: aSvastanaviDAnaH syAnmunirBAvasamanvitaH । laGvASI niyatAhAraH sakfdannanizevitA ॥6॥

text: kapālaṃ vṛkṣamūlāni kucelamasahāyatā । upekṣā sarvabhūtānāmetāvadbhikṣulakṣaṇam ॥7॥
html:
kapālaṃ vṛkṣamūlāni kucelamasahāyatā ।
upekṣā sarvabhūtānāmetāvadbhikṣulakṣaṇam ॥7॥
slp1: kapAlaM vfkzamUlAni kucelamasahAyatA । upekzA sarvaBUtAnAmetAvadBikzulakzaRam ॥7॥

text: yasminvācaḥ praviśanti kūpe prāptāḥ śilā iva । na vaktāraṃ punaryānti sa kaivalyāśrame vaset ॥8॥

yasminvācaḥ praviśanti kūpe prāptāḥ śilā iva ।
na vaktāraṃ punaryānti sa kaivalyāśrame vaset ॥8॥

text: naiva paśyenna śṛṇuyādavācyaṃ jātu kasyacit । brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣeṇa naiva brūyātkathañcana ॥9॥
html:
naiva paśyenna śṛṇuyādavācyaṃ jātu kasyacit ।

text: yadbrāhmaṇasya kuśalaṃ tadeva satataṃ vadet । tūṣṇīmāsīta nindāyāṃ kurvanbheṣajamātmanaḥ ॥10॥

slp1: yadbrAhmaRasya kuSalaM tadeva satataM vadet । tUzRImAsIta nindAyAM kurvanBezajamAtmanaH ॥10॥

text: yena pūrṇamivākāśaṃ bhavatyekena sarvadā । śūnyaṃ yena janākīrṇaṃ taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ ॥11॥
html:
yena pūrṇamivākāśaṃ bhavatyekena sarvadā ।

slp1: yena pUrRamivAkASaM Bavatyekena sarvadA । SUnyaM yena janAkIrRaM taM devA brAhmaRaM viduH ॥11॥

slp1: yena kenacidAcCanno yena kenacidASitaH । yatrakvacanaSAyI ca taM devA brAhmaRaM viduH ॥12॥

text: nābhinandeta maraṇaṃ nābhinandeta jīvitam । kālameva pratīkṣeta nideśaṃ bhṛtako yathā ॥15॥

nābhinandeta maraṇaṃ nābhinandeta jīvitam ।
kālameva pratīkṣeta nideśaṃ bhṛtako yathā ॥15॥
slp1: nABinandeta maraRaM nABinandeta jIvitam । kAlameva pratIkzeta nideSaM Bftako yaTA ॥15॥

text: anabhyāhatacittaḥ syādanabhyāhatavāktathā । nirmuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo niramitrasya kiṃ bhayam ॥16॥
html:
anabhyāhatacittaḥ syādanabhyāhatavāktathā ।
nirmuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo niramitrasya kiṃ bhayam ॥16॥
slp1: anaByAhatacittaH syAdanaByAhatavAktaTA । nirmuktaH sarvapApeByo niramitrasya kiM Bayam ॥16॥

text: abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo bhūtānāmabhayaṃ yataḥ । tasya dehādvimuktasya bhayaṃ nāsti kutaścana ॥17॥
html:
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo bhūtānāmabhayaṃ yataḥ ।
tasya dehādvimuktasya bhayaṃ nāsti kutaścana ॥17॥
slp1: aBayaM sarvaBUteByo BUtAnAmaBayaM yataH । tasya dehAdvimuktasya BayaM nAsti kutaScana ॥17॥

text: yathā nāgapade'nyāni padāni padagāminām । sarvāṇyevāpidhīyante padajātāni kauñjare ॥18॥
html:
yathā nāgapade'nyāni padāni padagāminām ।
sarvāṇyevāpidhīyante padajātāni kauñjare ॥18॥
slp1: yaTA nAgapade'nyAni padAni padagAminAm । sarvARyevApiDIyante padajAtAni kOYjare ॥18॥

text: evaṃ sarvamahiṃsāyāṃ dharmārthamapidhīyate । amṛtaḥ sa nityaṃ vasati yo'hiṃsāṃ pratipadyate ॥19॥
html:
evaṃ sarvamahiṃsāyāṃ dharmārthamapidhīyate ।
amṛtaḥ sa nityaṃ vasati yo'hiṃsāṃ pratipadyate ॥19॥
slp1: evaM sarvamahiMsAyAM DarmArTamapiDIyate । amftaH sa nityaM vasati yo'hiMsAM pratipadyate ॥19॥

text: ahiṃsakaḥ samaḥ satyo dhṛtimānniyatendriyaḥ । śaraṇyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ gatimāpnotyanuttamām ॥20॥
html:
ahiṃsakaḥ samaḥ satyo dhṛtimānniyatendriyaḥ ।
śaraṇyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ gatimāpnotyanuttamām ॥20॥
slp1: ahiMsakaH samaH satyo DftimAnniyatendriyaH । SaraRyaH sarvaBUtAnAM gatimApnotyanuttamAm ॥20॥

text: evaṃ prajñānatṛptasya nirbhayasya manīṣiṇaḥ । na mṛtyuratigo bhāvaḥ sa mṛtyumadhigacchati ॥21॥
html:
evaṃ prajñānatṛptasya nirbhayasya manīṣiṇaḥ ।
na mṛtyuratigo bhāvaḥ sa mṛtyumadhigacchati ॥21॥
slp1: evaM prajYAnatfptasya nirBayasya manIziRaH । na mftyuratigo BAvaH sa mftyumaDigacCati ॥21॥

text: vimuktaṃ sarvasaṅgebhyo munimākāśavatsthitam । asvamekacaraṃ śāntaṃ taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ ॥22॥
html:
vimuktaṃ sarvasaṅgebhyo munimākāśavatsthitam ।
asvamekacaraṃ śāntaṃ taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ ॥22॥
slp1: vimuktaM sarvasaNgeByo munimAkASavatsTitam । asvamekacaraM SAntaM taM devA brAhmaRaM viduH ॥22॥

text: jīvitaṃ yasya dharmārthaṃ dharmo'ratyarthameva ca । ahorātrāśca puṇyārthaṃ taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ ॥23॥
html:
jīvitaṃ yasya dharmārthaṃ dharmo'ratyarthameva ca ।
ahorātrāśca puṇyārthaṃ taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ ॥23॥
slp1: jIvitaM yasya DarmArTaM Darmo'ratyarTameva ca । ahorAtrASca puRyArTaM taM devA brAhmaRaM viduH ॥23॥

text: nirāśiṣamanārambhaṃ nirnamaskāramastutim । akṣīṇaṃ kṣīṇakarmāṇaṃ taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ ॥24॥
html:
nirāśiṣamanārambhaṃ nirnamaskāramastutim ।
akṣīṇaṃ kṣīṇakarmāṇaṃ taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ ॥24॥
slp1: nirASizamanAramBaM nirnamaskAramastutim । akzIRaM kzIRakarmARaM taM devA brAhmaRaM viduH ॥24॥

text: sarvāṇi bhūtāni sukhe ramante sarvāṇi duḥkhasya bhṛśaṃ trasanti । teṣāṃ bhayotpādanajātakhedaḥ kuryānna karmāṇi hi śraddadhānaḥ ॥25॥
html:
sarvāṇi bhūtāni sukhe ramante sarvāṇi duḥkhasya bhṛśaṃ trasanti ।
teṣāṃ bhayotpādanajātakhedaḥ kuryānna karmāṇi hi śraddadhānaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: sarvARi BUtAni suKe ramante sarvARi duHKasya BfSaM trasanti । tezAM BayotpAdanajAtaKedaH kuryAnna karmARi hi SraddaDAnaH ॥25॥

text: dānaṃ hi bhūtābhayadakṣiṇāyāḥ sarvāṇi dānānyadhitiṣṭhatīha । tīkṣṇāṃ tanuṃ yaḥ prathamaṃ jahāti so'nantamāpnotyabhayaṃ prajābhyaḥ ॥26॥
html:
dānaṃ hi bhūtābhayadakṣiṇāyāḥ sarvāṇi dānānyadhitiṣṭhatīha ।
tīkṣṇāṃ tanuṃ yaḥ prathamaṃ jahāti so'nantamāpnotyabhayaṃ prajābhyaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: dAnaM hi BUtABayadakziRAyAH sarvARi dAnAnyaDitizWatIha । tIkzRAM tanuM yaH praTamaM jahAti so'nantamApnotyaBayaM prajAByaH ॥26॥

text: uttāna āsyena havirjuhoti lokasya nābhirjagataḥ pratiṣṭhā । tasyāṅgamaṅgāni kṛtākṛtaṃ ca vaiśvānaraḥ sarvameva prapede ॥27॥
html:
uttāna āsyena havirjuhoti lokasya nābhirjagataḥ pratiṣṭhā ।
tasyāṅgamaṅgāni kṛtākṛtaṃ ca vaiśvānaraḥ sarvameva prapede ॥27॥
slp1: uttAna Asyena havirjuhoti lokasya nABirjagataH pratizWA । tasyANgamaNgAni kftAkftaM ca vESvAnaraH sarvameva prapede ॥27॥

text: prādeśamātre hṛdi niśritaṃ yattasminprāṇānātmayājī juhoti । tasyāgnihotraṃ hutamātmasaṃsthaṃ sarveṣu lokeṣu sadaivateṣu ॥28॥
html:
prādeśamātre hṛdi niśritaṃ yattasminprāṇānātmayājī juhoti ।
tasyāgnihotraṃ hutamātmasaṃsthaṃ sarveṣu lokeṣu sadaivateṣu ॥28॥
slp1: prAdeSamAtre hfdi niSritaM yattasminprARAnAtmayAjI juhoti । tasyAgnihotraM hutamAtmasaMsTaM sarvezu lokezu sadEvatezu ॥28॥

text: daivaṃ tridhātuṃ trivṛtaṃ suparṇaṃ ye vidyuragryaṃ paramārthatāṃ ca । te sarvalokeṣu mahīyamānā devāḥ samarthāḥ sukṛtaṃ vrajanti ॥29॥
html:
daivaṃ tridhātuṃ trivṛtaṃ suparṇaṃ ye vidyuragryaṃ paramārthatāṃ ca ।
te sarvalokeṣu mahīyamānā devāḥ samarthāḥ sukṛtaṃ vrajanti ॥29॥
slp1: dEvaM triDAtuM trivftaM suparRaM ye vidyuragryaM paramArTatAM ca । te sarvalokezu mahIyamAnA devAH samarTAH sukftaM vrajanti ॥29॥

text: vedāṃśca vedyaṃ ca vidhiṃ ca kṛtsnamatho niruktaṃ paramārthatāṃ ca । sarvaṃ śarīrātmani yaḥ praveda tasmai sma devāḥ spṛhayanti nityam ॥30॥
html:
vedāṃśca vedyaṃ ca vidhiṃ ca kṛtsnamatho niruktaṃ paramārthatāṃ ca ।
sarvaṃ śarīrātmani yaḥ praveda tasmai sma devāḥ spṛhayanti nityam ॥30॥
slp1: vedAMSca vedyaM ca viDiM ca kftsnamaTo niruktaM paramArTatAM ca । sarvaM SarIrAtmani yaH praveda tasmE sma devAH spfhayanti nityam ॥30॥

text: bhūmāvasaktaṃ divi cāprameyaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ yo'ṇḍajamaṇḍamadhye । patatriṇaṃ pakṣiṇamantarikṣe yo veda bhogyātmani dīptaraśmiḥ ॥31॥
html:
bhūmāvasaktaṃ divi cāprameyaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ yo'ṇḍajamaṇḍamadhye ।
patatriṇaṃ pakṣiṇamantarikṣe yo veda bhogyātmani dīptaraśmiḥ ॥31॥
slp1: BUmAvasaktaM divi cAprameyaM hiraRmayaM yo'RqajamaRqamaDye । patatriRaM pakziRamantarikze yo veda BogyAtmani dIptaraSmiH ॥31॥

text: āvartamānamajaraṃ vivartanaṃ ṣaṇṇemikaṃ dvādaśāraṃ suparva । yasyedamāsye pariyāti viśvaṃ tatkālacakraṃ nihitaṃ guhāyām ॥32॥
html:
āvartamānamajaraṃ vivartanaṃ ṣaṇṇemikaṃ dvādaśāraṃ suparva ।
yasyedamāsye pariyāti viśvaṃ tatkālacakraṃ nihitaṃ guhāyām ॥32॥
slp1: AvartamAnamajaraM vivartanaM zaRRemikaM dvAdaSAraM suparva । yasyedamAsye pariyAti viSvaM tatkAlacakraM nihitaM guhAyAm ॥32॥

text: yaḥ samprasādaṃ jagataḥ śarīraṃ sarvānsa lokānadhigacchatīha । tasminhutaṃ tarpayatīha devāṃste vai tṛptāstarpayantyāsyamasya ॥33॥
html:
yaḥ samprasādaṃ jagataḥ śarīraṃ sarvānsa lokānadhigacchatīha ।
tasminhutaṃ tarpayatīha devāṃste vai tṛptāstarpayantyāsyamasya ॥33॥
slp1: yaH samprasAdaM jagataH SarIraM sarvAnsa lokAnaDigacCatIha । tasminhutaM tarpayatIha devAMste vE tfptAstarpayantyAsyamasya ॥33॥

text: tejomayo nityatanuḥ purāṇo lokānanantānabhayānupaiti । bhūtāni yasmānna trasante kadācitsa bhūtebhyo na trasate kadācit ॥34॥
html:
tejomayo nityatanuḥ purāṇo lokānanantānabhayānupaiti ।
bhūtāni yasmānna trasante kadācitsa bhūtebhyo na trasate kadācit ॥34॥
slp1: tejomayo nityatanuH purARo lokAnanantAnaBayAnupEti । BUtAni yasmAnna trasante kadAcitsa BUteByo na trasate kadAcit ॥34॥

text: agarhaṇīyo na ca garhate'nyānsa vai vipraḥ paramātmānamīkṣet । vinītamoho vyapanītakalmaṣo na ceha nāmutra ca yo'rthamṛcchati ॥35॥
html:
agarhaṇīyo na ca garhate'nyānsa vai vipraḥ paramātmānamīkṣet ।
vinītamoho vyapanītakalmaṣo na ceha nāmutra ca yo'rthamṛcchati ॥35॥
slp1: agarhaRIyo na ca garhate'nyAnsa vE vipraH paramAtmAnamIkzet । vinItamoho vyapanItakalmazo na ceha nAmutra ca yo'rTamfcCati ॥35॥

text: aroṣamohaḥ samaloṣṭakāñcanaḥ prahīṇaśoko gatasandhivigrahaḥ । apetanindāstutirapriyāpriyaścarannudāsīnavadeṣa bhikṣukaḥ] ॥36॥
html:
aroṣamohaḥ samaloṣṭakāñcanaḥ prahīṇaśoko gatasandhivigrahaḥ ।
apetanindāstutirapriyāpriyaścarannudāsīnavadeṣa bhikṣukaḥ] ॥36॥
slp1: arozamohaH samalozwakAYcanaH prahIRaSoko gatasanDivigrahaH । apetanindAstutirapriyApriyaScarannudAsInavadeza BikzukaH] ॥36॥

text: prakṛtestu vikārā ye kṣetrajñastaiḥ pariśritaḥ । te cainaṃ na prajānanti sa tu jānāti tānapi ॥1॥
html:
prakṛtestu vikārā ye kṣetrajñastaiḥ pariśritaḥ ।
te cainaṃ na prajānanti sa tu jānāti tānapi ॥1॥
slp1: prakftestu vikArA ye kzetrajYastEH pariSritaH । te cEnaM na prajAnanti sa tu jAnAti tAnapi ॥1॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: taiścaiṣa kurute kāryaṃ manaḥṣaṣṭhairihendriyaiḥ । sudāntairiva saṃyantā dṛḍhaiḥ paramavājibhiḥ ॥2॥
html:
taiścaiṣa kurute kāryaṃ manaḥṣaṣṭhairihendriyaiḥ ।
sudāntairiva saṃyantā dṛḍhaiḥ paramavājibhiḥ ॥2॥
slp1: tEScEza kurute kAryaM manaHzazWErihendriyEH । sudAntEriva saMyantA dfQEH paramavAjiBiH ॥2॥

text: indriyebhyaḥ parā hyarthā arthebhyaḥ paramaṃ manaḥ । manasastu parā buddhirbuddherātmā mahānparaḥ ॥3॥
html:
indriyebhyaḥ parā hyarthā arthebhyaḥ paramaṃ manaḥ ।
manasastu parā buddhirbuddherātmā mahānparaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: indriyeByaH parA hyarTA arTeByaH paramaM manaH । manasastu parA budDirbudDerAtmA mahAnparaH ॥3॥

text: mahataḥ paramavyaktamavyaktātparato'mṛtam । amṛtānna paraṃ kiñcitsā kāṣṭhā sā parā gatiḥ ॥4॥
html:
mahataḥ paramavyaktamavyaktātparato'mṛtam ।
amṛtānna paraṃ kiñcitsā kāṣṭhā sā parā gatiḥ ॥4॥
slp1: mahataH paramavyaktamavyaktAtparato'mftam । amftAnna paraM kiYcitsA kAzWA sA parA gatiH ॥4॥

text: evaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu gūḍho''tmā na prakāśate । dṛśyate tvagryayā buddhyā sūkṣmayā tattvadarśibhiḥ ॥5॥
html:
evaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu gūḍho''tmā na prakāśate ।
dṛśyate tvagryayā buddhyā sūkṣmayā tattvadarśibhiḥ ॥5॥
slp1: evaM sarvezu BUtezu gUQo''tmA na prakASate । dfSyate tvagryayA budDyA sUkzmayA tattvadarSiBiH ॥5॥

text: antarātmani saṃlīya manaḥṣaṣṭhāni medhayā । indriyāṇīndriyārthāṃśca bahu cintyamacintayan ॥6॥
html:
antarātmani saṃlīya manaḥṣaṣṭhāni medhayā ।
indriyāṇīndriyārthāṃśca bahu cintyamacintayan ॥6॥
slp1: antarAtmani saMlIya manaHzazWAni meDayA । indriyARIndriyArTAMSca bahu cintyamacintayan ॥6॥

text: dhyānoparamaṇaṃ kṛtvā vidyāsampāditaṃ manaḥ । anīśvaraḥ praśāntātma tato'rchatyamṛtaṃ padam ॥7॥
html:
dhyānoparamaṇaṃ kṛtvā vidyāsampāditaṃ manaḥ ।
anīśvaraḥ praśāntātma tato'rchatyamṛtaṃ padam ॥7॥
slp1: DyAnoparamaRaM kftvA vidyAsampAditaM manaH । anISvaraH praSAntAtma tato'rCatyamftaM padam ॥7॥

text: indriyāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ vaśyātmā calitasmṛtiḥ । ātmanaḥ sampradānena martyo mṛtyumupāśnute ॥8॥
html:
indriyāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ vaśyātmā calitasmṛtiḥ ।
ātmanaḥ sampradānena martyo mṛtyumupāśnute ॥8॥
slp1: indriyARAM tu sarvezAM vaSyAtmA calitasmftiH । AtmanaH sampradAnena martyo mftyumupASnute ॥8॥

text: hitvā tu sarvasaṅkalpānsattve cittaṃ niveśayet । sattve cittaṃ samāveśya tataḥ kālañjaro bhavet ॥9॥
html:
hitvā tu sarvasaṅkalpānsattve cittaṃ niveśayet ।
sattve cittaṃ samāveśya tataḥ kālañjaro bhavet ॥9॥
slp1: hitvA tu sarvasaNkalpAnsattve cittaM niveSayet । sattve cittaM samAveSya tataH kAlaYjaro Bavet ॥9॥

text: cittaprasādena yatirjahāti hi śubhāśubham । prasannātmātmani sthitvā sukhamānantyamaśnute ॥10॥
html:
cittaprasādena yatirjahāti hi śubhāśubham ।
prasannātmātmani sthitvā sukhamānantyamaśnute ॥10॥
slp1: cittaprasAdena yatirjahAti hi SuBASuBam । prasannAtmAtmani sTitvA suKamAnantyamaSnute ॥10॥

text: lakṣaṇaṃ tu prasādasya yathā tṛptaḥ sukhaṃ svapet । nivāte vā yathā dīpo dīpyamāno na kampate ॥11॥
html:
lakṣaṇaṃ tu prasādasya yathā tṛptaḥ sukhaṃ svapet ।
nivāte vā yathā dīpo dīpyamāno na kampate ॥11॥
slp1: lakzaRaM tu prasAdasya yaTA tfptaH suKaM svapet । nivAte vA yaTA dIpo dIpyamAno na kampate ॥11॥

text: evaṃ pūrvāpare rātre yuñjannātmānamātmanā । sattvāhāraviśuddhātmā paśyatyātmānamātmani ॥12॥
html:
evaṃ pūrvāpare rātre yuñjannātmānamātmanā ।
sattvāhāraviśuddhātmā paśyatyātmānamātmani ॥12॥
slp1: evaM pUrvApare rAtre yuYjannAtmAnamAtmanA । sattvAhAraviSudDAtmA paSyatyAtmAnamAtmani ॥12॥

text: rahasyaṃ sarvavedānāmanaitihyamanāgamam । ātmapratyayikaṃ śāstramidaṃ putrānuśāsanam ॥13॥
html:
rahasyaṃ sarvavedānāmanaitihyamanāgamam ।
ātmapratyayikaṃ śāstramidaṃ putrānuśāsanam ॥13॥
slp1: rahasyaM sarvavedAnAmanEtihyamanAgamam । AtmapratyayikaM SAstramidaM putrAnuSAsanam ॥13॥

text: dharmākhyāneṣu sarveṣu satyākhyāneṣu yadvasu । daśedamṛksahasrāṇi nirmathyāmṛtamuddhṛtam ॥14॥
html:
dharmākhyāneṣu sarveṣu satyākhyāneṣu yadvasu ।
daśedamṛksahasrāṇi nirmathyāmṛtamuddhṛtam ॥14॥
slp1: DarmAKyAnezu sarvezu satyAKyAnezu yadvasu । daSedamfksahasrARi nirmaTyAmftamudDftam ॥14॥

text: navanītaṃ yathā dadhnaḥ kāṣṭhādagniryathaiva ca । tathaiva viduṣāṃ jñānaṃ putrahetoḥ samuddhṛtam । snātakānāmidaṃ śāstraṃ vācyaṃ putrānuśāsanam ॥15॥
html:
navanītaṃ yathā dadhnaḥ kāṣṭhādagniryathaiva ca ।
tathaiva viduṣāṃ jñānaṃ putrahetoḥ samuddhṛtam ।
snātakānāmidaṃ śāstraṃ vācyaṃ putrānuśāsanam ॥15॥
slp1: navanItaM yaTA daDnaH kAzWAdagniryaTEva ca । taTEva viduzAM jYAnaM putrahetoH samudDftam । snAtakAnAmidaM SAstraM vAcyaM putrAnuSAsanam ॥15॥

text: tadidaṃ nāpraśāntāya nādāntāyātapasvine । nāvedaviduṣe vācyaṃ tathā nānugatāya ca ॥16॥
html:
tadidaṃ nāpraśāntāya nādāntāyātapasvine ।
nāvedaviduṣe vācyaṃ tathā nānugatāya ca ॥16॥
slp1: tadidaM nApraSAntAya nAdAntAyAtapasvine । nAvedaviduze vAcyaM taTA nAnugatAya ca ॥16॥

text: nāsūyakāyānṛjave na cānirdiṣṭakāriṇe । na tarkaśāstradagdhāya tathaiva piśunāya ca ॥17॥
html:
nāsūyakāyānṛjave na cānirdiṣṭakāriṇe ।
na tarkaśāstradagdhāya tathaiva piśunāya ca ॥17॥
slp1: nAsUyakAyAnfjave na cAnirdizwakAriRe । na tarkaSAstradagDAya taTEva piSunAya ca ॥17॥

text: ślāghate ślāghanīyāya praśāntāya tapasvine । idaṃ priyāya putrāya śiṣyāyānugatāya ca । rahasyadharmaṃ vaktavyaṃ nānyasmai tu kathañcana ॥18॥
html:
ślāghate ślāghanīyāya praśāntāya tapasvine ।
idaṃ priyāya putrāya śiṣyāyānugatāya ca ।
rahasyadharmaṃ vaktavyaṃ nānyasmai tu kathañcana ॥18॥
slp1: SlAGate SlAGanIyAya praSAntAya tapasvine । idaM priyAya putrAya SizyAyAnugatAya ca । rahasyaDarmaM vaktavyaM nAnyasmE tu kaTaYcana ॥18॥

text: yadyapyasya mahīṃ dadyādratnapūrṇāmimāṃ naraḥ । idameva tataḥ śreya iti manyeta tattvavit ॥19॥
html:
yadyapyasya mahīṃ dadyādratnapūrṇāmimāṃ naraḥ ।
idameva tataḥ śreya iti manyeta tattvavit ॥19॥
slp1: yadyapyasya mahIM dadyAdratnapUrRAmimAM naraH । idameva tataH Sreya iti manyeta tattvavit ॥19॥

text: ato guhyatarārthaṃ tadadhyātmamatimānuṣam । yattanmaharṣibhirdṛṣṭaṃ vedānteṣu ca gīyate । tatte'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi] ॥20॥
html:
ato guhyatarārthaṃ tadadhyātmamatimānuṣam ।
yattanmaharṣibhirdṛṣṭaṃ vedānteṣu ca gīyate ।
tatte'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi] ॥20॥
slp1: ato guhyatarArTaM tadaDyAtmamatimAnuzam । yattanmaharziBirdfzwaM vedAntezu ca gIyate । tatte'haM sampravakzyAmi yanmAM tvaM paripfcCasi] ॥20॥

text: adhyātmaṃ vistareṇeha punareva vadasva me । yadadhyātmaṃ yathā cedaṃ bhagavannṛṣisattama ॥1॥
html:
adhyātmaṃ vistareṇeha punareva vadasva me ।
yadadhyātmaṃ yathā cedaṃ bhagavannṛṣisattama ॥1॥
slp1: aDyAtmaM vistareReha punareva vadasva me । yadaDyAtmaM yaTA cedaM Bagavannfzisattama ॥1॥
author: śuka uvāca ।

text: adhyātmaṃ yadidaṃ tāta puruṣasyeha vidyate । tatte'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi tasya vyākhyāmimāṃ śṛṇu ॥2॥
html:
adhyātmaṃ yadidaṃ tāta puruṣasyeha vidyate ।
tatte'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi tasya vyākhyāmimāṃ śṛṇu ॥2॥
slp1: aDyAtmaM yadidaM tAta puruzasyeha vidyate । tatte'haM sampravakzyAmi tasya vyAKyAmimAM SfRu ॥2॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: bhūmirāpastathā jyotirvāyurākāśameva ca । mahābhūtāni bhūtānāṃ sāgarasyormayo yathā ॥3॥
html:
bhūmirāpastathā jyotirvāyurākāśameva ca ।
mahābhūtāni bhūtānāṃ sāgarasyormayo yathā ॥3॥
slp1: BUmirApastaTA jyotirvAyurAkASameva ca । mahABUtAni BUtAnAM sAgarasyormayo yaTA ॥3॥

text: prasāryeha yathāṅgāni kūrmaḥ saṃharate punaḥ । tadvanmahānti bhūtāni yavīyaḥsu vikurvate ॥4॥
html:
prasāryeha yathāṅgāni kūrmaḥ saṃharate punaḥ ।
tadvanmahānti bhūtāni yavīyaḥsu vikurvate ॥4॥
slp1: prasAryeha yaTANgAni kUrmaH saMharate punaH । tadvanmahAnti BUtAni yavIyaHsu vikurvate ॥4॥

text: iti tanmayamevedaṃ sarvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam । sarge ca pralaye caiva tasmānnirdiśyate tathā ॥5॥
html:
iti tanmayamevedaṃ sarvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam ।
sarge ca pralaye caiva tasmānnirdiśyate tathā ॥5॥
slp1: iti tanmayamevedaM sarvaM sTAvarajaNgamam । sarge ca pralaye cEva tasmAnnirdiSyate taTA ॥5॥

text: mahābhūtāni pañcaiva sarvabhūteṣu bhūtakṛt । akarottāta vaiṣamyaṃ yasminyadanupaśyati ॥6॥
html:
mahābhūtāni pañcaiva sarvabhūteṣu bhūtakṛt ।
akarottāta vaiṣamyaṃ yasminyadanupaśyati ॥6॥
slp1: mahABUtAni paYcEva sarvaBUtezu BUtakft । akarottAta vEzamyaM yasminyadanupaSyati ॥6॥

text: akarodyaccharīreṣu kathaṃ tadupalakṣayet । indriyāṇi guṇāḥ kecitkathaṃ tānupalakṣayet ॥7॥
html:
akarodyaccharīreṣu kathaṃ tadupalakṣayet ।
indriyāṇi guṇāḥ kecitkathaṃ tānupalakṣayet ॥7॥
slp1: akarodyacCarIrezu kaTaM tadupalakzayet । indriyARi guRAH kecitkaTaM tAnupalakzayet ॥7॥
author: śuka uvāca ।

text: etatte vartayiṣyāmi yathāvadiha darśanam । śṛṇu tattvamihaikāgro yathātattvaṃ yathā ca tat ॥8॥
html:
etatte vartayiṣyāmi yathāvadiha darśanam ।
śṛṇu tattvamihaikāgro yathātattvaṃ yathā ca tat ॥8॥
slp1: etatte vartayizyAmi yaTAvadiha darSanam । SfRu tattvamihEkAgro yaTAtattvaM yaTA ca tat ॥8॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: śabdaḥ śrotraṃ tathā khāni trayamākāśasambhavam । prāṇaśceṣṭā tathā sparśa ete vāyuguṇāstrayaḥ ॥9॥
html:
śabdaḥ śrotraṃ tathā khāni trayamākāśasambhavam ।
prāṇaśceṣṭā tathā sparśa ete vāyuguṇāstrayaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: SabdaH SrotraM taTA KAni trayamAkASasamBavam । prARaScezwA taTA sparSa ete vAyuguRAstrayaH ॥9॥

text: rūpaṃ cakṣurvipākaśca tridhā jyotirvidhīyate । raso'tha rasanaṃ sneho guṇāstvete trayo'mbhasām ॥10॥
html:
rūpaṃ cakṣurvipākaśca tridhā jyotirvidhīyate ।
raso'tha rasanaṃ sneho guṇāstvete trayo'mbhasām ॥10॥
slp1: rUpaM cakzurvipAkaSca triDA jyotirviDIyate । raso'Ta rasanaM sneho guRAstvete trayo'mBasAm ॥10॥

text: ghreyaṃ ghrāṇaṃ śarīraṃ ca bhūmerete guṇāstrayaḥ । etāvānindriyagrāmo vyākhyātaḥ pāñcabhautikaḥ ॥11॥
html:
ghreyaṃ ghrāṇaṃ śarīraṃ ca bhūmerete guṇāstrayaḥ ।
etāvānindriyagrāmo vyākhyātaḥ pāñcabhautikaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: GreyaM GrARaM SarIraM ca BUmerete guRAstrayaH । etAvAnindriyagrAmo vyAKyAtaH pAYcaBOtikaH ॥11॥

text: vāyoḥ sparśo raso'dbhyaśca jyotiṣo rūpamucyate । ākāśaprabhavaḥ śabdo gandho bhūmiguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥12॥
html:
vāyoḥ sparśo raso'dbhyaśca jyotiṣo rūpamucyate ।
ākāśaprabhavaḥ śabdo gandho bhūmiguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: vAyoH sparSo raso'dByaSca jyotizo rUpamucyate । AkASapraBavaH Sabdo ganDo BUmiguRaH smftaH ॥12॥

text: mano buddhiśca bhāvaśca traya ete''tmayonijāḥ । na guṇānativartante guṇebhyaḥ paramā matāḥ ॥13॥
html:
mano buddhiśca bhāvaśca traya ete''tmayonijāḥ ।
na guṇānativartante guṇebhyaḥ paramā matāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: mano budDiSca BAvaSca traya ete''tmayonijAH । na guRAnativartante guReByaH paramA matAH ॥13॥

text: indriyāṇi nare pañca ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu mana ucyate । saptamīṃ buddhimevāhuḥ kṣetrajñaṃ punaraṣṭamam ॥14॥
html:
indriyāṇi nare pañca ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu mana ucyate ।
saptamīṃ buddhimevāhuḥ kṣetrajñaṃ punaraṣṭamam ॥14॥
slp1: indriyARi nare paYca zazWaM tu mana ucyate । saptamIM budDimevAhuH kzetrajYaM punarazwamam ॥14॥

text: cakṣurālocanāyaiva saṃśayaṃ kurute manaḥ । buddhiradhyavasānāya sākṣī kṣetrajña ucyate ॥15॥
html:
cakṣurālocanāyaiva saṃśayaṃ kurute manaḥ ।
buddhiradhyavasānāya sākṣī kṣetrajña ucyate ॥15॥
slp1: cakzurAlocanAyEva saMSayaM kurute manaH । budDiraDyavasAnAya sAkzI kzetrajYa ucyate ॥15॥

text: rajastamaśca sattvaṃ ca traya ete svayonijāḥ । samāḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tadguṇeṣūpalakṣayet ॥16॥
html:
rajastamaśca sattvaṃ ca traya ete svayonijāḥ ।
samāḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tadguṇeṣūpalakṣayet ॥16॥
slp1: rajastamaSca sattvaM ca traya ete svayonijAH । samAH sarvezu BUtezu tadguRezUpalakzayet ॥16॥

text: yathā kūrma ihāṅgāni prasārya viniyacchati । evamevendriyagrāmaṃ buddhiḥ sṛṣṭvā niyacchati ॥17॥
html:
yathā kūrma ihāṅgāni prasārya viniyacchati ।
evamevendriyagrāmaṃ buddhiḥ sṛṣṭvā niyacchati ॥17॥
slp1: yaTA kUrma ihANgAni prasArya viniyacCati । evamevendriyagrAmaM budDiH sfzwvA niyacCati ॥17॥

text: yadūrdhvaṃ pādatalayoravāṅmūrdhnaśca paśyati । etasminneva kṛtye vai vartate buddhiruttamā ॥18॥
html:
yadūrdhvaṃ pādatalayoravāṅmūrdhnaśca paśyati ।
etasminneva kṛtye vai vartate buddhiruttamā ॥18॥
slp1: yadUrDvaM pAdatalayoravANmUrDnaSca paSyati । etasminneva kftye vE vartate budDiruttamA ॥18॥

text: guṇānnenīyate buddhirbuddhirevendriyāṇyapi । manaḥṣaṣṭhāni sarvāṇi buddhyabhāve kuto guṇāḥ ॥19॥
html:
guṇānnenīyate buddhirbuddhirevendriyāṇyapi ।
manaḥṣaṣṭhāni sarvāṇi buddhyabhāve kuto guṇāḥ ॥19॥
slp1: guRAnnenIyate budDirbudDirevendriyARyapi । manaHzazWAni sarvARi budDyaBAve kuto guRAH ॥19॥

text: tatra yatprītisaṃyuktaṃ kiñcidātmani lakṣayet । praśāntamiva saṃśuddhaṃ sattvaṃ tadupadhārayet ॥20॥
html:
tatra yatprītisaṃyuktaṃ kiñcidātmani lakṣayet ।
praśāntamiva saṃśuddhaṃ sattvaṃ tadupadhārayet ॥20॥
slp1: tatra yatprItisaMyuktaM kiYcidAtmani lakzayet । praSAntamiva saMSudDaM sattvaM tadupaDArayet ॥20॥

text: yattu santāpasaṃyuktaṃ kāye manasi vā bhavet । rajaḥ pravartakaṃ tatsyātsatataṃ hāri dehinām ॥21॥
html:
yattu santāpasaṃyuktaṃ kāye manasi vā bhavet ।
rajaḥ pravartakaṃ tatsyātsatataṃ hāri dehinām ॥21॥
slp1: yattu santApasaMyuktaM kAye manasi vA Bavet । rajaH pravartakaM tatsyAtsatataM hAri dehinAm ॥21॥

text: yattu saṃmohasaṃyuktamavyaktaviṣayaṃ bhavet । apratarkyamavijñeyaṃ tamastadupadhāryatām ॥22॥
html:
yattu saṃmohasaṃyuktamavyaktaviṣayaṃ bhavet ।
apratarkyamavijñeyaṃ tamastadupadhāryatām ॥22॥
slp1: yattu saMmohasaMyuktamavyaktavizayaM Bavet । apratarkyamavijYeyaM tamastadupaDAryatAm ॥22॥

text: praharṣaḥ prītirānandaḥ sāmyaṃ svasthātmacittatā । akasmādyadi vā kasmādvartate sāttviko guṇaḥ ॥23॥
html:
praharṣaḥ prītirānandaḥ sāmyaṃ svasthātmacittatā ।
akasmādyadi vā kasmādvartate sāttviko guṇaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: praharzaH prItirAnandaH sAmyaM svasTAtmacittatA । akasmAdyadi vA kasmAdvartate sAttviko guRaH ॥23॥

text: abhimāno mṛṣāvādo lobho mohastathākṣamā । liṅgāni rajasastāni vartante hetvahetutaḥ ॥24॥
html:
abhimāno mṛṣāvādo lobho mohastathākṣamā ।
liṅgāni rajasastāni vartante hetvahetutaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: aBimAno mfzAvAdo loBo mohastaTAkzamA । liNgAni rajasastAni vartante hetvahetutaH ॥24॥

text: tathā mohaḥ pramādaśca tandrī nidrāprabodhitā । kathañcidabhivartante vijñeyāstāmasā guṇāḥ] ॥25॥
html:
tathā mohaḥ pramādaśca tandrī nidrāprabodhitā ।
kathañcidabhivartante vijñeyāstāmasā guṇāḥ] ॥25॥
slp1: taTA mohaH pramAdaSca tandrI nidrApraboDitA । kaTaYcidaBivartante vijYeyAstAmasA guRAH] ॥25॥

text: manaḥ prasṛjate bhāvaṃ buddhiradhyavasāyinī । hṛdayaṃ priyāpriye veda trividhā karmacodanā ॥1॥
html:
manaḥ prasṛjate bhāvaṃ buddhiradhyavasāyinī ।
hṛdayaṃ priyāpriye veda trividhā karmacodanā ॥1॥
slp1: manaH prasfjate BAvaM budDiraDyavasAyinI । hfdayaM priyApriye veda triviDA karmacodanA ॥1॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: indriyebhyaḥ parā hyarthā arthebhyaḥ paramaṃ manaḥ । manasastu parā buddhirbuddherātmā paro mataḥ ॥2॥
html:
indriyebhyaḥ parā hyarthā arthebhyaḥ paramaṃ manaḥ ।
manasastu parā buddhirbuddherātmā paro mataḥ ॥2॥
slp1: indriyeByaH parA hyarTA arTeByaH paramaM manaH । manasastu parA budDirbudDerAtmA paro mataH ॥2॥

text: buddhirātmā manuṣyasya buddhirevātmano''tmikā । yadā vikurute bhāvaṃ tadā bhavati sā manaḥ ॥3॥
html:
buddhirātmā manuṣyasya buddhirevātmano''tmikā ।
yadā vikurute bhāvaṃ tadā bhavati sā manaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: budDirAtmA manuzyasya budDirevAtmano''tmikA । yadA vikurute BAvaM tadA Bavati sA manaH ॥3॥

text: indriyāṇāṃ pṛthagbhāvādbuddhirvikriyate hyaṇu । śṛṇvatī bhavati śrotraṃ spṛśatī sparśa ucyate ॥4॥
html:
indriyāṇāṃ pṛthagbhāvādbuddhirvikriyate hyaṇu ।
śṛṇvatī bhavati śrotraṃ spṛśatī sparśa ucyate ॥4॥
slp1: indriyARAM pfTagBAvAdbudDirvikriyate hyaRu । SfRvatI Bavati SrotraM spfSatI sparSa ucyate ॥4॥

text: paśyantī bhavate dṛṣṭī rasatī rasanaṃ bhavet । jighratī bhavati ghrāṇaṃ buddhirvikriyate pṛthak ॥5॥
html:
paśyantī bhavate dṛṣṭī rasatī rasanaṃ bhavet ।
jighratī bhavati ghrāṇaṃ buddhirvikriyate pṛthak ॥5॥
slp1: paSyantI Bavate dfzwI rasatI rasanaM Bavet । jiGratI Bavati GrARaM budDirvikriyate pfTak ॥5॥

text: indriyāṇīti tānyāhusteṣvadṛśyādhitiṣṭhati । tiṣṭhatī puruṣe buddhistriṣu bhāveṣu vartate ॥6॥
html:
indriyāṇīti tānyāhusteṣvadṛśyādhitiṣṭhati ।
tiṣṭhatī puruṣe buddhistriṣu bhāveṣu vartate ॥6॥
slp1: indriyARIti tAnyAhustezvadfSyADitizWati । tizWatI puruze budDistrizu BAvezu vartate ॥6॥

text: kadācillabhate prītiṃ kadācidapi śocate । na sukhena na duḥkhena kadācidiha yujyate ॥7॥
html:
kadācillabhate prītiṃ kadācidapi śocate ।
na sukhena na duḥkhena kadācidiha yujyate ॥7॥
slp1: kadAcillaBate prItiM kadAcidapi Socate । na suKena na duHKena kadAcidiha yujyate ॥7॥

text: seyaṃ bhāvātmikā bhāvāṃstrīnetānativartate । saritāṃ sāgaro bhartā mahāvelāmivormimān ॥8॥
html:
seyaṃ bhāvātmikā bhāvāṃstrīnetānativartate ।
saritāṃ sāgaro bhartā mahāvelāmivormimān ॥8॥
slp1: seyaM BAvAtmikA BAvAMstrInetAnativartate । saritAM sAgaro BartA mahAvelAmivormimAn ॥8॥

text: yadā prārthayate kiñcittadā bhavati sā manaḥ । adhiṣṭhānāni vai buddhyā pṛthagetāni saṃsmaret । indriyāṇyeva medhyāni vijetavyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ ॥9॥
html:
yadā prārthayate kiñcittadā bhavati sā manaḥ ।
adhiṣṭhānāni vai buddhyā pṛthagetāni saṃsmaret ।
indriyāṇyeva medhyāni vijetavyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: yadA prArTayate kiYcittadA Bavati sA manaH । aDizWAnAni vE budDyA pfTagetAni saMsmaret । indriyARyeva meDyAni vijetavyAni kftsnaSaH ॥9॥

text: sarvāṇyevānupūrvyeṇa yadyannānuvidhīyate । avibhāgagatā buddhirbhāve manasi vartate । pravartamānaṃ tu rajaḥ sattvamapyanuvartate ॥10॥
html:
sarvāṇyevānupūrvyeṇa yadyannānuvidhīyate ।
avibhāgagatā buddhirbhāve manasi vartate ।
pravartamānaṃ tu rajaḥ sattvamapyanuvartate ॥10॥
slp1: sarvARyevAnupUrvyeRa yadyannAnuviDIyate । aviBAgagatA budDirBAve manasi vartate । pravartamAnaM tu rajaH sattvamapyanuvartate ॥10॥

text: ye caiva bhāvā vartante sarva eṣveva te triṣu । anvarthāḥ sampravartante rathanemimarā iva ॥11॥
html:
ye caiva bhāvā vartante sarva eṣveva te triṣu ।
anvarthāḥ sampravartante rathanemimarā iva ॥11॥
slp1: ye cEva BAvA vartante sarva ezveva te trizu । anvarTAH sampravartante raTanemimarA iva ॥11॥

text: pradīpārthaṃ naraḥ kuryādindriyairbuddhisattamaiḥ । niścaradbhiryathāyogamudāsīnairyadṛcchayā ॥12॥
html:
pradīpārthaṃ naraḥ kuryādindriyairbuddhisattamaiḥ ।
niścaradbhiryathāyogamudāsīnairyadṛcchayā ॥12॥
slp1: pradIpArTaM naraH kuryAdindriyErbudDisattamEH । niScaradBiryaTAyogamudAsInEryadfcCayA ॥12॥

text: evaṃsvabhāvamevedamiti vidvānna muhyati । aśocannaprahṛṣyaṃśca nityaṃ vigatamatsaraḥ ॥13॥
html:
evaṃsvabhāvamevedamiti vidvānna muhyati ।
aśocannaprahṛṣyaṃśca nityaṃ vigatamatsaraḥ ॥13॥
slp1: evaMsvaBAvamevedamiti vidvAnna muhyati । aSocannaprahfzyaMSca nityaM vigatamatsaraH ॥13॥

text: na hyātmā śakyate draṣṭumindriyaiḥ kāmagocaraiḥ । pravartamānairanaye durdharairakṛtātmabhiḥ ॥14॥
html:
na hyātmā śakyate draṣṭumindriyaiḥ kāmagocaraiḥ ।
pravartamānairanaye durdharairakṛtātmabhiḥ ॥14॥
slp1: na hyAtmA Sakyate drazwumindriyEH kAmagocarEH । pravartamAnEranaye durDarErakftAtmaBiH ॥14॥

text: teṣāṃ tu manasā raśmīnyadā samyaṅniyacchati । tadā prakāśate hyātmā ghaṭe dīpa iva jvalan । sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ tamasyapagate yathā ॥15॥
html:
teṣāṃ tu manasā raśmīnyadā samyaṅniyacchati ।
tadā prakāśate hyātmā ghaṭe dīpa iva jvalan ।
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ tamasyapagate yathā ॥15॥
slp1: tezAM tu manasA raSmInyadA samyaNniyacCati । tadA prakASate hyAtmA Gawe dIpa iva jvalan । sarvezAmeva BUtAnAM tamasyapagate yaTA ॥15॥

text: yathā vāricaraḥ pakṣī na lipyati jale caran । evameva kṛtaprajño na doṣairviṣayāṃścaran । asajjamānaḥ sarveṣu na kathañcana lipyate ॥16॥
html:
yathā vāricaraḥ pakṣī na lipyati jale caran ।
evameva kṛtaprajño na doṣairviṣayāṃścaran ।
asajjamānaḥ sarveṣu na kathañcana lipyate ॥16॥
slp1: yaTA vAricaraH pakzI na lipyati jale caran । evameva kftaprajYo na dozErvizayAMScaran । asajjamAnaH sarvezu na kaTaYcana lipyate ॥16॥

text: tyaktvā pūrvakṛtaṃ karma ratiryasya sadātmani । sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya guṇamārgeṣvasajjataḥ ॥17॥
html:
tyaktvā pūrvakṛtaṃ karma ratiryasya sadātmani ।
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya guṇamārgeṣvasajjataḥ ॥17॥
slp1: tyaktvA pUrvakftaM karma ratiryasya sadAtmani । sarvaBUtAtmaBUtasya guRamArgezvasajjataH ॥17॥

text: sattvamātmā prasavati guṇānvāpi kadā ca na । na guṇā vidurātmānaṃ guṇānveda sa sarvadā ॥18॥
html:
sattvamātmā prasavati guṇānvāpi kadā ca na ।
na guṇā vidurātmānaṃ guṇānveda sa sarvadā ॥18॥
slp1: sattvamAtmA prasavati guRAnvApi kadA ca na । na guRA vidurAtmAnaM guRAnveda sa sarvadA ॥18॥

text: paridraṣṭā guṇānāṃ sa sraṣṭā caiva yathātatham । sattvakṣetrajñayoretadantaraṃ viddhi sūkṣmayoḥ ॥19॥
html:
paridraṣṭā guṇānāṃ sa sraṣṭā caiva yathātatham ।
sattvakṣetrajñayoretadantaraṃ viddhi sūkṣmayoḥ ॥19॥
slp1: paridrazwA guRAnAM sa srazwA cEva yaTAtaTam । sattvakzetrajYayoretadantaraM vidDi sUkzmayoH ॥19॥

text: sṛjate tu guṇāneka eko na sṛjate guṇān । pṛthagbhūtau prakṛtyā tau samprayuktau ca sarvadā ॥20॥
html:
sṛjate tu guṇāneka eko na sṛjate guṇān ।
pṛthagbhūtau prakṛtyā tau samprayuktau ca sarvadā ॥20॥
slp1: sfjate tu guRAneka eko na sfjate guRAn । pfTagBUtO prakftyA tO samprayuktO ca sarvadA ॥20॥

text: yathā matsyo'dbhiranyaḥ sansamprayuktau tathaiva tau । maśakodumbarau cāpi samprayuktau yathā saha ॥21॥
html:
yathā matsyo'dbhiranyaḥ sansamprayuktau tathaiva tau ।
maśakodumbarau cāpi samprayuktau yathā saha ॥21॥
slp1: yaTA matsyo'dBiranyaH sansamprayuktO taTEva tO । maSakodumbarO cApi samprayuktO yaTA saha ॥21॥

text: iṣīkā vā yathā muñje pṛthakca saha caiva ca । tathaiva sahitāvetāvanyonyasminpratiṣṭhitau] ॥22॥
html:
iṣīkā vā yathā muñje pṛthakca saha caiva ca ।
tathaiva sahitāvetāvanyonyasminpratiṣṭhitau] ॥22॥
slp1: izIkA vA yaTA muYje pfTakca saha cEva ca । taTEva sahitAvetAvanyonyasminpratizWitO] ॥22॥

text: sṛjate tu guṇānsattvaṃ kṣetrajñastvanutiṣṭhati । guṇānvikriyataḥ sarvānudāsīnavadīśvaraḥ ॥1॥
html:
sṛjate tu guṇānsattvaṃ kṣetrajñastvanutiṣṭhati ।
guṇānvikriyataḥ sarvānudāsīnavadīśvaraḥ ॥1॥
slp1: sfjate tu guRAnsattvaM kzetrajYastvanutizWati । guRAnvikriyataH sarvAnudAsInavadISvaraH ॥1॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: svabhāvayuktaṃ tatsarvaṃ yadimānsṛjate guṇān । ūrṇanābhiryathā sūtraṃ sṛjate tantuvadguṇān ॥2॥
html:
svabhāvayuktaṃ tatsarvaṃ yadimānsṛjate guṇān ।
ūrṇanābhiryathā sūtraṃ sṛjate tantuvadguṇān ॥2॥
slp1: svaBAvayuktaM tatsarvaM yadimAnsfjate guRAn । UrRanABiryaTA sUtraM sfjate tantuvadguRAn ॥2॥

text: pradhvastā na nivartante pravṛttirnopalabhyate । evameke vyavasyanti nivṛttiriti cāpare ॥3॥
html:
pradhvastā na nivartante pravṛttirnopalabhyate ।
evameke vyavasyanti nivṛttiriti cāpare ॥3॥
slp1: praDvastA na nivartante pravfttirnopalaByate । evameke vyavasyanti nivfttiriti cApare ॥3॥

text: ubhayaṃ sampradhāryaitadadhyavasyedyathāmati । anenaiva vidhānena bhavedgarbhaśayo mahān ॥4॥
html:
ubhayaṃ sampradhāryaitadadhyavasyedyathāmati ।
anenaiva vidhānena bhavedgarbhaśayo mahān ॥4॥
slp1: uBayaM sampraDAryEtadaDyavasyedyaTAmati । anenEva viDAnena BavedgarBaSayo mahAn ॥4॥

text: anādinidhanaṃ nityamāsādya vicarennaraḥ । akrudhyannaprahṛṣyaṃśca nityaṃ vigatamatsaraḥ ॥5॥
html:
anādinidhanaṃ nityamāsādya vicarennaraḥ ।
akrudhyannaprahṛṣyaṃśca nityaṃ vigatamatsaraḥ ॥5॥
slp1: anAdiniDanaM nityamAsAdya vicarennaraH । akruDyannaprahfzyaMSca nityaM vigatamatsaraH ॥5॥

text: ityevaṃ hṛdayagranthiṃ buddhicintāmayaṃ dṛḍham । atītya sukhamāsīta aśocaṃśchinnasaṃśayaḥ ॥6॥
html:
ityevaṃ hṛdayagranthiṃ buddhicintāmayaṃ dṛḍham ।
atītya sukhamāsīta aśocaṃśchinnasaṃśayaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: ityevaM hfdayagranTiM budDicintAmayaM dfQam । atItya suKamAsIta aSocaMSCinnasaMSayaH ॥6॥

text: tapyeyuḥ pracyutāḥ pṛthvyā yathā pūrṇāṃ nadīṃ narāḥ । avagāḍhā hyavidvāṃso viddhi lokamimaṃ tathā ॥7॥
html:
tapyeyuḥ pracyutāḥ pṛthvyā yathā pūrṇāṃ nadīṃ narāḥ ।
avagāḍhā hyavidvāṃso viddhi lokamimaṃ tathā ॥7॥
slp1: tapyeyuH pracyutAH pfTvyA yaTA pUrRAM nadIM narAH । avagAQA hyavidvAMso vidDi lokamimaM taTA ॥7॥

text: na tu tāmyati vai vidvānsthale carati tattvavit । evaṃ yo vindate''tmānaṃ kevalaṃ jñānamātmanaḥ ॥8॥
html:
na tu tāmyati vai vidvānsthale carati tattvavit ।
evaṃ yo vindate''tmānaṃ kevalaṃ jñānamātmanaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: na tu tAmyati vE vidvAnsTale carati tattvavit । evaM yo vindate''tmAnaM kevalaM jYAnamAtmanaH ॥8॥

text: evaṃ buddhvā naraḥ sarvāṃ bhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatim । samavekṣya śanaiḥ samyaglabhate śamamuttamam ॥9॥
html:
evaṃ buddhvā naraḥ sarvāṃ bhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatim ।
samavekṣya śanaiḥ samyaglabhate śamamuttamam ॥9॥
slp1: evaM budDvA naraH sarvAM BUtAnAmAgatiM gatim । samavekzya SanEH samyaglaBate Samamuttamam ॥9॥

text: etadvai janmasāmarthyaṃ brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ । ātmajñānaṃ śamaścaiva paryāptaṃ tatparāyaṇam ॥10॥
html:
etadvai janmasāmarthyaṃ brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ ।
ātmajñānaṃ śamaścaiva paryāptaṃ tatparāyaṇam ॥10॥
slp1: etadvE janmasAmarTyaM brAhmaRasya viSezataH । AtmajYAnaM SamaScEva paryAptaM tatparAyaRam ॥10॥

text: etadbuddhvā bhavedbuddhaḥ kimanyadbuddhalakṣaṇam । vijñāyaitadvimucyante kṛtakṛtyā manīṣiṇaḥ ॥11॥
html:
etadbuddhvā bhavedbuddhaḥ kimanyadbuddhalakṣaṇam ।
vijñāyaitadvimucyante kṛtakṛtyā manīṣiṇaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: etadbudDvA BavedbudDaH kimanyadbudDalakzaRam । vijYAyEtadvimucyante kftakftyA manIziRaH ॥11॥

text: na bhavati viduṣāṃ mahadbhayaṃ yadaviduṣāṃ sumahadbhayaṃ bhavet । na hi gatiradhikāsti kasyacidbhavati hi yā viduṣaḥ sanātanī ॥12॥
html:
na bhavati viduṣāṃ mahadbhayaṃ yadaviduṣāṃ sumahadbhayaṃ bhavet ।
na hi gatiradhikāsti kasyacidbhavati hi yā viduṣaḥ sanātanī ॥12॥
slp1: na Bavati viduzAM mahadBayaM yadaviduzAM sumahadBayaM Bavet । na hi gatiraDikAsti kasyacidBavati hi yA viduzaH sanAtanI ॥12॥

text: lokamāturamasūyate janastattadeva ca nirīkṣya śocate । tatra paśya kuśalānaśocato ye vidustadubhayaṃ kṛtākṛtam ॥13॥
html:
lokamāturamasūyate janastattadeva ca nirīkṣya śocate ।
tatra paśya kuśalānaśocato ye vidustadubhayaṃ kṛtākṛtam ॥13॥
slp1: lokamAturamasUyate janastattadeva ca nirIkzya Socate । tatra paSya kuSalAnaSocato ye vidustaduBayaM kftAkftam ॥13॥

text: yatkarotyanabhisandhipūrvakaṃ tacca nirṇudati yatpurā kṛtam । na priyaṃ tadubhayaṃ na cāpriyaṃ tasya tajjanayatīha kurvataḥ] ॥14॥
html:
yatkarotyanabhisandhipūrvakaṃ tacca nirṇudati yatpurā kṛtam ।
na priyaṃ tadubhayaṃ na cāpriyaṃ tasya tajjanayatīha kurvataḥ] ॥14॥
slp1: yatkarotyanaBisanDipUrvakaM tacca nirRudati yatpurA kftam । na priyaM taduBayaM na cApriyaM tasya tajjanayatIha kurvataH] ॥14॥

text: yasmāddharmātparo dharmo vidyate neha kaścana । yo viśiṣṭaśca dharmebhyastaṃ bhavānprabravītu me ॥1॥
html:
yasmāddharmātparo dharmo vidyate neha kaścana ।
yo viśiṣṭaśca dharmebhyastaṃ bhavānprabravītu me ॥1॥
slp1: yasmAdDarmAtparo Darmo vidyate neha kaScana । yo viSizwaSca DarmeByastaM BavAnprabravItu me ॥1॥
author: śuka uvāca ।

text: dharmaṃ te sampravakṣyāmi purāṇamṛṣisaṃstutam । viśiṣṭaṃ sarvadharmebhyastamihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ॥2॥
html:
dharmaṃ te sampravakṣyāmi purāṇamṛṣisaṃstutam ।
viśiṣṭaṃ sarvadharmebhyastamihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ॥2॥
slp1: DarmaM te sampravakzyAmi purARamfzisaMstutam । viSizwaM sarvaDarmeByastamihEkamanAH SfRu ॥2॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: indriyāṇi pramāthīni buddhyā saṃyamya yatnataḥ । sarvato niṣpatiṣṇūni pitā bālānivātmajān ॥3॥
html:
indriyāṇi pramāthīni buddhyā saṃyamya yatnataḥ ।
sarvato niṣpatiṣṇūni pitā bālānivātmajān ॥3॥
slp1: indriyARi pramATIni budDyA saMyamya yatnataH । sarvato nizpatizRUni pitA bAlAnivAtmajAn ॥3॥

text: manasaścendriyāṇāṃ ca hyaikāgryaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ । tajjyāyaḥ sarvadharmebhyaḥ sa dharmaḥ para ucyate ॥4॥
html:
manasaścendriyāṇāṃ ca hyaikāgryaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ ।
tajjyāyaḥ sarvadharmebhyaḥ sa dharmaḥ para ucyate ॥4॥
slp1: manasaScendriyARAM ca hyEkAgryaM paramaM tapaH । tajjyAyaH sarvaDarmeByaH sa DarmaH para ucyate ॥4॥

text: tāni sarvāṇi sandhāya manaḥṣaṣṭhāni medhayā । ātmatṛpta ivāsīta bahu cintyamacintayan ॥5॥
html:
tāni sarvāṇi sandhāya manaḥṣaṣṭhāni medhayā ।
ātmatṛpta ivāsīta bahu cintyamacintayan ॥5॥
slp1: tAni sarvARi sanDAya manaHzazWAni meDayA । Atmatfpta ivAsIta bahu cintyamacintayan ॥5॥

text: gocarebhyo nivṛttāni yadā sthāsyanti veśmani । tadā tvamātmanātmānaṃ paraṃ drakṣyasi śāśvatam ॥6॥
html:
gocarebhyo nivṛttāni yadā sthāsyanti veśmani ।
tadā tvamātmanātmānaṃ paraṃ drakṣyasi śāśvatam ॥6॥
slp1: gocareByo nivfttAni yadA sTAsyanti veSmani । tadA tvamAtmanAtmAnaM paraM drakzyasi SASvatam ॥6॥

text: sarvātmānaṃ mahātmānaṃ vidhūmamiva pāvakam । taṃ paśyanti mahātmāno brāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ ॥7॥
html:
sarvātmānaṃ mahātmānaṃ vidhūmamiva pāvakam ।
taṃ paśyanti mahātmāno brāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: sarvAtmAnaM mahAtmAnaM viDUmamiva pAvakam । taM paSyanti mahAtmAno brAhmaRA ye manIziRaH ॥7॥

text: yathā puṣpaphalopeto bahuśākho mahādrumaḥ । ātmano nābhijānīte kva me puṣpaṃ kva me phalam ॥8॥
html:
yathā puṣpaphalopeto bahuśākho mahādrumaḥ ।
ātmano nābhijānīte kva me puṣpaṃ kva me phalam ॥8॥
slp1: yaTA puzpaPalopeto bahuSAKo mahAdrumaH । Atmano nABijAnIte kva me puzpaM kva me Palam ॥8॥

text: evamātmā na jānīte kva gamiṣye kuto nvaham । anyo hyatrāntarātmāsti yaḥ sarvamanupaśyati ॥9॥
html:
evamātmā na jānīte kva gamiṣye kuto nvaham ।
anyo hyatrāntarātmāsti yaḥ sarvamanupaśyati ॥9॥
slp1: evamAtmA na jAnIte kva gamizye kuto nvaham । anyo hyatrAntarAtmAsti yaH sarvamanupaSyati ॥9॥

text: jñānadīpena dīptena paśyatyātmānamātmanā । dṛṣṭvā tvamātmanātmānaṃ nirātmā bhava sarvavit ॥10॥
html:
jñānadīpena dīptena paśyatyātmānamātmanā ।
dṛṣṭvā tvamātmanātmānaṃ nirātmā bhava sarvavit ॥10॥
slp1: jYAnadIpena dIptena paSyatyAtmAnamAtmanA । dfzwvA tvamAtmanAtmAnaM nirAtmA Bava sarvavit ॥10॥

text: vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo muktatvaca ivoragaḥ । parāṃ buddhimavāpyeha vipāpmā vigatajvaraḥ ॥11॥
html:
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo muktatvaca ivoragaḥ ।
parāṃ buddhimavāpyeha vipāpmā vigatajvaraḥ ॥11॥
slp1: vimuktaH sarvapApeByo muktatvaca ivoragaH । parAM budDimavApyeha vipApmA vigatajvaraH ॥11॥

text: sarvataḥsrotasaṃ ghorāṃ nadīṃ lokapravāhinīm । pañcendriyagrāhavatīṃ manaḥsaṅkalparodhasam ॥12॥
html:
sarvataḥsrotasaṃ ghorāṃ nadīṃ lokapravāhinīm ।
pañcendriyagrāhavatīṃ manaḥsaṅkalparodhasam ॥12॥
slp1: sarvataHsrotasaM GorAM nadIM lokapravAhinIm । paYcendriyagrAhavatIM manaHsaNkalparoDasam ॥12॥

text: lobhamohatṛṇacchannāṃ kāmakrodhasarīsṛpām । satyatīrthānṛtakṣobhāṃ krodhapaṅkāṃ saridvarām ॥13॥
html:
lobhamohatṛṇacchannāṃ kāmakrodhasarīsṛpām ।
satyatīrthānṛtakṣobhāṃ krodhapaṅkāṃ saridvarām ॥13॥
slp1: loBamohatfRacCannAM kAmakroDasarIsfpAm । satyatIrTAnftakzoBAM kroDapaNkAM saridvarAm ॥13॥

text: avyaktaprabhavāṃ śīghrāṃ dustarāmakṛtātmabhiḥ । pratarasva nadīṃ buddhyā kāmagrāhasamākulām ॥14॥
html:
avyaktaprabhavāṃ śīghrāṃ dustarāmakṛtātmabhiḥ ।
pratarasva nadīṃ buddhyā kāmagrāhasamākulām ॥14॥
slp1: avyaktapraBavAM SIGrAM dustarAmakftAtmaBiH । pratarasva nadIM budDyA kAmagrAhasamAkulAm ॥14॥

text: saṃsārasāgaragamāṃ yonipātāladustarām । ātmajanmodbhavāṃ tāta jihvāvartāṃ durāsadām ॥15॥
html:
saṃsārasāgaragamāṃ yonipātāladustarām ।
ātmajanmodbhavāṃ tāta jihvāvartāṃ durāsadām ॥15॥
slp1: saMsArasAgaragamAM yonipAtAladustarAm । AtmajanmodBavAM tAta jihvAvartAM durAsadAm ॥15॥

text: yāṃ taranti kṛtaprajñā dhṛtimanto manīṣiṇaḥ । tāṃ tīrṇaḥ sarvatomukto vipūtātmātmavicchuciḥ ॥16॥
html:
yāṃ taranti kṛtaprajñā dhṛtimanto manīṣiṇaḥ ।
tāṃ tīrṇaḥ sarvatomukto vipūtātmātmavicchuciḥ ॥16॥
slp1: yAM taranti kftaprajYA Dftimanto manIziRaH । tAM tIrRaH sarvatomukto vipUtAtmAtmavicCuciH ॥16॥

text: uttamāṃ buddhimāsthāya brahmabhūyaṃ gamiṣyasi । santīrṇaḥ sarvasaṅkleśānprasannātmā vikalmaṣaḥ ॥17॥
html:
uttamāṃ buddhimāsthāya brahmabhūyaṃ gamiṣyasi ।
santīrṇaḥ sarvasaṅkleśānprasannātmā vikalmaṣaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: uttamAM budDimAsTAya brahmaBUyaM gamizyasi । santIrRaH sarvasaNkleSAnprasannAtmA vikalmazaH ॥17॥

text: bhūmiṣṭhānīva bhūtāni parvatastho niśāmaya । akrudhyannaprahṛṣyaṃśca nanṛśaṃsamatistathā । tato drakṣyasi bhūtānāṃ sarveṣāṃ prabhavāpyayau ॥18॥
html:
bhūmiṣṭhānīva bhūtāni parvatastho niśāmaya ।
akrudhyannaprahṛṣyaṃśca nanṛśaṃsamatistathā ।
tato drakṣyasi bhūtānāṃ sarveṣāṃ prabhavāpyayau ॥18॥
slp1: BUmizWAnIva BUtAni parvatasTo niSAmaya । akruDyannaprahfzyaMSca nanfSaMsamatistaTA । tato drakzyasi BUtAnAM sarvezAM praBavApyayO ॥18॥

text: evaṃ vai sarvadharmebhyo viśiṣṭaṃ menire budhāḥ । dharmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha munayastattvadarśinaḥ ॥19॥
html:
evaṃ vai sarvadharmebhyo viśiṣṭaṃ menire budhāḥ ।
dharmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha munayastattvadarśinaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: evaM vE sarvaDarmeByo viSizwaM menire buDAH । DarmaM DarmaBftAM SrezWa munayastattvadarSinaH ॥19॥

text: ātmano'vyayino jñātvā idaṃ putrānuśāsanam । prayatāya pravaktavyaṃ hitāyānugatāya ca ॥20॥
html:
ātmano'vyayino jñātvā idaṃ putrānuśāsanam ।
prayatāya pravaktavyaṃ hitāyānugatāya ca ॥20॥
slp1: Atmano'vyayino jYAtvA idaM putrAnuSAsanam । prayatAya pravaktavyaM hitAyAnugatAya ca ॥20॥

text: ātmajñānamidaṃ guhyaṃ sarvaguhyatamaṃ mahat । abruvaṃ yadahaṃ tāta ātmasākṣikamañjasā ॥21॥
html:
ātmajñānamidaṃ guhyaṃ sarvaguhyatamaṃ mahat ।
abruvaṃ yadahaṃ tāta ātmasākṣikamañjasā ॥21॥
slp1: AtmajYAnamidaM guhyaM sarvaguhyatamaM mahat । abruvaM yadahaM tAta AtmasAkzikamaYjasA ॥21॥

text: naiva strī na pumānetannaiva cedaṃ napuṃsakam । aduḥkhamasukhaṃ brahma bhūtabhavyabhavātmakam ॥22॥
html:
naiva strī na pumānetannaiva cedaṃ napuṃsakam ।
aduḥkhamasukhaṃ brahma bhūtabhavyabhavātmakam ॥22॥
slp1: nEva strI na pumAnetannEva cedaM napuMsakam । aduHKamasuKaM brahma BUtaBavyaBavAtmakam ॥22॥

text: naitajjñātvā pumānstrī vā punarbhavamavāpnuyāt । abhavapratipattyarthametadvartma vidhīyate ॥23॥
html:
naitajjñātvā pumānstrī vā punarbhavamavāpnuyāt ।
abhavapratipattyarthametadvartma vidhīyate ॥23॥
slp1: nEtajjYAtvA pumAnstrI vA punarBavamavApnuyAt । aBavapratipattyarTametadvartma viDIyate ॥23॥

text: yathā matāni sarvāṇi na caitāni yathā tathā । kathitāni mayā putra bhavanti na bhavanti ca ॥24॥
html:
yathā matāni sarvāṇi na caitāni yathā tathā ।
kathitāni mayā putra bhavanti na bhavanti ca ॥24॥
slp1: yaTA matAni sarvARi na cEtAni yaTA taTA । kaTitAni mayA putra Bavanti na Bavanti ca ॥24॥

text: tatprītiyuktena guṇānvitena putreṇa satputraguṇānvitena । pṛṣṭo hīdaṃ prītimatā hitārthaṃ brūyātsutasyeha yaduktametat] ॥25॥
html:
tatprītiyuktena guṇānvitena putreṇa satputraguṇānvitena ।
pṛṣṭo hīdaṃ prītimatā hitārthaṃ brūyātsutasyeha yaduktametat] ॥25॥
slp1: tatprItiyuktena guRAnvitena putreRa satputraguRAnvitena । pfzwo hIdaM prItimatA hitArTaM brUyAtsutasyeha yaduktametat] ॥25॥

text: gandhānrasānnānurundhyātsukhaṃ vā nālaṅkārāṃścāpnuyāttasya tasya । mānaṃ ca kīrtiṃ ca yaśaśca necchetsa vai pracāraḥ paśyato brāhmaṇasya ॥1॥
html:
gandhānrasānnānurundhyātsukhaṃ vā nālaṅkārāṃścāpnuyāttasya tasya ।
mānaṃ ca kīrtiṃ ca yaśaśca necchetsa vai pracāraḥ paśyato brāhmaṇasya ॥1॥
slp1: ganDAnrasAnnAnurunDyAtsuKaM vA nAlaNkArAMScApnuyAttasya tasya । mAnaM ca kIrtiM ca yaSaSca necCetsa vE pracAraH paSyato brAhmaRasya ॥1॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: sarvānvedānadhīyīta śuśrūṣurbrahmacaryavān । ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni na tena na sa brāhmaṇaḥ ॥2॥
html:
sarvānvedānadhīyīta śuśrūṣurbrahmacaryavān ।
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni na tena na sa brāhmaṇaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: sarvAnvedAnaDIyIta SuSrUzurbrahmacaryavAn । fco yajUMzi sAmAni na tena na sa brAhmaRaH ॥2॥

text: jñātivatsarvabhūtānāṃ sarvavitsarvavedavit । nākāmo mriyate jātu na tena na ca brāhmaṇaḥ ॥3॥
html:
jñātivatsarvabhūtānāṃ sarvavitsarvavedavit ।
nākāmo mriyate jātu na tena na ca brāhmaṇaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: jYAtivatsarvaBUtAnAM sarvavitsarvavedavit । nAkAmo mriyate jAtu na tena na ca brAhmaRaH ॥3॥

text: iṣṭīśca vividhāḥ prāpya kratūṃścaivāptadakṣiṇān । naiva prāpnoti brāhmaṇyamabhidhyānātkathañcana ॥4॥
html:
iṣṭīśca vividhāḥ prāpya kratūṃścaivāptadakṣiṇān ।
naiva prāpnoti brāhmaṇyamabhidhyānātkathañcana ॥4॥
slp1: izwISca viviDAH prApya kratUMScEvAptadakziRAn । nEva prApnoti brAhmaRyamaBiDyAnAtkaTaYcana ॥4॥

text: yadā cāyaṃ na bibheti yadā cāsmānna bibhyati । yadā necchati na dveṣṭi brahma sampadyate tadā ॥5॥
html:
yadā cāyaṃ na bibheti yadā cāsmānna bibhyati ।
yadā necchati na dveṣṭi brahma sampadyate tadā ॥5॥
slp1: yadA cAyaM na biBeti yadA cAsmAnna biByati । yadA necCati na dvezwi brahma sampadyate tadA ॥5॥

text: yadā na kurute bhāvaṃ sarvabhūteṣu pāpakam । karmaṇā manasā vācā brahma sampadyate tadā ॥6॥
html:
yadā na kurute bhāvaṃ sarvabhūteṣu pāpakam ।
karmaṇā manasā vācā brahma sampadyate tadā ॥6॥
slp1: yadA na kurute BAvaM sarvaBUtezu pApakam । karmaRA manasA vAcA brahma sampadyate tadA ॥6॥

text: kāmabandhanamevaikaṃ nānyadastīha bandhanam । kāmabandhanamukto hi brahmabhūyāya kalpate ॥7॥
html:
kāmabandhanamevaikaṃ nānyadastīha bandhanam ।
kāmabandhanamukto hi brahmabhūyāya kalpate ॥7॥
slp1: kAmabanDanamevEkaM nAnyadastIha banDanam । kAmabanDanamukto hi brahmaBUyAya kalpate ॥7॥

text: kāmato mucyamānastu dhūmrābhrādiva candramāḥ । virajāḥ kālamākāṅkṣandhīro dhairyeṇa vartate ॥8॥
html:
kāmato mucyamānastu dhūmrābhrādiva candramāḥ ।
virajāḥ kālamākāṅkṣandhīro dhairyeṇa vartate ॥8॥
slp1: kAmato mucyamAnastu DUmrABrAdiva candramAH । virajAH kAlamAkANkzanDIro DEryeRa vartate ॥8॥

text: āpūryamāṇamacalapratiṣṭhaṃ samudramāpaḥ praviśanti yadvat । sa kāmakānto na tu kāmakāmaḥ sa vai lokātsvargamupaiti dehī ॥9॥
html:
āpūryamāṇamacalapratiṣṭhaṃ samudramāpaḥ praviśanti yadvat ।
sa kāmakānto na tu kāmakāmaḥ sa vai lokātsvargamupaiti dehī ॥9॥
slp1: ApUryamARamacalapratizWaM samudramApaH praviSanti yadvat । sa kAmakAnto na tu kAmakAmaH sa vE lokAtsvargamupEti dehI ॥9॥

text: vedasyopaniṣatsatyaṃ satyasyopaniṣaddamaḥ । damasyopaniṣaddānaṃ dānasyopaniṣattapaḥ ॥10॥
html:
vedasyopaniṣatsatyaṃ satyasyopaniṣaddamaḥ ।
damasyopaniṣaddānaṃ dānasyopaniṣattapaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: vedasyopanizatsatyaM satyasyopanizaddamaH । damasyopanizaddAnaM dAnasyopanizattapaH ॥10॥

text: tapasopaniṣattyāgastyāgasyopaniṣatsukham । sukhasyopaniṣatsvargaḥ svargasyopaniṣacchamaḥ ॥11॥
html:
tapasopaniṣattyāgastyāgasyopaniṣatsukham ।
sukhasyopaniṣatsvargaḥ svargasyopaniṣacchamaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: tapasopanizattyAgastyAgasyopanizatsuKam । suKasyopanizatsvargaH svargasyopanizacCamaH ॥11॥

text: kledanaṃ śokamanasoḥ santāpaṃ tṛṣṇayā saha । sattvamicchasi santoṣācchāntilakṣaṇamuttamam ॥12॥
html:
kledanaṃ śokamanasoḥ santāpaṃ tṛṣṇayā saha ।
sattvamicchasi santoṣācchāntilakṣaṇamuttamam ॥12॥
slp1: kledanaM SokamanasoH santApaM tfzRayA saha । sattvamicCasi santozAcCAntilakzaRamuttamam ॥12॥

text: viśoko nirmamaḥ śāntaḥ prasannātmātmavittamaḥ । ṣaḍbhirlakṣaṇavānetaiḥ samagraḥ punareṣyati ॥13॥
html:
viśoko nirmamaḥ śāntaḥ prasannātmātmavittamaḥ ।
ṣaḍbhirlakṣaṇavānetaiḥ samagraḥ punareṣyati ॥13॥
slp1: viSoko nirmamaH SAntaH prasannAtmAtmavittamaH । zaqBirlakzaRavAnetEH samagraH punarezyati ॥13॥

text: ṣaḍbhiḥ sattvaguṇopetaiḥ prājñairadhikamantribhiḥ । ye viduḥ pretya cātmānamihasthāṃstāṃstathā viduḥ ॥14॥
html:
ṣaḍbhiḥ sattvaguṇopetaiḥ prājñairadhikamantribhiḥ ।
ye viduḥ pretya cātmānamihasthāṃstāṃstathā viduḥ ॥14॥
slp1: zaqBiH sattvaguRopetEH prAjYEraDikamantriBiH । ye viduH pretya cAtmAnamihasTAMstAMstaTA viduH ॥14॥

text: akṛtrimamasaṃhāryaṃ prākṛtaṃ nirupaskṛtam । adhyātmaṃ sukṛtaprajñaḥ sukhamavyayamaśnute ॥15॥
html:
akṛtrimamasaṃhāryaṃ prākṛtaṃ nirupaskṛtam ।
adhyātmaṃ sukṛtaprajñaḥ sukhamavyayamaśnute ॥15॥
slp1: akftrimamasaMhAryaM prAkftaM nirupaskftam । aDyAtmaM sukftaprajYaH suKamavyayamaSnute ॥15॥

text: niṣpracāraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāpya ca sarvataḥ । yāmayaṃ labhate tuṣṭiṃ sā na śakyamato'nyathā ॥16॥
html:
niṣpracāraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāpya ca sarvataḥ ।
yāmayaṃ labhate tuṣṭiṃ sā na śakyamato'nyathā ॥16॥
slp1: nizpracAraM manaH kftvA pratizWApya ca sarvataH । yAmayaM laBate tuzwiM sA na Sakyamato'nyaTA ॥16॥

text: yena tṛpyatyabhuñjāno yena tuṣyatyavittavān । yenāsneho balaṃ dhatte yastaṃ veda sa vedavit ॥17॥
html:
yena tṛpyatyabhuñjāno yena tuṣyatyavittavān ।
yenāsneho balaṃ dhatte yastaṃ veda sa vedavit ॥17॥
slp1: yena tfpyatyaBuYjAno yena tuzyatyavittavAn । yenAsneho balaM Datte yastaM veda sa vedavit ॥17॥

text: saṅgopya hyātmano dvārāṇyapidhāya vicintayan । yo hyāste brāhmaṇaḥ śiṣṭaḥ sa ātmaratirucyate ॥18॥
html:
saṅgopya hyātmano dvārāṇyapidhāya vicintayan ।
yo hyāste brāhmaṇaḥ śiṣṭaḥ sa ātmaratirucyate ॥18॥
slp1: saNgopya hyAtmano dvArARyapiDAya vicintayan । yo hyAste brAhmaRaH SizwaH sa Atmaratirucyate ॥18॥

text: samāhitaṃ pare tattve kṣīṇakāmamavasthitam । sarvataḥ sukhamanveti vapuścāndramasaṃ yathā ॥19॥
html:
samāhitaṃ pare tattve kṣīṇakāmamavasthitam ।
sarvataḥ sukhamanveti vapuścāndramasaṃ yathā ॥19॥
slp1: samAhitaM pare tattve kzIRakAmamavasTitam । sarvataH suKamanveti vapuScAndramasaM yaTA ॥19॥

text: saviśeṣāṇi bhūtāni guṇāṃścābhajato muneḥ । sukhenāpohyate duḥkhaṃ bhāskareṇa tamo yathā ॥20॥
html:
saviśeṣāṇi bhūtāni guṇāṃścābhajato muneḥ ।
sukhenāpohyate duḥkhaṃ bhāskareṇa tamo yathā ॥20॥
slp1: saviSezARi BUtAni guRAMScABajato muneH । suKenApohyate duHKaM BAskareRa tamo yaTA ॥20॥

text: tamatikrāntakarmāṇamatikrāntaguṇakṣayam । brāhmaṇaṃ viṣayāśliṣṭaṃ jarāmṛtyū na vindataḥ ॥21॥
html:
tamatikrāntakarmāṇamatikrāntaguṇakṣayam ।
brāhmaṇaṃ viṣayāśliṣṭaṃ jarāmṛtyū na vindataḥ ॥21॥
slp1: tamatikrAntakarmARamatikrAntaguRakzayam । brAhmaRaM vizayASlizwaM jarAmftyU na vindataH ॥21॥

text: sa yadā sarvato muktaḥ samaḥ paryavatiṣṭhate । indriyāṇīndriyārthāṃśca śarīrastho'tivartate ॥22॥
html:
sa yadā sarvato muktaḥ samaḥ paryavatiṣṭhate ।
indriyāṇīndriyārthāṃśca śarīrastho'tivartate ॥22॥
slp1: sa yadA sarvato muktaH samaH paryavatizWate । indriyARIndriyArTAMSca SarIrasTo'tivartate ॥22॥

text: kāraṇaṃ paramaṃ prāpya atikrāntasya kāryatām । punarāvartanaṃ nāsti samprāptasya parātparam] ॥23॥
html:
kāraṇaṃ paramaṃ prāpya atikrāntasya kāryatām ।
punarāvartanaṃ nāsti samprāptasya parātparam] ॥23॥
slp1: kAraRaM paramaM prApya atikrAntasya kAryatAm । punarAvartanaM nAsti samprAptasya parAtparam] ॥23॥

text: dvandvāni mokṣajijñāsurarthadharmāvanuṣṭhitaḥ । vaktrā guṇavatā śiṣyaḥ śrāvyaḥ pūrvamidaṃ mahat ॥1॥
html:
dvandvāni mokṣajijñāsurarthadharmāvanuṣṭhitaḥ ।
vaktrā guṇavatā śiṣyaḥ śrāvyaḥ pūrvamidaṃ mahat ॥1॥
slp1: dvandvAni mokzajijYAsurarTaDarmAvanuzWitaH । vaktrA guRavatA SizyaH SrAvyaH pUrvamidaM mahat ॥1॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: ākāśaṃ māruto jyotirāpaḥ pṛthvī ca pañcamī । bhāvābhāvau ca kālaśca sarvabhūteṣu pañcasu ॥2॥
html:
ākāśaṃ māruto jyotirāpaḥ pṛthvī ca pañcamī ।
bhāvābhāvau ca kālaśca sarvabhūteṣu pañcasu ॥2॥
slp1: AkASaM mAruto jyotirApaH pfTvI ca paYcamI । BAvABAvO ca kAlaSca sarvaBUtezu paYcasu ॥2॥

text: antarātmakamākāśaṃ tanmayaṃ śrotramindriyam । tasya śabdaṃ guṇaṃ vidyānmūrtiśāstravidhānavit ॥3॥
html:
antarātmakamākāśaṃ tanmayaṃ śrotramindriyam ।
tasya śabdaṃ guṇaṃ vidyānmūrtiśāstravidhānavit ॥3॥
slp1: antarAtmakamAkASaM tanmayaM Srotramindriyam । tasya SabdaM guRaM vidyAnmUrtiSAstraviDAnavit ॥3॥

text: caraṇaṃ mārutātmeti prāṇāpānau ca tanmayau । sparśanaṃ cendriyaṃ vidyāttathā sparśaṃ ca tanmayam ॥4॥
html:
caraṇaṃ mārutātmeti prāṇāpānau ca tanmayau ।
sparśanaṃ cendriyaṃ vidyāttathā sparśaṃ ca tanmayam ॥4॥
slp1: caraRaM mArutAtmeti prARApAnO ca tanmayO । sparSanaM cendriyaM vidyAttaTA sparSaM ca tanmayam ॥4॥

text: tataḥ pākaḥ prakāśaśca jyotiścakṣuśca tanmayam । tasya rūpaṃ guṇaṃ vidyāttamo'nvavasitātmakam ॥5॥
html:
tataḥ pākaḥ prakāśaśca jyotiścakṣuśca tanmayam ।
tasya rūpaṃ guṇaṃ vidyāttamo'nvavasitātmakam ॥5॥
slp1: tataH pAkaH prakASaSca jyotiScakzuSca tanmayam । tasya rUpaM guRaM vidyAttamo'nvavasitAtmakam ॥5॥

text: prakledaḥ kṣudratā sneha ityāpo hyupadiśyate । rasanaṃ cendriyaṃ jihvā rasaścāpāṃ guṇo mataḥ ॥6॥
html:
prakledaḥ kṣudratā sneha ityāpo hyupadiśyate ।
rasanaṃ cendriyaṃ jihvā rasaścāpāṃ guṇo mataḥ ॥6॥
slp1: prakledaH kzudratA sneha ityApo hyupadiSyate । rasanaM cendriyaM jihvA rasaScApAM guRo mataH ॥6॥

text: saṅghātaḥ pārthivo dhāturasthidantanakhāni ca । śmaśru loma ca keśāśca sirāḥ snāyu ca carma ca ॥7॥
html:
saṅghātaḥ pārthivo dhāturasthidantanakhāni ca ।
