śmaśru loma ca keśāśca sirāḥ snāyu ca carma ca ॥7॥
slp1: saNGAtaH pArTivo DAturasTidantanaKAni ca । SmaSru loma ca keSASca sirAH snAyu ca carma ca ॥7॥

text: indriyaṃ ghrāṇasañjñānaṃ nāsiketyabhidhīyate । gandhaścaivendriyārtho'yaṃ vijñeyaḥ pṛthivīmayaḥ ॥8॥
html:
indriyaṃ ghrāṇasañjñānaṃ nāsiketyabhidhīyate ।
gandhaścaivendriyārtho'yaṃ vijñeyaḥ pṛthivīmayaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: indriyaM GrARasaYjYAnaM nAsiketyaBiDIyate । ganDaScEvendriyArTo'yaM vijYeyaH pfTivImayaH ॥8॥

text: uttareṣu guṇāḥ santi sarve sarveṣu cottarāḥ । pañcānāṃ bhūtasaṅghānāṃ santatiṃ munayo viduḥ ॥9॥
html:
uttareṣu guṇāḥ santi sarve sarveṣu cottarāḥ ।
pañcānāṃ bhūtasaṅghānāṃ santatiṃ munayo viduḥ ॥9॥
slp1: uttarezu guRAH santi sarve sarvezu cottarAH । paYcAnAM BUtasaNGAnAM santatiM munayo viduH ॥9॥

text: mano navamameṣāṃ tu buddhistu daśamī smṛtā । ekādaśo'ntarātmā ca sarvataḥ para ucyate ॥10॥
html:
mano navamameṣāṃ tu buddhistu daśamī smṛtā ।
ekādaśo'ntarātmā ca sarvataḥ para ucyate ॥10॥
slp1: mano navamamezAM tu budDistu daSamI smftA । ekAdaSo'ntarAtmA ca sarvataH para ucyate ॥10॥

text: vyavasāyātmikā buddhirmano vyākaraṇātmakam । karmānumānādvijñeyaḥ sa jīvaḥ kṣetrasañjñakaḥ ॥11॥
html:
vyavasāyātmikā buddhirmano vyākaraṇātmakam ।
karmānumānādvijñeyaḥ sa jīvaḥ kṣetrasañjñakaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: vyavasAyAtmikA budDirmano vyAkaraRAtmakam । karmAnumAnAdvijYeyaH sa jIvaH kzetrasaYjYakaH ॥11॥

text: ebhiḥ kālāṣṭamairbhāvairyaḥ sarvaiḥ sarvamanvitam । paśyatyakaluṣaṃ prājñaḥ sa mohaṃ nānuvartate] ॥12॥
html:
ebhiḥ kālāṣṭamairbhāvairyaḥ sarvaiḥ sarvamanvitam ।
paśyatyakaluṣaṃ prājñaḥ sa mohaṃ nānuvartate] ॥12॥
slp1: eBiH kAlAzwamErBAvEryaH sarvEH sarvamanvitam । paSyatyakaluzaM prAjYaH sa mohaM nAnuvartate] ॥12॥

text: śarīrādvipramuktaṃ hi sūkṣmabhūtaṃ śarīriṇam । karmabhiḥ paripaśyanti śāstroktaiḥ śāstracetasaḥ ॥1॥
html:
śarīrādvipramuktaṃ hi sūkṣmabhūtaṃ śarīriṇam ।
karmabhiḥ paripaśyanti śāstroktaiḥ śāstracetasaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: SarIrAdvipramuktaM hi sUkzmaBUtaM SarIriRam । karmaBiH paripaSyanti SAstroktEH SAstracetasaH ॥1॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: yathā marīcyaḥ sahitāścaranti gacchanti tiṣṭhanti ca dṛśyamānāḥ । dehairvimuktā vicaranti lokāṃstathaiva sattvānyatimānuṣāṇi ॥2॥
html:
yathā marīcyaḥ sahitāścaranti gacchanti tiṣṭhanti ca dṛśyamānāḥ ।
dehairvimuktā vicaranti lokāṃstathaiva sattvānyatimānuṣāṇi ॥2॥
slp1: yaTA marIcyaH sahitAScaranti gacCanti tizWanti ca dfSyamAnAH । dehErvimuktA vicaranti lokAMstaTEva sattvAnyatimAnuzARi ॥2॥

text: pratirūpaṃ yathaivāpsu tāpaḥ sūryasya lakṣyate । sattvavāṃstu tathā sattvaṃ pratirūpaṃ prapaśyati ॥3॥
html:
pratirūpaṃ yathaivāpsu tāpaḥ sūryasya lakṣyate ।
sattvavāṃstu tathā sattvaṃ pratirūpaṃ prapaśyati ॥3॥
slp1: pratirUpaM yaTEvApsu tApaH sUryasya lakzyate । sattvavAMstu taTA sattvaM pratirUpaM prapaSyati ॥3॥

text: tāni sūkṣmāṇi sattvasthā vimuktāni śarīrataḥ । svena tattvena tattvajñāḥ paśyanti niyatendriyāḥ ॥4॥
html:
tāni sūkṣmāṇi sattvasthā vimuktāni śarīrataḥ ।
svena tattvena tattvajñāḥ paśyanti niyatendriyāḥ ॥4॥
slp1: tAni sUkzmARi sattvasTA vimuktAni SarIrataH । svena tattvena tattvajYAH paSyanti niyatendriyAH ॥4॥

text: svapatāṃ jāgratāṃ caiva sarveṣāmātmacintitam । pradhānadvaidhayuktānāṃ jahatāṃ karmajaṃ rajaḥ ॥5॥
html:
svapatāṃ jāgratāṃ caiva sarveṣāmātmacintitam ।
pradhānadvaidhayuktānāṃ jahatāṃ karmajaṃ rajaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: svapatAM jAgratAM cEva sarvezAmAtmacintitam । praDAnadvEDayuktAnAM jahatAM karmajaM rajaH ॥5॥

text: yathāhani tathā rātrau yathā rātrau tathāhani । vaśe tiṣṭhati sattvātmā satataṃ yogayoginām ॥6॥
html:
yathāhani tathā rātrau yathā rātrau tathāhani ।
vaśe tiṣṭhati sattvātmā satataṃ yogayoginām ॥6॥
slp1: yaTAhani taTA rAtrO yaTA rAtrO taTAhani । vaSe tizWati sattvAtmA satataM yogayoginAm ॥6॥

text: teṣāṃ nityaṃ sadānityo bhūtātmā satataṃ guṇaiḥ । saptabhistvanvitaḥ sūkṣmaiścariṣṇurajarāmaraḥ ॥7॥
html:
teṣāṃ nityaṃ sadānityo bhūtātmā satataṃ guṇaiḥ ।
saptabhistvanvitaḥ sūkṣmaiścariṣṇurajarāmaraḥ ॥7॥
slp1: tezAM nityaM sadAnityo BUtAtmA satataM guREH । saptaBistvanvitaH sUkzmEScarizRurajarAmaraH ॥7॥

text: manobuddhiparābhūtaḥ svadehaparadehavit । svapneṣvapi bhavatyeṣa vijñātā sukhaduḥkhayoḥ ॥8॥
html:
manobuddhiparābhūtaḥ svadehaparadehavit ।
svapneṣvapi bhavatyeṣa vijñātā sukhaduḥkhayoḥ ॥8॥
slp1: manobudDiparABUtaH svadehaparadehavit । svapnezvapi Bavatyeza vijYAtA suKaduHKayoH ॥8॥

text: tatrāpi labhate duḥkhaṃ tatrāpi labhate sukham । krodhalobhau tu tatrāpi kṛtvā vyasanamarchati ॥9॥
html:
tatrāpi labhate duḥkhaṃ tatrāpi labhate sukham ।
krodhalobhau tu tatrāpi kṛtvā vyasanamarchati ॥9॥
slp1: tatrApi laBate duHKaM tatrApi laBate suKam । kroDaloBO tu tatrApi kftvA vyasanamarCati ॥9॥

text: prīṇitaścāpi bhavati mahato'rthānavāpya ca । karoti puṇyaṃ tatrāpi jāgranniva ca paśyati ॥10॥
html:
prīṇitaścāpi bhavati mahato'rthānavāpya ca ।
karoti puṇyaṃ tatrāpi jāgranniva ca paśyati ॥10॥
slp1: prIRitaScApi Bavati mahato'rTAnavApya ca । karoti puRyaM tatrApi jAgranniva ca paSyati ॥10॥

text: tamevamatitejoṃśaṃ bhūtātmānaṃ hṛdi sthitam । tamorajobhyāmāviṣṭā nānupaśyanti mūrtiṣu ॥11॥
html:
tamevamatitejoṃśaṃ bhūtātmānaṃ hṛdi sthitam ।
tamorajobhyāmāviṣṭā nānupaśyanti mūrtiṣu ॥11॥
slp1: tamevamatitejoMSaM BUtAtmAnaM hfdi sTitam । tamorajoByAmAvizwA nAnupaSyanti mUrtizu ॥11॥

text: śāstrayogaparā bhūtvā svamātmānaṃ parīpsavaḥ । anucchvāsānyamūrtīni yāni vajropamānyapi ॥12॥
html:
śāstrayogaparā bhūtvā svamātmānaṃ parīpsavaḥ ।
anucchvāsānyamūrtīni yāni vajropamānyapi ॥12॥
slp1: SAstrayogaparA BUtvA svamAtmAnaM parIpsavaH । anucCvAsAnyamUrtIni yAni vajropamAnyapi ॥12॥

text: pṛthagbhūteṣu sṛṣṭeṣu caturṣvāśramakarmasu । samādhau yogamevaitacchāṇḍilyaḥ śamamabravīt ॥13॥
html:
pṛthagbhūteṣu sṛṣṭeṣu caturṣvāśramakarmasu ।
samādhau yogamevaitacchāṇḍilyaḥ śamamabravīt ॥13॥
slp1: pfTagBUtezu sfzwezu caturzvASramakarmasu । samADO yogamevEtacCARqilyaH SamamabravIt ॥13॥

text: viditvā sapta sūkṣmāṇi ṣaḍaṅgaṃ ca maheśvaram । pradhānaviniyogasthaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati] ॥14॥
html:
viditvā sapta sūkṣmāṇi ṣaḍaṅgaṃ ca maheśvaram ।
pradhānaviniyogasthaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati] ॥14॥
slp1: viditvA sapta sUkzmARi zaqaNgaM ca maheSvaram । praDAnaviniyogasTaH paraM brahmADigacCati] ॥14॥

text: hṛdi kāmadrumaścitro mohasañcayasambhavaḥ । krodhamānamahāskandho vivitsāparimocanaḥ ॥1॥
html:
hṛdi kāmadrumaścitro mohasañcayasambhavaḥ ।
krodhamānamahāskandho vivitsāparimocanaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: hfdi kAmadrumaScitro mohasaYcayasamBavaH । kroDamAnamahAskanDo vivitsAparimocanaH ॥1॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: tasya cājñānamādhāraḥ pramādaḥ pariṣecanam । so'bhyasūyāpalāśo hi purāduṣkṛtasāravān ॥2॥
html:
tasya cājñānamādhāraḥ pramādaḥ pariṣecanam ।
so'bhyasūyāpalāśo hi purāduṣkṛtasāravān ॥2॥
slp1: tasya cAjYAnamADAraH pramAdaH parizecanam । so'ByasUyApalASo hi purAduzkftasAravAn ॥2॥

text: sammohacintāviṭapaḥ śokaśākho bhayaṅkaraḥ । mohanībhiḥ pipāsābhirlatābhiḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ ॥3॥
html:
sammohacintāviṭapaḥ śokaśākho bhayaṅkaraḥ ।
mohanībhiḥ pipāsābhirlatābhiḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: sammohacintAviwapaH SokaSAKo BayaNkaraH । mohanIBiH pipAsABirlatABiH parivezwitaH ॥3॥

text: upāsate mahāvṛkṣaṃ sulubdhāstaṃ phalepsavaḥ । āyāsaiḥ saṃyataḥ pāśaiḥ phalāni pariveṣṭayan ॥4॥
html:
upāsate mahāvṛkṣaṃ sulubdhāstaṃ phalepsavaḥ ।
āyāsaiḥ saṃyataḥ pāśaiḥ phalāni pariveṣṭayan ॥4॥
slp1: upAsate mahAvfkzaM sulubDAstaM PalepsavaH । AyAsEH saMyataH pASEH PalAni parivezwayan ॥4॥

text: yastānpāśānvaśe kṛtvā taṃ vṛkṣamapakarṣati । gataḥ sa duḥkhayorantaṃ yatamānastayordvayoḥ ॥5॥
html:
yastānpāśānvaśe kṛtvā taṃ vṛkṣamapakarṣati ।
gataḥ sa duḥkhayorantaṃ yatamānastayordvayoḥ ॥5॥
slp1: yastAnpASAnvaSe kftvA taM vfkzamapakarzati । gataH sa duHKayorantaM yatamAnastayordvayoH ॥5॥

text: saṃrohatyakṛtaprajñaḥ santāpena hi pādapam । sa tameva tato hanti viṣaṃ grastamivāturam ॥6॥
html:
saṃrohatyakṛtaprajñaḥ santāpena hi pādapam ।
sa tameva tato hanti viṣaṃ grastamivāturam ॥6॥
slp1: saMrohatyakftaprajYaH santApena hi pAdapam । sa tameva tato hanti vizaM grastamivAturam ॥6॥

text: tasyānuśayamūlasya mūlamuddhriyate balāt । tyāgāpramādākṛtinā sāmyena paramāsinā ॥7॥
html:
tasyānuśayamūlasya mūlamuddhriyate balāt ।
tyāgāpramādākṛtinā sāmyena paramāsinā ॥7॥
slp1: tasyAnuSayamUlasya mUlamudDriyate balAt । tyAgApramAdAkftinA sAmyena paramAsinA ॥7॥

text: evaṃ yo veda kāmasya kevalaṃ parikarṣaṇam । vadhaṃ vai kāmaśāstrasya sa duḥkhānyativartate ॥8॥
html:
evaṃ yo veda kāmasya kevalaṃ parikarṣaṇam ।
vadhaṃ vai kāmaśāstrasya sa duḥkhānyativartate ॥8॥
slp1: evaM yo veda kAmasya kevalaM parikarzaRam । vaDaM vE kAmaSAstrasya sa duHKAnyativartate ॥8॥

text: śarīraṃ puramityāhuḥ svāminī buddhiriṣyate । tatra buddheḥ śarīrasthaṃ mano nāmārthacintakam ॥9॥
html:
śarīraṃ puramityāhuḥ svāminī buddhiriṣyate ।
tatra buddheḥ śarīrasthaṃ mano nāmārthacintakam ॥9॥
slp1: SarIraM puramityAhuH svAminI budDirizyate । tatra budDeH SarIrasTaM mano nAmArTacintakam ॥9॥

text: indriyāṇi janāḥ paurāstadarthaṃ tu parā kṛtiḥ । tatra dvau dāruṇau doṣau tamo nāma rajastathā ॥10॥
html:
indriyāṇi janāḥ paurāstadarthaṃ tu parā kṛtiḥ ।
tatra dvau dāruṇau doṣau tamo nāma rajastathā ॥10॥
slp1: indriyARi janAH pOrAstadarTaM tu parA kftiH । tatra dvO dAruRO dozO tamo nAma rajastaTA ॥10॥

text: yadarthamupajīvanti paurāḥ sahapureśvarāḥ । advāreṇa tamevārthaṃ dvau doṣāvupajīvataḥ ॥11॥
html:
yadarthamupajīvanti paurāḥ sahapureśvarāḥ ।
advāreṇa tamevārthaṃ dvau doṣāvupajīvataḥ ॥11॥
slp1: yadarTamupajIvanti pOrAH sahapureSvarAH । advAreRa tamevArTaM dvO dozAvupajIvataH ॥11॥

text: tatra buddhirhi durdharṣā manaḥ sādharmyamucyate । paurāścāpi manastrastāsteṣāmapi calā sthitiḥ ॥12॥
html:
tatra buddhirhi durdharṣā manaḥ sādharmyamucyate ।
paurāścāpi manastrastāsteṣāmapi calā sthitiḥ ॥12॥
slp1: tatra budDirhi durDarzA manaH sADarmyamucyate । pOrAScApi manastrastAstezAmapi calA sTitiH ॥12॥

text: yadarthaṃ buddhiradhyāste na so'rthaḥ pariṣīdati । yadarthaṃ pṛthagadhyāste manastatpariṣīdati ॥13॥
html:
yadarthaṃ buddhiradhyāste na so'rthaḥ pariṣīdati ।
yadarthaṃ pṛthagadhyāste manastatpariṣīdati ॥13॥
slp1: yadarTaM budDiraDyAste na so'rTaH parizIdati । yadarTaM pfTagaDyAste manastatparizIdati ॥13॥

text: pṛthagbhūtaṃ yadā buddhyā mano bhavati kevalam । tatrainaṃ vivṛtaṃ śūnyaṃ rajaḥ paryavatiṣṭhate ॥14॥
html:
pṛthagbhūtaṃ yadā buddhyā mano bhavati kevalam ।
tatrainaṃ vivṛtaṃ śūnyaṃ rajaḥ paryavatiṣṭhate ॥14॥
slp1: pfTagBUtaM yadA budDyA mano Bavati kevalam । tatrEnaM vivftaM SUnyaM rajaH paryavatizWate ॥14॥

text: tanmanaḥ kurute sakhyaṃ rajasā saha saṅgatam । taṃ cādāya janaṃ pauraṃ rajase samprayacchati] ॥15॥
html:
tanmanaḥ kurute sakhyaṃ rajasā saha saṅgatam ।
taṃ cādāya janaṃ pauraṃ rajase samprayacchati] ॥15॥
slp1: tanmanaH kurute saKyaM rajasA saha saNgatam । taM cAdAya janaM pOraM rajase samprayacCati] ॥15॥

text: bhūtānāṃ guṇasaṅkhyānaṃ bhūyaḥ putra niśāmaya । dvaipāyanamukhādbhraṣṭaṃ ślāghayā parayānagha ॥1॥
html:
bhūtānāṃ guṇasaṅkhyānaṃ bhūyaḥ putra niśāmaya ।
dvaipāyanamukhādbhraṣṭaṃ ślāghayā parayānagha ॥1॥
slp1: BUtAnAM guRasaNKyAnaM BUyaH putra niSAmaya । dvEpAyanamuKAdBrazwaM SlAGayA parayAnaGa ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dīptānalanibhaḥ prāha bhagavāndhūmravarcase । tato'hamapi vakṣyāmi bhūyaḥ putra nidarśanam ॥2॥
html:
dīptānalanibhaḥ prāha bhagavāndhūmravarcase ।
tato'hamapi vakṣyāmi bhūyaḥ putra nidarśanam ॥2॥
slp1: dIptAnalaniBaH prAha BagavAnDUmravarcase । tato'hamapi vakzyAmi BUyaH putra nidarSanam ॥2॥

text: bhūmeḥ sthairyaṃ pṛthutvaṃ ca kāṭhinyaṃ prasavātmatā । gandho gurutvaṃ śaktiśca saṅghātaḥ sthāpanā dhṛtiḥ ॥3॥
html:
bhūmeḥ sthairyaṃ pṛthutvaṃ ca kāṭhinyaṃ prasavātmatā ।
gandho gurutvaṃ śaktiśca saṅghātaḥ sthāpanā dhṛtiḥ ॥3॥
slp1: BUmeH sTEryaM pfTutvaM ca kAWinyaM prasavAtmatA । ganDo gurutvaM SaktiSca saNGAtaH sTApanA DftiH ॥3॥

text: apāṃ śaityaṃ rasaḥ kledo dravatvaṃ snehasaumyatā । jihvā viṣyandinī caiva bhaumāpyāsravaṇaṃ tathā ॥4॥
html:
apāṃ śaityaṃ rasaḥ kledo dravatvaṃ snehasaumyatā ।
jihvā viṣyandinī caiva bhaumāpyāsravaṇaṃ tathā ॥4॥
slp1: apAM SEtyaM rasaH kledo dravatvaM snehasOmyatA । jihvA vizyandinI cEva BOmApyAsravaRaM taTA ॥4॥

text: agnerdurdharṣatā tejastāpaḥ pākaḥ prakāśanam । śaucaṃ rāgo laghustaikṣṇyaṃ daśamaṃ cordhvabhāgitā ॥5॥
html:
agnerdurdharṣatā tejastāpaḥ pākaḥ prakāśanam ।
śaucaṃ rāgo laghustaikṣṇyaṃ daśamaṃ cordhvabhāgitā ॥5॥
slp1: agnerdurDarzatA tejastApaH pAkaH prakASanam । SOcaM rAgo laGustEkzRyaM daSamaM corDvaBAgitA ॥5॥

text: vāyoraniyamaḥ sparśo vādasthānaṃ svatantratā । balaṃ śaighryaṃ ca mohaśca ceṣṭā karmakṛtā bhavaḥ ॥6॥
html:
vāyoraniyamaḥ sparśo vādasthānaṃ svatantratā ।
balaṃ śaighryaṃ ca mohaśca ceṣṭā karmakṛtā bhavaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: vAyoraniyamaH sparSo vAdasTAnaM svatantratA । balaM SEGryaM ca mohaSca cezwA karmakftA BavaH ॥6॥

text: ākāśasya guṇaḥ śabdo vyāpitvaṃ chidratāpi ca । anāśrayamanālambamavyaktamavikāritā ॥7॥
html:
ākāśasya guṇaḥ śabdo vyāpitvaṃ chidratāpi ca ।
anāśrayamanālambamavyaktamavikāritā ॥7॥
slp1: AkASasya guRaH Sabdo vyApitvaM CidratApi ca । anASrayamanAlambamavyaktamavikAritA ॥7॥

text: apratīghātatā caiva bhūtatvaṃ vikṛtāni ca । guṇāḥ pañcāśataṃ proktāḥ pañcabhūtātmabhāvitāḥ ॥8॥
html:
apratīghātatā caiva bhūtatvaṃ vikṛtāni ca ।
guṇāḥ pañcāśataṃ proktāḥ pañcabhūtātmabhāvitāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: apratIGAtatA cEva BUtatvaM vikftAni ca । guRAH paYcASataM proktAH paYcaBUtAtmaBAvitAH ॥8॥

text: calopapattirvyaktiśca visargaḥ kalpanā kṣamā । sadasaccāśutā caiva manaso nava vai guṇāḥ ॥9॥
html:
calopapattirvyaktiśca visargaḥ kalpanā kṣamā ।
sadasaccāśutā caiva manaso nava vai guṇāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: calopapattirvyaktiSca visargaH kalpanA kzamA । sadasaccASutA cEva manaso nava vE guRAH ॥9॥

text: iṣṭāniṣṭavikalpaśca vyavasāyaḥ samādhitā । saṃśayaḥ pratipattiśca buddhau pañceha ye guṇāḥ ॥10॥
html:
iṣṭāniṣṭavikalpaśca vyavasāyaḥ samādhitā ।
saṃśayaḥ pratipattiśca buddhau pañceha ye guṇāḥ ॥10॥
slp1: izwAnizwavikalpaSca vyavasAyaH samADitA । saMSayaH pratipattiSca budDO paYceha ye guRAH ॥10॥

text: kathaṃ pañcaguṇā buddhiḥ kathaṃ pañcendriyā guṇāḥ । etanme sarvamācakṣva sūkṣmajñānaṃ pitāmaha ॥11॥
html:
kathaṃ pañcaguṇā buddhiḥ kathaṃ pañcendriyā guṇāḥ ।
etanme sarvamācakṣva sūkṣmajñānaṃ pitāmaha ॥11॥
slp1: kaTaM paYcaguRA budDiH kaTaM paYcendriyA guRAH । etanme sarvamAcakzva sUkzmajYAnaM pitAmaha ॥11॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: āhuḥ ṣaṣṭiṃ bhūtaguṇānvai bhūtaviśiṣṭā nityaviṣaktāḥ । bhūtaviṣaktāścākṣarasṛṣṭāḥ putra na nityaṃ tadiha vadanti ॥12॥
html:
āhuḥ ṣaṣṭiṃ bhūtaguṇānvai bhūtaviśiṣṭā nityaviṣaktāḥ ।
bhūtaviṣaktāścākṣarasṛṣṭāḥ putra na nityaṃ tadiha vadanti ॥12॥
slp1: AhuH zazwiM BUtaguRAnvE BUtaviSizwA nityavizaktAH । BUtavizaktAScAkzarasfzwAH putra na nityaM tadiha vadanti ॥12॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tatputra cintākalitaṃ yaduktamanāgataṃ vai tava sampratīha । bhūtārthatattvaṃ tadavāpya sarvaṃ bhūtaprabhāvādbhava śāntabuddhiḥ] ॥13॥
html:
tatputra cintākalitaṃ yaduktamanāgataṃ vai tava sampratīha ।
bhūtārthatattvaṃ tadavāpya sarvaṃ bhūtaprabhāvādbhava śāntabuddhiḥ] ॥13॥
slp1: tatputra cintAkalitaM yaduktamanAgataM vE tava sampratIha । BUtArTatattvaM tadavApya sarvaM BUtapraBAvAdBava SAntabudDiH] ॥13॥

text: ya ime pṛthivīpālāḥ śerate pṛthivītale । pṛtanāmadhya ete hi gatasattvā mahābalāḥ ॥1॥
html:
ya ime pṛthivīpālāḥ śerate pṛthivītale ।
pṛtanāmadhya ete hi gatasattvā mahābalāḥ ॥1॥
slp1: ya ime pfTivIpAlAH Serate pfTivItale । pftanAmaDya ete hi gatasattvA mahAbalAH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: ekaikaśo bhīmabalā nāgāyutabalāstathā । ete hi nihatāḥ saṅkhye tulyatejobalairnaraiḥ ॥2॥
html:
ekaikaśo bhīmabalā nāgāyutabalāstathā ।
ete hi nihatāḥ saṅkhye tulyatejobalairnaraiḥ ॥2॥
slp1: ekEkaSo BImabalA nAgAyutabalAstaTA । ete hi nihatAH saNKye tulyatejobalErnarEH ॥2॥

text: naiṣāṃ paśyāmi hantāraṃ prāṇināṃ saṃyuge purā । vikrameṇopasaṃpannāstejobalasamanvitāḥ ॥3॥
html:
naiṣāṃ paśyāmi hantāraṃ prāṇināṃ saṃyuge purā ।
vikrameṇopasaṃpannāstejobalasamanvitāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: nEzAM paSyAmi hantAraM prARinAM saMyuge purA । vikrameRopasaMpannAstejobalasamanvitAH ॥3॥

text: atha ceme mahāprājña śerate hi gatāsavaḥ । mṛtā iti ca śabdo'yaṃ vartatyeṣu gatāsuṣu ॥4॥
html:
atha ceme mahāprājña śerate hi gatāsavaḥ ।
mṛtā iti ca śabdo'yaṃ vartatyeṣu gatāsuṣu ॥4॥
slp1: aTa ceme mahAprAjYa Serate hi gatAsavaH । mftA iti ca Sabdo'yaM vartatyezu gatAsuzu ॥4॥

text: ime mṛtā nṛpatayaḥ prāyaśo bhīmavikramāḥ । tatra me saṃśayo jātaḥ kutaḥ sañjñā mṛtā iti ॥5॥
html:
ime mṛtā nṛpatayaḥ prāyaśo bhīmavikramāḥ ।
tatra me saṃśayo jātaḥ kutaḥ sañjñā mṛtā iti ॥5॥
slp1: ime mftA nfpatayaH prAyaSo BImavikramAH । tatra me saMSayo jAtaH kutaH saYjYA mftA iti ॥5॥

text: kasya mṛtyuḥ kuto mṛtyuḥ kena mṛtyuriha prajāḥ । haratyamarasaṅkāśa tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥6॥
html:
kasya mṛtyuḥ kuto mṛtyuḥ kena mṛtyuriha prajāḥ ।
haratyamarasaṅkāśa tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥6॥
slp1: kasya mftyuH kuto mftyuH kena mftyuriha prajAH । haratyamarasaNkASa tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥6॥

text: purā kṛtayuge tāta rājāsīdavikampakaḥ । sa śatruvaśamāpannaḥ saṅgrāme kṣīṇavāhanaḥ ॥7॥
html:
purā kṛtayuge tāta rājāsīdavikampakaḥ ।
sa śatruvaśamāpannaḥ saṅgrāme kṣīṇavāhanaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: purA kftayuge tAta rAjAsIdavikampakaH । sa SatruvaSamApannaH saNgrAme kzIRavAhanaH ॥7॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tatra putro harirnāma nārāyaṇasamo bale । sa śatrubhirhataḥ saṅkhye sabalaḥ sapadānugaḥ ॥8॥
html:
tatra putro harirnāma nārāyaṇasamo bale ।
sa śatrubhirhataḥ saṅkhye sabalaḥ sapadānugaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tatra putro harirnAma nArAyaRasamo bale । sa SatruBirhataH saNKye sabalaH sapadAnugaH ॥8॥

text: sa rājā śatruvaśagaḥ putraśokasamanvitaḥ । yadṛcchayāśāntiparo dadarśa bhuvi nāradam ॥9॥
html:
sa rājā śatruvaśagaḥ putraśokasamanvitaḥ ।
yadṛcchayāśāntiparo dadarśa bhuvi nāradam ॥9॥
slp1: sa rAjA SatruvaSagaH putraSokasamanvitaH । yadfcCayASAntiparo dadarSa Buvi nAradam ॥9॥

text: sa tasmai sarvamācaṣṭa yathā vṛttaṃ janeśvaraḥ । śatrubhirgrahaṇaṃ saṅkhye putrasya maraṇaṃ tathā ॥10॥
html:
sa tasmai sarvamācaṣṭa yathā vṛttaṃ janeśvaraḥ ।
śatrubhirgrahaṇaṃ saṅkhye putrasya maraṇaṃ tathā ॥10॥
slp1: sa tasmE sarvamAcazwa yaTA vfttaM janeSvaraH । SatruBirgrahaRaM saNKye putrasya maraRaM taTA ॥10॥

text: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā nārado'tha tapodhanaḥ । ākhyānamidamācaṣṭa putraśokāpahaṃ tadā ॥11॥
html:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā nārado'tha tapodhanaḥ ।
ākhyānamidamācaṣṭa putraśokāpahaṃ tadā ॥11॥
slp1: tasya tadvacanaM SrutvA nArado'Ta tapoDanaH । AKyAnamidamAcazwa putraSokApahaM tadA ॥11॥

text: rājañśṛṇu samākhyānamadyedaṃ bahuvistaram । yathā vṛttaṃ śrutaṃ caiva mayāpi vasudhādhipa ॥12॥
html:
rājañśṛṇu samākhyānamadyedaṃ bahuvistaram ।
yathā vṛttaṃ śrutaṃ caiva mayāpi vasudhādhipa ॥12॥
slp1: rAjaYSfRu samAKyAnamadyedaM bahuvistaram । yaTA vfttaM SrutaM cEva mayApi vasuDADipa ॥12॥

text: prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā mahātejāḥ prajāsarge pitāmahaḥ । atīva vṛddhā bahulā nāmṛṣyata punaḥ prajāḥ ॥13॥
html:
prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā mahātejāḥ prajāsarge pitāmahaḥ ।
atīva vṛddhā bahulā nāmṛṣyata punaḥ prajāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: prajAH sfzwvA mahAtejAH prajAsarge pitAmahaH । atIva vfdDA bahulA nAmfzyata punaH prajAH ॥13॥

text: na hyantaramabhūtkiñcitkvacijjantubhiracyuta । nirucchvāsamivonnaddhaṃ trailokyamabhavannṛpa ॥14॥
html:
na hyantaramabhūtkiñcitkvacijjantubhiracyuta ।
nirucchvāsamivonnaddhaṃ trailokyamabhavannṛpa ॥14॥
slp1: na hyantaramaBUtkiYcitkvacijjantuBiracyuta । nirucCvAsamivonnadDaM trElokyamaBavannfpa ॥14॥

text: tasya cintā samutpannā saṃhāraṃ prati bhūpate । cintayannādhyagacchacca saṃhāre hetukāraṇam ॥15॥
html:
tasya cintā samutpannā saṃhāraṃ prati bhūpate ।
cintayannādhyagacchacca saṃhāre hetukāraṇam ॥15॥
slp1: tasya cintA samutpannA saMhAraM prati BUpate । cintayannADyagacCacca saMhAre hetukAraRam ॥15॥

text: tasya roṣānmahārāja khebhyo'gnirudatiṣṭhata । tena sarvā diśo rājandadāha sa pitāmahaḥ ॥16॥
html:
tasya roṣānmahārāja khebhyo'gnirudatiṣṭhata ।
tena sarvā diśo rājandadāha sa pitāmahaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: tasya rozAnmahArAja KeByo'gnirudatizWata । tena sarvA diSo rAjandadAha sa pitAmahaH ॥16॥

text: tato divaṃ bhuvaṃ khaṃ ca jagacca sacarācaram । dadāha pāvako rājanbhagavatkopasambhavaḥ ॥17॥
html:
tato divaṃ bhuvaṃ khaṃ ca jagacca sacarācaram ।
dadāha pāvako rājanbhagavatkopasambhavaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: tato divaM BuvaM KaM ca jagacca sacarAcaram । dadAha pAvako rAjanBagavatkopasamBavaH ॥17॥

text: tatrādahyanta bhūtāni jaṅgamāni dhruvāṇi ca । mahatā kopavegena kupite prapitāmahe ॥18॥
html:
tatrādahyanta bhūtāni jaṅgamāni dhruvāṇi ca ।
mahatā kopavegena kupite prapitāmahe ॥18॥
slp1: tatrAdahyanta BUtAni jaNgamAni DruvARi ca । mahatA kopavegena kupite prapitAmahe ॥18॥

text: tato harijaṭaḥ sthāṇurvedādhvarapatiḥ śivaḥ । jagāda śaraṇaṃ devo brahmāṇaṃ paravīrahā ॥19॥
html:
tato harijaṭaḥ sthāṇurvedādhvarapatiḥ śivaḥ ।
jagāda śaraṇaṃ devo brahmāṇaṃ paravīrahā ॥19॥
slp1: tato harijawaH sTARurvedADvarapatiH SivaH । jagAda SaraRaM devo brahmARaM paravIrahA ॥19॥

text: tasminnabhigate sthāṇau prajānāṃ hitakāmyayā । abravīdvarado devo jvalanniva tadā śivam ॥20॥
html:
tasminnabhigate sthāṇau prajānāṃ hitakāmyayā ।
abravīdvarado devo jvalanniva tadā śivam ॥20॥
slp1: tasminnaBigate sTARO prajAnAM hitakAmyayA । abravIdvarado devo jvalanniva tadA Sivam ॥20॥

text: karavāṇyadya kaṃ kāmaṃ varārho'si mato mama । kartā hyasmi priyaṃ śambho tava yaddhṛdi vartate] ॥21॥
html:
karavāṇyadya kaṃ kāmaṃ varārho'si mato mama ।
kartā hyasmi priyaṃ śambho tava yaddhṛdi vartate] ॥21॥
slp1: karavARyadya kaM kAmaM varArho'si mato mama । kartA hyasmi priyaM SamBo tava yadDfdi vartate] ॥21॥

text: prajāsarganimittaṃ me kāryavattāmimāṃ prabho । viddhi sṛṣṭāstvayā hīmā mā kupyāsāṃ pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
prajāsarganimittaṃ me kāryavattāmimāṃ prabho ।
viddhi sṛṣṭāstvayā hīmā mā kupyāsāṃ pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: prajAsarganimittaM me kAryavattAmimAM praBo । vidDi sfzwAstvayA hImA mA kupyAsAM pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: sthāṇuruvāca ।

text: tava tejogninā deva prajā dahyanti sarvaśaḥ । tā dṛṣṭvā mama kāruṇyaṃ mā kupyāsāṃ jagatprabho ॥2॥
html:
tava tejogninā deva prajā dahyanti sarvaśaḥ ।
tā dṛṣṭvā mama kāruṇyaṃ mā kupyāsāṃ jagatprabho ॥2॥
slp1: tava tejogninA deva prajA dahyanti sarvaSaH । tA dfzwvA mama kAruRyaM mA kupyAsAM jagatpraBo ॥2॥

text: na kupye na ca me kāmo na bhaveranprajā iti । lāghavārthaṃ dharaṇyāstu tataḥ saṃhāra iṣyate ॥3॥
html:
na kupye na ca me kāmo na bhaveranprajā iti ।
lāghavārthaṃ dharaṇyāstu tataḥ saṃhāra iṣyate ॥3॥
slp1: na kupye na ca me kAmo na BaveranprajA iti । lAGavArTaM DaraRyAstu tataH saMhAra izyate ॥3॥
author: prajāpatiruvāca ।

text: iyaṃ hi māṃ sadā devī bhārārtā samacodayat । saṃhārārthaṃ mahādeva bhāreṇāpsu nimajjati ॥4॥
html:
iyaṃ hi māṃ sadā devī bhārārtā samacodayat ।
saṃhārārthaṃ mahādeva bhāreṇāpsu nimajjati ॥4॥
slp1: iyaM hi mAM sadA devI BArArtA samacodayat । saMhArArTaM mahAdeva BAreRApsu nimajjati ॥4॥

text: yadāhaṃ nādhigacchāmi buddhyā bahu vicārayan । saṃhāramāsāṃ vṛddhānāṃ tato māṃ krodha āviśat ॥5॥
html:
yadāhaṃ nādhigacchāmi buddhyā bahu vicārayan ।
saṃhāramāsāṃ vṛddhānāṃ tato māṃ krodha āviśat ॥5॥
slp1: yadAhaM nADigacCAmi budDyA bahu vicArayan । saMhAramAsAM vfdDAnAM tato mAM kroDa AviSat ॥5॥

text: saṃhārāntaṃ prasīdasva mā krudhastridaśeśvara । mā prajāḥ sthāvaraṃ caiva jaṅgamaṃ ca vinīnaśaḥ ॥6॥
html:
saṃhārāntaṃ prasīdasva mā krudhastridaśeśvara ।
mā prajāḥ sthāvaraṃ caiva jaṅgamaṃ ca vinīnaśaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: saMhArAntaM prasIdasva mA kruDastridaSeSvara । mA prajAH sTAvaraM cEva jaNgamaM ca vinInaSaH ॥6॥
author: sthāṇuruvāca ।

text: palvalāni ca sarvāṇi sarvaṃ caiva tṛṇolapam । sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham ॥7॥
html:
palvalāni ca sarvāṇi sarvaṃ caiva tṛṇolapam ।
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham ॥7॥
slp1: palvalAni ca sarvARi sarvaM cEva tfRolapam । sTAvaraM jaNgamaM cEva BUtagrAmaM caturviDam ॥7॥

text: tadetadbhasmasādbhūtaṃ jagatsarvamupaplutam । prasīda bhagavansādho vara eṣa vṛto mayā ॥8॥
html:
tadetadbhasmasādbhūtaṃ jagatsarvamupaplutam ।
prasīda bhagavansādho vara eṣa vṛto mayā ॥8॥
slp1: tadetadBasmasAdBUtaM jagatsarvamupaplutam । prasIda BagavansADo vara eza vfto mayA ॥8॥

text: naṣṭā na punareṣyanti prajā hyetāḥ kathañcana । tasmānnivartyatāmetattejaḥ svenaiva tejasā ॥9॥
html:
naṣṭā na punareṣyanti prajā hyetāḥ kathañcana ।
tasmānnivartyatāmetattejaḥ svenaiva tejasā ॥9॥
slp1: nazwA na punarezyanti prajA hyetAH kaTaYcana । tasmAnnivartyatAmetattejaH svenEva tejasA ॥9॥

text: upāyamanyaṃ sampaśya prajānāṃ hitakāmyayā । yatheme jantavaḥ sarve nivarteranparantapa ॥10॥
html:
upāyamanyaṃ sampaśya prajānāṃ hitakāmyayā ।
yatheme jantavaḥ sarve nivarteranparantapa ॥10॥
slp1: upAyamanyaM sampaSya prajAnAM hitakAmyayA । yaTeme jantavaH sarve nivarteranparantapa ॥10॥

text: abhāvamabhigaccheyurutsannaprajanāḥ prajāḥ । adhidaivaniyukto'smi tvayā lokeṣviheśvara ॥11॥
html:
abhāvamabhigaccheyurutsannaprajanāḥ prajāḥ ।
adhidaivaniyukto'smi tvayā lokeṣviheśvara ॥11॥
slp1: aBAvamaBigacCeyurutsannaprajanAH prajAH । aDidEvaniyukto'smi tvayA lokezviheSvara ॥11॥

text: tvadbhavaṃ hi jagannātha jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam । prasādya tvāṃ mahādeva yācāmyāvṛttijāḥ prajāḥ ॥12॥
html:
tvadbhavaṃ hi jagannātha jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam ।
prasādya tvāṃ mahādeva yācāmyāvṛttijāḥ prajāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: tvadBavaM hi jagannATa jagatsTAvarajaNgamam । prasAdya tvAM mahAdeva yAcAmyAvfttijAH prajAH ॥12॥

text: śrutvā tu vacanaṃ devaḥ sthāṇorniyatavāṅmanāḥ । tejastatsvaṃ nijagrāha punarevāntarātmanā ॥13॥
html:
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ devaḥ sthāṇorniyatavāṅmanāḥ ।
tejastatsvaṃ nijagrāha punarevāntarātmanā ॥13॥
slp1: SrutvA tu vacanaM devaH sTARorniyatavANmanAH । tejastatsvaM nijagrAha punarevAntarAtmanA ॥13॥
author: nārada uvāca ।

text: tato'gnimupasaṅgṛhya bhagavāṁllokapūjitaḥ । pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca kalpayāmāsa vai prabhuḥ ॥14॥
html:
tato'gnimupasaṅgṛhya bhagavāṁllokapūjitaḥ ।
pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca kalpayāmāsa vai prabhuḥ ॥14॥
slp1: tato'gnimupasaNgfhya BagavAṁllokapUjitaH । pravfttiM ca nivfttiM ca kalpayAmAsa vE praBuH ॥14॥

text: upasaṃharatastasya tamagniṃ roṣajaṃ tadā । prādurbabhūva viśvebhyaḥ khebhyo nārī mahātmanaḥ ॥15॥
html:
upasaṃharatastasya tamagniṃ roṣajaṃ tadā ।
prādurbabhūva viśvebhyaḥ khebhyo nārī mahātmanaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: upasaMharatastasya tamagniM rozajaM tadA । prAdurbaBUva viSveByaH KeByo nArI mahAtmanaH ॥15॥

text: kṛṣṇā raktāmbaradharā raktanetratalāntarā । divyakuṇḍalasampannā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā ॥16॥
html:
kṛṣṇā raktāmbaradharā raktanetratalāntarā ।
divyakuṇḍalasampannā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā ॥16॥
slp1: kfzRA raktAmbaraDarA raktanetratalAntarA । divyakuRqalasampannA divyABaraRaBUzitA ॥16॥

text: sā viniḥsṛtya vai khebhyo dakṣiṇāmāśritā diśam । dadṛśāte'tha tau kanyāṃ devau viśveśvarāvubhau ॥17॥
html:
sā viniḥsṛtya vai khebhyo dakṣiṇāmāśritā diśam ।
dadṛśāte'tha tau kanyāṃ devau viśveśvarāvubhau ॥17॥
slp1: sA viniHsftya vE KeByo dakziRAmASritA diSam । dadfSAte'Ta tO kanyAM devO viSveSvarAvuBO ॥17॥

text: tāmāhūya tadā devo lokānāmādirīśvaraḥ । mṛtyo iti mahīpāla jahi cemāḥ prajā iti ॥18॥
html:
tāmāhūya tadā devo lokānāmādirīśvaraḥ ।
mṛtyo iti mahīpāla jahi cemāḥ prajā iti ॥18॥
slp1: tAmAhUya tadA devo lokAnAmAdirISvaraH । mftyo iti mahIpAla jahi cemAH prajA iti ॥18॥

text: tvaṃ hi saṃhārabuddhyā me cintitā ruṣitena ca । tasmātsaṃhara sarvāstvaṃ prajāḥ sajaḍapaṇḍitāḥ ॥19॥
html:
tvaṃ hi saṃhārabuddhyā me cintitā ruṣitena ca ।
tasmātsaṃhara sarvāstvaṃ prajāḥ sajaḍapaṇḍitāḥ ॥19॥
slp1: tvaM hi saMhArabudDyA me cintitA ruzitena ca । tasmAtsaMhara sarvAstvaM prajAH sajaqapaRqitAH ॥19॥

text: aviśeṣeṇa caiva tvaṃ prajāḥ saṃhara bhāmini । mama tvaṃ hi niyogena śreyaḥ paramavāpsyasi ॥20॥
html:
aviśeṣeṇa caiva tvaṃ prajāḥ saṃhara bhāmini ।
mama tvaṃ hi niyogena śreyaḥ paramavāpsyasi ॥20॥
slp1: aviSezeRa cEva tvaM prajAH saMhara BAmini । mama tvaM hi niyogena SreyaH paramavApsyasi ॥20॥

text: evamuktā tu sā devī mṛtyuḥ kamalamālinī । pradadhyau duḥkhitā bālā sāśrupātamatīva hi ॥21॥
html:
evamuktā tu sā devī mṛtyuḥ kamalamālinī ।
pradadhyau duḥkhitā bālā sāśrupātamatīva hi ॥21॥
slp1: evamuktA tu sA devI mftyuH kamalamAlinI । pradaDyO duHKitA bAlA sASrupAtamatIva hi ॥21॥

text: pāṇibhyāṃ caiva jagrāha tānyaśrūṇi janeśvaraḥ । mānavānāṃ hitārthāya yayāce punareva ca] ॥22॥
html:
pāṇibhyāṃ caiva jagrāha tānyaśrūṇi janeśvaraḥ ।
mānavānāṃ hitārthāya yayāce punareva ca] ॥22॥
slp1: pARiByAM cEva jagrAha tAnyaSrURi janeSvaraH । mAnavAnAM hitArTAya yayAce punareva ca] ॥22॥

text: vinīya duḥkhamabalā sā tvatīvāyatekṣaṇā । uvāca prāñjalirbhūtvā latevāvarjitā tadā ॥1॥
html:
vinīya duḥkhamabalā sā tvatīvāyatekṣaṇā ।
uvāca prāñjalirbhūtvā latevāvarjitā tadā ॥1॥
slp1: vinIya duHKamabalA sA tvatIvAyatekzaRA । uvAca prAYjalirBUtvA latevAvarjitA tadA ॥1॥
author: nārada uvāca ।

text: tvayā sṛṣṭā kathaṃ nārī mādṛśī vadatāṃ vara । raudrakarmābhijāyeta sarvaprāṇibhayaṅkarī ॥2॥
html:
tvayā sṛṣṭā kathaṃ nārī mādṛśī vadatāṃ vara ।
raudrakarmābhijāyeta sarvaprāṇibhayaṅkarī ॥2॥
slp1: tvayA sfzwA kaTaM nArI mAdfSI vadatAM vara । rOdrakarmABijAyeta sarvaprARiBayaNkarI ॥2॥

text: bibhemyahamadharmasya dharmyamādiśa karma me । tvaṃ māṃ bhītāmavekṣasva śiveneśvara cakṣuṣā ॥3॥
html:
bibhemyahamadharmasya dharmyamādiśa karma me ।
tvaṃ māṃ bhītāmavekṣasva śiveneśvara cakṣuṣā ॥3॥
slp1: biBemyahamaDarmasya DarmyamAdiSa karma me । tvaM mAM BItAmavekzasva SiveneSvara cakzuzA ॥3॥

text: bālānvṛddhānvayaḥsthāṃśca na hareyamanāgasaḥ । prāṇinaḥ prāṇināmīśa namaste'bhiprasīda me ॥4॥
html:
bālānvṛddhānvayaḥsthāṃśca na hareyamanāgasaḥ ।
prāṇinaḥ prāṇināmīśa namaste'bhiprasīda me ॥4॥
slp1: bAlAnvfdDAnvayaHsTAMSca na hareyamanAgasaH । prARinaH prARinAmISa namaste'BiprasIda me ॥4॥

text: priyānputrānvayasyāṃśca bhrātṝnmātṝḥ pitṝnapi । apadhyāsyanti yaddeva mṛtāṃsteṣāṃ bibhemyaham ॥5॥
html:
priyānputrānvayasyāṃśca bhrātṝnmātṝḥ pitṝnapi ।
apadhyāsyanti yaddeva mṛtāṃsteṣāṃ bibhemyaham ॥5॥
slp1: priyAnputrAnvayasyAMSca BrAtFnmAtFH pitFnapi । apaDyAsyanti yaddeva mftAMstezAM biBemyaham ॥5॥

text: kṛpaṇāśruparikledo dahenmāṃ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ । tebhyo'haṃ balavadbhītā śaraṇaṃ tvāmupāgatā ॥6॥
html:
kṛpaṇāśruparikledo dahenmāṃ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ।
tebhyo'haṃ balavadbhītā śaraṇaṃ tvāmupāgatā ॥6॥
slp1: kfpaRASruparikledo dahenmAM SASvatIH samAH । teByo'haM balavadBItA SaraRaM tvAmupAgatA ॥6॥

text: yamasya bhavane deva yātyante pāpakarmiṇaḥ । prasādaye tvā varada prasādaṃ kuru me prabho ॥7॥
html:
yamasya bhavane deva yātyante pāpakarmiṇaḥ ।
prasādaye tvā varada prasādaṃ kuru me prabho ॥7॥
slp1: yamasya Bavane deva yAtyante pApakarmiRaH । prasAdaye tvA varada prasAdaM kuru me praBo ॥7॥

text: etamicchāmyahaṃ kāmaṃ tvatto lokapitāmaha । iccheyaṃ tvatprasādācca tapastaptuṃ sureśvara ॥8॥
html:
etamicchāmyahaṃ kāmaṃ tvatto lokapitāmaha ।
iccheyaṃ tvatprasādācca tapastaptuṃ sureśvara ॥8॥
slp1: etamicCAmyahaM kAmaM tvatto lokapitAmaha । icCeyaM tvatprasAdAcca tapastaptuM sureSvara ॥8॥

text: mṛtyo saṅkalpitā me tvaṃ prajāsaṃhārahetunā । gaccha saṃhara sarvāstvaṃ prajā mā ca vicāraya ॥9॥
html:
mṛtyo saṅkalpitā me tvaṃ prajāsaṃhārahetunā ।
gaccha saṃhara sarvāstvaṃ prajā mā ca vicāraya ॥9॥
slp1: mftyo saNkalpitA me tvaM prajAsaMhArahetunA । gacCa saMhara sarvAstvaM prajA mA ca vicAraya ॥9॥
author: pitāmaha uvāca ।

text: etadevamavaśyaṃ hi bhavitā naitadanyathā । kriyatāmanavadyāṅgi yathoktaṃ madvaco'naghe ॥10॥
html:
etadevamavaśyaṃ hi bhavitā naitadanyathā ।
kriyatāmanavadyāṅgi yathoktaṃ madvaco'naghe ॥10॥
slp1: etadevamavaSyaM hi BavitA nEtadanyaTA । kriyatAmanavadyANgi yaToktaM madvaco'naGe ॥10॥

text: evamuktā mahābāho mṛtyuḥ parapurañjaya । na vyājahāra tasthau ca prahvā bhagavadunmukhī ॥11॥
html:
evamuktā mahābāho mṛtyuḥ parapurañjaya ।
na vyājahāra tasthau ca prahvā bhagavadunmukhī ॥11॥
slp1: evamuktA mahAbAho mftyuH parapuraYjaya । na vyAjahAra tasTO ca prahvA BagavadunmuKI ॥11॥
author: nārada uvāca ।

text: punaḥ punarathoktā sā gatasattveva bhāminī । tūṣṇīmāsīttato devo devānāmīśvareśvaraḥ ॥12॥
html:
punaḥ punarathoktā sā gatasattveva bhāminī ।
tūṣṇīmāsīttato devo devānāmīśvareśvaraḥ ॥12॥
slp1: punaH punaraToktA sA gatasattveva BAminI । tUzRImAsIttato devo devAnAmISvareSvaraH ॥12॥

text: prasasāda kila brahmā svayamevātmanātmavān । smayamānaśca lokeśo lokānsarvānavaikṣata ॥13॥
html:
prasasāda kila brahmā svayamevātmanātmavān ।
smayamānaśca lokeśo lokānsarvānavaikṣata ॥13॥
slp1: prasasAda kila brahmA svayamevAtmanAtmavAn । smayamAnaSca lokeSo lokAnsarvAnavEkzata ॥13॥

text: nivṛttaroṣe tasmiṃstu bhagavatyaparājite । sā kanyāpajagāmāsya samīpāditi naḥ śrutam ॥14॥
html:
nivṛttaroṣe tasmiṃstu bhagavatyaparājite ।
sā kanyāpajagāmāsya samīpāditi naḥ śrutam ॥14॥
slp1: nivfttaroze tasmiMstu BagavatyaparAjite । sA kanyApajagAmAsya samIpAditi naH Srutam ॥14॥

text: apasṛtyāpratiśrutya prajāsaṃharaṇaṃ tadā । tvaramāṇeva rājendra mṛtyurdhenukamabhyayāt ॥15॥
html:
apasṛtyāpratiśrutya prajāsaṃharaṇaṃ tadā ।
tvaramāṇeva rājendra mṛtyurdhenukamabhyayāt ॥15॥
slp1: apasftyApratiSrutya prajAsaMharaRaM tadA । tvaramAReva rAjendra mftyurDenukamaByayAt ॥15॥

text: sā tatra paramaṃ devī tapo'carata duścaram । samā hyekapade tasthau daśa padmāni pañca ca ॥16॥
html:
sā tatra paramaṃ devī tapo'carata duścaram ।
samā hyekapade tasthau daśa padmāni pañca ca ॥16॥
slp1: sA tatra paramaM devI tapo'carata duScaram । samA hyekapade tasTO daSa padmAni paYca ca ॥16॥

text: tāṃ tathā kurvatīṃ tatra tapaḥ paramaduścaram । punareva mahātejā brahmā vacanamabravīt ॥17॥
html:
tāṃ tathā kurvatīṃ tatra tapaḥ paramaduścaram ।
punareva mahātejā brahmā vacanamabravīt ॥17॥
slp1: tAM taTA kurvatIM tatra tapaH paramaduScaram । punareva mahAtejA brahmA vacanamabravIt ॥17॥

text: kuruṣva me vaco mṛtyo tadanādṛtya satvarā । tathaivaikapade tāta punaranyāni sapta sā ॥18॥
html:
kuruṣva me vaco mṛtyo tadanādṛtya satvarā ।
tathaivaikapade tāta punaranyāni sapta sā ॥18॥
slp1: kuruzva me vaco mftyo tadanAdftya satvarA । taTEvEkapade tAta punaranyAni sapta sA ॥18॥

text: tasthau padmāni ṣaṭcaiva pañca dve caiva mānada । bhūyaḥ padmāyutaṃ tāta mṛgaiḥ saha cacāra sā ॥19॥
html:
tasthau padmāni ṣaṭcaiva pañca dve caiva mānada ।
bhūyaḥ padmāyutaṃ tāta mṛgaiḥ saha cacāra sā ॥19॥
slp1: tasTO padmAni zawcEva paYca dve cEva mAnada । BUyaH padmAyutaM tAta mfgEH saha cacAra sA ॥19॥

text: punargatvā tato rājanmaunamātiṣṭhaduttamam । apsu varṣasahasrāṇi sapta caikaṃ ca pārthiva ॥20॥
html:
punargatvā tato rājanmaunamātiṣṭhaduttamam ।
apsu varṣasahasrāṇi sapta caikaṃ ca pārthiva ॥20॥
slp1: punargatvA tato rAjanmOnamAtizWaduttamam । apsu varzasahasrARi sapta cEkaM ca pArTiva ॥20॥

text: tato jagāma sā kanyā kauśikīṃ bharatarṣabha । tatra vāyujalāhārā cacāra niyamaṃ punaḥ ॥21॥
html:
tato jagāma sā kanyā kauśikīṃ bharatarṣabha ।
tatra vāyujalāhārā cacāra niyamaṃ punaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: tato jagAma sA kanyA kOSikIM BaratarzaBa । tatra vAyujalAhArA cacAra niyamaM punaH ॥21॥

text: tato yayau mahābhāgā gaṅgāṃ meruṃ ca kevalam । tasthau dārviva niśceṣṭā bhūtānāṃ hitakāmyayā ॥22॥
html:
tato yayau mahābhāgā gaṅgāṃ meruṃ ca kevalam ।
tasthau dārviva niśceṣṭā bhūtānāṃ hitakāmyayā ॥22॥
slp1: tato yayO mahABAgA gaNgAM meruM ca kevalam । tasTO dArviva niScezwA BUtAnAM hitakAmyayA ॥22॥

text: tato himavato mūrdhni yatra devāḥ samījire । tatrāṅguṣṭhena rājendra nikharvamaparaṃ tataḥ । tasthau pitāmahaṃ caiva toṣayāmāsa yatnataḥ ॥23॥
html:
tato himavato mūrdhni yatra devāḥ samījire ।
tatrāṅguṣṭhena rājendra nikharvamaparaṃ tataḥ ।
tasthau pitāmahaṃ caiva toṣayāmāsa yatnataḥ ॥23॥
slp1: tato himavato mUrDni yatra devAH samIjire । tatrANguzWena rAjendra niKarvamaparaM tataH । tasTO pitAmahaM cEva tozayAmAsa yatnataH ॥23॥

text: tatastāmabravīttatra lokānāṃ prabhavāpyayaḥ । kimidaṃ vartate putri kriyatāṃ tadvaco mama ॥24॥
html:
tatastāmabravīttatra lokānāṃ prabhavāpyayaḥ ।
kimidaṃ vartate putri kriyatāṃ tadvaco mama ॥24॥
slp1: tatastAmabravIttatra lokAnAM praBavApyayaH । kimidaM vartate putri kriyatAM tadvaco mama ॥24॥

text: tato'bravītpunarmṛtyurbhagavantaṃ pitāmaham । na hareyaṃ prajā deva punastvāhaṃ prasādaye ॥25॥
html:
tato'bravītpunarmṛtyurbhagavantaṃ pitāmaham ।
na hareyaṃ prajā deva punastvāhaṃ prasādaye ॥25॥
slp1: tato'bravItpunarmftyurBagavantaM pitAmaham । na hareyaM prajA deva punastvAhaM prasAdaye ॥25॥

text: tāmadharmabhayatrastāṃ punareva ca yācatīm । tadābravīddevadevo nigṛhyedaṃ vacastataḥ ॥26॥
html:
tāmadharmabhayatrastāṃ punareva ca yācatīm ।
tadābravīddevadevo nigṛhyedaṃ vacastataḥ ॥26॥
slp1: tAmaDarmaBayatrastAM punareva ca yAcatIm । tadAbravIddevadevo nigfhyedaM vacastataH ॥26॥

text: adharmo nāsti te mṛtyo saṃyacchemāḥ prajāḥ śubhe । mayā hyuktaṃ mṛṣā bhadre bhavitā neha kiñcana ॥27॥
html:
adharmo nāsti te mṛtyo saṃyacchemāḥ prajāḥ śubhe ।
mayā hyuktaṃ mṛṣā bhadre bhavitā neha kiñcana ॥27॥
slp1: aDarmo nAsti te mftyo saMyacCemAH prajAH SuBe । mayA hyuktaM mfzA Badre BavitA neha kiYcana ॥27॥

text: dharmaḥ sanātanaśca tvāmihaivānupravekṣyate । ahaṃ ca vibudhāścaiva tvaddhite niratāḥ sadā ॥28॥
html:
dharmaḥ sanātanaśca tvāmihaivānupravekṣyate ।
ahaṃ ca vibudhāścaiva tvaddhite niratāḥ sadā ॥28॥
slp1: DarmaH sanAtanaSca tvAmihEvAnupravekzyate । ahaM ca vibuDAScEva tvadDite niratAH sadA ॥28॥

text: imamanyaṃ ca te kāmaṃ dadāmi manasepsitam । na tvā doṣeṇa yāsyanti vyādhisampīḍitāḥ prajāḥ ॥29॥
html:
imamanyaṃ ca te kāmaṃ dadāmi manasepsitam ।
na tvā doṣeṇa yāsyanti vyādhisampīḍitāḥ prajāḥ ॥29॥
slp1: imamanyaM ca te kAmaM dadAmi manasepsitam । na tvA dozeRa yAsyanti vyADisampIqitAH prajAH ॥29॥

text: puruṣeṣu ca rūpeṇa puruṣastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi । strīṣu strīrūpiṇī caiva tṛtīyeṣu napuṃsakam ॥30॥
html:
puruṣeṣu ca rūpeṇa puruṣastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ।
strīṣu strīrūpiṇī caiva tṛtīyeṣu napuṃsakam ॥30॥
slp1: puruzezu ca rUpeRa puruzastvaM Bavizyasi । strIzu strIrUpiRI cEva tftIyezu napuMsakam ॥30॥

text: saivamuktā mahārāja kṛtāñjaliruvāca ha । punareva mahātmānaṃ neti deveśamavyayam ॥31॥
html:
saivamuktā mahārāja kṛtāñjaliruvāca ha ।
punareva mahātmānaṃ neti deveśamavyayam ॥31॥
slp1: sEvamuktA mahArAja kftAYjaliruvAca ha । punareva mahAtmAnaM neti deveSamavyayam ॥31॥

text: tāmabravīttadā devo mṛtyo saṃhara mānavān । adharmaste na bhavitā tathā dhyāsyāmyahaṃ śubhe ॥32॥
html:
tāmabravīttadā devo mṛtyo saṃhara mānavān ।
adharmaste na bhavitā tathā dhyāsyāmyahaṃ śubhe ॥32॥
slp1: tAmabravIttadA devo mftyo saMhara mAnavAn । aDarmaste na BavitA taTA DyAsyAmyahaM SuBe ॥32॥

text: yānaśrubindūnpatitānapaśyaṃ ye pāṇibhyāṃ dhāritāste purastāt । te vyādhayo mānavānghorarūpāḥ prāpte kāle pīḍayiṣyanti mṛtyo ॥33॥
html:
yānaśrubindūnpatitānapaśyaṃ ye pāṇibhyāṃ dhāritāste purastāt ।
te vyādhayo mānavānghorarūpāḥ prāpte kāle pīḍayiṣyanti mṛtyo ॥33॥
slp1: yAnaSrubindUnpatitAnapaSyaM ye pARiByAM DAritAste purastAt । te vyADayo mAnavAnGorarUpAH prApte kAle pIqayizyanti mftyo ॥33॥

text: sarveṣāṃ tvaṃ prāṇināmantakāle kāmakrodhau sahitau yojayethāḥ । evaṃ dharmastvāmupaiṣyatyameyo na cādharmaṃ lapsyase tulyavṛttiḥ ॥34॥
html:
sarveṣāṃ tvaṃ prāṇināmantakāle kāmakrodhau sahitau yojayethāḥ ।
evaṃ dharmastvāmupaiṣyatyameyo na cādharmaṃ lapsyase tulyavṛttiḥ ॥34॥
slp1: sarvezAM tvaM prARinAmantakAle kAmakroDO sahitO yojayeTAH । evaM DarmastvAmupEzyatyameyo na cADarmaM lapsyase tulyavfttiH ॥34॥

text: evaṃ dharmaṃ pālayiṣyasyathoktaṃ na cātmānaṃ majjayiṣyasyadharme । tasmātkāmaṃ rocayābhyāgataṃ tvaṃ saṃyojyātho saṃharasveha jantūn ॥35॥
html:
evaṃ dharmaṃ pālayiṣyasyathoktaṃ na cātmānaṃ majjayiṣyasyadharme ।
tasmātkāmaṃ rocayābhyāgataṃ tvaṃ saṃyojyātho saṃharasveha jantūn ॥35॥
slp1: evaM DarmaM pAlayizyasyaToktaM na cAtmAnaM majjayizyasyaDarme । tasmAtkAmaM rocayAByAgataM tvaM saMyojyATo saMharasveha jantUn ॥35॥

text: sā vai tadā mṛtyusañjñāpadeśācchāpādbhītā bāḍhamityabravīttam । atho prāṇānprāṇināmantakāle kāmakrodhau prāpya nirmohya hanti ॥36॥
html:
sā vai tadā mṛtyusañjñāpadeśācchāpādbhītā bāḍhamityabravīttam ।
atho prāṇānprāṇināmantakāle kāmakrodhau prāpya nirmohya hanti ॥36॥
slp1: sA vE tadA mftyusaYjYApadeSAcCApAdBItA bAQamityabravIttam । aTo prARAnprARinAmantakAle kAmakroDO prApya nirmohya hanti ॥36॥

text: mṛtyorye te vyādhayaścāśrupātā manuṣyāṇāṃ rujyate yaiḥ śarīram । sarveṣāṃ vai prāṇināṃ prāṇanānte tasmācchokaṃ mā kṛthā budhya buddhyā ॥37॥
html:
mṛtyorye te vyādhayaścāśrupātā manuṣyāṇāṃ rujyate yaiḥ śarīram ।
sarveṣāṃ vai prāṇināṃ prāṇanānte tasmācchokaṃ mā kṛthā budhya buddhyā ॥37॥
slp1: mftyorye te vyADayaScASrupAtA manuzyARAM rujyate yEH SarIram । sarvezAM vE prARinAM prARanAnte tasmAcCokaM mA kfTA buDya budDyA ॥37॥

text: sarve devāḥ prāṇināṃ prāṇanānte gatvā vṛttāḥ sannivṛttāstathaiva । evaṃ sarve mānavāḥ prāṇanānte gatvāvṛttā devavadrājasiṃha ॥38॥
html:
sarve devāḥ prāṇināṃ prāṇanānte gatvā vṛttāḥ sannivṛttāstathaiva ।
evaṃ sarve mānavāḥ prāṇanānte gatvāvṛttā devavadrājasiṃha ॥38॥
slp1: sarve devAH prARinAM prARanAnte gatvA vfttAH sannivfttAstaTEva । evaM sarve mAnavAH prARanAnte gatvAvfttA devavadrAjasiMha ॥38॥

text: vāyurbhīmo bhīmanādo mahaujāḥ sarveṣāṃ ca prāṇināṃ prāṇabhūtaḥ । nānāvṛttirdehināṃ dehabhede tasmādvāyurdevadevo viśiṣṭaḥ ॥39॥
html:
vāyurbhīmo bhīmanādo mahaujāḥ sarveṣāṃ ca prāṇināṃ prāṇabhūtaḥ ।
nānāvṛttirdehināṃ dehabhede tasmādvāyurdevadevo viśiṣṭaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: vAyurBImo BImanAdo mahOjAH sarvezAM ca prARinAM prARaBUtaH । nAnAvfttirdehinAM dehaBede tasmAdvAyurdevadevo viSizwaH ॥39॥

text: sarve devā martyasañjñāviśiṣṭāḥ sarve martyā devasañjñāviśiṣṭāḥ । tasmātputraṃ mā śuco rājasiṃha putraḥ svargaṃ prāpya te modate ha ॥40॥
html:
sarve devā martyasañjñāviśiṣṭāḥ sarve martyā devasañjñāviśiṣṭāḥ ।
tasmātputraṃ mā śuco rājasiṃha putraḥ svargaṃ prāpya te modate ha ॥40॥
slp1: sarve devA martyasaYjYAviSizwAH sarve martyA devasaYjYAviSizwAH । tasmAtputraM mA Suco rAjasiMha putraH svargaM prApya te modate ha ॥40॥

text: evaṃ mṛtyurdevasṛṣṭā prajānāṃ prāpte kāle saṃharantī yathāvat । tasyāścaiva vyādhayaste'śrupātāḥ prāpte kāle saṃharantīha jantūn] ॥41॥
html:
evaṃ mṛtyurdevasṛṣṭā prajānāṃ prāpte kāle saṃharantī yathāvat ।
tasyāścaiva vyādhayaste'śrupātāḥ prāpte kāle saṃharantīha jantūn] ॥41॥
slp1: evaM mftyurdevasfzwA prajAnAM prApte kAle saMharantI yaTAvat । tasyAScEva vyADayaste'SrupAtAH prApte kAle saMharantIha jantUn] ॥41॥

text: ime vai mānavāḥ sarve dharmaṃ prati viśaṅkitāḥ । ko'yaṃ dharmaḥ kuto dharmastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
ime vai mānavāḥ sarve dharmaṃ prati viśaṅkitāḥ ।
ko'yaṃ dharmaḥ kuto dharmastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: ime vE mAnavAH sarve DarmaM prati viSaNkitAH । ko'yaM DarmaH kuto Darmastanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: dharmo nvayamihārthaḥ kimamutrārtho'pi vā bhavet । ubhayārtho'pi vā dharmastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥2॥
html:
dharmo nvayamihārthaḥ kimamutrārtho'pi vā bhavet ।
ubhayārtho'pi vā dharmastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥2॥
slp1: Darmo nvayamihArTaH kimamutrArTo'pi vA Bavet । uBayArTo'pi vA Darmastanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥2॥

text: sadācāraḥ smṛtirvedāstrividhaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam । caturthamarthamityāhuḥ kavayo dharmalakṣaṇam ॥3॥
html:
sadācāraḥ smṛtirvedāstrividhaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam ।
caturthamarthamityāhuḥ kavayo dharmalakṣaṇam ॥3॥
slp1: sadAcAraH smftirvedAstriviDaM DarmalakzaRam । caturTamarTamityAhuH kavayo DarmalakzaRam ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: api hyuktāni karmāṇi vyavasyantyuttarāvare । lokayātrārthameveha dharmasya niyamaḥ kṛtaḥ । ubhayatra sukhodarka iha caiva paratra ca ॥4॥
html:
api hyuktāni karmāṇi vyavasyantyuttarāvare ।
lokayātrārthameveha dharmasya niyamaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
ubhayatra sukhodarka iha caiva paratra ca ॥4॥
slp1: api hyuktAni karmARi vyavasyantyuttarAvare । lokayAtrArTameveha Darmasya niyamaH kftaH । uBayatra suKodarka iha cEva paratra ca ॥4॥

text: alabdhvā nipuṇaṃ dharmaṃ pāpaḥ pāpe prasajjati । na ca pāpakṛtaḥ pāpānmucyante kecidāpadi ॥5॥
html:
alabdhvā nipuṇaṃ dharmaṃ pāpaḥ pāpe prasajjati ।
na ca pāpakṛtaḥ pāpānmucyante kecidāpadi ॥5॥
slp1: alabDvA nipuRaM DarmaM pApaH pApe prasajjati । na ca pApakftaH pApAnmucyante kecidApadi ॥5॥

text: apāpavādī bhavati yadā bhavati dharmavit । dharmasya niṣṭhā svācārastamevāśritya bhotsyase ॥6॥
html:
apāpavādī bhavati yadā bhavati dharmavit ।
dharmasya niṣṭhā svācārastamevāśritya bhotsyase ॥6॥
slp1: apApavAdI Bavati yadA Bavati Darmavit । Darmasya nizWA svAcArastamevASritya Botsyase ॥6॥

text: yadādharmasamāviṣṭo dhanaṃ gṛhṇāti taskaraḥ । ramate nirharanstenaḥ paravittamarājake ॥7॥
html:
yadādharmasamāviṣṭo dhanaṃ gṛhṇāti taskaraḥ ।
ramate nirharanstenaḥ paravittamarājake ॥7॥
slp1: yadADarmasamAvizwo DanaM gfhRAti taskaraH । ramate nirharanstenaH paravittamarAjake ॥7॥

text: yadāsya taddharantyanye tadā rājānamicchati । tadā teṣāṃ spṛhayate ye vai tuṣṭāḥ svakairdhanaiḥ ॥8॥
html:
yadāsya taddharantyanye tadā rājānamicchati ।
tadā teṣāṃ spṛhayate ye vai tuṣṭāḥ svakairdhanaiḥ ॥8॥
slp1: yadAsya tadDarantyanye tadA rAjAnamicCati । tadA tezAM spfhayate ye vE tuzwAH svakErDanEH ॥8॥

text: abhītaḥ śucirabhyeti rājadvāramaśaṅkitaḥ । na hi duścaritaṃ kiñcidantarātmani paśyati ॥9॥
html:
abhītaḥ śucirabhyeti rājadvāramaśaṅkitaḥ ।
na hi duścaritaṃ kiñcidantarātmani paśyati ॥9॥
slp1: aBItaH SuciraByeti rAjadvAramaSaNkitaH । na hi duScaritaM kiYcidantarAtmani paSyati ॥9॥

text: satyasya vacanaṃ sādhu na satyādvidyate param । satyena vidhṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sarvaṃ satye pratiṣṭhitam ॥10॥
html:
satyasya vacanaṃ sādhu na satyādvidyate param ।
satyena vidhṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sarvaṃ satye pratiṣṭhitam ॥10॥
slp1: satyasya vacanaM sADu na satyAdvidyate param । satyena viDftaM sarvaM sarvaM satye pratizWitam ॥10॥

text: api pāpakṛto raudrāḥ satyaṃ kṛtvā pṛthakpṛthak । adrohamavisaṃvādaṃ pravartante tadāśrayāḥ । te cenmitho'dhṛtiṃ kuryurvinaśyeyurasaṃśayam ॥11॥
html:
api pāpakṛto raudrāḥ satyaṃ kṛtvā pṛthakpṛthak ।
adrohamavisaṃvādaṃ pravartante tadāśrayāḥ ।
te cenmitho'dhṛtiṃ kuryurvinaśyeyurasaṃśayam ॥11॥
slp1: api pApakfto rOdrAH satyaM kftvA pfTakpfTak । adrohamavisaMvAdaM pravartante tadASrayAH । te cenmiTo'DftiM kuryurvinaSyeyurasaMSayam ॥11॥

text: na hartavyaṃ paradhanamiti dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ । manyante balavantastaṃ durbalaiḥ sampravartitam । yadā niyatidaurbalyamathaiṣāmeva rocate ॥12॥
html:
na hartavyaṃ paradhanamiti dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
manyante balavantastaṃ durbalaiḥ sampravartitam ।
yadā niyatidaurbalyamathaiṣāmeva rocate ॥12॥
slp1: na hartavyaM paraDanamiti DarmaH sanAtanaH । manyante balavantastaM durbalEH sampravartitam । yadA niyatidOrbalyamaTEzAmeva rocate ॥12॥

text: na hyatyantaṃ balayutā bhavanti sukhino'pi vā । tasmādanārjave buddhirna kāryā te kathañcana ॥13॥
html:
na hyatyantaṃ balayutā bhavanti sukhino'pi vā ।
tasmādanārjave buddhirna kāryā te kathañcana ॥13॥
slp1: na hyatyantaM balayutA Bavanti suKino'pi vA । tasmAdanArjave budDirna kAryA te kaTaYcana ॥13॥

text: asādhubhyo'sya na bhayaṃ na corebhyo na rājataḥ । na kiñcitkasyacitkurvannirbhayaḥ śucirāvaset ॥14॥
html:
asādhubhyo'sya na bhayaṃ na corebhyo na rājataḥ ।
na kiñcitkasyacitkurvannirbhayaḥ śucirāvaset ॥14॥
slp1: asADuByo'sya na BayaM na coreByo na rAjataH । na kiYcitkasyacitkurvannirBayaH SucirAvaset ॥14॥

text: sarvataḥ śaṅkate steno mṛgo grāmamiveyivān । bahudhācaritaṃ pāpamanyatraivānupaśyati ॥15॥
html:
sarvataḥ śaṅkate steno mṛgo grāmamiveyivān ।
bahudhācaritaṃ pāpamanyatraivānupaśyati ॥15॥
slp1: sarvataH SaNkate steno mfgo grAmamiveyivAn । bahuDAcaritaM pApamanyatrEvAnupaSyati ॥15॥

text: muditaḥ śucirabhyeti sarvato nirbhayaḥ sadā । na hi duścaritaṃ kiñcidātmano'nyeṣu paśyati ॥16॥
html:
muditaḥ śucirabhyeti sarvato nirbhayaḥ sadā ।
na hi duścaritaṃ kiñcidātmano'nyeṣu paśyati ॥16॥
slp1: muditaH SuciraByeti sarvato nirBayaH sadA । na hi duScaritaM kiYcidAtmano'nyezu paSyati ॥16॥

text: dātavyamityayaṃ dharma ukto bhūtahite rataiḥ । taṃ manyante dhanayutāḥ kṛpaṇaiḥ sampravartitam ॥17॥
html:
dātavyamityayaṃ dharma ukto bhūtahite rataiḥ ।
taṃ manyante dhanayutāḥ kṛpaṇaiḥ sampravartitam ॥17॥
slp1: dAtavyamityayaM Darma ukto BUtahite ratEH । taM manyante DanayutAH kfpaREH sampravartitam ॥17॥

text: yadā niyatikārpaṇyamathaiṣāmeva rocate । na hyatyantaṃ dhanavanto bhavanti sukhino'pi vā ॥18॥
html:
yadā niyatikārpaṇyamathaiṣāmeva rocate ।
na hyatyantaṃ dhanavanto bhavanti sukhino'pi vā ॥18॥
slp1: yadA niyatikArpaRyamaTEzAmeva rocate । na hyatyantaM Danavanto Bavanti suKino'pi vA ॥18॥

text: yadanyairvihitaṃ necchedātmanaḥ karma pūruṣaḥ । na tatpareṣu kurvīta jānannapriyamātmanaḥ ॥19॥
html:
yadanyairvihitaṃ necchedātmanaḥ karma pūruṣaḥ ।
na tatpareṣu kurvīta jānannapriyamātmanaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: yadanyErvihitaM necCedAtmanaH karma pUruzaH । na tatparezu kurvIta jAnannapriyamAtmanaH ॥19॥

text: yo'nyasya syādupapatiḥ sa kaṃ kiṃ vaktumarhati । yadanyastasya tatkuryānna mṛṣyediti me matiḥ ॥20॥
html:
yo'nyasya syādupapatiḥ sa kaṃ kiṃ vaktumarhati ।
yadanyastasya tatkuryānna mṛṣyediti me matiḥ ॥20॥
slp1: yo'nyasya syAdupapatiH sa kaM kiM vaktumarhati । yadanyastasya tatkuryAnna mfzyediti me matiH ॥20॥

text: jīvituṃ yaḥ svayaṃ cecchetkathaṃ so'nyaṃ praghātayet । yadyadātmana iccheta tatparasyāpi cintayet ॥21॥
html:
jīvituṃ yaḥ svayaṃ cecchetkathaṃ so'nyaṃ praghātayet ।
yadyadātmana iccheta tatparasyāpi cintayet ॥21॥
slp1: jIvituM yaH svayaM cecCetkaTaM so'nyaM praGAtayet । yadyadAtmana icCeta tatparasyApi cintayet ॥21॥

text: atiriktaiḥ saṃvibhajedbhogairanyānakiñcanān । etasmātkāraṇāddhātrā kusīdaṃ sampravartitam ॥22॥
html:
atiriktaiḥ saṃvibhajedbhogairanyānakiñcanān ।
etasmātkāraṇāddhātrā kusīdaṃ sampravartitam ॥22॥
slp1: atiriktEH saMviBajedBogEranyAnakiYcanAn । etasmAtkAraRAdDAtrA kusIdaM sampravartitam ॥22॥

text: yasmiṃstu devāḥ samaye santiṣṭheraṃstathā bhavet । atha cellābhasamaye sthitirdharme'pi śobhanā ॥23॥
html:
yasmiṃstu devāḥ samaye santiṣṭheraṃstathā bhavet ।
atha cellābhasamaye sthitirdharme'pi śobhanā ॥23॥
slp1: yasmiMstu devAH samaye santizWeraMstaTA Bavet । aTa cellABasamaye sTitirDarme'pi SoBanA ॥23॥

text: sarvaṃ priyābhyupagataṃ dharmamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ । paśyaitaṃ lakṣaṇoddeśaṃ dharmādharme yudhiṣṭhira ॥24॥
html:
sarvaṃ priyābhyupagataṃ dharmamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ।
paśyaitaṃ lakṣaṇoddeśaṃ dharmādharme yudhiṣṭhira ॥24॥
slp1: sarvaM priyAByupagataM DarmamAhurmanIziRaH । paSyEtaM lakzaRoddeSaM DarmADarme yuDizWira ॥24॥

text: lokasaṅgrahasaṃyuktaṃ vidhātrā vihitaṃ purā । sūkṣmadharmārthaniyataṃ satāṃ caritamuttamam ॥25॥
html:
lokasaṅgrahasaṃyuktaṃ vidhātrā vihitaṃ purā ।
sūkṣmadharmārthaniyataṃ satāṃ caritamuttamam ॥25॥
slp1: lokasaNgrahasaMyuktaM viDAtrA vihitaM purA । sUkzmaDarmArTaniyataM satAM caritamuttamam ॥25॥

text: dharmalakṣaṇamākhyātametatte kurusattama । tasmādanārjave buddhirna kāryā te kathañcana] ॥26॥
html:
dharmalakṣaṇamākhyātametatte kurusattama ।
tasmādanārjave buddhirna kāryā te kathañcana] ॥26॥
slp1: DarmalakzaRamAKyAtametatte kurusattama । tasmAdanArjave budDirna kAryA te kaTaYcana] ॥26॥

text: sūkṣmaṃ sādhu samādiṣṭaṃ bhavatā dharmalakṣaṇam । pratibhā tvasti me kācittāṃ brūyāmanumānataḥ ॥1॥
html:
sūkṣmaṃ sādhu samādiṣṭaṃ bhavatā dharmalakṣaṇam ।
pratibhā tvasti me kācittāṃ brūyāmanumānataḥ ॥1॥
slp1: sUkzmaM sADu samAdizwaM BavatA DarmalakzaRam । pratiBA tvasti me kAcittAM brUyAmanumAnataH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: bhūyāṃso hṛdaye ye me praśnāste vyāhṛtāstvayā । imamanyaṃ pravakṣyāmi na rājanvigrahādiva ॥2॥
html:
bhūyāṃso hṛdaye ye me praśnāste vyāhṛtāstvayā ।
imamanyaṃ pravakṣyāmi na rājanvigrahādiva ॥2॥
slp1: BUyAMso hfdaye ye me praSnAste vyAhftAstvayA । imamanyaM pravakzyAmi na rAjanvigrahAdiva ॥2॥

text: imāni hi prāpayanti sṛjantyuttārayanti ca । na dharmaḥ paripāṭhena śakyo bhārata veditum ॥3॥
html:
imāni hi prāpayanti sṛjantyuttārayanti ca ।
na dharmaḥ paripāṭhena śakyo bhārata veditum ॥3॥
slp1: imAni hi prApayanti sfjantyuttArayanti ca । na DarmaH paripAWena Sakyo BArata veditum ॥3॥

text: anyo dharmaḥ samasthasya viṣamasthasya cāparaḥ । āpadastu kathaṃ śakyāḥ paripāṭhena veditum ॥4॥
html:
anyo dharmaḥ samasthasya viṣamasthasya cāparaḥ ।
āpadastu kathaṃ śakyāḥ paripāṭhena veditum ॥4॥
slp1: anyo DarmaH samasTasya vizamasTasya cAparaH । Apadastu kaTaM SakyAH paripAWena veditum ॥4॥

text: sadācāro mato dharmaḥ santastvācāralakṣaṇāḥ । sādhyāsādhyaṃ kathaṃ śakyaṃ sadācāro hyalakṣaṇam ॥5॥
html:
sadācāro mato dharmaḥ santastvācāralakṣaṇāḥ ।
sādhyāsādhyaṃ kathaṃ śakyaṃ sadācāro hyalakṣaṇam ॥5॥
slp1: sadAcAro mato DarmaH santastvAcAralakzaRAH । sADyAsADyaM kaTaM SakyaM sadAcAro hyalakzaRam ॥5॥

text: dṛśyate dharmarūpeṇa adharmaṃ prākṛtaścaran । dharmaṃ cādharmarūpeṇa kaścidaprākṛtaścaran ॥6॥
html:
dṛśyate dharmarūpeṇa adharmaṃ prākṛtaścaran ।
dharmaṃ cādharmarūpeṇa kaścidaprākṛtaścaran ॥6॥
slp1: dfSyate DarmarUpeRa aDarmaM prAkftaScaran । DarmaM cADarmarUpeRa kaScidaprAkftaScaran ॥6॥

text: punarasya pramāṇaṃ hi nirdiṣṭaṃ śāstrakovidaiḥ । vedavādāścānuyugaṃ hrasantīti ha naḥ śrutam ॥7॥
html:
punarasya pramāṇaṃ hi nirdiṣṭaṃ śāstrakovidaiḥ ।
vedavādāścānuyugaṃ hrasantīti ha naḥ śrutam ॥7॥
slp1: punarasya pramARaM hi nirdizwaM SAstrakovidEH । vedavAdAScAnuyugaM hrasantIti ha naH Srutam ॥7॥

text: anye kṛtayuge dharmāstretāyāṃ dvāpare'pare । anye kaliyuge dharmā yathāśaktikṛtā iva ॥8॥
html:
anye kṛtayuge dharmāstretāyāṃ dvāpare'pare ।
anye kaliyuge dharmā yathāśaktikṛtā iva ॥8॥
slp1: anye kftayuge DarmAstretAyAM dvApare'pare । anye kaliyuge DarmA yaTASaktikftA iva ॥8॥

text: āmnāyavacanaṃ satyamityayaṃ lokasaṅgrahaḥ । āmnāyebhyaḥ paraṃ vedāḥ prasṛtā viśvatomukhāḥ ॥9॥
html:
āmnāyavacanaṃ satyamityayaṃ lokasaṅgrahaḥ ।
āmnāyebhyaḥ paraṃ vedāḥ prasṛtā viśvatomukhāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: AmnAyavacanaM satyamityayaM lokasaNgrahaH । AmnAyeByaH paraM vedAH prasftA viSvatomuKAH ॥9॥

text: te cetsarve pramāṇaṃ vai pramāṇaṃ tanna vidyate । pramāṇe cāpramāṇe ca viruddhe śāstratā kutaḥ ॥10॥
html:
te cetsarve pramāṇaṃ vai pramāṇaṃ tanna vidyate ।
pramāṇe cāpramāṇe ca viruddhe śāstratā kutaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: te cetsarve pramARaM vE pramARaM tanna vidyate । pramARe cApramARe ca virudDe SAstratA kutaH ॥10॥

text: dharmasya hriyamāṇasya balavadbhirdurātmabhiḥ । yā yā vikriyate saṃsthā tataḥ sāpi praṇaśyati ॥11॥
html:
dharmasya hriyamāṇasya balavadbhirdurātmabhiḥ ।
yā yā vikriyate saṃsthā tataḥ sāpi praṇaśyati ॥11॥
slp1: Darmasya hriyamARasya balavadBirdurAtmaBiH । yA yA vikriyate saMsTA tataH sApi praRaSyati ॥11॥

text: vidma caivaṃ na vā vidma śakyaṃ vā vedituṃ na vā । aṇīyānkṣuradhārāyā garīyānparvatādapi ॥12॥
html:
vidma caivaṃ na vā vidma śakyaṃ vā vedituṃ na vā ।
aṇīyānkṣuradhārāyā garīyānparvatādapi ॥12॥
slp1: vidma cEvaM na vA vidma SakyaM vA vedituM na vA । aRIyAnkzuraDArAyA garIyAnparvatAdapi ॥12॥

text: gandharvanagarākāraḥ prathamaṃ sampradṛśyate । anvīkṣyamāṇaḥ kavibhiḥ punargacchatyadarśanam ॥13॥
html:
gandharvanagarākāraḥ prathamaṃ sampradṛśyate ।
anvīkṣyamāṇaḥ kavibhiḥ punargacchatyadarśanam ॥13॥
slp1: ganDarvanagarAkAraH praTamaM sampradfSyate । anvIkzyamARaH kaviBiH punargacCatyadarSanam ॥13॥

text: nipānānīva gobhyāśe kṣetre kulyeva bhārata । smṛto'pi śāśvato dharmo viprahīṇo na dṛśyate ॥14॥
html:
nipānānīva gobhyāśe kṣetre kulyeva bhārata ।
smṛto'pi śāśvato dharmo viprahīṇo na dṛśyate ॥14॥
slp1: nipAnAnIva goByASe kzetre kulyeva BArata । smfto'pi SASvato Darmo viprahIRo na dfSyate ॥14॥

text: kāmādanye kṣayādanye kāraṇairaparaistathā । asanto hi vṛthācāraṃ bhajante bahavo'pare ॥15॥
html:
kāmādanye kṣayādanye kāraṇairaparaistathā ।
asanto hi vṛthācāraṃ bhajante bahavo'pare ॥15॥
slp1: kAmAdanye kzayAdanye kAraREraparEstaTA । asanto hi vfTAcAraM Bajante bahavo'pare ॥15॥

text: dharmo bhavati sa kṣipraṃ vilīnastveva sādhuṣu । anye tānāhurunmattānapi cāvahasantyuta ॥16॥
html:
dharmo bhavati sa kṣipraṃ vilīnastveva sādhuṣu ।
anye tānāhurunmattānapi cāvahasantyuta ॥16॥
slp1: Darmo Bavati sa kzipraM vilInastveva sADuzu । anye tAnAhurunmattAnapi cAvahasantyuta ॥16॥

text: mahājanā hyupāvṛttā rājadharmaṃ samāśritāḥ । na hi sarvahitaḥ kaścidācāraḥ sampradṛśyate ॥17॥
html:
mahājanā hyupāvṛttā rājadharmaṃ samāśritāḥ ।
na hi sarvahitaḥ kaścidācāraḥ sampradṛśyate ॥17॥
slp1: mahAjanA hyupAvfttA rAjaDarmaM samASritAH । na hi sarvahitaH kaScidAcAraH sampradfSyate ॥17॥

text: tenaivānyaḥ prabhavati so'paraṃ bādhate punaḥ । dṛśyate caiva sa punastulyarūpo yadṛcchayā ॥18॥
html:
tenaivānyaḥ prabhavati so'paraṃ bādhate punaḥ ।
dṛśyate caiva sa punastulyarūpo yadṛcchayā ॥18॥
slp1: tenEvAnyaH praBavati so'paraM bADate punaH । dfSyate cEva sa punastulyarUpo yadfcCayA ॥18॥

text: yenaivānyaḥ prabhavati so'parānapi bādhate । ācārāṇāmanaikāgryaṃ sarveṣāmeva lakṣayet ॥19॥
html:
yenaivānyaḥ prabhavati so'parānapi bādhate ।
ācārāṇāmanaikāgryaṃ sarveṣāmeva lakṣayet ॥19॥
slp1: yenEvAnyaH praBavati so'parAnapi bADate । AcArARAmanEkAgryaM sarvezAmeva lakzayet ॥19॥

text: cirābhipannaḥ kavibhiḥ pūrvaṃ dharma udāhṛtaḥ । tenācāreṇa pūrveṇa saṃsthā bhavati śāśvatī] ॥20॥
html:
cirābhipannaḥ kavibhiḥ pūrvaṃ dharma udāhṛtaḥ ।
tenācāreṇa pūrveṇa saṃsthā bhavati śāśvatī] ॥20॥
slp1: cirABipannaH kaviBiH pUrvaM Darma udAhftaH । tenAcAreRa pUrveRa saMsTA Bavati SASvatI] ॥20॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । tulādhārasya vākyāni dharme jājalinā saha ॥1॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
tulādhārasya vākyāni dharme jājalinā saha ॥1॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । tulADArasya vAkyAni Darme jAjalinA saha ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: vane vanacaraḥ kaścijjājalirnāma vai dvijaḥ । sāgaroddeśamāgamya tapastepe mahātapāḥ ॥2॥
html:
vane vanacaraḥ kaścijjājalirnāma vai dvijaḥ ।
sāgaroddeśamāgamya tapastepe mahātapāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: vane vanacaraH kaScijjAjalirnAma vE dvijaH । sAgaroddeSamAgamya tapastepe mahAtapAH ॥2॥

text: niyato niyatāhāraścīrājinajaṭādharaḥ । malapaṅkadharo dhīmānbahūnvarṣagaṇānmuniḥ ॥3॥
html:
niyato niyatāhāraścīrājinajaṭādharaḥ ।
malapaṅkadharo dhīmānbahūnvarṣagaṇānmuniḥ ॥3॥
slp1: niyato niyatAhAraScIrAjinajawADaraH । malapaNkaDaro DImAnbahUnvarzagaRAnmuniH ॥3॥

text: sa kadācinmahātejā jalavāso mahīpate । cacāra lokānviprarṣiḥ prekṣamāṇo manojavaḥ ॥4॥
html:
sa kadācinmahātejā jalavāso mahīpate ।
cacāra lokānviprarṣiḥ prekṣamāṇo manojavaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: sa kadAcinmahAtejA jalavAso mahIpate । cacAra lokAnviprarziH prekzamARo manojavaH ॥4॥

text: sa cintayāmāsa munirjalamadhye kadācana । viprekṣya sāgarāntāṃ vai mahīṃ savanakānanām ॥5॥
html:
sa cintayāmāsa munirjalamadhye kadācana ।
viprekṣya sāgarāntāṃ vai mahīṃ savanakānanām ॥5॥
slp1: sa cintayAmAsa munirjalamaDye kadAcana । viprekzya sAgarAntAM vE mahIM savanakAnanAm ॥5॥

text: na mayā sadṛśo'stīha loke sthāvarajaṅgame । apsu vaihāyasaṃ gacchenmayā yo'nyaḥ saheti vai ॥6॥
html:
na mayā sadṛśo'stīha loke sthāvarajaṅgame ।
apsu vaihāyasaṃ gacchenmayā yo'nyaḥ saheti vai ॥6॥
slp1: na mayA sadfSo'stIha loke sTAvarajaNgame । apsu vEhAyasaM gacCenmayA yo'nyaH saheti vE ॥6॥

text: sa dṛśyamāno rakṣobhirjalamadhye'vadattataḥ । abruvaṃśca piśācāstaṃ naivaṃ tvaṃ vaktumarhasi ॥7॥
html:
sa dṛśyamāno rakṣobhirjalamadhye'vadattataḥ ।
abruvaṃśca piśācāstaṃ naivaṃ tvaṃ vaktumarhasi ॥7॥
slp1: sa dfSyamAno rakzoBirjalamaDye'vadattataH । abruvaMSca piSAcAstaM nEvaM tvaM vaktumarhasi ॥7॥

text: tulādhāro vaṇigdharmā vārāṇasyāṃ mahāyaśāḥ । so'pyevaṃ nārhate vaktuṃ yathā tvaṃ dvijasattama ॥8॥
html:
tulādhāro vaṇigdharmā vārāṇasyāṃ mahāyaśāḥ ।
so'pyevaṃ nārhate vaktuṃ yathā tvaṃ dvijasattama ॥8॥
slp1: tulADAro vaRigDarmA vArARasyAM mahAyaSAH । so'pyevaM nArhate vaktuM yaTA tvaM dvijasattama ॥8॥

text: ityukto jājalirbhūtaiḥ pratyuvāca mahātapāḥ । paśyeyaṃ tamahaṃ prājñaṃ tulādhāraṃ yaśasvinam ॥9॥
html:
ityukto jājalirbhūtaiḥ pratyuvāca mahātapāḥ ।
paśyeyaṃ tamahaṃ prājñaṃ tulādhāraṃ yaśasvinam ॥9॥
slp1: ityukto jAjalirBUtEH pratyuvAca mahAtapAH । paSyeyaM tamahaM prAjYaM tulADAraM yaSasvinam ॥9॥

text: iti bruvāṇaṃ tamṛṣiṃ rakṣāṃsyuddhṛtya sāgarāt । abruvangaccha panthānamāsthāyemaṃ dvijottama ॥10॥
html:
iti bruvāṇaṃ tamṛṣiṃ rakṣāṃsyuddhṛtya sāgarāt ।
abruvangaccha panthānamāsthāyemaṃ dvijottama ॥10॥
slp1: iti bruvARaM tamfziM rakzAMsyudDftya sAgarAt । abruvangacCa panTAnamAsTAyemaM dvijottama ॥10॥

text: ityukto jājalirbhūtairjagāma vimanāstadā । vārāṇasyāṃ tulādhāraṃ samāsādyābravīdvacaḥ ॥11॥
html:
ityukto jājalirbhūtairjagāma vimanāstadā ।
vārāṇasyāṃ tulādhāraṃ samāsādyābravīdvacaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: ityukto jAjalirBUtErjagAma vimanAstadA । vArARasyAM tulADAraM samAsAdyAbravIdvacaH ॥11॥

text: kiṃ kṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ karma tāta jājalinā purā । yena siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptastanno vyākhyātumarhasi ॥12॥
html:
kiṃ kṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ karma tāta jājalinā purā ।
yena siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptastanno vyākhyātumarhasi ॥12॥
slp1: kiM kftaM sukftaM karma tAta jAjalinA purA । yena sidDiM parAM prAptastanno vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥12॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atīva tapasā yukto ghoreṇa sa babhūva ha । nadyupasparśanarataḥ sāyaṃ prātarmahātapāḥ ॥13॥
html:
atīva tapasā yukto ghoreṇa sa babhūva ha ।
nadyupasparśanarataḥ sāyaṃ prātarmahātapāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: atIva tapasA yukto GoreRa sa baBUva ha । nadyupasparSanarataH sAyaM prAtarmahAtapAH ॥13॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: agnīnparicaransamyaksvādhyāyaparamo dvijaḥ । vānaprasthavidhānajño jājalirjvalitaḥ śriyā ॥14॥
html:
agnīnparicaransamyaksvādhyāyaparamo dvijaḥ ।
vānaprasthavidhānajño jājalirjvalitaḥ śriyā ॥14॥
slp1: agnInparicaransamyaksvADyAyaparamo dvijaH । vAnaprasTaviDAnajYo jAjalirjvalitaH SriyA ॥14॥

text: satye tapasi tiṣṭhansa na ca dharmamavaikṣata । varṣāsvākāśaśāyī sa hemante jalasaṃśrayaḥ ॥15॥
html:
satye tapasi tiṣṭhansa na ca dharmamavaikṣata ।
varṣāsvākāśaśāyī sa hemante jalasaṃśrayaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: satye tapasi tizWansa na ca DarmamavEkzata । varzAsvAkASaSAyI sa hemante jalasaMSrayaH ॥15॥

text: vatātapasaho grīṣme na ca dharmamavindata । duḥkhaśayyāśca vividhā bhūmau ca parivartanam ॥16॥
html:
vatātapasaho grīṣme na ca dharmamavindata ।
duḥkhaśayyāśca vividhā bhūmau ca parivartanam ॥16॥
slp1: vatAtapasaho grIzme na ca Darmamavindata । duHKaSayyASca viviDA BUmO ca parivartanam ॥16॥

text: tataḥ kadācitsa munirvarṣāsvākāśamāsthitaḥ । antarikṣājjalaṃ mūrdhnā pratyagṛhṇānmuhurmuhuḥ ॥17॥
html:
tataḥ kadācitsa munirvarṣāsvākāśamāsthitaḥ ।
antarikṣājjalaṃ mūrdhnā pratyagṛhṇānmuhurmuhuḥ ॥17॥
slp1: tataH kadAcitsa munirvarzAsvAkASamAsTitaH । antarikzAjjalaM mUrDnA pratyagfhRAnmuhurmuhuH ॥17॥

text: atha tasya jaṭāḥ klinnā babhūvurgrathitāḥ prabho । araṇyagamanānnityaṃ malino malasaṃyutāḥ ॥18॥
html:
atha tasya jaṭāḥ klinnā babhūvurgrathitāḥ prabho ।
araṇyagamanānnityaṃ malino malasaṃyutāḥ ॥18॥
slp1: aTa tasya jawAH klinnA baBUvurgraTitAH praBo । araRyagamanAnnityaM malino malasaMyutAH ॥18॥

text: sa kadācinnirāhāro vāyubhakṣo mahātapāḥ । tasthau kāṣṭhavadavyagro na cacāla ca karhicit ॥19॥
html:
sa kadācinnirāhāro vāyubhakṣo mahātapāḥ ।
tasthau kāṣṭhavadavyagro na cacāla ca karhicit ॥19॥
slp1: sa kadAcinnirAhAro vAyuBakzo mahAtapAH । tasTO kAzWavadavyagro na cacAla ca karhicit ॥19॥

text: tasya sma sthāṇubhūtasya nirviceṣṭasya bhārata । kuliṅgaśakunau rājannīḍaṃ śirasi cakratuḥ ॥20॥
html:
tasya sma sthāṇubhūtasya nirviceṣṭasya bhārata ।
kuliṅgaśakunau rājannīḍaṃ śirasi cakratuḥ ॥20॥
slp1: tasya sma sTARuBUtasya nirvicezwasya BArata । kuliNgaSakunO rAjannIqaM Sirasi cakratuH ॥20॥

text: sa tau dayāvānviprarṣirupapraikṣata dampatī । kurvāṇaṃ nīḍakaṃ tatra jaṭāsu tṛṇatantubhiḥ ॥21॥
html:
sa tau dayāvānviprarṣirupapraikṣata dampatī ।
kurvāṇaṃ nīḍakaṃ tatra jaṭāsu tṛṇatantubhiḥ ॥21॥
slp1: sa tO dayAvAnviprarzirupaprEkzata dampatI । kurvARaM nIqakaM tatra jawAsu tfRatantuBiH ॥21॥

text: yadā sa na calatyeva sthāṇubhūto mahātapāḥ । tatastau pariviśvastau sukhaṃ tatroṣatustadā ॥22॥
html:
yadā sa na calatyeva sthāṇubhūto mahātapāḥ ।
tatastau pariviśvastau sukhaṃ tatroṣatustadā ॥22॥
slp1: yadA sa na calatyeva sTARuBUto mahAtapAH । tatastO pariviSvastO suKaM tatrozatustadA ॥22॥

text: atītāsvatha varṣāsu śaratkāla upasthite । prājāpatyena vidhinā viśvāsātkāmamohitau ॥23॥
html:
atītāsvatha varṣāsu śaratkāla upasthite ।
prājāpatyena vidhinā viśvāsātkāmamohitau ॥23॥
slp1: atItAsvaTa varzAsu SaratkAla upasTite । prAjApatyena viDinA viSvAsAtkAmamohitO ॥23॥

text: tatrāpātayatāṃ rājañśirasyaṇḍāni khecarau । tānyabudhyata tejasvī sa vipraḥ saṃśitavrataḥ ॥24॥
html:
tatrāpātayatāṃ rājañśirasyaṇḍāni khecarau ।
tānyabudhyata tejasvī sa vipraḥ saṃśitavrataḥ ॥24॥
slp1: tatrApAtayatAM rAjaYSirasyaRqAni KecarO । tAnyabuDyata tejasvI sa vipraH saMSitavrataH ॥24॥

text: buddhvā ca sa mahātejā na cacālaiva jājaliḥ । dharme dhṛtamanā nityaṃ nādharmaṃ sa tvarocayat ॥25॥
html:
buddhvā ca sa mahātejā na cacālaiva jājaliḥ ।
dharme dhṛtamanā nityaṃ nādharmaṃ sa tvarocayat ॥25॥
slp1: budDvA ca sa mahAtejA na cacAlEva jAjaliH । Darme DftamanA nityaM nADarmaM sa tvarocayat ॥25॥

text: ahanyahani cāgamya tatastau tasya mūrdhani । āśvāsitau vai vasataḥ samprahṛṣṭau tadā vibho ॥26॥
html:
ahanyahani cāgamya tatastau tasya mūrdhani ।
āśvāsitau vai vasataḥ samprahṛṣṭau tadā vibho ॥26॥
slp1: ahanyahani cAgamya tatastO tasya mUrDani । ASvAsitO vE vasataH samprahfzwO tadA viBo ॥26॥

text: aṇḍebhyastvatha puṣṭebhyaḥ prajāyanta śakuntakāḥ । vyavardhanta ca tatraiva na cākampata jājaliḥ ॥27॥
html:
aṇḍebhyastvatha puṣṭebhyaḥ prajāyanta śakuntakāḥ ।
vyavardhanta ca tatraiva na cākampata jājaliḥ ॥27॥
slp1: aRqeByastvaTa puzweByaH prajAyanta SakuntakAH । vyavarDanta ca tatrEva na cAkampata jAjaliH ॥27॥

text: sa rakṣamāṇastvaṇḍāni kuliṅgānāṃ yatavrataḥ । tathaiva tasthau dharmātmā nirviceṣṭaḥ samāhitaḥ ॥28॥
html:
sa rakṣamāṇastvaṇḍāni kuliṅgānāṃ yatavrataḥ ।
tathaiva tasthau dharmātmā nirviceṣṭaḥ samāhitaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: sa rakzamARastvaRqAni kuliNgAnAM yatavrataH । taTEva tasTO DarmAtmA nirvicezwaH samAhitaH ॥28॥

text: tatastu kālasamaye babhūvuste'tha pakṣiṇaḥ । bubudhe tāṃśca sa munirjātapakṣāñśakuntakān ॥29॥
html:
tatastu kālasamaye babhūvuste'tha pakṣiṇaḥ ।
bubudhe tāṃśca sa munirjātapakṣāñśakuntakān ॥29॥
slp1: tatastu kAlasamaye baBUvuste'Ta pakziRaH । bubuDe tAMSca sa munirjAtapakzAYSakuntakAn ॥29॥

text: tataḥ kadācittāṃstatra paśyanpakṣīnyatavrataḥ । babhūva paramaprītastadā matimatāṃ varaḥ ॥30॥
html:
tataḥ kadācittāṃstatra paśyanpakṣīnyatavrataḥ ।
babhūva paramaprītastadā matimatāṃ varaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: tataH kadAcittAMstatra paSyanpakzInyatavrataH । baBUva paramaprItastadA matimatAM varaH ॥30॥

text: tathā tānabhisaṃvṛddhāndṛṣṭvā cāpnuvatāṃ mudam । śakunau nirbhayau tatra ūṣatuścātmajaiḥ saha ॥31॥
html:
tathā tānabhisaṃvṛddhāndṛṣṭvā cāpnuvatāṃ mudam ।
śakunau nirbhayau tatra ūṣatuścātmajaiḥ saha ॥31॥
slp1: taTA tAnaBisaMvfdDAndfzwvA cApnuvatAM mudam । SakunO nirBayO tatra UzatuScAtmajEH saha ॥31॥

text: jātapakṣāṃśca so'paśyaduḍḍīnānpunarāgatān । sāyaṃ sāyaṃ dvijānvipro na cākampata jājaliḥ ॥32॥
html:
jātapakṣāṃśca so'paśyaduḍḍīnānpunarāgatān ।
sāyaṃ sāyaṃ dvijānvipro na cākampata jājaliḥ ॥32॥
slp1: jAtapakzAMSca so'paSyaduqqInAnpunarAgatAn । sAyaM sAyaM dvijAnvipro na cAkampata jAjaliH ॥32॥

text: kadācitpunarabhyetya punargacchanti santatam । tyaktā mātṛpitṛbhyāṃ te na cākampata jājaliḥ ॥33॥
html:
kadācitpunarabhyetya punargacchanti santatam ।
tyaktā mātṛpitṛbhyāṃ te na cākampata jājaliḥ ॥33॥
slp1: kadAcitpunaraByetya punargacCanti santatam । tyaktA mAtfpitfByAM te na cAkampata jAjaliH ॥33॥

text: atha te divasaṃ cārīṃ gatvā sāyaṃ punarnṛpa । upāvartanta tatraiva nivāsārthaṃ śakuntakāḥ ॥34॥
html:
atha te divasaṃ cārīṃ gatvā sāyaṃ punarnṛpa ।
upāvartanta tatraiva nivāsārthaṃ śakuntakāḥ ॥34॥
slp1: aTa te divasaM cArIM gatvA sAyaM punarnfpa । upAvartanta tatrEva nivAsArTaM SakuntakAH ॥34॥

text: kadāciddivasānpañca samutpatya vihaṅgamāḥ । ṣaṣṭhe'hani samājagmurna cākampata jājaliḥ ॥35॥
html:
kadāciddivasānpañca samutpatya vihaṅgamāḥ ।
ṣaṣṭhe'hani samājagmurna cākampata jājaliḥ ॥35॥
slp1: kadAciddivasAnpaYca samutpatya vihaNgamAH । zazWe'hani samAjagmurna cAkampata jAjaliH ॥35॥
