abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyaḥ sa prāpnoti sadā mune ॥25॥
slp1: yasmAnnodvijate BUtaM jAtu kiYcitkaTaYcana । aBayaM sarvaBUteByaH sa prApnoti sadA mune ॥25॥

text: yasmādudvijate vidvansarvaloko vṛkādiva । krośatastīramāsādya yathā sarve jalecarāḥ ॥26॥
html:
yasmādudvijate vidvansarvaloko vṛkādiva ।
krośatastīramāsādya yathā sarve jalecarāḥ ॥26॥
slp1: yasmAdudvijate vidvansarvaloko vfkAdiva । kroSatastIramAsAdya yaTA sarve jalecarAH ॥26॥

text: sahāyavāndravyavānyaḥ subhago'nyo'parastathā । tatastāneva kavayaḥ śāstreṣu pravadantyuta । kīrtyarthamalpahṛllekhāḥ paṭavaḥ kṛtsnanirṇayāḥ ॥27॥
html:
sahāyavāndravyavānyaḥ subhago'nyo'parastathā ।
tatastāneva kavayaḥ śāstreṣu pravadantyuta ।
kīrtyarthamalpahṛllekhāḥ paṭavaḥ kṛtsnanirṇayāḥ ॥27॥
slp1: sahAyavAndravyavAnyaH suBago'nyo'parastaTA । tatastAneva kavayaH SAstrezu pravadantyuta । kIrtyarTamalpahflleKAH pawavaH kftsnanirRayAH ॥27॥

text: tapobhiryajñadānaiśca vākyaiḥ prajñāśritaistathā । prāpnotyabhayadānasya yadyatphalamihāśnute ॥28॥
html:
tapobhiryajñadānaiśca vākyaiḥ prajñāśritaistathā ।
prāpnotyabhayadānasya yadyatphalamihāśnute ॥28॥
slp1: tapoBiryajYadAnESca vAkyEH prajYASritEstaTA । prApnotyaBayadAnasya yadyatPalamihASnute ॥28॥

text: loke yaḥ sarvabhūtebhyo dadātyabhayadakṣiṇām । sa sarvayajñairījānaḥ prāpnotyabhayadakṣiṇām । na bhūtānāmahiṃsāyā jyāyāndharmo'sti kaścana ॥29॥
html:
loke yaḥ sarvabhūtebhyo dadātyabhayadakṣiṇām ।
sa sarvayajñairījānaḥ prāpnotyabhayadakṣiṇām ।
na bhūtānāmahiṃsāyā jyāyāndharmo'sti kaścana ॥29॥
slp1: loke yaH sarvaBUteByo dadAtyaBayadakziRAm । sa sarvayajYErIjAnaH prApnotyaBayadakziRAm । na BUtAnAmahiMsAyA jyAyAnDarmo'sti kaScana ॥29॥

text: yasmānnodvijate bhūtaṃ jātu kiñcitkathañcana । so'bhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyaḥ samprāpnoti mahāmune ॥30॥
html:
yasmānnodvijate bhūtaṃ jātu kiñcitkathañcana ।
so'bhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyaḥ samprāpnoti mahāmune ॥30॥
slp1: yasmAnnodvijate BUtaM jAtu kiYcitkaTaYcana । so'BayaM sarvaBUteByaH samprApnoti mahAmune ॥30॥

text: yasmādudvijate lokaḥ sarpādveśmagatādiva । na sa dharmamavāpnoti iha loke paratra ca ॥31॥
html:
yasmādudvijate lokaḥ sarpādveśmagatādiva ।
na sa dharmamavāpnoti iha loke paratra ca ॥31॥
slp1: yasmAdudvijate lokaH sarpAdveSmagatAdiva । na sa DarmamavApnoti iha loke paratra ca ॥31॥

text: sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya samyagbhūtāni paśyataḥ । devāpi mārge muhyanti apadasya padaiṣiṇaḥ ॥32॥
html:
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya samyagbhūtāni paśyataḥ ।
devāpi mārge muhyanti apadasya padaiṣiṇaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: sarvaBUtAtmaBUtasya samyagBUtAni paSyataH । devApi mArge muhyanti apadasya padEziRaH ॥32॥

text: dānaṃ bhūtābhayasyāhuḥ sarvadānebhya uttamam । bravīmi te satyamidaṃ śraddadhasva ca jājale ॥33॥
html:
dānaṃ bhūtābhayasyāhuḥ sarvadānebhya uttamam ।
bravīmi te satyamidaṃ śraddadhasva ca jājale ॥33॥
slp1: dAnaM BUtABayasyAhuH sarvadAneBya uttamam । bravImi te satyamidaM SraddaDasva ca jAjale ॥33॥

text: sa eva subhago bhūtvā punarbhavati durbhagaḥ । vyāpattiṃ karmaṇāṃ dṛṣṭvā jugupsanti janāḥ sadā ॥34॥
html:
sa eva subhago bhūtvā punarbhavati durbhagaḥ ।
vyāpattiṃ karmaṇāṃ dṛṣṭvā jugupsanti janāḥ sadā ॥34॥
slp1: sa eva suBago BUtvA punarBavati durBagaH । vyApattiM karmaRAM dfzwvA jugupsanti janAH sadA ॥34॥

text: akāraṇo hi nehāsti dharmaḥ sūkṣmo'pi jājale । bhūtabhavyārthameveha dharmapravacanaṃ kṛtam ॥35॥
html:
akāraṇo hi nehāsti dharmaḥ sūkṣmo'pi jājale ।
bhūtabhavyārthameveha dharmapravacanaṃ kṛtam ॥35॥
slp1: akAraRo hi nehAsti DarmaH sUkzmo'pi jAjale । BUtaBavyArTameveha DarmapravacanaM kftam ॥35॥

text: sūkṣmatvānna sa vijñātuṃ śakyate bahunihnavaḥ । upalabhyāntarā cānyānācārānavabudhyate ॥36॥
html:
sūkṣmatvānna sa vijñātuṃ śakyate bahunihnavaḥ ।
upalabhyāntarā cānyānācārānavabudhyate ॥36॥
slp1: sUkzmatvAnna sa vijYAtuM Sakyate bahunihnavaH । upalaByAntarA cAnyAnAcArAnavabuDyate ॥36॥

text: ye ca chindanti vṛṣaṇānye ca bhindanti nastakān । vahanti mahato bhārānbadhnanti damayanti ca ॥37॥
html:
ye ca chindanti vṛṣaṇānye ca bhindanti nastakān ।
vahanti mahato bhārānbadhnanti damayanti ca ॥37॥
slp1: ye ca Cindanti vfzaRAnye ca Bindanti nastakAn । vahanti mahato BArAnbaDnanti damayanti ca ॥37॥

text: hatvā sattvāni khādanti tānkathaṃ na vigarhase । mānuṣā mānuṣāneva dāsabhogena bhuñjate ॥38॥
html:
hatvā sattvāni khādanti tānkathaṃ na vigarhase ।
mānuṣā mānuṣāneva dāsabhogena bhuñjate ॥38॥
slp1: hatvA sattvAni KAdanti tAnkaTaM na vigarhase । mAnuzA mAnuzAneva dAsaBogena BuYjate ॥38॥

text: vadhabandhavirodhena kārayanti divāniśam । ātmanā cāpi jānāsi yadduḥkhaṃ vadhatāḍane ॥39॥
html:
vadhabandhavirodhena kārayanti divāniśam ।
ātmanā cāpi jānāsi yadduḥkhaṃ vadhatāḍane ॥39॥
slp1: vaDabanDaviroDena kArayanti divAniSam । AtmanA cApi jAnAsi yadduHKaM vaDatAqane ॥39॥

text: pañcendriyeṣu bhūteṣu sarvaṃ vasati daivatam । ādityaścandramā vāyurbrahmā prāṇaḥ kraturyamaḥ ॥40॥
html:
pañcendriyeṣu bhūteṣu sarvaṃ vasati daivatam ।
ādityaścandramā vāyurbrahmā prāṇaḥ kraturyamaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: paYcendriyezu BUtezu sarvaM vasati dEvatam । AdityaScandramA vAyurbrahmA prARaH kraturyamaH ॥40॥

text: tāni jīvāni vikrīya kā mṛteṣu vicāraṇā । kā taile kā ghṛte brahmanmadhunyapsvauṣadheṣu vā ॥41॥
html:
tāni jīvāni vikrīya kā mṛteṣu vicāraṇā ।
kā taile kā ghṛte brahmanmadhunyapsvauṣadheṣu vā ॥41॥
slp1: tAni jIvAni vikrIya kA mftezu vicAraRA । kA tEle kA Gfte brahmanmaDunyapsvOzaDezu vA ॥41॥

text: adaṃśamaśake deśe sukhaṃ saṃvardhitānpaśūn । tāṃśca mātuḥ priyāñjānannākramya bahudhā narāḥ । bahudaṃśakuśāndeśānnayanti bahukardamān ॥42॥
html:
adaṃśamaśake deśe sukhaṃ saṃvardhitānpaśūn ।
tāṃśca mātuḥ priyāñjānannākramya bahudhā narāḥ ।
bahudaṃśakuśāndeśānnayanti bahukardamān ॥42॥
slp1: adaMSamaSake deSe suKaM saMvarDitAnpaSUn । tAMSca mAtuH priyAYjAnannAkramya bahuDA narAH । bahudaMSakuSAndeSAnnayanti bahukardamAn ॥42॥

text: vāhasampīḍitā dhuryāḥ sīdantyavidhināpare । na manye bhrūṇahatyāpi viśiṣṭā tena karmaṇā ॥43॥
html:
vāhasampīḍitā dhuryāḥ sīdantyavidhināpare ।
na manye bhrūṇahatyāpi viśiṣṭā tena karmaṇā ॥43॥
slp1: vAhasampIqitA DuryAH sIdantyaviDinApare । na manye BrURahatyApi viSizwA tena karmaRA ॥43॥

text: kṛṣiṃ sādhviti manyante sā ca vṛttiḥ sudāruṇā । bhūmiṃ bhūmiśayāṃścaiva hanti kāṣṭhamayomukham । tathaivānaḍuho yuktānsamavekṣasva jājale ॥44॥
html:
kṛṣiṃ sādhviti manyante sā ca vṛttiḥ sudāruṇā ।
bhūmiṃ bhūmiśayāṃścaiva hanti kāṣṭhamayomukham ।
tathaivānaḍuho yuktānsamavekṣasva jājale ॥44॥
slp1: kfziM sADviti manyante sA ca vfttiH sudAruRA । BUmiM BUmiSayAMScEva hanti kAzWamayomuKam । taTEvAnaquho yuktAnsamavekzasva jAjale ॥44॥

text: aghnyā iti gavāṃ nāma ka enānhantumarhati । mahaccakārākuśalaṃ pṛṣadhro gālabhanniva ॥45॥
html:
aghnyā iti gavāṃ nāma ka enānhantumarhati ।
mahaccakārākuśalaṃ pṛṣadhro gālabhanniva ॥45॥
slp1: aGnyA iti gavAM nAma ka enAnhantumarhati । mahaccakArAkuSalaM pfzaDro gAlaBanniva ॥45॥

text: ṛṣayo yatayo hyetannahuṣe pratyavedayan । gāṃ mātaraṃ cāpyavadhīrvṛṣabhaṃ ca prajāpatim । akāryaṃ nahuṣākārṣīrlapsyāmastvatkṛte bhayam ॥46॥
html:
ṛṣayo yatayo hyetannahuṣe pratyavedayan ।
gāṃ mātaraṃ cāpyavadhīrvṛṣabhaṃ ca prajāpatim ।
akāryaṃ nahuṣākārṣīrlapsyāmastvatkṛte bhayam ॥46॥
slp1: fzayo yatayo hyetannahuze pratyavedayan । gAM mAtaraM cApyavaDIrvfzaBaM ca prajApatim । akAryaM nahuzAkArzIrlapsyAmastvatkfte Bayam ॥46॥

text: śataṃ caikaṃ ca rogāṇāṃ sarvabhūteṣvapātayan । ṛṣayaste mahābhāgāḥ prajāsveva hi jājale । bhrūṇahaṃ nahuṣaṃ tvāhurna te hoṣyāmahe haviḥ ॥47॥
html:
śataṃ caikaṃ ca rogāṇāṃ sarvabhūteṣvapātayan ।
ṛṣayaste mahābhāgāḥ prajāsveva hi jājale ।
bhrūṇahaṃ nahuṣaṃ tvāhurna te hoṣyāmahe haviḥ ॥47॥
slp1: SataM cEkaM ca rogARAM sarvaBUtezvapAtayan । fzayaste mahABAgAH prajAsveva hi jAjale । BrURahaM nahuzaM tvAhurna te hozyAmahe haviH ॥47॥

text: ityuktvā te mahātmānaḥ sarve tattvārthadarśinaḥ । ṛṣayo yatayaḥ śāntāstarasā pratyavedayan ॥48॥
html:
ityuktvā te mahātmānaḥ sarve tattvārthadarśinaḥ ।
ṛṣayo yatayaḥ śāntāstarasā pratyavedayan ॥48॥
slp1: ityuktvA te mahAtmAnaH sarve tattvArTadarSinaH । fzayo yatayaH SAntAstarasA pratyavedayan ॥48॥

text: īdṛśānaśivānghorānācārāniha jājale । kevalācaritatvāttu nipuṇānnāvabudhyase ॥49॥
html:
īdṛśānaśivānghorānācārāniha jājale ।
kevalācaritatvāttu nipuṇānnāvabudhyase ॥49॥
slp1: IdfSAnaSivAnGorAnAcArAniha jAjale । kevalAcaritatvAttu nipuRAnnAvabuDyase ॥49॥

text: kāraṇāddharmamanvicchenna lokacaritaṃ caret । yo hanyādyaśca māṃ stauti tatrāpi śṛṇu jājale ॥50॥
html:
kāraṇāddharmamanvicchenna lokacaritaṃ caret ।
yo hanyādyaśca māṃ stauti tatrāpi śṛṇu jājale ॥50॥
slp1: kAraRAdDarmamanvicCenna lokacaritaM caret । yo hanyAdyaSca mAM stOti tatrApi SfRu jAjale ॥50॥

text: samau tāvapi me syātāṃ na hi me staḥ priyāpriye । etadīdṛśakaṃ dharmaṃ praśaṃsanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥51॥
html:
samau tāvapi me syātāṃ na hi me staḥ priyāpriye ।
etadīdṛśakaṃ dharmaṃ praśaṃsanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥51॥
slp1: samO tAvapi me syAtAM na hi me staH priyApriye । etadIdfSakaM DarmaM praSaMsanti manIziRaH ॥51॥

text: upapattyā hi sampanno yatibhiścaiva sevyate । satataṃ dharmaśīlaiśca naipuṇyenopalakṣitaḥ] ॥52॥
html:
upapattyā hi sampanno yatibhiścaiva sevyate ।
satataṃ dharmaśīlaiśca naipuṇyenopalakṣitaḥ] ॥52॥
slp1: upapattyA hi sampanno yatiBiScEva sevyate । satataM DarmaSIlESca nEpuRyenopalakzitaH] ॥52॥

text: yathā pravartito dharmastulāṃ dhārayatā tvayā । svargadvāraṃ ca vṛttiṃ ca bhūtānāmavarotsyate ॥1॥
html:
yathā pravartito dharmastulāṃ dhārayatā tvayā ।
svargadvāraṃ ca vṛttiṃ ca bhūtānāmavarotsyate ॥1॥
slp1: yaTA pravartito DarmastulAM DArayatA tvayA । svargadvAraM ca vfttiM ca BUtAnAmavarotsyate ॥1॥
author: jājaliruvāca ।

text: kṛṣyā hyannaṃ prabhavati tatastvamapi jīvasi । paśubhiścauṣadhībhiśca martyā jīvanti vāṇija ॥2॥
html:
kṛṣyā hyannaṃ prabhavati tatastvamapi jīvasi ।
paśubhiścauṣadhībhiśca martyā jīvanti vāṇija ॥2॥
slp1: kfzyA hyannaM praBavati tatastvamapi jIvasi । paSuBiScOzaDIBiSca martyA jIvanti vARija ॥2॥

text: yato yajñaḥ prabhavati nāstikyamapi jalpasi । na hi vartedayaṃ loko vārtāmutsṛjya kevalam ॥3॥
html:
yato yajñaḥ prabhavati nāstikyamapi jalpasi ।
na hi vartedayaṃ loko vārtāmutsṛjya kevalam ॥3॥
slp1: yato yajYaH praBavati nAstikyamapi jalpasi । na hi vartedayaM loko vArtAmutsfjya kevalam ॥3॥

text: vakṣyāmi jājale vṛttiṃ nāsmi brāhmaṇa nāstikaḥ । na ca yajñaṃ vinindāmi yajñavittu sudurlabhaḥ ॥4॥
html:
vakṣyāmi jājale vṛttiṃ nāsmi brāhmaṇa nāstikaḥ ।
na ca yajñaṃ vinindāmi yajñavittu sudurlabhaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: vakzyAmi jAjale vfttiM nAsmi brAhmaRa nAstikaH । na ca yajYaM vinindAmi yajYavittu sudurlaBaH ॥4॥
author: tulādhāra uvāca ।

text: namo brāhmaṇayajñāya ye ca yajñavido janāḥ । svayajñaṃ brāhmaṇā hitvā kṣātraṃ yajñamihāsthitāḥ ॥5॥
html:
namo brāhmaṇayajñāya ye ca yajñavido janāḥ ।
svayajñaṃ brāhmaṇā hitvā kṣātraṃ yajñamihāsthitāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: namo brAhmaRayajYAya ye ca yajYavido janAH । svayajYaM brAhmaRA hitvA kzAtraM yajYamihAsTitAH ॥5॥

text: lubdhairvittaparairbrahmannāstikaiḥ sampravartitam । vedavādānavijñāya satyābhāsamivānṛtam ॥6॥
html:
lubdhairvittaparairbrahmannāstikaiḥ sampravartitam ।
vedavādānavijñāya satyābhāsamivānṛtam ॥6॥
slp1: lubDErvittaparErbrahmannAstikEH sampravartitam । vedavAdAnavijYAya satyABAsamivAnftam ॥6॥

text: idaṃ deyamidaṃ deyamiti nāntaṃ cikīrṣati । ataḥ stainyaṃ prabhavati vikarmāṇi ca jājale । tadeva sukṛtaṃ havyaṃ yena tuṣyanti devatāḥ ॥7॥
html:
idaṃ deyamidaṃ deyamiti nāntaṃ cikīrṣati ।
ataḥ stainyaṃ prabhavati vikarmāṇi ca jājale ।
tadeva sukṛtaṃ havyaṃ yena tuṣyanti devatāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: idaM deyamidaM deyamiti nAntaM cikIrzati । ataH stEnyaM praBavati vikarmARi ca jAjale । tadeva sukftaM havyaM yena tuzyanti devatAH ॥7॥

text: namaskāreṇa haviṣā svādhyāyairauṣadhaistathā । pūjā syāddevatānāṃ hi yathā śāstranidarśanam ॥8॥
html:
namaskāreṇa haviṣā svādhyāyairauṣadhaistathā ।
pūjā syāddevatānāṃ hi yathā śāstranidarśanam ॥8॥
slp1: namaskAreRa havizA svADyAyErOzaDEstaTA । pUjA syAddevatAnAM hi yaTA SAstranidarSanam ॥8॥

text: iṣṭāpūrtādasādhūnāṃ viṣamā jāyate prajā । lubdhebhyo jāyate lubdhaḥ samebhyo jāyate samaḥ ॥9॥
html:
iṣṭāpūrtādasādhūnāṃ viṣamā jāyate prajā ।
lubdhebhyo jāyate lubdhaḥ samebhyo jāyate samaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: izwApUrtAdasADUnAM vizamA jAyate prajA । lubDeByo jAyate lubDaH sameByo jAyate samaH ॥9॥

text: yajamāno yathātmānamṛtvijaśca tathā prajāḥ । yajñātprajā prabhavati nabhaso'mbha ivāmalam ॥10॥
html:
yajamāno yathātmānamṛtvijaśca tathā prajāḥ ।
yajñātprajā prabhavati nabhaso'mbha ivāmalam ॥10॥
slp1: yajamAno yaTAtmAnamftvijaSca taTA prajAH । yajYAtprajA praBavati naBaso'mBa ivAmalam ॥10॥

text: agnau prāstāhutirbrahmannādityamupatiṣṭhati । ādityājjāyate vṛṣṭirvṛṣṭerannaṃ tataḥ prajāḥ ॥11॥
html:
agnau prāstāhutirbrahmannādityamupatiṣṭhati ।
ādityājjāyate vṛṣṭirvṛṣṭerannaṃ tataḥ prajāḥ ॥11॥
slp1: agnO prAstAhutirbrahmannAdityamupatizWati । AdityAjjAyate vfzwirvfzwerannaM tataH prajAH ॥11॥

text: tasmātsvanuṣṭhitātpūrve sarvānkāmāṃśca lebhire । akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī āśīrbhirvīrudho'bhavan । na te yajñeṣvātmasu vā phalaṃ paśyanti kiñcana ॥12॥
html:
tasmātsvanuṣṭhitātpūrve sarvānkāmāṃśca lebhire ।
akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī āśīrbhirvīrudho'bhavan ।
na te yajñeṣvātmasu vā phalaṃ paśyanti kiñcana ॥12॥
slp1: tasmAtsvanuzWitAtpUrve sarvAnkAmAMSca leBire । akfzwapacyA pfTivI ASIrBirvIruDo'Bavan । na te yajYezvAtmasu vA PalaM paSyanti kiYcana ॥12॥

text: śaṅkamānāḥ phalaṃ yajñe ye yajerankathañcana । jāyante'sādhavo dhūrtā lubdhā vittaprayojanāḥ ॥13॥
html:
śaṅkamānāḥ phalaṃ yajñe ye yajerankathañcana ।
jāyante'sādhavo dhūrtā lubdhā vittaprayojanāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: SaNkamAnAH PalaM yajYe ye yajerankaTaYcana । jAyante'sADavo DUrtA lubDA vittaprayojanAH ॥13॥

text: sa sma pāpakṛtāṃ lokāngacchedaśubhakarmaṇā । pramāṇamapramāṇena yaḥ kuryādaśubhaṃ naraḥ । pāpātmā so'kṛtaprajñaḥ sadaiveha dvijottama ॥14॥
html:
sa sma pāpakṛtāṃ lokāngacchedaśubhakarmaṇā ।
pramāṇamapramāṇena yaḥ kuryādaśubhaṃ naraḥ ।
pāpātmā so'kṛtaprajñaḥ sadaiveha dvijottama ॥14॥
slp1: sa sma pApakftAM lokAngacCedaSuBakarmaRA । pramARamapramARena yaH kuryAdaSuBaM naraH । pApAtmA so'kftaprajYaH sadEveha dvijottama ॥14॥

text: kartavyamiti kartavyaṃ vetti yo brāhmaṇobhayam । brahmaiva vartate loke naiti kartavyatāṃ punaḥ ॥15॥
html:
kartavyamiti kartavyaṃ vetti yo brāhmaṇobhayam ।
brahmaiva vartate loke naiti kartavyatāṃ punaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: kartavyamiti kartavyaM vetti yo brAhmaRoBayam । brahmEva vartate loke nEti kartavyatAM punaH ॥15॥

text: viguṇaṃ ca punaḥ karma jyāya ityanuśuśruma । sarvabhūtopaghātaśca phalabhāve ca saṃyamaḥ ॥16॥
html:
viguṇaṃ ca punaḥ karma jyāya ityanuśuśruma ।
sarvabhūtopaghātaśca phalabhāve ca saṃyamaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: viguRaM ca punaH karma jyAya ityanuSuSruma । sarvaBUtopaGAtaSca PalaBAve ca saMyamaH ॥16॥

text: satyayajñā damayajñā alubdhāścātmatṛptayaḥ । utpannatyāginaḥ sarve janā āsannamatsarāḥ ॥17॥
html:
satyayajñā damayajñā alubdhāścātmatṛptayaḥ ।
utpannatyāginaḥ sarve janā āsannamatsarāḥ ॥17॥
slp1: satyayajYA damayajYA alubDAScAtmatfptayaH । utpannatyAginaH sarve janA AsannamatsarAH ॥17॥

text: kṣetrakṣetrajñatattvajñāḥ svayajñapariniṣṭhitāḥ । brāhmaṃ vedamadhīyantastoṣayantyamarānapi ॥18॥
html:
kṣetrakṣetrajñatattvajñāḥ svayajñapariniṣṭhitāḥ ।
brāhmaṃ vedamadhīyantastoṣayantyamarānapi ॥18॥
slp1: kzetrakzetrajYatattvajYAH svayajYaparinizWitAH । brAhmaM vedamaDIyantastozayantyamarAnapi ॥18॥

text: akhilaṃ daivataṃ sarvaṃ brahma brāhmaṇasaṃśritam । tṛpyanti tṛpyato devāstṛptāstṛptasya jājale ॥19॥
html:
akhilaṃ daivataṃ sarvaṃ brahma brāhmaṇasaṃśritam ।
tṛpyanti tṛpyato devāstṛptāstṛptasya jājale ॥19॥
slp1: aKilaM dEvataM sarvaM brahma brAhmaRasaMSritam । tfpyanti tfpyato devAstfptAstfptasya jAjale ॥19॥

text: yathā sarvarasaistṛpto nābhinandati kiñcana । tathā prajñānatṛptasya nityaṃ tṛptiḥ sukhodayā ॥20॥
html:
yathā sarvarasaistṛpto nābhinandati kiñcana ।
tathā prajñānatṛptasya nityaṃ tṛptiḥ sukhodayā ॥20॥
slp1: yaTA sarvarasEstfpto nABinandati kiYcana । taTA prajYAnatfptasya nityaM tfptiH suKodayA ॥20॥

text: dharmārāmā dharmasukhāḥ kṛtsnavyavasitāstathā । asti nastattvato bhūya iti prajñāgaveṣiṇaḥ ॥21॥
html:
dharmārāmā dharmasukhāḥ kṛtsnavyavasitāstathā ।
asti nastattvato bhūya iti prajñāgaveṣiṇaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: DarmArAmA DarmasuKAH kftsnavyavasitAstaTA । asti nastattvato BUya iti prajYAgaveziRaH ॥21॥

text: jñānavijñāninaḥ kecitparaṃ pāraṃ titīrṣavaḥ । atīva tatsadā puṇyaṃ puṇyābhijanasaṃhitam ॥22॥
html:
jñānavijñāninaḥ kecitparaṃ pāraṃ titīrṣavaḥ ।
atīva tatsadā puṇyaṃ puṇyābhijanasaṃhitam ॥22॥
slp1: jYAnavijYAninaH kecitparaM pAraM titIrzavaH । atIva tatsadA puRyaM puRyABijanasaMhitam ॥22॥

text: yatra gatvā na śocanti na cyavanti vyathanti ca । te tu tadbrahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ prāpnuvantīha sāttvikāḥ ॥23॥
html:
yatra gatvā na śocanti na cyavanti vyathanti ca ।
te tu tadbrahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ prāpnuvantīha sāttvikāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: yatra gatvA na Socanti na cyavanti vyaTanti ca । te tu tadbrahmaRaH sTAnaM prApnuvantIha sAttvikAH ॥23॥

text: naiva te svargamicchanti na yajanti yaśodhanaiḥ । satāṃ vartmānuvartante yathābalamahiṃsayā ॥24॥
html:
naiva te svargamicchanti na yajanti yaśodhanaiḥ ।
satāṃ vartmānuvartante yathābalamahiṃsayā ॥24॥
slp1: nEva te svargamicCanti na yajanti yaSoDanEH । satAM vartmAnuvartante yaTAbalamahiMsayA ॥24॥

text: vanaspatīnoṣadhīśca phalamūlaṃ ca te viduḥ । na caitānṛtvijo lubdhā yājayanti dhanārthinaḥ ॥25॥
html:
vanaspatīnoṣadhīśca phalamūlaṃ ca te viduḥ ।
na caitānṛtvijo lubdhā yājayanti dhanārthinaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: vanaspatInozaDISca PalamUlaM ca te viduH । na cEtAnftvijo lubDA yAjayanti DanArTinaH ॥25॥

text: svameva cārthaṃ kurvāṇā yajñaṃ cakruḥ punardvijāḥ । pariniṣṭhitakarmāṇaḥ prajānugrahakāmyayā ॥26॥
html:
svameva cārthaṃ kurvāṇā yajñaṃ cakruḥ punardvijāḥ ।
pariniṣṭhitakarmāṇaḥ prajānugrahakāmyayā ॥26॥
slp1: svameva cArTaM kurvARA yajYaM cakruH punardvijAH । parinizWitakarmARaH prajAnugrahakAmyayA ॥26॥

text: prāpayeyuḥ prajāḥ svargaṃ svadharmacaraṇena vai । iti me vartate buddhiḥ samā sarvatra jājale ॥27॥
html:
prāpayeyuḥ prajāḥ svargaṃ svadharmacaraṇena vai ।
iti me vartate buddhiḥ samā sarvatra jājale ॥27॥
slp1: prApayeyuH prajAH svargaM svaDarmacaraRena vE । iti me vartate budDiH samA sarvatra jAjale ॥27॥

text: prayuñjate yāni yajñe sadā prājñā dvijarṣabha । tena te devayānena pathā yānti mahāmune ॥28॥
html:
prayuñjate yāni yajñe sadā prājñā dvijarṣabha ।
tena te devayānena pathā yānti mahāmune ॥28॥
slp1: prayuYjate yAni yajYe sadA prAjYA dvijarzaBa । tena te devayAnena paTA yAnti mahAmune ॥28॥

text: āvṛttistatra caikasya nāstyāvṛttirmanīṣiṇām । ubhau tau devayānena gacchato jājale pathā ॥29॥
html:
āvṛttistatra caikasya nāstyāvṛttirmanīṣiṇām ।
ubhau tau devayānena gacchato jājale pathā ॥29॥
slp1: Avfttistatra cEkasya nAstyAvfttirmanIziRAm । uBO tO devayAnena gacCato jAjale paTA ॥29॥

text: svayaṃ caiṣāmanaḍuho yujyanti ca vahanti ca । svayamusrāśca duhyante manaḥsaṅkalpasiddhibhiḥ ॥30॥
html:
svayaṃ caiṣāmanaḍuho yujyanti ca vahanti ca ।
svayamusrāśca duhyante manaḥsaṅkalpasiddhibhiḥ ॥30॥
slp1: svayaM cEzAmanaquho yujyanti ca vahanti ca । svayamusrASca duhyante manaHsaNkalpasidDiBiH ॥30॥

text: svayaṃ yūpānupādāya yajante svāptadakṣiṇaiḥ । yastathābhāvitātmā syātsa gāmālabdhumarhati ॥31॥
html:
svayaṃ yūpānupādāya yajante svāptadakṣiṇaiḥ ।
yastathābhāvitātmā syātsa gāmālabdhumarhati ॥31॥
slp1: svayaM yUpAnupAdAya yajante svAptadakziREH । yastaTABAvitAtmA syAtsa gAmAlabDumarhati ॥31॥

text: oṣadhībhistathā brahmanyajeraṃste natādṛśāḥ । buddhityāgaṃ puraskṛtya tādṛśaṃ prabravīmi te ॥32॥
html:
oṣadhībhistathā brahmanyajeraṃste natādṛśāḥ ।
buddhityāgaṃ puraskṛtya tādṛśaṃ prabravīmi te ॥32॥
slp1: ozaDIBistaTA brahmanyajeraMste natAdfSAH । budDityAgaM puraskftya tAdfSaM prabravImi te ॥32॥

text: nirāśiṣamanārambhaṃ nirnamaskāramastutim । akṣīṇaṃ kṣīṇakarmāṇaṃ taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ ॥33॥
html:
nirāśiṣamanārambhaṃ nirnamaskāramastutim ।
akṣīṇaṃ kṣīṇakarmāṇaṃ taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ ॥33॥
slp1: nirASizamanAramBaM nirnamaskAramastutim । akzIRaM kzIRakarmARaM taM devA brAhmaRaM viduH ॥33॥

text: nāśrāvayanna ca yajanna dadadbrāhmaṇeṣu ca । grāmyāṃ vṛttiṃ lipsamānaḥ kāṃ gatiṃ yāti jājale । idaṃ tu daivataṃ kṛtvā yathā yajñamavāpnuyāt ॥34॥
html:
nāśrāvayanna ca yajanna dadadbrāhmaṇeṣu ca ।
grāmyāṃ vṛttiṃ lipsamānaḥ kāṃ gatiṃ yāti jājale ।
idaṃ tu daivataṃ kṛtvā yathā yajñamavāpnuyāt ॥34॥
slp1: nASrAvayanna ca yajanna dadadbrAhmaRezu ca । grAmyAM vfttiM lipsamAnaH kAM gatiM yAti jAjale । idaM tu dEvataM kftvA yaTA yajYamavApnuyAt ॥34॥

text: na vai munīnāṃ śṛṇumaḥ sma tattvaṃ pṛcchāmi tvā vāṇija kaṣṭametat । pūrve pūrve cāsya nāvekṣamāṇā nātaḥ paraṃ tamṛṣayaḥ sthāpayanti ॥35॥
html:
na vai munīnāṃ śṛṇumaḥ sma tattvaṃ pṛcchāmi tvā vāṇija kaṣṭametat ।
pūrve pūrve cāsya nāvekṣamāṇā nātaḥ paraṃ tamṛṣayaḥ sthāpayanti ॥35॥
slp1: na vE munInAM SfRumaH sma tattvaM pfcCAmi tvA vARija kazwametat । pUrve pUrve cAsya nAvekzamARA nAtaH paraM tamfzayaH sTApayanti ॥35॥
author: jājaliruvāca ।

text: asminnevātmatīrthe na paśavaḥ prāpnuyuḥ sukham । atha svakarmaṇā kena vāṇija prāpnuyātsukham । śaṃsa me tanmahāprājña bhṛśaṃ vai śraddadhāmi te ॥36॥
html:
asminnevātmatīrthe na paśavaḥ prāpnuyuḥ sukham ।
atha svakarmaṇā kena vāṇija prāpnuyātsukham ।
śaṃsa me tanmahāprājña bhṛśaṃ vai śraddadhāmi te ॥36॥
slp1: asminnevAtmatIrTe na paSavaH prApnuyuH suKam । aTa svakarmaRA kena vARija prApnuyAtsuKam । SaMsa me tanmahAprAjYa BfSaM vE SraddaDAmi te ॥36॥

text: uta yajñā utāyajñā makhaṃ nārhanti te kvacit । ājyena payasā dadhnā pūrṇāhutyā viśeṣataḥ । vālaiḥ śṛṅgeṇa pādena sambhavatyeva gaurmakham ॥37॥
html:
uta yajñā utāyajñā makhaṃ nārhanti te kvacit ।
ājyena payasā dadhnā pūrṇāhutyā viśeṣataḥ ।
vālaiḥ śṛṅgeṇa pādena sambhavatyeva gaurmakham ॥37॥
slp1: uta yajYA utAyajYA maKaM nArhanti te kvacit । Ajyena payasA daDnA pUrRAhutyA viSezataH । vAlEH SfNgeRa pAdena samBavatyeva gOrmaKam ॥37॥
author: tulādhāra uvāca ।

text: patnīṃ cānena vidhinā prakaroti niyojayan । puroḍāśo hi sarveṣāṃ paśūnāṃ medhya ucyate ॥38॥
html:
patnīṃ cānena vidhinā prakaroti niyojayan ।
puroḍāśo hi sarveṣāṃ paśūnāṃ medhya ucyate ॥38॥
slp1: patnIM cAnena viDinA prakaroti niyojayan । puroqASo hi sarvezAM paSUnAM meDya ucyate ॥38॥

text: sarvā nadyaḥ sarasvatyaḥ sarve puṇyāḥ śiloccayāḥ । jājale tīrthamātmaiva mā sma deśātithirbhava ॥39॥
html:
sarvā nadyaḥ sarasvatyaḥ sarve puṇyāḥ śiloccayāḥ ।
jājale tīrthamātmaiva mā sma deśātithirbhava ॥39॥
slp1: sarvA nadyaH sarasvatyaH sarve puRyAH SiloccayAH । jAjale tIrTamAtmEva mA sma deSAtiTirBava ॥39॥

text: etānīdṛśakāndharmānācaranniha jājale । kāraṇairdharmamanvicchanna lokānāpnute śubhān ॥40॥
html:
etānīdṛśakāndharmānācaranniha jājale ।
kāraṇairdharmamanvicchanna lokānāpnute śubhān ॥40॥
slp1: etAnIdfSakAnDarmAnAcaranniha jAjale । kAraRErDarmamanvicCanna lokAnApnute SuBAn ॥40॥

text: etānīdṛśakāndharmāṃstulādhāraḥ praśaṃsati । upapattyā hi sampannānnityaṃ sadbhirniṣevitān] ॥41॥
html:
etānīdṛśakāndharmāṃstulādhāraḥ praśaṃsati ।
upapattyā hi sampannānnityaṃ sadbhirniṣevitān] ॥41॥
slp1: etAnIdfSakAnDarmAMstulADAraH praSaMsati । upapattyA hi sampannAnnityaM sadBirnizevitAn] ॥41॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sadbhirvā yadi vāsadbhirayaṃ panthāḥ samāśritaḥ । pratyakṣaṃ kriyatāṃ sādhu tato jñāsyasi tadyathā ॥1॥
html:
sadbhirvā yadi vāsadbhirayaṃ panthāḥ samāśritaḥ ।
pratyakṣaṃ kriyatāṃ sādhu tato jñāsyasi tadyathā ॥1॥
slp1: sadBirvA yadi vAsadBirayaM panTAH samASritaH । pratyakzaM kriyatAM sADu tato jYAsyasi tadyaTA ॥1॥
author: tulādhāra uvāca ।

text: ete śakuntā bahavaḥ samantādvicaranti hi । tavottamāṅge sambhūtāḥ śyenāścānyāśca jātayaḥ ॥2॥
html:
ete śakuntā bahavaḥ samantādvicaranti hi ।
tavottamāṅge sambhūtāḥ śyenāścānyāśca jātayaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: ete SakuntA bahavaH samantAdvicaranti hi । tavottamANge samBUtAH SyenAScAnyASca jAtayaH ॥2॥

text: āhvayainānmahābrahmanviśamānāṃstatastataḥ । paśyemānhastapādeṣu śliṣṭāndehe ca sarvaśaḥ ॥3॥
html:
āhvayainānmahābrahmanviśamānāṃstatastataḥ ।
paśyemānhastapādeṣu śliṣṭāndehe ca sarvaśaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: AhvayEnAnmahAbrahmanviSamAnAMstatastataH । paSyemAnhastapAdezu SlizwAndehe ca sarvaSaH ॥3॥

text: sambhāvayanti pitaraṃ tvayā sambhāvitāḥ khagāḥ । asaṃśayaṃ pitā ca tvaṃ putrānāhvaya jājale ॥4॥
html:
sambhāvayanti pitaraṃ tvayā sambhāvitāḥ khagāḥ ।
asaṃśayaṃ pitā ca tvaṃ putrānāhvaya jājale ॥4॥
slp1: samBAvayanti pitaraM tvayA samBAvitAH KagAH । asaMSayaM pitA ca tvaM putrAnAhvaya jAjale ॥4॥

text: tato jājalinā tena samāhūtāḥ patatriṇaḥ । vācamuccārayandivyāṃ dharmasya vacanātkila ॥5॥
html:
tato jājalinā tena samāhūtāḥ patatriṇaḥ ।
vācamuccārayandivyāṃ dharmasya vacanātkila ॥5॥
slp1: tato jAjalinA tena samAhUtAH patatriRaH । vAcamuccArayandivyAM Darmasya vacanAtkila ॥5॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ahiṃsādikṛtaṃ karma iha caiva paratra ca । spardhā nihanti vai brahmansāhatā hanti taṃ naram ॥6॥
html:
ahiṃsādikṛtaṃ karma iha caiva paratra ca ।
spardhā nihanti vai brahmansāhatā hanti taṃ naram ॥6॥
slp1: ahiMsAdikftaM karma iha cEva paratra ca । sparDA nihanti vE brahmansAhatA hanti taM naram ॥6॥

text: śraddhāvṛddhaṃ vāṅmanasī na yajñastrātumarhati । atra gāthā brahmagītāḥ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ ॥7॥
html:
śraddhāvṛddhaṃ vāṅmanasī na yajñastrātumarhati ।
atra gāthā brahmagītāḥ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: SradDAvfdDaM vANmanasI na yajYastrAtumarhati । atra gATA brahmagItAH kIrtayanti purAvidaH ॥7॥

text: śuceraśraddadhānasya śraddadhānasya cāśuceḥ । devāścittamamanyanta sadṛśaṃ yajñakarmaṇi ॥8॥
html:
śuceraśraddadhānasya śraddadhānasya cāśuceḥ ।
devāścittamamanyanta sadṛśaṃ yajñakarmaṇi ॥8॥
slp1: SuceraSraddaDAnasya SraddaDAnasya cASuceH । devAScittamamanyanta sadfSaM yajYakarmaRi ॥8॥

text: śrotriyasya kadaryasya vadānyasya ca vārdhuṣeḥ । mīmāṃsitvobhayaṃ devāḥ samamannamakalpayan ॥9॥
html:
śrotriyasya kadaryasya vadānyasya ca vārdhuṣeḥ ।
mīmāṃsitvobhayaṃ devāḥ samamannamakalpayan ॥9॥
slp1: Srotriyasya kadaryasya vadAnyasya ca vArDuzeH । mImAMsitvoBayaM devAH samamannamakalpayan ॥9॥

text: prajāpatistānuvāca viṣamaṃ kṛtamityuta । śraddhāpūtaṃ vadānyasya hatamaśraddhayetarat । bhojyamannaṃ vadānyasya kadaryasya na vārdhuṣeḥ ॥10॥
html:
prajāpatistānuvāca viṣamaṃ kṛtamityuta ।
śraddhāpūtaṃ vadānyasya hatamaśraddhayetarat ।
bhojyamannaṃ vadānyasya kadaryasya na vārdhuṣeḥ ॥10॥
slp1: prajApatistAnuvAca vizamaM kftamityuta । SradDApUtaM vadAnyasya hatamaSradDayetarat । BojyamannaM vadAnyasya kadaryasya na vArDuzeH ॥10॥

text: aśraddadhāna evaiko devānāṃ nārhate haviḥ । tasyaivānnaṃ na bhoktavyamiti dharmavido viduḥ ॥11॥
html:
aśraddadhāna evaiko devānāṃ nārhate haviḥ ।
tasyaivānnaṃ na bhoktavyamiti dharmavido viduḥ ॥11॥
slp1: aSraddaDAna evEko devAnAM nArhate haviH । tasyEvAnnaM na Boktavyamiti Darmavido viduH ॥11॥

text: aśraddhā paramaṃ pāpaṃ śraddhā pāpapramocanī । jahāti pāpaṃ śraddhāvānsarpo jīrṇāmiva tvacam ॥12॥
html:
aśraddhā paramaṃ pāpaṃ śraddhā pāpapramocanī ।
jahāti pāpaṃ śraddhāvānsarpo jīrṇāmiva tvacam ॥12॥
slp1: aSradDA paramaM pApaM SradDA pApapramocanI । jahAti pApaM SradDAvAnsarpo jIrRAmiva tvacam ॥12॥

text: jyāyasī yā pavitrāṇāṃ nivṛttiḥ śraddhayā saha । nivṛttaśīladoṣo yaḥ śraddhāvānpūta eva saḥ ॥13॥
html:
jyāyasī yā pavitrāṇāṃ nivṛttiḥ śraddhayā saha ।
nivṛttaśīladoṣo yaḥ śraddhāvānpūta eva saḥ ॥13॥
slp1: jyAyasI yA pavitrARAM nivfttiH SradDayA saha । nivfttaSIladozo yaH SradDAvAnpUta eva saH ॥13॥

text: kiṃ tasya tapasā kāryaṃ kiṃ vṛttena kimātmanā । śraddhāmayo'yaṃ puruṣo yo yacchraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ ॥14॥
html:
kiṃ tasya tapasā kāryaṃ kiṃ vṛttena kimātmanā ।
śraddhāmayo'yaṃ puruṣo yo yacchraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ ॥14॥
slp1: kiM tasya tapasA kAryaM kiM vfttena kimAtmanA । SradDAmayo'yaM puruzo yo yacCradDaH sa eva saH ॥14॥

text: iti dharmaḥ samākhyātaḥ sadbhirdharmārthadarśibhiḥ । vayaṃ jijñāsamānāstvā samprāptā dharmadarśanāt ॥15॥
html:
iti dharmaḥ samākhyātaḥ sadbhirdharmārthadarśibhiḥ ।
vayaṃ jijñāsamānāstvā samprāptā dharmadarśanāt ॥15॥
slp1: iti DarmaH samAKyAtaH sadBirDarmArTadarSiBiH । vayaM jijYAsamAnAstvA samprAptA DarmadarSanAt ॥15॥

text: spardhāṃ jahi mahāprājña tataḥ prāpsyasi yatparam । śraddhāvāñśraddadhānaśca dharmāṃścaiveha vāṇijaḥ । svavartmani sthitaścaiva garīyāneṣa jājale ॥16॥
html:
spardhāṃ jahi mahāprājña tataḥ prāpsyasi yatparam ।
śraddhāvāñśraddadhānaśca dharmāṃścaiveha vāṇijaḥ ।
svavartmani sthitaścaiva garīyāneṣa jājale ॥16॥
slp1: sparDAM jahi mahAprAjYa tataH prApsyasi yatparam । SradDAvAYSraddaDAnaSca DarmAMScEveha vARijaH । svavartmani sTitaScEva garIyAneza jAjale ॥16॥

text: evaṃ bahumatārthaṃ ca tulādhāreṇa bhāṣitam । samyakcaivamupālabdho dharmaścoktaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥17॥
html:
evaṃ bahumatārthaṃ ca tulādhāreṇa bhāṣitam ।
samyakcaivamupālabdho dharmaścoktaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: evaM bahumatArTaM ca tulADAreRa BAzitam । samyakcEvamupAlabDo DarmaScoktaH sanAtanaH ॥17॥

text: tasya vikhyātavīryasya śrutvā vākyāni sa dvijaḥ । tulādhārasya kaunteya śāntimevānvapadyata ॥18॥
html:
tasya vikhyātavīryasya śrutvā vākyāni sa dvijaḥ ।
tulādhārasya kaunteya śāntimevānvapadyata ॥18॥
slp1: tasya viKyAtavIryasya SrutvA vAkyAni sa dvijaH । tulADArasya kOnteya SAntimevAnvapadyata ॥18॥

text: tato'cireṇa kālena tulādhāraḥ sa eva ca । divaṃ gatvā mahāprājñau viharetāṃ yathāsukham । svaṃ svaṃ sthānamupāgamya svakarmaphalanirjitam ॥19॥
html:
tato'cireṇa kālena tulādhāraḥ sa eva ca ।
divaṃ gatvā mahāprājñau viharetāṃ yathāsukham ।
svaṃ svaṃ sthānamupāgamya svakarmaphalanirjitam ॥19॥
slp1: tato'cireRa kAlena tulADAraH sa eva ca । divaM gatvA mahAprAjYO viharetAM yaTAsuKam । svaM svaM sTAnamupAgamya svakarmaPalanirjitam ॥19॥

text: samānāṃ śraddadhānānāṃ saṃyatānāṃ sucetasām । kurvatāṃ yajña ityeva na yajño jātu neṣyate ॥20॥
html:
samānāṃ śraddadhānānāṃ saṃyatānāṃ sucetasām ।
kurvatāṃ yajña ityeva na yajño jātu neṣyate ॥20॥
slp1: samAnAM SraddaDAnAnAM saMyatAnAM sucetasAm । kurvatAM yajYa ityeva na yajYo jAtu nezyate ॥20॥

text: śraddhā vai sāttvikī devī sūryasya duhitā nṛpa । sāvitrī prasavitrī ca jīvaviśvāsinī tathā ॥21॥
html:
śraddhā vai sāttvikī devī sūryasya duhitā nṛpa ।
sāvitrī prasavitrī ca jīvaviśvāsinī tathā ॥21॥
slp1: SradDA vE sAttvikI devI sUryasya duhitA nfpa । sAvitrI prasavitrI ca jIvaviSvAsinI taTA ॥21॥

text: vāgvṛddhaṃ trāyate śraddhā manovṛddhaṃ ca bhārata । yathaupamyopadeśena kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi] ॥22॥
html:
vāgvṛddhaṃ trāyate śraddhā manovṛddhaṃ ca bhārata ।
yathaupamyopadeśena kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi] ॥22॥
slp1: vAgvfdDaM trAyate SradDA manovfdDaM ca BArata । yaTOpamyopadeSena kiM BUyaH SrotumicCasi] ॥22॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । prajānāmanukampārthaṃ gītaṃ rājñā vicakhnunā ॥1॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
prajānāmanukampārthaṃ gītaṃ rājñā vicakhnunā ॥1॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । prajAnAmanukampArTaM gItaM rAjYA vicaKnunA ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: chinnasthūṇaṃ vṛṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā virāvaṃ ca gavāṃ bhṛśam । gograhe yajñavāṭasya prekṣamāṇaḥ sa pārthivaḥ ॥2॥
html:
chinnasthūṇaṃ vṛṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā virāvaṃ ca gavāṃ bhṛśam ।
gograhe yajñavāṭasya prekṣamāṇaḥ sa pārthivaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: CinnasTURaM vfzaM dfzwvA virAvaM ca gavAM BfSam । gograhe yajYavAwasya prekzamARaH sa pArTivaH ॥2॥

text: svasti gobhyo'stu lokeṣu tato nirvacanaṃ kṛtam । hiṃsāyāṃ hi pravṛttāyāmāśīreṣānukalpitā ॥3॥
html:
svasti gobhyo'stu lokeṣu tato nirvacanaṃ kṛtam ।
hiṃsāyāṃ hi pravṛttāyāmāśīreṣānukalpitā ॥3॥
slp1: svasti goByo'stu lokezu tato nirvacanaM kftam । hiMsAyAM hi pravfttAyAmASIrezAnukalpitA ॥3॥

text: avyavasthitamaryādairvimūḍhairnāstikairnaraiḥ । saṃśayātmabhiravyaktairhiṃsā samanukīrtitā ॥4॥
html:
avyavasthitamaryādairvimūḍhairnāstikairnaraiḥ ।
saṃśayātmabhiravyaktairhiṃsā samanukīrtitā ॥4॥
slp1: avyavasTitamaryAdErvimUQErnAstikErnarEH । saMSayAtmaBiravyaktErhiMsA samanukIrtitA ॥4॥

text: sarvakarmasvahiṃsā hi dharmātmā manurabravīt । kāmarāgādvihiṃsanti bahirvedyāṃ paśūnnarāḥ ॥5॥
html:
sarvakarmasvahiṃsā hi dharmātmā manurabravīt ।
kāmarāgādvihiṃsanti bahirvedyāṃ paśūnnarāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: sarvakarmasvahiMsA hi DarmAtmA manurabravIt । kAmarAgAdvihiMsanti bahirvedyAM paSUnnarAH ॥5॥

text: tasmātpramāṇataḥ kāryo dharmaḥ sūkṣmo vijānatā । ahiṃsaiva hi sarvebhyo dharmebhyo jyāyasī matā ॥6॥
html:
tasmātpramāṇataḥ kāryo dharmaḥ sūkṣmo vijānatā ।
ahiṃsaiva hi sarvebhyo dharmebhyo jyāyasī matā ॥6॥
slp1: tasmAtpramARataH kAryo DarmaH sUkzmo vijAnatA । ahiMsEva hi sarveByo DarmeByo jyAyasI matA ॥6॥

text: upoṣya saṃśito bhūtvā hitvā vedakṛtāḥ śrutīḥ । ācāra ityanācārāḥ kṛpaṇāḥ phalahetavaḥ ॥7॥
html:
upoṣya saṃśito bhūtvā hitvā vedakṛtāḥ śrutīḥ ।
ācāra ityanācārāḥ kṛpaṇāḥ phalahetavaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: upozya saMSito BUtvA hitvA vedakftAH SrutIH । AcAra ityanAcArAH kfpaRAH PalahetavaH ॥7॥

text: yadi yajñāṃśca vṛkṣāṃśca yūpāṃścoddiśya mānavāḥ । vṛthā māṃsāni khādanti naiṣa dharmaḥ praśasyate ॥8॥
html:
yadi yajñāṃśca vṛkṣāṃśca yūpāṃścoddiśya mānavāḥ ।
vṛthā māṃsāni khādanti naiṣa dharmaḥ praśasyate ॥8॥
slp1: yadi yajYAMSca vfkzAMSca yUpAMScoddiSya mAnavAH । vfTA mAMsAni KAdanti nEza DarmaH praSasyate ॥8॥

text: māṃsaṃ madhu surā matsyā āsavaṃ kṛsaraudanam । dhūrtaiḥ pravartitaṃ hyetannaitadvedeṣu kalpitam ॥9॥
html:
māṃsaṃ madhu surā matsyā āsavaṃ kṛsaraudanam ।
dhūrtaiḥ pravartitaṃ hyetannaitadvedeṣu kalpitam ॥9॥
slp1: mAMsaM maDu surA matsyA AsavaM kfsarOdanam । DUrtEH pravartitaM hyetannEtadvedezu kalpitam ॥9॥

text: kāmānmohācca lobhācca laulyametatpravartitam । viṣṇumevābhijānanti sarvayajñeṣu brāhmaṇāḥ । pāyasaiḥ sumanobhiśca tasyāpi yajanaṃ smṛtam ॥10॥
html:
kāmānmohācca lobhācca laulyametatpravartitam ।
viṣṇumevābhijānanti sarvayajñeṣu brāhmaṇāḥ ।
pāyasaiḥ sumanobhiśca tasyāpi yajanaṃ smṛtam ॥10॥
slp1: kAmAnmohAcca loBAcca lOlyametatpravartitam । vizRumevABijAnanti sarvayajYezu brAhmaRAH । pAyasEH sumanoBiSca tasyApi yajanaM smftam ॥10॥

text: yajñiyāścaiva ye vṛkṣā vedeṣu parikalpitāḥ । yaccāpi kiñcitkartavyamanyaccokṣaiḥ susaṃskṛtam । mahāsattvaiḥ śuddhabhāvaiḥ sarvaṃ devārhameva tat ॥11॥
html:
yajñiyāścaiva ye vṛkṣā vedeṣu parikalpitāḥ ।
yaccāpi kiñcitkartavyamanyaccokṣaiḥ susaṃskṛtam ।
mahāsattvaiḥ śuddhabhāvaiḥ sarvaṃ devārhameva tat ॥11॥
slp1: yajYiyAScEva ye vfkzA vedezu parikalpitAH । yaccApi kiYcitkartavyamanyaccokzEH susaMskftam । mahAsattvEH SudDaBAvEH sarvaM devArhameva tat ॥11॥

text: śarīramāpadaścāpi vivadantyavihiṃsataḥ । kathaṃ yātrā śarīrasya nirārambhasya setsyati ॥12॥
html:
śarīramāpadaścāpi vivadantyavihiṃsataḥ ।
kathaṃ yātrā śarīrasya nirārambhasya setsyati ॥12॥
slp1: SarIramApadaScApi vivadantyavihiMsataH । kaTaM yAtrA SarIrasya nirAramBasya setsyati ॥12॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: yathā śarīraṃ na glāyenneyānmṛtyuvaśaṃ yathā । tathā karmasu varteta samartho dharmamācaret] ॥13॥
html:
yathā śarīraṃ na glāyenneyānmṛtyuvaśaṃ yathā ।
tathā karmasu varteta samartho dharmamācaret] ॥13॥
slp1: yaTA SarIraM na glAyenneyAnmftyuvaSaM yaTA । taTA karmasu varteta samarTo DarmamAcaret] ॥13॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kathaṃ kāryaṃ parīkṣeta śīghraṃ vātha cireṇa vā । sarvathā kāryadurge'sminbhavānnaḥ paramo guruḥ ॥1॥
html:
kathaṃ kāryaṃ parīkṣeta śīghraṃ vātha cireṇa vā ।
sarvathā kāryadurge'sminbhavānnaḥ paramo guruḥ ॥1॥
slp1: kaTaM kAryaM parIkzeta SIGraM vATa cireRa vA । sarvaTA kAryadurge'sminBavAnnaH paramo guruH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । cirakārestu yatpūrvaṃ vṛttamāṅgirase kule ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
cirakārestu yatpūrvaṃ vṛttamāṅgirase kule ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । cirakArestu yatpUrvaM vfttamANgirase kule ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: cirakārika bhadraṃ te bhadraṃ te cirakārika । cirakārī hi medhāvī nāparādhyati karmasu ॥3॥
html:
cirakārika bhadraṃ te bhadraṃ te cirakārika ।
cirakārī hi medhāvī nāparādhyati karmasu ॥3॥
slp1: cirakArika BadraM te BadraM te cirakArika । cirakArI hi meDAvI nAparADyati karmasu ॥3॥

text: cirakārī mahāprājño gautamasyābhavatsutaḥ । ciraṃ hi sarvakāryāṇi samekṣāvānprapadyate ॥4॥
html:
cirakārī mahāprājño gautamasyābhavatsutaḥ ।
ciraṃ hi sarvakāryāṇi samekṣāvānprapadyate ॥4॥
slp1: cirakArI mahAprAjYo gOtamasyABavatsutaH । ciraM hi sarvakAryARi samekzAvAnprapadyate ॥4॥

text: ciraṃ sañcintayannarthāṃściraṃ jāgracciraṃ svapan । cirakāryābhisaṃpatteścirakārī tathocyate ॥5॥
html:
ciraṃ sañcintayannarthāṃściraṃ jāgracciraṃ svapan ।
cirakāryābhisaṃpatteścirakārī tathocyate ॥5॥
slp1: ciraM saYcintayannarTAMSciraM jAgracciraM svapan । cirakAryABisaMpatteScirakArI taTocyate ॥5॥

text: alasagrahaṇaṃ prāpto durmedhāvī tathocyate । buddhilāghavayuktena janenādīrghadarśinā ॥6॥
html:
alasagrahaṇaṃ prāpto durmedhāvī tathocyate ।
buddhilāghavayuktena janenādīrghadarśinā ॥6॥
slp1: alasagrahaRaM prApto durmeDAvI taTocyate । budDilAGavayuktena janenAdIrGadarSinA ॥6॥

text: vyabhicāre tu kasmiṃścidvyatikramyāparānsutān । pitroktaḥ kupitenātha jahīmāṃ jananīmiti ॥7॥
html:
vyabhicāre tu kasmiṃścidvyatikramyāparānsutān ।
pitroktaḥ kupitenātha jahīmāṃ jananīmiti ॥7॥
slp1: vyaBicAre tu kasmiMScidvyatikramyAparAnsutAn । pitroktaH kupitenATa jahImAM jananImiti ॥7॥

text: sa tatheti cireṇoktvā svabhāvāccirakārikaḥ । vimṛśya cirakāritvāccintayāmāsa vai ciram ॥8॥
html:
sa tatheti cireṇoktvā svabhāvāccirakārikaḥ ।
vimṛśya cirakāritvāccintayāmāsa vai ciram ॥8॥
slp1: sa taTeti cireRoktvA svaBAvAccirakArikaH । vimfSya cirakAritvAccintayAmAsa vE ciram ॥8॥

text: piturājñāṃ kathaṃ kuryāṃ na hanyāṃ mātaraṃ katham । kathaṃ dharmacchale nāsminnimajjeyamasādhuvat ॥9॥
html:
piturājñāṃ kathaṃ kuryāṃ na hanyāṃ mātaraṃ katham ।
kathaṃ dharmacchale nāsminnimajjeyamasādhuvat ॥9॥
slp1: piturAjYAM kaTaM kuryAM na hanyAM mAtaraM kaTam । kaTaM DarmacCale nAsminnimajjeyamasADuvat ॥9॥

text: piturājñā paro dharmaḥ svadharmo mātṛrakṣaṇam । asvatantraṃ ca putratvaṃ kiṃ nu māṃ nātra pīḍayet ॥10॥
html:
piturājñā paro dharmaḥ svadharmo mātṛrakṣaṇam ।
asvatantraṃ ca putratvaṃ kiṃ nu māṃ nātra pīḍayet ॥10॥
slp1: piturAjYA paro DarmaH svaDarmo mAtfrakzaRam । asvatantraM ca putratvaM kiM nu mAM nAtra pIqayet ॥10॥

text: striyaṃ hatvā mātaraṃ ca ko hi jātu sukhī bhavet । pitaraṃ cāpyavajñāya kaḥ pratiṣṭhāmavāpnuyāt ॥11॥
html:
striyaṃ hatvā mātaraṃ ca ko hi jātu sukhī bhavet ।
pitaraṃ cāpyavajñāya kaḥ pratiṣṭhāmavāpnuyāt ॥11॥
slp1: striyaM hatvA mAtaraM ca ko hi jAtu suKI Bavet । pitaraM cApyavajYAya kaH pratizWAmavApnuyAt ॥11॥

text: anavajñā pituryuktā dhāraṇaṃ mātṛrakṣaṇam । yuktakṣamāvubhāvetau nātivartetamāṃ katham ॥12॥
html:
anavajñā pituryuktā dhāraṇaṃ mātṛrakṣaṇam ।
yuktakṣamāvubhāvetau nātivartetamāṃ katham ॥12॥
slp1: anavajYA pituryuktA DAraRaM mAtfrakzaRam । yuktakzamAvuBAvetO nAtivartetamAM kaTam ॥12॥

text: pitā hyātmānamādhatte jāyāyāṃ jajñiyāmiti । śīlacāritragotrasya dhāraṇārthaṃ kulasya ca ॥13॥
html:
pitā hyātmānamādhatte jāyāyāṃ jajñiyāmiti ।
śīlacāritragotrasya dhāraṇārthaṃ kulasya ca ॥13॥
slp1: pitA hyAtmAnamADatte jAyAyAM jajYiyAmiti । SIlacAritragotrasya DAraRArTaM kulasya ca ॥13॥

text: so'hamātmā svayaṃ pitrā putratve prakṛtaḥ punaḥ । vijñānaṃ me kathaṃ na syādbubudhe cātmasambhavam ॥14॥
html:
so'hamātmā svayaṃ pitrā putratve prakṛtaḥ punaḥ ।
vijñānaṃ me kathaṃ na syādbubudhe cātmasambhavam ॥14॥
slp1: so'hamAtmA svayaM pitrA putratve prakftaH punaH । vijYAnaM me kaTaM na syAdbubuDe cAtmasamBavam ॥14॥

text: jātakarmaṇi yatprāha pitā yaccopakarmaṇi । paryāptaḥ sa dṛḍhīkāraḥ piturgauravaniścaye ॥15॥
html:
jātakarmaṇi yatprāha pitā yaccopakarmaṇi ।
paryāptaḥ sa dṛḍhīkāraḥ piturgauravaniścaye ॥15॥
slp1: jAtakarmaRi yatprAha pitA yaccopakarmaRi । paryAptaH sa dfQIkAraH piturgOravaniScaye ॥15॥

text: gururagryaḥ paro dharmaḥ poṣaṇādhyayanāddhitaḥ । pitā yadāha dharmaḥ sa vedeṣvapi suniścitaḥ ॥16॥
html:
gururagryaḥ paro dharmaḥ poṣaṇādhyayanāddhitaḥ ।
pitā yadāha dharmaḥ sa vedeṣvapi suniścitaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: gururagryaH paro DarmaH pozaRADyayanAdDitaH । pitA yadAha DarmaH sa vedezvapi suniScitaH ॥16॥

text: prītimātraṃ pituḥ putraḥ sarvaṃ putrasya vai pitā । śarīrādīni deyāni pitā tvekaḥ prayacchati ॥17॥
html:
prītimātraṃ pituḥ putraḥ sarvaṃ putrasya vai pitā ।
śarīrādīni deyāni pitā tvekaḥ prayacchati ॥17॥
slp1: prItimAtraM pituH putraH sarvaM putrasya vE pitA । SarIrAdIni deyAni pitA tvekaH prayacCati ॥17॥

text: tasmātpiturvacaḥ kāryaṃ na vicāryaṃ kathañcana । pātakānyapi pūyante piturvacanakāriṇaḥ ॥18॥
html:
tasmātpiturvacaḥ kāryaṃ na vicāryaṃ kathañcana ।
pātakānyapi pūyante piturvacanakāriṇaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: tasmAtpiturvacaH kAryaM na vicAryaM kaTaYcana । pAtakAnyapi pUyante piturvacanakAriRaH ॥18॥

text: bhoge bhāgye prasavane sarvalokanidarśane । bhartrā caiva samāyoge sīmantonnayane tathā ॥19॥
html:
bhoge bhāgye prasavane sarvalokanidarśane ।
bhartrā caiva samāyoge sīmantonnayane tathā ॥19॥
slp1: Boge BAgye prasavane sarvalokanidarSane । BartrA cEva samAyoge sImantonnayane taTA ॥19॥

text: pitā svargaḥ pitā dharmaḥ pitā paramakaṃ tapaḥ । pitari prītimāpanne sarvāḥ prīyanti devatāḥ ॥20॥
html:
pitā svargaḥ pitā dharmaḥ pitā paramakaṃ tapaḥ ।
pitari prītimāpanne sarvāḥ prīyanti devatāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: pitA svargaH pitA DarmaH pitA paramakaM tapaH । pitari prItimApanne sarvAH prIyanti devatAH ॥20॥

text: āśiṣastā bhajantyenaṃ puruṣaṃ prāha yāḥ pitā । niṣkṛtiḥ sarvapāpānāṃ pitā yadabhinandati ॥21॥
html:
āśiṣastā bhajantyenaṃ puruṣaṃ prāha yāḥ pitā ।
niṣkṛtiḥ sarvapāpānāṃ pitā yadabhinandati ॥21॥
slp1: ASizastA BajantyenaM puruzaM prAha yAH pitA । nizkftiH sarvapApAnAM pitA yadaBinandati ॥21॥

text: mucyate bandhanātpuṣpaṃ phalaṃ vṛntātpramucyate । kliśyannapi sutasnehaiḥ pitā snehaṃ na muñcati ॥22॥
html:
mucyate bandhanātpuṣpaṃ phalaṃ vṛntātpramucyate ।
kliśyannapi sutasnehaiḥ pitā snehaṃ na muñcati ॥22॥
slp1: mucyate banDanAtpuzpaM PalaM vfntAtpramucyate । kliSyannapi sutasnehEH pitA snehaM na muYcati ॥22॥

text: etadvicintitaṃ tāvatputrasya pitṛgauravam । pitā hyalpataraṃ sthānaṃ cintayiṣyāmi mātaram ॥23॥
html:
etadvicintitaṃ tāvatputrasya pitṛgauravam ।
pitā hyalpataraṃ sthānaṃ cintayiṣyāmi mātaram ॥23॥
slp1: etadvicintitaM tAvatputrasya pitfgOravam । pitA hyalpataraM sTAnaM cintayizyAmi mAtaram ॥23॥

text: yo hyayaṃ mayi saṅghāto martyatve pāñcabhautikaḥ । asya me jananī hetuḥ pāvakasya yathāraṇiḥ । mātā dehāraṇiḥ puṃsāṃ sarvasyārtasya nirvṛtiḥ ॥24॥
html:
yo hyayaṃ mayi saṅghāto martyatve pāñcabhautikaḥ ।
asya me jananī hetuḥ pāvakasya yathāraṇiḥ ।
mātā dehāraṇiḥ puṃsāṃ sarvasyārtasya nirvṛtiḥ ॥24॥
slp1: yo hyayaM mayi saNGAto martyatve pAYcaBOtikaH । asya me jananI hetuH pAvakasya yaTAraRiH । mAtA dehAraRiH puMsAM sarvasyArtasya nirvftiH ॥24॥

text: na ca śocati nāpyenaṃ sthāviryamapakarṣati । śriyā hīno'pi yo gehe ambeti pratipadyate ॥25॥
html:
na ca śocati nāpyenaṃ sthāviryamapakarṣati ।
śriyā hīno'pi yo gehe ambeti pratipadyate ॥25॥
slp1: na ca Socati nApyenaM sTAviryamapakarzati । SriyA hIno'pi yo gehe ambeti pratipadyate ॥25॥

text: putrapautrasamākīrṇo jananīṃ yaḥ samāśritaḥ । api varṣaśatasyānte sa dvihāyanavaccaret ॥26॥
html:
putrapautrasamākīrṇo jananīṃ yaḥ samāśritaḥ ।
api varṣaśatasyānte sa dvihāyanavaccaret ॥26॥
slp1: putrapOtrasamAkIrRo jananIM yaH samASritaH । api varzaSatasyAnte sa dvihAyanavaccaret ॥26॥

text: samarthaṃ vāsamarthaṃ vā kṛśaṃ vāpyakṛśaṃ tathā । rakṣatyeva sutaṃ mātā nānyaḥ poṣṭā vidhānataḥ ॥27॥
html:
samarthaṃ vāsamarthaṃ vā kṛśaṃ vāpyakṛśaṃ tathā ।
rakṣatyeva sutaṃ mātā nānyaḥ poṣṭā vidhānataḥ ॥27॥
slp1: samarTaM vAsamarTaM vA kfSaM vApyakfSaM taTA । rakzatyeva sutaM mAtA nAnyaH pozwA viDAnataH ॥27॥

text: tadā sa vṛddho bhavati yadā bhavati duḥkhitaḥ । tadā śūnyaṃ jagattasya yadā mātrā viyujyate ॥28॥
html:
tadā sa vṛddho bhavati yadā bhavati duḥkhitaḥ ।
tadā śūnyaṃ jagattasya yadā mātrā viyujyate ॥28॥
slp1: tadA sa vfdDo Bavati yadA Bavati duHKitaH । tadA SUnyaM jagattasya yadA mAtrA viyujyate ॥28॥

text: nāsti mātṛsamā chāyā nāsti mātṛsamā gatiḥ । nāsti mātṛsamaṃ trāṇaṃ nāsti mātṛsamā prapā ॥29॥
html:
nāsti mātṛsamā chāyā nāsti mātṛsamā gatiḥ ।
nāsti mātṛsamaṃ trāṇaṃ nāsti mātṛsamā prapā ॥29॥
slp1: nAsti mAtfsamA CAyA nAsti mAtfsamA gatiH । nAsti mAtfsamaM trARaM nAsti mAtfsamA prapA ॥29॥

text: kukṣisandhāraṇāddhātrī jananājjananī smṛtā । aṅgānāṃ vardhanādambā vīrasūtvena vīrasūḥ ॥30॥
html:
kukṣisandhāraṇāddhātrī jananājjananī smṛtā ।
aṅgānāṃ vardhanādambā vīrasūtvena vīrasūḥ ॥30॥
slp1: kukzisanDAraRAdDAtrI jananAjjananI smftA । aNgAnAM varDanAdambA vIrasUtvena vIrasUH ॥30॥

text: śiśoḥ śuśrūṣaṇācchuśrūrmātā dehamanantaram । cetanāvānnaro hanyādyasya nāsuṣiraṃ śiraḥ ॥31॥
html:
śiśoḥ śuśrūṣaṇācchuśrūrmātā dehamanantaram ।
cetanāvānnaro hanyādyasya nāsuṣiraṃ śiraḥ ॥31॥
slp1: SiSoH SuSrUzaRAcCuSrUrmAtA dehamanantaram । cetanAvAnnaro hanyAdyasya nAsuziraM SiraH ॥31॥

text: dampatyoḥ prāṇasaṃśleṣe yo'bhisandhiḥ kṛtaḥ kila । taṃ mātā vā pitā veda bhūtārtho mātari sthitaḥ ॥32॥
html:
dampatyoḥ prāṇasaṃśleṣe yo'bhisandhiḥ kṛtaḥ kila ।
taṃ mātā vā pitā veda bhūtārtho mātari sthitaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: dampatyoH prARasaMSleze yo'BisanDiH kftaH kila । taM mAtA vA pitA veda BUtArTo mAtari sTitaH ॥32॥

text: mātā jānāti yadgotraṃ mātā jānāti yasya saḥ । māturbharaṇamātreṇa prītiḥ snehaḥ pituḥ prajāḥ ॥33॥
html:
mātā jānāti yadgotraṃ mātā jānāti yasya saḥ ।
māturbharaṇamātreṇa prītiḥ snehaḥ pituḥ prajāḥ ॥33॥
slp1: mAtA jAnAti yadgotraM mAtA jAnAti yasya saH । mAturBaraRamAtreRa prItiH snehaH pituH prajAH ॥33॥

text: pāṇibandhaṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā sahadharmamupetya ca । yadi yāpyanti puruṣāḥ striyo nārhanti yāpyatām ॥34॥
html:
pāṇibandhaṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā sahadharmamupetya ca ।
yadi yāpyanti puruṣāḥ striyo nārhanti yāpyatām ॥34॥
slp1: pARibanDaM svayaM kftvA sahaDarmamupetya ca । yadi yApyanti puruzAH striyo nArhanti yApyatAm ॥34॥

text: bharaṇāddhi striyo bhartā pātyāccaiva striyāḥ patiḥ । guṇasyāsya nivṛttau tu na bhartā na patiḥ patiḥ ॥35॥
html:
bharaṇāddhi striyo bhartā pātyāccaiva striyāḥ patiḥ ।
guṇasyāsya nivṛttau tu na bhartā na patiḥ patiḥ ॥35॥
slp1: BaraRAdDi striyo BartA pAtyAccEva striyAH patiH । guRasyAsya nivfttO tu na BartA na patiH patiH ॥35॥

text: evaṃ strī nāparādhnoti nara evāparādhyati । vyuccaraṃśca mahādoṣaṃ nara evāparādhyati ॥36॥
html:
evaṃ strī nāparādhnoti nara evāparādhyati ।
vyuccaraṃśca mahādoṣaṃ nara evāparādhyati ॥36॥
slp1: evaM strI nAparADnoti nara evAparADyati । vyuccaraMSca mahAdozaM nara evAparADyati ॥36॥

text: striyā hi paramo bhartā daivataṃ paramaṃ smṛtam । tasyātmanā tu sadṛśamātmānaṃ paramaṃ dadau । sarvakāryāparādhyatvānnāparādhyanti cāṅganāḥ ॥37॥
html:
striyā hi paramo bhartā daivataṃ paramaṃ smṛtam ।
tasyātmanā tu sadṛśamātmānaṃ paramaṃ dadau ।
sarvakāryāparādhyatvānnāparādhyanti cāṅganāḥ ॥37॥
slp1: striyA hi paramo BartA dEvataM paramaM smftam । tasyAtmanA tu sadfSamAtmAnaM paramaM dadO । sarvakAryAparADyatvAnnAparADyanti cANganAH ॥37॥

text: yaścanokto hi nirdeśaḥ striyā maithunatṛptaye । tasya smārayato vyaktamadharmo nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥38॥
html:
yaścanokto hi nirdeśaḥ striyā maithunatṛptaye ।
tasya smārayato vyaktamadharmo nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: yaScanokto hi nirdeSaH striyA mETunatfptaye । tasya smArayato vyaktamaDarmo nAtra saMSayaH ॥38॥

text: yāvannārīṃ mātaraṃ ca gaurave cādhike sthitām । avadhyāṃ tu vijānīyuḥ paśavo'pyavicakṣaṇāḥ ॥39॥
html:
yāvannārīṃ mātaraṃ ca gaurave cādhike sthitām ।
avadhyāṃ tu vijānīyuḥ paśavo'pyavicakṣaṇāḥ ॥39॥
slp1: yAvannArIM mAtaraM ca gOrave cADike sTitAm । avaDyAM tu vijAnIyuH paSavo'pyavicakzaRAH ॥39॥

text: devatānāṃ samāvāyamekasthaṃ pitaraṃ viduḥ । martyānāṃ devatānāṃ ca snehādabhyeti mātaram ॥40॥
html:
devatānāṃ samāvāyamekasthaṃ pitaraṃ viduḥ ।
martyānāṃ devatānāṃ ca snehādabhyeti mātaram ॥40॥
slp1: devatAnAM samAvAyamekasTaM pitaraM viduH । martyAnAM devatAnAM ca snehAdaByeti mAtaram ॥40॥

text: evaṃ vimṛśatastasya cirakāritayā bahu । dīrghaḥ kālo vyatikrāntastatastasyāgamatpitā ॥41॥
html:
evaṃ vimṛśatastasya cirakāritayā bahu ।
dīrghaḥ kālo vyatikrāntastatastasyāgamatpitā ॥41॥
slp1: evaM vimfSatastasya cirakAritayA bahu । dIrGaH kAlo vyatikrAntastatastasyAgamatpitA ॥41॥

text: medhātithirmahāprājño gautamastapasi sthitaḥ । vimṛśya tena kālena patnyāḥ saṃsthāvyatikramam ॥42॥
html:
medhātithirmahāprājño gautamastapasi sthitaḥ ।
vimṛśya tena kālena patnyāḥ saṃsthāvyatikramam ॥42॥
slp1: meDAtiTirmahAprAjYo gOtamastapasi sTitaH । vimfSya tena kAlena patnyAH saMsTAvyatikramam ॥42॥

text: so'bravīdduḥkhasantapto bhṛśamaśrūṇi vartayan । śrutadhairyaprasādena paścāttāpamupāgataḥ ॥43॥
html:
so'bravīdduḥkhasantapto bhṛśamaśrūṇi vartayan ।
śrutadhairyaprasādena paścāttāpamupāgataḥ ॥43॥
slp1: so'bravIdduHKasantapto BfSamaSrURi vartayan । SrutaDEryaprasAdena paScAttApamupAgataH ॥43॥

text: āśramaṃ mama samprāptastrilokeśaḥ purandaraḥ । atithivratamāsthāya brāhmaṇaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ ॥44॥
html:
āśramaṃ mama samprāptastrilokeśaḥ purandaraḥ ।
atithivratamāsthāya brāhmaṇaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ ॥44॥
slp1: ASramaM mama samprAptastrilokeSaH purandaraH । atiTivratamAsTAya brAhmaRaM rUpamAsTitaH ॥44॥

text: samayā sāntvito vāgbhiḥ svāgatenābhipūjitaḥ । arghyaṃ pādyaṃ ca nyāyena tayābhipratipāditaḥ ॥45॥
html:
samayā sāntvito vāgbhiḥ svāgatenābhipūjitaḥ ।
arghyaṃ pādyaṃ ca nyāyena tayābhipratipāditaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: samayA sAntvito vAgBiH svAgatenABipUjitaH । arGyaM pAdyaM ca nyAyena tayABipratipAditaH ॥45॥

text: paravatyasmi cāpyuktaḥ praṇayiṣye nayena ca । atra cākuśale jāte striyo nāsti vyatikramaḥ ॥46॥
html:
paravatyasmi cāpyuktaḥ praṇayiṣye nayena ca ।
atra cākuśale jāte striyo nāsti vyatikramaḥ ॥46॥
slp1: paravatyasmi cApyuktaH praRayizye nayena ca । atra cAkuSale jAte striyo nAsti vyatikramaH ॥46॥

text: evaṃ na strī na caivāhaṃ nādhvagastridaśeśvaraḥ । aparādhyati dharmasya pramādastvaparādhyati ॥47॥
html:
evaṃ na strī na caivāhaṃ nādhvagastridaśeśvaraḥ ।
aparādhyati dharmasya pramādastvaparādhyati ॥47॥
slp1: evaM na strI na cEvAhaM nADvagastridaSeSvaraH । aparADyati Darmasya pramAdastvaparADyati ॥47॥

text: īrṣyājaṃ vyasanaṃ prāhustena caivordhvaretasaḥ । īrṣyayā tvahamākṣipto magno duṣkṛtasāgare ॥48॥
html:
īrṣyājaṃ vyasanaṃ prāhustena caivordhvaretasaḥ ।
īrṣyayā tvahamākṣipto magno duṣkṛtasāgare ॥48॥
slp1: IrzyAjaM vyasanaM prAhustena cEvorDvaretasaH । IrzyayA tvahamAkzipto magno duzkftasAgare ॥48॥

text: hatvā sādhvīṃ ca nārīṃ ca vyasanitvācca śāsitām । bhartavyatvena bhāryāṃ ca ko nu māṃ tārayiṣyati ॥49॥
html:
hatvā sādhvīṃ ca nārīṃ ca vyasanitvācca śāsitām ।
bhartavyatvena bhāryāṃ ca ko nu māṃ tārayiṣyati ॥49॥
slp1: hatvA sADvIM ca nArIM ca vyasanitvAcca SAsitAm । Bartavyatvena BAryAM ca ko nu mAM tArayizyati ॥49॥

text: antareṇa mayājñaptaścirakārī hyudāradhīḥ । yadyadya cirakārī syātsa māṃ trāyeta pātakāt ॥50॥
html:
antareṇa mayājñaptaścirakārī hyudāradhīḥ ।
yadyadya cirakārī syātsa māṃ trāyeta pātakāt ॥50॥
slp1: antareRa mayAjYaptaScirakArI hyudAraDIH । yadyadya cirakArI syAtsa mAM trAyeta pAtakAt ॥50॥

text: cirakārika bhadraṃ te bhadraṃ te cirakārika । yadyadya cirakārī tvaṃ tato'si cirakārikaḥ ॥51॥
html:
cirakārika bhadraṃ te bhadraṃ te cirakārika ।
yadyadya cirakārī tvaṃ tato'si cirakārikaḥ ॥51॥
slp1: cirakArika BadraM te BadraM te cirakArika । yadyadya cirakArI tvaM tato'si cirakArikaH ॥51॥

text: trāhi māṃ mātaraṃ caiva tapo yaccārjitaṃ mayā । ātmānaṃ pātakebhyaśca bhavādya cirakārikaḥ ॥52॥
html:
trāhi māṃ mātaraṃ caiva tapo yaccārjitaṃ mayā ।
ātmānaṃ pātakebhyaśca bhavādya cirakārikaḥ ॥52॥
slp1: trAhi mAM mAtaraM cEva tapo yaccArjitaM mayA । AtmAnaM pAtakeByaSca BavAdya cirakArikaH ॥52॥

text: sahajaṃ cirakāritvaṃ ciraprājñatayā tava । saphalaṃ tattavādyāstu bhavādya cirakārikaḥ ॥53॥
html:
sahajaṃ cirakāritvaṃ ciraprājñatayā tava ।
saphalaṃ tattavādyāstu bhavādya cirakārikaḥ ॥53॥
slp1: sahajaM cirakAritvaM ciraprAjYatayA tava । saPalaM tattavAdyAstu BavAdya cirakArikaH ॥53॥

text: ciramāśaṃsito mātrā ciraṃ garbheṇa dhāritaḥ । saphalaṃ cirakāritvaṃ kuru tvaṃ cirakārika ॥54॥
html:
ciramāśaṃsito mātrā ciraṃ garbheṇa dhāritaḥ ।
saphalaṃ cirakāritvaṃ kuru tvaṃ cirakārika ॥54॥
slp1: ciramASaMsito mAtrA ciraM garBeRa DAritaH । saPalaM cirakAritvaM kuru tvaM cirakArika ॥54॥

text: cirāyate ca santāpācciraṃ svapiti vāritaḥ । āvayościrasantāpādavekṣya cirakārika ॥55॥
html:
cirāyate ca santāpācciraṃ svapiti vāritaḥ ।
āvayościrasantāpādavekṣya cirakārika ॥55॥
slp1: cirAyate ca santApAcciraM svapiti vAritaH । AvayoScirasantApAdavekzya cirakArika ॥55॥

text: evaṃ sa duḥkhito rājanmaharṣirgautamastadā । cirakāriṃ dadarśātha putraṃ sthitamathāntike ॥56॥
html:
evaṃ sa duḥkhito rājanmaharṣirgautamastadā ।
cirakāriṃ dadarśātha putraṃ sthitamathāntike ॥56॥
slp1: evaM sa duHKito rAjanmaharzirgOtamastadA । cirakAriM dadarSATa putraM sTitamaTAntike ॥56॥

text: cirakārī tu pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaduḥkhitaḥ । śastraṃ tyaktvā tato mūrdhnā prasādāyopacakrame ॥57॥
html:
cirakārī tu pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaduḥkhitaḥ ।
śastraṃ tyaktvā tato mūrdhnā prasādāyopacakrame ॥57॥
slp1: cirakArI tu pitaraM dfzwvA paramaduHKitaH । SastraM tyaktvA tato mUrDnA prasAdAyopacakrame ॥57॥

text: gautamastu sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā śirasā patitaṃ bhuvi । patnīṃ caiva nirākārāṃ parāmabhyagamanmudam ॥58॥
html:
gautamastu sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā śirasā patitaṃ bhuvi ।
patnīṃ caiva nirākārāṃ parāmabhyagamanmudam ॥58॥
slp1: gOtamastu sutaM dfzwvA SirasA patitaM Buvi । patnIM cEva nirAkArAM parAmaByagamanmudam ॥58॥

text: na hi sā tena sambhedaṃ patnī nītā mahātmanā । vijane cāśramasthena putraścāpi samāhitaḥ ॥59॥
html:
na hi sā tena sambhedaṃ patnī nītā mahātmanā ।
vijane cāśramasthena putraścāpi samāhitaḥ ॥59॥
slp1: na hi sA tena samBedaM patnI nItA mahAtmanA । vijane cASramasTena putraScApi samAhitaH ॥59॥

text: hanyāttvanapavādena śastrapāṇau sute sthite । vinītaṃ praśnayitvā ca vyavasyedātmakarmasu ॥60॥
html:
hanyāttvanapavādena śastrapāṇau sute sthite ।
vinītaṃ praśnayitvā ca vyavasyedātmakarmasu ॥60॥
slp1: hanyAttvanapavAdena SastrapARO sute sTite । vinItaM praSnayitvA ca vyavasyedAtmakarmasu ॥60॥

text: buddhiścāsītsutaṃ dṛṣṭvā pituścaraṇayornatam । śastragrahaṇacāpalyaṃ saṃvṛṇoti bhayāditi ॥61॥
html:
buddhiścāsītsutaṃ dṛṣṭvā pituścaraṇayornatam ।
śastragrahaṇacāpalyaṃ saṃvṛṇoti bhayāditi ॥61॥
slp1: budDiScAsItsutaM dfzwvA pituScaraRayornatam । SastragrahaRacApalyaM saMvfRoti BayAditi ॥61॥

text: tataḥ pitrā ciraṃ stutvā ciraṃ cāghrāya mūrdhani । ciraṃ dorbhyāṃ pariṣvajya ciraṃ jīvetyudāhṛtaḥ ॥62॥
html:
tataḥ pitrā ciraṃ stutvā ciraṃ cāghrāya mūrdhani ।
ciraṃ dorbhyāṃ pariṣvajya ciraṃ jīvetyudāhṛtaḥ ॥62॥
slp1: tataH pitrA ciraM stutvA ciraM cAGrAya mUrDani । ciraM dorByAM parizvajya ciraM jIvetyudAhftaH ॥62॥

text: evaṃ sa gautamaḥ putraṃ prītiharṣasamanvitaḥ । abhinandya mahāprājña idaṃ vacanamabravīt ॥63॥
html:
evaṃ sa gautamaḥ putraṃ prītiharṣasamanvitaḥ ।
abhinandya mahāprājña idaṃ vacanamabravīt ॥63॥
slp1: evaM sa gOtamaH putraM prItiharzasamanvitaH । aBinandya mahAprAjYa idaM vacanamabravIt ॥63॥

text: cirakārika bhadraṃ te cirakārī ciraṃ bhava । cirāyamāṇe tvayi ca ciramasmi suduḥkhitaḥ ॥64॥
html:
cirakārika bhadraṃ te cirakārī ciraṃ bhava ।
cirāyamāṇe tvayi ca ciramasmi suduḥkhitaḥ ॥64॥
slp1: cirakArika BadraM te cirakArI ciraM Bava । cirAyamARe tvayi ca ciramasmi suduHKitaH ॥64॥

text: gāthāścāpyabravīdvidvāngautamo munisattamaḥ । cirakāriṣu dhīreṣu guṇoddeśasamāśrayāt ॥65॥
html:
gāthāścāpyabravīdvidvāngautamo munisattamaḥ ।
cirakāriṣu dhīreṣu guṇoddeśasamāśrayāt ॥65॥
slp1: gATAScApyabravIdvidvAngOtamo munisattamaH । cirakArizu DIrezu guRoddeSasamASrayAt ॥65॥

text: cireṇa mitraṃ badhnīyāccireṇa ca kṛtaṃ tyajet । cireṇa hi kṛtaṃ mitraṃ ciraṃ dhāraṇamarhati ॥66॥
html:
cireṇa mitraṃ badhnīyāccireṇa ca kṛtaṃ tyajet ।
cireṇa hi kṛtaṃ mitraṃ ciraṃ dhāraṇamarhati ॥66॥
slp1: cireRa mitraM baDnIyAccireRa ca kftaM tyajet । cireRa hi kftaM mitraM ciraM DAraRamarhati ॥66॥

text: rāge darpe ca māne ca drohe pāpe ca karmaṇi । apriye caiva kartavye cirakārī praśasyate ॥67॥
html:
rāge darpe ca māne ca drohe pāpe ca karmaṇi ।
apriye caiva kartavye cirakārī praśasyate ॥67॥
slp1: rAge darpe ca mAne ca drohe pApe ca karmaRi । apriye cEva kartavye cirakArI praSasyate ॥67॥

text: bandhūnāṃ suhṛdāṃ caiva bhṛtyānāṃ strījanasya ca । avyakteṣvaparādheṣu cirakārī praśasyate ॥68॥
html:
bandhūnāṃ suhṛdāṃ caiva bhṛtyānāṃ strījanasya ca ।
avyakteṣvaparādheṣu cirakārī praśasyate ॥68॥
slp1: banDUnAM suhfdAM cEva BftyAnAM strIjanasya ca । avyaktezvaparADezu cirakArI praSasyate ॥68॥

text: evaṃ sa gautamastasya prītaḥ putrasya bhārata । karmaṇā tena kauravya cirakāritayā tayā ॥69॥
html:
evaṃ sa gautamastasya prītaḥ putrasya bhārata ।
karmaṇā tena kauravya cirakāritayā tayā ॥69॥
slp1: evaM sa gOtamastasya prItaH putrasya BArata । karmaRA tena kOravya cirakAritayA tayA ॥69॥

text: evaṃ sarveṣu kāryeṣu vimṛśya puruṣastataḥ । cireṇa niścayaṃ kṛtvā ciraṃ na paritapyate ॥70॥
html:
evaṃ sarveṣu kāryeṣu vimṛśya puruṣastataḥ ।
cireṇa niścayaṃ kṛtvā ciraṃ na paritapyate ॥70॥
slp1: evaM sarvezu kAryezu vimfSya puruzastataH । cireRa niScayaM kftvA ciraM na paritapyate ॥70॥

text: ciraṃ dhārayate roṣaṃ ciraṃ karma niyacchati । paścāttāpakaraṃ karma na kiñcidupapadyate ॥71॥
html:
ciraṃ dhārayate roṣaṃ ciraṃ karma niyacchati ।
paścāttāpakaraṃ karma na kiñcidupapadyate ॥71॥
slp1: ciraM DArayate rozaM ciraM karma niyacCati । paScAttApakaraM karma na kiYcidupapadyate ॥71॥

text: ciraṃ vṛddhānupāsīta ciramanvāsya pūjayet । ciraṃ dharmānniṣeveta kuryāccānveṣaṇaṃ ciram ॥72॥
html:
ciraṃ vṛddhānupāsīta ciramanvāsya pūjayet ।
ciraṃ dharmānniṣeveta kuryāccānveṣaṇaṃ ciram ॥72॥
slp1: ciraM vfdDAnupAsIta ciramanvAsya pUjayet । ciraM DarmAnnizeveta kuryAccAnvezaRaM ciram ॥72॥

text: ciramanvāsya viduṣaściraṃ śiṣṭānniṣevya ca । ciraṃ vinīya cātmānaṃ ciraṃ yātyanavajñatām ॥73॥
html:
ciramanvāsya viduṣaściraṃ śiṣṭānniṣevya ca ।
ciraṃ vinīya cātmānaṃ ciraṃ yātyanavajñatām ॥73॥
slp1: ciramanvAsya viduzaSciraM SizwAnnizevya ca । ciraM vinIya cAtmAnaM ciraM yAtyanavajYatAm ॥73॥

text: bruvataśca parasyāpi vākyaṃ dharmopasaṃhitam । ciraṃ pṛcchecciraṃ brūyācciraṃ na paribhūyate ॥74॥
html:
bruvataśca parasyāpi vākyaṃ dharmopasaṃhitam ।
ciraṃ pṛcchecciraṃ brūyācciraṃ na paribhūyate ॥74॥
slp1: bruvataSca parasyApi vAkyaM DarmopasaMhitam । ciraM pfcCecciraM brUyAcciraM na pariBUyate ॥74॥

text: upāsya bahulāstasminnāśrame sumahātapāḥ । samāḥ svargaṃ gato vipraḥ putreṇa sahitastadā] ॥75॥

samāḥ svargaṃ gato vipraḥ putreṇa sahitastadā] ॥75॥
slp1: upAsya bahulAstasminnASrame sumahAtapAH । samAH svargaM gato vipraH putreRa sahitastadA] ॥75॥

text: kathaṃ rājā prajā rakṣenna ca kiñcitpratāpayet । pṛcchāmi tvāṃ satāṃ śreṣṭha tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
kathaṃ rājā prajā rakṣenna ca kiñcitpratāpayet ।
pṛcchāmi tvāṃ satāṃ śreṣṭha tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: kaTaM rAjA prajA rakzenna ca kiYcitpratApayet । pfcCAmi tvAM satAM SrezWa tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । dyumatsenasya saṃvādaṃ rājñā satyavatā saha ॥2॥
html:

dyumatsenasya saṃvādaṃ rājñā satyavatā saha ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । dyumatsenasya saMvAdaM rAjYA satyavatA saha ॥2॥

text: avyāhṛtaṃ vyājahāra satyavāniti naḥ śrutam । vadhāya nīyamāneṣu piturevānuśāsanāt ॥3॥
html:
avyāhṛtaṃ vyājahāra satyavāniti naḥ śrutam ।
vadhāya nīyamāneṣu piturevānuśāsanāt ॥3॥
slp1: avyAhftaM vyAjahAra satyavAniti naH Srutam । vaDAya nIyamAnezu piturevAnuSAsanAt ॥3॥

text: adharmatāṃ yāti dharmo yātyadharmaśca dharmatām । vadho nāma bhaveddharmo naitadbhavitumarhati ॥4॥
html:

vadho nāma bhaveddharmo naitadbhavitumarhati ॥4॥
slp1: aDarmatAM yAti Darmo yAtyaDarmaSca DarmatAm । vaDo nAma BavedDarmo nEtadBavitumarhati ॥4॥

text: atha cedavadho dharmo dharmaḥ ko jātu cidbhavet । dasyavaścenna hanyeransatyavansaṅkaro bhavet ॥5॥
html:

slp1: aTa cedavaDo Darmo DarmaH ko jAtu cidBavet । dasyavaScenna hanyeransatyavansaNkaro Bavet ॥5॥

text: mamedamiti nāsyaitatpravarteta kalau yuge । lokayātrā na caiva syādatha cedvettha śaṃsa naḥ ॥6॥

text: sarva eva trayo varṇāḥ kāryā brāhmaṇabandhanāḥ । dharmapāśanibaddhānāmalpo vyapacariṣyati ॥7॥

text: yo yasteṣāmapacarettamācakṣīta vai dvijaḥ । ayaṃ me na śṛṇotīti tasminrājā pradhārayet ॥8॥

text: tattvābhedena yacchāstraṃ tatkāryaṃ nānyathā vadhaḥ । asamīkṣyaiva karmāṇi nītiśāstraṃ yathāvidhi ॥9॥

slp1: na mUlaGAtaH kartavyo nEza DarmaH sanAtanaH । api KalvavaDenEva prAyaScittaM viDIyate ॥12॥

slp1: udvejanena banDena virUpakaraRena ca । vaDadaRqena te kleSyA na puro'hitasampadA ॥13॥

text: yadā purohitaṃ vā te paryeyuḥ śaraṇaiṣiṇaḥ । kariṣyāmaḥ punarbrahmanna pāpamiti vādinaḥ ॥14॥

text: tadā visargamarhāḥ syuritīdaṃ nṛpaśāsanam । bibhraddaṇḍājinaṃ muṇḍo brāhmaṇo'rhati vāsanam ॥15॥

text: yatra yatraiva śakyeransaṃyantuṃ samaye prajāḥ । sa tāvatprocyate dharmo yāvanna pratilaṅghyate ॥17॥

slp1: ahanyamAnezu punaH sarvameva parABavet । pUrve pUrvatare cEva suSAsyA aBavaYjanAH ॥18॥

html:
mṛdavaḥ satyabhūyiṣṭhā alpadrohālpamanyavaḥ ।

slp1: AsIdAdAnadaRqo'pi vaDadaRqo'dya vartate । vaDenApi na Sakyante niyantumapare janAH ॥20॥

text: naiva dasyurmanuṣyāṇāṃ na devānāmiti śrutiḥ । na gandharvapitṝṇāṃ ca kaḥ kasyeha na kaścana ॥21॥
html:

na gandharvapitṝṇāṃ ca kaḥ kasyeha na kaścana ॥21॥

text: padmaṃ śmaśānādādatte piśācāccāpi daivatam । teṣu yaḥ samayaṃ kuryādajñeṣu hatabuddhiṣu ॥22॥
html:

slp1: AtmAnamasamADAya samADitsati yaH parAn । vizayezvindriyavaSaM mAnavAH prahasanti tam ॥27॥

text: yo rājño dambhamohena kiñcitkuryādasāmpratam । sarvopāyairniyamyaḥ sa tathā pāpānnivartate ॥28॥

sarvopāyairniyamyaḥ sa tathā pāpānnivartate ॥28॥
slp1: yo rAjYo damBamohena kiYcitkuryAdasAmpratam । sarvopAyErniyamyaH sa taTA pApAnnivartate ॥28॥

text: ātmaivādau niyantavyo duṣkṛtaṃ sanniyacchatā । daṇḍayecca mahādaṇḍairapi bandhūnanantarān ॥29॥
html:
ātmaivādau niyantavyo duṣkṛtaṃ sanniyacchatā ।
daṇḍayecca mahādaṇḍairapi bandhūnanantarān ॥29॥
slp1: AtmEvAdO niyantavyo duzkftaM sanniyacCatA । daRqayecca mahAdaRqErapi banDUnanantarAn ॥29॥

text: yatra vai pāpakṛtkleśyo na mahadduḥkhamarchati । vardhante tatra pāpāni dharmo hrasati ca dhruvam । iti kāruṇyaśīlastu vidvānvai brāhmaṇo'nvaśāt ॥30॥
html:
yatra vai pāpakṛtkleśyo na mahadduḥkhamarchati ।
vardhante tatra pāpāni dharmo hrasati ca dhruvam ।
iti kāruṇyaśīlastu vidvānvai brāhmaṇo'nvaśāt ॥30॥
slp1: yatra vE pApakftkleSyo na mahadduHKamarCati । varDante tatra pApAni Darmo hrasati ca Druvam । iti kAruRyaSIlastu vidvAnvE brAhmaRo'nvaSAt ॥30॥

text: iti caivānuśiṣṭo'smi pūrvaistāta pitāmahaiḥ । āśvāsayadbhiḥ subhṛśamanukrośāttathaiva ca ॥31॥
html:
iti caivānuśiṣṭo'smi pūrvaistāta pitāmahaiḥ ।
āśvāsayadbhiḥ subhṛśamanukrośāttathaiva ca ॥31॥
slp1: iti cEvAnuSizwo'smi pUrvEstAta pitAmahEH । ASvAsayadBiH suBfSamanukroSAttaTEva ca ॥31॥

text: etatprathamakalpena rājā kṛtayuge'bhajat । pādonenāpi dharmeṇa gacchettretāyuge tathā । dvāpare tu dvipādena pādena tvapare yuge ॥32॥
html:
etatprathamakalpena rājā kṛtayuge'bhajat ।
pādonenāpi dharmeṇa gacchettretāyuge tathā ।
dvāpare tu dvipādena pādena tvapare yuge ॥32॥
slp1: etatpraTamakalpena rAjA kftayuge'Bajat । pAdonenApi DarmeRa gacCettretAyuge taTA । dvApare tu dvipAdena pAdena tvapare yuge ॥32॥

text: tathā kaliyuge prāpte rājñāṃ duścaritena ha । bhavetkālaviśeṣeṇa kalā dharmasya ṣoḍaśī ॥33॥
html:
tathā kaliyuge prāpte rājñāṃ duścaritena ha ।
bhavetkālaviśeṣeṇa kalā dharmasya ṣoḍaśī ॥33॥
slp1: taTA kaliyuge prApte rAjYAM duScaritena ha । BavetkAlaviSezeRa kalA Darmasya zoqaSI ॥33॥

text: atha prathamakalpena satyavansaṅkaro bhavet । āyuḥ śaktiṃ ca kālaṃ ca nirdiśya tapa ādiśet ॥34॥
html:
atha prathamakalpena satyavansaṅkaro bhavet ।
āyuḥ śaktiṃ ca kālaṃ ca nirdiśya tapa ādiśet ॥34॥
slp1: aTa praTamakalpena satyavansaNkaro Bavet । AyuH SaktiM ca kAlaM ca nirdiSya tapa AdiSet ॥34॥

text: satyāya hi yathā neha jahyāddharmaphalaṃ mahat । bhūtānāmanukampārthaṃ manuḥ svāyambhuvo'bravīt] ॥35॥
html:
satyāya hi yathā neha jahyāddharmaphalaṃ mahat ।
bhūtānāmanukampārthaṃ manuḥ svāyambhuvo'bravīt] ॥35॥
slp1: satyAya hi yaTA neha jahyAdDarmaPalaM mahat । BUtAnAmanukampArTaM manuH svAyamBuvo'bravIt] ॥35॥

text: avirodhena bhūtānāṃ tyāgaḥ ṣāḍguṇyakārakaḥ । yaḥ syādubhayabhāgdharmastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
avirodhena bhūtānāṃ tyāgaḥ ṣāḍguṇyakārakaḥ ।
yaḥ syādubhayabhāgdharmastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: aviroDena BUtAnAM tyAgaH zAqguRyakArakaH । yaH syAduBayaBAgDarmastanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: gārhasthyasya ca dharmasya tyāgadharmasya cobhayoḥ । adūrasamprasthitayoḥ kiṃ svicchreyaḥ pitāmaha ॥2॥
html:
gārhasthyasya ca dharmasya tyāgadharmasya cobhayoḥ ।
adūrasamprasthitayoḥ kiṃ svicchreyaḥ pitāmaha ॥2॥
slp1: gArhasTyasya ca Darmasya tyAgaDarmasya coBayoH । adUrasamprasTitayoH kiM svicCreyaH pitAmaha ॥2॥

text: ubhau dharmau mahābhāgāvubhau paramaduścarau । ubhau mahāphalau tāta sadbhirācaritāvubhau ॥3॥
html:
ubhau dharmau mahābhāgāvubhau paramaduścarau ।
ubhau mahāphalau tāta sadbhirācaritāvubhau ॥3॥
slp1: uBO DarmO mahABAgAvuBO paramaduScarO । uBO mahAPalO tAta sadBirAcaritAvuBO ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: atra te vartayiṣyāmi prāmāṇyamubhayostayoḥ । śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ pārtha chinnadharmārthasaṃśayam ॥4॥
html:
atra te vartayiṣyāmi prāmāṇyamubhayostayoḥ ।
śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ pārtha chinnadharmārthasaṃśayam ॥4॥
slp1: atra te vartayizyAmi prAmARyamuBayostayoH । SfRuzvEkamanAH pArTa CinnaDarmArTasaMSayam ॥4॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । kapilasya gośca saṃvādaṃ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥5॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
kapilasya gośca saṃvādaṃ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥5॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । kapilasya goSca saMvAdaM tanniboDa yuDizWira ॥5॥

text: āmnāyamanupaśyanhi purāṇaṃ śāśvataṃ dhruvam । nahuṣaḥ pūrvamālebhe tvaṣṭurgāmiti naḥ śrutam ॥6॥
html:
āmnāyamanupaśyanhi purāṇaṃ śāśvataṃ dhruvam ।
nahuṣaḥ pūrvamālebhe tvaṣṭurgāmiti naḥ śrutam ॥6॥
slp1: AmnAyamanupaSyanhi purARaM SASvataM Druvam । nahuzaH pUrvamAleBe tvazwurgAmiti naH Srutam ॥6॥

text: tāṃ niyuktāmadīnātmā sattvasthaḥ samaye rataḥ । jñānavānniyatāhāro dadarśa kapilastadā ॥7॥
html:
tāṃ niyuktāmadīnātmā sattvasthaḥ samaye rataḥ ।
jñānavānniyatāhāro dadarśa kapilastadā ॥7॥
slp1: tAM niyuktAmadInAtmA sattvasTaH samaye rataH । jYAnavAnniyatAhAro dadarSa kapilastadA ॥7॥

text: sa buddhimuttamāṃ prāpto naiṣṭhikīmakutobhayām । smarāmi śithilaṃ satyaṃ vedā ityabravītsakṛt ॥8॥
html:
sa buddhimuttamāṃ prāpto naiṣṭhikīmakutobhayām ।
smarāmi śithilaṃ satyaṃ vedā ityabravītsakṛt ॥8॥
slp1: sa budDimuttamAM prApto nEzWikImakutoBayAm । smarAmi SiTilaM satyaM vedA ityabravItsakft ॥8॥

text: tāṃ gāmṛṣiḥ syūmaraśmiḥ praviśya yatimabravīt । haṃho vedā yadi matā dharmāḥ kenāpare matāḥ ॥9॥
html:
tāṃ gāmṛṣiḥ syūmaraśmiḥ praviśya yatimabravīt ।
haṃho vedā yadi matā dharmāḥ kenāpare matāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: tAM gAmfziH syUmaraSmiH praviSya yatimabravIt । haMho vedA yadi matA DarmAH kenApare matAH ॥9॥

text: tapasvino dhṛtimataḥ śrutivijñānacakṣuṣaḥ । sarvamārṣaṃ hi manyante vyāhṛtaṃ viditātmanaḥ ॥10॥
html:
tapasvino dhṛtimataḥ śrutivijñānacakṣuṣaḥ ।
sarvamārṣaṃ hi manyante vyāhṛtaṃ viditātmanaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: tapasvino DftimataH SrutivijYAnacakzuzaH । sarvamArzaM hi manyante vyAhftaM viditAtmanaH ॥10॥

text: tasyaivaṃ gatatṛṣṇasya vijvarasya nirāśiṣaḥ । kā vivakṣāsti vedeṣu nirārambhasya sarvaśaḥ ॥11॥
html:
tasyaivaṃ gatatṛṣṇasya vijvarasya nirāśiṣaḥ ।
kā vivakṣāsti vedeṣu nirārambhasya sarvaśaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: tasyEvaM gatatfzRasya vijvarasya nirASizaH । kA vivakzAsti vedezu nirAramBasya sarvaSaH ॥11॥

text: nāhaṃ vedānvinindāmi na vivakṣāmi karhicit । pṛthagāśramiṇāṃ karmāṇyekārthānīti naḥ śrutam ॥12॥
html:
nāhaṃ vedānvinindāmi na vivakṣāmi karhicit ।
pṛthagāśramiṇāṃ karmāṇyekārthānīti naḥ śrutam ॥12॥
slp1: nAhaM vedAnvinindAmi na vivakzAmi karhicit । pfTagASramiRAM karmARyekArTAnIti naH Srutam ॥12॥
author: kapila uvāca ।

text: gacchatyeva parityāgī vānaprasthaśca gacchati । gṛhastho brahmacārī ca ubhau tāvapi gacchataḥ ॥13॥
html:
gacchatyeva parityāgī vānaprasthaśca gacchati ।
gṛhastho brahmacārī ca ubhau tāvapi gacchataḥ ॥13॥
slp1: gacCatyeva parityAgI vAnaprasTaSca gacCati । gfhasTo brahmacArI ca uBO tAvapi gacCataH ॥13॥

text: devayānā hi panthānaścatvāraḥ śāśvatā matāḥ । teṣāṃ jyāyaḥkanīyastvaṃ phaleṣūktaṃ balābalam ॥14॥
html:
devayānā hi panthānaścatvāraḥ śāśvatā matāḥ ।
teṣāṃ jyāyaḥkanīyastvaṃ phaleṣūktaṃ balābalam ॥14॥
slp1: devayAnA hi panTAnaScatvAraH SASvatA matAH । tezAM jyAyaHkanIyastvaM PalezUktaM balAbalam ॥14॥

text: evaṃ viditvā sarvārthānārabhediti vaidikam । nārabhediti cānyatra naiṣṭhikī śrūyate śrutiḥ ॥15॥
html:
evaṃ viditvā sarvārthānārabhediti vaidikam ।
nārabhediti cānyatra naiṣṭhikī śrūyate śrutiḥ ॥15॥
slp1: evaM viditvA sarvArTAnAraBediti vEdikam । nAraBediti cAnyatra nEzWikI SrUyate SrutiH ॥15॥

text: anārambhe hyadoṣaḥ syādārambhe'doṣa uttamaḥ । evaṃ sthitasya śāstrasya durvijñeyaṃ balābalam ॥16॥
html:
anārambhe hyadoṣaḥ syādārambhe'doṣa uttamaḥ ।
evaṃ sthitasya śāstrasya durvijñeyaṃ balābalam ॥16॥
slp1: anAramBe hyadozaH syAdAramBe'doza uttamaH । evaM sTitasya SAstrasya durvijYeyaM balAbalam ॥16॥

text: yadyatra kiñcitpratyakṣamahiṃsāyāḥ paraṃ matam । ṛte tvāgamaśāstrebhyo brūhi tadyadi paśyasi ॥17॥
html:
yadyatra kiñcitpratyakṣamahiṃsāyāḥ paraṃ matam ।
ṛte tvāgamaśāstrebhyo brūhi tadyadi paśyasi ॥17॥
slp1: yadyatra kiYcitpratyakzamahiMsAyAH paraM matam । fte tvAgamaSAstreByo brUhi tadyadi paSyasi ॥17॥

text: svargakāmo yajeteti satataṃ śrūyate śrutiḥ । phalaṃ prakalpya pūrvaṃ hi tato yajñaḥ pratāyate ॥18॥
html:
svargakāmo yajeteti satataṃ śrūyate śrutiḥ ।
phalaṃ prakalpya pūrvaṃ hi tato yajñaḥ pratāyate ॥18॥
slp1: svargakAmo yajeteti satataM SrUyate SrutiH । PalaM prakalpya pUrvaM hi tato yajYaH pratAyate ॥18॥
author: syūmaraśmiruvāca ।

text: ajaścāśvaśca meṣaśca gauśca pakṣigaṇāśca ye । grāmyāraṇyā oṣadhayaḥ prāṇasyānnamiti śrutiḥ ॥19॥
html:
ajaścāśvaśca meṣaśca gauśca pakṣigaṇāśca ye ।
grāmyāraṇyā oṣadhayaḥ prāṇasyānnamiti śrutiḥ ॥19॥
slp1: ajaScASvaSca mezaSca gOSca pakzigaRASca ye । grAmyAraRyA ozaDayaH prARasyAnnamiti SrutiH ॥19॥

text: tathaivānnaṃ hyaharahaḥ sāyaṃ prātarnirupyate । paśavaścātha dhānyaṃ ca yajñasyāṅgamiti śrutiḥ ॥20॥
html:
tathaivānnaṃ hyaharahaḥ sāyaṃ prātarnirupyate ।
paśavaścātha dhānyaṃ ca yajñasyāṅgamiti śrutiḥ ॥20॥
slp1: taTEvAnnaM hyaharahaH sAyaM prAtarnirupyate । paSavaScATa DAnyaM ca yajYasyANgamiti SrutiH ॥20॥

text: etāni saha yajñena prajāpatirakalpayat । tena prajāpatirdevānyajñenāyajata prabhuḥ ॥21॥
html:
etāni saha yajñena prajāpatirakalpayat ।
tena prajāpatirdevānyajñenāyajata prabhuḥ ॥21॥
slp1: etAni saha yajYena prajApatirakalpayat । tena prajApatirdevAnyajYenAyajata praBuH ॥21॥

text: te smānyonyañcarāḥ sarve prāṇinaḥ sapta sapta ca । yajñeṣūpākṛtaṃ viśvaṃ prāhuruttamasañjñitam ॥22॥
html:
te smānyonyañcarāḥ sarve prāṇinaḥ sapta sapta ca ।
yajñeṣūpākṛtaṃ viśvaṃ prāhuruttamasañjñitam ॥22॥
slp1: te smAnyonyaYcarAH sarve prARinaH sapta sapta ca । yajYezUpAkftaM viSvaM prAhuruttamasaYjYitam ॥22॥

text: etaccaivābhyanujñātaṃ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraistathā । ko jātu na vicinvīta vidvānsvāṃ śaktimātmanaḥ ॥23॥
html:
etaccaivābhyanujñātaṃ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraistathā ।
ko jātu na vicinvīta vidvānsvāṃ śaktimātmanaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: etaccEvAByanujYAtaM pUrvEH pUrvatarEstaTA । ko jAtu na vicinvIta vidvAnsvAM SaktimAtmanaH ॥23॥

text: paśavaśca manuṣyāśca drumāścauṣadhibhiḥ saha । svargamevābhikāṅkṣante na ca svargastvṛte makham ॥24॥
html:
paśavaśca manuṣyāśca drumāścauṣadhibhiḥ saha ।
svargamevābhikāṅkṣante na ca svargastvṛte makham ॥24॥
slp1: paSavaSca manuzyASca drumAScOzaDiBiH saha । svargamevABikANkzante na ca svargastvfte maKam ॥24॥

text: oṣadhyaḥ paśavo vṛkṣā vīrudājyaṃ payo dadhi । havirbhūmirdiśaḥ śraddhā kālaścaitāni dvādaśa ॥25॥
html:
oṣadhyaḥ paśavo vṛkṣā vīrudājyaṃ payo dadhi ।
havirbhūmirdiśaḥ śraddhā kālaścaitāni dvādaśa ॥25॥
slp1: ozaDyaH paSavo vfkzA vIrudAjyaM payo daDi । havirBUmirdiSaH SradDA kAlaScEtAni dvAdaSa ॥25॥

text: ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni yajamānaśca ṣoḍaśaḥ । agnirjñeyo gṛhapatiḥ sa saptadaśa ucyate । aṅgānyetāni yajñasya yajño mūlamiti śrutiḥ ॥26॥
html:
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni yajamānaśca ṣoḍaśaḥ ।
agnirjñeyo gṛhapatiḥ sa saptadaśa ucyate ।
aṅgānyetāni yajñasya yajño mūlamiti śrutiḥ ॥26॥
slp1: fco yajUMzi sAmAni yajamAnaSca zoqaSaH । agnirjYeyo gfhapatiH sa saptadaSa ucyate । aNgAnyetAni yajYasya yajYo mUlamiti SrutiH ॥26॥

text: ājyena payasā dadhnā śakṛtāmikṣayā tvacā । vālaiḥ śṛṅgeṇa pādena sambhavatyeva gaurmakham । evaṃ pratyekaśaḥ sarvaṃ yadyadasya vidhīyate ॥27॥
html:
ājyena payasā dadhnā śakṛtāmikṣayā tvacā ।
vālaiḥ śṛṅgeṇa pādena sambhavatyeva gaurmakham ।
evaṃ pratyekaśaḥ sarvaṃ yadyadasya vidhīyate ॥27॥
slp1: Ajyena payasA daDnA SakftAmikzayA tvacA । vAlEH SfNgeRa pAdena samBavatyeva gOrmaKam । evaM pratyekaSaH sarvaM yadyadasya viDIyate ॥27॥

text: yajñaṃ vahanti sambhūya sahartvigbhiḥ sadakṣiṇaiḥ । saṃhatyaitāni sarvāṇi yajñaṃ nirvartayantyuta ॥28॥
html:
yajñaṃ vahanti sambhūya sahartvigbhiḥ sadakṣiṇaiḥ ।
saṃhatyaitāni sarvāṇi yajñaṃ nirvartayantyuta ॥28॥
slp1: yajYaM vahanti samBUya sahartvigBiH sadakziREH । saMhatyEtAni sarvARi yajYaM nirvartayantyuta ॥28॥

text: yajñārthāni hi sṛṣṭāni yathā vai śrūyate śrutiḥ । evaṃ pūrve pūrvatarāḥ pravṛttāścaiva mānavāḥ ॥29॥
html:
yajñārthāni hi sṛṣṭāni yathā vai śrūyate śrutiḥ ।
evaṃ pūrve pūrvatarāḥ pravṛttāścaiva mānavāḥ ॥29॥
slp1: yajYArTAni hi sfzwAni yaTA vE SrUyate SrutiH । evaM pUrve pUrvatarAH pravfttAScEva mAnavAH ॥29॥

text: na hinasti hyārabhate nābhidruhyati kiñcana । yajño yaṣṭavya ityeva yo yajatyaphalepsayā ॥30॥
html:
na hinasti hyārabhate nābhidruhyati kiñcana ।
yajño yaṣṭavya ityeva yo yajatyaphalepsayā ॥30॥
slp1: na hinasti hyAraBate nABidruhyati kiYcana । yajYo yazwavya ityeva yo yajatyaPalepsayA ॥30॥

text: yajñāṅgānyapi caitāni yathoktāni nasaṃśayaḥ । vidhinā vidhiyuktāni tārayanti parasparam ॥31॥
html:
yajñāṅgānyapi caitāni yathoktāni nasaṃśayaḥ ।
vidhinā vidhiyuktāni tārayanti parasparam ॥31॥
slp1: yajYANgAnyapi cEtAni yaToktAni nasaMSayaH । viDinA viDiyuktAni tArayanti parasparam ॥31॥

text: āmnāyamārṣaṃ paśyāmi yasminvedāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ । taṃ vidvāṃso'nupaśyanti brāhmaṇasyānudarśanāt ॥32॥
html:
āmnāyamārṣaṃ paśyāmi yasminvedāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ।
taṃ vidvāṃso'nupaśyanti brāhmaṇasyānudarśanāt ॥32॥
slp1: AmnAyamArzaM paSyAmi yasminvedAH pratizWitAH । taM vidvAMso'nupaSyanti brAhmaRasyAnudarSanAt ॥32॥

text: brāhmaṇaprabhavo yajño brāhmaṇārpaṇa eva ca । anu yajñaṃ jagatsarvaṃ yajñaścānu jagatsadā ॥33॥
html:
brāhmaṇaprabhavo yajño brāhmaṇārpaṇa eva ca ।
anu yajñaṃ jagatsarvaṃ yajñaścānu jagatsadā ॥33॥
slp1: brAhmaRapraBavo yajYo brAhmaRArpaRa eva ca । anu yajYaM jagatsarvaM yajYaScAnu jagatsadA ॥33॥

text: omiti brahmaṇo yonirnamaḥ svāhā svadhā vaṣaṭ । yasyaitāni prayujyante yathāśakti kṛtānyapi ॥34॥
html:
omiti brahmaṇo yonirnamaḥ svāhā svadhā vaṣaṭ ।
yasyaitāni prayujyante yathāśakti kṛtānyapi ॥34॥
slp1: omiti brahmaRo yonirnamaH svAhA svaDA vazaw । yasyEtAni prayujyante yaTASakti kftAnyapi ॥34॥

text: na tasya triṣu lokeṣu paralokabhayaṃ viduḥ । iti vedā vadantīha siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ ॥35॥
html:
na tasya triṣu lokeṣu paralokabhayaṃ viduḥ ।
iti vedā vadantīha siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: na tasya trizu lokezu paralokaBayaM viduH । iti vedA vadantIha sidDASca paramarzayaH ॥35॥

text: ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni stobhāśca vidhicoditāḥ । yasminnetāni sarvāṇi bahireva sa vai dvijaḥ ॥36॥
html:
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni stobhāśca vidhicoditāḥ ।
yasminnetāni sarvāṇi bahireva sa vai dvijaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: fco yajUMzi sAmAni stoBASca viDicoditAH । yasminnetAni sarvARi bahireva sa vE dvijaH ॥36॥

text: agnyādheye yadbhavati yacca some sute dvija । yaccetarairmahāyajñairveda tadbhagavānsvataḥ ॥37॥
html:
agnyādheye yadbhavati yacca some sute dvija ।
yaccetarairmahāyajñairveda tadbhagavānsvataḥ ॥37॥
slp1: agnyADeye yadBavati yacca some sute dvija । yaccetarErmahAyajYErveda tadBagavAnsvataH ॥37॥

text: tasmādbrahmanyajetaiva yājayeccāvicārayan । yajataḥ svargavidhinā pretya svargaphalaṃ mahat ॥38॥
html:
tasmādbrahmanyajetaiva yājayeccāvicārayan ।
yajataḥ svargavidhinā pretya svargaphalaṃ mahat ॥38॥
slp1: tasmAdbrahmanyajetEva yAjayeccAvicArayan । yajataH svargaviDinA pretya svargaPalaM mahat ॥38॥

text: nāyaṃ loko'styayajñānāṃ paraśceti viniścayaḥ । vedavādavidaścaiva pramāṇamubhayaṃ tadā] ॥39॥
html:
nāyaṃ loko'styayajñānāṃ paraśceti viniścayaḥ ।
vedavādavidaścaiva pramāṇamubhayaṃ tadā] ॥39॥
slp1: nAyaM loko'styayajYAnAM paraSceti viniScayaH । vedavAdavidaScEva pramARamuBayaM tadA] ॥39॥

text: etāvadanupaśyanto yatayo yānti mārgagāḥ । naiṣāṃ sarveṣu lokeṣu kaścidasti vyatikramaḥ ॥1॥
html:
etāvadanupaśyanto yatayo yānti mārgagāḥ ।
naiṣāṃ sarveṣu lokeṣu kaścidasti vyatikramaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: etAvadanupaSyanto yatayo yAnti mArgagAH । nEzAM sarvezu lokezu kaScidasti vyatikramaH ॥1॥
author: kapila uvāca ।

text: nirdvandvā nirnamaskārā nirāśīrbandhanā budhāḥ । vimuktāḥ sarvapāpebhyaścaranti śucayo'malāḥ ॥2॥
html:
nirdvandvā nirnamaskārā nirāśīrbandhanā budhāḥ ।
vimuktāḥ sarvapāpebhyaścaranti śucayo'malāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: nirdvandvA nirnamaskArA nirASIrbanDanA buDAH । vimuktAH sarvapApeByaScaranti Sucayo'malAH ॥2॥

text: apavarge'tha santyāge buddhau ca kṛtaniścayāḥ । brahmiṣṭhā brahmabhūtāśca brahmaṇyeva kṛtālayāḥ ॥3॥
html:
apavarge'tha santyāge buddhau ca kṛtaniścayāḥ ।
brahmiṣṭhā brahmabhūtāśca brahmaṇyeva kṛtālayāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: apavarge'Ta santyAge budDO ca kftaniScayAH । brahmizWA brahmaBUtASca brahmaRyeva kftAlayAH ॥3॥

text: viśokā naṣṭarajasasteṣāṃ lokāḥ sanātanāḥ । teṣāṃ gatiṃ parāṃ prāpya gārhasthye kiṃ prayojanam ॥4॥
html:
viśokā naṣṭarajasasteṣāṃ lokāḥ sanātanāḥ ।
teṣāṃ gatiṃ parāṃ prāpya gārhasthye kiṃ prayojanam ॥4॥
slp1: viSokA nazwarajasastezAM lokAH sanAtanAH । tezAM gatiM parAM prApya gArhasTye kiM prayojanam ॥4॥

text: yadyeṣā paramā niṣṭhā yadyeṣā paramā gatiḥ । gṛhasthānavyapāśritya nāśramo'nyaḥ pravartate ॥5॥
html:
yadyeṣā paramā niṣṭhā yadyeṣā paramā gatiḥ ।
gṛhasthānavyapāśritya nāśramo'nyaḥ pravartate ॥5॥
slp1: yadyezA paramA nizWA yadyezA paramA gatiH । gfhasTAnavyapASritya nASramo'nyaH pravartate ॥5॥
author: syūmaraśmiruvāca ।

text: yathā mātaramāśritya sarve jīvanti jantavaḥ । evaṃ gṛhasthamāśritya vartanta itare''śramāḥ ॥6॥
html:
yathā mātaramāśritya sarve jīvanti jantavaḥ ।
evaṃ gṛhasthamāśritya vartanta itare''śramāḥ ॥6॥
slp1: yaTA mAtaramASritya sarve jIvanti jantavaH । evaM gfhasTamASritya vartanta itare''SramAH ॥6॥

text: gṛhastha eva yajate gṛhasthastapyate tapaḥ । gārhasthyamasya dharmasya mūlaṃ yatkiñcidejate ॥7॥
html:
gṛhastha eva yajate gṛhasthastapyate tapaḥ ।
gārhasthyamasya dharmasya mūlaṃ yatkiñcidejate ॥7॥
slp1: gfhasTa eva yajate gfhasTastapyate tapaH । gArhasTyamasya Darmasya mUlaM yatkiYcidejate ॥7॥

text: prajanāddhyabhinirvṛttāḥ sarve prāṇabhṛto mune । prajanaṃ cāpyutānyatra na kathañcana vidyate ॥8॥
html:
prajanāddhyabhinirvṛttāḥ sarve prāṇabhṛto mune ।
prajanaṃ cāpyutānyatra na kathañcana vidyate ॥8॥
slp1: prajanAdDyaBinirvfttAH sarve prARaBfto mune । prajanaM cApyutAnyatra na kaTaYcana vidyate ॥8॥

text: yāstāḥ syurbahiroṣadhyo bahvaraṇyāstathā dvija । oṣadhibhyo bahiryasmātprāṇī kaścinna vidyate । kasyaiṣā vāgbhavetsatyā mokṣo nāsti gṛhāditi ॥9॥
html:
yāstāḥ syurbahiroṣadhyo bahvaraṇyāstathā dvija ।
oṣadhibhyo bahiryasmātprāṇī kaścinna vidyate ।
kasyaiṣā vāgbhavetsatyā mokṣo nāsti gṛhāditi ॥9॥
slp1: yAstAH syurbahirozaDyo bahvaraRyAstaTA dvija । ozaDiByo bahiryasmAtprARI kaScinna vidyate । kasyEzA vAgBavetsatyA mokzo nAsti gfhAditi ॥9॥

text: aśraddadhānairaprājñaiḥ sūkṣmadarśanavarjitaiḥ । nirāśairalasaiḥ śrāntaistapyamānaiḥ svakarmabhiḥ । śramasyoparamo dṛṣṭaḥ pravrajyā nāma paṇḍitaiḥ ॥10॥
html:
aśraddadhānairaprājñaiḥ sūkṣmadarśanavarjitaiḥ ।
nirāśairalasaiḥ śrāntaistapyamānaiḥ svakarmabhiḥ ।
śramasyoparamo dṛṣṭaḥ pravrajyā nāma paṇḍitaiḥ ॥10॥
slp1: aSraddaDAnEraprAjYEH sUkzmadarSanavarjitEH । nirASEralasEH SrAntEstapyamAnEH svakarmaBiH । Sramasyoparamo dfzwaH pravrajyA nAma paRqitEH ॥10॥

text: trailokyasyaiva heturhi maryādā śāśvatī dhruvā । brāhmaṇo nāma bhagavāñjanmaprabhṛti pūjyate ॥11॥
html:
trailokyasyaiva heturhi maryādā śāśvatī dhruvā ।
brāhmaṇo nāma bhagavāñjanmaprabhṛti pūjyate ॥11॥
slp1: trElokyasyEva heturhi maryAdA SASvatI DruvA । brAhmaRo nAma BagavAYjanmapraBfti pUjyate ॥11॥

text: prāggarbhādhānānmantrā hi pravartante dvijātiṣu । aviśrambheṣu vartante viśrambheṣvapyasaṃśayam ॥12॥
html:
prāggarbhādhānānmantrā hi pravartante dvijātiṣu ।
aviśrambheṣu vartante viśrambheṣvapyasaṃśayam ॥12॥
slp1: prAggarBADAnAnmantrA hi pravartante dvijAtizu । aviSramBezu vartante viSramBezvapyasaMSayam ॥12॥

text: dāhaḥ punaḥ saṃśrayaṇe saṃsthite pātrabhojanam । dānaṃ gavāṃ paśūnāṃ vā piṇḍānāṃ cāpsu majjanam ॥13॥
html:
dāhaḥ punaḥ saṃśrayaṇe saṃsthite pātrabhojanam ।
dānaṃ gavāṃ paśūnāṃ vā piṇḍānāṃ cāpsu majjanam ॥13॥
slp1: dAhaH punaH saMSrayaRe saMsTite pAtraBojanam । dAnaM gavAM paSUnAM vA piRqAnAM cApsu majjanam ॥13॥

text: arciṣmanto barhiṣadaḥ kravyādāḥ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ । mṛtasyāpyanumanyante mantrā mantrāśca kāraṇam ॥14॥
html:
arciṣmanto barhiṣadaḥ kravyādāḥ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ ।
mṛtasyāpyanumanyante mantrā mantrāśca kāraṇam ॥14॥
slp1: arcizmanto barhizadaH kravyAdAH pitaraH smftAH । mftasyApyanumanyante mantrA mantrASca kAraRam ॥14॥

text: evaṃ krośatsu vedeṣu kuto mokṣo'sti kasyacit । ṛṇavanto yadā martyāḥ pitṛdevadvijātiṣu ॥15॥
html:
evaṃ krośatsu vedeṣu kuto mokṣo'sti kasyacit ।
ṛṇavanto yadā martyāḥ pitṛdevadvijātiṣu ॥15॥
slp1: evaM kroSatsu vedezu kuto mokzo'sti kasyacit । fRavanto yadA martyAH pitfdevadvijAtizu ॥15॥

text: śriyā vihīnairalasaiḥ paṇḍitairapalāpitam । vedavādāparijñānaṃ satyābhāsamivānṛtam ॥16॥
html:
śriyā vihīnairalasaiḥ paṇḍitairapalāpitam ।
