vedavādāparijñānaṃ satyābhāsamivānṛtam ॥16॥
slp1: SriyA vihInEralasEH paRqitErapalApitam । vedavAdAparijYAnaM satyABAsamivAnftam ॥16॥

text: na vai pāpairhriyate kṛṣyate vā yo brāhmaṇo yajate vedaśāstraiḥ । ūrdhvaṃ yajñaḥ paśubhiḥ sārdhameti santarpitastarpayate ca kāmaiḥ ॥17॥
html:
na vai pāpairhriyate kṛṣyate vā yo brāhmaṇo yajate vedaśāstraiḥ ।
ūrdhvaṃ yajñaḥ paśubhiḥ sārdhameti santarpitastarpayate ca kāmaiḥ ॥17॥
slp1: na vE pApErhriyate kfzyate vA yo brAhmaRo yajate vedaSAstrEH । UrDvaM yajYaH paSuBiH sArDameti santarpitastarpayate ca kAmEH ॥17॥

text: na vedānāṃ paribhavānna śāṭhyena na māyayā । mahatprāpnoti puruṣo brahma brahmaṇi vindati ॥18॥
html:
na vedānāṃ paribhavānna śāṭhyena na māyayā ।
mahatprāpnoti puruṣo brahma brahmaṇi vindati ॥18॥
slp1: na vedAnAM pariBavAnna SAWyena na mAyayA । mahatprApnoti puruzo brahma brahmaRi vindati ॥18॥

text: darśaṃ ca paurṇamāsaṃ ca agnihotraṃ ca dhīmatām । cāturmāsyāni caivāsaṃsteṣu yajñaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥19॥
html:
darśaṃ ca paurṇamāsaṃ ca agnihotraṃ ca dhīmatām ।
cāturmāsyāni caivāsaṃsteṣu yajñaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: darSaM ca pOrRamAsaM ca agnihotraM ca DImatAm । cAturmAsyAni cEvAsaMstezu yajYaH sanAtanaH ॥19॥
author: kapila uvāca ।

text: anārambhāḥ sudhṛtayaḥ śucayo brahmasaṃśritāḥ । brahmaṇaiva sma te devāṃstarpayantyamṛtaiṣiṇaḥ ॥20॥
html:
anārambhāḥ sudhṛtayaḥ śucayo brahmasaṃśritāḥ ।
brahmaṇaiva sma te devāṃstarpayantyamṛtaiṣiṇaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: anAramBAH suDftayaH Sucayo brahmasaMSritAH । brahmaREva sma te devAMstarpayantyamftEziRaH ॥20॥

text: sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya sarvabhūtāni paśyataḥ । devāpi mārge muhyanti apadasya padaiṣiṇaḥ ॥21॥
html:
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya sarvabhūtāni paśyataḥ ।
devāpi mārge muhyanti apadasya padaiṣiṇaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: sarvaBUtAtmaBUtasya sarvaBUtAni paSyataH । devApi mArge muhyanti apadasya padEziRaH ॥21॥

text: caturdvāraṃ puruṣaṃ caturmukhaṃ caturdhā cainamupayāti nindā । bāhubhyāṃ vāca udarādupasthātteṣāṃ dvāraṃ dvārapālo bubhūṣet ॥22॥
html:
caturdvāraṃ puruṣaṃ caturmukhaṃ caturdhā cainamupayāti nindā ।
bāhubhyāṃ vāca udarādupasthātteṣāṃ dvāraṃ dvārapālo bubhūṣet ॥22॥
slp1: caturdvAraM puruzaM caturmuKaM caturDA cEnamupayAti nindA । bAhuByAM vAca udarAdupasTAttezAM dvAraM dvArapAlo buBUzet ॥22॥

text: nākṣairdīvyennādadītānyavittaṃ na vāyonīyasya śṛtaṃ pragṛhṇet । kruddho na caiva prahareta dhīmāṃstathāsya tatpāṇipādaṃ suguptam ॥23॥
html:
nākṣairdīvyennādadītānyavittaṃ na vāyonīyasya śṛtaṃ pragṛhṇet ।
kruddho na caiva prahareta dhīmāṃstathāsya tatpāṇipādaṃ suguptam ॥23॥
slp1: nAkzErdIvyennAdadItAnyavittaM na vAyonIyasya SftaM pragfhRet । krudDo na cEva prahareta DImAMstaTAsya tatpARipAdaM suguptam ॥23॥

text: nākrośamarchenna mṛṣā vadecca na paiśunaṃ janavādaṃ ca kuryāt । satyavrato mitabhāṣo'pramattastathāsya vāgdvāramatho suguptam ॥24॥
html:
nākrośamarchenna mṛṣā vadecca na paiśunaṃ janavādaṃ ca kuryāt ।
satyavrato mitabhāṣo'pramattastathāsya vāgdvāramatho suguptam ॥24॥
slp1: nAkroSamarCenna mfzA vadecca na pESunaM janavAdaM ca kuryAt । satyavrato mitaBAzo'pramattastaTAsya vAgdvAramaTo suguptam ॥24॥

text: nānāśanaḥ syānna mahāśanaḥ syādalolupaḥ sādhubhirāgataḥ syāt । yātrārthamāhāramihādadīta tathāsya syājjāṭharī dvāraguptiḥ ॥25॥
html:
nānāśanaḥ syānna mahāśanaḥ syādalolupaḥ sādhubhirāgataḥ syāt ।
yātrārthamāhāramihādadīta tathāsya syājjāṭharī dvāraguptiḥ ॥25॥
slp1: nAnASanaH syAnna mahASanaH syAdalolupaH sADuBirAgataH syAt । yAtrArTamAhAramihAdadIta taTAsya syAjjAWarI dvAraguptiH ॥25॥

text: na vīrapatnīṃ vihareta nārīṃ na cāpi nārīmanṛtāvāhvayīta । bhāryāvrataṃ hyātmani dhārayīta tathāsyopasthadvāraguptirbhaveta ॥26॥
html:
na vīrapatnīṃ vihareta nārīṃ na cāpi nārīmanṛtāvāhvayīta ।
bhāryāvrataṃ hyātmani dhārayīta tathāsyopasthadvāraguptirbhaveta ॥26॥
slp1: na vIrapatnIM vihareta nArIM na cApi nArImanftAvAhvayIta । BAryAvrataM hyAtmani DArayIta taTAsyopasTadvAraguptirBaveta ॥26॥

text: dvārāṇi yasya sarvāṇi suguptāni manīṣiṇaḥ । upasthamudaraṃ bāhū vākcaturthī sa vai dvijaḥ ॥27॥
html:
dvārāṇi yasya sarvāṇi suguptāni manīṣiṇaḥ ।
upasthamudaraṃ bāhū vākcaturthī sa vai dvijaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: dvArARi yasya sarvARi suguptAni manIziRaH । upasTamudaraM bAhU vAkcaturTI sa vE dvijaH ॥27॥

text: moghānyaguptadvārasya sarvāṇyeva bhavantyuta । kiṃ tasya tapasā kāryaṃ kiṃ yajñena kimātmanā ॥28॥
html:
moghānyaguptadvārasya sarvāṇyeva bhavantyuta ।
kiṃ tasya tapasā kāryaṃ kiṃ yajñena kimātmanā ॥28॥
slp1: moGAnyaguptadvArasya sarvARyeva Bavantyuta । kiM tasya tapasA kAryaM kiM yajYena kimAtmanA ॥28॥

text: anuttarīyavasanamanupastīrṇaśāyinam । bāhūpadhānaṃ śāmyantaṃ taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ ॥29॥
html:
anuttarīyavasanamanupastīrṇaśāyinam ।
bāhūpadhānaṃ śāmyantaṃ taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ ॥29॥
slp1: anuttarIyavasanamanupastIrRaSAyinam । bAhUpaDAnaM SAmyantaM taM devA brAhmaRaM viduH ॥29॥

text: dvandvārāmeṣu sarveṣu ya eko ramate muniḥ । pareṣāmananudhyāyaṃstaṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ ॥30॥
html:
dvandvārāmeṣu sarveṣu ya eko ramate muniḥ ।
pareṣāmananudhyāyaṃstaṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ ॥30॥
slp1: dvandvArAmezu sarvezu ya eko ramate muniH । parezAmananuDyAyaMstaM devA brAhmaRaM viduH ॥30॥

text: yena sarvamidaṃ buddhaṃ prakṛtirvikṛtiśca yā । gatijñaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ ॥31॥
html:
yena sarvamidaṃ buddhaṃ prakṛtirvikṛtiśca yā ।
gatijñaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ ॥31॥
slp1: yena sarvamidaM budDaM prakftirvikftiSca yA । gatijYaH sarvaBUtAnAM taM devA brAhmaRaM viduH ॥31॥

text: abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyaḥ sarveṣāmabhayaṃ yataḥ । sarvabhūtātmabhūto yastaṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ ॥32॥
html:
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyaḥ sarveṣāmabhayaṃ yataḥ ।
sarvabhūtātmabhūto yastaṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ ॥32॥
slp1: aBayaM sarvaBUteByaH sarvezAmaBayaM yataH । sarvaBUtAtmaBUto yastaM devA brAhmaRaM viduH ॥32॥

text: nāntareṇānujānanti vedānāṃ yatkriyāphalam । anujñāya ca tatsarvamanyadrocayate'phalam ॥33॥
html:
nāntareṇānujānanti vedānāṃ yatkriyāphalam ।
anujñāya ca tatsarvamanyadrocayate'phalam ॥33॥
slp1: nAntareRAnujAnanti vedAnAM yatkriyAPalam । anujYAya ca tatsarvamanyadrocayate'Palam ॥33॥

text: phalavanti ca karmāṇi vyuṣṭimanti dhruvāṇi ca । viguṇāni ca paśyanti tathānaikāntikāni ca ॥34॥
html:
phalavanti ca karmāṇi vyuṣṭimanti dhruvāṇi ca ।
viguṇāni ca paśyanti tathānaikāntikāni ca ॥34॥
slp1: Palavanti ca karmARi vyuzwimanti DruvARi ca । viguRAni ca paSyanti taTAnEkAntikAni ca ॥34॥

text: guṇāścātra sudurjñeyā jñātāścāpi suduṣkarāḥ । anuṣṭhitāścāntavanta iti tvamanupaśyasi ॥35॥
html:
guṇāścātra sudurjñeyā jñātāścāpi suduṣkarāḥ ।
anuṣṭhitāścāntavanta iti tvamanupaśyasi ॥35॥
slp1: guRAScAtra sudurjYeyA jYAtAScApi suduzkarAH । anuzWitAScAntavanta iti tvamanupaSyasi ॥35॥

text: yathā ca vedaprāmāṇyaṃ tyāgaśca saphalo yathā । tau panthānāvubhau vyaktau bhagavaṃstadbravīhi me ॥36॥
html:
yathā ca vedaprāmāṇyaṃ tyāgaśca saphalo yathā ।
tau panthānāvubhau vyaktau bhagavaṃstadbravīhi me ॥36॥
slp1: yaTA ca vedaprAmARyaM tyAgaSca saPalo yaTA । tO panTAnAvuBO vyaktO BagavaMstadbravIhi me ॥36॥
author: syūmaraśmiruvāca ।

text: pratyakṣamiha paśyanti bhavantaḥ satpathe sthitāḥ । pratyakṣaṃ tu kimatrāsti yadbhavanta upāsate ॥37॥
html:
pratyakṣamiha paśyanti bhavantaḥ satpathe sthitāḥ ।
pratyakṣaṃ tu kimatrāsti yadbhavanta upāsate ॥37॥
slp1: pratyakzamiha paSyanti BavantaH satpaTe sTitAH । pratyakzaM tu kimatrAsti yadBavanta upAsate ॥37॥
author: kapila uvāca ।

text: syūmaraśmirahaṃ brahmañjijñāsārthamihāgataḥ । śreyaskāmaḥ pratyavocamārjavānna vivakṣayā । imaṃ ca saṃśayaṃ ghoraṃ bhagavānprabravītu me ॥38॥
html:
syūmaraśmirahaṃ brahmañjijñāsārthamihāgataḥ ।
śreyaskāmaḥ pratyavocamārjavānna vivakṣayā ।
imaṃ ca saṃśayaṃ ghoraṃ bhagavānprabravītu me ॥38॥
slp1: syUmaraSmirahaM brahmaYjijYAsArTamihAgataH । SreyaskAmaH pratyavocamArjavAnna vivakzayA । imaM ca saMSayaM GoraM BagavAnprabravItu me ॥38॥
author: syūmaraśmiruvāca ।

text: pratyakṣamiha paśyanto bhavantaḥ satpathe sthitāḥ । kimatra pratyakṣatamaṃ bhavanto yadupāsate । anyatra tarkaśāstrebhya āgamācca yathāgamam ॥39॥
html:
pratyakṣamiha paśyanto bhavantaḥ satpathe sthitāḥ ।
kimatra pratyakṣatamaṃ bhavanto yadupāsate ।
anyatra tarkaśāstrebhya āgamācca yathāgamam ॥39॥
slp1: pratyakzamiha paSyanto BavantaH satpaTe sTitAH । kimatra pratyakzatamaM Bavanto yadupAsate । anyatra tarkaSAstreBya AgamAcca yaTAgamam ॥39॥

text: āgamo vedavādastu tarkaśāstrāṇi cāgamaḥ । yathāgamamupāsīta āgamastatra sidhyati । siddhiḥ pratyakṣarūpā ca dṛśyatyāgamaniścayāt ॥40॥
html:
āgamo vedavādastu tarkaśāstrāṇi cāgamaḥ ।
yathāgamamupāsīta āgamastatra sidhyati ।
siddhiḥ pratyakṣarūpā ca dṛśyatyāgamaniścayāt ॥40॥
slp1: Agamo vedavAdastu tarkaSAstrARi cAgamaH । yaTAgamamupAsIta Agamastatra siDyati । sidDiH pratyakzarUpA ca dfSyatyAgamaniScayAt ॥40॥

text: naurnāvīva nibaddhā hi srotasā sanibandhanā । hriyamāṇā kathaṃ vipra kubuddhīṃstārayiṣyati । etadbravītu bhagavānupapanno'smyadhīhi bhoḥ ॥41॥
html:
naurnāvīva nibaddhā hi srotasā sanibandhanā ।
hriyamāṇā kathaṃ vipra kubuddhīṃstārayiṣyati ।
etadbravītu bhagavānupapanno'smyadhīhi bhoḥ ॥41॥
slp1: nOrnAvIva nibadDA hi srotasA sanibanDanA । hriyamARA kaTaM vipra kubudDIMstArayizyati । etadbravItu BagavAnupapanno'smyaDIhi BoH ॥41॥

text: naiva tyāgī na santuṣṭo nāśoko na nirāmayaḥ । na nirvivitso nāvṛtto nāpavṛtto'sti kaścana ॥42॥
html:
naiva tyāgī na santuṣṭo nāśoko na nirāmayaḥ ।
na nirvivitso nāvṛtto nāpavṛtto'sti kaścana ॥42॥
slp1: nEva tyAgI na santuzwo nASoko na nirAmayaH । na nirvivitso nAvftto nApavftto'sti kaScana ॥42॥

text: bhavanto'pi ca hṛṣyanti śocanti ca yathā vayam । indriyārthāśca bhavatāṃ samānāḥ sarvajantuṣu ॥43॥
html:
bhavanto'pi ca hṛṣyanti śocanti ca yathā vayam ।
indriyārthāśca bhavatāṃ samānāḥ sarvajantuṣu ॥43॥
slp1: Bavanto'pi ca hfzyanti Socanti ca yaTA vayam । indriyArTASca BavatAM samAnAH sarvajantuzu ॥43॥

text: evaṃ caturṇāṃ varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ pravṛttiṣu । ekamālambamānānāṃ nirṇaye kiṃ nirāmayam ॥44॥
html:
evaṃ caturṇāṃ varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ pravṛttiṣu ।
ekamālambamānānāṃ nirṇaye kiṃ nirāmayam ॥44॥
slp1: evaM caturRAM varRAnAmASramARAM pravfttizu । ekamAlambamAnAnAM nirRaye kiM nirAmayam ॥44॥

text: yadyadācarate śāstramatha sarvapravṛttiṣu । yasya yatra hyanuṣṭhānaṃ tatra tatra nirāmayam ॥45॥
html:
yadyadācarate śāstramatha sarvapravṛttiṣu ।
yasya yatra hyanuṣṭhānaṃ tatra tatra nirāmayam ॥45॥
slp1: yadyadAcarate SAstramaTa sarvapravfttizu । yasya yatra hyanuzWAnaM tatra tatra nirAmayam ॥45॥
author: kapila uvāca ।

text: sarvaṃ pāvayate jñānaṃ yo jñānaṃ hyanuvartate । jñānādapetya yā vṛttiḥ sā vināśayati prajāḥ ॥46॥
html:
sarvaṃ pāvayate jñānaṃ yo jñānaṃ hyanuvartate ।
jñānādapetya yā vṛttiḥ sā vināśayati prajāḥ ॥46॥
slp1: sarvaM pAvayate jYAnaM yo jYAnaM hyanuvartate । jYAnAdapetya yA vfttiH sA vinASayati prajAH ॥46॥

text: bhavanto jñānino nityaṃ sarvataśca nirāgamāḥ । aikātmyaṃ nāma kaściddhi kadācidabhipadyate ॥47॥
html:
bhavanto jñānino nityaṃ sarvataśca nirāgamāḥ ।
aikātmyaṃ nāma kaściddhi kadācidabhipadyate ॥47॥
slp1: Bavanto jYAnino nityaM sarvataSca nirAgamAH । EkAtmyaM nAma kaScidDi kadAcidaBipadyate ॥47॥

text: śāstraṃ hyabuddhvā tattvena kecidvādabalā janāḥ । kāmadveṣābhibhūtatvādahaṅkāravaśaṃ gatāḥ ॥48॥
html:
śāstraṃ hyabuddhvā tattvena kecidvādabalā janāḥ ।
kāmadveṣābhibhūtatvādahaṅkāravaśaṃ gatāḥ ॥48॥
slp1: SAstraM hyabudDvA tattvena kecidvAdabalA janAH । kAmadvezABiBUtatvAdahaNkAravaSaM gatAH ॥48॥

text: yāthātathyamavijñāya śāstrāṇāṃ śāstradasyavaḥ । brahmastenā nirārambhā apakvamatayo'śivāḥ ॥49॥
html:
yāthātathyamavijñāya śāstrāṇāṃ śāstradasyavaḥ ।
brahmastenā nirārambhā apakvamatayo'śivāḥ ॥49॥
slp1: yATAtaTyamavijYAya SAstrARAM SAstradasyavaH । brahmastenA nirAramBA apakvamatayo'SivAH ॥49॥

text: vaiguṇyameva paśyanti na guṇānanuyuñjate । teṣāṃ tamaḥśarīrāṇāṃ tama eva parāyaṇam ॥50॥
html:
vaiguṇyameva paśyanti na guṇānanuyuñjate ।
teṣāṃ tamaḥśarīrāṇāṃ tama eva parāyaṇam ॥50॥
slp1: vEguRyameva paSyanti na guRAnanuyuYjate । tezAM tamaHSarIrARAM tama eva parAyaRam ॥50॥

text: yo yathāprakṛtirjantuḥ prakṛteḥ syādvaśānugaḥ । tasya dveṣaśca kāmaśca krodho dambho'nṛtaṃ madaḥ । nityamevābhivartante guṇāḥ prakṛtisambhavāḥ ॥51॥
html:
yo yathāprakṛtirjantuḥ prakṛteḥ syādvaśānugaḥ ।
tasya dveṣaśca kāmaśca krodho dambho'nṛtaṃ madaḥ ।
nityamevābhivartante guṇāḥ prakṛtisambhavāḥ ॥51॥
slp1: yo yaTAprakftirjantuH prakfteH syAdvaSAnugaH । tasya dvezaSca kAmaSca kroDo damBo'nftaM madaH । nityamevABivartante guRAH prakftisamBavAH ॥51॥

text: etadbuddhyānupaśyantaḥ santyajeyuḥ śubhāśubham । parāṃ gatimabhīpsanto yatayaḥ saṃyame ratāḥ ॥52॥
html:
etadbuddhyānupaśyantaḥ santyajeyuḥ śubhāśubham ।
parāṃ gatimabhīpsanto yatayaḥ saṃyame ratāḥ ॥52॥
slp1: etadbudDyAnupaSyantaH santyajeyuH SuBASuBam । parAM gatimaBIpsanto yatayaH saMyame ratAH ॥52॥

text: sarvametanmayā brahmañśāstrataḥ parikīrtitam । na hyavijñāya śāstrārthaṃ pravartante pravṛttayaḥ ॥53॥
html:
sarvametanmayā brahmañśāstrataḥ parikīrtitam ।
na hyavijñāya śāstrārthaṃ pravartante pravṛttayaḥ ॥53॥
slp1: sarvametanmayA brahmaYSAstrataH parikIrtitam । na hyavijYAya SAstrArTaM pravartante pravfttayaH ॥53॥
author: syūmaraśmiruvāca ।

text: yaḥ kaścinnyāyya ācāraḥ sarvaṃ śāstramiti śrutiḥ । yadanyāyyamaśāstraṃ tadityeṣā śrūyate śrutiḥ ॥54॥
html:
yaḥ kaścinnyāyya ācāraḥ sarvaṃ śāstramiti śrutiḥ ।
yadanyāyyamaśāstraṃ tadityeṣā śrūyate śrutiḥ ॥54॥
slp1: yaH kaScinnyAyya AcAraH sarvaM SAstramiti SrutiH । yadanyAyyamaSAstraM tadityezA SrUyate SrutiH ॥54॥

text: na pravṛttirṛte śāstrātkācidastīti niścayaḥ । yadanyadvedavādebhyastadaśāstramiti śrutiḥ ॥55॥
html:
na pravṛttirṛte śāstrātkācidastīti niścayaḥ ।
yadanyadvedavādebhyastadaśāstramiti śrutiḥ ॥55॥
slp1: na pravfttirfte SAstrAtkAcidastIti niScayaH । yadanyadvedavAdeByastadaSAstramiti SrutiH ॥55॥

text: śāstrādapetaṃ paśyanti bahavo vyaktamāninaḥ । śāstradoṣānna paśyanti iha cāmutra cāpare । avijñānahataprajñā hīnaprajñāstamovṛtāḥ ॥56॥
html:
śāstrādapetaṃ paśyanti bahavo vyaktamāninaḥ ।
śāstradoṣānna paśyanti iha cāmutra cāpare ।
avijñānahataprajñā hīnaprajñāstamovṛtāḥ ॥56॥
slp1: SAstrAdapetaM paSyanti bahavo vyaktamAninaH । SAstradozAnna paSyanti iha cAmutra cApare । avijYAnahataprajYA hInaprajYAstamovftAH ॥56॥

text: śakyaṃ tvekena muktena kṛtakṛtyena sarvaśaḥ । piṇḍamātraṃ vyapāśritya carituṃ sarvatodiśam । vedavādaṃ vyapāśritya mokṣo'stīti prabhāṣitum ॥57॥
html:
śakyaṃ tvekena muktena kṛtakṛtyena sarvaśaḥ ।
piṇḍamātraṃ vyapāśritya carituṃ sarvatodiśam ।
vedavādaṃ vyapāśritya mokṣo'stīti prabhāṣitum ॥57॥
slp1: SakyaM tvekena muktena kftakftyena sarvaSaH । piRqamAtraM vyapASritya carituM sarvatodiSam । vedavAdaM vyapASritya mokzo'stIti praBAzitum ॥57॥

text: idaṃ tu duṣkaraṃ karma kuṭumbamabhisaṃśritam । dānamadhyayanaṃ yajñaḥ prajāsantānamārjavam ॥58॥
html:
idaṃ tu duṣkaraṃ karma kuṭumbamabhisaṃśritam ।
dānamadhyayanaṃ yajñaḥ prajāsantānamārjavam ॥58॥
slp1: idaM tu duzkaraM karma kuwumbamaBisaMSritam । dAnamaDyayanaM yajYaH prajAsantAnamArjavam ॥58॥

text: yadyetadevaṃ kṛtvāpi na vimokṣo'sti kasyacit । dhikkartāraṃ ca kāryaṃ ca śramaścāyaṃ nirarthakaḥ ॥59॥
html:
yadyetadevaṃ kṛtvāpi na vimokṣo'sti kasyacit ।
dhikkartāraṃ ca kāryaṃ ca śramaścāyaṃ nirarthakaḥ ॥59॥
slp1: yadyetadevaM kftvApi na vimokzo'sti kasyacit । DikkartAraM ca kAryaM ca SramaScAyaM nirarTakaH ॥59॥

text: nāstikyamanyathā ca syādvedānāṃ pṛṣṭhataḥkriyā । etasyānantyamicchāmi bhagavañśrotumañjasā ॥60॥
html:
nāstikyamanyathā ca syādvedānāṃ pṛṣṭhataḥkriyā ।
etasyānantyamicchāmi bhagavañśrotumañjasā ॥60॥
slp1: nAstikyamanyaTA ca syAdvedAnAM pfzWataHkriyA । etasyAnantyamicCAmi BagavaYSrotumaYjasA ॥60॥

text: tathyaṃ vadasva me brahmannupasanno'smyadhīhi bhoḥ । yathā te vidito mokṣastathecchāmyupaśikṣitum] ॥61॥
html:
tathyaṃ vadasva me brahmannupasanno'smyadhīhi bhoḥ ।
yathā te vidito mokṣastathecchāmyupaśikṣitum] ॥61॥
slp1: taTyaM vadasva me brahmannupasanno'smyaDIhi BoH । yaTA te vidito mokzastaTecCAmyupaSikzitum] ॥61॥

text: vedāḥ pramāṇaṃ lokānāṃ na vedāḥ pṛṣṭhataḥkṛtāḥ । dve brahmaṇī veditavye śabdabrahma paraṃ ca yat । śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati ॥1॥
html:
vedāḥ pramāṇaṃ lokānāṃ na vedāḥ pṛṣṭhataḥkṛtāḥ ।
dve brahmaṇī veditavye śabdabrahma paraṃ ca yat ।
śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati ॥1॥
slp1: vedAH pramARaM lokAnAM na vedAH pfzWataHkftAH । dve brahmaRI veditavye Sabdabrahma paraM ca yat । SabdabrahmaRi nizRAtaH paraM brahmADigacCati ॥1॥
author: kapila uvāca ।

text: śarīrametatkurute yadvede kurute tanum । kṛtaśuddhaśarīro hi pātraṃ bhavati brāhmaṇaḥ ॥2॥
html:
śarīrametatkurute yadvede kurute tanum ।
kṛtaśuddhaśarīro hi pātraṃ bhavati brāhmaṇaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: SarIrametatkurute yadvede kurute tanum । kftaSudDaSarIro hi pAtraM Bavati brAhmaRaH ॥2॥

text: ānantyamanuyuṅkte yaḥ karmaṇā tadbravīmi te । nirāgamamanaitihyaṃ pratyakṣaṃ lokasākṣikam ॥3॥
html:
ānantyamanuyuṅkte yaḥ karmaṇā tadbravīmi te ।
nirāgamamanaitihyaṃ pratyakṣaṃ lokasākṣikam ॥3॥
slp1: AnantyamanuyuNkte yaH karmaRA tadbravImi te । nirAgamamanEtihyaM pratyakzaM lokasAkzikam ॥3॥

text: dharma ityeva ye yajñānvitanvanti nirāśiṣaḥ । utpannatyāgino'lubdhāḥ kṛpāsūyāvivarjitāḥ । dhanānāmeṣa vai panthāstīrtheṣu pratipādanam ॥4॥
html:
dharma ityeva ye yajñānvitanvanti nirāśiṣaḥ ।
utpannatyāgino'lubdhāḥ kṛpāsūyāvivarjitāḥ ।
dhanānāmeṣa vai panthāstīrtheṣu pratipādanam ॥4॥
slp1: Darma ityeva ye yajYAnvitanvanti nirASizaH । utpannatyAgino'lubDAH kfpAsUyAvivarjitAH । DanAnAmeza vE panTAstIrTezu pratipAdanam ॥4॥

text: anāśritāḥ pāpakṛtyāḥ kadācitkarmayonitaḥ । manaḥsaṅkalpasaṃsiddhā viśuddhajñānaniścayāḥ ॥5॥
html:
anāśritāḥ pāpakṛtyāḥ kadācitkarmayonitaḥ ।
manaḥsaṅkalpasaṃsiddhā viśuddhajñānaniścayāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: anASritAH pApakftyAH kadAcitkarmayonitaH । manaHsaNkalpasaMsidDA viSudDajYAnaniScayAH ॥5॥

text: akrudhyanto'nasūyanto nirahaṅkāramatsarāḥ । jñānaniṣṭhāstriśuklāśca sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ॥6॥
html:
akrudhyanto'nasūyanto nirahaṅkāramatsarāḥ ।
jñānaniṣṭhāstriśuklāśca sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ॥6॥
slp1: akruDyanto'nasUyanto nirahaNkAramatsarAH । jYAnanizWAstriSuklASca sarvaBUtahite ratAH ॥6॥

text: āsangṛhasthā bhūyiṣṭhamavyutkrāntāḥ svakarmasu । rājānaśca tathā yuktā brāhmaṇāśca yathāvidhi ॥7॥
html:
āsangṛhasthā bhūyiṣṭhamavyutkrāntāḥ svakarmasu ।
rājānaśca tathā yuktā brāhmaṇāśca yathāvidhi ॥7॥
slp1: AsangfhasTA BUyizWamavyutkrAntAH svakarmasu । rAjAnaSca taTA yuktA brAhmaRASca yaTAviDi ॥7॥

text: samā hyārjavasampannāḥ santuṣṭā jñānaniścayāḥ । pratyakṣadharmāḥ śucayaḥ śraddadhānāḥ parāvare ॥8॥
html:
samā hyārjavasampannāḥ santuṣṭā jñānaniścayāḥ ।
pratyakṣadharmāḥ śucayaḥ śraddadhānāḥ parāvare ॥8॥
slp1: samA hyArjavasampannAH santuzwA jYAnaniScayAH । pratyakzaDarmAH SucayaH SraddaDAnAH parAvare ॥8॥

text: purastādbhāvitātmāno yathāvaccaritavratāḥ । caranti dharmaṃ kṛcchre'pi durge caivādhisaṃhatāḥ ॥9॥
html:
purastādbhāvitātmāno yathāvaccaritavratāḥ ।
caranti dharmaṃ kṛcchre'pi durge caivādhisaṃhatāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: purastAdBAvitAtmAno yaTAvaccaritavratAH । caranti DarmaM kfcCre'pi durge cEvADisaMhatAH ॥9॥

text: saṃhatya dharmaṃ caratāṃ purāsītsukhameva tat । teṣāṃ nāsīdvidhātavyaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kadācana ॥10॥
html:
saṃhatya dharmaṃ caratāṃ purāsītsukhameva tat ।
teṣāṃ nāsīdvidhātavyaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kadācana ॥10॥
slp1: saMhatya DarmaM caratAM purAsItsuKameva tat । tezAM nAsIdviDAtavyaM prAyaScittaM kadAcana ॥10॥

text: satyaṃ hi dharmamāsthāya durādharṣatamā matāḥ । na mātrāmanurudhyante na dharmacchalamantataḥ ॥11॥
html:
satyaṃ hi dharmamāsthāya durādharṣatamā matāḥ ।
na mātrāmanurudhyante na dharmacchalamantataḥ ॥11॥
slp1: satyaM hi DarmamAsTAya durADarzatamA matAH । na mAtrAmanuruDyante na DarmacCalamantataH ॥11॥

text: ya eva prathamaḥ kalpastamevābhyācaransaha । asyāṃ sthitau sthitānāṃ hi prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate । durbalātmana utpannaṃ prāyaścittamiti śrutiḥ ॥12॥
html:
ya eva prathamaḥ kalpastamevābhyācaransaha ।
asyāṃ sthitau sthitānāṃ hi prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate ।
durbalātmana utpannaṃ prāyaścittamiti śrutiḥ ॥12॥
slp1: ya eva praTamaH kalpastamevAByAcaransaha । asyAM sTitO sTitAnAM hi prAyaScittaM na vidyate । durbalAtmana utpannaM prAyaScittamiti SrutiH ॥12॥

text: yata evaṃvidhā viprāḥ purāṇā yajñavāhanāḥ । traividyavṛddhāḥ śucayo vṛttavanto yaśasvinaḥ । yajanto'haraharyajñairnirāśīrbandhanā budhāḥ ॥13॥
html:
yata evaṃvidhā viprāḥ purāṇā yajñavāhanāḥ ।
traividyavṛddhāḥ śucayo vṛttavanto yaśasvinaḥ ।
yajanto'haraharyajñairnirāśīrbandhanā budhāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: yata evaMviDA viprAH purARA yajYavAhanAH । trEvidyavfdDAH Sucayo vfttavanto yaSasvinaH । yajanto'haraharyajYErnirASIrbanDanA buDAH ॥13॥

text: teṣāṃ yajñāśca vedāśca karmāṇi ca yathāgamam । āgamāśca yathākālaṃ saṅkalpāśca yathāvratam ॥14॥
html:
teṣāṃ yajñāśca vedāśca karmāṇi ca yathāgamam ।
āgamāśca yathākālaṃ saṅkalpāśca yathāvratam ॥14॥
slp1: tezAM yajYASca vedASca karmARi ca yaTAgamam । AgamASca yaTAkAlaM saNkalpASca yaTAvratam ॥14॥

text: apetakāmakrodhānāṃ prakṛtyā saṃśitātmanām । ṛjūnāṃ śamanityānāṃ sthitānāṃ sveṣu karmasu । sarvamānantyamevāsīditi naḥ śāśvatī śrutiḥ ॥15॥
html:
apetakāmakrodhānāṃ prakṛtyā saṃśitātmanām ।
ṛjūnāṃ śamanityānāṃ sthitānāṃ sveṣu karmasu ।
sarvamānantyamevāsīditi naḥ śāśvatī śrutiḥ ॥15॥
slp1: apetakAmakroDAnAM prakftyA saMSitAtmanAm । fjUnAM SamanityAnAM sTitAnAM svezu karmasu । sarvamAnantyamevAsIditi naH SASvatI SrutiH ॥15॥

text: teṣāmadīnasattvānāṃ duścarācārakarmaṇām । svakarmabhiḥ saṃvṛtānāṃ tapo ghoratvamāgatam ॥16॥
html:
teṣāmadīnasattvānāṃ duścarācārakarmaṇām ।
svakarmabhiḥ saṃvṛtānāṃ tapo ghoratvamāgatam ॥16॥
slp1: tezAmadInasattvAnAM duScarAcArakarmaRAm । svakarmaBiH saMvftAnAM tapo GoratvamAgatam ॥16॥

text: taṃ sadācāramāścaryaṃ purāṇaṃ śāśvataṃ dhruvam । aśaknuvadbhiścarituṃ kiñciddharmeṣu sūcitam ॥17॥
html:
taṃ sadācāramāścaryaṃ purāṇaṃ śāśvataṃ dhruvam ।
aśaknuvadbhiścarituṃ kiñciddharmeṣu sūcitam ॥17॥
slp1: taM sadAcAramAScaryaM purARaM SASvataM Druvam । aSaknuvadBiScarituM kiYcidDarmezu sUcitam ॥17॥

text: nirāpaddharma ācārastvapramādo'parābhavaḥ । sarvavarṇeṣu yatteṣu nāsītkaścidvyatikramaḥ ॥18॥
html:
nirāpaddharma ācārastvapramādo'parābhavaḥ ।
sarvavarṇeṣu yatteṣu nāsītkaścidvyatikramaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: nirApadDarma AcArastvapramAdo'parABavaH । sarvavarRezu yattezu nAsItkaScidvyatikramaH ॥18॥

text: dharmamekaṃ catuṣpādamāśritāste nararṣabhāḥ । taṃ santo vidhivatprāpya gacchanti paramāṃ gatim ॥19॥
html:
dharmamekaṃ catuṣpādamāśritāste nararṣabhāḥ ।
taṃ santo vidhivatprāpya gacchanti paramāṃ gatim ॥19॥
slp1: DarmamekaM catuzpAdamASritAste nararzaBAH । taM santo viDivatprApya gacCanti paramAM gatim ॥19॥

text: gṛhebhya eva niṣkramya vanamanye samāśritāḥ । gṛhamevābhisaṃśritya tato'nye brahmacāriṇaḥ ॥20॥
html:
gṛhebhya eva niṣkramya vanamanye samāśritāḥ ।
gṛhamevābhisaṃśritya tato'nye brahmacāriṇaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: gfheBya eva nizkramya vanamanye samASritAH । gfhamevABisaMSritya tato'nye brahmacAriRaH ॥20॥

text: dharmametaṃ catuṣpādamāśramaṃ brāhmaṇā viduḥ । ānantyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ brāhmaṇā nāma niścayaḥ ॥21॥
html:
dharmametaṃ catuṣpādamāśramaṃ brāhmaṇā viduḥ ।
ānantyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ brāhmaṇā nāma niścayaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: DarmametaM catuzpAdamASramaM brAhmaRA viduH । AnantyaM brahmaRaH sTAnaM brAhmaRA nAma niScayaH ॥21॥

text: ata evaṃvidhā viprāḥ purāṇā dharmacāriṇaḥ । ta ete divi dṛśyante jyotirbhūtā dvijātayaḥ ॥22॥
html:
ata evaṃvidhā viprāḥ purāṇā dharmacāriṇaḥ ।
ta ete divi dṛśyante jyotirbhūtā dvijātayaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: ata evaMviDA viprAH purARA DarmacAriRaH । ta ete divi dfSyante jyotirBUtA dvijAtayaH ॥22॥

text: nakṣatrāṇīva dhiṣṇyeṣu bahavastārakāgaṇāḥ । ānantyamupasamprāptāḥ santoṣāditi vaidikam ॥23॥
html:
nakṣatrāṇīva dhiṣṇyeṣu bahavastārakāgaṇāḥ ।
ānantyamupasamprāptāḥ santoṣāditi vaidikam ॥23॥
slp1: nakzatrARIva DizRyezu bahavastArakAgaRAH । AnantyamupasamprAptAH santozAditi vEdikam ॥23॥

text: yadyāgacchanti saṃsāraṃ punaryoniṣu tādṛśāḥ । na lipyante pāpakṛtyaiḥ kadācitkarmayonitaḥ ॥24॥
html:
yadyāgacchanti saṃsāraṃ punaryoniṣu tādṛśāḥ ।
na lipyante pāpakṛtyaiḥ kadācitkarmayonitaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: yadyAgacCanti saMsAraM punaryonizu tAdfSAH । na lipyante pApakftyEH kadAcitkarmayonitaH ॥24॥

text: evaṃ yukto brāhmaṇaḥ syādanyo brāhmaṇako bhavet । karmaiva puruṣasyāha śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham ॥25॥
html:
evaṃ yukto brāhmaṇaḥ syādanyo brāhmaṇako bhavet ।
karmaiva puruṣasyāha śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham ॥25॥
slp1: evaM yukto brAhmaRaH syAdanyo brAhmaRako Bavet । karmEva puruzasyAha SuBaM vA yadi vASuBam ॥25॥

text: evaṃ pakvakaṣāyāṇāmānantyena śrutena ca । sarvamānantyamevāsīdevaṃ naḥ śāśvatī śrutiḥ ॥26॥
html:
evaṃ pakvakaṣāyāṇāmānantyena śrutena ca ।
sarvamānantyamevāsīdevaṃ naḥ śāśvatī śrutiḥ ॥26॥
slp1: evaM pakvakazAyARAmAnantyena Srutena ca । sarvamAnantyamevAsIdevaM naH SASvatI SrutiH ॥26॥

text: teṣāmapetatṛṣṇānāṃ nirṇiktānāṃ śubhātmanām । caturtha aupaniṣado dharmaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥27॥
html:
teṣāmapetatṛṣṇānāṃ nirṇiktānāṃ śubhātmanām ।
caturtha aupaniṣado dharmaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: tezAmapetatfzRAnAM nirRiktAnAM SuBAtmanAm । caturTa Opanizado DarmaH sADAraRaH smftaH ॥27॥

text: sa siddhaiḥ sādhyate nityaṃ brāhmaṇairniyatātmabhiḥ । santoṣamūlastyāgātmā jñānādhiṣṭhānamucyate ॥28॥
html:
sa siddhaiḥ sādhyate nityaṃ brāhmaṇairniyatātmabhiḥ ।
santoṣamūlastyāgātmā jñānādhiṣṭhānamucyate ॥28॥
slp1: sa sidDEH sADyate nityaM brAhmaRErniyatAtmaBiH । santozamUlastyAgAtmA jYAnADizWAnamucyate ॥28॥

text: apavargagatirnityo yatidharmaḥ sanātanaḥ । sādhāraṇaḥ kevalo vā yathābalamupāsyate ॥29॥
html:
apavargagatirnityo yatidharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
sādhāraṇaḥ kevalo vā yathābalamupāsyate ॥29॥
slp1: apavargagatirnityo yatiDarmaH sanAtanaH । sADAraRaH kevalo vA yaTAbalamupAsyate ॥29॥

text: gacchato gacchataḥ kṣemaṃ durbalo'trāvasīdati । brahmaṇaḥ padamanvicchansaṃsārānmucyate śuciḥ ॥30॥
html:
gacchato gacchataḥ kṣemaṃ durbalo'trāvasīdati ।
brahmaṇaḥ padamanvicchansaṃsārānmucyate śuciḥ ॥30॥
slp1: gacCato gacCataH kzemaM durbalo'trAvasIdati । brahmaRaH padamanvicCansaMsArAnmucyate SuciH ॥30॥

text: ye bhuñjate ye dadate yajante'dhīyate ca ye । mātrābhirdharmalabdhābhirye vā tyāgaṃ samāśritāḥ ॥31॥
html:
ye bhuñjate ye dadate yajante'dhīyate ca ye ।
mātrābhirdharmalabdhābhirye vā tyāgaṃ samāśritāḥ ॥31॥
slp1: ye BuYjate ye dadate yajante'DIyate ca ye । mAtrABirDarmalabDABirye vA tyAgaM samASritAH ॥31॥
author: syūmaraśmiruvāca ।

text: eteṣāṃ pretyabhāve tu katamaḥ svargajittamaḥ । etadācakṣva me brahmanyathātathyena pṛcchataḥ ॥32॥
html:
eteṣāṃ pretyabhāve tu katamaḥ svargajittamaḥ ।
etadācakṣva me brahmanyathātathyena pṛcchataḥ ॥32॥
slp1: etezAM pretyaBAve tu katamaH svargajittamaH । etadAcakzva me brahmanyaTAtaTyena pfcCataH ॥32॥

text: parigrahāḥ śubhāḥ sarve guṇato'bhyudayāśca ye । na tu tyāgasukhaṃ prāptā etattvamapi paśyasi ॥33॥
html:
parigrahāḥ śubhāḥ sarve guṇato'bhyudayāśca ye ।
na tu tyāgasukhaṃ prāptā etattvamapi paśyasi ॥33॥
slp1: parigrahAH SuBAH sarve guRato'ByudayASca ye । na tu tyAgasuKaM prAptA etattvamapi paSyasi ॥33॥
author: kapila uvāca ।

text: bhavanto jñānaniṣṭhā vai gṛhasthāḥ karmaniścayāḥ । āśramāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ niṣṭhāyāmaikyamucyate ॥34॥
html:
bhavanto jñānaniṣṭhā vai gṛhasthāḥ karmaniścayāḥ ।
āśramāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ niṣṭhāyāmaikyamucyate ॥34॥
slp1: Bavanto jYAnanizWA vE gfhasTAH karmaniScayAH । ASramARAM ca sarvezAM nizWAyAmEkyamucyate ॥34॥
author: syūmaraśmiruvāca ।

text: ekatve ca pṛthaktve ca viśeṣo nānya ucyate । tadyathāvadyathānyāyaṃ bhagavānprabravītu me ॥35॥
html:
ekatve ca pṛthaktve ca viśeṣo nānya ucyate ।
tadyathāvadyathānyāyaṃ bhagavānprabravītu me ॥35॥
slp1: ekatve ca pfTaktve ca viSezo nAnya ucyate । tadyaTAvadyaTAnyAyaM BagavAnprabravItu me ॥35॥

text: śarīrapaktiḥ karmāṇi jñānaṃ tu paramā gatiḥ । pakve kaṣāye vamanai rasajñāne na tiṣṭhati ॥36॥
html:
śarīrapaktiḥ karmāṇi jñānaṃ tu paramā gatiḥ ।
pakve kaṣāye vamanai rasajñāne na tiṣṭhati ॥36॥
slp1: SarIrapaktiH karmARi jYAnaM tu paramA gatiH । pakve kazAye vamanE rasajYAne na tizWati ॥36॥
author: kapila uvāca ।

text: ānṛśaṃsyaṃ kṣamā śāntirahiṃsā satyamārjavam । adroho nābhimānaśca hrīstitikṣā śamastathā ॥37॥
html:
ānṛśaṃsyaṃ kṣamā śāntirahiṃsā satyamārjavam ।
adroho nābhimānaśca hrīstitikṣā śamastathā ॥37॥
slp1: AnfSaMsyaM kzamA SAntirahiMsA satyamArjavam । adroho nABimAnaSca hrIstitikzA SamastaTA ॥37॥

text: panthāno brahmaṇastvete etaiḥ prāpnoti yatparam । tadvidvānanubudhyeta manasā karmaniścayam ॥38॥
html:
panthāno brahmaṇastvete etaiḥ prāpnoti yatparam ।
tadvidvānanubudhyeta manasā karmaniścayam ॥38॥
slp1: panTAno brahmaRastvete etEH prApnoti yatparam । tadvidvAnanubuDyeta manasA karmaniScayam ॥38॥

text: yāṃ viprāḥ sarvataḥ śāntā viśuddhā jñānaniścayāḥ । gatiṃ gacchanti santuṣṭāstāmāhuḥ paramāṃ gatim ॥39॥
html:
yāṃ viprāḥ sarvataḥ śāntā viśuddhā jñānaniścayāḥ ।
gatiṃ gacchanti santuṣṭāstāmāhuḥ paramāṃ gatim ॥39॥
slp1: yAM viprAH sarvataH SAntA viSudDA jYAnaniScayAH । gatiM gacCanti santuzwAstAmAhuH paramAM gatim ॥39॥

text: vedāṃśca veditavyaṃ ca viditvā ca yathāsthiti । evaṃ vedavidityāhurato'nyo vātareṭakaḥ ॥40॥
html:
vedāṃśca veditavyaṃ ca viditvā ca yathāsthiti ।
evaṃ vedavidityāhurato'nyo vātareṭakaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: vedAMSca veditavyaM ca viditvA ca yaTAsTiti । evaM vedavidityAhurato'nyo vAtarewakaH ॥40॥

text: sarvaṃ vidurvedavido vede sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam । vede hi niṣṭhā sarvasya yadyadasti ca nāsti ca ॥41॥
html:
sarvaṃ vidurvedavido vede sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ।
vede hi niṣṭhā sarvasya yadyadasti ca nāsti ca ॥41॥
slp1: sarvaM vidurvedavido vede sarvaM pratizWitam । vede hi nizWA sarvasya yadyadasti ca nAsti ca ॥41॥

text: eṣaiva niṣṭhā sarvasya yadyadasti ca nāsti ca । etadantaṃ ca madhyaṃ ca saccāsacca vijānataḥ ॥42॥
html:
eṣaiva niṣṭhā sarvasya yadyadasti ca nāsti ca ।
etadantaṃ ca madhyaṃ ca saccāsacca vijānataḥ ॥42॥
slp1: ezEva nizWA sarvasya yadyadasti ca nAsti ca । etadantaM ca maDyaM ca saccAsacca vijAnataH ॥42॥

text: samastatyāga ityeva śama ityeva niṣṭhitaḥ । santoṣa ityatra śubhamapavarge pratiṣṭhitam ॥43॥
html:
samastatyāga ityeva śama ityeva niṣṭhitaḥ ।
santoṣa ityatra śubhamapavarge pratiṣṭhitam ॥43॥
slp1: samastatyAga ityeva Sama ityeva nizWitaH । santoza ityatra SuBamapavarge pratizWitam ॥43॥

text: ṛtaṃ satyaṃ viditaṃ veditavyaṃ sarvasyātmā jaṅgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ ca । sarvaṃ sukhaṃ yacchivamuttamaṃ ca brahmāvyaktaṃ prabhavaścāvyayaśca ॥44॥
html:
ṛtaṃ satyaṃ viditaṃ veditavyaṃ sarvasyātmā jaṅgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ ca ।
sarvaṃ sukhaṃ yacchivamuttamaṃ ca brahmāvyaktaṃ prabhavaścāvyayaśca ॥44॥
slp1: ftaM satyaM viditaM veditavyaM sarvasyAtmA jaNgamaM sTAvaraM ca । sarvaM suKaM yacCivamuttamaM ca brahmAvyaktaM praBavaScAvyayaSca ॥44॥

text: tejaḥ kṣamā śāntiranāmayaṃ śubhaṃ tathāvidhaṃ vyoma sanātanaṃ dhruvam । etaiḥ śabdairgamyate buddhinetraistasmai namo brahmaṇe brāhmaṇāya] ॥45॥
html:
tejaḥ kṣamā śāntiranāmayaṃ śubhaṃ tathāvidhaṃ vyoma sanātanaṃ dhruvam ।
etaiḥ śabdairgamyate buddhinetraistasmai namo brahmaṇe brāhmaṇāya] ॥45॥
slp1: tejaH kzamA SAntiranAmayaM SuBaM taTAviDaM vyoma sanAtanaM Druvam । etEH SabdErgamyate budDinetrEstasmE namo brahmaRe brAhmaRAya] ॥45॥

text: dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca vedāḥ śaṃsanti bhārata । kasya lābho viśiṣṭo'tra tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca vedāḥ śaṃsanti bhārata ।
kasya lābho viśiṣṭo'tra tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: DarmamarTaM ca kAmaM ca vedAH SaMsanti BArata । kasya lABo viSizwo'tra tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atra te vartayiṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam । kuṇḍadhāreṇa yatprītyā bhaktāyopakṛtaṃ purā ॥2॥
html:
atra te vartayiṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam ।
kuṇḍadhāreṇa yatprītyā bhaktāyopakṛtaṃ purā ॥2॥
slp1: atra te vartayizyAmi itihAsaM purAtanam । kuRqaDAreRa yatprItyA BaktAyopakftaM purA ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: adhano brāhmaṇaḥ kaścitkāmāddharmamavaikṣata । yajñārthaṃ sa tato'rthārthī tapo'tapyata dāruṇam ॥3॥
html:
adhano brāhmaṇaḥ kaścitkāmāddharmamavaikṣata ।
yajñārthaṃ sa tato'rthārthī tapo'tapyata dāruṇam ॥3॥
slp1: aDano brAhmaRaH kaScitkAmAdDarmamavEkzata । yajYArTaM sa tato'rTArTI tapo'tapyata dAruRam ॥3॥

text: sa niścayamatho kṛtvā pūjayāmāsa devatāḥ । bhaktyā na caivādhyagacchaddhanaṃ sampūjya devatāḥ ॥4॥
html:
sa niścayamatho kṛtvā pūjayāmāsa devatāḥ ।
bhaktyā na caivādhyagacchaddhanaṃ sampūjya devatāḥ ॥4॥
slp1: sa niScayamaTo kftvA pUjayAmAsa devatAH । BaktyA na cEvADyagacCadDanaM sampUjya devatAH ॥4॥

text: tataścintāṃ punaḥ prāptaḥ katamaddaivataṃ nu tat । yanme drutaṃ prasīdeta mānuṣairajaḍīkṛtam ॥5॥
html:
tataścintāṃ punaḥ prāptaḥ katamaddaivataṃ nu tat ।
yanme drutaṃ prasīdeta mānuṣairajaḍīkṛtam ॥5॥
slp1: tataScintAM punaH prAptaH katamaddEvataM nu tat । yanme drutaM prasIdeta mAnuzErajaqIkftam ॥5॥

text: atha saumyena vapuṣā devānucaramantike । pratyapaśyajjaladharaṃ kuṇḍadhāramavasthitam ॥6॥
html:
atha saumyena vapuṣā devānucaramantike ।
pratyapaśyajjaladharaṃ kuṇḍadhāramavasthitam ॥6॥
slp1: aTa sOmyena vapuzA devAnucaramantike । pratyapaSyajjalaDaraM kuRqaDAramavasTitam ॥6॥

text: dṛṣṭvaiva taṃ mahātmānaṃ tasya bhaktirajāyata । ayaṃ me dhāsyati śreyo vapuretaddhi tādṛśam ॥7॥
html:
dṛṣṭvaiva taṃ mahātmānaṃ tasya bhaktirajāyata ।
ayaṃ me dhāsyati śreyo vapuretaddhi tādṛśam ॥7॥
slp1: dfzwvEva taM mahAtmAnaM tasya BaktirajAyata । ayaM me DAsyati Sreyo vapuretadDi tAdfSam ॥7॥

text: sannikṛṣṭaśca devasya na cānyairmānuṣairvṛtaḥ । eṣa me dāsyati dhanaṃ prabhūtaṃ śīghrameva ca ॥8॥
html:
sannikṛṣṭaśca devasya na cānyairmānuṣairvṛtaḥ ।
eṣa me dāsyati dhanaṃ prabhūtaṃ śīghrameva ca ॥8॥
slp1: sannikfzwaSca devasya na cAnyErmAnuzErvftaH । eza me dAsyati DanaM praBUtaM SIGrameva ca ॥8॥

text: tato dhūpaiśca gandhaiśca mālyairuccāvacairapi । balibhirvividhaiścāpi pūjayāmāsa taṃ dvijaḥ ॥9॥
html:
tato dhūpaiśca gandhaiśca mālyairuccāvacairapi ।
balibhirvividhaiścāpi pūjayāmāsa taṃ dvijaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: tato DUpESca ganDESca mAlyEruccAvacErapi । baliBirviviDEScApi pUjayAmAsa taM dvijaH ॥9॥

text: tataḥ svalpena kālena tuṣṭo jaladharastadā । tasyopakāre niyatāmimāṃ vācamuvāca ha ॥10॥
html:
tataḥ svalpena kālena tuṣṭo jaladharastadā ।
tasyopakāre niyatāmimāṃ vācamuvāca ha ॥10॥
slp1: tataH svalpena kAlena tuzwo jalaDarastadA । tasyopakAre niyatAmimAM vAcamuvAca ha ॥10॥

text: brahmaghne ca surāpe ca core bhagnavrate tathā । niṣkṛtirvihitā sadbhiḥ kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ ॥11॥
html:
brahmaghne ca surāpe ca core bhagnavrate tathā ।
niṣkṛtirvihitā sadbhiḥ kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ ॥11॥
slp1: brahmaGne ca surApe ca core Bagnavrate taTA । nizkftirvihitA sadBiH kftaGne nAsti nizkftiH ॥11॥

text: āśāyāstanayo'dharmaḥ krodho'sūyāsutaḥ smṛtaḥ । putro lobho nikṛtyāstu kṛtaghno nārhati prajām ॥12॥
html:
āśāyāstanayo'dharmaḥ krodho'sūyāsutaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
putro lobho nikṛtyāstu kṛtaghno nārhati prajām ॥12॥
slp1: ASAyAstanayo'DarmaH kroDo'sUyAsutaH smftaH । putro loBo nikftyAstu kftaGno nArhati prajAm ॥12॥

text: tataḥ sa brāhmaṇaḥ svapne kuṇḍadhārasya tejasā । apaśyatsarvabhūtāni kuśeṣu śayitastadā ॥13॥
html:
tataḥ sa brāhmaṇaḥ svapne kuṇḍadhārasya tejasā ।
apaśyatsarvabhūtāni kuśeṣu śayitastadā ॥13॥
slp1: tataH sa brAhmaRaH svapne kuRqaDArasya tejasA । apaSyatsarvaBUtAni kuSezu SayitastadA ॥13॥

text: śamena tapasā caiva bhaktyā ca nirupaskṛtaḥ । śuddhātmā brāhmaṇo rātrau nidarśanamapaśyata ॥14॥
html:
śamena tapasā caiva bhaktyā ca nirupaskṛtaḥ ।
śuddhātmā brāhmaṇo rātrau nidarśanamapaśyata ॥14॥
slp1: Samena tapasA cEva BaktyA ca nirupaskftaH । SudDAtmA brAhmaRo rAtrO nidarSanamapaSyata ॥14॥

text: maṇibhadraṃ sa tatrasthaṃ devatānāṃ mahādyutim । apaśyata mahātmānaṃ vyādiśantaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥15॥
html:
maṇibhadraṃ sa tatrasthaṃ devatānāṃ mahādyutim ।
apaśyata mahātmānaṃ vyādiśantaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥15॥
slp1: maRiBadraM sa tatrasTaM devatAnAM mahAdyutim । apaSyata mahAtmAnaM vyAdiSantaM yuDizWira ॥15॥

text: tatra devāḥ prayacchanti rājyāni ca dhanāni ca । śubhaiḥ karmabhirārabdhāḥ pracchidantyaśubheṣu ca ॥16॥
html:
tatra devāḥ prayacchanti rājyāni ca dhanāni ca ।
śubhaiḥ karmabhirārabdhāḥ pracchidantyaśubheṣu ca ॥16॥
slp1: tatra devAH prayacCanti rAjyAni ca DanAni ca । SuBEH karmaBirArabDAH pracCidantyaSuBezu ca ॥16॥

text: paśyatāmatha yakṣāṇāṃ kuṇḍadhāro mahādyutiḥ । niṣpatya patito bhūmau devānāṃ bharatarṣabha ॥17॥
html:
paśyatāmatha yakṣāṇāṃ kuṇḍadhāro mahādyutiḥ ।
niṣpatya patito bhūmau devānāṃ bharatarṣabha ॥17॥
slp1: paSyatAmaTa yakzARAM kuRqaDAro mahAdyutiH । nizpatya patito BUmO devAnAM BaratarzaBa ॥17॥

text: tatastu devavacanānmaṇibhadro mahāyaśāḥ । uvāca patitaṃ bhūmau kuṇḍadhāra kimiṣyate ॥18॥
html:
tatastu devavacanānmaṇibhadro mahāyaśāḥ ।
uvāca patitaṃ bhūmau kuṇḍadhāra kimiṣyate ॥18॥
slp1: tatastu devavacanAnmaRiBadro mahAyaSAH । uvAca patitaM BUmO kuRqaDAra kimizyate ॥18॥

text: yadi prasannā devā me bhakto'yaṃ brāhmaṇo mama । asyānugrahamicchāmi kṛtaṃ kiñcitsukhodayam ॥19॥
html:
yadi prasannā devā me bhakto'yaṃ brāhmaṇo mama ।
asyānugrahamicchāmi kṛtaṃ kiñcitsukhodayam ॥19॥
slp1: yadi prasannA devA me Bakto'yaM brAhmaRo mama । asyAnugrahamicCAmi kftaM kiYcitsuKodayam ॥19॥
author: kuṇḍadhāra uvāca ।

text: tatastaṃ maṇibhadrastu punarvacanamabravīt । devānāmeva vacanātkuṇḍadhāraṃ mahādyutim ॥20॥
html:
tatastaṃ maṇibhadrastu punarvacanamabravīt ।
devānāmeva vacanātkuṇḍadhāraṃ mahādyutim ॥20॥
slp1: tatastaM maRiBadrastu punarvacanamabravIt । devAnAmeva vacanAtkuRqaDAraM mahAdyutim ॥20॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhadraṃ te kṛtakāryaḥ sukhī bhava । yāvaddhanaṃ prārthayate brāhmaṇo'yaṃ sakhā tava । devānāṃ śāsanāttāvadasaṅkhyeyaṃ dadāmyaham ॥21॥
html:
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhadraṃ te kṛtakāryaḥ sukhī bhava ।
yāvaddhanaṃ prārthayate brāhmaṇo'yaṃ sakhā tava ।
devānāṃ śāsanāttāvadasaṅkhyeyaṃ dadāmyaham ॥21॥
slp1: uttizWottizWa BadraM te kftakAryaH suKI Bava । yAvadDanaM prArTayate brAhmaRo'yaM saKA tava । devAnAM SAsanAttAvadasaNKyeyaM dadAmyaham ॥21॥

text: vicārya kuṇḍadhārastu mānuṣyaṃ calamadhruvam । tapase matimādhatta brāhmaṇasya yaśasvinaḥ ॥22॥
html:
vicārya kuṇḍadhārastu mānuṣyaṃ calamadhruvam ।
tapase matimādhatta brāhmaṇasya yaśasvinaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: vicArya kuRqaDArastu mAnuzyaM calamaDruvam । tapase matimADatta brAhmaRasya yaSasvinaH ॥22॥

text: nāhaṃ dhanāni yācāmi brāhmaṇāya dhanaprada । anyamevāhamicchāmi bhaktāyānugrahaṃ kṛtam ॥23॥
html:
nāhaṃ dhanāni yācāmi brāhmaṇāya dhanaprada ।
anyamevāhamicchāmi bhaktāyānugrahaṃ kṛtam ॥23॥
slp1: nAhaM DanAni yAcAmi brAhmaRAya Danaprada । anyamevAhamicCAmi BaktAyAnugrahaM kftam ॥23॥
author: kuṇḍadhāra uvāca ।

text: pṛthivīṃ ratnapūrṇāṃ vā mahadvā dhanasañcayam । bhaktāya nāhamicchāmi bhavedeṣa tu dhārmikaḥ ॥24॥
html:
pṛthivīṃ ratnapūrṇāṃ vā mahadvā dhanasañcayam ।
bhaktāya nāhamicchāmi bhavedeṣa tu dhārmikaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: pfTivIM ratnapUrRAM vA mahadvA DanasaYcayam । BaktAya nAhamicCAmi Bavedeza tu DArmikaH ॥24॥

text: dharme'sya ramatāṃ buddhirdharmaṃ caivopajīvatu । dharmapradhāno bhavatu mamaiṣo'nugraho mataḥ ॥25॥
html:
dharme'sya ramatāṃ buddhirdharmaṃ caivopajīvatu ।
dharmapradhāno bhavatu mamaiṣo'nugraho mataḥ ॥25॥
slp1: Darme'sya ramatAM budDirDarmaM cEvopajIvatu । DarmapraDAno Bavatu mamEzo'nugraho mataH ॥25॥

text: yadā dharmaphalaṃ rājyaṃ sukhāni vividhāni ca । phalānyevāyamaśnātu kāyakleśavivarjitaḥ ॥26॥
html:
yadā dharmaphalaṃ rājyaṃ sukhāni vividhāni ca ।
phalānyevāyamaśnātu kāyakleśavivarjitaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: yadA DarmaPalaM rAjyaM suKAni viviDAni ca । PalAnyevAyamaSnAtu kAyakleSavivarjitaH ॥26॥
author: maṇibhadra uvāca ।

text: tatastadeva bahuśaḥ kuṇḍadhāro mahāyaśāḥ । abhyāsamakaroddharme tatastuṣṭāsya devatāḥ ॥27॥
html:
tatastadeva bahuśaḥ kuṇḍadhāro mahāyaśāḥ ।
abhyāsamakaroddharme tatastuṣṭāsya devatāḥ ॥27॥
slp1: tatastadeva bahuSaH kuRqaDAro mahAyaSAH । aByAsamakarodDarme tatastuzwAsya devatAH ॥27॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: prītāste devatāḥ sarvā dvijasyāsya tathaiva ca । bhaviṣyatyeṣa dharmātmā dharme cādhāsyate matiḥ ॥28॥
html:
prītāste devatāḥ sarvā dvijasyāsya tathaiva ca ।
bhaviṣyatyeṣa dharmātmā dharme cādhāsyate matiḥ ॥28॥
slp1: prItAste devatAH sarvA dvijasyAsya taTEva ca । Bavizyatyeza DarmAtmA Darme cADAsyate matiH ॥28॥
author: maṇibhadra uvāca ।

text: tataḥ prīto jaladharaḥ kṛtakāryo yudhiṣṭhira । īpsitaṃ manaso labdhvā varamanyaiḥ sudurlabham ॥29॥
html:
tataḥ prīto jaladharaḥ kṛtakāryo yudhiṣṭhira ।
īpsitaṃ manaso labdhvā varamanyaiḥ sudurlabham ॥29॥
slp1: tataH prIto jalaDaraH kftakAryo yuDizWira । IpsitaM manaso labDvA varamanyEH sudurlaBam ॥29॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tato'paśyata cīrāṇi sūkṣmāṇi dvijasattamaḥ । pārśvato'bhyāgato nyastānyatha nirvedamāgataḥ ॥30॥
html:
tato'paśyata cīrāṇi sūkṣmāṇi dvijasattamaḥ ।
pārśvato'bhyāgato nyastānyatha nirvedamāgataḥ ॥30॥
slp1: tato'paSyata cIrARi sUkzmARi dvijasattamaH । pArSvato'ByAgato nyastAnyaTa nirvedamAgataH ॥30॥

text: ayaṃ na sukṛtaṃ vetti ko nvanyo vetsyate kṛtam । gacchāmi vanamevāhaṃ varaṃ dharmeṇa jīvitum ॥31॥
html:
ayaṃ na sukṛtaṃ vetti ko nvanyo vetsyate kṛtam ।
gacchāmi vanamevāhaṃ varaṃ dharmeṇa jīvitum ॥31॥
slp1: ayaM na sukftaM vetti ko nvanyo vetsyate kftam । gacCAmi vanamevAhaM varaM DarmeRa jIvitum ॥31॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: nirvedāddevatānāṃ ca prasādātsa dvijottamaḥ । vanaṃ praviśya sumahattapa ārabdhavāṃstadā ॥32॥
html:
nirvedāddevatānāṃ ca prasādātsa dvijottamaḥ ।
vanaṃ praviśya sumahattapa ārabdhavāṃstadā ॥32॥
slp1: nirvedAddevatAnAM ca prasAdAtsa dvijottamaH । vanaM praviSya sumahattapa ArabDavAMstadA ॥32॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: devatātithiśeṣeṇa phalamūlāśano dvijaḥ । dharme cāpi mahārāja ratirasyābhyajāyata ॥33॥
html:
devatātithiśeṣeṇa phalamūlāśano dvijaḥ ।
dharme cāpi mahārāja ratirasyābhyajāyata ॥33॥
slp1: devatAtiTiSezeRa PalamUlASano dvijaH । Darme cApi mahArAja ratirasyAByajAyata ॥33॥

text: tyaktvā mūlaphalaṃ sarvaṃ parṇāhāro'bhavaddvijaḥ । parṇaṃ tyaktvā jalāhārastadāsīddvijasattamaḥ ॥34॥
html:
tyaktvā mūlaphalaṃ sarvaṃ parṇāhāro'bhavaddvijaḥ ।
parṇaṃ tyaktvā jalāhārastadāsīddvijasattamaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: tyaktvA mUlaPalaM sarvaM parRAhAro'BavaddvijaH । parRaM tyaktvA jalAhArastadAsIddvijasattamaH ॥34॥

text: vāyubhakṣastataḥ paścādbahūnvarṣagaṇānabhūt । na cāsya kṣīyate prāṇastadadbhutamivābhavat ॥35॥
html:
vāyubhakṣastataḥ paścādbahūnvarṣagaṇānabhūt ।
na cāsya kṣīyate prāṇastadadbhutamivābhavat ॥35॥
slp1: vAyuBakzastataH paScAdbahUnvarzagaRAnaBUt । na cAsya kzIyate prARastadadButamivABavat ॥35॥

text: dharme ca śraddadhānasya tapasyugre ca vartataḥ । kālena mahatā tasya divyā dṛṣṭirajāyata ॥36॥
html:
dharme ca śraddadhānasya tapasyugre ca vartataḥ ।
kālena mahatā tasya divyā dṛṣṭirajāyata ॥36॥
slp1: Darme ca SraddaDAnasya tapasyugre ca vartataH । kAlena mahatA tasya divyA dfzwirajAyata ॥36॥

text: tasya buddhiḥ prādurāsīdyadi dadyāṃ mahaddhanam । tuṣṭaḥ kasmaicidevāhaṃ na mithyā vāgbhavenmama ॥37॥
html:
tasya buddhiḥ prādurāsīdyadi dadyāṃ mahaddhanam ।
tuṣṭaḥ kasmaicidevāhaṃ na mithyā vāgbhavenmama ॥37॥
slp1: tasya budDiH prAdurAsIdyadi dadyAM mahadDanam । tuzwaH kasmEcidevAhaM na miTyA vAgBavenmama ॥37॥

text: tataḥ prahṛṣṭavadano bhūya ārabdhavāṃstapaḥ । bhūyaścācintayatsiddho yatparaṃ so'bhyapadyata ॥38॥
html:
tataḥ prahṛṣṭavadano bhūya ārabdhavāṃstapaḥ ।
bhūyaścācintayatsiddho yatparaṃ so'bhyapadyata ॥38॥
slp1: tataH prahfzwavadano BUya ArabDavAMstapaH । BUyaScAcintayatsidDo yatparaM so'Byapadyata ॥38॥

text: yadi dadyāmahaṃ rājyaṃ tuṣṭo vai yasya kasyacit । sa bhavedacirādrājā na mithyā vāgbhavenmama ॥39॥
html:
yadi dadyāmahaṃ rājyaṃ tuṣṭo vai yasya kasyacit ।
sa bhavedacirādrājā na mithyā vāgbhavenmama ॥39॥
slp1: yadi dadyAmahaM rAjyaM tuzwo vE yasya kasyacit । sa BavedacirAdrAjA na miTyA vAgBavenmama ॥39॥

text: tasya sākṣātkuṇḍadhāro darśayāmāsa bhārata । brāhmaṇasya tapoyogātsauhṛdenābhicoditaḥ ॥40॥
html:
tasya sākṣātkuṇḍadhāro darśayāmāsa bhārata ।
brāhmaṇasya tapoyogātsauhṛdenābhicoditaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: tasya sAkzAtkuRqaDAro darSayAmAsa BArata । brAhmaRasya tapoyogAtsOhfdenABicoditaH ॥40॥

text: samāgamya sa tenātha pūjāṃ cakre yathāvidhi । brāhmaṇaḥ kuṇḍadhārasya vismitaścābhavannṛpa ॥41॥
html:
samāgamya sa tenātha pūjāṃ cakre yathāvidhi ।
brāhmaṇaḥ kuṇḍadhārasya vismitaścābhavannṛpa ॥41॥
slp1: samAgamya sa tenATa pUjAM cakre yaTAviDi । brAhmaRaH kuRqaDArasya vismitaScABavannfpa ॥41॥

text: tato'bravītkuṇḍadhāro divyaṃ te cakṣuruttamam । paśya rājñāṃ gatiṃ vipra lokāṃścāvekṣa cakṣuṣā ॥42॥
html:
tato'bravītkuṇḍadhāro divyaṃ te cakṣuruttamam ।
paśya rājñāṃ gatiṃ vipra lokāṃścāvekṣa cakṣuṣā ॥42॥
slp1: tato'bravItkuRqaDAro divyaM te cakzuruttamam । paSya rAjYAM gatiM vipra lokAMScAvekza cakzuzA ॥42॥

text: tato rājñāṃ sahasrāṇi magnāni niraye tadā । dūrādapaśyadvipraḥ sa divyayuktena cakṣuṣā ॥43॥
html:
tato rājñāṃ sahasrāṇi magnāni niraye tadā ।
dūrādapaśyadvipraḥ sa divyayuktena cakṣuṣā ॥43॥
slp1: tato rAjYAM sahasrARi magnAni niraye tadA । dUrAdapaSyadvipraH sa divyayuktena cakzuzA ॥43॥

text: māṃ pūjayitvā bhāvena yadi tvaṃ duḥkhamāpnuyāḥ । kṛtaṃ mayā bhavetkiṃ te kaśca te'nugraho bhavet ॥44॥
html:
māṃ pūjayitvā bhāvena yadi tvaṃ duḥkhamāpnuyāḥ ।
kṛtaṃ mayā bhavetkiṃ te kaśca te'nugraho bhavet ॥44॥
slp1: mAM pUjayitvA BAvena yadi tvaM duHKamApnuyAH । kftaM mayA BavetkiM te kaSca te'nugraho Bavet ॥44॥
author: kuṇḍadhāra uvāca ।

text: paśya paśya ca bhūyastvaṃ kāmānicchetkathaṃ naraḥ । svargadvāraṃ hi saṃruddhaṃ mānuṣeṣu viśeṣataḥ ॥45॥
html:
paśya paśya ca bhūyastvaṃ kāmānicchetkathaṃ naraḥ ।
svargadvāraṃ hi saṃruddhaṃ mānuṣeṣu viśeṣataḥ ॥45॥
slp1: paSya paSya ca BUyastvaM kAmAnicCetkaTaM naraH । svargadvAraM hi saMrudDaM mAnuzezu viSezataH ॥45॥

text: tato'paśyatsa kāmaṃ ca krodhaṃ lobhaṃ bhayaṃ madam । nidrāṃ tandrīṃ tathālasyamāvṛtya puruṣānsthitān ॥46॥
html:
tato'paśyatsa kāmaṃ ca krodhaṃ lobhaṃ bhayaṃ madam ।
nidrāṃ tandrīṃ tathālasyamāvṛtya puruṣānsthitān ॥46॥
slp1: tato'paSyatsa kAmaM ca kroDaM loBaM BayaM madam । nidrAM tandrIM taTAlasyamAvftya puruzAnsTitAn ॥46॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: etairlokāḥ susaṃruddhā devānāṃ mānuṣādbhayam । tathaiva devavacanādvighnaṃ kurvanti sarvaśaḥ ॥47॥
html:
etairlokāḥ susaṃruddhā devānāṃ mānuṣādbhayam ।
tathaiva devavacanādvighnaṃ kurvanti sarvaśaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: etErlokAH susaMrudDA devAnAM mAnuzAdBayam । taTEva devavacanAdviGnaM kurvanti sarvaSaH ॥47॥
author: kuṇḍadhāra uvāca ।

text: na devairananujñātaḥ kaścidbhavati dhārmikaḥ । eṣa śakto'si tapasā rājyaṃ dātuṃ dhanāni ca ॥48॥
html:
na devairananujñātaḥ kaścidbhavati dhārmikaḥ ।
eṣa śakto'si tapasā rājyaṃ dātuṃ dhanāni ca ॥48॥
slp1: na devErananujYAtaH kaScidBavati DArmikaH । eza Sakto'si tapasA rAjyaM dAtuM DanAni ca ॥48॥

text: tataḥ papāta śirasā brāhmaṇastoyadhāriṇe । uvāca cainaṃ dharmātmā mahānme'nugrahaḥ kṛtaḥ ॥49॥
html:
tataḥ papāta śirasā brāhmaṇastoyadhāriṇe ।
uvāca cainaṃ dharmātmā mahānme'nugrahaḥ kṛtaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: tataH papAta SirasA brAhmaRastoyaDAriRe । uvAca cEnaM DarmAtmA mahAnme'nugrahaH kftaH ॥49॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kāmalobhānubandhena purā te yadasūyitam । mayā snehamavijñāya tatra me kṣantumarhasi ॥50॥
html:
kāmalobhānubandhena purā te yadasūyitam ।
mayā snehamavijñāya tatra me kṣantumarhasi ॥50॥
slp1: kAmaloBAnubanDena purA te yadasUyitam । mayA snehamavijYAya tatra me kzantumarhasi ॥50॥

text: kṣāntameva mayetyuktvā kuṇḍadhāro dvijarṣabham । sampariṣvajya bāhubhyāṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata ॥51॥
html:
kṣāntameva mayetyuktvā kuṇḍadhāro dvijarṣabham ।
sampariṣvajya bāhubhyāṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata ॥51॥
slp1: kzAntameva mayetyuktvA kuRqaDAro dvijarzaBam । samparizvajya bAhuByAM tatrEvAntaraDIyata ॥51॥

text: tataḥ sarvānimāṁllokānbrāhmaṇo'nucacāra ha । kuṇḍadhāraprasādena tapasā yojitaḥ purā ॥52॥
html:
tataḥ sarvānimāṁllokānbrāhmaṇo'nucacāra ha ।
kuṇḍadhāraprasādena tapasā yojitaḥ purā ॥52॥
slp1: tataH sarvAnimAṁllokAnbrAhmaRo'nucacAra ha । kuRqaDAraprasAdena tapasA yojitaH purA ॥52॥

text: vihāyasā ca gamanaṃ tathā saṅkalpitārthatā । dharmācchaktyā tathā yogādyā caiva paramā gatiḥ ॥53॥
html:
vihāyasā ca gamanaṃ tathā saṅkalpitārthatā ।
dharmācchaktyā tathā yogādyā caiva paramā gatiḥ ॥53॥
slp1: vihAyasA ca gamanaM taTA saNkalpitArTatA । DarmAcCaktyA taTA yogAdyA cEva paramA gatiH ॥53॥

text: devatā brāhmaṇāḥ santo yakṣā mānuṣacāraṇāḥ । dhārmikānpūjayantīha na dhanāḍhyānna kāminaḥ ॥54॥
html:
devatā brāhmaṇāḥ santo yakṣā mānuṣacāraṇāḥ ।
dhārmikānpūjayantīha na dhanāḍhyānna kāminaḥ ॥54॥
slp1: devatA brAhmaRAH santo yakzA mAnuzacAraRAH । DArmikAnpUjayantIha na DanAQyAnna kAminaH ॥54॥

text: suprasannā hi te devā yatte dharme ratā matiḥ । dhane sukhakalā kāciddharme tu paramaṃ sukham] ॥55॥
html:
suprasannā hi te devā yatte dharme ratā matiḥ ।
dhane sukhakalā kāciddharme tu paramaṃ sukham] ॥55॥
slp1: suprasannA hi te devA yatte Darme ratA matiH । Dane suKakalA kAcidDarme tu paramaM suKam] ॥55॥

text: bahūnāṃ yajñatapasāmekārthānāṃ pitāmaha । dharmārthaṃ na sukhārthārthaṃ kathaṃ yajñaḥ samāhitaḥ ॥1॥
html:
bahūnāṃ yajñatapasāmekārthānāṃ pitāmaha ।
dharmārthaṃ na sukhārthārthaṃ kathaṃ yajñaḥ samāhitaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: bahUnAM yajYatapasAmekArTAnAM pitAmaha । DarmArTaM na suKArTArTaM kaTaM yajYaH samAhitaH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atra te vartayiṣyāmi nāradenānukīrtitam । uñchavṛtteḥ purāvṛttaṃ yajñārthe brāhmaṇasya ha ॥2॥
html:
atra te vartayiṣyāmi nāradenānukīrtitam ।
uñchavṛtteḥ purāvṛttaṃ yajñārthe brāhmaṇasya ha ॥2॥
slp1: atra te vartayizyAmi nAradenAnukIrtitam । uYCavftteH purAvfttaM yajYArTe brAhmaRasya ha ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: rāṣṭre dharmottare śreṣṭhe vidarbheṣvabhavaddvijaḥ । uñchavṛttirṛṣiḥ kaścidyajñe yajñaṃ samādadhe ॥3॥
html:
rāṣṭre dharmottare śreṣṭhe vidarbheṣvabhavaddvijaḥ ।
uñchavṛttirṛṣiḥ kaścidyajñe yajñaṃ samādadhe ॥3॥
slp1: rAzwre Darmottare SrezWe vidarBezvaBavaddvijaH । uYCavfttirfziH kaScidyajYe yajYaM samAdaDe ॥3॥

text: śyāmākamaśanaṃ tatra sūryapatnī suvarcalā । tiktaṃ ca virasaṃ śākaṃ tapasā svādutāṃ gatam ॥4॥
html:
śyāmākamaśanaṃ tatra sūryapatnī suvarcalā ।
tiktaṃ ca virasaṃ śākaṃ tapasā svādutāṃ gatam ॥4॥
slp1: SyAmAkamaSanaM tatra sUryapatnI suvarcalA । tiktaM ca virasaM SAkaM tapasA svAdutAM gatam ॥4॥

text: upagamya vane pṛthvīṃ sarvabhūtavihiṃsayā । api mūlaphalairijyo yajñaḥ svargyaḥ parantapa ॥5॥
html:
upagamya vane pṛthvīṃ sarvabhūtavihiṃsayā ।
api mūlaphalairijyo yajñaḥ svargyaḥ parantapa ॥5॥
slp1: upagamya vane pfTvIM sarvaBUtavihiMsayA । api mUlaPalErijyo yajYaH svargyaH parantapa ॥5॥

text: tasya bhāryā vratakṛśā śuciḥ puṣkaracāriṇī । yajñapatnītvamānītā satyenānuvidhīyate । sā tu śāpaparitrastā na svabhāvānuvartinī ॥6॥
html:
tasya bhāryā vratakṛśā śuciḥ puṣkaracāriṇī ।
yajñapatnītvamānītā satyenānuvidhīyate ।
sā tu śāpaparitrastā na svabhāvānuvartinī ॥6॥
slp1: tasya BAryA vratakfSA SuciH puzkaracAriRI । yajYapatnItvamAnItA satyenAnuviDIyate । sA tu SApaparitrastA na svaBAvAnuvartinI ॥6॥

text: mayūrajīrṇaparṇānāṃ vastraṃ tasyāśca parṇinām । akāmāyāḥ kṛtaṃ tatra yajñe hotrānumārgataḥ ॥7॥
html:
mayūrajīrṇaparṇānāṃ vastraṃ tasyāśca parṇinām ।
akāmāyāḥ kṛtaṃ tatra yajñe hotrānumārgataḥ ॥7॥
slp1: mayUrajIrRaparRAnAM vastraM tasyASca parRinAm । akAmAyAH kftaM tatra yajYe hotrAnumArgataH ॥7॥

text: śukrasya punarājātirapadhyānādadharmavit । tasminvane samīpastho mṛgo'bhūtsahacārikaḥ । vacobhirabravītsatyaṃ tvayā duṣkṛtakaṃ kṛtam ॥8॥
html:
śukrasya punarājātirapadhyānādadharmavit ।
tasminvane samīpastho mṛgo'bhūtsahacārikaḥ ।
vacobhirabravītsatyaṃ tvayā duṣkṛtakaṃ kṛtam ॥8॥
slp1: Sukrasya punarAjAtirapaDyAnAdaDarmavit । tasminvane samIpasTo mfgo'BUtsahacArikaH । vacoBirabravItsatyaM tvayA duzkftakaM kftam ॥8॥

text: yadi mantrāṅgahīno'yaṃ yajño bhavati vaikṛtaḥ । māṃ bhoḥ prakṣipa hotre tvaṃ gaccha svargamatandritaḥ ॥9॥
html:
yadi mantrāṅgahīno'yaṃ yajño bhavati vaikṛtaḥ ।
māṃ bhoḥ prakṣipa hotre tvaṃ gaccha svargamatandritaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: yadi mantrANgahIno'yaM yajYo Bavati vEkftaH । mAM BoH prakzipa hotre tvaM gacCa svargamatandritaH ॥9॥

text: tatastu yajñe sāvitrī sākṣāttaṃ saṃnyamantrayat । nimantrayantī pratyuktā na hanyāṃ sahavāsinam ॥10॥
html:
tatastu yajñe sāvitrī sākṣāttaṃ saṃnyamantrayat ।
nimantrayantī pratyuktā na hanyāṃ sahavāsinam ॥10॥
slp1: tatastu yajYe sAvitrI sAkzAttaM saMnyamantrayat । nimantrayantI pratyuktA na hanyAM sahavAsinam ॥10॥

text: evamuktā nivṛttā sā praviṣṭā yajñapāvakam । kiṃ nu duścaritaṃ yajñe didṛkṣuḥ sā rasātalam ॥11॥
html:
evamuktā nivṛttā sā praviṣṭā yajñapāvakam ।
kiṃ nu duścaritaṃ yajñe didṛkṣuḥ sā rasātalam ॥11॥
slp1: evamuktA nivfttA sA pravizwA yajYapAvakam । kiM nu duScaritaM yajYe didfkzuH sA rasAtalam ॥11॥

text: sā tu baddhāñjaliṃ satyamayācaddhariṇaṃ punaḥ । satyena saṃpariṣvajya sandiṣṭo gamyatāmiti ॥12॥
html:
sā tu baddhāñjaliṃ satyamayācaddhariṇaṃ punaḥ ।
satyena saṃpariṣvajya sandiṣṭo gamyatāmiti ॥12॥
slp1: sA tu badDAYjaliM satyamayAcadDariRaM punaH । satyena saMparizvajya sandizwo gamyatAmiti ॥12॥

text: tataḥ sa hariṇo gatvā padānyaṣṭau nyavartata । sādhu hiṃsaya māṃ satya hato yāsyāmi sadgatim ॥13॥
html:
tataḥ sa hariṇo gatvā padānyaṣṭau nyavartata ।
sādhu hiṃsaya māṃ satya hato yāsyāmi sadgatim ॥13॥
slp1: tataH sa hariRo gatvA padAnyazwO nyavartata । sADu hiMsaya mAM satya hato yAsyAmi sadgatim ॥13॥

text: paśya hyapsaraso divyā mayā dattena cakṣuṣā । vimānāni vicitrāṇi gandharvāṇāṃ mahātmanām ॥14॥
html:
paśya hyapsaraso divyā mayā dattena cakṣuṣā ।
vimānāni vicitrāṇi gandharvāṇāṃ mahātmanām ॥14॥
slp1: paSya hyapsaraso divyA mayA dattena cakzuzA । vimAnAni vicitrARi ganDarvARAM mahAtmanAm ॥14॥

text: tataḥ suruciraṃ dṛṣṭvā spṛhālagnena cakṣuṣā । mṛgamālokya hiṃsāyāṃ svargavāsaṃ samarthayat ॥15॥
html:
tataḥ suruciraṃ dṛṣṭvā spṛhālagnena cakṣuṣā ।
mṛgamālokya hiṃsāyāṃ svargavāsaṃ samarthayat ॥15॥
slp1: tataH suruciraM dfzwvA spfhAlagnena cakzuzA । mfgamAlokya hiMsAyAM svargavAsaM samarTayat ॥15॥

text: sa tu dharmo mṛgo bhūtvā bahuvarṣoṣito vane । tasya niṣkṛtimādhatta na hyasau yajñasaṃvidhiḥ ॥16॥
html:
sa tu dharmo mṛgo bhūtvā bahuvarṣoṣito vane ।
tasya niṣkṛtimādhatta na hyasau yajñasaṃvidhiḥ ॥16॥
slp1: sa tu Darmo mfgo BUtvA bahuvarzozito vane । tasya nizkftimADatta na hyasO yajYasaMviDiH ॥16॥

text: tasya tena tu bhāvena mṛgahiṃsātmanastadā । tapo mahatsamucchinnaṃ tasmāddhiṃsā na yajñiyā ॥17॥
html:
tasya tena tu bhāvena mṛgahiṃsātmanastadā ।
tapo mahatsamucchinnaṃ tasmāddhiṃsā na yajñiyā ॥17॥
slp1: tasya tena tu BAvena mfgahiMsAtmanastadA । tapo mahatsamucCinnaM tasmAdDiMsA na yajYiyA ॥17॥

text: tatastaṃ bhagavāndharmo yajñaṃ yājayata svayam । samādhānaṃ ca bhāryāyā lebhe sa tapasā param ॥18॥
html:
tatastaṃ bhagavāndharmo yajñaṃ yājayata svayam ।
samādhānaṃ ca bhāryāyā lebhe sa tapasā param ॥18॥
slp1: tatastaM BagavAnDarmo yajYaM yAjayata svayam । samADAnaM ca BAryAyA leBe sa tapasA param ॥18॥

text: ahiṃsā sakalo dharmo hiṃsā yajñe'samāhitā । satyaṃ te'haṃ pravakṣyāmi yo dharmaḥ satyavādinām] ॥19॥
html:
ahiṃsā sakalo dharmo hiṃsā yajñe'samāhitā ।
satyaṃ te'haṃ pravakṣyāmi yo dharmaḥ satyavādinām] ॥19॥
slp1: ahiMsA sakalo Darmo hiMsA yajYe'samAhitA । satyaM te'haM pravakzyAmi yo DarmaH satyavAdinAm] ॥19॥

text: kathaṃ bhavati pāpātmā kathaṃ dharmaṃ karoti vā । kena nirvedamādatte mokṣaṃ vā kena gacchati ॥1॥
html:
kathaṃ bhavati pāpātmā kathaṃ dharmaṃ karoti vā ।
kena nirvedamādatte mokṣaṃ vā kena gacchati ॥1॥
slp1: kaTaM Bavati pApAtmA kaTaM DarmaM karoti vA । kena nirvedamAdatte mokzaM vA kena gacCati ॥1॥

text: viditāḥ sarvadharmāste sthityarthamanupṛcchasi । śṛṇu mokṣaṃ sanirvedaṃ pāpaṃ dharmaṃ ca mūlataḥ ॥2॥
html:
viditāḥ sarvadharmāste sthityarthamanupṛcchasi ।
śṛṇu mokṣaṃ sanirvedaṃ pāpaṃ dharmaṃ ca mūlataḥ ॥2॥
slp1: viditAH sarvaDarmAste sTityarTamanupfcCasi । SfRu mokzaM sanirvedaM pApaM DarmaM ca mUlataH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: vijñānārthaṃ hi pañcānāmicchā pūrvaṃ pravartate । prāpya tāñjāyate kāmo dveṣo vā bharatarṣabha ॥3॥
html:
vijñānārthaṃ hi pañcānāmicchā pūrvaṃ pravartate ।
prāpya tāñjāyate kāmo dveṣo vā bharatarṣabha ॥3॥
slp1: vijYAnArTaM hi paYcAnAmicCA pUrvaM pravartate । prApya tAYjAyate kAmo dvezo vA BaratarzaBa ॥3॥

text: tatastadarthaṃ yatate karma cārabhate punaḥ । iṣṭānāṃ rūpagandhānāmabhyāsaṃ ca cikīrṣati ॥4॥
html:
tatastadarthaṃ yatate karma cārabhate punaḥ ।
iṣṭānāṃ rūpagandhānāmabhyāsaṃ ca cikīrṣati ॥4॥
slp1: tatastadarTaM yatate karma cAraBate punaH । izwAnAM rUpaganDAnAmaByAsaM ca cikIrzati ॥4॥

text: tato rāgaḥ prabhavati dveṣaśca tadanantaram । tato lobhaḥ prabhavati mohaśca tadanantaram ॥5॥
html:
tato rāgaḥ prabhavati dveṣaśca tadanantaram ।
tato lobhaḥ prabhavati mohaśca tadanantaram ॥5॥
slp1: tato rAgaH praBavati dvezaSca tadanantaram । tato loBaH praBavati mohaSca tadanantaram ॥5॥

text: lobhamohābhibhūtasya rāgadveṣānvitasya ca । na dharme jāyate buddhirvyājāddharmaṃ karoti ca ॥6॥
html:
lobhamohābhibhūtasya rāgadveṣānvitasya ca ।
na dharme jāyate buddhirvyājāddharmaṃ karoti ca ॥6॥
slp1: loBamohABiBUtasya rAgadvezAnvitasya ca । na Darme jAyate budDirvyAjAdDarmaM karoti ca ॥6॥

text: vyājena carato dharmamarthavyājo'pi rocate । vyājena sidhyamāneṣu dhaneṣu kurunandana ॥7॥
html:
vyājena carato dharmamarthavyājo'pi rocate ।
vyājena sidhyamāneṣu dhaneṣu kurunandana ॥7॥
slp1: vyAjena carato DarmamarTavyAjo'pi rocate । vyAjena siDyamAnezu Danezu kurunandana ॥7॥

text: tatraiva kurute buddhiṃ tataḥ pāpaṃ cikīrṣati । suhṛdbhirvāryamāṇo'pi paṇḍitaiścāpi bhārata ॥8॥
html:
tatraiva kurute buddhiṃ tataḥ pāpaṃ cikīrṣati ।
suhṛdbhirvāryamāṇo'pi paṇḍitaiścāpi bhārata ॥8॥
slp1: tatrEva kurute budDiM tataH pApaM cikIrzati । suhfdBirvAryamARo'pi paRqitEScApi BArata ॥8॥

text: uttaraṃ nyāyasambaddhaṃ bravīti vidhiyojitam । adharmastrividhastasya vardhate rāgamohajaḥ ॥9॥
html:
uttaraṃ nyāyasambaddhaṃ bravīti vidhiyojitam ।
adharmastrividhastasya vardhate rāgamohajaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: uttaraM nyAyasambadDaM bravIti viDiyojitam । aDarmastriviDastasya varDate rAgamohajaH ॥9॥

text: pāpaṃ cintayate caiva prabravīti karoti ca । tasyādharmapravṛttasya doṣānpaśyanti sādhavaḥ ॥10॥
html:
pāpaṃ cintayate caiva prabravīti karoti ca ।
tasyādharmapravṛttasya doṣānpaśyanti sādhavaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: pApaM cintayate cEva prabravIti karoti ca । tasyADarmapravfttasya dozAnpaSyanti sADavaH ॥10॥

text: ekaśīlāśca mitratvaṃ bhajante pāpakarmiṇaḥ । sa neha sukhamāpnoti kuta eva paratra vai ॥11॥
html:
ekaśīlāśca mitratvaṃ bhajante pāpakarmiṇaḥ ।
sa neha sukhamāpnoti kuta eva paratra vai ॥11॥
slp1: ekaSIlASca mitratvaM Bajante pApakarmiRaH । sa neha suKamApnoti kuta eva paratra vE ॥11॥

text: evaṃ bhavati pāpātmā dharmātmānaṃ tu me śṛṇu । yathā kuśaladharmā sa kuśalaṃ pratipadyate ॥12॥
html:
evaṃ bhavati pāpātmā dharmātmānaṃ tu me śṛṇu ।
yathā kuśaladharmā sa kuśalaṃ pratipadyate ॥12॥
slp1: evaM Bavati pApAtmA DarmAtmAnaM tu me SfRu । yaTA kuSalaDarmA sa kuSalaM pratipadyate ॥12॥

text: ya etānprajñayā doṣānpūrvamevānupaśyati । kuśalaḥ sukhaduḥkhānāṃ sādhūṃścāpyupasevate ॥13॥
html:
ya etānprajñayā doṣānpūrvamevānupaśyati ।
kuśalaḥ sukhaduḥkhānāṃ sādhūṃścāpyupasevate ॥13॥
slp1: ya etAnprajYayA dozAnpUrvamevAnupaSyati । kuSalaH suKaduHKAnAM sADUMScApyupasevate ॥13॥

text: tasya sādhusamācārādabhyāsāccaiva vardhate । prajñā dharme ca ramate dharmaṃ caivopajīvati ॥14॥
html:
tasya sādhusamācārādabhyāsāccaiva vardhate ।
prajñā dharme ca ramate dharmaṃ caivopajīvati ॥14॥
slp1: tasya sADusamAcArAdaByAsAccEva varDate । prajYA Darme ca ramate DarmaM cEvopajIvati ॥14॥

text: so'tha dharmādavāpteṣu dhaneṣu kurute manaḥ । tasyaiva siñcate mūlaṃ guṇānpaśyati yatra vai ॥15॥
html:
so'tha dharmādavāpteṣu dhaneṣu kurute manaḥ ।
tasyaiva siñcate mūlaṃ guṇānpaśyati yatra vai ॥15॥
slp1: so'Ta DarmAdavAptezu Danezu kurute manaH । tasyEva siYcate mUlaM guRAnpaSyati yatra vE ॥15॥

text: dharmātmā bhavati hyevaṃ mitraṃ ca labhate śubham । sa mitradhanalābhāttu pretya ceha ca nandati ॥16॥
html:
dharmātmā bhavati hyevaṃ mitraṃ ca labhate śubham ।
sa mitradhanalābhāttu pretya ceha ca nandati ॥16॥
slp1: DarmAtmA Bavati hyevaM mitraM ca laBate SuBam । sa mitraDanalABAttu pretya ceha ca nandati ॥16॥

text: śabde sparśe tathā rūpe rase gandhe ca bhārata । prabhutvaṃ labhate janturdharmasyaitatphalaṃ viduḥ ॥17॥
html:
śabde sparśe tathā rūpe rase gandhe ca bhārata ।
prabhutvaṃ labhate janturdharmasyaitatphalaṃ viduḥ ॥17॥
slp1: Sabde sparSe taTA rUpe rase ganDe ca BArata । praButvaM laBate janturDarmasyEtatPalaM viduH ॥17॥

text: sa dharmasya phalaṃ labdhvā na tṛpyati yudhiṣṭhira । atṛpyamāṇo nirvedamādatte jñānacakṣuṣā ॥18॥
html:
sa dharmasya phalaṃ labdhvā na tṛpyati yudhiṣṭhira ।
atṛpyamāṇo nirvedamādatte jñānacakṣuṣā ॥18॥
slp1: sa Darmasya PalaM labDvA na tfpyati yuDizWira । atfpyamARo nirvedamAdatte jYAnacakzuzA ॥18॥

text: prajñācakṣuryadā kāme doṣamevānupaśyati । virajyate tadā kāmānna ca dharmaṃ vimuñcati ॥19॥
html:
prajñācakṣuryadā kāme doṣamevānupaśyati ।
virajyate tadā kāmānna ca dharmaṃ vimuñcati ॥19॥
slp1: prajYAcakzuryadA kAme dozamevAnupaSyati । virajyate tadA kAmAnna ca DarmaM vimuYcati ॥19॥

text: sarvatyāge ca yatate dṛṣṭvā lokaṃ kṣayātmakam । tato mokṣāya yatate nānupāyādupāyataḥ ॥20॥
html:
sarvatyāge ca yatate dṛṣṭvā lokaṃ kṣayātmakam ।
tato mokṣāya yatate nānupāyādupāyataḥ ॥20॥
slp1: sarvatyAge ca yatate dfzwvA lokaM kzayAtmakam । tato mokzAya yatate nAnupAyAdupAyataH ॥20॥

text: śanairnirvedamādatte pāpaṃ karma jahāti ca । dharmātmā caiva bhavati mokṣaṃ ca labhate param ॥21॥
html:
śanairnirvedamādatte pāpaṃ karma jahāti ca ।
dharmātmā caiva bhavati mokṣaṃ ca labhate param ॥21॥
slp1: SanErnirvedamAdatte pApaM karma jahAti ca । DarmAtmA cEva Bavati mokzaM ca laBate param ॥21॥

text: etatte kathitaṃ tāta yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi । pāpaṃ dharmaṃ tathā mokṣaṃ nirvedaṃ caiva bhārata ॥22॥
html:
etatte kathitaṃ tāta yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ।
pāpaṃ dharmaṃ tathā mokṣaṃ nirvedaṃ caiva bhārata ॥22॥
slp1: etatte kaTitaM tAta yanmAM tvaM paripfcCasi । pApaM DarmaM taTA mokzaM nirvedaM cEva BArata ॥22॥

text: tasmāddharme pravartethāḥ sarvāvasthaṃ yudhiṣṭhira । dharme sthitānāṃ kaunteya siddhirbhavati śāśvatī] ॥23॥
html:
tasmāddharme pravartethāḥ sarvāvasthaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
dharme sthitānāṃ kaunteya siddhirbhavati śāśvatī] ॥23॥
slp1: tasmAdDarme pravarteTAH sarvAvasTaM yuDizWira । Darme sTitAnAM kOnteya sidDirBavati SASvatI] ॥23॥

text: mokṣaḥ pitāmahenokta upāyānnānupāyataḥ । tamupāyaṃ yathānyāyaṃ śrotumicchāmi bhārata ॥1॥
html:
mokṣaḥ pitāmahenokta upāyānnānupāyataḥ ।
tamupāyaṃ yathānyāyaṃ śrotumicchāmi bhārata ॥1॥
slp1: mokzaH pitAmahenokta upAyAnnAnupAyataH । tamupAyaM yaTAnyAyaM SrotumicCAmi BArata ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: tvayyevaitanmahāprājña yuktaṃ nipuṇadarśanam । yadupāyena sarvārthānnityaṃ mṛgayase'nagha ॥2॥
html:
tvayyevaitanmahāprājña yuktaṃ nipuṇadarśanam ।
yadupāyena sarvārthānnityaṃ mṛgayase'nagha ॥2॥
slp1: tvayyevEtanmahAprAjYa yuktaM nipuRadarSanam । yadupAyena sarvArTAnnityaM mfgayase'naGa ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: karaṇe ghaṭasya yā buddhirghaṭotpattau na sānagha । evaṃ dharmābhyupāyeṣu nānyaddharmeṣu kāraṇam ॥3॥
html:
karaṇe ghaṭasya yā buddhirghaṭotpattau na sānagha ।
evaṃ dharmābhyupāyeṣu nānyaddharmeṣu kāraṇam ॥3॥
slp1: karaRe Gawasya yA budDirGawotpattO na sAnaGa । evaM DarmAByupAyezu nAnyadDarmezu kAraRam ॥3॥

text: pūrve samudre yaḥ panthā na sa gacchati paścimam । ekaḥ panthā hi mokṣasya tanme vistarataḥ śṛṇu ॥4॥
html:
pūrve samudre yaḥ panthā na sa gacchati paścimam ।
ekaḥ panthā hi mokṣasya tanme vistarataḥ śṛṇu ॥4॥
slp1: pUrve samudre yaH panTA na sa gacCati paScimam । ekaH panTA hi mokzasya tanme vistarataH SfRu ॥4॥

text: kṣamayā krodhamucchindyātkāmaṃ saṅkalpavarjanāt । sattvasaṃsevanāddhīro nidrāmucchetumarhati ॥5॥
html:
kṣamayā krodhamucchindyātkāmaṃ saṅkalpavarjanāt ।
sattvasaṃsevanāddhīro nidrāmucchetumarhati ॥5॥
slp1: kzamayA kroDamucCindyAtkAmaM saNkalpavarjanAt । sattvasaMsevanAdDIro nidrAmucCetumarhati ॥5॥

text: apramādādbhayaṃ rakṣecchvāsaṃ kṣetrajñaśīlanāt । icchāṃ dveṣaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca dhairyeṇa vinivartayet ॥6॥
html:
apramādādbhayaṃ rakṣecchvāsaṃ kṣetrajñaśīlanāt ।
icchāṃ dveṣaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca dhairyeṇa vinivartayet ॥6॥
slp1: apramAdAdBayaM rakzecCvAsaM kzetrajYaSIlanAt । icCAM dvezaM ca kAmaM ca DEryeRa vinivartayet ॥6॥

text: bhramaṃ pramohamāvartamabhyāsādvinivartayet । nidrāṃ ca pratibhāṃ caiva jñānābhyāsena tattvavit ॥7॥
html:
bhramaṃ pramohamāvartamabhyāsādvinivartayet ।
nidrāṃ ca pratibhāṃ caiva jñānābhyāsena tattvavit ॥7॥
slp1: BramaM pramohamAvartamaByAsAdvinivartayet । nidrAM ca pratiBAM cEva jYAnAByAsena tattvavit ॥7॥

text: upadravāṃstathā rogānhitajīrṇamitāśanāt । lobhaṃ mohaṃ ca santoṣādviṣayāṃstattvadarśanāt ॥8॥
html:
upadravāṃstathā rogānhitajīrṇamitāśanāt ।
lobhaṃ mohaṃ ca santoṣādviṣayāṃstattvadarśanāt ॥8॥
slp1: upadravAMstaTA rogAnhitajIrRamitASanAt । loBaM mohaM ca santozAdvizayAMstattvadarSanAt ॥8॥

text: anukrośādadharmaṃ ca jayeddharmamupekṣayā । āyatyā ca jayedāśāmarthaṃ saṅgavivarjanāt ॥9॥
html:
anukrośādadharmaṃ ca jayeddharmamupekṣayā ।
āyatyā ca jayedāśāmarthaṃ saṅgavivarjanāt ॥9॥
slp1: anukroSAdaDarmaM ca jayedDarmamupekzayA । AyatyA ca jayedASAmarTaM saNgavivarjanAt ॥9॥

text: anityatvena ca snehaṃ kṣudhaṃ yogena paṇḍitaḥ । kāruṇyenātmano mānaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ ca paritoṣataḥ ॥10॥
html:
anityatvena ca snehaṃ kṣudhaṃ yogena paṇḍitaḥ ।
kāruṇyenātmano mānaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ ca paritoṣataḥ ॥10॥
slp1: anityatvena ca snehaM kzuDaM yogena paRqitaH । kAruRyenAtmano mAnaM tfzRAM ca paritozataH ॥10॥

text: utthānena jayettandrīṃ vitarkaṃ niścayājjayet । maunena bahubhāṣyaṃ ca śauryeṇa ca bhayaṃ jayet ॥11॥
html:
utthānena jayettandrīṃ vitarkaṃ niścayājjayet ।
maunena bahubhāṣyaṃ ca śauryeṇa ca bhayaṃ jayet ॥11॥
slp1: utTAnena jayettandrIM vitarkaM niScayAjjayet । mOnena bahuBAzyaM ca SOryeRa ca BayaM jayet ॥11॥

text: yacchedvāṅmanasī buddhyā tāṃ yacchejjñānacakṣuṣā । jñānamātmā mahānyacchettaṃ yacchecchāntirātmanaḥ ॥12॥
html:
yacchedvāṅmanasī buddhyā tāṃ yacchejjñānacakṣuṣā ।
jñānamātmā mahānyacchettaṃ yacchecchāntirātmanaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: yacCedvANmanasI budDyA tAM yacCejjYAnacakzuzA । jYAnamAtmA mahAnyacCettaM yacCecCAntirAtmanaH ॥12॥

text: tadetadupaśāntena boddhavyaṃ śucikarmaṇā । yogadoṣānsamucchidya pañca yānkavayo viduḥ ॥13॥
html:
tadetadupaśāntena boddhavyaṃ śucikarmaṇā ।
yogadoṣānsamucchidya pañca yānkavayo viduḥ ॥13॥
slp1: tadetadupaSAntena bodDavyaM SucikarmaRA । yogadozAnsamucCidya paYca yAnkavayo viduH ॥13॥

text: kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca bhayaṃ svapnaṃ ca pañcamam । parityajya niṣeveta tathemānyogasādhanān ॥14॥
html:
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca bhayaṃ svapnaṃ ca pañcamam ।
parityajya niṣeveta tathemānyogasādhanān ॥14॥
slp1: kAmaM kroDaM ca loBaM ca BayaM svapnaM ca paYcamam । parityajya nizeveta taTemAnyogasADanAn ॥14॥

text: dhyānamadhyayanaṃ dānaṃ satyaṃ hrīrārjavaṃ kṣamā । śaucamāhārataḥ śuddhirindriyāṇāṃ ca saṃyamaḥ ॥15॥
html:
dhyānamadhyayanaṃ dānaṃ satyaṃ hrīrārjavaṃ kṣamā ।
śaucamāhārataḥ śuddhirindriyāṇāṃ ca saṃyamaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: DyAnamaDyayanaM dAnaM satyaM hrIrArjavaM kzamA । SOcamAhArataH SudDirindriyARAM ca saMyamaH ॥15॥

text: etairvivardhate tejaḥ pāpmānamapahanti ca । sidhyanti cāsya saṅkalpā vijñānaṃ ca pravartate ॥16॥
html:
etairvivardhate tejaḥ pāpmānamapahanti ca ।
sidhyanti cāsya saṅkalpā vijñānaṃ ca pravartate ॥16॥
slp1: etErvivarDate tejaH pApmAnamapahanti ca । siDyanti cAsya saNkalpA vijYAnaM ca pravartate ॥16॥

text: dhūtapāpaḥ sa tejasvī laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ । kāmakrodhau vaśe kṛtvā ninīṣedbrahmaṇaḥ padam ॥17॥
html:
dhūtapāpaḥ sa tejasvī laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ ।
kāmakrodhau vaśe kṛtvā ninīṣedbrahmaṇaḥ padam ॥17॥
slp1: DUtapApaH sa tejasvI laGvAhAro jitendriyaH । kAmakroDO vaSe kftvA ninIzedbrahmaRaH padam ॥17॥

text: amūḍhatvamasaṅgitvaṃ kāmakrodhavivarjanam । adainyamanudīrṇatvamanudvego vyavasthitiḥ ॥18॥
html:
amūḍhatvamasaṅgitvaṃ kāmakrodhavivarjanam ।
adainyamanudīrṇatvamanudvego vyavasthitiḥ ॥18॥
slp1: amUQatvamasaNgitvaM kAmakroDavivarjanam । adEnyamanudIrRatvamanudvego vyavasTitiH ॥18॥

text: eṣa mārgo hi mokṣasya prasanno vimalaḥ śuciḥ । tathā vākkāyamanasāṃ niyamaḥ kāmato'nyathā] ॥19॥
html:
eṣa mārgo hi mokṣasya prasanno vimalaḥ śuciḥ ।
tathā vākkāyamanasāṃ niyamaḥ kāmato'nyathā] ॥19॥
slp1: eza mArgo hi mokzasya prasanno vimalaH SuciH । taTA vAkkAyamanasAM niyamaH kAmato'nyaTA] ॥19॥

text: atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । nāradasya ca saṃvādaṃ devalasyāsitasya ca ॥1॥
html:
atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
nāradasya ca saṃvādaṃ devalasyāsitasya ca ॥1॥
slp1: atrEvodAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । nAradasya ca saMvAdaM devalasyAsitasya ca ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: āsīnaṃ devalaṃ vṛddhaṃ buddhvā buddhimatāṃ varaḥ । nāradaḥ paripapraccha bhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayam ॥2॥
html:
āsīnaṃ devalaṃ vṛddhaṃ buddhvā buddhimatāṃ varaḥ ।
nāradaḥ paripapraccha bhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayam ॥2॥
slp1: AsInaM devalaM vfdDaM budDvA budDimatAM varaH । nAradaH paripapracCa BUtAnAM praBavApyayam ॥2॥

text: kutaḥ sṛṣṭamidaṃ viśvaṃ brahmansthāvarajaṅgamam । pralaye ca kamabhyeti tadbhavānprabravītu me ॥3॥
html:
kutaḥ sṛṣṭamidaṃ viśvaṃ brahmansthāvarajaṅgamam ।
pralaye ca kamabhyeti tadbhavānprabravītu me ॥3॥
slp1: kutaH sfzwamidaM viSvaM brahmansTAvarajaNgamam । pralaye ca kamaByeti tadBavAnprabravItu me ॥3॥

text: yebhyaḥ sṛjati bhūtāni kālo bhāvapracoditaḥ । mahābhūtāni pañceti tānyāhurbhūtacintakāḥ ॥4॥
html:
yebhyaḥ sṛjati bhūtāni kālo bhāvapracoditaḥ ।
mahābhūtāni pañceti tānyāhurbhūtacintakāḥ ॥4॥
slp1: yeByaH sfjati BUtAni kAlo BAvapracoditaH । mahABUtAni paYceti tAnyAhurBUtacintakAH ॥4॥
author: asita uvāca ।

text: tebhyaḥ sṛjati bhūtāni kāla ātmapracoditaḥ । etebhyo yaḥ paraṃ brūyādasadbrūyādasaṃśayam ॥5॥
html:
tebhyaḥ sṛjati bhūtāni kāla ātmapracoditaḥ ।
etebhyo yaḥ paraṃ brūyādasadbrūyādasaṃśayam ॥5॥
slp1: teByaH sfjati BUtAni kAla AtmapracoditaH । eteByo yaH paraM brUyAdasadbrUyAdasaMSayam ॥5॥

text: viddhi nārada pañcaitāñśāśvatānacalāndhruvān । mahatastejaso rāśīnkālaṣaṣṭhānsvabhāvataḥ ॥6॥
html:
viddhi nārada pañcaitāñśāśvatānacalāndhruvān ।
mahatastejaso rāśīnkālaṣaṣṭhānsvabhāvataḥ ॥6॥
slp1: vidDi nArada paYcEtAYSASvatAnacalAnDruvAn । mahatastejaso rASInkAlazazWAnsvaBAvataH ॥6॥

text: āpaścaivāntarikṣaṃ ca pṛthivī vāyupāvakau । asiddhiḥ parametebhyo bhūtebhyo muktasaṃśayam ॥7॥
html:
āpaścaivāntarikṣaṃ ca pṛthivī vāyupāvakau ।
asiddhiḥ parametebhyo bhūtebhyo muktasaṃśayam ॥7॥
slp1: ApaScEvAntarikzaM ca pfTivI vAyupAvakO । asidDiH parameteByo BUteByo muktasaMSayam ॥7॥

text: nopapattyā na vā yuktyā tvasadbrūyādasaṃśayam । vettha tānabhinirvṛttānṣaḍete yasya rāśayaḥ ॥8॥
html:
nopapattyā na vā yuktyā tvasadbrūyādasaṃśayam ।
vettha tānabhinirvṛttānṣaḍete yasya rāśayaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: nopapattyA na vA yuktyA tvasadbrUyAdasaMSayam । vetTa tAnaBinirvfttAnzaqete yasya rASayaH ॥8॥

text: pañcaiva tāni kālaśca bhāvābhāvau ca kevalau । aṣṭau bhūtāni bhūtānāṃ śāśvatāni bhavāpyayau ॥9॥
html:
pañcaiva tāni kālaśca bhāvābhāvau ca kevalau ।
aṣṭau bhūtāni bhūtānāṃ śāśvatāni bhavāpyayau ॥9॥
slp1: paYcEva tAni kAlaSca BAvABAvO ca kevalO । azwO BUtAni BUtAnAM SASvatAni BavApyayO ॥9॥

text: abhāvādbhāviteṣveva tebhyaśca prabhavantyapi । vinaṣṭo'pi ca tānyeva janturbhavati pañcadhā ॥10॥
html:
abhāvādbhāviteṣveva tebhyaśca prabhavantyapi ।
vinaṣṭo'pi ca tānyeva janturbhavati pañcadhā ॥10॥
slp1: aBAvAdBAvitezveva teByaSca praBavantyapi । vinazwo'pi ca tAnyeva janturBavati paYcaDA ॥10॥

text: tasya bhūmimayo dehaḥ śrotramākāśasambhavam । sūryaścakṣurasurvāyuradbhyastu khalu śoṇitam ॥11॥
html:
tasya bhūmimayo dehaḥ śrotramākāśasambhavam ।
sūryaścakṣurasurvāyuradbhyastu khalu śoṇitam ॥11॥
slp1: tasya BUmimayo dehaH SrotramAkASasamBavam । sUryaScakzurasurvAyuradByastu Kalu SoRitam ॥11॥

text: cakṣuṣī nāsikākarṇau tvagjihveti ca pañcamī । indriyāṇīndriyārthānāṃ jñānāni kavayo viduḥ ॥12॥
html:
cakṣuṣī nāsikākarṇau tvagjihveti ca pañcamī ।
indriyāṇīndriyārthānāṃ jñānāni kavayo viduḥ ॥12॥
slp1: cakzuzI nAsikAkarRO tvagjihveti ca paYcamI । indriyARIndriyArTAnAM jYAnAni kavayo viduH ॥12॥

text: darśanaṃ śravaṇaṃ ghrāṇaṃ sparśanaṃ rasanaṃ tathā । upapattyā guṇānviddhi pañca pañcasu pañcadhā ॥13॥
html:
darśanaṃ śravaṇaṃ ghrāṇaṃ sparśanaṃ rasanaṃ tathā ।
upapattyā guṇānviddhi pañca pañcasu pañcadhā ॥13॥
slp1: darSanaM SravaRaM GrARaM sparSanaM rasanaM taTA । upapattyA guRAnvidDi paYca paYcasu paYcaDA ॥13॥

text: rūpaṃ gandho rasaḥ sparśaḥ śabdaścaivātha tadguṇāḥ । indriyairupalabhyante pañcadhā pañca pañcabhiḥ ॥14॥
html:
rūpaṃ gandho rasaḥ sparśaḥ śabdaścaivātha tadguṇāḥ ।
indriyairupalabhyante pañcadhā pañca pañcabhiḥ ॥14॥
slp1: rUpaM ganDo rasaH sparSaH SabdaScEvATa tadguRAH । indriyErupalaByante paYcaDA paYca paYcaBiH ॥14॥

text: rūpaṃ gandhaṃ rasaṃ sparśaṃ śabdaṃ caitāṃstu tadguṇān । indriyāṇi na budhyante kṣetrajñastaistu budhyate ॥15॥
html:
rūpaṃ gandhaṃ rasaṃ sparśaṃ śabdaṃ caitāṃstu tadguṇān ।
indriyāṇi na budhyante kṣetrajñastaistu budhyate ॥15॥
slp1: rUpaM ganDaM rasaM sparSaM SabdaM cEtAMstu tadguRAn । indriyARi na buDyante kzetrajYastEstu buDyate ॥15॥

text: cittamindriyasaṅghātātparaṃ tasmātparaṃ manaḥ । manasastu parā buddhiḥ kṣetrajño buddhitaḥ paraḥ ॥16॥
html:
cittamindriyasaṅghātātparaṃ tasmātparaṃ manaḥ ।
manasastu parā buddhiḥ kṣetrajño buddhitaḥ paraḥ ॥16॥
slp1: cittamindriyasaNGAtAtparaM tasmAtparaM manaH । manasastu parA budDiH kzetrajYo budDitaH paraH ॥16॥

text: pūrvaṃ cetayate janturindriyairviṣayānpṛthak । vicārya manasā paścādatha buddhyā vyavasyati । indriyairupalabdhārthānsarvānyastvadhyavasyati ॥17॥
html:
pūrvaṃ cetayate janturindriyairviṣayānpṛthak ।
vicārya manasā paścādatha buddhyā vyavasyati ।
indriyairupalabdhārthānsarvānyastvadhyavasyati ॥17॥
slp1: pUrvaM cetayate janturindriyErvizayAnpfTak । vicArya manasA paScAdaTa budDyA vyavasyati । indriyErupalabDArTAnsarvAnyastvaDyavasyati ॥17॥

text: cittamindriyasaṅghātaṃ mano buddhiṃ tathāṣṭamīm । aṣṭau jñānendriyāṇyāhuretānyadhyātmacintakāḥ ॥18॥
html:
cittamindriyasaṅghātaṃ mano buddhiṃ tathāṣṭamīm ।
aṣṭau jñānendriyāṇyāhuretānyadhyātmacintakāḥ ॥18॥
slp1: cittamindriyasaNGAtaM mano budDiM taTAzwamIm । azwO jYAnendriyARyAhuretAnyaDyAtmacintakAH ॥18॥

text: pāṇipādaṃ ca pāyuśca mehanaṃ pañcamaṃ mukham । iti saṃśabdyamānāni śṛṇu karmendriyāṇyapi ॥19॥
html:
pāṇipādaṃ ca pāyuśca mehanaṃ pañcamaṃ mukham ।
iti saṃśabdyamānāni śṛṇu karmendriyāṇyapi ॥19॥
slp1: pARipAdaM ca pAyuSca mehanaM paYcamaM muKam । iti saMSabdyamAnAni SfRu karmendriyARyapi ॥19॥

text: jalpanābhyavahārārthaṃ mukhamindriyamucyate । gamanendriyaṃ tathā pādau karmaṇaḥ karaṇe karau ॥20॥
html:
jalpanābhyavahārārthaṃ mukhamindriyamucyate ।
gamanendriyaṃ tathā pādau karmaṇaḥ karaṇe karau ॥20॥
slp1: jalpanAByavahArArTaM muKamindriyamucyate । gamanendriyaM taTA pAdO karmaRaH karaRe karO ॥20॥

text: pāyūpasthau visargārthamindriye tulyakarmaṇī । visarge ca purīṣasya visarge cābhikāmike ॥21॥
html:
pāyūpasthau visargārthamindriye tulyakarmaṇī ।
visarge ca purīṣasya visarge cābhikāmike ॥21॥
slp1: pAyUpasTO visargArTamindriye tulyakarmaRI । visarge ca purIzasya visarge cABikAmike ॥21॥

text: balaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ ṣaḍetāni vācā samyagyathāgamam । jñānaceṣṭendriyaguṇāḥ sarve saṃśabditā mayā ॥22॥
html:
balaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ ṣaḍetāni vācā samyagyathāgamam ।
jñānaceṣṭendriyaguṇāḥ sarve saṃśabditā mayā ॥22॥
slp1: balaM zazWaM zaqetAni vAcA samyagyaTAgamam । jYAnacezwendriyaguRAH sarve saMSabditA mayA ॥22॥

text: indriyāṇāṃ svakarmabhyaḥ śramāduparamo yadā । bhavatīndriyasaṃnyāsādatha svapiti vai naraḥ ॥23॥
html:
indriyāṇāṃ svakarmabhyaḥ śramāduparamo yadā ।
bhavatīndriyasaṃnyāsādatha svapiti vai naraḥ ॥23॥
slp1: indriyARAM svakarmaByaH SramAduparamo yadA । BavatIndriyasaMnyAsAdaTa svapiti vE naraH ॥23॥

text: indriyāṇāṃ vyuparame mano'nuparataṃ yadi । sevate viṣayāneva tadvidyātsvapnadarśanam ॥24॥
html:
indriyāṇāṃ vyuparame mano'nuparataṃ yadi ।
sevate viṣayāneva tadvidyātsvapnadarśanam ॥24॥
slp1: indriyARAM vyuparame mano'nuparataM yadi । sevate vizayAneva tadvidyAtsvapnadarSanam ॥24॥

text: sāttvikāścaiva ye bhāvāstathā rājasatāmasāḥ । karmayuktānpraśaṃsanti sāttvikānitarāṃstathā ॥25॥
html:
sāttvikāścaiva ye bhāvāstathā rājasatāmasāḥ ।
karmayuktānpraśaṃsanti sāttvikānitarāṃstathā ॥25॥
slp1: sAttvikAScEva ye BAvAstaTA rAjasatAmasAH । karmayuktAnpraSaMsanti sAttvikAnitarAMstaTA ॥25॥

text: ānandaḥ karmaṇāṃ siddhiḥ pratipattiḥ parā gatiḥ । sāttvikasya nimittāni bhāvānsaṃśrayate smṛtiḥ ॥26॥
html:
ānandaḥ karmaṇāṃ siddhiḥ pratipattiḥ parā gatiḥ ।
sāttvikasya nimittāni bhāvānsaṃśrayate smṛtiḥ ॥26॥
slp1: AnandaH karmaRAM sidDiH pratipattiH parA gatiH । sAttvikasya nimittAni BAvAnsaMSrayate smftiH ॥26॥

text: jantuṣvekatameṣvevaṃ bhāvā ye vidhimāsthitāḥ । bhāvayorīpsitaṃ nityaṃ pratyakṣagamanaṃ dvayoḥ ॥27॥
html:
jantuṣvekatameṣvevaṃ bhāvā ye vidhimāsthitāḥ ।
bhāvayorīpsitaṃ nityaṃ pratyakṣagamanaṃ dvayoḥ ॥27॥
slp1: jantuzvekatamezvevaM BAvA ye viDimAsTitAH । BAvayorIpsitaM nityaM pratyakzagamanaM dvayoH ॥27॥

text: indriyāṇi ca bhāvāśca guṇāḥ saptadaśa smṛtāḥ । teṣāmaṣṭādaśo dehī yaḥ śarīre sa śāśvataḥ ॥28॥
html:
indriyāṇi ca bhāvāśca guṇāḥ saptadaśa smṛtāḥ ।
teṣāmaṣṭādaśo dehī yaḥ śarīre sa śāśvataḥ ॥28॥
slp1: indriyARi ca BAvASca guRAH saptadaSa smftAH । tezAmazwAdaSo dehI yaH SarIre sa SASvataH ॥28॥

text: atha vā saśarīrāste guṇāḥ sarve śarīriṇām । saṃśritāstadviyoge hi saśarīrā na santi te ॥29॥
html:
atha vā saśarīrāste guṇāḥ sarve śarīriṇām ।
saṃśritāstadviyoge hi saśarīrā na santi te ॥29॥
slp1: aTa vA saSarIrAste guRAH sarve SarIriRAm । saMSritAstadviyoge hi saSarIrA na santi te ॥29॥

text: atha vā sannipāto'yaṃ śarīraṃ pāñcabhautikam । ekaśca daśa cāṣṭau ca guṇāḥ saha śarīriṇām । ūṣmaṇā saha viṃśo vā saṅghātaḥ pāñcabhautikaḥ ॥30॥
html:
atha vā sannipāto'yaṃ śarīraṃ pāñcabhautikam ।
ekaśca daśa cāṣṭau ca guṇāḥ saha śarīriṇām ।
ūṣmaṇā saha viṃśo vā saṅghātaḥ pāñcabhautikaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: aTa vA sannipAto'yaM SarIraM pAYcaBOtikam । ekaSca daSa cAzwO ca guRAH saha SarIriRAm । UzmaRA saha viMSo vA saNGAtaH pAYcaBOtikaH ॥30॥

text: mahānsandhārayatyetaccharīraṃ vāyunā saha । tasyāsya bhāvayuktasya nimittaṃ dehabhedane ॥31॥
html:
mahānsandhārayatyetaccharīraṃ vāyunā saha ।
tasyāsya bhāvayuktasya nimittaṃ dehabhedane ॥31॥
slp1: mahAnsanDArayatyetacCarIraM vAyunA saha । tasyAsya BAvayuktasya nimittaM dehaBedane ॥31॥

text: yathaivotpadyate kiñcitpañcatvaṃ gacchate tathā । puṇyapāpavināśānte puṇyapāpasamīritam । dehaṃ viśati kālena tato'yaṃ karmasambhavam ॥32॥
html:
yathaivotpadyate kiñcitpañcatvaṃ gacchate tathā ।
puṇyapāpavināśānte puṇyapāpasamīritam ।
dehaṃ viśati kālena tato'yaṃ karmasambhavam ॥32॥
slp1: yaTEvotpadyate kiYcitpaYcatvaM gacCate taTA । puRyapApavinASAnte puRyapApasamIritam । dehaM viSati kAlena tato'yaM karmasamBavam ॥32॥

text: hitvā hitvā hyayaṃ praiti dehāddehaṃ kṛtāśrayaḥ । kālasañcoditaḥ kṣetrī viśīrṇādvā gṛhādgṛham ॥33॥
html:
hitvā hitvā hyayaṃ praiti dehāddehaṃ kṛtāśrayaḥ ।
kālasañcoditaḥ kṣetrī viśīrṇādvā gṛhādgṛham ॥33॥
slp1: hitvA hitvA hyayaM prEti dehAddehaM kftASrayaH । kAlasaYcoditaH kzetrI viSIrRAdvA gfhAdgfham ॥33॥

text: tatra naivānutapyante prājñā niścitaniścayāḥ । kṛpaṇāstvanutapyante janāḥ sambandhimāninaḥ ॥34॥
html:
tatra naivānutapyante prājñā niścitaniścayāḥ ।
kṛpaṇāstvanutapyante janāḥ sambandhimāninaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: tatra nEvAnutapyante prAjYA niScitaniScayAH । kfpaRAstvanutapyante janAH sambanDimAninaH ॥34॥

text: na hyayaṃ kasyacitkaścinnāsya kaścana vidyate । bhavatyeko hyayaṃ nityaṃ śarīre sukhaduḥkhabhāk ॥35॥
html:
na hyayaṃ kasyacitkaścinnāsya kaścana vidyate ।
bhavatyeko hyayaṃ nityaṃ śarīre sukhaduḥkhabhāk ॥35॥
slp1: na hyayaM kasyacitkaScinnAsya kaScana vidyate । Bavatyeko hyayaM nityaM SarIre suKaduHKaBAk ॥35॥

text: naiva sañjāyate janturna ca jātu vipadyate । yāti dehamayaṃ bhuktvā kadācitparamāṃ gatim ॥36॥
html:
naiva sañjāyate janturna ca jātu vipadyate ।
yāti dehamayaṃ bhuktvā kadācitparamāṃ gatim ॥36॥
slp1: nEva saYjAyate janturna ca jAtu vipadyate । yAti dehamayaM BuktvA kadAcitparamAM gatim ॥36॥

text: puṇyapāpamayaṃ dehaṃ kṣapayankarmasañcayāt । kṣīṇadehaḥ punardehī brahmatvamupagacchati ॥37॥
html:
puṇyapāpamayaṃ dehaṃ kṣapayankarmasañcayāt ।
kṣīṇadehaḥ punardehī brahmatvamupagacchati ॥37॥
slp1: puRyapApamayaM dehaM kzapayankarmasaYcayAt । kzIRadehaH punardehI brahmatvamupagacCati ॥37॥

text: puṇyapāpakṣayārthaṃ ca sāṅkhyaṃ jñānaṃ vidhīyate । tatkṣaye hyasya paśyanti brahmabhāve parāṃ gatim] ॥38॥
html:
puṇyapāpakṣayārthaṃ ca sāṅkhyaṃ jñānaṃ vidhīyate ।
tatkṣaye hyasya paśyanti brahmabhāve parāṃ gatim] ॥38॥
slp1: puRyapApakzayArTaM ca sANKyaM jYAnaM viDIyate । tatkzaye hyasya paSyanti brahmaBAve parAM gatim] ॥38॥

text: bhrātaraḥ pitaraḥ putrā jñātayaḥ suhṛdastathā । arthahetorhatāḥ krūrairasmābhiḥ pāpabuddhibhiḥ ॥1॥
html:
bhrātaraḥ pitaraḥ putrā jñātayaḥ suhṛdastathā ।
arthahetorhatāḥ krūrairasmābhiḥ pāpabuddhibhiḥ ॥1॥
slp1: BrAtaraH pitaraH putrA jYAtayaH suhfdastaTA । arTahetorhatAH krUrErasmABiH pApabudDiBiH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: yeyamarthodbhavā tṛṣṇā kathametāṃ pitāmaha । nivartayema pāpaṃ hi tṛṣṇayā kāritā vayam ॥2॥
html:
yeyamarthodbhavā tṛṣṇā kathametāṃ pitāmaha ।
nivartayema pāpaṃ hi tṛṣṇayā kāritā vayam ॥2॥
slp1: yeyamarTodBavA tfzRA kaTametAM pitAmaha । nivartayema pApaM hi tfzRayA kAritA vayam ॥2॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । gītaṃ videharājena māṇḍavyāyānupṛcchate ॥3॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
gītaṃ videharājena māṇḍavyāyānupṛcchate ॥3॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । gItaM videharAjena mARqavyAyAnupfcCate ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: susukhaṃ bata jīvāmi yasya me nāsti kiñcana । mithilāyāṃ pradīptāyāṃ na me dahyati kiñcana ॥4॥
html:
susukhaṃ bata jīvāmi yasya me nāsti kiñcana ।
mithilāyāṃ pradīptāyāṃ na me dahyati kiñcana ॥4॥
slp1: susuKaM bata jIvAmi yasya me nAsti kiYcana । miTilAyAM pradIptAyAM na me dahyati kiYcana ॥4॥
