text: arthāḥ khalu samṛddhā hi bāḍhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vijānatām । asamṛddhāstvapi sadā mohayantyavicakṣaṇān ॥5॥
html:
arthāḥ khalu samṛddhā hi bāḍhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vijānatām ।
asamṛddhāstvapi sadā mohayantyavicakṣaṇān ॥5॥
slp1: arTAH Kalu samfdDA hi bAQaM duHKaM vijAnatAm । asamfdDAstvapi sadA mohayantyavicakzaRAn ॥5॥

text: yacca kāmasukhaṃ loke yacca divyaṃ mahatsukham । tṛṣṇākṣayasukhasyaite nārhataḥ ṣoḍaśīṃ kalām ॥6॥
html:
yacca kāmasukhaṃ loke yacca divyaṃ mahatsukham ।
tṛṣṇākṣayasukhasyaite nārhataḥ ṣoḍaśīṃ kalām ॥6॥
slp1: yacca kAmasuKaM loke yacca divyaM mahatsuKam । tfzRAkzayasuKasyEte nArhataH zoqaSIM kalAm ॥6॥

text: yathaiva śṛṅgaṃ goḥ kāle vardhamānasya vardhate । tathaiva tṛṣṇā vittena vardhamānena vardhate ॥7॥
html:
yathaiva śṛṅgaṃ goḥ kāle vardhamānasya vardhate ।
tathaiva tṛṣṇā vittena vardhamānena vardhate ॥7॥
slp1: yaTEva SfNgaM goH kAle varDamAnasya varDate । taTEva tfzRA vittena varDamAnena varDate ॥7॥

text: kiñcideva mamatvena yadā bhavati kalpitam । tadeva paritāpāya nāśe sampadyate punaḥ ॥8॥
html:
kiñcideva mamatvena yadā bhavati kalpitam ।
tadeva paritāpāya nāśe sampadyate punaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: kiYcideva mamatvena yadA Bavati kalpitam । tadeva paritApAya nASe sampadyate punaH ॥8॥

text: na kāmānanurudhyeta duḥkhaṃ kāmeṣu vai ratiḥ । prāpyārthamupayuñjīta dharme kāmaṃ vivarjayet ॥9॥
html:
na kāmānanurudhyeta duḥkhaṃ kāmeṣu vai ratiḥ ।
prāpyārthamupayuñjīta dharme kāmaṃ vivarjayet ॥9॥
slp1: na kAmAnanuruDyeta duHKaM kAmezu vE ratiH । prApyArTamupayuYjIta Darme kAmaM vivarjayet ॥9॥

text: vidvānsarveṣu bhūteṣu vyāghramāṃsopamo bhavet । kṛtakṛtyo viśuddhātmā sarvaṃ tyajati vai saha ॥10॥
html:
vidvānsarveṣu bhūteṣu vyāghramāṃsopamo bhavet ।
kṛtakṛtyo viśuddhātmā sarvaṃ tyajati vai saha ॥10॥
slp1: vidvAnsarvezu BUtezu vyAGramAMsopamo Bavet । kftakftyo viSudDAtmA sarvaM tyajati vE saha ॥10॥

text: ubhe satyānṛte tyaktvā śokānandau priyāpriye । bhayābhaye ca santyajya saṃpraśānto nirāmayaḥ ॥11॥
html:
ubhe satyānṛte tyaktvā śokānandau priyāpriye ।
bhayābhaye ca santyajya saṃpraśānto nirāmayaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: uBe satyAnfte tyaktvA SokAnandO priyApriye । BayABaye ca santyajya saMpraSAnto nirAmayaH ॥11॥

text: yā dustyajā durmatibhiryā na jīryati jīryataḥ । yo'sau prāṇāntiko rogastāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ tyajataḥ sukham ॥12॥
html:
yā dustyajā durmatibhiryā na jīryati jīryataḥ ।
yo'sau prāṇāntiko rogastāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ tyajataḥ sukham ॥12॥
slp1: yA dustyajA durmatiBiryA na jIryati jIryataH । yo'sO prARAntiko rogastAM tfzRAM tyajataH suKam ॥12॥

text: cāritramātmanaḥ paśyaṃścandraśuddhamanāmayam । dharmātmā labhate kīrtiṃ pretya ceha yathāsukham ॥13॥
html:
cāritramātmanaḥ paśyaṃścandraśuddhamanāmayam ।
dharmātmā labhate kīrtiṃ pretya ceha yathāsukham ॥13॥
slp1: cAritramAtmanaH paSyaMScandraSudDamanAmayam । DarmAtmA laBate kIrtiM pretya ceha yaTAsuKam ॥13॥

text: rājñastadvacanaṃ śrutvā prītimānabhavaddvijaḥ । pūjayitvā ca tadvākyaṃ māṇḍavyo mokṣamāśritaḥ] ॥14॥
html:
rājñastadvacanaṃ śrutvā prītimānabhavaddvijaḥ ।
pūjayitvā ca tadvākyaṃ māṇḍavyo mokṣamāśritaḥ] ॥14॥
slp1: rAjYastadvacanaM SrutvA prItimAnaBavaddvijaH । pUjayitvA ca tadvAkyaM mARqavyo mokzamASritaH] ॥14॥

text: kiṃśīlaḥ kiṃsamācāraḥ kiṃvidyaḥ kiṃparāyaṇaḥ । prāpnoti brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ yatparaṃ prakṛterdhruvam ॥1॥
html:
kiṃśīlaḥ kiṃsamācāraḥ kiṃvidyaḥ kiṃparāyaṇaḥ ।
prāpnoti brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ yatparaṃ prakṛterdhruvam ॥1॥
slp1: kiMSIlaH kiMsamAcAraH kiMvidyaH kiMparAyaRaH । prApnoti brahmaRaH sTAnaM yatparaM prakfterDruvam ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: mokṣadharmeṣu nirato laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ । prāpnoti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatparaṃ prakṛterdhruvam ॥2॥
html:
mokṣadharmeṣu nirato laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ ।
prāpnoti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatparaṃ prakṛterdhruvam ॥2॥
slp1: mokzaDarmezu nirato laGvAhAro jitendriyaH । prApnoti paramaM sTAnaM yatparaM prakfterDruvam ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: svagṛhādabhiniḥsṛtya lābhālābhe samo muniḥ । samupoḍheṣu kāmeṣu nirapekṣaḥ parivrajet ॥3॥
html:
svagṛhādabhiniḥsṛtya lābhālābhe samo muniḥ ।
samupoḍheṣu kāmeṣu nirapekṣaḥ parivrajet ॥3॥
slp1: svagfhAdaBiniHsftya lABAlABe samo muniH । samupoQezu kAmezu nirapekzaH parivrajet ॥3॥

text: na cakṣuṣā na manasā na vācā dūṣayedapi । na pratyakṣaṃ parokṣaṃ vā dūṣaṇaṃ vyāharetkvacit ॥4॥
html:
na cakṣuṣā na manasā na vācā dūṣayedapi ।
na pratyakṣaṃ parokṣaṃ vā dūṣaṇaṃ vyāharetkvacit ॥4॥
slp1: na cakzuzA na manasA na vAcA dUzayedapi । na pratyakzaM parokzaM vA dUzaRaM vyAharetkvacit ॥4॥

text: na hiṃsyātsarvabhūtāni maitrāyaṇagatiścaret । nedaṃ jīvitamāsādya vairaṃ kurvīta kenacit ॥5॥
html:
na hiṃsyātsarvabhūtāni maitrāyaṇagatiścaret ।
nedaṃ jīvitamāsādya vairaṃ kurvīta kenacit ॥5॥
slp1: na hiMsyAtsarvaBUtAni mEtrAyaRagatiScaret । nedaM jIvitamAsAdya vEraM kurvIta kenacit ॥5॥

text: ativādāṃstitikṣeta nābhimanyetkathañcana । krodhyamānaḥ priyaṃ brūyādākruṣṭaḥ kuśalaṃ vadet ॥6॥
html:
ativādāṃstitikṣeta nābhimanyetkathañcana ।
krodhyamānaḥ priyaṃ brūyādākruṣṭaḥ kuśalaṃ vadet ॥6॥
slp1: ativAdAMstitikzeta nABimanyetkaTaYcana । kroDyamAnaH priyaM brUyAdAkruzwaH kuSalaM vadet ॥6॥

text: pradakṣiṇaṃ prasavyaṃ ca grāmamadhye na cācaret । bhaikṣacaryāmanāpanno na gacchetpūrvaketitaḥ ॥7॥
html:
pradakṣiṇaṃ prasavyaṃ ca grāmamadhye na cācaret ।
bhaikṣacaryāmanāpanno na gacchetpūrvaketitaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: pradakziRaM prasavyaM ca grAmamaDye na cAcaret । BEkzacaryAmanApanno na gacCetpUrvaketitaH ॥7॥

text: avakīrṇaḥ suguptaśca na vācā hyapriyaṃ vadet । mṛduḥ syādapratikrūro visrabdhaḥ syādaroṣaṇaḥ ॥8॥
html:
avakīrṇaḥ suguptaśca na vācā hyapriyaṃ vadet ।
mṛduḥ syādapratikrūro visrabdhaḥ syādaroṣaṇaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: avakIrRaH suguptaSca na vAcA hyapriyaM vadet । mfduH syAdapratikrUro visrabDaH syAdarozaRaH ॥8॥

text: vidhūme nyastamusale vyaṅgāre bhuktavajjane । atīte pātrasañcāre bhikṣāṃ lipseta vai muniḥ ॥9॥
html:
vidhūme nyastamusale vyaṅgāre bhuktavajjane ।
atīte pātrasañcāre bhikṣāṃ lipseta vai muniḥ ॥9॥
slp1: viDUme nyastamusale vyaNgAre Buktavajjane । atIte pAtrasaYcAre BikzAM lipseta vE muniH ॥9॥

text: anuyātrikamarthasya mātrālābheṣvanādṛtaḥ । alābhe na vihanyeta lābhaścainaṃ na harṣayet ॥10॥
html:
anuyātrikamarthasya mātrālābheṣvanādṛtaḥ ।
alābhe na vihanyeta lābhaścainaṃ na harṣayet ॥10॥
slp1: anuyAtrikamarTasya mAtrAlABezvanAdftaH । alABe na vihanyeta lABaScEnaM na harzayet ॥10॥

text: lābhaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ necchenna bhuñjītābhipūjitaḥ । abhipūjitalābhaṃ hi jugupsetaiva tādṛśaḥ ॥11॥
html:
lābhaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ necchenna bhuñjītābhipūjitaḥ ।
abhipūjitalābhaṃ hi jugupsetaiva tādṛśaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: lABaM sADAraRaM necCenna BuYjItABipUjitaH । aBipUjitalABaM hi jugupsetEva tAdfSaH ॥11॥

text: na cānnadoṣānnindeta na guṇānabhipūjayet । śayyāsane vivikte ca nityamevābhipūjayet ॥12॥
html:
na cānnadoṣānnindeta na guṇānabhipūjayet ।
śayyāsane vivikte ca nityamevābhipūjayet ॥12॥
slp1: na cAnnadozAnnindeta na guRAnaBipUjayet । SayyAsane vivikte ca nityamevABipUjayet ॥12॥

text: śūnyāgāraṃ vṛkṣamūlamaraṇyamatha vā guhām । ajñātacaryāṃ gatvānyāṃ tato'nyatraiva saṃviśet ॥13॥
html:
śūnyāgāraṃ vṛkṣamūlamaraṇyamatha vā guhām ।
ajñātacaryāṃ gatvānyāṃ tato'nyatraiva saṃviśet ॥13॥
slp1: SUnyAgAraM vfkzamUlamaraRyamaTa vA guhAm । ajYAtacaryAM gatvAnyAM tato'nyatrEva saMviSet ॥13॥

text: anurodhavirodhābhyāṃ samaḥ syādacalo dhruvaḥ । sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ cobhe nānurudhyeta karmaṇi ॥14॥
html:
anurodhavirodhābhyāṃ samaḥ syādacalo dhruvaḥ ।
sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ cobhe nānurudhyeta karmaṇi ॥14॥
slp1: anuroDaviroDAByAM samaH syAdacalo DruvaH । sukftaM duzkftaM coBe nAnuruDyeta karmaRi ॥14॥

text: vāco vegaṃ manasaḥ krodhavegaṃ vivitsāvegamudaropasthavegam । etānvegānvinayedvai tapasvī nindā cāsya hṛdayaṃ nopahanyāt ॥15॥
html:
vāco vegaṃ manasaḥ krodhavegaṃ vivitsāvegamudaropasthavegam ।
etānvegānvinayedvai tapasvī nindā cāsya hṛdayaṃ nopahanyāt ॥15॥
slp1: vAco vegaM manasaH kroDavegaM vivitsAvegamudaropasTavegam । etAnvegAnvinayedvE tapasvI nindA cAsya hfdayaM nopahanyAt ॥15॥

text: madhyastha eva tiṣṭheta praśaṃsānindayoḥ samaḥ । etatpavitraṃ paramaṃ parivrājaka āśrame ॥16॥
html:
madhyastha eva tiṣṭheta praśaṃsānindayoḥ samaḥ ।
etatpavitraṃ paramaṃ parivrājaka āśrame ॥16॥
slp1: maDyasTa eva tizWeta praSaMsAnindayoH samaH । etatpavitraM paramaM parivrAjaka ASrame ॥16॥

text: mahātmā suvrato dāntaḥ sarvatraivānapāśritaḥ । apūrvacārakaḥ saumyo aniketaḥ samāhitaḥ ॥17॥
html:
mahātmā suvrato dāntaḥ sarvatraivānapāśritaḥ ।
apūrvacārakaḥ saumyo aniketaḥ samāhitaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: mahAtmA suvrato dAntaH sarvatrEvAnapASritaH । apUrvacArakaH sOmyo aniketaH samAhitaH ॥17॥

text: vānaprasthagṛhasthābhyāṃ na saṃsṛjyeta karhicit । ajñātalipsāṃ lipseta na cainaṃ harṣa āviśet ॥18॥
html:
vānaprasthagṛhasthābhyāṃ na saṃsṛjyeta karhicit ।
ajñātalipsāṃ lipseta na cainaṃ harṣa āviśet ॥18॥
slp1: vAnaprasTagfhasTAByAM na saMsfjyeta karhicit । ajYAtalipsAM lipseta na cEnaM harza AviSet ॥18॥

text: vijānatāṃ mokṣa eṣa śramaḥ syādavijānatām । mokṣayānamidaṃ kṛtsnaṃ viduṣāṃ hārito'bravīt ॥19॥
html:
vijānatāṃ mokṣa eṣa śramaḥ syādavijānatām ।
mokṣayānamidaṃ kṛtsnaṃ viduṣāṃ hārito'bravīt ॥19॥
slp1: vijAnatAM mokza eza SramaH syAdavijAnatAm । mokzayAnamidaM kftsnaM viduzAM hArito'bravIt ॥19॥

text: abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo dattvā yaḥ pravrajedgṛhāt । lokāstejomayāstasya tathānantyāya kalpate] ॥20॥
html:
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo dattvā yaḥ pravrajedgṛhāt ।
lokāstejomayāstasya tathānantyāya kalpate] ॥20॥
slp1: aBayaM sarvaBUteByo dattvA yaH pravrajedgfhAt । lokAstejomayAstasya taTAnantyAya kalpate] ॥20॥

text: dhanyā dhanyā iti janāḥ sarve'smānpravadantyuta । na duḥkhitataraḥ kaścitpumānasmābhirasti ha ॥1॥
html:
dhanyā dhanyā iti janāḥ sarve'smānpravadantyuta ।
na duḥkhitataraḥ kaścitpumānasmābhirasti ha ॥1॥
slp1: DanyA DanyA iti janAH sarve'smAnpravadantyuta । na duHKitataraH kaScitpumAnasmABirasti ha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: lokasambhāvitairduḥkhaṃ yatprāptaṃ kurusattama । prāpya jātiṃ manuṣyeṣu devairapi pitāmaha ॥2॥
html:
lokasambhāvitairduḥkhaṃ yatprāptaṃ kurusattama ।
prāpya jātiṃ manuṣyeṣu devairapi pitāmaha ॥2॥
slp1: lokasamBAvitErduHKaM yatprAptaM kurusattama । prApya jAtiM manuzyezu devErapi pitAmaha ॥2॥

text: kadā vayaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ saṃnyāsaṃ duḥkhasañjñakam । duḥkhametaccharīrāṇāṃ dhāraṇaṃ kurusattama ॥3॥
html:
kadā vayaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ saṃnyāsaṃ duḥkhasañjñakam ।
duḥkhametaccharīrāṇāṃ dhāraṇaṃ kurusattama ॥3॥
slp1: kadA vayaM karizyAmaH saMnyAsaM duHKasaYjYakam । duHKametacCarIrARAM DAraRaM kurusattama ॥3॥

text: vimuktāḥ saptadaśabhirhetubhūtaiśca pañcabhiḥ । indriyārthairguṇaiścaiva aṣṭābhiḥ prapitāmaha ॥4॥
html:
vimuktāḥ saptadaśabhirhetubhūtaiśca pañcabhiḥ ।
indriyārthairguṇaiścaiva aṣṭābhiḥ prapitāmaha ॥4॥
slp1: vimuktAH saptadaSaBirhetuBUtESca paYcaBiH । indriyArTErguREScEva azwABiH prapitAmaha ॥4॥

text: na gacchanti punarbhāvaṃ munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ । kadā vayaṃ bhaviṣyāmo rājyaṃ hitvā parantapa ॥5॥
html:
na gacchanti punarbhāvaṃ munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ ।
kadā vayaṃ bhaviṣyāmo rājyaṃ hitvā parantapa ॥5॥
slp1: na gacCanti punarBAvaM munayaH saMSitavratAH । kadA vayaM BavizyAmo rAjyaM hitvA parantapa ॥5॥

text: nāstyanantaṃ mahārāja sarvaṃ saṅkhyānagocaram । punarbhāvo'pi saṅkhyāto nāsti kiñcidihācalam ॥6॥
html:
nāstyanantaṃ mahārāja sarvaṃ saṅkhyānagocaram ।
punarbhāvo'pi saṅkhyāto nāsti kiñcidihācalam ॥6॥
slp1: nAstyanantaM mahArAja sarvaM saNKyAnagocaram । punarBAvo'pi saNKyAto nAsti kiYcidihAcalam ॥6॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: na cāpi gamyate rājannaiṣa doṣaḥ prasaṅgataḥ । udyogādeva dharmajña kālenaiva gamiṣyatha ॥7॥
html:
na cāpi gamyate rājannaiṣa doṣaḥ prasaṅgataḥ ।
udyogādeva dharmajña kālenaiva gamiṣyatha ॥7॥
slp1: na cApi gamyate rAjannEza dozaH prasaNgataH । udyogAdeva DarmajYa kAlenEva gamizyaTa ॥7॥

text: īśo'yaṃ satataṃ dehī nṛpate puṇyapāpayoḥ । tata eva samutthena tamasā rudhyate'pi ca ॥8॥
html:
īśo'yaṃ satataṃ dehī nṛpate puṇyapāpayoḥ ।
tata eva samutthena tamasā rudhyate'pi ca ॥8॥
slp1: ISo'yaM satataM dehI nfpate puRyapApayoH । tata eva samutTena tamasA ruDyate'pi ca ॥8॥

text: yathāñjanamayo vāyuḥ punarmānaḥśilaṃ rajaḥ । anupraviśya tadvarṇo dṛśyate rañjayandiśaḥ ॥9॥
html:
yathāñjanamayo vāyuḥ punarmānaḥśilaṃ rajaḥ ।
anupraviśya tadvarṇo dṛśyate rañjayandiśaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: yaTAYjanamayo vAyuH punarmAnaHSilaM rajaH । anupraviSya tadvarRo dfSyate raYjayandiSaH ॥9॥

text: tathā karmaphalairdehī rañjitastamasāvṛtaḥ । vivarṇo varṇamāśritya deheṣu parivartate ॥10॥
html:
tathā karmaphalairdehī rañjitastamasāvṛtaḥ ।
vivarṇo varṇamāśritya deheṣu parivartate ॥10॥
slp1: taTA karmaPalErdehI raYjitastamasAvftaH । vivarRo varRamASritya dehezu parivartate ॥10॥

text: jñānena hi yadā janturajñānaprabhavaṃ tamaḥ । vyapohati tadā brahma prakāśeta sanātanam ॥11॥
html:
jñānena hi yadā janturajñānaprabhavaṃ tamaḥ ।
vyapohati tadā brahma prakāśeta sanātanam ॥11॥
slp1: jYAnena hi yadA janturajYAnapraBavaM tamaH । vyapohati tadA brahma prakASeta sanAtanam ॥11॥

text: ayatnasādhyaṃ munayo vadanti ye cāpi muktāsta upāsitavyāḥ । tvayā ca lokena ca sāmareṇa tasmānna śāmyanti maharṣisaṅghāḥ ॥12॥
html:
ayatnasādhyaṃ munayo vadanti ye cāpi muktāsta upāsitavyāḥ ।
tvayā ca lokena ca sāmareṇa tasmānna śāmyanti maharṣisaṅghāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: ayatnasADyaM munayo vadanti ye cApi muktAsta upAsitavyAH । tvayA ca lokena ca sAmareRa tasmAnna SAmyanti maharzisaNGAH ॥12॥

text: asminnarthe purā gītaṃ śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa । yathā daityena vṛtreṇa bhraṣṭaiśvaryeṇa ceṣṭitam ॥13॥
html:
asminnarthe purā gītaṃ śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa ।
yathā daityena vṛtreṇa bhraṣṭaiśvaryeṇa ceṣṭitam ॥13॥
slp1: asminnarTe purA gItaM SfRuzvEkamanA nfpa । yaTA dEtyena vftreRa BrazwESvaryeRa cezwitam ॥13॥

text: nirjitenāsahāyena hṛtarājyena bhārata । aśocatā śatrumadhye buddhimāsthāya kevalām ॥14॥
html:
nirjitenāsahāyena hṛtarājyena bhārata ।
aśocatā śatrumadhye buddhimāsthāya kevalām ॥14॥
slp1: nirjitenAsahAyena hftarAjyena BArata । aSocatA SatrumaDye budDimAsTAya kevalAm ॥14॥

text: bhraṣṭaiśvaryaṃ purā vṛtramuśanā vākyamabravīt । kaccitparājitasyādya na vyathā te'sti dānava ॥15॥
html:
bhraṣṭaiśvaryaṃ purā vṛtramuśanā vākyamabravīt ।
kaccitparājitasyādya na vyathā te'sti dānava ॥15॥
slp1: BrazwESvaryaM purA vftramuSanA vAkyamabravIt । kaccitparAjitasyAdya na vyaTA te'sti dAnava ॥15॥

text: satyena tapasā caiva viditvā saṅkṣayaṃ hyaham । na śocāmi na hṛṣyāmi bhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatim ॥16॥
html:
satyena tapasā caiva viditvā saṅkṣayaṃ hyaham ।
na śocāmi na hṛṣyāmi bhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatim ॥16॥
slp1: satyena tapasA cEva viditvA saNkzayaM hyaham । na SocAmi na hfzyAmi BUtAnAmAgatiM gatim ॥16॥
author: vṛtra uvāca ।

text: kālasañcoditā jīvā majjanti narake'vaśāḥ । paridṛṣṭāni sarvāṇi divyānyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥17॥
html:
kālasañcoditā jīvā majjanti narake'vaśāḥ ।
paridṛṣṭāni sarvāṇi divyānyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: kAlasaYcoditA jIvA majjanti narake'vaSAH । paridfzwAni sarvARi divyAnyAhurmanIziRaH ॥17॥

text: kṣapayitvā tu taṃ kālaṃ gaṇitaṃ kālacoditāḥ । sāvaśeṣeṇa kālena sambhavanti punaḥ punaḥ ॥18॥
html:
kṣapayitvā tu taṃ kālaṃ gaṇitaṃ kālacoditāḥ ।
sāvaśeṣeṇa kālena sambhavanti punaḥ punaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: kzapayitvA tu taM kAlaM gaRitaM kAlacoditAH । sAvaSezeRa kAlena samBavanti punaH punaH ॥18॥

text: tiryagyonisahasrāṇi gatvā narakameva ca । nirgacchantyavaśā jīvāḥ kālabandhanabandhanāḥ ॥19॥
html:
tiryagyonisahasrāṇi gatvā narakameva ca ।
nirgacchantyavaśā jīvāḥ kālabandhanabandhanāḥ ॥19॥
slp1: tiryagyonisahasrARi gatvA narakameva ca । nirgacCantyavaSA jIvAH kAlabanDanabanDanAH ॥19॥

text: evaṃ saṃsaramāṇāni jīvānyahamadṛṣṭavān । yathā karma tathā lābha iti śāstranidarśanam ॥20॥
html:
evaṃ saṃsaramāṇāni jīvānyahamadṛṣṭavān ।
yathā karma tathā lābha iti śāstranidarśanam ॥20॥
slp1: evaM saMsaramARAni jIvAnyahamadfzwavAn । yaTA karma taTA lABa iti SAstranidarSanam ॥20॥

text: tiryaggacchanti narakaṃ mānuṣyaṃ daivameva ca । sukhaduḥkhe priyadveṣye caritvā pūrvameva ca ॥21॥
html:
tiryaggacchanti narakaṃ mānuṣyaṃ daivameva ca ।
sukhaduḥkhe priyadveṣye caritvā pūrvameva ca ॥21॥
slp1: tiryaggacCanti narakaM mAnuzyaM dEvameva ca । suKaduHKe priyadvezye caritvA pUrvameva ca ॥21॥

text: kṛtāntavidhisaṃyuktaṃ sarvalokaḥ prapadyate । gataṃ gacchanti cādhvānaṃ sarvabhūtāni sarvadā ॥22॥
html:
kṛtāntavidhisaṃyuktaṃ sarvalokaḥ prapadyate ।
gataṃ gacchanti cādhvānaṃ sarvabhūtāni sarvadā ॥22॥
slp1: kftAntaviDisaMyuktaM sarvalokaH prapadyate । gataM gacCanti cADvAnaM sarvaBUtAni sarvadA ॥22॥

text: kālasaṅkhyānasaṅkhyātaṃ sṛṣṭisthitiparāyaṇam । taṃ bhāṣamāṇaṃ bhagavānuśanā pratyabhāṣata । bhīmānduṣṭapralāpāṃstvaṃ tāta kasmātprabhāṣase ॥23॥
html:
kālasaṅkhyānasaṅkhyātaṃ sṛṣṭisthitiparāyaṇam ।
taṃ bhāṣamāṇaṃ bhagavānuśanā pratyabhāṣata ।
bhīmānduṣṭapralāpāṃstvaṃ tāta kasmātprabhāṣase ॥23॥
slp1: kAlasaNKyAnasaNKyAtaM sfzwisTitiparAyaRam । taM BAzamARaM BagavAnuSanA pratyaBAzata । BImAnduzwapralApAMstvaM tAta kasmAtpraBAzase ॥23॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: pratyakṣametadbhavatastathānyeṣāṃ manīṣiṇām । mayā yajjayalubdhena purā taptaṃ mahattapaḥ ॥24॥
html:
pratyakṣametadbhavatastathānyeṣāṃ manīṣiṇām ।
mayā yajjayalubdhena purā taptaṃ mahattapaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: pratyakzametadBavatastaTAnyezAM manIziRAm । mayA yajjayalubDena purA taptaM mahattapaH ॥24॥
author: vṛtra uvāca ।

text: gandhānādāya bhūtānāṃ rasāṃśca vividhānapi । avardhaṃ trīnsamākramya lokānvai svena tejasā ॥25॥
html:
gandhānādāya bhūtānāṃ rasāṃśca vividhānapi ।
avardhaṃ trīnsamākramya lokānvai svena tejasā ॥25॥
slp1: ganDAnAdAya BUtAnAM rasAMSca viviDAnapi । avarDaM trInsamAkramya lokAnvE svena tejasA ॥25॥

text: jvālāmālāparikṣipto vaihāyasacarastathā । ajeyaḥ sarvabhūtānāmāsaṃ nityamapetabhīḥ ॥26॥
html:
jvālāmālāparikṣipto vaihāyasacarastathā ।
ajeyaḥ sarvabhūtānāmāsaṃ nityamapetabhīḥ ॥26॥
slp1: jvAlAmAlAparikzipto vEhAyasacarastaTA । ajeyaH sarvaBUtAnAmAsaM nityamapetaBIH ॥26॥

text: aiśvaryaṃ tapasā prāptaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ tacca svakarmabhiḥ । dhṛtimāsthāya bhagavanna śocāmi tatastvaham ॥27॥
html:
aiśvaryaṃ tapasā prāptaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ tacca svakarmabhiḥ ।
dhṛtimāsthāya bhagavanna śocāmi tatastvaham ॥27॥
slp1: ESvaryaM tapasA prAptaM BrazwaM tacca svakarmaBiH । DftimAsTAya Bagavanna SocAmi tatastvaham ॥27॥

text: yuyutsatā mahendreṇa purā sārdhaṃ mahātmanā । tato me bhagavāndṛṣṭo harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ॥28॥
html:
yuyutsatā mahendreṇa purā sārdhaṃ mahātmanā ।
tato me bhagavāndṛṣṭo harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ॥28॥
slp1: yuyutsatA mahendreRa purA sArDaM mahAtmanA । tato me BagavAndfzwo harirnArAyaRaH praBuH ॥28॥

text: vaikuṇṭhaḥ puruṣo viṣṇuḥ śuklo'nantaḥ sanātanaḥ । muñjakeśo hariśmaśruḥ sarvabhūtapitāmahaḥ ॥29॥
html:
vaikuṇṭhaḥ puruṣo viṣṇuḥ śuklo'nantaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
muñjakeśo hariśmaśruḥ sarvabhūtapitāmahaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: vEkuRWaH puruzo vizRuH Suklo'nantaH sanAtanaH । muYjakeSo hariSmaSruH sarvaBUtapitAmahaH ॥29॥

text: nūnaṃ tu tasya tapasaḥ sāvaśeṣaṃ mamāsti vai । yadahaṃ praṣṭumicchāmi bhavantaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam ॥30॥
html:
nūnaṃ tu tasya tapasaḥ sāvaśeṣaṃ mamāsti vai ।
yadahaṃ praṣṭumicchāmi bhavantaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam ॥30॥
slp1: nUnaM tu tasya tapasaH sAvaSezaM mamAsti vE । yadahaM prazwumicCAmi BavantaM karmaRaH Palam ॥30॥

text: aiśvaryaṃ vai mahadbrahmankasminvarṇe pratiṣṭhitam । nivartate cāpi punaḥ kathamaiśvaryamuttamam ॥31॥
html:
aiśvaryaṃ vai mahadbrahmankasminvarṇe pratiṣṭhitam ।
nivartate cāpi punaḥ kathamaiśvaryamuttamam ॥31॥
slp1: ESvaryaM vE mahadbrahmankasminvarRe pratizWitam । nivartate cApi punaH kaTamESvaryamuttamam ॥31॥

text: kasmādbhūtāni jīvanti pravartante'tha vā punaḥ । kiṃ vā phalaṃ paraṃ prāpya jīvastiṣṭhati śāśvataḥ ॥32॥
html:
kasmādbhūtāni jīvanti pravartante'tha vā punaḥ ।
kiṃ vā phalaṃ paraṃ prāpya jīvastiṣṭhati śāśvataḥ ॥32॥
slp1: kasmAdBUtAni jIvanti pravartante'Ta vA punaH । kiM vA PalaM paraM prApya jIvastizWati SASvataH ॥32॥

text: kena vā karmaṇā śakyamatha jñānena kena vā । brahmarṣe tatphalaṃ prāptuṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥33॥
html:
kena vā karmaṇā śakyamatha jñānena kena vā ।
brahmarṣe tatphalaṃ prāptuṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥33॥
slp1: kena vA karmaRA SakyamaTa jYAnena kena vA । brahmarze tatPalaM prAptuM tanme vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥33॥

text: itīdamuktaḥ sa munistadānīṃ pratyāha yattacchṛṇu rājasiṃha । mayocyamānaṃ puruṣarṣabha tvamananyacittaḥ saha sodarīyaiḥ] ॥34॥
html:
itīdamuktaḥ sa munistadānīṃ pratyāha yattacchṛṇu rājasiṃha ।
mayocyamānaṃ puruṣarṣabha tvamananyacittaḥ saha sodarīyaiḥ] ॥34॥
slp1: itIdamuktaH sa munistadAnIM pratyAha yattacCfRu rAjasiMha । mayocyamAnaM puruzarzaBa tvamananyacittaH saha sodarIyEH] ॥34॥

text: namastasmai bhagavate devāya prabhaviṣṇave । yasya pṛthvītalaṃ tāta sākāśaṃ bāhugocaram ॥1॥
html:
namastasmai bhagavate devāya prabhaviṣṇave ।
yasya pṛthvītalaṃ tāta sākāśaṃ bāhugocaram ॥1॥
slp1: namastasmE Bagavate devAya praBavizRave । yasya pfTvItalaM tAta sAkASaM bAhugocaram ॥1॥
author: uśanovāca ।

text: mūrdhā yasya tvanantaṃ ca sthānaṃ dānavasattama । tasyāhaṃ te pravakṣyāmi viṣṇormāhātmyamuttamam ॥2॥
html:
mūrdhā yasya tvanantaṃ ca sthānaṃ dānavasattama ।
tasyāhaṃ te pravakṣyāmi viṣṇormāhātmyamuttamam ॥2॥
slp1: mUrDA yasya tvanantaM ca sTAnaM dAnavasattama । tasyAhaM te pravakzyAmi vizRormAhAtmyamuttamam ॥2॥

text: tayoḥ saṃvadatorevamājagāma mahāmuniḥ । sanatkumāro dharmātmā saṃśayacchedanāya vai ॥3॥
html:
tayoḥ saṃvadatorevamājagāma mahāmuniḥ ।
sanatkumāro dharmātmā saṃśayacchedanāya vai ॥3॥
slp1: tayoH saMvadatorevamAjagAma mahAmuniH । sanatkumAro DarmAtmA saMSayacCedanAya vE ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sa pūjito'surendreṇa muninośanasā tathā । niṣasādāsane rājanmahārhe munipuṅgavaḥ ॥4॥
html:
sa pūjito'surendreṇa muninośanasā tathā ।
niṣasādāsane rājanmahārhe munipuṅgavaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: sa pUjito'surendreRa muninoSanasA taTA । nizasAdAsane rAjanmahArhe munipuNgavaH ॥4॥

text: tamāsīnaṃ mahāprājñamuśanā vākyamabravīt । brūhyasmai dānavendrāya viṣṇormāhātmyamuttamam ॥5॥
html:
tamāsīnaṃ mahāprājñamuśanā vākyamabravīt ।
brūhyasmai dānavendrāya viṣṇormāhātmyamuttamam ॥5॥
slp1: tamAsInaM mahAprAjYamuSanA vAkyamabravIt । brUhyasmE dAnavendrAya vizRormAhAtmyamuttamam ॥5॥

text: sanatkumārastu tataḥ śrutvā prāha vaco'rthavat । viṣṇormāhātmyasaṃyuktaṃ dānavendrāya dhīmate ॥6॥
html:
sanatkumārastu tataḥ śrutvā prāha vaco'rthavat ।
viṣṇormāhātmyasaṃyuktaṃ dānavendrāya dhīmate ॥6॥
slp1: sanatkumArastu tataH SrutvA prAha vaco'rTavat । vizRormAhAtmyasaMyuktaM dAnavendrAya DImate ॥6॥

text: śṛṇu sarvamidaṃ daitya viṣṇormāhātmyamuttamam । viṣṇau jagatsthitaṃ sarvamiti viddhi parantapa ॥7॥
html:
śṛṇu sarvamidaṃ daitya viṣṇormāhātmyamuttamam ।
viṣṇau jagatsthitaṃ sarvamiti viddhi parantapa ॥7॥
slp1: SfRu sarvamidaM dEtya vizRormAhAtmyamuttamam । vizRO jagatsTitaM sarvamiti vidDi parantapa ॥7॥

text: sṛjatyeṣa mahābāho bhūtagrāmaṃ carācaram । eṣa cākṣipate kāle kāle visṛjate punaḥ । asmingacchanti vilayamasmācca prabhavantyuta ॥8॥
html:
sṛjatyeṣa mahābāho bhūtagrāmaṃ carācaram ।
eṣa cākṣipate kāle kāle visṛjate punaḥ ।
asmingacchanti vilayamasmācca prabhavantyuta ॥8॥
slp1: sfjatyeza mahAbAho BUtagrAmaM carAcaram । eza cAkzipate kAle kAle visfjate punaH । asmingacCanti vilayamasmAcca praBavantyuta ॥8॥

text: naiṣa dānavatā śakyastapasā naiva cejyayā । samprāptumindriyāṇāṃ tu saṃyamenaiva śakyate ॥9॥
html:
naiṣa dānavatā śakyastapasā naiva cejyayā ।
samprāptumindriyāṇāṃ tu saṃyamenaiva śakyate ॥9॥
slp1: nEza dAnavatA SakyastapasA nEva cejyayA । samprAptumindriyARAM tu saMyamenEva Sakyate ॥9॥

text: bāhye cābhyantare caiva karmaṇā manasi sthitaḥ । nirmalīkurute buddhyā so'mutrānantyamaśnute ॥10॥
html:
bāhye cābhyantare caiva karmaṇā manasi sthitaḥ ।
nirmalīkurute buddhyā so'mutrānantyamaśnute ॥10॥
slp1: bAhye cAByantare cEva karmaRA manasi sTitaH । nirmalIkurute budDyA so'mutrAnantyamaSnute ॥10॥

text: yathā hiraṇyakartā vai rūpyamagnau viśodhayet । bahuśo'tiprayatnena mahatātmakṛtena ha ॥11॥
html:
yathā hiraṇyakartā vai rūpyamagnau viśodhayet ।
bahuśo'tiprayatnena mahatātmakṛtena ha ॥11॥
slp1: yaTA hiraRyakartA vE rUpyamagnO viSoDayet । bahuSo'tiprayatnena mahatAtmakftena ha ॥11॥

text: tadvajjātiśatairjīvaḥ śudhyate'lpena karmaṇā । yatnena mahatā caivāpyekajātau viśudhyate ॥12॥
html:
tadvajjātiśatairjīvaḥ śudhyate'lpena karmaṇā ।
yatnena mahatā caivāpyekajātau viśudhyate ॥12॥
slp1: tadvajjAtiSatErjIvaH SuDyate'lpena karmaRA । yatnena mahatA cEvApyekajAtO viSuDyate ॥12॥

text: līlayālpaṃ yathā gātrātpramṛjyādātmano rajaḥ । bahu yatnena mahatā doṣanirharaṇaṃ tathā ॥13॥
html:
līlayālpaṃ yathā gātrātpramṛjyādātmano rajaḥ ।
bahu yatnena mahatā doṣanirharaṇaṃ tathā ॥13॥
slp1: lIlayAlpaM yaTA gAtrAtpramfjyAdAtmano rajaH । bahu yatnena mahatA dozanirharaRaM taTA ॥13॥

text: yathā cālpena mālyena vāsitaṃ tilasarṣapam । na muñcati svakaṃ gandhaṃ tadvatsūkṣmasya darśanam ॥14॥
html:
yathā cālpena mālyena vāsitaṃ tilasarṣapam ।
na muñcati svakaṃ gandhaṃ tadvatsūkṣmasya darśanam ॥14॥
slp1: yaTA cAlpena mAlyena vAsitaM tilasarzapam । na muYcati svakaM ganDaM tadvatsUkzmasya darSanam ॥14॥

text: tadeva bahubhirmālyairvāsyamānaṃ punaḥ punaḥ । vimuñcati svakaṃ gandhaṃ mālyagandhe'vatiṣṭhati ॥15॥
html:
tadeva bahubhirmālyairvāsyamānaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
vimuñcati svakaṃ gandhaṃ mālyagandhe'vatiṣṭhati ॥15॥
slp1: tadeva bahuBirmAlyErvAsyamAnaM punaH punaH । vimuYcati svakaM ganDaM mAlyaganDe'vatizWati ॥15॥

text: evaṃ jātiśatairyukto guṇaireva prasaṅgiṣu । buddhyā nivartate doṣo yatnenābhyāsajena vai ॥16॥
html:
evaṃ jātiśatairyukto guṇaireva prasaṅgiṣu ।
buddhyā nivartate doṣo yatnenābhyāsajena vai ॥16॥
slp1: evaM jAtiSatEryukto guREreva prasaNgizu । budDyA nivartate dozo yatnenAByAsajena vE ॥16॥

text: karmaṇā svena raktāni viraktāni ca dānava । yathā karmaviśeṣāṃśca prāpnuvanti tathā śṛṇu ॥17॥
html:
karmaṇā svena raktāni viraktāni ca dānava ।
yathā karmaviśeṣāṃśca prāpnuvanti tathā śṛṇu ॥17॥
slp1: karmaRA svena raktAni viraktAni ca dAnava । yaTA karmaviSezAMSca prApnuvanti taTA SfRu ॥17॥

text: yathā ca sampravartante yasmiṃstiṣṭhanti vā vibho । tatte'nupūrvyā vyākhyāsye tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ॥18॥
html:
yathā ca sampravartante yasmiṃstiṣṭhanti vā vibho ।
tatte'nupūrvyā vyākhyāsye tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ॥18॥
slp1: yaTA ca sampravartante yasmiMstizWanti vA viBo । tatte'nupUrvyA vyAKyAsye tadihEkamanAH SfRu ॥18॥

text: anādinidhanaḥ śrīmānharirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ । sa vai sṛjati bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ॥19॥
html:
anādinidhanaḥ śrīmānharirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
sa vai sṛjati bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ॥19॥
slp1: anAdiniDanaH SrImAnharirnArAyaRaH praBuH । sa vE sfjati BUtAni sTAvarARi carARi ca ॥19॥

text: eṣa sarveṣu bhūteṣu kṣaraścākṣara eva ca । ekādaśavikārātmā jagatpibati raśmibhiḥ ॥20॥
html:
eṣa sarveṣu bhūteṣu kṣaraścākṣara eva ca ।
ekādaśavikārātmā jagatpibati raśmibhiḥ ॥20॥
slp1: eza sarvezu BUtezu kzaraScAkzara eva ca । ekAdaSavikArAtmA jagatpibati raSmiBiH ॥20॥

text: pādau tasya mahīṃ viddhi mūrdhānaṃ divameva ca । bāhavastu diśo daitya śrotramākāśameva ca ॥21॥
html:
pādau tasya mahīṃ viddhi mūrdhānaṃ divameva ca ।
bāhavastu diśo daitya śrotramākāśameva ca ॥21॥
slp1: pAdO tasya mahIM vidDi mUrDAnaM divameva ca । bAhavastu diSo dEtya SrotramAkASameva ca ॥21॥

text: tasya tejomayaḥ sūryo manaścandramasi sthitam । buddhirjñānagatā nityaṃ rasastvapsu pravartate ॥22॥
html:
tasya tejomayaḥ sūryo manaścandramasi sthitam ।
buddhirjñānagatā nityaṃ rasastvapsu pravartate ॥22॥
slp1: tasya tejomayaH sUryo manaScandramasi sTitam । budDirjYAnagatA nityaM rasastvapsu pravartate ॥22॥

text: bhruvoranantarāstasya grahā dānavasattama । nakṣatracakraṃ netrābhyāṃ pādayorbhūśca dānava ॥23॥
html:
bhruvoranantarāstasya grahā dānavasattama ।
nakṣatracakraṃ netrābhyāṃ pādayorbhūśca dānava ॥23॥
slp1: BruvoranantarAstasya grahA dAnavasattama । nakzatracakraM netrAByAM pAdayorBUSca dAnava ॥23॥

text: rajastamaśca sattvaṃ ca viddhi nārāyaṇātmakam । so''śramāṇāṃ mukhaṃ tāta karmaṇastatphalaṃ viduḥ ॥24॥
html:
rajastamaśca sattvaṃ ca viddhi nārāyaṇātmakam ।
so''śramāṇāṃ mukhaṃ tāta karmaṇastatphalaṃ viduḥ ॥24॥
slp1: rajastamaSca sattvaM ca vidDi nArAyaRAtmakam । so''SramARAM muKaM tAta karmaRastatPalaM viduH ॥24॥

text: akarmaṇaḥ phalaṃ caiva sa eva paramavyayaḥ । chandāṃsi tasya romāṇi akṣaraṃ ca sarasvatī ॥25॥
html:
akarmaṇaḥ phalaṃ caiva sa eva paramavyayaḥ ।
chandāṃsi tasya romāṇi akṣaraṃ ca sarasvatī ॥25॥
slp1: akarmaRaH PalaM cEva sa eva paramavyayaH । CandAMsi tasya romARi akzaraM ca sarasvatI ॥25॥

text: bahvāśrayo bahumukho dharmo hṛdi samāśritaḥ । sa brahmaparamo dharmastapaśca sadasacca saḥ ॥26॥
html:
bahvāśrayo bahumukho dharmo hṛdi samāśritaḥ ।
sa brahmaparamo dharmastapaśca sadasacca saḥ ॥26॥
slp1: bahvASrayo bahumuKo Darmo hfdi samASritaH । sa brahmaparamo DarmastapaSca sadasacca saH ॥26॥

text: śrutiśāstragrahopetaḥ ṣoḍaśartvikkratuśca saḥ । pitāmahaśca viṣṇuśca so'śvinau sa purandaraḥ ॥27॥
html:
śrutiśāstragrahopetaḥ ṣoḍaśartvikkratuśca saḥ ।
pitāmahaśca viṣṇuśca so'śvinau sa purandaraḥ ॥27॥
slp1: SrutiSAstragrahopetaH zoqaSartvikkratuSca saH । pitAmahaSca vizRuSca so'SvinO sa purandaraH ॥27॥

text: mitraśca varuṇaścaiva yamo'tha dhanadastathā । te pṛthagdarśanāstasya saṃvidanti tathaikatām । ekasya viddhi devasya sarvaṃ jagadidaṃ vaśe ॥28॥
html:
mitraśca varuṇaścaiva yamo'tha dhanadastathā ।
te pṛthagdarśanāstasya saṃvidanti tathaikatām ।
ekasya viddhi devasya sarvaṃ jagadidaṃ vaśe ॥28॥
slp1: mitraSca varuRaScEva yamo'Ta DanadastaTA । te pfTagdarSanAstasya saMvidanti taTEkatAm । ekasya vidDi devasya sarvaM jagadidaM vaSe ॥28॥

text: nānābhūtasya daityendra tasyaikatvaṃ vadatyayam । jantuḥ paśyati jñānena tataḥ sattvaṃ prakāśate ॥29॥
html:
nānābhūtasya daityendra tasyaikatvaṃ vadatyayam ।
jantuḥ paśyati jñānena tataḥ sattvaṃ prakāśate ॥29॥
slp1: nAnABUtasya dEtyendra tasyEkatvaM vadatyayam । jantuH paSyati jYAnena tataH sattvaM prakASate ॥29॥

text: saṃhāravikṣepasahasrakoṭīstiṣṭhanti jīvāḥ pracaranti cānye । prajāvisargasya ca pārimāṇyaṃ vāpīsahasrāṇi bahūni daitya ॥30॥
html:
saṃhāravikṣepasahasrakoṭīstiṣṭhanti jīvāḥ pracaranti cānye ।
prajāvisargasya ca pārimāṇyaṃ vāpīsahasrāṇi bahūni daitya ॥30॥
slp1: saMhAravikzepasahasrakowIstizWanti jIvAH pracaranti cAnye । prajAvisargasya ca pArimARyaM vApIsahasrARi bahUni dEtya ॥30॥

text: vāpyaḥ punaryojanavistṛtāstāḥ krośaṃ ca gambhīratayāvagāḍhāḥ । āyāmataḥ pañcaśatāśca sarvāḥ pratyekaśo yojanataḥ pravṛddhāḥ ॥31॥
html:
vāpyaḥ punaryojanavistṛtāstāḥ krośaṃ ca gambhīratayāvagāḍhāḥ ।
āyāmataḥ pañcaśatāśca sarvāḥ pratyekaśo yojanataḥ pravṛddhāḥ ॥31॥
slp1: vApyaH punaryojanavistftAstAH kroSaM ca gamBIratayAvagAQAH । AyAmataH paYcaSatASca sarvAH pratyekaSo yojanataH pravfdDAH ॥31॥

text: vāpyā jalaṃ kṣipyati vālakoṭyā tvahnā sakṛccāpyatha na dvitīyam । tāsāṃ kṣaye viddhi kṛtaṃ visargaṃ saṃhāramekaṃ ca tathā prajānām ॥32॥
html:
vāpyā jalaṃ kṣipyati vālakoṭyā tvahnā sakṛccāpyatha na dvitīyam ।
tāsāṃ kṣaye viddhi kṛtaṃ visargaṃ saṃhāramekaṃ ca tathā prajānām ॥32॥
slp1: vApyA jalaM kzipyati vAlakowyA tvahnA sakfccApyaTa na dvitIyam । tAsAM kzaye vidDi kftaM visargaM saMhAramekaM ca taTA prajAnAm ॥32॥

text: ṣaḍjīvavarṇāḥ paramaṃ pramāṇaṃ kṛṣṇo dhūmro nīlamathāsya madhyam । raktaṃ punaḥ sahyataraṃ sukhaṃ tu hāridravarṇaṃ susukhaṃ ca śuklam ॥33॥
html:
ṣaḍjīvavarṇāḥ paramaṃ pramāṇaṃ kṛṣṇo dhūmro nīlamathāsya madhyam ।
raktaṃ punaḥ sahyataraṃ sukhaṃ tu hāridravarṇaṃ susukhaṃ ca śuklam ॥33॥
slp1: zaqjIvavarRAH paramaM pramARaM kfzRo DUmro nIlamaTAsya maDyam । raktaM punaH sahyataraM suKaM tu hAridravarRaM susuKaM ca Suklam ॥33॥

text: paraṃ tu śuklaṃ vimalaṃ viśokaṃ gataklamaṃ sidhyati dānavendra । gatvā tu yoniprabhavāni daitya sahasraśaḥ siddhimupaiti jīvaḥ ॥34॥
html:
paraṃ tu śuklaṃ vimalaṃ viśokaṃ gataklamaṃ sidhyati dānavendra ।
gatvā tu yoniprabhavāni daitya sahasraśaḥ siddhimupaiti jīvaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: paraM tu SuklaM vimalaM viSokaM gataklamaM siDyati dAnavendra । gatvA tu yonipraBavAni dEtya sahasraSaH sidDimupEti jIvaH ॥34॥

text: gatiṃ ca yāṃ darśanamāha devo gatvā śubhaṃ darśanameva cāha । gatiḥ punarvarṇakṛtā prajānāṃ varṇastathā kālakṛto'surendra ॥35॥
html:
gatiṃ ca yāṃ darśanamāha devo gatvā śubhaṃ darśanameva cāha ।
gatiḥ punarvarṇakṛtā prajānāṃ varṇastathā kālakṛto'surendra ॥35॥
slp1: gatiM ca yAM darSanamAha devo gatvA SuBaM darSanameva cAha । gatiH punarvarRakftA prajAnAM varRastaTA kAlakfto'surendra ॥35॥

text: śataṃ sahasrāṇi caturdaśeha parā gatirjīvaguṇasya daitya । ārohaṇaṃ tatkṛtameva viddhi sthānaṃ tathā niḥsaraṇaṃ ca teṣām ॥36॥
html:
śataṃ sahasrāṇi caturdaśeha parā gatirjīvaguṇasya daitya ।
ārohaṇaṃ tatkṛtameva viddhi sthānaṃ tathā niḥsaraṇaṃ ca teṣām ॥36॥
slp1: SataM sahasrARi caturdaSeha parA gatirjIvaguRasya dEtya । ArohaRaM tatkftameva vidDi sTAnaM taTA niHsaraRaM ca tezAm ॥36॥

text: kṛṣṇasya varṇasya gatirnikṛṣṭā sa majjate narake pacyamānaḥ । sthānaṃ tathā durgatibhistu tasya prajāvisargānsubahūnvadanti ॥37॥
html:
kṛṣṇasya varṇasya gatirnikṛṣṭā sa majjate narake pacyamānaḥ ।
sthānaṃ tathā durgatibhistu tasya prajāvisargānsubahūnvadanti ॥37॥
slp1: kfzRasya varRasya gatirnikfzwA sa majjate narake pacyamAnaH । sTAnaM taTA durgatiBistu tasya prajAvisargAnsubahUnvadanti ॥37॥

text: śataṃ sahasrāṇi tataścaritvā prāpnoti varṇaṃ haritaṃ tu paścāt । sa caiva tasminnivasatyanīśo yugakṣaye tamasā saṃvṛtātmā ॥38॥
html:
śataṃ sahasrāṇi tataścaritvā prāpnoti varṇaṃ haritaṃ tu paścāt ।
sa caiva tasminnivasatyanīśo yugakṣaye tamasā saṃvṛtātmā ॥38॥
slp1: SataM sahasrARi tataScaritvA prApnoti varRaM haritaM tu paScAt । sa cEva tasminnivasatyanISo yugakzaye tamasA saMvftAtmA ॥38॥

text: sa vai yadā sattvaguṇena yuktastamo vyapohanghaṭate svabuddhyā । sa lohitaṃ varṇamupaiti nīlo manuṣyaloke parivartate ca ॥39॥
html:
sa vai yadā sattvaguṇena yuktastamo vyapohanghaṭate svabuddhyā ।
sa lohitaṃ varṇamupaiti nīlo manuṣyaloke parivartate ca ॥39॥
slp1: sa vE yadA sattvaguRena yuktastamo vyapohanGawate svabudDyA । sa lohitaM varRamupEti nIlo manuzyaloke parivartate ca ॥39॥

text: sa tatra saṃhāravisargameva svakarmajairbandhanaiḥ kliśyamānaḥ । tataḥ sa hāridramupaiti varṇaṃ saṃhāravikṣepaśate vyatīte ॥40॥
html:
sa tatra saṃhāravisargameva svakarmajairbandhanaiḥ kliśyamānaḥ ।
tataḥ sa hāridramupaiti varṇaṃ saṃhāravikṣepaśate vyatīte ॥40॥
slp1: sa tatra saMhAravisargameva svakarmajErbanDanEH kliSyamAnaH । tataH sa hAridramupEti varRaM saMhAravikzepaSate vyatIte ॥40॥

text: hāridravarṇastu prajāvisargānsahasraśastiṣṭhati sañcaranvai । avipramukto niraye ca daitya tataḥ sahasrāṇi daśāparāṇi ॥41॥
html:
hāridravarṇastu prajāvisargānsahasraśastiṣṭhati sañcaranvai ।
avipramukto niraye ca daitya tataḥ sahasrāṇi daśāparāṇi ॥41॥
slp1: hAridravarRastu prajAvisargAnsahasraSastizWati saYcaranvE । avipramukto niraye ca dEtya tataH sahasrARi daSAparARi ॥41॥

text: gatīḥ sahasrāṇi ca pañca tasya catvāri saṃvartakṛtāni caiva । vimuktamenaṃ nirayācca viddhi sarveṣu cānyeṣu ca sambhaveṣu ॥42॥
html:
gatīḥ sahasrāṇi ca pañca tasya catvāri saṃvartakṛtāni caiva ।
vimuktamenaṃ nirayācca viddhi sarveṣu cānyeṣu ca sambhaveṣu ॥42॥
slp1: gatIH sahasrARi ca paYca tasya catvAri saMvartakftAni cEva । vimuktamenaM nirayAcca vidDi sarvezu cAnyezu ca samBavezu ॥42॥

text: sa devaloke viharatyabhīkṣṇaṃ tataścyuto mānuṣatāmupaiti । saṃhāravikṣepaśatāni cāṣṭau martyeṣu tiṣṭhannamṛtatvameti ॥43॥
html:
sa devaloke viharatyabhīkṣṇaṃ tataścyuto mānuṣatāmupaiti ।
saṃhāravikṣepaśatāni cāṣṭau martyeṣu tiṣṭhannamṛtatvameti ॥43॥
slp1: sa devaloke viharatyaBIkzRaM tataScyuto mAnuzatAmupEti । saMhAravikzepaSatAni cAzwO martyezu tizWannamftatvameti ॥43॥

text: so'smādatha bhraśyati kālayogātkṛṣṇe tale tiṣṭhati sarvakaṣṭe । yathā tvayaṃ sidhyati jīvalokastatte'bhidhāsyāmyasurapravīra ॥44॥
html:
so'smādatha bhraśyati kālayogātkṛṣṇe tale tiṣṭhati sarvakaṣṭe ।
yathā tvayaṃ sidhyati jīvalokastatte'bhidhāsyāmyasurapravīra ॥44॥
slp1: so'smAdaTa BraSyati kAlayogAtkfzRe tale tizWati sarvakazwe । yaTA tvayaM siDyati jIvalokastatte'BiDAsyAmyasurapravIra ॥44॥

text: daivāni sa vyūhaśatāni sapta rakto haridro'tha tathaiva śuklaḥ । saṃśritya sandhāvati śuklametamaṣṭāparānarcyatamānsa lokān ॥45॥
html:
daivāni sa vyūhaśatāni sapta rakto haridro'tha tathaiva śuklaḥ ।
saṃśritya sandhāvati śuklametamaṣṭāparānarcyatamānsa lokān ॥45॥
slp1: dEvAni sa vyUhaSatAni sapta rakto haridro'Ta taTEva SuklaH । saMSritya sanDAvati SuklametamazwAparAnarcyatamAnsa lokAn ॥45॥

text: aṣṭau ca ṣaṣṭiṃ ca śatāni yāni manoviruddhāni mahādyutīnām । śuklasya varṇasya parā gatiryā trīṇyeva ruddhāni mahānubhāva ॥46॥
html:
aṣṭau ca ṣaṣṭiṃ ca śatāni yāni manoviruddhāni mahādyutīnām ।
śuklasya varṇasya parā gatiryā trīṇyeva ruddhāni mahānubhāva ॥46॥
slp1: azwO ca zazwiM ca SatAni yAni manovirudDAni mahAdyutInAm । Suklasya varRasya parA gatiryA trIRyeva rudDAni mahAnuBAva ॥46॥

text: saṃhāravikṣepamaniṣṭamekaṃ catvāri cānyāni vasatyanīśaḥ । ṣaṣṭhasya varṇasya parā gatiryā siddhā viśiṣṭasya gataklamasya ॥47॥
html:
saṃhāravikṣepamaniṣṭamekaṃ catvāri cānyāni vasatyanīśaḥ ।
ṣaṣṭhasya varṇasya parā gatiryā siddhā viśiṣṭasya gataklamasya ॥47॥
slp1: saMhAravikzepamanizwamekaM catvAri cAnyAni vasatyanISaH । zazWasya varRasya parA gatiryA sidDA viSizwasya gataklamasya ॥47॥

text: saptottaraṃ teṣu vasatyanīśaḥ saṃhāravikṣepaśataṃ saśeṣam । tasmādupāvṛtya manuṣyaloke tato mahānmānuṣatāmupaiti ॥48॥
html:
saptottaraṃ teṣu vasatyanīśaḥ saṃhāravikṣepaśataṃ saśeṣam ।
tasmādupāvṛtya manuṣyaloke tato mahānmānuṣatāmupaiti ॥48॥
slp1: saptottaraM tezu vasatyanISaH saMhAravikzepaSataM saSezam । tasmAdupAvftya manuzyaloke tato mahAnmAnuzatAmupEti ॥48॥

text: tasmādupāvṛtya tataḥ krameṇa so'gre sma santiṣṭhati bhūtasargam । sa saptakṛtvaśca paraiti lokānsaṃhāravikṣepakṛtapravāsaḥ ॥49॥
html:
tasmādupāvṛtya tataḥ krameṇa so'gre sma santiṣṭhati bhūtasargam ।
sa saptakṛtvaśca paraiti lokānsaṃhāravikṣepakṛtapravāsaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: tasmAdupAvftya tataH krameRa so'gre sma santizWati BUtasargam । sa saptakftvaSca parEti lokAnsaMhAravikzepakftapravAsaH ॥49॥

text: saptaiva saṃhāramupaplavāni sambhāvya santiṣṭhati siddhaloke । tato'vyayaṃ sthānamanantameti devasya viṣṇoratha brahmaṇaśca । śeṣasya caivātha narasya caiva devasya viṣṇoḥ paramasya caiva ॥50॥
html:
saptaiva saṃhāramupaplavāni sambhāvya santiṣṭhati siddhaloke ।
tato'vyayaṃ sthānamanantameti devasya viṣṇoratha brahmaṇaśca ।
śeṣasya caivātha narasya caiva devasya viṣṇoḥ paramasya caiva ॥50॥
slp1: saptEva saMhAramupaplavAni samBAvya santizWati sidDaloke । tato'vyayaM sTAnamanantameti devasya vizRoraTa brahmaRaSca । Sezasya cEvATa narasya cEva devasya vizRoH paramasya cEva ॥50॥

text: saṃhārakāle paridagdhakāyā brahmāṇamāyānti sadā prajā hi । ceṣṭātmano devagaṇāśca sarve ye brahmalokādamarāḥ sma te'pi ॥51॥
html:
saṃhārakāle paridagdhakāyā brahmāṇamāyānti sadā prajā hi ।
ceṣṭātmano devagaṇāśca sarve ye brahmalokādamarāḥ sma te'pi ॥51॥
slp1: saMhArakAle paridagDakAyA brahmARamAyAnti sadA prajA hi । cezwAtmano devagaRASca sarve ye brahmalokAdamarAH sma te'pi ॥51॥

text: prajāvisargaṃ tu saśeṣakālaṃ sthānāni svānyeva saranti jīvāḥ । niḥśeṣāṇāṃ tatpadaṃ yānti cānte sarvāpadā ye sadṛśā manuṣyāḥ ॥52॥
html:
prajāvisargaṃ tu saśeṣakālaṃ sthānāni svānyeva saranti jīvāḥ ।
niḥśeṣāṇāṃ tatpadaṃ yānti cānte sarvāpadā ye sadṛśā manuṣyāḥ ॥52॥
slp1: prajAvisargaM tu saSezakAlaM sTAnAni svAnyeva saranti jIvAH । niHSezARAM tatpadaM yAnti cAnte sarvApadA ye sadfSA manuzyAH ॥52॥

text: ye tu cyutāḥ siddhalokātkrameṇa teṣāṃ gatiṃ yānti tathānupūrvyā । jīvāḥ pare tadbalaveṣarūpā vidhiṃ svakaṃ yānti viparyayeṇa ॥53॥
html:
ye tu cyutāḥ siddhalokātkrameṇa teṣāṃ gatiṃ yānti tathānupūrvyā ।
jīvāḥ pare tadbalaveṣarūpā vidhiṃ svakaṃ yānti viparyayeṇa ॥53॥
slp1: ye tu cyutAH sidDalokAtkrameRa tezAM gatiM yAnti taTAnupUrvyA । jIvAH pare tadbalavezarUpA viDiM svakaM yAnti viparyayeRa ॥53॥

text: sa yāvadevāsti saśeṣabhukte prajāśca devyau ca tathaiva śukle । tāvattadā teṣu viśuddhabhāvaḥ saṃyamya pañcendriyarūpametat ॥54॥
html:
sa yāvadevāsti saśeṣabhukte prajāśca devyau ca tathaiva śukle ।
tāvattadā teṣu viśuddhabhāvaḥ saṃyamya pañcendriyarūpametat ॥54॥
slp1: sa yAvadevAsti saSezaBukte prajASca devyO ca taTEva Sukle । tAvattadA tezu viSudDaBAvaH saMyamya paYcendriyarUpametat ॥54॥

text: śuddhāṃ gatiṃ tāṃ paramāṃ paraiti śuddhena nityaṃ manasā vicinvan । tato'vyayaṃ sthānamupaiti brahma duṣprāpamabhyeti sa śāśvataṃ vai । ityetadākhyātamahīnasattva nārāyaṇasyeha balaṃ mayā te ॥55॥
html:
śuddhāṃ gatiṃ tāṃ paramāṃ paraiti śuddhena nityaṃ manasā vicinvan ।
tato'vyayaṃ sthānamupaiti brahma duṣprāpamabhyeti sa śāśvataṃ vai ।
ityetadākhyātamahīnasattva nārāyaṇasyeha balaṃ mayā te ॥55॥
slp1: SudDAM gatiM tAM paramAM parEti SudDena nityaM manasA vicinvan । tato'vyayaM sTAnamupEti brahma duzprApamaByeti sa SASvataM vE । ityetadAKyAtamahInasattva nArAyaRasyeha balaM mayA te ॥55॥

text: evaṃ gate me na viṣādo'sti kaścitsamyakca paśyāmi vacastavaitat । śrutvā ca te vācamadīnasattva vikalmaṣo'smyadya tathā vipāpmā ॥56॥
html:
evaṃ gate me na viṣādo'sti kaścitsamyakca paśyāmi vacastavaitat ।
śrutvā ca te vācamadīnasattva vikalmaṣo'smyadya tathā vipāpmā ॥56॥
slp1: evaM gate me na vizAdo'sti kaScitsamyakca paSyAmi vacastavEtat । SrutvA ca te vAcamadInasattva vikalmazo'smyadya taTA vipApmA ॥56॥
author: vṛtra uvāca ।

text: pravṛttametadbhagavanmaharṣe mahādyuteścakramanantavīryam । viṣṇoranantasya sanātanaṃ tatsthānaṃ sargā yatra sarve pravṛttāḥ । sa vai mahātmā puruṣottamo vai tasmiñjagatsarvamidaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ॥57॥
html:
pravṛttametadbhagavanmaharṣe mahādyuteścakramanantavīryam ।
viṣṇoranantasya sanātanaṃ tatsthānaṃ sargā yatra sarve pravṛttāḥ ।
sa vai mahātmā puruṣottamo vai tasmiñjagatsarvamidaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ॥57॥
slp1: pravfttametadBagavanmaharze mahAdyuteScakramanantavIryam । vizRoranantasya sanAtanaM tatsTAnaM sargA yatra sarve pravfttAH । sa vE mahAtmA puruzottamo vE tasmiYjagatsarvamidaM pratizWitam ॥57॥

text: evamuktvā sa kaunteya vṛtraḥ prāṇānavāsṛjat । yojayitvā tathātmānaṃ paraṃ sthānamavāptavān ॥58॥
html:
evamuktvā sa kaunteya vṛtraḥ prāṇānavāsṛjat ।
yojayitvā tathātmānaṃ paraṃ sthānamavāptavān ॥58॥
slp1: evamuktvA sa kOnteya vftraH prARAnavAsfjat । yojayitvA taTAtmAnaM paraM sTAnamavAptavAn ॥58॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ayaṃ sa bhagavāndevaḥ pitāmaha janārdanaḥ । sanatkumāro vṛtrāya yattadākhyātavānpurā ॥59॥
html:
ayaṃ sa bhagavāndevaḥ pitāmaha janārdanaḥ ।
sanatkumāro vṛtrāya yattadākhyātavānpurā ॥59॥
slp1: ayaM sa BagavAndevaH pitAmaha janArdanaH । sanatkumAro vftrAya yattadAKyAtavAnpurA ॥59॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: mūlasthāyī sa bhagavānsvenānantena tejasā । tatsthaḥ sṛjati tānbhāvānnānārūpānmahātapāḥ ॥60॥
html:
mūlasthāyī sa bhagavānsvenānantena tejasā ।
tatsthaḥ sṛjati tānbhāvānnānārūpānmahātapāḥ ॥60॥
slp1: mUlasTAyI sa BagavAnsvenAnantena tejasA । tatsTaH sfjati tAnBAvAnnAnArUpAnmahAtapAH ॥60॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: turīyārdhena tasyemaṃ viddhi keśavamacyutam । turīyārdhena lokāṃstrīnbhāvayatyeṣa buddhimān ॥61॥
html:
turīyārdhena tasyemaṃ viddhi keśavamacyutam ।
turīyārdhena lokāṃstrīnbhāvayatyeṣa buddhimān ॥61॥
slp1: turIyArDena tasyemaM vidDi keSavamacyutam । turIyArDena lokAMstrInBAvayatyeza budDimAn ॥61॥

text: arvāksthitastu yaḥ sthāyī kalpānte parivartate । sa śete bhagavānapsu yo'sāvatibalaḥ prabhuḥ । tānvidhātā prasannātmā lokāṃścarati śāśvatān ॥62॥
html:
arvāksthitastu yaḥ sthāyī kalpānte parivartate ।
sa śete bhagavānapsu yo'sāvatibalaḥ prabhuḥ ।
tānvidhātā prasannātmā lokāṃścarati śāśvatān ॥62॥
slp1: arvAksTitastu yaH sTAyI kalpAnte parivartate । sa Sete BagavAnapsu yo'sAvatibalaH praBuH । tAnviDAtA prasannAtmA lokAMScarati SASvatAn ॥62॥

text: sarvāṇyaśūnyāni karotyanantaḥ sanatkumāraḥ sañcarate ca lokān । sa cāniruddhaḥ sṛjate mahātmā tatsthaṃ jagatsarvamidaṃ vicitram ॥63॥
html:
sarvāṇyaśūnyāni karotyanantaḥ sanatkumāraḥ sañcarate ca lokān ।
sa cāniruddhaḥ sṛjate mahātmā tatsthaṃ jagatsarvamidaṃ vicitram ॥63॥
slp1: sarvARyaSUnyAni karotyanantaH sanatkumAraH saYcarate ca lokAn । sa cAnirudDaH sfjate mahAtmA tatsTaM jagatsarvamidaM vicitram ॥63॥

text: vṛtreṇa paramārthajña dṛṣṭā manye''tmano gatiḥ । śubhā tasmātsa sukhito na śocati pitāmaha ॥64॥
html:
vṛtreṇa paramārthajña dṛṣṭā manye''tmano gatiḥ ।
śubhā tasmātsa sukhito na śocati pitāmaha ॥64॥
slp1: vftreRa paramArTajYa dfzwA manye''tmano gatiH । SuBA tasmAtsa suKito na Socati pitAmaha ॥64॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: śuklaḥ śuklābhijātīyaḥ sādhyo nāvartate'nagha । tiryaggateśca nirmukto nirayācca pitāmaha ॥65॥
html:
śuklaḥ śuklābhijātīyaḥ sādhyo nāvartate'nagha ।
tiryaggateśca nirmukto nirayācca pitāmaha ॥65॥
slp1: SuklaH SuklABijAtIyaH sADyo nAvartate'naGa । tiryaggateSca nirmukto nirayAcca pitAmaha ॥65॥

text: hāridravarṇe rakte vā vartamānastu pārthiva । tiryagevānupaśyeta karmabhistāmasairvṛtaḥ ॥66॥
html:
hāridravarṇe rakte vā vartamānastu pārthiva ।
tiryagevānupaśyeta karmabhistāmasairvṛtaḥ ॥66॥
slp1: hAridravarRe rakte vA vartamAnastu pArTiva । tiryagevAnupaSyeta karmaBistAmasErvftaH ॥66॥

text: vayaṃ tu bhṛśamāpannā raktāḥ kaṣṭamukhe'sukhe । kāṃ gatiṃ pratipatsyāmo nīlāṃ kṛṣṇādhamāmatha ॥67॥
html:
vayaṃ tu bhṛśamāpannā raktāḥ kaṣṭamukhe'sukhe ।
kāṃ gatiṃ pratipatsyāmo nīlāṃ kṛṣṇādhamāmatha ॥67॥
slp1: vayaM tu BfSamApannA raktAH kazwamuKe'suKe । kAM gatiM pratipatsyAmo nIlAM kfzRADamAmaTa ॥67॥

text: śuddhābhijanasampannāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ saṃśitavratāḥ । vihṛtya devalokeṣu punarmānuṣyameṣyatha ॥68॥
html:
śuddhābhijanasampannāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ saṃśitavratāḥ ।
vihṛtya devalokeṣu punarmānuṣyameṣyatha ॥68॥
slp1: SudDABijanasampannAH pARqavAH saMSitavratAH । vihftya devalokezu punarmAnuzyamezyaTa ॥68॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: prajāvisargaṃ ca sukhena kāle pratyetya deveṣu sukhāni bhuktvā । sukhena saṃyāsyatha siddhasaṅkhyāṃ mā vo bhayaṃ bhūdvimalāḥ stha sarve] ॥69॥
html:
prajāvisargaṃ ca sukhena kāle pratyetya deveṣu sukhāni bhuktvā ।
sukhena saṃyāsyatha siddhasaṅkhyāṃ mā vo bhayaṃ bhūdvimalāḥ stha sarve] ॥69॥
slp1: prajAvisargaM ca suKena kAle pratyetya devezu suKAni BuktvA । suKena saMyAsyaTa sidDasaNKyAM mA vo BayaM BUdvimalAH sTa sarve] ॥69॥

text: aho dharmiṣṭhatā tāta vṛtrasyāmitatejasaḥ । yasya vijñānamatulaṃ viṣṇorbhaktiśca tādṛśī ॥1॥
html:
aho dharmiṣṭhatā tāta vṛtrasyāmitatejasaḥ ।
yasya vijñānamatulaṃ viṣṇorbhaktiśca tādṛśī ॥1॥
slp1: aho DarmizWatA tAta vftrasyAmitatejasaH । yasya vijYAnamatulaM vizRorBaktiSca tAdfSI ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: durvijñeyamidaṃ tāta viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ । kathaṃ vā rājaśārdūla padaṃ tajjñātavānasau ॥2॥
html:
durvijñeyamidaṃ tāta viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ ।
kathaṃ vā rājaśārdūla padaṃ tajjñātavānasau ॥2॥
slp1: durvijYeyamidaM tAta vizRoramitatejasaH । kaTaM vA rAjaSArdUla padaM tajjYAtavAnasO ॥2॥

text: bhavatā kathitaṃ hyetacchraddadhe cāhamacyuta । bhūyastu me samutpannā buddhiravyaktadarśanāt ॥3॥
html:
bhavatā kathitaṃ hyetacchraddadhe cāhamacyuta ।
bhūyastu me samutpannā buddhiravyaktadarśanāt ॥3॥
slp1: BavatA kaTitaM hyetacCraddaDe cAhamacyuta । BUyastu me samutpannA budDiravyaktadarSanAt ॥3॥

text: kathaṃ vinihato vṛtraḥ śakreṇa bharatarṣabha । dharmiṣṭho viṣṇubhaktaśca tattvajñaśca padānvaye ॥4॥
html:
kathaṃ vinihato vṛtraḥ śakreṇa bharatarṣabha ।
dharmiṣṭho viṣṇubhaktaśca tattvajñaśca padānvaye ॥4॥
slp1: kaTaM vinihato vftraH SakreRa BaratarzaBa । DarmizWo vizRuBaktaSca tattvajYaSca padAnvaye ॥4॥

text: etanme saṃśayaṃ brūhi pṛcchato bharatarṣabha । vṛtrastu rājaśārdūla yathā śakreṇa nirjitaḥ ॥5॥
html:
etanme saṃśayaṃ brūhi pṛcchato bharatarṣabha ।
vṛtrastu rājaśārdūla yathā śakreṇa nirjitaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: etanme saMSayaM brUhi pfcCato BaratarzaBa । vftrastu rAjaSArdUla yaTA SakreRa nirjitaH ॥5॥

text: yathā caivābhavadyuddhaṃ taccācakṣva pitāmaha । vistareṇa mahābāho paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ॥6॥
html:
yathā caivābhavadyuddhaṃ taccācakṣva pitāmaha ।
vistareṇa mahābāho paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ॥6॥
slp1: yaTA cEvABavadyudDaM taccAcakzva pitAmaha । vistareRa mahAbAho paraM kOtUhalaM hi me ॥6॥

text: rathenendraḥ prayāto vai sārdhaṃ suragaṇaiḥ purā । dadarśāthāgrato vṛtraṃ viṣṭhitaṃ parvatopamam ॥7॥
html:
rathenendraḥ prayāto vai sārdhaṃ suragaṇaiḥ purā ।
dadarśāthāgrato vṛtraṃ viṣṭhitaṃ parvatopamam ॥7॥
slp1: raTenendraH prayAto vE sArDaM suragaREH purA । dadarSATAgrato vftraM vizWitaM parvatopamam ॥7॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yojanānāṃ śatānyūrdhvaṃ pañcocchritamarindama । śatāni vistareṇātha trīṇyevābhyadhikāni tu ॥8॥
html:
yojanānāṃ śatānyūrdhvaṃ pañcocchritamarindama ।
śatāni vistareṇātha trīṇyevābhyadhikāni tu ॥8॥
slp1: yojanAnAM SatAnyUrDvaM paYcocCritamarindama । SatAni vistareRATa trIRyevAByaDikAni tu ॥8॥

text: tatprekṣya tādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ trailokyenāpi durjayam । vṛtrasya devāḥ santrastā na śāntimupalebhire ॥9॥
html:
tatprekṣya tādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ trailokyenāpi durjayam ।
vṛtrasya devāḥ santrastā na śāntimupalebhire ॥9॥
slp1: tatprekzya tAdfSaM rUpaM trElokyenApi durjayam । vftrasya devAH santrastA na SAntimupaleBire ॥9॥

text: śakrasya tu tadā rājannūrustambho vyajāyata । bhayādvṛtrasya sahasā dṛṣṭvā tadrūpamuttamam ॥10॥
html:
śakrasya tu tadā rājannūrustambho vyajāyata ।
bhayādvṛtrasya sahasā dṛṣṭvā tadrūpamuttamam ॥10॥
slp1: Sakrasya tu tadA rAjannUrustamBo vyajAyata । BayAdvftrasya sahasA dfzwvA tadrUpamuttamam ॥10॥

text: tato nādaḥ samabhavadvāditrāṇāṃ ca nisvanaḥ । devāsurāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ tasminyuddha upasthite ॥11॥
html:
tato nādaḥ samabhavadvāditrāṇāṃ ca nisvanaḥ ।
devāsurāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ tasminyuddha upasthite ॥11॥
slp1: tato nAdaH samaBavadvAditrARAM ca nisvanaH । devAsurARAM sarvezAM tasminyudDa upasTite ॥11॥

text: atha vṛtrasya kauravya dṛṣṭvā śakramupasthitam । na sambhramo na bhīḥ kācidāsthā vā samajāyata ॥12॥
html:
atha vṛtrasya kauravya dṛṣṭvā śakramupasthitam ।
na sambhramo na bhīḥ kācidāsthā vā samajāyata ॥12॥
slp1: aTa vftrasya kOravya dfzwvA SakramupasTitam । na samBramo na BIH kAcidAsTA vA samajAyata ॥12॥

text: tataḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ trailokyasya bhayaṅkaram । śakrasya ca surendrasya vṛtrasya ca mahātmanaḥ ॥13॥
html:
tataḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ trailokyasya bhayaṅkaram ।
śakrasya ca surendrasya vṛtrasya ca mahātmanaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: tataH samaBavadyudDaM trElokyasya BayaNkaram । Sakrasya ca surendrasya vftrasya ca mahAtmanaH ॥13॥

text: asibhiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ śūlaiḥ śaktitomaramudgaraiḥ । śilābhirvividhābhiśca kārmukaiśca mahāsvanaiḥ ॥14॥
html:
asibhiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ śūlaiḥ śaktitomaramudgaraiḥ ।
śilābhirvividhābhiśca kārmukaiśca mahāsvanaiḥ ॥14॥
slp1: asiBiH pawwiSEH SUlEH SaktitomaramudgarEH । SilABirviviDABiSca kArmukESca mahAsvanEH ॥14॥

text: astraiśca vividhairdivyaiḥ pāvakolkābhireva ca । devāsuraistataḥ sainyaiḥ sarvamāsītsamākulam ॥15॥
html:
astraiśca vividhairdivyaiḥ pāvakolkābhireva ca ।
devāsuraistataḥ sainyaiḥ sarvamāsītsamākulam ॥15॥
slp1: astrESca viviDErdivyEH pAvakolkABireva ca । devAsurEstataH sEnyEH sarvamAsItsamAkulam ॥15॥

text: pitāmahapurogāśca sarve devagaṇāstathā । ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgāstadyuddhaṃ draṣṭumāgaman ॥16॥
html:
pitāmahapurogāśca sarve devagaṇāstathā ।
ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgāstadyuddhaṃ draṣṭumāgaman ॥16॥
slp1: pitAmahapurogASca sarve devagaRAstaTA । fzayaSca mahABAgAstadyudDaM drazwumAgaman ॥16॥

text: vimānāgryairmahārāja siddhāśca bharatarṣabha । gandharvāśca vimānāgryairapsarobhiḥ samāgaman ॥17॥
html:
vimānāgryairmahārāja siddhāśca bharatarṣabha ।
gandharvāśca vimānāgryairapsarobhiḥ samāgaman ॥17॥
slp1: vimAnAgryErmahArAja sidDASca BaratarzaBa । ganDarvASca vimAnAgryErapsaroBiH samAgaman ॥17॥

text: tato'ntarikṣamāvṛtya vṛtro dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ । aśmavarṣeṇa devendraṃ parvatātsamavākirat ॥18॥
html:
tato'ntarikṣamāvṛtya vṛtro dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ।
aśmavarṣeṇa devendraṃ parvatātsamavākirat ॥18॥
slp1: tato'ntarikzamAvftya vftro DarmaBftAM varaH । aSmavarzeRa devendraM parvatAtsamavAkirat ॥18॥

text: tato devagaṇāḥ kruddhāḥ sarvataḥ śastravṛṣṭibhiḥ । aśmavarṣamapohanta vṛtrapreritamāhave ॥19॥
html:
tato devagaṇāḥ kruddhāḥ sarvataḥ śastravṛṣṭibhiḥ ।
aśmavarṣamapohanta vṛtrapreritamāhave ॥19॥
slp1: tato devagaRAH krudDAH sarvataH SastravfzwiBiH । aSmavarzamapohanta vftrapreritamAhave ॥19॥

text: vṛtraśca kuruśārdūla mahāmāyo mahābalaḥ । mohayāmāsa devendraṃ māyāyuddhena sarvataḥ ॥20॥
html:
vṛtraśca kuruśārdūla mahāmāyo mahābalaḥ ।
mohayāmāsa devendraṃ māyāyuddhena sarvataḥ ॥20॥
slp1: vftraSca kuruSArdUla mahAmAyo mahAbalaH । mohayAmAsa devendraM mAyAyudDena sarvataH ॥20॥

text: tasya vṛtrārditasyātha moha āsīcchatakratoḥ । rathantareṇa taṃ tatra vasiṣṭhaḥ samabodhayat ॥21॥
html:
tasya vṛtrārditasyātha moha āsīcchatakratoḥ ।
rathantareṇa taṃ tatra vasiṣṭhaḥ samabodhayat ॥21॥
slp1: tasya vftrArditasyATa moha AsIcCatakratoH । raTantareRa taM tatra vasizWaH samaboDayat ॥21॥

text: devaśreṣṭho'si devendra surārivinibarhaṇa । trailokyabalasaṃyuktaḥ kasmācchakra viṣīdasi ॥22॥
html:
devaśreṣṭho'si devendra surārivinibarhaṇa ।
trailokyabalasaṃyuktaḥ kasmācchakra viṣīdasi ॥22॥
slp1: devaSrezWo'si devendra surArivinibarhaRa । trElokyabalasaMyuktaH kasmAcCakra vizIdasi ॥22॥
author: vasiṣṭha uvāca ।

text: eṣa brahmā ca viṣṇuśca śivaścaiva jagatprabhuḥ । somaśca bhagavāndevaḥ sarve ca paramarṣayaḥ ॥23॥
html:
eṣa brahmā ca viṣṇuśca śivaścaiva jagatprabhuḥ ।
somaśca bhagavāndevaḥ sarve ca paramarṣayaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: eza brahmA ca vizRuSca SivaScEva jagatpraBuH । somaSca BagavAndevaH sarve ca paramarzayaH ॥23॥

text: mā kārṣīḥ kaśmalaṃ śakra kaścidevetaro yathā । āryāṃ yuddhe matiṃ kṛtvā jahi śatruṃ sureśvara ॥24॥
html:
mā kārṣīḥ kaśmalaṃ śakra kaścidevetaro yathā ।
āryāṃ yuddhe matiṃ kṛtvā jahi śatruṃ sureśvara ॥24॥
slp1: mA kArzIH kaSmalaM Sakra kaScidevetaro yaTA । AryAM yudDe matiM kftvA jahi SatruM sureSvara ॥24॥

text: eṣa lokagurustryakṣaḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ । nirīkṣate tvāṃ bhagavāṃstyaja mohaṃ sureśvara ॥25॥
html:
eṣa lokagurustryakṣaḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ ।
nirīkṣate tvāṃ bhagavāṃstyaja mohaṃ sureśvara ॥25॥
slp1: eza lokagurustryakzaH sarvalokanamaskftaH । nirIkzate tvAM BagavAMstyaja mohaM sureSvara ॥25॥

text: ete brahmarṣayaścaiva bṛhaspatipurogamāḥ । stavena śakra divyena stuvanti tvāṃ jayāya vai ॥26॥
html:
ete brahmarṣayaścaiva bṛhaspatipurogamāḥ ।
stavena śakra divyena stuvanti tvāṃ jayāya vai ॥26॥
slp1: ete brahmarzayaScEva bfhaspatipurogamAH । stavena Sakra divyena stuvanti tvAM jayAya vE ॥26॥

text: evaṃ sambodhyamānasya vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā । atīva vāsavasyāsīdbalamuttamatejasaḥ ॥27॥
html:
evaṃ sambodhyamānasya vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā ।
atīva vāsavasyāsīdbalamuttamatejasaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: evaM samboDyamAnasya vasizWena mahAtmanA । atIva vAsavasyAsIdbalamuttamatejasaH ॥27॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tato buddhimupāgamya bhagavānpākaśāsanaḥ । yogena mahatā yuktastāṃ māyāṃ vyapakarṣata ॥28॥
html:
tato buddhimupāgamya bhagavānpākaśāsanaḥ ।
yogena mahatā yuktastāṃ māyāṃ vyapakarṣata ॥28॥
slp1: tato budDimupAgamya BagavAnpAkaSAsanaH । yogena mahatA yuktastAM mAyAM vyapakarzata ॥28॥

text: tato'ṅgiraḥsutaḥ śrīmāṃste caiva paramarṣayaḥ । dṛṣṭvā vṛtrasya vikrāntamupagamya maheśvaram । ūcurvṛtravināśārthaṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ॥29॥
html:
tato'ṅgiraḥsutaḥ śrīmāṃste caiva paramarṣayaḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā vṛtrasya vikrāntamupagamya maheśvaram ।
ūcurvṛtravināśārthaṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ॥29॥
slp1: tato'NgiraHsutaH SrImAMste cEva paramarzayaH । dfzwvA vftrasya vikrAntamupagamya maheSvaram । UcurvftravinASArTaM lokAnAM hitakAmyayA ॥29॥

text: tato bhagavatastejo jvaro bhūtvā jagatpateḥ । samāviśanmahāraudraṃ vṛtraṃ daityavaraṃ tadā ॥30॥
html:
tato bhagavatastejo jvaro bhūtvā jagatpateḥ ।
samāviśanmahāraudraṃ vṛtraṃ daityavaraṃ tadā ॥30॥
slp1: tato Bagavatastejo jvaro BUtvA jagatpateH । samAviSanmahArOdraM vftraM dEtyavaraM tadA ॥30॥

text: viṣṇuśca bhagavāndevaḥ sarvalokābhipūjitaḥ । aindraṃ samāviśadvajraṃ lokasaṃrakṣaṇe rataḥ ॥31॥
html:
viṣṇuśca bhagavāndevaḥ sarvalokābhipūjitaḥ ।
aindraṃ samāviśadvajraṃ lokasaṃrakṣaṇe rataḥ ॥31॥
slp1: vizRuSca BagavAndevaH sarvalokABipUjitaH । EndraM samAviSadvajraM lokasaMrakzaRe rataH ॥31॥

text: tato bṛhaspatirdhīmānupāgamya śatakratum । vasiṣṭhaśca mahātejāḥ sarve ca paramarṣayaḥ ॥32॥
html:
tato bṛhaspatirdhīmānupāgamya śatakratum ।
vasiṣṭhaśca mahātejāḥ sarve ca paramarṣayaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: tato bfhaspatirDImAnupAgamya Satakratum । vasizWaSca mahAtejAH sarve ca paramarzayaH ॥32॥

text: te samāsādya varadaṃ vāsavaṃ lokapūjitam । ūcurekāgramanaso jahi vṛtramiti prabho ॥33॥
html:
te samāsādya varadaṃ vāsavaṃ lokapūjitam ।
ūcurekāgramanaso jahi vṛtramiti prabho ॥33॥
slp1: te samAsAdya varadaM vAsavaM lokapUjitam । UcurekAgramanaso jahi vftramiti praBo ॥33॥

text: eṣa vṛtro mahāñśakra balena mahatā vṛtaḥ । viśvātmā sarvagaścaiva bahumāyaśca viśrutaḥ ॥34॥
html:
eṣa vṛtro mahāñśakra balena mahatā vṛtaḥ ।
viśvātmā sarvagaścaiva bahumāyaśca viśrutaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: eza vftro mahAYSakra balena mahatA vftaH । viSvAtmA sarvagaScEva bahumAyaSca viSrutaH ॥34॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: tadenamasuraśreṣṭhaṃ trailokyenāpi durjayam । jahi tvaṃ yogamāsthāya māvamaṃsthāḥ sureśvara ॥35॥
html:
tadenamasuraśreṣṭhaṃ trailokyenāpi durjayam ।
jahi tvaṃ yogamāsthāya māvamaṃsthāḥ sureśvara ॥35॥
slp1: tadenamasuraSrezWaM trElokyenApi durjayam । jahi tvaM yogamAsTAya mAvamaMsTAH sureSvara ॥35॥

text: anena hi tapastaptaṃ balārthamamarādhipa । ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣasahasrāṇi brahmā cāsmai varaṃ dadau ॥36॥
html:
anena hi tapastaptaṃ balārthamamarādhipa ।
ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣasahasrāṇi brahmā cāsmai varaṃ dadau ॥36॥
slp1: anena hi tapastaptaM balArTamamarADipa । zazwiM varzasahasrARi brahmA cAsmE varaM dadO ॥36॥

text: mahattvaṃ yogināṃ caiva mahāmāyatvameva ca । mahābalatvaṃ ca tathā tejaścāgryaṃ sureśvara ॥37॥
html:
mahattvaṃ yogināṃ caiva mahāmāyatvameva ca ।
mahābalatvaṃ ca tathā tejaścāgryaṃ sureśvara ॥37॥
slp1: mahattvaM yoginAM cEva mahAmAyatvameva ca । mahAbalatvaM ca taTA tejaScAgryaM sureSvara ॥37॥

text: etadvai māmakaṃ tejaḥ samāviśati vāsava । vṛtramenaṃ tvamapyevaṃ jahi vajreṇa dānavam ॥38॥
html:
etadvai māmakaṃ tejaḥ samāviśati vāsava ।
vṛtramenaṃ tvamapyevaṃ jahi vajreṇa dānavam ॥38॥
slp1: etadvE mAmakaM tejaH samAviSati vAsava । vftramenaM tvamapyevaM jahi vajreRa dAnavam ॥38॥

text: bhagavaṃstvatprasādena ditijaṃ sudurāsadam । vajreṇa nihaniṣyāmi paśyataste surarṣabha ॥39॥
html:
bhagavaṃstvatprasādena ditijaṃ sudurāsadam ।
vajreṇa nihaniṣyāmi paśyataste surarṣabha ॥39॥
slp1: BagavaMstvatprasAdena ditijaM sudurAsadam । vajreRa nihanizyAmi paSyataste surarzaBa ॥39॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: āviśyamāne daitye tu jvareṇātha mahāsure । devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca harṣānnādo mahānabhūt ॥40॥
html:
āviśyamāne daitye tu jvareṇātha mahāsure ।
devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca harṣānnādo mahānabhūt ॥40॥
slp1: AviSyamAne dEtye tu jvareRATa mahAsure । devatAnAmfzIRAM ca harzAnnAdo mahAnaBUt ॥40॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tato dundubhayaścaiva śaṅkhāśca sumahāsvanāḥ । murajā ḍiṇḍimāścaiva prāvādyanta sahasraśaḥ ॥41॥
html:
tato dundubhayaścaiva śaṅkhāśca sumahāsvanāḥ ।
murajā ḍiṇḍimāścaiva prāvādyanta sahasraśaḥ ॥41॥
slp1: tato dunduBayaScEva SaNKASca sumahAsvanAH । murajA qiRqimAScEva prAvAdyanta sahasraSaH ॥41॥

text: asurāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ smṛtilopo'bhavanmahān । prajñānāśaśca balavānkṣaṇena samapadyata ॥42॥
html:
asurāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ smṛtilopo'bhavanmahān ।
prajñānāśaśca balavānkṣaṇena samapadyata ॥42॥
slp1: asurARAM tu sarvezAM smftilopo'BavanmahAn । prajYAnASaSca balavAnkzaRena samapadyata ॥42॥

text: tamāviṣṭamatho jñātvā ṛṣayo devatāstathā । stuvantaḥ śakramīśānaṃ tathā prācodayannapi ॥43॥
html:
tamāviṣṭamatho jñātvā ṛṣayo devatāstathā ।
stuvantaḥ śakramīśānaṃ tathā prācodayannapi ॥43॥
slp1: tamAvizwamaTo jYAtvA fzayo devatAstaTA । stuvantaH SakramISAnaM taTA prAcodayannapi ॥43॥

text: rathasthasya hi śakrasya yuddhakāle mahātmanaḥ । ṛṣibhiḥ stūyamānasya rūpamāsītsudurdṛśam] ॥44॥
html:
rathasthasya hi śakrasya yuddhakāle mahātmanaḥ ।
ṛṣibhiḥ stūyamānasya rūpamāsītsudurdṛśam] ॥44॥
slp1: raTasTasya hi Sakrasya yudDakAle mahAtmanaH । fziBiH stUyamAnasya rUpamAsItsudurdfSam] ॥44॥

text: vṛtrasya tu mahārāja jvarāviṣṭasya sarvaśaḥ । abhavanyāni liṅgāni śarīre tāni me śṛṇu ॥1॥
html:
vṛtrasya tu mahārāja jvarāviṣṭasya sarvaśaḥ ।
abhavanyāni liṅgāni śarīre tāni me śṛṇu ॥1॥
slp1: vftrasya tu mahArAja jvarAvizwasya sarvaSaH । aBavanyAni liNgAni SarIre tAni me SfRu ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: jvalitāsyo'bhavadghoro vaivarṇyaṃ cāgamatparam । gātrakampaśca sumahāñśvāsaścāpyabhavanmahān । romaharṣaśca tīvro'bhūnniḥśvāsaśca mahānnṛpa ॥2॥
html:
jvalitāsyo'bhavadghoro vaivarṇyaṃ cāgamatparam ।
gātrakampaśca sumahāñśvāsaścāpyabhavanmahān ।
romaharṣaśca tīvro'bhūnniḥśvāsaśca mahānnṛpa ॥2॥
slp1: jvalitAsyo'BavadGoro vEvarRyaM cAgamatparam । gAtrakampaSca sumahAYSvAsaScApyaBavanmahAn । romaharzaSca tIvro'BUnniHSvAsaSca mahAnnfpa ॥2॥

text: śivā cāśivasaṅkāśā tasya vaktrātsudāruṇā । niṣpapāta mahāghorā smṛtiḥ sā tasya bhārata । ulkāśca jvalitāstasya dīptāḥ pārśve prapedire ॥3॥
html:
śivā cāśivasaṅkāśā tasya vaktrātsudāruṇā ।
niṣpapāta mahāghorā smṛtiḥ sā tasya bhārata ।
ulkāśca jvalitāstasya dīptāḥ pārśve prapedire ॥3॥
slp1: SivA cASivasaNkASA tasya vaktrAtsudAruRA । nizpapAta mahAGorA smftiH sA tasya BArata । ulkASca jvalitAstasya dIptAH pArSve prapedire ॥3॥

text: gṛdhrakaṅkavaḍāścaiva vāco'muñcansudāruṇāḥ । vṛtrasyopari saṃhṛṣṭāścakravatparibabhramuḥ ॥4॥
html:
gṛdhrakaṅkavaḍāścaiva vāco'muñcansudāruṇāḥ ।
vṛtrasyopari saṃhṛṣṭāścakravatparibabhramuḥ ॥4॥
slp1: gfDrakaNkavaqAScEva vAco'muYcansudAruRAH । vftrasyopari saMhfzwAScakravatparibaBramuH ॥4॥

text: tatastaṃ rathamāsthāya devāpyāyitamāhave । vajrodyatakaraḥ śakrastaṃ daityaṃ pratyavaikṣata ॥5॥
html:
tatastaṃ rathamāsthāya devāpyāyitamāhave ।
vajrodyatakaraḥ śakrastaṃ daityaṃ pratyavaikṣata ॥5॥
slp1: tatastaM raTamAsTAya devApyAyitamAhave । vajrodyatakaraH SakrastaM dEtyaM pratyavEkzata ॥5॥

text: amānuṣamatho nādaṃ sa mumoca mahāsuraḥ । vyajṛmbhata ca rājendra tīvrajvarasamanvitaḥ । athāsya jṛmbhataḥ śakrastato vajramavāsṛjat ॥6॥
html:
amānuṣamatho nādaṃ sa mumoca mahāsuraḥ ।
vyajṛmbhata ca rājendra tīvrajvarasamanvitaḥ ।
athāsya jṛmbhataḥ śakrastato vajramavāsṛjat ॥6॥
slp1: amAnuzamaTo nAdaM sa mumoca mahAsuraH । vyajfmBata ca rAjendra tIvrajvarasamanvitaH । aTAsya jfmBataH Sakrastato vajramavAsfjat ॥6॥

text: sa vajraḥ sumahātejāḥ kālāgnisadṛśopamaḥ । kṣiprameva mahākāyaṃ vṛtraṃ daityamapātayat ॥7॥
html:
sa vajraḥ sumahātejāḥ kālāgnisadṛśopamaḥ ।
kṣiprameva mahākāyaṃ vṛtraṃ daityamapātayat ॥7॥
slp1: sa vajraH sumahAtejAH kAlAgnisadfSopamaH । kziprameva mahAkAyaM vftraM dEtyamapAtayat ॥7॥

text: tato nādaḥ samabhavatpunareva samantataḥ । vṛtraṃ vinihataṃ dṛṣṭvā devānāṃ bharatarṣabha ॥8॥
html:
tato nādaḥ samabhavatpunareva samantataḥ ।
vṛtraṃ vinihataṃ dṛṣṭvā devānāṃ bharatarṣabha ॥8॥
slp1: tato nAdaH samaBavatpunareva samantataH । vftraM vinihataM dfzwvA devAnAM BaratarzaBa ॥8॥

text: vṛtraṃ tu hatvā bhagavāndānavārirmahāyaśāḥ । vajreṇa viṣṇuyuktena divameva samāviśat ॥9॥
html:
vṛtraṃ tu hatvā bhagavāndānavārirmahāyaśāḥ ।
vajreṇa viṣṇuyuktena divameva samāviśat ॥9॥
slp1: vftraM tu hatvA BagavAndAnavArirmahAyaSAH । vajreRa vizRuyuktena divameva samAviSat ॥9॥

text: atha vṛtrasya kauravya śarīrādabhiniḥsṛtā । brahmahatyā mahāghorā raudrā lokabhayāvahā ॥10॥
html:
atha vṛtrasya kauravya śarīrādabhiniḥsṛtā ।
brahmahatyā mahāghorā raudrā lokabhayāvahā ॥10॥
slp1: aTa vftrasya kOravya SarIrAdaBiniHsftA । brahmahatyA mahAGorA rOdrA lokaBayAvahA ॥10॥

text: karāladaśanā bhīmā vikṛtā kṛṣṇapiṅgalā । prakīrṇamūrdhajā caiva ghoranetrā ca bhārata ॥11॥
html:
karāladaśanā bhīmā vikṛtā kṛṣṇapiṅgalā ।
prakīrṇamūrdhajā caiva ghoranetrā ca bhārata ॥11॥
slp1: karAladaSanA BImA vikftA kfzRapiNgalA । prakIrRamUrDajA cEva GoranetrA ca BArata ॥11॥

text: kapālamālinī caiva kṛśā ca bharatarṣabha । rudhirārdrā ca dharmajña cīravastranivāsinī ॥12॥
html:
kapālamālinī caiva kṛśā ca bharatarṣabha ।
rudhirārdrā ca dharmajña cīravastranivāsinī ॥12॥
slp1: kapAlamAlinI cEva kfSA ca BaratarzaBa । ruDirArdrA ca DarmajYa cIravastranivAsinI ॥12॥

text: sābhiniṣkramya rājendra tādṛgrūpā bhayāvahā । vajriṇaṃ mṛgayāmāsa tadā bharatasattama ॥13॥
html:
sābhiniṣkramya rājendra tādṛgrūpā bhayāvahā ।
vajriṇaṃ mṛgayāmāsa tadā bharatasattama ॥13॥
slp1: sABinizkramya rAjendra tAdfgrUpA BayAvahA । vajriRaM mfgayAmAsa tadA Baratasattama ॥13॥

text: kasyacittvatha kālasya vṛtrahā kurunandana । svargāyābhimukhaḥ prāyāllokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ॥14॥
html:
kasyacittvatha kālasya vṛtrahā kurunandana ।
svargāyābhimukhaḥ prāyāllokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ॥14॥
slp1: kasyacittvaTa kAlasya vftrahA kurunandana । svargAyABimuKaH prAyAllokAnAM hitakAmyayA ॥14॥

text: bisānniḥsaramāṇaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā śakraṃ mahaujasam । kaṇṭhe jagrāha devendraṃ sulagnā cābhavattadā ॥15॥
html:
bisānniḥsaramāṇaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā śakraṃ mahaujasam ।
kaṇṭhe jagrāha devendraṃ sulagnā cābhavattadā ॥15॥
slp1: bisAnniHsaramARaM tu dfzwvA SakraM mahOjasam । kaRWe jagrAha devendraM sulagnA cABavattadA ॥15॥

text: sa hi tasminsamutpanne brahmahatyākṛte bhaye । nalinyāṃ bisamadhyastho babhūvābdagaṇānbahūn ॥16॥
html:
sa hi tasminsamutpanne brahmahatyākṛte bhaye ।
nalinyāṃ bisamadhyastho babhūvābdagaṇānbahūn ॥16॥
slp1: sa hi tasminsamutpanne brahmahatyAkfte Baye । nalinyAM bisamaDyasTo baBUvAbdagaRAnbahUn ॥16॥

text: anusṛtya tu yatnātsa tayā vai brahmahatyayā । tadā gṛhītaḥ kauravya niśceṣṭaḥ samapadyata ॥17॥
html:
anusṛtya tu yatnātsa tayā vai brahmahatyayā ।
tadā gṛhītaḥ kauravya niśceṣṭaḥ samapadyata ॥17॥
slp1: anusftya tu yatnAtsa tayA vE brahmahatyayA । tadA gfhItaH kOravya niScezwaH samapadyata ॥17॥

text: tasyā vyapohane śakraḥ paraṃ yatnaṃ cakāra ha । na cāśakattāṃ devendro brahmahatyāṃ vyapohitum ॥18॥
html:
tasyā vyapohane śakraḥ paraṃ yatnaṃ cakāra ha ।
na cāśakattāṃ devendro brahmahatyāṃ vyapohitum ॥18॥
slp1: tasyA vyapohane SakraH paraM yatnaM cakAra ha । na cASakattAM devendro brahmahatyAM vyapohitum ॥18॥

text: gṛhīta eva tu tayā devendro bharatarṣabha । pitāmahamupāgamya śirasā pratyapūjayat ॥19॥
html:
gṛhīta eva tu tayā devendro bharatarṣabha ।
pitāmahamupāgamya śirasā pratyapūjayat ॥19॥
slp1: gfhIta eva tu tayA devendro BaratarzaBa । pitAmahamupAgamya SirasA pratyapUjayat ॥19॥

text: jñātvā gṛhītaṃ śakraṃ tu dvijapravarahatyayā । brahmā sañcintayāmāsa tadā bharatasattama ॥20॥
html:
jñātvā gṛhītaṃ śakraṃ tu dvijapravarahatyayā ।
brahmā sañcintayāmāsa tadā bharatasattama ॥20॥
slp1: jYAtvA gfhItaM SakraM tu dvijapravarahatyayA । brahmA saYcintayAmAsa tadA Baratasattama ॥20॥

text: tāmuvāca mahābāho brahmahatyāṃ pitāmahaḥ । svareṇa madhureṇātha sāntvayanniva bhārata ॥21॥
html:
tāmuvāca mahābāho brahmahatyāṃ pitāmahaḥ ।
svareṇa madhureṇātha sāntvayanniva bhārata ॥21॥
slp1: tAmuvAca mahAbAho brahmahatyAM pitAmahaH । svareRa maDureRATa sAntvayanniva BArata ॥21॥

text: mucyatāṃ tridaśendro'yaṃ matpriyaṃ kuru bhāmini । brūhi kiṃ te karomyadya kāmaṃ kaṃ tvamihecchasi ॥22॥
html:
mucyatāṃ tridaśendro'yaṃ matpriyaṃ kuru bhāmini ।
brūhi kiṃ te karomyadya kāmaṃ kaṃ tvamihecchasi ॥22॥
slp1: mucyatAM tridaSendro'yaM matpriyaM kuru BAmini । brUhi kiM te karomyadya kAmaM kaM tvamihecCasi ॥22॥

text: trilokapūjite deve prīte trailokyakartari । kṛtameveha manye'haṃ nivāsaṃ tu vidhatsva me ॥23॥
html:
trilokapūjite deve prīte trailokyakartari ।
kṛtameveha manye'haṃ nivāsaṃ tu vidhatsva me ॥23॥
slp1: trilokapUjite deve prIte trElokyakartari । kftameveha manye'haM nivAsaM tu viDatsva me ॥23॥
author: brahmahatyovāca ।

text: tvayā kṛteyaṃ maryādā lokasaṃrakṣaṇārthinā । sthāpanā vai sumahatī tvayā deva pravartitā ॥24॥
html:
tvayā kṛteyaṃ maryādā lokasaṃrakṣaṇārthinā ।
sthāpanā vai sumahatī tvayā deva pravartitā ॥24॥
slp1: tvayA kfteyaM maryAdA lokasaMrakzaRArTinA । sTApanA vE sumahatI tvayA deva pravartitA ॥24॥

text: prīte tu tvayi dharmajña sarvalokeśvare prabho । śakrādapagamiṣyāmi nivāsaṃ tu vidhatsva me ॥25॥
html:
prīte tu tvayi dharmajña sarvalokeśvare prabho ।
śakrādapagamiṣyāmi nivāsaṃ tu vidhatsva me ॥25॥
slp1: prIte tu tvayi DarmajYa sarvalokeSvare praBo । SakrAdapagamizyAmi nivAsaM tu viDatsva me ॥25॥

text: tatheti tāṃ prāha tadā brahmahatyāṃ pitāmahaḥ । upāyataḥ sa śakrasya brahmahatyāṃ vyapohata ॥26॥
html:
tatheti tāṃ prāha tadā brahmahatyāṃ pitāmahaḥ ।
upāyataḥ sa śakrasya brahmahatyāṃ vyapohata ॥26॥
slp1: taTeti tAM prAha tadA brahmahatyAM pitAmahaH । upAyataH sa Sakrasya brahmahatyAM vyapohata ॥26॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tataḥ svayambhuvā dhyātastatra vahnirmahātmanā । brahmāṇamupasaṅgamya tato vacanamabravīt ॥27॥
html:
tataḥ svayambhuvā dhyātastatra vahnirmahātmanā ।
brahmāṇamupasaṅgamya tato vacanamabravīt ॥27॥
slp1: tataH svayamBuvA DyAtastatra vahnirmahAtmanA । brahmARamupasaNgamya tato vacanamabravIt ॥27॥

text: prāpto'smi bhagavandeva tvatsakāśamarindama । yatkartavyaṃ mayā deva tadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥28॥
html:
prāpto'smi bhagavandeva tvatsakāśamarindama ।
yatkartavyaṃ mayā deva tadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥28॥
slp1: prApto'smi Bagavandeva tvatsakASamarindama । yatkartavyaM mayA deva tadBavAnvaktumarhati ॥28॥

text: bahudhā vibhajiṣyāmi brahmahatyāmimāmaham । śakrasyādya vimokṣārthaṃ caturbhāgaṃ pratīccha me ॥29॥
html:
bahudhā vibhajiṣyāmi brahmahatyāmimāmaham ।
śakrasyādya vimokṣārthaṃ caturbhāgaṃ pratīccha me ॥29॥
slp1: bahuDA viBajizyAmi brahmahatyAmimAmaham । SakrasyAdya vimokzArTaM caturBAgaM pratIcCa me ॥29॥
author: brahmovāca ।

text: mama mokṣasya ko'nto vai brahmandhyāyasva vai prabho । etadicchāmi vijñātuṃ tattvato lokapūjita ॥30॥
html:
mama mokṣasya ko'nto vai brahmandhyāyasva vai prabho ।
etadicchāmi vijñātuṃ tattvato lokapūjita ॥30॥
slp1: mama mokzasya ko'nto vE brahmanDyAyasva vE praBo । etadicCAmi vijYAtuM tattvato lokapUjita ॥30॥
author: agniruvāca ।

text: yastvāṃ jvalantamāsādya svayaṃ vai mānavaḥ kvacit । bījauṣadhirasairvahne na yakṣyati tamovṛtaḥ ॥31॥
html:
yastvāṃ jvalantamāsādya svayaṃ vai mānavaḥ kvacit ।
bījauṣadhirasairvahne na yakṣyati tamovṛtaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: yastvAM jvalantamAsAdya svayaM vE mAnavaH kvacit । bIjOzaDirasErvahne na yakzyati tamovftaH ॥31॥
author: brahmovāca ।

text: tameṣā yāsyati kṣipraṃ tatraiva ca nivatsyati । brahmahatyā havyavāha vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ ॥32॥
html:
tameṣā yāsyati kṣipraṃ tatraiva ca nivatsyati ।
brahmahatyā havyavāha vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ ॥32॥
slp1: tamezA yAsyati kzipraM tatrEva ca nivatsyati । brahmahatyA havyavAha vyetu te mAnaso jvaraH ॥32॥

text: ityuktaḥ pratijagrāha tadvaco havyakavyabhuk । pitāmahasya bhagavāṃstathā ca tadabhūtprabho ॥33॥
html:
ityuktaḥ pratijagrāha tadvaco havyakavyabhuk ।
pitāmahasya bhagavāṃstathā ca tadabhūtprabho ॥33॥
slp1: ityuktaH pratijagrAha tadvaco havyakavyaBuk । pitAmahasya BagavAMstaTA ca tadaBUtpraBo ॥33॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tato vṛkṣauṣadhitṛṇaṃ samāhūya pitāmahaḥ । imamarthaṃ mahārāja vaktuṃ samupacakrame ॥34॥
html:
tato vṛkṣauṣadhitṛṇaṃ samāhūya pitāmahaḥ ।
imamarthaṃ mahārāja vaktuṃ samupacakrame ॥34॥
slp1: tato vfkzOzaDitfRaM samAhUya pitAmahaH । imamarTaM mahArAja vaktuM samupacakrame ॥34॥

text: tato vṛkṣauṣadhitṛṇaṃ tathaivoktaṃ yathātatham । vyathitaṃ vahnivadrājanbrahmāṇamidamabravīt ॥35॥
html:
tato vṛkṣauṣadhitṛṇaṃ tathaivoktaṃ yathātatham ।
vyathitaṃ vahnivadrājanbrahmāṇamidamabravīt ॥35॥
slp1: tato vfkzOzaDitfRaM taTEvoktaM yaTAtaTam । vyaTitaM vahnivadrAjanbrahmARamidamabravIt ॥35॥

text: asmākaṃ brahmahatyāto ko'nto lokapitāmaha । svabhāvanihatānasmānna punarhantumarhasi ॥36॥
html:
asmākaṃ brahmahatyāto ko'nto lokapitāmaha ।
svabhāvanihatānasmānna punarhantumarhasi ॥36॥
slp1: asmAkaM brahmahatyAto ko'nto lokapitAmaha । svaBAvanihatAnasmAnna punarhantumarhasi ॥36॥

text: vayamagniṃ tathā śītaṃ varṣaṃ ca pavaneritam । sahāmaḥ satataṃ deva tathā chedanabhedanam ॥37॥
html:
vayamagniṃ tathā śītaṃ varṣaṃ ca pavaneritam ।
sahāmaḥ satataṃ deva tathā chedanabhedanam ॥37॥
slp1: vayamagniM taTA SItaM varzaM ca pavaneritam । sahAmaH satataM deva taTA CedanaBedanam ॥37॥

text: brahmahatyāmimāmadya bhavataḥ śāsanādvayam । grahīṣyāmastrilokeśa mokṣaṃ cintayatāṃ bhavān ॥38॥
html:
brahmahatyāmimāmadya bhavataḥ śāsanādvayam ।
grahīṣyāmastrilokeśa mokṣaṃ cintayatāṃ bhavān ॥38॥
slp1: brahmahatyAmimAmadya BavataH SAsanAdvayam । grahIzyAmastrilokeSa mokzaM cintayatAM BavAn ॥38॥

text: parvakāle tu samprāpte yo vai chedanabhedanam । kariṣyati naro mohāttameṣānugamiṣyati ॥39॥
html:
parvakāle tu samprāpte yo vai chedanabhedanam ।
kariṣyati naro mohāttameṣānugamiṣyati ॥39॥
slp1: parvakAle tu samprApte yo vE CedanaBedanam । karizyati naro mohAttamezAnugamizyati ॥39॥
author: brahmovāca ।

text: tato vṛkṣauṣadhitṛṇamevamuktaṃ mahātmanā । brahmāṇamabhisampūjya jagāmāśu yathāgatam ॥40॥
html:
tato vṛkṣauṣadhitṛṇamevamuktaṃ mahātmanā ।
brahmāṇamabhisampūjya jagāmāśu yathāgatam ॥40॥
slp1: tato vfkzOzaDitfRamevamuktaM mahAtmanA । brahmARamaBisampUjya jagAmASu yaTAgatam ॥40॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: āhūyāpsaraso devastato lokapitāmahaḥ । vācā madhurayā prāha sāntvayanniva bhārata ॥41॥
html:
āhūyāpsaraso devastato lokapitāmahaḥ ।
vācā madhurayā prāha sāntvayanniva bhārata ॥41॥
slp1: AhUyApsaraso devastato lokapitAmahaH । vAcA maDurayA prAha sAntvayanniva BArata ॥41॥

text: iyamindrādanuprāptā brahmahatyā varāṅganāḥ । caturthamasyā bhāgaṃ hi mayoktāḥ sampratīcchata ॥42॥
html:
iyamindrādanuprāptā brahmahatyā varāṅganāḥ ।
caturthamasyā bhāgaṃ hi mayoktāḥ sampratīcchata ॥42॥
slp1: iyamindrAdanuprAptA brahmahatyA varANganAH । caturTamasyA BAgaM hi mayoktAH sampratIcCata ॥42॥

text: grahaṇe kṛtabuddhīnāṃ deveśa tava śāsanāt । mokṣaṃ samayato'smākaṃ cintayasva pitāmaha ॥43॥
html:
grahaṇe kṛtabuddhīnāṃ deveśa tava śāsanāt ।
mokṣaṃ samayato'smākaṃ cintayasva pitāmaha ॥43॥
slp1: grahaRe kftabudDInAM deveSa tava SAsanAt । mokzaM samayato'smAkaM cintayasva pitAmaha ॥43॥
author: apsarasa ūcuḥ ।

text: rajasvalāsu nārīṣu yo vai maithunamācaret । tameṣā yāsyati kṣipraṃ vyetu vo mānaso jvaraḥ ॥44॥
html:
rajasvalāsu nārīṣu yo vai maithunamācaret ।
tameṣā yāsyati kṣipraṃ vyetu vo mānaso jvaraḥ ॥44॥
slp1: rajasvalAsu nArIzu yo vE mETunamAcaret । tamezA yAsyati kzipraM vyetu vo mAnaso jvaraH ॥44॥
author: brahmovāca ।

text: tatheti hṛṣṭamanasa uktvāthāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ । svāni sthānāni samprāpya remire bharatarṣabha ॥45॥
html:
tatheti hṛṣṭamanasa uktvāthāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ।
svāni sthānāni samprāpya remire bharatarṣabha ॥45॥
slp1: taTeti hfzwamanasa uktvATApsarasAM gaRAH । svAni sTAnAni samprApya remire BaratarzaBa ॥45॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tatastrilokakṛddevaḥ punareva mahātapāḥ । apaḥ sañcintayāmāsa dhyātāstāścāpyathāgaman ॥46॥
html:
tatastrilokakṛddevaḥ punareva mahātapāḥ ।
apaḥ sañcintayāmāsa dhyātāstāścāpyathāgaman ॥46॥
slp1: tatastrilokakfddevaH punareva mahAtapAH । apaH saYcintayAmAsa DyAtAstAScApyaTAgaman ॥46॥

text: tāstu sarvāḥ samāgamya brahmāṇamamitaujasam । idamūcurvaco rājanpraṇipatya pitāmaham ॥47॥
html:
tāstu sarvāḥ samāgamya brahmāṇamamitaujasam ।
idamūcurvaco rājanpraṇipatya pitāmaham ॥47॥
slp1: tAstu sarvAH samAgamya brahmARamamitOjasam । idamUcurvaco rAjanpraRipatya pitAmaham ॥47॥

text: imāḥ sma deva samprāptāstvatsakāśamarindama । śāsanāttava deveśa samājñāpaya no vibho ॥48॥
html:
imāḥ sma deva samprāptāstvatsakāśamarindama ।
śāsanāttava deveśa samājñāpaya no vibho ॥48॥
slp1: imAH sma deva samprAptAstvatsakASamarindama । SAsanAttava deveSa samAjYApaya no viBo ॥48॥

text: iyaṃ vṛtrādanuprāptā puruhūtaṃ mahābhayā । brahmahatyā caturthāṃśamasyā yūyaṃ pratīcchata ॥49॥
html:
iyaṃ vṛtrādanuprāptā puruhūtaṃ mahābhayā ।
brahmahatyā caturthāṃśamasyā yūyaṃ pratīcchata ॥49॥
slp1: iyaM vftrAdanuprAptA puruhUtaM mahABayA । brahmahatyA caturTAMSamasyA yUyaM pratIcCata ॥49॥
author: brahmovāca ।

text: evaṃ bhavatu lokeśa yathā vadasi naḥ prabho । mokṣaṃ samayato'smākaṃ sañcintayitumarhasi ॥50॥
html:
evaṃ bhavatu lokeśa yathā vadasi naḥ prabho ।
mokṣaṃ samayato'smākaṃ sañcintayitumarhasi ॥50॥
slp1: evaM Bavatu lokeSa yaTA vadasi naH praBo । mokzaM samayato'smAkaM saYcintayitumarhasi ॥50॥
author: āpa ūcuḥ ।

text: tvaṃ hi deveśa sarvasya jagataḥ paramo guruḥ । ko'nyaḥ prasādo hi bhavedyaḥ kṛcchrānnaḥ samuddharet ॥51॥
html:
tvaṃ hi deveśa sarvasya jagataḥ paramo guruḥ ।
ko'nyaḥ prasādo hi bhavedyaḥ kṛcchrānnaḥ samuddharet ॥51॥
slp1: tvaM hi deveSa sarvasya jagataH paramo guruH । ko'nyaH prasAdo hi BavedyaH kfcCrAnnaH samudDaret ॥51॥

text: alpā iti matiṃ kṛtvā yo naro buddhimohitaḥ । śleṣmamūtrapurīṣāṇi yuṣmāsu pratimokṣyati ॥52॥
html:
alpā iti matiṃ kṛtvā yo naro buddhimohitaḥ ।
śleṣmamūtrapurīṣāṇi yuṣmāsu pratimokṣyati ॥52॥
slp1: alpA iti matiM kftvA yo naro budDimohitaH । SlezmamUtrapurIzARi yuzmAsu pratimokzyati ॥52॥
author: brahmovāca ।

text: tameṣā yāsyati kṣipraṃ tatraiva ca nivatsyati । tathā vo bhavitā mokṣa iti satyaṃ bravīmi vaḥ ॥53॥
html:
tameṣā yāsyati kṣipraṃ tatraiva ca nivatsyati ।
tathā vo bhavitā mokṣa iti satyaṃ bravīmi vaḥ ॥53॥
slp1: tamezA yAsyati kzipraM tatrEva ca nivatsyati । taTA vo BavitA mokza iti satyaM bravImi vaH ॥53॥

text: tato vimucya devendraṃ brahmahatyā yudhiṣṭhira । yathānisṛṣṭaṃ taṃ deśamagacchaddevaśāsanāt ॥54॥
html:
tato vimucya devendraṃ brahmahatyā yudhiṣṭhira ।
yathānisṛṣṭaṃ taṃ deśamagacchaddevaśāsanāt ॥54॥
slp1: tato vimucya devendraM brahmahatyA yuDizWira । yaTAnisfzwaM taM deSamagacCaddevaSAsanAt ॥54॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: evaṃ śakreṇa samprāptā brahmahatyā janādhipa । pitāmahamanujñāpya so'śvamedhamakalpayat ॥55॥
html:
evaṃ śakreṇa samprāptā brahmahatyā janādhipa ।
pitāmahamanujñāpya so'śvamedhamakalpayat ॥55॥
slp1: evaM SakreRa samprAptA brahmahatyA janADipa । pitAmahamanujYApya so'SvameDamakalpayat ॥55॥

text: śrūyate hi mahārāja samprāptā vāsavena vai । brahmahatyā tataḥ śuddhiṃ hayamedhena labdhavān ॥56॥
html:
śrūyate hi mahārāja samprāptā vāsavena vai ।
brahmahatyā tataḥ śuddhiṃ hayamedhena labdhavān ॥56॥
slp1: SrUyate hi mahArAja samprAptA vAsavena vE । brahmahatyA tataH SudDiM hayameDena labDavAn ॥56॥

text: samavāpya śriyaṃ devo hatvārīṃśca sahasraśaḥ । praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe vāsavaḥ pṛthivīpate ॥57॥
html:
samavāpya śriyaṃ devo hatvārīṃśca sahasraśaḥ ।
praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe vāsavaḥ pṛthivīpate ॥57॥
slp1: samavApya SriyaM devo hatvArIMSca sahasraSaH । praharzamatulaM leBe vAsavaH pfTivIpate ॥57॥

text: vṛtrasya rudhirāccaiva khukhuṇḍāḥ pārtha jajñire । dvijātibhirabhakṣyāste dīkṣitaiśca tapodhanaiḥ ॥58॥
html:
vṛtrasya rudhirāccaiva khukhuṇḍāḥ pārtha jajñire ।
dvijātibhirabhakṣyāste dīkṣitaiśca tapodhanaiḥ ॥58॥
slp1: vftrasya ruDirAccEva KuKuRqAH pArTa jajYire । dvijAtiBiraBakzyAste dIkzitESca tapoDanEH ॥58॥

text: sarvāvasthaṃ tvamapyeṣāṃ dvijātīnāṃ priyaṃ kuru । ime hi bhūtale devāḥ prathitāḥ kurunandana ॥59॥
html:
sarvāvasthaṃ tvamapyeṣāṃ dvijātīnāṃ priyaṃ kuru ।
ime hi bhūtale devāḥ prathitāḥ kurunandana ॥59॥
slp1: sarvAvasTaM tvamapyezAM dvijAtInAM priyaM kuru । ime hi BUtale devAH praTitAH kurunandana ॥59॥

text: evaṃ śakreṇa kauravya buddhisaukṣmyānmahāsuraḥ । upāyapūrvaṃ nihato vṛtro'thāmitatejasā ॥60॥
html:
evaṃ śakreṇa kauravya buddhisaukṣmyānmahāsuraḥ ।
upāyapūrvaṃ nihato vṛtro'thāmitatejasā ॥60॥
slp1: evaM SakreRa kOravya budDisOkzmyAnmahAsuraH । upAyapUrvaM nihato vftro'TAmitatejasA ॥60॥

text: evaṃ tvamapi kauravya pṛthivyāmaparājitaḥ । bhaviṣyasi yathā devaḥ śatakraturamitrahā ॥61॥
html:
evaṃ tvamapi kauravya pṛthivyāmaparājitaḥ ।
bhaviṣyasi yathā devaḥ śatakraturamitrahā ॥61॥
slp1: evaM tvamapi kOravya pfTivyAmaparAjitaH । Bavizyasi yaTA devaH SatakraturamitrahA ॥61॥

text: ye tu śakrakathāṃ divyāmimāṃ parvasu parvasu । vipramadhye paṭhiṣyanti na te prāpsyanti kilbiṣam ॥62॥
html:
ye tu śakrakathāṃ divyāmimāṃ parvasu parvasu ।
vipramadhye paṭhiṣyanti na te prāpsyanti kilbiṣam ॥62॥
slp1: ye tu SakrakaTAM divyAmimAM parvasu parvasu । vipramaDye paWizyanti na te prApsyanti kilbizam ॥62॥

text: ityetadvṛtramāśritya śakrasyātyadbhutaṃ mahat । kathitaṃ karma te tāta kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi] ॥63॥
html:
ityetadvṛtramāśritya śakrasyātyadbhutaṃ mahat ।
kathitaṃ karma te tāta kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi] ॥63॥
slp1: ityetadvftramASritya SakrasyAtyadButaM mahat । kaTitaM karma te tAta kiM BUyaH SrotumicCasi] ॥63॥

text: pitāmaha mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada । asti vṛtravadhādeva vivakṣā mama jāyate ॥1॥
html:
pitāmaha mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada ।
asti vṛtravadhādeva vivakṣā mama jāyate ॥1॥
slp1: pitAmaha mahAprAjYa sarvaSAstraviSArada । asti vftravaDAdeva vivakzA mama jAyate ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: jvareṇa mohito vṛtraḥ kathitaste janādhipa । nihato vāsaveneha vajreṇeti mamānagha ॥2॥
html:
jvareṇa mohito vṛtraḥ kathitaste janādhipa ।
nihato vāsaveneha vajreṇeti mamānagha ॥2॥
slp1: jvareRa mohito vftraH kaTitaste janADipa । nihato vAsaveneha vajreReti mamAnaGa ॥2॥

text: kathameṣa mahāprājña jvaraḥ prādurabhūtkutaḥ । jvarotpattiṃ nipuṇataḥ śrotumicchāmyahaṃ prabho ॥3॥
html:
kathameṣa mahāprājña jvaraḥ prādurabhūtkutaḥ ।
jvarotpattiṃ nipuṇataḥ śrotumicchāmyahaṃ prabho ॥3॥
slp1: kaTameza mahAprAjYa jvaraH prAduraBUtkutaH । jvarotpattiM nipuRataH SrotumicCAmyahaM praBo ॥3॥

text: śṛṇu rājañjvarasyeha sambhavaṃ lokaviśrutam । vistaraṃ cāsya vakṣyāmi yādṛśaṃ caiva bhārata ॥4॥
html:
śṛṇu rājañjvarasyeha sambhavaṃ lokaviśrutam ।
vistaraṃ cāsya vakṣyāmi yādṛśaṃ caiva bhārata ॥4॥
slp1: SfRu rAjaYjvarasyeha samBavaM lokaviSrutam । vistaraM cAsya vakzyAmi yAdfSaM cEva BArata ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: purā merormahārāja śṛṅgaṃ trailokyaviśrutam । jyotiṣkaṃ nāma sāvitraṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam । aprameyamanādhṛṣyaṃ sarvalokeṣu bhārata ॥5॥
html:
purā merormahārāja śṛṅgaṃ trailokyaviśrutam ।
jyotiṣkaṃ nāma sāvitraṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam ।
aprameyamanādhṛṣyaṃ sarvalokeṣu bhārata ॥5॥
slp1: purA merormahArAja SfNgaM trElokyaviSrutam । jyotizkaM nAma sAvitraM sarvaratnaviBUzitam । aprameyamanADfzyaM sarvalokezu BArata ॥5॥

text: tatra devo giritaṭe hemadhātuvibhūṣite । paryaṅka iva vibhrājannupaviṣṭo babhūva ha ॥6॥
html:
