tatra devo giritaṭe hemadhātuvibhūṣite ।
paryaṅka iva vibhrājannupaviṣṭo babhūva ha ॥6॥
slp1: tatra devo giritawe hemaDAtuviBUzite । paryaNka iva viBrAjannupavizwo baBUva ha ॥6॥

text: śailarājasutā cāsya nityaṃ pārśve sthitā babhau । tathā devā mahātmāno vasavaśca mahaujasaḥ ॥7॥
html:
śailarājasutā cāsya nityaṃ pārśve sthitā babhau ।
tathā devā mahātmāno vasavaśca mahaujasaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: SElarAjasutA cAsya nityaM pArSve sTitA baBO । taTA devA mahAtmAno vasavaSca mahOjasaH ॥7॥

text: tathaiva ca mahātmānāvaśvinau bhiṣajāṃ varau । tathā vaiśravaṇo rājā guhyakairabhisaṃvṛtaḥ ॥8॥
html:
tathaiva ca mahātmānāvaśvinau bhiṣajāṃ varau ।
tathā vaiśravaṇo rājā guhyakairabhisaṃvṛtaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: taTEva ca mahAtmAnAvaSvinO BizajAM varO । taTA vESravaRo rAjA guhyakEraBisaMvftaH ॥8॥

text: yakṣāṇāmadhipaḥ śrīmānkailāsanilayaḥ prabhuḥ । aṅgiraḥpramukhāścaiva tathā devarṣayo'pare ॥9॥
html:
yakṣāṇāmadhipaḥ śrīmānkailāsanilayaḥ prabhuḥ ।
aṅgiraḥpramukhāścaiva tathā devarṣayo'pare ॥9॥
slp1: yakzARAmaDipaH SrImAnkElAsanilayaH praBuH । aNgiraHpramuKAScEva taTA devarzayo'pare ॥9॥

text: viśvāvasuśca gandharvastathā nāradaparvatau । apsarogaṇasaṅghāśca samājagmuranekaśaḥ ॥10॥
html:
viśvāvasuśca gandharvastathā nāradaparvatau ।
apsarogaṇasaṅghāśca samājagmuranekaśaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: viSvAvasuSca ganDarvastaTA nAradaparvatO । apsarogaRasaNGASca samAjagmuranekaSaH ॥10॥

text: vavau śivaḥ sukho vāyurnānāgandhavahaḥ śuciḥ । sarvartukusumopetāḥ puṣpavanto mahādrumāḥ ॥11॥
html:
vavau śivaḥ sukho vāyurnānāgandhavahaḥ śuciḥ ।
sarvartukusumopetāḥ puṣpavanto mahādrumāḥ ॥11॥
slp1: vavO SivaH suKo vAyurnAnAganDavahaH SuciH । sarvartukusumopetAH puzpavanto mahAdrumAH ॥11॥

text: tathā vidyādharāścaiva siddhāścaiva tapodhanāḥ । mahādevaṃ paśupatiṃ paryupāsanta bhārata ॥12॥
html:
tathā vidyādharāścaiva siddhāścaiva tapodhanāḥ ।
mahādevaṃ paśupatiṃ paryupāsanta bhārata ॥12॥
slp1: taTA vidyADarAScEva sidDAScEva tapoDanAH । mahAdevaM paSupatiM paryupAsanta BArata ॥12॥

text: bhūtāni ca mahārāja nānārūpadharāṇyatha । rākṣasāśca mahāraudrāḥ piśācāśca mahābalāḥ ॥13॥
html:
bhūtāni ca mahārāja nānārūpadharāṇyatha ।
rākṣasāśca mahāraudrāḥ piśācāśca mahābalāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: BUtAni ca mahArAja nAnArUpaDarARyaTa । rAkzasASca mahArOdrAH piSAcASca mahAbalAH ॥13॥

text: bahurūpadharā hṛṣṭā nānāpraharaṇodyatāḥ । devasyānucarāstatra tasthire cānalopamāḥ ॥14॥
html:
bahurūpadharā hṛṣṭā nānāpraharaṇodyatāḥ ।
devasyānucarāstatra tasthire cānalopamāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: bahurUpaDarA hfzwA nAnApraharaRodyatAH । devasyAnucarAstatra tasTire cAnalopamAH ॥14॥

text: nandī ca bhagavāṃstatra devasyānumate sthitaḥ । pragṛhya jvalitaṃ śūlaṃ dīpyamānaṃ svatejasā ॥15॥
html:
nandī ca bhagavāṃstatra devasyānumate sthitaḥ ।
pragṛhya jvalitaṃ śūlaṃ dīpyamānaṃ svatejasā ॥15॥
slp1: nandI ca BagavAMstatra devasyAnumate sTitaH । pragfhya jvalitaM SUlaM dIpyamAnaM svatejasA ॥15॥

text: gaṅgā ca saritāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvatīrthajalodbhavā । paryupāsata taṃ devaṃ rūpiṇī kurunandana ॥16॥
html:
gaṅgā ca saritāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvatīrthajalodbhavā ।
paryupāsata taṃ devaṃ rūpiṇī kurunandana ॥16॥
slp1: gaNgA ca saritAM SrezWA sarvatIrTajalodBavA । paryupAsata taM devaM rUpiRI kurunandana ॥16॥

text: evaṃ sa bhagavāṃstatra pūjyamānaḥ surarṣibhiḥ । devaiśca sumahābhāgairmahādevo vyatiṣṭhata ॥17॥
html:
evaṃ sa bhagavāṃstatra pūjyamānaḥ surarṣibhiḥ ।
devaiśca sumahābhāgairmahādevo vyatiṣṭhata ॥17॥
slp1: evaM sa BagavAMstatra pUjyamAnaH surarziBiH । devESca sumahABAgErmahAdevo vyatizWata ॥17॥

text: kasyacittvatha kālasya dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ । pūrvoktena vidhānena yakṣyamāṇo'nvapadyata ॥18॥
html:
kasyacittvatha kālasya dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ ।
pūrvoktena vidhānena yakṣyamāṇo'nvapadyata ॥18॥
slp1: kasyacittvaTa kAlasya dakzo nAma prajApatiH । pUrvoktena viDAnena yakzyamARo'nvapadyata ॥18॥

text: tatastasya makhaṃ devāḥ sarve śakrapurogamāḥ । gamanāya samāgamya buddhimāpedire tadā ॥19॥
html:
tatastasya makhaṃ devāḥ sarve śakrapurogamāḥ ।
gamanāya samāgamya buddhimāpedire tadā ॥19॥
slp1: tatastasya maKaM devAH sarve SakrapurogamAH । gamanAya samAgamya budDimApedire tadA ॥19॥

text: te vimānairmahātmāno jvalitairjvalanaprabhāḥ । devasyānumate'gacchangaṅgādvāramiti śrutiḥ ॥20॥
html:
te vimānairmahātmāno jvalitairjvalanaprabhāḥ ।
devasyānumate'gacchangaṅgādvāramiti śrutiḥ ॥20॥
slp1: te vimAnErmahAtmAno jvalitErjvalanapraBAH । devasyAnumate'gacCangaNgAdvAramiti SrutiH ॥20॥

text: prasthitā devatā dṛṣṭvā śailarājasutā tadā । uvāca vacanaṃ sādhvī devaṃ paśupatiṃ patim ॥21॥
html:
prasthitā devatā dṛṣṭvā śailarājasutā tadā ।
uvāca vacanaṃ sādhvī devaṃ paśupatiṃ patim ॥21॥
slp1: prasTitA devatA dfzwvA SElarAjasutA tadA । uvAca vacanaM sADvI devaM paSupatiM patim ॥21॥

text: bhagavankva nu yāntyete devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ । brūhi tattvena tattvajña saṃśayo me mahānayam ॥22॥
html:
bhagavankva nu yāntyete devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ ।
brūhi tattvena tattvajña saṃśayo me mahānayam ॥22॥
slp1: Bagavankva nu yAntyete devAH SakrapurogamAH । brUhi tattvena tattvajYa saMSayo me mahAnayam ॥22॥

text: dakṣo nāma mahābhāge prajānāṃ patiruttamaḥ । hayamedhena yajate tatra yānti divaukasaḥ ॥23॥
html:
dakṣo nāma mahābhāge prajānāṃ patiruttamaḥ ।
hayamedhena yajate tatra yānti divaukasaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: dakzo nAma mahABAge prajAnAM patiruttamaH । hayameDena yajate tatra yAnti divOkasaH ॥23॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: yajñametaṃ mahābhāga kimarthaṃ nābhigacchasi । kena vā pratiṣedhena gamanaṃ te na vidyate ॥24॥
html:
yajñametaṃ mahābhāga kimarthaṃ nābhigacchasi ।
kena vā pratiṣedhena gamanaṃ te na vidyate ॥24॥
slp1: yajYametaM mahABAga kimarTaM nABigacCasi । kena vA pratizeDena gamanaM te na vidyate ॥24॥
author: umā uvāca ।

text: suraireva mahābhāge sarvametadanuṣṭhitam । yajñeṣu sarveṣu mama na bhāga upakalpitaḥ ॥25॥
html:
suraireva mahābhāge sarvametadanuṣṭhitam ।
yajñeṣu sarveṣu mama na bhāga upakalpitaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: surEreva mahABAge sarvametadanuzWitam । yajYezu sarvezu mama na BAga upakalpitaH ॥25॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: pūrvopāyopapannena mārgeṇa varavarṇini । na me surāḥ prayacchanti bhāgaṃ yajñasya dharmataḥ ॥26॥
html:
pūrvopāyopapannena mārgeṇa varavarṇini ।
na me surāḥ prayacchanti bhāgaṃ yajñasya dharmataḥ ॥26॥
slp1: pUrvopAyopapannena mArgeRa varavarRini । na me surAH prayacCanti BAgaM yajYasya DarmataH ॥26॥

text: bhagavansarvabhūteṣu prabhavābhyadhiko guṇaiḥ । ajeyaścāpradhṛṣyaśca tejasā yaśasā śriyā ॥27॥
html:
bhagavansarvabhūteṣu prabhavābhyadhiko guṇaiḥ ।
ajeyaścāpradhṛṣyaśca tejasā yaśasā śriyā ॥27॥
slp1: BagavansarvaBUtezu praBavAByaDiko guREH । ajeyaScApraDfzyaSca tejasA yaSasA SriyA ॥27॥
author: umā uvāca ।

text: anena te mahābhāga pratiṣedhena bhāgataḥ । atīva duḥkhamutpannaṃ vepathuśca mamānagha ॥28॥
html:
anena te mahābhāga pratiṣedhena bhāgataḥ ।
atīva duḥkhamutpannaṃ vepathuśca mamānagha ॥28॥
slp1: anena te mahABAga pratizeDena BAgataH । atIva duHKamutpannaM vepaTuSca mamAnaGa ॥28॥

text: evamuktvā tu sā devī devaṃ paśupatiṃ patim । tūṣṇīṃbhūtābhavadrājandahyamānena cetasā ॥29॥
html:
evamuktvā tu sā devī devaṃ paśupatiṃ patim ।
tūṣṇīṃbhūtābhavadrājandahyamānena cetasā ॥29॥
slp1: evamuktvA tu sA devI devaM paSupatiM patim । tUzRIMBUtABavadrAjandahyamAnena cetasA ॥29॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: atha devyā mataṃ jñātvā hṛdgataṃ yaccikīrṣitam । sa samājñāpayāmāsa tiṣṭha tvamiti nandinam ॥30॥
html:
atha devyā mataṃ jñātvā hṛdgataṃ yaccikīrṣitam ।
sa samājñāpayāmāsa tiṣṭha tvamiti nandinam ॥30॥
slp1: aTa devyA mataM jYAtvA hfdgataM yaccikIrzitam । sa samAjYApayAmAsa tizWa tvamiti nandinam ॥30॥

text: tato yogabalaṃ kṛtvā sarvayogeśvareśvaraḥ । taṃ yajñaṃ sumahātejā bhīmairanucaraistadā । sahasā ghātayāmāsa devadevaḥ pinākadhṛk ॥31॥
html:
tato yogabalaṃ kṛtvā sarvayogeśvareśvaraḥ ।
taṃ yajñaṃ sumahātejā bhīmairanucaraistadā ।
sahasā ghātayāmāsa devadevaḥ pinākadhṛk ॥31॥
slp1: tato yogabalaM kftvA sarvayogeSvareSvaraH । taM yajYaM sumahAtejA BImEranucarEstadA । sahasA GAtayAmAsa devadevaH pinAkaDfk ॥31॥

text: kecinnādānamuñcanta keciddhāsāṃśca cakrire । rudhireṇāpare rājaṃstatrāgniṃ samavākiran ॥32॥
html:
kecinnādānamuñcanta keciddhāsāṃśca cakrire ।
rudhireṇāpare rājaṃstatrāgniṃ samavākiran ॥32॥
slp1: kecinnAdAnamuYcanta kecidDAsAMSca cakrire । ruDireRApare rAjaMstatrAgniM samavAkiran ॥32॥

text: kecidyūpānsamutpāṭya babhramurvikṛtānanāḥ । āsyairanye cāgrasanta tathaiva paricārakān ॥33॥
html:
kecidyūpānsamutpāṭya babhramurvikṛtānanāḥ ।
āsyairanye cāgrasanta tathaiva paricārakān ॥33॥
slp1: kecidyUpAnsamutpAwya baBramurvikftAnanAH । AsyEranye cAgrasanta taTEva paricArakAn ॥33॥

text: tataḥ sa yajño nṛpate vadhyamānaḥ samantataḥ । āsthāya mṛgarūpaṃ vai khamevābhyapatattadā ॥34॥
html:
tataḥ sa yajño nṛpate vadhyamānaḥ samantataḥ ।
āsthāya mṛgarūpaṃ vai khamevābhyapatattadā ॥34॥
slp1: tataH sa yajYo nfpate vaDyamAnaH samantataH । AsTAya mfgarUpaM vE KamevAByapatattadA ॥34॥

text: taṃ tu yajñaṃ tathārūpaṃ gacchantamupalabhya saḥ । dhanurādāya bāṇaṃ ca tadānvasarata prabhuḥ ॥35॥
html:
taṃ tu yajñaṃ tathārūpaṃ gacchantamupalabhya saḥ ।
dhanurādāya bāṇaṃ ca tadānvasarata prabhuḥ ॥35॥
slp1: taM tu yajYaM taTArUpaM gacCantamupalaBya saH । DanurAdAya bARaM ca tadAnvasarata praBuH ॥35॥

text: tatastasya sureśasya krodhādamitatejasaḥ । lalāṭātprasṛto ghoraḥ svedabindurbabhūva ha ॥36॥
html:
tatastasya sureśasya krodhādamitatejasaḥ ।
lalāṭātprasṛto ghoraḥ svedabindurbabhūva ha ॥36॥
slp1: tatastasya sureSasya kroDAdamitatejasaH । lalAwAtprasfto GoraH svedabindurbaBUva ha ॥36॥

text: tasminpatitamātre tu svedabindau tathā bhuvi । prādurbabhūva sumahānagniḥ kālānalopamaḥ ॥37॥
html:
tasminpatitamātre tu svedabindau tathā bhuvi ।
prādurbabhūva sumahānagniḥ kālānalopamaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: tasminpatitamAtre tu svedabindO taTA Buvi । prAdurbaBUva sumahAnagniH kAlAnalopamaH ॥37॥

text: tatra cājāyata tadā puruṣaḥ puruṣarṣabha । hrasvo'timātraraktākṣo hariśmaśrurvibhīṣaṇaḥ ॥38॥
html:
tatra cājāyata tadā puruṣaḥ puruṣarṣabha ।
hrasvo'timātraraktākṣo hariśmaśrurvibhīṣaṇaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: tatra cAjAyata tadA puruzaH puruzarzaBa । hrasvo'timAtraraktAkzo hariSmaSrurviBIzaRaH ॥38॥

text: ūrdhvakeśo'tilomāṅgaḥ śyenolūkastathaiva ca । karālaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaśca raktavāsāstathaiva ca ॥39॥
html:
ūrdhvakeśo'tilomāṅgaḥ śyenolūkastathaiva ca ।
karālaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaśca raktavāsāstathaiva ca ॥39॥
slp1: UrDvakeSo'tilomANgaH SyenolUkastaTEva ca । karAlaH kfzRavarRaSca raktavAsAstaTEva ca ॥39॥

text: taṃ yajñaṃ sa mahāsattvo'dahatkakṣamivānalaḥ । devāścāpyadravansarve tato bhītā diśo daśa ॥40॥
html:
taṃ yajñaṃ sa mahāsattvo'dahatkakṣamivānalaḥ ।
devāścāpyadravansarve tato bhītā diśo daśa ॥40॥
slp1: taM yajYaM sa mahAsattvo'dahatkakzamivAnalaH । devAScApyadravansarve tato BItA diSo daSa ॥40॥

text: tena tasminvicaratā puruṣeṇa viśāmpate । pṛthivī vyacaladrājannatīva bharatarṣabha ॥41॥
html:
tena tasminvicaratā puruṣeṇa viśāmpate ।
pṛthivī vyacaladrājannatīva bharatarṣabha ॥41॥
slp1: tena tasminvicaratA puruzeRa viSAmpate । pfTivI vyacaladrAjannatIva BaratarzaBa ॥41॥

text: hāhābhūte pravṛtte tu nāde lokabhayaṅkare । pitāmaho mahādevaṃ darśayanpratyabhāṣata ॥42॥
html:
hāhābhūte pravṛtte tu nāde lokabhayaṅkare ।
pitāmaho mahādevaṃ darśayanpratyabhāṣata ॥42॥
slp1: hAhABUte pravftte tu nAde lokaBayaNkare । pitAmaho mahAdevaM darSayanpratyaBAzata ॥42॥

text: bhavato'pi surāḥ sarve bhāgaṃ dāsyanti vai prabho । kriyatāṃ pratisaṃhāraḥ sarvadeveśvara tvayā ॥43॥
html:
bhavato'pi surāḥ sarve bhāgaṃ dāsyanti vai prabho ।
kriyatāṃ pratisaṃhāraḥ sarvadeveśvara tvayā ॥43॥
slp1: Bavato'pi surAH sarve BAgaM dAsyanti vE praBo । kriyatAM pratisaMhAraH sarvadeveSvara tvayA ॥43॥

text: imā hi devatāḥ sarvā ṛṣayaśca parantapa । tava krodhānmahādeva na śāntimupalebhire ॥44॥
html:
imā hi devatāḥ sarvā ṛṣayaśca parantapa ।
tava krodhānmahādeva na śāntimupalebhire ॥44॥
slp1: imA hi devatAH sarvA fzayaSca parantapa । tava kroDAnmahAdeva na SAntimupaleBire ॥44॥

text: yaścaiṣa puruṣo jātaḥ svedātte vibudhottama । jvaro nāmaiṣa dharmajña lokeṣu pracariṣyati ॥45॥
html:
yaścaiṣa puruṣo jātaḥ svedātte vibudhottama ।
jvaro nāmaiṣa dharmajña lokeṣu pracariṣyati ॥45॥
slp1: yaScEza puruzo jAtaH svedAtte vibuDottama । jvaro nAmEza DarmajYa lokezu pracarizyati ॥45॥

text: ekībhūtasya na hyasya dhāraṇe tejasaḥ prabho । samarthā sakalā pṛthvī bahudhā sṛjyatāmayam ॥46॥
html:
ekībhūtasya na hyasya dhāraṇe tejasaḥ prabho ।
samarthā sakalā pṛthvī bahudhā sṛjyatāmayam ॥46॥
slp1: ekIBUtasya na hyasya DAraRe tejasaH praBo । samarTA sakalA pfTvI bahuDA sfjyatAmayam ॥46॥

text: ityukto brahmaṇā devo bhāge cāpi prakalpite । bhagavantaṃ tathetyāha brahmāṇamamitaujasam ॥47॥
html:
ityukto brahmaṇā devo bhāge cāpi prakalpite ।
bhagavantaṃ tathetyāha brahmāṇamamitaujasam ॥47॥
slp1: ityukto brahmaRA devo BAge cApi prakalpite । BagavantaM taTetyAha brahmARamamitOjasam ॥47॥

text: parāṃ ca prītimagamadutsmayaṃśca pinākadhṛk । avāpa ca tadā bhāgaṃ yathoktaṃ brahmaṇā bhavaḥ ॥48॥
html:
parāṃ ca prītimagamadutsmayaṃśca pinākadhṛk ।
avāpa ca tadā bhāgaṃ yathoktaṃ brahmaṇā bhavaḥ ॥48॥
slp1: parAM ca prItimagamadutsmayaMSca pinAkaDfk । avApa ca tadA BAgaM yaToktaM brahmaRA BavaH ॥48॥

text: jvaraṃ ca sarvadharmajño bahudhā vyasṛjattadā । śāntyarthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ śṛṇu taccāpi putraka ॥49॥
html:
jvaraṃ ca sarvadharmajño bahudhā vyasṛjattadā ।
śāntyarthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ śṛṇu taccāpi putraka ॥49॥
slp1: jvaraM ca sarvaDarmajYo bahuDA vyasfjattadA । SAntyarTaM sarvaBUtAnAM SfRu taccApi putraka ॥49॥

text: śīrṣābhitāpo nāgānāṃ parvatānāṃ śilājatuḥ । apāṃ tu nīlikāṃ vidyānnirmokaṃ bhujageṣu ca ॥50॥
html:
śīrṣābhitāpo nāgānāṃ parvatānāṃ śilājatuḥ ।
apāṃ tu nīlikāṃ vidyānnirmokaṃ bhujageṣu ca ॥50॥
slp1: SIrzABitApo nAgAnAM parvatAnAM SilAjatuH । apAM tu nIlikAM vidyAnnirmokaM Bujagezu ca ॥50॥

text: khorakaḥ saurabheyāṇāmūṣaraṃ pṛthivītale । paśūnāmapi dharmajña dṛṣṭipratyavarodhanam ॥51॥
html:
khorakaḥ saurabheyāṇāmūṣaraṃ pṛthivītale ।
paśūnāmapi dharmajña dṛṣṭipratyavarodhanam ॥51॥
slp1: KorakaH sOraBeyARAmUzaraM pfTivItale । paSUnAmapi DarmajYa dfzwipratyavaroDanam ॥51॥

text: randhrāgatamathāśvānāṃ śikhodbhedaśca barhiṇām । netrarogaḥ kokilānāṃ jvaraḥ prokto mahātmanā ॥52॥
html:
randhrāgatamathāśvānāṃ śikhodbhedaśca barhiṇām ।
netrarogaḥ kokilānāṃ jvaraḥ prokto mahātmanā ॥52॥
slp1: ranDrAgatamaTASvAnAM SiKodBedaSca barhiRAm । netrarogaH kokilAnAM jvaraH prokto mahAtmanA ॥52॥

text: abjānāṃ pittabhedaśca sarveṣāmiti naḥ śrutam । śukānāmapi sarveṣāṃ hikkikā procyate jvaraḥ ॥53॥
html:
abjānāṃ pittabhedaśca sarveṣāmiti naḥ śrutam ।
śukānāmapi sarveṣāṃ hikkikā procyate jvaraḥ ॥53॥
slp1: abjAnAM pittaBedaSca sarvezAmiti naH Srutam । SukAnAmapi sarvezAM hikkikA procyate jvaraH ॥53॥

text: śārdūleṣvatha dharmajña śramo jvara ihocyate । mānuṣeṣu tu dharmajña jvaro nāmaiṣa viśrutaḥ । maraṇe janmani tathā madhye cāviśate naram ॥54॥
html:
śārdūleṣvatha dharmajña śramo jvara ihocyate ।
mānuṣeṣu tu dharmajña jvaro nāmaiṣa viśrutaḥ ।
maraṇe janmani tathā madhye cāviśate naram ॥54॥
slp1: SArdUlezvaTa DarmajYa Sramo jvara ihocyate । mAnuzezu tu DarmajYa jvaro nAmEza viSrutaH । maraRe janmani taTA maDye cAviSate naram ॥54॥

text: etanmāheśvaraṃ tejo jvaro nāma sudāruṇaḥ । namasyaścaiva mānyaśca sarvaprāṇibhirīśvaraḥ ॥55॥
html:
etanmāheśvaraṃ tejo jvaro nāma sudāruṇaḥ ।
namasyaścaiva mānyaśca sarvaprāṇibhirīśvaraḥ ॥55॥
slp1: etanmAheSvaraM tejo jvaro nAma sudAruRaH । namasyaScEva mAnyaSca sarvaprARiBirISvaraH ॥55॥

text: anena hi samāviṣṭo vṛtro dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ । vyajṛmbhata tataḥ śakrastasmai vajramavāsṛjat ॥56॥
html:
anena hi samāviṣṭo vṛtro dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ।
vyajṛmbhata tataḥ śakrastasmai vajramavāsṛjat ॥56॥
slp1: anena hi samAvizwo vftro DarmaBftAM varaH । vyajfmBata tataH SakrastasmE vajramavAsfjat ॥56॥

text: praviśya vajro vṛtraṃ tu dārayāmāsa bhārata । dāritaśca sa vajreṇa mahāyogī mahāsuraḥ । jagāma paramaṃ sthānaṃ viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ ॥57॥
html:
praviśya vajro vṛtraṃ tu dārayāmāsa bhārata ।
dāritaśca sa vajreṇa mahāyogī mahāsuraḥ ।
jagāma paramaṃ sthānaṃ viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ ॥57॥
slp1: praviSya vajro vftraM tu dArayAmAsa BArata । dAritaSca sa vajreRa mahAyogI mahAsuraH । jagAma paramaM sTAnaM vizRoramitatejasaH ॥57॥

text: viṣṇubhaktyā hi tenedaṃ jagadvyāptamabhūtpurā । tasmācca nihato yuddhe viṣṇoḥ sthānamavāptavān ॥58॥
html:
viṣṇubhaktyā hi tenedaṃ jagadvyāptamabhūtpurā ।
tasmācca nihato yuddhe viṣṇoḥ sthānamavāptavān ॥58॥
slp1: vizRuBaktyA hi tenedaM jagadvyAptamaBUtpurA । tasmAcca nihato yudDe vizRoH sTAnamavAptavAn ॥58॥

text: ityeṣa vṛtramāśritya jvarasya mahato mayā । vistaraḥ kathitaḥ putra kimanyatprabravīmi te ॥59॥
html:
ityeṣa vṛtramāśritya jvarasya mahato mayā ।
vistaraḥ kathitaḥ putra kimanyatprabravīmi te ॥59॥
slp1: ityeza vftramASritya jvarasya mahato mayA । vistaraH kaTitaH putra kimanyatprabravImi te ॥59॥

text: imāṃ jvarotpattimadīnamānasaḥ paṭhetsadā yaḥ susamāhito naraḥ । vimuktarogaḥ sa sukhī mudā yuto labheta kāmānsa yathāmanīṣitān] ॥60॥
html:
imāṃ jvarotpattimadīnamānasaḥ paṭhetsadā yaḥ susamāhito naraḥ ।
vimuktarogaḥ sa sukhī mudā yuto labheta kāmānsa yathāmanīṣitān] ॥60॥
slp1: imAM jvarotpattimadInamAnasaH paWetsadA yaH susamAhito naraH । vimuktarogaH sa suKI mudA yuto laBeta kAmAnsa yaTAmanIzitAn] ॥60॥

text: śokādduḥkhācca mṛtyośca trasyanti prāṇinaḥ sadā । ubhayaṃ me yathā na syāttanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
śokādduḥkhācca mṛtyośca trasyanti prāṇinaḥ sadā ।
ubhayaṃ me yathā na syāttanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: SokAdduHKAcca mftyoSca trasyanti prARinaH sadA । uBayaM me yaTA na syAttanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । nāradasya ca saṃvādaṃ samaṅgasya ca bhārata ॥2॥
html:
atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
nāradasya ca saṃvādaṃ samaṅgasya ca bhārata ॥2॥
slp1: atrEvodAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । nAradasya ca saMvAdaM samaNgasya ca BArata ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: uraseva praṇamase bāhubhyāṃ tarasīva ca । saṃprahṛṣṭamanā nityaṃ viśoka iva lakṣyase ॥3॥
html:
uraseva praṇamase bāhubhyāṃ tarasīva ca ।
saṃprahṛṣṭamanā nityaṃ viśoka iva lakṣyase ॥3॥
slp1: uraseva praRamase bAhuByAM tarasIva ca । saMprahfzwamanA nityaM viSoka iva lakzyase ॥3॥
author: nārada uvāca ।

text: udvegaṃ neha te kiñcitsusūkṣmamapi lakṣaye । nityatṛpta iva svastho bālavacca viceṣṭase ॥4॥
html:
udvegaṃ neha te kiñcitsusūkṣmamapi lakṣaye ।
nityatṛpta iva svastho bālavacca viceṣṭase ॥4॥
slp1: udvegaM neha te kiYcitsusUkzmamapi lakzaye । nityatfpta iva svasTo bAlavacca vicezwase ॥4॥

text: bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca sarvaṃ sattveṣu mānada । teṣāṃ tattvāni jānāmi tato na vimanā hyaham ॥5॥
html:
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca sarvaṃ sattveṣu mānada ।
teṣāṃ tattvāni jānāmi tato na vimanā hyaham ॥5॥
slp1: BUtaM BavyaM Bavizyacca sarvaM sattvezu mAnada । tezAM tattvAni jAnAmi tato na vimanA hyaham ॥5॥
author: samaṅga uvāca ।

text: upakramānahaṃ veda punareva phalodayān । loke phalāni citrāṇi tato na vimanā hyaham ॥6॥
html:
upakramānahaṃ veda punareva phalodayān ।
loke phalāni citrāṇi tato na vimanā hyaham ॥6॥
slp1: upakramAnahaM veda punareva PalodayAn । loke PalAni citrARi tato na vimanA hyaham ॥6॥

text: agādhāścāpratiṣṭhāśca gatimantaśca nārada । andhā jaḍāśca jīvanti paśyāsmānapi jīvataḥ ॥7॥
html:
agādhāścāpratiṣṭhāśca gatimantaśca nārada ।
andhā jaḍāśca jīvanti paśyāsmānapi jīvataḥ ॥7॥
slp1: agADAScApratizWASca gatimantaSca nArada । anDA jaqASca jIvanti paSyAsmAnapi jIvataH ॥7॥

text: vihitenaiva jīvanti arogāṅgā divaukasaḥ । balavanto'balāścaiva tadvadasmānsabhājaya ॥8॥
html:
vihitenaiva jīvanti arogāṅgā divaukasaḥ ।
balavanto'balāścaiva tadvadasmānsabhājaya ॥8॥
slp1: vihitenEva jIvanti arogANgA divOkasaH । balavanto'balAScEva tadvadasmAnsaBAjaya ॥8॥

text: sahasriṇaśca jīvanti jīvanti śatinastathā । śākena cānye jīvanti paśyāsmānapi jīvataḥ ॥9॥
html:
sahasriṇaśca jīvanti jīvanti śatinastathā ।
śākena cānye jīvanti paśyāsmānapi jīvataḥ ॥9॥
slp1: sahasriRaSca jIvanti jIvanti SatinastaTA । SAkena cAnye jIvanti paSyAsmAnapi jIvataH ॥9॥

text: yadā na śocemahi kiṃ nu na syāddharmeṇa vā nārada karmaṇā vā । kṛtāntavaśyāni yadā sukhāni duḥkhāni vā yanna vidharṣayanti ॥10॥
html:
yadā na śocemahi kiṃ nu na syāddharmeṇa vā nārada karmaṇā vā ।
kṛtāntavaśyāni yadā sukhāni duḥkhāni vā yanna vidharṣayanti ॥10॥
slp1: yadA na Socemahi kiM nu na syAdDarmeRa vA nArada karmaRA vA । kftAntavaSyAni yadA suKAni duHKAni vA yanna viDarzayanti ॥10॥

text: yasmai prajñāṃ kathayante manuṣyāḥ prajñāmūlo hīndriyāṇāṃ prasādaḥ । muhyanti śocanti yadendriyāṇi prajñālābho nāsti mūḍhendriyasya ॥11॥
html:
yasmai prajñāṃ kathayante manuṣyāḥ prajñāmūlo hīndriyāṇāṃ prasādaḥ ।
muhyanti śocanti yadendriyāṇi prajñālābho nāsti mūḍhendriyasya ॥11॥
slp1: yasmE prajYAM kaTayante manuzyAH prajYAmUlo hIndriyARAM prasAdaH । muhyanti Socanti yadendriyARi prajYAlABo nAsti mUQendriyasya ॥11॥

text: mūḍhasya darpaḥ sa punarmoha eva mūḍhasya nāyaṃ na paro'sti lokaḥ । na hyeva duḥkhāni sadā bhavanti sukhasya vā nityaśo lābha eva ॥12॥
html:
mūḍhasya darpaḥ sa punarmoha eva mūḍhasya nāyaṃ na paro'sti lokaḥ ।
na hyeva duḥkhāni sadā bhavanti sukhasya vā nityaśo lābha eva ॥12॥
slp1: mUQasya darpaH sa punarmoha eva mUQasya nAyaM na paro'sti lokaH । na hyeva duHKAni sadA Bavanti suKasya vA nityaSo lABa eva ॥12॥

text: bhāvātmakaṃ saṃparivartamānaṃ na mādṛśaḥ sañjvaraṃ jātu kuryāt । iṣṭānbhogānnānurudhyetsukhaṃ vā na cintayedduḥkhamabhyāgataṃ vā ॥13॥
html:
bhāvātmakaṃ saṃparivartamānaṃ na mādṛśaḥ sañjvaraṃ jātu kuryāt ।
iṣṭānbhogānnānurudhyetsukhaṃ vā na cintayedduḥkhamabhyāgataṃ vā ॥13॥
slp1: BAvAtmakaM saMparivartamAnaM na mAdfSaH saYjvaraM jAtu kuryAt । izwAnBogAnnAnuruDyetsuKaM vA na cintayedduHKamaByAgataM vA ॥13॥

text: samāhito na spṛhayetpareṣāṃ nānāgataṃ nābhinandeta lābham । na cāpi hṛṣyedvipule'rthalābhe tathārthanāśe ca na vai viṣīdet ॥14॥
html:
samāhito na spṛhayetpareṣāṃ nānāgataṃ nābhinandeta lābham ।
na cāpi hṛṣyedvipule'rthalābhe tathārthanāśe ca na vai viṣīdet ॥14॥
slp1: samAhito na spfhayetparezAM nAnAgataM nABinandeta lABam । na cApi hfzyedvipule'rTalABe taTArTanASe ca na vE vizIdet ॥14॥

text: na bāndhavā na ca vittaṃ na kaulī na ca śrutaṃ na ca mantrā na vīryam । duḥkhāttrātuṃ sarva evotsahante paratra śīle na tu yānti śāntim ॥15॥
html:
na bāndhavā na ca vittaṃ na kaulī na ca śrutaṃ na ca mantrā na vīryam ।
duḥkhāttrātuṃ sarva evotsahante paratra śīle na tu yānti śāntim ॥15॥
slp1: na bAnDavA na ca vittaM na kOlI na ca SrutaM na ca mantrA na vIryam । duHKAttrAtuM sarva evotsahante paratra SIle na tu yAnti SAntim ॥15॥

text: nāsti buddhirayuktasya nāyogādvidyate sukham । dhṛtiśca duḥkhatyāgaścāpyubhayaṃ naḥ sukhodayam ॥16॥
html:
nāsti buddhirayuktasya nāyogādvidyate sukham ।
dhṛtiśca duḥkhatyāgaścāpyubhayaṃ naḥ sukhodayam ॥16॥
slp1: nAsti budDirayuktasya nAyogAdvidyate suKam । DftiSca duHKatyAgaScApyuBayaM naH suKodayam ॥16॥

text: priyaṃ hi harṣajananaṃ harṣa utsekavardhanaḥ । utseko narakāyaiva tasmāttaṃ santyajāmyaham ॥17॥
html:
priyaṃ hi harṣajananaṃ harṣa utsekavardhanaḥ ।
utseko narakāyaiva tasmāttaṃ santyajāmyaham ॥17॥
slp1: priyaM hi harzajananaM harza utsekavarDanaH । utseko narakAyEva tasmAttaM santyajAmyaham ॥17॥

text: etāñśokabhayotsekānmohanānsukhaduḥkhayoḥ । paśyāmi sākṣivalloke dehasyāsya viceṣṭanāt ॥18॥
html:
etāñśokabhayotsekānmohanānsukhaduḥkhayoḥ ।
paśyāmi sākṣivalloke dehasyāsya viceṣṭanāt ॥18॥
slp1: etAYSokaBayotsekAnmohanAnsuKaduHKayoH । paSyAmi sAkzivalloke dehasyAsya vicezwanAt ॥18॥

text: arthakāmau parityajya viśoko vigatajvaraḥ । tṛṣṇāmohau tu santyajya carāmi pṛthivīmimām ॥19॥
html:
arthakāmau parityajya viśoko vigatajvaraḥ ।
tṛṣṇāmohau tu santyajya carāmi pṛthivīmimām ॥19॥
slp1: arTakAmO parityajya viSoko vigatajvaraH । tfzRAmohO tu santyajya carAmi pfTivImimAm ॥19॥

text: na mṛtyuto na cādharmānna lobhānna kutaścana । pītāmṛtasyevātyantamiha cāmutra vā bhayam ॥20॥
html:
na mṛtyuto na cādharmānna lobhānna kutaścana ।
pītāmṛtasyevātyantamiha cāmutra vā bhayam ॥20॥
slp1: na mftyuto na cADarmAnna loBAnna kutaScana । pItAmftasyevAtyantamiha cAmutra vA Bayam ॥20॥

text: etadbrahmanvijānāmi mahatkṛtvā tapo'vyayam । tena nārada samprāpto na māṃ śokaḥ prabādhate] ॥21॥
html:
etadbrahmanvijānāmi mahatkṛtvā tapo'vyayam ।
tena nārada samprāpto na māṃ śokaḥ prabādhate] ॥21॥
slp1: etadbrahmanvijAnAmi mahatkftvA tapo'vyayam । tena nArada samprApto na mAM SokaH prabADate] ॥21॥

text: atattvajñasya śāstrāṇāṃ satataṃ saṃśayātmanaḥ । akṛtavyavasāyasya śreyo brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
atattvajñasya śāstrāṇāṃ satataṃ saṃśayātmanaḥ ।
akṛtavyavasāyasya śreyo brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: atattvajYasya SAstrARAM satataM saMSayAtmanaH । akftavyavasAyasya Sreyo brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: gurupūjā ca satataṃ vṛddhānāṃ paryupāsanam । śravaṇaṃ caiva vidyānāṃ kūṭasthaṃ śreya ucyate ॥2॥
html:
gurupūjā ca satataṃ vṛddhānāṃ paryupāsanam ।
śravaṇaṃ caiva vidyānāṃ kūṭasthaṃ śreya ucyate ॥2॥
slp1: gurupUjA ca satataM vfdDAnAM paryupAsanam । SravaRaM cEva vidyAnAM kUwasTaM Sreya ucyate ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । gālavasya ca saṃvādaṃ devarṣernāradasya ca ॥3॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
gālavasya ca saṃvādaṃ devarṣernāradasya ca ॥3॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । gAlavasya ca saMvAdaM devarzernAradasya ca ॥3॥

text: vītamohaklamaṃ vipraṃ jñānatṛptaṃ jitendriyam । śreyaskāmaṃ jitātmānaṃ nāradaṃ gālavo'bravīt ॥4॥
html:
vītamohaklamaṃ vipraṃ jñānatṛptaṃ jitendriyam ।
śreyaskāmaṃ jitātmānaṃ nāradaṃ gālavo'bravīt ॥4॥
slp1: vItamohaklamaM vipraM jYAnatfptaM jitendriyam । SreyaskAmaM jitAtmAnaM nAradaM gAlavo'bravIt ॥4॥

text: yaiḥ kaiścitsammato loke guṇaistu puruṣo nṛṣu । bhavatyanapagānsarvāṃstānguṇāṁllakṣayāmyaham ॥5॥
html:
yaiḥ kaiścitsammato loke guṇaistu puruṣo nṛṣu ।
bhavatyanapagānsarvāṃstānguṇāṁllakṣayāmyaham ॥5॥
slp1: yEH kEScitsammato loke guREstu puruzo nfzu । BavatyanapagAnsarvAMstAnguRAṁllakzayAmyaham ॥5॥

text: bhavānevaṃvidho'smākaṃ saṃśayaṃ chettumarhati । amūḍhaściramūḍhānāṃ lokatattvamajānatām ॥6॥
html:
bhavānevaṃvidho'smākaṃ saṃśayaṃ chettumarhati ।
amūḍhaściramūḍhānāṃ lokatattvamajānatām ॥6॥
slp1: BavAnevaMviDo'smAkaM saMSayaM Cettumarhati । amUQaSciramUQAnAM lokatattvamajAnatAm ॥6॥

text: jñāne hyevaṃ pravṛttiḥ syātkāryākārye vijānataḥ । yatkāryaṃ na vyavasyāmastadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥7॥
html:
jñāne hyevaṃ pravṛttiḥ syātkāryākārye vijānataḥ ।
yatkāryaṃ na vyavasyāmastadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥7॥
slp1: jYAne hyevaM pravfttiH syAtkAryAkArye vijAnataH । yatkAryaM na vyavasyAmastadBavAnvaktumarhati ॥7॥

text: bhagavannāśramāḥ sarve pṛthagācāradarśinaḥ । idaṃ śreya idaṃ śreya iti nānāpradhāvitāḥ ॥8॥
html:
bhagavannāśramāḥ sarve pṛthagācāradarśinaḥ ।
idaṃ śreya idaṃ śreya iti nānāpradhāvitāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: BagavannASramAH sarve pfTagAcAradarSinaH । idaM Sreya idaM Sreya iti nAnApraDAvitAH ॥8॥

text: tāṃstu viprasthitāndṛṣṭvā śāstraiḥ śāstrābhinandinaḥ । svaśāstraiḥ parituṣṭāṃśca śreyo nopalabhāmahe ॥9॥
html:
tāṃstu viprasthitāndṛṣṭvā śāstraiḥ śāstrābhinandinaḥ ।
svaśāstraiḥ parituṣṭāṃśca śreyo nopalabhāmahe ॥9॥
slp1: tAMstu viprasTitAndfzwvA SAstrEH SAstrABinandinaH । svaSAstrEH parituzwAMSca Sreyo nopalaBAmahe ॥9॥

text: śāstraṃ yadi bhavedekaṃ vyaktaṃ śreyo bhavettadā । śāstraiśca bahubhirbhūyaḥ śreyo guhyaṃ praveśitam ॥10॥
html:
śāstraṃ yadi bhavedekaṃ vyaktaṃ śreyo bhavettadā ।
śāstraiśca bahubhirbhūyaḥ śreyo guhyaṃ praveśitam ॥10॥
slp1: SAstraM yadi BavedekaM vyaktaM Sreyo BavettadA । SAstrESca bahuBirBUyaH Sreyo guhyaM praveSitam ॥10॥

text: etasmātkāraṇācchreyaḥ kalilaṃ pratibhāti mām । bravītu bhagavāṃstanme upasanno'smyadhīhi bhoḥ ॥11॥
html:
etasmātkāraṇācchreyaḥ kalilaṃ pratibhāti mām ।
bravītu bhagavāṃstanme upasanno'smyadhīhi bhoḥ ॥11॥
slp1: etasmAtkAraRAcCreyaH kalilaM pratiBAti mAm । bravItu BagavAMstanme upasanno'smyaDIhi BoH ॥11॥

text: āśramāstāta catvāro yathāsaṅkalpitāḥ pṛthak । tānsarvānanupaśya tvaṃ samāśrityaiva gālava ॥12॥
html:
āśramāstāta catvāro yathāsaṅkalpitāḥ pṛthak ।
tānsarvānanupaśya tvaṃ samāśrityaiva gālava ॥12॥
slp1: ASramAstAta catvAro yaTAsaNkalpitAH pfTak । tAnsarvAnanupaSya tvaM samASrityEva gAlava ॥12॥
author: nārada uvāca ।

text: teṣāṃ teṣāṃ tathā hi tvamāśramāṇāṃ tatastataḥ । nānārūpaguṇoddeśaṃ paśya viprasthitaṃ pṛthak । nayanti caiva te samyagabhipretamasaṃśayam ॥13॥
html:
teṣāṃ teṣāṃ tathā hi tvamāśramāṇāṃ tatastataḥ ।
nānārūpaguṇoddeśaṃ paśya viprasthitaṃ pṛthak ।
nayanti caiva te samyagabhipretamasaṃśayam ॥13॥
slp1: tezAM tezAM taTA hi tvamASramARAM tatastataH । nAnArUpaguRoddeSaM paSya viprasTitaM pfTak । nayanti cEva te samyagaBipretamasaMSayam ॥13॥

text: ṛju paśyaṃstathā samyagāśramāṇāṃ parāṃ gatim । yattu niḥśreyasaṃ samyaktaccaivāsaṃśayātmakam ॥14॥
html:
ṛju paśyaṃstathā samyagāśramāṇāṃ parāṃ gatim ।
yattu niḥśreyasaṃ samyaktaccaivāsaṃśayātmakam ॥14॥
slp1: fju paSyaMstaTA samyagASramARAM parAM gatim । yattu niHSreyasaM samyaktaccEvAsaMSayAtmakam ॥14॥

text: anugrahaṃ ca mitrāṇāmamitrāṇāṃ ca nigraham । saṅgrahaṃ ca trivargasya śreya āhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥15॥
html:
anugrahaṃ ca mitrāṇāmamitrāṇāṃ ca nigraham ।
saṅgrahaṃ ca trivargasya śreya āhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: anugrahaM ca mitrARAmamitrARAM ca nigraham । saNgrahaM ca trivargasya Sreya AhurmanIziRaH ॥15॥

text: nivṛttiḥ karmaṇaḥ pāpātsatataṃ puṇyaśīlatā । sadbhiśca samudācāraḥ śreya etadasaṃśayam ॥16॥
html:
nivṛttiḥ karmaṇaḥ pāpātsatataṃ puṇyaśīlatā ।
sadbhiśca samudācāraḥ śreya etadasaṃśayam ॥16॥
slp1: nivfttiH karmaRaH pApAtsatataM puRyaSIlatA । sadBiSca samudAcAraH Sreya etadasaMSayam ॥16॥

text: mārdavaṃ sarvabhūteṣu vyavahāreṣu cārjavam । vākcaiva madhurā proktā śreya etadasaṃśayam ॥17॥
html:
mārdavaṃ sarvabhūteṣu vyavahāreṣu cārjavam ।
vākcaiva madhurā proktā śreya etadasaṃśayam ॥17॥
slp1: mArdavaM sarvaBUtezu vyavahArezu cArjavam । vAkcEva maDurA proktA Sreya etadasaMSayam ॥17॥

text: devatābhyaḥ pitṛbhyaśca saṃvibhāgo'tithiṣvapi । asantyāgaśca bhṛtyānāṃ śreya etadasaṃśayam ॥18॥
html:
devatābhyaḥ pitṛbhyaśca saṃvibhāgo'tithiṣvapi ।
asantyāgaśca bhṛtyānāṃ śreya etadasaṃśayam ॥18॥
slp1: devatAByaH pitfByaSca saMviBAgo'tiTizvapi । asantyAgaSca BftyAnAM Sreya etadasaMSayam ॥18॥

text: satyasya vacanaṃ śreyaḥ satyajñānaṃ tu duṣkaram । yadbhūtahitamatyantametatsatyaṃ bravīmyaham ॥19॥
html:
satyasya vacanaṃ śreyaḥ satyajñānaṃ tu duṣkaram ।
yadbhūtahitamatyantametatsatyaṃ bravīmyaham ॥19॥
slp1: satyasya vacanaM SreyaH satyajYAnaM tu duzkaram । yadBUtahitamatyantametatsatyaM bravImyaham ॥19॥

text: ahaṅkārasya ca tyāgaḥ praṇayasya ca nigrahaḥ । santoṣaścaikacaryā ca kūṭasthaṃ śreya ucyate ॥20॥
html:
ahaṅkārasya ca tyāgaḥ praṇayasya ca nigrahaḥ ।
santoṣaścaikacaryā ca kūṭasthaṃ śreya ucyate ॥20॥
slp1: ahaNkArasya ca tyAgaH praRayasya ca nigrahaH । santozaScEkacaryA ca kUwasTaM Sreya ucyate ॥20॥

text: dharmeṇa vedādhyayanaṃ vedāṅgānāṃ tathaiva ca । vidyārthānāṃ ca jijñāsā śreya etadasaṃśayam ॥21॥
html:
dharmeṇa vedādhyayanaṃ vedāṅgānāṃ tathaiva ca ।
vidyārthānāṃ ca jijñāsā śreya etadasaṃśayam ॥21॥
slp1: DarmeRa vedADyayanaM vedANgAnAM taTEva ca । vidyArTAnAM ca jijYAsA Sreya etadasaMSayam ॥21॥

text: śabdarūparasasparśānsaha gandhena kevalān । nātyarthamupaseveta śreyaso'rthī parantapa ॥22॥
html:
śabdarūparasasparśānsaha gandhena kevalān ।
nātyarthamupaseveta śreyaso'rthī parantapa ॥22॥
slp1: SabdarUparasasparSAnsaha ganDena kevalAn । nAtyarTamupaseveta Sreyaso'rTI parantapa ॥22॥

text: naktañcaryā divāsvapnamālasyaṃ paiśunaṃ madam । atiyogamayogaṃ ca śreyaso'rthī parityajet ॥23॥
html:
naktañcaryā divāsvapnamālasyaṃ paiśunaṃ madam ।
atiyogamayogaṃ ca śreyaso'rthī parityajet ॥23॥
slp1: naktaYcaryA divAsvapnamAlasyaM pESunaM madam । atiyogamayogaM ca Sreyaso'rTI parityajet ॥23॥

text: karmotkarṣaṃ na mārgeta pareṣāṃ parinindayā । svaguṇaireva mārgeta viprakarṣaṃ pṛthagjanāt ॥24॥
html:
karmotkarṣaṃ na mārgeta pareṣāṃ parinindayā ।
svaguṇaireva mārgeta viprakarṣaṃ pṛthagjanāt ॥24॥
slp1: karmotkarzaM na mArgeta parezAM parinindayA । svaguREreva mArgeta viprakarzaM pfTagjanAt ॥24॥

text: nirguṇāstveva bhūyiṣṭhamātmasambhāvino narāḥ । doṣairanyānguṇavataḥ kṣipantyātmaguṇakṣayāt ॥25॥
html:
nirguṇāstveva bhūyiṣṭhamātmasambhāvino narāḥ ।
doṣairanyānguṇavataḥ kṣipantyātmaguṇakṣayāt ॥25॥
slp1: nirguRAstveva BUyizWamAtmasamBAvino narAH । dozEranyAnguRavataH kzipantyAtmaguRakzayAt ॥25॥

text: anucyamānāśca punaste manyante mahājanāt । guṇavattaramātmānaṃ svena mānena darpitāḥ ॥26॥
html:
anucyamānāśca punaste manyante mahājanāt ।
guṇavattaramātmānaṃ svena mānena darpitāḥ ॥26॥
slp1: anucyamAnASca punaste manyante mahAjanAt । guRavattaramAtmAnaM svena mAnena darpitAH ॥26॥

text: abruvankasyacinnindāmātmapūjāmavarṇayan । vipaścidguṇasampannaḥ prāpnotyeva mahadyaśaḥ ॥27॥
html:
abruvankasyacinnindāmātmapūjāmavarṇayan ।
vipaścidguṇasampannaḥ prāpnotyeva mahadyaśaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: abruvankasyacinnindAmAtmapUjAmavarRayan । vipaScidguRasampannaH prApnotyeva mahadyaSaH ॥27॥

text: abruvanvāti surabhirgandhaḥ sumanasāṃ śuciḥ । tathaivāvyāharanbhāti vimalo bhānurambare ॥28॥
html:
abruvanvāti surabhirgandhaḥ sumanasāṃ śuciḥ ।
tathaivāvyāharanbhāti vimalo bhānurambare ॥28॥
slp1: abruvanvAti suraBirganDaH sumanasAM SuciH । taTEvAvyAharanBAti vimalo BAnurambare ॥28॥

text: evamādīni cānyāni parityaktāni medhayā । jvalanti yaśasā loke yāni na vyāharanti ca ॥29॥
html:
evamādīni cānyāni parityaktāni medhayā ।
jvalanti yaśasā loke yāni na vyāharanti ca ॥29॥
slp1: evamAdIni cAnyAni parityaktAni meDayA । jvalanti yaSasA loke yAni na vyAharanti ca ॥29॥

text: na loke dīpyate mūrkhaḥ kevalātmapraśaṃsayā । api cāpihitaḥ śvabhre kṛtavidyaḥ prakāśate ॥30॥
html:
na loke dīpyate mūrkhaḥ kevalātmapraśaṃsayā ।
api cāpihitaḥ śvabhre kṛtavidyaḥ prakāśate ॥30॥
slp1: na loke dIpyate mUrKaH kevalAtmapraSaMsayA । api cApihitaH SvaBre kftavidyaH prakASate ॥30॥

text: asannuccairapi proktaḥ śabdaḥ samupaśāmyati । dīpyate tveva lokeṣu śanairapi subhāṣitam ॥31॥
html:
asannuccairapi proktaḥ śabdaḥ samupaśāmyati ।
dīpyate tveva lokeṣu śanairapi subhāṣitam ॥31॥
slp1: asannuccErapi proktaH SabdaH samupaSAmyati । dIpyate tveva lokezu SanErapi suBAzitam ॥31॥

text: mūḍhānāmavaliptānāmasāraṃ bhāṣitaṃ bahu । darśayatyantarātmānaṃ divā rūpamivāṃśumān ॥32॥
html:
mūḍhānāmavaliptānāmasāraṃ bhāṣitaṃ bahu ।
darśayatyantarātmānaṃ divā rūpamivāṃśumān ॥32॥
slp1: mUQAnAmavaliptAnAmasAraM BAzitaM bahu । darSayatyantarAtmAnaM divA rUpamivAMSumAn ॥32॥

text: etasmātkāraṇātprajñāṃ mṛgayante pṛthagvidhām । prajñālābho hi bhūtānāmuttamaḥ pratibhāti mām ॥33॥
html:
etasmātkāraṇātprajñāṃ mṛgayante pṛthagvidhām ।
prajñālābho hi bhūtānāmuttamaḥ pratibhāti mām ॥33॥
slp1: etasmAtkAraRAtprajYAM mfgayante pfTagviDAm । prajYAlABo hi BUtAnAmuttamaH pratiBAti mAm ॥33॥

text: nāpṛṣṭaḥ kasyacidbrūyānna cānyāyena pṛcchataḥ । jñānavānapi medhāvī jaḍavallokamācaret ॥34॥
html:
nāpṛṣṭaḥ kasyacidbrūyānna cānyāyena pṛcchataḥ ।
jñānavānapi medhāvī jaḍavallokamācaret ॥34॥
slp1: nApfzwaH kasyacidbrUyAnna cAnyAyena pfcCataH । jYAnavAnapi meDAvI jaqavallokamAcaret ॥34॥

text: tato vāsaṃ parīkṣeta dharmanityeṣu sādhuṣu । manuṣyeṣu vadānyeṣu svadharmanirateṣu ca ॥35॥
html:
tato vāsaṃ parīkṣeta dharmanityeṣu sādhuṣu ।
manuṣyeṣu vadānyeṣu svadharmanirateṣu ca ॥35॥
slp1: tato vAsaM parIkzeta Darmanityezu sADuzu । manuzyezu vadAnyezu svaDarmaniratezu ca ॥35॥

text: caturṇāṃ yatra varṇānāṃ dharmavyatikaro bhavet । na tatra vāsaṃ kurvīta śreyorthī vai kathañcana ॥36॥
html:
caturṇāṃ yatra varṇānāṃ dharmavyatikaro bhavet ।
na tatra vāsaṃ kurvīta śreyorthī vai kathañcana ॥36॥
slp1: caturRAM yatra varRAnAM Darmavyatikaro Bavet । na tatra vAsaM kurvIta SreyorTI vE kaTaYcana ॥36॥

text: nirārambho'pyayamiha yathālabdhopajīvanaḥ । puṇyaṃ puṇyeṣu vimalaṃ pāpaṃ pāpeṣu cāpnuyāt ॥37॥
html:
nirārambho'pyayamiha yathālabdhopajīvanaḥ ।
puṇyaṃ puṇyeṣu vimalaṃ pāpaṃ pāpeṣu cāpnuyāt ॥37॥
slp1: nirAramBo'pyayamiha yaTAlabDopajIvanaH । puRyaM puRyezu vimalaM pApaM pApezu cApnuyAt ॥37॥

text: apāmagnestathendośca sparśaṃ vedayate yathā । tathā paśyāmahe sparśamubhayoḥ pāpapuṇyayoḥ ॥38॥
html:
apāmagnestathendośca sparśaṃ vedayate yathā ।
tathā paśyāmahe sparśamubhayoḥ pāpapuṇyayoḥ ॥38॥
slp1: apAmagnestaTendoSca sparSaM vedayate yaTA । taTA paSyAmahe sparSamuBayoH pApapuRyayoH ॥38॥

text: apaśyanto'nnaviṣayaṃ bhuñjate vighasāśinaḥ । bhuñjānaṃ cānnaviṣayānviṣayaṃ viddhi karmaṇām ॥39॥
html:
apaśyanto'nnaviṣayaṃ bhuñjate vighasāśinaḥ ।
bhuñjānaṃ cānnaviṣayānviṣayaṃ viddhi karmaṇām ॥39॥
slp1: apaSyanto'nnavizayaM BuYjate viGasASinaH । BuYjAnaM cAnnavizayAnvizayaM vidDi karmaRAm ॥39॥

text: yatrāgamayamānānāmasatkāreṇa pṛcchatām । prabrūyādbrahmaṇo dharmaṃ tyajettaṃ deśamātmavān ॥40॥
html:
yatrāgamayamānānāmasatkāreṇa pṛcchatām ।
prabrūyādbrahmaṇo dharmaṃ tyajettaṃ deśamātmavān ॥40॥
slp1: yatrAgamayamAnAnAmasatkAreRa pfcCatAm । prabrUyAdbrahmaRo DarmaM tyajettaM deSamAtmavAn ॥40॥

text: śiṣyopādhyāyikā vṛttiryatra syātsusamāhitā । yathāvacchāstrasampannā kastaṃ deśaṃ parityajet ॥41॥
html:
śiṣyopādhyāyikā vṛttiryatra syātsusamāhitā ।
yathāvacchāstrasampannā kastaṃ deśaṃ parityajet ॥41॥
slp1: SizyopADyAyikA vfttiryatra syAtsusamAhitA । yaTAvacCAstrasampannA kastaM deSaM parityajet ॥41॥

text: ākāśasthā dhruvaṃ yatra doṣaṃ brūyurvipaścitām । ātmapūjābhikāmā vai ko vasettatra paṇḍitaḥ ॥42॥
html:
ākāśasthā dhruvaṃ yatra doṣaṃ brūyurvipaścitām ।
ātmapūjābhikāmā vai ko vasettatra paṇḍitaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: AkASasTA DruvaM yatra dozaM brUyurvipaScitAm । AtmapUjABikAmA vE ko vasettatra paRqitaH ॥42॥

text: yatra saṃloḍitā lubdhaiḥ prāyaśo dharmasetavaḥ । pradīptamiva śailāntaṃ kastaṃ deśaṃ na santyajet ॥43॥
html:
yatra saṃloḍitā lubdhaiḥ prāyaśo dharmasetavaḥ ।
pradīptamiva śailāntaṃ kastaṃ deśaṃ na santyajet ॥43॥
slp1: yatra saMloqitA lubDEH prAyaSo DarmasetavaH । pradIptamiva SElAntaM kastaM deSaM na santyajet ॥43॥

text: yatra dharmamanāśaṅkāścareyurvītamatsarāḥ । carettatra vaseccaiva puṇyaśīleṣu sādhuṣu ॥44॥
html:
yatra dharmamanāśaṅkāścareyurvītamatsarāḥ ।
carettatra vaseccaiva puṇyaśīleṣu sādhuṣu ॥44॥
slp1: yatra DarmamanASaNkAScareyurvItamatsarAH । carettatra vaseccEva puRyaSIlezu sADuzu ॥44॥

text: dharmamarthanimittaṃ tu careyuryatra mānavāḥ । na tānanuvasejjātu te hi pāpakṛto janāḥ ॥45॥
html:
dharmamarthanimittaṃ tu careyuryatra mānavāḥ ।
na tānanuvasejjātu te hi pāpakṛto janāḥ ॥45॥
slp1: DarmamarTanimittaM tu careyuryatra mAnavAH । na tAnanuvasejjAtu te hi pApakfto janAH ॥45॥

text: karmaṇā yatra pāpena vartante jīvitespavaḥ । vyavadhāvettatastūrṇaṃ sasarpāccharaṇādiva ॥46॥
html:
karmaṇā yatra pāpena vartante jīvitespavaḥ ।
vyavadhāvettatastūrṇaṃ sasarpāccharaṇādiva ॥46॥
slp1: karmaRA yatra pApena vartante jIvitespavaH । vyavaDAvettatastUrRaM sasarpAcCaraRAdiva ॥46॥

text: yena khaṭvāṃ samārūḍhaḥ karmaṇānuśayī bhavet । āditastanna kartavyamicchatā bhavamātmanaḥ ॥47॥
html:
yena khaṭvāṃ samārūḍhaḥ karmaṇānuśayī bhavet ।
āditastanna kartavyamicchatā bhavamātmanaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: yena KawvAM samArUQaH karmaRAnuSayI Bavet । Aditastanna kartavyamicCatA BavamAtmanaH ॥47॥

text: yatra rājā ca rājñaśca puruṣāḥ pratyanantarāḥ । kuṭumbināmagrabhujastyajettadrāṣṭramātmavān ॥48॥
html:
yatra rājā ca rājñaśca puruṣāḥ pratyanantarāḥ ।
kuṭumbināmagrabhujastyajettadrāṣṭramātmavān ॥48॥
slp1: yatra rAjA ca rAjYaSca puruzAH pratyanantarAH । kuwumbinAmagraBujastyajettadrAzwramAtmavAn ॥48॥

text: śrotriyāstvagrabhoktāro dharmanityāḥ sanātanāḥ । yājanādhyāpane yuktā yatra tadrāṣṭramāvaset ॥49॥
html:
śrotriyāstvagrabhoktāro dharmanityāḥ sanātanāḥ ।
yājanādhyāpane yuktā yatra tadrāṣṭramāvaset ॥49॥
slp1: SrotriyAstvagraBoktAro DarmanityAH sanAtanAH । yAjanADyApane yuktA yatra tadrAzwramAvaset ॥49॥

text: svāhāsvadhāvaṣaṭkārā yatra samyaganuṣṭhitāḥ । ajasraṃ caiva vartante vasettatrāvicārayan ॥50॥
html:
svāhāsvadhāvaṣaṭkārā yatra samyaganuṣṭhitāḥ ।
ajasraṃ caiva vartante vasettatrāvicārayan ॥50॥
slp1: svAhAsvaDAvazawkArA yatra samyaganuzWitAH । ajasraM cEva vartante vasettatrAvicArayan ॥50॥

text: aśucīnyatra paśyeta brāhmaṇānvṛttikarśitān । tyajettadrāṣṭramāsannamupasṛṣṭamivāmiṣam ॥51॥
html:
aśucīnyatra paśyeta brāhmaṇānvṛttikarśitān ।
tyajettadrāṣṭramāsannamupasṛṣṭamivāmiṣam ॥51॥
slp1: aSucInyatra paSyeta brAhmaRAnvfttikarSitAn । tyajettadrAzwramAsannamupasfzwamivAmizam ॥51॥

text: prīyamāṇā narā yatra prayaccheyurayācitāḥ । svasthacitto vasettatra kṛtakṛtya ivātmavān ॥52॥
html:
prīyamāṇā narā yatra prayaccheyurayācitāḥ ।
svasthacitto vasettatra kṛtakṛtya ivātmavān ॥52॥
slp1: prIyamARA narA yatra prayacCeyurayAcitAH । svasTacitto vasettatra kftakftya ivAtmavAn ॥52॥

text: daṇḍo yatrāvinīteṣu satkāraśca kṛtātmasu । carettatra vaseccaiva puṇyaśīleṣu sādhuṣu ॥53॥
html:
daṇḍo yatrāvinīteṣu satkāraśca kṛtātmasu ।
carettatra vaseccaiva puṇyaśīleṣu sādhuṣu ॥53॥
slp1: daRqo yatrAvinItezu satkAraSca kftAtmasu । carettatra vaseccEva puRyaSIlezu sADuzu ॥53॥

text: upasṛṣṭeṣvadānteṣu durācāreṣvasādhuṣu । avinīteṣu lubdheṣu sumahaddaṇḍadhāraṇam ॥54॥
html:
upasṛṣṭeṣvadānteṣu durācāreṣvasādhuṣu ।
avinīteṣu lubdheṣu sumahaddaṇḍadhāraṇam ॥54॥
slp1: upasfzwezvadAntezu durAcArezvasADuzu । avinItezu lubDezu sumahaddaRqaDAraRam ॥54॥

text: yatra rājā dharmanityo rājyaṃ vai paryupāsitā । apāsya kāmānkāmeśo vasettatrāvicārayan ॥55॥
html:
yatra rājā dharmanityo rājyaṃ vai paryupāsitā ।
apāsya kāmānkāmeśo vasettatrāvicārayan ॥55॥
slp1: yatra rAjA Darmanityo rAjyaM vE paryupAsitA । apAsya kAmAnkAmeSo vasettatrAvicArayan ॥55॥

text: tathāśīlā hi rājānaḥ sarvānviṣayavāsinaḥ । śreyasā yojayantyāśu śreyasi pratyupasthite ॥56॥
html:
tathāśīlā hi rājānaḥ sarvānviṣayavāsinaḥ ।
śreyasā yojayantyāśu śreyasi pratyupasthite ॥56॥
slp1: taTASIlA hi rAjAnaH sarvAnvizayavAsinaH । SreyasA yojayantyASu Sreyasi pratyupasTite ॥56॥

text: pṛcchataste mayā tāta śreya etadudāhṛtam । na hi śakyaṃ pradhānena śreyaḥ saṅkhyātumātmanaḥ ॥57॥
html:
pṛcchataste mayā tāta śreya etadudāhṛtam ।
na hi śakyaṃ pradhānena śreyaḥ saṅkhyātumātmanaḥ ॥57॥
slp1: pfcCataste mayA tAta Sreya etadudAhftam । na hi SakyaM praDAnena SreyaH saNKyAtumAtmanaH ॥57॥

text: evaṃ pravartamānasya vṛttiṃ praṇihitātmanaḥ । tapasaiveha bahulaṃ śreyo vyaktaṃ bhaviṣyati] ॥58॥
html:
evaṃ pravartamānasya vṛttiṃ praṇihitātmanaḥ ।
tapasaiveha bahulaṃ śreyo vyaktaṃ bhaviṣyati] ॥58॥
slp1: evaM pravartamAnasya vfttiM praRihitAtmanaH । tapasEveha bahulaM Sreyo vyaktaM Bavizyati] ॥58॥

text: kathaṃ nu muktaḥ pṛthivīṃ caredasmadvidho nṛpaḥ । nityaṃ kaiśca guṇairyuktaḥ saṅgapāśādvimucyate ॥1॥
html:
kathaṃ nu muktaḥ pṛthivīṃ caredasmadvidho nṛpaḥ ।
nityaṃ kaiśca guṇairyuktaḥ saṅgapāśādvimucyate ॥1॥
slp1: kaTaM nu muktaH pfTivIM caredasmadviDo nfpaH । nityaM kESca guREryuktaH saNgapASAdvimucyate ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atra te vartayiṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam । ariṣṭaneminā proktaṃ sagarāyānupṛcchate ॥2॥
html:
atra te vartayiṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam ।
ariṣṭaneminā proktaṃ sagarāyānupṛcchate ॥2॥
slp1: atra te vartayizyAmi itihAsaM purAtanam । arizwaneminA proktaM sagarAyAnupfcCate ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kiṃ śreyaḥ paramaṃ brahmankṛtveha sukhamaśnute । kathaṃ na śocenna kṣubhyedetadicchāmi veditum ॥3॥
html:
kiṃ śreyaḥ paramaṃ brahmankṛtveha sukhamaśnute ।
kathaṃ na śocenna kṣubhyedetadicchāmi veditum ॥3॥
slp1: kiM SreyaH paramaM brahmankftveha suKamaSnute । kaTaM na Socenna kzuByedetadicCAmi veditum ॥3॥
author: sagara uvāca ।

text: evamuktastadā tārkṣyaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ । vibudhya saṃpadaṃ cāgryāṃ sadvākyamidamabravīt ॥4॥
html:
evamuktastadā tārkṣyaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ ।
vibudhya saṃpadaṃ cāgryāṃ sadvākyamidamabravīt ॥4॥
slp1: evamuktastadA tArkzyaH sarvaSAstraviSAradaH । vibuDya saMpadaM cAgryAM sadvAkyamidamabravIt ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sukhaṃ mokṣasukhaṃ loke na ca loko'vagacchati । prasaktaḥ putrapaśuṣu dhanadhānyasamākulaḥ ॥5॥
html:
sukhaṃ mokṣasukhaṃ loke na ca loko'vagacchati ।
prasaktaḥ putrapaśuṣu dhanadhānyasamākulaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: suKaM mokzasuKaM loke na ca loko'vagacCati । prasaktaH putrapaSuzu DanaDAnyasamAkulaH ॥5॥

text: saktabuddhiraśāntātmā na sa śakyaścikitsitum । snehapāśasito mūḍho na sa mokṣāya kalpate ॥6॥
html:
saktabuddhiraśāntātmā na sa śakyaścikitsitum ।
snehapāśasito mūḍho na sa mokṣāya kalpate ॥6॥
slp1: saktabudDiraSAntAtmA na sa SakyaScikitsitum । snehapASasito mUQo na sa mokzAya kalpate ॥6॥

text: snehajāniha te pāśānvakṣyāmi śṛṇu tānmama । sakarṇakena śirasā śakyāśchettuṃ vijānatā ॥7॥
html:
snehajāniha te pāśānvakṣyāmi śṛṇu tānmama ।
sakarṇakena śirasā śakyāśchettuṃ vijānatā ॥7॥
slp1: snehajAniha te pASAnvakzyAmi SfRu tAnmama । sakarRakena SirasA SakyASCettuM vijAnatA ॥7॥

text: sambhāvya putrānkālena yauvanasthānniveśya ca । samarthāñjīvane jñātvā muktaścara yathāsukham ॥8॥
html:
sambhāvya putrānkālena yauvanasthānniveśya ca ।
samarthāñjīvane jñātvā muktaścara yathāsukham ॥8॥
slp1: samBAvya putrAnkAlena yOvanasTAnniveSya ca । samarTAYjIvane jYAtvA muktaScara yaTAsuKam ॥8॥

text: bhāryāṃ putravatīṃ vṛddhāṃ lālitāṃ putravatsalām । jñātvā prajahi kāle tvaṃ parārthamanudṛśya ca ॥9॥
html:
bhāryāṃ putravatīṃ vṛddhāṃ lālitāṃ putravatsalām ।
jñātvā prajahi kāle tvaṃ parārthamanudṛśya ca ॥9॥
slp1: BAryAM putravatIM vfdDAM lAlitAM putravatsalAm । jYAtvA prajahi kAle tvaM parArTamanudfSya ca ॥9॥

text: sāpatyo nirapatyo vā muktaścara yathāsukham । indriyairindriyārthāṃstvamanubhūya yathāvidhi ॥10॥
html:
sāpatyo nirapatyo vā muktaścara yathāsukham ।
indriyairindriyārthāṃstvamanubhūya yathāvidhi ॥10॥
slp1: sApatyo nirapatyo vA muktaScara yaTAsuKam । indriyErindriyArTAMstvamanuBUya yaTAviDi ॥10॥

text: kṛtakautūhalasteṣu muktaścara yathāsukham । upapattyopalabdheṣu lābheṣu ca samo bhava ॥11॥
html:
kṛtakautūhalasteṣu muktaścara yathāsukham ।
upapattyopalabdheṣu lābheṣu ca samo bhava ॥11॥
slp1: kftakOtUhalastezu muktaScara yaTAsuKam । upapattyopalabDezu lABezu ca samo Bava ॥11॥

text: eṣa tāvatsamāsena tava saṅkīrtito mayā । mokṣārtho vistareṇāpi bhūyo vakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu ॥12॥
html:
eṣa tāvatsamāsena tava saṅkīrtito mayā ।
mokṣārtho vistareṇāpi bhūyo vakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu ॥12॥
slp1: eza tAvatsamAsena tava saNkIrtito mayA । mokzArTo vistareRApi BUyo vakzyAmi tacCfRu ॥12॥

text: muktā vītabhayā loke caranti sukhino narāḥ । saktabhāvā vinaśyanti narāstatra na saṃśayaḥ ॥13॥
html:
muktā vītabhayā loke caranti sukhino narāḥ ।
saktabhāvā vinaśyanti narāstatra na saṃśayaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: muktA vItaBayA loke caranti suKino narAH । saktaBAvA vinaSyanti narAstatra na saMSayaH ॥13॥

text: āhārasañcayāścaiva tathā kīṭapipīlikāḥ । asaktāḥ sukhino loke saktāścaiva vināśinaḥ ॥14॥
html:
āhārasañcayāścaiva tathā kīṭapipīlikāḥ ।
asaktāḥ sukhino loke saktāścaiva vināśinaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: AhArasaYcayAScEva taTA kIwapipIlikAH । asaktAH suKino loke saktAScEva vinASinaH ॥14॥

text: svajane na ca te cintā kartavyā mokṣabuddhinā । ime mayā vinābhūtā bhaviṣyanti kathaṃ tviti ॥15॥
html:
svajane na ca te cintā kartavyā mokṣabuddhinā ।
ime mayā vinābhūtā bhaviṣyanti kathaṃ tviti ॥15॥
slp1: svajane na ca te cintA kartavyA mokzabudDinA । ime mayA vinABUtA Bavizyanti kaTaM tviti ॥15॥

text: svayamutpadyate jantuḥ svayameva vivardhate । sukhaduḥkhe tathā mṛtyuṃ svayamevādhigacchati ॥16॥
html:
svayamutpadyate jantuḥ svayameva vivardhate ।
sukhaduḥkhe tathā mṛtyuṃ svayamevādhigacchati ॥16॥
slp1: svayamutpadyate jantuH svayameva vivarDate । suKaduHKe taTA mftyuM svayamevADigacCati ॥16॥

text: bhojanācchādane caiva mātrā pitrā ca saṅgraham । svakṛtenādhigacchanti loke nāstyakṛtaṃ purā ॥17॥
html:
bhojanācchādane caiva mātrā pitrā ca saṅgraham ।
svakṛtenādhigacchanti loke nāstyakṛtaṃ purā ॥17॥
slp1: BojanAcCAdane cEva mAtrA pitrA ca saNgraham । svakftenADigacCanti loke nAstyakftaM purA ॥17॥

text: dhātrā vihitabhakṣyāṇi sarvabhūtāni medinīm । loke viparidhāvanti rakṣitāni svakarmabhiḥ ॥18॥
html:
dhātrā vihitabhakṣyāṇi sarvabhūtāni medinīm ।
loke viparidhāvanti rakṣitāni svakarmabhiḥ ॥18॥
slp1: DAtrA vihitaBakzyARi sarvaBUtAni medinIm । loke vipariDAvanti rakzitAni svakarmaBiH ॥18॥

text: svayaṃ mṛtpiṇḍabhūtasya paratantrasya sarvadā । ko hetuḥ svajanaṃ poṣṭuṃ rakṣituṃ vādṛḍhātmanaḥ ॥19॥
html:
svayaṃ mṛtpiṇḍabhūtasya paratantrasya sarvadā ।
ko hetuḥ svajanaṃ poṣṭuṃ rakṣituṃ vādṛḍhātmanaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: svayaM mftpiRqaBUtasya paratantrasya sarvadA । ko hetuH svajanaM pozwuM rakzituM vAdfQAtmanaH ॥19॥

text: svajanaṃ hi yadā mṛtyurhantyeva tava paśyataḥ । kṛte'pi yatne mahati tatra boddhavyamātmanā ॥20॥
html:
svajanaṃ hi yadā mṛtyurhantyeva tava paśyataḥ ।
kṛte'pi yatne mahati tatra boddhavyamātmanā ॥20॥
slp1: svajanaM hi yadA mftyurhantyeva tava paSyataH । kfte'pi yatne mahati tatra bodDavyamAtmanA ॥20॥

text: jīvantamapi caivainaṃ bharaṇe rakṣaṇe tathā । asamāpte parityajya paścādapi mariṣyasi ॥21॥
html:
jīvantamapi caivainaṃ bharaṇe rakṣaṇe tathā ।
asamāpte parityajya paścādapi mariṣyasi ॥21॥
slp1: jIvantamapi cEvEnaM BaraRe rakzaRe taTA । asamApte parityajya paScAdapi marizyasi ॥21॥

text: yadā mṛtaśca svajanaṃ na jñāsyasi kathañcana । sukhitaṃ duḥkhitaṃ vāpi nanu boddhavyamātmanā ॥22॥
html:
yadā mṛtaśca svajanaṃ na jñāsyasi kathañcana ।
sukhitaṃ duḥkhitaṃ vāpi nanu boddhavyamātmanā ॥22॥
slp1: yadA mftaSca svajanaM na jYAsyasi kaTaYcana । suKitaM duHKitaM vApi nanu bodDavyamAtmanA ॥22॥

text: mṛte vā tvayi jīve vā yadi bhokṣyati vai janaḥ । svakṛtaṃ nanu buddhvaivaṃ kartavyaṃ hitamātmanaḥ ॥23॥
html:
mṛte vā tvayi jīve vā yadi bhokṣyati vai janaḥ ।
svakṛtaṃ nanu buddhvaivaṃ kartavyaṃ hitamātmanaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: mfte vA tvayi jIve vA yadi Bokzyati vE janaH । svakftaM nanu budDvEvaM kartavyaM hitamAtmanaH ॥23॥

text: evaṃ vijānaṁlloke'sminkaḥ kasyetyabhiniścitaḥ । mokṣe niveśaya mano bhūyaścāpyupadhāraya ॥24॥
html:
evaṃ vijānaṁlloke'sminkaḥ kasyetyabhiniścitaḥ ।
mokṣe niveśaya mano bhūyaścāpyupadhāraya ॥24॥
slp1: evaM vijAnaṁlloke'sminkaH kasyetyaBiniScitaH । mokze niveSaya mano BUyaScApyupaDAraya ॥24॥

text: kṣutpipāsādayo bhāvā jitā yasyeha dehinaḥ । krodho lobhastathā mohaḥ sattvavānmukta eva saḥ ॥25॥
html:
kṣutpipāsādayo bhāvā jitā yasyeha dehinaḥ ।
krodho lobhastathā mohaḥ sattvavānmukta eva saḥ ॥25॥
slp1: kzutpipAsAdayo BAvA jitA yasyeha dehinaH । kroDo loBastaTA mohaH sattvavAnmukta eva saH ॥25॥

text: dyūte pāne tathā strīṣu mṛgayāyāṃ ca yo naraḥ । na pramādyati sammohātsatataṃ mukta eva saḥ ॥26॥
html:
dyūte pāne tathā strīṣu mṛgayāyāṃ ca yo naraḥ ।
na pramādyati sammohātsatataṃ mukta eva saḥ ॥26॥
slp1: dyUte pAne taTA strIzu mfgayAyAM ca yo naraH । na pramAdyati sammohAtsatataM mukta eva saH ॥26॥

text: divase divase nāma rātrau rātrau sadā sadā । bhoktavyamiti yaḥ khinno doṣabuddhiḥ sa ucyate ॥27॥
html:
divase divase nāma rātrau rātrau sadā sadā ।
bhoktavyamiti yaḥ khinno doṣabuddhiḥ sa ucyate ॥27॥
slp1: divase divase nAma rAtrO rAtrO sadA sadA । Boktavyamiti yaH Kinno dozabudDiH sa ucyate ॥27॥

text: ātmabhāvaṃ tathā strīṣu muktameva punaḥ punaḥ । yaḥ paśyati sadā yukto yathāvanmukta eva saḥ ॥28॥
html:
ātmabhāvaṃ tathā strīṣu muktameva punaḥ punaḥ ।
yaḥ paśyati sadā yukto yathāvanmukta eva saḥ ॥28॥
slp1: AtmaBAvaM taTA strIzu muktameva punaH punaH । yaH paSyati sadA yukto yaTAvanmukta eva saH ॥28॥

text: sambhavaṃ ca vināśaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ ceṣṭitaṃ tathā । yastattvato vijānāti loke'sminmukta eva saḥ ॥29॥
html:
sambhavaṃ ca vināśaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ ceṣṭitaṃ tathā ।
yastattvato vijānāti loke'sminmukta eva saḥ ॥29॥
slp1: samBavaM ca vinASaM ca BUtAnAM cezwitaM taTA । yastattvato vijAnAti loke'sminmukta eva saH ॥29॥

text: prasthaṃ vāhasahasreṣu yātrārthaṃ caiva koṭiṣu । prāsāde mañcakasthānaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa mucyate ॥30॥
html:
prasthaṃ vāhasahasreṣu yātrārthaṃ caiva koṭiṣu ।
prāsāde mañcakasthānaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa mucyate ॥30॥
slp1: prasTaM vAhasahasrezu yAtrArTaM cEva kowizu । prAsAde maYcakasTAnaM yaH paSyati sa mucyate ॥30॥

text: mṛtyunābhyāhataṃ lokaṃ vyādhibhiścopapīḍitam । avṛttikarśitaṃ caiva yaḥ paśyati sa mucyate ॥31॥
html:
mṛtyunābhyāhataṃ lokaṃ vyādhibhiścopapīḍitam ।
avṛttikarśitaṃ caiva yaḥ paśyati sa mucyate ॥31॥
slp1: mftyunAByAhataM lokaM vyADiBiScopapIqitam । avfttikarSitaM cEva yaH paSyati sa mucyate ॥31॥

text: yaḥ paśyati sukhī tuṣṭo napaśyaṃśca vihanyate । yaścāpyalpena santuṣṭo loke'sminmukta eva saḥ ॥32॥
html:
yaḥ paśyati sukhī tuṣṭo napaśyaṃśca vihanyate ।
yaścāpyalpena santuṣṭo loke'sminmukta eva saḥ ॥32॥
slp1: yaH paSyati suKI tuzwo napaSyaMSca vihanyate । yaScApyalpena santuzwo loke'sminmukta eva saH ॥32॥

text: agnīṣomāvidaṃ sarvamiti yaścānupaśyati । na ca saṃspṛśyate bhāvairadbhutairmukta eva saḥ ॥33॥
html:
agnīṣomāvidaṃ sarvamiti yaścānupaśyati ।
na ca saṃspṛśyate bhāvairadbhutairmukta eva saḥ ॥33॥
slp1: agnIzomAvidaM sarvamiti yaScAnupaSyati । na ca saMspfSyate BAvEradButErmukta eva saH ॥33॥

text: paryaṅkaśayyā bhūmiśca samāne yasya dehinaḥ । śālayaśca kadannaṃ ca yasya syānmukta eva saḥ ॥34॥
html:
paryaṅkaśayyā bhūmiśca samāne yasya dehinaḥ ।
śālayaśca kadannaṃ ca yasya syānmukta eva saḥ ॥34॥
slp1: paryaNkaSayyA BUmiSca samAne yasya dehinaH । SAlayaSca kadannaM ca yasya syAnmukta eva saH ॥34॥

text: kṣaumaṃ ca kuśacīraṃ ca kauśeyaṃ valkalāni ca । āvikaṃ carma ca samaṃ yasya syānmukta eva saḥ ॥35॥
html:
kṣaumaṃ ca kuśacīraṃ ca kauśeyaṃ valkalāni ca ।
āvikaṃ carma ca samaṃ yasya syānmukta eva saḥ ॥35॥
slp1: kzOmaM ca kuSacIraM ca kOSeyaM valkalAni ca । AvikaM carma ca samaM yasya syAnmukta eva saH ॥35॥

text: pañcabhūtasamudbhūtaṃ lokaṃ yaścānupaśyati । tathā ca vartate dṛṣṭvā loke'sminmukta eva saḥ ॥36॥
html:
pañcabhūtasamudbhūtaṃ lokaṃ yaścānupaśyati ।
tathā ca vartate dṛṣṭvā loke'sminmukta eva saḥ ॥36॥
slp1: paYcaBUtasamudBUtaM lokaM yaScAnupaSyati । taTA ca vartate dfzwvA loke'sminmukta eva saH ॥36॥

text: sukhaduḥkhe same yasya lābhālābhau jayājayau । icchādveṣau bhayodvegau sarvathā mukta eva saḥ ॥37॥
html:
sukhaduḥkhe same yasya lābhālābhau jayājayau ।
icchādveṣau bhayodvegau sarvathā mukta eva saḥ ॥37॥
slp1: suKaduHKe same yasya lABAlABO jayAjayO । icCAdvezO BayodvegO sarvaTA mukta eva saH ॥37॥

text: raktamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ doṣāṇāṃ sañcayaṃ tathā । śarīraṃ doṣabahulaṃ dṛṣṭvā cedaṃ vimucyate ॥38॥
html:
raktamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ doṣāṇāṃ sañcayaṃ tathā ।
śarīraṃ doṣabahulaṃ dṛṣṭvā cedaṃ vimucyate ॥38॥
slp1: raktamUtrapurIzARAM dozARAM saYcayaM taTA । SarIraM dozabahulaM dfzwvA cedaM vimucyate ॥38॥

text: valīpalitasaṃyogaṃ kārśyaṃ vaivarṇyameva ca । kubjabhāvaṃ ca jarayā yaḥ paśyati sa mucyate ॥39॥
html:
valīpalitasaṃyogaṃ kārśyaṃ vaivarṇyameva ca ।
kubjabhāvaṃ ca jarayā yaḥ paśyati sa mucyate ॥39॥
slp1: valIpalitasaMyogaM kArSyaM vEvarRyameva ca । kubjaBAvaM ca jarayA yaH paSyati sa mucyate ॥39॥

text: puṃstvopaghātaṃ kālena darśanoparamaṃ tathā । bādhiryaṃ prāṇamandatvaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa mucyate ॥40॥
html:
puṃstvopaghātaṃ kālena darśanoparamaṃ tathā ।
bādhiryaṃ prāṇamandatvaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa mucyate ॥40॥
slp1: puMstvopaGAtaM kAlena darSanoparamaM taTA । bADiryaM prARamandatvaM yaH paSyati sa mucyate ॥40॥

text: gatānṛṣīṃstathā devānasurāṃśca tathā gatān । lokādasmātparaṃ lokaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa mucyate ॥41॥
html:
gatānṛṣīṃstathā devānasurāṃśca tathā gatān ।
lokādasmātparaṃ lokaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa mucyate ॥41॥
slp1: gatAnfzIMstaTA devAnasurAMSca taTA gatAn । lokAdasmAtparaM lokaM yaH paSyati sa mucyate ॥41॥

text: prabhāvairanvitāstaistaiḥ pārthivendrāḥ sahasraśaḥ । ye gatāḥ pṛthivīṃ tyaktvā iti jñātvā vimucyate ॥42॥
html:
prabhāvairanvitāstaistaiḥ pārthivendrāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।
ye gatāḥ pṛthivīṃ tyaktvā iti jñātvā vimucyate ॥42॥
slp1: praBAvEranvitAstEstEH pArTivendrAH sahasraSaH । ye gatAH pfTivIM tyaktvA iti jYAtvA vimucyate ॥42॥

text: arthāṃśca durlabhāṁlloke kleśāṃśca sulabhāṃstathā । duḥkhaṃ caiva kuṭumbārthe yaḥ paśyati sa mucyate ॥43॥
html:
arthāṃśca durlabhāṁlloke kleśāṃśca sulabhāṃstathā ।
duḥkhaṃ caiva kuṭumbārthe yaḥ paśyati sa mucyate ॥43॥
slp1: arTAMSca durlaBAṁlloke kleSAMSca sulaBAMstaTA । duHKaM cEva kuwumbArTe yaH paSyati sa mucyate ॥43॥

text: apatyānāṃ ca vaiguṇyaṃ janaṃ viguṇameva ca । paśyanbhūyiṣṭhaśo loke ko mokṣaṃ nābhipūjayet ॥44॥
html:
apatyānāṃ ca vaiguṇyaṃ janaṃ viguṇameva ca ।
paśyanbhūyiṣṭhaśo loke ko mokṣaṃ nābhipūjayet ॥44॥
slp1: apatyAnAM ca vEguRyaM janaM viguRameva ca । paSyanBUyizWaSo loke ko mokzaM nABipUjayet ॥44॥

text: śāstrāllokācca yo buddhaḥ sarvaṃ paśyati mānavaḥ । asāramiva mānuṣyaṃ sarvathā mukta eva saḥ ॥45॥
html:
śāstrāllokācca yo buddhaḥ sarvaṃ paśyati mānavaḥ ।
asāramiva mānuṣyaṃ sarvathā mukta eva saḥ ॥45॥
slp1: SAstrAllokAcca yo budDaH sarvaM paSyati mAnavaH । asAramiva mAnuzyaM sarvaTA mukta eva saH ॥45॥

text: etacchrutvā mama vaco bhavāṃścaratu muktavat । gārhasthye yadi te mokṣe kṛtā buddhiraviklavā ॥46॥
html:
etacchrutvā mama vaco bhavāṃścaratu muktavat ।
gārhasthye yadi te mokṣe kṛtā buddhiraviklavā ॥46॥
slp1: etacCrutvA mama vaco BavAMScaratu muktavat । gArhasTye yadi te mokze kftA budDiraviklavA ॥46॥

text: tattasya vacanaṃ śrutvā samyaksa pṛthivīpatiḥ । mokṣajaiśca guṇairyuktaḥ pālayāmāsa ca prajāḥ] ॥47॥
html:
tattasya vacanaṃ śrutvā samyaksa pṛthivīpatiḥ ।
mokṣajaiśca guṇairyuktaḥ pālayāmāsa ca prajāḥ] ॥47॥
slp1: tattasya vacanaM SrutvA samyaksa pfTivIpatiH । mokzajESca guREryuktaH pAlayAmAsa ca prajAH] ॥47॥

text: tiṣṭhate me sadā tāta kautūhalamidaṃ hṛdi । tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvattaḥ kurupitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
tiṣṭhate me sadā tāta kautūhalamidaṃ hṛdi ।
tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvattaḥ kurupitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: tizWate me sadA tAta kOtUhalamidaM hfdi । tadahaM SrotumicCAmi tvattaH kurupitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kathaṃ devarṣiruśanā sadā kāvyo mahāmatiḥ । asurāṇāṃ priyakaraḥ surāṇāmapriye rataḥ ॥2॥
html:
kathaṃ devarṣiruśanā sadā kāvyo mahāmatiḥ ।
asurāṇāṃ priyakaraḥ surāṇāmapriye rataḥ ॥2॥
slp1: kaTaM devarziruSanA sadA kAvyo mahAmatiH । asurARAM priyakaraH surARAmapriye rataH ॥2॥

text: vardhayāmāsa tejaśca kimarthamamitaujasām । nityaṃ vairanibaddhāśca dānavāḥ surasattamaiḥ ॥3॥
html:
vardhayāmāsa tejaśca kimarthamamitaujasām ।
nityaṃ vairanibaddhāśca dānavāḥ surasattamaiḥ ॥3॥
slp1: varDayAmAsa tejaSca kimarTamamitOjasAm । nityaM vEranibadDASca dAnavAH surasattamEH ॥3॥

text: kathaṃ cāpyuśanā prāpa śukratvamamaradyutiḥ । ṛddhiṃ ca sa kathaṃ prāptaḥ sarvametadbravīhi me ॥4॥
html:
kathaṃ cāpyuśanā prāpa śukratvamamaradyutiḥ ।
ṛddhiṃ ca sa kathaṃ prāptaḥ sarvametadbravīhi me ॥4॥
slp1: kaTaM cApyuSanA prApa SukratvamamaradyutiH । fdDiM ca sa kaTaM prAptaH sarvametadbravIhi me ॥4॥

text: na yāti ca sa tejasvī madhyena nabhasaḥ katham । etadicchāmi vijñātuṃ nikhilena pitāmaha ॥5॥
html:
na yāti ca sa tejasvī madhyena nabhasaḥ katham ।
etadicchāmi vijñātuṃ nikhilena pitāmaha ॥5॥
slp1: na yAti ca sa tejasvI maDyena naBasaH kaTam । etadicCAmi vijYAtuM niKilena pitAmaha ॥5॥

text: śṛṇu rājannavahitaḥ sarvametadyathātatham । yathāmati yathā caitacchrutapūrvaṃ mayānagha ॥6॥
html:
śṛṇu rājannavahitaḥ sarvametadyathātatham ।
yathāmati yathā caitacchrutapūrvaṃ mayānagha ॥6॥
slp1: SfRu rAjannavahitaH sarvametadyaTAtaTam । yaTAmati yaTA cEtacCrutapUrvaM mayAnaGa ॥6॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: eṣa bhārgavadāyādo muniḥ satyo dṛḍhavrataḥ । asurāṇāṃ priyakaro nimitte karuṇātmake ॥7॥
html:
eṣa bhārgavadāyādo muniḥ satyo dṛḍhavrataḥ ।
asurāṇāṃ priyakaro nimitte karuṇātmake ॥7॥
slp1: eza BArgavadAyAdo muniH satyo dfQavrataH । asurARAM priyakaro nimitte karuRAtmake ॥7॥

text: indro'tha dhanado rājā yakṣarakṣodhipaḥ sa ca । prabhaviṣṇuśca kośasya jagataśca tathā prabhuḥ ॥8॥
html:
indro'tha dhanado rājā yakṣarakṣodhipaḥ sa ca ।
prabhaviṣṇuśca kośasya jagataśca tathā prabhuḥ ॥8॥
slp1: indro'Ta Danado rAjA yakzarakzoDipaH sa ca । praBavizRuSca koSasya jagataSca taTA praBuH ॥8॥

text: tasyātmānamathāviśya yogasiddho mahāmuniḥ । ruddhvā dhanapatiṃ devaṃ yogena hṛtavānvasu ॥9॥
html:
tasyātmānamathāviśya yogasiddho mahāmuniḥ ।
ruddhvā dhanapatiṃ devaṃ yogena hṛtavānvasu ॥9॥
slp1: tasyAtmAnamaTAviSya yogasidDo mahAmuniH । rudDvA DanapatiM devaM yogena hftavAnvasu ॥9॥

text: hṛte dhane tataḥ śarma na lebhe dhanadastathā । āpannamanyuḥ saṃvignaḥ so'bhyagātsurasattamam ॥10॥
html:
hṛte dhane tataḥ śarma na lebhe dhanadastathā ।
āpannamanyuḥ saṃvignaḥ so'bhyagātsurasattamam ॥10॥
slp1: hfte Dane tataH Sarma na leBe DanadastaTA । ApannamanyuH saMvignaH so'ByagAtsurasattamam ॥10॥

text: nivedayāmāsa tadā śivāyāmitatejase । devaśreṣṭhāya rudrāya saumyāya bahurūpiṇe ॥11॥
html:
nivedayāmāsa tadā śivāyāmitatejase ।
devaśreṣṭhāya rudrāya saumyāya bahurūpiṇe ॥11॥
slp1: nivedayAmAsa tadA SivAyAmitatejase । devaSrezWAya rudrAya sOmyAya bahurUpiRe ॥11॥

text: yogātmakenośanasā ruddhvā mama hṛtaṃ vasu । yogenātmagatiṃ kṛtvā niḥsṛtaśca mahātapāḥ ॥12॥
html:
yogātmakenośanasā ruddhvā mama hṛtaṃ vasu ।
yogenātmagatiṃ kṛtvā niḥsṛtaśca mahātapāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: yogAtmakenoSanasA rudDvA mama hftaM vasu । yogenAtmagatiM kftvA niHsftaSca mahAtapAH ॥12॥
author: kubera uvāca ।

text: etacchrutvā tataḥ kruddho mahāyogī maheśvaraḥ । saṃraktanayano rājañśūlamādāya tasthivān ॥13॥
html:
etacchrutvā tataḥ kruddho mahāyogī maheśvaraḥ ।
saṃraktanayano rājañśūlamādāya tasthivān ॥13॥
slp1: etacCrutvA tataH krudDo mahAyogI maheSvaraH । saMraktanayano rAjaYSUlamAdAya tasTivAn ॥13॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kvāsvau kvāsāviti prāha gṛhītvā paramāyudham । uśanā dūratastasya babhau jñātvā cikīrṣitam ॥14॥
html:
kvāsvau kvāsāviti prāha gṛhītvā paramāyudham ।
uśanā dūratastasya babhau jñātvā cikīrṣitam ॥14॥
slp1: kvAsvO kvAsAviti prAha gfhItvA paramAyuDam । uSanA dUratastasya baBO jYAtvA cikIrzitam ॥14॥

text: sa mahāyogino buddhvā taṃ roṣaṃ vai mahātmanaḥ । gatimāgamanaṃ vetti sthānaṃ vetti tataḥ prabhuḥ ॥15॥
html:
sa mahāyogino buddhvā taṃ roṣaṃ vai mahātmanaḥ ।
gatimāgamanaṃ vetti sthānaṃ vetti tataḥ prabhuḥ ॥15॥
slp1: sa mahAyogino budDvA taM rozaM vE mahAtmanaH । gatimAgamanaM vetti sTAnaM vetti tataH praBuH ॥15॥

text: sañcintyogreṇa tapasā mahātmānaṃ maheśvaram । uśanā yogasiddhātmā śūlāgre pratyadṛśyata ॥16॥
html:
sañcintyogreṇa tapasā mahātmānaṃ maheśvaram ।
uśanā yogasiddhātmā śūlāgre pratyadṛśyata ॥16॥
slp1: saYcintyogreRa tapasA mahAtmAnaM maheSvaram । uSanA yogasidDAtmA SUlAgre pratyadfSyata ॥16॥

text: vijñātarūpaḥ sa tadā tapaḥsiddhena dhanvinā । jñātvā śūlaṃ ca deveśaḥ pāṇinā samanāmayat ॥17॥
html:
vijñātarūpaḥ sa tadā tapaḥsiddhena dhanvinā ।
jñātvā śūlaṃ ca deveśaḥ pāṇinā samanāmayat ॥17॥
slp1: vijYAtarUpaH sa tadA tapaHsidDena DanvinA । jYAtvA SUlaM ca deveSaH pARinA samanAmayat ॥17॥

text: ānatenātha śūlena pāṇināmitatejasā । pinākamiti covāca śūlamugrāyudhaḥ prabhuḥ ॥18॥
html:
ānatenātha śūlena pāṇināmitatejasā ।
pinākamiti covāca śūlamugrāyudhaḥ prabhuḥ ॥18॥
slp1: AnatenATa SUlena pARinAmitatejasA । pinAkamiti covAca SUlamugrAyuDaH praBuH ॥18॥

text: pāṇimadhyagataṃ dṛṣṭvā bhārgavaṃ tamumāpatiḥ । āsyaṃ vivṛtya kakudī pāṇiṃ samprākṣipacchanaiḥ ॥19॥
html:
pāṇimadhyagataṃ dṛṣṭvā bhārgavaṃ tamumāpatiḥ ।
āsyaṃ vivṛtya kakudī pāṇiṃ samprākṣipacchanaiḥ ॥19॥
slp1: pARimaDyagataM dfzwvA BArgavaM tamumApatiH । AsyaM vivftya kakudI pARiM samprAkzipacCanEH ॥19॥

text: sa tu praviṣṭa uśanā koṣṭhaṃ māheśvaraṃ prabhuḥ । vyacaraccāpi tatrāsau mahātmā bhṛgunandanaḥ ॥20॥
html:
sa tu praviṣṭa uśanā koṣṭhaṃ māheśvaraṃ prabhuḥ ।
vyacaraccāpi tatrāsau mahātmā bhṛgunandanaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: sa tu pravizwa uSanA kozWaM mAheSvaraM praBuH । vyacaraccApi tatrAsO mahAtmA BfgunandanaH ॥20॥

text: kimarthaṃ vyacaradrājannuśanā tasya dhīmataḥ । jaṭhare devadevasya kiṃ cākārṣīnmahādyutiḥ ॥21॥
html:
kimarthaṃ vyacaradrājannuśanā tasya dhīmataḥ ।
jaṭhare devadevasya kiṃ cākārṣīnmahādyutiḥ ॥21॥
slp1: kimarTaM vyacaradrAjannuSanA tasya DImataH । jaWare devadevasya kiM cAkArzInmahAdyutiH ॥21॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: purā so'ntarjalagataḥ sthāṇubhūto mahāvrataḥ । varṣāṇāmabhavadrājanprayutānyarbudāni ca ॥22॥
html:
purā so'ntarjalagataḥ sthāṇubhūto mahāvrataḥ ।
varṣāṇāmabhavadrājanprayutānyarbudāni ca ॥22॥
slp1: purA so'ntarjalagataH sTARuBUto mahAvrataH । varzARAmaBavadrAjanprayutAnyarbudAni ca ॥22॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: udatiṣṭhattapastaptvā duścaraṃ sa mahāhradāt । tato devātidevastaṃ brahmā samupasarpata ॥23॥
html:
udatiṣṭhattapastaptvā duścaraṃ sa mahāhradāt ।
tato devātidevastaṃ brahmā samupasarpata ॥23॥
slp1: udatizWattapastaptvA duScaraM sa mahAhradAt । tato devAtidevastaM brahmA samupasarpata ॥23॥

text: tapovṛddhimapṛcchacca kuśalaṃ cainamavyayam । tapaḥ sucīrṇamiti ca provāca vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ॥24॥
html:
tapovṛddhimapṛcchacca kuśalaṃ cainamavyayam ।
tapaḥ sucīrṇamiti ca provāca vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: tapovfdDimapfcCacca kuSalaM cEnamavyayam । tapaH sucIrRamiti ca provAca vfzaBaDvajaH ॥24॥

text: tatsaṃyogena vṛddhiṃ cāpyapaśyatsa tu śaṅkaraḥ । mahāmatiracintyātmā satyadharmarataḥ sadā ॥25॥
html:
tatsaṃyogena vṛddhiṃ cāpyapaśyatsa tu śaṅkaraḥ ।
mahāmatiracintyātmā satyadharmarataḥ sadā ॥25॥
slp1: tatsaMyogena vfdDiM cApyapaSyatsa tu SaNkaraH । mahAmatiracintyAtmA satyaDarmarataH sadA ॥25॥

text: sa tenāḍhyo mahāyogī tapasā ca dhanena ca । vyarājata mahārāja triṣu lokeṣu vīryavān ॥26॥
html:
sa tenāḍhyo mahāyogī tapasā ca dhanena ca ।
vyarājata mahārāja triṣu lokeṣu vīryavān ॥26॥
slp1: sa tenAQyo mahAyogI tapasA ca Danena ca । vyarAjata mahArAja trizu lokezu vIryavAn ॥26॥

text: tataḥ pinākī yogātmā dhyānayogaṃ samāviśat । uśanā tu samudvigno nililye jaṭhare tataḥ ॥27॥
html:
tataḥ pinākī yogātmā dhyānayogaṃ samāviśat ।
uśanā tu samudvigno nililye jaṭhare tataḥ ॥27॥
slp1: tataH pinAkI yogAtmA DyAnayogaM samAviSat । uSanA tu samudvigno nililye jaWare tataH ॥27॥

text: tuṣṭāva ca mahāyogī devaṃ tatrastha eva ca । niḥsāraṃ kāṅkṣamāṇastu tejasā pratyahanyata ॥28॥
html:
tuṣṭāva ca mahāyogī devaṃ tatrastha eva ca ।
niḥsāraṃ kāṅkṣamāṇastu tejasā pratyahanyata ॥28॥
slp1: tuzwAva ca mahAyogI devaM tatrasTa eva ca । niHsAraM kANkzamARastu tejasA pratyahanyata ॥28॥

text: uśanā tu tadovāca jaṭharastho mahāmuniḥ । prasādaṃ me kuruṣveti punaḥ punararindama ॥29॥
html:
uśanā tu tadovāca jaṭharastho mahāmuniḥ ।
prasādaṃ me kuruṣveti punaḥ punararindama ॥29॥
slp1: uSanA tu tadovAca jaWarasTo mahAmuniH । prasAdaM me kuruzveti punaH punararindama ॥29॥

text: tamuvāca mahādevo gaccha śiśnena mokṣaṇam । iti srotāṃsi sarvāṇi ruddhvā tridaśapuṅgavaḥ ॥30॥
html:
tamuvāca mahādevo gaccha śiśnena mokṣaṇam ।
iti srotāṃsi sarvāṇi ruddhvā tridaśapuṅgavaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: tamuvAca mahAdevo gacCa SiSnena mokzaRam । iti srotAMsi sarvARi rudDvA tridaSapuNgavaH ॥30॥

text: apaśyamānaḥ sa dvāraṃ sarvataḥpihito muniḥ । paryakrāmaddahyamāna itaścetaśca tejasā ॥31॥
html:
apaśyamānaḥ sa dvāraṃ sarvataḥpihito muniḥ ।
paryakrāmaddahyamāna itaścetaśca tejasā ॥31॥
slp1: apaSyamAnaH sa dvAraM sarvataHpihito muniH । paryakrAmaddahyamAna itaScetaSca tejasA ॥31॥

text: sa viniṣkramya śiśnena śukratvamabhipedivān । kāryeṇa tena nabhaso nāgacchata ca madhyataḥ ॥32॥
html:
sa viniṣkramya śiśnena śukratvamabhipedivān ।
kāryeṇa tena nabhaso nāgacchata ca madhyataḥ ॥32॥
slp1: sa vinizkramya SiSnena SukratvamaBipedivAn । kAryeRa tena naBaso nAgacCata ca maDyataH ॥32॥

text: niṣkrāntamatha taṃ dṛṣṭvā jvalantamiva tejasā । bhavo roṣasamāviṣṭaḥ śūlodyatakaraḥ sthitaḥ ॥33॥
html:
niṣkrāntamatha taṃ dṛṣṭvā jvalantamiva tejasā ।
bhavo roṣasamāviṣṭaḥ śūlodyatakaraḥ sthitaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: nizkrAntamaTa taM dfzwvA jvalantamiva tejasA । Bavo rozasamAvizwaH SUlodyatakaraH sTitaH ॥33॥

text: nyavārayata taṃ devī kruddhaṃ paśupatiṃ patim । putratvamagamaddevyā vārite śaṅkare ca saḥ ॥34॥
html:
nyavārayata taṃ devī kruddhaṃ paśupatiṃ patim ।
putratvamagamaddevyā vārite śaṅkare ca saḥ ॥34॥
slp1: nyavArayata taM devI krudDaM paSupatiM patim । putratvamagamaddevyA vArite SaNkare ca saH ॥34॥

text: hiṃsanīyastvayā naiṣa mama putratvamāgataḥ । na hi devodarātkaścinniḥsṛto nāśamarchati ॥35॥
html:
hiṃsanīyastvayā naiṣa mama putratvamāgataḥ ।
na hi devodarātkaścinniḥsṛto nāśamarchati ॥35॥
slp1: hiMsanIyastvayA nEza mama putratvamAgataH । na hi devodarAtkaScinniHsfto nASamarCati ॥35॥
author: devyuvāca ।

text: tataḥ prīto'bhavaddevyāḥ prahasaṃścedamabravīt । gacchatveṣa yathākāmamiti rājanpunaḥ punaḥ ॥36॥
html:
tataḥ prīto'bhavaddevyāḥ prahasaṃścedamabravīt ।
gacchatveṣa yathākāmamiti rājanpunaḥ punaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: tataH prIto'BavaddevyAH prahasaMScedamabravIt । gacCatveza yaTAkAmamiti rAjanpunaH punaH ॥36॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tataḥ praṇamya varadaṃ devaṃ devīmumāṃ tathā । uśanā prāpa taddhīmāngatimiṣṭāṃ mahāmuniḥ ॥37॥
html:
tataḥ praṇamya varadaṃ devaṃ devīmumāṃ tathā ।
uśanā prāpa taddhīmāngatimiṣṭāṃ mahāmuniḥ ॥37॥
slp1: tataH praRamya varadaM devaM devImumAM taTA । uSanA prApa tadDImAngatimizwAM mahAmuniH ॥37॥

text: etatte kathitaṃ tāta bhārgavasya mahātmanaḥ । caritaṃ bharataśreṣṭha yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi] ॥38॥
html:
etatte kathitaṃ tāta bhārgavasya mahātmanaḥ ।
caritaṃ bharataśreṣṭha yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi] ॥38॥
slp1: etatte kaTitaM tAta BArgavasya mahAtmanaH । caritaM BarataSrezWa yanmAM tvaM paripfcCasi] ॥38॥

text: ataḥ paraṃ mahābāho yacchreyastadvadasva me । na tṛpyāmyamṛtasyeva vacasaste pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
ataḥ paraṃ mahābāho yacchreyastadvadasva me ।
na tṛpyāmyamṛtasyeva vacasaste pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: ataH paraM mahAbAho yacCreyastadvadasva me । na tfpyAmyamftasyeva vacasaste pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kiṃ karma puruṣaḥ kṛtvā śubhaṃ puruṣasattama । śreyaḥ paramavāpnoti pretya ceha ca tadvada ॥2॥
html:
kiṃ karma puruṣaḥ kṛtvā śubhaṃ puruṣasattama ।
śreyaḥ paramavāpnoti pretya ceha ca tadvada ॥2॥
slp1: kiM karma puruzaH kftvA SuBaM puruzasattama । SreyaH paramavApnoti pretya ceha ca tadvada ॥2॥

text: atra te vartayiṣyāmi yathā pūrvaṃ mahāyaśāḥ । parāśaraṃ mahātmānaṃ papraccha janako nṛpaḥ ॥3॥
html:
atra te vartayiṣyāmi yathā pūrvaṃ mahāyaśāḥ ।
parāśaraṃ mahātmānaṃ papraccha janako nṛpaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: atra te vartayizyAmi yaTA pUrvaM mahAyaSAH । parASaraM mahAtmAnaM papracCa janako nfpaH ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kiṃ śreyaḥ sarvabhūtānāmasmiṁlloke paratra ca । yadbhavetpratipattavyaṃ tadbhavānprabravītu me ॥4॥
html:
kiṃ śreyaḥ sarvabhūtānāmasmiṁlloke paratra ca ।
yadbhavetpratipattavyaṃ tadbhavānprabravītu me ॥4॥
slp1: kiM SreyaH sarvaBUtAnAmasmiṁlloke paratra ca । yadBavetpratipattavyaM tadBavAnprabravItu me ॥4॥

text: tataḥ sa tapasā yuktaḥ sarvadharmavidhānavit । nṛpāyānugrahamanā munirvākyamathābravīt ॥5॥
html:
tataḥ sa tapasā yuktaḥ sarvadharmavidhānavit ।
nṛpāyānugrahamanā munirvākyamathābravīt ॥5॥
slp1: tataH sa tapasA yuktaH sarvaDarmaviDAnavit । nfpAyAnugrahamanA munirvAkyamaTAbravIt ॥5॥

text: dharma eva kṛtaḥ śreyāniha loke paratra ca । tasmāddhi paramaṃ nāsti yathā prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥6॥
html:
dharma eva kṛtaḥ śreyāniha loke paratra ca ।
tasmāddhi paramaṃ nāsti yathā prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: Darma eva kftaH SreyAniha loke paratra ca । tasmAdDi paramaM nAsti yaTA prAhurmanIziRaH ॥6॥

text: pratipadya naro dharmaṃ svargaloke mahīyate । dharmātmakaḥ karmavidhirdehināṃ nṛpasattama । tasminnāśramiṇaḥ santaḥ svakarmāṇīha kurvate ॥7॥
html:
pratipadya naro dharmaṃ svargaloke mahīyate ।
dharmātmakaḥ karmavidhirdehināṃ nṛpasattama ।
tasminnāśramiṇaḥ santaḥ svakarmāṇīha kurvate ॥7॥
slp1: pratipadya naro DarmaM svargaloke mahIyate । DarmAtmakaH karmaviDirdehinAM nfpasattama । tasminnASramiRaH santaH svakarmARIha kurvate ॥7॥

text: caturvidhā hi lokasya yātrā tāta vidhīyate । martyā yatrāvatiṣṭhante sā ca kāmātpravartate ॥8॥
html:
caturvidhā hi lokasya yātrā tāta vidhīyate ।
martyā yatrāvatiṣṭhante sā ca kāmātpravartate ॥8॥
slp1: caturviDA hi lokasya yAtrA tAta viDIyate । martyA yatrAvatizWante sA ca kAmAtpravartate ॥8॥

text: sukṛtāsukṛtaṃ karma niṣevya vividhaiḥ kramaiḥ । daśārdhapravibhaktānāṃ bhūtānāṃ bahudhā gatiḥ ॥9॥
html:
sukṛtāsukṛtaṃ karma niṣevya vividhaiḥ kramaiḥ ।
daśārdhapravibhaktānāṃ bhūtānāṃ bahudhā gatiḥ ॥9॥
slp1: sukftAsukftaM karma nizevya viviDEH kramEH । daSArDapraviBaktAnAM BUtAnAM bahuDA gatiH ॥9॥

text: sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi yathā bhāṇḍaṃ niṣicyate । tathā niṣicyate jantuḥ pūrvakarmavaśānugaḥ ॥10॥
html:
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi yathā bhāṇḍaṃ niṣicyate ।
tathā niṣicyate jantuḥ pūrvakarmavaśānugaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: sOvarRaM rAjataM vApi yaTA BARqaM nizicyate । taTA nizicyate jantuH pUrvakarmavaSAnugaH ॥10॥

text: nābījājjāyate kiñcinnākṛtvā sukhamedhate । sukṛtī vindati sukhaṃ prāpya dehakṣayaṃ naraḥ ॥11॥
html:
nābījājjāyate kiñcinnākṛtvā sukhamedhate ।
sukṛtī vindati sukhaṃ prāpya dehakṣayaṃ naraḥ ॥11॥
slp1: nAbIjAjjAyate kiYcinnAkftvA suKameDate । sukftI vindati suKaM prApya dehakzayaM naraH ॥11॥

text: daivaṃ tāta na paśyāmi nāsti daivasya sādhanam । svabhāvato hi saṃsiddhā devagandharvadānavāḥ ॥12॥
html:
daivaṃ tāta na paśyāmi nāsti daivasya sādhanam ।
svabhāvato hi saṃsiddhā devagandharvadānavāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: dEvaM tAta na paSyAmi nAsti dEvasya sADanam । svaBAvato hi saMsidDA devaganDarvadAnavAH ॥12॥

text: pretya jātikṛtaṃ karma na smaranti sadā janāḥ । te vai tasya phalaprāptau karma cāpi caturvidham ॥13॥
html:
pretya jātikṛtaṃ karma na smaranti sadā janāḥ ।
te vai tasya phalaprāptau karma cāpi caturvidham ॥13॥
slp1: pretya jAtikftaM karma na smaranti sadA janAH । te vE tasya PalaprAptO karma cApi caturviDam ॥13॥

text: lokayātrāśrayaścaiva śabdo vedāśrayaḥ kṛtaḥ । śāntyarthaṃ manasastāta naitadvṛddhānuśāsanam ॥14॥
html:
lokayātrāśrayaścaiva śabdo vedāśrayaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
śāntyarthaṃ manasastāta naitadvṛddhānuśāsanam ॥14॥
slp1: lokayAtrASrayaScEva Sabdo vedASrayaH kftaH । SAntyarTaM manasastAta nEtadvfdDAnuSAsanam ॥14॥

text: cakṣuṣā manasā vācā karmaṇā ca caturvidham । kurute yādṛśaṃ karma tādṛśaṃ pratipadyate ॥15॥
html:
cakṣuṣā manasā vācā karmaṇā ca caturvidham ।
kurute yādṛśaṃ karma tādṛśaṃ pratipadyate ॥15॥
slp1: cakzuzA manasA vAcA karmaRA ca caturviDam । kurute yAdfSaM karma tAdfSaM pratipadyate ॥15॥

text: nirantaraṃ ca miśraṃ ca phalate karma pārthiva । kalyāṇaṃ yadi vā pāpaṃ na tu nāśo'sya vidyate ॥16॥
html:
nirantaraṃ ca miśraṃ ca phalate karma pārthiva ।
kalyāṇaṃ yadi vā pāpaṃ na tu nāśo'sya vidyate ॥16॥
slp1: nirantaraM ca miSraM ca Palate karma pArTiva । kalyARaM yadi vA pApaM na tu nASo'sya vidyate ॥16॥

text: kadācitsukṛtaṃ tāta kūṭasthamiva tiṣṭhati । majjamānasya saṃsāre yāvadduḥkhādvimucyate ॥17॥
html:
kadācitsukṛtaṃ tāta kūṭasthamiva tiṣṭhati ।
majjamānasya saṃsāre yāvadduḥkhādvimucyate ॥17॥
slp1: kadAcitsukftaM tAta kUwasTamiva tizWati । majjamAnasya saMsAre yAvadduHKAdvimucyate ॥17॥

text: tato duḥkhakṣayaṃ kṛtvā sukṛtaṃ karma sevate । sukṛtakṣayādduṣkṛtaṃ ca tadviddhi manujādhipa ॥18॥
html:
tato duḥkhakṣayaṃ kṛtvā sukṛtaṃ karma sevate ।
sukṛtakṣayādduṣkṛtaṃ ca tadviddhi manujādhipa ॥18॥
slp1: tato duHKakzayaM kftvA sukftaM karma sevate । sukftakzayAdduzkftaM ca tadvidDi manujADipa ॥18॥

text: damaḥ kṣamā dhṛtistejaḥ santoṣaḥ satyavāditā । hrīrahiṃsāvyasanitā dākṣyaṃ ceti sukhāvahāḥ ॥19॥
html:
damaḥ kṣamā dhṛtistejaḥ santoṣaḥ satyavāditā ।
hrīrahiṃsāvyasanitā dākṣyaṃ ceti sukhāvahāḥ ॥19॥
slp1: damaH kzamA DftistejaH santozaH satyavAditA । hrIrahiMsAvyasanitA dAkzyaM ceti suKAvahAH ॥19॥

text: duṣkṛte sukṛte vāpi na janturayato bhavet । nityaṃ manaḥsamādhāne prayateta vicakṣaṇaḥ ॥20॥
html:
duṣkṛte sukṛte vāpi na janturayato bhavet ।
nityaṃ manaḥsamādhāne prayateta vicakṣaṇaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: duzkfte sukfte vApi na janturayato Bavet । nityaM manaHsamADAne prayateta vicakzaRaH ॥20॥

text: nāyaṃ parasya sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ vāpi sevate । karoti yādṛśaṃ karma tādṛśaṃ pratipadyate ॥21॥
html:
nāyaṃ parasya sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ vāpi sevate ।
karoti yādṛśaṃ karma tādṛśaṃ pratipadyate ॥21॥
slp1: nAyaM parasya sukftaM duzkftaM vApi sevate । karoti yAdfSaM karma tAdfSaM pratipadyate ॥21॥

text: sukhaduḥkhe samādhāya pumānanyena gacchati । anyenaiva janaḥ sarvaḥ saṅgato yaśca pārthiva ॥22॥
html:
sukhaduḥkhe samādhāya pumānanyena gacchati ।
anyenaiva janaḥ sarvaḥ saṅgato yaśca pārthiva ॥22॥
slp1: suKaduHKe samADAya pumAnanyena gacCati । anyenEva janaH sarvaH saNgato yaSca pArTiva ॥22॥

text: pareṣāṃ yadasūyeta na tatkuryātsvayaṃ naraḥ । yo hyasūyustathāyuktaḥ so'vahāsaṃ niyacchati ॥23॥
html:
pareṣāṃ yadasūyeta na tatkuryātsvayaṃ naraḥ ।
yo hyasūyustathāyuktaḥ so'vahāsaṃ niyacchati ॥23॥
slp1: parezAM yadasUyeta na tatkuryAtsvayaM naraH । yo hyasUyustaTAyuktaH so'vahAsaM niyacCati ॥23॥

text: bhīrū rājanyo brāhmaṇaḥ sarvabhakṣo vaiśyo'nīhāvānhīnavarṇo'lasaśca । vidvāṃścāśīlo vṛttahīnaḥ kulīnaḥ satyādbhraṣṭo brāhmaṇaḥ strī ca duṣṭā ॥24॥
html:
bhīrū rājanyo brāhmaṇaḥ sarvabhakṣo vaiśyo'nīhāvānhīnavarṇo'lasaśca ।
vidvāṃścāśīlo vṛttahīnaḥ kulīnaḥ satyādbhraṣṭo brāhmaṇaḥ strī ca duṣṭā ॥24॥
slp1: BIrU rAjanyo brAhmaRaH sarvaBakzo vESyo'nIhAvAnhInavarRo'lasaSca । vidvAMScASIlo vfttahInaH kulInaH satyAdBrazwo brAhmaRaH strI ca duzwA ॥24॥

text: rāgī muktaḥ pacamāno''tmahetormūrkho vaktā nṛpahīnaṃ ca rāṣṭram । ete sarve śocyatāṃ yānti rājanyaścāyuktaḥ snehahīnaḥ prajāsu] ॥25॥
html:
rāgī muktaḥ pacamāno''tmahetormūrkho vaktā nṛpahīnaṃ ca rāṣṭram ।
ete sarve śocyatāṃ yānti rājanyaścāyuktaḥ snehahīnaḥ prajāsu] ॥25॥
slp1: rAgI muktaH pacamAno''tmahetormUrKo vaktA nfpahInaM ca rAzwram । ete sarve SocyatAM yAnti rAjanyaScAyuktaH snehahInaH prajAsu] ॥25॥

text: manoratharathaṃ prāpya indriyārthahayaṃ naraḥ । raśmibhirjñānasaṃbhūtairyo gacchati sa buddhimān ॥1॥
html:
manoratharathaṃ prāpya indriyārthahayaṃ naraḥ ।
raśmibhirjñānasaṃbhūtairyo gacchati sa buddhimān ॥1॥
slp1: manoraTaraTaM prApya indriyArTahayaM naraH । raSmiBirjYAnasaMBUtEryo gacCati sa budDimAn ॥1॥
author: parāśara uvāca ।

text: sevāśritena manasā vṛttihīnasya śasyate । dvijātihastānnirvṛttā na tu tulyātparasparam ॥2॥
html:
sevāśritena manasā vṛttihīnasya śasyate ।
dvijātihastānnirvṛttā na tu tulyātparasparam ॥2॥
slp1: sevASritena manasA vfttihInasya Sasyate । dvijAtihastAnnirvfttA na tu tulyAtparasparam ॥2॥

text: āyurnasulabhaṃ labdhvā nāvakarṣedviśāmpate । utkarṣārthaṃ prayatate naraḥ puṇyena karmaṇā ॥3॥
html:
āyurnasulabhaṃ labdhvā nāvakarṣedviśāmpate ।
utkarṣārthaṃ prayatate naraḥ puṇyena karmaṇā ॥3॥
slp1: AyurnasulaBaM labDvA nAvakarzedviSAmpate । utkarzArTaM prayatate naraH puRyena karmaRA ॥3॥

text: varṇebhyo'pi paribhraṣṭaḥ sa vai sammānamarhati । na tu yaḥ satkriyāṃ prāpya rājasaṃ karma sevate ॥4॥
html:
varṇebhyo'pi paribhraṣṭaḥ sa vai sammānamarhati ।
na tu yaḥ satkriyāṃ prāpya rājasaṃ karma sevate ॥4॥
slp1: varReByo'pi pariBrazwaH sa vE sammAnamarhati । na tu yaH satkriyAM prApya rAjasaM karma sevate ॥4॥

text: varṇotkarṣamavāpnoti naraḥ puṇyena karmaṇā । durlabhaṃ tamalabdhā hi hanyātpāpena karmaṇā ॥5॥
html:
varṇotkarṣamavāpnoti naraḥ puṇyena karmaṇā ।
durlabhaṃ tamalabdhā hi hanyātpāpena karmaṇā ॥5॥
slp1: varRotkarzamavApnoti naraH puRyena karmaRA । durlaBaM tamalabDA hi hanyAtpApena karmaRA ॥5॥

text: ajñānāddhi kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tapasaivābhinirṇudet । pāpaṃ hi karma phalati pāpameva svayaṃ kṛtam । tasmātpāpaṃ na seveta karma duḥkhaphalodayam ॥6॥
html:
ajñānāddhi kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tapasaivābhinirṇudet ।
pāpaṃ hi karma phalati pāpameva svayaṃ kṛtam ।
tasmātpāpaṃ na seveta karma duḥkhaphalodayam ॥6॥
slp1: ajYAnAdDi kftaM pApaM tapasEvABinirRudet । pApaM hi karma Palati pApameva svayaM kftam । tasmAtpApaM na seveta karma duHKaPalodayam ॥6॥

text: pāpānubandhaṃ yatkarma yadyapi syānmahāphalam । na tatseveta medhāvī śuciḥ kusalilaṃ yathā ॥7॥
html:
pāpānubandhaṃ yatkarma yadyapi syānmahāphalam ।
na tatseveta medhāvī śuciḥ kusalilaṃ yathā ॥7॥
slp1: pApAnubanDaM yatkarma yadyapi syAnmahAPalam । na tatseveta meDAvI SuciH kusalilaM yaTA ॥7॥

text: kiṅkaṣṭamanupaśyāmi phalaṃ pāpasya karmaṇaḥ । pratyāpannasya hi sato nātmā tāvadvirocate ॥8॥
html:
kiṅkaṣṭamanupaśyāmi phalaṃ pāpasya karmaṇaḥ ।
pratyāpannasya hi sato nātmā tāvadvirocate ॥8॥
slp1: kiNkazwamanupaSyAmi PalaM pApasya karmaRaH । pratyApannasya hi sato nAtmA tAvadvirocate ॥8॥

text: pratyāpattiśca yasyeha bāliśasya na jāyate । tasyāpi sumahāṃstāpaḥ prasthitasyopajāyate ॥9॥
html:
pratyāpattiśca yasyeha bāliśasya na jāyate ।
tasyāpi sumahāṃstāpaḥ prasthitasyopajāyate ॥9॥
slp1: pratyApattiSca yasyeha bAliSasya na jAyate । tasyApi sumahAMstApaH prasTitasyopajAyate ॥9॥

text: viraktaṃ śodhyate vastraṃ na tu kṛṣṇopasaṃhitam । prayatnena manuṣyendra pāpamevaṃ nibodha me ॥10॥
html:
viraktaṃ śodhyate vastraṃ na tu kṛṣṇopasaṃhitam ।
prayatnena manuṣyendra pāpamevaṃ nibodha me ॥10॥
slp1: viraktaM SoDyate vastraM na tu kfzRopasaMhitam । prayatnena manuzyendra pApamevaM niboDa me ॥10॥

text: svayaṃ kṛtvā tu yaḥ pāpaṃ śubhamevānutiṣṭhati । prāyaścittaṃ naraḥ kartumubhayaṃ so'śnute pṛthak ॥11॥
html:
svayaṃ kṛtvā tu yaḥ pāpaṃ śubhamevānutiṣṭhati ।
prāyaścittaṃ naraḥ kartumubhayaṃ so'śnute pṛthak ॥11॥
slp1: svayaM kftvA tu yaH pApaM SuBamevAnutizWati । prAyaScittaM naraH kartumuBayaM so'Snute pfTak ॥11॥

text: ajñānāttu kṛtāṃ hiṃsāmahiṃsā vyapakarṣati । brāhmaṇāḥ śāstranirdeśādityāhurbrahmavādinaḥ ॥12॥
html:
ajñānāttu kṛtāṃ hiṃsāmahiṃsā vyapakarṣati ।
brāhmaṇāḥ śāstranirdeśādityāhurbrahmavādinaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: ajYAnAttu kftAM hiMsAmahiMsA vyapakarzati । brAhmaRAH SAstranirdeSAdityAhurbrahmavAdinaH ॥12॥

text: tathā kāmakṛtaṃ cāsya vihiṃsaivāpakarṣati । ityāhurdharmaśāstrajñā brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ ॥13॥
html:
tathā kāmakṛtaṃ cāsya vihiṃsaivāpakarṣati ।
ityāhurdharmaśāstrajñā brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: taTA kAmakftaM cAsya vihiMsEvApakarzati । ityAhurDarmaSAstrajYA brAhmaRA vedapAragAH ॥13॥

text: ahaṃ tu tāvatpaśyāmi karma yadvartate kṛtam । guṇayuktaṃ prakāśaṃ ca pāpenānupasaṃhitam ॥14॥
html:
ahaṃ tu tāvatpaśyāmi karma yadvartate kṛtam ।
guṇayuktaṃ prakāśaṃ ca pāpenānupasaṃhitam ॥14॥
slp1: ahaM tu tAvatpaSyAmi karma yadvartate kftam । guRayuktaM prakASaM ca pApenAnupasaMhitam ॥14॥
