text: yathā sūkṣmāṇi karmāṇi phalantīha yathātatham । buddhiyuktāni tānīha kṛtāni manasā saha ॥15॥
html:
yathā sūkṣmāṇi karmāṇi phalantīha yathātatham ।
buddhiyuktāni tānīha kṛtāni manasā saha ॥15॥
slp1: yaTA sUkzmARi karmARi PalantIha yaTAtaTam । budDiyuktAni tAnIha kftAni manasA saha ॥15॥

text: bhavatyalpaphalaṃ karma sevitaṃ nityamulbaṇam । abuddhipūrvaṃ dharmajña kṛtamugreṇa karmaṇā ॥16॥
html:
bhavatyalpaphalaṃ karma sevitaṃ nityamulbaṇam ।
abuddhipūrvaṃ dharmajña kṛtamugreṇa karmaṇā ॥16॥
slp1: BavatyalpaPalaM karma sevitaM nityamulbaRam । abudDipUrvaM DarmajYa kftamugreRa karmaRA ॥16॥

text: kṛtāni yāni karmāṇi daivatairmunibhistathā । nācarettāni dharmātmā śrutvā cāpi na kutsayet ॥17॥
html:
kṛtāni yāni karmāṇi daivatairmunibhistathā ।
nācarettāni dharmātmā śrutvā cāpi na kutsayet ॥17॥
slp1: kftAni yAni karmARi dEvatErmuniBistaTA । nAcarettAni DarmAtmA SrutvA cApi na kutsayet ॥17॥

text: sañcintya manasā rājanviditvā śaktimātmanaḥ । karoti yaḥ śubhaṃ karma sa vai bhadrāṇi paśyati ॥18॥
html:
sañcintya manasā rājanviditvā śaktimātmanaḥ ।
karoti yaḥ śubhaṃ karma sa vai bhadrāṇi paśyati ॥18॥
slp1: saYcintya manasA rAjanviditvA SaktimAtmanaH । karoti yaH SuBaM karma sa vE BadrARi paSyati ॥18॥

text: nave kapāle salilaṃ saṃnyastaṃ hīyate yathā । navetare tathābhāvaṃ prāpnoti sukhabhāvitam ॥19॥
html:
nave kapāle salilaṃ saṃnyastaṃ hīyate yathā ।
navetare tathābhāvaṃ prāpnoti sukhabhāvitam ॥19॥
slp1: nave kapAle salilaM saMnyastaM hIyate yaTA । navetare taTABAvaM prApnoti suKaBAvitam ॥19॥

text: satoye'nyattu yattoyaṃ tasminneva prasicyate । vṛddhe vṛddhimavāpnoti salile salilaṃ yathā ॥20॥
html:
satoye'nyattu yattoyaṃ tasminneva prasicyate ।
vṛddhe vṛddhimavāpnoti salile salilaṃ yathā ॥20॥
slp1: satoye'nyattu yattoyaM tasminneva prasicyate । vfdDe vfdDimavApnoti salile salilaM yaTA ॥20॥

text: evaṃ karmāṇi yānīha buddhiyuktāni bhūpate । na samānīha hīnāni tāni puṇyatamānyapi ॥21॥
html:
evaṃ karmāṇi yānīha buddhiyuktāni bhūpate ।
na samānīha hīnāni tāni puṇyatamānyapi ॥21॥
slp1: evaM karmARi yAnIha budDiyuktAni BUpate । na samAnIha hInAni tAni puRyatamAnyapi ॥21॥

text: rājñā jetavyāḥ sāyudhāśconnatāśca samyakkartavyaṃ pālanaṃ ca prajānām । agniśceyo bahubhiścāpi yajñairante madhye vā vanamāśritya stheyam ॥22॥
html:
rājñā jetavyāḥ sāyudhāśconnatāśca samyakkartavyaṃ pālanaṃ ca prajānām ।
agniśceyo bahubhiścāpi yajñairante madhye vā vanamāśritya stheyam ॥22॥
slp1: rAjYA jetavyAH sAyuDASconnatASca samyakkartavyaM pAlanaM ca prajAnAm । agniSceyo bahuBiScApi yajYErante maDye vA vanamASritya sTeyam ॥22॥

text: damānvitaḥ puruṣo dharmaśīlo bhūtāni cātmānamivānupaśyet । garīyasaḥ pūjayedātmaśaktyā satyena śīlena sukhaṃ narendra] ॥23॥
html:
damānvitaḥ puruṣo dharmaśīlo bhūtāni cātmānamivānupaśyet ।
garīyasaḥ pūjayedātmaśaktyā satyena śīlena sukhaṃ narendra] ॥23॥
slp1: damAnvitaH puruzo DarmaSIlo BUtAni cAtmAnamivAnupaSyet । garIyasaH pUjayedAtmaSaktyA satyena SIlena suKaM narendra] ॥23॥

text: kaḥ kasya copakurute kaśca kasmai prayacchati । prāṇī karotyayaṃ karma sarvamātmārthamātmanā ॥1॥
html:
kaḥ kasya copakurute kaśca kasmai prayacchati ।
prāṇī karotyayaṃ karma sarvamātmārthamātmanā ॥1॥
slp1: kaH kasya copakurute kaSca kasmE prayacCati । prARI karotyayaM karma sarvamAtmArTamAtmanA ॥1॥
author: parāśara uvāca ।

text: gauraveṇa parityaktaṃ niḥsnehaṃ parivarjayet । sodaryaṃ bhrātaramapi kimutānyaṃ pṛthagjanam ॥2॥
html:
gauraveṇa parityaktaṃ niḥsnehaṃ parivarjayet ।
sodaryaṃ bhrātaramapi kimutānyaṃ pṛthagjanam ॥2॥
slp1: gOraveRa parityaktaM niHsnehaM parivarjayet । sodaryaM BrAtaramapi kimutAnyaM pfTagjanam ॥2॥

text: viśiṣṭasya viśiṣṭācca tulyau dānapratigrahau । tayoḥ puṇyataraṃ dānaṃ taddvijasya prayacchataḥ ॥3॥
html:
viśiṣṭasya viśiṣṭācca tulyau dānapratigrahau ।
tayoḥ puṇyataraṃ dānaṃ taddvijasya prayacchataḥ ॥3॥
slp1: viSizwasya viSizwAcca tulyO dAnapratigrahO । tayoH puRyataraM dAnaM taddvijasya prayacCataH ॥3॥

text: nyāyāgataṃ dhanaṃ varṇairnyāyenaiva vivardhitam । saṃrakṣyaṃ yatnamāsthāya dharmārthamiti niścayaḥ ॥4॥
html:
nyāyāgataṃ dhanaṃ varṇairnyāyenaiva vivardhitam ।
saṃrakṣyaṃ yatnamāsthāya dharmārthamiti niścayaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: nyAyAgataM DanaM varRErnyAyenEva vivarDitam । saMrakzyaM yatnamAsTAya DarmArTamiti niScayaH ॥4॥

text: na dharmārthī nṛśaṃsena karmaṇā dhanamarjayet । śaktitaḥ sarvakāryāṇi kuryānnarddhimanusmaret ॥5॥
html:
na dharmārthī nṛśaṃsena karmaṇā dhanamarjayet ।
śaktitaḥ sarvakāryāṇi kuryānnarddhimanusmaret ॥5॥
slp1: na DarmArTI nfSaMsena karmaRA Danamarjayet । SaktitaH sarvakAryARi kuryAnnardDimanusmaret ॥5॥

text: apo hi prayataḥ śītāstāpitā jvalanena vā । śaktito'tithaye dattvā kṣudhārtāyāśnute phalam ॥6॥
html:
apo hi prayataḥ śītāstāpitā jvalanena vā ।
śaktito'tithaye dattvā kṣudhārtāyāśnute phalam ॥6॥
slp1: apo hi prayataH SItAstApitA jvalanena vA । Saktito'tiTaye dattvA kzuDArtAyASnute Palam ॥6॥

text: rantidevena lokeṣṭā siddhiḥ prāptā mahātmanā । phalapatrairatho mūlairmunīnarcitavānasau ॥7॥
html:
rantidevena lokeṣṭā siddhiḥ prāptā mahātmanā ।
phalapatrairatho mūlairmunīnarcitavānasau ॥7॥
slp1: rantidevena lokezwA sidDiH prAptA mahAtmanA । PalapatrEraTo mUlErmunInarcitavAnasO ॥7॥

text: taireva phalapatraiśca sa māṭharamatoṣayat । tasmāllebhe paraṃ sthānaṃ śaibyo'pi pṛthivīpatiḥ ॥8॥
html:
taireva phalapatraiśca sa māṭharamatoṣayat ।
tasmāllebhe paraṃ sthānaṃ śaibyo'pi pṛthivīpatiḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tEreva PalapatrESca sa mAWaramatozayat । tasmAlleBe paraM sTAnaM SEbyo'pi pfTivIpatiH ॥8॥

text: devatātithibhṛtyebhyaḥ pitṛbhyo'thātmanastathā । ṛṇavāñjāyate martyastasmādanṛṇatāṃ vrajet ॥9॥
html:
devatātithibhṛtyebhyaḥ pitṛbhyo'thātmanastathā ।
ṛṇavāñjāyate martyastasmādanṛṇatāṃ vrajet ॥9॥
slp1: devatAtiTiBftyeByaH pitfByo'TAtmanastaTA । fRavAYjAyate martyastasmAdanfRatAM vrajet ॥9॥

text: svādhyāyena maharṣibhyo devebhyo yajñakarmaṇā । pitṛbhyaḥ śrāddhadānena nṛṇāmabhyarcanena ca ॥10॥
html:
svādhyāyena maharṣibhyo devebhyo yajñakarmaṇā ।
pitṛbhyaḥ śrāddhadānena nṛṇāmabhyarcanena ca ॥10॥
slp1: svADyAyena maharziByo deveByo yajYakarmaRA । pitfByaH SrAdDadAnena nfRAmaByarcanena ca ॥10॥

text: vācaḥ śeṣāvahāryeṇa pālanenātmano'pi ca । yathāvadbhṛtyavargasya cikīrṣeddharmamāditaḥ ॥11॥
html:
vācaḥ śeṣāvahāryeṇa pālanenātmano'pi ca ।
yathāvadbhṛtyavargasya cikīrṣeddharmamāditaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: vAcaH SezAvahAryeRa pAlanenAtmano'pi ca । yaTAvadBftyavargasya cikIrzedDarmamAditaH ॥11॥

text: prayatnena ca saṃsiddhā dhanairapi vivarjitāḥ । samyagghutvā hutavahaṃ munayaḥ siddhimāgatāḥ ॥12॥
html:
prayatnena ca saṃsiddhā dhanairapi vivarjitāḥ ।
samyagghutvā hutavahaṃ munayaḥ siddhimāgatāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: prayatnena ca saMsidDA DanErapi vivarjitAH । samyagGutvA hutavahaM munayaH sidDimAgatAH ॥12॥

text: viśvāmitrasya putratvamṛcīkatanayo'gamat । ṛgbhiḥ stutvā mahābhāgo devānvai yajñabhāginaḥ ॥13॥
html:
viśvāmitrasya putratvamṛcīkatanayo'gamat ।
ṛgbhiḥ stutvā mahābhāgo devānvai yajñabhāginaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: viSvAmitrasya putratvamfcIkatanayo'gamat । fgBiH stutvA mahABAgo devAnvE yajYaBAginaH ॥13॥

text: gataḥ śukratvamuśanā devadevaprasādanāt । devīṃ stutvā tu gagane modate tejasā vṛtaḥ ॥14॥
html:
gataḥ śukratvamuśanā devadevaprasādanāt ।
devīṃ stutvā tu gagane modate tejasā vṛtaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: gataH SukratvamuSanA devadevaprasAdanAt । devIM stutvA tu gagane modate tejasA vftaH ॥14॥

text: asito devalaścaiva tathā nāradaparvatau । kakṣīvāñjāmadagnyaśca rāmastāṇḍyastathāṃśumān ॥15॥
html:
asito devalaścaiva tathā nāradaparvatau ।
kakṣīvāñjāmadagnyaśca rāmastāṇḍyastathāṃśumān ॥15॥
slp1: asito devalaScEva taTA nAradaparvatO । kakzIvAYjAmadagnyaSca rAmastARqyastaTAMSumAn ॥15॥

text: vasiṣṭho jamadagniśca viśvāmitro'trireva ca । bharadvājo hariśmaśruḥ kuṇḍadhāraḥ śrutaśravāḥ ॥16॥
html:
vasiṣṭho jamadagniśca viśvāmitro'trireva ca ।
bharadvājo hariśmaśruḥ kuṇḍadhāraḥ śrutaśravāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: vasizWo jamadagniSca viSvAmitro'trireva ca । BaradvAjo hariSmaSruH kuRqaDAraH SrutaSravAH ॥16॥

text: ete maharṣayaḥ stutvā viṣṇumṛgbhiḥ samāhitāḥ । lebhire tapasā siddhiṃ prasādāttasya dhīmataḥ ॥17॥
html:
ete maharṣayaḥ stutvā viṣṇumṛgbhiḥ samāhitāḥ ।
lebhire tapasā siddhiṃ prasādāttasya dhīmataḥ ॥17॥
slp1: ete maharzayaH stutvA vizRumfgBiH samAhitAH । leBire tapasA sidDiM prasAdAttasya DImataH ॥17॥

text: anarhāścārhatāṃ prāptāḥ santaḥ stutvā tameva ha । na tu vṛddhimihānvicchetkarma kṛtvā jugupsitam ॥18॥
html:
anarhāścārhatāṃ prāptāḥ santaḥ stutvā tameva ha ।
na tu vṛddhimihānvicchetkarma kṛtvā jugupsitam ॥18॥
slp1: anarhAScArhatAM prAptAH santaH stutvA tameva ha । na tu vfdDimihAnvicCetkarma kftvA jugupsitam ॥18॥

text: ye'rthā dharmeṇa te satyā ye'dharmeṇa dhigastu tān । dharmaṃ vai śāśvataṃ loke na jahyāddhanakāṅkṣayā ॥19॥
html:
ye'rthā dharmeṇa te satyā ye'dharmeṇa dhigastu tān ।
dharmaṃ vai śāśvataṃ loke na jahyāddhanakāṅkṣayā ॥19॥
slp1: ye'rTA DarmeRa te satyA ye'DarmeRa Digastu tAn । DarmaM vE SASvataM loke na jahyAdDanakANkzayA ॥19॥

text: āhitāgnirhi dharmātmā yaḥ sa puṇyakṛduttamaḥ । vedā hi sarve rājendra sthitāstriṣvagniṣu prabho ॥20॥
html:
āhitāgnirhi dharmātmā yaḥ sa puṇyakṛduttamaḥ ।
vedā hi sarve rājendra sthitāstriṣvagniṣu prabho ॥20॥
slp1: AhitAgnirhi DarmAtmA yaH sa puRyakfduttamaH । vedA hi sarve rAjendra sTitAstrizvagnizu praBo ॥20॥

text: sa cāpyagnyāhito vipraḥ kriyā yasya na hīyate । śreyo hyanāhitāgnitvamagnihotraṃ na niṣkriyam ॥21॥
html:
sa cāpyagnyāhito vipraḥ kriyā yasya na hīyate ।
śreyo hyanāhitāgnitvamagnihotraṃ na niṣkriyam ॥21॥
slp1: sa cApyagnyAhito vipraH kriyA yasya na hIyate । Sreyo hyanAhitAgnitvamagnihotraM na nizkriyam ॥21॥

text: agnirātmā ca mātā ca pitā janayitā tathā । guruśca naraśārdūla paricaryā yathātatham ॥22॥
html:
agnirātmā ca mātā ca pitā janayitā tathā ।
guruśca naraśārdūla paricaryā yathātatham ॥22॥
slp1: agnirAtmA ca mAtA ca pitA janayitA taTA । guruSca naraSArdUla paricaryA yaTAtaTam ॥22॥

text: mānaṃ tyaktvā yo naro vṛddhasevī vidvānklībaḥ paśyati prītiyogāt । dākṣyeṇāhīno dharmayukto nadānto loke'sminvai pūjyate sadbhirāryaḥ] ॥23॥
html:
mānaṃ tyaktvā yo naro vṛddhasevī vidvānklībaḥ paśyati prītiyogāt ।
dākṣyeṇāhīno dharmayukto nadānto loke'sminvai pūjyate sadbhirāryaḥ] ॥23॥
slp1: mAnaM tyaktvA yo naro vfdDasevI vidvAnklIbaH paSyati prItiyogAt । dAkzyeRAhIno Darmayukto nadAnto loke'sminvE pUjyate sadBirAryaH] ॥23॥

text: vṛttiḥ sakāśādvarṇebhyastribhyo hīnasya śobhanā । prītyopanītā nirdiṣṭā dharmiṣṭhānkurute sadā ॥1॥
html:
vṛttiḥ sakāśādvarṇebhyastribhyo hīnasya śobhanā ।
prītyopanītā nirdiṣṭā dharmiṣṭhānkurute sadā ॥1॥
slp1: vfttiH sakASAdvarReByastriByo hInasya SoBanA । prItyopanItA nirdizwA DarmizWAnkurute sadA ॥1॥
author: parāśara uvāca ।

text: vṛttiścennāsti śūdrasya pitṛpaitāmahī dhruvā । na vṛttiṃ parato mārgecchuśrūṣāṃ tu prayojayet ॥2॥
html:
vṛttiścennāsti śūdrasya pitṛpaitāmahī dhruvā ।
na vṛttiṃ parato mārgecchuśrūṣāṃ tu prayojayet ॥2॥
slp1: vfttiScennAsti SUdrasya pitfpEtAmahI DruvA । na vfttiM parato mArgecCuSrUzAM tu prayojayet ॥2॥

text: sadbhistu saha saṃsargaḥ śobhate dharmadarśibhiḥ । nityaṃ sarvāsvavasthāsu nāsadbhiriti me matiḥ ॥3॥
html:
sadbhistu saha saṃsargaḥ śobhate dharmadarśibhiḥ ।
nityaṃ sarvāsvavasthāsu nāsadbhiriti me matiḥ ॥3॥
slp1: sadBistu saha saMsargaH SoBate DarmadarSiBiH । nityaM sarvAsvavasTAsu nAsadBiriti me matiH ॥3॥

text: yathodayagirau dravyaṃ sannikarṣeṇa dīpyate । tathā satsannikarṣeṇa hīnavarṇo'pi dīpyate ॥4॥
html:
yathodayagirau dravyaṃ sannikarṣeṇa dīpyate ।
tathā satsannikarṣeṇa hīnavarṇo'pi dīpyate ॥4॥
slp1: yaTodayagirO dravyaM sannikarzeRa dIpyate । taTA satsannikarzeRa hInavarRo'pi dIpyate ॥4॥

text: yādṛśena hi varṇena bhāvyate śuklamambaram । tādṛśaṃ kurute rūpametadevamavaihi me ॥5॥
html:
yādṛśena hi varṇena bhāvyate śuklamambaram ।
tādṛśaṃ kurute rūpametadevamavaihi me ॥5॥
slp1: yAdfSena hi varRena BAvyate Suklamambaram । tAdfSaM kurute rUpametadevamavEhi me ॥5॥

text: tasmādguṇeṣu rajyethā mā doṣeṣu kadācana । anityamiha martyānāṃ jīvitaṃ hi calācalam ॥6॥
html:
tasmādguṇeṣu rajyethā mā doṣeṣu kadācana ।
anityamiha martyānāṃ jīvitaṃ hi calācalam ॥6॥
slp1: tasmAdguRezu rajyeTA mA dozezu kadAcana । anityamiha martyAnAM jIvitaM hi calAcalam ॥6॥

text: sukhe vā yadi vā duḥkhe vartamāno vicakṣaṇaḥ । yaścinoti śubhānyeva sa bhadrāṇīha paśyati ॥7॥
html:
sukhe vā yadi vā duḥkhe vartamāno vicakṣaṇaḥ ।
yaścinoti śubhānyeva sa bhadrāṇīha paśyati ॥7॥
slp1: suKe vA yadi vA duHKe vartamAno vicakzaRaH । yaScinoti SuBAnyeva sa BadrARIha paSyati ॥7॥

text: dharmādapetaṃ yatkarma yadyapi syānmahāphalam । na tatseveta medhāvī na taddhitamihocyate ॥8॥
html:
dharmādapetaṃ yatkarma yadyapi syānmahāphalam ।
na tatseveta medhāvī na taddhitamihocyate ॥8॥
slp1: DarmAdapetaM yatkarma yadyapi syAnmahAPalam । na tatseveta meDAvI na tadDitamihocyate ॥8॥

text: yo hṛtvā gosahasrāṇi nṛpo dadyādarakṣitā । sa śabdamātraphalabhāgrājā bhavati taskaraḥ ॥9॥
html:
yo hṛtvā gosahasrāṇi nṛpo dadyādarakṣitā ।
sa śabdamātraphalabhāgrājā bhavati taskaraḥ ॥9॥
slp1: yo hftvA gosahasrARi nfpo dadyAdarakzitA । sa SabdamAtraPalaBAgrAjA Bavati taskaraH ॥9॥

text: svayambhūrasṛjaccāgre dhātāraṃ lokapūjitam । dhātāsṛjatputramekaṃ prajānāṃ dhāraṇe ratam ॥10॥
html:
svayambhūrasṛjaccāgre dhātāraṃ lokapūjitam ।
dhātāsṛjatputramekaṃ prajānāṃ dhāraṇe ratam ॥10॥
slp1: svayamBUrasfjaccAgre DAtAraM lokapUjitam । DAtAsfjatputramekaM prajAnAM DAraRe ratam ॥10॥

text: tamarcayitvā vaiśyastu kuryādatyarthamṛddhimat । rakṣitavyaṃ tu rājanyairupayojyaṃ dvijātibhiḥ ॥11॥
html:
tamarcayitvā vaiśyastu kuryādatyarthamṛddhimat ।
rakṣitavyaṃ tu rājanyairupayojyaṃ dvijātibhiḥ ॥11॥
slp1: tamarcayitvA vESyastu kuryAdatyarTamfdDimat । rakzitavyaM tu rAjanyErupayojyaM dvijAtiBiH ॥11॥

text: ajihmairaśaṭhakrodhairhavyakavyaprayoktṛbhiḥ । śūdrairnirmārjanaṃ kāryamevaṃ dharmo na naśyati ॥12॥
html:
ajihmairaśaṭhakrodhairhavyakavyaprayoktṛbhiḥ ।
śūdrairnirmārjanaṃ kāryamevaṃ dharmo na naśyati ॥12॥
slp1: ajihmEraSaWakroDErhavyakavyaprayoktfBiH । SUdrErnirmArjanaM kAryamevaM Darmo na naSyati ॥12॥

text: apranaṣṭe tato dharme bhavanti sukhitāḥ prajāḥ । sukhena tāsāṃ rājendra modante divi devatāḥ ॥13॥
html:
apranaṣṭe tato dharme bhavanti sukhitāḥ prajāḥ ।
sukhena tāsāṃ rājendra modante divi devatāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: apranazwe tato Darme Bavanti suKitAH prajAH । suKena tAsAM rAjendra modante divi devatAH ॥13॥

text: tasmādyo rakṣati nṛpaḥ sa dharmeṇābhipūjyate । adhīte cāpi yo vipro vaiśyo yaścārjane rataḥ ॥14॥
html:
tasmādyo rakṣati nṛpaḥ sa dharmeṇābhipūjyate ।
adhīte cāpi yo vipro vaiśyo yaścārjane rataḥ ॥14॥
slp1: tasmAdyo rakzati nfpaH sa DarmeRABipUjyate । aDIte cApi yo vipro vESyo yaScArjane rataH ॥14॥

text: yaśca śuśrūṣate śūdraḥ satataṃ niyatendriyaḥ । ato'nyathā manuṣyendra svadharmātparihīyate ॥15॥
html:
yaśca śuśrūṣate śūdraḥ satataṃ niyatendriyaḥ ।
ato'nyathā manuṣyendra svadharmātparihīyate ॥15॥
slp1: yaSca SuSrUzate SUdraH satataM niyatendriyaH । ato'nyaTA manuzyendra svaDarmAtparihIyate ॥15॥

text: prāṇasantāpanirdiṣṭāḥ kākiṇyo'pi mahāphalāḥ । nyāyenopārjitā dattāḥ kimutānyāḥ sahasraśaḥ ॥16॥
html:
prāṇasantāpanirdiṣṭāḥ kākiṇyo'pi mahāphalāḥ ।
nyāyenopārjitā dattāḥ kimutānyāḥ sahasraśaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: prARasantApanirdizwAH kAkiRyo'pi mahAPalAH । nyAyenopArjitA dattAH kimutAnyAH sahasraSaH ॥16॥

text: satkṛtya tu dvijātibhyo yo dadāti narādhipa । yādṛśaṃ tādṛśaṃ nityamaśnāti phalamūrjitam ॥17॥
html:
satkṛtya tu dvijātibhyo yo dadāti narādhipa ।
yādṛśaṃ tādṛśaṃ nityamaśnāti phalamūrjitam ॥17॥
slp1: satkftya tu dvijAtiByo yo dadAti narADipa । yAdfSaM tAdfSaM nityamaSnAti PalamUrjitam ॥17॥

text: abhigamya dattaṃ tuṣṭyā yaddhanyamāhurabhiṣṭutam । yācitena tu yaddattaṃ tadāhurmadhyamaṃ budhāḥ ॥18॥
html:
abhigamya dattaṃ tuṣṭyā yaddhanyamāhurabhiṣṭutam ।
yācitena tu yaddattaṃ tadāhurmadhyamaṃ budhāḥ ॥18॥
slp1: aBigamya dattaM tuzwyA yadDanyamAhuraBizwutam । yAcitena tu yaddattaM tadAhurmaDyamaM buDAH ॥18॥

text: avajñayā dīyate yattathaivāśraddhayāpi ca । tadāhuradhamaṃ dānaṃ munayaḥ satyavādinaḥ ॥19॥
html:
avajñayā dīyate yattathaivāśraddhayāpi ca ।
tadāhuradhamaṃ dānaṃ munayaḥ satyavādinaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: avajYayA dIyate yattaTEvASradDayApi ca । tadAhuraDamaM dAnaM munayaH satyavAdinaH ॥19॥

text: atikrame majjamāno vividhena naraḥ sadā । tathā prayatnaṃ kurvīta yathā mucyeta saṃśayāt ॥20॥
html:
atikrame majjamāno vividhena naraḥ sadā ।
tathā prayatnaṃ kurvīta yathā mucyeta saṃśayāt ॥20॥
slp1: atikrame majjamAno viviDena naraH sadA । taTA prayatnaM kurvIta yaTA mucyeta saMSayAt ॥20॥

text: damena śobhate vipraḥ kṣatriyo vijayena tu । dhanena vaiśyaḥ śūdrastu nityaṃ dākṣyeṇa śobhate] ॥21॥
html:
damena śobhate vipraḥ kṣatriyo vijayena tu ।
dhanena vaiśyaḥ śūdrastu nityaṃ dākṣyeṇa śobhate] ॥21॥
slp1: damena SoBate vipraH kzatriyo vijayena tu । Danena vESyaH SUdrastu nityaM dAkzyeRa SoBate] ॥21॥

text: pratigrahāgatā vipre kṣatriye śastranirjitāḥ । vaiśye nyāyārjitāścaiva śūdre śuśrūṣayārjitāḥ । svalpāpyarthāḥ praśasyante dharmasyārthe mahāphalāḥ ॥1॥
html:
pratigrahāgatā vipre kṣatriye śastranirjitāḥ ।
vaiśye nyāyārjitāścaiva śūdre śuśrūṣayārjitāḥ ।
svalpāpyarthāḥ praśasyante dharmasyārthe mahāphalāḥ ॥1॥
slp1: pratigrahAgatA vipre kzatriye SastranirjitAH । vESye nyAyArjitAScEva SUdre SuSrUzayArjitAH । svalpApyarTAH praSasyante DarmasyArTe mahAPalAH ॥1॥
author: parāśara uvāca ।

text: nityaṃ trayāṇāṃ varṇānāṃ śūdraḥ śuśrūṣurucyate । kṣatradharmā vaiśyadharmā nāvṛttiḥ patati dvijaḥ । śūdrakarmā yadā tu syāttadā patati vai dvijaḥ ॥2॥
html:
nityaṃ trayāṇāṃ varṇānāṃ śūdraḥ śuśrūṣurucyate ।
kṣatradharmā vaiśyadharmā nāvṛttiḥ patati dvijaḥ ।
śūdrakarmā yadā tu syāttadā patati vai dvijaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: nityaM trayARAM varRAnAM SUdraH SuSrUzurucyate । kzatraDarmA vESyaDarmA nAvfttiH patati dvijaH । SUdrakarmA yadA tu syAttadA patati vE dvijaH ॥2॥

text: vāṇijyaṃ pāśupālyaṃ ca tathā śilpopajīvanam । śūdrasyāpi vidhīyante yadā vṛttirna jāyate ॥3॥
html:
vāṇijyaṃ pāśupālyaṃ ca tathā śilpopajīvanam ।
śūdrasyāpi vidhīyante yadā vṛttirna jāyate ॥3॥
slp1: vARijyaM pASupAlyaM ca taTA SilpopajIvanam । SUdrasyApi viDIyante yadA vfttirna jAyate ॥3॥

text: raṅgāvataraṇaṃ caiva tathā rūpopajīvanam । madyamāṃsopajīvyaṃ ca vikrayo lohacarmaṇoḥ ॥4॥
html:
raṅgāvataraṇaṃ caiva tathā rūpopajīvanam ।
madyamāṃsopajīvyaṃ ca vikrayo lohacarmaṇoḥ ॥4॥
slp1: raNgAvataraRaM cEva taTA rUpopajIvanam । madyamAMsopajIvyaM ca vikrayo lohacarmaRoH ॥4॥

text: apūrviṇā na kartavyaṃ karma loke vigarhitam । kṛtapūrviṇastu tyajato mahāndharma iti śrutiḥ ॥5॥
html:
apūrviṇā na kartavyaṃ karma loke vigarhitam ।
kṛtapūrviṇastu tyajato mahāndharma iti śrutiḥ ॥5॥
slp1: apUrviRA na kartavyaM karma loke vigarhitam । kftapUrviRastu tyajato mahAnDarma iti SrutiH ॥5॥

text: saṃsiddhaḥ puruṣo loke yadācarati pāpakam । madenābhiplutamanāstacca na grāhyamucyate ॥6॥
html:
saṃsiddhaḥ puruṣo loke yadācarati pāpakam ।
madenābhiplutamanāstacca na grāhyamucyate ॥6॥
slp1: saMsidDaH puruzo loke yadAcarati pApakam । madenABiplutamanAstacca na grAhyamucyate ॥6॥

text: śrūyante hi purāṇe vai prajā dhigdaṇḍaśāsanāḥ । dāntā dharmapradhānāśca nyāyadharmānuvartakāḥ ॥7॥
html:
śrūyante hi purāṇe vai prajā dhigdaṇḍaśāsanāḥ ।
dāntā dharmapradhānāśca nyāyadharmānuvartakāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: SrUyante hi purARe vE prajA DigdaRqaSAsanAH । dAntA DarmapraDAnASca nyAyaDarmAnuvartakAH ॥7॥

text: dharma eva sadā nṝṇāmiha rājanpraśasyate । dharmavṛddhā guṇāneva sevante hi narā bhuvi ॥8॥
html:
dharma eva sadā nṝṇāmiha rājanpraśasyate ।
dharmavṛddhā guṇāneva sevante hi narā bhuvi ॥8॥
slp1: Darma eva sadA nFRAmiha rAjanpraSasyate । DarmavfdDA guRAneva sevante hi narA Buvi ॥8॥

text: taṃ dharmamasurāstāta nāmṛṣyanta janādhipa । vivardhamānāḥ kramaśastatra te'nvāviśanprajāḥ ॥9॥
html:
taṃ dharmamasurāstāta nāmṛṣyanta janādhipa ।
vivardhamānāḥ kramaśastatra te'nvāviśanprajāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: taM DarmamasurAstAta nAmfzyanta janADipa । vivarDamAnAH kramaSastatra te'nvAviSanprajAH ॥9॥

text: teṣāṃ darpaḥ samabhavatprajānāṃ dharmanāśanaḥ । darpātmanāṃ tataḥ krodhaḥ punasteṣāmajāyata ॥10॥
html:
teṣāṃ darpaḥ samabhavatprajānāṃ dharmanāśanaḥ ।
darpātmanāṃ tataḥ krodhaḥ punasteṣāmajāyata ॥10॥
slp1: tezAM darpaH samaBavatprajAnAM DarmanASanaH । darpAtmanAM tataH kroDaH punastezAmajAyata ॥10॥

text: tataḥ krodhābhibhūtānāṃ vṛttaṃ lajjāsamanvitam । hrīścaivāpyanaśadrājaṃstato moho vyajāyata ॥11॥
html:
tataḥ krodhābhibhūtānāṃ vṛttaṃ lajjāsamanvitam ।
hrīścaivāpyanaśadrājaṃstato moho vyajāyata ॥11॥
slp1: tataH kroDABiBUtAnAM vfttaM lajjAsamanvitam । hrIScEvApyanaSadrAjaMstato moho vyajAyata ॥11॥

text: tato mohaparītāste nāpaśyanta yathā purā । parasparāvamardena vartayanti yathāsukham ॥12॥
html:
tato mohaparītāste nāpaśyanta yathā purā ।
parasparāvamardena vartayanti yathāsukham ॥12॥
slp1: tato mohaparItAste nApaSyanta yaTA purA । parasparAvamardena vartayanti yaTAsuKam ॥12॥

text: tānprāpya tu sa dhigdaṇḍo nakāraṇamato'bhavat । tato'bhyagacchandevāṃśca brāhmaṇāṃścāvamanya ha ॥13॥
html:
tānprāpya tu sa dhigdaṇḍo nakāraṇamato'bhavat ।
tato'bhyagacchandevāṃśca brāhmaṇāṃścāvamanya ha ॥13॥
slp1: tAnprApya tu sa DigdaRqo nakAraRamato'Bavat । tato'ByagacCandevAMSca brAhmaRAMScAvamanya ha ॥13॥

text: etasminneva kāle tu devā devavaraṃ śivam । agacchañśaraṇaṃ vīraṃ bahurūpaṃ gaṇādhipam ॥14॥
html:
etasminneva kāle tu devā devavaraṃ śivam ।
agacchañśaraṇaṃ vīraṃ bahurūpaṃ gaṇādhipam ॥14॥
slp1: etasminneva kAle tu devA devavaraM Sivam । agacCaYSaraRaM vIraM bahurUpaM gaRADipam ॥14॥

text: tena sma te gaganagāḥ sapurāḥ pātitāḥ kṣitau । tisro'pyekena bāṇena devāpyāyitatejasā ॥15॥
html:
tena sma te gaganagāḥ sapurāḥ pātitāḥ kṣitau ।
tisro'pyekena bāṇena devāpyāyitatejasā ॥15॥
slp1: tena sma te gaganagAH sapurAH pAtitAH kzitO । tisro'pyekena bARena devApyAyitatejasA ॥15॥

text: teṣāmadhipatistvāsīdbhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ । devatānāṃ bhayakaraḥ sa hataḥ śūlapāṇinā ॥16॥
html:
teṣāmadhipatistvāsīdbhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ ।
devatānāṃ bhayakaraḥ sa hataḥ śūlapāṇinā ॥16॥
slp1: tezAmaDipatistvAsIdBImo BImaparAkramaH । devatAnAM BayakaraH sa hataH SUlapARinA ॥16॥

text: tasminhate'tha svaṃ bhāvaṃ pratyapadyanta mānavāḥ । prāvartanta ca vedā vai śāstrāṇi ca yathā purā ॥17॥
html:
tasminhate'tha svaṃ bhāvaṃ pratyapadyanta mānavāḥ ।
prāvartanta ca vedā vai śāstrāṇi ca yathā purā ॥17॥
slp1: tasminhate'Ta svaM BAvaM pratyapadyanta mAnavAH । prAvartanta ca vedA vE SAstrARi ca yaTA purA ॥17॥

text: tato'bhyaṣiñcanrājyena devānāṃ divi vāsavam । saptarṣayaścānvayuñjannarāṇāṃ daṇḍadhāraṇe ॥18॥
html:
tato'bhyaṣiñcanrājyena devānāṃ divi vāsavam ।
saptarṣayaścānvayuñjannarāṇāṃ daṇḍadhāraṇe ॥18॥
slp1: tato'ByaziYcanrAjyena devAnAM divi vAsavam । saptarzayaScAnvayuYjannarARAM daRqaDAraRe ॥18॥

text: saptarṣīṇāmathordhvaṃ ca vipṛthurnāma pārthivaḥ । rājānaḥ kṣatriyāścaiva maṇḍaleṣu pṛthakpṛthak ॥19॥
html:
saptarṣīṇāmathordhvaṃ ca vipṛthurnāma pārthivaḥ ।
rājānaḥ kṣatriyāścaiva maṇḍaleṣu pṛthakpṛthak ॥19॥
slp1: saptarzIRAmaTorDvaM ca vipfTurnAma pArTivaH । rAjAnaH kzatriyAScEva maRqalezu pfTakpfTak ॥19॥

text: mahākuleṣu ye jātā vṛttāḥ pūrvatarāśca ye । teṣāmathāsuro bhāvo hṛdayānnāpasarpati ॥20॥
html:
mahākuleṣu ye jātā vṛttāḥ pūrvatarāśca ye ।
teṣāmathāsuro bhāvo hṛdayānnāpasarpati ॥20॥
slp1: mahAkulezu ye jAtA vfttAH pUrvatarASca ye । tezAmaTAsuro BAvo hfdayAnnApasarpati ॥20॥

text: tasmāttenaiva bhāvena sānuṣaṅgena pārthivāḥ । āsurāṇyeva karmāṇi nyaṣevanbhīmavikramāḥ ॥21॥
html:
tasmāttenaiva bhāvena sānuṣaṅgena pārthivāḥ ।
āsurāṇyeva karmāṇi nyaṣevanbhīmavikramāḥ ॥21॥
slp1: tasmAttenEva BAvena sAnuzaNgena pArTivAH । AsurARyeva karmARi nyazevanBImavikramAH ॥21॥

text: pratyatiṣṭhaṃśca teṣveva tānyeva sthāpayanti ca । bhajante tāni cādyāpi ye bāliśatamā narāḥ ॥22॥
html:
pratyatiṣṭhaṃśca teṣveva tānyeva sthāpayanti ca ।
bhajante tāni cādyāpi ye bāliśatamā narāḥ ॥22॥
slp1: pratyatizWaMSca tezveva tAnyeva sTApayanti ca । Bajante tAni cAdyApi ye bAliSatamA narAH ॥22॥

text: tasmādahaṃ bravīmi tvāṃ rājansañcintya śāstrataḥ । saṃsiddhādhigamaṃ kuryātkarma hiṃsātmakaṃ tyajet ॥23॥
html:
tasmādahaṃ bravīmi tvāṃ rājansañcintya śāstrataḥ ।
saṃsiddhādhigamaṃ kuryātkarma hiṃsātmakaṃ tyajet ॥23॥
slp1: tasmAdahaM bravImi tvAM rAjansaYcintya SAstrataH । saMsidDADigamaM kuryAtkarma hiMsAtmakaM tyajet ॥23॥

text: na saṅkareṇa draviṇaṃ vicinvīta vicakṣaṇaḥ । dharmārthaṃ nyāyamutsṛjya na tatkalyāṇamucyate ॥24॥
html:
na saṅkareṇa draviṇaṃ vicinvīta vicakṣaṇaḥ ।
dharmārthaṃ nyāyamutsṛjya na tatkalyāṇamucyate ॥24॥
slp1: na saNkareRa draviRaM vicinvIta vicakzaRaH । DarmArTaM nyAyamutsfjya na tatkalyARamucyate ॥24॥

text: sa tvamevaṃvidho dāntaḥ kṣatriyaḥ priyabāndhavaḥ । prajā bhṛtyāṃśca putrāṃśca svadharmeṇānupālaya ॥25॥
html:
sa tvamevaṃvidho dāntaḥ kṣatriyaḥ priyabāndhavaḥ ।
prajā bhṛtyāṃśca putrāṃśca svadharmeṇānupālaya ॥25॥
slp1: sa tvamevaMviDo dAntaH kzatriyaH priyabAnDavaH । prajA BftyAMSca putrAMSca svaDarmeRAnupAlaya ॥25॥

text: iṣṭāniṣṭasamāyogo vairaṃ sauhārdameva ca । atha jātisahasrāṇi bahūni parivartate ॥26॥
html:
iṣṭāniṣṭasamāyogo vairaṃ sauhārdameva ca ।
atha jātisahasrāṇi bahūni parivartate ॥26॥
slp1: izwAnizwasamAyogo vEraM sOhArdameva ca । aTa jAtisahasrARi bahUni parivartate ॥26॥

text: tasmādguṇeṣu rajyethā mā doṣeṣu kadācana । nirguṇo yo hi durbuddhirātmanaḥ so'rirucyate ॥27॥
html:
tasmādguṇeṣu rajyethā mā doṣeṣu kadācana ।
nirguṇo yo hi durbuddhirātmanaḥ so'rirucyate ॥27॥
slp1: tasmAdguRezu rajyeTA mA dozezu kadAcana । nirguRo yo hi durbudDirAtmanaH so'rirucyate ॥27॥

text: mānuṣeṣu mahārāja dharmādharmau pravartataḥ । na tathānyeṣu bhūteṣu manuṣyarahiteṣviha ॥28॥
html:
mānuṣeṣu mahārāja dharmādharmau pravartataḥ ।
na tathānyeṣu bhūteṣu manuṣyarahiteṣviha ॥28॥
slp1: mAnuzezu mahArAja DarmADarmO pravartataH । na taTAnyezu BUtezu manuzyarahitezviha ॥28॥

text: dharmaśīlo naro vidvānīhako'nīhako'pi vā । ātmabhūtaḥ sadā loke caredbhūtānyahiṃsayan ॥29॥
html:
dharmaśīlo naro vidvānīhako'nīhako'pi vā ।
ātmabhūtaḥ sadā loke caredbhūtānyahiṃsayan ॥29॥
slp1: DarmaSIlo naro vidvAnIhako'nIhako'pi vA । AtmaBUtaH sadA loke caredBUtAnyahiMsayan ॥29॥

text: yadā vyapetahṛllekhaṃ mano bhavati tasya vai । nānṛtaṃ caiva bhavati tadā kalyāṇamṛcchati] ॥30॥
html:
yadā vyapetahṛllekhaṃ mano bhavati tasya vai ।
nānṛtaṃ caiva bhavati tadā kalyāṇamṛcchati] ॥30॥
slp1: yadA vyapetahflleKaM mano Bavati tasya vE । nAnftaM cEva Bavati tadA kalyARamfcCati] ॥30॥

text: eṣa dharmavidhistāta gṛhasthasya prakīrtitaḥ । tapovidhiṃ tu vakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ॥1॥
html:
eṣa dharmavidhistāta gṛhasthasya prakīrtitaḥ ।
tapovidhiṃ tu vakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ॥1॥
slp1: eza DarmaviDistAta gfhasTasya prakIrtitaH । tapoviDiM tu vakzyAmi tanme nigadataH SfRu ॥1॥
author: parāśara uvāca ।

text: prāyeṇa hi gṛhasthasya mamatvaṃ nāma jāyate । saṅgāgataṃ naraśreṣṭha bhāvaistāmasarājasaiḥ ॥2॥
html:
prāyeṇa hi gṛhasthasya mamatvaṃ nāma jāyate ।
saṅgāgataṃ naraśreṣṭha bhāvaistāmasarājasaiḥ ॥2॥
slp1: prAyeRa hi gfhasTasya mamatvaM nAma jAyate । saNgAgataM naraSrezWa BAvEstAmasarAjasEH ॥2॥

text: gṛhāṇyāśritya gāvaśca kṣetrāṇi ca dhanāni ca । dārāḥ putrāśca bhṛtyāśca bhavantīha narasya vai ॥3॥
html:
gṛhāṇyāśritya gāvaśca kṣetrāṇi ca dhanāni ca ।
dārāḥ putrāśca bhṛtyāśca bhavantīha narasya vai ॥3॥
slp1: gfhARyASritya gAvaSca kzetrARi ca DanAni ca । dArAH putrASca BftyASca BavantIha narasya vE ॥3॥

text: evaṃ tasya pravṛttasya nityamevānupaśyataḥ । rāgadveṣau vivardhete hyanityatvamapaśyataḥ ॥4॥
html:
evaṃ tasya pravṛttasya nityamevānupaśyataḥ ।
rāgadveṣau vivardhete hyanityatvamapaśyataḥ ॥4॥
slp1: evaM tasya pravfttasya nityamevAnupaSyataH । rAgadvezO vivarDete hyanityatvamapaSyataH ॥4॥

text: rāgadveṣābhibhūtaṃ ca naraṃ dravyavaśānugam । mohajātā ratirnāma samupaiti narādhipa ॥5॥
html:
rāgadveṣābhibhūtaṃ ca naraṃ dravyavaśānugam ।
mohajātā ratirnāma samupaiti narādhipa ॥5॥
slp1: rAgadvezABiBUtaM ca naraM dravyavaSAnugam । mohajAtA ratirnAma samupEti narADipa ॥5॥

text: kṛtārtho bhogato bhūtvā sa vai ratiparāyaṇaḥ । lābhaṃ grāmyasukhādanyaṃ ratito nānupaśyati ॥6॥
html:
kṛtārtho bhogato bhūtvā sa vai ratiparāyaṇaḥ ।
lābhaṃ grāmyasukhādanyaṃ ratito nānupaśyati ॥6॥
slp1: kftArTo Bogato BUtvA sa vE ratiparAyaRaH । lABaM grAmyasuKAdanyaM ratito nAnupaSyati ॥6॥

text: tato lobhābhibhūtātmā saṅgādvardhayate janam । puṣṭyarthaṃ caiva tasyeha janasyārthaṃ cikīrṣati ॥7॥
html:
tato lobhābhibhūtātmā saṅgādvardhayate janam ।
puṣṭyarthaṃ caiva tasyeha janasyārthaṃ cikīrṣati ॥7॥
slp1: tato loBABiBUtAtmA saNgAdvarDayate janam । puzwyarTaM cEva tasyeha janasyArTaM cikIrzati ॥7॥

text: sa jānannapi cākāryamarthārthaṃ sevate naraḥ । bālasnehaparītātmā tatkṣayāccānutapyate ॥8॥
html:
sa jānannapi cākāryamarthārthaṃ sevate naraḥ ।
bālasnehaparītātmā tatkṣayāccānutapyate ॥8॥
slp1: sa jAnannapi cAkAryamarTArTaM sevate naraH । bAlasnehaparItAtmA tatkzayAccAnutapyate ॥8॥

text: tato mānena sampanno rakṣannātmaparājayam । karoti yena bhogī syāmiti tasmādvinaśyati ॥9॥
html:
tato mānena sampanno rakṣannātmaparājayam ।
karoti yena bhogī syāmiti tasmādvinaśyati ॥9॥
slp1: tato mAnena sampanno rakzannAtmaparAjayam । karoti yena BogI syAmiti tasmAdvinaSyati ॥9॥

text: tapo hi buddhiyuktānāṃ śāśvataṃ brahmadarśanam । anvicchatāṃ śubhaṃ karma narāṇāṃ tyajatāṃ sukham ॥10॥
html:
tapo hi buddhiyuktānāṃ śāśvataṃ brahmadarśanam ।
anvicchatāṃ śubhaṃ karma narāṇāṃ tyajatāṃ sukham ॥10॥
slp1: tapo hi budDiyuktAnAM SASvataM brahmadarSanam । anvicCatAM SuBaM karma narARAM tyajatAM suKam ॥10॥

text: snehāyatananāśācca dhananāśācca pārthiva । ādhivyādhipratāpācca nirvedamupagacchati ॥11॥
html:
snehāyatananāśācca dhananāśācca pārthiva ।
ādhivyādhipratāpācca nirvedamupagacchati ॥11॥
slp1: snehAyatananASAcca DananASAcca pArTiva । ADivyADipratApAcca nirvedamupagacCati ॥11॥

text: nirvedādātmasambodhaḥ sambodhācchāstradarśanam । śāstrārthadarśanādrājaṃstapa evānupaśyati ॥12॥
html:
nirvedādātmasambodhaḥ sambodhācchāstradarśanam ।
śāstrārthadarśanādrājaṃstapa evānupaśyati ॥12॥
slp1: nirvedAdAtmasamboDaH samboDAcCAstradarSanam । SAstrArTadarSanAdrAjaMstapa evAnupaSyati ॥12॥

text: durlabho hi manuṣyendra naraḥ pratyavamarśavān । yo vai priyasukhe kṣīṇe tapaḥ kartuṃ vyavasyati ॥13॥
html:
durlabho hi manuṣyendra naraḥ pratyavamarśavān ।
yo vai priyasukhe kṣīṇe tapaḥ kartuṃ vyavasyati ॥13॥
slp1: durlaBo hi manuzyendra naraH pratyavamarSavAn । yo vE priyasuKe kzIRe tapaH kartuM vyavasyati ॥13॥

text: tapaḥ sarvagataṃ tāta hīnasyāpi vidhīyate । jitendriyasya dāntasya svargamārgapradeśakam ॥14॥
html:
tapaḥ sarvagataṃ tāta hīnasyāpi vidhīyate ।
jitendriyasya dāntasya svargamārgapradeśakam ॥14॥
slp1: tapaH sarvagataM tAta hInasyApi viDIyate । jitendriyasya dAntasya svargamArgapradeSakam ॥14॥

text: prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ pūrvamasṛjattapasā vibhuḥ । kvacitkvacidvrataparo vratānyāsthāya pārthiva ॥15॥
html:
prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ pūrvamasṛjattapasā vibhuḥ ।
kvacitkvacidvrataparo vratānyāsthāya pārthiva ॥15॥
slp1: prajApatiH prajAH pUrvamasfjattapasA viBuH । kvacitkvacidvrataparo vratAnyAsTAya pArTiva ॥15॥

text: ādityā vasavo rudrāstathaivāgnyaśvimārutāḥ । viśvedevāstathā sādhyāḥ pitaro'tha marudgaṇāḥ ॥16॥
html:
ādityā vasavo rudrāstathaivāgnyaśvimārutāḥ ।
viśvedevāstathā sādhyāḥ pitaro'tha marudgaṇāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: AdityA vasavo rudrAstaTEvAgnyaSvimArutAH । viSvedevAstaTA sADyAH pitaro'Ta marudgaRAH ॥16॥

text: yakṣarākṣasagandharvāḥ siddhāścānye divaukasaḥ । saṃsiddhāstapasā tāta ye cānye svargavāsinaḥ ॥17॥
html:
yakṣarākṣasagandharvāḥ siddhāścānye divaukasaḥ ।
saṃsiddhāstapasā tāta ye cānye svargavāsinaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: yakzarAkzasaganDarvAH sidDAScAnye divOkasaH । saMsidDAstapasA tAta ye cAnye svargavAsinaH ॥17॥

text: ye cādau brahmaṇā sṛṣṭā brāhmaṇāstapasā purā । te bhāvayantaḥ pṛthivīṃ vicaranti divaṃ tathā ॥18॥
html:
ye cādau brahmaṇā sṛṣṭā brāhmaṇāstapasā purā ।
te bhāvayantaḥ pṛthivīṃ vicaranti divaṃ tathā ॥18॥
slp1: ye cAdO brahmaRA sfzwA brAhmaRAstapasA purA । te BAvayantaH pfTivIM vicaranti divaM taTA ॥18॥

text: martyaloke ca rājāno ye cānye gṛhamedhinaḥ । mahākuleṣu dṛśyante tatsarvaṃ tapasaḥ phalam ॥19॥
html:
martyaloke ca rājāno ye cānye gṛhamedhinaḥ ।
mahākuleṣu dṛśyante tatsarvaṃ tapasaḥ phalam ॥19॥
slp1: martyaloke ca rAjAno ye cAnye gfhameDinaH । mahAkulezu dfSyante tatsarvaM tapasaH Palam ॥19॥

text: kauśikāni ca vastrāṇi śubhānyābharaṇāni ca । vāhanāsanayānāni sarvaṃ tattapasaḥ phalam ॥20॥
html:
kauśikāni ca vastrāṇi śubhānyābharaṇāni ca ।
vāhanāsanayānāni sarvaṃ tattapasaḥ phalam ॥20॥
slp1: kOSikAni ca vastrARi SuBAnyABaraRAni ca । vAhanAsanayAnAni sarvaM tattapasaH Palam ॥20॥

text: manonukūlāḥ pramadā rūpavatyaḥ sahasraśaḥ । vāsaḥ prāsādapṛṣṭhe ca tatsarvaṃ tapasaḥ phalam ॥21॥
html:
manonukūlāḥ pramadā rūpavatyaḥ sahasraśaḥ ।
vāsaḥ prāsādapṛṣṭhe ca tatsarvaṃ tapasaḥ phalam ॥21॥
slp1: manonukUlAH pramadA rUpavatyaH sahasraSaH । vAsaH prAsAdapfzWe ca tatsarvaM tapasaH Palam ॥21॥

text: śayanāni ca mukhyāni bhojyāni vividhāni ca । abhipretāni sarvāṇi bhavanti kṛtakarmaṇām ॥22॥
html:
śayanāni ca mukhyāni bhojyāni vividhāni ca ।
abhipretāni sarvāṇi bhavanti kṛtakarmaṇām ॥22॥
slp1: SayanAni ca muKyAni BojyAni viviDAni ca । aBipretAni sarvARi Bavanti kftakarmaRAm ॥22॥

text: nāprāpyaṃ tapasā kiñcittrailokye'sminparantapa । upabhogaparityāgaḥ phalānyakṛtakarmaṇām ॥23॥
html:
nāprāpyaṃ tapasā kiñcittrailokye'sminparantapa ।
upabhogaparityāgaḥ phalānyakṛtakarmaṇām ॥23॥
slp1: nAprApyaM tapasA kiYcittrElokye'sminparantapa । upaBogaparityAgaH PalAnyakftakarmaRAm ॥23॥

text: sukhito duḥkhito vāpi naro lobhaṃ parityajet । avekṣya manasā śāstraṃ buddhyā ca nṛpasattama ॥24॥
html:
sukhito duḥkhito vāpi naro lobhaṃ parityajet ।
avekṣya manasā śāstraṃ buddhyā ca nṛpasattama ॥24॥
slp1: suKito duHKito vApi naro loBaM parityajet । avekzya manasA SAstraM budDyA ca nfpasattama ॥24॥

text: asantoṣo'sukhāyaiva lobhādindriyavibhramaḥ । tato'sya naśyati prajñā vidyevābhyāsavarjitā ॥25॥
html:
asantoṣo'sukhāyaiva lobhādindriyavibhramaḥ ।
tato'sya naśyati prajñā vidyevābhyāsavarjitā ॥25॥
slp1: asantozo'suKAyEva loBAdindriyaviBramaH । tato'sya naSyati prajYA vidyevAByAsavarjitA ॥25॥

text: naṣṭaprajño yadā bhavati tadā nyāyaṃ na paśyati । tasmātsukhakṣaye prāpte pumānugraṃ tapaścaret ॥26॥
html:
naṣṭaprajño yadā bhavati tadā nyāyaṃ na paśyati ।
tasmātsukhakṣaye prāpte pumānugraṃ tapaścaret ॥26॥
slp1: nazwaprajYo yadA Bavati tadA nyAyaM na paSyati । tasmAtsuKakzaye prApte pumAnugraM tapaScaret ॥26॥

text: yadiṣṭaṃ tatsukhaṃ prāhurdveṣyaṃ duḥkhamihocyate । kṛtākṛtasya tapasaḥ phalaṃ paśyasva yādṛśam ॥27॥
html:
yadiṣṭaṃ tatsukhaṃ prāhurdveṣyaṃ duḥkhamihocyate ।
kṛtākṛtasya tapasaḥ phalaṃ paśyasva yādṛśam ॥27॥
slp1: yadizwaM tatsuKaM prAhurdvezyaM duHKamihocyate । kftAkftasya tapasaH PalaM paSyasva yAdfSam ॥27॥

text: nityaṃ bhadrāṇi paśyanti viṣayāṃścopabhuñjate । prākāśyaṃ caiva gacchanti kṛtvā niṣkalmaṣaṃ tapaḥ ॥28॥
html:
nityaṃ bhadrāṇi paśyanti viṣayāṃścopabhuñjate ।
prākāśyaṃ caiva gacchanti kṛtvā niṣkalmaṣaṃ tapaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: nityaM BadrARi paSyanti vizayAMScopaBuYjate । prAkASyaM cEva gacCanti kftvA nizkalmazaM tapaH ॥28॥

text: apriyāṇyavamānāṃśca duḥkhaṃ bahuvidhātmakam । phalārthī satpathatyaktaḥ prāpnoti viṣayātmakam ॥29॥
html:
apriyāṇyavamānāṃśca duḥkhaṃ bahuvidhātmakam ।
phalārthī satpathatyaktaḥ prāpnoti viṣayātmakam ॥29॥
slp1: apriyARyavamAnAMSca duHKaM bahuviDAtmakam । PalArTI satpaTatyaktaH prApnoti vizayAtmakam ॥29॥

text: dharme tapasi dāne ca vicikitsāsya jāyate । sa kṛtvā pāpakānyeva nirayaṃ pratipadyate ॥30॥
html:
dharme tapasi dāne ca vicikitsāsya jāyate ।
sa kṛtvā pāpakānyeva nirayaṃ pratipadyate ॥30॥
slp1: Darme tapasi dAne ca vicikitsAsya jAyate । sa kftvA pApakAnyeva nirayaM pratipadyate ॥30॥

text: sukhe tu vartamāno vai duḥkhe vāpi narottama । svavṛttādyo na calati śāstracakṣuḥ sa mānavaḥ ॥31॥
html:
sukhe tu vartamāno vai duḥkhe vāpi narottama ।
svavṛttādyo na calati śāstracakṣuḥ sa mānavaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: suKe tu vartamAno vE duHKe vApi narottama । svavfttAdyo na calati SAstracakzuH sa mAnavaH ॥31॥

text: iṣuprapātamātraṃ hi sparśayoge ratiḥ smṛtā । rasane darśane ghrāṇe śravaṇe ca viśāmpate ॥32॥
html:
iṣuprapātamātraṃ hi sparśayoge ratiḥ smṛtā ।
rasane darśane ghrāṇe śravaṇe ca viśāmpate ॥32॥
slp1: izuprapAtamAtraM hi sparSayoge ratiH smftA । rasane darSane GrARe SravaRe ca viSAmpate ॥32॥

text: tato'sya jāyate tīvrā vedanā tatkṣayātpunaḥ । budhā yena praśaṃsanti mokṣaṃ sukhamanuttamam ॥33॥
html:
tato'sya jāyate tīvrā vedanā tatkṣayātpunaḥ ।
budhā yena praśaṃsanti mokṣaṃ sukhamanuttamam ॥33॥
slp1: tato'sya jAyate tIvrA vedanA tatkzayAtpunaH । buDA yena praSaMsanti mokzaM suKamanuttamam ॥33॥

text: tataḥ phalārthaṃ carati bhavanti jyāyaso guṇāḥ । dharmavṛttyā ca satataṃ kāmārthābhyāṃ na hīyate ॥34॥
html:
tataḥ phalārthaṃ carati bhavanti jyāyaso guṇāḥ ।
dharmavṛttyā ca satataṃ kāmārthābhyāṃ na hīyate ॥34॥
slp1: tataH PalArTaM carati Bavanti jyAyaso guRAH । DarmavfttyA ca satataM kAmArTAByAM na hIyate ॥34॥

text: aprayatnāgatāḥ sevyā gṛhasthairviṣayāḥ sadā । prayatnenopagamyaśca svadharma iti me matiḥ ॥35॥
html:
aprayatnāgatāḥ sevyā gṛhasthairviṣayāḥ sadā ।
prayatnenopagamyaśca svadharma iti me matiḥ ॥35॥
slp1: aprayatnAgatAH sevyA gfhasTErvizayAH sadA । prayatnenopagamyaSca svaDarma iti me matiH ॥35॥

text: mānināṃ kulajātānāṃ nityaṃ śāstrārthacakṣuṣām । dharmakriyāviyuktānāmaśaktyā saṃvṛtātmanām ॥36॥
html:
mānināṃ kulajātānāṃ nityaṃ śāstrārthacakṣuṣām ।
dharmakriyāviyuktānāmaśaktyā saṃvṛtātmanām ॥36॥
slp1: mAninAM kulajAtAnAM nityaM SAstrArTacakzuzAm । DarmakriyAviyuktAnAmaSaktyA saMvftAtmanAm ॥36॥

text: kriyamāṇaṃ yadā karma nāśaṃ gacchati mānuṣam । teṣāṃ nānyadṛte loke tapasaḥ karma vidyate ॥37॥
html:
kriyamāṇaṃ yadā karma nāśaṃ gacchati mānuṣam ।
teṣāṃ nānyadṛte loke tapasaḥ karma vidyate ॥37॥
slp1: kriyamARaM yadA karma nASaM gacCati mAnuzam । tezAM nAnyadfte loke tapasaH karma vidyate ॥37॥

text: sarvātmanā tu kurvīta gṛhasthaḥ karmaniścayam । dākṣyeṇa havyakavyārthaṃ svadharmaṃ vicarennṛpa ॥38॥
html:
sarvātmanā tu kurvīta gṛhasthaḥ karmaniścayam ।
dākṣyeṇa havyakavyārthaṃ svadharmaṃ vicarennṛpa ॥38॥
slp1: sarvAtmanA tu kurvIta gfhasTaH karmaniScayam । dAkzyeRa havyakavyArTaM svaDarmaM vicarennfpa ॥38॥

text: yathā nadīnadāḥ sarve sāgare yānti saṃsthitim । evamāśramiṇaḥ sarve gṛhasthe yānti saṃsthitim] ॥39॥
html:
yathā nadīnadāḥ sarve sāgare yānti saṃsthitim ।
evamāśramiṇaḥ sarve gṛhasthe yānti saṃsthitim] ॥39॥
slp1: yaTA nadInadAH sarve sAgare yAnti saMsTitim । evamASramiRaH sarve gfhasTe yAnti saMsTitim] ॥39॥

text: varṇo viśeṣavarṇānāṃ maharṣe kena jāyate । etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ tadbrūhi vadatāṃ vara ॥1॥
html:
varṇo viśeṣavarṇānāṃ maharṣe kena jāyate ।
etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ tadbrūhi vadatāṃ vara ॥1॥
slp1: varRo viSezavarRAnAM maharze kena jAyate । etadicCAmyahaM SrotuM tadbrUhi vadatAM vara ॥1॥
author: janaka uvāca ।

text: yadetajjāyate'patyaṃ sa evāyamiti śrutiḥ । kathaṃ brāhmaṇato jāto viśeṣagrahaṇaṃ gataḥ ॥2॥
html:
yadetajjāyate'patyaṃ sa evāyamiti śrutiḥ ।
kathaṃ brāhmaṇato jāto viśeṣagrahaṇaṃ gataḥ ॥2॥
slp1: yadetajjAyate'patyaM sa evAyamiti SrutiH । kaTaM brAhmaRato jAto viSezagrahaRaM gataH ॥2॥

text: evametanmahārāja yena jātaḥ sa eva saḥ । tapasastvapakarṣeṇa jātigrahaṇatāṃ gataḥ ॥3॥
html:
evametanmahārāja yena jātaḥ sa eva saḥ ।
tapasastvapakarṣeṇa jātigrahaṇatāṃ gataḥ ॥3॥
slp1: evametanmahArAja yena jAtaH sa eva saH । tapasastvapakarzeRa jAtigrahaRatAM gataH ॥3॥
author: parāśara uvāca ।

text: sukṣetrācca subījācca puṇyo bhavati saṃbhavaḥ । ato'nyatarato hīnādavaro nāma jāyate ॥4॥
html:
sukṣetrācca subījācca puṇyo bhavati saṃbhavaḥ ।
ato'nyatarato hīnādavaro nāma jāyate ॥4॥
slp1: sukzetrAcca subIjAcca puRyo Bavati saMBavaH । ato'nyatarato hInAdavaro nAma jAyate ॥4॥

text: vaktrādbhujābhyāmūrubhyāṃ padbhyāṃ caivātha jajñire । sṛjataḥ prajāpaterlokāniti dharmavido viduḥ ॥5॥
html:
vaktrādbhujābhyāmūrubhyāṃ padbhyāṃ caivātha jajñire ।
sṛjataḥ prajāpaterlokāniti dharmavido viduḥ ॥5॥
slp1: vaktrAdBujAByAmUruByAM padByAM cEvATa jajYire । sfjataH prajApaterlokAniti Darmavido viduH ॥5॥

text: mukhajā brāhmaṇāstāta bāhujāḥ kṣatrabandhavaḥ । ūrujā dhanino rājanpādajāḥ paricārakāḥ ॥6॥
html:
mukhajā brāhmaṇāstāta bāhujāḥ kṣatrabandhavaḥ ।
ūrujā dhanino rājanpādajāḥ paricārakāḥ ॥6॥
slp1: muKajA brAhmaRAstAta bAhujAH kzatrabanDavaH । UrujA Danino rAjanpAdajAH paricArakAH ॥6॥

text: caturṇāmeva varṇānāmāgamaḥ puruṣarṣabha । ato'nye tvatiriktā ye te vai saṅkarajāḥ smṛtāḥ ॥7॥
html:
caturṇāmeva varṇānāmāgamaḥ puruṣarṣabha ।
ato'nye tvatiriktā ye te vai saṅkarajāḥ smṛtāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: caturRAmeva varRAnAmAgamaH puruzarzaBa । ato'nye tvatiriktA ye te vE saNkarajAH smftAH ॥7॥

text: kṣatrajātirathāmbaṣṭhā ugrā vaidehakāstathā । śvapākāḥ pulkasāḥ stenā niṣādāḥ sūtamāgadhāḥ ॥8॥
html:
kṣatrajātirathāmbaṣṭhā ugrā vaidehakāstathā ।
śvapākāḥ pulkasāḥ stenā niṣādāḥ sūtamāgadhāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: kzatrajAtiraTAmbazWA ugrA vEdehakAstaTA । SvapAkAH pulkasAH stenA nizAdAH sUtamAgaDAH ॥8॥

text: āyogāḥ karaṇā vrātyāścaṇḍālāśca narādhipa । ete caturbhyo varṇebhyo jāyante vai parasparam ॥9॥
html:
āyogāḥ karaṇā vrātyāścaṇḍālāśca narādhipa ।
ete caturbhyo varṇebhyo jāyante vai parasparam ॥9॥
slp1: AyogAH karaRA vrAtyAScaRqAlASca narADipa । ete caturByo varReByo jAyante vE parasparam ॥9॥

text: brahmaṇaikena jātānāṃ nānātvaṃ gotrataḥ katham । bahūnīha hi loke vai gotrāṇi munisattama ॥10॥
html:
brahmaṇaikena jātānāṃ nānātvaṃ gotrataḥ katham ।
bahūnīha hi loke vai gotrāṇi munisattama ॥10॥
slp1: brahmaREkena jAtAnAM nAnAtvaM gotrataH kaTam । bahUnIha hi loke vE gotrARi munisattama ॥10॥
author: janaka uvāca ।

text: yatra tatra kathaṃ jātāḥ svayoniṃ munayo gatāḥ । śūdrayonau samutpannā viyonau ca tathāpare ॥11॥
html:
yatra tatra kathaṃ jātāḥ svayoniṃ munayo gatāḥ ।
śūdrayonau samutpannā viyonau ca tathāpare ॥11॥
slp1: yatra tatra kaTaM jAtAH svayoniM munayo gatAH । SUdrayonO samutpannA viyonO ca taTApare ॥11॥

text: rājannaitadbhavedgrāhyamapakṛṣṭena janmanā । mahātmanāṃ samutpattistapasā bhāvitātmanām ॥12॥
html:
rājannaitadbhavedgrāhyamapakṛṣṭena janmanā ।
mahātmanāṃ samutpattistapasā bhāvitātmanām ॥12॥
slp1: rAjannEtadBavedgrAhyamapakfzwena janmanA । mahAtmanAM samutpattistapasA BAvitAtmanAm ॥12॥
author: parāśara uvāca ।

text: utpādya putrānmunayo nṛpate yatra tatra ha । svenaiva tapasā teṣāmṛṣitvaṃ vidadhuḥ punaḥ ॥13॥
html:
utpādya putrānmunayo nṛpate yatra tatra ha ।
svenaiva tapasā teṣāmṛṣitvaṃ vidadhuḥ punaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: utpAdya putrAnmunayo nfpate yatra tatra ha । svenEva tapasA tezAmfzitvaM vidaDuH punaH ॥13॥

text: pitāmahaśca me pūrvamṛśyaśṛṅgaśca kāśyapaḥ । vaṭastāṇḍyaḥ kṛpaścaiva kakṣīvānkamaṭhādayaḥ ॥14॥
html:
pitāmahaśca me pūrvamṛśyaśṛṅgaśca kāśyapaḥ ।
vaṭastāṇḍyaḥ kṛpaścaiva kakṣīvānkamaṭhādayaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: pitAmahaSca me pUrvamfSyaSfNgaSca kASyapaH । vawastARqyaH kfpaScEva kakzIvAnkamaWAdayaH ॥14॥

text: yavakrītaśca nṛpate droṇaśca vadatāṃ varaḥ । āyurmataṅgo dattaśca drupado matsya eva ca ॥15॥
html:
yavakrītaśca nṛpate droṇaśca vadatāṃ varaḥ ।
āyurmataṅgo dattaśca drupado matsya eva ca ॥15॥
slp1: yavakrItaSca nfpate droRaSca vadatAM varaH । AyurmataNgo dattaSca drupado matsya eva ca ॥15॥

text: ete svāṃ prakṛtiṃ prāptā vaideha tapaso''śrayāt । pratiṣṭhitā vedavido dame tapasi caiva hi ॥16॥
html:
ete svāṃ prakṛtiṃ prāptā vaideha tapaso''śrayāt ।
pratiṣṭhitā vedavido dame tapasi caiva hi ॥16॥
slp1: ete svAM prakftiM prAptA vEdeha tapaso''SrayAt । pratizWitA vedavido dame tapasi cEva hi ॥16॥

text: mūlagotrāṇi catvāri samutpannāni pārthiva । aṅgirāḥ kaśyapaścaiva vasiṣṭho bhṛgureva ca ॥17॥
html:
mūlagotrāṇi catvāri samutpannāni pārthiva ।
aṅgirāḥ kaśyapaścaiva vasiṣṭho bhṛgureva ca ॥17॥
slp1: mUlagotrARi catvAri samutpannAni pArTiva । aNgirAH kaSyapaScEva vasizWo Bfgureva ca ॥17॥

text: karmato'nyāni gotrāṇi samutpannāni pārthiva । nāmadheyāni tapasā tāni ca grahaṇaṃ satām ॥18॥
html:
karmato'nyāni gotrāṇi samutpannāni pārthiva ।
nāmadheyāni tapasā tāni ca grahaṇaṃ satām ॥18॥
slp1: karmato'nyAni gotrARi samutpannAni pArTiva । nAmaDeyAni tapasA tAni ca grahaRaM satAm ॥18॥

text: viśeṣadharmānvarṇānāṃ prabrūhi bhagavanmama । tathā sāmānyadharmāṃśca sarvatra kuśalo hyasi ॥19॥
html:
viśeṣadharmānvarṇānāṃ prabrūhi bhagavanmama ।
tathā sāmānyadharmāṃśca sarvatra kuśalo hyasi ॥19॥
slp1: viSezaDarmAnvarRAnAM prabrUhi Bagavanmama । taTA sAmAnyaDarmAMSca sarvatra kuSalo hyasi ॥19॥
author: janaka uvāca ।

text: pratigraho yājanaṃ ca tathaivādhyāpanaṃ nṛpa । viśeṣadharmo viprāṇāṃ rakṣā kṣatrasya śobhanā ॥20॥
html:
pratigraho yājanaṃ ca tathaivādhyāpanaṃ nṛpa ।
viśeṣadharmo viprāṇāṃ rakṣā kṣatrasya śobhanā ॥20॥
slp1: pratigraho yAjanaM ca taTEvADyApanaM nfpa । viSezaDarmo viprARAM rakzA kzatrasya SoBanA ॥20॥
author: parāśara uvāca ।

text: kṛṣiśca pāśupālyaṃ ca vāṇijyaṃ ca viśāmapi । dvijānāṃ paricaryā ca śūdrakarma narādhipa ॥21॥
html:
kṛṣiśca pāśupālyaṃ ca vāṇijyaṃ ca viśāmapi ।
dvijānāṃ paricaryā ca śūdrakarma narādhipa ॥21॥
slp1: kfziSca pASupAlyaM ca vARijyaM ca viSAmapi । dvijAnAM paricaryA ca SUdrakarma narADipa ॥21॥

text: viśeṣadharmā nṛpate varṇānāṃ parikīrtitāḥ । dharmānsādhāraṇāṃstāta vistareṇa śṛṇuṣva me ॥22॥
html:
viśeṣadharmā nṛpate varṇānāṃ parikīrtitāḥ ।
dharmānsādhāraṇāṃstāta vistareṇa śṛṇuṣva me ॥22॥
slp1: viSezaDarmA nfpate varRAnAM parikIrtitAH । DarmAnsADAraRAMstAta vistareRa SfRuzva me ॥22॥

text: ānṛśaṃsyamahiṃsā cāpramādaḥ saṃvibhāgitā । śrāddhakarmātitheyaṃ ca satyamakrodha eva ca ॥23॥
html:
ānṛśaṃsyamahiṃsā cāpramādaḥ saṃvibhāgitā ।
śrāddhakarmātitheyaṃ ca satyamakrodha eva ca ॥23॥
slp1: AnfSaMsyamahiMsA cApramAdaH saMviBAgitA । SrAdDakarmAtiTeyaM ca satyamakroDa eva ca ॥23॥

text: sveṣu dāreṣu santoṣaḥ śaucaṃ nityānasūyatā । ātmajñānaṃ titikṣā ca dharmāḥ sādhāraṇā nṛpa ॥24॥
html:
sveṣu dāreṣu santoṣaḥ śaucaṃ nityānasūyatā ।
ātmajñānaṃ titikṣā ca dharmāḥ sādhāraṇā nṛpa ॥24॥
slp1: svezu dArezu santozaH SOcaM nityAnasUyatA । AtmajYAnaM titikzA ca DarmAH sADAraRA nfpa ॥24॥

text: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāstrayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ । atra teṣāmadhīkāro dharmeṣu dvipadāṃ vara ॥25॥
html:
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāstrayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ ।
atra teṣāmadhīkāro dharmeṣu dvipadāṃ vara ॥25॥
slp1: brAhmaRAH kzatriyA vESyAstrayo varRA dvijAtayaH । atra tezAmaDIkAro Darmezu dvipadAM vara ॥25॥

text: vikarmāvasthitā varṇāḥ patanti nṛpate trayaḥ । unnamanti yathāsantamāśrityeha svakarmasu ॥26॥
html:
vikarmāvasthitā varṇāḥ patanti nṛpate trayaḥ ।
unnamanti yathāsantamāśrityeha svakarmasu ॥26॥
slp1: vikarmAvasTitA varRAH patanti nfpate trayaH । unnamanti yaTAsantamASrityeha svakarmasu ॥26॥

text: na cāpi śūdraḥ patatīti niścayo na cāpi saṃskāramihārhatīti vā । śrutipravṛttaṃ na ca dharmamāpnute na cāsya dharme pratiṣedhanaṃ kṛtam ॥27॥
html:
na cāpi śūdraḥ patatīti niścayo na cāpi saṃskāramihārhatīti vā ।
śrutipravṛttaṃ na ca dharmamāpnute na cāsya dharme pratiṣedhanaṃ kṛtam ॥27॥
slp1: na cApi SUdraH patatIti niScayo na cApi saMskAramihArhatIti vA । SrutipravfttaM na ca DarmamApnute na cAsya Darme pratizeDanaM kftam ॥27॥

text: vaidehakaṃ śūdramudāharanti dvijā mahārāja śrutopapannāḥ । ahaṃ hi paśyāmi narendra devaṃ viśvasya viṣṇuṃ jagataḥ pradhānam ॥28॥
html:
vaidehakaṃ śūdramudāharanti dvijā mahārāja śrutopapannāḥ ।
ahaṃ hi paśyāmi narendra devaṃ viśvasya viṣṇuṃ jagataḥ pradhānam ॥28॥
slp1: vEdehakaM SUdramudAharanti dvijA mahArAja SrutopapannAH । ahaM hi paSyAmi narendra devaM viSvasya vizRuM jagataH praDAnam ॥28॥

text: satāṃ vṛttamanuṣṭhāya nihīnā ujjihīrṣavaḥ । mantravarjaṃ na duṣyanti kurvāṇāḥ pauṣṭikīḥ kriyāḥ ॥29॥
html:
satāṃ vṛttamanuṣṭhāya nihīnā ujjihīrṣavaḥ ।
mantravarjaṃ na duṣyanti kurvāṇāḥ pauṣṭikīḥ kriyāḥ ॥29॥
slp1: satAM vfttamanuzWAya nihInA ujjihIrzavaH । mantravarjaM na duzyanti kurvARAH pOzwikIH kriyAH ॥29॥

text: yathā yathā hi sadvṛttamālambantītare janāḥ । tathā tathā sukhaṃ prāpya pretya ceha ca śerate ॥30॥
html:
yathā yathā hi sadvṛttamālambantītare janāḥ ।
tathā tathā sukhaṃ prāpya pretya ceha ca śerate ॥30॥
slp1: yaTA yaTA hi sadvfttamAlambantItare janAH । taTA taTA suKaM prApya pretya ceha ca Serate ॥30॥

text: kiṃ karma dūṣayatyenamatha jātirmahāmune । sandeho me samutpannastanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥31॥
html:
kiṃ karma dūṣayatyenamatha jātirmahāmune ।
sandeho me samutpannastanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥31॥
slp1: kiM karma dUzayatyenamaTa jAtirmahAmune । sandeho me samutpannastanme vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥31॥
author: janaka uvāca ।

text: asaṃśayaṃ mahārāja ubhayaṃ doṣakārakam । karma caiva hi jātiśca viśeṣaṃ tu niśāmaya ॥32॥
html:
asaṃśayaṃ mahārāja ubhayaṃ doṣakārakam ।
karma caiva hi jātiśca viśeṣaṃ tu niśāmaya ॥32॥
slp1: asaMSayaM mahArAja uBayaM dozakArakam । karma cEva hi jAtiSca viSezaM tu niSAmaya ॥32॥
author: parāśara uvāca ।

text: jātyā ca karmaṇā caiva duṣṭaṃ karma niṣevate । jātyā duṣṭaśca yaḥ pāpaṃ na karoti sa pūruṣaḥ ॥33॥
html:
jātyā ca karmaṇā caiva duṣṭaṃ karma niṣevate ।
jātyā duṣṭaśca yaḥ pāpaṃ na karoti sa pūruṣaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: jAtyA ca karmaRA cEva duzwaM karma nizevate । jAtyA duzwaSca yaH pApaM na karoti sa pUruzaH ॥33॥

text: jātyā pradhānaṃ puruṣaṃ kurvāṇaṃ karma dhikkṛtam । karma taddūṣayatyenaṃ tasmātkarma na śobhanam ॥34॥
html:
jātyā pradhānaṃ puruṣaṃ kurvāṇaṃ karma dhikkṛtam ।
karma taddūṣayatyenaṃ tasmātkarma na śobhanam ॥34॥
slp1: jAtyA praDAnaM puruzaM kurvARaM karma Dikkftam । karma taddUzayatyenaM tasmAtkarma na SoBanam ॥34॥

text: kāni karmāṇi dharmyāṇi loke'smindvijasattama । na hiṃsantīha bhūtāni kriyamāṇāni sarvadā ॥35॥
html:
kāni karmāṇi dharmyāṇi loke'smindvijasattama ।
na hiṃsantīha bhūtāni kriyamāṇāni sarvadā ॥35॥
slp1: kAni karmARi DarmyARi loke'smindvijasattama । na hiMsantIha BUtAni kriyamARAni sarvadA ॥35॥
author: janaka uvāca ।

text: śṛṇu me'tra mahārāja yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi । yāni karmāṇyahiṃsrāṇi naraṃ trāyanti sarvadā ॥36॥
html:
śṛṇu me'tra mahārāja yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ।
yāni karmāṇyahiṃsrāṇi naraṃ trāyanti sarvadā ॥36॥
slp1: SfRu me'tra mahArAja yanmAM tvaM paripfcCasi । yAni karmARyahiMsrARi naraM trAyanti sarvadA ॥36॥
author: parāśara uvāca ।

text: saṃnyasyāgnīnupāsīnāḥ paśyanti vigatajvarāḥ । naiḥśreyasaṃ dharmapathaṃ samāruhya yathākramam ॥37॥
html:
saṃnyasyāgnīnupāsīnāḥ paśyanti vigatajvarāḥ ।
naiḥśreyasaṃ dharmapathaṃ samāruhya yathākramam ॥37॥
slp1: saMnyasyAgnInupAsInAH paSyanti vigatajvarAH । nEHSreyasaM DarmapaTaM samAruhya yaTAkramam ॥37॥

text: praśritā vinayopetā damanityāḥ susaṃśitāḥ । prayānti sthānamajaraṃ sarvakarmavivarjitāḥ ॥38॥
html:
praśritā vinayopetā damanityāḥ susaṃśitāḥ ।
prayānti sthānamajaraṃ sarvakarmavivarjitāḥ ॥38॥
slp1: praSritA vinayopetA damanityAH susaMSitAH । prayAnti sTAnamajaraM sarvakarmavivarjitAH ॥38॥

text: sarve varṇā dharmakāryāṇi samyakkṛtvā rājansatyavākyāni coktvā । tyaktvādharmaṃ dāruṇaṃ jīvaloke yānti svargaṃ nātra kāryo vicāraḥ] ॥39॥
html:
sarve varṇā dharmakāryāṇi samyakkṛtvā rājansatyavākyāni coktvā ।
tyaktvādharmaṃ dāruṇaṃ jīvaloke yānti svargaṃ nātra kāryo vicāraḥ] ॥39॥
slp1: sarve varRA DarmakAryARi samyakkftvA rAjansatyavAkyAni coktvA । tyaktvADarmaM dAruRaM jIvaloke yAnti svargaM nAtra kAryo vicAraH] ॥39॥

text: pitā sakhāyo guravaḥ striyaśca na nirguṇā nāma bhavanti loke । ananyabhaktāḥ priyavādinaśca hitāśca vaśyāśca tathaiva rājan ॥1॥
html:
pitā sakhāyo guravaḥ striyaśca na nirguṇā nāma bhavanti loke ।
ananyabhaktāḥ priyavādinaśca hitāśca vaśyāśca tathaiva rājan ॥1॥
slp1: pitA saKAyo guravaH striyaSca na nirguRA nAma Bavanti loke । ananyaBaktAH priyavAdinaSca hitASca vaSyASca taTEva rAjan ॥1॥
author: parāśara uvāca ।

text: pitā paraṃ daivataṃ mānavānāṃ māturviśiṣṭaṃ pitaraṃ vadanti । jñānasya lābhaṃ paramaṃ vadanti jitendriyārthāḥ paramāpnuvanti ॥2॥
html:
pitā paraṃ daivataṃ mānavānāṃ māturviśiṣṭaṃ pitaraṃ vadanti ।
jñānasya lābhaṃ paramaṃ vadanti jitendriyārthāḥ paramāpnuvanti ॥2॥
slp1: pitA paraM dEvataM mAnavAnAM mAturviSizwaM pitaraM vadanti । jYAnasya lABaM paramaM vadanti jitendriyArTAH paramApnuvanti ॥2॥

text: raṇājire yatra śarāgnisaṃstare nṛpātmajo ghātamavāpya dahyate । prayāti lokānamaraiḥ sudurlabhānniṣevate svargaphalaṃ yathāsukham ॥3॥
html:
raṇājire yatra śarāgnisaṃstare nṛpātmajo ghātamavāpya dahyate ।
prayāti lokānamaraiḥ sudurlabhānniṣevate svargaphalaṃ yathāsukham ॥3॥
slp1: raRAjire yatra SarAgnisaMstare nfpAtmajo GAtamavApya dahyate । prayAti lokAnamarEH sudurlaBAnnizevate svargaPalaM yaTAsuKam ॥3॥

text: śrāntaṃ bhītaṃ bhraṣṭaśastraṃ rudantaṃ parāṅmukhaṃ paribarhaiśca hīnam । anudyataṃ rogiṇaṃ yācamānaṃ na vai hiṃsyādbālavṛddhau ca rājan ॥4॥
html:
śrāntaṃ bhītaṃ bhraṣṭaśastraṃ rudantaṃ parāṅmukhaṃ paribarhaiśca hīnam ।
anudyataṃ rogiṇaṃ yācamānaṃ na vai hiṃsyādbālavṛddhau ca rājan ॥4॥
slp1: SrAntaM BItaM BrazwaSastraM rudantaM parANmuKaM paribarhESca hInam । anudyataM rogiRaM yAcamAnaM na vE hiMsyAdbAlavfdDO ca rAjan ॥4॥

text: paribarhaiḥ susaṃpannamudyataṃ tulyatāṃ gatam । atikrameta nṛpatiḥ saṅgrāme kṣatriyātmajam ॥5॥
html:
paribarhaiḥ susaṃpannamudyataṃ tulyatāṃ gatam ।
atikrameta nṛpatiḥ saṅgrāme kṣatriyātmajam ॥5॥
slp1: paribarhEH susaMpannamudyataM tulyatAM gatam । atikrameta nfpatiH saNgrAme kzatriyAtmajam ॥5॥

text: tulyādiha vadhaḥ śreyānviśiṣṭācceti niścayaḥ । nihīnātkātarāccaiva nṛpāṇāṃ garhito vadhaḥ ॥6॥
html:
tulyādiha vadhaḥ śreyānviśiṣṭācceti niścayaḥ ।
nihīnātkātarāccaiva nṛpāṇāṃ garhito vadhaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: tulyAdiha vaDaH SreyAnviSizwAcceti niScayaH । nihInAtkAtarAccEva nfpARAM garhito vaDaH ॥6॥

text: pāpātpāpasamācārānnihīnācca narādhipa । pāpa eva vadhaḥ prokto narakāyeti niścayaḥ ॥7॥
html:
pāpātpāpasamācārānnihīnācca narādhipa ।
pāpa eva vadhaḥ prokto narakāyeti niścayaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: pApAtpApasamAcArAnnihInAcca narADipa । pApa eva vaDaH prokto narakAyeti niScayaH ॥7॥

text: na kaścittrāti vai rājandiṣṭāntavaśamāgatam । sāvaśeṣāyuṣaṃ cāpi kaścidevāpakarṣati ॥8॥
html:
na kaścittrāti vai rājandiṣṭāntavaśamāgatam ।
sāvaśeṣāyuṣaṃ cāpi kaścidevāpakarṣati ॥8॥
slp1: na kaScittrAti vE rAjandizwAntavaSamAgatam । sAvaSezAyuzaM cApi kaScidevApakarzati ॥8॥

text: snigdhaiśca kriyamāṇāni karmāṇīha nivartayet । hiṃsātmakāni karmāṇi nāyuricchetparāyuṣā ॥9॥
html:
snigdhaiśca kriyamāṇāni karmāṇīha nivartayet ।
hiṃsātmakāni karmāṇi nāyuricchetparāyuṣā ॥9॥
slp1: snigDESca kriyamARAni karmARIha nivartayet । hiMsAtmakAni karmARi nAyuricCetparAyuzA ॥9॥

text: gṛhasthānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ vināśamabhikāṅkṣatām । nidhanaṃ śobhanaṃ tāta pulineṣu kriyāvatām ॥10॥
html:
gṛhasthānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ vināśamabhikāṅkṣatām ।
nidhanaṃ śobhanaṃ tāta pulineṣu kriyāvatām ॥10॥
slp1: gfhasTAnAM tu sarvezAM vinASamaBikANkzatAm । niDanaM SoBanaM tAta pulinezu kriyAvatAm ॥10॥

text: āyuṣi kṣayamāpanne pañcatvamupagacchati । nākāraṇāttadbhavati kāraṇairupapāditam ॥11॥
html:
āyuṣi kṣayamāpanne pañcatvamupagacchati ।
nākāraṇāttadbhavati kāraṇairupapāditam ॥11॥
slp1: Ayuzi kzayamApanne paYcatvamupagacCati । nAkAraRAttadBavati kAraRErupapAditam ॥11॥

text: tathā śarīraṃ bhavati dehādyenopapāditam । adhvānaṃ gatakaścāyaṃ prāptaścāyaṃ gṛhādgṛham ॥12॥
html:
tathā śarīraṃ bhavati dehādyenopapāditam ।
adhvānaṃ gatakaścāyaṃ prāptaścāyaṃ gṛhādgṛham ॥12॥
slp1: taTA SarIraM Bavati dehAdyenopapAditam । aDvAnaM gatakaScAyaM prAptaScAyaM gfhAdgfham ॥12॥

text: dvitīyaṃ kāraṇaṃ tatra nānyatkiñcana vidyate । taddehaṃ dehināṃ yuktaṃ mokṣabhūteṣu vartate ॥13॥
html:
dvitīyaṃ kāraṇaṃ tatra nānyatkiñcana vidyate ।
taddehaṃ dehināṃ yuktaṃ mokṣabhūteṣu vartate ॥13॥
slp1: dvitIyaM kAraRaM tatra nAnyatkiYcana vidyate । taddehaM dehinAM yuktaM mokzaBUtezu vartate ॥13॥

text: sirāsnāyvasthisaṅghātaṃ bībhatsāmedhyasaṅkulam । bhūtānāmindriyāṇāṃ ca guṇānāṃ ca samāgamam ॥14॥
html:
sirāsnāyvasthisaṅghātaṃ bībhatsāmedhyasaṅkulam ।
bhūtānāmindriyāṇāṃ ca guṇānāṃ ca samāgamam ॥14॥
slp1: sirAsnAyvasTisaNGAtaM bIBatsAmeDyasaNkulam । BUtAnAmindriyARAM ca guRAnAM ca samAgamam ॥14॥

text: tvagantaṃ dehamityāhurvidvāṃso'dhyātmacintakāḥ । guṇairapi parikṣīṇaṃ śarīraṃ martyatāṃ gatam ॥15॥
html:
tvagantaṃ dehamityāhurvidvāṃso'dhyātmacintakāḥ ।
guṇairapi parikṣīṇaṃ śarīraṃ martyatāṃ gatam ॥15॥
slp1: tvagantaM dehamityAhurvidvAMso'DyAtmacintakAH । guRErapi parikzIRaM SarIraM martyatAM gatam ॥15॥

text: śarīriṇā parityaktaṃ niśceṣṭaṃ gatacetanam । bhūtaiḥ prakṛtimāpannaistato bhūmau nimajjati ॥16॥
html:
śarīriṇā parityaktaṃ niśceṣṭaṃ gatacetanam ।
bhūtaiḥ prakṛtimāpannaistato bhūmau nimajjati ॥16॥
slp1: SarIriRA parityaktaM niScezwaM gatacetanam । BUtEH prakftimApannEstato BUmO nimajjati ॥16॥

text: bhāvitaṃ karmayogena jāyate tatra tatra ha । idaṃ śarīraṃ vaideha mriyate yatra tatra ha । tatsvabhāvo'paro dṛṣṭo visargaḥ karmaṇastathā ॥17॥
html:
bhāvitaṃ karmayogena jāyate tatra tatra ha ।
idaṃ śarīraṃ vaideha mriyate yatra tatra ha ।
tatsvabhāvo'paro dṛṣṭo visargaḥ karmaṇastathā ॥17॥
slp1: BAvitaM karmayogena jAyate tatra tatra ha । idaM SarIraM vEdeha mriyate yatra tatra ha । tatsvaBAvo'paro dfzwo visargaH karmaRastaTA ॥17॥

text: na jāyate tu nṛpate kañcitkālamayaṃ punaḥ । paribhramati bhūtātmā dyāmivāmbudharo mahān ॥18॥
html:
na jāyate tu nṛpate kañcitkālamayaṃ punaḥ ।
paribhramati bhūtātmā dyāmivāmbudharo mahān ॥18॥
slp1: na jAyate tu nfpate kaYcitkAlamayaM punaH । pariBramati BUtAtmA dyAmivAmbuDaro mahAn ॥18॥

text: sa punarjāyate rājanprāpyehāyatanaṃ nṛpa । manasaḥ paramo hyātmā indriyebhyaḥ paraṃ manaḥ ॥19॥
html:
sa punarjāyate rājanprāpyehāyatanaṃ nṛpa ।
manasaḥ paramo hyātmā indriyebhyaḥ paraṃ manaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: sa punarjAyate rAjanprApyehAyatanaM nfpa । manasaH paramo hyAtmA indriyeByaH paraM manaH ॥19॥

text: dvividhānāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ jaṅgamāḥ paramā nṛpa । jaṅgamānāmapi tathā dvipadāḥ paramā matāḥ । dvipadānāmapi tathā dvijā vai paramāḥ smṛtāḥ ॥20॥
html:
dvividhānāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ jaṅgamāḥ paramā nṛpa ।
jaṅgamānāmapi tathā dvipadāḥ paramā matāḥ ।
dvipadānāmapi tathā dvijā vai paramāḥ smṛtāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: dviviDAnAM ca BUtAnAM jaNgamAH paramA nfpa । jaNgamAnAmapi taTA dvipadAH paramA matAH । dvipadAnAmapi taTA dvijA vE paramAH smftAH ॥20॥

text: dvijānāmapi rājendra prajñāvantaḥ parā matāḥ । prājñānāmātmasambuddhāḥ sambuddhānāmamāninaḥ ॥21॥
html:
dvijānāmapi rājendra prajñāvantaḥ parā matāḥ ।
prājñānāmātmasambuddhāḥ sambuddhānāmamāninaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: dvijAnAmapi rAjendra prajYAvantaH parA matAH । prAjYAnAmAtmasambudDAH sambudDAnAmamAninaH ॥21॥

text: jātamanveti maraṇaṃ nṛṇāmiti viniścayaḥ । antavanti hi karmāṇi sevante guṇataḥ prajāḥ ॥22॥
html:
jātamanveti maraṇaṃ nṛṇāmiti viniścayaḥ ।
antavanti hi karmāṇi sevante guṇataḥ prajāḥ ॥22॥
slp1: jAtamanveti maraRaM nfRAmiti viniScayaH । antavanti hi karmARi sevante guRataH prajAH ॥22॥

text: āpanne tūttarāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ sūrye yo nidhanaṃ vrajet । nakṣatre ca muhūrte ca puṇye rājansa puṇyakṛt ॥23॥
html:
āpanne tūttarāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ sūrye yo nidhanaṃ vrajet ।
nakṣatre ca muhūrte ca puṇye rājansa puṇyakṛt ॥23॥
slp1: Apanne tUttarAM kAzWAM sUrye yo niDanaM vrajet । nakzatre ca muhUrte ca puRye rAjansa puRyakft ॥23॥

text: ayojayitvā kleśena janaṃ plāvya ca duṣkṛtam । mṛtyunāprākṛteneha karma kṛtvātmaśaktitaḥ ॥24॥
html:
ayojayitvā kleśena janaṃ plāvya ca duṣkṛtam ।
mṛtyunāprākṛteneha karma kṛtvātmaśaktitaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: ayojayitvA kleSena janaM plAvya ca duzkftam । mftyunAprAkfteneha karma kftvAtmaSaktitaH ॥24॥

text: viṣamudbandhanaṃ dāho dasyuhastāttathā vadhaḥ । daṃṣṭribhyaśca paśubhyaśca prākṛto vadha ucyate ॥25॥
html:
viṣamudbandhanaṃ dāho dasyuhastāttathā vadhaḥ ।
daṃṣṭribhyaśca paśubhyaśca prākṛto vadha ucyate ॥25॥
slp1: vizamudbanDanaM dAho dasyuhastAttaTA vaDaH । daMzwriByaSca paSuByaSca prAkfto vaDa ucyate ॥25॥

text: na caibhiḥ puṇyakarmāṇo yujyante nābhisandhijaiḥ । evaṃvidhaiśca bahubhiraparaiḥ prākṛtairapi ॥26॥
html:
na caibhiḥ puṇyakarmāṇo yujyante nābhisandhijaiḥ ।
evaṃvidhaiśca bahubhiraparaiḥ prākṛtairapi ॥26॥
slp1: na cEBiH puRyakarmARo yujyante nABisanDijEH । evaMviDESca bahuBiraparEH prAkftErapi ॥26॥

text: ūrdhvaṃ hitvā pratiṣṭhante prāṇāḥ puṇyakṛtāṃ nṛpa । madhyato madhyapuṇyānāmadho duṣkṛtakarmaṇām ॥27॥
html:
ūrdhvaṃ hitvā pratiṣṭhante prāṇāḥ puṇyakṛtāṃ nṛpa ।
madhyato madhyapuṇyānāmadho duṣkṛtakarmaṇām ॥27॥
slp1: UrDvaM hitvA pratizWante prARAH puRyakftAM nfpa । maDyato maDyapuRyAnAmaDo duzkftakarmaRAm ॥27॥

text: ekaḥ śatrurna dvitīyo'sti śatrurajñānatulyaḥ puruṣasya rājan । yenāvṛtaḥ kurute samprayukto ghorāṇi karmāṇi sudāruṇāni ॥28॥
html:
ekaḥ śatrurna dvitīyo'sti śatrurajñānatulyaḥ puruṣasya rājan ।
yenāvṛtaḥ kurute samprayukto ghorāṇi karmāṇi sudāruṇāni ॥28॥
slp1: ekaH Satrurna dvitIyo'sti SatrurajYAnatulyaH puruzasya rAjan । yenAvftaH kurute samprayukto GorARi karmARi sudAruRAni ॥28॥

text: prabodhanārthaṃ śrutidharmayuktaṃ vṛddhānupāsyaṃ ca bhaveta yasya । prayatnasādhyo hi sa rājaputra prajñāśareṇonmathitaḥ paraiti ॥29॥
html:
prabodhanārthaṃ śrutidharmayuktaṃ vṛddhānupāsyaṃ ca bhaveta yasya ।
prayatnasādhyo hi sa rājaputra prajñāśareṇonmathitaḥ paraiti ॥29॥
slp1: praboDanArTaM SrutiDarmayuktaM vfdDAnupAsyaM ca Baveta yasya । prayatnasADyo hi sa rAjaputra prajYASareRonmaTitaH parEti ॥29॥

text: adhītya vedāṃstapasā brahmacārī yajñāñśaktyā sannisṛjyeha pañca । vanaṃ gacchetpuruṣo dharmakāmaḥ śreyaścitvā sthāpayitvā svavaṃśam ॥30॥
html:
adhītya vedāṃstapasā brahmacārī yajñāñśaktyā sannisṛjyeha pañca ।
vanaṃ gacchetpuruṣo dharmakāmaḥ śreyaścitvā sthāpayitvā svavaṃśam ॥30॥
slp1: aDItya vedAMstapasA brahmacArI yajYAYSaktyA sannisfjyeha paYca । vanaM gacCetpuruzo DarmakAmaH SreyaScitvA sTApayitvA svavaMSam ॥30॥

text: upabhogairapi tyaktaṃ nātmānamavasādayet । caṇḍālatve'pi mānuṣyaṃ sarvathā tāta durlabham ॥31॥
html:
upabhogairapi tyaktaṃ nātmānamavasādayet ।
caṇḍālatve'pi mānuṣyaṃ sarvathā tāta durlabham ॥31॥
slp1: upaBogErapi tyaktaM nAtmAnamavasAdayet । caRqAlatve'pi mAnuzyaM sarvaTA tAta durlaBam ॥31॥

text: iyaṃ hi yoniḥ prathamā yāṃ prāpya jagatīpate । ātmā vai śakyate trātuṃ karmabhiḥ śubhalakṣaṇaiḥ ॥32॥
html:
iyaṃ hi yoniḥ prathamā yāṃ prāpya jagatīpate ।
ātmā vai śakyate trātuṃ karmabhiḥ śubhalakṣaṇaiḥ ॥32॥
slp1: iyaM hi yoniH praTamA yAM prApya jagatIpate । AtmA vE Sakyate trAtuM karmaBiH SuBalakzaREH ॥32॥

text: kathaṃ na vipraṇaśyema yonito'syā iti prabho । kurvanti dharmaṃ manujāḥ śrutiprāmāṇyadarśanāt ॥33॥
html:
kathaṃ na vipraṇaśyema yonito'syā iti prabho ।
kurvanti dharmaṃ manujāḥ śrutiprāmāṇyadarśanāt ॥33॥
slp1: kaTaM na vipraRaSyema yonito'syA iti praBo । kurvanti DarmaM manujAH SrutiprAmARyadarSanAt ॥33॥

text: yo durlabhataraṃ prāpya mānuṣyamiha vai naraḥ । dharmāvamantā kāmātmā bhavetsa khalu vañcyate ॥34॥
html:
yo durlabhataraṃ prāpya mānuṣyamiha vai naraḥ ।
dharmāvamantā kāmātmā bhavetsa khalu vañcyate ॥34॥
slp1: yo durlaBataraM prApya mAnuzyamiha vE naraH । DarmAvamantA kAmAtmA Bavetsa Kalu vaYcyate ॥34॥

text: yastu prītipurogeṇa cakṣuṣā tāta paśyati । dīpopamāni bhūtāni yāvadarcirna naśyati ॥35॥
html:
yastu prītipurogeṇa cakṣuṣā tāta paśyati ।
dīpopamāni bhūtāni yāvadarcirna naśyati ॥35॥
slp1: yastu prItipurogeRa cakzuzA tAta paSyati । dIpopamAni BUtAni yAvadarcirna naSyati ॥35॥

text: sāntvenānupradānena priyavādena cāpyuta । samaduḥkhasukho bhūtvā sa paratra mahīyate ॥36॥
html:
sāntvenānupradānena priyavādena cāpyuta ।
samaduḥkhasukho bhūtvā sa paratra mahīyate ॥36॥
slp1: sAntvenAnupradAnena priyavAdena cApyuta । samaduHKasuKo BUtvA sa paratra mahIyate ॥36॥

text: dānaṃ tyāgaḥ śobhanā mūrtiradbhyo bhūyaḥ plāvyaṃ tapasā vai śarīram । sarasvatīnaimiṣapuṣkareṣu ye cāpyanye puṇyadeśāḥ pṛthivyām ॥37॥
html:
dānaṃ tyāgaḥ śobhanā mūrtiradbhyo bhūyaḥ plāvyaṃ tapasā vai śarīram ।
sarasvatīnaimiṣapuṣkareṣu ye cāpyanye puṇyadeśāḥ pṛthivyām ॥37॥
slp1: dAnaM tyAgaH SoBanA mUrtiradByo BUyaH plAvyaM tapasA vE SarIram । sarasvatInEmizapuzkarezu ye cApyanye puRyadeSAH pfTivyAm ॥37॥

text: gṛheṣu yeṣāmasavaḥ patanti teṣāmatho nirharaṇaṃ praśastam । yānena vai prāpaṇaṃ ca śmaśāne śaucena nūnaṃ vidhinā caiva dāhaḥ ॥38॥
html:
gṛheṣu yeṣāmasavaḥ patanti teṣāmatho nirharaṇaṃ praśastam ।
yānena vai prāpaṇaṃ ca śmaśāne śaucena nūnaṃ vidhinā caiva dāhaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: gfhezu yezAmasavaH patanti tezAmaTo nirharaRaM praSastam । yAnena vE prApaRaM ca SmaSAne SOcena nUnaM viDinA cEva dAhaH ॥38॥

text: iṣṭiḥ puṣṭiryajanaṃ yājanaṃ ca dānaṃ puṇyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ ca prayogaḥ । śaktyā pitryaṃ yacca kiñcitpraśastaṃ sarvāṇyātmārthe mānavo yaḥ karoti ॥39॥
html:
iṣṭiḥ puṣṭiryajanaṃ yājanaṃ ca dānaṃ puṇyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ ca prayogaḥ ।
śaktyā pitryaṃ yacca kiñcitpraśastaṃ sarvāṇyātmārthe mānavo yaḥ karoti ॥39॥
slp1: izwiH puzwiryajanaM yAjanaM ca dAnaM puRyAnAM karmaRAM ca prayogaH । SaktyA pitryaM yacca kiYcitpraSastaM sarvARyAtmArTe mAnavo yaH karoti ॥39॥

text: dharmaśāstrāṇi vedāśca ṣaḍaṅgāni narādhipa । śreyaso'rthe vidhīyante narasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ ॥40॥
html:
dharmaśāstrāṇi vedāśca ṣaḍaṅgāni narādhipa ।
śreyaso'rthe vidhīyante narasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: DarmaSAstrARi vedASca zaqaNgAni narADipa । Sreyaso'rTe viDIyante narasyAklizwakarmaRaH ॥40॥

text: etadvai sarvamākhyātaṃ muninā sumahātmanā । videharājāya purā śreyaso'rthe narādhipa] ॥41॥
html:
etadvai sarvamākhyātaṃ muninā sumahātmanā ।
videharājāya purā śreyaso'rthe narādhipa] ॥41॥
slp1: etadvE sarvamAKyAtaM muninA sumahAtmanA । videharAjAya purA Sreyaso'rTe narADipa] ॥41॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: punar eva tu papraccha janako mithilādhipaḥ । parāśaraṃ mahātmānaṃ dharme paramaniścayam ॥1॥
html:
punar eva tu papraccha janako mithilādhipaḥ ।
parāśaraṃ mahātmānaṃ dharme paramaniścayam ॥1॥
slp1: punar eva tu papracCa janako miTilADipaH । parASaraM mahAtmAnaM Darme paramaniScayam ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kiṃ śreyaḥ kā gatir brahman kiṃ kṛtaṃ na vinaśyati । kva gato na nivarteta tanme brūhi mahāmune ॥2॥
html:
kiṃ śreyaḥ kā gatir brahman kiṃ kṛtaṃ na vinaśyati ।
kva gato na nivarteta tanme brūhi mahāmune ॥2॥
slp1: kiM SreyaH kA gatir brahman kiM kftaM na vinaSyati । kva gato na nivarteta tanme brUhi mahAmune ॥2॥

text: asaṅgaḥ śreyaso mūlaṃ jñānaṃ jñānagatiḥ parā । cīrṇaṃ tapo na praṇaśyed vāpaḥ kṣetre na naśyati ॥3॥
html:
asaṅgaḥ śreyaso mūlaṃ jñānaṃ jñānagatiḥ parā ।
cīrṇaṃ tapo na praṇaśyed vāpaḥ kṣetre na naśyati ॥3॥
slp1: asaNgaH Sreyaso mUlaM jYAnaM jYAnagatiH parA । cIrRaM tapo na praRaSyed vApaH kzetre na naSyati ॥3॥
author: parāśara uvāca ।

text: chittvādharmamayaṃ pāśaṃ yadā dharme 'bhirajyate । dattvābhayakṛtaṃ dānaṃ tadā siddhim avāpnuyāt ॥4॥
html:
chittvādharmamayaṃ pāśaṃ yadā dharme 'bhirajyate ।
dattvābhayakṛtaṃ dānaṃ tadā siddhim avāpnuyāt ॥4॥
slp1: CittvADarmamayaM pASaM yadA Darme 'Birajyate । dattvABayakftaM dAnaM tadA sidDim avApnuyAt ॥4॥

text: yo dadāti sahasrāṇi gavām aśvaśatāni ca । abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyastad dānam ativartate ॥5॥
html:
yo dadāti sahasrāṇi gavām aśvaśatāni ca ।
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyastad dānam ativartate ॥5॥
slp1: yo dadAti sahasrARi gavAm aSvaSatAni ca । aBayaM sarvaBUteByastad dAnam ativartate ॥5॥

text: vasan viṣayamadhye 'pi na vasatyeva buddhimān । saṃvasatyeva durbuddhir asatsu viṣayeṣvapi ॥6॥
html:
vasan viṣayamadhye 'pi na vasatyeva buddhimān ।
saṃvasatyeva durbuddhir asatsu viṣayeṣvapi ॥6॥
slp1: vasan vizayamaDye 'pi na vasatyeva budDimAn । saMvasatyeva durbudDir asatsu vizayezvapi ॥6॥

text: nādharmaḥ śliṣyate prājñam āpaḥ puṣkaraparṇavat । aprājñam adhikaṃ pāpaṃ śliṣyate jatu kāṣṭhavat ॥7॥
html:
nādharmaḥ śliṣyate prājñam āpaḥ puṣkaraparṇavat ।
aprājñam adhikaṃ pāpaṃ śliṣyate jatu kāṣṭhavat ॥7॥
slp1: nADarmaH Slizyate prAjYam ApaH puzkaraparRavat । aprAjYam aDikaM pApaM Slizyate jatu kAzWavat ॥7॥

text: nādharmaḥ kāraṇāpekṣī kartāram abhimuñcati । kartā khalu yathākālaṃ tat sarvam abhipadyate । na bhidyante kṛtātmāna ātmapratyayadarśinaḥ ॥8॥
html:
nādharmaḥ kāraṇāpekṣī kartāram abhimuñcati ।
kartā khalu yathākālaṃ tat sarvam abhipadyate ।
na bhidyante kṛtātmāna ātmapratyayadarśinaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: nADarmaH kAraRApekzI kartAram aBimuYcati । kartA Kalu yaTAkAlaM tat sarvam aBipadyate । na Bidyante kftAtmAna AtmapratyayadarSinaH ॥8॥

text: buddhikarmendriyāṇāṃ hi pramatto yo na budhyate । śubhāśubheṣu saktātmā prāpnoti sumahad bhayam ॥9॥
html:
buddhikarmendriyāṇāṃ hi pramatto yo na budhyate ।
śubhāśubheṣu saktātmā prāpnoti sumahad bhayam ॥9॥
slp1: budDikarmendriyARAM hi pramatto yo na buDyate । SuBASuBezu saktAtmA prApnoti sumahad Bayam ॥9॥

text: vītarāgo jitakrodhaḥ samyag bhavati yaḥ sadā । viṣaye vartamāno 'pi na sa pāpena yujyate ॥10॥
html:
vītarāgo jitakrodhaḥ samyag bhavati yaḥ sadā ।
viṣaye vartamāno 'pi na sa pāpena yujyate ॥10॥
slp1: vItarAgo jitakroDaH samyag Bavati yaH sadA । vizaye vartamAno 'pi na sa pApena yujyate ॥10॥

text: maryādāyāṃ dharmasetur nibaddho naiva sīdati । puṣṭasrota ivāyattaḥ sphīto bhavati saṃcayaḥ ॥11॥
html:
maryādāyāṃ dharmasetur nibaddho naiva sīdati ।
puṣṭasrota ivāyattaḥ sphīto bhavati saṃcayaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: maryAdAyAM Darmasetur nibadDo nEva sIdati । puzwasrota ivAyattaH sPIto Bavati saMcayaH ॥11॥

text: yathā bhānugataṃ tejo maṇiḥ śuddhaḥ samādhinā । ādatte rājaśārdūla tathā yogaḥ pravartate ॥12॥
html:
yathā bhānugataṃ tejo maṇiḥ śuddhaḥ samādhinā ।
ādatte rājaśārdūla tathā yogaḥ pravartate ॥12॥
slp1: yaTA BAnugataM tejo maRiH SudDaH samADinA । Adatte rAjaSArdUla taTA yogaH pravartate ॥12॥

text: yathā tilānām iha puṣpasaṃśrayāt pṛthak pṛthag yāti guṇo 'tisaumyatām । tathā narāṇāṃ bhuvi bhāvitātmanāṃ yathāśrayaṃ sattvaguṇaḥ pravartate ॥13॥
html:
yathā tilānām iha puṣpasaṃśrayāt pṛthak pṛthag yāti guṇo 'tisaumyatām ।
tathā narāṇāṃ bhuvi bhāvitātmanāṃ yathāśrayaṃ sattvaguṇaḥ pravartate ॥13॥
slp1: yaTA tilAnAm iha puzpasaMSrayAt pfTak pfTag yAti guRo 'tisOmyatAm । taTA narARAM Buvi BAvitAtmanAM yaTASrayaM sattvaguRaH pravartate ॥13॥

text: jahāti dārān ihate na saṃpadaḥ sadaśvayānaṃ vividhāśca yāḥ kriyāḥ । triviṣṭape jātamatir yadā naras tadāsya buddhir viṣayeṣu bhidyate ॥14॥
html:
jahāti dārān ihate na saṃpadaḥ sadaśvayānaṃ vividhāśca yāḥ kriyāḥ ।
triviṣṭape jātamatir yadā naras tadāsya buddhir viṣayeṣu bhidyate ॥14॥
slp1: jahAti dArAn ihate na saMpadaH sadaSvayAnaM viviDASca yAH kriyAH । trivizwape jAtamatir yadA naras tadAsya budDir vizayezu Bidyate ॥14॥

text: prasaktabuddhir viṣayeṣu yo naro yo budhyate hyātmahitaṃ kadācana । sa sarvabhāvānugatena cetasā nṛpāmiṣeṇeva jhaṣo vikṛṣyate ॥15॥
html:
prasaktabuddhir viṣayeṣu yo naro yo budhyate hyātmahitaṃ kadācana ।
sa sarvabhāvānugatena cetasā nṛpāmiṣeṇeva jhaṣo vikṛṣyate ॥15॥
slp1: prasaktabudDir vizayezu yo naro yo buDyate hyAtmahitaM kadAcana । sa sarvaBAvAnugatena cetasA nfpAmizeReva Jazo vikfzyate ॥15॥

text: saṃghātavān martyalokaḥ parasparam apāśritaḥ । kadalīgarbhaniḥsāro naur ivāpsu nimajjati ॥16॥

text: na dharmakālaḥ puruṣasya niścito na cāpi mṛtyuḥ puruṣaṃ pratīkṣate । kriyā hi dharmasya sadaiva śobhanā yadā naro mṛtyumukhe 'bhivartate ॥17॥
html:
na dharmakālaḥ puruṣasya niścito na cāpi mṛtyuḥ puruṣaṃ pratīkṣate ।
kriyā hi dharmasya sadaiva śobhanā yadā naro mṛtyumukhe 'bhivartate ॥17॥
slp1: na DarmakAlaH puruzasya niScito na cApi mftyuH puruzaM pratIkzate । kriyA hi Darmasya sadEva SoBanA yadA naro mftyumuKe 'Bivartate ॥17॥

text: yathāndhaḥ svagṛhe yukto hyabhyāsād eva gacchati । tathā yuktena manasā prājño gacchati tāṃ gatim ॥18॥
html:
yathāndhaḥ svagṛhe yukto hyabhyāsād eva gacchati ।

slp1: yaTAnDaH svagfhe yukto hyaByAsAd eva gacCati । taTA yuktena manasA prAjYo gacCati tAM gatim ॥18॥

text: maraṇaṃ janmani proktaṃ janma vai maraṇāśritam । avidvānmokṣadharmeṣu baddho bhramati cakravat ॥19॥
html:
maraṇaṃ janmani proktaṃ janma vai maraṇāśritam ।
avidvānmokṣadharmeṣu baddho bhramati cakravat ॥19॥
slp1: maraRaM janmani proktaM janma vE maraRASritam । avidvAnmokzaDarmezu badDo Bramati cakravat ॥19॥

text: yathā mṛṇālo 'nugatam āśu muñcati kardamam । tathātmā puruṣasyeha manasā parimucyate । manaḥ praṇayate ''tmānaṃ sa enam abhiyuñjati ॥20॥
html:

tathātmā puruṣasyeha manasā parimucyate ।

slp1: yaTA mfRAlo 'nugatam ASu muYcati kardamam । taTAtmA puruzasyeha manasA parimucyate । manaH praRayate ''tmAnaM sa enam aBiyuYjati ॥20॥

text: parārthe vartamānastu svakāryaṃ yo 'bhimanyate । indriyārtheṣu saktaḥ san svakāryāt parihīyate ॥21॥
html:

slp1: parArTe vartamAnastu svakAryaM yo 'Bimanyate । indriyArTezu saktaH san svakAryAt parihIyate ॥21॥

text: adhastiryaggatiṃ caiva svarge caiva parāṃ gatim । prāpnoti svakṛtair ātmā prājñasyehetarasya ca ॥22॥

text: mṛnmaye bhājane pakve yathā vai nyasyate dravaḥ । tathā śarīraṃ tapasā taptaṃ viṣayam aśnute ॥23॥

html:
viṣayān aśnute yastu na sa bhokṣyatyasaṃśayam ।

slp1: vizayAn aSnute yastu na sa BokzyatyasaMSayam । yastu BogAMstyajed AtmA sa vE BoktuM vyavasyati ॥24॥

text: nīhāreṇa hi saṃvītaḥ śiśnodaraparāyaṇaḥ । jātyandha iva panthānam āvṛtātmā na budhyate ॥25॥
html:
nīhāreṇa hi saṃvītaḥ śiśnodaraparāyaṇaḥ ।

slp1: nIhAreRa hi saMvItaH SiSnodaraparAyaRaH । jAtyanDa iva panTAnam AvftAtmA na buDyate ॥25॥

text: vaṇig yathā samudrād vai yathārthaṃ labhate dhanam । tathā martyārṇave jantoḥ karmavijñānato gatiḥ ॥26॥
html:
vaṇig yathā samudrād vai yathārthaṃ labhate dhanam ।

slp1: vaRig yaTA samudrAd vE yaTArTaM laBate Danam । taTA martyArRave jantoH karmavijYAnato gatiH ॥26॥

text: ahorātramaye loke jarārūpeṇa saṃcaran । mṛtyur grasati bhūtāni pavanaṃ pannago yathā ॥27॥

text: svayaṃ kṛtāni karmāṇi jāto jantuḥ prapadyate । nākṛtaṃ labhate kaścit kiṃcid atra priyāpriyam ॥28॥

slp1: SayAnaM yAntam AsInaM pravfttaM vizayezu ca । SuBASuBAni karmARi prapadyante naraM sadA ॥29॥

text: na hyanyat tīram āsādya punastartuṃ vyavasyati । durlabho dṛśyate hyasya vinipāto mahārṇave ॥30॥

text: satyaṃ kṣamāṃ damaṃ prajñāṃ praśaṃsanti pitāmaha । vidvāṃso manujā loke katham etanmataṃ tava ॥1॥

text: atra te vartayiṣye 'ham itihāsaṃ purātanam । sādhyānām iha saṃvādaṃ haṃsasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥

text: śakune vayaṃ sma devā vai sādhyāstvām anuyujmahe । pṛcchāmastvāṃ mokṣadharmaṃ bhavāṃśca kila mokṣavit ॥4॥

text: śruto 'si naḥ paṇḍito dhīravādī sādhuśabdaḥ patate te patatrin । kiṃ manyase śreṣṭhatamaṃ dvija tvaṃ kasminmanaste ramate mahātman ॥5॥

tannaḥ kāryaṃ pakṣivara praśādhi yat kāryāṇāṃ manyase śreṣṭham ekam ।
yat kṛtvā vai puruṣaḥ sarvabandhair vimucyate vihagendreha śīghram ॥6॥
slp1: tannaH kAryaM pakzivara praSADi yat kAryARAM manyase SrezWam ekam । yat kftvA vE puruzaH sarvabanDEr vimucyate vihagendreha SIGram ॥6॥

text: idaṃ kāryam amṛtāśāḥ śṛṇomi tapo damaḥ satyam ātmābhiguptiḥ । granthīn vimucya hṛdayasya sarvān priyāpriye svaṃ vaśam ānayīta ॥7॥
html:
idaṃ kāryam amṛtāśāḥ śṛṇomi tapo damaḥ satyam ātmābhiguptiḥ ।
granthīn vimucya hṛdayasya sarvān priyāpriye svaṃ vaśam ānayīta ॥7॥
slp1: idaM kAryam amftASAH SfRomi tapo damaH satyam AtmABiguptiH । granTIn vimucya hfdayasya sarvAn priyApriye svaM vaSam AnayIta ॥7॥
author: haṃsa uvāca ।

text: nāruṃtudaḥ syānna nṛśaṃsavādī na hīnataḥ param abhyādadīta । yayāsya vācā para udvijeta na tāṃ vaded ruśatīṃ pāpalokyām ॥8॥
html:
nāruṃtudaḥ syānna nṛśaṃsavādī na hīnataḥ param abhyādadīta ।
yayāsya vācā para udvijeta na tāṃ vaded ruśatīṃ pāpalokyām ॥8॥
slp1: nAruMtudaH syAnna nfSaMsavAdI na hInataH param aByAdadIta । yayAsya vAcA para udvijeta na tAM vaded ruSatIM pApalokyAm ॥8॥

text: vāksāyakā vadanānniṣpatanti yair āhataḥ śocati rātryahāni । parasya nāmarmasu te patanti tān paṇḍito nāvasṛjet pareṣu ॥9॥
html:
vāksāyakā vadanānniṣpatanti yair āhataḥ śocati rātryahāni ।
parasya nāmarmasu te patanti tān paṇḍito nāvasṛjet pareṣu ॥9॥
slp1: vAksAyakA vadanAnnizpatanti yEr AhataH Socati rAtryahAni । parasya nAmarmasu te patanti tAn paRqito nAvasfjet parezu ॥9॥

text: paraśced enam ativādabāṇair bhṛśaṃ vidhyecchama eveha kāryaḥ । saṃroṣyamāṇaḥ pratimṛṣyate yaḥ sa ādatte sukṛtaṃ vai parasya ॥10॥
html:
paraśced enam ativādabāṇair bhṛśaṃ vidhyecchama eveha kāryaḥ ।
saṃroṣyamāṇaḥ pratimṛṣyate yaḥ sa ādatte sukṛtaṃ vai parasya ॥10॥
slp1: paraSced enam ativAdabAREr BfSaM viDyecCama eveha kAryaH । saMrozyamARaH pratimfzyate yaH sa Adatte sukftaM vE parasya ॥10॥

text: kṣepābhimānād abhiṣaṅgavyalīkaṃ nigṛhṇāti jvalitaṃ yaśca manyum । aduṣṭacetā mudito 'nasūyuḥ sa ādatte sukṛtaṃ vai pareṣām ॥11॥
html:
kṣepābhimānād abhiṣaṅgavyalīkaṃ nigṛhṇāti jvalitaṃ yaśca manyum ।
aduṣṭacetā mudito 'nasūyuḥ sa ādatte sukṛtaṃ vai pareṣām ॥11॥
slp1: kzepABimAnAd aBizaNgavyalIkaM nigfhRAti jvalitaM yaSca manyum । aduzwacetA mudito 'nasUyuH sa Adatte sukftaM vE parezAm ॥11॥

text: ākruśyamāno na vadāmi kiṃcit kṣamāmyahaṃ tāḍyamānaśca nityam । śreṣṭhaṃ hyetat kṣamam apyāhur āryāḥ satyaṃ tathaivārjavam ānṛśaṃsyam ॥12॥
html:
ākruśyamāno na vadāmi kiṃcit kṣamāmyahaṃ tāḍyamānaśca nityam ।
śreṣṭhaṃ hyetat kṣamam apyāhur āryāḥ satyaṃ tathaivārjavam ānṛśaṃsyam ॥12॥
slp1: AkruSyamAno na vadAmi kiMcit kzamAmyahaM tAqyamAnaSca nityam । SrezWaM hyetat kzamam apyAhur AryAH satyaM taTEvArjavam AnfSaMsyam ॥12॥

text: vedasyopaniṣat satyaṃ satyasyopaniṣad damaḥ । damasyopaniṣanmokṣa etat sarvānuśāsanam ॥13॥
html:
vedasyopaniṣat satyaṃ satyasyopaniṣad damaḥ ।
damasyopaniṣanmokṣa etat sarvānuśāsanam ॥13॥
slp1: vedasyopanizat satyaM satyasyopanizad damaH । damasyopanizanmokza etat sarvAnuSAsanam ॥13॥

text: vāco vegaṃ manasaḥ krodhavegaṃ vivitsāvegam udaropasthavegam । etān vegān yo viṣahatyudīrṇāṃs taṃ manye 'haṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vai muniṃ ca ॥14॥
html:
vāco vegaṃ manasaḥ krodhavegaṃ vivitsāvegam udaropasthavegam ।
etān vegān yo viṣahatyudīrṇāṃs taṃ manye 'haṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vai muniṃ ca ॥14॥
slp1: vAco vegaM manasaH kroDavegaM vivitsAvegam udaropasTavegam । etAn vegAn yo vizahatyudIrRAMs taM manye 'haM brAhmaRaM vE muniM ca ॥14॥

text: akrodhanaḥ krudhyatāṃ vai viśiṣṭas tathā titikṣur atitikṣor viśiṣṭaḥ । amānuṣānmānuṣo vai viśiṣṭas tathājñānājjñānavān vai pradhānaḥ ॥15॥
html:
akrodhanaḥ krudhyatāṃ vai viśiṣṭas tathā titikṣur atitikṣor viśiṣṭaḥ ।
amānuṣānmānuṣo vai viśiṣṭas tathājñānājjñānavān vai pradhānaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: akroDanaH kruDyatAM vE viSizwas taTA titikzur atitikzor viSizwaH । amAnuzAnmAnuzo vE viSizwas taTAjYAnAjjYAnavAn vE praDAnaH ॥15॥

text: ākruśyamāno nākrośenmanyur eva titikṣataḥ । ākroṣṭāraṃ nirdahati sukṛtaṃ cāsya vindati ॥16॥
html:
ākruśyamāno nākrośenmanyur eva titikṣataḥ ।
ākroṣṭāraṃ nirdahati sukṛtaṃ cāsya vindati ॥16॥
slp1: AkruSyamAno nAkroSenmanyur eva titikzataH । AkrozwAraM nirdahati sukftaM cAsya vindati ॥16॥

text: yo nātyuktaḥ prāha rūkṣaṃ priyaṃ vā yo vā hato na pratihanti dhairyāt । pāpaṃ ca yo necchati tasya hantus tasmai devāḥ spṛhayante sadaiva ॥17॥
html:
yo nātyuktaḥ prāha rūkṣaṃ priyaṃ vā yo vā hato na pratihanti dhairyāt ।
pāpaṃ ca yo necchati tasya hantus tasmai devāḥ spṛhayante sadaiva ॥17॥
slp1: yo nAtyuktaH prAha rUkzaM priyaM vA yo vA hato na pratihanti DEryAt । pApaM ca yo necCati tasya hantus tasmE devAH spfhayante sadEva ॥17॥

text: pāpīyasaḥ kṣametaiva śreyasaḥ sadṛśasya ca । vimānito hato ''kruṣṭa evaṃ siddhiṃ gamiṣyati ॥18॥
html:
pāpīyasaḥ kṣametaiva śreyasaḥ sadṛśasya ca ।
vimānito hato ''kruṣṭa evaṃ siddhiṃ gamiṣyati ॥18॥
slp1: pApIyasaH kzametEva SreyasaH sadfSasya ca । vimAnito hato ''kruzwa evaM sidDiM gamizyati ॥18॥

text: sadāham āryānnibhṛto 'pyupāse na me vivitsā na ca me 'sti roṣaḥ । na cāpyahaṃ lipsamānaḥ paraimi na caiva kiṃcid viṣameṇa yāmi ॥19॥
html:
sadāham āryānnibhṛto 'pyupāse na me vivitsā na ca me 'sti roṣaḥ ।
na cāpyahaṃ lipsamānaḥ paraimi na caiva kiṃcid viṣameṇa yāmi ॥19॥
slp1: sadAham AryAnniBfto 'pyupAse na me vivitsA na ca me 'sti rozaH । na cApyahaM lipsamAnaH parEmi na cEva kiMcid vizameRa yAmi ॥19॥

text: nāhaṃ śaptaḥ pratiśapāmi kiṃcid damaṃ dvāraṃ hyamṛtasyeha vedmi । guhyaṃ brahma tad idaṃ vo bravīmi na mānuṣācchreṣṭhataraṃ hi kiṃcit ॥20॥
html:
nāhaṃ śaptaḥ pratiśapāmi kiṃcid damaṃ dvāraṃ hyamṛtasyeha vedmi ।
guhyaṃ brahma tad idaṃ vo bravīmi na mānuṣācchreṣṭhataraṃ hi kiṃcit ॥20॥
slp1: nAhaM SaptaH pratiSapAmi kiMcid damaM dvAraM hyamftasyeha vedmi । guhyaM brahma tad idaM vo bravImi na mAnuzAcCrezWataraM hi kiMcit ॥20॥

text: vimucyamānaḥ pāpebhyo dhanebhya iva candramāḥ । virajāḥ kālam ākāṅkṣan dhīro dhairyeṇa sidhyati ॥21॥
html:
vimucyamānaḥ pāpebhyo dhanebhya iva candramāḥ ।
virajāḥ kālam ākāṅkṣan dhīro dhairyeṇa sidhyati ॥21॥
slp1: vimucyamAnaH pApeByo DaneBya iva candramAH । virajAH kAlam AkANkzan DIro DEryeRa siDyati ॥21॥

text: yaḥ sarveṣāṃ bhavati hyarcanīya utsecane stambha ivābhijātaḥ । yasmai vācaṃ supraśastāṃ vadanti sa vai devān gacchati saṃyatātmā ॥22॥
html:
yaḥ sarveṣāṃ bhavati hyarcanīya utsecane stambha ivābhijātaḥ ।
yasmai vācaṃ supraśastāṃ vadanti sa vai devān gacchati saṃyatātmā ॥22॥
slp1: yaH sarvezAM Bavati hyarcanIya utsecane stamBa ivABijAtaH । yasmE vAcaM supraSastAM vadanti sa vE devAn gacCati saMyatAtmA ॥22॥

text: na tathā vaktum icchanti kalyāṇān puruṣe guṇān । yathaiṣāṃ vaktum icchanti nairguṇyam anuyuñjakāḥ ॥23॥
html:
na tathā vaktum icchanti kalyāṇān puruṣe guṇān ।
yathaiṣāṃ vaktum icchanti nairguṇyam anuyuñjakāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: na taTA vaktum icCanti kalyARAn puruze guRAn । yaTEzAM vaktum icCanti nErguRyam anuyuYjakAH ॥23॥

text: yasya vāṅmanasī gupte samyak praṇihite sadā । vedāstapaśca tyāgaśca sa idaṃ sarvam āpnuyāt ॥24॥
html:
yasya vāṅmanasī gupte samyak praṇihite sadā ।
vedāstapaśca tyāgaśca sa idaṃ sarvam āpnuyāt ॥24॥
slp1: yasya vANmanasI gupte samyak praRihite sadA । vedAstapaSca tyAgaSca sa idaM sarvam ApnuyAt ॥24॥

text: ākrośanāvamānābhyām abudhād vardhate budhaḥ । tasmānna vardhayed anyaṃ na cātmānaṃ vihiṃsayet ॥25॥
html:
ākrośanāvamānābhyām abudhād vardhate budhaḥ ।
tasmānna vardhayed anyaṃ na cātmānaṃ vihiṃsayet ॥25॥
slp1: AkroSanAvamAnAByAm abuDAd varDate buDaH । tasmAnna varDayed anyaM na cAtmAnaM vihiMsayet ॥25॥

text: amṛtasyeva saṃtṛpyed avamānasya vai dvijaḥ । sukhaṃ hyavamataḥ śete yo 'vamantā sa naśyati ॥26॥
html:
amṛtasyeva saṃtṛpyed avamānasya vai dvijaḥ ।
