sukhaṃ hyavamataḥ śete yo 'vamantā sa naśyati ॥26॥
slp1: amftasyeva saMtfpyed avamAnasya vE dvijaH । suKaM hyavamataH Sete yo 'vamantA sa naSyati ॥26॥

text: yat krodhano yajate yad dadāti yad vā tapastapyati yajjuhoti । vaivasvatastaddharate 'sya sarvaṃ moghaḥ śramo bhavati krodhanasya ॥27॥
html:
yat krodhano yajate yad dadāti yad vā tapastapyati yajjuhoti ।
vaivasvatastaddharate 'sya sarvaṃ moghaḥ śramo bhavati krodhanasya ॥27॥
slp1: yat kroDano yajate yad dadAti yad vA tapastapyati yajjuhoti । vEvasvatastadDarate 'sya sarvaM moGaH Sramo Bavati kroDanasya ॥27॥

text: catvāri yasya dvārāṇi suguptānyamarottamāḥ । upastham udaraṃ hastau vāk caturthī sa dharmavit ॥28॥
html:
catvāri yasya dvārāṇi suguptānyamarottamāḥ ।
upastham udaraṃ hastau vāk caturthī sa dharmavit ॥28॥
slp1: catvAri yasya dvArARi suguptAnyamarottamAH । upasTam udaraM hastO vAk caturTI sa Darmavit ॥28॥

text: satyaṃ damaṃ hyārjavam ānṛśaṃsyaṃ dhṛtiṃ titikṣām abhisevamānaḥ । svādhyāyanityo 'spṛhayan pareṣām ekāntaśīlyūrdhvagatir bhavet saḥ ॥29॥
html:
satyaṃ damaṃ hyārjavam ānṛśaṃsyaṃ dhṛtiṃ titikṣām abhisevamānaḥ ।
svādhyāyanityo 'spṛhayan pareṣām ekāntaśīlyūrdhvagatir bhavet saḥ ॥29॥
slp1: satyaM damaM hyArjavam AnfSaMsyaM DftiM titikzAm aBisevamAnaH । svADyAyanityo 'spfhayan parezAm ekAntaSIlyUrDvagatir Bavet saH ॥29॥

text: sarvān etān anucaran vatsavaccaturaḥ stanān । na pāvanatamaṃ kiṃcit satyād adhyagamaṃ kvacit ॥30॥
html:
sarvān etān anucaran vatsavaccaturaḥ stanān ।
na pāvanatamaṃ kiṃcit satyād adhyagamaṃ kvacit ॥30॥
slp1: sarvAn etAn anucaran vatsavaccaturaH stanAn । na pAvanatamaM kiMcit satyAd aDyagamaM kvacit ॥30॥

text: ācakṣe 'haṃ manuṣyebhyo devebhyaḥ pratisaṃcaran । satyaṃ svargasya sopānaṃ pārāvārasya naur iva ॥31॥
html:
ācakṣe 'haṃ manuṣyebhyo devebhyaḥ pratisaṃcaran ।
satyaṃ svargasya sopānaṃ pārāvārasya naur iva ॥31॥
slp1: Acakze 'haM manuzyeByo deveByaH pratisaMcaran । satyaM svargasya sopAnaM pArAvArasya nOr iva ॥31॥

text: yādṛśaiḥ saṃnivasati yādṛśāṃścopasevate । yādṛg icchecca bhavituṃ tādṛg bhavati pūruṣaḥ ॥32॥
html:
yādṛśaiḥ saṃnivasati yādṛśāṃścopasevate ।
yādṛg icchecca bhavituṃ tādṛg bhavati pūruṣaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: yAdfSEH saMnivasati yAdfSAMScopasevate । yAdfg icCecca BavituM tAdfg Bavati pUruzaH ॥32॥

text: yadi santaṃ sevate yadyasantaṃ tapasvinaṃ yadi vā stenam eva । vāso yathā raṅgavaśaṃ prayāti tathā sa teṣāṃ vaśam abhyupaiti ॥33॥
html:
yadi santaṃ sevate yadyasantaṃ tapasvinaṃ yadi vā stenam eva ।
vāso yathā raṅgavaśaṃ prayāti tathā sa teṣāṃ vaśam abhyupaiti ॥33॥
slp1: yadi santaM sevate yadyasantaM tapasvinaM yadi vA stenam eva । vAso yaTA raNgavaSaM prayAti taTA sa tezAM vaSam aByupEti ॥33॥

text: sadā devāḥ sādhubhiḥ saṃvadante na mānuṣaṃ viṣayaṃ yānti draṣṭum । nenduḥ samaḥ syād asamo hi vāyur uccāvacaṃ viṣayaṃ yaḥ sa veda ॥34॥
html:
sadā devāḥ sādhubhiḥ saṃvadante na mānuṣaṃ viṣayaṃ yānti draṣṭum ।
nenduḥ samaḥ syād asamo hi vāyur uccāvacaṃ viṣayaṃ yaḥ sa veda ॥34॥
slp1: sadA devAH sADuBiH saMvadante na mAnuzaM vizayaM yAnti drazwum । nenduH samaH syAd asamo hi vAyur uccAvacaM vizayaM yaH sa veda ॥34॥

text: aduṣṭaṃ vartamāne tu hṛdayāntarapūruṣe । tenaiva devāḥ prīyante satāṃ mārgasthitena vai ॥35॥
html:
aduṣṭaṃ vartamāne tu hṛdayāntarapūruṣe ।
tenaiva devāḥ prīyante satāṃ mārgasthitena vai ॥35॥
slp1: aduzwaM vartamAne tu hfdayAntarapUruze । tenEva devAH prIyante satAM mArgasTitena vE ॥35॥

text: śiśnodare ye 'bhiratāḥ sadaiva stenā narā vākparuṣāśca nityam । apetadoṣān iti tān viditvā dūrād devāḥ samparivarjayanti ॥36॥
html:
śiśnodare ye 'bhiratāḥ sadaiva stenā narā vākparuṣāśca nityam ।
apetadoṣān iti tān viditvā dūrād devāḥ samparivarjayanti ॥36॥
slp1: SiSnodare ye 'BiratAH sadEva stenA narA vAkparuzASca nityam । apetadozAn iti tAn viditvA dUrAd devAH samparivarjayanti ॥36॥

text: na vai devā hīnasattvena toṣyāḥ sarvāśinā duṣkṛtakarmaṇā vā । satyavratā ye tu narāḥ kṛtajñā dharme ratāstaiḥ saha saṃbhajante ॥37॥
html:
na vai devā hīnasattvena toṣyāḥ sarvāśinā duṣkṛtakarmaṇā vā ।
satyavratā ye tu narāḥ kṛtajñā dharme ratāstaiḥ saha saṃbhajante ॥37॥
slp1: na vE devA hInasattvena tozyAH sarvASinA duzkftakarmaRA vA । satyavratA ye tu narAH kftajYA Darme ratAstEH saha saMBajante ॥37॥

text: avyāhṛtaṃ vyāhṛtācchreya āhuḥ satyaṃ vaded vyāhṛtaṃ tad dvitīyam । dharmaṃ vaded vyāhṛtaṃ tat tṛtīyaṃ priyaṃ vaded vyāhṛtaṃ taccaturtham ॥38॥
html:
avyāhṛtaṃ vyāhṛtācchreya āhuḥ satyaṃ vaded vyāhṛtaṃ tad dvitīyam ।
dharmaṃ vaded vyāhṛtaṃ tat tṛtīyaṃ priyaṃ vaded vyāhṛtaṃ taccaturtham ॥38॥
slp1: avyAhftaM vyAhftAcCreya AhuH satyaM vaded vyAhftaM tad dvitIyam । DarmaM vaded vyAhftaM tat tftIyaM priyaM vaded vyAhftaM taccaturTam ॥38॥

text: kenāyam āvṛto lokaḥ kena vā na prakāśate । kena tyajati mitrāṇi kena svargaṃ na gacchati ॥39॥
html:
kenāyam āvṛto lokaḥ kena vā na prakāśate ।
kena tyajati mitrāṇi kena svargaṃ na gacchati ॥39॥
slp1: kenAyam Avfto lokaH kena vA na prakASate । kena tyajati mitrARi kena svargaM na gacCati ॥39॥
author: sādhyā ūcuḥ ।

text: ajñānenāvṛto loko mātsaryānna prakāśate । lobhāt tyajati mitrāṇi saṅgāt svargaṃ na gacchati ॥40॥
html:
ajñānenāvṛto loko mātsaryānna prakāśate ।
lobhāt tyajati mitrāṇi saṅgāt svargaṃ na gacchati ॥40॥
slp1: ajYAnenAvfto loko mAtsaryAnna prakASate । loBAt tyajati mitrARi saNgAt svargaM na gacCati ॥40॥
author: haṃsa uvāca ।

text: kaḥ svid eko ramate brāhmaṇānāṃ kaḥ svid eko bahubhir joṣam āste । kaḥ svid eko balavān durbalo 'pi kaḥ svid eṣāṃ kalahaṃ nānvavaiti ॥41॥
html:
kaḥ svid eko ramate brāhmaṇānāṃ kaḥ svid eko bahubhir joṣam āste ।
kaḥ svid eko balavān durbalo 'pi kaḥ svid eṣāṃ kalahaṃ nānvavaiti ॥41॥
slp1: kaH svid eko ramate brAhmaRAnAM kaH svid eko bahuBir jozam Aste । kaH svid eko balavAn durbalo 'pi kaH svid ezAM kalahaM nAnvavEti ॥41॥
author: sādhyā ūcuḥ ।

text: prājña eko ramate brāhmaṇānāṃ prājña eko bahubhir joṣam āste । prājña eko balavān durbalo 'pi prājña eṣāṃ kalahaṃ nānvavaiti ॥42॥
html:
prājña eko ramate brāhmaṇānāṃ prājña eko bahubhir joṣam āste ।
prājña eko balavān durbalo 'pi prājña eṣāṃ kalahaṃ nānvavaiti ॥42॥
slp1: prAjYa eko ramate brAhmaRAnAM prAjYa eko bahuBir jozam Aste । prAjYa eko balavAn durbalo 'pi prAjYa ezAM kalahaM nAnvavEti ॥42॥
author: haṃsa uvāca ।

text: kiṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ devatvaṃ kiṃ ca sādhutvam ucyate । asādhutvaṃ ca kiṃ teṣāṃ kim eṣāṃ mānuṣaṃ matam ॥43॥
html:
kiṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ devatvaṃ kiṃ ca sādhutvam ucyate ।
asādhutvaṃ ca kiṃ teṣāṃ kim eṣāṃ mānuṣaṃ matam ॥43॥
slp1: kiM brAhmaRAnAM devatvaM kiM ca sADutvam ucyate । asADutvaM ca kiM tezAM kim ezAM mAnuzaM matam ॥43॥
author: sādhyā ūcuḥ ।

text: svādhyāya eṣāṃ devatvaṃ vrataṃ sādhutvam ucyate । asādhutvaṃ parīvādo mṛtyur mānuṣam ucyate ॥44॥
html:
svādhyāya eṣāṃ devatvaṃ vrataṃ sādhutvam ucyate ।
asādhutvaṃ parīvādo mṛtyur mānuṣam ucyate ॥44॥
slp1: svADyAya ezAM devatvaM vrataM sADutvam ucyate । asADutvaM parIvAdo mftyur mAnuzam ucyate ॥44॥
author: haṃsa uvāca ।

text: saṃvāda ityayaṃ śreṣṭhaḥ sādhyānāṃ parikīrtitaḥ । kṣetraṃ vai karmaṇāṃ yoniḥ sadbhāvaḥ satyam ucyate ॥45॥
html:
saṃvāda ityayaṃ śreṣṭhaḥ sādhyānāṃ parikīrtitaḥ ।
kṣetraṃ vai karmaṇāṃ yoniḥ sadbhāvaḥ satyam ucyate ॥45॥
slp1: saMvAda ityayaM SrezWaH sADyAnAM parikIrtitaH । kzetraM vE karmaRAM yoniH sadBAvaH satyam ucyate ॥45॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sāṃkhye yoge ca me tāta viśeṣaṃ vaktum arhasi । tava sarvajña sarvaṃ hi viditaṃ kurusattama ॥1॥
html:
sāṃkhye yoge ca me tāta viśeṣaṃ vaktum arhasi ।
tava sarvajña sarvaṃ hi viditaṃ kurusattama ॥1॥
slp1: sAMKye yoge ca me tAta viSezaM vaktum arhasi । tava sarvajYa sarvaM hi viditaM kurusattama ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: sāṃkhyāḥ sāṃkhyaṃ praśaṃsanti yogā yogaṃ dvijātayaḥ । vadanti kāraṇaiḥ śraiṣṭhyaṃ svapakṣodbhāvanāya vai ॥2॥
html:
sāṃkhyāḥ sāṃkhyaṃ praśaṃsanti yogā yogaṃ dvijātayaḥ ।
vadanti kāraṇaiḥ śraiṣṭhyaṃ svapakṣodbhāvanāya vai ॥2॥
slp1: sAMKyAH sAMKyaM praSaMsanti yogA yogaM dvijAtayaH । vadanti kAraREH SrEzWyaM svapakzodBAvanAya vE ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: anīśvaraḥ kathaṃ mucyed ityevaṃ śatrukarśana । vadanti kāraṇaiḥ śraiṣṭhyaṃ yogāḥ samyaṅ manīṣiṇaḥ ॥3॥
html:
anīśvaraḥ kathaṃ mucyed ityevaṃ śatrukarśana ।
vadanti kāraṇaiḥ śraiṣṭhyaṃ yogāḥ samyaṅ manīṣiṇaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: anISvaraH kaTaM mucyed ityevaM SatrukarSana । vadanti kAraREH SrEzWyaM yogAH samyaN manIziRaH ॥3॥

text: vadanti kāraṇaṃ cedaṃ sāṃkhyāḥ samyag dvijātayaḥ । vijñāyeha gatīḥ sarvā virakto viṣayeṣu yaḥ ॥4॥
html:
vadanti kāraṇaṃ cedaṃ sāṃkhyāḥ samyag dvijātayaḥ ।
vijñāyeha gatīḥ sarvā virakto viṣayeṣu yaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: vadanti kAraRaM cedaM sAMKyAH samyag dvijAtayaH । vijYAyeha gatIH sarvA virakto vizayezu yaH ॥4॥

text: ūrdhvaṃ sa dehāt suvyaktaṃ vimucyed iti nānyathā । etad āhur mahāprājñāḥ sāṃkhyaṃ vai mokṣadarśanam ॥5॥
html:
ūrdhvaṃ sa dehāt suvyaktaṃ vimucyed iti nānyathā ।
etad āhur mahāprājñāḥ sāṃkhyaṃ vai mokṣadarśanam ॥5॥
slp1: UrDvaM sa dehAt suvyaktaM vimucyed iti nAnyaTA । etad Ahur mahAprAjYAH sAMKyaM vE mokzadarSanam ॥5॥

text: svapakṣe kāraṇaṃ grāhyaṃ samarthaṃ vacanaṃ hitam । śiṣṭānāṃ hi mataṃ grāhyaṃ tvadvidhaiḥ śiṣṭasaṃmataiḥ ॥6॥
html:
svapakṣe kāraṇaṃ grāhyaṃ samarthaṃ vacanaṃ hitam ।
śiṣṭānāṃ hi mataṃ grāhyaṃ tvadvidhaiḥ śiṣṭasaṃmataiḥ ॥6॥
slp1: svapakze kAraRaM grAhyaM samarTaM vacanaM hitam । SizwAnAM hi mataM grAhyaM tvadviDEH SizwasaMmatEH ॥6॥

text: pratyakṣahetavo yogāḥ sāṃkhyāḥ śāstraviniścayāḥ । ubhe caite mate tattve mama tāta yudhiṣṭhira ॥7॥
html:
pratyakṣahetavo yogāḥ sāṃkhyāḥ śāstraviniścayāḥ ।
ubhe caite mate tattve mama tāta yudhiṣṭhira ॥7॥
slp1: pratyakzahetavo yogAH sAMKyAH SAstraviniScayAH । uBe cEte mate tattve mama tAta yuDizWira ॥7॥

text: ubhe caite mate jñāne nṛpate śiṣṭasaṃmate । anuṣṭhite yathāśāstraṃ nayetāṃ paramāṃ gatim ॥8॥
html:
ubhe caite mate jñāne nṛpate śiṣṭasaṃmate ।
anuṣṭhite yathāśāstraṃ nayetāṃ paramāṃ gatim ॥8॥
slp1: uBe cEte mate jYAne nfpate SizwasaMmate । anuzWite yaTASAstraM nayetAM paramAM gatim ॥8॥

text: tulyaṃ śaucaṃ tayor yuktaṃ dayā bhūteṣu cānagha । vratānāṃ dhāraṇaṃ tulyaṃ darśanaṃ na samaṃ tayoḥ ॥9॥
html:
tulyaṃ śaucaṃ tayor yuktaṃ dayā bhūteṣu cānagha ।
vratānāṃ dhāraṇaṃ tulyaṃ darśanaṃ na samaṃ tayoḥ ॥9॥
slp1: tulyaM SOcaM tayor yuktaM dayA BUtezu cAnaGa । vratAnAM DAraRaM tulyaM darSanaM na samaM tayoH ॥9॥

text: yadi tulyaṃ vrataṃ śaucaṃ dayā cātra pitāmaha । tulyaṃ na darśanaṃ kasmāt tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥10॥
html:
yadi tulyaṃ vrataṃ śaucaṃ dayā cātra pitāmaha ।
tulyaṃ na darśanaṃ kasmāt tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥10॥
slp1: yadi tulyaM vrataM SOcaM dayA cAtra pitAmaha । tulyaM na darSanaM kasmAt tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥10॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: rāgaṃ mohaṃ tathā snehaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca kevalam । yogācchittvādito doṣān pañcaitān prāpnuvanti tat ॥11॥
html:
rāgaṃ mohaṃ tathā snehaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca kevalam ।
yogācchittvādito doṣān pañcaitān prāpnuvanti tat ॥11॥
slp1: rAgaM mohaM taTA snehaM kAmaM kroDaM ca kevalam । yogAcCittvAdito dozAn paYcEtAn prApnuvanti tat ॥11॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yathā cānimiṣāḥ sthūlā jālaṃ chittvā punar jalam । prāpnuvanti tathā yogāstat padaṃ vītakalmaṣāḥ ॥12॥
html:
yathā cānimiṣāḥ sthūlā jālaṃ chittvā punar jalam ।
prāpnuvanti tathā yogāstat padaṃ vītakalmaṣāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: yaTA cAnimizAH sTUlA jAlaM CittvA punar jalam । prApnuvanti taTA yogAstat padaM vItakalmazAH ॥12॥

text: tathaiva vāgurāṃ chittvā balavanto yathā mṛgāḥ । prāpnuyur vimalaṃ mārgaṃ vimuktāḥ sarvabandhanaiḥ ॥13॥
html:
tathaiva vāgurāṃ chittvā balavanto yathā mṛgāḥ ।
prāpnuyur vimalaṃ mārgaṃ vimuktāḥ sarvabandhanaiḥ ॥13॥
slp1: taTEva vAgurAM CittvA balavanto yaTA mfgAH । prApnuyur vimalaM mArgaM vimuktAH sarvabanDanEH ॥13॥

text: lobhajāni tathā rājan bandhanāni balānvitāḥ । chittvā yogāḥ paraṃ mārgaṃ gacchanti vimalāḥ śivam ॥14॥
html:
lobhajāni tathā rājan bandhanāni balānvitāḥ ।
chittvā yogāḥ paraṃ mārgaṃ gacchanti vimalāḥ śivam ॥14॥
slp1: loBajAni taTA rAjan banDanAni balAnvitAH । CittvA yogAH paraM mArgaM gacCanti vimalAH Sivam ॥14॥

text: abalāśca mṛgā rājan vāgurāsu tathāpare । vinaśyanti na saṃdehastadvad yogabalād ṛte ॥15॥
html:
abalāśca mṛgā rājan vāgurāsu tathāpare ।
vinaśyanti na saṃdehastadvad yogabalād ṛte ॥15॥
slp1: abalASca mfgA rAjan vAgurAsu taTApare । vinaSyanti na saMdehastadvad yogabalAd fte ॥15॥

text: balahīnāśca kaunteya yathā jālagatā jhaṣāḥ । antaṃ gacchanti rājendra tathā yogāḥ sudurbalāḥ ॥16॥
html:
balahīnāśca kaunteya yathā jālagatā jhaṣāḥ ।
antaṃ gacchanti rājendra tathā yogāḥ sudurbalāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: balahInASca kOnteya yaTA jAlagatA JazAH । antaM gacCanti rAjendra taTA yogAH sudurbalAH ॥16॥

text: yathā ca śakunāḥ sūkṣmāḥ prāpya jālam ariṃdama । tatra saktā vipadyante mucyante ca balānvitāḥ ॥17॥
html:
yathā ca śakunāḥ sūkṣmāḥ prāpya jālam ariṃdama ।
tatra saktā vipadyante mucyante ca balānvitāḥ ॥17॥
slp1: yaTA ca SakunAH sUkzmAH prApya jAlam ariMdama । tatra saktA vipadyante mucyante ca balAnvitAH ॥17॥

text: karmajair bandhanair baddhāstadvad yogāḥ paraṃtapa । abalā vai vinaśyanti mucyante ca balānvitāḥ ॥18॥
html:
karmajair bandhanair baddhāstadvad yogāḥ paraṃtapa ।
abalā vai vinaśyanti mucyante ca balānvitāḥ ॥18॥
slp1: karmajEr banDanEr badDAstadvad yogAH paraMtapa । abalA vE vinaSyanti mucyante ca balAnvitAH ॥18॥

text: alpakaśca yathā rājan vahniḥ śāmyati durbalaḥ । ākrānta indhanaiḥ sthūlaistadvad yogo 'balaḥ prabho ॥19॥
html:
alpakaśca yathā rājan vahniḥ śāmyati durbalaḥ ।
ākrānta indhanaiḥ sthūlaistadvad yogo 'balaḥ prabho ॥19॥
slp1: alpakaSca yaTA rAjan vahniH SAmyati durbalaH । AkrAnta inDanEH sTUlEstadvad yogo 'balaH praBo ॥19॥

text: sa eva ca yadā rājan vahnir jātabalaḥ punaḥ । samīraṇayutaḥ kṛtsnāṃ dahet kṣipraṃ mahīm api ॥20॥
html:
sa eva ca yadā rājan vahnir jātabalaḥ punaḥ ।
samīraṇayutaḥ kṛtsnāṃ dahet kṣipraṃ mahīm api ॥20॥
slp1: sa eva ca yadA rAjan vahnir jAtabalaH punaH । samIraRayutaH kftsnAM dahet kzipraM mahIm api ॥20॥

text: tadvajjātabalo yogī dīptatejā mahābalaḥ । antakāla ivādityaḥ kṛtsnaṃ saṃśoṣayejjagat ॥21॥
html:
tadvajjātabalo yogī dīptatejā mahābalaḥ ।
antakāla ivādityaḥ kṛtsnaṃ saṃśoṣayejjagat ॥21॥
slp1: tadvajjAtabalo yogI dIptatejA mahAbalaH । antakAla ivAdityaH kftsnaM saMSozayejjagat ॥21॥

text: durbalaśca yathā rājan srotasā hriyate naraḥ । balahīnastathā yogo viṣayair hriyate 'vaśaḥ ॥22॥
html:
durbalaśca yathā rājan srotasā hriyate naraḥ ।
balahīnastathā yogo viṣayair hriyate 'vaśaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: durbalaSca yaTA rAjan srotasA hriyate naraH । balahInastaTA yogo vizayEr hriyate 'vaSaH ॥22॥

text: tad eva ca yathā sroto viṣṭambhayati vāraṇaḥ । tadvad yogabalaṃ labdhvā vyūhate viṣayān bahūn ॥23॥
html:
tad eva ca yathā sroto viṣṭambhayati vāraṇaḥ ।
tadvad yogabalaṃ labdhvā vyūhate viṣayān bahūn ॥23॥
slp1: tad eva ca yaTA sroto vizwamBayati vAraRaH । tadvad yogabalaM labDvA vyUhate vizayAn bahUn ॥23॥

text: viśanti cāvaśāḥ pārtha yogā yogabalānvitāḥ । prajāpatīn ṛṣīn devānmahābhūtāni ceśvarāḥ ॥24॥
html:
viśanti cāvaśāḥ pārtha yogā yogabalānvitāḥ ।
prajāpatīn ṛṣīn devānmahābhūtāni ceśvarāḥ ॥24॥
slp1: viSanti cAvaSAH pArTa yogA yogabalAnvitAH । prajApatIn fzIn devAnmahABUtAni ceSvarAH ॥24॥

text: na yamo nāntakaḥ kruddho na mṛtyur bhīmavikramaḥ । īśate nṛpate sarve yogasyāmitatejasaḥ ॥25॥
html:
na yamo nāntakaḥ kruddho na mṛtyur bhīmavikramaḥ ।
īśate nṛpate sarve yogasyāmitatejasaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: na yamo nAntakaH krudDo na mftyur BImavikramaH । ISate nfpate sarve yogasyAmitatejasaH ॥25॥

text: ātmanāṃ ca sahasrāṇi bahūni bharatarṣabha । yogaḥ kuryād balaṃ prāpya taiśca sarvair mahīṃ caret ॥26॥
html:
ātmanāṃ ca sahasrāṇi bahūni bharatarṣabha ।
yogaḥ kuryād balaṃ prāpya taiśca sarvair mahīṃ caret ॥26॥
slp1: AtmanAM ca sahasrARi bahUni BaratarzaBa । yogaH kuryAd balaM prApya tESca sarvEr mahIM caret ॥26॥

text: prāpnuyād viṣayāṃścaiva punaścograṃ tapaścaret । saṃkṣipecca punaḥ pārtha sūryastejoguṇān iva ॥27॥
html:
prāpnuyād viṣayāṃścaiva punaścograṃ tapaścaret ।
saṃkṣipecca punaḥ pārtha sūryastejoguṇān iva ॥27॥
slp1: prApnuyAd vizayAMScEva punaScograM tapaScaret । saMkzipecca punaH pArTa sUryastejoguRAn iva ॥27॥

text: balasthasya hi yogasya bandhaneśasya pārthiva । vimokṣaprabhaviṣṇutvam upapannam asaṃśayam ॥28॥
html:
balasthasya hi yogasya bandhaneśasya pārthiva ।
vimokṣaprabhaviṣṇutvam upapannam asaṃśayam ॥28॥
slp1: balasTasya hi yogasya banDaneSasya pArTiva । vimokzapraBavizRutvam upapannam asaMSayam ॥28॥

text: balāni yoge proktāni mayaitāni viśāṃ pate । nidarśanārthaṃ sūkṣmāṇi vakṣyāmi ca punastava ॥29॥
html:
balāni yoge proktāni mayaitāni viśāṃ pate ।
nidarśanārthaṃ sūkṣmāṇi vakṣyāmi ca punastava ॥29॥
slp1: balAni yoge proktAni mayEtAni viSAM pate । nidarSanArTaM sUkzmARi vakzyAmi ca punastava ॥29॥

text: ātmanaśca samādhāne dhāraṇāṃ prati cābhibho । nidarśanāni sūkṣmāṇi śṛṇu me bharatarṣabha ॥30॥
html:
ātmanaśca samādhāne dhāraṇāṃ prati cābhibho ।
nidarśanāni sūkṣmāṇi śṛṇu me bharatarṣabha ॥30॥
slp1: AtmanaSca samADAne DAraRAM prati cABiBo । nidarSanAni sUkzmARi SfRu me BaratarzaBa ॥30॥

text: apramatto yathā dhanvī lakṣyaṃ hanti samāhitaḥ । yuktaḥ samyak tathā yogī mokṣaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam ॥31॥
html:
apramatto yathā dhanvī lakṣyaṃ hanti samāhitaḥ ।
yuktaḥ samyak tathā yogī mokṣaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam ॥31॥
slp1: apramatto yaTA DanvI lakzyaM hanti samAhitaH । yuktaH samyak taTA yogI mokzaM prApnotyasaMSayam ॥31॥

text: snehapūrṇe yathā pātre mana ādhāya niścalam । puruṣo yatta ārohet sopānaṃ yuktamānasaḥ ॥32॥
html:
snehapūrṇe yathā pātre mana ādhāya niścalam ।
puruṣo yatta ārohet sopānaṃ yuktamānasaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: snehapUrRe yaTA pAtre mana ADAya niScalam । puruzo yatta Arohet sopAnaM yuktamAnasaH ॥32॥

text: yuktvā tathāyam ātmānaṃ yogaḥ pārthiva niścalam । karotyamalam ātmānaṃ bhāskaropamadarśanam ॥33॥
html:
yuktvā tathāyam ātmānaṃ yogaḥ pārthiva niścalam ।
karotyamalam ātmānaṃ bhāskaropamadarśanam ॥33॥
slp1: yuktvA taTAyam AtmAnaM yogaH pArTiva niScalam । karotyamalam AtmAnaM BAskaropamadarSanam ॥33॥

text: yathā ca nāvaṃ kaunteya karṇadhāraḥ samāhitaḥ । mahārṇavagatāṃ śīghraṃ nayet pārthiva pattanam ॥34॥
html:
yathā ca nāvaṃ kaunteya karṇadhāraḥ samāhitaḥ ।
mahārṇavagatāṃ śīghraṃ nayet pārthiva pattanam ॥34॥
slp1: yaTA ca nAvaM kOnteya karRaDAraH samAhitaH । mahArRavagatAM SIGraM nayet pArTiva pattanam ॥34॥

text: tadvad ātmasamādhānaṃ yuktvā yogena tattvavit । durgamaṃ sthānam āpnoti hitvā deham imaṃ nṛpa ॥35॥
html:
tadvad ātmasamādhānaṃ yuktvā yogena tattvavit ।
durgamaṃ sthānam āpnoti hitvā deham imaṃ nṛpa ॥35॥
slp1: tadvad AtmasamADAnaM yuktvA yogena tattvavit । durgamaM sTAnam Apnoti hitvA deham imaM nfpa ॥35॥

text: sārathiśca yathā yuktvā sadaśvān susamāhitaḥ । deśam iṣṭaṃ nayatyāśu dhanvinaṃ puruṣarṣabha ॥36॥
html:
sārathiśca yathā yuktvā sadaśvān susamāhitaḥ ।
deśam iṣṭaṃ nayatyāśu dhanvinaṃ puruṣarṣabha ॥36॥
slp1: sAraTiSca yaTA yuktvA sadaSvAn susamAhitaH । deSam izwaM nayatyASu DanvinaM puruzarzaBa ॥36॥

text: tathaiva nṛpate yogī dhāraṇāsu samāhitaḥ । prāpnotyāśu paraṃ sthānaṃ lakṣaṃ mukta ivāśugaḥ ॥37॥
html:
tathaiva nṛpate yogī dhāraṇāsu samāhitaḥ ।
prāpnotyāśu paraṃ sthānaṃ lakṣaṃ mukta ivāśugaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: taTEva nfpate yogI DAraRAsu samAhitaH । prApnotyASu paraM sTAnaM lakzaM mukta ivASugaH ॥37॥

text: āveśyātmani cātmānaṃ yogī tiṣṭhati yo 'calaḥ । pāpaṃ hanteva mīnānāṃ padam āpnoti so 'jaram ॥38॥
html:
āveśyātmani cātmānaṃ yogī tiṣṭhati yo 'calaḥ ।
pāpaṃ hanteva mīnānāṃ padam āpnoti so 'jaram ॥38॥
slp1: AveSyAtmani cAtmAnaM yogI tizWati yo 'calaH । pApaM hanteva mInAnAM padam Apnoti so 'jaram ॥38॥

text: nābhyāṃ kaṇṭhe ca śīrṣe ca hṛdi vakṣasi pārśvayoḥ । darśane sparśane cāpi ghrāṇe cāmitavikrama ॥39॥
html:
nābhyāṃ kaṇṭhe ca śīrṣe ca hṛdi vakṣasi pārśvayoḥ ।
darśane sparśane cāpi ghrāṇe cāmitavikrama ॥39॥
slp1: nAByAM kaRWe ca SIrze ca hfdi vakzasi pArSvayoH । darSane sparSane cApi GrARe cAmitavikrama ॥39॥

text: sthāneṣveteṣu yo yogī mahāvratasamāhitaḥ । ātmanā sūkṣmam ātmānaṃ yuṅkte samyag viśāṃ pate ॥40॥
html:
sthāneṣveteṣu yo yogī mahāvratasamāhitaḥ ।
ātmanā sūkṣmam ātmānaṃ yuṅkte samyag viśāṃ pate ॥40॥
slp1: sTAnezvetezu yo yogI mahAvratasamAhitaH । AtmanA sUkzmam AtmAnaM yuNkte samyag viSAM pate ॥40॥

text: sa śīghram amalaprajñaḥ karma dagdhvā śubhāśubham । uttamaṃ yogam āsthāya yadīcchati vimucyate ॥41॥
html:
sa śīghram amalaprajñaḥ karma dagdhvā śubhāśubham ।
uttamaṃ yogam āsthāya yadīcchati vimucyate ॥41॥
slp1: sa SIGram amalaprajYaH karma dagDvA SuBASuBam । uttamaM yogam AsTAya yadIcCati vimucyate ॥41॥

text: āhārān kīdṛśān kṛtvā kāni jitvā ca bhārata । yogī balam avāpnoti tad bhavān vaktum arhati ॥42॥
html:
āhārān kīdṛśān kṛtvā kāni jitvā ca bhārata ।
yogī balam avāpnoti tad bhavān vaktum arhati ॥42॥
slp1: AhArAn kIdfSAn kftvA kAni jitvA ca BArata । yogI balam avApnoti tad BavAn vaktum arhati ॥42॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kaṇānāṃ bhakṣaṇe yuktaḥ piṇyākasya ca bhakṣaṇe । snehānāṃ varjane yukto yogī balam avāpnuyāt ॥43॥
html:
kaṇānāṃ bhakṣaṇe yuktaḥ piṇyākasya ca bhakṣaṇe ।
snehānāṃ varjane yukto yogī balam avāpnuyāt ॥43॥
slp1: kaRAnAM BakzaRe yuktaH piRyAkasya ca BakzaRe । snehAnAM varjane yukto yogI balam avApnuyAt ॥43॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: bhuñjāno yāvakaṃ rūkṣaṃ dīrghakālam ariṃdama । ekārāmo viśuddhātmā yogī balam avāpnuyāt ॥44॥
html:
bhuñjāno yāvakaṃ rūkṣaṃ dīrghakālam ariṃdama ।
ekārāmo viśuddhātmā yogī balam avāpnuyāt ॥44॥
slp1: BuYjAno yAvakaM rUkzaM dIrGakAlam ariMdama । ekArAmo viSudDAtmA yogI balam avApnuyAt ॥44॥

text: pakṣānmāsān ṛtūṃścitrān saṃcaraṃśca guhāstathā । apaḥ pītvā payomiśrā yogī balam avāpnuyāt ॥45॥
html:
pakṣānmāsān ṛtūṃścitrān saṃcaraṃśca guhāstathā ।
apaḥ pītvā payomiśrā yogī balam avāpnuyāt ॥45॥
slp1: pakzAnmAsAn ftUMScitrAn saMcaraMSca guhAstaTA । apaH pItvA payomiSrA yogI balam avApnuyAt ॥45॥

text: akhaṇḍam api vā māsaṃ satataṃ manujeśvara । upoṣya samyak śuddhātmā yogī balam avāpnuyāt ॥46॥
html:
akhaṇḍam api vā māsaṃ satataṃ manujeśvara ।
upoṣya samyak śuddhātmā yogī balam avāpnuyāt ॥46॥
slp1: aKaRqam api vA mAsaM satataM manujeSvara । upozya samyak SudDAtmA yogI balam avApnuyAt ॥46॥

text: kāmaṃ jitvā tathā krodhaṃ śītoṣṇe varṣam eva ca । bhayaṃ nidrāṃ tathā śvāsaṃ pauruṣaṃ viṣayāṃstathā ॥47॥
html:
kāmaṃ jitvā tathā krodhaṃ śītoṣṇe varṣam eva ca ।
bhayaṃ nidrāṃ tathā śvāsaṃ pauruṣaṃ viṣayāṃstathā ॥47॥
slp1: kAmaM jitvA taTA kroDaM SItozRe varzam eva ca । BayaM nidrAM taTA SvAsaM pOruzaM vizayAMstaTA ॥47॥

text: aratiṃ durjayāṃ caiva ghorāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ ca pārthiva । sparśān sarvāṃstathā tandrīṃ durjayāṃ nṛpasattama ॥48॥
html:
aratiṃ durjayāṃ caiva ghorāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ ca pārthiva ।
sparśān sarvāṃstathā tandrīṃ durjayāṃ nṛpasattama ॥48॥
slp1: aratiM durjayAM cEva GorAM tfzRAM ca pArTiva । sparSAn sarvAMstaTA tandrIM durjayAM nfpasattama ॥48॥

text: dīpayanti mahātmānaḥ sūkṣmam ātmānam ātmanā । vītarāgā mahāprājñā dhyānādhyayanasaṃpadā ॥49॥
html:
dīpayanti mahātmānaḥ sūkṣmam ātmānam ātmanā ।
vītarāgā mahāprājñā dhyānādhyayanasaṃpadā ॥49॥
slp1: dIpayanti mahAtmAnaH sUkzmam AtmAnam AtmanA । vItarAgA mahAprAjYA DyAnADyayanasaMpadA ॥49॥

text: durgastveṣa mataḥ panthā brāhmaṇānāṃ vipaścitām । na kaścid vrajati hyasmin kṣemeṇa bharatarṣabha ॥50॥
html:
durgastveṣa mataḥ panthā brāhmaṇānāṃ vipaścitām ।
na kaścid vrajati hyasmin kṣemeṇa bharatarṣabha ॥50॥
slp1: durgastveza mataH panTA brAhmaRAnAM vipaScitAm । na kaScid vrajati hyasmin kzemeRa BaratarzaBa ॥50॥

text: yathā kaścid vanaṃ ghoraṃ bahusarpasarīsṛpam । śvabhravat toyahīnaṃ ca durgamaṃ bahukaṇṭakam ॥51॥
html:
yathā kaścid vanaṃ ghoraṃ bahusarpasarīsṛpam ।
śvabhravat toyahīnaṃ ca durgamaṃ bahukaṇṭakam ॥51॥
slp1: yaTA kaScid vanaM GoraM bahusarpasarIsfpam । SvaBravat toyahInaM ca durgamaM bahukaRwakam ॥51॥

text: abhaktam aṭavīprāyaṃ dāvadagdhamahīruham । panthānaṃ taskarākīrṇaṃ kṣemeṇābhipated yuvā ॥52॥
html:
abhaktam aṭavīprāyaṃ dāvadagdhamahīruham ।
panthānaṃ taskarākīrṇaṃ kṣemeṇābhipated yuvā ॥52॥
slp1: aBaktam awavIprAyaM dAvadagDamahIruham । panTAnaM taskarAkIrRaM kzemeRABipated yuvA ॥52॥

text: yogamārgaṃ tathāsādya yaḥ kaścid bhajate dvijaḥ । kṣemeṇoparamenmārgād bahudoṣo hi sa smṛtaḥ ॥53॥
html:
yogamārgaṃ tathāsādya yaḥ kaścid bhajate dvijaḥ ।
kṣemeṇoparamenmārgād bahudoṣo hi sa smṛtaḥ ॥53॥
slp1: yogamArgaM taTAsAdya yaH kaScid Bajate dvijaH । kzemeRoparamenmArgAd bahudozo hi sa smftaH ॥53॥

text: sustheyaṃ kṣuradhārāsu niśitāsu mahīpate । dhāraṇāsu tu yogasya duḥstheyam akṛtātmabhiḥ ॥54॥
html:
sustheyaṃ kṣuradhārāsu niśitāsu mahīpate ।
dhāraṇāsu tu yogasya duḥstheyam akṛtātmabhiḥ ॥54॥
slp1: susTeyaM kzuraDArAsu niSitAsu mahIpate । DAraRAsu tu yogasya duHsTeyam akftAtmaBiH ॥54॥

text: vipannā dhāraṇāstāta nayanti naśubhāṃ gatim । netṛhīnā yathā nāvaḥ puruṣān arṇave nṛpa ॥55॥
html:
vipannā dhāraṇāstāta nayanti naśubhāṃ gatim ।
netṛhīnā yathā nāvaḥ puruṣān arṇave nṛpa ॥55॥
slp1: vipannA DAraRAstAta nayanti naSuBAM gatim । netfhInA yaTA nAvaH puruzAn arRave nfpa ॥55॥

text: yastu tiṣṭhati kaunteya dhāraṇāsu yathāvidhi । maraṇaṃ janma duḥkhaṃ ca sukhaṃ ca sa vimuñcati ॥56॥
html:
yastu tiṣṭhati kaunteya dhāraṇāsu yathāvidhi ।
maraṇaṃ janma duḥkhaṃ ca sukhaṃ ca sa vimuñcati ॥56॥
slp1: yastu tizWati kOnteya DAraRAsu yaTAviDi । maraRaM janma duHKaM ca suKaM ca sa vimuYcati ॥56॥

text: nānāśāstreṣu niṣpannaṃ yogeṣvidam udāhṛtam । paraṃ yogaṃ tu yat kṛtsnaṃ niścitaṃ tad dvijātiṣu ॥57॥
html:
nānāśāstreṣu niṣpannaṃ yogeṣvidam udāhṛtam ।
paraṃ yogaṃ tu yat kṛtsnaṃ niścitaṃ tad dvijātiṣu ॥57॥
slp1: nAnASAstrezu nizpannaM yogezvidam udAhftam । paraM yogaM tu yat kftsnaM niScitaM tad dvijAtizu ॥57॥

text: paraṃ hi tad brahma mahanmahātman brahmāṇam īśaṃ varadaṃ ca viṣṇum । bhavaṃ ca dharmaṃ ca ṣaḍānanaṃ ca ṣaḍ brahmaputrāṃśca mahānubhāvān ॥58॥
html:
paraṃ hi tad brahma mahanmahātman brahmāṇam īśaṃ varadaṃ ca viṣṇum ।
bhavaṃ ca dharmaṃ ca ṣaḍānanaṃ ca ṣaḍ brahmaputrāṃśca mahānubhāvān ॥58॥
slp1: paraM hi tad brahma mahanmahAtman brahmARam ISaM varadaM ca vizRum । BavaM ca DarmaM ca zaqAnanaM ca zaq brahmaputrAMSca mahAnuBAvAn ॥58॥

text: tamaśca kaṣṭaṃ sumahad rajaśca sattvaṃ ca śuddhaṃ prakṛtiṃ parāṃ ca । siddhiṃ ca devīṃ varuṇasya patnīṃ tejaśca kṛtsnaṃ sumahacca dhairyam ॥59॥
html:
tamaśca kaṣṭaṃ sumahad rajaśca sattvaṃ ca śuddhaṃ prakṛtiṃ parāṃ ca ।
siddhiṃ ca devīṃ varuṇasya patnīṃ tejaśca kṛtsnaṃ sumahacca dhairyam ॥59॥
slp1: tamaSca kazwaM sumahad rajaSca sattvaM ca SudDaM prakftiM parAM ca । sidDiM ca devIM varuRasya patnIM tejaSca kftsnaM sumahacca DEryam ॥59॥

text: tārādhipaṃ vai vimalaṃ satāraṃ viśvāṃśca devān uragān pitṝṃśca । śailāṃśca kṛtsnān udadhīṃśca ghorān nadīśca sarvāḥ savanān ghanāṃśca ॥60॥
html:
tārādhipaṃ vai vimalaṃ satāraṃ viśvāṃśca devān uragān pitṝṃśca ।
śailāṃśca kṛtsnān udadhīṃśca ghorān nadīśca sarvāḥ savanān ghanāṃśca ॥60॥
slp1: tArADipaM vE vimalaM satAraM viSvAMSca devAn uragAn pitFMSca । SElAMSca kftsnAn udaDIMSca GorAn nadISca sarvAH savanAn GanAMSca ॥60॥

text: nāgānnagān yakṣagaṇān diśaśca gandharvasaṃghān puruṣān striyaśca । parasparaṃ prāpya mahānmahātmā viśeta yogī nacirād vimuktaḥ ॥61॥
html:
nāgānnagān yakṣagaṇān diśaśca gandharvasaṃghān puruṣān striyaśca ।
parasparaṃ prāpya mahānmahātmā viśeta yogī nacirād vimuktaḥ ॥61॥
slp1: nAgAnnagAn yakzagaRAn diSaSca ganDarvasaMGAn puruzAn striyaSca । parasparaM prApya mahAnmahAtmA viSeta yogI nacirAd vimuktaH ॥61॥

text: kathā ca yeyaṃ nṛpate prasaktā deve mahāvīryamatau śubheyam । yogān sa sarvān abhibhūya martyān nārāyaṇātmā kurute mahātmā ॥62॥
html:
kathā ca yeyaṃ nṛpate prasaktā deve mahāvīryamatau śubheyam ।
yogān sa sarvān abhibhūya martyān nārāyaṇātmā kurute mahātmā ॥62॥
slp1: kaTA ca yeyaM nfpate prasaktA deve mahAvIryamatO SuBeyam । yogAn sa sarvAn aBiBUya martyAn nArAyaRAtmA kurute mahAtmA ॥62॥

text: samyak tvayāyaṃ nṛpate varṇitaḥ śiṣṭasaṃmataḥ । yogamārgo yathānyāyaṃ śiṣyāyeha hitaiṣiṇā ॥1॥
html:
samyak tvayāyaṃ nṛpate varṇitaḥ śiṣṭasaṃmataḥ ।
yogamārgo yathānyāyaṃ śiṣyāyeha hitaiṣiṇā ॥1॥
slp1: samyak tvayAyaM nfpate varRitaH SizwasaMmataH । yogamArgo yaTAnyAyaM SizyAyeha hitEziRA ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: sāṃkhye tvidānīṃ kārtsnyena vidhiṃ prabrūhi pṛcchate । triṣu lokeṣu yajjñānaṃ sarvaṃ tad viditaṃ hi te ॥2॥
html:
sāṃkhye tvidānīṃ kārtsnyena vidhiṃ prabrūhi pṛcchate ।
triṣu lokeṣu yajjñānaṃ sarvaṃ tad viditaṃ hi te ॥2॥
slp1: sAMKye tvidAnIM kArtsnyena viDiM prabrUhi pfcCate । trizu lokezu yajjYAnaM sarvaM tad viditaM hi te ॥2॥

text: śṛṇu me tvam idaṃ śuddhaṃ sāṃkhyānāṃ viditātmanām । vihitaṃ yatibhir buddhaiḥ kapilādibhir īśvaraiḥ ॥3॥
html:
śṛṇu me tvam idaṃ śuddhaṃ sāṃkhyānāṃ viditātmanām ।
vihitaṃ yatibhir buddhaiḥ kapilādibhir īśvaraiḥ ॥3॥
slp1: SfRu me tvam idaM SudDaM sAMKyAnAM viditAtmanAm । vihitaM yatiBir budDEH kapilAdiBir ISvarEH ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yasminna vibhramāḥ kecid dṛśyante manujarṣabha । guṇāśca yasmin bahavo doṣahāniśca kevalā ॥4॥
html:
yasminna vibhramāḥ kecid dṛśyante manujarṣabha ।
guṇāśca yasmin bahavo doṣahāniśca kevalā ॥4॥
slp1: yasminna viBramAH kecid dfSyante manujarzaBa । guRASca yasmin bahavo dozahAniSca kevalA ॥4॥

text: jñānena parisaṃkhyāya sadoṣān viṣayānnṛpa । mānuṣān durjayān kṛtsnān paiśācān viṣayāṃstathā ॥5॥
html:
jñānena parisaṃkhyāya sadoṣān viṣayānnṛpa ।
mānuṣān durjayān kṛtsnān paiśācān viṣayāṃstathā ॥5॥
slp1: jYAnena parisaMKyAya sadozAn vizayAnnfpa । mAnuzAn durjayAn kftsnAn pESAcAn vizayAMstaTA ॥5॥

text: rākṣasān viṣayāñjñātvā yakṣāṇāṃ viṣayāṃstathā । viṣayān auragāñjñātvā gāndharvaviṣayāṃstathā ॥6॥
html:
rākṣasān viṣayāñjñātvā yakṣāṇāṃ viṣayāṃstathā ।
viṣayān auragāñjñātvā gāndharvaviṣayāṃstathā ॥6॥
slp1: rAkzasAn vizayAYjYAtvA yakzARAM vizayAMstaTA । vizayAn OragAYjYAtvA gAnDarvavizayAMstaTA ॥6॥

text: pitṝṇāṃ viṣayāñjñātvā tiryakṣu caratāṃ nṛpa । suparṇaviṣayāñjñātvā marutāṃ viṣayāṃstathā ॥7॥
html:
pitṝṇāṃ viṣayāñjñātvā tiryakṣu caratāṃ nṛpa ।
suparṇaviṣayāñjñātvā marutāṃ viṣayāṃstathā ॥7॥
slp1: pitFRAM vizayAYjYAtvA tiryakzu caratAM nfpa । suparRavizayAYjYAtvA marutAM vizayAMstaTA ॥7॥

text: rājarṣiviṣayāñjñātvā brahmarṣiviṣayāṃstathā । āsurān viṣayāñjñātvā vaiśvadevāṃstathaiva ca ॥8॥
html:
rājarṣiviṣayāñjñātvā brahmarṣiviṣayāṃstathā ।
āsurān viṣayāñjñātvā vaiśvadevāṃstathaiva ca ॥8॥
slp1: rAjarzivizayAYjYAtvA brahmarzivizayAMstaTA । AsurAn vizayAYjYAtvA vESvadevAMstaTEva ca ॥8॥

text: devarṣiviṣayāñjñātvā yogānām api ceśvarān । viṣayāṃśca prajeśānāṃ brahmaṇo viṣayāṃstathā ॥9॥
html:
devarṣiviṣayāñjñātvā yogānām api ceśvarān ।
viṣayāṃśca prajeśānāṃ brahmaṇo viṣayāṃstathā ॥9॥
slp1: devarzivizayAYjYAtvA yogAnAm api ceSvarAn । vizayAMSca prajeSAnAM brahmaRo vizayAMstaTA ॥9॥

text: āyuṣaśca paraṃ kālaṃ loke vijñāya tattvataḥ । sukhasya ca paraṃ tattvaṃ vijñāya vadatāṃ vara ॥10॥
html:
āyuṣaśca paraṃ kālaṃ loke vijñāya tattvataḥ ।
sukhasya ca paraṃ tattvaṃ vijñāya vadatāṃ vara ॥10॥
slp1: AyuzaSca paraM kAlaM loke vijYAya tattvataH । suKasya ca paraM tattvaM vijYAya vadatAM vara ॥10॥

text: prāpte kāle ca yad duḥkhaṃ patatāṃ viṣayaiṣiṇām । tiryak ca patatāṃ duḥkhaṃ patatāṃ narake ca yat ॥11॥
html:
prāpte kāle ca yad duḥkhaṃ patatāṃ viṣayaiṣiṇām ।
tiryak ca patatāṃ duḥkhaṃ patatāṃ narake ca yat ॥11॥
slp1: prApte kAle ca yad duHKaM patatAM vizayEziRAm । tiryak ca patatAM duHKaM patatAM narake ca yat ॥11॥

text: svargasya ca guṇān kṛtsnān doṣān sarvāṃśca bhārata । vedavāde ca ye doṣā guṇā ye cāpi vaidikāḥ ॥12॥
html:
svargasya ca guṇān kṛtsnān doṣān sarvāṃśca bhārata ।
vedavāde ca ye doṣā guṇā ye cāpi vaidikāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: svargasya ca guRAn kftsnAn dozAn sarvAMSca BArata । vedavAde ca ye dozA guRA ye cApi vEdikAH ॥12॥

text: jñānayoge ca ye doṣā guṇā yoge ca ye nṛpa । sāṃkhyajñāne ca ye doṣāstathaiva ca guṇā nṛpa ॥13॥
html:
jñānayoge ca ye doṣā guṇā yoge ca ye nṛpa ।
sāṃkhyajñāne ca ye doṣāstathaiva ca guṇā nṛpa ॥13॥
slp1: jYAnayoge ca ye dozA guRA yoge ca ye nfpa । sAMKyajYAne ca ye dozAstaTEva ca guRA nfpa ॥13॥

text: sattvaṃ daśaguṇaṃ jñātvā rajo navaguṇaṃ tathā । tamaścāṣṭaguṇaṃ jñātvā buddhiṃ saptaguṇāṃ tathā ॥14॥
html:
sattvaṃ daśaguṇaṃ jñātvā rajo navaguṇaṃ tathā ।
tamaścāṣṭaguṇaṃ jñātvā buddhiṃ saptaguṇāṃ tathā ॥14॥
slp1: sattvaM daSaguRaM jYAtvA rajo navaguRaM taTA । tamaScAzwaguRaM jYAtvA budDiM saptaguRAM taTA ॥14॥

text: ṣaḍguṇaṃ ca nabho jñātvā manaḥ pañcaguṇaṃ tathā । buddhiṃ caturguṇāṃ jñātvā tamaśca triguṇaṃ mahat ॥15॥
html:
ṣaḍguṇaṃ ca nabho jñātvā manaḥ pañcaguṇaṃ tathā ।
buddhiṃ caturguṇāṃ jñātvā tamaśca triguṇaṃ mahat ॥15॥
slp1: zaqguRaM ca naBo jYAtvA manaH paYcaguRaM taTA । budDiM caturguRAM jYAtvA tamaSca triguRaM mahat ॥15॥

text: dviguṇaṃ ca rajo jñātvā sattvam ekaguṇaṃ punaḥ । mārgaṃ vijñāya tattvena pralaye prekṣaṇaṃ tathā ॥16॥
html:
dviguṇaṃ ca rajo jñātvā sattvam ekaguṇaṃ punaḥ ।
mārgaṃ vijñāya tattvena pralaye prekṣaṇaṃ tathā ॥16॥
slp1: dviguRaM ca rajo jYAtvA sattvam ekaguRaM punaH । mArgaM vijYAya tattvena pralaye prekzaRaM taTA ॥16॥

text: jñānavijñānasampannāḥ kāraṇair bhāvitāḥ śubhaiḥ । prāpnuvanti śubhaṃ mokṣaṃ sūkṣmā iha nabhaḥ param ॥17॥
html:
jñānavijñānasampannāḥ kāraṇair bhāvitāḥ śubhaiḥ ।
prāpnuvanti śubhaṃ mokṣaṃ sūkṣmā iha nabhaḥ param ॥17॥
slp1: jYAnavijYAnasampannAH kAraREr BAvitAH SuBEH । prApnuvanti SuBaM mokzaM sUkzmA iha naBaH param ॥17॥

text: rūpeṇa dṛṣṭiṃ saṃyuktāṃ ghrāṇaṃ gandhaguṇena ca । śabde saktaṃ tathā śrotraṃ jihvāṃ rasaguṇeṣu ca ॥18॥
html:
rūpeṇa dṛṣṭiṃ saṃyuktāṃ ghrāṇaṃ gandhaguṇena ca ।
śabde saktaṃ tathā śrotraṃ jihvāṃ rasaguṇeṣu ca ॥18॥
slp1: rUpeRa dfzwiM saMyuktAM GrARaM ganDaguRena ca । Sabde saktaM taTA SrotraM jihvAM rasaguRezu ca ॥18॥

text: tanuṃ sparśe tathā saktāṃ vāyuṃ nabhasi cāśritam । mohaṃ tamasi saṃsaktaṃ lobham artheṣu saṃśritam ॥19॥
html:
tanuṃ sparśe tathā saktāṃ vāyuṃ nabhasi cāśritam ।
mohaṃ tamasi saṃsaktaṃ lobham artheṣu saṃśritam ॥19॥
slp1: tanuM sparSe taTA saktAM vAyuM naBasi cASritam । mohaM tamasi saMsaktaM loBam arTezu saMSritam ॥19॥

text: viṣṇuṃ krānte bale śakraṃ koṣṭhe saktaṃ tathānalam । apsu devīṃ tathā saktām apastejasi cāśritāḥ ॥20॥
html:
viṣṇuṃ krānte bale śakraṃ koṣṭhe saktaṃ tathānalam ।
apsu devīṃ tathā saktām apastejasi cāśritāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: vizRuM krAnte bale SakraM kozWe saktaM taTAnalam । apsu devIM taTA saktAm apastejasi cASritAH ॥20॥

text: tejo vāyau tu saṃsaktaṃ vāyuṃ nabhasi cāśritam । nabho mahati saṃyuktaṃ mahad buddhau ca saṃśritam ॥21॥
html:
tejo vāyau tu saṃsaktaṃ vāyuṃ nabhasi cāśritam ।
nabho mahati saṃyuktaṃ mahad buddhau ca saṃśritam ॥21॥
slp1: tejo vAyO tu saMsaktaM vAyuM naBasi cASritam । naBo mahati saMyuktaM mahad budDO ca saMSritam ॥21॥

text: buddhiṃ tamasi saṃsaktāṃ tamo rajasi cāśritam । rajaḥ sattve tathā saktaṃ sattvaṃ saktaṃ tathātmani ॥22॥
html:
buddhiṃ tamasi saṃsaktāṃ tamo rajasi cāśritam ।
rajaḥ sattve tathā saktaṃ sattvaṃ saktaṃ tathātmani ॥22॥
slp1: budDiM tamasi saMsaktAM tamo rajasi cASritam । rajaH sattve taTA saktaM sattvaM saktaM taTAtmani ॥22॥

text: saktam ātmānam īśe ca deve nārāyaṇe tathā । devaṃ mokṣe ca saṃsaktaṃ mokṣaṃ saktaṃ tu na kvacit ॥23॥
html:
saktam ātmānam īśe ca deve nārāyaṇe tathā ।
devaṃ mokṣe ca saṃsaktaṃ mokṣaṃ saktaṃ tu na kvacit ॥23॥
slp1: saktam AtmAnam ISe ca deve nArAyaRe taTA । devaM mokze ca saMsaktaM mokzaM saktaM tu na kvacit ॥23॥

text: jñātvā sattvayutaṃ dehaṃ vṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśabhir guṇaiḥ । svabhāvaṃ cetanāṃ caiva jñātvā vai deham āśrite ॥24॥
html:
jñātvā sattvayutaṃ dehaṃ vṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśabhir guṇaiḥ ।
svabhāvaṃ cetanāṃ caiva jñātvā vai deham āśrite ॥24॥
slp1: jYAtvA sattvayutaM dehaM vftaM zoqaSaBir guREH । svaBAvaM cetanAM cEva jYAtvA vE deham ASrite ॥24॥

text: madhyastham ekam ātmānaṃ pāpaṃ yasminna vidyate । dvitīyaṃ karma vijñāya nṛpate viṣayaiṣiṇām ॥25॥
html:
madhyastham ekam ātmānaṃ pāpaṃ yasminna vidyate ।
dvitīyaṃ karma vijñāya nṛpate viṣayaiṣiṇām ॥25॥
slp1: maDyasTam ekam AtmAnaM pApaM yasminna vidyate । dvitIyaM karma vijYAya nfpate vizayEziRAm ॥25॥

text: indriyāṇīndriyārthāṃśca sarvān ātmani saṃśritān । prāṇāpānau samānaṃ ca vyānodānau ca tattvataḥ ॥26॥
html:
indriyāṇīndriyārthāṃśca sarvān ātmani saṃśritān ।
prāṇāpānau samānaṃ ca vyānodānau ca tattvataḥ ॥26॥
slp1: indriyARIndriyArTAMSca sarvAn Atmani saMSritAn । prARApAnO samAnaM ca vyAnodAnO ca tattvataH ॥26॥

text: avāk caivānilaṃ jñātvā pravahaṃ cānilaṃ punaḥ । sapta vātāṃstathā śeṣān saptadhā vidhivat punaḥ ॥27॥
html:
avāk caivānilaṃ jñātvā pravahaṃ cānilaṃ punaḥ ।
sapta vātāṃstathā śeṣān saptadhā vidhivat punaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: avAk cEvAnilaM jYAtvA pravahaM cAnilaM punaH । sapta vAtAMstaTA SezAn saptaDA viDivat punaH ॥27॥

text: prajāpatīn ṛṣīṃścaiva mārgāṃśca subahūn varān । saptarṣīṃśca bahūñ jñātvā rājarṣīṃśca paraṃtapa ॥28॥
html:
prajāpatīn ṛṣīṃścaiva mārgāṃśca subahūn varān ।
saptarṣīṃśca bahūñ jñātvā rājarṣīṃśca paraṃtapa ॥28॥
slp1: prajApatIn fzIMScEva mArgAMSca subahUn varAn । saptarzIMSca bahUY jYAtvA rAjarzIMSca paraMtapa ॥28॥

text: surarṣīnmahataścānyānmaharṣīn sūryasaṃnibhān । aiśvaryāccyāvitāñ jñātvā kālena mahatā nṛpa ॥29॥
html:
surarṣīnmahataścānyānmaharṣīn sūryasaṃnibhān ।
aiśvaryāccyāvitāñ jñātvā kālena mahatā nṛpa ॥29॥
slp1: surarzInmahataScAnyAnmaharzIn sUryasaMniBAn । ESvaryAccyAvitAY jYAtvA kAlena mahatA nfpa ॥29॥

text: mahatāṃ bhūtasaṃghānāṃ śrutvā nāśaṃ ca pārthiva । gatiṃ cāpyaśubhāṃ jñātvā nṛpate pāpakarmaṇām ॥30॥
html:
mahatāṃ bhūtasaṃghānāṃ śrutvā nāśaṃ ca pārthiva ।
gatiṃ cāpyaśubhāṃ jñātvā nṛpate pāpakarmaṇām ॥30॥
slp1: mahatAM BUtasaMGAnAM SrutvA nASaM ca pArTiva । gatiM cApyaSuBAM jYAtvA nfpate pApakarmaRAm ॥30॥

text: vaitaraṇyāṃ ca yad duḥkhaṃ patitānāṃ yamakṣaye । yonīṣu ca vicitrāsu saṃsārān aśubhāṃstathā ॥31॥
html:
vaitaraṇyāṃ ca yad duḥkhaṃ patitānāṃ yamakṣaye ।
yonīṣu ca vicitrāsu saṃsārān aśubhāṃstathā ॥31॥
slp1: vEtaraRyAM ca yad duHKaM patitAnAM yamakzaye । yonIzu ca vicitrAsu saMsArAn aSuBAMstaTA ॥31॥

text: jaṭhare cāśubhe vāsaṃ śoṇitodakabhājane । śleṣmamūtrapurīṣe ca tīvragandhasamanvite ॥32॥
html:
jaṭhare cāśubhe vāsaṃ śoṇitodakabhājane ।
śleṣmamūtrapurīṣe ca tīvragandhasamanvite ॥32॥
slp1: jaWare cASuBe vAsaM SoRitodakaBAjane । SlezmamUtrapurIze ca tIvraganDasamanvite ॥32॥

text: śukraśoṇitasaṃghāte majjāsnāyuparigrahe । sirāśatasamākīrṇe navadvāre pure 'śucau ॥33॥
html:
śukraśoṇitasaṃghāte majjāsnāyuparigrahe ।
sirāśatasamākīrṇe navadvāre pure 'śucau ॥33॥
slp1: SukraSoRitasaMGAte majjAsnAyuparigrahe । sirASatasamAkIrRe navadvAre pure 'SucO ॥33॥

text: vijñāyāhitam ātmānaṃ yogāṃśca vividhānnṛpa । tāmasānāṃ ca jantūnāṃ ramaṇīyāvṛtātmanām ॥34॥
html:
vijñāyāhitam ātmānaṃ yogāṃśca vividhānnṛpa ।
tāmasānāṃ ca jantūnāṃ ramaṇīyāvṛtātmanām ॥34॥
slp1: vijYAyAhitam AtmAnaM yogAMSca viviDAnnfpa । tAmasAnAM ca jantUnAM ramaRIyAvftAtmanAm ॥34॥

text: sāttvikānāṃ ca jantūnāṃ kutsitaṃ bharatarṣabha । garhitaṃ mahatām arthe sāṃkhyānāṃ viditātmanām ॥35॥
html:
sāttvikānāṃ ca jantūnāṃ kutsitaṃ bharatarṣabha ।
garhitaṃ mahatām arthe sāṃkhyānāṃ viditātmanām ॥35॥
slp1: sAttvikAnAM ca jantUnAM kutsitaM BaratarzaBa । garhitaM mahatAm arTe sAMKyAnAM viditAtmanAm ॥35॥

text: upaplavāṃstathā ghorāñ śaśinastejasastathā । tārāṇāṃ patanaṃ dṛṣṭvā nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca paryayam ॥36॥
html:
upaplavāṃstathā ghorāñ śaśinastejasastathā ।
tārāṇāṃ patanaṃ dṛṣṭvā nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca paryayam ॥36॥
slp1: upaplavAMstaTA GorAY SaSinastejasastaTA । tArARAM patanaM dfzwvA nakzatrARAM ca paryayam ॥36॥

text: dvaṃdvānāṃ viprayogaṃ ca vijñāya kṛpaṇaṃ nṛpa । anyonyabhakṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhūtānām api cāśubham ॥37॥
html:
dvaṃdvānāṃ viprayogaṃ ca vijñāya kṛpaṇaṃ nṛpa ।
anyonyabhakṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhūtānām api cāśubham ॥37॥
slp1: dvaMdvAnAM viprayogaM ca vijYAya kfpaRaM nfpa । anyonyaBakzaRaM dfzwvA BUtAnAm api cASuBam ॥37॥

text: bālye mohaṃ ca vijñāya kṣayaṃ dehasya cāśubham । rāge mohe ca samprāpte kvacit sattvaṃ samāśritam ॥38॥
html:
bālye mohaṃ ca vijñāya kṣayaṃ dehasya cāśubham ।
rāge mohe ca samprāpte kvacit sattvaṃ samāśritam ॥38॥
slp1: bAlye mohaM ca vijYAya kzayaM dehasya cASuBam । rAge mohe ca samprApte kvacit sattvaM samASritam ॥38॥

text: sahasreṣu naraḥ kaścinmokṣabuddhiṃ samāśritaḥ । durlabhatvaṃ ca mokṣasya vijñāya śrutipūrvakam ॥39॥
html:
sahasreṣu naraḥ kaścinmokṣabuddhiṃ samāśritaḥ ।
durlabhatvaṃ ca mokṣasya vijñāya śrutipūrvakam ॥39॥
slp1: sahasrezu naraH kaScinmokzabudDiM samASritaH । durlaBatvaM ca mokzasya vijYAya SrutipUrvakam ॥39॥

text: bahumānam alabdheṣu labdhe madhyasthatāṃ punaḥ । viṣayāṇāṃ ca daurātmyaṃ vijñāya nṛpate punaḥ ॥40॥
html:
bahumānam alabdheṣu labdhe madhyasthatāṃ punaḥ ।
viṣayāṇāṃ ca daurātmyaṃ vijñāya nṛpate punaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: bahumAnam alabDezu labDe maDyasTatAM punaH । vizayARAM ca dOrAtmyaM vijYAya nfpate punaH ॥40॥

text: gatāsūnāṃ ca kaunteya dehān dṛṣṭvā tathāśubhān । vāsaṃ kuleṣu jantūnāṃ duḥkhaṃ vijñāya bhārata ॥41॥
html:
gatāsūnāṃ ca kaunteya dehān dṛṣṭvā tathāśubhān ।
vāsaṃ kuleṣu jantūnāṃ duḥkhaṃ vijñāya bhārata ॥41॥
slp1: gatAsUnAM ca kOnteya dehAn dfzwvA taTASuBAn । vAsaM kulezu jantUnAM duHKaM vijYAya BArata ॥41॥

text: brahmaghnānāṃ gatiṃ jñātvā patitānāṃ sudāruṇām । surāpāne ca saktānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ durātmanām । gurudāraprasaktānāṃ gatiṃ vijñāya cāśubhām ॥42॥
html:
brahmaghnānāṃ gatiṃ jñātvā patitānāṃ sudāruṇām ।
surāpāne ca saktānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ durātmanām ।
gurudāraprasaktānāṃ gatiṃ vijñāya cāśubhām ॥42॥
slp1: brahmaGnAnAM gatiM jYAtvA patitAnAM sudAruRAm । surApAne ca saktAnAM brAhmaRAnAM durAtmanAm । gurudAraprasaktAnAM gatiM vijYAya cASuBAm ॥42॥

text: jananīṣu ca vartante ye na samyag yudhiṣṭhira । sadevakeṣu lokeṣu ye na vartanti mānavāḥ ॥43॥
html:
jananīṣu ca vartante ye na samyag yudhiṣṭhira ।
sadevakeṣu lokeṣu ye na vartanti mānavāḥ ॥43॥
slp1: jananIzu ca vartante ye na samyag yuDizWira । sadevakezu lokezu ye na vartanti mAnavAH ॥43॥

text: tena jñānena vijñāya gatiṃ cāśubhakarmaṇām । tiryagyonigatānāṃ ca vijñāya gatayaḥ pṛthak ॥44॥
html:
tena jñānena vijñāya gatiṃ cāśubhakarmaṇām ।
tiryagyonigatānāṃ ca vijñāya gatayaḥ pṛthak ॥44॥
slp1: tena jYAnena vijYAya gatiM cASuBakarmaRAm । tiryagyonigatAnAM ca vijYAya gatayaH pfTak ॥44॥

text: vedavādāṃstathā citrān ṛtūnāṃ paryayāṃstathā । kṣayaṃ saṃvatsarāṇāṃ ca māsānāṃ prakṣayaṃ tathā ॥45॥
html:
vedavādāṃstathā citrān ṛtūnāṃ paryayāṃstathā ।
kṣayaṃ saṃvatsarāṇāṃ ca māsānāṃ prakṣayaṃ tathā ॥45॥
slp1: vedavAdAMstaTA citrAn ftUnAM paryayAMstaTA । kzayaM saMvatsarARAM ca mAsAnAM prakzayaM taTA ॥45॥

text: pakṣakṣayaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā divasānāṃ ca saṃkṣayam । kṣayaṃ vṛddhiṃ ca candrasya dṛṣṭvā pratyakṣatastathā ॥46॥
html:
pakṣakṣayaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā divasānāṃ ca saṃkṣayam ।
kṣayaṃ vṛddhiṃ ca candrasya dṛṣṭvā pratyakṣatastathā ॥46॥
slp1: pakzakzayaM taTA dfzwvA divasAnAM ca saMkzayam । kzayaM vfdDiM ca candrasya dfzwvA pratyakzatastaTA ॥46॥

text: vṛddhiṃ dṛṣṭvā samudrāṇāṃ kṣayaṃ teṣāṃ tathā punaḥ । kṣayaṃ dhanānāṃ ca tathā punar vṛddhiṃ tathaiva ca ॥47॥
html:
vṛddhiṃ dṛṣṭvā samudrāṇāṃ kṣayaṃ teṣāṃ tathā punaḥ ।
kṣayaṃ dhanānāṃ ca tathā punar vṛddhiṃ tathaiva ca ॥47॥
slp1: vfdDiM dfzwvA samudrARAM kzayaM tezAM taTA punaH । kzayaM DanAnAM ca taTA punar vfdDiM taTEva ca ॥47॥

text: saṃyogānāṃ kṣayaṃ dṛṣṭvā yugānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ । kṣayaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā śailānāṃ kṣayaṃ ca saritāṃ tathā ॥48॥
html:
saṃyogānāṃ kṣayaṃ dṛṣṭvā yugānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ।
kṣayaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā śailānāṃ kṣayaṃ ca saritāṃ tathā ॥48॥
slp1: saMyogAnAM kzayaM dfzwvA yugAnAM ca viSezataH । kzayaM ca dfzwvA SElAnAM kzayaM ca saritAM taTA ॥48॥

text: varṇānāṃ ca kṣayaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣayāntaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ । jarāmṛtyuṃ tathā janma dṛṣṭvā duḥkhāni caiva ha ॥49॥
html:
varṇānāṃ ca kṣayaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣayāntaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ ।
jarāmṛtyuṃ tathā janma dṛṣṭvā duḥkhāni caiva ha ॥49॥
slp1: varRAnAM ca kzayaM dfzwvA kzayAntaM ca punaH punaH । jarAmftyuM taTA janma dfzwvA duHKAni cEva ha ॥49॥

text: dehadoṣāṃstathā jñātvā teṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ ca tattvataḥ । dehaviklavatāṃ caiva samyag vijñāya bhārata ॥50॥
html:
dehadoṣāṃstathā jñātvā teṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ ca tattvataḥ ।
dehaviklavatāṃ caiva samyag vijñāya bhārata ॥50॥
slp1: dehadozAMstaTA jYAtvA tezAM duHKaM ca tattvataH । dehaviklavatAM cEva samyag vijYAya BArata ॥50॥

text: ātmadoṣāṃśca vijñāya sarvān ātmani saṃśritān । svadehād utthitān gandhāṃstathā vijñāya cāśubhān ॥51॥
html:
ātmadoṣāṃśca vijñāya sarvān ātmani saṃśritān ।
svadehād utthitān gandhāṃstathā vijñāya cāśubhān ॥51॥
slp1: AtmadozAMSca vijYAya sarvAn Atmani saMSritAn । svadehAd utTitAn ganDAMstaTA vijYAya cASuBAn ॥51॥

text: kān svagātrodbhavān doṣān paśyasyamitavikrama । etanme saṃśayaṃ kṛtsnaṃ vaktum arhasi tattvataḥ ॥52॥
html:
kān svagātrodbhavān doṣān paśyasyamitavikrama ।
etanme saṃśayaṃ kṛtsnaṃ vaktum arhasi tattvataḥ ॥52॥
slp1: kAn svagAtrodBavAn dozAn paSyasyamitavikrama । etanme saMSayaM kftsnaM vaktum arhasi tattvataH ॥52॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: pañca doṣān prabho dehe pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ । mārgajñāḥ kāpilāḥ sāṃkhyāḥ śṛṇu tān arisūdana ॥53॥
html:
pañca doṣān prabho dehe pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ।
mārgajñāḥ kāpilāḥ sāṃkhyāḥ śṛṇu tān arisūdana ॥53॥
slp1: paYca dozAn praBo dehe pravadanti manIziRaH । mArgajYAH kApilAH sAMKyAH SfRu tAn arisUdana ॥53॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kāmakrodhau bhayaṃ nidrā pañcamaḥ śvāsa ucyate । ete doṣāḥ śarīreṣu dṛśyante sarvadehinām ॥54॥
html:
kāmakrodhau bhayaṃ nidrā pañcamaḥ śvāsa ucyate ।
ete doṣāḥ śarīreṣu dṛśyante sarvadehinām ॥54॥
slp1: kAmakroDO BayaM nidrA paYcamaH SvAsa ucyate । ete dozAH SarIrezu dfSyante sarvadehinAm ॥54॥

text: chindanti kṣamayā krodhaṃ kāmaṃ saṃkalpavarjanāt । sattvasaṃśīlanānnidrām apramādād bhayaṃ tathā । chindanti pañcamaṃ śvāsaṃ laghvāhāratayā nṛpa ॥55॥
html:
chindanti kṣamayā krodhaṃ kāmaṃ saṃkalpavarjanāt ।
sattvasaṃśīlanānnidrām apramādād bhayaṃ tathā ।
chindanti pañcamaṃ śvāsaṃ laghvāhāratayā nṛpa ॥55॥
slp1: Cindanti kzamayA kroDaM kAmaM saMkalpavarjanAt । sattvasaMSIlanAnnidrAm apramAdAd BayaM taTA । Cindanti paYcamaM SvAsaM laGvAhAratayA nfpa ॥55॥

text: guṇān guṇaśatair jñātvā doṣān doṣaśatair api । hetūn hetuśataiścitraiścitrān vijñāya tattvataḥ ॥56॥
html:
guṇān guṇaśatair jñātvā doṣān doṣaśatair api ।
hetūn hetuśataiścitraiścitrān vijñāya tattvataḥ ॥56॥
slp1: guRAn guRaSatEr jYAtvA dozAn dozaSatEr api । hetUn hetuSatEScitrEScitrAn vijYAya tattvataH ॥56॥

text: apāṃ phenopamaṃ lokaṃ viṣṇor māyāśatair vṛtam । cittabhittipratīkāśaṃ nalasāram anarthakam ॥57॥
html:
apāṃ phenopamaṃ lokaṃ viṣṇor māyāśatair vṛtam ।
cittabhittipratīkāśaṃ nalasāram anarthakam ॥57॥
slp1: apAM PenopamaM lokaM vizRor mAyASatEr vftam । cittaBittipratIkASaM nalasAram anarTakam ॥57॥

text: tamaḥ śvabhranibhaṃ dṛṣṭvā varṣabudbudasaṃnibham । nāśaprāyaṃ sukhāddhīnaṃ nāśottaram abhāvagam । rajastamasi saṃmagnaṃ paṅke dvipam ivāvaśam ॥58॥
html:
tamaḥ śvabhranibhaṃ dṛṣṭvā varṣabudbudasaṃnibham ।
nāśaprāyaṃ sukhāddhīnaṃ nāśottaram abhāvagam ।
rajastamasi saṃmagnaṃ paṅke dvipam ivāvaśam ॥58॥
slp1: tamaH SvaBraniBaM dfzwvA varzabudbudasaMniBam । nASaprAyaM suKAdDInaM nASottaram aBAvagam । rajastamasi saMmagnaM paNke dvipam ivAvaSam ॥58॥

text: sāṃkhyā rājanmahāprājñāstyaktvā dehaṃ prajākṛtam । jñānajñeyena sāṃkhyena vyāpinā mahatā nṛpa ॥59॥
html:
sāṃkhyā rājanmahāprājñāstyaktvā dehaṃ prajākṛtam ।
jñānajñeyena sāṃkhyena vyāpinā mahatā nṛpa ॥59॥
slp1: sAMKyA rAjanmahAprAjYAstyaktvA dehaM prajAkftam । jYAnajYeyena sAMKyena vyApinA mahatA nfpa ॥59॥

text: rājasān aśubhān gandhāṃstāmasāṃśca tathāvidhān । puṇyāṃśca sāttvikān gandhān sparśajān dehasaṃśritān । chittvāśu jñānaśastreṇa tapodaṇḍena bhārata ॥60॥
html:
rājasān aśubhān gandhāṃstāmasāṃśca tathāvidhān ।
puṇyāṃśca sāttvikān gandhān sparśajān dehasaṃśritān ।
chittvāśu jñānaśastreṇa tapodaṇḍena bhārata ॥60॥
slp1: rAjasAn aSuBAn ganDAMstAmasAMSca taTAviDAn । puRyAMSca sAttvikAn ganDAn sparSajAn dehasaMSritAn । CittvASu jYAnaSastreRa tapodaRqena BArata ॥60॥

text: tato duḥkhodakaṃ ghoraṃ cintāśokamahāhradam । vyādhimṛtyumahāgrāhaṃ mahābhayamahoragam ॥61॥
html:
tato duḥkhodakaṃ ghoraṃ cintāśokamahāhradam ।
vyādhimṛtyumahāgrāhaṃ mahābhayamahoragam ॥61॥
slp1: tato duHKodakaM GoraM cintASokamahAhradam । vyADimftyumahAgrAhaM mahABayamahoragam ॥61॥

text: tamaḥkūrmaṃ rajomīnaṃ prajñayā saṃtarantyuta । snehapaṅkaṃ jarādurgaṃ sparśadvīpam ariṃdama ॥62॥
html:
tamaḥkūrmaṃ rajomīnaṃ prajñayā saṃtarantyuta ।
snehapaṅkaṃ jarādurgaṃ sparśadvīpam ariṃdama ॥62॥
slp1: tamaHkUrmaM rajomInaM prajYayA saMtarantyuta । snehapaNkaM jarAdurgaM sparSadvIpam ariMdama ॥62॥

text: karmāgādhaṃ satyatīraṃ sthitavratam idaṃ nṛpa । hiṃsāśīghramahāvegaṃ nānārasamahākaram ॥63॥
html:
karmāgādhaṃ satyatīraṃ sthitavratam idaṃ nṛpa ।
hiṃsāśīghramahāvegaṃ nānārasamahākaram ॥63॥
slp1: karmAgADaM satyatIraM sTitavratam idaM nfpa । hiMsASIGramahAvegaM nAnArasamahAkaram ॥63॥

text: nānāprītimahāratnaṃ duḥkhajvarasamīraṇam । śokatṛṣṇāmahāvartaṃ tīkṣṇavyādhimahāgajam ॥64॥
html:
nānāprītimahāratnaṃ duḥkhajvarasamīraṇam ।
śokatṛṣṇāmahāvartaṃ tīkṣṇavyādhimahāgajam ॥64॥
slp1: nAnAprItimahAratnaM duHKajvarasamIraRam । SokatfzRAmahAvartaM tIkzRavyADimahAgajam ॥64॥

text: asthisaṃghātasaṃghāṭaṃ śleṣmaphenam ariṃdama । dānamuktākaraṃ bhīmaṃ śoṇitahradavidrumam ॥65॥
html:
asthisaṃghātasaṃghāṭaṃ śleṣmaphenam ariṃdama ।
dānamuktākaraṃ bhīmaṃ śoṇitahradavidrumam ॥65॥
slp1: asTisaMGAtasaMGAwaM SlezmaPenam ariMdama । dAnamuktAkaraM BImaM SoRitahradavidrumam ॥65॥

text: hasitotkruṣṭanirghoṣaṃ nānājñānasudustaram । rodanāśrumalakṣāraṃ saṅgatyāgaparāyaṇam ॥66॥
html:
hasitotkruṣṭanirghoṣaṃ nānājñānasudustaram ।
rodanāśrumalakṣāraṃ saṅgatyāgaparāyaṇam ॥66॥
slp1: hasitotkruzwanirGozaM nAnAjYAnasudustaram । rodanASrumalakzAraM saNgatyAgaparAyaRam ॥66॥

text: punar ājanmalokaughaṃ putrabāndhavapattanam । ahiṃsāsatyamaryādaṃ prāṇatyāgamahormiṇam ॥67॥
html:
punar ājanmalokaughaṃ putrabāndhavapattanam ।
ahiṃsāsatyamaryādaṃ prāṇatyāgamahormiṇam ॥67॥
slp1: punar AjanmalokOGaM putrabAnDavapattanam । ahiMsAsatyamaryAdaM prARatyAgamahormiRam ॥67॥

text: vedāntagamanadvīpaṃ sarvabhūtadayodadhim । mokṣaduṣprāpaviṣayaṃ vaḍavāmukhasāgaram ॥68॥
html:
vedāntagamanadvīpaṃ sarvabhūtadayodadhim ।
mokṣaduṣprāpaviṣayaṃ vaḍavāmukhasāgaram ॥68॥
slp1: vedAntagamanadvIpaM sarvaBUtadayodaDim । mokzaduzprApavizayaM vaqavAmuKasAgaram ॥68॥

text: taranti munayaḥ siddhā jñānayogena bhārata । tīrtvā ca dustaraṃ janma viśanti vimalaṃ nabhaḥ ॥69॥
html:
taranti munayaḥ siddhā jñānayogena bhārata ।
tīrtvā ca dustaraṃ janma viśanti vimalaṃ nabhaḥ ॥69॥
slp1: taranti munayaH sidDA jYAnayogena BArata । tIrtvA ca dustaraM janma viSanti vimalaM naBaH ॥69॥

text: tatastān sukṛtīn sāṃkhyān sūryo vahati raśmibhiḥ । padmatantuvad āviśya pravahan viṣayānnṛpa ॥70॥
html:
tatastān sukṛtīn sāṃkhyān sūryo vahati raśmibhiḥ ।
padmatantuvad āviśya pravahan viṣayānnṛpa ॥70॥
slp1: tatastAn sukftIn sAMKyAn sUryo vahati raSmiBiH । padmatantuvad AviSya pravahan vizayAnnfpa ॥70॥

text: tatra tān pravaho vāyuḥ pratigṛhṇāti bhārata । vītarāgān yatīn siddhān vīryayuktāṃstapodhanān ॥71॥
html:
tatra tān pravaho vāyuḥ pratigṛhṇāti bhārata ।
vītarāgān yatīn siddhān vīryayuktāṃstapodhanān ॥71॥
slp1: tatra tAn pravaho vAyuH pratigfhRAti BArata । vItarAgAn yatIn sidDAn vIryayuktAMstapoDanAn ॥71॥

text: sūkṣmaḥ śītaḥ sugandhī ca sukhasparśaśca bhārata । saptānāṃ marutāṃ śreṣṭho lokān gacchati yaḥ śubhān । sa tān vahati kaunteya nabhasaḥ paramāṃ gatim ॥72॥
html:
sūkṣmaḥ śītaḥ sugandhī ca sukhasparśaśca bhārata ।
saptānāṃ marutāṃ śreṣṭho lokān gacchati yaḥ śubhān ।
sa tān vahati kaunteya nabhasaḥ paramāṃ gatim ॥72॥
slp1: sUkzmaH SItaH suganDI ca suKasparSaSca BArata । saptAnAM marutAM SrezWo lokAn gacCati yaH SuBAn । sa tAn vahati kOnteya naBasaH paramAM gatim ॥72॥

text: nabho vahati lokeśa rajasaḥ paramāṃ gatim । rajo vahati rājendra sattvasya paramāṃ gatim ॥73॥
html:
nabho vahati lokeśa rajasaḥ paramāṃ gatim ।
rajo vahati rājendra sattvasya paramāṃ gatim ॥73॥
slp1: naBo vahati lokeSa rajasaH paramAM gatim । rajo vahati rAjendra sattvasya paramAM gatim ॥73॥

text: sattvaṃ vahati śuddhātman paraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum । prabhur vahati śuddhātmā paramātmānam ātmanā ॥74॥
html:
sattvaṃ vahati śuddhātman paraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
prabhur vahati śuddhātmā paramātmānam ātmanā ॥74॥
slp1: sattvaM vahati SudDAtman paraM nArAyaRaM praBum । praBur vahati SudDAtmA paramAtmAnam AtmanA ॥74॥

text: paramātmānam āsādya tadbhūtāyatanāmalāḥ । amṛtatvāya kalpante na nivartanti cābhibho । paramā sā gatiḥ pārtha nirdvaṃdvānāṃ mahātmanām ॥75॥
html:
paramātmānam āsādya tadbhūtāyatanāmalāḥ ।
amṛtatvāya kalpante na nivartanti cābhibho ।
paramā sā gatiḥ pārtha nirdvaṃdvānāṃ mahātmanām ॥75॥
slp1: paramAtmAnam AsAdya tadBUtAyatanAmalAH । amftatvAya kalpante na nivartanti cABiBo । paramA sA gatiH pArTa nirdvaMdvAnAM mahAtmanAm ॥75॥

text: sthānam uttamam āsādya bhagavantaṃ sthiravratāḥ । ājanmamaraṇaṃ vā te smarantyuta na vānagha ॥76॥
html:
sthānam uttamam āsādya bhagavantaṃ sthiravratāḥ ।
ājanmamaraṇaṃ vā te smarantyuta na vānagha ॥76॥
slp1: sTAnam uttamam AsAdya BagavantaM sTiravratAH । AjanmamaraRaM vA te smarantyuta na vAnaGa ॥76॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: yad atra tathyaṃ tanme tvaṃ yathāvad vaktum arhasi । tvad ṛte mānavaṃ nānyaṃ praṣṭum arhāmi kaurava ॥77॥
html:
yad atra tathyaṃ tanme tvaṃ yathāvad vaktum arhasi ।
tvad ṛte mānavaṃ nānyaṃ praṣṭum arhāmi kaurava ॥77॥
slp1: yad atra taTyaM tanme tvaM yaTAvad vaktum arhasi । tvad fte mAnavaM nAnyaM prazwum arhAmi kOrava ॥77॥

text: mokṣadoṣo mahān eṣa prāpya siddhiṃ gatān ṛṣīn । yadi tatraiva vijñāne vartante yatayaḥ pare ॥78॥
html:
mokṣadoṣo mahān eṣa prāpya siddhiṃ gatān ṛṣīn ।
yadi tatraiva vijñāne vartante yatayaḥ pare ॥78॥
slp1: mokzadozo mahAn eza prApya sidDiM gatAn fzIn । yadi tatrEva vijYAne vartante yatayaH pare ॥78॥

text: pravṛttilakṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ paśyāmi paramaṃ nṛpa । magnasya hi pare jñāne kiṃ nu duḥkhataraṃ bhavet ॥79॥
html:
pravṛttilakṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ paśyāmi paramaṃ nṛpa ।
magnasya hi pare jñāne kiṃ nu duḥkhataraṃ bhavet ॥79॥
slp1: pravfttilakzaRaM DarmaM paSyAmi paramaM nfpa । magnasya hi pare jYAne kiM nu duHKataraM Bavet ॥79॥

text: yathānyāyaṃ tvayā tāta praśnaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ susaṃkaṭaḥ । buddhānām api saṃmohaḥ praśne 'smin bharatarṣabha । atrāpi tattvaṃ paramaṃ śṛṇu samyaṅ mayeritam ॥80॥
html:
yathānyāyaṃ tvayā tāta praśnaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ susaṃkaṭaḥ ।
buddhānām api saṃmohaḥ praśne 'smin bharatarṣabha ।
atrāpi tattvaṃ paramaṃ śṛṇu samyaṅ mayeritam ॥80॥
slp1: yaTAnyAyaM tvayA tAta praSnaH pfzwaH susaMkawaH । budDAnAm api saMmohaH praSne 'smin BaratarzaBa । atrApi tattvaM paramaM SfRu samyaN mayeritam ॥80॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: buddhiśca paramā yatra kāpilānāṃ mahātmanām । indriyāṇyapi budhyante svadehaṃ dehino nṛpa । kāraṇānyātmanastāni sūkṣmaḥ paśyati taistu saḥ ॥81॥
html:
buddhiśca paramā yatra kāpilānāṃ mahātmanām ।
indriyāṇyapi budhyante svadehaṃ dehino nṛpa ।
kāraṇānyātmanastāni sūkṣmaḥ paśyati taistu saḥ ॥81॥
slp1: budDiSca paramA yatra kApilAnAM mahAtmanAm । indriyARyapi buDyante svadehaM dehino nfpa । kAraRAnyAtmanastAni sUkzmaH paSyati tEstu saH ॥81॥

text: ātmanā viprahīṇāni kāṣṭhakuḍyasamāni tu । vinaśyanti na saṃdehaḥ phenā iva mahārṇave ॥82॥
html:
ātmanā viprahīṇāni kāṣṭhakuḍyasamāni tu ।
vinaśyanti na saṃdehaḥ phenā iva mahārṇave ॥82॥
slp1: AtmanA viprahIRAni kAzWakuqyasamAni tu । vinaSyanti na saMdehaH PenA iva mahArRave ॥82॥

text: indriyaiḥ saha suptasya dehinaḥ śatrutāpana । sūkṣmaścarati sarvatra nabhasīva samīraṇaḥ ॥83॥
html:
indriyaiḥ saha suptasya dehinaḥ śatrutāpana ।
sūkṣmaścarati sarvatra nabhasīva samīraṇaḥ ॥83॥
slp1: indriyEH saha suptasya dehinaH SatrutApana । sUkzmaScarati sarvatra naBasIva samIraRaH ॥83॥

text: sa paśyati yathānyāyaṃ sparśān spṛśati cābhibho । budhyamāno yathāpūrvam akhileneha bhārata ॥84॥
html:
sa paśyati yathānyāyaṃ sparśān spṛśati cābhibho ।
budhyamāno yathāpūrvam akhileneha bhārata ॥84॥
slp1: sa paSyati yaTAnyAyaM sparSAn spfSati cABiBo । buDyamAno yaTApUrvam aKileneha BArata ॥84॥

text: indriyāṇīha sarvāṇi sve sve sthāne yathāvidhi । anīśatvāt pralīyante sarpā hataviṣā iva ॥85॥
html:
indriyāṇīha sarvāṇi sve sve sthāne yathāvidhi ।
anīśatvāt pralīyante sarpā hataviṣā iva ॥85॥
slp1: indriyARIha sarvARi sve sve sTAne yaTAviDi । anISatvAt pralIyante sarpA hatavizA iva ॥85॥

text: indriyāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ svasthāneṣveva sarvaśaḥ । ākramya gatayaḥ sūkṣmāścaratyātmā na saṃśayaḥ ॥86॥
html:
indriyāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ svasthāneṣveva sarvaśaḥ ।
ākramya gatayaḥ sūkṣmāścaratyātmā na saṃśayaḥ ॥86॥
slp1: indriyARAM tu sarvezAM svasTAnezveva sarvaSaH । Akramya gatayaH sUkzmAScaratyAtmA na saMSayaH ॥86॥

text: sattvasya ca guṇān kṛtsnān rajasaśca guṇān punaḥ । guṇāṃśca tamasaḥ sarvān guṇān buddheśca bhārata ॥87॥
html:
sattvasya ca guṇān kṛtsnān rajasaśca guṇān punaḥ ।
guṇāṃśca tamasaḥ sarvān guṇān buddheśca bhārata ॥87॥
slp1: sattvasya ca guRAn kftsnAn rajasaSca guRAn punaH । guRAMSca tamasaH sarvAn guRAn budDeSca BArata ॥87॥

text: guṇāṃśca manasastadvannabhasaśca guṇāṃstathā । guṇān vāyośca dharmātmaṃstejasaśca guṇān punaḥ ॥88॥
html:
guṇāṃśca manasastadvannabhasaśca guṇāṃstathā ।
guṇān vāyośca dharmātmaṃstejasaśca guṇān punaḥ ॥88॥
slp1: guRAMSca manasastadvannaBasaSca guRAMstaTA । guRAn vAyoSca DarmAtmaMstejasaSca guRAn punaH ॥88॥

text: apāṃ guṇāṃstathā pārtha pārthivāṃśca guṇān api । sarvātmanā guṇair vyāpya kṣetrajñaḥ sa yudhiṣṭhira ॥89॥
html:
apāṃ guṇāṃstathā pārtha pārthivāṃśca guṇān api ।
sarvātmanā guṇair vyāpya kṣetrajñaḥ sa yudhiṣṭhira ॥89॥
slp1: apAM guRAMstaTA pArTa pArTivAMSca guRAn api । sarvAtmanA guREr vyApya kzetrajYaH sa yuDizWira ॥89॥

text: ātmā ca yāti kṣetrajñaṃ karmaṇī ca śubhāśubhe । śiṣyā iva mahātmānam indriyāṇi ca taṃ vibho ॥90॥
html:
ātmā ca yāti kṣetrajñaṃ karmaṇī ca śubhāśubhe ।
śiṣyā iva mahātmānam indriyāṇi ca taṃ vibho ॥90॥
slp1: AtmA ca yAti kzetrajYaM karmaRI ca SuBASuBe । SizyA iva mahAtmAnam indriyARi ca taM viBo ॥90॥

text: prakṛtiṃ cāpyatikramya gacchatyātmānam avyayam । paraṃ nārāyaṇātmānaṃ nirdvaṃdvaṃ prakṛteḥ param ॥91॥
html:
prakṛtiṃ cāpyatikramya gacchatyātmānam avyayam ।
paraṃ nārāyaṇātmānaṃ nirdvaṃdvaṃ prakṛteḥ param ॥91॥
slp1: prakftiM cApyatikramya gacCatyAtmAnam avyayam । paraM nArAyaRAtmAnaM nirdvaMdvaM prakfteH param ॥91॥

text: vimuktaḥ puṇyapāpebhyaḥ praviṣṭastam anāmayam । paramātmānam aguṇaṃ na nivartati bhārata ॥92॥
html:
vimuktaḥ puṇyapāpebhyaḥ praviṣṭastam anāmayam ।
paramātmānam aguṇaṃ na nivartati bhārata ॥92॥
slp1: vimuktaH puRyapApeByaH pravizwastam anAmayam । paramAtmAnam aguRaM na nivartati BArata ॥92॥

text: śiṣṭaṃ tvatra manas tāta indriyāṇi ca bhārata । āgacchanti yathākālaṃ guroḥ saṃdeśakāriṇaḥ ॥93॥
html:
śiṣṭaṃ tvatra manas tāta indriyāṇi ca bhārata ।
āgacchanti yathākālaṃ guroḥ saṃdeśakāriṇaḥ ॥93॥
slp1: SizwaM tvatra manas tAta indriyARi ca BArata । AgacCanti yaTAkAlaM guroH saMdeSakAriRaH ॥93॥

text: śakyaṃ cālpena kālena śāntiṃ prāptuṃ guṇārthinā । evaṃ yuktena kaunteya yuktajñānena mokṣiṇā ॥94॥
html:
śakyaṃ cālpena kālena śāntiṃ prāptuṃ guṇārthinā ।
evaṃ yuktena kaunteya yuktajñānena mokṣiṇā ॥94॥
slp1: SakyaM cAlpena kAlena SAntiM prAptuM guRArTinA । evaM yuktena kOnteya yuktajYAnena mokziRA ॥94॥

text: sāṃkhyā rājanmahāprājñā gacchanti paramāṃ gatim । jñānenānena kaunteya tulyaṃ jñānaṃ na vidyate ॥95॥
html:
sāṃkhyā rājanmahāprājñā gacchanti paramāṃ gatim ।
jñānenānena kaunteya tulyaṃ jñānaṃ na vidyate ॥95॥
slp1: sAMKyA rAjanmahAprAjYA gacCanti paramAM gatim । jYAnenAnena kOnteya tulyaM jYAnaM na vidyate ॥95॥

text: atra te saṃśayo mā bhūjjñānaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ paraṃ matam । akṣaraṃ dhruvam avyaktaṃ pūrvaṃ brahma sanātanam ॥96॥
html:
atra te saṃśayo mā bhūjjñānaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ paraṃ matam ।
akṣaraṃ dhruvam avyaktaṃ pūrvaṃ brahma sanātanam ॥96॥
slp1: atra te saMSayo mA BUjjYAnaM sAMKyaM paraM matam । akzaraM Druvam avyaktaM pUrvaM brahma sanAtanam ॥96॥

text: anādimadhyanidhanaṃ nirdvaṃdvaṃ kartṛ śāśvatam । kūṭasthaṃ caiva nityaṃ ca yad vadanti śamātmakāḥ ॥97॥
html:
anādimadhyanidhanaṃ nirdvaṃdvaṃ kartṛ śāśvatam ।
kūṭasthaṃ caiva nityaṃ ca yad vadanti śamātmakāḥ ॥97॥
slp1: anAdimaDyaniDanaM nirdvaMdvaM kartf SASvatam । kUwasTaM cEva nityaM ca yad vadanti SamAtmakAH ॥97॥

text: yataḥ sarvāḥ pravartante sargapralayavikriyāḥ । yacca śaṃsanti śāstreṣu vadanti paramarṣayaḥ ॥98॥
html:
yataḥ sarvāḥ pravartante sargapralayavikriyāḥ ।
yacca śaṃsanti śāstreṣu vadanti paramarṣayaḥ ॥98॥
slp1: yataH sarvAH pravartante sargapralayavikriyAH । yacca SaMsanti SAstrezu vadanti paramarzayaH ॥98॥

text: sarve viprāśca devāśca tathāgamavido janāḥ । brahmaṇyaṃ paramaṃ devam anantaṃ parato 'cyutam ॥99॥
html:
sarve viprāśca devāśca tathāgamavido janāḥ ।
brahmaṇyaṃ paramaṃ devam anantaṃ parato 'cyutam ॥99॥
slp1: sarve viprASca devASca taTAgamavido janAH । brahmaRyaM paramaM devam anantaM parato 'cyutam ॥99॥

text: prārthayantaśca taṃ viprā vadanti guṇabuddhayaḥ । samyag yuktāstathā yogāḥ sāṃkhyāścāmitadarśanāḥ ॥100॥
html:
prārthayantaśca taṃ viprā vadanti guṇabuddhayaḥ ।
samyag yuktāstathā yogāḥ sāṃkhyāścāmitadarśanāḥ ॥100॥
slp1: prArTayantaSca taM viprA vadanti guRabudDayaH । samyag yuktAstaTA yogAH sAMKyAScAmitadarSanAH ॥100॥

text: amūrtestasya kaunteya sāṃkhyaṃ mūrtir iti śrutiḥ । abhijñānāni tasyāhur mataṃ hi bharatarṣabha ॥101॥
html:
amūrtestasya kaunteya sāṃkhyaṃ mūrtir iti śrutiḥ ।
abhijñānāni tasyāhur mataṃ hi bharatarṣabha ॥101॥
slp1: amUrtestasya kOnteya sAMKyaM mUrtir iti SrutiH । aBijYAnAni tasyAhur mataM hi BaratarzaBa ॥101॥

text: dvividhānīha bhūtāni pṛthivyāṃ pṛthivīpate । jaṅgamāgamasaṃjñāni jaṅgamaṃ tu viśiṣyate ॥102॥
html:
dvividhānīha bhūtāni pṛthivyāṃ pṛthivīpate ।
jaṅgamāgamasaṃjñāni jaṅgamaṃ tu viśiṣyate ॥102॥
slp1: dviviDAnIha BUtAni pfTivyAM pfTivIpate । jaNgamAgamasaMjYAni jaNgamaM tu viSizyate ॥102॥

text: jñānaṃ mahad yaddhi mahatsu rājan vedeṣu sāṃkhyeṣu tathaiva yoge । yaccāpi dṛṣṭaṃ vividhaṃ purāṇaṃ sāṃkhyāgataṃ tannikhilaṃ narendra ॥103॥
html:
jñānaṃ mahad yaddhi mahatsu rājan vedeṣu sāṃkhyeṣu tathaiva yoge ।
yaccāpi dṛṣṭaṃ vividhaṃ purāṇaṃ sāṃkhyāgataṃ tannikhilaṃ narendra ॥103॥
slp1: jYAnaM mahad yadDi mahatsu rAjan vedezu sAMKyezu taTEva yoge । yaccApi dfzwaM viviDaM purARaM sAMKyAgataM tanniKilaM narendra ॥103॥

text: yaccetihāseṣu mahatsu dṛṣṭaṃ yaccārthaśāstre nṛpa śiṣṭajuṣṭe । jñānaṃ ca loke yad ihāsti kiṃcit sāṃkhyāgataṃ tacca mahanmahātman ॥104॥
html:
yaccetihāseṣu mahatsu dṛṣṭaṃ yaccārthaśāstre nṛpa śiṣṭajuṣṭe ।
jñānaṃ ca loke yad ihāsti kiṃcit sāṃkhyāgataṃ tacca mahanmahātman ॥104॥
slp1: yaccetihAsezu mahatsu dfzwaM yaccArTaSAstre nfpa Sizwajuzwe । jYAnaM ca loke yad ihAsti kiMcit sAMKyAgataM tacca mahanmahAtman ॥104॥

text: śamaśca dṛṣṭaḥ paramaṃ balaṃ ca jñānaṃ ca sūkṣmaṃ ca yathāvad uktam । tapāṃsi sūkṣmāṇi sukhāni caiva sāṃkhye yathāvad vihitāni rājan ॥105॥
html:
śamaśca dṛṣṭaḥ paramaṃ balaṃ ca jñānaṃ ca sūkṣmaṃ ca yathāvad uktam ।
tapāṃsi sūkṣmāṇi sukhāni caiva sāṃkhye yathāvad vihitāni rājan ॥105॥
slp1: SamaSca dfzwaH paramaM balaM ca jYAnaM ca sUkzmaM ca yaTAvad uktam । tapAMsi sUkzmARi suKAni cEva sAMKye yaTAvad vihitAni rAjan ॥105॥

text: viparyaye tasya hi pārtha devān gacchanti sāṃkhyāḥ satataṃ sukhena । tāṃścānusaṃcārya tataḥ kṛtārthāḥ patanti vipreṣu yateṣu bhūyaḥ ॥106॥
html:
viparyaye tasya hi pārtha devān gacchanti sāṃkhyāḥ satataṃ sukhena ।
tāṃścānusaṃcārya tataḥ kṛtārthāḥ patanti vipreṣu yateṣu bhūyaḥ ॥106॥
slp1: viparyaye tasya hi pArTa devAn gacCanti sAMKyAH satataM suKena । tAMScAnusaMcArya tataH kftArTAH patanti viprezu yatezu BUyaH ॥106॥

text: hitvā ca dehaṃ praviśanti mokṣaṃ divaukaso dyām iva pārtha sāṃkhyāḥ । tato 'dhikaṃ te 'bhiratā mahārhe sāṃkhye dvijāḥ pārthiva śiṣṭajuṣṭe ॥107॥
html:
hitvā ca dehaṃ praviśanti mokṣaṃ divaukaso dyām iva pārtha sāṃkhyāḥ ।
tato 'dhikaṃ te 'bhiratā mahārhe sāṃkhye dvijāḥ pārthiva śiṣṭajuṣṭe ॥107॥
slp1: hitvA ca dehaM praviSanti mokzaM divOkaso dyAm iva pArTa sAMKyAH । tato 'DikaM te 'BiratA mahArhe sAMKye dvijAH pArTiva Sizwajuzwe ॥107॥

text: teṣāṃ na tiryaggamanaṃ hi dṛṣṭaṃ nāvāg gatiḥ pāpakṛtāṃ nivāsaḥ । na cābudhānām api te dvijātayo ye jñānam etannṛpate 'nuraktāḥ ॥108॥
html:
teṣāṃ na tiryaggamanaṃ hi dṛṣṭaṃ nāvāg gatiḥ pāpakṛtāṃ nivāsaḥ ।
na cābudhānām api te dvijātayo ye jñānam etannṛpate 'nuraktāḥ ॥108॥
slp1: tezAM na tiryaggamanaM hi dfzwaM nAvAg gatiH pApakftAM nivAsaH । na cAbuDAnAm api te dvijAtayo ye jYAnam etannfpate 'nuraktAH ॥108॥

text: sāṃkhyaṃ viśālaṃ paramaṃ purāṇaṃ mahārṇavaṃ vimalam udārakāntam । kṛtsnaṃ ca sāṃkhyaṃ nṛpate mahātmā nārāyaṇo dhārayate 'prameyam ॥109॥
html:
sāṃkhyaṃ viśālaṃ paramaṃ purāṇaṃ mahārṇavaṃ vimalam udārakāntam ।
kṛtsnaṃ ca sāṃkhyaṃ nṛpate mahātmā nārāyaṇo dhārayate 'prameyam ॥109॥
slp1: sAMKyaM viSAlaM paramaM purARaM mahArRavaM vimalam udArakAntam । kftsnaM ca sAMKyaM nfpate mahAtmA nArAyaRo DArayate 'prameyam ॥109॥

text: etanmayoktaṃ naradeva tattvaṃ nārāyaṇo viśvam idaṃ purāṇam । sa sargakāle ca karoti sargaṃ saṃhārakāle ca tad atti bhūyaḥ ॥110॥
html:
etanmayoktaṃ naradeva tattvaṃ nārāyaṇo viśvam idaṃ purāṇam ।
sa sargakāle ca karoti sargaṃ saṃhārakāle ca tad atti bhūyaḥ ॥110॥
slp1: etanmayoktaM naradeva tattvaM nArAyaRo viSvam idaM purARam । sa sargakAle ca karoti sargaM saMhArakAle ca tad atti BUyaH ॥110॥

text: kiṃ tad akṣaram ityuktaṃ yasmānnāvartate punaḥ । kiṃ ca tat kṣaram ityuktaṃ yasmād āvartate punaḥ ॥1॥
html:
kiṃ tad akṣaram ityuktaṃ yasmānnāvartate punaḥ ।
kiṃ ca tat kṣaram ityuktaṃ yasmād āvartate punaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: kiM tad akzaram ityuktaM yasmAnnAvartate punaH । kiM ca tat kzaram ityuktaM yasmAd Avartate punaH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: akṣarakṣarayor vyaktim icchāmyariniṣūdana । upalabdhuṃ mahābāho tattvena kurunandana ॥2॥
html:
akṣarakṣarayor vyaktim icchāmyariniṣūdana ।
upalabdhuṃ mahābāho tattvena kurunandana ॥2॥
slp1: akzarakzarayor vyaktim icCAmyarinizUdana । upalabDuM mahAbAho tattvena kurunandana ॥2॥

text: tvaṃ hi jñānanidhir viprair ucyase vedapāragaiḥ । ṛṣibhiśca mahābhāgair yatibhiśca mahātmabhiḥ ॥3॥
html:
tvaṃ hi jñānanidhir viprair ucyase vedapāragaiḥ ।
ṛṣibhiśca mahābhāgair yatibhiśca mahātmabhiḥ ॥3॥
slp1: tvaM hi jYAnaniDir viprEr ucyase vedapAragEH । fziBiSca mahABAgEr yatiBiSca mahAtmaBiH ॥3॥

text: śeṣam alpaṃ dinānāṃ te dakṣiṇāyanabhāskare । āvṛtte bhagavatyarke gantāsi paramāṃ gatim ॥4॥
html:
śeṣam alpaṃ dinānāṃ te dakṣiṇāyanabhāskare ।
āvṛtte bhagavatyarke gantāsi paramāṃ gatim ॥4॥
slp1: Sezam alpaM dinAnAM te dakziRAyanaBAskare । Avftte Bagavatyarke gantAsi paramAM gatim ॥4॥

text: tvayi pratigate śreyaḥ kutaḥ śroṣyāmahe vayam । kuruvaṃśapradīpastvaṃ jñānadravyeṇa dīpyase ॥5॥
html:
tvayi pratigate śreyaḥ kutaḥ śroṣyāmahe vayam ।
kuruvaṃśapradīpastvaṃ jñānadravyeṇa dīpyase ॥5॥
slp1: tvayi pratigate SreyaH kutaH SrozyAmahe vayam । kuruvaMSapradIpastvaM jYAnadravyeRa dIpyase ॥5॥

text: tad etacchrotum icchāmi tvattaḥ kurukulodvaha । na tṛpyāmīha rājendra śṛṇvann amṛtam īdṛśam ॥6॥
html:
tad etacchrotum icchāmi tvattaḥ kurukulodvaha ।
na tṛpyāmīha rājendra śṛṇvann amṛtam īdṛśam ॥6॥
slp1: tad etacCrotum icCAmi tvattaH kurukulodvaha । na tfpyAmIha rAjendra SfRvann amftam IdfSam ॥6॥

text: atra te vartayiṣye 'ham itihāsaṃ purātanam । vasiṣṭhasya ca saṃvādaṃ karālajanakasya ca ॥7॥
html:
atra te vartayiṣye 'ham itihāsaṃ purātanam ।
vasiṣṭhasya ca saṃvādaṃ karālajanakasya ca ॥7॥
slp1: atra te vartayizye 'ham itihAsaM purAtanam । vasizWasya ca saMvAdaM karAlajanakasya ca ॥7॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: vasiṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭham āsīnam ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāskaradyutim । papraccha janako rājā jñānaṃ naiḥśreyasaṃ param ॥8॥
html:
vasiṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭham āsīnam ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāskaradyutim ।
papraccha janako rājā jñānaṃ naiḥśreyasaṃ param ॥8॥
slp1: vasizWaM SrezWam AsInam fzIRAM BAskaradyutim । papracCa janako rAjA jYAnaM nEHSreyasaM param ॥8॥

text: param adhyātmakuśalam adhyātmagatiniścayam । maitrāvaruṇim āsīnam abhivādya kṛtāñjaliḥ ॥9॥
html:
param adhyātmakuśalam adhyātmagatiniścayam ।
maitrāvaruṇim āsīnam abhivādya kṛtāñjaliḥ ॥9॥
slp1: param aDyAtmakuSalam aDyAtmagatiniScayam । mEtrAvaruRim AsInam aBivAdya kftAYjaliH ॥9॥

text: svakṣaraṃ praśritaṃ vākyaṃ madhuraṃ cāpyanulbaṇam । papraccharṣivaraṃ rājā karālajanakaḥ purā ॥10॥
html:
svakṣaraṃ praśritaṃ vākyaṃ madhuraṃ cāpyanulbaṇam ।
papraccharṣivaraṃ rājā karālajanakaḥ purā ॥10॥
slp1: svakzaraM praSritaM vAkyaM maDuraM cApyanulbaRam । papracCarzivaraM rAjA karAlajanakaH purA ॥10॥

text: bhagavañ śrotum icchāmi paraṃ brahma sanātanam । yasmānna punarāvṛttim āpnuvanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥11॥
html:
bhagavañ śrotum icchāmi paraṃ brahma sanātanam ।
yasmānna punarāvṛttim āpnuvanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: BagavaY Srotum icCAmi paraM brahma sanAtanam । yasmAnna punarAvfttim Apnuvanti manIziRaH ॥11॥

text: yacca tat kṣaram ityuktaṃ yatredaṃ kṣarate jagat । yaccākṣaram iti proktaṃ śivaṃ kṣemyam anāmayam ॥12॥
html:
yacca tat kṣaram ityuktaṃ yatredaṃ kṣarate jagat ।
yaccākṣaram iti proktaṃ śivaṃ kṣemyam anāmayam ॥12॥
slp1: yacca tat kzaram ityuktaM yatredaM kzarate jagat । yaccAkzaram iti proktaM SivaM kzemyam anAmayam ॥12॥

text: śrūyatāṃ pṛthivīpāla kṣaratīdaṃ yathā jagat । yanna kṣarati pūrveṇa yāvat kālena cāpyatha ॥13॥
html:
śrūyatāṃ pṛthivīpāla kṣaratīdaṃ yathā jagat ।
yanna kṣarati pūrveṇa yāvat kālena cāpyatha ॥13॥
slp1: SrUyatAM pfTivIpAla kzaratIdaM yaTA jagat । yanna kzarati pUrveRa yAvat kAlena cApyaTa ॥13॥
author: vasiṣṭha uvāca ।

text: yugaṃ dvādaśasāhasraṃ kalpaṃ viddhi caturguṇam । daśakalpaśatāvṛttaṃ tad ahar brāhmam ucyate । rātriścaitāvatī rājan yasyānte pratibudhyate ॥14॥
html:
yugaṃ dvādaśasāhasraṃ kalpaṃ viddhi caturguṇam ।
daśakalpaśatāvṛttaṃ tad ahar brāhmam ucyate ।
rātriścaitāvatī rājan yasyānte pratibudhyate ॥14॥
slp1: yugaM dvAdaSasAhasraM kalpaM vidDi caturguRam । daSakalpaSatAvfttaM tad ahar brAhmam ucyate । rAtriScEtAvatI rAjan yasyAnte pratibuDyate ॥14॥

text: sṛjatyanantakarmāṇaṃ mahāntaṃ bhūtam agrajam । mūrtimantam amūrtātmā viśvaṃ śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃbhuvaḥ । aṇimā laghimā prāptir īśānaṃ jyotir avyayam ॥15॥
html:
sṛjatyanantakarmāṇaṃ mahāntaṃ bhūtam agrajam ।
mūrtimantam amūrtātmā viśvaṃ śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃbhuvaḥ ।
aṇimā laghimā prāptir īśānaṃ jyotir avyayam ॥15॥
slp1: sfjatyanantakarmARaM mahAntaM BUtam agrajam । mUrtimantam amUrtAtmA viSvaM SaMBuH svayaMBuvaH । aRimA laGimA prAptir ISAnaM jyotir avyayam ॥15॥

text: sarvataḥpāṇipādāntaṃ sarvato'kṣiśiromukham । sarvataḥśrutimal loke sarvam āvṛtya tiṣṭhati ॥16॥
html:
sarvataḥpāṇipādāntaṃ sarvato'kṣiśiromukham ।
sarvataḥśrutimal loke sarvam āvṛtya tiṣṭhati ॥16॥
slp1: sarvataHpARipAdAntaM sarvato'kziSiromuKam । sarvataHSrutimal loke sarvam Avftya tizWati ॥16॥

text: hiraṇyagarbho bhagavān eṣa buddhir iti smṛtaḥ । mahān iti ca yogeṣu viriñca iti cāpyuta ॥17॥
html:
hiraṇyagarbho bhagavān eṣa buddhir iti smṛtaḥ ।
mahān iti ca yogeṣu viriñca iti cāpyuta ॥17॥
slp1: hiraRyagarBo BagavAn eza budDir iti smftaH । mahAn iti ca yogezu viriYca iti cApyuta ॥17॥

text: sāṃkhye ca paṭhyate śāstre nāmabhir bahudhātmakaḥ । vicitrarūpo viśvātmā ekākṣara iti smṛtaḥ ॥18॥
html:
sāṃkhye ca paṭhyate śāstre nāmabhir bahudhātmakaḥ ।
vicitrarūpo viśvātmā ekākṣara iti smṛtaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: sAMKye ca paWyate SAstre nAmaBir bahuDAtmakaH । vicitrarUpo viSvAtmA ekAkzara iti smftaH ॥18॥

text: vṛtaṃ naikātmakaṃ yena kṛtsnaṃ trailokyam ātmanā । tathaiva bahurūpatvād viśvarūpa iti smṛtaḥ ॥19॥
html:
vṛtaṃ naikātmakaṃ yena kṛtsnaṃ trailokyam ātmanā ।
tathaiva bahurūpatvād viśvarūpa iti smṛtaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: vftaM nEkAtmakaM yena kftsnaM trElokyam AtmanA । taTEva bahurUpatvAd viSvarUpa iti smftaH ॥19॥

text: eṣa vai vikriyāpannaḥ sṛjatyātmānam ātmanā । ahaṃkāraṃ mahātejāḥ prajāpatim ahaṃkṛtam ॥20॥
html:
eṣa vai vikriyāpannaḥ sṛjatyātmānam ātmanā ।
ahaṃkāraṃ mahātejāḥ prajāpatim ahaṃkṛtam ॥20॥
slp1: eza vE vikriyApannaH sfjatyAtmAnam AtmanA । ahaMkAraM mahAtejAH prajApatim ahaMkftam ॥20॥

text: avyaktād vyaktam utpannaṃ vidyāsargaṃ vadanti tam । mahāntaṃ cāpyahaṃkāram avidyāsargam eva ca ॥21॥
html:
avyaktād vyaktam utpannaṃ vidyāsargaṃ vadanti tam ।
mahāntaṃ cāpyahaṃkāram avidyāsargam eva ca ॥21॥
slp1: avyaktAd vyaktam utpannaM vidyAsargaM vadanti tam । mahAntaM cApyahaMkAram avidyAsargam eva ca ॥21॥

text: avidhiśca vidhiścaiva samutpannau tathaikataḥ । vidyāvidyeti vikhyāte śrutiśāstrārthacintakaiḥ ॥22॥
html:
avidhiśca vidhiścaiva samutpannau tathaikataḥ ।
vidyāvidyeti vikhyāte śrutiśāstrārthacintakaiḥ ॥22॥
slp1: aviDiSca viDiScEva samutpannO taTEkataH । vidyAvidyeti viKyAte SrutiSAstrArTacintakEH ॥22॥

text: bhūtasargam ahaṃkārāt tṛtīyaṃ viddhi pārthiva । ahaṃkāreṣu bhūteṣu caturthaṃ viddhi vaikṛtam ॥23॥
html:
bhūtasargam ahaṃkārāt tṛtīyaṃ viddhi pārthiva ।
ahaṃkāreṣu bhūteṣu caturthaṃ viddhi vaikṛtam ॥23॥
slp1: BUtasargam ahaMkArAt tftIyaM vidDi pArTiva । ahaMkArezu BUtezu caturTaM vidDi vEkftam ॥23॥

text: vāyur jyotir athākāśam āpo 'tha pṛthivī tathā । śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca ॥24॥
html:
vāyur jyotir athākāśam āpo 'tha pṛthivī tathā ।
śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca ॥24॥
slp1: vAyur jyotir aTAkASam Apo 'Ta pfTivI taTA । SabdaH sparSaSca rUpaM ca raso ganDastaTEva ca ॥24॥

text: evaṃ yugapad utpannaṃ daśavargam asaṃśayam । pañcamaṃ viddhi rājendra bhautikaṃ sargam arthavat ॥25॥
html:
evaṃ yugapad utpannaṃ daśavargam asaṃśayam ।
pañcamaṃ viddhi rājendra bhautikaṃ sargam arthavat ॥25॥
slp1: evaM yugapad utpannaM daSavargam asaMSayam । paYcamaM vidDi rAjendra BOtikaM sargam arTavat ॥25॥

text: śrotraṃ tvak cakṣuṣī jihvā ghrāṇam eva ca pañcamam । vāk ca hastau ca pādau ca pāyur meḍhraṃ tathaiva ca ॥26॥
html:
śrotraṃ tvak cakṣuṣī jihvā ghrāṇam eva ca pañcamam ।
vāk ca hastau ca pādau ca pāyur meḍhraṃ tathaiva ca ॥26॥
slp1: SrotraM tvak cakzuzI jihvA GrARam eva ca paYcamam । vAk ca hastO ca pAdO ca pAyur meQraM taTEva ca ॥26॥

text: buddhīndriyāṇi caitāni tathā karmendriyāṇi ca । sambhūtānīha yugapanmanasā saha pārthiva ॥27॥
html:
buddhīndriyāṇi caitāni tathā karmendriyāṇi ca ।
sambhūtānīha yugapanmanasā saha pārthiva ॥27॥
slp1: budDIndriyARi cEtAni taTA karmendriyARi ca । samBUtAnIha yugapanmanasA saha pArTiva ॥27॥

text: eṣā tattvacaturviṃśā sarvākṛtiṣu vartate । yāṃ jñātvā nābhiśocanti brāhmaṇāstattvadarśinaḥ ॥28॥
html:
eṣā tattvacaturviṃśā sarvākṛtiṣu vartate ।
yāṃ jñātvā nābhiśocanti brāhmaṇāstattvadarśinaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: ezA tattvacaturviMSA sarvAkftizu vartate । yAM jYAtvA nABiSocanti brAhmaRAstattvadarSinaH ॥28॥

text: etad dehaṃ samākhyātaṃ trailokye sarvadehiṣu । veditavyaṃ naraśreṣṭha sadevanaradānave ॥29॥
html:
etad dehaṃ samākhyātaṃ trailokye sarvadehiṣu ।
veditavyaṃ naraśreṣṭha sadevanaradānave ॥29॥
slp1: etad dehaM samAKyAtaM trElokye sarvadehizu । veditavyaM naraSrezWa sadevanaradAnave ॥29॥

text: sayakṣabhūtagandharve sakiṃnaramahorage । sacāraṇapiśāce vai sadevarṣiniśācare ॥30॥
html:
sayakṣabhūtagandharve sakiṃnaramahorage ।
sacāraṇapiśāce vai sadevarṣiniśācare ॥30॥
slp1: sayakzaBUtaganDarve sakiMnaramahorage । sacAraRapiSAce vE sadevarziniSAcare ॥30॥

text: sadaṃśakīṭamaśake sapūtikṛmimūṣake । śuni śvapāke vaiṇeye sacaṇḍāle sapulkase ॥31॥
html:
sadaṃśakīṭamaśake sapūtikṛmimūṣake ।
śuni śvapāke vaiṇeye sacaṇḍāle sapulkase ॥31॥
slp1: sadaMSakIwamaSake sapUtikfmimUzake । Suni SvapAke vEReye sacaRqAle sapulkase ॥31॥

text: hastyaśvakharaśārdūle savṛkṣe gavi caiva ha । yacca mūrtimayaṃ kiṃcit sarvatraitannidarśanam ॥32॥
html:
hastyaśvakharaśārdūle savṛkṣe gavi caiva ha ।
yacca mūrtimayaṃ kiṃcit sarvatraitannidarśanam ॥32॥
slp1: hastyaSvaKaraSArdUle savfkze gavi cEva ha । yacca mUrtimayaM kiMcit sarvatrEtannidarSanam ॥32॥

text: jale bhuvi tathākāśe nānyatreti viniścayaḥ । sthānaṃ dehavatām asti ityevam anuśuśruma ॥33॥
html:
jale bhuvi tathākāśe nānyatreti viniścayaḥ ।
sthānaṃ dehavatām asti ityevam anuśuśruma ॥33॥
slp1: jale Buvi taTAkASe nAnyatreti viniScayaH । sTAnaM dehavatAm asti ityevam anuSuSruma ॥33॥

text: kṛtsnam etāvatastāta kṣarate vyaktasaṃjñakam । ahanyahani bhūtātmā tataḥ kṣara iti smṛtaḥ ॥34॥
html:
kṛtsnam etāvatastāta kṣarate vyaktasaṃjñakam ।
ahanyahani bhūtātmā tataḥ kṣara iti smṛtaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: kftsnam etAvatastAta kzarate vyaktasaMjYakam । ahanyahani BUtAtmA tataH kzara iti smftaH ॥34॥

text: etad akṣaram ityuktaṃ kṣaratīdaṃ yathā jagat । jaganmohātmakaṃ prāhur avyaktaṃ vyaktasaṃjñakam ॥35॥
html:
etad akṣaram ityuktaṃ kṣaratīdaṃ yathā jagat ।
jaganmohātmakaṃ prāhur avyaktaṃ vyaktasaṃjñakam ॥35॥
slp1: etad akzaram ityuktaM kzaratIdaM yaTA jagat । jaganmohAtmakaM prAhur avyaktaM vyaktasaMjYakam ॥35॥

text: mahāṃścaivāgrajo nityam etat kṣaranidarśanam । kathitaṃ te mahārāja yasmānnāvartate punaḥ ॥36॥
html:
mahāṃścaivāgrajo nityam etat kṣaranidarśanam ।
kathitaṃ te mahārāja yasmānnāvartate punaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: mahAMScEvAgrajo nityam etat kzaranidarSanam । kaTitaM te mahArAja yasmAnnAvartate punaH ॥36॥

text: pañcaviṃśatimo viṣṇur nistattvastattvasaṃjñakaḥ । tattvasaṃśrayaṇād etat tattvam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ ॥37॥
html:
pañcaviṃśatimo viṣṇur nistattvastattvasaṃjñakaḥ ।
tattvasaṃśrayaṇād etat tattvam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: paYcaviMSatimo vizRur nistattvastattvasaMjYakaH । tattvasaMSrayaRAd etat tattvam Ahur manIziRaH ॥37॥

text: yad amūrtyasṛjad vyaktaṃ tat tanmūrtyadhitiṣṭhati । caturviṃśatimo vyakto hyamūrtaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ ॥38॥
html:
yad amūrtyasṛjad vyaktaṃ tat tanmūrtyadhitiṣṭhati ।
caturviṃśatimo vyakto hyamūrtaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: yad amUrtyasfjad vyaktaM tat tanmUrtyaDitizWati । caturviMSatimo vyakto hyamUrtaH paYcaviMSakaH ॥38॥

text: sa eva hṛdi sarvāsu mūrtiṣvātiṣṭhate ''tmavān । cetayaṃścetano nityaḥ sarvamūrtir amūrtimān ॥39॥
html:
sa eva hṛdi sarvāsu mūrtiṣvātiṣṭhate ''tmavān ।
cetayaṃścetano nityaḥ sarvamūrtir amūrtimān ॥39॥
slp1: sa eva hfdi sarvAsu mUrtizvAtizWate ''tmavAn । cetayaMScetano nityaH sarvamUrtir amUrtimAn ॥39॥

text: sargapralayadharmiṇyā asargapralayātmakaḥ । gocare vartate nityaṃ nirguṇo guṇasaṃjñakaḥ ॥40॥
html:
sargapralayadharmiṇyā asargapralayātmakaḥ ।
gocare vartate nityaṃ nirguṇo guṇasaṃjñakaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: sargapralayaDarmiRyA asargapralayAtmakaH । gocare vartate nityaM nirguRo guRasaMjYakaH ॥40॥

text: evam eṣa mahān ātmā sargapralayakovidaḥ । vikurvāṇaḥ prakṛtimān abhimanyatyabuddhimān ॥41॥
html:
evam eṣa mahān ātmā sargapralayakovidaḥ ।
vikurvāṇaḥ prakṛtimān abhimanyatyabuddhimān ॥41॥
slp1: evam eza mahAn AtmA sargapralayakovidaH । vikurvARaH prakftimAn aBimanyatyabudDimAn ॥41॥

text: tamaḥsattvarajoyuktastāsu tāsviha yoniṣu । līyate 'pratibuddhatvād abuddhajanasevanāt ॥42॥
html:
tamaḥsattvarajoyuktastāsu tāsviha yoniṣu ।
līyate 'pratibuddhatvād abuddhajanasevanāt ॥42॥
slp1: tamaHsattvarajoyuktastAsu tAsviha yonizu । lIyate 'pratibudDatvAd abudDajanasevanAt ॥42॥

text: sahavāso nivāsātmā nānyo 'ham iti manyate । yo 'haṃ so 'ham iti hyuktvā guṇān anu nivartate ॥43॥
html:
sahavāso nivāsātmā nānyo 'ham iti manyate ।
yo 'haṃ so 'ham iti hyuktvā guṇān anu nivartate ॥43॥
slp1: sahavAso nivAsAtmA nAnyo 'ham iti manyate । yo 'haM so 'ham iti hyuktvA guRAn anu nivartate ॥43॥

text: tamasā tāmasān bhāvān vividhān pratipadyate । rajasā rājasāṃścaiva sāttvikān sattvasaṃśrayāt ॥44॥
html:
tamasā tāmasān bhāvān vividhān pratipadyate ।
rajasā rājasāṃścaiva sāttvikān sattvasaṃśrayāt ॥44॥
slp1: tamasA tAmasAn BAvAn viviDAn pratipadyate । rajasA rAjasAMScEva sAttvikAn sattvasaMSrayAt ॥44॥

text: śuklalohitakṛṣṇāni rūpāṇyetāni trīṇi tu । sarvāṇyetāni rūpāṇi jānīhi prākṛtāni vai ॥45॥
html:
śuklalohitakṛṣṇāni rūpāṇyetāni trīṇi tu ।
sarvāṇyetāni rūpāṇi jānīhi prākṛtāni vai ॥45॥
slp1: SuklalohitakfzRAni rUpARyetAni trIRi tu । sarvARyetAni rUpARi jAnIhi prAkftAni vE ॥45॥

text: tāmasā nirayaṃ yānti rājasā mānuṣāṃstathā । sāttvikā devalokāya gacchanti sukhabhāginaḥ ॥46॥
html:
tāmasā nirayaṃ yānti rājasā mānuṣāṃstathā ।
sāttvikā devalokāya gacchanti sukhabhāginaḥ ॥46॥
slp1: tAmasA nirayaM yAnti rAjasA mAnuzAMstaTA । sAttvikA devalokAya gacCanti suKaBAginaH ॥46॥

text: niṣkaivalyena pāpena tiryagyonim avāpnuyāt । puṇyapāpena mānuṣyaṃ puṇyenaikena devatāḥ ॥47॥
html:
niṣkaivalyena pāpena tiryagyonim avāpnuyāt ।
puṇyapāpena mānuṣyaṃ puṇyenaikena devatāḥ ॥47॥
slp1: nizkEvalyena pApena tiryagyonim avApnuyAt । puRyapApena mAnuzyaM puRyenEkena devatAH ॥47॥

text: evam avyaktaviṣayaṃ kṣaram āhur manīṣiṇaḥ । pañcaviṃśatimo yo 'yaṃ jñānād eva pravartate ॥48॥
html:
evam avyaktaviṣayaṃ kṣaram āhur manīṣiṇaḥ ।
pañcaviṃśatimo yo 'yaṃ jñānād eva pravartate ॥48॥
slp1: evam avyaktavizayaM kzaram Ahur manIziRaH । paYcaviMSatimo yo 'yaM jYAnAd eva pravartate ॥48॥

text: evam apratibuddhatvād abuddham anuvartate । dehād dehasahasrāṇi tathā samabhipadyate ॥1॥
html:
evam apratibuddhatvād abuddham anuvartate ।
dehād dehasahasrāṇi tathā samabhipadyate ॥1॥
slp1: evam apratibudDatvAd abudDam anuvartate । dehAd dehasahasrARi taTA samaBipadyate ॥1॥
author: vasiṣṭha uvāca ।

text: tiryagyonisahasreṣu kadācid devatāsvapi । upapadyati saṃyogād guṇaiḥ saha guṇakṣayāt ॥2॥
html:
tiryagyonisahasreṣu kadācid devatāsvapi ।
upapadyati saṃyogād guṇaiḥ saha guṇakṣayāt ॥2॥
slp1: tiryagyonisahasrezu kadAcid devatAsvapi । upapadyati saMyogAd guREH saha guRakzayAt ॥2॥

text: mānuṣatvād divaṃ yāti divo mānuṣyam eva ca । mānuṣyānnirayasthānam ānantyaṃ pratipadyate ॥3॥
html:
mānuṣatvād divaṃ yāti divo mānuṣyam eva ca ।
mānuṣyānnirayasthānam ānantyaṃ pratipadyate ॥3॥
slp1: mAnuzatvAd divaM yAti divo mAnuzyam eva ca । mAnuzyAnnirayasTAnam AnantyaM pratipadyate ॥3॥

text: kośakāro yathātmānaṃ kīṭaḥ samanurundhati । sūtratantuguṇair nityaṃ tathāyam aguṇo guṇaiḥ ॥4॥
html:
kośakāro yathātmānaṃ kīṭaḥ samanurundhati ।
sūtratantuguṇair nityaṃ tathāyam aguṇo guṇaiḥ ॥4॥
slp1: koSakAro yaTAtmAnaM kIwaH samanurunDati । sUtratantuguREr nityaM taTAyam aguRo guREH ॥4॥

text: dvaṃdvam eti ca nirdvaṃdvastāsu tāsviha yoniṣu । śīrṣaroge 'kṣiroge ca dantaśūle galagrahe ॥5॥
html:
