dvaṃdvam eti ca nirdvaṃdvastāsu tāsviha yoniṣu ।
śīrṣaroge 'kṣiroge ca dantaśūle galagrahe ॥5॥
slp1: dvaMdvam eti ca nirdvaMdvastAsu tAsviha yonizu । SIrzaroge 'kziroge ca dantaSUle galagrahe ॥5॥

text: jalodare 'rśasāṃ roge jvaragaṇḍaviṣūcike । śvitre kuṣṭhe 'gnidāhe ca sidhmāpasmārayor api ॥6॥
html:
jalodare 'rśasāṃ roge jvaragaṇḍaviṣūcike ।
śvitre kuṣṭhe 'gnidāhe ca sidhmāpasmārayor api ॥6॥
slp1: jalodare 'rSasAM roge jvaragaRqavizUcike । Svitre kuzWe 'gnidAhe ca siDmApasmArayor api ॥6॥

text: yāni cānyāni dvaṃdvāni prākṛtāni śarīriṣu । utpadyante vicitrāṇi tānyeṣo 'pyabhimanyate । abhimanyatyabhīmānāt tathaiva sukṛtānyapi ॥7॥
html:
yāni cānyāni dvaṃdvāni prākṛtāni śarīriṣu ।
utpadyante vicitrāṇi tānyeṣo 'pyabhimanyate ।
abhimanyatyabhīmānāt tathaiva sukṛtānyapi ॥7॥
slp1: yAni cAnyAni dvaMdvAni prAkftAni SarIrizu । utpadyante vicitrARi tAnyezo 'pyaBimanyate । aBimanyatyaBImAnAt taTEva sukftAnyapi ॥7॥

text: ekavāsāśca durvāsāḥ śāyī nityam adhastathā । maṇḍūkaśāyī ca tathā vīrāsanagatastathā ॥8॥
html:
ekavāsāśca durvāsāḥ śāyī nityam adhastathā ।
maṇḍūkaśāyī ca tathā vīrāsanagatastathā ॥8॥
slp1: ekavAsASca durvAsAH SAyI nityam aDastaTA । maRqUkaSAyI ca taTA vIrAsanagatastaTA ॥8॥

text: cīradhāraṇam ākāśe śayanaṃ sthānam eva ca । iṣṭakāprastare caiva kaṇṭakaprastare tathā ॥9॥
html:
cīradhāraṇam ākāśe śayanaṃ sthānam eva ca ।
iṣṭakāprastare caiva kaṇṭakaprastare tathā ॥9॥
slp1: cIraDAraRam AkASe SayanaM sTAnam eva ca । izwakAprastare cEva kaRwakaprastare taTA ॥9॥

text: bhasmaprastaraśāyī ca bhūmiśayyānulepanaḥ । vīrasthānāmbupaṅke ca śayanaṃ phalakeṣu ca ॥10॥
html:
bhasmaprastaraśāyī ca bhūmiśayyānulepanaḥ ।
vīrasthānāmbupaṅke ca śayanaṃ phalakeṣu ca ॥10॥
slp1: BasmaprastaraSAyI ca BUmiSayyAnulepanaH । vIrasTAnAmbupaNke ca SayanaM Palakezu ca ॥10॥

text: vividhāsu ca śayyāsu phalagṛddhyānvito 'phalaḥ । muñjamekhalanagnatvaṃ kṣaumakṛṣṇājināni ca ॥11॥
html:
vividhāsu ca śayyāsu phalagṛddhyānvito 'phalaḥ ।
muñjamekhalanagnatvaṃ kṣaumakṛṣṇājināni ca ॥11॥
slp1: viviDAsu ca SayyAsu PalagfdDyAnvito 'PalaH । muYjameKalanagnatvaM kzOmakfzRAjinAni ca ॥11॥

text: śāṇīvālaparīdhāno vyāghracarmaparicchadaḥ । siṃhacarmaparīdhānaḥ paṭṭavāsāstathaiva ca ॥12॥
html:
śāṇīvālaparīdhāno vyāghracarmaparicchadaḥ ।
siṃhacarmaparīdhānaḥ paṭṭavāsāstathaiva ca ॥12॥
slp1: SARIvAlaparIDAno vyAGracarmaparicCadaH । siMhacarmaparIDAnaH pawwavAsAstaTEva ca ॥12॥

text: kīṭakāvasanaścaiva cīravāsāstathaiva ca । vastrāṇi cānyāni bahūnyabhimanyatyabuddhimān ॥13॥
html:
kīṭakāvasanaścaiva cīravāsāstathaiva ca ।
vastrāṇi cānyāni bahūnyabhimanyatyabuddhimān ॥13॥
slp1: kIwakAvasanaScEva cIravAsAstaTEva ca । vastrARi cAnyAni bahUnyaBimanyatyabudDimAn ॥13॥

text: bhojanāni vicitrāṇi ratnāni vividhāni ca । ekavastrāntarāśitvam ekakālikabhojanam ॥14॥
html:
bhojanāni vicitrāṇi ratnāni vividhāni ca ।
ekavastrāntarāśitvam ekakālikabhojanam ॥14॥
slp1: BojanAni vicitrARi ratnAni viviDAni ca । ekavastrAntarASitvam ekakAlikaBojanam ॥14॥

text: caturthāṣṭamakālaśca ṣaṣṭhakālika eva ca । ṣaḍrātrabhojanaścaiva tathaivāṣṭāhabhojanaḥ ॥15॥
html:
caturthāṣṭamakālaśca ṣaṣṭhakālika eva ca ।
ṣaḍrātrabhojanaścaiva tathaivāṣṭāhabhojanaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: caturTAzwamakAlaSca zazWakAlika eva ca । zaqrAtraBojanaScEva taTEvAzwAhaBojanaH ॥15॥

text: saptarātradaśāhāro dvādaśāhāra eva ca । māsopavāsī mūlāśī phalāhārastathaiva ca ॥16॥
html:
saptarātradaśāhāro dvādaśāhāra eva ca ।
māsopavāsī mūlāśī phalāhārastathaiva ca ॥16॥
slp1: saptarAtradaSAhAro dvAdaSAhAra eva ca । mAsopavAsI mUlASI PalAhArastaTEva ca ॥16॥

text: vāyubhakṣo 'mbupiṇyākagomayādana eva ca । gomūtrabhojanaścaiva śākapuṣpāda eva ca ॥17॥
html:
vāyubhakṣo 'mbupiṇyākagomayādana eva ca ।
gomūtrabhojanaścaiva śākapuṣpāda eva ca ॥17॥
slp1: vAyuBakzo 'mbupiRyAkagomayAdana eva ca । gomUtraBojanaScEva SAkapuzpAda eva ca ॥17॥

text: śaivālabhojanaścaiva tathācāmena vartayan । vartayañ śīrṇaparṇaiśca prakīrṇaphalabhojanaḥ ॥18॥
html:
śaivālabhojanaścaiva tathācāmena vartayan ।
vartayañ śīrṇaparṇaiśca prakīrṇaphalabhojanaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: SEvAlaBojanaScEva taTAcAmena vartayan । vartayaY SIrRaparRESca prakIrRaPalaBojanaH ॥18॥

text: vividhāni ca kṛcchrāṇi sevate sukhakāṅkṣayā । cāndrāyaṇāni vidhival liṅgāni vividhāni ca ॥19॥
html:
vividhāni ca kṛcchrāṇi sevate sukhakāṅkṣayā ।
cāndrāyaṇāni vidhival liṅgāni vividhāni ca ॥19॥
slp1: viviDAni ca kfcCrARi sevate suKakANkzayA । cAndrAyaRAni viDival liNgAni viviDAni ca ॥19॥

text: cāturāśramyapanthānam āśrayatyāśramān api । upāsīnaśca pāṣaṇḍān guhāḥ śailāṃstathaiva ca ॥20॥
html:
cāturāśramyapanthānam āśrayatyāśramān api ।
upāsīnaśca pāṣaṇḍān guhāḥ śailāṃstathaiva ca ॥20॥
slp1: cAturASramyapanTAnam ASrayatyASramAn api । upAsInaSca pAzaRqAn guhAH SElAMstaTEva ca ॥20॥

text: viviktāśca śilāchāyāstathā prasravaṇāni ca । vividhāni ca japyāni vividhāni vratāni ca ॥21॥
html:
viviktāśca śilāchāyāstathā prasravaṇāni ca ।
vividhāni ca japyāni vividhāni vratāni ca ॥21॥
slp1: viviktASca SilACAyAstaTA prasravaRAni ca । viviDAni ca japyAni viviDAni vratAni ca ॥21॥

text: niyamān suvicitrāṃśca vividhāni tapāṃsi ca । yajñāṃśca vividhākārān vidhīṃśca vividhāṃstathā ॥22॥
html:
niyamān suvicitrāṃśca vividhāni tapāṃsi ca ।
yajñāṃśca vividhākārān vidhīṃśca vividhāṃstathā ॥22॥
slp1: niyamAn suvicitrAMSca viviDAni tapAMsi ca । yajYAMSca viviDAkArAn viDIMSca viviDAMstaTA ॥22॥

text: vaṇikpathaṃ dvijakṣatraṃ vaiśyaśūdraṃ tathaiva ca । dānaṃ ca vividhākāraṃ dīnāndhakṛpaṇeṣvapi ॥23॥
html:
vaṇikpathaṃ dvijakṣatraṃ vaiśyaśūdraṃ tathaiva ca ।
dānaṃ ca vividhākāraṃ dīnāndhakṛpaṇeṣvapi ॥23॥
slp1: vaRikpaTaM dvijakzatraM vESyaSUdraM taTEva ca । dAnaM ca viviDAkAraM dInAnDakfpaRezvapi ॥23॥

text: abhimanyatyasaṃbodhāt tathaiva trividhān guṇān । sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva dharmārthau kāma eva ca । prakṛtyātmānam evātmā evaṃ pravibhajatyuta ॥24॥
html:
abhimanyatyasaṃbodhāt tathaiva trividhān guṇān ।
sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva dharmārthau kāma eva ca ।
prakṛtyātmānam evātmā evaṃ pravibhajatyuta ॥24॥
slp1: aBimanyatyasaMboDAt taTEva triviDAn guRAn । sattvaM rajastamaScEva DarmArTO kAma eva ca । prakftyAtmAnam evAtmA evaM praviBajatyuta ॥24॥

text: svadhākāravaṣaṭkārau svāhākāranamaskriyāḥ । yājanādhyāpanaṃ dānaṃ tathaivāhuḥ pratigraham । yajanādhyayane caiva yaccānyad api kiṃcana ॥25॥
html:
svadhākāravaṣaṭkārau svāhākāranamaskriyāḥ ।
yājanādhyāpanaṃ dānaṃ tathaivāhuḥ pratigraham ।
yajanādhyayane caiva yaccānyad api kiṃcana ॥25॥
slp1: svaDAkAravazawkArO svAhAkAranamaskriyAH । yAjanADyApanaM dAnaM taTEvAhuH pratigraham । yajanADyayane cEva yaccAnyad api kiMcana ॥25॥

text: janmamṛtyuvivāde ca tathā viśasane 'pi ca । śubhāśubhamayaṃ sarvam etad āhuḥ kriyāpatham ॥26॥
html:
janmamṛtyuvivāde ca tathā viśasane 'pi ca ।
śubhāśubhamayaṃ sarvam etad āhuḥ kriyāpatham ॥26॥
slp1: janmamftyuvivAde ca taTA viSasane 'pi ca । SuBASuBamayaM sarvam etad AhuH kriyApaTam ॥26॥

text: prakṛtiḥ kurute devī mahāpralayam eva ca । divasānte guṇān etān abhyetyaiko 'vatiṣṭhati ॥27॥
html:
prakṛtiḥ kurute devī mahāpralayam eva ca ।
divasānte guṇān etān abhyetyaiko 'vatiṣṭhati ॥27॥
slp1: prakftiH kurute devI mahApralayam eva ca । divasAnte guRAn etAn aByetyEko 'vatizWati ॥27॥

text: raśmijālam ivādityastatkālena niyacchati । evam eṣo 'sakṛt sarvaṃ krīḍārtham abhimanyate ॥28॥
html:
raśmijālam ivādityastatkālena niyacchati ।
evam eṣo 'sakṛt sarvaṃ krīḍārtham abhimanyate ॥28॥
slp1: raSmijAlam ivAdityastatkAlena niyacCati । evam ezo 'sakft sarvaM krIqArTam aBimanyate ॥28॥

text: ātmarūpaguṇān etān vividhān hṛdayapriyān । evam eva vikurvāṇaḥ sargapralayakarmaṇī ॥29॥
html:
ātmarūpaguṇān etān vividhān hṛdayapriyān ।
evam eva vikurvāṇaḥ sargapralayakarmaṇī ॥29॥
slp1: AtmarUpaguRAn etAn viviDAn hfdayapriyAn । evam eva vikurvARaH sargapralayakarmaRI ॥29॥

text: kriyākriyā pathe raktastriguṇastriguṇātigaḥ । kriyākriyāpathopetastathā tad iti manyate ॥30॥
html:
kriyākriyā pathe raktastriguṇastriguṇātigaḥ ।
kriyākriyāpathopetastathā tad iti manyate ॥30॥
slp1: kriyAkriyA paTe raktastriguRastriguRAtigaH । kriyAkriyApaTopetastaTA tad iti manyate ॥30॥

text: evaṃ dvaṃdvānyathaitāni vartante mama nityaśaḥ । mamaivaitāni jāyante bādhante tāni mām iti ॥31॥
html:
evaṃ dvaṃdvānyathaitāni vartante mama nityaśaḥ ।
mamaivaitāni jāyante bādhante tāni mām iti ॥31॥
slp1: evaM dvaMdvAnyaTEtAni vartante mama nityaSaH । mamEvEtAni jAyante bADante tAni mAm iti ॥31॥

text: nistartavyānyathaitāni sarvāṇīti narādhipa । manyate 'yaṃ hyabuddhitvāt tathaiva sukṛtānyapi ॥32॥
html:
nistartavyānyathaitāni sarvāṇīti narādhipa ।
manyate 'yaṃ hyabuddhitvāt tathaiva sukṛtānyapi ॥32॥
slp1: nistartavyAnyaTEtAni sarvARIti narADipa । manyate 'yaM hyabudDitvAt taTEva sukftAnyapi ॥32॥

text: bhoktavyāni mayaitāni devalokagatena vai । ihaiva cainaṃ bhokṣyāmi śubhāśubhaphalodayam ॥33॥
html:
bhoktavyāni mayaitāni devalokagatena vai ।
ihaiva cainaṃ bhokṣyāmi śubhāśubhaphalodayam ॥33॥
slp1: BoktavyAni mayEtAni devalokagatena vE । ihEva cEnaM BokzyAmi SuBASuBaPalodayam ॥33॥

text: sukham eva ca kartavyaṃ sakṛt kṛtvā sukhaṃ mama । yāvadantaṃ ca me saukhyaṃ jātyāṃ jātyāṃ bhaviṣyati ॥34॥
html:
sukham eva ca kartavyaṃ sakṛt kṛtvā sukhaṃ mama ।
yāvadantaṃ ca me saukhyaṃ jātyāṃ jātyāṃ bhaviṣyati ॥34॥
slp1: suKam eva ca kartavyaM sakft kftvA suKaM mama । yAvadantaM ca me sOKyaM jAtyAM jAtyAM Bavizyati ॥34॥

text: bhaviṣyati ca me duḥkhaṃ kṛtenehāpyanantakam । mahad duḥkhaṃ hi mānuṣyaṃ niraye cāpi majjanam ॥35॥
html:
bhaviṣyati ca me duḥkhaṃ kṛtenehāpyanantakam ।
mahad duḥkhaṃ hi mānuṣyaṃ niraye cāpi majjanam ॥35॥
slp1: Bavizyati ca me duHKaM kftenehApyanantakam । mahad duHKaM hi mAnuzyaM niraye cApi majjanam ॥35॥

text: nirayāccāpi mānuṣyaṃ kālenaiṣyāmyahaṃ punaḥ । manuṣyatvācca devatvaṃ devatvāt pauruṣaṃ punaḥ । manuṣyatvācca nirayaṃ paryāyeṇopagacchati ॥36॥
html:
nirayāccāpi mānuṣyaṃ kālenaiṣyāmyahaṃ punaḥ ।
manuṣyatvācca devatvaṃ devatvāt pauruṣaṃ punaḥ ।
manuṣyatvācca nirayaṃ paryāyeṇopagacchati ॥36॥
slp1: nirayAccApi mAnuzyaM kAlenEzyAmyahaM punaH । manuzyatvAcca devatvaM devatvAt pOruzaM punaH । manuzyatvAcca nirayaM paryAyeRopagacCati ॥36॥

text: ya evaṃ vetti vai nityaṃ nirātmātmaguṇair vṛtaḥ । tena devamanuṣyeṣu niraye copapadyate ॥37॥
html:
ya evaṃ vetti vai nityaṃ nirātmātmaguṇair vṛtaḥ ।
tena devamanuṣyeṣu niraye copapadyate ॥37॥
slp1: ya evaM vetti vE nityaM nirAtmAtmaguREr vftaH । tena devamanuzyezu niraye copapadyate ॥37॥

text: mamatvenāvṛto nityaṃ tatraiva parivartate । sargakoṭisahasrāṇi maraṇāntāsu mūrtiṣu ॥38॥
html:
mamatvenāvṛto nityaṃ tatraiva parivartate ।
sargakoṭisahasrāṇi maraṇāntāsu mūrtiṣu ॥38॥
slp1: mamatvenAvfto nityaM tatrEva parivartate । sargakowisahasrARi maraRAntAsu mUrtizu ॥38॥

text: ya evaṃ kurute karma śubhāśubhaphalātmakam । sa eva phalam aśnāti triṣu lokeṣu mūrtimān ॥39॥
html:
ya evaṃ kurute karma śubhāśubhaphalātmakam ।
sa eva phalam aśnāti triṣu lokeṣu mūrtimān ॥39॥
slp1: ya evaM kurute karma SuBASuBaPalAtmakam । sa eva Palam aSnAti trizu lokezu mUrtimAn ॥39॥

text: prakṛtiḥ kurute karma śubhāśubhaphalātmakam । prakṛtiśca tad aśnāti triṣu lokeṣu kāmagā ॥40॥
html:
prakṛtiḥ kurute karma śubhāśubhaphalātmakam ।
prakṛtiśca tad aśnāti triṣu lokeṣu kāmagā ॥40॥
slp1: prakftiH kurute karma SuBASuBaPalAtmakam । prakftiSca tad aSnAti trizu lokezu kAmagA ॥40॥

text: tiryagyonau manuṣyatve devaloke tathaiva ca । trīṇi sthānāni caitāni jānīyāt prākṛtāni ha ॥41॥
html:
tiryagyonau manuṣyatve devaloke tathaiva ca ।
trīṇi sthānāni caitāni jānīyāt prākṛtāni ha ॥41॥
slp1: tiryagyonO manuzyatve devaloke taTEva ca । trIRi sTAnAni cEtAni jAnIyAt prAkftAni ha ॥41॥

text: aliṅgāṃ prakṛtiṃ tvāhur liṅgair anumimīmahe । tathaiva pauruṣaṃ liṅgam anumānāddhi paśyati ॥42॥
html:
aliṅgāṃ prakṛtiṃ tvāhur liṅgair anumimīmahe ।
tathaiva pauruṣaṃ liṅgam anumānāddhi paśyati ॥42॥
slp1: aliNgAM prakftiM tvAhur liNgEr anumimImahe । taTEva pOruzaM liNgam anumAnAdDi paSyati ॥42॥

text: sa liṅgāntaram āsādya prākṛtaṃ liṅgam avraṇam । vraṇadvārāṇyadhiṣṭhāya karmāṇyātmani manyate ॥43॥
html:
sa liṅgāntaram āsādya prākṛtaṃ liṅgam avraṇam ।
vraṇadvārāṇyadhiṣṭhāya karmāṇyātmani manyate ॥43॥
slp1: sa liNgAntaram AsAdya prAkftaM liNgam avraRam । vraRadvArARyaDizWAya karmARyAtmani manyate ॥43॥

text: śrotrādīni tu sarvāṇi pañca karmendriyāṇi ca । vāgādīni pravartante guṇeṣveva guṇaiḥ saha । aham etāni vai kurvanmamaitānīndriyāṇi ca ॥44॥
html:
śrotrādīni tu sarvāṇi pañca karmendriyāṇi ca ।
vāgādīni pravartante guṇeṣveva guṇaiḥ saha ।
aham etāni vai kurvanmamaitānīndriyāṇi ca ॥44॥
slp1: SrotrAdIni tu sarvARi paYca karmendriyARi ca । vAgAdIni pravartante guRezveva guREH saha । aham etAni vE kurvanmamEtAnIndriyARi ca ॥44॥

text: nirindriyo 'bhimanyeta vraṇavān asmi nirvraṇaḥ । aliṅgo liṅgam ātmānam akālaḥ kālam ātmanaḥ ॥45॥
html:
nirindriyo 'bhimanyeta vraṇavān asmi nirvraṇaḥ ।
aliṅgo liṅgam ātmānam akālaḥ kālam ātmanaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: nirindriyo 'Bimanyeta vraRavAn asmi nirvraRaH । aliNgo liNgam AtmAnam akAlaH kAlam AtmanaH ॥45॥

text: asattvaṃ sattvam ātmānam atattvaṃ tattvam ātmanaḥ । amṛtyur mṛtyum ātmānam acaraścaram ātmanaḥ ॥46॥
html:
asattvaṃ sattvam ātmānam atattvaṃ tattvam ātmanaḥ ।
amṛtyur mṛtyum ātmānam acaraścaram ātmanaḥ ॥46॥
slp1: asattvaM sattvam AtmAnam atattvaM tattvam AtmanaH । amftyur mftyum AtmAnam acaraScaram AtmanaH ॥46॥

text: akṣetraḥ kṣetram ātmānam asargaḥ sargam ātmanaḥ । atapāstapa ātmānam agatir gatim ātmanaḥ ॥47॥
html:
akṣetraḥ kṣetram ātmānam asargaḥ sargam ātmanaḥ ।
atapāstapa ātmānam agatir gatim ātmanaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: akzetraH kzetram AtmAnam asargaH sargam AtmanaH । atapAstapa AtmAnam agatir gatim AtmanaH ॥47॥

text: abhavo bhavam ātmānam abhayo bhayam ātmanaḥ । akṣaraḥ kṣaram ātmānam abuddhistvabhimanyate ॥48॥
html:
abhavo bhavam ātmānam abhayo bhayam ātmanaḥ ।
akṣaraḥ kṣaram ātmānam abuddhistvabhimanyate ॥48॥
slp1: aBavo Bavam AtmAnam aBayo Bayam AtmanaH । akzaraH kzaram AtmAnam abudDistvaBimanyate ॥48॥

text: evam apratibuddhatvād abuddhajanasevanāt । sargakoṭisahasrāṇi patanāntāni gacchati ॥1॥
html:
evam apratibuddhatvād abuddhajanasevanāt ।
sargakoṭisahasrāṇi patanāntāni gacchati ॥1॥
slp1: evam apratibudDatvAd abudDajanasevanAt । sargakowisahasrARi patanAntAni gacCati ॥1॥
author: vasiṣṭha uvāca ।

text: dhāmnā dhāmasahasrāṇi maraṇāntāni gacchati । tiryagyonau manuṣyatve devaloke tathaiva ca ॥2॥
html:
dhāmnā dhāmasahasrāṇi maraṇāntāni gacchati ।
tiryagyonau manuṣyatve devaloke tathaiva ca ॥2॥
slp1: DAmnA DAmasahasrARi maraRAntAni gacCati । tiryagyonO manuzyatve devaloke taTEva ca ॥2॥

text: candramā iva kośānāṃ punastatra sahasraśaḥ । līyate 'pratibuddhatvād evam eṣa hyabuddhimān ॥3॥
html:
candramā iva kośānāṃ punastatra sahasraśaḥ ।
līyate 'pratibuddhatvād evam eṣa hyabuddhimān ॥3॥
slp1: candramA iva koSAnAM punastatra sahasraSaH । lIyate 'pratibudDatvAd evam eza hyabudDimAn ॥3॥

text: kalāḥ pañcadaśā yonistad dhāma iti paṭhyate । nityam etad vijānīhi somaḥ ṣoḍaśamī kalā ॥4॥
html:
kalāḥ pañcadaśā yonistad dhāma iti paṭhyate ।
nityam etad vijānīhi somaḥ ṣoḍaśamī kalā ॥4॥
slp1: kalAH paYcadaSA yonistad DAma iti paWyate । nityam etad vijAnIhi somaH zoqaSamI kalA ॥4॥

text: kalāyāṃ jāyate 'jasraṃ punaḥ punar abuddhimān । dhāma tasyopayuñjanti bhūya eva tu jāyate ॥5॥
html:
kalāyāṃ jāyate 'jasraṃ punaḥ punar abuddhimān ।
dhāma tasyopayuñjanti bhūya eva tu jāyate ॥5॥
slp1: kalAyAM jAyate 'jasraM punaH punar abudDimAn । DAma tasyopayuYjanti BUya eva tu jAyate ॥5॥

text: ṣoḍaśī tu kalā sūkṣmā sa soma upadhāryatām । na tūpayujyate devair devān upayunakti sā ॥6॥
html:
ṣoḍaśī tu kalā sūkṣmā sa soma upadhāryatām ।
na tūpayujyate devair devān upayunakti sā ॥6॥
slp1: zoqaSI tu kalA sUkzmA sa soma upaDAryatAm । na tUpayujyate devEr devAn upayunakti sA ॥6॥

text: evaṃ tāṃ kṣapayitvā hi jāyate nṛpasattama । sā hyasya prakṛtir dṛṣṭā tatkṣayānmokṣa ucyate ॥7॥
html:
evaṃ tāṃ kṣapayitvā hi jāyate nṛpasattama ।
sā hyasya prakṛtir dṛṣṭā tatkṣayānmokṣa ucyate ॥7॥
slp1: evaM tAM kzapayitvA hi jAyate nfpasattama । sA hyasya prakftir dfzwA tatkzayAnmokza ucyate ॥7॥

text: tad evaṃ ṣoḍaśakalaṃ deham avyaktasaṃjñakam । mamāyam iti manvānastatraiva parivartate ॥8॥
html:
tad evaṃ ṣoḍaśakalaṃ deham avyaktasaṃjñakam ।
mamāyam iti manvānastatraiva parivartate ॥8॥
slp1: tad evaM zoqaSakalaM deham avyaktasaMjYakam । mamAyam iti manvAnastatrEva parivartate ॥8॥

text: pañcaviṃśastathaivātmā tasyaiva ā pratibodhanāt । vimalasya viśuddhasya śuddhānilaniṣevaṇāt ॥9॥
html:
pañcaviṃśastathaivātmā tasyaiva ā pratibodhanāt ।
vimalasya viśuddhasya śuddhānilaniṣevaṇāt ॥9॥
slp1: paYcaviMSastaTEvAtmA tasyEva A pratiboDanAt । vimalasya viSudDasya SudDAnilanizevaRAt ॥9॥

text: aśuddha eva śuddhātmā tādṛg bhavati pārthiva । abuddhasevanāccāpi buddho 'pyabudhatāṃ vrajet ॥10॥
html:
aśuddha eva śuddhātmā tādṛg bhavati pārthiva ।
abuddhasevanāccāpi buddho 'pyabudhatāṃ vrajet ॥10॥
slp1: aSudDa eva SudDAtmA tAdfg Bavati pArTiva । abudDasevanAccApi budDo 'pyabuDatAM vrajet ॥10॥

text: tathaivāpratibuddho 'pi jñeyo nṛpatisattama । prakṛtestriguṇāyāstu sevanāt prākṛto bhavet ॥11॥
html:
tathaivāpratibuddho 'pi jñeyo nṛpatisattama ।
prakṛtestriguṇāyāstu sevanāt prākṛto bhavet ॥11॥
slp1: taTEvApratibudDo 'pi jYeyo nfpatisattama । prakftestriguRAyAstu sevanAt prAkfto Bavet ॥11॥

text: akṣarakṣarayor eṣa dvayoḥ saṃbandha iṣyate । strīpuṃsor vāpi bhagavan saṃbandhastadvad ucyate ॥12॥
html:
akṣarakṣarayor eṣa dvayoḥ saṃbandha iṣyate ।
strīpuṃsor vāpi bhagavan saṃbandhastadvad ucyate ॥12॥
slp1: akzarakzarayor eza dvayoH saMbanDa izyate । strIpuMsor vApi Bagavan saMbanDastadvad ucyate ॥12॥
author: karālajanaka uvāca ।

text: ṛte na puruṣeṇeha strī garbhaṃ dhārayatyuta । ṛte striyaṃ na puruṣo rūpaṃ nirvartayet tathā ॥13॥
html:
ṛte na puruṣeṇeha strī garbhaṃ dhārayatyuta ।
ṛte striyaṃ na puruṣo rūpaṃ nirvartayet tathā ॥13॥
slp1: fte na puruzeReha strI garBaM DArayatyuta । fte striyaM na puruzo rUpaM nirvartayet taTA ॥13॥

text: anyonyasyābhisaṃbandhād anyonyaguṇasaṃśrayāt । rūpaṃ nirvartayatyetad evaṃ sarvāsu yoniṣu ॥14॥
html:
anyonyasyābhisaṃbandhād anyonyaguṇasaṃśrayāt ।
rūpaṃ nirvartayatyetad evaṃ sarvāsu yoniṣu ॥14॥
slp1: anyonyasyABisaMbanDAd anyonyaguRasaMSrayAt । rUpaM nirvartayatyetad evaM sarvAsu yonizu ॥14॥

text: ratyartham abhisaṃrodhād anyonyaguṇasaṃśrayāt । ṛtau nirvartate rūpaṃ tad vakṣyāmi nidarśanam ॥15॥
html:
ratyartham abhisaṃrodhād anyonyaguṇasaṃśrayāt ।
ṛtau nirvartate rūpaṃ tad vakṣyāmi nidarśanam ॥15॥
slp1: ratyarTam aBisaMroDAd anyonyaguRasaMSrayAt । ftO nirvartate rUpaM tad vakzyAmi nidarSanam ॥15॥

text: ye guṇāḥ puruṣasyeha ye ca mātṛguṇāstathā । asthi snāyu ca majjā ca jānīmaḥ pitṛto dvija ॥16॥
html:
ye guṇāḥ puruṣasyeha ye ca mātṛguṇāstathā ।
asthi snāyu ca majjā ca jānīmaḥ pitṛto dvija ॥16॥
slp1: ye guRAH puruzasyeha ye ca mAtfguRAstaTA । asTi snAyu ca majjA ca jAnImaH pitfto dvija ॥16॥

text: tvaṅ māṃsaṃ śoṇitaṃ caiva mātṛjānyapi śuśruma । evam etad dvijaśreṣṭha vedaśāstreṣu paṭhyate ॥17॥
html:
tvaṅ māṃsaṃ śoṇitaṃ caiva mātṛjānyapi śuśruma ।
evam etad dvijaśreṣṭha vedaśāstreṣu paṭhyate ॥17॥
slp1: tvaN mAMsaM SoRitaM cEva mAtfjAnyapi SuSruma । evam etad dvijaSrezWa vedaSAstrezu paWyate ॥17॥

text: pramāṇaṃ yacca vedoktaṃ śāstroktaṃ yacca paṭhyate । vedaśāstrapramāṇaṃ ca pramāṇaṃ tat sanātanam ॥18॥
html:
pramāṇaṃ yacca vedoktaṃ śāstroktaṃ yacca paṭhyate ।
vedaśāstrapramāṇaṃ ca pramāṇaṃ tat sanātanam ॥18॥
slp1: pramARaM yacca vedoktaM SAstroktaM yacca paWyate । vedaSAstrapramARaM ca pramARaM tat sanAtanam ॥18॥

text: evam evābhisaṃbaddhau nityaṃ prakṛtipūruṣau । paśyāmi bhagavaṃstasmānmokṣadharmo na vidyate ॥19॥
html:
evam evābhisaṃbaddhau nityaṃ prakṛtipūruṣau ।
paśyāmi bhagavaṃstasmānmokṣadharmo na vidyate ॥19॥
slp1: evam evABisaMbadDO nityaM prakftipUruzO । paSyAmi BagavaMstasmAnmokzaDarmo na vidyate ॥19॥

text: athavānantarakṛtaṃ kiṃcid eva nidarśanam । tanmamācakṣva tattvena pratyakṣo hyasi sarvathā ॥20॥
html:
athavānantarakṛtaṃ kiṃcid eva nidarśanam ।
tanmamācakṣva tattvena pratyakṣo hyasi sarvathā ॥20॥
slp1: aTavAnantarakftaM kiMcid eva nidarSanam । tanmamAcakzva tattvena pratyakzo hyasi sarvaTA ॥20॥

text: mokṣakāmā vayaṃ cāpi kāṅkṣāmo yad anāmayam । adeham ajaraṃ divyam atīndriyam anīśvaram ॥21॥
html:
mokṣakāmā vayaṃ cāpi kāṅkṣāmo yad anāmayam ।
adeham ajaraṃ divyam atīndriyam anīśvaram ॥21॥
slp1: mokzakAmA vayaM cApi kANkzAmo yad anAmayam । adeham ajaraM divyam atIndriyam anISvaram ॥21॥

text: yad etad uktaṃ bhavatā vedaśāstranidarśanam । evam etad yathā caitanna gṛhṇāti tathā bhavān ॥22॥
html:
yad etad uktaṃ bhavatā vedaśāstranidarśanam ।
evam etad yathā caitanna gṛhṇāti tathā bhavān ॥22॥
slp1: yad etad uktaM BavatA vedaSAstranidarSanam । evam etad yaTA cEtanna gfhRAti taTA BavAn ॥22॥
author: vasiṣṭha uvāca ।

text: dhāryate hi tvayā grantha ubhayor vedaśāstrayoḥ । na tu granthasya tattvajño yathāvat tvaṃ nareśvara ॥23॥
html:
dhāryate hi tvayā grantha ubhayor vedaśāstrayoḥ ।
na tu granthasya tattvajño yathāvat tvaṃ nareśvara ॥23॥
slp1: DAryate hi tvayA granTa uBayor vedaSAstrayoH । na tu granTasya tattvajYo yaTAvat tvaM nareSvara ॥23॥

text: yo hi vede ca śāstre ca granthadhāraṇatatparaḥ । na ca granthārthatattvajñastasya tad dhāraṇaṃ vṛthā ॥24॥
html:
yo hi vede ca śāstre ca granthadhāraṇatatparaḥ ।
na ca granthārthatattvajñastasya tad dhāraṇaṃ vṛthā ॥24॥
slp1: yo hi vede ca SAstre ca granTaDAraRatatparaH । na ca granTArTatattvajYastasya tad DAraRaM vfTA ॥24॥

text: bhāraṃ sa vahate tasya granthasyārthaṃ na vetti yaḥ । yastu granthārthatattvajño nāsya granthāgamo vṛthā ॥25॥
html:
bhāraṃ sa vahate tasya granthasyārthaṃ na vetti yaḥ ।
yastu granthārthatattvajño nāsya granthāgamo vṛthā ॥25॥
slp1: BAraM sa vahate tasya granTasyArTaM na vetti yaH । yastu granTArTatattvajYo nAsya granTAgamo vfTA ॥25॥

text: granthasyārthaṃ ca pṛṣṭaḥ saṃstādṛśo vaktum arhati । yathā tattvābhigamanād arthaṃ tasya sa vindati ॥26॥
html:
granthasyārthaṃ ca pṛṣṭaḥ saṃstādṛśo vaktum arhati ।
yathā tattvābhigamanād arthaṃ tasya sa vindati ॥26॥
slp1: granTasyArTaM ca pfzwaH saMstAdfSo vaktum arhati । yaTA tattvABigamanAd arTaM tasya sa vindati ॥26॥

text: yastu saṃsatsu kathayed granthārthaṃ sthūlabuddhimān । sa kathaṃ mandavijñāno granthaṃ vakṣyati nirṇayāt ॥27॥
html:
yastu saṃsatsu kathayed granthārthaṃ sthūlabuddhimān ।
sa kathaṃ mandavijñāno granthaṃ vakṣyati nirṇayāt ॥27॥
slp1: yastu saMsatsu kaTayed granTArTaM sTUlabudDimAn । sa kaTaM mandavijYAno granTaM vakzyati nirRayAt ॥27॥

text: nirṇayaṃ cāpi chidrātmā na taṃ vakṣyati tattvataḥ । sopahāsātmatām eti yasmāccaivātmavān api ॥28॥
html:
nirṇayaṃ cāpi chidrātmā na taṃ vakṣyati tattvataḥ ।
sopahāsātmatām eti yasmāccaivātmavān api ॥28॥
slp1: nirRayaM cApi CidrAtmA na taM vakzyati tattvataH । sopahAsAtmatAm eti yasmAccEvAtmavAn api ॥28॥

text: tasmāt tvaṃ śṛṇu rājendra yathaitad anudṛśyate । yāthātathyena sāṃkhyeṣu yogeṣu ca mahātmasu ॥29॥
html:
tasmāt tvaṃ śṛṇu rājendra yathaitad anudṛśyate ।
yāthātathyena sāṃkhyeṣu yogeṣu ca mahātmasu ॥29॥
slp1: tasmAt tvaM SfRu rAjendra yaTEtad anudfSyate । yATAtaTyena sAMKyezu yogezu ca mahAtmasu ॥29॥

text: yad eva yogāḥ paśyanti sāṃkhyaistad anugamyate । ekaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa buddhimān ॥30॥
html:
yad eva yogāḥ paśyanti sāṃkhyaistad anugamyate ।
ekaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa buddhimān ॥30॥
slp1: yad eva yogAH paSyanti sAMKyEstad anugamyate । ekaM sAMKyaM ca yogaM ca yaH paSyati sa budDimAn ॥30॥

text: tvaṅ māṃsaṃ rudhiraṃ medaḥ pittaṃ majjāsthi snāyu ca । etad aindriyakaṃ tāta yad bhavān idam āha vai ॥31॥
html:
tvaṅ māṃsaṃ rudhiraṃ medaḥ pittaṃ majjāsthi snāyu ca ।
etad aindriyakaṃ tāta yad bhavān idam āha vai ॥31॥
slp1: tvaN mAMsaM ruDiraM medaH pittaM majjAsTi snAyu ca । etad EndriyakaM tAta yad BavAn idam Aha vE ॥31॥

text: dravyād dravyasya niṣpattir indriyād indriyaṃ tathā । dehād deham avāpnoti bījād bījaṃ tathaiva ca ॥32॥
html:
dravyād dravyasya niṣpattir indriyād indriyaṃ tathā ।
dehād deham avāpnoti bījād bījaṃ tathaiva ca ॥32॥
slp1: dravyAd dravyasya nizpattir indriyAd indriyaM taTA । dehAd deham avApnoti bIjAd bIjaM taTEva ca ॥32॥

text: nirindriyasyābījasya nirdravyasyāsya dehinaḥ । kathaṃ guṇā bhaviṣyanti nirguṇatvānmahātmanaḥ ॥33॥
html:
nirindriyasyābījasya nirdravyasyāsya dehinaḥ ।
kathaṃ guṇā bhaviṣyanti nirguṇatvānmahātmanaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: nirindriyasyAbIjasya nirdravyasyAsya dehinaH । kaTaM guRA Bavizyanti nirguRatvAnmahAtmanaH ॥33॥

text: guṇā guṇeṣu jāyante tatraiva niviśanti ca । evaṃ guṇāḥ prakṛtito jāyante ca na santi ca ॥34॥
html:
guṇā guṇeṣu jāyante tatraiva niviśanti ca ।
evaṃ guṇāḥ prakṛtito jāyante ca na santi ca ॥34॥
slp1: guRA guRezu jAyante tatrEva niviSanti ca । evaM guRAH prakftito jAyante ca na santi ca ॥34॥

text: tvaṅ māṃsaṃ rudhiraṃ medaḥ pittaṃ majjāsthi snāyu ca । aṣṭau tānyatha śukreṇa jānīhi prākṛtāni vai ॥35॥
html:
tvaṅ māṃsaṃ rudhiraṃ medaḥ pittaṃ majjāsthi snāyu ca ।
aṣṭau tānyatha śukreṇa jānīhi prākṛtāni vai ॥35॥
slp1: tvaN mAMsaM ruDiraM medaH pittaM majjAsTi snAyu ca । azwO tAnyaTa SukreRa jAnIhi prAkftAni vE ॥35॥

text: pumāṃścaivāpumāṃścaiva trailiṅgyaṃ prākṛtaṃ smṛtam । naiva pumān pumāṃścaiva sa liṅgītyabhidhīyate ॥36॥
html:
pumāṃścaivāpumāṃścaiva trailiṅgyaṃ prākṛtaṃ smṛtam ।
naiva pumān pumāṃścaiva sa liṅgītyabhidhīyate ॥36॥
slp1: pumAMScEvApumAMScEva trEliNgyaM prAkftaM smftam । nEva pumAn pumAMScEva sa liNgItyaBiDIyate ॥36॥

text: aliṅgā prakṛtir liṅgair upalabhyati sātmajaiḥ । yathā puṣpaphalair nityam ṛtavo mūrtayastathā ॥37॥
html:
aliṅgā prakṛtir liṅgair upalabhyati sātmajaiḥ ।
yathā puṣpaphalair nityam ṛtavo mūrtayastathā ॥37॥
slp1: aliNgA prakftir liNgEr upalaByati sAtmajEH । yaTA puzpaPalEr nityam ftavo mUrtayastaTA ॥37॥

text: evam apyanumānena hyaliṅgam upalabhyate । pañcaviṃśatimastāta liṅgeṣvaniyatātmakaḥ ॥38॥
html:
evam apyanumānena hyaliṅgam upalabhyate ।
pañcaviṃśatimastāta liṅgeṣvaniyatātmakaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: evam apyanumAnena hyaliNgam upalaByate । paYcaviMSatimastAta liNgezvaniyatAtmakaH ॥38॥

text: anādinidhano 'nantaḥ sarvadarśī nirāmayaḥ । kevalaṃ tvabhimānitvād guṇeṣvaguṇa ucyate ॥39॥
html:
anādinidhano 'nantaḥ sarvadarśī nirāmayaḥ ।
kevalaṃ tvabhimānitvād guṇeṣvaguṇa ucyate ॥39॥
slp1: anAdiniDano 'nantaH sarvadarSI nirAmayaH । kevalaM tvaBimAnitvAd guRezvaguRa ucyate ॥39॥

text: guṇā guṇavataḥ santi nirguṇasya kuto guṇāḥ । tasmād evaṃ vijānanti ye janā guṇadarśinaḥ ॥40॥
html:
guṇā guṇavataḥ santi nirguṇasya kuto guṇāḥ ।
tasmād evaṃ vijānanti ye janā guṇadarśinaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: guRA guRavataH santi nirguRasya kuto guRAH । tasmAd evaM vijAnanti ye janA guRadarSinaH ॥40॥

text: yadā tveṣa guṇān sarvān prākṛtān abhimanyate । tadā sa guṇavān eva parameṇānupaśyati ॥41॥
html:
yadā tveṣa guṇān sarvān prākṛtān abhimanyate ।
tadā sa guṇavān eva parameṇānupaśyati ॥41॥
slp1: yadA tveza guRAn sarvAn prAkftAn aBimanyate । tadA sa guRavAn eva parameRAnupaSyati ॥41॥

text: yat tad buddheḥ paraṃ prāhuḥ sāṃkhyā yogāśca sarvaśaḥ । budhyamānaṃ mahāprājñam abuddhaparivarjanāt ॥42॥
html:
yat tad buddheḥ paraṃ prāhuḥ sāṃkhyā yogāśca sarvaśaḥ ।
budhyamānaṃ mahāprājñam abuddhaparivarjanāt ॥42॥
slp1: yat tad budDeH paraM prAhuH sAMKyA yogASca sarvaSaH । buDyamAnaM mahAprAjYam abudDaparivarjanAt ॥42॥

text: aprabuddham athāvyaktaṃ saguṇaṃ prāhur īśvaram । nirguṇaṃ ceśvaraṃ nityam adhiṣṭhātāram eva ca ॥43॥
html:
aprabuddham athāvyaktaṃ saguṇaṃ prāhur īśvaram ।
nirguṇaṃ ceśvaraṃ nityam adhiṣṭhātāram eva ca ॥43॥
slp1: aprabudDam aTAvyaktaM saguRaM prAhur ISvaram । nirguRaM ceSvaraM nityam aDizWAtAram eva ca ॥43॥

text: prakṛteśca guṇānāṃ ca pañcaviṃśatikaṃ budhāḥ । sāṃkhyayoge ca kuśalā budhyante paramaiṣiṇaḥ ॥44॥
html:
prakṛteśca guṇānāṃ ca pañcaviṃśatikaṃ budhāḥ ।
sāṃkhyayoge ca kuśalā budhyante paramaiṣiṇaḥ ॥44॥
slp1: prakfteSca guRAnAM ca paYcaviMSatikaM buDAH । sAMKyayoge ca kuSalA buDyante paramEziRaH ॥44॥

text: yadā prabuddhāstvavyaktam avasthājanmabhīravaḥ । budhyamānaṃ prabudhyanti gamayanti samaṃ tadā ॥45॥
html:
yadā prabuddhāstvavyaktam avasthājanmabhīravaḥ ।
budhyamānaṃ prabudhyanti gamayanti samaṃ tadā ॥45॥
slp1: yadA prabudDAstvavyaktam avasTAjanmaBIravaH । buDyamAnaM prabuDyanti gamayanti samaM tadA ॥45॥

text: etannidarśanaṃ samyag asamyag anudarśanam । budhyamānāprabuddhābhyāṃ pṛthak pṛthag ariṃdama ॥46॥
html:
etannidarśanaṃ samyag asamyag anudarśanam ।
budhyamānāprabuddhābhyāṃ pṛthak pṛthag ariṃdama ॥46॥
slp1: etannidarSanaM samyag asamyag anudarSanam । buDyamAnAprabudDAByAM pfTak pfTag ariMdama ॥46॥

text: paraspareṇaitad uktaṃ kṣarākṣaranidarśanam । ekatvam akṣaraṃ prāhur nānātvaṃ kṣaram ucyate ॥47॥
html:
paraspareṇaitad uktaṃ kṣarākṣaranidarśanam ।
ekatvam akṣaraṃ prāhur nānātvaṃ kṣaram ucyate ॥47॥
slp1: paraspareREtad uktaM kzarAkzaranidarSanam । ekatvam akzaraM prAhur nAnAtvaM kzaram ucyate ॥47॥

text: pañcaviṃśatiniṣṭho 'yaṃ yadāsamyak pravartate । ekatvaṃ darśanaṃ cāsya nānātvaṃ cāpyadarśanam ॥48॥
html:
pañcaviṃśatiniṣṭho 'yaṃ yadāsamyak pravartate ।
ekatvaṃ darśanaṃ cāsya nānātvaṃ cāpyadarśanam ॥48॥
slp1: paYcaviMSatinizWo 'yaM yadAsamyak pravartate । ekatvaM darSanaM cAsya nAnAtvaM cApyadarSanam ॥48॥

text: tattvanistattvayor etat pṛthag eva nidarśanam । pañcaviṃśatisargaṃ tu tattvam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ ॥49॥
html:
tattvanistattvayor etat pṛthag eva nidarśanam ।
pañcaviṃśatisargaṃ tu tattvam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: tattvanistattvayor etat pfTag eva nidarSanam । paYcaviMSatisargaM tu tattvam Ahur manIziRaH ॥49॥

text: nistattvaṃ pañcaviṃśasya param āhur nidarśanam । vargasya vargam ācāraṃ tattvaṃ tattvāt sanātanam ॥50॥
html:
nistattvaṃ pañcaviṃśasya param āhur nidarśanam ।
vargasya vargam ācāraṃ tattvaṃ tattvāt sanātanam ॥50॥
slp1: nistattvaM paYcaviMSasya param Ahur nidarSanam । vargasya vargam AcAraM tattvaM tattvAt sanAtanam ॥50॥

text: nānātvaikatvam ityuktaṃ tvayaitad ṛṣisattama । paśyāmi cābhisaṃdigdham etayor vai nidarśanam ॥1॥
html:
nānātvaikatvam ityuktaṃ tvayaitad ṛṣisattama ।
paśyāmi cābhisaṃdigdham etayor vai nidarśanam ॥1॥
slp1: nAnAtvEkatvam ityuktaM tvayEtad fzisattama । paSyAmi cABisaMdigDam etayor vE nidarSanam ॥1॥
author: karālajanaka uvāca ।

text: tathāprabuddhabuddhābhyāṃ budhyamānasya cānagha । sthūlabuddhyā na paśyāmi tattvam etanna saṃśayaḥ ॥2॥
html:
tathāprabuddhabuddhābhyāṃ budhyamānasya cānagha ।
sthūlabuddhyā na paśyāmi tattvam etanna saṃśayaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: taTAprabudDabudDAByAM buDyamAnasya cAnaGa । sTUlabudDyA na paSyAmi tattvam etanna saMSayaH ॥2॥

text: akṣarakṣarayor uktaṃ tvayā yad api kāraṇam । tad apyasthirabuddhitvāt pranaṣṭam iva me 'nagha ॥3॥
html:
akṣarakṣarayor uktaṃ tvayā yad api kāraṇam ।
tad apyasthirabuddhitvāt pranaṣṭam iva me 'nagha ॥3॥
slp1: akzarakzarayor uktaM tvayA yad api kAraRam । tad apyasTirabudDitvAt pranazwam iva me 'naGa ॥3॥

text: tad etacchrotum icchāmi nānātvaikatvadarśanam । buddham apratibuddhaṃ ca budhyamānaṃ ca tattvataḥ ॥4॥
html:
tad etacchrotum icchāmi nānātvaikatvadarśanam ।
buddham apratibuddhaṃ ca budhyamānaṃ ca tattvataḥ ॥4॥
slp1: tad etacCrotum icCAmi nAnAtvEkatvadarSanam । budDam apratibudDaM ca buDyamAnaM ca tattvataH ॥4॥

text: vidyāvidye ca bhagavann akṣaraṃ kṣaram eva ca । sāṃkhyaṃ yogaṃ ca kārtsnyena pṛthak caivāpṛthak ca ha ॥5॥
html:
vidyāvidye ca bhagavann akṣaraṃ kṣaram eva ca ।
sāṃkhyaṃ yogaṃ ca kārtsnyena pṛthak caivāpṛthak ca ha ॥5॥
slp1: vidyAvidye ca Bagavann akzaraM kzaram eva ca । sAMKyaM yogaM ca kArtsnyena pfTak cEvApfTak ca ha ॥5॥

text: hanta te sampravakṣyāmi yad etad anupṛcchasi । yogakṛtyaṃ mahārāja pṛthag eva śṛṇuṣva me ॥6॥
html:
hanta te sampravakṣyāmi yad etad anupṛcchasi ।
yogakṛtyaṃ mahārāja pṛthag eva śṛṇuṣva me ॥6॥
slp1: hanta te sampravakzyAmi yad etad anupfcCasi । yogakftyaM mahArAja pfTag eva SfRuzva me ॥6॥
author: vasiṣṭha uvāca ।

text: yogakṛtyaṃ tu yogānāṃ dhyānam eva paraṃ balam । taccāpi dvividhaṃ dhyānam āhur vedavido janāḥ ॥7॥
html:
yogakṛtyaṃ tu yogānāṃ dhyānam eva paraṃ balam ।
taccāpi dvividhaṃ dhyānam āhur vedavido janāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: yogakftyaM tu yogAnAM DyAnam eva paraM balam । taccApi dviviDaM DyAnam Ahur vedavido janAH ॥7॥

text: ekāgratā ca manasaḥ prāṇāyāmastathaiva ca । prāṇāyāmastu saguṇo nirguṇo manasastathā ॥8॥
html:
ekāgratā ca manasaḥ prāṇāyāmastathaiva ca ।
prāṇāyāmastu saguṇo nirguṇo manasastathā ॥8॥
slp1: ekAgratA ca manasaH prARAyAmastaTEva ca । prARAyAmastu saguRo nirguRo manasastaTA ॥8॥

text: mūtrotsarge purīṣe ca bhojane ca narādhipa । trikālaṃ nābhiyuñjīta śeṣaṃ yuñjīta tatparaḥ ॥9॥
html:
mūtrotsarge purīṣe ca bhojane ca narādhipa ।
trikālaṃ nābhiyuñjīta śeṣaṃ yuñjīta tatparaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: mUtrotsarge purIze ca Bojane ca narADipa । trikAlaM nABiyuYjIta SezaM yuYjIta tatparaH ॥9॥

text: indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyo nivartya manasā muniḥ । daśadvādaśabhir vāpi caturviṃśāt paraṃ tataḥ ॥10॥
html:
indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyo nivartya manasā muniḥ ।
daśadvādaśabhir vāpi caturviṃśāt paraṃ tataḥ ॥10॥
slp1: indriyARIndriyArTeByo nivartya manasA muniH । daSadvAdaSaBir vApi caturviMSAt paraM tataH ॥10॥

text: taṃ codanābhir matimān ātmānaṃ codayed atha । tiṣṭhantam ajaraṃ taṃ tu yat tad uktaṃ manīṣibhiḥ ॥11॥
html:
taṃ codanābhir matimān ātmānaṃ codayed atha ।
tiṣṭhantam ajaraṃ taṃ tu yat tad uktaṃ manīṣibhiḥ ॥11॥
slp1: taM codanABir matimAn AtmAnaM codayed aTa । tizWantam ajaraM taM tu yat tad uktaM manIziBiH ॥11॥

text: taiścātmā satataṃ jñeya ityevam anuśuśruma । dravyaṃ hyahīnamanaso nānyatheti viniścayaḥ ॥12॥
html:
taiścātmā satataṃ jñeya ityevam anuśuśruma ।
dravyaṃ hyahīnamanaso nānyatheti viniścayaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: tEScAtmA satataM jYeya ityevam anuSuSruma । dravyaM hyahInamanaso nAnyaTeti viniScayaH ॥12॥

text: vimuktaḥ sarvasaṅgebhyo laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ । pūrvarātre pare caiva dhārayeta mano 'tmani ॥13॥
html:
vimuktaḥ sarvasaṅgebhyo laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ ।
pūrvarātre pare caiva dhārayeta mano 'tmani ॥13॥
slp1: vimuktaH sarvasaNgeByo laGvAhAro jitendriyaH । pUrvarAtre pare cEva DArayeta mano 'tmani ॥13॥

text: sthirīkṛtyendriyagrāmaṃ manasā mithileśvara । mano buddhyā sthiraṃ kṛtvā pāṣāṇa iva niścalaḥ ॥14॥
html:
sthirīkṛtyendriyagrāmaṃ manasā mithileśvara ।
mano buddhyā sthiraṃ kṛtvā pāṣāṇa iva niścalaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: sTirIkftyendriyagrAmaM manasA miTileSvara । mano budDyA sTiraM kftvA pAzARa iva niScalaH ॥14॥

text: sthāṇuvaccāpyakampaḥ syād girivaccāpi niścalaḥ । budhā vidhividhānajñāstadā yuktaṃ pracakṣate ॥15॥
html:
sthāṇuvaccāpyakampaḥ syād girivaccāpi niścalaḥ ।
budhā vidhividhānajñāstadā yuktaṃ pracakṣate ॥15॥
slp1: sTARuvaccApyakampaH syAd girivaccApi niScalaH । buDA viDiviDAnajYAstadA yuktaM pracakzate ॥15॥

text: na śṛṇoti na cāghrāti na rasyati na paśyati । na ca sparśaṃ vijānāti na saṃkalpayate manaḥ ॥16॥
html:
na śṛṇoti na cāghrāti na rasyati na paśyati ।
na ca sparśaṃ vijānāti na saṃkalpayate manaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: na SfRoti na cAGrAti na rasyati na paSyati । na ca sparSaM vijAnAti na saMkalpayate manaH ॥16॥

text: na cābhimanyate kiṃcinna ca budhyati kāṣṭhavat । tadā prakṛtim āpannaṃ yuktam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ ॥17॥
html:
na cābhimanyate kiṃcinna ca budhyati kāṣṭhavat ।
tadā prakṛtim āpannaṃ yuktam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: na cABimanyate kiMcinna ca buDyati kAzWavat । tadA prakftim ApannaM yuktam Ahur manIziRaH ॥17॥

text: nivāte ca yathā dīpyan dīpastadvat sa dṛśyate । niriṅgaścācalaścordhvaṃ na tiryaggatim āpnuyāt ॥18॥
html:
nivāte ca yathā dīpyan dīpastadvat sa dṛśyate ।
niriṅgaścācalaścordhvaṃ na tiryaggatim āpnuyāt ॥18॥
slp1: nivAte ca yaTA dIpyan dIpastadvat sa dfSyate । niriNgaScAcalaScorDvaM na tiryaggatim ApnuyAt ॥18॥

text: tadā tam anupaśyeta yasmin dṛṣṭe tu kathyate । hṛdayastho 'ntarātmeti jñeyo jñastāta madvidhaiḥ ॥19॥
html:
tadā tam anupaśyeta yasmin dṛṣṭe tu kathyate ।
hṛdayastho 'ntarātmeti jñeyo jñastāta madvidhaiḥ ॥19॥
slp1: tadA tam anupaSyeta yasmin dfzwe tu kaTyate । hfdayasTo 'ntarAtmeti jYeyo jYastAta madviDEH ॥19॥

text: vidhūma iva saptārcir āditya iva raśmimān । vaidyuto 'gnir ivākāśe dṛśyate 'tmā tathātmani ॥20॥
html:
vidhūma iva saptārcir āditya iva raśmimān ।
vaidyuto 'gnir ivākāśe dṛśyate 'tmā tathātmani ॥20॥
slp1: viDUma iva saptArcir Aditya iva raSmimAn । vEdyuto 'gnir ivAkASe dfSyate 'tmA taTAtmani ॥20॥

text: yaṃ paśyanti mahātmāno dhṛtimanto manīṣiṇaḥ । brāhmaṇā brahmayoniṣṭhā hyayonim amṛtātmakam ॥21॥
html:
yaṃ paśyanti mahātmāno dhṛtimanto manīṣiṇaḥ ।
brāhmaṇā brahmayoniṣṭhā hyayonim amṛtātmakam ॥21॥
slp1: yaM paSyanti mahAtmAno Dftimanto manIziRaH । brAhmaRA brahmayonizWA hyayonim amftAtmakam ॥21॥

text: tad evāhur aṇubhyo 'ṇu tanmahadbhyo mahattaram । tadantaḥ sarvabhūteṣu dhruvaṃ tiṣṭhanna dṛśyate ॥22॥
html:
tad evāhur aṇubhyo 'ṇu tanmahadbhyo mahattaram ।
tadantaḥ sarvabhūteṣu dhruvaṃ tiṣṭhanna dṛśyate ॥22॥
slp1: tad evAhur aRuByo 'Ru tanmahadByo mahattaram । tadantaH sarvaBUtezu DruvaM tizWanna dfSyate ॥22॥

text: buddhidravyeṇa dṛśyeta manodīpena lokakṛt । mahatastamasastāta pāre tiṣṭhann atāmasaḥ ॥23॥
html:
buddhidravyeṇa dṛśyeta manodīpena lokakṛt ।
mahatastamasastāta pāre tiṣṭhann atāmasaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: budDidravyeRa dfSyeta manodIpena lokakft । mahatastamasastAta pAre tizWann atAmasaH ॥23॥

text: sa tamonuda ityuktastattvajñair vedapāragaiḥ । vimalo vitamaskaśca nirliṅgo 'liṅgasaṃjñitaḥ ॥24॥
html:
sa tamonuda ityuktastattvajñair vedapāragaiḥ ।
vimalo vitamaskaśca nirliṅgo 'liṅgasaṃjñitaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: sa tamonuda ityuktastattvajYEr vedapAragEH । vimalo vitamaskaSca nirliNgo 'liNgasaMjYitaH ॥24॥

text: yogam etaddhi yogānāṃ manye yogasya lakṣaṇam । evaṃ paśyaṃ prapaśyanti ātmānam ajaraṃ param ॥25॥
html:
yogam etaddhi yogānāṃ manye yogasya lakṣaṇam ।
evaṃ paśyaṃ prapaśyanti ātmānam ajaraṃ param ॥25॥
slp1: yogam etadDi yogAnAM manye yogasya lakzaRam । evaM paSyaM prapaSyanti AtmAnam ajaraM param ॥25॥

text: yogadarśanam etāvad uktaṃ te tattvato mayā । sāṃkhyajñānaṃ pravakṣyāmi parisaṃkhyānidarśanam ॥26॥
html:
yogadarśanam etāvad uktaṃ te tattvato mayā ।
sāṃkhyajñānaṃ pravakṣyāmi parisaṃkhyānidarśanam ॥26॥
slp1: yogadarSanam etAvad uktaM te tattvato mayA । sAMKyajYAnaM pravakzyAmi parisaMKyAnidarSanam ॥26॥

text: avyaktam āhuḥ prakṛtiṃ parāṃ prakṛtivādinaḥ । tasmānmahat samutpannaṃ dvitīyaṃ rājasattama ॥27॥
html:
avyaktam āhuḥ prakṛtiṃ parāṃ prakṛtivādinaḥ ।
tasmānmahat samutpannaṃ dvitīyaṃ rājasattama ॥27॥
slp1: avyaktam AhuH prakftiM parAM prakftivAdinaH । tasmAnmahat samutpannaM dvitIyaM rAjasattama ॥27॥

text: ahaṃkārastu mahatastṛtīyam iti naḥ śrutam । pañca bhūtānyahaṃkārād āhuḥ sāṃkhyānudarśinaḥ ॥28॥
html:
ahaṃkārastu mahatastṛtīyam iti naḥ śrutam ।
pañca bhūtānyahaṃkārād āhuḥ sāṃkhyānudarśinaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: ahaMkArastu mahatastftIyam iti naH Srutam । paYca BUtAnyahaMkArAd AhuH sAMKyAnudarSinaH ॥28॥

text: etāḥ prakṛtayastvaṣṭau vikārāścāpi ṣoḍaśa । pañca caiva viśeṣā vai tathā pañcendriyāṇi ca ॥29॥
html:
etāḥ prakṛtayastvaṣṭau vikārāścāpi ṣoḍaśa ।
pañca caiva viśeṣā vai tathā pañcendriyāṇi ca ॥29॥
slp1: etAH prakftayastvazwO vikArAScApi zoqaSa । paYca cEva viSezA vE taTA paYcendriyARi ca ॥29॥

text: etāvad eva tattvānāṃ sāṃkhyam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ । sāṃkhye vidhividhānajñā nityaṃ sāṃkhyapathe ratāḥ ॥30॥
html:
etāvad eva tattvānāṃ sāṃkhyam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ ।
sāṃkhye vidhividhānajñā nityaṃ sāṃkhyapathe ratāḥ ॥30॥
slp1: etAvad eva tattvAnAM sAMKyam Ahur manIziRaH । sAMKye viDiviDAnajYA nityaM sAMKyapaTe ratAH ॥30॥

text: yasmād yad abhijāyeta tat tatraiva pralīyate । līyante pratilomāni sṛjyante cāntarātmanā ॥31॥
html:
yasmād yad abhijāyeta tat tatraiva pralīyate ।
līyante pratilomāni sṛjyante cāntarātmanā ॥31॥
slp1: yasmAd yad aBijAyeta tat tatrEva pralIyate । lIyante pratilomAni sfjyante cAntarAtmanA ॥31॥

text: anulomena jāyante līyante pratilomataḥ । guṇā guṇeṣu satataṃ sāgarasyormayo yathā ॥32॥
html:
anulomena jāyante līyante pratilomataḥ ।
guṇā guṇeṣu satataṃ sāgarasyormayo yathā ॥32॥
slp1: anulomena jAyante lIyante pratilomataH । guRA guRezu satataM sAgarasyormayo yaTA ॥32॥

text: sargapralaya etāvān prakṛter nṛpasattama । ekatvaṃ pralaye cāsya bahutvaṃ ca yadāsṛjat । evam eva ca rājendra vijñeyaṃ jñeyacintakaiḥ ॥33॥
html:
sargapralaya etāvān prakṛter nṛpasattama ।
ekatvaṃ pralaye cāsya bahutvaṃ ca yadāsṛjat ।
evam eva ca rājendra vijñeyaṃ jñeyacintakaiḥ ॥33॥
slp1: sargapralaya etAvAn prakfter nfpasattama । ekatvaM pralaye cAsya bahutvaM ca yadAsfjat । evam eva ca rAjendra vijYeyaM jYeyacintakEH ॥33॥

text: adhiṣṭhātāram avyaktam asyāpyetannidarśanam । ekatvaṃ ca bahutvaṃ ca prakṛter anu tattvavān । ekatvaṃ pralaye cāsya bahutvaṃ ca pravartanāt ॥34॥
html:
adhiṣṭhātāram avyaktam asyāpyetannidarśanam ।
ekatvaṃ ca bahutvaṃ ca prakṛter anu tattvavān ।
ekatvaṃ pralaye cāsya bahutvaṃ ca pravartanāt ॥34॥
slp1: aDizWAtAram avyaktam asyApyetannidarSanam । ekatvaM ca bahutvaM ca prakfter anu tattvavAn । ekatvaM pralaye cAsya bahutvaM ca pravartanAt ॥34॥

text: bahudhātmā prakurvīta prakṛtiṃ prasavātmikām । tacca kṣetraṃ mahān ātmā pañcaviṃśo 'dhitiṣṭhati ॥35॥
html:
bahudhātmā prakurvīta prakṛtiṃ prasavātmikām ।
tacca kṣetraṃ mahān ātmā pañcaviṃśo 'dhitiṣṭhati ॥35॥
slp1: bahuDAtmA prakurvIta prakftiM prasavAtmikAm । tacca kzetraM mahAn AtmA paYcaviMSo 'DitizWati ॥35॥

text: adhiṣṭhāteti rājendra procyate yatisattamaiḥ । adhiṣṭhānād adhiṣṭhātā kṣetrāṇām iti naḥ śrutam ॥36॥
html:
adhiṣṭhāteti rājendra procyate yatisattamaiḥ ।
adhiṣṭhānād adhiṣṭhātā kṣetrāṇām iti naḥ śrutam ॥36॥
slp1: aDizWAteti rAjendra procyate yatisattamEH । aDizWAnAd aDizWAtA kzetrARAm iti naH Srutam ॥36॥

text: kṣetraṃ jānāti cāvyaktaṃ kṣetrajña iti cocyate । avyaktike pure śete puruṣaśceti kathyate ॥37॥
html:
kṣetraṃ jānāti cāvyaktaṃ kṣetrajña iti cocyate ।
avyaktike pure śete puruṣaśceti kathyate ॥37॥
slp1: kzetraM jAnAti cAvyaktaM kzetrajYa iti cocyate । avyaktike pure Sete puruzaSceti kaTyate ॥37॥

text: anyad eva ca kṣetraṃ syād anyaḥ kṣetrajña ucyate । kṣetram avyaktam ityuktaṃ jñātā vai pañcaviṃśakaḥ ॥38॥
html:
anyad eva ca kṣetraṃ syād anyaḥ kṣetrajña ucyate ।
kṣetram avyaktam ityuktaṃ jñātā vai pañcaviṃśakaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: anyad eva ca kzetraM syAd anyaH kzetrajYa ucyate । kzetram avyaktam ityuktaM jYAtA vE paYcaviMSakaH ॥38॥

text: anyad eva ca jñānaṃ syād anyajjñeyaṃ tad ucyate । jñānam avyaktam ityuktaṃ jñeyo vai pañcaviṃśakaḥ ॥39॥
html:
anyad eva ca jñānaṃ syād anyajjñeyaṃ tad ucyate ।
jñānam avyaktam ityuktaṃ jñeyo vai pañcaviṃśakaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: anyad eva ca jYAnaM syAd anyajjYeyaM tad ucyate । jYAnam avyaktam ityuktaM jYeyo vE paYcaviMSakaH ॥39॥

text: avyaktaṃ kṣetram ityuktaṃ tathā sattvaṃ tatheśvaram । anīśvaram atattvaṃ ca tattvaṃ tat pañcaviṃśakam ॥40॥
html:
avyaktaṃ kṣetram ityuktaṃ tathā sattvaṃ tatheśvaram ।
anīśvaram atattvaṃ ca tattvaṃ tat pañcaviṃśakam ॥40॥
slp1: avyaktaM kzetram ityuktaM taTA sattvaM taTeSvaram । anISvaram atattvaM ca tattvaM tat paYcaviMSakam ॥40॥

text: sāṃkhyadarśanam etāvat parisaṃkhyānadarśanam । sāṃkhyaṃ prakurute caiva prakṛtiṃ ca pracakṣate ॥41॥
html:
sāṃkhyadarśanam etāvat parisaṃkhyānadarśanam ।
sāṃkhyaṃ prakurute caiva prakṛtiṃ ca pracakṣate ॥41॥
slp1: sAMKyadarSanam etAvat parisaMKyAnadarSanam । sAMKyaM prakurute cEva prakftiM ca pracakzate ॥41॥

text: tattvāni ca caturviṃśat parisaṃkhyāya tattvataḥ । sāṃkhyāḥ saha prakṛtyā tu nistattvaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ ॥42॥
html:
tattvāni ca caturviṃśat parisaṃkhyāya tattvataḥ ।
sāṃkhyāḥ saha prakṛtyā tu nistattvaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: tattvAni ca caturviMSat parisaMKyAya tattvataH । sAMKyAH saha prakftyA tu nistattvaH paYcaviMSakaH ॥42॥

text: pañcaviṃśo 'prabuddhātmā budhyamāna iti smṛtaḥ । yadā tu budhyate 'tmānaṃ tadā bhavati kevalaḥ ॥43॥
html:
pañcaviṃśo 'prabuddhātmā budhyamāna iti smṛtaḥ ।
yadā tu budhyate 'tmānaṃ tadā bhavati kevalaḥ ॥43॥
slp1: paYcaviMSo 'prabudDAtmA buDyamAna iti smftaH । yadA tu buDyate 'tmAnaM tadA Bavati kevalaH ॥43॥

text: samyag darśanam etāvad bhāṣitaṃ tava tattvataḥ । evam etad vijānantaḥ sāmyatāṃ pratiyāntyuta ॥44॥
html:
samyag darśanam etāvad bhāṣitaṃ tava tattvataḥ ।
evam etad vijānantaḥ sāmyatāṃ pratiyāntyuta ॥44॥
slp1: samyag darSanam etAvad BAzitaM tava tattvataH । evam etad vijAnantaH sAmyatAM pratiyAntyuta ॥44॥

text: samyaṅ nidarśanaṃ nāma pratyakṣaṃ prakṛtestathā । guṇatattvānyathaitāni nirguṇo 'nyastathā bhavet ॥45॥
html:
samyaṅ nidarśanaṃ nāma pratyakṣaṃ prakṛtestathā ।
guṇatattvānyathaitāni nirguṇo 'nyastathā bhavet ॥45॥
slp1: samyaN nidarSanaM nAma pratyakzaM prakftestaTA । guRatattvAnyaTEtAni nirguRo 'nyastaTA Bavet ॥45॥

text: na tvevaṃ vartamānānām āvṛttir vidyate punaḥ । vidyate 'kṣarabhāvatvād aparasparam avyayam ॥46॥
html:
na tvevaṃ vartamānānām āvṛttir vidyate punaḥ ।
vidyate 'kṣarabhāvatvād aparasparam avyayam ॥46॥
slp1: na tvevaM vartamAnAnAm Avfttir vidyate punaH । vidyate 'kzaraBAvatvAd aparasparam avyayam ॥46॥

text: paśyerann ekamatayo na samyak teṣu darśanam । te 'vyaktaṃ pratipadyante punaḥ punar ariṃdama ॥47॥
html:
paśyerann ekamatayo na samyak teṣu darśanam ।
te 'vyaktaṃ pratipadyante punaḥ punar ariṃdama ॥47॥
slp1: paSyerann ekamatayo na samyak tezu darSanam । te 'vyaktaM pratipadyante punaH punar ariMdama ॥47॥

text: sarvam etad vijānanto na sarvasya prabodhanāt । vyaktībhūtā bhaviṣyanti vyaktasya vaśavartinaḥ ॥48॥
html:
sarvam etad vijānanto na sarvasya prabodhanāt ।
vyaktībhūtā bhaviṣyanti vyaktasya vaśavartinaḥ ॥48॥
slp1: sarvam etad vijAnanto na sarvasya praboDanAt । vyaktIBUtA Bavizyanti vyaktasya vaSavartinaH ॥48॥

text: sarvam avyaktam ityuktam asarvaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ । ya enam abhijānanti na bhayaṃ teṣu vidyate ॥49॥
html:
sarvam avyaktam ityuktam asarvaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ ।
ya enam abhijānanti na bhayaṃ teṣu vidyate ॥49॥
slp1: sarvam avyaktam ityuktam asarvaH paYcaviMSakaH । ya enam aBijAnanti na BayaM tezu vidyate ॥49॥

text: sāṃkhyadarśanam etāvad uktaṃ te nṛpasattama । vidyāvidye tvidānīṃ me tvaṃ nibodhānupūrvaśaḥ ॥1॥
html:
sāṃkhyadarśanam etāvad uktaṃ te nṛpasattama ।
vidyāvidye tvidānīṃ me tvaṃ nibodhānupūrvaśaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: sAMKyadarSanam etAvad uktaM te nfpasattama । vidyAvidye tvidAnIM me tvaM niboDAnupUrvaSaH ॥1॥
author: vasiṣṭha uvāca ।

text: avidyām āhur avyaktaṃ sargapralayadharmi vai । sargapralayanirmuktaṃ vidyāṃ vai pañcaviṃśakam ॥2॥
html:
avidyām āhur avyaktaṃ sargapralayadharmi vai ।
sargapralayanirmuktaṃ vidyāṃ vai pañcaviṃśakam ॥2॥
slp1: avidyAm Ahur avyaktaM sargapralayaDarmi vE । sargapralayanirmuktaM vidyAM vE paYcaviMSakam ॥2॥

text: parasparam avidyāṃ vai tannibodhānupūrvaśaḥ । yathoktam ṛṣibhistāta sāṃkhyasyāsya nidarśanam ॥3॥
html:
parasparam avidyāṃ vai tannibodhānupūrvaśaḥ ।
yathoktam ṛṣibhistāta sāṃkhyasyāsya nidarśanam ॥3॥
slp1: parasparam avidyAM vE tanniboDAnupUrvaSaH । yaToktam fziBistAta sAMKyasyAsya nidarSanam ॥3॥

text: karmendriyāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ vidyā buddhīndriyaṃ smṛtam । buddhīndriyāṇāṃ ca tathā viśeṣā iti naḥ śrutam ॥4॥
html:
karmendriyāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ vidyā buddhīndriyaṃ smṛtam ।
buddhīndriyāṇāṃ ca tathā viśeṣā iti naḥ śrutam ॥4॥
slp1: karmendriyARAM sarvezAM vidyA budDIndriyaM smftam । budDIndriyARAM ca taTA viSezA iti naH Srutam ॥4॥

text: viśeṣāṇāṃ manasteṣāṃ vidyām āhur manīṣiṇaḥ । manasaḥ pañcabhūtāni vidyā ityabhicakṣate ॥5॥
html:
viśeṣāṇāṃ manasteṣāṃ vidyām āhur manīṣiṇaḥ ।
manasaḥ pañcabhūtāni vidyā ityabhicakṣate ॥5॥
slp1: viSezARAM manastezAM vidyAm Ahur manIziRaH । manasaH paYcaBUtAni vidyA ityaBicakzate ॥5॥

text: ahaṃkārastu bhūtānāṃ pañcānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ । ahaṃkārasya ca tathā buddhir vidyā nareśvara ॥6॥
html:
ahaṃkārastu bhūtānāṃ pañcānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
ahaṃkārasya ca tathā buddhir vidyā nareśvara ॥6॥
slp1: ahaMkArastu BUtAnAM paYcAnAM nAtra saMSayaH । ahaMkArasya ca taTA budDir vidyA nareSvara ॥6॥

text: buddheḥ prakṛtir avyaktaṃ tattvānāṃ parameśvaram । vidyā jñeyā naraśreṣṭha vidhiśca paramaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥7॥
html:
buddheḥ prakṛtir avyaktaṃ tattvānāṃ parameśvaram ।
vidyā jñeyā naraśreṣṭha vidhiśca paramaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: budDeH prakftir avyaktaM tattvAnAM parameSvaram । vidyA jYeyA naraSrezWa viDiSca paramaH smftaH ॥7॥

text: avyaktasya paraṃ prāhur vidyāṃ vai pañcaviṃśakam । sarvasya sarvam ityuktaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānasya pārthiva ॥8॥
html:
avyaktasya paraṃ prāhur vidyāṃ vai pañcaviṃśakam ।
sarvasya sarvam ityuktaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānasya pārthiva ॥8॥
slp1: avyaktasya paraM prAhur vidyAM vE paYcaviMSakam । sarvasya sarvam ityuktaM jYeyaM jYAnasya pArTiva ॥8॥

text: jñānam avyaktam ityuktaṃ jñeyaṃ vai pañcaviṃśakam । tathaiva jñānam avyaktaṃ vijñātā pañcaviṃśakaḥ ॥9॥
html:
jñānam avyaktam ityuktaṃ jñeyaṃ vai pañcaviṃśakam ।
tathaiva jñānam avyaktaṃ vijñātā pañcaviṃśakaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: jYAnam avyaktam ityuktaM jYeyaM vE paYcaviMSakam । taTEva jYAnam avyaktaM vijYAtA paYcaviMSakaH ॥9॥

text: vidyāvidyārthatattvena mayoktaṃ te viśeṣataḥ । akṣaraṃ ca kṣaraṃ caiva yad uktaṃ tannibodha me ॥10॥
html:
vidyāvidyārthatattvena mayoktaṃ te viśeṣataḥ ।
akṣaraṃ ca kṣaraṃ caiva yad uktaṃ tannibodha me ॥10॥
slp1: vidyAvidyArTatattvena mayoktaM te viSezataH । akzaraM ca kzaraM cEva yad uktaM tanniboDa me ॥10॥

text: ubhāvetau kṣarāvuktāvubhāvetau ca na kṣarau । kāraṇaṃ tu pravakṣyāmi yathā khyātau tu tattvataḥ ॥11॥
html:
ubhāvetau kṣarāvuktāvubhāvetau ca na kṣarau ।
kāraṇaṃ tu pravakṣyāmi yathā khyātau tu tattvataḥ ॥11॥
slp1: uBAvetO kzarAvuktAvuBAvetO ca na kzarO । kAraRaM tu pravakzyAmi yaTA KyAtO tu tattvataH ॥11॥

text: anādinidhanāvetāvubhāveveśvarau matau । tattvasaṃjñāvubhāvetau procyete jñānacintakaiḥ ॥12॥
html:
anādinidhanāvetāvubhāveveśvarau matau ।
tattvasaṃjñāvubhāvetau procyete jñānacintakaiḥ ॥12॥
slp1: anAdiniDanAvetAvuBAveveSvarO matO । tattvasaMjYAvuBAvetO procyete jYAnacintakEH ॥12॥

text: sargapralayadharmitvād avyaktaṃ prāhur akṣaram । tad etad guṇasargāya vikurvāṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ॥13॥
html:
sargapralayadharmitvād avyaktaṃ prāhur akṣaram ।
tad etad guṇasargāya vikurvāṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: sargapralayaDarmitvAd avyaktaM prAhur akzaram । tad etad guRasargAya vikurvARaM punaH punaH ॥13॥

text: guṇānāṃ mahadādīnām utpadyati parasparam । adhiṣṭhānāt kṣetram āhur etat tat pañcaviṃśakam ॥14॥
html:
guṇānāṃ mahadādīnām utpadyati parasparam ।
adhiṣṭhānāt kṣetram āhur etat tat pañcaviṃśakam ॥14॥
slp1: guRAnAM mahadAdInAm utpadyati parasparam । aDizWAnAt kzetram Ahur etat tat paYcaviMSakam ॥14॥

text: yadā tu guṇajālaṃ tad avyaktātmani saṃkṣipet । tadā saha guṇaistaistu pañcaviṃśo vilīyate ॥15॥
html:
yadā tu guṇajālaṃ tad avyaktātmani saṃkṣipet ।
tadā saha guṇaistaistu pañcaviṃśo vilīyate ॥15॥
slp1: yadA tu guRajAlaM tad avyaktAtmani saMkzipet । tadA saha guREstEstu paYcaviMSo vilIyate ॥15॥

text: guṇā guṇeṣu līyante tadaikā prakṛtir bhavet । kṣetrajño 'pi yadā tāta tatkṣetre sampralīyate ॥16॥
html:
guṇā guṇeṣu līyante tadaikā prakṛtir bhavet ।
kṣetrajño 'pi yadā tāta tatkṣetre sampralīyate ॥16॥
slp1: guRA guRezu lIyante tadEkA prakftir Bavet । kzetrajYo 'pi yadA tAta tatkzetre sampralIyate ॥16॥

text: tadākṣaratvaṃ prakṛtir gacchate guṇasaṃjñitā । nirguṇatvaṃ ca vaideha guṇeṣu prativartanāt ॥17॥
html:
tadākṣaratvaṃ prakṛtir gacchate guṇasaṃjñitā ।
nirguṇatvaṃ ca vaideha guṇeṣu prativartanāt ॥17॥
slp1: tadAkzaratvaM prakftir gacCate guRasaMjYitA । nirguRatvaM ca vEdeha guRezu prativartanAt ॥17॥

text: evam eva ca kṣetrajñaḥ kṣetrajñānaparikṣaye । prakṛtyā nirguṇastveṣa ityevam anuśuśruma ॥18॥
html:
evam eva ca kṣetrajñaḥ kṣetrajñānaparikṣaye ।
prakṛtyā nirguṇastveṣa ityevam anuśuśruma ॥18॥
slp1: evam eva ca kzetrajYaH kzetrajYAnaparikzaye । prakftyA nirguRastveza ityevam anuSuSruma ॥18॥

text: kṣaro bhavatyeṣa yadā tadā guṇavatīm atha । prakṛtiṃ tvabhijānāti nirguṇatvaṃ tathātmanaḥ ॥19॥
html:
kṣaro bhavatyeṣa yadā tadā guṇavatīm atha ।
prakṛtiṃ tvabhijānāti nirguṇatvaṃ tathātmanaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: kzaro Bavatyeza yadA tadA guRavatIm aTa । prakftiM tvaBijAnAti nirguRatvaM taTAtmanaH ॥19॥

text: tadā viśuddho bhavati prakṛteḥ parivarjanāt । anyo 'ham anyeyam iti yadā budhyati buddhimān ॥20॥
html:
tadā viśuddho bhavati prakṛteḥ parivarjanāt ।
anyo 'ham anyeyam iti yadā budhyati buddhimān ॥20॥
slp1: tadA viSudDo Bavati prakfteH parivarjanAt । anyo 'ham anyeyam iti yadA buDyati budDimAn ॥20॥

text: tadaiṣo 'nyatvatām eti na ca miśratvam āvrajet । prakṛtyā caiva rājendra namiśro 'nyaśca dṛśyate ॥21॥
html:
tadaiṣo 'nyatvatām eti na ca miśratvam āvrajet ।
prakṛtyā caiva rājendra namiśro 'nyaśca dṛśyate ॥21॥
slp1: tadEzo 'nyatvatAm eti na ca miSratvam Avrajet । prakftyA cEva rAjendra namiSro 'nyaSca dfSyate ॥21॥

text: yadā tu guṇajālaṃ tat prākṛtaṃ vijugupsate । paśyate cāparaṃ paśyaṃ tadā paśyanna saṃjvaret ॥22॥
html:
yadā tu guṇajālaṃ tat prākṛtaṃ vijugupsate ।
paśyate cāparaṃ paśyaṃ tadā paśyanna saṃjvaret ॥22॥
slp1: yadA tu guRajAlaM tat prAkftaM vijugupsate । paSyate cAparaM paSyaM tadA paSyanna saMjvaret ॥22॥

text: kiṃ mayā kṛtam etāvad yo 'haṃ kālam imaṃ janam । matsyo jālaṃ hyavijñānād anuvartitavāṃstathā ॥23॥
html:
kiṃ mayā kṛtam etāvad yo 'haṃ kālam imaṃ janam ।
matsyo jālaṃ hyavijñānād anuvartitavāṃstathā ॥23॥
slp1: kiM mayA kftam etAvad yo 'haM kAlam imaM janam । matsyo jAlaM hyavijYAnAd anuvartitavAMstaTA ॥23॥

text: aham eva hi saṃmohād anyam anyaṃ janājjanam । matsyo yathodakajñānād anuvartitavān iha ॥24॥
html:
aham eva hi saṃmohād anyam anyaṃ janājjanam ।
matsyo yathodakajñānād anuvartitavān iha ॥24॥
slp1: aham eva hi saMmohAd anyam anyaM janAjjanam । matsyo yaTodakajYAnAd anuvartitavAn iha ॥24॥

text: matsyo 'nyatvaṃ yathājñānād udakānnābhimanyate । ātmānaṃ tadvad ajñānād anyatvaṃ caiva vedmyaham ॥25॥
html:
matsyo 'nyatvaṃ yathājñānād udakānnābhimanyate ।
ātmānaṃ tadvad ajñānād anyatvaṃ caiva vedmyaham ॥25॥
slp1: matsyo 'nyatvaM yaTAjYAnAd udakAnnABimanyate । AtmAnaM tadvad ajYAnAd anyatvaM cEva vedmyaham ॥25॥

text: mamāstu dhig abuddhasya yo 'haṃ magnam imaṃ punaḥ । anuvartitavānmohād anyam anyaṃ janājjanam ॥26॥
html:
mamāstu dhig abuddhasya yo 'haṃ magnam imaṃ punaḥ ।
anuvartitavānmohād anyam anyaṃ janājjanam ॥26॥
slp1: mamAstu Dig abudDasya yo 'haM magnam imaM punaH । anuvartitavAnmohAd anyam anyaM janAjjanam ॥26॥

text: ayam atra bhaved bandhur anena saha mokṣaṇam । sāmyam ekatvam āyāto yādṛśastādṛśastvaham ॥27॥
html:
ayam atra bhaved bandhur anena saha mokṣaṇam ।
sāmyam ekatvam āyāto yādṛśastādṛśastvaham ॥27॥
slp1: ayam atra Baved banDur anena saha mokzaRam । sAmyam ekatvam AyAto yAdfSastAdfSastvaham ॥27॥

text: tulyatām iha paśyāmi sadṛśo 'ham anena vai । ayaṃ hi vimalo vyaktam aham īdṛśakastathā ॥28॥
html:
tulyatām iha paśyāmi sadṛśo 'ham anena vai ।
ayaṃ hi vimalo vyaktam aham īdṛśakastathā ॥28॥
slp1: tulyatAm iha paSyAmi sadfSo 'ham anena vE । ayaM hi vimalo vyaktam aham IdfSakastaTA ॥28॥

text: yo 'ham ajñānasaṃmohād ajñayā sampravṛttavān । sasaṅgayāhaṃ niḥsaṅgaḥ sthitaḥ kālam imaṃ tvaham ॥29॥
html:
yo 'ham ajñānasaṃmohād ajñayā sampravṛttavān ।
sasaṅgayāhaṃ niḥsaṅgaḥ sthitaḥ kālam imaṃ tvaham ॥29॥
slp1: yo 'ham ajYAnasaMmohAd ajYayA sampravfttavAn । sasaNgayAhaM niHsaNgaH sTitaH kAlam imaM tvaham ॥29॥

text: anayāhaṃ vaśībhūtaḥ kālam etaṃ na buddhavān । uccamadhyamanīcānāṃ tām ahaṃ katham āvase ॥30॥
html:
anayāhaṃ vaśībhūtaḥ kālam etaṃ na buddhavān ।
uccamadhyamanīcānāṃ tām ahaṃ katham āvase ॥30॥
slp1: anayAhaM vaSIBUtaH kAlam etaM na budDavAn । uccamaDyamanIcAnAM tAm ahaM kaTam Avase ॥30॥

text: samānayānayā ceha sahavāsam ahaṃ katham । gacchāmyabuddhabhāvatvād eṣedānīṃ sthiro bhave ॥31॥
html:
samānayānayā ceha sahavāsam ahaṃ katham ।
gacchāmyabuddhabhāvatvād eṣedānīṃ sthiro bhave ॥31॥
slp1: samAnayAnayA ceha sahavAsam ahaM kaTam । gacCAmyabudDaBAvatvAd ezedAnIM sTiro Bave ॥31॥

text: sahavāsaṃ na yāsyāmi kālam etaddhi vañcanāt । vañcito 'smyanayā yaddhi nirvikāro vikārayā ॥32॥
html:
sahavāsaṃ na yāsyāmi kālam etaddhi vañcanāt ।
vañcito 'smyanayā yaddhi nirvikāro vikārayā ॥32॥
slp1: sahavAsaM na yAsyAmi kAlam etadDi vaYcanAt । vaYcito 'smyanayA yadDi nirvikAro vikArayA ॥32॥

text: na cāyam aparādho 'syā aparādho hyayaṃ mama । yo 'ham atrābhavaṃ saktaḥ parāṅmukham upasthitaḥ ॥33॥
html:
na cāyam aparādho 'syā aparādho hyayaṃ mama ।
yo 'ham atrābhavaṃ saktaḥ parāṅmukham upasthitaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: na cAyam aparADo 'syA aparADo hyayaM mama । yo 'ham atrABavaM saktaH parANmuKam upasTitaH ॥33॥

text: tato 'smi bahurūpāsu sthito mūrtiṣvamūrtimān । amūrtaścāpi mūrtātmā mamatvena pradharṣitaḥ ॥34॥
html:
tato 'smi bahurūpāsu sthito mūrtiṣvamūrtimān ।
amūrtaścāpi mūrtātmā mamatvena pradharṣitaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: tato 'smi bahurUpAsu sTito mUrtizvamUrtimAn । amUrtaScApi mUrtAtmA mamatvena praDarzitaH ॥34॥

text: prakṛter anayatvena tāsu tāsviha yoniṣu । nirmamasya mamatvena kiṃ kṛtaṃ tāsu tāsu ca । yonīṣu vartamānena naṣṭasaṃjñena cetasā ॥35॥
html:
prakṛter anayatvena tāsu tāsviha yoniṣu ।
nirmamasya mamatvena kiṃ kṛtaṃ tāsu tāsu ca ।
yonīṣu vartamānena naṣṭasaṃjñena cetasā ॥35॥
slp1: prakfter anayatvena tAsu tAsviha yonizu । nirmamasya mamatvena kiM kftaM tAsu tAsu ca । yonIzu vartamAnena nazwasaMjYena cetasA ॥35॥

text: na mamātrānayā kāryam ahaṃkārakṛtātmayā । ātmānaṃ bahudhā kṛtvā yeyaṃ bhūyo yunakti mām । idānīm eṣa buddho 'smi nirmamo nirahaṃkṛtaḥ ॥36॥
html:
na mamātrānayā kāryam ahaṃkārakṛtātmayā ।
ātmānaṃ bahudhā kṛtvā yeyaṃ bhūyo yunakti mām ।
idānīm eṣa buddho 'smi nirmamo nirahaṃkṛtaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: na mamAtrAnayA kAryam ahaMkArakftAtmayA । AtmAnaM bahuDA kftvA yeyaM BUyo yunakti mAm । idAnIm eza budDo 'smi nirmamo nirahaMkftaH ॥36॥

text: mamatvam anayā nityam ahaṃkārakṛtātmakam । apetyāham imāṃ hitvā saṃśrayiṣye nirāmayam ॥37॥
html:
mamatvam anayā nityam ahaṃkārakṛtātmakam ।
apetyāham imāṃ hitvā saṃśrayiṣye nirāmayam ॥37॥
slp1: mamatvam anayA nityam ahaMkArakftAtmakam । apetyAham imAM hitvA saMSrayizye nirAmayam ॥37॥

text: anena sāmyaṃ yāsyāmi nānayāham acetasā । kṣamaṃ mama sahānena naikatvam anayā saha । evaṃ paramasaṃbodhāt pañcaviṃśo 'nubuddhavān ॥38॥
html:
anena sāmyaṃ yāsyāmi nānayāham acetasā ।
kṣamaṃ mama sahānena naikatvam anayā saha ।
evaṃ paramasaṃbodhāt pañcaviṃśo 'nubuddhavān ॥38॥
slp1: anena sAmyaM yAsyAmi nAnayAham acetasA । kzamaM mama sahAnena nEkatvam anayA saha । evaM paramasaMboDAt paYcaviMSo 'nubudDavAn ॥38॥

text: akṣaratvaṃ niyaccheta tyaktvā kṣaram anāmayam । avyaktaṃ vyaktadharmāṇaṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ tathā । nirguṇaṃ prathamaṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛg bhavati maithila ॥39॥
html:
akṣaratvaṃ niyaccheta tyaktvā kṣaram anāmayam ।
avyaktaṃ vyaktadharmāṇaṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ tathā ।
nirguṇaṃ prathamaṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛg bhavati maithila ॥39॥
slp1: akzaratvaM niyacCeta tyaktvA kzaram anAmayam । avyaktaM vyaktaDarmARaM saguRaM nirguRaM taTA । nirguRaM praTamaM dfzwvA tAdfg Bavati mETila ॥39॥

text: akṣarakṣarayor etad uktaṃ tava nidarśanam । mayeha jñānasampannaṃ yathāśrutinidarśanāt ॥40॥
html:
akṣarakṣarayor etad uktaṃ tava nidarśanam ।
mayeha jñānasampannaṃ yathāśrutinidarśanāt ॥40॥
slp1: akzarakzarayor etad uktaM tava nidarSanam । mayeha jYAnasampannaM yaTASrutinidarSanAt ॥40॥

text: niḥsaṃdigdhaṃ ca sūkṣmaṃ ca vibuddhaṃ vimalaṃ tathā । pravakṣyāmi tu te bhūyastannibodha yathāśrutam ॥41॥
html:
niḥsaṃdigdhaṃ ca sūkṣmaṃ ca vibuddhaṃ vimalaṃ tathā ।
pravakṣyāmi tu te bhūyastannibodha yathāśrutam ॥41॥
slp1: niHsaMdigDaM ca sUkzmaM ca vibudDaM vimalaM taTA । pravakzyAmi tu te BUyastanniboDa yaTASrutam ॥41॥

text: sāṃkhyayogau mayā proktau śāstradvayanidarśanāt । yad eva śāstraṃ sāṃkhyoktaṃ yogadarśanam eva tat ॥42॥
html:
sāṃkhyayogau mayā proktau śāstradvayanidarśanāt ।
yad eva śāstraṃ sāṃkhyoktaṃ yogadarśanam eva tat ॥42॥
slp1: sAMKyayogO mayA proktO SAstradvayanidarSanAt । yad eva SAstraM sAMKyoktaM yogadarSanam eva tat ॥42॥

text: prabodhanakaraṃ jñānaṃ sāṃkhyānām avanīpate । vispaṣṭaṃ procyate tatra śiṣyāṇāṃ hitakāmyayā ॥43॥
html:
prabodhanakaraṃ jñānaṃ sāṃkhyānām avanīpate ।
vispaṣṭaṃ procyate tatra śiṣyāṇāṃ hitakāmyayā ॥43॥
slp1: praboDanakaraM jYAnaM sAMKyAnAm avanIpate । vispazwaM procyate tatra SizyARAM hitakAmyayA ॥43॥

text: bṛhaccaiva hi tacchāstram ityāhuḥ kuśalā janāḥ । asmiṃśca śāstre yogānāṃ punar dadhi punaḥ śaraḥ ॥44॥
html:
bṛhaccaiva hi tacchāstram ityāhuḥ kuśalā janāḥ ।
asmiṃśca śāstre yogānāṃ punar dadhi punaḥ śaraḥ ॥44॥
slp1: bfhaccEva hi tacCAstram ityAhuH kuSalA janAH । asmiMSca SAstre yogAnAM punar daDi punaH SaraH ॥44॥

text: pañcaviṃśāt paraṃ tattvaṃ na paśyati narādhipa । sāṃkhyānāṃ tu paraṃ tatra yathāvad anuvarṇitam ॥45॥
html:
pañcaviṃśāt paraṃ tattvaṃ na paśyati narādhipa ।
sāṃkhyānāṃ tu paraṃ tatra yathāvad anuvarṇitam ॥45॥
slp1: paYcaviMSAt paraM tattvaM na paSyati narADipa । sAMKyAnAM tu paraM tatra yaTAvad anuvarRitam ॥45॥

text: buddham apratibuddhaṃ ca budhyamānaṃ ca tattvataḥ । budhyamānaṃ ca buddhaṃ ca prāhur yoganidarśanam ॥46॥
html:
buddham apratibuddhaṃ ca budhyamānaṃ ca tattvataḥ ।
budhyamānaṃ ca buddhaṃ ca prāhur yoganidarśanam ॥46॥
slp1: budDam apratibudDaM ca buDyamAnaM ca tattvataH । buDyamAnaM ca budDaM ca prAhur yoganidarSanam ॥46॥

text: aprabuddham athāvyaktam imaṃ guṇavidhiṃ śṛṇu । guṇān dhārayate hyeṣā sṛjatyākṣipate tathā ॥1॥
html:
aprabuddham athāvyaktam imaṃ guṇavidhiṃ śṛṇu ।
guṇān dhārayate hyeṣā sṛjatyākṣipate tathā ॥1॥
slp1: aprabudDam aTAvyaktam imaM guRaviDiM SfRu । guRAn DArayate hyezA sfjatyAkzipate taTA ॥1॥
author: vasiṣṭha uvāca ।

text: ajasraṃ tviha krīḍārthaṃ vikurvantī narādhipa । ātmānaṃ bahudhā kṛtvā tānyeva ca vicakṣate ॥2॥
html:
ajasraṃ tviha krīḍārthaṃ vikurvantī narādhipa ।
ātmānaṃ bahudhā kṛtvā tānyeva ca vicakṣate ॥2॥
slp1: ajasraM tviha krIqArTaM vikurvantI narADipa । AtmAnaM bahuDA kftvA tAnyeva ca vicakzate ॥2॥

text: etad evaṃ vikurvāṇāṃ budhyamāno na budhyate । avyaktabodhanāccaiva budhyamānaṃ vadantyapi ॥3॥
html:
etad evaṃ vikurvāṇāṃ budhyamāno na budhyate ।
avyaktabodhanāccaiva budhyamānaṃ vadantyapi ॥3॥
slp1: etad evaM vikurvARAM buDyamAno na buDyate । avyaktaboDanAccEva buDyamAnaM vadantyapi ॥3॥

text: na tveva budhyate 'vyaktaṃ saguṇaṃ vātha nirguṇam । kadācit tveva khalvetad āhur apratibuddhakam ॥4॥
html:
na tveva budhyate 'vyaktaṃ saguṇaṃ vātha nirguṇam ।
kadācit tveva khalvetad āhur apratibuddhakam ॥4॥
slp1: na tveva buDyate 'vyaktaM saguRaM vATa nirguRam । kadAcit tveva Kalvetad Ahur apratibudDakam ॥4॥

text: budhyate yadi vāvyaktam etad vai pañcaviṃśakam । budhyamāno bhavatyeṣa saṅgātmaka iti śrutiḥ ॥5॥
html:
budhyate yadi vāvyaktam etad vai pañcaviṃśakam ।
budhyamāno bhavatyeṣa saṅgātmaka iti śrutiḥ ॥5॥
slp1: buDyate yadi vAvyaktam etad vE paYcaviMSakam । buDyamAno Bavatyeza saNgAtmaka iti SrutiH ॥5॥

text: anenāpratibuddheti vadantyavyaktam acyutam । avyaktabodhanāccaiva budhyamānaṃ vadantyuta ॥6॥
html:
anenāpratibuddheti vadantyavyaktam acyutam ।
avyaktabodhanāccaiva budhyamānaṃ vadantyuta ॥6॥
slp1: anenApratibudDeti vadantyavyaktam acyutam । avyaktaboDanAccEva buDyamAnaM vadantyuta ॥6॥

text: pañcaviṃśaṃ mahātmānaṃ na cāsāvapi budhyate । ṣaḍviṃśaṃ vimalaṃ buddham aprameyaṃ sanātanam ॥7॥
html:
pañcaviṃśaṃ mahātmānaṃ na cāsāvapi budhyate ।
ṣaḍviṃśaṃ vimalaṃ buddham aprameyaṃ sanātanam ॥7॥
slp1: paYcaviMSaM mahAtmAnaM na cAsAvapi buDyate । zaqviMSaM vimalaM budDam aprameyaM sanAtanam ॥7॥

text: satataṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ ca caturviṃśaṃ ca budhyate । dṛśyādṛśye hyanugatam ubhāveva mahādyutī ॥8॥
html:
satataṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ ca caturviṃśaṃ ca budhyate ।
dṛśyādṛśye hyanugatam ubhāveva mahādyutī ॥8॥
slp1: satataM paYcaviMSaM ca caturviMSaM ca buDyate । dfSyAdfSye hyanugatam uBAveva mahAdyutI ॥8॥

text: avyaktaṃ na tu tad brahma budhyate tāta kevalam । kevalaṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ ca caturviṃśaṃ na paśyati ॥9॥
html:
avyaktaṃ na tu tad brahma budhyate tāta kevalam ।
kevalaṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ ca caturviṃśaṃ na paśyati ॥9॥
slp1: avyaktaM na tu tad brahma buDyate tAta kevalam । kevalaM paYcaviMSaM ca caturviMSaM na paSyati ॥9॥

text: budhyamāno yadātmānam anyo 'ham iti manyate । tadā prakṛtimān eṣa bhavatyavyaktalocanaḥ ॥10॥
html:
budhyamāno yadātmānam anyo 'ham iti manyate ।
tadā prakṛtimān eṣa bhavatyavyaktalocanaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: buDyamAno yadAtmAnam anyo 'ham iti manyate । tadA prakftimAn eza BavatyavyaktalocanaH ॥10॥

text: budhyate ca parāṃ buddhiṃ viśuddhām amalāṃ yadā । ṣaḍviṃśo rājaśārdūla tadā buddhatvam āvrajet ॥11॥
html:
budhyate ca parāṃ buddhiṃ viśuddhām amalāṃ yadā ।
ṣaḍviṃśo rājaśārdūla tadā buddhatvam āvrajet ॥11॥
slp1: buDyate ca parAM budDiM viSudDAm amalAM yadA । zaqviMSo rAjaSArdUla tadA budDatvam Avrajet ॥11॥

text: tatastyajati so 'vyaktaṃ sargapralayadharmiṇam । nirguṇaḥ prakṛtiṃ veda guṇayuktām acetanām ॥12॥
html:
tatastyajati so 'vyaktaṃ sargapralayadharmiṇam ।
nirguṇaḥ prakṛtiṃ veda guṇayuktām acetanām ॥12॥
slp1: tatastyajati so 'vyaktaM sargapralayaDarmiRam । nirguRaH prakftiM veda guRayuktAm acetanAm ॥12॥

text: tataḥ kevaladharmāsau bhavatyavyaktadarśanāt । kevalena samāgamya vimukto 'tmānam āpnuyāt ॥13॥
html:
tataḥ kevaladharmāsau bhavatyavyaktadarśanāt ।
kevalena samāgamya vimukto 'tmānam āpnuyāt ॥13॥
slp1: tataH kevalaDarmAsO BavatyavyaktadarSanAt । kevalena samAgamya vimukto 'tmAnam ApnuyAt ॥13॥

text: etat tat tattvam ityāhur nistattvam ajarāmaram । tattvasaṃśrayaṇād etat tattvavanna ca mānada । pañcaviṃśatitattvāni pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥14॥
html:
etat tat tattvam ityāhur nistattvam ajarāmaram ।
tattvasaṃśrayaṇād etat tattvavanna ca mānada ।
pañcaviṃśatitattvāni pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: etat tat tattvam ityAhur nistattvam ajarAmaram । tattvasaMSrayaRAd etat tattvavanna ca mAnada । paYcaviMSatitattvAni pravadanti manIziRaH ॥14॥

text: na caiṣa tattvavāṃstāta nistattvastveṣa buddhimān । eṣa muñcati tattvaṃ hi kṣipraṃ buddhasya lakṣaṇam ॥15॥
html:
na caiṣa tattvavāṃstāta nistattvastveṣa buddhimān ।
eṣa muñcati tattvaṃ hi kṣipraṃ buddhasya lakṣaṇam ॥15॥
slp1: na cEza tattvavAMstAta nistattvastveza budDimAn । eza muYcati tattvaM hi kzipraM budDasya lakzaRam ॥15॥

text: ṣaḍviṃśo 'ham iti prājño gṛhyamāṇo 'jarāmaraḥ । kevalena balenaiva samatāṃ yātyasaṃśayam ॥16॥
html:
ṣaḍviṃśo 'ham iti prājño gṛhyamāṇo 'jarāmaraḥ ।
kevalena balenaiva samatāṃ yātyasaṃśayam ॥16॥
slp1: zaqviMSo 'ham iti prAjYo gfhyamARo 'jarAmaraH । kevalena balenEva samatAM yAtyasaMSayam ॥16॥

text: ṣaḍviṃśena prabuddhena budhyamāno 'pyabuddhimān । etannānātvam ityuktaṃ sāṃkhyaśrutinidarśanāt ॥17॥
html:
ṣaḍviṃśena prabuddhena budhyamāno 'pyabuddhimān ।
etannānātvam ityuktaṃ sāṃkhyaśrutinidarśanāt ॥17॥
slp1: zaqviMSena prabudDena buDyamAno 'pyabudDimAn । etannAnAtvam ityuktaM sAMKyaSrutinidarSanAt ॥17॥

text: cetanena sametasya pañcaviṃśatikasya ca । ekatvaṃ vai bhavatyasya yadā buddhyā na budhyate ॥18॥
html:
cetanena sametasya pañcaviṃśatikasya ca ।
ekatvaṃ vai bhavatyasya yadā buddhyā na budhyate ॥18॥
slp1: cetanena sametasya paYcaviMSatikasya ca । ekatvaM vE Bavatyasya yadA budDyA na buDyate ॥18॥

text: budhyamāno 'prabuddhena samatāṃ yāti maithila । saṅgadharmā bhavatyeṣa niḥsaṅgātmā narādhipa ॥19॥
html:
budhyamāno 'prabuddhena samatāṃ yāti maithila ।
saṅgadharmā bhavatyeṣa niḥsaṅgātmā narādhipa ॥19॥
slp1: buDyamAno 'prabudDena samatAM yAti mETila । saNgaDarmA Bavatyeza niHsaNgAtmA narADipa ॥19॥

text: niḥsaṅgātmānam āsādya ṣaḍviṃśakam ajaṃ viduḥ । vibhustyajati cāvyaktaṃ yadā tvetad vibudhyate । caturviṃśam agādhaṃ ca ṣaḍviṃśasya prabodhanāt ॥20॥
html:
niḥsaṅgātmānam āsādya ṣaḍviṃśakam ajaṃ viduḥ ।
vibhustyajati cāvyaktaṃ yadā tvetad vibudhyate ।
caturviṃśam agādhaṃ ca ṣaḍviṃśasya prabodhanāt ॥20॥
slp1: niHsaNgAtmAnam AsAdya zaqviMSakam ajaM viduH । viBustyajati cAvyaktaM yadA tvetad vibuDyate । caturviMSam agADaM ca zaqviMSasya praboDanAt ॥20॥

text: eṣa hyapratibuddhaśca budhyamānaśca te 'nagha । prokto buddhaśca tattvena yathāśrutinidarśanāt । nānātvaikatvam etāvad draṣṭavyaṃ śāstradṛṣṭibhiḥ ॥21॥
html:
eṣa hyapratibuddhaśca budhyamānaśca te 'nagha ।
prokto buddhaśca tattvena yathāśrutinidarśanāt ।
nānātvaikatvam etāvad draṣṭavyaṃ śāstradṛṣṭibhiḥ ॥21॥
slp1: eza hyapratibudDaSca buDyamAnaSca te 'naGa । prokto budDaSca tattvena yaTASrutinidarSanAt । nAnAtvEkatvam etAvad drazwavyaM SAstradfzwiBiH ॥21॥

text: maśakodumbare yadvad anyatvaṃ tadvad etayoḥ । matsyo 'mbhasi yathā tadvad anyatvam upalabhyate ॥22॥
html:
maśakodumbare yadvad anyatvaṃ tadvad etayoḥ ।
matsyo 'mbhasi yathā tadvad anyatvam upalabhyate ॥22॥
slp1: maSakodumbare yadvad anyatvaM tadvad etayoH । matsyo 'mBasi yaTA tadvad anyatvam upalaByate ॥22॥

text: evam evāvagantavyaṃ nānātvaikatvam etayoḥ । etad vimokṣa ityuktam avyaktajñānasaṃhitam ॥23॥
html:
evam evāvagantavyaṃ nānātvaikatvam etayoḥ ।
etad vimokṣa ityuktam avyaktajñānasaṃhitam ॥23॥
slp1: evam evAvagantavyaM nAnAtvEkatvam etayoH । etad vimokza ityuktam avyaktajYAnasaMhitam ॥23॥

text: pañcaviṃśatikasyāsya yo 'yaṃ deheṣu vartate । eṣa mokṣayitavyeti prāhur avyaktagocarāt ॥24॥
html:
pañcaviṃśatikasyāsya yo 'yaṃ deheṣu vartate ।
eṣa mokṣayitavyeti prāhur avyaktagocarāt ॥24॥
slp1: paYcaviMSatikasyAsya yo 'yaM dehezu vartate । eza mokzayitavyeti prAhur avyaktagocarAt ॥24॥

text: so 'yam evaṃ vimucyeta nānyatheti viniścayaḥ । pareṇa paradharmā ca bhavatyeṣa sametya vai ॥25॥
html:
so 'yam evaṃ vimucyeta nānyatheti viniścayaḥ ।
pareṇa paradharmā ca bhavatyeṣa sametya vai ॥25॥
slp1: so 'yam evaM vimucyeta nAnyaTeti viniScayaH । pareRa paraDarmA ca Bavatyeza sametya vE ॥25॥

text: viśuddhadharmā śuddhena buddhena ca sa buddhimān । vimuktadharmā muktena sametya puruṣarṣabha ॥26॥
html:
viśuddhadharmā śuddhena buddhena ca sa buddhimān ।
vimuktadharmā muktena sametya puruṣarṣabha ॥26॥
slp1: viSudDaDarmA SudDena budDena ca sa budDimAn । vimuktaDarmA muktena sametya puruzarzaBa ॥26॥

text: niyogadharmiṇā caiva niyogātmā bhavatyapi । vimokṣiṇā vimokṣaśca sametyeha tathā bhavet ॥27॥
html:
niyogadharmiṇā caiva niyogātmā bhavatyapi ।
vimokṣiṇā vimokṣaśca sametyeha tathā bhavet ॥27॥
slp1: niyogaDarmiRA cEva niyogAtmA Bavatyapi । vimokziRA vimokzaSca sametyeha taTA Bavet ॥27॥

text: śucikarmā śuciścaiva bhavatyamitadīptimān । vimalātmā ca bhavati sametya vimalātmanā ॥28॥
html:
śucikarmā śuciścaiva bhavatyamitadīptimān ।
vimalātmā ca bhavati sametya vimalātmanā ॥28॥
slp1: SucikarmA SuciScEva BavatyamitadIptimAn । vimalAtmA ca Bavati sametya vimalAtmanA ॥28॥

text: kevalātmā tathā caiva kevalena sametya vai । svatantraśca svatantreṇa svatantratvam avāpnute ॥29॥
html:
kevalātmā tathā caiva kevalena sametya vai ।
svatantraśca svatantreṇa svatantratvam avāpnute ॥29॥
slp1: kevalAtmA taTA cEva kevalena sametya vE । svatantraSca svatantreRa svatantratvam avApnute ॥29॥

text: etāvad etat kathitaṃ mayā te tathyaṃ mahārāja yathārthatattvam । amatsaratvaṃ pratigṛhya cārthaṃ sanātanaṃ brahma viśuddham ādyam ॥30॥
html:

text: na vedaniṣṭhasya janasya rājan pradeyam etat paramaṃ tvayā bhavet । vivitsamānāya vibodhakārakaṃ prabodhahetoḥ praṇatasya śāsanam ॥31॥

text: na deyam etacca tathānṛtātmane śaṭhāya klībāya na jihmabuddhaye । na paṇḍitajñānaparopatāpine deyaṃ tvayedaṃ vinibodha yādṛśe ॥32॥

text: śraddhānvitāyātha guṇānvitāya parāpavādād viratāya nityam । viśuddhayogāya budhāya caiva kriyāvate 'tha kṣamiṇe hitāya ॥33॥

text: etair guṇair hīnatame na deyam etat paraṃ brahma viśuddham āhuḥ । na śreyasā yokṣyati tādṛśe kṛtaṃ dharmapravaktāram apātradānāt ॥35॥

text: karāla mā te bhayam astu kiṃcid etacchrutaṃ brahma paraṃ tvayādya । yathāvad uktaṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ niḥśokam atyantam anādimadhyam ॥37॥

text: agādhajanmāmaraṇaṃ ca rājan nirāmayaṃ vītabhayaṃ śivaṃ ca । samīkṣya mohaṃ tyaja cādya sarvaṃ jñānasya tattvārtham idaṃ viditvā ॥38॥

text: avāptam etaddhi purā sanātanāddhiraṇyagarbhād gadato narādhipa । prasādya yatnena tam ugratejasaṃ sanātanaṃ brahma yathādya vai tvayā ॥39॥

text: pṛṣṭastvayā cāsmi yathā narendra tathā mayedaṃ tvayi coktam adya । tathāvāptaṃ brahmaṇo me narendra mahajjñānaṃ mokṣavidāṃ purāṇam ॥40॥
