svadharme yatra rāgaste kāmaṃ dharmo vidhīyatām ॥20॥
slp1: sarvaM sarveRa sarvatra kriyamARaM ca pUjaya । svaDarme yatra rAgaste kAmaM Darmo viDIyatAm ॥20॥

text: adhṛtātmandhṛtau tiṣṭha durbuddhe buddhimānbhava । apraśānta praśāmya tvamaprājña prājñavaccara ॥21॥
html:
adhṛtātmandhṛtau tiṣṭha durbuddhe buddhimānbhava ।
apraśānta praśāmya tvamaprājña prājñavaccara ॥21॥
slp1: aDftAtmanDftO tizWa durbudDe budDimAnBava । apraSAnta praSAmya tvamaprAjYa prAjYavaccara ॥21॥

text: tejasā śakyate prāptumupāyasahacāriṇā । iha ca pretya ca śreyastasya mūlaṃ dhṛtiḥ parā ॥22॥
html:
tejasā śakyate prāptumupāyasahacāriṇā ।
iha ca pretya ca śreyastasya mūlaṃ dhṛtiḥ parā ॥22॥
slp1: tejasA Sakyate prAptumupAyasahacAriRA । iha ca pretya ca Sreyastasya mUlaM DftiH parA ॥22॥

text: rājarṣiradhṛtiḥ svargātpatito hi mahābhiṣaḥ । yayātiḥ kṣīṇapuṇyaśca dhṛtyā lokānavāptavān ॥23॥
html:
rājarṣiradhṛtiḥ svargātpatito hi mahābhiṣaḥ ।
yayātiḥ kṣīṇapuṇyaśca dhṛtyā lokānavāptavān ॥23॥
slp1: rAjarziraDftiH svargAtpatito hi mahABizaH । yayAtiH kzIRapuRyaSca DftyA lokAnavAptavAn ॥23॥

text: tapasvināṃ dharmavatāṃ viduṣāṃ copasevanāt । prāpsyase vipulāṃ buddhiṃ tathā śreyo'bhipatsyase ॥24॥
html:
tapasvināṃ dharmavatāṃ viduṣāṃ copasevanāt ।
prāpsyase vipulāṃ buddhiṃ tathā śreyo'bhipatsyase ॥24॥
slp1: tapasvinAM DarmavatAM viduzAM copasevanAt । prApsyase vipulAM budDiM taTA Sreyo'Bipatsyase ॥24॥

text: sa tu svabhāvasaṃpannastacchrutvā munibhāṣitam । vinivartya manaḥ kāmāddharme buddhiṃ cakāra ha] ॥25॥
html:
sa tu svabhāvasaṃpannastacchrutvā munibhāṣitam ।
vinivartya manaḥ kāmāddharme buddhiṃ cakāra ha] ॥25॥
slp1: sa tu svaBAvasaMpannastacCrutvA muniBAzitam । vinivartya manaH kAmAdDarme budDiM cakAra ha] ॥25॥

text: dharmādharmavimuktaṃ yadvimuktaṃ sarvasaṃśrayāt । janmamṛtyuvimuktaṃ ca vimuktaṃ puṇyapāpayoḥ ॥1॥
html:
dharmādharmavimuktaṃ yadvimuktaṃ sarvasaṃśrayāt ।
janmamṛtyuvimuktaṃ ca vimuktaṃ puṇyapāpayoḥ ॥1॥
slp1: DarmADarmavimuktaM yadvimuktaM sarvasaMSrayAt । janmamftyuvimuktaM ca vimuktaM puRyapApayoH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: yacchivaṃ nityamabhayaṃ nityaṃ cākṣaramavyayam । śuci nityamanāyāsaṃ tadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥2॥
html:
yacchivaṃ nityamabhayaṃ nityaṃ cākṣaramavyayam ।
śuci nityamanāyāsaṃ tadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥2॥
slp1: yacCivaM nityamaBayaM nityaM cAkzaramavyayam । Suci nityamanAyAsaM tadBavAnvaktumarhati ॥2॥

text: atra te vartayiṣye'hamitihāsaṃ purātanam । yājñavalkyasya saṃvādaṃ janakasya ca bhārata ॥3॥
html:
atra te vartayiṣye'hamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
yājñavalkyasya saṃvādaṃ janakasya ca bhārata ॥3॥
slp1: atra te vartayizye'hamitihAsaM purAtanam । yAjYavalkyasya saMvAdaM janakasya ca BArata ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yājñavalkyamṛṣiśreṣṭhaṃ daivarātirmahāyaśāḥ । papraccha janako rājā praśnaṃ praśnavidāṃ varaḥ ॥4॥
html:
yājñavalkyamṛṣiśreṣṭhaṃ daivarātirmahāyaśāḥ ।
papraccha janako rājā praśnaṃ praśnavidāṃ varaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: yAjYavalkyamfziSrezWaM dEvarAtirmahAyaSAH । papracCa janako rAjA praSnaM praSnavidAM varaH ॥4॥

text: katīndriyāṇi viprarṣe kati prakṛtayaḥ smṛtāḥ । kimavyaktaṃ paraṃ brahma tasmācca paratastu kim ॥5॥
html:
katīndriyāṇi viprarṣe kati prakṛtayaḥ smṛtāḥ ।
kimavyaktaṃ paraṃ brahma tasmācca paratastu kim ॥5॥
slp1: katIndriyARi viprarze kati prakftayaH smftAH । kimavyaktaM paraM brahma tasmAcca paratastu kim ॥5॥

text: prabhavaṃ cāpyayaṃ caiva kālasaṅkhyāṃ tathaiva ca । vaktumarhasi viprendra tvadanugrahakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ॥6॥
html:
prabhavaṃ cāpyayaṃ caiva kālasaṅkhyāṃ tathaiva ca ।
vaktumarhasi viprendra tvadanugrahakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: praBavaM cApyayaM cEva kAlasaNKyAM taTEva ca । vaktumarhasi viprendra tvadanugrahakANkziRaH ॥6॥

text: ajñānātparipṛcchāmi tvaṃ hi jñānamayo nidhiḥ । tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi sarvametadasaṃśayam ॥7॥
html:
ajñānātparipṛcchāmi tvaṃ hi jñānamayo nidhiḥ ।
tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi sarvametadasaṃśayam ॥7॥
slp1: ajYAnAtparipfcCAmi tvaM hi jYAnamayo niDiH । tadahaM SrotumicCAmi sarvametadasaMSayam ॥7॥

text: śrūyatāmavanīpāla yadetadanupṛcchasi । yogānāṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ sāṅkhyānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ॥8॥
html:
śrūyatāmavanīpāla yadetadanupṛcchasi ।
yogānāṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ sāṅkhyānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ॥8॥
slp1: SrUyatAmavanIpAla yadetadanupfcCasi । yogAnAM paramaM jYAnaM sANKyAnAM ca viSezataH ॥8॥
author: yājñavalkya uvāca ।

text: na tavāviditaṃ kiñcinmāṃ tu jijñāsate bhavān । pṛṣṭena cāpi vaktavyameṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥9॥
html:
na tavāviditaṃ kiñcinmāṃ tu jijñāsate bhavān ।
pṛṣṭena cāpi vaktavyameṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: na tavAviditaM kiYcinmAM tu jijYAsate BavAn । pfzwena cApi vaktavyameza DarmaH sanAtanaH ॥9॥

text: aṣṭau prakṛtayaḥ proktā vikārāścāpi ṣoḍaśa । atha sapta tu vyaktāni prāhuradhyātmacintakāḥ ॥10॥
html:
aṣṭau prakṛtayaḥ proktā vikārāścāpi ṣoḍaśa ।
atha sapta tu vyaktāni prāhuradhyātmacintakāḥ ॥10॥
slp1: azwO prakftayaH proktA vikArAScApi zoqaSa । aTa sapta tu vyaktAni prAhuraDyAtmacintakAH ॥10॥

text: avyaktaṃ ca mahāṃścaiva tathāhaṅkāra eva ca । pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam ॥11॥
html:
avyaktaṃ ca mahāṃścaiva tathāhaṅkāra eva ca ।
pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam ॥11॥
slp1: avyaktaM ca mahAMScEva taTAhaNkAra eva ca । pfTivI vAyurAkASamApo jyotiSca paYcamam ॥11॥

text: etāḥ prakṛtayastvaṣṭau vikārānapi me śṛṇu । śrotraṃ tvakcaiva cakṣuśca jihvā ghrāṇaṃ ca pañcamam ॥12॥
html:
etāḥ prakṛtayastvaṣṭau vikārānapi me śṛṇu ।
śrotraṃ tvakcaiva cakṣuśca jihvā ghrāṇaṃ ca pañcamam ॥12॥
slp1: etAH prakftayastvazwO vikArAnapi me SfRu । SrotraM tvakcEva cakzuSca jihvA GrARaM ca paYcamam ॥12॥

text: śabdasparśau ca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca । vākca hastau ca pādau ca pāyurmeḍhraṃ tathaiva ca ॥13॥
html:
śabdasparśau ca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca ।
vākca hastau ca pādau ca pāyurmeḍhraṃ tathaiva ca ॥13॥
slp1: SabdasparSO ca rUpaM ca raso ganDastaTEva ca । vAkca hastO ca pAdO ca pAyurmeQraM taTEva ca ॥13॥

text: ete viśeṣā rājendra mahābhūteṣu pañcasu । buddhīndriyāṇyathaitāni saviśeṣāṇi maithila ॥14॥
html:
ete viśeṣā rājendra mahābhūteṣu pañcasu ।
buddhīndriyāṇyathaitāni saviśeṣāṇi maithila ॥14॥
slp1: ete viSezA rAjendra mahABUtezu paYcasu । budDIndriyARyaTEtAni saviSezARi mETila ॥14॥

text: manaḥ ṣoḍaśakaṃ prāhuradhyātmagaticintakāḥ । tvaṃ caivānye ca vidvāṃsastattvabuddhiviśāradāḥ ॥15॥
html:
manaḥ ṣoḍaśakaṃ prāhuradhyātmagaticintakāḥ ।
tvaṃ caivānye ca vidvāṃsastattvabuddhiviśāradāḥ ॥15॥
slp1: manaH zoqaSakaM prAhuraDyAtmagaticintakAH । tvaM cEvAnye ca vidvAMsastattvabudDiviSAradAH ॥15॥

text: avyaktācca mahānātmā samutpadyati pārthiva । prathamaṃ sargamityetadāhuḥ prādhānikaṃ budhāḥ ॥16॥
html:
avyaktācca mahānātmā samutpadyati pārthiva ।
prathamaṃ sargamityetadāhuḥ prādhānikaṃ budhāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: avyaktAcca mahAnAtmA samutpadyati pArTiva । praTamaM sargamityetadAhuH prADAnikaM buDAH ॥16॥

text: mahataścāpyahaṅkāra utpadyati narādhipa । dvitīyaṃ sargamityāhuretadbuddhyātmakaṃ smṛtam ॥17॥
html:
mahataścāpyahaṅkāra utpadyati narādhipa ।
dvitīyaṃ sargamityāhuretadbuddhyātmakaṃ smṛtam ॥17॥
slp1: mahataScApyahaNkAra utpadyati narADipa । dvitIyaM sargamityAhuretadbudDyAtmakaM smftam ॥17॥

text: ahaṅkārācca sambhūtaṃ mano bhūtaguṇātmakam । tṛtīyaḥ sarga ityeṣa āhaṅkārika ucyate ॥18॥
html:
ahaṅkārācca sambhūtaṃ mano bhūtaguṇātmakam ।
tṛtīyaḥ sarga ityeṣa āhaṅkārika ucyate ॥18॥
slp1: ahaNkArAcca samBUtaM mano BUtaguRAtmakam । tftIyaH sarga ityeza AhaNkArika ucyate ॥18॥

text: manasastu samudbhūtā mahābhūtā narādhipa । caturthaṃ sargamityetanmānasaṃ paricakṣate ॥19॥
html:
manasastu samudbhūtā mahābhūtā narādhipa ।
caturthaṃ sargamityetanmānasaṃ paricakṣate ॥19॥
slp1: manasastu samudBUtA mahABUtA narADipa । caturTaM sargamityetanmAnasaM paricakzate ॥19॥

text: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca । pañcamaṃ sargamityāhurbhautikaṃ bhūtacintakāḥ ॥20॥
html:
śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca ।
pañcamaṃ sargamityāhurbhautikaṃ bhūtacintakāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: SabdaH sparSaSca rUpaM ca raso ganDastaTEva ca । paYcamaM sargamityAhurBOtikaM BUtacintakAH ॥20॥

text: śrotraṃ tvakcaiva cakṣuśca jihvā ghrāṇaṃ ca pañcamam । sargaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhamityāhurbahucintātmakaṃ smṛtam ॥21॥
html:
śrotraṃ tvakcaiva cakṣuśca jihvā ghrāṇaṃ ca pañcamam ।
sargaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhamityāhurbahucintātmakaṃ smṛtam ॥21॥
slp1: SrotraM tvakcEva cakzuSca jihvA GrARaM ca paYcamam । sargaM tu zazWamityAhurbahucintAtmakaM smftam ॥21॥

text: adhaḥ śrotrendriyagrāma utpadyati narādhipa । saptamaṃ sargamityāhuretadaindriyakaṃ smṛtam ॥22॥
html:
adhaḥ śrotrendriyagrāma utpadyati narādhipa ।
saptamaṃ sargamityāhuretadaindriyakaṃ smṛtam ॥22॥
slp1: aDaH SrotrendriyagrAma utpadyati narADipa । saptamaM sargamityAhuretadEndriyakaM smftam ॥22॥

text: ūrdhvasrotastathā tiryagutpadyati narādhipa । aṣṭamaṃ sargamityāhuretadārjavakaṃ budhāḥ ॥23॥
html:
ūrdhvasrotastathā tiryagutpadyati narādhipa ।
aṣṭamaṃ sargamityāhuretadārjavakaṃ budhāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: UrDvasrotastaTA tiryagutpadyati narADipa । azwamaM sargamityAhuretadArjavakaM buDAH ॥23॥

text: tiryaksrotastvadhaḥsrota utpadyati narādhipa । navamaṃ sargamityāhuretadārjavakaṃ budhāḥ ॥24॥
html:
tiryaksrotastvadhaḥsrota utpadyati narādhipa ।
navamaṃ sargamityāhuretadārjavakaṃ budhāḥ ॥24॥
slp1: tiryaksrotastvaDaHsrota utpadyati narADipa । navamaM sargamityAhuretadArjavakaM buDAH ॥24॥

text: etāni nava sargāṇi tattvāni ca narādhipa । caturviṃśatiruktāni yathāśruti nidarśanāt ॥25॥
html:
etāni nava sargāṇi tattvāni ca narādhipa ।
caturviṃśatiruktāni yathāśruti nidarśanāt ॥25॥
slp1: etAni nava sargARi tattvAni ca narADipa । caturviMSatiruktAni yaTASruti nidarSanAt ॥25॥

text: ata ūrdhvaṃ mahārāja guṇasyaitasya tattvataḥ । mahātmabhiranuproktāṃ kālasaṅkhyāṃ nibodha me] ॥26॥
html:
ata ūrdhvaṃ mahārāja guṇasyaitasya tattvataḥ ।
mahātmabhiranuproktāṃ kālasaṅkhyāṃ nibodha me] ॥26॥
slp1: ata UrDvaM mahArAja guRasyEtasya tattvataH । mahAtmaBiranuproktAM kAlasaNKyAM niboDa me] ॥26॥

text: avyaktasya naraśreṣṭha kālasaṅkhyāṃ nibodha me । pañca kalpasahasrāṇi dviguṇānyaharucyate ॥1॥
html:
avyaktasya naraśreṣṭha kālasaṅkhyāṃ nibodha me ।
pañca kalpasahasrāṇi dviguṇānyaharucyate ॥1॥
slp1: avyaktasya naraSrezWa kAlasaNKyAM niboDa me । paYca kalpasahasrARi dviguRAnyaharucyate ॥1॥
author: yājñavalkya uvāca ।

text: rātriretāvatī cāsya pratibuddho narādhipa । sṛjatyoṣadhimevāgre jīvanaṃ sarvadehinām ॥2॥
html:
rātriretāvatī cāsya pratibuddho narādhipa ।
sṛjatyoṣadhimevāgre jīvanaṃ sarvadehinām ॥2॥
slp1: rAtriretAvatI cAsya pratibudDo narADipa । sfjatyozaDimevAgre jIvanaM sarvadehinAm ॥2॥

text: tato brahmāṇamasṛjaddhairaṇyāṇḍasamudbhavam । sā mūrtiḥ sarvabhūtānāmityevamanuśuśruma ॥3॥
html:
tato brahmāṇamasṛjaddhairaṇyāṇḍasamudbhavam ।
sā mūrtiḥ sarvabhūtānāmityevamanuśuśruma ॥3॥
slp1: tato brahmARamasfjadDEraRyARqasamudBavam । sA mUrtiH sarvaBUtAnAmityevamanuSuSruma ॥3॥

text: saṃvatsaramuṣitvāṇḍe niṣkramya ca mahāmuniḥ । sandadhe'rdhaṃ mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ divamardhaṃ prajāpatiḥ ॥4॥
html:
saṃvatsaramuṣitvāṇḍe niṣkramya ca mahāmuniḥ ।
sandadhe'rdhaṃ mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ divamardhaṃ prajāpatiḥ ॥4॥
slp1: saMvatsaramuzitvARqe nizkramya ca mahAmuniH । sandaDe'rDaM mahIM kftsnAM divamarDaM prajApatiH ॥4॥

text: dyāvāpṛthivyorityeṣa rājanvedeṣu paṭhyate । tayoḥ śakalayormadhyamākāśamakarotprabhuḥ ॥5॥
html:
dyāvāpṛthivyorityeṣa rājanvedeṣu paṭhyate ।
tayoḥ śakalayormadhyamākāśamakarotprabhuḥ ॥5॥
slp1: dyAvApfTivyorityeza rAjanvedezu paWyate । tayoH SakalayormaDyamAkASamakarotpraBuH ॥5॥

text: etasyāpi ca saṅkhyānaṃ vedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ । daśa kalpasahasrāṇi pādonānyaharucyate । rātrimetāvatīṃ cāsya prāhuradhyātmacintakāḥ ॥6॥
html:
etasyāpi ca saṅkhyānaṃ vedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ ।
daśa kalpasahasrāṇi pādonānyaharucyate ।
rātrimetāvatīṃ cāsya prāhuradhyātmacintakāḥ ॥6॥
slp1: etasyApi ca saNKyAnaM vedavedANgapAragEH । daSa kalpasahasrARi pAdonAnyaharucyate । rAtrimetAvatIM cAsya prAhuraDyAtmacintakAH ॥6॥

text: sṛjatyahaṅkāramṛṣirbhūtaṃ divyātmakaṃ tathā । caturaścāparānputrāndehātpūrvaṃ mahānṛṣiḥ । te vai pitṛbhyaḥ pitaraḥ śrūyante rājasattama ॥7॥
html:
sṛjatyahaṅkāramṛṣirbhūtaṃ divyātmakaṃ tathā ।
caturaścāparānputrāndehātpūrvaṃ mahānṛṣiḥ ।
te vai pitṛbhyaḥ pitaraḥ śrūyante rājasattama ॥7॥
slp1: sfjatyahaNkAramfzirBUtaM divyAtmakaM taTA । caturaScAparAnputrAndehAtpUrvaM mahAnfziH । te vE pitfByaH pitaraH SrUyante rAjasattama ॥7॥

text: devāḥ pitṝṇāṃ ca sutā devairlokāḥ samāvṛtāḥ । carācarā naraśreṣṭha ityevamanuśuśruma ॥8॥
html:
devāḥ pitṝṇāṃ ca sutā devairlokāḥ samāvṛtāḥ ।
carācarā naraśreṣṭha ityevamanuśuśruma ॥8॥
slp1: devAH pitFRAM ca sutA devErlokAH samAvftAH । carAcarA naraSrezWa ityevamanuSuSruma ॥8॥

text: parameṣṭhī tvahaṅkāro'sṛjadbhūtāni pañcadhā । pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam ॥9॥
html:
parameṣṭhī tvahaṅkāro'sṛjadbhūtāni pañcadhā ।
pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam ॥9॥
slp1: paramezWI tvahaNkAro'sfjadBUtAni paYcaDA । pfTivI vAyurAkASamApo jyotiSca paYcamam ॥9॥

text: etasyāpi niśāmāhustṛtīyamiha kurvataḥ । pañca kalpasahasrāṇi tāvadevāharucyate ॥10॥
html:
etasyāpi niśāmāhustṛtīyamiha kurvataḥ ।
pañca kalpasahasrāṇi tāvadevāharucyate ॥10॥
slp1: etasyApi niSAmAhustftIyamiha kurvataH । paYca kalpasahasrARi tAvadevAharucyate ॥10॥

text: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaśca pañcamaḥ । ete viśeṣā rājendra mahābhūteṣu pañcasu । yairāviṣṭāni bhūtāni ahanyahani pārthiva ॥11॥
html:
śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaśca pañcamaḥ ।
ete viśeṣā rājendra mahābhūteṣu pañcasu ।
yairāviṣṭāni bhūtāni ahanyahani pārthiva ॥11॥
slp1: SabdaH sparSaSca rUpaM ca raso ganDaSca paYcamaH । ete viSezA rAjendra mahABUtezu paYcasu । yErAvizwAni BUtAni ahanyahani pArTiva ॥11॥

text: anyonyaṃ spṛhayantyete anyonyasya hite ratāḥ । anyonyamabhimanyante anyonyaspardhinastathā ॥12॥
html:
anyonyaṃ spṛhayantyete anyonyasya hite ratāḥ ।
anyonyamabhimanyante anyonyaspardhinastathā ॥12॥
slp1: anyonyaM spfhayantyete anyonyasya hite ratAH । anyonyamaBimanyante anyonyasparDinastaTA ॥12॥

text: te vadhyamānā anyonyaṃ guṇairhāribhiravyayāḥ । ihaiva parivartante tiryagyonipraveśinaḥ ॥13॥
html:
te vadhyamānā anyonyaṃ guṇairhāribhiravyayāḥ ।
ihaiva parivartante tiryagyonipraveśinaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: te vaDyamAnA anyonyaM guRErhAriBiravyayAH । ihEva parivartante tiryagyonipraveSinaH ॥13॥

text: trīṇi kalpasahasrāṇi eteṣāmaharucyate । rātriretāvatī caiva manasaśca narādhipa ॥14॥
html:
trīṇi kalpasahasrāṇi eteṣāmaharucyate ।
rātriretāvatī caiva manasaśca narādhipa ॥14॥
slp1: trIRi kalpasahasrARi etezAmaharucyate । rAtriretAvatI cEva manasaSca narADipa ॥14॥

text: manaścarati rājendra caritaṃ sarvamindriyaiḥ । na cendriyāṇi paśyanti mana evātra paśyati ॥15॥
html:
manaścarati rājendra caritaṃ sarvamindriyaiḥ ।
na cendriyāṇi paśyanti mana evātra paśyati ॥15॥
slp1: manaScarati rAjendra caritaM sarvamindriyEH । na cendriyARi paSyanti mana evAtra paSyati ॥15॥

text: cakṣuḥ paśyati rūpāṇi manasā tu na cakṣuṣā । manasi vyākule cakṣuḥ paśyannapi na paśyati । tathendriyāṇi sarvāṇi paśyantītyabhicakṣate ॥16॥
html:
cakṣuḥ paśyati rūpāṇi manasā tu na cakṣuṣā ।
manasi vyākule cakṣuḥ paśyannapi na paśyati ।
tathendriyāṇi sarvāṇi paśyantītyabhicakṣate ॥16॥
slp1: cakzuH paSyati rUpARi manasA tu na cakzuzA । manasi vyAkule cakzuH paSyannapi na paSyati । taTendriyARi sarvARi paSyantItyaBicakzate ॥16॥

text: manasyuparate rājannindriyoparamo bhavet । na cendriyavyuparame manasyuparamo bhavet । evaṃ manaḥpradhānāni indriyāṇi vibhāvayet ॥17॥
html:
manasyuparate rājannindriyoparamo bhavet ।
na cendriyavyuparame manasyuparamo bhavet ।
evaṃ manaḥpradhānāni indriyāṇi vibhāvayet ॥17॥
slp1: manasyuparate rAjannindriyoparamo Bavet । na cendriyavyuparame manasyuparamo Bavet । evaM manaHpraDAnAni indriyARi viBAvayet ॥17॥

text: indriyāṇāṃ hi sarveṣāmīśvaraṃ mana ucyate । etadviśanti bhūtāni sarvāṇīha mahāyaśāḥ] ॥18॥
html:
indriyāṇāṃ hi sarveṣāmīśvaraṃ mana ucyate ।
etadviśanti bhūtāni sarvāṇīha mahāyaśāḥ] ॥18॥
slp1: indriyARAM hi sarvezAmISvaraM mana ucyate । etadviSanti BUtAni sarvARIha mahAyaSAH] ॥18॥

text: tattvānāṃ sargasaṅkhyā ca kālasaṅkhyā tathaiva ca । mayā proktānupūrvyeṇa saṃhāramapi me śṛṇu ॥1॥
html:
tattvānāṃ sargasaṅkhyā ca kālasaṅkhyā tathaiva ca ।
mayā proktānupūrvyeṇa saṃhāramapi me śṛṇu ॥1॥
slp1: tattvAnAM sargasaNKyA ca kAlasaNKyA taTEva ca । mayA proktAnupUrvyeRa saMhAramapi me SfRu ॥1॥
author: yājñavalkya uvāca ।

text: yathā saṃharate jantūnsasarja ca punaḥ punaḥ । anādinidhano brahmā nityaścākṣara eva ca ॥2॥
html:
yathā saṃharate jantūnsasarja ca punaḥ punaḥ ।
anādinidhano brahmā nityaścākṣara eva ca ॥2॥
slp1: yaTA saMharate jantUnsasarja ca punaH punaH । anAdiniDano brahmA nityaScAkzara eva ca ॥2॥

text: ahaḥkṣayamatho buddhvā niśi svapnamanāstathā । codayāmāsa bhagavānavyakto'haṅkṛtaṃ naram ॥3॥
html:
ahaḥkṣayamatho buddhvā niśi svapnamanāstathā ।
codayāmāsa bhagavānavyakto'haṅkṛtaṃ naram ॥3॥
slp1: ahaHkzayamaTo budDvA niSi svapnamanAstaTA । codayAmAsa BagavAnavyakto'haNkftaM naram ॥3॥

text: tataḥ śatasahasrāṃśuravyaktenābhicoditaḥ । kṛtvā dvādaśadhātmānamādityo jvaladagnivat ॥4॥
html:
tataḥ śatasahasrāṃśuravyaktenābhicoditaḥ ।
kṛtvā dvādaśadhātmānamādityo jvaladagnivat ॥4॥
slp1: tataH SatasahasrAMSuravyaktenABicoditaH । kftvA dvAdaSaDAtmAnamAdityo jvaladagnivat ॥4॥

text: caturvidhaṃ prajājālaṃ nirdahatyāśu tejasā । jarāyvaṇḍasvedajātamudbhijjaṃ ca narādhipa ॥5॥
html:
caturvidhaṃ prajājālaṃ nirdahatyāśu tejasā ।
jarāyvaṇḍasvedajātamudbhijjaṃ ca narādhipa ॥5॥
slp1: caturviDaM prajAjAlaM nirdahatyASu tejasA । jarAyvaRqasvedajAtamudBijjaM ca narADipa ॥5॥

text: etadunmeṣamātreṇa viniṣṭaṃ sthāṇujaṅgamam । kūrmapṛṣṭhasamā bhūmirbhavatyatha samantataḥ ॥6॥
html:
etadunmeṣamātreṇa viniṣṭaṃ sthāṇujaṅgamam ।
kūrmapṛṣṭhasamā bhūmirbhavatyatha samantataḥ ॥6॥
slp1: etadunmezamAtreRa vinizwaM sTARujaNgamam । kUrmapfzWasamA BUmirBavatyaTa samantataH ॥6॥

text: jagaddagdhvāmitabalaḥ kevalaṃ jagatīṃ tataḥ । ambhasā balinā kṣipramāpūryata samantataḥ ॥7॥
html:
jagaddagdhvāmitabalaḥ kevalaṃ jagatīṃ tataḥ ।
ambhasā balinā kṣipramāpūryata samantataḥ ॥7॥
slp1: jagaddagDvAmitabalaH kevalaM jagatIM tataH । amBasA balinA kzipramApUryata samantataH ॥7॥

text: tataḥ kālāgnimāsādya tadambho yāti saṅkṣayam । vinaṣṭe'mbhasi rājendra jājvalītyanalo mahān ॥8॥
html:
tataḥ kālāgnimāsādya tadambho yāti saṅkṣayam ।
vinaṣṭe'mbhasi rājendra jājvalītyanalo mahān ॥8॥
slp1: tataH kAlAgnimAsAdya tadamBo yAti saNkzayam । vinazwe'mBasi rAjendra jAjvalItyanalo mahAn ॥8॥

text: tamaprameyo'tibalaṃ jvalamānaṃ vibhāvasum । ūṣmāṇaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ saptārciṣamathāñjasā ॥9॥
html:
tamaprameyo'tibalaṃ jvalamānaṃ vibhāvasum ।
ūṣmāṇaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ saptārciṣamathāñjasā ॥9॥
slp1: tamaprameyo'tibalaM jvalamAnaM viBAvasum । UzmARaM sarvaBUtAnAM saptArcizamaTAYjasA ॥9॥

text: bhakṣayāmāsa balavānvāyuraṣṭātmako balī । vicarannamitaprāṇastiryagūrdhvamadhastathā ॥10॥
html:
bhakṣayāmāsa balavānvāyuraṣṭātmako balī ।
vicarannamitaprāṇastiryagūrdhvamadhastathā ॥10॥
slp1: BakzayAmAsa balavAnvAyurazwAtmako balI । vicarannamitaprARastiryagUrDvamaDastaTA ॥10॥

text: tamapratibalaṃ bhīmamākāśaṃ grasate''tmanā । ākāśamapyatinadanmano grasati cārikam ॥11॥
html:
tamapratibalaṃ bhīmamākāśaṃ grasate''tmanā ।
ākāśamapyatinadanmano grasati cārikam ॥11॥
slp1: tamapratibalaM BImamAkASaM grasate''tmanA । AkASamapyatinadanmano grasati cArikam ॥11॥

text: mano grasati sarvātmā so'haṅkāraḥ prajāpatiḥ । ahaṅkāraṃ mahānātmā bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyavit ॥12॥
html:
mano grasati sarvātmā so'haṅkāraḥ prajāpatiḥ ।
ahaṅkāraṃ mahānātmā bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyavit ॥12॥
slp1: mano grasati sarvAtmA so'haNkAraH prajApatiH । ahaNkAraM mahAnAtmA BUtaBavyaBavizyavit ॥12॥

text: tamapyanupamātmānaṃ viśvaṃ śaṃbhuḥ prajāpatiḥ । aṇimā laghimā prāptirīśāno jyotiravyayaḥ ॥13॥
html:
tamapyanupamātmānaṃ viśvaṃ śaṃbhuḥ prajāpatiḥ ।
aṇimā laghimā prāptirīśāno jyotiravyayaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: tamapyanupamAtmAnaM viSvaM SaMBuH prajApatiH । aRimA laGimA prAptirISAno jyotiravyayaH ॥13॥

text: sarvataḥpāṇipādāntaḥ sarvatokṣiśiromukhaḥ । sarvataḥśrutimāṁlloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati ॥14॥
html:
sarvataḥpāṇipādāntaḥ sarvatokṣiśiromukhaḥ ।
sarvataḥśrutimāṁlloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati ॥14॥
slp1: sarvataHpARipAdAntaH sarvatokziSiromuKaH । sarvataHSrutimAṁlloke sarvamAvftya tizWati ॥14॥

text: hṛdayaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ parvaṇo'ṅguṣṭhamātrakaḥ । anugrasatyanantaṃ hi mahātmā viśvamīśvaraḥ ॥15॥
html:
hṛdayaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ parvaṇo'ṅguṣṭhamātrakaḥ ।
anugrasatyanantaṃ hi mahātmā viśvamīśvaraḥ ॥15॥
slp1: hfdayaM sarvaBUtAnAM parvaRo'NguzWamAtrakaH । anugrasatyanantaM hi mahAtmA viSvamISvaraH ॥15॥

text: tataḥ samabhavatsarvamakṣayāvyayamavraṇam । bhūtabhavyamanuṣyāṇāṃ sraṣṭāramanaghaṃ tathā ॥16॥
html:
tataḥ samabhavatsarvamakṣayāvyayamavraṇam ।
bhūtabhavyamanuṣyāṇāṃ sraṣṭāramanaghaṃ tathā ॥16॥
slp1: tataH samaBavatsarvamakzayAvyayamavraRam । BUtaBavyamanuzyARAM srazwAramanaGaM taTA ॥16॥

text: eṣo'pyayaste rājendra yathāvatparibhāṣitaḥ । adhyātmamadhibhūtaṃ ca adhidaivaṃ ca śrūyatām] ॥17॥
html:
eṣo'pyayaste rājendra yathāvatparibhāṣitaḥ ।
adhyātmamadhibhūtaṃ ca adhidaivaṃ ca śrūyatām] ॥17॥
slp1: ezo'pyayaste rAjendra yaTAvatpariBAzitaH । aDyAtmamaDiBUtaM ca aDidEvaM ca SrUyatAm] ॥17॥

text: pādāvadhyātmamityāhurbrāhmaṇāstattvadarśinaḥ । gantavyamadhibhūtaṃ ca viṣṇustatrādhidaivatam ॥1॥
html:
pādāvadhyātmamityāhurbrāhmaṇāstattvadarśinaḥ ।
gantavyamadhibhūtaṃ ca viṣṇustatrādhidaivatam ॥1॥
slp1: pAdAvaDyAtmamityAhurbrAhmaRAstattvadarSinaH । gantavyamaDiBUtaM ca vizRustatrADidEvatam ॥1॥
author: yājñavalkya uvāca ।

text: pāyuradhyātmamityāhuryathātattvārthadarśinaḥ । visargamadhibhūtaṃ ca mitrastatrādhidaivatam ॥2॥
html:
pāyuradhyātmamityāhuryathātattvārthadarśinaḥ ।
visargamadhibhūtaṃ ca mitrastatrādhidaivatam ॥2॥
slp1: pAyuraDyAtmamityAhuryaTAtattvArTadarSinaH । visargamaDiBUtaM ca mitrastatrADidEvatam ॥2॥

text: upastho'dhyātmamityāhuryathāyoganidarśanam । adhibhūtaṃ tathānando daivataṃ ca prajāpatiḥ ॥3॥
html:
upastho'dhyātmamityāhuryathāyoganidarśanam ।
adhibhūtaṃ tathānando daivataṃ ca prajāpatiḥ ॥3॥
slp1: upasTo'DyAtmamityAhuryaTAyoganidarSanam । aDiBUtaM taTAnando dEvataM ca prajApatiH ॥3॥

text: hastāvadhyātmamityāhuryathāsāṅkhyanidarśanam । kartavyamadhibhūtaṃ tu indrastatrādhidaivatam ॥4॥
html:
hastāvadhyātmamityāhuryathāsāṅkhyanidarśanam ।
kartavyamadhibhūtaṃ tu indrastatrādhidaivatam ॥4॥
slp1: hastAvaDyAtmamityAhuryaTAsANKyanidarSanam । kartavyamaDiBUtaM tu indrastatrADidEvatam ॥4॥

text: vāgadhyātmamiti prāhuryathāśrutinidarśanam । vaktavyamadhibhūtaṃ tu vahnistatrādhidaivatam ॥5॥
html:
vāgadhyātmamiti prāhuryathāśrutinidarśanam ।
vaktavyamadhibhūtaṃ tu vahnistatrādhidaivatam ॥5॥
slp1: vAgaDyAtmamiti prAhuryaTASrutinidarSanam । vaktavyamaDiBUtaM tu vahnistatrADidEvatam ॥5॥

text: cakṣuradhyātmamityāhuryathāśrutinidarśanam । rūpamatrādhibhūtaṃ tu sūryastatrādhidaivatam ॥6॥
html:
cakṣuradhyātmamityāhuryathāśrutinidarśanam ।
rūpamatrādhibhūtaṃ tu sūryastatrādhidaivatam ॥6॥
slp1: cakzuraDyAtmamityAhuryaTASrutinidarSanam । rUpamatrADiBUtaM tu sUryastatrADidEvatam ॥6॥

text: śrotramadhyātmamityāhuryathāśrutinidarśanam । śabdastatrādhibhūtaṃ tu diśastatrādhidaivatam ॥7॥
html:
śrotramadhyātmamityāhuryathāśrutinidarśanam ।
śabdastatrādhibhūtaṃ tu diśastatrādhidaivatam ॥7॥
slp1: SrotramaDyAtmamityAhuryaTASrutinidarSanam । SabdastatrADiBUtaM tu diSastatrADidEvatam ॥7॥

text: jihvāmadhyātmamityāhuryathātattvanidarśanam । rasa evādhibhūtaṃ tu āpastatrādhidaivatam ॥8॥
html:
jihvāmadhyātmamityāhuryathātattvanidarśanam ।
rasa evādhibhūtaṃ tu āpastatrādhidaivatam ॥8॥
slp1: jihvAmaDyAtmamityAhuryaTAtattvanidarSanam । rasa evADiBUtaM tu ApastatrADidEvatam ॥8॥

text: ghrāṇamadhyātmamityāhuryathāśrutinidarśanam । gandha evādhibhūtaṃ tu pṛthivī cādhidaivatam ॥9॥
html:
ghrāṇamadhyātmamityāhuryathāśrutinidarśanam ।
gandha evādhibhūtaṃ tu pṛthivī cādhidaivatam ॥9॥
slp1: GrARamaDyAtmamityAhuryaTASrutinidarSanam । ganDa evADiBUtaM tu pfTivI cADidEvatam ॥9॥

text: tvagadhyātmamiti prāhustattvabuddhiviśāradāḥ । sparśa evādhibhūtaṃ tu pavanaścādhidaivatam ॥10॥
html:
tvagadhyātmamiti prāhustattvabuddhiviśāradāḥ ।
sparśa evādhibhūtaṃ tu pavanaścādhidaivatam ॥10॥
slp1: tvagaDyAtmamiti prAhustattvabudDiviSAradAH । sparSa evADiBUtaM tu pavanaScADidEvatam ॥10॥

text: mano'dhyātmamiti prāhuryathāśrutinidarśanam । mantavyamadhibhūtaṃ tu candramāścādhidaivatam ॥11॥
html:
mano'dhyātmamiti prāhuryathāśrutinidarśanam ।
mantavyamadhibhūtaṃ tu candramāścādhidaivatam ॥11॥
slp1: mano'DyAtmamiti prAhuryaTASrutinidarSanam । mantavyamaDiBUtaM tu candramAScADidEvatam ॥11॥

text: ahaṅkārikamadhyātmamāhustattvanidarśanam । abhimāno'dhibhūtaṃ tu bhavastatrādhidaivatam ॥12॥
html:
ahaṅkārikamadhyātmamāhustattvanidarśanam ।
abhimāno'dhibhūtaṃ tu bhavastatrādhidaivatam ॥12॥
slp1: ahaNkArikamaDyAtmamAhustattvanidarSanam । aBimAno'DiBUtaM tu BavastatrADidEvatam ॥12॥

text: buddhiradhyātmamityāhuryathāvedanidarśanam । boddhavyamadhibhūtaṃ tu kṣetrajño'trādhidaivatam ॥13॥
html:
buddhiradhyātmamityāhuryathāvedanidarśanam ।
boddhavyamadhibhūtaṃ tu kṣetrajño'trādhidaivatam ॥13॥
slp1: budDiraDyAtmamityAhuryaTAvedanidarSanam । bodDavyamaDiBUtaM tu kzetrajYo'trADidEvatam ॥13॥

text: eṣā te vyaktato rājanvibhūtiranuvarṇitā । ādau madhye tathā cānte yathātattvena tattvavit ॥14॥
html:
eṣā te vyaktato rājanvibhūtiranuvarṇitā ।
ādau madhye tathā cānte yathātattvena tattvavit ॥14॥
slp1: ezA te vyaktato rAjanviBUtiranuvarRitA । AdO maDye taTA cAnte yaTAtattvena tattvavit ॥14॥

text: prakṛtirguṇānvikurute svacchandenātmakāmyayā । krīḍārthaṃ tu mahārāja śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ॥15॥
html:
prakṛtirguṇānvikurute svacchandenātmakāmyayā ।
krīḍārthaṃ tu mahārāja śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: prakftirguRAnvikurute svacCandenAtmakAmyayA । krIqArTaM tu mahArAja SataSo'Ta sahasraSaH ॥15॥

text: yathā dīpasahasrāṇi dīpānmartyāḥ prakurvate । prakṛtistathā vikurute puruṣasya guṇānbahūn ॥16॥
html:
yathā dīpasahasrāṇi dīpānmartyāḥ prakurvate ।
prakṛtistathā vikurute puruṣasya guṇānbahūn ॥16॥
slp1: yaTA dIpasahasrARi dIpAnmartyAH prakurvate । prakftistaTA vikurute puruzasya guRAnbahUn ॥16॥

text: sattvamānanda udrekaḥ prītiḥ prākāśyameva ca । sukhaṃ śuddhitvamārogyaṃ santoṣaḥ śraddadhānatā ॥17॥
html:
sattvamānanda udrekaḥ prītiḥ prākāśyameva ca ।
sukhaṃ śuddhitvamārogyaṃ santoṣaḥ śraddadhānatā ॥17॥
slp1: sattvamAnanda udrekaH prItiH prAkASyameva ca । suKaM SudDitvamArogyaM santozaH SraddaDAnatA ॥17॥

text: akārpaṇyamasaṃrambhaḥ kṣamā dhṛtirahiṃsatā । samatā satyamānṛṇyaṃ mārdavaṃ hrīracāpalam ॥18॥
html:
akārpaṇyamasaṃrambhaḥ kṣamā dhṛtirahiṃsatā ।
samatā satyamānṛṇyaṃ mārdavaṃ hrīracāpalam ॥18॥
slp1: akArpaRyamasaMramBaH kzamA DftirahiMsatA । samatA satyamAnfRyaM mArdavaM hrIracApalam ॥18॥

text: śaucamārjavamācāramalaulyaṃ hṛdyasambhramaḥ । iṣṭāniṣṭaviyogānāṃ kṛtānāmavikatthanam ॥19॥
html:
śaucamārjavamācāramalaulyaṃ hṛdyasambhramaḥ ।
iṣṭāniṣṭaviyogānāṃ kṛtānāmavikatthanam ॥19॥
slp1: SOcamArjavamAcAramalOlyaM hfdyasamBramaH । izwAnizwaviyogAnAM kftAnAmavikatTanam ॥19॥

text: dānena cānugrahaṇamaspṛhārthe parārthatā । sarvabhūtadayā caiva sattvasyaite guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ॥20॥
html:
dānena cānugrahaṇamaspṛhārthe parārthatā ।
sarvabhūtadayā caiva sattvasyaite guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: dAnena cAnugrahaRamaspfhArTe parArTatA । sarvaBUtadayA cEva sattvasyEte guRAH smftAH ॥20॥

text: rajoguṇānāṃ saṅghāto rūpamaiśvaryavigrahe । atyāśitvamakāruṇyaṃ sukhaduḥkhopasevanam ॥21॥
html:
rajoguṇānāṃ saṅghāto rūpamaiśvaryavigrahe ।
atyāśitvamakāruṇyaṃ sukhaduḥkhopasevanam ॥21॥
slp1: rajoguRAnAM saNGAto rUpamESvaryavigrahe । atyASitvamakAruRyaM suKaduHKopasevanam ॥21॥

text: parāpavādeṣu ratirvivādānāṃ ca sevanam । ahaṅkārastvasatkāraścintā vairopasevanam ॥22॥
html:
parāpavādeṣu ratirvivādānāṃ ca sevanam ।
ahaṅkārastvasatkāraścintā vairopasevanam ॥22॥
slp1: parApavAdezu ratirvivAdAnAM ca sevanam । ahaNkArastvasatkAraScintA vEropasevanam ॥22॥

text: paritāpo'paharaṇaṃ hrīnāśo'nārjavaṃ tathā । bhedaḥ paruṣatā caiva kāmakrodhau madastathā । darpo dveṣo'tivādaśca ete proktā rajoguṇāḥ ॥23॥
html:
paritāpo'paharaṇaṃ hrīnāśo'nārjavaṃ tathā ।
bhedaḥ paruṣatā caiva kāmakrodhau madastathā ।
darpo dveṣo'tivādaśca ete proktā rajoguṇāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: paritApo'paharaRaM hrInASo'nArjavaM taTA । BedaH paruzatA cEva kAmakroDO madastaTA । darpo dvezo'tivAdaSca ete proktA rajoguRAH ॥23॥

text: tāmasānāṃ tu saṅghātaṃ pravakṣyāmyupadhāryatām । moho'prakāśastāmisramandhatāmisrasañjñitam ॥24॥
html:
tāmasānāṃ tu saṅghātaṃ pravakṣyāmyupadhāryatām ।
moho'prakāśastāmisramandhatāmisrasañjñitam ॥24॥
slp1: tAmasAnAM tu saNGAtaM pravakzyAmyupaDAryatAm । moho'prakASastAmisramanDatAmisrasaYjYitam ॥24॥

text: maraṇaṃ cāndhatāmisraṃ tāmisraṃ krodha ucyate । tamaso lakṣaṇānīha bhakṣāṇāmabhirocanam ॥25॥
html:
maraṇaṃ cāndhatāmisraṃ tāmisraṃ krodha ucyate ।
tamaso lakṣaṇānīha bhakṣāṇāmabhirocanam ॥25॥
slp1: maraRaM cAnDatAmisraM tAmisraM kroDa ucyate । tamaso lakzaRAnIha BakzARAmaBirocanam ॥25॥

text: bhojanānāmaparyāptistathā peyeṣvatṛptatā । gandhavāso vihāreṣu śayaneṣvāsaneṣu ca ॥26॥
html:
bhojanānāmaparyāptistathā peyeṣvatṛptatā ।
gandhavāso vihāreṣu śayaneṣvāsaneṣu ca ॥26॥
slp1: BojanAnAmaparyAptistaTA peyezvatfptatA । ganDavAso vihArezu SayanezvAsanezu ca ॥26॥

text: divāsvapne vivāde ca pramādeṣu ca vai ratiḥ । nṛtyavāditragītānāmajñānācchraddadhānatā । dveṣo dharmaviśeṣāṇāmete vai tāmasā guṇāḥ] ॥27॥
html:
divāsvapne vivāde ca pramādeṣu ca vai ratiḥ ।
nṛtyavāditragītānāmajñānācchraddadhānatā ।
dveṣo dharmaviśeṣāṇāmete vai tāmasā guṇāḥ] ॥27॥
slp1: divAsvapne vivAde ca pramAdezu ca vE ratiH । nftyavAditragItAnAmajYAnAcCraddaDAnatA । dvezo DarmaviSezARAmete vE tAmasA guRAH] ॥27॥

text: ete pradhānasya guṇāstrayaḥ puruṣasattama । kṛtsnasya caiva jagatastiṣṭhantyanapagāḥ sadā ॥1॥
html:
ete pradhānasya guṇāstrayaḥ puruṣasattama ।
kṛtsnasya caiva jagatastiṣṭhantyanapagāḥ sadā ॥1॥
slp1: ete praDAnasya guRAstrayaH puruzasattama । kftsnasya cEva jagatastizWantyanapagAH sadA ॥1॥
author: yājñavalkya uvāca ।

text: śatadhā sahasradhā caiva tathā śatasahasradhā । koṭiśaśca karotyeṣa pratyagātmānamātmanā ॥2॥
html:
śatadhā sahasradhā caiva tathā śatasahasradhā ।
koṭiśaśca karotyeṣa pratyagātmānamātmanā ॥2॥
slp1: SataDA sahasraDA cEva taTA SatasahasraDA । kowiSaSca karotyeza pratyagAtmAnamAtmanA ॥2॥

text: sāttvikasyottamaṃ sthānaṃ rājasasyeha madhyamam । tāmasasyādhamaṃ sthānaṃ prāhuradhyātmacintakāḥ ॥3॥
html:
sāttvikasyottamaṃ sthānaṃ rājasasyeha madhyamam ।
tāmasasyādhamaṃ sthānaṃ prāhuradhyātmacintakāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: sAttvikasyottamaM sTAnaM rAjasasyeha maDyamam । tAmasasyADamaM sTAnaM prAhuraDyAtmacintakAH ॥3॥

text: kevaleneha puṇyena gatimūrdhvāmavāpnuyāt । puṇyapāpena mānuṣyamadharmeṇāpyadhogatim ॥4॥
html:
kevaleneha puṇyena gatimūrdhvāmavāpnuyāt ।
puṇyapāpena mānuṣyamadharmeṇāpyadhogatim ॥4॥
slp1: kevaleneha puRyena gatimUrDvAmavApnuyAt । puRyapApena mAnuzyamaDarmeRApyaDogatim ॥4॥

text: dvandvameṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ tu sannipātaṃ ca tattvataḥ । sattvasya rajasaścaiva tamasaśca śṛṇuṣva me ॥5॥
html:
dvandvameṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ tu sannipātaṃ ca tattvataḥ ।
sattvasya rajasaścaiva tamasaśca śṛṇuṣva me ॥5॥
slp1: dvandvamezAM trayARAM tu sannipAtaM ca tattvataH । sattvasya rajasaScEva tamasaSca SfRuzva me ॥5॥

text: sattvasya tu rajo dṛṣṭaṃ rajasaśca tamastathā । tamasaśca tathā sattvaṃ sattvasyāvyaktameva ca ॥6॥
html:
sattvasya tu rajo dṛṣṭaṃ rajasaśca tamastathā ।
tamasaśca tathā sattvaṃ sattvasyāvyaktameva ca ॥6॥
slp1: sattvasya tu rajo dfzwaM rajasaSca tamastaTA । tamasaSca taTA sattvaM sattvasyAvyaktameva ca ॥6॥

text: avyaktasattvasaṃyukto devalokamavāpnuyāt । rajaḥsattvasamāyukto manuṣyeṣūpapadyate ॥7॥
html:
avyaktasattvasaṃyukto devalokamavāpnuyāt ।
rajaḥsattvasamāyukto manuṣyeṣūpapadyate ॥7॥
slp1: avyaktasattvasaMyukto devalokamavApnuyAt । rajaHsattvasamAyukto manuzyezUpapadyate ॥7॥

text: rajastamobhyāṃ saṃyuktastiryagyoniṣu jāyate । rajastāmasasattvaiśca yukto mānuṣyamāpnuyāt ॥8॥
html:
rajastamobhyāṃ saṃyuktastiryagyoniṣu jāyate ।
rajastāmasasattvaiśca yukto mānuṣyamāpnuyāt ॥8॥
slp1: rajastamoByAM saMyuktastiryagyonizu jAyate । rajastAmasasattvESca yukto mAnuzyamApnuyAt ॥8॥

text: puṇyapāpaviyuktānāṃ sthānamāhurmanīṣiṇām । śāsvataṃ cāvyayaṃ caiva akṣaraṃ cābhayaṃ ca yat ॥9॥
html:
puṇyapāpaviyuktānāṃ sthānamāhurmanīṣiṇām ।
śāsvataṃ cāvyayaṃ caiva akṣaraṃ cābhayaṃ ca yat ॥9॥
slp1: puRyapApaviyuktAnAM sTAnamAhurmanIziRAm । SAsvataM cAvyayaM cEva akzaraM cABayaM ca yat ॥9॥

text: jñānināṃ sambhavaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sthānamavraṇamacyutam । atīndriyamabījaṃ ca janmamṛtyutamonudam ॥10॥
html:
jñānināṃ sambhavaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sthānamavraṇamacyutam ।
atīndriyamabījaṃ ca janmamṛtyutamonudam ॥10॥
slp1: jYAninAM samBavaM SrezWaM sTAnamavraRamacyutam । atIndriyamabIjaM ca janmamftyutamonudam ॥10॥

text: avyaktasthaṃ paraṃ yattatpṛṣṭaste'haṃ narādhipa । sa eṣa prakṛtiṣṭho hi tasthurityabhidhīyate ॥11॥
html:
avyaktasthaṃ paraṃ yattatpṛṣṭaste'haṃ narādhipa ।
sa eṣa prakṛtiṣṭho hi tasthurityabhidhīyate ॥11॥
slp1: avyaktasTaM paraM yattatpfzwaste'haM narADipa । sa eza prakftizWo hi tasTurityaBiDIyate ॥11॥

text: acetanaścaiṣa mataḥ prakṛtisthaśca pārthiva । etenādhiṣṭhitaścaiva sṛjate saṃharatyapi ॥12॥
html:
acetanaścaiṣa mataḥ prakṛtisthaśca pārthiva ।
etenādhiṣṭhitaścaiva sṛjate saṃharatyapi ॥12॥
slp1: acetanaScEza mataH prakftisTaSca pArTiva । etenADizWitaScEva sfjate saMharatyapi ॥12॥

text: anādinidhanāvetāvubhāveva mahāmune । amūrtimantāvacalāvaprakampyau ca nirvraṇau ॥13॥
html:
anādinidhanāvetāvubhāveva mahāmune ।
amūrtimantāvacalāvaprakampyau ca nirvraṇau ॥13॥
slp1: anAdiniDanAvetAvuBAveva mahAmune । amUrtimantAvacalAvaprakampyO ca nirvraRO ॥13॥
author: janaka uvāca ।

text: agrāhyāvṛṣiśārdūla kathameko hyacetanaḥ । cetanāvāṃstathā caikaḥ kṣetrajña iti bhāṣitaḥ ॥14॥
html:
agrāhyāvṛṣiśārdūla kathameko hyacetanaḥ ।
cetanāvāṃstathā caikaḥ kṣetrajña iti bhāṣitaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: agrAhyAvfziSArdUla kaTameko hyacetanaH । cetanAvAMstaTA cEkaH kzetrajYa iti BAzitaH ॥14॥

text: tvaṃ hi viprendra kārtsnyena mokṣadharmamupāsase । sākalyaṃ mokṣadharmasya śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ॥15॥
html:
tvaṃ hi viprendra kārtsnyena mokṣadharmamupāsase ।
sākalyaṃ mokṣadharmasya śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ॥15॥
slp1: tvaM hi viprendra kArtsnyena mokzaDarmamupAsase । sAkalyaM mokzaDarmasya SrotumicCAmi tattvataH ॥15॥

text: astitvaṃ kevalatvaṃ ca vinābhāvaṃ tathaiva ca । tathaivotkramaṇasthānaṃ dehino'pi viyujyataḥ ॥16॥
html:
astitvaṃ kevalatvaṃ ca vinābhāvaṃ tathaiva ca ।
tathaivotkramaṇasthānaṃ dehino'pi viyujyataḥ ॥16॥
slp1: astitvaM kevalatvaM ca vinABAvaM taTEva ca । taTEvotkramaRasTAnaM dehino'pi viyujyataH ॥16॥

text: kālena yaddhi prāpnoti sthānaṃ tadbrūhi me dvija । sāṅkhyajñānaṃ ca tattvena pṛthagyogaṃ tathaiva ca ॥17॥
html:
kālena yaddhi prāpnoti sthānaṃ tadbrūhi me dvija ।
sāṅkhyajñānaṃ ca tattvena pṛthagyogaṃ tathaiva ca ॥17॥
slp1: kAlena yadDi prApnoti sTAnaM tadbrUhi me dvija । sANKyajYAnaM ca tattvena pfTagyogaM taTEva ca ॥17॥

text: ariṣṭāni ca tattvena vaktumarhasi sattama । viditaṃ sarvametatte pāṇāvāmalakaṃ yathā] ॥18॥
html:
ariṣṭāni ca tattvena vaktumarhasi sattama ।
viditaṃ sarvametatte pāṇāvāmalakaṃ yathā] ॥18॥
slp1: arizwAni ca tattvena vaktumarhasi sattama । viditaM sarvametatte pARAvAmalakaM yaTA] ॥18॥

text: na śakyo nirguṇastāta guṇīkartuṃ viśāṃ pate । guṇavāṃścāpyaguṇavānyathātattvaṃ nibodha me ॥1॥
html:
na śakyo nirguṇastāta guṇīkartuṃ viśāṃ pate ।
guṇavāṃścāpyaguṇavānyathātattvaṃ nibodha me ॥1॥
slp1: na Sakyo nirguRastAta guRIkartuM viSAM pate । guRavAMScApyaguRavAnyaTAtattvaM niboDa me ॥1॥
author: yājñavalkya uvāca ।

text: guṇairhi guṇavāneva nirguṇaścāguṇastathā । prāhurevaṃ mahātmāno munayastattvadarśinaḥ ॥2॥
html:
guṇairhi guṇavāneva nirguṇaścāguṇastathā ।
prāhurevaṃ mahātmāno munayastattvadarśinaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: guRErhi guRavAneva nirguRaScAguRastaTA । prAhurevaM mahAtmAno munayastattvadarSinaH ॥2॥

text: guṇasvabhāvastvavyakto guṇānevābhivartate । upayuṅkte ca tāneva sa caivājñaḥ svabhāvataḥ ॥3॥
html:
guṇasvabhāvastvavyakto guṇānevābhivartate ।
upayuṅkte ca tāneva sa caivājñaḥ svabhāvataḥ ॥3॥
slp1: guRasvaBAvastvavyakto guRAnevABivartate । upayuNkte ca tAneva sa cEvAjYaH svaBAvataH ॥3॥

text: avyaktastu na jānīte puruṣo jñaḥ svabhāvataḥ । na mattaḥ paramastīti nityamevābhimanyate ॥4॥
html:
avyaktastu na jānīte puruṣo jñaḥ svabhāvataḥ ।
na mattaḥ paramastīti nityamevābhimanyate ॥4॥
slp1: avyaktastu na jAnIte puruzo jYaH svaBAvataH । na mattaH paramastIti nityamevABimanyate ॥4॥

text: anena kāraṇenaitadavyaktaṃ syādacetanam । nityatvādakṣaratvācca kṣarāṇāṃ tattvato'nyathā ॥5॥
html:
anena kāraṇenaitadavyaktaṃ syādacetanam ।
nityatvādakṣaratvācca kṣarāṇāṃ tattvato'nyathā ॥5॥
slp1: anena kAraRenEtadavyaktaM syAdacetanam । nityatvAdakzaratvAcca kzarARAM tattvato'nyaTA ॥5॥

text: yadājñānena kurvīta guṇasargaṃ punaḥ punaḥ । yadātmānaṃ na jānīte tadāvyaktamihocyate ॥6॥
html:
yadājñānena kurvīta guṇasargaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
yadātmānaṃ na jānīte tadāvyaktamihocyate ॥6॥
slp1: yadAjYAnena kurvIta guRasargaM punaH punaH । yadAtmAnaM na jAnIte tadAvyaktamihocyate ॥6॥

text: kartṛtvāccāpi tattvānāṃ tattvadharmī tathocyate । kartṛtvāccaiva yonīnāṃ yonidharmā tathocyate ॥7॥
html:
kartṛtvāccāpi tattvānāṃ tattvadharmī tathocyate ।
kartṛtvāccaiva yonīnāṃ yonidharmā tathocyate ॥7॥
slp1: kartftvAccApi tattvAnAM tattvaDarmI taTocyate । kartftvAccEva yonInAM yoniDarmA taTocyate ॥7॥

text: kartṛtvātprakṛtīnāṃ tu tathā prakṛtidharmitā । kartṛtvāccāpi bījānāṃ bījadharmī tathocyate ॥8॥
html:
kartṛtvātprakṛtīnāṃ tu tathā prakṛtidharmitā ।
kartṛtvāccāpi bījānāṃ bījadharmī tathocyate ॥8॥
slp1: kartftvAtprakftInAM tu taTA prakftiDarmitA । kartftvAccApi bIjAnAM bIjaDarmI taTocyate ॥8॥

text: guṇānāṃ prasavatvācca tathā prasavadharmavān । kartṛtvātpralayānāṃ ca tathā pralayadharmitā ॥9॥
html:
guṇānāṃ prasavatvācca tathā prasavadharmavān ।
kartṛtvātpralayānāṃ ca tathā pralayadharmitā ॥9॥
slp1: guRAnAM prasavatvAcca taTA prasavaDarmavAn । kartftvAtpralayAnAM ca taTA pralayaDarmitA ॥9॥

text: bījatvātprakṛtitvācca pralayatvāttathaiva ca । upekṣakatvādanyatvādabhimānācca kevalam ॥10॥
html:
bījatvātprakṛtitvācca pralayatvāttathaiva ca ।
upekṣakatvādanyatvādabhimānācca kevalam ॥10॥
slp1: bIjatvAtprakftitvAcca pralayatvAttaTEva ca । upekzakatvAdanyatvAdaBimAnAcca kevalam ॥10॥

text: manyante yatayaḥ śuddhā adhyātmavigatajvarāḥ । anityaṃ nityamavyaktamevametaddhi śuśruma ॥11॥
html:
manyante yatayaḥ śuddhā adhyātmavigatajvarāḥ ।
anityaṃ nityamavyaktamevametaddhi śuśruma ॥11॥
slp1: manyante yatayaH SudDA aDyAtmavigatajvarAH । anityaM nityamavyaktamevametadDi SuSruma ॥11॥

text: avyaktaikatvamityāhurnānātvaṃ puruṣastathā । sarvabhūtadayāvantaḥ kevalaṃ jñānamāsthitāḥ ॥12॥
html:
avyaktaikatvamityāhurnānātvaṃ puruṣastathā ।
sarvabhūtadayāvantaḥ kevalaṃ jñānamāsthitāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: avyaktEkatvamityAhurnAnAtvaM puruzastaTA । sarvaBUtadayAvantaH kevalaM jYAnamAsTitAH ॥12॥

text: anyaḥ sa puruṣo'vyaktastvadhruvo dhruvasañjñakaḥ । yathā muñja iṣīkāyāstathaivaitaddhi jāyate ॥13॥
html:
anyaḥ sa puruṣo'vyaktastvadhruvo dhruvasañjñakaḥ ।
yathā muñja iṣīkāyāstathaivaitaddhi jāyate ॥13॥
slp1: anyaH sa puruzo'vyaktastvaDruvo DruvasaYjYakaH । yaTA muYja izIkAyAstaTEvEtadDi jAyate ॥13॥

text: anyaṃ ca maśakaṃ vidyādanyaccodumbaraṃ tathā । na codumbarasaṃyogairmaśakastatra lipyate ॥14॥
html:
anyaṃ ca maśakaṃ vidyādanyaccodumbaraṃ tathā ।
na codumbarasaṃyogairmaśakastatra lipyate ॥14॥
slp1: anyaM ca maSakaM vidyAdanyaccodumbaraM taTA । na codumbarasaMyogErmaSakastatra lipyate ॥14॥

text: anya eva tathā matsyastathānyadudakaṃ smṛtam । na codakasya sparśena matsyo lipyati sarvaśaḥ ॥15॥
html:
anya eva tathā matsyastathānyadudakaṃ smṛtam ।
na codakasya sparśena matsyo lipyati sarvaśaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: anya eva taTA matsyastaTAnyadudakaM smftam । na codakasya sparSena matsyo lipyati sarvaSaH ॥15॥

text: anyo hyagnirukhāpyanyā nityamevamavaihi bhoḥ । na copalipyate so'gnirukhāsaṃsparśanena vai ॥16॥
html:

text: sāṅkhyadarśanametatte parisaṅkhyātamuttamam । evaṃ hi parisaṅkhyāya sāṅkhyāḥ kevalatāṃ gatāḥ ॥20॥

text: sāṅkhyajñānaṃ mayā proktaṃ yogajñānaṃ nibodha me । yathāśrutaṃ yathādṛṣṭaṃ tattvena nṛpasattama ॥1॥

text: pṛthakpṛthaktu paśyanti ye'lpabuddhiratā narāḥ । vayaṃ tu rājanpaśyāma ekameva tu niścayāt ॥3॥

text: vedeṣu cāṣṭaguṇitaṃ yogamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ । sūkṣmamaṣṭaguṇaṃ prāhurnetaraṃ nṛpasattama ॥7॥

text: dviguṇaṃ yogakṛtyaṃ tu yogānāṃ prāhuruttamam । saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ caiva yathāśāstranidarśanam ॥8॥

text: dhāraṇā caiva manasaḥ prāṇāyāmaśca pārthiva । prāṇāyāmo hi saguṇo nirguṇaṃ dhāraṇaṃ manaḥ ॥9॥
html:

slp1: DAraRA cEva manasaH prARAyAmaSca pArTiva । prARAyAmo hi saguRo nirguRaM DAraRaM manaH ॥9॥

text: tathaivotkramamāṇaṃ tu śṛṇuṣvāvahito nṛpa । padbhyāmutkramamāṇasya vaiṣṇavaṃ sthānamucyate ॥1॥
