ātmacchāyākṛtībhūtaṃ te'pi saṃvatsarāyuṣaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: paracakzuzi cAtmAnaM ye na paSyanti pArTiva । AtmacCAyAkftIBUtaM te'pi saMvatsarAyuzaH ॥10॥

text: atidyutiratiprajñā aprajñā cādyutistathā । prakṛtervikriyāpattiḥ ṣaṇmāsānmṛtyulakṣaṇam ॥11॥
html:
atidyutiratiprajñā aprajñā cādyutistathā ।
prakṛtervikriyāpattiḥ ṣaṇmāsānmṛtyulakṣaṇam ॥11॥
slp1: atidyutiratiprajYA aprajYA cAdyutistaTA । prakftervikriyApattiH zaRmAsAnmftyulakzaRam ॥11॥

text: daivatānyavajānāti brāhmaṇaiśca virudhyate । kṛṣṇaśyāvacchavicchāyaḥ ṣaṇmāsānmṛtyulakṣaṇam ॥12॥
html:
daivatānyavajānāti brāhmaṇaiśca virudhyate ।
kṛṣṇaśyāvacchavicchāyaḥ ṣaṇmāsānmṛtyulakṣaṇam ॥12॥
slp1: dEvatAnyavajAnAti brAhmaRESca viruDyate । kfzRaSyAvacCavicCAyaH zaRmAsAnmftyulakzaRam ॥12॥

text: śīrṇanābhi yathā cakraṃ chidraṃ somaṃ prapaśyati । tathaiva ca sahasrāṃśuṃ saptarātreṇa mṛtyubhāk ॥13॥
html:
śīrṇanābhi yathā cakraṃ chidraṃ somaṃ prapaśyati ।
tathaiva ca sahasrāṃśuṃ saptarātreṇa mṛtyubhāk ॥13॥
slp1: SIrRanABi yaTA cakraM CidraM somaM prapaSyati । taTEva ca sahasrAMSuM saptarAtreRa mftyuBAk ॥13॥

text: śavagandhamupāghrāti surabhiṃ prāpya yo naraḥ । devatāyatanasthastu ṣaḍrātreṇa sa mṛtyubhāk ॥14॥
html:
śavagandhamupāghrāti surabhiṃ prāpya yo naraḥ ।
devatāyatanasthastu ṣaḍrātreṇa sa mṛtyubhāk ॥14॥
slp1: SavaganDamupAGrAti suraBiM prApya yo naraH । devatAyatanasTastu zaqrAtreRa sa mftyuBAk ॥14॥

text: karṇanāsāvanamanaṃ dantadṛṣṭivirāgitā । sañjñālopo nirūṣmatvaṃ sadyomṛtyunidarśanam ॥15॥
html:
karṇanāsāvanamanaṃ dantadṛṣṭivirāgitā ।
sañjñālopo nirūṣmatvaṃ sadyomṛtyunidarśanam ॥15॥
slp1: karRanAsAvanamanaM dantadfzwivirAgitA । saYjYAlopo nirUzmatvaM sadyomftyunidarSanam ॥15॥

text: akasmācca sravedyasya vāmamakṣi narādhipa । mūrdhataścotpateddhūmaḥ sadyomṛtyunidarśanam ॥16॥
html:
akasmācca sravedyasya vāmamakṣi narādhipa ।
mūrdhataścotpateddhūmaḥ sadyomṛtyunidarśanam ॥16॥
slp1: akasmAcca sravedyasya vAmamakzi narADipa । mUrDataScotpatedDUmaH sadyomftyunidarSanam ॥16॥

text: etāvanti tvariṣṭāni viditvā mānavo''tmavān । niśi cāhani cātmānaṃ yojayetparamātmani ॥17॥
html:
etāvanti tvariṣṭāni viditvā mānavo''tmavān ।
niśi cāhani cātmānaṃ yojayetparamātmani ॥17॥
slp1: etAvanti tvarizwAni viditvA mAnavo''tmavAn । niSi cAhani cAtmAnaM yojayetparamAtmani ॥17॥

text: pratīkṣamāṇastatkālaṃ yatkālaṃ prati tadbhavet । athāsya neṣṭaṃ maraṇaṃ sthātumicchedimāṃ kriyām ॥18॥
html:
pratīkṣamāṇastatkālaṃ yatkālaṃ prati tadbhavet ।
athāsya neṣṭaṃ maraṇaṃ sthātumicchedimāṃ kriyām ॥18॥
slp1: pratIkzamARastatkAlaM yatkAlaM prati tadBavet । aTAsya nezwaM maraRaM sTAtumicCedimAM kriyAm ॥18॥

text: sarvagandhānrasāṃścaiva dhārayeta samāhitaḥ । tathā hi mṛtyuṃ jayati tatpareṇāntarātmanā ॥19॥
html:
sarvagandhānrasāṃścaiva dhārayeta samāhitaḥ ।
tathā hi mṛtyuṃ jayati tatpareṇāntarātmanā ॥19॥
slp1: sarvaganDAnrasAMScEva DArayeta samAhitaH । taTA hi mftyuM jayati tatpareRAntarAtmanA ॥19॥

text: sasāṅkhyadhāraṇaṃ caiva viditvā manujarṣabha । jayecca mṛtyuṃ yogena tatpareṇāntarātmanā ॥20॥
html:
sasāṅkhyadhāraṇaṃ caiva viditvā manujarṣabha ।
jayecca mṛtyuṃ yogena tatpareṇāntarātmanā ॥20॥
slp1: sasANKyaDAraRaM cEva viditvA manujarzaBa । jayecca mftyuM yogena tatpareRAntarAtmanA ॥20॥

text: gacchetprāpyākṣayaṃ kṛtsnamajanma śivamavyayam । śāśvataṃ sthānamacalaṃ duṣprāpamakṛtātmabhiḥ] ॥21॥
html:
gacchetprāpyākṣayaṃ kṛtsnamajanma śivamavyayam ।
śāśvataṃ sthānamacalaṃ duṣprāpamakṛtātmabhiḥ] ॥21॥
slp1: gacCetprApyAkzayaM kftsnamajanma Sivamavyayam । SASvataM sTAnamacalaM duzprApamakftAtmaBiH] ॥21॥

text: avyaktasthaṃ paraṃ yattatpṛṣṭaste'haṃ narādhipa । paraṃ guhyamimaṃ praśnaṃ śṛṇuṣvāvahito nṛpa ॥1॥
html:
avyaktasthaṃ paraṃ yattatpṛṣṭaste'haṃ narādhipa ।
paraṃ guhyamimaṃ praśnaṃ śṛṇuṣvāvahito nṛpa ॥1॥
slp1: avyaktasTaM paraM yattatpfzwaste'haM narADipa । paraM guhyamimaM praSnaM SfRuzvAvahito nfpa ॥1॥
author: yājñavalkya uvāca ।

text: yathārṣeṇeha vidhinā caratāvamatena ha । mayādityādavāptāni yajūṃṣi mithilādhipa ॥2॥
html:
yathārṣeṇeha vidhinā caratāvamatena ha ।
mayādityādavāptāni yajūṃṣi mithilādhipa ॥2॥
slp1: yaTArzeReha viDinA caratAvamatena ha । mayAdityAdavAptAni yajUMzi miTilADipa ॥2॥

text: mahatā tapasā devastapiṣṭhaḥ sevito mayā । prītena cāhaṃ vibhunā sūryeṇoktastadānagha ॥3॥
html:
mahatā tapasā devastapiṣṭhaḥ sevito mayā ।
prītena cāhaṃ vibhunā sūryeṇoktastadānagha ॥3॥
slp1: mahatA tapasA devastapizWaH sevito mayA । prItena cAhaM viBunA sUryeRoktastadAnaGa ॥3॥

text: varaṃ vṛṇīṣva viprarṣe yadiṣṭaṃ te sudurlabham । tatte dāsyāmi prītātmā matprasādo hi durlabhaḥ ॥4॥
html:
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva viprarṣe yadiṣṭaṃ te sudurlabham ।
tatte dāsyāmi prītātmā matprasādo hi durlabhaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: varaM vfRIzva viprarze yadizwaM te sudurlaBam । tatte dAsyAmi prItAtmA matprasAdo hi durlaBaH ॥4॥

text: tataḥ praṇamya śirasā mayoktastapatāṃ varaḥ । yajūṃṣi nopayuktāni kṣipramicchāmi veditum ॥5॥
html:
tataḥ praṇamya śirasā mayoktastapatāṃ varaḥ ।
yajūṃṣi nopayuktāni kṣipramicchāmi veditum ॥5॥
slp1: tataH praRamya SirasA mayoktastapatAM varaH । yajUMzi nopayuktAni kzipramicCAmi veditum ॥5॥

text: tato māṃ bhagavānāha vitariṣyāmi te dvija । sarasvatīha vāgbhūtā śarīraṃ te pravekṣyati ॥6॥
html:
tato māṃ bhagavānāha vitariṣyāmi te dvija ।
sarasvatīha vāgbhūtā śarīraṃ te pravekṣyati ॥6॥
slp1: tato mAM BagavAnAha vitarizyAmi te dvija । sarasvatIha vAgBUtA SarIraM te pravekzyati ॥6॥

text: tato māmāha bhagavānāsyaṃ svaṃ vivṛtaṃ kuru । vivṛtaṃ ca tato me''syaṃ praviṣṭā ca sarasvatī ॥7॥
html:
tato māmāha bhagavānāsyaṃ svaṃ vivṛtaṃ kuru ।
vivṛtaṃ ca tato me''syaṃ praviṣṭā ca sarasvatī ॥7॥
slp1: tato mAmAha BagavAnAsyaM svaM vivftaM kuru । vivftaM ca tato me''syaM pravizwA ca sarasvatI ॥7॥

text: tato vidahyamāno'haṃ praviṣṭo'mbhastadānagha । avijñānādamarṣācca bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ ॥8॥
html:
tato vidahyamāno'haṃ praviṣṭo'mbhastadānagha ।
avijñānādamarṣācca bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tato vidahyamAno'haM pravizwo'mBastadAnaGa । avijYAnAdamarzAcca BAskarasya mahAtmanaH ॥8॥

text: tato vidahyamānaṃ māmuvāca bhagavānraviḥ । muhūrtaṃ sahyatāṃ dāhastataḥ śītībhaviṣyasi ॥9॥
html:
tato vidahyamānaṃ māmuvāca bhagavānraviḥ ।
muhūrtaṃ sahyatāṃ dāhastataḥ śītībhaviṣyasi ॥9॥
slp1: tato vidahyamAnaM mAmuvAca BagavAnraviH । muhUrtaM sahyatAM dAhastataH SItIBavizyasi ॥9॥

text: śītībhūtaṃ ca māṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavānāha bhāskaraḥ । pratiṣṭhāsyati te vedaḥ sottaraḥ sakhilo dvija ॥10॥
html:
śītībhūtaṃ ca māṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavānāha bhāskaraḥ ।
pratiṣṭhāsyati te vedaḥ sottaraḥ sakhilo dvija ॥10॥
slp1: SItIBUtaM ca mAM dfzwvA BagavAnAha BAskaraH । pratizWAsyati te vedaH sottaraH saKilo dvija ॥10॥

text: kṛtsnaṃ śatapathaṃ caiva praṇeṣyasi dvijarṣabha । tasyānte cāpunarbhāve buddhistava bhaviṣyati ॥11॥
html:
kṛtsnaṃ śatapathaṃ caiva praṇeṣyasi dvijarṣabha ।
tasyānte cāpunarbhāve buddhistava bhaviṣyati ॥11॥
slp1: kftsnaM SatapaTaM cEva praRezyasi dvijarzaBa । tasyAnte cApunarBAve budDistava Bavizyati ॥11॥

text: prāpsyase ca yadiṣṭaṃ tatsāṅkhyayogepsitaṃ padam । etāvaduktvā bhagavānastamevābhyavartata ॥12॥
html:
prāpsyase ca yadiṣṭaṃ tatsāṅkhyayogepsitaṃ padam ।
etāvaduktvā bhagavānastamevābhyavartata ॥12॥
slp1: prApsyase ca yadizwaM tatsANKyayogepsitaM padam । etAvaduktvA BagavAnastamevAByavartata ॥12॥

text: tato'nuvyāhṛtaṃ śrutvā gate deve vibhāvasau । gṛhamāgatya saṃhṛṣṭo'cintayaṃ vai sarasvatīm ॥13॥
html:
tato'nuvyāhṛtaṃ śrutvā gate deve vibhāvasau ।
gṛhamāgatya saṃhṛṣṭo'cintayaṃ vai sarasvatīm ॥13॥
slp1: tato'nuvyAhftaM SrutvA gate deve viBAvasO । gfhamAgatya saMhfzwo'cintayaM vE sarasvatIm ॥13॥

text: tataḥ pravṛttātiśubhā svaravyañjanabhūṣitā । oṅkāramāditaḥ kṛtvā mama devī sarasvatī ॥14॥
html:
tataḥ pravṛttātiśubhā svaravyañjanabhūṣitā ।
oṅkāramāditaḥ kṛtvā mama devī sarasvatī ॥14॥
slp1: tataH pravfttAtiSuBA svaravyaYjanaBUzitA । oNkAramAditaH kftvA mama devI sarasvatI ॥14॥

text: tato'hamarghyaṃ vidhivatsarasvatyai nyavedayam । tapatāṃ ca variṣṭhāya niṣaṇṇastatparāyaṇaḥ ॥15॥
html:
tato'hamarghyaṃ vidhivatsarasvatyai nyavedayam ।
tapatāṃ ca variṣṭhāya niṣaṇṇastatparāyaṇaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: tato'hamarGyaM viDivatsarasvatyE nyavedayam । tapatAM ca varizWAya nizaRRastatparAyaRaH ॥15॥

text: tataḥ śatapathaṃ kṛtsnaṃ sarahasyaṃ sasaṅgraham । cakre sapariśeṣaṃ ca harṣeṇa parameṇa ha ॥16॥
html:
tataḥ śatapathaṃ kṛtsnaṃ sarahasyaṃ sasaṅgraham ।
cakre sapariśeṣaṃ ca harṣeṇa parameṇa ha ॥16॥
slp1: tataH SatapaTaM kftsnaM sarahasyaM sasaNgraham । cakre sapariSezaM ca harzeRa parameRa ha ॥16॥

text: kṛtvā cādhyayanaṃ teṣāṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ śatamuttamam । vipriyārthaṃ saśiṣyasya mātulasya mahātmanaḥ ॥17॥
html:
kṛtvā cādhyayanaṃ teṣāṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ śatamuttamam ।
vipriyārthaṃ saśiṣyasya mātulasya mahātmanaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: kftvA cADyayanaM tezAM SizyARAM Satamuttamam । vipriyArTaM saSizyasya mAtulasya mahAtmanaH ॥17॥

text: tataḥ saśiṣyeṇa mayā sūryeṇeva gabhastibhiḥ । vyāpto yajño mahārāja pitustava mahātmanaḥ ॥18॥
html:
tataḥ saśiṣyeṇa mayā sūryeṇeva gabhastibhiḥ ।
vyāpto yajño mahārāja pitustava mahātmanaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: tataH saSizyeRa mayA sUryeReva gaBastiBiH । vyApto yajYo mahArAja pitustava mahAtmanaH ॥18॥

text: miṣato devalasyāpi tato'rdhaṃ hṛtavānaham । svavedadakṣiṇāyātha vimarde mātulena ha ॥19॥
html:
miṣato devalasyāpi tato'rdhaṃ hṛtavānaham ।
svavedadakṣiṇāyātha vimarde mātulena ha ॥19॥
slp1: mizato devalasyApi tato'rDaM hftavAnaham । svavedadakziRAyATa vimarde mAtulena ha ॥19॥

text: sumantunātha pailena tathā jaimininā ca vai । pitrā te munibhiścaiva tato'hamanumānitaḥ ॥20॥
html:
sumantunātha pailena tathā jaimininā ca vai ।
pitrā te munibhiścaiva tato'hamanumānitaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: sumantunATa pElena taTA jEmininA ca vE । pitrA te muniBiScEva tato'hamanumAnitaH ॥20॥

text: daśa pañca ca prāptāni yajūṃṣyarkānmayānagha । tathaiva lomaharṣācca purāṇamavadhāritam ॥21॥
html:
daśa pañca ca prāptāni yajūṃṣyarkānmayānagha ।
tathaiva lomaharṣācca purāṇamavadhāritam ॥21॥
slp1: daSa paYca ca prAptAni yajUMzyarkAnmayAnaGa । taTEva lomaharzAcca purARamavaDAritam ॥21॥

text: bījametatpuraskṛtya devīṃ caiva sarasvatīm । sūryasya cānubhāvena pravṛtto'haṃ narādhipa ॥22॥
html:
bījametatpuraskṛtya devīṃ caiva sarasvatīm ।
sūryasya cānubhāvena pravṛtto'haṃ narādhipa ॥22॥
slp1: bIjametatpuraskftya devIM cEva sarasvatIm । sUryasya cAnuBAvena pravftto'haM narADipa ॥22॥

text: kartuṃ śatapathaṃ vedamapūrvaṃ kāritaṃ ca me । yathābhilaṣitaṃ mārgaṃ tathā taccopapāditam ॥23॥
html:
kartuṃ śatapathaṃ vedamapūrvaṃ kāritaṃ ca me ।
yathābhilaṣitaṃ mārgaṃ tathā taccopapāditam ॥23॥
slp1: kartuM SatapaTaM vedamapUrvaM kAritaM ca me । yaTABilazitaM mArgaM taTA taccopapAditam ॥23॥

text: śiṣyāṇāmakhilaṃ kṛtsnamanujñātaṃ sasaṅgraham । sarve ca śiṣyāḥ śucayo gatāḥ paramaharṣitāḥ ॥24॥
html:
śiṣyāṇāmakhilaṃ kṛtsnamanujñātaṃ sasaṅgraham ।
sarve ca śiṣyāḥ śucayo gatāḥ paramaharṣitāḥ ॥24॥
slp1: SizyARAmaKilaM kftsnamanujYAtaM sasaNgraham । sarve ca SizyAH Sucayo gatAH paramaharzitAH ॥24॥

text: śākhāḥ pañcadaśemāstu vidyā bhāskaradarśitāḥ । pratiṣṭhāpya yathākāmaṃ vedyaṃ tadanucintayam ॥25॥
html:
śākhāḥ pañcadaśemāstu vidyā bhāskaradarśitāḥ ।
pratiṣṭhāpya yathākāmaṃ vedyaṃ tadanucintayam ॥25॥
slp1: SAKAH paYcadaSemAstu vidyA BAskaradarSitAH । pratizWApya yaTAkAmaM vedyaM tadanucintayam ॥25॥

text: kimatra brahmaṇyamṛtaṃ kiṃ ca vedyamanuttamam । cintaye tatra cāgatya gandharvo māmapṛcchata ॥26॥
html:
kimatra brahmaṇyamṛtaṃ kiṃ ca vedyamanuttamam ।
cintaye tatra cāgatya gandharvo māmapṛcchata ॥26॥
slp1: kimatra brahmaRyamftaM kiM ca vedyamanuttamam । cintaye tatra cAgatya ganDarvo mAmapfcCata ॥26॥

text: viśvāvasustato rājanvedāntajñānakovidaḥ । caturviṃśatikānpraśnānpṛṣṭvā vedasya pārthiva । pañcaviṃśatimaṃ praśnaṃ papracchānvīkṣikīṃ tathā ॥27॥
html:
viśvāvasustato rājanvedāntajñānakovidaḥ ।
caturviṃśatikānpraśnānpṛṣṭvā vedasya pārthiva ।
pañcaviṃśatimaṃ praśnaṃ papracchānvīkṣikīṃ tathā ॥27॥
slp1: viSvAvasustato rAjanvedAntajYAnakovidaH । caturviMSatikAnpraSnAnpfzwvA vedasya pArTiva । paYcaviMSatimaM praSnaM papracCAnvIkzikIM taTA ॥27॥

text: viśvāviśvaṃ tathāśvāśvaṃ mitraṃ varuṇameva ca । jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ tathājño jñaḥ kastapā atapāstathā । sūryādaḥ sūrya iti ca vidyāvidye tathaiva ca ॥28॥
html:
viśvāviśvaṃ tathāśvāśvaṃ mitraṃ varuṇameva ca ।
jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ tathājño jñaḥ kastapā atapāstathā ।
sūryādaḥ sūrya iti ca vidyāvidye tathaiva ca ॥28॥
slp1: viSvAviSvaM taTASvASvaM mitraM varuRameva ca । jYAnaM jYeyaM taTAjYo jYaH kastapA atapAstaTA । sUryAdaH sUrya iti ca vidyAvidye taTEva ca ॥28॥

text: vedyāvedyaṃ tathā rājannacalaṃ calameva ca । apūrvamakṣayaṃ kṣayyametatpraśnamanuttamam ॥29॥
html:
vedyāvedyaṃ tathā rājannacalaṃ calameva ca ।
apūrvamakṣayaṃ kṣayyametatpraśnamanuttamam ॥29॥
slp1: vedyAvedyaM taTA rAjannacalaM calameva ca । apUrvamakzayaM kzayyametatpraSnamanuttamam ॥29॥

text: athoktaśca mayā rājanrājā gandharvasattamaḥ । pṛṣṭavānanupūrveṇa praśnamuttamamarthavat ॥30॥
html:
athoktaśca mayā rājanrājā gandharvasattamaḥ ।
pṛṣṭavānanupūrveṇa praśnamuttamamarthavat ॥30॥
slp1: aToktaSca mayA rAjanrAjA ganDarvasattamaH । pfzwavAnanupUrveRa praSnamuttamamarTavat ॥30॥

text: muhūrtaṃ mṛṣyatāṃ tāvadyāvadenaṃ vicintaye । bāḍhamityeva kṛtvā sa tūṣṇīṃ gandharva āsthitaḥ ॥31॥
html:
muhūrtaṃ mṛṣyatāṃ tāvadyāvadenaṃ vicintaye ।
bāḍhamityeva kṛtvā sa tūṣṇīṃ gandharva āsthitaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: muhUrtaM mfzyatAM tAvadyAvadenaM vicintaye । bAQamityeva kftvA sa tUzRIM ganDarva AsTitaH ॥31॥

text: tato'nvacintayamahaṃ bhūyo devīṃ sarasvatīm । manasā sa ca me praśno dadhno ghṛtamivoddhṛtam ॥32॥
html:
tato'nvacintayamahaṃ bhūyo devīṃ sarasvatīm ।
manasā sa ca me praśno dadhno ghṛtamivoddhṛtam ॥32॥
slp1: tato'nvacintayamahaM BUyo devIM sarasvatIm । manasA sa ca me praSno daDno GftamivodDftam ॥32॥

text: tatropaniṣadaṃ caiva pariśeṣaṃ ca pārthiva । mathnāmi manasā tāta dṛṣṭvā cānvīkṣikīṃ parām ॥33॥
html:
tatropaniṣadaṃ caiva pariśeṣaṃ ca pārthiva ।
mathnāmi manasā tāta dṛṣṭvā cānvīkṣikīṃ parām ॥33॥
slp1: tatropanizadaM cEva pariSezaM ca pArTiva । maTnAmi manasA tAta dfzwvA cAnvIkzikIM parAm ॥33॥

text: caturthī rājaśārdūla vidyaiṣā sāmparāyikī । udīritā mayā tubhyaṃ pañcaviṃśe'dhi dhiṣṭhitā ॥34॥
html:
caturthī rājaśārdūla vidyaiṣā sāmparāyikī ।
udīritā mayā tubhyaṃ pañcaviṃśe'dhi dhiṣṭhitā ॥34॥
slp1: caturTI rAjaSArdUla vidyEzA sAmparAyikI । udIritA mayA tuByaM paYcaviMSe'Di DizWitA ॥34॥

text: athoktastu mayā rājanrājā viśvāvasustadā । śrūyatāṃ yadbhavānasmānpraśnaṃ sampṛṣṭavāniha ॥35॥
html:
athoktastu mayā rājanrājā viśvāvasustadā ।
śrūyatāṃ yadbhavānasmānpraśnaṃ sampṛṣṭavāniha ॥35॥
slp1: aToktastu mayA rAjanrAjA viSvAvasustadA । SrUyatAM yadBavAnasmAnpraSnaM sampfzwavAniha ॥35॥

text: viśvāviśveti yadidaṃ gandharvendrānupṛcchasi । viśvāvyaktaṃ paraṃ vidyādbhūtabhavyabhayaṅkaram ॥36॥
html:
viśvāviśveti yadidaṃ gandharvendrānupṛcchasi ।
viśvāvyaktaṃ paraṃ vidyādbhūtabhavyabhayaṅkaram ॥36॥
slp1: viSvAviSveti yadidaM ganDarvendrAnupfcCasi । viSvAvyaktaM paraM vidyAdBUtaBavyaBayaNkaram ॥36॥

text: triguṇaṃ guṇakartṛtvādaviśvo niṣkalastathā । aśvastathaiva mithunamevamevānudṛśyate ॥37॥
html:
triguṇaṃ guṇakartṛtvādaviśvo niṣkalastathā ।
aśvastathaiva mithunamevamevānudṛśyate ॥37॥
slp1: triguRaM guRakartftvAdaviSvo nizkalastaTA । aSvastaTEva miTunamevamevAnudfSyate ॥37॥

text: avyaktaṃ prakṛtiṃ prāhuḥ puruṣeti ca nirguṇam । tathaiva mitraṃ puruṣaṃ varuṇaṃ prakṛtiṃ tathā ॥38॥
html:
avyaktaṃ prakṛtiṃ prāhuḥ puruṣeti ca nirguṇam ।
tathaiva mitraṃ puruṣaṃ varuṇaṃ prakṛtiṃ tathā ॥38॥
slp1: avyaktaM prakftiM prAhuH puruzeti ca nirguRam । taTEva mitraM puruzaM varuRaM prakftiM taTA ॥38॥

text: jñānaṃ tu prakṛtiṃ prāhurjñeyaṃ niṣkalameva ca । ajñaśca jñaśca puruṣastasmānniṣkala ucyate ॥39॥
html:
jñānaṃ tu prakṛtiṃ prāhurjñeyaṃ niṣkalameva ca ।
ajñaśca jñaśca puruṣastasmānniṣkala ucyate ॥39॥
slp1: jYAnaM tu prakftiM prAhurjYeyaM nizkalameva ca । ajYaSca jYaSca puruzastasmAnnizkala ucyate ॥39॥

text: kastapā atapāḥ proktaḥ ko'sau puruṣa ucyate । tapāḥ prakṛtirityāhuratapā niṣkalaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥40॥
html:
kastapā atapāḥ proktaḥ ko'sau puruṣa ucyate ।
tapāḥ prakṛtirityāhuratapā niṣkalaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: kastapA atapAH proktaH ko'sO puruza ucyate । tapAH prakftirityAhuratapA nizkalaH smftaH ॥40॥

text: tathaivāvedyamavyaktaṃ vedyaḥ puruṣa ucyate । calācalamiti proktaṃ tvayā tadapi me śṛṇu ॥41॥
html:
tathaivāvedyamavyaktaṃ vedyaḥ puruṣa ucyate ।
calācalamiti proktaṃ tvayā tadapi me śṛṇu ॥41॥
slp1: taTEvAvedyamavyaktaM vedyaH puruza ucyate । calAcalamiti proktaM tvayA tadapi me SfRu ॥41॥

text: calāṃ tu prakṛtiṃ prāhuḥ kāraṇaṃ kṣepasargayoḥ । akṣepasargayoḥkartā niścalaḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥42॥
html:
calāṃ tu prakṛtiṃ prāhuḥ kāraṇaṃ kṣepasargayoḥ ।
akṣepasargayoḥkartā niścalaḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: calAM tu prakftiM prAhuH kAraRaM kzepasargayoH । akzepasargayoHkartA niScalaH puruzaH smftaH ॥42॥

text: ajāvubhāvaprajau ca akṣayau cāpyubhāvapi । ajau nityāvubhau prāhuradhyātmagatiniścayāḥ ॥43॥
html:
ajāvubhāvaprajau ca akṣayau cāpyubhāvapi ।
ajau nityāvubhau prāhuradhyātmagatiniścayāḥ ॥43॥
slp1: ajAvuBAvaprajO ca akzayO cApyuBAvapi । ajO nityAvuBO prAhuraDyAtmagatiniScayAH ॥43॥

text: akṣayatvātprajanane ajamatrāhuravyayam । akṣayaṃ puruṣaṃ prāhuḥ kṣayo hyasya na vidyate ॥44॥
html:
akṣayatvātprajanane ajamatrāhuravyayam ।
akṣayaṃ puruṣaṃ prāhuḥ kṣayo hyasya na vidyate ॥44॥
slp1: akzayatvAtprajanane ajamatrAhuravyayam । akzayaM puruzaM prAhuH kzayo hyasya na vidyate ॥44॥

text: guṇakṣayatvātprakṛtiḥ kartṛtvādakṣayaṃ budhāḥ । eṣā te''nvīkṣikī vidyā caturthī sāmparāyikī ॥45॥
html:
guṇakṣayatvātprakṛtiḥ kartṛtvādakṣayaṃ budhāḥ ।
eṣā te''nvīkṣikī vidyā caturthī sāmparāyikī ॥45॥
slp1: guRakzayatvAtprakftiH kartftvAdakzayaM buDAH । ezA te''nvIkzikI vidyA caturTI sAmparAyikI ॥45॥

text: vidyopetaṃ dhanaṃ kṛtvā karmaṇā nityakarmaṇi । ekāntadarśanā vedāḥ sarve viśvāvaso smṛtāḥ ॥46॥
html:
vidyopetaṃ dhanaṃ kṛtvā karmaṇā nityakarmaṇi ।
ekāntadarśanā vedāḥ sarve viśvāvaso smṛtāḥ ॥46॥
slp1: vidyopetaM DanaM kftvA karmaRA nityakarmaRi । ekAntadarSanA vedAH sarve viSvAvaso smftAH ॥46॥

text: jāyante ca mriyante ca yasminnete yataścyutāḥ । vedārthaṃ ye na jānanti vedyaṃ gandharvasattama ॥47॥
html:
jāyante ca mriyante ca yasminnete yataścyutāḥ ।
vedārthaṃ ye na jānanti vedyaṃ gandharvasattama ॥47॥
slp1: jAyante ca mriyante ca yasminnete yataScyutAH । vedArTaM ye na jAnanti vedyaM ganDarvasattama ॥47॥

text: sāṅgopāṅgānapi yadi pañca vedānadhīyate । vedavedyaṃ na jānīte vedabhāravaho hi saḥ ॥48॥
html:
sāṅgopāṅgānapi yadi pañca vedānadhīyate ।
vedavedyaṃ na jānīte vedabhāravaho hi saḥ ॥48॥
slp1: sANgopANgAnapi yadi paYca vedAnaDIyate । vedavedyaM na jAnIte vedaBAravaho hi saH ॥48॥

text: yo ghṛtārthī kharīkṣīraṃ mathedgandharvasattama । viṣṭhāṃ tatrānupaśyeta na maṇḍaṃ nāpi vā ghṛtam ॥49॥
html:
yo ghṛtārthī kharīkṣīraṃ mathedgandharvasattama ।
viṣṭhāṃ tatrānupaśyeta na maṇḍaṃ nāpi vā ghṛtam ॥49॥
slp1: yo GftArTI KarIkzIraM maTedganDarvasattama । vizWAM tatrAnupaSyeta na maRqaM nApi vA Gftam ॥49॥

text: tathā vedyamavedyaṃ ca vedavidyo na vindati । sa kevalaṃ mūḍhamatirjñānabhāravahaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥50॥
html:
tathā vedyamavedyaṃ ca vedavidyo na vindati ।
sa kevalaṃ mūḍhamatirjñānabhāravahaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥50॥
slp1: taTA vedyamavedyaM ca vedavidyo na vindati । sa kevalaM mUQamatirjYAnaBAravahaH smftaH ॥50॥

text: draṣṭavyau nityamevaitau tatpareṇāntarātmanā । yathāsya janmanidhane na bhavetāṃ punaḥ punaḥ ॥51॥
html:
draṣṭavyau nityamevaitau tatpareṇāntarātmanā ।
yathāsya janmanidhane na bhavetāṃ punaḥ punaḥ ॥51॥
slp1: drazwavyO nityamevEtO tatpareRAntarAtmanA । yaTAsya janmaniDane na BavetAM punaH punaH ॥51॥

text: ajasraṃ janmanidhanaṃ cintayitvā trayīmimām । parityajya kṣayamiha akṣayaṃ dharmamāsthitaḥ ॥52॥
html:
ajasraṃ janmanidhanaṃ cintayitvā trayīmimām ।
parityajya kṣayamiha akṣayaṃ dharmamāsthitaḥ ॥52॥
slp1: ajasraM janmaniDanaM cintayitvA trayImimAm । parityajya kzayamiha akzayaM DarmamAsTitaH ॥52॥

text: yadā tu paśyate'tyantamahanyahani kāśyapa । tadā sa kevalībhūtaḥ ṣaḍviṃśamanupaśyati ॥53॥
html:
yadā tu paśyate'tyantamahanyahani kāśyapa ।
tadā sa kevalībhūtaḥ ṣaḍviṃśamanupaśyati ॥53॥
slp1: yadA tu paSyate'tyantamahanyahani kASyapa । tadA sa kevalIBUtaH zaqviMSamanupaSyati ॥53॥

text: anyaśca śaśvadavyaktastathānyaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ । tasya dvāvanupaśyeta tamekamiti sādhavaḥ ॥54॥
html:
anyaśca śaśvadavyaktastathānyaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ ।
tasya dvāvanupaśyeta tamekamiti sādhavaḥ ॥54॥
slp1: anyaSca SaSvadavyaktastaTAnyaH paYcaviMSakaH । tasya dvAvanupaSyeta tamekamiti sADavaH ॥54॥

text: tenaitannābhijānanti pañcaviṃśakamacyutam । janmamṛtyubhayādyogāḥ sāṅkhyāśca paramaiṣiṇaḥ ॥55॥
html:
tenaitannābhijānanti pañcaviṃśakamacyutam ।
janmamṛtyubhayādyogāḥ sāṅkhyāśca paramaiṣiṇaḥ ॥55॥
slp1: tenEtannABijAnanti paYcaviMSakamacyutam । janmamftyuBayAdyogAH sANKyASca paramEziRaH ॥55॥

text: pañcaviṃśaṃ yadetatte proktaṃ brāhmaṇasattama । tathā tanna tathā veti tadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥56॥
html:
pañcaviṃśaṃ yadetatte proktaṃ brāhmaṇasattama ।
tathā tanna tathā veti tadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥56॥
slp1: paYcaviMSaM yadetatte proktaM brAhmaRasattama । taTA tanna taTA veti tadBavAnvaktumarhati ॥56॥
author: viśvāvasuruvāca ।

text: jaigīṣavyasyāsitasya devalasya ca me śrutam । parāśarasya viprarṣervārṣagaṇyasya dhīmataḥ ॥57॥
html:
jaigīṣavyasyāsitasya devalasya ca me śrutam ।
parāśarasya viprarṣervārṣagaṇyasya dhīmataḥ ॥57॥
slp1: jEgIzavyasyAsitasya devalasya ca me Srutam । parASarasya viprarzervArzagaRyasya DImataH ॥57॥

text: bhikṣoḥ pañcaśikhasyātha kapilasya śukasya ca । gautamasyārṣṭiṣeṇasya gargasya ca mahātmanaḥ ॥58॥
html:
bhikṣoḥ pañcaśikhasyātha kapilasya śukasya ca ।
gautamasyārṣṭiṣeṇasya gargasya ca mahātmanaḥ ॥58॥
slp1: BikzoH paYcaSiKasyATa kapilasya Sukasya ca । gOtamasyArzwizeRasya gargasya ca mahAtmanaH ॥58॥

text: nāradasyāsureścaiva pulastyasya ca dhīmataḥ । sanatkumārasya tataḥ śukrasya ca mahātmanaḥ ॥59॥
html:
nāradasyāsureścaiva pulastyasya ca dhīmataḥ ।
sanatkumārasya tataḥ śukrasya ca mahātmanaḥ ॥59॥
slp1: nAradasyAsureScEva pulastyasya ca DImataH । sanatkumArasya tataH Sukrasya ca mahAtmanaH ॥59॥

text: kaśyapasya pituścaiva pūrvameva mayā śrutam । tadanantaraṃ ca rudrasya viśvarūpasya dhīmataḥ ॥60॥
html:
kaśyapasya pituścaiva pūrvameva mayā śrutam ।
tadanantaraṃ ca rudrasya viśvarūpasya dhīmataḥ ॥60॥
slp1: kaSyapasya pituScEva pUrvameva mayA Srutam । tadanantaraM ca rudrasya viSvarUpasya DImataH ॥60॥

text: daivatebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaśca daityebhyaśca tatastataḥ । prāptametanmayā kṛtsnaṃ vedyaṃ nityaṃ vadantyuta ॥61॥
html:
daivatebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaśca daityebhyaśca tatastataḥ ।
prāptametanmayā kṛtsnaṃ vedyaṃ nityaṃ vadantyuta ॥61॥
slp1: dEvateByaH pitfByaSca dEtyeByaSca tatastataH । prAptametanmayA kftsnaM vedyaM nityaM vadantyuta ॥61॥

text: tasmāttadvai bhavadbuddhyā śrotumicchāmi brāhmaṇa । bhavānprabarhaḥ śāstrāṇāṃ pragalbhaścātibuddhimān ॥62॥
html:
tasmāttadvai bhavadbuddhyā śrotumicchāmi brāhmaṇa ।
bhavānprabarhaḥ śāstrāṇāṃ pragalbhaścātibuddhimān ॥62॥
slp1: tasmAttadvE BavadbudDyA SrotumicCAmi brAhmaRa । BavAnprabarhaH SAstrARAM pragalBaScAtibudDimAn ॥62॥

text: na tavāviditaṃ kiñcidbhavāñśrutinidhiḥ smṛtaḥ । kathyate devaloke ca pitṛloke ca brāhmaṇa ॥63॥
html:
na tavāviditaṃ kiñcidbhavāñśrutinidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ।
kathyate devaloke ca pitṛloke ca brāhmaṇa ॥63॥
slp1: na tavAviditaM kiYcidBavAYSrutiniDiH smftaH । kaTyate devaloke ca pitfloke ca brAhmaRa ॥63॥

text: brahmalokagatāścaiva kathayanti maharṣayaḥ । patiśca tapatāṃ śaśvadādityastava bhāṣate ॥64॥
html:
brahmalokagatāścaiva kathayanti maharṣayaḥ ।
patiśca tapatāṃ śaśvadādityastava bhāṣate ॥64॥
slp1: brahmalokagatAScEva kaTayanti maharzayaH । patiSca tapatAM SaSvadAdityastava BAzate ॥64॥

text: sāṅkhyajñānaṃ tvayā brahmannavāptaṃ kṛtsnameva ca । tathaiva yogajñānaṃ ca yājñavalkya viśeṣataḥ ॥65॥
html:
sāṅkhyajñānaṃ tvayā brahmannavāptaṃ kṛtsnameva ca ।
tathaiva yogajñānaṃ ca yājñavalkya viśeṣataḥ ॥65॥
slp1: sANKyajYAnaM tvayA brahmannavAptaM kftsnameva ca । taTEva yogajYAnaM ca yAjYavalkya viSezataH ॥65॥

text: niḥsandigdhaṃ prabuddhastvaṃ budhyamānaścarācaram । śrotumicchāmi tajjñānaṃ ghṛtaṃ maṇḍamayaṃ yathā ॥66॥
html:
niḥsandigdhaṃ prabuddhastvaṃ budhyamānaścarācaram ।
śrotumicchāmi tajjñānaṃ ghṛtaṃ maṇḍamayaṃ yathā ॥66॥
slp1: niHsandigDaM prabudDastvaM buDyamAnaScarAcaram । SrotumicCAmi tajjYAnaM GftaM maRqamayaM yaTA ॥66॥

text: kṛtsnadhāriṇameva tvāṃ manye gandharvasattama । jijñāsasi ca māṃ rājaṃstannibodha yathāśrutam ॥67॥
html:
kṛtsnadhāriṇameva tvāṃ manye gandharvasattama ।
jijñāsasi ca māṃ rājaṃstannibodha yathāśrutam ॥67॥
slp1: kftsnaDAriRameva tvAM manye ganDarvasattama । jijYAsasi ca mAM rAjaMstanniboDa yaTASrutam ॥67॥
author: yājñavalkya uvāca ।

text: abudhyamānāṃ prakṛtiṃ budhyate pañcaviṃśakaḥ । na tu budhyati gandharva prakṛtiḥ pañcaviṃśakam ॥68॥
html:
abudhyamānāṃ prakṛtiṃ budhyate pañcaviṃśakaḥ ।
na tu budhyati gandharva prakṛtiḥ pañcaviṃśakam ॥68॥
slp1: abuDyamAnAM prakftiM buDyate paYcaviMSakaH । na tu buDyati ganDarva prakftiH paYcaviMSakam ॥68॥

text: anenāpratibodhena pradhānaṃ pravadanti tam । sāṅkhyayogāśca tattvajñā yathāśrutinidarśanāt ॥69॥
html:
anenāpratibodhena pradhānaṃ pravadanti tam ।
sāṅkhyayogāśca tattvajñā yathāśrutinidarśanāt ॥69॥
slp1: anenApratiboDena praDAnaM pravadanti tam । sANKyayogASca tattvajYA yaTASrutinidarSanAt ॥69॥

text: paśyaṃstathaivāpaśyaṃśca paśyatyanyastathānagha । ṣaḍviṃśaḥ pañcaviṃśaṃ ca caturviṃśaṃ ca paśyati । na tu paśyati paśyaṃstu yaścainamanupaśyati ॥70॥
html:
paśyaṃstathaivāpaśyaṃśca paśyatyanyastathānagha ।
ṣaḍviṃśaḥ pañcaviṃśaṃ ca caturviṃśaṃ ca paśyati ।
na tu paśyati paśyaṃstu yaścainamanupaśyati ॥70॥
slp1: paSyaMstaTEvApaSyaMSca paSyatyanyastaTAnaGa । zaqviMSaH paYcaviMSaM ca caturviMSaM ca paSyati । na tu paSyati paSyaMstu yaScEnamanupaSyati ॥70॥

text: pañcaviṃśo'bhimanyeta nānyo'sti paramo mama । na caturviṃśako'grāhyo manujairjñānadarśibhiḥ ॥71॥
html:
pañcaviṃśo'bhimanyeta nānyo'sti paramo mama ।
na caturviṃśako'grāhyo manujairjñānadarśibhiḥ ॥71॥
slp1: paYcaviMSo'Bimanyeta nAnyo'sti paramo mama । na caturviMSako'grAhyo manujErjYAnadarSiBiH ॥71॥

text: matsyevodakamanveti pravartati pravartanāt । yathaiva budhyate matsyastathaiṣo'pyanubudhyate । sasnehaḥ sahavāsācca sābhimānaśca nityaśaḥ ॥72॥
html:
matsyevodakamanveti pravartati pravartanāt ।
yathaiva budhyate matsyastathaiṣo'pyanubudhyate ।
sasnehaḥ sahavāsācca sābhimānaśca nityaśaḥ ॥72॥
slp1: matsyevodakamanveti pravartati pravartanAt । yaTEva buDyate matsyastaTEzo'pyanubuDyate । sasnehaH sahavAsAcca sABimAnaSca nityaSaH ॥72॥

text: sa nimajjati kālasya yadaikatvaṃ na budhyate । unmajjati hi kālasya mamatvenābhisaṃvṛtaḥ ॥73॥
html:
sa nimajjati kālasya yadaikatvaṃ na budhyate ।
unmajjati hi kālasya mamatvenābhisaṃvṛtaḥ ॥73॥
slp1: sa nimajjati kAlasya yadEkatvaM na buDyate । unmajjati hi kAlasya mamatvenABisaMvftaH ॥73॥

text: yadā tu manyate'nyo'hamanya eṣa iti dvijaḥ । tadā sa kevalībhūtaḥ ṣaḍviṃśamanupaśyati ॥74॥
html:
yadā tu manyate'nyo'hamanya eṣa iti dvijaḥ ।
tadā sa kevalībhūtaḥ ṣaḍviṃśamanupaśyati ॥74॥
slp1: yadA tu manyate'nyo'hamanya eza iti dvijaH । tadA sa kevalIBUtaH zaqviMSamanupaSyati ॥74॥

text: anyaśca rājannavarastathānyaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ । tatsthatvādanupaśyanti eka eveti sādhavaḥ ॥75॥
html:
anyaśca rājannavarastathānyaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ ।
tatsthatvādanupaśyanti eka eveti sādhavaḥ ॥75॥
slp1: anyaSca rAjannavarastaTAnyaH paYcaviMSakaH । tatsTatvAdanupaSyanti eka eveti sADavaH ॥75॥

text: tenaitannābhinandanti pañcaviṃśakamacyutam । janmamṛtyubhayādbhītā yogāḥ sāṅkhyāśca kāśyapa । ṣaḍviṃśamanupaśyanti śucayastatparāyaṇāḥ ॥76॥
html:
tenaitannābhinandanti pañcaviṃśakamacyutam ।
janmamṛtyubhayādbhītā yogāḥ sāṅkhyāśca kāśyapa ।
ṣaḍviṃśamanupaśyanti śucayastatparāyaṇāḥ ॥76॥
slp1: tenEtannABinandanti paYcaviMSakamacyutam । janmamftyuBayAdBItA yogAH sANKyASca kASyapa । zaqviMSamanupaSyanti SucayastatparAyaRAH ॥76॥

text: yadā sa kevalībhūtaḥ ṣaḍviṃśamanupaśyati । tadā sa sarvavidvidvānna punarjanma vindati ॥77॥
html:
yadā sa kevalībhūtaḥ ṣaḍviṃśamanupaśyati ।
tadā sa sarvavidvidvānna punarjanma vindati ॥77॥
slp1: yadA sa kevalIBUtaH zaqviMSamanupaSyati । tadA sa sarvavidvidvAnna punarjanma vindati ॥77॥

text: evamapratibuddhaśca budhyamānaśca te'nagha । buddhaścokto yathātattvaṃ mayā śrutinidarśanāt ॥78॥
html:
evamapratibuddhaśca budhyamānaśca te'nagha ।
buddhaścokto yathātattvaṃ mayā śrutinidarśanāt ॥78॥
slp1: evamapratibudDaSca buDyamAnaSca te'naGa । budDaScokto yaTAtattvaM mayA SrutinidarSanAt ॥78॥

text: paśyāpaśyaṃ yo'nupaśyetkṣemaṃ tattvaṃ ca kāśyapa । kevalākevalaṃ cādyaṃ pañcaviṃśātparaṃ ca yat ॥79॥
html:
paśyāpaśyaṃ yo'nupaśyetkṣemaṃ tattvaṃ ca kāśyapa ।
kevalākevalaṃ cādyaṃ pañcaviṃśātparaṃ ca yat ॥79॥
slp1: paSyApaSyaM yo'nupaSyetkzemaM tattvaM ca kASyapa । kevalAkevalaM cAdyaM paYcaviMSAtparaM ca yat ॥79॥

text: tathyaṃ śubhaṃ caitaduktaṃ tvayā bhoḥ samyakkṣemyaṃ devatādyaṃ yathāvat । svastyakṣayaṃ bhavataścāstu nityaṃ buddhyā sadā buddhiyuktaṃ namaste ॥80॥
html:
tathyaṃ śubhaṃ caitaduktaṃ tvayā bhoḥ samyakkṣemyaṃ devatādyaṃ yathāvat ।
svastyakṣayaṃ bhavataścāstu nityaṃ buddhyā sadā buddhiyuktaṃ namaste ॥80॥
slp1: taTyaM SuBaM cEtaduktaM tvayA BoH samyakkzemyaM devatAdyaM yaTAvat । svastyakzayaM BavataScAstu nityaM budDyA sadA budDiyuktaM namaste ॥80॥
author: viśvāvasuruvāca ।

text: evamuktvā samprayāto divaṃ sa vibhrājanvai śrīmatā darśanena । tuṣṭaśca tuṣṭyā parayābhinandya pradakṣiṇaṃ mama kṛtvā mahātmā ॥81॥
html:
evamuktvā samprayāto divaṃ sa vibhrājanvai śrīmatā darśanena ।
tuṣṭaśca tuṣṭyā parayābhinandya pradakṣiṇaṃ mama kṛtvā mahātmā ॥81॥
slp1: evamuktvA samprayAto divaM sa viBrAjanvE SrImatA darSanena । tuzwaSca tuzwyA parayABinandya pradakziRaM mama kftvA mahAtmA ॥81॥
author: yājñavalkya uvāca ।

text: brahmādīnāṃ khecarāṇāṃ kṣitau ca ye cādhastātsaṃvasante narendra । tatraiva taddarśanaṃ darśayanvai samyakkṣemyaṃ ye pathaṃ saṃśritā vai ॥82॥
html:
brahmādīnāṃ khecarāṇāṃ kṣitau ca ye cādhastātsaṃvasante narendra ।
tatraiva taddarśanaṃ darśayanvai samyakkṣemyaṃ ye pathaṃ saṃśritā vai ॥82॥
slp1: brahmAdInAM KecarARAM kzitO ca ye cADastAtsaMvasante narendra । tatrEva taddarSanaM darSayanvE samyakkzemyaM ye paTaM saMSritA vE ॥82॥

text: sāṅkhyāḥ sarve sāṅkhyadharme ratāśca tadvadyogā yogadharme ratāśca । ye cāpyanye mokṣakāmā manuṣyāsteṣāmetaddarśanaṃ jñānadṛṣṭam ॥83॥
html:
sāṅkhyāḥ sarve sāṅkhyadharme ratāśca tadvadyogā yogadharme ratāśca ।
ye cāpyanye mokṣakāmā manuṣyāsteṣāmetaddarśanaṃ jñānadṛṣṭam ॥83॥
slp1: sANKyAH sarve sANKyaDarme ratASca tadvadyogA yogaDarme ratASca । ye cApyanye mokzakAmA manuzyAstezAmetaddarSanaM jYAnadfzwam ॥83॥

text: jñānānmokṣo jāyate pūruṣāṇāṃ nāstyajñānādevamāhurnarendra । tasmājjñānaṃ tattvato'nveṣitavyaṃ yenātmānaṃ mokṣayejjanmamṛtyoḥ ॥84॥
html:
jñānānmokṣo jāyate pūruṣāṇāṃ nāstyajñānādevamāhurnarendra ।
tasmājjñānaṃ tattvato'nveṣitavyaṃ yenātmānaṃ mokṣayejjanmamṛtyoḥ ॥84॥
slp1: jYAnAnmokzo jAyate pUruzARAM nAstyajYAnAdevamAhurnarendra । tasmAjjYAnaM tattvato'nvezitavyaM yenAtmAnaM mokzayejjanmamftyoH ॥84॥

text: prāpya jñānaṃ brāhmaṇātkṣatriyādvā vaiśyācchūdrādapi nīcādabhīkṣṇam । śraddhātavyaṃ śraddadhānena nityaṃ na śraddhinaṃ janmamṛtyū viśetām ॥85॥
html:
prāpya jñānaṃ brāhmaṇātkṣatriyādvā vaiśyācchūdrādapi nīcādabhīkṣṇam ।
śraddhātavyaṃ śraddadhānena nityaṃ na śraddhinaṃ janmamṛtyū viśetām ॥85॥
slp1: prApya jYAnaM brAhmaRAtkzatriyAdvA vESyAcCUdrAdapi nIcAdaBIkzRam । SradDAtavyaM SraddaDAnena nityaM na SradDinaM janmamftyU viSetAm ॥85॥

text: sarve varṇā brāhmaṇā brahmajāśca sarve nityaṃ vyāharante ca brahma । tattvaṃ śāstraṃ brahmabuddhyā bravīmi sarvaṃ viśvaṃ brahma caitatsamastam ॥86॥
html:
sarve varṇā brāhmaṇā brahmajāśca sarve nityaṃ vyāharante ca brahma ।
tattvaṃ śāstraṃ brahmabuddhyā bravīmi sarvaṃ viśvaṃ brahma caitatsamastam ॥86॥
slp1: sarve varRA brAhmaRA brahmajASca sarve nityaM vyAharante ca brahma । tattvaM SAstraM brahmabudDyA bravImi sarvaM viSvaM brahma cEtatsamastam ॥86॥

text: brahmāsyato brāhmaṇāḥ samprasūtā bāhubhyāṃ vai kṣatriyāḥ samprasūtāḥ । nābhyāṃ vaiśyāḥ pādataścāpi śūdrāḥ sarve varṇā nānyathā veditavyāḥ ॥87॥
html:
brahmāsyato brāhmaṇāḥ samprasūtā bāhubhyāṃ vai kṣatriyāḥ samprasūtāḥ ।
nābhyāṃ vaiśyāḥ pādataścāpi śūdrāḥ sarve varṇā nānyathā veditavyāḥ ॥87॥
slp1: brahmAsyato brAhmaRAH samprasUtA bAhuByAM vE kzatriyAH samprasUtAH । nAByAM vESyAH pAdataScApi SUdrAH sarve varRA nAnyaTA veditavyAH ॥87॥

text: ajñānataḥ karmayoniṃ bhajante tāṃ tāṃ rājaṃste yathā yāntyabhāvam । tathā varṇā jñānahīnāḥ patante ghorādajñānātprākṛtaṃ yonijālam ॥88॥
html:
ajñānataḥ karmayoniṃ bhajante tāṃ tāṃ rājaṃste yathā yāntyabhāvam ।
tathā varṇā jñānahīnāḥ patante ghorādajñānātprākṛtaṃ yonijālam ॥88॥
slp1: ajYAnataH karmayoniM Bajante tAM tAM rAjaMste yaTA yAntyaBAvam । taTA varRA jYAnahInAH patante GorAdajYAnAtprAkftaM yonijAlam ॥88॥

text: tasmājjñānaṃ sarvato mārgitavyaṃ sarvatrasthaṃ caitaduktaṃ mayā te । tasthau brahmā tasthivāṃścāparo yastasmai nityaṃ mokṣamāhurdvijendrāḥ ॥89॥
html:
tasmājjñānaṃ sarvato mārgitavyaṃ sarvatrasthaṃ caitaduktaṃ mayā te ।
tasthau brahmā tasthivāṃścāparo yastasmai nityaṃ mokṣamāhurdvijendrāḥ ॥89॥
slp1: tasmAjjYAnaM sarvato mArgitavyaM sarvatrasTaM cEtaduktaM mayA te । tasTO brahmA tasTivAMScAparo yastasmE nityaM mokzamAhurdvijendrAH ॥89॥

text: yatte pṛṣṭaṃ tanmayā copadiṣṭaṃ yāthātathyaṃ tadviśoko bhavasva । rājangacchasvaitadarthasya pāraṃ samyakproktaṃ svasti te'stvatra nityam ॥90॥
html:
yatte pṛṣṭaṃ tanmayā copadiṣṭaṃ yāthātathyaṃ tadviśoko bhavasva ।
rājangacchasvaitadarthasya pāraṃ samyakproktaṃ svasti te'stvatra nityam ॥90॥
slp1: yatte pfzwaM tanmayA copadizwaM yATAtaTyaM tadviSoko Bavasva । rAjangacCasvEtadarTasya pAraM samyakproktaM svasti te'stvatra nityam ॥90॥

text: sa evamanuśāstastu yājñavalkyena dhīmatā । prītimānabhavadrājā mithilādhipatistadā ॥91॥
html:
sa evamanuśāstastu yājñavalkyena dhīmatā ।
prītimānabhavadrājā mithilādhipatistadā ॥91॥
slp1: sa evamanuSAstastu yAjYavalkyena DImatA । prItimAnaBavadrAjA miTilADipatistadA ॥91॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: gate munivare tasminkṛte cāpi pradakṣiṇe । daivarātirnarapatirāsīnastatra mokṣavit ॥92॥
html:
gate munivare tasminkṛte cāpi pradakṣiṇe ।
daivarātirnarapatirāsīnastatra mokṣavit ॥92॥
slp1: gate munivare tasminkfte cApi pradakziRe । dEvarAtirnarapatirAsInastatra mokzavit ॥92॥

text: gokoṭiṃ sparśayāmāsa hiraṇyasya tathaiva ca । ratnāñjalimathaikaṃ ca brāhmaṇebhyo dadau tadā ॥93॥
html:
gokoṭiṃ sparśayāmāsa hiraṇyasya tathaiva ca ।
ratnāñjalimathaikaṃ ca brāhmaṇebhyo dadau tadā ॥93॥
slp1: gokowiM sparSayAmAsa hiraRyasya taTEva ca । ratnAYjalimaTEkaM ca brAhmaReByo dadO tadA ॥93॥

text: videharājyaṃ ca tathā pratiṣṭhāpya sutasya vai । yatidharmamupāsaṃścāpyavasanmithilādhipaḥ ॥94॥
html:
videharājyaṃ ca tathā pratiṣṭhāpya sutasya vai ।
yatidharmamupāsaṃścāpyavasanmithilādhipaḥ ॥94॥
slp1: videharAjyaM ca taTA pratizWApya sutasya vE । yatiDarmamupAsaMScApyavasanmiTilADipaH ॥94॥

text: sāṅkhyajñānamadhīyāno yogaśāstraṃ ca kṛtsnaśaḥ । dharmādharmau ca rājendra prākṛtaṃ parigarhayan ॥95॥
html:
sāṅkhyajñānamadhīyāno yogaśāstraṃ ca kṛtsnaśaḥ ।
dharmādharmau ca rājendra prākṛtaṃ parigarhayan ॥95॥
slp1: sANKyajYAnamaDIyAno yogaSAstraM ca kftsnaSaH । DarmADarmO ca rAjendra prAkftaM parigarhayan ॥95॥

text: anantamiti kṛtvā sa nityaṃ kevalameva ca । dharmādharmau puṇyapāpe satyāsatye tathaiva ca ॥96॥
html:
anantamiti kṛtvā sa nityaṃ kevalameva ca ।
dharmādharmau puṇyapāpe satyāsatye tathaiva ca ॥96॥
slp1: anantamiti kftvA sa nityaM kevalameva ca । DarmADarmO puRyapApe satyAsatye taTEva ca ॥96॥

text: janmamṛtyū ca rājendra prākṛtaṃ tadacintayat । brahmāvyaktasya karmedamiti nityaṃ narādhipa ॥97॥
html:
janmamṛtyū ca rājendra prākṛtaṃ tadacintayat ।
brahmāvyaktasya karmedamiti nityaṃ narādhipa ॥97॥
slp1: janmamftyU ca rAjendra prAkftaM tadacintayat । brahmAvyaktasya karmedamiti nityaM narADipa ॥97॥

text: paśyanti yogāḥ sāṅkhyāśca svaśāstrakṛtalakṣaṇāḥ । iṣṭāniṣṭaviyuktaṃ hi tasthau brahma parātparam । nityaṃ tamāhurvidvāṃsaḥ śucistasmācchucirbhava ॥98॥
html:
paśyanti yogāḥ sāṅkhyāśca svaśāstrakṛtalakṣaṇāḥ ।
iṣṭāniṣṭaviyuktaṃ hi tasthau brahma parātparam ।
nityaṃ tamāhurvidvāṃsaḥ śucistasmācchucirbhava ॥98॥
slp1: paSyanti yogAH sANKyASca svaSAstrakftalakzaRAH । izwAnizwaviyuktaM hi tasTO brahma parAtparam । nityaM tamAhurvidvAMsaH SucistasmAcCucirBava ॥98॥

text: dīyate yacca labhate dattaṃ yaccānumanyate । dadāti ca naraśreṣṭha pratigṛhṇāti yacca ha । dadātyavyaktamevaitatpratigṛhṇāti tacca vai ॥99॥
html:
dīyate yacca labhate dattaṃ yaccānumanyate ।
dadāti ca naraśreṣṭha pratigṛhṇāti yacca ha ।
dadātyavyaktamevaitatpratigṛhṇāti tacca vai ॥99॥
slp1: dIyate yacca laBate dattaM yaccAnumanyate । dadAti ca naraSrezWa pratigfhRAti yacca ha । dadAtyavyaktamevEtatpratigfhRAti tacca vE ॥99॥

text: ātmā hyevātmano hyekaḥ ko'nyastvatto'dhiko bhavet । evaṃ manyasva satatamanyathā mā vicintaya ॥100॥
html:
ātmā hyevātmano hyekaḥ ko'nyastvatto'dhiko bhavet ।
evaṃ manyasva satatamanyathā mā vicintaya ॥100॥
slp1: AtmA hyevAtmano hyekaH ko'nyastvatto'Diko Bavet । evaM manyasva satatamanyaTA mA vicintaya ॥100॥

text: yasyāvyaktaṃ na viditaṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ punaḥ । tena tīrthāni yajñāśca sevitavyāvipaścitā ॥101॥
html:
yasyāvyaktaṃ na viditaṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ punaḥ ।
tena tīrthāni yajñāśca sevitavyāvipaścitā ॥101॥
slp1: yasyAvyaktaM na viditaM saguRaM nirguRaM punaH । tena tIrTAni yajYASca sevitavyAvipaScitA ॥101॥

text: na svādhyāyaistapobhirvā yajñairvā kurunandana । labhate'vyaktasaṃsthānaṃ jñātvāvyaktaṃ mahīpate ॥102॥
html:
na svādhyāyaistapobhirvā yajñairvā kurunandana ।
labhate'vyaktasaṃsthānaṃ jñātvāvyaktaṃ mahīpate ॥102॥
slp1: na svADyAyEstapoBirvA yajYErvA kurunandana । laBate'vyaktasaMsTAnaM jYAtvAvyaktaM mahIpate ॥102॥

text: tathaiva mahataḥ sthānamāhaṅkārikameva ca । ahaṅkārātparaṃ cāpi sthānāni samavāpnuyāt ॥103॥
html:
tathaiva mahataḥ sthānamāhaṅkārikameva ca ।
ahaṅkārātparaṃ cāpi sthānāni samavāpnuyāt ॥103॥
slp1: taTEva mahataH sTAnamAhaNkArikameva ca । ahaNkArAtparaM cApi sTAnAni samavApnuyAt ॥103॥

text: ye tvavyaktātparaṃ nityaṃ jānate śāstratatparāḥ । janmamṛtyuviyuktaṃ ca viyuktaṃ sadasacca yat ॥104॥
html:
ye tvavyaktātparaṃ nityaṃ jānate śāstratatparāḥ ।
janmamṛtyuviyuktaṃ ca viyuktaṃ sadasacca yat ॥104॥
slp1: ye tvavyaktAtparaM nityaM jAnate SAstratatparAH । janmamftyuviyuktaM ca viyuktaM sadasacca yat ॥104॥

text: etanmayāptaṃ janakātpurastāttenāpi cāptaṃ nṛpa yājñavalkyāt । jñānaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ na tathā hi yajñā jñānena durgaṃ tarate na yajñaiḥ ॥105॥
html:
etanmayāptaṃ janakātpurastāttenāpi cāptaṃ nṛpa yājñavalkyāt ।
jñānaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ na tathā hi yajñā jñānena durgaṃ tarate na yajñaiḥ ॥105॥
slp1: etanmayAptaM janakAtpurastAttenApi cAptaM nfpa yAjYavalkyAt । jYAnaM viSizwaM na taTA hi yajYA jYAnena durgaM tarate na yajYEH ॥105॥

text: durgaṃ janma nidhanaṃ cāpi rājanna bhūtikaṃ jñānavido vadanti । yajñaistapobhirniyamairvrataiśca divaṃ samāsādya patanti bhūmau ॥106॥
html:
durgaṃ janma nidhanaṃ cāpi rājanna bhūtikaṃ jñānavido vadanti ।
yajñaistapobhirniyamairvrataiśca divaṃ samāsādya patanti bhūmau ॥106॥
slp1: durgaM janma niDanaM cApi rAjanna BUtikaM jYAnavido vadanti । yajYEstapoBirniyamErvratESca divaM samAsAdya patanti BUmO ॥106॥

text: tasmādupāsasva paraṃ mahacchuci śivaṃ vimokṣaṃ vimalaṃ pavitram । kṣetrajñavitpārthiva jñānayajñamupāsya vai tattvamṛṣirbhaviṣyasi ॥107॥
html:
tasmādupāsasva paraṃ mahacchuci śivaṃ vimokṣaṃ vimalaṃ pavitram ।
kṣetrajñavitpārthiva jñānayajñamupāsya vai tattvamṛṣirbhaviṣyasi ॥107॥
slp1: tasmAdupAsasva paraM mahacCuci SivaM vimokzaM vimalaM pavitram । kzetrajYavitpArTiva jYAnayajYamupAsya vE tattvamfzirBavizyasi ॥107॥

text: upaniṣadamupākarottadā vai janakanṛpasya purā hi yājñavalkyaḥ । yadupagaṇitaśāśvatāvyayaṃ tacchubhamamṛtatvamaśokamṛcchatīti] ॥108॥
html:
upaniṣadamupākarottadā vai janakanṛpasya purā hi yājñavalkyaḥ ।
yadupagaṇitaśāśvatāvyayaṃ tacchubhamamṛtatvamaśokamṛcchatīti] ॥108॥
slp1: upanizadamupAkarottadA vE janakanfpasya purA hi yAjYavalkyaH । yadupagaRitaSASvatAvyayaM tacCuBamamftatvamaSokamfcCatIti] ॥108॥

text: aiśvaryaṃ vā mahatprāpya dhanaṃ vā bharatarṣabha । dīrghamāyuravāpyātha kathaṃ mṛtyumatikramet ॥1॥
html:
aiśvaryaṃ vā mahatprāpya dhanaṃ vā bharatarṣabha ।
dīrghamāyuravāpyātha kathaṃ mṛtyumatikramet ॥1॥
slp1: ESvaryaM vA mahatprApya DanaM vA BaratarzaBa । dIrGamAyuravApyATa kaTaM mftyumatikramet ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: tapasā vā sumahatā karmaṇā vā śrutena vā । rasāyanaprayogairvā kairnopaiti jarāntakau ॥2॥
html:
tapasā vā sumahatā karmaṇā vā śrutena vā ।
rasāyanaprayogairvā kairnopaiti jarāntakau ॥2॥
slp1: tapasA vA sumahatA karmaRA vA Srutena vA । rasAyanaprayogErvA kErnopEti jarAntakO ॥2॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । bhikṣoḥ pañcaśikhasyeha saṃvādaṃ janakasya ca ॥3॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
bhikṣoḥ pañcaśikhasyeha saṃvādaṃ janakasya ca ॥3॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । BikzoH paYcaSiKasyeha saMvAdaM janakasya ca ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: vaideho janako rājā maharṣiṃ vedavittamam । paryapṛcchatpañcaśikhaṃ chinnadharmārthasaṃśayam ॥4॥
html:
vaideho janako rājā maharṣiṃ vedavittamam ।
paryapṛcchatpañcaśikhaṃ chinnadharmārthasaṃśayam ॥4॥
slp1: vEdeho janako rAjA maharziM vedavittamam । paryapfcCatpaYcaSiKaM CinnaDarmArTasaMSayam ॥4॥

text: kena vṛttena bhagavannatikrāmejjarāntakau । tapasā vātha buddhyā vā karmaṇā vā śrutena vā ॥5॥
html:
kena vṛttena bhagavannatikrāmejjarāntakau ।
tapasā vātha buddhyā vā karmaṇā vā śrutena vā ॥5॥
slp1: kena vfttena BagavannatikrAmejjarAntakO । tapasA vATa budDyA vA karmaRA vA Srutena vA ॥5॥

text: evamuktaḥ sa vaidehaṃ pratyuvāca parokṣavit । nivṛttirnaitayorasti nānivṛttiḥ kathañcana ॥6॥
html:
evamuktaḥ sa vaidehaṃ pratyuvāca parokṣavit ।
nivṛttirnaitayorasti nānivṛttiḥ kathañcana ॥6॥
slp1: evamuktaH sa vEdehaM pratyuvAca parokzavit । nivfttirnEtayorasti nAnivfttiH kaTaYcana ॥6॥

text: na hyahāni nivartante na māsā na punaḥ kṣapāḥ । so'yaṃ prapadyate'dhvānaṃ cirāya dhruvamadhruvaḥ ॥7॥
html:
na hyahāni nivartante na māsā na punaḥ kṣapāḥ ।
so'yaṃ prapadyate'dhvānaṃ cirāya dhruvamadhruvaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: na hyahAni nivartante na mAsA na punaH kzapAH । so'yaM prapadyate'DvAnaM cirAya DruvamaDruvaH ॥7॥

text: sarvabhūtasamucchedaḥ srotasevohyate sadā । uhyamānaṃ nimajjantamaplave kālasāgare । jarāmṛtyumahāgrāhe na kaścidabhipadyate ॥8॥
html:
sarvabhūtasamucchedaḥ srotasevohyate sadā ।
uhyamānaṃ nimajjantamaplave kālasāgare ।
jarāmṛtyumahāgrāhe na kaścidabhipadyate ॥8॥
slp1: sarvaBUtasamucCedaH srotasevohyate sadA । uhyamAnaM nimajjantamaplave kAlasAgare । jarAmftyumahAgrAhe na kaScidaBipadyate ॥8॥

text: naivāsya bhavitā kaścinnāsau bhavati kasyacit । pathi saṅgatamevedaṃ dārairanyaiśca bandhubhiḥ । nāyamatyantasaṃvāso labdhapūrvo hi kenacit ॥9॥
html:
naivāsya bhavitā kaścinnāsau bhavati kasyacit ।
pathi saṅgatamevedaṃ dārairanyaiśca bandhubhiḥ ।
nāyamatyantasaṃvāso labdhapūrvo hi kenacit ॥9॥
slp1: nEvAsya BavitA kaScinnAsO Bavati kasyacit । paTi saNgatamevedaM dArEranyESca banDuBiH । nAyamatyantasaMvAso labDapUrvo hi kenacit ॥9॥

text: kṣipyante tena tenaiva niṣṭanantaḥ punaḥ punaḥ । kālena jātā jātā hi vāyunevābhrasañcayāḥ ॥10॥
html:
kṣipyante tena tenaiva niṣṭanantaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
kālena jātā jātā hi vāyunevābhrasañcayāḥ ॥10॥
slp1: kzipyante tena tenEva nizwanantaH punaH punaH । kAlena jAtA jAtA hi vAyunevABrasaYcayAH ॥10॥

text: jarāmṛtyū hi bhūtānāṃ khāditārau vṛkāviva । balināṃ durbalānāṃ ca hrasvānāṃ mahatāmapi ॥11॥
html:
jarāmṛtyū hi bhūtānāṃ khāditārau vṛkāviva ।
balināṃ durbalānāṃ ca hrasvānāṃ mahatāmapi ॥11॥
slp1: jarAmftyU hi BUtAnAM KAditArO vfkAviva । balinAM durbalAnAM ca hrasvAnAM mahatAmapi ॥11॥

text: evambhūteṣu bhūteṣu nityabhūtādhruveṣu ca । kathaṃ hṛṣyeta jāteṣu mṛteṣu ca kathaṃ jvaret ॥12॥
html:
evambhūteṣu bhūteṣu nityabhūtādhruveṣu ca ।
kathaṃ hṛṣyeta jāteṣu mṛteṣu ca kathaṃ jvaret ॥12॥
slp1: evamBUtezu BUtezu nityaBUtADruvezu ca । kaTaM hfzyeta jAtezu mftezu ca kaTaM jvaret ॥12॥

text: kuto'hamāgataḥ ko'smi kva gamiṣyāmi kasya vā । kasminsthitaḥ kva bhavitā kasmātkimanuśocasi ॥13॥
html:
kuto'hamāgataḥ ko'smi kva gamiṣyāmi kasya vā ।
kasminsthitaḥ kva bhavitā kasmātkimanuśocasi ॥13॥
slp1: kuto'hamAgataH ko'smi kva gamizyAmi kasya vA । kasminsTitaH kva BavitA kasmAtkimanuSocasi ॥13॥

text: draṣṭā svargasya na hyasti tathaiva narakasya ca । āgamāṃstvanatikramya dadyāccaiva yajeta ca] ॥14॥
html:
draṣṭā svargasya na hyasti tathaiva narakasya ca ।
āgamāṃstvanatikramya dadyāccaiva yajeta ca] ॥14॥
slp1: drazwA svargasya na hyasti taTEva narakasya ca । AgamAMstvanatikramya dadyAccEva yajeta ca] ॥14॥

text: aparityajya gārhasthyaṃ kururājarṣisattama । kaḥ prāpto vinayaṃ buddhyā mokṣatattvaṃ vadasva me ॥1॥
html:
aparityajya gārhasthyaṃ kururājarṣisattama ।
kaḥ prāpto vinayaṃ buddhyā mokṣatattvaṃ vadasva me ॥1॥
slp1: aparityajya gArhasTyaM kururAjarzisattama । kaH prApto vinayaM budDyA mokzatattvaM vadasva me ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: saṃnyasyate yathātmāyaṃ saṃnyastātmā yathā ca yaḥ । paraṃ mokṣasya yaccāpi tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥2॥
html:
saṃnyasyate yathātmāyaṃ saṃnyastātmā yathā ca yaḥ ।
paraṃ mokṣasya yaccāpi tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥2॥
slp1: saMnyasyate yaTAtmAyaM saMnyastAtmA yaTA ca yaH । paraM mokzasya yaccApi tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥2॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । janakasya ca saṃvādaṃ sulabhāyāśca bhārata ॥3॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
janakasya ca saṃvādaṃ sulabhāyāśca bhārata ॥3॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । janakasya ca saMvAdaM sulaBAyASca BArata ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: saṃnyāsaphalikaḥ kaścidbabhūva nṛpatiḥ purā । maithilo janako nāma dharmadhvaja iti śrutaḥ ॥4॥
html:
saṃnyāsaphalikaḥ kaścidbabhūva nṛpatiḥ purā ।
maithilo janako nāma dharmadhvaja iti śrutaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: saMnyAsaPalikaH kaScidbaBUva nfpatiH purA । mETilo janako nAma DarmaDvaja iti SrutaH ॥4॥

text: sa vede mokṣaśāstre ca sve ca śāstre kṛtāgamaḥ । indriyāṇi samādhāya śaśāsa vasudhāmimām ॥5॥
html:
sa vede mokṣaśāstre ca sve ca śāstre kṛtāgamaḥ ।
indriyāṇi samādhāya śaśāsa vasudhāmimām ॥5॥
slp1: sa vede mokzaSAstre ca sve ca SAstre kftAgamaH । indriyARi samADAya SaSAsa vasuDAmimAm ॥5॥

text: tasya vedavidaḥ prājñāḥ śrutvā tāṃ sādhuvṛttatām । lokeṣu spṛhayantyanye puruṣāḥ puruṣeśvara ॥6॥
html:
tasya vedavidaḥ prājñāḥ śrutvā tāṃ sādhuvṛttatām ।
lokeṣu spṛhayantyanye puruṣāḥ puruṣeśvara ॥6॥
slp1: tasya vedavidaH prAjYAH SrutvA tAM sADuvfttatAm । lokezu spfhayantyanye puruzAH puruzeSvara ॥6॥

text: atha dharmayuge tasminyogadharmamanuṣṭhitā । mahīmanucacāraikā sulabhā nāma bhikṣukī ॥7॥
html:
atha dharmayuge tasminyogadharmamanuṣṭhitā ।
mahīmanucacāraikā sulabhā nāma bhikṣukī ॥7॥
slp1: aTa Darmayuge tasminyogaDarmamanuzWitA । mahImanucacArEkA sulaBA nAma BikzukI ॥7॥

text: tayā jagadidaṃ sarvamaṭantyā mithileśvaraḥ । tatra tatra śruto mokṣe kathyamānastridaṇḍibhiḥ ॥8॥
html:
tayā jagadidaṃ sarvamaṭantyā mithileśvaraḥ ।
tatra tatra śruto mokṣe kathyamānastridaṇḍibhiḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tayA jagadidaM sarvamawantyA miTileSvaraH । tatra tatra Sruto mokze kaTyamAnastridaRqiBiH ॥8॥

text: sā susūkṣmāṃ kathāṃ śrutvā tathyaṃ neti sasaṃśayā । darśane jātasaṅkalpā janakasya babhūva ha ॥9॥
html:
sā susūkṣmāṃ kathāṃ śrutvā tathyaṃ neti sasaṃśayā ।
darśane jātasaṅkalpā janakasya babhūva ha ॥9॥
slp1: sA susUkzmAM kaTAM SrutvA taTyaM neti sasaMSayA । darSane jAtasaNkalpA janakasya baBUva ha ॥9॥

text: tataḥ sā viprahāyātha pūrvarūpaṃ hi yogataḥ । abibhradanavadyāṅgī rūpamanyadanuttamam ॥10॥
html:
tataḥ sā viprahāyātha pūrvarūpaṃ hi yogataḥ ।
abibhradanavadyāṅgī rūpamanyadanuttamam ॥10॥
slp1: tataH sA viprahAyATa pUrvarUpaM hi yogataH । abiBradanavadyANgI rUpamanyadanuttamam ॥10॥

text: cakṣurnimeṣamātreṇa laghvastragatigāminī । videhānāṃ purīṃ subhrūrjagāma kamalekṣaṇā ॥11॥
html:
cakṣurnimeṣamātreṇa laghvastragatigāminī ।
videhānāṃ purīṃ subhrūrjagāma kamalekṣaṇā ॥11॥
slp1: cakzurnimezamAtreRa laGvastragatigAminI । videhAnAM purIM suBrUrjagAma kamalekzaRA ॥11॥

text: sā prāpya mithilāṃ ramyāṃ samṛddhajanasaṅkulām । bhaikṣacaryāpadeśena dadarśa mithileśvaram ॥12॥
html:
sā prāpya mithilāṃ ramyāṃ samṛddhajanasaṅkulām ।
bhaikṣacaryāpadeśena dadarśa mithileśvaram ॥12॥
slp1: sA prApya miTilAM ramyAM samfdDajanasaNkulAm । BEkzacaryApadeSena dadarSa miTileSvaram ॥12॥

text: rājā tasyāḥ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā saukumāryaṃ vapustathā । keyaṃ kasya kuto veti babhūvāgatavismayaḥ ॥13॥
html:
rājā tasyāḥ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā saukumāryaṃ vapustathā ।
keyaṃ kasya kuto veti babhūvāgatavismayaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: rAjA tasyAH paraM dfzwvA sOkumAryaM vapustaTA । keyaM kasya kuto veti baBUvAgatavismayaH ॥13॥

text: tato'syāḥ svāgataṃ kṛtvā vyādiśya ca varāsanam । pūjitāṃ pādaśaucena varānnenāpyatarpayat ॥14॥
html:
tato'syāḥ svāgataṃ kṛtvā vyādiśya ca varāsanam ।
pūjitāṃ pādaśaucena varānnenāpyatarpayat ॥14॥
slp1: tato'syAH svAgataM kftvA vyAdiSya ca varAsanam । pUjitAM pAdaSOcena varAnnenApyatarpayat ॥14॥

text: atha bhuktavatī prītā rājānaṃ mantribhirvṛtam । sarvabhāṣyavidāṃ madhye codayāmāsa bhikṣukī ॥15॥
html:
atha bhuktavatī prītā rājānaṃ mantribhirvṛtam ।
sarvabhāṣyavidāṃ madhye codayāmāsa bhikṣukī ॥15॥
slp1: aTa BuktavatI prItA rAjAnaM mantriBirvftam । sarvaBAzyavidAM maDye codayAmAsa BikzukI ॥15॥

text: sulabhā tvasya dharmeṣu mukto neti sasaṃśayā । sattvaṃ sattvena yogajñā praviveśa mahīpate ॥16॥
html:
sulabhā tvasya dharmeṣu mukto neti sasaṃśayā ।
sattvaṃ sattvena yogajñā praviveśa mahīpate ॥16॥
slp1: sulaBA tvasya Darmezu mukto neti sasaMSayA । sattvaM sattvena yogajYA praviveSa mahIpate ॥16॥

text: netrābhyāṃ netrayorasya raśmīnsaṃyojya raśmibhiḥ । sā sma sañcodayiṣyantaṃ yogabandhairbabandha ha ॥17॥
html:
netrābhyāṃ netrayorasya raśmīnsaṃyojya raśmibhiḥ ।
sā sma sañcodayiṣyantaṃ yogabandhairbabandha ha ॥17॥
slp1: netrAByAM netrayorasya raSmInsaMyojya raSmiBiH । sA sma saYcodayizyantaM yogabanDErbabanDa ha ॥17॥

text: janako'pyutsmayanrājā bhāvamasyā viśeṣayan । pratijagrāha bhāvena bhāvamasyā nṛpottamaḥ ॥18॥
html:
janako'pyutsmayanrājā bhāvamasyā viśeṣayan ।
pratijagrāha bhāvena bhāvamasyā nṛpottamaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: janako'pyutsmayanrAjA BAvamasyA viSezayan । pratijagrAha BAvena BAvamasyA nfpottamaH ॥18॥

text: tadekasminnadhiṣṭhāne saṃvādaḥ śrūyatāmayam । chatrādiṣu vimuktasya muktāyāśca tridaṇḍake ॥19॥
html:
tadekasminnadhiṣṭhāne saṃvādaḥ śrūyatāmayam ।
chatrādiṣu vimuktasya muktāyāśca tridaṇḍake ॥19॥
slp1: tadekasminnaDizWAne saMvAdaH SrUyatAmayam । CatrAdizu vimuktasya muktAyASca tridaRqake ॥19॥

text: bhagavatyāḥ kva caryeyaṃ kṛtā kva ca gamiṣyasi । kasya ca tvaṃ kuto veti papracchaināṃ mahīpatiḥ ॥20॥
html:
bhagavatyāḥ kva caryeyaṃ kṛtā kva ca gamiṣyasi ।
kasya ca tvaṃ kuto veti papracchaināṃ mahīpatiḥ ॥20॥
slp1: BagavatyAH kva caryeyaM kftA kva ca gamizyasi । kasya ca tvaM kuto veti papracCEnAM mahIpatiH ॥20॥

text: śrute vayasi jātau ca sadbhāvo nādhigamyate । eṣvartheṣūttaraṃ tasmātpravedyaṃ satsamāgame ॥21॥
html:
śrute vayasi jātau ca sadbhāvo nādhigamyate ।
eṣvartheṣūttaraṃ tasmātpravedyaṃ satsamāgame ॥21॥
slp1: Srute vayasi jAtO ca sadBAvo nADigamyate । ezvarTezUttaraM tasmAtpravedyaM satsamAgame ॥21॥

text: chatrādiṣu viśeṣeṣu muktaṃ māṃ viddhi sarvaśaḥ । sa tvāṃ sammantumicchāmi mānārhāsi matā hi me ॥22॥
html:
chatrādiṣu viśeṣeṣu muktaṃ māṃ viddhi sarvaśaḥ ।
sa tvāṃ sammantumicchāmi mānārhāsi matā hi me ॥22॥
slp1: CatrAdizu viSezezu muktaM mAM vidDi sarvaSaH । sa tvAM sammantumicCAmi mAnArhAsi matA hi me ॥22॥

text: yasmāccaitanmayā prāptaṃ jñānaṃ vaiśeṣikaṃ purā । yasya nānyaḥ pravaktāsti mokṣe tamapi me śṛṇu ॥23॥
html:
yasmāccaitanmayā prāptaṃ jñānaṃ vaiśeṣikaṃ purā ।
yasya nānyaḥ pravaktāsti mokṣe tamapi me śṛṇu ॥23॥
slp1: yasmAccEtanmayA prAptaM jYAnaM vESezikaM purA । yasya nAnyaH pravaktAsti mokze tamapi me SfRu ॥23॥

text: pārāśaryasagotrasya vṛddhasya sumahātmanaḥ । bhikṣoḥ pañcaśikhasyāhaṃ śiṣyaḥ paramasammataḥ ॥24॥
html:
pārāśaryasagotrasya vṛddhasya sumahātmanaḥ ।
bhikṣoḥ pañcaśikhasyāhaṃ śiṣyaḥ paramasammataḥ ॥24॥
slp1: pArASaryasagotrasya vfdDasya sumahAtmanaH । BikzoH paYcaSiKasyAhaM SizyaH paramasammataH ॥24॥

text: sāṅkhyajñāne tathā yoge mahīpālavidhau tathā । trividhe mokṣadharme'smingatādhvā chinnasaṃśayaḥ ॥25॥
html:
sāṅkhyajñāne tathā yoge mahīpālavidhau tathā ।
trividhe mokṣadharme'smingatādhvā chinnasaṃśayaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: sANKyajYAne taTA yoge mahIpAlaviDO taTA । triviDe mokzaDarme'smingatADvA CinnasaMSayaH ॥25॥

text: sa yathāśāstradṛṣṭena mārgeṇeha parivrajan । vārṣikāṃścaturo māsānpurā mayi sukhoṣitaḥ ॥26॥
html:
sa yathāśāstradṛṣṭena mārgeṇeha parivrajan ।
vārṣikāṃścaturo māsānpurā mayi sukhoṣitaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: sa yaTASAstradfzwena mArgeReha parivrajan । vArzikAMScaturo mAsAnpurA mayi suKozitaH ॥26॥

text: tenāhaṃ sāṅkhyamukhyena sudṛṣṭārthena tattvataḥ । śrāvitastrividhaṃ mokṣaṃ na ca rājyādvicālitaḥ ॥27॥
html:
tenāhaṃ sāṅkhyamukhyena sudṛṣṭārthena tattvataḥ ।
śrāvitastrividhaṃ mokṣaṃ na ca rājyādvicālitaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: tenAhaM sANKyamuKyena sudfzwArTena tattvataH । SrAvitastriviDaM mokzaM na ca rAjyAdvicAlitaH ॥27॥

text: so'haṃ tāmakhilāṃ vṛttiṃ trividhāṃ mokṣasaṃhitām । muktarāgaścarāmyekaḥ pade paramake sthitaḥ ॥28॥
html:
so'haṃ tāmakhilāṃ vṛttiṃ trividhāṃ mokṣasaṃhitām ।
muktarāgaścarāmyekaḥ pade paramake sthitaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: so'haM tAmaKilAM vfttiM triviDAM mokzasaMhitAm । muktarAgaScarAmyekaH pade paramake sTitaH ॥28॥

text: vairāgyaṃ punaretasya mokṣasya paramo vidhiḥ । jñānādeva ca vairāgyaṃ jāyate yena mucyate ॥29॥
html:
vairāgyaṃ punaretasya mokṣasya paramo vidhiḥ ।
jñānādeva ca vairāgyaṃ jāyate yena mucyate ॥29॥
slp1: vErAgyaM punaretasya mokzasya paramo viDiH । jYAnAdeva ca vErAgyaM jAyate yena mucyate ॥29॥

text: jñānena kurute yatnaṃ yatnena prāpyate mahat । mahaddvandvapramokṣāya sā siddhiryā vayotigā ॥30॥
html:
jñānena kurute yatnaṃ yatnena prāpyate mahat ।
mahaddvandvapramokṣāya sā siddhiryā vayotigā ॥30॥
slp1: jYAnena kurute yatnaM yatnena prApyate mahat । mahaddvandvapramokzAya sA sidDiryA vayotigA ॥30॥

text: seyaṃ paramikā buddhiḥ prāptā nirdvandvatā mayā । ihaiva gatamohena caratā muktasaṅginā ॥31॥
html:
seyaṃ paramikā buddhiḥ prāptā nirdvandvatā mayā ।
ihaiva gatamohena caratā muktasaṅginā ॥31॥
slp1: seyaM paramikA budDiH prAptA nirdvandvatA mayA । ihEva gatamohena caratA muktasaNginA ॥31॥

text: yathā kṣetraṃ mṛdūbhūtamadbhirāplāvitaṃ tathā । janayatyaṅkuraṃ karma nṛṇāṃ tadvatpunarbhavam ॥32॥
html:
yathā kṣetraṃ mṛdūbhūtamadbhirāplāvitaṃ tathā ।
janayatyaṅkuraṃ karma nṛṇāṃ tadvatpunarbhavam ॥32॥
slp1: yaTA kzetraM mfdUBUtamadBirAplAvitaM taTA । janayatyaNkuraM karma nfRAM tadvatpunarBavam ॥32॥

text: yathā cottāpitaṃ bījaṃ kapāle yatra tatra vā । prāpyāpyaṅkurahetutvamabījatvānna jāyate ॥33॥
html:
yathā cottāpitaṃ bījaṃ kapāle yatra tatra vā ।
prāpyāpyaṅkurahetutvamabījatvānna jāyate ॥33॥
slp1: yaTA cottApitaM bIjaM kapAle yatra tatra vA । prApyApyaNkurahetutvamabIjatvAnna jAyate ॥33॥

text: tadvadbhagavatā tena śikhāproktena bhikṣuṇā । jñānaṃ kṛtamabījaṃ me viṣayeṣu na jāyate ॥34॥
html:
tadvadbhagavatā tena śikhāproktena bhikṣuṇā ।
jñānaṃ kṛtamabījaṃ me viṣayeṣu na jāyate ॥34॥
slp1: tadvadBagavatA tena SiKAproktena BikzuRA । jYAnaM kftamabIjaM me vizayezu na jAyate ॥34॥

text: nābhiṣajjati kasmiṃścinnānarthe na parigrahe । nābhirajyati caiteṣu vyarthatvādrāgadoṣayoḥ ॥35॥
html:
nābhiṣajjati kasmiṃścinnānarthe na parigrahe ।
nābhirajyati caiteṣu vyarthatvādrāgadoṣayoḥ ॥35॥
slp1: nABizajjati kasmiMScinnAnarTe na parigrahe । nABirajyati cEtezu vyarTatvAdrAgadozayoH ॥35॥

text: yaśca me dakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ candanena samukṣayet । savyaṃ vāsyā ca yastakṣetsamāvetāvubhau mama ॥36॥
html:
yaśca me dakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ candanena samukṣayet ।
savyaṃ vāsyā ca yastakṣetsamāvetāvubhau mama ॥36॥
slp1: yaSca me dakziRaM bAhuM candanena samukzayet । savyaM vAsyA ca yastakzetsamAvetAvuBO mama ॥36॥

text: sukhī so'hamavāptārthaḥ samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ । muktasaṅgaḥ sthito rājye viśiṣṭo'nyaistridaṇḍibhiḥ ॥37॥
html:
sukhī so'hamavāptārthaḥ samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ ।
muktasaṅgaḥ sthito rājye viśiṣṭo'nyaistridaṇḍibhiḥ ॥37॥
slp1: suKI so'hamavAptArTaH samalozwASmakAYcanaH । muktasaNgaH sTito rAjye viSizwo'nyEstridaRqiBiH ॥37॥

text: mokṣe hi trividhā niṣṭhā dṛṣṭā pūrvairmaharṣibhiḥ । jñānaṃ lokottaraṃ yacca sarvatyāgaśca karmaṇām ॥38॥
html:
mokṣe hi trividhā niṣṭhā dṛṣṭā pūrvairmaharṣibhiḥ ।
jñānaṃ lokottaraṃ yacca sarvatyāgaśca karmaṇām ॥38॥
slp1: mokze hi triviDA nizWA dfzwA pUrvErmaharziBiH । jYAnaM lokottaraM yacca sarvatyAgaSca karmaRAm ॥38॥

text: jñānaniṣṭhāṃ vadantyeke mokṣaśāstravido janāḥ । karmaniṣṭhāṃ tathaivānye yatayaḥ sūkṣmadarśinaḥ ॥39॥
html:
jñānaniṣṭhāṃ vadantyeke mokṣaśāstravido janāḥ ।
karmaniṣṭhāṃ tathaivānye yatayaḥ sūkṣmadarśinaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: jYAnanizWAM vadantyeke mokzaSAstravido janAH । karmanizWAM taTEvAnye yatayaH sUkzmadarSinaH ॥39॥

text: prahāyobhayamapyetajjñānaṃ karma ca kevalam । tṛtīyeyaṃ samākhyātā niṣṭhā tena mahātmanā ॥40॥
html:
prahāyobhayamapyetajjñānaṃ karma ca kevalam ।
tṛtīyeyaṃ samākhyātā niṣṭhā tena mahātmanā ॥40॥
slp1: prahAyoBayamapyetajjYAnaM karma ca kevalam । tftIyeyaM samAKyAtA nizWA tena mahAtmanA ॥40॥

text: yame ca niyame caiva dveṣe kāme parigrahe । māne dambhe tathā snehe sadṛśāste kuṭumbibhiḥ ॥41॥
html:
yame ca niyame caiva dveṣe kāme parigrahe ।
māne dambhe tathā snehe sadṛśāste kuṭumbibhiḥ ॥41॥
slp1: yame ca niyame cEva dveze kAme parigrahe । mAne damBe taTA snehe sadfSAste kuwumbiBiH ॥41॥

text: tridaṇḍādiṣu yadyasti mokṣo jñānena kenacit । chatrādiṣu kathaṃ na syāttulyahetau parigrahe ॥42॥
html:
tridaṇḍādiṣu yadyasti mokṣo jñānena kenacit ।
chatrādiṣu kathaṃ na syāttulyahetau parigrahe ॥42॥
slp1: tridaRqAdizu yadyasti mokzo jYAnena kenacit । CatrAdizu kaTaM na syAttulyahetO parigrahe ॥42॥

text: yena yena hi yasyārthaḥ kāraṇeneha kasyacit । tattadālambate dravyaṃ sarvaḥ sve sve parigrahe ॥43॥
html:
yena yena hi yasyārthaḥ kāraṇeneha kasyacit ।
tattadālambate dravyaṃ sarvaḥ sve sve parigrahe ॥43॥
slp1: yena yena hi yasyArTaH kAraReneha kasyacit । tattadAlambate dravyaM sarvaH sve sve parigrahe ॥43॥

text: doṣadarśī tu gārhasthye yo vrajatyāśramāntaram । utsṛjanparigṛhṇaṃśca so'pi saṅgānna mucyate ॥44॥
html:
doṣadarśī tu gārhasthye yo vrajatyāśramāntaram ।
utsṛjanparigṛhṇaṃśca so'pi saṅgānna mucyate ॥44॥
slp1: dozadarSI tu gArhasTye yo vrajatyASramAntaram । utsfjanparigfhRaMSca so'pi saNgAnna mucyate ॥44॥

text: ādhipatye tathā tulye nigrahānugrahātmani । rājarṣibhikṣukācāryā mucyante kena hetunā ॥45॥
html:
ādhipatye tathā tulye nigrahānugrahātmani ।
rājarṣibhikṣukācāryā mucyante kena hetunā ॥45॥
slp1: ADipatye taTA tulye nigrahAnugrahAtmani । rAjarziBikzukAcAryA mucyante kena hetunA ॥45॥

text: atha satyādhipatye'pi jñānenaiveha kevalam । mucyante kiṃ na mucyante pade paramake sthitāḥ ॥46॥
html:
atha satyādhipatye'pi jñānenaiveha kevalam ।
mucyante kiṃ na mucyante pade paramake sthitāḥ ॥46॥
slp1: aTa satyADipatye'pi jYAnenEveha kevalam । mucyante kiM na mucyante pade paramake sTitAH ॥46॥

text: kāṣāyadhāraṇaṃ mauṇḍyaṃ triviṣṭabdhaḥ kamaṇḍaluḥ । liṅgānyatyarthametāni na mokṣāyeti me matiḥ ॥47॥
html:
kāṣāyadhāraṇaṃ mauṇḍyaṃ triviṣṭabdhaḥ kamaṇḍaluḥ ।
liṅgānyatyarthametāni na mokṣāyeti me matiḥ ॥47॥
slp1: kAzAyaDAraRaM mORqyaM trivizwabDaH kamaRqaluH । liNgAnyatyarTametAni na mokzAyeti me matiH ॥47॥

text: yadi satyapi liṅge'smiñjñānamevātra kāraṇam । nirmokṣāyeha duḥkhasya liṅgamātraṃ nirarthakam ॥48॥
html:
yadi satyapi liṅge'smiñjñānamevātra kāraṇam ।
nirmokṣāyeha duḥkhasya liṅgamātraṃ nirarthakam ॥48॥
slp1: yadi satyapi liNge'smiYjYAnamevAtra kAraRam । nirmokzAyeha duHKasya liNgamAtraM nirarTakam ॥48॥

text: atha vā duḥkhaśaithilyaṃ vīkṣya liṅge kṛtā matiḥ । kiṃ tadevārthasāmānyaṃ chatrādiṣu na lakṣyate ॥49॥
html:
atha vā duḥkhaśaithilyaṃ vīkṣya liṅge kṛtā matiḥ ।
kiṃ tadevārthasāmānyaṃ chatrādiṣu na lakṣyate ॥49॥
slp1: aTa vA duHKaSETilyaM vIkzya liNge kftA matiH । kiM tadevArTasAmAnyaM CatrAdizu na lakzyate ॥49॥

text: ākiñcanye na mokṣo'sti kaiñcanye nāsti bandhanam । kaiñcanye cetare caiva janturjñānena mucyate ॥50॥
html:
ākiñcanye na mokṣo'sti kaiñcanye nāsti bandhanam ।
kaiñcanye cetare caiva janturjñānena mucyate ॥50॥
slp1: AkiYcanye na mokzo'sti kEYcanye nAsti banDanam । kEYcanye cetare cEva janturjYAnena mucyate ॥50॥

text: tasmāddharmārthakāmeṣu tathā rājyaparigrahe । bandhanāyataneṣveṣu viddhyabandhe pade sthitam ॥51॥
html:
tasmāddharmārthakāmeṣu tathā rājyaparigrahe ।
bandhanāyataneṣveṣu viddhyabandhe pade sthitam ॥51॥
slp1: tasmAdDarmArTakAmezu taTA rAjyaparigrahe । banDanAyatanezvezu vidDyabanDe pade sTitam ॥51॥

text: rājyaiśvaryamayaḥ pāśaḥ snehāyatanabandhanaḥ । mokṣāśmaniśiteneha chinnastyāgāsinā mayā ॥52॥
html:
rājyaiśvaryamayaḥ pāśaḥ snehāyatanabandhanaḥ ।
mokṣāśmaniśiteneha chinnastyāgāsinā mayā ॥52॥
slp1: rAjyESvaryamayaH pASaH snehAyatanabanDanaH । mokzASmaniSiteneha CinnastyAgAsinA mayA ॥52॥

text: so'hamevaṅgato mukto jātāsthastvayi bhikṣuki । ayathārtho hi te varṇo vakṣyāmi śṛṇu tanmama ॥53॥
html:
so'hamevaṅgato mukto jātāsthastvayi bhikṣuki ।
ayathārtho hi te varṇo vakṣyāmi śṛṇu tanmama ॥53॥
slp1: so'hamevaNgato mukto jAtAsTastvayi Bikzuki । ayaTArTo hi te varRo vakzyAmi SfRu tanmama ॥53॥

text: saukumāryaṃ tathā rūpaṃ vapuragryaṃ tathā vayaḥ । tavaitāni samastāni niyamaśceti saṃśayaḥ ॥54॥
html:
saukumāryaṃ tathā rūpaṃ vapuragryaṃ tathā vayaḥ ।
tavaitāni samastāni niyamaśceti saṃśayaḥ ॥54॥
slp1: sOkumAryaM taTA rUpaM vapuragryaM taTA vayaH । tavEtAni samastAni niyamaSceti saMSayaH ॥54॥

text: yaccāpyananurūpaṃ te liṅgasyāsya viceṣṭitam । mukto'yaṃ syānna vetyasmāddharṣito matparigrahaḥ ॥55॥
html:
yaccāpyananurūpaṃ te liṅgasyāsya viceṣṭitam ।
mukto'yaṃ syānna vetyasmāddharṣito matparigrahaḥ ॥55॥
slp1: yaccApyananurUpaM te liNgasyAsya vicezwitam । mukto'yaM syAnna vetyasmAdDarzito matparigrahaH ॥55॥

text: na ca kāmasamāyukte mukte'pyasti tridaṇḍakam । na rakṣyate tvayā cedaṃ na muktasyāsti gopanā ॥56॥
html:
na ca kāmasamāyukte mukte'pyasti tridaṇḍakam ।
na rakṣyate tvayā cedaṃ na muktasyāsti gopanā ॥56॥
slp1: na ca kAmasamAyukte mukte'pyasti tridaRqakam । na rakzyate tvayA cedaM na muktasyAsti gopanA ॥56॥

text: matpakṣasaṃśrayāccāyaṃ śṛṇu yaste vyatikramaḥ । āśrayantyāḥ svabhāvena mama pūrvaparigraham ॥57॥
html:
matpakṣasaṃśrayāccāyaṃ śṛṇu yaste vyatikramaḥ ।
āśrayantyāḥ svabhāvena mama pūrvaparigraham ॥57॥
slp1: matpakzasaMSrayAccAyaM SfRu yaste vyatikramaH । ASrayantyAH svaBAvena mama pUrvaparigraham ॥57॥

text: praveśaste kṛtaḥ kena mama rāṣṭre pure tathā । kasya vā saṃnisargāttvaṃ praviṣṭā hṛdayaṃ mama ॥58॥
html:
praveśaste kṛtaḥ kena mama rāṣṭre pure tathā ।
kasya vā saṃnisargāttvaṃ praviṣṭā hṛdayaṃ mama ॥58॥
slp1: praveSaste kftaH kena mama rAzwre pure taTA । kasya vA saMnisargAttvaM pravizwA hfdayaM mama ॥58॥

text: varṇapravaramukhyāsi brāhmaṇī kṣatriyo hyaham । nāvayorekayogo'sti mā kṛthā varṇasaṅkaram ॥59॥
html:
varṇapravaramukhyāsi brāhmaṇī kṣatriyo hyaham ।
nāvayorekayogo'sti mā kṛthā varṇasaṅkaram ॥59॥
slp1: varRapravaramuKyAsi brAhmaRI kzatriyo hyaham । nAvayorekayogo'sti mA kfTA varRasaNkaram ॥59॥

text: vartase mokṣadharmeṣu gārhasthye tvahamāśrame । ayaṃ cāpi sukaṣṭaste dvitīyo''śramasaṅkaraḥ ॥60॥
html:
vartase mokṣadharmeṣu gārhasthye tvahamāśrame ।
ayaṃ cāpi sukaṣṭaste dvitīyo''śramasaṅkaraḥ ॥60॥
slp1: vartase mokzaDarmezu gArhasTye tvahamASrame । ayaM cApi sukazwaste dvitIyo''SramasaNkaraH ॥60॥

text: sagotrāṃ vāsagotrāṃ vā na veda tvāṃ na vettha mām । sagotramāviśantyāste tṛtīyo gotrasaṅkaraḥ ॥61॥
html:
sagotrāṃ vāsagotrāṃ vā na veda tvāṃ na vettha mām ।
sagotramāviśantyāste tṛtīyo gotrasaṅkaraḥ ॥61॥
slp1: sagotrAM vAsagotrAM vA na veda tvAM na vetTa mAm । sagotramAviSantyAste tftIyo gotrasaNkaraH ॥61॥

text: atha jīvati te bhartā proṣito'pyatha vā kvacit । agamyā parabhāryeti caturtho dharmasaṅkaraḥ ॥62॥
html:
atha jīvati te bhartā proṣito'pyatha vā kvacit ।
agamyā parabhāryeti caturtho dharmasaṅkaraḥ ॥62॥
slp1: aTa jIvati te BartA prozito'pyaTa vA kvacit । agamyA paraBAryeti caturTo DarmasaNkaraH ॥62॥

text: sā tvametānyakāryāṇi kāryāpekṣā vyavasyasi । avijñānena vā yuktā mithyājñānena vā punaḥ ॥63॥
html:
sā tvametānyakāryāṇi kāryāpekṣā vyavasyasi ।
avijñānena vā yuktā mithyājñānena vā punaḥ ॥63॥
slp1: sA tvametAnyakAryARi kAryApekzA vyavasyasi । avijYAnena vA yuktA miTyAjYAnena vA punaH ॥63॥

text: atha vāpi svatantrāsi svadoṣeṇeha kenacit । yadi kiñcicchrutaṃ te'sti sarvaṃ kṛtamanarthakam ॥64॥
html:
atha vāpi svatantrāsi svadoṣeṇeha kenacit ।
yadi kiñcicchrutaṃ te'sti sarvaṃ kṛtamanarthakam ॥64॥
slp1: aTa vApi svatantrAsi svadozeReha kenacit । yadi kiYcicCrutaM te'sti sarvaM kftamanarTakam ॥64॥

text: idamanyattṛtīyaṃ te bhāvasparśavighātakam । duṣṭāyā lakṣyate liṅgaṃ pravaktavyaṃ prakāśitam ॥65॥
html:
idamanyattṛtīyaṃ te bhāvasparśavighātakam ।
duṣṭāyā lakṣyate liṅgaṃ pravaktavyaṃ prakāśitam ॥65॥
slp1: idamanyattftIyaM te BAvasparSaviGAtakam । duzwAyA lakzyate liNgaM pravaktavyaM prakASitam ॥65॥

text: na mayyevābhisandhiste jayaiṣiṇyā jaye kṛtaḥ । yeyaṃ matpariṣatkṛtsnā jetumicchasi tāmapi ॥66॥
html:
na mayyevābhisandhiste jayaiṣiṇyā jaye kṛtaḥ ।
yeyaṃ matpariṣatkṛtsnā jetumicchasi tāmapi ॥66॥
slp1: na mayyevABisanDiste jayEziRyA jaye kftaH । yeyaM matparizatkftsnA jetumicCasi tAmapi ॥66॥

text: tathā hyevaṃ punaśca tvaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ svāṃ pratimuñcasi । matpakṣapratighātāya svapakṣodbhāvanāya ca ॥67॥
html:
tathā hyevaṃ punaśca tvaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ svāṃ pratimuñcasi ।
matpakṣapratighātāya svapakṣodbhāvanāya ca ॥67॥
slp1: taTA hyevaM punaSca tvaM dfzwiM svAM pratimuYcasi । matpakzapratiGAtAya svapakzodBAvanAya ca ॥67॥

text: sā svenāmarṣajena tvamṛddhimohena mohitā । bhūyaḥ sṛjasi yogāstraṃ viṣāmṛtamivaikadhā ॥68॥
html:
sā svenāmarṣajena tvamṛddhimohena mohitā ।
bhūyaḥ sṛjasi yogāstraṃ viṣāmṛtamivaikadhā ॥68॥
slp1: sA svenAmarzajena tvamfdDimohena mohitA । BUyaH sfjasi yogAstraM vizAmftamivEkaDA ॥68॥

text: icchatorhi dvayorlābhaḥ strīpuṃsoramṛtopamaḥ । alābhaścāpyaraktasya so'tra doṣo viṣopamaḥ ॥69॥
html:
icchatorhi dvayorlābhaḥ strīpuṃsoramṛtopamaḥ ।
alābhaścāpyaraktasya so'tra doṣo viṣopamaḥ ॥69॥
slp1: icCatorhi dvayorlABaH strIpuMsoramftopamaH । alABaScApyaraktasya so'tra dozo vizopamaH ॥69॥

text: mā sprākṣīḥ sādhu jānīṣva svaśāstramanupālaya । kṛteyaṃ hi vijijñāsā mukto neti tvayā mama । etatsarvaṃ praticchannaṃ mayi nārhasi gūhitum ॥70॥
html:
mā sprākṣīḥ sādhu jānīṣva svaśāstramanupālaya ।
kṛteyaṃ hi vijijñāsā mukto neti tvayā mama ।
etatsarvaṃ praticchannaṃ mayi nārhasi gūhitum ॥70॥
slp1: mA sprAkzIH sADu jAnIzva svaSAstramanupAlaya । kfteyaM hi vijijYAsA mukto neti tvayA mama । etatsarvaM praticCannaM mayi nArhasi gUhitum ॥70॥

text: sā yadi tvaṃ svakāryeṇa yadyanyasya mahīpateḥ । tattvaṃ satrapraticchannā mayi nārhasi gūhitum ॥71॥
html:
sā yadi tvaṃ svakāryeṇa yadyanyasya mahīpateḥ ।
tattvaṃ satrapraticchannā mayi nārhasi gūhitum ॥71॥
slp1: sA yadi tvaM svakAryeRa yadyanyasya mahIpateH । tattvaM satrapraticCannA mayi nArhasi gUhitum ॥71॥

text: na rājānaṃ mṛṣā gacchenna dvijātiṃ kathañcana । na striyaṃ strīguṇopetāṃ hanyurhyete mṛṣāgatāḥ ॥72॥
html:
na rājānaṃ mṛṣā gacchenna dvijātiṃ kathañcana ।
na striyaṃ strīguṇopetāṃ hanyurhyete mṛṣāgatāḥ ॥72॥
slp1: na rAjAnaM mfzA gacCenna dvijAtiM kaTaYcana । na striyaM strIguRopetAM hanyurhyete mfzAgatAH ॥72॥

text: rājñāṃ hi balamaiśvaryaṃ brahma brahmavidāṃ balam । rūpayauvanasaubhāgyaṃ strīṇāṃ balamanuttamam ॥73॥
html:
rājñāṃ hi balamaiśvaryaṃ brahma brahmavidāṃ balam ।
rūpayauvanasaubhāgyaṃ strīṇāṃ balamanuttamam ॥73॥
slp1: rAjYAM hi balamESvaryaM brahma brahmavidAM balam । rUpayOvanasOBAgyaM strIRAM balamanuttamam ॥73॥

text: ata etairbalairete balinaḥ svārthamicchatā । ārjavenābhigantavyā vināśāya hyanārjavam ॥74॥
html:
ata etairbalairete balinaḥ svārthamicchatā ।
ārjavenābhigantavyā vināśāya hyanārjavam ॥74॥
slp1: ata etErbalErete balinaH svArTamicCatA । ArjavenABigantavyA vinASAya hyanArjavam ॥74॥

text: sā tvaṃ jātiṃ śrutaṃ vṛttaṃ bhāvaṃ prakṛtimātmanaḥ । kṛtyamāgamane caiva vaktumarhasi tattvataḥ ॥75॥
html:
sā tvaṃ jātiṃ śrutaṃ vṛttaṃ bhāvaṃ prakṛtimātmanaḥ ।
kṛtyamāgamane caiva vaktumarhasi tattvataḥ ॥75॥
slp1: sA tvaM jAtiM SrutaM vfttaM BAvaM prakftimAtmanaH । kftyamAgamane cEva vaktumarhasi tattvataH ॥75॥

text: ityetairasukhairvākyairayuktairasamañjasaiḥ । pratyādiṣṭā narendreṇa sulabhā na vyakampata ॥76॥
html:
ityetairasukhairvākyairayuktairasamañjasaiḥ ।
pratyādiṣṭā narendreṇa sulabhā na vyakampata ॥76॥
slp1: ityetErasuKErvAkyErayuktErasamaYjasEH । pratyAdizwA narendreRa sulaBA na vyakampata ॥76॥

text: uktavākye tu nṛpatau sulabhā cārudarśanā । tataścārutaraṃ vākyaṃ pracakrāmātha bhāṣitum ॥77॥
html:
uktavākye tu nṛpatau sulabhā cārudarśanā ।
tataścārutaraṃ vākyaṃ pracakrāmātha bhāṣitum ॥77॥
slp1: uktavAkye tu nfpatO sulaBA cArudarSanA । tataScArutaraM vAkyaM pracakrAmATa BAzitum ॥77॥

text: navabhirnavabhiścaiva doṣairvāgbuddhidūṣaṇaiḥ । apetamupapannārthamaṣṭādaśaguṇānvitam ॥78॥
html:
navabhirnavabhiścaiva doṣairvāgbuddhidūṣaṇaiḥ ।
apetamupapannārthamaṣṭādaśaguṇānvitam ॥78॥
slp1: navaBirnavaBiScEva dozErvAgbudDidUzaREH । apetamupapannArTamazwAdaSaguRAnvitam ॥78॥

text: saukṣmyaṃ saṅkhyākramau cobhau nirṇayaḥ saprayojanaḥ । pañcaitānyarthajātāni vākyamityucyate nṛpa ॥79॥
html:
saukṣmyaṃ saṅkhyākramau cobhau nirṇayaḥ saprayojanaḥ ।
pañcaitānyarthajātāni vākyamityucyate nṛpa ॥79॥
slp1: sOkzmyaM saNKyAkramO coBO nirRayaH saprayojanaH । paYcEtAnyarTajAtAni vAkyamityucyate nfpa ॥79॥

text: eṣāmekaikaśo'rthānāṃ saukṣmyādīnāṃ sulakṣaṇam । śṛṇu saṃsāryamāṇānāṃ padārthaiḥ padavākyataḥ ॥80॥
html:
eṣāmekaikaśo'rthānāṃ saukṣmyādīnāṃ sulakṣaṇam ।
śṛṇu saṃsāryamāṇānāṃ padārthaiḥ padavākyataḥ ॥80॥
slp1: ezAmekEkaSo'rTAnAM sOkzmyAdInAM sulakzaRam । SfRu saMsAryamARAnAM padArTEH padavAkyataH ॥80॥

text: jñānaṃ jñeyeṣu bhinneṣu yathābhedena vartate । tatrātiśayinī buddhistatsaukṣmyamiti vartate ॥81॥
html:
jñānaṃ jñeyeṣu bhinneṣu yathābhedena vartate ।
tatrātiśayinī buddhistatsaukṣmyamiti vartate ॥81॥
slp1: jYAnaM jYeyezu Binnezu yaTABedena vartate । tatrAtiSayinI budDistatsOkzmyamiti vartate ॥81॥

text: doṣāṇāṃ ca guṇānāṃ ca pramāṇaṃ pravibhāgaśaḥ । kañcidarthamabhipretya sā saṅkhyetyupadhāryatām ॥82॥
html:
doṣāṇāṃ ca guṇānāṃ ca pramāṇaṃ pravibhāgaśaḥ ।
kañcidarthamabhipretya sā saṅkhyetyupadhāryatām ॥82॥
slp1: dozARAM ca guRAnAM ca pramARaM praviBAgaSaH । kaYcidarTamaBipretya sA saNKyetyupaDAryatAm ॥82॥

text: idaṃ pūrvamidaṃ paścādvaktavyaṃ yadvivakṣitam । kramayogaṃ tamapyāhurvākyaṃ vākyavido janāḥ ॥83॥
html:
idaṃ pūrvamidaṃ paścādvaktavyaṃ yadvivakṣitam ।
kramayogaṃ tamapyāhurvākyaṃ vākyavido janāḥ ॥83॥
slp1: idaM pUrvamidaM paScAdvaktavyaM yadvivakzitam । kramayogaM tamapyAhurvAkyaM vAkyavido janAH ॥83॥

text: dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu pratijñāya viśeṣataḥ । idaṃ taditi vākyānte procyate sa vinirṇayaḥ ॥84॥
html:
dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu pratijñāya viśeṣataḥ ।
idaṃ taditi vākyānte procyate sa vinirṇayaḥ ॥84॥
slp1: DarmArTakAmamokzezu pratijYAya viSezataH । idaM taditi vAkyAnte procyate sa vinirRayaH ॥84॥

text: icchādveṣabhavairduḥkhaiḥ prakarṣo yatra jāyate । tatra yā nṛpate vṛttistatprayojanamiṣyate ॥85॥
html:
icchādveṣabhavairduḥkhaiḥ prakarṣo yatra jāyate ।
tatra yā nṛpate vṛttistatprayojanamiṣyate ॥85॥
slp1: icCAdvezaBavErduHKEH prakarzo yatra jAyate । tatra yA nfpate vfttistatprayojanamizyate ॥85॥

text: tānyetāni yathoktāni saukṣmyādīni janādhipa । ekārthasamavetāni vākyaṃ mama niśāmaya ॥86॥
html:
tānyetāni yathoktāni saukṣmyādīni janādhipa ।
ekārthasamavetāni vākyaṃ mama niśāmaya ॥86॥
slp1: tAnyetAni yaToktAni sOkzmyAdIni janADipa । ekArTasamavetAni vAkyaM mama niSAmaya ॥86॥

text: upetārthamabhinnārthaṃ nāpavṛttaṃ na cādhikam । nāślakṣṇaṃ na ca sandigdhaṃ vakṣyāmi paramaṃ tava ॥87॥
html:
upetārthamabhinnārthaṃ nāpavṛttaṃ na cādhikam ।
nāślakṣṇaṃ na ca sandigdhaṃ vakṣyāmi paramaṃ tava ॥87॥
slp1: upetArTamaBinnArTaM nApavfttaM na cADikam । nASlakzRaM na ca sandigDaM vakzyAmi paramaM tava ॥87॥

text: na gurvakṣarasambaddhaṃ parāṅmukhamukhaṃ na ca । nānṛtaṃ na trivargeṇa viruddhaṃ nāpyasaṃskṛtam ॥88॥
html:
na gurvakṣarasambaddhaṃ parāṅmukhamukhaṃ na ca ।
nānṛtaṃ na trivargeṇa viruddhaṃ nāpyasaṃskṛtam ॥88॥
slp1: na gurvakzarasambadDaM parANmuKamuKaM na ca । nAnftaM na trivargeRa virudDaM nApyasaMskftam ॥88॥

text: na nyūnaṃ kaṣṭaśabdaṃ vā vyutkramābhihitaṃ na ca । na śeṣaṃ nānukalpena niṣkāraṇamahetukam ॥89॥
html:
na nyūnaṃ kaṣṭaśabdaṃ vā vyutkramābhihitaṃ na ca ।
na śeṣaṃ nānukalpena niṣkāraṇamahetukam ॥89॥
slp1: na nyUnaM kazwaSabdaM vA vyutkramABihitaM na ca । na SezaM nAnukalpena nizkAraRamahetukam ॥89॥

text: kāmātkrodhādbhayāllobhāddainyādānāryakāttathā । hrīto'nukrośato mānānna vakṣyāmi kathañcana ॥90॥
html:
kāmātkrodhādbhayāllobhāddainyādānāryakāttathā ।
hrīto'nukrośato mānānna vakṣyāmi kathañcana ॥90॥
slp1: kAmAtkroDAdBayAlloBAddEnyAdAnAryakAttaTA । hrIto'nukroSato mAnAnna vakzyAmi kaTaYcana ॥90॥

text: vaktā śrotā ca vākyaṃ ca yadā tvavikalaṃ nṛpa । samameti vivakṣāyāṃ tadā so'rthaḥ prakāśate ॥91॥
html:
vaktā śrotā ca vākyaṃ ca yadā tvavikalaṃ nṛpa ।
samameti vivakṣāyāṃ tadā so'rthaḥ prakāśate ॥91॥
slp1: vaktA SrotA ca vAkyaM ca yadA tvavikalaM nfpa । samameti vivakzAyAM tadA so'rTaH prakASate ॥91॥

text: vaktavye tu yadā vaktā śrotāramavamanyate । svārthamāha parārthaṃ vā tadā vākyaṃ na rohati ॥92॥
html:
vaktavye tu yadā vaktā śrotāramavamanyate ।
svārthamāha parārthaṃ vā tadā vākyaṃ na rohati ॥92॥
slp1: vaktavye tu yadA vaktA SrotAramavamanyate । svArTamAha parArTaM vA tadA vAkyaM na rohati ॥92॥

text: atha yaḥ svārthamutsṛjya parārthaṃ prāha mānavaḥ । viśaṅkā jāyate tasminvākyaṃ tadapi doṣavat ॥93॥
html:
atha yaḥ svārthamutsṛjya parārthaṃ prāha mānavaḥ ।
viśaṅkā jāyate tasminvākyaṃ tadapi doṣavat ॥93॥
slp1: aTa yaH svArTamutsfjya parArTaM prAha mAnavaH । viSaNkA jAyate tasminvAkyaM tadapi dozavat ॥93॥

text: yastu vaktā dvayorarthamaviruddhaṃ prabhāṣate । śrotuścaivātmanaścaiva sa vaktā netaro nṛpa ॥94॥
html:
yastu vaktā dvayorarthamaviruddhaṃ prabhāṣate ।
śrotuścaivātmanaścaiva sa vaktā netaro nṛpa ॥94॥
slp1: yastu vaktA dvayorarTamavirudDaM praBAzate । SrotuScEvAtmanaScEva sa vaktA netaro nfpa ॥94॥

text: tadarthavadidaṃ vākyamupetaṃ vākyasampadā । avikṣiptamanā rājannekāgraḥ śrotumarhasi ॥95॥
html:
tadarthavadidaṃ vākyamupetaṃ vākyasampadā ।
avikṣiptamanā rājannekāgraḥ śrotumarhasi ॥95॥
slp1: tadarTavadidaM vAkyamupetaM vAkyasampadA । avikziptamanA rAjannekAgraH Srotumarhasi ॥95॥

text: kāsi kasya kuto veti tvayāhamabhicoditā । tatrottaramidaṃ vākyaṃ rājannekamanāḥ śṛṇu ॥96॥
html:
kāsi kasya kuto veti tvayāhamabhicoditā ।
tatrottaramidaṃ vākyaṃ rājannekamanāḥ śṛṇu ॥96॥
slp1: kAsi kasya kuto veti tvayAhamaBicoditA । tatrottaramidaM vAkyaM rAjannekamanAH SfRu ॥96॥

text: yathā jatu ca kāṣṭhaṃ ca pāṃsavaścodabindubhiḥ । suśliṣṭāni tathā rājanprāṇināmiha sambhavaḥ ॥97॥
html:
yathā jatu ca kāṣṭhaṃ ca pāṃsavaścodabindubhiḥ ।
suśliṣṭāni tathā rājanprāṇināmiha sambhavaḥ ॥97॥
slp1: yaTA jatu ca kAzWaM ca pAMsavaScodabinduBiH । suSlizwAni taTA rAjanprARinAmiha samBavaH ॥97॥

text: śabdaḥ sparśo raso rūpaṃ gandhaḥ pañcendriyāṇi ca । pṛthagātmā daśātmānaḥ saṃśliṣṭā jatukāṣṭhavat ॥98॥
html:
śabdaḥ sparśo raso rūpaṃ gandhaḥ pañcendriyāṇi ca ।
pṛthagātmā daśātmānaḥ saṃśliṣṭā jatukāṣṭhavat ॥98॥
slp1: SabdaH sparSo raso rUpaM ganDaH paYcendriyARi ca । pfTagAtmA daSAtmAnaH saMSlizwA jatukAzWavat ॥98॥

text: na caiṣāṃ codanā kācidastītyeṣa viniścayaḥ । ekaikasyeha vijñānaṃ nāstyātmani tathā pare ॥99॥
html:
na caiṣāṃ codanā kācidastītyeṣa viniścayaḥ ।
ekaikasyeha vijñānaṃ nāstyātmani tathā pare ॥99॥
slp1: na cEzAM codanA kAcidastItyeza viniScayaH । ekEkasyeha vijYAnaM nAstyAtmani taTA pare ॥99॥

text: na veda cakṣuścakṣuṣṭvaṃ śrotraṃ nātmani vartate । tathaiva vyabhicāreṇa na vartante parasparam । saṃśliṣṭā nābhijāyante yathāpa iha pāṃsavaḥ ॥100॥
html:
na veda cakṣuścakṣuṣṭvaṃ śrotraṃ nātmani vartate ।
tathaiva vyabhicāreṇa na vartante parasparam ।
saṃśliṣṭā nābhijāyante yathāpa iha pāṃsavaḥ ॥100॥
slp1: na veda cakzuScakzuzwvaM SrotraM nAtmani vartate । taTEva vyaBicAreRa na vartante parasparam । saMSlizwA nABijAyante yaTApa iha pAMsavaH ॥100॥

text: bāhyānanyānapekṣante guṇāṃstānapi me śṛṇu । rūpaṃ cakṣuḥ prakāśaśca darśane hetavastrayaḥ । yathaivātra tathānyeṣu jñānajñeyeṣu hetavaḥ ॥101॥
html:
bāhyānanyānapekṣante guṇāṃstānapi me śṛṇu ।
rūpaṃ cakṣuḥ prakāśaśca darśane hetavastrayaḥ ।
yathaivātra tathānyeṣu jñānajñeyeṣu hetavaḥ ॥101॥
slp1: bAhyAnanyAnapekzante guRAMstAnapi me SfRu । rUpaM cakzuH prakASaSca darSane hetavastrayaH । yaTEvAtra taTAnyezu jYAnajYeyezu hetavaH ॥101॥

text: jñānajñeyāntare tasminmano nāmāparo guṇaḥ । vicārayati yenāyaṃ niścaye sādhvasādhunī ॥102॥
html:
jñānajñeyāntare tasminmano nāmāparo guṇaḥ ।
vicārayati yenāyaṃ niścaye sādhvasādhunī ॥102॥
slp1: jYAnajYeyAntare tasminmano nAmAparo guRaH । vicArayati yenAyaM niScaye sADvasADunI ॥102॥

text: dvādaśastvaparastatra buddhirnāma guṇaḥ smṛtaḥ । yena saṃśayapūrveṣu boddhavyeṣu vyavasyati ॥103॥
html:
dvādaśastvaparastatra buddhirnāma guṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
yena saṃśayapūrveṣu boddhavyeṣu vyavasyati ॥103॥
slp1: dvAdaSastvaparastatra budDirnAma guRaH smftaH । yena saMSayapUrvezu bodDavyezu vyavasyati ॥103॥

text: atha dvādaśake tasminsattvaṃ nāmāparo guṇaḥ । mahāsattvo'lpasattvo vā janturyenānumīyate ॥104॥
html:
atha dvādaśake tasminsattvaṃ nāmāparo guṇaḥ ।
mahāsattvo'lpasattvo vā janturyenānumīyate ॥104॥
slp1: aTa dvAdaSake tasminsattvaM nAmAparo guRaH । mahAsattvo'lpasattvo vA janturyenAnumIyate ॥104॥

text: kṣetrajña iti cāpyanyo guṇastatra caturdaśaḥ । mamāyamiti yenāyaṃ manyate na ca manyate ॥105॥
html:
kṣetrajña iti cāpyanyo guṇastatra caturdaśaḥ ।
mamāyamiti yenāyaṃ manyate na ca manyate ॥105॥
slp1: kzetrajYa iti cApyanyo guRastatra caturdaSaH । mamAyamiti yenAyaM manyate na ca manyate ॥105॥

text: atha pañcadaśo rājanguṇastatrāparaḥ smṛtaḥ । pṛthakkalāsamūhasya sāmagryaṃ tadihocyate ॥106॥
html:
atha pañcadaśo rājanguṇastatrāparaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
pṛthakkalāsamūhasya sāmagryaṃ tadihocyate ॥106॥
slp1: aTa paYcadaSo rAjanguRastatrAparaH smftaH । pfTakkalAsamUhasya sAmagryaM tadihocyate ॥106॥

text: guṇastvevāparastatra saṅghāta iti ṣoḍaśaḥ । ākṛtirvyaktirityetau guṇau yasminsamāśritau ॥107॥
html:
guṇastvevāparastatra saṅghāta iti ṣoḍaśaḥ ।
ākṛtirvyaktirityetau guṇau yasminsamāśritau ॥107॥
slp1: guRastvevAparastatra saNGAta iti zoqaSaH । AkftirvyaktirityetO guRO yasminsamASritO ॥107॥

text: sukhaduḥkhe jarāmṛtyū lābhālābhau priyāpriye । iti caikonaviṃśo'yaṃ dvandvayoga iti smṛtaḥ ॥108॥
html:
sukhaduḥkhe jarāmṛtyū lābhālābhau priyāpriye ।
iti caikonaviṃśo'yaṃ dvandvayoga iti smṛtaḥ ॥108॥
slp1: suKaduHKe jarAmftyU lABAlABO priyApriye । iti cEkonaviMSo'yaM dvandvayoga iti smftaH ॥108॥

text: ūrdhvamekonaviṃśatyāḥ kālo nāmāparo guṇaḥ । itīmaṃ viddhi viṃśatyā bhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayam ॥109॥
html:
ūrdhvamekonaviṃśatyāḥ kālo nāmāparo guṇaḥ ।
itīmaṃ viddhi viṃśatyā bhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayam ॥109॥
slp1: UrDvamekonaviMSatyAH kAlo nAmAparo guRaH । itImaM vidDi viMSatyA BUtAnAM praBavApyayam ॥109॥

text: viṃśakaścaiṣa saṅghāto mahābhūtāni pañca ca । sadasadbhāvayogau ca guṇāvanyau prakāśakau ॥110॥
html:
viṃśakaścaiṣa saṅghāto mahābhūtāni pañca ca ।
sadasadbhāvayogau ca guṇāvanyau prakāśakau ॥110॥
slp1: viMSakaScEza saNGAto mahABUtAni paYca ca । sadasadBAvayogO ca guRAvanyO prakASakO ॥110॥

text: ityevaṃ viṃśatiścaiva guṇāḥ sapta ca ye smṛtāḥ । vidhiḥ śukraṃ balaṃ ceti traya ete guṇāḥ pare ॥111॥
html:
ityevaṃ viṃśatiścaiva guṇāḥ sapta ca ye smṛtāḥ ।
vidhiḥ śukraṃ balaṃ ceti traya ete guṇāḥ pare ॥111॥
slp1: ityevaM viMSatiScEva guRAH sapta ca ye smftAH । viDiH SukraM balaM ceti traya ete guRAH pare ॥111॥
