balaṃ kośamamātyāṃśca kasyaitāni na vā nṛpa ॥153॥
slp1: mamedamiti yaccedaM puraM rAzwraM ca manyase । balaM koSamamAtyAMSca kasyEtAni na vA nfpa ॥153॥

text: mitrāmātyaṃ puraṃ rāṣṭraṃ daṇḍaḥ kośo mahīpatiḥ । saptāṅgaścakrasaṅghāto rājyamityucyate nṛpa ॥154॥
html:
mitrāmātyaṃ puraṃ rāṣṭraṃ daṇḍaḥ kośo mahīpatiḥ ।
saptāṅgaścakrasaṅghāto rājyamityucyate nṛpa ॥154॥
slp1: mitrAmAtyaM puraM rAzwraM daRqaH koSo mahIpatiH । saptANgaScakrasaNGAto rAjyamityucyate nfpa ॥154॥

text: saptāṅgasyāsya rājyasya tridaṇḍasyeva tiṣṭhataḥ । anyonyaguṇayuktasya kaḥ kena guṇato'dhikaḥ ॥155॥
html:
saptāṅgasyāsya rājyasya tridaṇḍasyeva tiṣṭhataḥ ।
anyonyaguṇayuktasya kaḥ kena guṇato'dhikaḥ ॥155॥
slp1: saptANgasyAsya rAjyasya tridaRqasyeva tizWataH । anyonyaguRayuktasya kaH kena guRato'DikaH ॥155॥

text: teṣu teṣu hi kāleṣu tattadaṅgaṃ viśiṣyate । yena yatsidhyate kāryaṃ tatprādhānyāya kalpate ॥156॥
html:
teṣu teṣu hi kāleṣu tattadaṅgaṃ viśiṣyate ।
yena yatsidhyate kāryaṃ tatprādhānyāya kalpate ॥156॥
slp1: tezu tezu hi kAlezu tattadaNgaM viSizyate । yena yatsiDyate kAryaM tatprADAnyAya kalpate ॥156॥

text: saptāṅgaścāpi saṅghātastrayaścānye nṛpottama । sambhūya daśavargo'yaṃ bhuṅkte rājyaṃ hi rājavat ॥157॥
html:
saptāṅgaścāpi saṅghātastrayaścānye nṛpottama ।
sambhūya daśavargo'yaṃ bhuṅkte rājyaṃ hi rājavat ॥157॥
slp1: saptANgaScApi saNGAtastrayaScAnye nfpottama । samBUya daSavargo'yaM BuNkte rAjyaM hi rAjavat ॥157॥

text: yaśca rājā mahotsāhaḥ kṣatradharmarato bhavet । sa tuṣyeddaśabhāgena tatastvanyo daśāvaraiḥ ॥158॥
html:
yaśca rājā mahotsāhaḥ kṣatradharmarato bhavet ।
sa tuṣyeddaśabhāgena tatastvanyo daśāvaraiḥ ॥158॥
slp1: yaSca rAjA mahotsAhaH kzatraDarmarato Bavet । sa tuzyeddaSaBAgena tatastvanyo daSAvarEH ॥158॥

text: nāstyasādhāraṇo rājā nāsti rājyamarājakam । rājye'sati kuto dharmo dharme'sati kutaḥ param ॥159॥
html:
nāstyasādhāraṇo rājā nāsti rājyamarājakam ।
rājye'sati kuto dharmo dharme'sati kutaḥ param ॥159॥
slp1: nAstyasADAraRo rAjA nAsti rAjyamarAjakam । rAjye'sati kuto Darmo Darme'sati kutaH param ॥159॥

text: yo'pyatra paramo dharmaḥ pavitraṃ rājarājyayoḥ । pṛthivī dakṣiṇā yasya so'śvamedho na vidyate ॥160॥
html:
yo'pyatra paramo dharmaḥ pavitraṃ rājarājyayoḥ ।
pṛthivī dakṣiṇā yasya so'śvamedho na vidyate ॥160॥
slp1: yo'pyatra paramo DarmaH pavitraM rAjarAjyayoH । pfTivI dakziRA yasya so'SvameDo na vidyate ॥160॥

text: sāhametāni karmāṇi rājyaduḥkhāni maithila । samarthā śataśo vaktumatha vāpi sahasraśaḥ ॥161॥
html:
sāhametāni karmāṇi rājyaduḥkhāni maithila ।
samarthā śataśo vaktumatha vāpi sahasraśaḥ ॥161॥
slp1: sAhametAni karmARi rAjyaduHKAni mETila । samarTA SataSo vaktumaTa vApi sahasraSaH ॥161॥

text: svadehe nābhiṣaṅgo me kutaḥ paraparigrahe । na māmevaṃvidhāṃ muktāmīdṛśaṃ vaktumarhasi ॥162॥
html:
svadehe nābhiṣaṅgo me kutaḥ paraparigrahe ।
na māmevaṃvidhāṃ muktāmīdṛśaṃ vaktumarhasi ॥162॥
slp1: svadehe nABizaNgo me kutaH paraparigrahe । na mAmevaMviDAM muktAmIdfSaM vaktumarhasi ॥162॥

text: nanu nāma tvayā mokṣaḥ kṛtsnaḥ pañcaśikhācchrutaḥ । sopāyaḥ sopaniṣadaḥ sopāsaṅgaḥ saniścayaḥ ॥163॥
html:
nanu nāma tvayā mokṣaḥ kṛtsnaḥ pañcaśikhācchrutaḥ ।
sopāyaḥ sopaniṣadaḥ sopāsaṅgaḥ saniścayaḥ ॥163॥
slp1: nanu nAma tvayA mokzaH kftsnaH paYcaSiKAcCrutaH । sopAyaH sopanizadaH sopAsaNgaH saniScayaH ॥163॥

text: tasya te muktasaṅgasya pāśānākramya tiṣṭhataḥ । chatrādiṣu viśeṣeṣu kathaṃ saṅgaḥ punarnṛpa ॥164॥
html:
tasya te muktasaṅgasya pāśānākramya tiṣṭhataḥ ।
chatrādiṣu viśeṣeṣu kathaṃ saṅgaḥ punarnṛpa ॥164॥
slp1: tasya te muktasaNgasya pASAnAkramya tizWataH । CatrAdizu viSezezu kaTaM saNgaH punarnfpa ॥164॥

text: śrutaṃ te na śrutaṃ manye mithyā vāpi śrutaṃ śrutam । atha vā śrutasaṅkāśaṃ śrutamanyacchrutaṃ tvayā ॥165॥
html:
śrutaṃ te na śrutaṃ manye mithyā vāpi śrutaṃ śrutam ।
atha vā śrutasaṅkāśaṃ śrutamanyacchrutaṃ tvayā ॥165॥
slp1: SrutaM te na SrutaM manye miTyA vApi SrutaM Srutam । aTa vA SrutasaNkASaM SrutamanyacCrutaM tvayA ॥165॥

text: athāpīmāsu sañjñāsu laukikīṣu pratiṣṭhasi । abhiṣaṅgāvarodhābhyāṃ baddhastvaṃ prākṛto mayā ॥166॥
html:
athāpīmāsu sañjñāsu laukikīṣu pratiṣṭhasi ।
abhiṣaṅgāvarodhābhyāṃ baddhastvaṃ prākṛto mayā ॥166॥
slp1: aTApImAsu saYjYAsu lOkikIzu pratizWasi । aBizaNgAvaroDAByAM badDastvaM prAkfto mayA ॥166॥

text: sattvenānupraveśo hi yo'yaṃ tvayi kṛto mayā । kiṃ tavāpakṛtaṃ tatra yadi mukto'si sarvataḥ ॥167॥
html:
sattvenānupraveśo hi yo'yaṃ tvayi kṛto mayā ।
kiṃ tavāpakṛtaṃ tatra yadi mukto'si sarvataḥ ॥167॥
slp1: sattvenAnupraveSo hi yo'yaM tvayi kfto mayA । kiM tavApakftaM tatra yadi mukto'si sarvataH ॥167॥

text: niyamo hyeṣa dharmeṣu yatīnāṃ śūnyavāsitā । śūnyamāvāsayantyā ca mayā kiṃ kasya dūṣitam ॥168॥
html:
niyamo hyeṣa dharmeṣu yatīnāṃ śūnyavāsitā ।
śūnyamāvāsayantyā ca mayā kiṃ kasya dūṣitam ॥168॥
slp1: niyamo hyeza Darmezu yatInAM SUnyavAsitA । SUnyamAvAsayantyA ca mayA kiM kasya dUzitam ॥168॥

text: na pāṇibhyāṃ na bāhubhyāṃ pādorubhyāṃ na cānagha । na gātrāvayavairanyaiḥ spṛśāmi tvā narādhipa ॥169॥
html:
na pāṇibhyāṃ na bāhubhyāṃ pādorubhyāṃ na cānagha ।
na gātrāvayavairanyaiḥ spṛśāmi tvā narādhipa ॥169॥
slp1: na pARiByAM na bAhuByAM pAdoruByAM na cAnaGa । na gAtrAvayavEranyEH spfSAmi tvA narADipa ॥169॥

text: kule mahati jātena hrīmatā dīrghadarśinā । naitatsadasi vaktavyaṃ sadvāsadvā mithaḥ kṛtam ॥170॥
html:
kule mahati jātena hrīmatā dīrghadarśinā ।
naitatsadasi vaktavyaṃ sadvāsadvā mithaḥ kṛtam ॥170॥
slp1: kule mahati jAtena hrImatA dIrGadarSinA । nEtatsadasi vaktavyaM sadvAsadvA miTaH kftam ॥170॥

text: brāhmaṇā guravaśceme tathāmātyā gurūttamāḥ । tvaṃ cātha gururapyeṣāmevamanyonyagauravam ॥171॥
html:
brāhmaṇā guravaśceme tathāmātyā gurūttamāḥ ।
tvaṃ cātha gururapyeṣāmevamanyonyagauravam ॥171॥
slp1: brAhmaRA guravaSceme taTAmAtyA gurUttamAH । tvaM cATa gururapyezAmevamanyonyagOravam ॥171॥

text: tadevamanusandṛśya vācyāvācyaṃ parīkṣatā । strīpuṃsoḥ samavāyo'yaṃ tvayā vācyo na saṃsadi ॥172॥
html:
tadevamanusandṛśya vācyāvācyaṃ parīkṣatā ।
strīpuṃsoḥ samavāyo'yaṃ tvayā vācyo na saṃsadi ॥172॥
slp1: tadevamanusandfSya vAcyAvAcyaM parIkzatA । strIpuMsoH samavAyo'yaM tvayA vAcyo na saMsadi ॥172॥

text: yathā puṣkaraparṇasthaṃ jalaṃ tatparṇasaṃsthitam । tiṣṭhatyaspṛśatī tadvattvayi vatsyāmi maithila ॥173॥
html:
yathā puṣkaraparṇasthaṃ jalaṃ tatparṇasaṃsthitam ।
tiṣṭhatyaspṛśatī tadvattvayi vatsyāmi maithila ॥173॥
slp1: yaTA puzkaraparRasTaM jalaM tatparRasaMsTitam । tizWatyaspfSatI tadvattvayi vatsyAmi mETila ॥173॥

text: yadi vāpyaspṛśantyā me sparśaṃ jānāsi kañcana । jñānaṃ kṛtamabījaṃ te kathaṃ teneha bhikṣuṇā ॥174॥
html:
yadi vāpyaspṛśantyā me sparśaṃ jānāsi kañcana ।
jñānaṃ kṛtamabījaṃ te kathaṃ teneha bhikṣuṇā ॥174॥
slp1: yadi vApyaspfSantyA me sparSaM jAnAsi kaYcana । jYAnaM kftamabIjaM te kaTaM teneha BikzuRA ॥174॥

text: sa gārhasthyāccyutaśca tvaṃ mokṣaṃ nāvāpya durvidam । ubhayorantarāle ca vartase mokṣavātikaḥ ॥175॥
html:
sa gārhasthyāccyutaśca tvaṃ mokṣaṃ nāvāpya durvidam ।
ubhayorantarāle ca vartase mokṣavātikaḥ ॥175॥
slp1: sa gArhasTyAccyutaSca tvaM mokzaM nAvApya durvidam । uBayorantarAle ca vartase mokzavAtikaH ॥175॥

text: na hi muktasya muktena jñasyaikatvapṛthaktvayoḥ । bhāvābhāvasamāyoge jāyate varṇasaṅkaraḥ ॥176॥
html:
na hi muktasya muktena jñasyaikatvapṛthaktvayoḥ ।
bhāvābhāvasamāyoge jāyate varṇasaṅkaraḥ ॥176॥
slp1: na hi muktasya muktena jYasyEkatvapfTaktvayoH । BAvABAvasamAyoge jAyate varRasaNkaraH ॥176॥

text: varṇāśramapṛthaktve ca dṛṣṭārthasyāpṛthaktvinaḥ । nānyadanyaditi jñātvā nānyadanyatpravartate ॥177॥
html:
varṇāśramapṛthaktve ca dṛṣṭārthasyāpṛthaktvinaḥ ।
nānyadanyaditi jñātvā nānyadanyatpravartate ॥177॥
slp1: varRASramapfTaktve ca dfzwArTasyApfTaktvinaH । nAnyadanyaditi jYAtvA nAnyadanyatpravartate ॥177॥

text: pāṇau kuṇḍaṃ tathā kuṇḍe payaḥ payasi makṣikāḥ । āśritāśrayayogena pṛthaktvenāśrayā vayam ॥178॥
html:
pāṇau kuṇḍaṃ tathā kuṇḍe payaḥ payasi makṣikāḥ ।
āśritāśrayayogena pṛthaktvenāśrayā vayam ॥178॥
slp1: pARO kuRqaM taTA kuRqe payaH payasi makzikAH । ASritASrayayogena pfTaktvenASrayA vayam ॥178॥

text: na tu kuṇḍe payobhāvaḥ payaścāpi na makṣikāḥ । svayamevāśrayantyete bhāvā na tu parāśrayam ॥179॥
html:
na tu kuṇḍe payobhāvaḥ payaścāpi na makṣikāḥ ।
svayamevāśrayantyete bhāvā na tu parāśrayam ॥179॥
slp1: na tu kuRqe payoBAvaH payaScApi na makzikAH । svayamevASrayantyete BAvA na tu parASrayam ॥179॥

text: pṛthaktvādāśramāṇāṃ ca varṇānyatve tathaiva ca । parasparapṛthaktvācca kathaṃ te varṇasaṅkaraḥ ॥180॥
html:
pṛthaktvādāśramāṇāṃ ca varṇānyatve tathaiva ca ।
parasparapṛthaktvācca kathaṃ te varṇasaṅkaraḥ ॥180॥
slp1: pfTaktvAdASramARAM ca varRAnyatve taTEva ca । parasparapfTaktvAcca kaTaM te varRasaNkaraH ॥180॥

text: nāsmi varṇottamā jātyā na vaiśyā nāvarā tathā । tava rājansavarṇāsmi śuddhayoniraviplutā ॥181॥
html:
nāsmi varṇottamā jātyā na vaiśyā nāvarā tathā ।
tava rājansavarṇāsmi śuddhayoniraviplutā ॥181॥
slp1: nAsmi varRottamA jAtyA na vESyA nAvarA taTA । tava rAjansavarRAsmi SudDayoniraviplutA ॥181॥

text: pradhāno nāma rājarṣirvyaktaṃ te śrotramāgataḥ । kule tasya samutpannāṃ sulabhāṃ nāma viddhi mām ॥182॥
html:
pradhāno nāma rājarṣirvyaktaṃ te śrotramāgataḥ ।
kule tasya samutpannāṃ sulabhāṃ nāma viddhi mām ॥182॥
slp1: praDAno nAma rAjarzirvyaktaM te SrotramAgataH । kule tasya samutpannAM sulaBAM nAma vidDi mAm ॥182॥

text: droṇaśca śataśṛṅgaśca vakradvāraśca parvataḥ । mama satreṣu pūrveṣāṃ citā maghavatā saha ॥183॥
html:
droṇaśca śataśṛṅgaśca vakradvāraśca parvataḥ ।
mama satreṣu pūrveṣāṃ citā maghavatā saha ॥183॥
slp1: droRaSca SataSfNgaSca vakradvAraSca parvataH । mama satrezu pUrvezAM citA maGavatA saha ॥183॥

text: sāhaṃ tasminkule jātā bhartaryasati madvidhe । vinītā mokṣadharmeṣu carāmyekā munivratam ॥184॥
html:
sāhaṃ tasminkule jātā bhartaryasati madvidhe ।
vinītā mokṣadharmeṣu carāmyekā munivratam ॥184॥
slp1: sAhaM tasminkule jAtA Bartaryasati madviDe । vinItA mokzaDarmezu carAmyekA munivratam ॥184॥

text: nāsmi satrapraticchannā na parasvābhimāninī । na dharmasaṅkarakarī svadharme'smi dhṛtavratā ॥185॥
html:
nāsmi satrapraticchannā na parasvābhimāninī ।
na dharmasaṅkarakarī svadharme'smi dhṛtavratā ॥185॥
slp1: nAsmi satrapraticCannA na parasvABimAninI । na DarmasaNkarakarI svaDarme'smi DftavratA ॥185॥

text: nāsthirā svapratijñāyāṃ nāsamīkṣyapravādinī । nāsamīkṣyāgatā cāhaṃ tvatsakāśaṃ janādhipa ॥186॥
html:
nāsthirā svapratijñāyāṃ nāsamīkṣyapravādinī ।
nāsamīkṣyāgatā cāhaṃ tvatsakāśaṃ janādhipa ॥186॥
slp1: nAsTirA svapratijYAyAM nAsamIkzyapravAdinI । nAsamIkzyAgatA cAhaM tvatsakASaM janADipa ॥186॥

text: mokṣe te bhāvitāṃ buddhiṃ śrutvāhaṃ kuśalaiṣiṇī । tava mokṣasya cāpyasya jijñāsārthamihāgatā ॥187॥
html:
mokṣe te bhāvitāṃ buddhiṃ śrutvāhaṃ kuśalaiṣiṇī ।
tava mokṣasya cāpyasya jijñāsārthamihāgatā ॥187॥
slp1: mokze te BAvitAM budDiM SrutvAhaM kuSalEziRI । tava mokzasya cApyasya jijYAsArTamihAgatA ॥187॥

text: na vargasthā bravīmyetatsvapakṣaparapakṣayoḥ । mukto na mucyate yaśca śānto yaśca na śāmyati ॥188॥
html:
na vargasthā bravīmyetatsvapakṣaparapakṣayoḥ ।
mukto na mucyate yaśca śānto yaśca na śāmyati ॥188॥
slp1: na vargasTA bravImyetatsvapakzaparapakzayoH । mukto na mucyate yaSca SAnto yaSca na SAmyati ॥188॥

text: yathā śūnye purāgāre bhikṣurekāṃ niśāṃ vaset । tathā hi tvaccharīre'sminnimāṃ vatsyāmi śarvarīm ॥189॥
html:
yathā śūnye purāgāre bhikṣurekāṃ niśāṃ vaset ।
tathā hi tvaccharīre'sminnimāṃ vatsyāmi śarvarīm ॥189॥
slp1: yaTA SUnye purAgAre BikzurekAM niSAM vaset । taTA hi tvacCarIre'sminnimAM vatsyAmi SarvarIm ॥189॥

text: sāhamāsanadānena vāgātithyena cārcitā । suptā suśaraṇā prītā śvo gamiṣyāmi maithila ॥190॥
html:
sāhamāsanadānena vāgātithyena cārcitā ।
suptā suśaraṇā prītā śvo gamiṣyāmi maithila ॥190॥
slp1: sAhamAsanadAnena vAgAtiTyena cArcitA । suptA suSaraRA prItA Svo gamizyAmi mETila ॥190॥

text: ityetāni sa vākyāni hetumantyarthavanti ca । śrutvā nādhijagau rājā kiñcidanyadataḥ param] ॥191॥
html:
ityetāni sa vākyāni hetumantyarthavanti ca ।
śrutvā nādhijagau rājā kiñcidanyadataḥ param] ॥191॥
slp1: ityetAni sa vAkyAni hetumantyarTavanti ca । SrutvA nADijagO rAjA kiYcidanyadataH param] ॥191॥

text: kathaṃ nirvedamāpannaḥ śuko vaiyāsakiḥ purā । etadicchāmi kauravya śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ॥1॥
html:
kathaṃ nirvedamāpannaḥ śuko vaiyāsakiḥ purā ।
etadicchāmi kauravya śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ॥1॥
slp1: kaTaM nirvedamApannaH Suko vEyAsakiH purA । etadicCAmi kOravya SrotuM kOtUhalaM hi me ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: prākṛtena suvṛttena carantamakutobhayam । adhyāpya kṛtsnaṃ svādhyāyamanvaśādvai pitā sutam ॥2॥
html:
prākṛtena suvṛttena carantamakutobhayam ।
adhyāpya kṛtsnaṃ svādhyāyamanvaśādvai pitā sutam ॥2॥
slp1: prAkftena suvfttena carantamakutoBayam । aDyApya kftsnaM svADyAyamanvaSAdvE pitA sutam ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dharmaṃ putra niṣevasva sutīkṣṇau hi himātapau । kṣutpipāse ca vāyuṃ ca jaya nityaṃ jitendriyaḥ ॥3॥
html:
dharmaṃ putra niṣevasva sutīkṣṇau hi himātapau ।
kṣutpipāse ca vāyuṃ ca jaya nityaṃ jitendriyaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: DarmaM putra nizevasva sutIkzRO hi himAtapO । kzutpipAse ca vAyuM ca jaya nityaM jitendriyaH ॥3॥

text: satyamārjavamakrodhamanasūyāṃ damaṃ tapaḥ । ahiṃsāṃ cānṛśaṃsyaṃ ca vidhivatparipālaya ॥4॥
html:
satyamārjavamakrodhamanasūyāṃ damaṃ tapaḥ ।
ahiṃsāṃ cānṛśaṃsyaṃ ca vidhivatparipālaya ॥4॥

text: na tatra saṃvibhajyate svakarmabhiḥ parasparam । yadeva yasya yautakaṃ tadeva tatra so'śnute ॥46॥
html:
na tatra saṃvibhajyate svakarmabhiḥ parasparam ।
yadeva yasya yautakaṃ tadeva tatra so'śnute ॥46॥
slp1: na tatra saMviBajyate svakarmaBiH parasparam । yadeva yasya yOtakaM tadeva tatra so'Snute ॥46॥

text: paratra yena jīvyate tadeva putra dīyatām । dhanaṃ yadakṣayaṃ dhruvaṃ samarjayasva tatsvayam ॥47॥
html:
paratra yena jīvyate tadeva putra dīyatām ।
dhanaṃ yadakṣayaṃ dhruvaṃ samarjayasva tatsvayam ॥47॥
slp1: paratra yena jIvyate tadeva putra dIyatAm । DanaM yadakzayaM DruvaM samarjayasva tatsvayam ॥47॥

text: na yāvadeva pacyate mahājanasya yāvakam । apakva eva yāvake purā praṇīyase tvara ॥48॥
html:
na yāvadeva pacyate mahājanasya yāvakam ।
apakva eva yāvake purā praṇīyase tvara ॥48॥
slp1: na yAvadeva pacyate mahAjanasya yAvakam । apakva eva yAvake purA praRIyase tvara ॥48॥

text: na mātṛpitṛbāndhavā na saṃstutaḥ priyo janaḥ । anuvrajanti saṅkaṭe vrajantamekapātinam ॥49॥
html:
na mātṛpitṛbāndhavā na saṃstutaḥ priyo janaḥ ।
anuvrajanti saṅkaṭe vrajantamekapātinam ॥49॥
slp1: na mAtfpitfbAnDavA na saMstutaH priyo janaH । anuvrajanti saNkawe vrajantamekapAtinam ॥49॥

text: yadeva karma kevalaṃ svayaṃ kṛtaṃ śubhāśubham । tadeva tasya yautakaṃ bhavatyamutra gacchataḥ ॥50॥
html:
yadeva karma kevalaṃ svayaṃ kṛtaṃ śubhāśubham ।
tadeva tasya yautakaṃ bhavatyamutra gacchataḥ ॥50॥
slp1: yadeva karma kevalaM svayaM kftaM SuBASuBam । tadeva tasya yOtakaM Bavatyamutra gacCataH ॥50॥

text: hiraṇyaratnasañcayāḥ śubhāśubhena sañcitāḥ । na tasya dehasaṅkṣaye bhavanti kāryasādhakāḥ ॥51॥
html:
hiraṇyaratnasañcayāḥ śubhāśubhena sañcitāḥ ।
na tasya dehasaṅkṣaye bhavanti kāryasādhakāḥ ॥51॥
slp1: hiraRyaratnasaYcayAH SuBASuBena saYcitAH । na tasya dehasaNkzaye Bavanti kAryasADakAH ॥51॥

text: paratragāmikasya te kṛtākṛtasya karmaṇaḥ । na sākṣirātmanā samo nṛṇāmihāsti kaścana ॥52॥
html:
paratragāmikasya te kṛtākṛtasya karmaṇaḥ ।
na sākṣirātmanā samo nṛṇāmihāsti kaścana ॥52॥
slp1: paratragAmikasya te kftAkftasya karmaRaH । na sAkzirAtmanA samo nfRAmihAsti kaScana ॥52॥

text: manuṣyadehaśūnyakaṃ bhavatyamutra gacchataḥ । prapaśya buddhicakṣuṣā pradṛśyate hi sarvataḥ ॥53॥
html:
manuṣyadehaśūnyakaṃ bhavatyamutra gacchataḥ ।
prapaśya buddhicakṣuṣā pradṛśyate hi sarvataḥ ॥53॥
slp1: manuzyadehaSUnyakaM Bavatyamutra gacCataH । prapaSya budDicakzuzA pradfSyate hi sarvataH ॥53॥

text: ihāgnisūryavāyavaḥ śarīramāśritāstrayaḥ । ta eva tasya sākṣiṇo bhavanti dharmadarśinaḥ ॥54॥
html:
ihāgnisūryavāyavaḥ śarīramāśritāstrayaḥ ।
ta eva tasya sākṣiṇo bhavanti dharmadarśinaḥ ॥54॥
slp1: ihAgnisUryavAyavaH SarIramASritAstrayaH । ta eva tasya sAkziRo Bavanti DarmadarSinaH ॥54॥

text: yathāniśeṣu sarvataḥspṛśatsu sarvadāriṣu । prakāśagūḍhavṛttiṣu svadharmameva pālaya ॥55॥
html:
yathāniśeṣu sarvataḥspṛśatsu sarvadāriṣu ।
prakāśagūḍhavṛttiṣu svadharmameva pālaya ॥55॥
slp1: yaTAniSezu sarvataHspfSatsu sarvadArizu । prakASagUQavfttizu svaDarmameva pAlaya ॥55॥

text: anekapāripanthike virūparaudrarakṣite । svameva karma rakṣyatāṃ svakarma tatra gacchati ॥56॥
html:
anekapāripanthike virūparaudrarakṣite ।
svameva karma rakṣyatāṃ svakarma tatra gacchati ॥56॥
slp1: anekapAripanTike virUparOdrarakzite । svameva karma rakzyatAM svakarma tatra gacCati ॥56॥

text: na tatra saṃvibhajyate svakarmaṇā parasparam । yathākṛtaṃ svakarmajaṃ tadeva bhujyate phalam ॥57॥
html:
na tatra saṃvibhajyate svakarmaṇā parasparam ।
yathākṛtaṃ svakarmajaṃ tadeva bhujyate phalam ॥57॥
slp1: na tatra saMviBajyate svakarmaRA parasparam । yaTAkftaM svakarmajaM tadeva Bujyate Palam ॥57॥

text: yathāpsarogaṇāḥ phalaṃ sukhaṃ maharṣibhiḥ saha । tathāpnuvanti karmato vimānakāmagāminaḥ ॥58॥
html:
yathāpsarogaṇāḥ phalaṃ sukhaṃ maharṣibhiḥ saha ।
tathāpnuvanti karmato vimānakāmagāminaḥ ॥58॥
slp1: yaTApsarogaRAH PalaM suKaM maharziBiH saha । taTApnuvanti karmato vimAnakAmagAminaH ॥58॥

text: yatheha yatkṛtaṃ śubhaṃ vipāpmabhiḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ । tadāpnuvanti mānavāstathā viśuddhayonayaḥ ॥59॥
html:
yatheha yatkṛtaṃ śubhaṃ vipāpmabhiḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ ।
tadāpnuvanti mānavāstathā viśuddhayonayaḥ ॥59॥
slp1: yaTeha yatkftaM SuBaM vipApmaBiH kftAtmaBiH । tadApnuvanti mAnavAstaTA viSudDayonayaH ॥59॥

text: prajāpateḥ salokatāṃ bṛhaspateḥ śatakratoḥ । vrajanti te parāṃ gatiṃ gṛhasthadharmasetubhiḥ ॥60॥
html:
prajāpateḥ salokatāṃ bṛhaspateḥ śatakratoḥ ।
vrajanti te parāṃ gatiṃ gṛhasthadharmasetubhiḥ ॥60॥
slp1: prajApateH salokatAM bfhaspateH SatakratoH । vrajanti te parAM gatiM gfhasTaDarmasetuBiH ॥60॥

text: sahasraśo'pyanekaśaḥ pravaktumutsahāmahe । abuddhimohanaṃ punaḥ prabhurvinā na yāvakam ॥61॥
html:
sahasraśo'pyanekaśaḥ pravaktumutsahāmahe ।
abuddhimohanaṃ punaḥ prabhurvinā na yāvakam ॥61॥
slp1: sahasraSo'pyanekaSaH pravaktumutsahAmahe । abudDimohanaM punaH praBurvinA na yAvakam ॥61॥

text: gatā dviraṣṭavarṣatā dhruvo'si pañcaviṃśakaḥ । kuruṣva dharmasañcayaṃ vayo hi te'tivartate ॥62॥
html:
gatā dviraṣṭavarṣatā dhruvo'si pañcaviṃśakaḥ ।
kuruṣva dharmasañcayaṃ vayo hi te'tivartate ॥62॥
slp1: gatA dvirazwavarzatA Druvo'si paYcaviMSakaH । kuruzva DarmasaYcayaM vayo hi te'tivartate ॥62॥

text: purā karoti so'ntakaḥ pramādagomukhaṃ damam । yathāgṛhītamutthitaṃ tvarasva dharmapālane ॥63॥
html:
purā karoti so'ntakaḥ pramādagomukhaṃ damam ।
yathāgṛhītamutthitaṃ tvarasva dharmapālane ॥63॥
slp1: purA karoti so'ntakaH pramAdagomuKaM damam । yaTAgfhItamutTitaM tvarasva DarmapAlane ॥63॥

text: yadā tvameva pṛṣṭhatastvamagrato gamiṣyasi । tathā gatiṃ gamiṣyataḥ kimātmanā pareṇa vā ॥64॥
html:
yadā tvameva pṛṣṭhatastvamagrato gamiṣyasi ।
tathā gatiṃ gamiṣyataḥ kimātmanā pareṇa vā ॥64॥
slp1: yadA tvameva pfzWatastvamagrato gamizyasi । taTA gatiM gamizyataH kimAtmanA pareRa vA ॥64॥

text: yadekapātināṃ satāṃ bhavatyamutra gacchatām । bhayeṣu sāmparāyikaṃ nidhatsva taṃ mahānidhim ॥65॥
html:
yadekapātināṃ satāṃ bhavatyamutra gacchatām ।
bhayeṣu sāmparāyikaṃ nidhatsva taṃ mahānidhim ॥65॥
slp1: yadekapAtinAM satAM Bavatyamutra gacCatAm । Bayezu sAmparAyikaM niDatsva taM mahAniDim ॥65॥

text: sakūlamūlabāndhavaṃ prabhurharatyasaṅgavān । na santi yasya vārakāḥ kuruṣva dharmasannidhim ॥66॥
html:
sakūlamūlabāndhavaṃ prabhurharatyasaṅgavān ।
na santi yasya vārakāḥ kuruṣva dharmasannidhim ॥66॥
slp1: sakUlamUlabAnDavaM praBurharatyasaNgavAn । na santi yasya vArakAH kuruzva DarmasanniDim ॥66॥

text: idaṃ nidarśanaṃ mayā taveha putra sammatam । svadarśanānumānataḥ pravarṇitaṃ kuruṣva tat ॥67॥
html:
idaṃ nidarśanaṃ mayā taveha putra sammatam ।
svadarśanānumānataḥ pravarṇitaṃ kuruṣva tat ॥67॥
slp1: idaM nidarSanaM mayA taveha putra sammatam । svadarSanAnumAnataH pravarRitaM kuruzva tat ॥67॥

text: dadhāti yaḥ svakarmaṇā dhanāni yasya kasyacit । abuddhimohajairguṇaiḥ śataika eva yujyate ॥68॥
html:
dadhāti yaḥ svakarmaṇā dhanāni yasya kasyacit ।
abuddhimohajairguṇaiḥ śataika eva yujyate ॥68॥
slp1: daDAti yaH svakarmaRA DanAni yasya kasyacit । abudDimohajErguREH SatEka eva yujyate ॥68॥

text: śrutaṃ samarthamastu te prakurvataḥ śubhāḥ kriyāḥ । tadeva tatra darśanaṃ kṛtajñamarthasaṃhitam ॥69॥
html:
śrutaṃ samarthamastu te prakurvataḥ śubhāḥ kriyāḥ ।
tadeva tatra darśanaṃ kṛtajñamarthasaṃhitam ॥69॥
slp1: SrutaM samarTamastu te prakurvataH SuBAH kriyAH । tadeva tatra darSanaM kftajYamarTasaMhitam ॥69॥

text: nibandhanī rajjureṣā yā grāme vasato ratiḥ । chittvaināṃ sukṛto yānti naināṃ chindanti duṣkṛtaḥ ॥70॥
html:
nibandhanī rajjureṣā yā grāme vasato ratiḥ ।
chittvaināṃ sukṛto yānti naināṃ chindanti duṣkṛtaḥ ॥70॥
slp1: nibanDanI rajjurezA yA grAme vasato ratiH । CittvEnAM sukfto yAnti nEnAM Cindanti duzkftaH ॥70॥

text: kiṃ te dhanena kiṃ bandhubhiste kiṃ te putraiḥ putraka yo mariṣyasi । ātmānamanviccha guhāṃ praviṣṭaṃ pitāmahāste kva gatāśca sarve ॥71॥
html:
kiṃ te dhanena kiṃ bandhubhiste kiṃ te putraiḥ putraka yo mariṣyasi ।
ātmānamanviccha guhāṃ praviṣṭaṃ pitāmahāste kva gatāśca sarve ॥71॥
slp1: kiM te Danena kiM banDuBiste kiM te putrEH putraka yo marizyasi । AtmAnamanvicCa guhAM pravizwaM pitAmahAste kva gatASca sarve ॥71॥

text: śvaḥkāryamadya kurvīta pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇikam । ko hi tadveda kasyādya mṛtyusenā nivekṣyate ॥72॥
html:
śvaḥkāryamadya kurvīta pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇikam ।
ko hi tadveda kasyādya mṛtyusenā nivekṣyate ॥72॥
slp1: SvaHkAryamadya kurvIta pUrvAhRe cAparAhRikam । ko hi tadveda kasyAdya mftyusenA nivekzyate ॥72॥

text: anugamya śmaśānāntaṃ nivartantīha bāndhavāḥ । agnau prakṣipya puruṣaṃ jñātayaḥ suhṛdastathā ॥73॥
html:
anugamya śmaśānāntaṃ nivartantīha bāndhavāḥ ।
agnau prakṣipya puruṣaṃ jñātayaḥ suhṛdastathā ॥73॥
slp1: anugamya SmaSAnAntaM nivartantIha bAnDavAH । agnO prakzipya puruzaM jYAtayaH suhfdastaTA ॥73॥

text: nāstikānniranukrośānnarānpāpamatau sthitān । vāmataḥ kuru viśrabdhaṃ paraṃ prepsuratandritaḥ ॥74॥
html:
nāstikānniranukrośānnarānpāpamatau sthitān ।
vāmataḥ kuru viśrabdhaṃ paraṃ prepsuratandritaḥ ॥74॥
slp1: nAstikAnniranukroSAnnarAnpApamatO sTitAn । vAmataH kuru viSrabDaM paraM prepsuratandritaH ॥74॥

text: evamabhyāhate loke kālenopanipīḍite । sumahaddhairyamālambya dharmaṃ sarvātmanā kuru ॥75॥
html:
evamabhyāhate loke kālenopanipīḍite ।
sumahaddhairyamālambya dharmaṃ sarvātmanā kuru ॥75॥
slp1: evamaByAhate loke kAlenopanipIqite । sumahadDEryamAlambya DarmaM sarvAtmanA kuru ॥75॥

text: athemaṃ darśanopāyaṃ samyagyo vetti mānavaḥ । samyaksa dharmaṃ kṛtveha paratra sukhamedhate ॥76॥
html:
athemaṃ darśanopāyaṃ samyagyo vetti mānavaḥ ।
samyaksa dharmaṃ kṛtveha paratra sukhamedhate ॥76॥
slp1: aTemaM darSanopAyaM samyagyo vetti mAnavaH । samyaksa DarmaM kftveha paratra suKameDate ॥76॥

text: na dehabhede maraṇaṃ vijānatāṃ na ca praṇāśaḥ svanupālite pathi । dharmaṃ hi yo vardhayate sa paṇḍito ya eva dharmāccyavate sa muhyati ॥77॥
html:
na dehabhede maraṇaṃ vijānatāṃ na ca praṇāśaḥ svanupālite pathi ।
dharmaṃ hi yo vardhayate sa paṇḍito ya eva dharmāccyavate sa muhyati ॥77॥
slp1: na dehaBede maraRaM vijAnatAM na ca praRASaH svanupAlite paTi । DarmaM hi yo varDayate sa paRqito ya eva DarmAccyavate sa muhyati ॥77॥

text: prayuktayoḥ karmapathi svakarmaṇoḥ phalaṃ prayoktā labhate yathāvidhi । nihīnakarmā nirayaṃ prapadyate triviṣṭapaṃ gacchati dharmapāragaḥ ॥78॥
html:
prayuktayoḥ karmapathi svakarmaṇoḥ phalaṃ prayoktā labhate yathāvidhi ।
nihīnakarmā nirayaṃ prapadyate triviṣṭapaṃ gacchati dharmapāragaḥ ॥78॥
slp1: prayuktayoH karmapaTi svakarmaRoH PalaM prayoktA laBate yaTAviDi । nihInakarmA nirayaM prapadyate trivizwapaM gacCati DarmapAragaH ॥78॥

text: sopānabhūtaṃ svargasya mānuṣyaṃ prāpya durlabham । tathātmānaṃ samādadhyādbhraśyeta na punaryathā ॥79॥
html:
sopānabhūtaṃ svargasya mānuṣyaṃ prāpya durlabham ।
tathātmānaṃ samādadhyādbhraśyeta na punaryathā ॥79॥
slp1: sopAnaBUtaM svargasya mAnuzyaM prApya durlaBam । taTAtmAnaM samAdaDyAdBraSyeta na punaryaTA ॥79॥

text: yasya notkrāmati matiḥ svargamārgānusāriṇī । tamāhuḥ puṇyakarmāṇamaśocyaṃ mitrabāndhavaiḥ ॥80॥
html:
yasya notkrāmati matiḥ svargamārgānusāriṇī ।
tamāhuḥ puṇyakarmāṇamaśocyaṃ mitrabāndhavaiḥ ॥80॥
slp1: yasya notkrAmati matiH svargamArgAnusAriRI । tamAhuH puRyakarmARamaSocyaM mitrabAnDavEH ॥80॥

text: yasya nopahatā buddhirniścayeṣvavalambate । svarge kṛtāvakāśasya tasya nāsti mahadbhayam ॥81॥
html:
yasya nopahatā buddhirniścayeṣvavalambate ।
svarge kṛtāvakāśasya tasya nāsti mahadbhayam ॥81॥
slp1: yasya nopahatA budDirniScayezvavalambate । svarge kftAvakASasya tasya nAsti mahadBayam ॥81॥

text: tapovaneṣu ye jātāstatraiva nidhanaṃ gatāḥ । teṣāmalpataro dharmaḥ kāmabhogamajānatām ॥82॥
html:
tapovaneṣu ye jātāstatraiva nidhanaṃ gatāḥ ।
teṣāmalpataro dharmaḥ kāmabhogamajānatām ॥82॥
slp1: tapovanezu ye jAtAstatrEva niDanaM gatAH । tezAmalpataro DarmaH kAmaBogamajAnatAm ॥82॥

text: yastu bhogānparityajya śarīreṇa tapaścaret । na tena kiñcinna prāptaṃ tanme bahumataṃ phalam ॥83॥
html:
yastu bhogānparityajya śarīreṇa tapaścaret ।
na tena kiñcinna prāptaṃ tanme bahumataṃ phalam ॥83॥
slp1: yastu BogAnparityajya SarIreRa tapaScaret । na tena kiYcinna prAptaM tanme bahumataM Palam ॥83॥

text: mātāpitṛsahasrāṇi putradāraśatāni ca । anāgatānyatītāni kasya te kasya vā vayam ॥84॥
html:
mātāpitṛsahasrāṇi putradāraśatāni ca ।

slp1: mAtApitfsahasrARi putradAraSatAni ca । anAgatAnyatItAni kasya te kasya vA vayam ॥84॥

text: na teṣāṃ bhavatā kāryaṃ na kāryaṃ tava tairapi । svakṛtaistāni yātāni bhavāṃścaiva gamiṣyati ॥85॥
html:
na teṣāṃ bhavatā kāryaṃ na kāryaṃ tava tairapi ।
svakṛtaistāni yātāni bhavāṃścaiva gamiṣyati ॥85॥
slp1: na tezAM BavatA kAryaM na kAryaM tava tErapi । svakftEstAni yAtAni BavAMScEva gamizyati ॥85॥

html:

slp1: iha loke hi DaninaH paro'pi svajanAyate । svajanastu daridrARAM jIvatAmeva naSyati ॥86॥

text: sañcinotyaśubhaṃ karma kalatrāpekṣayā naraḥ । tataḥ kleśamavāpnoti paratreha tathaiva ca ॥87॥
html:

html:
paśya tvaṃ chidrabhūtaṃ hi jīvalokaṃ svakarmaṇā ।
tatkuruṣva tathā putra kṛtsnaṃ yatsamudāhṛtam ॥88॥
slp1: paSya tvaM CidraBUtaM hi jIvalokaM svakarmaRA । tatkuruzva taTA putra kftsnaM yatsamudAhftam ॥88॥

text: tadetatsampradṛśyaiva karmabhūmiṃ praviśya tām । śubhānyācaritavyāni paralokamabhīpsatā ॥89॥
html:
tadetatsampradṛśyaiva karmabhūmiṃ praviśya tām ।

babhau tadā bhāvitātmā vidhūmo'gniriva jvalan ॥11॥
slp1: biBratpituSca kOravya rUpavarRamanuttamam । baBO tadA BAvitAtmA viDUmo'gniriva jvalan ॥11॥

text: taṃ gaṅgā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā merupṛṣṭhe janeśvara । svarūpiṇī tadābhyetya snāpayāmāsa vāriṇā ॥12॥
html:
taṃ gaṅgā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā merupṛṣṭhe janeśvara ।
svarūpiṇī tadābhyetya snāpayāmāsa vāriṇā ॥12॥
slp1: taM gaNgA saritAM SrezWA merupfzWe janeSvara । svarUpiRI tadAByetya snApayAmAsa vAriRA ॥12॥

text: antarikṣācca kauravya daṇḍaḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ ca ha । papāta bhuvi rājendra śukasyārthe mahātmanaḥ ॥13॥
html:
antarikṣācca kauravya daṇḍaḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ ca ha ।
papāta bhuvi rājendra śukasyārthe mahātmanaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: antarikzAcca kOravya daRqaH kfzRAjinaM ca ha । papAta Buvi rAjendra SukasyArTe mahAtmanaH ॥13॥

text: jegīyante sma gandharvā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ । devadundubhayaścaiva prāvādyanta mahāsvanāḥ ॥14॥
html:
jegīyante sma gandharvā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ।
devadundubhayaścaiva prāvādyanta mahāsvanāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: jegIyante sma ganDarvA nanftuScApsarogaRAH । devadunduBayaScEva prAvAdyanta mahAsvanAH ॥14॥

text: viśvāvasuśca gandharvastathā tumburunāradau । hāhāhūhū ca gandharvau tuṣṭuvuḥ śukasambhavam ॥15॥
html:
viśvāvasuśca gandharvastathā tumburunāradau ।
hāhāhūhū ca gandharvau tuṣṭuvuḥ śukasambhavam ॥15॥
slp1: viSvAvasuSca ganDarvastaTA tumburunAradO । hAhAhUhU ca ganDarvO tuzwuvuH SukasamBavam ॥15॥

text: tatra śakrapurogāśca lokapālāḥ samāgatāḥ । devā devarṣayaścaiva tathā brahmarṣayo'pi ca ॥16॥
html:
tatra śakrapurogāśca lokapālāḥ samāgatāḥ ।
devā devarṣayaścaiva tathā brahmarṣayo'pi ca ॥16॥
slp1: tatra SakrapurogASca lokapAlAH samAgatAH । devA devarzayaScEva taTA brahmarzayo'pi ca ॥16॥

text: divyāni sarvapuṣpāṇi pravavarṣātra mārutaḥ । jaṅgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ caiva prahṛṣṭamabhavajjagat ॥17॥
html:
divyāni sarvapuṣpāṇi pravavarṣātra mārutaḥ ।
jaṅgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ caiva prahṛṣṭamabhavajjagat ॥17॥
slp1: divyAni sarvapuzpARi pravavarzAtra mArutaH । jaNgamaM sTAvaraM cEva prahfzwamaBavajjagat ॥17॥

text: taṃ mahātmā svayaṃ prītyā devyā saha mahādyutiḥ । jātamātraṃ muneḥ putraṃ vidhinopānayattadā ॥18॥
html:
taṃ mahātmā svayaṃ prītyā devyā saha mahādyutiḥ ।
jātamātraṃ muneḥ putraṃ vidhinopānayattadā ॥18॥
slp1: taM mahAtmA svayaM prItyA devyA saha mahAdyutiH । jAtamAtraM muneH putraM viDinopAnayattadA ॥18॥

text: tasya deveśvaraḥ śakro divyamadbhutadarśanam । dadau kamaṇḍaluṃ prītyā devavāsāṃsi cābhibho ॥19॥
html:
tasya deveśvaraḥ śakro divyamadbhutadarśanam ।
dadau kamaṇḍaluṃ prītyā devavāsāṃsi cābhibho ॥19॥
slp1: tasya deveSvaraH Sakro divyamadButadarSanam । dadO kamaRqaluM prItyA devavAsAMsi cABiBo ॥19॥

text: haṃsāśca śatapatrāśca sārasāśca sahasraśaḥ । pradakṣiṇamavartanta śukāścāṣāśca bhārata ॥20॥
html:
haṃsāśca śatapatrāśca sārasāśca sahasraśaḥ ।
pradakṣiṇamavartanta śukāścāṣāśca bhārata ॥20॥
slp1: haMsASca SatapatrASca sArasASca sahasraSaH । pradakziRamavartanta SukAScAzASca BArata ॥20॥

text: āraṇeyastathā divyaṃ prāpya janma mahādyutiḥ । tatraivovāsa medhāvī vratacārī samāhitaḥ ॥21॥
html:
āraṇeyastathā divyaṃ prāpya janma mahādyutiḥ ।
tatraivovāsa medhāvī vratacārī samāhitaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: AraReyastaTA divyaM prApya janma mahAdyutiH । tatrEvovAsa meDAvI vratacArI samAhitaH ॥21॥

text: utpannamātraṃ taṃ vedāḥ sarahasyāḥ sasaṅgrahāḥ । upatasthurmahārāja yathāsya pitaraṃ tathā ॥22॥
html:
utpannamātraṃ taṃ vedāḥ sarahasyāḥ sasaṅgrahāḥ ।
upatasthurmahārāja yathāsya pitaraṃ tathā ॥22॥
slp1: utpannamAtraM taM vedAH sarahasyAH sasaNgrahAH । upatasTurmahArAja yaTAsya pitaraM taTA ॥22॥

text: bṛhaspatiṃ tu vavre sa vedavedāṅgabhāṣyavit । upādhyāyaṃ mahārāja dharmamevānucintayan ॥23॥
html:
bṛhaspatiṃ tu vavre sa vedavedāṅgabhāṣyavit ।
upādhyāyaṃ mahārāja dharmamevānucintayan ॥23॥
slp1: bfhaspatiM tu vavre sa vedavedANgaBAzyavit । upADyAyaM mahArAja DarmamevAnucintayan ॥23॥

text: so'dhītya vedānakhilānsarahasyānsasaṅgrahān । itihāsaṃ ca kārtsnyena rājaśāstrāṇi cābhibho ॥24॥
html:
so'dhītya vedānakhilānsarahasyānsasaṅgrahān ।
itihāsaṃ ca kārtsnyena rājaśāstrāṇi cābhibho ॥24॥
slp1: so'DItya vedAnaKilAnsarahasyAnsasaNgrahAn । itihAsaM ca kArtsnyena rAjaSAstrARi cABiBo ॥24॥

text: gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā samāvṛtto mahāmuniḥ । ugraṃ tapaḥ samārebhe brahmacārī samāhitaḥ ॥25॥
html:
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā samāvṛtto mahāmuniḥ ।
ugraṃ tapaḥ samārebhe brahmacārī samāhitaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: gurave dakziRAM dattvA samAvftto mahAmuniH । ugraM tapaH samAreBe brahmacArI samAhitaH ॥25॥

text: devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca bālye'pi sa mahātapāḥ । sammantraṇīyo mānyaśca jñānena tapasā tathā ॥26॥
html:
devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca bālye'pi sa mahātapāḥ ।
sammantraṇīyo mānyaśca jñānena tapasā tathā ॥26॥
slp1: devatAnAmfzIRAM ca bAlye'pi sa mahAtapAH । sammantraRIyo mAnyaSca jYAnena tapasA taTA ॥26॥

text: na tvasya ramate buddhirāśrameṣu narādhipa । triṣu gārhasthyamūleṣu mokṣadharmānudarśinaḥ] ॥27॥
html:
na tvasya ramate buddhirāśrameṣu narādhipa ।
triṣu gārhasthyamūleṣu mokṣadharmānudarśinaḥ] ॥27॥
slp1: na tvasya ramate budDirASramezu narADipa । trizu gArhasTyamUlezu mokzaDarmAnudarSinaH] ॥27॥

text: sa mokṣamanucintyaiva śukaḥ pitaramabhyagāt । prāhābhivādya ca guruṃ śreyorthī vinayānvitaḥ ॥1॥
html:
sa mokṣamanucintyaiva śukaḥ pitaramabhyagāt ।
prāhābhivādya ca guruṃ śreyorthī vinayānvitaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: sa mokzamanucintyEva SukaH pitaramaByagAt । prAhABivAdya ca guruM SreyorTI vinayAnvitaH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: mokṣadharmeṣu kuśalo bhagavānprabravītu me । yathā me manasaḥ śāntiḥ paramā sambhavetprabho ॥2॥
html:
mokṣadharmeṣu kuśalo bhagavānprabravītu me ।
yathā me manasaḥ śāntiḥ paramā sambhavetprabho ॥2॥
slp1: mokzaDarmezu kuSalo BagavAnprabravItu me । yaTA me manasaH SAntiH paramA samBavetpraBo ॥2॥

text: śrutvā putrasya vacanaṃ paramarṣiruvāca tam । adhīṣva putra mokṣaṃ vai dharmāṃśca vividhānapi ॥3॥
html:
śrutvā putrasya vacanaṃ paramarṣiruvāca tam ।
adhīṣva putra mokṣaṃ vai dharmāṃśca vividhānapi ॥3॥
slp1: SrutvA putrasya vacanaM paramarziruvAca tam । aDIzva putra mokzaM vE DarmAMSca viviDAnapi ॥3॥

text: piturniyogājjagrāha śuko brahmavidāṃ varaḥ । yogaśāstraṃ ca nikhilaṃ kāpilaṃ caiva bhārata ॥4॥
html:
piturniyogājjagrāha śuko brahmavidāṃ varaḥ ।
yogaśāstraṃ ca nikhilaṃ kāpilaṃ caiva bhārata ॥4॥
slp1: piturniyogAjjagrAha Suko brahmavidAM varaH । yogaSAstraM ca niKilaM kApilaM cEva BArata ॥4॥

text: sa taṃ brāhmyā śriyā yuktaṃ brahmatulyaparākramam । mene putraṃ yadā vyāso mokṣavidyāviśāradam ॥5॥
html:
sa taṃ brāhmyā śriyā yuktaṃ brahmatulyaparākramam ।
mene putraṃ yadā vyāso mokṣavidyāviśāradam ॥5॥
slp1: sa taM brAhmyA SriyA yuktaM brahmatulyaparAkramam । mene putraM yadA vyAso mokzavidyAviSAradam ॥5॥

text: uvāca gaccheti tadā janakaṃ mithileśvaram । sa te vakṣyati mokṣārthaṃ nikhilena viśeṣataḥ ॥6॥
html:
uvāca gaccheti tadā janakaṃ mithileśvaram ।
sa te vakṣyati mokṣārthaṃ nikhilena viśeṣataḥ ॥6॥
slp1: uvAca gacCeti tadA janakaM miTileSvaram । sa te vakzyati mokzArTaM niKilena viSezataH ॥6॥

text: piturniyogādagamanmaithilaṃ janakaṃ nṛpam । praṣṭuṃ dharmasya niṣṭhāṃ vai mokṣasya ca parāyaṇam ॥7॥
html:
piturniyogādagamanmaithilaṃ janakaṃ nṛpam ।
praṣṭuṃ dharmasya niṣṭhāṃ vai mokṣasya ca parāyaṇam ॥7॥
slp1: piturniyogAdagamanmETilaM janakaM nfpam । prazwuM Darmasya nizWAM vE mokzasya ca parAyaRam ॥7॥

text: uktaśca mānuṣeṇa tvaṃ pathā gacchetyavismitaḥ । na prabhāveṇa gantavyamantarikṣacareṇa vai ॥8॥
html:
uktaśca mānuṣeṇa tvaṃ pathā gacchetyavismitaḥ ।
na prabhāveṇa gantavyamantarikṣacareṇa vai ॥8॥
slp1: uktaSca mAnuzeRa tvaM paTA gacCetyavismitaH । na praBAveRa gantavyamantarikzacareRa vE ॥8॥

text: ārjaveṇaiva gantavyaṃ na sukhānveṣiṇā pathā । nānveṣṭavyā viśeṣāstu viśeṣā hi prasaṅginaḥ ॥9॥
html:
ārjaveṇaiva gantavyaṃ na sukhānveṣiṇā pathā ।
nānveṣṭavyā viśeṣāstu viśeṣā hi prasaṅginaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: ArjaveREva gantavyaM na suKAnveziRA paTA । nAnvezwavyA viSezAstu viSezA hi prasaNginaH ॥9॥

text: ahaṅkāro na kartavyo yājye tasminnarādhipe । sthātavyaṃ ca vaśe tasya sa te chetsyati saṃśayam ॥10॥
html:
ahaṅkāro na kartavyo yājye tasminnarādhipe ।
sthātavyaṃ ca vaśe tasya sa te chetsyati saṃśayam ॥10॥
slp1: ahaNkAro na kartavyo yAjye tasminnarADipe । sTAtavyaM ca vaSe tasya sa te Cetsyati saMSayam ॥10॥

text: sa dharmakuśalo rājā mokṣaśāstraviśāradaḥ । yājyo mama sa yadbrūyāttatkāryamaviśaṅkayā ॥11॥
html:
sa dharmakuśalo rājā mokṣaśāstraviśāradaḥ ।
yājyo mama sa yadbrūyāttatkāryamaviśaṅkayā ॥11॥
slp1: sa DarmakuSalo rAjA mokzaSAstraviSAradaH । yAjyo mama sa yadbrUyAttatkAryamaviSaNkayA ॥11॥

text: evamuktaḥ sa dharmātmā jagāma mithilāṃ muniḥ । padbhyāṃ śakto'ntarikṣeṇa krāntuṃ bhūmiṃ sasāgarām ॥12॥
html:
evamuktaḥ sa dharmātmā jagāma mithilāṃ muniḥ ।
padbhyāṃ śakto'ntarikṣeṇa krāntuṃ bhūmiṃ sasāgarām ॥12॥
slp1: evamuktaH sa DarmAtmA jagAma miTilAM muniH । padByAM Sakto'ntarikzeRa krAntuM BUmiM sasAgarAm ॥12॥

text: sa girīṃścāpyatikramya nadīstīrtvā sarāṃsi ca । bahuvyālamṛgākīrṇā vividhāścāṭavīstathā ॥13॥
html:
sa girīṃścāpyatikramya nadīstīrtvā sarāṃsi ca ।
bahuvyālamṛgākīrṇā vividhāścāṭavīstathā ॥13॥
slp1: sa girIMScApyatikramya nadIstIrtvA sarAMsi ca । bahuvyAlamfgAkIrRA viviDAScAwavIstaTA ॥13॥

text: merorhareśca dve varṣe varṣaṃ haimavataṃ tathā । krameṇaiva vyatikramya bhārataṃ varṣamāsadat ॥14॥
html:
merorhareśca dve varṣe varṣaṃ haimavataṃ tathā ।
krameṇaiva vyatikramya bhārataṃ varṣamāsadat ॥14॥
slp1: merorhareSca dve varze varzaM hEmavataM taTA । krameREva vyatikramya BArataM varzamAsadat ॥14॥

text: sa deśānvividhānpaśyaṃścīnahūṇaniṣevitān । āryāvartamimaṃ deśamājagāma mahāmuniḥ ॥15॥
html:
sa deśānvividhānpaśyaṃścīnahūṇaniṣevitān ।
āryāvartamimaṃ deśamājagāma mahāmuniḥ ॥15॥
slp1: sa deSAnviviDAnpaSyaMScInahURanizevitAn । AryAvartamimaM deSamAjagAma mahAmuniH ॥15॥

text: piturvacanamājñāya tamevārthaṃ vicintayan । adhvānaṃ so'ticakrāma khe'caraḥ khe caranniva ॥16॥
html:
piturvacanamājñāya tamevārthaṃ vicintayan ।
adhvānaṃ so'ticakrāma khe'caraḥ khe caranniva ॥16॥
slp1: piturvacanamAjYAya tamevArTaM vicintayan । aDvAnaM so'ticakrAma Ke'caraH Ke caranniva ॥16॥

text: pattanāni ca ramyāṇi sphītāni nagarāṇi ca । ratnāni ca vicitrāṇi śukaḥ paśyanna paśyati ॥17॥
html:
pattanāni ca ramyāṇi sphītāni nagarāṇi ca ।
ratnāni ca vicitrāṇi śukaḥ paśyanna paśyati ॥17॥
slp1: pattanAni ca ramyARi sPItAni nagarARi ca । ratnAni ca vicitrARi SukaH paSyanna paSyati ॥17॥

text: udyānāni ca ramyāṇi tathaivāyatanāni ca । puṇyāni caiva tīrthāni so'tikramya tathādhvanaḥ ॥18॥
html:
udyānāni ca ramyāṇi tathaivāyatanāni ca ।
puṇyāni caiva tīrthāni so'tikramya tathādhvanaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: udyAnAni ca ramyARi taTEvAyatanAni ca । puRyAni cEva tIrTAni so'tikramya taTADvanaH ॥18॥

text: so'cireṇaiva kālena videhānāsasāda ha । rakṣitāndharmarājena janakena mahātmanā ॥19॥
html:
so'cireṇaiva kālena videhānāsasāda ha ।
rakṣitāndharmarājena janakena mahātmanā ॥19॥
slp1: so'cireREva kAlena videhAnAsasAda ha । rakzitAnDarmarAjena janakena mahAtmanA ॥19॥

text: tatra grāmānbahūnpaśyanbahvannarasabhojanān । pallīghoṣānsamṛddhāṃśca bahugokulasaṅkulān ॥20॥
html:
tatra grāmānbahūnpaśyanbahvannarasabhojanān ।
pallīghoṣānsamṛddhāṃśca bahugokulasaṅkulān ॥20॥
slp1: tatra grAmAnbahUnpaSyanbahvannarasaBojanAn । pallIGozAnsamfdDAMSca bahugokulasaNkulAn ॥20॥

text: sphītāṃśca śāliyavasairhaṃsasārasasevitān । padminībhiśca śataśaḥ śrīmatībhiralaṅkṛtān ॥21॥
html:
sphītāṃśca śāliyavasairhaṃsasārasasevitān ।
padminībhiśca śataśaḥ śrīmatībhiralaṅkṛtān ॥21॥
slp1: sPItAMSca SAliyavasErhaMsasArasasevitAn । padminIBiSca SataSaH SrImatIBiralaNkftAn ॥21॥

text: sa videhānatikramya samṛddhajanasevitān । mithilopavanaṃ ramyamāsasāda maharddhimat ॥22॥
html:
sa videhānatikramya samṛddhajanasevitān ।
mithilopavanaṃ ramyamāsasāda maharddhimat ॥22॥
slp1: sa videhAnatikramya samfdDajanasevitAn । miTilopavanaM ramyamAsasAda mahardDimat ॥22॥

text: hastyaśvarathasaṅkīrṇaṃ naranārīsamākulam । paśyannapaśyanniva tatsamatikrāmadacyutaḥ ॥23॥
html:
hastyaśvarathasaṅkīrṇaṃ naranārīsamākulam ।
paśyannapaśyanniva tatsamatikrāmadacyutaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: hastyaSvaraTasaNkIrRaM naranArIsamAkulam । paSyannapaSyanniva tatsamatikrAmadacyutaH ॥23॥

text: manasā taṃ vahanbhāraṃ tamevārthaṃ vicintayan । ātmārāmaḥ prasannātmā mithilāmāsasāda ha ॥24॥
html:
manasā taṃ vahanbhāraṃ tamevārthaṃ vicintayan ।
ātmārāmaḥ prasannātmā mithilāmāsasāda ha ॥24॥
slp1: manasA taM vahanBAraM tamevArTaM vicintayan । AtmArAmaH prasannAtmA miTilAmAsasAda ha ॥24॥

text: tasyā dvāraṃ samāsādya dvārapālairnivāritaḥ । sthito dhyānaparo mukto viditaḥ praviveśa ha ॥25॥
html:
tasyā dvāraṃ samāsādya dvārapālairnivāritaḥ ।
sthito dhyānaparo mukto viditaḥ praviveśa ha ॥25॥
slp1: tasyA dvAraM samAsAdya dvArapAlErnivAritaH । sTito DyAnaparo mukto viditaH praviveSa ha ॥25॥

text: sa rājamārgamāsādya samṛddhajanasaṅkulam । pārthivakṣayamāsādya niḥśaṅkaḥ praviveśa ha ॥26॥
html:
sa rājamārgamāsādya samṛddhajanasaṅkulam ।
pārthivakṣayamāsādya niḥśaṅkaḥ praviveśa ha ॥26॥
slp1: sa rAjamArgamAsAdya samfdDajanasaNkulam । pArTivakzayamAsAdya niHSaNkaH praviveSa ha ॥26॥

text: tatrāpi dvārapālāstamugravāco nyaṣedhayan । tathaiva ca śukastatra nirmanyuḥ samatiṣṭhata ॥27॥
html:
tatrāpi dvārapālāstamugravāco nyaṣedhayan ।
tathaiva ca śukastatra nirmanyuḥ samatiṣṭhata ॥27॥
slp1: tatrApi dvArapAlAstamugravAco nyazeDayan । taTEva ca Sukastatra nirmanyuH samatizWata ॥27॥

text: na cātapādhvasantaptaḥ kṣutpipāsāśramānvitaḥ । pratāmyati glāyati vā nāpaiti ca tathātapāt ॥28॥
html:
na cātapādhvasantaptaḥ kṣutpipāsāśramānvitaḥ ।
pratāmyati glāyati vā nāpaiti ca tathātapāt ॥28॥
slp1: na cAtapADvasantaptaH kzutpipAsASramAnvitaH । pratAmyati glAyati vA nApEti ca taTAtapAt ॥28॥

text: teṣāṃ tu dvārapālānāmekaḥ śokasamanvitaḥ । madhyaṅgatamivādityaṃ dṛṣṭvā śukamavasthitam ॥29॥
html:
teṣāṃ tu dvārapālānāmekaḥ śokasamanvitaḥ ।
madhyaṅgatamivādityaṃ dṛṣṭvā śukamavasthitam ॥29॥
slp1: tezAM tu dvArapAlAnAmekaH SokasamanvitaH । maDyaNgatamivAdityaM dfzwvA SukamavasTitam ॥29॥

text: pūjayitvā yathānyāyamabhivādya kṛtāñjaliḥ । prāveśayattataḥ kakṣyāṃ dvitīyāṃ rājaveśmanaḥ ॥30॥
html:
pūjayitvā yathānyāyamabhivādya kṛtāñjaliḥ ।
prāveśayattataḥ kakṣyāṃ dvitīyāṃ rājaveśmanaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: pUjayitvA yaTAnyAyamaBivAdya kftAYjaliH । prAveSayattataH kakzyAM dvitIyAM rAjaveSmanaH ॥30॥

text: tatrāsīnaḥ śukastāta mokṣamevānucintayan । chāyāyāmātape caiva samadarśī mahādyutiḥ ॥31॥
html:
tatrāsīnaḥ śukastāta mokṣamevānucintayan ।
chāyāyāmātape caiva samadarśī mahādyutiḥ ॥31॥
slp1: tatrAsInaH SukastAta mokzamevAnucintayan । CAyAyAmAtape cEva samadarSI mahAdyutiH ॥31॥

text: taṃ muhūrtādivāgamya rājño mantrī kṛtāñjaliḥ । prāveśayattataḥ kakṣyāṃ tṛtīyāṃ rājaveśmanaḥ ॥32॥
html:
taṃ muhūrtādivāgamya rājño mantrī kṛtāñjaliḥ ।
prāveśayattataḥ kakṣyāṃ tṛtīyāṃ rājaveśmanaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: taM muhUrtAdivAgamya rAjYo mantrI kftAYjaliH । prAveSayattataH kakzyAM tftIyAM rAjaveSmanaH ॥32॥

text: tatrāntaḥpurasambaddhaṃ mahaccaitrarathopamam । suvibhaktajalākrīḍaṃ ramyaṃ puṣpitapādapam ॥33॥
html:
tatrāntaḥpurasambaddhaṃ mahaccaitrarathopamam ।
suvibhaktajalākrīḍaṃ ramyaṃ puṣpitapādapam ॥33॥
slp1: tatrAntaHpurasambadDaM mahaccEtraraTopamam । suviBaktajalAkrIqaM ramyaM puzpitapAdapam ॥33॥

text: taddarśayitvā sa śukaṃ mantrī kānanamuttamam । arhamāsanamādiśya niścakrāma tataḥ punaḥ ॥34॥
html:
taddarśayitvā sa śukaṃ mantrī kānanamuttamam ।
arhamāsanamādiśya niścakrāma tataḥ punaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: taddarSayitvA sa SukaM mantrI kAnanamuttamam । arhamAsanamAdiSya niScakrAma tataH punaH ॥34॥

text: taṃ cāruveṣāḥ suśroṇyastaruṇyaḥ priyadarśanāḥ । sūkṣmaraktāmbaradharāstaptakāñcanabhūṣaṇāḥ ॥35॥
html:
taṃ cāruveṣāḥ suśroṇyastaruṇyaḥ priyadarśanāḥ ।
sūkṣmaraktāmbaradharāstaptakāñcanabhūṣaṇāḥ ॥35॥
slp1: taM cAruvezAH suSroRyastaruRyaH priyadarSanAH । sUkzmaraktAmbaraDarAstaptakAYcanaBUzaRAH ॥35॥

text: saṃlāpollāpakuśalā nṛttagītaviśāradāḥ । smitapūrvābhibhāṣiṇyo rūpeṇāpsarasāṃ samāḥ ॥36॥
html:
saṃlāpollāpakuśalā nṛttagītaviśāradāḥ ।
smitapūrvābhibhāṣiṇyo rūpeṇāpsarasāṃ samāḥ ॥36॥
slp1: saMlApollApakuSalA nfttagItaviSAradAH । smitapUrvABiBAziRyo rUpeRApsarasAM samAH ॥36॥

text: kāmopacārakuśalā bhāvajñāḥ sarvakovidāḥ । paraṃ pañcāśato nāryo vāramukhyāḥ samādravan ॥37॥
html:
kāmopacārakuśalā bhāvajñāḥ sarvakovidāḥ ।
paraṃ pañcāśato nāryo vāramukhyāḥ samādravan ॥37॥
slp1: kAmopacArakuSalA BAvajYAH sarvakovidAH । paraM paYcASato nAryo vAramuKyAH samAdravan ॥37॥

text: pādyādīni pratigrāhya pūjayā parayārcya ca । deśakālopapannena sādhvannenāpyatarpayan ॥38॥
html:
pādyādīni pratigrāhya pūjayā parayārcya ca ।
deśakālopapannena sādhvannenāpyatarpayan ॥38॥
slp1: pAdyAdIni pratigrAhya pUjayA parayArcya ca । deSakAlopapannena sADvannenApyatarpayan ॥38॥

text: tasya bhuktavatastāta tadantaḥpurakānanam । suramyaṃ darśayāmāsurekaikaśyena bhārata ॥39॥
html:
tasya bhuktavatastāta tadantaḥpurakānanam ।
suramyaṃ darśayāmāsurekaikaśyena bhārata ॥39॥
slp1: tasya BuktavatastAta tadantaHpurakAnanam । suramyaM darSayAmAsurekEkaSyena BArata ॥39॥

text: krīḍantyaśca hasantyaśca gāyantyaścaiva tāḥ śukam । udārasattvaṃ sattvajñāḥ sarvāḥ paryacaraṃstadā ॥40॥
html:
krīḍantyaśca hasantyaśca gāyantyaścaiva tāḥ śukam ।
udārasattvaṃ sattvajñāḥ sarvāḥ paryacaraṃstadā ॥40॥
slp1: krIqantyaSca hasantyaSca gAyantyaScEva tAH Sukam । udArasattvaM sattvajYAH sarvAH paryacaraMstadA ॥40॥

text: āraṇeyastu śuddhātmā trisandehastrikarmakṛt । vaśyendriyo jitakrodho na hṛṣyati na kupyati ॥41॥
html:
āraṇeyastu śuddhātmā trisandehastrikarmakṛt ।
vaśyendriyo jitakrodho na hṛṣyati na kupyati ॥41॥
slp1: AraReyastu SudDAtmA trisandehastrikarmakft । vaSyendriyo jitakroDo na hfzyati na kupyati ॥41॥

text: tasmai śayyāsanaṃ divyaṃ varārhaṃ ratnabhūṣitam । spardhyāstaraṇasaṃstīrṇaṃ dadustāḥ paramastriyaḥ ॥42॥
html:
tasmai śayyāsanaṃ divyaṃ varārhaṃ ratnabhūṣitam ।
spardhyāstaraṇasaṃstīrṇaṃ dadustāḥ paramastriyaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: tasmE SayyAsanaM divyaM varArhaM ratnaBUzitam । sparDyAstaraRasaMstIrRaM dadustAH paramastriyaH ॥42॥

text: pādaśaucaṃ tu kṛtvaiva śukaḥ sandhyāmupāsya ca । niṣasādāsane puṇye tamevārthaṃ vicintayan ॥43॥
html:
pādaśaucaṃ tu kṛtvaiva śukaḥ sandhyāmupāsya ca ।
niṣasādāsane puṇye tamevārthaṃ vicintayan ॥43॥
slp1: pAdaSOcaM tu kftvEva SukaH sanDyAmupAsya ca । nizasAdAsane puRye tamevArTaM vicintayan ॥43॥

text: pūrvarātre tu tatrāsau bhūtvā dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ । madhyarātre yathānyāyaṃ nidrāmāhārayatprabhuḥ ॥44॥
html:
pūrvarātre tu tatrāsau bhūtvā dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ।
madhyarātre yathānyāyaṃ nidrāmāhārayatprabhuḥ ॥44॥
slp1: pUrvarAtre tu tatrAsO BUtvA DyAnaparAyaRaH । maDyarAtre yaTAnyAyaM nidrAmAhArayatpraBuH ॥44॥

text: tato muhūrtādutthāya kṛtvā śaucamanantaram । strībhiḥ parivṛto dhīmāndhyānamevānvapadyata ॥45॥
html:
tato muhūrtādutthāya kṛtvā śaucamanantaram ।
strībhiḥ parivṛto dhīmāndhyānamevānvapadyata ॥45॥
slp1: tato muhUrtAdutTAya kftvA SOcamanantaram । strIBiH parivfto DImAnDyAnamevAnvapadyata ॥45॥

text: anena vidhinā kārṣṇistadahaḥśeṣamacyutaḥ । tāṃ ca rātriṃ nṛpakule vartayāmāsa bhārata] ॥46॥
html:
anena vidhinā kārṣṇistadahaḥśeṣamacyutaḥ ।
tāṃ ca rātriṃ nṛpakule vartayāmāsa bhārata] ॥46॥
slp1: anena viDinA kArzRistadahaHSezamacyutaH । tAM ca rAtriM nfpakule vartayAmAsa BArata] ॥46॥

text: tataḥ sa rājā janako mantribhiḥ saha bhārata । puraḥ purohitaṃ kṛtvā sarvāṇyantaḥpurāṇi ca ॥1॥
html:
tataḥ sa rājā janako mantribhiḥ saha bhārata ।
puraḥ purohitaṃ kṛtvā sarvāṇyantaḥpurāṇi ca ॥1॥
slp1: tataH sa rAjA janako mantriBiH saha BArata । puraH purohitaM kftvA sarvARyantaHpurARi ca ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: āsanaṃ ca puraskṛtya ratnāni vividhāni ca । śirasā cārghyamādāya guruputraṃ samabhyagāt ॥2॥
html:
āsanaṃ ca puraskṛtya ratnāni vividhāni ca ।
śirasā cārghyamādāya guruputraṃ samabhyagāt ॥2॥
slp1: AsanaM ca puraskftya ratnAni viviDAni ca । SirasA cArGyamAdAya guruputraM samaByagAt ॥2॥

text: sa tadāsanamādāya bahuratnavibhūṣitam । spardhyāstaraṇasaṃstīrṇaṃ sarvatobhadramṛddhimat ॥3॥
html:
sa tadāsanamādāya bahuratnavibhūṣitam ।
spardhyāstaraṇasaṃstīrṇaṃ sarvatobhadramṛddhimat ॥3॥
slp1: sa tadAsanamAdAya bahuratnaviBUzitam । sparDyAstaraRasaMstIrRaM sarvatoBadramfdDimat ॥3॥

text: purodhasā saṅgṛhītaṃ hastenālabhya pārthivaḥ । pradadau guruputrāya śukāya paramārcitam ॥4॥
html:
purodhasā saṅgṛhītaṃ hastenālabhya pārthivaḥ ।
pradadau guruputrāya śukāya paramārcitam ॥4॥
slp1: puroDasA saNgfhItaM hastenAlaBya pArTivaH । pradadO guruputrAya SukAya paramArcitam ॥4॥

text: tatropaviṣṭaṃ taṃ kārṣṇiṃ śāstrataḥ pratyapūjayat । pādyaṃ nivedya prathamamarghyaṃ gāṃ ca nyavedayat । sa ca tāṃ mantravatpūjāṃ pratyagṛhṇādyathāvidhi ॥5॥
html:
tatropaviṣṭaṃ taṃ kārṣṇiṃ śāstrataḥ pratyapūjayat ।
pādyaṃ nivedya prathamamarghyaṃ gāṃ ca nyavedayat ।
sa ca tāṃ mantravatpūjāṃ pratyagṛhṇādyathāvidhi ॥5॥
slp1: tatropavizwaM taM kArzRiM SAstrataH pratyapUjayat । pAdyaM nivedya praTamamarGyaM gAM ca nyavedayat । sa ca tAM mantravatpUjAM pratyagfhRAdyaTAviDi ॥5॥

text: pratigṛhya ca tāṃ pūjāṃ janakāddvijasattamaḥ । gāṃ caiva samanujñāya rājānamanumānya ca ॥6॥
html:
pratigṛhya ca tāṃ pūjāṃ janakāddvijasattamaḥ ।
gāṃ caiva samanujñāya rājānamanumānya ca ॥6॥
slp1: pratigfhya ca tAM pUjAM janakAddvijasattamaH । gAM cEva samanujYAya rAjAnamanumAnya ca ॥6॥

text: paryapṛcchanmahātejā rājñaḥ kuśalamavyayam । anāmayaṃ ca rājendra śukaḥ sānucarasya ha ॥7॥
html:
paryapṛcchanmahātejā rājñaḥ kuśalamavyayam ।
anāmayaṃ ca rājendra śukaḥ sānucarasya ha ॥7॥
slp1: paryapfcCanmahAtejA rAjYaH kuSalamavyayam । anAmayaM ca rAjendra SukaH sAnucarasya ha ॥7॥

text: anujñātaḥ sa tenātha niṣasāda sahānugaḥ । udārasattvābhijano bhūmau rājā kṛtāñjaliḥ ॥8॥
html:
anujñātaḥ sa tenātha niṣasāda sahānugaḥ ।
udārasattvābhijano bhūmau rājā kṛtāñjaliḥ ॥8॥
slp1: anujYAtaH sa tenATa nizasAda sahAnugaH । udArasattvABijano BUmO rAjA kftAYjaliH ॥8॥

text: kuśalaṃ cāvyayaṃ caiva pṛṣṭvā vaiyāsakiṃ nṛpaḥ । kimāgamanamityeva paryapṛcchata pārthivaḥ ॥9॥
html:
kuśalaṃ cāvyayaṃ caiva pṛṣṭvā vaiyāsakiṃ nṛpaḥ ।
kimāgamanamityeva paryapṛcchata pārthivaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: kuSalaM cAvyayaM cEva pfzwvA vEyAsakiM nfpaH । kimAgamanamityeva paryapfcCata pArTivaH ॥9॥

text: pitrāhamukto bhadraṃ te mokṣadharmārthakovidaḥ । videharājo yājyo me janako nāma viśrutaḥ ॥10॥
html:
pitrāhamukto bhadraṃ te mokṣadharmārthakovidaḥ ।
videharājo yājyo me janako nāma viśrutaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: pitrAhamukto BadraM te mokzaDarmArTakovidaH । videharAjo yAjyo me janako nAma viSrutaH ॥10॥

text: tatra gacchasva vai tūrṇaṃ yadi te hṛdi saṃśayaḥ । pravṛttau vā nivṛttau vā sa te chetsyati saṃśayam ॥11॥
html:
tatra gacchasva vai tūrṇaṃ yadi te hṛdi saṃśayaḥ ।
pravṛttau vā nivṛttau vā sa te chetsyati saṃśayam ॥11॥
slp1: tatra gacCasva vE tUrRaM yadi te hfdi saMSayaH । pravfttO vA nivfttO vA sa te Cetsyati saMSayam ॥11॥

text: so'haṃ piturniyogāttvāmupapraṣṭumihāgataḥ । tanme dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha yathāvadvaktumarhasi ॥12॥
html:
so'haṃ piturniyogāttvāmupapraṣṭumihāgataḥ ।
tanme dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha yathāvadvaktumarhasi ॥12॥
slp1: so'haM piturniyogAttvAmupaprazwumihAgataH । tanme DarmaBftAM SrezWa yaTAvadvaktumarhasi ॥12॥

text: kiṃ kāryaṃ brāhmaṇeneha mokṣārthaśca kimātmakaḥ । kathaṃ ca mokṣaḥ kartavyo jñānena tapasāpi vā ॥13॥
html:
kiṃ kāryaṃ brāhmaṇeneha mokṣārthaśca kimātmakaḥ ।
kathaṃ ca mokṣaḥ kartavyo jñānena tapasāpi vā ॥13॥
slp1: kiM kAryaM brAhmaReneha mokzArTaSca kimAtmakaH । kaTaM ca mokzaH kartavyo jYAnena tapasApi vA ॥13॥

html:
yatkāryaṃ brāhmaṇeneha janmaprabhṛti tacchṛṇu ।
kṛtopanayanastāta bhavedvedaparāyaṇaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: yatkAryaM brAhmaReneha janmapraBfti tacCfRu । kftopanayanastAta BavedvedaparAyaRaH ॥14॥

text: tapasā guruvṛttyā ca brahmacaryeṇa cābhibho । devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ cāpyanṛṇaścānasūyakaḥ ॥15॥
html:
tapasā guruvṛttyā ca brahmacaryeṇa cābhibho ।
devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ cāpyanṛṇaścānasūyakaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: tapasA guruvfttyA ca brahmacaryeRa cABiBo । devatAnAM pitFRAM cApyanfRaScAnasUyakaH ॥15॥

text: vedānadhītya niyato dakṣiṇāmapavarjya ca । abhyanujñāmatha prāpya samāvarteta vai dvijaḥ ॥16॥
html:
vedānadhītya niyato dakṣiṇāmapavarjya ca ।

slp1: vedAnaDItya niyato dakziRAmapavarjya ca । aByanujYAmaTa prApya samAvarteta vE dvijaH ॥16॥

text: samāvṛttastu gārhasthye sadāro niyato vaset । anasūyuryathānyāyamāhitāgnistathaiva ca ॥17॥
html:
samāvṛttastu gārhasthye sadāro niyato vaset ।
anasūyuryathānyāyamāhitāgnistathaiva ca ॥17॥
slp1: samAvfttastu gArhasTye sadAro niyato vaset । anasUyuryaTAnyAyamAhitAgnistaTEva ca ॥17॥

text: utpādya putrapautraṃ tu vanyāśramapade vaset । tānevāgnīnyathāśāstramarcayannatithipriyaḥ ॥18॥
html:
utpādya putrapautraṃ tu vanyāśramapade vaset ।
tānevāgnīnyathāśāstramarcayannatithipriyaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: utpAdya putrapOtraM tu vanyASramapade vaset । tAnevAgnInyaTASAstramarcayannatiTipriyaH ॥18॥

text: sa vane'gnīnyathānyāyamātmanyāropya dharmavit । nirdvandvo vītarāgātmā brahmāśramapade vaset ॥19॥
html:
sa vane'gnīnyathānyāyamātmanyāropya dharmavit ।
nirdvandvo vītarāgātmā brahmāśramapade vaset ॥19॥
slp1: sa vane'gnInyaTAnyAyamAtmanyAropya Darmavit । nirdvandvo vItarAgAtmA brahmASramapade vaset ॥19॥

text: utpanne jñānavijñāne pratyakṣe hṛdi śāśvate । kimavaśyaṃ nivastavyamāśrameṣu vaneṣu ca ॥20॥
html:
utpanne jñānavijñāne pratyakṣe hṛdi śāśvate ।
kimavaśyaṃ nivastavyamāśrameṣu vaneṣu ca ॥20॥
slp1: utpanne jYAnavijYAne pratyakze hfdi SASvate । kimavaSyaM nivastavyamASramezu vanezu ca ॥20॥
author: śuka uvāca ।

text: etadbhavantaṃ pṛcchāmi tadbhavānvaktumarhati । yathāvedārthatattvena brūhi me tvaṃ janādhipa ॥21॥
html:
etadbhavantaṃ pṛcchāmi tadbhavānvaktumarhati ।
yathāvedārthatattvena brūhi me tvaṃ janādhipa ॥21॥
slp1: etadBavantaM pfcCAmi tadBavAnvaktumarhati । yaTAvedArTatattvena brUhi me tvaM janADipa ॥21॥

text: na vinā jñānavijñānaṃ mokṣasyādhigamo bhavet । na vinā gurusambandhaṃ jñānasyādhigamaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥22॥
html:
na vinā jñānavijñānaṃ mokṣasyādhigamo bhavet ।
na vinā gurusambandhaṃ jñānasyādhigamaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: na vinA jYAnavijYAnaM mokzasyADigamo Bavet । na vinA gurusambanDaM jYAnasyADigamaH smftaH ॥22॥
