text: ācāryaḥ plāvitā tasya jñānaṃ plava ihocyate । vijñāya kṛtakṛtyastu tīrṇastadubhayaṃ tyajet ॥23॥
html:
ācāryaḥ plāvitā tasya jñānaṃ plava ihocyate ।
vijñāya kṛtakṛtyastu tīrṇastadubhayaṃ tyajet ॥23॥
slp1: AcAryaH plAvitA tasya jYAnaM plava ihocyate । vijYAya kftakftyastu tIrRastaduBayaM tyajet ॥23॥

text: anucchedāya lokānāmanucchedāya karmaṇām । pūrvairācarito dharmaścāturāśramyasaṅkathaḥ ॥24॥
html:
anucchedāya lokānāmanucchedāya karmaṇām ।
pūrvairācarito dharmaścāturāśramyasaṅkathaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: anucCedAya lokAnAmanucCedAya karmaRAm । pUrvErAcarito DarmaScAturASramyasaNkaTaH ॥24॥

text: anena kramayogena bahujātiṣu karmaṇā । kṛtvā śubhāśubhaṃ karma mokṣo nāmeha labhyate ॥25॥
html:
anena kramayogena bahujātiṣu karmaṇā ।
kṛtvā śubhāśubhaṃ karma mokṣo nāmeha labhyate ॥25॥
slp1: anena kramayogena bahujAtizu karmaRA । kftvA SuBASuBaM karma mokzo nAmeha laByate ॥25॥

text: bhāvitaiḥ kāraṇaiścāyaṃ bahusaṃsārayoniṣu । āsādayati śuddhātmā mokṣaṃ vai prathamāśrame ॥26॥
html:
bhāvitaiḥ kāraṇaiścāyaṃ bahusaṃsārayoniṣu ।
āsādayati śuddhātmā mokṣaṃ vai prathamāśrame ॥26॥
slp1: BAvitEH kAraREScAyaM bahusaMsArayonizu । AsAdayati SudDAtmA mokzaM vE praTamASrame ॥26॥

text: tamāsādya tu muktasya dṛṣṭārthasya vipaścitaḥ । triṣvāśrameṣu ko nvartho bhavetparamabhīpsataḥ ॥27॥
html:
tamāsādya tu muktasya dṛṣṭārthasya vipaścitaḥ ।
triṣvāśrameṣu ko nvartho bhavetparamabhīpsataḥ ॥27॥
slp1: tamAsAdya tu muktasya dfzwArTasya vipaScitaH । trizvASramezu ko nvarTo BavetparamaBIpsataH ॥27॥

text: rājasāṃstāmasāṃścaiva nityaṃ doṣānvivarjayet । sāttvikaṃ mārgamāsthāya paśyedātmānamātmanā ॥28॥
html:
rājasāṃstāmasāṃścaiva nityaṃ doṣānvivarjayet ।
sāttvikaṃ mārgamāsthāya paśyedātmānamātmanā ॥28॥
slp1: rAjasAMstAmasAMScEva nityaM dozAnvivarjayet । sAttvikaM mArgamAsTAya paSyedAtmAnamAtmanA ॥28॥

text: sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani । sampaśyannopalipyeta jale vāricaro yathā ॥29॥
html:
sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani ।
sampaśyannopalipyeta jale vāricaro yathā ॥29॥
slp1: sarvaBUtezu cAtmAnaM sarvaBUtAni cAtmani । sampaSyannopalipyeta jale vAricaro yaTA ॥29॥

text: pakṣīva plavanādūrdhvamamutrānantyamaśnute । vihāya dehaṃ nirmukto nirdvandvaḥ praśamaṃ gataḥ ॥30॥
html:
pakṣīva plavanādūrdhvamamutrānantyamaśnute ।
vihāya dehaṃ nirmukto nirdvandvaḥ praśamaṃ gataḥ ॥30॥
slp1: pakzIva plavanAdUrDvamamutrAnantyamaSnute । vihAya dehaM nirmukto nirdvandvaH praSamaM gataH ॥30॥

text: atra gāthāḥ purā gītāḥ śṛṇu rājñā yayātinā । dhāryante yā dvijaistāta mokṣaśāstraviśāradaiḥ ॥31॥
html:
atra gāthāḥ purā gītāḥ śṛṇu rājñā yayātinā ।
dhāryante yā dvijaistāta mokṣaśāstraviśāradaiḥ ॥31॥
slp1: atra gATAH purA gItAH SfRu rAjYA yayAtinA । DAryante yA dvijEstAta mokzaSAstraviSAradEH ॥31॥

text: jyotirātmani nānyatra rataṃ tatraiva caiva tat । svayaṃ ca śakyaṃ taddraṣṭuṃ susamāhitacetasā ॥32॥
html:
jyotirātmani nānyatra rataṃ tatraiva caiva tat ।
svayaṃ ca śakyaṃ taddraṣṭuṃ susamāhitacetasā ॥32॥
slp1: jyotirAtmani nAnyatra rataM tatrEva cEva tat । svayaM ca SakyaM taddrazwuM susamAhitacetasA ॥32॥

text: na bibheti paro yasmānna bibheti parācca yaḥ । yaśca necchati na dveṣṭi brahma sampadyate tadā ॥33॥
html:
na bibheti paro yasmānna bibheti parācca yaḥ ।
yaśca necchati na dveṣṭi brahma sampadyate tadā ॥33॥
slp1: na biBeti paro yasmAnna biBeti parAcca yaH । yaSca necCati na dvezwi brahma sampadyate tadA ॥33॥

text: yadā bhāvaṃ na kurute sarvabhūteṣu pāpakam । karmaṇā manasā vācā brahma sampadyate tadā ॥34॥
html:
yadā bhāvaṃ na kurute sarvabhūteṣu pāpakam ।
karmaṇā manasā vācā brahma sampadyate tadā ॥34॥
slp1: yadA BAvaM na kurute sarvaBUtezu pApakam । karmaRA manasA vAcA brahma sampadyate tadA ॥34॥

text: saṃyojya tapasātmānamīrṣyāmutsṛjya mohinīm । tyaktvā kāmaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca tato brahmatvamaśnute ॥35॥
html:
saṃyojya tapasātmānamīrṣyāmutsṛjya mohinīm ।
tyaktvā kāmaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca tato brahmatvamaśnute ॥35॥
slp1: saMyojya tapasAtmAnamIrzyAmutsfjya mohinIm । tyaktvA kAmaM ca loBaM ca tato brahmatvamaSnute ॥35॥

text: yadā śravye ca dṛśye ca sarvabhūteṣu cāpyayam । samo bhavati nirdvandvo brahma sampadyate tadā ॥36॥
html:
yadā śravye ca dṛśye ca sarvabhūteṣu cāpyayam ।
samo bhavati nirdvandvo brahma sampadyate tadā ॥36॥
slp1: yadA Sravye ca dfSye ca sarvaBUtezu cApyayam । samo Bavati nirdvandvo brahma sampadyate tadA ॥36॥

text: yadā stutiṃ ca nindāṃ ca samatvenaiva paśyati । kāñcanaṃ cāyasaṃ caiva sukhaduḥkhe tathaiva ca ॥37॥
html:
yadā stutiṃ ca nindāṃ ca samatvenaiva paśyati ।
kāñcanaṃ cāyasaṃ caiva sukhaduḥkhe tathaiva ca ॥37॥
slp1: yadA stutiM ca nindAM ca samatvenEva paSyati । kAYcanaM cAyasaM cEva suKaduHKe taTEva ca ॥37॥

text: śītamuṣṇaṃ tathaivārthamanarthaṃ priyamapriyam । jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ caiva brahma sampadyate tadā ॥38॥
html:
śītamuṣṇaṃ tathaivārthamanarthaṃ priyamapriyam ।
jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ caiva brahma sampadyate tadā ॥38॥
slp1: SItamuzRaM taTEvArTamanarTaM priyamapriyam । jIvitaM maraRaM cEva brahma sampadyate tadA ॥38॥

text: prasāryeha yathāṅgāni kūrmaḥ saṃharate punaḥ । tathendriyāṇi manasā saṃyantavyāni bhikṣuṇā ॥39॥
html:
prasāryeha yathāṅgāni kūrmaḥ saṃharate punaḥ ।
tathendriyāṇi manasā saṃyantavyāni bhikṣuṇā ॥39॥
slp1: prasAryeha yaTANgAni kUrmaH saMharate punaH । taTendriyARi manasA saMyantavyAni BikzuRA ॥39॥

text: tamaḥparigataṃ veśma yathā dīpena dṛśyate । tathā buddhipradīpena śakya ātmā nirīkṣitum ॥40॥
html:
tamaḥparigataṃ veśma yathā dīpena dṛśyate ।
tathā buddhipradīpena śakya ātmā nirīkṣitum ॥40॥
slp1: tamaHparigataM veSma yaTA dIpena dfSyate । taTA budDipradIpena Sakya AtmA nirIkzitum ॥40॥

text: etatsarvaṃ prapaśyāmi tvayi buddhimatāṃ vara । yaccānyadapi vettavyaṃ tattvato veda tadbhavān ॥41॥
html:
etatsarvaṃ prapaśyāmi tvayi buddhimatāṃ vara ।
yaccānyadapi vettavyaṃ tattvato veda tadbhavān ॥41॥
slp1: etatsarvaM prapaSyAmi tvayi budDimatAM vara । yaccAnyadapi vettavyaM tattvato veda tadBavAn ॥41॥

text: brahmarṣe viditaścāsi viṣayāntamupāgataḥ । gurostava prasādena tava caivopaśikṣayā ॥42॥
html:
brahmarṣe viditaścāsi viṣayāntamupāgataḥ ।
gurostava prasādena tava caivopaśikṣayā ॥42॥
slp1: brahmarze viditaScAsi vizayAntamupAgataH । gurostava prasAdena tava cEvopaSikzayA ॥42॥

text: tasyaiva ca prasādena prādurbhūtaṃ mahāmune । jñānaṃ divyaṃ mamāpīdaṃ tenāsi vidito mama ॥43॥
html:
tasyaiva ca prasādena prādurbhūtaṃ mahāmune ।
jñānaṃ divyaṃ mamāpīdaṃ tenāsi vidito mama ॥43॥
slp1: tasyEva ca prasAdena prAdurBUtaM mahAmune । jYAnaM divyaM mamApIdaM tenAsi vidito mama ॥43॥

text: adhikaṃ tava vijñānamadhikā ca gatistava । adhikaṃ ca tavaiśvaryaṃ tacca tvaṃ nāvabudhyase ॥44॥
html:
adhikaṃ tava vijñānamadhikā ca gatistava ।
adhikaṃ ca tavaiśvaryaṃ tacca tvaṃ nāvabudhyase ॥44॥
slp1: aDikaM tava vijYAnamaDikA ca gatistava । aDikaM ca tavESvaryaM tacca tvaM nAvabuDyase ॥44॥

text: bālyādvā saṃśayādvāpi bhayādvāpyavimokṣajāt । utpanne cāpi vijñāne nādhigacchati tāṃ gatim ॥45॥
html:
bālyādvā saṃśayādvāpi bhayādvāpyavimokṣajāt ।
utpanne cāpi vijñāne nādhigacchati tāṃ gatim ॥45॥
slp1: bAlyAdvA saMSayAdvApi BayAdvApyavimokzajAt । utpanne cApi vijYAne nADigacCati tAM gatim ॥45॥

text: vyavasāyena śuddhena madvidhaiśchinnasaṃśayaḥ । vimucya hṛdayagranthīnāsādayati tāṃ gatim ॥46॥
html:
vyavasāyena śuddhena madvidhaiśchinnasaṃśayaḥ ।
vimucya hṛdayagranthīnāsādayati tāṃ gatim ॥46॥
slp1: vyavasAyena SudDena madviDESCinnasaMSayaH । vimucya hfdayagranTInAsAdayati tAM gatim ॥46॥

text: bhavāṃścotpannavijñānaḥ sthirabuddhiralolupaḥ । vyavasāyādṛte brahmannāsādayati tatparam ॥47॥
html:
bhavāṃścotpannavijñānaḥ sthirabuddhiralolupaḥ ।
vyavasāyādṛte brahmannāsādayati tatparam ॥47॥
slp1: BavAMScotpannavijYAnaH sTirabudDiralolupaH । vyavasAyAdfte brahmannAsAdayati tatparam ॥47॥

text: nāsti te sukhaduḥkheṣu viśeṣo nāsti lolupā । nautsukyaṃ nṛttagīteṣu na rāga upajāyate ॥48॥
html:
nāsti te sukhaduḥkheṣu viśeṣo nāsti lolupā ।
nautsukyaṃ nṛttagīteṣu na rāga upajāyate ॥48॥
slp1: nAsti te suKaduHKezu viSezo nAsti lolupA । nOtsukyaM nfttagItezu na rAga upajAyate ॥48॥

text: na bandhuṣu nibandhaste na bhayeṣvasti te bhayam । paśyāmi tvāṃ mahābhāga tulyaloṣṭāśmakāñcanam ॥49॥
html:
na bandhuṣu nibandhaste na bhayeṣvasti te bhayam ।
paśyāmi tvāṃ mahābhāga tulyaloṣṭāśmakāñcanam ॥49॥
slp1: na banDuzu nibanDaste na Bayezvasti te Bayam । paSyAmi tvAM mahABAga tulyalozwASmakAYcanam ॥49॥

text: ahaṃ ca tvānupaśyāmi ye cāpyanye manīṣiṇaḥ । āsthitaṃ paramaṃ mārgamakṣayaṃ tamanāmayam ॥50॥
html:
ahaṃ ca tvānupaśyāmi ye cāpyanye manīṣiṇaḥ ।
āsthitaṃ paramaṃ mārgamakṣayaṃ tamanāmayam ॥50॥
slp1: ahaM ca tvAnupaSyAmi ye cApyanye manIziRaH । AsTitaM paramaM mArgamakzayaM tamanAmayam ॥50॥

text: yatphalaṃ brāhmaṇasyeha mokṣārthaśca yadātmakaḥ । tasminvai vartase vipra kimanyatparipṛcchasi] ॥51॥
html:
yatphalaṃ brāhmaṇasyeha mokṣārthaśca yadātmakaḥ ।
tasminvai vartase vipra kimanyatparipṛcchasi] ॥51॥
slp1: yatPalaM brAhmaRasyeha mokzArTaSca yadAtmakaH । tasminvE vartase vipra kimanyatparipfcCasi] ॥51॥

text: etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ kṛtātmā kṛtaniścayaḥ । ātmanātmānamāsthāya dṛṣṭvā cātmānamātmanā ॥1॥
html:
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ kṛtātmā kṛtaniścayaḥ ।
ātmanātmānamāsthāya dṛṣṭvā cātmānamātmanā ॥1॥
slp1: etacCrutvA tu vacanaM kftAtmA kftaniScayaH । AtmanAtmAnamAsTAya dfzwvA cAtmAnamAtmanA ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kṛtakāryaḥ sukhī śāntastūṣṇīṃ prāyādudaṅmukhaḥ । śaiśiraṃ girimuddiśya sadharmā mātariśvanaḥ ॥2॥
html:
kṛtakāryaḥ sukhī śāntastūṣṇīṃ prāyādudaṅmukhaḥ ।
śaiśiraṃ girimuddiśya sadharmā mātariśvanaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: kftakAryaH suKI SAntastUzRIM prAyAdudaNmuKaH । SESiraM girimuddiSya saDarmA mAtariSvanaH ॥2॥

text: etasminneva kāle tu devarṣirnāradastadā । himavantamiyāddraṣṭuṃ siddhacāraṇasevitam ॥3॥
html:
etasminneva kāle tu devarṣirnāradastadā ।
himavantamiyāddraṣṭuṃ siddhacāraṇasevitam ॥3॥
slp1: etasminneva kAle tu devarzirnAradastadA । himavantamiyAddrazwuM sidDacAraRasevitam ॥3॥

text: tamapsarogaṇākīrṇaṃ gītasvananināditam । kinnarāṇāṃ samūhaiśca bhṛṅgarājaistathaiva ca ॥4॥
html:
tamapsarogaṇākīrṇaṃ gītasvananināditam ।
kinnarāṇāṃ samūhaiśca bhṛṅgarājaistathaiva ca ॥4॥
slp1: tamapsarogaRAkIrRaM gItasvananinAditam । kinnarARAM samUhESca BfNgarAjEstaTEva ca ॥4॥

text: madgubhiḥ khañjarīṭaiśca vicitrairjīvajīvakaiḥ । citravarṇairmayūraiśca kekāśatavirājitaiḥ । rājahaṃsasamūhaiśca hṛṣṭaiḥ parabhṛtaistathā ॥5॥
html:
madgubhiḥ khañjarīṭaiśca vicitrairjīvajīvakaiḥ ।
citravarṇairmayūraiśca kekāśatavirājitaiḥ ।
rājahaṃsasamūhaiśca hṛṣṭaiḥ parabhṛtaistathā ॥5॥
slp1: madguBiH KaYjarIwESca vicitrErjIvajIvakEH । citravarRErmayUrESca kekASatavirAjitEH । rAjahaMsasamUhESca hfzwEH paraBftEstaTA ॥5॥

text: pakṣirājo garutmāṃśca yaṃ nityamadhigacchati । catvāro lokapālāśca devāḥ sarṣigaṇāstathā । yatra nityaṃ samāyānti lokasya hitakāmyayā ॥6॥
html:
pakṣirājo garutmāṃśca yaṃ nityamadhigacchati ।
catvāro lokapālāśca devāḥ sarṣigaṇāstathā ।
yatra nityaṃ samāyānti lokasya hitakāmyayā ॥6॥
slp1: pakzirAjo garutmAMSca yaM nityamaDigacCati । catvAro lokapAlASca devAH sarzigaRAstaTA । yatra nityaM samAyAnti lokasya hitakAmyayA ॥6॥

text: viṣṇunā yatra putrārthe tapastaptaṃ mahātmanā । yatraiva ca kumāreṇa bālye kṣiptā divaukasaḥ ॥7॥
html:
viṣṇunā yatra putrārthe tapastaptaṃ mahātmanā ।
yatraiva ca kumāreṇa bālye kṣiptā divaukasaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: vizRunA yatra putrArTe tapastaptaM mahAtmanA । yatrEva ca kumAreRa bAlye kziptA divOkasaH ॥7॥

text: śaktirnyastā kṣititale trailokyamavamanya vai । yatrovāca jagatskandaḥ kṣipanvākyamidaṃ tadā ॥8॥
html:
śaktirnyastā kṣititale trailokyamavamanya vai ।
yatrovāca jagatskandaḥ kṣipanvākyamidaṃ tadā ॥8॥
slp1: SaktirnyastA kzititale trElokyamavamanya vE । yatrovAca jagatskandaH kzipanvAkyamidaM tadA ॥8॥

text: yo'nyo'sti matto'bhyadhiko viprā yasyādhikaṃ priyāḥ । yo brahmaṇyo dvitīyo'sti triṣu lokeṣu vīryavān ॥9॥
html:
yo'nyo'sti matto'bhyadhiko viprā yasyādhikaṃ priyāḥ ।
yo brahmaṇyo dvitīyo'sti triṣu lokeṣu vīryavān ॥9॥
slp1: yo'nyo'sti matto'ByaDiko viprA yasyADikaM priyAH । yo brahmaRyo dvitIyo'sti trizu lokezu vIryavAn ॥9॥

text: so'bhyuddharatvimāṃ śaktimatha vā kampayatviti । tacchrutvā vyathitā lokāḥ ka imāmuddharediti ॥10॥
html:
so'bhyuddharatvimāṃ śaktimatha vā kampayatviti ।
tacchrutvā vyathitā lokāḥ ka imāmuddharediti ॥10॥
slp1: so'ByudDaratvimAM SaktimaTa vA kampayatviti । tacCrutvA vyaTitA lokAH ka imAmudDarediti ॥10॥

text: atha devagaṇaṃ sarvaṃ sambhrāntendriyamānasam । apaśyadbhagavānviṣṇuḥ kṣiptaṃ sāsurarākṣasam । kiṃ nvatra sukṛtaṃ kāryaṃ bhavediti vicintayan ॥11॥
html:
atha devagaṇaṃ sarvaṃ sambhrāntendriyamānasam ।
apaśyadbhagavānviṣṇuḥ kṣiptaṃ sāsurarākṣasam ।
kiṃ nvatra sukṛtaṃ kāryaṃ bhavediti vicintayan ॥11॥
slp1: aTa devagaRaM sarvaM samBrAntendriyamAnasam । apaSyadBagavAnvizRuH kziptaM sAsurarAkzasam । kiM nvatra sukftaM kAryaM Bavediti vicintayan ॥11॥

text: sa nāmṛṣyata taṃ kṣepamavaikṣata ca pāvakim । sa prahasya viśuddhātmā śaktiṃ prajvalitāṃ tadā । kampayāmāsa savyena pāṇinā puruṣottamaḥ ॥12॥
html:
sa nāmṛṣyata taṃ kṣepamavaikṣata ca pāvakim ।
sa prahasya viśuddhātmā śaktiṃ prajvalitāṃ tadā ।
kampayāmāsa savyena pāṇinā puruṣottamaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: sa nAmfzyata taM kzepamavEkzata ca pAvakim । sa prahasya viSudDAtmA SaktiM prajvalitAM tadA । kampayAmAsa savyena pARinA puruzottamaH ॥12॥

text: śaktyāṃ tu kampamānāyāṃ viṣṇunā balinā tadā । medinī kampitā sarvā saśailavanakānanā ॥13॥
html:
śaktyāṃ tu kampamānāyāṃ viṣṇunā balinā tadā ।
medinī kampitā sarvā saśailavanakānanā ॥13॥
slp1: SaktyAM tu kampamAnAyAM vizRunA balinA tadA । medinI kampitA sarvA saSElavanakAnanA ॥13॥

text: śaktenāpi samuddhartuṃ kampitā sā na tūddhṛtā । rakṣatā skandarājasya dharṣaṇāṃ prabhaviṣṇunā ॥14॥
html:
śaktenāpi samuddhartuṃ kampitā sā na tūddhṛtā ।
rakṣatā skandarājasya dharṣaṇāṃ prabhaviṣṇunā ॥14॥
slp1: SaktenApi samudDartuM kampitA sA na tUdDftA । rakzatA skandarAjasya DarzaRAM praBavizRunA ॥14॥

text: tāṃ kampayitvā bhagavānprahrādamidamabravīt । paśya vīryaṃ kumārasya naitadanyaḥ kariṣyati ॥15॥
html:
tāṃ kampayitvā bhagavānprahrādamidamabravīt ।
paśya vīryaṃ kumārasya naitadanyaḥ kariṣyati ॥15॥
slp1: tAM kampayitvA BagavAnprahrAdamidamabravIt । paSya vIryaM kumArasya nEtadanyaH karizyati ॥15॥

text: so'mṛṣyamāṇastadvākyaṃ samuddharaṇaniścitaḥ । jagrāha tāṃ tasya śaktiṃ na caināmapyakampayat ॥16॥
html:
so'mṛṣyamāṇastadvākyaṃ samuddharaṇaniścitaḥ ।
jagrāha tāṃ tasya śaktiṃ na caināmapyakampayat ॥16॥
slp1: so'mfzyamARastadvAkyaM samudDaraRaniScitaH । jagrAha tAM tasya SaktiM na cEnAmapyakampayat ॥16॥

text: nādaṃ mahāntaṃ muktvā sa mūrchito girimūrdhani । vihvalaḥ prāpatadbhūmau hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutaḥ ॥17॥
html:
nādaṃ mahāntaṃ muktvā sa mūrchito girimūrdhani ।
vihvalaḥ prāpatadbhūmau hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: nAdaM mahAntaM muktvA sa mUrCito girimUrDani । vihvalaH prApatadBUmO hiraRyakaSipoH sutaH ॥17॥

text: yatrottarāṃ diśaṃ gatvā śailarājasya pārśvataḥ । tapo'tapyata durdharṣastāta nityaṃ vṛṣadhvajaḥ ॥18॥
html:
yatrottarāṃ diśaṃ gatvā śailarājasya pārśvataḥ ।
tapo'tapyata durdharṣastāta nityaṃ vṛṣadhvajaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: yatrottarAM diSaM gatvA SElarAjasya pArSvataH । tapo'tapyata durDarzastAta nityaM vfzaDvajaH ॥18॥

text: pāvakena parikṣipto dīpyatā tasya cāśramaḥ । ādityabandhanaṃ nāma durdharṣamakṛtātmabhiḥ ॥19॥
html:
pāvakena parikṣipto dīpyatā tasya cāśramaḥ ।
ādityabandhanaṃ nāma durdharṣamakṛtātmabhiḥ ॥19॥
slp1: pAvakena parikzipto dIpyatA tasya cASramaH । AdityabanDanaM nAma durDarzamakftAtmaBiH ॥19॥

text: na tatra śakyate gantuṃ yakṣarākṣasadānavaiḥ । daśayojanavistāramagnijvālāsamāvṛtam ॥20॥
html:
na tatra śakyate gantuṃ yakṣarākṣasadānavaiḥ ।
daśayojanavistāramagnijvālāsamāvṛtam ॥20॥
slp1: na tatra Sakyate gantuM yakzarAkzasadAnavEH । daSayojanavistAramagnijvAlAsamAvftam ॥20॥

text: bhagavānpāvakastatra svayaṃ tiṣṭhati vīryavān । sarvavighnānpraśamayanmahādevasya dhīmataḥ ॥21॥
html:
bhagavānpāvakastatra svayaṃ tiṣṭhati vīryavān ।
sarvavighnānpraśamayanmahādevasya dhīmataḥ ॥21॥
slp1: BagavAnpAvakastatra svayaM tizWati vIryavAn । sarvaviGnAnpraSamayanmahAdevasya DImataH ॥21॥

text: divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ hi pādenaikena tiṣṭhataḥ । devānsantāpayaṃstatra mahādevo dhṛtavrataḥ ॥22॥
html:
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ hi pādenaikena tiṣṭhataḥ ।
devānsantāpayaṃstatra mahādevo dhṛtavrataḥ ॥22॥
slp1: divyaM varzasahasraM hi pAdenEkena tizWataH । devAnsantApayaMstatra mahAdevo DftavrataH ॥22॥

text: aindrīṃ tu diśamāsthāya śailarājasya dhīmataḥ । vivikte parvatataṭe pārāśaryo mahātapāḥ । vedānadhyāpayāmāsa vyāsaḥ śiṣyānmahātapāḥ ॥23॥
html:
aindrīṃ tu diśamāsthāya śailarājasya dhīmataḥ ।
vivikte parvatataṭe pārāśaryo mahātapāḥ ।
vedānadhyāpayāmāsa vyāsaḥ śiṣyānmahātapāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: EndrIM tu diSamAsTAya SElarAjasya DImataH । vivikte parvatatawe pArASaryo mahAtapAH । vedAnaDyApayAmAsa vyAsaH SizyAnmahAtapAH ॥23॥

text: sumantuṃ ca mahābhāgaṃ vaiśampāyanameva ca । jaiminiṃ ca mahāprājñaṃ pailaṃ cāpi tapasvinam ॥24॥
html:
sumantuṃ ca mahābhāgaṃ vaiśampāyanameva ca ।
jaiminiṃ ca mahāprājñaṃ pailaṃ cāpi tapasvinam ॥24॥
slp1: sumantuM ca mahABAgaM vESampAyanameva ca । jEminiM ca mahAprAjYaM pElaM cApi tapasvinam ॥24॥

text: ebhiḥ śiṣyaiḥ parivṛto vyāsa āste mahātapāḥ । tatrāśramapadaṃ puṇyaṃ dadarśa pituruttamam । āraṇeyo viśuddhātmā nabhasīva divākaraḥ ॥25॥
html:
ebhiḥ śiṣyaiḥ parivṛto vyāsa āste mahātapāḥ ।
tatrāśramapadaṃ puṇyaṃ dadarśa pituruttamam ।
āraṇeyo viśuddhātmā nabhasīva divākaraḥ ॥25॥
slp1: eBiH SizyEH parivfto vyAsa Aste mahAtapAH । tatrASramapadaM puRyaM dadarSa pituruttamam । AraReyo viSudDAtmA naBasIva divAkaraH ॥25॥

text: atha vyāsaḥ parikṣiptaṃ jvalantamiva pāvakam । dadarśa sutamāyāntaṃ divākarasamaprabham ॥26॥
html:
atha vyāsaḥ parikṣiptaṃ jvalantamiva pāvakam ।
dadarśa sutamāyāntaṃ divākarasamaprabham ॥26॥
slp1: aTa vyAsaH parikziptaM jvalantamiva pAvakam । dadarSa sutamAyAntaM divAkarasamapraBam ॥26॥

text: asajjamānaṃ vṛkṣeṣu śaileṣu viṣameṣu ca । yogayuktaṃ mahātmānaṃ yathā bāṇaṃ guṇacyutam ॥27॥
html:
asajjamānaṃ vṛkṣeṣu śaileṣu viṣameṣu ca ।
yogayuktaṃ mahātmānaṃ yathā bāṇaṃ guṇacyutam ॥27॥
slp1: asajjamAnaM vfkzezu SElezu vizamezu ca । yogayuktaM mahAtmAnaM yaTA bARaM guRacyutam ॥27॥

text: so'bhigamya pituḥ pādāvagṛhṇādaraṇīsutaḥ । yathopajoṣaṃ taiścāpi samāgacchanmahāmuniḥ ॥28॥
html:
so'bhigamya pituḥ pādāvagṛhṇādaraṇīsutaḥ ।
yathopajoṣaṃ taiścāpi samāgacchanmahāmuniḥ ॥28॥
slp1: so'Bigamya pituH pAdAvagfhRAdaraRIsutaH । yaTopajozaM tEScApi samAgacCanmahAmuniH ॥28॥

text: tato nivedayāmāsa pitre sarvamaśeṣataḥ । śuko janakarājena saṃvādaṃ prītamānasaḥ ॥29॥
html:
tato nivedayāmāsa pitre sarvamaśeṣataḥ ।
śuko janakarājena saṃvādaṃ prītamānasaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: tato nivedayAmAsa pitre sarvamaSezataH । Suko janakarAjena saMvAdaM prItamAnasaH ॥29॥

text: evamadhyāpayañśiṣyānvyāsaḥ putraṃ ca vīryavān । uvāsa himavatpṛṣṭhe pārāśaryo mahāmuniḥ ॥30॥
html:
evamadhyāpayañśiṣyānvyāsaḥ putraṃ ca vīryavān ।
uvāsa himavatpṛṣṭhe pārāśaryo mahāmuniḥ ॥30॥
slp1: evamaDyApayaYSizyAnvyAsaH putraM ca vIryavAn । uvAsa himavatpfzWe pArASaryo mahAmuniH ॥30॥

text: tataḥ kadācicchiṣyāstaṃ parivāryāvatasthire । vedādhyayanasampannāḥ śāntātmāno jitendriyāḥ ॥31॥
html:
tataḥ kadācicchiṣyāstaṃ parivāryāvatasthire ।
vedādhyayanasampannāḥ śāntātmāno jitendriyāḥ ॥31॥
slp1: tataH kadAcicCizyAstaM parivAryAvatasTire । vedADyayanasampannAH SAntAtmAno jitendriyAH ॥31॥

text: vedeṣu niṣṭhāṃ samprāpya sāṅgeṣvatitapasvinaḥ । athocuste tadā vyāsaṃ śiṣyāḥ prāñjalayo gurum ॥32॥
html:
vedeṣu niṣṭhāṃ samprāpya sāṅgeṣvatitapasvinaḥ ।
athocuste tadā vyāsaṃ śiṣyāḥ prāñjalayo gurum ॥32॥
slp1: vedezu nizWAM samprApya sANgezvatitapasvinaH । aTocuste tadA vyAsaM SizyAH prAYjalayo gurum ॥32॥

text: mahatā śreyasā yuktā yaśasā ca sma vardhitāḥ । ekaṃ tvidānīmicchāmo guruṇānugrahaṃ kṛtam ॥33॥
html:
mahatā śreyasā yuktā yaśasā ca sma vardhitāḥ ।
ekaṃ tvidānīmicchāmo guruṇānugrahaṃ kṛtam ॥33॥
slp1: mahatA SreyasA yuktA yaSasA ca sma varDitAH । ekaM tvidAnImicCAmo guruRAnugrahaM kftam ॥33॥

text: iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā brahmarṣistānuvāca ha । ucyatāmiti tadvatsā yadvaḥ kāryaṃ priyaṃ mayā ॥34॥
html:
iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā brahmarṣistānuvāca ha ।
ucyatāmiti tadvatsā yadvaḥ kāryaṃ priyaṃ mayā ॥34॥
slp1: iti tezAM vacaH SrutvA brahmarzistAnuvAca ha । ucyatAmiti tadvatsA yadvaH kAryaM priyaM mayA ॥34॥

text: etadvākyaṃ guroḥ śrutvā śiṣyāste hṛṣṭamānasāḥ । punaḥ prāñjalayo bhūtvā praṇamya śirasā gurum ॥35॥
html:
etadvākyaṃ guroḥ śrutvā śiṣyāste hṛṣṭamānasāḥ ।
punaḥ prāñjalayo bhūtvā praṇamya śirasā gurum ॥35॥
slp1: etadvAkyaM guroH SrutvA SizyAste hfzwamAnasAH । punaH prAYjalayo BUtvA praRamya SirasA gurum ॥35॥

text: ūcuste sahitā rājannidaṃ vacanamuttamam । yadi prīta upādhyāyo dhanyāḥ smo munisattama ॥36॥
html:
ūcuste sahitā rājannidaṃ vacanamuttamam ।
yadi prīta upādhyāyo dhanyāḥ smo munisattama ॥36॥
slp1: Ucuste sahitA rAjannidaM vacanamuttamam । yadi prIta upADyAyo DanyAH smo munisattama ॥36॥

text: kāṅkṣāmastu vayaṃ sarve varaṃ dattaṃ maharṣiṇā । ṣaṣṭhaḥ śiṣyo na te khyātiṃ gacchedatra prasīda naḥ ॥37॥
html:
kāṅkṣāmastu vayaṃ sarve varaṃ dattaṃ maharṣiṇā ।
ṣaṣṭhaḥ śiṣyo na te khyātiṃ gacchedatra prasīda naḥ ॥37॥
slp1: kANkzAmastu vayaM sarve varaM dattaM maharziRA । zazWaH Sizyo na te KyAtiM gacCedatra prasIda naH ॥37॥

text: catvāraste vayaṃ śiṣyā guruputraśca pañcamaḥ । iha vedāḥ pratiṣṭheranneṣa naḥ kāṅkṣito varaḥ ॥38॥
html:
catvāraste vayaṃ śiṣyā guruputraśca pañcamaḥ ।
iha vedāḥ pratiṣṭheranneṣa naḥ kāṅkṣito varaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: catvAraste vayaM SizyA guruputraSca paYcamaH । iha vedAH pratizWeranneza naH kANkzito varaH ॥38॥

text: śiṣyāṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā vyāso vedārthatattvavit । parāśarātmajo dhīmānparalokārthacintakaḥ । uvāca śiṣyāndharmātmā dharmyaṃ naiḥśreyasaṃ vacaḥ ॥39॥
html:
śiṣyāṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā vyāso vedārthatattvavit ।
parāśarātmajo dhīmānparalokārthacintakaḥ ।
uvāca śiṣyāndharmātmā dharmyaṃ naiḥśreyasaṃ vacaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: SizyARAM vacanaM SrutvA vyAso vedArTatattvavit । parASarAtmajo DImAnparalokArTacintakaH । uvAca SizyAnDarmAtmA DarmyaM nEHSreyasaM vacaH ॥39॥

text: brāhmaṇāya sadā deyaṃ brahma śuśrūṣave bhavet । brahmaloke nivāsaṃ yo dhruvaṃ samabhikāṅkṣati ॥40॥
html:
brāhmaṇāya sadā deyaṃ brahma śuśrūṣave bhavet ।
brahmaloke nivāsaṃ yo dhruvaṃ samabhikāṅkṣati ॥40॥
slp1: brAhmaRAya sadA deyaM brahma SuSrUzave Bavet । brahmaloke nivAsaM yo DruvaM samaBikANkzati ॥40॥

text: bhavanto bahulāḥ santu vedo vistāryatāmayam । nāśiṣye sampradātavyo nāvrate nākṛtātmani ॥41॥
html:
bhavanto bahulāḥ santu vedo vistāryatāmayam ।
nāśiṣye sampradātavyo nāvrate nākṛtātmani ॥41॥
slp1: Bavanto bahulAH santu vedo vistAryatAmayam । nASizye sampradAtavyo nAvrate nAkftAtmani ॥41॥

text: ete śiṣyaguṇāḥ sarve vijñātavyā yathārthataḥ । nāparīkṣitacāritre vidyā deyā kathañcana ॥42॥
html:
ete śiṣyaguṇāḥ sarve vijñātavyā yathārthataḥ ।
nāparīkṣitacāritre vidyā deyā kathañcana ॥42॥
slp1: ete SizyaguRAH sarve vijYAtavyA yaTArTataH । nAparIkzitacAritre vidyA deyA kaTaYcana ॥42॥

text: yathā hi kanakaṃ śuddhaṃ tāpacchedanigharṣaṇaiḥ । parīkṣeta tathā śiṣyānīkṣetkulaguṇādibhiḥ ॥43॥
html:
yathā hi kanakaṃ śuddhaṃ tāpacchedanigharṣaṇaiḥ ।
parīkṣeta tathā śiṣyānīkṣetkulaguṇādibhiḥ ॥43॥
slp1: yaTA hi kanakaM SudDaM tApacCedaniGarzaREH । parIkzeta taTA SizyAnIkzetkulaguRAdiBiH ॥43॥

text: na niyojyāśca vaḥ śiṣyā aniyoge mahābhaye । yathāmati yathāpāṭhaṃ tathā vidyā phaliṣyati ॥44॥
html:
na niyojyāśca vaḥ śiṣyā aniyoge mahābhaye ।
yathāmati yathāpāṭhaṃ tathā vidyā phaliṣyati ॥44॥
slp1: na niyojyASca vaH SizyA aniyoge mahABaye । yaTAmati yaTApAWaM taTA vidyA Palizyati ॥44॥

text: sarvastaratu durgāṇi sarvo bhadrāṇi paśyatu । śrāvayeccaturo varṇānkṛtvā brāhmaṇamagrataḥ ॥45॥
html:
sarvastaratu durgāṇi sarvo bhadrāṇi paśyatu ।
śrāvayeccaturo varṇānkṛtvā brāhmaṇamagrataḥ ॥45॥
slp1: sarvastaratu durgARi sarvo BadrARi paSyatu । SrAvayeccaturo varRAnkftvA brAhmaRamagrataH ॥45॥

text: vedasyādhyayanaṃ hīdaṃ tacca kāryaṃ mahatsmṛtam । stutyarthamiha devānāṃ vedāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayambhuvā ॥46॥
html:
vedasyādhyayanaṃ hīdaṃ tacca kāryaṃ mahatsmṛtam ।
stutyarthamiha devānāṃ vedāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayambhuvā ॥46॥
slp1: vedasyADyayanaM hIdaM tacca kAryaM mahatsmftam । stutyarTamiha devAnAM vedAH sfzwAH svayamBuvA ॥46॥

text: yo nirvadeta sammohādbrāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam । so'padhyānādbrāhmaṇasya parābhūyādasaṃśayam ॥47॥
html:
yo nirvadeta sammohādbrāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam ।
so'padhyānādbrāhmaṇasya parābhūyādasaṃśayam ॥47॥
slp1: yo nirvadeta sammohAdbrAhmaRaM vedapAragam । so'paDyAnAdbrAhmaRasya parABUyAdasaMSayam ॥47॥

text: yaścādharmeṇa vibrūyādyaścādharmeṇa pṛcchati । tayoranyataraḥ praiti vidveṣaṃ vādhigacchati ॥48॥
html:
yaścādharmeṇa vibrūyādyaścādharmeṇa pṛcchati ।
tayoranyataraḥ praiti vidveṣaṃ vādhigacchati ॥48॥
slp1: yaScADarmeRa vibrUyAdyaScADarmeRa pfcCati । tayoranyataraH prEti vidvezaM vADigacCati ॥48॥

text: etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ svādhyāyasya vidhiṃ prati । upakuryācca śiṣyāṇāmetacca hṛdi vo bhavet] ॥49॥
html:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ svādhyāyasya vidhiṃ prati ।
upakuryācca śiṣyāṇāmetacca hṛdi vo bhavet] ॥49॥
slp1: etadvaH sarvamAKyAtaM svADyAyasya viDiM prati । upakuryAcca SizyARAmetacca hfdi vo Bavet] ॥49॥

text: etacchrutvā gurorvākyaṃ vyāsaśiṣyā mahaujasaḥ । anyonyaṃ hṛṣṭamanasaḥ pariṣasvajire tadā ॥1॥
html:
etacchrutvā gurorvākyaṃ vyāsaśiṣyā mahaujasaḥ ।
anyonyaṃ hṛṣṭamanasaḥ pariṣasvajire tadā ॥1॥
slp1: etacCrutvA gurorvAkyaM vyAsaSizyA mahOjasaH । anyonyaM hfzwamanasaH parizasvajire tadA ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: uktāḥ smo yadbhagavatā tadātvāyatisaṃhitam । tanno manasi saṃrūḍhaṃ kariṣyāmastathā ca tat ॥2॥
html:
uktāḥ smo yadbhagavatā tadātvāyatisaṃhitam ।
tanno manasi saṃrūḍhaṃ kariṣyāmastathā ca tat ॥2॥
slp1: uktAH smo yadBagavatA tadAtvAyatisaMhitam । tanno manasi saMrUQaM karizyAmastaTA ca tat ॥2॥

text: anyonyaṃ ca sabhājyaivaṃ suprītamanasaḥ punaḥ । vijñāpayanti sma guruṃ punarvākyaviśāradāḥ ॥3॥
html:
anyonyaṃ ca sabhājyaivaṃ suprītamanasaḥ punaḥ ।
vijñāpayanti sma guruṃ punarvākyaviśāradāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: anyonyaM ca saBAjyEvaM suprItamanasaH punaH । vijYApayanti sma guruM punarvAkyaviSAradAH ॥3॥

text: śailādasmānmahīṃ gantuṃ kāṅkṣitaṃ no mahāmune । vedānanekadhā kartuṃ yadi te rucitaṃ vibho ॥4॥
html:
śailādasmānmahīṃ gantuṃ kāṅkṣitaṃ no mahāmune ।
vedānanekadhā kartuṃ yadi te rucitaṃ vibho ॥4॥
slp1: SElAdasmAnmahIM gantuM kANkzitaM no mahAmune । vedAnanekaDA kartuM yadi te rucitaM viBo ॥4॥

text: śiṣyāṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā parāśarasutaḥ prabhuḥ । pratyuvāca tato vākyaṃ dharmārthasahitaṃ hitam ॥5॥
html:
śiṣyāṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā parāśarasutaḥ prabhuḥ ।
pratyuvāca tato vākyaṃ dharmārthasahitaṃ hitam ॥5॥
slp1: SizyARAM vacanaM SrutvA parASarasutaH praBuH । pratyuvAca tato vAkyaM DarmArTasahitaM hitam ॥5॥

text: kṣitiṃ vā devalokaṃ vā gamyatāṃ yadi rocate । apramādaśca vaḥ kāryo brahma hi pracuracchalam ॥6॥
html:
kṣitiṃ vā devalokaṃ vā gamyatāṃ yadi rocate ।
apramādaśca vaḥ kāryo brahma hi pracuracchalam ॥6॥
slp1: kzitiM vA devalokaM vA gamyatAM yadi rocate । apramAdaSca vaH kAryo brahma hi pracuracCalam ॥6॥

text: te'nujñātāstataḥ sarve guruṇā satyavādinā । jagmuḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā vyāsaṃ mūrdhnābhivādya ca ॥7॥
html:
te'nujñātāstataḥ sarve guruṇā satyavādinā ।
jagmuḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā vyāsaṃ mūrdhnābhivādya ca ॥7॥
slp1: te'nujYAtAstataH sarve guruRA satyavAdinA । jagmuH pradakziRaM kftvA vyAsaM mUrDnABivAdya ca ॥7॥

text: avatīrya mahīṃ te'tha cāturhotramakalpayan । saṃyājayanto viprāṃśca rājanyāṃśca viśastathā ॥8॥
html:
avatīrya mahīṃ te'tha cāturhotramakalpayan ।
saṃyājayanto viprāṃśca rājanyāṃśca viśastathā ॥8॥
slp1: avatIrya mahIM te'Ta cAturhotramakalpayan । saMyAjayanto viprAMSca rAjanyAMSca viSastaTA ॥8॥

text: pūjyamānā dvijairnityaṃ modamānā gṛhe ratāḥ । yājanādhyāpanaratāḥ śrīmanto lokaviśrutāḥ ॥9॥
html:
pūjyamānā dvijairnityaṃ modamānā gṛhe ratāḥ ।
yājanādhyāpanaratāḥ śrīmanto lokaviśrutāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: pUjyamAnA dvijErnityaM modamAnA gfhe ratAH । yAjanADyApanaratAH SrImanto lokaviSrutAH ॥9॥

text: avatīrṇeṣu śiṣyeṣu vyāsaḥ putrasahāyavān । tūṣṇīṃ dhyānaparo dhīmānekānte samupāviśat ॥10॥
html:
avatīrṇeṣu śiṣyeṣu vyāsaḥ putrasahāyavān ।
tūṣṇīṃ dhyānaparo dhīmānekānte samupāviśat ॥10॥
slp1: avatIrRezu Sizyezu vyAsaH putrasahAyavAn । tUzRIM DyAnaparo DImAnekAnte samupAviSat ॥10॥

text: taṃ dadarśāśramapade nāradaḥ sumahātapāḥ । athainamabravītkāle madhurākṣarayā girā ॥11॥
html:
taṃ dadarśāśramapade nāradaḥ sumahātapāḥ ।
athainamabravītkāle madhurākṣarayā girā ॥11॥
slp1: taM dadarSASramapade nAradaH sumahAtapAH । aTEnamabravItkAle maDurAkzarayA girA ॥11॥

text: bho bho maharṣe vāsiṣṭha brahmaghoṣo na vartate । eko dhyānaparastūṣṇīṃ kimāsse cintayanniva ॥12॥
html:
bho bho maharṣe vāsiṣṭha brahmaghoṣo na vartate ।
eko dhyānaparastūṣṇīṃ kimāsse cintayanniva ॥12॥
slp1: Bo Bo maharze vAsizWa brahmaGozo na vartate । eko DyAnaparastUzRIM kimAsse cintayanniva ॥12॥

text: brahmaghoṣairvirahitaḥ parvato'yaṃ na śobhate । rajasā tamasā caiva somaḥ sopaplavo yathā ॥13॥
html:
brahmaghoṣairvirahitaḥ parvato'yaṃ na śobhate ।
rajasā tamasā caiva somaḥ sopaplavo yathā ॥13॥
slp1: brahmaGozErvirahitaH parvato'yaM na SoBate । rajasA tamasA cEva somaH sopaplavo yaTA ॥13॥

text: na bhrājate yathāpūrvaṃ niṣādānāmivālayaḥ । devarṣigaṇajuṣṭo'pi vedadhvaninirākṛtaḥ ॥14॥
html:
na bhrājate yathāpūrvaṃ niṣādānāmivālayaḥ ।
devarṣigaṇajuṣṭo'pi vedadhvaninirākṛtaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: na BrAjate yaTApUrvaM nizAdAnAmivAlayaH । devarzigaRajuzwo'pi vedaDvaninirAkftaH ॥14॥

text: ṛṣayaśca hi devāśca gandharvāśca mahaujasaḥ । vimuktā brahmaghoṣeṇa na bhrājante yathā purā ॥15॥
html:
ṛṣayaśca hi devāśca gandharvāśca mahaujasaḥ ।
vimuktā brahmaghoṣeṇa na bhrājante yathā purā ॥15॥
slp1: fzayaSca hi devASca ganDarvASca mahOjasaH । vimuktA brahmaGozeRa na BrAjante yaTA purA ॥15॥

text: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā kṛṣṇadvaipāyano'bravīt । maharṣe yattvayā proktaṃ vedavādavicakṣaṇa ॥16॥
html:
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā kṛṣṇadvaipāyano'bravīt ।
maharṣe yattvayā proktaṃ vedavādavicakṣaṇa ॥16॥
slp1: nAradasya vacaH SrutvA kfzRadvEpAyano'bravIt । maharze yattvayA proktaM vedavAdavicakzaRa ॥16॥

text: etanmanonukūlaṃ me bhavānarhati bhāṣitum । sarvajñaḥ sarvadarśī ca sarvatra ca kutūhalī ॥17॥
html:
etanmanonukūlaṃ me bhavānarhati bhāṣitum ।
sarvajñaḥ sarvadarśī ca sarvatra ca kutūhalī ॥17॥
slp1: etanmanonukUlaM me BavAnarhati BAzitum । sarvajYaH sarvadarSI ca sarvatra ca kutUhalI ॥17॥

text: triṣu lokeṣu yadvṛttaṃ sarvaṃ tava mate sthitam । tadājñāpaya viprarṣe brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te ॥18॥
html:
triṣu lokeṣu yadvṛttaṃ sarvaṃ tava mate sthitam ।
tadājñāpaya viprarṣe brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te ॥18॥
slp1: trizu lokezu yadvfttaM sarvaM tava mate sTitam । tadAjYApaya viprarze brUhi kiM karavARi te ॥18॥

text: yanmayā samanuṣṭheyaṃ brahmarṣe tadudāhara । viyuktasyeha śiṣyairme nātihṛṣṭamidaṃ manaḥ ॥19॥
html:
yanmayā samanuṣṭheyaṃ brahmarṣe tadudāhara ।
viyuktasyeha śiṣyairme nātihṛṣṭamidaṃ manaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: yanmayA samanuzWeyaM brahmarze tadudAhara । viyuktasyeha SizyErme nAtihfzwamidaM manaH ॥19॥

text: anāmnāyamalā vedā brāhmaṇasyāvrataṃ malam । malaṃ pṛthivyā vāhīkāḥ strīṇāṃ kautūhalaṃ malam ॥20॥
html:
anāmnāyamalā vedā brāhmaṇasyāvrataṃ malam ।
malaṃ pṛthivyā vāhīkāḥ strīṇāṃ kautūhalaṃ malam ॥20॥
slp1: anAmnAyamalA vedA brAhmaRasyAvrataM malam । malaM pfTivyA vAhIkAH strIRAM kOtUhalaM malam ॥20॥
author: nārada uvāca ।

text: adhīyatāṃ bhavānvedānsārdhaṃ putreṇa dhīmatā । vidhunvanbrahmaghoṣeṇa rakṣobhayakṛtaṃ tamaḥ ॥21॥
html:
adhīyatāṃ bhavānvedānsārdhaṃ putreṇa dhīmatā ।
vidhunvanbrahmaghoṣeṇa rakṣobhayakṛtaṃ tamaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: aDIyatAM BavAnvedAnsArDaM putreRa DImatA । viDunvanbrahmaGozeRa rakzoBayakftaM tamaH ॥21॥

text: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā vyāsaḥ paramadharmavit । tathetyuvāca saṃhṛṣṭo vedābhyāse dṛḍhavrataḥ ॥22॥
html:
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā vyāsaḥ paramadharmavit ।
tathetyuvāca saṃhṛṣṭo vedābhyāse dṛḍhavrataḥ ॥22॥
slp1: nAradasya vacaH SrutvA vyAsaH paramaDarmavit । taTetyuvAca saMhfzwo vedAByAse dfQavrataH ॥22॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: śukena saha putreṇa vedābhyāsamathākarot । svareṇoccaiḥ sa śaikṣeṇa lokānāpūrayanniva ॥23॥
html:
śukena saha putreṇa vedābhyāsamathākarot ।
svareṇoccaiḥ sa śaikṣeṇa lokānāpūrayanniva ॥23॥
slp1: Sukena saha putreRa vedAByAsamaTAkarot । svareRoccEH sa SEkzeRa lokAnApUrayanniva ॥23॥

text: tayorabhyasatorevaṃ nānādharmapravādinoḥ । vāto'timātraṃ pravavau samudrānilavejitaḥ ॥24॥
html:
tayorabhyasatorevaṃ nānādharmapravādinoḥ ।
vāto'timātraṃ pravavau samudrānilavejitaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: tayoraByasatorevaM nAnADarmapravAdinoH । vAto'timAtraM pravavO samudrAnilavejitaH ॥24॥

text: tato'nadhyāya iti taṃ vyāsaḥ putramavārayat । śuko vāritamātrastu kautūhalasamanvitaḥ ॥25॥
html:
tato'nadhyāya iti taṃ vyāsaḥ putramavārayat ।
śuko vāritamātrastu kautūhalasamanvitaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: tato'naDyAya iti taM vyAsaH putramavArayat । Suko vAritamAtrastu kOtUhalasamanvitaH ॥25॥

text: apṛcchatpitaraṃ brahmankuto vāyurabhūdayam । ākhyātumarhati bhavānvāyoḥ sarvaṃ viceṣṭitam ॥26॥
html:
apṛcchatpitaraṃ brahmankuto vāyurabhūdayam ।
ākhyātumarhati bhavānvāyoḥ sarvaṃ viceṣṭitam ॥26॥
slp1: apfcCatpitaraM brahmankuto vAyuraBUdayam । AKyAtumarhati BavAnvAyoH sarvaM vicezwitam ॥26॥

text: śukasyaitadvacaḥ śrutvā vyāsaḥ paramavismitaḥ । anadhyāyanimitte'sminnidaṃ vacanamabravīt ॥27॥
html:
śukasyaitadvacaḥ śrutvā vyāsaḥ paramavismitaḥ ।
anadhyāyanimitte'sminnidaṃ vacanamabravīt ॥27॥
slp1: SukasyEtadvacaH SrutvA vyAsaH paramavismitaH । anaDyAyanimitte'sminnidaM vacanamabravIt ॥27॥

text: divyaṃ te cakṣurutpannaṃ svasthaṃ te nirmalaṃ manaḥ । tamasā rajasā cāpi tyaktaḥ sattve vyavasthitaḥ ॥28॥
html:
divyaṃ te cakṣurutpannaṃ svasthaṃ te nirmalaṃ manaḥ ।
tamasā rajasā cāpi tyaktaḥ sattve vyavasthitaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: divyaM te cakzurutpannaM svasTaM te nirmalaM manaH । tamasA rajasA cApi tyaktaH sattve vyavasTitaH ॥28॥

text: ādarśe svāmiva chāyāṃ paśyasyātmānamātmanā । nyasyātmani svayaṃ vedānbuddhyā samanucintaya ॥29॥
html:
ādarśe svāmiva chāyāṃ paśyasyātmānamātmanā ।
nyasyātmani svayaṃ vedānbuddhyā samanucintaya ॥29॥
slp1: AdarSe svAmiva CAyAM paSyasyAtmAnamAtmanA । nyasyAtmani svayaM vedAnbudDyA samanucintaya ॥29॥

text: devayānacaro viṣṇoḥ pitṛyānaśca tāmasaḥ । dvāvetau pretya panthānau divaṃ cādhaśca gacchataḥ ॥30॥
html:
devayānacaro viṣṇoḥ pitṛyānaśca tāmasaḥ ।
dvāvetau pretya panthānau divaṃ cādhaśca gacchataḥ ॥30॥
slp1: devayAnacaro vizRoH pitfyAnaSca tAmasaH । dvAvetO pretya panTAnO divaM cADaSca gacCataH ॥30॥

text: pṛthivyāmantarikṣe ca yatra saṃvānti vāyavaḥ । saptaite vāyumārgā vai tānnibodhānupūrvaśaḥ ॥31॥
html:
pṛthivyāmantarikṣe ca yatra saṃvānti vāyavaḥ ।
saptaite vāyumārgā vai tānnibodhānupūrvaśaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: pfTivyAmantarikze ca yatra saMvAnti vAyavaH । saptEte vAyumArgA vE tAnniboDAnupUrvaSaH ॥31॥

text: tatra devagaṇāḥ sādhyāḥ samabhūvanmahābalāḥ । teṣāmapyabhavatputraḥ samāno nāma durjayaḥ ॥32॥
html:
tatra devagaṇāḥ sādhyāḥ samabhūvanmahābalāḥ ।
teṣāmapyabhavatputraḥ samāno nāma durjayaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: tatra devagaRAH sADyAH samaBUvanmahAbalAH । tezAmapyaBavatputraH samAno nAma durjayaH ॥32॥

text: udānastasya putro'bhūdvyānastasyābhavatsutaḥ । apānaśca tato jñeyaḥ prāṇaścāpi tataḥ param ॥33॥
html:
udānastasya putro'bhūdvyānastasyābhavatsutaḥ ।
apānaśca tato jñeyaḥ prāṇaścāpi tataḥ param ॥33॥
slp1: udAnastasya putro'BUdvyAnastasyABavatsutaH । apAnaSca tato jYeyaH prARaScApi tataH param ॥33॥

text: anapatyo'bhavatprāṇo durdharṣaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ । pṛthakkarmāṇi teṣāṃ tu pravakṣyāmi yathātatham ॥34॥
html:
anapatyo'bhavatprāṇo durdharṣaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ ।
pṛthakkarmāṇi teṣāṃ tu pravakṣyāmi yathātatham ॥34॥
slp1: anapatyo'BavatprARo durDarzaH SatrutApanaH । pfTakkarmARi tezAM tu pravakzyAmi yaTAtaTam ॥34॥

text: prāṇināṃ sarvato vāyuśceṣṭā vartayate pṛthak । prāṇanāccaiva bhūtānāṃ prāṇa ityabhidhīyate ॥35॥
html:
prāṇināṃ sarvato vāyuśceṣṭā vartayate pṛthak ।
prāṇanāccaiva bhūtānāṃ prāṇa ityabhidhīyate ॥35॥
slp1: prARinAM sarvato vAyuScezwA vartayate pfTak । prARanAccEva BUtAnAM prARa ityaBiDIyate ॥35॥

text: prerayatyabhrasaṅghātāndhūmajāṃścoṣmajāṃśca yaḥ । prathamaḥ prathame mārge pravaho nāma so'nilaḥ ॥36॥
html:
prerayatyabhrasaṅghātāndhūmajāṃścoṣmajāṃśca yaḥ ।
prathamaḥ prathame mārge pravaho nāma so'nilaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: prerayatyaBrasaNGAtAnDUmajAMScozmajAMSca yaH । praTamaH praTame mArge pravaho nAma so'nilaH ॥36॥

text: ambare snehamabhrebhyastaḍidbhyaścottamadyutiḥ । āvaho nāma saṃvāti dvitīyaḥ śvasano nadan ॥37॥
html:
ambare snehamabhrebhyastaḍidbhyaścottamadyutiḥ ।
āvaho nāma saṃvāti dvitīyaḥ śvasano nadan ॥37॥
slp1: ambare snehamaBreByastaqidByaScottamadyutiH । Avaho nAma saMvAti dvitIyaH Svasano nadan ॥37॥

text: udayaṃ jyotiṣāṃ śaśvatsomādīnāṃ karoti yaḥ । antardeheṣu codānaṃ yaṃ vadanti maharṣayaḥ ॥38॥
html:
udayaṃ jyotiṣāṃ śaśvatsomādīnāṃ karoti yaḥ ।
antardeheṣu codānaṃ yaṃ vadanti maharṣayaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: udayaM jyotizAM SaSvatsomAdInAM karoti yaH । antardehezu codAnaM yaM vadanti maharzayaH ॥38॥

text: yaścaturbhyaḥ samudrebhyo vāyurdhārayate jalam । uddhṛtyādadate cāpo jīmūtebhyo'mbare'nilaḥ ॥39॥
html:
yaścaturbhyaḥ samudrebhyo vāyurdhārayate jalam ।
uddhṛtyādadate cāpo jīmūtebhyo'mbare'nilaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: yaScaturByaH samudreByo vAyurDArayate jalam । udDftyAdadate cApo jImUteByo'mbare'nilaH ॥39॥

text: yo'dbhiḥ saṃyojya jīmūtānparjanyāya prayacchati । udvaho nāma varṣiṣṭhastritīyaḥ sa sadāgatiḥ ॥40॥
html:
yo'dbhiḥ saṃyojya jīmūtānparjanyāya prayacchati ।
udvaho nāma varṣiṣṭhastritīyaḥ sa sadāgatiḥ ॥40॥
slp1: yo'dBiH saMyojya jImUtAnparjanyAya prayacCati । udvaho nAma varzizWastritIyaH sa sadAgatiH ॥40॥

text: samuhyamānā bahudhā yena nīlāḥ pṛthagghanāḥ । varṣamokṣakṛtārambhāste bhavanti ghanāghanāḥ ॥41॥
html:
samuhyamānā bahudhā yena nīlāḥ pṛthagghanāḥ ।
varṣamokṣakṛtārambhāste bhavanti ghanāghanāḥ ॥41॥
slp1: samuhyamAnA bahuDA yena nIlAH pfTagGanAH । varzamokzakftAramBAste Bavanti GanAGanAH ॥41॥

text: saṃhatā yena cāviddhā bhavanti nadatāṃ nadāḥ । rakṣaṇārthāya sambhūtā meghatvamupayānti ca ॥42॥
html:
saṃhatā yena cāviddhā bhavanti nadatāṃ nadāḥ ।
rakṣaṇārthāya sambhūtā meghatvamupayānti ca ॥42॥
slp1: saMhatA yena cAvidDA Bavanti nadatAM nadAH । rakzaRArTAya samBUtA meGatvamupayAnti ca ॥42॥

text: yo'sau vahati devānāṃ vimānāni vihāyasā । caturthaḥ saṃvaho nāma vāyuḥ sa girimardanaḥ ॥43॥
html:
yo'sau vahati devānāṃ vimānāni vihāyasā ।
caturthaḥ saṃvaho nāma vāyuḥ sa girimardanaḥ ॥43॥
slp1: yo'sO vahati devAnAM vimAnAni vihAyasA । caturTaH saMvaho nAma vAyuH sa girimardanaH ॥43॥

text: yena vegavatā rugṇā rūkṣeṇārujatā rasān । vāyunā vihatā meghā na bhavanti balāhakāḥ ॥44॥
html:
yena vegavatā rugṇā rūkṣeṇārujatā rasān ।
vāyunā vihatā meghā na bhavanti balāhakāḥ ॥44॥
slp1: yena vegavatA rugRA rUkzeRArujatA rasAn । vAyunA vihatA meGA na Bavanti balAhakAH ॥44॥

text: dāruṇotpātasañcāro nabhasaḥ stanayitnumān । pañcamaḥ sa mahāvego vivaho nāma mārutaḥ ॥45॥
html:
dāruṇotpātasañcāro nabhasaḥ stanayitnumān ।
pañcamaḥ sa mahāvego vivaho nāma mārutaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: dAruRotpAtasaYcAro naBasaH stanayitnumAn । paYcamaH sa mahAvego vivaho nAma mArutaH ॥45॥

text: yasminpāriplave divyā vahantyāpo vihāyasā । puṇyaṃ cākāśagaṅgāyāstoyaṃ viṣṭabhya tiṣṭhati ॥46॥
html:
yasminpāriplave divyā vahantyāpo vihāyasā ।
puṇyaṃ cākāśagaṅgāyāstoyaṃ viṣṭabhya tiṣṭhati ॥46॥
slp1: yasminpAriplave divyA vahantyApo vihAyasA । puRyaM cAkASagaNgAyAstoyaM vizwaBya tizWati ॥46॥

text: dūrātpratihato yasminnekaraśmirdivākaraḥ । yoniraṃśusahasrasya yena bhāti vasundharā ॥47॥
html:
dūrātpratihato yasminnekaraśmirdivākaraḥ ।
yoniraṃśusahasrasya yena bhāti vasundharā ॥47॥
slp1: dUrAtpratihato yasminnekaraSmirdivAkaraH । yoniraMSusahasrasya yena BAti vasunDarA ॥47॥

text: yasmādāpyāyate somo nidhirdivyo'mṛtasya ca । ṣaṣṭhaḥ parivaho nāma sa vāyurjavatāṃ varaḥ ॥48॥
html:
yasmādāpyāyate somo nidhirdivyo'mṛtasya ca ।
ṣaṣṭhaḥ parivaho nāma sa vāyurjavatāṃ varaḥ ॥48॥
slp1: yasmAdApyAyate somo niDirdivyo'mftasya ca । zazWaH parivaho nAma sa vAyurjavatAM varaH ॥48॥

text: sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ prāṇānyo'ntakāle nirasyati । yasya vartmānuvartete mṛtyuvaivasvatāvubhau ॥49॥
html:
sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ prāṇānyo'ntakāle nirasyati ।
yasya vartmānuvartete mṛtyuvaivasvatāvubhau ॥49॥
slp1: sarvaprARaBftAM prARAnyo'ntakAle nirasyati । yasya vartmAnuvartete mftyuvEvasvatAvuBO ॥49॥

text: samyaganvīkṣatāṃ buddhyā śāntayādhyātmanityayā । dhyānābhyāsābhirāmāṇāṃ yo'mṛtatvāya kalpate ॥50॥
html:
samyaganvīkṣatāṃ buddhyā śāntayādhyātmanityayā ।
dhyānābhyāsābhirāmāṇāṃ yo'mṛtatvāya kalpate ॥50॥
slp1: samyaganvIkzatAM budDyA SAntayADyAtmanityayA । DyAnAByAsABirAmARAM yo'mftatvAya kalpate ॥50॥

text: yaṃ samāsādya vegena diśāmantaṃ prapedire । dakṣasya daśa putrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi prajāpateḥ ॥51॥
html:
yaṃ samāsādya vegena diśāmantaṃ prapedire ।
dakṣasya daśa putrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi prajāpateḥ ॥51॥
slp1: yaM samAsAdya vegena diSAmantaM prapedire । dakzasya daSa putrARAM sahasrARi prajApateH ॥51॥

text: yena sṛṣṭaḥ parābhūto yātyeva na nivartate । parāvaho nāma paro vāyuḥ sa duratikramaḥ ॥52॥
html:
yena sṛṣṭaḥ parābhūto yātyeva na nivartate ।
parāvaho nāma paro vāyuḥ sa duratikramaḥ ॥52॥
slp1: yena sfzwaH parABUto yAtyeva na nivartate । parAvaho nAma paro vAyuH sa duratikramaH ॥52॥

text: evamete'diteḥ putrā mārutāḥ paramādbhutāḥ । anāramantaḥ saṃvānti sarvagāḥ sarvadhāriṇaḥ ॥53॥
html:
evamete'diteḥ putrā mārutāḥ paramādbhutāḥ ।
anāramantaḥ saṃvānti sarvagāḥ sarvadhāriṇaḥ ॥53॥
slp1: evamete'diteH putrA mArutAH paramAdButAH । anAramantaH saMvAnti sarvagAH sarvaDAriRaH ॥53॥

text: etattu mahadāścaryaṃ yadayaṃ parvatottamaḥ । kampitaḥ sahasā tena vāyunābhipravāyatā ॥54॥
html:
etattu mahadāścaryaṃ yadayaṃ parvatottamaḥ ।
kampitaḥ sahasā tena vāyunābhipravāyatā ॥54॥
slp1: etattu mahadAScaryaM yadayaM parvatottamaH । kampitaH sahasA tena vAyunABipravAyatA ॥54॥

text: viṣṇorniḥśvāsavāto'yaṃ yadā vegasamīritaḥ । sahasodīryate tāta jagatpravyathate tadā ॥55॥
html:
viṣṇorniḥśvāsavāto'yaṃ yadā vegasamīritaḥ ।
sahasodīryate tāta jagatpravyathate tadā ॥55॥
slp1: vizRorniHSvAsavAto'yaM yadA vegasamIritaH । sahasodIryate tAta jagatpravyaTate tadA ॥55॥

text: tasmādbrahmavido brahma nādhīyante'tivāyati । vāyorvāyubhayaṃ hyuktaṃ brahma tatpīḍitaṃ bhavet ॥56॥
html:
tasmādbrahmavido brahma nādhīyante'tivāyati ।
vāyorvāyubhayaṃ hyuktaṃ brahma tatpīḍitaṃ bhavet ॥56॥
slp1: tasmAdbrahmavido brahma nADIyante'tivAyati । vAyorvAyuBayaM hyuktaM brahma tatpIqitaM Bavet ॥56॥

text: etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ parāśarasutaḥ prabhuḥ । uktvā putramadhīṣveti vyomagaṅgāmayāttadā] ॥57॥
html:
etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ parāśarasutaḥ prabhuḥ ।
uktvā putramadhīṣveti vyomagaṅgāmayāttadā] ॥57॥
slp1: etAvaduktvA vacanaM parASarasutaH praBuH । uktvA putramaDIzveti vyomagaNgAmayAttadA] ॥57॥

text: etasminnantare śūnye nāradaḥ samupāgamat । śukaṃ svādhyāyanirataṃ vedārthānvaktumīpsitān ॥1॥
html:
etasminnantare śūnye nāradaḥ samupāgamat ।
śukaṃ svādhyāyanirataṃ vedārthānvaktumīpsitān ॥1॥
slp1: etasminnantare SUnye nAradaH samupAgamat । SukaM svADyAyanirataM vedArTAnvaktumIpsitAn ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: devarṣiṃ tu śuko dṛṣṭvā nāradaṃ samupasthitam । arghyapūrveṇa vidhinā vedoktenābhyapūjayat ॥2॥
html:
devarṣiṃ tu śuko dṛṣṭvā nāradaṃ samupasthitam ।
arghyapūrveṇa vidhinā vedoktenābhyapūjayat ॥2॥
slp1: devarziM tu Suko dfzwvA nAradaM samupasTitam । arGyapUrveRa viDinA vedoktenAByapUjayat ॥2॥

text: nārado'thābravītprīto brūhi brahmavidāṃ vara । kena tvāṃ śreyasā tāta yojayāmīti hṛṣṭavat ॥3॥
html:
nārado'thābravītprīto brūhi brahmavidāṃ vara ।
kena tvāṃ śreyasā tāta yojayāmīti hṛṣṭavat ॥3॥
slp1: nArado'TAbravItprIto brUhi brahmavidAM vara । kena tvAM SreyasA tAta yojayAmIti hfzwavat ॥3॥

text: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā śukaḥ provāca bhārata । asmiṁlloke hitaṃ yatsyāttena māṃ yoktumarhasi ॥4॥
html:
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā śukaḥ provāca bhārata ।
asmiṁlloke hitaṃ yatsyāttena māṃ yoktumarhasi ॥4॥
slp1: nAradasya vacaH SrutvA SukaH provAca BArata । asmiṁlloke hitaM yatsyAttena mAM yoktumarhasi ॥4॥

text: tattvaṃ jijñāsatāṃ pūrvamṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām । sanatkumāro bhagavānidaṃ vacanamabravīt ॥5॥
html:
tattvaṃ jijñāsatāṃ pūrvamṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām ।
sanatkumāro bhagavānidaṃ vacanamabravīt ॥5॥
slp1: tattvaM jijYAsatAM pUrvamfzIRAM BAvitAtmanAm । sanatkumAro BagavAnidaM vacanamabravIt ॥5॥
author: nārada uvāca ।

text: nāsti vidyāsamaṃ cakṣurnāsti vidyāsamaṃ tapaḥ । nāsti rāgasamaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāsti tyāgasamaṃ sukham ॥6॥
html:
nāsti vidyāsamaṃ cakṣurnāsti vidyāsamaṃ tapaḥ ।
nāsti rāgasamaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāsti tyāgasamaṃ sukham ॥6॥
slp1: nAsti vidyAsamaM cakzurnAsti vidyAsamaM tapaH । nAsti rAgasamaM duHKaM nAsti tyAgasamaM suKam ॥6॥

text: nivṛttiḥ karmaṇaḥ pāpātsatataṃ puṇyaśīlatā । sadvṛttiḥ samudācāraḥ śreya etadanuttamam ॥7॥
html:
nivṛttiḥ karmaṇaḥ pāpātsatataṃ puṇyaśīlatā ।
sadvṛttiḥ samudācāraḥ śreya etadanuttamam ॥7॥
slp1: nivfttiH karmaRaH pApAtsatataM puRyaSIlatA । sadvfttiH samudAcAraH Sreya etadanuttamam ॥7॥

text: mānuṣyamasukhaṃ prāpya yaḥ sajjati sa muhyati । nālaṃ sa duḥkhamokṣāya saṅgo vai duḥkhalakṣaṇam ॥8॥
html:
mānuṣyamasukhaṃ prāpya yaḥ sajjati sa muhyati ।
nālaṃ sa duḥkhamokṣāya saṅgo vai duḥkhalakṣaṇam ॥8॥
slp1: mAnuzyamasuKaM prApya yaH sajjati sa muhyati । nAlaM sa duHKamokzAya saNgo vE duHKalakzaRam ॥8॥

text: saktasya buddhiścalati mohajālavivardhinī । mohajālāvṛto duḥkhamiha cāmutra cāśnute ॥9॥
html:
saktasya buddhiścalati mohajālavivardhinī ।
mohajālāvṛto duḥkhamiha cāmutra cāśnute ॥9॥
slp1: saktasya budDiScalati mohajAlavivarDinI । mohajAlAvfto duHKamiha cAmutra cASnute ॥9॥

text: sarvopāyena kāmasya krodhasya ca vinigrahaḥ । kāryaḥ śreyorthinā tau hi śreyoghātārthamudyatau ॥10॥
html:
sarvopāyena kāmasya krodhasya ca vinigrahaḥ ।
kāryaḥ śreyorthinā tau hi śreyoghātārthamudyatau ॥10॥
slp1: sarvopAyena kAmasya kroDasya ca vinigrahaH । kAryaH SreyorTinA tO hi SreyoGAtArTamudyatO ॥10॥

text: nityaṃ krodhāttapo rakṣecchriyaṃ rakṣeta matsarāt । vidyāṃ mānāvamānābhyāmātmānaṃ tu pramādataḥ ॥11॥
html:
nityaṃ krodhāttapo rakṣecchriyaṃ rakṣeta matsarāt ।
vidyāṃ mānāvamānābhyāmātmānaṃ tu pramādataḥ ॥11॥
slp1: nityaM kroDAttapo rakzecCriyaM rakzeta matsarAt । vidyAM mAnAvamAnAByAmAtmAnaM tu pramAdataH ॥11॥

text: ānṛśaṃsyaṃ paro dharmaḥ kṣamā ca paramaṃ balam । ātmajñānaṃ paraṃ jñānaṃ na satyādvidyate param ॥12॥
html:
ānṛśaṃsyaṃ paro dharmaḥ kṣamā ca paramaṃ balam ।
ātmajñānaṃ paraṃ jñānaṃ na satyādvidyate param ॥12॥
slp1: AnfSaMsyaM paro DarmaH kzamA ca paramaM balam । AtmajYAnaM paraM jYAnaM na satyAdvidyate param ॥12॥

text: satyasya vacanaṃ śreyaḥ satyādapi hitaṃ bhavet । yadbhūtahitamatyantametatsatyaṃ mataṃ mama ॥13॥
html:
satyasya vacanaṃ śreyaḥ satyādapi hitaṃ bhavet ।
yadbhūtahitamatyantametatsatyaṃ mataṃ mama ॥13॥
slp1: satyasya vacanaM SreyaH satyAdapi hitaM Bavet । yadBUtahitamatyantametatsatyaM mataM mama ॥13॥

text: sarvārambhaphalatyāgī nirāśīrniṣparigrahaḥ । yena sarvaṃ parityaktaṃ sa vidvānsa ca paṇḍitaḥ ॥14॥
html:
sarvārambhaphalatyāgī nirāśīrniṣparigrahaḥ ।
yena sarvaṃ parityaktaṃ sa vidvānsa ca paṇḍitaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: sarvAramBaPalatyAgI nirASIrnizparigrahaH । yena sarvaM parityaktaM sa vidvAnsa ca paRqitaH ॥14॥

text: indriyairindriyārthebhyaścaratyātmavaśairiha । asajjamānaḥ śāntātmā nirvikāraḥ samāhitaḥ ॥15॥
html:
indriyairindriyārthebhyaścaratyātmavaśairiha ।
asajjamānaḥ śāntātmā nirvikāraḥ samāhitaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: indriyErindriyArTeByaScaratyAtmavaSEriha । asajjamAnaH SAntAtmA nirvikAraH samAhitaH ॥15॥

text: ātmabhūtairatadbhūtaḥ saha caiva vinaiva ca । sa vimuktaḥ paraṃ śreyo nacireṇādhigacchati ॥16॥
html:
ātmabhūtairatadbhūtaḥ saha caiva vinaiva ca ।
sa vimuktaḥ paraṃ śreyo nacireṇādhigacchati ॥16॥
slp1: AtmaBUtEratadBUtaH saha cEva vinEva ca । sa vimuktaH paraM Sreyo nacireRADigacCati ॥16॥

text: adarśanamasaṃsparśastathāsambhāṣaṇaṃ sadā । yasya bhūtaiḥ saha mune sa śreyo vindate param ॥17॥
html:
adarśanamasaṃsparśastathāsambhāṣaṇaṃ sadā ।
yasya bhūtaiḥ saha mune sa śreyo vindate param ॥17॥
slp1: adarSanamasaMsparSastaTAsamBAzaRaM sadA । yasya BUtEH saha mune sa Sreyo vindate param ॥17॥

text: na hiṃsyātsarvabhūtāni maitrāyaṇagataścaret । nedaṃ janma samāsādya vairaṃ kurvīta kenacit ॥18॥
html:
na hiṃsyātsarvabhūtāni maitrāyaṇagataścaret ।
nedaṃ janma samāsādya vairaṃ kurvīta kenacit ॥18॥
slp1: na hiMsyAtsarvaBUtAni mEtrAyaRagataScaret । nedaM janma samAsAdya vEraM kurvIta kenacit ॥18॥

text: ākiñcanyaṃ susantoṣo nirāśīṣṭvamacāpalam । etadāhuḥ paraṃ śreya ātmajñasya jitātmanaḥ ॥19॥
html:
ākiñcanyaṃ susantoṣo nirāśīṣṭvamacāpalam ।
etadāhuḥ paraṃ śreya ātmajñasya jitātmanaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: AkiYcanyaM susantozo nirASIzwvamacApalam । etadAhuH paraM Sreya AtmajYasya jitAtmanaH ॥19॥

text: parigrahaṃ parityajya bhava tāta jitendriyaḥ । aśokaṃ sthānamātiṣṭha iha cāmutra cābhayam ॥20॥
html:
parigrahaṃ parityajya bhava tāta jitendriyaḥ ।
aśokaṃ sthānamātiṣṭha iha cāmutra cābhayam ॥20॥
slp1: parigrahaM parityajya Bava tAta jitendriyaH । aSokaM sTAnamAtizWa iha cAmutra cABayam ॥20॥

text: nirāmiṣā na śocanti tyajehāmiṣamātmanaḥ । parityajyāmiṣaṃ saumya duḥkhatāpādvimokṣyase ॥21॥
html:
nirāmiṣā na śocanti tyajehāmiṣamātmanaḥ ।
parityajyāmiṣaṃ saumya duḥkhatāpādvimokṣyase ॥21॥
slp1: nirAmizA na Socanti tyajehAmizamAtmanaH । parityajyAmizaM sOmya duHKatApAdvimokzyase ॥21॥

text: taponityena dāntena muninā saṃyatātmanā । ajitaṃ jetukāmena bhāvyaṃ saṅgeṣvasaṅginā ॥22॥
html:
taponityena dāntena muninā saṃyatātmanā ।
ajitaṃ jetukāmena bhāvyaṃ saṅgeṣvasaṅginā ॥22॥
slp1: taponityena dAntena muninA saMyatAtmanA । ajitaM jetukAmena BAvyaM saNgezvasaNginA ॥22॥

text: guṇasaṅgeṣvanāsakta ekacaryārataḥ sadā । brāhmaṇe nacirādeva sukhamāyātyanuttamam ॥23॥
html:
guṇasaṅgeṣvanāsakta ekacaryārataḥ sadā ।
brāhmaṇe nacirādeva sukhamāyātyanuttamam ॥23॥
slp1: guRasaNgezvanAsakta ekacaryArataH sadA । brAhmaRe nacirAdeva suKamAyAtyanuttamam ॥23॥

text: dvandvārāmeṣu bhūteṣu ya eko ramate muniḥ । viddhi prajñānatṛptaṃ taṃ jñānatṛpto na śocati ॥24॥
html:
dvandvārāmeṣu bhūteṣu ya eko ramate muniḥ ।
viddhi prajñānatṛptaṃ taṃ jñānatṛpto na śocati ॥24॥
slp1: dvandvArAmezu BUtezu ya eko ramate muniH । vidDi prajYAnatfptaM taM jYAnatfpto na Socati ॥24॥

text: śubhairlabhati devatvaṃ vyāmiśrairjanma mānuṣam । aśubhaiścāpyadhojanma karmabhirlabhate'vaśaḥ ॥25॥
html:
śubhairlabhati devatvaṃ vyāmiśrairjanma mānuṣam ।
aśubhaiścāpyadhojanma karmabhirlabhate'vaśaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: SuBErlaBati devatvaM vyAmiSrErjanma mAnuzam । aSuBEScApyaDojanma karmaBirlaBate'vaSaH ॥25॥

text: tatra mṛtyujarāduḥkhaiḥ satataṃ samabhidrutaḥ । saṃsāre pacyate jantustatkathaṃ nāvabudhyase ॥26॥
html:
tatra mṛtyujarāduḥkhaiḥ satataṃ samabhidrutaḥ ।
saṃsāre pacyate jantustatkathaṃ nāvabudhyase ॥26॥
slp1: tatra mftyujarAduHKEH satataM samaBidrutaH । saMsAre pacyate jantustatkaTaM nAvabuDyase ॥26॥

text: ahite hitasañjñastvamadhruve dhruvasañjñakaḥ । anarthe cārthasañjñastvaṃ kimarthaṃ nāvabudhyase ॥27॥
html:
ahite hitasañjñastvamadhruve dhruvasañjñakaḥ ।
anarthe cārthasañjñastvaṃ kimarthaṃ nāvabudhyase ॥27॥
slp1: ahite hitasaYjYastvamaDruve DruvasaYjYakaH । anarTe cArTasaYjYastvaM kimarTaM nAvabuDyase ॥27॥

text: saṃveṣṭyamānaṃ bahubhirmohatantubhirātmajaiḥ । kośakāravadātmānaṃ veṣṭayannāvabudhyase ॥28॥
html:
saṃveṣṭyamānaṃ bahubhirmohatantubhirātmajaiḥ ।
kośakāravadātmānaṃ veṣṭayannāvabudhyase ॥28॥
slp1: saMvezwyamAnaM bahuBirmohatantuBirAtmajEH । koSakAravadAtmAnaM vezwayannAvabuDyase ॥28॥

text: alaṃ parigraheṇeha doṣavānhi parigrahaḥ । kṛmirhi kośakārastu badhyate svaparigrahāt ॥29॥
html:
alaṃ parigraheṇeha doṣavānhi parigrahaḥ ।
kṛmirhi kośakārastu badhyate svaparigrahāt ॥29॥
slp1: alaM parigraheReha dozavAnhi parigrahaH । kfmirhi koSakArastu baDyate svaparigrahAt ॥29॥

text: putradārakuṭumbeṣu saktāḥ sīdanti jantavaḥ । saraḥpaṅkārṇave magnā jīrṇā vanagajā iva ॥30॥
html:
putradārakuṭumbeṣu saktāḥ sīdanti jantavaḥ ।
saraḥpaṅkārṇave magnā jīrṇā vanagajā iva ॥30॥
slp1: putradArakuwumbezu saktAH sIdanti jantavaH । saraHpaNkArRave magnA jIrRA vanagajA iva ॥30॥

text: mahājālasamākṛṣṭānsthale matsyānivoddhṛtān । snehajālasamākṛṣṭānpaśya jantūnsuduḥkhitān ॥31॥
html:
mahājālasamākṛṣṭānsthale matsyānivoddhṛtān ।
snehajālasamākṛṣṭānpaśya jantūnsuduḥkhitān ॥31॥
slp1: mahAjAlasamAkfzwAnsTale matsyAnivodDftAn । snehajAlasamAkfzwAnpaSya jantUnsuduHKitAn ॥31॥

text: kuṭumbaṃ putradāraṃ ca śarīraṃ dravyasañcayāḥ । pārakyamadhruvaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ svaṃ sukṛtaduṣkṛtam ॥32॥
html:
kuṭumbaṃ putradāraṃ ca śarīraṃ dravyasañcayāḥ ।
pārakyamadhruvaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ svaṃ sukṛtaduṣkṛtam ॥32॥
slp1: kuwumbaM putradAraM ca SarIraM dravyasaYcayAH । pArakyamaDruvaM sarvaM kiM svaM sukftaduzkftam ॥32॥

text: yadā sarvaṃ parityajya gantavyamavaśena te । anarthe kiṃ prasaktastvaṃ svamarthaṃ nānutiṣṭhasi ॥33॥
html:
yadā sarvaṃ parityajya gantavyamavaśena te ।
anarthe kiṃ prasaktastvaṃ svamarthaṃ nānutiṣṭhasi ॥33॥
slp1: yadA sarvaM parityajya gantavyamavaSena te । anarTe kiM prasaktastvaM svamarTaM nAnutizWasi ॥33॥

text: aviśrāntamanālambamapātheyamadaiśikam । tamaḥkāntāramadhvānaṃ kathameko gamiṣyasi ॥34॥
html:
aviśrāntamanālambamapātheyamadaiśikam ।
tamaḥkāntāramadhvānaṃ kathameko gamiṣyasi ॥34॥
slp1: aviSrAntamanAlambamapATeyamadESikam । tamaHkAntAramaDvAnaM kaTameko gamizyasi ॥34॥

text: na hi tvā prasthitaṃ kaścitpṛṣṭhato'nugamiṣyati । sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ ca tvā yāsyantamanuyāsyati ॥35॥
html:
na hi tvā prasthitaṃ kaścitpṛṣṭhato'nugamiṣyati ।
sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ ca tvā yāsyantamanuyāsyati ॥35॥
slp1: na hi tvA prasTitaM kaScitpfzWato'nugamizyati । sukftaM duzkftaM ca tvA yAsyantamanuyAsyati ॥35॥

text: vidyā karma ca śauryaṃ ca jñānaṃ ca bahuvistaram । arthārthamanusāryante siddhārthastu vimucyate ॥36॥
html:
vidyā karma ca śauryaṃ ca jñānaṃ ca bahuvistaram ।
arthārthamanusāryante siddhārthastu vimucyate ॥36॥
slp1: vidyA karma ca SOryaM ca jYAnaM ca bahuvistaram । arTArTamanusAryante sidDArTastu vimucyate ॥36॥

text: nibandhanī rajjureṣā yā grāme vasato ratiḥ । chittvaināṃ sukṛto yānti naināṃ chindanti duṣkṛtaḥ ॥37॥
html:
nibandhanī rajjureṣā yā grāme vasato ratiḥ ।
chittvaināṃ sukṛto yānti naināṃ chindanti duṣkṛtaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: nibanDanI rajjurezA yA grAme vasato ratiH । CittvEnAM sukfto yAnti nEnAM Cindanti duzkftaH ॥37॥

text: rūpakūlāṃ manaḥsrotāṃ sparśadvīpāṃ rasāvahām । gandhapaṅkāṃ śabdajalāṃ svargamārgadurāvahām ॥38॥
html:
rūpakūlāṃ manaḥsrotāṃ sparśadvīpāṃ rasāvahām ।
gandhapaṅkāṃ śabdajalāṃ svargamārgadurāvahām ॥38॥
slp1: rUpakUlAM manaHsrotAM sparSadvIpAM rasAvahAm । ganDapaNkAM SabdajalAM svargamArgadurAvahAm ॥38॥

text: kṣamāritrāṃ satyamayīṃ dharmasthairyavaṭākarām । tyāgavātādhvagāṃ śīghrāṃ buddhināvā nadīṃ taret ॥39॥
html:
kṣamāritrāṃ satyamayīṃ dharmasthairyavaṭākarām ।
tyāgavātādhvagāṃ śīghrāṃ buddhināvā nadīṃ taret ॥39॥
slp1: kzamAritrAM satyamayIM DarmasTEryavawAkarAm । tyAgavAtADvagAM SIGrAM budDinAvA nadIM taret ॥39॥

text: tyaja dharmamadharmaṃ ca ubhe satyānṛte tyaja । ubhe satyānṛte tyaktvā yena tyajasi taṃ tyaja ॥40॥
html:
tyaja dharmamadharmaṃ ca ubhe satyānṛte tyaja ।
ubhe satyānṛte tyaktvā yena tyajasi taṃ tyaja ॥40॥
slp1: tyaja DarmamaDarmaM ca uBe satyAnfte tyaja । uBe satyAnfte tyaktvA yena tyajasi taM tyaja ॥40॥

text: tyaja dharmamasaṅkalpādadharmaṃ cāpyahiṃsayā । ubhe satyānṛte buddhyā buddhiṃ paramaniścayāt ॥41॥
html:
tyaja dharmamasaṅkalpādadharmaṃ cāpyahiṃsayā ।
ubhe satyānṛte buddhyā buddhiṃ paramaniścayāt ॥41॥
slp1: tyaja DarmamasaNkalpAdaDarmaM cApyahiMsayA । uBe satyAnfte budDyA budDiM paramaniScayAt ॥41॥

text: asthisthūṇaṃ snāyuyutaṃ māṃsaśoṇitalepanam । carmāvanaddhaṃ durgandhi pūrṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣayoḥ ॥42॥
html:
asthisthūṇaṃ snāyuyutaṃ māṃsaśoṇitalepanam ।
carmāvanaddhaṃ durgandhi pūrṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣayoḥ ॥42॥
slp1: asTisTURaM snAyuyutaM mAMsaSoRitalepanam । carmAvanadDaM durganDi pUrRaM mUtrapurIzayoH ॥42॥

text: jarāśokasamāviṣṭaṃ rogāyatanamāturam । rajasvalamanityaṃ ca bhūtāvāsaṃ samutsṛja ॥43॥
html:
jarāśokasamāviṣṭaṃ rogāyatanamāturam ।
rajasvalamanityaṃ ca bhūtāvāsaṃ samutsṛja ॥43॥
slp1: jarASokasamAvizwaM rogAyatanamAturam । rajasvalamanityaM ca BUtAvAsaM samutsfja ॥43॥

text: idaṃ viśvaṃ jagatsarvamajagaccāpi yadbhavet । mahābhūtātmakaṃ sarvaṃ mahadyatparamāṇu yat ॥44॥
html:
idaṃ viśvaṃ jagatsarvamajagaccāpi yadbhavet ।
mahābhūtātmakaṃ sarvaṃ mahadyatparamāṇu yat ॥44॥
slp1: idaM viSvaM jagatsarvamajagaccApi yadBavet । mahABUtAtmakaM sarvaM mahadyatparamARu yat ॥44॥

text: indriyāṇi ca pañcaiva tamaḥ sattvaṃ rajastathā । ityeṣa saptadaśako rāśiravyaktasañjñakaḥ ॥45॥
html:
indriyāṇi ca pañcaiva tamaḥ sattvaṃ rajastathā ।
ityeṣa saptadaśako rāśiravyaktasañjñakaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: indriyARi ca paYcEva tamaH sattvaM rajastaTA । ityeza saptadaSako rASiravyaktasaYjYakaH ॥45॥

text: sarvairihendriyārthaiśca vyaktāvyaktairhi saṃhitaḥ । pañcaviṃśaka ityeṣa vyaktāvyaktamayo guṇaḥ ॥46॥
html:
sarvairihendriyārthaiśca vyaktāvyaktairhi saṃhitaḥ ।
pañcaviṃśaka ityeṣa vyaktāvyaktamayo guṇaḥ ॥46॥
slp1: sarvErihendriyArTESca vyaktAvyaktErhi saMhitaH । paYcaviMSaka ityeza vyaktAvyaktamayo guRaH ॥46॥

text: etaiḥ sarvaiḥ samāyuktaḥ pumānityabhidhīyate । trivargo'tra sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ tathā ॥47॥
html:
etaiḥ sarvaiḥ samāyuktaḥ pumānityabhidhīyate ।
trivargo'tra sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ tathā ॥47॥
slp1: etEH sarvEH samAyuktaH pumAnityaBiDIyate । trivargo'tra suKaM duHKaM jIvitaM maraRaM taTA ॥47॥

text: ya idaṃ veda tattvena sa veda prabhavāpyayau । pārāśaryeha boddhavyaṃ jñānānāṃ yacca kiñcana ॥48॥
html:
ya idaṃ veda tattvena sa veda prabhavāpyayau ।
pārāśaryeha boddhavyaṃ jñānānāṃ yacca kiñcana ॥48॥
slp1: ya idaM veda tattvena sa veda praBavApyayO । pArASaryeha bodDavyaM jYAnAnAM yacca kiYcana ॥48॥

text: indriyairgṛhyate yadyattattadvyaktamiti sthitiḥ । avyaktamiti vijñeyaṃ liṅgagrāhyamatīndriyam ॥49॥
html:
indriyairgṛhyate yadyattattadvyaktamiti sthitiḥ ।
avyaktamiti vijñeyaṃ liṅgagrāhyamatīndriyam ॥49॥
slp1: indriyErgfhyate yadyattattadvyaktamiti sTitiH । avyaktamiti vijYeyaM liNgagrAhyamatIndriyam ॥49॥

text: indriyairniyatairdehī dhārābhiriva tarpyate । loke vitatamātmānaṃ lokaṃ cātmani paśyati ॥50॥
html:
indriyairniyatairdehī dhārābhiriva tarpyate ।
loke vitatamātmānaṃ lokaṃ cātmani paśyati ॥50॥
slp1: indriyErniyatErdehI DArABiriva tarpyate । loke vitatamAtmAnaM lokaM cAtmani paSyati ॥50॥

text: parāvaradṛśaḥ śaktirjñānavelāṃ na paśyati । paśyataḥ sarvabhūtāni sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā ॥51॥
html:
parāvaradṛśaḥ śaktirjñānavelāṃ na paśyati ।
paśyataḥ sarvabhūtāni sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā ॥51॥
slp1: parAvaradfSaH SaktirjYAnavelAM na paSyati । paSyataH sarvaBUtAni sarvAvasTAsu sarvadA ॥51॥

text: brahmabhūtasya saṃyogo nāśubhenopapadyate । jñānena vividhānkleśānativṛttasya mohajān । loke buddhiprakāśena lokamārgo na riṣyate ॥52॥
html:
brahmabhūtasya saṃyogo nāśubhenopapadyate ।
jñānena vividhānkleśānativṛttasya mohajān ।
loke buddhiprakāśena lokamārgo na riṣyate ॥52॥
slp1: brahmaBUtasya saMyogo nASuBenopapadyate । jYAnena viviDAnkleSAnativfttasya mohajAn । loke budDiprakASena lokamArgo na rizyate ॥52॥

text: anādinidhanaṃ jantumātmani sthitamavyayam । akartāramamūrtaṃ ca bhagavānāha tīrthavit ॥53॥
html:
anādinidhanaṃ jantumātmani sthitamavyayam ।
akartāramamūrtaṃ ca bhagavānāha tīrthavit ॥53॥
slp1: anAdiniDanaM jantumAtmani sTitamavyayam । akartAramamUrtaM ca BagavAnAha tIrTavit ॥53॥

text: yo jantuḥ svakṛtaistaistaiḥ karmabhirnityaduḥkhitaḥ । sa duḥkhapratighātārthaṃ hanti jantūnanekadhā ॥54॥
html:
yo jantuḥ svakṛtaistaistaiḥ karmabhirnityaduḥkhitaḥ ।
sa duḥkhapratighātārthaṃ hanti jantūnanekadhā ॥54॥
slp1: yo jantuH svakftEstEstEH karmaBirnityaduHKitaH । sa duHKapratiGAtArTaM hanti jantUnanekaDA ॥54॥

text: tataḥ karma samādatte punaranyannavaṃ bahu । tapyate'tha punastena bhuktvāpathyamivāturaḥ ॥55॥
html:
tataḥ karma samādatte punaranyannavaṃ bahu ।
tapyate'tha punastena bhuktvāpathyamivāturaḥ ॥55॥
slp1: tataH karma samAdatte punaranyannavaM bahu । tapyate'Ta punastena BuktvApaTyamivAturaH ॥55॥

text: ajasrameva mohārto duḥkheṣu sukhasañjñitaḥ । badhyate mathyate caiva karmabhirmanthavatsadā ॥56॥
html:
ajasrameva mohārto duḥkheṣu sukhasañjñitaḥ ।
badhyate mathyate caiva karmabhirmanthavatsadā ॥56॥
slp1: ajasrameva mohArto duHKezu suKasaYjYitaH । baDyate maTyate cEva karmaBirmanTavatsadA ॥56॥

text: tato nivṛtto bandhātsvātkarmaṇāmudayādiha । paribhramati saṃsāraṃ cakravadbahuvedanaḥ ॥57॥
html:
tato nivṛtto bandhātsvātkarmaṇāmudayādiha ।
paribhramati saṃsāraṃ cakravadbahuvedanaḥ ॥57॥
slp1: tato nivftto banDAtsvAtkarmaRAmudayAdiha । pariBramati saMsAraM cakravadbahuvedanaH ॥57॥

text: sa tvaṃ nivṛttabandhastu nivṛttaścāpi karmataḥ । sarvavitsarvajitsiddho bhava bhāvavivarjitaḥ ॥58॥
html:
sa tvaṃ nivṛttabandhastu nivṛttaścāpi karmataḥ ।
sarvavitsarvajitsiddho bhava bhāvavivarjitaḥ ॥58॥
slp1: sa tvaM nivfttabanDastu nivfttaScApi karmataH । sarvavitsarvajitsidDo Bava BAvavivarjitaH ॥58॥

text: saṃyamena navaṃ bandhaṃ nivartya tapaso balāt । samprāptā bahavaḥ siddhimapyabādhāṃ sukhodayām] ॥59॥
html:
saṃyamena navaṃ bandhaṃ nivartya tapaso balāt ।
samprāptā bahavaḥ siddhimapyabādhāṃ sukhodayām] ॥59॥
slp1: saMyamena navaM banDaM nivartya tapaso balAt । samprAptA bahavaH sidDimapyabADAM suKodayAm] ॥59॥

text: aśokaṃ śokanāśārthaṃ śāstraṃ śāntikaraṃ śivam । niśamya labhate buddhiṃ tāṃ labdhvā sukhamedhate ॥1॥
html:
aśokaṃ śokanāśārthaṃ śāstraṃ śāntikaraṃ śivam ।
niśamya labhate buddhiṃ tāṃ labdhvā sukhamedhate ॥1॥
slp1: aSokaM SokanASArTaM SAstraM SAntikaraM Sivam । niSamya laBate budDiM tAM labDvA suKameDate ॥1॥
author: nārada uvāca ।

text: śokasthānasahasrāṇi bhayasthānaśatāni ca । divase divase mūḍhamāviśanti na paṇḍitam ॥2॥
html:
śokasthānasahasrāṇi bhayasthānaśatāni ca ।
divase divase mūḍhamāviśanti na paṇḍitam ॥2॥
slp1: SokasTAnasahasrARi BayasTAnaSatAni ca । divase divase mUQamAviSanti na paRqitam ॥2॥

text: tasmādaniṣṭanāśārthamitihāsaṃ nibodha me । tiṣṭhate cedvaśe buddhirlabhate śokanāśanam ॥3॥
html:
tasmādaniṣṭanāśārthamitihāsaṃ nibodha me ।
tiṣṭhate cedvaśe buddhirlabhate śokanāśanam ॥3॥
slp1: tasmAdanizwanASArTamitihAsaM niboDa me । tizWate cedvaSe budDirlaBate SokanASanam ॥3॥

text: aniṣṭasamprayogācca viprayogātpriyasya ca । manuṣyā mānasairduḥkhairyujyante alpabuddhayaḥ ॥4॥
html:
aniṣṭasamprayogācca viprayogātpriyasya ca ।
manuṣyā mānasairduḥkhairyujyante alpabuddhayaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: anizwasamprayogAcca viprayogAtpriyasya ca । manuzyA mAnasErduHKEryujyante alpabudDayaH ॥4॥

text: dravyeṣu samatīteṣu ye guṇāstānna cintayet । tānanādriyamāṇasya snehabandhaḥ pramucyate ॥5॥
html:
dravyeṣu samatīteṣu ye guṇāstānna cintayet ।
tānanādriyamāṇasya snehabandhaḥ pramucyate ॥5॥
slp1: dravyezu samatItezu ye guRAstAnna cintayet । tAnanAdriyamARasya snehabanDaH pramucyate ॥5॥

text: doṣadarśī bhavettatra yatra rāgaḥ pravartate । aniṣṭavaddhitaṃ paśyettathā kṣipraṃ virajyate ॥6॥
html:
doṣadarśī bhavettatra yatra rāgaḥ pravartate ।
aniṣṭavaddhitaṃ paśyettathā kṣipraṃ virajyate ॥6॥
slp1: dozadarSI Bavettatra yatra rAgaH pravartate । anizwavadDitaM paSyettaTA kzipraM virajyate ॥6॥

text: nārtho na dharmo na yaśo yo'tītamanuśocati । apyabhāvena yujyeta taccāsya na nivartate ॥7॥
html:
nārtho na dharmo na yaśo yo'tītamanuśocati ।
apyabhāvena yujyeta taccāsya na nivartate ॥7॥
slp1: nArTo na Darmo na yaSo yo'tItamanuSocati । apyaBAvena yujyeta taccAsya na nivartate ॥7॥

text: guṇairbhūtāni yujyante viyujyante tathaiva ca । sarvāṇi naitadekasya śokasthānaṃ hi vidyate ॥8॥
html:
guṇairbhūtāni yujyante viyujyante tathaiva ca ।
sarvāṇi naitadekasya śokasthānaṃ hi vidyate ॥8॥
slp1: guRErBUtAni yujyante viyujyante taTEva ca । sarvARi nEtadekasya SokasTAnaM hi vidyate ॥8॥

text: mṛtaṃ vā yadi vā naṣṭaṃ yo'tītamanuśocati । duḥkhena labhate duḥkhaṃ dvāvanarthau prapadyate ॥9॥
html:
mṛtaṃ vā yadi vā naṣṭaṃ yo'tītamanuśocati ।
duḥkhena labhate duḥkhaṃ dvāvanarthau prapadyate ॥9॥
slp1: mftaM vA yadi vA nazwaM yo'tItamanuSocati । duHKena laBate duHKaM dvAvanarTO prapadyate ॥9॥

text: nāśru kurvanti ye buddhyā dṛṣṭvā lokeṣu santatim । samyakprapaśyataḥ sarvaṃ nāśrukarmopapadyate ॥10॥
html:
nāśru kurvanti ye buddhyā dṛṣṭvā lokeṣu santatim ।
samyakprapaśyataḥ sarvaṃ nāśrukarmopapadyate ॥10॥
slp1: nASru kurvanti ye budDyA dfzwvA lokezu santatim । samyakprapaSyataH sarvaM nASrukarmopapadyate ॥10॥

text: duḥkhopaghāte śārīre mānase vāpyupasthite । yasminna śakyate kartuṃ yatnastannānucintayet ॥11॥
html:
duḥkhopaghāte śārīre mānase vāpyupasthite ।
yasminna śakyate kartuṃ yatnastannānucintayet ॥11॥
slp1: duHKopaGAte SArIre mAnase vApyupasTite । yasminna Sakyate kartuM yatnastannAnucintayet ॥11॥

text: bhaiṣajyametadduḥkhasya yadetannānucintayet । cintyamānaṃ hi na vyeti bhūyaścāpi pravardhate ॥12॥
html:
bhaiṣajyametadduḥkhasya yadetannānucintayet ।
cintyamānaṃ hi na vyeti bhūyaścāpi pravardhate ॥12॥
slp1: BEzajyametadduHKasya yadetannAnucintayet । cintyamAnaM hi na vyeti BUyaScApi pravarDate ॥12॥

text: prajñayā mānasaṃ duḥkhaṃ hanyācchārīramauṣadhaiḥ । etadvijñānasāmarthyaṃ na bālaiḥ samatāmiyāt ॥13॥
html:
prajñayā mānasaṃ duḥkhaṃ hanyācchārīramauṣadhaiḥ ।
etadvijñānasāmarthyaṃ na bālaiḥ samatāmiyāt ॥13॥
slp1: prajYayA mAnasaM duHKaM hanyAcCArIramOzaDEH । etadvijYAnasAmarTyaM na bAlEH samatAmiyAt ॥13॥

text: anityaṃ yauvanaṃ rūpaṃ jīvitaṃ dravyasañcayaḥ । ārogyaṃ priyasaṃvāso gṛdhyettatra na paṇḍitaḥ ॥14॥
html:
anityaṃ yauvanaṃ rūpaṃ jīvitaṃ dravyasañcayaḥ ।
ārogyaṃ priyasaṃvāso gṛdhyettatra na paṇḍitaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: anityaM yOvanaM rUpaM jIvitaM dravyasaYcayaH । ArogyaM priyasaMvAso gfDyettatra na paRqitaH ॥14॥

text: na jānapadikaṃ duḥkhamekaḥ śocitumarhati । aśocanpratikurvīta yadi paśyedupakramam ॥15॥
html:
na jānapadikaṃ duḥkhamekaḥ śocitumarhati ।
aśocanpratikurvīta yadi paśyedupakramam ॥15॥
slp1: na jAnapadikaM duHKamekaH Socitumarhati । aSocanpratikurvIta yadi paSyedupakramam ॥15॥

text: sukhādbahutaraṃ duḥkhaṃ jīvite nātra saṃśayaḥ । snigdhatvaṃ cendriyārtheṣu mohānmaraṇamapriyam ॥16॥
html:
sukhādbahutaraṃ duḥkhaṃ jīvite nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
snigdhatvaṃ cendriyārtheṣu mohānmaraṇamapriyam ॥16॥
slp1: suKAdbahutaraM duHKaM jIvite nAtra saMSayaH । snigDatvaM cendriyArTezu mohAnmaraRamapriyam ॥16॥

text: parityajati yo duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ vāpyubhayaṃ naraḥ । abhyeti brahma so'tyantaṃ na taṃ śocanti paṇḍitāḥ ॥17॥
html:
parityajati yo duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ vāpyubhayaṃ naraḥ ।
abhyeti brahma so'tyantaṃ na taṃ śocanti paṇḍitāḥ ॥17॥
slp1: parityajati yo duHKaM suKaM vApyuBayaM naraH । aByeti brahma so'tyantaM na taM Socanti paRqitAH ॥17॥

text: duḥkhamarthā hi tyajyante pālane na ca te sukhāḥ । duḥkhena cādhigamyante nāśameṣāṃ na cintayet ॥18॥
html:
duḥkhamarthā hi tyajyante pālane na ca te sukhāḥ ।
duḥkhena cādhigamyante nāśameṣāṃ na cintayet ॥18॥
slp1: duHKamarTA hi tyajyante pAlane na ca te suKAH । duHKena cADigamyante nASamezAM na cintayet ॥18॥

text: anyāmanyāṃ dhanāvasthāṃ prāpya vaiśeṣikīṃ narāḥ । atṛptā yānti vidhvaṃsaṃ santoṣaṃ yānti paṇḍitāḥ ॥19॥
html:
anyāmanyāṃ dhanāvasthāṃ prāpya vaiśeṣikīṃ narāḥ ।
atṛptā yānti vidhvaṃsaṃ santoṣaṃ yānti paṇḍitāḥ ॥19॥
slp1: anyAmanyAM DanAvasTAM prApya vESezikIM narAH । atfptA yAnti viDvaMsaM santozaM yAnti paRqitAH ॥19॥
