dṛśyante jarayā bhagnā nāgā nāgairivottamaiḥ ॥32॥
slp1: te pibantaH kazAyAMSca sarpIMzi viviDAni ca । dfSyante jarayA BagnA nAgA nAgErivottamEH ॥32॥

text: ke vā bhuvi cikitsante rogārtānmṛgapakṣiṇaḥ । śvāpadāni daridrāṃśca prāyo nārtā bhavanti te ॥33॥
html:
ke vā bhuvi cikitsante rogārtānmṛgapakṣiṇaḥ ।
śvāpadāni daridrāṃśca prāyo nārtā bhavanti te ॥33॥
slp1: ke vA Buvi cikitsante rogArtAnmfgapakziRaH । SvApadAni daridrAMSca prAyo nArtA Bavanti te ॥33॥

text: ghorānapi durādharṣānnṛpatīnugratejasaḥ । ākramya roga ādatte paśūnpaśupaco yathā ॥34॥
html:
ghorānapi durādharṣānnṛpatīnugratejasaḥ ।
ākramya roga ādatte paśūnpaśupaco yathā ॥34॥
slp1: GorAnapi durADarzAnnfpatInugratejasaH । Akramya roga Adatte paSUnpaSupaco yaTA ॥34॥

text: iti lokamanākrandaṃ mohaśokapariplutam । srotasā sahasā kṣiptaṃ hriyamāṇaṃ balīyasā ॥35॥
html:
iti lokamanākrandaṃ mohaśokapariplutam ।
srotasā sahasā kṣiptaṃ hriyamāṇaṃ balīyasā ॥35॥
slp1: iti lokamanAkrandaM mohaSokapariplutam । srotasA sahasA kziptaM hriyamARaM balIyasA ॥35॥

text: na dhanena na rājyena nogreṇa tapasā tathā । svabhāvā vyativartante ye niyuktāḥ śarīriṣu ॥36॥
html:
na dhanena na rājyena nogreṇa tapasā tathā ।
svabhāvā vyativartante ye niyuktāḥ śarīriṣu ॥36॥
slp1: na Danena na rAjyena nogreRa tapasA taTA । svaBAvA vyativartante ye niyuktAH SarIrizu ॥36॥

text: na mriyeranna jīryeransarve syuḥ sarvakāmikāḥ । nāpriyaṃ pratipaśyeyurutthānasya phalaṃ prati ॥37॥
html:
na mriyeranna jīryeransarve syuḥ sarvakāmikāḥ ।
nāpriyaṃ pratipaśyeyurutthānasya phalaṃ prati ॥37॥
slp1: na mriyeranna jIryeransarve syuH sarvakAmikAH । nApriyaM pratipaSyeyurutTAnasya PalaM prati ॥37॥

text: uparyupari lokasya sarvo bhavitumicchati । yatate ca yathāśakti na ca tadvartate tathā ॥38॥
html:
uparyupari lokasya sarvo bhavitumicchati ।
yatate ca yathāśakti na ca tadvartate tathā ॥38॥
slp1: uparyupari lokasya sarvo BavitumicCati । yatate ca yaTASakti na ca tadvartate taTA ॥38॥

text: aiśvaryamadamattāṃśca mattānmadyamadena ca । apramattāḥ śaṭhāḥ krūrā vikrāntāḥ paryupāsate ॥39॥
html:
aiśvaryamadamattāṃśca mattānmadyamadena ca ।
apramattāḥ śaṭhāḥ krūrā vikrāntāḥ paryupāsate ॥39॥
slp1: ESvaryamadamattAMSca mattAnmadyamadena ca । apramattAH SaWAH krUrA vikrAntAH paryupAsate ॥39॥

text: kleśāḥ pratinivartante keṣāñcidasamīkṣitāḥ । svaṃ svaṃ ca punaranyeṣāṃ na kiñcidabhigamyate ॥40॥
html:
kleśāḥ pratinivartante keṣāñcidasamīkṣitāḥ ।
svaṃ svaṃ ca punaranyeṣāṃ na kiñcidabhigamyate ॥40॥
slp1: kleSAH pratinivartante kezAYcidasamIkzitAH । svaM svaM ca punaranyezAM na kiYcidaBigamyate ॥40॥

text: mahacca phalavaiṣamyaṃ dṛśyate karmasandhiṣu । vahanti śibikāmanye yāntyanye śibikāgatāḥ ॥41॥
html:
mahacca phalavaiṣamyaṃ dṛśyate karmasandhiṣu ।
vahanti śibikāmanye yāntyanye śibikāgatāḥ ॥41॥
slp1: mahacca PalavEzamyaM dfSyate karmasanDizu । vahanti SibikAmanye yAntyanye SibikAgatAH ॥41॥

text: sarveṣāmṛddhikāmānāmanye rathapuraḥsarāḥ । manujāśca śatastrīkāḥ śataśo vidhavāḥ striyaḥ ॥42॥
html:
sarveṣāmṛddhikāmānāmanye rathapuraḥsarāḥ ।
manujāśca śatastrīkāḥ śataśo vidhavāḥ striyaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: sarvezAmfdDikAmAnAmanye raTapuraHsarAH । manujASca SatastrIkAH SataSo viDavAH striyaH ॥42॥

text: dvandvārāmeṣu bhūteṣu gacchantyekaikaśo narāḥ । idamanyatparaṃ paśya mātra mohaṃ kariṣyasi ॥43॥
html:
dvandvārāmeṣu bhūteṣu gacchantyekaikaśo narāḥ ।
idamanyatparaṃ paśya mātra mohaṃ kariṣyasi ॥43॥
slp1: dvandvArAmezu BUtezu gacCantyekEkaSo narAH । idamanyatparaM paSya mAtra mohaM karizyasi ॥43॥

text: tyaja dharmamadharmaṃ ca ubhe satyānṛte tyaja । ubhe satyānṛte tyaktvā yena tyajasi taṃ tyaja ॥44॥
html:
tyaja dharmamadharmaṃ ca ubhe satyānṛte tyaja ।
ubhe satyānṛte tyaktvā yena tyajasi taṃ tyaja ॥44॥
slp1: tyaja DarmamaDarmaM ca uBe satyAnfte tyaja । uBe satyAnfte tyaktvA yena tyajasi taM tyaja ॥44॥

text: etatte paramaṃ guhyamākhyātamṛṣisattama । yena devāḥ parityajya martyalokaṃ divaṃ gatāḥ ॥45॥
html:
etatte paramaṃ guhyamākhyātamṛṣisattama ।
yena devāḥ parityajya martyalokaṃ divaṃ gatāḥ ॥45॥
slp1: etatte paramaM guhyamAKyAtamfzisattama । yena devAH parityajya martyalokaM divaM gatAH ॥45॥

text: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā śukaḥ paramabuddhimān । sañcintya manasā dhīro niścayaṃ nādhyagacchata ॥46॥
html:
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā śukaḥ paramabuddhimān ।
sañcintya manasā dhīro niścayaṃ nādhyagacchata ॥46॥
slp1: nAradasya vacaH SrutvA SukaH paramabudDimAn । saYcintya manasA DIro niScayaM nADyagacCata ॥46॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: putradārairmahānkleśo vidyāmnāye mahāñśramaḥ । kiṃ nu syācchāśvataṃ sthānamalpakleśaṃ mahodayam ॥47॥
html:
putradārairmahānkleśo vidyāmnāye mahāñśramaḥ ।
kiṃ nu syācchāśvataṃ sthānamalpakleśaṃ mahodayam ॥47॥
slp1: putradArErmahAnkleSo vidyAmnAye mahAYSramaH । kiM nu syAcCASvataM sTAnamalpakleSaM mahodayam ॥47॥

text: tato muhūrtaṃ sañcintya niścitāṃ gatimātmanaḥ । parāvarajño dharmasya parāṃ naiḥśreyasīṃ gatim ॥48॥
html:
tato muhūrtaṃ sañcintya niścitāṃ gatimātmanaḥ ।
parāvarajño dharmasya parāṃ naiḥśreyasīṃ gatim ॥48॥
slp1: tato muhUrtaM saYcintya niScitAM gatimAtmanaH । parAvarajYo Darmasya parAM nEHSreyasIM gatim ॥48॥

text: kathaṃ tvahamasaṅkliṣṭo gaccheyaṃ paramāṃ gatim । nāvarteyaṃ yathā bhūyo yonisaṃsārasāgare ॥49॥
html:
kathaṃ tvahamasaṅkliṣṭo gaccheyaṃ paramāṃ gatim ।
nāvarteyaṃ yathā bhūyo yonisaṃsārasāgare ॥49॥
slp1: kaTaM tvahamasaNklizwo gacCeyaM paramAM gatim । nAvarteyaM yaTA BUyo yonisaMsArasAgare ॥49॥

text: paraṃ bhāvaṃ hi kāṅkṣāmi yatra nāvartate punaḥ । sarvasaṅgānparityajya niścitāṃ manaso gatim ॥50॥
html:
paraṃ bhāvaṃ hi kāṅkṣāmi yatra nāvartate punaḥ ।
sarvasaṅgānparityajya niścitāṃ manaso gatim ॥50॥
slp1: paraM BAvaM hi kANkzAmi yatra nAvartate punaH । sarvasaNgAnparityajya niScitAM manaso gatim ॥50॥

text: tatra yāsyāmi yatrātmā śamaṃ me'dhigamiṣyati । akṣayaścāvyayaścaiva yatra sthāsyāmi śāśvataḥ ॥51॥
html:
tatra yāsyāmi yatrātmā śamaṃ me'dhigamiṣyati ।
akṣayaścāvyayaścaiva yatra sthāsyāmi śāśvataḥ ॥51॥
slp1: tatra yAsyAmi yatrAtmA SamaM me'Digamizyati । akzayaScAvyayaScEva yatra sTAsyAmi SASvataH ॥51॥

text: na tu yogamṛte śakyā prāptuṃ sā paramā gatiḥ । avabandho hi muktasya karmabhirnopapadyate ॥52॥
html:
na tu yogamṛte śakyā prāptuṃ sā paramā gatiḥ ।
avabandho hi muktasya karmabhirnopapadyate ॥52॥
slp1: na tu yogamfte SakyA prAptuM sA paramA gatiH । avabanDo hi muktasya karmaBirnopapadyate ॥52॥

text: tasmādyogaṃ samāsthāya tyaktvā gṛhakalevaram । vāyubhūtaḥ pravekṣyāmi tejorāśiṃ divākaram ॥53॥
html:
tasmādyogaṃ samāsthāya tyaktvā gṛhakalevaram ।
vāyubhūtaḥ pravekṣyāmi tejorāśiṃ divākaram ॥53॥
slp1: tasmAdyogaM samAsTAya tyaktvA gfhakalevaram । vAyuBUtaH pravekzyAmi tejorASiM divAkaram ॥53॥

text: na hyeṣa kṣayamāpnoti somaḥ suragaṇairyathā । kampitaḥ patate bhūmiṃ punaścaivādhirohati । kṣīyate hi sadā somaḥ punaścaivābhipūryate ॥54॥
html:
na hyeṣa kṣayamāpnoti somaḥ suragaṇairyathā ।
kampitaḥ patate bhūmiṃ punaścaivādhirohati ।
kṣīyate hi sadā somaḥ punaścaivābhipūryate ॥54॥
slp1: na hyeza kzayamApnoti somaH suragaREryaTA । kampitaH patate BUmiM punaScEvADirohati । kzIyate hi sadA somaH punaScEvABipUryate ॥54॥

text: ravistu santāpayati lokānraśmibhirulbaṇaiḥ । sarvatasteja ādatte nityamakṣayamaṇḍalaḥ ॥55॥
html:
ravistu santāpayati lokānraśmibhirulbaṇaiḥ ।
sarvatasteja ādatte nityamakṣayamaṇḍalaḥ ॥55॥
slp1: ravistu santApayati lokAnraSmiBirulbaREH । sarvatasteja Adatte nityamakzayamaRqalaH ॥55॥

text: ato me rocate gantumādityaṃ dīptatejasam । atra vatsyāmi durdharṣo niḥsaṅgenāntarātmanā ॥56॥
html:
ato me rocate gantumādityaṃ dīptatejasam ।
atra vatsyāmi durdharṣo niḥsaṅgenāntarātmanā ॥56॥
slp1: ato me rocate gantumAdityaM dIptatejasam । atra vatsyAmi durDarzo niHsaNgenAntarAtmanA ॥56॥

text: sūryasya sadane cāhaṃ nikṣipyedaṃ kalevaram । ṛṣibhiḥ saha yāsyāmi sauraṃ tejo'tiduḥsaham ॥57॥
html:
sūryasya sadane cāhaṃ nikṣipyedaṃ kalevaram ।
ṛṣibhiḥ saha yāsyāmi sauraṃ tejo'tiduḥsaham ॥57॥
slp1: sUryasya sadane cAhaM nikzipyedaM kalevaram । fziBiH saha yAsyAmi sOraM tejo'tiduHsaham ॥57॥

text: āpṛcchāmi nagānnāgāngirīnurvīṃ diśo divam । devadānavagandharvānpiśācoragarākṣasān ॥58॥
html:
āpṛcchāmi nagānnāgāngirīnurvīṃ diśo divam ।
devadānavagandharvānpiśācoragarākṣasān ॥58॥
slp1: ApfcCAmi nagAnnAgAngirInurvIM diSo divam । devadAnavaganDarvAnpiSAcoragarAkzasAn ॥58॥

text: lokeṣu sarvabhūtāni pravekṣyāmi nasaṃśayaḥ । paśyantu yogavīryaṃ me sarve devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ ॥59॥
html:
lokeṣu sarvabhūtāni pravekṣyāmi nasaṃśayaḥ ।
paśyantu yogavīryaṃ me sarve devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ ॥59॥
slp1: lokezu sarvaBUtAni pravekzyAmi nasaMSayaH । paSyantu yogavIryaM me sarve devAH saharziBiH ॥59॥

text: athānujñāpya tamṛṣiṃ nāradaṃ lokaviśrutam । tasmādanujñāṃ samprāpya jagāma pitaraṃ prati ॥60॥
html:
athānujñāpya tamṛṣiṃ nāradaṃ lokaviśrutam ।
tasmādanujñāṃ samprāpya jagāma pitaraṃ prati ॥60॥
slp1: aTAnujYApya tamfziM nAradaM lokaviSrutam । tasmAdanujYAM samprApya jagAma pitaraM prati ॥60॥

text: so'bhivādya mahātmānamṛṣiṃ dvaipāyanaṃ munim । śukaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya kṛṣṇamāpṛṣṭavānmuniḥ ॥61॥
html:
so'bhivādya mahātmānamṛṣiṃ dvaipāyanaṃ munim ।
śukaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya kṛṣṇamāpṛṣṭavānmuniḥ ॥61॥
slp1: so'BivAdya mahAtmAnamfziM dvEpAyanaM munim । SukaH pradakziRIkftya kfzRamApfzwavAnmuniH ॥61॥

text: śrutvā ṛṣistadvacanaṃ śukasya prīto mahātmā punarāha cainam । bho bhoḥ putra sthīyatāṃ tāvadadya yāvaccakṣuḥ prīṇayāmi tvadartham ॥62॥
html:
śrutvā ṛṣistadvacanaṃ śukasya prīto mahātmā punarāha cainam ।
bho bhoḥ putra sthīyatāṃ tāvadadya yāvaccakṣuḥ prīṇayāmi tvadartham ॥62॥
slp1: SrutvA fzistadvacanaM Sukasya prIto mahAtmA punarAha cEnam । Bo BoH putra sTIyatAM tAvadadya yAvaccakzuH prIRayAmi tvadarTam ॥62॥

text: nirapekṣaḥ śuko bhūtvā niḥsneho muktabandhanaḥ । mokṣamevānusañcintya gamanāya mano dadhe । pitaraṃ samparityajya jagāma dvijasattamaḥ] ॥63॥
html:
nirapekṣaḥ śuko bhūtvā niḥsneho muktabandhanaḥ ।
mokṣamevānusañcintya gamanāya mano dadhe ।
pitaraṃ samparityajya jagāma dvijasattamaḥ] ॥63॥
slp1: nirapekzaH Suko BUtvA niHsneho muktabanDanaH । mokzamevAnusaYcintya gamanAya mano daDe । pitaraM samparityajya jagAma dvijasattamaH] ॥63॥

text: giripṛṣṭhaṃ samāruhya suto vyāsasya bhārata । same deśe vivikte ca niḥśalāka upāviśat ॥1॥
html:
giripṛṣṭhaṃ samāruhya suto vyāsasya bhārata ।
same deśe vivikte ca niḥśalāka upāviśat ॥1॥
slp1: giripfzWaM samAruhya suto vyAsasya BArata । same deSe vivikte ca niHSalAka upAviSat ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dhārayāmāsa cātmānaṃ yathāśāstraṃ mahāmuniḥ । pādātprabhṛtigātreṣu krameṇa kramayogavit ॥2॥
html:
dhārayāmāsa cātmānaṃ yathāśāstraṃ mahāmuniḥ ।
pādātprabhṛtigātreṣu krameṇa kramayogavit ॥2॥
slp1: DArayAmAsa cAtmAnaM yaTASAstraM mahAmuniH । pAdAtpraBftigAtrezu krameRa kramayogavit ॥2॥

text: tataḥ sa prāṅmukho vidvānāditye nacirodite । pāṇipādaṃ samādhāya vinītavadupāviśat ॥3॥
html:
tataḥ sa prāṅmukho vidvānāditye nacirodite ।
pāṇipādaṃ samādhāya vinītavadupāviśat ॥3॥
slp1: tataH sa prANmuKo vidvAnAditye nacirodite । pARipAdaM samADAya vinItavadupAviSat ॥3॥

text: na tatra pakṣisaṅghāto na śabdo nāpi darśanam । yatra vaiyāsakirdhīmānyoktuṃ samupacakrame ॥4॥
html:
na tatra pakṣisaṅghāto na śabdo nāpi darśanam ।
yatra vaiyāsakirdhīmānyoktuṃ samupacakrame ॥4॥
slp1: na tatra pakzisaNGAto na Sabdo nApi darSanam । yatra vEyAsakirDImAnyoktuM samupacakrame ॥4॥

text: sa dadarśa tadātmānaṃ sarvasaṅgaviniḥsṛtam । prajahāsa tato hāsaṃ śukaḥ samprekṣya bhāskaram ॥5॥
html:
sa dadarśa tadātmānaṃ sarvasaṅgaviniḥsṛtam ।
prajahāsa tato hāsaṃ śukaḥ samprekṣya bhāskaram ॥5॥
slp1: sa dadarSa tadAtmAnaM sarvasaNgaviniHsftam । prajahAsa tato hAsaM SukaH samprekzya BAskaram ॥5॥

text: sa punaryogamāsthāya mokṣamārgopalabdhaye । mahāyogīśvaro bhūtvā so'tyakrāmadvihāyasam ॥6॥
html:
sa punaryogamāsthāya mokṣamārgopalabdhaye ।
mahāyogīśvaro bhūtvā so'tyakrāmadvihāyasam ॥6॥
slp1: sa punaryogamAsTAya mokzamArgopalabDaye । mahAyogISvaro BUtvA so'tyakrAmadvihAyasam ॥6॥

text: tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā devarṣiṃ nāradaṃ tadā । nivedayāmāsa tadā svaṃ yogaṃ paramarṣaye ॥7॥
html:
tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā devarṣiṃ nāradaṃ tadā ।
nivedayāmāsa tadā svaṃ yogaṃ paramarṣaye ॥7॥
slp1: tataH pradakziRaM kftvA devarziM nAradaM tadA । nivedayAmAsa tadA svaM yogaM paramarzaye ॥7॥

text: dṛṣṭo mārgaḥ pravṛtto'smi svasti te'stu tapodhana । tvatprasādādgamiṣyāmi gatimiṣṭāṃ mahādyute ॥8॥
html:
dṛṣṭo mārgaḥ pravṛtto'smi svasti te'stu tapodhana ।
tvatprasādādgamiṣyāmi gatimiṣṭāṃ mahādyute ॥8॥
slp1: dfzwo mArgaH pravftto'smi svasti te'stu tapoDana । tvatprasAdAdgamizyAmi gatimizwAM mahAdyute ॥8॥

text: nāradenābhyanujñātastato dvaipāyanātmajaḥ । abhivādya punaryogamāsthāyākāśamāviśat ॥9॥
html:
nāradenābhyanujñātastato dvaipāyanātmajaḥ ।
abhivādya punaryogamāsthāyākāśamāviśat ॥9॥
slp1: nAradenAByanujYAtastato dvEpAyanAtmajaH । aBivAdya punaryogamAsTAyAkASamAviSat ॥9॥

text: kailāsapṛṣṭhādutpatya sa papāta divaṃ tadā । antarikṣacaraḥ śrīmānvyāsaputraḥ suniścitaḥ ॥10॥
html:
kailāsapṛṣṭhādutpatya sa papāta divaṃ tadā ।
antarikṣacaraḥ śrīmānvyāsaputraḥ suniścitaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: kElAsapfzWAdutpatya sa papAta divaM tadA । antarikzacaraH SrImAnvyAsaputraH suniScitaH ॥10॥

text: tamudyantaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ vainateyasamadyutim । dadṛśuḥ sarvabhūtāni manomārutaraṃhasam ॥11॥
html:
tamudyantaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ vainateyasamadyutim ।
dadṛśuḥ sarvabhūtāni manomārutaraṃhasam ॥11॥
slp1: tamudyantaM dvijaSrezWaM vEnateyasamadyutim । dadfSuH sarvaBUtAni manomArutaraMhasam ॥11॥

text: vyavasāyena lokāṃstrīnsarvānso'tha vicintayan । āsthito divyamadhvānaṃ pāvakārkasamaprabhaḥ ॥12॥
html:
vyavasāyena lokāṃstrīnsarvānso'tha vicintayan ।
āsthito divyamadhvānaṃ pāvakārkasamaprabhaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: vyavasAyena lokAMstrInsarvAnso'Ta vicintayan । AsTito divyamaDvAnaM pAvakArkasamapraBaH ॥12॥

text: tamekamanasaṃ yāntamavyagramakutobhayam । dadṛśuḥ sarvabhūtāni jaṅgamānītarāṇi ca ॥13॥
html:
tamekamanasaṃ yāntamavyagramakutobhayam ।
dadṛśuḥ sarvabhūtāni jaṅgamānītarāṇi ca ॥13॥
slp1: tamekamanasaM yAntamavyagramakutoBayam । dadfSuH sarvaBUtAni jaNgamAnItarARi ca ॥13॥

text: yathāśakti yathānyāyaṃ pūjayāṃ cakrire tadā । puṣpavarṣaiśca divyaistamavacakrurdivaukasaḥ ॥14॥
html:
yathāśakti yathānyāyaṃ pūjayāṃ cakrire tadā ।
puṣpavarṣaiśca divyaistamavacakrurdivaukasaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: yaTASakti yaTAnyAyaM pUjayAM cakrire tadA । puzpavarzESca divyEstamavacakrurdivOkasaH ॥14॥

text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitāḥ sarve gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ । ṛṣayaścaiva saṃsiddhāḥ paraṃ vismayamāgatāḥ ॥15॥
html:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitāḥ sarve gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ।
ṛṣayaścaiva saṃsiddhāḥ paraṃ vismayamāgatāḥ ॥15॥
slp1: taM dfzwvA vismitAH sarve ganDarvApsarasAM gaRAH । fzayaScEva saMsidDAH paraM vismayamAgatAH ॥15॥

text: antarikṣacaraḥ ko'yaṃ tapasā siddhimāgataḥ । adhaḥkāyordhvavaktraśca netraiḥ samabhivāhyate ॥16॥
html:
antarikṣacaraḥ ko'yaṃ tapasā siddhimāgataḥ ।
adhaḥkāyordhvavaktraśca netraiḥ samabhivāhyate ॥16॥
slp1: antarikzacaraH ko'yaM tapasA sidDimAgataH । aDaHkAyorDvavaktraSca netrEH samaBivAhyate ॥16॥

text: tataḥ paramadhīrātmā triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ । bhāskaraṃ samudīkṣansa prāṅmukho vāgyato'gamat । śabdenākāśamakhilaṃ pūrayanniva sarvataḥ ॥17॥
html:
tataḥ paramadhīrātmā triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ ।
bhāskaraṃ samudīkṣansa prāṅmukho vāgyato'gamat ।
śabdenākāśamakhilaṃ pūrayanniva sarvataḥ ॥17॥
slp1: tataH paramaDIrAtmA trizu lokezu viSrutaH । BAskaraM samudIkzansa prANmuKo vAgyato'gamat । SabdenAkASamaKilaM pUrayanniva sarvataH ॥17॥

text: tamāpatantaṃ sahasā dṛṣṭvā sarvāpsarogaṇāḥ । sambhrāntamanaso rājannāsanparamavismitāḥ । pañcacūḍāprabhṛtayo bhṛśamutphullalocanāḥ ॥18॥
html:
tamāpatantaṃ sahasā dṛṣṭvā sarvāpsarogaṇāḥ ।
sambhrāntamanaso rājannāsanparamavismitāḥ ।
pañcacūḍāprabhṛtayo bhṛśamutphullalocanāḥ ॥18॥
slp1: tamApatantaM sahasA dfzwvA sarvApsarogaRAH । samBrAntamanaso rAjannAsanparamavismitAH । paYcacUqApraBftayo BfSamutPullalocanAH ॥18॥

text: daivataṃ katamaṃ hyetaduttamāṃ gatimāsthitam । suniścitamihāyāti vimuktamiva niḥspṛham ॥19॥
html:
daivataṃ katamaṃ hyetaduttamāṃ gatimāsthitam ।
suniścitamihāyāti vimuktamiva niḥspṛham ॥19॥
slp1: dEvataM katamaM hyetaduttamAM gatimAsTitam । suniScitamihAyAti vimuktamiva niHspfham ॥19॥

text: tataḥ samaticakrāma malayaṃ nāma parvatam । urvaśī pūrvacittiśca yaṃ nityamupasevate । te sma brahmarṣiputrasya vismayaṃ yayatuḥ param ॥20॥
html:
tataḥ samaticakrāma malayaṃ nāma parvatam ।
urvaśī pūrvacittiśca yaṃ nityamupasevate ।
te sma brahmarṣiputrasya vismayaṃ yayatuḥ param ॥20॥
slp1: tataH samaticakrAma malayaM nAma parvatam । urvaSI pUrvacittiSca yaM nityamupasevate । te sma brahmarziputrasya vismayaM yayatuH param ॥20॥

text: aho buddhisamādhānaṃ vedābhyāsarate dvije । acireṇaiva kālena nabhaścarati candravat । pitṛśuśrūṣayā siddhiṃ samprāpto'yamanuttamām ॥21॥
html:
aho buddhisamādhānaṃ vedābhyāsarate dvije ।
acireṇaiva kālena nabhaścarati candravat ।
pitṛśuśrūṣayā siddhiṃ samprāpto'yamanuttamām ॥21॥
slp1: aho budDisamADAnaM vedAByAsarate dvije । acireREva kAlena naBaScarati candravat । pitfSuSrUzayA sidDiM samprApto'yamanuttamAm ॥21॥

text: pitṛbhakto dṛḍhatapāḥ pituḥ sudayitaḥ sutaḥ । ananyamanasā tena kathaṃ pitrā vivarjitaḥ ॥22॥
html:
pitṛbhakto dṛḍhatapāḥ pituḥ sudayitaḥ sutaḥ ।
ananyamanasā tena kathaṃ pitrā vivarjitaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: pitfBakto dfQatapAH pituH sudayitaH sutaH । ananyamanasA tena kaTaM pitrA vivarjitaH ॥22॥

text: urvaśyā vacanaṃ śrutvā śukaḥ paramadharmavit । udaikṣata diśaḥ sarvā vacane gatamānasaḥ ॥23॥
html:
urvaśyā vacanaṃ śrutvā śukaḥ paramadharmavit ।
udaikṣata diśaḥ sarvā vacane gatamānasaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: urvaSyA vacanaM SrutvA SukaH paramaDarmavit । udEkzata diSaH sarvA vacane gatamAnasaH ॥23॥

text: so'ntarikṣaṃ mahīṃ caiva saśailavanakānanām । ālokayāmāsa tadā sarāṃsi saritastathā ॥24॥
html:
so'ntarikṣaṃ mahīṃ caiva saśailavanakānanām ।
ālokayāmāsa tadā sarāṃsi saritastathā ॥24॥
slp1: so'ntarikzaM mahIM cEva saSElavanakAnanAm । AlokayAmAsa tadA sarAMsi saritastaTA ॥24॥

text: tato dvaipāyanasutaṃ bahumānapuraḥsaram । kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ sarvā nirīkṣante sma devatāḥ ॥25॥
html:
tato dvaipāyanasutaṃ bahumānapuraḥsaram ।
kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ sarvā nirīkṣante sma devatāḥ ॥25॥
slp1: tato dvEpAyanasutaM bahumAnapuraHsaram । kftAYjalipuwAH sarvA nirIkzante sma devatAH ॥25॥

text: abravīttāstadā vākyaṃ śukaḥ paramadharmavit । pitā yadyanugacchenmāṃ krośamānaḥ śuketi vai ॥26॥
html:
abravīttāstadā vākyaṃ śukaḥ paramadharmavit ।
pitā yadyanugacchenmāṃ krośamānaḥ śuketi vai ॥26॥
slp1: abravIttAstadA vAkyaM SukaH paramaDarmavit । pitA yadyanugacCenmAM kroSamAnaH Suketi vE ॥26॥

text: tataḥ prativaco deyaṃ sarvaireva samāhitaiḥ । etanme snehataḥ sarve vacanaṃ kartumarhatha ॥27॥
html:
tataḥ prativaco deyaṃ sarvaireva samāhitaiḥ ।
etanme snehataḥ sarve vacanaṃ kartumarhatha ॥27॥
slp1: tataH prativaco deyaM sarvEreva samAhitEH । etanme snehataH sarve vacanaM kartumarhaTa ॥27॥

text: śukasya vacanaṃ śrutvā diśaḥ savanakānanāḥ । samudrāḥ saritaḥ śailāḥ pratyūcustaṃ samantataḥ ॥28॥
html:
śukasya vacanaṃ śrutvā diśaḥ savanakānanāḥ ।
samudrāḥ saritaḥ śailāḥ pratyūcustaṃ samantataḥ ॥28॥
slp1: Sukasya vacanaM SrutvA diSaH savanakAnanAH । samudrAH saritaH SElAH pratyUcustaM samantataH ॥28॥

text: yathājñāpayase vipra bāḍhamevaṃ bhaviṣyati । ṛṣervyāharato vākyaṃ prativakṣyāmahe vayam] ॥29॥
html:
yathājñāpayase vipra bāḍhamevaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
ṛṣervyāharato vākyaṃ prativakṣyāmahe vayam] ॥29॥
slp1: yaTAjYApayase vipra bAQamevaM Bavizyati । fzervyAharato vAkyaM prativakzyAmahe vayam] ॥29॥

text: ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ brahmarṣiḥ sumahātapāḥ । prātiṣṭhata śukaḥ siddhiṃ hitvā lokāṃścaturvidhān ॥1॥
html:
ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ brahmarṣiḥ sumahātapāḥ ।
prātiṣṭhata śukaḥ siddhiṃ hitvā lokāṃścaturvidhān ॥1॥
slp1: ityevamuktvA vacanaM brahmarziH sumahAtapAH । prAtizWata SukaH sidDiM hitvA lokAMScaturviDAn ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tamo hyaṣṭavidhaṃ hitvā jahau pañcavidhaṃ rajaḥ । tataḥ sattvaṃ jahau dhīmāṃstadadbhutamivābhavat ॥2॥
html:
tamo hyaṣṭavidhaṃ hitvā jahau pañcavidhaṃ rajaḥ ।
tataḥ sattvaṃ jahau dhīmāṃstadadbhutamivābhavat ॥2॥
slp1: tamo hyazwaviDaM hitvA jahO paYcaviDaM rajaH । tataH sattvaM jahO DImAMstadadButamivABavat ॥2॥

text: tatastasminpade nitye nirguṇe liṅgavarjite । brahmaṇi pratyatiṣṭhatsa vidhūmo'gniriva jvalan ॥3॥
html:
tatastasminpade nitye nirguṇe liṅgavarjite ।
brahmaṇi pratyatiṣṭhatsa vidhūmo'gniriva jvalan ॥3॥
slp1: tatastasminpade nitye nirguRe liNgavarjite । brahmaRi pratyatizWatsa viDUmo'gniriva jvalan ॥3॥

text: ulkāpātā diśāṃ dāhā bhūmikampāstathaiva ca । prādurbhūtāḥ kṣaṇe tasmiṃstadadbhutamivābhavat ॥4॥
html:
ulkāpātā diśāṃ dāhā bhūmikampāstathaiva ca ।
prādurbhūtāḥ kṣaṇe tasmiṃstadadbhutamivābhavat ॥4॥
slp1: ulkApAtA diSAM dAhA BUmikampAstaTEva ca । prAdurBUtAH kzaRe tasmiMstadadButamivABavat ॥4॥

text: drumāḥ śākhāśca mumucuḥ śikharāṇi ca parvatāḥ । nirghātaśabdaiśca girirhimavāndīryatīva ha ॥5॥
html:
drumāḥ śākhāśca mumucuḥ śikharāṇi ca parvatāḥ ।
nirghātaśabdaiśca girirhimavāndīryatīva ha ॥5॥
slp1: drumAH SAKASca mumucuH SiKarARi ca parvatAH । nirGAtaSabdESca girirhimavAndIryatIva ha ॥5॥

text: na babhāse sahasrāṃśurna jajvāla ca pāvakaḥ । hradāśca saritaścaiva cukṣubhuḥ sāgarāstathā ॥6॥
html:
na babhāse sahasrāṃśurna jajvāla ca pāvakaḥ ।
hradāśca saritaścaiva cukṣubhuḥ sāgarāstathā ॥6॥
slp1: na baBAse sahasrAMSurna jajvAla ca pAvakaH । hradASca saritaScEva cukzuBuH sAgarAstaTA ॥6॥

text: vavarṣa vāsavastoyaṃ rasavacca sugandhi ca । vavau samīraṇaścāpi divyagandhavahaḥ śuciḥ ॥7॥
html:
vavarṣa vāsavastoyaṃ rasavacca sugandhi ca ।
vavau samīraṇaścāpi divyagandhavahaḥ śuciḥ ॥7॥
slp1: vavarza vAsavastoyaM rasavacca suganDi ca । vavO samIraRaScApi divyaganDavahaH SuciH ॥7॥

text: sa śṛṅge'pratime divye himavanmerusambhave । saṃśliṣṭe śvetapīte dve rukmarūpyamaye śubhe ॥8॥
html:
sa śṛṅge'pratime divye himavanmerusambhave ।
saṃśliṣṭe śvetapīte dve rukmarūpyamaye śubhe ॥8॥
slp1: sa SfNge'pratime divye himavanmerusamBave । saMSlizwe SvetapIte dve rukmarUpyamaye SuBe ॥8॥

text: śatayojanavistāre tiryagūrdhvaṃ ca bhārata । udīcīṃ diśamāśritya rucire sandadarśa ha ॥9॥
html:
śatayojanavistāre tiryagūrdhvaṃ ca bhārata ।
udīcīṃ diśamāśritya rucire sandadarśa ha ॥9॥
slp1: SatayojanavistAre tiryagUrDvaM ca BArata । udIcIM diSamASritya rucire sandadarSa ha ॥9॥

text: so'viśaṅkena manasā tathaivābhyapatacchukaḥ । tataḥ parvataśṛṅge dve sahasaiva dvidhākṛte । adṛśyetāṃ mahārāja tadadbhutamivābhavat ॥10॥
html:
so'viśaṅkena manasā tathaivābhyapatacchukaḥ ।
tataḥ parvataśṛṅge dve sahasaiva dvidhākṛte ।
adṛśyetāṃ mahārāja tadadbhutamivābhavat ॥10॥
slp1: so'viSaNkena manasA taTEvAByapatacCukaH । tataH parvataSfNge dve sahasEva dviDAkfte । adfSyetAM mahArAja tadadButamivABavat ॥10॥

text: tataḥ parvataśṛṅgābhyāṃ sahasaiva viniḥsṛtaḥ । na ca pratijaghānāsya sa gatiṃ parvatottamaḥ ॥11॥
html:
tataḥ parvataśṛṅgābhyāṃ sahasaiva viniḥsṛtaḥ ।
na ca pratijaghānāsya sa gatiṃ parvatottamaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: tataH parvataSfNgAByAM sahasEva viniHsftaH । na ca pratijaGAnAsya sa gatiM parvatottamaH ॥11॥

text: tato mahānabhūcchabdo divi sarvadivaukasām । gandharvāṇāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca ye ca śailanivāsinaḥ ॥12॥
html:
tato mahānabhūcchabdo divi sarvadivaukasām ।
gandharvāṇāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca ye ca śailanivāsinaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: tato mahAnaBUcCabdo divi sarvadivOkasAm । ganDarvARAmfzIRAM ca ye ca SElanivAsinaH ॥12॥

text: dṛṣṭvā śukamatikrāntaṃ parvataṃ ca dvidhākṛtam । sādhu sādhviti tatrāsīnnādaḥ sarvatra bhārata ॥13॥
html:
dṛṣṭvā śukamatikrāntaṃ parvataṃ ca dvidhākṛtam ।
sādhu sādhviti tatrāsīnnādaḥ sarvatra bhārata ॥13॥
slp1: dfzwvA SukamatikrAntaM parvataM ca dviDAkftam । sADu sADviti tatrAsInnAdaH sarvatra BArata ॥13॥

text: sa pūjyamāno devaiśca gandharvairṝṣibhistathā । yakṣarākṣasasaṅghaiśca vidyādharagaṇaistathā ॥14॥
html:
sa pūjyamāno devaiśca gandharvairṝṣibhistathā ।
yakṣarākṣasasaṅghaiśca vidyādharagaṇaistathā ॥14॥
slp1: sa pUjyamAno devESca ganDarvErFziBistaTA । yakzarAkzasasaNGESca vidyADaragaREstaTA ॥14॥

text: divyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ samākīrṇamantarikṣaṃ samantataḥ । āsītkila mahārāja śukābhipatane tadā ॥15॥
html:
divyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ samākīrṇamantarikṣaṃ samantataḥ ।
āsītkila mahārāja śukābhipatane tadā ॥15॥
slp1: divyEH puzpEH samAkIrRamantarikzaM samantataH । AsItkila mahArAja SukABipatane tadA ॥15॥

text: tato mandākinīṃ ramyāmupariṣṭādabhivrajan । śuko dadarśa dharmātmā puṣpitadrumakānanām ॥16॥
html:
tato mandākinīṃ ramyāmupariṣṭādabhivrajan ।
śuko dadarśa dharmātmā puṣpitadrumakānanām ॥16॥
slp1: tato mandAkinIM ramyAmuparizwAdaBivrajan । Suko dadarSa DarmAtmA puzpitadrumakAnanAm ॥16॥

text: tasyāṃ krīḍantyabhiratāḥ snānti caivāpsarogaṇāḥ । śūnyākāraṃ nirākārāḥ śukaṃ dṛṣṭvā vivāsasaḥ ॥17॥
html:
tasyāṃ krīḍantyabhiratāḥ snānti caivāpsarogaṇāḥ ।
śūnyākāraṃ nirākārāḥ śukaṃ dṛṣṭvā vivāsasaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: tasyAM krIqantyaBiratAH snAnti cEvApsarogaRAH । SUnyAkAraM nirAkArAH SukaM dfzwvA vivAsasaH ॥17॥

text: taṃ prakramantamājñāya pitā snehasamanvitaḥ । uttamāṃ gatimāsthāya pṛṣṭhato'nusasāra ha ॥18॥
html:
taṃ prakramantamājñāya pitā snehasamanvitaḥ ।
uttamāṃ gatimāsthāya pṛṣṭhato'nusasāra ha ॥18॥
slp1: taM prakramantamAjYAya pitA snehasamanvitaH । uttamAM gatimAsTAya pfzWato'nusasAra ha ॥18॥

text: śukastu mārutādūrdhvaṃ gatiṃ kṛtvāntarikṣagām । darśayitvā prabhāvaṃ svaṃ sarvabhūto'bhavattadā ॥19॥
html:
śukastu mārutādūrdhvaṃ gatiṃ kṛtvāntarikṣagām ।
darśayitvā prabhāvaṃ svaṃ sarvabhūto'bhavattadā ॥19॥
slp1: Sukastu mArutAdUrDvaM gatiM kftvAntarikzagAm । darSayitvA praBAvaM svaM sarvaBUto'BavattadA ॥19॥

text: mahāyogagatiṃ tvagryāṃ vyāsotthāya mahātapāḥ । nimeṣāntaramātreṇa śukābhipatanaṃ yayau ॥20॥
html:
mahāyogagatiṃ tvagryāṃ vyāsotthāya mahātapāḥ ।
nimeṣāntaramātreṇa śukābhipatanaṃ yayau ॥20॥
slp1: mahAyogagatiM tvagryAM vyAsotTAya mahAtapAH । nimezAntaramAtreRa SukABipatanaM yayO ॥20॥

text: sa dadarśa dvidhā kṛtvā parvatāgraṃ śukaṃ gatam । śaśaṃsurṝṣayastasmai karma putrasya tattadā ॥21॥
html:
sa dadarśa dvidhā kṛtvā parvatāgraṃ śukaṃ gatam ।
śaśaṃsurṝṣayastasmai karma putrasya tattadā ॥21॥
slp1: sa dadarSa dviDA kftvA parvatAgraM SukaM gatam । SaSaMsurFzayastasmE karma putrasya tattadA ॥21॥

text: tataḥ śuketi dīrgheṇa śaikṣeṇākranditastadā । svayaṃ pitrā svareṇoccaistrīṁllokānanunādya vai ॥22॥
html:
tataḥ śuketi dīrgheṇa śaikṣeṇākranditastadā ।
svayaṃ pitrā svareṇoccaistrīṁllokānanunādya vai ॥22॥
slp1: tataH Suketi dIrGeRa SEkzeRAkranditastadA । svayaM pitrA svareRoccEstrIṁllokAnanunAdya vE ॥22॥

text: śukaḥ sarvagato bhūtvā sarvātmā sarvatomukhaḥ । pratyabhāṣata dharmātmā bhoḥśabdenānunādayan ॥23॥
html:
śukaḥ sarvagato bhūtvā sarvātmā sarvatomukhaḥ ।
pratyabhāṣata dharmātmā bhoḥśabdenānunādayan ॥23॥
slp1: SukaH sarvagato BUtvA sarvAtmA sarvatomuKaH । pratyaBAzata DarmAtmA BoHSabdenAnunAdayan ॥23॥

text: tata ekākṣaraṃ nādaṃ bho ityeva samīrayan । pratyāharajjagatsarvamuccaiḥ sthāvarajaṅgamam ॥24॥
html:
tata ekākṣaraṃ nādaṃ bho ityeva samīrayan ।
pratyāharajjagatsarvamuccaiḥ sthāvarajaṅgamam ॥24॥

yajante tvāmaharaharnānāmūrtisamāsthitam ॥25॥
slp1: catvAro hyASramA deva sarve gArhasTyamUlakAH । yajante tvAmaharaharnAnAmUrtisamAsTitam ॥25॥

text: pitā mātā ca sarvasya jagataḥ śāśvato guruḥ । kaṃ tvadya yajase devaṃ pitaraṃ kaṃ na vidmahe ॥26॥
html:
pitā mātā ca sarvasya jagataḥ śāśvato guruḥ ।
kaṃ tvadya yajase devaṃ pitaraṃ kaṃ na vidmahe ॥26॥
slp1: pitA mAtA ca sarvasya jagataH SASvato guruH । kaM tvadya yajase devaM pitaraM kaM na vidmahe ॥26॥

text: avācyametadvaktavyamātmaguhyaṃ sanātanam । tava bhaktimato brahmanvakṣyāmi tu yathātatham ॥27॥
html:
avācyametadvaktavyamātmaguhyaṃ sanātanam ।
tava bhaktimato brahmanvakṣyāmi tu yathātatham ॥27॥
slp1: avAcyametadvaktavyamAtmaguhyaM sanAtanam । tava Baktimato brahmanvakzyAmi tu yaTAtaTam ॥27॥
author: śrībhagavānuvāca ।

text: yattatsūkṣmamavijñeyamavyaktamacalaṃ dhruvam । indriyairindriyārthaiśca sarvabhūtaiśca varjitam ॥28॥
html:
yattatsūkṣmamavijñeyamavyaktamacalaṃ dhruvam ।
indriyairindriyārthaiśca sarvabhūtaiśca varjitam ॥28॥
slp1: yattatsUkzmamavijYeyamavyaktamacalaM Druvam । indriyErindriyArTESca sarvaBUtESca varjitam ॥28॥

text: sa hyantarātmā bhūtānāṃ kṣetrajñaśceti kathyate । triguṇavyatirikto'sau puruṣaśceti kalpitaḥ । tasmādavyaktamutpannaṃ triguṇaṃ dvijasattama ॥29॥
html:
sa hyantarātmā bhūtānāṃ kṣetrajñaśceti kathyate ।
triguṇavyatirikto'sau puruṣaśceti kalpitaḥ ।
tasmādavyaktamutpannaṃ triguṇaṃ dvijasattama ॥29॥
slp1: sa hyantarAtmA BUtAnAM kzetrajYaSceti kaTyate । triguRavyatirikto'sO puruzaSceti kalpitaH । tasmAdavyaktamutpannaM triguRaM dvijasattama ॥29॥

text: avyaktā vyaktabhāvasthā yā sā prakṛtiravyayā । tāṃ yonimāvayorviddhi yo'sau sadasadātmakaḥ । āvābhyāṃ pūjyate'sau hi daive pitrye ca kalpite ॥30॥
html:
avyaktā vyaktabhāvasthā yā sā prakṛtiravyayā ।
tāṃ yonimāvayorviddhi yo'sau sadasadātmakaḥ ।
āvābhyāṃ pūjyate'sau hi daive pitrye ca kalpite ॥30॥
slp1: avyaktA vyaktaBAvasTA yA sA prakftiravyayA । tAM yonimAvayorvidDi yo'sO sadasadAtmakaH । AvAByAM pUjyate'sO hi dEve pitrye ca kalpite ॥30॥

text: nāsti tasmātparo'nyo hi pitā devo'tha vā dvijaḥ । ātmā hi nau sa vijñeyastatastaṃ pūjayāvahe ॥31॥
html:
nāsti tasmātparo'nyo hi pitā devo'tha vā dvijaḥ ।
ātmā hi nau sa vijñeyastatastaṃ pūjayāvahe ॥31॥
slp1: nAsti tasmAtparo'nyo hi pitA devo'Ta vA dvijaH । AtmA hi nO sa vijYeyastatastaM pUjayAvahe ॥31॥

text: tenaiṣā prathitā brahmanmaryādā lokabhāvinī । daivaṃ pitryaṃ ca kartavyamiti tasyānuśāsanam ॥32॥
html:
tenaiṣā prathitā brahmanmaryādā lokabhāvinī ।
daivaṃ pitryaṃ ca kartavyamiti tasyānuśāsanam ॥32॥
slp1: tenEzA praTitA brahmanmaryAdA lokaBAvinI । dEvaM pitryaM ca kartavyamiti tasyAnuSAsanam ॥32॥

text: brahmā sthāṇurmanurdakṣo bhṛgurdharmastapo damaḥ । marīciraṅgirātriśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ ॥33॥
html:
brahmā sthāṇurmanurdakṣo bhṛgurdharmastapo damaḥ ।
marīciraṅgirātriśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ ॥33॥
slp1: brahmA sTARurmanurdakzo BfgurDarmastapo damaH । marIciraNgirAtriSca pulastyaH pulahaH kratuH ॥33॥

text: vasiṣṭhaḥ parameṣṭhī ca vivasvānsoma eva ca । kardamaścāpi yaḥ proktaḥ krodho vikrīta eva ca ॥34॥
html:
vasiṣṭhaḥ parameṣṭhī ca vivasvānsoma eva ca ।
kardamaścāpi yaḥ proktaḥ krodho vikrīta eva ca ॥34॥
slp1: vasizWaH paramezWI ca vivasvAnsoma eva ca । kardamaScApi yaH proktaH kroDo vikrIta eva ca ॥34॥

text: ekaviṃśatirutpannāste prajāpatayaḥ smṛtāḥ । tasya devasya maryādāṃ pūjayanti sanātanīm ॥35॥
html:
ekaviṃśatirutpannāste prajāpatayaḥ smṛtāḥ ।
tasya devasya maryādāṃ pūjayanti sanātanīm ॥35॥
slp1: ekaviMSatirutpannAste prajApatayaH smftAH । tasya devasya maryAdAM pUjayanti sanAtanIm ॥35॥

text: daivaṃ pitryaṃ ca satataṃ tasya vijñāya tattvataḥ । ātmaprāptāni ca tato jānanti dvijasattamāḥ ॥36॥
html:
daivaṃ pitryaṃ ca satataṃ tasya vijñāya tattvataḥ ।
ātmaprāptāni ca tato jānanti dvijasattamāḥ ॥36॥
slp1: dEvaM pitryaM ca satataM tasya vijYAya tattvataH । AtmaprAptAni ca tato jAnanti dvijasattamAH ॥36॥

text: svargasthā api ye kecittaṃ namasyanti dehinaḥ । te tatprasādādgacchanti tenādiṣṭaphalāṃ gatim ॥37॥
html:
svargasthā api ye kecittaṃ namasyanti dehinaḥ ।
te tatprasādādgacchanti tenādiṣṭaphalāṃ gatim ॥37॥
slp1: svargasTA api ye kecittaM namasyanti dehinaH । te tatprasAdAdgacCanti tenAdizwaPalAM gatim ॥37॥

text: ye hīnāḥ saptadaśabhirguṇaiḥ karmabhireva ca । kalāḥ pañcadaśa tyaktvā te muktā iti niścayaḥ ॥38॥
html:
ye hīnāḥ saptadaśabhirguṇaiḥ karmabhireva ca ।
kalāḥ pañcadaśa tyaktvā te muktā iti niścayaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: ye hInAH saptadaSaBirguREH karmaBireva ca । kalAH paYcadaSa tyaktvA te muktA iti niScayaH ॥38॥

text: muktānāṃ tu gatirbrahmankṣetrajña iti kalpitaḥ । sa hi sarvagataścaiva nirguṇaścaiva kathyate ॥39॥
html:
muktānāṃ tu gatirbrahmankṣetrajña iti kalpitaḥ ।
sa hi sarvagataścaiva nirguṇaścaiva kathyate ॥39॥
slp1: muktAnAM tu gatirbrahmankzetrajYa iti kalpitaH । sa hi sarvagataScEva nirguRaScEva kaTyate ॥39॥

text: dṛśyate jñānayogena āvāṃ ca prasṛtau tataḥ । evaṃ jñātvā tamātmānaṃ pūjayāvaḥ sanātanam ॥40॥
html:
dṛśyate jñānayogena āvāṃ ca prasṛtau tataḥ ।
evaṃ jñātvā tamātmānaṃ pūjayāvaḥ sanātanam ॥40॥
slp1: dfSyate jYAnayogena AvAM ca prasftO tataH । evaM jYAtvA tamAtmAnaM pUjayAvaH sanAtanam ॥40॥

text: taṃ vedāścāśramāścaiva nānātanusamāsthitāḥ । bhaktyā sampūjayantyādyaṃ gatiṃ caiṣāṃ dadāti saḥ ॥41॥
html:
taṃ vedāścāśramāścaiva nānātanusamāsthitāḥ ।
bhaktyā sampūjayantyādyaṃ gatiṃ caiṣāṃ dadāti saḥ ॥41॥
slp1: taM vedAScASramAScEva nAnAtanusamAsTitAH । BaktyA sampUjayantyAdyaM gatiM cEzAM dadAti saH ॥41॥

text: ye tu tadbhāvitā loke ekāntitvaṃ samāsthitāḥ । etadabhyadhikaṃ teṣāṃ yatte taṃ praviśantyuta ॥42॥
html:
ye tu tadbhāvitā loke ekāntitvaṃ samāsthitāḥ ।
etadabhyadhikaṃ teṣāṃ yatte taṃ praviśantyuta ॥42॥
slp1: ye tu tadBAvitA loke ekAntitvaM samAsTitAH । etadaByaDikaM tezAM yatte taM praviSantyuta ॥42॥

text: iti guhyasamuddeśastava nārada kīrtitaḥ । bhaktyā premṇā ca viprarṣe asmadbhaktyā ca te śrutaḥ] ॥43॥
html:
iti guhyasamuddeśastava nārada kīrtitaḥ ।
bhaktyā premṇā ca viprarṣe asmadbhaktyā ca te śrutaḥ] ॥43॥
slp1: iti guhyasamuddeSastava nArada kIrtitaH । BaktyA premRA ca viprarze asmadBaktyA ca te SrutaH] ॥43॥

text: sa evamukto dvipadāṃ variṣṭho nārāyaṇenottamapūruṣeṇa । jagāda vākyaṃ dvipadāṃ variṣṭhaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ lokahitādhivāsam ॥1॥
html:
sa evamukto dvipadāṃ variṣṭho nārāyaṇenottamapūruṣeṇa ।
jagāda vākyaṃ dvipadāṃ variṣṭhaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ lokahitādhivāsam ॥1॥
slp1: sa evamukto dvipadAM varizWo nArAyaRenottamapUruzeRa । jagAda vAkyaM dvipadAM varizWaM nArAyaRaM lokahitADivAsam ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yadarthamātmaprabhaveha janma tavottamaṃ dharmagṛhe caturdhā । tatsādhyatāṃ lokahitārthamadya gacchāmi draṣṭuṃ prakṛtiṃ tavādyām ॥2॥
html:
yadarthamātmaprabhaveha janma tavottamaṃ dharmagṛhe caturdhā ।
tatsādhyatāṃ lokahitārthamadya gacchāmi draṣṭuṃ prakṛtiṃ tavādyām ॥2॥
slp1: yadarTamAtmapraBaveha janma tavottamaM Darmagfhe caturDA । tatsADyatAM lokahitArTamadya gacCAmi drazwuM prakftiM tavAdyAm ॥2॥

text: vedāḥ svadhītā mama lokanātha taptaṃ tapo nānṛtamuktapūrvam । pūjāṃ gurūṇāṃ satataṃ karomi parasya guhyaṃ na ca bhinnapūrvam ॥3॥
html:
vedāḥ svadhītā mama lokanātha taptaṃ tapo nānṛtamuktapūrvam ।
pūjāṃ gurūṇāṃ satataṃ karomi parasya guhyaṃ na ca bhinnapūrvam ॥3॥
slp1: vedAH svaDItA mama lokanATa taptaM tapo nAnftamuktapUrvam । pUjAM gurURAM satataM karomi parasya guhyaM na ca BinnapUrvam ॥3॥

text: guptāni catvāri yathāgamaṃ me śatrau ca mitre ca samo'smi nityam । taṃ cādidevaṃ satataṃ prapanna ekāntabhāvena vṛṇomyajasram । ebhirviśeṣaiḥ pariśuddhasattvaḥ kasmānna paśyeyamanantamīśam ॥4॥
html:
guptāni catvāri yathāgamaṃ me śatrau ca mitre ca samo'smi nityam ।
taṃ cādidevaṃ satataṃ prapanna ekāntabhāvena vṛṇomyajasram ।
ebhirviśeṣaiḥ pariśuddhasattvaḥ kasmānna paśyeyamanantamīśam ॥4॥
slp1: guptAni catvAri yaTAgamaM me SatrO ca mitre ca samo'smi nityam । taM cAdidevaM satataM prapanna ekAntaBAvena vfRomyajasram । eBirviSezEH pariSudDasattvaH kasmAnna paSyeyamanantamISam ॥4॥

text: tatpārameṣṭhyasya vaco niśamya nārāyaṇaḥ sātvatadharmagoptā । gaccheti taṃ nāradamuktavānsa sampūjayitvātmavidhikriyābhiḥ ॥5॥
html:
tatpārameṣṭhyasya vaco niśamya nārāyaṇaḥ sātvatadharmagoptā ।
gaccheti taṃ nāradamuktavānsa sampūjayitvātmavidhikriyābhiḥ ॥5॥
slp1: tatpAramezWyasya vaco niSamya nArAyaRaH sAtvataDarmagoptA । gacCeti taM nAradamuktavAnsa sampUjayitvAtmaviDikriyABiH ॥5॥

text: tato visṛṣṭaḥ parameṣṭhiputraḥ so'bhyarcayitvā tamṛṣiṃ purāṇam । khamutpapātottamavegayuktastato'dhimerau sahasā nililye ॥6॥
html:
tato visṛṣṭaḥ parameṣṭhiputraḥ so'bhyarcayitvā tamṛṣiṃ purāṇam ।
khamutpapātottamavegayuktastato'dhimerau sahasā nililye ॥6॥
slp1: tato visfzwaH paramezWiputraH so'ByarcayitvA tamfziM purARam । KamutpapAtottamavegayuktastato'DimerO sahasA nililye ॥6॥

text: tatrāvatasthe ca munirmuhūrtamekāntamāsādya gireḥ sa śṛṅge । ālokayannuttarapaścimena dadarśa cātyadbhutarūpayuktam ॥7॥
html:
tatrāvatasthe ca munirmuhūrtamekāntamāsādya gireḥ sa śṛṅge ।
ālokayannuttarapaścimena dadarśa cātyadbhutarūpayuktam ॥7॥
slp1: tatrAvatasTe ca munirmuhUrtamekAntamAsAdya gireH sa SfNge । AlokayannuttarapaScimena dadarSa cAtyadButarUpayuktam ॥7॥

text: kṣīrodadheruttarato hi dvīpaḥ śvetaḥ sa nāmnā prathito viśālaḥ । meroḥ sahasraiḥ sa hi yojanānāṃ dvātriṃśatordhvaṃ kavibhirniruktaḥ ॥8॥
html:
kṣīrodadheruttarato hi dvīpaḥ śvetaḥ sa nāmnā prathito viśālaḥ ।
meroḥ sahasraiḥ sa hi yojanānāṃ dvātriṃśatordhvaṃ kavibhirniruktaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: kzIrodaDeruttarato hi dvIpaH SvetaH sa nAmnA praTito viSAlaH । meroH sahasrEH sa hi yojanAnAM dvAtriMSatorDvaM kaviBirniruktaH ॥8॥

text: atīndriyāścānaśanāśca tatra niṣpandahīnāḥ susugandhinaśca । śvetāḥ pumāṃso gatasarvapāpāścakṣurmuṣaḥ pāpakṛtāṃ narāṇām ॥9॥
html:
atīndriyāścānaśanāśca tatra niṣpandahīnāḥ susugandhinaśca ।
śvetāḥ pumāṃso gatasarvapāpāścakṣurmuṣaḥ pāpakṛtāṃ narāṇām ॥9॥
slp1: atIndriyAScAnaSanASca tatra nizpandahInAH susuganDinaSca । SvetAH pumAMso gatasarvapApAScakzurmuzaH pApakftAM narARAm ॥9॥

text: vajrāsthikāyāḥ samamānonmānā divyānvayarūpāḥ śubhasāropetāḥ । chatrākṛtiśīrṣā meghaughaninādāḥ satpuṣkaracatuṣkā rājīvaśatapādāḥ ॥10॥
html:
vajrāsthikāyāḥ samamānonmānā divyānvayarūpāḥ śubhasāropetāḥ ।
chatrākṛtiśīrṣā meghaughaninādāḥ satpuṣkaracatuṣkā rājīvaśatapādāḥ ॥10॥
slp1: vajrAsTikAyAH samamAnonmAnA divyAnvayarUpAH SuBasAropetAH । CatrAkftiSIrzA meGOGaninAdAH satpuzkaracatuzkA rAjIvaSatapAdAH ॥10॥

text: ṣaṣṭyā dantairyuktāḥ śuklairaṣṭābhirdaṃṣṭrābhirye । jihvābhirye viṣvagvaktraṃ lelihyante sūryaprakhyam ॥11॥
html:
ṣaṣṭyā dantairyuktāḥ śuklairaṣṭābhirdaṃṣṭrābhirye ।
jihvābhirye viṣvagvaktraṃ lelihyante sūryaprakhyam ॥11॥
slp1: zazwyA dantEryuktAH SuklErazwABirdaMzwrABirye । jihvABirye vizvagvaktraM lelihyante sUryapraKyam ॥11॥

text: bhaktyā devaṃ viśvotpannaṃ yasmātsarve lokāḥ sūtāḥ । vedā dharmā munayaḥ śāntā devāḥ sarve tasya visargāḥ ॥12॥
html:
bhaktyā devaṃ viśvotpannaṃ yasmātsarve lokāḥ sūtāḥ ।
vedā dharmā munayaḥ śāntā devāḥ sarve tasya visargāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: BaktyA devaM viSvotpannaM yasmAtsarve lokAH sUtAH । vedA DarmA munayaH SAntA devAH sarve tasya visargAH ॥12॥

text: atīndriyā nirāhārā aniṣpandāḥ sugandhinaḥ । kathaṃ te puruṣā jātāḥ kā teṣāṃ gatiruttamā ॥13॥
html:
atīndriyā nirāhārā aniṣpandāḥ sugandhinaḥ ।
kathaṃ te puruṣā jātāḥ kā teṣāṃ gatiruttamā ॥13॥
slp1: atIndriyA nirAhArA anizpandAH suganDinaH । kaTaM te puruzA jAtAH kA tezAM gatiruttamA ॥13॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: ye vimuktā bhavantīha narā bharatasattama । teṣāṃ lakṣaṇametaddhi yacchvetadvīpavāsinām ॥14॥
html:
ye vimuktā bhavantīha narā bharatasattama ।
teṣāṃ lakṣaṇametaddhi yacchvetadvīpavāsinām ॥14॥
slp1: ye vimuktA BavantIha narA Baratasattama । tezAM lakzaRametadDi yacCvetadvIpavAsinAm ॥14॥

text: tasmānme saṃśayaṃ chindhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me । tvaṃ hi sarvakathārāmastvāṃ caivopāśritā vayam ॥15॥
html:
tasmānme saṃśayaṃ chindhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ।
tvaṃ hi sarvakathārāmastvāṃ caivopāśritā vayam ॥15॥
slp1: tasmAnme saMSayaM CinDi paraM kOtUhalaM hi me । tvaM hi sarvakaTArAmastvAM cEvopASritA vayam ॥15॥

text: vistīrṇaiṣā kathā rājañśrutā me pitṛsannidhau । saiṣā tava hi vaktavyā kathāsāro hi sa smṛtaḥ ॥16॥
html:
vistīrṇaiṣā kathā rājañśrutā me pitṛsannidhau ।
saiṣā tava hi vaktavyā kathāsāro hi sa smṛtaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: vistIrREzA kaTA rAjaYSrutA me pitfsanniDO । sEzA tava hi vaktavyA kaTAsAro hi sa smftaH ॥16॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: rājoparicaro nāma babhūvādhipatirbhuvaḥ । ākhaṇḍalasakhaḥ khyāto bhakto nārāyaṇaṃ harim ॥17॥
html:
rājoparicaro nāma babhūvādhipatirbhuvaḥ ।
ākhaṇḍalasakhaḥ khyāto bhakto nārāyaṇaṃ harim ॥17॥
slp1: rAjoparicaro nAma baBUvADipatirBuvaH । AKaRqalasaKaH KyAto Bakto nArAyaRaM harim ॥17॥

text: dhārmiko nityabhaktaśca pitṝnnityamatandritaḥ । sāmrājyaṃ tena samprāptaṃ nārāyaṇavarātpurā ॥18॥
html:
dhārmiko nityabhaktaśca pitṝnnityamatandritaḥ ।
sāmrājyaṃ tena samprāptaṃ nārāyaṇavarātpurā ॥18॥
slp1: DArmiko nityaBaktaSca pitFnnityamatandritaH । sAmrAjyaM tena samprAptaM nArAyaRavarAtpurA ॥18॥

text: sātvataṃ vidhimāsthāya prāksūryamukhaniḥsṛtam । pūjayāmāsa deveśaṃ taccheṣeṇa pitāmahān ॥19॥
html:
sātvataṃ vidhimāsthāya prāksūryamukhaniḥsṛtam ।
pūjayāmāsa deveśaṃ taccheṣeṇa pitāmahān ॥19॥
slp1: sAtvataM viDimAsTAya prAksUryamuKaniHsftam । pUjayAmAsa deveSaM tacCezeRa pitAmahAn ॥19॥

text: pitṛśeṣeṇa viprāṃśca saṃvibhajyāśritāṃśca saḥ । śeṣānnabhuksatyaparaḥ sarvabhūteṣvahiṃsakaḥ । sarvabhāvena bhaktaḥ sa devadevaṃ janārdanam ॥20॥
html:
pitṛśeṣeṇa viprāṃśca saṃvibhajyāśritāṃśca saḥ ।
śeṣānnabhuksatyaparaḥ sarvabhūteṣvahiṃsakaḥ ।
sarvabhāvena bhaktaḥ sa devadevaṃ janārdanam ॥20॥
slp1: pitfSezeRa viprAMSca saMviBajyASritAMSca saH । SezAnnaBuksatyaparaH sarvaBUtezvahiMsakaH । sarvaBAvena BaktaH sa devadevaM janArdanam ॥20॥

text: tasya nārāyaṇe bhaktiṃ vahato'mitrakarśana । ekaśayyāsanaṃ śakro dattavāndevarāṭsvayam ॥21॥
html:
tasya nārāyaṇe bhaktiṃ vahato'mitrakarśana ।
ekaśayyāsanaṃ śakro dattavāndevarāṭsvayam ॥21॥
slp1: tasya nArAyaRe BaktiM vahato'mitrakarSana । ekaSayyAsanaM Sakro dattavAndevarAwsvayam ॥21॥

text: ātmā rājyaṃ dhanaṃ caiva kalatraṃ vāhanāni ca । etadbhagavate sarvamiti tatprekṣitaṃ sadā ॥22॥
html:
ātmā rājyaṃ dhanaṃ caiva kalatraṃ vāhanāni ca ।
etadbhagavate sarvamiti tatprekṣitaṃ sadā ॥22॥
slp1: AtmA rAjyaM DanaM cEva kalatraM vAhanAni ca । etadBagavate sarvamiti tatprekzitaM sadA ॥22॥

text: kāmyanaimittikājasraṃ yajñiyāḥ paramakriyāḥ । sarvāḥ sātvatamāsthāya vidhiṃ cakre samāhitaḥ ॥23॥
html:
kāmyanaimittikājasraṃ yajñiyāḥ paramakriyāḥ ।
sarvāḥ sātvatamāsthāya vidhiṃ cakre samāhitaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: kAmyanEmittikAjasraM yajYiyAH paramakriyAH । sarvAH sAtvatamAsTAya viDiM cakre samAhitaH ॥23॥

text: pañcarātravido mukhyāstasya gehe mahātmanaḥ । prāyaṇaṃ bhagavatproktaṃ bhuñjate cāgrabhojanam ॥24॥
html:
pañcarātravido mukhyāstasya gehe mahātmanaḥ ।
prāyaṇaṃ bhagavatproktaṃ bhuñjate cāgrabhojanam ॥24॥
slp1: paYcarAtravido muKyAstasya gehe mahAtmanaH । prAyaRaM BagavatproktaM BuYjate cAgraBojanam ॥24॥

text: tasya praśāsato rājyaṃ dharmeṇāmitraghātinaḥ । nānṛtā vāksamabhavanmano duṣṭaṃ na cābhavat । na ca kāyena kṛtavānsa pāpaṃ paramaṇvapi ॥25॥
html:
tasya praśāsato rājyaṃ dharmeṇāmitraghātinaḥ ।
nānṛtā vāksamabhavanmano duṣṭaṃ na cābhavat ।
na ca kāyena kṛtavānsa pāpaṃ paramaṇvapi ॥25॥
slp1: tasya praSAsato rAjyaM DarmeRAmitraGAtinaH । nAnftA vAksamaBavanmano duzwaM na cABavat । na ca kAyena kftavAnsa pApaM paramaRvapi ॥25॥

text: ye hi te munayaḥ khyātāḥ sapta citraśikhaṇḍinaḥ । tairekamatibhirbhūtvā yatproktaṃ śāstramuttamam ॥26॥
html:
ye hi te munayaḥ khyātāḥ sapta citraśikhaṇḍinaḥ ।
tairekamatibhirbhūtvā yatproktaṃ śāstramuttamam ॥26॥
slp1: ye hi te munayaH KyAtAH sapta citraSiKaRqinaH । tErekamatiBirBUtvA yatproktaM SAstramuttamam ॥26॥

text: marīciratryaṅgirasau pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ । vasiṣṭhaśca mahātejā ete citraśikhaṇḍinaḥ ॥27॥
html:
marīciratryaṅgirasau pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ ।
vasiṣṭhaśca mahātejā ete citraśikhaṇḍinaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: marIciratryaNgirasO pulastyaH pulahaH kratuH । vasizWaSca mahAtejA ete citraSiKaRqinaH ॥27॥

text: sapta prakṛtayo hyetāstathā svāyambhuvo'ṣṭamaḥ । etābhirdhāryate lokastābhyaḥ śāstraṃ viniḥsṛtam ॥28॥
html:
sapta prakṛtayo hyetāstathā svāyambhuvo'ṣṭamaḥ ।
etābhirdhāryate lokastābhyaḥ śāstraṃ viniḥsṛtam ॥28॥
slp1: sapta prakftayo hyetAstaTA svAyamBuvo'zwamaH । etABirDAryate lokastAByaH SAstraM viniHsftam ॥28॥

text: ekāgramanaso dāntā munayaḥ saṃyame ratāḥ । idaṃ śreya idaṃ brahma idaṃ hitamanuttamam । lokānsañcintya manasā tataḥ śāstraṃ pracakrire ॥29॥
html:
ekāgramanaso dāntā munayaḥ saṃyame ratāḥ ।
idaṃ śreya idaṃ brahma idaṃ hitamanuttamam ।
lokānsañcintya manasā tataḥ śāstraṃ pracakrire ॥29॥
slp1: ekAgramanaso dAntA munayaH saMyame ratAH । idaM Sreya idaM brahma idaM hitamanuttamam । lokAnsaYcintya manasA tataH SAstraM pracakrire ॥29॥

text: tatra dharmārthakāmā hi mokṣaḥ paścācca kīrtitaḥ । maryādā vividhāścaiva divi bhūmau ca saṃsthitāḥ ॥30॥
html:
tatra dharmārthakāmā hi mokṣaḥ paścācca kīrtitaḥ ।
maryādā vividhāścaiva divi bhūmau ca saṃsthitāḥ ॥30॥
slp1: tatra DarmArTakAmA hi mokzaH paScAcca kIrtitaH । maryAdA viviDAScEva divi BUmO ca saMsTitAH ॥30॥

text: ārādhya tapasā devaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum । divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ vai sarve te ṛṣibhiḥ saha ॥31॥
html:
ārādhya tapasā devaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ vai sarve te ṛṣibhiḥ saha ॥31॥
slp1: ArADya tapasA devaM hariM nArAyaRaM praBum । divyaM varzasahasraM vE sarve te fziBiH saha ॥31॥

text: nārāyaṇānuśāstā hi tadā devī sarasvatī । viveśa tānṛṣīnsarvāṁllokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ॥32॥
html:
nārāyaṇānuśāstā hi tadā devī sarasvatī ।
viveśa tānṛṣīnsarvāṁllokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ॥32॥
slp1: nArAyaRAnuSAstA hi tadA devI sarasvatI । viveSa tAnfzInsarvAṁllokAnAM hitakAmyayA ॥32॥

text: tataḥ pravartitā samyaktapovidbhirdvijātibhiḥ । śabde cārthe ca hetau ca eṣā prathamasargajā ॥33॥
html:
tataḥ pravartitā samyaktapovidbhirdvijātibhiḥ ।
śabde cārthe ca hetau ca eṣā prathamasargajā ॥33॥
slp1: tataH pravartitA samyaktapovidBirdvijAtiBiH । Sabde cArTe ca hetO ca ezA praTamasargajA ॥33॥

text: ādāveva hi tacchāstramoṅkārasvarabhūṣitam । ṛṣibhirbhāvitaṃ tatra yatra kāruṇiko hyasau ॥34॥
html:
ādāveva hi tacchāstramoṅkārasvarabhūṣitam ।
ṛṣibhirbhāvitaṃ tatra yatra kāruṇiko hyasau ॥34॥
slp1: AdAveva hi tacCAstramoNkArasvaraBUzitam । fziBirBAvitaM tatra yatra kAruRiko hyasO ॥34॥

text: tataḥ prasanno bhagavānanirdiṣṭaśarīragaḥ । ṛṣīnuvāca tānsarvānadṛśyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥35॥
html:
tataḥ prasanno bhagavānanirdiṣṭaśarīragaḥ ।
ṛṣīnuvāca tānsarvānadṛśyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: tataH prasanno BagavAnanirdizwaSarIragaH । fzInuvAca tAnsarvAnadfSyaH puruzottamaH ॥35॥

text: kṛtaṃ śatasahasraṃ hi ślokānāmidamuttamam । lokatantrasya kṛtsnasya yasmāddharmaḥ pravartate ॥36॥
html:
kṛtaṃ śatasahasraṃ hi ślokānāmidamuttamam ।
lokatantrasya kṛtsnasya yasmāddharmaḥ pravartate ॥36॥
slp1: kftaM SatasahasraM hi SlokAnAmidamuttamam । lokatantrasya kftsnasya yasmAdDarmaH pravartate ॥36॥

text: pravṛttau ca nivṛttau ca yoniretadbhaviṣyati । ṛgyajuḥsāmabhirjuṣṭamatharvāṅgirasaistathā ॥37॥
html:
pravṛttau ca nivṛttau ca yoniretadbhaviṣyati ।
ṛgyajuḥsāmabhirjuṣṭamatharvāṅgirasaistathā ॥37॥
slp1: pravfttO ca nivfttO ca yoniretadBavizyati । fgyajuHsAmaBirjuzwamaTarvANgirasEstaTA ॥37॥

text: tathā pramāṇaṃ hi mayā kṛto brahmā prasādajaḥ । rudraśca krodhajo viprā yūyaṃ prakṛtayastathā ॥38॥
html:
tathā pramāṇaṃ hi mayā kṛto brahmā prasādajaḥ ।
rudraśca krodhajo viprā yūyaṃ prakṛtayastathā ॥38॥
slp1: taTA pramARaM hi mayA kfto brahmA prasAdajaH । rudraSca kroDajo viprA yUyaM prakftayastaTA ॥38॥

text: sūryācandramasau vāyurbhūmirāpo'gnireva ca । sarve ca nakṣatragaṇā yacca bhūtābhiśabditam ॥39॥
html:
sūryācandramasau vāyurbhūmirāpo'gnireva ca ।
sarve ca nakṣatragaṇā yacca bhūtābhiśabditam ॥39॥
slp1: sUryAcandramasO vAyurBUmirApo'gnireva ca । sarve ca nakzatragaRA yacca BUtABiSabditam ॥39॥

text: adhikāreṣu vartante yathāsvaṃ brahmavādinaḥ । sarve pramāṇaṃ hi yathā tathaitacchāstramuttamam ॥40॥
html:
adhikāreṣu vartante yathāsvaṃ brahmavādinaḥ ।
sarve pramāṇaṃ hi yathā tathaitacchāstramuttamam ॥40॥
slp1: aDikArezu vartante yaTAsvaM brahmavAdinaH । sarve pramARaM hi yaTA taTEtacCAstramuttamam ॥40॥

text: bhaviṣyati pramāṇaṃ vai etanmadanuśāsanam । asmātpravakṣyate dharmānmanuḥ svāyambhuvaḥ svayam ॥41॥
html:
bhaviṣyati pramāṇaṃ vai etanmadanuśāsanam ।
asmātpravakṣyate dharmānmanuḥ svāyambhuvaḥ svayam ॥41॥
slp1: Bavizyati pramARaM vE etanmadanuSAsanam । asmAtpravakzyate DarmAnmanuH svAyamBuvaH svayam ॥41॥

text: uśanā bṛhaspatiścaiva yadotpannau bhaviṣyataḥ । tadā pravakṣyataḥ śāstraṃ yuṣmanmatibhiruddhṛtam ॥42॥
html:
uśanā bṛhaspatiścaiva yadotpannau bhaviṣyataḥ ।
tadā pravakṣyataḥ śāstraṃ yuṣmanmatibhiruddhṛtam ॥42॥
slp1: uSanA bfhaspatiScEva yadotpannO BavizyataH । tadA pravakzyataH SAstraM yuzmanmatiBirudDftam ॥42॥

text: svāyambhuveṣu dharmeṣu śāstre cośanasā kṛte । bṛhaspatimate caiva lokeṣu pravicārite ॥43॥
html:
svāyambhuveṣu dharmeṣu śāstre cośanasā kṛte ।
bṛhaspatimate caiva lokeṣu pravicārite ॥43॥
slp1: svAyamBuvezu Darmezu SAstre coSanasA kfte । bfhaspatimate cEva lokezu pravicArite ॥43॥

text: yuṣmatkṛtamidaṃ śāstraṃ prajāpālo vasustataḥ । bṛhaspatisakāśādvai prāpsyate dvijasattamāḥ ॥44॥
html:
yuṣmatkṛtamidaṃ śāstraṃ prajāpālo vasustataḥ ।
bṛhaspatisakāśādvai prāpsyate dvijasattamāḥ ॥44॥
slp1: yuzmatkftamidaM SAstraM prajApAlo vasustataH । bfhaspatisakASAdvE prApsyate dvijasattamAH ॥44॥

text: sa hi madbhāvito rājā madbhaktaśca bhaviṣyati । tena śāstreṇa lokeṣu kriyāḥ sarvāḥ kariṣyati ॥45॥
html:
sa hi madbhāvito rājā madbhaktaśca bhaviṣyati ।
tena śāstreṇa lokeṣu kriyāḥ sarvāḥ kariṣyati ॥45॥
slp1: sa hi madBAvito rAjA madBaktaSca Bavizyati । tena SAstreRa lokezu kriyAH sarvAH karizyati ॥45॥

text: etaddhi sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ śāstramuttamasañjñitam । etadarthyaṃ ca dharmyaṃ ca yaśasyaṃ caitaduttamam ॥46॥
html:
etaddhi sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ śāstramuttamasañjñitam ।
etadarthyaṃ ca dharmyaṃ ca yaśasyaṃ caitaduttamam ॥46॥
slp1: etadDi sarvaSAstrARAM SAstramuttamasaYjYitam । etadarTyaM ca DarmyaM ca yaSasyaM cEtaduttamam ॥46॥

text: asya pravartanāccaiva prajāvanto bhaviṣyatha । sa ca rājā śriyā yukto bhaviṣyati mahānvasuḥ ॥47॥
html:
asya pravartanāccaiva prajāvanto bhaviṣyatha ।
sa ca rājā śriyā yukto bhaviṣyati mahānvasuḥ ॥47॥
slp1: asya pravartanAccEva prajAvanto BavizyaTa । sa ca rAjA SriyA yukto Bavizyati mahAnvasuH ॥47॥

text: saṃsthite tu nṛpe tasmiñśāstrametatsanātanam । antardhāsyati tatsatyametadvaḥ kathitaṃ mayā ॥48॥
html:
saṃsthite tu nṛpe tasmiñśāstrametatsanātanam ।
antardhāsyati tatsatyametadvaḥ kathitaṃ mayā ॥48॥
slp1: saMsTite tu nfpe tasmiYSAstrametatsanAtanam । antarDAsyati tatsatyametadvaH kaTitaM mayA ॥48॥

text: etāvaduktvā vacanamadṛśyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ । visṛjya tānṛṣīnsarvānkāmapi prasthito diśam ॥49॥
html:
etāvaduktvā vacanamadṛśyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
visṛjya tānṛṣīnsarvānkāmapi prasthito diśam ॥49॥
slp1: etAvaduktvA vacanamadfSyaH puruzottamaH । visfjya tAnfzInsarvAnkAmapi prasTito diSam ॥49॥

text: tataste lokapitaraḥ sarvalokārthacintakāḥ । prāvartayanta tacchāstraṃ dharmayoniṃ sanātanam ॥50॥
html:
tataste lokapitaraḥ sarvalokārthacintakāḥ ।
prāvartayanta tacchāstraṃ dharmayoniṃ sanātanam ॥50॥
slp1: tataste lokapitaraH sarvalokArTacintakAH । prAvartayanta tacCAstraM DarmayoniM sanAtanam ॥50॥

text: utpanne''ṅgirase caiva yuge prathamakalpite । sāṅgopaniṣadaṃ śāstraṃ sthāpayitvā bṛhaspatau ॥51॥
html:
utpanne''ṅgirase caiva yuge prathamakalpite ।
sāṅgopaniṣadaṃ śāstraṃ sthāpayitvā bṛhaspatau ॥51॥
slp1: utpanne''Ngirase cEva yuge praTamakalpite । sANgopanizadaM SAstraM sTApayitvA bfhaspatO ॥51॥

text: jagmuryathepsitaṃ deśaṃ tapase kṛtaniścayāḥ । dhāraṇātsarvalokānāṃ sarvadharmapravartakāḥ] ॥52॥
html:
jagmuryathepsitaṃ deśaṃ tapase kṛtaniścayāḥ ।
dhāraṇātsarvalokānāṃ sarvadharmapravartakāḥ] ॥52॥
slp1: jagmuryaTepsitaM deSaM tapase kftaniScayAH । DAraRAtsarvalokAnAM sarvaDarmapravartakAH] ॥52॥

text: tato'tīte mahākalpe utpanne'ṅgirasaḥ sute । babhūvurnirvṛtā devā jāte devapurohite ॥1॥
html:
tato'tīte mahākalpe utpanne'ṅgirasaḥ sute ।
babhūvurnirvṛtā devā jāte devapurohite ॥1॥
slp1: tato'tIte mahAkalpe utpanne'NgirasaH sute । baBUvurnirvftA devA jAte devapurohite ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: bṛhadbrahma mahacceti śabdāḥ paryāyavācakāḥ । ebhiḥ samanvito rājanguṇairvidvānbṛhaspatiḥ ॥2॥
html:
bṛhadbrahma mahacceti śabdāḥ paryāyavācakāḥ ।
ebhiḥ samanvito rājanguṇairvidvānbṛhaspatiḥ ॥2॥
slp1: bfhadbrahma mahacceti SabdAH paryAyavAcakAH । eBiH samanvito rAjanguRErvidvAnbfhaspatiH ॥2॥

text: tasya śiṣyo babhūvāgryo rājoparicaro vasuḥ । adhītavāṃstadā śāstraṃ samyakcitraśikhaṇḍijam ॥3॥
html:
tasya śiṣyo babhūvāgryo rājoparicaro vasuḥ ।
adhītavāṃstadā śāstraṃ samyakcitraśikhaṇḍijam ॥3॥
slp1: tasya Sizyo baBUvAgryo rAjoparicaro vasuH । aDItavAMstadA SAstraM samyakcitraSiKaRqijam ॥3॥

text: sa rājā bhāvitaḥ pūrvaṃ daivena vidhinā vasuḥ । pālayāmāsa pṛthivīṃ divamākhaṇḍalo yathā ॥4॥
html:
sa rājā bhāvitaḥ pūrvaṃ daivena vidhinā vasuḥ ।
pālayāmāsa pṛthivīṃ divamākhaṇḍalo yathā ॥4॥
slp1: sa rAjA BAvitaH pUrvaM dEvena viDinA vasuH । pAlayAmAsa pfTivIM divamAKaRqalo yaTA ॥4॥

text: tasya yajño mahānāsīdaśvamedho mahātmanaḥ । bṛhaspatirupādhyāyastatra hotā babhūva ha ॥5॥
html:
tasya yajño mahānāsīdaśvamedho mahātmanaḥ ।
bṛhaspatirupādhyāyastatra hotā babhūva ha ॥5॥
slp1: tasya yajYo mahAnAsIdaSvameDo mahAtmanaH । bfhaspatirupADyAyastatra hotA baBUva ha ॥5॥

text: prajāpatisutāścātra sadasyāstvabhavaṃstrayaḥ । ekataśca dvitaścaiva tritaścaiva maharṣayaḥ ॥6॥
html:
prajāpatisutāścātra sadasyāstvabhavaṃstrayaḥ ।
ekataśca dvitaścaiva tritaścaiva maharṣayaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: prajApatisutAScAtra sadasyAstvaBavaMstrayaH । ekataSca dvitaScEva tritaScEva maharzayaH ॥6॥

text: dhanuṣākṣo'tha raibhyaśca arvāvasuparāvasū । ṛṣirmedhātithiścaiva tāṇḍyaścaiva mahānṛṣiḥ ॥7॥
html:
dhanuṣākṣo'tha raibhyaśca arvāvasuparāvasū ।
ṛṣirmedhātithiścaiva tāṇḍyaścaiva mahānṛṣiḥ ॥7॥
slp1: DanuzAkzo'Ta rEByaSca arvAvasuparAvasU । fzirmeDAtiTiScEva tARqyaScEva mahAnfziH ॥7॥

text: ṛṣiḥ śaktirmahābhāgastathā vedaśirāśca yaḥ । kapilaśca ṛṣiśreṣṭhaḥ śālihotrapitāmahaḥ ॥8॥
html:
ṛṣiḥ śaktirmahābhāgastathā vedaśirāśca yaḥ ।
kapilaśca ṛṣiśreṣṭhaḥ śālihotrapitāmahaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: fziH SaktirmahABAgastaTA vedaSirASca yaH । kapilaSca fziSrezWaH SAlihotrapitAmahaH ॥8॥

text: ādyaḥ kaṭhastaittiriśca vaiśampāyanapūrvajaḥ । kaṇvo'tha devahotraśca ete ṣoḍaśa kīrtitāḥ । sambhṛtāḥ sarvasambhārāstasminrājanmahākratau ॥9॥
html:
ādyaḥ kaṭhastaittiriśca vaiśampāyanapūrvajaḥ ।
kaṇvo'tha devahotraśca ete ṣoḍaśa kīrtitāḥ ।
sambhṛtāḥ sarvasambhārāstasminrājanmahākratau ॥9॥
slp1: AdyaH kaWastEttiriSca vESampAyanapUrvajaH । kaRvo'Ta devahotraSca ete zoqaSa kIrtitAH । samBftAH sarvasamBArAstasminrAjanmahAkratO ॥9॥

text: na tatra paśughāto'bhūtsa rājaivaṃ sthito'bhavat । ahiṃsraḥ śucirakṣudro nirāśīḥ karmasaṃstutaḥ । āraṇyakapadodgītā bhāgāstatropakalpitāḥ ॥10॥
html:
na tatra paśughāto'bhūtsa rājaivaṃ sthito'bhavat ।
ahiṃsraḥ śucirakṣudro nirāśīḥ karmasaṃstutaḥ ।
āraṇyakapadodgītā bhāgāstatropakalpitāḥ ॥10॥
slp1: na tatra paSuGAto'BUtsa rAjEvaM sTito'Bavat । ahiMsraH Sucirakzudro nirASIH karmasaMstutaH । AraRyakapadodgItA BAgAstatropakalpitAH ॥10॥

text: prītastato'sya bhagavāndevadevaḥ purātanaḥ । sākṣāttaṃ darśayāmāsa so'dṛśyo'nyena kenacit ॥11॥
html:
prītastato'sya bhagavāndevadevaḥ purātanaḥ ।
sākṣāttaṃ darśayāmāsa so'dṛśyo'nyena kenacit ॥11॥
slp1: prItastato'sya BagavAndevadevaH purAtanaH । sAkzAttaM darSayAmAsa so'dfSyo'nyena kenacit ॥11॥

text: svayaṃ bhāgamupāghrāya puroḍāśaṃ gṛhītavān । adṛśyena hṛto bhāgo devena harimedhasā ॥12॥
html:
svayaṃ bhāgamupāghrāya puroḍāśaṃ gṛhītavān ।
adṛśyena hṛto bhāgo devena harimedhasā ॥12॥
slp1: svayaM BAgamupAGrAya puroqASaM gfhItavAn । adfSyena hfto BAgo devena harimeDasA ॥12॥

text: bṛhaspatistataḥ kruddhaḥ sruvamudyamya vegitaḥ । ākāśaṃ ghnansruvaḥ pātai roṣādaśrūṇyavartayat ॥13॥
html:
bṛhaspatistataḥ kruddhaḥ sruvamudyamya vegitaḥ ।
ākāśaṃ ghnansruvaḥ pātai roṣādaśrūṇyavartayat ॥13॥
slp1: bfhaspatistataH krudDaH sruvamudyamya vegitaH । AkASaM GnansruvaH pAtE rozAdaSrURyavartayat ॥13॥

text: uvāca coparicaraṃ mayā bhāgo'yamudyataḥ । grāhyaḥ svayaṃ hi devena matpratyakṣaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ॥14॥
html:
uvāca coparicaraṃ mayā bhāgo'yamudyataḥ ।
grāhyaḥ svayaṃ hi devena matpratyakṣaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: uvAca coparicaraM mayA BAgo'yamudyataH । grAhyaH svayaM hi devena matpratyakzaM na saMSayaH ॥14॥

text: udyatā yajñabhāgā hi sākṣātprāptāḥ surairiha । kimarthamiha na prāpto darśanaṃ sa harirvibhuḥ ॥15॥
html:
udyatā yajñabhāgā hi sākṣātprāptāḥ surairiha ।
kimarthamiha na prāpto darśanaṃ sa harirvibhuḥ ॥15॥
slp1: udyatA yajYaBAgA hi sAkzAtprAptAH surEriha । kimarTamiha na prApto darSanaM sa harirviBuH ॥15॥

text: tataḥ sa taṃ samuddhūtaṃ bhūmipālo mahānvasuḥ । prasādayāmāsa muniṃ sadasyāste ca sarvaśaḥ ॥16॥
html:
tataḥ sa taṃ samuddhūtaṃ bhūmipālo mahānvasuḥ ।
prasādayāmāsa muniṃ sadasyāste ca sarvaśaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: tataH sa taM samudDUtaM BUmipAlo mahAnvasuH । prasAdayAmAsa muniM sadasyAste ca sarvaSaH ॥16॥

text: ūcuścainamasambhrāntā na roṣaṃ kartumarhasi । naiṣa dharmaḥ kṛtayuge yastvaṃ roṣamacīkṛthāḥ ॥17॥
html:
ūcuścainamasambhrāntā na roṣaṃ kartumarhasi ।
naiṣa dharmaḥ kṛtayuge yastvaṃ roṣamacīkṛthāḥ ॥17॥
slp1: UcuScEnamasamBrAntA na rozaM kartumarhasi । nEza DarmaH kftayuge yastvaM rozamacIkfTAH ॥17॥

text: aroṣaṇo hyasau devo yasya bhāgo'yamudyataḥ । na sa śakyastvayā draṣṭumasmābhirvā bṛhaspate । yasya prasādaṃ kurute sa vai taṃ draṣṭumarhati ॥18॥
html:
aroṣaṇo hyasau devo yasya bhāgo'yamudyataḥ ।
na sa śakyastvayā draṣṭumasmābhirvā bṛhaspate ।
yasya prasādaṃ kurute sa vai taṃ draṣṭumarhati ॥18॥
slp1: arozaRo hyasO devo yasya BAgo'yamudyataH । na sa SakyastvayA drazwumasmABirvA bfhaspate । yasya prasAdaM kurute sa vE taM drazwumarhati ॥18॥

text: vayaṃ hi brahmaṇaḥ putrā mānasāḥ parikīrtitāḥ । gatā niḥśreyasārthaṃ hi kadāciddiśamuttarām ॥19॥
html:
vayaṃ hi brahmaṇaḥ putrā mānasāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ।
gatā niḥśreyasārthaṃ hi kadāciddiśamuttarām ॥19॥
slp1: vayaM hi brahmaRaH putrA mAnasAH parikIrtitAH । gatA niHSreyasArTaM hi kadAciddiSamuttarAm ॥19॥
author: ekatadvitatritā ūcuḥ ।

text: taptvā varṣasahasrāṇi catvāri tapa uttamam । ekapādasthitāḥ samyakkāṣṭhabhūtāḥ samāhitāḥ ॥20॥
html:
taptvā varṣasahasrāṇi catvāri tapa uttamam ।
ekapādasthitāḥ samyakkāṣṭhabhūtāḥ samāhitāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: taptvA varzasahasrARi catvAri tapa uttamam । ekapAdasTitAH samyakkAzWaBUtAH samAhitAH ॥20॥

text: meroruttarabhāge tu kṣīrodasyānukūlataḥ । sa deśo yatra nastaptaṃ tapaḥ paramadāruṇam । kathaṃ paśyemahi vayaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tviti ॥21॥
html:
meroruttarabhāge tu kṣīrodasyānukūlataḥ ।
sa deśo yatra nastaptaṃ tapaḥ paramadāruṇam ।
kathaṃ paśyemahi vayaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tviti ॥21॥
slp1: meroruttaraBAge tu kzIrodasyAnukUlataH । sa deSo yatra nastaptaM tapaH paramadAruRam । kaTaM paSyemahi vayaM devaM nArAyaRaM tviti ॥21॥

text: tato vratasyāvabhṛthe vāguvācāśarīriṇī । sutaptaṃ vastapo viprāḥ prasannenāntarātmanā ॥22॥
html:
tato vratasyāvabhṛthe vāguvācāśarīriṇī ।
sutaptaṃ vastapo viprāḥ prasannenāntarātmanā ॥22॥
slp1: tato vratasyAvaBfTe vAguvAcASarIriRI । sutaptaM vastapo viprAH prasannenAntarAtmanA ॥22॥

text: yūyaṃ jijñāsavo bhaktāḥ kathaṃ drakṣyatha taṃ prabhum । kṣīrodadheruttarataḥ śvetadvīpo mahāprabhaḥ ॥23॥
html:
yūyaṃ jijñāsavo bhaktāḥ kathaṃ drakṣyatha taṃ prabhum ।
kṣīrodadheruttarataḥ śvetadvīpo mahāprabhaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: yUyaM jijYAsavo BaktAH kaTaM drakzyaTa taM praBum । kzIrodaDeruttarataH SvetadvIpo mahApraBaH ॥23॥

text: tatra nārāyaṇaparā mānavāścandravarcasaḥ । ekāntabhāvopagatāste bhaktāḥ puruṣottamam ॥24॥
html:
tatra nārāyaṇaparā mānavāścandravarcasaḥ ।
ekāntabhāvopagatāste bhaktāḥ puruṣottamam ॥24॥
slp1: tatra nArAyaRaparA mAnavAScandravarcasaH । ekAntaBAvopagatAste BaktAH puruzottamam ॥24॥

text: te sahasrārciṣaṃ devaṃ praviśanti sanātanam । atīndriyā nirāhārā aniṣpandāḥ sugandhinaḥ ॥25॥
html:
te sahasrārciṣaṃ devaṃ praviśanti sanātanam ।
atīndriyā nirāhārā aniṣpandāḥ sugandhinaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: te sahasrArcizaM devaM praviSanti sanAtanam । atIndriyA nirAhArA anizpandAH suganDinaH ॥25॥

text: ekāntinaste puruṣāḥ śvetadvīpanivāsinaḥ । gacchadhvaṃ tatra munayastatrātmā me prakāśitaḥ ॥26॥
html:
ekāntinaste puruṣāḥ śvetadvīpanivāsinaḥ ।
gacchadhvaṃ tatra munayastatrātmā me prakāśitaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: ekAntinaste puruzAH SvetadvIpanivAsinaH । gacCaDvaM tatra munayastatrAtmA me prakASitaH ॥26॥

text: atha śrutvā vayaṃ sarve vācaṃ tāmaśarīriṇīm । yathākhyātena mārgeṇa taṃ deśaṃ pratipedire ॥27॥
html:
atha śrutvā vayaṃ sarve vācaṃ tāmaśarīriṇīm ।
yathākhyātena mārgeṇa taṃ deśaṃ pratipedire ॥27॥
slp1: aTa SrutvA vayaM sarve vAcaM tAmaSarIriRIm । yaTAKyAtena mArgeRa taM deSaM pratipedire ॥27॥

text: prāpya śvetaṃ mahādvīpaṃ taccittāstaddidṛkṣavaḥ । tato no dṛṣṭiviṣayastadā pratihato'bhavat ॥28॥
html:
prāpya śvetaṃ mahādvīpaṃ taccittāstaddidṛkṣavaḥ ।
tato no dṛṣṭiviṣayastadā pratihato'bhavat ॥28॥
slp1: prApya SvetaM mahAdvIpaM taccittAstaddidfkzavaH । tato no dfzwivizayastadA pratihato'Bavat ॥28॥

text: na ca paśyāma puruṣaṃ tattejohṛtadarśanāḥ । tato naḥ prādurabhavadvijñānaṃ devayogajam ॥29॥
html:
na ca paśyāma puruṣaṃ tattejohṛtadarśanāḥ ।
tato naḥ prādurabhavadvijñānaṃ devayogajam ॥29॥
slp1: na ca paSyAma puruzaM tattejohftadarSanAH । tato naH prAduraBavadvijYAnaM devayogajam ॥29॥

text: na kilātaptatapasā śakyate draṣṭumañjasā । tataḥ punarvarṣaśataṃ taptvā tātkālikaṃ mahat ॥30॥
html:
na kilātaptatapasā śakyate draṣṭumañjasā ।
tataḥ punarvarṣaśataṃ taptvā tātkālikaṃ mahat ॥30॥
slp1: na kilAtaptatapasA Sakyate drazwumaYjasA । tataH punarvarzaSataM taptvA tAtkAlikaM mahat ॥30॥

text: vratāvasāne suśubhānnarāndadṛśire vayam । śvetāṃścandrapratīkāśānsarvalakṣaṇalakṣitān ॥31॥
html:
vratāvasāne suśubhānnarāndadṛśire vayam ।
śvetāṃścandrapratīkāśānsarvalakṣaṇalakṣitān ॥31॥
slp1: vratAvasAne suSuBAnnarAndadfSire vayam । SvetAMScandrapratIkASAnsarvalakzaRalakzitAn ॥31॥

text: nityāñjalikṛtānbrahma japataḥ prāgudaṅmukhān । mānaso nāma sa japo japyate tairmahātmabhiḥ । tenaikāgramanastvena prīto bhavati vai hariḥ ॥32॥
html:
nityāñjalikṛtānbrahma japataḥ prāgudaṅmukhān ।
mānaso nāma sa japo japyate tairmahātmabhiḥ ।
tenaikāgramanastvena prīto bhavati vai hariḥ ॥32॥
slp1: nityAYjalikftAnbrahma japataH prAgudaNmuKAn । mAnaso nAma sa japo japyate tErmahAtmaBiH । tenEkAgramanastvena prIto Bavati vE hariH ॥32॥

text: yā bhavenmuniśārdūla bhāḥ sūryasya yugakṣaye । ekaikasya prabhā tādṛksābhavanmānavasya ha ॥33॥
html:
yā bhavenmuniśārdūla bhāḥ sūryasya yugakṣaye ।
ekaikasya prabhā tādṛksābhavanmānavasya ha ॥33॥
slp1: yA BavenmuniSArdUla BAH sUryasya yugakzaye । ekEkasya praBA tAdfksABavanmAnavasya ha ॥33॥

text: tejonivāsaḥ sa dvīpa iti vai menire vayam । na tatrābhyadhikaḥ kaścitsarve te samatejasaḥ ॥34॥
html:
tejonivāsaḥ sa dvīpa iti vai menire vayam ।
na tatrābhyadhikaḥ kaścitsarve te samatejasaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: tejonivAsaH sa dvIpa iti vE menire vayam । na tatrAByaDikaH kaScitsarve te samatejasaH ॥34॥

text: atha sūryasahasrasya prabhāṃ yugapadutthitām । sahasā dṛṣṭavantaḥ sma punareva bṛhaspate ॥35॥
html:
atha sūryasahasrasya prabhāṃ yugapadutthitām ।
sahasā dṛṣṭavantaḥ sma punareva bṛhaspate ॥35॥
slp1: aTa sUryasahasrasya praBAM yugapadutTitAm । sahasA dfzwavantaH sma punareva bfhaspate ॥35॥

text: sahitāścābhyadhāvanta tataste mānavā drutam । kṛtāñjalipuṭā hṛṣṭā nama ityeva vādinaḥ ॥36॥
html:
sahitāścābhyadhāvanta tataste mānavā drutam ।
kṛtāñjalipuṭā hṛṣṭā nama ityeva vādinaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: sahitAScAByaDAvanta tataste mAnavA drutam । kftAYjalipuwA hfzwA nama ityeva vAdinaH ॥36॥

text: tato'bhivadatāṃ teṣāmaśrauṣma vipulaṃ dhvanim । baliḥ kilopahriyate tasya devasya tairnaraiḥ ॥37॥
html:
tato'bhivadatāṃ teṣāmaśrauṣma vipulaṃ dhvanim ।
baliḥ kilopahriyate tasya devasya tairnaraiḥ ॥37॥
slp1: tato'BivadatAM tezAmaSrOzma vipulaM Dvanim । baliH kilopahriyate tasya devasya tErnarEH ॥37॥

text: vayaṃ tu tejasā tasya sahasā hṛtacetasaḥ । na kiñcidapi paśyāmo hṛtadṛṣṭibalendriyāḥ ॥38॥
html:
vayaṃ tu tejasā tasya sahasā hṛtacetasaḥ ।
na kiñcidapi paśyāmo hṛtadṛṣṭibalendriyāḥ ॥38॥
slp1: vayaM tu tejasA tasya sahasA hftacetasaH । na kiYcidapi paSyAmo hftadfzwibalendriyAH ॥38॥

text: ekastu śabdo'virataḥ śruto'smābhirudīritaḥ । jitaṃ te puṇḍarīkākṣa namaste viśvabhāvana ॥39॥
html:
ekastu śabdo'virataḥ śruto'smābhirudīritaḥ ।
jitaṃ te puṇḍarīkākṣa namaste viśvabhāvana ॥39॥
slp1: ekastu Sabdo'virataH Sruto'smABirudIritaH । jitaM te puRqarIkAkza namaste viSvaBAvana ॥39॥

text: namaste'stu hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣapūrvaja । iti śabdaḥ śruto'smābhiḥ śikṣākṣarasamīritaḥ ॥40॥
html:
namaste'stu hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣapūrvaja ।
iti śabdaḥ śruto'smābhiḥ śikṣākṣarasamīritaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: namaste'stu hfzIkeSa mahApuruzapUrvaja । iti SabdaH Sruto'smABiH SikzAkzarasamIritaH ॥40॥

text: etasminnantare vāyuḥ sarvagandhavahaḥ śuciḥ । divyānyuvāha puṣpāṇi karmaṇyāścauṣadhīstathā ॥41॥
html:
etasminnantare vāyuḥ sarvagandhavahaḥ śuciḥ ।
divyānyuvāha puṣpāṇi karmaṇyāścauṣadhīstathā ॥41॥
slp1: etasminnantare vAyuH sarvaganDavahaH SuciH । divyAnyuvAha puzpARi karmaRyAScOzaDIstaTA ॥41॥

text: tairiṣṭaḥ pañcakālajñairharirekāntibhirnaraiḥ । nūnaṃ tatrāgato devo yathā tairvāgudīritā । vayaṃ tvenaṃ na paśyāmo mohitāstasya māyayā ॥42॥
html:
tairiṣṭaḥ pañcakālajñairharirekāntibhirnaraiḥ ।
nūnaṃ tatrāgato devo yathā tairvāgudīritā ।
vayaṃ tvenaṃ na paśyāmo mohitāstasya māyayā ॥42॥
slp1: tErizwaH paYcakAlajYErharirekAntiBirnarEH । nUnaM tatrAgato devo yaTA tErvAgudIritA । vayaM tvenaM na paSyAmo mohitAstasya mAyayA ॥42॥

text: mārute sannivṛtte ca balau ca pratipādite । cintāvyākulitātmāno jātāḥ smo'ṅgirasāṃ vara ॥43॥
html:
mārute sannivṛtte ca balau ca pratipādite ।
cintāvyākulitātmāno jātāḥ smo'ṅgirasāṃ vara ॥43॥
slp1: mArute sannivftte ca balO ca pratipAdite । cintAvyAkulitAtmAno jAtAH smo'NgirasAM vara ॥43॥

text: mānavānāṃ sahasreṣu teṣu vai śuddhayoniṣu । asmānna kaścinmanasā cakṣuṣā vāpyapūjayat ॥44॥
html:
mānavānāṃ sahasreṣu teṣu vai śuddhayoniṣu ।
asmānna kaścinmanasā cakṣuṣā vāpyapūjayat ॥44॥
slp1: mAnavAnAM sahasrezu tezu vE SudDayonizu । asmAnna kaScinmanasA cakzuzA vApyapUjayat ॥44॥

text: te'pi svasthā munigaṇā ekabhāvamanuvratāḥ । nāsmāsu dadhire bhāvaṃ brahmabhāvamanuṣṭhitāḥ ॥45॥
html:
te'pi svasthā munigaṇā ekabhāvamanuvratāḥ ।
nāsmāsu dadhire bhāvaṃ brahmabhāvamanuṣṭhitāḥ ॥45॥
slp1: te'pi svasTA munigaRA ekaBAvamanuvratAH । nAsmAsu daDire BAvaM brahmaBAvamanuzWitAH ॥45॥

text: tato'smānsupariśrāntāṃstapasā cāpi karśitān । uvāca khasthaṃ kimapi bhūtaṃ tatrāśarīrakam ॥46॥
html:
tato'smānsupariśrāntāṃstapasā cāpi karśitān ।
uvāca khasthaṃ kimapi bhūtaṃ tatrāśarīrakam ॥46॥
slp1: tato'smAnsupariSrAntAMstapasA cApi karSitAn । uvAca KasTaM kimapi BUtaM tatrASarIrakam ॥46॥

text: dṛṣṭā vaḥ puruṣāḥ śvetāḥ sarvendriyavivarjitāḥ । dṛṣṭo bhavati deveśa ebhirdṛṣṭairdvijottamāḥ ॥47॥
html:
dṛṣṭā vaḥ puruṣāḥ śvetāḥ sarvendriyavivarjitāḥ ।
dṛṣṭo bhavati deveśa ebhirdṛṣṭairdvijottamāḥ ॥47॥
slp1: dfzwA vaH puruzAH SvetAH sarvendriyavivarjitAH । dfzwo Bavati deveSa eBirdfzwErdvijottamAH ॥47॥

text: gacchadhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve yathāgatamito'cirāt । na sa śakyo abhaktena draṣṭuṃ devaḥ kathañcana ॥48॥
html:
gacchadhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve yathāgatamito'cirāt ।
na sa śakyo abhaktena draṣṭuṃ devaḥ kathañcana ॥48॥
slp1: gacCaDvaM munayaH sarve yaTAgatamito'cirAt । na sa Sakyo aBaktena drazwuM devaH kaTaYcana ॥48॥

text: kāmaṃ kālena mahatā ekāntitvaṃ samāgataiḥ । śakyo draṣṭuṃ sa bhagavānprabhāmaṇḍaladurdṛśaḥ ॥49॥
html:
kāmaṃ kālena mahatā ekāntitvaṃ samāgataiḥ ।
śakyo draṣṭuṃ sa bhagavānprabhāmaṇḍaladurdṛśaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: kAmaM kAlena mahatA ekAntitvaM samAgatEH । Sakyo drazwuM sa BagavAnpraBAmaRqaladurdfSaH ॥49॥

text: mahatkāryaṃ tu kartavyaṃ yuṣmābhirdvijasattamāḥ । itaḥ kṛtayuge'tīte viparyāsaṃ gate'pi ca ॥50॥
html:
mahatkāryaṃ tu kartavyaṃ yuṣmābhirdvijasattamāḥ ।
itaḥ kṛtayuge'tīte viparyāsaṃ gate'pi ca ॥50॥
slp1: mahatkAryaM tu kartavyaM yuzmABirdvijasattamAH । itaH kftayuge'tIte viparyAsaM gate'pi ca ॥50॥

text: vaivasvate'ntare viprāḥ prāpte tretāyuge tataḥ । surāṇāṃ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ sahāyā vai bhaviṣyatha ॥51॥
html:
vaivasvate'ntare viprāḥ prāpte tretāyuge tataḥ ।
surāṇāṃ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ sahāyā vai bhaviṣyatha ॥51॥
slp1: vEvasvate'ntare viprAH prApte tretAyuge tataH । surARAM kAryasidDyarTaM sahAyA vE BavizyaTa ॥51॥

text: tatastadadbhutaṃ vākyaṃ niśamyaivaṃ sma somapa । tasya prasādātprāptāḥ smo deśamīpsitamañjasā ॥52॥
html:
tatastadadbhutaṃ vākyaṃ niśamyaivaṃ sma somapa ।
tasya prasādātprāptāḥ smo deśamīpsitamañjasā ॥52॥
slp1: tatastadadButaM vAkyaM niSamyEvaM sma somapa । tasya prasAdAtprAptAH smo deSamIpsitamaYjasA ॥52॥

text: evaṃ sutapasā caiva havyakavyaistathaiva ca । devo'smābhirna dṛṣṭaḥ sa kathaṃ tvaṃ draṣṭumarhasi । nārāyaṇo mahadbhūtaṃ viśvasṛgghavyakavyabhuk ॥53॥
html:
evaṃ sutapasā caiva havyakavyaistathaiva ca ।
devo'smābhirna dṛṣṭaḥ sa kathaṃ tvaṃ draṣṭumarhasi ।
nārāyaṇo mahadbhūtaṃ viśvasṛgghavyakavyabhuk ॥53॥
slp1: evaM sutapasA cEva havyakavyEstaTEva ca । devo'smABirna dfzwaH sa kaTaM tvaM drazwumarhasi । nArAyaRo mahadBUtaM viSvasfgGavyakavyaBuk ॥53॥

text: evamekatavākyena dvitatritamatena ca । anunītaḥ sadasyaiśca bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ । samānīya tato yajñaṃ daivataṃ samapūjayat ॥54॥
html:
evamekatavākyena dvitatritamatena ca ।
anunītaḥ sadasyaiśca bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ ।
samānīya tato yajñaṃ daivataṃ samapūjayat ॥54॥
slp1: evamekatavAkyena dvitatritamatena ca । anunItaH sadasyESca bfhaspatirudAraDIH । samAnIya tato yajYaM dEvataM samapUjayat ॥54॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: samāptayajño rājāpi prajāḥ pālitavānvasuḥ । brahmaśāpāddivo bhraṣṭaḥ praviveśa mahīṃ tataḥ ॥55॥
html:
samāptayajño rājāpi prajāḥ pālitavānvasuḥ ।
brahmaśāpāddivo bhraṣṭaḥ praviveśa mahīṃ tataḥ ॥55॥
slp1: samAptayajYo rAjApi prajAH pAlitavAnvasuH । brahmaSApAddivo BrazwaH praviveSa mahIM tataH ॥55॥

text: antarbhūmigataścaiva satataṃ dharmavatsalaḥ । nārāyaṇaparo bhūtvā nārāyaṇapadaṃ jagau ॥56॥
html:
antarbhūmigataścaiva satataṃ dharmavatsalaḥ ।
nārāyaṇaparo bhūtvā nārāyaṇapadaṃ jagau ॥56॥
slp1: antarBUmigataScEva satataM DarmavatsalaH । nArAyaRaparo BUtvA nArAyaRapadaM jagO ॥56॥

text: tasyaiva ca prasādena punarevotthitastu saḥ । mahītalādgataḥ sthānaṃ brahmaṇaḥ samanantaram । parāṃ gatimanuprāpta iti naiṣṭhikamañjasā] ॥57॥
html:
tasyaiva ca prasādena punarevotthitastu saḥ ।
mahītalādgataḥ sthānaṃ brahmaṇaḥ samanantaram ।
parāṃ gatimanuprāpta iti naiṣṭhikamañjasā] ॥57॥
slp1: tasyEva ca prasAdena punarevotTitastu saH । mahItalAdgataH sTAnaM brahmaRaH samanantaram । parAM gatimanuprApta iti nEzWikamaYjasA] ॥57॥

text: yadā bhakto bhagavata āsīdrājā mahāvasuḥ । kimarthaṃ sa paribhraṣṭo viveśa vivaraṃ bhuvaḥ ॥1॥
html:
yadā bhakto bhagavata āsīdrājā mahāvasuḥ ।
kimarthaṃ sa paribhraṣṭo viveśa vivaraṃ bhuvaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: yadA Bakto Bagavata AsIdrAjA mahAvasuH । kimarTaM sa pariBrazwo viveSa vivaraM BuvaH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva saṃvādaṃ tridaśānāṃ ca bhārata ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva saṃvādaṃ tridaśānāṃ ca bhārata ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । fzIRAM cEva saMvAdaM tridaSAnAM ca BArata ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ajena yaṣṭavyamiti devāḥ prāhurdvijottamān । sa ca chāgo hyajo jñeyo nānyaḥ paśuriti sthitiḥ ॥3॥
html:
ajena yaṣṭavyamiti devāḥ prāhurdvijottamān ।
sa ca chāgo hyajo jñeyo nānyaḥ paśuriti sthitiḥ ॥3॥
slp1: ajena yazwavyamiti devAH prAhurdvijottamAn । sa ca CAgo hyajo jYeyo nAnyaH paSuriti sTitiH ॥3॥

text: bījairyajñeṣu yaṣṭavyamiti vai vaidikī śrutiḥ । ajasañjñāni bījāni chāgaṃ na ghnantumarhatha ॥4॥
html:
bījairyajñeṣu yaṣṭavyamiti vai vaidikī śrutiḥ ।
ajasañjñāni bījāni chāgaṃ na ghnantumarhatha ॥4॥
slp1: bIjEryajYezu yazwavyamiti vE vEdikI SrutiH । ajasaYjYAni bIjAni CAgaM na GnantumarhaTa ॥4॥
author: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ।

text: naiṣa dharmaḥ satāṃ devā yatra vadhyeta vai paśuḥ । idaṃ kṛtayugaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kathaṃ vadhyeta vai paśuḥ ॥5॥
html:
naiṣa dharmaḥ satāṃ devā yatra vadhyeta vai paśuḥ ।
idaṃ kṛtayugaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kathaṃ vadhyeta vai paśuḥ ॥5॥
slp1: nEza DarmaH satAM devA yatra vaDyeta vE paSuH । idaM kftayugaM SrezWaM kaTaM vaDyeta vE paSuH ॥5॥

text: teṣāṃ saṃvadatāmevamṛṣīṇāṃ vibudhaiḥ saha । mārgāgato nṛpaśreṣṭhastaṃ deśaṃ prāptavānvasuḥ । antarikṣacaraḥ śrīmānsamagrabalavāhanaḥ ॥6॥
html:
teṣāṃ saṃvadatāmevamṛṣīṇāṃ vibudhaiḥ saha ।
mārgāgato nṛpaśreṣṭhastaṃ deśaṃ prāptavānvasuḥ ।
antarikṣacaraḥ śrīmānsamagrabalavāhanaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: tezAM saMvadatAmevamfzIRAM vibuDEH saha । mArgAgato nfpaSrezWastaM deSaM prAptavAnvasuH । antarikzacaraH SrImAnsamagrabalavAhanaH ॥6॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasāyāntaṃ vasuṃ te tvantarikṣagam । ūcurdvijātayo devāneṣa chetsyati saṃśayam ॥7॥
html:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasāyāntaṃ vasuṃ te tvantarikṣagam ।
ūcurdvijātayo devāneṣa chetsyati saṃśayam ॥7॥
slp1: taM dfzwvA sahasAyAntaM vasuM te tvantarikzagam । UcurdvijAtayo devAneza Cetsyati saMSayam ॥7॥

text: yajvā dānapatiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvabhūtahitapriyaḥ । kathaṃ svidanyathā brūyādvākyameṣa mahānvasuḥ ॥8॥
html:
yajvā dānapatiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvabhūtahitapriyaḥ ।
kathaṃ svidanyathā brūyādvākyameṣa mahānvasuḥ ॥8॥
slp1: yajvA dAnapatiH SrezWaH sarvaBUtahitapriyaH । kaTaM svidanyaTA brUyAdvAkyameza mahAnvasuH ॥8॥

text: evaṃ te saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā vibudhā ṛṣayastathā । apṛcchansahasābhyetya vasuṃ rājānamantikāt ॥9॥
html:
evaṃ te saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā vibudhā ṛṣayastathā ।
apṛcchansahasābhyetya vasuṃ rājānamantikāt ॥9॥
slp1: evaM te saMvidaM kftvA vibuDA fzayastaTA । apfcCansahasAByetya vasuM rAjAnamantikAt ॥9॥

text: bho rājankena yaṣṭavyamajenāho svidauṣadhaiḥ । etannaḥ saṃśayaṃ chindhi pramāṇaṃ no bhavānmataḥ ॥10॥
html:
bho rājankena yaṣṭavyamajenāho svidauṣadhaiḥ ।
etannaḥ saṃśayaṃ chindhi pramāṇaṃ no bhavānmataḥ ॥10॥
slp1: Bo rAjankena yazwavyamajenAho svidOzaDEH । etannaH saMSayaM CinDi pramARaM no BavAnmataH ॥10॥

text: sa tānkṛtāñjalirbhūtvā paripapraccha vai vasuḥ । kasya vaḥ ko mataḥ pakṣo brūta satyaṃ samāgatāḥ ॥11॥
html:
sa tānkṛtāñjalirbhūtvā paripapraccha vai vasuḥ ।
kasya vaḥ ko mataḥ pakṣo brūta satyaṃ samāgatāḥ ॥11॥
slp1: sa tAnkftAYjalirBUtvA paripapracCa vE vasuH । kasya vaH ko mataH pakzo brUta satyaM samAgatAH ॥11॥

text: dhānyairyaṣṭavyamityeṣa pakṣo'smākaṃ narādhipa । devānāṃ tu paśuḥ pakṣo mato rājanvadasva naḥ ॥12॥
html:
dhānyairyaṣṭavyamityeṣa pakṣo'smākaṃ narādhipa ।
devānāṃ tu paśuḥ pakṣo mato rājanvadasva naḥ ॥12॥
slp1: DAnyEryazwavyamityeza pakzo'smAkaM narADipa । devAnAM tu paSuH pakzo mato rAjanvadasva naH ॥12॥
author: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ।

text: devānāṃ tu mataṃ jñātvā vasunā pakṣasaṃśrayāt । chāgenājena yaṣṭavyamevamuktaṃ vacastadā ॥13॥
html:
devānāṃ tu mataṃ jñātvā vasunā pakṣasaṃśrayāt ।
chāgenājena yaṣṭavyamevamuktaṃ vacastadā ॥13॥
slp1: devAnAM tu mataM jYAtvA vasunA pakzasaMSrayAt । CAgenAjena yazwavyamevamuktaM vacastadA ॥13॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kupitāste tataḥ sarve munayaḥ sūryavarcasaḥ । ūcurvasuṃ vimānasthaṃ devapakṣārthavādinam ॥14॥
html:
kupitāste tataḥ sarve munayaḥ sūryavarcasaḥ ।
ūcurvasuṃ vimānasthaṃ devapakṣārthavādinam ॥14॥
slp1: kupitAste tataH sarve munayaH sUryavarcasaH । UcurvasuM vimAnasTaM devapakzArTavAdinam ॥14॥

text: surapakṣo gṛhītaste yasmāttasmāddivaḥ pata । adya prabhṛti te rājannākāśe vihatā gatiḥ । asmacchāpābhighātena mahīṃ bhittvā pravekṣyasi ॥15॥
html:
surapakṣo gṛhītaste yasmāttasmāddivaḥ pata ।
adya prabhṛti te rājannākāśe vihatā gatiḥ ।
asmacchāpābhighātena mahīṃ bhittvā pravekṣyasi ॥15॥
slp1: surapakzo gfhItaste yasmAttasmAddivaH pata । adya praBfti te rAjannAkASe vihatA gatiH । asmacCApABiGAtena mahIM BittvA pravekzyasi ॥15॥

text: tatastasminmuhūrte'tha rājoparicarastadā । adho vai sambabhūvāśu bhūmervivarago nṛpaḥ । smṛtistvenaṃ na prajahau tadā nārāyaṇājñayā ॥16॥
html:
tatastasminmuhūrte'tha rājoparicarastadā ।
adho vai sambabhūvāśu bhūmervivarago nṛpaḥ ।
smṛtistvenaṃ na prajahau tadā nārāyaṇājñayā ॥16॥
slp1: tatastasminmuhUrte'Ta rAjoparicarastadA । aDo vE sambaBUvASu BUmervivarago nfpaH । smftistvenaM na prajahO tadA nArAyaRAjYayA ॥16॥

text: devāstu sahitāḥ sarve vasoḥ śāpavimokṣaṇam । cintayāmāsuravyagrāḥ sukṛtaṃ hi nṛpasya tat ॥17॥
html:
devāstu sahitāḥ sarve vasoḥ śāpavimokṣaṇam ।
cintayāmāsuravyagrāḥ sukṛtaṃ hi nṛpasya tat ॥17॥
slp1: devAstu sahitAH sarve vasoH SApavimokzaRam । cintayAmAsuravyagrAH sukftaM hi nfpasya tat ॥17॥

text: anenāsmatkṛte rājñā śāpaḥ prāpto mahātmanā । asya pratipriyaṃ kāryaṃ sahitairno divaukasaḥ ॥18॥
html:
anenāsmatkṛte rājñā śāpaḥ prāpto mahātmanā ।
asya pratipriyaṃ kāryaṃ sahitairno divaukasaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: anenAsmatkfte rAjYA SApaH prApto mahAtmanA । asya pratipriyaM kAryaM sahitErno divOkasaH ॥18॥

text: iti buddhyā vyavasyāśu gatvā niścayamīśvarāḥ । ūcustaṃ hṛṣṭamanaso rājoparicaraṃ tadā ॥19॥
html:
iti buddhyā vyavasyāśu gatvā niścayamīśvarāḥ ।
ūcustaṃ hṛṣṭamanaso rājoparicaraṃ tadā ॥19॥
slp1: iti budDyA vyavasyASu gatvA niScayamISvarAH । UcustaM hfzwamanaso rAjoparicaraM tadA ॥19॥

text: brahmaṇyadevaṃ tvaṃ bhaktaḥ surāsuraguruṃ harim । kāmaṃ sa tava tuṣṭātmā kuryācchāpavimokṣaṇam ॥20॥
html:
brahmaṇyadevaṃ tvaṃ bhaktaḥ surāsuraguruṃ harim ।
kāmaṃ sa tava tuṣṭātmā kuryācchāpavimokṣaṇam ॥20॥
slp1: brahmaRyadevaM tvaM BaktaH surAsuraguruM harim । kAmaM sa tava tuzwAtmA kuryAcCApavimokzaRam ॥20॥

text: mānanā tu dvijātīnāṃ kartavyā vai mahātmanām । avaśyaṃ tapasā teṣāṃ phalitavyaṃ nṛpottama ॥21॥
html:
mānanā tu dvijātīnāṃ kartavyā vai mahātmanām ।
avaśyaṃ tapasā teṣāṃ phalitavyaṃ nṛpottama ॥21॥
slp1: mAnanA tu dvijAtInAM kartavyA vE mahAtmanAm । avaSyaM tapasA tezAM PalitavyaM nfpottama ॥21॥

text: yatastvaṃ sahasā bhraṣṭa ākāśānmedinītalam । ekaṃ tvanugrahaṃ tubhyaṃ dadmo vai nṛpasattama ॥22॥
html:
yatastvaṃ sahasā bhraṣṭa ākāśānmedinītalam ।
ekaṃ tvanugrahaṃ tubhyaṃ dadmo vai nṛpasattama ॥22॥
slp1: yatastvaM sahasA Brazwa AkASAnmedinItalam । ekaM tvanugrahaM tuByaM dadmo vE nfpasattama ॥22॥

text: yāvattvaṃ śāpadoṣeṇa kālamāsiṣyase'nagha । bhūmervivarago bhūtvā tāvantaṃ kālamāpsyasi । yajñeṣu suhutāṃ viprairvasordhārāṃ mahātmabhiḥ ॥23॥
html:
yāvattvaṃ śāpadoṣeṇa kālamāsiṣyase'nagha ।
bhūmervivarago bhūtvā tāvantaṃ kālamāpsyasi ।
yajñeṣu suhutāṃ viprairvasordhārāṃ mahātmabhiḥ ॥23॥
slp1: yAvattvaM SApadozeRa kAlamAsizyase'naGa । BUmervivarago BUtvA tAvantaM kAlamApsyasi । yajYezu suhutAM viprErvasorDArAM mahAtmaBiH ॥23॥

text: prāpsyase'smadanudhyānānmā ca tvāṃ glānirāspṛśet । na kṣutpipāse rājendra bhūmeśchidre bhaviṣyataḥ ॥24॥
html:
prāpsyase'smadanudhyānānmā ca tvāṃ glānirāspṛśet ।
na kṣutpipāse rājendra bhūmeśchidre bhaviṣyataḥ ॥24॥
slp1: prApsyase'smadanuDyAnAnmA ca tvAM glAnirAspfSet । na kzutpipAse rAjendra BUmeSCidre BavizyataH ॥24॥

text: vasordhārānupītatvāttejasāpyāyitena ca । sa devo'smadvarātprīto brahmalokaṃ hi neṣyati ॥25॥
html:
vasordhārānupītatvāttejasāpyāyitena ca ।
sa devo'smadvarātprīto brahmalokaṃ hi neṣyati ॥25॥
slp1: vasorDArAnupItatvAttejasApyAyitena ca । sa devo'smadvarAtprIto brahmalokaM hi nezyati ॥25॥

text: evaṃ dattvā varaṃ rājñe sarve tatra divaukasaḥ । gatāḥ svabhavanaṃ devā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ ॥26॥
html:
evaṃ dattvā varaṃ rājñe sarve tatra divaukasaḥ ।
gatāḥ svabhavanaṃ devā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ ॥26॥
slp1: evaM dattvA varaM rAjYe sarve tatra divOkasaH । gatAH svaBavanaM devA fzayaSca tapoDanAH ॥26॥

text: cakre ca satataṃ pūjāṃ viṣvaksenāya bhārata । japyaṃ jagau ca satataṃ nārāyaṇamukhodgatam ॥27॥
html:
cakre ca satataṃ pūjāṃ viṣvaksenāya bhārata ।
japyaṃ jagau ca satataṃ nārāyaṇamukhodgatam ॥27॥
slp1: cakre ca satataM pUjAM vizvaksenAya BArata । japyaM jagO ca satataM nArAyaRamuKodgatam ॥27॥

text: tatrāpi pañcabhiryajñaiḥ pañcakālānarindama । ayajaddhariṃ surapatiṃ bhūmervivarago'pi san ॥28॥
html:
tatrāpi pañcabhiryajñaiḥ pañcakālānarindama ।
ayajaddhariṃ surapatiṃ bhūmervivarago'pi san ॥28॥
slp1: tatrApi paYcaBiryajYEH paYcakAlAnarindama । ayajadDariM surapatiM BUmervivarago'pi san ॥28॥

text: tato'sya tuṣṭo bhagavānbhaktyā nārāyaṇo hariḥ । ananyabhaktasya satastatparasya jitātmanaḥ ॥29॥
html:
tato'sya tuṣṭo bhagavānbhaktyā nārāyaṇo hariḥ ।
ananyabhaktasya satastatparasya jitātmanaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: tato'sya tuzwo BagavAnBaktyA nArAyaRo hariH । ananyaBaktasya satastatparasya jitAtmanaH ॥29॥

text: varado bhagavānviṣṇuḥ samīpasthaṃ dvijottamam । garutmantaṃ mahāvegamābabhāṣe smayanniva ॥30॥
html:
varado bhagavānviṣṇuḥ samīpasthaṃ dvijottamam ।
garutmantaṃ mahāvegamābabhāṣe smayanniva ॥30॥
slp1: varado BagavAnvizRuH samIpasTaM dvijottamam । garutmantaM mahAvegamAbaBAze smayanniva ॥30॥

text: dvijottama mahābhāga gamyatāṃ vacanānmama । samrāḍrājā vasurnāma dharmātmā māṃ samāśritaḥ ॥31॥
html:
dvijottama mahābhāga gamyatāṃ vacanānmama ।
samrāḍrājā vasurnāma dharmātmā māṃ samāśritaḥ ॥31॥
