text: etānvarṇānbahuvidhānrūpe bibhratsanātanaḥ । sahasranayanaḥ śrīmāñśataśīrṣaḥ sahasrapāt ॥6॥
html:
etānvarṇānbahuvidhānrūpe bibhratsanātanaḥ ।
sahasranayanaḥ śrīmāñśataśīrṣaḥ sahasrapāt ॥6॥
slp1: etAnvarRAnbahuviDAnrUpe biBratsanAtanaH । sahasranayanaH SrImAYSataSIrzaH sahasrapAt ॥6॥

text: sahasrodarabāhuśca avyakta iti ca kvacit । oṅkāramudgiranvaktrātsāvitrīṃ ca tadanvayām ॥7॥
html:
sahasrodarabāhuśca avyakta iti ca kvacit ।
oṅkāramudgiranvaktrātsāvitrīṃ ca tadanvayām ॥7॥
slp1: sahasrodarabAhuSca avyakta iti ca kvacit । oNkAramudgiranvaktrAtsAvitrIM ca tadanvayAm ॥7॥

text: śeṣebhyaścaiva vaktrebhyaścaturvedodgataṃ vasu । āraṇyakaṃ jagau devo harirnārāyaṇo vaśī ॥8॥
html:
śeṣebhyaścaiva vaktrebhyaścaturvedodgataṃ vasu ।
āraṇyakaṃ jagau devo harirnārāyaṇo vaśī ॥8॥
slp1: SezeByaScEva vaktreByaScaturvedodgataM vasu । AraRyakaM jagO devo harirnArAyaRo vaSI ॥8॥

text: vedīṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ darbhānmaṇirūpānathopalān । ajinaṃ daṇḍakāṣṭhaṃ ca jvalitaṃ ca hutāśanam । dhārayāmāsa deveśo hastairyajñapatistadā ॥9॥
html:
vedīṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ darbhānmaṇirūpānathopalān ।
ajinaṃ daṇḍakāṣṭhaṃ ca jvalitaṃ ca hutāśanam ।
dhārayāmāsa deveśo hastairyajñapatistadā ॥9॥
slp1: vedIM kamaRqaluM darBAnmaRirUpAnaTopalAn । ajinaM daRqakAzWaM ca jvalitaM ca hutASanam । DArayAmAsa deveSo hastEryajYapatistadA ॥9॥

text: taṃ prasannaṃ prasannātmā nārado dvijasattamaḥ । vāgyataḥ prayato bhūtvā vavande parameśvaram । tamuvāca nataṃ mūrdhnā devānāmādiravyayaḥ ॥10॥
html:
taṃ prasannaṃ prasannātmā nārado dvijasattamaḥ ।
vāgyataḥ prayato bhūtvā vavande parameśvaram ।
tamuvāca nataṃ mūrdhnā devānāmādiravyayaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: taM prasannaM prasannAtmA nArado dvijasattamaH । vAgyataH prayato BUtvA vavande parameSvaram । tamuvAca nataM mUrDnA devAnAmAdiravyayaH ॥10॥

text: ekataśca dvitaścaiva tritaścaiva maharṣayaḥ । imaṃ deśamanuprāptā mama darśanalālasāḥ ॥11॥
html:
ekataśca dvitaścaiva tritaścaiva maharṣayaḥ ।
imaṃ deśamanuprāptā mama darśanalālasāḥ ॥11॥
slp1: ekataSca dvitaScEva tritaScEva maharzayaH । imaM deSamanuprAptA mama darSanalAlasAH ॥11॥

text: na ca māṃ te dadṛśire na ca drakṣyati kaścana । ṛte hyekāntikaśreṣṭhāttvaṃ caivaikāntiko mataḥ ॥12॥
html:
na ca māṃ te dadṛśire na ca drakṣyati kaścana ।
ṛte hyekāntikaśreṣṭhāttvaṃ caivaikāntiko mataḥ ॥12॥
slp1: na ca mAM te dadfSire na ca drakzyati kaScana । fte hyekAntikaSrezWAttvaM cEvEkAntiko mataH ॥12॥

text: mamaitāstanavaḥ śreṣṭhā jātā dharmagṛhe dvija । tāstvaṃ bhajasva satataṃ sādhayasva yathāgatam ॥13॥
html:
mamaitāstanavaḥ śreṣṭhā jātā dharmagṛhe dvija ।
tāstvaṃ bhajasva satataṃ sādhayasva yathāgatam ॥13॥
slp1: mamEtAstanavaH SrezWA jAtA Darmagfhe dvija । tAstvaM Bajasva satataM sADayasva yaTAgatam ॥13॥

text: vṛṇīṣva ca varaṃ vipra mattastvaṃ yamihecchasi । prasanno'haṃ tavādyeha viśvamūrtirihāvyayaḥ ॥14॥
html:
vṛṇīṣva ca varaṃ vipra mattastvaṃ yamihecchasi ।
prasanno'haṃ tavādyeha viśvamūrtirihāvyayaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: vfRIzva ca varaM vipra mattastvaM yamihecCasi । prasanno'haM tavAdyeha viSvamUrtirihAvyayaH ॥14॥

text: adya me tapaso deva yamasya niyamasya ca । sadyaḥ phalamavāptaṃ vai dṛṣṭo yadbhagavānmayā ॥15॥
html:
adya me tapaso deva yamasya niyamasya ca ।
sadyaḥ phalamavāptaṃ vai dṛṣṭo yadbhagavānmayā ॥15॥
slp1: adya me tapaso deva yamasya niyamasya ca । sadyaH PalamavAptaM vE dfzwo yadBagavAnmayA ॥15॥
author: nārada uvāca ।

text: vara eṣa mamātyantaṃ dṛṣṭastvaṃ yatsanātanaḥ । bhagavānviśvadṛksiṃhaḥ sarvamūrtirmahāprabhuḥ ॥16॥
html:
vara eṣa mamātyantaṃ dṛṣṭastvaṃ yatsanātanaḥ ।
bhagavānviśvadṛksiṃhaḥ sarvamūrtirmahāprabhuḥ ॥16॥
slp1: vara eza mamAtyantaM dfzwastvaM yatsanAtanaH । BagavAnviSvadfksiMhaH sarvamUrtirmahApraBuH ॥16॥

text: evaṃ sandarśayitvā tu nāradaṃ parameṣṭhijam । uvāca vacanaṃ bhūyo gaccha nārada māciram ॥17॥
html:
evaṃ sandarśayitvā tu nāradaṃ parameṣṭhijam ।
uvāca vacanaṃ bhūyo gaccha nārada māciram ॥17॥
slp1: evaM sandarSayitvA tu nAradaM paramezWijam । uvAca vacanaM BUyo gacCa nArada mAciram ॥17॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ime hyanindriyāhārā madbhaktāścandravarcasaḥ । ekāgrāścintayeyurmāṃ naiṣāṃ vighno bhavediti ॥18॥
html:
ime hyanindriyāhārā madbhaktāścandravarcasaḥ ।
ekāgrāścintayeyurmāṃ naiṣāṃ vighno bhavediti ॥18॥
slp1: ime hyanindriyAhArA madBaktAScandravarcasaH । ekAgrAScintayeyurmAM nEzAM viGno Bavediti ॥18॥

text: siddhāścaite mahābhāgāḥ purā hyekāntino'bhavan । tamorajovinirmuktā māṃ pravekṣyantyasaṃśayam ॥19॥
html:
siddhāścaite mahābhāgāḥ purā hyekāntino'bhavan ।
tamorajovinirmuktā māṃ pravekṣyantyasaṃśayam ॥19॥
slp1: sidDAScEte mahABAgAH purA hyekAntino'Bavan । tamorajovinirmuktA mAM pravekzyantyasaMSayam ॥19॥

text: na dṛśyaścakṣuṣā yo'sau na spṛśyaḥ sparśanena ca । na ghreyaścaiva gandhena rasena ca vivarjitaḥ ॥20॥
html:
na dṛśyaścakṣuṣā yo'sau na spṛśyaḥ sparśanena ca ।
na ghreyaścaiva gandhena rasena ca vivarjitaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: na dfSyaScakzuzA yo'sO na spfSyaH sparSanena ca । na GreyaScEva ganDena rasena ca vivarjitaH ॥20॥

text: sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva na guṇāstaṃ bhajanti vai । yaśca sarvagataḥ sākṣī lokasyātmeti kathyate ॥21॥
html:
sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva na guṇāstaṃ bhajanti vai ।
yaśca sarvagataḥ sākṣī lokasyātmeti kathyate ॥21॥
slp1: sattvaM rajastamaScEva na guRAstaM Bajanti vE । yaSca sarvagataH sAkzI lokasyAtmeti kaTyate ॥21॥

text: bhūtagrāmaśarīreṣu naśyatsu na vinaśyati । ajo nityaḥ śāśvataśca nirguṇo niṣkalastathā ॥22॥
html:
bhūtagrāmaśarīreṣu naśyatsu na vinaśyati ।
ajo nityaḥ śāśvataśca nirguṇo niṣkalastathā ॥22॥
slp1: BUtagrAmaSarIrezu naSyatsu na vinaSyati । ajo nityaH SASvataSca nirguRo nizkalastaTA ॥22॥

text: dvirdvādaśebhyastattvebhyaḥ khyāto yaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ । puruṣo niṣkriyaścaiva jñānadṛśyaśca kathyate ॥23॥
html:
dvirdvādaśebhyastattvebhyaḥ khyāto yaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ ।
puruṣo niṣkriyaścaiva jñānadṛśyaśca kathyate ॥23॥
slp1: dvirdvAdaSeByastattveByaH KyAto yaH paYcaviMSakaH । puruzo nizkriyaScEva jYAnadfSyaSca kaTyate ॥23॥

text: yaṃ praviśya bhavantīha muktā vai dvijasattama । sa vāsudevo vijñeyaḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ ॥24॥
html:
yaṃ praviśya bhavantīha muktā vai dvijasattama ।
sa vāsudevo vijñeyaḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: yaM praviSya BavantIha muktA vE dvijasattama । sa vAsudevo vijYeyaH paramAtmA sanAtanaH ॥24॥

text: paśya devasya māhātmyaṃ mahimānaṃ ca nārada । śubhāśubhaiḥ karmabhiryo na lipyati kadācana ॥25॥
html:
paśya devasya māhātmyaṃ mahimānaṃ ca nārada ।
śubhāśubhaiḥ karmabhiryo na lipyati kadācana ॥25॥
slp1: paSya devasya mAhAtmyaM mahimAnaM ca nArada । SuBASuBEH karmaBiryo na lipyati kadAcana ॥25॥

text: sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva guṇānetānpracakṣate । ete sarvaśarīreṣu tiṣṭhanti vicaranti ca ॥26॥
html:
sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva guṇānetānpracakṣate ।
ete sarvaśarīreṣu tiṣṭhanti vicaranti ca ॥26॥
slp1: sattvaM rajastamaScEva guRAnetAnpracakzate । ete sarvaSarIrezu tizWanti vicaranti ca ॥26॥

text: etānguṇāṃstu kṣetrajño bhuṅkte naibhiḥ sa bhujyate । nirguṇo guṇabhukcaiva guṇasraṣṭā guṇādhikaḥ ॥27॥
html:
etānguṇāṃstu kṣetrajño bhuṅkte naibhiḥ sa bhujyate ।
nirguṇo guṇabhukcaiva guṇasraṣṭā guṇādhikaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: etAnguRAMstu kzetrajYo BuNkte nEBiH sa Bujyate । nirguRo guRaBukcEva guRasrazwA guRADikaH ॥27॥

text: jagatpratiṣṭhā devarṣe pṛthivyapsu pralīyate । jyotiṣyāpaḥ pralīyante jyotirvāyau pralīyate ॥28॥
html:
jagatpratiṣṭhā devarṣe pṛthivyapsu pralīyate ।
jyotiṣyāpaḥ pralīyante jyotirvāyau pralīyate ॥28॥
slp1: jagatpratizWA devarze pfTivyapsu pralIyate । jyotizyApaH pralIyante jyotirvAyO pralIyate ॥28॥

text: khe vāyuḥ pralayaṃ yāti manasyākāśameva ca । mano hi paramaṃ bhūtaṃ tadavyakte pralīyate ॥29॥
html:
khe vāyuḥ pralayaṃ yāti manasyākāśameva ca ।
mano hi paramaṃ bhūtaṃ tadavyakte pralīyate ॥29॥
slp1: Ke vAyuH pralayaM yAti manasyAkASameva ca । mano hi paramaM BUtaM tadavyakte pralIyate ॥29॥

text: avyaktaṃ puruṣe brahmanniṣkriye sampralīyate । nāsti tasmātparataraṃ puruṣādvai sanātanāt ॥30॥
html:
avyaktaṃ puruṣe brahmanniṣkriye sampralīyate ।
nāsti tasmātparataraṃ puruṣādvai sanātanāt ॥30॥
slp1: avyaktaM puruze brahmannizkriye sampralIyate । nAsti tasmAtparataraM puruzAdvE sanAtanAt ॥30॥

text: nityaṃ hi nāsti jagati bhūtaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam । ṛte tamekaṃ puruṣaṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam । sarvabhūtātmabhūto hi vāsudevo mahābalaḥ ॥31॥
html:
nityaṃ hi nāsti jagati bhūtaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam ।
ṛte tamekaṃ puruṣaṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam ।
sarvabhūtātmabhūto hi vāsudevo mahābalaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: nityaM hi nAsti jagati BUtaM sTAvarajaNgamam । fte tamekaM puruzaM vAsudevaM sanAtanam । sarvaBUtAtmaBUto hi vAsudevo mahAbalaH ॥31॥

text: pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam । te sametā mahātmānaḥ śarīramiti sañjñitam ॥32॥
html:
pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam ।
te sametā mahātmānaḥ śarīramiti sañjñitam ॥32॥
slp1: pfTivI vAyurAkASamApo jyotiSca paYcamam । te sametA mahAtmAnaH SarIramiti saYjYitam ॥32॥

text: tadāviśati yo brahmannadṛśyo laghuvikramaḥ । utpanna eva bhavati śarīraṃ ceṣṭayanprabhuḥ ॥33॥
html:
tadāviśati yo brahmannadṛśyo laghuvikramaḥ ।
utpanna eva bhavati śarīraṃ ceṣṭayanprabhuḥ ॥33॥
slp1: tadAviSati yo brahmannadfSyo laGuvikramaH । utpanna eva Bavati SarIraM cezwayanpraBuH ॥33॥

text: na vinā dhātusaṅghātaṃ śarīraṃ bhavati kvacit । na ca jīvaṃ vinā brahmandhātavaśceṣṭayantyuta ॥34॥
html:
na vinā dhātusaṅghātaṃ śarīraṃ bhavati kvacit ।
na ca jīvaṃ vinā brahmandhātavaśceṣṭayantyuta ॥34॥
slp1: na vinA DAtusaNGAtaM SarIraM Bavati kvacit । na ca jIvaM vinA brahmanDAtavaScezwayantyuta ॥34॥

text: sa jīvaḥ parisaṅkhyātaḥ śeṣaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ । tasmātsanatkumāratvaṃ yo labheta svakarmaṇā ॥35॥
html:
sa jīvaḥ parisaṅkhyātaḥ śeṣaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
tasmātsanatkumāratvaṃ yo labheta svakarmaṇā ॥35॥
slp1: sa jIvaH parisaNKyAtaH SezaH saNkarzaRaH praBuH । tasmAtsanatkumAratvaM yo laBeta svakarmaRA ॥35॥

text: yasmiṃśca sarvabhūtāni pralayaṃ yānti saṅkṣaye । sa manaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ pradyumnaḥ paripaṭhyate ॥36॥
html:
yasmiṃśca sarvabhūtāni pralayaṃ yānti saṅkṣaye ।
sa manaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ pradyumnaḥ paripaṭhyate ॥36॥
slp1: yasmiMSca sarvaBUtAni pralayaM yAnti saNkzaye । sa manaH sarvaBUtAnAM pradyumnaH paripaWyate ॥36॥

text: tasmātprasūto yaḥ kartā kāryaṃ kāraṇameva ca । yasmātsarvaṃ prabhavati jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam । so'niruddhaḥ sa īśāno vyaktiḥ sā sarvakarmasu ॥37॥
html:
tasmātprasūto yaḥ kartā kāryaṃ kāraṇameva ca ।
yasmātsarvaṃ prabhavati jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam ।
so'niruddhaḥ sa īśāno vyaktiḥ sā sarvakarmasu ॥37॥
slp1: tasmAtprasUto yaH kartA kAryaM kAraRameva ca । yasmAtsarvaM praBavati jagatsTAvarajaNgamam । so'nirudDaH sa ISAno vyaktiH sA sarvakarmasu ॥37॥

text: yo vāsudevo bhagavānkṣetrajño nirguṇātmakaḥ । jñeyaḥ sa eva bhagavāñjīvaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ॥38॥
html:
yo vāsudevo bhagavānkṣetrajño nirguṇātmakaḥ ।
jñeyaḥ sa eva bhagavāñjīvaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ॥38॥
slp1: yo vAsudevo BagavAnkzetrajYo nirguRAtmakaH । jYeyaH sa eva BagavAYjIvaH saNkarzaRaH praBuH ॥38॥

text: saṅkarṣaṇācca pradyumno manobhūtaḥ sa ucyate । pradyumnādyo'niruddhastu so'haṅkāro maheśvaraḥ ॥39॥
html:
saṅkarṣaṇācca pradyumno manobhūtaḥ sa ucyate ।
pradyumnādyo'niruddhastu so'haṅkāro maheśvaraḥ ॥39॥
slp1: saNkarzaRAcca pradyumno manoBUtaH sa ucyate । pradyumnAdyo'nirudDastu so'haNkAro maheSvaraH ॥39॥

text: mattaḥ sarvaṃ sambhavati jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam । akṣaraṃ ca kṣaraṃ caiva saccāsaccaiva nārada ॥40॥
html:
mattaḥ sarvaṃ sambhavati jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam ।
akṣaraṃ ca kṣaraṃ caiva saccāsaccaiva nārada ॥40॥
slp1: mattaH sarvaM samBavati jagatsTAvarajaNgamam । akzaraM ca kzaraM cEva saccAsaccEva nArada ॥40॥

text: māṃ praviśya bhavantīha muktā bhaktāstu ye mama । ahaṃ hi puruṣo jñeyo niṣkriyaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ ॥41॥
html:
māṃ praviśya bhavantīha muktā bhaktāstu ye mama ।
ahaṃ hi puruṣo jñeyo niṣkriyaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ ॥41॥
slp1: mAM praviSya BavantIha muktA BaktAstu ye mama । ahaM hi puruzo jYeyo nizkriyaH paYcaviMSakaH ॥41॥

text: nirguṇo niṣkalaścaiva nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ । etattvayā na vijñeyaṃ rūpavāniti dṛśyate । icchanmuhūrtānnaśyeyamīśo'haṃ jagato guruḥ ॥42॥
html:
nirguṇo niṣkalaścaiva nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ ।
etattvayā na vijñeyaṃ rūpavāniti dṛśyate ।
icchanmuhūrtānnaśyeyamīśo'haṃ jagato guruḥ ॥42॥
slp1: nirguRo nizkalaScEva nirdvandvo nizparigrahaH । etattvayA na vijYeyaM rUpavAniti dfSyate । icCanmuhUrtAnnaSyeyamISo'haM jagato guruH ॥42॥

text: māyā hyeṣā mayā sṛṣṭā yanmāṃ paśyasi nārada । sarvabhūtaguṇairyuktaṃ naivaṃ tvaṃ jñātumarhasi । mayaitatkathitaṃ samyaktava mūrticatuṣṭayam ॥43॥
html:
māyā hyeṣā mayā sṛṣṭā yanmāṃ paśyasi nārada ।
sarvabhūtaguṇairyuktaṃ naivaṃ tvaṃ jñātumarhasi ।
mayaitatkathitaṃ samyaktava mūrticatuṣṭayam ॥43॥
slp1: mAyA hyezA mayA sfzwA yanmAM paSyasi nArada । sarvaBUtaguREryuktaM nEvaM tvaM jYAtumarhasi । mayEtatkaTitaM samyaktava mUrticatuzwayam ॥43॥

text: siddhā hyete mahābhāgā narā hyekāntino'bhavan । tamorajobhyāṃ nirmuktāḥ pravekṣyanti ca māṃ mune ॥44॥
html:
siddhā hyete mahābhāgā narā hyekāntino'bhavan ।
tamorajobhyāṃ nirmuktāḥ pravekṣyanti ca māṃ mune ॥44॥
slp1: sidDA hyete mahABAgA narA hyekAntino'Bavan । tamorajoByAM nirmuktAH pravekzyanti ca mAM mune ॥44॥

text: ahaṃ kartā ca kāryaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ cāpi nārada । ahaṃ hi jīvasañjño vai mayi jīvaḥ samāhitaḥ । maivaṃ te buddhiratrābhūddṛṣṭo jīvo mayeti ca ॥45॥
html:
ahaṃ kartā ca kāryaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ cāpi nārada ।
ahaṃ hi jīvasañjño vai mayi jīvaḥ samāhitaḥ ।
maivaṃ te buddhiratrābhūddṛṣṭo jīvo mayeti ca ॥45॥
slp1: ahaM kartA ca kAryaM ca kAraRaM cApi nArada । ahaM hi jIvasaYjYo vE mayi jIvaH samAhitaH । mEvaM te budDiratrABUddfzwo jIvo mayeti ca ॥45॥

text: ahaṃ sarvatrago brahmanbhūtagrāmāntarātmakaḥ । bhūtagrāmaśarīreṣu naśyatsu na naśāmyaham ॥46॥
html:
ahaṃ sarvatrago brahmanbhūtagrāmāntarātmakaḥ ।
bhūtagrāmaśarīreṣu naśyatsu na naśāmyaham ॥46॥
slp1: ahaM sarvatrago brahmanBUtagrAmAntarAtmakaH । BUtagrAmaSarIrezu naSyatsu na naSAmyaham ॥46॥

text: hiraṇyagarbho lokādiścaturvaktro niruktagaḥ । brahmā sanātano devo mama bahvarthacintakaḥ ॥47॥
html:
hiraṇyagarbho lokādiścaturvaktro niruktagaḥ ।
brahmā sanātano devo mama bahvarthacintakaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: hiraRyagarBo lokAdiScaturvaktro niruktagaH । brahmA sanAtano devo mama bahvarTacintakaH ॥47॥

text: paśyaikādaśa me rudrāndakṣiṇaṃ pārśvamāsthitān । dvādaśaiva tathādityānvāmaṃ pārśvaṃ samāsthitān ॥48॥
html:
paśyaikādaśa me rudrāndakṣiṇaṃ pārśvamāsthitān ।
dvādaśaiva tathādityānvāmaṃ pārśvaṃ samāsthitān ॥48॥
slp1: paSyEkAdaSa me rudrAndakziRaM pArSvamAsTitAn । dvAdaSEva taTAdityAnvAmaM pArSvaM samAsTitAn ॥48॥

text: agrataścaiva me paśya vasūnaṣṭau surottamān । nāsatyaṃ caiva dasraṃ ca bhiṣajau paśya pṛṣṭhataḥ ॥49॥
html:
agrataścaiva me paśya vasūnaṣṭau surottamān ।
nāsatyaṃ caiva dasraṃ ca bhiṣajau paśya pṛṣṭhataḥ ॥49॥
slp1: agrataScEva me paSya vasUnazwO surottamAn । nAsatyaM cEva dasraM ca BizajO paSya pfzWataH ॥49॥

text: sarvānprajāpatīnpaśya paśya sapta ṛṣīnapi । vedānyajñāṃśca śataśaḥ paśyāmṛtamathauṣadhīḥ ॥50॥
html:
sarvānprajāpatīnpaśya paśya sapta ṛṣīnapi ।
vedānyajñāṃśca śataśaḥ paśyāmṛtamathauṣadhīḥ ॥50॥
slp1: sarvAnprajApatInpaSya paSya sapta fzInapi । vedAnyajYAMSca SataSaH paSyAmftamaTOzaDIH ॥50॥

text: tapāṃsi niyamāṃścaiva yamānapi pṛthagvidhān । tathāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryamekasthaṃ paśya mūrtimat ॥51॥
html:
tapāṃsi niyamāṃścaiva yamānapi pṛthagvidhān ।
tathāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryamekasthaṃ paśya mūrtimat ॥51॥
slp1: tapAMsi niyamAMScEva yamAnapi pfTagviDAn । taTAzwaguRamESvaryamekasTaM paSya mUrtimat ॥51॥

text: śriyaṃ lakṣmīṃ ca kīrtiṃ ca pṛthivīṃ ca kakudminīm । vedānāṃ mātaraṃ paśya matsthāṃ devīṃ sarasvatīm ॥52॥
html:
śriyaṃ lakṣmīṃ ca kīrtiṃ ca pṛthivīṃ ca kakudminīm ।
vedānāṃ mātaraṃ paśya matsthāṃ devīṃ sarasvatīm ॥52॥
slp1: SriyaM lakzmIM ca kIrtiM ca pfTivIM ca kakudminIm । vedAnAM mAtaraM paSya matsTAM devIM sarasvatIm ॥52॥

text: dhruvaṃ ca jyotiṣāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ paśya nārada khecaram । ambhodharānsamudrāṃśca sarāṃsi saritastathā ॥53॥
html:
dhruvaṃ ca jyotiṣāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ paśya nārada khecaram ।
ambhodharānsamudrāṃśca sarāṃsi saritastathā ॥53॥
slp1: DruvaM ca jyotizAM SrezWaM paSya nArada Kecaram । amBoDarAnsamudrAMSca sarAMsi saritastaTA ॥53॥

text: mūrtimantaḥ pitṛgaṇāṃścaturaḥ paśya sattama । trīṃścaivemānguṇānpaśya matsthānmūrtivivarjitān ॥54॥
html:
mūrtimantaḥ pitṛgaṇāṃścaturaḥ paśya sattama ।
trīṃścaivemānguṇānpaśya matsthānmūrtivivarjitān ॥54॥
slp1: mUrtimantaH pitfgaRAMScaturaH paSya sattama । trIMScEvemAnguRAnpaSya matsTAnmUrtivivarjitAn ॥54॥

text: devakāryādapi mune pitṛkāryaṃ viśiṣyate । devānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ ca pitā hyeko'hamāditaḥ ॥55॥
html:
devakāryādapi mune pitṛkāryaṃ viśiṣyate ।
devānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ ca pitā hyeko'hamāditaḥ ॥55॥
slp1: devakAryAdapi mune pitfkAryaM viSizyate । devAnAM ca pitFRAM ca pitA hyeko'hamAditaH ॥55॥

text: ahaṃ hayaśiro bhūtvā samudre paścimottare । pibāmi suhutaṃ havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca śraddhayānvitam ॥56॥
html:
ahaṃ hayaśiro bhūtvā samudre paścimottare ।
pibāmi suhutaṃ havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca śraddhayānvitam ॥56॥
slp1: ahaM hayaSiro BUtvA samudre paScimottare । pibAmi suhutaM havyaM kavyaM ca SradDayAnvitam ॥56॥

text: mayā sṛṣṭaḥ purā brahmā madyajñamayajatsvayam । tatastasmai varānprīto dadāvahamanuttamān ॥57॥
html:
mayā sṛṣṭaḥ purā brahmā madyajñamayajatsvayam ।
tatastasmai varānprīto dadāvahamanuttamān ॥57॥
slp1: mayA sfzwaH purA brahmA madyajYamayajatsvayam । tatastasmE varAnprIto dadAvahamanuttamAn ॥57॥

text: matputratvaṃ ca kalpādau lokādhyakṣatvameva ca । ahaṅkārakṛtaṃ caiva nāma paryāyavācakam ॥58॥
html:
matputratvaṃ ca kalpādau lokādhyakṣatvameva ca ।
ahaṅkārakṛtaṃ caiva nāma paryāyavācakam ॥58॥
slp1: matputratvaM ca kalpAdO lokADyakzatvameva ca । ahaNkArakftaM cEva nAma paryAyavAcakam ॥58॥

text: tvayā kṛtāṃ ca maryādāṃ nātikrāmyati kaścana । tvaṃ caiva varado brahmanvarepsūnāṃ bhaviṣyasi ॥59॥
html:
tvayā kṛtāṃ ca maryādāṃ nātikrāmyati kaścana ।
tvaṃ caiva varado brahmanvarepsūnāṃ bhaviṣyasi ॥59॥
slp1: tvayA kftAM ca maryAdAM nAtikrAmyati kaScana । tvaM cEva varado brahmanvarepsUnAM Bavizyasi ॥59॥

text: surāsuragaṇānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca tapodhana । pitṝṇāṃ ca mahābhāga satataṃ saṃśitavrata । vividhānāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ tvamupāsyo bhaviṣyasi ॥60॥
html:
surāsuragaṇānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca tapodhana ।
pitṝṇāṃ ca mahābhāga satataṃ saṃśitavrata ।
vividhānāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ tvamupāsyo bhaviṣyasi ॥60॥
slp1: surAsuragaRAnAM ca fzIRAM ca tapoDana । pitFRAM ca mahABAga satataM saMSitavrata । viviDAnAM ca BUtAnAM tvamupAsyo Bavizyasi ॥60॥

text: prādurbhāvagataścāhaṃ surakāryeṣu nityadā । anuśāsyastvayā brahmanniyojyaśca suto yathā ॥61॥
html:
prādurbhāvagataścāhaṃ surakāryeṣu nityadā ।
anuśāsyastvayā brahmanniyojyaśca suto yathā ॥61॥
slp1: prAdurBAvagataScAhaM surakAryezu nityadA । anuSAsyastvayA brahmanniyojyaSca suto yaTA ॥61॥

text: etāṃścānyāṃśca rucirānbrahmaṇe'mitatejase । ahaṃ dattvā varānprīto nivṛttiparamo'bhavam ॥62॥
html:
etāṃścānyāṃśca rucirānbrahmaṇe'mitatejase ।
ahaṃ dattvā varānprīto nivṛttiparamo'bhavam ॥62॥
slp1: etAMScAnyAMSca rucirAnbrahmaRe'mitatejase । ahaM dattvA varAnprIto nivfttiparamo'Bavam ॥62॥

text: nirvāṇaṃ sarvadharmāṇāṃ nivṛttiḥ paramā smṛtā । tasmānnivṛttimāpannaścaretsarvāṅganirvṛtaḥ ॥63॥
html:
nirvāṇaṃ sarvadharmāṇāṃ nivṛttiḥ paramā smṛtā ।
tasmānnivṛttimāpannaścaretsarvāṅganirvṛtaḥ ॥63॥
slp1: nirvARaM sarvaDarmARAM nivfttiH paramA smftA । tasmAnnivfttimApannaScaretsarvANganirvftaH ॥63॥

text: vidyāsahāyavantaṃ māmādityasthaṃ sanātanam । kapilaṃ prāhurācāryāḥ sāṅkhyaniścitaniścayāḥ ॥64॥
html:
vidyāsahāyavantaṃ māmādityasthaṃ sanātanam ।
kapilaṃ prāhurācāryāḥ sāṅkhyaniścitaniścayāḥ ॥64॥
slp1: vidyAsahAyavantaM mAmAdityasTaM sanAtanam । kapilaM prAhurAcAryAH sANKyaniScitaniScayAH ॥64॥

text: hiraṇyagarbho bhagavāneṣa chandasi suṣṭutaḥ । so'haṃ yogagatirbrahmanyogaśāstreṣu śabditaḥ ॥65॥
html:
hiraṇyagarbho bhagavāneṣa chandasi suṣṭutaḥ ।
so'haṃ yogagatirbrahmanyogaśāstreṣu śabditaḥ ॥65॥
slp1: hiraRyagarBo BagavAneza Candasi suzwutaH । so'haM yogagatirbrahmanyogaSAstrezu SabditaH ॥65॥

text: eṣo'haṃ vyaktimāgamya tiṣṭhāmi divi śāśvataḥ । tato yugasahasrānte saṃhariṣye jagatpunaḥ । kṛtvātmasthāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ॥66॥
html:
eṣo'haṃ vyaktimāgamya tiṣṭhāmi divi śāśvataḥ ।
tato yugasahasrānte saṃhariṣye jagatpunaḥ ।
kṛtvātmasthāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ॥66॥
slp1: ezo'haM vyaktimAgamya tizWAmi divi SASvataH । tato yugasahasrAnte saMharizye jagatpunaH । kftvAtmasTAni BUtAni sTAvarARi carARi ca ॥66॥

text: ekākī vidyayā sārdhaṃ vihariṣye dvijottama । tato bhūyo jagatsarvaṃ kariṣyāmīha vidyayā ॥67॥
html:
ekākī vidyayā sārdhaṃ vihariṣye dvijottama ।
tato bhūyo jagatsarvaṃ kariṣyāmīha vidyayā ॥67॥
slp1: ekAkI vidyayA sArDaM viharizye dvijottama । tato BUyo jagatsarvaM karizyAmIha vidyayA ॥67॥

text: asmanmūrtiścaturthī yā sāsṛjaccheṣamavyayam । sa hi saṅkarṣaṇaḥ proktaḥ pradyumnaṃ so'pyajījanat ॥68॥
html:
asmanmūrtiścaturthī yā sāsṛjaccheṣamavyayam ।
sa hi saṅkarṣaṇaḥ proktaḥ pradyumnaṃ so'pyajījanat ॥68॥
slp1: asmanmUrtiScaturTI yA sAsfjacCezamavyayam । sa hi saNkarzaRaH proktaH pradyumnaM so'pyajIjanat ॥68॥

text: pradyumnādaniruddho'haṃ sargo mama punaḥ punaḥ । aniruddhāttathā brahmā tatrādikamalodbhavaḥ ॥69॥
html:
pradyumnādaniruddho'haṃ sargo mama punaḥ punaḥ ।
aniruddhāttathā brahmā tatrādikamalodbhavaḥ ॥69॥
slp1: pradyumnAdanirudDo'haM sargo mama punaH punaH । anirudDAttaTA brahmA tatrAdikamalodBavaH ॥69॥

text: brahmaṇaḥ sarvabhūtāni carāṇi sthāvarāṇi ca । etāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ vijānīhi kalpādiṣu punaḥ punaḥ ॥70॥
html:
brahmaṇaḥ sarvabhūtāni carāṇi sthāvarāṇi ca ।
etāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ vijānīhi kalpādiṣu punaḥ punaḥ ॥70॥
slp1: brahmaRaH sarvaBUtAni carARi sTAvarARi ca । etAM sfzwiM vijAnIhi kalpAdizu punaH punaH ॥70॥

text: yathā sūryasya gaganādudayāstamayāviha । naṣṭau punarbalātkāla ānayatyamitadyutiḥ । tathā balādahaṃ pṛthvīṃ sarvabhūtahitāya vai ॥71॥
html:
yathā sūryasya gaganādudayāstamayāviha ।
naṣṭau punarbalātkāla ānayatyamitadyutiḥ ।
tathā balādahaṃ pṛthvīṃ sarvabhūtahitāya vai ॥71॥
slp1: yaTA sUryasya gaganAdudayAstamayAviha । nazwO punarbalAtkAla AnayatyamitadyutiH । taTA balAdahaM pfTvIM sarvaBUtahitAya vE ॥71॥

text: sattvairākrāntasarvāṅgāṃ naṣṭāṃ sāgaramekhalām । ānayiṣyāmi svaṃ sthānaṃ vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ ॥72॥
html:
sattvairākrāntasarvāṅgāṃ naṣṭāṃ sāgaramekhalām ।
ānayiṣyāmi svaṃ sthānaṃ vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ ॥72॥
slp1: sattvErAkrAntasarvANgAM nazwAM sAgarameKalAm । AnayizyAmi svaM sTAnaM vArAhaM rUpamAsTitaH ॥72॥

text: hiraṇyākṣaṃ haniṣyāmi daiteyaṃ balagarvitam । nārasiṃhaṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā hiraṇyakaśipuṃ punaḥ । surakārye haniṣyāmi yajñaghnaṃ ditinandanam ॥73॥
html:
hiraṇyākṣaṃ haniṣyāmi daiteyaṃ balagarvitam ।
nārasiṃhaṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā hiraṇyakaśipuṃ punaḥ ।
surakārye haniṣyāmi yajñaghnaṃ ditinandanam ॥73॥
slp1: hiraRyAkzaM hanizyAmi dEteyaM balagarvitam । nArasiMhaM vapuH kftvA hiraRyakaSipuM punaH । surakArye hanizyAmi yajYaGnaM ditinandanam ॥73॥

text: virocanasya balavānbaliḥ putro mahāsuraḥ । bhaviṣyati sa śakraṃ ca svarājyāccyāvayiṣyati ॥74॥
html:
virocanasya balavānbaliḥ putro mahāsuraḥ ।
bhaviṣyati sa śakraṃ ca svarājyāccyāvayiṣyati ॥74॥
slp1: virocanasya balavAnbaliH putro mahAsuraH । Bavizyati sa SakraM ca svarAjyAccyAvayizyati ॥74॥

text: trailokye'pahṛte tena vimukhe ca śacīpatau । adityāṃ dvādaśaḥ putraḥ sambhaviṣyāmi kaśyapāt ॥75॥
html:
trailokye'pahṛte tena vimukhe ca śacīpatau ।
adityāṃ dvādaśaḥ putraḥ sambhaviṣyāmi kaśyapāt ॥75॥
slp1: trElokye'pahfte tena vimuKe ca SacIpatO । adityAM dvAdaSaH putraH samBavizyAmi kaSyapAt ॥75॥

text: tato rājyaṃ pradāsyāmi śakrāyāmitatejase । devatāḥ sthāpayiṣyāmi sveṣu sthāneṣu nārada । baliṃ caiva kariṣyāmi pātālatalavāsinam ॥76॥
html:
tato rājyaṃ pradāsyāmi śakrāyāmitatejase ।
devatāḥ sthāpayiṣyāmi sveṣu sthāneṣu nārada ।
baliṃ caiva kariṣyāmi pātālatalavāsinam ॥76॥
slp1: tato rAjyaM pradAsyAmi SakrAyAmitatejase । devatAH sTApayizyAmi svezu sTAnezu nArada । baliM cEva karizyAmi pAtAlatalavAsinam ॥76॥

text: tretāyuge bhaviṣyāmi rāmo bhṛgukulodvahaḥ । kṣatraṃ cotsādayiṣyāmi samṛddhabalavāhanam ॥77॥
html:
tretāyuge bhaviṣyāmi rāmo bhṛgukulodvahaḥ ।
kṣatraṃ cotsādayiṣyāmi samṛddhabalavāhanam ॥77॥
slp1: tretAyuge BavizyAmi rAmo BfgukulodvahaH । kzatraM cotsAdayizyAmi samfdDabalavAhanam ॥77॥

text: sandhau tu samanuprāpte tretāyāṃ dvāparasya ca । rāmo dāśarathirbhūtvā bhaviṣyāmi jagatpatiḥ ॥78॥
html:
sandhau tu samanuprāpte tretāyāṃ dvāparasya ca ।
rāmo dāśarathirbhūtvā bhaviṣyāmi jagatpatiḥ ॥78॥
slp1: sanDO tu samanuprApte tretAyAM dvAparasya ca । rAmo dASaraTirBUtvA BavizyAmi jagatpatiH ॥78॥

text: tritopaghātādvairūpyamekato'tha dvitastathā । prāpsyato vānaratvaṃ hi prajāpatisutāvṛṣī ॥79॥
html:
tritopaghātādvairūpyamekato'tha dvitastathā ।
prāpsyato vānaratvaṃ hi prajāpatisutāvṛṣī ॥79॥
slp1: tritopaGAtAdvErUpyamekato'Ta dvitastaTA । prApsyato vAnaratvaM hi prajApatisutAvfzI ॥79॥

text: tayorye tvanvaye jātā bhaviṣyanti vanaukasaḥ । te sahāyā bhaviṣyanti surakārye mama dvija ॥80॥
html:
tayorye tvanvaye jātā bhaviṣyanti vanaukasaḥ ।
te sahāyā bhaviṣyanti surakārye mama dvija ॥80॥
slp1: tayorye tvanvaye jAtA Bavizyanti vanOkasaH । te sahAyA Bavizyanti surakArye mama dvija ॥80॥

text: tato rakṣaḥpatiṃ ghoraṃ pulastyakulapāṃsanam । haniṣye rāvaṇaṃ saṅkhye sagaṇaṃ lokakaṇṭakam ॥81॥
html:
tato rakṣaḥpatiṃ ghoraṃ pulastyakulapāṃsanam ।
haniṣye rāvaṇaṃ saṅkhye sagaṇaṃ lokakaṇṭakam ॥81॥
slp1: tato rakzaHpatiM GoraM pulastyakulapAMsanam । hanizye rAvaRaM saNKye sagaRaM lokakaRwakam ॥81॥

text: dvāparasya kaleścaiva sandhau paryavasānike । prādurbhāvaḥ kaṃsahetormathurāyāṃ bhaviṣyati ॥82॥
html:
dvāparasya kaleścaiva sandhau paryavasānike ।
prādurbhāvaḥ kaṃsahetormathurāyāṃ bhaviṣyati ॥82॥
slp1: dvAparasya kaleScEva sanDO paryavasAnike । prAdurBAvaH kaMsahetormaTurAyAM Bavizyati ॥82॥

text: tatrāhaṃ dānavānhatvā subahūndevakaṇṭakān । kuśasthalīṃ kariṣyāmi nivāsaṃ dvārakāṃ purīm ॥83॥
html:
tatrāhaṃ dānavānhatvā subahūndevakaṇṭakān ।
kuśasthalīṃ kariṣyāmi nivāsaṃ dvārakāṃ purīm ॥83॥
slp1: tatrAhaM dAnavAnhatvA subahUndevakaRwakAn । kuSasTalIM karizyAmi nivAsaM dvArakAM purIm ॥83॥

text: vasānastatra vai puryāmaditervipriyaṅkaram । haniṣye narakaṃ bhaumaṃ muraṃ pīṭhaṃ ca dānavam ॥84॥
html:
vasānastatra vai puryāmaditervipriyaṅkaram ।
haniṣye narakaṃ bhaumaṃ muraṃ pīṭhaṃ ca dānavam ॥84॥
slp1: vasAnastatra vE puryAmaditervipriyaNkaram । hanizye narakaM BOmaM muraM pIWaM ca dAnavam ॥84॥

text: prāgjyotiṣapuraṃ ramyaṃ nānādhanasamanvitam । kuśasthalīṃ nayiṣyāmi hatvā vai dānavottamān ॥85॥
html:
prāgjyotiṣapuraṃ ramyaṃ nānādhanasamanvitam ।
kuśasthalīṃ nayiṣyāmi hatvā vai dānavottamān ॥85॥
slp1: prAgjyotizapuraM ramyaM nAnADanasamanvitam । kuSasTalIM nayizyAmi hatvA vE dAnavottamAn ॥85॥

text: śaṅkaraṃ ca mahāsenaṃ bāṇapriyahitaiṣiṇam । parājeṣyāmyathodyuktau devalokanamaskṛtau ॥86॥
html:
śaṅkaraṃ ca mahāsenaṃ bāṇapriyahitaiṣiṇam ।
parājeṣyāmyathodyuktau devalokanamaskṛtau ॥86॥
slp1: SaNkaraM ca mahAsenaM bARapriyahitEziRam । parAjezyAmyaTodyuktO devalokanamaskftO ॥86॥

text: tataḥ sutaṃ balerjitvā bāṇaṃ bāhusahasriṇam । vināśayiṣyāmi tataḥ sarvānsaubhanivāsinaḥ ॥87॥
html:
tataḥ sutaṃ balerjitvā bāṇaṃ bāhusahasriṇam ।
vināśayiṣyāmi tataḥ sarvānsaubhanivāsinaḥ ॥87॥
slp1: tataH sutaM balerjitvA bARaM bAhusahasriRam । vinASayizyAmi tataH sarvAnsOBanivAsinaH ॥87॥

text: yaḥ kālayavanaḥ khyāto gargatejobhisaṃvṛtaḥ । bhaviṣyati vadhastasya matta eva dvijottama ॥88॥
html:
yaḥ kālayavanaḥ khyāto gargatejobhisaṃvṛtaḥ ।
bhaviṣyati vadhastasya matta eva dvijottama ॥88॥
slp1: yaH kAlayavanaH KyAto gargatejoBisaMvftaH । Bavizyati vaDastasya matta eva dvijottama ॥88॥

text: jarāsandhaśca balavānsarvarājavirodhakaḥ । bhaviṣyatyasuraḥ sphīto bhūmipālo girivraje । mama buddhiparispandādvadhastasya bhaviṣyati ॥89॥
html:
jarāsandhaśca balavānsarvarājavirodhakaḥ ।
bhaviṣyatyasuraḥ sphīto bhūmipālo girivraje ।
mama buddhiparispandādvadhastasya bhaviṣyati ॥89॥
slp1: jarAsanDaSca balavAnsarvarAjaviroDakaH । BavizyatyasuraH sPIto BUmipAlo girivraje । mama budDiparispandAdvaDastasya Bavizyati ॥89॥

text: samāgateṣu baliṣu pṛthivyāṃ sarvarājasu । vāsaviḥ susahāyo vai mama hyeko bhaviṣyati ॥90॥
html:
samāgateṣu baliṣu pṛthivyāṃ sarvarājasu ।
vāsaviḥ susahāyo vai mama hyeko bhaviṣyati ॥90॥
slp1: samAgatezu balizu pfTivyAM sarvarAjasu । vAsaviH susahAyo vE mama hyeko Bavizyati ॥90॥

text: evaṃ lokā vadiṣyanti naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī । udyuktau dahataḥ kṣatraṃ lokakāryārthamīśvarau ॥91॥
html:
evaṃ lokā vadiṣyanti naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ।
udyuktau dahataḥ kṣatraṃ lokakāryārthamīśvarau ॥91॥
slp1: evaM lokA vadizyanti naranArAyaRAvfzI । udyuktO dahataH kzatraM lokakAryArTamISvarO ॥91॥

text: kṛtvā bhārāvataraṇaṃ vasudhāyā yathepsitam । sarvasātvatamukhyānāṃ dvārakāyāśca sattama । kariṣye pralayaṃ ghoramātmajñātivināśanam ॥92॥
html:
kṛtvā bhārāvataraṇaṃ vasudhāyā yathepsitam ।
sarvasātvatamukhyānāṃ dvārakāyāśca sattama ।
kariṣye pralayaṃ ghoramātmajñātivināśanam ॥92॥
slp1: kftvA BArAvataraRaM vasuDAyA yaTepsitam । sarvasAtvatamuKyAnAM dvArakAyASca sattama । karizye pralayaM GoramAtmajYAtivinASanam ॥92॥

text: karmāṇyaparimeyāni caturmūrtidharo hyaham । kṛtvā lokāngamiṣyāmi svānahaṃ brahmasatkṛtān ॥93॥
html:
karmāṇyaparimeyāni caturmūrtidharo hyaham ।
kṛtvā lokāngamiṣyāmi svānahaṃ brahmasatkṛtān ॥93॥
slp1: karmARyaparimeyAni caturmUrtiDaro hyaham । kftvA lokAngamizyAmi svAnahaM brahmasatkftAn ॥93॥

text: haṃso hayaśirāścaiva prādurbhāvā dvijottama । yadā vedaśrutirnaṣṭā mayā pratyāhṛtā tadā । savedāḥ saśrutīkāśca kṛtāḥ pūrvaṃ kṛte yuge ॥94॥
html:
haṃso hayaśirāścaiva prādurbhāvā dvijottama ।
yadā vedaśrutirnaṣṭā mayā pratyāhṛtā tadā ।
savedāḥ saśrutīkāśca kṛtāḥ pūrvaṃ kṛte yuge ॥94॥
slp1: haMso hayaSirAScEva prAdurBAvA dvijottama । yadA vedaSrutirnazwA mayA pratyAhftA tadA । savedAH saSrutIkASca kftAH pUrvaM kfte yuge ॥94॥

text: atikrāntāḥ purāṇeṣu śrutāste yadi vā kvacit । atikrāntāśca bahavaḥ prādurbhāvā mamottamāḥ । lokakāryāṇi kṛtvā ca punaḥ svāṃ prakṛtiṃ gatāḥ ॥95॥
html:
atikrāntāḥ purāṇeṣu śrutāste yadi vā kvacit ।
atikrāntāśca bahavaḥ prādurbhāvā mamottamāḥ ।
lokakāryāṇi kṛtvā ca punaḥ svāṃ prakṛtiṃ gatāḥ ॥95॥
slp1: atikrAntAH purARezu SrutAste yadi vA kvacit । atikrAntASca bahavaH prAdurBAvA mamottamAH । lokakAryARi kftvA ca punaH svAM prakftiM gatAH ॥95॥

text: na hyetadbrahmaṇā prāptamīdṛśaṃ mama darśanam । yattvayā prāptamadyeha ekāntagatabuddhinā ॥96॥
html:
na hyetadbrahmaṇā prāptamīdṛśaṃ mama darśanam ।
yattvayā prāptamadyeha ekāntagatabuddhinā ॥96॥
slp1: na hyetadbrahmaRA prAptamIdfSaM mama darSanam । yattvayA prAptamadyeha ekAntagatabudDinA ॥96॥

text: etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ brahmanbhaktimato mayā । purāṇaṃ ca bhaviṣyaṃ ca sarahasyaṃ ca sattama ॥97॥
html:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ brahmanbhaktimato mayā ।
purāṇaṃ ca bhaviṣyaṃ ca sarahasyaṃ ca sattama ॥97॥
slp1: etatte sarvamAKyAtaM brahmanBaktimato mayA । purARaM ca BavizyaM ca sarahasyaM ca sattama ॥97॥

text: evaṃ sa bhagavāndevo viśvamūrtidharo'vyayaḥ । etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata ॥98॥
html:
evaṃ sa bhagavāndevo viśvamūrtidharo'vyayaḥ ।
etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata ॥98॥
slp1: evaM sa BagavAndevo viSvamUrtiDaro'vyayaH । etAvaduktvA vacanaM tatrEvAntaraDIyata ॥98॥

text: nārado'pi mahātejāḥ prāpyānugrahamīpsitam । naranārāyaṇau draṣṭuṃ prādravadbadarāśramam ॥99॥
html:
nārado'pi mahātejāḥ prāpyānugrahamīpsitam ।
naranārāyaṇau draṣṭuṃ prādravadbadarāśramam ॥99॥
slp1: nArado'pi mahAtejAH prApyAnugrahamIpsitam । naranArAyaRO drazwuM prAdravadbadarASramam ॥99॥

text: idaṃ mahopaniṣadaṃ caturvedasamanvitam । sāṅkhyayogakṛtaṃ tena pañcarātrānuśabditam ॥100॥
html:
idaṃ mahopaniṣadaṃ caturvedasamanvitam ।
sāṅkhyayogakṛtaṃ tena pañcarātrānuśabditam ॥100॥
slp1: idaM mahopanizadaM caturvedasamanvitam । sANKyayogakftaM tena paYcarAtrAnuSabditam ॥100॥

text: nārāyaṇamukhodgītaṃ nārado'śrāvayatpunaḥ । brahmaṇaḥ sadane tāta yathā dṛṣṭaṃ yathā śrutam ॥101॥
html:
nārāyaṇamukhodgītaṃ nārado'śrāvayatpunaḥ ।
brahmaṇaḥ sadane tāta yathā dṛṣṭaṃ yathā śrutam ॥101॥
slp1: nArAyaRamuKodgItaM nArado'SrAvayatpunaH । brahmaRaH sadane tAta yaTA dfzwaM yaTA Srutam ॥101॥

text: etadāścaryabhūtaṃ hi māhātmyaṃ tasya dhīmataḥ । kiṃ brahmā na vijānīte yataḥ śuśrāva nāradāt ॥102॥
html:
etadāścaryabhūtaṃ hi māhātmyaṃ tasya dhīmataḥ ।
kiṃ brahmā na vijānīte yataḥ śuśrāva nāradāt ॥102॥
slp1: etadAScaryaBUtaM hi mAhAtmyaM tasya DImataH । kiM brahmA na vijAnIte yataH SuSrAva nAradAt ॥102॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: pitāmaho hi bhagavāṃstasmāddevādanantaraḥ । kathaṃ sa na vijānīyātprabhāvamamitaujasaḥ ॥103॥
html:
pitāmaho hi bhagavāṃstasmāddevādanantaraḥ ।
kathaṃ sa na vijānīyātprabhāvamamitaujasaḥ ॥103॥
slp1: pitAmaho hi BagavAMstasmAddevAdanantaraH । kaTaM sa na vijAnIyAtpraBAvamamitOjasaH ॥103॥

text: mahākalpasahasrāṇi mahākalpaśatāni ca । samatītāni rājendra sargāśca pralayāśca ha ॥104॥
html:
mahākalpasahasrāṇi mahākalpaśatāni ca ।
samatītāni rājendra sargāśca pralayāśca ha ॥104॥
slp1: mahAkalpasahasrARi mahAkalpaSatAni ca । samatItAni rAjendra sargASca pralayASca ha ॥104॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sargasyādau smṛto brahmā prajāsargakaraḥ prabhuḥ । jānāti devapravaraṃ bhūyaścāto'dhikaṃ nṛpa । paramātmānamīśānamātmanaḥ prabhavaṃ tathā ॥105॥
html:
sargasyādau smṛto brahmā prajāsargakaraḥ prabhuḥ ।
jānāti devapravaraṃ bhūyaścāto'dhikaṃ nṛpa ।
paramātmānamīśānamātmanaḥ prabhavaṃ tathā ॥105॥
slp1: sargasyAdO smfto brahmA prajAsargakaraH praBuH । jAnAti devapravaraM BUyaScAto'DikaM nfpa । paramAtmAnamISAnamAtmanaH praBavaM taTA ॥105॥

text: ye tvanye brahmasadane siddhasaṅghāḥ samāgatāḥ । tebhyastacchrāvayāmāsa purāṇaṃ vedasammitam ॥106॥
html:
ye tvanye brahmasadane siddhasaṅghāḥ samāgatāḥ ।
tebhyastacchrāvayāmāsa purāṇaṃ vedasammitam ॥106॥
slp1: ye tvanye brahmasadane sidDasaNGAH samAgatAH । teByastacCrAvayAmAsa purARaM vedasammitam ॥106॥

text: teṣāṃ sakāśātsūryaśca śrutvā vai bhāvitātmanām । ātmānugāmināṃ brahma śrāvayāmāsa bhārata ॥107॥
html:
teṣāṃ sakāśātsūryaśca śrutvā vai bhāvitātmanām ।
ātmānugāmināṃ brahma śrāvayāmāsa bhārata ॥107॥
slp1: tezAM sakASAtsUryaSca SrutvA vE BAvitAtmanAm । AtmAnugAminAM brahma SrAvayAmAsa BArata ॥107॥

text: ṣaṭṣaṣṭirhi sahasrāṇi ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām । sūryasya tapato lokānnirmitā ye puraḥsarāḥ । teṣāmakathayatsūryaḥ sarveṣāṃ bhāvitātmanām ॥108॥
html:
ṣaṭṣaṣṭirhi sahasrāṇi ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām ।
sūryasya tapato lokānnirmitā ye puraḥsarāḥ ।
teṣāmakathayatsūryaḥ sarveṣāṃ bhāvitātmanām ॥108॥
slp1: zawzazwirhi sahasrARi fzIRAM BAvitAtmanAm । sUryasya tapato lokAnnirmitA ye puraHsarAH । tezAmakaTayatsUryaH sarvezAM BAvitAtmanAm ॥108॥

text: sūryānugāmibhistāta ṛṣibhistairmahātmabhiḥ । merau samāgatā devāḥ śrāvitāścedamuttamam ॥109॥
html:
sūryānugāmibhistāta ṛṣibhistairmahātmabhiḥ ।
merau samāgatā devāḥ śrāvitāścedamuttamam ॥109॥
slp1: sUryAnugAmiBistAta fziBistErmahAtmaBiH । merO samAgatA devAH SrAvitAScedamuttamam ॥109॥

text: devānāṃ tu sakāśādvai tataḥ śrutvāsito dvijaḥ । śrāvayāmāsa rājendra pitṝṇāṃ munisattamaḥ ॥110॥
html:
devānāṃ tu sakāśādvai tataḥ śrutvāsito dvijaḥ ।
śrāvayāmāsa rājendra pitṝṇāṃ munisattamaḥ ॥110॥
slp1: devAnAM tu sakASAdvE tataH SrutvAsito dvijaH । SrAvayAmAsa rAjendra pitFRAM munisattamaH ॥110॥

text: mama cāpi pitā tāta kathayāmāsa śantanuḥ । tato mayaitacchrutvā ca kīrtitaṃ tava bhārata ॥111॥
html:
mama cāpi pitā tāta kathayāmāsa śantanuḥ ।
tato mayaitacchrutvā ca kīrtitaṃ tava bhārata ॥111॥
slp1: mama cApi pitA tAta kaTayAmAsa SantanuH । tato mayEtacCrutvA ca kIrtitaM tava BArata ॥111॥

text: surairvā munibhirvāpi purāṇaṃ yairidaṃ śrutam । sarve te paramātmānaṃ pūjayanti punaḥ punaḥ ॥112॥
html:
surairvā munibhirvāpi purāṇaṃ yairidaṃ śrutam ।
sarve te paramātmānaṃ pūjayanti punaḥ punaḥ ॥112॥
slp1: surErvA muniBirvApi purARaM yEridaM Srutam । sarve te paramAtmAnaM pUjayanti punaH punaH ॥112॥

text: idamākhyānamārṣeyaṃ pāramparyāgataṃ nṛpa । nāvāsudevabhaktāya tvayā deyaṃ kathañcana ॥113॥
html:
idamākhyānamārṣeyaṃ pāramparyāgataṃ nṛpa ।
nāvāsudevabhaktāya tvayā deyaṃ kathañcana ॥113॥
slp1: idamAKyAnamArzeyaM pAramparyAgataM nfpa । nAvAsudevaBaktAya tvayA deyaM kaTaYcana ॥113॥

text: matto'nyāni ca te rājannupākhyānaśatāni vai । yāni śrutāni dharmyāṇi teṣāṃ sāro'yamuddhṛtaḥ ॥114॥
html:
matto'nyāni ca te rājannupākhyānaśatāni vai ।
yāni śrutāni dharmyāṇi teṣāṃ sāro'yamuddhṛtaḥ ॥114॥
slp1: matto'nyAni ca te rAjannupAKyAnaSatAni vE । yAni SrutAni DarmyARi tezAM sAro'yamudDftaH ॥114॥

text: surāsurairyathā rājannirmathyāmṛtamuddhṛtam । evametatpurā vipraiḥ kathāmṛtamihoddhṛtam ॥115॥
html:
surāsurairyathā rājannirmathyāmṛtamuddhṛtam ।
evametatpurā vipraiḥ kathāmṛtamihoddhṛtam ॥115॥
slp1: surAsurEryaTA rAjannirmaTyAmftamudDftam । evametatpurA viprEH kaTAmftamihodDftam ॥115॥

text: yaścedaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyānnaraḥ । ekāntabhāvopagata ekānte susamāhitaḥ ॥116॥
html:
yaścedaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyānnaraḥ ।
ekāntabhāvopagata ekānte susamāhitaḥ ॥116॥
slp1: yaScedaM paWate nityaM yaScedaM SfRuyAnnaraH । ekAntaBAvopagata ekAnte susamAhitaH ॥116॥

text: prāpya śvetaṃ mahādvīpaṃ bhūtvā candraprabho naraḥ । sa sahasrārciṣaṃ devaṃ praviśennātra saṃśayaḥ ॥117॥
html:
prāpya śvetaṃ mahādvīpaṃ bhūtvā candraprabho naraḥ ।
sa sahasrārciṣaṃ devaṃ praviśennātra saṃśayaḥ ॥117॥
slp1: prApya SvetaM mahAdvIpaM BUtvA candrapraBo naraH । sa sahasrArcizaM devaM praviSennAtra saMSayaH ॥117॥

text: mucyedārtastathā rogācchrutvemāmāditaḥ kathām । jijñāsurlabhate kāmānbhakto bhaktagatiṃ vrajet ॥118॥
html:
mucyedārtastathā rogācchrutvemāmāditaḥ kathām ।
jijñāsurlabhate kāmānbhakto bhaktagatiṃ vrajet ॥118॥
slp1: mucyedArtastaTA rogAcCrutvemAmAditaH kaTAm । jijYAsurlaBate kAmAnBakto BaktagatiM vrajet ॥118॥

text: tvayāpi satataṃ rājannabhyarcyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ । sa hi mātā pitā caiva kṛtsnasya jagato guruḥ ॥119॥
html:
tvayāpi satataṃ rājannabhyarcyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
sa hi mātā pitā caiva kṛtsnasya jagato guruḥ ॥119॥
slp1: tvayApi satataM rAjannaByarcyaH puruzottamaH । sa hi mAtA pitA cEva kftsnasya jagato guruH ॥119॥

text: brahmaṇyadevo bhagavānprīyatāṃ te sanātanaḥ । yudhiṣṭhira mahābāho mahābāhurjanārdanaḥ ॥120॥
html:
brahmaṇyadevo bhagavānprīyatāṃ te sanātanaḥ ।
yudhiṣṭhira mahābāho mahābāhurjanārdanaḥ ॥120॥
slp1: brahmaRyadevo BagavAnprIyatAM te sanAtanaH । yuDizWira mahAbAho mahAbAhurjanArdanaH ॥120॥

text: śrutvaitadākhyānavaraṃ dharmarāḍjanamejaya । bhrātaraścāsya te sarve nārāyaṇaparābhavan ॥121॥
html:
śrutvaitadākhyānavaraṃ dharmarāḍjanamejaya ।
bhrātaraścāsya te sarve nārāyaṇaparābhavan ॥121॥
slp1: SrutvEtadAKyAnavaraM DarmarAqjanamejaya । BrAtaraScAsya te sarve nArAyaRaparABavan ॥121॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: jitaṃ bhagavatā tena puruṣeṇeti bhārata । nityaṃ japyaparā bhūtvā sarasvatīmudīrayan ॥122॥
html:
jitaṃ bhagavatā tena puruṣeṇeti bhārata ।
nityaṃ japyaparā bhūtvā sarasvatīmudīrayan ॥122॥
slp1: jitaM BagavatA tena puruzeReti BArata । nityaM japyaparA BUtvA sarasvatImudIrayan ॥122॥

text: yo hyasmākaṃ guruḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ । sa jagau paramaṃ japyaṃ nārāyaṇamudīrayan ॥123॥
html:
yo hyasmākaṃ guruḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ ।
sa jagau paramaṃ japyaṃ nārāyaṇamudīrayan ॥123॥
slp1: yo hyasmAkaM guruH SrezWaH kfzRadvEpAyano muniH । sa jagO paramaM japyaM nArAyaRamudIrayan ॥123॥

text: gatvāntarikṣātsatataṃ kṣīrodamamṛtāśayam । pūjayitvā ca deveśaṃ punarāyātsvamāśramam] ॥124॥
html:
gatvāntarikṣātsatataṃ kṣīrodamamṛtāśayam ।
pūjayitvā ca deveśaṃ punarāyātsvamāśramam] ॥124॥
slp1: gatvAntarikzAtsatataM kzIrodamamftASayam । pUjayitvA ca deveSaM punarAyAtsvamASramam] ॥124॥

text: kathaṃ sa bhagavāndevo yajñeṣvagraharaḥ prabhuḥ । yajñadhārī ca satataṃ vedavedāṅgavittathā ॥1॥
html:
kathaṃ sa bhagavāndevo yajñeṣvagraharaḥ prabhuḥ ।
yajñadhārī ca satataṃ vedavedāṅgavittathā ॥1॥
slp1: kaTaM sa BagavAndevo yajYezvagraharaH praBuH । yajYaDArI ca satataM vedavedANgavittaTA ॥1॥
author: janamejaya uvāca ।

text: nivṛttaṃ cāsthito dharmaṃ kṣemī bhāgavatapriyaḥ । pravṛttidharmānvidadhe sa eva bhagavānprabhuḥ ॥2॥
html:
nivṛttaṃ cāsthito dharmaṃ kṣemī bhāgavatapriyaḥ ।
pravṛttidharmānvidadhe sa eva bhagavānprabhuḥ ॥2॥
slp1: nivfttaM cAsTito DarmaM kzemI BAgavatapriyaH । pravfttiDarmAnvidaDe sa eva BagavAnpraBuH ॥2॥

text: kathaṃ pravṛttidharmeṣu bhāgārhā devatāḥ kṛtāḥ । kathaṃ nivṛttidharmāśca kṛtā vyāvṛttabuddhayaḥ ॥3॥
html:
kathaṃ pravṛttidharmeṣu bhāgārhā devatāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
kathaṃ nivṛttidharmāśca kṛtā vyāvṛttabuddhayaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: kaTaM pravfttiDarmezu BAgArhA devatAH kftAH । kaTaM nivfttiDarmASca kftA vyAvfttabudDayaH ॥3॥

text: etaṃ naḥ saṃśayaṃ vipra chindhi guhyaṃ sanātanam । tvayā nārāyaṇakathā śrutā vai dharmasaṃhitā ॥4॥
html:
etaṃ naḥ saṃśayaṃ vipra chindhi guhyaṃ sanātanam ।
tvayā nārāyaṇakathā śrutā vai dharmasaṃhitā ॥4॥
slp1: etaM naH saMSayaM vipra CinDi guhyaM sanAtanam । tvayA nArAyaRakaTA SrutA vE DarmasaMhitA ॥4॥

text: ime sabrahmakā lokāḥ sasurāsuramānavāḥ । kriyāsvabhyudayoktāsu saktā dṛśyanti sarvaśaḥ । mokṣaścoktastvayā brahmannirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ sukham ॥5॥
html:
ime sabrahmakā lokāḥ sasurāsuramānavāḥ ।
kriyāsvabhyudayoktāsu saktā dṛśyanti sarvaśaḥ ।
mokṣaścoktastvayā brahmannirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ sukham ॥5॥
slp1: ime sabrahmakA lokAH sasurAsuramAnavAH । kriyAsvaByudayoktAsu saktA dfSyanti sarvaSaH । mokzaScoktastvayA brahmannirvARaM paramaM suKam ॥5॥

text: ye ca muktā bhavantīha puṇyapāpavivarjitāḥ । te sahasrārciṣaṃ devaṃ praviśantīti śuśrumaḥ ॥6॥
html:
ye ca muktā bhavantīha puṇyapāpavivarjitāḥ ।
te sahasrārciṣaṃ devaṃ praviśantīti śuśrumaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: ye ca muktA BavantIha puRyapApavivarjitAH । te sahasrArcizaM devaM praviSantIti SuSrumaH ॥6॥

text: aho hi duranuṣṭheyo mokṣadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ । yaṃ hitvā devatāḥ sarvā havyakavyabhujo'bhavan ॥7॥
html:
aho hi duranuṣṭheyo mokṣadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
yaṃ hitvā devatāḥ sarvā havyakavyabhujo'bhavan ॥7॥
slp1: aho hi duranuzWeyo mokzaDarmaH sanAtanaH । yaM hitvA devatAH sarvA havyakavyaBujo'Bavan ॥7॥

text: kiṃ nu brahmā ca rudraśca śakraśca balabhitprabhuḥ । sūryastārādhipo vāyuragnirvaruṇa eva ca । ākāśaṃ jagatī caiva ye ca śeṣā divaukasaḥ ॥8॥
html:
kiṃ nu brahmā ca rudraśca śakraśca balabhitprabhuḥ ।
sūryastārādhipo vāyuragnirvaruṇa eva ca ।
ākāśaṃ jagatī caiva ye ca śeṣā divaukasaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: kiM nu brahmA ca rudraSca SakraSca balaBitpraBuH । sUryastArADipo vAyuragnirvaruRa eva ca । AkASaM jagatI cEva ye ca SezA divOkasaH ॥8॥

text: pralayaṃ na vijānanti ātmanaḥ parinirmitam । tataste nāsthitā mārgaṃ dhruvamakṣayamavyayam ॥9॥
html:
pralayaṃ na vijānanti ātmanaḥ parinirmitam ।
tataste nāsthitā mārgaṃ dhruvamakṣayamavyayam ॥9॥
slp1: pralayaM na vijAnanti AtmanaH parinirmitam । tataste nAsTitA mArgaM Druvamakzayamavyayam ॥9॥

text: smṛtvā kālaparīmāṇaṃ pravṛttiṃ ye samāsthitāḥ । doṣaḥ kālaparīmāṇe mahāneṣa kriyāvatām ॥10॥
html:
smṛtvā kālaparīmāṇaṃ pravṛttiṃ ye samāsthitāḥ ।
doṣaḥ kālaparīmāṇe mahāneṣa kriyāvatām ॥10॥
slp1: smftvA kAlaparImARaM pravfttiM ye samAsTitAH । dozaH kAlaparImARe mahAneza kriyAvatAm ॥10॥

text: etanme saṃśayaṃ vipra hṛdi śalyamivārpitam । chindhītihāsakathanātparaṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ॥11॥
html:
etanme saṃśayaṃ vipra hṛdi śalyamivārpitam ।
chindhītihāsakathanātparaṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ॥11॥
slp1: etanme saMSayaM vipra hfdi SalyamivArpitam । CinDItihAsakaTanAtparaM kOtUhalaM hi me ॥11॥

text: kathaṃ bhāgaharāḥ proktā devatāḥ kratuṣu dvija । kimarthaṃ cādhvare brahmannijyante tridivaukasaḥ ॥12॥
html:
kathaṃ bhāgaharāḥ proktā devatāḥ kratuṣu dvija ।
kimarthaṃ cādhvare brahmannijyante tridivaukasaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: kaTaM BAgaharAH proktA devatAH kratuzu dvija । kimarTaM cADvare brahmannijyante tridivOkasaH ॥12॥

text: ye ca bhāgaṃ pragṛhṇanti yajñeṣu dvijasattama । te yajanto mahāyajñaiḥ kasya bhāgaṃ dadanti vai ॥13॥
html:
ye ca bhāgaṃ pragṛhṇanti yajñeṣu dvijasattama ।
te yajanto mahāyajñaiḥ kasya bhāgaṃ dadanti vai ॥13॥
slp1: ye ca BAgaM pragfhRanti yajYezu dvijasattama । te yajanto mahAyajYEH kasya BAgaM dadanti vE ॥13॥

text: aho gūḍhatamaḥ praśnastvayā pṛṣṭo janeśvara । nātaptatapasā hyeṣa nāvedaviduṣā tathā । nāpurāṇavidā cāpi śakyo vyāhartumañjasā ॥14॥
html:
aho gūḍhatamaḥ praśnastvayā pṛṣṭo janeśvara ।
nātaptatapasā hyeṣa nāvedaviduṣā tathā ।
nāpurāṇavidā cāpi śakyo vyāhartumañjasā ॥14॥
slp1: aho gUQatamaH praSnastvayA pfzwo janeSvara । nAtaptatapasA hyeza nAvedaviduzA taTA । nApurARavidA cApi Sakyo vyAhartumaYjasA ॥14॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi yanme pṛṣṭaḥ purā guruḥ । kṛṣṇadvaipāyano vyāso vedavyāso mahānṛṣiḥ ॥15॥
html:
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi yanme pṛṣṭaḥ purā guruḥ ।
kṛṣṇadvaipāyano vyāso vedavyāso mahānṛṣiḥ ॥15॥
slp1: hanta te kaTayizyAmi yanme pfzwaH purA guruH । kfzRadvEpAyano vyAso vedavyAso mahAnfziH ॥15॥

text: sumanturjaiminiścaiva pailaśca sudṛḍhavrataḥ । ahaṃ caturthaḥ śiṣyo vai pañcamaśca śukaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥16॥
html:
sumanturjaiminiścaiva pailaśca sudṛḍhavrataḥ ।
ahaṃ caturthaḥ śiṣyo vai pañcamaśca śukaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: sumanturjEminiScEva pElaSca sudfQavrataH । ahaM caturTaH Sizyo vE paYcamaSca SukaH smftaH ॥16॥

text: etānsamāgatānsarvānpañca śiṣyāndamānvitān । śaucācārasamāyuktāñjitakrodhāñjitendriyān ॥17॥
html:
etānsamāgatānsarvānpañca śiṣyāndamānvitān ।
śaucācārasamāyuktāñjitakrodhāñjitendriyān ॥17॥
slp1: etAnsamAgatAnsarvAnpaYca SizyAndamAnvitAn । SOcAcArasamAyuktAYjitakroDAYjitendriyAn ॥17॥

text: vedānadhyāpayāmāsa mahābhāratapañcamān । merau girivare ramye siddhacāraṇasevite ॥18॥
html:
vedānadhyāpayāmāsa mahābhāratapañcamān ।
merau girivare ramye siddhacāraṇasevite ॥18॥
slp1: vedAnaDyApayAmAsa mahABAratapaYcamAn । merO girivare ramye sidDacAraRasevite ॥18॥

text: teṣāmabhyasyatāṃ vedānkadācitsaṃśayo'bhavat । eṣa vai yastvayā pṛṣṭastena teṣāṃ prakīrtitaḥ । tataḥ śruto mayā cāpi tavākhyeyo'dya bhārata ॥19॥
html:
teṣāmabhyasyatāṃ vedānkadācitsaṃśayo'bhavat ।
eṣa vai yastvayā pṛṣṭastena teṣāṃ prakīrtitaḥ ।
tataḥ śruto mayā cāpi tavākhyeyo'dya bhārata ॥19॥
slp1: tezAmaByasyatAM vedAnkadAcitsaMSayo'Bavat । eza vE yastvayA pfzwastena tezAM prakIrtitaH । tataH Sruto mayA cApi tavAKyeyo'dya BArata ॥19॥

text: śiṣyāṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā sarvājñānatamonudaḥ । parāśarasutaḥ śrīmānvyāso vākyamuvāca ha ॥20॥
html:
śiṣyāṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā sarvājñānatamonudaḥ ।
parāśarasutaḥ śrīmānvyāso vākyamuvāca ha ॥20॥
slp1: SizyARAM vacanaM SrutvA sarvAjYAnatamonudaH । parASarasutaH SrImAnvyAso vAkyamuvAca ha ॥20॥

text: mayā hi sumahattaptaṃ tapaḥ paramadāruṇam । bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca jānīyāmiti sattamāḥ ॥21॥
html:
mayā hi sumahattaptaṃ tapaḥ paramadāruṇam ।
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca jānīyāmiti sattamāḥ ॥21॥
slp1: mayA hi sumahattaptaM tapaH paramadAruRam । BUtaM BavyaM Bavizyacca jAnIyAmiti sattamAH ॥21॥

text: tasya me taptatapaso nigṛhītendriyasya ca । nārāyaṇaprasādena kṣīrodasyānukūlataḥ ॥22॥
html:
tasya me taptatapaso nigṛhītendriyasya ca ।
nārāyaṇaprasādena kṣīrodasyānukūlataḥ ॥22॥
slp1: tasya me taptatapaso nigfhItendriyasya ca । nArAyaRaprasAdena kzIrodasyAnukUlataH ॥22॥

text: traikālikamidaṃ jñānaṃ prādurbhūtaṃ yathepsitam । tacchṛṇudhvaṃ yathājñānaṃ vakṣye saṃśayamuttamam । yathā vṛttaṃ hi kalpādau dṛṣṭaṃ me jñānacakṣuṣā ॥23॥
html:
traikālikamidaṃ jñānaṃ prādurbhūtaṃ yathepsitam ।
tacchṛṇudhvaṃ yathājñānaṃ vakṣye saṃśayamuttamam ।
yathā vṛttaṃ hi kalpādau dṛṣṭaṃ me jñānacakṣuṣā ॥23॥
slp1: trEkAlikamidaM jYAnaM prAdurBUtaM yaTepsitam । tacCfRuDvaM yaTAjYAnaM vakzye saMSayamuttamam । yaTA vfttaM hi kalpAdO dfzwaM me jYAnacakzuzA ॥23॥

text: paramātmeti yaṃ prāhuḥ sāṅkhyayogavido janāḥ । mahāpuruṣasañjñāṃ sa labhate svena karmaṇā ॥24॥
html:
paramātmeti yaṃ prāhuḥ sāṅkhyayogavido janāḥ ।
mahāpuruṣasañjñāṃ sa labhate svena karmaṇā ॥24॥
slp1: paramAtmeti yaM prAhuH sANKyayogavido janAH । mahApuruzasaYjYAM sa laBate svena karmaRA ॥24॥

text: tasmātprasūtamavyaktaṃ pradhānaṃ tadvidurbudhāḥ । avyaktādvyaktamutpannaṃ lokasṛṣṭyarthamīśvarāt ॥25॥
html:
tasmātprasūtamavyaktaṃ pradhānaṃ tadvidurbudhāḥ ।
avyaktādvyaktamutpannaṃ lokasṛṣṭyarthamīśvarāt ॥25॥
slp1: tasmAtprasUtamavyaktaM praDAnaM tadvidurbuDAH । avyaktAdvyaktamutpannaM lokasfzwyarTamISvarAt ॥25॥

text: aniruddho hi lokeṣu mahānātmeti kathyate । yo'sau vyaktatvamāpanno nirmame ca pitāmaham । so'haṅkāra iti proktaḥ sarvatejomayo hi saḥ ॥26॥
html:
aniruddho hi lokeṣu mahānātmeti kathyate ।
yo'sau vyaktatvamāpanno nirmame ca pitāmaham ।
so'haṅkāra iti proktaḥ sarvatejomayo hi saḥ ॥26॥
slp1: anirudDo hi lokezu mahAnAtmeti kaTyate । yo'sO vyaktatvamApanno nirmame ca pitAmaham । so'haNkAra iti proktaH sarvatejomayo hi saH ॥26॥

text: pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam । ahaṅkāraprasūtāni mahābhūtāni bhārata ॥27॥
html:
pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam ।
ahaṅkāraprasūtāni mahābhūtāni bhārata ॥27॥
slp1: pfTivI vAyurAkASamApo jyotiSca paYcamam । ahaNkAraprasUtAni mahABUtAni BArata ॥27॥

text: mahābhūtāni sṛṣṭvātha tadguṇānnirmame punaḥ । bhūtebhyaścaiva niṣpannā mūrtimanto'ṣṭa tāñśṛṇu ॥28॥
html:
mahābhūtāni sṛṣṭvātha tadguṇānnirmame punaḥ ।
bhūtebhyaścaiva niṣpannā mūrtimanto'ṣṭa tāñśṛṇu ॥28॥
slp1: mahABUtAni sfzwvATa tadguRAnnirmame punaH । BUteByaScEva nizpannA mUrtimanto'zwa tAYSfRu ॥28॥

text: marīciraṅgirāścātriḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ । vasiṣṭhaśca mahātmā vai manuḥ svāyambhuvastathā । jñeyāḥ prakṛtayo'ṣṭau tā yāsu lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ॥29॥
html:
marīciraṅgirāścātriḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ ।
vasiṣṭhaśca mahātmā vai manuḥ svāyambhuvastathā ।
jñeyāḥ prakṛtayo'ṣṭau tā yāsu lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ॥29॥
slp1: marIciraNgirAScAtriH pulastyaH pulahaH kratuH । vasizWaSca mahAtmA vE manuH svAyamBuvastaTA । jYeyAH prakftayo'zwO tA yAsu lokAH pratizWitAH ॥29॥

text: vedānvedāṅgasaṃyuktānyajñānyajñāṅgasaṃyutān । nirmame lokasiddhyarthaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ । aṣṭābhyaḥ prakṛtibhyaśca jātaṃ viśvamidaṃ jagat ॥30॥
html:
vedānvedāṅgasaṃyuktānyajñānyajñāṅgasaṃyutān ।
nirmame lokasiddhyarthaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ।
aṣṭābhyaḥ prakṛtibhyaśca jātaṃ viśvamidaṃ jagat ॥30॥
slp1: vedAnvedANgasaMyuktAnyajYAnyajYANgasaMyutAn । nirmame lokasidDyarTaM brahmA lokapitAmahaH । azwAByaH prakftiByaSca jAtaM viSvamidaM jagat ॥30॥

text: rudro roṣātmako jāto daśānyānso'sṛjatsvayam । ekādaśaite rudrāstu vikārāḥ puruṣāḥ smṛtāḥ ॥31॥
html:
rudro roṣātmako jāto daśānyānso'sṛjatsvayam ।
ekādaśaite rudrāstu vikārāḥ puruṣāḥ smṛtāḥ ॥31॥
slp1: rudro rozAtmako jAto daSAnyAnso'sfjatsvayam । ekAdaSEte rudrAstu vikArAH puruzAH smftAH ॥31॥

text: te rudrāḥ prakṛtiścaiva sarve caiva surarṣayaḥ । utpannā lokasiddhyarthaṃ brahmāṇaṃ samupasthitāḥ ॥32॥
html:
te rudrāḥ prakṛtiścaiva sarve caiva surarṣayaḥ ।
utpannā lokasiddhyarthaṃ brahmāṇaṃ samupasthitāḥ ॥32॥
slp1: te rudrAH prakftiScEva sarve cEva surarzayaH । utpannA lokasidDyarTaM brahmARaM samupasTitAH ॥32॥

text: vayaṃ hi sṛṣṭā bhagavaṃstvayā vai prabhaviṣṇunā । yena yasminnadhīkāre vartitavyaṃ pitāmaha ॥33॥
html:
vayaṃ hi sṛṣṭā bhagavaṃstvayā vai prabhaviṣṇunā ।
yena yasminnadhīkāre vartitavyaṃ pitāmaha ॥33॥
slp1: vayaM hi sfzwA BagavaMstvayA vE praBavizRunA । yena yasminnaDIkAre vartitavyaM pitAmaha ॥33॥

text: yo'sau tvayā vinirdiṣṭo adhikāro'rthacintakaḥ । paripālyaḥ kathaṃ tena so'dhikāro'dhikāriṇā ॥34॥
html:
yo'sau tvayā vinirdiṣṭo adhikāro'rthacintakaḥ ।
paripālyaḥ kathaṃ tena so'dhikāro'dhikāriṇā ॥34॥
slp1: yo'sO tvayA vinirdizwo aDikAro'rTacintakaH । paripAlyaH kaTaM tena so'DikAro'DikAriRA ॥34॥

text: pradiśasva balaṃ tasya yo'dhikārārthacintakaḥ । evamukto mahādevo devāṃstānidamabravīt ॥35॥
html:
pradiśasva balaṃ tasya yo'dhikārārthacintakaḥ ।
evamukto mahādevo devāṃstānidamabravīt ॥35॥
slp1: pradiSasva balaM tasya yo'DikArArTacintakaH । evamukto mahAdevo devAMstAnidamabravIt ॥35॥

text: sādhvahaṃ jñāpito devā yuṣmābhirbhadramastu vaḥ । mamāpyeṣā samutpannā cintā yā bhavatāṃ matā ॥36॥
html:
sādhvahaṃ jñāpito devā yuṣmābhirbhadramastu vaḥ ।
mamāpyeṣā samutpannā cintā yā bhavatāṃ matā ॥36॥
slp1: sADvahaM jYApito devA yuzmABirBadramastu vaH । mamApyezA samutpannA cintA yA BavatAM matA ॥36॥

text: lokatantrasya kṛtsnasya kathaṃ kāryaḥ parigrahaḥ । kathaṃ balakṣayo na syādyuṣmākaṃ hyātmanaśca me ॥37॥
html:
lokatantrasya kṛtsnasya kathaṃ kāryaḥ parigrahaḥ ।
kathaṃ balakṣayo na syādyuṣmākaṃ hyātmanaśca me ॥37॥
slp1: lokatantrasya kftsnasya kaTaM kAryaH parigrahaH । kaTaM balakzayo na syAdyuzmAkaM hyAtmanaSca me ॥37॥

text: itaḥ sarve'pi gacchāmaḥ śaraṇaṃ lokasākṣiṇam । mahāpuruṣamavyaktaṃ sa no vakṣyati yaddhitam ॥38॥
html:
itaḥ sarve'pi gacchāmaḥ śaraṇaṃ lokasākṣiṇam ।
mahāpuruṣamavyaktaṃ sa no vakṣyati yaddhitam ॥38॥
slp1: itaH sarve'pi gacCAmaH SaraRaM lokasAkziRam । mahApuruzamavyaktaM sa no vakzyati yadDitam ॥38॥

text: tataste brahmaṇā sārdhamṛṣayo vibudhāstathā । kṣīrodasyottaraṃ kūlaṃ jagmurlokahitārthinaḥ ॥39॥
html:
tataste brahmaṇā sārdhamṛṣayo vibudhāstathā ।
kṣīrodasyottaraṃ kūlaṃ jagmurlokahitārthinaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: tataste brahmaRA sArDamfzayo vibuDAstaTA । kzIrodasyottaraM kUlaM jagmurlokahitArTinaH ॥39॥

text: te tapaḥ samupātiṣṭhanbrahmoktaṃ vedakalpitam । sa mahāniyamo nāma tapaścaryā sudāruṇā ॥40॥
html:
te tapaḥ samupātiṣṭhanbrahmoktaṃ vedakalpitam ।
sa mahāniyamo nāma tapaścaryā sudāruṇā ॥40॥
slp1: te tapaH samupAtizWanbrahmoktaM vedakalpitam । sa mahAniyamo nAma tapaScaryA sudAruRA ॥40॥

text: ūrdhvaṃ dṛṣṭirbāhavaśca ekāgraṃ ca mano'bhavat । ekapādasthitāḥ samyakkāṣṭhabhūtāḥ samāhitāḥ ॥41॥
html:
ūrdhvaṃ dṛṣṭirbāhavaśca ekāgraṃ ca mano'bhavat ।
ekapādasthitāḥ samyakkāṣṭhabhūtāḥ samāhitāḥ ॥41॥
slp1: UrDvaM dfzwirbAhavaSca ekAgraM ca mano'Bavat । ekapAdasTitAH samyakkAzWaBUtAH samAhitAH ॥41॥

text: divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ te tapastaptvā taduttamam । śuśruvurmadhurāṃ vāṇīṃ vedavedāṅgabhūṣitām ॥42॥
html:
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ te tapastaptvā taduttamam ।
śuśruvurmadhurāṃ vāṇīṃ vedavedāṅgabhūṣitām ॥42॥
slp1: divyaM varzasahasraM te tapastaptvA taduttamam । SuSruvurmaDurAM vARIM vedavedANgaBUzitAm ॥42॥

text: bho bhoḥ sabrahmakā devā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ । svāgatenārcya vaḥ sarvāñśrāvaye vākyamuttamam ॥43॥
html:
bho bhoḥ sabrahmakā devā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ ।
svāgatenārcya vaḥ sarvāñśrāvaye vākyamuttamam ॥43॥
slp1: Bo BoH sabrahmakA devA fzayaSca tapoDanAH । svAgatenArcya vaH sarvAYSrAvaye vAkyamuttamam ॥43॥

text: vijñātaṃ vo mayā kāryaṃ tacca lokahitaṃ mahat । pravṛttiyuktaṃ kartavyaṃ yuṣmatprāṇopabṛṃhaṇam ॥44॥
html:
vijñātaṃ vo mayā kāryaṃ tacca lokahitaṃ mahat ।
pravṛttiyuktaṃ kartavyaṃ yuṣmatprāṇopabṛṃhaṇam ॥44॥
slp1: vijYAtaM vo mayA kAryaM tacca lokahitaM mahat । pravfttiyuktaM kartavyaM yuzmatprARopabfMhaRam ॥44॥

text: sutaptaṃ vastapo devā mamārādhanakāmyayā । bhokṣyathāsya mahāsattvāstapasaḥ phalamuttamam ॥45॥
html:
sutaptaṃ vastapo devā mamārādhanakāmyayā ।
bhokṣyathāsya mahāsattvāstapasaḥ phalamuttamam ॥45॥
slp1: sutaptaM vastapo devA mamArADanakAmyayA । BokzyaTAsya mahAsattvAstapasaH Palamuttamam ॥45॥

text: eṣa brahmā lokaguruḥ sarvalokapitāmahaḥ । yūyaṃ ca vibudhaśreṣṭhā māṃ yajadhvaṃ samāhitāḥ ॥46॥
html:
eṣa brahmā lokaguruḥ sarvalokapitāmahaḥ ।
yūyaṃ ca vibudhaśreṣṭhā māṃ yajadhvaṃ samāhitāḥ ॥46॥
slp1: eza brahmA lokaguruH sarvalokapitAmahaH । yUyaM ca vibuDaSrezWA mAM yajaDvaM samAhitAH ॥46॥

text: sarve bhāgānkalpayadhvaṃ yajñeṣu mama nityaśaḥ । tathā śreyo vidhāsyāmi yathādhīkāramīśvarāḥ ॥47॥
html:
sarve bhāgānkalpayadhvaṃ yajñeṣu mama nityaśaḥ ।
tathā śreyo vidhāsyāmi yathādhīkāramīśvarāḥ ॥47॥
slp1: sarve BAgAnkalpayaDvaM yajYezu mama nityaSaH । taTA Sreyo viDAsyAmi yaTADIkAramISvarAH ॥47॥

text: śrutvaitaddevadevasya vākyaṃ hṛṣṭatanūruhāḥ । tataste vibudhāḥ sarve brahmā te ca maharṣayaḥ ॥48॥
html:
śrutvaitaddevadevasya vākyaṃ hṛṣṭatanūruhāḥ ।
tataste vibudhāḥ sarve brahmā te ca maharṣayaḥ ॥48॥
slp1: SrutvEtaddevadevasya vAkyaM hfzwatanUruhAH । tataste vibuDAH sarve brahmA te ca maharzayaH ॥48॥

text: vedadṛṣṭena vidhinā vaiṣṇavaṃ kratumāharan । tasminsatre tadā brahmā svayaṃ bhāgamakalpayat । devā devarṣayaścaiva sarve bhāgānakalpayan ॥49॥
html:
vedadṛṣṭena vidhinā vaiṣṇavaṃ kratumāharan ।
tasminsatre tadā brahmā svayaṃ bhāgamakalpayat ।
devā devarṣayaścaiva sarve bhāgānakalpayan ॥49॥
slp1: vedadfzwena viDinA vEzRavaM kratumAharan । tasminsatre tadA brahmA svayaM BAgamakalpayat । devA devarzayaScEva sarve BAgAnakalpayan ॥49॥

text: te kārtayugadharmāṇo bhāgāḥ paramasatkṛtāḥ । prāpurādityavarṇaṃ taṃ puruṣaṃ tamasaḥ param । bṛhantaṃ sarvagaṃ devamīśānaṃ varadaṃ prabhum ॥50॥
html:
te kārtayugadharmāṇo bhāgāḥ paramasatkṛtāḥ ।
prāpurādityavarṇaṃ taṃ puruṣaṃ tamasaḥ param ।
bṛhantaṃ sarvagaṃ devamīśānaṃ varadaṃ prabhum ॥50॥
slp1: te kArtayugaDarmARo BAgAH paramasatkftAH । prApurAdityavarRaM taM puruzaM tamasaH param । bfhantaM sarvagaM devamISAnaM varadaM praBum ॥50॥

text: tato'tha varado devastānsarvānamarānsthitān । aśarīro babhāṣedaṃ vākyaṃ khastho maheśvaraḥ ॥51॥
html:
tato'tha varado devastānsarvānamarānsthitān ।
aśarīro babhāṣedaṃ vākyaṃ khastho maheśvaraḥ ॥51॥
slp1: tato'Ta varado devastAnsarvAnamarAnsTitAn । aSarIro baBAzedaM vAkyaM KasTo maheSvaraH ॥51॥

text: yena yaḥ kalpito bhāgaḥ sa tathā samupāgataḥ । prīto'haṃ pradiśāmyadya phalamāvṛttilakṣaṇam ॥52॥
html:
yena yaḥ kalpito bhāgaḥ sa tathā samupāgataḥ ।
prīto'haṃ pradiśāmyadya phalamāvṛttilakṣaṇam ॥52॥
slp1: yena yaH kalpito BAgaH sa taTA samupAgataH । prIto'haM pradiSAmyadya PalamAvfttilakzaRam ॥52॥

text: etadvo lakṣaṇaṃ devā matprasādasamudbhavam । yūyaṃ yajñairijyamānāḥ samāptavaradakṣiṇaiḥ । yuge yuge bhaviṣyadhvaṃ pravṛttiphalabhoginaḥ ॥53॥
html:
etadvo lakṣaṇaṃ devā matprasādasamudbhavam ।
yūyaṃ yajñairijyamānāḥ samāptavaradakṣiṇaiḥ ।
yuge yuge bhaviṣyadhvaṃ pravṛttiphalabhoginaḥ ॥53॥
slp1: etadvo lakzaRaM devA matprasAdasamudBavam । yUyaM yajYErijyamAnAH samAptavaradakziREH । yuge yuge BavizyaDvaM pravfttiPalaBoginaH ॥53॥

text: yajñairye cāpi yakṣyanti sarvalokeṣu vai surāḥ । kalpayiṣyanti vo bhāgāṃste narā vedakalpitān ॥54॥
html:
yajñairye cāpi yakṣyanti sarvalokeṣu vai surāḥ ।
kalpayiṣyanti vo bhāgāṃste narā vedakalpitān ॥54॥
slp1: yajYErye cApi yakzyanti sarvalokezu vE surAH । kalpayizyanti vo BAgAMste narA vedakalpitAn ॥54॥

text: yo me yathā kalpitavānbhāgamasminmahākratau । sa tathā yajñabhāgārho vedasūtre mayā kṛtaḥ ॥55॥
html:
yo me yathā kalpitavānbhāgamasminmahākratau ।
sa tathā yajñabhāgārho vedasūtre mayā kṛtaḥ ॥55॥
slp1: yo me yaTA kalpitavAnBAgamasminmahAkratO । sa taTA yajYaBAgArho vedasUtre mayA kftaH ॥55॥

text: yūyaṃ lokāndhārayadhvaṃ yajñabhāgaphaloditāḥ । sarvārthacintakā loke yathādhīkāranirmitāḥ ॥56॥
html:
yūyaṃ lokāndhārayadhvaṃ yajñabhāgaphaloditāḥ ।
sarvārthacintakā loke yathādhīkāranirmitāḥ ॥56॥
slp1: yUyaM lokAnDArayaDvaM yajYaBAgaPaloditAH । sarvArTacintakA loke yaTADIkAranirmitAH ॥56॥

text: yāḥ kriyāḥ pracariṣyanti pravṛttiphalasatkṛtāḥ । tābhirāpyāyitabalā lokānvai dhārayiṣyatha ॥57॥
html:
yāḥ kriyāḥ pracariṣyanti pravṛttiphalasatkṛtāḥ ।
tābhirāpyāyitabalā lokānvai dhārayiṣyatha ॥57॥
slp1: yAH kriyAH pracarizyanti pravfttiPalasatkftAH । tABirApyAyitabalA lokAnvE DArayizyaTa ॥57॥

text: yūyaṃ hi bhāvitā loke sarvayajñeṣu mānavaiḥ । māṃ tato bhāvayiṣyadhvameṣā vo bhāvanā mama ॥58॥
html:
yūyaṃ hi bhāvitā loke sarvayajñeṣu mānavaiḥ ।
māṃ tato bhāvayiṣyadhvameṣā vo bhāvanā mama ॥58॥
slp1: yUyaM hi BAvitA loke sarvayajYezu mAnavEH । mAM tato BAvayizyaDvamezA vo BAvanA mama ॥58॥

text: ityarthaṃ nirmitā vedā yajñāścauṣadhibhiḥ saha । ebhiḥ samyakprayuktairhi prīyante devatāḥ kṣitau ॥59॥
html:
ityarthaṃ nirmitā vedā yajñāścauṣadhibhiḥ saha ।
ebhiḥ samyakprayuktairhi prīyante devatāḥ kṣitau ॥59॥
slp1: ityarTaM nirmitA vedA yajYAScOzaDiBiH saha । eBiH samyakprayuktErhi prIyante devatAH kzitO ॥59॥

text: nirmāṇametadyuṣmākaṃ pravṛttiguṇakalpitam । mayā kṛtaṃ suraśreṣṭhā yāvatkalpakṣayāditi । cintayadhvaṃ lokahitaṃ yathādhīkāramīśvarāḥ ॥60॥
html:
nirmāṇametadyuṣmākaṃ pravṛttiguṇakalpitam ।
mayā kṛtaṃ suraśreṣṭhā yāvatkalpakṣayāditi ।
cintayadhvaṃ lokahitaṃ yathādhīkāramīśvarāḥ ॥60॥
slp1: nirmARametadyuzmAkaM pravfttiguRakalpitam । mayA kftaM suraSrezWA yAvatkalpakzayAditi । cintayaDvaM lokahitaM yaTADIkAramISvarAH ॥60॥

text: marīciraṅgirāścātriḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ । vasiṣṭha iti saptaite mānasā nirmitā hi vai ॥61॥
html:
marīciraṅgirāścātriḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ ।
vasiṣṭha iti saptaite mānasā nirmitā hi vai ॥61॥
slp1: marIciraNgirAScAtriH pulastyaH pulahaH kratuH । vasizWa iti saptEte mAnasA nirmitA hi vE ॥61॥

text: ete vedavido mukhyā vedācāryāśca kalpitāḥ । pravṛttidharmiṇaścaiva prājāpatyena kalpitāḥ ॥62॥
html:
ete vedavido mukhyā vedācāryāśca kalpitāḥ ।
pravṛttidharmiṇaścaiva prājāpatyena kalpitāḥ ॥62॥
slp1: ete vedavido muKyA vedAcAryASca kalpitAH । pravfttiDarmiRaScEva prAjApatyena kalpitAH ॥62॥

text: ayaṃ kriyāvatāṃ panthā vyaktībhūtaḥ sanātanaḥ । aniruddha iti prokto lokasargakaraḥ prabhuḥ ॥63॥
html:
ayaṃ kriyāvatāṃ panthā vyaktībhūtaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
aniruddha iti prokto lokasargakaraḥ prabhuḥ ॥63॥
slp1: ayaM kriyAvatAM panTA vyaktIBUtaH sanAtanaH । anirudDa iti prokto lokasargakaraH praBuH ॥63॥

text: sanaḥ sanatsujātaśca sanakaḥ sasanandanaḥ । sanatkumāraḥ kapilaḥ saptamaśca sanātanaḥ ॥64॥
html:
sanaḥ sanatsujātaśca sanakaḥ sasanandanaḥ ।
sanatkumāraḥ kapilaḥ saptamaśca sanātanaḥ ॥64॥
slp1: sanaH sanatsujAtaSca sanakaH sasanandanaH । sanatkumAraH kapilaH saptamaSca sanAtanaH ॥64॥

text: saptaite mānasāḥ proktā ṛṣayo brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ । svayamāgatavijñānā nivṛttaṃ dharmamāsthitāḥ ॥65॥
html:
saptaite mānasāḥ proktā ṛṣayo brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ ।
svayamāgatavijñānā nivṛttaṃ dharmamāsthitāḥ ॥65॥
slp1: saptEte mAnasAH proktA fzayo brahmaRaH sutAH । svayamAgatavijYAnA nivfttaM DarmamAsTitAH ॥65॥

text: ete yogavido mukhyāḥ sāṅkhyadharmavidastathā । ācāryā mokṣaśāstre ca mokṣadharmapravartakāḥ ॥66॥
html:
ete yogavido mukhyāḥ sāṅkhyadharmavidastathā ।
ācāryā mokṣaśāstre ca mokṣadharmapravartakāḥ ॥66॥
slp1: ete yogavido muKyAH sANKyaDarmavidastaTA । AcAryA mokzaSAstre ca mokzaDarmapravartakAH ॥66॥

text: yato'haṃ prasṛtaḥ pūrvamavyaktāttriguṇo mahān । tasmātparataro yo'sau kṣetrajña iti kalpitaḥ । so'haṃ kriyāvatāṃ panthāḥ punarāvṛttidurlabhaḥ ॥67॥
html:
yato'haṃ prasṛtaḥ pūrvamavyaktāttriguṇo mahān ।
tasmātparataro yo'sau kṣetrajña iti kalpitaḥ ।
so'haṃ kriyāvatāṃ panthāḥ punarāvṛttidurlabhaḥ ॥67॥
slp1: yato'haM prasftaH pUrvamavyaktAttriguRo mahAn । tasmAtparataro yo'sO kzetrajYa iti kalpitaH । so'haM kriyAvatAM panTAH punarAvfttidurlaBaH ॥67॥

text: yo yathā nirmito janturyasminyasmiṃśca karmaṇi । pravṛttau vā nivṛttau vā tatphalaṃ so'śnute'vaśaḥ ॥68॥
html:
yo yathā nirmito janturyasminyasmiṃśca karmaṇi ।
pravṛttau vā nivṛttau vā tatphalaṃ so'śnute'vaśaḥ ॥68॥
slp1: yo yaTA nirmito janturyasminyasmiMSca karmaRi । pravfttO vA nivfttO vA tatPalaM so'Snute'vaSaH ॥68॥

text: eṣa lokagururbrahmā jagadādikaraḥ prabhuḥ । eṣa mātā pitā caiva yuṣmākaṃ ca pitāmahaḥ । mayānuśiṣṭo bhavitā sarvabhūtavarapradaḥ ॥69॥
html:
eṣa lokagururbrahmā jagadādikaraḥ prabhuḥ ।
eṣa mātā pitā caiva yuṣmākaṃ ca pitāmahaḥ ।
mayānuśiṣṭo bhavitā sarvabhūtavarapradaḥ ॥69॥
slp1: eza lokagururbrahmA jagadAdikaraH praBuH । eza mAtA pitA cEva yuzmAkaM ca pitAmahaH । mayAnuSizwo BavitA sarvaBUtavarapradaH ॥69॥

text: asya caivānujo rudro lalāṭādyaḥ samutthitaḥ । brahmānuśiṣṭo bhavitā sarvatrasavarapradaḥ ॥70॥
html:
asya caivānujo rudro lalāṭādyaḥ samutthitaḥ ।
brahmānuśiṣṭo bhavitā sarvatrasavarapradaḥ ॥70॥
slp1: asya cEvAnujo rudro lalAwAdyaH samutTitaH । brahmAnuSizwo BavitA sarvatrasavarapradaH ॥70॥

text: gacchadhvaṃ svānadhīkārāṃścintayadhvaṃ yathāvidhi । pravartantāṃ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ sarvalokeṣu māciram ॥71॥
html:
gacchadhvaṃ svānadhīkārāṃścintayadhvaṃ yathāvidhi ।
pravartantāṃ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ sarvalokeṣu māciram ॥71॥
slp1: gacCaDvaM svAnaDIkArAMScintayaDvaM yaTAviDi । pravartantAM kriyAH sarvAH sarvalokezu mAciram ॥71॥

text: pradṛśyantāṃ ca karmāṇi prāṇināṃ gatayastathā । parinirmitakālāni āyūṃṣi ca surottamāḥ ॥72॥
html:
pradṛśyantāṃ ca karmāṇi prāṇināṃ gatayastathā ।
parinirmitakālāni āyūṃṣi ca surottamāḥ ॥72॥
slp1: pradfSyantAM ca karmARi prARinAM gatayastaTA । parinirmitakAlAni AyUMzi ca surottamAH ॥72॥

text: idaṃ kṛtayugaṃ nāma kālaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pravartate । ahiṃsyā yajñapaśavo yuge'sminnaitadanyathā । catuṣpātsakalo dharmo bhaviṣyatyatra vai surāḥ ॥73॥
html:
idaṃ kṛtayugaṃ nāma kālaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pravartate ।
ahiṃsyā yajñapaśavo yuge'sminnaitadanyathā ।
catuṣpātsakalo dharmo bhaviṣyatyatra vai surāḥ ॥73॥
slp1: idaM kftayugaM nAma kAlaH SrezWaH pravartate । ahiMsyA yajYapaSavo yuge'sminnEtadanyaTA । catuzpAtsakalo Darmo Bavizyatyatra vE surAH ॥73॥

text: tatastretāyugaṃ nāma trayī yatra bhaviṣyati । prokṣitā yatra paśavo vadhaṃ prāpsyanti vai makhe । tatra pādacaturtho vai dharmasya na bhaviṣyati ॥74॥
html:
tatastretāyugaṃ nāma trayī yatra bhaviṣyati ।
prokṣitā yatra paśavo vadhaṃ prāpsyanti vai makhe ।
tatra pādacaturtho vai dharmasya na bhaviṣyati ॥74॥
slp1: tatastretAyugaM nAma trayI yatra Bavizyati । prokzitA yatra paSavo vaDaM prApsyanti vE maKe । tatra pAdacaturTo vE Darmasya na Bavizyati ॥74॥

text: tato vai dvāparaṃ nāma miśraḥ kālo bhaviṣyati । dvipādahīno dharmaśca yuge tasminbhaviṣyati ॥75॥
html:
tato vai dvāparaṃ nāma miśraḥ kālo bhaviṣyati ।
dvipādahīno dharmaśca yuge tasminbhaviṣyati ॥75॥
slp1: tato vE dvAparaM nAma miSraH kAlo Bavizyati । dvipAdahIno DarmaSca yuge tasminBavizyati ॥75॥

text: tatastiṣye'tha samprāpte yuge kalipuraskṛte । ekapādasthito dharmo yatra tatra bhaviṣyati ॥76॥
html:
tatastiṣye'tha samprāpte yuge kalipuraskṛte ।
ekapādasthito dharmo yatra tatra bhaviṣyati ॥76॥
slp1: tatastizye'Ta samprApte yuge kalipuraskfte । ekapAdasTito Darmo yatra tatra Bavizyati ॥76॥

text: ekapādasthite dharme yatrakvacanagāmini । kathaṃ kartavyamasmābhirbhagavaṃstadvadasva naḥ ॥77॥
html:
ekapādasthite dharme yatrakvacanagāmini ।
kathaṃ kartavyamasmābhirbhagavaṃstadvadasva naḥ ॥77॥
slp1: ekapAdasTite Darme yatrakvacanagAmini । kaTaM kartavyamasmABirBagavaMstadvadasva naH ॥77॥
author: devā ūcuḥ ।

text: yatra vedāśca yajñāśca tapaḥ satyaṃ damastathā । ahiṃsādharmasaṃyuktāḥ pracareyuḥ surottamāḥ । sa vai deśaḥ sevitavyo mā vo'dharmaḥ padā spṛśet ॥78॥
html:
yatra vedāśca yajñāśca tapaḥ satyaṃ damastathā ।
ahiṃsādharmasaṃyuktāḥ pracareyuḥ surottamāḥ ।
sa vai deśaḥ sevitavyo mā vo'dharmaḥ padā spṛśet ॥78॥

html:
yasya prasādajo brahmā rudraśca krodhasambhavaḥ ।
yo'sau yonirhi sarvasya sthāvarasya carasya ca ॥12॥
slp1: yasya prasAdajo brahmA rudraSca kroDasamBavaH । yo'sO yonirhi sarvasya sTAvarasya carasya ca ॥12॥

text: aṣṭādaśaguṇaṃ yattatsattvaṃ sattvavatāṃ vara । prakṛtiḥ sā parā mahyaṃ rodasī yogadhāriṇī । ṛtā satyāmarājayyā lokānāmātmasañjñitā ॥13॥
html:
aṣṭādaśaguṇaṃ yattatsattvaṃ sattvavatāṃ vara ।
prakṛtiḥ sā parā mahyaṃ rodasī yogadhāriṇī ।
ṛtā satyāmarājayyā lokānāmātmasañjñitā ॥13॥
slp1: azwAdaSaguRaM yattatsattvaM sattvavatAM vara । prakftiH sA parA mahyaM rodasI yogaDAriRI । ftA satyAmarAjayyA lokAnAmAtmasaYjYitA ॥13॥

text: tasmātsarvāḥ pravartante sargapralayavikriyāḥ । tato yajñaśca yaṣṭā ca purāṇaḥ puruṣo virāṭ । aniruddha iti prokto lokānāṃ prabhavāpyayaḥ ॥14॥
html:
tasmātsarvāḥ pravartante sargapralayavikriyāḥ ।
tato yajñaśca yaṣṭā ca purāṇaḥ puruṣo virāṭ ।
aniruddha iti prokto lokānāṃ prabhavāpyayaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: tasmAtsarvAH pravartante sargapralayavikriyAH । tato yajYaSca yazwA ca purARaH puruzo virAw । anirudDa iti prokto lokAnAM praBavApyayaH ॥14॥

text: brāhme rātrikṣaye prāpte tasya hyamitatejasaḥ । prasādātprādurabhavatpadmaṃ padmanibhekṣaṇa । tatra brahmā samabhavatsa tasyaiva prasādajaḥ ॥15॥
html:
brāhme rātrikṣaye prāpte tasya hyamitatejasaḥ ।
prasādātprādurabhavatpadmaṃ padmanibhekṣaṇa ।
tatra brahmā samabhavatsa tasyaiva prasādajaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: brAhme rAtrikzaye prApte tasya hyamitatejasaH । prasAdAtprAduraBavatpadmaM padmaniBekzaRa । tatra brahmA samaBavatsa tasyEva prasAdajaH ॥15॥

text: ahnaḥ kṣaye lalāṭācca suto devasya vai tathā । krodhāviṣṭasya sañjajñe rudraḥ saṃhārakārakaḥ ॥16॥
html:
ahnaḥ kṣaye lalāṭācca suto devasya vai tathā ।
krodhāviṣṭasya sañjajñe rudraḥ saṃhārakārakaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: ahnaH kzaye lalAwAcca suto devasya vE taTA । kroDAvizwasya saYjajYe rudraH saMhArakArakaH ॥16॥

text: etau dvau vibudhaśreṣṭhau prasādakrodhajau smṛtau । tadādeśitapanthānau sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakau । nimittamātraṃ tāvatra sarvaprāṇivarapradau ॥17॥
html:
etau dvau vibudhaśreṣṭhau prasādakrodhajau smṛtau ।
tadādeśitapanthānau sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakau ।
nimittamātraṃ tāvatra sarvaprāṇivarapradau ॥17॥
slp1: etO dvO vibuDaSrezWO prasAdakroDajO smftO । tadAdeSitapanTAnO sfzwisaMhArakArakO । nimittamAtraM tAvatra sarvaprARivarapradO ॥17॥

text: kapardī jaṭilo muṇḍaḥ śmaśānagṛhasevakaḥ । ugravratadharo rudro yogī tripuradāruṇaḥ ॥18॥
html:
kapardī jaṭilo muṇḍaḥ śmaśānagṛhasevakaḥ ।
ugravratadharo rudro yogī tripuradāruṇaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: kapardI jawilo muRqaH SmaSAnagfhasevakaH । ugravrataDaro rudro yogI tripuradAruRaH ॥18॥

text: dakṣakratuharaścaiva bhaganetraharastathā । nārāyaṇātmako jñeyaḥ pāṇḍaveya yuge yuge ॥19॥
html:
dakṣakratuharaścaiva bhaganetraharastathā ।
nārāyaṇātmako jñeyaḥ pāṇḍaveya yuge yuge ॥19॥
slp1: dakzakratuharaScEva BaganetraharastaTA । nArAyaRAtmako jYeyaH pARqaveya yuge yuge ॥19॥

text: tasminhi pūjyamāne vai devadeve maheśvare । sampūjito bhavetpārtha devo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ॥20॥
html:
tasminhi pūjyamāne vai devadeve maheśvare ।
sampūjito bhavetpārtha devo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ॥20॥
slp1: tasminhi pUjyamAne vE devadeve maheSvare । sampUjito BavetpArTa devo nArAyaRaH praBuH ॥20॥

text: ahamātmā hi lokānāṃ viśvānāṃ pāṇḍunandana । tasmādātmānamevāgre rudraṃ sampūjayāmyaham ॥21॥
html:
ahamātmā hi lokānāṃ viśvānāṃ pāṇḍunandana ।
tasmādātmānamevāgre rudraṃ sampūjayāmyaham ॥21॥
slp1: ahamAtmA hi lokAnAM viSvAnAM pARqunandana । tasmAdAtmAnamevAgre rudraM sampUjayAmyaham ॥21॥

text: yadyahaṃ nārcayeyaṃ vai īśānaṃ varadaṃ śivam । ātmānaṃ nārcayetkaściditi me bhāvitaṃ manaḥ । mayā pramāṇaṃ hi kṛtaṃ lokaḥ samanuvartate ॥22॥
html:
yadyahaṃ nārcayeyaṃ vai īśānaṃ varadaṃ śivam ।
ātmānaṃ nārcayetkaściditi me bhāvitaṃ manaḥ ।
mayā pramāṇaṃ hi kṛtaṃ lokaḥ samanuvartate ॥22॥
slp1: yadyahaM nArcayeyaM vE ISAnaM varadaM Sivam । AtmAnaM nArcayetkaSciditi me BAvitaM manaH । mayA pramARaM hi kftaM lokaH samanuvartate ॥22॥

text: pramāṇāni hi pūjyāni tatastaṃ pūjayāmyaham । yastaṃ vetti sa māṃ vetti yo'nu taṃ sa hi māmanu ॥23॥
html:
pramāṇāni hi pūjyāni tatastaṃ pūjayāmyaham ।
yastaṃ vetti sa māṃ vetti yo'nu taṃ sa hi māmanu ॥23॥
slp1: pramARAni hi pUjyAni tatastaM pUjayAmyaham । yastaM vetti sa mAM vetti yo'nu taM sa hi mAmanu ॥23॥

text: rudro nārāyaṇaścaiva sattvamekaṃ dvidhākṛtam । loke carati kaunteya vyaktisthaṃ sarvakarmasu ॥24॥
html:
rudro nārāyaṇaścaiva sattvamekaṃ dvidhākṛtam ।
loke carati kaunteya vyaktisthaṃ sarvakarmasu ॥24॥
slp1: rudro nArAyaRaScEva sattvamekaM dviDAkftam । loke carati kOnteya vyaktisTaM sarvakarmasu ॥24॥

text: na hi me kenaciddeyo varaḥ pāṇḍavanandana । iti sañcintya manasā purāṇaṃ viśvamīśvaram । putrārthamārādhitavānātmānamahamātmanā ॥25॥
html:
na hi me kenaciddeyo varaḥ pāṇḍavanandana ।
iti sañcintya manasā purāṇaṃ viśvamīśvaram ।
putrārthamārādhitavānātmānamahamātmanā ॥25॥
slp1: na hi me kenaciddeyo varaH pARqavanandana । iti saYcintya manasA purARaM viSvamISvaram । putrArTamArADitavAnAtmAnamahamAtmanA ॥25॥

text: na hi viṣṇuḥ praṇamati kasmaicidvibudhāya tu । ṛta ātmānameveti tato rudraṃ bhajāmyaham ॥26॥
html:
na hi viṣṇuḥ praṇamati kasmaicidvibudhāya tu ।
ṛta ātmānameveti tato rudraṃ bhajāmyaham ॥26॥
slp1: na hi vizRuH praRamati kasmEcidvibuDAya tu । fta AtmAnameveti tato rudraM BajAmyaham ॥26॥

text: sabrahmakāḥ sarudrāśca sendrā devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ । arcayanti suraśreṣṭhaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim ॥27॥
html:
sabrahmakāḥ sarudrāśca sendrā devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ ।
arcayanti suraśreṣṭhaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim ॥27॥
slp1: sabrahmakAH sarudrASca sendrA devAH saharziBiH । arcayanti suraSrezWaM devaM nArAyaRaM harim ॥27॥

text: bhaviṣyatāṃ vartatāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ caiva bhārata । sarveṣāmagraṇīrviṣṇuḥ sevyaḥ pūjyaśca nityaśaḥ ॥28॥
html:
bhaviṣyatāṃ vartatāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ caiva bhārata ।
sarveṣāmagraṇīrviṣṇuḥ sevyaḥ pūjyaśca nityaśaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: BavizyatAM vartatAM ca BUtAnAM cEva BArata । sarvezAmagraRIrvizRuH sevyaH pUjyaSca nityaSaH ॥28॥

text: namasva havyadaṃ viṣṇuṃ tathā śaraṇadaṃ nama । varadaṃ namasva kaunteya havyakavyabhujaṃ nama ॥29॥
html:
namasva havyadaṃ viṣṇuṃ tathā śaraṇadaṃ nama ।
varadaṃ namasva kaunteya havyakavyabhujaṃ nama ॥29॥
slp1: namasva havyadaM vizRuM taTA SaraRadaM nama । varadaM namasva kOnteya havyakavyaBujaM nama ॥29॥

text: caturvidhā mama janā bhaktā evaṃ hi te śrutam । teṣāmekāntinaḥ śreṣṭhāste caivānanyadevatāḥ । ahameva gatisteṣāṃ nirāśīḥkarmakāriṇām ॥30॥
html:
caturvidhā mama janā bhaktā evaṃ hi te śrutam ।
teṣāmekāntinaḥ śreṣṭhāste caivānanyadevatāḥ ।
ahameva gatisteṣāṃ nirāśīḥkarmakāriṇām ॥30॥
slp1: caturviDA mama janA BaktA evaM hi te Srutam । tezAmekAntinaH SrezWAste cEvAnanyadevatAH । ahameva gatistezAM nirASIHkarmakAriRAm ॥30॥

text: ye ca śiṣṭāstrayo bhaktāḥ phalakāmā hi te matāḥ । sarve cyavanadharmāṇaḥ pratibuddhastu śreṣṭhabhāk ॥31॥
html:
ye ca śiṣṭāstrayo bhaktāḥ phalakāmā hi te matāḥ ।
sarve cyavanadharmāṇaḥ pratibuddhastu śreṣṭhabhāk ॥31॥
slp1: ye ca SizwAstrayo BaktAH PalakAmA hi te matAH । sarve cyavanaDarmARaH pratibudDastu SrezWaBAk ॥31॥

text: brahmāṇaṃ śitikaṇṭhaṃ ca yāścānyā devatāḥ smṛtāḥ । prabuddhavaryāḥ sevante māmevaiṣyanti yatparam । bhaktaṃ prati viśeṣaste eṣa pārthānukīrtitaḥ ॥32॥
html:
brahmāṇaṃ śitikaṇṭhaṃ ca yāścānyā devatāḥ smṛtāḥ ।
prabuddhavaryāḥ sevante māmevaiṣyanti yatparam ।
bhaktaṃ prati viśeṣaste eṣa pārthānukīrtitaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: brahmARaM SitikaRWaM ca yAScAnyA devatAH smftAH । prabudDavaryAH sevante mAmevEzyanti yatparam । BaktaM prati viSezaste eza pArTAnukIrtitaH ॥32॥

text: tvaṃ caivāhaṃ ca kaunteya naranārāyaṇau smṛtau । bhārāvataraṇārthaṃ hi praviṣṭau mānuṣīṃ tanum ॥33॥
html:
tvaṃ caivāhaṃ ca kaunteya naranārāyaṇau smṛtau ।
bhārāvataraṇārthaṃ hi praviṣṭau mānuṣīṃ tanum ॥33॥
slp1: tvaM cEvAhaM ca kOnteya naranArAyaRO smftO । BArAvataraRArTaM hi pravizwO mAnuzIM tanum ॥33॥

text: jānāmyadhyātmayogāṃśca yo'haṃ yasmācca bhārata । nivṛttilakṣaṇo dharmastathābhyudayiko'pi ca ॥34॥
html:
jānāmyadhyātmayogāṃśca yo'haṃ yasmācca bhārata ।
nivṛttilakṣaṇo dharmastathābhyudayiko'pi ca ॥34॥
slp1: jAnAmyaDyAtmayogAMSca yo'haM yasmAcca BArata । nivfttilakzaRo DarmastaTAByudayiko'pi ca ॥34॥

text: narāṇāmayanaṃ khyātamahamekaḥ sanātanaḥ । āpo nārā iti proktā āpo vai narasūnavaḥ । ayanaṃ mama tatpūrvamato nārāyaṇo hyaham ॥35॥
html:
narāṇāmayanaṃ khyātamahamekaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
āpo nārā iti proktā āpo vai narasūnavaḥ ।
ayanaṃ mama tatpūrvamato nārāyaṇo hyaham ॥35॥
slp1: narARAmayanaM KyAtamahamekaH sanAtanaH । Apo nArA iti proktA Apo vE narasUnavaH । ayanaM mama tatpUrvamato nArAyaRo hyaham ॥35॥

text: chādayāmi jagadviśvaṃ bhūtvā sūrya ivāṃśubhiḥ । sarvabhūtādhivāsaśca vāsudevastato hyaham ॥36॥
html:
chādayāmi jagadviśvaṃ bhūtvā sūrya ivāṃśubhiḥ ।
sarvabhūtādhivāsaśca vāsudevastato hyaham ॥36॥
slp1: CAdayAmi jagadviSvaM BUtvA sUrya ivAMSuBiH । sarvaBUtADivAsaSca vAsudevastato hyaham ॥36॥

text: gatiśca sarvabhūtānāṃ prajānāṃ cāpi bhārata । vyāptā me rodasī pārtha kāntiścābhyadhikā mama ॥37॥
html:
gatiśca sarvabhūtānāṃ prajānāṃ cāpi bhārata ।
vyāptā me rodasī pārtha kāntiścābhyadhikā mama ॥37॥
slp1: gatiSca sarvaBUtAnAM prajAnAM cApi BArata । vyAptA me rodasI pArTa kAntiScAByaDikA mama ॥37॥

text: adhibhūtāni cānte'haṃ tadicchaṃścāsmi bhārata । kramaṇāccāpyahaṃ pārtha viṣṇurityabhisañjñitaḥ ॥38॥
html:
adhibhūtāni cānte'haṃ tadicchaṃścāsmi bhārata ।
kramaṇāccāpyahaṃ pārtha viṣṇurityabhisañjñitaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: aDiBUtAni cAnte'haM tadicCaMScAsmi BArata । kramaRAccApyahaM pArTa vizRurityaBisaYjYitaH ॥38॥

text: damātsiddhiṃ parīpsanto māṃ janāḥ kāmayanti hi । divaṃ corvīṃ ca madhyaṃ ca tasmāddāmodaro hyaham ॥39॥
html:
damātsiddhiṃ parīpsanto māṃ janāḥ kāmayanti hi ।
divaṃ corvīṃ ca madhyaṃ ca tasmāddāmodaro hyaham ॥39॥
slp1: damAtsidDiM parIpsanto mAM janAH kAmayanti hi । divaM corvIM ca maDyaM ca tasmAddAmodaro hyaham ॥39॥

text: pṛśnirityucyate cānnaṃ vedā āpo'mṛtaṃ tathā । mamaitāni sadā garbhe pṛśnigarbhastato hyaham ॥40॥
html:
pṛśnirityucyate cānnaṃ vedā āpo'mṛtaṃ tathā ।
mamaitāni sadā garbhe pṛśnigarbhastato hyaham ॥40॥
slp1: pfSnirityucyate cAnnaM vedA Apo'mftaM taTA । mamEtAni sadA garBe pfSnigarBastato hyaham ॥40॥

text: ṛṣayaḥ prāhurevaṃ māṃ tritakūpābhipātitam । pṛśnigarbha tritaṃ pāhītyekatadvitapātitam ॥41॥
html:
ṛṣayaḥ prāhurevaṃ māṃ tritakūpābhipātitam ।
pṛśnigarbha tritaṃ pāhītyekatadvitapātitam ॥41॥
slp1: fzayaH prAhurevaM mAM tritakUpABipAtitam । pfSnigarBa tritaM pAhItyekatadvitapAtitam ॥41॥

text: tataḥ sa brahmaṇaḥ putra ādyo ṛṣivarastritaḥ । uttatārodapānādvai pṛśnigarbhānukīrtanāt ॥42॥
html:
tataḥ sa brahmaṇaḥ putra ādyo ṛṣivarastritaḥ ।
uttatārodapānādvai pṛśnigarbhānukīrtanāt ॥42॥
slp1: tataH sa brahmaRaH putra Adyo fzivarastritaH । uttatArodapAnAdvE pfSnigarBAnukIrtanAt ॥42॥

text: sūryasya tapato lokānagneḥ somasya cāpyuta । aṃśavo ye prakāśante mama te keśasañjñitāḥ । sarvajñāḥ keśavaṃ tasmānmāmāhurdvijasattamāḥ ॥43॥
html:
sūryasya tapato lokānagneḥ somasya cāpyuta ।
aṃśavo ye prakāśante mama te keśasañjñitāḥ ।
sarvajñāḥ keśavaṃ tasmānmāmāhurdvijasattamāḥ ॥43॥
slp1: sUryasya tapato lokAnagneH somasya cApyuta । aMSavo ye prakASante mama te keSasaYjYitAH । sarvajYAH keSavaM tasmAnmAmAhurdvijasattamAH ॥43॥

text: svapatnyāmāhito garbha utathyena mahātmanā । utathye'ntarhite caiva kadāciddevamāyayā । bṛhaspatirathāvindattāṃ patnīṃ tasya bhārata ॥44॥
html:
svapatnyāmāhito garbha utathyena mahātmanā ।
utathye'ntarhite caiva kadāciddevamāyayā ।
bṛhaspatirathāvindattāṃ patnīṃ tasya bhārata ॥44॥
slp1: svapatnyAmAhito garBa utaTyena mahAtmanA । utaTye'ntarhite cEva kadAciddevamAyayA । bfhaspatiraTAvindattAM patnIM tasya BArata ॥44॥

text: tato vai tamṛṣiśreṣṭhaṃ maithunopagataṃ tathā । uvāca garbhaḥ kaunteya pañcabhūtasamanvitaḥ ॥45॥
html:
tato vai tamṛṣiśreṣṭhaṃ maithunopagataṃ tathā ।
uvāca garbhaḥ kaunteya pañcabhūtasamanvitaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: tato vE tamfziSrezWaM mETunopagataM taTA । uvAca garBaH kOnteya paYcaBUtasamanvitaH ॥45॥

text: pūrvāgato'haṃ varada nārhasyambāṃ prabādhitum । etadbṛhaspatiḥ śrutvā cukrodha ca śaśāpa ca ॥46॥
html:
pūrvāgato'haṃ varada nārhasyambāṃ prabādhitum ।
etadbṛhaspatiḥ śrutvā cukrodha ca śaśāpa ca ॥46॥
slp1: pUrvAgato'haM varada nArhasyambAM prabADitum । etadbfhaspatiH SrutvA cukroDa ca SaSApa ca ॥46॥

text: maithunopagato yasmāttvayāhaṃ vinivāritaḥ । tasmādandho jāsyasi tvaṃ macchāpānnātra saṃśayaḥ ॥47॥
html:
maithunopagato yasmāttvayāhaṃ vinivāritaḥ ।
tasmādandho jāsyasi tvaṃ macchāpānnātra saṃśayaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: mETunopagato yasmAttvayAhaM vinivAritaH । tasmAdanDo jAsyasi tvaM macCApAnnAtra saMSayaH ॥47॥

text: sa śāpādṛṣimukhyasya dīrghaṃ tama upeyivān । sa hi dīrghatamā nāma nāmnā hyāsīdṛṣiḥ purā ॥48॥
html:
sa śāpādṛṣimukhyasya dīrghaṃ tama upeyivān ।
sa hi dīrghatamā nāma nāmnā hyāsīdṛṣiḥ purā ॥48॥
slp1: sa SApAdfzimuKyasya dIrGaM tama upeyivAn । sa hi dIrGatamA nAma nAmnA hyAsIdfziH purA ॥48॥

text: vedānavāpya caturaḥ sāṅgopāṅgānsanātanān । prayojayāmāsa tadā nāma guhyamidaṃ mama ॥49॥
html:
vedānavāpya caturaḥ sāṅgopāṅgānsanātanān ।
prayojayāmāsa tadā nāma guhyamidaṃ mama ॥49॥
slp1: vedAnavApya caturaH sANgopANgAnsanAtanAn । prayojayAmAsa tadA nAma guhyamidaM mama ॥49॥

text: ānupūrvyeṇa vidhinā keśaveti punaḥ punaḥ । sa cakṣuṣmānsamabhavadgautamaścābhavatpunaḥ ॥50॥
html:
ānupūrvyeṇa vidhinā keśaveti punaḥ punaḥ ।
sa cakṣuṣmānsamabhavadgautamaścābhavatpunaḥ ॥50॥
slp1: AnupUrvyeRa viDinA keSaveti punaH punaH । sa cakzuzmAnsamaBavadgOtamaScABavatpunaH ॥50॥

text: evaṃ hi varadaṃ nāma keśaveti mamārjuna । devānāmatha sarveṣāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca mahātmanām ॥51॥
html:
evaṃ hi varadaṃ nāma keśaveti mamārjuna ।
devānāmatha sarveṣāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca mahātmanām ॥51॥
slp1: evaM hi varadaM nAma keSaveti mamArjuna । devAnAmaTa sarvezAmfzIRAM ca mahAtmanAm ॥51॥

text: agniḥ somena saṃyukta ekayoni mukhaṃ kṛtam । agnīṣomātmakaṃ tasmājjagatkṛtsnaṃ carācaram ॥52॥
html:
agniḥ somena saṃyukta ekayoni mukhaṃ kṛtam ।
agnīṣomātmakaṃ tasmājjagatkṛtsnaṃ carācaram ॥52॥
slp1: agniH somena saMyukta ekayoni muKaM kftam । agnIzomAtmakaM tasmAjjagatkftsnaM carAcaram ॥52॥

text: api hi purāṇe bhavati ॥053A॥ ekayonyātmakāvagnīṣomau ॥053B॥ devāścāgnimukhā iti ॥053C॥ ekayonitvācca parasparaṃ mahayanto lokāndhārayata iti] ॥053D॥

text: agnīṣomau kathaṃ pūrvamekayonī pravartitau । eṣa me saṃśayo jātastaṃ chindhi madhusūdana ॥1॥
html:
agnīṣomau kathaṃ pūrvamekayonī pravartitau ।
eṣa me saṃśayo jātastaṃ chindhi madhusūdana ॥1॥
slp1: agnIzomO kaTaM pUrvamekayonI pravartitO । eza me saMSayo jAtastaM CinDi maDusUdana ॥1॥

text: hanta te vartayiṣyāmi purāṇaṃ pāṇḍunandana । ātmatejodbhavaṃ pārtha śṛṇuṣvaikamanā mama ॥2॥
html:
hanta te vartayiṣyāmi purāṇaṃ pāṇḍunandana ।
ātmatejodbhavaṃ pārtha śṛṇuṣvaikamanā mama ॥2॥
slp1: hanta te vartayizyAmi purARaM pARqunandana । AtmatejodBavaM pArTa SfRuzvEkamanA mama ॥2॥
