text: samprakṣālanakāle'tikrānte caturthe yugasahasrānte ॥003A॥ avyakte sarvabhūtapralaye sthāvarajaṅgame ॥003B॥ jyotirdharaṇivāyurahite'ndhe tamasi jalaikārṇave loke ॥003C॥ tama ityevābhibhūte'sañjñake'dvitīye pratiṣṭhite ॥003D॥ naiva rātryāṃ na divase na sati nāsati na vyakte nāvyakte vyavasthite ॥003E॥ etasyāmavasthāyāṃ nārāyaṇaguṇāśrayādakṣayādajarādanindriyādagrāhyādasambhavātsatyādahiṃsrāllalāmādvividhapravṛttiviśeṣāt ॥003F॥ akṣayādajarāmarādamūrtitaḥ sarvavyāpinaḥ sarvakartuḥ śāśvatāttamasaḥ puruṣaḥ prādurbhūto hariravyayaḥ ॥003G॥
html:
samprakṣālanakāle'tikrānte caturthe yugasahasrānte ॥003A॥
avyakte sarvabhūtapralaye sthāvarajaṅgame ॥003B॥
jyotirdharaṇivāyurahite'ndhe tamasi jalaikārṇave loke ॥003C॥
tama ityevābhibhūte'sañjñake'dvitīye pratiṣṭhite ॥003D॥
naiva rātryāṃ na divase na sati nāsati na vyakte nāvyakte vyavasthite ॥003E॥
etasyāmavasthāyāṃ nārāyaṇaguṇāśrayādakṣayādajarādanindriyādagrāhyādasambhavātsatyādahiṃsrāllalāmādvividhapravṛttiviśeṣāt ॥003F॥
akṣayādajarāmarādamūrtitaḥ sarvavyāpinaḥ sarvakartuḥ śāśvatāttamasaḥ puruṣaḥ prādurbhūto hariravyayaḥ ॥003G॥
slp1: samprakzAlanakAle'tikrAnte caturTe yugasahasrAnte ॥003a॥ avyakte sarvaBUtapralaye sTAvarajaNgame ॥003b॥ jyotirDaraRivAyurahite'nDe tamasi jalEkArRave loke ॥003c॥ tama ityevABiBUte'saYjYake'dvitIye pratizWite ॥003d॥ nEva rAtryAM na divase na sati nAsati na vyakte nAvyakte vyavasTite ॥003e॥ etasyAmavasTAyAM nArAyaRaguRASrayAdakzayAdajarAdanindriyAdagrAhyAdasamBavAtsatyAdahiMsrAllalAmAdviviDapravfttiviSezAt ॥003P0॥ akzayAdajarAmarAdamUrtitaH sarvavyApinaH sarvakartuH SASvatAttamasaH puruzaH prAdurBUto hariravyayaH ॥003g॥

text: nidarśanamapi hyatra bhavati ॥004A॥ nāsīdaho na rātrirāsīt ॥004B॥ na sadāsīnnāsadāsīt ॥004C॥ tama eva purastādabhavadviśvarūpam ॥004D॥ sā viśvasya jananītyevamasyārtho'nubhāṣyate ॥004E॥
html:
nidarśanamapi hyatra bhavati ॥004A॥
nāsīdaho na rātrirāsīt ॥004B॥
na sadāsīnnāsadāsīt ॥004C॥
tama eva purastādabhavadviśvarūpam ॥004D॥
sā viśvasya jananītyevamasyārtho'nubhāṣyate ॥004E॥
slp1: nidarSanamapi hyatra Bavati ॥004a॥ nAsIdaho na rAtrirAsIt ॥004b॥ na sadAsInnAsadAsIt ॥004c॥ tama eva purastAdaBavadviSvarUpam ॥004d॥ sA viSvasya jananItyevamasyArTo'nuBAzyate ॥004e॥

text: tasyedānīṃ tamaḥsambhavasya puruṣasya padmayonerbrahmaṇaḥ prādurbhāve sa puruṣaḥ prajāḥ sisṛkṣamāṇo netrābhyāmagnīṣomau sasarja ॥005A॥ tato bhūtasarge pravṛtte prajākramavaśādbrahmakṣatramupātiṣṭhat ॥005B॥ yaḥ somastadbrahma yadbrahma te brāhmaṇāḥ ॥005C॥ yo'gnistatkṣatraṃ kṣatrādbrahma balavattaram ॥005D॥ kasmāditi lokapratyakṣaguṇametattadyathā ॥005E॥ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paraṃ bhūtaṃ notpannapūrvam ॥005F॥ dīpyamāne'gnau juhotīti kṛtvā bravīmi ॥005G॥ bhūtasargaḥ kṛto brahmaṇā bhūtāni ca pratiṣṭhāpya trailokyaṃ dhāryata iti ॥005H॥
html:
tasyedānīṃ tamaḥsambhavasya puruṣasya padmayonerbrahmaṇaḥ prādurbhāve sa puruṣaḥ prajāḥ sisṛkṣamāṇo netrābhyāmagnīṣomau sasarja ॥005A॥
tato bhūtasarge pravṛtte prajākramavaśādbrahmakṣatramupātiṣṭhat ॥005B॥
yaḥ somastadbrahma yadbrahma te brāhmaṇāḥ ॥005C॥
yo'gnistatkṣatraṃ kṣatrādbrahma balavattaram ॥005D॥
kasmāditi lokapratyakṣaguṇametattadyathā ॥005E॥
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paraṃ bhūtaṃ notpannapūrvam ॥005F॥
dīpyamāne'gnau juhotīti kṛtvā bravīmi ॥005G॥
bhūtasargaḥ kṛto brahmaṇā bhūtāni ca pratiṣṭhāpya trailokyaṃ dhāryata iti ॥005H॥
slp1: tasyedAnIM tamaHsamBavasya puruzasya padmayonerbrahmaRaH prAdurBAve sa puruzaH prajAH sisfkzamARo netrAByAmagnIzomO sasarja ॥005a॥ tato BUtasarge pravftte prajAkramavaSAdbrahmakzatramupAtizWat ॥005b॥ yaH somastadbrahma yadbrahma te brAhmaRAH ॥005c॥ yo'gnistatkzatraM kzatrAdbrahma balavattaram ॥005d॥ kasmAditi lokapratyakzaguRametattadyaTA ॥005e॥ brAhmaReByaH paraM BUtaM notpannapUrvam ॥005P0॥ dIpyamAne'gnO juhotIti kftvA bravImi ॥005g॥ BUtasargaH kfto brahmaRA BUtAni ca pratizWApya trElokyaM DAryata iti ॥005h॥

text: mantravādo'pi hi bhavati ॥006A॥ tvamagne yajñānāṃ hotā viśveṣām ॥006B॥ hito devebhirmānuṣe jane iti ॥006C॥ nidarśanaṃ cātra bhavati ॥006D॥ viśveṣāmagne yajñānāṃ hoteti ॥006E॥ hito devairmānuṣairjagata iti ॥006F॥ agnirhi yajñānāṃ hotā kartā ॥006G॥ sa cāgnirbrahma ॥006H॥
html:
mantravādo'pi hi bhavati ॥006A॥
tvamagne yajñānāṃ hotā viśveṣām ॥006B॥
hito devebhirmānuṣe jane iti ॥006C॥
nidarśanaṃ cātra bhavati ॥006D॥
viśveṣāmagne yajñānāṃ hoteti ॥006E॥
hito devairmānuṣairjagata iti ॥006F॥
agnirhi yajñānāṃ hotā kartā ॥006G॥
sa cāgnirbrahma ॥006H॥
slp1: mantravAdo'pi hi Bavati ॥006a॥ tvamagne yajYAnAM hotA viSvezAm ॥006b॥ hito deveBirmAnuze jane iti ॥006c॥ nidarSanaM cAtra Bavati ॥006d॥ viSvezAmagne yajYAnAM hoteti ॥006e॥ hito devErmAnuzErjagata iti ॥006P0॥ agnirhi yajYAnAM hotA kartA ॥006g॥ sa cAgnirbrahma ॥006h॥

text: na hyṛte mantrāddhavanamasti ॥007A॥ na vinā puruṣaṃ tapaḥ sambhavati ॥007B॥ havirmantrāṇāṃ sampūjā vidyate devamanuṣyāṇāmanena tvaṃ hoteti niyuktaḥ ॥007C॥ ye ca mānuṣā hotrādhikārāste ca ॥007D॥ brāhmaṇasya hi yājanaṃ vidhīyate na kṣatravaiśyayordvijātyoḥ ॥007E॥ tasmādbrāhmaṇā hyagnibhūtā yajñānudvahanti ॥007F॥ yajñā devāṃstarpayanti devāḥ pṛthivīṃ bhāvayanti ॥007G॥
html:
na hyṛte mantrāddhavanamasti ॥007A॥
na vinā puruṣaṃ tapaḥ sambhavati ॥007B॥
havirmantrāṇāṃ sampūjā vidyate devamanuṣyāṇāmanena tvaṃ hoteti niyuktaḥ ॥007C॥
ye ca mānuṣā hotrādhikārāste ca ॥007D॥
brāhmaṇasya hi yājanaṃ vidhīyate na kṣatravaiśyayordvijātyoḥ ॥007E॥
tasmādbrāhmaṇā hyagnibhūtā yajñānudvahanti ॥007F॥
yajñā devāṃstarpayanti devāḥ pṛthivīṃ bhāvayanti ॥007G॥
slp1: na hyfte mantrAdDavanamasti ॥007a॥ na vinA puruzaM tapaH samBavati ॥007b॥ havirmantrARAM sampUjA vidyate devamanuzyARAmanena tvaM hoteti niyuktaH ॥007c॥ ye ca mAnuzA hotrADikArAste ca ॥007d॥ brAhmaRasya hi yAjanaM viDIyate na kzatravESyayordvijAtyoH ॥007e॥ tasmAdbrAhmaRA hyagniBUtA yajYAnudvahanti ॥007P0॥ yajYA devAMstarpayanti devAH pfTivIM BAvayanti ॥007g॥

text: śatapathe hi brāhmaṇaṃ bhavati ॥008A॥ agnau samiddhe sa juhoti yo vidvānbrāhmaṇamukhe dānāhutiṃ juhoti ॥008B॥ evamapyagnibhūtā brāhmaṇā vidvāṃso'gniṃ bhāvayanti ॥008C॥ agnirviṣṇuḥ sarvabhūtānyanupraviśya prāṇāndhārayati ॥008D॥ api cātra sanatkumāragītāḥ ślokā bhavanti ॥008E॥
html:
śatapathe hi brāhmaṇaṃ bhavati ॥008A॥
agnau samiddhe sa juhoti yo vidvānbrāhmaṇamukhe dānāhutiṃ juhoti ॥008B॥
evamapyagnibhūtā brāhmaṇā vidvāṃso'gniṃ bhāvayanti ॥008C॥
agnirviṣṇuḥ sarvabhūtānyanupraviśya prāṇāndhārayati ॥008D॥
api cātra sanatkumāragītāḥ ślokā bhavanti ॥008E॥
slp1: SatapaTe hi brAhmaRaM Bavati ॥008a॥ agnO samidDe sa juhoti yo vidvAnbrAhmaRamuKe dAnAhutiM juhoti ॥008b॥ evamapyagniBUtA brAhmaRA vidvAMso'gniM BAvayanti ॥008c॥ agnirvizRuH sarvaBUtAnyanupraviSya prARAnDArayati ॥008d॥ api cAtra sanatkumAragItAH SlokA Bavanti ॥008e॥

text: viśvaṃ brahmāsṛjatpūrvaṃ sarvādirniravaskaram । brahmaghoṣairdivaṃ tiṣṭhantyamarā brahmayonayaḥ ॥9॥
html:
viśvaṃ brahmāsṛjatpūrvaṃ sarvādirniravaskaram ।
brahmaghoṣairdivaṃ tiṣṭhantyamarā brahmayonayaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: viSvaM brahmAsfjatpUrvaM sarvAdirniravaskaram । brahmaGozErdivaM tizWantyamarA brahmayonayaH ॥9॥

text: brāhmaṇānāṃ matirvākyaṃ karma śraddhā tapāṃsi ca । dhārayanti mahīṃ dyāṃ ca śaityādvāryamṛtaṃ yathā ॥10॥
html:
brāhmaṇānāṃ matirvākyaṃ karma śraddhā tapāṃsi ca ।
dhārayanti mahīṃ dyāṃ ca śaityādvāryamṛtaṃ yathā ॥10॥
slp1: brAhmaRAnAM matirvAkyaM karma SradDA tapAMsi ca । DArayanti mahIM dyAM ca SEtyAdvAryamftaM yaTA ॥10॥

text: nāsti satyātparo dharmo nāsti mātṛsamo guruḥ । brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paraṃ nāsti pretya ceha ca bhūtaye ॥11॥
html:
nāsti satyātparo dharmo nāsti mātṛsamo guruḥ ।
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paraṃ nāsti pretya ceha ca bhūtaye ॥11॥
slp1: nAsti satyAtparo Darmo nAsti mAtfsamo guruH । brAhmaReByaH paraM nAsti pretya ceha ca BUtaye ॥11॥

text: naiṣāmukṣā vardhate nota vāhā na gargaro mathyate sampradāne । apadhvastā dasyubhūtā bhavanti yeṣāṃ rāṣṭre brāhmaṇā vṛttihīnāḥ ॥12॥
html:
naiṣāmukṣā vardhate nota vāhā na gargaro mathyate sampradāne ।
apadhvastā dasyubhūtā bhavanti yeṣāṃ rāṣṭre brāhmaṇā vṛttihīnāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: nEzAmukzA varDate nota vAhA na gargaro maTyate sampradAne । apaDvastA dasyuBUtA Bavanti yezAM rAzwre brAhmaRA vfttihInAH ॥12॥

text: vedapurāṇetihāsaprāmāṇyānnārāyaṇamukhodgatāḥ sarvātmānaḥ sarvakartāraḥ sarvabhāvanāśca brāhmaṇāḥ ॥013A॥ vāksamakālaṃ hi tasya devasya varapradasya brāhmaṇāḥ prathamaṃ prādurbhūtā brāhmaṇebhyaśca śeṣā varṇāḥ prādurbhūtāḥ ॥013B॥ itthaṃ ca surāsuraviśiṣṭā brāhmaṇā yadā mayā brahmabhūtena purā svayamevotpāditāḥ surāsuramaharṣayo bhūtaviśeṣāḥ sthāpitā nigṛhītāśca ॥013C॥
html:
vedapurāṇetihāsaprāmāṇyānnārāyaṇamukhodgatāḥ sarvātmānaḥ sarvakartāraḥ sarvabhāvanāśca brāhmaṇāḥ ॥013A॥
vāksamakālaṃ hi tasya devasya varapradasya brāhmaṇāḥ prathamaṃ prādurbhūtā brāhmaṇebhyaśca śeṣā varṇāḥ prādurbhūtāḥ ॥013B॥
itthaṃ ca surāsuraviśiṣṭā brāhmaṇā yadā mayā brahmabhūtena purā svayamevotpāditāḥ surāsuramaharṣayo bhūtaviśeṣāḥ sthāpitā nigṛhītāśca ॥013C॥
slp1: vedapurARetihAsaprAmARyAnnArAyaRamuKodgatAH sarvAtmAnaH sarvakartAraH sarvaBAvanASca brAhmaRAH ॥013a॥ vAksamakAlaM hi tasya devasya varapradasya brAhmaRAH praTamaM prAdurBUtA brAhmaReByaSca SezA varRAH prAdurBUtAH ॥013b॥ itTaM ca surAsuraviSizwA brAhmaRA yadA mayA brahmaBUtena purA svayamevotpAditAH surAsuramaharzayo BUtaviSezAH sTApitA nigfhItASca ॥013c॥

text: ahalyādharṣaṇanimittaṃ hi gautamāddhariśmaśrutāmindraḥ prāptaḥ ॥014A॥ kauśikanimittaṃ cendro muṣkaviyogaṃ meṣavṛṣaṇatvaṃ cāvāpa ॥014B॥ aśvinorgrahapratiṣedhodyatavajrasya purandarasya cyavanena stambhito bāhuḥ ॥014C॥ kratuvadhaprāptamanyunā ca dakṣeṇa bhūyastapasā cātmānaṃ saṃyojya netrākṛtiranyā lalāṭe rudrasyotpāditā ॥014D॥
html:
ahalyādharṣaṇanimittaṃ hi gautamāddhariśmaśrutāmindraḥ prāptaḥ ॥014A॥
kauśikanimittaṃ cendro muṣkaviyogaṃ meṣavṛṣaṇatvaṃ cāvāpa ॥014B॥
aśvinorgrahapratiṣedhodyatavajrasya purandarasya cyavanena stambhito bāhuḥ ॥014C॥
kratuvadhaprāptamanyunā ca dakṣeṇa bhūyastapasā cātmānaṃ saṃyojya netrākṛtiranyā lalāṭe rudrasyotpāditā ॥014D॥
slp1: ahalyADarzaRanimittaM hi gOtamAdDariSmaSrutAmindraH prAptaH ॥014a॥ kOSikanimittaM cendro muzkaviyogaM mezavfzaRatvaM cAvApa ॥014b॥ aSvinorgrahapratizeDodyatavajrasya purandarasya cyavanena stamBito bAhuH ॥014c॥ kratuvaDaprAptamanyunA ca dakzeRa BUyastapasA cAtmAnaM saMyojya netrAkftiranyA lalAwe rudrasyotpAditA ॥014d॥

text: tripuravadhārthaṃ dīkṣāmabhyupagatasya rudrasyośanasā śiraso jaṭā utkṛtya prayuktāḥ ॥015A॥ tataḥ prādurbhūtā bhujagāḥ ॥015B॥ pūrve ca manvantare svāyambhuve nārāyaṇahastabandhagrahaṇānnīlakaṇṭhatvameva vā ॥015D॥ tairasya bhujagaiḥ pīḍyamānaḥ kaṇṭho nīlatāmupanītaḥ ॥15॥
html:
tripuravadhārthaṃ dīkṣāmabhyupagatasya rudrasyośanasā śiraso jaṭā utkṛtya prayuktāḥ ॥015A॥
tataḥ prādurbhūtā bhujagāḥ ॥015B॥
pūrve ca manvantare svāyambhuve nārāyaṇahastabandhagrahaṇānnīlakaṇṭhatvameva vā ॥015D॥
tairasya bhujagaiḥ pīḍyamānaḥ kaṇṭho nīlatāmupanītaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: tripuravaDArTaM dIkzAmaByupagatasya rudrasyoSanasA Siraso jawA utkftya prayuktAH ॥015a॥ tataH prAdurBUtA BujagAH ॥015b॥ pUrve ca manvantare svAyamBuve nArAyaRahastabanDagrahaRAnnIlakaRWatvameva vA ॥015d॥ tErasya BujagEH pIqyamAnaH kaRWo nIlatAmupanItaH ॥15॥

text: amṛtotpādane puraścaraṇatāmupagatasyāṅgiraso bṛhaspaterupaspṛśato na prasādaṃ gatavatyaḥ kilāpaḥ ॥016A॥ atha bṛhaspatirapāṃ cukrodha ॥016B॥ yasmānmamopaspṛśataḥ kaluṣībhūtā na prasādamupagatāstasmādadyaprabhṛti jhaṣamakaramatsyakacchapajantusaṅkīrṇāḥ kaluṣībhavateti ॥016C॥ tadāprabhṛtyāpo yādobhiḥ saṅkīrṇāḥ saṃvṛttāḥ ॥016D॥
html:
amṛtotpādane puraścaraṇatāmupagatasyāṅgiraso bṛhaspaterupaspṛśato na prasādaṃ gatavatyaḥ kilāpaḥ ॥016A॥
atha bṛhaspatirapāṃ cukrodha ॥016B॥
yasmānmamopaspṛśataḥ kaluṣībhūtā na prasādamupagatāstasmādadyaprabhṛti jhaṣamakaramatsyakacchapajantusaṅkīrṇāḥ kaluṣībhavateti ॥016C॥
tadāprabhṛtyāpo yādobhiḥ saṅkīrṇāḥ saṃvṛttāḥ ॥016D॥
slp1: amftotpAdane puraScaraRatAmupagatasyANgiraso bfhaspaterupaspfSato na prasAdaM gatavatyaH kilApaH ॥016a॥ aTa bfhaspatirapAM cukroDa ॥016b॥ yasmAnmamopaspfSataH kaluzIBUtA na prasAdamupagatAstasmAdadyapraBfti JazamakaramatsyakacCapajantusaNkIrRAH kaluzIBavateti ॥016c॥ tadApraBftyApo yAdoBiH saNkIrRAH saMvfttAH ॥016d॥

text: viśvarūpo vai tvāṣṭraḥ purohito devānāmāsītsvasrīyo'surāṇām ॥017A॥ sa pratyakṣaṃ devebhyo bhāgamadadatparokṣamasurebhyaḥ ॥017B॥
html:
viśvarūpo vai tvāṣṭraḥ purohito devānāmāsītsvasrīyo'surāṇām ॥017A॥
sa pratyakṣaṃ devebhyo bhāgamadadatparokṣamasurebhyaḥ ॥017B॥
slp1: viSvarUpo vE tvAzwraH purohito devAnAmAsItsvasrIyo'surARAm ॥017a॥ sa pratyakzaM deveByo BAgamadadatparokzamasureByaH ॥017b॥

text: atha hiraṇyakaśipuṃ puraskṛtya viśvarūpamātaraṃ svasāramasurā varamayācanta ॥018A॥ he svasarayaṃ te putrastvāṣṭro viśvarūpastriśirā devānāṃ purohitaḥ pratyakṣaṃ devebhyo bhāgamadadatparokṣamasmākam ॥018B॥ tato devā vardhante vayaṃ kṣīyāmaḥ ॥018C॥ tadenaṃ tvaṃ vārayitumarhasi tathā yathāsmānbhajediti ॥018D॥
html:
atha hiraṇyakaśipuṃ puraskṛtya viśvarūpamātaraṃ svasāramasurā varamayācanta ॥018A॥
he svasarayaṃ te putrastvāṣṭro viśvarūpastriśirā devānāṃ purohitaḥ pratyakṣaṃ devebhyo bhāgamadadatparokṣamasmākam ॥018B॥
tato devā vardhante vayaṃ kṣīyāmaḥ ॥018C॥
tadenaṃ tvaṃ vārayitumarhasi tathā yathāsmānbhajediti ॥018D॥
slp1: aTa hiraRyakaSipuM puraskftya viSvarUpamAtaraM svasAramasurA varamayAcanta ॥018a॥ he svasarayaM te putrastvAzwro viSvarUpastriSirA devAnAM purohitaH pratyakzaM deveByo BAgamadadatparokzamasmAkam ॥018b॥ tato devA varDante vayaM kzIyAmaH ॥018c॥ tadenaM tvaM vArayitumarhasi taTA yaTAsmAnBajediti ॥018d॥

text: atha viśvarūpaṃ nandanavanamupagataṃ mātovāca ॥019A॥ putra kiṃ parapakṣavardhanastvaṃ mātulapakṣaṃ nāśayasi ॥019B॥ nārhasyevaṃ kartumiti ॥019C॥ sa viśvarūpo māturvākyamanatikramaṇīyamiti matvā sampūjya hiraṇyakaśipumagāt ॥019D॥
html:
atha viśvarūpaṃ nandanavanamupagataṃ mātovāca ॥019A॥
putra kiṃ parapakṣavardhanastvaṃ mātulapakṣaṃ nāśayasi ॥019B॥
nārhasyevaṃ kartumiti ॥019C॥
sa viśvarūpo māturvākyamanatikramaṇīyamiti matvā sampūjya hiraṇyakaśipumagāt ॥019D॥
slp1: aTa viSvarUpaM nandanavanamupagataM mAtovAca ॥019a॥ putra kiM parapakzavarDanastvaM mAtulapakzaM nASayasi ॥019b॥ nArhasyevaM kartumiti ॥019c॥ sa viSvarUpo mAturvAkyamanatikramaRIyamiti matvA sampUjya hiraRyakaSipumagAt ॥019d॥

text: hairaṇyagarbhācca vasiṣṭhāddhiraṇyakaśipuḥ śāpaṃ prāptavān ॥020A॥ yasmāttvayānyo vṛto hotā tasmādasamāptayajñastvamapūrvātsattvajātādvadhaṃ prāpsyasīti ॥020B॥ tacchāpadānāddhiraṇyakaśipuḥ prāptavānvadham ॥020C॥
html:
hairaṇyagarbhācca vasiṣṭhāddhiraṇyakaśipuḥ śāpaṃ prāptavān ॥020A॥
yasmāttvayānyo vṛto hotā tasmādasamāptayajñastvamapūrvātsattvajātādvadhaṃ prāpsyasīti ॥020B॥
tacchāpadānāddhiraṇyakaśipuḥ prāptavānvadham ॥020C॥
slp1: hEraRyagarBAcca vasizWAdDiraRyakaSipuH SApaM prAptavAn ॥020a॥ yasmAttvayAnyo vfto hotA tasmAdasamAptayajYastvamapUrvAtsattvajAtAdvaDaM prApsyasIti ॥020b॥ tacCApadAnAdDiraRyakaSipuH prAptavAnvaDam ॥020c॥

text: viśvarūpo mātṛpakṣavardhano'tyarthaṃ tapasyabhavat ॥021A॥ tasya vratabhaṅgārthamindro bahvīḥ śrīmatyo'psaraso niyuyoja ॥021B॥ tāśca dṛṣṭvā manaḥ kṣubhitaṃ tasyābhavattāsu cāpsaraḥsu nacirādeva sakto'bhavat ॥021C॥ saktaṃ cainaṃ jñātvāpsarasa ūcurgacchāmahe vayaṃ yathāgatamiti ॥021D॥
html:
viśvarūpo mātṛpakṣavardhano'tyarthaṃ tapasyabhavat ॥021A॥
tasya vratabhaṅgārthamindro bahvīḥ śrīmatyo'psaraso niyuyoja ॥021B॥
tāśca dṛṣṭvā manaḥ kṣubhitaṃ tasyābhavattāsu cāpsaraḥsu nacirādeva sakto'bhavat ॥021C॥
saktaṃ cainaṃ jñātvāpsarasa ūcurgacchāmahe vayaṃ yathāgatamiti ॥021D॥
slp1: viSvarUpo mAtfpakzavarDano'tyarTaM tapasyaBavat ॥021a॥ tasya vrataBaNgArTamindro bahvIH SrImatyo'psaraso niyuyoja ॥021b॥ tASca dfzwvA manaH kzuBitaM tasyABavattAsu cApsaraHsu nacirAdeva sakto'Bavat ॥021c॥ saktaM cEnaM jYAtvApsarasa UcurgacCAmahe vayaM yaTAgatamiti ॥021d॥

text: tāstvāṣṭra uvāca ॥022A॥ kva gamiṣyatha āsyatāṃ tāvanmayā saha śreyo bhaviṣyatīti ॥022B॥ tāstamabruvan ॥022C॥ vayaṃ devastriyo'psarasa indraṃ varadaṃ purā prabhaviṣṇuṃ vṛṇīmaha iti ॥022D॥
html:
tāstvāṣṭra uvāca ॥022A॥
kva gamiṣyatha āsyatāṃ tāvanmayā saha śreyo bhaviṣyatīti ॥022B॥
tāstamabruvan ॥022C॥
vayaṃ devastriyo'psarasa indraṃ varadaṃ purā prabhaviṣṇuṃ vṛṇīmaha iti ॥022D॥
slp1: tAstvAzwra uvAca ॥022a॥ kva gamizyaTa AsyatAM tAvanmayA saha Sreyo BavizyatIti ॥022b॥ tAstamabruvan ॥022c॥ vayaM devastriyo'psarasa indraM varadaM purA praBavizRuM vfRImaha iti ॥022d॥

text: atha tā viśvarūpo'bravīdadyaiva sendrā devā na bhaviṣyantīti ॥023A॥ tato mantrāñjajāpa ॥023B॥ tairmantraiḥ prāvardhata triśirāḥ ॥023C॥ ekenāsyena sarvalokeṣu dvijaiḥ kriyāvadbhiryajñeṣu suhutaṃ somaṃ papāvekenāpa ekena sendrāndevān ॥023D॥ athendrastaṃ vivardhamānaṃ somapānāpyāyitasarvagātraṃ dṛṣṭvā cintāmāpede ॥023E॥
html:
atha tā viśvarūpo'bravīdadyaiva sendrā devā na bhaviṣyantīti ॥023A॥
tato mantrāñjajāpa ॥023B॥
tairmantraiḥ prāvardhata triśirāḥ ॥023C॥
ekenāsyena sarvalokeṣu dvijaiḥ kriyāvadbhiryajñeṣu suhutaṃ somaṃ papāvekenāpa ekena sendrāndevān ॥023D॥
athendrastaṃ vivardhamānaṃ somapānāpyāyitasarvagātraṃ dṛṣṭvā cintāmāpede ॥023E॥
slp1: aTa tA viSvarUpo'bravIdadyEva sendrA devA na BavizyantIti ॥023a॥ tato mantrAYjajApa ॥023b॥ tErmantrEH prAvarData triSirAH ॥023c॥ ekenAsyena sarvalokezu dvijEH kriyAvadBiryajYezu suhutaM somaM papAvekenApa ekena sendrAndevAn ॥023d॥ aTendrastaM vivarDamAnaM somapAnApyAyitasarvagAtraM dfzwvA cintAmApede ॥023e॥

text: devāśca te sahendreṇa brahmāṇamabhijagmurūcuśca ॥024A॥ viśvarūpeṇa sarvayajñeṣu suhutaḥ somaḥ pīyate ॥024B॥ vayamabhāgāḥ saṃvṛttāḥ ॥024C॥ asurapakṣo vardhate vayaṃ kṣīyāmaḥ ॥024D॥ tadarhasi no vidhātuṃ śreyo yadanantaramiti ॥024E॥
html:
devāśca te sahendreṇa brahmāṇamabhijagmurūcuśca ॥024A॥
viśvarūpeṇa sarvayajñeṣu suhutaḥ somaḥ pīyate ॥024B॥
vayamabhāgāḥ saṃvṛttāḥ ॥024C॥
asurapakṣo vardhate vayaṃ kṣīyāmaḥ ॥024D॥
tadarhasi no vidhātuṃ śreyo yadanantaramiti ॥024E॥
slp1: devASca te sahendreRa brahmARamaBijagmurUcuSca ॥024a॥ viSvarUpeRa sarvayajYezu suhutaH somaH pIyate ॥024b॥ vayamaBAgAH saMvfttAH ॥024c॥ asurapakzo varDate vayaM kzIyAmaH ॥024d॥ tadarhasi no viDAtuM Sreyo yadanantaramiti ॥024e॥

text: tānbrahmovāca ṛṣirbhārgavastapastapyate dadhīcaḥ ॥025A॥ sa yācyatāṃ varaṃ yathā kalevaraṃ jahyāt ॥025B॥ tasyāsthibhirvajraṃ kriyatāmiti ॥025C॥
html:
tānbrahmovāca ṛṣirbhārgavastapastapyate dadhīcaḥ ॥025A॥
sa yācyatāṃ varaṃ yathā kalevaraṃ jahyāt ॥025B॥
tasyāsthibhirvajraṃ kriyatāmiti ॥025C॥
slp1: tAnbrahmovAca fzirBArgavastapastapyate daDIcaH ॥025a॥ sa yAcyatAM varaM yaTA kalevaraM jahyAt ॥025b॥ tasyAsTiBirvajraM kriyatAmiti ॥025c॥

text: devāstatrāgacchanyatra dadhīco bhagavānṛṣistapastepe ॥026A॥ sendrā devāstamabhigamyocurbhagavaṃstapasaḥ kuśalamavighnaṃ ceti ॥026B॥ tāndadhīca uvāca svāgataṃ bhavadbhyaḥ kiṃ kriyatām ॥026C॥ yadvakṣyatha tatkariṣyāmīti ॥026D॥ te tamabruvañśarīraparityāgaṃ lokahitārthaṃ bhagavānkartumarhatīti ॥026E॥ atha dadhīcastathaivāvimanāḥ sukhaduḥkhasamo mahāyogī ātmānaṃ samādhāya śarīraparityāgaṃ cakāra ॥026F॥
html:
devāstatrāgacchanyatra dadhīco bhagavānṛṣistapastepe ॥026A॥
sendrā devāstamabhigamyocurbhagavaṃstapasaḥ kuśalamavighnaṃ ceti ॥026B॥
tāndadhīca uvāca svāgataṃ bhavadbhyaḥ kiṃ kriyatām ॥026C॥
yadvakṣyatha tatkariṣyāmīti ॥026D॥
te tamabruvañśarīraparityāgaṃ lokahitārthaṃ bhagavānkartumarhatīti ॥026E॥
atha dadhīcastathaivāvimanāḥ sukhaduḥkhasamo mahāyogī ātmānaṃ samādhāya śarīraparityāgaṃ cakāra ॥026F॥
slp1: devAstatrAgacCanyatra daDIco BagavAnfzistapastepe ॥026a॥ sendrA devAstamaBigamyocurBagavaMstapasaH kuSalamaviGnaM ceti ॥026b॥ tAndaDIca uvAca svAgataM BavadByaH kiM kriyatAm ॥026c॥ yadvakzyaTa tatkarizyAmIti ॥026d॥ te tamabruvaYSarIraparityAgaM lokahitArTaM BagavAnkartumarhatIti ॥026e॥ aTa daDIcastaTEvAvimanAH suKaduHKasamo mahAyogI AtmAnaM samADAya SarIraparityAgaM cakAra ॥026P0॥

text: tasya paramātmanyavasṛte tānyasthīni dhātā saṅgṛhya vajramakarot ॥027A॥ tena vajreṇābhedyenāpradhṛṣyeṇa brahmāsthisambhūtena viṣṇupraviṣṭenendro viśvarūpaṃ jaghāna ॥027B॥ śirasāṃ cāsya chedanamakarot ॥027C॥ tasmādanantaraṃ viśvarūpagātramathanasambhavaṃ tvaṣṭrotpāditamevāriṃ vṛtramindro jaghāna ॥027D॥
html:
tasya paramātmanyavasṛte tānyasthīni dhātā saṅgṛhya vajramakarot ॥027A॥
tena vajreṇābhedyenāpradhṛṣyeṇa brahmāsthisambhūtena viṣṇupraviṣṭenendro viśvarūpaṃ jaghāna ॥027B॥
śirasāṃ cāsya chedanamakarot ॥027C॥
tasmādanantaraṃ viśvarūpagātramathanasambhavaṃ tvaṣṭrotpāditamevāriṃ vṛtramindro jaghāna ॥027D॥
slp1: tasya paramAtmanyavasfte tAnyasTIni DAtA saNgfhya vajramakarot ॥027a॥ tena vajreRABedyenApraDfzyeRa brahmAsTisamBUtena vizRupravizwenendro viSvarUpaM jaGAna ॥027b॥ SirasAM cAsya Cedanamakarot ॥027c॥ tasmAdanantaraM viSvarUpagAtramaTanasamBavaM tvazwrotpAditamevAriM vftramindro jaGAna ॥027d॥

text: tasyāṃ dvaidhībhūtāyāṃ brahmavadhyāyāṃ bhayādindro devarājyaṃ parityajya apsu sambhavāṃ śītalāṃ mānasasarogatāṃ nalinīṃ prapede ॥028A॥ tatra caiśvaryayogādaṇumātro bhūtvā bisagranthiṃ praviveśa ॥028B॥
html:
tasyāṃ dvaidhībhūtāyāṃ brahmavadhyāyāṃ bhayādindro devarājyaṃ parityajya apsu sambhavāṃ śītalāṃ mānasasarogatāṃ nalinīṃ prapede ॥028A॥
tatra caiśvaryayogādaṇumātro bhūtvā bisagranthiṃ praviveśa ॥028B॥
slp1: tasyAM dvEDIBUtAyAM brahmavaDyAyAM BayAdindro devarAjyaM parityajya apsu samBavAM SItalAM mAnasasarogatAM nalinIM prapede ॥028a॥ tatra cESvaryayogAdaRumAtro BUtvA bisagranTiM praviveSa ॥028b॥

text: atha brahmavadhyābhayapranaṣṭe trailokyanāthe śacīpatau jagadanīśvaraṃ babhūva ॥029A॥ devānrajastamaścāviveśa ॥029B॥ mantrā na prāvartanta maharṣīṇām ॥029C॥ rakṣāṃsi prādurabhavan ॥029D॥ brahma cotsādanaṃ jagāma ॥029E॥ anindrāścābalā lokāḥ supradhṛṣyā babhūvuḥ ॥029F॥
html:
atha brahmavadhyābhayapranaṣṭe trailokyanāthe śacīpatau jagadanīśvaraṃ babhūva ॥029A॥
devānrajastamaścāviveśa ॥029B॥
mantrā na prāvartanta maharṣīṇām ॥029C॥
rakṣāṃsi prādurabhavan ॥029D॥
brahma cotsādanaṃ jagāma ॥029E॥
anindrāścābalā lokāḥ supradhṛṣyā babhūvuḥ ॥029F॥
slp1: aTa brahmavaDyABayapranazwe trElokyanATe SacIpatO jagadanISvaraM baBUva ॥029a॥ devAnrajastamaScAviveSa ॥029b॥ mantrA na prAvartanta maharzIRAm ॥029c॥ rakzAMsi prAduraBavan ॥029d॥ brahma cotsAdanaM jagAma ॥029e॥ anindrAScAbalA lokAH supraDfzyA baBUvuH ॥029P0॥

text: atha devā ṛṣayaścāyuṣaḥ putraṃ nahuṣaṃ nāma devarājatve'bhiṣiṣicuḥ ॥030A॥ nahuṣaḥ pañcabhiḥ śatairjyotiṣāṃ lalāṭe jvaladbhiḥ sarvatejoharaistriviṣṭapaṃ pālayāṃ babhūva ॥030B॥ atha lokāḥ prakṛtimāpedire svasthāśca babhūvuḥ ॥030C॥
html:
atha devā ṛṣayaścāyuṣaḥ putraṃ nahuṣaṃ nāma devarājatve'bhiṣiṣicuḥ ॥030A॥
nahuṣaḥ pañcabhiḥ śatairjyotiṣāṃ lalāṭe jvaladbhiḥ sarvatejoharaistriviṣṭapaṃ pālayāṃ babhūva ॥030B॥
atha lokāḥ prakṛtimāpedire svasthāśca babhūvuḥ ॥030C॥
slp1: aTa devA fzayaScAyuzaH putraM nahuzaM nAma devarAjatve'BizizicuH ॥030a॥ nahuzaH paYcaBiH SatErjyotizAM lalAwe jvaladBiH sarvatejoharEstrivizwapaM pAlayAM baBUva ॥030b॥ aTa lokAH prakftimApedire svasTASca baBUvuH ॥030c॥

text: athovāca nahuṣaḥ ॥031A॥ sarvaṃ māṃ śakropabhuktamupasthitamṛte śacīmiti ॥031B॥ sa evamuktvā śacīsamīpamagamaduvāca cainām ॥031C॥ subhage'hamindro devānāṃ bhajasva māmiti ॥031D॥ taṃ śacī pratyuvāca ॥031E॥ prakṛtyā tvaṃ dharmavatsalaḥ somavaṃśodbhavaśca ॥031F॥ nārhasi parapatnīdharṣaṇaṃ kartumiti ॥031G॥
html:
athovāca nahuṣaḥ ॥031A॥
sarvaṃ māṃ śakropabhuktamupasthitamṛte śacīmiti ॥031B॥
sa evamuktvā śacīsamīpamagamaduvāca cainām ॥031C॥
subhage'hamindro devānāṃ bhajasva māmiti ॥031D॥
taṃ śacī pratyuvāca ॥031E॥
prakṛtyā tvaṃ dharmavatsalaḥ somavaṃśodbhavaśca ॥031F॥
nārhasi parapatnīdharṣaṇaṃ kartumiti ॥031G॥
slp1: aTovAca nahuzaH ॥031a॥ sarvaM mAM SakropaBuktamupasTitamfte SacImiti ॥031b॥ sa evamuktvA SacIsamIpamagamaduvAca cEnAm ॥031c॥ suBage'hamindro devAnAM Bajasva mAmiti ॥031d॥ taM SacI pratyuvAca ॥031e॥ prakftyA tvaM DarmavatsalaH somavaMSodBavaSca ॥031P0॥ nArhasi parapatnIDarzaRaM kartumiti ॥031g॥

text: tāmathovāca nahuṣaḥ ॥032A॥ aindraṃ padamadhyāsyate mayā ॥032B॥ ahamindrasya rājyaratnaharo nātrādharmaḥ kaścittvamindrabhukteti ॥032C॥ sā tamuvāca ॥032D॥ asti mama kiñcidvratamaparyavasitam ॥032E॥ tasyāvabhṛthe tvāmupagamiṣyāmi kaiścidevāhobhiriti ॥032F॥ sa śacyaivamabhihito nahuṣo jagāma ॥032G॥
html:
tāmathovāca nahuṣaḥ ॥032A॥
aindraṃ padamadhyāsyate mayā ॥032B॥
ahamindrasya rājyaratnaharo nātrādharmaḥ kaścittvamindrabhukteti ॥032C॥
sā tamuvāca ॥032D॥
asti mama kiñcidvratamaparyavasitam ॥032E॥
tasyāvabhṛthe tvāmupagamiṣyāmi kaiścidevāhobhiriti ॥032F॥
sa śacyaivamabhihito nahuṣo jagāma ॥032G॥
slp1: tAmaTovAca nahuzaH ॥032a॥ EndraM padamaDyAsyate mayA ॥032b॥ ahamindrasya rAjyaratnaharo nAtrADarmaH kaScittvamindraBukteti ॥032c॥ sA tamuvAca ॥032d॥ asti mama kiYcidvratamaparyavasitam ॥032e॥ tasyAvaBfTe tvAmupagamizyAmi kEScidevAhoBiriti ॥032P0॥ sa SacyEvamaBihito nahuzo jagAma ॥032g॥

text: atha śacī duḥkhaśokārtā bhartṛdarśanalālasā nahuṣabhayagṛhītā bṛhaspatimupāgacchat ॥033A॥ sa ca tāmabhigatāṃ dṛṣṭvaiva dhyānaṃ praviśya bhartṛkāryatatparāṃ jñātvā bṛhaspatiruvāca ॥033B॥ sā tavendraṃ darśayiṣyatīti ॥033D॥ anenaiva vratena tapasā cānvitā devīṃ varadāmupaśrutimāhvaya ॥33॥
html:
atha śacī duḥkhaśokārtā bhartṛdarśanalālasā nahuṣabhayagṛhītā bṛhaspatimupāgacchat ॥033A॥
sa ca tāmabhigatāṃ dṛṣṭvaiva dhyānaṃ praviśya bhartṛkāryatatparāṃ jñātvā bṛhaspatiruvāca ॥033B॥
sā tavendraṃ darśayiṣyatīti ॥033D॥
anenaiva vratena tapasā cānvitā devīṃ varadāmupaśrutimāhvaya ॥33॥
slp1: aTa SacI duHKaSokArtA BartfdarSanalAlasA nahuzaBayagfhItA bfhaspatimupAgacCat ॥033a॥ sa ca tAmaBigatAM dfzwvEva DyAnaM praviSya BartfkAryatatparAM jYAtvA bfhaspatiruvAca ॥033b॥ sA tavendraM darSayizyatIti ॥033d॥ anenEva vratena tapasA cAnvitA devIM varadAmupaSrutimAhvaya ॥33॥

text: sātha mahāniyamamāsthitā devīṃ varadāmupaśrutiṃ mantrairāhvayat ॥034A॥ sopaśrutiḥ śacīsamīpamagāt ॥034B॥ uvāca caināmiyamasmi tvayopahūtopasthitā ॥034C॥ kiṃ te priyaṃ karavāṇīti ॥034D॥ tāṃ mūrdhnā praṇamyovāca śacī bhagavatyarhasi me bhartāraṃ darśayituṃ tvaṃ satyā matā ceti ॥034E॥ saināṃ mānasaṃ saro'nayat ॥034F॥ tatrendraṃ bisagranthigatamadarśayat ॥034G॥

text: tāmindraḥ patnīṃ kṛśāṃ glānāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā cintayāṃ babhūva ॥035A॥ aho mama mahadduḥkhamidamadyopagatam ॥035B॥ tāmindra uvāca kathaṃ vartayasīti ॥035D॥ sā tamuvāca ॥035E॥ nahuṣo māmāhvayati ॥035F॥ kālaścāsya mayā kṛta iti ॥035G॥ naṣṭaṃ hi māmiyamanviṣyopāgamadduḥkhārteti ॥35॥

text: tāmindra uvāca ॥036A॥ gaccha ॥036B॥ nahuṣastvayā vācyo'pūrveṇa māmṛṣiyuktena yānena tvamadhirūḍha udvahasva ॥036C॥ indrasya hi mahānti vāhanāni manasaḥ priyāṇyadhirūḍhāni mayā ॥036D॥ tvamanyenopayātumarhasīti ॥036E॥ saivamuktā hṛṣṭā jagāma ॥036F॥ indro'pi bisagranthimevāviveśa bhūyaḥ ॥036G॥

text: atha maitrāvaruṇiḥ kumbhayoniragastyo maharṣīnvikriyamāṇāṃstānnahuṣeṇāpaśyat ॥038A॥ padbhyāṃ ca tenāspṛśyata ॥038B॥ tataḥ sa nahuṣamabravīdakāryapravṛtta pāpa patasva mahīm ॥038C॥ sarpo bhava yāvadbhūmirgirayaśca tiṣṭheyustāvaditi ॥038D॥ sa maharṣivākyasamakālameva tasmādyānādavāpatat ॥038E॥

text: athānindraṃ punastrailokyamabhavat ॥039A॥ tato devā ṛṣayaśca bhagavantaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaraṇamindrārthe'bhijagmuḥ ॥039B॥ ūcuścainaṃ bhagavannindraṃ brahmavadhyābhibhūtaṃ trātumarhasīti ॥039C॥ tataḥ sa varadastānabravīdaśvamedhaṃ yajñaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ śakro'bhiyajatu ॥039D॥ tataḥ svaṃ sthānaṃ prāpsyatīti ॥039E॥

text: tato devā ṛṣayaścendraṃ nāpaśyanyadā tadā śacīmūcurgaccha subhage indramānayasveti ॥040A॥ sā punastatsaraḥ samabhyagacchat ॥040B॥ indraśca tasmātsarasaḥ samutthāya bṛhaspatimabhijagāma ॥040C॥ bṛhaspatiścāśvamedhaṃ mahākratuṃ śakrāyāharat ॥040D॥ tataḥ kṛṣṇasāraṅgaṃ medhyamaśvamutsṛjya vāhanaṃ tameva kṛtvā indraṃ marutpatiṃ bṛhaspatiḥ svasthānaṃ prāpayāmāsa ॥040E॥

text: tataḥ sa devarāḍdevairṝṣibhiḥ stūyamānastriviṣṭapastho niṣkalmaṣo babhūva ॥041A॥ brahmavadhyāṃ caturṣu sthāneṣu vanitāgnivanaspatigoṣu vyabhajat ॥041B॥ evamindro brahmatejaḥprabhāvopabṛṃhitaḥ śatruvadhaṃ kṛtvā svasthānaṃ prāpitaḥ ॥041C॥

text: aditirvai devānāmannamapacadetadbhuktvāsurānhaniṣyantīti ॥044A॥ tatra budho vratacaryāsamāptāvāgacchat ॥044B॥ aditiṃ cāvocadbhikṣāṃ dehīti ॥044C॥ tatra devaiḥ pūrvametatprāśyaṃ nānyenetyaditirbhikṣāṃ nādāt ॥044D॥ atha bhikṣāpratyākhyānaruṣitena budhena brahmabhūtena vivasvato dvitīye janmanyaṇḍasañjñitasyāṇḍaṃ māritamadityāḥ ॥044E॥ sa mārtaṇḍo vivasvānabhavacchrāddhadevaḥ ॥044F॥

text: dakṣasya vai duhitaraḥ ṣaṣṭirāsan ॥045A॥ tābhyaḥ kaśyapāya trayodaśa prādāddaśa dharmāya daśa manave saptaviṃśatimindave ॥045B॥ tāsu tulyāsu nakṣatrākhyāṃ gatāsu somo rohiṇyāmabhyadhikāṃ prītimakarot ॥045C॥ tatastāḥ śeṣāḥ patnya īrṣyāvatyaḥ pituḥ samīpaṃ gatvemamarthaṃ śaśaṃsuḥ ॥045D॥ bhagavannasmāsu tulyaprabhāvāsu somo rohiṇīmadhikaṃ bhajatīti ॥045E॥ so'bravīdyakṣmainamāvekṣyatīti ॥045F॥

text: dakṣaśāpātsomaṃ rājānaṃ yakṣmāviveśa ॥046A॥ sa yakṣmaṇāviṣṭo dakṣamagamat ॥046B॥ dakṣaścainamabravīnna samaṃ vartasa iti ॥046C॥ tatrarṣayaḥ somamabruvankṣīyase yakṣmaṇā ॥046D॥ paścimasyāṃ diśi samudre hiraṇyasarastīrtham ॥046E॥ tatra gatvātmānamabhiṣecayasveti ॥046F॥ athāgacchatsomastatra hiraṇyasarastīrtham ॥046G॥ gatvā cātmanaḥ snapanamakarot ॥046H॥ snātvā cātmānaṃ pāpmano mokṣayāmāsa ॥046I॥ tatra cāvabhāsitastīrthe yadā somastadāprabhṛti tīrthaṃ tatprabhāsamiti nāmnā khyātaṃ babhūva ॥046J॥ tacchāpādadyāpi kṣīyate somo'māvāsyāntarasthaḥ ॥046K॥ paurṇamāsīmātre'dhiṣṭhito meghalekhāpraticchannaṃ vapurdarśayati ॥046L॥ meghasadṛśaṃ varṇamagamattadasya śaśalakṣma vimalamabhavat ॥046M॥

dakṣaścainamabravīnna samaṃ vartasa iti ॥046C॥

tatra gatvātmānamabhiṣecayasveti ॥046F॥

gatvā cātmanaḥ snapanamakarot ॥046H॥
snātvā cātmānaṃ pāpmano mokṣayāmāsa ॥046I॥
tatra cāvabhāsitastīrthe yadā somastadāprabhṛti tīrthaṃ tatprabhāsamiti nāmnā khyātaṃ babhūva ॥046J॥
tacchāpādadyāpi kṣīyate somo'māvāsyāntarasthaḥ ॥046K॥

text: sthūlaśirā maharṣirmeroḥ prāguttare digbhāge tapastepe ॥047A॥ tasya tapastapyamānasya sarvagandhavahaḥ śucirvāyurvivāyamānaḥ śarīramaspṛśat ॥047B॥ sa tapasā tāpitaśarīraḥ kṛśo vāyunopavījyamāno hṛdayaparitoṣamagamat ॥047C॥ tatra tasyānilavyajanakṛtaparitoṣasya sadyo vanaspatayaḥ puṣpaśobhāṃ na darśitavanta iti sa etāñśaśāpa na sarvakālaṃ puṣpavanto bhaviṣyatheti ॥047D॥
html:
sthūlaśirā maharṣirmeroḥ prāguttare digbhāge tapastepe ॥047A॥
tasya tapastapyamānasya sarvagandhavahaḥ śucirvāyurvivāyamānaḥ śarīramaspṛśat ॥047B॥
sa tapasā tāpitaśarīraḥ kṛśo vāyunopavījyamāno hṛdayaparitoṣamagamat ॥047C॥
tatra tasyānilavyajanakṛtaparitoṣasya sadyo vanaspatayaḥ puṣpaśobhāṃ na darśitavanta iti sa etāñśaśāpa na sarvakālaṃ puṣpavanto bhaviṣyatheti ॥047D॥
slp1: sTUlaSirA maharzirmeroH prAguttare digBAge tapastepe ॥047a॥ tasya tapastapyamAnasya sarvaganDavahaH SucirvAyurvivAyamAnaH SarIramaspfSat ॥047b॥ sa tapasA tApitaSarIraH kfSo vAyunopavIjyamAno hfdayaparitozamagamat ॥047c॥ tatra tasyAnilavyajanakftaparitozasya sadyo vanaspatayaH puzpaSoBAM na darSitavanta iti sa etAYSaSApa na sarvakAlaM puzpavanto BavizyaTeti ॥047d॥

text: nārāyaṇo lokahitārthaṃ vaḍavāmukho nāma maharṣiḥ purābhavat ॥048A॥ tasya merau tapastapyataḥ samudra āhūto nāgataḥ ॥048B॥ tenāmarṣitenātmagātroṣmaṇā samudraḥ stimitajalaḥ kṛtaḥ ॥048C॥ svedaprasyandanasadṛśaścāsya lavaṇabhāvo janitaḥ ॥048D॥ uktaścāpeyo bhaviṣyasi ॥048E॥ etacca te toyaṃ vaḍavāmukhasañjñitena pīyamānaṃ madhuraṃ bhaviṣyati ॥048F॥ tadetadadyāpi vaḍavāmukhasañjñitenānuvartinā toyaṃ sāmudraṃ pīyate ॥048G॥
html:
nārāyaṇo lokahitārthaṃ vaḍavāmukho nāma maharṣiḥ purābhavat ॥048A॥
tasya merau tapastapyataḥ samudra āhūto nāgataḥ ॥048B॥
tenāmarṣitenātmagātroṣmaṇā samudraḥ stimitajalaḥ kṛtaḥ ॥048C॥
svedaprasyandanasadṛśaścāsya lavaṇabhāvo janitaḥ ॥048D॥
uktaścāpeyo bhaviṣyasi ॥048E॥
etacca te toyaṃ vaḍavāmukhasañjñitena pīyamānaṃ madhuraṃ bhaviṣyati ॥048F॥
tadetadadyāpi vaḍavāmukhasañjñitenānuvartinā toyaṃ sāmudraṃ pīyate ॥048G॥
slp1: nArAyaRo lokahitArTaM vaqavAmuKo nAma maharziH purABavat ॥048a॥ tasya merO tapastapyataH samudra AhUto nAgataH ॥048b॥ tenAmarzitenAtmagAtrozmaRA samudraH stimitajalaH kftaH ॥048c॥ svedaprasyandanasadfSaScAsya lavaRaBAvo janitaH ॥048d॥ uktaScApeyo Bavizyasi ॥048e॥ etacca te toyaM vaqavAmuKasaYjYitena pIyamAnaM maDuraM Bavizyati ॥048P0॥ tadetadadyApi vaqavAmuKasaYjYitenAnuvartinA toyaM sAmudraM pIyate ॥048g॥

text: himavato girerduhitaramumāṃ rudraścakame ॥049A॥ bhṛgurapi ca maharṣirhimavantamāgamyābravītkanyāmumāṃ me dehīti ॥049B॥ tamabravīddhimavānabhilaṣito varo rudra iti ॥049C॥ tamabravīdbhṛguryasmāttvayāhaṃ kanyāvaraṇakṛtabhāvaḥ pratyākhyātastasmānna ratnānāṃ bhavānbhājanaṃ bhaviṣyatīti ॥049D॥ adyaprabhṛtyetadavasthitamṛṣivacanam ॥049E॥
html:
himavato girerduhitaramumāṃ rudraścakame ॥049A॥
bhṛgurapi ca maharṣirhimavantamāgamyābravītkanyāmumāṃ me dehīti ॥049B॥
tamabravīddhimavānabhilaṣito varo rudra iti ॥049C॥
tamabravīdbhṛguryasmāttvayāhaṃ kanyāvaraṇakṛtabhāvaḥ pratyākhyātastasmānna ratnānāṃ bhavānbhājanaṃ bhaviṣyatīti ॥049D॥
adyaprabhṛtyetadavasthitamṛṣivacanam ॥049E॥
slp1: himavato girerduhitaramumAM rudraScakame ॥049a॥ Bfgurapi ca maharzirhimavantamAgamyAbravItkanyAmumAM me dehIti ॥049b॥ tamabravIdDimavAnaBilazito varo rudra iti ॥049c॥ tamabravIdBfguryasmAttvayAhaM kanyAvaraRakftaBAvaH pratyAKyAtastasmAnna ratnAnAM BavAnBAjanaM BavizyatIti ॥049d॥ adyapraBftyetadavasTitamfzivacanam ॥049e॥

text: tadevaṃvidhaṃ māhātmyaṃ brāhmaṇānām ॥050A॥ kṣatramapi śāśvatīmavyayāṃ pṛthivīṃ patnīmabhigamya bubhuje ॥050B॥ tadetadbrahmāgnīṣomīyam ॥050C॥ tena jagaddhāryate] ॥050D॥
html:
tadevaṃvidhaṃ māhātmyaṃ brāhmaṇānām ॥050A॥
kṣatramapi śāśvatīmavyayāṃ pṛthivīṃ patnīmabhigamya bubhuje ॥050B॥
tadetadbrahmāgnīṣomīyam ॥050C॥
tena jagaddhāryate] ॥050D॥
slp1: tadevaMviDaM mAhAtmyaM brAhmaRAnAm ॥050a॥ kzatramapi SASvatImavyayAM pfTivIM patnImaBigamya buBuje ॥050b॥ tadetadbrahmAgnIzomIyam ॥050c॥ tena jagadDAryate] ॥050d॥

text: sūryācandramasau śaśvatkeśairme aṃśusañjñitaiḥ । bodhayaṃstāpayaṃścaiva jagaduttiṣṭhataḥ pṛthak ॥1॥
html:
sūryācandramasau śaśvatkeśairme aṃśusañjñitaiḥ ।
bodhayaṃstāpayaṃścaiva jagaduttiṣṭhataḥ pṛthak ॥1॥
slp1: sUryAcandramasO SaSvatkeSErme aMSusaYjYitEH । boDayaMstApayaMScEva jagaduttizWataH pfTak ॥1॥
author: śrībhagavānuvāca ।

text: bodhanāttāpanāccaiva jagato harṣaṇaṃ bhavet । agnīṣomakṛtairebhiḥ karmabhiḥ pāṇḍunandana । hṛṣīkeśo'hamīśāno varado lokabhāvanaḥ ॥2॥
html:
bodhanāttāpanāccaiva jagato harṣaṇaṃ bhavet ।
agnīṣomakṛtairebhiḥ karmabhiḥ pāṇḍunandana ।
hṛṣīkeśo'hamīśāno varado lokabhāvanaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: boDanAttApanAccEva jagato harzaRaM Bavet । agnIzomakftEreBiH karmaBiH pARqunandana । hfzIkeSo'hamISAno varado lokaBAvanaH ॥2॥

text: iḍopahūtayogena hare bhāgaṃ kratuṣvaham । varṇaśca me hariśreṣṭhastasmāddharirahaṃ smṛtaḥ ॥3॥
html:
iḍopahūtayogena hare bhāgaṃ kratuṣvaham ।
varṇaśca me hariśreṣṭhastasmāddharirahaṃ smṛtaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: iqopahUtayogena hare BAgaM kratuzvaham । varRaSca me hariSrezWastasmAdDarirahaM smftaH ॥3॥

text: dhāma sāro hi lokānāmṛtaṃ caiva vicāritam । ṛtadhāmā tato vipraiḥ satyaścāhaṃ prakīrtitaḥ ॥4॥
html:
dhāma sāro hi lokānāmṛtaṃ caiva vicāritam ।
ṛtadhāmā tato vipraiḥ satyaścāhaṃ prakīrtitaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: DAma sAro hi lokAnAmftaM cEva vicAritam । ftaDAmA tato viprEH satyaScAhaM prakIrtitaH ॥4॥

text: naṣṭāṃ ca dharaṇīṃ pūrvamavindaṃ vai guhāgatām । govinda iti māṃ devā vāgbhiḥ samabhituṣṭuvuḥ ॥5॥
html:
naṣṭāṃ ca dharaṇīṃ pūrvamavindaṃ vai guhāgatām ।
govinda iti māṃ devā vāgbhiḥ samabhituṣṭuvuḥ ॥5॥
slp1: nazwAM ca DaraRIM pUrvamavindaM vE guhAgatAm । govinda iti mAM devA vAgBiH samaBituzwuvuH ॥5॥

text: śipiviṣṭeti cākhyāyāṃ hīnaromā ca yo bhavet । tenāviṣṭaṃ hi yatkiñcicchipiviṣṭaṃ hi tatsmṛtam ॥6॥
html:
śipiviṣṭeti cākhyāyāṃ hīnaromā ca yo bhavet ।
tenāviṣṭaṃ hi yatkiñcicchipiviṣṭaṃ hi tatsmṛtam ॥6॥
slp1: Sipivizweti cAKyAyAM hInaromA ca yo Bavet । tenAvizwaM hi yatkiYcicCipivizwaM hi tatsmftam ॥6॥

text: yāsko māmṛṣiravyagro naikayajñeṣu gītavān । śipiviṣṭa iti hyasmādguhyanāmadharo hyaham ॥7॥
html:
yāsko māmṛṣiravyagro naikayajñeṣu gītavān ।
śipiviṣṭa iti hyasmādguhyanāmadharo hyaham ॥7॥
slp1: yAsko mAmfziravyagro nEkayajYezu gItavAn । Sipivizwa iti hyasmAdguhyanAmaDaro hyaham ॥7॥

text: stutvā māṃ śipiviṣṭeti yāsko ṛṣirudāradhīḥ । matprasādādadho naṣṭaṃ niruktamabhijagmivān ॥8॥
html:
stutvā māṃ śipiviṣṭeti yāsko ṛṣirudāradhīḥ ।
matprasādādadho naṣṭaṃ niruktamabhijagmivān ॥8॥
slp1: stutvA mAM Sipivizweti yAsko fzirudAraDIH । matprasAdAdaDo nazwaM niruktamaBijagmivAn ॥8॥

text: na hi jāto na jāye'haṃ na janiṣye kadācana । kṣetrajñaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tasmādahamajaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥9॥
html:
na hi jāto na jāye'haṃ na janiṣye kadācana ।
kṣetrajñaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tasmādahamajaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: na hi jAto na jAye'haM na janizye kadAcana । kzetrajYaH sarvaBUtAnAM tasmAdahamajaH smftaH ॥9॥

text: noktapūrvaṃ mayā kṣudramaślīlaṃ vā kadācana । ṛtā brahmasutā sā me satyā devī sarasvatī ॥10॥
html:
noktapūrvaṃ mayā kṣudramaślīlaṃ vā kadācana ।
ṛtā brahmasutā sā me satyā devī sarasvatī ॥10॥
slp1: noktapUrvaM mayA kzudramaSlIlaM vA kadAcana । ftA brahmasutA sA me satyA devI sarasvatI ॥10॥

text: saccāsaccaiva kaunteya mayāveśitamātmani । pauṣkare brahmasadane satyaṃ māmṛṣayo viduḥ ॥11॥
html:
saccāsaccaiva kaunteya mayāveśitamātmani ।
pauṣkare brahmasadane satyaṃ māmṛṣayo viduḥ ॥11॥
slp1: saccAsaccEva kOnteya mayAveSitamAtmani । pOzkare brahmasadane satyaM mAmfzayo viduH ॥11॥

text: sattvānna cyutapūrvo'haṃ sattvaṃ vai viddhi matkṛtam । janmanīhābhavatsattvaṃ paurvikaṃ me dhanañjaya ॥12॥
html:
sattvānna cyutapūrvo'haṃ sattvaṃ vai viddhi matkṛtam ।
janmanīhābhavatsattvaṃ paurvikaṃ me dhanañjaya ॥12॥
slp1: sattvAnna cyutapUrvo'haM sattvaM vE vidDi matkftam । janmanIhABavatsattvaM pOrvikaM me DanaYjaya ॥12॥

text: nirāśīḥkarmasaṃyuktaṃ sātvataṃ māṃ prakalpaya । sātvatajñānadṛṣṭo'haṃ sātvataḥ sātvatāṃ patiḥ ॥13॥
html:
nirāśīḥkarmasaṃyuktaṃ sātvataṃ māṃ prakalpaya ।
sātvatajñānadṛṣṭo'haṃ sātvataḥ sātvatāṃ patiḥ ॥13॥
slp1: nirASIHkarmasaMyuktaM sAtvataM mAM prakalpaya । sAtvatajYAnadfzwo'haM sAtvataH sAtvatAM patiH ॥13॥

text: kṛṣāmi medinīṃ pārtha bhūtvā kārṣṇāyaso mahān । kṛṣṇo varṇaśca me yasmāttasmātkṛṣṇo'hamarjuna ॥14॥
html:
kṛṣāmi medinīṃ pārtha bhūtvā kārṣṇāyaso mahān ।
kṛṣṇo varṇaśca me yasmāttasmātkṛṣṇo'hamarjuna ॥14॥
slp1: kfzAmi medinIM pArTa BUtvA kArzRAyaso mahAn । kfzRo varRaSca me yasmAttasmAtkfzRo'hamarjuna ॥14॥

text: mayā saṃśleṣitā bhūmiradbhirvyoma ca vāyunā । vāyuśca tejasā sārdhaṃ vaikuṇṭhatvaṃ tato mama ॥15॥
html:
mayā saṃśleṣitā bhūmiradbhirvyoma ca vāyunā ।
vāyuśca tejasā sārdhaṃ vaikuṇṭhatvaṃ tato mama ॥15॥
slp1: mayA saMSlezitA BUmiradBirvyoma ca vAyunA । vAyuSca tejasA sArDaM vEkuRWatvaM tato mama ॥15॥

text: nirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ saukhyaṃ dharmo'sau para ucyate । tasmānna cyutapūrvo'hamacyutastena karmaṇā ॥16॥
html:
nirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ saukhyaṃ dharmo'sau para ucyate ।
tasmānna cyutapūrvo'hamacyutastena karmaṇā ॥16॥
slp1: nirvARaM paramaM sOKyaM Darmo'sO para ucyate । tasmAnna cyutapUrvo'hamacyutastena karmaRA ॥16॥

text: pṛthivīnabhasī cobhe viśrute viśvalaukike । tayoḥ sandhāraṇārthaṃ hi māmadhokṣajamañjasā ॥17॥
html:
pṛthivīnabhasī cobhe viśrute viśvalaukike ।
tayoḥ sandhāraṇārthaṃ hi māmadhokṣajamañjasā ॥17॥
slp1: pfTivInaBasI coBe viSrute viSvalOkike । tayoH sanDAraRArTaM hi mAmaDokzajamaYjasA ॥17॥

text: niruktaṃ vedaviduṣo ye ca śabdārthacintakāḥ । te māṃ gāyanti prāgvaṃśe adhokṣaja iti sthitiḥ ॥18॥
html:
niruktaṃ vedaviduṣo ye ca śabdārthacintakāḥ ।
te māṃ gāyanti prāgvaṃśe adhokṣaja iti sthitiḥ ॥18॥
slp1: niruktaM vedaviduzo ye ca SabdArTacintakAH । te mAM gAyanti prAgvaMSe aDokzaja iti sTitiH ॥18॥

text: śabda ekamataireṣa vyāhṛtaḥ paramarṣibhiḥ । nānyo hyadhokṣajo loke ṛte nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ॥19॥
html:
śabda ekamataireṣa vyāhṛtaḥ paramarṣibhiḥ ।
nānyo hyadhokṣajo loke ṛte nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ॥19॥
slp1: Sabda ekamatEreza vyAhftaH paramarziBiH । nAnyo hyaDokzajo loke fte nArAyaRaM praBum ॥19॥

text: ghṛtaṃ mamārciṣo loke jantūnāṃ prāṇadhāraṇam । ghṛtārcirahamavyagrairvedajñaiḥ parikīrtitaḥ ॥20॥
html:
ghṛtaṃ mamārciṣo loke jantūnāṃ prāṇadhāraṇam ।
ghṛtārcirahamavyagrairvedajñaiḥ parikīrtitaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: GftaM mamArcizo loke jantUnAM prARaDAraRam । GftArcirahamavyagrErvedajYEH parikIrtitaH ॥20॥

text: trayo hi dhātavaḥ khyātāḥ karmajā iti ca smṛtāḥ । pittaṃ śleṣmā ca vāyuśca eṣa saṅghāta ucyate ॥21॥
html:
trayo hi dhātavaḥ khyātāḥ karmajā iti ca smṛtāḥ ।
pittaṃ śleṣmā ca vāyuśca eṣa saṅghāta ucyate ॥21॥
slp1: trayo hi DAtavaH KyAtAH karmajA iti ca smftAH । pittaM SlezmA ca vAyuSca eza saNGAta ucyate ॥21॥

text: etaiśca dhāryate janturetaiḥ kṣīṇaiśca kṣīyate । āyurvedavidastasmāttridhātuṃ māṃ pracakṣate ॥22॥
html:
etaiśca dhāryate janturetaiḥ kṣīṇaiśca kṣīyate ।
āyurvedavidastasmāttridhātuṃ māṃ pracakṣate ॥22॥
slp1: etESca DAryate janturetEH kzIRESca kzIyate । AyurvedavidastasmAttriDAtuM mAM pracakzate ॥22॥

text: vṛṣo hi bhagavāndharmaḥ khyāto lokeṣu bhārata । naighaṇṭukapadākhyātaṃ viddhi māṃ vṛṣamuttamam ॥23॥
html:
vṛṣo hi bhagavāndharmaḥ khyāto lokeṣu bhārata ।
naighaṇṭukapadākhyātaṃ viddhi māṃ vṛṣamuttamam ॥23॥
slp1: vfzo hi BagavAnDarmaH KyAto lokezu BArata । nEGaRwukapadAKyAtaM vidDi mAM vfzamuttamam ॥23॥

text: kapirvarāhaḥ śreṣṭhaśca dharmaśca vṛṣa ucyate । tasmādvṛṣākapiṃ prāha kaśyapo māṃ prajāpatiḥ ॥24॥
html:
kapirvarāhaḥ śreṣṭhaśca dharmaśca vṛṣa ucyate ।
tasmādvṛṣākapiṃ prāha kaśyapo māṃ prajāpatiḥ ॥24॥
slp1: kapirvarAhaH SrezWaSca DarmaSca vfza ucyate । tasmAdvfzAkapiM prAha kaSyapo mAM prajApatiH ॥24॥

text: na cādiṃ na madhyaṃ tathā naiva cāntaṃ kadācidvidante surāścāsurāśca । anādyo hyamadhyastathā cāpyanantaḥ pragīto'hamīśo vibhurlokasākṣī ॥25॥
html:
na cādiṃ na madhyaṃ tathā naiva cāntaṃ kadācidvidante surāścāsurāśca ।
anādyo hyamadhyastathā cāpyanantaḥ pragīto'hamīśo vibhurlokasākṣī ॥25॥
slp1: na cAdiM na maDyaM taTA nEva cAntaM kadAcidvidante surAScAsurASca । anAdyo hyamaDyastaTA cApyanantaH pragIto'hamISo viBurlokasAkzI ॥25॥

text: śucīni śravaṇīyāni śṛṇomīha dhanañjaya । na ca pāpāni gṛhṇāmi tato'haṃ vai śuciśravāḥ ॥26॥
html:
śucīni śravaṇīyāni śṛṇomīha dhanañjaya ।
na ca pāpāni gṛhṇāmi tato'haṃ vai śuciśravāḥ ॥26॥
slp1: SucIni SravaRIyAni SfRomIha DanaYjaya । na ca pApAni gfhRAmi tato'haM vE SuciSravAH ॥26॥

text: ekaśṛṅgaḥ purā bhūtvā varāho divyadarśanaḥ । imāmuddhṛtavānbhūmimekaśṛṅgastato hyaham ॥27॥
html:
ekaśṛṅgaḥ purā bhūtvā varāho divyadarśanaḥ ।
imāmuddhṛtavānbhūmimekaśṛṅgastato hyaham ॥27॥
slp1: ekaSfNgaH purA BUtvA varAho divyadarSanaH । imAmudDftavAnBUmimekaSfNgastato hyaham ॥27॥

text: tathaivāsaṃ trikakudo vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ । trikakuttena vikhyātaḥ śarīrasya tu māpanāt ॥28॥
html:
tathaivāsaṃ trikakudo vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ ।
trikakuttena vikhyātaḥ śarīrasya tu māpanāt ॥28॥
slp1: taTEvAsaM trikakudo vArAhaM rUpamAsTitaH । trikakuttena viKyAtaH SarIrasya tu mApanAt ॥28॥

text: viriñca iti yaḥ proktaḥ kapilajñānacintakaiḥ । sa prajāpatirevāhaṃ cetanātsarvalokakṛt ॥29॥
html:
viriñca iti yaḥ proktaḥ kapilajñānacintakaiḥ ।
sa prajāpatirevāhaṃ cetanātsarvalokakṛt ॥29॥
slp1: viriYca iti yaH proktaH kapilajYAnacintakEH । sa prajApatirevAhaM cetanAtsarvalokakft ॥29॥

text: vidyāsahāyavantaṃ māmādityasthaṃ sanātanam । kapilaṃ prāhurācāryāḥ sāṅkhyā niścitaniścayāḥ ॥30॥
html:
vidyāsahāyavantaṃ māmādityasthaṃ sanātanam ।
kapilaṃ prāhurācāryāḥ sāṅkhyā niścitaniścayāḥ ॥30॥
slp1: vidyAsahAyavantaM mAmAdityasTaM sanAtanam । kapilaM prAhurAcAryAH sANKyA niScitaniScayAH ॥30॥

text: hiraṇyagarbho dyutimāneṣa yaśchandasi stutaḥ । yogaiḥ sampūjyate nityaṃ sa evāhaṃ vibhuḥ smṛtaḥ ॥31॥
html:
hiraṇyagarbho dyutimāneṣa yaśchandasi stutaḥ ।
yogaiḥ sampūjyate nityaṃ sa evāhaṃ vibhuḥ smṛtaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: hiraRyagarBo dyutimAneza yaSCandasi stutaH । yogEH sampUjyate nityaM sa evAhaM viBuH smftaH ॥31॥

text: ekaviṃśatiśākhaṃ ca ṛgvedaṃ māṃ pracakṣate । sahasraśākhaṃ yatsāma ye vai vedavido janāḥ । gāyantyāraṇyake viprā madbhaktāste'pi durlabhāḥ ॥32॥
html:
ekaviṃśatiśākhaṃ ca ṛgvedaṃ māṃ pracakṣate ।
sahasraśākhaṃ yatsāma ye vai vedavido janāḥ ।
gāyantyāraṇyake viprā madbhaktāste'pi durlabhāḥ ॥32॥
slp1: ekaviMSatiSAKaM ca fgvedaM mAM pracakzate । sahasraSAKaM yatsAma ye vE vedavido janAH । gAyantyAraRyake viprA madBaktAste'pi durlaBAH ॥32॥

text: ṣaṭpañcāśatamaṣṭau ca saptatriṃśatamityuta । yasmiñśākhā yajurvede so'hamādhvaryave smṛtaḥ ॥33॥
html:
ṣaṭpañcāśatamaṣṭau ca saptatriṃśatamityuta ।
yasmiñśākhā yajurvede so'hamādhvaryave smṛtaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: zawpaYcASatamazwO ca saptatriMSatamityuta । yasmiYSAKA yajurvede so'hamADvaryave smftaH ॥33॥

text: pañcakalpamatharvāṇaṃ kṛtyābhiḥ paribṛṃhitam । kalpayanti hi māṃ viprā atharvāṇavidastathā ॥34॥
html:
pañcakalpamatharvāṇaṃ kṛtyābhiḥ paribṛṃhitam ।
kalpayanti hi māṃ viprā atharvāṇavidastathā ॥34॥
slp1: paYcakalpamaTarvARaM kftyABiH paribfMhitam । kalpayanti hi mAM viprA aTarvARavidastaTA ॥34॥

text: śākhābhedāśca ye kecidyāśca śākhāsu gītayaḥ । svaravarṇasamuccārāḥ sarvāṃstānviddhi matkṛtān ॥35॥
html:
śākhābhedāśca ye kecidyāśca śākhāsu gītayaḥ ।
svaravarṇasamuccārāḥ sarvāṃstānviddhi matkṛtān ॥35॥
slp1: SAKABedASca ye kecidyASca SAKAsu gItayaH । svaravarRasamuccArAH sarvAMstAnvidDi matkftAn ॥35॥

text: yattaddhayaśiraḥ pārtha samudeti varapradam । so'hamevottare bhāge kramākṣaravibhāgavit ॥36॥
html:
yattaddhayaśiraḥ pārtha samudeti varapradam ।
so'hamevottare bhāge kramākṣaravibhāgavit ॥36॥
slp1: yattadDayaSiraH pArTa samudeti varapradam । so'hamevottare BAge kramAkzaraviBAgavit ॥36॥

text: rāmādeśitamārgeṇa matprasādānmahātmanā । pāñcālena kramaḥ prāptastasmādbhūtātsanātanāt । bābhravyagotraḥ sa babhau prathamaḥ kramapāragaḥ ॥37॥
html:
rāmādeśitamārgeṇa matprasādānmahātmanā ।
pāñcālena kramaḥ prāptastasmādbhūtātsanātanāt ।
bābhravyagotraḥ sa babhau prathamaḥ kramapāragaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: rAmAdeSitamArgeRa matprasAdAnmahAtmanA । pAYcAlena kramaH prAptastasmAdBUtAtsanAtanAt । bABravyagotraH sa baBO praTamaH kramapAragaH ॥37॥

text: nārāyaṇādvaraṃ labdhvā prāpya yogamanuttamam । kramaṃ praṇīya śikṣāṃ ca praṇayitvā sa gālavaḥ ॥38॥
html:
nārāyaṇādvaraṃ labdhvā prāpya yogamanuttamam ।
kramaṃ praṇīya śikṣāṃ ca praṇayitvā sa gālavaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: nArAyaRAdvaraM labDvA prApya yogamanuttamam । kramaM praRIya SikzAM ca praRayitvA sa gAlavaH ॥38॥

text: kaṇḍarīko'tha rājā ca brahmadattaḥ pratāpavān । jātīmaraṇajaṃ duḥkhaṃ smṛtvā smṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ । saptajātiṣu mukhyatvādyogānāṃ sampadaṃ gataḥ ॥39॥
html:
kaṇḍarīko'tha rājā ca brahmadattaḥ pratāpavān ।
jātīmaraṇajaṃ duḥkhaṃ smṛtvā smṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ ।
saptajātiṣu mukhyatvādyogānāṃ sampadaṃ gataḥ ॥39॥
slp1: kaRqarIko'Ta rAjA ca brahmadattaH pratApavAn । jAtImaraRajaM duHKaM smftvA smftvA punaH punaH । saptajAtizu muKyatvAdyogAnAM sampadaM gataH ॥39॥

text: purāhamātmajaḥ pārtha prathitaḥ kāraṇāntare । dharmasya kuruśārdūla tato'haṃ dharmajaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥40॥
html:
purāhamātmajaḥ pārtha prathitaḥ kāraṇāntare ।
dharmasya kuruśārdūla tato'haṃ dharmajaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: purAhamAtmajaH pArTa praTitaH kAraRAntare । Darmasya kuruSArdUla tato'haM DarmajaH smftaH ॥40॥

text: naranārāyaṇau pūrvaṃ tapastepaturavyayam । dharmayānaṃ samārūḍhau parvate gandhamādane ॥41॥
html:
naranārāyaṇau pūrvaṃ tapastepaturavyayam ।
dharmayānaṃ samārūḍhau parvate gandhamādane ॥41॥
slp1: naranArAyaRO pUrvaM tapastepaturavyayam । DarmayAnaM samArUQO parvate ganDamAdane ॥41॥

text: tatkālasamayaṃ caiva dakṣayajño babhūva ha । na caivākalpayadbhāgaṃ dakṣo rudrasya bhārata ॥42॥
html:
tatkālasamayaṃ caiva dakṣayajño babhūva ha ।
na caivākalpayadbhāgaṃ dakṣo rudrasya bhārata ॥42॥
slp1: tatkAlasamayaM cEva dakzayajYo baBUva ha । na cEvAkalpayadBAgaM dakzo rudrasya BArata ॥42॥

text: tato dadhīcivacanāddakṣayajñamapāharat । sasarja śūlaṃ krodhena prajvalantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ॥43॥
html:
tato dadhīcivacanāddakṣayajñamapāharat ।
sasarja śūlaṃ krodhena prajvalantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ॥43॥
slp1: tato daDIcivacanAddakzayajYamapAharat । sasarja SUlaM kroDena prajvalantaM muhurmuhuH ॥43॥

text: tacchūlaṃ bhasmasātkṛtvā dakṣayajñaṃ savistaram । āvayoḥ sahasāgacchadbadaryāśramamantikāt । vegena mahatā pārtha patannārāyaṇorasi ॥44॥
html:
tacchūlaṃ bhasmasātkṛtvā dakṣayajñaṃ savistaram ।
āvayoḥ sahasāgacchadbadaryāśramamantikāt ।
vegena mahatā pārtha patannārāyaṇorasi ॥44॥
slp1: tacCUlaM BasmasAtkftvA dakzayajYaM savistaram । AvayoH sahasAgacCadbadaryASramamantikAt । vegena mahatA pArTa patannArAyaRorasi ॥44॥

text: tataḥ svatejasāviṣṭāḥ keśā nārāyaṇasya ha । babhūvurmuñjavarṇāstu tato'haṃ muñjakeśavān ॥45॥
html:
tataḥ svatejasāviṣṭāḥ keśā nārāyaṇasya ha ।
babhūvurmuñjavarṇāstu tato'haṃ muñjakeśavān ॥45॥
slp1: tataH svatejasAvizwAH keSA nArAyaRasya ha । baBUvurmuYjavarRAstu tato'haM muYjakeSavAn ॥45॥

text: tacca śūlaṃ vinirdhūtaṃ huṅkāreṇa mahātmanā । jagāma śaṅkarakaraṃ nārāyaṇasamāhatam ॥46॥
html:
tacca śūlaṃ vinirdhūtaṃ huṅkāreṇa mahātmanā ।
jagāma śaṅkarakaraṃ nārāyaṇasamāhatam ॥46॥
slp1: tacca SUlaM vinirDUtaM huNkAreRa mahAtmanA । jagAma SaNkarakaraM nArAyaRasamAhatam ॥46॥

text: atha rudra upādhāvattāvṛṣī tapasānvitau । tata enaṃ samuddhūtaṃ kaṇṭhe jagrāha pāṇinā । nārāyaṇaḥ sa viśvātmā tenāsya śitikaṇṭhatā ॥47॥
html:
atha rudra upādhāvattāvṛṣī tapasānvitau ।
tata enaṃ samuddhūtaṃ kaṇṭhe jagrāha pāṇinā ।
nārāyaṇaḥ sa viśvātmā tenāsya śitikaṇṭhatā ॥47॥
slp1: aTa rudra upADAvattAvfzI tapasAnvitO । tata enaM samudDUtaM kaRWe jagrAha pARinA । nArAyaRaH sa viSvAtmA tenAsya SitikaRWatA ॥47॥

text: atha rudravighātārthamiṣīkāṃ jagṛhe naraḥ । mantraiśca saṃyuyojāśu so'bhavatparaśurmahān ॥48॥
html:
atha rudravighātārthamiṣīkāṃ jagṛhe naraḥ ।
mantraiśca saṃyuyojāśu so'bhavatparaśurmahān ॥48॥
slp1: aTa rudraviGAtArTamizIkAM jagfhe naraH । mantrESca saMyuyojASu so'BavatparaSurmahAn ॥48॥

text: kṣiptaśca sahasā rudre khaṇḍanaṃ prāptavāṃstadā । tato'haṃ khaṇḍaparaśuḥ smṛtaḥ paraśukhaṇḍanāt ॥49॥
html:
kṣiptaśca sahasā rudre khaṇḍanaṃ prāptavāṃstadā ।
tato'haṃ khaṇḍaparaśuḥ smṛtaḥ paraśukhaṇḍanāt ॥49॥
slp1: kziptaSca sahasA rudre KaRqanaM prAptavAMstadA । tato'haM KaRqaparaSuH smftaH paraSuKaRqanAt ॥49॥

text: asminyuddhe tu vārṣṇeya trailokyamathane tadā । jayaṃ kaḥ prāptavāṃstatra śaṃsaitanme janārdana ॥50॥
html:
asminyuddhe tu vārṣṇeya trailokyamathane tadā ।
jayaṃ kaḥ prāptavāṃstatra śaṃsaitanme janārdana ॥50॥
slp1: asminyudDe tu vArzReya trElokyamaTane tadA । jayaM kaH prAptavAMstatra SaMsEtanme janArdana ॥50॥
author: arjuna uvāca ।

text: tayoḥ saṃlagnayoryuddhe rudranārāyaṇātmanoḥ । udvignāḥ sahasā kṛtsnā lokāḥ sarve'bhavaṃstadā ॥51॥
html:
tayoḥ saṃlagnayoryuddhe rudranārāyaṇātmanoḥ ।
udvignāḥ sahasā kṛtsnā lokāḥ sarve'bhavaṃstadā ॥51॥
slp1: tayoH saMlagnayoryudDe rudranArAyaRAtmanoH । udvignAH sahasA kftsnA lokAH sarve'BavaMstadA ॥51॥
author: śrībhagavānuvāca ।

text: nāgṛhṇātpāvakaḥ śubhraṃ makheṣu suhutaṃ haviḥ । vedā na pratibhānti sma ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām ॥52॥
html:
nāgṛhṇātpāvakaḥ śubhraṃ makheṣu suhutaṃ haviḥ ।
vedā na pratibhānti sma ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām ॥52॥
slp1: nAgfhRAtpAvakaH SuBraM maKezu suhutaM haviH । vedA na pratiBAnti sma fzIRAM BAvitAtmanAm ॥52॥

text: devānrajastamaścaiva samāviviśatustadā । vasudhā sañcakampe'tha nabhaśca vipaphāla ha ॥53॥
html:
devānrajastamaścaiva samāviviśatustadā ।
vasudhā sañcakampe'tha nabhaśca vipaphāla ha ॥53॥
slp1: devAnrajastamaScEva samAviviSatustadA । vasuDA saYcakampe'Ta naBaSca vipaPAla ha ॥53॥

text: niṣprabhāṇi ca tejāṃsi brahmā caivāsanāccyutaḥ । agācchoṣaṃ samudraśca himavāṃśca vyaśīryata ॥54॥
html:
niṣprabhāṇi ca tejāṃsi brahmā caivāsanāccyutaḥ ।
agācchoṣaṃ samudraśca himavāṃśca vyaśīryata ॥54॥
slp1: nizpraBARi ca tejAMsi brahmA cEvAsanAccyutaH । agAcCozaM samudraSca himavAMSca vyaSIryata ॥54॥

text: tasminnevaṃ samutpanne nimitte pāṇḍunandana । brahmā vṛto devagaṇairṝṣibhiśca mahātmabhiḥ । ājagāmāśu taṃ deśaṃ yatra yuddhamavartata ॥55॥
html:
tasminnevaṃ samutpanne nimitte pāṇḍunandana ।
brahmā vṛto devagaṇairṝṣibhiśca mahātmabhiḥ ।
ājagāmāśu taṃ deśaṃ yatra yuddhamavartata ॥55॥
slp1: tasminnevaM samutpanne nimitte pARqunandana । brahmA vfto devagaRErFziBiSca mahAtmaBiH । AjagAmASu taM deSaM yatra yudDamavartata ॥55॥

text: sāñjalipragraho bhūtvā caturvaktro niruktagaḥ । uvāca vacanaṃ rudraṃ lokānāmastu vai śivam । nyasyāyudhāni viśveśa jagato hitakāmyayā ॥56॥
html:
sāñjalipragraho bhūtvā caturvaktro niruktagaḥ ।
uvāca vacanaṃ rudraṃ lokānāmastu vai śivam ।
nyasyāyudhāni viśveśa jagato hitakāmyayā ॥56॥
slp1: sAYjalipragraho BUtvA caturvaktro niruktagaH । uvAca vacanaM rudraM lokAnAmastu vE Sivam । nyasyAyuDAni viSveSa jagato hitakAmyayA ॥56॥

text: yadakṣaramathāvyaktamīśaṃ lokasya bhāvanam । kūṭasthaṃ kartṛnirdvandvamakarteti ca yaṃ viduḥ ॥57॥
html:
yadakṣaramathāvyaktamīśaṃ lokasya bhāvanam ।
kūṭasthaṃ kartṛnirdvandvamakarteti ca yaṃ viduḥ ॥57॥
slp1: yadakzaramaTAvyaktamISaM lokasya BAvanam । kUwasTaM kartfnirdvandvamakarteti ca yaM viduH ॥57॥

text: vyaktibhāvagatasyāsya ekā mūrtiriyaṃ śivā । naro nārāyaṇaścaiva jātau dharmakulodvahau ॥58॥
html:
vyaktibhāvagatasyāsya ekā mūrtiriyaṃ śivā ।
naro nārāyaṇaścaiva jātau dharmakulodvahau ॥58॥
slp1: vyaktiBAvagatasyAsya ekA mUrtiriyaM SivA । naro nArAyaRaScEva jAtO DarmakulodvahO ॥58॥

text: tapasā mahatā yuktau devaśreṣṭhau mahāvratau । ahaṃ prasādajastasya kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare । tvaṃ caiva krodhajastāta pūrvasarge sanātanaḥ ॥59॥
html:
tapasā mahatā yuktau devaśreṣṭhau mahāvratau ।
ahaṃ prasādajastasya kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare ।
tvaṃ caiva krodhajastāta pūrvasarge sanātanaḥ ॥59॥
slp1: tapasA mahatA yuktO devaSrezWO mahAvratO । ahaM prasAdajastasya kasmiMScitkAraRAntare । tvaM cEva kroDajastAta pUrvasarge sanAtanaH ॥59॥

text: mayā ca sārdhaṃ varadaṃ vibudhaiśca maharṣibhiḥ । prasasādayāśu lokānāṃ śāntirbhavatu māciram ॥60॥
html:
mayā ca sārdhaṃ varadaṃ vibudhaiśca maharṣibhiḥ ।
prasasādayāśu lokānāṃ śāntirbhavatu māciram ॥60॥
slp1: mayA ca sArDaM varadaM vibuDESca maharziBiH । prasasAdayASu lokAnAM SAntirBavatu mAciram ॥60॥

text: brahmaṇā tvevamuktastu rudraḥ krodhāgnimutsṛjan । prasādayāmāsa tato devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum । śaraṇaṃ ca jagāmādyaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ harim ॥61॥
html:
brahmaṇā tvevamuktastu rudraḥ krodhāgnimutsṛjan ।
prasādayāmāsa tato devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
śaraṇaṃ ca jagāmādyaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ harim ॥61॥
slp1: brahmaRA tvevamuktastu rudraH kroDAgnimutsfjan । prasAdayAmAsa tato devaM nArAyaRaM praBum । SaraRaM ca jagAmAdyaM vareRyaM varadaM harim ॥61॥

text: tato'tha varado devo jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ । prītimānabhavattatra rudreṇa saha saṅgataḥ ॥62॥
html:
tato'tha varado devo jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ ।
prītimānabhavattatra rudreṇa saha saṅgataḥ ॥62॥
slp1: tato'Ta varado devo jitakroDo jitendriyaH । prItimAnaBavattatra rudreRa saha saNgataH ॥62॥

text: ṛṣibhirbrahmaṇā caiva vibudhaiśca supūjitaḥ । uvāca devamīśānamīśaḥ sa jagato hariḥ ॥63॥
html:
ṛṣibhirbrahmaṇā caiva vibudhaiśca supūjitaḥ ।
uvāca devamīśānamīśaḥ sa jagato hariḥ ॥63॥
slp1: fziBirbrahmaRA cEva vibuDESca supUjitaH । uvAca devamISAnamISaH sa jagato hariH ॥63॥

text: yastvāṃ vetti sa māṃ vetti yastvāmanu sa māmanu । nāvayorantaraṃ kiñcinmā te bhūdbuddhiranyathā ॥64॥
html:
yastvāṃ vetti sa māṃ vetti yastvāmanu sa māmanu ।
nāvayorantaraṃ kiñcinmā te bhūdbuddhiranyathā ॥64॥
slp1: yastvAM vetti sa mAM vetti yastvAmanu sa mAmanu । nAvayorantaraM kiYcinmA te BUdbudDiranyaTA ॥64॥

text: adya prabhṛti śrīvatsaḥ śūlāṅko'yaṃ bhavatvayam । mama pāṇyaṅkitaścāpi śrīkaṇṭhastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ॥65॥
html:
adya prabhṛti śrīvatsaḥ śūlāṅko'yaṃ bhavatvayam ।
mama pāṇyaṅkitaścāpi śrīkaṇṭhastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ॥65॥
slp1: adya praBfti SrIvatsaH SUlANko'yaM Bavatvayam । mama pARyaNkitaScApi SrIkaRWastvaM Bavizyasi ॥65॥

text: evaṃ lakṣaṇamutpādya parasparakṛtaṃ tadā । sakhyaṃ caivātulaṃ kṛtvā rudreṇa sahitāvṛṣī । tapastepaturavyagrau visṛjya tridivaukasaḥ ॥66॥
html:
evaṃ lakṣaṇamutpādya parasparakṛtaṃ tadā ।
sakhyaṃ caivātulaṃ kṛtvā rudreṇa sahitāvṛṣī ।
tapastepaturavyagrau visṛjya tridivaukasaḥ ॥66॥
slp1: evaM lakzaRamutpAdya parasparakftaM tadA । saKyaM cEvAtulaM kftvA rudreRa sahitAvfzI । tapastepaturavyagrO visfjya tridivOkasaH ॥66॥

text: eṣa te kathitaḥ pārtha nārāyaṇajayo mṛdhe । nāmāni caiva guhyāni niruktāni ca bhārata । ṛṣibhiḥ kathitānīha yāni saṅkīrtitāni te ॥67॥
html:
eṣa te kathitaḥ pārtha nārāyaṇajayo mṛdhe ।
nāmāni caiva guhyāni niruktāni ca bhārata ।
ṛṣibhiḥ kathitānīha yāni saṅkīrtitāni te ॥67॥
slp1: eza te kaTitaH pArTa nArAyaRajayo mfDe । nAmAni cEva guhyAni niruktAni ca BArata । fziBiH kaTitAnIha yAni saNkIrtitAni te ॥67॥

text: evaṃ bahuvidhai rūpaiścarāmīha vasundharām । brahmalokaṃ ca kaunteya golokaṃ ca sanātanam । mayā tvaṃ rakṣito yuddhe mahāntaṃ prāptavāñjayam ॥68॥
html:
evaṃ bahuvidhai rūpaiścarāmīha vasundharām ।
brahmalokaṃ ca kaunteya golokaṃ ca sanātanam ।
mayā tvaṃ rakṣito yuddhe mahāntaṃ prāptavāñjayam ॥68॥
slp1: evaM bahuviDE rUpEScarAmIha vasunDarAm । brahmalokaM ca kOnteya golokaM ca sanAtanam । mayA tvaM rakzito yudDe mahAntaM prAptavAYjayam ॥68॥

text: yastu te so'grato yāti yuddhe sampratyupasthite । taṃ viddhi rudraṃ kaunteya devadevaṃ kapardinam ॥69॥
html:
yastu te so'grato yāti yuddhe sampratyupasthite ।
taṃ viddhi rudraṃ kaunteya devadevaṃ kapardinam ॥69॥
slp1: yastu te so'grato yAti yudDe sampratyupasTite । taM vidDi rudraM kOnteya devadevaM kapardinam ॥69॥

text: kālaḥ sa eva kathitaḥ krodhajeti mayā tava । nihatāṃstena vai pūrvaṃ hatavānasi vai ripūn ॥70॥
html:
kālaḥ sa eva kathitaḥ krodhajeti mayā tava ।
nihatāṃstena vai pūrvaṃ hatavānasi vai ripūn ॥70॥
slp1: kAlaH sa eva kaTitaH kroDajeti mayA tava । nihatAMstena vE pUrvaM hatavAnasi vE ripUn ॥70॥

text: aprameyaprabhāvaṃ taṃ devadevamumāpatim । namasva devaṃ prayato viśveśaṃ haramavyayam] ॥71॥
html:
aprameyaprabhāvaṃ taṃ devadevamumāpatim ।
namasva devaṃ prayato viśveśaṃ haramavyayam] ॥71॥
slp1: aprameyapraBAvaM taM devadevamumApatim । namasva devaM prayato viSveSaM haramavyayam] ॥71॥

text: brahmansumahadākhyānaṃ bhavatā parikīrtitam । yacchrutvā munayaḥ sarve vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ ॥1॥
html:
brahmansumahadākhyānaṃ bhavatā parikīrtitam ।
yacchrutvā munayaḥ sarve vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ ॥1॥
slp1: brahmansumahadAKyAnaM BavatA parikIrtitam । yacCrutvA munayaH sarve vismayaM paramaM gatAH ॥1॥
author: janamejaya uvāca ।

text: idaṃ śatasahasrāddhi bhāratākhyānavistarāt । āmathya matimanthena jñānodadhimanuttamam ॥2॥
html:
idaṃ śatasahasrāddhi bhāratākhyānavistarāt ।
āmathya matimanthena jñānodadhimanuttamam ॥2॥
slp1: idaM SatasahasrAdDi BAratAKyAnavistarAt । AmaTya matimanTena jYAnodaDimanuttamam ॥2॥

text: navanītaṃ yathā dadhno malayāccandanaṃ yathā । āraṇyakaṃ ca vedebhya oṣadhibhyo'mṛtaṃ yathā ॥3॥
html:
navanītaṃ yathā dadhno malayāccandanaṃ yathā ।
āraṇyakaṃ ca vedebhya oṣadhibhyo'mṛtaṃ yathā ॥3॥
slp1: navanItaM yaTA daDno malayAccandanaM yaTA । AraRyakaM ca vedeBya ozaDiByo'mftaM yaTA ॥3॥

text: samuddhṛtamidaṃ brahmankathāmṛtamanuttamam । taponidhe tvayoktaṃ hi nārāyaṇakathāśrayam ॥4॥
html:
samuddhṛtamidaṃ brahmankathāmṛtamanuttamam ।
taponidhe tvayoktaṃ hi nārāyaṇakathāśrayam ॥4॥
slp1: samudDftamidaM brahmankaTAmftamanuttamam । taponiDe tvayoktaM hi nArAyaRakaTASrayam ॥4॥

text: sa hīśo bhagavāndevaḥ sarvabhūtātmabhāvanaḥ । aho nārāyaṇaṃ tejo durdarśaṃ dvijasattama ॥5॥
html:
sa hīśo bhagavāndevaḥ sarvabhūtātmabhāvanaḥ ।
aho nārāyaṇaṃ tejo durdarśaṃ dvijasattama ॥5॥
slp1: sa hISo BagavAndevaH sarvaBUtAtmaBAvanaH । aho nArAyaRaM tejo durdarSaM dvijasattama ॥5॥

text: yatrāviśanti kalpānte sarve brahmādayaḥ surāḥ । ṛṣayaśca sagandharvā yacca kiñciccarācaram । na tato'sti paraṃ manye pāvanaṃ divi ceha ca ॥6॥
html:
yatrāviśanti kalpānte sarve brahmādayaḥ surāḥ ।
ṛṣayaśca sagandharvā yacca kiñciccarācaram ।
na tato'sti paraṃ manye pāvanaṃ divi ceha ca ॥6॥
slp1: yatrAviSanti kalpAnte sarve brahmAdayaH surAH । fzayaSca saganDarvA yacca kiYciccarAcaram । na tato'sti paraM manye pAvanaM divi ceha ca ॥6॥

text: sarvāśramābhigamanaṃ sarvatīrthāvagāhanam । na tathā phaladaṃ cāpi nārāyaṇakathā yathā ॥7॥
html:
sarvāśramābhigamanaṃ sarvatīrthāvagāhanam ।
na tathā phaladaṃ cāpi nārāyaṇakathā yathā ॥7॥
slp1: sarvASramABigamanaM sarvatIrTAvagAhanam । na taTA PaladaM cApi nArAyaRakaTA yaTA ॥7॥

text: sarvathā pāvitāḥ smeha śrutvemāmāditaḥ kathām । harerviśveśvarasyeha sarvapāpapraṇāśanīm ॥8॥
html:
sarvathā pāvitāḥ smeha śrutvemāmāditaḥ kathām ।
harerviśveśvarasyeha sarvapāpapraṇāśanīm ॥8॥
slp1: sarvaTA pAvitAH smeha SrutvemAmAditaH kaTAm । harerviSveSvarasyeha sarvapApapraRASanIm ॥8॥

text: na citraṃ kṛtavāṃstatra yadāryo me dhanañjayaḥ । vāsudevasahāyo yaḥ prāptavāñjayamuttamam ॥9॥
html:
na citraṃ kṛtavāṃstatra yadāryo me dhanañjayaḥ ।
vāsudevasahāyo yaḥ prāptavāñjayamuttamam ॥9॥
slp1: na citraM kftavAMstatra yadAryo me DanaYjayaH । vAsudevasahAyo yaH prAptavAYjayamuttamam ॥9॥

text: na cāsya kiñcidaprāpyaṃ manye lokeṣvapi triṣu । trailokyanātho viṣṇuḥ sa yasyāsītsāhyakṛtsakhā ॥10॥
html:
na cāsya kiñcidaprāpyaṃ manye lokeṣvapi triṣu ।
trailokyanātho viṣṇuḥ sa yasyāsītsāhyakṛtsakhā ॥10॥
slp1: na cAsya kiYcidaprApyaM manye lokezvapi trizu । trElokyanATo vizRuH sa yasyAsItsAhyakftsaKA ॥10॥

text: dhanyāśca sarva evāsanbrahmaṃste mama pūrvakāḥ । hitāya śreyase caiva yeṣāmāsījjanārdanaḥ ॥11॥
html:
dhanyāśca sarva evāsanbrahmaṃste mama pūrvakāḥ ।
hitāya śreyase caiva yeṣāmāsījjanārdanaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: DanyASca sarva evAsanbrahmaMste mama pUrvakAH । hitAya Sreyase cEva yezAmAsIjjanArdanaH ॥11॥

text: tapasāpi na dṛśyo hi bhagavāṁllokapūjitaḥ । yaṃ dṛṣṭavantaste sākṣācchrīvatsāṅkavibhūṣaṇam ॥12॥
html:
tapasāpi na dṛśyo hi bhagavāṁllokapūjitaḥ ।
yaṃ dṛṣṭavantaste sākṣācchrīvatsāṅkavibhūṣaṇam ॥12॥
slp1: tapasApi na dfSyo hi BagavAṁllokapUjitaH । yaM dfzwavantaste sAkzAcCrIvatsANkaviBUzaRam ॥12॥

text: tebhyo dhanyataraścaiva nāradaḥ parameṣṭhijaḥ । na cālpatejasamṛṣiṃ vedmi nāradamavyayam । śvetadvīpaṃ samāsādya yena dṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ ॥13॥
html:
tebhyo dhanyataraścaiva nāradaḥ parameṣṭhijaḥ ।
na cālpatejasamṛṣiṃ vedmi nāradamavyayam ।
śvetadvīpaṃ samāsādya yena dṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ ॥13॥
slp1: teByo DanyataraScEva nAradaH paramezWijaH । na cAlpatejasamfziM vedmi nAradamavyayam । SvetadvIpaM samAsAdya yena dfzwaH svayaM hariH ॥13॥

text: devaprasādānugataṃ vyaktaṃ tattasya darśanam । yaddṛṣṭavāṃstadā devamaniruddhatanau sthitam ॥14॥
html:
devaprasādānugataṃ vyaktaṃ tattasya darśanam ।
yaddṛṣṭavāṃstadā devamaniruddhatanau sthitam ॥14॥
slp1: devaprasAdAnugataM vyaktaM tattasya darSanam । yaddfzwavAMstadA devamanirudDatanO sTitam ॥14॥

text: badarīmāśramaṃ yattu nāradaḥ prādravatpunaḥ । naranārāyaṇau draṣṭuṃ kiṃ nu tatkāraṇaṃ mune ॥15॥
html:
badarīmāśramaṃ yattu nāradaḥ prādravatpunaḥ ।
naranārāyaṇau draṣṭuṃ kiṃ nu tatkāraṇaṃ mune ॥15॥
slp1: badarImASramaM yattu nAradaH prAdravatpunaH । naranArAyaRO drazwuM kiM nu tatkAraRaM mune ॥15॥

text: śvetadvīpānnivṛttaśca nāradaḥ parameṣṭhijaḥ । badarīmāśramaṃ prāpya samāgamya ca tāvṛṣī ॥16॥
html:
śvetadvīpānnivṛttaśca nāradaḥ parameṣṭhijaḥ ।
badarīmāśramaṃ prāpya samāgamya ca tāvṛṣī ॥16॥
slp1: SvetadvIpAnnivfttaSca nAradaH paramezWijaH । badarImASramaM prApya samAgamya ca tAvfzI ॥16॥

text: kiyantaṃ kālamavasatkāḥ kathāḥ pṛṣṭavāṃśca saḥ । śvetadvīpādupāvṛtte tasminvā sumahātmani ॥17॥
html:
kiyantaṃ kālamavasatkāḥ kathāḥ pṛṣṭavāṃśca saḥ ।
śvetadvīpādupāvṛtte tasminvā sumahātmani ॥17॥
slp1: kiyantaM kAlamavasatkAH kaTAH pfzwavAMSca saH । SvetadvIpAdupAvftte tasminvA sumahAtmani ॥17॥

text: kimabrūtāṃ mahātmānau naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī । tadetanme yathātattvaṃ sarvamākhyātumarhasi ॥18॥
html:
kimabrūtāṃ mahātmānau naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ।
tadetanme yathātattvaṃ sarvamākhyātumarhasi ॥18॥
slp1: kimabrUtAM mahAtmAnO naranArAyaRAvfzI । tadetanme yaTAtattvaM sarvamAKyAtumarhasi ॥18॥

text: namo bhagavate tasmai vyāsāyāmitatejase । yasya prasādādvakṣyāmi nārāyaṇakathāmimām ॥19॥
html:
namo bhagavate tasmai vyāsāyāmitatejase ।
yasya prasādādvakṣyāmi nārāyaṇakathāmimām ॥19॥
slp1: namo Bagavate tasmE vyAsAyAmitatejase । yasya prasAdAdvakzyAmi nArAyaRakaTAmimAm ॥19॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: prāpya śvetaṃ mahādvīpaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca harimavyayam । nivṛtto nārado rājaṃstarasā merumāgamat । hṛdayenodvahanbhāraṃ yaduktaṃ paramātmanā ॥20॥
html:
prāpya śvetaṃ mahādvīpaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca harimavyayam ।
nivṛtto nārado rājaṃstarasā merumāgamat ।
hṛdayenodvahanbhāraṃ yaduktaṃ paramātmanā ॥20॥
slp1: prApya SvetaM mahAdvIpaM dfzwvA ca harimavyayam । nivftto nArado rAjaMstarasA merumAgamat । hfdayenodvahanBAraM yaduktaM paramAtmanA ॥20॥

text: paścādasyābhavadrājannātmanaḥ sādhvasaṃ mahat । yadgatvā dūramadhvānaṃ kṣemī punarihāgataḥ ॥21॥
html:
paścādasyābhavadrājannātmanaḥ sādhvasaṃ mahat ।
yadgatvā dūramadhvānaṃ kṣemī punarihāgataḥ ॥21॥
slp1: paScAdasyABavadrAjannAtmanaH sADvasaM mahat । yadgatvA dUramaDvAnaM kzemI punarihAgataH ॥21॥

text: tato meroḥ pracakrāma parvataṃ gandhamādanam । nipapāta ca khāttūrṇaṃ viśālāṃ badarīmanu ॥22॥
html:
tato meroḥ pracakrāma parvataṃ gandhamādanam ।
nipapāta ca khāttūrṇaṃ viśālāṃ badarīmanu ॥22॥
slp1: tato meroH pracakrAma parvataM ganDamAdanam । nipapAta ca KAttUrRaM viSAlAM badarImanu ॥22॥

text: tataḥ sa dadṛśe devau purāṇāvṛṣisattamau । tapaścarantau sumahadātmaniṣṭhau mahāvratau ॥23॥
html:
tataḥ sa dadṛśe devau purāṇāvṛṣisattamau ।
tapaścarantau sumahadātmaniṣṭhau mahāvratau ॥23॥
slp1: tataH sa dadfSe devO purARAvfzisattamO । tapaScarantO sumahadAtmanizWO mahAvratO ॥23॥

text: tejasābhyadhikau sūryātsarvalokavirocanāt । śrīvatsalakṣaṇau pūjyau jaṭāmaṇḍaladhāriṇau ॥24॥
html:
tejasābhyadhikau sūryātsarvalokavirocanāt ।
śrīvatsalakṣaṇau pūjyau jaṭāmaṇḍaladhāriṇau ॥24॥
slp1: tejasAByaDikO sUryAtsarvalokavirocanAt । SrIvatsalakzaRO pUjyO jawAmaRqalaDAriRO ॥24॥

text: jālapādabhujau tau tu pādayoścakralakṣaṇau । vyūḍhoraskau dīrghabhujau tathā muṣkacatuṣkiṇau ॥25॥
html:
jālapādabhujau tau tu pādayoścakralakṣaṇau ।
vyūḍhoraskau dīrghabhujau tathā muṣkacatuṣkiṇau ॥25॥
slp1: jAlapAdaBujO tO tu pAdayoScakralakzaRO । vyUQoraskO dIrGaBujO taTA muzkacatuzkiRO ॥25॥

text: ṣaṣṭidantāvaṣṭadaṃṣṭrau meghaughasadṛśasvanau । svāsyau pṛthulalāṭau ca suhanū subhrunāsikau ॥26॥
html:
ṣaṣṭidantāvaṣṭadaṃṣṭrau meghaughasadṛśasvanau ।
svāsyau pṛthulalāṭau ca suhanū subhrunāsikau ॥26॥
slp1: zazwidantAvazwadaMzwrO meGOGasadfSasvanO । svAsyO pfTulalAwO ca suhanU suBrunAsikO ॥26॥

text: ātapatreṇa sadṛśe śirasī devayostayoḥ । evaṃ lakṣaṇasampannau mahāpuruṣasañjñitau ॥27॥
html:
ātapatreṇa sadṛśe śirasī devayostayoḥ ।
evaṃ lakṣaṇasampannau mahāpuruṣasañjñitau ॥27॥
slp1: AtapatreRa sadfSe SirasI devayostayoH । evaM lakzaRasampannO mahApuruzasaYjYitO ॥27॥

text: tau dṛṣṭvā nārado hṛṣṭastābhyāṃ ca pratipūjitaḥ । svāgatenābhibhāṣyātha pṛṣṭaścānāmayaṃ tadā ॥28॥
html:
tau dṛṣṭvā nārado hṛṣṭastābhyāṃ ca pratipūjitaḥ ।
svāgatenābhibhāṣyātha pṛṣṭaścānāmayaṃ tadā ॥28॥
slp1: tO dfzwvA nArado hfzwastAByAM ca pratipUjitaH । svAgatenABiBAzyATa pfzwaScAnAmayaM tadA ॥28॥

text: babhūvāntargatamatirnirīkṣya puruṣottamau । sadogatāstatra ye vai sarvabhūtanamaskṛtāḥ ॥29॥
html:
babhūvāntargatamatirnirīkṣya puruṣottamau ।
sadogatāstatra ye vai sarvabhūtanamaskṛtāḥ ॥29॥
slp1: baBUvAntargatamatirnirIkzya puruzottamO । sadogatAstatra ye vE sarvaBUtanamaskftAH ॥29॥

text: śvetadvīpe mayā dṛṣṭāstādṛśāvṛṣisattamau । iti sañcintya manasā kṛtvā cābhipradakṣiṇam । upopaviviśe tatra pīṭhe kuśamaye śubhe ॥30॥
html:
śvetadvīpe mayā dṛṣṭāstādṛśāvṛṣisattamau ।
iti sañcintya manasā kṛtvā cābhipradakṣiṇam ।
upopaviviśe tatra pīṭhe kuśamaye śubhe ॥30॥
slp1: SvetadvIpe mayA dfzwAstAdfSAvfzisattamO । iti saYcintya manasA kftvA cABipradakziRam । upopaviviSe tatra pIWe kuSamaye SuBe ॥30॥

text: tatastau tapasāṃ vāsau yaśasāṃ tejasāmapi । ṛṣī śamadamopetau kṛtvā pūrvāhṇikaṃ vidhim ॥31॥
html:
tatastau tapasāṃ vāsau yaśasāṃ tejasāmapi ।
ṛṣī śamadamopetau kṛtvā pūrvāhṇikaṃ vidhim ॥31॥
slp1: tatastO tapasAM vAsO yaSasAM tejasAmapi । fzI SamadamopetO kftvA pUrvAhRikaM viDim ॥31॥

text: paścānnāradamavyagrau pādyārghyābhyāṃ prapūjya ca । pīṭhayoścopaviṣṭau tau kṛtātithyāhnikau nṛpa ॥32॥
html:
paścānnāradamavyagrau pādyārghyābhyāṃ prapūjya ca ।
pīṭhayoścopaviṣṭau tau kṛtātithyāhnikau nṛpa ॥32॥
slp1: paScAnnAradamavyagrO pAdyArGyAByAM prapUjya ca । pIWayoScopavizwO tO kftAtiTyAhnikO nfpa ॥32॥

text: teṣu tatropaviṣṭeṣu sa deśo'bhivyarājata । ājyāhutimahājvālairyajñavāṭo'gnibhiryathā ॥33॥
html:
teṣu tatropaviṣṭeṣu sa deśo'bhivyarājata ।
ājyāhutimahājvālairyajñavāṭo'gnibhiryathā ॥33॥
slp1: tezu tatropavizwezu sa deSo'BivyarAjata । AjyAhutimahAjvAlEryajYavAwo'gniBiryaTA ॥33॥

text: atha nārāyaṇastatra nāradaṃ vākyamabravīt । sukhopaviṣṭaṃ viśrāntaṃ kṛtātithyaṃ sukhasthitam ॥34॥
html:
atha nārāyaṇastatra nāradaṃ vākyamabravīt ।
sukhopaviṣṭaṃ viśrāntaṃ kṛtātithyaṃ sukhasthitam ॥34॥
slp1: aTa nArAyaRastatra nAradaM vAkyamabravIt । suKopavizwaM viSrAntaM kftAtiTyaM suKasTitam ॥34॥

text: apīdānīṃ sa bhagavānparamātmā sanātanaḥ । śvetadvīpe tvayā dṛṣṭa āvayoḥ prakṛtiḥ parā ॥35॥
html:
apīdānīṃ sa bhagavānparamātmā sanātanaḥ ।
śvetadvīpe tvayā dṛṣṭa āvayoḥ prakṛtiḥ parā ॥35॥
slp1: apIdAnIM sa BagavAnparamAtmA sanAtanaH । SvetadvIpe tvayA dfzwa AvayoH prakftiH parA ॥35॥

text: dṛṣṭo me puruṣaḥ śrīmānviśvarūpadharo'vyayaḥ । sarve hi lokāstatrasthāstathā devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ । adyāpi cainaṃ paśyāmi yuvāṃ paśyansanātanau ॥36॥
html:
dṛṣṭo me puruṣaḥ śrīmānviśvarūpadharo'vyayaḥ ।
sarve hi lokāstatrasthāstathā devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ ।
adyāpi cainaṃ paśyāmi yuvāṃ paśyansanātanau ॥36॥
slp1: dfzwo me puruzaH SrImAnviSvarUpaDaro'vyayaH । sarve hi lokAstatrasTAstaTA devAH saharziBiH । adyApi cEnaM paSyAmi yuvAM paSyansanAtanO ॥36॥
author: nārada uvāca ।

text: yairlakṣaṇairupetaḥ sa hariravyaktarūpadhṛk । tairlakṣaṇairupetau hi vyaktarūpadharau yuvām ॥37॥
html:
yairlakṣaṇairupetaḥ sa hariravyaktarūpadhṛk ।
tairlakṣaṇairupetau hi vyaktarūpadharau yuvām ॥37॥
slp1: yErlakzaRErupetaH sa hariravyaktarUpaDfk । tErlakzaRErupetO hi vyaktarUpaDarO yuvAm ॥37॥

text: dṛṣṭau mayā yuvāṃ tatra tasya devasya pārśvataḥ । iha caivāgato'smyadya visṛṣṭaḥ paramātmanā ॥38॥
html:
dṛṣṭau mayā yuvāṃ tatra tasya devasya pārśvataḥ ।
iha caivāgato'smyadya visṛṣṭaḥ paramātmanā ॥38॥
slp1: dfzwO mayA yuvAM tatra tasya devasya pArSvataH । iha cEvAgato'smyadya visfzwaH paramAtmanA ॥38॥

text: ko hi nāma bhavettasya tejasā yaśasā śriyā । sadṛśastriṣu lokeṣu ṛte dharmātmajau yuvām ॥39॥
html:
ko hi nāma bhavettasya tejasā yaśasā śriyā ।
sadṛśastriṣu lokeṣu ṛte dharmātmajau yuvām ॥39॥
slp1: ko hi nAma Bavettasya tejasA yaSasA SriyA । sadfSastrizu lokezu fte DarmAtmajO yuvAm ॥39॥

text: tena me kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ nāma kṣetrajñasañjñitam । prādurbhāvāśca kathitā bhaviṣyanti hi ye yathā ॥40॥
html:
tena me kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ nāma kṣetrajñasañjñitam ।
prādurbhāvāśca kathitā bhaviṣyanti hi ye yathā ॥40॥
slp1: tena me kaTitaM pUrvaM nAma kzetrajYasaYjYitam । prAdurBAvASca kaTitA Bavizyanti hi ye yaTA ॥40॥

text: tatra ye puruṣāḥ śvetāḥ pañcendriyavivarjitāḥ । pratibuddhāśca te sarve bhaktāśca puruṣottamam ॥41॥
html:
tatra ye puruṣāḥ śvetāḥ pañcendriyavivarjitāḥ ।
pratibuddhāśca te sarve bhaktāśca puruṣottamam ॥41॥
slp1: tatra ye puruzAH SvetAH paYcendriyavivarjitAH । pratibudDASca te sarve BaktASca puruzottamam ॥41॥

text: te'rcayanti sadā devaṃ taiḥ sārdhaṃ ramate ca saḥ । priyabhakto hi bhagavānparamātmā dvijapriyaḥ ॥42॥
html:
te'rcayanti sadā devaṃ taiḥ sārdhaṃ ramate ca saḥ ।
priyabhakto hi bhagavānparamātmā dvijapriyaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: te'rcayanti sadA devaM tEH sArDaM ramate ca saH । priyaBakto hi BagavAnparamAtmA dvijapriyaH ॥42॥

text: ramate so'rcyamāno hi sadā bhāgavatapriyaḥ । viśvabhuksarvago devo bāndhavo bhaktavatsalaḥ । sa kartā kāraṇaṃ caiva kāryaṃ cātibaladyutiḥ ॥43॥
html:
ramate so'rcyamāno hi sadā bhāgavatapriyaḥ ।
viśvabhuksarvago devo bāndhavo bhaktavatsalaḥ ।
sa kartā kāraṇaṃ caiva kāryaṃ cātibaladyutiḥ ॥43॥
slp1: ramate so'rcyamAno hi sadA BAgavatapriyaH । viSvaBuksarvago devo bAnDavo BaktavatsalaH । sa kartA kAraRaM cEva kAryaM cAtibaladyutiH ॥43॥

text: tapasā yojya so''tmānaṃ śvetadvīpātparaṃ hi yat । teja ityabhivikhyātaṃ svayambhāsāvabhāsitam ॥44॥
html:
tapasā yojya so''tmānaṃ śvetadvīpātparaṃ hi yat ।
teja ityabhivikhyātaṃ svayambhāsāvabhāsitam ॥44॥
slp1: tapasA yojya so''tmAnaM SvetadvIpAtparaM hi yat । teja ityaBiviKyAtaM svayamBAsAvaBAsitam ॥44॥

text: śāntiḥ sā triṣu lokeṣu siddhānāṃ bhāvitātmanām । etayā śubhayā buddhyā naiṣṭhikaṃ vratamāsthitaḥ ॥45॥
html:
śāntiḥ sā triṣu lokeṣu siddhānāṃ bhāvitātmanām ।
etayā śubhayā buddhyā naiṣṭhikaṃ vratamāsthitaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: SAntiH sA trizu lokezu sidDAnAM BAvitAtmanAm । etayA SuBayA budDyA nEzWikaM vratamAsTitaH ॥45॥

text: na tatra sūryastapati na somo'bhivirājate । na vāyurvāti deveśe tapaścarati duścaram ॥46॥
html:
na tatra sūryastapati na somo'bhivirājate ।
na vāyurvāti deveśe tapaścarati duścaram ॥46॥
slp1: na tatra sUryastapati na somo'BivirAjate । na vAyurvAti deveSe tapaScarati duScaram ॥46॥

text: vedīmaṣṭatalotsedhāṃ bhūmāvāsthāya viśvabhuk । ekapādasthito deva ūrdhvabāhurudaṅmukhaḥ । sāṅgānāvartayanvedāṃstapastepe suduścaram ॥47॥
html:
vedīmaṣṭatalotsedhāṃ bhūmāvāsthāya viśvabhuk ।
ekapādasthito deva ūrdhvabāhurudaṅmukhaḥ ।
sāṅgānāvartayanvedāṃstapastepe suduścaram ॥47॥
slp1: vedImazwatalotseDAM BUmAvAsTAya viSvaBuk । ekapAdasTito deva UrDvabAhurudaNmuKaH । sANgAnAvartayanvedAMstapastepe suduScaram ॥47॥

text: yadbrahmā ṛṣayaścaiva svayaṃ paśupatiśca yat । śeṣāśca vibudhaśreṣṭhā daityadānavarākṣasāḥ ॥48॥
html:
yadbrahmā ṛṣayaścaiva svayaṃ paśupatiśca yat ।
śeṣāśca vibudhaśreṣṭhā daityadānavarākṣasāḥ ॥48॥
slp1: yadbrahmA fzayaScEva svayaM paSupatiSca yat । SezASca vibuDaSrezWA dEtyadAnavarAkzasAH ॥48॥

text: nāgāḥ suparṇā gandharvāḥ siddhā rājarṣayaśca ye । havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca satataṃ vidhipūrvaṃ prayuñjate । kṛtsnaṃ tattasya devasya caraṇāvupatiṣṭhati ॥49॥
html:
nāgāḥ suparṇā gandharvāḥ siddhā rājarṣayaśca ye ।
havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca satataṃ vidhipūrvaṃ prayuñjate ।
kṛtsnaṃ tattasya devasya caraṇāvupatiṣṭhati ॥49॥
slp1: nAgAH suparRA ganDarvAH sidDA rAjarzayaSca ye । havyaM kavyaM ca satataM viDipUrvaM prayuYjate । kftsnaM tattasya devasya caraRAvupatizWati ॥49॥

text: yāḥ kriyāḥ samprayuktāstu ekāntagatabuddhibhiḥ । tāḥ sarvāḥ śirasā devaḥ pratigṛhṇāti vai svayam ॥50॥
html:
yāḥ kriyāḥ samprayuktāstu ekāntagatabuddhibhiḥ ।
tāḥ sarvāḥ śirasā devaḥ pratigṛhṇāti vai svayam ॥50॥
slp1: yAH kriyAH samprayuktAstu ekAntagatabudDiBiH । tAH sarvAH SirasA devaH pratigfhRAti vE svayam ॥50॥

text: na tasyānyaḥ priyataraḥ pratibuddhairmahātmabhiḥ । vidyate triṣu lokeṣu tato'smyaikāntikaṃ gataḥ । iha caivāgatastena visṛṣṭaḥ paramātmanā ॥51॥
html:
na tasyānyaḥ priyataraḥ pratibuddhairmahātmabhiḥ ।
vidyate triṣu lokeṣu tato'smyaikāntikaṃ gataḥ ।
iha caivāgatastena visṛṣṭaḥ paramātmanā ॥51॥
slp1: na tasyAnyaH priyataraH pratibudDErmahAtmaBiH । vidyate trizu lokezu tato'smyEkAntikaM gataH । iha cEvAgatastena visfzwaH paramAtmanA ॥51॥

text: evaṃ me bhagavāndevaḥ svayamākhyātavānhariḥ । āsiṣye tatparo bhūtvā yuvābhyāṃ saha nityaśaḥ] ॥52॥
html:
evaṃ me bhagavāndevaḥ svayamākhyātavānhariḥ ।
āsiṣye tatparo bhūtvā yuvābhyāṃ saha nityaśaḥ] ॥52॥
slp1: evaM me BagavAndevaH svayamAKyAtavAnhariH । Asizye tatparo BUtvA yuvAByAM saha nityaSaH] ॥52॥

text: naranārāyaṇāvūcatuḥ । dhanyo'syanugṛhīto'si yatte dṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ । na hi taṃ dṛṣṭavānkaścitpadmayonirapi svayam ॥1॥
html:
naranārāyaṇāvūcatuḥ ।
dhanyo'syanugṛhīto'si yatte dṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।
na hi taṃ dṛṣṭavānkaścitpadmayonirapi svayam ॥1॥
slp1: naranArAyaRAvUcatuH । Danyo'syanugfhIto'si yatte dfzwaH svayaM praBuH । na hi taM dfzwavAnkaScitpadmayonirapi svayam ॥1॥

text: avyaktayonirbhagavāndurdarśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ । nāradaitaddhi te satyaṃ vacanaṃ samudāhṛtam ॥2॥
html:
avyaktayonirbhagavāndurdarśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
nāradaitaddhi te satyaṃ vacanaṃ samudāhṛtam ॥2॥
slp1: avyaktayonirBagavAndurdarSaH puruzottamaH । nAradEtadDi te satyaM vacanaM samudAhftam ॥2॥

text: nāsya bhaktaiḥ priyataro loke kaścana vidyate । tataḥ svayaṃ darśitavānsvamātmānaṃ dvijottama ॥3॥
html:
nāsya bhaktaiḥ priyataro loke kaścana vidyate ।
tataḥ svayaṃ darśitavānsvamātmānaṃ dvijottama ॥3॥
slp1: nAsya BaktEH priyataro loke kaScana vidyate । tataH svayaM darSitavAnsvamAtmAnaM dvijottama ॥3॥

text: tapo hi tapyatastasya yatsthānaṃ paramātmanaḥ । na tatsamprāpnute kaścidṛte hyāvāṃ dvijottama ॥4॥
html:
tapo hi tapyatastasya yatsthānaṃ paramātmanaḥ ।
na tatsamprāpnute kaścidṛte hyāvāṃ dvijottama ॥4॥
slp1: tapo hi tapyatastasya yatsTAnaM paramAtmanaH । na tatsamprApnute kaScidfte hyAvAM dvijottama ॥4॥

text: yā hi sūryasahasrasya samastasya bhaveddyutiḥ । sthānasya sā bhavettasya svayaṃ tena virājatā ॥5॥
html:
yā hi sūryasahasrasya samastasya bhaveddyutiḥ ।
sthānasya sā bhavettasya svayaṃ tena virājatā ॥5॥
slp1: yA hi sUryasahasrasya samastasya BaveddyutiH । sTAnasya sA Bavettasya svayaM tena virAjatA ॥5॥

text: tasmāduttiṣṭhate vipra devādviśvabhuvaḥ pateḥ । kṣamā kṣamāvatāṃ śreṣṭha yayā bhūmistu yujyate ॥6॥
html:
tasmāduttiṣṭhate vipra devādviśvabhuvaḥ pateḥ ।
kṣamā kṣamāvatāṃ śreṣṭha yayā bhūmistu yujyate ॥6॥
slp1: tasmAduttizWate vipra devAdviSvaBuvaH pateH । kzamA kzamAvatAM SrezWa yayA BUmistu yujyate ॥6॥

text: tasmāccottiṣṭhate devātsarvabhūtahito rasaḥ । āpo yena hi yujyante dravatvaṃ prāpnuvanti ca ॥7॥
html:
tasmāccottiṣṭhate devātsarvabhūtahito rasaḥ ।
āpo yena hi yujyante dravatvaṃ prāpnuvanti ca ॥7॥
slp1: tasmAccottizWate devAtsarvaBUtahito rasaH । Apo yena hi yujyante dravatvaM prApnuvanti ca ॥7॥

text: tasmādeva samudbhūtaṃ tejo rūpaguṇātmakam । yena sma yujyate sūryastato lokānvirājate ॥8॥
html:
tasmādeva samudbhūtaṃ tejo rūpaguṇātmakam ।
yena sma yujyate sūryastato lokānvirājate ॥8॥
slp1: tasmAdeva samudBUtaM tejo rUpaguRAtmakam । yena sma yujyate sUryastato lokAnvirAjate ॥8॥

text: tasmāddevātsamudbhūtaḥ sparśastu puruṣottamāt । yena sma yujyate vāyustato lokānvivātyasau ॥9॥
html:
tasmāddevātsamudbhūtaḥ sparśastu puruṣottamāt ।
yena sma yujyate vāyustato lokānvivātyasau ॥9॥
slp1: tasmAddevAtsamudBUtaH sparSastu puruzottamAt । yena sma yujyate vAyustato lokAnvivAtyasO ॥9॥

text: tasmāccottiṣṭhate śabdaḥ sarvalokeśvarātprabhoḥ । ākāśaṃ yujyate yena tatastiṣṭhatyasaṃvṛtam ॥10॥
html:
tasmāccottiṣṭhate śabdaḥ sarvalokeśvarātprabhoḥ ।
ākāśaṃ yujyate yena tatastiṣṭhatyasaṃvṛtam ॥10॥
slp1: tasmAccottizWate SabdaH sarvalokeSvarAtpraBoH । AkASaM yujyate yena tatastizWatyasaMvftam ॥10॥

text: tasmāccottiṣṭhate devātsarvabhūtagataṃ manaḥ । candramā yena saṃyuktaḥ prakāśaguṇadhāraṇaḥ ॥11॥
html:
tasmāccottiṣṭhate devātsarvabhūtagataṃ manaḥ ।
candramā yena saṃyuktaḥ prakāśaguṇadhāraṇaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: tasmAccottizWate devAtsarvaBUtagataM manaH । candramA yena saMyuktaH prakASaguRaDAraRaH ॥11॥

text: ṣaḍbhūtotpādakaṃ nāma tatsthānaṃ vedasañjñitam । vidyāsahāyo yatrāste bhagavānhavyakavyabhuk ॥12॥
html:
ṣaḍbhūtotpādakaṃ nāma tatsthānaṃ vedasañjñitam ।
vidyāsahāyo yatrāste bhagavānhavyakavyabhuk ॥12॥
slp1: zaqBUtotpAdakaM nAma tatsTAnaM vedasaYjYitam । vidyAsahAyo yatrAste BagavAnhavyakavyaBuk ॥12॥

text: ye hi niṣkalmaṣā loke puṇyapāpavivarjitāḥ । teṣāṃ vai kṣemamadhvānaṃ gacchatāṃ dvijasattama । sarvalokatamohantā ādityo dvāramucyate ॥13॥
html:
ye hi niṣkalmaṣā loke puṇyapāpavivarjitāḥ ।
teṣāṃ vai kṣemamadhvānaṃ gacchatāṃ dvijasattama ।
sarvalokatamohantā ādityo dvāramucyate ॥13॥
slp1: ye hi nizkalmazA loke puRyapApavivarjitAH । tezAM vE kzemamaDvAnaM gacCatAM dvijasattama । sarvalokatamohantA Adityo dvAramucyate ॥13॥

text: ādityadagdhasarvāṅgā adṛśyāḥ kenacitkvacit । paramāṇubhūtā bhūtvā tu taṃ devaṃ praviśantyuta ॥14॥
html:
ādityadagdhasarvāṅgā adṛśyāḥ kenacitkvacit ।
paramāṇubhūtā bhūtvā tu taṃ devaṃ praviśantyuta ॥14॥
slp1: AdityadagDasarvANgA adfSyAH kenacitkvacit । paramARuBUtA BUtvA tu taM devaM praviSantyuta ॥14॥

text: tasmādapi vinirmuktā aniruddhatanau sthitāḥ । manobhūtāstato bhūyaḥ pradyumnaṃ praviśantyuta ॥15॥
html:
tasmādapi vinirmuktā aniruddhatanau sthitāḥ ।
manobhūtāstato bhūyaḥ pradyumnaṃ praviśantyuta ॥15॥
slp1: tasmAdapi vinirmuktA anirudDatanO sTitAH । manoBUtAstato BUyaH pradyumnaM praviSantyuta ॥15॥

text: pradyumnāccāpi nirmuktā jīvaṃ saṅkarṣaṇaṃ tathā । viśanti viprapravarāḥ sāṅkhyā bhāgavataiḥ saha ॥16॥
html:
pradyumnāccāpi nirmuktā jīvaṃ saṅkarṣaṇaṃ tathā ।
viśanti viprapravarāḥ sāṅkhyā bhāgavataiḥ saha ॥16॥
slp1: pradyumnAccApi nirmuktA jIvaM saNkarzaRaM taTA । viSanti viprapravarAH sANKyA BAgavatEH saha ॥16॥

text: tatastraiguṇyahīnāste paramātmānamañjasā । praviśanti dvijaśreṣṭha kṣetrajñaṃ nirguṇātmakam । sarvāvāsaṃ vāsudevaṃ kṣetrajñaṃ viddhi tattvataḥ ॥17॥
html:
tatastraiguṇyahīnāste paramātmānamañjasā ।
praviśanti dvijaśreṣṭha kṣetrajñaṃ nirguṇātmakam ।
sarvāvāsaṃ vāsudevaṃ kṣetrajñaṃ viddhi tattvataḥ ॥17॥
slp1: tatastrEguRyahInAste paramAtmAnamaYjasA । praviSanti dvijaSrezWa kzetrajYaM nirguRAtmakam । sarvAvAsaM vAsudevaM kzetrajYaM vidDi tattvataH ॥17॥

text: samāhitamanaskāśca niyatāḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ । ekāntabhāvopagatā vāsudevaṃ viśanti te ॥18॥
html:
samāhitamanaskāśca niyatāḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ ।
ekāntabhāvopagatā vāsudevaṃ viśanti te ॥18॥
slp1: samAhitamanaskASca niyatAH saMyatendriyAH । ekAntaBAvopagatA vAsudevaM viSanti te ॥18॥

text: āvāmapi ca dharmasya gṛhe jātau dvijottama । ramyāṃ viśālāmāśritya tapa ugraṃ samāsthitau ॥19॥
html:
āvāmapi ca dharmasya gṛhe jātau dvijottama ।
ramyāṃ viśālāmāśritya tapa ugraṃ samāsthitau ॥19॥
slp1: AvAmapi ca Darmasya gfhe jAtO dvijottama । ramyAM viSAlAmASritya tapa ugraM samAsTitO ॥19॥

text: ye tu tasyaiva devasya prādurbhāvāḥ surapriyāḥ । bhaviṣyanti trilokasthāsteṣāṃ svastītyato dvija ॥20॥
html:
ye tu tasyaiva devasya prādurbhāvāḥ surapriyāḥ ।
bhaviṣyanti trilokasthāsteṣāṃ svastītyato dvija ॥20॥
slp1: ye tu tasyEva devasya prAdurBAvAH surapriyAH । Bavizyanti trilokasTAstezAM svastItyato dvija ॥20॥

text: vidhinā svena yuktābhyāṃ yathāpūrvaṃ dvijottama । āsthitābhyāṃ sarvakṛcchraṃ vrataṃ samyaktaduttamam ॥21॥
