html:
vidhinā svena yuktābhyāṃ yathāpūrvaṃ dvijottama ।
āsthitābhyāṃ sarvakṛcchraṃ vrataṃ samyaktaduttamam ॥21॥
slp1: viDinA svena yuktAByAM yaTApUrvaM dvijottama । AsTitAByAM sarvakfcCraM vrataM samyaktaduttamam ॥21॥

text: āvābhyāmapi dṛṣṭastvaṃ śvetadvīpe tapodhana । samāgato bhagavatā sañjalpaṃ kṛtavānyathā ॥22॥
html:
āvābhyāmapi dṛṣṭastvaṃ śvetadvīpe tapodhana ।
samāgato bhagavatā sañjalpaṃ kṛtavānyathā ॥22॥
slp1: AvAByAmapi dfzwastvaM SvetadvIpe tapoDana । samAgato BagavatA saYjalpaM kftavAnyaTA ॥22॥

text: sarvaṃ hi nau saṃviditaṃ trailokye sacarācare । yadbhaviṣyati vṛttaṃ vā vartate vā śubhāśubham ॥23॥
html:
sarvaṃ hi nau saṃviditaṃ trailokye sacarācare ।
yadbhaviṣyati vṛttaṃ vā vartate vā śubhāśubham ॥23॥
slp1: sarvaM hi nO saMviditaM trElokye sacarAcare । yadBavizyati vfttaM vA vartate vA SuBASuBam ॥23॥

text: etacchrutvā tayorvākyaṃ tapasyugre'bhyavartata । nāradaḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ ॥24॥
html:
etacchrutvā tayorvākyaṃ tapasyugre'bhyavartata ।
nāradaḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: etacCrutvA tayorvAkyaM tapasyugre'Byavartata । nAradaH prAYjalirBUtvA nArAyaRaparAyaRaH ॥24॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: jajāpa vidhivanmantrānnārāyaṇagatānbahūn । divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ hi naranārāyaṇāśrame ॥25॥
html:
jajāpa vidhivanmantrānnārāyaṇagatānbahūn ।
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ hi naranārāyaṇāśrame ॥25॥
slp1: jajApa viDivanmantrAnnArAyaRagatAnbahUn । divyaM varzasahasraM hi naranArAyaRASrame ॥25॥

text: avasatsa mahātejā nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ । tamevābhyarcayandevaṃ naranārāyaṇau ca tau] ॥26॥
html:
avasatsa mahātejā nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ ।
tamevābhyarcayandevaṃ naranārāyaṇau ca tau] ॥26॥
slp1: avasatsa mahAtejA nArado BagavAnfziH । tamevAByarcayandevaM naranArAyaRO ca tO] ॥26॥

text: kasyacittvatha kālasya nāradaḥ parameṣṭhijaḥ । daivaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ pitryaṃ cakre tataḥ param ॥1॥
html:
kasyacittvatha kālasya nāradaḥ parameṣṭhijaḥ ।
daivaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ pitryaṃ cakre tataḥ param ॥1॥
slp1: kasyacittvaTa kAlasya nAradaH paramezWijaH । dEvaM kftvA yaTAnyAyaM pitryaM cakre tataH param ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: tatastaṃ vacanaṃ prāha jyeṣṭho dharmātmajaḥ prabhuḥ । ka ijyate dvijaśreṣṭha daive pitrye ca kalpite ॥2॥
html:
tatastaṃ vacanaṃ prāha jyeṣṭho dharmātmajaḥ prabhuḥ ।
ka ijyate dvijaśreṣṭha daive pitrye ca kalpite ॥2॥
slp1: tatastaM vacanaM prAha jyezWo DarmAtmajaH praBuH । ka ijyate dvijaSrezWa dEve pitrye ca kalpite ॥2॥

text: tvayā matimatāṃ śreṣṭha tanme śaṃsa yathāgamam । kimetatkriyate karma phalaṃ cāsya kimiṣyate ॥3॥
html:
tvayā matimatāṃ śreṣṭha tanme śaṃsa yathāgamam ।
kimetatkriyate karma phalaṃ cāsya kimiṣyate ॥3॥
slp1: tvayA matimatAM SrezWa tanme SaMsa yaTAgamam । kimetatkriyate karma PalaM cAsya kimizyate ॥3॥

text: tvayaitatkathitaṃ pūrvaṃ daivaṃ kartavyamityapi । daivataṃ ca paro yajñaḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ ॥4॥
html:
tvayaitatkathitaṃ pūrvaṃ daivaṃ kartavyamityapi ।
daivataṃ ca paro yajñaḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: tvayEtatkaTitaM pUrvaM dEvaM kartavyamityapi । dEvataM ca paro yajYaH paramAtmA sanAtanaH ॥4॥
author: nārada uvāca ।

text: tatastadbhāvito nityaṃ yaje vaikuṇṭhamavyayam । tasmācca prasṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ॥5॥
html:
tatastadbhāvito nityaṃ yaje vaikuṇṭhamavyayam ।
tasmācca prasṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: tatastadBAvito nityaM yaje vEkuRWamavyayam । tasmAcca prasftaH pUrvaM brahmA lokapitAmahaH ॥5॥

text: mama vai pitaraṃ prītaḥ parameṣṭhyapyajījanat । ahaṃ saṅkalpajastasya putraḥ prathamakalpitaḥ ॥6॥
html:
mama vai pitaraṃ prītaḥ parameṣṭhyapyajījanat ।
ahaṃ saṅkalpajastasya putraḥ prathamakalpitaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: mama vE pitaraM prItaH paramezWyapyajIjanat । ahaM saNkalpajastasya putraH praTamakalpitaH ॥6॥

text: yajāmyahaṃ pitṝnsādho nārāyaṇavidhau kṛte । evaṃ sa eva bhagavānpitā mātā pitāmahaḥ । ijyate pitṛyajñeṣu mayā nityaṃ jagatpatiḥ ॥7॥
html:
yajāmyahaṃ pitṝnsādho nārāyaṇavidhau kṛte ।
evaṃ sa eva bhagavānpitā mātā pitāmahaḥ ।
ijyate pitṛyajñeṣu mayā nityaṃ jagatpatiḥ ॥7॥
slp1: yajAmyahaM pitFnsADo nArAyaRaviDO kfte । evaM sa eva BagavAnpitA mAtA pitAmahaH । ijyate pitfyajYezu mayA nityaM jagatpatiH ॥7॥

text: śrutiścāpyaparā deva putrānhi pitaro'yajan । vedaśrutiḥ praṇaṣṭā ca punaradhyāpitā sutaiḥ । tataste mantradāḥ putrāḥ pitṛtvamupapedire ॥8॥
html:
śrutiścāpyaparā deva putrānhi pitaro'yajan ।
vedaśrutiḥ praṇaṣṭā ca punaradhyāpitā sutaiḥ ।
tataste mantradāḥ putrāḥ pitṛtvamupapedire ॥8॥
slp1: SrutiScApyaparA deva putrAnhi pitaro'yajan । vedaSrutiH praRazwA ca punaraDyApitA sutEH । tataste mantradAH putrAH pitftvamupapedire ॥8॥

text: nūnaṃ puraitadviditaṃ yuvayorbhāvitātmanoḥ । putrāśca pitaraścaiva parasparamapūjayan ॥9॥
html:
nūnaṃ puraitadviditaṃ yuvayorbhāvitātmanoḥ ।
putrāśca pitaraścaiva parasparamapūjayan ॥9॥
slp1: nUnaM purEtadviditaM yuvayorBAvitAtmanoH । putrASca pitaraScEva parasparamapUjayan ॥9॥

text: trīnpiṇḍānnyasya vai pṛthvyāṃ pūrvaṃ dattvā kuśāniti । kathaṃ tu piṇḍasañjñāṃ te pitaro lebhire purā ॥10॥
html:
trīnpiṇḍānnyasya vai pṛthvyāṃ pūrvaṃ dattvā kuśāniti ।
kathaṃ tu piṇḍasañjñāṃ te pitaro lebhire purā ॥10॥
slp1: trInpiRqAnnyasya vE pfTvyAM pUrvaM dattvA kuSAniti । kaTaM tu piRqasaYjYAM te pitaro leBire purA ॥10॥

text: naranārāyaṇāvūcatuḥ । imāṃ hi dharaṇīṃ pūrvaṃ naṣṭāṃ sāgaramekhalām । govinda ujjahārāśu vārāhaṃ rūpamāśritaḥ ॥11॥
html:
naranārāyaṇāvūcatuḥ ।
imāṃ hi dharaṇīṃ pūrvaṃ naṣṭāṃ sāgaramekhalām ।
govinda ujjahārāśu vārāhaṃ rūpamāśritaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: naranArAyaRAvUcatuH । imAM hi DaraRIM pUrvaM nazwAM sAgarameKalAm । govinda ujjahArASu vArAhaM rUpamASritaH ॥11॥

text: sthāpayitvā tu dharaṇīṃ sve sthāne puruṣottamaḥ । jalakardamaliptāṅgo lokakāryārthamudyataḥ ॥12॥
html:
sthāpayitvā tu dharaṇīṃ sve sthāne puruṣottamaḥ ।
jalakardamaliptāṅgo lokakāryārthamudyataḥ ॥12॥
slp1: sTApayitvA tu DaraRIM sve sTAne puruzottamaH । jalakardamaliptANgo lokakAryArTamudyataH ॥12॥

text: prāpte cāhnikakāle sa madhyandinagate ravau । daṃṣṭrāvilagnānmṛtpiṇḍānvidhūya sahasā prabhuḥ । sthāpayāmāsa vai pṛthvyāṃ kuśānāstīrya nārada ॥13॥
html:
prāpte cāhnikakāle sa madhyandinagate ravau ।
daṃṣṭrāvilagnānmṛtpiṇḍānvidhūya sahasā prabhuḥ ।
sthāpayāmāsa vai pṛthvyāṃ kuśānāstīrya nārada ॥13॥
slp1: prApte cAhnikakAle sa maDyandinagate ravO । daMzwrAvilagnAnmftpiRqAnviDUya sahasA praBuH । sTApayAmAsa vE pfTvyAM kuSAnAstIrya nArada ॥13॥

text: sa teṣvātmānamuddiśya pitryaṃ cakre yathāvidhi । saṅkalpayitvā trīnpiṇḍānsvenaiva vidhinā prabhuḥ ॥14॥
html:
sa teṣvātmānamuddiśya pitryaṃ cakre yathāvidhi ।
saṅkalpayitvā trīnpiṇḍānsvenaiva vidhinā prabhuḥ ॥14॥
slp1: sa tezvAtmAnamuddiSya pitryaM cakre yaTAviDi । saNkalpayitvA trInpiRqAnsvenEva viDinA praBuH ॥14॥

text: ātmagātroṣmasambhūtaiḥ snehagarbhaistilairapi । prokṣyāpavargaṃ deveśaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ kṛtavānsvayam ॥15॥
html:
ātmagātroṣmasambhūtaiḥ snehagarbhaistilairapi ।
prokṣyāpavargaṃ deveśaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ kṛtavānsvayam ॥15॥
slp1: AtmagAtrozmasamBUtEH snehagarBEstilErapi । prokzyApavargaM deveSaH prANmuKaH kftavAnsvayam ॥15॥

text: maryādāsthāpanārthaṃ ca tato vacanamuktavān । ahaṃ hi pitaraḥ sraṣṭumudyato lokakṛtsvayam ॥16॥
html:
maryādāsthāpanārthaṃ ca tato vacanamuktavān ।
ahaṃ hi pitaraḥ sraṣṭumudyato lokakṛtsvayam ॥16॥
slp1: maryAdAsTApanArTaM ca tato vacanamuktavAn । ahaM hi pitaraH srazwumudyato lokakftsvayam ॥16॥

text: tasya cintayataḥ sadyaḥ pitṛkāryavidhiṃ param । daṃṣṭrābhyāṃ pravinirdhūtā mamaite dakṣiṇāṃ diśam । āśritā dharaṇīṃ piṇḍāstasmātpitara eva te ॥17॥
html:
tasya cintayataḥ sadyaḥ pitṛkāryavidhiṃ param ।
daṃṣṭrābhyāṃ pravinirdhūtā mamaite dakṣiṇāṃ diśam ।
āśritā dharaṇīṃ piṇḍāstasmātpitara eva te ॥17॥
slp1: tasya cintayataH sadyaH pitfkAryaviDiM param । daMzwrAByAM pravinirDUtA mamEte dakziRAM diSam । ASritA DaraRIM piRqAstasmAtpitara eva te ॥17॥

text: trayo mūrtivihīnā vai piṇḍamūrtidharāstvime । bhavantu pitaro loke mayā sṛṣṭāḥ sanātanāḥ ॥18॥
html:
trayo mūrtivihīnā vai piṇḍamūrtidharāstvime ।
bhavantu pitaro loke mayā sṛṣṭāḥ sanātanāḥ ॥18॥
slp1: trayo mUrtivihInA vE piRqamUrtiDarAstvime । Bavantu pitaro loke mayA sfzwAH sanAtanAH ॥18॥

text: pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ । ahamevātra vijñeyastriṣu piṇḍeṣu saṃsthitaḥ ॥19॥
html:
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ।
ahamevātra vijñeyastriṣu piṇḍeṣu saṃsthitaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: pitA pitAmahaScEva taTEva prapitAmahaH । ahamevAtra vijYeyastrizu piRqezu saMsTitaH ॥19॥

text: nāsti matto'dhikaḥ kaścitko vābhyarcyo mayā svayam । ko vā mama pitā loke ahameva pitāmahaḥ ॥20॥
html:
nāsti matto'dhikaḥ kaścitko vābhyarcyo mayā svayam ।
ko vā mama pitā loke ahameva pitāmahaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: nAsti matto'DikaH kaScitko vAByarcyo mayA svayam । ko vA mama pitA loke ahameva pitAmahaH ॥20॥

text: pitāmahapitā caiva ahamevātra kāraṇam । ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ devadevo vṛṣākapiḥ ॥21॥
html:
pitāmahapitā caiva ahamevātra kāraṇam ।
ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ devadevo vṛṣākapiḥ ॥21॥
slp1: pitAmahapitA cEva ahamevAtra kAraRam । ityevamuktvA vacanaM devadevo vfzAkapiH ॥21॥

text: varāhaparvate vipra dattvā piṇḍānsavistarān । ātmānaṃ pūjayitvaiva tatraivādarśanaṃ gataḥ ॥22॥
html:
varāhaparvate vipra dattvā piṇḍānsavistarān ।
ātmānaṃ pūjayitvaiva tatraivādarśanaṃ gataḥ ॥22॥
slp1: varAhaparvate vipra dattvA piRqAnsavistarAn । AtmAnaM pUjayitvEva tatrEvAdarSanaM gataH ॥22॥

text: etadarthaṃ śubhamate pitaraḥ piṇḍasañjñitāḥ । labhante satataṃ pūjāṃ vṛṣākapivaco yathā ॥23॥
html:
etadarthaṃ śubhamate pitaraḥ piṇḍasañjñitāḥ ।
labhante satataṃ pūjāṃ vṛṣākapivaco yathā ॥23॥
slp1: etadarTaM SuBamate pitaraH piRqasaYjYitAH । laBante satataM pUjAM vfzAkapivaco yaTA ॥23॥

text: ye yajanti pitṝndevāngurūṃścaivātithīṃstathā । gāścaiva dvijamukhyāṃśca pṛthivīṃ mātaraṃ tathā । karmaṇā manasā vācā viṣṇumeva yajanti te ॥24॥
html:
ye yajanti pitṝndevāngurūṃścaivātithīṃstathā ।
gāścaiva dvijamukhyāṃśca pṛthivīṃ mātaraṃ tathā ।
karmaṇā manasā vācā viṣṇumeva yajanti te ॥24॥
slp1: ye yajanti pitFndevAngurUMScEvAtiTIMstaTA । gAScEva dvijamuKyAMSca pfTivIM mAtaraM taTA । karmaRA manasA vAcA vizRumeva yajanti te ॥24॥

text: antargataḥ sa bhagavānsarvasattvaśarīragaḥ । samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu īśvaraḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ । mahānmahātmā sarvātmā nārāyaṇa iti śrutaḥ] ॥25॥
html:
antargataḥ sa bhagavānsarvasattvaśarīragaḥ ।
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu īśvaraḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ ।
mahānmahātmā sarvātmā nārāyaṇa iti śrutaḥ] ॥25॥
slp1: antargataH sa BagavAnsarvasattvaSarIragaH । samaH sarvezu BUtezu ISvaraH suKaduHKayoH । mahAnmahAtmA sarvAtmA nArAyaRa iti SrutaH] ॥25॥

text: śrutvaitannārado vākyaṃ naranārāyaṇeritam । atyantabhaktimāndeve ekāntitvamupeyivān ॥1॥
html:
śrutvaitannārado vākyaṃ naranārāyaṇeritam ।
atyantabhaktimāndeve ekāntitvamupeyivān ॥1॥
slp1: SrutvEtannArado vAkyaM naranArAyaReritam । atyantaBaktimAndeve ekAntitvamupeyivAn ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: proṣya varṣasahasraṃ tu naranārāyaṇāśrame । śrutvā bhagavadākhyānaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca harimavyayam । himavantaṃ jagāmāśu yatrāsya svaka āśramaḥ ॥2॥
html:
proṣya varṣasahasraṃ tu naranārāyaṇāśrame ।
śrutvā bhagavadākhyānaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca harimavyayam ।
himavantaṃ jagāmāśu yatrāsya svaka āśramaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: prozya varzasahasraM tu naranArAyaRASrame । SrutvA BagavadAKyAnaM dfzwvA ca harimavyayam । himavantaM jagAmASu yatrAsya svaka ASramaH ॥2॥

text: tāvapi khyātatapasau naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī । tasminnevāśrame ramye tepatustapa uttamam ॥3॥
html:
tāvapi khyātatapasau naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ।
tasminnevāśrame ramye tepatustapa uttamam ॥3॥
slp1: tAvapi KyAtatapasO naranArAyaRAvfzI । tasminnevASrame ramye tepatustapa uttamam ॥3॥

text: tvamapyamitavikrāntaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ kulodvahaḥ । pāvitātmādya saṃvṛttaḥ śrutvemāmāditaḥ kathām ॥4॥
html:
tvamapyamitavikrāntaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ kulodvahaḥ ।
pāvitātmādya saṃvṛttaḥ śrutvemāmāditaḥ kathām ॥4॥
slp1: tvamapyamitavikrAntaH pARqavAnAM kulodvahaH । pAvitAtmAdya saMvfttaH SrutvemAmAditaH kaTAm ॥4॥

text: naiva tasya paro loko nāyaṃ pārthivasattama । karmaṇā manasā vācā yo dviṣyādviṣṇumavyayam ॥5॥
html:
naiva tasya paro loko nāyaṃ pārthivasattama ।
karmaṇā manasā vācā yo dviṣyādviṣṇumavyayam ॥5॥
slp1: nEva tasya paro loko nAyaM pArTivasattama । karmaRA manasA vAcA yo dvizyAdvizRumavyayam ॥5॥

text: majjanti pitarastasya narake śāśvatīḥ samāḥ । yo dviṣyādvibudhaśreṣṭhaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim ॥6॥
html:
majjanti pitarastasya narake śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ।
yo dviṣyādvibudhaśreṣṭhaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim ॥6॥
slp1: majjanti pitarastasya narake SASvatIH samAH । yo dvizyAdvibuDaSrezWaM devaM nArAyaRaM harim ॥6॥

text: kathaṃ nāma bhaveddveṣya ātmā lokasya kasyacit । ātmā hi puruṣavyāghra jñeyo viṣṇuriti sthitiḥ ॥7॥
html:
kathaṃ nāma bhaveddveṣya ātmā lokasya kasyacit ।
ātmā hi puruṣavyāghra jñeyo viṣṇuriti sthitiḥ ॥7॥
slp1: kaTaM nAma Baveddvezya AtmA lokasya kasyacit । AtmA hi puruzavyAGra jYeyo vizRuriti sTitiH ॥7॥

text: ya eṣa gururasmākamṛṣirgandhavatīsutaḥ । tenaitatkathitaṃ tāta māhātmyaṃ paramātmanaḥ । tasmācchrutaṃ mayā cedaṃ kathitaṃ ca tavānagha ॥8॥
html:
ya eṣa gururasmākamṛṣirgandhavatīsutaḥ ।
tenaitatkathitaṃ tāta māhātmyaṃ paramātmanaḥ ।
tasmācchrutaṃ mayā cedaṃ kathitaṃ ca tavānagha ॥8॥
slp1: ya eza gururasmAkamfzirganDavatIsutaH । tenEtatkaTitaM tAta mAhAtmyaM paramAtmanaH । tasmAcCrutaM mayA cedaM kaTitaM ca tavAnaGa ॥8॥

text: kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ vyāsaṃ viddhi nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum । ko hyanyaḥ puruṣavyāghra mahābhāratakṛdbhavet । dharmānnānāvidhāṃścaiva ko brūyāttamṛte prabhum ॥9॥
html:
kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ vyāsaṃ viddhi nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
ko hyanyaḥ puruṣavyāghra mahābhāratakṛdbhavet ।
dharmānnānāvidhāṃścaiva ko brūyāttamṛte prabhum ॥9॥
slp1: kfzRadvEpAyanaM vyAsaM vidDi nArAyaRaM praBum । ko hyanyaH puruzavyAGra mahABAratakfdBavet । DarmAnnAnAviDAMScEva ko brUyAttamfte praBum ॥9॥

text: vartatāṃ te mahāyajño yathā saṅkalpitastvayā । saṅkalpitāśvamedhastvaṃ śrutadharmaśca tattvataḥ ॥10॥
html:
vartatāṃ te mahāyajño yathā saṅkalpitastvayā ।
saṅkalpitāśvamedhastvaṃ śrutadharmaśca tattvataḥ ॥10॥
slp1: vartatAM te mahAyajYo yaTA saNkalpitastvayA । saNkalpitASvameDastvaM SrutaDarmaSca tattvataH ॥10॥

text: etattu mahadākhyānaṃ śrutvā pārikṣito nṛpaḥ । tato yajñasamāptyarthaṃ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ samārabhat ॥11॥
html:
etattu mahadākhyānaṃ śrutvā pārikṣito nṛpaḥ ।
tato yajñasamāptyarthaṃ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ samārabhat ॥11॥
slp1: etattu mahadAKyAnaM SrutvA pArikzito nfpaH । tato yajYasamAptyarTaM kriyAH sarvAH samAraBat ॥11॥

text: nārāyaṇīyamākhyānametatte kathitaṃ mayā । nāradena purā rājangurave me niveditam । ṛṣīṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca śṛṇvatoḥ kṛṣṇabhīṣmayoḥ ॥12॥
html:
nārāyaṇīyamākhyānametatte kathitaṃ mayā ।
nāradena purā rājangurave me niveditam ।
ṛṣīṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca śṛṇvatoḥ kṛṣṇabhīṣmayoḥ ॥12॥
slp1: nArAyaRIyamAKyAnametatte kaTitaM mayA । nAradena purA rAjangurave me niveditam । fzIRAM pARqavAnAM ca SfRvatoH kfzRaBIzmayoH ॥12॥

text: sa hi paramagururbhuvanapatirdharaṇidharaḥ śamaniyamanidhiḥ । śrutivinayanidhirdvijaparamahitastava bhavatu gatirhariramarahitaḥ ॥13॥
html:
sa hi paramagururbhuvanapatirdharaṇidharaḥ śamaniyamanidhiḥ ।
śrutivinayanidhirdvijaparamahitastava bhavatu gatirhariramarahitaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: sa hi paramagururBuvanapatirDaraRiDaraH SamaniyamaniDiH । SrutivinayaniDirdvijaparamahitastava Bavatu gatirhariramarahitaH ॥13॥

text: tapasāṃ nidhiḥ sumahatāṃ mahato yaśasaśca bhājanamariṣṭakahā । ekāntināṃ śaraṇado'bhayado gatido'stu vaḥ sa makhabhāgaharaḥ ॥14॥
html:
tapasāṃ nidhiḥ sumahatāṃ mahato yaśasaśca bhājanamariṣṭakahā ।
ekāntināṃ śaraṇado'bhayado gatido'stu vaḥ sa makhabhāgaharaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: tapasAM niDiH sumahatAM mahato yaSasaSca BAjanamarizwakahA । ekAntinAM SaraRado'Bayado gatido'stu vaH sa maKaBAgaharaH ॥14॥

text: triguṇātigaścatuṣpañcadharaḥ pūrteṣṭayośca phalabhāgaharaḥ । vidadhāti nityamajito'tibalo gatimātmagāṃ sukṛtināmṛṣiṇām ॥15॥
html:
triguṇātigaścatuṣpañcadharaḥ pūrteṣṭayośca phalabhāgaharaḥ ।
vidadhāti nityamajito'tibalo gatimātmagāṃ sukṛtināmṛṣiṇām ॥15॥
slp1: triguRAtigaScatuzpaYcaDaraH pUrtezwayoSca PalaBAgaharaH । vidaDAti nityamajito'tibalo gatimAtmagAM sukftinAmfziRAm ॥15॥

text: taṃ lokasākṣiṇamajaṃ puruṣaṃ ravivarṇamīśvaragatiṃ bahuśaḥ । praṇamadhvamekamatayo yatayaḥ salilodbhavo'pi tamṛṣiṃ praṇataḥ ॥16॥
html:
taṃ lokasākṣiṇamajaṃ puruṣaṃ ravivarṇamīśvaragatiṃ bahuśaḥ ।
praṇamadhvamekamatayo yatayaḥ salilodbhavo'pi tamṛṣiṃ praṇataḥ ॥16॥
slp1: taM lokasAkziRamajaM puruzaM ravivarRamISvaragatiM bahuSaH । praRamaDvamekamatayo yatayaH salilodBavo'pi tamfziM praRataH ॥16॥

text: sa hi lokayoniramṛtasya padaṃ sūkṣmaṃ purāṇamacalaṃ paramam । tatsāṅkhyayogibhirudāradhṛtaṃ buddhyā yatātmabhirviditaṃ satatam] ॥17॥
html:
sa hi lokayoniramṛtasya padaṃ sūkṣmaṃ purāṇamacalaṃ paramam ।
tatsāṅkhyayogibhirudāradhṛtaṃ buddhyā yatātmabhirviditaṃ satatam] ॥17॥
slp1: sa hi lokayoniramftasya padaM sUkzmaM purARamacalaM paramam । tatsANKyayogiBirudAraDftaM budDyA yatAtmaBirviditaM satatam] ॥17॥

text: śrutaṃ bhagavatastasya māhātmyaṃ paramātmanaḥ । janma dharmagṛhe caiva naranārāyaṇātmakam । mahāvarāhasṛṣṭā ca piṇḍotpattiḥ purātanī ॥1॥
html:
śrutaṃ bhagavatastasya māhātmyaṃ paramātmanaḥ ।
janma dharmagṛhe caiva naranārāyaṇātmakam ।
mahāvarāhasṛṣṭā ca piṇḍotpattiḥ purātanī ॥1॥
slp1: SrutaM Bagavatastasya mAhAtmyaM paramAtmanaH । janma Darmagfhe cEva naranArAyaRAtmakam । mahAvarAhasfzwA ca piRqotpattiH purAtanI ॥1॥
author: janamejaya uvāca ।

text: pravṛttau ca nivṛttau ca yo yathā parikalpitaḥ । sa tathā naḥ śruto brahmankathyamānastvayānagha ॥2॥
html:
pravṛttau ca nivṛttau ca yo yathā parikalpitaḥ ।
sa tathā naḥ śruto brahmankathyamānastvayānagha ॥2॥
slp1: pravfttO ca nivfttO ca yo yaTA parikalpitaH । sa taTA naH Sruto brahmankaTyamAnastvayAnaGa ॥2॥

text: yacca tatkathitaṃ pūrvaṃ tvayā hayaśiro mahat । havyakavyabhujo viṣṇorudakpūrve mahodadhau । tacca dṛṣṭaṃ bhagavatā brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā ॥3॥
html:
yacca tatkathitaṃ pūrvaṃ tvayā hayaśiro mahat ।
havyakavyabhujo viṣṇorudakpūrve mahodadhau ।
tacca dṛṣṭaṃ bhagavatā brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā ॥3॥
slp1: yacca tatkaTitaM pUrvaM tvayA hayaSiro mahat । havyakavyaBujo vizRorudakpUrve mahodaDO । tacca dfzwaM BagavatA brahmaRA paramezWinA ॥3॥

text: kiṃ tadutpāditaṃ pūrvaṃ hariṇā lokadhāriṇā । rūpaṃ prabhāvamahatāmapūrvaṃ dhīmatāṃ vara ॥4॥
html:
kiṃ tadutpāditaṃ pūrvaṃ hariṇā lokadhāriṇā ।
rūpaṃ prabhāvamahatāmapūrvaṃ dhīmatāṃ vara ॥4॥
slp1: kiM tadutpAditaM pUrvaM hariRA lokaDAriRA । rUpaM praBAvamahatAmapUrvaM DImatAM vara ॥4॥

text: dṛṣṭvā hi vibudhaśreṣṭhamapūrvamamitaujasam । tadaśvaśirasaṃ puṇyaṃ brahmā kimakaronmune ॥5॥
html:
dṛṣṭvā hi vibudhaśreṣṭhamapūrvamamitaujasam ।
tadaśvaśirasaṃ puṇyaṃ brahmā kimakaronmune ॥5॥
slp1: dfzwvA hi vibuDaSrezWamapUrvamamitOjasam । tadaSvaSirasaM puRyaM brahmA kimakaronmune ॥5॥

text: etannaḥ saṃśayaṃ brahmanpurāṇajñānasambhavam । kathayasvottamamate mahāpuruṣanirmitam । pāvitāḥ sma tvayā brahmanpuṇyāṃ kathayatā kathām ॥6॥
html:
etannaḥ saṃśayaṃ brahmanpurāṇajñānasambhavam ।
kathayasvottamamate mahāpuruṣanirmitam ।
pāvitāḥ sma tvayā brahmanpuṇyāṃ kathayatā kathām ॥6॥
slp1: etannaH saMSayaM brahmanpurARajYAnasamBavam । kaTayasvottamamate mahApuruzanirmitam । pAvitAH sma tvayA brahmanpuRyAM kaTayatA kaTAm ॥6॥

text: kathayiṣyāmi te sarvaṃ purāṇaṃ vedasammitam । jagau yadbhagavānvyāso rājño dharmasutasya vai ॥7॥
html:
kathayiṣyāmi te sarvaṃ purāṇaṃ vedasammitam ।
jagau yadbhagavānvyāso rājño dharmasutasya vai ॥7॥
slp1: kaTayizyAmi te sarvaM purARaM vedasammitam । jagO yadBagavAnvyAso rAjYo Darmasutasya vE ॥7॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: śrutvāśvaśiraso mūrtiṃ devasya harimedhasaḥ । utpannasaṃśayo rājā tameva samacodayat ॥8॥
html:
śrutvāśvaśiraso mūrtiṃ devasya harimedhasaḥ ।
utpannasaṃśayo rājā tameva samacodayat ॥8॥
slp1: SrutvASvaSiraso mUrtiM devasya harimeDasaH । utpannasaMSayo rAjA tameva samacodayat ॥8॥

text: yattaddarśitavānbrahmā devaṃ hayaśirodharam । kimarthaṃ tatsamabhavadvapurdevopakalpitam ॥9॥
html:
yattaddarśitavānbrahmā devaṃ hayaśirodharam ।
kimarthaṃ tatsamabhavadvapurdevopakalpitam ॥9॥
slp1: yattaddarSitavAnbrahmA devaM hayaSiroDaram । kimarTaM tatsamaBavadvapurdevopakalpitam ॥9॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: yatkiñcidiha loke vai dehabaddhaṃ viśāṃ pate । sarvaṃ pañcabhirāviṣṭaṃ bhūtairīśvarabuddhijaiḥ ॥10॥
html:
yatkiñcidiha loke vai dehabaddhaṃ viśāṃ pate ।
sarvaṃ pañcabhirāviṣṭaṃ bhūtairīśvarabuddhijaiḥ ॥10॥
slp1: yatkiYcidiha loke vE dehabadDaM viSAM pate । sarvaM paYcaBirAvizwaM BUtErISvarabudDijEH ॥10॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: īśvaro hi jagatsraṣṭā prabhurnārāyaṇo virāṭ । bhūtāntarātmā varadaḥ saguṇo nirguṇo'pi ca । bhūtapralayamavyaktaṃ śṛṇuṣva nṛpasattama ॥11॥
html:
īśvaro hi jagatsraṣṭā prabhurnārāyaṇo virāṭ ।
bhūtāntarātmā varadaḥ saguṇo nirguṇo'pi ca ।
bhūtapralayamavyaktaṃ śṛṇuṣva nṛpasattama ॥11॥
slp1: ISvaro hi jagatsrazwA praBurnArAyaRo virAw । BUtAntarAtmA varadaH saguRo nirguRo'pi ca । BUtapralayamavyaktaM SfRuzva nfpasattama ॥11॥

text: dharaṇyāmatha līnāyāmapsu caikārṇave purā । jyotirbhūte jale cāpi līne jyotiṣi cānile ॥12॥
html:
dharaṇyāmatha līnāyāmapsu caikārṇave purā ।
jyotirbhūte jale cāpi līne jyotiṣi cānile ॥12॥
slp1: DaraRyAmaTa lInAyAmapsu cEkArRave purA । jyotirBUte jale cApi lIne jyotizi cAnile ॥12॥

text: vāyau cākāśasaṃlīne ākāśe ca manonuge । vyakte manasi saṃlīne vyakte cāvyaktatāṃ gate ॥13॥
html:
vāyau cākāśasaṃlīne ākāśe ca manonuge ।
vyakte manasi saṃlīne vyakte cāvyaktatāṃ gate ॥13॥
slp1: vAyO cAkASasaMlIne AkASe ca manonuge । vyakte manasi saMlIne vyakte cAvyaktatAM gate ॥13॥

text: avyakte puruṣaṃ yāte puṃsi sarvagate'pi ca । tama evābhavatsarvaṃ na prājñāyata kiñcana ॥14॥
html:
avyakte puruṣaṃ yāte puṃsi sarvagate'pi ca ।
tama evābhavatsarvaṃ na prājñāyata kiñcana ॥14॥
slp1: avyakte puruzaM yAte puMsi sarvagate'pi ca । tama evABavatsarvaM na prAjYAyata kiYcana ॥14॥

text: tamaso brahma sambhūtaṃ tamomūlamṛtātmakam । tadviśvabhāvasañjñāntaṃ pauruṣīṃ tanumāsthitam ॥15॥
html:
tamaso brahma sambhūtaṃ tamomūlamṛtātmakam ।
tadviśvabhāvasañjñāntaṃ pauruṣīṃ tanumāsthitam ॥15॥
slp1: tamaso brahma samBUtaM tamomUlamftAtmakam । tadviSvaBAvasaYjYAntaM pOruzIM tanumAsTitam ॥15॥

text: so'niruddha iti proktastatpradhānaṃ pracakṣate । tadavyaktamiti jñeyaṃ triguṇaṃ nṛpasattama ॥16॥
html:
so'niruddha iti proktastatpradhānaṃ pracakṣate ।
tadavyaktamiti jñeyaṃ triguṇaṃ nṛpasattama ॥16॥
slp1: so'nirudDa iti proktastatpraDAnaM pracakzate । tadavyaktamiti jYeyaM triguRaM nfpasattama ॥16॥

text: vidyāsahāyavāndevo viṣvakseno hariḥ prabhuḥ । apsveva śayanaṃ cakre nidrāyogamupāgataḥ । jagataścintayansṛṣṭiṃ citrāṃ bahuguṇodbhavām ॥17॥
html:
vidyāsahāyavāndevo viṣvakseno hariḥ prabhuḥ ।
apsveva śayanaṃ cakre nidrāyogamupāgataḥ ।
jagataścintayansṛṣṭiṃ citrāṃ bahuguṇodbhavām ॥17॥
slp1: vidyAsahAyavAndevo vizvakseno hariH praBuH । apsveva SayanaM cakre nidrAyogamupAgataH । jagataScintayansfzwiM citrAM bahuguRodBavAm ॥17॥

text: tasya cintayataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ mahānātmaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ । ahaṅkārastato jāto brahmā śubhacaturmukhaḥ । hiraṇyagarbho bhagavānsarvalokapitāmahaḥ ॥18॥
html:
tasya cintayataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ mahānātmaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
ahaṅkārastato jāto brahmā śubhacaturmukhaḥ ।
hiraṇyagarbho bhagavānsarvalokapitāmahaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: tasya cintayataH sfzwiM mahAnAtmaguRaH smftaH । ahaNkArastato jAto brahmA SuBacaturmuKaH । hiraRyagarBo BagavAnsarvalokapitAmahaH ॥18॥

text: padme'niruddhātsambhūtastadā padmanibhekṣaṇaḥ । sahasrapatre dyutimānupaviṣṭaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥19॥
html:
padme'niruddhātsambhūtastadā padmanibhekṣaṇaḥ ।
sahasrapatre dyutimānupaviṣṭaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: padme'nirudDAtsamBUtastadA padmaniBekzaRaH । sahasrapatre dyutimAnupavizwaH sanAtanaH ॥19॥

text: dadṛśe'dbhutasaṅkāśe lokānāpomayānprabhuḥ । sattvasthaḥ parameṣṭhī sa tato bhūtagaṇānsṛjat ॥20॥
html:
dadṛśe'dbhutasaṅkāśe lokānāpomayānprabhuḥ ।
sattvasthaḥ parameṣṭhī sa tato bhūtagaṇānsṛjat ॥20॥
slp1: dadfSe'dButasaNkASe lokAnApomayAnpraBuH । sattvasTaH paramezWI sa tato BUtagaRAnsfjat ॥20॥

text: pūrvameva ca padmasya patre sūryāṃśusaprabhe । nārāyaṇakṛtau bindū apāmāstāṃ guṇottarau ॥21॥
html:
pūrvameva ca padmasya patre sūryāṃśusaprabhe ।
nārāyaṇakṛtau bindū apāmāstāṃ guṇottarau ॥21॥
slp1: pUrvameva ca padmasya patre sUryAMSusapraBe । nArAyaRakftO bindU apAmAstAM guRottarO ॥21॥

text: tāvapaśyatsa bhagavānanādinidhano'cyutaḥ । ekastatrābhavadbindurmadhvābho ruciraprabhaḥ ॥22॥
html:
tāvapaśyatsa bhagavānanādinidhano'cyutaḥ ।
ekastatrābhavadbindurmadhvābho ruciraprabhaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: tAvapaSyatsa BagavAnanAdiniDano'cyutaH । ekastatrABavadbindurmaDvABo rucirapraBaH ॥22॥

text: sa tāmaso madhurjātastadā nārāyaṇājñayā । kaṭhinastvaparo binduḥ kaiṭabho rājasastu saḥ ॥23॥
html:
sa tāmaso madhurjātastadā nārāyaṇājñayā ।
kaṭhinastvaparo binduḥ kaiṭabho rājasastu saḥ ॥23॥
slp1: sa tAmaso maDurjAtastadA nArAyaRAjYayA । kaWinastvaparo binduH kEwaBo rAjasastu saH ॥23॥

text: tāvabhyadhāvatāṃ śreṣṭhau tamorajaguṇānvitau । balavantau gadāhastau padmanālānusāriṇau ॥24॥
html:
tāvabhyadhāvatāṃ śreṣṭhau tamorajaguṇānvitau ।
balavantau gadāhastau padmanālānusāriṇau ॥24॥
slp1: tAvaByaDAvatAM SrezWO tamorajaguRAnvitO । balavantO gadAhastO padmanAlAnusAriRO ॥24॥

text: dadṛśāte'ravindasthaṃ brahmāṇamamitaprabham । sṛjantaṃ prathamaṃ vedāṃścaturaścāruvigrahān ॥25॥
html:
dadṛśāte'ravindasthaṃ brahmāṇamamitaprabham ।
sṛjantaṃ prathamaṃ vedāṃścaturaścāruvigrahān ॥25॥
slp1: dadfSAte'ravindasTaM brahmARamamitapraBam । sfjantaM praTamaM vedAMScaturaScAruvigrahAn ॥25॥

text: tato vigrahavantau tau vedāndṛṣṭvāsurottamau । sahasā jagṛhaturvedānbrahmaṇaḥ paśyatastadā ॥26॥
html:
tato vigrahavantau tau vedāndṛṣṭvāsurottamau ।
sahasā jagṛhaturvedānbrahmaṇaḥ paśyatastadā ॥26॥
slp1: tato vigrahavantO tO vedAndfzwvAsurottamO । sahasA jagfhaturvedAnbrahmaRaH paSyatastadA ॥26॥

text: atha tau dānavaśreṣṭhau vedāngṛhya sanātanān । rasāṃ viviśatustūrṇamudakpūrve mahodadhau ॥27॥
html:
atha tau dānavaśreṣṭhau vedāngṛhya sanātanān ।
rasāṃ viviśatustūrṇamudakpūrve mahodadhau ॥27॥
slp1: aTa tO dAnavaSrezWO vedAngfhya sanAtanAn । rasAM viviSatustUrRamudakpUrve mahodaDO ॥27॥

text: tato hṛteṣu vedeṣu brahmā kaśmalamāviśat । tato vacanamīśānaṃ prāha vedairvinākṛtaḥ ॥28॥
html:
tato hṛteṣu vedeṣu brahmā kaśmalamāviśat ।
tato vacanamīśānaṃ prāha vedairvinākṛtaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: tato hftezu vedezu brahmA kaSmalamAviSat । tato vacanamISAnaM prAha vedErvinAkftaH ॥28॥

text: vedā me paramaṃ cakṣurvedā me paramaṃ balam । vedā me paramaṃ dhāma vedā me brahma cottamam ॥29॥
html:
vedā me paramaṃ cakṣurvedā me paramaṃ balam ।
vedā me paramaṃ dhāma vedā me brahma cottamam ॥29॥
slp1: vedA me paramaM cakzurvedA me paramaM balam । vedA me paramaM DAma vedA me brahma cottamam ॥29॥

text: mama vedā hṛtāḥ sarve dānavābhyāṃ balāditaḥ । andhakārā hi me lokā jātā vedairvinākṛtāḥ । vedānṛte hi kiṃ kuryāṃ lokānvai sraṣṭumudyataḥ ॥30॥
html:
mama vedā hṛtāḥ sarve dānavābhyāṃ balāditaḥ ।
andhakārā hi me lokā jātā vedairvinākṛtāḥ ।
vedānṛte hi kiṃ kuryāṃ lokānvai sraṣṭumudyataḥ ॥30॥
slp1: mama vedA hftAH sarve dAnavAByAM balAditaH । anDakArA hi me lokA jAtA vedErvinAkftAH । vedAnfte hi kiM kuryAM lokAnvE srazwumudyataH ॥30॥

text: aho bata mahadduḥkhaṃ vedanāśanajaṃ mama । prāptaṃ dunoti hṛdayaṃ tīvraśokāya randhayan ॥31॥
html:
aho bata mahadduḥkhaṃ vedanāśanajaṃ mama ।
prāptaṃ dunoti hṛdayaṃ tīvraśokāya randhayan ॥31॥
slp1: aho bata mahadduHKaM vedanASanajaM mama । prAptaM dunoti hfdayaM tIvraSokAya ranDayan ॥31॥

text: ko hi śokārṇave magnaṃ māmito'dya samuddharet । vedāṃstānānayennaṣṭānkasya cāhaṃ priyo bhave ॥32॥
html:
ko hi śokārṇave magnaṃ māmito'dya samuddharet ।
vedāṃstānānayennaṣṭānkasya cāhaṃ priyo bhave ॥32॥
slp1: ko hi SokArRave magnaM mAmito'dya samudDaret । vedAMstAnAnayennazwAnkasya cAhaM priyo Bave ॥32॥

text: ityevaṃ bhāṣamāṇasya brahmaṇo nṛpasattama । hareḥ stotrārthamudbhūtā buddhirbuddhimatāṃ vara । tato jagau paraṃ japyaṃ sāñjalipragrahaḥ prabhuḥ ॥33॥
html:
ityevaṃ bhāṣamāṇasya brahmaṇo nṛpasattama ।
hareḥ stotrārthamudbhūtā buddhirbuddhimatāṃ vara ।
tato jagau paraṃ japyaṃ sāñjalipragrahaḥ prabhuḥ ॥33॥
slp1: ityevaM BAzamARasya brahmaRo nfpasattama । hareH stotrArTamudBUtA budDirbudDimatAM vara । tato jagO paraM japyaM sAYjalipragrahaH praBuH ॥33॥

text: namaste brahmahṛdaya namaste mama pūrvaja । lokādya bhuvanaśreṣṭha sāṅkhyayoganidhe vibho ॥34॥
html:
namaste brahmahṛdaya namaste mama pūrvaja ।
lokādya bhuvanaśreṣṭha sāṅkhyayoganidhe vibho ॥34॥
slp1: namaste brahmahfdaya namaste mama pUrvaja । lokAdya BuvanaSrezWa sANKyayoganiDe viBo ॥34॥

text: vyaktāvyaktakarācintya kṣemaṃ panthānamāsthita । viśvabhuksarvabhūtānāmantarātmannayonija ॥35॥
html:
vyaktāvyaktakarācintya kṣemaṃ panthānamāsthita ।
viśvabhuksarvabhūtānāmantarātmannayonija ॥35॥
slp1: vyaktAvyaktakarAcintya kzemaM panTAnamAsTita । viSvaBuksarvaBUtAnAmantarAtmannayonija ॥35॥

text: ahaṃ prasādajastubhyaṃ lokadhāmne svayambhuve । tvatto me mānasaṃ janma prathamaṃ dvijapūjitam ॥36॥
html:
ahaṃ prasādajastubhyaṃ lokadhāmne svayambhuve ।
tvatto me mānasaṃ janma prathamaṃ dvijapūjitam ॥36॥
slp1: ahaM prasAdajastuByaM lokaDAmne svayamBuve । tvatto me mAnasaM janma praTamaM dvijapUjitam ॥36॥

text: cākṣuṣaṃ vai dvitīyaṃ me janma cāsītpurātanam । tvatprasādācca me janma tṛtīyaṃ vācikaṃ mahat ॥37॥
html:
cākṣuṣaṃ vai dvitīyaṃ me janma cāsītpurātanam ।
tvatprasādācca me janma tṛtīyaṃ vācikaṃ mahat ॥37॥
slp1: cAkzuzaM vE dvitIyaM me janma cAsItpurAtanam । tvatprasAdAcca me janma tftIyaM vAcikaM mahat ॥37॥

text: tvattaḥ śravaṇajaṃ cāpi caturthaṃ janma me vibho । nāsikyaṃ cāpi me janma tvattaḥ pañcamamucyate ॥38॥
html:
tvattaḥ śravaṇajaṃ cāpi caturthaṃ janma me vibho ।
nāsikyaṃ cāpi me janma tvattaḥ pañcamamucyate ॥38॥
slp1: tvattaH SravaRajaM cApi caturTaM janma me viBo । nAsikyaM cApi me janma tvattaH paYcamamucyate ॥38॥

text: aṇḍajaṃ cāpi me janma tvattaḥ ṣaṣṭhaṃ vinirmitam । idaṃ ca saptamaṃ janma padmajaṃ me'mitaprabha ॥39॥
html:
aṇḍajaṃ cāpi me janma tvattaḥ ṣaṣṭhaṃ vinirmitam ।
idaṃ ca saptamaṃ janma padmajaṃ me'mitaprabha ॥39॥
slp1: aRqajaM cApi me janma tvattaH zazWaM vinirmitam । idaM ca saptamaM janma padmajaM me'mitapraBa ॥39॥

text: sarge sarge hyahaṃ putrastava triguṇavarjitaḥ । prathitaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣa pradhānaguṇakalpitaḥ ॥40॥
html:
sarge sarge hyahaṃ putrastava triguṇavarjitaḥ ।
prathitaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣa pradhānaguṇakalpitaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: sarge sarge hyahaM putrastava triguRavarjitaH । praTitaH puRqarIkAkza praDAnaguRakalpitaH ॥40॥

text: tvamīśvarasvabhāvaśca svayambhūḥ puruṣottamaḥ । tvayā vinirmito'haṃ vai vedacakṣurvayotigaḥ ॥41॥
html:
tvamīśvarasvabhāvaśca svayambhūḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
tvayā vinirmito'haṃ vai vedacakṣurvayotigaḥ ॥41॥
slp1: tvamISvarasvaBAvaSca svayamBUH puruzottamaH । tvayA vinirmito'haM vE vedacakzurvayotigaH ॥41॥

text: te me vedā hṛtāścakṣurandho jāto'smi jāgṛhi । dadasva cakṣuṣī mahyaṃ priyo'haṃ te priyo'si me ॥42॥
html:
te me vedā hṛtāścakṣurandho jāto'smi jāgṛhi ।
dadasva cakṣuṣī mahyaṃ priyo'haṃ te priyo'si me ॥42॥
slp1: te me vedA hftAScakzuranDo jAto'smi jAgfhi । dadasva cakzuzI mahyaM priyo'haM te priyo'si me ॥42॥

text: evaṃ stutaḥ sa bhagavānpuruṣaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ । jahau nidrāmatha tadā vedakāryārthamudyataḥ । aiśvareṇa prayogeṇa dvitīyāṃ tanumāsthitaḥ ॥43॥
html:
evaṃ stutaḥ sa bhagavānpuruṣaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ ।
jahau nidrāmatha tadā vedakāryārthamudyataḥ ।
aiśvareṇa prayogeṇa dvitīyāṃ tanumāsthitaḥ ॥43॥
slp1: evaM stutaH sa BagavAnpuruzaH sarvatomuKaH । jahO nidrAmaTa tadA vedakAryArTamudyataH । ESvareRa prayogeRa dvitIyAM tanumAsTitaH ॥43॥

text: sunāsikena kāyena bhūtvā candraprabhastadā । kṛtvā hayaśiraḥ śubhraṃ vedānāmālayaṃ prabhuḥ ॥44॥
html:
sunāsikena kāyena bhūtvā candraprabhastadā ।
kṛtvā hayaśiraḥ śubhraṃ vedānāmālayaṃ prabhuḥ ॥44॥
slp1: sunAsikena kAyena BUtvA candrapraBastadA । kftvA hayaSiraH SuBraM vedAnAmAlayaM praBuH ॥44॥

text: tasya mūrdhā samabhavaddyauḥ sanakṣatratārakā । keśāścāsyābhavandīrghā raveraṃśusamaprabhāḥ ॥45॥
html:
tasya mūrdhā samabhavaddyauḥ sanakṣatratārakā ।
keśāścāsyābhavandīrghā raveraṃśusamaprabhāḥ ॥45॥
slp1: tasya mUrDA samaBavaddyOH sanakzatratArakA । keSAScAsyABavandIrGA raveraMSusamapraBAH ॥45॥

text: karṇāvākāśapātāle lalāṭaṃ bhūtadhāriṇī । gaṅgā sarasvatī puṇyā bhruvāvāstāṃ mahānadī ॥46॥
html:
karṇāvākāśapātāle lalāṭaṃ bhūtadhāriṇī ।
gaṅgā sarasvatī puṇyā bhruvāvāstāṃ mahānadī ॥46॥
slp1: karRAvAkASapAtAle lalAwaM BUtaDAriRI । gaNgA sarasvatI puRyA BruvAvAstAM mahAnadI ॥46॥

text: cakṣuṣī somasūryau te nāsā sandhyā punaḥ smṛtā । oṅkārastvatha saṃskāro vidyujjihvā ca nirmitā ॥47॥
html:
cakṣuṣī somasūryau te nāsā sandhyā punaḥ smṛtā ।
oṅkārastvatha saṃskāro vidyujjihvā ca nirmitā ॥47॥
slp1: cakzuzI somasUryO te nAsA sanDyA punaH smftA । oNkArastvaTa saMskAro vidyujjihvA ca nirmitA ॥47॥

text: dantāśca pitaro rājansomapā iti viśrutāḥ । goloko brahmalokaśca oṣṭhāvāstāṃ mahātmanaḥ । grīvā cāsyābhavadrājankālarātrirguṇottarā ॥48॥
html:
dantāśca pitaro rājansomapā iti viśrutāḥ ।
goloko brahmalokaśca oṣṭhāvāstāṃ mahātmanaḥ ।
grīvā cāsyābhavadrājankālarātrirguṇottarā ॥48॥
slp1: dantASca pitaro rAjansomapA iti viSrutAH । goloko brahmalokaSca ozWAvAstAM mahAtmanaH । grIvA cAsyABavadrAjankAlarAtrirguRottarA ॥48॥

text: etaddhayaśiraḥ kṛtvā nānāmūrtibhirāvṛtam । antardadhe sa viśveśo viveśa ca rasāṃ prabhuḥ ॥49॥
html:
etaddhayaśiraḥ kṛtvā nānāmūrtibhirāvṛtam ।
antardadhe sa viśveśo viveśa ca rasāṃ prabhuḥ ॥49॥
slp1: etadDayaSiraH kftvA nAnAmUrtiBirAvftam । antardaDe sa viSveSo viveSa ca rasAM praBuH ॥49॥

text: rasāṃ punaḥ praviṣṭaśca yogaṃ paramamāsthitaḥ । śaikṣaṃ svaraṃ samāsthāya omiti prāsṛjatsvaram ॥50॥
html:
rasāṃ punaḥ praviṣṭaśca yogaṃ paramamāsthitaḥ ।
śaikṣaṃ svaraṃ samāsthāya omiti prāsṛjatsvaram ॥50॥
slp1: rasAM punaH pravizwaSca yogaM paramamAsTitaH । SEkzaM svaraM samAsTAya omiti prAsfjatsvaram ॥50॥

text: sa svaraḥ sānunādī ca sarvagaḥ snigdha eva ca । babhūvāntarmahībhūtaḥ sarvabhūtaguṇoditaḥ ॥51॥
html:
sa svaraḥ sānunādī ca sarvagaḥ snigdha eva ca ।
babhūvāntarmahībhūtaḥ sarvabhūtaguṇoditaḥ ॥51॥
slp1: sa svaraH sAnunAdI ca sarvagaH snigDa eva ca । baBUvAntarmahIBUtaH sarvaBUtaguRoditaH ॥51॥

text: tatastāvasurau kṛtvā vedānsamayabandhanān । rasātale vinikṣipya yataḥ śabdastato drutau ॥52॥
html:
tatastāvasurau kṛtvā vedānsamayabandhanān ।
rasātale vinikṣipya yataḥ śabdastato drutau ॥52॥
slp1: tatastAvasurO kftvA vedAnsamayabanDanAn । rasAtale vinikzipya yataH Sabdastato drutO ॥52॥

text: etasminnantare rājandevo hayaśirodharaḥ । jagrāha vedānakhilānrasātalagatānhariḥ । prādācca brahmaṇe bhūyastataḥ svāṃ prakṛtiṃ gataḥ ॥53॥
html:
etasminnantare rājandevo hayaśirodharaḥ ।
jagrāha vedānakhilānrasātalagatānhariḥ ।
prādācca brahmaṇe bhūyastataḥ svāṃ prakṛtiṃ gataḥ ॥53॥
slp1: etasminnantare rAjandevo hayaSiroDaraH । jagrAha vedAnaKilAnrasAtalagatAnhariH । prAdAcca brahmaRe BUyastataH svAM prakftiM gataH ॥53॥

text: sthāpayitvā hayaśira udakpūrve mahodadhau । vedānāmālayaścāpi babhūvāśvaśirāstataḥ ॥54॥
html:
sthāpayitvā hayaśira udakpūrve mahodadhau ।
vedānāmālayaścāpi babhūvāśvaśirāstataḥ ॥54॥
slp1: sTApayitvA hayaSira udakpUrve mahodaDO । vedAnAmAlayaScApi baBUvASvaSirAstataH ॥54॥

text: atha kiñcidapaśyantau dānavau madhukaiṭabhau । punarājagmatustatra vegitau paśyatāṃ ca tau । yatra vedā vinikṣiptāstatsthānaṃ śūnyameva ca ॥55॥
html:
atha kiñcidapaśyantau dānavau madhukaiṭabhau ।
punarājagmatustatra vegitau paśyatāṃ ca tau ।
yatra vedā vinikṣiptāstatsthānaṃ śūnyameva ca ॥55॥
slp1: aTa kiYcidapaSyantO dAnavO maDukEwaBO । punarAjagmatustatra vegitO paSyatAM ca tO । yatra vedA vinikziptAstatsTAnaM SUnyameva ca ॥55॥

text: tata uttamamāsthāya vegaṃ balavatāṃ varau । punaruttasthatuḥ śīghraṃ rasānāmālayāttadā । dadṛśāte ca puruṣaṃ tamevādikaraṃ prabhum ॥56॥
html:
tata uttamamāsthāya vegaṃ balavatāṃ varau ।
punaruttasthatuḥ śīghraṃ rasānāmālayāttadā ।
dadṛśāte ca puruṣaṃ tamevādikaraṃ prabhum ॥56॥
slp1: tata uttamamAsTAya vegaM balavatAM varO । punaruttasTatuH SIGraM rasAnAmAlayAttadA । dadfSAte ca puruzaM tamevAdikaraM praBum ॥56॥

text: śvetaṃ candraviśuddhābhamaniruddhatanau sthitam । bhūyo'pyamitavikrāntaṃ nidrāyogamupāgatam ॥57॥
html:
śvetaṃ candraviśuddhābhamaniruddhatanau sthitam ।
bhūyo'pyamitavikrāntaṃ nidrāyogamupāgatam ॥57॥
slp1: SvetaM candraviSudDABamanirudDatanO sTitam । BUyo'pyamitavikrAntaM nidrAyogamupAgatam ॥57॥

text: ātmapramāṇaracite apāmupari kalpite । śayane nāgabhogāḍhye jvālāmālāsamāvṛte ॥58॥
html:
ātmapramāṇaracite apāmupari kalpite ।
śayane nāgabhogāḍhye jvālāmālāsamāvṛte ॥58॥
slp1: AtmapramARaracite apAmupari kalpite । Sayane nAgaBogAQye jvAlAmAlAsamAvfte ॥58॥

text: niṣkalmaṣeṇa sattvena sampannaṃ ruciraprabham । taṃ dṛṣṭvā dānavendrau tau mahāhāsamamuñcatām ॥59॥
html:
niṣkalmaṣeṇa sattvena sampannaṃ ruciraprabham ।
taṃ dṛṣṭvā dānavendrau tau mahāhāsamamuñcatām ॥59॥
slp1: nizkalmazeRa sattvena sampannaM rucirapraBam । taM dfzwvA dAnavendrO tO mahAhAsamamuYcatAm ॥59॥

text: ūcatuśca samāviṣṭau rajasā tamasā ca tau । ayaṃ sa puruṣaḥ śvetaḥ śete nidrāmupāgataḥ ॥60॥
html:
ūcatuśca samāviṣṭau rajasā tamasā ca tau ।
ayaṃ sa puruṣaḥ śvetaḥ śete nidrāmupāgataḥ ॥60॥
slp1: UcatuSca samAvizwO rajasA tamasA ca tO । ayaM sa puruzaH SvetaH Sete nidrAmupAgataH ॥60॥

text: anena nūnaṃ vedānāṃ kṛtamāharaṇaṃ rasāt । kasyaiṣa ko nu khalveṣa kiṃ ca svapiti bhogavān ॥61॥
html:
anena nūnaṃ vedānāṃ kṛtamāharaṇaṃ rasāt ।
kasyaiṣa ko nu khalveṣa kiṃ ca svapiti bhogavān ॥61॥
slp1: anena nUnaM vedAnAM kftamAharaRaM rasAt । kasyEza ko nu Kalveza kiM ca svapiti BogavAn ॥61॥

text: ityuccāritavākyau tau bodhayāmāsaturharim । yuddhārthinau tu vijñāya vibuddhaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥62॥
html:
ityuccāritavākyau tau bodhayāmāsaturharim ।
yuddhārthinau tu vijñāya vibuddhaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥62॥
slp1: ityuccAritavAkyO tO boDayAmAsaturharim । yudDArTinO tu vijYAya vibudDaH puruzottamaH ॥62॥

text: nirīkṣya cāsurendrau tau tato yuddhe mano dadhe । atha yuddhaṃ samabhavattayornārāyaṇasya ca ॥63॥
html:
nirīkṣya cāsurendrau tau tato yuddhe mano dadhe ।
atha yuddhaṃ samabhavattayornārāyaṇasya ca ॥63॥
slp1: nirIkzya cAsurendrO tO tato yudDe mano daDe । aTa yudDaM samaBavattayornArAyaRasya ca ॥63॥

text: rajastamoviṣṭatanū tāvubhau madhukaiṭabhau । brahmaṇopacitiṃ kurvañjaghāna madhusūdanaḥ ॥64॥
html:
rajastamoviṣṭatanū tāvubhau madhukaiṭabhau ।
brahmaṇopacitiṃ kurvañjaghāna madhusūdanaḥ ॥64॥
slp1: rajastamovizwatanU tAvuBO maDukEwaBO । brahmaRopacitiM kurvaYjaGAna maDusUdanaH ॥64॥

text: tatastayorvadhenāśu vedāpaharaṇena ca । śokāpanayanaṃ cakre brahmaṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥65॥
html:
tatastayorvadhenāśu vedāpaharaṇena ca ।
śokāpanayanaṃ cakre brahmaṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥65॥
slp1: tatastayorvaDenASu vedApaharaRena ca । SokApanayanaM cakre brahmaRaH puruzottamaH ॥65॥

text: tataḥ parivṛto brahmā hatārirvedasatkṛtaḥ । nirmame sa tadā lokānkṛtsnānsthāvarajaṅgamān ॥66॥
html:
tataḥ parivṛto brahmā hatārirvedasatkṛtaḥ ।
nirmame sa tadā lokānkṛtsnānsthāvarajaṅgamān ॥66॥
slp1: tataH parivfto brahmA hatArirvedasatkftaH । nirmame sa tadA lokAnkftsnAnsTAvarajaNgamAn ॥66॥

text: dattvā pitāmahāyāgryāṃ buddhiṃ lokavisargikīm । tatraivāntardadhe devo yata evāgato hariḥ ॥67॥
html:
dattvā pitāmahāyāgryāṃ buddhiṃ lokavisargikīm ।
tatraivāntardadhe devo yata evāgato hariḥ ॥67॥
slp1: dattvA pitAmahAyAgryAM budDiM lokavisargikIm । tatrEvAntardaDe devo yata evAgato hariH ॥67॥

text: tau dānavau harirhatvā kṛtvā hayaśirastanum । punaḥ pravṛttidharmārthaṃ tāmeva vidadhe tanum ॥68॥
html:
tau dānavau harirhatvā kṛtvā hayaśirastanum ।
punaḥ pravṛttidharmārthaṃ tāmeva vidadhe tanum ॥68॥
slp1: tO dAnavO harirhatvA kftvA hayaSirastanum । punaH pravfttiDarmArTaM tAmeva vidaDe tanum ॥68॥

text: evameṣa mahābhāgo babhūvāśvaśirā hariḥ । paurāṇametadākhyātaṃ rūpaṃ varadamaiśvaram ॥69॥
html:
evameṣa mahābhāgo babhūvāśvaśirā hariḥ ।
paurāṇametadākhyātaṃ rūpaṃ varadamaiśvaram ॥69॥
slp1: evameza mahABAgo baBUvASvaSirA hariH । pOrARametadAKyAtaM rUpaM varadamESvaram ॥69॥

text: yo hyetadbrāhmaṇo nityaṃ śṛṇuyāddhārayeta vā । na tasyādhyayanaṃ nāśamupagacchetkadācana ॥70॥
html:
yo hyetadbrāhmaṇo nityaṃ śṛṇuyāddhārayeta vā ।
na tasyādhyayanaṃ nāśamupagacchetkadācana ॥70॥
slp1: yo hyetadbrAhmaRo nityaM SfRuyAdDArayeta vA । na tasyADyayanaM nASamupagacCetkadAcana ॥70॥

text: ārādhya tapasogreṇa devaṃ hayaśirodharam । pāñcālena kramaḥ prāpto rāmeṇa pathi deśite ॥71॥
html:
ārādhya tapasogreṇa devaṃ hayaśirodharam ।
pāñcālena kramaḥ prāpto rāmeṇa pathi deśite ॥71॥
slp1: ArADya tapasogreRa devaM hayaSiroDaram । pAYcAlena kramaH prApto rAmeRa paTi deSite ॥71॥

text: etaddhayaśiro rājannākhyānaṃ tava kīrtitam । purāṇaṃ vedasamitaṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ॥72॥
html:
etaddhayaśiro rājannākhyānaṃ tava kīrtitam ।
purāṇaṃ vedasamitaṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ॥72॥
slp1: etadDayaSiro rAjannAKyAnaM tava kIrtitam । purARaM vedasamitaM yanmAM tvaM paripfcCasi ॥72॥

text: yāṃ yāmicchettanuṃ devaḥ kartuṃ kāryavidhau kvacit । tāṃ tāṃ kuryādvikurvāṇaḥ svayamātmānamātmanā ॥73॥
html:
yāṃ yāmicchettanuṃ devaḥ kartuṃ kāryavidhau kvacit ।
tāṃ tāṃ kuryādvikurvāṇaḥ svayamātmānamātmanā ॥73॥
slp1: yAM yAmicCettanuM devaH kartuM kAryaviDO kvacit । tAM tAM kuryAdvikurvARaH svayamAtmAnamAtmanA ॥73॥

text: eṣa vedanidhiḥ śrīmāneṣa vai tapaso nidhiḥ । eṣa yogaśca sāṅkhyaṃ ca brahma cāgryaṃ harirvibhuḥ ॥74॥
html:
eṣa vedanidhiḥ śrīmāneṣa vai tapaso nidhiḥ ।
eṣa yogaśca sāṅkhyaṃ ca brahma cāgryaṃ harirvibhuḥ ॥74॥
slp1: eza vedaniDiH SrImAneza vE tapaso niDiH । eza yogaSca sANKyaM ca brahma cAgryaM harirviBuH ॥74॥

text: nārāyaṇaparā vedā yajñā nārāyaṇātmakāḥ । tapo nārāyaṇaparaṃ nārāyaṇaparā gatiḥ ॥75॥
html:
nārāyaṇaparā vedā yajñā nārāyaṇātmakāḥ ।
tapo nārāyaṇaparaṃ nārāyaṇaparā gatiḥ ॥75॥
slp1: nArAyaRaparA vedA yajYA nArAyaRAtmakAH । tapo nArAyaRaparaM nArAyaRaparA gatiH ॥75॥

text: nārāyaṇaparaṃ satyamṛtaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam । nārāyaṇaparo dharmaḥ punarāvṛttidurlabhaḥ ॥76॥
html:
nārāyaṇaparaṃ satyamṛtaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam ।
nārāyaṇaparo dharmaḥ punarāvṛttidurlabhaḥ ॥76॥
slp1: nArAyaRaparaM satyamftaM nArAyaRAtmakam । nArAyaRaparo DarmaH punarAvfttidurlaBaH ॥76॥

text: pravṛttilakṣaṇaścaiva dharmo nārāyaṇātmakaḥ । nārāyaṇātmako gandho bhūmau śreṣṭhatamaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥77॥
html:
pravṛttilakṣaṇaścaiva dharmo nārāyaṇātmakaḥ ।
nārāyaṇātmako gandho bhūmau śreṣṭhatamaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥77॥
slp1: pravfttilakzaRaScEva Darmo nArAyaRAtmakaH । nArAyaRAtmako ganDo BUmO SrezWatamaH smftaH ॥77॥

text: apāṃ caiva guṇo rājanraso nārāyaṇātmakaḥ । jyotiṣāṃ ca guṇo rūpaṃ smṛtaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam ॥78॥
html:
apāṃ caiva guṇo rājanraso nārāyaṇātmakaḥ ।
jyotiṣāṃ ca guṇo rūpaṃ smṛtaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam ॥78॥
slp1: apAM cEva guRo rAjanraso nArAyaRAtmakaH । jyotizAM ca guRo rUpaM smftaM nArAyaRAtmakam ॥78॥

text: nārāyaṇātmakaścāpi sparśo vāyuguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ । nārāyaṇātmakaścāpi śabda ākāśasambhavaḥ ॥79॥
html:
nārāyaṇātmakaścāpi sparśo vāyuguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
nārāyaṇātmakaścāpi śabda ākāśasambhavaḥ ॥79॥
slp1: nArAyaRAtmakaScApi sparSo vAyuguRaH smftaH । nArAyaRAtmakaScApi Sabda AkASasamBavaH ॥79॥

text: manaścāpi tato bhūtamavyaktaguṇalakṣaṇam । nārāyaṇaparaḥ kālo jyotiṣāmayanaṃ ca yat ॥80॥
html:
manaścāpi tato bhūtamavyaktaguṇalakṣaṇam ।
nārāyaṇaparaḥ kālo jyotiṣāmayanaṃ ca yat ॥80॥
slp1: manaScApi tato BUtamavyaktaguRalakzaRam । nArAyaRaparaH kAlo jyotizAmayanaM ca yat ॥80॥

text: nārāyaṇaparā kīrtiḥ śrīśca lakṣmīśca devatāḥ । nārāyaṇaparaṃ sāṅkhyaṃ yogo nārāyaṇātmakaḥ ॥81॥
html:
nārāyaṇaparā kīrtiḥ śrīśca lakṣmīśca devatāḥ ।
nārāyaṇaparaṃ sāṅkhyaṃ yogo nārāyaṇātmakaḥ ॥81॥
slp1: nArAyaRaparA kIrtiH SrISca lakzmISca devatAH । nArAyaRaparaM sANKyaM yogo nArAyaRAtmakaH ॥81॥

text: kāraṇaṃ puruṣo yeṣāṃ pradhānaṃ cāpi kāraṇam । svabhāvaścaiva karmāṇi daivaṃ yeṣāṃ ca kāraṇam ॥82॥
html:
kāraṇaṃ puruṣo yeṣāṃ pradhānaṃ cāpi kāraṇam ।
svabhāvaścaiva karmāṇi daivaṃ yeṣāṃ ca kāraṇam ॥82॥
slp1: kAraRaM puruzo yezAM praDAnaM cApi kAraRam । svaBAvaScEva karmARi dEvaM yezAM ca kAraRam ॥82॥

text: pañcakāraṇasaṅkhyāto niṣṭhā sarvatra vai hariḥ । tattvaṃ jijñāsamānānāṃ hetubhiḥ sarvatomukhaiḥ ॥83॥
html:
pañcakāraṇasaṅkhyāto niṣṭhā sarvatra vai hariḥ ।
tattvaṃ jijñāsamānānāṃ hetubhiḥ sarvatomukhaiḥ ॥83॥
slp1: paYcakAraRasaNKyAto nizWA sarvatra vE hariH । tattvaM jijYAsamAnAnAM hetuBiH sarvatomuKEH ॥83॥

text: tattvameko mahāyogī harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ । sabrahmakānāṃ lokānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca mahātmanām ॥84॥
html:
tattvameko mahāyogī harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
sabrahmakānāṃ lokānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca mahātmanām ॥84॥
slp1: tattvameko mahAyogI harirnArAyaRaH praBuH । sabrahmakAnAM lokAnAmfzIRAM ca mahAtmanAm ॥84॥

text: sāṅkhyānāṃ yogināṃ cāpi yatīnāmātmavedinām । manīṣitaṃ vijānāti keśavo na tu tasya te ॥85॥
html:
sāṅkhyānāṃ yogināṃ cāpi yatīnāmātmavedinām ।
manīṣitaṃ vijānāti keśavo na tu tasya te ॥85॥
slp1: sANKyAnAM yoginAM cApi yatInAmAtmavedinAm । manIzitaM vijAnAti keSavo na tu tasya te ॥85॥

text: ye kecitsarvalokeṣu daivaṃ pitryaṃ ca kurvate । dānāni ca prayacchanti tapyanti ca tapo mahat ॥86॥
html:
ye kecitsarvalokeṣu daivaṃ pitryaṃ ca kurvate ।
dānāni ca prayacchanti tapyanti ca tapo mahat ॥86॥
slp1: ye kecitsarvalokezu dEvaM pitryaM ca kurvate । dAnAni ca prayacCanti tapyanti ca tapo mahat ॥86॥

text: sarveṣāmāśrayo viṣṇuraiśvaraṃ vidhimāsthitaḥ । sarvabhūtakṛtāvāso vāsudeveti cocyate ॥87॥
html:
sarveṣāmāśrayo viṣṇuraiśvaraṃ vidhimāsthitaḥ ।
sarvabhūtakṛtāvāso vāsudeveti cocyate ॥87॥
slp1: sarvezAmASrayo vizRurESvaraM viDimAsTitaH । sarvaBUtakftAvAso vAsudeveti cocyate ॥87॥

text: ayaṃ hi nityaḥ paramo maharṣirmahāvibhūtirguṇavānnirguṇākhyaḥ । guṇaiśca saṃyogamupaiti śīghraṃ kālo yathartāvṛtusamprayuktaḥ ॥88॥
html:
ayaṃ hi nityaḥ paramo maharṣirmahāvibhūtirguṇavānnirguṇākhyaḥ ।
guṇaiśca saṃyogamupaiti śīghraṃ kālo yathartāvṛtusamprayuktaḥ ॥88॥
slp1: ayaM hi nityaH paramo maharzirmahAviBUtirguRavAnnirguRAKyaH । guRESca saMyogamupEti SIGraM kAlo yaTartAvftusamprayuktaH ॥88॥

text: naivāsya vindanti gatiṃ mahātmano na cāgatiṃ kaścidihānupaśyati । jñānātmakāḥ saṃyamino maharṣayaḥ paśyanti nityaṃ puruṣaṃ guṇādhikam] ॥89॥
html:
naivāsya vindanti gatiṃ mahātmano na cāgatiṃ kaścidihānupaśyati ।
jñānātmakāḥ saṃyamino maharṣayaḥ paśyanti nityaṃ puruṣaṃ guṇādhikam] ॥89॥
slp1: nEvAsya vindanti gatiM mahAtmano na cAgatiM kaScidihAnupaSyati । jYAnAtmakAH saMyamino maharzayaH paSyanti nityaM puruzaM guRADikam] ॥89॥

text: aho hyekāntinaḥ sarvānprīṇāti bhagavānhariḥ । vidhiprayuktāṃ pūjāṃ ca gṛhṇāti bhagavānsvayam ॥1॥
html:
aho hyekāntinaḥ sarvānprīṇāti bhagavānhariḥ ।
vidhiprayuktāṃ pūjāṃ ca gṛhṇāti bhagavānsvayam ॥1॥
slp1: aho hyekAntinaH sarvAnprIRAti BagavAnhariH । viDiprayuktAM pUjAM ca gfhRAti BagavAnsvayam ॥1॥
author: janamejaya uvāca ।

text: ye tu dagdhendhanā loke puṇyapāpavivarjitāḥ । teṣāṃ tvayābhinirdiṣṭā pāramparyāgatā gatiḥ ॥2॥
html:
ye tu dagdhendhanā loke puṇyapāpavivarjitāḥ ।
teṣāṃ tvayābhinirdiṣṭā pāramparyāgatā gatiḥ ॥2॥
slp1: ye tu dagDenDanA loke puRyapApavivarjitAH । tezAM tvayABinirdizwA pAramparyAgatA gatiH ॥2॥

text: caturthyāṃ caiva te gatyāṃ gacchanti puruṣottamam । ekāntinastu puruṣā gacchanti paramaṃ padam ॥3॥
html:
caturthyāṃ caiva te gatyāṃ gacchanti puruṣottamam ।
ekāntinastu puruṣā gacchanti paramaṃ padam ॥3॥
slp1: caturTyAM cEva te gatyAM gacCanti puruzottamam । ekAntinastu puruzA gacCanti paramaM padam ॥3॥

text: nūnamekāntadharmo'yaṃ śreṣṭho nārāyaṇapriyaḥ । agatvā gatayastisro yadgacchantyavyayaṃ harim ॥4॥
html:
nūnamekāntadharmo'yaṃ śreṣṭho nārāyaṇapriyaḥ ।
agatvā gatayastisro yadgacchantyavyayaṃ harim ॥4॥
slp1: nUnamekAntaDarmo'yaM SrezWo nArAyaRapriyaH । agatvA gatayastisro yadgacCantyavyayaM harim ॥4॥

text: sahopaniṣadānvedānye viprāḥ samyagāsthitāḥ । paṭhanti vidhimāsthāya ye cāpi yatidharmiṇaḥ ॥5॥
html:
sahopaniṣadānvedānye viprāḥ samyagāsthitāḥ ।
paṭhanti vidhimāsthāya ye cāpi yatidharmiṇaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: sahopanizadAnvedAnye viprAH samyagAsTitAH । paWanti viDimAsTAya ye cApi yatiDarmiRaH ॥5॥

text: tebhyo viśiṣṭāṃ jānāmi gatimekāntināṃ nṛṇām । kenaiṣa dharmaḥ kathito devena ṛṣiṇāpi vā ॥6॥
html:
tebhyo viśiṣṭāṃ jānāmi gatimekāntināṃ nṛṇām ।
kenaiṣa dharmaḥ kathito devena ṛṣiṇāpi vā ॥6॥
slp1: teByo viSizwAM jAnAmi gatimekAntinAM nfRAm । kenEza DarmaH kaTito devena fziRApi vA ॥6॥

text: ekāntināṃ ca kā caryā kadā cotpāditā vibho । etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ॥7॥
html:
ekāntināṃ ca kā caryā kadā cotpāditā vibho ।
etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ॥7॥
slp1: ekAntinAM ca kA caryA kadA cotpAditA viBo । etanme saMSayaM CinDi paraM kOtUhalaM hi me ॥7॥

text: samupoḍheṣvanīkeṣu kurupāṇḍavayormṛdhe । arjune vimanaske ca gītā bhagavatā svayam ॥8॥
html:
samupoḍheṣvanīkeṣu kurupāṇḍavayormṛdhe ।
arjune vimanaske ca gītā bhagavatā svayam ॥8॥
slp1: samupoQezvanIkezu kurupARqavayormfDe । arjune vimanaske ca gItA BagavatA svayam ॥8॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: āgatiśca gatiścaiva pūrvaṃ te kathitā mayā । gahano hyeṣa dharmo vai durvijñeyo'kṛtātmabhiḥ ॥9॥
html:
āgatiśca gatiścaiva pūrvaṃ te kathitā mayā ।
gahano hyeṣa dharmo vai durvijñeyo'kṛtātmabhiḥ ॥9॥
slp1: AgatiSca gatiScEva pUrvaM te kaTitA mayA । gahano hyeza Darmo vE durvijYeyo'kftAtmaBiH ॥9॥

text: sammitaḥ sāmavedena puraivādiyuge kṛtaḥ । dhāryate svayamīśena rājannārāyaṇena ha ॥10॥
html:
sammitaḥ sāmavedena puraivādiyuge kṛtaḥ ।
dhāryate svayamīśena rājannārāyaṇena ha ॥10॥
slp1: sammitaH sAmavedena purEvAdiyuge kftaH । DAryate svayamISena rAjannArAyaRena ha ॥10॥

text: etamarthaṃ mahārāja pṛṣṭaḥ pārthena nāradaḥ । ṛṣimadhye mahābhāgaḥ śṛṇvatoḥ kṛṣṇabhīṣmayoḥ ॥11॥
html:
etamarthaṃ mahārāja pṛṣṭaḥ pārthena nāradaḥ ।
ṛṣimadhye mahābhāgaḥ śṛṇvatoḥ kṛṣṇabhīṣmayoḥ ॥11॥
slp1: etamarTaM mahArAja pfzwaH pArTena nAradaH । fzimaDye mahABAgaH SfRvatoH kfzRaBIzmayoH ॥11॥

text: guruṇā ca mamāpyeṣa kathito nṛpasattama । yathā tu kathitastatra nāradena tathā śṛṇu ॥12॥
html:
guruṇā ca mamāpyeṣa kathito nṛpasattama ।
yathā tu kathitastatra nāradena tathā śṛṇu ॥12॥
slp1: guruRA ca mamApyeza kaTito nfpasattama । yaTA tu kaTitastatra nAradena taTA SfRu ॥12॥

text: yadāsīnmānasaṃ janma nārāyaṇamukhodgatam । brahmaṇaḥ pṛthivīpāla tadā nārāyaṇaḥ svayam । tena dharmeṇa kṛtavāndaivaṃ pitryaṃ ca bhārata ॥13॥
html:
yadāsīnmānasaṃ janma nārāyaṇamukhodgatam ।
brahmaṇaḥ pṛthivīpāla tadā nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
tena dharmeṇa kṛtavāndaivaṃ pitryaṃ ca bhārata ॥13॥
slp1: yadAsInmAnasaM janma nArAyaRamuKodgatam । brahmaRaH pfTivIpAla tadA nArAyaRaH svayam । tena DarmeRa kftavAndEvaM pitryaM ca BArata ॥13॥

text: phenapā ṛṣayaścaiva taṃ dharmaṃ pratipedire । vaikhānasāḥ phenapebhyo dharmametaṃ prapedire । vaikhānasebhyaḥ somastu tataḥ so'ntardadhe punaḥ ॥14॥
html:
phenapā ṛṣayaścaiva taṃ dharmaṃ pratipedire ।
vaikhānasāḥ phenapebhyo dharmametaṃ prapedire ।
vaikhānasebhyaḥ somastu tataḥ so'ntardadhe punaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: PenapA fzayaScEva taM DarmaM pratipedire । vEKAnasAH PenapeByo DarmametaM prapedire । vEKAnaseByaH somastu tataH so'ntardaDe punaH ॥14॥

text: yadāsīccākṣuṣaṃ janma dvitīyaṃ brahmaṇo nṛpa । tadā pitāmahātsomādetaṃ dharmamajānata । nārāyaṇātmakaṃ rājanrudrāya pradadau ca saḥ ॥15॥
html:
yadāsīccākṣuṣaṃ janma dvitīyaṃ brahmaṇo nṛpa ।
tadā pitāmahātsomādetaṃ dharmamajānata ।
nārāyaṇātmakaṃ rājanrudrāya pradadau ca saḥ ॥15॥
slp1: yadAsIccAkzuzaM janma dvitIyaM brahmaRo nfpa । tadA pitAmahAtsomAdetaM DarmamajAnata । nArAyaRAtmakaM rAjanrudrAya pradadO ca saH ॥15॥

text: tato yogasthito rudraḥ purā kṛtayuge nṛpa । vālakhilyānṛṣīnsarvāndharmametamapāṭhayat । antardadhe tato bhūyastasya devasya māyayā ॥16॥
html:
tato yogasthito rudraḥ purā kṛtayuge nṛpa ।
vālakhilyānṛṣīnsarvāndharmametamapāṭhayat ।
antardadhe tato bhūyastasya devasya māyayā ॥16॥
slp1: tato yogasTito rudraH purA kftayuge nfpa । vAlaKilyAnfzInsarvAnDarmametamapAWayat । antardaDe tato BUyastasya devasya mAyayA ॥16॥

text: tṛtīyaṃ brahmaṇo janma yadāsīdvācikaṃ mahat । tatraiṣa dharmaḥ sambhūtaḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇānnṛpa ॥17॥
html:
tṛtīyaṃ brahmaṇo janma yadāsīdvācikaṃ mahat ।
tatraiṣa dharmaḥ sambhūtaḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇānnṛpa ॥17॥
slp1: tftIyaM brahmaRo janma yadAsIdvAcikaM mahat । tatrEza DarmaH samBUtaH svayaM nArAyaRAnnfpa ॥17॥

text: suparṇo nāma tamṛṣiḥ prāptavānpuruṣottamāt । tapasā vai sutaptena damena niyamena ca ॥18॥
html:
suparṇo nāma tamṛṣiḥ prāptavānpuruṣottamāt ।
tapasā vai sutaptena damena niyamena ca ॥18॥
slp1: suparRo nAma tamfziH prAptavAnpuruzottamAt । tapasA vE sutaptena damena niyamena ca ॥18॥

text: triḥ parikrāntavānetatsuparṇo dharmamuttamam । yasmāttasmādvrataṃ hyetattrisauparṇamihocyate ॥19॥
html:
triḥ parikrāntavānetatsuparṇo dharmamuttamam ।
yasmāttasmādvrataṃ hyetattrisauparṇamihocyate ॥19॥
slp1: triH parikrAntavAnetatsuparRo Darmamuttamam । yasmAttasmAdvrataM hyetattrisOparRamihocyate ॥19॥

text: ṛgvedapāṭhapaṭhitaṃ vratametaddhi duścaram । suparṇāccāpyadhigato dharma eṣa sanātanaḥ ॥20॥
html:
ṛgvedapāṭhapaṭhitaṃ vratametaddhi duścaram ।
suparṇāccāpyadhigato dharma eṣa sanātanaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: fgvedapAWapaWitaM vratametadDi duScaram । suparRAccApyaDigato Darma eza sanAtanaH ॥20॥

text: vāyunā dvipadāṃ śreṣṭha prathito jagadāyuṣā । vāyoḥ sakāśātprāptaśca ṛṣibhirvighasāśibhiḥ ॥21॥
html:
vāyunā dvipadāṃ śreṣṭha prathito jagadāyuṣā ।
vāyoḥ sakāśātprāptaśca ṛṣibhirvighasāśibhiḥ ॥21॥
slp1: vAyunA dvipadAM SrezWa praTito jagadAyuzA । vAyoH sakASAtprAptaSca fziBirviGasASiBiH ॥21॥

text: tebhyo mahodadhiścainaṃ prāptavāndharmamuttamam । tataḥ so'ntardadhe bhūyo nārāyaṇasamāhitaḥ ॥22॥
html:
tebhyo mahodadhiścainaṃ prāptavāndharmamuttamam ।
tataḥ so'ntardadhe bhūyo nārāyaṇasamāhitaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: teByo mahodaDiScEnaM prAptavAnDarmamuttamam । tataH so'ntardaDe BUyo nArAyaRasamAhitaH ॥22॥

text: yadā bhūyaḥ śravaṇajā sṛṣṭirāsīnmahātmanaḥ । brahmaṇaḥ puruṣavyāghra tatra kīrtayataḥ śṛṇu ॥23॥
html:
yadā bhūyaḥ śravaṇajā sṛṣṭirāsīnmahātmanaḥ ।
brahmaṇaḥ puruṣavyāghra tatra kīrtayataḥ śṛṇu ॥23॥
slp1: yadA BUyaH SravaRajA sfzwirAsInmahAtmanaH । brahmaRaH puruzavyAGra tatra kIrtayataH SfRu ॥23॥

text: jagatsraṣṭumanā devo harirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam । cintayāmāsa puruṣaṃ jagatsargakaraṃ prabhuḥ ॥24॥
html:
jagatsraṣṭumanā devo harirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
cintayāmāsa puruṣaṃ jagatsargakaraṃ prabhuḥ ॥24॥
slp1: jagatsrazwumanA devo harirnArAyaRaH svayam । cintayAmAsa puruzaM jagatsargakaraM praBuH ॥24॥

text: atha cintayatastasya karṇābhyāṃ puruṣaḥ sṛtaḥ । prajāsargakaro brahmā tamuvāca jagatpatiḥ ॥25॥
html:
atha cintayatastasya karṇābhyāṃ puruṣaḥ sṛtaḥ ।
prajāsargakaro brahmā tamuvāca jagatpatiḥ ॥25॥
slp1: aTa cintayatastasya karRAByAM puruzaH sftaH । prajAsargakaro brahmA tamuvAca jagatpatiH ॥25॥

text: sṛja prajāḥ putra sarvā mukhataḥ pādatastathā । śreyastava vidhāsyāmi balaṃ tejaśca suvrata ॥26॥
html:
sṛja prajāḥ putra sarvā mukhataḥ pādatastathā ।
śreyastava vidhāsyāmi balaṃ tejaśca suvrata ॥26॥
slp1: sfja prajAH putra sarvA muKataH pAdatastaTA । Sreyastava viDAsyAmi balaM tejaSca suvrata ॥26॥

text: dharmaṃ ca matto gṛhṇīṣva sātvataṃ nāma nāmataḥ । tena sarvaṃ kṛtayugaṃ sthāpayasva yathāvidhi ॥27॥
html:
dharmaṃ ca matto gṛhṇīṣva sātvataṃ nāma nāmataḥ ।
tena sarvaṃ kṛtayugaṃ sthāpayasva yathāvidhi ॥27॥
slp1: DarmaM ca matto gfhRIzva sAtvataM nAma nAmataH । tena sarvaM kftayugaM sTApayasva yaTAviDi ॥27॥

text: tato brahmā namaścakre devāya harimedhase । dharmaṃ cāgryaṃ sa jagrāha sarahasyaṃ sasaṅgraham । āraṇyakena sahitaṃ nārāyaṇamukhodgatam ॥28॥
html:
tato brahmā namaścakre devāya harimedhase ।
dharmaṃ cāgryaṃ sa jagrāha sarahasyaṃ sasaṅgraham ।
āraṇyakena sahitaṃ nārāyaṇamukhodgatam ॥28॥
slp1: tato brahmA namaScakre devAya harimeDase । DarmaM cAgryaM sa jagrAha sarahasyaM sasaNgraham । AraRyakena sahitaM nArAyaRamuKodgatam ॥28॥

text: upadiśya tato dharmaṃ brahmaṇe'mitatejase । taṃ kārtayugadharmāṇaṃ nirāśīḥkarmasañjñitam । jagāma tamasaḥ pāraṃ yatrāvyaktaṃ vyavasthitam ॥29॥
html:
upadiśya tato dharmaṃ brahmaṇe'mitatejase ।
taṃ kārtayugadharmāṇaṃ nirāśīḥkarmasañjñitam ।
jagāma tamasaḥ pāraṃ yatrāvyaktaṃ vyavasthitam ॥29॥
slp1: upadiSya tato DarmaM brahmaRe'mitatejase । taM kArtayugaDarmARaM nirASIHkarmasaYjYitam । jagAma tamasaH pAraM yatrAvyaktaM vyavasTitam ॥29॥

text: tato'tha varado devo brahmalokapitāmahaḥ । asṛjatsa tadā lokānkṛtsnānsthāvarajaṅgamān ॥30॥
html:
tato'tha varado devo brahmalokapitāmahaḥ ।
asṛjatsa tadā lokānkṛtsnānsthāvarajaṅgamān ॥30॥
slp1: tato'Ta varado devo brahmalokapitAmahaH । asfjatsa tadA lokAnkftsnAnsTAvarajaNgamAn ॥30॥

text: tataḥ prāvartata tadā ādau kṛtayugaṃ śubham । tato hi sātvato dharmo vyāpya lokānavasthitaḥ ॥31॥
html:
tataḥ prāvartata tadā ādau kṛtayugaṃ śubham ।
tato hi sātvato dharmo vyāpya lokānavasthitaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: tataH prAvartata tadA AdO kftayugaM SuBam । tato hi sAtvato Darmo vyApya lokAnavasTitaH ॥31॥

text: tenaivādyena dharmeṇa brahmā lokavisargakṛt । pūjayāmāsa deveśaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ॥32॥
html:
tenaivādyena dharmeṇa brahmā lokavisargakṛt ।
pūjayāmāsa deveśaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ॥32॥
slp1: tenEvAdyena DarmeRa brahmA lokavisargakft । pUjayAmAsa deveSaM hariM nArAyaRaM praBum ॥32॥

text: dharmapratiṣṭhāhetośca manuṃ svārociṣaṃ tataḥ । adhyāpayāmāsa tadā lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ॥33॥
html:
dharmapratiṣṭhāhetośca manuṃ svārociṣaṃ tataḥ ।
adhyāpayāmāsa tadā lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ॥33॥
slp1: DarmapratizWAhetoSca manuM svArocizaM tataH । aDyApayAmAsa tadA lokAnAM hitakAmyayA ॥33॥

text: tataḥ svārociṣaḥ putraṃ svayaṃ śaṅkhapadaṃ nṛpa । adhyāpayatpurāvyagraḥ sarvalokapatirvibhuḥ ॥34॥
html:
tataḥ svārociṣaḥ putraṃ svayaṃ śaṅkhapadaṃ nṛpa ।
adhyāpayatpurāvyagraḥ sarvalokapatirvibhuḥ ॥34॥
slp1: tataH svArocizaH putraM svayaM SaNKapadaM nfpa । aDyApayatpurAvyagraH sarvalokapatirviBuH ॥34॥

text: tataḥ śaṅkhapadaścāpi putramātmajamaurasam । diśāpālaṃ sudharmāṇamadhyāpayata bhārata । tataḥ so'ntardadhe bhūyaḥ prāpte tretāyuge punaḥ ॥35॥
html:
tataḥ śaṅkhapadaścāpi putramātmajamaurasam ।
diśāpālaṃ sudharmāṇamadhyāpayata bhārata ।
tataḥ so'ntardadhe bhūyaḥ prāpte tretāyuge punaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: tataH SaNKapadaScApi putramAtmajamOrasam । diSApAlaM suDarmARamaDyApayata BArata । tataH so'ntardaDe BUyaH prApte tretAyuge punaH ॥35॥

text: nāsikyajanmani purā brahmaṇaḥ pārthivottama । dharmametaṃ svayaṃ devo harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ । ujjagārāravindākṣo brahmaṇaḥ paśyatastadā ॥36॥
html:
nāsikyajanmani purā brahmaṇaḥ pārthivottama ।
dharmametaṃ svayaṃ devo harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
ujjagārāravindākṣo brahmaṇaḥ paśyatastadā ॥36॥
slp1: nAsikyajanmani purA brahmaRaH pArTivottama । DarmametaM svayaM devo harirnArAyaRaH praBuH । ujjagArAravindAkzo brahmaRaH paSyatastadA ॥36॥

text: sanatkumāro bhagavāṃstataḥ prādhītavānnṛpa । sanatkumārādapi ca vīraṇo vai prajāpatiḥ । kṛtādau kuruśārdūla dharmametamadhītavān ॥37॥
html:
sanatkumāro bhagavāṃstataḥ prādhītavānnṛpa ।
sanatkumārādapi ca vīraṇo vai prajāpatiḥ ।
kṛtādau kuruśārdūla dharmametamadhītavān ॥37॥
slp1: sanatkumAro BagavAMstataH prADItavAnnfpa । sanatkumArAdapi ca vIraRo vE prajApatiH । kftAdO kuruSArdUla DarmametamaDItavAn ॥37॥

text: vīraṇaścāpyadhītyainaṃ raucyāya manave dadau । raucyaḥ putrāya śuddhāya suvratāya sumedhase ॥38॥
html:
vīraṇaścāpyadhītyainaṃ raucyāya manave dadau ।
raucyaḥ putrāya śuddhāya suvratāya sumedhase ॥38॥
slp1: vIraRaScApyaDItyEnaM rOcyAya manave dadO । rOcyaH putrAya SudDAya suvratAya sumeDase ॥38॥

text: kukṣināmne'tha pradadau diśāṃ pālāya dharmiṇe । tataḥ so'ntardadhe bhūyo nārāyaṇamukhodgataḥ ॥39॥
html:
kukṣināmne'tha pradadau diśāṃ pālāya dharmiṇe ।
tataḥ so'ntardadhe bhūyo nārāyaṇamukhodgataḥ ॥39॥
slp1: kukzinAmne'Ta pradadO diSAM pAlAya DarmiRe । tataH so'ntardaDe BUyo nArAyaRamuKodgataH ॥39॥

text: aṇḍaje janmani punarbrahmaṇe hariyonaye । eṣa dharmaḥ samudbhūto nārāyaṇamukhātpunaḥ ॥40॥
html:
aṇḍaje janmani punarbrahmaṇe hariyonaye ।
eṣa dharmaḥ samudbhūto nārāyaṇamukhātpunaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: aRqaje janmani punarbrahmaRe hariyonaye । eza DarmaH samudBUto nArAyaRamuKAtpunaH ॥40॥

text: gṛhīto brahmaṇā rājanprayuktaśca yathāvidhi । adhyāpitāśca munayo nāmnā barhiṣado nṛpa ॥41॥
html:
gṛhīto brahmaṇā rājanprayuktaśca yathāvidhi ।
adhyāpitāśca munayo nāmnā barhiṣado nṛpa ॥41॥
slp1: gfhIto brahmaRA rAjanprayuktaSca yaTAviDi । aDyApitASca munayo nAmnA barhizado nfpa ॥41॥

text: barhiṣadbhyaśca saṅkrāntaḥ sāmavedāntagaṃ dvijam । jyeṣṭhaṃ nāmnābhivikhyātaṃ jyeṣṭhasāmavrato hariḥ ॥42॥
html:
barhiṣadbhyaśca saṅkrāntaḥ sāmavedāntagaṃ dvijam ।
jyeṣṭhaṃ nāmnābhivikhyātaṃ jyeṣṭhasāmavrato hariḥ ॥42॥
slp1: barhizadByaSca saNkrAntaH sAmavedAntagaM dvijam । jyezWaM nAmnABiviKyAtaM jyezWasAmavrato hariH ॥42॥

text: jyeṣṭhāccāpyanusaṅkrānto rājānamavikampanam । antardadhe tato rājanneṣa dharmaḥ prabhorhareḥ ॥43॥
html:
jyeṣṭhāccāpyanusaṅkrānto rājānamavikampanam ।
antardadhe tato rājanneṣa dharmaḥ prabhorhareḥ ॥43॥
slp1: jyezWAccApyanusaNkrAnto rAjAnamavikampanam । antardaDe tato rAjanneza DarmaH praBorhareH ॥43॥

text: yadidaṃ saptamaṃ janma padmajaṃ brahmaṇo nṛpa । tatraiṣa dharmaḥ kathitaḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇena hi ॥44॥
html:
yadidaṃ saptamaṃ janma padmajaṃ brahmaṇo nṛpa ।
tatraiṣa dharmaḥ kathitaḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇena hi ॥44॥
slp1: yadidaM saptamaM janma padmajaM brahmaRo nfpa । tatrEza DarmaH kaTitaH svayaM nArAyaRena hi ॥44॥

text: pitāmahāya śuddhāya yugādau lokadhāriṇe । pitāmahaśca dakṣāya dharmametaṃ purā dadau ॥45॥
html:
pitāmahāya śuddhāya yugādau lokadhāriṇe ।
pitāmahaśca dakṣāya dharmametaṃ purā dadau ॥45॥
slp1: pitAmahAya SudDAya yugAdO lokaDAriRe । pitAmahaSca dakzAya DarmametaM purA dadO ॥45॥

text: tato jyeṣṭhe tu dauhitre prādāddakṣo nṛpottama । āditye saviturjyeṣṭhe vivasvāñjagṛhe tataḥ ॥46॥
html:
tato jyeṣṭhe tu dauhitre prādāddakṣo nṛpottama ।
āditye saviturjyeṣṭhe vivasvāñjagṛhe tataḥ ॥46॥
slp1: tato jyezWe tu dOhitre prAdAddakzo nfpottama । Aditye saviturjyezWe vivasvAYjagfhe tataH ॥46॥

text: tretāyugādau ca punarvivasvānmanave dadau । manuśca lokabhūtyarthaṃ sutāyekṣvākave dadau ॥47॥
html:
tretāyugādau ca punarvivasvānmanave dadau ।
manuśca lokabhūtyarthaṃ sutāyekṣvākave dadau ॥47॥
slp1: tretAyugAdO ca punarvivasvAnmanave dadO । manuSca lokaBUtyarTaM sutAyekzvAkave dadO ॥47॥

text: ikṣvākuṇā ca kathito vyāpya lokānavasthitaḥ । gamiṣyati kṣayānte ca punarnārāyaṇaṃ nṛpa ॥48॥
html:
ikṣvākuṇā ca kathito vyāpya lokānavasthitaḥ ।
gamiṣyati kṣayānte ca punarnārāyaṇaṃ nṛpa ॥48॥
slp1: ikzvAkuRA ca kaTito vyApya lokAnavasTitaH । gamizyati kzayAnte ca punarnArAyaRaM nfpa ॥48॥

text: vratināṃ cāpi yo dharmaḥ sa te pūrvaṃ nṛpottama । kathito harigītāsu samāsavidhikalpitaḥ ॥49॥
html:
vratināṃ cāpi yo dharmaḥ sa te pūrvaṃ nṛpottama ।
kathito harigītāsu samāsavidhikalpitaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: vratinAM cApi yo DarmaH sa te pUrvaM nfpottama । kaTito harigItAsu samAsaviDikalpitaH ॥49॥

text: nāradena tu samprāptaḥ sarahasyaḥ sasaṅgrahaḥ । eṣa dharmo jagannāthātsākṣānnārāyaṇānnṛpa ॥50॥
html:
nāradena tu samprāptaḥ sarahasyaḥ sasaṅgrahaḥ ।
eṣa dharmo jagannāthātsākṣānnārāyaṇānnṛpa ॥50॥
slp1: nAradena tu samprAptaH sarahasyaH sasaNgrahaH । eza Darmo jagannATAtsAkzAnnArAyaRAnnfpa ॥50॥

text: evameṣa mahāndharma ādyo rājansanātanaḥ । durvijñeyo duṣkaraśca sātvatairdhāryate sadā ॥51॥
html:
evameṣa mahāndharma ādyo rājansanātanaḥ ।
durvijñeyo duṣkaraśca sātvatairdhāryate sadā ॥51॥
slp1: evameza mahAnDarma Adyo rAjansanAtanaH । durvijYeyo duzkaraSca sAtvatErDAryate sadA ॥51॥

text: dharmajñānena caitena suprayuktena karmaṇā । ahiṃsādharmayuktena prīyate harirīśvaraḥ ॥52॥
html:
dharmajñānena caitena suprayuktena karmaṇā ।
ahiṃsādharmayuktena prīyate harirīśvaraḥ ॥52॥
slp1: DarmajYAnena cEtena suprayuktena karmaRA । ahiMsADarmayuktena prIyate harirISvaraH ॥52॥

text: ekavyūhavibhāgo vā kvaciddvivyūhasañjñitaḥ । trivyūhaścāpi saṅkhyātaścaturvyūhaśca dṛśyate ॥53॥
html:
ekavyūhavibhāgo vā kvaciddvivyūhasañjñitaḥ ।
trivyūhaścāpi saṅkhyātaścaturvyūhaśca dṛśyate ॥53॥
slp1: ekavyUhaviBAgo vA kvaciddvivyUhasaYjYitaH । trivyUhaScApi saNKyAtaScaturvyUhaSca dfSyate ॥53॥

text: harireva hi kṣetrajño nirmamo niṣkalastathā । jīvaśca sarvabhūteṣu pañcabhūtaguṇātigaḥ ॥54॥
html:
harireva hi kṣetrajño nirmamo niṣkalastathā ।
jīvaśca sarvabhūteṣu pañcabhūtaguṇātigaḥ ॥54॥
slp1: harireva hi kzetrajYo nirmamo nizkalastaTA । jIvaSca sarvaBUtezu paYcaBUtaguRAtigaH ॥54॥

text: manaśca prathitaṃ rājanpañcendriyasamīraṇam । eṣa lokanidhirdhīmāneṣa lokavisargakṛt ॥55॥
html:
manaśca prathitaṃ rājanpañcendriyasamīraṇam ।
eṣa lokanidhirdhīmāneṣa lokavisargakṛt ॥55॥
slp1: manaSca praTitaM rAjanpaYcendriyasamIraRam । eza lokaniDirDImAneza lokavisargakft ॥55॥

text: akartā caiva kartā ca kāryaṃ kāraṇameva ca । yathecchati tathā rājankrīḍate puruṣo'vyayaḥ ॥56॥
html:
akartā caiva kartā ca kāryaṃ kāraṇameva ca ।
yathecchati tathā rājankrīḍate puruṣo'vyayaḥ ॥56॥
slp1: akartA cEva kartA ca kAryaM kAraRameva ca । yaTecCati taTA rAjankrIqate puruzo'vyayaH ॥56॥

text: eṣa ekāntidharmaste kīrtito nṛpasattama । mayā guruprasādena durvijñeyo'kṛtātmabhiḥ । ekāntino hi puruṣā durlabhā bahavo nṛpa ॥57॥
html:
eṣa ekāntidharmaste kīrtito nṛpasattama ।
mayā guruprasādena durvijñeyo'kṛtātmabhiḥ ।
ekāntino hi puruṣā durlabhā bahavo nṛpa ॥57॥
slp1: eza ekAntiDarmaste kIrtito nfpasattama । mayA guruprasAdena durvijYeyo'kftAtmaBiH । ekAntino hi puruzA durlaBA bahavo nfpa ॥57॥

text: yadyekāntibhirākīrṇaṃ jagatsyātkurunandana । ahiṃsakairātmavidbhiḥ sarvabhūtahite rataiḥ । bhavetkṛtayugaprāptirāśīḥkarmavivarjitaiḥ ॥58॥
html:
yadyekāntibhirākīrṇaṃ jagatsyātkurunandana ।
ahiṃsakairātmavidbhiḥ sarvabhūtahite rataiḥ ।
bhavetkṛtayugaprāptirāśīḥkarmavivarjitaiḥ ॥58॥
slp1: yadyekAntiBirAkIrRaM jagatsyAtkurunandana । ahiMsakErAtmavidBiH sarvaBUtahite ratEH । BavetkftayugaprAptirASIHkarmavivarjitEH ॥58॥

text: evaṃ sa bhagavānvyāso gururmama viśāṃ pate । kathayāmāsa dharmajño dharmarājñe dvijottamaḥ ॥59॥
html:
evaṃ sa bhagavānvyāso gururmama viśāṃ pate ।
kathayāmāsa dharmajño dharmarājñe dvijottamaḥ ॥59॥
slp1: evaM sa BagavAnvyAso gururmama viSAM pate । kaTayAmAsa DarmajYo DarmarAjYe dvijottamaH ॥59॥

text: ṛṣīṇāṃ sannidhau rājañśṛṇvatoḥ kṛṣṇabhīṣmayoḥ । tasyāpyakathayatpūrvaṃ nāradaḥ sumahātapāḥ ॥60॥
html:
ṛṣīṇāṃ sannidhau rājañśṛṇvatoḥ kṛṣṇabhīṣmayoḥ ।
tasyāpyakathayatpūrvaṃ nāradaḥ sumahātapāḥ ॥60॥
slp1: fzIRAM sanniDO rAjaYSfRvatoH kfzRaBIzmayoH । tasyApyakaTayatpUrvaM nAradaH sumahAtapAH ॥60॥

text: devaṃ paramakaṃ brahma śvetaṃ candrābhamacyutam । yatra caikāntino yānti nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ ॥61॥
html:
devaṃ paramakaṃ brahma śvetaṃ candrābhamacyutam ।
yatra caikāntino yānti nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ ॥61॥
slp1: devaM paramakaM brahma SvetaM candrABamacyutam । yatra cEkAntino yAnti nArAyaRaparAyaRAH ॥61॥

text: evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ dharmaṃ pratibuddhairniṣevitam । na kurvanti kathaṃ viprā anye nānāvrate sthitāḥ ॥62॥
html:
evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ dharmaṃ pratibuddhairniṣevitam ।
na kurvanti kathaṃ viprā anye nānāvrate sthitāḥ ॥62॥
slp1: evaM bahuviDaM DarmaM pratibudDErnizevitam । na kurvanti kaTaM viprA anye nAnAvrate sTitAH ॥62॥
author: janamejaya uvāca ।

text: tisraḥ prakṛtayo rājandehabandheṣu nirmitāḥ । sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ceti bhārata ॥63॥
html:
tisraḥ prakṛtayo rājandehabandheṣu nirmitāḥ ।
sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ceti bhārata ॥63॥
slp1: tisraH prakftayo rAjandehabanDezu nirmitAH । sAttvikI rAjasI cEva tAmasI ceti BArata ॥63॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: dehabandheṣu puruṣaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kurukulodvaha । sāttvikaḥ puruṣavyāghra bhavenmokṣārthaniścitaḥ ॥64॥
html:
dehabandheṣu puruṣaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kurukulodvaha ।
sāttvikaḥ puruṣavyāghra bhavenmokṣārthaniścitaḥ ॥64॥
slp1: dehabanDezu puruzaH SrezWaH kurukulodvaha । sAttvikaH puruzavyAGra BavenmokzArTaniScitaH ॥64॥

text: atrāpi sa vijānāti puruṣaṃ brahmavartinam । nārāyaṇaparo mokṣastato vai sāttvikaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥65॥
html:
atrāpi sa vijānāti puruṣaṃ brahmavartinam ।
nārāyaṇaparo mokṣastato vai sāttvikaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥65॥
slp1: atrApi sa vijAnAti puruzaM brahmavartinam । nArAyaRaparo mokzastato vE sAttvikaH smftaH ॥65॥

text: manīṣitaṃ ca prāpnoti cintayanpuruṣottamam । ekāntabhaktiḥ satataṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ ॥66॥
html:
manīṣitaṃ ca prāpnoti cintayanpuruṣottamam ।
ekāntabhaktiḥ satataṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ ॥66॥
slp1: manIzitaM ca prApnoti cintayanpuruzottamam । ekAntaBaktiH satataM nArAyaRaparAyaRaH ॥66॥

text: manīṣiṇo hi ye kecidyatayo mokṣakāṅkṣiṇaḥ । teṣāṃ vai chinnatṛṣṇānāṃ yogakṣemavaho hariḥ ॥67॥
html:
manīṣiṇo hi ye kecidyatayo mokṣakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ।
teṣāṃ vai chinnatṛṣṇānāṃ yogakṣemavaho hariḥ ॥67॥
slp1: manIziRo hi ye kecidyatayo mokzakANkziRaH । tezAM vE CinnatfzRAnAM yogakzemavaho hariH ॥67॥

text: jāyamānaṃ hi puruṣaṃ yaṃ paśyenmadhusūdanaḥ । sāttvikastu sa vijñeyo bhavenmokṣe ca niścitaḥ ॥68॥
html:
jāyamānaṃ hi puruṣaṃ yaṃ paśyenmadhusūdanaḥ ।
sāttvikastu sa vijñeyo bhavenmokṣe ca niścitaḥ ॥68॥
slp1: jAyamAnaM hi puruzaM yaM paSyenmaDusUdanaH । sAttvikastu sa vijYeyo Bavenmokze ca niScitaH ॥68॥

text: sāṅkhyayogena tulyo hi dharma ekāntasevitaḥ । nārāyaṇātmake mokṣe tato yānti parāṃ gatim ॥69॥
html:
sāṅkhyayogena tulyo hi dharma ekāntasevitaḥ ।
nārāyaṇātmake mokṣe tato yānti parāṃ gatim ॥69॥
slp1: sANKyayogena tulyo hi Darma ekAntasevitaH । nArAyaRAtmake mokze tato yAnti parAM gatim ॥69॥

text: nārāyaṇena dṛṣṭaśca pratibuddho bhavetpumān । evamātmecchayā rājanpratibuddho na jāyate ॥70॥
html:
nārāyaṇena dṛṣṭaśca pratibuddho bhavetpumān ।
evamātmecchayā rājanpratibuddho na jāyate ॥70॥
slp1: nArAyaRena dfzwaSca pratibudDo BavetpumAn । evamAtmecCayA rAjanpratibudDo na jAyate ॥70॥

text: rājasī tāmasī caiva vyāmiśre prakṛtī smṛte । tadātmakaṃ hi puruṣaṃ jāyamānaṃ viśāṃ pate । pravṛttilakṣaṇairyuktaṃ nāvekṣati hariḥ svayam ॥71॥
html:
rājasī tāmasī caiva vyāmiśre prakṛtī smṛte ।
tadātmakaṃ hi puruṣaṃ jāyamānaṃ viśāṃ pate ।
pravṛttilakṣaṇairyuktaṃ nāvekṣati hariḥ svayam ॥71॥
slp1: rAjasI tAmasI cEva vyAmiSre prakftI smfte । tadAtmakaM hi puruzaM jAyamAnaM viSAM pate । pravfttilakzaREryuktaM nAvekzati hariH svayam ॥71॥

text: paśyatyenaṃ jāyamānaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ । rajasā tamasā caiva mānuṣaṃ samabhiplutam ॥72॥
html:
paśyatyenaṃ jāyamānaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ।
rajasā tamasā caiva mānuṣaṃ samabhiplutam ॥72॥
slp1: paSyatyenaM jAyamAnaM brahmA lokapitAmahaH । rajasA tamasA cEva mAnuzaM samaBiplutam ॥72॥

text: kāmaṃ devāśca ṛṣayaḥ sattvasthā nṛpasattama । hīnāḥ sattvena sūkṣmeṇa tato vaikārikāḥ smṛtāḥ ॥73॥
html:
kāmaṃ devāśca ṛṣayaḥ sattvasthā nṛpasattama ।
hīnāḥ sattvena sūkṣmeṇa tato vaikārikāḥ smṛtāḥ ॥73॥
slp1: kAmaM devASca fzayaH sattvasTA nfpasattama । hInAH sattvena sUkzmeRa tato vEkArikAH smftAH ॥73॥

text: kathaṃ vaikāriko gacchetpuruṣaḥ puruṣottamam ॥74॥
html: kathaṃ vaikāriko gacchetpuruṣaḥ puruṣottamam ॥74॥
slp1: kaTaM vEkAriko gacCetpuruzaH puruzottamam ॥74॥
author: janamejaya uvāca ।

text: susūkṣmasattvasaṃyuktaṃ saṃyuktaṃ tribhirakṣaraiḥ । puruṣaḥ puruṣaṃ gacchenniṣkriyaḥ pañcaviṃśakam ॥75॥
html:
susūkṣmasattvasaṃyuktaṃ saṃyuktaṃ tribhirakṣaraiḥ ।
puruṣaḥ puruṣaṃ gacchenniṣkriyaḥ pañcaviṃśakam ॥75॥
slp1: susUkzmasattvasaMyuktaM saMyuktaM triBirakzarEH । puruzaH puruzaM gacCennizkriyaH paYcaviMSakam ॥75॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: evamekaṃ sāṅkhyayogaṃ vedāraṇyakameva ca । parasparāṅgānyetāni pañcarātraṃ ca kathyate । eṣa ekāntināṃ dharmo nārāyaṇaparātmakaḥ ॥76॥
html:
evamekaṃ sāṅkhyayogaṃ vedāraṇyakameva ca ।
parasparāṅgānyetāni pañcarātraṃ ca kathyate ।
eṣa ekāntināṃ dharmo nārāyaṇaparātmakaḥ ॥76॥
slp1: evamekaM sANKyayogaM vedAraRyakameva ca । parasparANgAnyetAni paYcarAtraM ca kaTyate । eza ekAntinAM Darmo nArAyaRaparAtmakaH ॥76॥

text: yathā samudrātprasṛtā jalaughāstameva rājanpunarāviśanti । ime tathā jñānamahājalaughā nārāyaṇaṃ vai punarāviśanti ॥77॥
html:
yathā samudrātprasṛtā jalaughāstameva rājanpunarāviśanti ।
ime tathā jñānamahājalaughā nārāyaṇaṃ vai punarāviśanti ॥77॥
slp1: yaTA samudrAtprasftA jalOGAstameva rAjanpunarAviSanti । ime taTA jYAnamahAjalOGA nArAyaRaM vE punarAviSanti ॥77॥

text: eṣa te kathito dharmaḥ sātvato yadubāndhava । kuruṣvainaṃ yathānyāyaṃ yadi śaknoṣi bhārata ॥78॥
html:
eṣa te kathito dharmaḥ sātvato yadubāndhava ।
kuruṣvainaṃ yathānyāyaṃ yadi śaknoṣi bhārata ॥78॥
slp1: eza te kaTito DarmaH sAtvato yadubAnDava । kuruzvEnaM yaTAnyAyaM yadi Saknozi BArata ॥78॥

text: evaṃ hi sumahābhāgo nārado gurave mama । śvetānāṃ yatināmāha ekāntagatimavyayām ॥79॥
html:
evaṃ hi sumahābhāgo nārado gurave mama ।
śvetānāṃ yatināmāha ekāntagatimavyayām ॥79॥
slp1: evaM hi sumahABAgo nArado gurave mama । SvetAnAM yatinAmAha ekAntagatimavyayAm ॥79॥

text: vyāsaścākathayatprītyā dharmaputrāya dhīmate । sa evāyaṃ mayā tubhyamākhyātaḥ prasṛto guroḥ ॥80॥
html:
vyāsaścākathayatprītyā dharmaputrāya dhīmate ।
sa evāyaṃ mayā tubhyamākhyātaḥ prasṛto guroḥ ॥80॥
slp1: vyAsaScAkaTayatprItyA DarmaputrAya DImate । sa evAyaM mayA tuByamAKyAtaH prasfto guroH ॥80॥

text: itthaṃ hi duścaro dharma eṣa pārthivasattama । yathaiva tvaṃ tathaivānye na bhajanti vimohitāḥ ॥81॥
html:
itthaṃ hi duścaro dharma eṣa pārthivasattama ।
yathaiva tvaṃ tathaivānye na bhajanti vimohitāḥ ॥81॥
slp1: itTaM hi duScaro Darma eza pArTivasattama । yaTEva tvaM taTEvAnye na Bajanti vimohitAH ॥81॥

text: kṛṣṇa eva hi lokānāṃ bhāvano mohanastathā] ॥82॥
html: kṛṣṇa eva hi lokānāṃ bhāvano mohanastathā] ॥82॥
slp1: kfzRa eva hi lokAnAM BAvano mohanastaTA] ॥82॥

text: sāṅkhyaṃ yogaṃ pañcarātraṃ vedāraṇyakameva ca । jñānānyetāni brahmarṣe lokeṣu pracaranti ha ॥1॥
html:
sāṅkhyaṃ yogaṃ pañcarātraṃ vedāraṇyakameva ca ।
jñānānyetāni brahmarṣe lokeṣu pracaranti ha ॥1॥
slp1: sANKyaM yogaM paYcarAtraM vedAraRyakameva ca । jYAnAnyetAni brahmarze lokezu pracaranti ha ॥1॥
author: janamejaya uvāca ।

text: kimetānyekaniṣṭhāni pṛthaṅniṣṭhāni vā mune । prabrūhi vai mayā pṛṣṭaḥ pravṛttiṃ ca yathākramam ॥2॥
html:
kimetānyekaniṣṭhāni pṛthaṅniṣṭhāni vā mune ।
prabrūhi vai mayā pṛṣṭaḥ pravṛttiṃ ca yathākramam ॥2॥
slp1: kimetAnyekanizWAni pfTaNnizWAni vA mune । prabrUhi vE mayA pfzwaH pravfttiM ca yaTAkramam ॥2॥

text: jajñe bahujñaṃ paramatyudāraṃ yaṃ dvīpamadhye sutamātmavantam । parāśarādgandhavatī maharṣiṃ tasmai namo'jñānatamonudāya ॥3॥
html:
jajñe bahujñaṃ paramatyudāraṃ yaṃ dvīpamadhye sutamātmavantam ।
parāśarādgandhavatī maharṣiṃ tasmai namo'jñānatamonudāya ॥3॥
slp1: jajYe bahujYaM paramatyudAraM yaM dvIpamaDye sutamAtmavantam । parASarAdganDavatI maharziM tasmE namo'jYAnatamonudAya ॥3॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: pitāmahādyaṃ pravadanti ṣaṣṭhaṃ maharṣimārṣeyavibhūtiyuktam । nārāyaṇasyāṃśajamekaputraṃ dvaipāyanaṃ vedamahānidhānam ॥4॥
html:
pitāmahādyaṃ pravadanti ṣaṣṭhaṃ maharṣimārṣeyavibhūtiyuktam ।
nārāyaṇasyāṃśajamekaputraṃ dvaipāyanaṃ vedamahānidhānam ॥4॥
slp1: pitAmahAdyaM pravadanti zazWaM maharzimArzeyaviBUtiyuktam । nArAyaRasyAMSajamekaputraM dvEpAyanaM vedamahAniDAnam ॥4॥

text: tamādikāleṣu mahāvibhūtirnārāyaṇo brahmamahānidhānam । sasarja putrārthamudāratejā vyāsaṃ mahātmānamajaḥ purāṇaḥ ॥5॥
html:
tamādikāleṣu mahāvibhūtirnārāyaṇo brahmamahānidhānam ।
sasarja putrārthamudāratejā vyāsaṃ mahātmānamajaḥ purāṇaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: tamAdikAlezu mahAviBUtirnArAyaRo brahmamahAniDAnam । sasarja putrArTamudAratejA vyAsaM mahAtmAnamajaH purARaH ॥5॥

text: tvayaiva kathitaḥ pūrvaṃ sambhavo dvijasattama । vasiṣṭhasya sutaḥ śaktiḥ śakteḥ putraḥ parāśaraḥ ॥6॥
html:
tvayaiva kathitaḥ pūrvaṃ sambhavo dvijasattama ।
vasiṣṭhasya sutaḥ śaktiḥ śakteḥ putraḥ parāśaraḥ ॥6॥
slp1: tvayEva kaTitaH pUrvaM samBavo dvijasattama । vasizWasya sutaH SaktiH SakteH putraH parASaraH ॥6॥
author: janamejaya uvāca ।

text: parāśarasya dāyādaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ । bhūyo nārāyaṇasutaṃ tvamevainaṃ prabhāṣase ॥7॥
html:
parāśarasya dāyādaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ ।
bhūyo nārāyaṇasutaṃ tvamevainaṃ prabhāṣase ॥7॥
slp1: parASarasya dAyAdaH kfzRadvEpAyano muniH । BUyo nArAyaRasutaM tvamevEnaM praBAzase ॥7॥

text: kimataḥ pūrvajaṃ janma vyāsasyāmitatejasaḥ । kathayasvottamamate janma nārāyaṇodbhavam ॥8॥
html:
kimataḥ pūrvajaṃ janma vyāsasyāmitatejasaḥ ।
kathayasvottamamate janma nārāyaṇodbhavam ॥8॥
slp1: kimataH pUrvajaM janma vyAsasyAmitatejasaH । kaTayasvottamamate janma nArAyaRodBavam ॥8॥

text: vedārthānvettukāmasya dharmiṣṭhasya taponidheḥ । gurorme jñānaniṣṭhasya himavatpāda āsataḥ ॥9॥
html:
vedārthānvettukāmasya dharmiṣṭhasya taponidheḥ ।
gurorme jñānaniṣṭhasya himavatpāda āsataḥ ॥9॥
slp1: vedArTAnvettukAmasya DarmizWasya taponiDeH । gurorme jYAnanizWasya himavatpAda AsataH ॥9॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: kṛtvā bhāratamākhyānaṃ tapaḥśrāntasya dhīmataḥ । śuśrūṣāṃ tatparā rājankṛtavanto vayaṃ tadā ॥10॥
html:
kṛtvā bhāratamākhyānaṃ tapaḥśrāntasya dhīmataḥ ।
śuśrūṣāṃ tatparā rājankṛtavanto vayaṃ tadā ॥10॥
slp1: kftvA BAratamAKyAnaM tapaHSrAntasya DImataH । SuSrUzAM tatparA rAjankftavanto vayaM tadA ॥10॥

text: sumanturjaiminiścaiva pailaśca sudṛḍhavrataḥ । ahaṃ caturthaḥ śiṣyo vai śuko vyāsātmajastathā ॥11॥
html:
sumanturjaiminiścaiva pailaśca sudṛḍhavrataḥ ।
ahaṃ caturthaḥ śiṣyo vai śuko vyāsātmajastathā ॥11॥
slp1: sumanturjEminiScEva pElaSca sudfQavrataH । ahaM caturTaH Sizyo vE Suko vyAsAtmajastaTA ॥11॥

text: ebhiḥ parivṛto vyāsaḥ śiṣyaiḥ pañcabhiruttamaiḥ । śuśubhe himavatpāde bhūtairbhūtapatiryathā ॥12॥
html:
ebhiḥ parivṛto vyāsaḥ śiṣyaiḥ pañcabhiruttamaiḥ ।
śuśubhe himavatpāde bhūtairbhūtapatiryathā ॥12॥
slp1: eBiH parivfto vyAsaH SizyEH paYcaBiruttamEH । SuSuBe himavatpAde BUtErBUtapatiryaTA ॥12॥

text: vedānāvartayansāṅgānbhāratārthāṃśca sarvaśaḥ । tamekamanasaṃ dāntaṃ yuktā vayamupāsmahe ॥13॥
html:
vedānāvartayansāṅgānbhāratārthāṃśca sarvaśaḥ ।
tamekamanasaṃ dāntaṃ yuktā vayamupāsmahe ॥13॥
slp1: vedAnAvartayansANgAnBAratArTAMSca sarvaSaH । tamekamanasaM dAntaM yuktA vayamupAsmahe ॥13॥

text: kathāntare'tha kasmiṃścitpṛṣṭo'smābhirdvijottamaḥ । vedārthānbhāratārthāṃśca janma nārāyaṇāttathā ॥14॥
html:
kathāntare'tha kasmiṃścitpṛṣṭo'smābhirdvijottamaḥ ।
vedārthānbhāratārthāṃśca janma nārāyaṇāttathā ॥14॥
slp1: kaTAntare'Ta kasmiMScitpfzwo'smABirdvijottamaH । vedArTAnBAratArTAMSca janma nArAyaRAttaTA ॥14॥

text: sa pūrvamuktvā vedārthānbhāratārthāṃśca tattvavit । nārāyaṇādidaṃ janma vyāhartumupacakrame ॥15॥
html:
sa pūrvamuktvā vedārthānbhāratārthāṃśca tattvavit ।
nārāyaṇādidaṃ janma vyāhartumupacakrame ॥15॥
slp1: sa pUrvamuktvA vedArTAnBAratArTAMSca tattvavit । nArAyaRAdidaM janma vyAhartumupacakrame ॥15॥

text: śṛṇudhvamākhyānavarametadārṣeyamuttamam । ādikālodbhavaṃ viprāstapasādhigataṃ mayā ॥16॥
html:
śṛṇudhvamākhyānavarametadārṣeyamuttamam ।
ādikālodbhavaṃ viprāstapasādhigataṃ mayā ॥16॥
slp1: SfRuDvamAKyAnavarametadArzeyamuttamam । AdikAlodBavaM viprAstapasADigataM mayA ॥16॥

text: prāpte prajāvisarge vai saptame padmasambhave । nārāyaṇo mahāyogī śubhāśubhavivarjitaḥ ॥17॥
html:
prāpte prajāvisarge vai saptame padmasambhave ।
nārāyaṇo mahāyogī śubhāśubhavivarjitaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: prApte prajAvisarge vE saptame padmasamBave । nArAyaRo mahAyogI SuBASuBavivarjitaH ॥17॥

text: sasṛje nābhitaḥ putraṃ brahmāṇamamitaprabham । tataḥ sa prādurabhavadathainaṃ vākyamabravīt ॥18॥
html:
sasṛje nābhitaḥ putraṃ brahmāṇamamitaprabham ।
tataḥ sa prādurabhavadathainaṃ vākyamabravīt ॥18॥
slp1: sasfje nABitaH putraM brahmARamamitapraBam । tataH sa prAduraBavadaTEnaM vAkyamabravIt ॥18॥

text: mama tvaṃ nābhito jātaḥ prajāsargakaraḥ prabhuḥ । sṛja prajāstvaṃ vividhā brahmansajaḍapaṇḍitāḥ ॥19॥
html:
mama tvaṃ nābhito jātaḥ prajāsargakaraḥ prabhuḥ ।
sṛja prajāstvaṃ vividhā brahmansajaḍapaṇḍitāḥ ॥19॥
slp1: mama tvaM nABito jAtaH prajAsargakaraH praBuH । sfja prajAstvaM viviDA brahmansajaqapaRqitAH ॥19॥

text: sa evamukto vimukhaścintāvyākulamānasaḥ । praṇamya varadaṃ devamuvāca harimīśvaram ॥20॥
html:
sa evamukto vimukhaścintāvyākulamānasaḥ ।
praṇamya varadaṃ devamuvāca harimīśvaram ॥20॥
slp1: sa evamukto vimuKaScintAvyAkulamAnasaH । praRamya varadaM devamuvAca harimISvaram ॥20॥

text: kā śaktirmama deveśa prajāḥ sraṣṭuṃ namo'stu te । aprajñāvānahaṃ deva vidhatsva yadanantaram ॥21॥
html:
kā śaktirmama deveśa prajāḥ sraṣṭuṃ namo'stu te ।
aprajñāvānahaṃ deva vidhatsva yadanantaram ॥21॥
slp1: kA Saktirmama deveSa prajAH srazwuM namo'stu te । aprajYAvAnahaM deva viDatsva yadanantaram ॥21॥

text: sa evamukto bhagavānbhūtvāthāntarhitastataḥ । cintayāmāsa deveśo buddhiṃ buddhimatāṃ varaḥ ॥22॥
html:
sa evamukto bhagavānbhūtvāthāntarhitastataḥ ।
cintayāmāsa deveśo buddhiṃ buddhimatāṃ varaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: sa evamukto BagavAnBUtvATAntarhitastataH । cintayAmAsa deveSo budDiM budDimatAM varaH ॥22॥

text: svarūpiṇī tato buddhirupatasthe hariṃ prabhum । yogena caināṃ niryogaḥ svayaṃ niyuyuje tadā ॥23॥
html:
svarūpiṇī tato buddhirupatasthe hariṃ prabhum ।
yogena caināṃ niryogaḥ svayaṃ niyuyuje tadā ॥23॥
slp1: svarUpiRI tato budDirupatasTe hariM praBum । yogena cEnAM niryogaH svayaM niyuyuje tadA ॥23॥

text: sa tāmaiśvaryayogasthāṃ buddhiṃ śaktimatīṃ satīm । uvāca vacanaṃ devo buddhiṃ vai prabhuravyayaḥ ॥24॥
html:
sa tāmaiśvaryayogasthāṃ buddhiṃ śaktimatīṃ satīm ।
uvāca vacanaṃ devo buddhiṃ vai prabhuravyayaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: sa tAmESvaryayogasTAM budDiM SaktimatIM satIm । uvAca vacanaM devo budDiM vE praBuravyayaH ॥24॥

text: brahmāṇaṃ praviśasveti lokasṛṣṭyarthasiddhaye । tatastamīśvarādiṣṭā buddhiḥ kṣipraṃ viveśa sā ॥25॥
html:
brahmāṇaṃ praviśasveti lokasṛṣṭyarthasiddhaye ।
tatastamīśvarādiṣṭā buddhiḥ kṣipraṃ viveśa sā ॥25॥
slp1: brahmARaM praviSasveti lokasfzwyarTasidDaye । tatastamISvarAdizwA budDiH kzipraM viveSa sA ॥25॥

text: athainaṃ buddhisaṃyuktaṃ punaḥ sa dadṛśe hariḥ । bhūyaścainaṃ vacaḥ prāha sṛjemā vividhāḥ prajāḥ ॥26॥
html:
athainaṃ buddhisaṃyuktaṃ punaḥ sa dadṛśe hariḥ ।
bhūyaścainaṃ vacaḥ prāha sṛjemā vividhāḥ prajāḥ ॥26॥
slp1: aTEnaM budDisaMyuktaM punaH sa dadfSe hariH । BUyaScEnaM vacaH prAha sfjemA viviDAH prajAH ॥26॥

text: evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstatraivāntaradhīyata । prāpa caiva muhūrtena svasthānaṃ devasañjñitam ॥27॥
html:
