evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstatraivāntaradhīyata ।
prāpa caiva muhūrtena svasthānaṃ devasañjñitam ॥27॥
slp1: evamuktvA sa BagavAMstatrEvAntaraDIyata । prApa cEva muhUrtena svasTAnaM devasaYjYitam ॥27॥

text: tāṃ caiva prakṛtiṃ prāpya ekībhāvagato'bhavat । athāsya buddhirabhavatpunaranyā tadā kila ॥28॥
html:
tāṃ caiva prakṛtiṃ prāpya ekībhāvagato'bhavat ।
athāsya buddhirabhavatpunaranyā tadā kila ॥28॥
slp1: tAM cEva prakftiM prApya ekIBAvagato'Bavat । aTAsya budDiraBavatpunaranyA tadA kila ॥28॥

text: sṛṣṭā imāḥ prajāḥ sarvā brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā । daityadānavagandharvarakṣogaṇasamākulāḥ । jātā hīyaṃ vasumatī bhārākrāntā tapasvinī ॥29॥
html:
sṛṣṭā imāḥ prajāḥ sarvā brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā ।
daityadānavagandharvarakṣogaṇasamākulāḥ ।
jātā hīyaṃ vasumatī bhārākrāntā tapasvinī ॥29॥
slp1: sfzwA imAH prajAH sarvA brahmaRA paramezWinA । dEtyadAnavaganDarvarakzogaRasamAkulAH । jAtA hIyaM vasumatI BArAkrAntA tapasvinI ॥29॥

text: bahavo balinaḥ pṛthvyāṃ daityadānavarākṣasāḥ । bhaviṣyanti tapoyuktā varānprāpsyanti cottamān ॥30॥
html:
bahavo balinaḥ pṛthvyāṃ daityadānavarākṣasāḥ ।
bhaviṣyanti tapoyuktā varānprāpsyanti cottamān ॥30॥
slp1: bahavo balinaH pfTvyAM dEtyadAnavarAkzasAH । Bavizyanti tapoyuktA varAnprApsyanti cottamAn ॥30॥

text: avaśyameva taiḥ sarvairvaradānena darpitaiḥ । bādhitavyāḥ suragaṇā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ । tatra nyāyyamidaṃ kartuṃ bhārāvataraṇaṃ mayā ॥31॥
html:
avaśyameva taiḥ sarvairvaradānena darpitaiḥ ।
bādhitavyāḥ suragaṇā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ ।
tatra nyāyyamidaṃ kartuṃ bhārāvataraṇaṃ mayā ॥31॥
slp1: avaSyameva tEH sarvErvaradAnena darpitEH । bADitavyAH suragaRA fzayaSca tapoDanAH । tatra nyAyyamidaM kartuM BArAvataraRaM mayA ॥31॥

text: atha nānāsamudbhūtairvasudhāyāṃ yathākramam । nigraheṇa ca pāpānāṃ sādhūnāṃ pragraheṇa ca ॥32॥
html:
atha nānāsamudbhūtairvasudhāyāṃ yathākramam ।
nigraheṇa ca pāpānāṃ sādhūnāṃ pragraheṇa ca ॥32॥
slp1: aTa nAnAsamudBUtErvasuDAyAM yaTAkramam । nigraheRa ca pApAnAM sADUnAM pragraheRa ca ॥32॥

text: imāṃ tapasvinīṃ satyāṃ dhārayiṣyāmi medinīm । mayā hyeṣā hi dhriyate pātālasthena bhoginā ॥33॥
html:
imāṃ tapasvinīṃ satyāṃ dhārayiṣyāmi medinīm ।
mayā hyeṣā hi dhriyate pātālasthena bhoginā ॥33॥
slp1: imAM tapasvinIM satyAM DArayizyAmi medinIm । mayA hyezA hi Driyate pAtAlasTena BoginA ॥33॥

text: mayā dhṛtā dhārayati jagaddhi sacarācaram । tasmātpṛthvyāḥ paritrāṇaṃ kariṣye sambhavaṃ gataḥ ॥34॥
html:
mayā dhṛtā dhārayati jagaddhi sacarācaram ।
tasmātpṛthvyāḥ paritrāṇaṃ kariṣye sambhavaṃ gataḥ ॥34॥
slp1: mayA DftA DArayati jagadDi sacarAcaram । tasmAtpfTvyAH paritrARaM karizye samBavaM gataH ॥34॥

text: evaṃ sa cintayitvā tu bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ । rūpāṇyanekānyasṛjatprādurbhāvabhavāya saḥ ॥35॥
html:
evaṃ sa cintayitvā tu bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ ।
rūpāṇyanekānyasṛjatprādurbhāvabhavāya saḥ ॥35॥
slp1: evaM sa cintayitvA tu BagavAnmaDusUdanaH । rUpARyanekAnyasfjatprAdurBAvaBavAya saH ॥35॥

text: vārāhaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ ca vāmanaṃ mānuṣaṃ tathā । ebhirmayā nihantavyā durvinītāḥ surārayaḥ ॥36॥
html:
vārāhaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ ca vāmanaṃ mānuṣaṃ tathā ।
ebhirmayā nihantavyā durvinītāḥ surārayaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: vArAhaM nArasiMhaM ca vAmanaM mAnuzaM taTA । eBirmayA nihantavyA durvinItAH surArayaH ॥36॥

text: atha bhūyo jagatsraṣṭā bhoḥśabdenānunādayan । sarasvatīmuccacāra tatra sārasvato'bhavat ॥37॥
html:
atha bhūyo jagatsraṣṭā bhoḥśabdenānunādayan ।
sarasvatīmuccacāra tatra sārasvato'bhavat ॥37॥
slp1: aTa BUyo jagatsrazwA BoHSabdenAnunAdayan । sarasvatImuccacAra tatra sArasvato'Bavat ॥37॥

text: apāntaratamā nāma suto vāksambhavo vibhoḥ । bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyajñaḥ satyavādī dṛḍhavrataḥ ॥38॥
html:
apāntaratamā nāma suto vāksambhavo vibhoḥ ।
bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyajñaḥ satyavādī dṛḍhavrataḥ ॥38॥
slp1: apAntaratamA nAma suto vAksamBavo viBoH । BUtaBavyaBavizyajYaH satyavAdI dfQavrataH ॥38॥

text: tamuvāca nataṃ mūrdhnā devānāmādiravyayaḥ । vedākhyāne śrutiḥ kāryā tvayā matimatāṃ vara । tasmātkuru yathājñaptaṃ mayaitadvacanaṃ mune ॥39॥
html:
tamuvāca nataṃ mūrdhnā devānāmādiravyayaḥ ।
vedākhyāne śrutiḥ kāryā tvayā matimatāṃ vara ।
tasmātkuru yathājñaptaṃ mayaitadvacanaṃ mune ॥39॥
slp1: tamuvAca nataM mUrDnA devAnAmAdiravyayaH । vedAKyAne SrutiH kAryA tvayA matimatAM vara । tasmAtkuru yaTAjYaptaM mayEtadvacanaM mune ॥39॥

text: tena bhinnāstadā vedā manoḥ svāyambhuve'ntare । tatastutoṣa bhagavānharistenāsya karmaṇā । tapasā ca sutaptena yamena niyamena ca ॥40॥
html:
tena bhinnāstadā vedā manoḥ svāyambhuve'ntare ।
tatastutoṣa bhagavānharistenāsya karmaṇā ।
tapasā ca sutaptena yamena niyamena ca ॥40॥
slp1: tena BinnAstadA vedA manoH svAyamBuve'ntare । tatastutoza BagavAnharistenAsya karmaRA । tapasA ca sutaptena yamena niyamena ca ॥40॥

text: manvantareṣu putra tvamevaṃ lokapravartakaḥ । bhaviṣyasyacalo brahmannapradhṛṣyaśca nityaśaḥ ॥41॥
html:
manvantareṣu putra tvamevaṃ lokapravartakaḥ ।
bhaviṣyasyacalo brahmannapradhṛṣyaśca nityaśaḥ ॥41॥
slp1: manvantarezu putra tvamevaM lokapravartakaH । Bavizyasyacalo brahmannapraDfzyaSca nityaSaH ॥41॥
author: śrībhagavānuvāca ।

text: punastiṣye ca samprāpte kuravo nāma bhāratāḥ । bhaviṣyanti mahātmāno rājānaḥ prathitā bhuvi ॥42॥
html:
punastiṣye ca samprāpte kuravo nāma bhāratāḥ ।
bhaviṣyanti mahātmāno rājānaḥ prathitā bhuvi ॥42॥
slp1: punastizye ca samprApte kuravo nAma BAratAH । Bavizyanti mahAtmAno rAjAnaH praTitA Buvi ॥42॥

text: teṣāṃ tvattaḥ prasūtānāṃ kulabhedo bhaviṣyati । parasparavināśārthaṃ tvāmṛte dvijasattama ॥43॥
html:
teṣāṃ tvattaḥ prasūtānāṃ kulabhedo bhaviṣyati ।
parasparavināśārthaṃ tvāmṛte dvijasattama ॥43॥
slp1: tezAM tvattaH prasUtAnAM kulaBedo Bavizyati । parasparavinASArTaM tvAmfte dvijasattama ॥43॥

text: tatrāpyanekadhā vedānbhetsyase tapasānvitaḥ । kṛṣṇe yuge ca samprāpte kṛṣṇavarṇo bhaviṣyasi ॥44॥
html:
tatrāpyanekadhā vedānbhetsyase tapasānvitaḥ ।
kṛṣṇe yuge ca samprāpte kṛṣṇavarṇo bhaviṣyasi ॥44॥
slp1: tatrApyanekaDA vedAnBetsyase tapasAnvitaH । kfzRe yuge ca samprApte kfzRavarRo Bavizyasi ॥44॥

text: dharmāṇāṃ vividhānāṃ ca kartā jñānakarastathā । bhaviṣyasi tapoyukto na ca rāgādvimokṣyase ॥45॥
html:
dharmāṇāṃ vividhānāṃ ca kartā jñānakarastathā ।
bhaviṣyasi tapoyukto na ca rāgādvimokṣyase ॥45॥
slp1: DarmARAM viviDAnAM ca kartA jYAnakarastaTA । Bavizyasi tapoyukto na ca rAgAdvimokzyase ॥45॥

text: vītarāgaśca putraste paramātmā bhaviṣyati । maheśvaraprasādena naitadvacanamanyathā ॥46॥
html:
vītarāgaśca putraste paramātmā bhaviṣyati ।
maheśvaraprasādena naitadvacanamanyathā ॥46॥
slp1: vItarAgaSca putraste paramAtmA Bavizyati । maheSvaraprasAdena nEtadvacanamanyaTA ॥46॥

text: yaṃ mānasaṃ vai pravadanti putraṃ pitāmahasyottamabuddhiyuktam । vasiṣṭhamagryaṃ tapaso nidhānaṃ yaścāpi sūryaṃ vyatiricya bhāti ॥47॥
html:
yaṃ mānasaṃ vai pravadanti putraṃ pitāmahasyottamabuddhiyuktam ।
vasiṣṭhamagryaṃ tapaso nidhānaṃ yaścāpi sūryaṃ vyatiricya bhāti ॥47॥
slp1: yaM mAnasaM vE pravadanti putraM pitAmahasyottamabudDiyuktam । vasizWamagryaM tapaso niDAnaM yaScApi sUryaM vyatiricya BAti ॥47॥

text: tasyānvaye cāpi tato maharṣiḥ parāśaro nāma mahāprabhāvaḥ । pitā sa te vedanidhirvariṣṭho mahātapā vai tapaso nivāsaḥ । kānīnagarbhaḥ pitṛkanyakāyāṃ tasmādṛṣestvaṃ bhavitā ca putraḥ ॥48॥
html:
tasyānvaye cāpi tato maharṣiḥ parāśaro nāma mahāprabhāvaḥ ।
pitā sa te vedanidhirvariṣṭho mahātapā vai tapaso nivāsaḥ ।
kānīnagarbhaḥ pitṛkanyakāyāṃ tasmādṛṣestvaṃ bhavitā ca putraḥ ॥48॥
slp1: tasyAnvaye cApi tato maharziH parASaro nAma mahApraBAvaH । pitA sa te vedaniDirvarizWo mahAtapA vE tapaso nivAsaH । kAnInagarBaH pitfkanyakAyAM tasmAdfzestvaM BavitA ca putraH ॥48॥

text: bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyāṇāṃ chinnasarvārthasaṃśayaḥ । ye hyatikrāntakāḥ pūrvaṃ sahasrayugaparyayāḥ ॥49॥
html:
bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyāṇāṃ chinnasarvārthasaṃśayaḥ ।
ye hyatikrāntakāḥ pūrvaṃ sahasrayugaparyayāḥ ॥49॥
slp1: BUtaBavyaBavizyARAM CinnasarvArTasaMSayaH । ye hyatikrAntakAH pUrvaM sahasrayugaparyayAH ॥49॥

text: tāṃśca sarvānmayoddiṣṭāndrakṣyase tapasānvitaḥ । punardrakṣyasi cānekasahasrayugaparyayān ॥50॥
html:
tāṃśca sarvānmayoddiṣṭāndrakṣyase tapasānvitaḥ ।
punardrakṣyasi cānekasahasrayugaparyayān ॥50॥
slp1: tAMSca sarvAnmayoddizwAndrakzyase tapasAnvitaH । punardrakzyasi cAnekasahasrayugaparyayAn ॥50॥

text: anādinidhanaṃ loke cakrahastaṃ ca māṃ mune । anudhyānānmama mune naitadvacanamanyathā ॥51॥
html:
anādinidhanaṃ loke cakrahastaṃ ca māṃ mune ।
anudhyānānmama mune naitadvacanamanyathā ॥51॥
slp1: anAdiniDanaM loke cakrahastaM ca mAM mune । anuDyAnAnmama mune nEtadvacanamanyaTA ॥51॥

text: śanaiścaraḥ sūryaputro bhaviṣyati manurmahān । tasminmanvantare caiva saptarṣigaṇapūrvakaḥ । tvameva bhavitā vatsa matprasādānna saṃśayaḥ ॥52॥
html:
śanaiścaraḥ sūryaputro bhaviṣyati manurmahān ।
tasminmanvantare caiva saptarṣigaṇapūrvakaḥ ।
tvameva bhavitā vatsa matprasādānna saṃśayaḥ ॥52॥
slp1: SanEScaraH sUryaputro Bavizyati manurmahAn । tasminmanvantare cEva saptarzigaRapUrvakaH । tvameva BavitA vatsa matprasAdAnna saMSayaH ॥52॥

text: evaṃ sārasvatamṛṣimapāntaratamaṃ tadā । uktvā vacanamīśānaḥ sādhayasvetyathābravīt ॥53॥
html:
evaṃ sārasvatamṛṣimapāntaratamaṃ tadā ।
uktvā vacanamīśānaḥ sādhayasvetyathābravīt ॥53॥
slp1: evaM sArasvatamfzimapAntaratamaM tadA । uktvA vacanamISAnaH sADayasvetyaTAbravIt ॥53॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: so'haṃ tasya prasādena devasya harimedhasaḥ । apāntaratamā nāma tato jāto''jñayā hareḥ । punaśca jāto vikhyāto vasiṣṭhakulanandanaḥ ॥54॥
html:
so'haṃ tasya prasādena devasya harimedhasaḥ ।
apāntaratamā nāma tato jāto''jñayā hareḥ ।
punaśca jāto vikhyāto vasiṣṭhakulanandanaḥ ॥54॥
slp1: so'haM tasya prasAdena devasya harimeDasaH । apAntaratamA nAma tato jAto''jYayA hareH । punaSca jAto viKyAto vasizWakulanandanaH ॥54॥

text: tadetatkathitaṃ janma mayā pūrvakamātmanaḥ । nārāyaṇaprasādena tathā nārāyaṇāṃśajam ॥55॥
html:
tadetatkathitaṃ janma mayā pūrvakamātmanaḥ ।
nārāyaṇaprasādena tathā nārāyaṇāṃśajam ॥55॥
slp1: tadetatkaTitaM janma mayA pUrvakamAtmanaH । nArAyaRaprasAdena taTA nArAyaRAMSajam ॥55॥

text: mayā hi sumahattaptaṃ tapaḥ paramadāruṇam । purā matimatāṃ śreṣṭhāḥ parameṇa samādhinā ॥56॥
html:
mayā hi sumahattaptaṃ tapaḥ paramadāruṇam ।
purā matimatāṃ śreṣṭhāḥ parameṇa samādhinā ॥56॥
slp1: mayA hi sumahattaptaM tapaH paramadAruRam । purA matimatAM SrezWAH parameRa samADinA ॥56॥

text: etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yanmāṃ pṛcchatha putrakāḥ । pūrvajanma bhaviṣyaṃ ca bhaktānāṃ snehato mayā ॥57॥
html:
etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yanmāṃ pṛcchatha putrakāḥ ।
pūrvajanma bhaviṣyaṃ ca bhaktānāṃ snehato mayā ॥57॥
slp1: etadvaH kaTitaM sarvaM yanmAM pfcCaTa putrakAH । pUrvajanma BavizyaM ca BaktAnAM snehato mayA ॥57॥

text: eṣa te kathitaḥ pūrvaṃ sambhavo'smadgurornṛpa । vyāsasyākliṣṭamanaso yathā pṛṣṭaḥ punaḥ śṛṇu ॥58॥
html:
eṣa te kathitaḥ pūrvaṃ sambhavo'smadgurornṛpa ।
vyāsasyākliṣṭamanaso yathā pṛṣṭaḥ punaḥ śṛṇu ॥58॥
slp1: eza te kaTitaH pUrvaM samBavo'smadgurornfpa । vyAsasyAklizwamanaso yaTA pfzwaH punaH SfRu ॥58॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: sāṅkhyaṃ yogaṃ pañcarātraṃ vedāḥ pāśupataṃ tathā । jñānānyetāni rājarṣe viddhi nānāmatāni vai ॥59॥
html:
sāṅkhyaṃ yogaṃ pañcarātraṃ vedāḥ pāśupataṃ tathā ।
jñānānyetāni rājarṣe viddhi nānāmatāni vai ॥59॥
slp1: sANKyaM yogaM paYcarAtraM vedAH pASupataM taTA । jYAnAnyetAni rAjarze vidDi nAnAmatAni vE ॥59॥

text: sāṅkhyasya vaktā kapilaḥ paramarṣiḥ sa ucyate । hiraṇyagarbho yogasya vettā nānyaḥ purātanaḥ ॥60॥
html:
sāṅkhyasya vaktā kapilaḥ paramarṣiḥ sa ucyate ।
hiraṇyagarbho yogasya vettā nānyaḥ purātanaḥ ॥60॥
slp1: sANKyasya vaktA kapilaH paramarziH sa ucyate । hiraRyagarBo yogasya vettA nAnyaH purAtanaH ॥60॥

text: apāntaratamāścaiva vedācāryaḥ sa ucyate । prācīnagarbhaṃ tamṛṣiṃ pravadantīha kecana ॥61॥
html:
apāntaratamāścaiva vedācāryaḥ sa ucyate ।
prācīnagarbhaṃ tamṛṣiṃ pravadantīha kecana ॥61॥
slp1: apAntaratamAScEva vedAcAryaH sa ucyate । prAcInagarBaM tamfziM pravadantIha kecana ॥61॥

text: umāpatirbhūtapatiḥ śrīkaṇṭho brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ । uktavānidamavyagro jñānaṃ pāśupataṃ śivaḥ ॥62॥
html:
umāpatirbhūtapatiḥ śrīkaṇṭho brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ ।
uktavānidamavyagro jñānaṃ pāśupataṃ śivaḥ ॥62॥
slp1: umApatirBUtapatiH SrIkaRWo brahmaRaH sutaH । uktavAnidamavyagro jYAnaM pASupataM SivaH ॥62॥

text: pañcarātrasya kṛtsnasya vettā tu bhagavānsvayam । sarveṣu ca nṛpaśreṣṭha jñāneṣveteṣu dṛśyate ॥63॥
html:
pañcarātrasya kṛtsnasya vettā tu bhagavānsvayam ।

eko hutāśo bahudhā samidhyate ekaḥ sūryastapasāṃ yonirekā ।
eko vāyurbahudhā vāti loke mahodadhiścāmbhasāṃ yonirekaḥ ।
puruṣaścaiko nirguṇo viśvarūpastaṃ nirguṇaṃ puruṣaṃ cāviśanti ॥10॥
slp1: eko hutASo bahuDA samiDyate ekaH sUryastapasAM yonirekA । eko vAyurbahuDA vAti loke mahodaDiScAmBasAM yonirekaH । puruzaScEko nirguRo viSvarUpastaM nirguRaM puruzaM cAviSanti ॥10॥

text: hitvā guṇamayaṃ sarvaṃ karma hitvā śubhāśubham । ubhe satyānṛte tyaktvā evaṃ bhavati nirguṇaḥ ॥11॥

text: acintyaṃ cāpi taṃ jñātvā bhāvasūkṣmaṃ catuṣṭayam । vicaredyo yatiryattaḥ sa gacchetpuruṣaṃ prabhum ॥12॥

text: evaṃ hi paramātmānaṃ kecidicchanti paṇḍitāḥ । ekātmānaṃ tathātmānamapare'dhyātmacintakāḥ ॥13॥

text: tatra yaḥ paramātmā hi sa nityaṃ nirguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ । sa hi nārāyaṇo jñeyaḥ sarvātmā puruṣo hi saḥ । na lipyate phalaiścāpi padmapatramivāmbhasā ॥14॥

sa hi nārāyaṇo jñeyaḥ sarvātmā puruṣo hi saḥ ।

text: karmātmā tvaparo yo'sau mokṣabandhaiḥ sa yujyate । sasaptadaśakenāpi rāśinā yujyate hi saḥ । evaṃ bahuvidhaḥ proktaḥ puruṣaste yathākramam ॥15॥
html:

text: yattatkṛtsnaṃ lokatantrasya dhāma vedyaṃ paraṃ bodhanīyaṃ saboddhṛ । mantā mantavyaṃ prāśitā prāśitavyaṃ ghrātā ghreyaṃ sparśitā sparśanīyam ॥16॥

text: draṣṭā draṣṭavyaṃ śrāvitā śrāvaṇīyaṃ jñātā jñeyaṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ ca । yadvai proktaṃ guṇasāmyaṃ pradhānaṃ nityaṃ caitacchāśvataṃ cāvyayaṃ ca ॥17॥
html:
draṣṭā draṣṭavyaṃ śrāvitā śrāvaṇīyaṃ jñātā jñeyaṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ ca ।
yadvai proktaṃ guṇasāmyaṃ pradhānaṃ nityaṃ caitacchāśvataṃ cāvyayaṃ ca ॥17॥

text: yadvai sūte dhāturādyaṃ nidhānaṃ tadvai viprāḥ pravadante'niruddham । yadvai loke vaidikaṃ karma sādhu āśīryuktaṃ taddhi tasyopabhojyam ॥18॥
html:

yadvai loke vaidikaṃ karma sādhu āśīryuktaṃ taddhi tasyopabhojyam ॥18॥
slp1: yadvE sUte DAturAdyaM niDAnaM tadvE viprAH pravadante'nirudDam । yadvE loke vEdikaM karma sADu ASIryuktaM tadDi tasyopaBojyam ॥18॥

text: devāḥ sarve munayaḥ sādhu dāntāstaṃ prāgyajñairyajñabhāgaṃ yajante । ahaṃ brahmā ādya īśaḥ prajānāṃ tasmājjātastvaṃ ca mattaḥ prasūtaḥ । matto jagajjaṅgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ ca sarve vedāḥ sarahasyā hi putra ॥19॥
html:
devāḥ sarve munayaḥ sādhu dāntāstaṃ prāgyajñairyajñabhāgaṃ yajante ।
ahaṃ brahmā ādya īśaḥ prajānāṃ tasmājjātastvaṃ ca mattaḥ prasūtaḥ ।
matto jagajjaṅgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ ca sarve vedāḥ sarahasyā hi putra ॥19॥
slp1: devAH sarve munayaH sADu dAntAstaM prAgyajYEryajYaBAgaM yajante । ahaM brahmA Adya ISaH prajAnAM tasmAjjAtastvaM ca mattaH prasUtaH । matto jagajjaNgamaM sTAvaraM ca sarve vedAH sarahasyA hi putra ॥19॥

text: caturvibhaktaḥ puruṣaḥ sa krīḍati yathecchati । evaṃ sa eva bhagavāñjñānena pratibodhitaḥ ॥20॥
html:

evaṃ sa eva bhagavāñjñānena pratibodhitaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: caturviBaktaH puruzaH sa krIqati yaTecCati । evaM sa eva BagavAYjYAnena pratiboDitaH ॥20॥

text: etatte kathitaṃ putra yathāvadanupṛcchataḥ । sāṅkhyajñāne tathā yoge yathāvadanuvarṇitam] ॥21॥

text: dharmāḥ pitāmahenoktā mokṣadharmāśritāḥ śubhāḥ । dharmamāśramiṇāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vaktumarhati me bhavān ॥1॥
html:

slp1: DarmAH pitAmahenoktA mokzaDarmASritAH SuBAH । DarmamASramiRAM SrezWaM vaktumarhati me BavAn ॥1॥

text: sarvatra vihito dharmaḥ svargyaḥ satyaphalodayaḥ । bahudvārasya dharmasya nehāsti viphalā kriyā ॥2॥

text: yasminyasmiṃstu viṣaye yo yo yāti viniścayam । sa tamevābhijānāti nānyaṃ bharatasattama ॥3॥

html:
na me mano rajyati bhogakāle dṛṣṭvā yatīnprārthayataḥ paratra ।
tenātithe buddhibalāśrayeṇa dharmārthatattve viniyuṅkṣva māṃ tvam ॥7॥
slp1: na me mano rajyati BogakAle dfzwvA yatInprArTayataH paratra । tenAtiTe budDibalASrayeRa DarmArTatattve viniyuNkzva mAM tvam ॥7॥

text: so'tithirvacanaṃ tasya śrutvā dharmābhilāṣiṇaḥ । provāca vacanaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ prājño madhurayā girā ॥8॥
html:
so'tithirvacanaṃ tasya śrutvā dharmābhilāṣiṇaḥ ।
provāca vacanaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ prājño madhurayā girā ॥8॥
slp1: so'tiTirvacanaM tasya SrutvA DarmABilAziRaH । provAca vacanaM SlakzRaM prAjYo maDurayA girA ॥8॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ahamapyatra muhyāmi mamāpyeṣa manorathaḥ । na ca sanniścayaṃ yāmi bahudvāre triviṣṭape ॥9॥
html:
ahamapyatra muhyāmi mamāpyeṣa manorathaḥ ।
na ca sanniścayaṃ yāmi bahudvāre triviṣṭape ॥9॥
slp1: ahamapyatra muhyAmi mamApyeza manoraTaH । na ca sanniScayaM yAmi bahudvAre trivizwape ॥9॥

text: kecinmokṣaṃ praśaṃsanti kecidyajñaphalaṃ dvijāḥ । vānaprasthāśramaṃ kecidgārhasthyaṃ kecidāśritāḥ ॥10॥
html:
kecinmokṣaṃ praśaṃsanti kecidyajñaphalaṃ dvijāḥ ।
vānaprasthāśramaṃ kecidgārhasthyaṃ kecidāśritāḥ ॥10॥
slp1: kecinmokzaM praSaMsanti kecidyajYaPalaM dvijAH । vAnaprasTASramaM kecidgArhasTyaM kecidASritAH ॥10॥

text: rājadharmāśrayaṃ kecitkecidātmaphalāśrayam । gurucaryāśrayaṃ kecitkecidvākyaṃ yamāśrayam ॥11॥
html:
rājadharmāśrayaṃ kecitkecidātmaphalāśrayam ।
gurucaryāśrayaṃ kecitkecidvākyaṃ yamāśrayam ॥11॥
slp1: rAjaDarmASrayaM kecitkecidAtmaPalASrayam । gurucaryASrayaM kecitkecidvAkyaM yamASrayam ॥11॥

text: mātaraṃ pitaraṃ kecicchuśrūṣanto divaṃ gatāḥ । ahiṃsayā pare svargaṃ satyena ca tathā pare ॥12॥
html:
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ kecicchuśrūṣanto divaṃ gatāḥ ।
ahiṃsayā pare svargaṃ satyena ca tathā pare ॥12॥
slp1: mAtaraM pitaraM kecicCuSrUzanto divaM gatAH । ahiMsayA pare svargaM satyena ca taTA pare ॥12॥

text: āhave'bhimukhāḥ kecinnihatāḥ sviddivaṃ gatāḥ । keciduñchavrataiḥ siddhāḥ svargamārgasamāśritāḥ ॥13॥
html:
āhave'bhimukhāḥ kecinnihatāḥ sviddivaṃ gatāḥ ।
keciduñchavrataiḥ siddhāḥ svargamārgasamāśritāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: Ahave'BimuKAH kecinnihatAH sviddivaM gatAH । keciduYCavratEH sidDAH svargamArgasamASritAH ॥13॥

text: kecidadhyayane yuktā vedavrataparāḥ śubhāḥ । buddhimanto gatāḥ svargaṃ tuṣṭātmāno jitendriyāḥ ॥14॥
html:
kecidadhyayane yuktā vedavrataparāḥ śubhāḥ ।
buddhimanto gatāḥ svargaṃ tuṣṭātmāno jitendriyāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: kecidaDyayane yuktA vedavrataparAH SuBAH । budDimanto gatAH svargaM tuzwAtmAno jitendriyAH ॥14॥

text: ārjavenāpare yuktā nihatānārjavairjanaiḥ । ṛjavo nākapṛṣṭhe vai śuddhātmānaḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ॥15॥
html:
ārjavenāpare yuktā nihatānārjavairjanaiḥ ।
ṛjavo nākapṛṣṭhe vai śuddhātmānaḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ॥15॥
slp1: ArjavenApare yuktA nihatAnArjavErjanEH । fjavo nAkapfzWe vE SudDAtmAnaH pratizWitAH ॥15॥

text: evaṃ bahuvidhairloke dharmadvārairanāvṛtaiḥ । mamāpi matirāvignā meghalekheva vāyunā] ॥16॥
html:
evaṃ bahuvidhairloke dharmadvārairanāvṛtaiḥ ।
mamāpi matirāvignā meghalekheva vāyunā] ॥16॥
slp1: evaM bahuviDErloke DarmadvArEranAvftEH । mamApi matirAvignA meGaleKeva vAyunA] ॥16॥

text: upadeśaṃ tu te vipra kariṣye'haṃ yathāgamam । guruṇā me yathākhyātamarthatastacca me śṛṇu ॥1॥
html:
upadeśaṃ tu te vipra kariṣye'haṃ yathāgamam ।
guruṇā me yathākhyātamarthatastacca me śṛṇu ॥1॥
slp1: upadeSaM tu te vipra karizye'haM yaTAgamam । guruRA me yaTAKyAtamarTatastacca me SfRu ॥1॥
author: atithiruvāca ।

text: yatra pūrvābhisargeṇa dharmacakraṃ pravartitam । naimiṣe gomatītīre tatra nāgāhvayaṃ puram ॥2॥
html:
yatra pūrvābhisargeṇa dharmacakraṃ pravartitam ।
naimiṣe gomatītīre tatra nāgāhvayaṃ puram ॥2॥
slp1: yatra pUrvABisargeRa DarmacakraM pravartitam । nEmize gomatItIre tatra nAgAhvayaM puram ॥2॥

text: samagraistridaśaistatra iṣṭamāsīddvijarṣabha । yatrendrātikramaṃ cakre māndhātā rājasattamaḥ ॥3॥
html:
samagraistridaśaistatra iṣṭamāsīddvijarṣabha ।
yatrendrātikramaṃ cakre māndhātā rājasattamaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: samagrEstridaSEstatra izwamAsIddvijarzaBa । yatrendrAtikramaM cakre mAnDAtA rAjasattamaH ॥3॥

text: kṛtādhivāso dharmātmā tatra cakṣuḥśravā mahān । padmanābho mahābhāgaḥ padma ityeva viśrutaḥ ॥4॥
html:
kṛtādhivāso dharmātmā tatra cakṣuḥśravā mahān ।
padmanābho mahābhāgaḥ padma ityeva viśrutaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: kftADivAso DarmAtmA tatra cakzuHSravA mahAn । padmanABo mahABAgaH padma ityeva viSrutaH ॥4॥

text: sa vācā karmaṇā caiva manasā ca dvijarṣabha । prasādayati bhūtāni trividhe vartmani sthitaḥ ॥5॥
html:
sa vācā karmaṇā caiva manasā ca dvijarṣabha ।
prasādayati bhūtāni trividhe vartmani sthitaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: sa vAcA karmaRA cEva manasA ca dvijarzaBa । prasAdayati BUtAni triviDe vartmani sTitaH ॥5॥

text: sāmnā dānena bhedena daṇḍeneti caturvidham । viṣamasthaṃ janaṃ svaṃ ca cakṣurdhyānena rakṣati ॥6॥
html:
sāmnā dānena bhedena daṇḍeneti caturvidham ।
viṣamasthaṃ janaṃ svaṃ ca cakṣurdhyānena rakṣati ॥6॥
slp1: sAmnA dAnena Bedena daRqeneti caturviDam । vizamasTaM janaM svaM ca cakzurDyAnena rakzati ॥6॥

text: tamabhikramya vidhinā praṣṭumarhasi kāṅkṣitam । sa te paramakaṃ dharmaṃ namithyā darśayiṣyati ॥7॥
html:
tamabhikramya vidhinā praṣṭumarhasi kāṅkṣitam ।
sa te paramakaṃ dharmaṃ namithyā darśayiṣyati ॥7॥
slp1: tamaBikramya viDinA prazwumarhasi kANkzitam । sa te paramakaM DarmaM namiTyA darSayizyati ॥7॥

text: sa hi sarvātithirnāgo buddhiśāstraviśāradaḥ । guṇairanavamairyuktaḥ samastairābhikāmikaiḥ ॥8॥
html:
sa hi sarvātithirnāgo buddhiśāstraviśāradaḥ ।
guṇairanavamairyuktaḥ samastairābhikāmikaiḥ ॥8॥
slp1: sa hi sarvAtiTirnAgo budDiSAstraviSAradaH । guREranavamEryuktaH samastErABikAmikEH ॥8॥

text: prakṛtyā nityasalilo nityamadhyayane rataḥ । tapodamābhyāṃ saṃyukto vṛttenānavareṇa ca ॥9॥
html:
prakṛtyā nityasalilo nityamadhyayane rataḥ ।
tapodamābhyāṃ saṃyukto vṛttenānavareṇa ca ॥9॥
slp1: prakftyA nityasalilo nityamaDyayane rataH । tapodamAByAM saMyukto vfttenAnavareRa ca ॥9॥

text: yajvā dānaruciḥ kṣānto vṛtte ca parame sthitaḥ । satyavāganasūyuśca śīlavānabhisaṃśritaḥ ॥10॥
html:
yajvā dānaruciḥ kṣānto vṛtte ca parame sthitaḥ ।
satyavāganasūyuśca śīlavānabhisaṃśritaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: yajvA dAnaruciH kzAnto vftte ca parame sTitaH । satyavAganasUyuSca SIlavAnaBisaMSritaH ॥10॥

text: śeṣānnabhoktā vacanānukūlo hitārjavotkṛṣṭakṛtākṛtajñaḥ । avairakṛdbhūtahite niyukto gaṅgāhradāmbho'bhijanopapannaḥ] ॥11॥
html:
śeṣānnabhoktā vacanānukūlo hitārjavotkṛṣṭakṛtākṛtajñaḥ ।
avairakṛdbhūtahite niyukto gaṅgāhradāmbho'bhijanopapannaḥ] ॥11॥
slp1: SezAnnaBoktA vacanAnukUlo hitArjavotkfzwakftAkftajYaH । avErakfdBUtahite niyukto gaNgAhradAmBo'BijanopapannaH] ॥11॥

text: atibhārodyatasyaiva bhārāpanayanaṃ mahat । parāśvāsakaraṃ vākyamidaṃ me bhavataḥ śrutam ॥1॥
html:
atibhārodyatasyaiva bhārāpanayanaṃ mahat ।
parāśvāsakaraṃ vākyamidaṃ me bhavataḥ śrutam ॥1॥
slp1: atiBArodyatasyEva BArApanayanaM mahat । parASvAsakaraM vAkyamidaM me BavataH Srutam ॥1॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: adhvaklāntasya śayanaṃ sthānaklāntasya cāsanam । tṛṣitasya ca pānīyaṃ kṣudhārtasya ca bhojanam ॥2॥
html:
adhvaklāntasya śayanaṃ sthānaklāntasya cāsanam ।
tṛṣitasya ca pānīyaṃ kṣudhārtasya ca bhojanam ॥2॥
slp1: aDvaklAntasya SayanaM sTAnaklAntasya cAsanam । tfzitasya ca pAnIyaM kzuDArtasya ca Bojanam ॥2॥

text: īpsitasyeva samprāptirannasya samaye'titheḥ । eṣitasyātmanaḥ kāle vṛddhasyeva suto yathā ॥3॥
html:
īpsitasyeva samprāptirannasya samaye'titheḥ ।
eṣitasyātmanaḥ kāle vṛddhasyeva suto yathā ॥3॥
slp1: Ipsitasyeva samprAptirannasya samaye'tiTeH । ezitasyAtmanaH kAle vfdDasyeva suto yaTA ॥3॥

text: manasā cintitasyeva prītisnigdhasya darśanam । prahrādayati māṃ vākyaṃ bhavatā yadudīritam ॥4॥
html:
manasā cintitasyeva prītisnigdhasya darśanam ।
prahrādayati māṃ vākyaṃ bhavatā yadudīritam ॥4॥
slp1: manasA cintitasyeva prItisnigDasya darSanam । prahrAdayati mAM vAkyaM BavatA yadudIritam ॥4॥

text: dattacakṣurivākāśe paśyāmi vimṛśāmi ca । prajñānavacanādyo'yamupadeśo hi me kṛtaḥ । bāḍhamevaṃ kariṣyāmi yathā māṃ bhāṣate bhavān ॥5॥
html:
dattacakṣurivākāśe paśyāmi vimṛśāmi ca ।
prajñānavacanādyo'yamupadeśo hi me kṛtaḥ ।
bāḍhamevaṃ kariṣyāmi yathā māṃ bhāṣate bhavān ॥5॥
slp1: dattacakzurivAkASe paSyAmi vimfSAmi ca । prajYAnavacanAdyo'yamupadeSo hi me kftaH । bAQamevaM karizyAmi yaTA mAM BAzate BavAn ॥5॥

text: ihemāṃ rajanīṃ sādho nivasasva mayā saha । prabhāte yāsyati bhavānparyāśvastaḥ sukhoṣitaḥ । asau hi bhagavānsūryo mandaraśmiravāṅmukhaḥ ॥6॥
html:
ihemāṃ rajanīṃ sādho nivasasva mayā saha ।
prabhāte yāsyati bhavānparyāśvastaḥ sukhoṣitaḥ ।
asau hi bhagavānsūryo mandaraśmiravāṅmukhaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: ihemAM rajanIM sADo nivasasva mayA saha । praBAte yAsyati BavAnparyASvastaH suKozitaH । asO hi BagavAnsUryo mandaraSmiravANmuKaH ॥6॥

text: tatastena kṛtātithyaḥ so'tithiḥ śatrusūdana । uvāsa kila tāṃ rātriṃ saha tena dvijena vai ॥7॥
html:
tatastena kṛtātithyaḥ so'tithiḥ śatrusūdana ।
uvāsa kila tāṃ rātriṃ saha tena dvijena vai ॥7॥
slp1: tatastena kftAtiTyaH so'tiTiH SatrusUdana । uvAsa kila tAM rAtriM saha tena dvijena vE ॥7॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tattacca dharmasaṃyuktaṃ tayoḥ kathayatostadā । vyatītā sā niśā kṛtsnā sukhena divasopamā ॥8॥
html:
tattacca dharmasaṃyuktaṃ tayoḥ kathayatostadā ।
vyatītā sā niśā kṛtsnā sukhena divasopamā ॥8॥
slp1: tattacca DarmasaMyuktaM tayoH kaTayatostadA । vyatItA sA niSA kftsnA suKena divasopamA ॥8॥

text: tataḥ prabhātasamaye so'tithistena pūjitaḥ । brāhmaṇena yathāśaktyā svakāryamabhikāṅkṣatā ॥9॥
html:
tataḥ prabhātasamaye so'tithistena pūjitaḥ ।
brāhmaṇena yathāśaktyā svakāryamabhikāṅkṣatā ॥9॥
slp1: tataH praBAtasamaye so'tiTistena pUjitaH । brAhmaRena yaTASaktyA svakAryamaBikANkzatA ॥9॥

text: tataḥ sa vipraḥ kṛtadharmaniścayaḥ kṛtābhyanujñaḥ svajanena dharmavit । yathopadiṣṭaṃ bhujagendrasaṃśrayaṃ jagāma kāle sukṛtaikaniścayaḥ] ॥10॥
html:
tataḥ sa vipraḥ kṛtadharmaniścayaḥ kṛtābhyanujñaḥ svajanena dharmavit ।
yathopadiṣṭaṃ bhujagendrasaṃśrayaṃ jagāma kāle sukṛtaikaniścayaḥ] ॥10॥
slp1: tataH sa vipraH kftaDarmaniScayaH kftAByanujYaH svajanena Darmavit । yaTopadizwaM BujagendrasaMSrayaM jagAma kAle sukftEkaniScayaH] ॥10॥

text: sa vanāni vicitrāṇi tīrthāni ca sarāṃsi ca । abhigacchankrameṇa sma kañcinmunimupasthitaḥ ॥1॥
html:
sa vanāni vicitrāṇi tīrthāni ca sarāṃsi ca ।
abhigacchankrameṇa sma kañcinmunimupasthitaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: sa vanAni vicitrARi tIrTAni ca sarAMsi ca । aBigacCankrameRa sma kaYcinmunimupasTitaH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: taṃ sa tena yathoddiṣṭaṃ nāgaṃ vipreṇa brāhmaṇaḥ । paryapṛcchadyathānyāyaṃ śrutvaiva ca jagāma saḥ ॥2॥
html:
taṃ sa tena yathoddiṣṭaṃ nāgaṃ vipreṇa brāhmaṇaḥ ।
paryapṛcchadyathānyāyaṃ śrutvaiva ca jagāma saḥ ॥2॥
slp1: taM sa tena yaToddizwaM nAgaM vipreRa brAhmaRaH । paryapfcCadyaTAnyAyaM SrutvEva ca jagAma saH ॥2॥

text: so'bhigamya yathākhyātaṃ nāgāyatanamarthavit । proktavānahamasmīti bhoḥśabdālaṅkṛtaṃ vacaḥ ॥3॥
html:
so'bhigamya yathākhyātaṃ nāgāyatanamarthavit ।
proktavānahamasmīti bhoḥśabdālaṅkṛtaṃ vacaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: so'Bigamya yaTAKyAtaM nAgAyatanamarTavit । proktavAnahamasmIti BoHSabdAlaNkftaM vacaH ॥3॥

text: tatastasya vacaḥ śrutvā rūpiṇī dharmavatsalā । darśayāmāsa taṃ vipraṃ nāgapatnī pativratā ॥4॥
html:
tatastasya vacaḥ śrutvā rūpiṇī dharmavatsalā ।
darśayāmāsa taṃ vipraṃ nāgapatnī pativratā ॥4॥
slp1: tatastasya vacaH SrutvA rUpiRI DarmavatsalA । darSayAmAsa taM vipraM nAgapatnI pativratA ॥4॥

text: sā tasmai vidhivatpūjāṃ cakre dharmaparāyaṇā । svāgatenāgataṃ kṛtvā kiṃ karomīti cābravīt ॥5॥
html:
sā tasmai vidhivatpūjāṃ cakre dharmaparāyaṇā ।
svāgatenāgataṃ kṛtvā kiṃ karomīti cābravīt ॥5॥
slp1: sA tasmE viDivatpUjAM cakre DarmaparAyaRA । svAgatenAgataM kftvA kiM karomIti cAbravIt ॥5॥

text: viśrānto'bhyarcitaścāsmi bhavatyā ślakṣṇayā girā । draṣṭumicchāmi bhavati taṃ devaṃ nāgamuttamam ॥6॥
html:
viśrānto'bhyarcitaścāsmi bhavatyā ślakṣṇayā girā ।
draṣṭumicchāmi bhavati taṃ devaṃ nāgamuttamam ॥6॥
slp1: viSrAnto'ByarcitaScAsmi BavatyA SlakzRayA girA । drazwumicCAmi Bavati taM devaM nAgamuttamam ॥6॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: etaddhi paramaṃ kāryametanme phalamīpsitam । anenārthena cāsmyadya samprāptaḥ pannagālayam ॥7॥
html:
etaddhi paramaṃ kāryametanme phalamīpsitam ।
anenārthena cāsmyadya samprāptaḥ pannagālayam ॥7॥
slp1: etadDi paramaM kAryametanme PalamIpsitam । anenArTena cAsmyadya samprAptaH pannagAlayam ॥7॥

text: ārya sūryarathaṃ voḍhuṃ gato'sau māsacārikaḥ । saptāṣṭabhirdinairvipra darśayiṣyatyasaṃśayam ॥8॥
html:
ārya sūryarathaṃ voḍhuṃ gato'sau māsacārikaḥ ।
saptāṣṭabhirdinairvipra darśayiṣyatyasaṃśayam ॥8॥
slp1: Arya sUryaraTaM voQuM gato'sO mAsacArikaH । saptAzwaBirdinErvipra darSayizyatyasaMSayam ॥8॥
author: nāgabhāryovāca ।

text: etadviditamāryasya vivāsakaraṇaṃ mama । bharturbhavatu kiṃ cānyatkriyatāṃ tadvadasva me ॥9॥
html:
etadviditamāryasya vivāsakaraṇaṃ mama ।
bharturbhavatu kiṃ cānyatkriyatāṃ tadvadasva me ॥9॥
slp1: etadviditamAryasya vivAsakaraRaM mama । BarturBavatu kiM cAnyatkriyatAM tadvadasva me ॥9॥

text: anena niścayenāhaṃ sādhvi samprāptavāniha । pratīkṣannāgamaṃ devi vatsyāmyasminmahāvane ॥10॥
html:
anena niścayenāhaṃ sādhvi samprāptavāniha ।
pratīkṣannāgamaṃ devi vatsyāmyasminmahāvane ॥10॥
slp1: anena niScayenAhaM sADvi samprAptavAniha । pratIkzannAgamaM devi vatsyAmyasminmahAvane ॥10॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: samprāptasyaiva cāvyagramāvedyo'hamihāgataḥ । mamābhigamanaṃ prāpto vācyaśca vacanaṃ tvayā ॥11॥
html:
samprāptasyaiva cāvyagramāvedyo'hamihāgataḥ ।
mamābhigamanaṃ prāpto vācyaśca vacanaṃ tvayā ॥11॥
slp1: samprAptasyEva cAvyagramAvedyo'hamihAgataH । mamABigamanaM prApto vAcyaSca vacanaM tvayA ॥11॥

text: ahamapyatra vatsyāmi gomatyāḥ puline śubhe । kālaṃ parimitāhāro yathoktaṃ paripālayan ॥12॥
html:
ahamapyatra vatsyāmi gomatyāḥ puline śubhe ।
kālaṃ parimitāhāro yathoktaṃ paripālayan ॥12॥
slp1: ahamapyatra vatsyAmi gomatyAH puline SuBe । kAlaM parimitAhAro yaToktaM paripAlayan ॥12॥

text: tataḥ sa viprastāṃ nāgīṃ samādhāya punaḥ punaḥ । tadeva pulinaṃ nadyāḥ prayayau brāhmaṇarṣabhaḥ] ॥13॥
html:
tataḥ sa viprastāṃ nāgīṃ samādhāya punaḥ punaḥ ।
tadeva pulinaṃ nadyāḥ prayayau brāhmaṇarṣabhaḥ] ॥13॥
slp1: tataH sa viprastAM nAgIM samADAya punaH punaH । tadeva pulinaM nadyAH prayayO brAhmaRarzaBaH] ॥13॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: atha tena naraśreṣṭha brāhmaṇena tapasvinā । nirāhāreṇa vasatā duḥkhitāste bhujaṅgamāḥ ॥1॥
html:
atha tena naraśreṣṭha brāhmaṇena tapasvinā ।
nirāhāreṇa vasatā duḥkhitāste bhujaṅgamāḥ ॥1॥
slp1: aTa tena naraSrezWa brAhmaRena tapasvinA । nirAhAreRa vasatA duHKitAste BujaNgamAH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sarve sambhūya sahitāstasya nāgasya bāndhavāḥ । bhrātarastanayā bhāryā yayus taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prati ॥2॥
html:
sarve sambhūya sahitāstasya nāgasya bāndhavāḥ ।
bhrātarastanayā bhāryā yayus taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prati ॥2॥
slp1: sarve samBUya sahitAstasya nAgasya bAnDavAH । BrAtarastanayA BAryA yayus taM brAhmaRaM prati ॥2॥

text: te'paśyanpuline taṃ vai vivikte niyatavratam । samāsīnaṃ nirāhāraṃ dvijaṃ japyaparāyaṇam ॥3॥
html:
te'paśyanpuline taṃ vai vivikte niyatavratam ।
samāsīnaṃ nirāhāraṃ dvijaṃ japyaparāyaṇam ॥3॥
slp1: te'paSyanpuline taM vE vivikte niyatavratam । samAsInaM nirAhAraM dvijaM japyaparAyaRam ॥3॥

text: te sarve samabhikramya vipramabhyarcya cāsakṛt । ūcurvākyamasandigdhamātitheyasya bāndhavāḥ ॥4॥
html:
te sarve samabhikramya vipramabhyarcya cāsakṛt ।
ūcurvākyamasandigdhamātitheyasya bāndhavāḥ ॥4॥
slp1: te sarve samaBikramya vipramaByarcya cAsakft । UcurvAkyamasandigDamAtiTeyasya bAnDavAH ॥4॥

text: ṣaṣṭho hi divasaste'dya prāptasyeha tapodhana । na cābhilaṣase kiñcidāhāraṃ dharmavatsala ॥5॥
html:
ṣaṣṭho hi divasaste'dya prāptasyeha tapodhana ।
na cābhilaṣase kiñcidāhāraṃ dharmavatsala ॥5॥
slp1: zazWo hi divasaste'dya prAptasyeha tapoDana । na cABilazase kiYcidAhAraM Darmavatsala ॥5॥

text: asmānabhigataścāsi vayaṃ ca tvāmupasthitāḥ । kāryaṃ cātithyamasmābhirvayaṃ sarve kuṭumbinaḥ ॥6॥
html:
asmānabhigataścāsi vayaṃ ca tvāmupasthitāḥ ।
kāryaṃ cātithyamasmābhirvayaṃ sarve kuṭumbinaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: asmAnaBigataScAsi vayaM ca tvAmupasTitAH । kAryaM cAtiTyamasmABirvayaM sarve kuwumbinaH ॥6॥

text: mūlaṃ phalaṃ vā parṇaṃ vā payo vā dvijasattama । āhārahetorannaṃ vā bhoktumarhasi brāhmaṇa ॥7॥
html:
mūlaṃ phalaṃ vā parṇaṃ vā payo vā dvijasattama ।
āhārahetorannaṃ vā bhoktumarhasi brāhmaṇa ॥7॥
slp1: mUlaM PalaM vA parRaM vA payo vA dvijasattama । AhArahetorannaM vA Boktumarhasi brAhmaRa ॥7॥

text: tyaktāhāreṇa bhavatā vane nivasatā satā । bālavṛddhamidaṃ sarvaṃ pīḍyate dharmasaṅkaṭāt ॥8॥
html:
tyaktāhāreṇa bhavatā vane nivasatā satā ।
bālavṛddhamidaṃ sarvaṃ pīḍyate dharmasaṅkaṭāt ॥8॥
slp1: tyaktAhAreRa BavatA vane nivasatA satA । bAlavfdDamidaM sarvaM pIqyate DarmasaNkawAt ॥8॥

text: na hi no bhrūṇahā kaścidrājāpathyo'nṛto'pi vā । pūrvāśī vā kule hyasmindevatātithibandhuṣu ॥9॥
html:
na hi no bhrūṇahā kaścidrājāpathyo'nṛto'pi vā ।
pūrvāśī vā kule hyasmindevatātithibandhuṣu ॥9॥
slp1: na hi no BrURahA kaScidrAjApaTyo'nfto'pi vA । pUrvASI vA kule hyasmindevatAtiTibanDuzu ॥9॥

text: upadeśena yuṣmākamāhāro'yaṃ mayā vṛtaḥ । dvirūnaṃ daśarātraṃ vai nāgasyāgamanaṃ prati ॥10॥
html:
upadeśena yuṣmākamāhāro'yaṃ mayā vṛtaḥ ।
dvirūnaṃ daśarātraṃ vai nāgasyāgamanaṃ prati ॥10॥
slp1: upadeSena yuzmAkamAhAro'yaM mayA vftaH । dvirUnaM daSarAtraM vE nAgasyAgamanaM prati ॥10॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: yadyaṣṭarātre niryāte nāgamiṣyati pannagaḥ । tadāhāraṃ kariṣyāmi tannimittamidaṃ vratam ॥11॥
html:
yadyaṣṭarātre niryāte nāgamiṣyati pannagaḥ ।
tadāhāraṃ kariṣyāmi tannimittamidaṃ vratam ॥11॥
slp1: yadyazwarAtre niryAte nAgamizyati pannagaH । tadAhAraM karizyAmi tannimittamidaM vratam ॥11॥

text: kartavyo na ca santāpo gamyatāṃ ca yathāgatam । tannimittaṃ vrataṃ mahyaṃ naitadbhettumihārhatha ॥12॥
html:
kartavyo na ca santāpo gamyatāṃ ca yathāgatam ।
tannimittaṃ vrataṃ mahyaṃ naitadbhettumihārhatha ॥12॥
slp1: kartavyo na ca santApo gamyatAM ca yaTAgatam । tannimittaM vrataM mahyaM nEtadBettumihArhaTa ॥12॥

text: tena te samanujñātā brāhmaṇena bhujaṅgamāḥ । svameva bhavanaṃ jagmurakṛtārthā nararṣabha] ॥13॥
html:
tena te samanujñātā brāhmaṇena bhujaṅgamāḥ ।
svameva bhavanaṃ jagmurakṛtārthā nararṣabha] ॥13॥
slp1: tena te samanujYAtA brAhmaRena BujaNgamAH । svameva BavanaM jagmurakftArTA nararzaBa] ॥13॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: atha kāle bahutithe pūrṇe prāpto bhujaṅgamaḥ । dattābhyanujñaḥ svaṃ veśma kṛtakarmā vivasvataḥ ॥1॥
html:
atha kāle bahutithe pūrṇe prāpto bhujaṅgamaḥ ।
dattābhyanujñaḥ svaṃ veśma kṛtakarmā vivasvataḥ ॥1॥
slp1: aTa kAle bahutiTe pUrRe prApto BujaNgamaH । dattAByanujYaH svaM veSma kftakarmA vivasvataH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: taṃ bhāryā samabhikrāmatpādaśaucādibhirguṇaiḥ । upapannāṃ ca tāṃ sādhvīṃ pannagaḥ paryapṛcchata ॥2॥
html:
taṃ bhāryā samabhikrāmatpādaśaucādibhirguṇaiḥ ।
upapannāṃ ca tāṃ sādhvīṃ pannagaḥ paryapṛcchata ॥2॥
slp1: taM BAryA samaBikrAmatpAdaSOcAdiBirguREH । upapannAM ca tAM sADvIM pannagaH paryapfcCata ॥2॥

text: api tvamasi kalyāṇi devatātithipūjane । pūrvamuktena vidhinā yuktā yuktena matsamam ॥3॥
html:
api tvamasi kalyāṇi devatātithipūjane ।
pūrvamuktena vidhinā yuktā yuktena matsamam ॥3॥
slp1: api tvamasi kalyARi devatAtiTipUjane । pUrvamuktena viDinA yuktA yuktena matsamam ॥3॥

text: na khalvasyakṛtārthena strībuddhyā mārdavīkṛtā । madviyogena suśroṇi viyuktā dharmasetunā ॥4॥
html:
na khalvasyakṛtārthena strībuddhyā mārdavīkṛtā ।
madviyogena suśroṇi viyuktā dharmasetunā ॥4॥
slp1: na KalvasyakftArTena strIbudDyA mArdavIkftA । madviyogena suSroRi viyuktA DarmasetunA ॥4॥

text: śiṣyāṇāṃ guruśuśrūṣā viprāṇāṃ vedapāraṇam । bhṛtyānāṃ svāmivacanaṃ rājñāṃ lokānupālanam ॥5॥
html:
śiṣyāṇāṃ guruśuśrūṣā viprāṇāṃ vedapāraṇam ।
bhṛtyānāṃ svāmivacanaṃ rājñāṃ lokānupālanam ॥5॥
slp1: SizyARAM guruSuSrUzA viprARAM vedapAraRam । BftyAnAM svAmivacanaM rAjYAM lokAnupAlanam ॥5॥
author: nāgabhāryovāca ।

text: sarvabhūtaparitrāṇaṃ kṣatradharma ihocyate । vaiśyānāṃ yajñasaṃvṛttirātitheyasamanvitā ॥6॥
html:
sarvabhūtaparitrāṇaṃ kṣatradharma ihocyate ।
vaiśyānāṃ yajñasaṃvṛttirātitheyasamanvitā ॥6॥
slp1: sarvaBUtaparitrARaM kzatraDarma ihocyate । vESyAnAM yajYasaMvfttirAtiTeyasamanvitA ॥6॥

text: viprakṣatriyavaiśyānāṃ śuśrūṣā śūdrakarma tat । gṛhasthadharmo nāgendra sarvabhūtahitaiṣitā ॥7॥
html:
viprakṣatriyavaiśyānāṃ śuśrūṣā śūdrakarma tat ।
gṛhasthadharmo nāgendra sarvabhūtahitaiṣitā ॥7॥
slp1: viprakzatriyavESyAnAM SuSrUzA SUdrakarma tat । gfhasTaDarmo nAgendra sarvaBUtahitEzitA ॥7॥

text: niyatāhāratā nityaṃ vratacaryā yathākramam । dharmo hi dharmasambandhādindriyāṇāṃ viśeṣaṇam ॥8॥
html:
niyatāhāratā nityaṃ vratacaryā yathākramam ।
dharmo hi dharmasambandhādindriyāṇāṃ viśeṣaṇam ॥8॥
slp1: niyatAhAratA nityaM vratacaryA yaTAkramam । Darmo hi DarmasambanDAdindriyARAM viSezaRam ॥8॥

text: ahaṃ kasya kuto vāhaṃ kaḥ ko me ha bhavediti । prayojanamatirnityamevaṃ mokṣāśramī bhavet ॥9॥
html:
ahaṃ kasya kuto vāhaṃ kaḥ ko me ha bhavediti ।
prayojanamatirnityamevaṃ mokṣāśramī bhavet ॥9॥
slp1: ahaM kasya kuto vAhaM kaH ko me ha Bavediti । prayojanamatirnityamevaM mokzASramI Bavet ॥9॥

text: pativratātvaṃ bhāryāyāḥ paramo dharma ucyate । tavopadeśānnāgendra tacca tattvena vedmi vai ॥10॥
html:
pativratātvaṃ bhāryāyāḥ paramo dharma ucyate ।
tavopadeśānnāgendra tacca tattvena vedmi vai ॥10॥
slp1: pativratAtvaM BAryAyAH paramo Darma ucyate । tavopadeSAnnAgendra tacca tattvena vedmi vE ॥10॥

text: sāhaṃ dharmaṃ vijānantī dharmanitye tvayi sthite । satpathaṃ kathamutsṛjya yāsyāmi viṣame pathi ॥11॥
html:
sāhaṃ dharmaṃ vijānantī dharmanitye tvayi sthite ।
satpathaṃ kathamutsṛjya yāsyāmi viṣame pathi ॥11॥
slp1: sAhaM DarmaM vijAnantI Darmanitye tvayi sTite । satpaTaM kaTamutsfjya yAsyAmi vizame paTi ॥11॥

text: devatānāṃ mahābhāga dharmacaryā na hīyate । atithīnāṃ ca satkāre nityayuktāsmyatandritā ॥12॥
html:
devatānāṃ mahābhāga dharmacaryā na hīyate ।
atithīnāṃ ca satkāre nityayuktāsmyatandritā ॥12॥
slp1: devatAnAM mahABAga DarmacaryA na hIyate । atiTInAM ca satkAre nityayuktAsmyatandritA ॥12॥

text: saptāṣṭadivasāstvadya viprasyehāgatasya vai । sa ca kāryaṃ na me khyāti darśanaṃ tava kāṅkṣati ॥13॥
html:
saptāṣṭadivasāstvadya viprasyehāgatasya vai ।
sa ca kāryaṃ na me khyāti darśanaṃ tava kāṅkṣati ॥13॥
slp1: saptAzwadivasAstvadya viprasyehAgatasya vE । sa ca kAryaM na me KyAti darSanaM tava kANkzati ॥13॥

text: gomatyāstveṣa puline tvaddarśanasamutsukaḥ । āsīno''vartayanbrahma brāhmaṇaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ ॥14॥
html:
gomatyāstveṣa puline tvaddarśanasamutsukaḥ ।
āsīno''vartayanbrahma brāhmaṇaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ ॥14॥
slp1: gomatyAstveza puline tvaddarSanasamutsukaH । AsIno''vartayanbrahma brAhmaRaH saMSitavrataH ॥14॥

text: ahaṃ tvanena nāgendra sāmapūrvaṃ samāhitā । prasthāpyo matsakāśaṃ sa samprāpto bhujagottamaḥ ॥15॥
html:
ahaṃ tvanena nāgendra sāmapūrvaṃ samāhitā ।
prasthāpyo matsakāśaṃ sa samprāpto bhujagottamaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: ahaM tvanena nAgendra sAmapUrvaM samAhitA । prasTApyo matsakASaM sa samprApto BujagottamaH ॥15॥

text: etacchrutvā mahāprājña tatra gantuṃ tvamarhasi । dātumarhasi vā tasya darśanaṃ darśanaśravaḥ] ॥16॥
html:
etacchrutvā mahāprājña tatra gantuṃ tvamarhasi ।
dātumarhasi vā tasya darśanaṃ darśanaśravaḥ] ॥16॥
slp1: etacCrutvA mahAprAjYa tatra gantuM tvamarhasi । dAtumarhasi vA tasya darSanaM darSanaSravaH] ॥16॥

text: atha brāhmaṇarūpeṇa kaṃ taṃ samanupaśyasi । mānuṣaṃ kevalaṃ vipraṃ devaṃ vātha śucismite ॥1॥
html:
atha brāhmaṇarūpeṇa kaṃ taṃ samanupaśyasi ।
mānuṣaṃ kevalaṃ vipraṃ devaṃ vātha śucismite ॥1॥
slp1: aTa brAhmaRarUpeRa kaM taM samanupaSyasi । mAnuzaM kevalaM vipraM devaM vATa Sucismite ॥1॥
author: nāga uvāca ।

text: ko hi māṃ mānuṣaḥ śakto draṣṭukāmo yaśasvini । sandarśanarucirvākyamājñāpūrvaṃ vadiṣyati ॥2॥
html:
ko hi māṃ mānuṣaḥ śakto draṣṭukāmo yaśasvini ।
sandarśanarucirvākyamājñāpūrvaṃ vadiṣyati ॥2॥
slp1: ko hi mAM mAnuzaH Sakto drazwukAmo yaSasvini । sandarSanarucirvAkyamAjYApUrvaM vadizyati ॥2॥

text: surāsuragaṇānāṃ ca devarṣīṇāṃ ca bhāmini । nanu nāgā mahāvīryāḥ sauraseyāstarasvinaḥ ॥3॥
html:
surāsuragaṇānāṃ ca devarṣīṇāṃ ca bhāmini ।
nanu nāgā mahāvīryāḥ sauraseyāstarasvinaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: surAsuragaRAnAM ca devarzIRAM ca BAmini । nanu nAgA mahAvIryAH sOraseyAstarasvinaH ॥3॥

text: vandanīyāśca varadā vayamapyanuyāyinaḥ । manuṣyāṇāṃ viśeṣeṇa dhanādhyakṣā iti śrutiḥ ॥4॥
html:
vandanīyāśca varadā vayamapyanuyāyinaḥ ।
manuṣyāṇāṃ viśeṣeṇa dhanādhyakṣā iti śrutiḥ ॥4॥
slp1: vandanIyASca varadA vayamapyanuyAyinaH । manuzyARAM viSezeRa DanADyakzA iti SrutiH ॥4॥

text: ārjavenābhijānāmi nāsau devo'nilāśana । ekaṃ tvasya vijānāmi bhaktimānatiroṣaṇaḥ ॥5॥
html:
ārjavenābhijānāmi nāsau devo'nilāśana ।
ekaṃ tvasya vijānāmi bhaktimānatiroṣaṇaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: ArjavenABijAnAmi nAsO devo'nilASana । ekaM tvasya vijAnAmi BaktimAnatirozaRaH ॥5॥
author: nāgabhāryovāca ।

text: sa hi kāryāntarākāṅkṣī jalepsuḥ stokako yathā । varṣaṃ varṣapriyaḥ pakṣī darśanaṃ tava kāṅkṣati ॥6॥
html:
sa hi kāryāntarākāṅkṣī jalepsuḥ stokako yathā ।
varṣaṃ varṣapriyaḥ pakṣī darśanaṃ tava kāṅkṣati ॥6॥
slp1: sa hi kAryAntarAkANkzI jalepsuH stokako yaTA । varzaM varzapriyaH pakzI darSanaM tava kANkzati ॥6॥

text: na hi tvā daivataṃ kiñcidvivignaṃ pratipālayet । tulye hyabhijane jāto na kaścitparyupāsate ॥7॥
html:
na hi tvā daivataṃ kiñcidvivignaṃ pratipālayet ।
tulye hyabhijane jāto na kaścitparyupāsate ॥7॥
slp1: na hi tvA dEvataM kiYcidvivignaM pratipAlayet । tulye hyaBijane jAto na kaScitparyupAsate ॥7॥

text: tadroṣaṃ sahajaṃ tyaktvā tvamenaṃ draṣṭumarhasi । āśāchedena tasyādya nātmānaṃ dagdhumarhasi ॥8॥
html:
tadroṣaṃ sahajaṃ tyaktvā tvamenaṃ draṣṭumarhasi ।
āśāchedena tasyādya nātmānaṃ dagdhumarhasi ॥8॥
slp1: tadrozaM sahajaM tyaktvA tvamenaM drazwumarhasi । ASACedena tasyAdya nAtmAnaM dagDumarhasi ॥8॥

text: āśayā tvabhipannānāmakṛtvāśrupramārjanam । rājā vā rājaputro vā bhrūṇahatyaiva yujyate ॥9॥
html:
āśayā tvabhipannānāmakṛtvāśrupramārjanam ।
rājā vā rājaputro vā bhrūṇahatyaiva yujyate ॥9॥
slp1: ASayA tvaBipannAnAmakftvASrupramArjanam । rAjA vA rAjaputro vA BrURahatyEva yujyate ॥9॥

text: maunājjñānaphalāvāptirdānena ca yaśo mahat । vāgmitvaṃ satyavākyena paratra ca mahīyate ॥10॥
html:
maunājjñānaphalāvāptirdānena ca yaśo mahat ।
vāgmitvaṃ satyavākyena paratra ca mahīyate ॥10॥
slp1: mOnAjjYAnaPalAvAptirdAnena ca yaSo mahat । vAgmitvaM satyavAkyena paratra ca mahIyate ॥10॥

text: bhūmipradānena gatiṃ labhatyāśramasammitām । naṣṭasyārthasya samprāptiṃ kṛtvā phalamupāśnute ॥11॥
html:
bhūmipradānena gatiṃ labhatyāśramasammitām ।
naṣṭasyārthasya samprāptiṃ kṛtvā phalamupāśnute ॥11॥
slp1: BUmipradAnena gatiM laBatyASramasammitAm । nazwasyArTasya samprAptiM kftvA PalamupASnute ॥11॥

text: abhipretāmasaṅkliṣṭāṃ kṛtvākāmavatīṃ kriyām । na yāti nirayaṃ kaściditi dharmavido viduḥ ॥12॥
html:
abhipretāmasaṅkliṣṭāṃ kṛtvākāmavatīṃ kriyām ।
na yāti nirayaṃ kaściditi dharmavido viduḥ ॥12॥
slp1: aBipretAmasaNklizwAM kftvAkAmavatIM kriyAm । na yAti nirayaM kaSciditi Darmavido viduH ॥12॥

text: abhimānena māno me jātidoṣeṇa vai mahān । roṣaḥ saṅkalpajaḥ sādhvi dagdho vācāgninā tvayā ॥13॥
html:
abhimānena māno me jātidoṣeṇa vai mahān ।
roṣaḥ saṅkalpajaḥ sādhvi dagdho vācāgninā tvayā ॥13॥
slp1: aBimAnena mAno me jAtidozeRa vE mahAn । rozaH saNkalpajaH sADvi dagDo vAcAgninA tvayA ॥13॥
author: nāga uvāca ।

text: na ca roṣādahaṃ sādhvi paśyeyamadhikaṃ tamaḥ । yasya vaktavyatāṃ yānti viśeṣeṇa bhujaṅgamāḥ ॥14॥
html:
na ca roṣādahaṃ sādhvi paśyeyamadhikaṃ tamaḥ ।
yasya vaktavyatāṃ yānti viśeṣeṇa bhujaṅgamāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: na ca rozAdahaM sADvi paSyeyamaDikaM tamaH । yasya vaktavyatAM yAnti viSezeRa BujaNgamAH ॥14॥

text: doṣasya hi vaśaṃ gatvā daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān । tathā śakrapratispardhī hato rāmeṇa saṃyuge ॥15॥
html:
doṣasya hi vaśaṃ gatvā daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān ।
tathā śakrapratispardhī hato rāmeṇa saṃyuge ॥15॥
slp1: dozasya hi vaSaM gatvA daSagrIvaH pratApavAn । taTA SakrapratisparDI hato rAmeRa saMyuge ॥15॥

text: antaḥpuragataṃ vatsaṃ śrutvā rāmeṇa nirhṛtam । dharṣaṇādroṣasaṃvignāḥ kārtavīryasutā hatāḥ ॥16॥
html:
antaḥpuragataṃ vatsaṃ śrutvā rāmeṇa nirhṛtam ।
dharṣaṇādroṣasaṃvignāḥ kārtavīryasutā hatāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: antaHpuragataM vatsaM SrutvA rAmeRa nirhftam । DarzaRAdrozasaMvignAH kArtavIryasutA hatAH ॥16॥

text: jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa sahasranayanopamaḥ । saṃyuge nihato roṣātkārtavīryo mahābalaḥ ॥17॥
html:
jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa sahasranayanopamaḥ ।
saṃyuge nihato roṣātkārtavīryo mahābalaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: jAmadagnyena rAmeRa sahasranayanopamaH । saMyuge nihato rozAtkArtavIryo mahAbalaH ॥17॥

text: tadeṣa tapasāṃ śatruḥ śreyasaśca nipātanaḥ । nigṛhīto mayā roṣaḥ śrutvaiva vacanaṃ tava ॥18॥
html:
tadeṣa tapasāṃ śatruḥ śreyasaśca nipātanaḥ ।
nigṛhīto mayā roṣaḥ śrutvaiva vacanaṃ tava ॥18॥
slp1: tadeza tapasAM SatruH SreyasaSca nipAtanaH । nigfhIto mayA rozaH SrutvEva vacanaM tava ॥18॥

text: ātmānaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa praśaṃsāmyanapāyini । yasya me tvaṃ viśālākṣi bhāryā sarvaguṇānvitā ॥19॥
html:
ātmānaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa praśaṃsāmyanapāyini ।
yasya me tvaṃ viśālākṣi bhāryā sarvaguṇānvitā ॥19॥
slp1: AtmAnaM ca viSezeRa praSaMsAmyanapAyini । yasya me tvaM viSAlAkzi BAryA sarvaguRAnvitA ॥19॥

text: eṣa tatraiva gacchāmi yatra tiṣṭhatyasau dvijaḥ । sarvathā coktavānvākyaṃ nākṛtārthaḥ prayāsyati] ॥20॥
html:
eṣa tatraiva gacchāmi yatra tiṣṭhatyasau dvijaḥ ।
sarvathā coktavānvākyaṃ nākṛtārthaḥ prayāsyati] ॥20॥
slp1: eza tatrEva gacCAmi yatra tizWatyasO dvijaH । sarvaTA coktavAnvAkyaM nAkftArTaH prayAsyati] ॥20॥

text: sa pannagapatistatra prayayau brāhmaṇaṃ prati । tameva manasā dhyāyankāryavattāṃ vicārayan ॥1॥
html:
sa pannagapatistatra prayayau brāhmaṇaṃ prati ।
tameva manasā dhyāyankāryavattāṃ vicārayan ॥1॥
slp1: sa pannagapatistatra prayayO brAhmaRaM prati । tameva manasA DyAyankAryavattAM vicArayan ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tamabhikramya nāgendro matimānsa nareśvara । provāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ prakṛtyā dharmavatsalaḥ ॥2॥
html:
tamabhikramya nāgendro matimānsa nareśvara ।
provāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ prakṛtyā dharmavatsalaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: tamaBikramya nAgendro matimAnsa nareSvara । provAca maDuraM vAkyaM prakftyA DarmavatsalaH ॥2॥

text: bho bho kṣāmyābhibhāṣe tvāṃ na roṣaṃ kartumarhasi । iha tvamabhisamprāptaḥ kasyārthe kiṃ prayojanam ॥3॥
html:
bho bho kṣāmyābhibhāṣe tvāṃ na roṣaṃ kartumarhasi ।
iha tvamabhisamprāptaḥ kasyārthe kiṃ prayojanam ॥3॥
slp1: Bo Bo kzAmyABiBAze tvAM na rozaM kartumarhasi । iha tvamaBisamprAptaH kasyArTe kiM prayojanam ॥3॥

text: ābhimukhyādabhikramya snehātpṛcchāmi te dvija । vivikte gomatītīre kiṃ vā tvaṃ paryupāsase ॥4॥
html:
ābhimukhyādabhikramya snehātpṛcchāmi te dvija ।
vivikte gomatītīre kiṃ vā tvaṃ paryupāsase ॥4॥
slp1: ABimuKyAdaBikramya snehAtpfcCAmi te dvija । vivikte gomatItIre kiM vA tvaM paryupAsase ॥4॥

text: dharmāraṇyaṃ hi māṃ viddhi nāgaṃ draṣṭumihāgatam । padmanābhaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ tatra me kāryamāhitam ॥5॥
html:
dharmāraṇyaṃ hi māṃ viddhi nāgaṃ draṣṭumihāgatam ।
padmanābhaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ tatra me kāryamāhitam ॥5॥
slp1: DarmAraRyaM hi mAM vidDi nAgaM drazwumihAgatam । padmanABaM dvijaSrezWaM tatra me kAryamAhitam ॥5॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: tasya cāhamasānnidhyaṃ śrutavānasmi taṃ gatam । svajanaṃ taṃ pratīkṣāmi parjanyamiva karṣakaḥ ॥6॥
html:
tasya cāhamasānnidhyaṃ śrutavānasmi taṃ gatam ।
svajanaṃ taṃ pratīkṣāmi parjanyamiva karṣakaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: tasya cAhamasAnniDyaM SrutavAnasmi taM gatam । svajanaM taM pratIkzAmi parjanyamiva karzakaH ॥6॥

text: tasya cākleśakaraṇaṃ svastikārasamāhitam । vartayāmyayutaṃ brahma yogayukto nirāmayaḥ ॥7॥
html:
tasya cākleśakaraṇaṃ svastikārasamāhitam ।
vartayāmyayutaṃ brahma yogayukto nirāmayaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: tasya cAkleSakaraRaM svastikArasamAhitam । vartayAmyayutaM brahma yogayukto nirAmayaH ॥7॥

text: aho kalyāṇavṛttastvaṃ sādhu sajjanavatsalaḥ । śravāḍhyastvaṃ mahābhāga paraṃ snehena paśyasi ॥8॥
html:
aho kalyāṇavṛttastvaṃ sādhu sajjanavatsalaḥ ।
śravāḍhyastvaṃ mahābhāga paraṃ snehena paśyasi ॥8॥
slp1: aho kalyARavfttastvaM sADu sajjanavatsalaH । SravAQyastvaM mahABAga paraM snehena paSyasi ॥8॥
author: nāga uvāca ।

text: ahaṃ sa nāgo viprarṣe yathā māṃ vindate bhavān । ājñāpaya yathā svairaṃ kiṃ karomi priyaṃ tava ॥9॥
html:
ahaṃ sa nāgo viprarṣe yathā māṃ vindate bhavān ।
ājñāpaya yathā svairaṃ kiṃ karomi priyaṃ tava ॥9॥
slp1: ahaM sa nAgo viprarze yaTA mAM vindate BavAn । AjYApaya yaTA svEraM kiM karomi priyaM tava ॥9॥

text: bhavantaṃ svajanādasmi samprāptaṃ śrutavāniha । atastvāṃ svayamevāhaṃ draṣṭumabhyāgato dvija ॥10॥
html:
bhavantaṃ svajanādasmi samprāptaṃ śrutavāniha ।
atastvāṃ svayamevāhaṃ draṣṭumabhyāgato dvija ॥10॥
slp1: BavantaM svajanAdasmi samprAptaM SrutavAniha । atastvAM svayamevAhaM drazwumaByAgato dvija ॥10॥

text: samprāptaśca bhavānadya kṛtārthaḥ pratiyāsyati । visrabdho māṃ dvijaśreṣṭha viṣaye yoktumarhasi ॥11॥
html:
samprāptaśca bhavānadya kṛtārthaḥ pratiyāsyati ।
visrabdho māṃ dvijaśreṣṭha viṣaye yoktumarhasi ॥11॥
slp1: samprAptaSca BavAnadya kftArTaH pratiyAsyati । visrabDo mAM dvijaSrezWa vizaye yoktumarhasi ॥11॥

text: vayaṃ hi bhavatā sarve guṇakrītā viśeṣataḥ । yastvamātmahitaṃ tyaktvā māmevehānurudhyase ॥12॥
html:
vayaṃ hi bhavatā sarve guṇakrītā viśeṣataḥ ।
yastvamātmahitaṃ tyaktvā māmevehānurudhyase ॥12॥
slp1: vayaM hi BavatA sarve guRakrItA viSezataH । yastvamAtmahitaM tyaktvA mAmevehAnuruDyase ॥12॥

text: āgato'haṃ mahābhāga tava darśanalālasaḥ । kañcidarthamanarthajñaḥ praṣṭukāmo bhujaṅgama ॥13॥
html:
āgato'haṃ mahābhāga tava darśanalālasaḥ ।
kañcidarthamanarthajñaḥ praṣṭukāmo bhujaṅgama ॥13॥
slp1: Agato'haM mahABAga tava darSanalAlasaH । kaYcidarTamanarTajYaH prazwukAmo BujaNgama ॥13॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: ahamātmānamātmastho mārgamāṇo''tmano hitam । vāsārthinaṃ mahāprājña balavantamupāsmi ha ॥14॥
html:
ahamātmānamātmastho mārgamāṇo''tmano hitam ।
vāsārthinaṃ mahāprājña balavantamupāsmi ha ॥14॥
slp1: ahamAtmAnamAtmasTo mArgamARo''tmano hitam । vAsArTinaM mahAprAjYa balavantamupAsmi ha ॥14॥

text: prakāśitastvaṃ svaguṇairyaśogarbhagabhastibhiḥ । śaśāṅkakarasaṃsparśairhṛdyairātmaprakāśitaiḥ ॥15॥
html:
prakāśitastvaṃ svaguṇairyaśogarbhagabhastibhiḥ ।
śaśāṅkakarasaṃsparśairhṛdyairātmaprakāśitaiḥ ॥15॥
slp1: prakASitastvaM svaguREryaSogarBagaBastiBiH । SaSANkakarasaMsparSErhfdyErAtmaprakASitEH ॥15॥

text: tasya me praśnamutpannaṃ chindhi tvamanilāśana । paścātkāryaṃ vadiṣyāmi śrotumarhati me bhavān] ॥16॥
html:
tasya me praśnamutpannaṃ chindhi tvamanilāśana ।
paścātkāryaṃ vadiṣyāmi śrotumarhati me bhavān] ॥16॥
slp1: tasya me praSnamutpannaM CinDi tvamanilASana । paScAtkAryaM vadizyAmi Srotumarhati me BavAn] ॥16॥

text: vivasvato gacchati paryayeṇa voḍhuṃ bhavāṃstaṃ rathamekacakram । āścaryabhūtaṃ yadi tatra kiṃ ciddṛṣṭaṃ tvayā śaṃsitumarhasi tvam ॥1॥
html:
vivasvato gacchati paryayeṇa voḍhuṃ bhavāṃstaṃ rathamekacakram ।
āścaryabhūtaṃ yadi tatra kiṃ ciddṛṣṭaṃ tvayā śaṃsitumarhasi tvam ॥1॥
slp1: vivasvato gacCati paryayeRa voQuM BavAMstaM raTamekacakram । AScaryaBUtaM yadi tatra kiM ciddfzwaM tvayA SaMsitumarhasi tvam ॥1॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: yasya raśmisahasreṣu śākhāsviva vihaṅgamāḥ । vasantyāśritya munayaḥ saṃsiddhā daivataiḥ saha ॥2॥
html:
yasya raśmisahasreṣu śākhāsviva vihaṅgamāḥ ।
vasantyāśritya munayaḥ saṃsiddhā daivataiḥ saha ॥2॥
slp1: yasya raSmisahasrezu SAKAsviva vihaNgamAH । vasantyASritya munayaH saMsidDA dEvatEH saha ॥2॥
author: nāga uvāca ।

text: yato vāyurviniḥsṛtya sūryaraśmyāśrito mahān । vijṛmbhatyambare vipra kimāścaryataraṃ tataḥ ॥3॥
html:
yato vāyurviniḥsṛtya sūryaraśmyāśrito mahān ।
vijṛmbhatyambare vipra kimāścaryataraṃ tataḥ ॥3॥
slp1: yato vAyurviniHsftya sUryaraSmyASrito mahAn । vijfmBatyambare vipra kimAScaryataraM tataH ॥3॥

text: śukro nāmāsitaḥ pādo yasya vāridharo'mbare । toyaṃ sṛjati varṣāsu kimāścaryamataḥ param ॥4॥
html:
śukro nāmāsitaḥ pādo yasya vāridharo'mbare ।
toyaṃ sṛjati varṣāsu kimāścaryamataḥ param ॥4॥
slp1: Sukro nAmAsitaH pAdo yasya vAriDaro'mbare । toyaM sfjati varzAsu kimAScaryamataH param ॥4॥

text: yo'ṣṭamāsāṃstu śucinā kiraṇenojjhitaṃ payaḥ । paryādatte punaḥ kāle kimāścaryamataḥ param ॥5॥
html:
yo'ṣṭamāsāṃstu śucinā kiraṇenojjhitaṃ payaḥ ।
paryādatte punaḥ kāle kimāścaryamataḥ param ॥5॥
slp1: yo'zwamAsAMstu SucinA kiraRenojJitaM payaH । paryAdatte punaH kAle kimAScaryamataH param ॥5॥

text: yasya tejoviśeṣeṣu nityamātmā pratiṣṭhitaḥ । yato bījaṃ mahī ceyaṃ dhāryate sacarācaram ॥6॥
html:
yasya tejoviśeṣeṣu nityamātmā pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।
yato bījaṃ mahī ceyaṃ dhāryate sacarācaram ॥6॥
slp1: yasya tejoviSezezu nityamAtmA pratizWitaH । yato bIjaM mahI ceyaM DAryate sacarAcaram ॥6॥

text: yatra devo mahābāhuḥ śāśvataḥ paramo'kṣaraḥ । anādinidhano vipra kimāścaryamataḥ param ॥7॥
html:
yatra devo mahābāhuḥ śāśvataḥ paramo'kṣaraḥ ।
anādinidhano vipra kimāścaryamataḥ param ॥7॥
slp1: yatra devo mahAbAhuH SASvataH paramo'kzaraH । anAdiniDano vipra kimAScaryamataH param ॥7॥

text: āścaryāṇāmivāścaryamidamekaṃ tu me śṛṇu । vimale yanmayā dṛṣṭamambare sūryasaṃśrayāt ॥8॥
html:
āścaryāṇāmivāścaryamidamekaṃ tu me śṛṇu ।
vimale yanmayā dṛṣṭamambare sūryasaṃśrayāt ॥8॥
slp1: AScaryARAmivAScaryamidamekaM tu me SfRu । vimale yanmayA dfzwamambare sUryasaMSrayAt ॥8॥

text: purā madhyāhnasamaye lokāṃstapati bhāskare । pratyādityapratīkāśaḥ sarvataḥ pratyadṛśyata ॥9॥
html:
purā madhyāhnasamaye lokāṃstapati bhāskare ।
pratyādityapratīkāśaḥ sarvataḥ pratyadṛśyata ॥9॥
slp1: purA maDyAhnasamaye lokAMstapati BAskare । pratyAdityapratIkASaH sarvataH pratyadfSyata ॥9॥

text: sa lokāṃstejasā sarvānsvabhāsā nirvibhāsayan । ādityābhimukho'bhyeti gaganaṃ pāṭayanniva ॥10॥
html:
sa lokāṃstejasā sarvānsvabhāsā nirvibhāsayan ।
ādityābhimukho'bhyeti gaganaṃ pāṭayanniva ॥10॥
slp1: sa lokAMstejasA sarvAnsvaBAsA nirviBAsayan । AdityABimuKo'Byeti gaganaM pAwayanniva ॥10॥

text: hutāhutiriva jyotirvyāpya tejomarīcibhiḥ । anirdeśyena rūpeṇa dvitīya iva bhāskaraḥ ॥11॥
html:
hutāhutiriva jyotirvyāpya tejomarīcibhiḥ ।
anirdeśyena rūpeṇa dvitīya iva bhāskaraḥ ॥11॥
slp1: hutAhutiriva jyotirvyApya tejomarIciBiH । anirdeSyena rUpeRa dvitIya iva BAskaraH ॥11॥

text: tasyābhigamanaprāptau hasto datto vivasvatā । tenāpi dakṣiṇo hasto dattaḥ pratyarcanārthinā ॥12॥
html:
tasyābhigamanaprāptau hasto datto vivasvatā ।
tenāpi dakṣiṇo hasto dattaḥ pratyarcanārthinā ॥12॥
slp1: tasyABigamanaprAptO hasto datto vivasvatA । tenApi dakziRo hasto dattaH pratyarcanArTinA ॥12॥

text: tato bhittvaiva gaganaṃ praviṣṭo ravimaṇḍalam । ekībhūtaṃ ca tattejaḥ kṣaṇenādityatāṃ gatam ॥13॥
html:
tato bhittvaiva gaganaṃ praviṣṭo ravimaṇḍalam ।
ekībhūtaṃ ca tattejaḥ kṣaṇenādityatāṃ gatam ॥13॥
slp1: tato BittvEva gaganaM pravizwo ravimaRqalam । ekIBUtaM ca tattejaH kzaRenAdityatAM gatam ॥13॥

text: tatra naḥ saṃśayo jātastayostejaḥsamāgame । anayoḥ ko bhavetsūryo rathastho yo'yamāgataḥ ॥14॥
html:
tatra naḥ saṃśayo jātastayostejaḥsamāgame ।
anayoḥ ko bhavetsūryo rathastho yo'yamāgataḥ ॥14॥
slp1: tatra naH saMSayo jAtastayostejaHsamAgame । anayoH ko BavetsUryo raTasTo yo'yamAgataH ॥14॥

text: te vayaṃ jātasandehāḥ paryapṛcchāmahe ravim । ka eṣa divamākramya gataḥ sūrya ivāparaḥ] ॥15॥
html:
te vayaṃ jātasandehāḥ paryapṛcchāmahe ravim ।
ka eṣa divamākramya gataḥ sūrya ivāparaḥ] ॥15॥
slp1: te vayaM jAtasandehAH paryapfcCAmahe ravim । ka eza divamAkramya gataH sUrya ivAparaH] ॥15॥

text: naiṣa devo'nilasakho nāsuro na ca pannagaḥ । uñchavṛttivrate siddho munireṣa divaṃ gataḥ ॥1॥
html:
naiṣa devo'nilasakho nāsuro na ca pannagaḥ ।
uñchavṛttivrate siddho munireṣa divaṃ gataḥ ॥1॥
slp1: nEza devo'nilasaKo nAsuro na ca pannagaH । uYCavfttivrate sidDo munireza divaM gataH ॥1॥
author: sūrya uvāca ।

text: eṣa mūlaphalāhāraḥ śīrṇaparṇāśanastathā । abbhakṣo vāyubhakṣaśca āsīdvipraḥ samāhitaḥ ॥2॥
html:
eṣa mūlaphalāhāraḥ śīrṇaparṇāśanastathā ।
abbhakṣo vāyubhakṣaśca āsīdvipraḥ samāhitaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: eza mUlaPalAhAraH SIrRaparRASanastaTA । abBakzo vAyuBakzaSca AsIdvipraH samAhitaH ॥2॥

text: ṛcaścānena vipreṇa saṃhitāntarabhiṣṭutāḥ । svargadvārakṛtodyogo yenāsau tridivaṃ gataḥ ॥3॥
html:
ṛcaścānena vipreṇa saṃhitāntarabhiṣṭutāḥ ।
svargadvārakṛtodyogo yenāsau tridivaṃ gataḥ ॥3॥
slp1: fcaScAnena vipreRa saMhitAntaraBizwutAH । svargadvArakftodyogo yenAsO tridivaM gataH ॥3॥

text: asannadhīranākāṅkṣī nityamuñchaśilāśanaḥ । sarvabhūtahite yukta eṣa vipro bhujaṅgama ॥4॥
html:
asannadhīranākāṅkṣī nityamuñchaśilāśanaḥ ।
sarvabhūtahite yukta eṣa vipro bhujaṅgama ॥4॥
slp1: asannaDIranAkANkzI nityamuYCaSilASanaH । sarvaBUtahite yukta eza vipro BujaNgama ॥4॥

text: na hi devā na gandharvā nāsurā na ca pannagāḥ । prabhavantīha bhūtānāṃ prāptānāṃ paramāṃ gatim ॥5॥
html:
na hi devā na gandharvā nāsurā na ca pannagāḥ ।
prabhavantīha bhūtānāṃ prāptānāṃ paramāṃ gatim ॥5॥
slp1: na hi devA na ganDarvA nAsurA na ca pannagAH । praBavantIha BUtAnAM prAptAnAM paramAM gatim ॥5॥

text: etadevaṃvidhaṃ dṛṣṭamāścaryaṃ tatra me dvija । saṃsiddho mānuṣaḥ kāyo yo'sau siddhagatiṃ gataḥ । sūryeṇa sahito brahmanpṛthivīṃ parivartate] ॥6॥
html:
etadevaṃvidhaṃ dṛṣṭamāścaryaṃ tatra me dvija ।
saṃsiddho mānuṣaḥ kāyo yo'sau siddhagatiṃ gataḥ ।
sūryeṇa sahito brahmanpṛthivīṃ parivartate] ॥6॥
slp1: etadevaMviDaM dfzwamAScaryaM tatra me dvija । saMsidDo mAnuzaH kAyo yo'sO sidDagatiM gataH । sUryeRa sahito brahmanpfTivIM parivartate] ॥6॥
author: nāga uvāca ।

text: āścaryaṃ nātra sandehaḥ suprīto'smi bhujaṅgama । anvarthopagatairvākyaiḥ panthānaṃ cāsmi darśitaḥ ॥1॥
html:
āścaryaṃ nātra sandehaḥ suprīto'smi bhujaṅgama ।
anvarthopagatairvākyaiḥ panthānaṃ cāsmi darśitaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: AScaryaM nAtra sandehaH suprIto'smi BujaNgama । anvarTopagatErvAkyEH panTAnaM cAsmi darSitaH ॥1॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi sādho bhujagasattama । smaraṇīyo'smi bhavatā sampreṣaṇaniyojanaiḥ ॥2॥
html:
svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi sādho bhujagasattama ।
smaraṇīyo'smi bhavatā sampreṣaṇaniyojanaiḥ ॥2॥
slp1: svasti te'stu gamizyAmi sADo Bujagasattama । smaraRIyo'smi BavatA samprezaRaniyojanEH ॥2॥

text: anuktvā madgataṃ kāryaṃ kvedānīṃ prasthito bhavān । ucyatāṃ dvija yatkāryaṃ yadarthaṃ tvamihāgataḥ ॥3॥
html:
anuktvā madgataṃ kāryaṃ kvedānīṃ prasthito bhavān ।
ucyatāṃ dvija yatkāryaṃ yadarthaṃ tvamihāgataḥ ॥3॥
slp1: anuktvA madgataM kAryaM kvedAnIM prasTito BavAn । ucyatAM dvija yatkAryaM yadarTaM tvamihAgataH ॥3॥
author: nāga uvāca ।

text: uktānukte kṛte kārye māmāmantrya dvijarṣabha । mayā pratyabhyanujñātastato yāsyasi brāhmaṇa ॥4॥
html:
uktānukte kṛte kārye māmāmantrya dvijarṣabha ।
mayā pratyabhyanujñātastato yāsyasi brāhmaṇa ॥4॥
slp1: uktAnukte kfte kArye mAmAmantrya dvijarzaBa । mayA pratyaByanujYAtastato yAsyasi brAhmaRa ॥4॥

text: na hi māṃ kevalaṃ dṛṣṭvā tyaktvā praṇayavāniha । gantumarhasi viprarṣe vṛkṣamūlagato yathā ॥5॥
html:
na hi māṃ kevalaṃ dṛṣṭvā tyaktvā praṇayavāniha ।
gantumarhasi viprarṣe vṛkṣamūlagato yathā ॥5॥
slp1: na hi mAM kevalaM dfzwvA tyaktvA praRayavAniha । gantumarhasi viprarze vfkzamUlagato yaTA ॥5॥

text: tvayi cāhaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha bhavānmayi na saṃśayaḥ । loko'yaṃ bhavataḥ sarvaḥ kā cintā mayi te'nagha ॥6॥
html:
tvayi cāhaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha bhavānmayi na saṃśayaḥ ।
loko'yaṃ bhavataḥ sarvaḥ kā cintā mayi te'nagha ॥6॥
slp1: tvayi cAhaM dvijaSrezWa BavAnmayi na saMSayaH । loko'yaM BavataH sarvaH kA cintA mayi te'naGa ॥6॥

text: evametanmahāprājña vijñātārtha bhujaṅgama । nātiriktāstvayā devāḥ sarvathaiva yathātatham ॥7॥
html:
evametanmahāprājña vijñātārtha bhujaṅgama ।
nātiriktāstvayā devāḥ sarvathaiva yathātatham ॥7॥
slp1: evametanmahAprAjYa vijYAtArTa BujaNgama । nAtiriktAstvayA devAH sarvaTEva yaTAtaTam ॥7॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: ya evāhaṃ sa eva tvamevametadbhujaṅgama । ahaṃ bhavāṃśca bhūtāni sarve sarvatragāḥ sadā ॥8॥
html:
ya evāhaṃ sa eva tvamevametadbhujaṅgama ।
ahaṃ bhavāṃśca bhūtāni sarve sarvatragāḥ sadā ॥8॥
slp1: ya evAhaM sa eva tvamevametadBujaNgama । ahaM BavAMSca BUtAni sarve sarvatragAH sadA ॥8॥

text: āsīttu me bhogapate saṃśayaḥ puṇyasañcaye । so'hamuñchavrataṃ sādho cariṣyāmyarthadarśanam ॥9॥
html:
āsīttu me bhogapate saṃśayaḥ puṇyasañcaye ।
so'hamuñchavrataṃ sādho cariṣyāmyarthadarśanam ॥9॥
slp1: AsIttu me Bogapate saMSayaH puRyasaYcaye । so'hamuYCavrataM sADo carizyAmyarTadarSanam ॥9॥

text: eṣa me niścayaḥ sādho kṛtaḥ kāraṇavattaraḥ । āmantrayāmi bhadraṃ te kṛtārtho'smi bhujaṅgama] ॥10॥
html:
eṣa me niścayaḥ sādho kṛtaḥ kāraṇavattaraḥ ।
āmantrayāmi bhadraṃ te kṛtārtho'smi bhujaṅgama] ॥10॥
slp1: eza me niScayaH sADo kftaH kAraRavattaraH । AmantrayAmi BadraM te kftArTo'smi BujaNgama] ॥10॥

text: sa cāmantryoragaśreṣṭhaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ kṛtaniścayaḥ । dīkṣākāṅkṣī tadā rājaṃścyavanaṃ bhārgavaṃ śritaḥ ॥1॥
html:
sa cāmantryoragaśreṣṭhaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ kṛtaniścayaḥ ।
dīkṣākāṅkṣī tadā rājaṃścyavanaṃ bhārgavaṃ śritaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: sa cAmantryoragaSrezWaM brAhmaRaH kftaniScayaH । dIkzAkANkzI tadA rAjaMScyavanaM BArgavaM SritaH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sa tena kṛtasaṃskāro dharmamevopatasthivān । tathaiva ca kathāmetāṃ rājankathitavāṃstadā ॥2॥
html:
sa tena kṛtasaṃskāro dharmamevopatasthivān ।
tathaiva ca kathāmetāṃ rājankathitavāṃstadā ॥2॥
slp1: sa tena kftasaMskAro DarmamevopatasTivAn । taTEva ca kaTAmetAM rAjankaTitavAMstadA ॥2॥

text: bhārgaveṇāpi rājendra janakasya niveśane । kathaiṣā kathitā puṇyā nāradāya mahātmane ॥3॥
html:
bhārgaveṇāpi rājendra janakasya niveśane ।
kathaiṣā kathitā puṇyā nāradāya mahātmane ॥3॥
slp1: BArgaveRApi rAjendra janakasya niveSane । kaTEzA kaTitA puRyA nAradAya mahAtmane ॥3॥

text: nāradenāpi rājendra devendrasya niveśane । kathitā bharataśreṣṭha pṛṣṭenākliṣṭakarmaṇā ॥4॥
html:
nāradenāpi rājendra devendrasya niveśane ।
kathitā bharataśreṣṭha pṛṣṭenākliṣṭakarmaṇā ॥4॥
slp1: nAradenApi rAjendra devendrasya niveSane । kaTitA BarataSrezWa pfzwenAklizwakarmaRA ॥4॥

text: devarājena ca purā kathaiṣā kathitā śubhā । samastebhyaḥ praśastebhyo vasubhyo vasudhādhipa ॥5॥
html:
devarājena ca purā kathaiṣā kathitā śubhā ।
samastebhyaḥ praśastebhyo vasubhyo vasudhādhipa ॥5॥
slp1: devarAjena ca purA kaTEzA kaTitA SuBA । samasteByaH praSasteByo vasuByo vasuDADipa ॥5॥

text: yadā ca mama rāmeṇa yuddhamāsītsudāruṇam । vasubhiśca tadā rājankatheyaṃ kathitā mama ॥6॥
html:
yadā ca mama rāmeṇa yuddhamāsītsudāruṇam ।
vasubhiśca tadā rājankatheyaṃ kathitā mama ॥6॥
slp1: yadA ca mama rAmeRa yudDamAsItsudAruRam । vasuBiSca tadA rAjankaTeyaM kaTitA mama ॥6॥

text: pṛcchamānāya tattvena mayā tubhyaṃ viśāṃ pate । katheyaṃ kathitā puṇyā dharmyā dharmabhṛtāṃ vara ॥7॥
html:
pṛcchamānāya tattvena mayā tubhyaṃ viśāṃ pate ।
katheyaṃ kathitā puṇyā dharmyā dharmabhṛtāṃ vara ॥7॥
slp1: pfcCamAnAya tattvena mayA tuByaM viSAM pate । kaTeyaM kaTitA puRyA DarmyA DarmaBftAM vara ॥7॥

text: tadeṣa paramo dharmo yanmāṃ pṛcchasi bhārata । asannadhīranākāṅkṣī dharmārthakaraṇe nṛpa ॥8॥
html:
tadeṣa paramo dharmo yanmāṃ pṛcchasi bhārata ।
asannadhīranākāṅkṣī dharmārthakaraṇe nṛpa ॥8॥
slp1: tadeza paramo Darmo yanmAM pfcCasi BArata । asannaDIranAkANkzI DarmArTakaraRe nfpa ॥8॥

text: sa ca kila kṛtaniścayo dvijāgryo bhujagapatipratideśitārthakṛtyaḥ । yamaniyamasamāhito vanāntaṃ parigaṇitoñchaśilāśanaḥ praviṣṭaḥ ॥9॥
html:
sa ca kila kṛtaniścayo dvijāgryo bhujagapatipratideśitārthakṛtyaḥ ।
yamaniyamasamāhito vanāntaṃ parigaṇitoñchaśilāśanaḥ praviṣṭaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: sa ca kila kftaniScayo dvijAgryo BujagapatipratideSitArTakftyaH । yamaniyamasamAhito vanAntaM parigaRitoYCaSilASanaH pravizwaH ॥9॥
